Tenía una reserva para el día 26 de diciembre 2020 para hacer noche en Lisboa antes de tomar un vuelo internacional el día 27 de diciembre a Brasil. El día 25/12 la aerolínea TAP modifica de forma imprevista mi fecha del vuelo, adelantando el mismo al día 26 de diciembre. Para no perder la reserva y teniendo en cuenta el problema, solicité por favor al Hotel modificar mi reserva para el día 4 de enero (justo mi vuelta de Brasil) pagando la diferencia de coste que fuera necesaria. Con esta modificación no perdería el dinero de la 1ª reserva y podría aprovechar mi reserva inicial. Rechazaron la modificación inmediatamente y ante mi insistencia han dado largas (consultas a la dirección del hotel, etc) respondiendo esta vez con posterioridad a la fecha solicitada para la modificación (4 de enero). Me sorprende mucho que en estos tiempos de pandemia y con la ocupación hotelera por los suelos, sean tan poco flexibles, tomando la reserva inicial para facturar sin tener en cuenta para nada la problemática ni el imprevisto (una modificación de un tercero, la aerolínea) y sin dar ninguna explicación más allá de la política de cancelaciones. No recomiendo para nada el establecimiento

Alfiya and Joao are wonderful hosts. Our flight got redirected to Faro and after a difficult journey back to Lisboa by coach, we arrived at 3am
Joao stayed up and greeted us with warmth and made us feel very welcome. The place is ideal and I wholeheatedly recommend staying there.
Great stay!
Excelente ubicación, un barrio bastante seguro con rapida conexiones con los diferentes medios de transporte. Relación calidad vs precio muy buena.

Appartement très propre
Au calme dans une petite ruelle typique et parfaitement situé

Great location and appartment, you can’t wish for a better host. Joao probably is the most friendly and avalaible host ever.
I’ll definitely book this appartment again if I go back to Lisbon.

5 stars easily earned. Thanks Alfiya and Joao, we had a great time thanks to you.
This place was awesome, super clean and in a great location. The owner is very nice and always available!

We loved our time in Lisbon and the apartment had everything our family of 5 needed. The location was perfect and walking around Lisbon or catching the tram or bus was very easy. The hosts went above and beyond, offering their friendship and kindness, making our trip even more memorable. We will definitely book here again next time we are in Lisbon.

1. The central location of the apartment cannot be beat: a 10 minute walk to the metro, train station, and downtown, next door to amazing mom and pop grocery stores, bars, and yummy restaurants.
2. The apartment was so quiet. I slept like a baby.
3. The best part was how enthusiastic and kind the host was. He even showed us around the neighborhood just because he had the time. We felt immensely welcomed and like locals because of his hospitality.
Stylish place in the heart of the city, I would definitely recommend staying here

Perfect spot to explore Lisbon! Could easily fit up to 6 people in the place and it is a great location to see and do lots in the city. If you have a rental car it could be very tricky though because there isn’t  a lot of parking in the neighbourhood and if you have a lot of luggage, it would be a bit of a walk to get to the apartment from where you park. We only stayed one night and it happened to be a Sunday, when street parking is free, so we found a spot to leave it overnight but we wouldn’t have been able to do that if we stayed longer. Apartment was exactly as described and very comfortable. Thanks for a great stay!
Alfiya met us at the apartment and was wonderful. Very friendly and gave a few recommendations for food. Apartment was clean and well presented

Alfiya and Joao were exceptional hosts. They met us at the apartment early and let us drop our bags off while we explored the city. They then showed us to some local places including restaurants and coffee shops. The apartment itself was lovely. They provided us with some heaters as it was a bit cold in the mornings. It was spotless, very clean and lots of tourist leaflets for us. Rooms were big and comfortable and the location ideal. Would recommend to anyone coming to Lisbon!
Great place to stay, close to the center and to many great places to see. Joao and his son were amazing.
Good location , very nice apartment, we had a tour around the house by Joan with advices where to eat, by things etc.. This was very kind.

Alfiya was the most humble and open hearted host that we have ever met. We got the best tips about what to do and eat at the area. The location of the appartment was great and despite its closeness to viewpoints and center, it's very quiet and comfortable. Thank you!

Wonderful apartment! As soon as we arrived to the Airbnb, the apartment was sparkling clean. The hosts are very welcoming and their hospitality is incredible. Thank you for making our stay at Lisbon a very pleasant one.

It was amazing. We we're greated at the door and after dropping off our luggage while the place was cleaned the host have us a quick tour if the area on foot. He was so nice. The location is amazing and everything was within reasonable walking distance.
Great place to stay! Very local and with great tips for good Portuguese restaurants.

João provided us a really warm welcome. He helped us finding the best adress in the neighborood, how to orientate ourself in the city., etc. The appartement is really convenient, clean, calm, so close to midtown and perfect for at least 3 persons.

El apartamento es bueno y tiene de todo. La ubicación PERFECTA, tiene de todo cerca, restaurantes, colmados, panaderías y vida nocturna.

Amazing value for money, Joao gave us great tips about what to see/where to go. Super hospitable people!!
You need to be aware of the stairs.  Very dark and steep, especially for a senior citizen.  The neighborhood is covered in graffiti.
Alfiya was a wonderful host, gave us a lot of suggestions for things to do around the area. Loved the balconies in the apartment, as well.

Alfiya et Joao nous ont accueillies comme personne ! Ils sont très attentionnés et très gentils ! Notre séjour c'est très bien passé, à 2 pas du  quartier animé mais au calme. Nous recommandons ! Peut-être à une prochaine fois ! Merci pour tout

Joao welcomed us to his & Alfiya’s peaceful, spacious apartment and, after our night there, looked after our cases and ensured we were safely on our way by the best route. The recommended places to eat worked out perfectly. Thanks!
João is a great host! The apartment is exactly like the pictures! Great location, everything was good.

It's a great place and you'll enjoy the night life around. Great restaurants nearby as well..
Recommended for you who do not bring car since everything is walking distance..
Really nice place, great hosts who were lovely people and full of amazing local suggestions.

This apartment is centrally located and quiet, which are usually mutually exclusive. The space itself is beautiful, with great recommendations available for guests, as well as all of the amenities one could hope for. DEFINITELY recommend, and we hope to get back!
Très bon accueil. João nous a attendu avec le sourire malgré nos 3h de retard dû au vol. L’appartement est spacieux et très bien situé pour profiter des douceurs de Lisbonne.

Alfiya was a wonderful host and he place was great! She met me at the door and walked me through the apartment and shared information about Lisbom and the neighborhood. She couldn't have been more welcoming and friendly. And that apartment was very comfortable and we'll appointed. Definitely recommend!

The best place to stay in Lisboa! Both Alfiya and her husband are super friendly and super helpful. Place is amazing, where clean, nice and big! There are many restaurants and small supermarkets minutes away! Easy way to get to all sights of Lisbon. Totally recommend to stay here!
公寓很舒適很乾淨，公寓位置很好，不論去哪裡都很方便，相當推薦此公寓。

Alfiya and her husband were amazing hosts and went above and beyond showing us around the neighborhood and even taking us to the area we could park. Thank you for everything!!!
The place was close to everything in barrio Alta and very clean.  The hosts were nice.  It is a basic place without a lot of updates but it depends on what you are looking for
Great location close to all amenities.  Highly recommend staying there.

Alfiya and her husband were amazing hosts!
They received us personally, they kept our luggage because we arrived earlier, they recommended a really good restaurant to have lunch and when we left, Alfiya’s husband helped us with our bags.
The apartment was very comfortable and very well located.
I highly recommend it!
感谢Alfiya女士。入住当天，她和她儿子亲自接待，并帮助我们搬运行李。感谢!
Big appartment, very clean, the beds were  very comfy.  We got a guided Tour in the area from the  owner. We felt very Welcom.

Thank you Alfiya and Joau for a lovely stay! We only had one night but everything was great. And thanks again for being able to walk around town and pick our luggage later, that was a great help! You are both very kind, lovely people:)

Apartment was just as described. Very central and easy to get around from here. We were met by Alfiya’s husband who stored our luggage as we early for check in. He then walked us around the area making suggestions of where we could eat and helping us to get our bearings. We also met Alfiya when she brought the apartment keys to us in the square where we were having some lunch. There are a lot of bars and restaurants in the area which are busy at night but there is not a lot of noice when inside the apartment. We were made to feel very welcome and would happily stay here again.

Our stay was absolutely over the top! From the time we were personally greeted until our checkout - we were extremely satisfied with our apartment!  Joao was exceptionally attentive and extremely helpful.  The apartment was sparkling clean, very comfortable and offered little special touches - such as bottled water and wine.  The special local tour upon arrival was excellent and we were delighted with the extra service loading our bags into our room, as well as upon check out!  The location of the apartment was well within walking distance to many attractions, and there were certainly several restaurants very close by! Thank you to our terrific hosts!  We would definitely recommend this apartment to anyone staying in Lisbon!

These hosts were so so helpful from the moment I booked the place. They offered to organise us a transfer from the airport straight to the apartment (25 euro BTW, such a bargain!) and we were met at the apartment. They shared key tourist information and gave us a map of which they located where we were. It was really helpful when we began to explore! We moved from Lisbon to Cascais and Alfiya could not have been more helpful organising us a taxi for this. The apartment is really central with all the amenities you need around it. Thank you!!l
Super location with beautiful views of the city and many restaurants nearby. Highly recommended!
We had a wonderful stay in Lisbon,the location was fabulous,a very fun place to stay. The host was very welcoming and helpful. Fully recommend it!

This location is in the heart of Bairro Alto, you are seconds away from the nightlife but you don’t hear it at night when you’re going to bed (big plus). As described in apartment details, would recommend!

Bonjour,
Nous avons passé un excellent séjour. Très bon accueil de notre hôte. Quartier très animée avec beaucoup de resto et services. Nous étions près de la Place du Commerce, des transports en commun et de lieux historiques à visiter.
Great location with a big, nicely laid-out apartment. Alfiya was super-helpful in getting us checked in, even though our flight was delayed and we didn't arrive until after 10pm.
Tolle Lage im Bairro Alto. Sehr zuvorkommende Gastgeber. Nach dem Check out konnte man sogar seine Koffer einlagern.
Alfiya ist sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Die Wohnung ist mitten in der Altstadt.
Great host, dated facilities.

An excellent apartment in a brilliant location. Lots of space and great value with plenty of room for up to 6 ( we were 2 adults, 3 kids). Area is a little noisy but that’s part of where you are. Lots of great bars and restaurants nearby. You can’t drive directly there so go to rue de Rosa, then try to drop off there and park in nearby place (host will tell you). We loved Lisbon and will definitely be back ( probably without the kids)
Cumple las espectativas, pero la casa es antigua y la calle por la noche es muy ruidosa por las fiestas de la gente. En todo caso el anfitrión fue agradable y la comunión rápida.
A great apartment in an amazing location! Alfiya is an awesome host with lots of ideas and suggestions for things to do in Lisbon!

We loved our stay in Alfiya’s apartment. It was a great location very near to the beautiful viewing point at Sao Pedro de Alcantara.
We also enjoyed a delicious buffet dinner with excellent service just around the corner from the apartment at Rosa da Rua.
Thank you for a lovely stay, we definitely want to come back to Lisbon for a longer holiday to explore more.
Piso en El Barrio Alto, a cuatro minutos de la Plaza Chiado o la estación de Rossio.
Super beautiful apartment, excellent location, great communication!!!!
Very nice flat and very nice owner. Alfiya has been very sweet and helpful to us. Great location close to everything to visit !

Joao vous réserve un accueil comme nul part ailleurs !!!!
Au petit soin il nous a bien expliqué et nous a même fait une visite guidée.
L'appartement est très bien situé pour visiter sans voiture lisbonne.

Nous n'avons pas cuisiné.
Appartement simple.!!!

Je recommande vivement cet appartement,  tant pour l emplacement que pour l appartement lui même.  Beau, grand , authentique et décoré avec soin. Sans oublié la gentillesse et le superbe accueil de Joao

Très court mais excellent séjour passé dans cet appartement très bien placé, propre et grand.
Nous avons pu profiter des trois chambres et avons apprécié le calme de la rue.

Joao was a wonderful host. He met us at the apartment and took us around the surrounding area to show us where to find everything. The apartment was everything we needed and in a good location to access the city. Highly recommend!

Joao was an amazing host. He greeted us on the street and carried our bags up to the apartment, and then took us on a short walking tour of the area so we could be familiar with everything the neighborhood had to offer.
At check out, we had to catch an early flight at 4 a.m., Joao called and made the taxi reservations for us, saving us a bit of stress, and was once again there to carry our bags down and see us off.
The apartment was well furnished, very clean, and very close to the attractions. It didn't have air conditioning, but we didn't need it. With the widows open, it was a very comfortable night of sleep even in the middle of July.
The WiFi wasn't the greatest, but it worked and was free so we really can't complain too much.
Great place to stay!
Exceeded all expectations. Delightfully refreshing with the hosts going out of their way many times over to make this a very special stay. Great location and peacefully quiet.

This is a lovely and very quiet apartment in a brilliant location from which to explore Lisbon. The hosts have outstanding hospitality! We very much enjoyed our stay and would highly recommend this property.
Wonderful apartment that feels like you’re in a 50s in the middle of Lisbon. Comfy beds and right in the middle of some of the best restaurants and bars in the city. Highly recommend staying here!

We only stayed one night, but we loved the location. We could walk to tons of places, and Joao was very helpful in making recommendations of good restaurants to try. We loved the m thoughtful touches of small treats and amenities for purchased in the apartment in case we needed anything! We wished we were in Lisbon for a longer than one day, and would recommend this apartment to anyone!
Muy buena comunicación, nos recomendó muchos sitios a los que ir, y las mejores zonas. La casa muy bonita y bien situada
La casa está muy bien situada al lado de una zona con mucha vida , los anfitriones te atienden muy bien
Perfect apartment, very spacious, clean and light. Very good location.

Apartment was clean and large, Barrio Alto was a fun area.
Всё хорошо, рекомендую.
Great location!
The place was booked for friends on their visit to Lisboa. They were throughout impressed and highly recommend the apartment. Thanks a lot Alfiya!
A genuine "old Lisbon " experience. Loved it!

The Sunshine1 apartment owned by Alfiya and Joao is situated in the old quarter of Lisbon (Bairro Alto) with restricted access for non-resident cars. We used local taxi, and this was the best way how to find the apartment in the middle of night.  The property position is just perfect for all sightseeing plans to discover such lovely city. Flat is situated at the 3rd floor, no elevator.  We rented 3 bedrooms, 1 kitchen equipped with everything what you need for short or long stays, spacious bathroom with bath, stylish living room and really loooong corridor. Entrance door looked secure. Everything clean, stylish with some elements of local history and culture. We were allowed to store our luggage for afternoon at the storage room which is situated at the basement of the house. Love it. Thanks Alfiya and Joao for your hospitality.

Beautiful, clean and cozy apartment, excellent location. Joao was an excellent host and provided us with great local tips.  We enjoyed our stay here. Would definitely recommend this place, hope to come back! :)
Alfiya and her husband were very helpful and friendly.  It was sparkling clean and we enjoyed our stay.

Alfiya, Joao and Ildar were such fantastic hosts! Their communication was superb, replying to messages very quickly. They booked us a transfer to and from the apartment, they ordered us prosecco for our arrival as we were visiting for a special occasion, they were available throughout our stay to give us tips and advice if we needed it. In the apartment they have a range of amenities, including milk, water, alcohol, coffee etc which could be purchased for a small cost. The apartment itself was super clean and comfortable, in a fabulous location and just a short walk from the shops and attractions. There are loads of bars and restaurants near the apartment. I can not fault them at all. Our stay was simply brilliant. I would certainly return and recommend their apartment.
En orden pero nada especial falta amor a los detalles .

Great stay at this apartment!
Large apartment with three double rooms! Good location walking distance to Lisbon high street
Lovely apartment just off the main streets so nice and peaceful. Sparkling clean upon arrival. Great location. Air con would be a bonus but the electric fans were ok. Would definitely recommend

Très bon logement.  Les propriétaires sont super gentils et attentionnés.  Joao nous a accompagnées le premier jour pour nous faire un peu visiter les lieux.  Il nous a donné de bonnes adresses de resto. Ils sont vraiment à écoute.  Merci  à vous . Le seul bémol est le bruit des nuits du week-end fait par des gens pas très respectueux.

There was slight confusion at the beginning with one of our friends finding the location. But this did not spoil our trip at all. When you meet Joao and his wife you will forget any worries you have. They are so kind and helpful! We look forward to returning again 😊

What amazing hospitality. We were treated so well by our hosts that this became a truly unique experience. From the personal tour and restaurant recommendations (please, everyone, eat at Rosa da Rua) really helped us tour Lisbon. The flat is in the perfect location for tourists looking to see the sites and experience the food and nightlife of Lisbon. Thank you for a wonderful experience. We cannot wait to be back!

We felt well looked after by João and Alfiya. He met us at the door and took us upstairs and showed us around. He recommended several restaurants, 2 of which we tried and loved. Both well within walking distance. If you are nervous about not being able to sleep because of it being close to a party neighbourhood, don’t be. We came on a weekend at the end of May, and had no trouble sleeping at all. When we checked out, they let us leave our bags there while we went to get lunch. They are very hospitable and helpful. I would love to stay there again if we come back to Lisbon. It was a safe and comfortable place to stay in a beautiful, charming, old part of the city.

Жуау и Альфия очень гостеприимные хозяева. Всегда на связи. В доме много карт, рекламных проспектов, визиток, которыми можно пользоваться. Лично встрчают, не смотря на задержки рейсов. Проводят экскурсию по городу, показывают рестораны, кафе и магазины, которыми пользуются местные жители. Чувствуется, что им хочется, чтобы их гости хорошо провели время в Лиссабоне.
В апартаментах есть всё необходимое. Квартира соответствует описанию и фото. Удобное местоположение, в центре, рядом остановки трамвая, автобусов, метро и вокзал, смотровая площадка, с которой открывается прекрасный вид на город, фуникулер, знаменитый лифт, музеи.
Жуау и Альфия любезно разрешили оставить вещи, так как у нас был поздний рейс, помогли вызвать такси, лично проводили. У Жуау и Альфии мы чувствовали себя как дома. Всем рекомендую это жилье.
Excellent accueil du propriétaire. Une adresse très très bien située. Je recommande.

Absolutely beautiful old Portuguese apartment. Has so much original character and feels well lived in. Location is also very central. The only slight downside is the WiFi was abit slow/I didn’t have good mobile signal in the apartment, but this didn’t affect how much I loved the place.

Never met such an excellent and thoughtful host. Alfiya guided us with beautiful food suggestions and was always there to help. She stored our luggages post checkout  and was extremely cooperative for the collection.

Жуау и Альфия очень гостеприимные хозяева. Точны, пунктуальны, всегда на связи. Наш рейс из Москвы задержирался, не смотря на это, встречали нас как дорогих гостей. Угостили вкусным вином. Рассказали о местоположении важных для нас объектов. Провели экскурсию по городу, показали красивые и милые уголки города, уютные ресторанчики, кафе, магазины, которыми пользуются местные жители. Предоставили карты, проспекты, визитки. Забронировали столик в ресторане для ужина с местным вином. Помогли с трансфером во время наших путешествий по стране.
Апартаменты удобно расположены в центре города, рядом метро, вокзал для поездки в Синтру, фуникулер, знаменитый лифт, музеи, парк и ботанический сад.
В квартире несколько балконов, один из которых выходит во внутренний дворик. Напротив два роскошных дерева, дающих тень на балкон, а в их
кроне живут птицы, с прекрасными голосами. И это в большом городе!
В апартаментах достаточно места для большой компании. Много посуды. Мы чувствовали себя как дома.
Всем рекомендую познакомиться с Альфией и Жуау и отдохнуть в их доме.
Joao’s place was so wonderful. It's close to everything and he was so nice to show us around a bit when we arrived. This place was so clean we really enjoyed our stay here:)

Great location while exploring Lisbon. Great hospitality from Alfiya He gave us a nice tour of the neighbourhood. Very clean and all we needed for our family of 4. Thank you and we would definitely go back.
Great place in the center of lisbon
Thank you Alfiya & Joao for your kind & warm hospitality. They provided us lots of travel information & valuable suggestions. Highly recommend!!!
Es un apartamento muy recomendable y acogedor. El apartamento tiene todo lo necesario. Y Alfiya es una persona muy agradable. Se preocupa por todo y te da buenos consejos para que tú te sientes bien.

L'appartement est très propre et très agréable à vivre. Il est parfaitement situé dans une petite rue calme, dans un quartier proche du centre ville et desservi par le tram et les bus. Si vous êtes au moins trois privilégiez les taxis, ça vous coûtera moins cher que les transports en commun. Allez chez Joao vous serez accueilli à bras ouvert.

Great location excellent value for money and very clean.
We had a warm welcome from our hosts who provided us with lots of local information.

Fantastic apartment, so close to everything.
The apartment is very very quiet at night which was remarkable considering the crazy nightlife around the corner but that shouldn't put you off!! You can have a quiet relaxing stay with option of great bars/ restaurants all within walking distance.
We arrived in the evening with 3 children. Alifiya had arranged airport transfer for us and was there to greet us. She gave us a quick tour of the area which gave us the confidence to explore.

Nous avons vraiment très bien été accueilli à notre arrivée sachant que nous avons eut quelques péripéties lors de notre départ de Nantes, nous faisant arriver avec 1 journée de retard. Mais Joao a toujours été en lien avec nous pour nous rassurer sur sa présence pour notre arrivée. Une fois sur place Joao a pris le temps de nous indiquer les lieux et restaurants où nous pouvions aller les yeux fermés. Merci Joao pour ce beau séjour.

Joao is an amazing host, very engaging, knowledgeable and helpful. The space is clean, bright and a good size. Great location, near some amazing restaurants and very walkable. Can be a bit difficult if you have a car. Overall, a really great experience.
A great stay and lovely welcome - highly recommended. Thank you!
Awesome nice place to stay and close to many good restaurants and places. I will love to return. Thanks for everything....

What a fantastic stay, the home had so much character.  It was comfortable and spacious for 3 adults and 3 children.   The location was perfect for walking around the city.  What really separated the stay was the touch upon check-in of walking us around to acclimate us with the area.  That was worth every penny of the stay. The owners are so great.  They stored our luggage before and after the stay, and even had food and water for purchase in the kitchen   I would highly recommend this home to anyone visiting Lisbon!

Our stay at Alfiya's place was really great, my boyfriend and I spent our last night in Lisbon. It was super close to all the bars and really amazing restaurant. Really easy to get in touch - we met the host and he gave us some awesome tips for restaurants. The kitchen was also stocked if you wanted to stay-in and cook. Overall, really great stay and would stay again next time.

Great apartment with everything that you need. Alfiya was really nice and had a lot of local tips for restaurants and breakfast places. But, the apartment is in Bairro Alto, which means you always have to climb up a hill to get there.
But besides that, we really loved the apartment and it has everything that you need!

Great location, close to the main Rossio station, as well as some great restaurants and shopping. The hosts went over and above to provide suggestions on places to go and things to do. As well as helping us with the check-in. Very very nice!!  Tidy place and just what you need!

We had a fantastic experience here. Alfiya personally met us at check in and recommended some restaurants that were amazing. She was accommodating at check out which really helped us get some more fun in on our last morning in Lisbon. There are some narrow stairs to get up to the unit, so be sure to take your time climbing the steps.
Hermoso aartamento muy bien situado. Su propietario muy amable y servicial.
Perfect location, close to many sights. Beautiful neighborhood. Have shampoo, towels, Internet, would definitely come again.

We had a fabulous stay with Alfiya and João. Communication was a breeze throughout the whole process. The apartment is well equipped and the location could not be any better. We hope to return to Lisbon and stay here again. Alfiya and João were so helpful and nice. We hope to see them again.
My friend and I stayed here for one night, and it was great. It's a very spacious and clean apartment, they had a lot of tips on what to do around Bairro Alto and check in was easy. I recommend it.

This apartment is great! Very spacious and centrally located. We arrived before check in, but the hosts let us drop our bags, gave us the keys early, texted us when the apartment was ready, and even brought our bags upstairs for us! It was a smooth and easy process. We also highly recommend the restaurant a few doors down!

My brother and I stayed here for one night and enjoyed our stay! The host was extremely helpful and responsive and even had a taxi waiting for us the next morning to the train station. He also showed us around Lisbon and recommended restaurants and cafés nearby.
The place was clean and spacious, however it was a little bit dark and spooky - while also being a bit loud at night due to a festival. The wi-fi also only works in one room, the living room but that didn’t seem to be too much of an issue.

The apartment is in a great location right in the heart of the Bairro Alto and convenient to explore Lisbon. The hosts were fantastic and took the time to give us a brief overview of the neighbourhood and where to visit/public transport etc. We would absolutely recommend a stay here, and would definitely return - Lisbon is such a great and friendly city!
O apartamento, além de fantástico e bem organizado, é muito aconchegante. O Sr. João é um anfitrião extraordinário. Muito solícito, cortês. Recomendo em absoluto o apartamento dele.

Des hôtes charmants, à l'écoute et très réactifs. Alfiya et Joao ont organisé le transfert via José un chauffeur adorable. Our host was simply amazing. Check in and getting to the place was very convenient. Also Alfiya took her time to point out local spots and showed us how to get around. The location was good and the apartment was very cozy. I definitely recommend this place.

Beautiful place and great location in Bairro Alto. The apartment had everything I needed and the hosts' communication was fast and nice. If you're looking for a nice and accessible place to stay in the hills of Lisbon, this is it.
Lovely hosts, excellent location. Recommended.
The apartment is in a great location. Walkable to many restaurants and sites. Great view of parts of the city next door in the park. Really enjoyed our stay!
Alfiya and Ildar are wonderful hosts. The apartment exceeded all our expectations, which were already high! The personal welcome and tour of the neighbourhood upon arrival were a wonderful surprise!
Apartamento con mucho encanto situado en uno de los barrios de moda de Lisboa, y con unos anfitriones encantadores!! Recomendable 100%
Uma curta e agradável experiência! O João foi um ótimo  anfitrião!
Super séjour ,la description est parfaite

Superb hosts who are so friendly and helpful, they gave us some great tips. Easy to contact at all times. Great amenities in the apartment. The location is excellent, would highly recommend this place!

Superbe appart ! Très chaleureux bien situé , personne très accueillant qui a prit le temps de nous donner de bon conseils et des super resto ! Un grand merci

Very accommodating host who worked with us with our early arrival time and showed us around the neighborhood. Very well located for nightlife. If you have accessibility concerns and needs, keep in mind that there are stairs up to the flat.

3층이라 체크인 체크아웃시 힘들었지만 호스트가 정말 친절해요

good place to stay but rather expensive according to all the other places we've been to in Portugal
Very nice of the hosts to walk through the neighborhood with us to help orient us for food, coffee, where to meet Uber, etc.

Very close to the nightlife of the city but very quiet. Great hosts keen to help with any questions that we had. Would return to stay if we were to return to Lisbon again.
The flat is basic but clean. Drinks are available but at a cost. €1.50 for a can of Coke seemed a little steep when staying as guests in an airbnb; hotel type prices.
Beds were extremely comfy!
Thanks for a great stay.
Excellent emplacement, très propre et confortable, tout le nécessaire pour un sejour ! :)

The place and the hosts were super! We had red all the good reviews in before hand and they were totally true! Excellent location, clean and nice appartement. And the hosts and the driver they have organized for us were so friendly. Thank you Lisbon!

João was fabulous. He met us early  (we arrived in Lisbon on a early flight) and allowed us to store our baggage until the proper check in time. He showed us around the area and suggested good restaurants and which sites to see. When we got back after check-in time our baggage had all been taken upstairs. The same when we left, we went out for the morning and when we arrived back to collect our luggage it had all been stored downstairs for easy collection. He also took our son down to the police station to report the loss of his camera (he left it in the taxi) and stayed there to translate his statement from English to Portuguese. Alfiya was also very friendly and communicated very well in English. The apartment was very comfortable and had everything we needed. It was in a perfect location, close to everything but on a nice quiet street. We would definitely stay there again. 😊
We had a great stay, and very much appreciated the quick communications and tips for getting from the airport + being able to leave our luggage there until our flight. I would definitely stay again!

Apartamento grande e confortável. Perto do agito do bairro alto. Bem
Movimentado. Bons restaurantes por perto. Anfitriões atenciosos e solícitos. Recomendo.

The apartment was wonderfully charming and spacious, with many special touches! The spaces were very neat and clean and well taken care of. The hosts were absolutely wonderful and went above and beyond to make sure we were taken care of. They met us at a late hour after our flight landed to make sure we knew everything we needed to know about the apartment, and were very good with communicating throughout. Thank you so much for a short but great stay, if I am back in Lisbon I will definitely consider booking with you again! :)
I can only recommend. If you are going to Lisbon, choose this accommodation.
언덕이라는 후기를 보고 괜찮겠지 했는데 택시 타시거나 트램 비슷한거 타고 꼭 올라오세요. 캐리어 끌고오느라 힘들었어요ㅜ 집은 크고 쾌적합니다. 근처 맛집도 알려주고요. 3층인데 엘레베이터가 없어요ㅜ 체크인때는 호스트가 들어줬는데 짐 내릴땐 힘들었네요 ~
everything was great.  hosts were very responsive !
very Nice People, Nice place. very good price. we would choose this again!

It was very smooth, I would recommend to anyone that wants a central location.
A lovely place in the heart of Lisbon, amazing for bigger groups with greats hosts too.
A very good location, clean apartment and excellent hosts!

What a find! Alfiya and João accommodated us on such short notice and went out of their way to help us check in early.

The place was great, clean and exactly as advertised. wish we stayed here longer. Highly recommended.

Awesome place in an awesome location with an outstanding host.

João is very sweet and enthusiatic, and not to mention he and his sister help us greatly when we desperately need help！
It's a big apartment ,simple yet very comfy, especially the warmth from João^^

Joao’s apartment is clean, cozy, and spacious. It has everything you will need on your trip. He is the best host I have ever experienced on Airbnb. He’s warm, kind, and so very knowledgeable. He walked with us through the city of Lisbon showing us where we can find the best sights, restaurants, and activities. He was very easy to reach through the app and was always ready to answer any questions we had.
Great location and wonderful atmosphere

We stayed at two places in Lisbon and Alfiya and Joao's place was our favorite. It was raining heavily and we took much longer than anticipated to arrive into Lisbon from Sintra, and Joao was very attentive to our arrival time.  He was efficient with communicating through the messaging platform and was waiting for us outside on the street as we were trying to locate the apartment! After we got settled in, he showed us the best place for us to get picked up to go to the airport the following morning and where the local laundromat was located at (and opened til midnight). Heaters were on throughout the apartment when we arrived making our rainy, wet day more bearable and it was extremely spacious for our family of four.  There was a selection of complimentary items in the kitchen and some premium items for sale if desired. We wish we had more time to explore Bairro Alto, but this apartment was nicely located in close proximity to many restaurants, bars, and other nightlife.  Time Out Market was just about a 15 minute walk south so that wasn't bad either.  Would definitely look up this place to check availability next time we drop into Lisbon again!
Logement très bien situé, propre, calme.  En plus nous avons eu droit à une visite guidée du quartier.  Je recommande fortement.

This apartment is great! It’s in the perfect area. Alfiya met us outside and showed us a place for lunch and offered to show us more. My friend and I were too tired from our flight so we decided to nap. It’s close to so many restaurants and bars, but you don’t hear any noise. I would definitely stay here again.

Merci à Monsieur Joao pour toutes ses marques d'attentions, tout le temps qu'il a prit pour nous expliquer les bons restaurants et les endroits touristiques. Nous avons passé un super séjour. L'emplacement est ideal pour visiter Lisbonne et etre au calme pour dormir. Recommande vivement.
Great, centrally located accommodation with friendly, informative hosts. Will return again

Alfiya and her husband Joao definitely rank as "super hosts" in our estimation.      The welcome was equally warm on our second visit, with Joao there to carry our luggage, arrange for car to airport, recommend local restaurants NOT saturated with tourists, and in general, give us a genuine taste of Portuguese kindness and generosity of spirit.
Juao, thank you very much for using your apartment and that you did care about us. We had a fantastic night at the old Town Lisbon. Will come back! Regards Andreas

The location of this flat in the old city of Lisbon in brilliant. You can get to so many cool places on foot very easily. The old city offers many bars, cafes, restaurants and small shops. We loved it there!
Alfiya and Joao are amazing hosts. We were given a short walking tour of the local area and given great tips. On the day of departure we needed a taxi at 4.30am. Joao was standing there at our doorstep to make sure the taxi arrived on time!
The flat itself is really really nice. It offers everything you need and is very nicely furnished. I didn’t sleep so well in the hard bed but some people prefer hard beds. You can’t satisfy everybody. Although it’s in the centre of the busy old town with its night life, the flat is extremely quiet. I’d return to this apartment anytime and can truly recommend it.
Close to transportation, close to cafes, restaurants, museums and waterfront

Alfiya and her husband Joao certainly go above and beyond being welcoming and helpful hosts.    My husband and I were sent on separate flights to Lisbon because of overbooking after storm etc.   My husband arrived before me with his mobile phone out of credit and unable to find an   Orange store. Apartment clean, comfortable and welcoming.

Très bel appartement, confortable et très calme dans la vieille ville haute. Excellent accueil et séjour. Difficultés à se garer. Merci au fils d’Alfiya de nous avoir conseillés et guidés  à notre arrivée. Nous recommandons vivement ce logement

great location, the mini tour on arrival was very helpful,  luggage storage and airport pickup is  a great service. lovely clean and comfortable apartment. If you are looking for a city break I would definitely recommend Lisbon and this apartment

Great location and very clean apartment. This great place provides everything you need for a short stay in Lisbonne.

The apartment is beautiful with lots of character and plenty of space - no air conditioning did not matter because the apartment was lovely and cool.
Jao and Alfiya will see us again on our next trip to Lisbon. I can highly recommend this apartment for your stay in Lisbon - the location could not be more perfect. Central yet quiet with a fantastic restaurant with great tapas a few meters down the road.
We loved it!

This is a nice apartment, but expected for the price.  The location is exceptional, but a map would be a nice touch.  Communication was very good.

Eine tolle Bäckerei bietet gleich um die Ecke auch ein Frühstück. Es gibt zahlreiche nette Restaurants  in der Gegend.

Absolutely amazing place and seamless check-in and check out! Ilya was a great host - provided local tips and a quick tour of the surroundings. The apartment had everything I could need, large, clean and beautiful and in an excellent location. Great place to stay in Lisbon- highly recommend!

Alfiya was an excellent host, he welcomed us to the apartment and showed us around the apartment and also gave up an hour of his time to give us a tour around the immediate area to show us the local sites, restaurants and amenities.
The apartment was clean and located in a an area close to the restaurants and bars, but not too close to spoil our sleep.
Alfaya booked our taxi to the airport when we left and was also there to say goodbye.
We have no hesitation in recommending a stay at the Sunshine apartment in Lisbon.
Fantastic location in the heart of historic Lisbon. Lovely host.

Geweldige appartement met heel veel charme. Je voelt je echt deel van Lissabon. Alles is aanwezig in dit ruime appartement om een geweldig verblijf te hebben in de stad. We loved the appartment! The Check-in was perfect (we had a flight delay and he was waiting for us), they organized a perfect transport for 6 persons + luggage from the airport to the Appartement!

Fantástico! Próximo de tudo, bom para caminhar durante o dia e a noite. Restaurantes e vida noturna muito próximos. Durften die Koffer einstellen nach dem check-out und Joao hat für uns ein Taxi für die Rückfahrt organisiert.
Nice apartment in lovely location. The host was very gracious and kind.
Een prima plek in Lissabon. Een leuke authentieke buurt. Bij aankomst een kleine rondleiding door de buurt gekregen. Cafeetjes in deze wijk genoeg, maar geen overlast daarvan.
The apartment was very nice and big! João is a very kind host he organized even a taxi for the airport and took care of our suitcases while we were in discovering the city. Highly recommended!

Netter und herzlicher Empfang durch den Gastgeber. Der Gastgeber hat sich freundlicherweise auch um ein Taxi vom und zum Airport gekümmert (ca. 20 - 25 EUR). Das Apartment war wie beschrieben und in einer Top-Lage mittem im Bairo Alto. Die Wohnung war dennoch sehr ruhig und wir konnten gut schlafen. Eine typische Lissaboner Altstadtwohnung, zweckmäßig und ohne übermäßigem Luxus.
This was a great place and the host went above and beyond to accommodate us  which was really appreciated. Thanks

Alfiya, Joao and IIdar were the perfect hosts - we were greeted on arrival and also checked out at 5:15am with a goodbye to make sure we got our taxi in time to go to the airport! The apartment was spotless and there was so much space. The location was also amazing. Highly recommend : )
Great location, lots of space, and excellent hospitality.

It's a nice flat, wll located in Barrio Alto, which is really close to the city center and all the momunents to visit. It is and old building, and maybe if you are sensitive to cold is not your flat, we went in april 1st and we had to slep with the heater on because the windows do not completly close. In photos it's seem newest than really are, but i supose that is a tipical flat from that neirborhoud.

Wir würden sehr herzlich empfangen....auch der Transfer vom und zum Flughafen wurde von Ihm super organisiert!!!
Nach der Begrüßung ging’s gleich mit einer privaten Stadtführung los...wo er uns viele wertvolle Tipps (Restaurant und schöne Pätze) gezeigt hat!!!
Wir würden jeder Zeit wieder bei ihm buchen!!! 100% empfehlenswert!!!

Joao was very helpful and after meeting me and showing me the apartment, he took me around the surrounding area and pointed out a few interesting spots and restaurants etc. He was very friendly and helpful and the apartment was ideally located. Thanks again!

Great location, stones throw away from tourist spots, restaurants and bars. Despite close location no noise from street, so was still able to get a good nights sleep. Lovely hosts, excellent communcation before and during trip and gave local tips on arrival. They also provided taxi to and from Airport which was very helpful. Apartment is clean and spacious, no complaints, would stay again and recommend to friends. Fiona

Thank you for a wonderful stay in your beautiful city and apartment! The location is ideal for exploring nearby shopping attractions sightseeing and dining. The value is amazing for how much space there is and the ideal location. You are both very helpful and accommodating hosts, we would love to come back sometime!

Thank you to our hosts for being fantastic. Their apartment is modern, clean, great value and right in the heart of Barrio Alto meaning it is surrounded by bars and restaurants filled with locals and fantastic (and good value) food and drink. Our hosts were there on check in, were able to book taxis for us from and to the airport, provided us with tonnes of helpful information and even gave us a tour of the local area (and an umbrella, because we were unlucky on the weather front!) . They were also on hand throughout our stay, replying to messages quickly. Barrio Alto is a fab place to stay. As I said, it is full of local bars and restaurants, but this apartment is a 5 min walk from the funicular down to town, a nice 15 - 20 min walk down to the time out market and train station which takes you to LX factory and Belem, 15 min down into town. Also nearby other public transport and there are lots of convenience stores minutes away from the apartment for any essentials you may need (although some food and beverage is provided in the apartment at a cost) shampoo and body wash also provide and hairdryer. Comfy beds and towels provided. You must visit Alfama for beautiful old town Lisbon. A fair walk from the apartment but easy by bus / tram that you can get from the main square in Barrio Alto.    Highly recommend! Thank you for a fantastic stay - we will be back!

No discription to explain how wonderful Joao was arriving, during and upon our return to the apartment. We were only there 24 hours but the service we got was so far above 5 star it was unbelievable. We did not cook in the unit as we were there  such a short time. However we did need the heaters and appreciated they were there. It's a cosy spacious two bedroom apartment that is incredible value. The location is stellar. But what made it outstanding was the hosts.   Not only would we recommend this location but we will be back on our next trip to Lisbon to stay here.
Five stars for sure... great area everything you need and very clean.. 100% recommended it was not the last time.. thanks

We were four adults and one teenager in this lovely apartment.  Very comfortable and clean on a lovely local street, where the locals live.  Very near the action but extremely quiet at night. The neighbourhood was very inviting and charming.  We were taken on a brief and wonderful tour of the surrounding streets, and the food recommendations were spectacular.  Overall, great neighbourhood, terrific apartment.  The hosts even assist with stocking the fridge for you and leaving a price list - no need to run out and pick up a few necessities, it was all there.  Prices were extremely reasonable and all was appreciated.  We would love to return for a longer stay in this beautiful city.
Mooi en sfeervol appartement, gunstig gelegen, in een rustig straatje. Dichtbij de metro, goede verbinding met de luchthaven. Een echte aanrader voor een paar dagen Lissabon!

Joao nous a formidablement bien accueillies! grâce à sa visite du quartier nous avons pu noter toutes les bonnes adresses et commencer à nous repérer! l'appartement est idéalement situé, très propre et nous y avons passé 3 jours parfaits! Merci mille fois pour votre accueil, votre gentillesse et votre disponibilité!
전망대까지 갈 필요가 없이 집 앞에서 좋은 경치를 볼 수 있다. 캐리어를 끌고 가는 길은 조금 힘들다.
Love everything about this apartment.

Sr. João foi muito atencioso conosco e ainda facilitou a nossa vida ao deixar que um amigo que vive em Lisboa fizesse o check-in para nós. Apartamento grande e espaçoso.  Muito obrigado e certeza que voltaremos.

Great Apartment
Great Location.
Very kind & helpful hosts -
1. Arranged both our airport taxi transfers.
2. Stored our luggage on arrival & 3 hours before check in - as well as carried them up to the apartment.
3. Provided a guided tour of the immediate neighbourhood to help us settle in and get our bearings.

Essentially - Highly Recommended.
We will hopefully be back next year!

An amazing location, good rooms and beds and even though it is in an area known for going out and parties, the house is really quiet and you hear nothing from the outside/parties. Highly recommended and very very friendly people with good local advice and quick communication.

Eu, minha esposa e meus dois filhos (24 e 16 anos) estivemos em Lisboa por uma tarde, uma noite e uma manhã. O apartamento nos atendeu perfeitamente, muito espaçoso e limpo. Destaco que a hospitalidade do Sr. João, o transfer (agendado por ele) e suas dicas foram fundamentais para transformar nossas poucas horas em Lisboa num tempo muito bem aproveitado. A localização é excelente, bons restaurantes, bares e pontos turísticos acessíveis a pé. Há escadas, mas facilmente superáveis. O Sr. João é o símbolo do espírito do Airbnb.
Nice appartement

Warning this review is LONG but detailed. Please read if you plan to stay here. The Pros soften the Cons, but, there are Cons.
Pros:
As Described. If you read the other reviews, everything is as described, unit has an old rustic vibe. Large enough for a big group or family, clean and in a secure building. Beds are comfortable.
Location. Near many restaurants, bars, sights and night life. In walking distance to Everything! Major Pro.
Hospitality. IIdar is a great host, going above and beyond in receiving us. He even gave us a mini tour of the area, on arrival and scheduled taxis for us to and from airport. IIdar was very responsive to all our communications.
Cons:
Foul Order. The house had a weird smell like bengay and burning wood. The bathroom also had a weird pungent smell, like sewage. We had to keep bathroom door shut so the smell would not linger throughout the house. Though the sewage smell is not unique to the AirBNB, we noticed this throughout establishments in Lisbon. Also could be attributable to building construction.
No Heat. There is no central heating system, space heaters are provided but the unit is cold in the winter. The space heaters were effective in warming the unit, but they were gas heaters ( also contributing to smell). ** IIdar and his family went above and beyond supplying us with extra heaters, blankets and even warming sacks. Obviously this won’t be a problem for warmer stays.
Thin walls, extremely thin. You could hear EVERYTHING, including construction work that started at 7am, DAILY and lasted until 5pm. The unit directly below was being renovated, so the workers sounded as if they were directly in our unit, you heard every word, hammer, nail, drill and saw. I highly recommend checking if construction is still on going before booking. Waking up to drill on vacation is NOT my idea of vacation. ** IIdar asked the workers to wait until at least 9am but they started at 7 anyway.
No elevator. If you have heavy luggage, please note that you are walking up several flights of stairs. ** Though IIdar and his Dad were helpful with carrying our luggage.
While I probably won’t stay here again, I think IIdar and his family were great! They were wonderful. The coldness, construction and smell killed the experience for me, especially after long days of walking and or partying.
Ildar was so nice and helpful. The apartment is in a great location, walking distance to everywhere. Definitely recommend!
Accoglienza calorosissima e appartamento perfetto!  Raccomandato  😉🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

We are four friends who travel to different cities in Europe for a long weekend break.  We had a brilliant stay at Alfiya's apartment, which was very central and a great place to see Lisbon from.  The apartment was in excellent order and it was a great help for us to leave our bags there as we arrived early on the Friday and were leaving late on the Monday.  Joao was particularly helpful in showing us around the area where the apartment was and helping us get our bearings.  He also recommended some great places to visit and to eat.  Overall we had a fantastic weekend and felt very relaxed while staying at this apartment.  We would highly recommend this apartment to anyone thinking of visiting Lisbon.

Joao est un hôte souriant, d'une extrême gentillesse, attentif.
Très bonne communication pour notre arrivée.
Joao a su nous conseiller de très bonnes petites adresses pour nous restaurer.
L'appartement correspond en tout point à l'annonce.
Nous n'hésiterons pas à y retourner lors de notre prochaine venue à Lisbonne.
Nous ne retiendrons que du positif.
Merci beaucoup Joao.
Au plaisir.
Benoît et Nicolas

This is the place to stay in Lisbon! Location is perfect since it is walking distance to most of the tourist sites, the apartment is super clean, Alfiya and Joao are the best hosts ever (the nicest people with a great attitude) and they gave me some really good tips on places to visit, restaurants and much more. I’d definitely stay with them again on my next trip to Lisbon.Thank, Merci.
João e seu filho são muito simpáticos. O prédio está, no entanto, em obras. Há muito barulho e sujeira. A rua também não é das mais limpas do bairro...

It was not easy to get to the hotel, but thanks to the kind host, I found it well and it is convenient to go to and from the house is relatively easy to use and organized. But the ground floor is dark and the corridor is narrow and it is very good.
Alles so wie erwartet, die Kommunikation war super und die Wohnung ist schön & groß :) Super Lage!
The house was clean and comfortable. The Alfiya was kind. I was able to get comfortable by taking care of it first. I recommend it as a good home.

The apparatement has a very good location, and everything you need. I suggest , if you do not take a taxi, use the bus line number 758 from Metro Rato to Elvador da Gloria,from their you walk 2 minutes. The flat is on one of the many hills, and this was rather convenient.
João foi super solicito e simpático. A todo momento esteve disponível para o que precisassemos. O apartamento é agradável, bem localizado e supriu todas as nossas necessidades. Recomendamos.

Der check in wäre um 15 uhr gewesen was ich aber überlesen hatte. Joao hat uns trotzdem viel früher und sehr sehr freundlich empfangen. Great host and great stay...

This was a great place. Close to the night life, public transit, restaurants and so much more. Being in the centre of the night life we did not hear the street noise. Our host greeted us and was very helpful. We truly enjoyed our stay.

Right in the heart of a very historic area. These buildings are old and authentic. The history is so interesting. They were built after the devastation of the earth quake and TsuNami in the 1700s. Our hosts organised Taxis for us before we arrived and on departure and were so attentive with plenty of suggestions as to how to fill our time.
Walk downhill from the apartment and you will come to the historic wharf area. The apartment is also in very close proximity to to the firms elevator, very Hill trolley, and the castle. We loved our stay in Lisbon.
Beautiful apartment centrally located. Everything we needed, including comfortable beds and heater! Host was super friendly and helpful. Parking available nearby. Well stocked, well equipped kitchen.

Fab apartment, in the right location for exploring Lisbon, in a quiet street, but surrounded by super restaurants and lots of bars, everything within walking distance, the apt. is well equipped and this time of year lovely and warm.
Great little apt in the centre of Lisbon. Superb value for money. Great hospitality from Joao.
Super nice host, very helpful. Apartment was comfortable, clean and we'd stay again!

Joao war ein toller Gastgeber, er hat die Fahrten zwischen Flughafen und Wohnung mit dem Taxi für uns arrangiert. Er hat einen Gang mit uns durchs Viertel gemacht und tolle Tipps für Frühstück, Einkäufe, Restaurants und versteckte Plätze/Sehenswürdigkeiten gegeben. Die Wohnung war ruhig und sauber und in toller Lage. Jederzeit wieder!

Wir waren sehr zufrieden, wurden spät Abends nach unserer Ankunft noch sehr nett empfangen. Am nächsten Morgen kam Herr Alfiya noch vorbei um uns mit Gegebenheiten bekannt zu machen. Er hat für uns die Rückfahrt zum Flughafen organisiert und wir hätten ihn immer um Rat fragen können. So einen Vermiter hatten wir noch nie auf einer Reise. Vielen Dank 🙏 es war sehr schön bei Ihnen und in Lissabon

Prima appartement in een rustige straat. Alfiya regeert snel op berichten. Bij aankomst kregen we gelijk allerlei tips, waarbij ze even mee naar buiten liep om een aantal plaatsen aan te wijzen direct in de omgeving van het appartement.

Appartement ancien très bien situé, métro, tramway ,restaurants .
L’accueil, la disponibilité, la gentillesse de la famille furent très appréciés, personnes charmantes.
emplacement ideal , hote parfait ....agreable et prevenant

Alfiya and Joao were perfect hosts. Very friendly, great communication before and during stay.
The apartment was a great size and had everything we needed.
The location was great. Down the road was of a stunning view, and very close to restaurants and bars.
logement bien placé, propre et agréable...nous avons été très bien accueillis, guidés  dans la ville. j y retournerai avec plaisir!
Top Lage und sehr herzliche Gastfreundschaft durch Vermieter Alfiya und Joao. Sehr gutes Preis Leistung Verhältnis.
João esposa e filho são ótimos anfitriões. Estiveram presentes a todas as necessidades. Sempre dispostos a ajudar e colaborar com as nossas necessidades.
Gostamos muito..especialmente o Sr . João que foi duma amabilidade extrema! Voltaremos concerteza!Até breve.
Excellent place to stay and value for money. Centrally located close to interesting places and transport, very helpful host, strongly recommended.

The apartment is great and Alfiya is a really lovely host!
The Check-In was super-easy with him, because he told us a lot about Bairro Alto and he showed us possibilities to eat and buy food around the apartment. So our welcome was very heartly, warm and informative! The district the apartment is in, is one of the most beautiful in Lissabon. And although most of Lissabons nightlife is taking place in Bairro Alto, directly around the apartment - the flat itself is a quite place to stay and take a time-out.
At the end of our Lissabon visit, Alfiya was ordering a taxi for us and he got up at 3 a.m. (!!!) just to be sure that everything is fine with us and that we get our taxi to the airport! So I really strongly recommend to stay at Alfiya's place, if you visit Lissabon - you won't find a better host and a better location for your homebase!

We had a wonderful stay at this apartment with our 2 children. It is spacious and is in a wonderful location - close to restaurants and the centre of Lisbon. The hosts are very welcoming and helpful. We were given a short tour of the area and taxis were booked for us when we needed it. I would recommend it!

Hôte tres accueillant, disponible et donne de bons conseils. Le logement est propre, équipé et conforme aux photos. On recommande vivement ce grand logement en plein Lisbonne. Nous comptons y retourner !!

Logement très bien situé pour une visite optimale de Lisbonne., entouré de restaurants et de bars et en plein quartier ERASMUS.
A conseiller ++

We stayed at this place for 3 nights. It's a wonderful location for travelers who want to explore Lisbon, but do not want the sounds of the street to ruin their peaceful nights. Joao was the perfect host who goes out of his way to ensure that you enjoy Lisbon like a local. We got a walking tour of the highlights around the area, including his recommendations for places to eat, enjoy Fado and do grocery shopping. I would definitely stay here or with Joao's hosted places again.

L'appartement est très bien situé car on peut se déplacer à pied. Il est dans une petite rue très calme aucune nuisances. Il est  propre et bien équipé. Les chambres sont spacieuses et la literie est bonne.

Super clean. Terrific location. Great attention to details in outfitting the place.  Extremely helpful and gracious hosts. Excellent communication. They even arranged for a private pick up at the airport for just a few euros more than the taxi price.  Which we felt was well worth it. Plus a private driver to our car rental location the next morning.  110%

Ildar is a very kind and polite host. We needed to change the check in time because of traffic just some hrs before arrival but it was no problem to him. Thanks for that again :). The check in was very quick and the late check out time made our lisbon nightlife experience possible. The appartment is very nice and clean and in a historic style. There were water and some beers for a small charge in the fridge which we really appreciated after walking up the lisbon hills. It is also good located and you can walk everything. We had a great stay and would always come back.

the house of Ildar, has been a great success, both because of its proximity to everything you want to enjoy in Lisbon, and its location in Barrio Alto, as being very centricos, the apartment is in a quiet area without noise by the night.
Illdar and his family have been great hosts making our days as easy as possible. we have been advised where to eat, what to visit, etc ... We will definitely repeat and return as soon as possible to Lisbon !!!

Un excellent séjour pour mes beaux parents et nous mêmes.
Un 10/10 pour Joao qui nous a accueillis et fait une petite visite des lieux pour nous guider et conseiller un peu dans Lisbonne.
Je recommande cette appartement.

The hosts were very friendly and greeted us warmly. The apartment is a good price but the street it's on is very noisy and full of people drinking, smoking, using drugs, and partying at night. Nice central apparment in the heart of barrio alto - without being too in the midst of the action. Well stocked, slightly basic but super functional and great value. Enjoyed the stay a lot and will be back!

We had an amazing time in Ildars apartment, it was cozy, clean and located in a quiet street in beautiful Bairro Alto. Ildar gave us a warm welcome and was very helpful. The communication was fast and he made sure that everything was convenient to us.

Fabulous stay, the apartment is in a wonderful location, close to everything, beautifully designed and spotlessly clean - there are some really nice touches like a stocked fridge and cupboard of things like beer and wine you can buy for shop prices. We slept with the windows open in August and it was so quiet! Absolutely recommend this place, we will be back !
Very nice city trip to Lissabon because of a lovely city, nice accommodation in the middle of Bairro Alto (but quiet!!) and great and helpful host! We were very happy, many thanks for everything!

Everything was great! The host, Joao was super helpful and accommodating and was always happy to go the extra mile for us.  Perfect location walking distance from the center, great places to eat close by. Hope to be back very soon!

Appartement extrêmement propre , très bien situé.
Accueil particulièrement chaleureux !!
Nous le recommandons vivement

Nice appartment in a vivid area, but the appartment itself is very quiet. We were there with four persons, but there is sufficient place for six. Alfiya is very nice and even gave us a one-hour tour in the neighbourwood and gave us good advice about restaurants.

We, a family with 2  teenagers (13&14 years), enjoyed 3 nights at this lovely place. It is central but still quiet at night. Ildar provided valuable recommendations upon our arrival. Perfect check-in although our plane was  1,5 hours late. Ildar was so flexible! Great stay!

The location of this Airbnb was a little tricky to navigate, but it is close to a major street and we got used to it. We had some issues with the lighting in the corridors (it was very dark!) but the space itself was well-lit and had all the necessary amenities. We had a ton of brohures and tourist assistance should we have needed it which was nice! Definitely a solid option for a Lisbon trip!

Appartement spacieux, propre, dans un quartier calme mais à proximité des plus beaux quartier de lisbonne. Nous avons été super Bien recu et Bien conseillé par notre hôte sur les restaurant et les choses à visiter. Tout était fait pour que nous passions un très bon séjour.

This lovely apartment is in my favourite district of Lisbon - it's the equivalent of Shoreditch in London. Independent design-led stores, great variety of restaurants and my favourite bar - gin lovers.
The apartment is a 15 minute walk from the downtown area. All downhill. With metro or taxi an easy option if you can't face the uphill walk home.
The apartment itself was as described - beds were comfy. Clean bed linen an towels provided. Hair dryer in the bathroom.
We were very happy with our stay!
Die Wohnung ist genau wie beschrieben, zentral aber ruhig. Der Gastgeber ist sehr hilfsbereit.

The stay in the apartment was very nice! All things went really smooth.The location is great, just in the heart of Bairro Alto. Moreover, while checking in we received a lot of useful tips regarding the restaurants and parking place. The apartment was nice and tidy, we do really recommend this place!:)
Ildar was an absolutely amazing host! Kind, communicative, and going above and beyond to make our stay very comfortable. I'd recommend their place with no hesitation whatsoever.
Really liked the apartment. Super nice host and great location! Recommend it to other people.
Beeeeeautiful!

Everything was fantastic for our stay! Great area and super easy to find your way around. Apartment was clean and spacious. Our hosts were very friendly and really happy to help. Alfiya took us on a short stroll to show recommendations and quick guide around the area.
All was really well and will be happy to stay again next time in Portugal.
Thank you
Lucie
Zentrale und doch sehr ruhige Unterkunft. Für unseren Kurzaufenthalt mit unseren jugenlichen Kindern optimal.
Great apartment on an excellent location. Very friendly and helpful as well.
Schöne Wohnung in sehr zentraler, aber dennoch ruhiger Lage! Sehr freundliche und hilfsbereite Vermieter. Haben uns trotz 6 h Verspätung vom Flughafen abholen lassen. Vielen Dank für alles!

Wow, the perfect way to experience Lisbon! Ildar was amazing- he was in constant communication with us, organised our transfer to & from the airport, gave us a fantastic guided tour of the city, & gave us many local tips on places to eat & visit. The apartment was perfectly located to be within walking distance of many of the main sights, or public transport to them, and even though the area is busy & bustling it was really quiet & safe on the street of the apartment. The apartment was clean & spacious for 5 of us staying, with supplies of bottled water, beer, champagne & wine if we wanted. I would thoroughly recommend staying here, especially with Ildar being the perfect host!
Great host! Thank you alfyia, you were very kind and helpful. Best location to stay in lisboa
O apartamento é muito lindo, muito bem localizado e o João é o melhor anfitrião que existe! Ficamos muito felizes com a nossa estadia em Lisboa!
Great location within walking distance to bars, restaurants, the train and main square. Ildar was very knowledgeable and helpful.
This apartment is in a great area - rustic charm with modern convinces. Ildar is a great host!
Beautiful place in a perfect location! The beds were ok, everything was really clean and nice. Overall, the apartment had a wonderful vibe.

We had a great time in Lisbon and enjoyed the appartment. Everything was close by and we could walk everywhere we wanted to go. We were very pleased that we could leave our bags on the last day, this made it more convenient to go explore the city one last time.

A casa do João é ótima! Bem localizada, organizada, ampla, limpa; as camas são muito boas;  um espaço em que me senti em casa. Além disso, o João é um anfitrião maravilhoso! Nos mostrou o bairro, indicou ótimos passeios, restaurantes e padarias. Indico para todos os viajantes ; )
excellent location, clean apartment and very friendly host .Highly recommended

This is a great place.  Perfect location, lots of space, clean, and very safe.  The apartment is on a quiet street and yet just down the block the entertainment begins.  Nightlife is amazing there.  Almost better than the space, are the hosts.  They are friendly and upbeat and helpful.  Really wonderful people.  My husband and I enjoyed our too short of stay very much.  For those who may not know, Lisbon can get hot in the spring and air conditioning is non existent.  There is a fan in the apartment which is helpful.  We are looking forward to having more time in Lisbon on a future trip

A big thank you for having us to stay in your beautiful apartment. We very much enjoyed our stay and would recommend it to anyone else looking to stay in this area of Lisbon. The apartment is clean, tidy, well equipped and full of beautiful furnishings. The hosts are incredibly friendly. Would love to stay here again, thanks!

Fantastic one night stay! Large three bedroom with cute balcony overlooking a lively alley. The windows are 100% sound proof so that was not an issue. One block from tons of restaurants, scenic sights, shops and bars.
This was a fantastic apartment for our stay in Lisbon. Great neighborhood and close to the city center. Clean place and met all of our needs.

Alfiya and Ildar were the perfect hosts, they were so helpful. The apartment was charming, in a great location and had everything we needed. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay in Lisbon. Thoroughly recommended!

Alfiya was great. We were greeted when we arrived.
We booked this place for four people and all were comfortable with the space. The location was within walking distance to good restaurants. We walked to Alfama and Sao Jorge Castle (wear comfortable shoes).
Our stay in Lisbon was short, would definitely book this place again.
Very nice place!

We only had one night at Ildars' place. But it was amazing. Beautiful appartment with room for six. I mostly travel alone but this time we were 6 grown ups and a child and we could all stay comfortably there. The location is wonderful, I would come back to Lissabon and this place happily. Also Ildar was extremely helpful, helping us get a lot of big suitcases up into the appartment, and bringing them down and storing them for us, when we did not make it back in time. Also he gave great suggestions for restaurants, beaches and such. My warmest recommendations!

Joao nous attendait à l'heure que nous lui avions annoncée. Il nous a fait faire un tour du quartier pour nous permettre de nous repérer. Joao parle très bien français. L'appartement est très propre très bien placé dans un quartier très vivant et très sympathique. L'accès au centre ville est très rapide à pied ou par le funiculaire.
Lage & Sauberkeit Top.

The flat is incredibly located to the sights and walking distance to the beach. It is on a quiet street and the place is very spacious and comfortable. Ildar was a GREAT host, good communication and recommendations to make sure I enjoyed my first time in Lisboa. I would recommend staying here.

This place was perfect for us to explore Lisbon! We stayed as 5 adults and one baby and we were all very comfortable in the place. The location is great for walking to restaurants and shops :) highly recommend!

This was my second time staying in the apartment, as my friends and I loved it so much the first time. It's in a great location, and is a clean, tidy and spacious apartment. The hosts are amazing, and go out of their way to make your stay in Lisbon special. We had a late arrival this time, but they arranged a taxi for us, and met us at the apartment. Always willing to help, and to give advice on the best things to do in Lisbon, and all the good stuff on their doorstep - loads of great bars and restaurants, and views across the city! Can't recommend highly enough.
Very central, clean, and easy to engage with the host.

La casa es muy alegre, espaciosa y limpia. Está equipada con todo lo necesario. Se encuentra situada en lugar céntrico y cerca de restaurantes, pero en una calle tranquila y segura. Hemos estado muy cómodos salvo por el hecho de que el piso no tuviera ascensor y viajábamos con mi madre. Nos recibió con mucha amabilidad el hijo de Alfiya y nos informó sobre sitios de interés.

Amazing Portuguese hospitality, perfect location in the middle of the old town, charming flat. A (quiet) block away from the partying, close to restaurants & sight-seeing, the perfect launch pad for our family explorations.
Super clean, well equipped, quiet, and did I mention the great Portuguese hospitality? The lengths to which they went to accomodate our strange departure time in the middle of the night set a new record.
Thank you Ildar (& Dad!!), you made it very easy for us to discover your fabulous city.

L'appartamento è spazioso e per 3-4 persone è ottimo. La posizione è centralissima nel Bairro Alto, una zona panoramica e ricca di vita notturna e a 15 min a piedi dal centro storico. Il proprietario è stato disponibilissimo nel accompagnarci a fare un giro di 20 min per indicarci le cose principali da vedere (avevamo solo un giorno e senza una guida avremmo sicuramente perso qualcosa di importante). Ci ha anche consigliato un ottimo posto per la colazione, molto tipico e sopratutto buono! Consigliato!
Great appartement. Spacious, clean and quiet. Great location, close to beautiful viewing point. Friendly hosts and Very punctial. We had a Great weekend in Lisbon.

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour dans l'appartement de Joao qui est un hôte charmant, agréable et serviable. L'appartement est très bien situé pour partir découvrir Lisbonne à pieds, même avec des enfants !
Joao prend le temps de faire découvrir les alentours de l'appartement, les restaurants, la boulangerie et ses pastéis de nata ;), l'épicerie... C'est très pratique. Joao a organisé nos transferts en taxi de l'aéroport et, pour notre départ à 6h00 du matin, il était présent !
Bref une très bonne adresse... nous y retournerons avec plaisir !

Accueil formidable.
Appartement idéalement situé.
Parfait

We really enjoyed our time in Lisbon staying in this apartment. The position is very central and close to all amenities. It was very clean and quiet and we were able to communicate easily with Alfiya and Ildar. Definitely recommended.
Excellent location. Very close to metro but steep climb to the apartment or you can get the cable car. Very nice apartment.
Nee

This is a great place within walking distance of central Lisbon and other great neighborhoods. Many options  for restaurants and bars, but still on a street that doesn't get the noise. Ildar provides his phone numbers and his parents in case you need anything.  They were all gracious, sweet,  and helpful.  Fantastic family.  The apartment was beautiful, spacious,  and clean.
Dichtbij metrostation, er loopt een metrolijn vanaf het vliegveld dus ideaal om te nemen. Scheelt ook geld!
Everything was amazing! Ildar was a great host and the apartment was even better than the pictures. 100% worth every penny!

El apartamento está en el barrio alto a 1 minuto andando del mirador de San Pedro de Alcántara. La ubicación es genial y aunque es una zona de ambiente, no se oye ningún ruido.
Los anfitriones son super amables y siempre pendientes de ayudarnos en todo momento.
Lisboa una maravilla.

Ildar was great, waiting for us as we got lost (our fault, it's not hard to find!), even coming out to retrieve us as we stood exhausted on the street staring at the building. The bed was comfortable and the apartment clean and inviting. I would say beware if you have large luggage, the place is on the third level with a dim and narrow staircase! Also, if you're walking from Restauradores station and using Google maps: Calçada da Gloriá is the tramway/funicular street that goes straight up the hill. I kept looking for a regular sidea street and missed it (3 times).

The home is well situated in a quiet neighborhood that is within walking distance of multiple great restaurants, bars, and main streets where taxis are readily available. The home was very clean and comfortable. The hosts were very accommodating with our early arrival time. I would absolutely stay again!

This was a great place!! The hosts were unbelievably accommodating and helpful, including a 4:45 a.m. departure for an early flight out of Lisbon. The place itself was immaculate and bright and roomy. The location in Bairro Alto was convenient to wonderful restaurants and markets.
In addition, Ildar provided an informed and informative tour of the area.
We highly recommend!!
We had a lovely stay.  Beautiful city,  comfy appartement. Ideal location. Lovely owners!  Thank you so much!
The house was really nice and cozy.

We spent a great week in Lisboa, thanks to Alfia, Ildar and Joao. Upon our arrival, Joao gave us a personal tour of the neighborhood around the apartment which helped us to organize our visits. We were a family of four with two young adults and had no problem with space. The apartment is calm even if the neighborhood is very active with bars and restaurants.
Yves and family - Québec Canada

The flat was everything that we were looking for and in the perfect location.  A lovely area with plenty of shops, restaurants and bars.  The host was extremely accommodating and they had a 'mini bar' of sorts which was extremely convenient. Would recommend.

Si on retourne à Lisbonne, on retournera dans l appartement de Joao
Il est spacieux bien placé au calme
Mais surtout Joao est le meilleur hôte que l on peut imaginer, sympathique, serviable et discret.
Il vous donnera tous les conseils nécessaires pour votre séjour
Such a lovely place !
Awesome place with nice hosts.

The apartment is big with 3 bedrooms, and is located in the center of Lisboa. Alfiya is really nice and friendly. He showed us around the neighborhood and help us to solve our problem as soon as we told him
Hôtes charmants et appartement très agréable en famille

Très bel appartement, spacieux, dans un quartier sympathique et bien situé . L'aérobus arrêt restauraradores est tout prêt de l'appartement en prenant l'elevator da gloria c'est très pratique.
Nos hôtes sont adorables, Joao nous a fait faire un tour du quartier et nous a indiqué de bonnes adresses

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour dans le logement d'Alfiya, Ildar et Joao, qui correspond exactement à l'annonce. Le quartier est animé le soir mais n'est pas du tout dérangeant lorsque nous sommes dans les chambres.
