L'appartement est proche du centre et des transports, ce qui est très pratique lorsque l'on arrive directement de l'aéroport. Il est relativement spacieux, ce qui évite d'être les "uns sur les autres" tout le temps.
La communication a été très claire entre nous et Joao (que nous avons rencontré) et il a su être très arrangeant pour les check-in et check-out et les dépôts de bagages si besoin. Il nous a également recommandé quelques adresses dans le quartier, ce qui nous a permis de nous "situer" un peu à notre arrivée.
Nous recommandons vivement ce logement qui nous a entièrement satisfait et qui était bien confortable après de longues journées de marches dans Lisbonne!
Muito boa a estadia! Acesso um pouco difícil, mas por ser em um bairro antigo e estacionar nas ruas, apenas para moradores do bairro.

We spent three nights in the apartment at Lisboa. The location of the apartment is perfect for exploring the city as you can walk easily in a few minutes to various attractions, metro, tram or bus and there are many bars and cafés around.
The offered taxi pick-up from the airport was also very well organized and the arrival in the apartment at midnight was also no problem. We also appriciated the variaty of offered drinks in the apartment.
Thank you very much for the wonderful days at Lisboa!
Great place in a lovely city with v friendly and helpful host - definitely will stay again when next in Lisbon - thanks
짧은 기간이었지만 우리 가족에게는 호스트 부부의 친절함과 배려가 가장 기억에 남습니다. 시내 관광명소까지 접근성이 매우 좋고, 인근에 맛집들도 많습니다. 지역주민인 호스트가 소개해주는 가성비 있는 곳들은 우리 여행자들에게 편안함과 안전함을 주는 것 같습니다. 3층 전체를 빌려 썼는데 방도 넓고 깨끗합니다.

Un très bon accueil. Alfiya et Joao sont vraiment gentils et à l'écoute, plein de bons conseils et restent disponibles sur place ci-besoin, même si vous ne venez qu'une nuit! bravo pour votre français Joao et merci pour votre accueil. Appartement très bien placé dans un vieil immeuble, en plein coeur du quartier central et vivant de Lisbonne (mais dans une rue calme). Photos très réalistes. Je recommande fortement!
Great location.

What a great apartment in a great neighborhood! Of all the places we stayed in Europe (Germany, France, Italy, Portugal), this was the largest and with the greatest $ value! A big shower and bathroom, comfortable living room with small balcony to the street, 3 bedrooms, comfortable bed, and separate kitchen space with fridge/oven, etc. We only had one night to spend in Lisbon, but we could have stayed here for days. The apartment is located in a very hip, active area at night, but relatively quiet during the day. I'm sure that in the summer you can hear the activities outside late in to the night, but the bedrooms are located at the back of the apartment and -- in January -- the noises were sealed off by closed windows. Peace and quiet! We loved the variety of places to eat and drink in the neighborhood and the relative ease to walk to everywhere in the city! If you want to use public transport, the cable cars are very close nearby for trips all around the city.
We loved Lisbon and wouldn't hesitate to stay at the wonderful apartment again!

IIldar was there to great us with wonderful hospitality and a warm smile (plus a bottle of local wine which added more to the warm welcome!).  The apartment had everything needed for us to stay comfortably and we felt very safe. The location is fantastic - so close to bars, sights, views, cafes restaurants, shops and yet very quiet which is hard to believe for the area as it is known for its liveliness!!! At check out our hosts allowed us to leave our many bags with them while we did some final shopping in Lisbon before getting the plane and organised our maxi taxi to the airport.  Would definitely stay here again!
Parfait ! Très accueillant.  Logement super.quartier sympa.

Stayed at this lovely apartment for New Years and really enjoyed it. Ildar was very welcoming and helpful and made sure we had a good stay. The location was perfect, very near the main pub scene but quiet at night. I definitely would recommend this as a place to stay if visiting beautiful Lisbon!

A great apartment tucked down a side street. Apartment was very clean and had everything we needed. Easy to walk everywhere to explore Lisbon. Ildar's tour was very informative and really helped us find our way around quickly. We would like to return to spend more time here. Thanks

L'appartement a complétement répondu à nos attentes pour 5 personnes adultes. La localisation est parfaite, très calme la journée, quartier animé la nuit (mais aucun bruit dans les chambres!). Les accès au centre et aux gares sont faciles à pied, avec quelques marches :)
Joao et son fils sont très disponibles en cas de besoins, et font tout pour aider, organiser le taxi,... (Joao est même venu sur place s'assurer que notre taxi était bien à l'heure lors de notre départ à 5h30 le matin !!).

Friendly hosts, great communication and a nice welcome gift.
Excellent location for a wonderful stay in the fabulous Lisbon!
Wonderful host. Great apartment

This apartment is a very decent place to live at during vacation. Its not only near to the main attractions of Lisbon, but you can also eat at fabulous local restaurants in a few minutes walk.

We felt very welcome by the host. He showed us the choices for our meals and even helped us with planning the trip.

The apartment is a bit old, when too many electrical appliances were opened, short circuit happens. However, its was only a small issue and all other things in the apartment are nice and clean.

At last, I would like to recommend everyone to stay at this apartment. Its is an excellent place to stay in for a family or group.

We had a great time in Lisbon, also thanks to the flat of Alfiya,Ildar & Joao.
The flat is cosy, clean and is perfect for a stay of few days. Nevertheless, there had been a leak in the water heater which is never cool when you are living in someone else's place.
In the same time, Alfiya,Ildar & Joao had been a really great host, really available and they let us to leave our luggage at the ground floor before the check-in. Moreover, they suggest us a Tourist tour we did not do, but it is good to know.
Thank you again !
Our host was very helpful as we arrived much later than expected.  The apartment was clean and exactly as advertised.
This is a charming old flat in a great location of town.

Alfiya, Ildar and Joao couldn't be better hosts. They were extremely kind and attentive, giving us some great advice on where to see and eat, as well as being readily available if we ever needed anything. We didn't have much luck with the weather on our trip to Lisbon, but this flat was the perfect base in which to hide from the rain and Joao very kindly offered to tumble dry our clothes for us and provide additional heaters for us when we got drenched. We were very sad not to be able to take the tour offered by Ildar due to the bad weather. The location is great - in a buzzing area, but inside the flat is very peaceful.

O apartamento é exatamente como nas fotos! Realmente muito aconchegante e com limpeza impecável. Os anfitriões estavam à espera e foram muito solícitos durante toda a estadia. Preço ótimo, boa localização.
Espero poder estar de volta a Lisboa!
listing description was accurate, great location, clean and spacious.  loved our visit

Host was lovely, very welcoming and showed me to a great restaurant after I arrived with traditional Portuguese food. Fantastic neighbourhood.

The apartment was great and very roomy but was a little surprised at the shower being luke warm and having to pay 3€ for a coffee.

Staying at the home of Alfiya, Ildar and Joao was a wonderful experience for us! The apartment is bright, comfortable and spacious. It had everything we needed for a lovely stay in Lisbon.

We especially enjoyed the special touches of a welcoming bottle of wine and a tour with Ildar! Ildar knows so much about the city and his informative tour was one of the highlights of our stay.

The location of the apartment is ideal - we were just a short walk away from so many wonderful restaurants. We especially enjoyed Ba Wine Bar, By the Wine, and Manteigaria.

I would also highly recommend asking Ildar coordinate a taxi pickup from and to the airport. It was $25 well spent in order to avoid lugging our bags around the cobblestone street.

Ildar, you and and your family were such wonderful hosts. Thank you for making our trip to Portugal so memorable.
Nice apartment closed to viewpoint. And lldar is a good person too.

Only stayed for one night, a very good location to see the city of Lisbon. Close to nice restaurants and bars and close to public transportation especially the Rossio Train Station which can get you to Sintra. Ildar offered us a personable 3 hour walking tour of the city around the area. The tour was great. We only had 1 day in lisbon and the tour he gave us was perfect for what we needed. It gave us a very good overview of the city and we were able to get a personal touch of Lisbon. Very enjoyable.

I would absolute recommend this apt to anyone visiting Lisbon! It's a perfect location for walking around to nearby sites/restaurants/etc. The apt was quiet, comfortable, and clean.

Parking can be a bit of a challenge, but as to be expected in Lisbon.

I'm writing on the behalf of my colleagues who stayed there; they absolutely loved everything about the place and the host. The place was spotless clean, very comfortable, the location absolutely amazing and the guest extremely kind. They woke up very early to make sure to meet the guest on time and were extremely helpful.

Very welcome,met us at door with bottle of wine and even carried bags up stairs .
It was great that they had beer,wine and water in fridge (reasonable charge)
Get them to line up cab pickup at airport
It's worth every nickel.
Location was great
We took Idler's tour
He knows Lisbon

O apartamento é espaçoso, confortável, seguro e bem localizado. Tivemos os melhores anfitriões que se pode esperar! O senhor João e a sua família são encatadores e estiveram a nossa disposição durante toda a viagem. Fomos recepcionados no aeroporto, solicitamos o traslado, guardaram as nossas malas até a hora do check-in.
Super recomendado para famílias, estávamos em seis adultos e um bebê de 7 meses e nos foi disponibilizado berço e brinquedos. E a cozinha conta com uma dispensa com amenidades que podem ser compradas por preço justo.
Quem gosta de sair a noite, o apt é no coração do Bairro Alto, mas fica numa rua reservada e tranquila, sendo silencioso para o sono. Há três mercadinhos por perto, o lindíssimo miradouro São Pedro de Alcântara que tem uma feira a noite com comidas típicas, o Elevador da Glória, sushi e mil pubs.
"Muito receptivo, acomodação confortável e excelente localização." Denísia, 50 anos.
"Casa acolhedora e confortável e bairro super divertido." Juliana, 26 anos.
"Me senti muito a vontade, e a localização não poderia ser melhor!" Isabel, 18 anos.
"Localização, conforto e hospitalidade!" Marisa, 46 anos.

We had a great time in Lisbon thanks to the wonderful apartment in the heart of the town and thanks to our charming hosts who really spoiled us during our staying. If we come back we would always book it again!
Dorothee, Dieter, Leonie

My husband and I came to Portugal for our honeymoon, and our first stop was Lisbon. We were in contact with Joao even before our stay, he met us upon our arrival and was very kind and helpful. He helped us to figure out how to get to and from each city - and also provided us with a ride to the train station when it was time to head to Lagos.  We also received a quick tour of the area surrounding the apartment while it was being cleaned. We felt right at home. Ildar gave us a wonderful 4 hour tour of the city that included much of the history of Lisbon. The apartment was very clean and in a perfect location. It has all the amenities that you would need for your stay. It was right in the heart of Bairro Alto, and still, a quiet and peaceful retreat amongst the bustling streets below.  The apartment is just a block away from one of the most stunning views in all of the city. I would recommend this apartment to anyone who wants to get the ultimate Lisbon experience.

Een goed appartement in de oude wijk Bairo Alto. Alles op loopafstand! Dichtbij het trammetje. Alfiya was heel behulpzaam. We konden onze bagage al vroeg brengen en ook de laatste dag daar achterlaten om ten volle van de dag te genieten. Ook had hij goede tips om dingen te gaan bekijken.

Wir hatten eine großartige Zeit in Lissabon! Nicht zuletzt, weil Alfiya, Ildar und Joao herzliche und wunderbare Gastgeber sind. Die schöne Wohnung liegt sehr zentral und ist gemütlich eingerichtet. Alles war bestens vorbereitet, wir fühlten uns sehr willkommen. Unser Urlaub begann sehr entspannt, wir wurden am Flughafen abgeholt – wie schön! Am Folgetag haben wir eine private Stadtführung mit Illdar genossen, haben einen guten Überblick bekommen und viel über die Stadt gelernt, leckeren Kuchen gegessen, die Musik (Fado) der Stadt gehört und und und.... Es waren wunderschöne Tage in Lissabon, eine tolle Stadt, eine schöne Wohnung, sehr herzliche Gastgeber - immer wieder gern!

Alfiya, Ildar and Joao's place is in the perfect location in old town. During the day it is lovely and quite and around 8pm it comes alive with a large selection of restaurants and bars to choose from. They are the most gracious hosts, communication is great from booking to check out. I will recommend this place to anyone I know heading to Lisbon!

I booked the flat for myself and 3 friends for a long weekend and from the start Joao and Alfiya kept in touch and provided really helpful information prior to our arrival.
Joao met us at a very late hour due to our flight times and was charming and helpful. The neighbourhood is central, great restaurants an shops nearby. The flat was very clean and well stocked - very helpful to have some provisions ( essential water, wine and beer !) in the fridge for us to use if we wanted. We were happy to explore alone but knew that we could get help and advice at anytime if needed

We all loved Lisbon and will return for a second visit - we would book into Joao's place again - i would definitely recommend it.

Très bel appartement. Nous avons été accueilli par le fils de Joao qui nous a attendu jusqu'à tard compte tenu de l'heure  d'arrivée de notre vol et des bouchons dans Lisbonne. Malgré ça l'accueil à été parfait avec beaucoup de conseils sur le quartier. L'appartement est bien situé dans le quartier de Bairro Alto. Le quartier est rempli de restaurant,bars et avec une bonne ambiance. Le logement est grand, fonctionnel, propre et bien équipé. Malgré le bruit du quartier, une fois les fenêtres fermées le calme est le plus complet. Des boissons sont à disposition ainsi que les serviettes de toilette et shampoing /gel douche. Joao est venu le dernier jour nous voir s'assurant ( dans un français impeccable ) que notre séjour se soit bien passé et nous a donné un coup de main pour les valises. Sachez qu'il se propose de vous réserver un taxi pour l'arrivée et retour. Merci à eux qui nous ont permis de passer un super séjour à Lisbonne.

Leading up to our trip I emailed Alfiya & she immediately responded to my questions. They offered taxi pick-up which we declined but in hind sight should have accepted as we had to wait in the airport line-up for an hour.

Upon arrival, Joao was waiting outside & took our luggage upstairs. He greeted us like we were old friends coming back for a visit. So friendly. It was our anniversary & on the bed was a hand crafted pillow with our names on it. So very thoughtful.

Joao then showed us the apartment and a 20 minute tour of the immediate area pointing out places to eat or listen to Fado. He explained that his son Ildar could do a tour for us the next day.

We booked a tour for noon & Ildar was right on time. He charged only €15 each for 2 hours. This was the best money I ever spent. Not only did Ildar show us Lisbon, but he knew all the cities history & explained where to buy transit passes, good restaurants to eat at & tips on how to save time & money. These tips were invaluable, especially the escalator that saves you from walking back uphill. He was so gracious, funny & knowledgeable that we offered for him to come stay with us back in Canada. I cannot say enough about him, he was an absolute pleasure to hang out with.

The apartment itself was spotless clean & the only thing I couldn't find were ice cube trays. The host stopped by the next day while we were out with them & even filled them so they would be frozen when we got home. They also brought beach towels.

Whats App is how a lot of people in Lisbon communicate so that's how I messaged the host. Almost everyday they said good morning & asked how we were doing & if we needed anything.

The light in the main building entrance wasn't working so it was dark & they sent an electrician to fix it. It can be a bit noisy at night but we just closed the windows & it was fine. The alleys may look a bit dingy but every restaurant or bar we visited was very clean. The locals were friendly & when we got lost they offered help without asking. We met so many locals & had an absolute blast & felt very safe. Don't let the graffiti fool you, it is very safe!

Upon check-out, they arranged a taxi & the whole family came to see us off. My husband & I felt like we knew them for years. So gracious, kind & thoughtful we couldn't believe it. We hugged them all when we left & we were sad to leave. We will definitely be back. Thank you for the warm welcome & kindness. Love Lisbon!!

This apartment was super and it really made my wife and I feel at home in Lisbon. The living room is really comfortable - we hung out here many times during our stay, drinking wine. We also had a dinner and used the kitchen and dining table. The kitchen is small but has everything you need to make coffee and meals.

We retrieved the keys from the host who was very helpful and gave us a little overview of the city and where we were in context. He also provided some recommendations for food and sight seeing. So nice to have an introduction the city from a local. Communication was easy, we just text messaged when we got close to arriving.

There are some extra bottles of water and wine in the unit in case you need something in the middle of the night.

The location is perfect, there are so many restaurants nearby, shopping is just a hop away, and one day we put on our comfortable shoes and hiked all around the city, it was easy to find our way back because Barrio Alto is up on a hill.

The bed and bathroom was clean and very accommodating. We only used one bedroom but the two others would allow a pretty large group to hang out and stay here.

We loved that, with all the windows open, you feel like you are connected to the neighborhood and the beautiful weather. Also loved the cross breeze that happened down the hall and to the kitchen & bedroom.

Overall great apartment and our only complaint is that we didn't stay here for a couple more days !
Wonderful apartment directly in the old city of lissabon; but also very quiet. Very nice and helpful owner :-) !! Gladly again!!

Ildar met us and spoke our language. Apartments were really clean and cozy.  The neighbourhood and location are fantastic. There was a problem with a hot water, but Ildar solved it as soon as possible. Place recommended to stay!

Joao and Ildar were fantastic hosts.  The apartment was much bigger than anticipated, super clean and in an excellent location.  They were very good at communication and arranged for a taxi to pick us up and drop us off at the airport when requested.  I was VERY satisfied with my stay and will be staying here again on my next (hopefully longer) stay in Lisbon.
Prompt communication and arrival check in. Great location. Spacious and clean.

Was promptly greeted and given a short and sweet tour around the neighborhood! Alfiya is wonderful and arranged for a taxi for us to the airport, checked in to make sure everything was going well.  Apt very spacious and has everything we needed! The location is PERFECT. Nights can get a little noisy if you have the windows open as it is a bustling neighborhood. Would stay here again!

Ildar took the time to give us a personal mini walking tour of the neighborhood.  Good location if you want to enjoy Bairro Alto but still be on a quiet side street to sleep. You don't need to pay for the elevator, just walk up the hill from the Restauradores metrobus or metro stop (unless your luggage prohibits this, but with a backpack we were fine)  At the top of the stairs go right (the mirador is on your right) and you will see the International Hostel on your left).  The apartment is up the hill behind it a couple of streets.  Ildar was very gracious to us.  In retrospect, I would not go to Cafe du Rosa as it is too much of an all you can eat buffet with nothing really exceptional but fine if you are ravenous.  It gets high TA ratings but you can do much better in this neighborood.

Joao and Ildar were fantastic hosts and very accommodating with our requests. The apartment is spacious and airy and the location in the Barrio Alto was fab - right in the centre but on a quiet street so we weren't woken up by partygoers at night.

Joao a été un hôte très sympathique, disponible et bienveillant. Nous n'avons manqué de rien.
L'appartement est idéalement placé, dans un des quartiers les plus animé de Lisbonne.
Ce dernier était spacieux, confortable et d'une propreté irréprochable.
Je le recommande sans aucune hésitation.

Die Unterkunft hat unsere Erwartungen übertroffen. DasWillkommen und die Betreuung sind sehr herzlich. Wir haben uns rundum wohl gefühlt. Wir würden jederzeit bei einem Stop in Lisboa wieder dieses schöne zuhause buchen. Danke Joao <3

Emplacement idéal pour visiter la ville, appartement très Calme. Accueil parfait, nous étions là seulement pour la journée et notre hôte a eus la gentillesse de nos guider pendant plus d'une heure dans la ville, de nous indiquer les restaurants sympa du quartier.

The apartment is in a charming location and is itself very charming. It's very well decorated and nice and spacious. The area is very central for exploring and is very well connected to the local transport once you get your bearings. Joao is very helpful and goes out of his way to ensure that you are looked after. We would thorough recommend Joao and his apartment.

Accueil extrêmement chaleureux de Joao qui parle français couramment. Avec une extrême disponibilité il nous a fait découvrir les bonnes adresses du quartier ainsi que les centres d'intérêt à ne pas manquer. On recommande vivement cette adresse bien placée, propre et calme.

The whole experience with Joao was perfect from the first enquiry through to him ordering a taxi for us when we left. The apartment is a perfect base to explore Lisbon set in the heart of Bairro Alto you are close to a busy night life but the street the apartment is on very quiet and is also within easy walking distance to the centre of Lisbon. We will be staying here again when we are next in Lisbon.

Nice apartment in the centre of Bairo Alto. Close to a very nice viewpoint over Lisbon with a small park and a terrace. Lovely to sit there in the evening. Short walk down to the center of town. The apartment was exactly as described and shown in the pictures and it was very clean.
Joao was a very gentle host, who showed us the neighbourhood en helped us rightaway whenever we needed him.
During our stay it was quite warm in the apartment because of the high temperatures in Lisbon. For us no big problem, but that's something to be aware of.

Joao is the best host ever. He was waiting for us and helped us to carry our heavy luggage to the 2nd floor. All luggage even :)
The house is extra clean and full of linen and towels. Sun is always inside and the furniture is very simple but super tasty and nice.
Joao came especially the next morning just to carry again our luggage, he was waiting for us with a taxi to the airport.
The location is very central, next to the best spots and restaurants, and in the same time very calm.
Next time we visit Lisbon, we will certainly rent this apartment and nothing else!

Joao er en fantastisk vert; han er 100% service minded, høflig og svarer omgående på forespørsler. Han var tilstede både ved ankomst og ved avreise kl 06.00 om morgenen.
Beliggenheten er meget sentral og ligger i gangavstand til mye. Da leiligheten ligger midt i området med utesteder, må man regne med noe bråk fra gaten om kvelden/natten.

I highly recommend this apartment. A group of 5 of us stayed here for one night at the end of a short break to Lisbon. We really wish we could have stayed longer, and would definitely return and stay here again. Joao was so very helpful, storing our bags for us before we checked in, and generally going above and beyond expectations. The apartment itself is lovely, and is exactly as shown in the pictures. The location is just perfect, close to shops, restaurants, bars, etc. It was easy to walk everywhere, or get to public transport if required. I shall definitely be returning for another stay!

João was amazing host. Incredibly accommodating and he made sure we had a great last night in Lisbon. Apartment was clean, bright, beds and pillows were comfortable. Apartment did get warm during the night however with the doors open it helped cool us off. Great location to lots of bars, restaurants and scenic views, and as you know Bairro Alto does get noisy at night but we didn't experience any issues that kept us up.

Great stay, fantastic location! We stayed at the appartement with 3 couples. We all had a great time. The communication with Joao and Ildar was also very good. I sent several mail before we arrived in Lisbon to ask for some information about available parking etc. Within 24h I received an answer. In one word: TOP.

Joao & Ildar were very welcoming on our arrival, they waited for us as our plane was delayed and showed us around the house. They further organised a tour of the city for us on the next day and showed us the good places to eat and go out. It was an overall very good experience.
The flat was in an amazing, beautiful location and Joao kindly gave us a little tour of the neighborhood and made us feel very welcome. Great hosts!

Joao and Alfiya were excellent hosts and made us feel very welcome. The flat is beautiful and in a very convenient location in Lisbon's busy Barrio Alto. It is very spacious and as shown in the photos. Would definitely recommend! The only things to note are that it was quite warm in the summer, with no air con, so we left doors & windows open overnight. However, having doors and windows open meant lots of noise from partying on the street until late, and also a few mosquitos. We were there for a festival so didn't mind the late noise, but it is worth reconsidering if you are hoping for peace and quiet.

From the moment I booked this Flat, 3 months prior to our trip, our hostess Alfiya, was very responsive and answered all my questions in a timely manner. She kindly arranged a driver to pick us up from the airport. Upon our arrival to the flat, her son Ildar and husband Joao greeted us at the door, carried our bags in, and were extremely welcoming. Joao and Ildar were so kind and helpful. They definitely went beyond the call of duty and made a lasting impression on me and my friends I was on holiday with.

The flat was very spacious as I had hoped. It was tastefully decorated without "trying to hard". We loved the high ceilings and the natural air flow from the back of the flat to the front. This helped cool the flat naturally on the hot summer nights we stayed. It somehow felt more authentic to the city than other air bnb's I've stayed, in their respective cities. It maybe cliche, but it felt like home away from home. I would stay here again, and would recommend it to anybody I know planning to visit Lisbon.

The flat was was situated in the neighborhood of Bairro Alto, which we truly enjoyed. The flat was tucked away on a road far enough from hearing the noise of the bustling bars and restaurants, but conveniently only a minute walk away whenever we wanted to eat, shop or take in the nightlife.
The neighborhood is great on the host was absolutely great and his nephew came to my rescue a couple of times and went beyond the call of duty

Joao and Alfiya were very responsive before and during the stay, greeted us, arranged  a cab, provided dining suggestions. The apartment was very spacious and included everything we needed, it would be great for a few couples to share or family. Great experience in Lisbon.
Nice host, well located, spacious, clean and comfortable apartement. Recommend also for familys with smaller kids, cause they provide baby cot and some toys. Kids totally enjoyed. Thanks!
Very helpful, friendly and welcoming host. Great location for central Lisbon and a good sized apartment.

Bel appartement dans un des quartiers les plus vivants de Lisbonne. Contrairement aux apparences très tranquille. Appartement très soigné et très propre. João est une personne avec de grandes qualités humaines, très éduquée et extrêmement gentille. Il a pris beaucoup de son temps pour nous faire découvrir sa ville et la culture portugaise.
Thank you to Joao for his warm welcome to the apartment and his guided orientation walk around the neighbourhood. The apartment enjoys a great location in Lisbon, central to everything.

The perfect end to our vacation. I wish we had stayed at Alfiya and Joao's longer. It's a clean, spacious place with warm character in a very central area to shops and food. We were greeted by Joao who kindly showed us around the neighbourhood, recommended restaurants and helped us with our bags and coordinating a taxi in the morning. The kitchen and living room space is perfect for anyone staying awhile. Although you're close to very many restaurants, bars and cafes, the street itself is quiet, which is perfect when it's time for sleep. The mini-bar in the kitchen was a nice touch and came in handy when we wanted a beer, but didn't want to venture outside to buy one. It was extra special having my boyfriend propose to me here!

Appartement parfait dans un quartier à ne pas manquer et les propriétaires sont très aidant
Merci beaucoup
Nice, spacious apartment full of light, great location, very pleasant hosts. Strongly recommend.
Wir wurden persönlich empfangen und Willkommen geheissen bei der Schlüsselübergabe. Danach zeigte uns Joao Geheimtips und die nähere Umgebung und führte uns durch die Stadt.

L'accueil d'Aliya et Joao a été très chaleureux et très arrangeant.
Nous avons passé un superbe week-end dans ce logement tout confort, spacieux, propre et très bien situé dans le Barrio Alto, quartier qui s'anime le soir!!!
Encore merci à nos hôtes!!!

Best location which easy to reach most of the attraction and restaurant in city area.
Owner's gave us a good tour when we checked in the Airbnb, he is friendly and bring us around the city.
Good memories in Losbon and thank you for the Airbnb!
Definitely recommend.

We had a fantastic stay at Sunshine Apartment. It's just how it looks in the pictures - if anything, it's more spacious and better equipped! All three bedrooms are ample size for 2 people each, the living room with juliet balconies is beautiful and the bathroom and kitchen are large and well equipped (although with so many great restaurants, cafes and bars in the area, you may not be needing the kitchen much!). The building itself is lovely and well kept.

The area around the apartment is great - characterful little streets and loads going on, particularly at night. We spent a fair amount of time at an outside cafe/bar on a terrace with a spectacular view of the whole city, 30 seconds walk from the apartment.

The best thing about this apartment, however, is the welcome you receive from Joao and Alfiya - we were met from our taxi, shown the apartment and given a personal walking tour of the local area, which was very useful and so unexpected for an Airbnb booking! They could not have been more accommodating, and we made use of all the cafe/bar/restaurant recommendations. Joao also booked us a taxi for when we left the apartment, which was great because the road is quite small and not all taxi drivers appear to know where it is :)

Would definitely stay here again if we come back to Lisbon. Great location, great people, fantastic value for money.

Joao was a wonderful host, he met us and explained the area, and even offered to have breakfast with us. His reccomendations for sights, restaurants and bars were great. The apartment was perfect - very large and in an ideal area. would definitely stay again!

Me and my family had a great stay at the apartment. Joao was there to welcome us and walked with us in the neighbourhood to show us a few places he likes. The apartment is situated in the heart of Bairo Alto, where it is calm during the day and more frequented at dinner time and at night. It can be noisy in the middle of the night when bar closes if the windows are opened. The apartment was clean and well equipped. I would definitely recommend the place.

Have you ever seen one of those European films where the characters live in a high-ceilinged multi-roomed apartment? Have you ever wondered what it would be like to live in an apartment like that? That's what it's like staying at Alfiya and João's; moreover, Alfiya, João, and their entire family are incredibly welcoming hosts. Their apartment is conveniently located for the nightlife of the Bairro Alto or, if you're a morning person, the Miradouro de São Pedro de Alcântara.

Great place to stay with friends.
Alfiya & Joao are very welcoming and nice
I recommand this appartment.

Très très bon accueil de la part de nos hôtes qui ont fait leur maximum pour répondre à nos attentes. Joao nous a permis de découvrir sa ville au niveau touristique (monuments, sites, les différents points de vue possibles sur la ville, les restaurants, les commerces...) mais aussi des petits + sur la vie des habitants. Le quartier est bien situé par rapport aux moyens de transport et bien desservi par ceux-ci, rue assez calme.Un grand merci à Alfiya et Joao!

We had a great stay at Joao & Alfiya's place. Great location, which made it easy to access most sights. Joao and his son were waiting at the door when we arrived and helped us with our bags and then gave us a very helpful tour of the neighbourhood! Nice and spacious accommodations, little to no noise at night. Perfect!

Herzliche und persönliche Begrüßung. Der Gastgeber hat sich, auf unseren Wunsch hin, um das Taxi vom und zum Airport gekümmert. Das Apartment war wie in der Beschreibung. Die Lage ist für einen Lissabonbesuch kaum zu toppen. Obwohl die Unterkunft mitten in einem populären Szeneviertel liegt, war es ruhig und unauffällig. Eine typische Lissaboner Altstadtwohnung, ohne übermäßigem Luxus. Absolut empfehlenswert.

Alfiya & Joao made us feel like we were part of their family. We took the overnight bus from Seville and arrived early. Joao met us long before check in and let us store our bags. He guided us arround the neighborhood to point out a bakery where we could have breakfast as well as a grocery store. He refused to let us carry our bags, so they were already upstairs when we checked in. We wanted to hear Fado, so at check in, he and Alfiya walked us to a fado spot and even made reservations for us, with a seat write near the musicians. They also guided us to a wonderful space for lunch. I have never experienced such thoughtful hosts. The apartment was spacious, comfortable, and very quiet. It was a very convenient location. We were sad to say good bye to them!

Upon arriving to Lisbon early in the morning the hosts let us leave our bags early at the apartment building prior to checking in which very helpful as we explored the city. The hosts were very responsive and accommodating and offered to help show us around the city. The apartment was very nice and clean on top of being in a great location. Thanks for the great stay!

Joao and Alfiya were excellent hosts! They were very welcoming and and extremely helpful. When we arrived at the Airbnb, Joao stored our luggage for us and showed us around the neighborhood. The apartment was very clean and spacious. I would definitely recommend!

wir hatten ein sehr nettes und hilfsbereites Gastgeberehepaar. Der
Empfang war trotz später Stunde überaus herzlich und zuvorkommend. Die Wohnung entsprach den Darstellungen des Internetauftritts in jeder Weise.Die lage war perfekt ;die Nachbarschaft trotz der Zentrallage besonders ruhig.

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour dans cet appartement.
Il est très bien situé dans un quartier animé. La rue de l'appartement est très tranquille.
Joao nous a accueilli très gentiment, a pris le temps de nous montrer le quartier et de nous donner des tuyaux pour tout un tas de petites choses utiles dans le quotidien.
L'appartement est très agréable avec 3 chambres.
Tout est impeccable.
Je recommande vivement ce logement.
L'accueil est au top et c'est formidable.

Joao et Aliya nous ont très bien accueillis. Joao a pris du temps pour nous faire découvrir les environs de l'appartement et nous indiquer des itinéraires ainsi que les bons restaurants et les épiceries du quartier.
L'appartement répondait fidèlement au descriptif et est au coeur d'un quartier très animé (Barro Alto) mais dans une rue très calme ce qui nous a permis de bien dormir tout en étant à proximité des animations.
Nous recommandons vivement cette adresse.

Excellent accueil de Joao et sa famille. Joao nous a fait une visite du quartier et donné toutes les explications pour un bon séjour. Il est disponible et son appartement est très agréable. Le quartier est typique mais assez bruyant en soirée. Cependant nous y avons passé un excellent séjour.

Schöne ruhige Wohnung in optimaler Lage, gut ausgestattet.
Und dazu sehr freundliche und hilfsbereite Vermieter.
Hat wirklich Spass gemacht und kann uneingeschränkt empfohlen werden.

Just perfect!
Alfiya & Joao erwarteten und begruessten uns herzlich am Apartment, was in dem bekannten Baixo-Alto liegt- aber am oberen Rand sodass wir von dem Getummel des Nachtlebens nicht gestoert wurden. Auch die Schlafzimmer sind nicht zur Strasse raus sodass es sehr ruhig war. Wenn man sich tummeln will: Bars und Restaurants sind in wenigen Gehminuten erreichbar und man ist "mitten drin". Joao hat uns sogar noch in einer kurzen Fuehrung alles Wichtige im Umfeld gezeigt und Tips und Ziele empfohlen. Das Apartment ist sehr grosszuegig und hat alles was man braucht. In weniger als 10 Gehminuten erreicht man die Metro (Baixo-Chiado) und Bus und Bahn fahren auch gleich um die Ecke. Der Kontakt mit Alfiya & Joao war sehr gut: sie hat uns das Taxi vom Bahnhof abends zum Apartment organisiert und bei Abreise konnten wir sogar noch unsere Koffer hinterlegen da unser Zug wieder erst spaet abfuhr. Alles in Allem eine sehr angenehme Erfahrung und sehr zu empfehlen! Danke an Alfiya & Joao! Wir kommen unbedingt wieder!

Alfiya and Joao were wonderful hosts, extremely accommodating and organised taxis for us to and from the airport and looked after our bags for us after checkout. They are a lovely family and made us feel very at home in their wonderful apartment . The apartment is in a great location in Lisbon and was very comfortable.

Merci Joao pour votre acceuil, votre sympathie et le plaisir de nous faire découvrir cette merveilleuse ville de Lisbonne qui est la votre. A notre demande Joao nous a reservé un taxi qui nous attendaient à l'aéroport , très agréable ...ainsi que le retour.
Je conseille vivement cet appartement car très bien situé, propre et agréable. A 2 minutes à pied d'une vie nocturne, mais l'appartement de Joao et Alfiya est dans une très calme ...
Si je reviens à Lisbonne , je ne poserai pas de question j'irai directement dans l'appartement de Joao.
Karima

Our host Joao was the best host we have ever had.  He met us at the apartment upon our arrival and departure, explained the apartment and then gave us a wonderful tour of the neighborhood. He showed us the local grocer, baker, Fado cafes and restaurants. The apartment had all the basics you need.

We loved staying in Alfiya & Joao's apartment! It was beautiful and spacious. Joao met us at the apartment and then took us on a quick walking tour of the neighborhood. He pointed out great restaurants (that we returned to) and gave us advice for how to see the most of the city in our short stay. He even called us a cab in the morning. It was a  lovely Airbnb experiences! Thank you so much for your hospitality.

Nous avons passé 3 jours à Lisbonne et Alfiya & Joao ont rendu ce séjour très sympathique!! Dès notre arrivée, nous avons pu faire un tour du quartier avec les hôtes, qui nous ont fait des recommandations sur les restaurants/épiceries/et autres endroits à visiter dans le quartier, ainsi qu'une présentation générale de Lisbonne (très pratique pour des touristes du week end!). L'appartement est idéalement situé, juste à coté du coeur de la ville et dans les hauteurs (terrasse avec une magnifique vue à quelques pas de l'appart), très propre et calme. Le quartier est animé mais la rue où se trouve l'appartement très calme. Le jour de notre départ nous avons pu laisser nos valises aux hôtes après le check out pour l'après midi. Si nous avons l'occasion de retourner à Lisbonne, pas d'hésitation: ce sera chez Alfiya & Joao!
Flat had everything we needed and is in a great location in Bairro Alto. Alfiya met us at the apartment when we arrived late at night and gave us a quick tour of the area. Great apartment and host.
The house was very nice and well located. Good hospitality and service. Thanks!
João nos recebeu maravilhosamente bem. O Apartamento é  excelente! Faz jus à tantos elogios nas descrições dos hóspedes. Nossa experiência foi maravilhosa, impecável.

Alfiya n Joao are very friendly n helpful host! Their apartment is very beautiful n central  collated while quite all time. We could easily walk around Lisbon from the apartment. Definitely recommended!

This apartment is located in the city centre and very beautiful. Alfiya and her husband gave us a warm welcome and a tour around the city centre. Lisbon is a very nice city, and Alfiya and Joao are very nice hosts.

Mieszkanie spelnilo nasze oczekiwania i bylo w bardzo przystepnej cenie. Spodobal nam sie duzy pokoj gdzie wieczorami wspolnie przesiadywalysmy. Alfiya i Joao przywitali nas i opowiedzieli co i jak dziala w mieszkaniu, byli bardzo sympatyczni i pomocni. Lokalizacja jest swietna, w weekendy troche glosno, ale do przezycia. Bylysmy w marcu wiec bylo troche chlodno w mieszkaniu, ale Alfiya i Joao wyposazyli przestrzen w dodatkowy grzejnik i dmuchawy do pokojow. Kilka razy wysiadly korki, ale nie byla to dla nas jakas przeszkoda, bo wiedzialysmy gdzie je wlaczyc ponownie. Mieszkanie jest czyste i zadbane, lazienka rowniez ok. Gospodarze dodatkowo wyposazyli lodowke w wina i piwa, ktore za oplata sa do dyspozycji - cena taka sama jak w sklepie na ulicy kilka drzwi dalej. Jedyny minus do jakiego ewentualnie moglabym sie przyczepic to fakt ze 3 sypialnie sa obok siebie i laczone drzwiami a to sprawia ze slychac wszystkie odglosy. Niemniej jednak jak mieszkanie zajmuje grupa przyjaciol to nie ma to znaczenia:) bylysmy bardzo zadowolone z wyboru mieszkania a wlasciciele okazali sie byc bardzo mili jak i rowniez chetni do pomocy. Blisko jest Miradouro de Sao Pedro de Alcantara...przepiekny punkt widokowy na Lizbone! Goraco polecam to mieszkanie:)

Alfiya made us feel so welcome!  He met us late at night and carried both of our bags up for my sister and I.  He then woke up in the morning and met us and took us on a 30 minute tour of the surrounding area, pointing out great restaurants, shops, landmarks, etc.  He also let us leave our baggage for a couple of hours after check in so that we could walk around before getting our rental car.  He is a real gem, as is his home!!! A spacious 3 bedroom with everything we needed.  I want to go back!

We received a very warm welcome from our host and his son. A nice tour of the apartment was given to us as well as a walking tour of the neighbourhood, which was very much appreciated.
The place was clean and near shops, restaurants, bars and a wonderful view point of Lisbon. It is easy access to all main attractions in Lisbon as well. Communication was easy and our hosts seemed available for any further inquiries along our stay.
We had a great stay, and would highly recommend booking this apartment.

Notre séjour s'est très bien déroulé, l'appartement est idéalement situé et est très central. Malgré sa proximité de la vie nocturne l'appartement est très calme.
Joao nous a fait visité les alentours et nous as donné de très bons conseils pour se restaurer et visiter; Très utile et agréable, merci!
Pour ce qui est de l'appartement, rien à redire, il est comme décrit.
Je précise que nous avons séjourné dans la chambre double et nous y avons très bien dormi!

We had an unbelievable experience in Lisbon! We took an overnight bus into the city so we arrived around 6 am and Joao let us store our baggage at the apartment until it was ready for us! He walked us around the city and showed us the most beautiful places to see. The location of the apartment is perfect and you truly feel like you are a local Lisboan. Great boutique shopping area right down the street and the most incredible view around the corner. I wish we could go back right now! Highly recommend staying here if you want a true Portugese experience and the kindest locals in town.

The apartment was amazing and Alfiya and her husband were so welcoming and accommodating! She showed us around the neighborhood and gave us some great suggestions for where to eat. We only stayed one night but the morning we were supposed to check out we ended up booking a tour and they let us store our bags for a few hours while we were out. I would definitely recommend this listing!

The apartment is in a great location: close to the nightlife in Bairro Alto but in a quiet street. It's spacious and well-decorated.
Our hosts were very helpful, showing us around the area and reacting very quickly to all our queries.

Toen wij aankwamen 's avonds rond 21 uur stonden Alfiya en Joao al op ons te wachten. Het appartement netjes schoon en sfeervol verlicht. Ze liepen met ons direct een rondje door de buurt om ons wegwijs te maken. De volgende dag heeft Joao 2 ur met ons rondgelopen om ons Lissabon te laten zien. Echt top! Het appartement is groot en keurig. Het ligt vlakbij het oude centrum. In principe is alles te voet te doen. Wij gaan hier zeker nog een keer naar toe!

Alfiya was a wonderful host. I was given a tour around the city and even showed a special place to go to get the best view ! Personalised restaurant recommendations and a really lovely hour spent wandering Lisbon with them. Apartment is as advertised, nice Historic building and in an ideal location. Walking distance from the centre and Barrio Alto is a great place to go out. Apartment was a little cold but there were extra blankets and several electric heaters so it was all good.

Alfia and her family are very friendly and hospitable people. We have received great pleasure from working with them. Old quarter, 50m from the magnificent observation platform, atmospheric apartment, with deliberate planning and execution, an equipped kitchen, a cosy lounge and a wine bar! We recommend this apartment with great pleasure!

Joao and Alfiya are great hosts. They did everything possible to make us feel welcomed, and took time to show us around the neighbourhood and give us tips upon arrival. The apartment is in a very good location - next to all the bars and restaurants of the Bairro Alto yet on a quiet, pretty street. The accomodation itself has a nice living room, large clean kitchen and bathroom, comfortable bedrooms and is a great bargain for the quality. Highly recommended!
Very nice flat in the center of the city. Very clean and tidy. Great. Experience to stay here.

Gracious and charming hosts; Joao welcomed us when we arrived and showed us around the neighbourhood - much appreciated.  The flat is spacious, quiet and comfortable, with an ideal location and easy access to many small restaurants, bars, and cafes, as well as a short walk down to the metro station.

A estadia em Lisboa foi excelente! A cidade é linda, mas a recepção de João e Alfya deixaram ela ainda mais especial. Eles foram simpáticos e cuidadosos, nos deram otimas dicas sobre a cidade e com ótima comunicação. O apartamento é ótimo e muito bem localizado , exatamente como descrito nas fotos. É bem equipado e super confortável! Com certeza recomendo o local. Mais uma vez obrigada por tudo João e Alfya, quando voltarmos a Lisboa ficaremos aí novamente!!
The stay in Lisbon was excelent! The city is amazing but the hospitality of our hosts João and Alfya made it all even more special. They were friendly and careful and gave us great tips about the city with awesome communication and even a brief tour. The apartament is great, well localized and very comfortable, exactly like the pictures and I certainly recommend it. Thanks for everything João and Alfya.

Alfiya and Joao met us at the agreed time at the flat, and were very helpful and friendly. They gave us great tips on local restaurants and left us various guides/maps for Lisbon which were useful. The flat is in a great central location and very comfortable, and we were provided with plenty of towels and bedding, as well as standalone gas and electric heaters. I would definitely recommend this flat for anyone staying in Lisbon!

Merci joao, de nous avoir receuilli a la sorti du taxi, et nous montrer le chemin de l'appartement. Apres une rapide installation, Joao, nous a fait visiter le quartier pour nous indiquer restaurants et Patisserie, pour le PdJ du  lendemain matin. L'appartement est tres spacieux, avec ces 3 ch. et son séjour. Nous ne sommes resté qu'une courte nuit avec mon collegue, mais avons aprécier sa position centrale et la proximité des ruelles animées au alentours. Calme absolu dans les chambres.

A pity we didn't get to meet Alfiya due to work commitments, but Joao took on the host role superbly. He was waiting at the door of the apartment when arrived, received us warmly. The apartment is spacious, clean, well-furnished and exudes old world charm. It is also in great location, in the historic section, walking distance to the centre, transportaction and good local restaurant. Joao generously gave us a walking tour of the city, very informative. We had a very comfortable stay in the apartment. Till next time, Joao & Alfiya. Thank you for your warm hosting.

My friends and I had a great experience staying here. Alfiya answered very promptly to all of our queries and provided us lots of tips for our stay. The flat was clean, warm and spacious; the beds were nice and comfortable. It was situated in a convenient location as well; there were lots of shops and restaurants nearby.

Alfiya was very welcoming when we arrived. He and his wife showed us around the neighbourhood and gave us recommendations for places to eat. They were very kind in helping us to book our taxi to the airport even after we had already checked out of their flat. Would definitely recommend staying here during your trip to Lisbon!

Wonderful hosts, we were met by Joao who took us on a walking tour of the area, recommended some great eating places and ways to get around Lisbon. Appartment was as described, warm and welcoming.

Thanks for th great stay
The house is great and really closed to the city center!! Alfiya is really nice and incredibly helpful... I really recommend staying here!!!

Alfiya no hizo sentir como si fuéramos en nuestra casa. El piso está situado en una calle muy tranquila y se encuentra al lado de los restaurantes, bares para salir por la noche.
El piso es muy agradable, grande, acogedor, tal y como viene en la descripción.

La estancia en la casa de joao fue perfecta. El departamento esta muy bien ubicado es muy lindo y tiene todo lo necesario para pasar unos dias hermosos en Lisboa. Sin embargo, lo mejor de Lisboa fue el anfitrion! Joao hizo todo lo posible para que conocieramos y recorrieramos lo mejor de Lisboa a pesar del mal tiempo. Es el anfitrion perfecto.!!!! Muchas gracias joao. Lisboa no hubiera sido lo mismo sin tu ayuda!!
Sin duda , cuando volvamos a Lisboa sera en lo de Joao!

Алфия и Жоао - очень гостеприимные хозяева и милые люди. Они прекрасно украсили квартиру к Новому году и подарили нам бутылку хорошего красного вина в честь приезда. А милый Жоао даже поделился с нами зонтиком, так как начался дождь во время прогулки. Хозяева показали нам ближайшие окрестности апартаментов: ресторанчики, паштеларии, где можно было поесть и старинную церковь св. Рока.
Расположение апартаментов очень удачное, рядом с красивой смотровой площадкой с изумительным видом на город. Рядом трамвай-фуникулер, на котором можно спуститься в центр на авеню Либердаде. Пешком мы дошли минут за 20 до вокзала, от которого отходят электрички в Белен и Кашкаиш. Апартаменты находятся в оживленном районе Байро Алто, но в тихом месте. Некоторым минусом является отсутствие окон в 2 спальнях.
Хозяева в каждой комнате поставили обогреватели, чтобы обогреть нас после прогулок по дождливой погоде.
Хозяева говорят по-русски.
Спасибо, Альфия и Жоао!

Alfiya and Joao were extremely accommodating and friendly. They had many great recommendations for restaurants in the neighborhood of Bairro Alto, which is a great area with beautiful views and restaurants. The home is very spacious, clean, and conveniently located. Would highly recommend Alfiya and Joao's place.

My friend and I spent a great time at Alfiya and Joao apartment. It's simple but very comfortable and  conveniently located to visit the city! Also Alfiya and Joao are súper helpful and gave us a very warm wellcome and they are always there whatever you need. I would recommend tris place without doubt!!!!

This apartment is ideal. It's large and comfortable and was warm in December with lots of hot water and a good shower. The place has everything you need and the hosts put up a Christmas tree and decorations. Along with their two sons they spent 2 hours showing us around the local area and helping us with restaurant bookings, we had a great laugh with them. They called into us on Christmas Eve with wine and cake.
We had other friends staying n a hotel and their experience was not as good as ours!
The area is old and full of life but some people might think it's too noisy. The good thing about the apartment is that it is in a quiet street so no sleepless nights.
There are items in the apartment to buy if you are too tired to go to the shop but there are lots of food shops and eateries on your door step.
I can't recommend the place and Alfiya and family highly enough.

We were met by our host at the apartment earlier than we could check in because he allowed us to store our luggage.  He took us on a tour around the neighbourhood, pointing out bakeries, restaurants, fado bars and orienting us with the transportation.  He let us in as soon as the apartment was ready.  He also had his son walk us to a restaurant so we could have lunch.  I found our host to be excellent and the apartment just as promised in a great location to walk and see Lisbon.  I would highly recommend this place and wouldn't hesitate to return.

The rooms where beautyful and for being in the mittle of the barrio alto it was even quite at night. The communication was very reliable and Alfiya's son gave us a good recomendation where to eat in the neighbourhood. I highly recommend this place. You will love it!

Alfiya and Joao were extremely accomodating and friendly. Joao was very nice as he even took us on a little tour around the neighbourhood. In addition, the location was great as we were right next to a viewpoint and several great restaurants. I would recommend this place to anyone going to Lisbon!

Superbe appartement très très bien situé , l accueil est parfait ! Nous recommandons vraiment cette adresse!! Alfiya et son mari sont des personnes vraiment agréables ils vous guiderons parfaitement ... Tout est parfait !
Everything is Perfect. Good location. Nice price.

Very nice and spacious appartment in a quiet street and close to many sights. Appartment is exactly as in the pictures; clean, nicely decorated and in a good neighborhood. Hosts were very friendly and eager to suggest places to visit.

Alfiya and Joaos apartment is pefectly located in the Bairro Alto area and perfect for exploring the city. Its very nice and lovely decorated, heater for cold winter evenings was also provided.
Joao welcomed us warmly and showed us around in the neighborhood that we knew where to find everything. He is very helpful, the communication was always easy and they helped where they could. I really recommend this aparment and Alfiya and Joao as hosts!

Joao welcomed us as long time friends, he show the apartment and features, showed me around the neighbourhood. The local shops, pastries shop for breakfasts and 3 local resturants. The apartment was clean & tidy, bed was comfortable. Kitchen had all needs required, great to catch up on the laundry with apartment's washing machine. On final day Joao stored our bags until we left then organised the taxi to the airport.  Would stay there again with no hesitation

My boyfriend and I visited Lisbon for a long weekend in November. Joao met us and gave us a very helpful little tour around the neighbourhood including recommendations for restaurants, bars and cafes. We took the recommendations on board and can confirm that they were all very nice. He also explained to us how to get to the centre and navigate our way around Lisbon, and was very warm and welcoming. The apartment itself was in a very nice area on a quiet street, but the adjacent streets had really fun bars, restaurants and a great atmosphere at night. It was lovely, very clean and had all the necessities. We really enjoyed our stay and loved Lisbon as a city. We would definitely recommend to a friend.

Casa muito confortável, acolhedora e limpa! Os proprietários era de uma simpatia extrema e muito atenciosos! Não podia ter sido melhor.
Óptima localização. Recomendo vivamente

The apartment is perfectly situated, just above the hill from Rossio and Restaudores- spectacular views just down the street.  The apartment is comfortable and well equipped.  There's a funicular from the metro if you don't want to walk up the hill.  Alfiya and his family are very thoughtful hosts.  Hot tip: there is the best Portuguese tart specialist (better than Belem) just a 5 min stroll away: http://www.tripadvisor.com/Restaurant_Review-g3874225-d6957429-Reviews-Manteigaria-Lisbon_District_Central_Portugal.html

Excellent hosts and apartment. The apartment is in a perfect location, tastefully decorated and a very generous size. We were met on arrival and given a quick tour round the neighbourhood which was really usefully. It was no issue to leave our bags early and to book a taxi for us. Above all, Joao who we met several times was a very kind and thoughtful man. We would definitely come back and thoroughly recommend.

Appartement tout à fait conforme à la description, idéalement placé et silencieux. Communication en amont excellente, flexible sur le stockage des valises. Rien à redire. C'était parfait
Un grand merci à Joao qui nous a offert un accueil digne d'un ami et qui nous rappelle ce qu'Airbnb peut offrir. Un grand merci à Alfiya et Joao pour leur gentillesse.
Expérience parfaite
It was great! Good location right in the centre of Lisbon, but super quiet even on busy nights. Host is super accommodating
Un accueil chaleureux et amical dans un quartier charmant et vivant. L appartement est propre et confortable encore miles merci.

Alfiya and Joao's apartment is amazing: Beautifully decorated, spacious, sunny and equipped with everything you need for a short or long term stay. It is perfectly located in the heart of Bairro Alto with restaurants, bars and shops within walking distance. Joao was very friendly and helpful at our arrival, and although we only stayed for one night on our way home from Madeira, I recommend this place to anyone. Would stay here again in a heart beat whenever I visit Lisboa.

Situé dans le centre historique de Lisbonne et plus particulièrement dans le quartier typique du Bairro Alto, ce sympathique appartement est le point de départ idéal pour toutes les visites. Nous avons eu un accueil exceptionnel de la part de Joao (du bon vin nous attendait dans le réfrigérateur ) qui malgré l'heure très tardive de notre arrivée n'a pas hésité à nous montrer le quartier. Ce dernier regorge de restaurants et de bars mais la rue dans laquelle se situe l'appartement est très calme et rien n'est venu perturber notre sommeil durant les 4 nuits. Nous avons eu droit à une plus grande visite le lendemain matin avec les principaux sites à visiter dans le coin et les bonnes adresses pour prendre le petit déjeuner et le dîner. Joao nous a donné une foule de conseils pour notre séjour à Lisbonne et nous a permis de trouver un parking très abordable à proximité pour notre voiture de location. Bref, un séjour et un accueil inoubliable.

Super appartement, très bien placé.
Joao nous a très bien accueillis et nous a même fait visiter le quartier!

Alfiya and Joao were fantastic hosts. They met us when we arrived and showed us round the area, pointing out places to eat and drink.

the apartment is exactly as described and is really spacious. The hosts provide everything you could need. They also very kindly shared a lovely bottle of Portugese wine with us.

The rooms are big and spacious and there is a nice big bathroom. The apartment is in the centre of the bars and restaurants and is a short walk from the centre of Lisbon.

If you're thinking of staying in Lisbon you have to stay here!

Esperienza positiva sotto tutti i punti di vista .Casa come da foto Host disponibile puntuale nelle risposte cordiale nei chiarimenti. Zona della casa nel Barrio Alto di Lisbona facilmente raggiungibile con mezzi pubblici.La città è vivace e godibile x brevi periodi il costo della vita medio basso quindi consigliabile anche x famiglie.
Easy contacting and very informative about the apartment and surrounding area. Very good recommendations and a clean and nice flat.

Nous avons été accueillies du mieux qu'on puisse l'espérer. Joao nous attendait au parking puis il nous a aidé à porter nos valises jusqu'à l'appartement. L'appartement est très bien situé dans une rue calme. Il est très propre et confortable. Si nous devons revenir à Lisbonne nous serons ravies de revoir Joao et d'apprécier à nouveau son appartement.

Un grazie speciale ad ALFIYA e JOAO per averci ospitato in questa casa deliziosa che hanno fatto sentire nostra fino in fondo. Questa è la nostra prima esperienza ma credo che host come loro siano il sogno di tutti. Gentili, disponibili, affettuosi e molto simpatici. Ci siamo sentiti come dei nipoti a spasso con degli zii per i vicoli del Barrio Alto. Torneremo sicuramente a trovarvi e alloggeremo nella vostra bella casetta, perché l'abbiamo veramente sentita nostra grazie a voi.  Grazie ancora per tutto e per il vino veramente apprezzatissimo.  A presto Mariagrazia e famiglia.

The apartment was clean and lovely . Good location, close to the bus stop and main attractions. They prepared the 3 large bedrooms for us and our kids. The street is quiet, which is good considering that the area is full of bars and restaurants favored by the tourists and locals.
Joao speaks french and Alfiya english very well. Joao took the time to give us a tour of the neighborhood : where to go, eat, get breakfast and buy food.
They were very nice and I strongly recommend the apartment.

Alfiya & Joao we both very friendly when picking up the keys and went out of their way to show the best local spots around the apartment. We all had a lovely time in the flat which was in a great location to explore Lisbon. Thank you Alfiya & Joao!
D'une gentillesse extrême, Joao qui parlait français nous a conseillé sur un très bon restaurant, sur ce qu'il y avait a visiter sur Lisbonne.

Sehr sehr nette Gastgeber! Gleich am ersten Tag eine tour gemacht und jns alles gezeigt was nötig war. Auch während des Aufenthaltes war Alfiya hilfsbereit und hat mir alles von Tattoo studios bis hin zu Bäckerein gezeigt!
Nur zu empfehlen!
Amazing time with Alfiya! Very enjoyable and she showed us around town on the first day telling us all about the neighborhood and all the other places to go!
Greatly enjoyed our stay and will be back as soon as possible!
Lots of love from Berlin!

A lovely flat in a wonderful corner of Lisbon & very close to a metro station. The hosts are very reliable and responsive. Only remark would be that the walls are very thin and the beds squeaky, so bring earplugs. The kitchen is well equipped with water bottles, coffee, wine and tea, but you are asked to pay for everything. So bring some cash or go shopping.

The apartment was clean and well maintained . Loved the location, close to transportation and main attractions,  Joao went out of his way to showed us around the night we arrived and the next morning gave us a tour of city center.   I recommend anyone that visits Lisbon, to stay at their apartment.

It was a very nice to stay in this beautiful apartment. The apartment was very clean and comfortable.
Joao was a perfect host and gave us a welcome tour in the neighborhood.

I highly recommend it and would stay here again.

Joao was the best host I've ever had! He was so sweet and extremely helpful! After our two day stay he felt like a close family friend that I hoped I'd get to see over the holidays.  He spent 30 minutes walking us around the neighborhood and showing us how to get around as well as recommendations for places to eat. We tried a few that were very close to the apartment and they were absolutely amazing! The apartment was in a great location, very close to a beautiful park and look-out point. It was very clean and spacious and was just as described. Joao even let us store our luggage for 7 hours after the check out time. Best Airbnb experience I've ever had and highly recommend!!!!
We had a great time. First a warm welcome and a tour in the neighborhood. Joao showed us the nice restaurants en places to be! What a nice people. Thanks for the hospitality. We will come back.

Фотографии квартиры полностью соответствуют реальности - квартира уютная, расположена на тихой улочке. Но самый большой плюс этих аппартаментов - хозяева! Жоау показал не туристические места для обедов, они были безмерно приветливы и радушны! Было ощущение, что мы приехали погостить к родственникам))
Один из плюсов в квартире - это общая гостиная, где вечером можно за бутылочкой португальского вина обменяться впечатлениями о прекрасной стране!
Lovely welcome and a great location. Host organised a taxi to the airport for us and even brought us the clothes we missed when packing!

My experience in Lisbon staying in Joao's apartment has been very pleasant. Joao was very flexible and met us when we arrived. He helped us with the luggage, went with us to park our car and was very kind to take us for a walk around the neighborhood and recommend us a few nice places to eat. The apartment is situated in Bairro Alto, in a quiet area just a few streets away from all the fun, pubs and restaurants.  The streets are restricted to residents only access, therefore access with your own car is not possible. The apartment is on the 2nd floor and it looks exactly like in the photos.  There is a "mini-bar" prepared for the guests (biscuits, wine, beer, water, tea, coffee etc), you can take what you need and pay when you checkout. So, in case the stores are closed you can find the basics right in the apartment.

A Lovely apartment very clean, spacious & comfortable.  The host couldn't have been more helpful, when we arrived he gave us a tour of the area which was very useful.  It is a great idea to be able to purchase some products such as beer, wine & lots more in the apartment.  The location is excellent in a vibrant area & in an interesting part of the city but in a quiet street.  Would recommend this apartment & look forward to staying here again in the future.

Our host was fantastic, able to meet me at local metro station, friendly & informative. He gave me a walking tour of the main local restaurants & shops, together with advice about local landmarks & transport.
The apartment was wonderful, clean, light & airy. The washing machine was easy to use, & there was ample spare bedding, towels & linen. All detergents etc were provided.
The area is superb, lively, fun & safe. Gorgeous neighbours in both the apartment & the street. Great to feel like a local & to not have to go far to savour great food, fado & nightlife. Also very easy to access the city highlights, churches, landmarks, shops, museums. A 100% great experience.

The Host was very nice and helpful. He was waiting at the apartment when we arrived and drived with us to find the gas station because we needed to give back the rental cars.
The apartment is in the middle of the action. Just around the corner are all the restaurants and clubs.
You can not drive there by car. If you have a car you need to leave it somewhere else. We left it to the parking house.
The apartment is nice.

The hosts were incredibly welcoming and friendly - really went the extra mile. The apartment is beautiful and spacious and also well equipped. There is a mini bar (tea/coffee/beers/water etc) which is nice as saves you from having to run to the shop for staples.
The location is also great, in the heart of the old town.
I very much recommend this apartment.

The apartment was fantastic and the welcome that we received from Joao was first class. We arrived earlier in the day and he kindly offered to store our bags and gave us a tour of the area outlining the best restaurants to eat at. The apartment was clean and had everything that you could require for a city break. Location is awesome!

Would recommend to anyone.
Квартира супер! Очень светлая и просторная! Хозяин квартиры очень приятный мужчина! И что важно, говорит на русском) спасибо вам огромное!
Joao was very nice and helpful. The house is well situated, in the middle of Barrio Alto but in a quiet street.

It was superb. Me and my family(2 adults, 1 teen, 1 child), stayed at the Joao apartment just one night, but his welcome has been really warm... Joao helped us with luggages and personally accompanied me to the nearest long stay car parking of the zone, showing me the best place where having dinner and enjoying Lisboa.
The apartment is just great: it's placed in the heart of Bairro Alto, but in a secondary street, really quiet and silent. At the same time you are 2 minute walking far by clubs,
The apartments has 3 bed rooms! For us Joao arranged one double and two singles, but any rooms has two beds, so the apartments could comfortably hosts 6 people. Fresh linens and huge and roomy bathroom.
I really recommend Joao's apartment for a wonderful staying in Lisboa!

Wonderful experience! The host Joao took such a good care of us. I was touched. He was waiting for us when we arrived and made sure we got on a taxi on time when we were heading to the airport. He was responding right away when we had questions which restaurant to choose or where to go.
The apartment is a gem in a great area. Very spacious, comfortable and quiet.

HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!

Bel appartement fonctionnel, bien situé au calme dans le Barrio Alto.
Parfait pour un voyage en famille ou entre amis.
Joao a été très accueillant et a pris le temps de nous montrer les bonnes adresses à proximité.
Très bon plan !!!

Nous avons adoré notre séjour à Lisbonne et les conseils de Joao nous ont permis de découvrir les bons restaurants, les lieux à ne pas oublier. Quel hôte extraordinaire ! Quelle gentillesse ! L'appartement est splendide et idéalement placé. je ne peux que recommander de séjourner chez Joao et Alfiya. On a adoré, adoré, adoré
Merci pour cet accueil très chaleureux et pour avoir été un guide d'exception. Appartement très bien situé, très mignon et très propre ! Nous reviendrons ! Merci de nous 4
The Apartment is spacious and nicely decorated.  It is located in Barrio  Alto so that you are close to a lot of tourist attractions. Joao and His son welcomed us very nice and gave us a lot of tips.

Neighbourhood was fantastic. We were in a quiet street in the middle of the Barrio Alto ( the liveliest part of Lisbon. A great place to stay.)
Everything was as described. Joao was a really nice host and very helpful. He also oriented us in the Barrio, in the morning of the day ,after we had arrived.
Great apartment, great location and great hosts who gave lots of recommendations about the local area. Definitely a recommendation for somewhere to stay whilst in Lisbon.

We stayed for one night following the NOS Alive festival and it was the perfect way to end our holiday! Joao was a fantastic host!!!

We were met at the apartment and then we were taken on a guided tour of the surrounding area! Joao showed us some great places to eat and drink as well as where to get a great coffee and breakfast in the morning! He took us to some of the best sights to help us plan our short time there, the best welcome we have ever had staying anywhere in the world!

The apartment is large and beautifully kept. Joao even has a selection of wines, snacks and essentials which you can buy for very low prices which was perfect if you don't want to leave the apartment. It is in a great location with lots of bars nearby and a short walk to the main sights.

I would definitely recommend this apartment and Joao as a host, we had a wonderful time and are even planning return visit later this year! We have never felt so at home on holiday!

Tolle und empfehlenswerte Adresse in Lissabon!
Die Wohnung ist einfach, aber liebevoll und geschmackvoll eingerichtet und liegt zentral im Altstadtviertel. Obwohl viele Lokale in nächster Nähe sind, findet man nachts wirklich Ruhe. Die Wohnung ist komplett eingerichtet und von den Vermietern werden auch Getränke und Kleinigkeiten zu einem fairen Unkostenbetrag bereitgestellt. Wir wurden sehr herzlich von Joao empfangen und umsorgt. Er war äußerst hilfsbereit, sei es bei einem kleinen Spaziergang, auf dem er uns Restaurant- und Frühstücktipps zeigte oder beim Bestellen eines Taxis zum Flughafen. Und das alles, obwohl wir nur (leider) für eine Nacht geblieben sind! Vielen herzlichen Dank!

A mais ótima estadia em Lisboa! O João e a sua família são supersimpáticas e hospitaleiras. A localização da casa é fantástica e o apartamento é muito bem equipado e agradável. Hei de voltar trazendo os familiares e mais amigos.

Super cosy apartment in the center of lisbon. I stayed there with five of my friends and we loved it. We were shown around by Joao, who is very friendly and welcoming. I would definitely recommend it!

La estancia fue maravillosa. Joao fue muy servicial. Nos ayudó en todo lo que le pedimos. Un diez como anfitrión. La casa es exactamente igual que en las fotos. Todo está cuidado al detalle. Tengo claro que cuando vuelva a Lisboa, volveré a contactar con ellos. Wonderfull people!!!

Joao was a kind and gracious host.  He met us at the apartment and showed us around the local area - shops, pastelaria (essential for breakfast!), restaurants, fabulous viewpoint over the city.  The apartment was really well located in a quiet narrow street just off the busy area of Barrio Alto. It was cool and airy on what was a very very hot day.  We rested for the afternoon - with the lucky bonus of the music from an practising acoustic guitarist floating up from a nearby window.  We took to the streets for the evening to eat and to ride the crazy rollercoaster trams - great fun.  Joao also arranged a taxi to the airport for the following morning and came by to make sure everything was ok.  Would definitely stay again.
非常棒~主人超好超nice

Nous étions ravis de l'accueil de Joao Silva. Très gentil, très bon accueil, nous étions les bienvenus. Nous avons apprécié d'avoir une petite réserve dans le frigo (bière, eau, beurre...) cela nous a permis de nous rafraichir en arrivant. Nous avons également apprécié qu'il vienne nous accueillir à l'aéroport. Nous nous sommes sentis chez nous. Le quartier est très bien et surtout très calme la nuit. Merci encore à Joao Silva. La famille Houssay

Wonderful stay in the apartment, with very helpful and warm hosts! The location is perfect for exploring Lisbon for a few days. The garden a block from the apartment had some of the best views of the city, and nightlife is steps away. Didn't have any problems with noise, especially with windows closed. Alfiya and Joao were absolutely lovely, went above and beyond to help give us suggestions, show us a bit of the neighborhood and make us feel at home. Would happily send any friend to stay at their place while in Lisbon!

Maria and João were incredible; it was the best one yet. From the initial messages, they gave us great suggestions, were very responsive, and were very hospitable.  They welcomed us immediately, took the time to show us around the neighborhood, and gave us great recommendations. The place was much better than expected: a chic, spacious, and very clean apartment. From the kitchen, to the bedrooms, to the bathroom, to the living, everything was spotless. They also had food for purchase, in the apartment, which was very convenient.

Joao est un hôte d'exception, et il n'a pas hésité à prendre le temps nécessaire pour nous faire découvrir les endroits qui pouvaient être intéressant. pour nous ( épicerie, patisserie, resto, en plus d'une magnifique église a proximité). L'appartement est vraiment bien, et conforme aux photographies. attention toutefois le soir il vaut mieux fermer les fenêtres car c'est un quartier ou la vie nocturne est importante, alors si vous êtes sensible au bruit.....Merci mille fois pour votre accueil, Lisbonne est une ville magnifique.

Maria and João were incredible; it was the best one yet. From the initial messages, they gave us great suggestions, were very responsive, and were very hospitable.  They welcomed us immediately, took the time to show us around the neighborhood, and gave us great recommendations. The place was much better than expected: a chic, spacious, and very clean apartment. From the kitchen, to the bedrooms, to the bathroom, to the living, everything was spotless. They also had food for purchase, in the apartment, which was very convenient.

Our experience in Lisbon was excellent!! Alfiya and Joao were wonderful!  They were more than accommodating meeting us in the morning so we could store our luggage, showing us around and giving recommendations of some of their favorite restaurants. The apt is great!  Very clean, excellent location.  We definitely plan on returning in the future!!

Large and nice apartment in a great area, close to a superb viewpoint, restaurants and bars. Joao and Alfiya are very hospitable. Beds are comfy. The apartment is not too varm in spite of no air condition. As it is a lovely but old building make sure you bring air plugs. I would definitely recommend this place!
Very nice apartment in a great location in Lisbon

The apartment is in an excellent location in Lisbon, and we found it easy to walk to many locations in the city.
