Alfiya and Joao were very welcoming and gave us a brief walking tour of the neighborhood.  The nearby park offers a lovely location to look out over the city, and there's a very pleasant outdoor cafe.  The apartment is spacious and clean.

Alfiya and Joao are very welcoming and helpful hosts. Joao kindly collected us from the airport and pointed out place of interest on the drive back to the apartment. Joao recommend a cafe just around the corner for breakfast and we would recommend it to. The apartment is ideally situated to visit  lisbon's  historic attractions. The apartment was very clean comfortable and suited our needs. We would definitely recommend the apartment.

Bonjour! Nous étions 3 adultes à rester dans ce grand appartement pour 4 nuits. On a trouvé ça très confortable et on était très satisfait.
L'appartement est dans le quartier branché du Bairro Alto (plein de petits bars) et malgré ça la rue est tranquille et silencieuse.
L'accueil de Joâo a été très chaleureux. La communication en français se faisait très bien. Il a pris le temps de nous faire le tour du quartier! Entre autre, il nous a suggéré un petit cafe tout proche qui êtait parfait pour le déjeuner et une petite épicerie. Merci beaucoup João ! Nos sincères salutations :) Nada, Hiam et Amal

We stayed here for 4 nights in May and had a great time.  The flat is spotlessly clean, airy and spacious; it is centrally located, with good transport links nearby including the Elevador Da Gloria, yet the location is quiet and peaceful.  We met Joao, his son and his sister who were so friendly and helpful and who gave us lots of useful information including recommendations about visits and places to eat. We definitely recommend Sunshine 1!

Le propriétaire Joao est très prévenant et dévoué. Il fait tout pour que le séjour se passe bien. Nous avons été très contents de le rencontrer. L'appartement est aussi très soigné et bien situé. Il faut juste savoir que deux des trois chambres  sont intérieures.

Bon accueil d'arriver de la part de Joao. Le propriétaire est très arrangeant, accessible et fait attention aux petits détailles pour qu'on passe un bon séjour.
Visite rapide des alentours afin de savoir où manger, boire un verre, petit déjeuner, acheter de la nourriture, prendre les transports, les quartiers à visiter.
Le logement correspond bien à la description, il est propre et dans une rue calme. Le quartier est facilement accessible depuis le centre et a l’avantage d'être pas loin de plusieurs restaurants et bars.

Alfyia and Joao were very welcoming, such a lovely couple! They surely know how to make you feel at home and they are flexible and available. The flat was clean, neat and tidy. Great location in a quiet street but close to the night life. I highly recommend this place.

WOW, where do I start, Joao is a exceptional person and really helpful as well and he made sure that everything was alright with us. We arrived late due to late flight arrival and a taxi driver who got lost!!, he was there waiting for us still smiling even at 01:15am. Joao met us the following day and provided us with suggestions on where to eat, which were spot on, and things to do in Lisbon and beyond. The apartment is excellent with big bedrooms and in a quiet but yet we were within walking distance to the lively bar area and eating area. The best Tapas bar is just at the bottom of the street and the best coffee house a 5 minute walk away, which we frequented and had amazing food and drink at excellent prices.
I would definitely recommend this place without hesitation. It is worth every single penny we paid for the 5 nights. We met Alfiya on the last day before our flight home, who is very nice. I can only say a massive thank you Joao and Alfiya..will definitely return to lisbon and rent out your place again! Wayne & Lauren Garvican, Doncaster, England
We had a very pleasant stay. Both hosts are great, very welcoming. Location is amazing. Joao also showed us around although we arrived after 11pm. Thank you to both!!

Joao &Alfiya were superb hosts. Joao arranged to pick us up at the Lisbon airport as it was our first trip to Portugal. In addition, he conducted a brief tour of his neighborhood so we were familiar with local stores, restaurants, points of interest and unique antique shops. One could not have anticipated more from our very first AirB&B experience.
The apartment was large, clean, comfortable, and very secure. The wi-fi connections worked well-an important feature for most travelers. Also, the location was ideal as we were about a one minute walk from one of the highest parks in Lisbon which afforded us great views in a very pleasant atmosphere. Plus, we were a 7 Euro ride, or a pleasant walk from the main square of Lisbon.
We strongly recommend this location as a pleasant and inexpensive alternative to traditional hotel room.
As an example, we had three very fine meals for two people for less than 30 Euros at a beautiful 250 year old bakery that was a 5 minute walk from J& A's place. Two small neighborhood markets with fresh everything are located along the walk to the bakery.
All-in-all, our first AirB&B experience would have been difficult to improve upon.
Regards.....Tim & Susan
Excellent accueil. L'appartement est conforme aux photos. Je le recommande vivement

Joao and Alfiya were the perfect hosts. Flexible on luggage and kind to give us some local tips! The flat was tidy, comfortable and located on a quite street, though close to the action in Barrio Alto! I would recommend anyone to stay here.
It was a great place to stay in the middle of Biarro Alto. Alfiya tried to make us feel at home right away.

Joao is a really nice person and really helpful as well and he made sure that everything was alright with us. We arrived late due to late flight arrival and he was there waiting for us still smiling! :) Also provided us with suggestions on places to go and things to do. He was really helpful and accommodating...Neighbourhood was quiet but yet we were walking distance to the lively bar area. I would definitely recommend this place. It is worth every single cent you pay for. Thank you Joao and Alfiya..will definitely return to lisbon and rent out your place again! Fabrigado :)

Joao was a very welcoming host. The rooms are as depicted. The location was terrific. Joao went out of his way to help us with our bags and to show us around the neighborhood. We enjoyed the visit very much! At a small charge, the bare necessities came pre-stocked in the house, allowing us to forgo a trip to the market just for milk and coffee.
La casa está muy bien situada, limpia y es como aparece en las fotos. Si vuelvo a Lisboa en otra ocasión repetiría sin dudar. Gracias.

Värdarna
Utmärkt värdpar. Bra mejl/chat-konversation före resan, där värdarna Joao och Alfiya svarade bra på de frågor vi hade. Personligt och trevligt bemötande vid ankomst och avresa. Värden Joao mycket omtänksam och vänlig.

Lägenheten
Lägenheten helt okej för våra behov, allt vi behövde fanns. Tyst miljö, rent och fint, lite mysigt och charmigt, ingen röklukt. Sängarna och duschen (tryck och temperaturreglering) kunde ha varit bättre men det var inget som i hög grad påverkade vårt helhetsintryck. Wifi fungerar okej men inte bra i alla rummen - räkna inte med att kunna spela onlinespel seriöst i denna lägenhet - däremot för att kolla google maps, nyheter och youtube på lägre upplösning fungerar det alldeles utmärkt.

Läget
Lägenhetens läge är mycket bra, väldigt nära till men inte påverkat av Bairro Altos alla hundratals barer, pubar och restauranger, och även nära till små gulliga närbutiker, slaktare och bagerier (allt detta rekommenderas). Gångavstånd ner till affärerna och sevärdheterna i centrum men många trappsteg upp igen! Lissabon har stora höjdskillnader och flera fina utsiktsplatser finns på bara några minuters promenad från lägenheten. Ganska nära till T-bana, spårvagn, bussar, taxihållplats (Principe Real) och hyrbilsfirma (DSCAR, Praca de Alegria mitt emot jazzklubben Hot Club).

Excellent séjour de 3 jours en famille dans cet appartement très confortable, spacieux, très bien situé dans une ruelle calme au cœur du Barrio Alto. Un grand merci à Joao et Alfiya qui sont plein d'attentions et font tout pour que leurs hôtes se sentent comme chez eux.

AMAZING VALUE! This apartment is exactly what you see in the photos. Clean, spacious and beautiful. Our host Joao was a kind, outgoing and helpful host. I would recommend this apartment to anyone and everyone.

If you go to Lisbon you MUST stay at Joao's. The place is really nice, fully equiped, they are very up to details, very kind and helpfull. The location couldnt be better.
But above everything, i would like to highlight Joaos attention, he is a great host and this is also shown in the way the house is taken care of.
We hope we can go back soon. Thank you!

L'appartement est magnifique, calme et très bien placé pour visiter Lisbonne.
Joao a été très accueillant, très serviable et d'une grande gentillesse.
Je recommande vivement cet appartement.

Joao and Alfiya could not have been nicer. They made us feel right at home and were available for any questions. The location was great. It was In a quaint quiet neighborhood but close enough to all the Action. The apartment was clean and very comfortable. We would definitely stay there again.
The apt is exactly as seen on pictures. Location is perfect and Joao is a perfect host. Thank you for a warm welcome, next time I will book your apt for sure. Greetings Lukasz

POSIZIONE : 9/10
VANTAGGI:
La casa è situata davvero nel cuore del quartiere Bairro Alto, vicinissima ad una piazzetta con il belvedere da cui si può godere di una vista mozzafiato di Lisbona. A piedi dal quartiere si puó raggiungere una delle piazze principali..Piazza Restauradores dove si trova la metro e l'info point per i turisti e da qui raggiungere tutte le attrazioni principali della città.
Noi non abbiamo mai usato la metro o altri mezzi pubblici per spostarci, anche se a pochi metri da casa c'è la fermata del tram. Abbiamo usufruito del bus turistico (25 euro per 48h linea verde+linea rossa) che consigliamo vivamente, per visitare la città e scendere nelle zone più lontane dal centro.
La sera si possono trovare sotto casa bar e ristoranti.
SVANTAGGI: nessuno

PULIZIA : 8/10
VANTAGGI:
Asciugamani e lenzuola pulite, così come la pulizia del bagno e dei pavimenti.
SVANTAGGI:
Nessuno

HOST : 8/10
VANTAGGI :
Le comunicazioni tramite airbnb con Joao sono state sempre puntuali ed efficienti.
Joao è stato un HOST perfetto, gentilmente si è offerto di venirci a prendere in aeroporto dove ci ha accolti con una bottiglia di buon vino e parlando con noi in italiano. Appena arrivati a casa, ci ha spiegato un pó le regole, e siamo scesi con lui a fare una passeggiata per il centro così da farci capire le distanze e come muoverci per vedere le attrazioni principali. Ci ha anche consigliato ristoranti o pub dove mangiare e un supermercato dove fare la spesa.
Joao sarà un HOST che non dimenticheremo mai per la sua gentilezza e il suo carattere davvero simpatico!
SVANTAGGI:
Nessuno

CASA: 6/10
VANTAGGI:
La casa ha tutto ciò che serve per trascorrere una breve vacanza turistica. L'arredamento delle camere e del bagno sono essenziali.
SVANTAGGI:
In casa non ci sono i termosifoni ma solo delle stufe che noi non abbiamo acceso poiché non abbiamo sentito freddo di notte.
Alle finestre non ci sono tende, per avere un pó di privacy bisogna chiudere le ante e quindi si resta al buio.

Consiglio questo appartamento a chi vuole visitare Lisbona trovandosi vicina al centro della città, in una posizione tranquilla e perfettamente collegata.
Inoltre la gentilezza e la disponibilità di Joao renderà ancora più piacevole il soggiorno.

Grazie ancora per l'ospitalità
Claudia e Vittorio
Great place! Highly recommended. Joao is really sweet and organized!
房子很大很宽敞，三个卧室装饰得很用心，厨房设备也一应俱全。地理位置位于市中心的一个小山坡上。Joao是个非常非常Nice的房主，带我们兜了一圈市中心，第二天还非常好的送我们去机场，这是我在airbnb上遇到过的最棒的一次住宿经历。
Thank you so much for welcoming us in Lisboa ! The flat was amazing, very clean and perfectly located in the city. Joao was very helpful and gave us very useful advice on the neighborhood!

Nous avons été excellemment bien reçus par Joao, notre hôte polyglotte, dans cet agréable appartement du Bairro Alto. Hyper disponibles, à la fois discrets et toujours aux petits soins pour nous, Alfiya et Joao n'auraient rien pu faire de plus pour rendre notre séjour plus agréable.
L'appartement est idéalement situé, comme indiqué par plusieurs hôtes, il se trouve dans une ruelle calme à proximité immédiate des restaurants et bars de ce quartier animé. L'appartement est fonctionnel, en excellent état, spacieux et plein de charme, en tout point conforme aux photos.
Nous reviendrons séjourner chez Alfiya et Joao sans hésiter lors de notre prochain séjour. Nous tenons à les remercier d'avoir rendu notre séjour à Lisbonne aussi agréable.

Alfiya and Joao were peeking out the windows to welcome us as we were lost and finding the place! The place was really cute and was sandwiched right in between the square / bairo alto (the location was great, despite getting to the place being super uphill) and they accommodated us very graciously. Check-in and check-out were a breeze, and perhaps if we are in the area next time, we will stop by! Thanks for the experience :)

Fantastic location, spacious apartment and everything you could need for your stay in Lisbon.
Joao met us at the airport and took us to the apartment. He showed us a bakery, supermarket and Portuguese restaurant right on our doorstep as well as providing us with various tips for our stay in Lisbon.
The kitchen was well stocked with wine, beer and hot drinks priced competitively and meant that you didn't have to spend time purchasing these items.
We enjoyed the local bars and restaurants until the early hours but at all times we felt safe. The apartment is also off of the main noisy strip so you can go to sleep at ease when you choose for your night to end.
Joao also let us leave our luggage in the apartment on our final day before dropping us at the airport for our return flight.
I could not recommend this apartment any more for price and location. Hospitality and communication from Alfiya and Joao could not be improved.

Agreable et spacieux appartement situe dans un quartier animé de lisbonne. A proximité des principales places tout peut se faire à  pied. Enfin joao a été un hôte vraiment aux petits soins, nous reviendrons avec plaisir! Encore merci :)

João é um perfeito anfitrião. Obrigado pela acolhida. Me senti completamente em casa!
O apartamento é maravilhoso. Amplo, limpo e bem equipado. Espero poder voltar várias vezes!
Um prazer conhecê-lo João!
Obrigado pelo carinho.

I stayed at Alfiya and Joao's house for a day. First of all, they were wonderful hosts (as we were bad travellers...:() we delayed our check-in time once and we were about 40minutes late for check-in. We should have double-checked timetables for tram because a) trams could get stuck in traffic like any cars and b) there aren't that many trams and buses in Lisboa which was different from other cities in Europe we had been to! Maybe it was just us...but anyways, they were very informing and welcoming despite our mistakes. we truly thank them for that!
About the apartment, it was beyond our imagination! It was a beautiful apartment: well-decorated, clean, equipped with everything. The bed was very comfortableWe loved the house and had a great time!
The location is great, too as there are many delicious restaurants near and two stations (Restadores and Rossio i believe)are in walking distance.
I highly recommend their places to couples, families, and other travelers!

Ottima l'esperienza a Lisbona e l'accoglienza a casa.
Joao è una persona gentile e disponile, ci messo subito nostro agio e ci ha dato indicazioni utili sulla città e i locali della zona. L'appartamento è grande, confortevole e ben curato. L'ubicazione è perfetta, dal Barrio Alto si raggiungono facilmente a piedi gli altri quartieri o, in alternativa, si può prendere il tram, la cui fermata è a pochi metri da casa. Consiglio a tutti l'apt. Sunshine 1
Excellent location and kind owner. Gladly recommend this place.

Joao was a perfect host - so very friendly, helpful and generous with his time.    The apartment was a pleasure to be in.  Quiet and comfortable, it has everything you could possibly need for a holiday or business break in Lisbon.  It's location is also perfect.  Located in the historic Bairro Alto with it's beautiful cobbled streets and traditional Lisbon houses, it has many great places to eat right on the doorstep.  Round the corner is a fantastic coffee shop which sells the most amazing cakes, including the famous Pastel de Nata (custard tart).

What a fantastic place! Joao met us at the entrance and welcomed us into the apartment. He was very friendly and suggested some good places to visit. The apartment was large for this area of Lisbon, very clean and warm with ample facilities. We would definitely look to stay here again the next time we are in Lisbon.

It was a pleasure to stay at Lisbon apt. Sunshine 1, the apartment is exactly what you see in the pictures with plenty of space, well decorated and clean. We felt immediately at home.

João was a super host, very welcoming and making himself available and to all our needs. These included providing us with a baby's clot, keeping hold of our luggage before check-in and after we had checked-out, and calling a taxi when we had to depart to the airport.

Despite having stayed only for one night, it felt we came as guests and left as friends.

I recommend the apartment to anyone visiting Lisbon, very suitable for a family or for a small group of friends who wish to experience life as a local.

The location, Bairro Alto is a hotspot for some of the best restaurants and bars in Lisbon, independent designer shops, and alternative culture. The beauty of the area resides in the smooth blend of old and new features and despite the neighborhood's vibrant dynamics, the apartment is located on a very tranquil tranquil street and at walking distance from main transport links and a variety of Lisbon's iconic landmarks.

If I ever need accommodation in Lisbon again (where I am also a host), I am certain to look for Alfiya's and João's place.

Thank you João and Alfiya.

Best wishes,

Miguel

Joao was a great host - very hospitable, flexible and open-hearted. He reacted stright away to all our wishes and made our stay very comfortable. The flat is very spacious and well-equipped - in the kitchen there is even a small shop with basic items like tea, coffee or drinks. Due to the central position of the flat, we could enjoy our stay in Lissabon to the maximum. We highly recommend the accomodation - we will come back definatelly in the future!
Very nice and helpfull host
El departamento es perfecto la ubicación la mejor muy recomendable

We loved the appartment and Alfiya and Joao made us feel welcome!
They are very friendly and helpfull hosts. The appartment is well situated in a quit street of Bairro Alto. The appartment was clean and comfortable, towels are included.
Lissabon is beautifull, the people are friendly and relaxed. The "pasteis de Belem" are great....all ingredients for a nice holiday!

Though we only live one night. The experience is really good. The apartment is spacious and clean. We suggest to get a day ticket of the transportation at the arrival since you have to take the 'lift bus' when we go to the apartment.

El apartamento esta perfectamente situado: en el Barrio Alto (muy cerca de bares y restaurantes) pero en una zona tranquila y sin ruido.
Lo encontramos todo muy limpio y muy bien equipado (estufas, menaje de cocina,...).
El anfitrion fue muy amable y muy atento. Sin duda, si volviesemos a Lisboa, repetiriamos!!
Apartment was perfect for our needs and in an ideal location. The hosts were very friendly and helpful. We would stay here again without a doubt.

Our host was charming and helpful, making sure we had everything we could possibly need.

The flat was very quiet, in a residential street in lively Bairro Alto district. Easy to find from the main road and was to walk to anywhere in central Lisbon.

Beautiful flat, very smart and spacious.

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour dans le logement de Maria et Luis.
Appartement très agréable et authentique proche de tout : métro, centre, commerces, restaurants...
A recommander
Excellent place and host! Walking distance to anywhere you might want to go in the city. The water in the shower was hot and heated up very quickly. Cozy, comfy loft bed. Would stay again. :-)

Die Unterkunft von Maria und Luis war super von der Lage, wir haben uns sehr über den netten Empfang gefreut bei Ankunft. Es war alles vorhanden was man gebraucht hat und bei Fragen konnte man sich immer melden. Für 2 Personen perfekt, wir würden jederzeit wieder buchen ❤️

Maria was extremely gracious and accommodating. A problem did arise (a battery had died), and she was on site immediately to address it.
The location is stellar, and the space was comfortable
Getting to and from the bed in the loft was awkward. It mightn't be for a younger guest, but I'm near eighty.

Gut gelegen und voll ausgestattet - nichts hat mir gefehlt. Das WLAN war aber nicht besonders zuverlässig. Gasherd war schon. Da die Decke hoch ist, kann die Wohnung etwas kalt sein. Ausstattung hat sich etwas, aber nicht wesentlich, geändert seit die Fotos aufgenommen würden. Beim Einchecken waren die sehr flexibel, zum Glück als meiner Flug Verspätung hatte.
The perfect location for atmosphere and access to amenities, local independent restaurants and transport links. Characterful property in a historic location. It was perfect for our needs.

We had a lovely time at Maria’s flat! It is a cute and cozy apartment in the beautiful Baixa area, very close to Praça Luis Camoes. It has a very well equipped kitchen and a comfy bed. We enjoyed it very much!

Despite the apartment's location in the city center (the funicular line is just a minute's walk away), it's quite quiet at night. It was easy to find it, thanks to the very detailed instructions.
You cannot expect a brand new renovation there, but you'll definitely feel the vibe of the city.
Maria was super helpful and understanding during our stay. The location is excellent as well as the place is nice and cozy, feeling like at home. I highly recommend.
Um apartamento maravilhoso, a gente gostou muito!
Un très agréable moment passé dans le logement et dans les échanges avec Maria et Luis. De bons conseils et aux petits soins.
Idéalement bien placé pour visiter la ville
Had a lovely few days staying here, it really felt like home. Maria was so helpful and friendly and the location was perfect. Hopefully we can return soon!
We loved our stay at Maria’s beautiful apartment! Great area with lots to do and eat nearby :) can’t wait to come back to Lisbon!
Excellent location and quintessential Lisbon streetscape
The host was amazing and very helpful throughout my stay. The apartment was clean and comfortable. I really enjoyed my time here and would definitely stay again!
it was amazing, really clean, friendly hosts
Maria’s place was wonderful. We only stayed one night because we left for home the next day but we would have liked to stay longer. Their place is beautiful!

Sehr gemütliche Unterkunft, die ihren Preis auf jeden Fall wert ist. Einzig kleines Manko, das Schlafzimmer ist sehr hellhörig und man hört den Lärm der darüber liegenden Unterkunft.
Maria und ihr Ehemann waren sehr nett und hilfreich. Die Kommunikation war ausgezeichnet.
Merci pour ce séjour dans un superbe appartement idéalement situé.  Tout était parfait!
classic apt right in the heart of Lisbon

Maria is een hele lieve behulpzame dame. Ze reageert snel en correct op onze vragen. De B&B  is een typisch Portugees huisje. Zeer charmant en een retro stijl. Alles wat je nodig hebt is voorradig. Leuke aangename buurt met gezellige restaurantjes en winkeltjes op wandelafstand. We hebben van ons verblijf genoten!

This spot is perfect if you want to explore Lisbon! It is in a great location, walkable to lively bars and beautiful views. Maria & her family were so helpful with check in and helped us navigate to the house from the train station seamlessly. Definitely book your stay here!!!

My husband and I had an absolutely amazing stay at Maria and Luis' apartment for our honeymoon. The location is perfect for exploring the city and is very quiet day and night which is lovely. Maria was so nice and welcoming! If we come back to Lisbon we will definitely be staying here again.
Great location and great hosts!
jolie appartement, proche de toutes, et le métro a 5 minutes à pied.
We had a lovely stay and could do a late checkout. Thank you

Joli appartement dont la localisation est parfaite pour visiter Lisbonne. Il est spacieux, équipé et très agréable d'y séjourner ! L'hôte à été très sympathique et réactive, nous avons passé d'excellentes vacances !

Einzig störend war der überalterte Ventilator. Die 3 Stufe funktionierte nicht mehr und auch das Zirkulieren um die Achse war defekt. Der Ventilator hat darüber hinaus Höllen Lärm gemacht.
Ansonsten war die Wohnung sehr gut und die Lage ist perfekt!
Soggiorno di una sola notte. Appartamento molto grazioso, un po’ calda la camera da letto mancando la possibilità di areazione (la finestra non si può aprire).

This is avery charming and cozy flat, with rich history in the center of one of Lisbon's most beautiful and trendy neighborhoods! Maria and Luis were very nice, communicative, and flexible - highly recommend!

Great location to stay in. Safe neighborhood within walking distance of lots of restaurants/bars. Maria was extremely nice and responsive as well. Having laundry in the apartment was also fantastic. No AC in the summer was a little rough especially to sleep in as Lisbon can get very warm. In the bathroom shower there were some black spots on the tub floor that were questionable but Maria provided a shower mat so I just covered it with that. There was also a strong odor in the bathroom that I did not know where it came from. Overall, it was a good stay, nice host, great location.
Maria was just lovely and we could not have asked for a better stay :)

Nous avons passé un séjour inoubliable dans cet appartement plein de charme, niché au cœur du Bairro Alto ! L’emplacement est tout simplement parfait : central, animé, mais calme une fois à l’intérieur (une excellente boulangerie à proximité).  L’appartement est décoré avec beaucoup de goût, confortable, lumineux et vraiment typique de Lisbonne. Nous étions trois amies et nous nous y sommes senties comme chez nous dès notre arrivée. Tout était propre, bien équipé, et la communication avec l’hôte a été fluide et chaleureuse du début à la fin. Un vrai coup de cœur — je recommande à 100 % et j’espère avoir l’occasion d’y revenir !
Cozy place in a very nice neighbourhood: quiet but close to bars, restaurants and metro. Maria and Luis were perfect hosts. We can warmly recomend their place.

La casa é molto carina, in una bella zona, facile da raggiungere e vicina ai luoghi di interesse e sopratutto Maria e Luis sono due host adorabili: cortesi, disponibili e attenti. Il vero valore aggiunto della casa!

Super séjour dans un appartement au calme et très facile d'accès. Accueil très sympathique et instructions très claires de la part de Luis. L'appartement est confortable, propre et calme, nous y reviendrons avec plaisir !
Very cozy apartment in a good location of Lisbon. Apartment looked better than the photos!
Great location to move around Lisbon!!
We loved this place! It was in a perfect location and María has the apartment beautifully decorated. This was one of our favorite stays during our Europe tour.
Amazing location with friendly and helpful hosts! They were very communicative and kind. Highly recommend.
Lovely host, cute place lots of character and excellent location

Nous avons passé 4 nuits dans ce logement, il est très bien situé, beaucoup de choses à visiter sont accessibles à pieds.
Le logement est assez grand et nous avons été très bien accueillis.
On recommande !
Petite information utile : Le week-end (nous y sommes allées fin mai), les rues à côté sont très animées le soir (pour les personnes avec un sommeil léger, peut-être prévoir des boules quies pour le vendredi et samedi soir)

conforme á la description.
Hôte disponible, réactif et discret.
Séjour agréable bien que rapide.
Adresse où je reviendrais avec plaisir si je dois séjourner à Lisbonne.
La casa e' molto graziosa e confortevole, posizionata in una zona interna molto tranquilla ma vicinissima a tutto. Se torniamo a LIsbona, questo è il posto!

Perfect spot in Lisbon. Walkable to everything  you want to see. Beautiful rustic charm, we absolutely loved the space. The bedroom is in a loft space requiring you to climb a ladder. This may be challenging for folks with mobility issues, but it was actually the highlight for us! Totally added to the charm and made our stay memorable. The only issue we had was with the check in - apartment was difficult to find but the hosts helped guide us and Luis personally met us when we went to the wrong location down the street. Hosts should provide photos along with the written instructions since Google maps sends you to the wrong address. Loved everything else about it and would stay here again in a heartbeat!!
Great location,  clean, spacious, very friendly  and communicative host
Maria est accueillante et parle très bien Français.  Emplacement idéal et rue calme.

logement de style ancien (même un lustre dans la salle de bain !), idéalement situé (très central) et très calme (même quand il y a une fête dans la rue adjacente!).
Maria et Luis sont très réactifs, accueillants et accomodants.
Great apartment. Loved the style and  had everything we needed. Would stay again.
Book it!
Cute layout. Host was very kind and accommodating. Smooth check-in.

Het appartement is prima voor een aantal nachten. Het is ruim en alles wat je nodig hebt is aanwezig. De locatie is ook echt super! Echter het appartement en interieur zijn erg verouderd. Onderhoud is wel noodzakelijk. De slaapkamer is een kleine ruimte en je slaapt op een vide. Wij vonden dit erg benauwd en het kraakt allemaal enorm.

Luiz nos recebeu muito bem e deu todas as instruções necessárias. A casa típica portuguesa faz a estadia ser mais imersiva. A casa tem tudo o que é preciso para estadias curtas ou longas. O espaço é amplo e fica no coração do centro histórico. Há metrô próximo e você fica a 10 minutos a pé de todas as principais atrações e a 20 minutos do castelo de São Jorge e Alfama. Definitivamente é um ótimo local para se hospedar em Lisboa.
Really nice and beautiful place in good situation

We loved everything about our stay at Maria’s . Super cozy apartment in a perfect location.
The beds were very comfortable and the apartment very clean.
Highly recommend!!

Very warm and personalized, artistic space. Large living room with a couch and a table to sit at, kitchen, bathroom, and separate bedroom.
My only issue with the space was the bedroom located in the back of the unit -- it is pretty small and the bed is located up some stairs to a cozy loft space. I need to get up during the night to pee a few times, and the ladder/stairs upstairs were very narrow and I was concerned about taking a tumble during the night, so I took the bedding and slept on the downstairs couch in the living room (which was fine).
Wonderful people, though, and I would definitely stay there again if I am lucky enough to return to Lisbon.
Sweet rustic place, lots of charm. Felt inviting and cozy.
The location is good, close to the subway and restaurants. The house was clean and comfortable,  provided the help we needed
Great stay at this wonderful, rustic property. Perfectly located to popular bits of town but also tucked away privately for quiet nights and sleep. Would 100% recommend!

The kitchen is well equipped for meal prep.  The living/dining space has a good cable equipped television.  There's plenty of fresh air as there are windows in both the front and midway back down a hallway.  The bed, a loft, requires 7-8 steps up. Maria's place is very spacious and conveniently located near Lisbon's sights and the metro. We only stayed for one night and wish we could have lived there longer. She provided some great kitchen amenities and was very responsive to our questions.
O apartamento da Maria é ótimo!Limpo, muito bem localizado, perto do metrô. O bairro é maravilhoso e cheio de coisas para se fazer! Recomendo!

Our stay by Maria was really nice. The location is a quiet spot and everything in Lisboa is easy to reach with the metro station nearby. You have also everything you need in the close area - supermarket, bars, restaurants. Maria is such a great host. One of us was sick at the day as we had to check out and Maria gave us a great support to make the next step of our trip in Portugal more confortable. We definitely recommend a stay in Maria’s place!
Emplacement idéal, en plein centre historique de Lisbonne. Personne très serviable et à l'écoute. Je conseille pour visiter Lisbonne.

We got into Lisbon early so Maria was kind enough to hold our luggage not far from the unit but even got them delivered to the apt. Large unit with a nice loft-style bed. Solid wifi and in a great location that’s relatively quiet but also near all the action. All in all a fanatic place we’d definitely stay at again.
Maria was an excellent host!! Couldn’t ask for anything to be better! Highly recommended to any couple!!!

Perfekte Unterkunft in sehr guter Lage!Ruhig und gemütlich.
Danke, immer wieder gerne.

Maria's appartment is really nice and well decorated. It is very confy and remains fresh even when it is hot outside. It is well located to visit the town.
The bed is also very confortable even if it is in a small mezzanine which gets hot during the night.
Lovely place in the heart of Chiado Baixa district. Lots of shopping and good restaurants near by. Good communication by Maria. Clean place.
친절한 호스트분과 적당한 위치. 그리고 침대가 있는 아늑한 방과 식기구가 갖춰져있는 주방이 있는 이 집은 큰 장점입니다. 엄청 예쁜 인테리어와 최신식 시설은 아니지만 오히려 그래서 더욱 이곳에 사는 것만 같은 느낌을 주는 정감 가는 집이었습니다. 잠시나마 현지인이 된 것 같아 좋았습니다. 추천합니다!
Charm, comfort & fab location. Great communication with host. No noise from outside but neighbour noise could be an issue for light sleepers.

위치: 지하철역에서 5-8분정도 걸리고 근처 골목마다 자그마한 펍이나 레스토랑이 있어서 좋았습니다. 다만 언덕위쪽에 있기때문에 역에서 캐리어를 끌고 가면 좀 힘듭니다. 우버나 택시를 이용하시는 걸 추천합니다(santa apolonia역에서 우버로 5-6유로 정도 나왔네요)
시설: 사진에 있는 것과 동일합니다. 현관은 열쇠로 잠급니다
호스트: 에어비앤비 메세지로는 인터벌이 길때가 있습니다. 그럴땐 전화하시면 바로 조치해줍니다. 인근에 거주하는 것 같고 부재중일땐 가족이 나와줘서 불편함이 없었습니다. 항상 친절히 대해줘서 좋았습니다.
리스본에서 비앤비를 찾으신다면 추천합니다
Maria's flat is perfectly located, quiet yet central. It is very cozy and charming. We even went there for the second time and would do so again.

wonderful space in a old building with lots of character. Perfect location close to the bustling nightlife of bario alto. both Maria and Luis were welcoming and always quick to respond to questions. recommended
Maria’s place is a great place to stay. I definitely recommend. It’s located right near bars and metro.

Bel emplacement
Logement pittoresque
Près de tout
Propre et agréable

Maria and Luis were very welcoming and accommodating. Their flexible check in/check out was very useful to us and we loved being so close to so many great bars and restaurants. Would definitely recommend for a stay in lovely Lisboa!

Maria gave us some really clear and helpful directions to her house which is in the heart of Lisbon close to shops, bars, trams and the metro. The apartment is small and comfortable. We really slept well in the cosy bedroom and it was quiet at night.
The kitchen had everything we needed and we cooked a nice meal without any problem.
Maria was always available to help us and always replied quickly to our messages. One day we might return to Lisbon and we would be happy to stay at Maria's house.

Bien situé
Proche de tout
Propre
Hôte accueillante et gentille
Tout ce qu’on avait de besoin était à proximité

Maria est très sympathique et attentionnée. Appartement au rez-de-chaussée bien au frais,
illuminé, au calme et très propre.
Recommandé positivement.
Bien situé à 2 pas de tout.
Je recommande positivement.

Les plus : emplacement, espace (appartement grand)
Les moins : lit dans un petit espace confiné, isolation à revoir (réveillé par le dessus et la semaine par les travaux dans la rue), salle de bain en mauvais état

Maria's place is in the perfect central Lisbon location overlooking scene steps and just minutes away from a river look out spot. It was so easy to find good food around and Maria was so quick to respond to us once we arrived in Lisbon.

I arrived late, because my train was delayed and I had to leave very early on the morning, but Maria's husband was at the apartment waiting for me. He was very kind to me.
The apartment is very nice, bigger than I expected and it's in an amazing position.
If you're looking for something in Bairro Alto, I would recommend it.

Mieszkanie o ciekawym rozkładzie, bardzo wygodne i świetnie urządzone. Gospodarze kontaktowi i bardzo pomocni. A poza tym głównym atutem mieszkania jest świetne położenie w centrum w dzielnicy Bica, blisko windy. Byliśmy też w Alamedzie, która jest żelaznym punktem do zwiedzania, ale byliśmy z lekka rozczarowani. W Lizbonie byliśmy tylko trzy dni i poza obiektami, które chcieliśmy zobaczyć zwiedziliśmy tylko niewielki fragment miasta, ale z tego co zobaczyliśmy dzielnica Bica wydaje się najbardziej autentyczna jako "Stara Lizbona". Generalnie ocena apartamentu na 5+ i polecamy wszystkim.
Ania i Jacek
nice location in the center of lisbon. high ceilings, original lovely style.
Great large space in the Heart of the City. We would consider staying here again on another visit.

Appartement très bien situé, à proximité du métro et le funiculaire Da Bica en bas des escaliers. Maria a été très arrangeante pour les heures d'arrivée et de sortie, et parle très bien français.  Des travaux se font dans l'immeuble à côté mais ils ne commencent qu'à 8h, donc pas de souci à se faire.

Die Wohnung von Maria ist sehr gut gelegen und die Bilder zeigen das, was man in der Wohnung findet.
Leider hatten wir 2 Übernachtungen im Monat Juni - dem Monat der Volksheiligen. In dieser Zeit
finden Festivitäten in vielen Ecken der Stadt statt. So auch genau vor der Wohnung von Maria, die Parterre gelegen ist und man den Eindruck hat ,die Fete ist im Wohnzimmer. Sehr laute Musik, lärmende , gröllende mit zunehmender Zeit immer stärker alkoholisierte Menschenmassen…Da es in der Wohnung überwiegend Tücher anstatt Türen in den Türbögen gibt, hat man auch keine Möglichkeit eine Tür zu schließen,um die Lautstärke zu dämpfen.
Kurzum, wir konnten in den 2 Nächten so gut wie gar nicht schlafen - der Lärm war unerträglich.
2 Möglichkeiten: In einem anderen Monat kommen oder 2 Tage und Nächte feiern.

Le logement est très central, très propre, bon rapport qualité-prix et Maria une charmante hôte qui nous a très agréablement accueillis. Maria parle Anglais et Français et nous a permis de gérer arrivée et départ avec souplesse. Deux remarques à noter : l'appartement est un peu vétuste et au mois de juin les fêtes de rue de Lisbonne rendent l'appartement très bruyant, tous les jours pendant toute la nuit.

Excelente localização e espaço muito bacana. Em época de festa, como foi nosso caso, música alta em frente à residência...foi um pouco barulhento mas como estávamos muito cansadas não foi um problema para dormir. Nos atrasamos para o check in e Maria nos aguardou, excelente host

Maria and Luis are fantastic hosts and the apartment itself is in an unbeatable spot. It's walking distance to everything you need in Lisbon. The apartment is cosy and clean with fast Wi-Fi. We had a great stay.
Maria’s apartment is ideal for exploring Lisbon. The space is charming, comfortable, and close to many sites.
Zeer gezellig appartement, authentieke elementen in het huis. Fijn bed, wasmachine aanwezig, van alle gemakken voorzien.

Perfect location with easy access to supermarket, metro and restaurant. Walkable to most of the main point of attractions and Bica funicular is just around the corner. Apartment is spacious and equipped with all basic amenities. Highly recommended!

A true gem of an apartment! Located in the city center on a quiet side street. This apartment in a 200 hundred-year-old building is amazing. Cozy, clean, well maintained and a good value. A little quirky and a lot of Lisbon charm. Maria is the cherry on the top. She is sweet and genuinely wants you to have a good experience.    Easy check in and out.
Maria is a great host and the AÜT is central and yet quiet. We felt at home! Thanks Maria!

The place is very clean and just as described. Maria was highly responsive both before and during the trip. Maria arranged for Luis to pick me up and take me back to the airport. I am so grateful because I had a heavy suitcase that would have been a nightmare trying to get up and down the stairs leading to the apartment. Luis was gracious enough to carry that bag for me. Thank you!!! I would highly recommend this place and will definitely stay here when in Lisbon again- minus the heavy suitcase!

Our favorite stay in Lisbon. A street level apartment with beautiful high ceilings. It’s historic but renovated with all the modern amenities. We had hot showers, a comfortable bed, cable tv(!), and a washer/clothes line. This flat is in such a convenient location, and Maria was so kind and professional.

Maria’s place was a nice brief stay for my parents during their last few days in Lisbon. The apartment is located in a residential area that is quite lively at night, with a lot of young people visiting bars and restaurants. The apartment was clean and charming, however there were some issues with cold water in the shower and a pretty serious leak in the bathroom ceiling from the apartment above. Maria was very attentive to this and extremely apologetic, and was adamant about addressing the leak following my parents’ stay. My parents highly recommend Santa Bica, a wonderful restaurant right around the corner!
Je recommande vivement !!! Logement super bien situé !!!

My girlfriend and I spent only a night in Maria and Louis apartment, but it was enough to appreciate the kindness of the hosts.
The house is located in the centre of Lisboa, very near to Cais do Sodré and Baixa Chiado. Perfect to enjoy the nightlife.
It was clean and a lot of personal touches make it cozy as it is anticipated in the name.
Strongly suggest it for a stay in Lisboa!

Pro dell’appartamento: Maria è una proprietaria gentilissima e davvero molto disponibile. La posizione dell’appartamento poi è incredibilmente centrale, dentro il
Barrio alto e a due passi dal mirodauro Di Santa Caterina.
Contro dell’appartamento: il letto è sopra un soppalco, non proprio comodissimo da raggiungere (anche se il letto in sè è comodo).
La casa è vecchia quindi qualche aggiustamento dovrebbe essere fatto, in particolare gli infissi non sono nuovi quindi la casa è umida. Poi noi siamo stati sfortunati perché ha piovuto due notti e si sentiva nettamente la pioggia che sbatteva nel cortile interno (non campiamo perché ma rimbombava veramente tanto).
In generale l’appartamento è comodo per visitare Lisbona, con qualche lavoretto agli infissi sarebbe risolto anche il problema dell’umidità.
Grazie a Maria che è stata davvero disponibile e carina con noi.

Super espaçoso e tranquilo, muito bem localizado, muito limpo. O restaurante O Adamastor bem pertinho foi um achado! Maria foi mega flexível no check out e não temos como agradecer tanta hospitalidade. Voltaremos com certeza!! Adoramos Lisboa!
Great location and great stay. Maria is fabulous. Would love to stay here again.
리스본에서 최고의 숙소 였다
Perfect location and wonderful host. We highly recommend!

Appartement au cœur du centre de Lisbonne. Accueil très agréable par le mari de Maria qui a été très arrangeant pour l'heure d'arrivée en fonction de notre avion. Appartement spacieux, et au calme. Nous avons passé un très bon séjour!

Tres contents de l'appart et des prestations ,nous avons été  tres bien accueillis malgré notre arrivée tardive. Appart bien localisé a cote du funiculaire bica dans un quartier dynamique mais avec la chambre au calme. On recommande.

Maria was an outstanding host! She responded so quickly and when we needed her she was ALWAYS there to help!! The place was so cute and in the most perfect location! There are stairs to get down to the apartment, just to be aware. Overall, I would stay here again!
Appartement clair et lumineux avec belle hauteur sous plafond et décoration sobre et efficace. Idéalement situé et calme. J'ai passé un très agréable séjour dans l'appartement de Maria. Encore merci.

It was a wonderful stay! For us, the highlight was the location! In the middle of a authentic, charming neighbourhood and very close to the attractions. The metro baixo chiado is  just 5-8 minutes by walk. House itself is clean and beautiful, with some nostalgic charm to it :) Maria is a very kind and generous host! Highly recommended!

Hier zu buchen ist ein Glücksfall
Beste Ausstattung in bester Lage.
perfekt für mindestens zwei Nächte.
Sehr schön

Nous recommandons l'adresse de chez maria ,le lieu est super sympa ,cosy ,il y a tout ce qu'il faut , on s'y sent bien .En plus c'est près du centre à pied, il y a un petit super marché pour faire ses courses ... C' est le reve pour ce genre de séjour ! nous y reviendrons assurement et nous le conseillons !
Great place, great location, right in the heart if Lisbon and in the centre if attraction. Quick responses from the host and very flexible in terms of check-in and out. Can recommend to anyone.

Maria's place is super convenient to everything and anything you would want to see or do in Lisbon. Maria's place is convenient, comfortable and clean. There wasn't anything else we needed for our visit to Lisbon. Thank you!

Highly recommended, would definitely stay here again if I revisit Lisbon. Fulfilled three things that are a must for me - comfortable bed; quiet especially at night; good shower pressure & plenty of hot water. Also excellent location (transport, seaside, bars/restaurants, shops), good value for money and clean. Maria was very helpful, a great host. Thanks!

L'appartamento gode di un ottima posizione per visitare la cittá. Purtroppo la casa è poco curata e richiede una manutenzione (porta del bagno che sbatte a terra e produce molto rumore, vasca del bagno che andrebbe sostituita, buchi nelle pareti...). Inoltre è presente un forte odore di muffa a causa di una grossa umiditá nelle pareti del bagno per delle infiltrazioni dal vicino di sopra. Maria si è comunque scusata per questo problema anche se avrei preferito saperlo prima dell'arrivo per poter decidere se cancellare la prenotazione. La pulizia non è sufficiente.

María es una gran anfitriona. Nos recibió a la hora que le pedimos teniendo en cuenta las peculiaridades de los vuelos y esas cosas. Además, nos guió estupendamente hasta llegar al apartamento. El piso está ubicado en una zona estupenda llena de bares y restaurantes, con mucho ambiente, pero también lo suficientemente alejada como para poder dormir sin ruidos. Además, el piso en sí es precioso, una casa antigua de Lisboa llena de encanto
Volveremos sin duda al piso de María si volvemos a tener la suerte de regresar a esa preciosa ciudad.
Eine wirklich wunderbar gelegene, freundliche und schöne Unterkunft im Herzen Lissabons. Das empfohlene Restaurant um die Ecke war auch wunderbar und veggie-freundlich! Sehr zu empfehlen!

The location of the apartment is superb - could not be better.  Lovely street in a great neighbourhood.  Everything you need is in the apartment and outside -  shops, restaurants, tourist spots nearby.  Quiet for sleeping while the lively Barrio Alto and the waterfront are within walking distance (or by the Santa Justa lift).     Maria is v friendly, communication between us was excellent and she is nearby to help if needed.  A relaxing stay with a laid back approach from Maria.  Recommended!
We had a great time in the apartment, it was very comfortable and has a great location!!

The apartment is in a good location 10-15 minutes away from the centre. Rooms are large, kitchen is well stocked. The apartment is old and there are cracks and stains on some of the walls/ceilings. Please be aware there is major construction taking place next door. Banging, drilling, music being played by the builders is taking place 8am until 6pm. It’s fine if you’re out all day but we weren’t made aware which was disappointing. Host was friendly and answered questions quickly and gave some restaurant tips.

Wirkliche hervorragende Lage mitten im Ausgehviertel, ist aber trotzdem ruhig gelegen. Alles absolut sauber - einzig das Bad bzw. die Warmwasserversorgung sind renovierungsbedürftig. Hatten eine schöne Zeit!

Maria's apartment is the perfect place to rest. Very well located, there are lively streets next to it where you can find a lot of bars and restaurants. Ideal to discover and enjoy the wonders of Lisbon! The apartment matches the descriptions and photos on airbnb. Thanks again Maria!
Perfect location to explore Lisbon by foot, loved it! Maria was very responsive to our questions and helped us in every way she could.
fantastische ligging! stijlvol en origineel ingericht appartement, met aparte ingang. veel privacy. maria en luiz zijn heel vriendelijk.
Good stay, within walking distance to other attractions.

Prachtige ligging, uitstekende ontvangst, wel beetje fris maar twee kleine radiatoren op elektriciteit voorzien. Tip voor Lissabon, vraag bij het nemen van een taxi altijd eerst de prijs, zoniet wordt er teveel gerekend.
very friendly accommondation, good Location, a little bit cold in the winter...all in all advisable.
Maria's apartment is in a really nice part of lisbon, close to the metro, the riverfront and loads of bars, but in the apartment I'd really peaceful and quiet! Perfect for a weekend getaway.

Logement très bien situé en plein cœur de la ville, pas loin de la gare de cais de sodre et de rossio ainsi que de la station de métro de Baixo-caido
Le logement etait assez grand, correspondait aux photos et étaient équipés de petits appareils électroniques ( microondes,tv,bouilloire etc...). Maria avait mis à notre disposition des plaids et des essuies. Maria nous a bien accueillie à notre arrivée et étaie très dispo par rapport aux messages. Nous sommes satisfaites du longement et le rapport qualité prix etait Bien
Attention si vous allez en hivers le logement est assez frais, pour ceux qui sont sensibles au bruit on entend fort ce qui se passe chez les voisins ou dans la rue
Petit bémol au niveau de l'eau de la douche qui n'était plus chaude le dernier jour Mais nous sommes contentés de notre expérience
The flat was very well located, cozy and clean and the hosts were very kind and helpful. A great stay!
Maria's flat is a beautiful, perfectly located, clean and well furnished wide flat. Maria is a super host, she's really helpful and answered quickly to my messages. Thank you so much !

Muito bem localizado, Maria respondeu a todos os contatos prontamente e nos deu várias dicas de acesso ao local bem como de restaurantes. O espaço é antigo, porém muito bem ajeitado e limpo, a cozinha é bem equipada, há temperos, chás, café e chocolate disponíveis. O aquecimento em janeiro foi imprescindível. Adoramos nossa estada, recomendo!

La casa è molto affascinante e silenziosa e non manca niente, e con le due piccole stufe anche molto calda e sicuramente merita di ritornarci in primavera-estate per goderne la frescura. La zona è bellissima e strategica, con locali e ristoranti di tutti i livelli e per tutti i gusti e a un tiro di schioppo da metropolitana Chiado e mitico electrico 28, col miradouro di Santa Caterina a due passi e giusto vicino al capolinea alto dell'elevador da Bica.
Vale muito a pena!

The location was perfect - quiet street but right in the heart of the Bairro Alto and close to the Time Out market, waterside etc. Lots of good eating places nearby. Maria was very helpful, meeting us quite late in the evening, booking a taxi to the airport etc.
The flat is full of interesting artworks and decorations, and everything we needed was there.
Very Nice place to Stay. Nicely located, Nice tips.

O apartamento está muito bem localizado, perto de metrô, restaurantes, supermercado, lojas, etc. Estava muito limpo e muito bem cuidado, nos atendeu plenamente.
Maria é uma excelente anfitriã, foi sempre muito prestativa e atenciosa, inclusive com nosso Pet. Recomendamos fortemente e esperamos voltar!
Perfect house in a perfect location!

Tolles kleines Apartment, sehr sauber und super Lage. Nur wenige Schritte bis nach Bairro Alto. Was man sonst noch braucht (Lebensmittel, U-Bahn, Kaffee etc.) findet man ebenfalls in nächster Nähe.
Gastgeberin, Maria, sehr nett und unkompliziert. Wir kommen wieder.
Brilliant location, close to local shops and lots of great little restaurants and bars. Maria was a great host and gave recommendations for our New Year’s Eve meal out.

Maria is a fantastic host who accommodated us after our arrival to Lisbon was delayed, and made sure that we were comfortable in her apartment after a long day of travel. She responded to all of our messages rapidly, and since she lives very close to the apartment, Maria was able to meet us for check in on very short notice. A great place to stay!

A good location is what matters and this place delivers. At the heart of Lisbon, on top of a hill with easy access to transports, restaurants and sights. Make sure to check out the Santa Bica restaurant right around the corner.
War alles ok.
Great location. Close to the Metro and restaurants and shopping. Prompt responses from Maria. She allowed me to drop off my bags early since my flight arrived early in the morning.

Maria's flat was in a great location with lots of amenities.  It even has a washer. Communication was great. She gave me an overview of the neighborhood. The only downside was that there is no central heating. Space heaters were available though. Not too much of an issue since I was mainly in the flat to shower and sleep. The loft style bedroom was not cold however. Not much noise from outside especially in the interior bedroom. Lots of public transportation close by. Shops, bars, and restaurants are convenient as well. A wonderful home away from home for my five night pre-Christmas stay in Lisbon.
Central and highly recommended!
Maria was great! : ) so sweet and met us at the apartment to talk to us and make us feel right at home

We had an excellent stay at this Airbnb. Unfortunately we only stayed for 1 night, but would have loved to have stayed for longer. It’s about a half hour taxi ride from the airport, and in a great neighborhood with lots of restaurants and bars in the nearby square. The apartment itself was very large for two people, and super clean. We would love to come back here again.
Beautiful, charming apartment in the perfect location. One of the best Airbnb's I've stayed at. Maria was a fantastic host - would highly recommend!

Maria and her husband were amazing hosts and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay in Lisbon at their beautiful apartment. She was incredibly responsive and easy to communicate with. Very flexible with check in and check out and making it  easy for us! The apartment is located in a perfect area with easy access to nearly everywhere in the city just minutes away.
마리아가 답장이 좀 느리고 문자는 아예 안받기도 하지만 그럴땐 전화하시면 돼요. 한 블록 건너 살아서 필요하면 언제든 올수있는 거리구요. 윗집 소음이 그대로 들리는 특징이 있지만 그것때문에 불편한적은 없었습니다. 현지인의 느낌 숙소를 찾고싶다면 좋은 선택이에요. 사진과 같습니다

L’alloggio di Maria si trova vicino all’elevador de Bica, nella parte più caratteristica del Barrio Alto. Ad attenderci al nostro arrivo, nonostante il ritardo, abbiamo trovato Maria che ci ha cordialmente accolto. L’alloggio corrispondeva alle nostre aspettative ed e’ risultato silenzioso. Su suggerimento di Maria, abbiamo cenato al vicino  ristorante  Santa Bica, dove ci siamo trovati veramente bene. Ci siamo fermati solo una notte e se ne avremo la possibilità ci torneremo volentieri
Perfect location to explore Lisbon by foot. Perfectly connected with subway to the airport and by tram to all other places in Lisbon. Super nice and cozy apartment

Maria was super friendly and helpful. She gave us walking directions from the metro, and set up a cab for us the morning we left! We had to do nothing, but have fun. The apartment was located in a general area, within walking distance of all of Lisbon.  I highly recommend staying here!

I had a great stay in Maria's lovely apartment. It has a lot of space and beautiful high ceilings. I loved the bed-attic which felt so cozy!
The location is perfect, in the middle of the centre, but still a quiet street.
Maria is a wonderful host and made me feel very welcome :) I hope to come back soon!

Incredible apartment that has character and comfort. Very spacious and clean. Maria was extremely accommodating and allowed our luggage to be held before the offered, flexible check in. Couldn’t ask for a better location with it being right by the main center. Our expectations were exceeded and the pictures do not do the apartment justice. Absolutely recommend.

The flat is really cosy and super nice. It is also very spacious and well organized. We had a great stay, nothing was missing. La Bica neighborhood is greatly located to reach anything in few minutes. Despite being close to bars in Bica, the flat was very quiet.
It is 5 min away from the Baixa-Chiado metro station, and it is reachable in less than an hour by metro from the airport: Maria gave us such good directions, we didnt need google maps to get there!! I’d rent it again when i come back to Lisbon! (hope soon!)

Wir hatten eine schöne Zeit in Lissabon in Maria's Unterkunft. Ihre Beschreibung vom Flughafen zur Wohnung war super wie die ganze Kommunikation und die Schlüsselübergabe lief reibungslos.
Die Wohnung ist groß und sehr zentral. Sehr nah an einem der schönen Aussichtspunkte auf den Fluss. Es gibt zahlreiche Restaurants, Cafés und Bars um die Ecke, trotzdem ist es in der Straße, in der die Wohnung liegt, nicht so laut. Das Schlafzimmer liegt außerdem hinten in der Wohnung, so dass es dort leise ist.
Maria is an easygoing, respectful and tidy host. Recommended.
Great location. Clean, roomy, artsy place. Loved it.
L'alloggio è in una posizione molto centrale e interessante per visitare la città. Maria è gentilissima e professionale. Unico neo è la camera da letto, scomoda
Everything was fine, we really enjoyed our stay in Lisbon!

Die Wohnung war sehr schön mit einer super Küchenausstattung. Die Lage war sehr gut, im Szeneviertel mit vielen Bars und Restaurants und einem Supermarkt um die Ecke. Die nächste Metrostation war auch fußläufig schnell zu erreichen und der Kontakt war sehr nett. Störend war nur der nächtliche Lärm durch die Partygänger, aber das kann man auch nicht ändern, wenn man mitten im Kneipenviertel wohnt. Alles in allem hat es uns sehr gut gefallen.

L'appartement de Maria est situé dans une ruelle traverssante à proximité d'un tram/funiculaire typique de LISBONNE - attention aux mollets pour les adeptes des dėcouvertes à pieds ... cela grimpe sec des rives du Tage jusqu'au nid de Maria !
Simplesmente perfeito, o local é exatamente como nas fotos, a localização é excelente e Maria foi muito amável e nos ajudou em tudo que pedimos.

Le logement est situé dans une rue calme mais au centre d'un superbe quartier. Proche du Tage, et des moyens de communication (train, tram (dont le 28), bateau, métro). Idéal aussi bien pour vivre des moments touristiques que d'autres authentiques de la vie lisboète! Très bon rapport qualité/prix.
Pour le trajet de l'aéroport à l'appartement (et inversement), il est très faisable en métro mais je conseille le taxi. Pour le retour nous avons payé 11€50 en étant déposé au terminal 2 directement et c'est beaucoup plus rapide.

Lovely apartment (bigger than it looks in the photos) in a great location close to bars, restaurants, shops and transport. Maria was an excellent host, good communication and there to meet us on arrival.

마리아도 너무 착했고 숙소도 너무너무 좋았어요!!! 너무 싼 가격에 잘 머물다 간거같아 뿌듯하네요ㅋㅋㅋ
All is good!

À deux pas du Barrio Alto, un petit appartement parfait pour se reposer après avoir visiter toutes les merveilles de Lisbonne !
Nous recommandons fortement.

Maria's place was fantastically located, near bars and restaurants, and a short walk to the metro and other parts of the city. Fresh towels and linen were ready and a fan in the loft was kept it from getting stuffy.  It is a busy area, but the sleeping room was secluded and quiet.  Tip: The Santa Catarina lookout is a few blocks away and I highly suggest going there to have a beer and watch the sunset.
Great location, host is easy to communicate with.

The place was just perfect in every way! The hosts are super friendly, the communication is the best and we felt the most welcome! Its situated right in the Center of Lisbon and a great starting point for sightseeing, enjoying Restaurants or just experiencing the City itself.
We would definately come back, next time we come to Lisbon! Thank you for the great time :)

Le logement était identique au descriptif et très propre, bien équipé et très bien situé dans le quartier du Bairro Alto. Maria toujours très disponible et à notre écoute, nous ne pouvons que recommander ce logement.
Vincent et Claire

Tolle Wohnung in top Lage am südlichen Rand des Bairro Alto. Trotz der zentralen Lage ruhig in kleinen Nebenstraße gelegen. Metro/Bus/Tram problemlos und schnell zu Fuß erreichbar. Supermarkt, Fleischer und Grocery gleich um die Ecke.
Maria was easy to contact and was flexible on check in and check out. Her apartment is in a great part of Lisbon, but in a perfect quiet side street! Very clean! Would stay here again!
La casa de María es preciosa. Estuvimos super agusto. La zona es preciosa y céntrica. Y la casa es preciosa, muy cómoda y acogedora.

Super Unterkunft in perfekter Lage!
Marias Appartement liegt in einer ruhigen Seitenstraße nahe der Metro Chiado/Baixa, der Tram 28 und dem Bahnhof Cais de Sodre. Nach ein paar Minuten ist man mitten im Restaurant-Viertel Bairro Alto!
Das Appartement ist sauber, groß und sehr gut ausgestattet! Der Check-in war sehr flexibel und Maria gab uns viele Infos zu Lissabon!
Wir würden jederzeit wieder dort übernachten!

The apartment is very nice and clean. It's located directly next to Bairro Alto. Many nice restaurants and bars can be reached within a few minutes. A perfect starting point to discover Lisbon!
Thank you very much for letting us stay in apartment, Maria!

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour dans l'appartement de Maria. Il correspond aux descriptions et photos proposées sur airbnb.
Il est très bien passé, à environ 15 minutes à pied de la gare permettant de se rendre à Sintra, et 10 minutes du Tage.
On trouve des rues très animées à côté de celle dans laquelle se situe l'appartement, avec plein de bars ! Mais la rue de l'appartement est calme, et surtout très belle !
Merci beaucoup Maria pour tout !
Wunderschöne Wohnung,  gerne wieder 😎

La casa e' molto accogliente e ben arredata. Ha il fascino di una vecchia casa di lisbona. Molto ben arredata e con una cucina molto attrezzata. Si trova nel centro storico in posizione veramente privilegiata per visitare la citta'
Nice location

Emplacement ideal au bairro alto quartier typique de lisbonne ! Un appartement atypique et très agréable ! On se sent comme à la maison ! Une hote très sympatique et accueillante. Nous ne regrettons pas notre choix. Et nous reviendrons sans hésitations ! Nous avons passé un superbe sejour a lisbonne ! Merci pour tout maria

We had a great time staying at Maria's apartment. It really is central--we were able to walk everywhere and only used the bus when we went to Belem (which we would've needed to do no matter where we stayed). The apartment was supplied with everything we needed, including a fan to keep us cool at night. The apartment is in a quiet area, which was nice to come home to every night.
Maria was out of the country during our stay, but she was easily accessible the entire time. Her friend was the one who met us and let us in. He was mixed up about which day we were coming, so no one was there when we arrived. But the moment Maria found out she fixed it immediately, and we had access to the apartment within 40 minutes. No complaints!
superbe appartement au coeur du vieux lisbonne. Très bien situé et décoré avec goût

Superbe logement, décoré avec goût, lumineux et très bien équipé.
Maria parle Francais et nous donné toute les informations utiles avant (accès) et à notre arrivée.
Endroit idéal, au centre, dans un quartier vivant et pour autant on dort au calme sur la cour arrière dans la petite mezzanine douillète.
Commerce, transports et toutes les commodités à 2 pas.
Je recommande sans hésiter !

We loved staying in Maria's place. Although it's an old apartment, it's clean, big enough and fully equiped. It's in a nice and lively neighborhood, very central. Maria is a good host, right there when you need her. Thanks for having us in your beautiful city!

Eine sehr schöne Altbauwohnung im Herzen von Lissabon. Die Wohnung ist schön eingerichtet und bietet Wohlfühlatmosphäre. Maria ist sehr freundlich und bemüht um einen. Es gibt viele und gute Möglichkeiten Essen zu gehen und den Abend in umliegenden Bars zu verbringen.

It was such a great experience at Maria's apartment. It was clean, cozy and so well located. We had a great time in Lisboa, it was really easy to reach any point in the city from this apartment - per feat and per tram.
Maria was also very friendly and so easy with our changing of the check-in and -out times. Thanks a lot, Maria!
Centrally located and everything you might need for a stay in Lisbon. Accommodating to our request for an earlier check in. Would stay here again.

역시 슈퍼호스트답게 약속시간보다 늦은 저희를 계속 기다려주셨고, 집이 너무 아늑하고 음식해먹기도 좋았어요. 지하철 cais do soudre역에서 걸어오려면 높다란 언덕이라 조금 힘들었지만 집앞 현관 계단에서 바라보는 리스본은 너무나 아름다웠습니다. 가보시면 아시겠지만 리스본의 그 유명한 트램 있는 포토스팟자리더라구요. 마리아씨가 너무잘해주셔서 감사해요. 다시 꼭 방문하고 싶은 숙소입니다!

La anfitriona fue encantadora, nos permitió dejar las cosas horas antes de lo acordado, pudiendo disfrutar de Lisboa sin nuestro equipaje. La casa es tal cuál se presenta en la web, estando muy bien equipada, y la zona no podría ser más céntrica, cerca de absolutamente todo. Cerca de la fiesta, pero siendo una zona tranquila, cerca del puerto y cerca del centro. Sin lugar a dudas si vuelvo a Lisboa intentaría repetir el alojamiento.
This place is great for your stay in Lissboa! The appt is even better/mi

Recomendamos vivamente este apartamento! Muito confortável, bastante espaçoso (bem acima da média em Lisboa), limpo e com tudo o que se poderia pedir para uma estadia agradável! While my sister and I only stayed one night, Maria's place was comfy, clean, and spacious, and in a great location (very close to the Baixa-Chiado metro station, so it wasn't long of a walk at all to have access to other parts of the city). Maria herself was so kind and helpful, especially in how to reach her place from the metro and in being able to keep in contact. I would say if you have the chance, staying at her place is definitely worth it.
Ótima localização para quem quer curtir o bairro alto, chiado e redondezas! Apartamento muito aconchegante! Vera nos recebeu super bem! Recomendo totalmente!
appartement au calme, en plein coeur du centre. Emplacement très pratique et lieu top.
My husband and I had an amazing stay at Maria's.  Location and the apartment were perfect! Would love to stay here again.
It's a beautiful appartment in a quiet area but the city centre is just around the corner. Recommended! Thank you Maria, we had a wonderful time in Lisbon.
Séjour très agréable dans cet appartement très bien placé dans Lisbonne. Les hôtes sont très serviables et à l'écoute. Je ne peux que recommander !

Appartement idéalement situé à proximité immédiate de tous les quartiers historiques de Lisbonne et pourtant très au calme ! Maria est très accueillante et parle français. Appartement très bien équipé !

L'appartement est très joli et agréable. Il est très bien situé dans la ville proche des quartiers vivants et notamment du Bairo alto , il est aussi proche de la gare cais de sodre qui permet de longer la côte . It was just for a night, so I can't say a lot of things! But the house is cozy, position is great and everything was clean.

Great place to stay - lovely area, relaxing apartment, and lovely high ceilings! Maria was very accommodating too.
Joe

Marias apartment is located in the trendy Chiado. Its location in a quiet side street guarantees you a good nights rest after an a day in busy Lisboã.  If you like the real Portugal you will like maria's place. She is a very hospitable

I suggest to stay in this apartment to experience the best holiday in Lisbon.

Really fantastic spot.  Unit has basically everything you need.  Short walking distance from the subway station, restaurants, and hip bars, but located in a quiet travessa off the popular roads.   I would definitely stay here again on my next visit to Lisbon.
Apartamento com otimal localização. Maria nos recebeu muito bem .

L'appartamento di Maria è carino, pulitissimo e ubicato in una zona vivace ma non rumorosa della città. A piedi si raggiunge in poco tempo sia la fermata della metropolitana che quella dei tram. La proprietaria è puntualissima e disponibile. Molto raccomandato.

Maria was a great host, very responsive and helpful and her place is lovely and perfectly located. Bed is lofted in a small room, but very comfortable.

Maria was the perfect host, well stocked house, maps and available with questions and suggestions. Was available by email for questions and responded promptly!!  Very impressive!!!
Fantastic location. Walk everywhere. Great restaurants within easy evening walk

Nous avons été accueilli par Maria et Luis avec une bouteille de vin et des fraises dans le frigo, l'appartement est parfait, bien situé près des transports (métro, tram), des restaurants et commerçants tout en étant très calme.

Great staying ! Everything was fine, great location . Luis was very kind and helpful .

Gastgeberin: Sehr netter und zuverlässige Kontakt!
Vielen Dank!

A lovely flat at a beautifull place. We can fully recommend Maria and her appartment

Que ce soit avant le départ que sur place, Maria a toujours été disponible pour l'ensemble des renseignements dont nous avions besoin. Nous avons également apprécié sa discrétion. Lisbonne est une très jolie ville, colorée, pleine de charme.  Notre visite à Sintra (accessible par train) , et la découverte des châteaux est également à recommander.

Marias flat was a great housing and would definitely recommend it to anyone!
O apartamento da Maria possui localização excelente...superou todas as minhas expectativas! Recomendo muito!
Jederzeit wieder!!! Alles perfekt !!!!
This place is a great value. Plenty of space, comfortable, quiet but close to all the action(great location). Definitely recommend.

Maria's flat has become a home away from home when I am in Lisboa. The flat is perfect for a short or long stay. The location is stellar. Maria and Luis are stellar hosts. I plan to return, again and again... You should too.

Maria is one lovely person who will provide directions there, plenty of towels or linen if needed, even tea and coffee. She is attentive and caring, I highly recommend. Her place is clean and big and spacious!

Maria's flat was perfect for a weekend in Lisbon. Amazing location, right in the heart of Bairro Alto but on a quiet street. Das Appartement war genau wie beschrieben. Super Lage und Maria war total nett. Hat alles problemlos geklappt. Wir empfehlen das Appartement jederzeit weiter.

its a perfect place. do not believe picture^^. much more better than pictures. there are everythings for travelers. 추천이요

Really recomendable!

L'appartement est idéalement situé en plein cœur de Lisbonne dans un quartier pittoresque et authentique. À proximité de nombreux points d'intérêt et des transports en communs.

Nous recommandons absolument!

Booked this as a present for a friend. Maria was extremely helpful throughout the whole process and my friends said the apartment was fantastic and they would definitely recommend.
Thanks!

marias house is a perfect place to stay close to everything but still located in a quiet and beautiful street. Maria is also very helpful and kind. It was nice to meet maria and spend our days in Lisbon in her beautiful apartment!

Maria was really helpful with checking in and out, communication and giving directions. The location is awesome: very near to great bars and restaurants, and very close to tram and metro stops. Nice apartment, with cool decoration, on a quiet street.
Maria is the best host, and the apartment is great! Good location, near by the authentic Lisboa life!

L'appartement est vraiment bien situé,dans une rue calme à proximité des transports,restaurants,bars etc..
Maria est très accueillante et disponible pour des renseignements ou en cas de problèmes.

Maria is a very friendly and helpful person. The communication was good, an we had a nice welcome. The place is very close to centre, restaurants and bars. Sítio perfeito para uma estadia em Lisboa. Sendo próximo de tudo o que importa é numa rua tranquila e de fácil acesso. Voltaria e recomendaria :)

A nice apartment located close to a subway station and close to a lot of restaurants/bars. It is a nice andcquiet area though. Communication was clear and we got a good route description how to get to the place from the airport.

Appartamento molto carino ed accogliente. In pieno centro a due passi da una delle piazze principali della città.

Esperienza molto positiva.
Everything was fine!
Better than we thought - the pictures does not show the comfort we actually felt. All perfect and highly recommended

We spend a one night stopover between flights at Maria's place and we were very sad that we did not have more time to explore the city. Communication with Maria was very easy and responses quick. Thank you Maria for making this short stopover a memorable experience

300개가 넘는 다른 게스트들의 후기에 전적으로 동감하고 강력 추천합니다.
1. 좋은 위치 : 주요 관광지, 마트, 레스토랑 등이 바로 집주변에 있어요. 벨렝, 까스카이스, 알파마, 알마다지역 등을 다녀오는 교통 수단을 이용하기도 좋은 최적의 위치입니다.
2. 정말 정말 친절한 호스트 : 괜히 슈퍼호스트가 아닙니다! 신속, 정확, 친절!!!
3. 모든 것을 갖춘 집(진짜 살아보기가 가능한 에어비앤비의 취지에 부합되는 집) : 물론 호스트가 사는 집은 아니지만, 에어비앤비의 다른 렌트형식의 집에 비해 진짜 집처럼 모든 생활용품이 구비된 집이에요. 천장높은 포르투갈의 집을 살아보듯 체험할 수 있는 이 점이 저는 정말 만족스럽고 좋았습니다.
다른 집들의 밝고 화려한 사진에 비해 마리아의 집이 어두워 보인다고 망설이지 마세요. 실제로 집은 사진보다 실물이 더 좋으니까요 ^^

La corta estadía en casa de Maria estuvo muy buena El departamento tiene todo lo necesario como para sentirse en casa; es amplio, tiene buena iluminación, y esta ubicado en un lugar accesible a distintos medios de transporte. Super recomendable

Maria is an excellent host and the location of her apartment is walking distance from the best pastel de natas in town. I highly recommend staying with her.

The apartment is in an excellent location - on a quieter side street but very close to shops and restaurants.  We loved the apartment itself - very unique and well decorated and equipped.  Thank you for an excellent stay - we hope to return!

Delightful! Maria is a fantastic host and her apartment, located in the wonderful Bairro Alto district, is just as described, with a comfortable loft bed, great shower, and speedy wireless internet. If Maria's apartment is available during your travel dates, book immediately!

Super appartement dans une rue calme à 5 min du métro et en plein centre ville. Les équipements sont très bien et l'appartement était très propre. Hôte très accueillante, nous avons passé un super week-end !

Maria, was wonderful, who place beautiful and comfortable. We highly recommend!
Maria fue muy amable. La casa es muy céntrica. Se nota que es una casa típica pero sin embargo está bien cuidada y muy limpia, con todo lo necesario. Muy recomendado para parejas.
Un appartement très bien localisé et spacieux. Tout y est dans la cuisine. Vous ne manquerez de rien! Je le recommande!

We had a great time at Maria's apartment. The apartment is very cozy, it's equipped with basic necessities (towels, toiletries, extra blankets etc.) and the loft bed is very comfortable.

Maria is a lovely host and she was available for any questions or concerns which is always a plus. We highly recommend staying at her charming place.

Die Unterkunft ist sehr zentral gelegen. Als wir angekommen sind wurden wir sehr herzlich empfangen. Maria hat uns auch einige Tipps für Lokale und Sehenswertes in der Nähe gegeben. This place really feels like home and is in a great location right in the thick of Lisbon's historic center. It's also about a 10-minute downhill walk from the Cais do Sodre train and metro stations.
I also can't say enough about Maria as a host. In addition to providing a comfortable, authentic apartment, she and her husband gave me a ride to the airport so I could make my early morning flight on the first day of a taxi driver strike!
It's a great value and a great place from which to experience Lisbon.

Maria was a great host, we only stayed in lisbon for just over a day and she allowed us to stay just for one night.. She was as accomodating as we could've hoped for and was very helpful. A great place to stay for a typical lisbon townhouse experience with perfect location.

The apt is great: very well equipped, clean and centrally located. Maria is a awesome host as well. She gave us helpful tipps and was verry accommodating regarding our check in and out times. Thank you for everything!

Maria made us feel very welcome and explained everything we needed to know about the flat and the neighbourhood. A real home away from home with authentic Portuguese charm. I would definitely choose to stay here again.
Maria was very sweet and a great host. Good communication and directions. Lots of great bars and restaurants close by.

Maria è una persona cortese e disponibile, ci è venuta incontro rispetto agli orari di check in e check out e ci ha fornito indicazioni per un piacevole soggiorno a Lisbona. Super appartement très bien situé (quelques minutes à pieds de la station Baixa-Chiado qui est un des noeuds du réseau), propre, grand, Maria habite à côté et est donc disponible en cas de besoin. On recommande!

We had a lovely stay at Teresa's. The flat is lovely and the location is great. In the very heart of Lisbon. We didn't get the chance to meet Teresa, but the communication was great and her sister that there to welcome us with a great smile! Would definitely recommend the place!

Unser Aufenthalt in Marias Wohnung war toll. Der Kontakt mit ihr war ohne Probleme. Marias Schwester hat uns empfangen und die Wohnung gezeigt. Sie war sehr nett. Die Wohnung war sehr sauber, hatte alles was wir brauchten und hatte WLAN. Die Lage ist sehr zentral.

This is my favourite place to stay in Lisbon! It was my second time at Maria's flat and I'm planning to come back again. This is the place to stay when you come to Lisbon. It's close to the old centre but still quiet. Thanks again!

Marias place was very nice and cozy! The apartment was authentic, and the location was perfect. You are minutes away from all the action, but also in a location that is nice and quiet.
