Maria is a great host, she went above and beyond to make us feel comfortable in her beautiful flat. The flat has everything one needs, is decorated with taste and very clean. The location could not be any better. We had a fantastic stay in lisbon, thank you Maria!

Maria's flat is very charming, comfortable and ideally located for Barrio Alto. We only wish our stay could have been longer. To anyone  looking for a place in Lisbon, look no further. Thanks very much indeed Maria.

We had a wonderful stay at Maria's apartment. The location is perfect - quiet but right in the middle of it all. Great local shops and restaurants. The apartment has beautiful tall ceilings and is very typical of Lisbon architecture. Kitchen is well equipped and bathroom is lovely. Mezzanine bedroom was hot during the summer night but a fan was supplied which really helped.

Staying at Maria's place was a really great experience.

There are many nice and affordable restaurants near the apartment, but also supermarkets. The apartment's kitchen is fully stocked for self-cooking.
The apartment is also super central, 5 minutes away from the subway, tram, bus, and 10 minutes way from the train station Cais do Sodre from where you can go to Cascais and many nice beaches.
We would definitely stay here again.

Although my stay at Maria's flat in Bica/Bairro Alto was short (I was there for only one night and had to catch an early morning the flight the next day), it was incredible. The flat is well-appointed and central, central, central to everything Lisboa has to offer!

You're steps from the famous Elevador da Bica. A few more steps and you're at the TimeOut Market and the central train station. You're 15 minutes walking distance from the popular Chiado shopping district. You're surrounded by tons of great restaurants, cafes, wine bars and shops.

When I head back to Lisboa, I will definitely be calling on Maria again!
L'appartement est très bien situé, bien équipé et propre. Nous avons passé un séjour fantastique.

Maria and her husband were super nice and helpful.  We had a great time in Lisbon and that was contributed to by Maria's flat.  If you have the opportunity to book with her, do it!

facile d'accès en métro depuis l'aéroport, très bien situé pour découvrir Lisbonne, très calme, très propre. Maria nous a très bien reçu. L'appartement est propre et bien équipé. Bref c'est un endroit que nous recommandons !

We enjoyed a lovely stay at Maria's place, which is excellently situated in the heart of the old town. The location of the apartment is perfect for exploring Bairro Alto and the surrounding districts. It's tucked away on a quiet street, comfortable inside and with a lot of character. Maria is a welcoming and friendly host. The house is well-located and furnished. All the things are as described. We truly enjoyed our stay at Maria’s place. Highly recommended!

L'appartamento è pulito, carino, vicinissimo al centro della città ed è sufficientemente spazioso.  Arredato con cura e completo di tutto il necessario. E' un'ottima scelta per una giovane coppia che vuole visitare Lisbona. Molto utili le indicazioni turistiche gentilmente fornite da Maria.

Maria è stata gentilissima e preziosa per le informazioni, le indicazioni, l aiuto e tutto il resto. Ha accolto le mie figliole come se fosse stata una zia.
La casa in ottima posizione, pulita e accogliente.
Grazie Maria di vero cuore
Maria was an excellent host, gave us really helpful directions to the apartment and was very flexible with checking in and out times. The apartment was lovely, clean and comfortable. Thank you

Really pretty and comfortable independent house, we met Maria's husband for take the keys and he was funny and gentle. The neighborhood is quiet but, at the same time, close to the centre of Lisbon. Highly recommended.

Es war ganz wunderbar bei Maria. Die Wohnung ist ganz reizend, liebevoll eingerichtet und sehr sauber. Es gibt jegliches Geschirr, Toaster, Kaffemaschine etc. in der Wohnung. Maria war sehr symphatisch und freundlich und gab uns tolle Tips für Resaurants in der Nähe. Die Lage ist sehr zentral. Dirrekt am Barrio Alto sehr nah zur U-Bahn, Tram und auch zum Bahnhof. Uns hat es prima gefallen und wir würden jederzeit wieder bei Maria wohnen.

Séjour vraiment agréable, l'appartement de Maria est calme et chaleureux, très bien situé entre Chiado et Bairro Alto, près du Tram et du Métro. Il correspondait bien aux photos sur le site. Maria est une hôte attentive et disponible. Nous reviendrons...

Maria is a very nice host and her apartment is a perfect location to discover Lisbon. There were no discrepancies between the pictures and the actual apartment. However, be mindful that there is current construction near the house. Hence, if you are not an early bird, this could be a little bit of an issue. In addition, we also had some issue with the hot water not working properly. But Maria assured me that this was exceptional. Overall, very good experience.

Мария и Луис, спасибо Вам огромное за этот теплый прием!
Нас встретили ровно в назначенное время, все показали, рассказали.
Квартира прекрасная! Простенькая, но со вкусом и огромным количеством интересных вещиц. Находится в старом районе Лиссабона. Многие достопримечательности и красивости города в пешей доступности, а так же знаменитый трамвай 28.
Полное погружение в атмосферу города!
Great location and apartment has everything you need for a great stay in Lisbon. Maria was very helpful with any questions I had and with directions to and from the airport.

Pour une 1ere experience sur Airbnb, c est une tres agreable surprise.
L appartement est idealement situe, entre la station de metro et la vue spectaculaire sur le Cristo Rei.
L appartement est tres confortable et tres calme.
Maria et son mari sont tres acceuillants et toujours disponibles par mail ou par SMS.
Bref nous ne pouvons que vous recommander cette adresse que nous ne manquerons pas de reserver a nouveau lors d un prochain sejour a Lisbonne.
Juste une chose on a pas vu Maria, c etait dommage...
Merci encore !

Гостили тут в ноябре 2015. Всё было очень хорошо. Квартира необычная, но уютная. С горячей водой всё в порядке, кровать удобная, на кухне есть всё, что необходимо.
Мария гостеприимная хозяйка, приятная в общении и не навязчивая. Живёт по соседству, при необходимости помогает очень быстро (у нас закончился газовый баллон, от которого работает плита и бойлер, я позвонила, она спустя несколько минут пришла и поменяла).
Спасибо!
Всем настоятельно рекомендую :)

This was my and my husband's first time staying in an AirBnB apartment (stayed one night) and Maria set the bar high with her hospitality, responsiveness and helpfulness. The apartment is indeed near to the metro and was quite easy to find (didn't use Google Maps so we asked one local who pointed us towards the general direction). We were 45mins late due to a flight delay, but Maria warmly welcomed us and took 15mins guiding us through the apartment and answering our questions. The apartment was lovely, clean and quiet. It had wonderfully high ceilings (with the exception of the cozy bedroom - 1.8m), which we learnt was typical of traditional Lisbon homes. We were happy for this unique experience and will recommend Maria's apartment.
The location is good, room is spacious. Maria's husband welcomed us and it is easy to find. Just the house is a bit high so you have to climb. Overall a great house and worth the money.

Maria was very welcoming with plenty of great suggestions about what we could do in Lisbon. The apartment was exactly as described and had everything we needed. The location was perfect for central Lisbon. Both Maria and Luis were charming and helpful, lovely people. We would highly recommend staying here. Thank you both.
Fomos muito bem acolhidos por Maria e Luis. Apartamento confortável e muito bem localizado.

Maria's apartment is simply beautiful! You can find there anything you might need. It's really cozy and has a "soul".
It is situated in a heart of Lisboa which makes it easy to see this beautiful town. We enjoyed our stay there a lot and we recommend it in 100% !!
Thank You!
Aleksandra i Piotrek <3
Logement idéalement situé à coté du métro et dans le quartier le plus typique, l'appartement est impeccable, Maria tres accueillante. Nous avions passé 4 belles journées. Je recommande fortement.

Dear Maria, dear Luis, thank you for the remarkable days we could spent in your cosy apartement. We made the experience of being warmly wellcomed by Luis. We found more than everthing what we needed. Often we felt nearly at home. At the end of our stay Maria and Luis took us to our next apartement. On this trip
we apreciated our conversation. Maria had some very good recomendations which we all did. Thank you very much indeed..........recoomdations....triptripripdrive we apreciated our converation

Not only that Lisbon is in my eyes one of the most beautiful cities in Europe, but the stay in Maria's appartment made our trip even perfect! For two people the appartment is totally enough, for students even very spacious ;). Everything was neat and clean, the kitchen fully equipped also with some daily needs as salt etc. The lovely decoration made you feel very confortable, as being at home.
Me and my boyfriend, we really enjoyed the appartment and can only recommend it

Maria was a beautiful host, very accommodating and informative. The apartment was lovely ( very clean and well equipped) & in the perfect location. Exactly what I had hoped for and in the heart of Lisbon. I wish we could have stayed longer and will definitely be back to visit again!

Maria's clean and cosy apartment was perfectly located and really comfortable. Maria made us feel extremely welcome and was really helpful and flexible with our arrival and departure. I would definitely recommend her apartment for a stay in Lisbon.
Great place in the Middle of Lisbon. Everything was fine, we hat a really nice stay.

Fantastic place and very nice host.
I stayed in Maria's nice, spacious, and very well located apartment for one week while visiting Lisbon for work reasons. The apartment is just a stone's throw from Lisbon central but is located in a lovely and quiet street with no disturbances.
It's basic in a nice way with everything you need.
Maria supplies homemade teas from the country and is just generally very nice and helpful.
I've stayed on many Airbnbs around the world and this is, by a wide margin, the best value for money I have ever experienced.
Would love to come back with my family.
Very recommended!
Thanks

This is a truly beautiful apartment in a perfect location! We stayed at Maria’s place only two nights but next time I will be visiting Lisbon I hope to stay there again. It’s much bigger than it looks from the pictures, very clean and comfortable. Maria was a perfect host, very nice and helpful and very flexible (our arrival was delayed by few hours and there was no problem to re-arrange the check in). Thank you Maria!

I starten af september 2015 havde vi et dejligt ophold i Lissabon. Maria tog godt imod os i lejligheden og vi følte os velkommen.
Dejlig lejlighed med alt hvad vi behøvede.
Desværre virkede internettet ikke godt og vi blev hele tiden logget af.

Ce logement est super pour deux personnes, parfaitement situé dans un des plus chouettes quartiers de la ville, très bien décoré, typique à souhait et notre hôtesse maria était très aidante et flexible! On y retournera!

Had a very nice stay at Maria's appartment. Very comfortable house, with everything you need in a great area. Maria has given us a warm welcome and has been very helpful and flexible !

Many thanks !

We had a short but very pleasant stay at Marias apartment! She is such a friendly person and gave us a warm welcome! The apartment is very lovely and tidy. It's located very close to all interesting spots downtown, the metro and further public transport. Perfect place to start a tour in the city on foot starting in the very charming and bright neighborhood! We want to come again!!

We stayed a week at Maria's place and we were very pleased. The localisation is very good, it is possible to go everywhere by walking. The apartment is near Cais do sodre train station and it is very easy to go to Cascais or Estoril. The place was very clean and was very convenient !  Thanks Maria!

Un super séjour chez Maria dans un bel appartement typique très bien situé à proximité du centre ville. La rue et le voisinage sont très calmes malgré cette proximité, ce qui est agréable quand on veut se reposer après une grande journée de balade !
L'appartement est bien très mignon, propre, et largement assez grand pour 2 personnes.
C'était notre première expérience avec AirBnb et nous avons été très satisfaits, Maria nous a donné toutes les informations nécessaires et s'est montrée disponible sans jamais être intrusive, un vrai plaisir !
Nous souhaitons d'ailleurs y retourner pour visiter ce que nous avons manqué dans cette superbe ville :)
Muito obrigado Maria !

La casita esta genial localizada en Barrio Alta, ideal para una pareja , es pequeñita pero luminosa, espaciosa, tranquila , tiene wifi y súper equipada la casa. Muy bonita decorada, nos la guardamos para nuestras escapadas frecuentes a Lisboa que hacemos , volveremos !

Marias Freund Luis hat bis 00:30 nachts auf uns gewartet, um uns persönlich zu empfangen - danke dafür! Er war sehr liebenswürdig und hat uns alles erklärt und gezeigt. Die Vermieter wohnen quasi nebenan und sind somit immer erreichbar.
Die Wohnung ist super ausgestattet (zB Küche mit Kaffeemaschine und Pfannen/Töpfen, gemütliches Sofa zum Abhängen) und sehr gemütlich. Die Atmosphäre ist noch netter und kuscheliger als es auf den Bildern zu sehen ist. Das Bett und der Stiegenaufgang dazu waren uns nicht zu eng oder niedrig - wir sind aber beide nur um die 1,70m.
Sauberkeit: super!! Alles perfekt gereinigt.
Lage: wunderbar, im Zentrum vom Zentrum!! Alles ist perfekt zu Fuß erreichbar, und es gibt einige kleine Supermärkte rundherum die bis 22:00 geöffnet haben.
Zwischendurch gab es ein kleines Problem mit dem WLAN, worauf Maria prompt reagiert hat.
Was ich besonders schön fand, war die Dekoration der Räume: liebevoll zusammengesuchte Kleinode stehen oder hängen an den Wänden (nicht zu viel oder kitschig), das Badezimmer ist farblich außerordentlich gestaltet.
Danke für die schönen Tage in Lissabon, Maria!

Just one day in Lisboa,  but what a fabulous experience thanks to Maria and her beautiful home!  The apartment is in a very nice neighborhood, on a beautiful street, and the photos don't do it justice.  For one day I really felt like I was in my own home away from home, thanks to Maria's warm welcome, the very comfortable, cozy, and super clean place. Thank you, Maria. I will be back!

Echanges chaleureux avec Maria avant notre arrivée et lors de notre rencontre à l'appartement. Situé dans un quartier typique de Lisboa tel que nous l'espérions, nous avons passé un séjour fort agréable dans un logement conforme à notre attente. Lisboa et ses environs sont accessibles très aisément à pieds, en métro, en bus, en tramway et en train à partir de chez Maria.

Nous avons été reçus par Inès, la soeur de Maria, très gentille, à l'écoute si besoin pour donner des renseignements. L'appartement est très bien situé, tout proche du centre de Lisbonne. Très calme, propre et conforme aux photos. Nous y reviendrons sans problème. Merci

Very good experience with maria. The apartment is perfectly located. The place was extra clean. The only thing is that the access to the bed is difficult with a steep stairs, almost ladder. It was awkward to climb up and down because i am more than 6 feet tall. Otherwise, everything was perfect.

Aunque no hemos conocido a María en persona, su hermana Inés nos ha recibido y nos han ayudado a localizar el piso (estábamos un poco perdidos). Inés ha sido muy agradable y nos ha explicado todo y resuelto todas nuestras dudas.

El piso es grande, aunque no recomendable para personas con algún tipo de movilidad reducida (la cama está en un altillo con escaleras).
Por lo demás, un piso excelente.

La estancia ha sido corta pero confortable, cerca de la zona histórica de la ciudad y con un supermercado cercano.

Gracias por alojarnos María.

It is my first solo airbnb experience. I am glad I found this place. It was really close by the metro station. And the tram 28 to the alfama area or tram 15 to Belem  towel were just a few mins walk. Mini mart are also very close by. I was not able to meet Maria but I saw Maria's Sister who is also called Maria. Maria  was very nice to me. She answered all my questions and even allowed me to leave my bag at her house nearby after checking out. The flat has everything that you need, you have all sorts of cooking essentials, bathroom essentials and a lovely little living room. This flat is Hugh for just myself but should be good for two people. I will definitely coming back to Maria place when visiting Lisbon again.
Super schöne Wohnung, zentral gelegen und sauber war es auch :) Mit Maria war's sehr freundlich, hilfsbereit  und unkompliziert, also auch hier Daumen hoch! Ich werd gewiss wieder hin ;)

Maria's place was absolutely charming! It made a great first night to our stay in Lisbon and we would have loved to stay longer. Maria was very friendly and accommodating with our last minute booking and late check out time.

María ist eine wunderbare Gastgeberin. In der Wohnung ist alles, aber wirklich alles vorhanden. Sogar eine kalte Flasche Weißwein!
Wir hatten ein kleines Problem mit dem Internet und María war sofort da und brachte es in Ordnung.
Die Wohnung ist genau wie beschrieben und ist optimal gelegen.
Wir haben den Aufenthalt sehr genossen und empfehlen es gerne weiter.

I had a very good communication with Maria all the months before our arriving (I met her the last day), giving me tips about my stay in Portugal after Lisboa. Unfortunately, we arrived at a busy time for Maria and a time of early morning noisy works in another house of the street and in the 1st floor, with consequences on the flat. The flat is a tipically old house of Lisboa, well situated with all type of transports near. Maria's husband gave us very good restaurants adresses in the area too.
This flat was amazing, very good location, really cute and had everything you need and even more. We really recomend this place.
Flat very confortable. good place to discover the beautifull town of Lisbon. No noise in the bedroom. It's was very pleasant

We had so good time for your house in Lisbon !!!
thank you so much !!!!^^

Maria was very helpful from the very start of our reservation. We met her upon arrival to the part meant and she showed us around. The apartment was great. Very homey, clean and I inviting. The location was fabulous and in close walking distance to many things. I spent a lot of time sitting in front of the apartment reading, enjoying the sunshine and people watching. I highly recommend this apartment while enjoying the fabulous city of Lisbon.

We had a fantastic stay at Maria's apartment. Maria was a great host and the apartment was very comfortable with everything we needed. It was in a really good location for exploring Lisbon and Maria was very good at communicating during and before the stay. Would definitely recommend!

We had a wonderful stay at Maria's apartment in Bica. The photos don't do it justice, it's spacious, very clean and full of charm and in an excellent location. At time we were there is was the Feast of St Anthony and we were in the heart of it which was an amazing experience.
We felt very relaxed and comfortable at Maria's place and would have loved to have stayed longer and had more time to explore beautiful Lisbon.

Maria was the perfect host, excellent communication before we arrived and so accommodating with our arrival and departure times and just a wonderful person to meet!

Thanks for a great stay!
Great appartment. Perfect location. Good value. Key handover smooth. Definitely recommend! Thanks :)

Maria was so helpful and welcoming, even though our flight was delayed by three hours to after midnight!  Location is great, with shops, bars, and restaurants round the corner, and within a few mins of two metro stations and bus stops to get further afield.  Apartment was comfortable and had everything we needed.  Recommended!
Maria was an amazing host. Super friendly and helpful. We had a warm welcome and felt extremly comfy from the start. The appartement is perfectly located and the flat is great!

Apartment was located walking distance from tram line 28's stop, which goes to castle area, placa commercio, and 5-7 mins walk to Baixo metro. Opp the tram 28 stop near the apartment has a really good pastry shop beside a fresh fruit grocer, it's called Aloma (the name is not printed in the outside of the shop but it's on the boxes used to package the take aways). We had (in our opinion) the best Portuguese egg tarts here (even better than the famous Belhem ones).
Maria was out in the street opp the tram stop waiting for us, it was very considerate of her! She lives in the apartment beside the rented apartment so it's very convenient to contact her. She's also always reachable by airbnb app and gave us useful recommendations for dining.
The living was cosy, kitchen had all we needed. We were provided with drinking water in the fridge too (very considerate).
One comment I have is that perhaps shampoo and conditioner be provided, n they stay will be made perfect! Just like home!
The room at the loft section was alright, just be mindful when one wakes up in the night.
Will definitely stay again and reccommend others to stay. :) I had a great time!

Great stay in an idealy located appartment (in one of the most friendly disctrict of the capital). Maria & Luis are really really friendly and available ! Many thanks to them
To recommand without moderation
Maria was welcoming and very helpful.  The apartment is spacious, clean and in a great location.highly recommended.

A great stay and a perfect location! Easy access to all transit and walkable to so many great sites! The apartment is very cute and we loved the little loft bed! Maria is so hospitable and was very accommodating even with a three hour delay in our arrival time due to travel issues. Would highly recommend this place to anyone hoping to stay in the heart of Lisbon!

Super séjour chez Maria!
Quand nous reviendrons à Lisbonne, nous esperons bien que son appartement sera libre
merci Maria pour votre accueil

Maria et Luis sont très sympathiques. L'appartement est sans fioritures, pratique et bien équipé. Le "Cozy Flat" porte bien son nom! On s'y sent bien une fois qu'on revient des ballades dans Lisbonne, où la marche peut être vite fatigante! Idéalement situé, proche des quartiers à visiter Bairro Alto, Chiado, Baixa, etc. On y retournera!

Thank you so much Maria, for letting us stay at your apartment.
You were very helpful and patient.
Very quick responding on my messages.
Regards from the Netherlands

Super agradável e muito bem localizada. Estadia curta, mas muito bem passada. Bem equipada, possibilitando aproveitar mais o tempo na casa.
Maria foi impecável, simpática, é super pratica.
Voltaria sem dúvida.

This airbnb was the best for me.

Maria and her husband were so kind :-)
House is so lovely, and it is really like my home cause I could find and use everything in the room.

Check in & out time were so flexible that I have no problem about arriving early.
I strongly recommend this house if you visit Lisbon!!

We had a wonderful time at Maria's place. Nice, clean appartment with everything you need for a pleasant stay. Well located in Bica, a couple of minutes walking from Bairro Alto, Chiado and Baixa. Lots of public transport nearby, buses, trainstation, and the historical tram 28E. Supermarket is around the corner. It was lovely to sit on the stairs in front of the appartment, have a wine and see the people cross the street and have a glimpse of the famous funicular passing by. Maria is a warm and friendly host; if you need her, she's there for you. Despite having to check out early, we were able to leave our luggage at her own place and pick it up later on. Highly recommended appartment. Thanks for everything!
Maria et sa famille nous ont accueillis à bras ouverts. Le logement etait tel qu'il était décrit dans l'annonce dans une belle ruelle typique de Lisbonne.

Perfect cosy flat for my short stay, cleaned, comfortable and adequate, situated in a nice part of Lisbon.
Would definitely returned.

Maria was a very nice host, she waited a lot for me despite being late at the check-in and gave me all the advice needed to enjoy our stay. Also, having forgot a jacket in the flat, she has been very helpful and available to find time to meet up to give it back to me. The flat is as in the pictures, a very nice cozy flat in a great part of Lisbon. Definitely recommended.
A Maria foi bem atenciosa, nas dúvidas que tivemos. Nos localizou muito bem em relação aeroporto- estação de metrô. O apartamento é bem equipado e bem localizado. Tudo ótimo! Recomendamos!

Fantastic stay! Maria met us as we arrived at the apartment and made us feel very welcome and showed us around, as it was getting late, I don't think many people would do that. The following morning she gave us a list of things to do along with some traditional cakes :) .. All in all was a really good trip to lisbon and the clean and tidy apartment contributed to that a lot. Couldn't recommend it enough! Location wise is perfect for quiet bars/restaurants or if you prefer nightclubs it's all here in Bairro Alto. Supermarket round the corner to stock up on food, which we did even at the late time we arrived. Maria was very relaxed about checking in and checking out which made us relaxed. Overall stay was 10/10!

Maria and her husband welcomed us at our arrival.
We immediately felt comfortable with her. She had also prepared a list of the places to visit and the restaurants to go to.
The flat is very nice, cosy and closed to the centre but without any noise.
We strongly recommand Maria's flat and when we are back we definitly stay there.
Thank you Maria!
Un très joli appartement bien équipé, très cosy et super bien situé .. Merci à Maria pour les petites attentions... Je recommande vivement l adresse !

Malgré de gros travaux en cours à l'étage supérieur, ils ne nous ont pas dérangés car nous étions levés avant 8h00.
Ce logement est très bien situé, et très propre et très calme.
La propriétaire Maria très agréable et pas avare en recommandations (endroits à visiter, bonnes adresses de restaurant, etc..).
Séjour très agréable.

Lejligheden er meget charmerende og behagelig med god plads. Den ligger smukt i en hyggelig bydel ikke langt fra en metrostation. Vi blev meget venligt modtaget af værten, som i forvejen havde sendt tydelig information om, hvordan vi skulle finde adresse. Vi følte os virkelig godt tilpas og godt behandlet.

Maria and her husband are very nice. I met them quickly and they were very polite and nice to us. The flat is amazing and the area where it is couldn't be better. Definitely recommend these hosts and place.

Maria was extremely kind and really made an effort to make us feel comfortable in the flat. The place was absolutely clean and had everything we needed. We had a few questions and she replied quickly and the next morning they had been dealt with. She even made arrangements for us to get a (quite cheap!) taxi to the airport on our last morning because it was quite early and public transport wasn't yet working.

The location is fantastic once you understand that tram 28 goes right by the place. Do ask Maria about this, because Google Maps doesn't display this information properly, but the tram is a very short walk from the apartment. It's also the most famous tram route in Lisbon for its sights.

The neighborhood is the absolute best in Lisbon and we definitely recommend the "A Padaria Portuguesa" shop in Praça Luís de Camões (short walking distance) for breakfast, best pasteis de Belem we had!!

Maria's flat is a exceptional place. It is very accessible to the center of Baixa yet keeps a certain distance with the somewhat noisy night life. Maria has been always helpful and attentive. I made my choice after reading all these positive reviews, and I reconfirm them.
Maria gave us a warm welcome. The house was cosy and clean. It is really a toplocation. The best way to visit Lisbon. All things you need are very close. We loved the place. We can recommend it!

I made reservations with Maria through my own account for my parents to visit Lisbon. She was very accommodating and very very helpful. Considering that this was their first experience with Airbnb, it wasn't hard at all for them to find the place thanks to her. Also, they said they enjoyed staying there a lot!
Very nice flat, in a gorgeous place. Maria made everything very easy. It was very clean, prepared, and with a lot of nice details like champoo, towels, coffee and filters... Thanks Maria!

The flat is lovely, just like on the pictures and Maria made us feel very welcomed. She is such a lovely and helpful person, you can't wish for anything more. The area is great as well, close to everything and a flat is an oasis in the hustle and bustle of Lisbon. I will definitely come back and try to stay at Maria's again! Thanks for everything!

Maria was a wonderfull host!
The flat itself has a central location in bairro alto, close to Bars, Restaurants and lots of "pastelarias".
Communication was great. Quick response at all time!
Really nice location! Thanks a lot. ;)

We loved our week long stay in Maria's flat, it was perfect. Everything is so lovely and charming and so was Maria. We had everything we needed, Maria gave us loads of lovely tips, there was a hair dryer, iron, washing machine, cable tv, coffee machine, lovely hot shower, big comfy bed, beautiful safe street, we loved it so much and are sad to be home! So close to everything, cais do sodre and rossio for all our metro/tram/train needs, bairro alto for bars, fado, wine, easy walk to lovely principe real, so many restaurants, we walked everywhere, lovely cafes and bakeries close by too and supermarket just up the street too. It was perfect, loved how quirky the flat was and Maria was so kind, generous and warm hearted. Would recommend to anyone, we are really in love with Portugal now! Thank you so much Maria!!!! Love Becky and Kester

Maria est une hôte accueillante et super disponible.
C'est un bel appartement, fonctionnel et surtout bien situé.
Je vous le conseille. ;)
We thank Maria for making our stay wonderful. The neighborhood was very close to the attractions and would definitely recommend to any one who wished to stay and enjoy Lisbon.

We had a lovely time staying in this apartment, Maria welcomed us warmly and was very helpful and kind in general. The apartment is particularly tastefully furnished and very spacious. It is well-located in the heart of Lisbon and many shops, sights & bars are within walking distance. We recommend this place to anyone visiting Lisbon!

L'accueil de Maria a Lisbonne a été parfait. L'appartement, plein de charme, correspondait parfaitement aux photos.  Très bien situé, dans une rue calme mais dans un quartier animé. Seul petit défaut, le froid dans l'appartement en cette période hivernale, mais des radiateurs d'appoints et des couvertures nous ont permis de ne pas trop en souffrir.

We can genuinely recommend this place! The apartment is cozy (use the electric radiators provided if you choose to come during the cool seasons!) and beautiful in shape and style of interior design. The kitchen provides all utilities necessary for cooking, though there are lots of great possibilities to go out for dinner in the area around.
Maria cared very good for our wellbeing, she is a most friendly and responsible host.

Maria's flat in picturesque Bica oozed with quaint charm. The kitchen was well-equipped and the apartment was clean and spacious. Unfortunately when we arrived the place was very cold, but the heaters provided by Maria helped a bit.

Maria was a very warm and friendly host helping us with directions and giving us suggestions on where to eat and what to see during our stopover in Lisbon.

It was a pleasure to meet Maria, and we wish her continued success in Airbnb hosting.

Marias place was great. Very spacious, light and airy with some basics already there for cooking with. She welcomed us in and gave us suggestions for things to do and was available by phone for the whole of our stay and her apartment is very near by so she can come round to sort anything out. She also booked us an early morning taxi for our flight back on Monday morning. The apartment is very close to lots of bars/restaurants and only 10 mins to the centre of town with a supermarket very close by. Lisbon is not too big so you can really walk anywhere from here. Would definitely recommend and use again when I go back to Lisbon.

We had a wonderful stay at this lovely flat in the heart of Lisbon. Maria our host gave us a warm welcome and really helpful information about the city before and during our stay. Maria is friendly and attentive, even bringing us extra blankets when she was worried we'd be cold! The flat itself is clean,  beautiful, well equipped and in a superb location within easy walking distance of cosy bars, restaurants and access to explore the city. I would highly recommend this apartment to anyone. Thanks Maria!

I simply did not feel I was mere guest passing by to stay one night in their flat, Maria and Her husband Louis were extremely welcoming, generous and friendly. I was picked from the airport with an unbelievable fare with warm hugs and smiles, I felt like a family member. The photos reflected the flat exactly: tiny cozy and home-like warmth. Maria was very patient and helpful to share useful info for shopping and transport. Her flat is so well located walking distance from all charms of the old city. It was a wonderful experience despite my very short stay. I will definitely stay here again. Maria, you should definitely charge more for all what you offer!
We had a great time in Maria's lovely flat, which was in a great location near to transport and lots of lovely bars and cafés. Maria made us feel very welcome.

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour dans l'appartement de Maria qui nous a reçues avec toute sa gentillesse et sa cordialité.
Son appartement est chaleureux, très bien situé et rien n'y manque pour s'y sentir comme chez soi.
Merci infiniment Maria pour votre accueil et vos conseils avisés que nous avons suivis !
Nous recommandons vivement cette adresse et cette hôtesse !
A bientôt si nous revenons à Lisbonne !
Martine et SImone
Ps : la petite bouteille de vin que vous nous avez offerte à été bue à votre santé!
Bonne Année
Very cosy apartments in the heart of Lisbon, Maria was so kind to help us with everything! Recommend

Maria's flat is much, much nicer than it looks in the pictures - at first we were worried about space and the ease of navigating the loft area, but after arriving, everything was absolutely wonderful. If I could have an apartment like hers, I wouldn't hesitate to move to Portugal instantly. Fast internet, wonderful location, good kitchen, comfortable bed.

There were two small and nice heaters included, which was a lovely touch, and local tea and a friendly and personable host made everything a dream. The location was flawless, right in the heart of the local area, and it was just generally a dream staying there. Would love to stay here for a few months to really get a feel for living in Portugal.

Maria was lovely as well, escorting me out in the morning we left to find an open apothecary and spent over an hour relaxing with a cup of tea, hanging out, and discussing Portugal with me and my girlfriend. What a joy to stay here!

Maria was very helpful and always presented herself as reachable anytime, even though there was no need for it because the cosy home is perfectly located -within walking distance to the main places of interest and in a very authentic and liveful area- and perfectly equipped. I'd definitely recommend it as a perfect choice to experience Lisbon. Thanks Maria! Parabéns! Ficarei ali cuando regresse.

We had a lovely long weekend at Maria's charming apartment in the historic centre of Lisbon. The apartment is exactly as described and very well placed for local shops, restaurants and public transport. Even the famous 28 tram runs one street away! Maria made us feel very welcome and was very respectful of our privacy while being available for any information we needed. We will return to Maria's without hesitation on future trips to Lisbon.
Maria was very welcoming and nice, the apartment is pretty, clean and in a very good location.

Maria and Luis are perfect hosts, extremely accommodating and genuinely nice people.

The apartment was amazing, everything was functional and comfortable, internet connection was fast and that was a huge plus as I rely on it for work. It's located on one of the best neighborhoods in Lisbon, close to virtually everything.

I highly recommend staying at this place.

Thank you, Maria and Luis for the warm welcome! :)
En plus d'être sympathique et accueillante, Maria a un appartement très bien placé, spacieux et très propre. J'y ai passé un agréable séjour. Perfect! Merci Maria.

L'accueil et la gentillesse de Maria ont contribué à un séjour parfait à Lisbonne. L'appartement est très bien situé. On s'y sent vraiment bien! La grande hauteur sous plafond permet de se mettre debout dans la mezzanine (sur laquelle se trouve un des meilleurs matelas sur lequel j'ai dormi depuis longtemps). J'y retournerai avec grand plaisir et recommande vivement cette adresse

This is my favourite place I stayed at during my trip to Portugal. Maria's husband met me there and was very helpful. They live in the apartment behind so you can see their place when you look out into the courtyard. They were very helpful and accessible. Even offered to book me a cab to the airport and helped me with subway directions.
I also loved the apartment itself. Great location in the city and wonderfully set up. I was a little nervous about the loft bed when I booked the place but it was very sturdy and the mattress was super comfortable. I was only staying there one night before flying home but I wish I'd been there longer. I hope to be back!

Nous avons passé un séjour fantastique.
Lisbonne est superbe et nous avons trouvé l'appartement de Maria parfait. L'accueil était des plus chaleureux. L'appartement est placé de façon idéale (super vie de quartier, tous les transports et commerces à proximité, et surtout, calme). C'est très propre. Maria est une hôte adorable et très disponible.
Nous reviendrons chez elle sans hésiter la prochaine fois et la recommandons vivement.
Encore merci pour ce beau séjour.
Léa & Olivier

We (me and my boyfriend) had a great stay at Maria's appartement! Maria waited for us in front of the building when we arrived by taxi and showed us her perfect, cosy appartement. A bottle of red wine was provided, that made us feel very welcome. After she gave us the keys and all the explanations we needed, she left the appartement and moved to her own house - just besides the appartement we were in. If we had any questions, we could send letters via a clothesline:)
We could check out when we wanted and Maria gave us lots of time to grab our stuff and get ready for the flight (our flight was in the evening). It made us feel comfortable and not stressed at all:)
The appartement is even more pretty than it looks like at the pictures and the street it's in is a traditional, beautiful one.
If we come back to Lissabon (and I think we will!) we will stay at this place again, because it is the perfect balance between privacy and contact with the host.
We definitely recommend this appartement and the city Lissabon. You 'll have a wonderful stay in your own appartement in the middle of the most beautiful neighbourhood of Lissabon!!

Maria met and greeted us and was available before and throughout our whole stay. She was very friendly and a professional host! Apartment looked like expected. There was a table fan on the bedroom table that kept you chilled during night. Apartment is located in the area where everything happens. Close to the cafe with the best view in town, to where a lot of restaurants are as well as where all the partying is going in Bairro Alto. Recommended!

Excellent accueil : comme on arrivait tard, Maria et son mari sont même venus nous chercher à l'aéroport!
L'appartement correspondait parfaitement au descriptif, très bien situé pour visiter Lisbonne, dans un quartier très typique.
Nous recommandons vivement cette adresse.
lovely place in central lisboa!!! very friendly host, feels like being at home!! thanks a lot!!!

Location is perfect. Many bars and restaurants just within several minutes walking. Apartment with high ceilings has a very nice atmosphere of a historical place. Special thanks to Maria for being flexible and helpful!
Very pleasant stay!

Maria et Luis sont des hôtes charmants et très attentionnés, qui sont venus nous chercher à une station de bus, malgré l'heure tardive. L'appartement est dans un quartier animé, proche des commerces et restaurants, il est cependant très calme. Conforme à la description, nous l'avons bien apprécié. Nous sommes enchantés et le recommandons vivement.
Dear Maria, thank you very much for you flat, it was a great experience and location to stay in the heart of the city. To be recommended. Thank you!

Logement fidèle aux photos.
Emplacement excellent !! A 2 pas de la place Baixa Chaido et le fameux quartier animé du Bairro Alto, mais aucun bruit car l'appartement est situé dans une rue annexe.
Maria est agréable, et nous a expliqué les différents endroits sympas de la ville.
Je reconseille vivement
Maria was the perfect host and her lovely apartment is in the perfect location, a stone's throw from the Bairro Alto, Cais do Sodré and Chiado. We'd recommend it to anyone.

Es war wunderbar bei Maria. Die Lage ist fabelhaft, alles zu Fuß zu erreichen und traumhafte Umgebung. Abends sind die Bars nicht weit, aber weit genug, um ruhig zu schlafen. Die Wohnung ist wie auf den Bildern, und alles sauber. Das beste war Maria als "Taschenreiseführer" - sie war immer über airbnb erreichbar und hat uns bei Bedarf mit Infos versorgt, bspw. wie wir von A nach B kommen.

Maria is a wonderful person. Very helpful. Her house is cozy clean and have everything you need. We bought a fresh food in the mercado near by and made a great dinner. Everything needed was in the kitchen.
Thank you very much for the great time we had
Vladimir and Katja

Maria was the perfect host. On arrival we were a bit early but she let us in to the apartment to drop off our bags and explained the ins and outs of the apartment and provided recommendations of nearby bars and restaurants.

Her place was our favorite apartment in Europe by far!! Its in a central location near the nightlife of Barrio Alto and only a 5- 7 minute walk from the Baxia- Chiado Metro stop (where all the action is). We loved the spaciousness, decor, cable and strong wifi connection. The place is fully stocked with everything you could possibly need. It felt like home. Our 3 night stay in her place made us LOVE Lisbon. If we ever come back to Lisbon (which we can't wait to do) I would definitely stay here again!

We had a great time at Maria's place. The flat is really well located near the Bica elevator. Only 10 min to walk to the Praca do Commercio. It was also nice and spacious. We would definitely recommend it.
Maria was really helpful and had loads of good tips on where to go.

Maria is a very nice and helpful person and the place is perfect to stay in Lisbon. Maria's flat is cosy and charming as well as very central but located in a quiet street, so that you can sleep not being disturbed by the busy night life. We felt very well in the flat and would be glad to stay there again the next time we come to Lisbon. Highly recommended.

Maria est très accueillante et très sympathique. Nous étions en retard le jour de notre arrivée et elle s'est montrée très disponible. L'appartement est très très bien situé dans un quartier animé et près des transport en commun. L'appartement est propre, bien entretenu et très joli. Nous sommes seulement restés un jour mais la prochaine fois que nous irons à Lisbonne nous retournerons dans cet appartement. N'hésitez pas, allez y les yeux fermés.

Maria is very welcoming and very kind. We were late on the day we arrived but Maria were still very available for us. The flat is very well located in a very animated part of the town and near public transportation. The flat is clean, well held and very lovely. We only stayed 1 day but next time we go to Lisbon again, we will stay there for sure. Don't hesitate, go ahead.
disponibilité et discrétion, accueil très chaleureux, l' appartement personnalisé est agréable dans un quartier idéal et central pour visiter Lisbonne.

Eccezionale! La casa è bellissima. Spaziosa, illuminata, accogliente e funzionale!
La posizione perfetta. Via tranquilla, vicino al centro, supermercato, metro e tanti altri servizi.
Maria gentilissima! Molto disponibile.

Our stay in Lisboa in the flat of Maria was very nice. The flat is well located and exactly as described in the announce of Maria. Furthermore, Maria was very nice with us and give some tips to discover Portuguse culture !
La casa es encantadora y acogedora,igual que nuestra anfitriona. La situación es perfecta, todo a mano, y en una calle estupenda. Un sitio muy recomendable para conocer Lisboa.

The apartment is great and it is in a great location to explore the city and the nightlife at Bairro Alto. If you are staying here (and you should) you cann't miss going to the Miradouro of Santa Caratrina and to the Jardim de São Pedro de Alcântara to be amazed by the views of Lisbon, all of them in walking distance from the apartment.
Most importantly, Maria is a great host and she will provide you with the best tips to explore Lisbon and make you feel more than welcomed.
Nice Place in the middle of a lot to visit. Maria was really helpful. Highly recommend to stay here.
This apartment was great! Super comfortable and in a great location. Maria was very helpful and accommodating.
Very nice place

Maria is a very helpful and friendly host. She gave us a valuable hint, where to find good food and fado. The cozy flat is very well situated, rather calm but central. To make it short, this is a very recommendable appartement.

Maria's apartment is perfectly located for a holiday in Lisbon. You can walk everywhere and it's quiet at night. The apartment is tastefully decorated and is equipped with everything you need for your stay. As a host, Maria was welcoming, attentive and unobtrusive. She gave  us great advice on where to go and what to see including a traditional Fado house! We highly recommend Maria and her apartment. What a great start to our holiday in Portugal!

Maria was really helpful and welcoming on our arrival and made us feel right at home. She gave us some great places to visit and eat at, all easy to get to due to the apartments central location. The apartment itself is quite large with lots of room. Great stay in Lisbon!

Un charmant petit appartment idéalement situé pour découvrir Lisbonne : à cheval entre bairro alto et chiado. Décoration mixte entre confort moderne et cachet de l'ancien et de petits meubles brocante portuguais. Maria a été très réactive pour répondre à nos demandes : plan de la ville, bon plan fado (expérience inoubliable chez une amie à elle, n'héistez pas à la solliciter !), ... tout en sachant rester en retrait pour veiller à notre intimité. Bref si je devais retourner à Libonne, je rempilerais avec Maria !

This Flat is exactly what we were hoping to find after seeing the photos and upon arriving in the city. It remains cool even if the outside world is a furnace wich was a blessing during our stay. If you arrive during the san antonio festivities, you're exposing yourself to a bad night if you're light sleeper otherwise, the street is very peaceful.
Maria took the time to advise us and aswer our questions about the apartment and the city even if she had urgent matters on hand wich makes her a great host especially if you add to that her friendliness and warmth.
The area Bairro Alto is an ideal place to arrive into : typical lisbon stairs, pretty houses, nice old ladies and in the evening, many many bars and some good restaurants to choose from.

What a  wonderful time we had in Marias cozy flat located in the heart of lisbon. Already during planning Maria was very helpful. Even though we  arrived very late Maria took the time to show and explain us the flat and surroundings. During our stay she took care of us ensuring that we have a great time and feel comfortable. The apartment itself is located in a lovely small street not further than 10 walking minutes from lisbons center and bairro alto. Maria equipped the flat with everything one would expect. From a coffee machine over oven and microwave everything was there. Also we were very happy to live in such a clean flat. From bathroom to kitchen everything was very clean and comfortable. Looking back we had a wonderful time and want to thank Maria very much again! Hope to come back in future again.

Posto bellissimo per stare a lisbona: centrale, pulito e molto caratteristico.
Un grazie a Maria per la sua gentilezza.

Simply perfect. Maria is a good host and very nice person. Her communication is quick and clear. She is helpfull, and gave us many suggestions where to go for restaurants, café ect .The flat is indeed cozy. It is also clean, comfortable, quiet, and very good located. A place that I definitely would recommend.
This was a wonderful place to stay in lisboa. Maria was fantastic and the location was perfect. highly recommend this flat!

Maria is very kindness and helpful. She gave us a lot of informations about the restaurants, the attractive places nearby. The flat is very nice, sunny and warm. It´s quiet and also near of the interest center of Lisboa. Definitively we will come back in Maria´s apartment and recommend it to you. Obrigada, obrigado Maria! See you soon.

Maria a eu la gentillesse de venir nous chercher en haut des marches à la sortie du métro sur la Largo do Chiado. D’emblée, une sympathie s’est établie. Quartier du Chiado que nous adorons, rue tranquille, appart vieillot et sympa avec ce qu’il faut pour nous contenter. On a apprécié la très cool corde à linge messagère qui nous reliait à l’appart de Maria, duquel on a reçu de petites douceurs. Le lit confortable sur la mezzanine faisait un petit cocon à l’abri des rumeurs  lointaines venant de la finale de la Ligue des champions de foot le samedi. Maria nous a donné de bons conseils utiles et c’est vraiment une personne charmante. C’est ici que notre voyage a pris fin et le Portugal occupe une place bien au chaud dans nos cœurs. Merci Maria, un jour qui sait nos chemins se recroiseront peut-être…

We really enjoyed our stay at the Cozy Flat.
The location is perfect: at walking distance to many interesting area's.
Maria gives good tips on places to visit, good local restaurants, etc. And she is very helpful to make the stay as comfortable as possible. Thanks Maria!
Maria is a very nice and attentive person. The flat was impeccable.

Our stay in Lisbon was exceptional thanks to Maria. She met us at the train station, gave us information about restaurants and directions to various points of interest. The apartment itself is very spacious, in a great neighbourhood with a lot of excellent cafes, a supermarket, restaurants, shopping, close to the metro and also within walking distance for most sites in the city. We couldn't have had a more enjoyable time.
We would highly recommend Maria and her apartment!
We would like to thank you again for your friendly accommodation and and we will suggest you at any possible chance. Barbara & Paul Christener, Switzerland

Très bel appartement propre et fonctionnel en plein coeur du centre-ville, à deux pas du Barrio Alto et de Baixa Chiado. L'idéal pour un couple qui souhaite découvrir Lisbonne en marge des grandes artères touristiques. Nous avons particulièrement apprécié l'accueil et la gentillesse de Maria qui nous a donné un tas de conseils sur les bons plans du quartier et les visites à faire, dans un anglais impeccable. Une hôte toujours disponible et très arrangeante. Allez-y les yeux fermés vous ne le regretterez pas !
Perfect stay during 3 night in Maria aprt. Very spacious and good location in the heart of Lisboa!..

Marias flat was great!
It was very clean, quiet and nicely done up!
We loved the neighborhood, everything was near to walk.
Thank you for 4 wonderfull days in Lisboa! We will absolutely recommend it!
Chears
Larissa and Patrick

All we can say is that Maria's flat was perfect. It does have everything you might need to enjoy your stay in Lisbon, and it's location simply can't be better. It's close to the Miracruz Miradouro, the Garret St. with all the shops, and both the 28 tram and the metro's blue line stops.

If we ever go back to Lisbon, we will try to book this flat again.

Merci a maria pour son super appart, idéal pour notre week end à deux , voir plu
Us. Situation idéal pres de tout. Première expérience airbnb 100%reusii
A beautiful apartment. Great welcome from a lovely host. Great location and had more than I could ever need. Thank you

We really enjoyed staying at Maria's apartment (that looks more like house). It is very cosy and, although more than 200 years old, nicely renovated and comfortable because there's a lot of place. We felt a bit like locals (and not as tourists).

Maria waited for us at the metro station and was very helpful and friendly. Maria's place is located in a very nice and calm neighborhood and is really close to many of Lisbon's sights. We'll go back and so we totally recommend Maria's place in Bica!

Maria's flat was perfect! It's close by to a metro station and has many sites, restaurants, and stores surrounding. It made exploring the city easy and fun. Communication was also easy and she provided us a lot of recommendations for our trip that were helpful! Would definitely stay again if we revisit Lisboa!

We stayed at Maria's apartment for three days and it was truly perfect. A very clean, cosy and well equipped flat. The neighbourhood was perfect and we walked to everything. Maria was a lovely host who gave us a lot of advice and places to go in Lisbon. We have nothing bad to say about this flat.

I went several times to Lisbon through AirBnB, Maria was the nicest lady to discuss with! She talks perfect English and can explain you whatever you need about the places to go. Her flat is in a very good location and very comfortable!
I recommend!
The apartment is nice and clean, the location is perfect. Thanks!

Maria is een sympathieke gastvrouw, die enthousiast vertelt over de omgeving van de stad , ze gaf ons goede tips.
De flat ligt in een mooie authentieke omgeving , vlakbij het oude centrum.
Het verblijf in de flat was voor ons erg aangenaam en voorzien van alle gemakken.
Kortom een prima uitval basis om Lissabon te bezoeken.
De communicatie met Maria verliep op een ludieke manier, namelijk via een waslijntje.
Ed en Jacolien

We had a great stay here - best location in town and a helpful and sympathic host! :)
Highly recommended to everyone - we hope to visit soon again!
Maria was a great host! She helped us in our first day lost in Lisbon and gave us several tips for visiting the city. The apartment is charming and the location is great. I definitely recommend it!

We stayed at the apartment of Maria a couple of weeks ago! We were very comfortable, the location is perfect and convenient for visiting the city and close to the means of transport!
Maria was very helpful and friendly! a truly enjoyable experience! Thank you so much Maria!

Maria nous a accueilli très chaleureusement dans son appartement attenant à sa maison.
Le quartier de Bairo Alto est l'un des plus agréable de Lisbonne, avec le belvédère de Santa Caterina au bout de la rue, on profite de la vue sur le TAJ en prenant l'apéro !
L'appartement est spacieux et plein de charme.
Sans hésitation notre adresse lors de notre prochain voyage à Lisbonne !
What a great time and such a perfect place, Maria you where very helpful ,The location A+ , Very very clean and well located i will recommend this place  to all my friends,

Everything in Maria's apartment was perfect, very tidy, very clean. The location is central and it is really easy to visit the city and going to nice restaurants and bars.
I strongly recommend Maria's house!
Beautiful apartment, one of the very best I've stayed in - it's a home, has great character, and is excellent value. Maria is a wonderful host, very kind and welcoming. Highly recommended.

Nous venons de passer un agréable séjour de 4jours 3 nuits à Lisbonne dans ce douillet petit appartement bien équipé et spacieux. L'installation de la chambre en mezzanine est très originale. La proximité d'une rue exclusivement piétonne et très calme n'empêche pas d'être à deux pas du célèbre café Brasiliéra , des halles près de la gare sur le bord du Tage et de tout le bario Alto. Il va de soi que l'accueil chaleureux et la disponibilité de Maria est un plus pour cette adresse à recommander .

In the beginning of january the weather was very bad in Lisbon, but Maria welcomend us so warmly, that we flew back with a very good impression of our days. We passed 5 nights in the cosy appartment, used the kitchen for cooking (good) and passed some chillout time inside while it was raining. All in all we would never have had such a good time without this friendly, calme an very clean place in the center of the city. Thanks a lot!
Michaela
We have stayed at Maria's place twice. In our second staying, everything went just perfect as in the first one :). Thanks, Maria!

Maria's apartment is just perfect. It is very well located and is exactly as described. The apartment was clean and organized, and has everything you need. Maria is very friendly and was always ready to support us anytime we needed. It was an excellent experience and I am very sure that by the time that I get back to Lisbon, Maria's apartment will be my first accomodation choice.

A Maria recebe-nos com sensibilidade e delicadeza, estas características estão reflectidas no espaço.
Local, acesso e serviços óptimo.
Aconselho vivamente.

La experiencia ha sido excelente, desde el primer contacto realizado con María obtuve una respuesta inmediata, toda la información brindada se corresponde con la realidad. María fue muy atenta, puntual, y amigable ya que nos brindo información sobre sitios para recorrer. El piso se corresponde exactamente con las fotografías, la ubicación es excelente. Fuimos dos personas  y es amplio, luminoso y muy cómodo. Sin lugar a duda volveríamos a alojarnos en el piso de Maria!
Perfect location and appartment has everything you need.

I loved Maria’s place!

Communication before our arrival was very simple and Maria responded fast to our mails. She explained us everything we needed to know about the flat and answered all of our questions. Maria is very helpful and courteous.

The apt is great for so many reasons! It's close to everything (the location will delight you)! It's an awesome, beautifully done-up, friendly flat, with WIFI, and amenities, this is a perfect home-from-home, a convenient, beautiful and welcoming apartment in downtown Lisbon.
The apartment has everything you need and it's true to its description. I would highly recommend this place to anyone traveling to Lisbon and wants to be in a central location! The location is also perfect for dinning and clubbing and well served by public transport.

Great apartment with sweet details, perfect location for visiting the city like a local! Everything was within walking distance (however we did take advantage of the train, since it was just too cute to pass up). The apartment was perfectly situated, with a lovely host who gave us some great recommendations and a complimentary bottle of wine!
100% plan on coming back to Lisbon and will be staying with Maria again. Everything was just perfect!

Maria was a wonderful host, she met us at the airport bus and gave us a nice tour of the area on the way to her flat.  She gave us great suggestions helping us get to Sintra and Belem, two areas we highly recommend for guests!  We felt like a local in the flat, it was in a wonderful location very close to the supermarket, very good restaurants, and fantastic views.  The flat had everything we needed and more.  Highly recommend!! Abrigado!!
Maria is the kindest host and her flat in Lisbon is so wonderful.  I wish I could have stayed longer, everything was perfect!

Our weekend- stay at Maria's place was wonderful:
She made us feel like home, with a warm welcome, wine and her homemade tea.
We experienced Maria as a professional, charming, well informed, lovely host.
Her apartment was original and cosy, we found it clean and well equipped.
The central position in a quiet street was good for excursions, as well by feet to the centre as travelling by bus, metro and train.
Our stay was a lovely memorable adventure, with Maria to thank for! We would love to come back again and definly recommend her place to others.

judith and laura
Maria a été parfaite :discrète, attentive, prévenante. L'appartement ést agréable, très calme, bien situé et nous a permis de vivre du bon temps pendant cinq jours

L'appartement est très bien placé, on a pu faire tout le centre de Lisbonne à pied. Lumineux, silencieux, propre et beau. Maria est adorable, nous a reçu avec une bouteille de vin et beaucoup de gentillesse. J'ai un bébé et elle nous a laissé disponible un lit parapluie et une chaise haute, parfait pour les parents que voyagent toujours déjà très chargés. Je recommande fortement et j'aimerais bien pouvoir donner même plus de 5 étoiles! :)
It was very nice to stay at Maria's place. The flat is indeed very cozy, very nicely located and we had a very good time at Maria's appartment!

We spent an excellent stay at Maria's flat, the apartment is perfect, very very well situated in a nice typical street. From the apartment we can visit all the city center by walk.

Maria is very pleasant and helpful, she just lives very close what is very practical. She even give us a little gift of welcome.

The appartment was wonderfull! Such a great place in the middle of Bairo Alto with a lot of nice cafes and restaurants walking distance. Nice and beautiful kitchen and sleeping room. Highly recommend the place! Maria was a great and helpfull host. Best wishes, Fleur & Djamel

If you are looking for a wonderful full of space for a couple or even more people at the heart of Lisbon`s old town then this is the right place for you. Maria is a great host. We arrived early morning in Lisbon and she kindly came to the metro station to help us to put our bags in her place (before checking time) to give us chance to explore amazing Lisbon. She is so helpful to give useful information about Lisbon. The place is just few minutes from metro station. We really enjoyed our stay at this place and for sure if we comeback to Lisbon again we will contact Maria.

This is a lovely flat in a great location. Maria is friendly and helpful - close at hand when needed but not intrusive at all. Her advice about the city should be listened to, it'll greatly enhance your stay..
Right in the heart of Bairro Alto, the flat is only a short stroll from any number of great bars, restaurants and sights - but is nicely nestled in a peaceful side-street, so noise isn't an issue. I really enjoyed my stay and I fully intend to stay here again when I return to Lisbon.
Amazing charming quiet place! And such a warm welcome. I shouldn't write tooo positive, otherwise it's fully booked everytime I wanna go back :)

Die perfekte Wohnung, um in Lissabon zu verweilen! Sie ist super zentral gelegen: man kann alles zu Fuß erkunden - Restaurants, Kneipen, Shopping und für weitere Ziele sind Tram und U-Bahn nicht weit. Dabei ist die Wohnung wundervoll ruhig, hat eine praktische Zimmeraufteilung und ist schön eingerichtet.
Und die Gastgeberin hat sich sehr fürsorglich um uns gekümmert - thanks Maria!

We have had nothing but great experiences with Air BnB to date, so prior to out trip to Lisbon, it was hard to imagine how the other stays could be beaten, but they were! The flat itself is a delight, spotless and full of understated character and charm. I would definetly recommend Maria and her apartment if you want to have a pleasent stay in Lisbon whether you want to relax and walk around the city or just go party. Pontos que precisam ser revisitados:

Would definitely recommend Bairro Alto Suites to anyone visiting Lisbon! Very well located! It’s close enough to walk to central Lisbon and some of the bigger tourist attractions, and a quick walk to the Metro station and the tram line running through the city. The hotel is also situated up the road from a street full of restaurants, bars and pubs, and close to areas like the Rua Nova do Carvalho and TimeOut market, so you’re never far from the hustle and bustle. There are also two Michelin Star restaurants right around the corner (Tapisco, the one I visited, is literally a few meters away). Nice small boutique hotel with a super friendly staff.  Ricardo was extreme professional and helpful upon our arrival.  Liked the keypad system for convenience of entry and exit.   Location was a great spot to start touring the restaurant area and was only 17 mins to the water and sites.

Ótima estadia, o Ricardo foi muito gentil nos ajudando com um check in fácil e um pouco mais cedo que o esperado, o que ajudou bastante, além de dar dicas na região. O espaço não é grande mas ficou ótimo para o nosso stopover em Lisboa, e o quarto estava limpo e organizado. Sem dúvida o ponto mais alto é a localização, com tudo próximo a metros de distância. O ônus vem também pela localização, pois a vida noturna é agitada e vai até tarde, e foi um pouco difícil dormir com o barulho, mas no geral gostamos muito da experiência.

The room in Bairro Alto Suites was comfortable and clean. My room was in the back of the building, so it was really quiet. It is easy to reach, also if you are coming by metro/bus. Pedro was very friendly and explained everything thoroughly whilst Check-In. Would definitely recommend.

It is not you typical commercialized area. All of the shops and cafés are locally owned and have a Bohemian type vibe. It's a great feel to get away from "typical" and experience something that is "real." There is a coffee shop / bakery at the corner named Sao Roque, which is a "must" to visit. If the ladies there get to know you and see that you're polite, they'll warm-up (a little ;).
The suite is small but centered in a good area. The guest attendant on site was very helpful during our stay.

Das Zimmer entsprach nicht ganz den Fotos - äusserst klein, wenig Platz um Koffer zu stellen - Dusche extrem klein - Unterkunft (unser Zimmer) ist gut für 1-2 Nächte. Empfang sehr freundlich, hilfsbereit. Das Zimmer wurde jeden Tag neu geputz, alles sehr sauber, neue Bettwäsche und Badetücher.
Muito limpo, confortável e bem localizado. Recomendo a todos.
Great place for my couple nights’ stay! Amazing location in Bairro Alto, close to all the cool places. Host was very helpful and responsive! Loved my stay

Great place to stay! The view really was as stunning as they advertised. Just a short walk to some great restaurants - very walkable neighborhood. Normal precautions for the city itself though, nothing against the stay, but if you don’t like big cities, you may not care for Lisbon. It certainly had its sketchy characters and the amount of restaurant owners begging you to come dine with them was overwhelming.. glad for the experience, but came to the conclusion that we won’t be staying around Lisbon in the future. Worth it for the castle de Sao Jorge though - stunning at night, but make sure to get there a little earlier as they won’t let you view the highest part of the castle past 7/8PM. There’s also a lot of shopping to do around the area - so make sure to leave some space in your luggage as you’ll need it!
