Unfortunately and I take full responsibility for this - my husband and I did not read all the reviews and failed to realize that a four flight walk up with several large luggage items was a terrible idea for our last night in Lisbon. There were also some challenges getting into the unit and Heloliza was very kind as to walk us through it - bottom line this is a great fun apartment for young people traveling light. Not for us but again not the fault of our host we didn’t do our research. If you are young with a backpack and a desire to be in the center of it all this place is for you !

We were excited to stay here.
It’s central to so many key places we wanted to walk to. Lots of food, sight seeings, etc.
A bit noisy at night since you are in the center of it all, but once you shut the windows it blocks out a lot of noise.
Would stay here again!

Such a beautiful place , I can’t imagine a better view!
The pictures make the place appear more spacious than it really is, tight around corners and furniture. But everything was so new and updated , everything worked great and having a washer/dryer was a huge plus!
We would definitely stay here again the robes, slippers and bottles of wine were a perfect touch. Would recommend to anyone again!
Also only two streets away from the lively rua augusta

Great location and very cute little spot. If you have a lot of luggage be aware that there are a lot of stairs and the stairway gets HOT. The bedroom stays cool but the rest of the apartment not as much but if you open the windows you get a nice airflow. One thing I will say there is no plug in the bathroom and not a lot of plugs in the apartment overall. I really like the vibe of the place it’s definitely feminine and cute. We had a car and there are a few parking garages all located within a 10 minute walk I suggest pre paying for those if you plan to have a car. The bed was actually very comfortable which you don’t find often in these Airbnbs.
We loved the place! Great location and great communication from the host!

The flat is located on the third floor, and as other reviews have mentioned, the stairs are quite steep. We struggled with our luggage, though to be fair, we were aware of this beforehand. The property is in a great location, walkable, with lovely views, but that comes with its own downside: it can get noisy at night, and we could hear the upstairs neighbors quite clearly.
While the decor looks appealing in photos, up close it feels more rushed than refined. Many surfaces, tiles, bathroom fixtures, doors, even the fridge, appear to have been hastily painted, which detracts from the overall impression of luxury or romance. For £345 for two nights, I don’t feel the value matched the price. It seems you're mostly paying for the location.
I did appreciate the thoughtful gesture of the complimentary bottle of wine. However, the request for a 5-star review felt a bit pushy, especially considering the experience didn’t quite justify it.
Thank you for hosting us.
Amazing experience. Great Airbnb. Highly recommend

Heloiza was a wonderful hostess. Her place was charming with some really special touches.  It was on the fourth floor with a spiral staircase, but we managed it fine. We only had trouble with the door lock. You must pay close attention to Heloiza’s instructions.  It was perfectly located with many activities nearby along with restaurants and shops.   Her honor system in the kitchen was super cute and provided us with some extra provisions that we needed.  I would definitely stay here again.

You cannot beat the location! We were able to walk to all the different neighborhoods and explore right from her doorstep. Fada in Alfama for dinner after the castle tour and sunset, or walking through Príncipe Real for an afternoon and all that is inbetween. Getting to outer areas such as Belém, LX Factory and Time out was an easy hop on to the Tram or bus only a short entertaining walk away. Thank you for the extra touch of leaving a bottle of Portuguese wine for our arrival. I would definitely recommend this adorable historic home, with great air conditioning in the bedroom for a cool sleep (in what we experienced was 36 degree heat while we were in Lisbon).
Toppenbra ställe. Nära till centrum, fräscht och väldigt bra värd.

Our evening in Lisbon will be one we won’t forget. The place is amazing and so stunning we got engaged over looking the streets. Would recommend this to anyone looking for a great place to stay in Lisbon!

The flat is in an absolutely amazing location for exploring the city on foot or using public transport.
Heloiza has gone to a lot of effort to make check-in easy and to make the stay as smooth and enjoyable as possible.
It was great for our 3 night stay in Lisbon. The flat is comfortable but the photos make it seem a bit more luxurious than in the flesh.
Overall a great stay.

överlag en bra vistelse! men upplever inte att fotona riktigt stämde med verkligheten, det var mer slitet än vad som sågs på bilderna. det fanns ac men bara i sovrummet och eftersom vi var tre personer sov en person i vardagsrummet på bäddsoffan där det fanns en fläkt men det blev inte riktigt svalt som i sovrummet vilket drar ner betyget lite. förstår att det är en gammal byggnad i en varm stad men kan förbättras. i övrigt bra rekommendationer och tydliga instruktioner!
Very much enjoyed our stay.  The air conditioning was an added bonus! The apartment was nicely supplied with little extras that were thoughtful and made the stay even better. thank you!!

Heloiza’s flat did initially come with some challenges. We had a hard time figuring out how to get into the building as the door on the street isn’t super clearly labeled. However, the host was incredibly responsive and we were able to figure it out quite quickly. once we were inside the place was so cute and cozy.
, You can tell there is a lot of attention to detail put into the place . We did have an issue with the cleanliness of the flat when we arrived but after chatting with Heloiza we sorted it out .
The Airbnb is also located in a great spot! So close to everything .
I will mention, there is no elevator in this building and quite a few narrow stairs to get to the flat, so be mindful, if bringing large bags.
Heloiza went above and beyond with the amenities she provided, the apartment was cozy and well-decorated, and you are mere steps away from the praça de comerciao! perfect!

Beautiful flat with a view of the sea from the bed. Gorgeous bathroom and romantic setting.
Great access to restaurants, the metro and local amenities.
Our host left us a bottle of wine to welcome us which was brilliant and made us feel very welcome

Outstanding apartment in Lisbon. Close by to anything and everything, all the sights to see and many hidden gems. The views are stunning. Heloiza was very accommodating with our early arrival, letting us store our luggage before to check in. Would recommend and be back any time.

We loved our stay here! The apartment was so beautiful and smelled amazing, there was a welcome wine bottle and bathrobes. The view from the bedroom was stunning. We loved that the fridge had some beverages for purchase. There are many windy stairs to get up to the apartment but it’s well worth the climb with suitcases.

Excellent!!! The accommodation was just as pictured and described. Centrally located, with easy access and walkability to everything. It was located on a busy main street but honestly we didn’t even notice it much, as the 3-sided views and the constant breeze kept us distracted. Loved it - We would definitely return!
Our host Hezokia was the best - very friendly and helpful. She went above and beyond to make our stay nothing less than excellent!!! Thank you!

Location can’t be beat, and the apartment offers a truly unique window into life in an old Lisbon walk up, with modern amenities. The views from the balcony were unparalleled. The AC in the bedroom worked great. The AC in the living room was a bit weak, but then again it was during a heat wave.  We only had one night during a layover and I’m really glad we chose this place, it was a a big part of our Lisbon experience. I also appreciated Helozia’s clear instructions on check in- we prob wouldn’t have been able to figure out the apartment key without it, but with the video we didn’t have any trouble.
We loved our stay here! Right in the heart of the city

We had an excellent time at our stay here-the apartment is in a busy part of town, so there was plenty to do a short walk away, and it was a real treat to have such a short walk to St. George’s Castle! The treats were a nice touch as well. My only word of caution is that there are a lot of stairs, so heavy suitcases could be hard to manage!
Amazing!

I enjoyed my stay in the apartment.  I really liked the location within Lisbon and I liked that the apartment had windows on all 3 sides.  This especially helped to cool the bedroom down.  It was a bit of struggle to bring the luggage up the stairs, but I knew that before booking so that is not reflected in my overall rating.  I just felt that the photos make the apartment look more luxurious than it actually is.  Everything just feels old and dated, including the furniture (the couch especially), the walls and floor, and especially the bath/shower.  I feel the apartment could benefit from some renovation work.  I get it, Lisbon is old, but I stayed in an Airbnb in Porto in an old building and that apartment felt fresh and modern

We were lucky enough to stay at this flat during long layovers on both ends of our European trip. The place is exactly as advertised with a wonderful view and central location adjacent to several popular neighborhoods. Heloiza was a wonderful host, immediately responsive to several questions we had and you could tell that she takes great pride in her space by the information she provided about the city and how her space was decorated. She even provided a welcome bottle of Portuguese wine which was greatly enjoyed and appreciated. We would absolutely stay here again if the opportunity presented itself and recommend this space to others for a comfortable and affordable stay in Lisbon.

Great host and a wonderful apartment in such a fantastic location.
being high up also gives you great views, whilst feeling a bit quieter and more peaceful.
Super localisation pour découvrir Lisbonne !

Great location. Cute place. Loved the rituals amenities. Some flights of stairs were not lit so it was a lil hard checking out in the early morning with the luggages. I would say I think an anti slip mat for the bathtub would go a long way, it can get quite slippery.

L'appartamento di Heloiza ha un grande fascino perché è perfettamente incastonato nel quartiere della Baixa, intonato all'architettura pombalina.
Vista eccezionale fino alle acque del Tago, dettagli di arredo sapientemente accostati; e non ultimo letti comodi.
Avrei gradito uno spazio doccia più confortevole, ma tenuto conto della natura storica dell'alloggio è accettabile.
consigliatissimo

Amamos estar con Heloiza! Queríamos quedarnos más noches incluso y nos arrepentimos de solo haber reservado una. La decoración es bellísima y está todo lleno de detalles increíbles. Seguramente volveremos

We had a short stay at this property, the Apartment located in the best Area in Lisbon, the check in instructions was clear and easy, the host was always available, the only thing was the cleanness of the Flat which was not acceptable, the Floor all over the Flat was soo dirty and it seems it wasn't clean for the last months, we just walked on the Dirty ground with hair left from other guest, my child's feet was all black and full of small hair pasted on the ground!
NOT RECOMMEND For the family with kids!

Had a great one-night stay here. The flat was clean, peaceful, and really well thought out. The stocked fridge with an honour system was such a nice touch, and made settling in really easy. The bed was super comfortable too, the memory foam mattress topper was a dream after a few nights in a hostel! Great location and smooth check-in. Would definitely come back.

Heloiza's place was easy to find, she very kindly allowed me to drop my bag early as I got to Lisbon before check in time. The apartment has had a lot of thought put into it ,especially the supplies in the fridge, which was an excellent idea! The location is brilliant- convenient to everything, and so many good eateries nearby. My only problem was that I hadn't realised how busy a spot it is, the traffic rarely stops...but that was my fault for not thinking about where it was- it won't bother a lot of people. Thanks for the lovely stay.
Amazing location and beautiful apartment!
Amazing stay! it was our first stay in our vocation, we were so tired and we find there everything what we need, even the gift from our host!🥹

We stayed here for one night before flying to Madeira, and overall it was a great stopover. The location is excellent—very walkable and close to everything you might need.
At first glance, the apartment feels a bit more worn than the photos suggest, but it quickly grows on you thanks to its charm and historic character. It was quite warm when we arrived (despite mild weather outside), so I imagine it could get hot in the peak of summer. The bedroom A/C works very well, but the living room unit wasn’t as effective. That said, if you’re out exploring and just need a comfortable place to sleep, it does the job.
Check-in instructions were clear and easy to follow. Just note that the apartment is on the 3rd floor with four flights of stairs and no elevator—totally fine for us, but something to keep in mind if you have a lot of luggage or mobility issues. We didn’t mind—it added a bit of a workout before our flight!
This place was great to stay in. Walkable to almost everything & right beside the castle, places to eat and coffee shops. We had a great time. COYG ❤️🤍

Loved staying at Heloiza’s place! It was cute, cozy, and right in the middle of everything — perfect for exploring Lisbon. Felt like a true local. Heloiza was super friendly and easy to communicate with. Would definitely stay again!

The place was clean.  Large bathroom, kitchen with coffee pods, welcome wine.   We used it for an overnight stay on our way to other places in Portugal.  Convenient to the metro.   Do not go by google map to get there as it is not accurate, look works the address instead along with the notes form the host. As people say there is a lot of stairs.  So do not go with big luggage
My husband and I had an excellent stay here during our honeymoon! The location was ideal, walkable to major sightseeing sites and good bakeries. We loved our stay!
Great place to stay in Lisbon! It’s in a Perfect location!

Localização perfeita, próximo de muitos pontos turísticos. Heloiza foi prestativa e muito clara nas instruções de acesso. o único ponto de atenção é em relação ao acesso por escadas, se você está com muita bagagem, pode ter dificuldades.

My partner and I only stayed one night. The location is fantastic, walkable to the popular tourist attractions and best restaurants of Lisbon. However, I would have preferred to stay at a more modern, comfortable apartment that's further from the attractions. I read from other reviews that the place was not the most clean and that it was noisy from neighbors. I chose to ignore those, but it was true... there were multiple house flies in the apartment and my partner really doesn't like insects. The sofa foot rests fit into the sofa. We took them out to use and there was litter (receipt, plastic wrapper, lot of dust) underneath. The floor felt sticky. I have no doubt that the apartment is superficially clean--that the sheets are laundered, surfaces wiped, etc., but it felt unclean. Upstairs and next door apartments were noisy, can hear footsteps/conversation. I liked the Rituals products (a good brand) and the comfortable bed. Nice touches we didn't use: bottle of wine, bathrobes.

Amazing deal. Clear check-in instructions and communication. Unbelievable view from the bedroom and very aesthetic space.
Would definitely book again!

De locatie is in de beste wijk van Lissabon, kort bij alles. De communicatie met de host was nog nooit zo goed als bij deze. We kregen een gedetailleerde uitleg hoe we binnen kwamen, en ook aanraders voor activiteiten, restaurants etc.
Een echte aanrader!

We stayed in Heloiza’s apartment for three nights and enjoyed being close to many sites and restaurants. We arrived to a bottle of wine which was a nice touch. Only challenge of our stay was the four flights of stairs to the apartment that are a bit slanted. After all those hill in Lisboa, our legs were worn out 😂 We loved the view out the bedroom where you could see a slice of the view to the water.
Heloiza was very responsive and was able to help is right away when we were having issues. Very nice and the place was super cute! It had everything we needed and the bed was comfy! Thank you.
Responsive host, clean and as described apartment. Great location with so many fun places to walk to.
A cozy place to stay.  Need to climb stairs to 3rd floor. Not a problem for us but could be challenging for elderly people. Many restaurants are within walking distance.
What a spectacular place. Great location, great amenities, great home and buenas vibras all around. 10/10 would Lisboa again.

This is an older style but fantastic, authentic apartment in downtown Lisbon. With a great view from the bedroom window. Perfect location for our 3 day stay. We had easy access to all sites. Either by foot or tram.
Thoroughly recommend this apartment but be warned it is on the 3rd floor snd there is no lift.

Unbeatable central location and a very comfortable stay, especially for a couple or friends. Lots of nice touches and a generous bottle of wine as a welcome! Very clear check-in instructions. Pack light, the apartment is on a very steep hill of a street and up 3 flights of narrow stairs. Wouldn’t recommend for accommodation with children/strollers/heavy packers. Otherwise, fantastic base for exploring Lisbon!
Good part of the city centre. Very close to a supermarket if you are self catering. Good area. Loved our stay there. Oh, and 2 brollies were provided because it can rain!

Absolutely perfect location in middle of old Lisbon, short walk from plaza figueroa exit of rossio metro. The flat is very cute with fantastic street (and castle!) views from master bedroom, you can even see ocean.
Heloiza was so flexible letting us drop bags early as we arrived in Lisbon few hours earlier than expected.
Bottle of wine and full booklet of recommendations were thoughtful touches.
Great stay! Perfect location. The welcoming bottle of wine was a very nice surprise as we walked in.

This place was in a perfect location! We loved the view from the room and it was so easy to hop on the metro or the train at Rossio. Heloiza was very quick to respond and very kind when we had issues. Would definitely stay here again!
Wonderful space in a great location! We walked from the place easily and we were able to go back mid day to change and be ready for dinner. We loved it!
Good location, right in the city close to everything.
Very unique place, had a great stay!

The place was beautiful and comfortable, had everything you would need for a short or longer stay. Only things that I wish had been better were the neighbors were a bit noisy and the key/lock was very difficult to maneuver. It took a couple minutes to get inside each time. Other than that, we really enjoyed our stay!
Our favorite AirB&B to date! Just the right amount of communication! We felt super at home and welcomed! Thank you!!
Great host! Heloiza was super friendly and accommodating. Would stay here again!

We had a lovely stay! Such a great home base and easily walkable to anything in the Chiado and Alfama neighborhoods. Helozia was always kind and helpful. It was a treat to be able to do laundry during our stay, and all of the rituals products throughout were such a special touch! We also loved the bottle of wine. Would happily stay again
Place was beautiful and very centrally located to all attractions :) beautiful, cute, and cozy inside.

This place is stunning and I loved my stay here. Wooden floors, crown moulding on the ceiling and vaulted windows with an incredible, colorful city view and you can even see the ocean! I wish could have stayed here longer, it’s so romantic, and Heloiza was very kind, helpful and flexible, 10/10! Make sure you do your part and read her helpful google doc of how to checking in and use the cool key. I found when turning both door keys it’s easier to open the door of you pull it towards you :)

Logement beau et vraiment bien situé mais un peu sale, mal isolé, bruyant, pas très grand, dommage...
L'appartement sentait le renfermé, l'humidité et les remontées d'égout à notre arrivée. Même en ayant beaucoup aéré, les odeurs sont restées pendant tout le séjour.
Les fenêtres ferment mal, on entend le bruit des routes qui passent en bas toute la nuit, le bruit des passants en pleine nuit, etc.
De plus, les voisins du dessus étaient très bruyants jusqu'à 23h, et dès 5h... Ça nous a empêché de bien dormir.
Logement pas très propre, de la poussière un peu partout, des taches dans les draps, des serviettes qui sentent le renfermé.
Enfin, le salon est un peu petit pour 3 personnes. La table pour manger est vraiment petite.

Great location that is easily accesed from the metro.😊 The host provided good description of how to get there and retrieve the keys, and responded very fast to inquireries. 😊 The apartment was otherwise good, a bit cold and humid outside of the bedroom, but with a comfortable bed. The busy area can be a bit loud.

Great apartment with gorgeous views and a wonderful style in a beautiful old building.  I especially appreciated that it had a bathtub - something few listings offered!  There were also lovely ways Heloiza went above and beyond - providing clean robes and slippers, a generous wine gift for guests, etc.  It rained during our stay, and the apartment did let in the damp quite a bit.  This was fine for us, but worth noting, I think, in case it affects others differently.  We would be very happy to stay here again!

Top Lage, viel Verkehr aber nachts voll ok vom Lärm her.
Für eine Nacht mit Kinder ok, für mehrere Nächte zu klein.
Für Paare zu empfehlen!

Heloiza was a great host. We were so grateful for an earlier checkin as our child was so tired from the journey. She was very responsive and her instructions were always clear and easy. The place is lovely. Wonderful location right where you want to be to explore Lisbon. We would definitely book again at this spot.
Muy lindo, nos sentimos muy cómodos

We had an amazing stay in Heloiza’s charming apartment. It was so easy to check in and we felt at home immediately. The decor is very tasteful and we had the best sleep in a very comfy bed. The location is perfect; only a five minute walk to the Main Street and sea but still in a quiet and peaceful area. When we come back to Lisbon this is where we will have to stay, I dont think anything else could compare.
Thank you so much!!

Sehr schöne authentische Unterkunft und unschlagbarer Lage.Heloiza war sehr gut erreichbar und der Check in und Out sehr klar und detailliert beschrieben.
Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt.

Absolutely loved our stay - just wish it was longer. Really cute space! So cozy and comfortable. Loved the small
Touches with the blackboards & wine & slippers!
Wonderful apartment in a very walkable location! It had everything we need. I really appreciated the blinds that closed all the windows so the sun didn’t come through in the morning.
Came during the winter so it was humid if you plan to do laundry and are okay with the rain. The views were exceptional! So much to do nearby for sites and food!
We had a great stay. The location was perfect… such a charming place.

Absolutely fabulous place to stay.  Easy walking distance to the restaurants and attractions. Beautiful view from the bedroom windows. Cozy and warm in the cold January temperatures. Can't wait to come back!
Très bon séjour chez Heloiza, et ce sur divers points: accessibilité, localisation, confort, équipement… je recommande vivement ce logement.
the space was great and the neighborhood was amazing. only thing negative i could say is the main staircase was steep and tight so if you're mobility challenged this isn't the place for you.
Heloiza's place was authentically welcoming in an older building. Great coffee, confirm bed, and a delicious bottle of wine. Thank you so much for a very convenient place to rest!
Heloiza was just marvellous, friendly and responsive, with clear advice. The apartment was superb, very cozy and very well equipped. We will definitely be back!
Amazing location — close to many great restaurants and shops. The neighbors upstairs were a bit noisy, but other than that we enjoyed our stay.
Mignon petit appartement que je recommande en plein cœur de Lisbonne

Excellent location, easy access to many tourist attractions including Rossio sq., Castelo de São Jorge etc. There are tons of cafes and restaurants around. Classical downtown Lisbon feeling house with antique style interior and house.
We had a great stay at Heloiza’s Airbnb in Lisbon! The location was fantastic for our holiday :)

We are happy to say that everything was set up and clean on arrival. We were contacted through the app to confirm our arrival.  This was our 40th anniversary and we are very happy that from contact to arrival to departure was smooth sailing
Perfect stay! In a great location. Would definitely recommend and stay again!

Amazing apartment and wonderful host. The location in Lisbon couldn’t have been any better and the instructions, recommendations and welcome gifts waiting for us on arrival made this a top notch stay.
Logement propre et très bien situé
This was a great find in Lisbon!! Very centrally located, great neighborhood, perfect for two people and the amenities/cleanliness was 10/10!

I had an amazing stay at Heloiza’s place! The location was absolutely perfect, with easy access to all the key attractions and great restaurants nearby. Heloiza was incredibly welcoming and kind, going above and beyond to make our stay comfortable. We were even greeted with a thoughtful gift of wine, which was such a lovely touch. The apartment was spotless, cozy, and exactly as described. I highly recommend staying here and would absolutely book again!

Heloiza was very polite and helpful, her apartment was homely and very well positioned with everything you needed for a short break,
lovely touches like a complimentary bottle of wine, tea & coffee were really appreciated.
Three flights of stairs got easier over the days. We really enjoyed our break and would recommend Heloiza's place

Heloiza's place was very nice - cute charm with nice decor, good space for a flat with full kitchen, washer/dryer and full bathroom. Welcomed with a free bottle of wine. Nice living room area and bed. Heloiza provided a full book of local recommendations which was very much appreciated. The stairs were steep and difficult to get suitcases up - but totally doable if able bodied. The street was loud at night with cars. etc but probably quieter than some other neighborhoods - would recommend sound machine if light sleeper. Would recommend this place for a visit to Lisbon!
Great apartment with prime location.
So stunning! We loved every minute here. Easy to walk to lots of great shops. Lots of lovely recommendations from Heloiza!
Definitely recommend staying here! Such a beautiful and spacious Airbnb. Also in the perfect location, with restaurants and shops easily walkable to.
Our stay was great!

This place has so much character.  I loved staying in such an old building.  The view was amazing, the location was very close to Alfama, the way the place was decorated was so thoughtful, and Heloiza's instruction were very thourough.  The washer machine was easy to use.  The one issue we experienced was that the hot water heater didnt always work, but it wasnt a huge deal for us.
perfect place thank you

The place looked even better than the pictures. It was easy to find and the bnb itself was clean, spacious, and had good vibe. Location was conveniently situated and the host has a nice booklet of recommendations for food and coffee. 10/10 would stay here again
Adorei a estadia no apartamento de Heloiza. Muito solícita, apartamento limpo e confortável, localização excelente!
Great location with the incredible views, the house is also beautiful.
We really enjoyed our stay, it was. a beautiful space, had the amenities we needed and was close to all the activities we had planned for our visit.

this space was everything we needed and more to explore. Lisbon, we were able to sleep and relax during the day and then explore during the night within the local area. plenty of walkable sites to see. this host is fabulous and I would recommend anybody coming to Lisbon to use this as a comfortable yet luxurious space. Views of the water and more

I had a lovely stay at this home and Heloiza made it easy to get inside. She provided clear instructions to get inside once we got there and gave some local recommendations as well. Once you climb some fairly precarious stairs, the room itself was lovely. The view and layout of the home is pretty and comfortable. She provided detergent for the washer as well, but had a clothes line for drying only. Within the home, there is not much space for appliances, but we were grateful for the washer and hung our clothes outside. The bathroom was nice and the bedroom was also gorgeous. I was walking distance to transportation and various sights and restaurants. Overall, I loved my stay and couldn’t be happier with the home.
Absolutely beautiful apartment!!! Excellent location and incredible view!

We loved our stay at Heloiza’s place.
She had provided really helpful instructions for the property, and a great recommendations and helpful tips (e.g. luggage storage) list.
She was very responsive and always happy to help.
And the location of the apartment was perfect for exploring the city.
Thank you again for a fantastic stay!

For a short holiday in Lisbon this was a great place, walkable to many restaurants and sights. Very safe city centre neighbourhood, supermarket about 2 minutes away. Not for those who are challenged by 3 flights of spiral stairs but the flat has a nice bedroom view of the city. The previous reviews mentioned city centre traffic noise but it is fairly quiet at night. Heloiza was a great host and stocked up really good coffee for the Nespresso and a fridge full of (reasonably priced) beer & colas.

Where do I start? This apartment is absolutely perfect. The location really cannot be beat - it's within walking distance to everything. The views from the bedroom will take your breath away. I think she forgot to mention you can see the ocean from your bed!
Aside from the apartment being beautiful, Heloiza added so many special touches like the softest bath robes and slippers to use and even making sure there was plenty of laundry detergent so I didn't waste money buying a lot for just 1 or 2 loads.
I work online and require strong consistent internet with zero interruptions and had no problems during my stay.
I am definitely coming back!

La estadía estuvo de lo mejor, muy cómodo el apartamento, con una excelente ubicación! Es importante tener en cuenta que hay varias escaleras tal y como se menciona en el anuncio. El apartamento es muy lindo, muy bien decorado y muy cómodo.Muy buena comunicación con Heloiza y nos dejó una botella de vino, que fue un gran detalle de su parte. Tuvimos una gran estadía
An amazing apartment with the perfect location - felt very lucky to wake up with a sea view each morning!

The apartment is in a wonderful location, close to interesting art, good food, and many historic sites.  Heloiza also added several personal touches, e.g., terry cloth robes and slippers. The downside of this experience was the need to climb 4 flights of stairs on a narrow winding staircase. This was difficult for me to maneuver with luggage and even more so in the dark. The hallway lights were on a timer that turned off more than once while I was in between floors.

Cute and comfortable apartment. Very good location and incredible view. Quiet neighbors. Good AC and responsive host. This apartment was perfect for us but may not be if you any difficulty climbing hills or stairs.
숙소 위치가 너무 좋았습니다. 중심가에 있어사 주변에 걸어서 갈만한 곳이 정말 많았습니다. 사진과 동일한 내부와 깨끗하게 정리된 숙소가 좋았습니다. 호스트가 매우 친절했어요. 단지 짐이 많으면 계단 오르내리기가 힘들순 있습니다.
bien ubicado, cómodo, con mucho por hacer alrededor.
Great stay! Good location, would stay again

Heloiza is a very responsive and kind host, she even treated us with a glass of wine during the check-in.
Would recommend.
Very centrally located! Heloiza was very nice and provided some great recommendations. Be prepared to carry luggage up some stairs! Overall had a great stay and would highly recommend!

Heloiza is an amazing host, she helped us through check-in and check-out and even when we locked ourselves out in the rain at night. She goes above and beyond and I would recommend her to anyone looking to stay in Lisbon. In terms of the place, it was a great spot, but of course that comes with a lot of noise at night, so if you want the location, be aware of that. Thanks again for a great stay.

Heloiza went above and beyond to welcome us to Lisboa and her home! She let us check in a little early to drop off our bags, she greeted us warmly and invited us to explore the plaza outside while she finished cleaning the apartment after the previous guest. When we came back our bags were moved to the bedroom, jackets we left over the chair were neatly hung and put away! Fresh wine and snacks were laid out for us as well! The location was perfect for exploring the city night or day! Cannot wait to come back!
I would recommend this place to anyone. It was a very nice apartment and Heloiza was very helpful and welcoming.
Great location; beautiful view; and amazing host! Couldn't ask for more...except maybe more time to enjoy!

Heloiza’s apartment is well situated in the heart of the city and not far from the airport. When my flight was delayed, she was flexible with the check in process and made herself available at an inconvenient hour. I greatly appreciated the thoughtful details and charm in the apartment. The street can be a tad noisy at times but it’s normal for being in the heart of a city. Overall, Heloiza is an incredibly warm, friendly host and I highly recommend this apartment for a visit to Lisbon. A+
Cute place, great location!
Un bel appartement bien situé pour visiter. Station de métro à 2 minutes de l'appartement et beaucoup d'ambiance dans le quartier.

Delightful host and great location to walk and explore lisbon. Be prepared for the steep stair case and travel lite. Can be noisey when hot and windows hv to be left open for ventilation at night. Recommened to stay.

The apartment is pretty much as Heloiza described. It looks just as the photos describe. The location is right in the middle of everything. Just a 10 minuet walk from the metro and close to the tram line. Restaurants and bars are close. Our only issues with the apartment are two. The apartment lacked the cleanliness that one would expect, and the noise. Helozia gives a warning about the noise but be aware that 3 out of 4 nights the parties continued till after 4:00am. We would not stay here again.

Heloiza was an absolutely wonderful hostess! She went out of her way to help us with transportation and gave us many recommendations for sights to see. Her apartment is in a perfect location and we felt right at home. My only complaint is that we couldn’t stay longer!
What a wonderful place! Great location ,hospitable host , flexible check in we loved it and would stay again. Thank you Heloiza
Heloiza est une hôte parfaite.  Souriante, gentille, pleine de bons conseils si vous en voulez. Elle vous accueille avec un joli sourire.  Nous avons passé un très bon moment chez Heloiza.

Great place to stay in a perfect location in Lisbon.  Yes, as others have said, being in such a central location it is a bit noisy at night and when hot the windows need to left open, but nothing that a lovely glass or two of wine and some earplugs can't deal with!   Lovely host too - thanks.

Great located right next to the castle, supermarkets, bars and restaurants and in the middle of so many beautiful houses with unique tilefacades.
We were very warmly welcomed at arrival. Everything was prepared for us. Sadly we only stayed one night.

Heloiza est une hôtesse parfaite. Souriante, gentille, pleine de bons conseils si vous en voulez. Elle vous accueille avec un grand sourire. Nous avons passé un très bon moment dans un endroit parfait. La chambre est charmante et proche du château, des supermarchés, des bars et des restaurants.
A refaire tout une semaine pour arriver à effleurer les endroits à visiter de Lisbonne.
Prévoir de bonnes chaussures et lever les yeux.
Ps : gardez des forces pour rentrer (3 étages)

Really nice apartment and perfectly located. Heloiza is a very friendly and helpful host. Would’ve stayed longer if possible and will come back to this flat for a stay in Lisbon. Definitely recommended!
Heloiza's place was awesome! Located within walking distance of most things you probably want to see. She gave us some tips and had some wine waiting for us. Highly recommended!

Heloiza was great and made herself available for check-ins and any follow up questions we had - the place is cheerful with great views out the windows and welcome fans for the bedroom (which, along with earplugs, made sleeping totally comfortable).  You're up a bit of a hill, so be aware if you aren't a big walker (good luck in Lisbon if you don't like stairs or inclines) - but you're also perched right on the seam between Baixa and the Alfama, the two coolest neighborhoods in central Lisbon and there's tons to do.  Expect fellow tourists to choke the best spots in high season, but it's a great basecamp for getting around the city and there is tons to do within a 10 minute walk.

Heloiza’s apartment is in a PERFECT location!! The bedroom overlooks a small square that has water views during the day time. We are a young couple and we’re experiencing Lisbon for the first time, and we couldn’t feel safer and more comfortable.
Heloiza even checked in with us throughout our stay to make sure we were having a good time. We’d recommend her and her home any day of the week!
Cozy and well located apartment.  Close to all amenities and touristy places. Just be prepare to climb 3 floors😁.

Super friendly and welcoming host!
Very central place but to noisy during the night.

We had a wonderful time staying at Heloiza’s place! The location was perfect, close to the metro for the ride to and from the airport and a short walk to more bars and restaurants than you could ever need. Heloiza was super helpful with tips and directions which helped to make our stay one we will not forget!

L’appartement est très bien situé, l’hôte est sympathique. Cependant, la propreté est à revoir dans cet appartement : le minimum n’était pas effectué, à savoir la poussière partout dans l’appartement, des cheveux dans le lit dés notre arrivée, les serviettes n’étaient pas non plus propres ( traces marrons sur les grandes serviettes...), traces de vin sur le meuble de la chambre ! Bref, les photos n’étaient pas révélatrices de notre nuit dans cet appartement ! Les nuisances sonores dûs aux pas des voisins du dessus ainsi que du trafic a rajouté une dernière couche bien désagréable !

Apartamento extremamente bem localizado. Heloiza é uma anfitriã exemplar.
O apartamento é limpo e completo. Apenas ressaltar o fato de que não há elevador no prédio (são 3 andares), porem este fato não é nada perto do que o apartamento proporciona. Recomendo e espero voltar!
Lovely view out of the tall windows. Thoughtful touches around the apartment. Great neighborhood to stay in.

O apartamento é simples, mas muito bem localizado e acolhedor. O ponto alto para nós foi o delicioso vento do Tejo que aliviou muito o extremo calor que fazia em Lisboa. Recomendo fortemente o espaço da Heloiza.
Sehr zentrale und schöne Unterkunft. Ich kann sie auf jeden Fall weiterempfehlen!

Appartement idéalement situé et hôte à l’air très sympathique et dispo si besoin. Un gros bémol pour la propreté et attention difficile voir impossible de se garer dans la rue, parking payant pas loin mais hors de prix.

The location is great. Walkable to all the neighborhoods that are must see areas. We were able to check in early so we didn’t need to store our luggage. Heloiza had suggestions of where to eat and a free tour.
Unfortunately, we happened to be there during a heat wave. No air conditioning and fans were not much help. We knew ahead of time that there would be some noise because it is the heart of the city, but she had reassured me that with ear plugs it wouldn’t be a problem. That was incorrect. It was not stop cars, trucks, motorcycles, and taxis all night long. Plus, tons of people walking and either talking or yelling loudly thorough out the night. One night 2 girls were physically fighting and screaming at 2 am. There is also a bar across the street that doesn’t close until 4am. Once it closes all the patrons mingle outside for a long time and cause a lot of noise. For my husband it was the heat. Me, the noise. The ear plugs offered no relief. Had only 2-3 hours of sleep each night. I come from a large city and expect some noise, but this was extreme. If the noise doesn’t bother you it is a great location and the view is great.

Este apartamento está muy bien situado en un lugar hermoso de Lisboa. No hay tantos bares como en otros barrios, pero está muy bien conectado con los puntos importantes que hay que ver,  la estación Rossio para moverse, la calle Augusta para comer pastelería, un supermercado grande muy cerca. Hay que subir un poco para llegar, como por todos lados, y los tres pisos por escalera no son aptos para todos los huéspedes. El apartamento mismo es encantador, las ventanas, la vista. Tiene todo lo necesario. Por supuesto que es una calle un poco ruidosa, pero menos de lo que esperábamos. Normal para una ciudad grande con calles angostas. Heloiza nos recibió a la hora indicada, de manera muy cordial, dándonos consejos y dejándonos un aperitivo de bienvenida. Si bien el apartamento había sido limpiado, se necesitaría ya una limpieza más profunda en el sector de la cocina (grasa) y del banio (sobre todo en la baniadera, restos de pasta de dientes, jabón y suciedad pegados en el porta-jabones, etc.). Suciedad también debajo de los muebles en las habitaciones. La ropa de cama había sido lavada y cambiada, pero los almohadones de decoración sobre la cama y el sofá, y la colcha sobre la cama, ya están gastados y con olor a viejo y sucio. Podrían cambiarse por otros más nuevos. Nada demasiado grave, recomendaría este apartamento, pero no se puede hablar de impecable. En definitiva, un lugar para recomendar a gente joven.

This place is close to everything that matters in Lisbon. The down side is that there's no park on the premisses or on street, but there is a paid parking lot within 500 metters from it. Super nice in every single way.
Nice and cozy place. Looks like the pictures. A little bit noisy due to a nightclub across the street. But the music stoped at around 10-11pm. Heloiza was a great host!
Very central location .Heloiza was a very welcoming host.Definitely recommend it!
Get place right in the heart of Lisbon. Quick responses from Heloiza, who let us check in early. I would definitely recommend this to anyone visiting Lisbon!
The place was really nice and as advertised. Great location and facilities, would definitely come again!
Good location, warm and friendly hosting.

Really nice cosy flat in alive neibourghood at Lisboa. Heloiza was really friendly! Only negative point: the Appartment is better for 2 persons, Because the third bed was too hard. Recommend the place!

This appartment was well furnished and conveniently located for sight-seeing. The 4 flights of spiral staircase was great for burning off calories from the famous Time Out Market- possibly the world's best food court! However, even the convenient location and splendid views cannot make up for all the noise coming from the bar and glass recycle bins directly below our bedroom window. Since there's no AC in the unit, there's no getting around sleeping with the windows wide open. After the bar noises ended around 4am, we were startled by the sound of broken glass at 6:30 am.  We initially thought someone was breaking out car windows down below until we realized it was the sound of broken bottle. A woman was tossing 5 of them slowly into the recycle bin. Although we loved this appartment for it's superb location and scenic views, the noise was beyond uncomfortable. No amount of earplugs will help. Would not recommend this place for light sleepers but highly recommend for bar crawlers and loud party animals.
Location is wonderful!

The view at night is amazing, as the listing shows. The apartment is the on the 3rd floor (lots of steep stairs) and is a bit cramped for 3 people. We weren't able to walk around a lot but is a ways from the water. Host was great for check in and communication.
Heloiza is a very nice host. I recommend 100%

Sehr charmante, individuelle Wohnung in super zentraler Lage. Heloiza ist eine tolle Vermieterin. Sie hat uns Tipps gegeben und den Transfer zum Flughafen organisiert..wir waren nur eine (wie beschrieben, noisy) Nacht da, aber das wussten wir ja. Es war eine tolle kurze Zeit in Lissabon- auf jeden Fall etwas für junge Leute...

Heloiza’s place was great! It was very spacious in regards to the kitchen, bathroom, living room, and bedroom. She even provided lots of shower soaps which was nice. The view from the bedroom was awesome of the Lisbon streets. It felt amazing with the windows open. Only con of the apartment is up 3 floors (a pain with heavy luggage) but other than that we loved it! We also loved Heloiza because she met us for check-in but BRIEFLY gave us tips and suggestions, rather than taking up a lot of time like other hosts I have had. I 100% recommend this place and would return!

Fantastic little place. Amazing location, nicely decorated and sufficiently equipped. Nice little touches for our arrival and a first class welcome experience. Is noted as somewhere we may we'll stay again in Lisbon. Recommended.

The Appartement is really nice and cozy! Heloiza was a great host and offered help in any situation.
It is very well-situated, so that you can walk everywhere in the center.

We absolutely loved our stay here. The apartment is extremely charming. So many windows a great view and many amenities.
Great place! Perfect location in the heart of Lisbon!

The ear plugs that the host provides Are useless against the noise which lasts till about 4am.  Then starts back up about 6am.  The flat is really cute to look at. However the futon couch is like sitting on a board and the bed itself is on the floor and not comfortable at all.

Heloiza was a wonderful host and provided us with a great place to stay. She was extremely accommodating with our check-in time and was always very fast in responding to messages.
We would recommend her to anyone visiting Lisbon!

Heloiza place is awesome. Just as pictured. Great location and awesome view..Right in the midst of lisbon. Close to everything. Great local places to eat and we just loved walking around and getting lost in the neighborhood! Heloiza allowed us to check in a little early and gave great tips as to where to eat! And we most certainly appreciated the glasses of wine she left for us. The view is awesome! Great way to truly immense yourself in Lisbon culture!

We loved Heloiza’s place! PERFECT location with an amazing view! It was a great way to end our stay in Portugal. Really cute and comfortable and easy to go explore Lisbon. This apartment is in a great location and very spacious. I would definitely consider staying here again:)

Heloiza's flat was the PERFECT spot for our stopover in Lisbon. Centrally located, right by the metro and all the major sights. The views from the flat were incredible!! The bedroom overlooks the hill with beautiful views of the traditional colorful buildings and the water. Heloiza takes extra care to add special touches to the flat and it was lovely. She even provided ear plugs for those who are not used to the city noise (we lived in Boston and did not find the flat to be loud at all). Would definitely stay again!

The apartment is on 3rd floor and stairs aren't the most comfortable one. But we've spent only one night there with two kids and it wasn't a big problem. The apartment is located close to the metro stations (Baixa-Chiado and Rossio), both about 3-5 minutes walking. There's everythin You need in the kitchen and bathroom. Heloiza was very helpful and flexible with our checking-in time and had some advices and suggestions what to do in Lisbon.
Great place in a perfect location. We would stay there again.
The place it’s ok. I would recommend it for the location.

Great location right in the middle of everything, and walking distance from the Alfalma and many of the main squares. Heloiza was very helpful as well, leaving tips for local places to check out. She also graciously provided wine and ear plugs -- though if you shut the windows the noise isn't too bad.
Made our first day in Lisbon magical
Schönes, kleines Appartement, mit allem ausgestattet was man braucht, an einer tollen Lage.

Heloiza is an amazing host! She let us drop our bags while she cleaned the flat. She gave us amazing recommendations and she was accurate with all of them. She even left us local port and a snack when we checked in.

Heloiza very welcoming host, as a couple visiting the city for the first time the location of the flat is outstanding, you could not be any more central if you tried! Fantastic weekend in Lisbon and would definitely visit again!
Thanks to Heloiza for welcoming us in her flat ! Everything was great ! Especially the localization. I recommand this flat.
Great location! Close to grocery store, shops, restaurants and transit.  3rd floor apartment with a nice view of a square below. A lovely flat with everything you need!
Well located and perfect for short trip. For your information, video camera shooting the main entrance.
Heloiza was a wonderful host and the flat was perfect! My friends and I had a great stay and loved how close the place was to everywhere else we wanted to go, walking distance and easy to navigate.

A great space for those looking to stay centrally in Lisbon. A fantastic apartment close to everything.  Heloiza added all the personal touches to make it really special. Every room is spacious and really clean. Highly recommend.
Heloiza est une hôte extrêmement disponible et sympathique. L'appartement est très bien situé et permet de profiter aisément de Lisbonne.

Great location, close to everything including groceries and local restaurants around the corner.  Need to be strong walker and stair climber- Lisbon is on the hills and not only one needs to go up hills to this location but also need to climb some stairs to the apartment.  The host is very responsive and friendly.  Will stay here again.

L’appartement est superbe. Super bien situé.

Merci à heloiza pour son accueil.

Functionnel

nice appart, good location, Heloiza is very kind!

Ubicación increíble! Lugar increíble con una vista inmejorable. Heloiza es una super host y nos dejó vino y chips de bienvenida. Sus recomendaciones y contactos fueron geniales y su lugar es muy espacioso y limpio. Recomendado! Totalmente volveríamos!

Amazing AirBNB experience with Heloiza. I was staying in Lisboa for a layover. Heloiza allowed for an early check in and gave plenty of recommendations for things to do during my short stay. I would highly recommend!
Cozy place. Heloiza is very friendly and polite. She shared a lot helpful information.

We had a great time in Heloiza’s apartment. It’s centrally located and near to lots of amenities. Heloiza allowed us to check in early which was great, and gave us some top tips to do in Lisbon.

Notre séjour chez Heloiza s'est très bien déroulé, l'appartement est idéalement situé proche de toute commodités. Heloiza nous a très bien accueillies, elle a un grand sens de l'hospitalité. Je recommande fortement!

Merci encore!

Appartement très bien situé.
Joliment décoré.
Hôte très sympathique
Great place to stay if you visit Lisbon. Clean, central and Heloiza was a very welcoming host. Definitely recommended

Heloiza was a fantastic host. She met us in person during check in and explained everything about the flat, giving us good tips for Lisbon. Communication with Heloiza was great too. Logement situé dans le cœur de Lisbonne, non loin de la place Figueira. À proximité des commerces, idéalement placé pour découvrir Lisbonne de jour comme de nuit. We had an excellent stay in a weekend at Heloiza's place and she gave us lot of tips. Location is great to explore lisbon. She is an excellent host. I would highly recommend this place.

This place is a must if you are visiting Lisbon!  Heloiza goes out of her way to make sure the stay will be the best it can be - from her tips about where to visit to her post-it notes pointing out hidden switches in the bathroom - no small detail is left out. Lovely apt, very central location, clean, great amenities

문제가 있을 때 메세지 하면 바로 응답이 오고 해결해주세요.

This apartment is very very well located. At 3 min walking from the Castle and 10 min walking from Placa Luis de Camoes. It was also very clean and Heloiza was very nice at our arrival, explaining us everything useful.

Impecable y bien ubicado, cerca de una peatonal llena de bares y negocios. Sin duda, volvere!

Très bon accueil d'Heloiza, appartement correspondant aux phots et à a description, plein centre. Transports à proximité.
Je recommande vivement cet appartement !
Awesome AirBnB experience! Definitely worth a stay if you’re visiting Lisbon.

We really enjoyed our two nights in Lisbon staying at Heloiza’s airbnb. The place was very accurate and was very spacious for two of us. Heloiza was a really friendly host and responded to all our needs. I would recommend highly if you’re looking for a place to stay in Lisbon!

We had a really nice time in Lisbon! Heloiza’s flat is perfectly located. You are close to the city centre, restaurants, metro and bus stations and you can reach every attraction quickly. Heloiza is a super kind host and person. She gave us some good ideas for a nice stay in Lisbon. We lacked nothing.

The place is really nice and cosy! I instantly felt like home. It is perfectly located as well. Close to all the main things and a few steps away from the only big supermarket in the whole area!! Una casa pequeña, modesta, pero limpia y muy bien ubicada. Estábamos al lado de todo. Y la dueña respondía al momento. Muy recomendable.
Great host and great location

Heloiza gave us a wonderful reception for our first visit to Portugal.
