Heloiza is very communicative and helpful. Apartment location is very convenient.
One of the best air b&b’s I’ve stayed in. Great location and super cute. Lots of charm and Loved this apartment

This apartment is very well located for central Lisbon and travel beyond. The description is accurate and whilst it may be a bit noisy sometimes, it didn't bother us at all. Heloiza is very friendly and helpful and was always available to ask questions. We have no hesitation recommending this place - it is very convenient for a city break.

L'appartamento è molto ben situato, luminoso e confortevole. La zona è ben servita da mezzi di trasporto e ci sono diversi posti interessanti in zona, dove mangiare qualcosa o bere un bicchiere. Consigliato!
O apartamento  está muito bem localizado, é  muito  limpo e organizado. A anfitriã  é muito  simpática  e atenciosa. Gostei muito e se tiver oportunidade,  voltarei a me hospedar lá.

Heloiza is such a great host. Awesome communication and great attention to details at her place. The location is very close to many restaurants and historic sites. Very clean and comfortable. Thanks Heloiza for a fantastic stay.
Heloiza was a great host with an appartment at a great location! We enjoyed our stay a lot!
thanks for hosting us!

I loved this apartment. Heloiza is a great host. This home was clean and comfortable, she had a bottle of wine, coffee for me and had a list of recommendations on restaurants and places to go. This apartment is close to everything so walking around was no problem. I highly recommend this Airbnb.
Great spot, love Lisbon.
Mooi appartmenent midden in het oude centrum van Lissabon. Heloiza is gastvrij en geeft bij aankomst leuke tips. Ik zou het appartement zeker aanraden om te boeken!
We had a great stay at Heloizas flat. Its well located in the centre. The communication with Heloiza was very friendly. I would recommend this appartment 100%

L'appartement est idéalement situé pour visiter Lisbonne, charmant, propre, le quartier est sûr et accessible en taxi, avec des commerces à 2 pas. Nous avons passé un agréable séjour. Heloiza a été une hôte parfaite et très disponible. Un grand merci à elle et son superbe appartement.
Good, clean, centrally located place. 5-10 minutes walking distance to everyware.  Really small and noisy during a night.

The flat was perfectly situated and was very suitable for our stay in lisbon.
There is a 3 floor staircase - just to be prepared if guests have a lot of luggage.
Heloiza was a wonderful hostess to help us.

Her house is cozy. We really enjoyed her house. Location is perfect. You can go to supermarket in 3 min.
She is really kind. When we arrived at her house earlier, she readily did earlier check-in.
Thank you very much

The place is just perfect! Its in the middle of the old lisbon with an amazing view. Really easy to walk to the Resto, bars and stores. Heloiza is so nice and really flexible.. We had problem with our flights and she waited for us until we get there(12 hours later) and kept our luggages past the time we were suppose to leave to let us go rent a car ! I will go back anytime ❤️ thank you very much
Vanessa et Etienne from Canada 🇨🇦
Logement très bien situé pour visiter Lisbonne. À pied de S.Jorge.

Heloiza was an amazing host, and her flat was perfect for the three of us. We were in Lisbon for a week, and enjoyed how close the flat was to everything. It was clean, had everything we needed (and also a bottle of wine!), and Heloiza met us at 2:00am when we arrived! We would highly recommend this place for anyone who wants to see the city and enjoy their time there. Thank you Heloiza!

Appartement sympa. Heloiza est très intentionnée.
Seul bémol, le bruit des voisins (bruit de pas...) et la clef de l'immeuble qui fonctionne difficilement.
We had a great stay. Very central place. Perfect host. During the night it is a bit noisy.
Very central and great view.
L'appartement d'heloiza est idéal pour un séjour à Lisbonne. Excellent accueil et conseils. À recommander!

Very clean and modern apartment in the center of town. Close to many sights, restaurants, and shops. Heloiza was an excellent host and helped us navigate the city and made excellent recommendations. Would definitely recommend her place!!!
Exelente anfitrión, muy buena persona, un lugar muy centrico y acogedor, recomendada al 100%
The flat is lovely!!! Great localisation, accomodation and hospitality of Helioza. Strong recomendation!!

Avec 2 amies, nous sommes restées une semaine dans l'appartement d'Heloiza et nous avons adoré! Heloiza était accueillante et toujours joignable, même si l'appartement est un peu étroit pour 3, cela ne nous a pas déranger et la situation de l'appartement était absolument idéale! Je recommande vivement ce super appart!
Lovely place, lovely host! High building... :)

Thank you so much Heloiza - your place was great and exactly as you described. We really enjoyed being so central and the views from the windows were fantastic. We did the free chill out walking tour that you'd suggested and it was great! Nice to have your recommendations to start off. And the bottle of wine was very thoughtful! If you're a light sleeper you'll want ear plugs as this location isn't really quiet on weekends (or wasn't while we were there anyway).
Thanks again - we really had a great time! I would highly recommend to my friends.

Heloiza est une hôte très sympathique et communicative.
Le quartier est bruyant mais pas grave si vous passez plus de temps à vous balader et puis fenêtres fermées et ventilateurs allumés ça le fait très bien.
3 étages à monter pour accéder au logement, pour nous c'est largement faisable mais pas pour tout le monde.
Les petites attentions comme le jeu de fléchettes, les cartes de transports ainsi que les nécessaire de toilette c'est un super plus pour le séjour! Merci à heloiza !
N'hésitez pas !
Heloíza made us feel very welcome as we arrived. The flat was really nice and the area really central. I will strongly recommend to stay here. It was easy to communicate with Heloíza.

Beautiful place in beautiful Lisboa. If you're looking for a place and come across this airbnb i wouldnt hesitate to take it. Very central and the view is awesome from the apartment. Also lots of windows and natural light was a plus.
Apartment in the historic center, a typical Lisbon house. Very hospitable Heloiza. Many attractions in walking distance. We really enjoyed. All photos are the same as in the ad. Thank you so much!)
Great host
Very nice appartment with everything needed. The area is perfect, close to the center and thl castel but noisy and pretty hot in summer.

Amazing apartment with nice views, also the sea. Heloiza was a very kind host and gergeous person. She was always there to help and she will become a Superhost very soon. I recommend this place to all users. Our stay was unforgettable.
Gracias Heloiza!

Inês, António, and their family are lovely hosts! They are friendly, helpful and greeted us with warm hearts. Special thanks to their children, who helped us with check-in and taught us how to use the doors.
The apartment itself is fabulous, clean and spacious for three people. With all the historical decor, it’s cozy and cute. The location is amazing: close to the metro station, the seaside, and a food market, and within walking distance of several main tourist sites.
You need to take some steep stairs to get to the apartment, but it did not bother us that much. If you have a healthy physical, I highly recommend it! I will definitely book this place again if I come back to Lisbon!
El alojamiento muy bien, no apto para gente que tiene miedo a las escaleras, son de madera y estan bastante inclinadas. El alojamiento muy bonito. Y la zona muy centrica.

Inez daughter Leonora was there to greet us having  waited over an hour to let us in as my phone went dead and couldn’t contact us. She was still there waiting smiling and very welcoming and extremely helpful. The place was lovely and homely and a great location. Certainly would recommend it .

Great place to stay in Lisbon! We stayed with the 4 of us and loved the place. It's very cozy, clean and in great location with amazing restaurants around :) The communication was great and very clear!

Die Wohnung ist perfekt geeignet für einen Aufenthalt in Lissabon. Viele Sehenswürdigkeiten sind gut zu Fuß erreichbar.
Die Kommunikation mit dem Vermieter war immer problemlos und sehr freundlich.
Wir können die Wohnung sehr empfehlen.

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour dans ce très bel appartement décoré avec goût et très bien équipé ainsi que idéalement placé pour découvrir la ville. Les instructions étaient très claires. Pour finir Ines et Antonio ont eu une délicate attention en nous mettant à disposition de quoi petit-déjeuner à notre arrivée. Nous conseillons +++
Excelente ubicación, muy céntrico, puedes hacer el recorrido caminando, lo recomiendo, gracias Inés y Antonio por su hospitalidad

Appartement atypique (tout comme son entrée :D), très propre, décoré avec beaucoup de goût, bonne literie, en plein centre de Lisbonne mais au calme, proche du métro, c'était parfait !
Un peu sportif de monter les étages, surtout avec des bagages ou après une journée de visites mais c'était sans surprise, car bien mentionné dans l'annonce.
Un peu frais également, la climatisation réversible avait du mal à réchauffer les pièces mais il y avait des chauffage à bain d'huile en appoint, de bons plaids et une couette en plume très cooconing.
Dans l'ensemble, donc, très belle expérience !

We had a great few days exploring Lisbon from our base at Ines & Antonio's place. The apartment was exactly as described, comfortable and well equipped. They proactively provided detailed instructions and made themselves available - we had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. Fresh bread was a lovely touch!
The location is so central: in the old centre, near to lots of sights, and all forms of transport are on the doorstep: metro, bus, tram, train, ferry.

We spent nearly a week here and loved it. The apartment had everything we needed and the location was ideal—walkable and close to all the main sights. But what really made our stay special were Ines and Antonio. Our flight was delayed and we arrived in Lisbon very late, and they were so kind and helpful.
Good central location, very nice hosts, clean apartment

El alojamiento es encantador. Está cuidado y tal como se anuncia. En pleno centro, buen sitio y perfectamente conectado.
Único punto a tener en cuenta son las escaleras, pero esta claramente indicado en la oferta y el propietario también lo indica en las comunicaciones.

Great location walkable to restaurants, Time Out Food Hall, Water Front and other local sights. Definitely in center of night life if you like to drink and be social. No noise from night life in apartment for a good sleep. Beds were comfortable and living space warm for socializing over Tea and coffee.  Would stay again

Lovely Airbnb! Very homely and clean, everything you could want they thought about. Only caution is that there are a lot of stairs to get to the property, not a problem for us but may be for other people!
Ines and Antonio were great hosts. The neighbourhood is beautiful and so is the flat.

We had a wonderful stay in Lisbon thanks to Ines and Antonio. The apartment is even more beautiful than the photos and perfectly located for exploring the city, with easy access to train stations, metro stops, and nearby attractions. Ines and Antonio are exceptionally welcoming and experienced hosts who went out of their way to make sure we had everything we needed—they even left us fresh bread, butter, jam, and fruit to enjoy. Their recommendations for food and activities were spot on, and we loved reading the guest book with messages from visitors over more than ten years of their hosting. It was clear how many memorable stays their apartment and hospitality have shaped, and it felt special to be part of that tradition. If (or rather, when) we return to Lisbon, we know exactly where we will stay!

We had a great stay here. The location is great for getting out and seeing the town. Ines and Antonio were very responsive and gave great instructions.
Dean

Die Wohnung hat uns sehr gut gefallen. Bilder und Beschreibung haben exakt zugetroffen.
Die Betten waren bequem, die Dusche gut und es war alles da, was wir brauchten. Die Wohnung wurde liebevoll restauriert und dekoriert.
Dadurch entstand eine sehr schöne Atmosphäre.
Wir fanden die Lage sehr gut, das meiste war zu Fuß gut zu erreichen.
Über die Treppe ist schon einiges geschrieben, es stimmt, man muss sich schon etwas anstrengen, aber wer Lissabon besucht, der weiß, dass er einige Steigungen überwinden muss....
Für uns ist die Wohnung eine sehr gute Empfehlung, wir würden sofort wieder buchen !
We had a great stay, such a cute place & we walked everywhere from the location! The hosts were super great at communication and tips beforehand as well.

Lovely apartment, spotless clean, very very comfortable bed and great quality linen. The host was super friendly, helpful and approachable. The location was in the heart of the old town, walkable with a lot of restaurants. Highly recommended!

Highly recommend! Location is unbeatable, walking distance to everywhere. Apartment is very clean, has everything you need. Host communicates very well and give clear instructions. Definitely will be back for our next trip to Lisbon

Wir hatten einen wunderschönen Aufenthalt bei Ines & Antonio! Die Wohnung ist perfekt gelegen im Herzen Lissabons und super zu erreichen.
Die Wohnung ist Wunderschön und weißt so einige Besonderheiten auf. Der Kontakt zu den beiden Hosts war auch tadellos.
Ich würde jederzeit wieder zu den beiden in diese besondere Wohnung.

Was a perfect little place, right near a lot of public transportation and good food! We had two young kids and the hosts set up the second bedroom perfectly for them. They were very responsive and friendly.

Ganz zauberhaftes Apartment in einer perfekten Lage. Die Gastgeber sind absolute Profis und es fiel uns sehr leicht, wohl zu fühlen. Auch die Lage ist absolut perfekt. Man ist ganz schnell am Wasser und im Herzen der Stadt. Ein rundum perfekter Aufenthalt. Vielen lieben Dank und hoffentlich bis bald.
Everything was good. Beautiful place, old and nice! Cozy and warm.

Appartement charmant!!!
The airbnb aesthetic was 🔥. Hidden behind a mysterious door in a souvenir shop was a series of steep steps leading to a relaxation oasis. Clean and cute with central AC. 10/10
Hôtes très réactifs et accomodants.
Idealement situé, un peu bruyant le week end.

Inês and António’s apartment was nothing short of amazing. The unit is centrally located with lots of restaurants, attractions, and public transportation options nearby. As listed, it’s a fourth floor walk-up but the views of the water from above are worth it. While the unit does it hot in the summer, they have AC and were quickly accommodating to our request for fans. They also provided numerous recommendations for luggage storage, sites to see, and best routes to and from the airport. In short, this listing and Inês and António as hosts are a great option to consider if you’re visiting Lisbon!

We loved Ines & Antonio's place.  It's very unique given its on the top floor, and it's in a great location but still very private because of the unique entrance.  Yes there are stairs, but they were very clear about that so no surprises!

Place was clean. I wouldn’t go back to the neighborhood. Maybe not that listing because I have a knee injury. The. Four flights up should be in the fourth front. In case there are people with such injuries mobility can be an issue, but other than that everything was up to Park sufficient for my family of three right around the corner from pink Street is important to note busy area, lively great food

We had a fantastic stay at the White House! The apartment was spotless, thoughtfully equipped, and incredibly comfortable. The bed was cozy, the shower had strong pressure with plenty of hot water, and the air conditioner kept the main room perfectly cool while fans in the bedrooms ensured a good night’s sleep.
Yes, there are some stairs to climb, but they weren’t a problem for us at all—and the location absolutely makes it worth it. We could walk to great spots for breakfast, lunch, and dinner, and easily access everything the city has to offer.
The hosts were outstanding—friendly, responsive, and truly went above and beyond. When we ran out of laundry detergent, they delivered more to our door in under five minutes. That kind of service is rare and very appreciated.
If you’re lucky enough to find this place available for your dates, don’t hesitate—book it. Highly recommended

Ein wundervoller Aufenthalt!
Die Lage der Unterkunft ist absolut top – alles ist fußläufig erreichbar, was unseren Aufenthalt besonders angenehm gemacht hat. Die Wohnung selbst war toll eingerichtet, sehr sauber und gemütlich – man fühlt sich direkt wohl. Besonders hervorheben möchte ich die schnelle und freundliche Kommunikation mit dem Gastgeber – alles verlief reibungslos. Es war wirklich eine tolle Erfahrung, und ich würde jederzeit wiederkommen. Vielen Dank!
The apartment was really cute. Those stairs were killer at first but it got easier and it was worth it for the cute place that was quiet despite being right in the center of everything.

We had a wonderful stay here.  The location is perfect for exploring all that Lisbon has to offer.  We walked everywhere.  Restaurants and bakery right next door!  Excellent communication with our hosts and would highly recommend.!  We are already starting to plan a return trip and hope to stay here again.

Biggest issue most people may need to be aware is that it’s on the 4th floor with about 86 steps up. No elevator. We knew that from the description & were fine with it. We just had small carry on luggages and backpacks. Anything bigger & heavier will definitely be more trickier. Honestly, the space you get is worth the 86 steps. The 3 of us were so happy not to be on top of each other. There’s enough storage/drawers/hangers if you don’t want to live out of your luggage. The towels provided are bath towels so they are massive! It’s not a hotel so hot water may run out quickly so plan showers accordingly. There is a bar downstairs that could get really noisy so earbuds are a great idea for light sleepers, and a bakery but we only got to have coffee and freshly squeezed orange juice. Have freshly squeezed orange juice whenever you can bec Portugal oranges are the best! Only other thing is ask ahead how to use the washer bec we didn’t find instructions. Such a lovely comfortable stay!

We stayed basically only for the night, less than 24 hours, since we arrived late at night and had to leave in the morning, but for the purpose and duration of our visit, it was perfect - centrally located, walking distance to everything we wanted to see and experience. The place was clean, looked like in the pictures. It is an old house with wooden floors and nice wooden furniture, which I liked. We knew about the stairs and didn't mind that at all. :-) After all, this is part of the experience. The host was kind enough to help with our suitcase and check us in despite the late hour we arrived. Communication was detailed and easy to follow. Keep in mind that the area is home to some bars and night clubs, so if you are a light sleeper and there over the weekend, it might be a bit noisy at night. We stayed during the week and the bar downstairs didn't last until too late so it was alright :-) Of course, it all depends on your travel purpose :-)

This is a great place and we’d definitely stay again when in Lisbon! Hosts were communicative and instructions were clear - very cozy and clean. And a great location! I would recommend to anyone looking for a great spot in a lovely neighborhood. Thanks!

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour chez Inês & António à l'occasion d'un long week-end à Lisbonne. L'appartement correspond parfaitement à la description de l'annonce, c'est effectivement au 4ème étage mais cela ne nous a pas dérangé. Nous avons séjourné avec nos 2 enfants de 8 et 10 ans et l'appartement était très pratique pour nous, la machine à laver et le lave-vaisselle ont été bien appréciables!
La communication s'est très bien passée avec Inês & António, les instructions très claires pour l'arrivée et leur fille Leonor nous a donné plein de recommandations aux alentours. Bref, c'était très bien!

Couldn't imagine a better stay. Beautiful furniture and design, comfortable beds with clean linens, fresh and simple breakfast supplies, great location, but most importantly... wonderful hosts that made us feel at home.
We happened to be in Lisbon for the blackout in Portugal and despite the uncertainty we felt safe and as though we were with family. Ines and her family welcomed us in to process the news, drink coffee, and get to know each other. We'd love to come again to visit. Highly recommend!

OMG we had the most fabulous stay in Lisbon, our hosts Ines & Antonio were the best hosts the apartment had everything you needed and it is so gorgeous with so much history and in the best area to get everywhere,
We received such accurate and thoughtful communication from our hosts they explain everything to you before checkin,
The apartment is on the 4th floor but we didn’t mind at all as it’s worth staying there because it’s such a great apartment,
You know you are staying at a fabulous Airbnb when the host communicates so well with information about getting from the train stayion or airport etc and as a extra bonus leaves milk , butter , fruit and beautiful fresh rolls in the apartment upon your arrival !
Honestly this apartment and hosts are the best we have experienced on air bnb thank you so much Ines & Antonio,
We highly recommend the apartment you will not regret it at all it’s your own little home in Lisbon , so close to fabulous restaurants and public transport.

Was für ein Juwel von einer Wohnung! So charmant und liebevoll eingerichtet, so viele süße Details. Diese Wohnung ist wie eine Schatzkiste.
Man ist superzentral, die Tipps (siehe Fotos) von Inês und Antonio sind klasse, wir haben alles ausprobiert!!👍🏻
Wir werden auf jeden Fall wiederkommen!
Bei unserer Ankunft waren wir etwas zu früh und Inês und ihre Familie waren so freundlich, so dass wir schon unsere Koffer unterstellen konnten. Am Tag unserer Abfahrt war Inês so lieb, uns ein Taxi vor die Haustür zu bestellen.
Wer Lissabon erleben möchte, dem empfehlen wir aus ganzem Herzen diese Unterkunft. Wir waren mit unseren Söhnen (12&14) da und sie waren glücklich über ihr eigenes Zimmer…
Vielen Dank, liebe Inês und lieber Antonio!🌞

דירה בעליית גג, מעוצבת מדהים. מרגישים בבית. הכל נקי ומסודר. לינור פגשה אותנו הייתה לבבית והמליצה לנו על מסעדות באזור - המחלצות מעולות.
היה מעולה- תודה רבה!

We loved staying at Ines and Antonio’s apartment. I especially loved to cotton olio cases which were very luxurious. We cooked one evening and everything we needed was provided in the kitchen. We loved how you had access through a secret door off the street. Do yourself a favor and book.
Ines and Antonio’s daughter Leonor was so friendly and gave us some great recommendations, for places to visit and eat.
We had a lovely stay at this place! Clean, great location, and friendly hosts!
Apartamento muy central, iluminado, acogedor, es un cuarto piso sin ascensor, por lo demas perfecto para 2 personas
Great place with responsive hosts. I would stay here again!

Great place! It worked well for us as everything was in and around the area. Great for first time visitors. The host was very helpul and had the house set up ready for us with some fresh bread butter and milk that made our tired evening a lot better. Will love to come back again. Be sure to checkout the recommendations from the host. It was some of the best food we had at Lisbon.

We enjoyed our visit to Lisbon and couldn’t have been happier about the location of our stay. The accommodations were very comfortable and clean! As shared, there are steps to climb, but this allowed us to enjoy extra pastries and not be concerned about gaining too much weight while vacationing.

Can’t recommend this apartment enough. The location is excellent, close to so many attractions, great restaurants, and a major train, metro, and ferry station. The hosts are friendly, welcoming, and responsive. The apartment itself is beautifully decorated, very very clean, spacious, and very comfortable. I have stayed in two of their apartments, and both were excellent five out of five star properties. Highly recommended.

This  apartment was a centrally located and in a walkable neighbourhood . The hosts greeted us, showed us around the apartment, were helpful with local recommendations and were friendly. The apartment was thoughtfully prepared for guests with everything that we needed to be comfortable. Windows are double glazed (good for sound and temperature control). Grocery shopping is nearby as are restaurants.

This place is great for location. Since it is very central. If you have a lot of luggage please beware! There are a lot of stairs! The only thing we would recommend is to use your phone when going up and down since they are not well lit and stairs are steep. We are from NYC and used to stairs and walking so we were relatively ok. The host was kind to help us with our carry ons but just beware if you have bigger luggage. The second room had a mattress on the floor. I did not appreciate that for the price you pay. Also the fact that I found a bug crawling on the bed in the second room. I had cancelled another location thinking if we paid more I would have a better experience. But unfortunately I did not sleep in the bed since seeing the bug crawling on it. Overall like I said you are paying for a centralized location. We stayed here one night. The hosts are very kind and helpful. If you get past the stairs and mattress on floor then you are good to go.

We loved our stay at the White House. The apartment is in a great location. It’s beautifully appointed with comfortable furniture, cozy features and very comfortable beds. Excellent kitchen and bathroom, with everything we need, so close to all the action in Lisbon including the river, the ferry port, the train station Rossio Square, Chiado,  the famous Time Out market plenty of bars on Pink Street, restaurants, bakery downstairs. We did lots of walking and exploring from this fantastic location and the communication from the hosts was fantastic. They were always helpful always willing to answer questions. We did a walking tour. We also did a driving tour out to Sintra, Cascais, Pena Castle and also back to the Cape de Roca. We were only there for five days but would love to have stayed longer. We will certainly be back. We love Lisbon and we love the White House.Thanks!!

10000% recommended to stay at Inês's & Antonio's place❤️
Apartment is serene, stylish and somehow immediately feels homey. Probably because it was originally created for friends and family:)
(That's also what you feel from the hosts, a more personal, warm approach).
Everything you need is there, thoughtfully designed, placed, cleaned and maintained.
The location is perfect: super close to the sea, the city center, a supermarket, bakeries, restaurants... But because of how quiet it is up in the apartment, you don't even realise you are in the middle of "action".
Pay attention to the fact that it is 4th floor, and after walking up and down the hills of Lisbon you would also need to walk up the stairs. We didn't mind and entering the apartment felt like a nice reward after a workout:)
Separate thank you to Leonor for the clear, fast and sweet communication.
We'll be more than glad to come back.

Great apartment, great location, great hosts. My next time in Lisabon will for sure be here. And if you wanna go somewhere all the other turist doesn’t go, like a secret Chinese restaurant, ask Leonor. Her recommendations are a gem
Great apartment with nice & responsive hosts. Flexible check In/check out with luggage storage available. Amazing area of Lisbon to stay in!

Ines & Antonio’s place was ideal for our trip. We were over in Lisbon to watch the football: Sportin Lisbon. The location of property was ideal for all our needs. Great amenities all close by.
The communication prior to visit was excellent and we were afforded a very warm welcome when we arrived at the property.
The property was as shown in pictures and matched the description. We were a party of two adults and two teenage boys. We thoroughly enjoyed our three night stay and wouldn’t hesitate to use this property &locatuon again if available for a return to Lisbon.

We loved our stay at the White House! It was central to everything and had exactly what we needed for our stay. The hosts were welcoming, helpful, and, always answered any questions we had during our visit. They went above and beyond to make our trip to Lisbon amazing! We would definitely stay here again in a heartbeat.

Fomos recebidos pela Leonor, filha da Inês. Bastante gentil e nos ajudou a subir com as malas. Ao chegarmos, tinha leite e pão fresco. Um cuidado a mais.
O apartamento é muito bem localizado, muito limpo e organizado. Para chegar ao quarto andar, são muitas escadas. Então, se você tem malas pesadas ou mobilidade reduzida, precisar ter atenção. Mas isso já estava no anúncio.

This was the perfect place for us (two ladies) as a base to explore Lisbon. The kitchen has all that is needed to cook (although we always ate out) or make breakfast (there is a bakery next door), and the hosts even put some butter, jam, fruit and milk in the fridge for us plus some bread rolls on the counter. The flat was very clean. We felt very safe at all times, the area was perfect to explore Lisbon. Since it is a busy area, it was great that the flat is right at the top of the building, so it was quiet enough to sleep, even on a Friday night (the steps are good exercise😉).
Thank you again to Henrique, the family’s son, who welcomed us, even though we arrived late in the evening, and gave us some good tips about restaurants etc.

A wonderful stay, location was great, easy to locate!
The instructions for checkin were exceptionally clear and the host was up-front about how to check-in as location to checkin was different than you might expect. Host was also upfront about the stairs - there are many and no elevator. Be prepared to take breaks if you have bags.
There’s a metro station right by the stop though as well as Lisbon’s Pink street! Great good - wonderful waterviews from the Airbnb.
Just an all around wonderful stay with nothing negative to say.

fueron muy amables y siempre bien con la comunicación.
El apartamento está muy bien ubicado y es limpio y acogedor.
gracias por compartir vuestra casa

Henrique fue una persona amable siempre dispuesto a apoyar y en que nos sintiéramos
Cómodos, un lugar ideal para estancias cortas y largas y muy cerca de todo.

Çok nazik kibarlardı. Bizi oğulları Henrique çok kibar şekilde karşıladı hatta bahsettikleri büyük merdivenlerde bavul taşımamıza bile yardım etti. Ev harika konumda her yere yakın çok merkezi. Tertemiz bir ev bizi karşıladı hatta taze ekmek yağ bal elma bile hazırdı. Harika bir deneyimdi. Herşey için teşekkürler Henrique ayrıca teşekkür ederiz.
Very kind hosts! Excellent location!
Loved this Airbnb, the location was great and the unit was as beautiful as the pictures. Hosts were very sweet and communicative as well

Thank you for the fresh bread and butter and milk in the fridge
Fresh apples were very nice as well, that paid for the walk up our suitcases up the stairs.

We stayed here for the last night of our trip to Portugal. We enjoyed how close it was to restaurants and to the water. The apartment is beautiful and we appreciated that it has 2 bedrooms.
Hosts were communicative and clear about how to receive the room key. There was a parking garage close by for our rental car.
Thank you!

Los anfitriones nos recibieron con manzana, pan, leche, manteca,mermelada, café y agua fria. El departamento es fiel anuncio. Limpio y en muy buen estado. Es importante tener en cuenta los 4 pisos por escalera tal cual se informa. Muy buena ubicación. Panaderia al lado muy recomendable para desayunar. Pasamos unos días hermosos en Lisboa.

The apartment was comfortable and the master bed was great. The twin beds on the floor were also comfy. Great shower. The neighborhood was wonderful, with a lovely bakery downstairs that we visited almost every day. Fantastic location close to the water and the pedestrian street, and a two-minute walk from the Time Out Market. There are a lot of stairs and no elevator, which is fine for exercise but not suitable for people with mobility difficulties. The hosts are very responsive and communicative with many local suggestions. We would happily stay here again!
Very clean and tidy. The place was described exactly as the listing. Also in a great location and very accessible to public transit. I would recommend!
Had a great stay in the amazing city of lisbon. Spotlessly clean and really welcoming. Would definitely recommend 🤩

very enjoyable stay in a great location, walking distance to everything you need
Great communication with the hosts, even though they were not around at the time of our check in, it was super easy to get inside and he host made a point of introducing herself shortly after in person
would definately recommend this stay and would definately return

We loved the apartment and were so impressed with the little touches like leaving us fresh bread, butter, jam, fruit and coffee. The location was perfect for exploring Lisbon, both on foot and by tram/metro/bus as there's a station a couple of minutes away. The view of the river was a real bonus. The hosts were super-responsive and gave us very clear and helpful information (so we were fully prepared for the stairs!) Great value and highly recommended.
Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt in der Unterkunft. Die Gastgeber sind sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Die Wohnung befindet sich an einer guten Lage um Lissabon zu Fuss zu erkunden.
Loved the place!

Inês& António szállása egyenesen fantasztikus volt! Szuper helyen, közel mindenhez, nagyon jó tömegközlekedéssel de mégis egy viszonylag csendes utcában, és a lakás már tényleg csendes helyen van kilátással a folyóra. Rendezett, tiszta, jól átgondolt lakás, jól felszerelve. Az ágy és főleg az ágynemű igazán fantasztikus volt. A házigazdák proaktívan gyorsan kommunikálnak.
Csak ajánlani tudjuk!
The hosting were always responsive and willing to help any way they can. we would definitely stay here again!

We arrived to fresh bread from the bakery downstairs and a tour of the apartment by Leonor. It was a fourth floor walk up with very steep steps, but the way to get in felt like we were in a magical fairytale apartment. We honestly didn’t stay long enough to spend much time at the apartment but the location was prime! We were right next to Pink Street, public transportation, and the ocean. It was a great place for our family of 4.

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour chez Inès et Antonio. L appartement est très bien situé proche du Tage, du centre ville de Lisbonne que l on a parcouru à pied et de la gare pour des excursions à Belem et Cascais. L intérieur était très confortable et très bien rénové avec tous les équipements  nécessaires pour passer une bonne semaine à 4. Inès et ses enfants sont très sympathiques et ont été très réactifs pour tous les échanges. Nous avons apprécié le pain frais, le beurre et la confiture à notre arrivée ainsi que la possibilité de laisser nos bagages après le check out. Nous reviendrons avec plaisir.
Incredible Airbnb that’s beautifully decorated, lots of room, close to everything in town, friendly and responsive host!

The BEST location in Lisbon. Easily walkable to everything and yet very quite. beautiful view of the water, very authentic feel, entering through the souvenir shop is a very cool twist! The bakery downstairs is a must try, so delicious. The 92 stairs are easy to overlook when everything else is so perfect. We will be back and we are telling everyone we know!
This is a great place if you want to be in the center of tourist activity.

Inês & António’s place is an excellent place to stay. We (2 adults, 2 young teenagers) had a change in travel plans and found this charming apartment at the last minute (i.e., arriving within 24 hours), but our hosts, Inês, António and Leonor, were very responsive to all of our questions and provided excellent details including where to park (difficult in Lisbon!), how to find the location, and what to expect. We also arrived quite late in the evening, but we were nevertheless greeted at the door with a smile and wonderful hospitality. It is my regret that we could not stay longer!
The apartment is extremely comfortable and clean, and it has fantastic character too. Its location is very central to many of the beautiful sites. As is stated in listing, the apartment is on the 4th floor and there stairs to climb. Lisbon is also very hilly, so you should expect to do a lot of walking on your trip!
I highly recommend this place: fantastic hosts and a great place to stay!

We LOVED our ‘White House’ Airbnb & our gracious & friendly hosts. The location was perfect (close to metro & trains… & the gorgeous waterfront) & we even enjoyed the exercise walking up the 91 steps to the apartment. We also appreciated the air conditioning & the fact that myself & my 2 girlfriends had our own beds. Our hosts left us fresh bread from the local bakery & apples in the refrigerator. We also loved the Nespresso machine! Thank you so much for a wonderful stay! K, L & V ! Highly recommended… esp if you enjoy some extra exercise!😉😍
Very good place
Ines and Antonio 's place was exactly as described.  The beds were comfortable and the location was outstanding.

Inés was impressively responsive, hospitable and courteous during my stay. The location is fantastic. I have stayed in Lisbon quite a few times and this location is absolutely perfect. Clean accommodations and very comfortable.
I highly recommend!!!

Inês and António were wonderful hosts; very responsive and friendly. It was very nice to have fresh bread, butter and jam there for us. The kitchen has everything you need and air conditioning works well. The location is very central and close to the metro, trains and easy to walk to many areas of Lisboa.
When Inês and António say that the apartment is on the 4th floor and a long walk up, it is very true. Take your time up and pack light since it is 103 steps from the front door to the apartment on the 4th floor.
The apartment is lovely with beautiful views.

Great experience. Quiet despite being right off Pink Street. Fun night life. The only issue is carrying luggage upstairs. It’s quite an endeavor but there is no getting around it. All good. I recommend.

We had a very nice stay in Lisbon. Leonor , Ines & Antonio were very helpful and their place met all our needs. We  loved the historical wood  features in the living room and the very sweet welcoming fresh bread from a neighboring bakery . It was close to many restaurants, stores and metro/train station making it  easy to navigate to the many sightseeing all over the neighborhoods. We would definitely stay at the White House again  if we have the opportunity to visit again.

Fantastic place in a Super convenient location of Lisbon.
Beautiful view and cosy apartment.
The host was fantastic!

First, communication with Ines and her family was outstanding. All our questions were answered quickly, they checked in on us, and we were provided great directions for check-in and use of the house.
The place itself is cool. Unique. Homey. Historic. Feels private even though you're in the thick of Lisbon life. The decor is a mix of old world with a modern flare. The couch is comfortable and the wall/ceiling let in plenty of light, There is some night-time noise, but with the windows shut it wasn't an issue. AC works well. Shower has good pressure and temp control. The second bedroom has the option of one or two floor mattresses, which were great for our kids. The kitchen is fully equipped. The stairs up to the place are definitely a hike, but we liked the exercise!
The location is awesome. Walk outside your door and you're in the middle of restaurants, pubs, tourist activities, and minutes from castles, cathedrals, and the water. I highly recommend this place! Thanks Ines!
Great location! Had everything you could need for a good trip.
great location, flexible and responsive hosts !! Lots of steps but it's good exercise! Cute and quaint spot!!
Tolle Wohnung im Zentrum von Lissabon, super mit Nahverkehr zu erreichen und als Ausgangspunkt für Unternehmungen….

Ines & Antonio were phenomenal hosts and the communication was top notch. I arrived prior to my friends due to some travel changes, which were quite stressful, but they were so accommodating and understanding.
The apartment was SO cozy and exactly like the photos. We could not have asked for a better location either - there were so many places to eat and go to within walking distance.
Next time we are in Lisbon, we won’t need to search for a place to stay because we loved staying in Ines & Antonio’s Airbnb. We cannot say enough good things about them as hosts and their space.

My sister and I had the pleasure of staying at this incredible airbnb while traveling to Lisbon for her birthday. The apartment was immaculate and we immediately felt at home upon arrival. The hosts and their entire family went above and beyond to make our stay special and comfortable. The place was very safe and in the best location. We could easily walk everywhere. We had an amazing trip and plan on coming back to visit and staying here again. I would recommend this place to anyone wanting to visit Lisbon and live like a local. I truly can’t say enough good things about this incredible place and amazing city.

Such a fun place in the heart of Lisbon. It was our first time to Lisbon and the hosts made it super easy for us and answered all of our questions timely. We lived the uniqueness of the location. It was fun to enter through the souvenir shop. What a fun surprise. We loved it!  Thank you Ines and Antonio!!
Amazing place, location, and even better hosts!
Perfect stay in the center of Lisbon, easy to reach everything and very cosy place to stay with wonderful hosts!

This place is great, clean easy to find and with everything you need.
Plus the hosts are very kind and friendly, giving all the information for your stay.
Recommend
Great location!

What a beautiful stay we had!!!! Communication exceeded all expectations and their children were so welcoming on arrival. The apartment was so cozy and homey, felt like we were stay in with family. Location was top-notch, the place was very clean, beds were comfy, they had AC, and even left us a loaf of bread! However, my favorite part was the little special details throughout the apartment from other guests that they incorporated 💛 would recommend this place to everyone!! The stairs are quite a bit but we had a laugh about it each time and it made the experience all the more authentic!! Do not hesitate to stay here!! I will definitely rebook here for my next time in Portugal, and would love to spend some more time with the hosts!!

Great location, close the water, metro & train station. All walkable!
Really appreciated to find milk for coffee in the fridge and the loaf of bread was delicious!

The apartment was exactly as advertised. Great location, great communication. The hosts sent a very large message with exactly how to get there, how to handle check-in and how to make the stay as good as possible. Overall, great spot to stay.

We visited Lisboa for five days in early April - and would have loved to stay longer.
Communication with Inês & Antonio was easy, very friendly and quick - we were provided with answers to all our questions and requests right from the start.
The appartment‘s location is a dream - an old town house in walking distance to the station and metro Cais do Sodré, in the heart of the city but within 150m to the river Tejo and a huge number of both local and international restaurants and bars. Right next door is a lovely bakery with very nice owners and tasty pastries. You can‘t possibly get a more „original“ Lisbon feeling.
We felt very safe and well taken care of right from the start, got excellent directions and hints about what to do and where to go.
The appartment is on the top floor under the roof, it is lovingly renovated and tastefully furnished. All we needed (and much more) was available.
We will be back on another occasion.
excellent

great location. great host. we were able to leave bags before and after, that was immensely helpful. pay heed to the warning about stairs. pack light. they have chairs on every floor so you can take a break walking up. I loved how they communicated precisely and clearly.

5 🌟  all the way.  I can't express how fortunate my family and I were to stay at I&A's place.  It's a hidden gem located in a great and convenient area. close to metro,tram,busses and various Cafe n restaurants. The place was clean and spotless upon check in and had all the items and amenities my family and I needed for our stay. Yes the main entrance is through a gift shop but we found that to be unique and beneficial as we did our souvenir shopping when we checked out.  the host was super responsive and accommodating. When our flight landed at 8am  I contacted the host to see if it was possible to check in early as I was traveling with my 3 year old n 6 month old. Not only did they help us out with early check in they also provided a pack n play for the baby.  all in all we enjoyed our stay and having I&A as hosts, we will definitely be returning and staying here again in the future.   A+ host

Il soggiorno è stato molto piacevole, la casa aveva tutto ciò di cui avevamo bisogno. Posizione veramente ottima per spostarsi. Molto apprezzata la colazione che ci hanno fatto trovare. Ci torneremo sicuramente.
Great location and very friendly host!
Very nice place in Lisbon, right next to Pink Street. Very friendly and helpful hosts.
Excellent location

Recomendo fortemente ficar no apartamento. Estava muito limpo e bem localizado. O check in foi fácil e rápido. Gostamos bastante que deixaram tudo arrumado e a cozinha era equipada. Obrigada e com certeza voltarei

estava tudo impecável,  limpo e arrumado, tem tudo o que é preciso e tudo como no anuncio. o henrique, filho dos anfitriões,  foi quemnis recebeu,  foi muito atencioso e explicou tudo muito bem,  de uma simpatia e gosto de bem receber louvaveis, certamente repetirei a estadia

这是我们第一次选择爱彼迎预定房间，也是我们第一次来里斯本。我们抵达之后，一切都如此顺利，如此完美。首先，我们抵达酒店时，是早上9点半，但是房东竟然给我们办理入住，这太惊喜了。因为我们还带了两个孩子。所以对此非常感谢。其次，是房东非常非常友好，帮我们把很重的两个行李箱，拿到了四楼房间。退房的时候是早上六点，还是帮我们把行李拿下楼，让我们感受到非常温暖。然后，是房间的位置非常好，在一个广场的旁边，也有著名的粉红街，房子是四楼的阁楼，通过阁楼的窗户就可以看到海，有两个房间，客厅面积因为有柱子稍微有点遮挡，不过这都没有关系。因为房子有点年代了，所以卫生间多少有点味道和发霉，我们快速通风，很快就得到了解决，不过这都不影响我们对这个房子的喜爱。对了，晚上楼下的牛排店传来的味道，对于需要减肥的人，真的是一个考验。总之，这个房子真的强烈推荐。如果你也来里斯本，可以来这里亲身体验，再次推荐！
Great location, nice place
Right downtown and friendly hosts!
Ines & Antonio were very responsive and accommodating of a late check out. The place has a lot of charm and a great location!

We had a great time in this apartment. Familiar,comfy and perfectly located. Ines, Antonio and their Children were superb hosts. 10/10 recommended.
Thanks for having us
Sascha and Patrick

Really Cute place. Had everything you need.  Very clean. Great attention to detail. Personalized it and got us a crib. Close to lots of places. Lots of stairs so be prepared! the host helped us with out bags, which was very helpful!
Amazing spot, great walking distance to a lot of great places and very detailed oriented hosts!

A great place to stay. Lisbon is an expensive area, so a stylish and comfortable place is not that easy to find. Inez and  Antonio's place is reasonably priced for the area then centrally located so it's a good deal for the money.

Ines & Antonio are great hosts; they are very responsive and help as much as possible to make sure your stay is comfortable. Their son even helped us with the luggage while checking in which was very sweat. If you’d like to stay somewhere in Cais do Sodre neighbourhood, I definitely recommend their place.
The place was as described, neat and easily accessible to the various parts of the city and transport. Would recommend it!
It was a fantastic time. Unfortunately the weather wasn’t  good but who cares while having a beautiful place to live. I&A gave us a perfect hospitality, thanks to both ;-)))
Great spot by everything we wanted to be. Responsive hosts with great recommendations!
Great place, will use it again when in Lisbon !

My family loved staying in this lovely apartment right in the center of lisbon! The location was perfect, close to all the key landmarks and the beautiful waterfront. The interior of the apartment was nicely decorated with all of the modern amenities and beautiful traditional elements. The apartment was very comfortable for my family of 5. The hosts were incredibly accommodating and helpful. When a difficult situation came up, they helped right away! I cannot recommend this apartment enough for anybody looking to visit Lisbon and I hope to stay there again!

The photos and apt description were deceiving. The second room could barely fit an adult, it was just a mattress on the floor. The rooms were warm and did not have AC. The staircase was narrow and going up was worse than I imagined. This was not worth $300 per night

L appartement est très bien conçu et magnifiquement meublé .
L emplacement est idéal et les hôtes charmants .

Perfect place. Right in the hub of everything but somehow the noise doesn’t travel to the rooms for sleeping. Walk to everything, train station and waterfront meters from the home. I have sleep issues and somehow had the best sleeps in this home I’ve had in years.
The apartment was exactly as described. Great location!

This is a lovely penthouse apartment located right in the middle of Lisbon's Cais do Sodré neighbourhood.  The property was immaculately clean, well equipped, and very cute.  Check in was a breeze and the hosts were very responsive throughout.  Access to the property is via four flights of stairs, so those with accessibility concerns may want to look elsewhere.  Otherwise, your heart will thank you for the workout:)  Highly recommended.

Our stay at Inês & António’s was amazing. We couldn’t have asked for better accommodations - or better hosts - during our stay in Lisbon. Their apartment is welcoming and comfortable. It’s location made it easy to find food and fun while also being able to walk or take a taxi to other neighborhoods. 10/10!
Had a great time in Lisbon and enjoyed our stay with Ines & António! The airbnb was in a prime location where we could explore the city and enjoy our stay.
Ein wunderschönes Appartement, großartige Lage und absolut hilfsbereite und liebenswürdige Gastgeber!
Awesome place! Great stay - nice personal touches!

We paid a premium to stay here because our flight was landing late and they offered late check in as well as the waterfront location. We had as requested sent our flight information and let them know when we left the airport. When we arrived no one answered the bell. The exterior door was unlocked so we went in to knock on his apartment door and the door of our unit. No one answered either and our messages through the airbnb system were unanswered. Finally airbnb was able to reach him and we got in. The exterior does not inspire confidence that it is the correct location and we were very concerned.
The apartment is very cute with a wonderful use of the limited space. Very well decorated as pictured and clean. We found the beds comfortable and the ac worked well. The water view is out a garret window which you have to be careful not to hit your head.
We found the neighborhood fine, close to metro. Would be perfect for those wanting night life. Very active late at night.
Location was excellent.  The beds were not ideal.

The apartment was cutely decorated and very cozy. We had everything we needed and ines and Antonio were very quick with responses. We had a power outage and ines got back to us pretty quickly and helped us to solve our problem.

Ines & Antonio are great guests. Beautiful apartment in the heart of Lisbon. They went above and beyond our expectations. Very clean and great amenities. Ton of things to do around the apartment with great restaurants and nightlife.

Check-in/out was super easy. You could not ask for a better location, easily walkable to top sights (Commerce Sq, Pink St, Time Out Market, night life). The bathroom was great, towels soft and fluffy. Very quiet. As stated in posting if you have mobility issues this is not the rental for you due to the stairs and no lift, not an issue for us.

It is a central location by the river, trains and restaurants. However note that this apartment is on the 4th floors with steep stairs (however, host was kind enough to take suitcases up and down though), undisclosed noisy construction across the apartment so cannot sleep in the morning, side view of river when looking out of window (versus a river and beach view as in listing photos), noisy creaking floors, old building, cramped shower, second bedroom has mats on floor (not beds). Overall not a pleasant stay and would not recommend it - especially for the prices being charged due to good location.

Great location with tons of things to do and see at walking distance.
Ines and Antonio were very responsive and flexible - they are local and can offer lots of advice in addition to the material they have at the apartment.
Fantastic experience to live like a local for a few days. Looking forward to returning soon!

Estancia fantástica! El apartamento esta ubicado en una de las mejores zonas de Lisboa que te permite ir a todas partes caminando pero también al lado del metro ( muy recomendable para ir al aeropuerto), tranvía y ferrys ( para cruzar al otro lado del rio dónde se encuentra el restaurante Ponto final, uno de mis favoritos! )
El espacio esta inmaculado limpio y equipado, con el encanto de estar en un edificio tradicional pero tranquilo.
No tuvimos oportunidad de conocer personalmente a Ines y Antonio, pero son unos anfitriones excepcionales y con sus indicaciones y mensajes hacen que el proceso de check in - out sea sencillo y nos sintamos como en casa desde el momento que pusimos un pie en el apartamento.
Recomiendo este alojamiento en Lisboa 100% y espero volver a alojarme aquí en un futuro.
Die Wohnung war sehr angenehm und hochwertig eingerichtet. Besonders haben wir uns über den kleinen Frühstückskorb gefreut.

The apartment has the best location, right in the middle of everything, super close to bars, restaurants, but very quiet at the same time.
The place itself is not very big, but was enough for 3 adults (4 adults would be a stretch in my opinion, as the second room is small, has low attic roof and on floor mattresses).
Place has a nice and thoughtful decoration and generally well looked after, but it’s an apartment in a historical/old building, so some limitations are expected. We struggle with the bathroom, as it was difficult not to make a flood, based on the shower head and curtain set up.
Overall the place was satisfactory for the short stay.
Very nice apartment an excellent location but still very quiet. The hosts left us some things for breakfast which was super convenient. Communication with them was perfect. Recommended
Magical location with clean and tidy place. Many small but caring considerations 👍
we certainly loved staying here.  wonderful atmospheric flat in the centre of town.

The accommodation was magical.
Everything is designed well in not only cozy but also fun way. I enjoyed to find playful thing around the room such as a box called ‘challenge box’.
This experience started from getting a message from the owner. The message was also written to stimulate adventure spirit with useful information.
The location was also great, easy access to both Belém and the center of Lisbon. I found many good restaurants around here.
I definitely recommend you to stay here in Lisbon. Here was one of the best places I found in Lisbon.

What a perfect location to stay in Lisbon and excellent hosts. I loved the unit for myself on a week stay in Lisbon and didn’t have any issues with noise despite how close it was to some amazing restaurants and bars. The hosts were always friendly and responsive with great resources.
Just be prepared for a lot of steps up and down each day but well worth the effort.
I will be returning here for sure.
lovely flat, great location

This was a great place to stay, centrally located in Lisbon. The apartment and building is super cool, you can really feel the history of the place and the small details and decorations of the interior of the apartment make it really feel like home. I would recommend this place to anyone looking for a nice place to stay in Lisbon. There are a bunch of stairs to get to the apartment, but it is a great work out :)

This was the perfect place for our stay in Lisbon. There were so many places to eat, visit, or just explore. The apartment was very comfy and cute, we felt at home. Ines  and Antonio were so helpful, leaving coffee and snacks when we arrived from our travels.

We had a truly wonderful stay in Ines and Antonio’s apartment. They did their utmost to ensure we were met with keys and that our entry to the apartment was ok despite our delay due to flights. There were some provisions for us in the kitchen and fridge for which we were hugely grateful especially as we had arrived so late in the evening. The apartment is charming, quiet and clean; ideal for exploring the main attractions of Lisbon. We highly recommend a stay here.

Great location-great thoughtful items like fresh bread, jam, coffee and info on what to do. Best suited for one couple, 2nd bedroom has 2 twin mattresses on floor so hard on our 60+ bodies.  The 4 floors up was hard but we did adapt. Perfect location for seeing Lisbon, felt safe, and thoughtful hosts was a big plus

This was an incredible stay for us in Lisbon. The location was fantastic and unbeatable, the apartment was sparkling and comfortable! Ines and Antonio are lovely hosts, we recommend any one to book this apartment you will not regret it.

This is such a charming spot from which to explore Lisbon. This location is fantastic and right in the center of most tourist attractions.
Inês and Antonio are wonderfully welcoming and helpful hosts. They offered so many useful suggestions. The place was spotless and well provisioned. We had a wonderful time and can't recommend it highly enough!
A perfect beautiful place in the best location possible. A@I are so nice and generous, left us coffee and treats, were available all the time and always charming. Best air bnb ever!!

A lovely stay in Lisbon. A charming, spotlessly clean apartment with a view over the tile rooftops to the river. The apartment is really well located, minutes from the Cais de Sodre train station with a commuter train to Estoril and Cascais, bike rentals for the riverfront path to Belem, Commerce Square with its impressive arch and monument, many patios and endless options for a cruise on the river and access to the Rua Augusta high street, Largo de Camões with its excellent walking tours and an easy walk to Rossio Square to catch the train to Sintra or tram 28 for a unique Lisbon experience! We were able to drop our bags before check-in which allowed us to start to explore right away. Our hosts very thoughtfully left the most delicious fresh bread, butter, jam and a bowl of apples as a much appreciated welcome. They communicated thoroughly and timely - including about the stairs to the apartment which will burn off those famous pastéis de Belém/Nada. The communication was exceptional and made our experience so enjoyable from the outset! We knew exactly where to go and what to expect.

The apartment was as described, clean, spacious, has AC, comfortable bedding. The hosts were responsive. The location is perfect to get around the city. The walk up to the fourth floor, which I believe would be eighth in the states, was a bit tough at times after a long day, but if you're up for the challenge, this apartment is perfect.
Fabulous location, great communication, and a wonderful stay.
Antonio and Inês’ apartment is great. Good location just around the corner from the pink street (but still quiet), time out market, and more. It’s clean and well kept, check in was smooth.

We really enjoyed our stay. We got even bread, butter, jam and apples to get started. Great location but still quite. We received many useful tips.
Can only recommend this nice appartement
5 stars. We enjoyed our stay and everything as we expected.
Very clean apartment, Great communication with lots of information. Kept us fit with the stairs.  Thank you for hosting us!

Great place! Very cute with great views! Also had everything we needed. Hosts were very thoughtful in prepping our stay, from the space itself to the recommendations of the area. Would stay again without hesitation.

Great location in the Centre of Lisbon. Hosts were accommodating and the apartment has everything you need. Just a warning for people traveling with heavy bags the stairs are a challenge 4 floors up but so worth the beautiful views over Lisbon.

First time in Portugal and it was perfect. The apartment was in an incredible location - I really don’t think you can beat it. We were also extremely impressed with the amenities and the actual apartment itself. It is always the little details :) The hosts were very friendly and available throughout the stay. I can’t wait to visit again!

Inês and António are the best of the best when it comes to Airbnb hosts. I can say so because I’ve now stayed in two of their listings! Their attention to detail in making our stay go as smoothly as possible—from arrival all the way through our departure—is second to none! Throughout both of my stays, I had zero complaints and only positive experiences. The apartment we stayed in was perfect. Clean, spacious, and welcoming! Not to mention the housewarming gifts they left us upon our arrival. What else? The location! Absolutely perfect. Central to everything, and an easy walk from the train station (which is especially critical when you’re hauling luggage). I would—and, i hope, will!—stay at this apartment again in the future. And you should too!!!
We could not have asked for a better place to stay in Lisbon. Prime location, great accommodations, and the kindest and most responsive hosts we've had. Do not hesitate to stay here!
Really well located apartment, with impeccable aircon and very cutely and exhaustively appointed. Easy to communicate with, would recommend.

Wonderful home and location, Ines and Antonio were extremely helpful and lovely, everything was clean with a lot of beautiful touches and gifts, highly recommended if you want a prime location that is clean, cozy, and provides excellent value for money.

This is a great location to be in the heart of it all. We stayed during July and it was hot!! Even with the weather the walk up was not too bad and the apartment is so centrally located to everything that it’s a great place to come back to, to relax and cool down before going back out.
The check in process was super easy and Ines & Antonio were very quick to respond prior to check in with any questions that I had.
Would definitely recommend this spot for anyone looking for a long weekend in Lisbon that gives them the opportunity to get out see and experience as much of the city as they can.

This was a great conveniently located spot for good value. As noted and as is typical of Lisbon apartments it’s a long walk up the stairs each time, but I enjoyed it in giving me a bit of workout. Inês & António were very kind and left us some wine, bread rolls, and a chilled water bottle upon arrival. Nice touch that feels all too uncommon with Airbnbs these days. One note: The one bedroom had a small single mattress on the floor and the other had a larger bed. There’s a single AC unit in the main living room and a floor fan for each bedroom. Though you’ll need to leave the bedroom doors open to keep them cool when the temp is over 30.
Great stay close to everything

Beautiful rooftop and water views make the climb so worth it. The apartment is lovely … beautifully designed, comfortable beds with quality linens, well-appointed kitchen. It was such a nice surprise to have ripe apricots and apples, rolls with butter and jam, coffee, tea, milk. I felt at home in this amazing city thanks to Ines and Antonio.

Great location for the price. Located near everything. Steps away from pink street, the timeout market, and a couple minutes to the city center. If you’re young and want to experience the most has to offer, this is the perfect place

Very centrally located apartment for visiting Lisbon. As advertised, the unit is on the fifth floor of a building. Well equipped and beds were comfy. Be aware that the neighborhood is the nightlife area of the city. There’s a fair amount of noise for sleepers facing the street. Main bedroom however is better secluded.

Inês & António’s place is a brief walk from the Metro station.  Close proximity to restaurants, bars, the market, Pink Street and many more.  We could easily spend a month in Lisbon and still not see/do everything.   Communication with them was quick, efficient and easy.

The apartment is perfectly located to explore Lisbon, as it is absolutely in the city center, surrounded by cafes and bars! The apartment is lovely equipped and has a great size for 3-4 people. However, as it is under the roof, it gets pretty hot (in June). So you have to sleep with open windows, which means that you hear all the noises from the streets & people in the bars. (no aircon, but fans!)
We anyways enjoyed our at the flat and would recommend it !

Super cozy and unique apartment! Highly recommended. Right in the city center, everything is easily accessible :)
Ines and Antonio are lovely hosts, they go above and beyond to make your stay the best it can be :)

The BEST location + cleanliness + fast wifi + great hot water pressure + amazing communication = 5 STARS
*as many have noted, it's a fourth floor walkup but it didn't bother me as I needed to burn off all the pasteis de nata

A convenient location with lots of character from which to explore Lisbon’s lively waterfront area. The hosts were also speedy and thorough with their communications and generous with helpful recommendations and information. Would stay here again!

Inês and Antonio were very helpful and communicative! The apartment was in an amazing location and was very well equipped for all your needs. The beds were comfortable, and the the rooms had character. Definitely get their recommendations on the area! Thanks again for having us!

We absolutely loved the apartment of Ines&Antonio. It was the perfect place to enjoy our time in wonderful Lisbon. Communication before and during our stay was always fast and easy. They thought of every little detail in the apartment and even got us a little welcome gift to start the day! The location of the apartment is perfect to explore Lisbon. We would definitely recommend this apartment and love to come back some time !

Very central location and hosts provided detailed instructions for all aspects of the process, making it easy to check in, etc. As the description states, it’s several flights up so be aware of that when you book! We also had a car from driving south in our trip and there was a paid parking deck extremely close by - super convenient for us!

Nous avons passé un merveilleux séjour entre ami(e) s dans cet appartement très bien situé dans le centre historique de Lisbonne. Ines et Antonio étaient d excellents hôtes et nous avons beaucoup apprécié séjourner chez eux. Nous recommendons vivement ce logement très bien conçu pour une famille ou passer un bon moment entre amis. Nous y reviendrons avec grand plaisir...

Inês and António have a great apt with a very large living room. It is very centrally located. Not for anyone who fears stairs, as it is a trip up, but by the end we'd gotten used to it. They left us a little snack and coffee, which was much appreciated!

O apartamento é ótimo, exatamente como descrito no anúncio. Apesar de não ter ar condicionado, não fez calor a noite. E apesar das ruas estarem muito movimentadas, nenhum barulho nos incomodou (mesmo com janelas abertas). O anfitrião é muito simpático e atencioso. Entretanto, de maneira geral, acreditamos que o custo-benefício não foi tão bom, mas talvez por que reservamos muito próximo à viagem.
Very convenient location!

Had a great stay here. Fantastic location, very clean. Excellent base to explore Lisbon.
There are a lot steps but the apartment is worth it!
Great place to explore the city, very close to public transportation!

L’appartement d’Ines et Antonio est très agréable, bien équipé et idéalement situé.
La communication est très facile.
Je recommande chaleureusement

L'appart de Ines et Antonio
Ines and Antonio's apartment is simply GORGEOUS! Under the roof, you will be delighted to climb the stairs and find a haven of peace and beauty to welcome you. You feel cocooned and want to curl up with books, writing, drawings or reveries: ideal after a day in Lisbon!
We arrived late but Ines was there, so everything was easy; communication and everything else.
Ines and Antonio have a special touch and made us find fresh bread and jam which was really helpful as we were leaving early the next day!
We can only recommend this place and will definitely come back!

Heel leuk appartement op een toplocatie, nabij openbaar vervoer en op loopafstand van veel bezienswaardigheden in Lissabon. Dichtbij allerlei leuke restaurants en bars. Appartement is ruim, netjes, schoon en goed uitgerust. Communicatie met de eigenaren verloopt soepel en vlot.

Geweldig plek om Lissabon te ontdekken! Vlakbij het metro station en een paar minuten van de binnenstad.
Mooi appartement; leuke ontvangst met brood etc!
Aanrader ! De 4 trappen naar het appartement passen prima in het dalen en klimmen in Lissabon

Incredible apartment, super clean, super well designed and in a perfect location.
Perfect communication with the host 👌🏻
Extremely recommended!

Nuestra estancia en la casa de Inés y Antonio fue magnífica. La ubicación es perfecta, está cerca del río y de los barrios más bonitos, pero hay tranquilidad y no se escuchan ruidos de la calle. Inés estuvo siempre disponible para resolver cualquier duda. Perfecto para pasar un fin de semana en Lisboa.

Ines and Antonio have such a wonderful place and it is in such an amazing location. You are close to the train station and there are so many fun places to explore when you leave the front door. The place is bright and beautiful and you have everything you need to  make a meal if you want to have a night in.

This was a perfect place for our visit in Lisbon. We were walking distance to everything, the appartement was clean and had all the amenities for us to be comfortable. They even left us breakfast food! I also loved all the travel guides and guests suggestions for places to see. Thank you!

One of the most unique and beautiful air bnbs I’ve gotten the privilege to stay in! Ines and Antonio were very communicative and lovely, warm hosts. Lots of great recommendations for places to see and restaurants as well!

Appartement propre.
les hôtes nous ont bien transmis les informations en amont.
l'appartement se trouvant au 4ème étage, vous allé faire de l'exercice.
seul point négatif le bruit des unités extérieures des climatiseurs de l'immeuble voisin dans la grande chambre.

We had a brilliant time at Inês and António’s place. It is ideally located, right next to a central metro station and walking distance to pretty much anywhere. Also about 3 mins from famous Time Out market. The apartment feels like authentic Lisbon- very high up - the stairs helped us burn off all the pastéis de nata! very spacious at the top with great exposed beams. Comms were great. Would recommend!

We had a wonderful visit to Lisbon at Inês & António’s beautiful home. Great location, well appointed apartment, gracious and hospitable hosts who were so sweet and very helpful. Would love to visit again, what an excellent experience. Highly recommend!

What a nice Place! Beautiful Apartment with excellent connections and lots of Bars / Restaurants / Sights easily to reach. The communication with Ines was uncomplicated at all times and we will definitely come back. Thank you so much Ines & Antonio!
This Airbnb was a gem. Well-priced, great location, nice view of the water and very kind and hospitable hosts! Would highly recommend and will stay here again if we are back in the area!
Great place, superb location, responsive hosts! Nothing else we could ask for :)

A wonderful place to stay in the heart of Lisbon. Communication was easy, quick and thorough and Inês and António were great hosts. The apartment is really spacious and has all the amenities you need for a comfortable stay in the city. We hope to return one day in the future.

Oh how we really wanted to love this apartment. But, there were things that we just couldn’t overlook. There were pros and cons staying here.
Pros:
1. It was easy to walk to a lot of
sights and restaurants.
2. The hosts had put in the apartment...milk, bread, butter, fruit...which was a nice touch.
Cons:
1. We knew that there were stairs ( 4 flights is what the information said on Airbnb) but that is not the case. It is 10 flights of stairs.
2. When we checked into the apartment there is a strong damp/mildew smell, that never went away even after having the windows open the whole trip.
3. The apartment is next to a bar and a restaurant. Which is convenient for a drink.....but the 4 nights we were at apartment....there were anywhere from 20 to 30 drunk men singing sport/ football songs in the sidewalk and street in front of the apartment. And this went on until 2:00 in the morning!! And each morning the sidewalk and street is totally trash with beer bottles.( it does get cleaned up later on in the day.)
4. The mattress in the master bedroom is so hard you can barley sleep in it.
Like I said before, we were really excited to stay here, I thought the pictures looked really cute.
We still had an amazing time in Lisbon.🇵🇹
a great place to stay when visiting Lisbon. friendly hosts and perfect location.
Located right in the middle of the city perfect walking distance to multiple restaurants lots to see and do!
Fantastic location, couldn’t get any better. Close to the sea, shops and bars/restaurants. Excellent communication and welcome, thank you again.

Ines and Antonio's apartment is a lovely base for seeing the sights of Lisbon. It is an extremely well designed living space on the top floor of the building with great views over the river and bridge. It is very well located and has access to all transport modes. I highly recommend Ines and Antonio's apartment. Tony

It is an awesome appartement, located right in the centre of Lisbon. You dont need a car to explore the city. You can do everything by foot or you take an bolt/uber. The communication was great. We definitely recommend this appartement!

Wonderful flat, full of beautiful details, great location the heart of Lisboa, amazing view on the river, warm welcome with bread and jam (like in the old time, when airbnb was actually a b&b) and one of the more peculiar entrance to a house I have ever seen. Thanks Ines&Antonio

We had a wonderful stay in this beautiful airbnb. The flat is spacious and lovely with everything a guest needs. From the living room window you can see the sea and the bedroom was quiet so we slept great!
The location is perfect, you can walk everywhere though the metro is just 2 min away.
10 / 10 would definetly go there again and I recommend Inês and António as hosts! Super kind, easy to communicate with and super quick in sending tips or responses.
If you are in Lissabon you will love it at their Appartement!

Amazing apartment. Better than in the pictures. The host is super attentive and responsive. I’ve stayed a lot of places in Lisbon and Ines’ and Antonio’s place is my absolute favorite. It’s at a perfect location and as it’s on the top floor you’re not bothered by the sounds of the street which is typical for many other Lisbon apartments.
Super lovely apartment, very cozy. Great hosts, also we really appreciated the little things. Coffee, bread, fruit basket etc. everything was taken care of. Good location. Would definitely recommend!

We greatly enjoyed our stay, and the only regret is that we didn’t stay longer! It is a place with character, from every detail - the books, the design, the guestbook with suggestions from other guests, the room with a view of the river, and there are more! Can’t recommend enough.

Very sweet, cozy flat for max. 4 people. Located in a central area, top location. If you want to discover Lisbon on foot or with excellent public transport access, this is a great spot.
The only negative points are: flat on the 4th floor without elevator. Diffilcult for families with small children. From 13/ 14 years old ok. Younger difficult.
Hosts were always very nice and the communication went very well and smoothly.

O apartamento é muito bem localizado, bem equipado e charmoso!

Obrigada Inês e Antonio!
Great place, Great location! I love it!

Es una vivienda con todo lo necesario para una corta estancia en Lisboa, limpia y con bonitos detalles decorativos y de bienvenida.
