Muy bien situada, hay parking cercano, y los anfitriones dan toda la información que necesiten para disfrutar Lisboa. Es cierto que tiene unas buenas escaleras que recorrer para llegar y no hay ascensor: hay que llevar poco equipaje y mejor que sea mochila!

Excellent, très bon accueil, l’appartement est magnifique, réponse rapide et précise des propriétaires, accès très bien organisé et simple. Je recommande et y reviendrais avec joie! Nous avons adoré le séjour

The apartment is in a perfect location.  accessible to all city amenities by foot and a few 100 metres from the water. Great place if you like sport and jogging along the water front. The apartment is as described and very comfortable. The kitchen is well equipped and Inès and Antonio left some welcoming refreshments which was really appreciated. The check in was perfect and really easy. If you have heavy luggage get ready for a long stair climb but this is well described in the briefing. We would certainly stay here again. Thanks Inès and Antonio for a great experience.

Nice place to stay...good location, good price, very clean!!
We were 3 friends staying for 3 days to visit Lisbon and it was a pleasure to stay at this place...i recommend!

The accommodation was perfect. Both the location and the size were optimal. The communication before and during the stay was without problems. We can only recommend it to everyone, no wishes remain unfulfilled. The stairs to the 4th Floor keep everyone fit. Warm regards
We loved staying at the White House. The location was great. So much to see and do in the area - could walk everywhere. The place has everything one needs.

Inês and Antonio have such a beautiful, unique and charming apartment. We were travelling with our 8 month old baby and were naturally quite anxious about how the trip would go, but we were put at ease instantly. A lovely cot was set up for us on arrival and there was everything we needed to make it a home from home with a baby bath, highchair and enough room for our son to entertain himself and have a great holiday!
The apartment is in an excellent location and the information provided to us by the hosts was perfect. Accurate and so helpful,we really felt so confident getting to and from the apartment and exploring the city.
We can't recommend this stay more, you will have a great visit and have everything you need at your fingertips!!
Thank you so much I & A - you helped give us a lovely family break away!!! ❤️
Easy going, nice and clean 👌

Brilliantly located, clean and very comfortable I cannot recommend Inês and António's apartment enough. they were very communicative and made our stay really easy and enjoyable. I'll definitely stay here again next time I'm in Lisbon.

Great place to stay that is separated from the busiest areas in the city while still being a short walk away from most things, and a short cab ride away from everything else.
As everyone else notes in their reviews, the stairs are no joke, so don't bring heavy luggage. But honestly, you get used to it because hills and stairs are a way of life in much of Portugal. Only us flatlanders are surprised by it.
Ines was very accommodating and communicative and even included some basic breakfast foods as a nice surprise... and plenty of coffee for our stay, which no other place did for us for some unknown reason. The cafe downstairs was perfect when we needed a quick bite on our way out to the city and a bus stop was just a block away to get us to the train station for our trip up to Porto. If I had to complain about anything it would be the the bed. But even that was par for the course for most places we stayed at. I would definitely stay here again next time.

Inês and António's home is a lovely apartment right at the center of Lisbon life.
It is lovely, well thought and full of surprises. Their hospitality is top notch and you can see that from the little details like fresh bread when you arrive.
The only problem we had with it was that we had to leave to go back to our lives :(
Thanks again!

appartement très agréable et bien situé et le départ comme l'accueil sont très bien organisés.
merci à vous!

Super appartement , très bien situé et très bien équipé. Quartier très agréable desservi par tous les moyens de transport. La communication avec nos hôtes était parfaite . Nous recommandons aux voyageurs ce bel appartement.
The apartment is very cute, well appointed, clean and the hosts were kind and welcoming. You can’t ask for a better Airbnb experience!

good location
clean with strong WiFi
We had a great stay, location is absolute great. The info you get is very detailed and accurate

We highly recommend Ines and Antonio’s apartment. The location is perfect, the apartment is clean and exactly as described and you will find everything you need inside.
Best,

Cascais and Sintra are well worth a visit. A truly romantic and magical stay in Lisboa- many thanks to I&A.
I couldn’t imagine better hosts, check-in and communication were very easy. Ines and Antonio were very supportive with our stay in Lisbon. Thank you!

Our stay at Ines/Antonios apartment in Lisbon was wonderful, but this of course we expected! When we planned a trip to Portugal this was our first thought to stay at the White House again as we had a couple years ago.

We recommend to anyone and will of course be back!!!
Amazing stay! Great location (walking distance to great landmarks and restaurants). 10/10 would recommend to any friends visiting Portugal.

A truly amazing place to stay at for anyone who wants to discover Lisbon. The location is very central and the apartment is exactly or even better as shown in the pictures + very well equipped.

5 stars, no doubt!
Fantastic place - cool interior and excellent location. Lots of space. Highly recommended!
Location was perfect! Inês and António were so helpful and accommodating to us. Beautiful views from the apartment. Very clean. We would definitely visit again!

A great base for a month in Lisbon.

Wonderful views of the water, and close to good restaurants and bars.

An absolute gem of a place! Fantastic location, extra clean, equipped with everything one might need (even the adapters for foreign plugs!). The hosts were incredibly kind and hospitable. They even stocked up some breakfast items for us prior to arrival.
Too bad the stay was too short, but will absolutely stay there again on our next trip to Lisbon!

This is an excellent Airbnb. Inês and António made the stay perfect. The apartment is beautiful, in an incredible location and it is very spacious and bright. Nous y reviendrons avec plaisir lors d'un prochain séjour.

We are so pleased, that we had the chance to stay in this comfortable flat in the centre of Lisbon. Great place with a very charming vibe. Great hosts - fully recommend staying here!

I won’t hesitate to recommend Ines & Antonio’s apartment for customers seeking for an authentic experience in the heart of Lisbon.

All round top notch experience.  Even though we only had one day in Lisbon, we were made to feel welcome.  The apartment is amazing, with all the wonderful extra touches.  We will make a point of coming back to stay longer in the future!  Highly recommended.

Location was great (even though it was close to a party street, I couldn’t hear anything at night), descriptions were accurate, and the bread and fruit were a nice touch! Stairs were hard after a long day of walking up hills but I knew that before booking. A little extra exercise never hurts! But if you’re young and/or fit, it’s fine. Overall it was a wonderful stay!

This is the second time I stayed in this lovely apartment.  The location is perfect and the apartment is lovely.  It is light and airy and well equipped.  My favorite place to stay in Lisbon. Lovely apartment! Lots of character, cool aesthetics, and great location. Would definitely stay again!

Great appartment, great location. There was fresh bread and jam, coffee, milk and a bottle of water. Great host!

The place has a good location and it's fully equiped.
The entrance is a bit strange, through a gift shop, sometimes you have to wait for people to leave the shop to enter the building, but it's not too bad. The owner of the shop is very nice and helpful.
I don't really mind it, but there are a lot of stairs, especially if you're coming from the US bear in mind that it's closer to 6 floors than to 4, but if you're already in Lisbon 6 floors of stairs is really just a walk around the block.
Such an incredibly beautiful space! The stairs are intense but worth it. The loft is wonderful, the location is amazing, and the communication was very easy! I would love to stay again!

5 Star Accommodation in Lisboa
It was a wonderful stay, the location is perfect for exploring the city and the apartment is furnished lovely. The key handover was super easy and we were super happy to stay here!
The appartment is very clean and very well located close to the metro. Highly recommanded.
Ines and Antonio are wonderful hosts.  The accomodations are clean and well equipped.  A nice home away from home.

Inês & António were wonderful hosts and their space is AMAZING. It's one of the most beautiful, interesting accommodations I've ever stayed in, with charming design and so many touches that are personal to them and Lisbon. The location is also amazing, convenient to to see so much of Lisbon. I would highly recommend. Thank you, Inês & António!

This is a sparkling clean beautifully decorated warm and  cosy apartment with a lovely view of the bridge and the Christo. It is a 4 floor walk up .I think the only reason you would not love this lace is if you had lots of heavy luggage and were not in a good condition to walk up the many stairs, but if you are young and sporty and you did not bring too many heavy bags you’ll love this place !

We loved this apartment. It is in a great location near the metro and a train station. Lots of great restaurants nearby not to mention the unmissable Time Out market.
The apartment was spotless & well equipped. Ines and António had thoughtfully left some provisions of food and milk for our arrival.
Communication was great with lots of useful information.
All in all a great trip to this fabulous city.
I can highly recommend.
muito boa!

The apartment is in a perfect location. Well equipped and spotless. A lovely touch was bread, butter and fruit left for us by the host. The case drop is perfect for being able to start your Lisbon experience as soon as you can. The stairs however do need to be taken into consideration but it all helps shifting the calories from lunches at the numerous  restaurants.
Great location in an adorable flat. The hosts left us fresh bread and jellies we were able to enjoy for our early morning flight out

This cute loft is in a great location close to many restaurants, bars and transportation yet not a lot of noise. It is clean and Ines was sweet leaving us coffee, fresh delicious bread and jam. Checking in was as directed and she has excellent communication especially compared to other places we stayed on this trip. The one negative is the narrow, steep staircase and 4 flights of stairs so those with large luggage may find this an inappropriate place to stay.

This is a REALLY cool, hip space in a great location and Ines and Antonio were very responsive to requests. They kindly left us fresh bread from bakery downstairs as well as jams and fruit, which was much appreciated when we arrived. The kitchen is well out-fitted, the bed was comfortable and the apartment was relatively quiet. Many windows allowed for a nice breeze in the apartment but there is no air conditioning or overhead fans and the apartment is on the top floor, so I don't know if it might be hot in the summer. Note also that it is five flights up steep stairs and there is no elevator.  It might be better for younger visitors.
The place was very cute, amazing view and Central to a lot of local places including public transportation.
I would like to thanks Ines & Antonio for being great great hosts and facilitate our stay in Lisbon. The apartment has a great location and was extremely cleaned

A perfect place to stay right in the center of Lisbon. Very nice hosts who offer a lot of help that goes far beyond the usual. Very cozy apartment with original and intelligent use of space. The only thing that bothered us a little bit was the noise of a ventilation machine (or whatever it was) which is installed at the building next to the sleeping room which kept us a little bit from sleep but is no fault of the hosts and probably can't be changed, so one night we preferred to sleep in the other room which was more quiet. Anyway, the city never sleeps and the place is definitely a recommendation.

This beautiful apartment is in a perfect location for exploring Lisbon, very close to the metro and has great water views.  It is even better than the pictures! We loved it and would stay again if we came back. The hosts are excellent at communicating and getting access was very easy. You will love it!

You could not ask for a better location or better hosts. If you're tired of cookie cutter places that all look the same, this is the place for you. It's very easy to get to from the airport, which is a big plus after a long flight. Unfortunately we had 4+ hours until check in, but they allowed you to leave your bags while you wandered around the city. There's lots to do right in the area.
It is on the 4 th floor, so if you can't climb steps, this might not be the place for you, but they are very upfront about that, so you know what to expect. They also have conveniently placed a chair on the landings if you need to stop for a breath.
They considerably had a few items in the refrigerator to welcome you to their place. There's info and suggestions on things to do and they are more than willing to help if you have any questions. Unfortunately we didn't get a chance to meet them since we were only there for the night, but I definitely would recommend it to anyone looking for a charming place in a great location for their stay in Lisbon.

Apartamento muito charmoso e limpo, Inês e Antônio foram muito atenciosos e deixaram alguns mimos como café, frutas e pão na nossa chegada. A localização é ótima e tem uma linda vista do Rio Tejo.
A experiência de entrada pela lojinha não é a mais agradável e as escadas muito íngremes dificultam bastante a logística com as malas.
Tivemos um problema com o ralo do chuveiro que estava entupido e foi desagradável tomar banho com água transbordando no pé, falamos com Inês e ela foi atenciosa e disse que iria verificar e mandar arrumar.
The place was great, had amazing views!! Location was perfect, easy access to the bus/metro and easy walk to the downtown plaza area.

This is a great place to stay. The location is central to the local market and other areas. The apartment is beautifully decorated in a minimalist style. The hosts are responsive and positive with a lovely welcoming tray. There are a lot of steps so don’t take too much luggage!
The apartment was divine. It was beautiful,  great amenities, well located & comfortable. Excellent transport links & I felt very safe there. I would absolutely stay again.  5 stars all the way.
A beautiful place to stay.

You really can’t beat this location in Lisbon! It was walking distance from all the main areas in Lisbon and surrounded by so many places to eat, including Time Out Market. The apartment itself was so charming and had an incredible view of the city and water. I highly recommend this place!

Very nice place. Interior decorating is on point. Some little things: The stairs are no joke so brace yourself. The bathroom sink will spray you if you’re not careful. WiFi was being a little weird but I restarted the modem and it worked fine. Everything else was wonderful.

Lovely space lots of nice touches, double room and a single room, if its hot use the fans they are great, lovely bread and jams, great location for airport bus, station, near bike rental place (definitely cycle out to cascais)... top of the house so no big windows but very cosy and comfortable and stylish.... easy to get keys etc

Die Lage ist einfach spitze!!!! Alles was man braucht ist im Apartment vorhanden. Zudem schön, sauber und mit einer selbst gemachten Kleinigkeit willkommen geheißen. Alles in allem: jederzeit wieder und sehr zu empfehlen!

The place is very centrally located, it's difficult to imagine a place which is closer to the nightlife. It's also close to every form of public transport you can think of.
On the negative side there is not a lot of space for hanging clothes.
It's certainly somewhere which would appeal more to somewhat younger people though.
Being so close to the center of things you can sometimes hear street noise outside; and, as the building has no lift and the flat is on the top floor, it's certainly not recommended for anyone with reduced mobility.
Nevertheless, my brother and I certainly enjoyed our few days there and we were sad to leave.

We enjoyed the views from the apartment. It was sweet to arrive to the goodies in the fridge after a long day of traveling with kids. Every detail was thought out. A little difficult with small children because of the stairs, but we knew what to expect due to the listing and the pictures. We would stay here again!
We loved staying here! The snacks in the fridge were a cute touch :) It’s also located in a great location.

I highly recommend it. The place is very stylish and cozy and very well located to visit Lisbon and surrounding areas. If you don’t mind climbing a few floors of stairs it’s a really nice place to stay!!
Perfect Location, the house is in a strategical position to visit the city, splendid view over the river, very peaceful, charming,  luminose and with an authentic  Portuguese mood. Highly recommended
Situation idéale pour visiter Lisbonne. Plein de petites attentions, petit déjeuner copieux et très bon. Appartement très propre et décoré avec goût.
An excellent experience, beautiful space, and thoughtful touches.
Wonderful attic apartment, great location, can’t imagine a better place to stay in Lisbon!

Location, location, location! It was a great apartment. Stylish, spacious with the best hosts ever! Great directions, making sure things went above and beyond. Close to everything, easy parking. Nothin negative to say. Thank you for all the lovely touches!

This apartment was perfect size, location and amenities for our family!  The space was so charming - great design touches and lots of character.  The location was perfect. We took the Metro with ease from the airport to the apartment which is just a few minutes from the station.  There are wonderful restaurants, shops, sightseeing etc... all close by.  Thank you to Ines and Antonio - our stay at The White House is another part of a memorable family vacation!
Great place! Super central!! Enjoy

We had a wonderful stay at Ines and Antonio’s flat. We particularly loved the beautiful stylish space and the lovely personal touches. I was travelling with my young baby and the hosts prepared a baby towel and high chair for her. Wow! Such a lovely thought. Very clean and excellent location also. We will definitely come
Here again when visiting Lisbon. Yes it is on the 4th floor and it can get heavy with big suitcases but it was alright all in all as the stairs are wide.

Such a great and lovely apartment. Located close to the southern area, It will give you an amazing portugese living with the river view. Hosts are very kind and responsible. I’d come again if I visit in next time!

The apartment is lovely and in a fabulous location, comfortable bed and quiet for Lisbon liveliness.
Extra measures were the fruit and condiments in the fridge, meaning didn’t have to leave early on the first morning.
The stairs aren’t for the faint hearted but it was good exercise!

We arrived very late and had a quick stay in Lisbon between our flights. Ines and Antonio were very accommodating with our check in. The street was very loud at the late hour we arrived but the apartment was quiet, clean, and very comfortable. Not to mention it's SUPER cute! All of the little touches--bread from a nearby bakery, fruit and milk in the fridge, fans in each room, etc. were lovely after our long day. They have a ton of helpful info in the apartment to make the most of your stay and it's worth every penny to be in such a convenient location. We enjoyed the city and were glad to have found this spot!

We had such a wonderful time in your home! So stylish & comfortable! We kept saying it was just the kind of place we would like to have in Portugal.
The groceries were a very thoughtful touch, and much appreciated.

We had an amazing stay Inês & António’s place. The space was beautifully decorated with delicate touches (cherries, fresh bread and amazing honey). There were helpful maps and books in the apartment and communicating with them was great, they were responsive and so helpful. There are beautiful views from the room and you are close to the train station, other transport and the beach was a quick Uber ride away! We highly recommend and would happily stay here again!

What a delightful find. This place is as chic as the pictures, in a perfect location and the hosts are generous hearted. There was lovely fruit and bread awaiting us and all check in arrangements were smooth and easy.  The family gave amazing food suggestions for our 2 vegan travelers, we went twice to AO 26 it was so good. Thankyou Inês and Antonio for your kind hospitality. A++
A localização do apartamento é excelente! Próximo de tudo! Espaço muito charmoso e equipado! Pequenos detalhes a fizeram a diferença.

Inês & António are very attentive hosts. All details from arrival to departure where precisely explained in advance. The apartment was very beautiful, perfectly clean, very well equipped and cosy. We were welcomed with fresh bread, butter, honey, marmalade and strawberries. The facebook tips are very useful and are strongly advised. So absolutely recommendable, our first choice if we come back to Lisbon.

This apartment is the perfect location to set out and explore Lisbon. It is sparkling clean and decorated in such an artistic and pleasing way. The hosts are very helpful and attentive and accommodated our late night check in with kindness and warmth. We had an amazing time and would 100% recommend this amazing spot.

Gaetana
7:49 AM

The pictures to this listing did not look like the apartment we went to. Unfortunately, we did not take pictures, we were too distraught. Upon checking in, we entered a souvenir shop. It was very very tiny. The door to the apartment was through this shop. The entry door was not wide enough for a person to go in, you had to walk in side ways. Our luggage or even an over weight person could not fit through this doorway. In the listing, it stated that it was on the 4th floor. It was more like 14 flights of stairs. Upon entering this apartment, which was in the attic, my husband had to go up another 2 flights of stairs. He was beside himself, he was out of breath. We are not overweight, we are very healthy and very active. To his surprise, he saw 2 mattresses about 1 inch thick on the floor, The apartment had a very bad odor. He felt trapped and could not stay in this apartment, much less sleep in this place. I was waiting downstairs also to find out that each time we would leave this place after store hours, we would have to open the store doors and lock them. I did not want to be responsible for this. The outside of this buiilding was very old and poorly kept. We were beside our selves. I contacted the hosts and canceled this reservation. Needless to say, we had to find other accommodations. I asked for a refund. They replied "No". I did understand that I would not get my full refund, but at least refund me Cleaning cost & Service fee.

We can absolutely recommend staying here! It's perfectly central, but still quiet and a perfect refuge. It's really nicely made up with many lovely details and we even had fresh bread, fruit and milk&coffee waiting for us! Would stay there again for sure the next time in Lisbon.
Perfect space and perfect location! Definitely stay here.

Great, great location! A very lovely place!! One block from the water, a street over from the famous Pink Street, and super close to all types of transportation! Awesome bakery right next door as well!

Perfect place, such an amazing location and the dècor is so chic!!
I definitely will be coming back, that’s a promise.
Just be careful if you have big bags or if you’re traveling with an elderly person since there are a lot of stairs to climb!!
This is a perfect location! You can walk to most places from here. I & A were great communicators and very easy to coordinate with :)

A beautiful space in a wonderful location.
There was fresh bread, fruit, tea and coffee waiting for us after our long trip.
The bedroom was clean and beautiful.
There are lots of stairs to climb to get to the apartment, but worth it.
We had a great trip, beautiful apartment and perfect location to discover Lisbon.  Inês & António are excellent hosts, I highly recommend

This apartment is great! Is in a great location for restaurants, shopping and site seeing. The shop owner that you interact with everyday is incredibly sweet and helpful. The only "negatives" would be the amount of stairs to the apartment, which is not a problem normally, but with luggage, it's quite difficult and the hardness of the main bed makes for many unrested days. The apartment is fantastic, I just wish the bed was more comfortable as it would add to a more relaxing stay!
appartement tres bien situé et tres calme.
Appartement avec beaucoup de charme et extrêmement bien placé dans le centre historique et point de départ ideal pour decouvrir la ville et ses alentours.

We had a great experience at Ines and Antonio's property.  It was the perfect location for exploring Lisbon.  We arrived to some wonderful snacks and a personal note - lovely touches.  We were also provided lots of great tips about exploring the city.  The stairs were a challenge at first  (4th floor walk up, 5th floor for those of us in the US) but we got used to them pretty quickly and we were happy to burn off the calories of the delicious custard tarts that Lisbon is known for.  We can highly recommend Ines and Antonio's charming and cozy apartment.

We had two wonderful days in Lisbon and enjoyed the apartment and its perfect location very much. It‘s very close to TimeOut Market and our favorite café Janis and many other nice places. The late checkin at midnight was no problem and we were warmly welcomed with fresh bread, honey and butter. Yummm! Inês and António are very kind snd polite hosts and always responded immediately to all our questions. The apartment has everything you might need like coffee, sugar, olive oil and of course all the equipment. We can truly recommend this apartment! Thank you guys
Möchte ich nicht. oben ist alles wesentliche gesagt.

Emplacement idéal pour visiter la ville à pied ou pour prendre les transports en commun. Très pratique aussi, possibilité de laisser les bagages avant l'heure d'entrée dans l'appartement et après l'heure de sortie.

The place is very centrally located with many bars, restaurants, eateries around. We rented a car. The first night I parked at a place underground about half a kilometer away for quite a stiff price. Then we figure it out and park it on the streets for free from 10 pm to 9 am.
Ines' place is very clean, attentive, with all the necessities...even bread, honey, and apples :)...and every time we had a question Ines replied right away. We really enjoyed the place.
Thank You!
Cornel

The location is really great, close to the station, and walking distance from numerous sites, so v. convenient for getting the most out of a short break. The apartment is pretty spacious, it has all the basic requirements plus the shower is super powerful and hot. Some nice touches like nespresso machine and capsules. The only thing to point out is that it is on the top level and there are a lot of quite steep steps. Still good for burning off the calories for all those delicious Portuguese cakes!

The apartment sets a great atmospheric tone for a late night stay in Lisbon with views looking out over the river and onto the square below. Plenty of space for activities and the spreading of your stuff as a traveler! The added breakfast treats really had us purring! Thanks for a great stay, would recommend.

I went on a euro trip to a few countries and out of all the b&b’s i booked, this one was my favorite ! The location is dead center of all the action. Close to restuarants, bars, and beautiful sites to see! 100% recommended !

We really enjoyed our stay.  The apartment was clean, spacious, and very centrally located.  Ines and Antonio provided a lot of very helpful tips and information for our trip and were responsive to our questions.  Would definitely recommend!

THIS IS THE BEST PLACE TO STAY! It is beautiful and has amazing views, as well as being centrally located near the water, restaurants, and bars. You are near bus and train stations which make navigating the city so easy. In the apartment, there are tips for travelers and other things around that make it feel more homey and personal. They are great hosts who gave so much information about the apartment and how to get around. It would be a mistake to stay anywhere else. I never wanted to leave!!!

Inès & Antonio’s flight has a great vibe and an amazing light. I really booked it for the decor and the area (I think it is the best neighborhood in Lisbon). Everything is made for you to feel comfortable and at home I really liked all the attentions in the flat. The flat was neat and tidy. I would recommend it to friends.

Inês and António’s place is so nice with many thoughtful amenities. They left out snacks for us upon arrival and had a well appointed kitchen. Their communication was exceptional with very detailed written instructions and suggestions for the area. Be prepared to climb the 4 flights of stairs. They are steep and narrow so will be difficult for those with heavy and/or bulky luggage.
We were happy with our stay at Ines & Antonio's place.  Future travelers should be very happy to stay there.
It's the 2nd time I have stayed in this apartment. It's great and the hosts are fantastic. 5* for this place!
Great little apartment with many extra personal touches.

Really great location, by the water, 2 minutes from all major transport links, 10 minute walk to Bairro Alto and about 20 minutes from Alfama.
The flat was beautiful and bright and the welcome pack of foods to get us started was very much appreciated.

Ines&Antonio's place is a bohemien, cosy attic fully equipped. The location is perfect to explore the city center and very close to the train station and the so-called Time-Out market. At our arrival we found a breakfast welcome kit that we truly appreciated. Many thanks!

My friend and I stayed here for two nights on our visit to Lisbon. The location was perfect for touring and getting around the city, and the space is absolutely gorgeous! Check-In was a breeze and zero complaints. Highly recommend!!!

This place is so cute! Aesthetics are on point, but even more importantly, the location was perfect. It was convenient getting around definitely made the stay more enjoyable. They were kind enough to welcome us with bread, fruits, and tea. We would definitely stay here again.
Je vous recommande Inès et Antonio, des hôtes adorables et attentionnés. Efficace en tout point. Ils ont su nous accueillir les bras ouvert, de ce fait nous faciliter notre séjour à Lisbonne.

Thankyou António and Inês we had a great time. Group of 2 couples. It’s an excellent apartment in a central location close to loads of bars and restaurants. It’s up 8 flights of stairs so you’ll also get your daily steps in. Overall highly recommended.

It was an amazing experience to stay and Inês and António’s place.
The communication is fast-responded. Since I started inquiry the place with the baggage storage information, I got the response from the owner fast and correct. After the booking confirmation, I got a long msg with all the detailed instructions, which makes our checkin and checkout very easy.
The place is exactly as you have seen in those photos, clean, lovely.... and with a lot of sweet surprises. With those fruits and bread in the kitchen, I woke up early and made myself a nice breakfast... the guest book in the house, where you could find all those valuable information in town, share by those previous guests. That’s a great resource to explore the city.... just sad that I was staying for a short time. But definitely I would come back and stay here again!!
Thank you again, Inês and António!!!!

Location was great. The flat has no central heating (portable radiators are there instead) so if you come in winter months take warmer clothes.
There are some really nice bars near the flat and it’s walking distance to the town centre.

Appartamento incantevole. é al 4º piano (senza ascensore) e l'indirizzo non é quello scritto sulla pagina. Le istruzioni sono prolisse ed estremamente tediose alcune di esse anche assolutamente inutili. Le chiavi le consegna un Paki che occupa l'entrata dell'edificio con il suo negozio e l'entrata é la sua vetrina. Assolutamente pittoresco ma NON viene specificato nella prolissa-e-lunga-come-la-quaresima spiegazione. Fatto salvo tutto ció la posizione é eccellente.
Great place. Fabulous location! Comfortable and stylish. Ines and Antonio made check in and checkout seamless with their straight forward communication prior to arrival. Thanks for a great stay!
If you aren’t afraid of the stairs, it’s the most central place that you can get!
we had a fantastic stay. thank you for making us feel so welcome. I have already forwarded your place to some friends who are looking to go to Lisbon.

We stayed in the apartment of Inês & António from January 13 to 18, 2019.
When we arrived in the apartment, the rooms were very bright and we felt comfortable at first sight. You can even see the river Tejo when looking out of the window. With great pleasure we found the little snack, the owners had left for us. Fresh fruit, coffee and everything you might need after a boring flight.
The kitchen is very well equipped and you can prepare your meal if you don't feel like going out for dinner.
When we got back after a long and exciting day visiting Lisbon we felt like coming home. The beds are very comfortable. The apartment is very quiet though it is situated in the very center of the city. When you go out on the street you are in the middle of life and all the places you might want to visit are very easy to reach as all public transportation is just around the corner.
Inês & António are great host. They gave us all information needed to make it easy to find our way to the apartment and also to move around in the city. They are there for you if you need any help. They are taking care of their visitors in a very discrete way.
We learned to love Lisbon and when we come back, we hope they will accept us again.
Amazing stay with a beautiful apartment and really funny stairs!

You will get in your steps as you work your way up to this apartment, but you will also have amazing sunrises over Lisbon and beautiful rooftop views out to the water. The location makes it easy to venture off to any part of the City, but there is also lots to do within a 15 minute walk.

the location for us was exceptionally great for what we wanted to do. literally 5 minute walk to the harbour, the timeout market and the train station to cascais. to get to all main areas, it was super easy to get around from the apartment. ines and antonio provided all the info we needed in detail so there was no guess work in what to do, or where to eat, etc. a short two-day stay...and great!! recommend!

The location is amazing. You’re less than 5 minutes from Time Out Market and and a few blocks from Chiado Palace. We were greeted with a welcome basket with bread and fruit and coffee which was so nice after a long flight. We couldn’t figure out the washing machine, so we had to knock and someone came directly upstairs. They are not responsive on my air bnb messenger and my phone couldn’t dial out so you need to find them on the first floor. The place was cold but there are space heaters. It’s in the attic basically so the living room is low light with the exception of the beams but that doesn’t hit the couch area. Overall, they were a sweet family and helpful.
Nos encantó el apartamento y todos los detalles de la casa .. gracias
Very great place.  Great location. Do pack light because of the four flights of stairs.
Great location, unique space, and hosts left a ton of information on local attractions. We really enjoyed our stay!
L'appartement est très agréable et super bien placé dans le quartier de Cais de Sodré. Il y a beaucoup d'animation et on est cependant tranquilles une fois rentrés.

Tout était parfait.
L’appartement est idéalement placé, vous serez à côté de beaucoup de points d'intérêts à Lisbonne. Tout est très propre et correspondait à la description.
Inês et Antonio sont pleins de petites intentions et nous avaient laissé de quoi faire le petit-déjeuner . Vraiment un bon accueil et de super hôtes.
Je ne peux que recommander ce logement. J'espère y revenir. Manon et Leonardo
I stayed a couple of days in the flat, and everything worked out perfectly well. I was fully satisfied, and recommend to anyone.

Five stars in every way. The roof top flat is great - welcoming, lovely and spacious with comfortable beds, lovely bed linen and kitchen very well equipped for self catering. Plenty of room for eating and relaxing, full of thoughtful details that make it seem like home.
It's in a fantastic location near the water, markets, cafes and with easy access to buses and trams. And amazingly quiet!!
Ines & Antonio are brilliant hosts. Previsit they gave very helpful directions and info online, and provided a welcome array of bread, jams, coffee and fruit on arrival.
Staying in their flat is a delight and I'd recommend it wholeheartedly

My wife, daughter, and I stayed at ‘the White House’ for two nights. The apartment is sparkling clean, beautiful, and very ‘cool’. We were welcomed by fruit and still-warm bread. Our hosts had many recommendations for us and were happy to answer the questions we had about the best way to see Sintra.
Yes, there are stairs getting up to it, but if these stairs are a worry to you, then Lisbon, with all its staircases and steep hills, will be problematic in and of itself. Truly, they weren’t an issue for us in the slightest.
We would absolutely stay again.

There’s a reason this listing has a consistent 5 star review across all categories. The hospitality was superb, and communication precise and accurate. This place was so special and adorable. The stairs were worth the climb every time! If you’re  healthy and fit - it’s not a problem at all. Thank you for a lovely stay in Lisbon. We lives the location, especially.
Just perfect!! The place is just too convenient to be true. There is a bible full of useful information and tips from previous guests. Definitely will come back here really

It's a very good located apartment, good information about everything you need to know. Clean rooms, everything you need is available in the apartment. Especially the location was a great thing which we liked.

We absolutely loved our time at Inês and António’s Lisbon apartment and would nightly recommend both the accommodations and the city. This was our first trip to Lisbon and we loved it. The apartment is very well located. You can walk to the waterfront, to the market, and to many, many wonderful restaurants and cafés. Be sure to take a day trip to Sintra via train and don’t miss Damas for a meal.

We loved the nice clean apartment and the location is perfect for staying in Lisbon.
Inês & António are great hosts and everything went very smooth and to our expectations.
Thanks a lot for an absolutely fabulous time in Lisbon.

Ines and Antonio are fantastic hosts. The apartment was clean, and there were lots of thoughtful touches. They communicated extremely well, and were quick to respond to any queries. The apartment itself is really characterful, and in a fantastic location.

最＆高！
夜遅くにリスボン空港に到着したので移動が不安でしたが、AirportBUSの終点で降りるとすぐアパートがあり、鉄道・メトロ駅の近くで安心でした。
市場も近く、調味料も揃っていて、自炊する旅にはもってこいかと（ナイフが切れにくいので持参すべし）
最上階だったので、景色はよかったですが70歳になる母は、階段の上り下りに苦戦していました。
ただ、到着時に出迎えてくれた息子さんが20キロ超えるスーツケースを運んでくれて感謝。
Nice apartment, well situatid, welcoming.
Great hospitality and superb location! Everything extremely well organised. Lisbon is a great city, made fantastic by the invaluable tips of I&A. Best recommendation

Die Wohnung liegt perfekt fast direkt am Tejo in Lissabon. Bus und Bahn ganz dicht. Auch der sightseeing Bus hält vor der Tür.
Die Wohnung ist sehr liebevoll eingerichtet, sehr stylisch!!
Wir wurden mit frischem Brot mit Honig und Butter empfangen.
Der Eingang ist witzig hinter eigenem Souvenir Laden versteckt. Das macht schon eine romantische Atmosphäre!
Nachts kann man, weil man super zentral wohnt, auch das Nachtleben hören. Dann sollte man die Fenster einfach schließen.
Wir können die große Wohnung nur empfehlen

Staying on Ines&Antonio place was grate experience, I felt that they really care for their guests, they also provided baby crib with so beautiful linings <3. Even it was only one night it was amazing, hope to return!
A lot of thanks!

Wir haben als 4-köpfige Familie (unsere Söhne sind 11 und 14 Jahre alt) Anfang Oktober 4 Tage in dem Apartment von Ines und Antonio verbracht und waren begeistert.
Die Lage ist super: mitten in der Stadt und in der Nähe toller Restaurants (nachts hört man natürlich auch ab und zu etwas vom Lissaboner Nachleben, da die Wohnung ganz oben ist, hat uns das aber nicht gestört).
Der Blick aus der Gaube auf den Tejo und die Ponte de 25 Abril ist großartig! Unbedingt zu empfehlen!!
Great spot in downtown Lisbon with roomy living area. Location was perfect, I&A made check in and check out extremely easy!
Great space, good location.  Hosts were very detailed in their communications!

I had an amazing time! The apartment is beautiful, clean, great location I walked everywhere and I loved all the sweet little details. Thanks Inés and Antônio for this amazing place. I highly recommended it!

Everything was super easy and the perfect location, bang in the middle of all the bars and restaurants.
If I come back to Lisobn this place will be top of my list.
Great place, great location and great hosts!

A beautiful apartment - lovely touches like fresh bread, butter, and fruit awaited us when we arrived. Crisp white linens, views of the river, right in the thick of things - couldn't ask for a better location and more beautiful flat for our last days in Lisbon. Steep 4 floor walk-up - so if you have heavy luggage,  you might want to split the load and make 2 trips. Also there's no air conditioning - but plenty of fans and windows that let in pleasant breezes. We were there in 80-90 degree heat and did fine without AC.
All went good for during my 1 night long stay
Lovely place to stay.
Good location

Great little place in a good location, perfect for a long weekend. Nice touches like fresh bread, milk and fruit waiting for us on arrival.
Super clean, comfortable bed. Thanks for all the excellent communication and tips too.

My husband and me stayed in Inês and António's place for two days. It was such a shame that we had no time to stay longer! The apartment is amazing and we loved everything. It is very unique and tasteful and with love furnished and decorated. We found everything what made our stay perfect! It was easy to communicate with Inês and Antonio and we received all information how to find and access the apartment. They provided loads of recommendations for our visit of Lisbon which was very helpful. Inês and Antonio are real super hosts and we highly recommend their apartment in this amazing city!!
Bring down your expectation.......way down!

Beautiful apartment with a lot of character. Hosts were super responsive and organized. The place was sparkling clean and extremely well located. Very breezy when all windows are opened. Ines left fresh flowers for us along with some Portuguese bread, jam, honey, coffee, milk and fresh fruits. It was super easy to explore the city using the apartment as a base. Word of warning: the apartment is a super charming attic, which means you have to climb stairs to the last floor but once there it’s totally worthy based on location and the apartment itself. Lots of nice touches and they keep it extremely well maintained. They have a guestbook and we saw nothing but great comments. They have every imaginable piece of information about Lisbon, both in the apartment and on a little Facebook page they’ve put together for guests. Check in and instructions about the apt were super clear and easy to navigate. We’ll book it again for our next Lisbon visit for sure.

Correctly advertised and pictures are accurate.  The home, although on the 4th floor, is well-worth the effort to take your baggage up the stairs.  Ines and Antonio are exceptional hosts and take care of their guests.  The home is centrally located and near amazing food and culture.   I would encourage travelers to experience the hospitality of a couple who truly loves their city and wants to share it with others.

Such a stylish place in a great area. The inside of the listing is also amazing (so long as you read the entire description/communications). I was here for a business trip and this was the perfect spot for me. I recommend it.
Amazing location. Great hosts! We had a wonderful stay

Appartement super bien placée dans la ville. À côté de tout.
Authentique à la description. Convient plus pour un couple et une enfant.
Un séjour magique dans cette ville avec un appartement idéale et une hôte aux petits soins
El departamento muy bien ubicado y muy lindo. Fue muy grato la fruta y víveres que nos dejaron!

I stayed at "The White House" with my wife and teenage daughter in July 2018 for three nights.  It has positives and negatives and overall it was fine but probably not the best place for us.  First of all, as they say it is a 4th floor walk up.  This is true, so be prepared that there are approximately 90 steps up to the living space.  If you forget something after you go out, you probably will just want to forget about going back and getting it for the day.  Note that this is the comment of three very active people in excellent physical condition, I run ultra marathons.  The building is very old but has quite a bit of charm and character.  You enter the building through what seems like a secret panel in the kiosk on street level.  The apartment has all the necessary accommodations and features but they are basic.  In July it was very hot and uncomfortable to sleep at night so we had to keep windows wide open and that made it so we heard all the activity of the local night life  going on the street all night and then when the garbage was being taken out in the very early morning.  It sounded like every item that went out in the garbage was a glass bottle bouncing on the pavement.  The location is great and is best for people who are planning to be out most of the night.  It was okay staying there but I would not recommend it for those who want to get some sleep on a warm night.
great place in an amazing location. wish I could have stayed longer

Magical is the word that best describes the White House. There are thoughtful touches and delightful discoveries at every turn. It felt a bit like staying in Narnia, which to me is the best thing ever to imagine...
Communicating with I&A was super easy and very efficient. It was smooth from beginning to end. The place was sparkling and very well equipped. It is easy distance and there are conveniences for shopping, eating, and transport in the immediate vicinity.
I will definitely stay again on my next visit to Lisbon. :)

We so appreciated the extra
trouble Ines & Antonio provided
to make our very short stay so
Comfortable. We arrived after a
long bus trip to nice cold water in
the fridge and all necessities for
breakfast next morning which was
so appreciated as we had an early
start again . They also were super
Fast to respond with any queries
and helped us when needed
Regards
Rick , Dee , Piet & Elaine
Australia Melbourne

Clean comfortable place in a lively neighborhood right downtown and by the water. Ines and Antonino were super friendly and easy to coordinate with. A great place to stay if you want the city at your fingertips.
Хорошее место в центре Лиссабона в старом доме, рядом отличные булочная и бары

A very nice place to stay!
Appartement idéalement situé et un accueil très positif de la part de nos hôtes!
Je recommande chaleureusement!

Excellent place to stay while in Lisbon - clean, inviting, central and wonderful hosts. Location is perfect - could not have asked for a better spot, and great bakeries/cafes/bars/restaurants right around the apartment. And within a 15 minute walk of most major attractions in the city. Would stay here again on our next trip to Lisbon.

This is truly a great place to stay! It’s easy to walk everywhere and right by night life! You get a great view of the city and the water! The hosts included some lovely touches - fresh bread, butter, honey and jam to greet you. They’ve done a great job with the decor and the bed is comfortable. They have reading material all over the apartment and it’s really charming.Please be aware that it is a long walk up four flights of stairs. Not everybody can do it. However, I appreciated getting the exercise in. Also for Americans, take note that the doors lock automatically and it just functions a bit differently than what were used to. So, make sure you understand how the door works so that you don’t get locked out and so that your key doesn’t get stuck. Truly, a lovely stay and I would recommend to anyone willing to take the walk up a few flights.

What a find! The apartment is just wonderful: incredibly charming, tastefully decorated, curated in the smallest details and spotless.  The apartment is equipped with everything you may need. The location could not be better: there are tons of cool cafes, bars and restaurants, and it is easy to go anywhere as metro, tram and bus lines are only steps away. Inês & António are very pleasant and accommodating. I very much appreciated their very clear directions, useful tips and suggestions. Overall, a great place to stay and would highly recommend it!
Lovely apartment. Great location. Home away from home. We hope to be back!

Wir hatten einen sehr schönen Urlaub in Lissabon und können die Unterkunft von Ines und Antonio gerne empfehlen! Es gibt eine Reihe von Restaurants in der Nähe und alle Transportarten sind vor Ort leicht zu erreichen.

Location-wise it doesn't get much better than this. The apartment of Ines and Antonio is located at the heart of Lisbon, between the Bairro Alto (old town) and Cais de Sodre (up and coming area with lots of cool street art, galleries etc.). The apartment itself is wonderful. It's on the attic of an historic building - with a nice view of the streets of Lisbon - and is clean and comfortable. Perfect for 2-4 people. Communication with Ines and Antonio was quick and easy. Thanks so much for a wonderful stay!

Het appartement is exact zoals de foto's laten zien: ruim, schoon, comfortabel en heeft alles wat je nodig hebt voor je verblijf. De communicatie vooraf met Ines en Antonio is helder en zeer volledig. Het appartement is heel centraal gelegen, met uitzicht op zee en met het levendig centrum van Lissabon dichtbij. Zeker een plek om aan te bevelen voor een bezoek aan Lissabon!

Sehr gemütliches und stylisches Apartment über den Dächern von Lissabon. Die zentrale, gut angebundene Lage direkt an den Cais do Sodré war perfekt für uns. In der Umgebung gibt es einige nette Lokale, direkt unten zum Beispiel ein erstklassiges Seafood-Restaurant und ein Bäcker mit tollem Brot. Das Check-In war problemlos und die Gastgeber Inês und António antworten schnell, genau und sehr freundlich auf Anfragen.
Der Einrichtungsstil hat uns so toll gefallen - wir nehmen sicherlich einige Ideen für zuhause mit.
Ich würde das "White House" jederzeit wieder buchen und empfehle es uneingeschränkt!

The apartment is really lovely! Ines and Antonio have clearly spent a lot of time and effort creating a very stylish and nice apartment with a lot of personal details. It is easy to feel at home immediately.
The apartment is well equiped (incl. dish washer) and the shower is good.
Ines & Antonio were very flexible to accommodate a late check-in and wer perfect in communicating and helping out whenever needed. Thanks again; we had a great visit in Lisbon!

L'appartement est très agréable, propre, surface correcte pour 4 et idéalement situé. Tout est proche: boulangerie, petite épicerie, bus, tram, train pour Cascais, location de vélos pour Bélem, quartiers à visiter ...
Nous vous le conseillons.
Ines et Antonio vous laisse leur logement comme si vous étiez de la famille avec des petites "attentions".

Un très bon moment passé sous les toits de Inès et Antonio. Très bien situé à Lisbonne, proche de la mer et du centre et des quartiers très prisés de Lisbonne. L'appartement est décoré avec goût, avec toutes les commodités sur place. Nous étions 4 (2 adultes et 2 enfants) très ravis de cette belle expérience.
Véronique, Pierre-Michel, Tomas et Alexis

Très joli appartement idéalement situé. Nous avons pu faire toutes nos ballades à pied. Le logement est très propre et les hôtes ont prévu un petit plateau de fruits, pain, beurre... de bienvenue. Équipement parfait (lave vaisselle, Nespresso, cuisine complète ... et même des crayons de couleur). Le seul point un peu sportif sont les 4 étages à monter. Bref, je recommande vivement cet endroit.

This is a nice charming space, and I and A left nice things for breakfast. Bread, butter, jam and honey, fruit and milk. Just a warning it is a long 4 flights up with a heavy suitcase. Great location. Vgood GF bakery across the street, and Time-out Market several blocks away..
casa particolare, bellissima!

We had a lovely time in Ines and Antonio's apartment.
It's in a great location for Lisbon, it has everything you need and they were lovely hosts. Responded quickly to communication. Lovely
Many thanks
Suzi
Great place!
This place is a must. Amazing location, super clear communication, comfy beds, great shower, very cool personal touches. highly recommend.

This place and these hosts are fantastic. They have thought of every detail. The flat is in a great, central, downtown neighborhood with everything nearby. It is stylishly decorated and has all amenities. Antonio and Ines even provided baby stuff for us and a few essentials in the kitchen so we wouldn’t starve after our late-evening arrival. The organization was easy, their replies prompt and thorough. I highly recommend this booking - as long as you don’t book it when I want to go back!
Great location but a little hard to find as you enter and exit through a tiny gift shop.  Lots of personal touches and tips about the area.  Comfortable and quiet.

This was our first experience staying at an airbnb and Ines & Antonio's home exceeded our expectations!  Their place is beautiful and the location can't be beat.  They welcomed us with a basket of fresh bread, natural honey and delicious apples.  We will definitely return but will pack more lightly next time as the four flights of stairs were a bit of challenge with our heavy suitcases.  If you're fortunate enough to stay here during your visit, the next best thing you can do for yourselves is to contact Yunieski (Yuni) of Sintra Cuban Travels.  The two days we spent with him exploring Sintra, Cascais, Cabo da Rocha, Obidos, Bahalta, Nazare, and Porto were well worth the reasonable fees!  We had a trip of a lifetime in these cities and Lisboa!

Die Unterkunft von Inês und António ist zu 100% weiterzuempfehlen. Die Wohnung ist sauber und gut ausgestattet. Für eine Reise zu dritt gibt es genügend Platz. Neben vielen Tipps für Aktivitäten von den Gastgebern gibt es auch in der Wohnung Flyer und Bücher zu erkunden. Besonders toll war, dass es als Willkommensgruß sogar Brot, Butter, Marmelade, Honig und Milch gab.
Die Lage der Wohnung ist perfekt für Ausflüge zu Fuß oder mit der Fähre und vom Flughafen aus einfach zu erreichen.
Vielen Dank an die Gastgeber für die tolle Möglichkeit, Lissabon auf diese persönliche Weise kennenzulernen!

I had a wonderful stay at the White House for a full week. Ines and Antonio have put a huge effort to make me feel comfortable and I had no reason to complain. You will see that the hosts put a lot of love into the place and it is just perfect to feel welcome and even a little bit at home. The kitchen even fancies a microwave and I need to say that I loved the strong water pressure in the shower :-)
I wish all other travelers coming to Lisbon that they can enjoy this place because it makes the journey a top experience.

Alojamiento para dos en Lisboa para cuatro noches. Perfecta ubicación, cerca de centro. Cuarto piso sin ascensor pero se suben de maravilla las escaleras.Tranquilo y espacioso. Bonito interior. Un poco frío pero también nos pillaron días lluviosos.. aunque tienen radiadores en los tres compartimentos.
Muy recomendable.

Ines & Antonio were great hosts that answered all of our questions. They provided TONS of resources and recommendations for their favorite places in Lisbon. The location is perfect and it is close to the train station and within walking distance of everything in downtown Lisbon. As mentioned in the listing, it is on the 4th floor up very steep steps so make sure you are able to physically carry all of your luggage. Would recommend to a friend!

What a great, funky apartment in an absolutely amazing city. The apartment was super clean, had everything we needed with nice touches such as fresh bread and butter/jams for hungry travellers on arrival. We forgot our city guide and our adapter and found both to borrow in the apartment. It is located near to the river - with river views  - and was near to original and very cool little bars, restaurants and cafes and within walking distance of all that we wanted to see. We fell totally in love with Lisbon. I cannot recommend this highly enough.

Disclaimer: we were traveling with two kids (3 and 1)
Good:
- location, right near cais de sodre. Near metro bus, and tram
-value
Not good:
- I would not recommend this place if you are traveling with kids. The stairs, uneven floors, protruding nails on the original wood frames and floor made it difficult to stay with the kids.
- if you don’t like the smell of cigarette you should avoid this place too because the neighbor (next building) smokes on the window and it’s right beside the kitchen.
- the host was not as responsive (I think he was away). The wife answered few questions over the phone, but it wasn’t a warm, helpful welcome like other reviewers have mentioned and what I was hoping for. This could be a stand alone case but that’s what happened to me

房源頗具特色，交通也很方便，靠近地鐵站，附近就有多條公車路線通往城市各處，隔音很好，即使在大路旁但晚上也相當安靜。房東人很貼心，我們到達時發現房東留下水果、麵包跟蜂蜜果醬等禮物。
需要注意的是，這是間老房子的頂層閣樓，房間內動線不是很良好，部分設備也已老舊而未更換或維修，暖氣只有兩台小型葉片式暖爐，晚上實在不太夠用，廁所內也缺少抽風設備導致有些潮濕。
Agradecemos a maravilhosa hospitalidade de Inês, adoramos tudo.

Inês & António’s place is perfectly located near Cais do Sodré station with easy access to the Lisbon metro as well as trains to Belém, Cascais, and Sintra.  Also very close to the riverfront and Lisbon’s historic districts.  It’s a great base for exploring Lisbon and nearby.  The apartment has character and artistic touches, and there was some fresh bread with butter and jam waiting on our arrival, which was a nice welcome.  We didn’t mind the many stairs up to the apartment, but overall it was a little hard to move around in the space if you’re tall and no longer in your twenties.  Both applies to us.

The apartment is clean and fun, with many thoughtful touches in snacks and games provided by the hosts. The building's age provides a nice connection to Lisbon's history.
The kitchen, bath, and internet are basic but appropriate for a short or medium term visit. The second bedroom has a low-ceiling and a floor-level mattress.
The location is very convenient for transportation and exploring. Since it is in the urban center, there is street life late into the night.
The unusual entrance through a tourist shop makes the apartment feel more secure, as the shopkeeper is keeping watch and the entrance is somewhat hidden.

Location Location Location! Very nice appartment in a great central location near the waterfront in the heart of Lisbon. Only the 5 stairs you have to take to get there might be a problem for some. If you’re fit: Don’t hesitate, just book!
Super Lage, tolles Appartement- jederzeit gerne wieder.

We had an amazing stay at Inês & António’s place, beyond our expectations!
The apartment in itself is clean, stylish and well located. The local tips from their guestbook and various guidebooks were incredibly helpful, very nice addition.
Thanks, will rent again when we come back in Lisbon :)

We had a fantastic stay in Lisbon at Ines and Antonio s place. The apartment is great, very comfortable, well equiped, very well located, close to the sea, to the old town, close to the station and lots of amazing restaurants around. Inès and Antonio left very useful and convient stuff for us: all for the breakfast, soap, fruits... We definitely recommend for your next stay in Lisbon.

This appartment is very well located and easy to access by any means of transport. Ines and Antonio were very helpfull and had a lot of tips about Lisboa.
We left like home during our stay in their flat.

This place is amazing and you won’t regret booking it. The location is perfect and close to Cais de Sodré bus and train station. There are a lot of stairs, but the apartment is definitely worth it. We enjoyed all of the special touches that Ines and Antonio have added and you can tell they really care about making sure guests have a great experience. We would definitely stay here again. If you get a chance, rent a bike from the shop close to your apartment and ride to Belém tower. You won’t regret it!

Alle Erwartungen wurden um Längen übertroffen. Perfekte Lage für jedermann. Egal ob zur Stadtmitte oder zum Meer alles zu Fuß gut erreichbar.
Vollkommene Weiterempfehlung für jeden der Lissabon von allen Seiten kennen lernen möchte.

Such a beautiful home and an amazing airbnb experience! The apartment is very well designed and decorated, with so much attention to detail. We felt instantly at home and it has a nice view too. Communication was great and check in super easy. Well located to central Lisboa and especially our favourite Timeout market. Highly recommend for the perfect stay in a gorgeous city!

Great location and easy to get around from here. It's 91 steps to the apartment but having eaten like we did it helped burned those calories.
The thing that was really nice was that they left us fresh bread, milk, coffee and jam which was a lovely touch and saved us worrying about having to get shopping.
Perfect place to visit Lisbon with good restaurants within walking distance.

The appartement is very well placed in the center. Close from transports, sea, Shop, restaurants... it is very easy to do everything by walking.
A nice area to lay around the Tage.
The appartement is clean & nice, we were very happy to be welcomed, our guest also organise nice continental breakfast. Big thanks for this, we really enjoy to feel home the first morning.
I already plan to come back & recommend my friends to stay over.
Thank you

Beautiful and modern apartment in a very central location.   Ines and Antonio were a joy to deal with and they really have put a lot of thought and love into this home.   Fresh coffee and bread a welcome extra on our arrival and the basics are all provided.   A bit of a climb up the stairs but worth every minute and a great way to get fit in a beautiful city

O apartamento de Inês & António é exatamente como se vê nas fotos. Lindo, limpo e aconchegante. A localização é excepcional, tendo próximos estação de metrô, ônibus, supermercado, mercado da ribeira, rua cor de rosa... O contato com os anfitriões também é fácil. Inês e Antônio tiveram o cuidado de nos deixar alguma comida para que pudéssemos passar as primeiras horas com mais tranquilidade. Voltaria aqui sem dúvidas.

The apartment is really nice and well located as it is actually pretty much in the city center. The communication, check-in and check-out were really smooth and there were no problems at all. We would absolutely choose the apartment again if we ever visited Lisbon again!

Fantastic hosts and excellent Communication.
Beautiful spot and an excellent location!

Lisbon is such an incredible place to visit. That visit couldn’t have been without the amazing accommodations from Inês & António. The place was local to all shops, restaurants and main historical monuments.  Communication was excellent and would definitely recommend this place to anyone!

Perfect place! We stay a week with our 2 kids (aged 2 & 4) in this appartment, very well furnished, we feel like at home. Central place, you can reach any place in lisboa quickly et go to the beach directly at the train station.
We had good information to reach the place from the airport et things to do and see.
4th floor was not a problem for us, a beautiful view on the bridge.
Ines and Antonio's place was well located and easy to get around. The check in was easy and the apartment had everything we needed. Very clean and better than expected.

Ines and Antonio's place is a charming, quiet haven just on the edge of some of Lisbon's hotspots. We were only there for 2 nights, perfect October city break with tram tours, art museums and lots and lots of white Douro wine. A few minutes' walk from the Time Out food market, at the foot of the bairro alto and chiado areas, easy for public transport. The apartment was well equipped and very welcoming, quirky and with a real Lisbon feel. Great books to read and plenty of tips about what to do. Would definitely recommend this place - it's a little gem!

Tämä kohteen vuokraaminen oli kokonaisuutena onnistunut. Omistajan ennakkotiedot sekä ohjeet olivat selkeät ja täsmälliset. Kysymyksiin vastattin nopeasti. Ennakkotiedot asunnosta vastasivat pääosin todellisuutta. Sijainti 4. kerroksessa ilman hissiä ei tullut yllätyksenä. Kovin painavaa matkalaukkua en suosittele. Tiedoissa mainittu pyykinpesukone ei ollut käytössä. Asunto oli siisti. Varustelu oli hyvä. Asunto sijainti on kaupunkiin ja ympäristöön tutustumisen kannalta loistava. Kaikki julkisen liikenteen kulkuvälineet lähtevät tai menevät vierestä. Sijainnin varjopuolena on kadulla olevat äänet ympäri vuorokauden.
Good location .Comfortable and clean . Nice finishing touches .
This place is central in location. Close to lots of sites.
Great apartment... love the little touches. Great location!

El apartamento es una buhardilla preciosa llena de detalles pintorescos . La cama muy cómoda y la cocina totalmente equipada para realizar alguna comida. Inés y Antonio tuvieron el detalle de dejarnos fruta, leche, café, y algunas otras cosas para poder organizar el desayuno. El apartamento está limpísimo, no faltan toallas, plancha, secador de cabello, gel, champú....está aislado del ruido externo con unas buenas ventanas.
La situación es inmejorable, ya que tienes transporte muy fácil, además de estar muy céntrico., por lo que lo recomiendo sin dudarlo.
Además después de unos días, las piernas se fortalecen y la escalera que parece dura las primeras veces, ya no lo es tanto y resulta divertida.
La comunicación con ellos ha sido fantástica en todo momento. Nos hemos sentido muy cómodos y felices en su casa.
Highly recommended apartment in a great location in Lisbon. Clean, stylish, bright and very comfortable. Nice extra touches and recommendations. Would love to stay again.

Magnifique! J’avais déjà séjourné chez Inês et António il y a 4 ans avec une amie. Un grand plaisir d’y revenir en famille! Comme la première fois, tout était parfait: l’appartement est élégant et chaleureux, plein de caractère, le quartier vivant mais sans être bruyant. La communication et l’accueil également : Inês et António sont bienveillants et soucieux de nous savoir bien chez eux. MERCI! Et j’espère y revenir une 3ème fois. Je le recommande sans hésiter!
Gezellige plek

This place is in the heart of Lisbon.  Great location close to bars and restaurants.  Quirky entry to the apartment (you enter through a gift shop).  This is on the top level, which makes getting luggage upstairs a bit difficult.  That is listed on the post though.  91 steps to the entrance of the flat makes for a good workout.  :). The host was great and welcomed us with fresh grapes and bread.  Such a treat!

A very comfortable place, in a great location which is perfect for exploring the city and close to shopping, restaurants and nightlife.
Great hosts, overall highly recommended.
Este sótão tem uma energia e localização incríveis, além de tudo muito funcional. Maravilhoso...Ari

This apartment is one of the most picturesque places I have ever stayed in. I felt like a native not a tourist. But in addition to the wonderful accommodation we were made very welcome and helped with every detail. Even the small gesture of leaving us teas, coffees and advice on what to do in Lisbon was greatly appreciated.  My friends and I can not recommend this place enough and my only regret is that we were only in Lisbon for one night. We can not wait to come back
Très bien décorés et beaucoup d'informations sur Lisbonne

STAY HERE!!! Honestly, it is the most adorable apartment that makes you feel instantly at home when walking in. The stairs up may be a little steep but walking into a basket of fresh bread with jam and butter, some fruit and a personal note made it all worth it. Apartment is IMPECCABLY clean, beautifully decorated and has all the amenities you could want or need. This is more in the historical district of Lisbon which we much preferred over the downtown liberty ave scene where we stayed at the beginning of our trip. Just amazing! Walk out the door and get ready to explore the beautiful neighbourhood!! Thank you Ines and Antonio!!! xo from Canada

The apartment is stylishly furnished and it's location in the city centre is great - you can reach any place quickly by metro, train, bus or ferry even.
We arrived quite late, so we were very happy to find a little welcome tray with buns and grapes - showing the care and hospitality of Inês and António.
The communication with the hosts and the information they gave us for reaching the apartment was flawless and we can only recommend a stay here for a lovely experience in Lisbon!

Staying at Ines & Antonio's place was simply more than perfect.
They were able to stay in constant communication with me and answer all questions I had prior to arrival and once we arrived they ensured we found the place with ease and made us feel truly welcomed. The small touches of leaving out the essential bits of food and cold water, all the things you would want after travelling to be honest.
If available again I would pick this apartment as we had such a pleasant time and we found the space really perfect for our needs. Being on the top floors allows you to feel out of the way of the hustle and bustle, its not directly beneath you but great location as you can still feel like you're in the middle of it all!
Not only did Ines & Antonio go the extra mile by providing the essential bits for us upon arrival they were always available during our stay to answer any questions and the apartment was immaculately clean and very sweetly decorated. If you find this apartment available on the dates you need I would take it while you can (as long as you are ok with stairs)!
Five stars for I&A all the way! Thank you for everything, we can't wait to return.

I would definitely recommend this house. The stairs are very steep to get to the top (no elevator) and the space is a little tight for 3 people, but it was very conveniently located to the rest of the city, and Ines and Antonio gave us tons of information before we got there and also had lots of books and guides available for us. We never actually met them, but Antonio was always available by text if we needed him. Would recommend.

Die kleine aber sehr gemütliche Wohnung von Ines & Antonio liegt mitten in Lissabons Zentrum und ermöglicht den schnellen Zugang zu allen Sehenswürdigkeiten. Sie ist mit viel Liebe zum Detail eingerichtet, alles ist im besten Zustand und für uns war es kein Problem, dass es keinen Aufzug gibt. Die Gastgeber sind unglaublich freundlich und hilfsbereit. Wir haben die kurze Zeit in Lissabon gerade auch wegen der tollen Wohnung voll genossen.

Apartamento muy bonito y acogedor ubicado en una zona muy buena y accesible con unas vistas increíbles. Inés muy atenta a todas nuestras necesidades. La subida de las escaleras hasta el apartamento se ven recompensadas con las preciosas vistas desde él.
Apartamento rehabilitado con mucho gusto, tiene todos los detalles para hacer una estancia agradable.

Très bien situé, à proximité de nombreux quartiers intéressants et centraux de Lisbonne, cet appartement est idéal pour séjourner quelques jours. On se sent vite chez soi avec tout le charme d'un petit appartement sous les toits. Même si la montée des escaliers est un peu rude, cela vaut vraiment le coup ! Et Ines et Antonio ont tout prévu dans les moindres détails pour vous faire passer un bon séjour. Très bon souvenir. Merci encore !
Wonderful place and nice hosts !

Das Apartment entspricht zu 100% den Bildern und Beschreibungen - die Lage für eine Stadtbesichtigung ist perfekt. Wir haben uns von Anfang an sehr wohl gefühlt. Besonders hat uns die geschmackvolle, persönliche Einrichtung gefallen.

This apartment was the perfect location for young people in Lisbon. Unique, close to the market and Metro, and near anything cool to check out in Lisbon. The instructions were clear, the place was so cute. I am so happy we stayed here! Thank you for the hospitality and hopefully we will see you another summer in Lisbon! ❤️

Loistava kokonaisuus hyvälle lomalle. Asunnolle on helppo tulla lentokentältä, sijainti on lähellä kaikkea. Asunto on siisti ja tyylikäs. Isänniltä saat hyviä vinkkejä onnistuneelle lomalle. Suosittelen.

The apartment is really charming, it is tastefully furnished and we felt at home immediately. Ines and Antonio are great hosts, the communication was very friendly and uncomplicated.
We can highly recommend this place!

We felt very welcomed and enjoyed every aspect of our stay, from the bread and jam left for us to the nicely furnished flat, complete with an acoustic guitar. The bed is comfortable and the water pressure is great. The area is great for good food and has a nice little park nearby where our daughter could play. We would be fortunate to return again.

Appartement très charmant, propre, calme et très bien équipé, avec des propriétaires qui mettent tout en oeuvre pour accueillir au mieux leurs invités.
A choisir sans hésiter pour une escapade ou des vacances à Lisbonne !
The “White House” was a fantastic find for our family vacation and I couldn’t be happier with our choice.

Truly charming loft experience in a great location. World class, caring hosts!
Don't come with huge suitcases unless ready for Olympic decathlon, but if traveling relatively light, or very fit, it's well worth the 92 steps! Very sweet suite! We'd come back, even with our aging bodies!

I would definitely recommend this place and will come back on my next trip to Lisbon. Communication was very easy and always pleasant, Inês and António really thought of everything. The apartment was very clean and lovely and the location is unbeatable. You had to earn this little oasis by climbing up the stairs, but it was worth every effort. :) Inês and António really went the extra mile with hospitality and all the information and tips they provided. Thank you for everything!!

We hadden een prima verblijf in dit appartement.
Ondanks het feit dat het vier hoog was. Het was de moeite waard!

The appartment is perfectly located, right in the city center, yet quiet enough to get some sleep. It is very spacious, clean and beautifully decorated!
Ines and Antonio are great hosts, they provide you with very valuable inside-information. Staying at The White House absolutely adds to the pleasure of visiting Lisbon!

This is the best place to be, if you want to spend some days in this wonderful city, it's very central, still quiet and very stylish.
The host's are very helpful and communication is perfect, before & during the stay.
We will definitely come back
F&H

Die Wohnung von Ines und Antonio liegt zentral im Herzen von Lissabon und ist sehr gut zu erreichen (30 Minuten per Metro vom Flughafen). Wir konnten all unsere Ausflüge zu Fuß oder mit der Metro machen. Dank der ausgezeichneten Information, die wir von Ines und Antonio bekommen hatten fanden wir uns sofort zurecht und auch während unseres Aufenthalts hatten wir in den beiden immer einen Ansprechpartner wenn wir wollten.
Das Apartment is mit sehr viel Liebe zum Detail eingerichtet und super sauber.
Kurzum, eine perfekte Location für ein langes Wochenende in Lissabon!

Excellent location! Ines and Antonio were excellent hosts.
Close to everything and everyplace we wanted to tour plus public transportation close by to visit places further out. We rented a car for a few days and had no trouble parking it in the garage close to the apartment recommended by Antonio. Each night we walked to a different restaurant for dinner. One evening we enjoyed a dinner and Fado show at a place recommended by Alex (Antonio's son) also walking distance. The apartment is more beautiful in person than in photos. It is spacious and comfortable. I was a bit worried about the heat since it did not have air condition, but not to worry - the windows offer a nice ocean breeze. All in all, we enjoyed staying at this lovely Airbnd and recommend it to others. If every we return to Lisbon, we would stay there again.
Appartement idéalement situé . Hôtes très réactifs a toutes questions éventuelles. Enfants en bas âge et personnes âgées s'abstenir. Étages multiples .
Lovely apartment in a great location! I will stay there again the next time I'm in Lisbon. Ines & Antonio were great hosts!
Wonderful apartment! Very centrally located and well equipped. Communication was good, hosts were readily reachable via the app. We would definitely recommend staying here for your visit to Lisbon!
Nous étions 4 personnes et l'appartement est très bien équipé et agencé. Très bien placé ( 30 mn airport en bus ) et à 2mn du Tage. Nous recommandons vivement.

Cet appartement est idéalement placé. Proche de beaucoup de points d'intérêts à Lisbonne et aussi de la vie nocture (bars et restaurants), sans pour autant nous empêcher de dormir. Tout est très propre et bien expliqué et Inês et Antonio nous avaient laissé de quoi faire un petit-déjeuner royal.
Vraiment un bon accueil et de super hôtes. Je retournerai chez eux et je ne peux que conseillé ce logement.
Très bon rapport qualité prix.
