Awesome space, and great location! Great option to stay when exploring Lisbon! We were able to navigate easily, and our hosts were so welcoming! Would recommend.
This is a beautiful apartment, its very easy to get to and a perfect place to stay and explore the city.

This truly is a hidden gem in the center of Lisbon. The apartment is beautiful - with authentic Portuguese charm which was not wasted on my boyfriend and I. Ines and Antonio left us a few thoughtful goodies and provided incredibly useful and detailed instructions. The apartment is right in the city center, an easy walking distance from many restaurants, the sea and the main square. All Adam and I can say is thank you for letting us stay in your beautiful home!

Although this was my first time in Lisbon, this has to be the best apartment with the best hosts in the whole city! Friendly, caring, fast and ecxellent communication, you just could not ask for better hosts! The Apartment itself is extremely stylish with a great eye and love for design and small suprising and beautiful details. Whether you just want a great place to stay or a magical hideaway place in this beautiful city, I recommend highly to come to Ines & Antonio! Again many thanks and see you soon! :)

This apartment is really lovely and comfortable. Centrally located and close to main attractions. And with all the public transportation supporting with walkable distance makes your trip in Lisbon very convenient.
Apartment is well furnished and decorated, clean and quiet, well ventilated and natural lighted. Bed is comfortable and clean. A book with all the shared information collected by previous guests can be found and it is quite useful.
Hosts are very nice people, patience and sharing a lot useful information and they will make you feel Lisbon is welcoming your visit. If you see this apartment available just don't hesitate to make your decision and book it.
Charmant appartement et super accueil, nous avons été ravis de notre séjour. Situation idéale, proche de tout mais calme la nuit, un grand coup de cœur.

Thank you, everything was perfect in the apartment: coffee, rolls, towels, cleanliness ...
The apartment is ideally located, and Lisbon is a fabulous city!

Beautifully styled apartment, rich in character and spotlessly clean! The communications with Ines & Antonio was good and they not only provided good instructions prior to arrival but also left a thoughtful welcome note and basket of bread, fruit, preserves. The power shower was awesome though the placement of the shower-head would better suit those taller than 5'9, which I am not. The stairs provides a welcome challenge for those that are fit and thought I found it very challenging, even my 5 months pregnant friend took it slowly and managed ok. The only issue was that as it is an attic apartment, we felt that we had to be mindful of the low roof in places, which was at times awkward and also in the smaller room, I wasn't prepared for the single bed to be a mattress on the floor - this would be fine for kids and perhaps some adults but limits how you use that room unless you are little. In terms of location, the apartment was perfectly located to get to shops, nightlife and culture.

Inês & António’s place is truly in the center of the action! A great location, but also amazingly quiet and private due to its fourth floor location. The apartment itself is tastefully furnished and decorated and has everything you need for a comfortable stay. The view from the apartment is amazing too! It is the kind of place you don't want to leave! They provide thorough information and tips about Portugal that we found very helpful, and were incredibly responsive communicators, being very tolerant of our travel plans, which changed a couple times due to some problems with the airline. We would definitely recommend it to anyone interested in being in a convenient location, but still desiring a relaxing nook in a charming building to get away from all the activity going on outside. We had a very brief in-person interaction with Antonio, but could tell he was full of energy and joy...and probably full of great stories about Lisbon!

Nous avons passé une merveilleuse semaine dans cet agréable appartement de Lisbonne où tout était simplement parfait!  Très bien situé, près du Tage, de la place du Commerce, des transports, restos, quelques commerces, dont le fantastique marché Ribeira, aménagé et décoré avec beaucoup de soin et de goût,  impeccablement propre, et très fonctionnel.  Et que dire de l'accueil? Pain et fruits frais, café, miel, confiture, mais plus encore la disponibilité et grande gentillesse de nos hôtes.   À recommander sans réserve, en tenant compte de la présence de nombreuses marches à monter pour y accéder, tel que précisé dans l'offre. Merci Inès et António d'avoir contribué à rendre notre séjour si agréable et mémorable!
The gorgeous apartment of Ines and Antonio is in a great location, clean and everything was exactly as advertised! We had a wonderful time in Lisbon staying there!

Well located and perfectly set up for a short visit. Clean and comfortable with one bedroom with double bed and a second with a single mattress on the floor. Train, tram and metro minutes away and the fantastic Time Out Market just down the street. Don't miss that! Ines and Mario were great at covering my butt when I left my passport on the plane. They met my friend to let him into the apartment while I dealt with my brain cramp at the airport. All's well that ends well, right? It is mentioned in the apartment description but I feel I must reiterate... there are a lot of stairs. 80 to be exact but stairs and hills will soon become a part of the Lisboa experience. Go with it!
Genial apartamento. Muy céntrico. Anfitrión muy atento con nosotros
We enjoyed our stay at the apparment a lot - the location, the appartment style it was a perfect beginning for our Lisboa trip.
Lovely apartment, great location. Exactly as it looks in the pictures and I&A were really prompt and responsive and friendly. Highly recommend.

Beautiful apartment, great view and superb location to explore the city. Ines and Antonio are also very nice, easy and fast communication and always there in case you need some help. Totally recommend this place!

Wat was het heerlijk in het appartement van Ines & Antonio. Van te voren hele duidelijke informatie gekregen. Snelle reacties op mijn berichten. Appartement is zeer goed gelegen tov openbaar vervoer en de bezienswaardigheden. Velen op loopafstand. Appartement ligt op 4e verdieping. Hele klim maar meer dan waard. Heel ruim voor 4 personen. Alles wat je nodig hebt, en meer, is aanwezig. Bij aankomst stond er een mandje met vers brood en beleg. Koffi melk en water. Top. Alle privacy. Aankomst en vertrek in goed overleg. Kan appartement aan iedereen aanbevelen.

Inês & António were great hosts and always quick to reply to any questions we had. Their apartment was very clean and just as described. The location is also prefect, just next to the train station and Time Out food market, as well as being close by to all the main sights. We will definitely be returning again! Thanks for the stay!

Inês & António’s apartment exceeded all my expectations - it is a beautiful flat that strikes the perfect balance between feeling homely without feeling like you are trespassing in someone else's space. The apartment is ideally located, no more than 20 minutes walk from all the main attractions (no more than 5 minutes for most!) and has everything you need and more in terms of amenities. There are some lovely little quirks inside too which just further adds to its charm. I have stayed at quite a few Airbnb's in my time and I can honestly say, without even having met I&A, they were the most helpful, friendly and attentive hosts I have come across. It was a pleasure, and I can happily report that my friends and I all fell in love with Lisbon whilst staying in this apartment.
In more practical apartment terms - shower pressure is great, coffee machine was a life saver, proximity/location is perfect (close to shops, restaurants and train station... yet as the flat is on top floor, very quiet too). We were a group of 4 mid-20s friends and the apartment perfectly suited our needs.

Really wonderful apartment. Beautiful, quiet and very comfortable bed. Few minutes walk to Time out market, the metro, Tram 28 and great shopping. Really made us feel like we experienced life in Lisbon like a local. Although we did not meet Ines and Antonio, we met their children who were very sweet and showed us around the apartment and where we could eat. Their son helped us with our bags up the four flights of stairs. Ines and Antonio were extremely accommodating with all our minor requests and would always get back to us right away on the app. Awesome location, clean comfy apartment, nice hosts, great value. 100% recommend and would stay again!

I can't say enough about this place and the hosts. They were wonderful and made the experience very welcoming even though we only stayed one night before heading back home.
When we arrived, they were there to greet us and let us in. They gave us the most wonderful bread you have ever eaten as a welcome snack. The apartment was quiet and well located. Nice shower and bed. Would definitely stay here again!
Tout était parfait jusque dans les moindres détails. Inês et Antonio méritent cette avalanche de commentaires dithyrambiques !

Amazing place. Me and my girlfirend enjoyed our stay verry very much. It is very well equiped and we instantly felt like home. Also the hosts are organizing everything very professionally, so nothing can go wrong.

N'hésitez pas!
- Un emplacement au cœur de Lisbonne qui permet de visiter la ville aussi bien à pied, qu'en transport en commun.
- Un appartement très confortable, typique et très accueillant.
- Des hôtes soucieux de votre confort et de votre bien-être.
Notre voyage en famille a été une réussite, nous sommes venus pour voir Lisbonne, nous reviendrons peut-être un jour pour retrouver ce nid douillet....
Tout simplement parfait. Situation, propreté, accueil, séjour,...
Good location. We can walk to those famous attractions. Cozy and comfortable.

Clean, comfortable accommodations. Very well stocked and thoughtfully equipped apartment. Kind hosts, very responsive throughout. Location was great in terms of transport links but just a little off centre, but good value for money. Highly recommended overall.

Definitely recommend. Our host was perfect, the location was close to everything we need. The main connection station is only a two minutes walking distance, as well as the beautiful lake shore - mmmm, the coffees we've had there :) Extremely  clean and attention to details (such as the jelly and the fruits for breakfast) made our holiday the perfect escape to Lisbon. Thank you for that Ines&Antonio. See you again in the future :)

Beautiful, spacious, clean top floor unit very close to the waterfront. Walkable and close to good places to eat. Ines and Antonio communicated frequently and were easy to reach if we had any concerns or needs; they left us some breakfast food, coffee, and wine which was a nice touch and made us feel welcome. We would absolutely stay again!

C'est un bel appartement à deux pas de Cais do Sodré donc du métro, du train pour les plages, des restaurants, bars etc. Tout est bien organisé par les propriétaires qui sont très disponibles si on a besoin de quoi que ce soit. La réception des clés est très simple et pratique. Pour le reste c'est bien équipé, notamment si vous voyagez avec de jeunes enfants (attention en revanche c'est au 4e étage sans ascenseur). Seule petite chose à savoir si vous avez le dos sensible, le matelas du lit est très ferme et pas hyper confortable.

Inês & António are the perfect Airbnb hosts, warm and welcoming. One of the reasons to choose Airbnb over a hotel is the people, living like and with the locals. Inês & António respected our privacy while making our visit absolutely perfect. They were available to us to answer any questions and even left us a lovely basket of local goodies on arrival. The apartment is lovely, filled with light and local Lisbon charm. Don't be afraid to climb the six flights of stairs because the reward at the top is totally worth it. One of my best Airbnb experiences ever.

The apartment was in the heart of the old city. Very close to the shops and restaurants. We had a great view of the fireworks on New Year's Eve from the apartment. It was clean and inviting. We loved staying there. Thank you Ines and Antonio for having us.

Super accueil et famille formidable dans ce très charmant appartement sous les toits de Lisboa
Très propre et lumineux c est quand même un challenge de monter les 4 étages mais Lisboa est la ville des escalier
Emplacement parfait pour visite de La ville et en bonus un super petit déjeuner nous attendait
Merci

L'appartement est parfait et super bien situé ! Il est à porté de marche de toute la ville. En quelques pas vous arriverez à tout les lieus historiques et touristiques pour les familles. La vie nocturne est littéralement juste à côté également puisque les bars et boîtes de nuit sont dans la rue adjacente.
Très propre et au calme l'appartement est joliment décoré. Bien que n'ayant pu rencontrer nos hôtes ils se sont avérés à nos petits soins, et extrêmement joignable.
Je recommande fortement !

Great flat and position! Inês and António are really kind and helpful.
We'll come back for sure!

Inês & António are great hosts. Apartment is spacious and clean. You have a nice view from the window. The location is great. You can walk or use public transportation to major traveler's destinations within and around center-city.
L'appartement correspond parfaitement aux photos , très propre

Good location if you want to be close to the water, train station, and walking distance to most tourist spots. Pretty views from south facing windows. The kitchen is well equipped if you want to cook a meal. The shower runs out of hot water a little quicker than most places we've stayed throughout Europe. The host left nice snacks (oranges, bread, butter, tea, cookies) on our arrival which was appreciated.
Truly the most gracious hosts, on so many levels, that I've ever experienced in an Airbnb.

Inês & António were extremely prompt with their responses and the instructions they left were most helpful and made the entire experience run smoothly.
Their house was lovely and as described in the posting. I would highly recommend staying with them.
I really loved this apartment! Really beautifully furnished with a homely feel, will definitely stay here again :)
super !

Nous vous recommandons vivement l'appartement d'Ines et Antonio. Il est idéalement situé dans le centre de Lisbonne et permet de visiter très facilement cette belle ville. Il est également décoré avec beaucoup de soin et on se sent immédiatement comme à la maison. En arrivant dans la soirée, nous avions un plateau d'accueil ce qui est aussi très agréable. Si nécessaire, la famille est disponible pour fournir des informations utiles et nous avons apprécié leur gentillesse.

Ines & Antonio were incredible hosts, and The White House is the perfect destination for your Lisbon trip. The views from the apartment window overlook the quintessential 25 De Abril Bridge & Christ the King, which are a must-see! Great proximity to the Time Out Market (one of our favorite Lisbon bucket list items) as well. Also, it is worth mentioning that this was by far the cleanest Airbnb that I've ever stayed in, and I really appreciated the welcoming accoutrements that they left out for us upon arrival - bread/jam, chilled water, and wine - to name a few. I would highly recommend booking this listing for anyone visiting Lisbon who loves great views, awesome location, and first-rate hospitality.

Arrivés devant l'immeuble vers 22h00 Antonio nous a accueilli depuis son balcon en nous faisant signe. lls nous ont aidé à monter nos bagages et le petit déjeuner avait été gentillement préparé pour le lendemain matin.
Appartement très cosy, idéalement placé pour visiter la ville est ses environs. Le soir pas besoin d'aller bien loin pour sortir faire la fête. Au milieu de la vie, nocturne mais au calme.

Un super séjour notamment grâce à Antonio et Inès !
L'appartement est parfait ! Les photos de l'annonce sont exactement ce que vous allez trouver en arrivant !
Nous avons beaucoup échangé par mail avec Antonio pour préparer notre arrivée et avec tous ces bons conseils tout a été facile à l'arrivée, au départ et lors de notre séjour.
L'accueil était parfait avec de très bons conseils pour aller diner rapidement le premier soir et pour organiser nos journées ensuite.
Les différentes contributions des voyageurs précédents nous ont aussi aidé à dénicher les bons plans.
Antonio et Ines avaient même prévu des fruits frais au frigo et le nécessaire complet (pain, confiture, miel, lait café ...) pour le petit déjeuner .
L'appartement est idéalement situé à 2 pas de Baixa Chiado, de Praça Do Commerco et de la Gare de Cais Do Sodré ...
L'appartement est très calme, à la décoration cosy et très bien équipé. Rien ne manque ...
Nous ne pouvons que recommander Inès et Antonio et leur appartement pour un séjour réussi à Lisbonne.

Simply the best! Second time I stay at The White House and the experience was just superb. Everything! From the place itself, the location, the views and, last but not least, the hosts. Ideal place to establish a pied-à-terre and explore the city from there.

I&A were wonderful hosts from the very first communication to the very last. Although we did not meet personally, they prepared a very warm welcome for us waiting in the apartment. They are extremely responsive and I highly recommend this apartment for anyone looking to be in the heart of Lisbon! They provide an insiders guide to the area, which was very helpful for us as we only stayed two nights.
As they warned us ahead of our stay, please be aware that this is a fourth floor walk up, so if you aren't so great on stairs perhaps this won't be the best place for you.
Thanks again for everything!

We were 2 people staying in the apartment during the beginning of October.
The hosts were very helpful during our stay and answered all our questions in a timely manner.
The apartment was comfortable and fulfilled our needs. The fast internet was useful for me needing to do some work during the trip.
Location wise the apartment is in the best area with only a short walk away from many of the best coffee shops and historic sites.
Can recommend for other guests!
Best place in Lisbon. Thanks for all!

Our experience was great! The host was very helpful throughout the time of our stay. We were able to find the location with ease thanks to the host communicating instructions to us on a regular basis. Don't hesitate choosing this location!!!

This place is amazing! I would recommend it to anyone that likes to experience the main attractions as well as places out of the main tourist areas. It's a perfect location! Ines and Antonio are gracious host and made us feel welcome the moment we stepped in the apartment with fresh baked bread with honey and wine. They gave fantastic recommendations! Also if you stay be sure to check out the challenge box. As lovers of art they encourage visitors to create art to frame and hang in the apartment.  We'll be back for sure!

From the start communication was exemplary. Ines and Antonio were extremely quick to respond to all queries and the information that was provided was extremely detailed and accurate. Instructions were clear to follow, the Facebook page they have set up is excellent and the information provided regarding the local area was useful and accurate.
The apartment is wonderful with all the amenities you could wish for. We were greeted with a bottle of wine, fresh fruit and rolls and honey for breakfast which was unexpected and delightful to receive. It was 5 star service and very much appreciated. It was extremely clean and has a light and airy feel. It was ideally located being a short walking distance from all the major sites and excellent access to all forms of transport. Ines and Antonio were wonderfully helpful and I cannot stress strongly enough what a delight it was to stay in this really special residence. The journey from the airport was simple due to the instructions provided. We took the train from the airport into the centre of the city without any problems at all. It was excellent value for money and if you manage to book it you are extremely lucky. Wonderful hosts, wonderful apartment, wonderful location and a wonderful time.

This apartment was absolutely fantastic - close to everything, incredibly clean and cosy with little treats (wine, bread rolls etc) which was a welcome surprise!

Cannot rate it highly enough.
Fantastic location, wonderful flat, Ines  and Antonio are highly hospital and thought of everything.
Amazing hosts and gorgeous flat. What a great experience!
O apartamento é um charme e possui uma localização magnífica. As dicas fornecidas pela Inês valem ouro e fazem toda diferença.  Recomendo muito!!

This apartment is just lovely. Excellent location, just as described - the pictures don't do justice to how lovely it is. Ines was an excellent host. We didn't actually meet in the end - just a coincidence - but I met her son who ran out into the street to find us on the first night as we wandered past looking for the apartment. What a lovely welcome to Lisbon. Excellent communication all the way which made us feel safe and secure in this welcoming city. I would absolutely recommend staying here - I hope to come back!

This is one of the best places I have rented. A charming top-floor apartment with character beams and every convenience you could wish for. Ones &Antonio arranged everything perfectly and even provided us with breakfast & cold beer in the fridge for the hot Lisbon days. They were super helpful and the flat is in a fantastic location. I would recommend to anybody & would love to return sometime.

This was a prefect base to explore Lisbon, and Ines and Antonio are the perfect hosts. They had thought of everything to make the apartment comfortable, homely and very stylish. All the suggestions they left for guests were very helpful, and the bread and jam was perfect for breakfast. I'd thoroughly recommend this apartment to anyone coming to delightful Lisbon!
Host was very accommodating and helpful. Allowed us to check in earlier. House was fully stocked with supplies and he even provided us with recommendations on places to visit.

La corbeille de fruits frais a été très appréciée... le logement est conforme au descriptif et bien situé pour découvrir Lisbonne que nous recommandons à tous.

Bien amicalement

Jeanne et Patrice
What a hotspot! Great apartment! 5 stars!!!

I&A apartment is even better than its photographs show due to the small details prepared by I&A to their guests. They even had fresh water and fruit on fridge expecting for us! The apartment is charming and very well treated. The location is fantastic, near the Center and with very transport facilities. If you travel with kids, this is the best option for you! They now what kids like. They think on them! They prepared a lot of advices for their guests in order to guarantee the best journey at Lisbon. It was a please being at I&A apartment.

Everything was perfect !
from the visit preparation to the warm welcome, including the fruits in the fridge !
the apartment was exactly what we expected, and is so charming
the situation is perfect, very easy to move from and to the apartment
what else ? this is OUR recommendation to stay in Lisbon, if you are 2 or 3
Ines and Antonio are perfect guests

If you visit Lisbon, you must stay at I&A's beautiful place. Our stay went from great to wonderful by staying at this apartment: perfect location, lovely furnished, incredibly welcoming hosts. It was the best Airbnb experienced I've ever had!

Ines and Antonios space exceeded all already high expectations. Such a lovely space and a perfect location in Lisbon. So many little touches really made the space feel like home. We didn't have enough time to meet I and A, but their communication was lovely, and based on their taste and hospitality, we would have loved to. Feel lucky for the experience!!!

Thanks a lot to Ines & Antonio for the nice welcome and nice attentions during our stay !
Great appartment in a nice location.

The apartment was very clean, comfortable, and centrally located.  The hosts left us fruit, coffee, bread, jam, honey, cold water, and wine for our arrival -- what a nice treat!  It was very very hot in Lisbon the two days we stayed here (95-98 degrees F).  Thus, we were very happy that this top floor (attic) apartment included three very good electric fans, because we surely needed them!  It cooled off enough at night that we slept very comfortably.  There are more than 5 flights of steep narrow stair steps from the street level up to the apartment (this is included in the listing), which we felt we could manage; however, it was tough with our big roller suitcases, perhaps more so because of the heat.  The area around the apartment is very busy, with a lot of car/bus traffic and narrow sidewalks with lots of people coming and going, construction noise, restaurant dishes clattering, etc.  It is very close to the subway stop and lots of sights and activities (so it's great for a base), but it's not located on a particularly charming street.

My recent stay at The White House was wonderful in every way. Ines and Antonio go out of their way to see that everything is ready and welcoming, from the welcome fruit, breads, jam and honey to the bottles of ice cold water and wine. I appreciated the thorough weekly cleaning during my long stay, especially the exquisite bed linens. The apartment is conveniently situated for easy access to all sorts of dining, shopping, and recreational activities. My friends and I loved being able to hop on a ferry for an impromptu lunch across the river and taking the train to many different beaches. The apartment has all sorts of print resources to help a new visitor learn more about Portugal in general and Lisbon in particular. Perhaps the best way to bring this city into your life is to wander neighborhoods and discover the beauty, excitement, and gentleness that this remarkable Lisbon has to offer. And there's no better place from which to do that than The White House. I hope to return soon!

Super séjour dans le bel appartement d'Inês & António, idéalement situé près de tous les commerces et d'une gare permettant de se rendre directement à la mer.
Accueil chaleureux et excellente communication avec les hôtes, quelques marches à gravir pour accéder à l'appartement, mais la récompense en arrivant dans un cadre très agréable, avec vue lointaine sur le Tage.
Le plus : la literie confortable et le panier de petit-déjeuner à l'arrivée. Merci encore pour tout !
It is great apartment with best location. It is on 4th floor no elevator so better pack with light luggages to stay there.
They could not have made us feel more welcomed. Beautiful home as described. There was fresh bread and chilled beer waiting for us. Such a fun neighborhood to be in. Would love to rent again.
Extremely welcoming hosts who were more than happy to give tips and advice about transports and activities around the city. Adorable apartment in a superb location. Could not recommend more.

We stayed at Inês & António's on our last day in Portugal, though I really wish we had started out here.

This charming apartment has been lovingly furnished and is full of guide books with everything you need to know (places to eat, things to do). It's the little details that make the difference, though (bread, butter, honey and fruit, coffee and tea, over sized towels, a table fan for the night, sketch books to draw in, notebooks filled with recommendations from previous guests..).

If there were more than five stars to give, this place would get it. We're definitely staying here again the next time we visit!

We absolutely loved the apartment. Everything about it was like home. The warm welcome fruit and bread was amazing. The location was easy to find if you follow the instruction clearly. Most of the places you want to visit is just around a few mins walk. If that's not enough, the metro station is just 3-5 mins away by walk. You can take the tram or train to anywhere you want to visit.
The facebook page from the host was the best! You can find all the things you don't want to miss about Lisbon. We truly felt like local. I traveled with my mom to Lisbon. And she is usually harder to say nice word about hotels etc., but this time she was so happy with "the White House." And we would love to stay longer if not due to the travel schedule limit.
推荐指数5颗星 (Highly Recommended)！

Just returned from a wonderful short break in Lisbon and this is the perfect place to stay.   Gorgeous apartment very well equipped and with stunning views over the roof tops to the bridge.  So close to everything we just walked everywhere and only a couple of minutes from the station so very easy airport transfer.  Wouldn't stay anywhere else in Lisbon. Perfect

Very welcoming host and an amazing apartment. Ines and Antonio have thought of every single detail in order to help enjoy your stay. It was impressive. I will say....you'll have to go through a 5 page welcome email with a ton of info but all the information you need will be on there. I guess my suggestion is to take your time to read through the very long email first so you can just show up and avoid a lot of back and forth like I found my self doing (sorry about that Ines!)
Also, please remember it is on the 4th floor as the hosts states in description. If you're bouncing around a lot, this might be something to consider. My friend and I are from NYC and used to a lot of walking, stairs, you name it...but this is a trek up to the apt. The location was nice, definitely several bars and restaurants to go to. It's a 10-15 min walk to proper barrio alto which was a bit more our style but also enjoyed coming back to a quieter neighborhood after a long day. It just depends what you prefer. I would definitely recommend this apartment.
Great place!  Hosts were very sweet and left us some food and wine.  Wonderful location near the water and walking distance to the happening neighborhoods.

Ines and Antonio are the perfect hosts. They take care of everything! The communication was very clear and detailed, the arrival went perfect, they came up with a lot of recommendations and the appartement was a bijou: exactly like on the pictures, very clean, charming – the best! We really enjoyed the time in lisbon.

Inès et Antonio sont des hotes charmant et plein d'intention. L'appartement est conforme à l'annonce et aux photos. Il est très bien situé, au pied des stations de bus, métro et tramways.
Nous avons passé un très bon moment et nous n'hésiterons pas à revenir dans cet endroit "magique".
Encore merci à Ines et Antonio et à très bientôt ....

Desde a entrada no edifício que se sente que este é um local especial. A carga histórica, a decoração e o ambiente geral do apartamento tornaram esta estadia numa experiência memorável.
O acolhimento e a comunicação por parte da Inês e do António foram excelentes. Definitivamente um local a recomendar para quem quer ter uma experiência genuína e verdadeiramente lisboeta.

The daughter of the family let us in and the flat was exactly as described/shown albeit a bit darker. Very well equipped and centrally located, everything can be done on foot. Thanks for the breakfast and the fruit!

We were greeted with a bounty of strawberries, wine, bread, and jam upon our arrival to this cozy and well-appointed apartment that is situated near the water in Lisbon- a nice welcome by our hosts Ines and Antonio. When we had questions about finding our bike tour, they were very prompt and helpful in getting  back with us. The apartment is cozy, clean, and well supplied with maps and books to guide us through Lisbon. We loved this place, and highly recommend it. Can't wait to go back!

Wunderbare Gastgeber in einer sehr schönen Wohnung! Ines&Antonio haben, als ich während meines Aufenthalts krank wurde, direkt angeboten, mich zum Krankenhaus zu bringen und zu dolmetschen. Glücklicherweise wurde es aber wieder besser, so dass dies nicht nötig war... Wenn man krank ist, ist man ja eigentlich am liebsten zuhause: Aber wenn man schon auf einer Reise krank wird, dann doch tatsächlich am besten in einer so schönen Wohnung und dem guten Gefühl einer großzügigen und ganz herzlichen Unterstützung!

The apartment was beautiful, clean, comfortable, easy to get to from the airport, centrally located, with an amazing view. It had a great sense of history but all modern amenities. We arrived to a basket of bread, jam, honey, strawberries and wine, a very considerate B n' B b touch. There were also tons of guidebooks and suggestions for what to do in Lisbon.

The hosts were incredibly responsive and got back to all of our messages within minutes. They helped us with everything from figuring out how to use the washer to figuring out how to get to our next destination. Super friendly and there whenever/if you need them.

I basically wanted to move into the apartment and never leave. Highly recommended.

What a nice and coosy appartment! We had e great week, every day passing the very friendly caretaker downstairs always in for a smile. Nearby the square where we had our breakfast in the sun. Taking the train to Cascais, only a 5 minutes walk to the station.

Thanks!

Llegamos muy tarde y Antonio estaba esperándonos. Además de las instrucciones, nos contó que había dejado cosas para alimentarnos, antes de descansar y dormir. El departamento está perfecto, muy bien ubicado, central, y para una noche, no está mal subir los 4 pisos de escaleras. Es muy lindo y limpio el lugar y perfectamente equipado, tal como lo describen. Fuimos bien acogidos en las pocas horas que estuvimos allí..

We had a wonderful time in Lisbonne thanks to Inês&Antonio. They're so much involved in our comfort (for adults and kids), we really appreciated it. Antonio gave us precious advice for the following trip in Portugal. Muito obrigado! Sophie&Greg

This is a great place to stay. Ines & Antonio are excellent hosts  (e.g they surprised us with an early check-in as they knew we were arriving early to the city, and left us some bread, jam, milk & strawberries in the apartment to find on arrival) and the apartment itself is located in central Lisbon and within easy walking distance of many of the tourist attractions. It is also very well placed for travel along the coast as the train line to Cascais (which can take you to Belem, Caxias, Estoril, Cascais ...) is only minutes away. The property is very clean and well equipped, and as it is on the top floor of a building, quiet despite its central location. Communication both prior to the stay, during and after was great. I would stay here again, and would highly recommend.

The experience in The White House was amazing. It's a very beautiful and charming apartment, and we (my mom and I) loved every minute staying there. When we arrived Ines & Antonio left fresh strawberries and tasteful bread, and we could even make our own cafe latte in the kitchen! Really awesome. The communication also went very smoothly. Highly recommend this place and hope to be back one day. Because you just got to love this place and the great city of Lisbon!

"Best in class"
Ines et Antonio sont des personnes passionnées et passionnantes.
L'accueil est hors du commun avec gentillesse et prévenance. Les petits pains, le miel la confiture, les boissons etc... vous attendent avec un petit mot d'accueil dans ce très bel appartement idéalement situé, très bien décoré et parfaitement équipé. Et que dire de la dernière journée ou nous avons eu la chance de visiter le quartier avec Antonio. Génial !
Pour une première avec "airbnb" c'est une totale réussite.
Absolument rien à redire... Si : Nous reviendrons.

Estava em Lisboa com a minha amiga para fazer férias pela 4 dias.
A casa de António e Ines foi espectacular.
O apartamento e grande, limpo, lindo, calmo e cómodo, perto do Cais do Sodré em centro da cidade, em centro da vida. Nós fizemos muitos excursões em pé. A vida da noite tem lugar na vizinhança e não precisamos um táxi a noite. A família do Ines e António foi mais de simpática, é uma família franca e hospitaleira. Eu vou voltar em todo o cabo, também para comer o bacalhau.

I've been to Lisbon with a friend for holiday. The house of Ines and Antonio was spectacularly. The apartment was big, clean beautiful, quiet and comfortable, near Cais do Sodre, in the city's center, in the center of life. We've done our excursions by foot. The nightlife was in the neighborhood, at night it wasn't necessary to take a taxi at home.
The family of Ines and Antonio was more than sympathetic, it's a cosmopolitan and hospitable family.
I'll definitely come back also to eat the bacalhau.

Mit meiner Freundin war ich 4 Tage in Lissabon. Das Haus von Ines und Antonio war spektakulär. Das Apartment war groß, sauber, schön, ruhig und gemütlich, direkt am Cais do Sodre , im Stadtzentrum, da wo das Leben tobt. Wir konnten alle Ausflüge zu Fuß machen und auch im Nachtleben, welches in direkter Nachbarschaft stattfindet, ist kein Taxi notwendig. Die Familie von Ines und Antonio war mehr als sympathisch, weltoffen und gastfreundlich. Ich werde auf jeden Fall wieder kommen... um dann auch endlich Bacalhau zu essen."

Cette première expérience Airbnb est une réussite. L'appartement était conforme à la description et nous avons eu tous les éléments qui nous étaient nécessaires pour vivre ces quelques jours dans les meilleures conditions : organisation du départ et arrivée, situation géographique, infos touristiques... Enfin un accueil chaleureux qui nous laisse que de jolis souvenirs ! Merci !

We have stayed 5 days with 2 children at the apartment of Antonio & Ines!  We have had a wonderful stay at Lissabon thanks to the great apartment (location, rooms, kitchen,...) and the useful tips and information of Antonio!

Staying at Inês and António's apartment was an absolute pleasure! They were very responsive and gave us lots of tips and information about Lisbon.
When we arrived, tired and stressed from driving through Lisbon (something we urge you to avoid at all costs), our hosts had left some food for us in the kitchen so that we wouldn't have to go back out right away.
We never actually met Inês and António, which is a shame. They invited us for coffee, but we already had plans.
The apartment itself is very comfortable and modern, and it was in perfect condition at our arrival. The location is great, with all of central Lisbon in a walkable distance. You would think it might be noisy to stay smack downtown, but we had no trouble sleeping with the window open.
We would absolutely recommend staying here!
Very nice welcoming hosts, beautiful and cosy apartment directly situated at barrio alto with many restaurants and bars around.

My friends and I stayed here for a few days and had a wonderful time. Great location, very clean, and a beautiful apartment. The owners are so helpful and their apartment is full of resources for traveling around the city. We only stayed a few nights, but we easily could have stayed longer. Would recommend to anyone :)

Majoittaja kommunikoi alusta asti erittäin hyvin ja nopeasti. Kaikkiin kysymyksiin ja tiedusteluihin tuli kattava ja hyödyllinen vastaus. Majoittaja oli myös erittäin ystävällinen, auttavainen ja joustava. Asunto oli täsmälleen kuvatun kaltainen, hyvin hoidettu ja erittäin siisti. Asunto sijaitsee hyvällä paikalla - kulkuyhteydet, ravintolat etc. Suosittelen muillekin.

My friend and I stayed at Inês and António's place for two nights in March.  The apartment is exactly how it looks in the pictures, very cute and charming. Everything was very comfortable and nicely decorated.  It is also in a great location, within walking distance of many attractions.  Our hosts were also very helpful.  They provided us with plenty of information prior to our arrival, and were always prompt in their responses to our questions once we arrived.  If we are ever back in Lisbon we will be sure to stay in the White House again!

This place is BEAUTIFUL! So lovely to stay in, so easy to walk the city. The hosts were brilliant before and during our stay - very helpful and thoughtful, think about what guests might want (nice coffee/welcome food basket/wine in fridge!).  We had a wonderful time.

Die Wohnung war wunderschön eingerichtet und toll renoviert, die Ausstattung mit Büchern, Reiseführern, Küchengeräten etc hat unseren Städtetrip sehr verbessert. Inês und António waren tolle Gastgeber, hatten uns sogar Wein und frisches Brot als Willkommensgeschenk hingestellt. Die Lage ist topp, zentral und nahe an den interessanten Vierteln mit super Restaurants und Cafés. Wir würden jederzeit wieder hinfahren!!

Staying at The White House was an incredible experience, it really does not getting any better than this.

The hosts have taken such great care with the place and it has everything you could possible need, great space, well equipped kitchen, heaters, clean toilet - the place is just perfect. They even have small surprises, the apartment just keeps giving.

It was amazing staying here and I would definitely stay here again if I were to visit Lisbon. The hosts were really helpful as well, very considerate and gave all the support we possibly needed.

Great place. 5 stars is an understatement!
Der aufenthalt bei Ines und Antonio war ein tolles Erlebnis. Die Wohnung war toll und wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Bei Fragen konnten wir imer auf nützliche Tipps zählen.

The hosts were my favourite kind - knowledgeable and  "invisible", the ones who don't make you spend a precious hour in a new city listening to how to switch on lights:))))) At the same time you feel that they can recommend you stuff as they have style - look at their apartment! It is gorgeous. And super clean. Thank you. I would like to stay here again for sure. And the district is perfect for those who want to experience a living and breathing city. And a tasty one as well:))))

Are you looking for the perfect flat in Lisbon? Don't hesitate anymore and make a reservation as long as it's available!
Inês & António were fabulous host, everything was just perfect.
First, the communication was really easy and fluent as well before our arrival and when we were there.
Secondly the apartment is really clean, spacious, luminous, quiet, comfy and very well equipped. We even had some goodies on our arrival, and it was very good!
The localization of the place is perfect, just near the Tage (you also have a really nice view from the flat!) and the transports. The neighborhood is really enjoyable both full of life and quiet and you can find a lot of really good bar and restaurants within 5/10 minutes walk.
By the way you can ask Inês & António if you want to know some good places where you could eat, have a drink or just chill. We tried out some of their recommendations and it was really nice every time.
To resume if you are looking for the perfect city break, here you are !

Absolutely amazing! I couldn't fault Inês and António in anyway, they made us feel so welcome and provided us with a couple of goodies when we arrived, which showed us they go the extra mile for their guests and making them feel at home.
The apartment is amazing and truly one of a kind and you can't help but feel at home!
Again in terms of the hosting, we never had any major issues but we knew if we did they would be more than happy to help and offer all the advice they could.
I couldn't recommend these guys more and I would love to come back!

This apartment is elegant, cool and romantic. Inês & António went to every level of detail to make the apartment feel like our home, thanks so much! Me and my girlfriend went to Lisbon during the Valentines weekend and we had lots of fun, the location was fantastic, a stones throw away from everywhere you can imagine. Thanks so much for making our trip special, we will be back!

This was my first experience of AirBnB and I believe I truly landed on my feet with Ines and Antonio's place. It is a little sanctuary in bustling Lisbon! I felt so at home and at ease, really welcome and comfortable. The little details make this place special; framed drawings from previous guests, wonderful smelling linen, gorgeous apartment with fresh bread on arrival and even milk in the fridge and delicious coffee.
Don't think twice. If this apartment is available when you need it. JUMP at it. Gorgeous. Central. Peaceful. :-)

Loved the house! Check in/out was super easy and they were able to accommodate our early arrival. The house was cozy and had everything we needed. I loved the special touch of leaving us fresh bread, honey, jam, milk and coffee. It was a perfect snack after a travel day.
The guest book and travel books gave us nice tips on what to see first and we felt the location was perfect for downtown, mass transit and just far away enough not to get the late night noise. There are stairs but we never felt it was too much. The nights were a little chilly but the heaters worked perfectly.
Thank you for the hospitality!

First time using AirBNB and my expectations were overpassed being Antonio&Ines' guest!!! Great couple and great family and for sure AMAZING apartment. Full of small details that make your stay wonderful. It's perfect located, great views and very much comfortable. Believe me when I say that I felt like being home. Without any doubt, my next time in Lisbon will be at Ines&Antonio's place. Muito Obrigado!

We stayed in the White House for a week. It was amazing!
The apartment is marvellous, it has a great location near everthing you need to see and taste Lisbon and everything you need to make your stay very comfortable: dishwasher, towels, great linens, espresso machine, free wi-fi and much more. The most important is that the White House apartment has all these beautiful details and ambience that makes you feel like Home.
The hosts Ines & Antonio are adorable: always available, friendly, helpful, using discreet care with every kind of communication: the notepad on the staircase was our favourite.
We absolutely loved the apartment and Lisbon city, we realy and badly want to come back, we strongly recommend it.
Ines & Antonio: thank you for sharing your Lisbon with us!
Paul & Eveline

My brother and mother stayed 3 nights in this beautiful appartment where Romain and I already stayed earlier in 2013. It was our Christmas gift and I can assure you that they really loved it!
They loved the design of the appartment, the beautiful decoration, the great beds, the cleanliness of the place, and the very good welcome of Ines and Antonio. They loved the appartment so much that they will recommend it to their friends! And Romain and I are doing the same because it's the best place in Lisboa ! Thanks a lot for welcoming us.

We loved staying at this apartment. The place really is as beautiful as it looks in the pictures. It was spotless when we got there, and Inês and António had left us a lovely note and some food, which made us feel very welcome. It was clear from everything that Inês and António love taking care of this beautiful apartment and making the guests feel welcome and taken care of.

The apartment has everything you need (Nespresso coffee machine and a percolator, microwave, electric kettle, milk frother, fridge, dishwasher) and many other fun things: a guitar, a guest book, many books in different languages, and a 'challenge box' that challenges guests to make drawings. It is also in a great neighbourhood close to many restaurants and shops and right next to the river.

If I ever go back to Lisbon, which I hope I will, I will definitely stay here again. I can't recommend it enough!

Ines & Antonio were so hospitable and had exceptional communication prior & during our stay. The apartment was so perfect - lots of character, natural light, cute decor, clean & comfortable. We loved the vibe and location of this Air BNB and found our favorite local restaurants and bars just down the street. The four of us were very comfortable there and had the best time! Ines & Antonio were also very sweet and left us a platter of treats and bottle of wine upon our arrival. The apartment is filled with magazines and books about Lisboa (really good recommendations) as well as a guest book with suggestions from other folks' trips there. It was fun to read through some of the other experiences and create our own memories. Our stay here exceeded our expectations. Thank you so much - we really hope to return to Lisboa and The White House again very, very soon!!!
Beautiful apartment in excellent location in Lisbon.  I would recommend it to any friend who was looking for a nice place to stay.  Ines and Antonio are super nice and helpful.

Amazing flat exactly as described on The ADVERTISING. Lots of charm. Beautiful décoration. Very well equiped, spottless Clean. Perfect location nearby The center and with river views. By far The best flat i hâve stayed in over The last few years.
Antonio and Ines were The perfect hosts. Available, welcoming but very discreet.
They had left A breakfast pack for us.
Another major benefit: while 2 steps away from vibrant lisboa, The flat is very quiet.
I strongly recommend this flat!!

We spend with my 2 kids a wonderful stay in the White House.
Ines and Antonio are very nice. All details where given, the appartment was very clean and is very well located.
It is the place to stay in Lisboa!
We enjoy this appartment Ines and Antonio are very nice The appartment is lire the description

We enjoyed a one week stay in this beautiful and well maintained apartment. Ines and Antonio made uns feel very welcome and offered their help with everything we needed. The location of the apartment was perfect to explore this fabulous city and is very close to the station for easy  connections e.g. to Belem or Cascais. We can highly recommend this accomodation and will hopefully use it again in the future. Thank you, Ines and Antonio, for this great experience!

What a lovely place!
We visited our beloved Lisbon with friends to show them what we fell in love with, the apartment was very well thought out, with small details to make you feel at home, we were so busy running around that we didn't even have time to meet our hosts! but a notepad is a great way to get to know each other.
I would love to stay again , and can recommend our hosts and the apartment.
Everything was perfect, I really sponsor this accomodation
Lisbon fantástico, flat fantástico, Antonio and Ines fantástico. Really couldn't be much better.

Ines and Antonio made our very brief stay in Lisbon Incredible. The city was charming and their flat cozy. Thanks to its position it was easy to move around
What we found interesting were the details of the house: our amazing hosts had very good ideas to make the guests feel comfortable and to make them feel like they were well-accepted. The idea of a guest Book in which everyone could leave a comment and a suggestion for future travellers was great! Thank you so much!!

Loved this flat to bits. The location is great, near the water, nearer still to the Mercado Da Ribeira, and walking distance to all the sights and sounds of historic Lisbon.
Inês and Antonio were excellent in their communication, and they really care about the well being of their guests as demonstrated by the numerous references on what to do in Lisbon, not to mention the little basket of fresh rolls and delicious jam that greeted us upon our arrival.
Be prepared for multiple flights of stairs up to the flat (which just warms you up for Lisbon's hills) and then reward yourself by taking in the views from one of the windows.
In brief, I really hope I can come back, to both Lisbon and this flat. Enjoy!

Strategically located in the Historic Center of Lisbon, this rental is a gem. My husband and I were delighted by the place, the owners and our entire experience. The 2-BR apartment is super clean and neat, stocked with the necessary household products and materials -- dishwashing soap, towels, linens, etc, as well as free wi-fi and a TV. The exposed beam rafters and skylight lighting make for lots of atmosphere, and the furniture is comfortable. Little things make a lot of difference to us, like the full bookshelves and the espresso machine. Antonio and his wife, Ines, are perfect hosts, available to answer any questions and to recommend favorite restaurants. They clearly love living in Lisbon and, based upon our brief experience, it is hard to blame them. It is a very cool city!

The steps leading to the 4th floor rental are the ONLY proviso. There are 80 stair-steps between the entrance to the building and the apartment. (My husband counted them!) There are three landings on which you can pause and rest on your way up. This rental would probably not be a good option for anybody with really small children, or those who -- for any reason -- might have difficulty with stairs. My husband is 71, and he managed them okay, but then he is a heck of a guy in good physical condition. The stairs are definitely not a deal-killer, but they are a consideration. Bottom line: This is a marvelous rental in a marvelous city. Highly recommended!

1ère expérience AirBNB et très positive en fait.
Appartement conforme aux renseignements fournis soit sur le site soit via mail de l’hôte.
L'appartement est très accueillant ( comme les proprios!) ,le frigo était rempli ainsi que du pain et café pour le petit déjeuner....
Chambres parfaites , salle de bain nickel,living super design.
Appartement au 4ème avec escalier digne de l’Himalaya pour les amateurs de trek......Idéal pour perdre les kilos superflus!
Localisation parfaite pour visiter LISBONNE car station de bus venant de l'aéroport et station de métro/bus à 5min
quartier animé le soir avec bars ++++
restaurants aux alentours ( les halles sont un repère à ne pas manquer!)
Dommage ne pas avoir l'occasion de rencontrer Ines et Antonio....Sauf par mail ou petits mots.

Five stars all the way!!! We absolutely loved staying at The White House and strongly recommend it to anyone looking for a home away from home in the beautiful city of Lisbon! This apartment is extremely charming, very neat and the location is just perfect. Ines and Antonio were great great hosts, making everything totally smooth and taking good care of us. We really felt super welcome and have the best of memories of a wonderful stay! Can't wait to be back!

Ines and Antonio, were very helpful, and thoughtful. we had a wonderful stay! the appartment was cosy and quiet, even though we were in a great location in the center of old lisbon. If you have no problem with stairs ( it's on the fourth floor with a view of the river)We would recommend this apartment to everyone.

Kate, Utz, & Isabel

La casa es perfecta para disfrutar al máximo de la estancia en Lisboa. La ubicación es magnífica y el interior es tal cual queda reflejado en las fotos. Inês y António han sido unos grandes anfitriones desde el primer momento, anticipándose a todas nuestras necesidades. Recomiendo este alojamiento a cualquier usuario de Airbnb que esté pensando en visitar Lisboa.

A fantastic apartment- beautifully decorated, excellent location and just like the photos and description. Ines and Antonio made sure we had everything we needed and even provided fresh bread and jam and fruit on arrival. It was a pleasure to stay in this beautiful apartment overlooking Lisbon and would highly recommend staying here if you can.
The neighborhood was very convenient. Close to shopping, restaurants and museums.  Neighborhood was always full of people, we felt safe there.

Hemos estado 3 dias mi madre, mi hermana, mi sobrina y yo en este apartamento.Es tal como se anuncia. Las camas individuales son futones pero son cómodos. Yo dormí ahí perfectamente. Muy bien decorado y equipado, y muy limpio. A la llegada tuvimos un vino de bienvenida que agradecimos mucho. Lo mejor, la ubicacion. Lo mas costoso, las escaleras pero una vez que recuperas el aliento, ya se te han olvidado.
El anfitrión fue muy amable siempre. Llamo por mi para reservar un taxi para el aeropuerto.

FIVE starts all the way. Would give more stars if I could.

Thoroughly adored this place. In a fabulous location - a five minute walk to the water and a night market where you can grab bites and drinks. Charming and extremely clean flat that I HIGHLY recommend to all.

I arrived in the late evening given my delayed flight. Had all the information needed to get me to the apartment efficiently. Antonio was a great, warm and friendly host who made sure my friends had everything needed to have an enjoyable, relaxing stay. :)

My experience in The White House was fantastic. From the initial communication with Inês and António, until the check out time, everything was perfect.
The apartment is very well located, in a nice area, close to the river side. It has all that you may need to make your stay confortable.
I strongly recommend this apartment if you want to stay in Lisbon as a tourist or for business.

Das White House von Inês & António ist absolut schmucke. Die Wohnung ist in Lissabon super gelegen und per ÖV und/oder Auto leicht erreichbar. Die Familie war super Gastegeberisch. Gerne wieder und bis hoffentlich bald!

Our stay in the apartment was incredible! A beautiful city, warm welcoming hosts - what more could you ask for! Everything was as listed and then some; the little touches that make it so special. So easy to get to the apartment and waking distance to so many locations of interest. Ines & Antonio were so great both before and during our stay, making everything as smooth as possible. Can't wait to come back!

This was our first visit to Portugal, and we booked Ines & Antonio's apartment for five nights. What a perfect home base for a visit to this beautiful city! We were in the heart of everything, with a delish bakery downstairs, and nearby restaurants / cafes. The space is light and airy, with lots of windows and views out to the rooftops and Tiber River. My husband and I had the large of the two bedrooms, while our friend was cozy in her space. A spacious kitchen, complete with coffee/tea and breakfast for the next morning (bread/jam/fresh fruit -- along with a bottle of wine and water). We felt we had much more of a true Lisbonian experience by staying here -- we loved the neighborhood, and didn't feel like tourists in a big box hotel. I loved Lisbon, and highly recommend The White House. Obrigado Ines & Antonio -- and your delightful children, one who awaited our arrival and took us to our rooftop accommodations.

Die Wohnung liegt perfekt für einen Städtetrip nach Lissabon. Sie ist sehr sauber und schön eingerichtet. Inês & António sind sehr nette und freundliche Gastgeber. Wir haben uns sehr Willkommen gefühlt. Es war sogar eine Kleinigkeit für uns vorbereitet. Auch die Kommunikation im Voraus war perfekt. In der Wohnung waren viele Informationen und Tips über Restaurants und Sehenswürdigkeiten in Lissabon.

Other reviews say it all. Amazing flat hosted by thoughtful couple. We both fell in love with the apartment at first sight. I even think Airbnb should give them a prize, Superhost is not enough :)
素晴らしいお部屋です。今すぐ予約してください。絶対に後悔しません。
Shiho&Maiko

Inês & António made everything so easy for us during our quick stay in Lisbon. We were able to easily access the keys. Once we arrive we had a lovely snack waiting for us. Everything was bright and clean. The location is great and their facebook site had some great ideas of where to eat. They even left us a lovely note when we left early for the airport.

Beware of the stairs. It's just under 100 stairs to reach the top so you definitely need to take your time and be able to take the stairs.

Loved staying in the White House! Very easy to find, close to everything! Stunning heritage apartment beautifully restored. Very comfortable with everything we could possibly need (including lovely fresh bread & fruit on arrival). Lovely hosts, great communication, gave very good information prior to arrival. I would love to come stay again & would recommend this apartment to anybody looking for beautiful luxury accommodation in an amazing location (and very reasonably priced).

Best stay yet, what a place! They put so much care into every detail. We spent the first hour just photographing everything inside the apartment and kept finding new details like an easter egg hunt. It was the perfect location too, near the metro and a junction of trains, busses and trolly cars. And the apartment was bigger than expected. Ines and Antonio even left us fresh grapes, bread, jam, honey, coffee and water. We absolutely loved the apartment and Lisbon is a gem. Stay here if you can.

The listing description was completely accurate and the neighborhood, if anyone has been to Lisbon, was fantastic.  The host made us feel welcome in a number of ways: by providing excellent guidance for our stay, by providing food and drink (including coffee) and a very nice, clean apartment.  Excellent hosts and beautiful place.  I very highly recommend this host and this apartment to anyone staying in Lisbon, five stars!

I have been travelling a lot with airbnb, worldwide and I have to say that I have rarely encountered so much effort as in the case of Ines&Antonio. The have a beautiful appartment and numerous of extremely lovely tipps to do in lisbon. Restaurants, places to visit, bars, pastelerias, portugues culture and far more.
I can therefore highly recommend to stay with them and enjoy their hospitality.

Thanks Ines& Antonio for having us in your wonderful apartment. It was a perfect base to stay and explore Lisbon. We almost did all sightseeing by walking, as the apartment is conveniently located downtown. We truly felt at home, as the apartment is so thoughtfully furnished and Ines & Antonio even had prepared welcome treats for us. Travel books and lots of useful info is provided and I&A even went out of their way to help us find a nearby gym for our athlete daughter.
That said, the stairs up to the apartment are good exercise as well.
In short, all was perfect and would stay again next time. And to possible guest: this place is highly recommended.

António and Inês have been, by far, the most hospitable, helpful, friendly and respectful people I have met and made our stay in Lisbon an absolute breeze.
Not only by providing a fantastic, clean, cool apartment with everything you could possibly need, the location couldn't be better, spitting distance from bus stops, metro / train / tram stations and ferry rides but with also practically the waterfront on your doorstep.
They went above and beyond their call of duty by providing any kind of assistance at any reasonable time of the day; we received valuable local knowledge of good eating places, beaches etc and if I had to list any negative point, it would have to be that Lisbon offers far too much to see and eat for anyone to fit into only a few days.
Book this place before someone beats you to it (probably me!)

We have spent just one night in this amazing apartment, but if we had more time in Lisbon we would love to stay here for weeks! The apartment is located right in the centre of Lisbon. The walk to Praça do Comércio is less than five minutes, just to give an example. Lisbon is a very lively city, and you might think that living in such a central location you have to deal with a lot of noise, but this is definitely not the case. The apartment is located on the fourth floor of a typical, charming Lisbon house, and while you have a breathtaking view from high above over the mouth of the Tajo river (and the very impressive Ponte 25 de Abril), the apartment itself is very peaceful and quiet. It consists of a beautifully decorated living room, two bedrooms with double beds, a fully equipped kitchen and a bathroom with a very nice shower. We've found everything extremely clean and tidy. The living room is full of charming items, pictures and books. You really feel that somebody put a lot of love and effort in thinking of items that will make the guests feel instantely at home. (Just to have it mentioned, there is also a fast WiFi connection and a TV set available.) When we arrived at the apartment there were already some snacks and a bottle of wine waiting for us in the kitchen. You cannot feel more welcome! The comunication with our hosts was perfect and very easygoing. They are really good and friedly people, and you feel it from the first moments of interaction. In particular, we were very grateful for the Lisbon tips that we got from them. If you want to visit the tourist hot spots of Lisbon, you can look them up in every other tourist guide. But if you'd like to find special places, good restaurants, authentic bars and beautiful parks, do yourself a favor and trust the suggestions that are given to you here. We're already looking forward to coming back to Lisbon just to visit all the places that we didn't manage to see during our short stay. All in all, this has been a wonderful experience. If you're visiting in Lisbon, this should be a perfect place to stay in this amazing city!

Appartement conforme à nos attentes. Spacieux, très clair, propre et calme.
Tres bien positionné proche de la gare de Cais do Sodres cela permet d'aller facilement à Cascai et Sintra, proche des commerces et des restaurant.
Une littérature abondante permettait de bien organiser nos visites à Lisbonne.

The apartment was even more beautiful than expected. Very sunny, clean, and spacious with wonderful touches everywhere. Great books, and plenty of pillows and towels. Ines & Antonio even left flowers and a few welcome gifts. Moreover, the apartment is in a great location in Lisbon. I've stayed at a few AirBnB apartments during my stay in Lisbon, and Ines & Antonio's apartment was one of the best yet.

The apartment of Inês and António is a great place to stay in Lissabon, next to all the facilities available is the location superb. The availability of some food, like for instance some bread, jam, a bottle of wine after a day of travelling is highly appriciated. The personal touch by all the different books and attributes in the apartment and the tips and trics available via the Facebook site is a great motivation to explore the city, which is at your feet, even more.

It was great staying at this apartment: perfect located (close to the river Tejo, very central), very cosy and clean flat, furnished with very good taste! Ines and Antonio were perfect hosts: giving all the informations needed in advance, preparing a welcome-package, offering a lot of tips for the city..! We would come back for sure!

We had a great stay at Ines&Antonio apartment, strategically located, beautiful place, superb interior deco, etc.etc.
You made our stay very comfortable and we loved all the small details (bottle of wine, small breakfast) that you carried about. We hope to come back :)

This is the second time I have stayed here (first time in 2012), and this visit was just as wonderful. I think it's the hosts' attention to detail that sets it apart...a bottle of wine, a bowl of fruit, exceptional bed linen, lots of reading matter, guidebooks galore, I could go on...it means they are thinking of their guests' enjoyment and comfort in a way that is so warm and welcoming. It's not just a place to stay but a place to call home while in Lisbon. There are so many great reviews for good reason - a lovely apartment in a great location with tonnes of 'special touches'. My recommendation is to book - now!

Ines and Antonio did everything possible to make us feel welcomed and at home. We were travelling with a baby and they had a cot bed and stair safety gate ready. We had everything we needed and more - there was even a lovely bottle of local wine. The apartment itself is perfectly located and stylishly furnished - exactly as in the pictures. The stairs are quite a climb and there is no air conditioning so it was quite hot, but we went in the middle of summer. There are two fans which helped a bit. I would recommend this place to all who can climb a few flights of stairs.

Schon die schriftlliche Begrüßung bei der Buchung war außerordentlich umfangreich, warm, freundlich und informativ. Inês und António haben an buchstäblich ALLES gedacht, sogar an nette Kleinigkeiten, die wir nicht erwartet hatten.
Wir bekamen einen großartigen Empfang in dieser geschmackvoll eingerichteten und wunderbar ausgestatteten Wohnung. Es gibt nichts, was wir vermisst hätten.
Schon der Eingang und das Treppenhaus sind ein Erlebnis der besonderen Art. Fantastisch!
Alles war blitzsauber. Zur Begrüßung hatten Inês und António uns einen Imbiss und Getränke bereit gestellt.
Muito obrigada!

Es gibt viele schöne Bücher und auch Reiseführer. Eine tolle Idee ist die Challenge Box.

Extrem aufmerksam war auch das kleine Memoboard, auf dem wir uns Nachrichten ausgetauscht hatten.
Vielen lieben Dank noch einmal für alles. Schade, dass wir uns nur einmal kurz getroffen haben. Vielleicht dürfen wir ja wiederkommen...

Liebe Grüße von Mara und Kathrin

Beautiful apartment, close to everything you need; river, metro, train station, shops, restaurants, bars. Antonio and Ines were great hosts who answered any questions we had very speedily. Everything about the apartment functioned well - great shower, fans if hot, lots of lamps to read, even a dishwasher and useful basics for cooking like oil, herbs and spices. Coffee machine a plus and lots of interesting books and guides. Altogether a lovely space and lovely people. Would thoroughly recommend. Thank you Antonio and Ines!

This is perhaps one of the nicest apartments I have seen, in a great location. Anyone who doesn't mind walking to the 4th floor (we didn't) would find a lovely apartment with a great view. Here is where I want to stay, if possible l, next time I visit Lisbon.

This apartment was so lovely and perfect. Ines and Antonio were wonderful hosts. We traveled with our three-year-old and she loved this apartment. The location is perfect and the apartment is exactly as described.

Great apartment! Super easy key pickup, tons of tips about what to do in Lisbon, and very good communication with hosts. Also the snack provided when we arrived was awesome. Apartment was in a great area, super close to everything you'd want to see as a tourist in Lisbon. Definitely recommend and would stay here again!

I just came back from Ines & Antonio's apartment yesterday and I really suggest to everyone to stay at this fantastic place! The location is awesome and everything was just perfect. We also had a very warm welcome from Ines & Antonio with a little welcome gift.
Thank you again for this fabulous experience

We would definately recommend the Appartment for a four day stay! It is very well located in the middle of all the cool and nice places to visit, restaurants, next to the train station that leads you to Cascais. We had a very warm welcome with fruit etc. in the frigo, bread, tipps, flowers..we just felt like at home. Only minus: the appartment is on the top floor but not so bright. But as we were out all time it did not bother at all. Just perfect!

Absolutely wonderful property in a great location. Lovely touches like bread/milk and wine on arrival and Inês & António were fantastic at checking up on us without being at all intrusive. Stay here !
Fantastic all around

A really wonderful stay. Tremendous value for a perfectly situated, tastefully laid out, well provisioned apartment (bread and honey, strawberries, wine, and coffee - the four food groups). Very thoughtful. The top floor location provides the flat with a lot of character and charm. The location was great - very close proximity to most of the highlights of Lisbon. There were no issues at all communicating with Antonio or arranging for our arrival or departure. We'd certainly enjoy staying again if we're able to pass through Lisbon. A big thumbs up.

Oh how we wished we could have stayed longer!  One night was a shame as we absolutely loved Ines  and Antonio's custom designed flat. It is stunningly appointed! They have taken every step to create a lovely experience for their guests!  I absolutely recommend their apartment for the ultimate Lisboa vacation. You will love the decor, the bathroom, the kitchen, the beds!  We loved the Nespresso!   But what is amazing is the effort they have taken to make you feel at home!  They are excellent communicators in every facet!

Really lovely place, with really kind touches that made us feel very welcome. Antonio couldn't have helped us more, and all the family were lovely. Our cheeky 2 year old was greeted with delight and enthusiasm, nothing was too much trouble...
The area was great, and although seemed noisy from street level we couldn't hear any noise from the apartment..
Fantastic experience

What a perfect place to begin our honeymoon. Incredibly clean with a lot of natural light. Super private. Equipped with all of the creature comforts one would need when traveling, including a pod espresso machine! Extra linens and towels for extended stays. Ines and Antonio provided special touches that made our experience even more wonderful.
Perfectly located between Baixa, Chiado, and the Barrio Alto. Right near the train to Cascais and Belem. Everything seemed to be within a 5 minute walk. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at the flat, and will definitely be returning. I wish we had stayed longer.
Don't pass this up

Ines and Antonio are very experienced hosts and manage expertly their communication with their guests.They also provide great recommendations on their neighborhood. The welcome treats are a beautiful surprise after a long days trip.

Wir hatten die Ferienwohnung für 4 Tage und für 4 Personen gemietet. Die Vorabinformationen von Ines und Antonio waren sehr hilfreich und ausführlich.
Für die Fahrt vom Flugplatz und zurück ist die Metro für 1,80Euro je Fahrt optimal! Vom Bahnhof Cais Sodre sind es nur ca. 150m zu Fuß. Die Lage der Wohung ist für alles, was man in Lissabon unternehmen will, kaum zu überbieten.
Wer nicht gut gehen kann, sollte sich allerdings nicht für diese Wohnung entscheiden, da der Treppenaufstieg in den 4. Stock steil ist.
Als nette Aufmerksamkeit zum Empfang fanden wir frische Erdbeeren und Blumen vor.
Die Gastgeber haben an alles gedacht, es fehlt wirklich nichts, die Wohnung ist mit viel Liebe zum Detail vollständig ausgestattet. Alles ist sehr sauber. Das Doppelbett ist hervorragend. Lediglich mehr Möglichkeiten, etwas aufzuhängen, haben wir vermisst.
Wir haben uns also rundum wohlgefühlt.

We have just returned from two fantastic nights at Ines& Antonio's apartment. We have nothing but great things to say about this place, it is in a perfect location, easy 20 mins in a taxi straight from the airport, right near the waterfront and close to other cultural hot spots, the market (mercado de Riberia) is also v close and a great place for lunch and a few drinks. Apartment is even better than the pictures but they give you a great impression of it. It is querky, beautiful decor, great personal touches, miles better than staying in a sterile hotel room which doesn't give you all the insight into Lisbon as Ines &Antonio have tried to do with a lovely guest book and book of places to go with reviews from other guests. The fruit basket and fresh bread etc was a lovely touch and made for a perfect breakfast on our first morning.
Thank you both again. We could not recommend more highly and I have already told all my friends to book this place if they go to Lisbon!
Sophie,Chris & Larry (London)

What a great experience staying at this apartment. Ines & Antonio's were fantastic hosts. The apartment matched the listing description/photos and is in a great central location. It was clean & inviting with personal touches for the guests. Be sure to check out the guest book for some fantastic restaurant and activity recommendations.

Do stay here!

Great stay at Ines and Antonio's apartment - their place looks amazing and was perfectly located in Lisbon. Plenty of space and light,  and little touches to make our stay comfortable. Highly recommended!

Nous avons passé 3 nuits chez Ines et Antonio, l'appartement est parfaitement situé et est tres confortable et harmonieusement decoré. Plein de petites attentions nous attendaient: plateau petit dejeuner (pain, confiture et miel delicieux !), fleurs fraiches, draps brodés...) et le livre d'or regorge de bonnes adresses.
En bref : nous recommandons très vivement cette location !

We had a great time in Ines & Antonio's place. They even waited up well after midnight when our flight was delayed. The location of the apartment is perfect for exploring Lisbon. Definitely recommend staying there. Book early if you want to make sure to enjoy the place and hospitality of Ines & Antonio

We had a wonderful time in Lisbon and really enjoyed the beautiful apartment. The location of the flat was perfect for exploring the city. Inês & António payed much attention to detail with the interior, there are super-helpful suggestions in the guest-book and on their Facebook, as well as, of course, from both of them in person.
We would take the apartment any time again and are looking forward to visiting this magnificent city once more sometime soon!
A lovely flat in a charming old building, with hosts who add extra touches to make your stay even nicer, like a little food hamper to welcome you.

Nous avons été très agréablement reçu par Inês et Antonio avec des fruits et de quoi prendre le petit déjeuner.
Antonio a pris le temps de nous donner de bonnes adresses pour manger et bien sûr les visites et spécialités culinaires à déguster.
Le logement répond en tout point au descriptif, il est parfaitement aménagé et équipé.
Les lieux sont dans un état de propreté irréprochable.
Cet appartement est idéalement placé pour visiter Lisbonne à pied et profiter des transports en communs.

We're just back from a wonderful few days at The White House. We couldn't have been made to feel more welcome, the apartment is gorgeous, and there was fresh bread, fruit and milk waiting for us when we arrived.
The apartment has masses of guide books, ideas, maps and personal recommendations of places to go, which we loved.
We were there as a family with 2 teenage children and the accommodation worked perfectly- very spacious feel to the whole place.
As far as location goes, it was great,we bought fresh fruit etc for breakfast every morning from the market 2 mins away, pastries for the bakery next door. Basically, everything you need is right on the doorstep, it is a great base to be and then go off and explore Lisbon.
Thank you so much to Ines and Antonio!

Thank you Ines & Antonio for letting us stay in your lovely apartment. We had such a nice time and the apartment is located so close to all amenities that we couldn`t have made a better choice staying in this little gem. I loved the characteristics of the apartment exposing and focusing the Portuguese heritage and even though it was on the 4th floor which seems quite high for some, we had no problems with the stairs even with our 4 year old son.
