The staircase was wide and very cleverly decorated. We had great fun. On arrival Ines and Antonio was kind enough to leave us few amenities and the bakery next door has made lovely pasteis de nata. Hopefully we will be back to Lisbon soon and will definitely try to book the same apartment. Many thanks once again for having us.

Our stay in The White House was one of the highlights of our recent trip to Portugal. Ines and Antonio went out of their way to make us feel welcome. The apartment was meticulously clean, delightfully appointed, and ready to greet weary travelers with fruit, bread, wine and fresh flowers. It is conveniently located in a charming neighborhood, and all of the directions and suggestions supplied by Ines and Antonio were spot on. We look forward to our next trip. It can't come soon enough, especially with such gracious and thoughtful hosts!

The previous 200+ reviews have said it all.  The apartment is convenient, beautiful and clean; exactly as shown in the pictures.  The hosts Ines and Antonio are friendly, generous and helpful.  They invited us to their home, told us about Lisbon, themselves and were genuinely interested in meeting their guests.  It felt like we made new friends during our stay.  Thank you very much, Ines and Antonio.

Me and my girlfriend stayed at the White House for 2 nights over a weekend. The apartment was brilliant - v good locations to lots of sites and restaurants. Apartment was very comfortable and a nice welcome hamper was left on our arrival.
We visited Ines and Antonios recommendations for restaurants and they were brilliant, especially the landeau chocolate cake cafe.
Thank you very much for your hospitality, a lovely stay in a beautiful city.

Das Apartment hat die absolut perfekte Lage, um von dort alle Touren zu starten. Es liegt sehr nah an der Bus-, Metro- u. Eisenbahnstation und ist trotzdem ruhig.Man hat einen tollen Blick auf den Tejo und die Brücke. Die Wohnung ist sehr geschmackvoll eingerichtet , mit viel Liebe zum Detail. Sie ist sehr hell und gemütlich, und es fehlt an nichts. Ines und Antonio sind die perfekten Gastgeber, sie haben ein absolutes Händchen dafür, ihren Gästen einen unvergesslichen Aufenthalt in Lissabon zu gestalten. Mit ihrer Gastfreundschaft, den Begrüßungsgeschenken (Essen u. Trinken) und frischen Blumen schaffen sie es, dass sich ihre Gäste sofort wie zu Hause fühlen. Einfach toll!

An ideal apartment:
- very well located in the old town of Lisbon, close to all public transport allowing access to very different areas of the city (such as the Park of Nations for example) or to quickly reach the Atlantic coast of Lisbon by train (Sintra);
- very functional: the equipment is intended to facilitate a stay in autonomy if desired;
- very comfortable and very pleasant: guests were thought to everything, including the little extras that make the difference: fresh flowers, fruit, coffee, tea and other pleasures greeted us...
Quite simply: PERFECT.
We hope to return to…

This apartment has everything you want to have both for short weekend or a 5-day stay. We stayed me and my mum for 3 days (2 nights). We had a room each, and the beds were both super comfortable.
But the main thing about this place is 1) the hosts: making everything for you to feel at home
2) the cachet of the apartment: it´s an old building and the flat is decorated with a lot of taste: simble but chic. There is plenty of light and a nice view over the Taje when you look through the window...
Cais do Sodre, the location, is very good: every interesting and lively place is within walking distance.
Definitely convinced me to stop using hotels in the future...
Thank you both Ines & Antonio, we had a great time in Lisbon!
Everything went just fine. We had a very nice week-end and the appartment was just perfect. Thanks again !!

Logement conforme à la description. Très bien équipé. On est très vite comme à la maison. Idéalement situé pour visiter Lisbonne à pied ou en Tram...
Super semaine.

Inés y Antonio consiguieron que nos sintiéramos como en casa porque ofrecen un trato totalmente familiar. No los vimos, pero sabíamos que estaban si los necesitábamos. El apartamento era aun mejor que en las fotos, con flores naturales, vino y un desayuno, detalles también para sentirnos como en casa. El barrio perfecto, céntrico y tranquilo. Las instrucciones perfectas también. Solo tenemos palabras de agradecimiento para ellos.

The apt. was clean and well equipped.  Antonio provided us with some noshes, wine and coffee gratis, nice touch.  We needed it after the hike up to the place.  He described the fact it was on the 4th floor so no big deal.  Neighborhood is in the central city and close to public transport.  Finding it was a bit of a challenge but Antonio was available and guided us to it.  If you are driving the side streets gave us enough time to get our bags out of the car.  The underground parking a few blocks away was fine for us while we pursued the city.  If you want central city and don't mind the hike up to the apt this is a good choice.

We stayed in this property for 4 days, we loved it. Excellent central location, close to most important amenities and lots of bars and restaurants, located in the middle of the old town, with good transport links. The property is newly done, very cozy, clean and has all you need for your holiday. Inês & António were really nice people with excellent communication skills. We have been provided with comprehensive info on how to get to the property including public transport. We loved this flat and we highly recommend everyone this place to those who want to visit in Lisbon.  Thank you Inês & António

What a revelation Lisbon was. Beautiful city,  great food and lovely people...especially Ines and Antonio who could not have been more helpful or kind. Their apartment is simply perfect and everything you need is 'just around the corner'... literally! Yes, you have to climb a few stairs to get there but it's worth it for the views and the chic home away from home they provide. It also helped work off the 3 pasteis de belem I had in one sitting...not including the one they left for us as an arrival treat along with the most delicious jams and bread to snack on! We were only there for 3 days and crammed lots of things in but their guest book and "Things you must see and do" notes are perfect for honing your choices down so that you get a true sense  of the city whilst visiting those special places off the tourist map. We are already planning our return. I cannot recommend Ines and Antonio or their beautiful apartment highly enough. Next time we will have that coffee.

Inês & António were the perfect hosts. Their apartment is so special - stylish and architecturally interesting - and very well presented. Everything that guests need is provided, and we were delighted on arrival by the special touches including fresh flowers, bread and fruit for breakfast, and a chilled bottle of wine!
The apartment is very well located in the old, interesting part of town, and is very well served by metro, bus and tram. There are many food shops, bars and cafes in the area, and the excellent Ribiera market is a few minutes walk. Inês & António provide a great amount of helpful material - maps, brochures and guide books, and a special book of suggestions.
They were very effective communicators before our trip, made good arrangements for our arrival, and were always available by email to answer questions during our stay. We were lucky enough to meet Inês & António during our stay, and they are indeed a charming, interesting couple.
The White House is a great place to stay in Lisbon, Inês & António are excellent hosts, and we have numerous reasons for recommending their apartment. It made our holiday in Lisbon very special.
Brian and Kathleen, Peregian Beach, Australia.

The flat is so wonderful! It is lovely decorated, with great attention to each detail. It has everything you will wish for and many more. I read before the great reviews, but it was even much more than I've expected. We only stayed 1 night and we regret that we have to leave, but for sure we will return and also recommend this flat to all our friends. The only problem, witch of course it is mentioned in the description of the flat, is that the building has no elevator, so you have to make a daily gym ;) But, again, the flat it is so lovely that we didn't want to leave it in the end! We will return here, for sure!

We absolutely loved this apartment. It was spacious, well-lit, clean, comfortable, and in a great location. Check-in and out was easy and the hosts supplied us with bread, jam, and fruit upon arrival. Not to mention the apartment had fresh flowers everywhere. It was a real treat to end our vacation here.

Would highly recommend The White House to anyone wishing to explore Lisbon. The apartment was quirky and personal which was important to us and really enhanced the trip. The apartment is ideally situated to explore the city. The information that Ines and Antonio sent us before the trip was very useful and really helped us plan our holiday and feel at ease.
Although we didn't get chance to meet them we always felt welcome and knew we could call on them if we needed to.We cannot recommend them highly enough.
Thank you and hope to see you next time! 10/10
Matt and Alice Tayler

We enjoyed very much our stay in Lisbon. The apartment is very well located, in the very center of the town. The owner have reformed the apartment nicely and the have created a cousy ambiance that make us feel like in our own home. Is very lighty and has a lot of character, we liked very much.
Inés&Antonio were always there to help and they gave us a lot of good advise for restaurants and places to visit, whch we tried to follow. We definetely should come back to complete all the visits we missed because of our short stay. And if we do, we will come back to Inés&Antonio's place. I recommend it.

Ines and Antonio are wonderful hosts who welcomed us personally when we arrived, helped us get our luggage up those flights of stairs we'd been warned about, and provided bread, fruit and wine.  The apartment  was clean, quiet, warm, comfortable.  Located within walking distance of many Lisbon sights, it is an ideal location from which to enjoy this beautiful city.  Thank you, Ines and Antonio.

El apartamento estaba amueblado con mucho gusto y con detalles "personales" (flores frescas, libros, guías de viaje...) que lo hacían acogedor e interesante.
Además, apreciamos mucho la generosidad de dejar fruta, vino, pan fresco y mermelada, miel, mantequilla, etc. que nos hizo más fácil y agradable el primer desayuno.

La decoración es muy bonita y se ha sacado provecho al espacio complicado con soluciones ingeniosas. Se aprecia que los dueños son personas sensibles y cultas.

Está bien insonorizado y se descansa muy bien. Los colchones son cómodos. El equipamiento de la cocina es completo y todo está muy limpio.

Bij aankomst stond er een lekker mandje met brood en appelen, het appartement was was gelijk aan de foto's en de beschrijving op Airbnb. Kortom, een echte aanrader qua appartement en ook zeker qua ligging.
Thank you Ines and Antonio! It was an amazing apartment, and even for the very short stay we felt completely at home.

We don't have enough nice things to say about  Inês and António's place in Lisbon. It's location is fantastic (we could walk everywhere or take the train or the bus--both had stops nearby--or find taxis with ease). We had lovely views of the river from the windows, enough space for the four of us, wifi to stay connected, and just about everything we could need. Above all else, this apartment was perhaps the most elegant places we've found via Airbnb, thoughtfully and tastefully arranged with real care for what guests might need. And the basket of bread, milk, fruit just topped things off with such class and helped us out so much the night of our arrival. In that sense, this apartment was home as few other places can be. Our hosts were incredibly helpful and wonderful people, too; it felt like we had found new friends in a new part of the world--another surprise gift. For the first time ever, we really didn't want to leave. If you're lucky enough to visit Lisboa, don't think twice. Book this place! It's completely worth the trek up to the fourth floor and your body will thank you just as much as your heart will relish the experience.

Inês & António were fantastic from the outset, providing a wealth of info about the apartment + staying in Lisbon. It is super easy to get to from the airport. On arrival they provided a lovely hamper, and the apartment couldn't have been any better; two wonderful stylish rooms, and considering the apartment is so central and close to the fun and charm of Bairro Alto, very quiet and relaxing too. We had the most amazing time, and it always felt like we were returning home at the end of every day.
A perfect experience all round.
Thank you i&a !

Ines and Antonio are great hosts, they know how to put their guests at ease and make them feel comfortable. They are very attentive and ready to help if there's any need. They left a welcome breakfast that saved our lives after a long flight. We appreciate it :)

And this is an amazing apartment: very clean, warm, comfortable and quiet. You'll find there everything you need during the stay. It has a great location, for far from underground station. It's surrounded with nice restaurants and cafe places. We really enjoyed our stay there :)

Ines and Antonio have a real talent for welcoming their guests. Their attention and their kindness are always present but never invasive. They really look forward to meet their guests but without any pressure to meet : just do as you want or can.
Perfectly located along the Tage, close to a vibrant and animated area but quiet anyway, the apartment is a cosy net just under the roof. Its old beams and Portuguese tiles bring it a so charmy and authentic personality. You immediately feel comfortable and safe.
Thanks a lot to both Ines and Antonio for the so pleasant stay we had in Lisbon.

Warm greeting in the form of wine , fruit,bread and beautiful flower arraignment,but we never crossed path with Ines or Antonio on our 2 short day visit. The apartment is just right ,pretty stylish ,very clean and perfect location.

The flat was exactly as described. A lovely apartment with great interior design, clean and a small welcome snack. The hosts did everything to make us feel welcome and are very nice and friendly people. Ines and Antonio will provide you with every detail you have to know upfront so you can start your holiday worry free!
The address is also very convenient - you can get anywhere without trouble (airport - Aerobus 1; Cascais and other beach places with the train from Cais do Sodre; center of Lisbon by foot....).

We can really recommend staying there and will probably chose this apartment again the next time we visit Lisbon.

Inês & Antonio are fantastic hosts, they made us feel at home right away. And were so nice to leave us a welcome basket with delicious fruit, bread,.... The flat is beautiful and is exactly as described. It is cozy and comfortable.  It's also right in the center of Lisboa.  The majority of the sights are in walking distances from the apartment. We fell in love with the city, the people and the flat. If you are doubting, just do it! You won't regret it! A tip if you are staying here: 1. Read the book the previous guests left with must sees and with great places to eat. 2. Go and meet Inês and Antonio and their family!

We stayed for one week in this beautiful city and even so beautiful apartment. The apartment was very clean, and prepared with bread, drinks (wine and water) and fresh fruit and flowers to welcome us. The apartment is very stylish (exactly as it is shown on the pictures) and we lived here with three people (2 adults, 1 child) really comfortable. We definitely want to come back here again.

We only stayed for one day on our last day in Lisbon. Ines and Antonio were busy with their own furniture moving and could not properly welcome us but when we returned from dinner, we found a handwritten note to welcome us and to ask if we need anything. They also prepared grapes, bread and water to welcome us. I found that thoughtful. They have an excellent Facebook page detailing all the good places to eat, places to visit, updates on the happenings and upcoming places in Lisbon. Very impressive. They were also very prompt in replying to our requests. The place was artistically done up. Very cool. Just note that you have four flights of stairs to climb up. We had big luggages and took us some effort to carry them up but it's not impossible. Overall, we enjoyed the apartment and wished we had more time in it.

Ines & Antonio have an incredible place that is clean, cozy and very very comfortable. A true home away from home. They are also extremely gracious hosts - from thinking about little details in the apartment, to inviting us over for a chat. They also gave us great local recommendations. The neighborhood is great - we walked everywhere - 10 minutes to all of Lisboa's hotspots. We will definitely stay with them again the next time we are in Lisboa!

We spent 5 days in Lisboa and enjoyed the city as well as the apartment at Inês & Antonio. The apartment is tastefully furnished and full of interesting details. It was well located for our strolls through Lisboa, close to the river, the train, the tramways and the market. We enjoyed getting in contact with the Almeida family: very interesting and friendly people. We can very much recommend the apartment. Adrian, Susanne, Marlen & Sara

This is a fabulous apartment in the best location possible in Lisbon. Hosts Antonio and Ines are incredibly thoughtful and imaginative with the apartment and their personal touches to make your stay easy and enjoyable. We fell in love with Lisbon and will most definitely be staying here again when we return.
Very nice , clean, well located and confortable flat

Ines and Antonio have created a truly unique and very charming place to stay while visiting Lisbon.  Though we did not have the pleasure of meeting them in person, Ines and Antonio were always very responsive to our communications and were very kind and courteous.  To make us feel even more welcome, they left fresh fruit, water, wine, bread, butter, jam and coffee for us, as well as a kind hand-written note.  The apartment itself has a very pleasing layout and includes everything that we needed, both of which features are clearly the result of a lot of thoughtful planning by our hosts.  The apartment includes quite a few books (and even a Challenge Box), which add to the eclectic and interesting atmosphere of the place.  The location is very convenient for exploring Lisbon and is only a few blocks from the Mercado da Ribeira, at which we had some very good food and met some interesting people, including some of Portugal's top chefs.

Very nice decorated and clean apartment located in city center but still very quiet. You will feel like home there. Their son is very nice and friendly boy who helped me with my heavy suitcase (there's lots of stairs- 4th floor). I was so lucky when I checked in there. So, pack light if you could. The host is very considering, they gave a very clear instruction thru email. You will feel very welcoming with bread, milk, honey, jam, fruit, cold water (it's summer time plus after lots of stair... You
Will love it）and wine. But at the same time they will you privacy (contact you through email or leave a note upside their apartment). I would recommend this place to everyone who visit Lisbon. But you must book few months ahead ... It's very busy and always fully booked.

L'appartement est comme sur les photos,  propre et agréable.  Les propriétaires ont même mis a notre disposition un panier avec des fruits, de la confiture, du pain.... parapluie et chapeau sont aussi a disposition. Je précise qu'il est très bien situé : métro, gare, bus, tram,resto, bar.... localisation parfaite!  Attention tout de même aux 4 étages à gravir ils sont en effet abrupte.  Je peux recommander sans problème.

We spent 2 days in that wonderful flat ! The guests are very nice, and the flat is shinny, and very useful if you need to cook or something else. Also the location in Lisbon is perfect (downtown, and close to Cais do Sodré Train station and Barrio Alto). A great experience !

I can highly recommend Ines and Antonio's place.  It really is a lovely apartment, beautifully designed and finished with lots of lovely touches.  Ines and Antonio have put so much into making the place special with a welcome hamper and all their hints and tips on what to do in Lisbon.  It's also in a great location, right in the centre of everything.  We loved Lisbon and the apartment and it was just a shame our stay was so short - one night only.  I definitely want to come back and would definitely choose to stay in the apartment again.
Dit appartement is het beste wat we tot nu toe in Lissabon hebben gehuurd. Piekfijn in orde, gezellig, ruim en in ieder hoekje valt er iets te ontdekken. Hier komen we terug.

This was an amazing apartment to stay in! It had great character and we loved spending time there! It was so close to walk to the main areas of Lisbon.
Ines and Antonio were great at helping us with places to go. The apartment was filled with books and other guests reviews! They made us feel welcome and were extremely hospitable! Anytime we are in Lisbon we will stay here!

Das Apartment ist sehr liebevoll eingerichtet und man fühlt sich gleich zuhause. Mit Auge für's Detail (frische Blumen, kühlen Weisswein, frisches Brot) und vielen Tips zur Stadt, sind Inês und Antonio ganz tolle Gastgeber.
Really nice flat! Clean, cosy, and well located! Thanks!

Dear Inês&Antonio,
We'd like to thank you so much for the wonderful stay in your fantastic flat. Everything was exactly as already described by all these former guests : the situation (close to the station, close to the banks of the Taag, close to all monuments, ets..) and the very well equipped flat (welcoming bread and wine, beautiful furniture as on the pictures, the guides, the books,..)
Once again : we will definetely come back!!
Marie-Franc&Filip

First of all this was the most gorgeous apartment ever! We are a family of 4 (2 teen daughters) and we a stayed at 5 airbnb apartments on our Europe trip and we all agree this was our favorite. Great location and we could walk to all the things we wanted to see in central Lisbon. The stairs are quite the feat everyday but we viewed it as part of the experience. There was an beautiful welcome basket waiting for us and everything we could ask for was provided. Great communication and recommendations for things to see and do from Ines and Antonio and also great suggestions left in a book from previous guests. We loved Lisbon and can't wait to go back!

This is a truly beautiful apartment in a perfect location. We are a group of 4 friends who holiday together most years and this is the best apartment we have stayed in yet. If you are arriving by plane, the apartment is a simple bus ride away from the airport which is a blessing when you've got all your luggage in tow. Inside the apartment, Inês & António have thought of everything to make this place more than just somewhere to sleep. We especially loved the coffee machine and the breakfast treats that were waiting for us when we arrived. There are lots of guidebooks and a 'Do Not Miss' book written by previous guests which we really enjoyed reading. When I booked this apartment, I thought it might be slightly cramped for 4 guests but decided to book it anyway because of the location and the beautiful interiors. If you are thinking the same thing, I would advise you not to worry as there was plenty of space for all 4 of us and all of our things.

Stepping outside the apartment, the whole of Lisbon is on your doorstep. The 'pink street' (about 2 minutes away) has some great bars and really comes alive after 11pm. The restaurants on the waterfront (again 2 minutes walk) are fantastic and the train station with services to Cascais is just across the road too.

I cannot praise this apartment highly enough. It had everything we were looking for and we will be back in the near future. Inês & António clearly enjoy welcoming people to their city and have put a great deal of thought into making this apartment a delight to stay in. If you have time during your stay, you must go and say hello to them as their apartment has given me so many design tips for the future. Thank you for a wonderful stay!
Wonderful place and charming people. Idéal localisation to reach every place in Lisbon which is charming ... Highly recommended !!

We had a really great time at Ines and Antonios appartment. It is exactly like it looks on the pictures, is in a perfect location, from which you can easily explore Lisbon by walking, tram etc. We felt very welcome and always knew that we could ask the two in case we needed something. I would highly recommend coming here and choosing to stay in this place and would definetely love to come back again.

Pour notre premier "airbnb" nous avons tout simplement l'impression d'avoir trouvé la perle rare!
L'appartement est identique aux photos: superbe !
Il est également tres bien situé pour pouvoir sortir et se deplacer ( meme à pied)
Inés et Antonio sont charmants et prévenants. Merci encore pour votre sympathie et les petites attentions à notre arrivée ( panier garni, bouquet de fleurs fraiches,frigo rempli, ect...)

The descriptions made this apartment sound fantastic - and it is! Really good location, and everything of the highest standard. Fresh croissants from the bakery downstairs each morning, and a super dinner in the recently renovated Mercado da Ribeira were the icing on the cake.

Exceptional apartment, beautifully done. Great hosts available at short notice. Everything was straight forward, felt secure staying there and appreciated the option to leave our luggage in storage on our last day.

Fantastische locatie midden in het hart van Lissabon. Hele fijne verhuurders die je van alles kunnen vertellen over de stad en de dingen die je kunt doen. Een echte aanrader! Hou wel rekening mee dat je een paar trappen moet lopen omdat het op de vierde verdieping is.

A warm, comfortable and cosy loft apartment in the centre of Lisbon. The apartment is located close to Cais do Sodre station with easy access to other parts of Lisbon as well Belem and Cascais. There are also several buses that stop a few metres away from the apartment. It is also easy to get a cab and they are relatively cheap.

Inês & António were very responsive and extremely helpful. I notified them that the 3.5 G Internet connection provided might not have been sufficient for my work and they upgraded it to a broadband connection for myself and future guests. They also provided wine, honey, bread, butter and marmalade, which were very welcome.

Despite being close to many bars, the apartment is quiet and the bed is very comfortable.

I liked the restaurants Green Room (casual) and IBO (casual/fine) both within a few minutes walk away.

A 5-star Airbnb experience and highly recommended.
Lovely apartment in a very convenient location! You'll also find wine and fruits waiting for you to make you feel at home :)  Ines and Antonio are really nice hosts.

We had a wonderful stay at Ines and Antonio's place.
It is ideally located:
By the river banks to go for the 7km run to Belem
By the new market place, el barro alto, etc... It is walkable distance to all sites
The place is charming:
Cosy, nicely decorated
It has been renovated so it is very comfortable
Our host had a lot of sweet attention for us:
Info before we arrived
Detailed notebook and guides
Etc...

This is the most beautiful apartment, in a superb location in Lisbon. Although the tram passes outside along the main street, its a quiet space with lots of light and is very comfortable. Our only regret was that we could not stay longer. We really fell in love with this place and although we didn't get the chance to meet our hosts, they provided lovely little treats for us and made us feel very taken care of. Wonderful place to stay, highly recommendable!

This apartment is well worth the Stairmaster workout to the top floor! It is beautiful and functional, clean and cozy. The river views from the smaller bedroom and the living room area are spectacular. It's even nicer in real life than the photos (a rare treat).

The area it's in (Cais do Sodre) is bustling with things to do - walk in any direction and you will find cafes, restaurants, wine bars, etc. It is near the river, a short walk to the train station (where you can easily get to the beach at Cascais and the magical land of Sintras), and you can walk to Alfama (a must for Fado and charming narrow streets).

The hosts left us wine and delicious peaches and bread (all the baked goods in Lisbon are amazing - no time to be gluten-free!) and when we asked for a second set of keys, they got them to us the next day and left note paper for us to communicate on and always responded quickly.

The details of this apartment (tiles along the baseboards, old beams, art, books, antiques, and the cutest little kitchen I have ever seen EVER) - all just perfect. There was also an Italian stovetop espresso maker, a Nespresso machine, and a larger coffee pot - everything a coffee lover needs to start the day!

One last important detail for the light sleepers of the world - while this apartment is in a busy area, the double-glass windows really do shut out the street noise. I slept very well.

I really loved this place and would HIGHLY recommend it to anyone not opposed to climbing stairs - it is a long climb up! (For me that was a + as I considered it to be great exercise to help burn off all the delicious Portuguese baked goods I consumed.)

J'ai adoré mon séjour à cet endroit!  L'escalier semble interminable et puis, on arrive dans l'appartement.  On découvre un endroit fonctionnel, confortable et d'une grande propreté.  Les propriétaires nous avaient laissé un petit cadeau de bienvenue : du pain, des fraises, de la confiture, etc., de quoi nous sustenter après le voyage et prendre le petit déjeuner le lendemain.  Ils portent une grande attention à leur appartement et cela se voit.  Ils ont même dépassé nos attentes en nous donnant de précieux conseils.  Je recommande cet endroit sans hésitation!
Obrigado !! Quel plaisir de découvrir Lisbonne en plein de coeur de la ville.

Appartement très agréable. Moderne et confortable avec un panier d'accueil bien apprécié. Très pratique : lave vaisselle lave linge et machine à café ! Tout y est ! Très bien situé pour visiter Lisbonne. Entre bairo alto (quartier fêtards) et alfma (quartier historique). Il y avait beaucoup d'indication pour nous conseiller, ainsi qu'un livre d'or: conseil des précédents visiteurs pour les lieux à ne pas manquer. Vivement recommandé!

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour sur Lisbonne qui est une ville à découvrir, vivante et accueillante. Nous avons particulièrement apprécié notre logement : dès notre arrivée nous nous sommes sentis "à la maison", dans un environnement chaleureux à la décoration soignée.
Attention touchante de bienvenue : panier de fraises fraîches, bouteille de vin blanc ; pains et confitures ! Quel accueil.
Literie confortable, nombreux guides pour aider à découvrir Lisbonne ; tout est là pour faciliter le séjour.
Et pour ne rien gâcher, l'emplacement est idéal à 2 mn du métro, tram, bus et train dans un quartier très vivant.
On y reviendra avec plaisir.

Ines and Antonio have a remarkably professional approach as hosts.
It was a great experience all the way.
The apartment is exactly like in the pictures, what you see is what you get.
The apartment is in a premium location for tourism, walking distance to the best areas of Lisbon such as Chiado and Bairro Alto.
You also get to see the river from the living room which is quite nice.
Ines and Antonio are very oriented for details and you will have wonderful surprises such as a little breakfast in the first day, some coffee too, which makes the experience even more pleasant.
From the beginning to the end, Ines and Antonio are always available, they answer very fast to enquiries and they provide you with very well elaborated guides of Lisbon. Very professional. Excellent! I have no doubts recommending Ines and Antonio as perfect hosts.
All the Best,
Francisco

This is an incredibly easy review to write, because Inês and António have created a beautiful space in the heart of Lisbon. The positives are too many to list, but I'll try:

- A personal note welcoming us to the apartment
- Fresh strawberries in the fridge
- Fresh flowers throughout the apartment
- Homemade strawberry jam, delicious bread, honey, milk, and tea
- An extensive book collection for browsing when you're resting your feet from exploring the city
- A good-sized shower
- Comfy bed
- Quiet location (the windows are very soundproof)
- Beautiful view, and many windows for natural light
- A sense of community, from the book of "can't miss" recommendations that Inês and António began and guests have contributed to, to the "challenge box" (you'll see what I mean when you get there)
- Great location - walking distance to the market, metro line, a very short walk to the largest square in Lisbon, and less than 5 minutes to the water
- A great sense of humor on the stairs :)

You should stay here, dine at Ibo, and just generally have a lovely time in Lisbon. Inês and António make it easy. :)
Ines and Antonio are great hosts, very helpfull. The appartment is lovely and confortable. It can easily fit a family of 4. We had a great time. Thanks

We only had a chance to stay for a night and this made me very sad as I would have loved to stay longer.

The apartment is really great. I loved it. Super cozy and clean with thoughtful activites and suggestions. And a lovely welcome basket of bread and strawberries.

i&a were great in communicating. Check-in was fantastic. And they called us a cab for our morning departure.

I would highly recommend this place and will stay again if passing through Lisbon.

This is the place to stay in Lisboa. Such an amazing view from the front, and the hosts are easy to access. Be warned you do have to carry items up the stairs, but you will see why when you open the front door....

Ines & Antonio left us fresh bread and strawberries that tasted like heaven.

The airport bus picks you up less than a block from the apartment.

Book this place, you will love it!

Ines and Antonio's apartment was great! It was easy to get to from the airport, the location was perfect and the apartment itself was cozy, clean and equipped with everything you may need. They even left us some delicious bread, fruit and coffee that we were able to enjoy for breakfast. Unfortunately, as our stay was quite short we did not get the chance to meet Ines and Antonio but they were excellent hosts. They gave us so much info and ensured a seamless arrival and departure. Our only regret is that we didn't stay longer!

Dear Ines dear Antonio, we just came back from our wonderful trip to Lisabon,
the City is wonderful but our place to stay was incredible beautiful.
Thank you so much for everything. Unforgetable! Astrid&Randolf

We really enjoyed our stay here. The flat is very well located for seeing Lisbon and many sights are within walking distance. It is comfortable and charming, spotless.
Although we didnt meet the hosts, it is clear from the attention to detail such as milk, rolls and fruit awaiting us when we arrived, water and wine in the fridge and especially the fresh flowers everywhere that they are a warm giving couple.
I wouldn't hesitate to recommend this apartment to anyone. Great first time experience of Lisbon.

This place was incredible, even nicer than anticipated. Easy access from the Lisbon airport via aerobus, and the concierge of the building is so sweet and helpful. Great light and super cozy upstairs, had everything we needed (even though we didn't spend a whole lot of time there!) There are some great guide/reference materials to help plan your days. Busy street during the day, but you're so high up  you can barely hear any city noise. Shower  has great water pressure. Very clean and lovely all around.

The apartment was really great, clean and very cozy, Inez and Antonio have done their best to make the place a home. The apartment is closely located to nice neighborhoods and a relaxing place to relax after a day in the city. Breakfast was arranged at arrival and Inez was available for support if needed! All in all a place I  can recommend!

I can only confirm the amazing ratings and comments below: It is a pleasure to stay in the flat of Inês and António. Maybe some notes that have not been mentioned yet: No need to worry about the fourth floor - the stairs are reasonably high and easy to climb. Parking was way easier than expected: Either on the street at Cais do Sodre (around Portugalia restaurant, free after 1900 and on weekends park) or in the garage at Calcada do Combro 74 for (guarded, 13€/24hrs, if you need something throughout the day). António even researched some more options and then drove me there to check it out myself - just one example of the excellent hospitality! Other examples: They gave us dedicated hints on where to go with children, they let us in early because or flight arrived in the morning, they put fresh flowers in every room and they welcomed us with a breakfast. When they invite you to come by, just do it - very very friendly people :-) The price seemed a bit high for us at the first sight, but then it was very worth every penny (other people already highlighted cleanliness, speedy internet, warm water without any hazzle, good public transport etc.). Regarding noisyness at Cais do Sodre: The bedroom with the window to the front was quite noisy on Saturday night - all other days were fine. The bedroom with the windows to the back were all quiet.
Summarizing: We loved it :-)

In maart hebben wij 4 nachten in het appartement van Ines en Antonio gelogeerd. Het is een aangenaam appartement en van alle gemakken voorzien. Ligt heel centraal in Lissabon. Vlakbij de Taag waar het op de boulevard heerlijk toeven is. Er is een leuk cafe met heerlijke lounge stoelen en prima restaurant (wel reserveren) aan de Taag. Het was een heerlijk, zonnig verblijf. Een aanrader dus.

Perfect ! It is probably the best word to describe our stay in Ines and Antonio apartment.
Great and convenient location, charming interior where we immediately feel "at home", and a wonderful attention from our host.
From delicacies for breakfast to fresh drink, from very useful information for arrival to good advices about Lisbon... everything was ready for us to enjoy our stay.
Even if we didn't have the chance to met our hosts, we feel like having old friends nearby, always ready to help and discreet.
Hopefully being back soon and stay again in your apartment.

Besides the fact that Lisbon truely is a stunning city, our fantastic experience of Lisbon was greatly influenced by this awsome apartment. During our stay it was like a second home to us, providing everything we needed and could possibly think of. Lovely interior design, great location and ideal in every way.
We really spent some quality-time in Lisbon and enjoyed every second. Even though the weather was superb, it wasn't always easy to leave the apartment - there really is a very special vibe and ambience to this place. And although we didn't meet our hosts in person, we always felt very well looked-after.
Highly recommendable - after all, it's always the details that count...

We just loved it! Very cozy, very comfortable, extremely clean and beautiful! It is very well adapted for a couple with kids!
The location is wonderful. It is at a walking distance from many of Lisbon attractions and it is next door to the metro and train stations.
It is good example of a old Lisbon type building that was very well reconstructed and furnished. We especially enjoy to see some old Portuguese objects together with for example the design Vista Alegre Porcelain coffee cups!
It has a beautiful view to the sky of Lisbon (with all the wonderful light) and to the shinning Tagus river.
The notebooks seems to be very useful tools for the foreigners and were very amusing for us!
We hope to come back!

Very nice appartment. Good location. Extremely friendly hosts. Highly recommended.

Enemark family, Denmark
Great "home" from which to view the city, all one's requirements and a little bit more, perfect location also.

If you are looking for something outstanding to stay in Lisbon this is the place! Don't miss! This place has get kharisma and positive energy, it tooks me an hour just to go around the aparts and look at the details . Apart of that the appartment is perfectly located, close to everything. It was pleasure to stay at Ines & Antonio's apartment. I've got very detailed instruction befor arrival and advices duaring the stay so there was now problems at all!
Thank you, guys! Hope to be back some day.

I spent 6 wonderful days with my husband in Ines and Antonio apartment. Its situation is just perfect, easy to go from the airport with the Aerobus that stop in front of the building, easy to visit the different districts.
The place is even more beautiful in reality than on the pictures. Decoration is very sophisticated. It is comfortable and everything is done to feel like home. Our hosts made our stay the best possible, they were very available and we really appreciated their advices (places to go, restaurants, ...). Speaking about advices, there are many books, guides, maps of Lisbon in the flat and most important: consult the "You should not miss" book, full of experiences of the passed visitors.
We definitely recommend this apartment and we hope to come back very soon.
Great place, great location and warm and welcoming hosts! Definitely worth to be recommended for a trip to Lisbon.

Everything was perfect:great location near the airport terminal and all the best spots for day and night visits in lisbona
Ines and Antonio's house is wonderfull, very well equiped and decored with taste. They also left us all we needed to have the first breakfast, Nespresso coffee capsules and a bottle of portoghese wine ( it's a pitty but we had not time to taste it)
Lisbona is fantastic and this house makes it even more charmfull
Super place and location! It would truly be difficult to find anything better in that area . The apartment was exactly as the pics.cozy and comfort. Highly recommend.

Desde la llegada todo fue genial y lleno de detalles (botella de vino, cosas para el desayuno, revistas y guías de viaje y locales en Lisboa...) en la casa de Inés y Antonio te sientes como en casa. El apartamento es super bonito, muy limpio y está muy bien decorado. Dan ganas de no salir!

Buena ubicación para conocer Lisboa en un fin de semana, tranvía al lado de casa para ir al barrio de Belém, a media hora andando y en un paseo muy agradable el barrio de Alfama con el castillo.

Si te parece tomar algo de noche y un poco de marcha a 5 minutos tienes el Barrio Alto lleno de locales con música en directo y restaurantes. También puedes optar por pasear por Lisboa durante el día y aprovechar a descansar en el piso y disfrutar de la casa con una botella de vino blanco y buena compañía.

Sin duda cuando volvamos a Lisboa dormiremos otra vez en el piso de Inés y Antonio.

We stayed in Ines & Antonio's apartment during the first week of January in 2014. We had a wonderful experience overall. The apartment has everything you might need, and it's decorated beautifully. The location is unbeatable and it allows to get to everyplace in Lisbon either walking or using public transportation. However, if you have a car, parking might be challenging. Ask Antonio about a few places where you don't have to pay near the apartment. We would definitely go back if we ever stayed in Lisbon again. Nick&Carolina.
We traveled thorough 13 hotels and apartments in january and and this apartment was cleanest, most comfartable and beatiful place to stay. Could not reccomend it more!

We were two couples who stayed in this lovely flat during 6 days
around New Years Eve.The flat was absolutely up to our expectations. Smart,creative touch to the detailing (loved the red lamp), lots of useful literature, a very nice welcoming-kit -all you needed for first breakfast which were very nice as we arrived late
in the evening.
The stairs were no problem although we are around 65 years all of us. Coming up, was like coming home!
We sure will recommend this flat to our friends and if we come back in summertime ( which I hope) we know where to stay.

Ines & Antonio sure know how to make one feel welcome! They go out of their way to make the experience as wonderful as possible. The apartment is cozy and decorated with love and fully equipped. A welcome tray with coffee, tea, bread, butter and jams, candy, wine made us feel like we were visiting family. There are books, maps, magazines to help organize our stay in Lisbon. The owners asked us over at their place for a glass of wine to give us tips on restaurants (and boy do they know their city!) Their Facebook page is very helpful as well.
We had a couple of days of bad weather and the museums were closed because of Christmas so we spent more time in the apartment than we had planned but we never felt cramped like one would in a hotel room. We are a family of 4 (2 teenagers) and we are unanimous; We love the apartment. We would definitely come back.

We had a short but nice stay in the appartment of Ines and Antonio. It is a very cosy place on the fourth floor so you have to climb some stairs but that is good training. The appartment is very neat and clean and Ines and Antonio bought some fresh bread and butter so we had a nice bite when we came in. Everything works well ( wifi, tv, lights ) and the bathroom with the shower is great. We only can recommend this plave to anyone who comes to Lisbon. If you come by car.. you better park your car near e.g. Dom Carlos street where there is free parking. It's only a 10 minute walk so you 1st. drop your gear and than park. It saves you a lot of stress and parking money.

This is the place that you dream when you book on AirB&B. The apartmnet is really cozy, clean and bright. Ines & Antonio are super and in the neighborhood you'll find good restaurants, public transports, bars & clubs. I suggest to rent a scooter ( there's a shop just behind the apartment ) and get lost in this amazing city.
What else.....

Ivan&Teresa
December_2013

The apartment is very well equipped and was very clean.  All furnishings of a very high standard.  Location is great for visiting the Lisbon sights.  Very helpful hosts. The steps to the apartment certainly concentrate the mind - you don't want to forget something and have to go back for it.  We recommend.

Hi Ines, Antonio,
My stay was amazing ... thanks to the great comfort you offer to your guests. The charming environment, with great location and easy access to the beauty of Lisboa. I fell in love with the good vibe. Inspired by its authenticity. Great tips ... A great escape for anyone who needs to re-energize. I will recommend to all my friends going to Lisboa, and sure they will enjoy it like i did.
Take care , and hope to see soon. Cédric
Fantastic location and great hosts! Totally recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Lisbon.

You have to overcome the stairs, but it's worth it! A beautiful, comfortable appartment on a more than great location. A good base to explore Lisbon. We didn't meet Inês and António, but the contact via email was very warm and made us feel very welcom.

Everything about this apartment is perfect: Location, decor, hosts... we couldn't have asked for more! We stayed for three days and were able to easily get to all the sites of Lisbon either by walk, or the metro/bus/tram 28 steps from the door. The apartment is very clean, with modern appliances and remodeled bathroom, but they kept the beautiful original wood features as well. Bedrooms are on opposite sides of the apartment which is nice for groups or families. Ines and Antonio provided many excellent recommendations, and there are guidebooks in multiple languages in the living room. Definitely book this place if you can, you will be happy you did!

This was a superb apartment, so spotlessly clean you could literally eat your food from the floor!! with plenty of clever and thoughtful additions. Really good central location.  Antonio and Ines were splendid hosts.  I would love to return and would highly recommend .

The flat is beautiful, charming, cosy.. Some stairs to get there, but it is really worth! And further in a very good location, nearby the centre. Ines and Antonio are very helpful hosts.
We would recommend it most warmly. Thanks a lot!

I would recommend the appartment! Its very central locaded, nicely decoraded and well equiped. We didn't need to buy sugar, oil, washing powder or anything basic! Also when we arrived there was a nice bottle of wine and very delicious bread with honey and confiture! Also there were a lot of books about Lisboa and recommandations from the owners that were very useful! The only thing that was missing was a place to sit outside. The apartment had a great view but very little windows to show it. But we are a little spoiled! Overall Great!!

Very comfortable apartment. The hosts were extraordinarily friendly and helpful. When we arrived there were snacks and drink available to make our stay more comfortable. I would certainly recommend this apartment to any family or group of friends that are visiting Lisbon. Very central location and I would endorse A and I unequivocally.

Ines&Antonio's apartment is fantastic. It looks exactly as in the pictures (if not better) and its location can't be beaten.
You can really feel the love and care they have put into every single thing within the apartment.
The communication with them and the information provided was also great. We even got a tray full of goodies!

If you are in doubt, this is the place, no need to look further!. I&A will take good care of you.

This place was great. We only stayed for 3 nights (which wasn't enough time in Lisbon!) but it was very clean and a good size. Ines & Antonio were very helpful and we were able to get some great advice from them on things to do & see. They also answered all the travel questions we had. The only tough part was it's a lot of stairs and I completely overpacked! Be sure to pack light (I learnt that I didn't need to bring my whole shoe closet! :)

What else is there to say that hasn't already been said about this place! There apartment is awesome and located in a great neighborhood.The art and decor is very cool and gives the place a very home like vibe. Ines and Antonio themselves are incredibly responsive and so easy to work with. Was sad I didn't get a chance to meet them but I am guessing they are just as great in person as they are in cyberspace.

As far as AirBnB's go, this is definitely a top notch experience. I highly recommend staying here if you are in Lisbon and looking for a cozy nook in an awesome area!

Happy Traveling.

This apartment is great! Clean, comfortable, well decorated and well equipped. The location can't be beat -- easy to get to from the airport, walking distance to a ton of stuff, and great public transport links.

Inês & António are great hosts. They provided a wealth of information about Lisbon (things to see, places to eat, etc.) and are top-notch communicators.

We were extremely happy with our stay here and highly (HIGHLY) recommend you do the same!

A great apartment on a perfect location. All the things we needed as a family with 2 small children (3 years & 2 months) were provided. The tips Ines & Antonio gave us about hotspots in Lisbon were perfect. You don't need a travelguide when you stay in this apartment. I can highly recommend it.

Ines and Antonio have done such an amazing job on remodeling this apartment which is located in the best part of Lisbon. The place is very very clean and tastefully designed with evry little detail. They are very welcoming and willing to help.
I highly recommend this warm place.

Ines & Antonio were excellent hosts. The apartment was great - and it was so nice to have a comfortable and clean place to come home to after a long day of sight seeing. The apartment was within walking distance to many attractions and if it wasn't it was very close to public transport. Even better it is right by the water.

Much more than I expected and will definitely be staying with Ines & Antonio the next time I am in Lisbon!

We'd rather shut our mouth and keep this apartment as a secret hot spot, otherwise we risk it be overrun by crowds. Anyway, we are fair enough to follow the rules of the game:
This apartment was much more than we had expected. Ines and Antonio are very generous hosts, they made us feel welcome, although we never saw them! The rooms are fournished personally and with delicate taste. Looking out over the roofs of Lisboa down to the Tejo river, we managed to leave our allday hassles way behind.
It is easy to discover this lively, exciting and sometimes tiring city from a comfortable base, where you truly feel relaxed. It definitely is a place to be marked on the hit list and to come back to!

There is nothing I can add that has not already been said. Wonderful location, great hosts (felt at home and had everything we needed) and just a really fun place to stay.
Had a wonderful time and would look for availability here when I visit Lisboa again.

Ines and Antonio's flat is very spacious and clean and modern , it is centrally located in cais do sodre which has being growing its own crazy night life over the last few years to rival barrio Alto's and yet you can't hear the 15+ discotecas named after various countries from the apartment so you get the best of both worlds.
When I arrived at the flat ines and Antonio had fresh bread , fresh honey , fresh jam , milk , wine , apples and grapes to great us , wifi password ,
Games , TV pens to draw with , tons of maps and reccomendations and Lisbon travel guides

The apartment has great views of the harbor, the bridge and cais do sodre , and the way of entering the apartment through the downstairs gift shop day and night was quite an interesting adventure

Highly recommended beautiful place

We really had a great time in this superb apartment. It was sweet and cosy and in the prime location of the city. It sports great literature, good travel guides, helpful tips, and lovely furniture. We'd love to come again.

Ines and Antonio were great. Their stella reviews really tell it all. We even had an incident where we ended up locking ourselves out of the flat late one night, and they were extremely accomodating in helping us liaise with the local fire department to get the door opened again! The flat itself is lovely and unique, and they have great tidbits for their guests for how to experience Lisbon like a local. We would be so grateful to stay at their flat again, the next time we're in Lisbon!
I'll echo all of the other positive reviews for these guys.  Ines and Antonio are the models for a great Airbnb host.

Our two week stay at Inés and Antonio's apt was perfect. My husband and I and two children, aged 3 and 2, felt at home there and were able to easily get to wherever we wanted to go; a very good location for public transport. The apt was very clean and had everything we needed. Our hosts supplied a baby bed and bath which made things even easier. We would stay here again!

Very nice appartment located centrally near public transport and with many nice restaurants in the area. It was clean and  Inês & Antóni had made sure we felt welcome and provided us with a lot of infomation before we arrived. Would definitely reccomend this if you are visiting Lisbon. The appartment is excately as shown on the picutues, we loved it.

My father and I had a fantastic stay at Ines and Antonio's apartment. The location was extremely central and the apartment was of a very high quality. We were left a very generous welcome tray which was much appreciated. Everything was immaculate and well taken care of. Very helpful book of hints and tips for Lisbon made good reading and helped us choose where to go to. I would definitely recommend your beautiful apartment for anyone wanting to stay centrally in Lisbon.

I highly recommend Ines and Antonio's apartment to anyone that may find themselves in Lisbon. It is a gorgeous apartment in a perfect location in the heart of the city.

Everything was clean, charming and very well done. There were so many personal touches that added to the personalized experience and made it a great home. Beware of the amount of stairs, but I would definitely stay here again in the future.
Lovely flat, great part of town, communicative hosts who left us cherries and wine when we arrived. Would definitively recommend a stay here!

Beautiful flat with lovely touches! Great recommendations from both the hosts and the guests! We kept referring to the guestbook throughout out stay! Very good location with public transport and easy to get a cab, different times of the day. Highly recommended!

We absolutely loved our stay at Ines and Anotnio's appartment and they could not have been more accommodating. Travelling with an 18 month old is not easy but they were super helpful in providing not only a cot and a baby bath especially for us but also putting up a stair gate so we did not have to worry. On arrival there was a chilled bottle of local wine in the fridge and a basket with bread and fruit as well as delicious butter, honey and jam. We could not have asked for more. Location of the apartment was super central and easy to get to everything. Also having tured up completely unprepared, the book of recommendations left by previous guests was a God send and everything recommended was worth while doing/seeing/eating, that we tried anyway. We will definately return. Thanks again A&I for your hospitality!

This fabulous place included guidebooks, local magazines, previous guests' recommendations, fresh bread and fruit, and it was in immaculate condition. There was some fun quirkiness about the surroundings, but let that be a surprise! The 4th floor does offer a view, you just have to look for it. When you find it, it is picture perfect! The area is a fun spot with a nearby market, waterfront, plenty of restaurants and shops, and even a British Bar. The apartment was roomy for 2 persons. It had all of the dishes and items you could possibly want, including a pair of much needed scissors! These hosts do not miss a detail. We stayed 4 days, which was enough time to cover much of Lisbon by foot during our stay. It is close to the Metro stop,  which we used quite a bit. Being lazy on our departure to the airport, we flagged a taxi right out front, and that was easy also. We would return in a minute!

What a gorgeous apartment. Could not have asked for a better location and the hosts were so thoughtful. So much attention to detail, this apartment was more than authentic, it was stylish and chic and made our stay in Lisbon even better than we could have thought. We would highly recommend it!
This place is fantastisch!
Great hospitality, beautiful apartment located in a nice district. A perfect experience in Lisbon. Greatly recommended.

This apartment is superb. Our hosts took great care of us, provided us with all the information we needed regarding good restaurants, sights etc, set up the apartment exactly as requested, and were great communicators.
Absolutely awesome place. Definitely would go back in a heart beat. Really accommodating. A must!

This place represents completely what the AirBnB experience should be about. It is family owned and managed, and they take great pride in adding personal touches to the apartment. While we never personally met Inês or António, we felt as if we knew them.

Upon arriving, we received a welcome note along with fresh strawberries, breads, and even a bottle of wine! There are notes around the apartment with messages explaining various aspects of the place. Our personal favorite was the hand written guide provided by António that included some great recommendations as well as encouragement for AirBnB guests to add their own. We referred back to this guide constantly during our stay.

The location is perfect. Central to everything and close to public transportation. We look forward to our next trip to Portugal, and would certainly stay with Inês & António again!

We loved this apt. The location is great, the apt has great design, very clean and Ines and and Antonio are incredibly helpful and fun to meet. Lisbon was amazing and the apt was the perfect place to be.

Magnifique appartement, atmosphère très personnelle et belle déco, rénové avec goût, joyeux mélange d'anciens éléments, poutres et céramiques, et de meubles modernes... original et chaleureux.
Il est très bien situé, en plein coeur du vieux Lisbonne, dans le quartier vivant du Bairro Alto, mais il offre pourtant du calme.
Idéal pour une escapade entre copines, c'était notre cas (5 jours).
Et, last but not least, l'accueil est tout simplement excellent... Panier de fruits, pain, beurre, confiture et miel, et du linge de lit qui sent bon le frais... Bref. Je le recommande vivement et y retournerais sans hésiter.
Excellent apartment in Lisbon! Extremely close to metro, bus, ferry, and light rail. Apartment was clean, comfortable, and quiet. I would highly recommend this apartment!

We truly enjoyed our stay. The flat is ideally located in the center of Lisboa - walking distance from all main sites. Particularly convenient if you plan day trips to Cascais or Estoril. The flat is extremely comfortable, well decorated and cosy. We agree with all previous positive comments posted on the website. We did feel welcomed and will stay there again ! Owners are super friendly and available. Many thanks to Ines and Antonio for all!

Ines and Antonio’s apartment is wonderful (the picture say already a lot). What you don’t fully see on the pictures is the love that Ines and Antonio put into this great place. It’s the little things that make it so special – the “Challenge Box”, the “Things-not-to-miss”-handwritten-Guidebook, the little decoration items and a basket with fresh fruits, stuff from the bakery and a bottle of wine in the fridge upon my arrival *Wow*. It’s been a very very nice stay and everything went perfectly smooth. So Ines and Antonio are GREAT hosts…they do really care to make sure that you have a great stay. I can fully recommend them and the apartment to anyone who wants to stay in Lisbon for Vacation or for Business. (By the way also Mr. Sannaula - the shop owner on the groundfloor - is very friendly and helpful.)

Everything is within walking distance: Cafés, Restaurants, Shops, Supermarket - Barrio Alto is just 1km walk. I stayed in Lisbon for a Business trip, so being central was important for me. A taxi stand is only 50meters from the apartment and you can reach the airport within 15mins. The WLAN in the apartment worked perfectly.

I’m sure this was not the last time I stay with Ines and Antonio ;-)
Muito Obrigado!

This is such a great place to stay, so much eye for detail and style, fantastic!..
It was nice to arrive in the apartment being overwhelmed by it's beauty and find a welcome basket full of fruits, fresh bread, honey and jam, together with coffee, tea and a bottle of good wine, just perfect! It gave us such a good feeling. We could not think of a better start of our stay in beautiful Lisbon and it stayed this way.
The location is great, close to the water and all the nicest restaurants and shops are just around the corner.
There's still so much to see for us in Lisbon so we will be back and we believe there's one place to stay, you may guess which place this will be.
Thank you for all A.and I.
Apartment was great; perfect centrally located, clean, good value. Although it is quite a climb for the older ones; for the younger ones it's perfect!

The appartement is really beautiful, decorated with a lot of taste, cosy and handy. The location, in the center near the beach, is ideal, near to all transports you might need, it is also very close by feet to many different beautifull sights and lots of good restaurants and nice pubs. Also Inês and Antonio are very friendly, very welcoming, they left a lots of informations and good tips about Lisbon, on there facebook and also in the appartement all the documents you might need. Was the best way for us to discover the city, Thank again! Alice

This place is fantastic! We stayed for four nights and kept finding small but well designed solutions everywhere. Beautiful Space in a good central neighborhood and quick access to and from airport. Antonio does everything to make you feel welcome. Hope to come back someday. Highly recommended!

This is where you want to stay in Lisbon! Ines and Antonio are delightful, artistic, family oriented, people and the apartment reflects this in every way: Beautiful, elegant, playful details, both in its design and finish and in how it is prepared for you by them. As you look through the apartment's portal windows out across the river, sipping an espresso, you will fall in love with Lisbon and will want both to stay in and enjoy the apartment for longer, and step outside onto the cobbled streets and start exploring! This is a perfect location, accessible to everything. We will definitely be back!

This is a fantastic apartment in Lisbon. I really liked the location and the space to relax when not out looking about the city.
Antonio and Ines really have done a fantastic job preparing the apartment as well as information about what to do in Lisbon as well as restaurant suggestions, guides to Portuguese pastries and wines.
I would certainly recommend this apartment.

Excellent place, extremely convenient, all the food recommendations were spot on and the location was perfect.  I will recommend this place to anyone I know that is travelling to Lisbon.  Staying there was a real privilege and there was no hassle in checking in or out.

we stayed there for 3 nights and we had great experience!
sucha pretty loft, in the centre of Lisboa, lots of nice guide books and handmade tip books !
everything was just so easy (checkin/ checkout)
would highly recommend ! !
Fantastic apartment and a great place to stay. Clean, spacious, all the facilities you could need including internet, coffee and a complimentary bottle of wine. Go now!

What a fantastic place! Small but perfectly formed, with so much thought gone into it - such as comfy beds, lovely ben linen, lots of guide books and maps and suggestions, bottle of wine and food there to welcome us on arrival.  A beautiful apartment with great views and in a terrific location - so central and particularly easy from the airport as the bus goes almost to the door.  We didn't need any guidebooks or recommendations other than what the host provided - we just did everything Antonio recommended and had a lovely, lovely weekend in Lisbon.  Hosts are super helpful and clearly enjoy hosting people.   Wouldn't hesitate to recommend it!!

A very comfy and cozy apartment! Beautiful renovated, very well located. Our hosts provided fruits and bread for the first breakfast, so nice!

Everything is near by or just a few stops away with Metro. Buy a metro card at the the airport station and go by train, it's cheaper then the aeroporto-bus.
We loved the view from the Castello and would have loved to bike to Torre de Belem along the Tejo, just the weather wasn't that nice. We'll come back!

We stayed at Inês and Antonio for a weekend in early March. This was my first visit to Lisbon and this proved to be a fantastic choice: The apartment is perfectly located, providing superbly easy access to all the main sites and attractions in central Lisbon. Despite being at the centre of activity, the flat is serene, beautifully designed and perfectly equipped- from an excellent coffee machine to a complimentary breakfast basket that awaited us upon arrival. Small touches tat make a big difference!

Antonio was easily reachable by email whenever we needed anything or had a question and was very accommodating.

In all, this is a wonderful place to stay!

...this has already been our second time in this absolutely lovely apartement, and I don't stop recomending it to all my friends, because it makes your trip to Lisbon so special and you really feel welcome and immediately at home!!!
The whole Interior-design is great and inspiring, with lots of little details and caring art on the walls, the location is very central but not noisy at all, and on top of all this, the host are super-friendly and tell you a lot about insider-tipps in Lisbon!
We will definitely be back soon, especially because we live on the algarve, and Lisbon is always worth a trip!

We were 4 girls away for the weekend and we had a blast. We felt so welcome from the moment we arrived - Receiving the keys was very easy and well organized, there was bread, fruit and wine for us in the appartment and the place was so lovely.
The appartment was placed very central with loads of restaurants and bar just around the corner.
Our hosts ws very friendly and serviceminded.
We can only recommed this place!

What a convenient location and great hosts!
We stayed in the apartment for 3 weeks and found the apartment to be extremely clean; located close to transportation; within easy walking distance to many major activities, shopping and restaurants. This is everything you need for an enjoyable stay in the beautiful city of Lisbon.
Also, the responsiveness of Antonio during the reservation process and whenever we had questions during our stay was quick and complete.
We do not hesitate to recommend this apartment and the hosts.

Together with 3 friends we spent a great weekend in this apartment. Everything was just perfect: starting with a welcome basket full of fruits and buns, honey and jam, through coffee machine to excellent location. 100% privacy, great neighborhood, walking distance to downtown. Place surrounded by great lunch and dinner places (checking places recommended by Antonio is mandatory!!). We had great time and will for sure come back!! I can recommend it to everybody who wants to visit Lisbon and stay in the city center!!

We have had a wonderful weekend in Lissabon, despite the rain. Mainly because we had a great appartment: close to the sea and every other hot spot in town. Clean, modern, comfortable, cosy, nice furniture and details, great flexible hosts. Nice bakery and restaurants next door. We definitely recommend this appartment to our friends and family. Antonio and Ines: THANK YOU!
regards, Petra, Danielle, Annemarie, Annemieke

Absolutely the best place to stay in Lisbon. The apartment looks exactly like the photos and Antonio and Ines have filled the place with great homely atmosphere, guidebooks, maps, ideas for walking tours and other inspiration for your stay in Lisbon. When I arrived I was met by a welcoming tray with fresh bread from the bakery, a basket of fruits, coffee for the nespresso machine, a sip of portwine and the smell of fresh flowers - amazing. The apartment is centrally located between the best neighboorhoods in Lisbon. It's also very easy and cheap to get to/from the airport with the new metro. I can only recommend others to stay at this place. Thank you for the best experience:-)

I had a great stay at this beautiful and stylish apartment. The location is excellent, close to Bairro Alto and the new night life area (Cais Do Sodre) where all the cool bars are with the benefit of not having any noise [the flat is on the 4th floor]. Ines and Antonio are excellent hosts, the house is clean, modern, beautiful, with lots of light during the day and everything you need and even more. I would strongly reccomend anyone who wants to experience the real Lisbon to stay here (it will also make you fit as climbing up the stairs helps losing some of the kilos you will gain after eating delicious pasteis de nata!) Thanks Antonio and Ines ... I will be back!

This is a great place. We stayed for New Years eve and had a blast !. There are wonderful restaurants and bars close by , but the apartment itself is nice and quiet.
Antonio and Ines are wonderful hosts who have put a lot of thought into the apartment. We greatly enjoyed all the small touches they put in. Honestly, I could not think of anything that could be better. We hope to be back sometime !

Absolutely loved the apartment - great location, stylishly set up and with so many small details thought of. So great to arrive to find complimentary, wine, fruit, milk and fresh bread...not to mention the supply of nespresso pods.

Ines and Antonio were great hosts. All logistics were seamless and Antonio's recommendations for restaurants and bars were extremely helpful.

I definitely recommend their apartment.

Our stay at Ines and Antonio apartment in Lisbon was excellent. Great location to see the historic areas, the apartment itself was very nice and spacious, and the doorman was nice and courteous. I definitely recommend this room.

Best place to stay in Lisbon: the flat is even prettier than the pictures, the views from the window are excellent and the place is well-equipped. Also the location is great: really close to a lot of the interesting parts of the city. On top, Inês & Antonio (and their sweet kids and awesome dog) were great hosts - even gave us enough (much needed) coffee for the first few days, and have stocked the apartment with plenty of guide books (and a guest-created suggestion list) for people looking to get the most out of their stay in Lisbon. Thanks to Inês & Antonio for a great time. Highly recommended. :)

What an absolutely fantastic apartment!  It is very bright and open.  Ines and Antonio have created a space that is perfect for visitors to Lisbon.  They provide coffee and bread and jam to have for breakfast for the first couple days.  They also are a great resource for everything you might need.  The apartment includes many wonderful details, including a book for guests to leave suggestions for future visitors. It is truly a beautiful apartment and was our favorite place to stay while we were in Portugal.  I can't recommend them highly enough!

Inez & Antonio's place is wonderful! The location is great, right near the water and very convenient from the airport and to other locations in Lisbon. Best of all, the apartment is very well appointed, with lots of thoughtful touches throughout: fruit and bread baskets, coffee and tea, and even wine were provided for our enjoyment, lots of books and magazines telling us about Lisbon, very comfortable beds and nice bedding, and lots of little creative touches around the apartment. Inez & Antonio also have a great facebook page with lots of photos and advice on the best places to visit, restaurants to go etc in Lisbon. They are great hosts!
I would certainly stay here again if I were to return to Lisbon for another visit.
We had a great time in Lisbon - the apartment was a perfect place to stay while we were discovering Portugal's charming capital. Highly recommended.

The flat is great and really well located! Sadly we stayed just 2 days in Lisbon, but for sure, when we come back, we'll stay again by Inês and António's flat!
Not only the flat was perfect (really beautiful, well restaured, in a perfect location, quiet, sunny and so on), but Inês and António were so kind. They explained me everything I needed to know about the flat and the surroundings. Plus, they have a facebook page with a lot of advices. As well, the small book with all the previous guests advice is a great idea!
I totally recommend them!

Location. Location. Location.

If you want be int he heart of Lisbon this flat is excellent. But the location is just the start, the flat is clean, fashionable and comfortable to be in.

Excellent!

Idyllic and peaceful. Our stay with the Almeida family was a great experience. Aside from the beautiful location, Ines and Antonio made us feel so comfortable and welcome that it felt like home. The apartment is conveniently located - metro, train and tram stops close by. It's right on the waterfront, in the flatter part of the old town, which is nice in a city with steep hills. All the nicest restaurants and shops are just around the corner. If you want to cook for yourself, the Mercado da Ribeira is near and the kitchen has everything you need. You might end up spending more time in the apartment than you think as it is just so cozy. The attention to detail in the furnishing and decoration is amazing. They take really good care of the apartment as well as their guests. Antonio has good suggestions on where to find great things to do. Also, there's a handy guidebook in the apartment with tips from other travellers.
Great apartment, very well located and great value for money.  Lots are charm and well designed.  A lovely touch is having some bread rolls and jam plus fruit on arrival!

The appartment is all that you can dream about : great location, great tips to know the city left by guests and Antonio&Ines + very nice place !
We had a very nice weekend there!

What a lovely apartment, my friends and I had such a great time, feeling at home the moment we walked into the flat. Ines and Antonio have done a great job making the flat and whole experience feel very personal and welcoming with great focus on detail: from their own tips on things to do in Lisbon, to a little guest book filled with great individual tips beyond the known touristic spots from previous guests to a breakfast basket surprise. The whole experience felt special and unique. I would definitely recommend staying in their apartment (which is also perfectly located by the way!)

Great flat ! We had a wonderful with all the little tips and cute attentions all around the flat, we loved it :)
All in all, a perfect flat from a very nice family (i was really sad not to have the time to come and say hey !). I would warmly recommend it.

Ines and Antonio were wonderful hosts. Firstly, the apartment is in a great location and has many thoughtful details inside. We enjoyed making meals at home and found all of the furnishings and details very comfortable for our stay. Next, the apartment has a lot of natural light and is well-designed and decorated. Even on a gray day in Lisbon the apartment always felt warm and bright. Lastly, Ines and Antonio were incredibly helpful and welcoming -- we instantly felt at home and enjoyed the opportunity to get to know them and their family.

We just spent 2 days in Lisbon but they were fantastic. People were really nice, the food was great and there would be too much to say about our visits. Do not forget to ride the number 28 tram!
The appartment was perfect and even though we did not see Ines and Antonio we felt at home (the welcoming breakfast basket was great!)

Ines & Antonio were the perfect hosts - we had our own space and they were there when we needed them. The whole family is very friendly and welcomed me into their midst.
The pictures and description of the apartment were 100% accurate and the attention to detail and extra touches which you can only appreciate when you get there made the experience very personal.
