This is the first time we have used Airbnb and would certainly use it again. Ines & Antonio are a credit to the Airbnb concept of individuals letting out their apartments. When you book then when you get there you are dealing with real people who care that you will have a good experience of the apartment and Lisbon. We highly recommend them to anyone considering a city stay in the historic centre of Lisbon.

The apartment is well located with easy acess from the airport bus, tram to Belem and buses around the city. In addition to being well presented and easy to live in ( all the little details had been thought through) there was a wealth of information available about tours, points of interest including a diary completed by previous guests of there adventures and recommendations. Great idea and very helpful Ines and Antonios recommendation for the Ibo is a must. Mr Santander was also very friendly and helpful with directions. For us climbing the stairs was always justification for a having another  pasteis de nata :)

I'm a writer for a living, and you know what, I think I'm almost lost for words! Really! My teenage daughter and I spent an amazing nine nights in early October at Antonio and Ines's apartment. We loved every minute, and I'm not sure there are enough superlatives and adjectives to describe how much we enjoyed our stay. Lisbon is a wondeful city, easy to walk just about everywhere, and this apartment is perfectly located to enjoy all its wonders and delights - which are many! The stairs and the climb up are part of its many charms, as it felt like we were coming up to a 'home away from home' every time we returned from our adventures in the city. The apartment is REALLY beautifully and thoughtfully furnished and decorated, better than the photos show I think (and the bedlinens and towels are incredible - I'm a bit if a linen freak and I loved them). But more than anything else, it's the 'feeling' of the place that we loved. It's so much more than the sum of its parts. So warm and inviting and friendly in every way. It's easy to tell that a lot of love and care has gone into making it a place to feel welcomed. And that we did. Antonio and Ines are really, really lovely people. This is a great apartment in a great city owned by great people. There are lots more little things I could describe about the apartment, but that would spoil your discovery of them. My recommendation - stay! I don't hesitate to recommend it, as I'm sure you'll enjoy it as much as we did. If there was a ten-star rating I'd give it in an instant. Kind regards, Simone

This apartment is a fantastic place from which to explore Lisbon! The bakery downstairs takes care of breakfast, or if you're in the mood for a sit-down feast, try Quinoa just around the corner on Rua Alecrim - which also gives you access to high-end shopping along Rua Garret.

And the metro station at Caise de Sodre (literally a stone's throw away) makes getting further afield really easy.

The apartment itself felt like home almost instantly - it was spotlessly clean, and thoughtfully (and thoroughly) appointed. What a relief to spend the day running around Lisbon knowing that we were coming home to clean comfort!

We do have one regret though: we should have made physical contact with our hosts MUCH sooner. Antonio and Ines are passionate about Lisbon, and their enthusiasm is infectious. Plus, they know how to avoid the tourist trap. They are generous with the information and their tips can be followed with confidence.

I heartily recommend this aprtment for three reasons: location, top-quality fixtures and knowledgeable hosts.

We only stayed for one night at Antonio's place before heading back to Germany but everything was perfect. The flat is located in downtown Lisbon close to the waterfront at Cais do Sodré. Most of the must-see's of the city are within walking distance and for the sights further out, there is a subway station nearby. You enter the place through a small parlor.The delivery of the keys its very smooth. It's on the top-floor of an old apartment building and the climb up the steep stairs can be a bit streneous (there is no lift), expecially if you have a lot of heavy luggage. Consider it a good opportunity to burn some of that fat you accumulated (or are about to accumulate) with that tasty Portuguese food. Antonio will let you know how much calories you spent on your way up through funny stickers on each floor.

The place itself is all worth the effort, though. It has a beautiful wooden floor and wooden beams throughout which give it a lot of individual, country-house charm. The owners have decorated it with a lovely style, mixing modern furniture with antique elements and a great eye and taste for beautiful small details. We felt immediately at home and appreciated this little oasis of retreat in the heart of a sometimes hectic (and hot) city. Everything was wonderfully prepared, clean, efficient and making our stay as enjoyable as possible. Antonio and his wife left a lot of personal, hand-written information (restaurants, transportation, sights) for us (which, due to our short stay, we couldn't really appreciate), they left us a whole range of travel guides on Lisbon on the sideboard and they even prepared a small welcome basket with bread, fruits, milk and a tasty cherry liquor. Wireless access is painless to get within minutes. There is a TV (which we didn't use) and a large, electric fan which all but compensates for the missing AC. The mattress is comfortable and gave us a good night's sleep. Since the bigger of two bedrooms goes to the back of the building, it was also nice and quiet. Kitchen is small but well equipped. We also loved the little Nespresso machine in the living room.

Even though we never met them in person, we left the place feeling as if some of our closest friends hat let us their apartment. Hopefully we can stay a bit longer next time. 5 stars.

A Treasure in lisbon! A perfect located apartment, perfect facilities, amazing design and ambience and a real homey feeling to it.
Antonio and his wife were great taking care of all details and especially Antonio's recommendations of where to go, to eat, to drink, to relax and all the special places in the city...
It's the small details that count and Antonio's details are the story of a great stay in lisbon.

The apartment was really, really nice. The location, the details, Antonio, his family.. everything was perfect.
Definitely the best choice we could make.

5 stars + for this beautiful apartment in downtown Lisbon and even more for our hosts Antonio and his family. It felt like "home" and we´ve had a perfect experience during our 3-day-stay. We were lucky enough to share some valuable time with our hosts during our first evening. We were given a warming welcome with Antonio and his family and it made this travel really special for us.  After years of travelling experience, I can definitely say that our hosts and the apartment itself were far above standard. Thanks again for this lovely experience. We will definitely book this apartment again when we´re back in Lisbon and would recommend it to everyone looking for a nice and well located apartment in Lisbon.

Staying at Antonio's beautiful apartment was a wonderful experience! And not just because the apartment is beutifully decorated, conveniently located in the center of Lisboa with easy access to the main turistic- and non- actraction. What really made our staying so enjoyable was the dedication of the host to make the visitors's experience of Lisboa the most complete. I explain myself better: the apartment is full of guide books, magazines, and other useful source of information in different languages about Lisboa and Portugal. From restaurants tips, to walking itenerary, to nightlife, u can find any kind of information u're looking for. I really appreciate that ! It was also very nice to find a welcome box with bread, drinks and fruits, so sweet!;)   I sincerely recommend to everyone to stay in Antonio's apartment when in Lisboa because it's the perfect place to be and we loved it!

We absolutely loved staying in Antonio's apartment in Lisbon/Lisboa. It was out first experience of Airbnb and it couldn't have been any better.

The apartment is out of this world awesome. It's in the heart of old Lisbon where all the best bars and night life is. It's on the top floor, so penthouse dudes! And it's amazing!! I don't want to describe it in detail so that it remains a surprise.

Antonio and his lovely wife are also the perfect hosts and couldn't do enough to make our stay a wonderful one. We would come back without a seconds thought and couldn't recommend it more highly. If we could give it an extra star we would. So what the hell 6 Star awesomeness and many, many thanks dudes..

A casa do Antonio, da Inês e família foi a nossa primeira impressão de Lisboa e da Airbnb, não poderia ter sido melhor!!! Fui com meu pai e minha prima no início de setembro/2012 para de lá irmos fazer o Caminho de Santiago Português (que foi maravilhoso!!!). Eles são hiper atenciosos, o apartamento é lindo, cada detalhe é uma delícia, inclusive as calorias perdidas ;-) ! Amamos ficar lá e foi uma pena que na nossa volta o apartamento já estava alugado e não conseguimos ficar lá. Infelizmente não conseguimos nos encontrar com eles durante a estadia, mas o carinho deles estava em cada canto da casa, no vinho presenteado e nas frutas, pães e delicadeza que nos foi presenteada em nossa estadia. Deixou Lisboa mais inesquecível para nós, com certeza! Recomendo muitoooo e quando voltar, espero ficar lá novamente!

Lovely place - beautifully decorated, well-equipped kitchen, spacious and lots of little extras too. We were especially grateful for the bread and coffee upon arrival! It was great having such a choice of guidebooks, information and tips at the flat - the guest book has useful recommendations from both Antonio and guests.
The location is really helpful since you're minutes away from trendy and beautiful shops, restaurants and sights, as well as the train station to get to Belem (10 minutes) / further afield.
Thanks for a wonderful stay!

Antonio is a great host, and his apartment is beautiful. The location is convenient (near the metro, and the Cais do Sodre train station makes other parts of the city/surrounding areas very accessible). Exceptionally clean apartment with everything one could need: clothes washer, dishwasher, good WiFi, espresso machine, extra linens, etc. Very modern space that is both quaint and wickedly efficient.

Antonio was extremely communicative and helpful with information before our arrival, and he even left a small gift for one of my traveling companions who was celebrating a birthday in Lisbon. Very thoughtful!

The apartment has many useful guidebooks and suggestions for things to do, and Antonio made himself readily available to answer questions and give suggestions.

I'd recommend the apartment as a home and Antonio as a host to anyone without hesitation. 5 stars.

When I saw Antonio's place listed in airbnb's most popular section I looked at it straight away and was immediately charmed by his place. I took the opportunity to stay few days here with my Aussie boyfriend André and I have no regrets. It was just magical.

After opening the surprising little door at the back of the Indian shop we discovered Antonio's wonderful place - it was like being in Aladdin's cave. Everything was done by Antonio and his wife Ines to make us feel welcome; the original Facebook page by Antonio and the book of previous guests' comments and ideas gave us the best advice to help us discover all the secrets of Lisboa. The white wine waiting for us in the fridge, the espresso and the fruit basket for the breakfast were lovely additions. It was always a pleasure to come back "home" after a long day in Lisboa's hot streets. Also the place is so well located, in a lively area 5 min from the main subway station and bus station with lots of cool bars around. And one of our best moments was to share a glass of wine in a bar close "our" place with our fantastic hosts, who are both full of life and very charming. Highly recommended, just go for it!

A very nice apartment that is furnished with great attention for details. Everything was well prepared and equipped with a nice welcome for our arrival. In the apartment we felt comfortable from the beginning, unfortunately, we barely had the time to take advantage of the interesting challenge-box (a really good idea of Antonio).

Overall, our stay was too short and we hope we will come back with a little more time in the luggage to enjoy Lisboa and Anonios appartment.

We spent one night at Antonio and Ines's place. The apartement is just perfect :
- really well located
- huge (2 beautiful rooms, one large living room, one gorgeous kitchen and bathroom)
- charming
- so well decorated
Moreover, Antonio and Ines are welcoming and so helpful.
We fall in love with their place and we only dream about coming back soon there !!
Don't doubt, the apartment is the best !!

This is our first time using Airbnb, and we were SO lucky to have found Antonio’s apartment in the heart of Lisbon. The apt. has an excellent location with convenient access to all of the major modes of public transportation and about 20 minutes to/from the airport by taxi. It’s within walking distance to the Bairro Alto, Chiado, and Baixa. Many restaurants, cafes, bars, were just around the corner or within a few minutes walk from the apartment. Especially convenient was the fantastic bakery/cafe just 2 doors down with amazing pastel de nata and pao de deus! The apt. is SO charming and looks just as it does in the photos. There's an incredible view of the river Tejo and the 25th of April bridge (looks just like the Golden Gate!) from the front window!!! The apartment is bright, airy, very very clean, and full of thoughtful details. There are many guidebooks, novels, and magazines in different languages, playing cards, a “challenge” box with sketchpads and drawing pencils so you can leave behind an artwork for the apartment walls. The kitchen is also very well equipped and even had a Nespresso machine, microwave, and a clothes washer!
Antonio was an incredibly gracious host. Upon our arrival were a basket of fresh breads, honey and jam, tea, a bowl of fresh fruit, and even a bottle of chilled white wine! There’s even cable tv, and FREE WIFI. We thought all of this was pretty incredible!!! But the best thing about this apartment and our stay in Lisbon was meeting Antonio, his lovely wife, and their family. They were all so warm and welcoming! We not only got advice on the must see places, suggestions for fantastic restaurants, cafes, and one of the BEST gelaterias in the world--Santini (only about a 10 minutes walk from the apartment); but we also ended up just talking and having a super time hanging out with his family. They made us feel so at home, like old friends visiting them in the beautiful city of Lisbon. We feel like we got a whole lot more than a great apartment, we also got the company of a family that we are now proud to call our friends. We loved Antonio's apartment in the heart of Lisbon and we love Antonio and his family! We HIGHLY recommend this apartment in Lisbon and can’t wait to return there ourselves!!! *P.S. Yes, it is a 4th floor walk-up. But since we ate our way through Lisbon, the walk up was a blessing in disguise!

August 2012
Antonio was very responsive and helpful. The apartment was really cute and we felt very much like we were in Lisbon. It's also super centrally located. We would stay here again!

Our stay  was fantastic. The charm and location of the apartment exceeded our already high expectations. Located right next to great markets, and the tram/train station for easy access to sightseeing and the beach, everything you want to do or see in Lisbon is right at your fingertips. Not only was the apartment great, but Antonio was very flexible and attentive to problems I had from missing my flight. On top of everything else, there was fresh bread, fruits, jams, and honey waiting for us when we arrived. Our stay in Lisbon was perfect and I can't wait to go back. When I do, I will make sure to stay at Antonio's apartment.

Unfortunately Antonio and his family was away during our stay in Lisbon.
He kindly sent all the details about the apartment and the city before our arrival.
Now I understand why Antonio was keeping remind me about the 4 floors without elevator, as to bring our luggages up there (big suitcases) was a strong sportive experience.
Then it was so nice to find a very cute apartment, you immediately feel the relaxing spirit, like a nest
They left us some nice welcoming things, with a kind birthday present for my friend, some food, and a fresh vino verde.
Antonio and Inès are really good hosts.

We were 3 peoples, so the size of the apt was perfect.
The location is very practice, as you can easily do everything by feet and get in different area of Lisbon.

I definitely recommend to stay by Antonio in Lisbon. So nice experience to finish our trip with that city, and especially with this apt.

We had an absolutely wonderful stay at António’s bright, beautiful apartment. Location-wise, you couldn’t get better for this price. The place is just minutes away from the architectural and transport hub of Praca de Comercio in one direction, the Bairro Alto restaurant and bar scene in the other, Chiado shopping behind, and the waterfront just up ahead. The space itself is comfortable and nicely lit with two bedrooms, an open common space with TV and internet, and a fully-stocked kitchen. It’s all very clean and bright, though the five-floor walk-up might be tough for anyone with mobility issues.

Still, what set this place apart from other Airbnb experiences we’ve had is António. He goes way beyond the call of duty to make his apartment a home and special stay for any visitors. He is a fabulous communicator and helped us a number of times with travel advice he made available or that we contacted him about, even though he himself was on vacation at the time we visited. He left us a complimentary welcome basket and put a lot of effort into making sure that our guest experience was more personal than a hotel would be, and more convenient as well. I would highly recommend António's apartment after our experience there and know that he’d be delighted to have you stay.

Antonio and Ines' apartment in Lisbon surpassed all our expectations!! This is the perfect airbnb experience. Apartment looks exactly like the photos, it is bright and beautifully decorated. The location is perfect, easy to get to from the airport, walking distance to everything, and right next door to a delicious bakery!
Our bags were delayed when we arrived (darn CDG airport!!!) and Antonio was super responsive and offered help to receive the baggages for us when they were delivered. He has a lot of tips for Lisbon, many nice books in the apartment (tourist and otherwise), you will really feel like you live there. From the way the apartment is setup so thoughtfully and all the information you will get from them, you see that Antonio and Ines really care about their guests.
My husband and I will be back, and will definitely stay at Antonio and Ines' place again!

To all Airbnb users ! This place is your dream home and if you have a keen eye for tasteful, classy yet practical and even playful creative space to live in - this is it ! We had the pleasure of bumping into Antonio on the way down for dinner and it was jus fate and delight ! Larger than life, super warm and makes you feel like you already know him in the first 10 seconds of meeing the host Antonio. I only had 1 nite in Lisbon and while I felt it was short, I think Antonio made me feel meeting him and staying in his place was already the best experience for me in Lisbon. The place is impeccable - with Nespressso machine, a challenge box for you to draw an art for them to place in this apartment as a momento of your stay, complementary fruits,tea and a white wine ( it was hot day) and the washing machine was a life saver. Antonio also leaves magazines and guidebooks so you dun even have to buy any of them. And if you are lucky enough to meet Antonio, he gave us the best recommendation round the corner to Povo where there was great food, Fado live performance and a pleasing crowd of locals just hanging out for the evening. If there were 6 stars in this - I would give it all the way to 6 star warmth, cosyness and style !

Jacquelynne
Dubai

Fabulous apartment! Charming and full of light. You can pop the windows open, lean out and watch the boats on the water. Antonio is a great host and provides everything you need to settle in and stay awhile. He and his family are really nice people too! The apartment is super close to metro,  trains, places to eat, bars...all you need for a fantastic visit to Lisbon! We would definitely stay again.

Amazing Location (super close to train station, market, access to beach and walking distance to the sights of Lisbon),
Amazing Apartment,
Amazing Host!!

If you're thinking about choosing this apartment, don't have any doubts about staying here. Hosts like this are why AirBnB is great! The apartment was immaculate and Antonio and Ines went the extra mile and a half to make us feel welcome. There are lovely little touches peppered throughout the place, from vintage typewriters, nespresso machine, stocked fruit bowl on arrival and a fantastic range of suggestions of places to go, things to do. Just stunning!

We loved staying here and would visit again in a heart beat. This feel like our Lisbon home.

Beautifully renovated appartement, ideally situated quite close to all places of interest. We stayed here with two kids, and did not need a car because nearly everything was in walking distance. Perfectly equipped, nice kitchen, well worth the stairclimb!
Will definitively stay here again whenever in Lisbon (which is a place we love)

We highly recommend this wonderful apartment in the centre of Lisbon, cosy, very clean, well equipped and renovated with style, full of charming details.
You can even organize your stay in Lisbon using the different guides, books and magazines and information available in the apartment.
We felt at home in this beautiful place near the most interesting city sides.
Antonio and Inés are great hosts and you can listen their advises in order to have an enjoyable experience.
Just a perfect place. We will come back!!! Obrigados.

This was our first time using airbnb and certainly won't be our last!  Antonio really makes the experience wonderful all around.  To start with, the apartment is vey conventiently located and couldn't be easier to get to from the airport.  The rates are better than I could find for any reasonable hotel and the accommodations were spectacular.  I would recommend this for anyone staying in Lisbon.  (just know its four floors up without a lift). We had a short two day stay in Lisbon and would have missed meeting Antonio but he invited us into his apartment at 1030 in the evening just to meet the family and chat.  Can't go wrong with this place!

We loved Antonios loft accomodation. After a full day walking  Lisbons hills in the heat it was lovely to come home to  a clean well equiped cosy apartment. Antonio left us  a lot of information about Lisbon which was extremely helpful. The apartment was in a great position walking distance to most places of interest. We will return one day and highly recommend this accomadation

My first experience with Airbnb - and the sad thing is, I doubt if it will ever be topped. A glorious apartment, unimaginably thoughtful curation of the space, fresh flowers, bread, honey.

Antonio and his wife were such generous, warm, charming hosts. We ate hour-old miniature seafood in a superb wine and garlic sauce and talked about Antonio becoming mayor of Lisbon. He should. We'll be back.

Definitely book this apartment if you feel like having  2nd home in Lisbon! The apartment is in the very centre of Lisbon.If  you don't want to feel as a regular tourist but experience the authentic way, you won't regret to book this place. Getting & leaving the keys went really smoothly. Apartment was nicely decorated.  Antonio is wonderful host. Would book again!

The best experience one could hope for. I fully support the other positive reviews. Antonio and Ines made sure our  first visit to Lisbon became a fantastic trip to the city. Spotles apartment, location perfect. Dont hesitate to ask Antonio and Ines for inside information about the city. We will definately stay there next time we go there on holiday.

This is a wonderfully located apartment just near Cais de Sodre railway station in the centre of Lisbon - in the old part of town.   The apartment has everything you could need for a few days accommodation.  It can be a bit noisy with the partying going on at Cais De Sodre.  The apartment is a little claustrophobic as you have to climb 4 flights of stairs to access and you are situated in the loft.  The view from the window is fabulous and the owners very obliging.

Staying in this apartment is the best experience you can make.
It´s a great apartment and it almost feels like you come to a friend.
Antonio and his family are amazing! They are so helpful and hearty hosts! If you´re looking for a "real" lisbon experience - this is the place to be. Beside the great location of the apartment (10 minutes walk to Bairro Alto, Chiado/Baixa, train- and bus station 2 minutes away, even the airport bus stop is there) you will meet lovely lisboetian enthusiasts, who love their city. And they will make you love the city too :-))
Meeting them was the highlight of our Lisbon experience.
We would highly recommend this place and we will come again - for sure! Thank you for all A.and I.

The flat is amazing, located in the center of Lisbon. Everything and even more is waiting for you since Antonio is a super host.
At your arrival you'll find some fruits, snacks with some wine !

Antonio did not hesitate to welcomed us as in his house as we had some questions regarding the next steps of our trip.

It was my first experience through Airbnb and I guess hostel definitely won't be able to compete soon.
this is the first time we find the appartment exactly as it was on the fhotos generally it does not
Great location, great space, marvelous hosts.  Thank you Antonio and Ines for a perfect "homebase" for exploring your fair city.  The apartment was impeccable, and the guest guide book invaluable.

Lisbon was amazing. Much bigger than I thought. We did the Yellow bus tour to see the whole lot. On the other day we were there we catch the train to Sintra.

Antonio's wife was great and we enjoyed the facilities. There was great extras with Englist TV during the day and at night. A lovely lounge area and bread and jam for our breakfast.

The accommodation is in a great spot and we found the parking once we stopped the car. Our GPS put us on the road which we could not enter from and we need the street name for the entrance but we got there.

The 4 floors was hard going but we altered our baggaged because Antonio had warned us previously so we adjusted everything to suit.

Great spot and we loved Lisbon. Thanks to Antonio

We had amazing 5 days in Lisbon while we were in the apartment of Antonio and Inês, all was well beyond the expected, the place is really amazing.
Besides being very organized with respect to all combinations of pre-arrival, departure and use of the apartment equipments , A. and I. keeps the place so clean, confortable and complete with everything to hand.
But what makes the place a special place are the small details that can make a difference for travelers curious and interested. The apartment is filled with excellent information on Lisbon, whether in books, guides or alternative publications about the city.
We feel at home in this small piece in the middle of heart of Lisbon. We note for anyone who wants a great experience in this city.

We loved our stay here, the location is perfect and the loft apartment is charming. It is bright, charming and cheery! The hosts are so warm and nice! When we return to Lisbon this is our first choice to stay!

A sensitively decorated flat right in the heart of Lisbon. It has everything you might need and is ideally placed. We walked all day, everyday and never even had to take the metro! The flat owners were wonderfully helpful and were the perfect advert for how well airbnb can work.
On top of it all - unbelievably good value.

I'll definitely be back.

Harry Darby

wonderful, even better than on photo! We enjoyed our stay at Antonios perfect situated apartment very much. We had a very good communication with the hosts and are very grateful for the excellent recommendation for fado and restaurants. We would like to mention the interesting books on the shelves as well as the pleasure of watching Mezzo on cable. We would have stayed longer if we could. We already have told our friends that being in Lisbon Antonios apratment is a must! Just beware of the steps, if you mind loosing 2500 calories, we did not!
All the best to Antonio and his familiy!
Vladimir,Jelica and Mirjana from Belgrade, Serbia

This is a really wonderful place to stay in Lisbon: my girlfriend and I had a brilliant time as a result of this fantastic flat and the warm welcome from Antonio and his family. The flat is incredible value as it is very centrally located, large, airy, attractively decorated and furnished and with a great view over the river. Antonio and his family were very friendly and had loads of useful recommendations about places to eat, drink etc. - in particular his restaurant suggestions are spot on! We look forward to visiting again in the future.

The apartment is very good located, close to the subway and not too far away from Tram 28. Very close to the river as well to chill at the various restaurants. Very well equipped, very clean and everything with a certain style. Nice view to the river and bridge and very helpful hosts, thanks Antonio!
Bike rental is around the corner and the ride to Belem along the river is highly recommended. A very good bakery is almost next door.

We spent awesome days in lisbon. We felt like home in the apartment. It is nice equiped and furnished with sweet little details. Everything you need in order feeling comfortable is there.
If we will stay in lisbon again, then at this place!!!

Thanks for awesome days!!
Best,
Simone

Antonio's apartment was a perfect home from home for us in Lisbon and he was a very good host, always quick to reply to emails. It's centrally located, well equipped, beautifully decorated and spotlessly clean. The fresh flowers, tea, coffee and bottle of wine waiting for us when we arrived were an added bonus! We would definitely stay there again and recommend it to others.

I would like to thank Antonio for all the help regarding our stay. I had a number of questions and all of them were answered fast and with all possible info.
The location of the apartment is very good, in the centre and close to the last metro station, so you never miss it :)
Antonio, keep it up!

Everything was perfect! The appartment is even better than in the pictures, is central and very well communicated (in Cais do Sodre there is the last stop of aerobus). It was ultraclean, completely equipped and is very comfortable and beautiful. Moreover, Antonio is the perfect host, very nice and helpful. I am just thinking when I can come back to this marvelous city, in this great appartment!

Antonio's place was superb!! It was very convenient to everything. As we entered his place we noticed right away how homely and tidy his place was. We loved his fresh flowers and fresh linens,we felt like we dont wanna get out from his place..lol. The kitchen was equipped and my wife enjoyed cooking for us. But most of all there were welcome fruits,bread and wine...how thoughtful!!! I would recommend his place as it is very handy to everything and if you are particular with tidy and fresh unit. ******.

Wir haben uns in Antónios Wohnung sehr wohl gefühlt. Es war wie nach Hause kommen in ein schön gestaltetes Heim. Ines geschmackvolle Handschrift war überall sichtbar und sie hat uns mit liebevollen Kleinigkeiten verwöhnt. Es war gut, in der Nachbarschaft eine Bäckerei zu haben, in der es leckeres Brot, Kaffee und Kuchen und kleine preiswerte Snacks gibt. Um die Ecke wird köstlicher Fisch im Freien gegrillt, die Verkehrsverbindungen sind mit Straßenbahn, Bus und Metro genial und von zu Hause aus haben wir zu Fuß die wichtigsten Plätze erreicht. Es wird Euch gefallen.

From the second we booked the apartment she was truly out guide to Libson.

Wonderful hosts. Beautiful apartment. Natural light, very clean and well appointed, lovely interior design and use of colour.
We received a lovely welcome on arrival - Teresa took the time to show us around the apartment and then provided maps for us with lots of tips for things to do and places to eat.
Neighbourhood is great, very lively with restaurants and bars at your doorstep which we loved. Tram 28, Portuguese tarts, viewpoints a short stroll away.
Thanks Teresa and Andy - it has been one of our favourite airbnb experiences so far
Thank you so much, Teresa and Andy, for being such great hosts. We loved the place! Beautiful light, amazing decor and super close to everything. Just perfect.

Teresa + Andy's apartment was extremely comfortable and an excellent place to stay for our visit to Lisbon. The apartment is spacious, clean, and cozy. We have no complaints and highly recommend this Airbnb!

Everything was perfect from location to cleanliness of apartment to the facilities and to Teresa's hosting. I could not have wished for a better and more comfortable place to retreat from busyness of Lisbon streets. I felt at home and like each detail was immaculately taken care of. I have no hesitation in recommending the place and hope you all have as wonderful experience as I did here in Portugal

Teresa's apartment was better than advertised! Location was perfect for two people who wanted to explore downtown Lisbon by foot - close enough to walk to bars/restaurants/sites and tucked away on an quiet side street in the otherwise rowdy Barrio Alto neighborhood. We couldn't have asked for a more considerate or communicative host. Teresa scheduled a taxi for us from the airport and met us at the apartment prepared with ice cold lemon water and a map of all the best sites. Stay in this apartment - it will be well worth it!

Thanks to Teresa we had a fantasic time in Lisbon. Teresa very helpful and attentive to all our requests. She helped us recommending places to see and eat. The apartment as described actually better which is rare. Anyone thinking of booking should not hesitate. Thankyou Teresa and Andy for all your help.
Diego & Martha

Unsere vier Tage bei Teresa & Andy in ihrer wunderschönen Wohnung im Barrio Alto waren herrlich. Die Wohnung liegt sehr zentral im lebhaften Szenen-Viertel, es gibt eine große Auswahl an Restaurants, Bars und Geschäften, die man zu Fuß erreichen kann. Die historische Straßenbahnlinie 28E hält quasi vor der Haustür (fährt in die Alfama), und auch hinunter zum Sodres ist es nur ein kurzer Fußweg. Die Wohnung ist geschmackvoll eingereicht mit viel Liebe zum Detail und sehr gepflegt, einfach ein Ort zum Wohlfühlen. Sie verfügt über eine sehr gute Ausstattung, alles ist tadellos sauber. Auf Wunsch organisiert Teresa einen Transfer vom Flughafen, was sehr zu empfehlen ist, da man damit die Warteschlange am Taxistand umgeht. Teresas Organisation war perfekt und auch die gesamte Kommunikation im Vorfeld hat Spaß gemacht. Wir sind begeistert und würden jederzeit wieder bei Teresa und Andy wohnen!

What a great place. We loved the openness of the apartment, the light and decor. So clean and refreshing. The bed was fantastic and there were several little nooks to escape into a book. The greatest little restaurants were just around the corner and the tram station was nearby.
The mystery is how a place so centrally located could be so quiet and secluded!
A wonderful spot in a vibrant, handy part of a lovely city. The apartment is great - exactly what you need for a rewarding city break. Thank you!
Amazing hosts. Wonderful apartment with an excellent location. Teresa was very helpful and had everything in order when we arrived. I would highly recommend staying here when in Lisbon.

Teresa and Andy were brilliant hosts. Teresa spent time giving us loads of information and tips about Lisbon; what to see, where to eat etc.  The apartment was lovely; modern, clean and very well equipped.  The location is spot on too. We had an amazing time in Lisbon and shall definitely return.

Teresa was there to greet my parents, who we visiting and very kindly spent time with them, highlighting the best places to visit. The flat was beautiful and clean, with a very nice bathroom. It is also in the perfect spot for walking around the city. They had a wonderful time. Thank you Teresa and Andy!

Lovely, very cosy, perfectly appointed appartment where you feel very much at home. Teresa is a very welcoming host who really cares about her guests and takes time to make sure that everything is ok, all needs are met so that you can enjoy your stay to the fullest.

Teresa and Andy's appartement is the perfect place to stay in Lisbon. It is located central in Bairro Alto, where night clubs, restaurants and shops are just a short walk away. The appartement was clean and nice, and Teresa and Andy welcomed us late in the night, and gave us a lot of useful information about the flat and the local area. They were also super-easy to communicate with! Will absolutely reccomend this to anyone going to Lisbon!

Everything about Teresa and Andy's is great - it has a lovely feel to it, has everything you need (and more) and is in a fantastic location. Teresa's a brilliant and super friendly host - she goes out of her way to be helpful and to find out what you're interested in, so she can give you suggestions of what to do and where to go. Their guide to the local area couldn't be better - I loved following their tips for bars, restaurants etc and hardly needed a guide book at all.

A superb apartment, in a great location and amazing hosts. Cannot recommend enough!
Simon

Everything was great-communication with Teresa, arrival, departure. When Teresa met us at the apartment she gave us maps and recommendations. We followed up about half the suggestions and they were terrific.
The apartment is beautiful and in a perfect location. We walked everywhere. Highly recommend.

Teresa + Andy have thought of it all. From helping with transportation to their place, and even helping with transportation to our next place. They provided maps, suggestions, and a great overview of what to do. Their restaurant suggestions were spectacular. And the location is perfect for exploring. If Lisbon is on your itinerary, don't miss staying at their place!

Teresa was a perfect host from meeting us upon arrival and cheerios on departure for which she arranged a taxi to the train station. The home was as described and well presented and tastefully decorated with all the things at you might need for your stay. For us the location was excellent and we would have no hesitation in recommending Teresa's apartment for young or old( We are in the second category )  enjoyed our bar hopping, fado music and the in's and outs of the back streets. The famous 28 tram on your doorstep, local sights as well as doing a couple of trips out of town . Thanks Teresa for being a lovely host, you have got things just right and deserve all the positive reviews you have had so far. Mick &Sue

Teresa and Andy's place is the epitome of AirBnB apartments. Their home is tastefully decorated with immaculate cleanliness and plenty of personal touches. The location was very central and yet still away from the crowd enough to offer a peaceful night of rest. Teresa is a great host and offered excellent directions plus recommendations for my stay. Everything from check in to their Lisbon guide was clear and helpful. I followed their guidebook and had an excellent time eating and sightseeing in Lisbon without doing any research on my own. Their hospitality is unbeatable and I felt right at home since the moment I arrived! I would definitely stay at their home again!

We enjoyed our stay at Teresa and Andy,
we found anything as it was described with very friendly and helpful hosts who gave us some advice for nice places we wouldn't have found without the tips.

The best location in Lisbon, hands down. This gorgeous loft was the perfect spot for us to use as a home base while exploring the city for several days. The apartment is immaculately clean, with tons of natural sunlight, a great kitchen, and modern updated bathroom. The bed is super comfy! The neighborhood is walking distance to everything you could want to see in Lisbon and some of the best restaurants to boot. My wife and I had a wonderful time here and would highly recommend anyone to stay here. Teresa is a fabulous host and she went out of her way to make our stay as comfortable as possible.

This place is ideal! The location is perfect - walking distance from so so much and easy to enjoy all of the beauties of Lisbon. Its a wonderful apartment with tasteful decoration. It was super clean, comfortable, quiet and all around fantastic. Teresa met us upon arrival and walked us through suggestions for our stay. She left us with a list of places to eat which were simply perfect. She communicated with us well and arranged for a taxi to take us to the airport. I have only positive things to say about the place. Highly recommend it for two friends or a couple. I would definitely stay there again.

The appartment feels like home, it's cosy and clean. Teresa and Andy are great hosts.  They also can arrange a friend who will pick you up from the Airport. The neighbourhood has enough nice restaurants, wine bars etc.

Great location, superb host - Teresa met us and gave us some excellent tips and advice of the great local places to go.
The flat is clean, tidy and has lots of little extras for you to use and make yourself feel at home.
As a base it was extremely central enabling you to walk around most of Lisbon.
Great place to stay, superb host and would recommend. Thanks for looking after us Teresa.
Exceptional host. Excellent house. I do highly reccomend!
Teresa is s super host. She gave us a lot of good tipps for restaurants and bars, for trips and things to see. The flat is cosy, clean and very good situated. We loved it!

Teresa was a very kind and friendly host. She had a lot of tips and maps of Lissabon. Communication was great and very fast. I would recommend her and her ap. , if u want to have a quite space but just five minutes walk to the very livly and exciting life of the city.

Teresa and Andy's place is an amazing little apartment well situated on the city and with everything you need for a great stay. Clean, light and close to everything you will want to see and do.
Teresa was very helpful and accommodating in our check in and out and had maps and tips prepared to make our stay the best possible. Even offering to arrange a cab for us from and to the airport.
Totally recommend for a great stay in Lisbon and if you are vegan/vegetarian she knows all the must go's!

This apartment exceeded our high expectations, and the hosts went out of their way to provide detailed recommendations, careful explanations about the apartment--and to arrange on-time transportation to and from the airport. The location was excellent, and we felt immediately "right at home." The description on Airbnb was entirely accurate, and the apartment was even better than the photos portrayed. The hosts' communication with us was very timely and helpful. This is an absolutely wonderful place, offering a great stay in Lisbon!

Teresa and Andy were excellent hosts and provided us with plenty of useful information prior to, and during our trip. They even arranged an airport transfer and kept our bags in their own apartment on our last day as we had an evening flight. The apartment was in an excellent location and was very well equipped with everything that you could need and Teresa had left fresh coffee, tea milk and other basics for our use during our stay. I would highly recommend them
Appartement nickel et très bien situé. Propriétaire charmante, disponible et pleine de conseils. Un superbe séjour.

This is a very comfortable apartment in a good area of central Lisbon, very walkable and close to metro and anything else you may need. The apartment is very well equipped with all the personal touches because it is not a business, rather the owners second place. Our check in was perfect and everything was excellent! Teresa was very helpful and provided thoughtful tips and information for our stay. We have stayed in many AirBNB places and this one was five star all the way!

The apartement is very central, you can walk everywhere. It was beautiful inside, everything is so well thought out. Teresa was so kind in recommending places to eat and to visit. We had a wonderful weekend and are planning to go again as soon as we can!
Thank you!
Excellent air bnb Immaculately clean. Stylish and good quality furnishings. Comfy bed. Good shower. All well equipped home from home . Excellent helpful host.

We would highly recommended anyone to stay at Teresa and Andy's.
The location is perfect for getting around Lisbon, which was all a walkable distance away in the 3 days we visited.
The apartment was clean, tidy and had everything you could possibly want provided for you.
But, the main reason to stay here is the kindness and excellent communication from Teresa and Andy. From booking through to checkout; from a taxi from the airport to amazing recommendations for trips, restaurants, custard tart patisseries.
We couldn't thank them enough for exceeding our expectations for the trip :)
The location is great - easy to get around and Teresa was ready with all the answers.
Ótimo apartamento , super limpo, organizado. ATeresa é educadíssima e atenciosa. A localização é perfeita! Quando voltarmos a Lisboa , quero voltar para lá.

The apartment was beautifully decorated and had everything we needed for our stay. The location was on a quiet side street just steps from the hubbub of the city. Exactly what you need for a city break. Teresa was a perfect host, she was able to arrange a car to pick us up at the airport and met us on arrival at the apartment. She provided an excellent list of recommendations for places to to go and eat, all of which were spot on. The best airbnb I've stayed in. Highly recommended!
L'appartement de Teresa et Andy est très agréable, très bien équipé et très bien décoré. Teresa a été très disponible et soucieuse de nous rendre service. Je recommande fortement ce logement.
Teresa and Andy's flat in Lisbon is wonderful. It's clean, bright, comfortable, and close to great restaurants. We can't wait to come back!

Teresa and Andy are really helpful and we can recommend them to everyone once they are in Lisbon, the Apartment is really gorgeous and the location is just perfect. You are in the middle of the old town and can discover everything by foot.
Thank you for the pleasant stay... you made our weekend really special
Best Regards
Dino and Olivia

Lovely apartment in the heart of bustling Lisbon but on a very quiet street. Top floor apartment but only two flights up. Great apartment for a couple or a single person. The hosts leave plenty of necessities, coffee and fresh produce to snack on. Teresa is very sweet and welcoming and gives a thorough rundown of the apartment.
Warning: The bedroom of apartment gets quite cold in the colder months since there's no heating in that room. The blankets make it warm within however. There is an AC in the bedroom for the warmer months.

If you're looking at this review and thinking about whether or not to book a stay at Teresa and Andy's, just scroll up and hit the 'Book' button.
Once I booked, Teresa offered us a warm welcome email and some great tips around getting to/from the airport. She followed up ahead of our trip with great tips for the locality - cafes, bars, restaurants and all the standards - food shop, pharmacy etc.
We shared travel plans and met Teresa who was warm and friendly. She took us around the flat and her local tips - great start.
The flat is gorgeous - rustic, spacious and very homely.
The wifi was fast, coffee machine was amazing and the rain shower (with view) was gorgeous.
The location is perfect - in the heart of Barrio Alto and close to everything you need - old town for the tourist vibes and all the bars and restaurants on your doorstep.
We went out for drinks the night we arrived and we concerned that it might be noisy in the flat - Lisbon people love to get a beer and drink and chat on the street. We should not have been worried - we could not hear a thing - very peaceful nights sleep.
Teresa also checked in with us that all was well in flat throughout our trip - an amazing service.
Finally, she arranged a pick up for us to get to the airport for a very cheap and fair cost.
I can't wait to come back to Lisboa and stay here again.
10 stars if possible!

En résumé : la prochaine fois que nous allons à Lisbonne, nous vérifierons d’abord les disponibilités de l’appartement de Teresa avant de prendre nos billets d’avion. L’accueil de Teresa fût parfait. Elle a pris le temps de nous expliquer les bons plans et les spécificités de Lisbonne. Son aide fût précieuse pour organiser nos transferts de et vers l’aéroport en contactant le chauffeur avec lequel elle a l’habitude de travailler. Son appartement est très bien situé, dans un quartier plein de vie et pourtant très calme. Il correspond tout à fait aux photos. Il est décoré avec beaucoup de goût. De plus il est très bien agencé ; on peut facilement y rester plusieurs jours et s’y faire à manger. On s'y sent comme chez soi.

Dit is een prachtig appartement in een trendy wijk van Lissabon. Teresa heeft ons uitstekend voorgelicht en had goede tips in de omgeving. Het appartement ziet er prachtig uit, bevat heel veel praktische zaken (kaarten, boeken, etc) en is superschoon. Een echte aanrader!

Teresa's apartment was absolutely perfect! It is beautifully decorated, clean, and centrally located. Teresa met us when we arrived and gave us great suggestions of places to eat and visit. We definitely felt like it was our home away from home.

We stayed here on the Lisbon portion of our honeymoon and it couldn't have been more perfect. The space is beautiful, bright, very well equipped and pristinely clean. It is in a great part of town for exploring and Teresa gave us no shortage of ideas for places to see, to shop, and to eat. The bed was comfortable, the wifi worked great, the walk up was really easy even despite our luggage, Teresa was SO nice and extremely helpful; I only have completely positive things to say about Teresa + Andy's place. We can't wait to come back to Lisbon and wouldn't dream of staying anywhere other than this flat!

Teresa and Andy are 5 Star hosts and the flat is absolutly brillant. Teresa has given us great recommandations, where to eat and what to visit in Lisbon. The flat is perfectly located to discover the City and just a minute walk to the tram station. Thanks Teresa for being such a great host - we loved it.

Theresa is a wonderful charming woman.
she spent a lot of time giving us very good advises and arranged a list of hot spots and maps.
We could feel at home immediately.
I'll return to that cosy place definitely.
Thanks so much, Theresa, you're welcome in Berlin!!!

We had a wonderful stay at Teresa and Andy's apartment. The apartment was lovely and exactly as depicted in the photos. It was bright spacious well appointed and in a great location. Teresa was fabulous to work with from the moment we made our booking. Her recommendations about restaurants and things to do in Lisbon were invaluable. She made restaurant bookings for us organized airport transfers and answered a multitude of questions ! We loved our stay at her apartment and would highly recommend it . If we return to Lisbon we will certainly stay there again !

Je ne peux que recommander l'appartement de Teresa !!!
Un accueil très chaleureux, nous sommes arrivés à 22 H 30 de l'aéroport, Teresa nous attendait et a pris le temps nécessaire pour tout nous expliquer. Hôte très sympathique, son appartement est trés bien situé, très fonctionnel, tout est là, et décoré avec beaucoup de goût .
Notre séjour chez Teresa a été un vrai plaisir !
Sylvie et Michel

Teresa was so friendly and gave us great recommendations for things to do/ places to eat. She also arranged for a taxi to pick up up from the airport. The apartment was lovely- very clean and beautifully decorated. The location is also perfect. Would definitely recommend!

Teresa was a fantastic host! We had one of the best experiences with Airbnb here. She was waiting for us even though our train was arriving later than expected, and she took the time to explain everything in the apartment, as well as provide great recommendations for restaurants and bars in the area. Everything in the apartment is well thought out - there is everything you could possibly need for a great stay. We also really enjoyed the unique decor. It is clear that Teresa and her husband are travellers themselves. The apartment is also in a great location, within walking distance to the coolest parts of Lisbon. Teresa also made sure to book us a cab to the airport on our last day, and came to help us with our luggage. Highly recommended! Wish we could have stayed longer!

Teresa was a terrific host. Communication was first class and her greeting on arrival was warm and incredibly informative. The apartment was lovely and there were books to read and movies to watch - if you could find the time. Location was excellent but if you are a light sleeper and staying over a weekend I would pack earplugs - it's a lively part of the world!
Would recommend Teresa's apartment without any reservations.

My two friends and I had a fantastic stay at Teresa's. Great location and the apartment was immaculately clean and decorated. Her attention to detail including the maps with recommendations of the local area really enhanced the trip. Would definitely stay again and recommend to others. Thanks for having us!

The location of the apartment is just perfect to discover the town on foot or by tram etc. Nevertheless it is very quiet located in a small street. We slept fabulous also because of the comfortable beds. The apartment is just great for recovering after an eventful day – all necessary things and much more are available in the apartment, we got valuable tips and guidance for Lisboa and were roundly satisfied. Teresa is just a great host – thanks for having us!

We had an amazing stay in Lisbon. The apartment was lovely and as described. The location is perfect for exploring Lisbon. Teresa was very friendly and helpful and gave great recommendations on what to do in Lisbon. We would definitely recommend to stay here to anyone looking to explore the city.

We felt right at home!  The space is as good as it looks in the photos.  The location was right in the heart of the city.  Teresa gave us lots of helpful info and was very responsive on coordinating arrival/departure.  Would definitely stay there again if we come back to Lisbon.

We had a great time in Lisbon. Teresa and Andy were great hosts, giving us good recommendations as to what to see, where to shop, eat, what sight to visit. Teresa even delivered us herbal tea when found out that one of us felt ill.We will definitely be back one shiny day :)

Andy & Teresa were fantastic hosts, even though they could not be there to great us they arranged everything for us. They even sent us a list of all their favourite restaurants and places to visit all clearly marked on maps. And all of them were great and made our first visit to Lisbon a an amazing experience. We could not have asked for more.

El apartamento es mejor que en las fotos y lo mejor es la localización en el corazón del Barrio Alto. Todo muy limpio y cómodo. Teresa es una gran anfitriona y desde el primer momento se preocupó de facilitarnos tanto la llegada como la estancia. Nos proporcionó información para aparcar y dos mapas con sus sitios preferidos de la ciudad. Muy recomendable.

Many thanks for the very warm welcome to Teresa! She immediately made us feel at home and showed us several places to visit in order to have a first idea of all the things we could do during our 6-days stay in Lisbon. Not only did we try out several recommendations but also we found ourselves very happy with them. The apartment is very nice and cozy. Luckily there is an air-conditioning as  the summer climate of Lisbon is pretty warm. The kitchen has everything you need should you ever want to cook a dinner / lunch or have breakfast at home (breakfast we always had there). The bathroom has everything you need and the living room (including several books / guides / dvds) really helps after an entire day out walking around the city. All in all, just what we wanted and expectations where definitely met if not even exceeded.

We absolutely loved our stay in Teresa and Andy's apartment. It felt like a true home away from home. Teresa was a wonderful help when we arrived. She organised our transport to and from the airport. She also gave us a map and list of places to see or restaurants to try. We made it a fun challenge/treasure hunt marking off the list.
The apartment is in a great position, easy walking distance to restaurants, tram stops etc.
We will definitely be recommending that any friends or family stay here if they visit Lisbon.
Julie and Grace Sheehan

Bedste velkomst vi nogensinde har fået! Vi blev modtaget af den sødeste udlejer Teresa som var SÅ sød og hjælpsom :) hun havde styr på alt og fortalte os om området og havde lavet lister til os med deres bedste anbefalinger (hvilket vi brugte hver dag og endte med de mest fantastiske oplevelser som man kun kan med tips fra lokale)
Området er perfekt! Meget stille og rolig vej og kun to gader væk kan du finde natteliv, som man ikke påvirkes af i lejligheden. man følte sig hjemme i den lækre lejlighed. Og god kommunikation over mail/sms både før og under ophold, hvor de tilbyder at arrangere kørsel fra lufthavnen til næsten ingen penge. Rigtig rigtig god oplevelse . Vil meget gerne tilbage og bo i deres lejlighed :)

Teresa and Andy were pretty great hosts.
They welcomed us and kindly made fresh lemon and rosemary and then gave us a lot of recommendations, there were quite wonderful. Her apartment was in perfect location, has a good taste, contained everything we needed.
I would highly recommend staying her apartment. We had a great time in Lisbon.
Thank you so much, Teresa and Andy!
Very nice (and clean) apartment and hospitable host.

We would like to give a comment on Teresa’s apartment. We stayed there 3 nights in August 2016.
Her apartment is very nice situated in the Old Barrio. Everything of the old parts of Lisbon is in walking distance. Very convenient! The atmosphere of the apartment is wonderful. In the Old Barrio you can see, touch, feel and taste the history of beautiful and impressive Lisbon. The apartment itself however is very modern and comfortable, a beautifully renovated attic of approximately 50 m2. We loved this mix.
Lisbon is fantastic! Just do it for a couple of days!
Teresa's is warmly recommended by us. She’ll give you all the information of everything of interest, she is friendly and hospitable.
Enjoy!
Bert & Marijke

Lejligheden er virkelig en perle, og jeg følte mig så godt tilpas der. Den er indrettet til ro og fryd, og placeringen er rigtig god. Terese er en supervært, meget sød og betænksom.  Jeg vil helt sikkert bo der igen.

Wonderful host, apartment and city. Teresa welcomed us on arrival with loads of recommendations to places loved by her and Andy and tips for the city. Will be recommending this gem to friends, family and will be sure to go back next time in Lisbon!

L'appartement de Teresa et Andy est magnifique et parfaitement équipé (clim). Il est au centre du Bairro Alto, à 5 mn à pied du Elevador sa Bica qui a été classé monument national !! Tout autour de l'appartement, vous trouverez Resto et Bars de nuits ... Teresa à également pris beaucoup de temps pour nous montrer sur un plan tous ces resto et les lieux à visiter.

The apartment is beautifully decorated and in a great location. Teresa is such a lovely host who really takes the time to make sure her guests can make the most out of their time in Lisbon. We were only there for 2 days and went to restaurants on her list of recommendations which turned out to be the best places we had eaten at all trip. I would strongly recommend her and her apartment to anyone.

Teresa ist a real superhost! She did everything to let us feel at home right from the start! The place is lovely and as shown on the pics! The bed is so comfy! You live right in the middle of Bairro Alto and all the food places can be easily reached by foot! Teresa will help you with instructions and suggestions! Thanx a lot Teresa! We will come back to lisbon!!!
An amazing, comfortable place to stay!

The flat is beautiful and cosy, and the location is perfect in a quiet street of the Bairro Alto, next to all the restaurants and bars. Teresa was a fantastic host, she gave us a full guide of their favourite places in Lisbon, including maps and directions. We tried almost all of them and they did not disappoint. She was really helpful and went out of her way to help us with our travel arrangements. Would definitely stay in Teresa and Andy's flat again and would recommend it to anyone travelling to Lisbon. Thank you Teresa!

Communication with Teresa was really great, both before and during our visit. Her welcome included meeting us at the door, helping with our luggage, and sitting with us to fill us in on how to get around, all her favorite sights and restaurants. The apartment is as fresh and attractive and well located as in all the previous reviews. Meticulous and filled with everything one would possibly need. The neighborhood is among the most desirable in Lisbon. Lots of interesting restaurants, night spots, and down to earth shopping. Thanks for a great stay.

We had such a fantastic stay in Teresa's apartment. It's a really lovely space, in a vibrant part of town. The apartment is so well equipped, there wasn't anything we needed that we couldn't find! Teresa was soooooo helpful too, gave us loads of great recommendations for bars and restaurants and they were all fantastic. I would highly recommend!!!

Teresa was an excellent host. She arranged for us to picked up from the airport and was there to welcome us. Her advise on where to go on Lisbon was excellent and she spent a while making sure we knew where to go and answering our questions. The flat is beautiful and it was a pleasure to stay there!

Teresa's flat is an absolute gem! Right in the middle of the lively part of Lisbon, so a great location for exploring all the great things this city has to offer. Teresa gave us many great recommendations, we made sure we followed her advice :-) The flat is flawless: clean and cosy just as in the pictures. Last but not least: Teresa is a great host, responds immediately and has many great suggestions! If you go to Lisbon, make sure you book this place! Thanks Teresa!!

OSPITALITA' GENEROSA E PERFETTA. LA CASA HA RISPETTATO IN PIENO LE NOSTRE ASPETTATIVE. IL QUARTIERE LO CONSIGLIERO' A CHIUNQUE VORRA' RECARSI A LISBONA.
MOLTO GENTILE TERESA. E' STATO VERAMENTE UN PIACERE.

Amazing stay in Lisbon. The apartment was perfect for us; clean, lovely decor, contained all we needed and was in a fantastic location. Teresa was incredibly helpful and provided us with excellent information and advice about places to visit/eat etc. Highly recommended.

Teresa and Andy were very welcoming and their flat was amazing. They provided us with a great selection of maps and information on sights, restaurants and places of interest. We used the information they gave us loads and they did not steer us wrong.
The flat is just perfect - very clean, well equipped and quiet! There was nothing we needed and could not find - they even provided us with slippers and all the basics (coffee, fruit, sugar, etc.). It is particularly bright and airy and the shower is excellent (warm and great pressure).
The location is very convenient. Very close to fantastic restaurants, cafes and sights and perfectly located for public transport. An absolutely perfect flat with great hosts!

het appartement was schattig, mooi en op een geweldige locatie.
Qua benodigdheden was alles aanwezig, goed werkbaar en prettig. Kortom een erg aangenaam verblijf, aanrader!

Teresa ist eine perfekte Gastgeberin. Wir haben uns sofort bei ihr wohlgefühlt. Die Wohnung war genau wie wir sie uns vorgestellt haben. Mit Teresa's Tipps konnten wir uns die Bairro Alto erschließen und viele neue Eindrücke gewinnen. Wenn wir wieder nach Lissabon fahren, werden wir bei Teresa wohnen.

Teresa ist super flexibel, somit konnten wir telefonisch mit Ihr die genaue Ankunftszeit abstimmen. Sie hat uns sehr herzlich begrüßt und einen super Plan mit Restaurants und Sehenswertem vorbereitet.
Ebenso hat Sie aufladbare Karten für den öffentlichen Verkehr, wodurch man ein bisschen was sparen kann und in einen leckeren Nata investiert.
Das Appartment liegt super zentral, ist hell und sauber. Man fühlt sich sofort sehr wohl, sodass man eigentlich gar nicht mehr gehen möchte :)
Sie hat uns einen Taxifahrer organisiert, der uns super zum Flughafen gebracht hat. Vielen Dank und jederzeit wieder!

Dear Teresa, we had a great stay in your apartment! It was very clean, quiet and beautifully decorated. It almost felt like home! Thanks for the nice suggestions you made. A vida portuguesa, Taberna da Rua das Flores ... we appreciated all of them! I definitely recommend "Your home in Bairro Alto", a nice place in the centre of Lisbon!

We'd highly recommend Teresa and Andy's apartment. It's a perfect base for exploring Lisbon - it's well located, with most sights in walking distance and good tram/train links to sights further afield, and is a comfortable home to return to at the end of the day. The apartment is just as shown in the photos - really light and airy, with an attention to detail and design. The bed was comfortable and there was everything we needed, including breakfast items, coffee and even a bottle of wine! Teresa is a great host, with a warm welcome and some really helpful tips and recommendations. She also organised travel from and to the airport for us for a reasonable price, which ran really smoothly. This was our first Airbnb experience but won't be our last!

Teresa was a wonderful host - she gave us a thorough introduction to Lisbon and to the flat upon our arrival. She was in constant communication with us during our stay when we had questions, and her recommendations for restaurants and sites were perfect for our interests. The flat is beautiful and quiet, the bed is comfy, and the kitchen was stocked with a bottle of wine and essentials including some amazing jam. We hope to return to Lisbon and stay in Teresa's flat again some day.

Accueil chaleureux et souriant, appartement vaste, lumineux, parfaitement équipé, décoré avec gout, dans une rue calme mais au cœur d'un quartier très animé.
Térésa et Andy ont organisé pour nous les transferts depuis et vers l'aéroport.
Térésa et Andy nous ont remis à notre arrivés une liste de bars, restaurants et magasins qui ont leur préférence dans le quartier, et les choix se sont avérés tout à fait adaptés à nos goûts, nos envies et notre budget.
Indubitablement ce logement a grandement contribué à faire de notre séjour à Lisbonne un grand moment de plaisir.

Wonderfull stay in Teresa's apartment.

The quality couldn't have been better. Teresa is an astonishing host and the oral and written suggestions for our stay helped us a lot.
The apartment is in a quiet street, very central and in walking distance to everything.
Everything you need is in this apartment and it full of delicate design

Our stay in Teresa's and Andy's apartment was just amazing. Teresa was super friendly and helpful. The location is good, you are near everything. I loved how the apartment was decorated. For sure when I'm ever come back to Lisbon I will book it again.

Would highly recommend this place! Host was extremely helpful, providing us with lots of information / tips on what to do and where to eat! House was really lovely, well decorated and comfortable, host left homemade strawberry jams, apples, coffee beans, etc for us. Area is near the tram, train station, super market and lots of local eateries. Host also helped us to arrange for the pickup to / fro airport.

We really enjoyed our 3 days in Lisbon at Teresa and Andy's lovely loft apartment. Despite mostly miserable weather the apartment was warm and welcoming. Decor is well captured in listing - it is tastefully decorated and has everything you need for a short stay. Teresa gave a very comprehensive and helpful intro to the apartment and Lisbon - probably the best we have received so far in Airbnb stays. The location is perfect for visiting Lisbon old city and major sights. Lots of restaurants, local shops and bars within easy walking distance. Tram stop and funicular were also close by. Highly recommended.

Lisbon is a beautiful city, the apartment is cosy and full of charm, and Teresa was more than helpful and welcoming !
I would recommend it to anyone !

Josephine

Our host made us feel extremely welcome and provided fantastic information on the local area. We have never been so well informed by any other accommodation facilities.
The location was fabulous, situated in the old part of Lisbon with easy access to all things.
We had an amazing 6 days.

The apartment was lovely and exactly as we saw it on pictures. Everything was in place and the atmosphere couldn't be more comfortable. Teresa and Andy were both very welcoming, explained everything in detail, they were extremely helpful and always available if we needed anything.

Teresa & Andy's apartment is absolutely perfect! Comfortable, quiet, clean and ideally located, in the heart of the cute area of Barrio Alto. Teresa is a lovely host, very welcoming and helpful and we had a pleasant check in.
We will definitely come back to her place when planning a future trip to Lisbon. Thank you very much for such a pleasant stay in a beautiful city!

Warmhearted welcome. Theresa provided us with detailed information on everything we needed. The apartment is outstanding in any respect. You will find everything you need to comfort your stay. There are many typical restaurants just a few meters away from the flat. The perfect apartment to feel at home in Lisbon. We will definitely come back!!

My friend and I came to Lisbon for the half marathon and stayed in Teresa and Andy's lovely apartment. Everything about the stay was perfect. The apartment was great- location, exactly as pictured or better, well-equipped kitchen. Teresa was very helpful and prepared, providing some great suggestions for the area.

Would definitely recommend this to friends or come back!

Teresa and Andy were fantastic hosts. Teresa helped us ahead of the trip with multiple recommendations and advice about Lisbon. She met us and gave us a tour of the lovely apartment, and provided maps and local information (including their favourite bars and restaurants). Would highly recommend staying in this spacious and modern flat (with a great bed and awesome shower), that is a great location for exploring Lisbon.

Teresa nous a accueilli chaleureusement dans son appartement très bien équipé et décoré avec beaucoup de goût.
Rien ne manque, il y a même les capsules pour la machine à café; nous avons trouvé les mêmes au "miniprice" en bas de la rue.
L'appartement est vraiment bien situé au cœur du "Bairo Alto" qui est très animé le soir grâce aux nombreux bars et restaurants que Teresa avait "sélectionnés" à notre intention.
Elle nous a même réservé le taxi pour le retour à l'aéroport.

Our experience at Barrio Alto from start to finish was flawless. Teresa organised taxi's for my family and I to and from the airport, gave us a locals guide to the area and prepared us with helpful tips for the weekend.
The apartment was clean, well decorated and great for a family get away. I have already been recommending to friends to stay with Teresa and Andy when they go to Lisbon next.

For those seeking an authentic 'downtown' flat in the world city of Lisboa, Portugal.....Teresa and Andy's space meets all that might be required. What can one say.....yes, it is in the heart of the Lisboa Scene ..with every visiting traveler needes at ones finger-tips...yes, one is placed just a few steps and side streets off of the hustle and bustle and with a easy climb to this roof-top apartment one is allowed to balance the 'go' of the city with easy access to privacy, comfort, quiet and above all a true sense of 'home' while on the 'road'.
And, as to approachability, efficiency, care, welcoming-warmth, experience and professionalism......Teresa was all there...and, more. Teresa thank you big time for you contribution to making Katherine's and my visit to your remarkable city of Lisbon, Portugal more than a great memory.
The place matched the photos and description perfectly. Teresa was very helpful, and her tips made our vacation in Lisbon even better.

We felt very welcomed at Teresa and Andy's place. Teresa showed us round the apartment in detail, left maps and tips what to see in town and around. The photos and description is precise. The street is really quiet and at the same time 2-3 minutes from the busy city centre, trams, metro, shops etc. Great location.
Teresa is a very nice person, willing to help and give you tips. We would definitely like to return one day to Lisabon and to stay at this very place if possible. I will recomend them to my friends.

Fantastic place to stay and fantastic host. From start to finish Teresa was in contact, giving us directions to the apartment and offering to book taxis to/from the airport. The apartment is beautiful, and perhaps even larger than what it looks like in the photos. My partner and I stayed here for 4 nights. So even when it was raining we were happy to stay indoors. The apartment is centrally located, close to a metro and 2 train stations (easy access to Belem, cascais and sintra for day trips from Lisbon) as well as being well located for lisbon's sights and nightlife. I highly recommend the apartment.

Teresa and Andy were outstanding hosts. Teresa communicated quickly and clearly throughout, providing us with detailed info not just about their lovely apartment, but about the neighborhood and Lisbon in general. The space was spotless, so beautifully decorated, and stocked with anything we might need - including snacks and a bottle of wine upon our arrival! The location was perfect - walking distance from a number of great shops, restaurants and bars, but still quiet at night. We were delighted with our stay here, and would stay again in a heartbeat! Thank you again, Teresa and Andy!

This has to be one of the best apartments I have stayed in through airbnb. Andy + Teresa were very friendly and helpful (organised taxis, sent information + recommendations sheets before we arrived, took our luggage in there apartment as we arrived very early), the apartment is fantastic (good size, very relaxing, comfortable bed, lots of books to read and very clean), the area is perfect (quiet pretty street but very close to the action and plenty of bars/restaurants). I can't recommend this accommodation enough.

Grâce aux indications de Teresa nous avons trouvé très facilement l appartement qui se trouve bien situé, à proximité des quartiers, à mon avis, les plus agréables de Lisbonne. Teresa nous a accueilli chaleureusement, en prenant le temps de nous indiquer de très bonnes adresses, bar à vin, pâtissier, restaurant pour écouter du fado etc. L appart était lumineux, décoré avec goût, la literie super, impeccable, rien à redire, un bel appart d une belle personne. Merci

Teresa welcomed us with great warmth. We went to three of her recommended restaurants - all superb. The stylish accommodation was great. We slept well in the quiet bedroom.  Well- equipped apartment. Super location. One of the best Airbnb experiences we've ever had.
Appartement extrêmement bien situé et décoré avec soin. Teresa est adorable et pleine de bons conseils (restaurants, boutiques ...). Je recommande vivement.

Les indications que donne Teresa dans le descriptif sont très précises, l'appartement est facile à trouver et près de la station de métro. La rue est très calme, nous avons vraiment très bien dormi là-bas.
L'appartement est MAGNIFIQUE. Teresa nous a vraiment tout expliqué et nous a fait part de ses adresses favorites, que nous avons essayées, et que nous validons !!!!!! Tout est simple dans l'appartement, et extrêmement propre, la décoration est très soignée.
Tout était là pour faciliter le séjour.

Merci beaucoup !!!

Parfait ! Charmant appartement plein de lumiere . belle deco . Lit tres confortable . Emplacement ideal , bairro alto mais au calme ! Teresa a vecu en Asie et en connait toutes les attentions , elle a un grand sens du service : chez elle il y a  tout ! elle a pensé à tout ! du coton tige à l'imperméabilisant pour chaussure ! Je reviendrai avec joie ! si il y a de la place ....  !!!

Teresa met us at the apartment on arrival. We loved our stay in Lisbon. The apartment was lovely, spacious, bright and clean. The neighborhood is great with lots of cafes nearby. I loved the decor and Teresa and Andy provided a wealth of information to help make our stay in Lisbon truly rewarding. I highly recommend this apartment!!!

We had a wonderful stay at Teresa & Andy's. Ideally located, it's in a relatively quiet street but still right in the midst of things in Bairro Alto and close to public transport for getting around the city. The apartment itself is gorgeous - thoughtfully equipped and well-maintained. We wanted for nothing. Teresa was a lovely host, very generous with communication and information before and during our stay. (And her map/guide to the area is fantastic; every single spot we checked out was great!) Our only regret is that we didn't stay longer!

Amazing flat, amazing experience!
Before our arrival Teresa sent useful tips and recommendations and also offered a pick-up service from the airport that we used and was great.
At our arrival Teresa met us in the flat with wine and snacks, and explained everything very detailed and friendly.
The flat is really amazing: it is located on a quite street in the middle of all the action, it is clean and lightened and has everything you might need, from cooking tools to sleepers.
Very warmly recommended!

Lovely, adorable apartment! Everything we needed, and the hosts very helpful and charming. There were lots of personal touches, a comfortable bed, great shower, and very pretty, old building. The apartment is very conveniently located. It was a wonderful visit!

Fueron muy amables y nos esperaron a pesar de que llegamos más tarde de lo convenido debido al tráfico.
