Su apartamento es hipercéntrico. Lo tienen impecable y es tal cual las fotos. Las recomendaciones de restaurantes que nos dieron fueron buenas. ¡¡¡Los recomendamos totalmente!!!

One of the greatest AirBnb experiences I've ever had. The flat is exactly as advertised -- it is exquisitely decorated and immaculately clean. It is bright and homey and we found it to be the perfect base to explore the city. It is right in the middle of everything, yet -- and this is a big deal in Lisbon -- amazingly quiet at night. Teresa was simply wonderful; our original flight to Lisbon was cancelled and she was so flexible and helpful throughout the uncertainty. She has prepared detailed maps and overviews of the area with specific recommendations that even if you do no planning before you arrive in Lisbon you will still have an amazing trip just following her suggestions. All around it was an amazing experience and I recommend without hesitation.
Clean, convenient and cute.  Everything you need for just the 'right' Lisbon adventure.  We welcomed experiencing such a charming spot to rest our heads.

Teresa and Andy's home is the perfect location to stay in Lisbon: well located, very warm and cozy. Teresa was very kind and welcoming with us, she's spend her time to illustrate us the city, the surroundings, with some good tips about restaurants and bar. We surely reccomend the home!

Amazing! Teresa's apartment was fantastic. A great start to a stay in Bairro Alto. More so, her recommendations were spot on. More than we could expect or anticipate. Everything she suggested was either delicious or spectacular. The views, the sights, the experience, we are still awe struck. And would love to return. We stayed for our honeymoon but cannot recommend this place enough for any occasion. The apartment was so clean and well kept. Very close to the metro station, close to many amenities and sights, everything in walking distance. And a very comfortable bed to come back to!  Again, we are so happy with our stay at Teresa's apartment in Bairro Alto, Lisbon, Portugal.

Wow what a beautiful cosy place! Loved every little detail of it. Very nice decorated with beautiful art and cosy colors. But also the apartment had a really good bed and a nice shower. Everything we needed was there. Teresa and Andy where a super nice relaxed couple. Teresa had made a list with good restaurants and great things to do in and around the city. We carried our secret list along the city and made sure we did not visit any place that was not on the list ;-) No, but seriously, we tried some of the restaurants from the list and they where all very good. We also visited Sintra, an amazing fairy tale city close to Lisbon. Future visitors should definitely go there also. Now back to our AirBnB experience.. I can highly recommend this place, not only because it's beautiful and suited in the best area, the barrio Alto. But also because Teresa is the best host.

We loved Theresa and Andy's home. One of the best Airbnb experiences I've had. The apartment was very clean and in a perfect location. Theresa was very quick to respond to our questions/concerns. She also provided detailed suggestions on things to do and see in Lisbon. They went above and beyond as Airbnb hosts and made sure we were comfortable. Highly recommend!

We were warmly welcomed by Teresa on our arrival. She showed us the best places to eat and visit in Lisbon  with details circled on easy to read maps...the apartment was so quiet and peaceful. And we enjoyed walking in the neighborhood and to local cafes and the market. We highly recommend this host and the apartment.

My brother and I really enjoyed our stay here. The apartment is clean, comfortable, beautifully decorated, and well-equipped with most everything you'd need while traveling. It's in a great neighborhood, on a quiet street a few blocks away from several bars with fado, and within walking distance of much of the city.

Teresa and Andy were super helpful and quick to respond to us from the first stages of planning our trip, and their generosity continued all the way to the end of our time in Lisbon, when Teresa ordered a cab for my early morning trip to the airport. On our first morning they took the time to help us orient ourselves, and to suggest some vegan spots around town for my brother. I'll happily recommend their listing to any friends heading to Lisbon, and I'm looking forward to coming back myself!

Teresa's and Andy's apartment is actual even more comfortable and tastefully furnished than it looks like on the pictures. Located in Bairro Alto, their apartment is a perfect starting point for some relaxing days in Portugal's capital and for exploring it.
Moreover, bakeries, the river Tajo and the nightlife district are within walking distance.
The provided information about Lisbon, it's sights and interesting restaurants have more than met our expectations.
We also want to point out Teresa's hospitality, her insider-knowledge and her cooperation concerning our luggage.

Thanks a lot for everything and the great stay in Lisbon!

Teresa + Andy's house is even more lovely than in photos. Extremely well located, and prepared for a great time in Lisbon.

Teresa provides tips and maps both from Lisbon and from other cities to visit (Cascais, Sintra, Belem).

Will definitively repeat at Teresa + Andy's next time in Lisbon.

We had a very enjoyable few days at Teresa and Andy's comfortable apartment in the Bairro Alto in early-November. Teresa helped make our trip stress-free by organising airport picks up for us.
She met and talked us through everything in the apartment. Her maps and lists of 'local recommendations' for food, fado, sights etc was very helpful - pity we didn't have time to try more!
The apartment was very comfortable, clean and had everything we needed - kitchen, interesting books, comfy bed, good location, wifi, secure. No TV but why would you? Although it is 'near the night spots', it is in a quiet historical area. We didn't feel the need to use transport much but the trains/trams aren't far.
Loved our stay and would love to come back to Lisbon for another visit!
Loved Lisbon and
Beautiful flat in a perfect location (in the middle of Bairro Alto). Teresa and Andy are really kind host. Highly recommendable.

We had a perfect first Airbnb expierience in Teresa + Andy's beautiful flat in the middle of the Bairro Alto. Thanks to the very cosy interior and Teresa's welcoming and friendly reception we instantly felt home in Lisbon. The recommendations Teresa gave us beforehand and at our arrival were very valuable and helped us to navigate trough the city and see the most interesting parts of town without having to use our guide book. I would stay at this apartment again without hesitation.

From the first contact with Teresa I knew we had chosen the right place for our first visit to Lisbon.Teresa was quick to answer our questions, gave me great advice on what to read before our visit and the information given was very helpful.
We were greeted by Teresa at our arrival and she took time to give us information which was so precious during our stay.
The appartement is lovely decorated with so much taste and spotless.Sure that Teresa knows what a traveller needs. The kitchen is very well equipped with basic products, some fruits in the fridge and a bottle of wine to welcome us.(Thank you Teresa !). Her home is home away from home and you will feel like a local when stepping out of the door.Great books on the shelves but you will probably not much have time to read them as there is so much to see in Lisbon!Very well situated in the middle of Bairro Alto a few steps away from tram 28 and with a lot of lovely restaurants in walking distance.Do not bother to search for a restaurant in your tourist guide just follow Teresa's list and you will not be disappointed. We loved Taberna de rua das flores even if we had but it is worth waiting for a table with a nice glass of wine, Pharmacia and Sinal Vermelho. Of course we were very lucky with the weather and could see the sunset on the rooftop of Park. Great breakfast at Tartine and Quinoa on rue Alecrim.We discovered Fado and went every night to Mascote da Atalaia to listen to the singers and musicians. During our stay Teresa contacted us very thoughtfully to make sure that we were ok.As our plane was late in the afternoon, Teresa was very kind to let us keep our luggage in the appartment.
We did not want to leave Lisbon and will for sure come back and stay at this beautiful place where the guests are welcomed as friends.
Thank you again Teresa for an unforgettable stay at your lovely place!
Very nice flat in the middle of Bairro Alto, and a really kind host. Teresa gave us valueable information about the area.

A anfitriã estava a nossa espera na porta no horário combinado, super atenciosa, até nos ajudou a subir uma mala pesada!!....muito prestativa, possui ótimo conhecimento dos melhores lugares a visitar, restaurantes, museus, enfim, é uma maravilha ser recepcionado por ela. O apartamento é uma graça, muito organizado, bem iluminado, limpeza impecável, muito bem equipado, localização perfeita. Voltaria e me hospedar e com certeza recomendarei a quem me pedir sobre onde ficar em Lisboa.

Wir haben uns in Teresas und Andys Apartment sehr wohl gefühlt, es bietet alles, was man braucht und ist sehr gemütlich. Die zahlreichen Lissabon-Tipps von Teresa bieten einen guten Leitfaden für einen gelungenen Kurztrip durch die Stadt, zumal das Apartment zentral in Bairro Alto liegt und man viele Restaurants, Shops und Sehenswürdigkeiten problemlos fußläufig erreichen kann.
Vielen Dank für die tolle Kommunikation, die schöne Unterkunft und die vielen Geheimtipps, Teresa! Wir waren nicht das letzte Mal in Lissabon! Heiko&Christin

Teresa and Andy have a very relaxing home with everything you could possibly want for your stay.
They kindly gave us some very useful tips with a whole host of things to do and see, which we used constantly.

The Taberna restaurant was lovely, hiring bikes along the river to Belem is a must, along with a trip to Sintra but walk a little further to Monserrate will keep you away from the crowds.

Teresa and Andy even organised a taxi to pick us up for our journey home so many thanks you guys.

Nick & Megan

Teresa nous a très bien reçu et nous a donné beaucoup d'informations à la fois sur l'environnement du quartier (supermarchés, lavomatic,...) que sur les endroits où sortir (restaurants, bars,...). les adresses étaient vraiment excellentes et Teresa prend beaucoup de soins pour vous faire aimer sa ville.

Les photos rendent bien compte l'appartement qui a vraiment beaucoup de charme. Il est très propre, a sans doute été refait récemment. C'est un endroit très agréable pour séjourner, on s'y sent chez soi. Il y a une jolie bibliothèque avec des guides sur Lisbonne et le Portugal ainsi que plein de livres sympa (en anglais).

Le quartier est très central, on peut aller à pied partout. On trouve à proximité tous les commerces. On est très proche des restaurants et des bars du Bario Alto mais on est pas en plein dedans et la rue est calme.

In all my travels, I've yet to encounter more helpful and friendly hosts as Teresa and Andy. Teresa spent a half hour at the apartment with me to explain the nuances of the place (how the stove worked, where backup blankets were stored, etc.) and to go over maps and her personal guide to Lisbon, which turned out to an invaluable resource while I stayed at their apartment. On my last day, they not only stored my (extremely heavy) bag at their personal apartment, they invited me in when I picked it up and helped me secure a taxi to the train station.

The apartment itself was clean, fully stocked (from towels and toiletries to cooking basics like garlic and oil), and remarkably quiet for being in the Bairro Alto. I particularly enjoyed the skylights and the windows overlooking the building's inner courtyard.

It was in walking distance to nearly everything I wanted.

Outstanding hosts and outstanding experience.

We had a great time at Teresa and Andy's place in Lisbon, it was like a home from home - exactly what air bnb should be like. The apartment is great, brilliantly located to walk around Lisbon, minutes away from cool patisseries and bars... it felt like a real home and we loved taking there!

Teresa herself was a fantastic host and took time to let us know about cool things to do and share her Lisbon knowledge. She even made sure the bathroom was stocked & left some local produce for us to try - the Vinho Verde is fantastic!

Barrio Alta is also a great neighbourhood. We would definitely stay here again if we return to Lisbon. The apartment was spotless and showed that someone had really taken time to think of what guests would need/like. One of our best air bnb experiences and really made our time in Lisbon special.

If you stay here you must try A taberna da Rua das Flores - it is worth the queue! The food, service, wine - everything here is fantastic. Brilliantly sourced ingredients and knowledgeable staff and not too pricey. The staff even gave us free wine when we were waiting outside to keep us 'warm'.

A 10/10 from us, thank you Teresa! :-)

Staying at Teresa's place was incredible! Firstly, Teresa is super nice and spent an hour with us chatting, showing us the apartment, and then going through all the VERY helpful maps and recommendations she has available.

The apartment itself is also wonderful. Very clean, just as bright and sunny as the airbnb pictures lead us to believe. BIG comfortable bed was a godsend after weeks in other apartments with small, less comfortable beds. Andy and Teresa even have an old Macbook you can use for research or to watch their great DVD collection.

We were worried about how noisy Bairro Alto could be at night, but the apartment is situated on the quite side of Bairro Alto and we didn't hear a peep at night.

Teresa is a delightful person and most gracious host. She was easy to reach before and during our trip and encouraged us to contact her anytime we might need additional info or help. She was waiting at the apartment when we arrived and provided a great overview of Lisbon and gave us tons of info and tips. The apartment is lovely and exactly as pictured; very comfy and roomy. The location is great, central and with good access to public transportation. There's also a fabulous restaurant that Teresa recommended right on the corner. We recommend the apartment and Teresa very highly; you can't go wrong staying there.

This is a beautiful apartment right on the edge of Bairro Alto. I couldn't have picked a better location. There is a supermarket and cash machine 2 streets away. Very safe, very comfortable.

Teresa and Andy were away when we arrived but they were brilliant with communication. They also organised for us to be picked up from the airport by their friend Pedro (who is lovely) and our taxi when leaving.

You have everything you need in this apartment but it is on the top floor with no lift, so if you have mobility problems do not stay here. For everyone else, book it straight away. We were in heaven here and really did not want to come home.

Teresa had mailed us with recommendations for restaurants and places to see on our visit. She left us a bottle of wine (thank you!) and there was coffee, fruit and biscuits in the apt. There was lavender shower gel (use it - I got bitten the second night and when I started using the shower gel didn't get bitten again) and plenty of fresh towels, toilet roll, clean sheets & extra blanket.

On the shelves there are plenty of books and a box with all the tourist information you could possibly need. There is also a laptop and dvds but there is so much to do in this wonderful city you don't need them.

We were so grateful that our first experience of Lisbon was from this apartment, I highly recommend it, for the decór, location and especially the host.

If you haven't been to Lisbon, book this place. You will not regret it.
Lauren & John
Teresa was very nice to us. Welcomed us with suprises, made everything about the apartment perfectly clear and added her excellent recommendations.

Teresa and Andy have a wonderful clean and well appointed apartment in Bairro Alto which was accessible to everything we needed a ms the Metro stop was a 5 min walk.
Although they were on holiday they arranged our pick up with Pedro and he was very helpful.
We were very comfortable and if in Lisboa again we would stay here.

We loved our stay here! Teresa was super responsive when our plans changed and helpful in lots of little ways. We enjoyed trying many of the local spots that our hosts recommended. The apartment itself was fantastic... comfy bed, very clean, excellent location, quiet, stylish, and a fully stocked kitchen. Check in and check out were very easy. I would absolutely recommend it to others; I can't imagine a better airbnb experience.

This was our first airbnb experience and it was superb from initial enquiry to the moment we left. Lovely flat - loved and thoughtfully equipped - in great location and Teresa gave us tons of detailed suggestions. Would definitely recommend and stay again but not with a car - public transport would be much better.
Teresa was great and extremely helpful. The place was just as described and in a great location for exploring Lisbon. Would recommend.

L'appartement de Teresa est parfait: Aussi beau en vrai que sur les photos, aménagé avec beaucoup de goût, très propre, très bien équipé. De plus il est dans un quartier très central.
Nous étions 3 (2 adultes et 1 enfant de 8 ans) et notre fille a pu dormir très confortablement dans le lit d'appoint de la chambre qui est très spacieuse.
Teresa est très accueillante et aussi très attentionnée. De plus elle nous a fourni tout une liste de petites adresses pertinentes et s'est montrée très souple quant au check-in/check-out. Elle a facilité notre trajet aéroport/appartement en s'occupant de réserver le taxi d'aller et de retour. Nous recommandons vivement ce lieu serein et accueillant. Nous reviendrons.

Teresa was very clear in the communication on booking our apartment and even arranged the transport for us from the airport to the apartment. We felt welcome from the beginning. Teresa was very friendly, showed us around the house and gave us a lot of useful tips on restaurants and places to go. You can trust her with your eyes closed because everything was worth visiting.
The location of the apartment is great too, almost everything is on a walking distance and there's lots of great places nearby.
The house was perfectly clean when we arrived and the interior made us feel at home immediately. . When we were here it was very hot so it was wonderful to open up all the windows when we got back from a busy day.

Teresa hat uns in der Wohnung, die genau so schön war wie beschrieben, sehr freundlich erwartet. Wir haben uns sofort wohl gefühlt. Sie hatte eine unglaublich gute und genaue Zusammenfassung besonderer Restaurants und Orte vorbereitet. Eigentlich haben wir dann unsere Woche ganz danach gestaltet und das war klasse (und vor allem lecker!)

Teresa+Andy apartment is lovely. We had a great time in Lisbon and the apartment couldn't be more convenient. Teresa was very helpful giving us advice on places to go, beaches near Lisbon, and general things to do.

Location is fantastic! Close to nice restaurants, bars, etc.

I would definitely stay at this apartment again!
Gorgeous and comfortable apartment, perfectly located. I would absolutely stay here again and would recommend Teresa and Andy's place in a heartbeat.

We were welcomed by both Andy and Teresa upon our (late) arrival to Lisbon, they were very warm, friendly and incredibly helpful towards us. We received a map of the surrounding area with markings of their favourite local haunts - we made great use of these in our time in the city and their suggestions we invariably excellent! The flat itself is lovely - very well equipped and cosy enough to have a quiet night in, if that's your thing. Should we be visiting Lisbon again we will be getting in touch with Andy and Teresa to come back and stay here.

Where to start on our amazing Lisbon experience. Following our booking, Teresa provided clear directions to the flat and she was very flexible about arrival times. Upon arrival Teresa was incredibly interested in our stay and what our interests were and tailored her suggestions accordingly this included a number of personal recommendations in the local area including custard tarts that we think were better than the famous ones! The flat is beautifully finished and includes a lot of unique items which make it a wonderful place to be. It has a great shower and well equipped kitchen and effective air conditioning which was essential during our visit. The flat is centrally located with a lot of the major attractions within easy walking distance as well as being in close proximity to the famous trams. A great host and a great stay, highly recommended.

A truly beautiful flat in a perfect location in Lisbon. Upon arrival Teresa gave us a very well curated selection of shops, restaurants and nearby sights that weren't to miss. The place is as nice as it looks in the photos and more, and was stocked with a lot of the small essentials that one is apt to need while staying in an airbnb abroad. Would highly recommend.

Words cannot describe what a lovely stay we had at Teresa and Andy's beautiful stylish loft apartment. Teresa was brilliant right from the start with prompt and easy communication, and a quick lisbon guide for us which we used as our go-to for food and activities (all her recommendations were fantastic!). She also went above and beyond to help us with airport transfers, and also finding the nearest car rental places and directions. The apartment is well appointed, airy, well lit and a real oasis for weary travellers! It is in a fantastic location but still set back far enough so you're not disturbed by the mayhem and can get a great night rest on the comfy bed. Would not hesitate to recommend this place. In fact, the only bad thing I can think of is that it might spoil our other air bnb experiences because it has set the bar so high! Thank you Teresa, your hospitality was hugely appreciated, and we loved staying at your place.

Beautiful apartment, great location, and amazing hosts! My wife and I spent three weeks in this charming flat, and it really did become our home away from home. The apartment is well represented by the photos and is bright, airy, and very artfully furnished. It is also immaculate and exceptionally well-equipped, with everything from an expresso machine and French press to great reading material and extra toiletries.  The Bairro Alto location is perfect; you are near dozens of restaurants and bars, but far enough away to keep the nightlife from disturbing your sleep. You are also walking distance to some of the most interesting neighborhoods: Principe Real, Chiado, and Baixa.  Access to the Metro, and to the trains to Sintra and Cascais is also quite good.  Above all, Teresa and Andy are outstanding hosts, helping with many aspects of our trip, from airport transportation to restaurant selection. Their immediate responsiveness to all our concerns, intimate knowledge of the city, and remarkable kindness helped make our time in Lisboa especially memorable.

Teresa to bardzo sympatyczna i pomocna osoba. Sam apartament jest bardzo przyjemny i zdjęcia nie oddają do końca jego uroku. Położenie bardzo dobre, tuż przy lini 28 , wszędzie blisko, bardzo nam się podobało. Rady i wskazówki od Teresy również były bardzo pomocne.
W przypadku jakichkolwiek problemów służy pomocą i radą.

The place is lovely as described in the pictures, well equipped to daily needs  (no need to carry your shower gel) and very well located. Teresa is a superb host and make you feel you have  someone local to rely on  if anything was to go wrong.

I couldn't recommend staying here enough. The apartment was stunning and a great place to come back to after site seeing for hours. Like a sanctuary. Teresa was amazing. She was in contact before we arrived with helpful info and maps via email. She met us at the apartment when we arrived and took the time to run through all the info she had previously sent to us. This made our trip unbelievably good. Every suggestion was spot on. The restaurants were fantastic. We were blown away by the food in Lisbon and how affordable it was. Having local knowledge on where to eat is really helpful. The places of interest to visit were amazing. I can't thank Teresa enough for all the help it made our trip really special and because of that we have fallen in love with Lisbon. Would return there in a heartbeat and will definitely be staying at this apartment again. Loved it. It is just like in the photos. Beautiful and the location is perfect for getting out and about.
If you have never been to Lisbon, go!! It's a wonderful charming city and stay in this apartment.

It was already my 2nd time in Teresa's apartment and again I just can say that it was perfect!

The apartment is even prettier than it looks on the pictures. The location couldn't be better (although it's in the heart of Bairro Alto it's super quiet), the apartment was perfectly clean. And the best part about it: Teresa's recommendations what to do and especially where to eat. We really loved everything - and our stay couldn't have been better. I'm sure we're gonna be back again.

Thanks to Teresa and her lovely, cozy, perfectly decorated apartment.

Theresa was an excellent host. She kindly showed us around and introduced us to the neighbourhood.
The house is fully equipped with maps, guides and everything you will require for a good stay in Lisbon. Definitely recommend this place for your stay.

Teresa is a superb host - the appartment is just as described and perfect for our needs smack bang in the middle of the Bairro Alto and a brilliant base for a short stay in Lisbon.   Teresa couldn't have been more helpful with a great list of recommendations for eateries and places to visit.   She was more than thoughtful as she helped us to plan all the things we wanted to do in just three days and we were pleased to accept all her suggestions especially for restaurants - do not miss out on number one on the list - thanks you Teresa for making our stay in Lisbon such a memorable one . J and J

Teresa ist eine Gastgeberin, wie man es sich wünscht. Sie hat mich vorgängig per E-Mail sehr gut über die Anfahrt informiert und mir nützliche Unterlagen geschickt. In ihrer sehr hübschen Wohnung wurde ich herzlich von ihr empfangen und über das Wichtigste informiert. Die Unterkunft ist genau so schön wie auf den Bildern. Während meines Aufenthalts habe ich mich sehr wohl gefühlt, der Standort war für mich perfekt um Lissabon und Umgebung zu entdecken. Ich würde die Wohnung wieder buchen.

Teresa made us feel so welcome and her recommendations were excellent. The flat is just as listed, even nicer if that is possible! The neighbourhood is perfect for seeing all the sights dining out etc but the flat feels like a tranquil oasis. A great place to stay in a wonderful city.

Teresa is a very welcoming host. She gave us lots of great tips for places to visit, nice shops, restaurants and bars. We feel that her tips really helped us to make the most of our holiday. She also checked in with us during our stay to see if everything was going ok.
The flat itself was just like it appears in the listing, spacious, clean, bright and thoughtfully decorated. The shower is wonderful! The coffee, fruit, shower gel and flowers Teresa left us were much appreciated. All in all, it was a lovely experience staying in Bairro Alto!

L'appartement de Teresa et Andy est un vrai petit nid douillet où il fait bon se retrouver après avoir sillonné la ville, très confortable et lumineux, très propre, très bien décoré avec tout ce qu'il faut pour un séjour sans soucis. Il est très bien situé et très calme même s'il est localisé dans un quartier animé. Cet appartement bien situé permet de visiter facilement Lisbonne, il est proche de tous les quartiers à visiter.
Teresa nous a accueilli avec beaucoup de gentillesse, nous fournissant plein de très bonnes adresses et de très bons conseils pour que notre séjour se déroule au mieux. Elle nous a très gentiment réservé nos taxis aller et retour aéroport. C'est une hôtesse hors pair !!!
Nous conseillons très vivement cette adresse !!!
Myriam et Michel

The home was absolutely gorgeous (my dream home) and in the perfect location. Teresa met us, showed us around, and gave us the most perfect recommendations and a labeled map for everything we should do. The place is spotless and has so much light. I've already told many friends they must stay here if they go to Lisbon!

This was our first visit to Lisbon and first time using Airbnb. I'm glad to say it was a great experience.
Our host Teresa was lovely to deal with, always replying to emails promptly, very informative about what to do and see in Lisbon......we ended up following most of Teresa's guides as our itinerary for the weekend. Cycling to Belem and watching the sunset from Park ( a nearby rooftop bar) are a must!
The apartment itself is really lovely, it is exactly as presented on Airbnb and has real character. It's in a great location for the night life and sightseeing but is also a great place just to hang out and relax. It was spotlessly clean, bright airy and very well equipped.
Lisbon is a great city to visit, if you're planning a trip I'd highly recommend Teresa and Andy's apartment.

Easily the best airbnb experience I have had. There are no doubts as to why Teresa is rated a "superhost," and the apartment is breathtakingly cute. I never wanted to leave. :) In terms of comforts, the place has everything. Extra towels and blankets if you need them, and even a laptop and DVDs to watch. The location is perfect, and Teresa was easily reachable via text & email. She also provided an extensive list of recommendations which I found to be perfect. As a solo female traveler, I would most certainly stay here again. Thanks again, Teresa!

Very nice neighbourhood. With lots of nice cafe's, bar's and Restaurants. Felt very Safe. Teresa even pickend us up from the Airport. Because the taxi-driver, i ordered was ill. All in all; i would Book agan. Thank you so much Theresa  for this wunderfull stay

3 things that we rate in airbnb: the owner (ability to facilitate entering the apartment, reply time, cleanliness, ease of exit and arrival, etc.), the value you receive from the rental property (how much bang do you get for your buck? the accuracy of the rental description, amenities, etc.) and Bonus points for going above and beyond.

This place scored perfectly in all three marks.

1. Teresa is amazing, we had an early flight and the apartment was being cleaned so she offered to hold onto our very very heavy bags and transfer them to the flat, mind you she might weigh as much as the bag did. I insisted on taking it, but she refused and lugged the bags there. She was so nice and helpful! We were completely delirious and she gave us a pretty decent run down of the town, places to snag food, coffee before we could access the place. After what was a delightful morning on the water in Lisboa, we met at the place. Teresa was there and gave us a very extensive rundown of the apartment as well as the town. She has a highlight list that begins with a bar on the rooftop of a parking garage, sounds eccentric, right? It was unbelievable, the sun setting over the water with the coolest 20 year olds in the world. Truly every suggestion on her list that we tried was amazing. The Pharmacia, which has a delicious gourmet tasting menu (pricy for Lisbon, but completely reasonable for US/UK$100 Euro for 2 w/ bottle of wine) and another homey place I can’t remember, but was perfect.

Owner: A+

2. The Value of the apartment. This apartment was perfect for our needs and was truly a wonderful value. It’s nicely decorated, simple. It’s got more amenities than we could take advantage of. The apartment is so close to the action, but with none of the noise. It’s quiet and I’m a very light sleeper. The espresso maker, French press, etc were perfect for our jet lagged brains. We haven’t stayed in an AirBnb or VRBO that had a better bang for your buck.

Place: A+

3. Bonus points: Teresa earns so many bonus points:
-She allowed us to leave our bags in her and her husband’s apartment. Then Lugged them over to the place — what that gets it’s own…
-She lugged our bags to the spot!
-Her local recommendations were right up our alley and actually tasted by her. Her newsletter is a perfect guide to Lisbon.
-Helpful insight on our visit to Sintra,
-Less an AirBNB and more like an actual B and B. She offered us the organic vegetables left over from the previous tenants. Coffee pods were available. Washing Machine.
-Maps/travel guides galore.
-More authentic suggestions to see real Fado.

Bonus points: A+

Our overall experience was the best on our trip through Lisbon, Sevilla and Madrid. That’s because of Teresa and the apartment. Couldn’t recommend it more.

Overall: A++++ perfect experience!

Teresa and Andy's apartment is excellent. It has been by far my best air bnb experience.
The apartment is beautiful. Spotlessly clean and stylishly decorated. They have provided every comfort and convenience you could wish for. The location is ideal for exploring all the popular sights and while central is very quiet.
Teresa, went to a lot of trouble providing maps and suggestions for fun things to do. Even providing printed information.
There were a couple of thoughtful touches, she provided a laptop for us to use and a complimentary bottle of wine.
All together this is a very comfortable apartment for exploring Lisbon. I couldn't recommend it highly enough. Thanks Teresa and Andy!

This was our 2nd time staying at Teresa & Andy's apartment and as before, they are extremely gracious hosts. They allowed us to drop luggage at their home as we arrived early and pointed out some new spots in the nighborhood. Apartment is the perfect location for a home base to explore the city.  Cannot wait to come back!! Thank you Teresa for being one of the many reasons we love Lisboa!!

Teresa and Andy were great - very friendly and accommodating. They held our bags for us before we could check in and even after we checked out.

The flat was wonderful and well lit in a PERFECT area of Lisboa. It was one of the best experiences in a city I've ever had. Beautiful.

Thank you both for hosting us.
George

Teresa made us feel right at home in her beautiful place in Barrio Alto in Lissabon! The neighbourhood was great and she had made sure that there was something to drink and some fresh fruit for our first night and morning. She really took time when we arrived to give us great tips for what to do, what to see and where to eat and all her tips were GREAT! From the time of booking until the time we left the communication with her was flawless! What a great host and great place! Thanks Teresa, we will definately come again....

Book now! We visited Lisbon in February and have nothing but rave reviews for our host and the City of Seven Hills.

Teresa is a consummate host thinking of everything her guests may need and providing excellent suggestions for sightseeing in and around Lisbon. Her guide to dining was indispensable. Boy did we enjoy our meal at Apicius. Go early and get a seat Park Rooftop Bar.

Prior to our trip she always responded to me in no time at all. The apartment has everything one would need while traveling and nice additions including a great cross section of popular fiction and travel books. You can't Bairro Alto for being the in the thick of the action. If you are the light sleeper the nightlife nearby might be a little much for you. You are steps away from old-world book shops, dining options, shopping and cafes.

Teresa has impeccable taste employing colors and textures to create warmth. The kitchen is well stocked and bed and bedding made us feel right at home.

If you are lucky you'll get a glimpse of Teresa's elegant and warm mother who was there to make sure we got off ok.

Teresa was a fabulous host and communication was easy right from the start! She made me feel welcome right from the start and was extremely helpful. I was already in Lisbon for a few days prior to staying at the apartment, but nevertheless Teresa organised a driver to pick me up from the airport and drive me to where I was staying and on the day I went to Teresa's apartment, she picked me up and carried my bags for me which was very kind and helpful of her. She also prepared a great list of places to go, eat, drink and visit with a map highlighting where everything was.  A great resource that helped me discover places I typically wouldn't have known about! The apartment was absolutely gorgeous and a home away from home! So lovely and cosy, I never wanted to leave!  It was also very well located and very quiet, which I know is quite rare in that area. I definitely recommend staying here and I would no doubt stay here again if I visit Lisbon again in the future.

Świetny czas, świetne mieszkanie (wnętrze, lokalizacja), super kontakt z Teresą! Wszystko przebiegło z rezerwacją bezproblemowo. Mieszkanie jest dokładnie takie jak na zdjęciach i jest idealnie położone do zwiedzania Lizbony. Apartament wyposażony we wszystko co potrzeba (komputer, internet, kuchnia, łazienka, ogrzewanie/klimatyzację, nawet ręczniki i środki czystości)! Bardzo czysty, cichy, klimatyczny.
Teresa to bardzo miła i pomocna osoba. Udzieliła nam wskazówek, dała wiele pożytecznych rad. Wszystko było super i jesteśmy bardzo zadowoleni z pobytu w apartamencie Teresy i mogę go polecić każdemu.

Nous avons été très bien reçues par teresa. Elle est très gentille et de très bon conseil pour découvrir Lisbonne. il faut suivre sa liste d'adresses, sans hésitation!!!
Son appartement est vraiment joli, très bien décoré, très fonctionnel. On se sent rapidement comme chez soi. Le quartier est un vrai spot pour découvrir Lisbonne. Il est très vivant le soir.
Nous avons adoré Lisbonne et espérons y revenir...
Merci a teresa. Nous recommandons vivement cette adresse
Teresa was a great host. She gave us precious advices. The apartment is really beautiful and pefectly located in the center. It was very clean. Thanks Teresa

Teresa is the perfect host with the perfect Lisbon flat! She kindly met us at the start of our holiday and gave us plenty of helpful advice on some great places to visit. The flat is very comfortable, quiet and relaxing, but right in the centre of the city. There were very few stairs to climb, which was appreciated after walking all day. We'd recommend this beautiful home to anyone for a short or long stay in Lisbon - thank you again Teresa!

What an amazing place. The place is charming, well decorated and functional. I certainly felt very homely during my stay there. The location of the apartment was extremely central to most touristic places. It's 10 mins walk to the train station to Sintra, and less than 5 mins walk to the trams.

There are a lot of bars in the the area, most of them are just minutes walk away. Also there are plenty of local authentic places to eat in the neighbourhood, but if you want to eat from touristy places, there are plenty to choose from within a 10 min walk radius. Despite its close proximity to night life hotspots, the apartment is extremely quiet, in fact we couldn't hear a thing and slept perfectly.

Teresa was extremely thoughtful, really took her time to show us around the apartment, and more importantly gave us tonnes of valuable information that only a local would know. She even had maps and guides ready so that we wouldn't get lost.

If I ever visit Lisbon again, I would no doubt choose this place. Hospitable host, comfortable apartment and central location - what more could one ask for.

Teresa a été très gentile avec nous, elle nous a reçu dans son propre appartement car on est arrivé tôt le matin, accueil chaleureux et avec beaucoup d'aide pour la visite.
son appartement est très agréable, décoré avec beaucoup de goût et avec une situation excellente au milieu du quartier animé de Lisbonne.
on a été très content de notre voyage et de notre choix pour l'appartement de Teresa

Teresa to najlepszy gospodarz na świecie. Mieszkaliśmy w apartamencie we trójkę ( dwie osoby dorosłe i dziecko). Teresa była zawsze z nami w kontakcie. Mam nadzieję wrócić do niego jeśli kiedykolwiek będę w Lizbonie. Dziękujemy Teresa!

We were very satisfied with our stay in Teresa's flat in Bairro Alto. The location is absolutely perfect making the whole stay very authentic. The flat itself is very comfy and clean. Another thing: Teresa's list of recommendations on restaurants/bars was a real gem. All the recommendations were right on point, we ate VERY well.

I couldn't have asked for a better place to stay.

What a great place. Thank you for being such a great host. The flat was just as described, so nicely appointed, easy to get to and fun! Also, many thanks for the wonderful advice, places to see and how to get there.

This was our first time booking with airbnb and we couldn't have asked for a better experience. Teresa was incredibly helpful from the start, giving us plenty of information on how to best get to the apartment and what to consider prior to traveling. We were welcomed at the appartment and were given a great introduction to the city and what not to miss.

The appartment is beautiful and incredibly well-located, close to great bars and restaurants but on a quite street. Thanks to Teresa's detailed maps and spot-on recommendations we had a wonderful holiday. I would highly recommend renting Teresa's appartment to anyone who is planning a visit to Lisbon.

Me and my friend Calle have nothing but good things to say about Teresa. Such a welcoming host, with great advice on how to see Lisbon. The apartment is perfectly situated and pretty much everything is just 5 minutes away. If I ever go to Lisbon again, I will get back here!

Teresa's flat is a real gem!
We stayed 3 friends in November 2014.
The location is perfect, very central and easy to explore the city from.
The flat itself is even more beautiful in reality. Both the bedroom and the living room are big. The decoration is tasteful and discreet. Everything is very clean and tidy, filled with light. The beds were comfortable, same for the sofa and bathroom and kitchen were in perfect order. The flat feels very welcoming. As for the hostess, Teresa, she gave us all the help we needed, plenty of advice and personal recommendations for Lisbon, took the time to prepare a detailed map for us and explained it to us when we met her and even booked us a taxi to return to the airport.
We strongly recommend Teresa's flat as we had a great stay and we are planning to go back again.
Many thanks Teresa!

Teresa is a very helpful and considerate host with comprehensive advice and recommendations on great local spots to visit to enhance our all-too-brief visit. She provided us with well labelled maps to ease our way.
The flat is lovely and was presented clean and well appointed.
The location is in the heart of Barrio Alto and walking adventures are fun through the heart of Lisbon right from the doorstep.
We stopped in on several of Teresa's restaurant, shopping and sightseeing suggestions and found great local experiences off the tourist track.
She was very helpful in assisting our arrival from the airport and even organised cab for our departure. Local knowledge is key in new cities and Teresa is very generous in this regard.
We enjoyed staying there immensely and I wouldn't hesitate to recommend her as a host.
We hope to return some day for a longer stay!

Teresa est une personne charmante, qui a tout fait pour que nous passions un excellent séjour et ce fut le cas !!! L'appartement est magnifique et très bien situé dans une quartier très animé et authentique. MERCI nous avons adoré notre séjour et l'appartement !!!

Teresa was a great host, she gave us a warm welcome, and sat down with us in the apartment to recommend us her favorite spots and sights of the city. She was always reachable, and asked for our feedback. We also liked the organic, "green" soaps ;-). Definitely the best apartment we've ever been to with airbnb!

As someone who has worked in the hospitality industry for many years I was very impressed with Theresa's hosting skills, the amenities in the apartment, the decor and the cleanliness-think boutique hotel with gorgeous bed linen, chaise long, lovely art, movies to watch and a choice of ground coffee or nespresso in the kitchen!
Theresa was actually waiting at the door for us on arrival, she obviously enjoys hosting and is a natural, considering her guest's every need and helping with the all important orientation of the city which can be daunting first time, spending plenty of time with us going over maps which she had
created with key spots and restaurants cleary marked.
All in all one of the best holiday rentals ever and I really hope to go back again soon. Thanks Theresa!

Nice appartment in the middle of a buisy neighbourhood full of restaurants and bars. Perfect base to explore the city. Teresa was nice and welcoming. Her tips for restaurants and places to visit were extremely useful. Overall I had a perfect experience with this stay.

From the moment we walked in, Teresa made us feel very welcome and at home.  Her hospitality was second to none.  Teresa took the time to show us places of interest on a map and even helped with wonderful restaurant suggestions.  We were celebrating our 1 year wedding anniversary while we were in Lisbon.  Teresa helped to make it a very special and memorable trip!  We will strongly recommend her apartment to anyone that we know traveling to Lisbon.  The apartment is also in an ideal location for walking around Lisbon.

It was a wonderful apartment in the center of the city. Teresa had good tips for sightseeing, restaurants and pubs. It was very nice at all and it was one of my best trip.
It was amazing.

Séjour très agréable chez Teresa, appartement fidèle aux photos, décoré avec goût, très propre, quartier très central.
Souplesse pour le check-in/check-out.
Excellentes recommendations, nous avons testé quelques restaurants conseillés: délicieux, authentiques et à un prix cohérent.

Nous avons été très bien reçu par Teresa Pacheco. Un sourire franc; une discussion informante et cordiale sur le quartier et sur Lisbonne. Des bonnes adresses. We had a wonderful time in Theresas beautiful flat. it is super clean and the furniture and Decor is very beautiful and chosen with love. The flat is light and has a very nice and calming atmosphere. It´s in a very nice and central area. Friday and saturday nights it can become a little noisy from the people partying in the restauarnts and bars in the area, but the other nights it was totally fine. Theresa was super nice and greeted us and gave us her great little map with markers for great places to eat and to see or to go shopping in Lissabon. we used it alot and it helped us through the city. thank you for that! her favorite restaurant definaltely was our favorite as well! I would always recommend the flat and always come back. thanks so much for making us feel "at home" in a new city!

Beautiful apartment in a great location. Teresa was a fantastic host and recommended some great places which we took advantage of. We look forward to returning to Lisbon and staying in the apartment again!

If you like the look of this Bairro Alto attic apartment, then you'll love staying here - because these photos are an excellent representation of what to expect. Teresa's apartment is full of stylish design with some lovely details (such as pottery frogs by Bordallo Pinheiro in the bathroom - I was delighted to find a similar one for sale in the Entre Tanto store in nearby Príncipe Real district, so now I have one too!). It's well equipped, and bright and airy despite being an attic. The location is another plus: it's a small residential building on a quiet street, yet it's just minutes away from some of Bairro Alto's most crazy late-night party streets (so you can participate or peacefully ignore!), as well as excellent restaurants, patisseries, butchers, greengrocer, etc. The rest of Lisbon is easy to reach via the famous 28 tram (which stops very close by) or via the Lisbon Metro. Teresa's recommendations of restaurants etc are definitely worth following, as they include some less-obvious options such as Mercearia do Seculo, a small and stylish neighbourhood grocery store which doubles as a micro-restaurant - we shopped and dined here, and it was all delicious! (in addition, I'd recommend De Castro on pretty Praça das Flores). One thing worth noting is that driving to the apartment is quite an experience, because the streets in Bairro Alto really are very steep and narrow - a challenge for the uninitiated! We'd previously been exploring the Portuguese coast, so arrived here in our rental car - in retrospect, it would have been better to return the rental car first, and then taken a taxi here. So we'll do that next time. Because I'd certainly love to return!

On se sent vraiment chez nous dans "Your home in Bairro Alto"!!! l'appartement est très fidèle aux photos, à la fois moderne mais avec le charme de l'ancien, et l'accueil de Teresa est juste excellent !! The apartment was clean quiet and in a perfect location. Teresa was very kind and very helpful and responsive during our stay. We would definitely recommend this apartment t anyone.

I really enjoyed my stay in Teresa´s apartment and just confirm all the following opinions. Teresa was very friendly, responsive and kind all the time, giving me detailed answers to all my questions bevore and during my stay.
The apartment was very clean and kempt, I was surprised to find there even more equipment than I expected. The flat was not just a good starting point to explore the city, but also a quiet and cozy place to spend some hours just relaxing there. To say that we enjoyed our stay in Teresa's wonderful apartment is a veritable understatement! The apartment is located in the Bairro Alto, full of late-night bistros and hole-in-the-wall bars but just a stone's throw from the boutique shopping and literary cafe ambience of Chiado and my favourite bohemian quarter of Principe Real. The location couldn't have been any better: the apartment manages to be at the centre of everything yet remains, at the same time, a haven of peace and tranquility as it is located on a very calm street.

The apartment is wonderfully light and airy and I can certainly attest to a very comfortable bed and a most pleasurable shower. The bedroom is a particularly agreeable room - peaceful and relaxing. The kitchen is well stocked, guide books, maps and recommendations carefully prepared by Teresa abound and the internet works perfectly. The weather during our stay was mild and temperate therefore we had no need of heat or air-conditioning but both facilities exist in the apartment so I imagine it to be comfortable both during high summer and deep winter.

To sum up: I cannot recommend Teresa's apartment highly enough - it was simply perfect in every respect. After a long day exploring the roller-coaster like seven hills of Lisbon on foot, it was always a joy to return to the apartment - our home away from home. Like Lisbon, it has taste, charisma, post-card good looks and a slight edge given it's location. Chapeau bas Teresa!

WOW! Well appointed flat with everything you need and a grocery store a short walk away down a steep hill. Owners are fantastic, friendly and communicative.
One thing to note is that access is through a steep pedestrian walkway (with excellent instructions provided by Bruno) and then up three steep stories to the flat. I had broken my foot earlier in the year and had a bulky walking boot, but was able to navigate fine. If you are OK with hills and stairs, you will be greatly rewarded with stunning views and a lovely flat!

Probably my favourite place I’ve stayed in so far. The view was incredible and the place was clean, comfortable and homely. Everything about this flat is perfect -from the decor and style to the outstanding View!
How special to be high atop this wonderful city. We enjoyed our stay in Lisboa and certainly do not want to leave! Thank you for such an amazing home for our visit.

Wow - what a view! We had the best time exploring Lisbon from our home base at Bruno’s place. Would highly recommend for anyone who wants to be a bit outside of the center of town but walking distance to many great places!
This place is a must stay. The views were insane and the hospitality was great. Joana was so helpful in getting us around the city and getting a covid test to return to the US.

Location was amazing and the views from the apartment were incredible. Very nice and friendly host. Apartment is in great shape. Bed was pretty comfy and shower worked great.

Wow - such an incredible place to stay. We had a magical time in Lisbon and Bruno’s place was even better than we could have imagined. Joana was so helpful in welcoming us too. Highly recommend!!
