Nette Wohnung in toller Lage mit super Aussicht. Alle Touristen wollen hoch zum viewpoint miradouro da nossa Senhora und die Wohnung liegt nur wenige Meter davon entfernt - > 6sterne für Lage und Aussicht.

Excellent communication -- Bruno handled logistics leading up to our stay & Joana was an absolute joy and a fantastic host during our time in Lisboa. Being tall guests, the sloping ceilings in the bathroom and shower were a bit limiting but that ended up being easy to forgive with the flat's views and our host's exceptional hospitality.

Absolutely beautiful apartment with breathtaking view of Lisbon. Wish we could stay longer! Hosts were kind and accommodating, made us feel right at home. Highly recommend, would definitely stay again!

So let me start by saying this is written from a North American view point- this place is on the top floor of a building with crazy steep spiral stairs and we were not expecting that with our heavy suitcases.  Also the pedestrian only street also has stairs and is limestone so very difficult with big suitcases.  The view from up there is lovely but the wind does howl as you are so high up.  The street is graffiti filled and poorly lit and in a residential setting with not a lot of shops or restaurants so we didn’t feel comfortable coming home late at night (or if we had any wine those stairs would have been dangerous!).  So we canceled this booking - at our expense because of the terrible cancellation policy.  I was very disappointed and feel concerned about booking other Airbnb’s in the future as the descriptions may not indicate important details with regards to accessibility.

We absolutely LOVED our stay with Bruno!We are totally in love with this apartment and miss it so much already. We instantly felt right at home. We were in Lisbon for our wedding. Fancy hotels are not our style, so instead we treated ourselves to the most awesome apartment in our favourite neighbourhood that we could find. This place did not disappoint! It has everything you need and more... it’s airy, bright, has a comfortable bed, well stocked kitchen AND THAT VIEW!! We needed a relaxing haven to get away from the busy-ness of wedding prep and entertaining our guests. This place was perfect. We had friends over to enjoy the balcony with us a few times and everyone loved it and said they would live there. I had a wonderful morning on the day of the wedding prepping with my girlfriends and makeup artist. The place is small but feels incredibly spacious and airy due to the layout, the many windows and balcony. The location really can’t be beat. Don’t let the hills scare you. We always stay in Graça when in Lisbon and being right beside the lookout was the best! Bruno was out of town during our stay but very responsive in messaging. It was his co-host Joana who took care of us and she is amazing!!! She is full of energy, positivity and joy! And she made our stay even more memorable by staying in contact and sending so much love our way for our wedding day! She felt like a new friend. She and Bruno even left us a wonderful surprise to come home to after the wedding. We stay in at least 5-10 AirBnb’s a year and this is one of our best experiences. I cannot recommend this apartment and hosts enough!

This apartment is in a great location and the apartment itself is lovely! Stunning views and nice outdoor space. Very easy check-in and check-out. Conveniently located to groceries etc as well as site-seeing and restaurants. And quick drive to and from airport. Overall it was a pleasure. Thank you Bruno and Joana!

We started our honeymoon at the Flat With the View and we could not be happier with our decision. From the extremely accommodating early check in (Joana went above and beyond for us!) to the perfect communication, to the insanely beautiful view and perfect location, our stay was everything we hoped for and more. Lisbon is an amazing city and this flat is truly the best of the best! Thank you for giving us a memory we will never forget and being apart of our trip of a lifetime.

The flat was the perfect place for our stay in Lisbon. It is located very near a popular viewpoint, and you can enjoy the amazing view of the city from the comfort of the flat at any time! Sunsets were spectacular! Communication with Bruno or Joana was simple and quick. Joana was readily available if needed, and we appreciated her tips for navigating the neighborhood.

The view is to die for.
If you have heavy luggage or a good deal of it, either leave it in the car (yes there is local parking) or pass on this great place. It’s 57 small circular steps up
As for for cooking dinner. There is a minimalist approach to dishes and cookware (yes this is a downside) so if you want to cook be aware when you arrive what you need for dinner of breakfast—-it’s a long walk for stuff
Renemthat dverything in this efficiency apartment had to go up these stairs. That’s why the bed is small and no box spring (that is hard)
But the view and a local bottle of wine will make up for a lot
All said, we loved it
The Flat with a View was an amazing place to rest our heads after exploring beautiful Lisboa.  The view is incredible and the Flat is very comfortable and super clean!

Bruno’s apartment is incredible! The view of Lisbon from the patio is better than almost any other view you could find in the city. The apartment is cozy and well furnished, with everything you could need including a kitchen and washer. Joana was attentive to our needs and quickly responded to the few questions that came up. We’ll definitely stay here again when we return to Lisbon!

Joana,
You are amazing and a great communicator! Thank you so much for all the suggestions. The place was amazing and we could see two views when lying in bed. I wish we could have stayed longer. The view was spectacular and the ability to store our bags after checkout was a great touch!

Flat with a view is and understatement! Such an awesome flat tucked away down a little alleyway. Reasonable walking distance from cafes and shops and very close to a popular city viewpoint which made catching a car especially easy. Bruno and Joana were quick to respond and forgiving of my shoddy international phone plan, haha. Super clean and tidy! I would recommend booking while you can!
A beautiful view with great amenities and very comfortable accommodations.  A great relaxing get away overlooking the city.

Attention
Beaucoup de montées beaucoup de marches
Bus 734 vous emmène en plein centre ville où vous pourrez prendre le métro ou le tramway
Excellent restaurant sushi vegan au pied de l'appartement
Si le temps comme nous est à la pluie attention aux trottoirs faient en petits pavés qui sont très glissants
Stunning views for our last night in Portugal! Wish we could've stayed longer!

Unbeatable view from balcony. The apartment located right next to the view point overlooking the whole city. Wonderful hospitality and great recommendations of the hidden gems of the city from Bruno and Joana. 20min walk to the Centre, a bit hilly but good exercise :) highly recommended if you like to chill on balcony with your morning coffee
Wonderful view, rain or shine :) cozy place and great use of space!!

Our stay at Bruno's place was incredible - communication and directions were very clear and they greeted us upon our arrival very late at night after our flight got delayed! Joanna was extremely hospitable and kind and provided us with everything we needed.
The place itself was spectacular - it was quiant and cozy and you cannot beat the incredible view. We were so close to a popular view point and it was really easy to get Ubers there as well. We highly recommend this little treasure on the hilltop. We will definitely be back!

Je pense qu'on puisse difficilement trouver un appartement ayant une plus belle vue sur Lisbonne. Le logement est confortable, lumineux, fonctionnel. Nous y avons passé un excellent séjour. Et merci à Joana pour son accueil, sa gentillesse et les petites attentions. Venez ici si vous voulez passer un séjour en amoureux à Lisbonne.

What a VIEW! What a welcome! What soft linens!! This airbnb takes TOP billing for exceeding expectations. HIGHEST marks for the excellent hospitality of both Bruno & Joana. This airbnb has ELEVATED its category both for location and perfect touches. If you are in Lisbon, you absolutely should not miss a stay at this gem. Perfeito!

If there were six or seven stars I would give them to this place, which must be the most beautiful apartment in Lisbon.  The view is mind boggling and the apartment is cozy, charming, meticulously designed and super romantic.   (And the hosts were very kind, friendly and welcoming.).  This was a wonderful trip and I am already missing The Flat With The View.
great great great~ view from the indoors.
Awesome location! feels like its the top of the whole city up there!

You will not find a more spectacular view in Lisbon from any spot in the flat or terrace. You will not mind the climb to the top floor, nor even the quirky architecture that has you duck your head in the bathroom because the space is just so unforgettable and beautiful. Our host Joanna was available anytime to return texts and to offer advice.  We are already thinking of returning for the last days of our vacation.

If you are going to Lisboa, this is it, best apt, host and view!
Loved every day and will be back:-)

The view is from the flat is fantastic and made the comfortable space seem even larger.  The view was worth the walk up three flights of winding stairs -- 54 stairs in all.  Our host carried our heavy suitcases!  The flat is tastefully  arranged and decorated.  Having the bath tub/shower in the bedroom was a clever use of space.  We were greeted warmly and given many good tips on restaurants and interesting things to do that were not in the guidebooks  -- such as a nice simple restaurant that also introduced patrons to Fado music.

The flat with a view is in an amazing location with one of the best views in the city! It’s located at the top of a steep hill however is walkable or alternatively you can catch an Uber which is usually no more than €4 from most places in the city! We were met by Joana who was extremely friendly and helpful and gave us great tips in terms of places to visit, the LX factory, areas around the April the 25th bridge and Belém are a must! The flat itself has everything that you will need and is very comfortable and homely! Would definitely recommend to anyone!

What a stunning apartment! There can't be a better view in Lisbon. Bruno is an extremely thoughtful host - his communication and directions before arrival were excellent and his flat had all we needed for our stay in Lisbon. Above all, this place felt like home - with lots of personal touches like books, games and even a guitar.
What can I say, you can’t ask for much better in an Airbnb stay. Joana and Bruno did everything to make sure our trip was enjoyable, and the place really was charming. We’d stay there anytime again.
Great flat in a great location
The flat has amazing view and good location. Joana and Bruno are very friendly and communicable. We were given all the help we need during our stay. Highly recommended.

숙소의 뷰는 매우 뛰어나며, 명소와 비교해도 뒤지지 않을 정도입니다!
연락을 취했던 Joana 도 매우 친절하고 이것저것 많은 정보를 제공해주었습니다~
다만 청결도가 떨어지는 것이 아쉬운 점입니다. 하지만 단언컨대 최고의 뷰입니다.

This may be the best AirBnB I've stayed in in Lisbon. The listing doesn't advertise the view enough, it is truly breathtaking from indoors, AND there's a balcony to view it from too.
Lots of lovely hospitality touches also made the stay personable and enjoyable on a human level - would always recommend

Great place! It has an amazing view and the apt is quite unique in the design and layout, makes it interesting. The shower is oddly in the room. The place has all basic things needed. Perfect for a romantic getaway.

Really cozy spot with an amazing view to wake up or to unwind in the evening.  Can imagine it’s nicer in spring or summer.  Easy to get to from Miradouro.  It wasn’t an issue for me but be aware it’s a walk up 3 flights.  Communication was fast & the bottle of wine was a nice touch!

Ce logement est l'endroit idéal pour se ressourcer. Il offre une vue splendide sur le cœur de Lisbonne, au calme et permet de visiter rapidement les quartiers de la capitale. Bruno est très accueillant et disponible pour donner de bons conseils. Ce fut un plaisir de le rencontrer.

The flat with a view is really a flat with a spectacular view! Be it night or day you just want to sit in the balcony and pass your time there. My second fav in the house was the bedroom, there was something very cosy to it - specially the winter evenings! Joana who received us, was extremely sweet and helpful. We had a nice 3 nights there ! The steps to get on top of the house was a bit challenging with a 9 month old baby and his stroller but it was an experience by itself.

The view is excellent as seen in the pictures.
However, the house was not neat enough. It could be better if the host maintains things properly like small fallingoff of paints here and there, old sofa and its cover, and blanket. Additionally the house needs to be cleaned up thoroughly.
It is a bit difficult to shower. The shower was separate from the toilet. You need to be careful not to splash water in the bedroom and cannot stand during shower if you are tall enough.
There is no elevator. Walking up to 4th floor with heavy luggage in the narrow stairs is not an easy job. Get prepared. The view is not for free.
For the price... hmmm.. Decision is on you.
Great place. Amazing location and great views.

Staying here has been a major highlight of our holiday. The hills certainly helped our fitness but thankfully the 28 tram made life easier. The Miradoura gives a great view over the city. Oh, did I mention the Fado bar? It's only open weekends but for a real experience don't miss it. The flat has everything you need and while we never met Bruno this time, Joana went out of her way to help us. Highly recommended.
Amazing Flat with an awesome view. Joana is so nicee!
Our second stay in this amazing apartment, still crazy about the view and the fantastic hospitality from the host.
Great place and amazing view!
Amazing place, definitely one of the best views in Lisbon !

The place was very pretty and quaint and does have a great view. However, please be aware that there are three flights of narrow steps to climb, so I don't suggest this place if you have heavy luggage or if you are very tall, as there are low slanted ceilings in the bathroom and shower area.

Appartement admirablement situé avec un point de vue unique. Très bien équipé, au calme, il nous a permis de profiter pleinement de Lisbonne, à pied la plupart du temps ou dans un des tramways pour gérer quelques montées. Bruno est un hôte chaleureux, disponible et qui s’exprime dans un français limpide. Séjour parfait !

Ein wunderschönes Apartment (also eins dieser Airbnb Juwele), das nicht nur durch seine zentrale Lage und den tollen Blick auf die Stadt besticht.
Joana ist immer da, um einen mit fantastischen Reisetipps die Stadt noch schneller erschließbar zu machen.
Es war ganz schön, Eure Gäste sein zu dürfen.
Bernhard

One of the most magical stays I’ve had on Airbnb, and I’ve stayed at plenty of nice listings! The views are to die for, and everything is well thought through. Easy and cheap Uber to get anywhere. Would stay here again in Lisbon in a heartbeat!

Simply spectacular! We had such an amazing time at this one of a kind Airbnb. From the moment we arrived, (and even the communication leading up to the stay), Joann and Bruno were incredible. The location is perfect and the flat is unique, stylish, clean, comfortable and has several of the most pitch perfect views I’ve ever seen. Upon check-in, Joann was immensely informative and engaging and once settled we enjoyed the bottle of wine she and Bruno gifted us on the terrace, paired with the sunset. Magical! The flat is also centrally located so when we finally set out to explore, we were easily able to take in many of the fantastic elements and vibrancy Lisbon has to offer. We will definitely be back!
Absolutely stunning view and fantastic place. A true gem! Host made sure my trip was a success. Grateful to have had the chance to stay here.
Bruno's was an amazing place to end our honeymoon, and he and his friend Joana could not have been better, more accommodating hosts and ambassadors for their gem of a city.

Bruno's apartment is a truly special place. Not to be missed on a trip to Lisbon. The view alone is worth it, but the apartment is incredibly comfortable, clean and stylish. It almost makes you not want to leave the apartment.

Die Wohnung ist fantastisch gelegen, mit herrlicher Aussicht in einem sehr ruhigen Quartier. Die Einrichtung ist geschmackvoll und es hat alles, was man braucht. Man kann sich auf die Fotos in der Beschreibung verlassen!
Absolutely fantastic! Best views in Lisbon.

Great place with an extraordinary view! Joana welcomed us warmly and checked up on us during our stay. She provided recommendations on what to do in Lisbon. The place was cozy. The walk up was a little tight, but you get used to it. Unfortunately the washer was broken during our stay. It was broken from the previous guest. Joana offered us the option of going to the laundry place down the street and she would pay for it. We decided not to since we did not want to spend time in the laundry facility while on vacation.

Le top de cet appartement est sans aucun doute, la magnifique vue. Il est calme, très propre et bien agencé. Si vous aimez marcher, (emplacement sur une des nombreuses colines de la ville + 3 étages à pieds) c’est idéal !

We would prefer to keep this place a secret! As much as Lisbon has to offer, we were always tempted to return to the terrace to soak up the stunning view and live like locals. Great space and location. A highlight of our trip.

Gorgeous views of the city and beautifully decorated apartment.  It is a third floor walk up, not a problem for us, but maybe for some.  Close to cafes and restaurants, and a scenic overlook of Lisbon.  Hosts were very accommodating and willing to provide suggestions for food and outings.  Would definitely come back!

Bruno and Joana were very responsive to all our questions and needs. Joana always seemed to be at the right place at the right time when we needed assistance. She did a very wonderful job of keeping in touch with us during our entire stay.
Having breakfast on our deck and looking out on the entire city as our view was an invigorating way to start our day. The apartment was spacious for the two of us and allowed us to get some exercise going up and down the stairs!

If you are looking to stay in Lisbon, this is the place! Fantastic views, restaurants within walking distance, comfortable apartment with a great outdoor area. This apartment was so cozy that we didn't really want to leave. Great place to stay!
Simply the best place to stay in Lisbon. It looks good in pictures but it is the utterly spectacular in reality. You actually won't want to leave, ever.
A great room with a superb view over the whole city! Hard to find anything better
Incredible view of the city. Bruno and Joana were both very responsive and great hosts. Apt was clean and comfy. I would  definitely stay here again the next time I’m in Lisbon.
Great Air bnb with an excellent view. We extended our stay and I would not hesitate to book again.

Absolutely amazing views.A wonderful flat with everything you could ask for. Clean, tidy and well laid out.
We thoroughly recommend this lovely flat, the host is brilliant, meets you in person and gives you great local tips. We will be visiting again.

The appartment is as you see on the pictures.
Very clean and a view to die for.
Joana was very nice and helpfull. She has a cafe very near if you should get any problem. We did not have any.
We will recomend this appartment very much and hope to return some Day.

This is one of my favorite AirBnb's that I have stayed in. The view of Lisbon is unbelievable. We saw an amazing sunset AND sunrise from Bruno's flat. The skylight in the shower is gorgeous. I wish we had been in Lisbon longer to enjoy the place even more. Stay here. You won't regret it.
A very clean and stylish flat with a fantastic view of Lisbon!

Les photos tiennent leurs promesses, entre ciel et terre on se laisse bercer devant cette vue à couper le souffle. Pas besoin d’aller faire la queue pour un roof top vous serez au plus bel endroit pour observer la ville. Ça souffle! Alors prenez un petit haut pour en profiter encore plus. Pour les transports, uber reste l’idéal prise en charge max dans les 2 min et pas de minimum de 5€ comme en France, très pratique!

This flat is beautiful and cozy with and amazing view and balcony. The AC works well and we enjoyed use oF the guitar. You are able to walk to many areas but it can be tiring walking back being so high up. Uber is easily accessed which is helpful. We enjoyed our stay and got what we were looking for!

Bruno’s place was incredible - it really is “the flat with the view”.  It is such a unique space and in a cool neighborhood.  Easy access to shops, restaurants and custard tarts galore!  Ask a good location for walking down the hill to the old town and the city.  Big thanks to Joana for meeting us - she has a great cafe with delicious espresso!

BEAUTIFUL!!!! Don't look any further for another place to stay. You must stay at Bruno's apartment!!!! The views from his patio are absolutely stunning. The sunsets were unreal. We never wanted to leave! Joana was an amazing host and was extremely friendly. We highly recommend staying here!

It’s just outside the most touristy areas, but still does have plenty of tourists coming to see the miradoro just atop the hill. Everything in the apartment itself is there you need and the bathroom and kitchen are immaculately clean.
Probably the best AirBnB I’ve stayed in solely for the view/patio. Truly a great place to wake up.

Bruno and Joana were fantastic hosts! We booked very last minute (2 hours before arrival and they accommodated us perfectly). The place was in a fantastic location and had such great style. We’re actually returning in 1 week on our way back through.

Bruno and his assistant were communicative, accommodating, and understanding throughout my terrible travel to Lisbon. Ultimately, I wasn't able to make the stay; so I can't comment on the physical place and location. Best wishes.

This is an amazing space with an amazing uplifting view! We loved our stay at Bruno's flat, a great location and comfortable space which served us well as a base to explore this wonderful city from. Joana who met us is very friendly and helpful and gave us great tips for our stay. Throughout the communication was fantastic.

The Flat With a view was what it said on the tin, a flat with a VIEW! It was a beautiful, perfect for sitting out on the balcony just taking everything in. The Flat was lovely and clean, it had everything we needed. Joana was lovely and very helpful with tips about the city. Will definitely recommend this friends and family and would definatley recommend to anyone that wants a place just outside the city centre with incredible views!
Samara and Tom

Bruno’s flat and Joana’s hosting was one of our best Airbnb experiences to date.  The flat is unbelievably gorgeous.  I have a whole new appreciation of what it means to have a view.  The view- seen from nearly every angle of the flat is remarkable.  The decor is tasteful and representative of Lisbon’s charm.  We could have stayed for much longer- we already missing it!  Joana presented a wonderful introduction of not only the flat, but the city as well.  She immediately picked up on our interests and tastes and provide stellar recommendations for the length of our stay.  She is so nice and fun and makes you feel welcome upon arrival.  Her cafe is also an excellent place to catch a futbol game or sip a cafe or beer on the way to or from the flat.  I would definitely stay again and highly recommend this experience!  Thank you!!!
Stunning view from charming and stylish home!
The flat is awesome, awesome location near Alfama and other burroughs, superb view over Lisbon with a unique terrace, and the hosts are friendly and responsive. Highly recommended!
Tres bien situé, vue superbe, nid adorable
Un accueil unique de Johanna. Un emplacement en hauteur pour une vue exceptionnelle.

I would highly recommend staying at this apartment. The views were beautiful and the place cute and relaxing after a long day out. It’s not super close to the center but Uber’s are really cheap in Lisbon. Enjoy!

Wonderfull place
!

Absolutely incredible view. The apartment is super nice and comfortable. I'll gladly move in if he needs a permanent tenant. :) Bruno's friend met us to check in and gave us so much helpful information including some great restaurant recommendations (Haweli's takeout down the block!).  Perfect stay.

L'appartement de Bruno est très agréable, et la vue est exceptionnelle. On a l'impression d'être suspendu au-dessus de la ville. La contrepartie c'est qu'il faut grimper pour y arriver, mais çà fait faire de l'exercice, et puis quand on est vraiment fatigué il y a Uber, ils sont très réactifs et vraiment pas chers (environ 2,50 euros pour monter du centre-ville).
Deux soirs, nous avons choisi de dîner "chez nous" pour profiter de ce petit nid douillet, des couleurs au moment du coucher de soleil, et de la ville illuminée.
Nous avons été accueillis par Joana qui est très sympa et très gaie, et qui est toujours dispo si on a une question sur l'appartement ou sur Lisbonne.
Nous avons beaucoup aimé Lisbonne et ses habitants. Un conseil : pour débuter votre séjour si vous ne connaissez pas la ville, réservez une visite à pieds chez "Ame et secrets", çà dure 4 h et c'est passionnant ; visite en petit comité et en français en dehors des circuits habituels, et qui plus est à un prix tout à fait raisonnable. Ils ont un site sur internet.
Fin utsikt. God hjelp til å finne fram til det vi ville oppleve. Kort vei til butikk og spisesteder. Litt hard madrass. Stille inne i leilighet når vindu var igjen.
Ein wunderschönes Wochenende in Lisboa! Apartment ist gut gelegen, die Aussicht atemberaubend! Tolle Gastfreundschaft und Tipps für Restaurants... Mit Uber gut erreichbar..

C’est un produit tout de même assez exceptionnel ... avec un accueil , une disponibilité et une attention de Joana pdt tout notre séjour ...
petit déjeuner sur la terrasse avec une vue incroyable et après une journée à visiter et à flâner dans Lisbonne on se plaisait à rentrer pour souffler un peu et pour mieux ressortir pour les soirées .
Cozy, warmly decorated flat  with a priceless view! Joana was very helpful and gave us tips on where to eat. Incredible spot to enjoy the sights and sounds of Lisbon.

Wahnsinns Ausblick über Lissabon! Tolle geschmackvolle Einrichtung mit allem was man brauch! Gerne jederzeit wieder in dieser außergewöhnlichen Unterkunft! Gastgeber immer zu erreichen und super hilfsbereit! Danke für alles!
Beliggenheden var fantastisk. Guddommelig udsigt i et stille kvarter væk fra alle turisterne down town. Gode restauranter i nærheden.

Amazing views!
Joana was super nice and very quick to reply when I had questions. Definitely recommend this place for anyone who wants to enjoy gorgeous views and get away from the noise of the city while still being in the city. Just keep in mind that there is no elevator so you will have to do some stair climbing, but its totally worth it!

Bruno's flat with a view was incredible! The view is really breathtaking and this place is truly a gem. The apartment was sparkling clean, and Joana was a great help and so sweet! Would definitely recommend this place to anyone going to Lisbon.

Bruno has an amazing apartment with maybe the best view in the entire city ! Very spacious apartment, beautiful bedroom and kitchen area. Of course the balcony is fantastic. The area is also very nice with many places to eat. The apartment even comes with complementary wine and delicious fruits ! Bruno and Joana made themselves available for any questions and very helpful overall.
Absolutely wonderful place on what felt like on top of the world. Perfect for a romantic get away.

L'accueil de Joana était vraiment chaleureux (en français qui plus est) et l'appartement a largement répondu à nos attentes! Le quartier est également bien sympa à l'écart des touristes. Nous espérons y revenir pour profiter de la belle terrasse si la météo est avec nous cette fois ci!

Nous avons été très bien accueillis par Joana qui tient un café à deux pas de l'appartement. Elle nous a fourni de très bonnes adresses au cours du séjour et a été très joignable via WhatsApp !
La vue de l'appartement est incroyable.
Obrigado Joana !
Great apartment in a central location with views to die for. Joana was very helpful giving us useful tips for our stay and was very responsive with any queries and allowed us to check in promptly.

The Flat with a View is lovely! The view is spectacular and the flat is also located near one of Lisbon’s recommended view points for additional great views. The neighborhood is quiet and peaceful - only about a 15 minute walk to the city center. Because it has a view - there’s definitely some hills to conquer when you’re returning home, which is great because it will burn off all the calories from the famous Pasteis! Joana met us upon check in and she was simply delightful - she gave us a list of things to do and said we could reach out if we ever needed anything. She truly wanted us to have a great time, which was so so thoughtful. The flat has everything you need, including a lovely patio to enjoy some wine or coffee. Really enjoyed our stay!
Great place, fantastic view and always there in any need. Loved to be there!

The flat is a hidden treasure in Lisbon. It's located in one of the highest viewpoints of the city so the view is amazing. The flat is very cozy - we felt at home.
Bruno is a great host: Rapid responses, very helpful.
L’emplacement est grandiose avec cette vue aérienne , ceux qui ont le vertige s’abstenir . Ne pas craindre les pentes à gravir mais il’y à plein de tucks tucks pour vous y amener .superbe adresse
Fantastic hosting and flat with great view. Nice to visit our host’s friend’s café and also the nearby sushi place.

Hello Bruno&Joana,
Many thanks for the hospitality, for being responsive, for the suggestions and, last but not least, for the best flat we ever stayed in! The view of the flat is extraordinary and it added a huge amount of emotions and perspectives and feelings to the entire Lisbon experience!
All the best!
Ottimo appartamento con vista stupenda su Lisbona... gentile è molto professionale la signora dell accoglienza

Wir hatten schöne 5 Tage bei strahlendem Sonnenschein und frühlingshaften Temperaturen im wunderschönen Lissabon. Bruno´s kleine Wohnung hat alle unsere Erwartungen erfüllt: gemütlich, sehr hell, mit allem ausgestattet, was man braucht, insbesondere mit einem Bett mit guter Matratze. Graca ist ein hübsches Viertel mit alltäglichem Leben. Unsere Lieblingsviertel Alfama, Moureira und auch Baixa - alles ist fußläufig erreichbar. Das Beste ist aber der weite Blick über die Stadt von der Dachterrasse aus und auch durch die großen Fenster des Wohnzimmers. Das ganz spezielle Licht zu jeder Tageszeit. Der hübsche kleine Miradouro-Platz direkt nebenan. Wir würden jederzeit wiederkommen!

El apartamento de Bruno tiene un gran encanto y está provisto de todo lo necesario.
Hemos disfrutado mucho los días allí
Joana est tres sympathique et donne de bon conseils, l appartement offre une belle vue

Bruno has two flats in this block and we had two nights in both - stunning !!

Wir sind sehr begeistert von Brunos Wohnung, von der Lage bis zur Ausstattung. Wir hatten unvergessliche Tage in Lissabon und können die Wohnung sehr empfehlen. Unsere 5. Wohnung über airbnb und die Allerschönste, wir kommen garantiert wieder.

Posto perfetto, nulla da aggiungere. Non rimanete una sera soltanto. È il posto ideale per visitare Lisbona e dintorni ma tenete un po’ di tempo per godervi lo splendido appartamento! Da rifare di sicuro
emplacement génial!!! et tout ce qu'il faut pour l'appartement. Accueil et disponibilité impeccables.
Hosts are great and the location is perfect!  Recommend 10/10.

The view from the apartment is fantastic and it is very nice to be able to sit on the balcony and watch the sun go down. Maybe we are a little weird since I read many of the reviews and they are all super-positive, but this were some of our observations for you to consider:
-The bathroom windows are clear glass with no blinds. Given that the apartment is overlooked at the back it was a bit disconcerting seeing someone in full view. There is also a beam across half of bathroom which given that I am tall (198cm) meant I had to be extra careful with night-time visits
- The shower is in the bedroom. The access is awkward again due to the sloping roof. Given my height, I had to stand under the skylight to be able to stand up straight. There is also a missing blind in the bedroom with a clear view in from the house overlooking the bed
- Given the apartment is on the top of a hill, its a big climb (150 steps+) before the three flights up to the apartment. It also generally took us more like 25 mins to walk into the main town area, or about 15 mins down the holl to the metro. It's good at keeping you fit, but it meant that it wasn't easy for us to pop back to the apartment after exploring to change and freshen up for the evening leading to long days.
I know that not many people may want to work while at the apartment, but if you do, bear in mind that the apartment doesn't have ac. It's on the top floor and it got quite hot during the day as we were having an unseasonable hot spell (we worked from the apartment in the week daytime). In addition, the desk chairs are garden chairs and not comfortable for any period of time. The upload speed of the WiFi meant Skype calls could be problematic (<1 mbps). During the day it was also quite noisy as they are building an apartment a few houses up which meant we could hear constant drilling which kind of got on our nerves.
In spite of these, we did have a wonderful time and I would highly recommend Lisbon as a destination.

Très bel emplacement avec une vue splendide sur Lisbonne. Logement très fonctionnel et agréable. Accueil très sympathique de Joana dont les conseils permettent de "sortir des sentiers battus" [diner en bord du Tage avec vue sur Lisbonne, Sintra à ne pas rater et Fado dans un endroit authentique]

Vores varmeste anbefalinger af denne skønne lejlighed - billederne lyver ikke! Desværre blæste det lidt for meget til rigtig at nyde balkonen med den svimlende udsigt -men så tog vi bare mere tøj på!

Thanks so much for taking such great care of us! Everything at Bruno's place was amazing- I only wish we had more time! Joana gave us all the scoop, which was greatly appreciated. Would love to come back soon!

Bruno nous a déduit la première nuit annulée au dernier moment, un geste bien trop rare pour ne pas être souligné !
Pour conclure, 5 étoiles ne suffiraient pas et nous partagerons volontiers cette adresse comme un précieux cadeau.

strongly recommend!

The apartment has everything you need and more - what an amazing place to wake up in! I can't recommend it highly enough.
Super Unterkunft, sauber und gepflegt. die Lage ist auf dem Hügel perfekt. sehr schönes Appartement. gerne wieder
The flat with the view : clean, convenient, nice. and the view....!

We loved our stay at Bruno's flat! The view was even better than the photos and higher than the nearby popular park viewpoint. The interior of the flat was very clean, bed was comfortable and modern updates were nice. Bruno gave us excellent recommendations in the Graca neighborhood at check-in and was easily accessible throughout the trip. The stairs up to the 3rd floor were not a problem for us, but definitely take them into consideration if that is an issue for you. The area is very easily walkable to Alfama and a short walk to taxi stands and the trams. If you are looking for a clean flat in quiet neighborhood, but accessible to the rest of Lisbon, do not hesitate and book Bruno's flat.

It's beautiful. And the host are so lovely and charming. They're very professional in making sure everything will ensure a smooth transition. My favorite part aside from the view is how Bruno/Joana make sure to give you a great intro to start your stay in Portugal ensuring that you will love their city and share in their heart and warmth for it. ✨ Lisbon is charming and so are they. :)

I'll write the review in English solely because I know more people will understand: Brunos place is perfect. Walking up and down the hill won't make you regret staying here. I was there for 2 nights and couldn't recommend it more! The view itself is breathtaking and even tough I did not get to meet Bruno in person, he was great via messages and Joana, his friend that checked us in and out, is one of the nicest human beings I've ever met.

Bruno was great - very responsive over email, and proactively put us in touch with his friend to help get us situated while he was previously occupied. The place itself is gorgeous, in a lovely neighborhood that's slightly removed yet still very walkable into the busier areas.

Sipping coffee in the morning while the sun rose over Lisbon was unforgettable - next time I'll be back for longer!

This flat is steps from the best view i found while in Lisbon. I was accidentally put into the wrong apartment when i got there, so i got to experience two of Bruno's offerings, and they are both good options.

This flat is on the 4th floor and has an amazing view from the living room. And an amazing deck overlooking lisbon. The problem is, that lisbon is a city currently under construction, so being up that high, there was nothing to block the sound of the construction that started at 8am each morning. And as other visitors have pointed out, this is at the top of a very large hill, so if you are not a fan of walking, might not be the place for you. I enjoyed the hike and being so close to the view point. Also the shower is strangely located in the bedroom. Wasn't a big deal, but i was staying there alone. Could see it being an issue for sharing.

The flat i was first incorrectly checked into is on the second floor. It is a little less expensive, because it does not provide the same view as the 4th floor, but it seemed a little quieter, and it had a more normal bathroom. Either are great options.

JOANA was the best!!!! I ended up on relying on her for all my restaurant suggestions.. she knows her city and knows her food. Don't bother experimenting... let Joana lead the way

No words to explain the amazing view from this appartment! We had two magnificent days in Lisboa with the coolest Airbnb ever-a warm welcome with precious revcommendations.
The appartement has everything you need (wine,coffee, cookies, maps,a shower in the bedroom, dishwasher etc..)
We explored the city and enjoyed the tram ride back home both evenings with 28E.
Thanks for everything, hope to meet you next time, Bruno!

Au top !
Nous avons eu un accueil très sympa par Bruno, qui nous a donné de nombreux et bons conseils sur les choses à faire à Lisbonne, et qui a été très flexible pour les horaires d'arrivée/départ. L'appartement est très agréable, parfaitement organisé et la vue est magnifique, encore mieux qu'en photo! Une telle vue se mérite, et après avoir montée la colline rien de tel que de se prélasser sur la terrasse, sans aucun doute la meilleure partie! Rien n'a manqué pendant notre séjour.
Encore merci !
Absolutely amazing!! Everything about Bruno's place is just perfect. From the unique space, home-y decor, cleanliness, natural light, and unsurmountable views! I highly recommend this place!!

Appartement confortable, calme, propre, bien équipé avec une vue à couper le souffle sur Lisbonne.
Quel bonheur de pouvoir profiter d'un tel panorama en buvant un verre de douro sur la terrasse après une journée bien remplie ! Nous avons été véritablement charmé par Lisbonne, son patrimoine culturel, sa gastronomie, la gentillesse de ses habitants. Nous reviendrons sans aucun doute. Bruno et Rita merci !

Superbe expérience Airbnb , jai été bien accueillie par Bruno Et l'appartement est vraiment génial. Malgré la pluie nous avons passé de très bons moments. Il est difficile de repartir ! Merci Bruno, merci Lisbonne !
A bientôt pour une prochaine fois je l'espère

We spent a fantastic time at Bruno's flat. Bruno has been the best host we could imagine. He welcomed us and show us the place. We had some very interesting talks with him. He's such a nice person. He will help you to discover lisboa the best way and with pleasure.
The apartment has an amazing view you're on the top of Lisbon. It is very quiet and the neighborhood is one the best of Lisbon. You have all the comfort you need.
Fantastic Airbnb experience.
Thank you Bruno

Just returned from a 7 night stay at this truly one-of-a-kind AirBnB experience, and I wish I could have stayed for 7 more. This is an airy, light-filled utterly peaceful apartment that's nestled high above the entire city. Besides the now-legendary view, the flat is ingeniously designed in a modern, comfortable style that makes the most of the space, so it "lives" much larger than it actually is. Bruno and his lovely wife were a delight to deal with, both before and during my visit. There's a reason why this place is booked solid - Lisbon is a thoroughly wonderful place to visit, and the Flat with the View is in every way its match.

It was really an amazing flat! I cannot express how much I loved it! The flat was much more beautiful than the photo. Bruno studied in architecture and designed the flat by himself. You will find how talent he is! You can see the 360 view of the whole city. By the way, you can not miss the sunset in the flat. Really magnificent! Perfect experience for me!

What a great experience!
Firstly, the apartment is amazing! With such an incredible view it was hard to leave sometimes but Lisbon has so much to offer we dragged ourselves away.
Everything was perfect from start to finish, with Bruno catering for our requests at the beginning and end of our stay.
Obrigado Bruno!
PS: wear comfortable shoes if you plan to see Lisbon's sights!
a fantastic example for what makes AirBnb so great! Hoping to stay longer next time.
Great appartment with a beautiful view and a perfect host!

première expérience sur Airbnb et ce fut exceptionnel dans l appartement de Bruno, mieux que les photos sur le site, en plus Bruno est tres attentionné
disponible nous communiquant de bonnes adresses ,nous aidant pour l arrivée comme au départ .
Une bonne bouteille pour admirer cette superbe vue et d autres bonnes choses
je recommande vivement cette belle adresse .
Merci Bruno

This was the second time in Bruno’s apartment and it was unbelievable as the first time. Everything was so perfect: the location, the details in the apartment, the view, the balcony and foremost the warm, open and welcoming way how Bruno and Joanna host their guest. You only can leave this apartment when you know that you will come back ; )

Great view-priceless both at night and daytime, thoughtful decorations and supplements, the apartment itself has it all.
Great host as well, thanks for the through directions and book collection, too bad we only stayed here for our last days in Lisbon.
Highly recommended and will definitely come back if we visit Lisbon again
Great, incredible apartment near the best view in Lisbon. Bruno was helpful, easy to communicate with, and prompt. I almost don't want to tell anyone else about this place!

Die Unterkunft hat unsere Erwartungen voll erfüllt! Der Blick von der Terrasse ist wirklich einmalig. Das Apartment selber ist sehr gut ausgestattet mit allem, was man so braucht.

Bruno war telefonisch problemlos zu erreichen und hat uns persönlich empfangen und uns einige nützliche Ratschläge für unseren Lissabon-Aufenthalt gegeben.

Lissabon ist wirklich eine Reise wert, aber packt gute Schuhe ein, da das Apartment auf einem der höchsten Punkte der Stadt liegt und es ständig bergauf und bergab geht :-)!

The Flat with the view is a wonderful place, we came the second time and it was perfect, again! And Bruno is such a nice person, it was a pleasure to meet you again. Thanks for all! See you next time!

Bruno was an amazing host- he was extremely helpful, gabe us recommendations for an amazing local restaurant. The apartment itself has a FANTASTIC view and as everyone said, the pictures just don't give it justice.

Bruno is a fantastic host and made us feel really at home here. He talked to us about where in Lisbon he'd recommend to visit, and marked everything down on a helpful map so we could navigate our way around. The flat itself is simply amazing- the photos really do not do the view justice! Eating dinner on the balcony overlooking Lisbon was simply breathtaking. It really is worth it for the view alone!

Everything went smooth from the arrival till the departure. Bruno is such a great guy, very welcoming and with a lot of advice and tips about the amazing city of Lisbon. The apartment is so cosy, neat, clean, with the best view I could have. The morning coffee and the breakfast is so much better with that amazing view. I TOTALLY recommend Bruno and his apartament and I can't thank him enough for his tips and tricks and also for the airport drop. So book with confidence and enjoy Lisbon and its surroundings, and I'm pretty sure you'll fall in love as I have. Cheers!

The stay at Bruno's was fantastic. The apartment is cosy, convenient and tastefully arranged, and the host is super nice and helpful. Watching the sunset on the breathtaking view of Lisbon to the sound of Smooth FM is an unforgettable experience!

Bruno is one of the those special hosts who you can tell really really enjoys sharing his home and city with travelers. He met us promptly and shared with us many great Lisbon spots for both tourists and locals. The apartment itself is one of the most remarkable places we have ever stayed through airbnb as it literally is the hightest point in the city of Lisbon and the view will bring tears of joy to your eyes.

Bruno's flat is excellent. It's clean, calm, cozy, airy, and the terrace really can't be beat. It has everything you need and the location suited us perfectly. Bruno gave us all sorts of great recommendations for what to do and see in Lisbon and beyond, and went above and beyond to make sure our stay was a great one. This was a top Airbnb experience for sure (and I've stayed in many...). Thanks, Bruno!

Nous avons passé un merveilleux séjour dans cet appartement très accueillant, lumineux, aménagé avec goût et très fonctionnel, et admirablement situé à la fois au calme et très proche de tous les sites à voir de Lisbonne. La vue fabuleuse sur tout Lisbonne nous donnait l'impression d'être privilégiés: après avoir profité de l'animation des différents sites, nous avions le plaisir de nous ressourcer au calme tout en continuant à profiter de Lisbonne. Le quartier est agréable avec des commerces à proximité et à deux pas du tram 28. Et Bruno est un hôte attentionné qui a le sens de l'accueil et sait partager son amour de la ville en donnant des pistes pertinentes et pratiques pour explorer Lisbonne (Merci Bruno). Notons par ailleurs la qualité et la propreté impeccable du linge.  Si nous retournons à Lisbonne, nous reviendrons sans hésiter dans l'appartement de Bruno.

Bruno has created a little piece of heaven in Lisbon. Every little detail has been thought out, everything a person could possibly need for a leisurely retreat can be found in his place. Books, music, art, entertainment galore. Even saving the day with a backup adapter when mine broke. Not that any of it is needed with that view! The place is simply stunning.
Bruno and Joana themselves are also the most hospitable and genuine people I met throughout my trip. They are great ambassadors for the city.
A true rare find.
Can't wait to visit again.
It was so great to stay in this flat. The view is just amazing - even better then on the given pictures! I can really recommend for everyone to go there.
This is an amazing place with an awesome view! The host was very helpful with what is there around. Definitely a good place to stay.

"The Flat with the View" could not be a more accurate description. You can see the entire city. We met many locals and they all told us to visit Miradouro da Senhora do Monte, and we happily told them that's where we're staying!
The apartment is bright and beautiful and clean. There's a constant breeze that keeps the place cool. I loved all of the windows, some of them are unique. It's really a perfect place.
We did not meet Bruno, but communicated a lot through email. He was very nice and easy to talk to. His wife Rita is super friendly, and gave us many suggestions for the city.
Word of advice: If you are driving, it seems as though most street parking is free and people park on the sidewalks. This was surprising for us as Americans and we were at first stressed out when parking at the Miradouro was not available. You can park really anywhere on the street that loops around.

We stayed in Bruno's flat for two nights and everything was perfect. The communication was clear and Joana gave us a quick overview of the city, the flat and the apartment. We really enjoyed staying in your apartment and would definitely come back! Thank you Bruno and Joana!

Bruno fue muy puntual y amable con nosotros a nuestra llegada. La verdad es que nos hizo sentir muy bien en la recepción, nos explicó muy bien la zona y nos hizo varias recomendaciones sobre Lisboa. Además en la casa dejó varios detalles para hacernos sentir cómodos. La casa está muy bien equipada, céntrica y en una zona donde se aparca bien y además es tranquila.
El apartamento coincide con la descripción, tiene una terraza con unas vistas impresionantes de Lisboa.
Nos ha gustado mucho la casa y la ubicación y también la amabilidad de Bruno

Bruno's apartment is fantastic! He sent us clear message about how to get to the house from the airport. And Bruno's friend Joana shows us the greatest viewpoint in lisbon when we arrive. The room is very clean and tidy with great view. Highly recommended!

Exactly as pictured but only better!  It was hard to leave the balcony especially at sunset time, but it was also very easy to find places for groceries, shopping, restaurants.  Great workout to get back up the hill each night!
Beautiful City. Awesome Flat. Can't wait to visit again

Lovely flat, perfect location, perfect welcome. What can I say? Breathtaking view with a beautiful terrace to enjoy sunset. House is clen, well equipped (kitchen too). Everything was perfect, thank you guys!:)
Wonderful. Would recommend to anyone anytime. The view was so good it made it hard to leave the appartment!

Bruno wasn't there but his friend met us, she was ace. Prompt, knowledgable about the area and very friendly. She showed us the flat and even did a brief guide to the city from the viewpoint next to the flat.

The flat is clean, perfectly sized for a couple staying away and has one of the best views I've ever seen.

If you want an amazing flat in a beautiful city, this is the place.

100% recommended :)
Bruno & his mom were incredible hosts and very helpful with the booking process and arrival.
The location is perfect and central to many beautiful sites in Lisbon. My boyfriend & I loved walking in the area to see all of the cool street art!
The flat is amazing and I will never forget watching the sunset on the terrace. The design is charming and everything was very clean.
I hope I can visit the flat again soon :)

Splendide appartement avec effectivement une vue à couper le souffle. Quartier tres animé de Graça à 200 mètres avec commerces et restaurants. Bruno est hyper accueillant et fait tout pour vous mettre à l'aise (explications sur ma villes, mise à disposition de guides et de plans, bouteilles de vin et corbeille de fruits à l'arrivée)! la meilleure expérience Airbnb que nous ayons eue!!
Splendid appartment with a breathtaking view as described. In the animated area of Graca plenty of shops and restaurants. Bruno is a very warm and welcoming host who explains to you what to do in town. He even let us a bottle of wine and a basket of fruit. The best experience we've had with Airbnb . We wish we could come back soon! Thanks for all Bruno.

We had a fantastic time at the flat! Bruno's wife Rita was able to welcome us, help find parking, and even help with our luggage! She was very helpful with suggestions in the city and recommendations for places to eat! The apartment was very welcoming with snacks, clean, organized, plenty of Lisbon tourist magazines and fantastic music playing! The balcony and view were breathtaking! Perfect stay, great location, fantastic hosts! We would gladly return and stay here again!

Bruno was a GREAT host!  He met us at the viewpoint next to the flat and gave us great information about Lisbon and then helped us into the flat where a bottle of wine was waiting to be enjoyed on the awesome balcony. The flat is just as pictured and more.  The neighborhood is very local with easy access to the Market and tram/train stations.  Just bring running/tennis shoes because there are a lot of hills.  I would definitely stay here again if I get back to Lisbon one day.
The flat was fantastic, views amazing and exactly as described. Bruno and his wife were incredibly helpful and would return without reservation!

This is our second time in the flat with The View in one year. We love the atmosfere in the tasteful apartment, the charming neighborhood with great, local restaurants, bars, food stores etc. .

We feel very welcome by the host, and feel free to ask about all information we need.

We had a perfect stay.. again!
We had a fantastic time at Bruno's flat! He was very helpful with restaurant ideas and things to do. Hope to return someday.

Wir wurden sehr herzlich von Bruno und Joana empfangen und auch gleich mit praktischen Tipps und Willkommensgeschenken versorgt! Das Appartement hat wirklich eine fantastische Aussicht, ist gemütlich eingerichtet, sehr gut ausgestattet und leicht mit der berühmten Strassenbahn 28, Taxis oder auch zu Fuß erreichbar.
Lissabon hat ein tolles Flair und wir werden sicher wieder kommen - hoffentlich ist Brunos Appartement dann wieder frei!

It was me and my partner's first night away on our own after having our 6 month old baby and I wanted a place where we could just relax, enjoy a meal with a great view and actually finally get some sleep!
Make no mistake, the view over the city is breathtaking and the flat couldn't be more quaint!
Rita and Bruno were super friendly hosts and it was an absolute pleasure to stay here.
Definitely recommended!

Back again! Thanks to Bruno for letting us stay in this very nice apartment with the amazing view. We was here for a week last Easter and liked it so much that we wanted to come back. The flat is clean and cosy with all you need for a pleasant stay. The location is perfect for getting around in Lisboa. The hills and stairs are just good for us after all the tasty foods and drinks that are served everywhere. But, it is also close to taxis and other transportation if that is needed. Our very, very best recommendation!

Bruno hat uns herzlich empfangen und die besten Tips gegeben. Die Wohnung lieget super, so dass man die Stadt unter Kontrolle hat:)
Einmalig die Aussicht und auch die Ausstattung ist komplett.
Gerne wieder !

The Flat with the View, das war die anziehende Botschaft in der Headline der Wohnung bei airbnb. Das Ergebnis war einzigartig. Der Blick über Lissabon von der Terrasse und direkt von dem Wohnzimmer war einfach fantastisch. Unser Gastgeber Bruno war super organisiert. Freundlich, Herzlichkeit und Liebe zu Details zeichneten die Gastfreundlichkeit aus. Eine Flasche Rotwein, ein Obstkorb, Kaffee-Pads und viele Kleinigkeiten mehr versüssten uns den Aufenthalt sehr. Wir haben uns hier außerordentlich wohl gefühlt und werden bei besserem Wetter sicherlich gerne wieder kommen und können die Wohnung vollster Überzeugung des Preis-Leistung-Verhältnisses weiter empfehlen.

This was my second visit to Lisbon. This trip was so much more enjoyable, and a great deal of that had to do with staying at this beautiful flat. The pictures in the listing are accurate, but nothing compares to walking in and seeing it. The best view in Lisbon.

Joana was very responsive when reserving and Bruno and Rita met us and showed us around the flat and gave us a general outline of the neighborhood and major sites to see. We took many recommendations and all were wonderful.

Location was perfect. This was at the tail end of our trip and we had a rental car. There was easy, free parking near the flat and it was just 15 minutes away from the airport.

Flat is well appointed, everything you need, including a washer. When we return to Lisbon we will definitely plan around when this flat is available.

3 jours supers avec ma fille de 15 ans. L'appartement de Bruno nous a enchanté : il est très bien conçu, parfaitement propre, rien ne manque. Le matin on est réveillé par le chant des oiseaux et le soleil qui inonde la chambre ( si on veut on peut fermer les volets!). L'après midi, direction  la terrasse jusqu'au couché de soleil qui offre un joli spectacle. Le quartier de Graça est très agréable et assez peu touristique.Le mirador où Bruno donne rendez vous est un endroit magique juste à coté de l'appartement.  Bruno accueille avec beaucoup de gentillesse et de professionnalisme et aide à monter les valises !  On se sent en parfaite sécurité dans le quartier et dans l'appartement qu'on a du mal à quitter...

Bruno nous a très aimablement accueilli. Une bouteille de vin de bienvenue assortie de quelques fruits nous attendaient, mais surtout notre hôte a toujours été ouvert et attentif à nos questions. Il nous a facilité la visite de la ville.

Bruno´s flat turned out to be a great choice: it has got a spectacular view (probably the best in Lisboa), enough space for two, is nicely furnished and clean!
We were welcomed and introduced to the flat and the neighborhood. There was a basket of fruits and a bottle of red wine as a gift for us - was a nice surprise!

Vue magnifique et imprenable sur Lisbonne depuis toutes les pièces de l'appartement. C'est génial!!!
Merci pour l'accueil agréable de Joana.

Un petit raté à l'arrivée (Joana chez le médecin, merci Rita...), au milieu (le champagne ne se vend qu'en centre-ville...) et au départ (vol de retour plus tôt que prévu...) mais tout cela arrive, même aux meilleurs, et n'a pas d'importance.

Et comme nous venions à Lisbonne pour faire exactement ce que nous voulions, sans consignes, sans horaires, ni conseils ou assistance, ni trop de blabla, comme des explorateurs (presque) sans téléphone... ça tombait très bien !!!

Nous avons peu utilisé (partis tôt, rentrés tard, sans cuisiner...) cet appartement très étudié mais pas toujours pratique (attention la tête..., couper le frigo la nuit...), dédié à la location courte malgré ses nombreux placards, très agréable et très bien placé.

Le marché aux Puces proche nous a fourni tout ce dont nous rêvions pour ramener de très beaux "souvenirs" (séries warholiennes de boîtes de sardines contenant San Antonio, patron de Lisbonne).

Noua avons massivement utilisé les taxis bien moins chers (10€ pour l'aéroport ou pour Belem à partir de Graça, 5€ pour remonter de Commercio...) et bien plus efficaces que les tuk-tuks à 50 balles... et passés d'excellents moments et de nombreux fou-rires avec leurs chauffeurs tous plus déjantés les uns que les autres.

Bref, un excellent séjour dans une excellente ambiance avec une météo comme on aime (vent puissant, pluie fraîche, soleil complice), du champagne au 38°41' en regardant les régates, des bouffes somptueuses dans ruelles sombres hors des convois de touristes, des pasteis dégustées dans le parc en regardant jouer les mômes à 123 soleil...

Parfait...

Corinne et Michel (MC-1%)

We had a lovely time at Brunios flat in Graça. Our flight arrived nearly 2 hours late, it was dark and windy when we arrived in the neighbourhood. Joana, our host in lieu of Bruno (he was out of the country) was simply amazing! She accommodated our delay with good humour and reassuring messages.
When we met Joana she was funny, informative and put us at ease. She had wine and nibbles ready for us and accompanied us to a bohemian, to-die-for, tapas bar. This made our evening and set us for to a wonderful break.
The flat has breathtaking views, it is clean, stylish and the bath in the bedroom is naughtily indulgent.
The lights of the city shinning below the flat 'hit' us with astonishing force when got up in the middle the night (due to too much Portuguese red wine!).
We definitely recommend. Luisa

Bruno's place was beautiful, top of one of the highest hills in the city with a gorgeous view night and day!  Walking distance from many small restaurants and Fado.  Super clean, amazing shower, couldnt ask for more, thanks Bruno!

The flat is everything as described on Airbnb. It has a spectacular view of the city, and if you are lucky (ie., weather permitting), you will have a complete Lisbon sunset experience. There was enough space for a couple. The neighbourhood (Graca) is safe and quiet. The flat is about a 5-10 walk to bakeries and grocery stores, which is convenient for breakfast or if you plan to do a little cooking yourself (fully equipped kitchen). It is situated on top of Miradouro da Senhora do Monte (view point), which meant walking up the hill everyday and can be a concern for those with some mobility issues (unless of course you decide to take a taxi or uber). The host's friend Joana, who was managing the flat at the time of our visit, was informative and available for questions. In addition, the host Bruno, whom unfortunately we didn't meet, has a good selection of guide books on Lisbon/Portuguese food, culture, history available for guests to read and use, a really nice touch for those who want to experience Lisbon in a more personal way. We had a great stay. Thank you so much!

Joana and Bruno are amazing hosts, really helpful, accommodating and fantastic tippers.

I have a newborn and the place was just right... we couldn't say enough about how great the experience was! Thank you for letting us feel like locals. Of course the apartment was fantastic, with astonishing view of Lisbon, will come back for sure.
Very good appartement as per description. Bruno And Joana were very hepful. Will come back soon with no doubts!

If you look at the pictures and you think the apartment is breathtaking and amazing: you really should come here. It was even more amazing than I expected.

It is not only the incomparable view on beautuful Lisbon. It is every other detail: the design of the apartment, the location (which is central but still with very local athmosphere), not to forget the very best: the hosts. Bruno and Joana had made me a so warm welcome as I was a friend. Joana took really time to show me around.

I could only leave the apartment because I knew one thing: I will come back soon : )

Notre séjour s'est passé parfaitement, nous avons été accueillis très gentiment par Joana, qui nous a expliqué le quartier et la vue depuis l'appartement, et il y avait une corbeille de fruits et une bouteille de vin qui nous attendaient à notre arrivée! Je recommanderai sans hésiter ce très agréable appartement à qui veut faire un séjour à Lisbonne.

Ecxellent ! L'accueil est attentionné, l'appartement est lumineux!
Nous avons passé un très bon moment ici.

Exceptional flat under the roof of a nice house close to a Miradouro. The interior is made with love to details, we had everything you need in a well-equiped appartement.

The weather was very windy during our stay, which led to quite a bit of noise in the flat, but this was no big deal.
Awesome flat with very nice housekeeper, the view was way better than pictures even

We had such a wonderful moment in Lisboa. Bruno's appartment, has one of the best view of Lisboa. Joana has welcome us and provided precious information (restaurants, best fado, transportation...).
Thank you so much for all !

Hope we will come back soon in Lisboa.

As a previous guest said, Bruno's flat was even better than expected. The space itself was very comfortable, well-equipped and stylish-- which together with the spectacular view, looking down on 2 of Lisbon's most famous lookout points--made it difficult to venture out of the flat. Venturing out, however, the Graça neighborhood was also very special, with attractive good and inexpensive cafés, restaurants, and shops where tourists were always a minority if present at all. This year is the time to go, before it all changes. Bruno was responsive and accommodating in pre-departure emails, and his friend Joana was exceptionally friendly and helpful during my stay. I hope that I have a chance to repeat the whole experience.
In one word : PERFECT

Our stay at Bruno's Flat with the view was absolutely wonderful. We were able to travel to all parts of Lisbon by foot, and very much enjoyed the breathing taking view from the top of Lisbon. Bruno was available and helpful when needed and very accommodating. I can't imagine finding any place better to stay in Lisbon!

We had a great time in Bruno´s flat. The view was even better than we thought. Peaceful area, easy to go around. Bruno was wonderful host and gave us useful tips where to go. Perfect first time with airbnb.

Bruno was fantastic. He was incredibly helpful and friendly. He told us about Lisbon, the neighborhood, the flat and left us full of suggestions for a wonderful time in the city. The flat listing is accurate and as breathtaking as the pictures suggest. The location is great--our favorite neighborhood (Alfama) was right next door.

One of the best AirBnb experience in terms of the house and the host. If anyone is planning a trip to Lisbon, the only place they should stay is this. Cozy,well maintained,amazing views and the list goes on.
Bruno (the host) is incredible and the most helpful person I have met.

Bruno was well prepared for our arrival and was very friendly and helpful. He gave us a lot of tips as to what to avoid doing and what we should definitely do in Lisbon. The flat was even better than in the pictures in our opinion. Also the location was just right, even though getting there requires some climbing so be sure to wear comfortable pair of shoes if you are planning on doing some walking!

El apartamento es exactamente como se describe, incluso mejor.
Joana (amiga de Bruno), fue quien nos recibió, muy simpática. Nos indicó algunas zonas interesantes de la ciudad para visitar y comer.
El apartamento dispone de guías de la ciudad muy útiles.
Conocimos a Bruno a la salida, un chico muy majo y simpático.
Sin duda, este apartamento es altamente recomendable. Volveré.

Bruno's friend Joana met us to welcome us to Lisbon and give us the keys. The flat was very comfortable, clean and hard to leave with such a beautiful view. The flat has everything you need, restaurant recommendations, maps and the kitchen looked great for cooking if you have the time.

Nous avons été très bien accueillis par Joana ( aide pour porter les bagages, bouteille de vin et petits encas ainsi que le panier avec des jouets pour les enfants ont mis toute la famille à l'aise dès l'arrivée ),l'appartement est calme mais n'est pas très grand mais bien agencé et fonctionnel, la vue est magnifique surtout la nuit. Une bonne expérience. Carine, Jonathan et Luna

The perfect Airbnb experience! A flat with a real wow factor and so much personality. A completely different travel experience from another boring hotel. Joana was a wonderful host, providing lots of useful information and ideas. We had a wonderful time. Thank you!

The great experience in Lisboa.
Very nice welcome from Joana, including a nice wine bottle, cookies, fruits... Immediately makes you feel at home.

THE VIEW is unique!!! The place is very quiet and very well located.

We can only recommend, and will certainly come back.
Thank you!!!

Die Wohnung von Bruno hat einfach den besten Ausblick der Stadt.
Joana und Bruno sind sehr zuverlässig. Joana hat uns ganz wunderbar empfangen und uns die Möglichkeiten, die Lissabon zu bieten hat ausführlich erklärt. Es hat uns sehr gut gefallen und wir werden beim nächsten Mal auf jeden Fall wieder kommen.
Vielen Dank für alles!
Stefan und Ellen

Es una suerte inmensa haber encontrado este lugar con las mejores vistas de Lisboa. Dos días no son suficientes y, por supuesto, volveremos!
