Vraiment super ! Appartement super! vue imprenable !! Top top !! Merci merci

super séjour l'appartement était impeccable, il y avait des petits cadeaux (du vin des gateaux des fruits) la vue imprenable
c'est douillet, et au calme
ideal pour venir se reposer et visiter la ville

Bruno was on holiday but his good friend Joana was a great replacement host.  The rental is actually right next to the best view in Lisbon from what I read so that was a pleasant surprise!  Granted the view itself was absolutely stunning! The listing was exactly what I expected.

This was our third stay at Flat With The View. If you are visiting Lisbon this is the place to be! Easy to get to from the airport, centrally located for seeing all the sites, comfortable in a relaxed and cozy way, and every question, concern or request will be handled promptly and thoroughly.
It's quiet at night which is great for travelors. It's only a minute from the Tram 28 or 10 minutes walk to Rossio train station or many buses so you can get anywhere you want to go. We walked to the Alfama, Baixo, Chiado, and Barrio Alto. There is an all night taxi stand nearby so getting back to the airport for a 6:00AM flight was easy.
Best of all for us, Joana met us each time and each time became more of a friend. She is knowledgeable, funny, helpful, has great stories to tell about her family and about Portugal, and was available on Whatsapp whenever we needed her.
We loved watching the sun set at night and settling in for a beautiful Lisbon visit.

Bruno's place is perfect- clean, plenty of room, and the view of the city from the balcony is spectacular. Check in was easy, Bruno was out of town but we met his friend Joanna who gave us a brief history of the city and recommended places to eat/see.

The place was everything we expected and better. When we arrived, Joana greeted us and gave us great advice and the run down on Lisbon. The view was absolutely stunning and I wish I could've spent more time on the balcony.

We arrived to the flat a little early, but Bruno's good friend Joana was there to welcome us :)
She was so cool and very helpful and informative about the city and the flat's features, including some fantastic books with heaps of travel tips that you won't find on lonely planet...
These were our last two night of our trip to Portugal and they were well spent in this unique setting!
The flat is very comfortable for couples, clean and welcoming with homey touches in every corner.
And on top of it all- THE VIEW. Wow. This has to be an almost one of a kind in Lisbon and words cannot really describe it- you have to see it for yourself ;)
One last thing- this three story building has no elevator, but if your'e up for it, it is well worth the climb!
All in all, a terrific an excellent bnb experience which I will highly recommend.

We loved Bruno's flat.  The views have to be the best in Lisbon.  The climb up and the stairs were a little tough, but the rewards are breathtaking views and firmer legs!  Joana was our hostess and was so kind to guide us to the location even helping with luggage.  She was available for anything we needed.  The wi-fi worked perfectly and the flat was clean and spacious for 2.  Thanks Bruno, it was great.

We had a wonderful stay at The Flat With The View.
The flat is idealy located in the Graça neighbourhood close from the center but not crowded with tourists.
The view over Lisbon is indeed incredible. The place is clean, cosy, and quiet. Perfect for a couple.
On top of that Bruno is a very nice and helpful host and he gave us plenty of useful tips and advice about Lisbon. I definitely recommend the place for anyone staying in Lisbon.

Bruno was very welcoming! He met us at the Miradouro and gave us advice on what to do in Lisbon and how to get around. The flat itself was incredible! The view is truly stunning, and the neighborhood is lovely. I could not recommend this apartment more.

My husband and I stayed here to celebrate our first anniversary and we had an incredible time! We loved the flat with the view--it was perfectly located to do everything we wanted to in Lisbon. Bruno was easy to deal with before our trip and provided tons of information about the flat and the surrounding neighborhood and all of the city! It was a great place, and we would absolutely recommend it and stay again!

Perfect! The place is amazing. You really feel like a local and it is hard to leave bruno's flat with such an epic view. Bruno was away, and his friend Joanne gave us the keys and gave some of the most amazing tips on what to do. Hands down the best air BnB I have stayed in. Thanks Bruno

Bruno was easily contactable and responded really quickly to all of my emails. Sadly he was out of town during our stay so we never got to meet him, but his friend Joana was extremely helpful and met us as planned, to check us in and explain a few things about the flat, and Lisbon itself. The flat itself is wonderful! The view is incredible (people line up about 50 metres away to get the same view from the Miradouro da Senhora do Monte). The neighbourhood is lovely. Handy supermarkets, local restaurants and it's easy to get to Tram 28 to get around town. There is also a taxi rank on Largo da Graca so easy to get back to the airport too. It only cost us 9 euros!
Lisbon is fantastic, but honestly, the flat, the balcony and the view will mean that you'd be more than happy staying in, and eating and drinking there - who needs a rooftop restaurant or bar, when you have 'The Flat with the View'.
Bruno's flat is perfect. Stunning view, located in a great area and tastefully furnished. Tip!

We loved staying in the flat with the view and would highly recommend it to everyone.
Bruno is a wonderful host and made us feel extremely welcome and his knowledge was invaluable.

We've been at Bruno's magnificent flat for 2 days in August, and we wish they had been more. Bruno is a great host and made us feel welcome! The flat is tastefully furnished and decorated, and very cozy. The view over Lisbon that can be enjoyed both from the flat and from the balcony is breathtaking. we cannot wait to be back!

Bruno was an excellent host! He made sure to direct us to the best spots in Lisbon. The apartment is located at one of --or if I'm not mistaken--the highest view point in the city. The view was what we loved the most.

Be prepared to walk everywhere. We did, a lot, but the "pain" was worth it. Cab rides were fairly inexpensive to/ from the cool spots.

This was my first Airbnb and I was not disappointed. The apartment exceeded our expectations; it was clean and felt so homey. Bruno was kind enough to greet us with wine and snacks. The kitchen has everything you need, even coffee! the bedroom is very comfortable and it was cool to have a bath tub in it. Be careful not to bump your head in the bathroom if you are a giant like me boyfriend. There's a washer in it as well which was very convenient. We hung out in the living room a lot and listened to local stations as Bruno recommended. We had great weather so we opened the windows to let the breeze in... it was so comfortable.

We are kind of disappointed we didn't spend more time in the apartment & Lisbon; we are also disappointment we didn't get to try Ramiro's!! We'll be sure to come back to this beautiful city, and we'll also make sure to come back to Bruno's spot!

E
View view view! Great view indeed from Bruno's flat in Graca. Great communication and excellent welcome.

Exactly as it looks in the listing - which is incredible! A great size flat for a couple, checkin/out was smooth - the very famous viewpoint is next door so its all very easy.

We would recommend Uber to and from the flat, it really is only 15 mins to the airport and all drivers know the location.

If we return to Lisbon we'll be looking to stay here!

The apartment is amazing and looks just like in the pictures. Bruno was not in town when we arrived but his friend Joana met with us and was extremely friendly and helpful in terms of giving us tips for Lisbon, giving us a sense of the neighborhood, and answering questions. Communication went smoothly and easily, and the place was perfectly clean when we arrived. The views are stunning, but it is worth noting that, because of how high the place is located (on the highest hill in a city of hills), it is ALWAYS extremely windy on the balcony. During our five days there we were never able to actually spend time on the balcony, because of the wind. Forget about having a proper meal out there. It is also quite a climb to reach the place, so you will leave with fit legs! We had some trouble with the hot water in the shower. But all of this was minor and ultimately the place was simply amazing and we had beautiful days here. Many thanks for a great stay!

This is a very nice apartment! The views, as noted by other reviewers, were amazing. The check-in process was smooth. Rita was very helpful, giving us good tips on restaurants and places to see. She also answered any queries very promptly. We very much enjoyed our stay. Highly recommended!

My boyfriend and I had an incredible time in Lisbon. Bruno's flat was fantastic. Unfortunately we didn't get to meet him as he was away but his friend Joana was brilliant. Incredibly helpful and friendly, we really appreciated all her advice and her enthusiasm. The flat is perfect, views are amazing. The one drawback is the balcony is too lovely which makes leaving every day difficult :) great city, great flat, can't really say anymore. Would certainly recommend.

Bruno's flat certainly has a great view over Lisbon. Sitting on the terrace with a glass of wine, and appreciating the views, is a great way to wind down after a day's sightseeing in Lisbon. It was our first time in Lisbon, but it's a fascinating city to which we hope to return.
Amazing views from the apartment over Lisbon, and what a fantastic city to explore and dine. Comfortable bed and good local tips from Bruno's friend who greeted us.
We really loved staying in your apartment. Definitely recommend staying here. The view over the town is amazing!

Appartamento delizioso con una vista davvero incredibile. Comoda la posizione (la fermata del mitico 28 é molto vicina), pulita la casa e calda l'accoglienza..il resto l'ha fatto Lisbona ...città magnifica

Not much I can add that hasn't already been said: stunning view and a gracious host. The apartment is tidy and equipped with lots of good books and a guitar. We went to the restaurant that Rita recommended, A Piteu, and it was one of the best meals we had in Portugal. I really liked the neighborhood this place was in; it felt a little more removed from the hustle of Lisbon, which was a welcome change towards the end of our trip. Thanks for everything, Rita and Bruno!

Great house, easy to find and in an excellent  spot in Lisbon. Everything was as described. Bruno/Rita made us feel at ease immediately and explained everything we needed to enjoy Lisbon. Will definitely be my  first choice when I come back to Lisbon which I will. And one word to describe the view: AMAZING.

Accueil chaleureux, vue fantastique, appartement ou l'on se sent bien.

While Lisbon in itself is a stunning place, Bruno's place makes the experience of seeing the city a simply spectacular and unforgettable memory! The flat is perfectly located and the views are even better than on the pictures! All amenities work well and those evenings spent on the terrace after a long day of touring with the pleasant breeze and the buzz of the city in the background will serve as fuel for thought for many months to come! Could not imagine a better place to stay in Lisbon!
Everything was explained to us perfectly and very efficiently. Bruno and Rita have been most helpful from the moment the reservation had been made. I could not give higher praise for their hospitality and help!

Rita, Bruno's friend, met up with us at a location right by the flat. She was terrific and talked through the various neighborhoods in Lisbon and gave us tips on places to see and eat. She brought us to the flat, which was in very good order and had everything that you would need, and more. The view cannot be beat and the breeze that you get with the of windows open is fantastic. This is the place to stay if you are looking to relax in Graca. You will want to spend more time at this flat than you normally would while you are in Lisbon due to its terrace/light/breeze. We highly recommend the hosts and the flat!

Experience magnifique à Lisbonne!
Tout était parfait, l'appartement est exactement comme on le voit dans les photos et la vue de la terrasse est simplement à couper le souffle!
Bruno à été très accueillant et il nous a donné des informations pour visiter la ville ainsi que des adresses très sympa!
La prochaine fois qu'on reviendra à Lisbonne, nous n'aurions aucun doute sur quel appartement choisir!

This is definitely the best Airbnb experience I've had yet (and I've had a few!).

The flat itself is fantastic: the view is even better than we expected; the amenities are brilliant (from local guide books, TV (we watched Eurovision on it!), iPod speakers, a full kitchen (with food), and all the rest you would expect and then some, such as a guitar and books!).

The location is brilliant, in an authentic but up-and-coming part of Lisbon. The flat is easily accessible, and we caught Ubers around town from the flat normally for less than €5 to most major locations.

Bruno, Rita, and Joana were lovely hosts, welcoming us upon arrival and departure and making themselves available for any questions or queries we had.

Lastly, Lisbon is stunning - I have no idea how more people don't come here. Regardless of where you stay, I highly recommend visiting.

We will definitely be back :)

We were met nearby at the lookout and taken to the accommodation where we were given useful information about the area and Lisbon.

The description isn't exaggerating about the view this apartment has! It is small, well appointment and well designed. We really enjoyed our stay. The location is 10-15 minutes walk to the castle and adjoining Alfama neighbourhood.

Highly recommended!

Thank you for an excellent stay in a great place! You are a good and very useful host!Hope to come back some day.

If there was an Airbnb “Hall of Fame" this would be in it! Bruno goes above and beyond to help guests with points of interest in Lisbon and provides what is possibly the best view in the city. Put simply: wow! From start to finish this was an amazing trip. Bruno was incredibly useful, quick to respond to all ours needs and very welcoming. We barely used a guide book and just relied heavily on suggestions from Bruno - all were spot on and made the trip so much easier.

The description of the flat is true in the sense that the photos don't do it justice! The view is without question the best I've ever had in a city location. We spent far more time in the flat than we would ordinarily just to make the most of it. The rest of the flat is really top notch too. It has everything you need and is really cool inside.

The location of the flat is also a massive plus. It's in a really cool area called Graca which is close enough to get to all the main areas, but far enough away to avoid the hustle & bustle of the party areas (i.e. Barrio Alto). The best restaurants that we ate in were both very close to the flat and we much preferred the atmosphere of the bars/restaurants/cafes of the most touristy areas. No where was more than 15-20 min walk away, so it's easy to access everything.

I can't recommend this place highly enough. Without question we'll be back soon. Lisbon is amazing and the flat is even better.

Bruno was there when we arrived by taxi. He even brought the suitcases in the third floor! In short time he explained us the most importaant things of the apartment as well as of the city, which we appreciated very much.

Wow! What a view and what a place! Must be the best place to live in Lisabon. We spent a week ther during the Easter. Bruno was a great host. Very friendly and helpful all the way. The flat is definitely a scenic view in our trip. Apart from the stunning view, it also has a good interior style. We highly recommend the airbnb peers to have a try if you are not too old to walk.

Ce fabuleux appartement a largement contribué à rendre ce séjour très agréable, malgré le mauvais temps!

Bruno est un excellent hôte. il nous attendait au point de rencontre déterminé plusieurs jours à l'avance. L'accueil fut fort sympathique.

A great location with tram number 28 winding you down through the cobbled streets of the city, with many beautiful little bars and places to explore! Highly recommend this experience x

Bruno and Fatima were both wonderfully helpful, and highly communicative.  Hospitality was truly warm!  Surely this is one of the best flats in all of Lisbon!  We had an amazing time.  If I ever have a 6 month sabbatical, then I just might rent this flat to read myself into bliss while having amazing views.  Superb locale!

Bruno made us feel extremely welcomed by meeting us by a lookout point by the flat.  He showed us around the flat and told us what there was to see around the city.  The flat is incredible.  It really is a once-in-a-lifetime experience to stay in his flat.  A slice of paradise.  The view is absolutely stunning.  The flat has everything you need for a comfortable stay.

Bruno made us feel very welcome, picked us up nearby the appartment and guided us to the flat. His apartment is very comfortable, has everything you need and more (guitar, binocular) and the view is really amazing. We spent most of our evenings at the balcony. A very nice place to stay!
Fantastic! We could not have wished for anything more.

We had a wonderful time at Bruno's flat with an "AMAZING" view!! Bruno was an excellent host, and the flat was welcoming, relaxing, and accommodating. The neighborhood was pleasant and walkable to most things you would want to see or access. Thank you so much for a great stay in Lisbon!! ~ Carrie & Maria

We really enjoyed staying at the flat. A great view and worth the climb up to it. All amenities there, well designed space. Clean and tidy -no problems there at all. Bruno was helpful and friendly & it was good to be able to leave luggage for the day at his other place when leaving. Near to Graca area with supermarket & local shops too -also very close to tram 28 route & cab rank at Graca. It was hot weather in July and there's no air con but the flat gets good air & breeze coming through if you open the windows at both ends so it was fine for us. We would stay again & it's much more fun to feel part of this neighbourhood than being in one of the big hotels..
Bruno was a perfect and welcoming host. Relaxed attitude and had a lot of great tips! Very flexible as well. Nice guy!

Bruno was the perfect host and we really enjoyed the stay thanks to all the tips we got. One tip that we especially appreciated was to take a taxi from the departures instead of from arrivals where there was a line of about 100 people waiting. Bruno had left some fruit for us, really nice gesture. The flat has a magnificent view and there is really everything you need. The area is nice and quiet although close to the center.  We can absolutely recommend a stay here!

A wonderful experience!
The apartment is a delight! Located next to the highest viewpoint of Lisbon (Belvedere da Graça), it offers an incredible view of the city.
The sun rises on the side of the room (full of light), and layer on the side of the terrace (sunset over the city).
The apartment is located in a quiet pedestrian street, so there is no noise (apart the birds singing in the morning ;)).
There is everything you need nearby (Tram 28, small shops, 2 miradouros ...).
I'll return to Lisbon and I'll stay at this apartment.
If it is available, do not hesitate! go for it!
(it is a little bit more expensive than the other but it is well worth)

Bruno is very welcoming and full of good advice and good addresses and really nice.

Un séjour merveilleux !
L'appartement est un bonheur ! Situé à coté du plus haut mirador de Lisbonne (Miradouro da Graça), il offre une vue incroyable sur la ville.
Le soleil se lève du coté de la chambre (baignée de lumière), et se couche du coté de la terrasse (couché de soleil sur la ville).
L'appartement est situé dans une petite rue piétonne, il y a donc aucun bruit (a par le chant des oiseaux le matin ;) ).
Il y a tout ce qu'il faut à proximité (Tram 28, petits commerces, 2 miradouros ...).
Je retournerai à Lisbonne et je retournerai dans cet appartement.
Si il est dispo, n'hésitez plus ! foncez !
(il est un peu être un plus cher que d'autre mais il le vaut largement)

Bruno est un très accueillant et disponible, plein de bon conseil et de bonnes adresses et vraiment très sympa.

The most amazing view in the city. I arrived in Lisbon sleep deprived and grumpy- this apartment changed my outlooks and made the city magical. Bruno also provided wonderful advice on where to dine, etc. I wish I could have stayed longer!

The flat and the view were absolutely incredible. It was easy to explore Lisbon during the day and relax on the terrace in the evening, and groceries and places to eat were conveniently situated. Bruno is an excellent host- our flight arrived slightly before the flat was ready so he sent information on where we could hang out and leave our luggage in the meantime. He also provided us with invaluable travel and sightseeing info for our trip, all of which was excellent. I highly recommend the flat and host and have only good memories of our trip to Lisbon :)

The apartment was great. Enjoying breakfast with this view was amazing.
The apartment has everything you need, it was clean and cosy.
Bruno is great as well. He will make sure you'll get to the apartment in a good order, he makes sure everything is okay during your stay and he even gives you suggestions on how to spend your time in Lisbon.

Bruno's apartment was awesome. It was a highlight of our trip to Lisbon. The view overlooking the city was unbeatable. It was definitely relaxing and enjoyable. I highly recommend this place to anyone. We look forward staying at Bruno's apartment again in the near future.

appartement avec une vue imprenable sur Lisbonne et une petite terrasse parfaite pour terminer la journée.. ou la commencer au moment du brunch ;)
En plus de cela nous avons été très bien accueillis par bruno.

Bruno is very helpful, easy to access via email or phone and a pro at making your stay in lisbon a great one! the location is top-notch and for those not used to climbing the steep hills of lisbon, a great reminder to hit the gym when you head home...thankfully bruno is there to help get your luggage up the 3 flights of stairs:)
and in case you are not up to walking up the hill - you can just kick back, drink some nice portuguese wine and enjoy the view!

Bruno was an absolutely fantastic host, and was very accommodating during our stay in Lisbon. The view was truly spectacular, pictures don't do it justice! We enjoyed having wine in the evening on the patio, it was the perfect way to end the day. The only thing we didn't realize was how far (and how high) the apartment was from some of the neighbourhoods we wanted to check out. The view is spectacular because it's at the highest point in Lisbon. But if you wear comfortable shoes, and are ok with taking a cab or the metro once in a while, you'll be just fine.

The apartment was extremely clean, and had everything we needed. I would definitely recommend The Flat with the View to other travellers who are looking for a unique and picturesque Lisbon experience.

In one word: AMAZING!

Best place of Lisbon for sure!

We've loved our stay at the apartment, the view is very impressing indeed. Bruno met us at a viewpoint close by and gave us a little introduction of the city from there, which was helpful as it was the first time that we were in Lisbon.

The apartment was great, perfectly decorated and felt instantly as a home. When I'd go back to Lisbon, I'd definitely go back to The Flat With A View 1!

my very first airbnb so I feel like I hit the jackpot with this spectacular flat and it's delightful owner Bruno. I'd echo everything that previous reviewers have said: Bruno couldn't be more helpful, polite, welcoming and informative. as for the flat: beautiful, tranquil, the most astonishing views, wonderful neighbourhood. a perfect introduction to Lisbon.

We were delighted with the accommodation, it is exactly as described if not better. It was a great base to explore Lisbon and somewhere to relax and feel very at home after a long day sightseeing.

Bruno was a superb host and made us feel extremely welcome throughout our stay. We would love to return.

Quel endroit parfait!  L'appart autant que l'emplacement. La vue est aussi impressionnante que le vent la nuit!  (Situé au sommet de 254 marches de la place principale)  Hôte attentionné, Bruno est à la hauteur de son flat.

Incredible journey! Incredible host! Bruno was so nice with us. He took a lot of his time to share with us his addresses, not only in Lisbon, but in South Portugal. In fact, we had a wonderful trip in Portugal and it's a lot because of him. I would strongly recommend his flat with the view as well as his lovely guesthouse (lisbon story guesthouse). Everything was impeccable and very unique. There is something about every details Bruno took time to do in his houses. The view is surely the best in town and it's easy going back home with the tram 28. We traveled with a baby and Bruno was very helpful with that, even proposing to lend a baby bath for the rest of our trip in South Portugal. I would definitely go back to the flat with the view!

First and foremost I would like to say how amazing Bruno was! We didn't get out luggage off our flight and Bruno was very helpful by calling the airport and having our luggage rerouted to an easier location for drop off! That sure made things easy breezy! My husband and I stayed here for 4 nights and I can't say how amazing this place was! You really do feel like a local:) The pictures do not do this place justice! The terrace was the like a piece of heaven at the end of a long day! I loved that I could lie down outside and stare out at such an amazing view! We would definitely stay here again and recommend it to anyone!

Bruno est une personne d'une grande gentillesse, et en plus il est très facilement joignable durant le séjour par email ou téléphone ce qui est très utile !
Merci à toi Bruno

6 jours dans un appartement confortable avec une vue d'exception sur Lisbonne. Nous avons particulièrement apprécié l'accueil de Bruno à nOtre arrivée attentionné, qui a pris le temps de nous donner les informations qui nous ont grandement aidées à nous organiser. Une très bonne adresse.

First, the apartment is fantastic.  The pictures don't lie.  The view is spectacular and there is a reason a public "viewpoint" is only a few yards away.  Second, the neighborhood is great.  Not touristy at all, and seems like a genuine Lisbon neighborhood.  Third, the apartment, though small, was incredibly well designed to maximize the space.  Very comfy.  And, finally, Bruno was a wonderful host.  Was flexible in meeting us and sending us off, had terrific suggestions of things to see and do, and was very welcoming.  If you go to Lisbon, stay here!

Not even rain, rain and more rain could spoil our 5-day visit in Lisbon. Thanks to The Wiew we constantly felt were a part of the beautiful city. And thank you, Bruno, for very fine tips on what to see, tast and do.

Bruno's flat is the perfect place for couples looking for a romantic week-end. The view is breathtaking and the sunset is gorgeous from the balcony. The flat was very clean and looks exactly like on the pictures provided. The location is great as well, a short walk from the castle, and the famous tram 28 stopping just down the street.
Bruno was very friendly and welcomed us warmly in his city. He spent some time with us when we arrived to give us some tips and advice about the city. He also provided a map with the top things to do and to see which happened to be very useful for us.
We would strongly recommend Bruno's apartment as a very good alternative to touristic hotels.

Great weekend. Thank you Bruno.

Merci pour tout Bruno,
Quel accueil exceptionnel, l'appartement est vraiment génial, un vrai petit nid douillet full option avec une vue extraordinaire. Nous ne pouvions pas rêver mieux !
A très bientôt sur Lisbonne, il nous reste encore de très belles choses à découvrir.
Olivier

Lisbon is beautiful and the apartment is Lisbon's most beautiful spot. We felt at home right from the start and the views are breathtaking. Bruno was very helpfull and communication with him was nothing short of excellent. I will def. reccomend staying at "The Flat with the View".
Bruno was very helpful and friendly and the flat was excellent! We had a great time and would gladly return on another occasion. Highly recommended!

die unterkunft war im wahrsten sinne hervorragend.und hat die wirklich beste aussicht auf die stadt. wir kommen wirklich gerne wieder.
beate und günther
This has been a very nice place in good location. Very uncomplicated "check in" and warm welcome. This is a nice place to spend the time in Lisbon.
awesome place , amazing view , will be back again.
The Flat With The View is the perfect place to stay while in Lisbon. The Neighbourhood is lovely, Bruno is very helpful and the flat has anything you need.

The Bruno's apartment is perfect! The view is just breathtaking and Bruno forgot to mention in its description that his apartment is the highest point of view of Lisbon! ;) Thank you so much Bruno for your warm welcome, your help and your advices...You said us when we arrived "In Lisbon, sometimes you have to follow your instinct to find the great and not touristic places" and it was so true! Each time that we saw something which seems cool, we reminded that saying us "Go!" and finally we fell in love with Lisbon and this lovely apartment! So I recommand it to everyone..
Thank you Bruno for this incredible stay in Lisboa. Your flat was just the perfect place, we had a very nice stay! And ... what a view!!! We'll be back ! Take care! Camille and Jeremy!

Lisbonne vaut le détour, tout autant que l'appartement de Bruno. Une vue assez exceptionnelle et (unique) sur Lisbonne, à 180° de la mer jusqu'au Tage / À ne pas rater /
Petit appart très bien aménagé, pensé, agréable, lumineux, bien équipé et Bruno est un hôte disponible, accueillant et très sympathique / On recommande vivement !

This flat was the best flat we ever rent on Airbnb. The only problem is that you don't want to visit lisbon when your are in. The amazing view make you feel that you're a part of lisbon.
Bruno is a really good person. Friendly, smily, and so helpfull.
This flat is a Island for 2 lovers.

The flat with a view is exactly that - a great little spot to watch the hustle and bustle of this beautiful and charming city from afar, whilst still being so conveniently located. You can take the 28 to commute into town and after a while you start to feel like a local. It's also fine to walk into town, but the weather was unusually bad when we were there so we used public transport more than We would have done otherwise. The hills certainly keep you fit and make you earn those delicious pastries that tempt you everywhere you go in Lisbon. Bruno is such a wonderful host, he made us feel extremely welcome, gave us lots of tips and was available all the time and extremely responsive when some things needed to be done. Would highly recommend this place and Bruno for a truly special Lisbon experience. Thanks Bruno we loved it and really enjoyed meeting you! We hope to meet you again in the future!
An incredible apartment completely equipped and very comfortable. Bruno was a fantastic, attentive host. Absolutely great all around!

Spotlessly clean, warmly welcoming and comfortably stocked is what the apartment feels like once you step in. Its when you step out to the terrace that the view takes your breath away. Better than the views afforded by the city's Miraduoros (viewpoints) including one which is 20 steps away; the panorama sweeps across from the wonderful Castle to the beautiful bridge. For honeymooners it was perfect to fall in love all over again and for people coming for a long stay a wonderful place to relax atop the buzzing city of Lisbon.

Bruno, the owner is a great and warm person who does not let you feel alone in a new city. He was always there for any questions we had over e-mail or whatsapp. He also arranged for a great surprise basket for my new bride and had carefully selected all the ingredients.

Would love to return soon and will stay nowhere else but here !!!

Bruno's apartment has a stunning view of Lisbon, and Bruno himself is very helpful and kind. This is unique flat with a lot of character.

The best part of our experience there was the gorgeous view, the lovely patio (that would be amazing if it had been warm), and the cozy, eclectic yet homey decor. It is also walking distance to many great places such as Rossio Square, St George's Castle and Barrio Alta. Although, as other reviews have mentioned, getting anywhere from the flat on foot is not super convenient. There is a fantastic cafe a couple of blocks away that is easy to find, but the old Graca neighborhood is extremely windy and it's easy to get lost (which can be fun, but also frustrating if you're jetlagged).

Also, because of the unique design of the flat (which makes really ingenious use of space), there are slanted beams that are easy to bump your head on.

While it's definitely not for everyone, we really appreciated Bruno's flat for it's cozy, homey, and unique appeal.

For the second time in Lisbon and lived in Bruno's flat - in a beautiful apartment that is clean and beautifully decorated and has everything you need. It was everything as described in the offer. In perfect weather we had wonderful sunrises and sunsets and fantastic views over the city. You can find everything you need in the area. Bruno gave us good tips, so you did not have to look far to find the right one. Thank you Bruno for the warm welcome!
The time was too short - there is still so much to see in Lisbon. Conclusion: We need to come back - Bruno, we are looking forward again to your apartment!

An excellent host who met us on arrival and made us feel very welcome. He made recommendations for our stay and was a friendly and relaxed owner. The flat was beautiful. Very clean and tidy and well appointed. What you see is less than what you get! Would definitely come back and recommend it to friends. Thank you Bruno.

Super appart, atypique, propre et soigné.
Vue incroyable, on domine la ville.
On recommande fortement!!!

Bruno's flat has an amazing view, especially at dawn & dusk! Totally worth climbing the 5 flights of stairs up everyday!
We enjoyed our 3 day stay there and it is one of our favourite apartments in Portugal!
We love the decor in his apartment - he cleverly made use of all the space in the flat to create a cozy apartment!
The bathroom is 'open-concept', no doors, but as it is in the bedroom, you have the choice of locking the bedroom door.
We enjoyed admiring the night view on the couch, which can be pulled out and made into a super comfortable bed!
The kitchen was well-equipped and very enjoyable to cook in. There was foodstuff left over by the previous tenants and some beers and drinks provided by Bruno in the fridge.
Bruno was very helpful and gave us a lot of tips on where and how to go to the attractions in Lisbon. He also left some guidebooks about Lisbon in the apartment, which we found very useful. He gave us two rechargeable metro cards, left by the previous tenants, which we took and use, but its a pity we forgot to leave ours there for future tenants. We will definitely come back to stay here again if we go back to Lisbon!

A truely special place!!
In an email prior to our visit, Bruno wrote that the pictures don't do it justice - and he was totaly right: The flat and the view are even more amazing then you can imagine from the pics. Everything is arranged with so much detail and thoughtfull use of space.
The kitchen is equipped with everything you could wish for.
You wake up with sunshine in the bedroom in the morning, and can watch the sunset from the terrace at night!
And Bruno is a very lovley guy. He provided us with on point arrangements and very usefull info before and upon getting there - including local radiostations!

What a a truly lovely flat. So cosy, so homely, so welcoming - and yes, the view lives up to the descriptions!! Wow :) Surprisingly quick and easy walk to and from the city centre..
Bruno was a fantastic host, very accommodating, laid back and really helpful with advice (you must take the trip to magical Sintra!) and we felt we could have contacted him at any time. We will be back!

THIS APARTMENT IS BREATHTAKING!!!!!!! I ABSOLUTELY RECOMMEND IT!!! I didn't think the stairs were a problem at all, if you go into town just take a taxi!  I LOVED IT!!!!! Will definitely stay there again when I go back to Lisbon.  I met Bruno and his mom, they are both charming and very friendly.  Bruno is fantastic with corresponding promptly and answering questions, etc.  the View is one of the best I've seen in my life!!!!!  I can't wait to get back there ;)

Beautiful flat with the grandest views, loved staying here. Everything you need in a fairly central location. Thanks Bruno
Recommended !

We spent one week in the Flat with a view - and the view was really spectacular. Bruno was very helpful and flexible, he picked us up at the meeting point and helped with the luggage when we arrived. We appreciated that since the flat is up on a hill and there is no elevator up to the flat. The flat is well furnished, very practical and tasteful. We really enjoyd staying there and felt very much at home. The center can be reached easily within about 10 - 15 minutes by walking, on the way back up the hill we usually took the 28 tram.

The flat with a view! The view is spectacular and the photos really don't do it justice! We had an amazing time in Lisbon and Bruno's local knowledge was very valuable. The flat has everything you may need during your stay.
The sunset from the terrace is something you can never forget!

We arrived in beautiful weather and met up with Fatima,Bruno's mother at the view point. We were 10 days in Lisbon and unfortunately had 3 days of continuous rain and little sun.
However we have seen a lot and experienced a lot of nice.
The apartment is small but very well designed and comfortable.
One can see from all the windows and the balcony over the city,
and the flat is bright,quit,very cosy,and the view sensational.
Bruno was very hospitable and has ordered us a taxi for departure.....worked out great!!!!!
Sometimes we where able to chill out on the balcony and that was wonderful.
Overall a great holiday,thank you!!!!!!

Deutsch.....
..die Wohnung ist sehr gemütlich und alles ist da,sogar eine
Heizung wenn es mal frisch wird, und die Küche ist sehr gut ausgestattet.Wir haben den tollen Ausblick genossen,selbst bei Regen!!!
Es ist sehr angenehm untouristisch und friedlich auf dieser
urigen Strasse,allerdings etwas steil,also nix für Gehbehinderte.
Die Straßenbahn :0)))) 28 ist in etwa 5 Minuten zu erreichen,den Berg hoch,also zurück, braucht man länger wenn man noch nicht trainiert ist und eingekauft hat.
Wir haben uns sehr wohlgefühlt und kommen bestimmt wieder.

The house is simply gorgeous as it looks like in the pictures! I loved the stay there, I wish I could spend moo ore time! :) Everything clean and perfect, such a good taste on the furniture and details! A special thanks to Joao who received us as a friend and provided to us really good tips!
I hope to back soon!
edo

We stayed at Bruno's flat for 3 nights and had an absolutely wonderful time. The view is amazing (very amazing) and the apartment itself is very comfortable and in great condition. I had heard good things of Lisbon but any expectations I had were exceeded - will be back!

Bruno was also great - we were delayed in our travels and Bruno was exceptionally helpful in accommodating us. His insight tips to Portugal included a selection of radio stations and, upon request, a Mozambican canteen. Thanks you!

Bruno was a fabulous host. he gave us a birds eye geography lesson from his viewpoint, so that we could find our way around Lisboa. He gave us great suggestions including the perfect fado restaurants. He met us for a drink across town where we had conversations and more advice about our visit. His communication was on point. All this plus the flat was beautiful and perfectly located with breathtaking views. We will hopefully stay there every time we visit. A big huge thank you and glowing recommendation from us. :-)

Seriously, the view from this place is like nothing you've ever seen! It is definitively, the best view of the city of Lisbon. Even taking a shower was an experience! There's a sunlight window in the shower. It feels like you're on the roof of Lisbon taking a shower! (a great way to start the day).

Apart from the wonderful apartment, Bruno is a wonderful host who made us feel welcome and at home immediately. Given the opportunity, we would stay at no other place in Lisbon the next time we visit.

AA+ Bruno and The Flat with THE View!

Bruno is very nice and her mother fatima received us with a lot of kindness
his apartment is very nice and the view is fantastic

The view is really impressive! but it must be earned! You have the best view, away from the very touristy areas and the apartment looks like the pictures. The only minor flaws are the noise of the fridge and the mattress is a bit hard.
Bruno give us a very warm welcome and very helpfuls tips for our stay in Lisbon.

Only one word to describe this place: BREATHTAKING!!! You have the best view and it is a very nice  apartment. Bruno is very friendly, and tells you which places you can visit. I would recommend this apartment to all of you!

It's truely THE VIEW!
Bruno's flat is amazing. We had a wonderful time in Lisbon and Bruno told us a lot of interesting things to do.
The flat is well located with this unbelievable view.
If you ever go to Lisbon, book this flat!

Bruno was an extaordinary host in helping us with our luggage to get to his great flat,but once You're up there you realize it was worth the effort.Beautiful views In a nice neighbourhood with everything nearby.I highly recommend it And thank you Bruno

This is a great flat! It's clean and well equipped and, best of all, you can watch the sun set over Lisbon from your own private terrace. The flat is located in a charming neighborhood, only a 10-15 minute walk away from downtown and the main attractions in the city, with a good selection of local restaurants nearby. There are also supermarkets and bakeries just around the corner. The hill is steep, but climbing back up is part of the fun (or you could opt for the tram or even a taxi, which are very affordable). Bruno is a friendly and welcoming host with good insight on where to go and what to see. We loved it!

We had an amazing stay in Bruno's lovely apartment with its spectacular view of Lisbon! Both Bruno (and his mom who let us in) were super friendly and helpful, Bruno even helped us figuring out the trains in Portugal. The apartment is clean, nicely decorated and offers everything you need, also for cooking if you like. We actually never did that as there are so many very affordable good places to eat, also close by. Super market and famous tram 28 are also on walking distance. The only down sight would be the fact that its quite a walk upwards to the apartment (Lisbon is very steep!), but the view is worth it (and the quiet nights for sleeping)+ taxi's are very cheap (we never paid more than 6E for a ride back home). Thanks again Bruno!
The view really is amazing, very nice flat too, and we were well looked after. I never normally review on things like this, but felt compelled to this time. Just wow!

The flat with the view has probably the best view in Lisbon! We stayed there for two weeks and couldn't be happier with the appartment, the host,  the balcony (big!), or the neighbourhood (central, charming and not in the typical touristic area). Will highly recommend this if you are going to visit Lisbon :)

It was our first time to Lisbon and we had an amazing time. Bruno is a lovely guy and his flat is everything we wanted in a holiday home. The flat is beautiful. Very clean and well equipped.
Bruno gave us a very warm welcome, showed us around the flat and then sat down with us and on a map showed us where to go and what to do whilst in Lisbon. It was great to get his advice and recommendations. We just need to go back to Lisbon and do all the things we didn't have time to do this time around!
The location is excellent. It is a very peaceful neighbourhood full of character and just a 10 minute walk into the city centre.
Lisbon is a very hilly city and the walk back to the flat is not for the faint hearted but the view when you get there is absolutely astounding.
There is one of the main viewpoints a few steps up from the flat. It's magical.
Waking up and having breakfast on the terrace every morning makes your trip extra special.
Lisbon is an amazing city and the public transport is fantastic so it's easy to get around and trips out to different areas such as Sintra are easy and highly recommended.
The people of Lisbon are lovely and very helpful which makes your stay even more special.
I would highly recommend visiting Lisbon and staying at Bruno's. I certainly will again!
Thank you Bruno!

What a cool place to stay - the views are really spectacular - well worth the stairs you climb. Can't think of one negative thing about the apartment or the host - Bruno is very helpful and super responsive when we texted questions. If you like to be off the beaten path and in an apartment that is very unique, this is your place.

Bruno a été un hôte parfait !!! Fabulous ! Je recommande chaudement a la fois l'emplacement de l'appartement, avec une incroyable sur Lisbonne, la proximité des sites incontournable, le calme. Réservez les yeux fermés, Bruno est disponible et attentionné. Nous avons passé un excellent séjour.

the flat with the view was on my wishlist.
fulfilled.

the ideal place for writers who want to be inspired by lisbon.
right next to one of the most beautiful viewpoints of the city.
even a local like me is suprised by the charm and light of the apartment.

bruno is a kind and caring host. as a traveller who understands the joy behind the discovery, bruno has a special sensibility to welcome his guests.

the flat with the view will continue on my wishlist.
i want to return one day.

det er så sandt som det er skrevet...with a view! Det er en vidunderlig lejlighed. Skøn skøn udsigt over hele byen. Bedst når det er varmt, da det jo blæser lidt...men så er det også vidunderligt. gode senge, godt og fint indrettet, rent og pænt, en utrolig skøn vært, som hjalp os meget fint tilrette. Lissabon er jo en pragtfuld by..kan anbefales på det varmeste!

We had a wonderful stay at this extraordinary place in Lisboa. The host is very kind and helpful, the flat is top 5* standard and the view is outstanding being one of the highest points in the city. A very quiet place with everything in close distance. Highly recommended!

Wonderful apartment, wonderful view. No other place in Lisbon can deliver a view, balcony and private accomodation like this. We thoroughly enjoyed ourselves, and if we are ever back in Lisbon will be hoping that we can stay here again. Thanks to Bruno & Joao for their welcoming hospitality.

We spent four days in this beautiful and cosy place, we felt at home straight away! Bruno gave us a warm and friendly welcome. About the view... just fantastic, with the sun setting in front of the balcony!
Great friendly area, shops for groceries, trams, cafes...and felt very safe even late at night. The walk to the other parts of Lisbon is pretty easy. A little harder on the way back up but easier we found that what we had imagined :-)
We had a car and always found parking close by. But you don't really need it there, taking the tram or walking is the nicest way to see and experience the town.
And... the people are so friendly, always helpful, and all the young ones speak great english!
Well what more can i say....just GO and enjoy :-)

Superbe appartement où on notera la petite terrasse ensoleillée (tout au long de la journée) sur un des toits les plus hauts de Lisbonne avec une vue à couper le souffle!
Situé au coeur de la ville dans un quartier typique, charmant et chaleureux (Graça) près de tout mais en étant préservé des foules de touristes.
La baignoire dans la chambre donne un côté marin et romantique très agréable. Toutes les commodités sont présentes (lave-vaisselle, lave-linge, etc...).
Et que dire de Bruno, l'hôte de ces lieux, aussi gentil, accueillant que serviable et disponible!
En bref, une superbe adresse et une très belle expérience lisboète!!!

Excellent host and superb view.  Very peaceful sitting up on top of one of Lisbon's 7 hills.  If you have trouble walking hilly terrain, would recommend that you take advantage of Lisbon's taxis since they are cheap, honest, and readily accessible.

Rien à redire, c'était vraiment parfait ! Accueil chaleureux, appartement idéalement placé et parfaitement équipé, quand à la vue, c'est une vraie carte postale. Merci Bruno, je conseillerai ce spot à tous mes amis. Forçà Lisboa !

This place is wonderful ! very warm welcoming, the flat is ideally located and perfectly furnished, the sight is a real postal card. Thank you Bruno, i will recommand your place to all my friends. Força Lisboa.
Perfect flat with a fantastic view on a Lisbon, it is the paradis, and bruno is a good hote.

In one word: breathtaking. There can't be a better and more unique place to stay in Lisbon, the view of this apartment is a real experience! Start the day with the most stunning view of Lisbon and end the day watching the romantic sunset from your private balcony! Then walk down into the city and have a great diner and listen to the beautiful fado. This apartment has everything you need for a perfect city trip, just walk down the hill and you are in the centre of Lisbon! Bring your best shoes, because walking up to the apartment is a real challenge! Thanks Bruno!!!

This is a very nice apartment embraced by a fantastic view. It is cleverly designed with a charming atmosphere and the host is very helpful and kind. I travelled with my two children and they very much appreciated the excellent wifi in the apartment. Also the bath in the bedroom was highly appreciated. Personally, I was very happy with the welcoming when I received a map with all the important places in relation to the apartment. Great stay!

We had a wonderful stay in the flat with a view! The view is truly amazing from both inside the flat and the balcony. And the cosy flat has a lot of natural light and everything you need. Bruno was a great host and we felt very welcome and at home. He also provided a baby cot and answered our queries about traveling to Lisbon with our 3-month old daughter before we booked the flat. The neighborhood is nice with a local and laid back atmosphere, nice restaurants and within walking distance from tourist sights. We definitely hope to come back!

Loved this flat! Very centrally located and Bruno was incredibly helpful in pointing us to some good spots (like the taxi stand, or nearby flea market). It felt like we were in a treehouse! The views surrounding the flat were unreal. The flat was very clean and Bruno did a great job of providing anything we could possibly need on our stay. Markets close by so we could buy any food, great restaurants if we wanted to go out, shopping and close to most of the greatest attractions! I would definitely recommend this flat to anyone traveling to Lisbon. It was our first time and we found it the perfect place to stay.

The title wasn't lying the view is #1. Wonderful flat, we had a great time.
thanks again Bruno for your hosting, everything was perfect.

If you want a real and unique Lisbon experience, book this wonderful apartment!
Arrive at Nossa Senhora do Monte viewpoint and meet Bruno, a wonderful host and very relaxed and extremely likeable person. Try to memorize all the good tipps he gives to you while explaining where you are. Enjoy the breathtaking view over the city and this special place (very calm litlle park with a tiny white church and an almost magic atmosphere). Climb the steps to the apartment, get embraced by te cosy interior and don´t even try to close your mouth again when standing on the terrace, enjoying this unbelievable view (beyond words!!!).

Feel like a real Lisbon resident when walking around Graca neigbourhood. Try to go shopping in the small quirky super bargain stores (Sao Vicente candles, plastic plates for a picnic at Jardim da Estrela...), the local fish monger and butcher shops. Eat some delicious grilled fish or piri piri chicken in the Churasqueira de Graca. And make sure trying at least three different sorts of those sweet pastries in the pastelerias nearby.

Go back to the appartment to enjoy this breathtaking view again.

Take the 28 and enjoy a long circle ride till you get back to Graca square.

Go back to the appartment to enjoy this (still) breathtaking view again.

Sit on the terrace in the evening (on a hot Lisbon day) or soak in the bath tub (on a cold and windy Lisbon day), have some Vinho Verde and read some lines by Pessoa – you will find an English version on the bed table – to complete your real Lisbon feeling. And get sad that you can´t stay her forever!

Très bel appartement, bien équipé, très bien situé!
Un bon plan!

The view from this flat is truly amazing. Although Lisbon is a city with many great views, this one is actually quite unique. The flat itself is stylish, quirky and has an uplifting atmosphere. Bruno is a great host and made us feel very welcome. The local area (Graca) is superb, down to earth and full of character, every essential within a short walk and the 28 tram if you want to go further.

Thoroughly recommended.
If one ever get the chance to rent this flat we highly recommend to do so. It was a little bit a piece of an individual heaven : )))
We spent a really special week exploring Lisbon from Bruno's flat. The views are special and Bruno is the warmest and friendliest host you could have! We couldn't recommend it more.

Meine Freundin und ich hatten hier eine wunderbare Zeit über 4 Tage hinweg… Hugo und Silvia waren immer sehr nett und kommunikativ, auch falls man mal Hilfe braucht. Auch wenn die Anreise und das erste mal in die Wohnung kommen nicht die einfachste ist, lohnt es sich umso mehr am Ende, denn das Zimmer ist sehr, sehr schön mit einer unglaublichen Aussicht über Alfama und auf den Tajo und total sauber, wie man es auf den Bildern vorfindet. Wir haben uns in die Stadt und in die Wohnung verliebt und sind Hugo und Silvia sehr dankbar für so einen tollen Aufenthalt ! Wir würden definitiv wieder kommen :)

This place was a delight. We were only there one night before leaving Portugal but had everything we needed (and more) in this space. The stairs are not for the faint of heart but I'm 65 and managed them just fine WITH luggage! There is plenty to do in this charming area and we loved Sala Rosa for dinner (make a reservation - it's tiny) and the views from our room were magnificent! Would recommend.

Great stay- Hugo was quick with his replies. He accommodated an earlier check in as well.
Lots of narrow stairs in the property so if there’s mobility issues then please be wary.
The flat itself was beautiful and cozy- was lovely with the view of the river and it was airy.
Getting Uber’s was relatively easy- requiring a 3 minute walk to the pick up location.
The shower was very powerful as well which was another benefit.
Couldn’t hear other neighbours as well which was fantastic.
The only things to note is the couch wasn’t too comfortable and the TV was quite small!
The Apartment is really beautiful and has a lot of Charme. The view is great and it had everything I needed.

Igazi Óváros környék, nagyon hangulatos. Sok emelkedő és csak a 28as villamos volt közel ami kiszámíthatatlan volt. Az apartman nagyon szép, ízléses, szép kilátással. 2 emberre kényelmes jól felszerelt.

とても親切で分かりやすいメッセージをいただき、安心して滞在することができました。
アルファマ地区の中心に位置しており、観光には最高の立地です！
ただし、Uberなどの車は建物の目の前までは入れないため、降車ポイントから急な階段を下る必要があります。また、建物内も傾斜のある階段を上がる必要があります。
足腰が丈夫で階段の昇降に問題がない方であれば、特に不便は感じないと思います。
また機会があれば是非よろしくお願いいたします！
Un espacio muy agradable, limpio y bien ubicado.
L'appartement est parfait pour un séjour a Lisbonne. L'emplacement dans la ville est stratégique. Le logement est propre, fonctionnel.
Great location with many great places to eat and see while staying in Lisbon! Hosts are very responsive and easy to reach.

A perfect place to use as a base in the lovely district of Alfama.  Ideal for using the 28e to get into Central Lisbon. A lovely flat. Well equipped and comfortable and excellent communication with Hugo and Silva. Would highly recommend this apartment as long as you are able to carry luggage up steep stairs which was fine for us. Thanks again for this lovely stay.

This location and place are perfect. It’s within walking distance to tons of restaurants and attractions. The view from the window is also breathtaking giving you a view of the water. The place is so cute and clean. I definitely hope to come back.

The place was as described, except the amount of narrow stairs you had to haul your luggage up and down.  It isn't a good place for elderly people.  It is a great place if you are just staying in Alfama.
Lovely apartment, right in the heart of Alfama.. Great location from which to explore and lots of bars and restaurants nearby. Had a great couple of days there.

This was an absolutely perfect location in the heart of the Alfama. Not too touristy as some other areas but very authentic and perfectly walkable to everything we wished to reverence. The home was tidy and clean. The stairs would be a challenge for anyone who is not very fit and limber but that is true for much of the area. We absolutely loved it and would stay again. The host was very responsive during check in.

Kitűnő szállás, másoknak is ajánlom, kívéve a mozgássérüleknek, mert elég meredek a házon belüli a lakáshoz vezető lépcső. Mikor ott voltunk elég csendes volt a ház. Mível hűvös volt a légkondicionálóval elég jól be tudtuk fűteni a lakást. A 28-as villamos mellett a várost átszelő 728-as autóbuszt használtuk a legöbbet. Jó tudni, hogy a Nemzeti Muzeum és a csempe múzeum zárva van, a híres felvonók se működtek (2026. januárjában írom ezt). De van Basky grafitijeiből kiállítás.

We had a really fantastic stay. The apartment was spotless when we arrived, and check-in was a breeze thanks to the very clear instructions. Hugo & Silvia were wonderful — responsive, warm, and incredibly helpful throughout our stay. They genuinely cared about making our experience great.
The location is amazing, it’s close to viewpoints and 28 tram. The surrounding area is beautiful and in the lower part of Alfama. The view is absolutely stunning. We could have spent hours just sitting by the balcony. The apartment faces south, and we caught the New Year fireworks here. Inside, the apartment was quiet and peaceful — even on New Year’s Eve, everything was calm shortly after midnight.
The blackout bedroom made for an amazing sleep environment. We really appreciated how well-equipped the space was. Trash disposal was close by and easy as well.
Overall, we couldn’t have asked for a better place or better hosts. If you’re visiting Lisbon, especially Alfama, we highly recommend staying here

My daughter and I spent six amazing days at the blue house in Alfama. We were there over Christmas and everything in Lisbon was so festive! From our beautiful apartment we could get everywhere quickly and easily. And there are cafes and restaurants and little food markets and laundromats nearby. Not to mention the 28 tram!
Inside the apartment was everything we needed. We cooked dinner several times and made coffee and breakfast every morning. So easy! We listened to the church bells and watched the boats go by in the river below. And we both slept great. It was quiet and dark with the shutters closed.
Great shower. Very comfortable bed in the bedroom ( the sofa bed is not as comfy ) , plenty of places to sit and eat or sit and write or play cards. All good.
The stairs to get in are very steep. No one with large heavy luggage or mobility issues should rent this place. But everyone else - go for it! You won't be sorry :)

A gorgeous apartment in a fantastic location. Absolutely worth staying here. That said, if you're planning on arriving by public transit (especially with big suitcases) be advised that it's a bit of a hike with lots of stairs both outside and in. Still, I would absolutely stay here again.

Hugo and Silvia flat was amazing. Easily accessible for walking and touring Alfama. They were also great communicators when trying to check in! Highly recommend booking if you're looking for a peaceful stay in Lisbon!

Lovely flat in a great location. Charming neighbourhood. Easy access to central Lisbon and public transportation.
The flat was very peaceful and offered fantastic views to the river.
This was a perfect Airbnb for our Lisbon experience. Right in the heart of Alfama — close to restaurants, shops, etc. An amazing view from the apt itself. We would definitely stay here again.

The apartment was a perfect home base for our stay in Lisbon. Alfama is a great neighborhood with a lot of stores and restaurants, and old world charm. After our site seeing was done for the day, we would sit, just looking out over the town with a glass of wine. I would recommend this apartment to anyone traveling to Lisbon. Thank you Hugo and Silvia!
Characterful apartment in Alfama, cosy with a great view. Very quiet and peaceful at night.
דירה מאוד נעימה ונקייה, קרוב להכל, מאוד נהננו

A great apartment in the lovely historic Alfama district with sea views. The place has tons of character. The neighbourhood is very hip with loads of eating, drinking and sightseeing options just round the corner.  The stairs will keep you fit! Hugo was super helpful and friendly.

Amazing place to spend an amazing time in the oldest part of Lisboa! We loved how peaceful it was but, at the same time, near from great restaurants, places to visit and accommodations. The view is great as well. We recommend this place for sure!
PS - Be mindful of the steep stairs that you have to climb to have access to the flat…but hey, it’s part of the vibe you’ll find there!!! 👍🏻☺️

We’ve had an altogether remarkable experience in Lisbon, and the apartment helped to get us in the mood from day 1.
Entering through the cosy little door from the street just off the 28 tram line, we found ourselves in a narrow stairwell, that has shown the atmosphere of the building, but couldn’t prepare us for the fantastic view from the windows.
The clean lines and comfort of the apartment gave place to start and end our days in a relaxing way.
Will recommend to anyone looking for a place to stay and explore this part of the city!
Wonderful apartment and hosts in a superb location.
Très beau logement idéalement situé en plein cœur du quartier de l'Alfama. Appartement lumineux avec une très belle vue sur le Tage. les hôtes sont très accueillants et arrangeants.

Really good place in Alfama. Wanted to visit Lisbon and Hugo&Silvia’s place provided the perfect base for that. Very quiet, although you’re in the middle of a touristic area; managed to get really good sleep, which is super important when traveling.
Communication was great.
좋았어요 근처 맛집도 많구요

Hugo & Silvia sont des hôtes réactifs et la communication avec eux a été impeccable. Le logement était propre, très bien situé ( proche de tout et avec une magnifique vue sur le Tage ) et assez tranquille pour le quartier.  Petite note aux visiteurs potentiels, il y beaucoup de marches pour se rendre à l’immeuble et à l’intérieur de l’immeuble, pour se rendre à l’appartement. Les UBER nous déposent en haut de la rue, ce qui implique de devoir porter les valises dans les escaliers. Si vous avez des grosses valises, soyez prévenus que ce n’est pas facile.  Les taxis sont probablement une meilleure solution, car ils passent dans la rue. C’est vraiment un super endroit et je recommande fortement. Nous avons adoré notre séjour!
Apartamento exatamente igual as fotos. Estava muito limpo, roupas de cama cheirosas e limpas. Vista muito bonita do rio. A localização é excelente para quem deseja viver a cultura local!
Nice cozy place in the middle of the old town. It was modern and clean. Was perfect for us

This apartment is in an excellent location in the beautiful old district of Alfama, close to tram stop and walkable to restaurants and supermarkets.
It has a fabulous view of the river.
Not easy to find despite being very close to where the taxi from the airport drops off, but if you take a wrong turn from there it is very difficult to find. Plus we couldn’t get a mobile phone signal in the area, so Google maps wasn’t much help.
The host relies on an app to enable entry to the property, but if there’s no phone signal you could get stuck outside. Luckily, a neighbour let us in as the host is remote.
Note that there was not a kettle during our stay.
The bed is in a small room and needs new bedding. The duvet was lumpy and did not fit its cover, both need replacing.
The sofa is scruffy and old and very uncomfortable.
This apartment would be a five star property if there was more helpful communication and more thought was given to guest comfort.

Hugo and Silvia’s place has a stunning view of the River! The neighborhood is very quaint and charming. Exactly the experience we were looking for in Lisbon! They have all the amenities you could need and more. If I return to Lisbon I will definitely stay here again. It’s a perfect location. Thank you Hugo and Silvia. You were lovely hosts!
Lovely and quiet apartment in beautiful Alfama. The hosts were super nice and we would be happy to stay here again!

Aunque el acceso a la calle y al piso puede ser un poco difícil con maletas por la cuesta arriba y las escaleras, el piso es precioso, tiene todas las comodidades y todo estaba muy limpio. Y tenía aire acondicionado que se valora un montón!
endroit très propre, bien situé, tranquille superbe vue, rien a redire je retournerais.

would highly recommend this place overall. very clean and spacious flat with a nice balcony view. Hugo and sylvia were very helpful and responded quickly.
area is a bit inconvenient, as public transport is weaker here and walking is tough, especially with luggage (lots of stairs)
Belle location très bien placée dans Lisbonne. Hugo est très sympathique et disponible pour prendre soin de ses hôtes. Je recommande cet appartement

Alojamiento perfecto para una escapada en lisboa. ubicación perfecta.
Estaba muy limpio, todo bastante nuevo, cocina equipada, baño bien con ducha. vistas al mar y terraza muy agradable. la atención de hugo siempre dispone muy bien.
Tan solo si eres una persona mayor tener en cuenta que es un tercero sin ascensor con escaleras empinadas.
Totalmente recomendable.

El departamento estaba impecable y ordenado, contaba con los servicios descriptos y en buen funcionamiento!
Hugo fue muy hospitalario, buen anfitrión. Se comunicó conmigo para ver si necesitaba de algo todos los días de la estadía. Amigable!
Respondió rápidamente ante consultas.

Hugo and Silvia’s home was beautiful! It was in a walking distance to most attractions and restaurants. They responded on time and were very helpful when I arrived (helping me leave my bags in a safe place prior to checkin time) . Great place overall. Clean and beautiful views from the living room balcony. Only downside was the stairs. If you have a lot of bags it may be difficult carrying them up and down the stairs.
La vue est magnifique et les hôtes sont rapide pour répondre au questions
Viihtyisä, viileä ja todella siisti asunto keskeisellä mutta rauhallisella paikalla. Voisin mennä uudestaan!
Great place to stay!

We loved our stay in this beautiful apartment in Alfama! The views were absolutely stunning it made visiting other viewpoints almost unnecessary, because the living room had the most breathtaking view of all. The apartment itself was very cute and cozy, and the location was perfect, with great restaurants, bakeries, and coffee spots nearby. Hugo was an excellent host very communicative, easy to reach, and responsive to anything we needed. We would definitely stay here again!

Such a lovely experience staying at Hugo and Silvia’s place in Lisbon! The location was very peaceful and close enough to transportation options that let us explore the city easily. Lots of really great restaurants in the area too. Thanks for hosting us!
Beautiful little apartment in great location to explore Lisbon

Nous avons eu une bonne expérience avec Hugo et Silvia! Le logement était propre et Hugo a été disponible par message tout au long du séjour. Les serrures sont impressionnantes, ce qui a augmenté notre sentiment de sécurité (bien qu’Alfama soit un quartier sûr). Le guide Airbnb disponible dans la fiche du logement a été très aidante et nous a permis de vivre une de nos meilleures expériences lors de notre visite au Portugal. On recommande chaudement A Baiuca à 5 minutes à pieds! Merci Hugo et Silvia!

We absolutely loved our stay at Hugo and Silvia’s apartment. The facilities were great, beautiful view, clean apartment, and amazing location which was walking distance to beautiful shops, restaurants, coffee shops, and the Main Street. We loved staying in the Alfama district - close enough to everything but just out of the tourist hotspots. Hugo was very responsive and helpful also! I would absolutely recommend staying here.
Great place
Best location in Alfama!

Très bel appartement. Très propre. Très calme. Très bonne literie. Proche tram sans le bruit.
Nous reviendrons avec plaisir.

Logement parfait pour un couple. Nous voulions être au cœur de la vieille ville et nous ne pouvions être mieux situés. Soyez prêt à marcher, c’est comme ça qu’on découvre et apprécie Alfama. Hugo et Sylvia nous ont permis d’apprécier notre séjour avec des conseils de restaurants dont l’ Agulha no palheiro que nous avons adoré pour l’ambiance, le service et les plats uniques.

Appartement super bien situé dans le quartier d’Alfama. Tout se fait à marche sans problème! Nous avons adoré la vue de l’appartement sur la ville et l’eau! Hugo a été flexible pour notre arrivée! Je recommande fortement!

We really enjoyed our stay at Hugo & Silvia’s place! The flat was spotlessly clean and very comfortable—perfect for unwinding after a long day of exploring. The ocean view from the window was absolutely stunning, and the fresh breeze made it even more enjoyable.
Finding the place was a bit tricky at first, as Google Maps led us to a different building, but once we arrived, it was absolutely worth it. The bed was incredibly comfortable and gave me the best rest each night.
The location was excellent and very convenient. We loved returning around 5–6 p.m. each day to take a quick nap before heading out for dinner or a nearby fado concert.
Just a heads-up: if you’re bringing a large suitcase, the stairs can be a bit challenging. I’d recommend packing light—something no larger than a carry-on would be ideal.
Clean, cute apartment in the heart of Alfama, We enjoyed the views of the river and getting lost in Alfama’s beautiful maze-like. Hugo was very responsive. Would recommend!

Alfama is the place to stay if you’re new to Lisbon! Hugo & Silvia’s apartment was in the best location and had everything you might need. Just be aware that there are a lot of steps like the other reviews mention. Be sure to check out their host guide for great local recommendations!

The flat is perfect for a stay in Lisbon.
Gorgeous view and quiet area despite a perfect central location.
Very well equipped.
Good shower.
Just note that the flat is up 3 flights of steep stairs!
Hugo and Silvia were very accommodating and thorough! We enjoyed the space and the location was walkable.

My daughter and I had a fantastic time in Hugo’s flat. It is beautifully decorated, very calm, with an amazing view on the Tage and on Lisbon. The bed is very comfortable, we slept so well! It was very hot outside when we were in Lisbon, but in the flat we could feel the heat, which was really very pleasant. Hugo is super reactive, very kind, he came several local recommendations, I can only warmly recommend staying in this flat to visit Lisbon. I will definitely come back next time I go to Lisbon. There is everything you need (bakeries, restaurants, transportation, etc) nearby. We had a wonderful time at Alfama Blue House! Thank you, Hugo!

If you are looking to experiencing old Lisbon, this is a place to stay. Our 3rd floor apartment was bright with a romantic view on the river, tiled corner house and red roofs of the neighborhood. Easy to access despite the steps leading to the apartment entrance. My sister with walking difficulties managed to get up easily. The place is bright, spotless with lightness and fresh air. Hosts amazing. Very responsive and informative.
Charming neighborhood with hilly access to simple cafes and restaurants.
Walking distances to city landmarks and public transportation.
I highly recommend the place and would love to stay there again.
Very cute place with an amazing view in the heart of Alfama! Hugo and Sylvia were great hosts.
Wonderful place to stay! Great location. Hugo and Silvia were always responsive if any questions!

Absolutely lovely apartment, more spacious than I expected. Location was perfect for us to explore and I loved getting the tram and wandering round the cobbled streets.
Comms were great. Thank you

Séjour parfait chez Hugo & Silvia ! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Nous avons passé un séjour absolument merveilleux dans l'appartement de Hugo & Silvia. Dès notre arrivée, nous avons été impressionnés par la propreté impeccable du logement - tout était nickel, on sentait vraiment l'attention portée aux détails.
La réactivité de nos hôtes a été exemplaire : ils ont répondu à toutes nos questions en un temps record et ont été disponibles tout au long de notre séjour. Leur communication était claire et chaleureuse.
L'emplacement est tout simplement parfait ! La vue depuis l'appartement est magnifique et la localisation permet d'accéder facilement aux principaux points d'intérêt. Nous n'aurions pas pu rêver mieux.
Honnêtement, tout était vraiment parfait - de l'accueil jusqu'à notre départ. Hugo & Silvia méritent amplement leur statut de Super Host !
Nous recommandons vivement ce logement et espérons avoir l'occasion de revenir bientôt.
Merci encore pour ce séjour inoubliable ! 🙏
Best location and fantastic communication! The perfect place to stay for a mother/daughter getaway!

J'ai passé 4 nuits dans le charmant appartement de Hugo et Silvia. Dans le quartier authentique de l'Alfama, vous serez proches de nombreux points de vue et monuments. L'appartement est calme. Les nuits y sont paisibles. Hugo est très réactif et a répondu de façon efficace à mes sollicitations. Je recommande pleinement cet appartement! Vous ne serez pas déçus!

Wir haben den Aufenthalt in Lissabon und in der hübschen Wohnung sehr genossen. Mitten im Altstadtzentrum mit herrlichem Ausblick. Viele Attraktionen in der nächsten Umgebung.
Sehr gerne weiter zu empfehlen.
Nice apartment with a great location. The host was very friendly and helpful.

It is a nice and cute appartment with a view on the river. With such a view on a sunny day, we felt like we could have spend the whole evening at the appartment, chilling in the living room.
It is also located near a street with many restaurants and it had everything we needed.

Die Unterkunft war sehr sauber und ist mit allem, was man braucht, ausgestattet. Das Bett war sehr bequem und der Ausblick auf den Fluss war fantastisch. Wir waren während des großen Stromausfalls dort und da das elektronische Türschloss nur mit Strom funktioniert, kamen wir nicht mehr in die Wohnung rein. Doch an dieser Stelle sei die Gastfreundlichkeit und Sorgfalt von Hugo hervorzuheben. Hugo kam schnellstmöglich mit dem manuellen Schlüssel und öffnete uns die Tür. Vielen Dank nochmal dafür! Alles im allem sehr zu empfehlen!

Great location in the heart of Alfama, with easy walking to coffee shops, restaurants, Fado performances, tram stops, and several major attractions. However, Uber seems to have a hard time getting to the front door, dropping us off on the street above.
Climbing the steep stairs isn’t well suited for large suitcases or those with limited mobility! Even with carry-ons, I could only take one at a time.
The battery-powered door locks are very secure, though the neighborhood was quiet except late the night of Liberation Day (April 25).
Directionally-challenged individuals will need their GPS to get around, and even then you may take the wrong turn at times. I enjoyed the challenge of figuring out where the staircases led to.
Hugo was very responsive and friendly, though we never met in person. The apartment is small but tidy and very clean. We did almost sprain a few toes on the small step-up to the rear of the apartment!
We had a great time! The place was beautiful in a perfect location. Thank you!

We loved Hugo and Silvia’s place. It is located in the beautiful area of Alfama, in which there is lots to see. It is very quick and easy (and inexpensive compared to the UK) to get Ubers from Alfama to other parts of Lisbon, and many popular attractions are walkable from the apartment, which is situated in a quiet, peaceful street.
The apartment itself is clean, cosy, and charming. It has a comfortable bed, nice view and all the necessary amenities. A few comments mention the stairs, but there are not too many and only the first few are narrow, so we didn’t find them problematic.
Hugo gave us clear instructions for finding and entering the apartment, which was straightforward. As everything was provided as laid out in his instructions and the Airbnb listing we did not have questions for him, but he checked in with us at the start and end of our stay to make sure we were okay. He was a very helpful, friendly host.
We would recommend Hugo and Silvia’s place to anyone visiting Lisbon.
Très beau séjour à Lisbonne. Bel et grand appartement bien situé et sécuritaire. À recommander sans hésitation!

Great unit! very well located! Hugo was very responsive and attentive to all inquiries. The bed is very comfortable and it has all the amenities that you need.
Thank you very much!

We only stayed one night and wish we had more time! The apartment is spacious and clean with a beautiful view. It’s in a great spot for exploring Alfama, we were able to walk to multiple Miradouros, restaurants , etc.

The location is perfect to explore the city!  The flat was super clean and had all the necessities. The bed was comfortable and bathroom and kitchen were spotless! The WiFi was faster than my fiber at home. Hugo was an amazing host, he would answer any questions immediately and had great recommendations. I would definitely stay here again!!!
