Excellent place and location. The only challenge is the steep stairs to the apartment with a big luggage. Overall, a great place.
Lovely flat and wonderful hosts. Great location. Quiet and comfortable. I would recommended this place.

We enjoyed the river view from the apartment. We were struck by the cleanliness and decor; the lounge in particular is a lovely shade of blue and the double doors provided good ventilation and natural light.
We enjoyed staying at this place. Very clean and organized. Great view and good access.

A very cute and clean apartment in the heart of Alfama, with a beautiful view and everything you need just a few steps away.
Despite extremely bad weather, my son and I adored both the flat and the city.
We highly recommend staying here!
Thank you Hugo for being so helpful, lovely place you have

Hugo and Sylvia were friendly hosts. The flat is clean and good looking, everything was ready when we arrived. The locking system is also great for the door. Hugo always answered our questions / requests in a short time.
We enjoyed our stay very much.
I would definitely recommend to a friend.

We stayed at Hugo and Silvia's place whilst visiting Lisbon for a few days. The apartment was lovely and clean and comfortable. It is in Alfama which is a great area with lots of lovely local food and bars right on your doorstep, but peaceful at the night time. We absolutely loved area and it was walking distance to lots of sights and different areas. We had a really comfortable and enjoyable stay and would definitely recommend to anyone wanting a great stop whilst visiting lovely Lisbon.
Estada perfecte en una zona emblemàtica de Lisboa. Bones vistes!

Everything about Hugo & Silvia’s place stands out. It was very clean, the apartment is very pretty and cozy, it has all the ammenities you could wish for, and last but not least its location is perfect. Every walk from and back to the apartment was lovely, through the charming streets of Alfama. Communication with the host couldn’t’ve been better, all the instructions were very clear, and the response time was really short. For both newcomers, as well as people that have experienced Lisbon before, I’d recommend this accomodation in a heart beat. We hope to be back as soon as possible. When that time comes, we know what accomodation we will check the availability for first.

It was an ok experience. The first problem I had would be to find the apartment as it has so many allies and it's not easy to find.
Then it's the amenity, I'm afraid it's not very satisfying, I found the forks in the kitchen aren't property washed and first night I arrive, I didn't even find the shampoo and shower gel until the landlord told me it's in the kitchen cabinet. The view is amazing but I guess it's due to the old town, the inside of the apartment looks a bit old.

The flat is cozy and well-designed, definitely great for 1-2 guests to share a bed. The neighborhood is Alfama, known to be hilly with some steeper walks and stairs, which might be tricky if you’re carrying a lot of luggage and walking up. To us it was definitely worth staying there because of the stunning views from the flat and balcony. Our hosts were responsive and gave very clear directions as well, which was helpful.

Wir hatten drei wunderschöne Tage in der liebevoll eingerichteten und blitz sauberen Wohnung von Hugo und Silvia. Die ruhige Gegend war der perfekte Ausgangspunkt um die Stadt zu Fuß oder mit den historischen Bahnen zu erkunden. Wir haben gut geschlafen und den tollen Ausblick über die Dächer bis zum Fluss jeden Morgen genossen.

I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at Hugo's. He is a wonderful host, helpful and quick to respond to inquiries.
The apartment is cozy, clean, with a great view of the river, and perfect for solo travellers or couples. I loved that many sites and restaurants were within walking distance.
You should know that carrying large luggage up the stairs may prove challenging. It was for me, especially going up the first set of stairs because they are steep and narrow, but once you get past those steps it's easier. I would suggest carrying smaller pieces of luggage.
I would definitely stay again and do recommend it.

Great location right in historic Alfama! Walking distance to many of the main sights and restaurants. The apartment is beautiful, clean, modern, and cozy, with an unbeatable view! We really enjoyed! The hosts were super responsive and accommodating. This place is a gem!

The appartment was very clean and at a perfect spot to reach everything in the city. The view out the windows was breathtaking. Alfama itself is beautiful. I would highly recommend Hugo and Silvias appartment and would always come back to it whenever I visit Lisbon.
L'appartamento era pulito e confertevole. Tutto in linea con l'annuncio. Nessun problema con il check in. Una bella vista sul fiume. Grazie

Superbe séjour dans le logement d’Hugo et Silvia. Excellent conseil avec Funny tour Lisboa, et un accueil parfait avec un lit pour bébé parfait!
Merci encore pour votre accueil et très belle appartement ! Nous reviendrons

I spent over few days at Hugo’s apartment. The location is very strategic yet quiet and I got to see the New Year’s fireworks and sunset over my room. Hugo is very communicative as a host, always responded within minutes. The apartment got what you need, especially in the kitchen.
Note: anyone with mobility issues may need a companion to bring their luggages in to their room.

Appartement propre et convenable pour deux personnes cependant l’emplacement n’est pas adéquat pour des personnes de 60+ qui doivent prendre les différentes montées pour arriver jusqu’à l’appartement et prendre les escaliers étroits pour arriver au 3e étage et avoir accès au logement.
superbe appartement, très bien situé, à proximité du tram/métro ! je recommande
We had a great stay!

I highly recommend Huge and Silvia's flat in the Triana neighborhood of Lisbon. Location wise, it was perfect for me - I loved being in a historic area, and walking around the cobblestone streets and making discoveries each time I walked the door was wonderful!
The flat is beautiful, has a lovely view, and is well appointed. The bed was really comfy, and it was a peaceful place to be at night.
Hugo was very responsive throughout, and helped me navigate the e-locks (thank you!) as I arrived. I highly recommend booking Hugo and Silvia's flat for your next adventure in Lisbon!
lovely place. Hugo and Silvia were very helpful in sorting out my situation with luggage and airport drop off and pick up! place is beautiful with a great view.
Ottimo

Great charming location,  fantastic response time (uber dropped us off a couple blocks away, they were quick to help point out location). The apartment has good space, especially considering historic district. Nice view of water (or cruise ship if it's a cruise ship day). Must be able to lift luggage 3 floors!
Very nice neighbourhood and lovely apartment. Be ready for some stairs :)
Great AirBnB. Keep up the good work
le logement est idéalement situé dans le quartier historique d'Alfama. Propre et agréable. le relationnel avec le propriétaire est excellent, je recommande.
L’emplacement est top, l’ appartement est très sympa , super vue , le matin avec le lever du soleil c’est grandiose.

Schönes und sauberes Apartment in sehr guter Lage. Alfama ist ein schöner Stadtteil mit vielen Restaurants und gut erreichbar. Die Gastgeber:innen waren sehr freundlich und haben sich gut gekümmert. Im Apartment war alles vorhanden, was man so braucht und die Aussicht war einfach grandios. Wir kommen gerne wieder!

We had a great stay in Alfama - the area is gorgeous and the apartment is very easy to find. Everything was as described and reflected the photos. Check-in was easy, as well as check-out. Thanks for a great and easy stay!
Location and apartment was great for our short stay. Everything exactly as listed. Hugo was quick to respond when we had any questions. Overall great stay in Lisbon.
Beautiful apartment in the heart of Alfama with a view of the river! It was perfect for our trip to Lisbon. Would definitely stay there again!

We had a lovely stay in Lisbon and the apartment was ideal for exploring the city! The stairs to get into the apartment were slightly tricky when we had heavy bags but the apartment itself was great. Would definitely recommend.

Hugo’s apartment is modern, clean and has a magnificent view from the living area. It’s centrally located in the heart of Portugal’s Alfama area and walking distance to many of the key sites and attractions. Hugo is a great communicator and an excellent host. He even offered to organise a taxi to the airport for us.
I highly recommend Hugo’s blue house.
Lovely house, nice views, and our hosts were very responsive.
Loved the location and view of the water!
l'appartement d'Hugo et Sylvia est parfait pour un séjour à Lisbonne. très agréable et vraiment cosy avec une vue fantastique. on a adoré.

Das Airbnb von Hugo & Silva ist wirklich sehr zu empfehlen. Die Lage ist zentral im Alfama Viertel von Lissabon in welchem man zu Fuß alles erreichen kann. Es sind tolle Kaffees und Bars rundherum. Die Wohnung war blitzsauber und sehr geräumig. Wir würden jederzeit wiederkommen ! :)

Hugo and Silvia were excellent hosts and very quick to respond to our questions. The location was perfect and very close to all the tourist attractions we wanted to see. The place itself was lovely, clean, and had everything we needed for our stay. We would happily stay at this air bnb again in the future!

Hugo and Sylvia were great hosts great communication and very responsive hosts
Properly is in great location and very quiet would recommend to other guests to stay.

The flat was exactly as described with a fabulous view. Communication was great and check in/out was a breeze. The location was good with everything in walking distance if you don’t mind the hills and steps.
Fabulous location

We loved our stay here, beautiful apartment, such a great area to be based, lots of restaurants and cafes nearby. Hugo was an excellent host, booked a restaurant and taxi for us and was so quick to respond to any queries. Highly recommend
Favorite place so far, very clean and great views.
Wonderful location if you love roaming the alleys of Alfama and finding great food. The flat is lovely, surprisingly quiet, and perfect for our stay.

Tolle Lage mit guten Blick auf den Tejo, mitten drin in der Altstadt. War auch alles sauber & hat insgesamt gut funktioniert.
Gute & freundliche Gastgeber, die wir gerne weiterempfehlen. Die kleine Wohnung ist zwar nicht günstig - dafür kommt man aber auch direkt in Alfama unter, nicht weit entfernt von schönen Sehenswürdigkeiten.
Jederzeit wieder! Grüße aus Köln :-)

This was the perfect Airbnb. Easy to find, super clean, and lots of things to do within walking distance. My boyfriend and I have never been to Portugal and this apartment was in the perfect location. Hugo coordinated Ricardo to pick us up from the airport and dropped us off at Lisbon’s iconic vintage flea market while we waited for our check in as our flight got in very early. Highly recommend this flat!

We stayed at Alfama Blue House for 3 nights.
The apartment was easy enough to find and check in was very easy using the instructions provided. The apartment is situated in Alfama which is a particularly hilly area of Lisbon, but for us this just added to the charm of our stay and made it even more enjoyable. There is so much in a walkable distance of the apartment, we barely used any public transport and still managed to see most what Lisbon has to offer. If however you did want to use public transport then there are Trams and the Metro in close proximity to the apartment too.
The apartment itself is perfect and exactly as described, and it was lovely and clean. It has everything we needed for our stay. There are a few flights of steep stairs to get up to the apartment but once up the view looking over the rooftops is incredible.
This apartment is definitely worth considering for your trip to Lisbon!
Hugo and Silvia were great hosts, thank you for letting us stay!

Wonderful little flat in Alfama. Hugo and Sylvia are great hosts… great communication, very friendly and responsive. They have a great online “guidebook” of restaurants and things to do and were super helpful suggesting a place to store luggage on my last day (left very late). Apartment is charming, clean, in a great location with all the essentials for a stay. Great place and I would highly recommend!

Great place, great view. Hugo greeted us outside of the apartment and gave us some great recommendations of things to do around Lisbon. Space was clean and a good size for a couple traveling. Would stay again!

5 étoiles pour le logement 10 étoiles pour l'hôte et ses efforts pour nous rendre le séjour aussi agréable 😃.
quelque petites choses à savoir sur les environs néanmoins. vous étes au centre de la vieille ville en surplomb de la ville et de la mer qui est trés agreable quand on y est. pour y arriver, préparez vous a monter et descendre pente raide et escalier , largement faisable sans valise mais vite fatiguant sous le soleil d'été donc préparez vous (sandale déconseillé).
pas de transport en commun praticable a coté, le tram a coté est full constamment vu qu'il s'agit d'une attraction touristique tres appreciée. on a tout fait a pied et puis bolt ou uber pour les grands trajet peu onereux pour le service rendu. les supermarchés à coté sont hyper cher mais les restos sont super sympa.
vous voilà prêt , vous ne regretterez pas votre séjour .

The place was in a great central location, walking distance to the castle and short distance to public transport. The hosts always replied in a short amount of time. The apartment was clean. Great place for a stay in Lisbon! Mind the steep stairs if you have mobility issues.
We had a great time at the apartment. The view was fantastic! Very good location in Alfama. Everything was modern and clean.
Good location, clean, comfortable.

Hugo and Sylvia were amazing hosts. The apartment is set in a beautiful location with an amazing view out to the water front. Hugo was super responsive and helpful to get us a local taxi when leaving the apartment.
Three things to note when staying here:
1. Ubers cannot pick-up/drop off passengers in front of the door. They will pick-up/drop you off 1 street over, where you need to climb up/down a set of stairs (~15 steps) to get to the street.
2. Local taxis are better to bring you to the apartment as they’re able to get right in front of the door (thank you Hugo - HUGE help!)
3. Just note that this apartment is on the 3rd floor with some steep steps on the first flight. Plan ahead related to luggage and access to the apartment.
Aside from this, the apartment is worth it if you want a location that is clean, easier to access, and in an ideal location to experience Lisboa!

We so loved our stay at Hugo & Sylvia's! They were just amazing with advice and help and multiple questions at all times of the day! The apartment is perfect - clean, comfortable, with everything you need. The balcony just delightful to stand and watch the world go by.
Lisbon is fabulous, and staying in the Alfama area was the best. The rambling, characterful streets, the bars & restaurants around every corner, and of course local fado. It felt all very authentic and less touristy than other areas. Thank you Hugo & Sylvia for such a memorable stay in Lisbon. The journey from Sydney is long but we'd love to come back!
Très beau séjour chez Hugo et Sylvia. L’appartement est parfait et idéalement situé.

Hugo and Silvia were excellent and proactive hosts. Provided clear and easy instructions for checking in and out, and it was easy to access the flat using the links they provided. Location is great for Alfama and near many restaurants, coffee places, luggage storage, etc. Just keep in mind the area is very hilly and steep so be prepared :). We also had an issue with Ubers trying to pick us up in the morning and had to walk a bit to meet them. Beautiful view of the water from the balcony.
Inside was clean and exact to review. Just keep in mind stairs after going in the main door are very steep. Size of flat is good and having an actual bedroom with a sliding door was great. Obrigada Hugo and Silvia!
Very nice place in the center of Alfama near all amenities. View is incredible. Loved the vibe of the neighbourhood. Would definitely recommend. Obrigado.
Really cute, clean,  great communication and a great location. Hugo and Silvia are wonderful hosts.
Loved staying here! Beautiful view and walkable area. Definitely recommend it, just be mindful of the stairs getting in!
Fantastic location and fabulous apartment!

We loved staying in the Alfama area and Hugo and Silvia's home did not disappoint!  The views of the River were incredible and the hosts were extremely responsive to all of our questions.  I would highly recommend staying in here!

We enjoyed our stay at Hugo and Sylvia’s apartment! It was in a great area, clean, and had a super view! We had a hard time with the door but Hugo replaced battery that day (a few hour later) so the rest of the stay was good! I would still recommend an old school key over electrical door entry system any day! All and all we were happy with our time at their place! I highly recommend this home!

This is a great little apartment with excellent views. The location is perfect for seeing the city and there are great restaurants nearby. The steps up to the flat are steep but not too bad if you don’t have any mobility problems. I would say the place is great for a couple! Thanks Hugo for the great stay

The host answered my questions quickly and was very supportive and helpful during my stay. Great recommendations were given.
It was very clean, I would just recommend you bring your own shampoo and conditioner, as well as toilet paper. Everything else you can think of was provided.
Everything matched the photos and description of amenities.
The area was lively and there were plenty of shops and restaurants hidden throughout the neighborhood, and it was only a short walk to major areas of Lisboa. I loved staying in the Alfama district!
The apartment is in the residential area, so you have to walk about 1 minute to the place from drop off. However, the host called me a taxi that was able to come right up to the door on the morning of my flight.

The property was in the heart of things. lots of restaurants near by. Trams and Ubers easily available, if you cant face the hills. The flat was lovely and bright and had a great view from the window.
As others have said it is up many stairs so you need to be fit. The settee/fold down bed was not very comfortable but it you are out and about this may not bother you. Overall a good place to stay.

Amazing little apartment in the heart of the Alfama. Just beyond the really noisy area but still only a minute or two from pastry and coffee shops. Stunning view of the bay, and beautiful winding streets and alleyways. Lots of stairs, which didn’t bother us but might be a challenge for older guests. Hugo and Silvia were very proactive and friendly in their communication and gave great instructions for check in and helped us find some things we needed in town. Best experience, will be back!
We had a really wonderful stay in this AirBnB. Silvia and Hugo were incredibly helpful and responsive, the location was very central and walkable, and the flat was comfortable!

Hugo is THE BEST, he lives super close and when Google Maps gets you mixed around, Hugo was there to save the day and came looking for me when I needed to check in. I hope no one rents in February because I want the place all to myself when escaping the East Coast Philly winter!!

Hugo’s place was exactly as listed. Perfect area for visiting Lisbon. Can walk to everything if one wants…the famous tram 28 is literally a 1 minute walk to catch right into the heart of Lisbon. Hugo was a perfect host and most helpful. Highly recommend.

Hugo and Silvia’s place is terrific. Well designed, really comfortable and great location. It is up 3 steep flights of stairs so getting luggage up can be challenging but Hugo met me there and carried it up which was so kind. Strongly recommend staying here!
Es war alles super: Wohnung, Ausblick, Sauberkeit, Kontakt mit Hugo…wir empfehlen diese Wohnung zu 100%!

We loved this place! highly recommended:) such a stunning view we felt so calm and relaxed and the check-in process is great. love the early check-in and late check out. located in a quiet yet well located part of time. such a great way to start off our trip, thanks Hugo and Silvia.
We loved this place. We only wish we could’ve stayed longer.

Petit, mais fonctionnel. Trois étages de marches un peu raides, mais comme l’a dit Hugo, c’est le prix à payer pour une aussi belle vue sur le Tage. Il a d’ailleurs eu la gentillesse de nous accueillir en personne et nous a aidé à monter nos bagages. Hugo nous a donné des indications sur les environs et les secteurs à visiter et s’est occupé de réservé un taxi pour notre départ tôt le samedi matin! Un hôte hors pair!

The view was amazing. Hugo
Was so quick to get back to us when we were lost. Loved the service as well as the apartments location. Very much recommend.
Nice, clean, comfortable place to stay in a historic part of the city.  Looks just like the pictures.  Steep stairs to get the apartment, but the view and place are worth the climb every time.

We enjoyed staying at Hugo and Silvia’s place. The apartment is modern, beautifully decorated and sparkly clean. The best location in Alfama with amazing views. The only problem would be very steep staircase leading to the 3d floor, that is difficult to climb with luggage. So pack light if you can!
Happy to recommend this place to Lisbon travelers.

Hugo and Silvia are wonderful hosts! Clear instructions and very responsive. The apartment is just as described with beautiful views. Located on a quiet street but walking distance to all the sights and many restaurants. We loved the Alfama neighborhood. Highly recommend!
Beautiful space! Felt very homey! Close to everything :) thank you for being a great host and making our stay in Lisbon pleasant and unforgettable!!!! Recommend this flat to friends and family!

The apartment has great views and is very clean. The steps are steep to get into the apartment so please keep that in mind! It was not a problem for me though and I enjoyed walking around the neighborhood. I also went to some of the restaurants recommended by Hugo and Silvia and they were amazing!! I would stay here again :)

We had a wonderful time in this lovely apartment. It is in the middle of Alfama and you have lots of nice restaurants, bars and cafés just a few steps away. It is a great location to explore the city as you can walk almost everywhere. The apartment is very comfy and well equipped and has a wonderful view over the rooftops and the river. Communication with Hugo was perfectly helpful, fast and very friendly. Would love to come back some time!
Great place in Alfama district!

This is a nice appartment in the historic part of Lisbon. The appartment was quiet and close to the centre of town. It had lovely views over the sea. Only thing missing was a kettle.
Not suitable for people with mobility issues due to the hills and steps in the area and the steep stairs in the building.
Hugo and Silvia were very prompt with any communication that we had.

Hugo & Silvia’s place is excellent. It is exactly as described and in a wonderful neighbourhood with loads of amenities on your doorstep. Lovely views from the Juliette balcony. It is clean and tidy, and felt very secure with their superb door locking system. There are solid wooden shutters to keep the light out for anyone sleeping in the living room.
The only downside was the sofa bed which was extremely uncomfortable. It is uneven and lumpy with a huge dip down the centre where the sofa folds down and is not really fit for an adult to sleep on, so I didn’t get a good night’s sleep unfortunately.
My friend who slept in the bedroom had an excellent sleep and the bedroom room / bed was very comfortable indeed.
For one person / a couple this apartment is perfect. We especially liked the quality of the bedding / towels :)
Lovely bijou apartment in great area for exploring Lisbon
Appartement magnifique, très bien placé. Je recommande !

Schöne Wohnung mit tollem Ausblick auf den Fluss im Herzen von Alfama!
Wer die steile Treppe hinauf nicht scheut, kann von hier aus gut Lissabon entdecken. Küche ausreichend eingerichtet, Wohnung sauber

This is a great place in the beautiful, historic Alfama neighborhood of Lisbon! We appreciated how clean and affordable this unit was. The hosts are great, and the view was incredible. It was nice to have a living area, plus a well-stocked kitchen. We stayed for 3 nights on the tail end of our Portugal/Azores trip and had no complaints. Lisbon is a massive city, and we really enjoyed the quaint character of this area of the city with its narrow, winding cobblestone streets and charming houses, some with the famous blue tiles. We were able to walk or take public transport to all of the tourist destinations. Overall, we would recommend Alfama, and this particular unit on a trip to Lisbon.
Schönes Apartment, ruhige Umgebung, nette Gastgeber

We had an amazing time here in this cute apartment in the historic part of the city!  The host was very helpful both during check in and throughout our stay! They were very responsive to all our needs and accommodated us when needed. We found the location to be perfect for us. I would definitely recommend this place for anyone wanting to explore all Lisbon has to offer!

Die Wohnung war für uns perfekt. Alles war tiptop sauber und hat auf uns einen sehr gepflegten Eindruck gemacht. Die Aussicht aus der Wohnung ist toll und hat zu unserem Urlaubserlebnis beigetragen. Die Lage ist sehr praktisch und wir würden auf jeden Fall wieder kommen.
Un espacio lleno de poesía. Alfama es hermoso y donde se encuentra este apartamento se une a lo hermoso del lugar.
superbe appartement avec une très jolie vue, dans un quartier calme mais proche des restaurants et autres activités.
alles okay, wie beschrieben
Great place, great location. Stayed there a couple of times before.  Accurate description, reliable. Hosts keep it up over years. Many thanks for everything.

Je recommande à 100% ! Annonce fidèle à la réalité.
Très bien situé et à proximité des principales lignes de transport.
Appartement très cosy et fonctionnel. Bonne exposition. Cuisine bien équipée.
Excellente communication avec Hugo. Nous avons passé un excellent séjour. Merci
A lovely apartment in a lovely part of Lisbon. The location and comfort made pur stay even more pleasurable. Hugo and Silvia helpful and polite. A joy to deal with

Inizio difficoltoso con problemi di serratura, ma Hugo è stato estremamente veloce e dispinibile.
Tutto molto bello e pittoresco! Se non fosse che c'è tanto altro da vedere in giro per il mondo, penso ci torneremmo!

The stay was immaculate and completely worth it. The view from the flat is unbeatable and was the cherry on top of a really nice stay. If you can… stay here! Hugo and Silvia are wonderful hosts. 5 stars!

We spent four nights at Hugo and Silvia's place, where we instantly felt at home. Even though it was our first time in Lisbon, we feel we couldn't have found a better location as Alfama for this stay. There is a lot to see within walking distance or going around with tram 28. We followed some of the good recommendations provided by our hosts for restaurants. One that is not on the list but certainly should be is the excellent Antiga Wine Bar (especially for seafood). The apartment, Alfama, and Lisbon were really above our expectations. Thank you!

Can't fault this beautiful flat in the very stunning Alfama.
The view alone is worth every penny and the apartment is smart and modern but still homely and absolutely spotlessly clean. Everything provided and great communication. A beautiful and peaceful area to explore Lisbon from.
Thanks again.

We had a wonderful time in Lisbon! Getting back to the flat after a full day of walking and sightseeing was nice. The flat had everything we needed, and located in a quiet street in Alfama. Thank you to Hugo and Silvia for their friendliness, they are great hosts.
The apartment was in a beatiful location. We had a very pleasant stay at this cozy apartment with a beautiful view 🥰

First, let me start off by saying the view from the flat was absolutely stunning. This was my first time in Portugal, & I was not disappointed. Hugo & Silvia were very responsive. I would use them again.
Great stay and hosts, highly recommend!
非常好的房子，当地的司机都说我们的选择是非常棒的。周边都是好吃的餐馆，而且很安全。谢谢房顶的热情招待。

Très bon séjour dans l’appartement de Hugo et Sylvia. La qualité du transfert aéroport a grandement facilité notre arrivée (merci Ricardo !). Ce séjour nous donne envie de revenir dans cette belle ville chaleureuse et accueillante.
Host was very nice, and the check in was very flexible. The view was amazing and I would definitely come back to Lisbon again!

A perfect, bright place to stay for a couple or solo traveller in one of the best neighborhoods of Lisbon. Well stocked with and close to key amenities and there is a stunning view from the balcony. Sleep was peaceful after days of sightseeing. The apartment is walkable to various beautiful vistas, tourist sites and lively  local spots.  Hugo was an incredible host who is helpful, kind and responsive.

We had a very good experience with the apartment of Silvia and Hugo. Located in Alfama, it is very close to the famous tram line 28 and to the main areas in Lisbon. The apartment is easy to find and the check in is very easy. The apartment is clean and tidy, and it overlooks the district of Alfama and has a beautiful view of the sea and port. The only aspects worth mentioning are that there is no escalator in the house; the apartment is located in the 3rd floor (which was no issue to us), and that the couch was not that comfortable. Other than that, I can 100% recommend the apartment.
Parfait ! Très propre avec une bel vue

This Airbnb was absolutely amazing! The location couldn't have been more perfect and although the stairs up to the apartment were a bit steep, the views made it all worth it. The host was super helpful and made sure we had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. Highly recommend this place!
A great stay in a great location. Very good communication from host

Très beau séjour dans l’appartement de Hugo et Silvia. Lieu très propre et belle ambiance. Malgré que l’appartement soit centrale, le lieu est très silencieux la nuit :) Je recommande vivement cet appartement!

An excellent apartment with all the amenities, in a brilliant location. The shower was exceptional, and the apartment was spotlessly clean. We had a very comfortable stay, and got very fit climbing the stairs!

This flat is lovely. Bright, well decorated, clean and welcoming. My absolute favourite thing was the shower. The shower was awesome!
I also loved the view of the river and the rooftops, the way the sunlight poured through the windows, the cute little kitchen and the fact the location was walkable to lots of important and interesting places.
Host communication was good - pre trip I'd messaged with a question but I hadn't heard back 24 hrs later and had to chase BUT while I was on the trip, everything was absolutely fine. I only messaged once with a few question about items in the flat. The questions were answered in a timely fashion and I didn't need to contact the host again. The flat has everything you could possibly need!
The steps to the flat (and around Lisbon) are a lot. You definitely need to be fit, but it's worth it for the fantastic views. Thank goodness for lovely Ricardo, the driver who picked me up from the airport. He was a huge help. Thanks, Ricardo :)

Lovely little flat for a couple. But if two people need to share, sofa bed not the most comfortable. The stairs are extremely steep.
Great location for little tavernas and fado. Very central location and beautiful views. Quiet at night time.
Easiest way from airport is train to Oriente and then to San Apolonia

Hugo’s place is very nice. We felt very comfortable in his apartment. The area is great to walk around, have great brunch and dinner ☺️
Communication with Hugo is amazing. He response super quickly and helps out for every question we had. Absolutely great service.
Only thing to mention which was a bit difficult was bringing up a big luggage as the stairs in the building are very narrow BUT each guest can see it as a little workout and it’s only two floors ☺️

Nous avons passé un très agréable séjour dans l'appartement de Hugo et Silvia.
Il est très bien placé dans le quartier de l'ALFAMA. Beaucoup de restaurants et magasins proches de l'appartement.
L'appartement est agréable à vivre et très lumineux avec une belle vue sur le Tage.
Hugo a été très réactif quand on lui a posé des questions et on le remercie.
Je recommande cet appartement.
Highly recommend this lovely place in the Alfama, close to everything, quiet with a great view. Loved it!
Great spot! We only stayed there for a day but it was really good experience. The place was nice and clean and close to a lot of stuff. Totally worth it.

Hugo & Silvia, were so helpful and finding someone to pick us up at the airport to the appartement, on arrival Hugo provided us we all the information we needed, the appartement was impeccably clean and equipped with everything we needed for our stay.
Everything was easily accessible from their location I highly recommend their Airbnb.
Bel appartement tres accessible depuis le metro ou la fameuse ligne 28 !

We had a great stay and loved the location! Would definitely return, I threw my back out night one so the furniture was a little uncomfortable for me but I’m not sure even a soft comfortable couch would do. Loved the view of the river in the morning watching the cruise ships dock and leave in the evening
A lovely apartment which we enjoyed staying at

We enjoyed our stay at the Alfama Blue House!  We were glad we choose this part of Lisbon to stay. It was a convenient, quiet location with great restaurants and views of the city. The host was very responsive with recommendations.  The guide book provided was helpful too. The place was clean, comfortable, and super cute.  Shower pressure was great and the layout of the flat was very functional.

Hugo and Silvia’s place was as described. It’s clean and quiet, but also near shops and restaurants in Alfama. We loved the area! Tram station is a 2 min walk away so it’s convenient to get to other tourist attractions. The hosts were very communicative as well. Their guide to Lisbon was very helpful so be sure to check it out!
As some of the other reviews mention, stairs up the apartment are very narrow so pack accordingly!
Endroit bien situé, très propre. Support rapide de Hugo lors de questions ou besoins

Hugo and Silvia’s place is charming! It is in the Alfama neighborhood of Lisbon with cobblestone streets and narrow sidewalks, but we loved the ambience of being higher above this beautiful city. Hugo checked in to make sure we had everything we needed. The views from the balcony are stunning. We felt most comfortable there. Also, many restaurants and cafes are nearby. We loved The Copenhagen Coffeehouse not too far away!

This is a nice, clean, quiet Airbnb in a great location to explore Lisbon. Everything went smoothly checking in and out and we didn’t have any issues during our stay. The steps to the apartment are very steep so probably not the best place if you have any mobility issues. However, it was fine for us and lovely to have a view of the rooftops and river. Lisbon is a brilliant city with so much to do that we will definitely be back!

hugo was totally brilliant at helping us to find the apartment and gain entry. He was utterly charming and excellent at communicating with us. The apartment had everything you could need and in a lovely location with a great view.
Thanks Hugo for a lovely time.
Soggiorno fantastico! L’appartamento era in posizione centrale, molto pulito e ordinato corrispondente alla descrizione. La vista mozzafiato! Hugo e Silvia cordiali e disponibili
Loved this place! Right in the heart of Alfama. Hugo was always available to help and check-in was a breeze. We highly recommend this AIRBNB!! Hope to come back soon.

A great apartment in the Alfama district! The taxi from the airport took us right to the front door. Hugo met us and let us check in a bit early. Nice to have the 2:00 pm arrival time. Clean, nicely decorated, great shower, comfortable bed and nice linens. Beautiful view and sunny apartment! Nice to have a functioning air conditioner for those hot Lisbon days. Breakfasts at Copenhagen coffee lab 5 mins away were delicious. 20 minute walk to the main square or train station. Glad we were fit for all those hills! Thanks again Hugo and Sylvia for a great stay!

Hugo’s place was a great choice. The location in Alfama is great, a couple of steps away from the Santa Luzia and Portas  da Sol but in a secluded street where you really get to experience what Alfama is about. The system to get in and out of the apartment worked perfectly and was convenient. The apartment is beautiful and comfortable and it was very clean. Hugo was very friendly and communicative.

Hugo and Silvia’s apartment was a little smaller than expected, however, very clean and within walking distance to all the restaurants in Alfama. Just be sure you know that some Ubers can not drive into the area of the apartment but will drop you off as close as possible. Some of my Ubers were able to actually drop me off in front. Nonetheless, the place was amazing with great views. Will definitely stay again. Hugo and Silvia were great hosts.

Great place to stay in the heart of Alfama; best neighbourhood in Lisbon. This top floor apartment has amazing views of the ocean and is really well set up with everything. It’s a hop skip away from the coolest spots and is private, peaceful and secure. Hugo & Silva are great hosts; helpful, responsive and kind.

The apartment was clean, quiet, and located in a beautiful neighborhood.
Self check-in was easy and convenient when arriving late.
The hosts were responsive and a pleasure to deal with :)

Nice apartment, very cute view, clean and as advertised! Nice area in Alfama. Ubers/taxis indeed cannot drop you directly in front of the apartment, but they will drop you about 1 street over and its about a 2min walk (many of the streets in Alfama are simply too small for cars or are only accessible to locals who live in the area).
beautiful spot in a beautiful neighborhood
J’ai passé un super moment chez vous et au Portugal donc je reviendrais !

The Alfama Blue House was perfect: super clean, well equipped and tastefully furnished. The apartment is in the Alfama quartier, in the real hearth of Lisbon. We've loved this quartier.
Hugo was always available, responsive and kind.
I truly recommend!

Como en casa!! Un apartamento acogedor, con todo lo necesario, cómodo (la cama especialmente), limpio y ordenado. Lo mejor, sin duda, sus vistas y la localización, en pleno barrio de alfama que, para quien conozca Lisboa sabe que es un barrio con mucho encanto, animado y muchas cuestas también (no recomiendo maletas grandes si vais en coche como nosotros pues el acceso se complica) si vas en avión, Hugo te ofrece desde el principio el traslado y eso es de agradecer.
Solamente un detalle a tener en cuenta, que para nosotros no es problema, pero no tiene ascensor.
Hugo and Silvia’s flat felt right at home. Very clean, organized, and well described. Location was good. I had no trouble walking to most of my destinations. Would definitely stay here again!

Really lovely apartment in Lisbon. Good instructions for self-check in. We spent two days in Lisbon and really enjoyed the location. Old charming building with everything you need for a comfortable stay. Can warmly recommend Hugo and Silvias apartment. Good hosts👌🏼
Lovely place thank you !!
Great place in a great area. Hugo was very quick to respond to all of our questions and queries. Would recommend.
Great private place, highlyrecommended.

Hugo and Silvia’s space made my first time in Lisbon absolutely perfect! It was such a cozy and clean apartment, the kitchen was so well equipped for quick, easy meals, and the view overlooking the river and the rooftops was breathtaking.  Hugo went above and beyond to make sure my sister and I were well taken care of by being one of the most communicative Airbnb hosts I’ve ever met! It was a bit of a struggle to find the apartment on our own since Ubers don’t have access to the tight, pedestrian streets of Alfama, but Hugo absolutely saved us by instantly responding to my messages  and virtually guided my sister and I to the right building. Thank you so much for making us feel so welcome, for recommending good places to eat, and for even researching a hemming place in Alfama for us! I truly can’t wait to be back. MUITO obrigado!🙏🏼

Great location near main parts of town but still quiet. Felt very safe.
Place is very clean, modern amenities and very comfortable.
It’s in an older building so there are quite steeper stairs getting in and out, but that’s just like the rest of an old city!

We had an amazing stay at Hugo’s place. It was conveniently located and many cafes and restaurants were nearby. It was clean and had everything we needed. We loved the view of the ocean from the living room. I would definitely stay there again if visiting Lisbon!

The apartment was really nice and the location fantastic. Alfama is a really relaxing and beautiful neighbourhood away from the hustle and bustle of Bairro Alto. Hugo was a very responsive host and was there if we needed anything. The view from the apartment is so good and you can watch the boats sail along the river. There is a nice bar called Santa Pausa nearby and Copenhagen Coffee Lab is good for breakfast also nearby (5 minute walk). If you want to try a new cuisine (Mozambique), Roda Viva (2 min walk) is so tasty - get the shrimp curry! Thanks Hugo & Silvia!
Great place to base yourself to explore Lisbon. Friendly and responsive host

We enjoyed our stay in beautiful Alfama! Lovely apartment with a view of the river. Very cozy. Walking distance from restaurants, bus, tuk tuks, the 28E tram. Hugo & Silvia recommended Ricardo from Funny tours for our transfer from the airport. Great way to start in Lisbon! He was very helpful and communicative.
Definitely bring your walking shoes for Lisbon!
Also helps to have smaller luggage for stairs and cobblestones. Lots of treasured memories! We’ll be back!

Hugo and Silvia’s place was one of the best airbnbs my partner and I have stayed at. It was incredibly clean and tidy. The location in Alfama was great and Hugo provided lots of great restaurant recommendations.
Hugo was so responsive and helpful. We had some trouble locating the Airbnb because our Uber dropped us off at the wrong location. Hugo immediately answered the phone and guided us to his place. He even allowed us to check in early. The room was impeccably clean with strong air conditioning. The kitchen had everything we needed.
Highly recommend staying here!!!
Confortevole, pulito e in posizione fantastica. Hugo e Silvia sono gentili e accoglienti. Consigliatissimo!
Great place! Lots of culture! Felt right in the middle of all the happenings!
Good location. The house is clean. The house owner’s reply is always on time. Good place to stay in Lisbon

Die Unterkunft von Hugo und Silvia kann man wirklich von Herzem empfehlen.
Ein sehr schönes, modernes und süßes Appartement in sehr zentraler Lage und mit toller Aussicht aufs Wasser.
Auch die Kommunikation mit den Beiden war sehr gut.
Bereits vor unserer Anreise haben sie uns proaktive kontaktiert und waren immer für Fragen da. Antworten bekam man super schnell.
Zusätzlich haben sie auch noch einen Airbnb lissabon guide mit den ein oder anderen guten Restaurant tipps.
Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und würden diese Unterkunft gerne wieder buchen.

Hugo was awesome and very responsive. Had taken care of my transfer from the airport with Ricardo from Funny Tours, who was amazing as well. Hugo also held my luggage for me while they were cleaning the Apt so so it was awesome! Thank you for everything! Will be back soon!

We had a wonderful stay, Alfama Blue House is a real gem in the Alfama. Clean, bright, very convenient location with many sightseeing spots and public transport nearby (including famous tram 28). The view from the small balcony over the Alfama and the Tagus River (Tejo) is amazing. Although we didn't use the kitchen a lot as there many restaurants and cafés in short walking distance, it is well equipped.
The apartment is modern, nicely decorated and well-kept. Hugo and Silvia are easy to communicate, they provided several recommendations including the Funny Tours transfer service from the airport. Ricardo, the driver, was very helpful, great service, easy communication, perfectly on time.
Excellent place. Desirable location right in the heart of the charming Alfama neighborhood - great views. Very clean also!

We loved staying at this apartment! It was a perfect location for us, easily walkable to two metro stations, great restaurants, and so many of the places we wanted to visit. There was plenty of space to relax, with a nice, clean bathroom and good sized, well-equipped kitchen. Hugo was very responsive, and helpful with restaurant suggestions. We enjoyed staying on the third floor and being able to look out over the rooftops, but do be aware that the steps in these old buildings are steep. It was not a problem for us at all. If we get back to Lisbon, we would definitely stay here again!
Great Experience waking up in Lisbon
Excellent emplacement en plein du quartier Alfama ; Accueil très  professionnel et réactif. Parfait pour partir à la découverte de Lisbonne et de ses ruelles labyrinthiques

We loved our visit to Lisbon! Hugo’s apartment was exactly as described and in such a scenic location in the old town. Very close to all the sights in the area and very easy to get around the city as a whole via tram, metro or walking. Highly recommend this as your base when in Lisbon, we would definitely return 🙌🏻

Had an absolutely AMAZING stay at Hugo and Silvia’a place. It was a perfect location and such a great spot in Lisbon. Really well located to so many amazing spots. Hugo was incredibly responsive. He organized an airport pickup for us that was PHENOMENAL. I would recommend every single part of this stay to anyone looking! Thank you!!

Great spot for a solo female traveler in Alfama! I felt really safe there. Beautiful views! Very quiet at night. Modern kitchen and bath. You’ll need cellular data to get into the place the first time and be willing to climb stairs. Totally worth it!
We had a lovely stay. The apartment was great with good views. Everything was available that we needed. Would definitely recommend this apartment to others. Thank you for a lovely stay.

Eine tolle Unterkunft, sehr zentral und alles gut zu erreichen!
Hugo ist sehr freundlich und antwortet eigentlich immer quasi sofort :) Wenn wir wieder in Lissabon sind werden wir auf jeden Fall nochmal kommen - definitiv eine Empfehlung!
A really well kept apartment. All amenities worked well. Close to all the action.

The Alfama is a great home base for visiting Lisbon.  We explore the city but often found ourselves wanting to just spend more time explore the alleys of Alfama. Hugo is very responsive and checked in often leading up to our arrival and departure.  The bed was very comfortable.  The view can't be described, even in a photo.  We loved opening the doors to listen to the sounds of the neighborhood and even the cruise ships docking along the river.  The flights of stairs are no joke with your luggage but totally worth it! We would definitely stay again upon a return to Lisbon.

This is really a fantastic find in the heart of Alfama! Nice and quiet and I felt very safe staying there as a solo traveler. Plenty of cafes you can walk to nearby. The view of the river is gorgeous from the little balcony although sometimes cruise ships are docked right there so that kind of blocks your view of the water. Other than that it’s perfect.

The stay in the apartment was lovely. Perfectly clean and tidy and Hugo was always very responsive if we had any issues.
A huge plus was the fully kitted out kitchen making it easy for us to do any cooking necessary.
Great Airbnb to stay! Totally recommend. Very clean, great location and absolutely great host!
Un emplacement de choix dans Afalma, Une vue magnifique! Un appartement coquet et bien complet offrant toutes les commodités nécessaires pour vivre un moment magique à Lisbonne.

Alles har gestimmt, sauber, Küche komplet ausgestattet und modern.
Alfama Gegend sehr schön und und zu Fuß kann man viele Sehenswürdigkeiten erreichen. Alles in allem geldwert.

Die Wohnung von Hugo können wir zu 100% empfehlen. Alles war wie beschrieben, die Kommunikation mit Hugo war perfekt. Die Wohnung war blitzsauber und wir haben die Aussicht jeden Tag genossen. Wir haben sehr viel zu Fuß unternommen, wir sind allerdings sehr gut zu Fuß. Das sollte man in dem Stadtviertel auch sein. Uns haben die engen und vielen Gassen sehr gefallen. Jeden Abend haben wir nette portugiesische Lokale in Alfama entdeckt und haben immer sehr gut gegessen. Lissabon ist auf jeden Fall eine Reise wert und wir werden Hugo weiterempfehlen. Toll war auch der organisierte Transfer mit Ricardo vom Flughafen, da wir schon morgens 8.30 Uhr angekommen waren. Er hat unser Gepäck verwahrt und es später in die Wohnung hochgetragen. Besser geht es nicht. Für Ricardo gibt es 5 Extra Sterne. Vielen Dank für alles Hugo.
Alfama Blue House was a perfect base in Lisboa. Clean, bright, fantastic location with a beautiful view of the river. Would definitely recommend and hope to return ourselves.

Alfama Blue House I is the best Airbnb we have stayed in a month while visiting Portugal. Bright, clean, quite and with beautiful river view. Hugo greeted us and helped with luggages, thanks. very responsive and easy to communicate. the place just felt like home away from home.
Everything was exactly as expected:)
Wir haben uns in der gemütlichen und hellen Wohnung sehr wohl gefühlt und es war die perfekt passende Unterkunft für vier Nächte in Lissabon.

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour dans l'appartement de Silvia et Hugo. Idéalement situé en plein cœur de l'Alfama. Nous avons adoré la vue sur le Tage depuis l'appartement. Attention seulement à l'ouverture de la porte du bas, nous nous sommes fait reprendre par une voisine quant au bruit. Très satisfait de notre séjour,l'appartement est fonctionnel.

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour dans l’appartement d’Hugo et Sylvia idéalement situé pour visiter Lisbonne.
Calme et propre, très bien équipé et décoré avec goût, nous nous sommes sentis comme chez nous.
Une vue imprenable sur le Tage et le magnifique quartier de l’Alfama.
Nous ne pouvons que vous recommander ce superbe hébergement pour votre futur voyage.

Die Wohnung von Hugo & Silvia ist blitzsauber, gepflegt, sehr ruhig gelegen und entspricht genau den Bildern. Die Aussicht ist super und die Lage ideal für einen Städtetrip, wenn man gut zu Fuss ist.  In den Gassen von Alfama hat es viele Restaurants und Bars.  Sehenswürdigkeiten sind von der Wohnung aus  gut erreichbar mit allen möglichen Transportmitteln oder zu Fuss. Hugo hat jederzeit schnell geantwortet, wenn Fragen auftauchten. Einige Tipps von Hugo & Silvia konnten wir testen und waren begeistert.

très beau logement très bien équipé idéalement situé dans Alfama!
un hôte hyper sympathique et très réactif
le seul tout petit bémol est l'ouverture de la porte 😀 la ère fois

Die Wohnung liegt sehr zentral in der Altstadt. Für den Check-in braucht man das Handy, das war für uns anfangs etwas ungewöhnlich , wir mussten uns erst daran gewöhnen. Lissabon ist eine wunderbare Stadt und Hugo und Silvia sind bei Fragen sofort erreichbar. Diese Unterkunft ist sehr zu empfehlen

appartamento in alfama comodo alla metro , al treno e ai bus
Ottima soluzione a Lisbona
Great location, peaceful surroundings, very sunny and bright place.

We absolutely loved our stay here, its the perfect location, close to everything but also quiet too. Hugo was quick to respond to any questions and really helpful. The bed was comfortable and its a great view.  We would definitely stay here again!

Lovely flat in the middle of a beautiful historic neighbourhood. The view of the river is so picturesque and everything was spotlessly clean.
Hugo was super helpful and friendly - we had a really great stay. Thank you
L'emplacement du logement est parfait pour visiter Lisbonne. L'appartement est bien équipé et propre.

Booked this property seeing the reviews on AirBnB and it matched what people had written about the host Hugo. He is a great guy and flexible. Let us check in early and was kind enough to carry heavy luggage for us to the apartment.
The apartment is in Alfama the old town. The inside is newly done and it looked great. Only you need to climb some steep & narrow stairs with Big Luggage. I was expecting the same based on the reviews so mentally prepared :-)
Hugo showed us around the house and showed the nearby restaurants and places. He was very responsive and easy to communicate in English. Apartment has all the necessary amenities for cooking as well. Great WIFI!!
I would HIGHLY RECOMMEND Hugo's Place to anyone who want to feel the Old City Charm BUT Vibrant Inside as well. Thanks Hugo!!

We enjoyed our stay in Alfama! Such an interesting historic piece of the city. Definitely the quieter older part of the city. Make sure you pack your walking shoes. The Airbnb it’s self is well decorated and has everything you need. It is small but what can you expect from an 18th century building. Hugo was an amazing host. Great experience in Lisbon!

I had a wonderful stay and Hugo and Silvia's place in Alfama! You can't beat the location! I was amazed at the view out the window and the place is so close to the main areas of Lisbon. Hugo and Silvia were extremely thoughtful and responsive especially with my confusion at first getting in. Do be prepared that Ubers may have a hard time getting to this location due to the narrow streets. It was not a problem for me to quickly walk up the stairs to a wider street. Overall I highly recommend Hugo and Silvia's place. I felt safe and comfortable as a solo traveler.

My husband and I enjoyed staying at the apartment. Excellent view. Great location with local restaurants and mini markets nearby. Very quiet at all time. Hugo was very quick to respond and provided very good service. Will stay here again when we are in town next time.

Hugo was a great host, super responsive and helpful. Check-in was super easy, everything was phone based so make sure you have a phone with working internet. Location was in a beautiful local neighborhood with lots of charm - note that there is a lot of walking up and down stairs, so make sure you’re ready to get those steps in if you’re staying in this neighborhood!
הדירה והמארחים נחמדים ונעימים
Très bel appartement,  bien équipé et propre, au top!  Emplacement parfait pour visiter Lisbonne et les alentours.  Merci Hugo

We wished we had more than one night at Hugo’s and Silvia’s! It was a perfect launching point for us. The apartment is extremely clean, comfortable, well located, and quiet. Hugo was very responsive and welcoming.

The place of Hugo and Silvia is absolutely wonderful! Everything was perfect! The apartment is stylish, cosy, clean with a lovely small balcony viewing the city and the shore. The check in and check out process was very convenient and easy! We are very grateful for the time we spent at this place. The location is also perfect: in the centre but without any noises at night. What is more, the owners are very friendly and helpful! It was a great experience !! Thank you, Hugo and Silvia!

Alfama is full of old houses which will give you a feel of Lisboa. This house is also within walking distance to the central area of Lisboa, and it is located in a neighborhood full of restaurants and viewpoints. The apartment is compact and there is a small wall separating living room and bedroom.

L’appartamento si trova nel cuore di Alfama, uno dei quartieri più belli e storici di Lisbona.
Vicino ci sono tanti bar, ristoranti, piccoli negozi e a piedi si raggiungono facilmente diverse attrazioni e il fiume.
La casa corrisponde alle foto e ha tutte le dotazioni necessarie per soggiornarci e una bella vista.
Si trova al terzo piano di un palazzo silenzioso, la zona è tranquilla e si dorme indisturbati dai rumori esterni della strada.
Hugo è molto disponibile e gentile, ha sempre risposto alle mie domande in poco tempo e offerto supporto e consigli.
Il check-in è facile e c’è la possibilità di utilizzare due metodi, questo è molto utile nel caso si dovesse scaricare il cellulare tra foto e maps.
Consiglio vivamente questo appartamento per chi vuole visitare Lisbona!
Grazie Hugo & Silvia, alla prossima!

这是我住过的性价比最高的公寓。面积不算很大但非常舒适。每天早晨打开窗都能看到巨大的邮轮。对于旅游者来说，你就住在景点的中心。你可以徒步玩遍Alfama。附近有许多有特色的咖啡馆。最重要的是与Hugo之间完美的沟通。他的回复很及时、周到、耐心，给了我们很大的帮助。唯一遗憾的是，在公寓外面墙上有几个字对于游客不友好。当然这与Hugo无关。非常感谢他们。
This is the most cost-effective apartment I have ever lived in. The area is not very large but very comfortable. Every morning when you open the window, you can see the huge cruise ship. For a tourist, you live right in the center of the attraction. You can walk all over Alfama on foot. There are many characteristic cafes nearby. The most important thing is the perfect communication with Hugo. His reply was timely, thoughtful and patient, which helped us a lot. The only pity is that there are some words on the wall outside the apartment that are not tourist friendly. Of course this has nothing to do with Hugo. Many thanks to them.

The apartment is located in the heart of the Alfama neighborhood.  The distribution of the house is very good and comfortable.  The bed is also very comfortable, which is appreciated after long days of sightseeing in Lisbon.  The host is always attentive to any need.

Hugo & Silvia’s place was right in the heart of the local scenery with lots of local restaurants and bars, small grocery stores and viewpoints to enjoy the amazing views. Check-in was seamless and Hugo was quick to respond to any concerns we had. 100% recommend this location!
Very clean and comfortable space with great view of river and alfama. very convenient location near many shops, bars, and restaurants

Authentic flat in Lisbon’s old neighborhood. Nice, clean flat with an excellent location and view. Narrow steep stairs in the building may be difficult if bags are heavy/large. Friendly, responsive host. Easy to check in and you can open doors from your phone via a link the hosts shares.

I only stayed there for one night. The flat looks beautiful. There is also a great view to the Tejo. The flat is very quiet and centrally located. Hugo responded very quick to my messages. However, I didn‘t like that you needed to fill out a form before arrival and the flat wasn‘t that easy to find at first. Thankfully you can open the doors to the flat with a link Hugo sends you and you will be able to find the doors.

Hugo and Silvia’s Alfama apartment is exactly the home base my wife and I were looking for in Lisbon. Clean, central, surrounded by historic buildings, secure and quiet. I’d recommend their place to any and everybody. I got some kind of bug on the last day of my stay, and we requested if we could check out a little later than what was originally said. At their own inconvenience, rearranging their cleaner’s schedule, they let us stay three extra hours just so I could get a little more rest before going. That’s kindness. Thank you Hugo and Silvia!
Hugo was in constant communication with us before and during our stay. The flat was very clean and in a nice neighborhood. We would definitely recommend booking with Hugo

Nous avons passé un très beau séjour à Lisbonne dans l'appartement d'Hugo. L'appartement était parfait pour nos besoins. Il est bien situé dans ce quartier pittoresque de l'Alfama avec en plus une belle vue sur le Tage. Hugo a répondu rapidement à nos questions. Nous recommandons sans hésitation son appartement.

The apartment is very conveniently located in the heart of Alfama. It is bright, clean, and comfortable. Hugo communicated with us regularly prior to and during our visit, and everything went smoothly. We very much enjoyed our stay.

Great location, this is the area of Lisbon you want to be staying in! Walkable to everything. Beautiful apartment just as shown in the photos. Lots of helpful maps and tourist references in the apartment. Hugo & Silvia were very responsive. You do need to climb 3-4 flights of stairs to get to the beautiful apartment, just a heads up to folks.

Nice apartment close to the center and very responsive hosts. The food recommendations that they provided were great 😋.
If we have to find something negative the only thing that comes to mind was that there wasn’t any shampoo or sugar.
Really lovely flat, great location, amazing view and lovely host.

Had a wonderful stay at Hugo & Silvia’s apartment. Clean, modern, great shower and little view from balcony. Loved the location it was beautiful, lots of stairs in this neighbourhood so keep it in mind if you are a lower mobility level.  Wish there was a comfier couch to relax on but that was fine because we were running around the city most of the time. Check-in requires going online to unlock automatically. Website was easy to use as we purchased a Portugal SIM card at airport but we had trouble accessing Airbnb internationally from our phones (we were locked out due to ‘unusual activity’) so had to use a laptop to do this. Not owner’s fault, just an FYI to know ahead of time that you should purchase data or let hosts know for an alternate arrangement if you won’t have internet access upon arrival! After initial check-in there is a key for front door and code for apartment so very easy access. Amazing stay, would definitely stay again!
Thanks do much for the warmth and hospitality. We felt at home in your apartment. The location is very unique and incomparable to any other part of the city. We love the Alfama streets.

What a great stay in Lisboa! Location is central in Alfama and near the 28 tram. Hugo is great with communication and quickly resolved an issue outside of his control during checkin! Apartment is spacious and has everything you need. One note is that the apartment is up 3 flights of stairs.

Hugo & Silvia’s apartment was everything you want from an Air BnB - it was clean, in a great location with highly communicative hosts.  Can’t wait to come back to Portugal and stay at Hugo & Silvia’s place - it is a hidden gem!
Great apartment and location close to lovely cafes. Be aware that the apartment is up 3 flights of stairs and the first flight is very steep.
Hugo’s apartment was in an easy to access location, the place was very clean, and Hugo gave fantastic recommendations for local food and dining. Highly recommend!

Some advice for the next guests:
- the stairs are quite tricky, especially the first set of around 20. They are narrow and not a lot of space around, so take into account
- everything! is in walking distance, around 15 mins for supermarkets, restaurants, bakeries. Sé cathedral is at around 10-15 mins walking distance, Portas do Sol, Castelo S. Jorge, National Pantheon the same. The tram has a stop just up the stairs from the right and you can take a great pic there in the morning
- for breakfast I suggest Alfama Doce, Quase Cafe
- for an amazing fado experience I recommend O'Corrido. Just book a table and go, trust me.
- take into account the center and the old town is up and downhill, also plenty of stairs that connect streets (Beco), so use the most comfy shoes. You can also use Uber/Bolt which is quite cheap.

The flat was really nice and bright with excellent views, the location was also handy.
Hugo was very helpful and gave us some good tips about the city.
I would stay here again.

Nicely welcomed by hugo! He gave us many tips to enjoy our week end ! The flat was perfect, with a wonderful view on the tage. The flat is well located, you can do and visit many things by foot in the neighbourhood ( the tram 28 is at less than 5 min from the apartment). We spend a wonderful week end ! I recommend it !!!

Really enjoyed our time here. Hugo was extremely friendly and welcoming. Highly recommend. Thank you both for your hospitality and kindness!

This apartment is exactly how it appears on the advert; bright, light and spacious, perfectly located to explore Alfama and Lisbon.

Hugo’s place is exactly as the pictures describe! We had a great view of the river and the rest of Alfama. The apartment was very clean and a good location to see many sites in Lisbon. Hugo also set up a transfer from the airport which was great as Ubers are not allowed within Alfama. Ubers are really cheap in Lisbon and a short walk from the apartment to be picked up. The apartment is located on 3 floor so many stairs - keep this in mind if planning to stay here. Not a big deal for me and my son though!
Lovely apartment in a great location. Perfect for couples

This lovely light apartment is a very well situated place from which to explore Lisbon. Hugo was extremely helpful and responded quickly to my questions. Highly recommended!
Really great stay.  Great place and location.  Hugo was quick to respond and very helpful.  Thanks so much!

Hugo's flat is a dream. It's open, full of light, and is at one of the best locations in Lisboa. The neighborhood is fun, classy, and surprisingly affordable. There are some great cafés nearby. In the evening, you can take a nice walk, hang out at one of the many bars, or even just read on the balcony while enjoying the view. The apartment is only a few minutes away from metro on foot, so other parts of the city are very accessible. And Uber in Lisboa is very cheap. The apartment itself is absolutely beautiful. The decorations have been carefully chosen. The bed is very comfortable and the bathroom is very clean and crisp. Overall, I just felt at home. Hugo was also a fantastic host. He's very friendly and more than happy to answer any questions. Communication with him was easy and pleasant.

Hugo & Silvia’s home was perfect for our stay! The view was amazing and the blue color throughout the house was just what I imagined for our trip to Lisbon. The location was great and it was super easy to get around. Highly recommend!

位置很不错。28路轨道车下站大约2分钟就可以到达；
缺点是上下楼梯以及路上有很多台阶，带着行李不是那么方便。
建议提前和房东沟通好到达时间。
We had a great stay at Hugo and Silvia’s place! They were very accommodating and even worked with us with our early arrival.

Great location in the centre of the old town of Alfama, Lisbon. Minutes from everything and a fantastic sea view.. there isn't much more you can ask for. Hugo is very accommodating and friendly and always willing to help. The stairs up to the flat are steep but it is a hilly town, so you can't complain! Keep up the work.

A lovely apartment in the heart of the incredible Amalfa area of Lisbon. It's the perfect base to explore the old town, with great little bars and restaurants on the doorstep and less than three minutes' walk to the tram stop where you can pick up the historic number 28 tram. The thieves' market (held on Saturdays and Tuesdays) is only five minutes walk away. For a taste of traditional Lisbon life, head to one of the many Fado houses for incredible singing and good food. The hosts (Hugo and Silvia) offer fantastic communication, a wonderfully clean apartment and a home away from home as you explore this bustling, cool and picturesque city.
This location is amazing! Walking distance to everything. We couldn’t have asked for a better place during our stay in Lisbon. Hugo was quick to respond any questions we had.

We stayed here in January and was a great place to explore the Alfama area and take in the views of the passing cruise ships. It is walking distance to a number of restaurants, mini-markets, viewpoints and the main train station. As it is the Alfama area the streets are very narrow and steep, so I would not recommend this area if you have any mobility issues. Also, the unit is up a number of steep and narrow flights of stairs so it can be difficult with luggage.  Again, the one concerns would be for anyone with poor mobility issues otherwise it is a great historical area to stay and a cosy unit. The unit has everything you need and a kitchen to prepare any meals if you wish to stay in. Down near the train station, there are some great restaurants right on the river which I recommend. Hugo is an excellent host and was available for help at any point.
Amazing location with a gorgeous view over the river! It’s a perfect apartment for your stay in Lisbon!

Apartment: clean, cosy, no direct neighbours, beautiful view, next to downtown and the famous tram 28, perfect for lovers ;-)
Hugo: very friendly, professional and cool at the time, respects privacy, answers all kind of questions within a couple of minutes = just a perfect host
Very communicative. The place was great and the location was amazing.

Really great place to stay: everything - the location, value, cleanliness, modern amenities , design, coziness . The view from the balcony is even better then photos, in my opinion. Probably the best airbnb we've stay in so far :-). Would gladly stay again.

Hugo and Silvia's place is beautiful and just as described.  The location in the Alfama neighborhood cannot be beat!  I'm so glad we stayed there.  Thank you Hugo for your help and attention to detail.  I would recommend this place to anyone staying in Lisbon.

Hugo’s apartment is in a great location, you really get a feel for Alfama and soak up the atmosphere of Lisbon. The apartment is clean and well equipped - a great base for exploring Lisbon and the surrounding area.
Enjoy the alfama district in a beautiful and peaceful location! This apartment is very clean and the the host very hospitable.
we will be back. thank you Hugo for everything .

Hugo’s place is right in the heart of Alfama, with easy access to Santa Apolonia train station and all the hot spots of Alfama. Checkin/checkout/communication were a breeze, and the apartment itself is very chic with a stunning view of the bay/river out the living room windows. Lots of local cafes, restaurants and attractions within a short 15min walk. Great place called Galhardo around the corner which I highly recommend popping in for a late night bite and some green wine. Would definitely stay at Hugo’s again when in Lisboa! Cheers, Hugo!

A convenient apartment in a very central location. Despite being in the old part of town, our car (which our hosts suggested) was able to drop us off in front of the door and the location was easy to find. Quiet at night, despite being steps away from bars, restaurants, and live music. Not a large apartment, but the two of us fit comfortably and had everything we needed.

Hugo was the perfect host and the place was delightful and in a great location! The stairs are a bit narrow and steep (like in most traditional Lisbon flats) so just keep it in mind if you are coming with a large suitcase/or struggle to get up stairs but Hugo was great and offered to carry our suitcases up which was really kind of him, but in any case this shouldn't put you off as it means you get a lovely view of the sea! Would definitely recommend!

Absolutely amazing location in the heart of Alfama (Lisbon's Old Town): the view is amongst the best in Lisbon, and Lisbon is full of good view! The only small thing was that the sofa bed was a bit hard. The other double bed was very comfy. All in all it was a great stay.

Eine tolle Wohnung für ein Pärchen. Zentral gelegen und super ruhig. Die Wohnung bietet alles, was man für einen mehrtägigen Aufenthalt benötigt. Die Kommunikation mit dem Vermieter ist perfekt und sehr zuvorkommend. Wir haben uns rundum wohlgefühlt und würden die Wohnung jederzeit wieder buchen.

L’appartement est extrêmement bien situé dans une rue tranquille de l’Alfama . Hugo a, organisé notre accueil et notre départ à l’aéroport, ce qui nous a permis d’arriver et de repartir tranquillement.
Si on ouvre les fenêtres on est bercé par le Fado en début de soirée.
Le ménage a été fait au milieu de notre séjour avec changements de draps et serviettes alors que l’on restait qu’une semaine.
Merci à eux d'avoir contribuée à la réussite de notre voyage.
Comme beaucoup de jeunes aux Portugal ils parlent très bien l'anglais mais hélas pas le français. C'est à nous à nous améliorer.
Les escaliers sont raides mais c'est le prix à payer si on veut dormir à l'Alfama.

Lovely apartment which is actually better than it looks in the pics! Note the steep stairs on the way up to the front door, but if that doesn’t bother you it’s a fabulous place to stay in Lisbon. Hugo was great and always contactable. Thoroughly recommended.

Host was fantastic and place was better than described. Great communication, personal touch, could not have been better! Be aware that apartment is on 3rd floor walk up and the climb is steep  - could be difficult if you have oversized luggage, but well worth it! View of the water from the balcony and if widows are open can hear Fado singing from local tavern. Great location for visiting Lisbon hot spots.  Another plus  - great water pressure in the shower!!
Hugo was a very accommodating host, who goes out of his way to be helpful. The apartment has a beautiful view and is in the heart of the Alfama District.

Hugo was a fantastic host. Great communication, everything was taken care of, he booked us dinner at a restaurant and arranged our taxi to leave. Super responsive to any questions. Thanks so much! (And the place was fantastic. Hanging on the balcony was the favorite part of our trip)

We had a lovely 3 day stay at Alfama Blue House.  So glad we chose to stay in this old area of Lisbon with the lovely view of the river and the sounds of traditional music from the nearby bar in the evenings.  The flat had everything we needed although the stairs are very steep if you have any mobility issues or lots of luggage.  Saying that the whole area is hilly so you get used to it!  Lots to do in Lisbon, we had lovely weather and very easy to walk to the main centre and the local metro and railway station.  Hugo arranged our transfer from the airport to the door and it is definitely worth booking as saves stress and time.  We were met by Hugo who showed us round the flat and gave us lots of tips.  Have no hesitation in recommending.

A very pleasant stay in a very nice flat with instructions for the equipment in the flat and a guide to help you settle into the flat and the area. One thing to be aware of is for those who have mobility difficulties some of the local streets have steep slopes  as do the initial set of stairs in the entrance to the property. I would highly recommend the flat.
Great place, amazing view and host.
Great place!

Wonderful! The location of this flat is absolutely perfect! We were able to walk to almost every sight we wanted to see, but there is a tram stop very close which was also convenient! The apartment itself was very comfortable and perfect for our needs. And the views are spectacular!

Really nice place located at the historical part of Lisbon.

Great location in the old part of town close to everything. Newly renovated space where everything works. Great hosts. Be ready to climb a narrow, steep staircase but then again stairs and hills are part of Lisbon!
Amazing apartment. Hugo is an outstanding guest. Will repeat for sure.

Appartement idéalement situé (toutes commodités à proximité), belle vue sur le Tage, propreté irréprochable, bien équipé, très calme

We can recommend the apartments without any doubts!
This is a wonderful apartment in a great location. It was clean, well appointed and quiet.  It also boasts a beautiful water view. I would absolutely stay here again.

We loved staying at Hugo and Silvia's place! Hugo personally welcomed us and was always quick to respond with messages. We would absolutely recommend staying here to anyone!

Our stay was perfect. Wonderful flat. Really well equiped and a fantastic view. Communication was easy and fast. Highly recommended :D

AMAZING location in Alfama, with a fun little view of the water over the city! Super clean place, comfortable bed, and very nice host! Nice and clean apartment in Alfama. Host was communicative and very helpful. Beware that there are many stairs in the area, so if you have any trouble walking it may not be ideal, but for us it was great. View and breeze in the morning especially were nice

Don't hesitate to book this location.  The owners are thoughtful, helpful and they care about your comfort.  I will definitely go back!!

Great apartment in the heart of Alfama. The photos actually don't do the view justice. It is the perfect backdrop over breakfast or a nightcap. Very good host! We really enjoyed our stay at this apartment and the view is breathtaking!!

Perfect location, close to everything in Alfama.   Our hosts were amazing, they arranged for transportation from the airport and to our tour that we booked after we left their place. Communication is on point, great recommendations to eat and drink.

Amazing views from the flat, super clean inside, warm welcome from Hugo's friend late in the night as Hugo had to leave early the next morning. The only downside is that there is no elevator in the old building but the stay was great in total.

Merci Hugo et Sylvia pour cet excellent séjour. L'appartement était parfait ainsi que l'organisation aller-retour pour l'aéroport, merci d'ailleurs à Joachim pour sa disponibilité!
Très joli appartement dans l'ancien quartier de Lisbonne!
Hugo’s apartment is lovely, bright and very clean. It has the best location with an amazing view. We couldn‘t have made a better choice!
Hugo’s apartment in the centre of Alfama is a special place to be staying. The view over the dense city and the clear river is spectacular. With Hugo’s local tips your journey will be unforgettable.

I would definitely recommend Hugo & Silvia’s flat.
