Hugo was an amazing host and gave us an in depth tour of the flat. He was also able to offer advice on local/regional transport and always available to contact through airbnb or whatsapp.
A few notes about the flat:
You have an amazing view over Alfama from both of the living room's windows, both windows can be fully opened and you can even step outside on a tiny balcony, all windows can be completely closed with shutters (in case you are worried about sunlight creeping in), the flat is quiet at night, many of Lisbon's sights are within walking distance (10-30mins), the tram stops nearby, the flat didn't get hot but there is an AC in case it does, the kitchen is equipped with all cooking accessories (pots, pans, bottle openers, fridge/freezer... no cooking oil but salt and pepper were present), the flat's TV has NETFLIX, Wi-Fi is quick, bathroom water pressure is excellent (lots of towels and rolls of toilet paper were provided), the flat features a heavy lock for safety...
Please note that Lisbon is called the city of seven hills for a reason, expect steep stairs and some hills. The flat is on the 3rd floor.
All in all a great stay.

The place is in a great location in the Alfama. Easy walking distance to the city center. Hugo is very friendly and made the check in easy. Make sure to ask for his restaurant recommendations, they were amazing!
A fantastic place in a really great location. Hugo was really accommodating and answered any of my questions really promptly. I would highly recommend their place.

Hugo and Silvia’s flat was in the perfect place to experience life in the Alfama. Handy  to great restaurants and Fado bars. Easy walking or tram ride to everywhere. Amazing views from this cute well-appointed apartment. Its in the picturesque old part of town. Hugo was helpful and courteous.

Terrific flat. Close to restaurants. Fado music close by every night. Trams within walking distance. Close to castle. If you like to walk the squares are minutes away.

Excellent apartment. Beautiful location with an amazing view of the river. Hugo & Silvia were easy to communicate with and provided great recommendations for food and entertainment around the city. We are so happy we selected this apartment and would stay there again when we return to Lisbon.

What great accommodation with a view to die for.! Cant think of anything missing from this spotless and modern place.  You have it all when you stay with  Hugo. Took a trip to Fatima, Nazare and Obidos. Park of the Nation as well as all of down town Lisbon and Time out market not to be missed.  A place to revisit for sure!🌞

Hugo was the perfect host! Very thankful to stay in this lovely place! It was close to really great restaurants, a view of the coast, and near to central! The space was very clean and accommodating. El departamento es como se ve en las fotos, muy lindo, cómodo, limpio y con una vista hermosa de la costa; para dos personas es espectacular. Está muy bien ubicado en el barrio de Alfama, cerca del tranvía que te lleva al centro. Lo recomiendo mucho!

This apartment is really fabulous, well equipped, WiFi, air conditioning, spotlessly clean, great location, close to tram 28, with lots of local restaurants close by. Thank you Sylvia and Hugo for looking after us so well and organising our airport transfers.

Notre séjour à Lisbonne s'est parfaitement déroulé. L'appartement était très bien placé avec une jolie vue sur mer, très propre et bien équipé, bien isolé, lumineux.Attention cependant, il faut pouvoir monter les escaliers qui sont pentus.

Overall it's a great place to stay. The ocean view is amazing. It is in the oldest part of Lisbon and the neighborhood is lovely. Getting to this place requires quite a bit climbing up the down hills.

This place was great to stay at! It was conveniently located and it was such a cute, safe, clean place. It’s close to the tram but not a difficult walk to many places. Any places a little further away we just took an Uber to which was cheap and not a problem at all. You can hear people walking to their apartment cause the walls are pretty thin but the place is safe and secure so don’t be alarmed when you hear people. Overall it was wonderful and we loved staying there! Also a beautiful view of the river :)

parfait! une vue magnifique, un équipement au top. une décoration apaisante comme sur un petit nuage. l'emplacement est idéal pour visiter et profitez des trésors de Lisbonne. à proximité, un arrêt pour prendre le vieux tramway mythique de la ville. l'appartement idéal pour profiter d'un petit séjour sur Lisbonne. nous avons vraiment apprécié. logement à recommander vivement

Nous avons adoré notre séjour chez Hugo et Silvia. Appartement douillet, très propre, calme et très bien situé. La cerise sur le gâteau restent l’attention et la gentillesse de Hugo ainsi que la vue sur le Taje. Nous recommandons vivement cet appartement et  sans aucune hésitation nous  y séjournerons encore une fois à notre prochaine visite. Nous remercions infiniment à Hugo et Silvia.

This is the best and most beautiful apartment in my airbnb experience so far. I will definately recommend to all my friends who might visit Lisbon and myself will choose it again if I come next time. The flat is bright with sunshine and face to river, I spent relaxing time in this flat, in Alfama, in Lisbon. In addition, the flat locates in safe area. Also close to 28 tram and metro station. Hugo is a smart and nice host, appreciate.

If you are looking for an authentic old Lisbon feel then you will love the location of this beautiful apartment in the heart of Alfama.  Quiet cobblestone streets, beautiful old buildings, views of the river and even the sounds of sweet Fado music when the the doors are open in the evening. The apartment has everything that you need for a wonderful stay in Lisbon and is close to all of the major sites and attractions. Hugo responded quickly to any questions or requests that we had and even arranged for a drive to pick us up at the airport and get us checked in to the apartment.  We would definitely recommend this lovely little apartment to anyone who really wants to experience old Lisbon.

Eine sehr schöne Wohnung im Herzen der  Alfama. Tolle Aussicht über den Tejo. Das Auto sollte man aber lieber nicht mitnehmen. Die Wohnung hat alles was man braucht  ist neu renoviert und praktisch ausgestattet.  Die steile Treppe ist echt spannend für Lisboa Verhältnisse aber völlig normal..

My best AirBnB experience since I use this service.
Hugo is a great host. Before the journey we got some tips how to reach the flat. On our last day Hugo reserved us a taxi in the morning. 👍
The flat is beautiful and centralized in Alfama. The flat has everything what you need and is perfect for 2 people. Very clean bathroom, a modern kitchen and a great view to the river.
Thanks Hugo again to make this journey unforgetable.

The apartment is in the 3rd floor and had a fantastic view. It is a clean and modern place I stay. Easy walk to the city centre and surrounding areas
Definitely recommend it.

Good points:
Their flat is well located (in Alfama) and has got all the equipment we need . It is very clean and has got a very nice view.
Attention points:
Third floor with very straight stairs.
The possible improvement : it's to change the bed .

A great location within the Alfama district of Lisbon.  Easy to walk to restaurants and some local sights.  Clean apartment with great views of the harbor.    Tourism literature available in apartment.
It's a lovely place, hugo is a perfect host !

Apartamento completamente renovado no coração de um bairro histórico de Lisboa, muito limpo e bem decorado. Boas vistas. Acesso de carro ao prédio não é possível, o que pode criar alguma dificuldades.

The flat was amazing. The views of the city were great, and the location was perfect for all that we did during our stay. Lisbon has become my favorite European city. Thank you for such wonderful accommodations during our stay.
Thank you! It was so wonderful. First time to Lisbon and we would come back and stay here again! Great location. Perfect river view.

Hugo & Silvia’s apartment in the Alfama neighborhood is perfect. If you can handle walking up only three flights of stairs, their apartment is a must-book. The views from the balcony are stunning and the residence has everything you need and more. We stayed four days in Lisbon and loved this apartment. You’re a ten minute walk to the city center (or 5 minute ride via the tram), tons of bars and restaurants - including ones that sing fado. Hugo was very quick to respond to any and all of our requests. He is a fantastic and very resourceful host. We will definitely be back to Lisbon and we’ll look to stay here when we come back!
Great location in Alfama, close to Great attractions and wonderful views. Restaurants in the neighborhood were all wonderful.

Great location！I love this location so much because everynight，I can hear the fado nearby！It is so romantic！and Hugo is so nice to help me hang the luggege，and sugget the best restaurant for me！Everything is amazing here！I would highly recommend this flat！

Had a wonderful stay. He provided all the basic amenities. Place is sparkling clean close to everything. There is graffiti in the neighborhood but thats about everywhere you go in Europe or elsewhere. We didn’t have any problems venturing out at night. Felt pretty comfortable and safe doing so. Uber rides about 3-5 euros everyhwere if you didn’t want to walk. Hugo was very accommodating with arrival and check in time. He helped set up a driver in advance.
Excellent Location and view. Very clean flat and linen although the bedroom was a bit claustrophobic. The transfer, which Hugo organised, from and to the airport was excellent.

Eine tolle kleine (!) Wohnung im Herzen der Alfama. Die Kommunikation mit Hugo im Vorfeld war super: einfach & schnell. Die Wohnung sieht genau so aus wie auf den Fotos und war super sauber. Man sollte allerdings gut Treppen steigen können, denn diese sind sehr steil. Einzig die Matratze war schon etwas alt und hatte eine Kuhle in der Mitte. Insgesamt ein perfekter Ausgangspunkt für unsere Erkundungen Lissabons und ein schöner Rückzugsort, wenn man mal ausspannen will. Auch der Transfer vom Flughafen mit Joaquim hat tadellos geklappt und ist sein Geld wirklich wert, wenn man eine stressfreie An- und Abreise haben möchte. Zusammengefasst: jederzeit gerne wieder! Vielen Dank, Hugo und Silvia!

Hugo and Silvia's is a stylish place to stay right in the heart of Alfama. It is beautifully decorated and very clean and tidy. Hugo was welcoming and arranged a pickup from the airport which was marvellous after a long flight from Australia. Alfama is a fascinating area to stay in and well worth a few days to explore. You can here Fado from balcony in the evening, or go to a concert  a couple of minutes walk away. The views to the river are fantastic and you can watch the ships come and go. There are many small places to eat very close to the apartment, and Hugo provided excellent recommendations which we were very happy with. Highly recommended.
This neighborhood is one of the oldest in Lisbon and has great charm... far away from all the western hotel chains. The flat was clean and had a view of the river. I would definitely stay here again.

Tha Alfama blue house was an excellent home base to explore Lisbon and neighboring towns such as Sintra and Cascais. The apartment itself was very clean and beautifully decorated in the Alfama district which is very beautiful and colorful. Tons of restaurants nearby with traditional Fado singers seranding the alleyways. Although the winding hills and steps are very beautiful and historic, it will be difficult to traverse for the elderly or families with multiple little kids. We had a 2.5 year old with us and were fine.
Hugo is a great host. He personally met us in the apartment and shared alot of great advice. He was very prompt to respond to questions we had regarding local bakeries/restaurants and sites to see. He also periodically checked in to make sure everything was ok...we highly recommend the Alfama blue house to fellow Airbnb travellers!

Hugo's apartment was great. It was well furnished and a comfortable place to return to after long days of sightseeing. The view was definitely the best part, along with the sound of Fado at night. Highly recommended!
It is a nice apartment, position is good to most of the views in the city center. Mr Hugo is also very kind. Hope to stay here again at next time.

Hugo & Silvia’s beautiful flat, with great river views, is superbly located in the heart of the Alfama district. It is literally a 10-15 min walk from Castelo de Sao George, one of the famous miradouros (viewpoint), Santa Apolónia train station and so many good local eats. Hugo was kind enough to recommend things to do and places to eat (Pateo 13 being one of the must try’s). The place itself is really clean and inviting and has great A/C (you’ll need it after exploring the hills of the city). Can’t stress enough how gracious Hugo and Silvia are as hosts and how great their flat is!

Merci a Hugo pour son accueil, présent à la remise des clefs.
L'appartement est idéalement situé dans le quartier de l'Alfama.
On est bercé par le Fado en début de soirée, lorsque l'on ouvre les fenêtres.
Appartement fidèle à la description : Propre, confortable, bien situé.
je recommande ce logement.

Fantastic location, sparkling clean and very well decorated and fitted out. Hugo was very responsive and helpful. We loved just walking, eating and drinking in Alfama. The couple of times we went further a field for food, we were thoroughly disappointed. Explore Lisbon, then eat and drink in Alfama. Beautiful place.

Great and central Airbnb. I would book it straight away again!
Thanks Hugo.

Le logement d’Hugo et Silvia est tous simplement merveilleux. Tout est propre, il ne manque absolument rien. La vue est formidable sur le Tage. Les photos décrivent très bien le le logement. Il y a plusieurs restaurants et petites épiceries à proximité. Hugo est disponible (via l’application Airbnb) pour nous aider ou nous conseiller.

Great flat and location! Cute, clean and comfortable (including the bed). It’s located in the Alfama neighborhood, which is walkable to many parts of the city/sights and very charming. We enjoyed staying there. The flat also has a great view and air conditioning! Only one thing to note: it is a 3 story narrow walkup and a bit difficult to negotiate carrying luggage up and down (that being said, it wouldn’t have been a problem had I not recently had knee surgery). Just something to be aware of if you have mobility issues.
Above all, Hugo’s responsiveness is amazing! He responded to our questions usually within minutes and arranged a driver, Joaquim who was also great, to take us to and from the airport/train station. Hugo is a pleasure to communicate with and that made our trip so much easier.

The Apartment is right in the middle of Alfama, the oldest neighbourhood in Lisbon. You can see the sunset over the river on the balcony and hear Fado performances at night at various restaurants nearby. The apartment made our visit to Lisbon feel THAT much more authentic.

This was a great home while in Lisbon! It is in a great location and well appointed. The interior was stylish and clean with everything we needed. At night we opened our window to enjoy the river views and hear Fado while enjoying a glass of wine to wind down. Hugo was excellent in communicating and they even arranged pick up and luggage hold (and drop off) for a great price so that we could begin enjoying Lisbon upon our 6 am arrival. LOVED THIS PLACE! Don't hesitate to book if available!

This place is perfect for a couple looking for somewhere central in Alfama! We had only 2 days and one night in Lisbon but walked everywhere; from nice brunch spots to all the tourist spots through the winding streets. The place itself was perfectly formed, perfectly clean and the hosts were great- v informative a quick to get back to us and answer our questions. I would highly recommend!
Hugo was great and the location is amazing, close to great restaurants, an old beautiful part of Lisbon and within walking distance of the plaza and the river/bay.
Hugo was great, fantastic communication and very straight forward transfer. Cracking location and able to explore Lisbon and all it has to offer. Would definitely stay again if in Lisbon... thanks

Sehr geschmackvolle, saubere und mitten in Alfama gelegene kleine Oase mit traumhaftem Blick über die Dächer bis zum Tejo. In unmittelbarer Umgebung unzählige kleine Restaurants und Imbisse aller Preisklassen inkl. Fado Musik.
Alles gut zu Fuß zu erreichen, u. a. auch das moderne Ausgehviertel Bairro Alto ( ca. 25 min.).
Schnelle und unkomplizierte Kommunikation mit Hugo, der uns auch bei der Organisation der An- und Abreise half.

We had a great time in this cosy Alfama apartment. Hugo was an excellent communicator and very kindly picked us up from the nearby station and drove us to the apartment.
The apartment is up 3 flights of steep stairs, which could definitely be a problem for those with fitness or mobility problems. Hugo is a real gentleman and kindly carried our heavy case up to the apartment.
Thanks apartment is quite compact, but very well organised. When the windows/ doors are opened the views across the tightly packed kasbah like streets and across the broad Tagus estuary is stunning. The balcony is a great place for viewing the surrounding area or just people watching.
The area itself was very lively at night - full of music and dancing in the street, colourful parades. A fantastic place for the young - I am 63 but was out dancing in the square to the early hours most nights. Don't worry about the noise however - once you shut the doors you are well insulated in the interior bedroom from the music down below.
The air-conditioning is also very quiet and efficient. All the key appliances are of a very good quality, particularly the cooker and the shower. Do note however that there is no washing machine - though I did notice launderettes not too far away. As a wine lover we would like to have seen one or two more wine glasses and a decent corkscrew - but you will have no problem self catering here. If cooking is not your idea of a holiday then you will have no problem finding a restaurant to suit your taste and pocket in this wonderful locality. On our last night we enjoyed an amazing meal with outstanding fado musical entertainment.
A great place to stay.
Hugo is wonderful, the flat is outstanding. Clean, modern and best location. Lots of steps but that keeps us fit!

Location was within walking distance to many of the local sites.  The apartment had a great view, was very clean and nicely appointed.   Our host, Hugo, was very responsive and helpful!   Highly recommend!!

Super gelegen in der Alfama,  schöne Aussicht auf den Fluss und die Kreuzfahrtschiffe. Fünf Minuten zu Fuß vom tollen Aussichtspunkt Santa Luzia. Organisation Pickup, Kommunikation hat alles perfekt geklappt.

Alfama Blue House I è una buona soluzione per visitare la meravigliosa città di Lisbona. La casa, posta in un quartiere molto caratteristico della città, è piccola ma deliziosa, ben curata e dotata di tutti i confort necessari per trascorrere serenamente un periodo di vacanza. Due aspetti non proprio negativi, ma che comunque mi hanno creato, per me che sono sessantenne e robusto di corporatura, delle difficoltà: sono le scale e il letto. Pur essendo un breve tratto, fortunatamente, le scale sono ripidissime e gli scalini stretti e molto alti. Per chi ha problemi di articolazioni al ginocchio diventa un problema. Il letto matrimoniale è alla francese, ovvero più piccolo di larghezza rispetto ai 160 cm canonici del letto matrimoniale, quindi per me è stato problematico dormirci. Per il resto tutto estremamente comodo, zona tranquillissima, a pochi passi si raggiunge comodamente sia il Castello di Sao Jorge che il quartiere di Bairro Alto. La zona è ricchissima di ristorantini tipici, dove si mangia molto bene. Nota stonata è per il proprietario Hugo. Persona che non abbiamo mai incontrato nei tre giorni trascorsi in casa sua, ci siamo scambiati solo dei whatsapp. Di solito, quando ho prenotato attraverso Airbnb, sono stato sempre accolto dai proprietari che, oltre a spiegare tutte le funzioni di casa, si sono prodigati a dispensare consigli su cosa visitare, come andare, dove mangiare e cosa mangiare. Tutto questo purtroppo non è avvenuto. La consegna di casa ci è stata fatta dal tassista che precedentemente avevamo prenotato attraverso Hugo. Persona gentilissima si è solo limitato a spiegarci le chiavi cosa aprivano e come accendere le luci di casa. Tutto qui.

Great spot in a great location! Hugo was wonderful, even went above and beyond by picking us up from the train station! The apartment was clean and exactly as advertised, in a great location. Many great sites within walking distance. Would stay again!

Cet appartement au coeur d Alfama est vraiment exceptionnel ! Très bien placé proche des restaurants et sites remarquable du quartier. Accès par un escalier intérieur typique et assez vertical !
Nous reviendrons sans aucune hésitation. Merci Hugo pour votre accueil . C était parfait !

Must be active and able to climb steep stairs. Quiet and convenient location.  Clean & modern.  They arranged airport pickup and drop off which was a lifesaver for sure.  Not sure we would have found on our own.  Great hosts.
Perfect location for Lisbon perfect host in Hugo.

Nous avons adoré notre séjour à Lisbonne!
L’appartement est fonctionnel, joliment décoré et d’une propreté irréprochable. Restaurants et métro à proximité, il est très bien situé dans un quartier exceptionnel.
De plus, notre hôte Hugo nous a très bien accueilli, il est très disponible pour donner des informations. Il a même organisé notre transport retour jusqu’à l’aéroport en taxi (à 5h du matin!!).
Nous recommandons vivement cette appartement et reviendrons avec plaisir si nous en avons l’occasion!

Appartement d'une propreté irréprochable, Très bien placé dans le quartier de l'Alfama. Hugo est venu nous chercher au métro à notre arrivée à Lisbonne et nous a gentiment envoyé un taxi le jour de notre départ. C'était parfait

This most stylish apartment in the heart of Lisbon is a place where you just want to stay longer. The ambiente is light and friendly and designed close to perfection; plus the view is just extraordinary!
Hugo is a great and very reliable host. Definitely will visit again.

Hugo and Silvia were very responsive and answered all our questions before and during our stay. The apartment was very clean with towels, hairdryer, aircon and ironing board. appartement TRÈS PROPRE et très agréable.  Exactement comme sur les photos en mieux!!!! We were so pleased with this apartment and its superb location!  It was beautiful, super clean, and had lovely views.  Hugo set up a pick up at the airport for us for a small fee and that was very worth it - Joaquim was fantastic and very personable.  I think the apartment would have been tricky to find without that help on the first day.  Actually, anything in the Alfama neighborhood would be tricky to find the first time. The neighborhood had all kinds of great restaurants, winding streets to stroll, and scenic overlooks.  Hugo was very responsive and helpful.  If we make it back to Lisbon, we would definitely stay here again.

Hugo met us on arrival to show us the apartment and explain the facilities. He also gave us many local tips and things to do. It was a really nice touch.
The apartment itself is in the old part of the city but is very nicely updated. Great location close to everything. Excellent amenities which make it feel like you are in your own home. Everything you could need is there. The umbrellas provided were great as it rained twice during our stay and we didn’t have wet weather clothing.
It was a great choice and glad we did.
Hugo was amazing in his communication and going the extra mile with our check-in and check-out. The location was outstanding.
Very nice small flat, perfect for a couple who wants to discover Alfama's atmosphere! The flat is very tidy and with a lovely view!

Lovely, clean and modern apartment with fantastic views. Hugo was incredibly helpful, meeting us when we arrived and passing on all his tips. Brilliant stay, would definitely come back next time we are in Lisbon.

Die Wohnung ist sehr schön gelegen und nett ausgestattet, klein, aber fein. Der Ausblick vom Fenster/Halbbalkon ist superschön! Für ein Paar, das kein übermäßig großes Doppelbett braucht, gut geeignet. Der Gastgeber antwortet immer sehr schnell und ist sehr zuverlässig. Wir haben uns dort wohl gefühlt, eine 2. L'appartement est idéalement situé dans le quartier historique de Lisbonne. Hugo est très accueillant et attentif à toutes les demandes.

This is a beautiful apartment, you can believe the photos! It is in an old district and you'll have fun exploring the maze of lanes. The hosts are really friendly and helpful.

Es gibt nicht viel zu sagen, ausser, dass wir es sicher weiterempfehlen und selber nochmals buchen werden. Liegt super, supernette und diskrete Gastgeber und gute, zweckvolle Wohnung für bis 3 Personen. Gut bis sehr gut!!

We liked the apartment very much especially the amazing view and that everything was super clean. Hugo was available for all our questions and gave us great tipps. The two things we think could be improved is firstly the wifi connection, which only worked in the living room and was quite weak even then. And secondly we thought that the bed was a little bit too small for two people. Otherwise everything was great and we had a really nice time.

Très belle ville chargée d'histoire et très accueillante.
Hugo nous a parfaitement reçu dans son très bel appartement.
Philippe & Béatrice

The apartment has marvelous view of the river. Beautifully decorated, very cosy, confortable, I was so happy being there.
Located very center of Alfama, just 10 menutes walk from Santa Apolonia station. It’s easy to access touristic places.

Hugo kindly came to the station and pick me up to the apartment, and gave me useful information about the town.
I had a great time and want to back to Lisbon to stay Alfama blue house again.

N'hésitez pas.... foncez. Appartement très propre et fonctionnel. Vue imprenable. Commerces à proximité.... et pour couronner le tout.... le soir avec les fenêtres ouvertes on entend le fado .....MAGIQUE ! Que du bonheur

The flat is well decorated. The kitchen is well equipped. There is salt and pepper, sugar, coffee and spices for guest use. There's a beautiful view of the river from the living room. It was spotlessly clean and very quiet throughout the night.  Hugo was helpful throughout our communication and we would certainly return for another visit.

We loved the Blue House and couldn’t recommend it more highly. Hugo and Silvia were great hosts, the apartment was spotless, and the neighborhood was lots of fun. The apartment was bright but had great shutters if you need darkness to sleep. And the kitchen had all the necessary equipment. Hugo and Silvia shared information about the area and had many maps and tour books for us to peruse during our stay. And they were exceptionally responsive. Sadly, we had to leave a little early due to a family emergency. Hugo answered our messages immediately, helped us figure out how to check out and get home in the middle of the night. We hope to return soon!

We stayed t Alfama Blue for 7 nights. Before arriving Hugo organised airport transfer for us which was great value for money. He was very responsive and informative. There were a number of lookouts within minutes walk from the building and many cafes and restaurants. Overall we loved it here and we highly recommend the stay at Hugo & Silvia's place. You wont be disappointed.

L'appartement est très bien situé dans le typique quartier de l'Alfama et proche du traw 28 qui nous fait traverser tout Lisbonne. C'est un logement très propre avec une jolie déco épurée et il est parfaitement équipé . La vue depuis le logement est splendide .
Hugo est un hôte sympathique qui s'est rendu disponible pour nous accueillir le jour de notre arrivée et nous a donné de bons conseils pour nos visites.

Mooi appartement met een geweldig uitzicht in de gezellige wijk Alfama. Hugo & Silvia zijn super hosts, ze zorgen er echt voor dat je je thuis gaat voelen.

We loved our stay at Hugo's place! Hugo was very responsive to any questions I had and was very helpful in arranging transportation from the airport to the apartment. The apartment was great - it's in a fantastic location in the charming Alfama district, is up to date and perfect for a couple or small group of friends.  The kitchen and bathroom were spacious and modern.  Hugo was very easy to communicate with - I would highly recommend to anyone looking to stay in Lisbon!

Great location with amazing views!! Walking distance to restaurants and public areas. Easy access to the trolly and buses. Convenient to Santa Apolnia train station. Great Airbnb and host. I would definitely recommend.

Hugo was an amazing host! The apartment location was perfect and we had an wonderful time. We can't wait to come back!

I am glad we chose Hugo and Silvia's flat to stay in. Hugo was easy to contact and responded quickly. Hugo & Silvia's apartment was great! Hugo met us at the local train station and got us to the apartment and gave us some tips on public transport as well as sights to see and places to check out. Great apartment, Hugo was incredibly welcoming and the bottle of wine he left us was a great touch! Also the shower was fantastic and the apartment was clean and modern and was easy to come back to after long days in the town. Next time we go back to Lisbon, we will stay here
Perfect for one or two people who want to explore the oldest part of Lisbon and many of the most important historic sites. Hugo met us at the apartment and was very gracious, informative and helpful.

Logement conforme au descriptif, très propre et décoration sympa. Au cœur de l'Alfama, sa situation permet de découvrir ce pittoresque cartier de Lisbonne. The accommodations were perfect. We enjoyed the alfama area and is within short walks to some great restaurants and pastelarias.  The added bonus of being picked up at the airport was worth it. Hugo was very attentive to any of our needs. Highly recommend!

I would surely stay here again -- the hospitality, the location and the quality of the space.

Parfait pour un séjour en amoureux.

Hugo and Silvia are great hosts. Their flat is very cozy in a prime location, just as described. and YES it does look exactly like the pictures, and the view even more so!

A place we may never have found but for his suggestion.

We loved our stay in Lisbon! Hugo was an excellent host and we really enjoyed his recommendations. The apartment was modern and spotless, and the views were gorgeous! Great location in the heart of Alfama.

Our stay here was perfect. Hugo picked us up from the station and told us some interesting things about lisbon.

Hugo and Silvia have been just great, although we met only Hugo...

We had an amazing time in Hugo & Sylvia's apartment. We hebben een geweldige tijd gehad in Lissabon. Het appartement is exact zo als op de foto, maar boven al schoon en een prachtig uitzicht. Hugo est un hôte 5 étoiles et très sympathique ! Il est venu nous chercher à l'aéroport et nous a fait découvrir la ville sur le chemin de l'appartement. Il est resté à notre écoute pendant les 4 jours de notre séjour. L'appartement est quand à lui situé idéalement dans l'Alfama, à 3 minutes du fameux tramway N°28. Il est très bien aménagé et l'air conditionné est vraiment appréciable étant donnée la température estivale. Nous avons passé un très agréable séjour et recommandons sans aucune hésitation cet appartement et ses propriétaires.

Hugo is an exceptional host! He picked us up from the train station and showed us to a beautiful view of the city where he described the different areas of Lisbon. He also pointed out where to get a ticket for the tram, and where the closest tram stop is, which was very helpful! The flat is absolutely stunning. Waking up to this beautiful view of the river and the city was one of my favorite things about the whole trip. The flat is furnished with everything you need and is VERY clean. There are great decorative details throughout, as well as some helpful tourist info and books to read. We were so grateful to find complimentary coffee and a fantastic bottle of wine provided by Hugo to welcome us! It was always easy to reach Hugo, and he would respond right away, very generously. In the time we met him I got a lovely sense of Portuguese hospitality which I noticed throughout our stay from the shop owners, to guides, to the many soccer fans we cheered with in the street! We could barely believe how lucky we were to be in Lisbon for the EuroCup final and experience all of the excitement in the city. It was always wonderful walking back to this apartment at night because the street is so quiet and tucked away. It is the perfect combination of being very close to all the action and wonderful cafes, bars and views in Alfama, but also a quiet peaceful home to return to. We are so grateful to have stayed in this gorgeous place in this very, very special city.

Hugo was very helpful in figuring out how to get to the house. Our flights ended up being delayed so he was able to come pick us up from the airport and bring us to the flat. He gave us all the information we needed and even left a great bottle of wine! The neighborhood is amazing and we really enjoyed just walking around and exploring. Great start to our Lisbon adventure! Huge was very responsive anytime we needed him and made us feel at home. The apartment had everything you could ever need from towels, toiletries, cooking utensils, iron/ironing board, tv, great internet, great A/C, guides to the city, etc. They literally thought of everything. The view is beautiful and the bed was a comfortable and firm bed. The flat is on the 3rd floor but if you can't climb that every day then you shouldn't be in Alfama. The streets are all cobblestone and at an incline so you are getting a workout while exploring. Uber had a difficult time finding us at the flat so I suggest going down to Museu do Fado or up by the tram stop for your pickup location. We did not take the tram but it was very close to the flat and seemed easy to take, just up a flight of stairs. We also had a great lookout point with performers and artists just a short walk from the flat. It looks far from the balcony in the flat but it is actually only maybe a 10 minute walk. Go up by the tram stop and keep going and you will be there in no time! After staying in this neighborhood we didn't want to go to our hotel because it was so charming. Most everyone speaks English in the area and there are some great restaurants not too far from the flat. I would suggest avoiding places that try to sell you on coming inside. The good places don't need to have a salesman out front trying to pull you in. A very short and cheap uber drive to Bairro Alto, Chiado, etc. Less than 5 Euros! The tuktuk's are all over but will be more like 5 Euro per person. It's a fun experience to take at least once. I truly cannot say enough about our stay in Hugo's flat. There is a reason he has a superhost badge. Will stay here in a heartbeat if we come back! Thanks again for everything.

Our stay at this apartment was perfect.  We had to arrive late in the evening in Lisbon, but Hugo still was able to accommodate us and gave us a warm welcome to the area including a little tour of Alfama.  The apartment is wonderful, everything is brand new and very clean. We only stayed for 2 nights but would definitely go back!

Wir haben die Tage in Lissabon und in Alfama Blue House seht genossen. Das Apartement ist sehr schön, modern und sauber und die Lage ist ein Traum. Hugo ist extrem nett und hilfsbereit. Er hat uns von der Metro abgeholt und einen kleinen Überblick über die Stadt gegeben. Wir werden wiederkommen und das Apartement weiterempfehlen!

Hugo was a very helpful and communicative host. The bed was very comfortable and the water pressure strong, both much appreciated after several long days exploring the hilly city!  The only thing that I would note is that the stairs up to the apartment and the streets around the apartment are pretty steep so this may not be the best location for some who has difficulty walking.  Other than that, everything about our stay was perfect!

Once again thank you so much for hosting us this couple of days. We really enjoyed our stay in beautiful Lisbon!
The apartment is quite well located in Alfama and the interior is just beautiful!

All the best!

What a wonderful stay in Lisboa! Perfect little apartment with a great view. Hugo picked us up at the metro station and gave us a small "orientation"tour. Nice! Oh well, everything within walking distance. Two really nice tips: go and have lunch at "Os Gazetteiros" (great food and wine, 3lunchcourses for 14€!) and visit the flea market right behind Sao Vicente.
Oh, and take the train (or a taxi) (not the tram) when you visit Belem (that is: if you don't want to be packed on the tram: really too crowded). Do try the "pasteis"! Mmmmm!
If you have time and want to escape the city, try crossing the Tejo to Cacilhas (same ticket as tram/metro): along the shore (15min walk) there is a great terrace"Ponto final", especially nice when it's hot!
Thanks again Hugo and Silvia.

In the evening if we opened the windows we could hear the Fado singers. The studio is very clean and well equipped and the riverview is stunning. We recommend this place for everyone who wants to visit Lisbon. If we go back we will surely book this place again!

Hugo nous a récupéré à l'aéroport avec un grand sourire, c'est super agréable comme accueil. Il était pressé (car il est venu nous chercher en milieu de journée et il travaillait) mais ce fut efficace ! Il nous a donné de bons conseils de promenades et de visites.
L'appartement est exactement ce que l'on voit sur les photos : très propre, super mignon, vue superbe, et bien équipé. On est comme à la maison, des guides sur Lisbonne sont disponibles, des plans etc. Des chanteurs de Fado nous accompagnent en soirée dans les rues de l'Alfama. Ce quartier est fantastique, trop beau, on s'y perd avec grand plaisir.
Bref, à conseiller et à renouveler ! Merci Hugo et Silvia pour la bouteille de vin de bienvenue, bue en France.

Nous avons été très bien accueillis.
Hugo nous a proposé de venir nous chercher à l'aéroport ce qui peut être pratique car la maison est située dans une rue pas tout près du métro (15minutes), et pas si facile à trouver.
L'appartement est exactement comme sur les photos,
très calme.
En plus une bouteille de vin en cadeau de bienvenue...ce qui est très gentil.

Nous avons passé un très agréable séjour à l'appartement de Hugo et Sylvia.

Premièrement, nous avons beaucoup apprécié que Hugo vienne nous chercher à la Gare Oriente. Il a pris le temps de nous faire faire un tour de ville en nous fournissant une foule d'informations utiles, notamment concernant les points de service à proximité de l'appartement. Il s'est également montré très disponible pour toute question que nous aurions pu avoir pendant notre séjour.

L'appartement correspondait exactement aux photos et descriptions données sur le site de Airbnb. Bel appartement, bien décoré et lumineux, très propre, contenant toutes les commodités, et avec une vue superbe sur le Tage. Nous avons eu du plaisir à s'installer devant notre balcon pour souper, à regarder les bateaux de croisière sur le Tage, à entendre les chants du Fado.

L'appartement est très bien situé, au cœur de l'Alfama, à proximité de tout: petits marchés, restaurants, boutiques... Nous avons pu faire plusieurs visites à pied. Nous avons eu bien du plaisir à marcher dans les ruelles étroites du quartier, à s'y perdre et s'y retrouver.

Nous recommanderons assurément cet appartement à nos amis qui veulent visiter Lisbonne.

Das Apartement Alfama Blue House war wirklich schön. Moderne Ausstattung incl. sehr gut ausgestatteter Küche; alles sehr sauber. Die Aussicht über die Dächer von Alfama sowie den Tejo und die Kreuzfahrtschiffe ist grandios. Das Apartement ist ein perfekter Ruheort nach dem geräuschvollen Stadtleben. Hugo war sehr gastfreundlich, jederzeit verfügbar und voller guter Ratschläge.
Wir fühlten uns willkommen und empfehlen die Wohnung sehr gern weiter.

Hugo and Silvia were the perfect hosts! All questions were promptly answered, they provided lots of information about the transfer and Lisbon. As we arrived mid-afternoon they could not welcome us themselves but organized a friend to take care of us who was very helpful, thank you, Joaquim!
The apartment is awesome!!! Everything seems brandnew, it was spotlessly clean, the kitchen is well equipped, it really is just like shown in the pictures. We loved it and enjoyed our stay a lot! And the river view is just amazing :-) Thanks again for having us, guys!

Just back from 8 days in Lisbon. First time going Air B & B Will definitely do it again based on this experience.
Apartment was really lovely ,just as lovely as on Web. Little concerned when arrived going up very steep old stairs but when opened door it was beautiful bright clean & modern. Little concerned also when saw 3 big dogs in Courtyard at back. They barked couple times first night but nothing after that.Views from window lovely seeing the boats on the river. Lovely sitting at window at night with glass of wine with sounds of Fado music from local bar. Apartment in great old local area near tram/ metro , little supermarket and bakery. Hugo great host picked us up at Airport, showed us some sights and gave several tips re getting round and local restaurants He had left lovely bottle of wine which was a lovely touch also a protugise phone to use . He also arranged taxi back to the airport for us. Nothing seemed too much for him . These little touches added to our holiday.
Lisbon lovely city but bring walking shoes as streets uneven and hilly. Enjoy all it has to offer by tram & Tuk-Tuk and on foot Visit marked beside Phantion on Sat & Tues Well worth a visit The Time Out Food Market has food to suit every taste. Wander the streets of Alfama and soak up the atmosphere in little Bars and Restaurants where you will get great food especially beautiful fish. plenty of great wines too.As weather was glorious we spend some time in Cascais beautiful beach resort Very easy to get by train , well worth a visit
We also visited Sintra really beautiful town with Fairy Tale Castle
Would definitely recommend the Alfama Blue House It has every thing you need for a great visit to Lisbon and if only all hosts were as thoughtful as Hugo
Bernie & Pat
Ireland Oct 2015

Hugo and Silvia were lovely hosts!  The apartment is great and looks like the pictures, maybe even a bit better in real life. The location of the appartment is just as great: the neighborhood in itself is super interesting but also bus and other modes of public transport are nearby. Hugo was super nice, he helped us with our luggage and some other logistics. Please do not hesitate to book this appartment, you won't regret it! ☺

The apartment is in the Alfama old city quarter. It is very nicely renewed. The owner, as well as the tenants who lived there looked after it very well, because it looked like it was gave just at that time. Everything was right and clean. We were welcomed with a bottle of wine. The owner, Hugo even met us at the airport, took us to the Orient Railway station and – as we started our journey in Portugal not in Lisbon immediately, staying there only for the last 6 days – he put away our suitcase until we came back, so we did not have to take all the suitcases with us. Only few hosts do it for the guests indeed. Thank you Hugo!
We really recommend this wonderful apartment with the majestic view and the excellent host to everyone.

My parents have spent a very good time in Lisbon and enjoyed a lot the apartment I had booked for them, well decorated and organized, with a nice view on the Tage. Hugo has picked them up at the airport and has been very helpful, giving plenty of information on the city.

Nous avons adoré l'appartement: propre, charmant et tres bien équipé.  Hugo nous a accueilli chaleureusement et à l'heure.  Il a pris le temps de bien nous expliquer le fonctionnement de l'appart et les environs. Nous avons apprécié les attentions : livres et depliants a notre disposition et cellulaire pour le rejoindre en cas de problèmes.  La localisation est super (vieux quartier et près de l'eau) .  Nous recommandons cet appartement

Alles war bestens! Abholung durch Hugo war perfekt und sehr entspannt. Die Kommunikation mit ihm war ganz prima und er war ein sehr guter Gastgeber einschließlich Wein zur Begrüßung und Taxi-Bestellung für die Abreise. Das Appartment ist Super!!! Alles wie beschrieben, modern, hell und gut ausgestattet in typischer Alfamagasse mit tollem Ausblick auf Lissabon und Tejo.  Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt, eine echte Empfehlung!

We were welcomed by Hugo’s friend Vitor who helped us to get to the apartment as our taxi driver got lost in Alfama’s streets. The apartment was perfectly clean, the rooms are nicely decorated, the bed was comfortable, but the pillows were too hard, Wi-Fi was fast. The windows of the living room overlook the river and nice old rooftops. The kitchen has all the necessary equipment, a bottle of wine was left for us as a welcome gift. The neighbourhood is not so quiet at night: you can hear all the fado singers from the nearby restaurants not even leaving the apartment. Also it was hard to find any good supermarket nearby. The tram 28 stops very closely to the house, but you can get to the major sights of the city by foot also. The window of the kitchen opens to the small internal court where three quite big dogs of the neighbours were living. They barked sometimes loudly and we couldn’t open the kitchen window without letting in the smell from the dogs, that was annoying.

John and I visited Lisbon on our honeymoon and the Alfama Blue House 1 was a wonderful homebase. Hugo picked us up from the airport and took us to an overlook to help us understand the layout of Lisbon. His wife Silvia made us a delicious chocolate cake, which was waiting for us at the apartment, to celebrate our wedding. The location of the apartment is on a quite street in the middle of the Alfama. It was a great jumping off point to explore the old city, discover cute restaurants and shops, and wander around Lisbon. John and I would definitely stay here again if we are ever back in Lisbon.

Nous avons passé une excellente semaine dans votre charmant appartement. Il est idéalement situé pour visiter la ville, dans un quartier typique (restaurants, fado...), vue très agréable sur le Tage.
Accueil chaleureux d'Hugo qui est venu nous chercher à l'aéroport et nous a fait découvrir un magnifique point de vue; merci de nous avoir conseillé la visite de Sintra.

We had a wonderful time in Hugo and Silvia's apartment. The apartment is very clean, has everything you need for a city trip and is located in the vibrant Alfama neighbourhood.
Communications went smooth. Hugo even picked us up from the airport and called a taxi for our departure, which was all very convenient.
Highly recommended!

Hugo was the best host! He gave us a lift from the airport, showed us arround in the city, explained everything and we always knew that we can count on him and give him a call if we needed help. He even left us a bottle of wine at the appartment! It was a real home to us! Hugo's appartment is freshly renovated and you have a great view over the river. The old town "Alfama" is a very good position to explore the city!

Hugo and Silvia have a wonderful place, ideal for a couple, and they were fantastic hosts. Hugo told us all we needed to know well in advance, gave us plenty of advice and good tips about the neighborhood on arrival, picked us up from the airport (!), and was easily and reliably reachable by phone during our stay. For reasons beyond our control (airlines, visas, etc.), we had first to plan for leaving a day earlier, then needed to stay a day longer, and Hugo not only put up with us and our back and forth, but offered to help with finding a place for an extra day - his was taken immediately, which shows how popular it is, justifiedly so. Hugo, you're a saint! :) And we enjoyed the bottle of wine!

The neighborhood is Lisbon at its best, and the apartment has a gorgeous view of the river (well worth the 3 floors of narrow stairs). Neighborhood store, tons of excellent restaurants (Pateo 1 3became our favorite), colors and friendly neighbors everywhere, and almost all the major sights and sites in walking distance. The apartment was perfectly clean on arrival, all the needed amenities were there, hard bed but not too hard, good shower, big fridge, toaster, work table and seating area in living room with view, separate eating table close to the kitchen, all just right. Modern yet comfy.

I wish we could stay longer, if not forever, but we'll be back.

L'appartement est tout à fait conforme aux photos, très agréable  et très bien situé dans le quartier historique de l'Alfama avec vue sur le  Tage. Nous avons passé un excellent séjour à Lisbonne. Hugo a été très accueillant, disponible et plein de bons conseils. Nous n'hésiterons pas à revenir chez Hugo et Sylvia  lors de notre prochain séjour à Lisbonne .  Merci encore à eux!

Very good place, very well located with surperbe view. Apartment very nice and true to the description. Hugo welcomes us very well and helps us perfectly when necessary. If we return it will be in Lisbon in this apartment.

The Blue House was absolutely wonderful. Fantastic views over the Tagus river, we were lulled to sleep by the Fado singers from the local restaurant, without it being noisy. The modern renovation made for a very comfortable stay in this beautiful old quarter of Lisbon . Hugo was a very considerate host  willing to help us out in every way . We really  appreciated being met at the airport . Highly recommended , no hesitation to return.

Nous avons été très bien accueilli par Hugo, qui nous a donné toutes les informations nécessaires au bon déroulement de notre séjour.
L'appartement correspondait exactement aux descriptions et photos mises sur le site airbnb. L'appartement était très bien situé, proche des restaurants et à deux pas du tram 28. Tout était parfait! nous recommandons l'appartement de Hugo et Silvia.

Hugo was extremely nice and informative. When we arrived, he took us to a lovely view point overlooking Lisbon and also told us a lot of information about the different areas of the city. He was also very helpful and responsive to all of our questions and concerns that we had during our stay. The newly renovated apartment was immaculate and very welcoming. We enjoyed the use of the kitchen and all the appliances, including the facilities in the bathroom, are very up to date. The bed was comfortable and the view of Alfama is gorgeous. We really enjoyed meeting Hugo and staying here, we would definitely stay here again the next time we visit and we recommend it for anyone looking for a wonderful experience in Lisbon.

The apt was in what we considered the best neighborhood of Lisbon! Hugo helped us park our car and drove us to his place - be warned for those with heavy luggage as you have to go up quite steep stairs. Once you do though, it is a modern apt with an amazing view and everything you need during your stay. Great accessibility as everyone has said, and truly the perfect place to step away from the crowds at night and just enjoy the neighborhood. Highly recommended!

L'appartamento con vista mozzafiato sul quartiere Alfama, è accogliente e dotato di tutti i comfort necessari. Perfettamente coerente con la descrizione presente sul sito! Hugo è venuto a prenderci all'aeroporto ed è stato disponibilissimo nel fornirci qualsiasi tipo di informazione di cui avessimo bisogno; lungo il tragitto ha trovato inoltre il tempo di mostrarci una vista spettacolare della città. Consiglio vivamente a chiunque questa esperienza!

Parfait accueil de Hugo à l'aéroport, très bien organisé. A pris le temps de nous emmener sur un des points de vue de Lisbonne avant de nous laisser à l'appartement. Une bonne bouteille de vin en cadeau de bienvenue, très sympa.
L'appartement idéalement situé dans une des rues typiques d'Alfama est exactement comme sur les photos, très lumineux et coquet. Le Tramway 28 à 2 pas. Une adresse idéale pour un très beau séjour à Lisbonne !

Marina  ed io abbiamo trascorso  un piacevolissimo soggiorno  a Lisbona  seguendo il suggerimento di nostri  amici abbiamo  utilizzato per la  prima  volta  il  servizio airbnb .  L' appartamento  Alfama Blue è situato  in una della zone  più  caratteristiche  di Lisbona, facilmente collegato con il centro  tramite il Tram 28     vicinissimo ad una delle più belle  terrazze panoramiche .   L' appartamento è esattamente come  indicato  nel sito  piuttosto piccolo  ,   pulito     completo  di tutto (aria condizionata, wifi telefonino con scheda portoghese, guide turistiche, lettore cd  etc , )  Dal piccolo salottino si gode  una bella  vista  che spazia sul Tago e sui tetti dell' Alfama . Hugo  stato  preciso  , abbiamo concordato  con 10€ il trasfert dall' aeroporto e puntuale  ci è venuto a prendere ed accompagnandoci all' appartamento ci  ha dato  il benvenuto omaggiandoci di una  bottiglia di  vino rosso . Dall' appartamento  Il  centro  città si raggiunge facilmente  in 15 - 20 minuti . Nel mese di giugno  abbiamo assistito ad una  bella festa  popolare con  grigliate di sardine  e  balli per strada .  Lo consiglio per  chi vuole  soggiornare  in un quartiere tipico  e  tranquillo con piccole  trattorie  rispetto ad un centro  più affollato  e turistico  . L'appartamento è situato al 3° piano  e si raggiunge  con una stretta  scala  abbastanza ripida .  Lo consiglio .

L'appartement est superbe et très bien situé dans le quartier historique de Lisbonne Alfama. Il est très confortable et possède une vue magnifique sur le Tage. Hugo nous a très bien reçu avec de nombreux conseils. Merci pour sa gentillesse et sa disponibilité .
Je reviendrai avec plaisir et je le recommande chaudement .
L'appartement est superbe et très bien situé dans le quartier Alfama. Hugo nous a très bien reçu avec de nombreux conseils. Vraiment top !

Thank you for an amazing stay in Lisbon !

Everything was truly great during our stay, including the authentic location, modern, beautiful and clean apartment as well as very warm welcome. We really felt your effort to make our stay comfortable and memorable.

Really recommended ! :)

Gabriele

Hugo made us feel very welcome as soon as we landed in Lisbon. For an extra fee he picked us up at the airport and drove us to the apartment. The apartment was accurately portrayed online. The space is well kept and has every amenity one would need during their stay.

A big thank you to Hugo & Silvia for hosting us in this lovely apartment. It was exactly like shown on the photos. Lovely view, beautiful interior to feel at home and great location in the old Alfama area of Lisbon. Lots of places to eat and hear fado around. Great experience. We will come again for sure!

Hugo was wonderfully welcoming, with great communication before and during my visit. He picked me up at the airport, gave me a brief tour of the neighborhood, and made great suggestions for transportation. The apartment is beautiful, and well-situated in a charming and ideal neighborhood for exploring Lisbon. I highly recommend this apartment and these hosts!

We had a great experience in Hugo's apartment. It is right in the city centre very close to tram 28, and you can walk to anywhere in Lisboa. The apartment is brand new and in top condition - comfortable bed, good bathroom and everything looks nice. Can definitely recommend this place, its awesome and great value for money. Hugo was also so kind to pick us up and we were welcomed by him.

Le logement était parfaitement conforme aux photos : très lumineux, hyper propre et très bien agencé. L'ouverture / balcon avec vue sur le Tage est un sacré bonus ! Quartier calme, ruelles parfaites pour se promener et profiter des restaurants aux alentours.
Silvia et Hugo sont des hôtes parfaits, nous reviendrons !!

Alles war optimal vorbereitet, von der Abholung am Flughafen (mit kleiner Sightseeing-Runde durch die Stadt) bis zu einem "Notfall"-Handy. Bei Fragen hätten wir jederzeit Hugo & Silvia erreichen können, was aber nicht notwendig war. Die Wohnung ist sehr schön und geschmackvoll eingerichtet mit allem, was man für einen Kurzurlaub benötigt. Genau wie die Bilder es auch zeigen. Der Blick auf den Tejo ist wunderbar. Die Wohnung liegt sehr schön im Alfama-Viertel und man kann auch sehr viel zu Fuss erreichen.
Alles in Allem hatten wir sehr schöne Tage in Lissabon in einer schönen Wohnung. Sie ist auf jeden Fall empfehlenswert ! Wir wünschen Hugo & Silvia weiterhin viel Erfolg !

It was a wonderful stay in Lisbon and I'd love to go back.   Everything was good...  Hugo was well organized and flexible, and kind to let us stay a bit late the day of our departure.  The apartment is lovely with the view and all the light coming in, but they've made an effort to fill it with nice stuff too.  I really enjoyed the location in Alfama... so beautiful but the street felt a bit off the tourist track, and it was easy to get anywhere.  Definitely recommended.

We had an amazing time at Hugo and Silvia's apartment. It's located in a beautiful, historic part of the city and everything we could have needed was within a short walking distance. Hugo was extremely friendly in picking us up from the train station upon our arrival, then giving us a brief overview of must-see attractions and destinations. Everything in the apartment was clean, new, and working - and comes with a beautiful view out the window. Thank you!!

The apartment was fantastic! Great location, quiet, but still accessible to nearby attractions and close to some great Fado spots. The apartment was clean and cozy, and Hugo even had a bottle of wine waiting for us when we arrived. Communication was very good and I would highly recommend booking this apartment!

Bright cosy and comfortable apartment . Brilliant shower lots hot water. Great location near all amenities . Surrounded by very good restaurants. Wonderful host. Drove us from the airport and gave lots of information and very hospatible. Only a phone call away if needed! Would highly recommend this apartment

Hugo was a lovely host and the house was 100% as listed on the site. Hugo kept us informed to see if everything was fine throughout our holiday.  He was generous to pickup from the Airport and bring us to the apartment for a small fee.

Notre séjour a Lisbonne a été plus qu'agreable et en grande partie grace a Hugo and Silvia. Leur appartement etait parfait, tres bien situé et équipé, propre, lumineux avec une si jolie vue sur le Tage et l'Alfama, comme sur les photos! Nous avions hésité a leur demander de venir nous chercher a l'aeroport, mais heureusement qu'Hugo est venu! Petite visite guidée en voiture, avec des renseignements bien utiles. Que de souvenirs mémorables! Je recommande cet appartement vivement. Merci et a bientot

We just stayed about 4 days in the lovely and cosy apartment of Hugo und Silvia. Everything was clean and tidy and we had everything we needed. But the best was the view over the harbour of the city! Just awesome!
Thank you for the great time in Lisbon.

We visited Lisboa to run the half marathon and to relax a few days. The apartment was the perfect place to do so. Without Hugo driving us to the registration office we would have been to late for the run. Thanks again Hugo, you were a perfect host! The apartment looks exactly like on the pictures. The view is even better!
Great place to go in the heart of alfama, the oldest-and nicest-part of Lisboa. Because the apartment is on the upper floor of the old house, you have to get up some very narrow stairs, but for us it was a good training. I fully recommend Hugo and his apartment! Thanks for all!

We had a wonderful stay at the Alfama Blue House. It is a very neat, tasteful apartment with everything you need for a comfortable stay. Hugo and Silvia are very welcoming, responsible and responsive hosts. It was a pleasure to book and stay with them.
Thank you!

Le logement neuf, super équipe, quelques produits pour l'usage courant, des attentions de la part du propriétaire.vue sur le Tage, environnement calme, mais a proximité des restau, logement très agréable, ensoleillé, et sans vis a vis. Juste parfait

We had a wonderful stay in Hugo and Silvia's beautiful and very clean appartement with the most breathtaking view. Hugo picked us up from the airport and gave us a lot of Information on the City and surroundings + took us to one of the viewing points overlooking the town!
We would definitely stay here again and recommend to anyone planning to stay in Lisbon! Trank you!

The host was extremely helpful and friendly. Hugo picked us up from the airport and brought us to the apartment and showed us around. He was able to give us information about the area and some things to do. The apartment was beautiful and perfectly cleaned. The host was friendly and helpful and the apartment was even better than we had hoped for. Overall it really made for a lovely experience in Lisbon to have such a nice place to enjoy with a beautiful view.  The neighborhood was great, the perfect place to be, very authentic, small cobblestone streets and staircases and delicious food around every corner.

Hugo est un hôte très accueillant : il est venu nous chercher à l'aéroport et nous a fait visiter le quartier avant de nous présenter l'appartement; le logement est très charmant, lumineux et décoré avec beaucoup de goût; il est bien équipé, tout est prévu dans les moindres détails; depuis les fenêtres, la vue sur le Tage est superbe; le quartier d'Alfama  est typique avec ses ruelles et son fameux tramway jaune  28; on peut rejoindre facilement le centre ville en tramway ou en 15 mn à pieds; je recommande cette location pour un séjour de charme à Lisbonne.

Prima locatie, vlakbij het centrum, kasteel en tram 28. Wij werden snel opgehaald door Hugo van het vliegveld en alvorens naar appartement te gaan heeft hij vanaf uitzichtpunt tips gegeven over de stad en waar heen te gaan. Er stond een lekkere fles wijn klaar en hij heeft zelfs een telefoon ter beschikking om hem te bereiken zodat je niet internationaal naar hem hoeft te bellen! Schoon appartement, mooi uitzicht. Hugo heeft nog voor ons gebeld of er kluisjes zijn op metrostation Orient , bij Parc de Nacions  is prima laatste stop onderweg naar vliegveld (3 stations verder).

Our stay at Hugo's apartment in Alfama, Lisbon, was a great experience.

Hugo provided us with a warm welcome by picking us up from the airport and giving us an overview of the city from one of the viewpoints. After arriving at the apartment, he provided some further ideas for exploring the city and left a bottle of Portuguese red wine as a welcome gift. Throughout our stay, the apartment felt like a second home to us. It was clean, well decorated and equipped with everything we needed. Additionally it resides in a "strategically" good location in the Alfama district of Lisbon from where you can reach many sights by foot - subway and tram aren't far either.

TL;DL
Awesome host + clean, beautiful and well equipped apartment + good location = great Lisbon trip

Nous avons passé un superbe séjour dans cet appartement de rêve , car très ensoleillé avec une vue magnifique sur les paquebots qui accostaient le matin sur le port de Lisbonne... Il est également très confortable , d'une propreté irréprochable, et il dispose de tout ce dont nous avions besoin.
De plus, Silvia est venue nous chercher et Hugo nous a raccompagnés à l'aéroport, ce qui est très agréable, d'autant que le tarif était tout à fait raisonnable.
Tout était parfait.
Merci à Hugo et Silvia.
Françoise et Patrice

Our stay in Lisbon was just wonderful. Hugo and Silvia contributed largely to this great experience. Their lovely apartment in the heart of Alfama is perfect to discover the city. Entirely renovated, it's nicely furnished and will provide you with everything you need. The view of the river Tago is splendid. Hugo picked us up at the airport and drove us to a viewpoint in Graça before taking us to the apartement. I would definitely recommend this place !

Our stay in Lisbon has been a fantastic experience and the flat was perfect. The location is wonderful and the appartment bright and well arrange. Finally, Hugo's welcome was very friendly and warm.
We'll definetely come back !

We felt very welcomed.  Hugo was waiting for us when we arrived very late on a rainy night and took us to the flat. We found fruit and a sandwich waiting for us and an immaculately clean flat with everything we might need.  There was ample space in the bathroom for my own toiletries, and the shower was wonderful. The view was amazing and we loved having coffee or wine in the living room and gazing out to see the ships. The kitchen was well equipped and my husband is a chef so we enjoyed most meals in the flat. Location was also very good just a few minutes from the no. 28 tramway. Washer in the flat was also very handy. Hugo and Silvia certainly thought of everything and Hugo was especially kind in answering any questions promptly and driving us to and from the airport.  Weather was a bit miserable for going out at night(but you will find an umbrella in the flat in case you need it) but there are many DVD's so we enjoyed watching them in the evening. We would not hesitate to stay here again and highly recommend this flat for a fantastic stay in Lisbon.  Neighborhood is also quiet and friendly.

We had a nice time in a beatiful apartment! - lovely location and nicly done up. I must recommend Hugo & Silvia's apartment; Great hosts! We got a nice guide at beforehand and also during our stay. A great service: a smartphone with potugouse sim! We loved to stay at Hugo & Silvia's apartment and now where to stay in Lissabon next time. :)

I woul definitivly recommand this place.
The appartment is lovely and very well located in the charming neighborhood of Afalma.
Hugo is a wonderfull host, very kind and helpfull.
Thanks again.

We stayed at Alfama Blue House over the new year's eve, and it was just lovely. The flat was spotlessly clean, has a serene river view with lots of sunlight into the living room. It's super close to the tram, attractions like Castelo, flea market, and only eleven minute walk away from the metro station. It's also walkable to Baixa/Chiado area. Hugo picked us up from the airport and showed us the spot where we could see the view of sun-down Alfama.
There was a couple of things to know, the power might go out if you use more than two machines(oven, microwave, space heater or washing machine) at once. You can turn it back on in the fuse box in the living room. It's an neighborhood with old buildings and renovations going on so there is a chance you might some banging noise in the morning. I slept through as the bedroom is away from the windows but if you are sensitive, earplugs are good item to have.
I'd recommend to friends and definitely come back to Alfama blue house on my next trip to Lisbon.

We werden door Hugo van het vliegveld opgehaald wat erg prettig was. Het scheelt erg veel tijd en kost maar €10. Bij aankomst stond er een fleswijn klaar! Het appartement voldeed aan alle verwachtingen. Door de inrichting en kleurgebruik was het ruim voor twee personen. De douche was heerlijk, het bed prima en de keuken was modern en picobello. De ligging van het appartement is top! Drie minuten lopen van de tram naar het centrum. Ook te voet is het centrum geen probleem, zeker niet als je de gratis liften omhoog neemt. The neighborhood was perfect for evening strolls and enjoying local fado music. It was a perfect location for accessing public  transportation, enjoying Lisbon and surroundings.

Dear Hugo and Silvia,

Alfama blue House is a lovely modern apartment set in a characterful part of Lisbon. Hugo met us at the airport and showed us some spectacular views of Lisbon and Alfama before taking us to the apartment. Super appartement, très bien situé. Le tram est à 3 minutes. En plein coeur de l'alfama, le soir, on entend les chanteurs de fado des restos voisins. C'est très agréable. Belle vue sur le tage.

Hugo and Silvia were perfect hosts. They were constantly in touch prior to our stay and on arrival very kindly collected us from the station and showed us around the area...a real bonus!

Eine sehr modern und liebevoll eingerichtete Wohnung in Lissabons Altstadt Alfama. Ein Stadtteil mit engen Gassen, kleinen Hinterhöfen und kleine Wohnungen. An zwei Tagen konnten wir vom Fenster aus beobachten, wie Kreuzfahrtschiffe anlegten.
Silvia und Hugo sind überaus gastfreundlich. Sie stellen nicht nur eine Wohnung zur Verfügung, sondern kümmern sich auch sehr um ihre Gäste. In der Wohnung ist an alles gedacht. Schön, auf diese Art mit Portugiesen ins Gespräch zu kommen - privates Sightseeing inklusive. Absolut empfehlenswert!

Hugo and Sylvia were wonderful hosts. Incredibly thoughtful down to the tiniest details. The neighborhood is very hilly, with giant staircases and old cobblestones -- so feels very authentic, but may not be right for anyone with any kind of accessibility issues. The apartment is lovely and the view of the water is incredible. Thanks for everything!

Very nice, clean, modern apartment in the heart of Alfama, old part of Lisbon.
Very good location for sightseeing, as well as, to enjoy nightlife opportunities of Alfama.
We will definitely come back to Lisbon and we will choose Hugo & Silva flat again, as we had all we needed.

The apartment was exactly as expected. Cozy, clean, and with a great view. The location and neighborhood (Alfama) were perfect for our needs. Easy to get around town, shopping, nightlife etc. without to big of a fuss.

Overall, we really enjoyed our stay at Alfama Blue House and the trip to Lisabon.

We had a great stay in Lisbon, the city is wonderful, the appartement perfect and hugo very nice. The flat looks the same as on the pictures, very clean and quiet. Even a surprise was waiting for us.

Die Wohnung und die Aussicht waren sehr, sehr schön und wir haben uns sehr wohl gefüllt.

The apartment was exactly as the pictures. Cosy, clean, fully equipped with a great view. The location and neighborhood was great. Alfama was the right place to stay. We just felt like locals in Lisbon.

Hugo and Silvia were the perfect hosts! Really informative and helpful...and fantastic at communicating before the trip.

Silvia picked us up from the airport and while driving us back to the apartment she gave us a quick run-down of all of the neighborhoods in Lisbon.

Alfama blue house was the perfect place to stay to visit Lisbon. The apartment is very well renovated and located in the most charming area of the city.

L'appartement est parfait, très beau, très propre et idéalement situé à Lisbonne en plein coeur de l'Alfama. L'accueil est simplement excellent et très attentionné ! Vraiment rien à redire, Lisbonne est une ville magnifique et l'Alfama Blue House est idéal pour la découvrir !

We spent 5 days in Lisbon and the Alfama Blue House was perfect for us. Alfama is truly special and you will love getting lost in its tiny streets and staircases. The flat has been very tastefully decorated with everything you could possibly need (TV, free Wi-Fi, oven, fridge, washing machine, hairdryer...). The photos shown in the description are genuine and you will be stunned by the amazing views of the river and Alfama from the balcony. Tram 28 is only 2mn walk away and there are a number of great Fado restaurants with a very local feel.
Our hosts, Hugo and Silvia have been extremely kind to us, from responding quickly to requests, sending information with suggestions of things to see/do in Lisbon, to offering to pick us up from the airport, even leaving a bottle of wine as a welcome gift on the kitchen table. They are discreet, but helpful if you need them and despite being busy with the flat's success, they've managed to make hosts feel special.
We cannot recommend Alfama Blue House enough - thank you so much Hugo and Silvia, you deserve the success!

Overall, our experience at the Alfama apartment was a great one!

We arrived during the Sardine Festival and had an amazing time watching the parades from above, before joining in ourselves!

The house is really cute, confortable and clean, a place where you can feel at home... and it's in an excellent location in the wonderful neighbourhood of Alfama, walking distance to most of the spots of the city. Furthermore, Hugo is an amazing host who is ready to give you a hand and who has planned everything concerning your stay carefully. Such small details can make a big difference

Our stay at Alfama Blue House has simply been fabulous! Hugo was kind enough to meet us and explain everything about the house. He was always available and helpful with our questions/problems. Amazing appartement! We had a perfect stay! The place has an amazing view. Very nice hosts as well! Very much recommended!

Lucy was so lovely! She greeted us at the apartment and showed us around. We loved this Airbnb and wished we could have stayed here for more than one night! The location was perfect. The place had everything we needed :)
Lucy and Mat's penthouse was the perfect place to unwind efter exploring Lisbon. It has easy access to every part of the city and the views are unbeatable
Eine Oase mitten in der Stadt mit einer mehr als ausreichenden Ausstattung für einen kurzen oder langen Aufenthalt. Lucy ist eine sehr freundliche Gastgeberin.

Very nice apartment, well appointed with high end finish.

Nous avons passé un agréable séjour chez Lucy ! L’appartement est super et proche du centre ville. Propre et la vue est superbe ! Je recommande ++
Lovely apartment, lovely location, lovely host

Highly recommend a stay at Mat and Lucy’s rooftop abode. Spectacular views, and Mat & Lucy are great hosts! A pleasure to chat with Mat, although we only stopped for one night, it was a great stay.

Lucy & Mat’s place provided us with great views of the city from their rooftop! We really enjoyed our stay - only wish we got to stay longer. They were also very responsive throughout the duration of our stay.
Excellent séjour et encore merci à Mat pour son accueil .
Lucy and Mat were great hosts and super accommodating. Lots of great local recommendations.
Great place! We wish we had more time! Amazing balcony!

Fabulous stay at Lucy & Mat's - gorgeous apartment, spotlessly clean and in a great location. Very friendly and helpful hosts too. Highly recommend staying here.

Amazing
