Lucy and May were responsive hosts and welcoming. The place is efficient and tidy. This is a unique and cute place and not for anyone with mobility challenges.
Having construction next door didn’t matter to us as we were gone all day and out the door early.

Thank you Lucy and Mat for providing such a nice place to stay in our time at Lisbon. They were so helpful and kind, and the apartment was lovely. Lots of light, clean, and beautiful patio area. Their cats even came up to play with us!!!
Also, I had a passport emergency and they gave advice on what we could do. Thank you !
Lucy was so kind and helpful. The place is exactly like the pictures and the outdoor area is very private. Lucy was great with local recs and was so kind! The place was spotless too!

Perfect Penthouse Paradise - A spiral staircase to a unique haven. Quaint and quiet (for Lisbon - it’s a lively city), with fabulous views across the city to the sea and up the hill across the park. This is a fabulous apartment with great hosts.
We were met personally for a great check in. The apartment was extremely clean, very unique and in an ideal location. We had breakfast on the way into the centre each day at Simpli (4 mins away), and Numa Cafe (15 mins away) but on way to the main areas.
If you like craft beer you need to visit Brew, Queen Of Ale and Crafty Corner and have their beer flights. We ate at the local Salta which was heavenly, and the Italian Forno d'Oro.
It is a great location to explore all that Lisbon has to offer.
The apartment perched amid the rooftops of Lisbon is the perfect location to do all of this from, and the most fantastic place to retreat to for some sunbathing before tea, or to cosy up and watch the world go by.
The location and views are wonderful
I wish I had spent more days at Lucy and Matt’s place! From check in, during my stay and checkout the experience was top tier! 10/10 I definitely recommend!!

Lucy was warm and welcoming on arrival, and we managed to communicate the essentials in spite of the language barrier. The lodging itself was just the right amount of space and the views of the city were expansive, even under stormy skies. I do wish I had paid a little more attention to the photos because navigating the outdoor spiral staircase in the rain to get up and down to the apartment required careful attention, but that was information I had prior to my trip. The location was fabulous - walkable, close to the metro, and plenty of spots nearby to get food. Since it was a holiday weekend, there was no construction going on next door and I enjoyed peace and quiet at the beginning and end of my days of touring. The decor of the apartment was charming and the whole place was clean and comfortable. Lisbon is a wonderful city and I'd love to stay at Lucy & Mat's place whenever I return.
Lucy and Mat were very responsive and accomodating. Great views and a such a cute little place.
Great place with very cool rooftop area and view!
Superbe penthouse bien situé dans le centre. Nous y avons passé 3 nuits et tout s’est bien passé :-)
Lucy and Mat are awesome. Their place is beautiful!!! Would definitely stay again!

Lucy & Mat’s place is simply stunning. What an amazing spot, we absolutely loved our stay here. Lucy was incredibly kind & responsive and made sure that we had everything we needed. Would go back in a heartbeat!!
Lovely location to take in the views of the city.
Un appartement en hauteur, belle vue sur Lisbonne, emplacement parfait pour ceux et celles qui veulent contempler et marcher la ville et se balader dans le merveilleux parc Parc Eduardo VII.

Lucy’s place was exactly as described, and a great place to land before seeing the rest of Portugal. Although it is in a busy neighborhood, it was up so high that it was a great place to go and relax. Had we stayed, it was also set up well to get groceries nearby and cook some meals as well. Even though the 5th floor makes you go up a winding staircase, it is not so hard, and the first 4 are in a nice elevator. Would definitely return.

Lucy is very kind and helpful.
Great apartment and location.
10/10
Asombroso lugar muy limpio bonito y bien situado, perfecto para un pareja
Amazing top floor flat with a panoramic view of Lisboa! Unique spiral staircase & old school lift to get you up there. Lucy was very kind & a great host :)

This is a stunning rooftop apartment with great views south to the river, and north uninterrupted over the park. Lucy and Mat were excellent hosts (they live below but gave us plenty of privacy) and incredibly communicative. It is nicely kitted out - cooking for yourself is highly plausible.
Great for a couple for a few days, well located and near the Metro, and with plenty within walking distance. The flat gets sun throughout the day and large glass patio doors can be pulled back to let the outside in.
A really positive experience, though this isn't a place for people with limited mobility (or lots of luggage!), as there are quite a few steps to access the property.

Lucy has made a very special space for her guests.  You can tell that they really care about being good hosts.  Be prepared to hoist your bags up a small steep stairwell.  Luckily we packed light!  Once you are there it is quite lovely.

Experiência 7/10. Espaço impecável, limpeza, localização, o contacto com o anfitrião é ótimo e rápido. Tudo maravilhoso
Porém só a duas horas do Check in é que fomos informados que havia 2 obras dos lados, por sua vez não fizeram barulho mas estão constantemente pessoas a passar em todas as janelas e a espreitar por todo o lado, o que se torna muito chato visto a casa ser 50% janelas. Acabamos por ter uma vista incrível mas temos de ter tudo fechado.
Great little flat in a perfect location to explore Lisbon. Lucy was great and very helpful. Comfortable bed, nice and quiet place considering your on a busy street.

Beautiful Airbnb! The nicest place we stayed at in Portugal. Amazing views. Lucy was extremely kind, understanding, and easy to communicate with. Easy to find parking nearby and great restaurants within walking distance.  Definitely recommend.

Lucy and Mat went above and beyond for us. Our flight got in at 7:00, although they couldn’t let us into the space yet since others were still there, they opened their home to us storing our belonging until the roof top unit was free. Once there, everything was super clean and looked just like the photos. Honestly, a dream to stay in. And very close to many activities as well as public transportation. Lucy gave us recommendations for Fado we requested and helped us out immensely even after we had checked out. Absolutely deserving of the “super host” badge.

This place was so cute, cozy and exactly what we expected. Lucy went above and beyond accommodating an early luggage drop off, having the apartment ready for us early, and providing prompt and clear instructions for our arrival. She also helped tremendously with providing local recommendations on things to do and see while we were in the area. I would highly recommend this Airbnb for your stay in Lisbon. The location is super convenient in terms of proximity to public transit options which makes it seamless to get around wherever you would like to go.
Lucy was a wonderful host. She ensured all our needs were being met and went above and beyond to make a comfortable stay. The view of the AirBnB gives you a wonderful look at all of Lisbon.
This is a truly special place with an incredible view of the city. The hosts were incredibly responsive, considerate and helpful. I absolutely recommend this site.

Lucy was so accommodating! Our flight from Naples was delayed and we didn’t end up getting to the air bnb until after midnight. Lucy made sure to stay awake so she was able to let us in and go over everything. Very sweet and gave us a whole list of recommendations. Would stay here again and have already shared the listing with a friend!

Wir hatten eine tolle Zeit in Lissabon! Das zauberhafte Apartment hat uns unsere Tage in Lissabon versüßt. Der Blick über die Dächer der Stadt, die Einrichtung der Wohnung… wir haben es geliebt. Lucy war sehr freundlich und super zu erreichen. Herzlichen Dank für alles…

Staying at this place is more than worth it, it's truly unique on the rooftop of a building. The apartment is as described and the pictures don't do it justice. Location is central, lots of things to reach via walking, metro, Uber. Can highly recommend staying here.
A great location & good views.  Walking distance to most things but also easy access to Metro & buses. The apartment is a lovely design,  very comfortable  and met all our needs.
Lucy was lovely and incredibly responsive to all messages. The place was gorgeous and had everything we needed along with good recommendations and info in the guest book. We had a great time!

Lucy and Mat communicated promptly and clearly with instructions to get there. Apartment was immaculate and clean. Great views and very central. Would definitely recommend!!
Cat

We only stayed with Lucy and Mat for one night but it was a great experience. The unit is exactly as shown in the pictures, the location is perfect, and the bed is very comfortable. Communication with Lucy was seemless and she was super helpful and responsive (with great recommendations). Wouldn't hesitate to stay here again!

Excellently located quirky apartment with great views over the city.
Central location but quiet at night and close to public transport hubs.
We had a great stay in Lisbon at Mat and Lucy’s rooftop Airbnb. Great hosts and the place looked just like the picture. It was a welcoming spot to come back to after exploring the city each day.

Lucy and Mat’s place is a rooftop oasis. The design touches are first rate, the view is sensational, and they are most-welcoming hosts. The next time I’m in Lisbon, I would love to stay there again one day!

Das Appartement ist sehr schön eingerichtet. Die Dachterasse ist nicht zu topen. Wenn man sich in Lisboa auskennt ist auch der etwas ausserhalb gelegene Standort optimal für den Hinweg in die Stadt. Retour kann man sich gut für 6-7 Stutz ein Taxi nehmen
Absolutely faultless! A hidden gem. It is something that could be featured on grand designs. Thank you Lucy & Mat for being such wonderful & flexible hosts. The port was gorgeous!

This was the PERFECT place to stay for our few nights in Lisbon. The apartment is amazing - even better than in photos. The view from the terrace is incredible and the apartment itself is incredibly comfortable. I’m a great location that combines proximity to attractions with a bit of a quieter more residential setting. We had dinner at Rosamar which was in Mat and Lucy’s extensive recommendation list and it was incredible. If we ever find ourselves back in Lisbon, we will certainly stay here again!

Just checked out of Lucy and Mat’s place after a week’s stay. Lucy was very attentive to our needs (we arrived when the city was incredibly busy with a religious festival) and, whilst she was out of the country, continued to look after us well throughout our stay. A special thanks too to Eugenie for all her help. The apartment was a perfect sanctuary from the lovely, vibrant - but hot - city. The apartment was a 20 minute walk into the heart of everything which we really enjoyed. We loved the panoramic views, the large terrace and the stylish apartment. We felt very lucky to have found it and would highly recommend a stay here. Thank you Lucy and Mat. Ps we fell in love with your little cats who were inquisitive, friendly and very well behaved!

Lucy & Mat were incredible hosts. Lucy took the time to talk to us about the local restaurants and also tips on how to get around the city.
The space was super clean and looked incredible!
Would love to stay again!
Lucy was a lovely host and the flat was even nicer than it looked from the listing! We loved our stay and would happily come back again
Extraordinary
Absolutely stunning place. The view was outstanding. Worth every penny.
We loved everything about our stay! The apartment exceeded expectations and was a peaceful sanctuary after busy days of touring around Lisbon.

Really well thought out space. Felt very trendy and up market. Quiet, secluded but so easy to get right to the heart of the city.
Everything you needed was there with an amazing roof terrace. Mat and Lucy were responsive and helpful. Also very flexible as our arrival flight was late. We had such a great stay here and highly recommend!
Lucy & May were excellent hosts- very friendly, responsive and personable. Their place was beautiful, extremely comfortable and equipped with everything we needed. Thank you!

Absolutely loved this stay! This little rooftop home that Lucy and Mat have created was perfect. I dreamt of enjoying beautiful balcony views of Portugal with my love and it’s exactly what we got. With city greenery and ocean views we were so happy. A little tired from travelling it’s also a place we felt happy to stay home and hang out in also, getting take away and just enjoying our very private feeling view. The place has everything you need for a long stay. We ate and explored a lot of there local (and day trip) recommendations and everything was so good! Forno pizza was to die for!
So many places to eat/drink and sight see near by. We love longer walks so felt the location was perfect for adventuring whilst staying out of hustle and bustle of tourist areas. It’s on Busy road, but it’s still super easy access and so so quiet. Thanks guys

Our stay at Lucy & Mat’s apartment was great, it lived up to expeditions and some.
The space was very clean and well put together. They were very accommodating and helpful when needed.
We would definitely recommend staying here and would 100% come back ourselves.
We really enjoyed this beautiful apartment.  Nicely furnished, great little kitchen and comfy bed.  The plants and outside area are amazing.
What a wonderful apartment. Very good and nice communication with the owners.  We can highly recommend it.
We can’t recommend Lucy & Mat’s place enough. They were fantastic hosts!

This airbnb rooftop is sooooo beautiful. Super clean and modern. Extremely comfortable. Beautiful plants everywhere. Two lounge chairs to relax with a magnificent view. You have access to the entire terrace. You also have a table with 4 chairs which gives you a view of another part of Lisbon. Lucy is such an awesome host. Super friendly and great communication. I highly recommend this place. Thanks again for everything ❤️

logement qui correspond aux photos vraiment parfait et très bien situé, Lucy est très réactive et à pu réalisé un extra demander par mes soins

This place blew me away! Looks like a mini botanical garden when you first see it. Just incredible. Very comfortable bed and pillows too! Great location for getting around Lisboa easily. This will be the only place I book when visiting Lisboa again

What unique and fun experience to live in the cutest little house on a roof top in Lisboa!  Staying at Lucy & Mat’s place makes you feel special because you have the key to enter one of those historic buildings, most others only get to admire as passersby.  The marble steps, high ceilings, and old-fashioned elevator – super charming and so is the modern looking sauna like hut that greets you after climbing a narrow spiral staircase to the roof garden.  Lucy was friendly, welcoming, and helpful with our luggage and parking. Highly recommend this place as well as dining at the best Italian pizza place in town, five-minute walk, Forno D’Oro.  Obrigada & Obrigado.
Amazing place in Lisbon. Private space within walking distance of everything. Lucy and Mat’s recommendations were great. Our only regret was not staying longer.

A wonderful apartment. It’s effectively a summer house on top of a  4 storey building with all the amenities that you need. The view is wonderful in both directions and you really do feel on holiday because it is such a different type of accommodation. Fabulous outdoor space as well, both in front and behind the unit. Beautifully furnished, really comfortable bed and well equipped, a truly novel experience. Lucy was very responsive and flexible. Because of the layout of her premises, we were able to leave our bags securely after we checked out and dropped the keys when we collected them later. Thoroughly recommend !!

This place is perfect. No matter what you are expecting, it's better. From the unparalleled view to the modern and chic interior, the space is drenched in natural light and gives off beach chalet vibes...despite being a penthouse in the city. It was the perfect place for a Lisbon residency! Lucy was great and very responsive and provided great recommendations. Checkout was flexible. There is also an adorable kitty who will visit at all hours of the day! I loved staying here and will absolutely return.

Great location and the private deck is wonderful with places to sit outside to relax and take in the great views of the city.  Lucy could not have been nicer or more responsive.  Truly enjoyable stay.

We decided to stay here for our last night in Lisbon and we had a very relaxing stay. Clean and as pictured. It really is such a cool space. Beautiful rooftop view. Good communication with host. Would recommend for people looking to have a quieter stay outside of the city center.

When we got up to the unit at Lucy & Mat’s our breath was literally taken away. We had seen the pics but it didn’t compare! We were running late for our check in and were trying to catch a big soccer match that night and Lucy so kindly helped us get our stuff all settled, gave us keys/ further instructions and helped us right back out the door and on our way! Highly recommend: cappuccinos on the balcony in the mornings, catching a storm come through the city looking out all the windows on the roof (magic!), and checking off as much on Lucy & Mat’s guidebook as you can - it was all there. Lucy also came in clutch with a late night recommendation for us for after the soccer match - thank you again!!!
Beautiful spot right in the heart of Lisbon! One of the best spots we've ever stayed. The rooftop views were spectacular. Lucy was very responsive and a great host!

Un vrai Panthouse comme dans les films 😉 Beau, Propre, Confortable et que dire de la vue… incroyable 🤩
Lucy est d’une gentillesse remarquable! Communication rapide et irréprochable! On s’est senti comme chez soi ☺️ J’ai adoré et je recommande à tous sans aucune hésitation 😍 Merci pour tout Lucy 🤗
Nathalie et François
Lucy & Mat’s place is so beautiful. Located in one the nicest area. It’s walkable to most restaurant and luxury shops down the road. The view is amazing as well. Enjoyed our stay.

This place is so special! My husband and I stayed here for two nights and we wished it was longer! The space is so unique and also very well situated for walking places and using transit. The host’s communication was excellent and we would stay there again in a heartbeat!
absolutely recommend this place!

This was a really great stay. Central location, high up from the hustle and bustle with really amazing views. It was modern and cosy in the apartment yet in an old building through an amazing door with traditional lift and staircase. There is a great pastry and coffee shop just a few meters up the hill and the terrace is a great morning spot to enjoy it. So much to see and do in Lisbon and this place offers a really great place to stay and base yourself. Thoroughly recommend it.

We loved our stay at Lucy and Mat's apartment.  Our host were very welcoming and helpful.  Great location with lots to do in the surrounding area.  Very peaceful area, beautiful views and loved listening to and watching the birds flying over the neighbouring park . The apartment was very spacious with plenty of out door space and furniture.  The apartment was spotless and well equipped.  We would certainly think about using the apartment again if we visit Lisbon.

If you're headed to Lisbon, this is the place to stay. It's beautiful and perfect for a couple with beautiful views and ideal amenities. Lucy was very communicative and quick to respond. Remember that Lisbon is a city built on hills so be prepared. There were some great bakeries and markets in the area. There is a bus stop right outside the front door of the building and a metro station a few minutes walk away. We couldn't have asked for a better experience. We can't wait to come back again.
Really nice stay at the apartment. Lucy and Mat are really nice Hosts, our stay was really comfortable and cozy. Next time staying in Lissabon we will definitely come back to this apartment!

Lucy and Mat’s roof top apartment was such a treat. Lucy provided me with a friendly welcome, a thorough, review of everything about the apartment, and a wonderful itinerary for my first day in Lisbon. The location near a huge park was perfect for a peaceful walk while recovering from my jetlag.
I only stayed the one night before joining friends but I felt that the apartment had everything I needed. The bed was very comfortable and I particularly enjoyed the balcony view while sipping a glass of Porto shared by my hosts! Thank you Lucy and Mat. I would love to return!

Lucy and Mat’s apartment is lovelier that the photos shown. To me, the highlight of my five nights in Lisbon were the evenings on the terrace as the views are stunning. Their place had everything needed for a comfortable stay, comfortable bed, complete kitchen, great air circulation due to the windows and the wall of sliding glass doors and only a two minute walk to the metro. Lucy was very quick to respond to any questions I had about the surrounding area and even reached out to me to make sure my stay was exceptional. I plan on returning.
This was an incredible stay and Lucy was so helpful. An awesome penthouse apartment with spectacular views! I highly recommend and woukd stay there any time in the future.

Great location. Close to metro and rental cars. Friendly host. Loved spending time on the deck. Great view. Upper floor so it's quiet for being in the city.
Would stay again.

Great location to many good restaurants and bars. It was fantastic having our host living in the building as well which made me happy. Lucy was so welcoming. The view and balcony are spacious. The only negatives were the size of the shower and it was a little ricky getting down the spiral staircase with my luggage but those were minor and it was definitely worth the money.

We had a great time at Lucy and Mat’s place. Lucy was very friendly and responsive. They provided us with the local information and restaurant locations, we have tried at least 3 and were not disappointed at all.
They have 2 cats, one of them came to say hi and came to visit us again in the morning, we love animals and enjoyed her company a lot! Lucy made sure we were okay with the cat, otherwise she would let it outside, so don’t be scared if you don’t want to interact with the cat, just let her know upfront.
The place is very bright and has lots of fresh air. We left some windows open at night and slept very well.
It’s 5 minutes walk to the blue subway line that takes you right to the centre of old Lisbon.
I’d definitely recommend this apartment!

Lucy & Mat’s place was perfect for us! The views of the city are amazing, nice to get a lay of the land from up there. All of their recommendations were excellent -from food to museums. Lucy greeted us so warmly upon our jet-lagged arrival and was very helpful the whole time. These accommodations made our stay in Lisbon just delightful.

We arrived late with no bags, as the airline lost our luggage. Lucy greeted us and bent over backwards to help us get the essentials we needed for our short stay.  She used her phone to call the airline and even gave us tote bags to travel with our few remaining items.  She was a little light of hope in an otherwise stressful situation, as our first day in a new country! Plus her apartment is ADORABLE!!
Had a fantastic time at Lucy and Matt’s place, it is super cute, the location is amazing too. Lucy is a great host. We would recommend the flat. Definitely 5 star all the way 😊

Lucy & Mat's place was gorgeous, warm, has a beautiful view, and as pictured in their pictures! My only regret is that I was only able to stay at their place for one evening. Lucy was absolutely wonderful showing me the space and also had a wonderful neighborhood guide as well. Highly recommend!

Fantastic trip and would highly recommend staying here. Lucy is very friendly and accommodating. Lots of useful information about the area and recommendations which we used throughout our stay. The accommodation is lovely. Great space with an outside terrace and stunning views - perfect for relaxing before or after a busy day, and seeing the sunrise. Very clean and tidy with everything you would need for your stay. Great location - close to a nice park, restaurants, public transport links, shops and sights.

Lucy was extremely helpful and friendly, a really attentive host. Lucy and Mat’s place is beautiful, arguably even nicer than the photos (which I didn’t think would be possible!)
The place is clearly well looked after with a gorgeous view over Lisbon. There were lots of recommendations and a guide book that Lucy and Mat had put together themselves which was extremely helpful. The location was also walkable to all the key places to visit.
Would definitely recommend and would stay there again if I return to Lisbon!

Everything about this place was spot on. Beautiful apartment in a great location with spectacular views. Bed was incredibly comfortable, the coffee machine was a nice addition, but the terrace was the main  attraction. We loved having our breakfast on the loungers planning our day from the guide books Lucy and Mat put together. They gave great recommendations and were altogether very friendly, accommodating and quick to respond. We will definitely be coming back and recommend this place to friends and family 😊

Stayed at Lucy and Mat's great space for a weekend trip! Honestly one of the best Air Bnbs I've ever stayed in, great space, brilliant views and although central enough still offered a brilliant level of peace and privacy. Handbook with recommendations to local spots was a also a really nice touch! Would highly recommend for anyone looking for a short/ long stay in a great city! Flexible check out was really useful too, gave us another day!

Séjour plus que parfait grâce au logement de Lucy & Mat !
Si je retourne à Lisbonne, je m'arrangerais pour pouvoir loger chez eux de nouveau. Appartement incroyable, encore mieux qu'en photos.

Lucy and Matt were wonderful hosts.  I was able to drop my luggage early so I could get to a class I signed up for.  Lucy was very friendly and gave me great suggestions for things to do and places to eat. You basically have the rooftop to yourself which is very private and has amazing views….it’s very unique! As a woman traveling alone I felt very safe staying there.  The space itself is a lovely treasure inside of Lisbon. I would definitely stay there again!

Lovely place in a great part of Lisbon.
Centrally located, we were able to walk everywhere we wanted to go. Lucy met and welcomed us in, she was very organized and provided great recommendations for groceries and dining. I appreciated the manual she had for the flat, as well as the guidebooks she provided.
The building itself is lovely art deco. It was a $10 Uber ride from the airport.
We felt safe during our stay.
There's a mini-mart within a block for drinks and necessities, and a nicer grocery store a few blocks down. As Lucy recommended, Simpli is a wonderful place for coffee nearby.
Thank-you Lucy, we enjoyed our stay!
Apartment has amazing views and great location! Mat & Lucy live downstairs so they could easily help if anything was needed.

We loved our stay in the penthouse, the views from the apartment are even better in person, the apartment is simply and beautifully decorated with all the necessities. It was a great sanctuary especially towards the end of our two week trip through Europe. Tons of local eateries and parks in the area. Would recommend Boubou if you can get a reservation as it’s a ten minute walk. If you are interested in getting to the busier tourist areas, it is very easy to get to anywhere via metro or Uber.  Lucy and Mat were very welcoming  and responsive hosts with a ton of suggestions

Superb location -- once inside the penthouse it felt like nesting privately atop the city with views of sunrise and sunset.  The deck is fabulous surrounded as it is with luscious plants and offers a sweet perch from which to plan your day or relish reflecting at its close.  Thoughtful space design for optimum comfort, ease, and respite.  All of our needs were more than met and best of all, Lucy's welcome made us feel like we'd made a new friend!

Sehr schöne Unterkunft, tolles Ambiente, sehr gemütlich. Gute Lage, man kann alles zu Fuß erreichen. Aber auch wenn man nicht zu Fuß gehen möchte, gibt es Öffis vor der Haustür. Tolle Restaurants fußläufig erreichbar, auch zum Frühstücken. Wir hatten einen späten Flug und auch die späte Anreise war kein Problem.
Lucy was so kind and helpful. The guide she provides is great if you are new to Lisbon. The place is very modern and private with a great view.

We loved staying at this cute penthouse apartment… the views were spectacular (only the sunset didn’t cooperate), the location was perfect for our needs and it was cozy and cute. Lucy was super helpful and offered early luggage drop off or late pickup as needed, and gave guidance on parking as well. The apartment is through their 4th floor place so I felt a bit bad ordering takeout, but Lucy assured me they’re used to it. The stairs would be tricky to navigate for kids or those with limited mobility, as a heads up. Wish we could have stayed longer!

We will come back - that's for shure...
We recomend this place to everyone...
Thank you Lucy & Mat.
Greetz Jamez & Gudrun

A great places to to stay if you are traveling light. Clean and tidy with very nice views. Close to a number of Michelin starred restaurants. It's a top floor stay with an elevator however there's an extra set of narrow stairs so be smart about what to pack!

The place is a beauty and the location is great. Not to far from everything, and only 15 minutes from the airport. Lucy is an outstanding host, and very attentive to her guest. The place looks like the photos and the views are amazing. Nice place and will start again.

We had a great stay at Lucy & Mat’s flat. All the amenities were there, and the plants made it feel like we had our own private rooftop garden. The view from the terrace is incredible: lounging with a book and a glass of port was a great respite after exploring the city. Communication was quick, location was central and right next to a metro station. Highly recommend booking this place!

Wonderful rooftop apartment with a beautiful in each direction. Host are very friendly & responsive - easy check-in. Apartment is in a great location that gives you a variety of options for transportation to get around the city. I chose to walk many times. Very clean & organized apartment. My favorite part during my stay was waking up and being able to see the Castelo de São Jorge while still in bed. Incredible!
Great experience. Very nice view!
Fantastic views and a great modern loft.

Lucy and Mat’s place was such a beautiful space. It’s a little bit of a hike to get down to Baixa and Chiado but if you’re looking for very relaxing areas and close to a public park it’s a gem. The views are incredible and it was very serene and beautifully decorated.

Our stay at Lucy & Mat’s was great. No complaints, we used their recommendations guide book for dinner most nights which was always good. The apartment was spotless and suited our needs perfectly. Beds very comfy, shower was good, warm and cosy and lots of facilities to cook breakfast in the kitchen.
Would happily recommend and stay again.

Perfect spot to explore Lisbon from! We absolutely loved staying in Lucy & Mat's apartment, perched on the top of the building with amazing views all around. Had everything we needed from coffee to linens, including complimentary port! The apartment is located about half a mile from the start of the main old town, and very easy to walk and get around. There are several convenience stores, pharmacies, and restaurants nearby for all your needs. Truly a great place to stay!
Very unique place! Great view and location

Lucy and Mat's place has some of the best views of the city! It is a beautiful rooftop oasis with lots of natural light and feels like an escape from the craziness even though you're still right in the middle of the city. Lucy was very helpful during check-in and provided lots of helpful recommendations. The space was clean and located a short walk away from Eduardo Park (which is beautiful). The place is perfect for a solo traveler or a couple. You have the entire roof area to yourself, which is much larger than it looks in the pictures. It's filled with plants and unique touches. It has a full kitchen, a small but full bathroom with a nice hot shower, and a very stylish living/dining space. Lucy was a great host and was very accommodating with issues that came up. I also appreciated the mid-stay cleaning for free during my 5-night stay here.
The location is also quite convenient, right by the Marques de Pombal metro stop along with several other bus stops. The surrounding area has a good amount of restaurants, cafés, bars, supermarkets, and mini-markets in walking distance as well. There's a nice guidebook that covers all the local recommendations in detail.
One thing to be aware of is that the street and the immediate neighborhood are a little hilly (like most of Lisbon), so be prepared for that if you have a lot of luggage. There is an oldschool elevator (like the one with the sliding metal grille door) that goes to the 4th floor but then you do have to climb up another narrow spiral staircase to get to the roof deck, so plan how you're going to get your luggage up accordingly.
The other thing to be aware of is that the wind whipping around at night on the roof can cause some random creaking sounds around the roof, so that might bother you if you're a light sleeper. I stayed here in May, so the weather was really nice and I left the sliding glass doors open at night which let in a cool gentle breeze.
Would definitely recommend staying here if you're in Lisbon! It's one of the most memorable Airbnbs I've ever stayed at.

Thank you Lucy and Mat for everything! Hopefully see you soon!
この部屋は駅から歩いて2分、とにかく眺望が素晴らしい。朝日を浴びながら朝食をいただき、昼間は目の前の公園でのんびりできます。街に出なくてもここにいるだけでリスボンを楽しめました。LISBOだいすきになりました。

the apartment is perfectly located right in the city center. you can walk or choose one of the public transports to get wherever you like. the terrace welcomes you with open arms and its more than worth it to get up for the perfect sunrise above the city. we gonna be back! most definitely. thanks a lot!

Superbe appartement,  bien situé . Terrasse incroyable. Très bien équipé. Lucy m'a très bien accueillie malgré mon retard et m'a permis de laisser mes bagages chez elle après le Check- in. Allez y les yeux fermés !

This is a lovely rooftop studio apoartment with a wonderful terrace overlooking the city. The large double bed is comfortable and the large windows give a perfect feel of this amazing city.
Lucy is extremely warm hearted and a lovely host. I'd gladly be back for longer next time!

The apartment area was quaint, yet modern. It was in a nice, secure neighbourhood and the location is ideal (it's beside a beautiful park and not too far from the city centre). Lucy was really nice and helpful.

The view is incredible. It's a great getaway place for a couple in the city of Lisbon. The decorating and ammenities are very nice and there is enough room for two people. The balcony was our favorite part!
Super apparemment avec une super vue, très bien placé, tout est accessible a pied.. Quand nous reviendrons a Lisbonne nous reviendrons ici..

We had a lovely short break in Lucy and Mat's rooftop apartment. It is private and beautifully designed, with a fabulous view over the city. Lucy recommended a fabulous pizza restaurant around the corner - highly recommended!

We really enjoyed Lucy and Mat's place. The decor was unique and beautiful, the view the city completely breath taking. Its the perfect place for a couples get away or for a business traveler that wants to try something different to a Hotel.
Charming and beautiful place to stay in Lisbon, would definitely recommend.

The communication was flawless as well as the apartment. A cozy place with everything you may need. Bonus, a wonderful sunny terrace. Lucy was extremely helpful and friendly.  She helped us recommending restaurants and places to visit. The apartment is in the perfect location - a stonesthrow from the underground station and a short walk to many attractions. Highly recommended!
Estadia muito agradavel ! Recomendo !!
this house is spectacular! cabin feeling on the rooftop with a great view of the city. perfect location to explore the city. very much recommended. thx!

If this apartment is available for the dates you need, book it. It's a gorgeous space with tons of privacy and amazing views. Wish we had more than one night there. Lucy was a great host. Can't recommend this enough!
Un apartamento perfecto para pasar unos dias en Lisboa.

perfect stay in very stylish apartment.owners and housekeeper could 'nt have been nicer.lovely view of the city and glimpse of the sea.if you 're lucky enough to get an open space in the calendar:go for it
A uniquely modern and lovely one bedroom with great views. Handy access to the city centre but also near parks. V cool - will stay again.

Astonishing flat, wonderful view on the city, it's exactly as you can see in the pictures, very bright with a sunny terrace. Perfect for relaxing and visiting the city. Lucy and Mat were very helpful and made our stay even more comfortable.
Absolutely recommended!

We stayed in this amazing rooftop for four nights. Location is perfect and the view from this super cool and modern rooftop apartment is truly spectacular. Hosts Lucy and Mat were very kind and extremely helpful. Their guidebook was very useful and proved valuable when picking out the hotspots of Lisbon. When you go to Lisbon this is a place where you to want stay.
Beautiful, clean apartment and highly accommodating hosts in a great location (with a stunning terrace which overlooks the city)! Not much more one could ask for. Would certainly stay here again!

Lucy and Mat made their place to be THE best experience we've ever had in Lisbon!
Well designed rooftop house with the best view you could have imagined.... The only possible downside is that we ended up staying at the house most of the time instead of going out for sightseeing!
Ein wunderschönes kleines Apartment mit einem tollen Blick über die Stadt. Gemütlich, sauber, modern und ein toller Ausgangspunkt zum Erkunden der Gegend.
Fabulous apartment with stunning view. Definitely recommend to anyone visiting Lisbon
Great location, beautiful apartment and awesome hosts!

Das Appartement war super schön und die Lage hat mich auch sehr überzeugt!
Lucy und Mat waren sehr zuvorkommend und nett, der Aufenthalt in Lissabon war einmalig!
Very nice location at the city center, the apartment is really great, amazing view. Lucy & Mat are very welcoming host
We had a great stay! Everthing just perfect! Many thanks Lucy!
Beautiful apartment in a beautiful city. Lucy was great really helpful, then left us to it. Perfect hosts.

We had an amazing stay at the rooftop apartment. It was bright, cosy and had everything needed for a great time in Lisbon. It was close to public transport, but we loved walking around the city too. Our host gave excellent recommendations and kindly helped us with luggage, and assisted in booking a taxi for us to get to the airport. Would definitely stay again!

The penthouse was better than advertised, Mat and Lucy were extremely accommodating, great recommendations, and beautiful view. Right next to a great park, and about a 15 minute walk to everything in Lisbon!
Empfang sehr freundlich und das Appartment bietet einen wunderschönen Blick über die Stadt hin zum Tejo. Ein schönes Gefühl auf der Terasse zu sitzen und diesen Blick zu genießen.

Excelente localização e uma vista fantástica.
A casa é perfeita, estava tudo 5 estrelas :)

A lovely flat with a youthful feel, wonderful having the roof terrace.  Not advisable for older travellers as a spiral staircase is involved which is a little narrow and steep and might defeat the older traveller with bad legs or knees!  But really, it was great and they were so nice.  Get a good restaurant recommendation, don't just walk down to the tourist restaurant area as we did.  Find out in advance of arriving about parking.
Super schönes Apartment, tolle Dachterrasse, freundliche Vermieter und zentrale Lage. Ich kann dieses außergewöhnliche Apartment nur empfehlen. Wir waren absolut begeistert.
Amazing views and great location! Lucy and Mat were so helpful and accommodating. We wish we could have stayed longer.

Communication with Mat and Lucy was great and they were really helpful providing great recommendations for places to see and eat in Lisbon. The apartment was excellent we would have liked to spend longer there!

Lucy is the airbnb host you hope to have. So sweet and provided us recommendations on where to go in Lisbon when we had a few hours to kill. She was also SUPER helpful in allowing us to leave our luggage with them on the day of our flight so we didn't have to lug it around.

Their space is super cool and staying in their rooftop room felt like an authentic Lisbon experience. Sitting out, over looking the city view and listening to music coming from the nearby park was like a dream. Their location is a bit away from the hustle and bustle, and restaurants are a bit more scarce than areas like Chiado/Barrio Alto, but it is well worth it for the experience and we would LOVE to come back :)
Very nice views. We got provided with everything we needed. Smooth arrival communication. When I come back to Lissabon I hope this place is available again!

Lucy and Mat's rooftop apartment is beautiful. It is conveniently located in a modern part of Lisbon with an incredible view, and is near to restaurants and the metro. Lucy contacted us about 5 days prior to our arrival and was very helpful with recommendations. Unfortunately we had a short time in Lisbon; we would love to stay at Lucy and Mat's place again when we visit in the future.
Lucky nous a proposé de poser nos bagages avant l'heure du check in. Nous avos été très bien acceulli. Un taxi était même réserve pour notre départ! Merci! Café à dispo et vin blanc offert!

We had a fantastic experience with Lucy and Mat. The apartment is in a great location, walking distance to everything and a very close to the Metro. The roof top patio is the perfect place to relax with a drink after a long day of exploring the city. Highly recommend staying here!

Lucy & Mat's place is about as epic as you can get. Spaceage dwelling on the roof of a building with amazing views.. I was able to walk to the downtown area easily. The place is clean, modern & unique. Waking up with the sunrise withe glass walls is truly a sight to behold. Wish I could have stayed longer.
Wonderful apartment in a fantastic city. We highly recommend this accommodation. Looking forward to returning soon.

Très beau studio...décoré avec beaucoup de goût et de beaux materiaux. Propreté. Tous le nécessaire etait là....même le café...nan vraiment parfait.
A si juste une chose....d habitude le soir à lisbonne il fait frais....mais ces derniers temps c etait pas du tout le cas et du coup sans climatisation c etait très difficile de dormir. Mais sinon tout était parfait. ..communication excellente.
Merci.
Et à la prochaine Lucy.

Der Aufenthalt in Lucy & Mats Apartment war fantastisch!
Die Lage ist gut, da viele Buslinien und auch die U-Bahn direkt um die Ecke abfahren.
Unsere Anreise lief völlig problemlos, wir sind am Flughafen einfach in ein Taxi gestiegen und Lucy erwartete uns trotz der späten Ankunftszeit (nach Mitternacht) bereits und zeigte uns das wirklich tolle Apartment.
Es ist wie beschrieben - sehr modern und mit einer fantastischen Dachterrasse, die allein schon ein Erlebnis ist. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt, auch wenn die Temperaturen im Sommer nicht gerade niedrig sind. Dank des Winds und des Öffnen mehrerer Fenster konnte man es auch am Tag gut in der Wohnung aushalten.
Lucy und Mat selbst waren hervorragende Gastgeber und hatten viele wertvolle Lissabon-Tipps für uns.
Wir würden jederzeit wiederkommen! Danke Lucy, danke Mat!!!
Great location, price,and space . Very private , and modern .. Would definatley stay again in a heart beat !!! Great communication from host as well

Such a fab apartment!  Great central location & had everything we could want for the ten days we stayed. Beautiful place & the hosts were wonderful. We stayed for our honeymoon & would highly recommend to anyone looking for an amazing view & relaxing City-break!

We had an amazing stay at Lucy and Matt's apartment. The apartment is stunning and the outdoor roof terrace was just perfect. We did not met Lucy&Mat in personally but the communication via text message was easy and unproblematically. The location of the apartment is quite good - bus station in front of the entry and 2 minute walk to the metro station. We definitely can recommend this apartment.
Fabulous apartment, great views and large terrace. Super clean, bright, spacious. Highly recommend staying here.

First, thank you to Lucy and Mat! We loved your place.
It is a one bedroom place on the fourth floor, and the building has an elevator. Although there is one flight of stairs that you need to use to access this rooftop apartment. Great view and location (near restaurants, metro). Loved sitting outside at night with the bottle of wine from the refrigerator :)
A friend (who lived in the building) checked us in. She was extremely helpful throughout the stay, also an easy checkout. Our flight leaving Lisbon was late afternoon, and they let us keep our bags there until our departure - we kept the keys and left them on the counter when we left.
The only downside was our stay was 2 days in the summer, and it was unseasonably hot. No air conditioning which is ok (described in profile) but maybe recommend a fan for those few weeks in the summer when it is hot. It was slightly uncomfortable to sleep. Everything was in working order (bathroom, lights, fridge, kitchen), and they also had a terrific welcome binder with recommendations for food, activities, and transportation.
We definitely recommend this place!

Lucy and Mat were fantastic hosts and made us feel very welcome. A detailed guidebook and Portuguese wine in the fridge were equally welcoming!

The apartment is unique with incredible views of the city. As an open plan studio it is a perfect place for a couple to stay - the rooftop terrace is private and perfect for having a drink at sunset. Very good value for money. We didn't get round to using the trampoline on the terrace...

Lucy and Mat are very helpful and the apartment is very spacious and have a very good view of lisbon it is very close to the hop on and off bus terminal and it is very good for the tourists to travel around in Lisbon.

Absolut zum empfehlen! Appartement entspricht genau den Bildern. Es ist über eine kleine Wendeltreppe von vierten Stock aus zu erreicheichen, Aufzug bis zu vierten Stock vorhanden. Es liegt eine Mappe mit Infos zum Appartement, Tipps zur Stadt und Restaurantempfehlungen bereit. Wir wurden sehr herzlich empfangen und es wurde uns alles gezeigt. Auch eine Flasche Wein und eine gewisse Grundausstattung wie Gewürze, Kaffee, usw. waren vorhanden. Von der Terrasse hat man einen wunderschönen Blick über die Stadt. Die Lage ist für einen Städtetrip perfekt. Ca. 50m vom Appartement am gegenüberliegenden Park befindet sich der Startpunkt der Sightseeingbusse. Ebenso ca. 50m vom Appartement befindet sich die Metrostation. Im ca. 400m entfernen Einkaufszentrum befindet sich auch ein großer Supermarkt. Verschiedene Restaurants befinden sich in der näheren Umgebung und sind fußläufig zu erreichen. Auch das historische Zentrum lässt sich in gut 20min zu Fuß erreichen. Wir kommen definitiv wieder!

Wir wurden sehr gut empfangen und durch die Wohnung geführt. Alles war in bester Ordnung. Die Wohnung und der Service sind top. Es hatte eine Auswahl an Reiseguides, es wurde Wasser und Kaffee bereit gestellt und alles dafür getan das wir einen tollen Aufenthalt hatten. Michael hat uns gut empfangen, wir konnten unsere Koffer sogar schon am Morgen im Eingangsbereich der Wohnung lassen. Wir hatten eine wirklich tolle Zeit und würden jederzeit wieder kommen.

We had an amazing stay at Lucy and Matt's penthouse apartment. The apartment is stunning and the outdoor roof deck was better than we could have hoped for. Lucy's housekeeper was so nice and accommodating and everything went smoothly. The apartment is very centrally  located. We absolutely loved it and would stay again.

Von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme bis zur Abreise war alles sehr gut organisiert und beschrieben. Wir haben für alle Fragen schnell Antworten bekommen und wurden sehr nett empfangen. Ob zum Einkaufen, Stadterkundung oder Essen gehen haben wir sehr gute und genaue Tipps bekommen.
Ob Kaffe, Wasser oder Wein, für die Erstversorgung haben Mat und Lucy bestens gesorgt. Vielen Dank
Wir haben unseren Aufenthalt in Lissabon sehr genossen und können diese Unterkunft besten Gewissens weiterempfehlen
Peter und Kerstin
We had such a lovely time staying in this beautiful apartment. Lucy and Mat were very friendly and gave us lots of great recommendations for Lisbon. We would highly recommend staying here.
Cinco días maravillosos pasamos en el piso de Lucy y Matt. Esperamos volver pronto a Lisboa y no quedariamos en ningún otro sitio.

magnifique location, Hôtes au petit soin avec nous et magnifique terrasse entourant tout l'appartement
nous conseillerons cette location à tous nos amis !!
The apartment is wonderful! We arrived at 10:00, but Check-in was only possible at 14:00. We could leave our bags in Matt and Lucy's house. At 14:00 we checked in and everything was fine!

The outlook from the terrace (and from the kitchen) is just stunning and amazing. This is really an outstanding place. The furnishing of the apartment is beautiful. It is located 50 m from Marques de Pombal, which was a perfect location for us.

Our hosts were very friendly and immediately available when we had a question.

Merci Lucy pour votre accueil, vos bons conseils , la qualité de l'hébergement et surtout le souci que vous montrez pour le bien-être de vos hôtes. Nous avons apprécié le confort, le mobilier moderne et la cuisine bien équipée. La situation à 2 pas du métro est idéale pour découvrir Lisbonne. C'était notre premier voyage au Portugal et une réussite totale.

Despite arriving late we were received kindly by Lucy. We spent two nights in the apartment, which has fantastic interior and views over the city. The location is excellent, most of the times we went walking to the city center. Lucy and Mat provided everything that was needed for a great stay in Lisbon, thank you guys!

Lucy and Mat were so great! We were greeted by their son and Mat gave us a tour of the most beautiful apartment in the most centrally located apartment in Lisbon.  This rooftop apartment was beyond incredible and now I have serious #vacationhomegoals.  They have a really great apartment/city manual, plenty of books about Lisbon/Portugal to help guide your way through.  Lucy was also helpful enough to make us dinner reservations and call us cabs when we needed them.  We were there on the hottest days but the breeze on the rooftop was a plenty.  There is plenty to do in walking distance from the apartment and frankly I wish they would adopt me so I could explore the city for months and months.  2 days is NOT enough in Lisbon.  I would love to stay here again.  Also, be prepared to stay up LATE in Lisbon.  These town knows how to kick it until dawn.
It was just awesome! Kind Hosts, individual apartement, top location in Lisboa and a great view! If we come back to Lisboa we gonna stay there again :)

The best place to stay in Lisbon! Central location, wonderful apartment with amazing view terrace, even better than it looks in pictures. Lucy and Mat are perfect hosts, always ready to give you any help or information. Thank you and see you soon!

Wir haben schon vor unserer Reise mit der Gastgeberin Kontakt aufgenommen und wurden direkt bei unserer Ankunft warm und herzlich empfangen. Rotwein, Wasser und Knabbergebäck standen bereit, alles war sehr einladend. Lucy zeigte uns die Wohnung und besondere Handhabungen.
Das Apartment war genauso, wie abgebildet und beschrieben.
Wir haben die Woche sehr genossen, einmal "top of the roof" zu sein und die die Dachterrasse ohne Einblick von außen genießen zu können.
Auch die lage ist so zentral, dass wir direkt vor der Haustür in einen der zahlreichen Busse steigen konnten und uns nachmittags im gegenüberliegenden Park von der Stadt erholen konnten.
Supermärkte befinden sich nicht so ganz in der Nähe und ein deutsches Fernsehprogramm war nicht verfügbar, jedoch 2 Videos auf deutsch. Fernsehen während einer Städtereise ist allerdings auch nicht so wichtig.
Rundherum waren wir sehr begeistert und kommen gern noch einmal wieder! Es war eine genussvolle Reise!
Vielen Dank!

Bel appartement, tres lumineux, prestations de qualité, propre, une grande baie vitrée donnant sur une grande et belle terrasse avec vue sur la ville et la mer au loin.
Centre historique à 15mn à pied, Metro/transport/taxi à 50m de l'immeuble seulement.
Lucy et Mat ont été très accueillant avec une bonne communication quand cela était nécessaire. Pas du tout intrusif.

Logement correspondant exactement à la description, très belle terrasse, logement très lumineux, très agréable à vivre
Mat & Lucy nous ont extremement bien accueilli et conseillé sur Lisbonne, nous recommandons à 100% !!
Encore merci à eux pour leur gentillesse!

Lucy welcomed us really friendly although we only arrived around midnight. She showed us their lovely apartment and we were really surprised with a full equipment in the kitchen, even a nespresso machine with free capsules was available!
For architecture fans the building will be awesome since it is a really nicely renovated from the 1930s' with an super cool antique elevator. The apartment was very modern and build on the roof top a couple of years ago. It was very clean, perfect for 2 persons and with a lot of Feng-Shui :)
The apartment and the view over Lisbon is really incredible. One point to mention is a general Lisbon issue. Due to that the airport is within the city, planes are quiet loud sometimes. Since the apartment is on the rooftop I waked up 2-3 times due to a plane, but the bed is really comfy and I could fall asleep very fast again :) Although we were quiet unlucky with the weather and it rained a lot we enjoyed the romantic sound of the rain on the roof.
Directly in front of the entrance of the building is a bus stop, though we used Uber all the time which was working great.
We are completely in Love with Lisbon. The most friendly people we ever encountered, it's really clean everywhere, the service and quality is great and it is surprisingly cheap. An espresso is usually between 0.6 - 1 Euro and we spent for dinner between 20-50 Euro for 2.

Lucy was an amazing host, and the apartment is beautiful, modern, and cozy (even better than the pictures!). I appreciated Lucy's consistent communication, including sending a PDF guide to the city with nearby amenities. She also provided maps, a metro card, and a bottle of wine that made me feel right at home. The apartment is perfect for one person or a couple, and located conveniently close to the metro (3-5 min walk). I would highly recommend staying here!
Great apartment with fabulous outdoor area to eat and relax in. Lucy & Matt welcomed us to Lisbon and had great recommendations for sight seeing, day trips and restaurants.

My husband and I stayed at Lucy and Mat's rooftop apartment for four nights in April. We had a fantastic time. The apartment was perfect for a short city break. Lucy and Mat were friendly and helpful hosts both before and during our trip.

Lucy sent us a guide to Lisbon which included directions to get the apartment. These were very easy to follow.

The apartment itself is compact but with everything you could need. It was spotless when we arrived and we were touched by the welcome drink. The terrace is lovely to sit on and have a glass of wine.

The apartment is in a great location right next to Eduardo Park and very close to Marques de Pombal metro station. We got on the metro every day and headed to the Baixa-Chiado metro stop which is on the same line. From there we could easily wander about the old town, get the train to Sintra (well worth a visit) or the metro then tram out to Belem.

I would highly recommend this apartment.

From the beginning, Mat and Lucy were incredibly prompt,helpful and friendly. The flat is perfect, it has everything you need and more. the view of Lisbon is wonderful. Lucy very kindly reserved restaurant bookings for us and a taxi. We really couldn't of wanted more from our stay, their restaurant suggestions were great. The flat is situated near plenty of public transport.

Mat & Lucy sont adorables et nous ont accueillis très chaleureusement. Le logement qu'ils proposent est incroyable : chouette terrasse avec vue sur toute la ville et le château, belle luminosité, tout confort, à deux pas du métro. Ils ont beaucoup de goût et un grand sens de l'hospitalité. Ils ont été d'excellent conseil pour nos visites et sorties. Nous recommandons chaudement !

We unfortunately only stayed here for one night on our way out of Lisbon, but we absolutely loved this beautiful apartment. Views were stunning, apartment was exactly like in the pics with great light and an open layout. We did not meet our hosts, but their housekeeper was there to welcome us and give us the keys. We would certainly recommend this to anyone staying in Lisbon, it's in a central area close to the metro and also within walking distance from other central areas as well. Great spot, thanks Mat and Lucy!

Wow, what a place! We loved staying here. Mat and Lucy greeted us warmly and provided everything we needed. The apartment is spacious, stylish, and has terrific views. Even one morning when it was pouring rain outside we were happy to just hang out there.

We loved staying with Mat and Lucy! The apartment is conveniently located and very beautiful- we were sad that we had only booked one night. Lucy gave us some wonderful recommendations both before and when we checked in and was great with helping us plan out our arrival.  I would absolutely recommend staying here!

Dès notre arrivée à l'appartement, nous avons été très bien accueillis par Mat et Lucy qui nous ont fait découvrir l'appartement et donné de précieux conseils de visites et restaurants.  Nous savions qu'ils seraient présents en cas de besoin ce qui est très important.  L'appartement est idéalement situé,  à 2 minutes a pied du metro et seulement 10 min a pied du centre-ville historique.  Le logement est très propre, très joli, moderne et pourvu d'une grande terrasse avec une très belle vue sur les toits de Lisbonne. Tout a été fourni, des serviettes aux guides touristiques, revues,  dvd, machine a café, et même une bouteille de vinho verde ! Bref, un logement où l'on se sent bien et avec toutes les commodités a proximité ( notamment un parking place Marques de Pombal juste a côté).

Lucy and Mat were wonderful hosts; very communicative and helpful, with plenty of great recommendations of things to do in Lisbon. To top that off, their place is stunning. Amazing views from their spacious balcony, very light, bright and clean living space and all within easy reach of the Metro or a stroll downhill to the city centre. We will definitely be staying here again on our next trip to Lisbon. Thanks both.

Mat and Lucy were both incredibly friendly and hospitable.  We arrived early in the day and took the bus to their place from the airport, which took around half an hour, and they were kind enough to let us drop of our luggage until our check-in time. The metro station is very close by and easy to use, which made getting around easy.  Their place had a gorgeous view, was cute and clean, and definitely worth it!

We had a great holiday in this wonderful apartment. The views from the terrace were amazing and it was so nice to sit and have breakfast there each morning in the sunshine. It had a great location a couple of minutes walk to the metro station then 5 mins into Central Lisbon on the metro train, or 15 minutes walk to Rossio Square. Mat and Lucy were very helpful. They respected our privacy, but were available if we needed anything; they recommended some fabulous restaurants, that the locals use, away from the tourists! We will definitely be staying here again if we are in Lisbon again.

That is really the most wonderful appartment I've ever seen - perfect for a city trip: located in the heart of the town hi above over the trouble of the city, so you can either relax and enjoy the outstanding view over Lissabon or walk down to every place you want.
Mat and Lucy are really wonderful hosts and so nice people - they welcomed us with their two sweet doogs Missy & Snoop and make us feel really at home. Also our little dog Ally enjoyed the sunny terrace, the park opposite the house and the play with Missy & Snoop.
We would love to come back - at least we'd loved to extend our holiday and stay for a longer term.
The apartment is really well equipped - you find everything you need and more...!

L'accueil de Mat & Lucy a été parfait, le loft placé idéalement pour visiter Lisbonne, avoir une vue panoramique sur la ville et prendre son petit déjeuner en terrasse au soleil...
Just perfect !

Die Unterkunft war wie beschrieben, wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Das traumhafte Wetter ermöglichte es uns, draußen zu frühstücken:-) Sie ist Ideal für Städtereisen. Die schriftliche Kurzinfo´s waren hilfreich und ausreichend.
Even though we arrived late, Mat  welcomed us very pleasantly.  The apartment offers exceptional views, excellent comfort. We had a great stay !

Wir hatten 3 wunderschöne Tage in dem Appartement von Mat & Lucy, Lucy hat uns herzlich in Empfang genommen und uns mit der Wohnung vertraut gemacht. Von der Terasse aus hat man einen fantastischen Ausblick über Lissabon. Die Wohnung ist sehr zentral, sodass wir fast alles zufuß erkunden konnten. Sollten wir noch einmal nach Lissabon kommen, so würden wir aufjedenfall wieder diese Wohnung mieten.

Mat & Lucy
Wir verbrachten 4 angenehme Tage in der wunderschönen lichtdurchfluteten Dachwohnung von unseren liebevollen Vermieterinnen. Mercie! Wir kommen gerne wieder.
Danke auch für die Hilfe am Schluss, dass wir wieder rechtzeitig ausfliegen konnten... (Nach der Beraubung in der Alferme)
Lisabon bei Mat + Lucy ist eine Reise wert!
Wir wünschen Euch Alles Gute!
Herzlich Beat + Annette

Great property right in the heart of the city centre. Amazing views over the city rooftops toward the sea. Private terrasss is great. Lovely hosts, leave you to get on with your vacation, but also very helpful and approachable. Couldn't do more to make us feel welcome.

From the moment we arrived at this gorgeous apartment we felt we were home.
It was everything we expected and more. The location is fantastic, you are so close to the metro and there is a bus stop literally at your front door. Despite its handy location we were happy just hanging out at the apartment, despite the freezing weather it was always warm and the views from every aspect were fabulous. We had lots of visitors who also raved about how gorgeous it was.
Our hosts could not have been any more friendly or helpful. They also have two friendly dogs which we loved to pet.

What a great place to stay in Lisbon.... Great place, great view, great location, great hosts and fantastic price! If you are looking for a couple retreat, location, location, location would 100% recommend the place! Well done Lucy!!!!!!

Nos hôtes ont été charmants. Lucy est venue nous chercher car nous nous étions trompés de rue (attention aux apprentis routards, deux rues voisines portent quasi le même nom)
Bonne bouteille de vin à l'arrivée.
Appartement conforme au descriptif, agréable à vivre, belle lumière le matin et vue large et dégagée sur Lisbonne, hélas pour nous séjour court de trois nuits et en partie gâché par la grisaille et la pluie.

Nous avons passé un excellent week end dans votre superbe appartement. Il correspond en tous point au descriptif, et la vue est absolument splendide..! Mat et Lucy sont très accueillant, donnent de bons conseils et sont disponibles. Merci de votre accueil et d'avoir permis que nous passions un super weekend. Nous reviendrons avec plaisir !

We had a fantastic stay at Mat and Lucy's place. The apartment is totally unique, very clean and has amazing views of the city. It's centrally located and very convenient to get around with the metro just a couple of minutes walk away. Mat and Lucy are great hosts, very helpful with recommendations of things to do and see. I'd definitely recommend staying here.

Mat & Lucy nous ont parfaitement accueilli et restent très disponibles.
L'appartement est très confortable, tout est prévu pour y passer un excellent séjour. La terrasse, un vrai petit bonheur... !

Mat et Lucy sont des hôtes très accueillants et de bon conseil pour les visites. Nous avons été très bien reçus. L'appartement est identique aux photos que vous pouvez voir dans l'annonce. Nous recommandons ces hôtes a chaque personne qui recherche un logement sur Lisbonne.

Such a great experience in Lisbon with them. They really love to host people and give you great advance and tips about the town. The flat was perfect and its in a good location quiet area but not far from touristic place. We plan to come back in Lisbon and we'd definitely stay there !

Can't say enough good things about Mat and Lucy's apartment.  The apartment has a beautiful view of the city, water and sunrises, and is well within walking distance of most Lisbon attractions.  We are already planning a second trip to Lisbon, and will be staying with Mat and Lucy if the apartment is available.

Mat & lucy haben uns direkt warm und herzlich willkommen geheißen. Eine nette Geste war auch die Flasche Rotwein die auf uns wartete, was für uns nach der Anreise die sich ziemlich gezogen hatte genau das richtige war!
Die beiden sind hilfsbereit und aufgeschlossen, sodass auch Probleme mit dem wlan direkt von mat beseitigt wurden, damit wir unsere Tagesziele planen könnten. Ein paar Insider Tipps gab es von den beiden natürlich auch immer mit auf den Weg.
Das rooftop apartement ist ein absoluter Traum, die Dachterasse lädt zum gemütlichen Frühstück (im besten Fall) unter blauem Himmel ein. Auch die Gegend ist zentral, trotzdem ruhig und leicht zu erreichen. Mit der Metro kommt man eigentlich in kurzer Zeit überall hin, wobei dass Metro Netz auch leicht zu verstehen ist. Die Unterkunft ist genau das richtige um ein paar schöne Tage im Herzen Lissabons zu verbringen. Danke an die beiden noch einmal :)

We had a fantastic stay at Mat and Lucy's apartment. It's really beautiful with incredible views - even better than the pictures! It's also very comfortable.
Mat and Lucy were lovely hosts - very friendly and kind. They gave us loads of great suggestions for things to do, where to eat etc. They really helped us make the most of all that Lisbon has to offer. We didn't want to leave and hope to come back again one day soon!
Thanks Mat and Lucy for a brilliant stay!

Apartamento lindo (vista maravilhosa, reformado, moderno, acessórios bem pensados - até cápsulas Nespresso e adoçante estão disponíveis). Localização excelente, perto dos pontos turísticos e mesmo do metrô, de locadoras de carro. Os anfitriões são perfeitos! Muito gentis e atenciosos, mas deixam os hóspedes completamente à vontade.
Super appartement - propre, commode, tel que décrit et présenté sur le site. Baie vitrée et vue sur Lisbonne exceptionnelles. Hôtes aux petits soins. A recommander ! Merci pour tout :-)

One of the nicest most gracious hosts we have ever encountered, the penthouse, a beautifully designed and built one bedroom have the best view of the city!! Because we were doing multiple stops I needed to wash some clothes and Lucy completely took care of us! Clothes were smelling fresh and neatly folded waiting for is after dinner! I would recommend this location because it is central, it is beautiful, the host is so sweet, and I will be returning next time I am in Portugal!!! Thank you!!!!

Tout s'est extrêmement bien passé. Le logement était conforme aux photos et même mieux encore !! Lucy nous a très bien accueillie et nous a recommandé beaucoup d'endroits très sympathique. Merci pour la recommandation du touk touk nous avons adoré !! Les petites attentions dans l'appartement était très bien pensées (bouteille d'eau, shampoing et gel douche, café et thé...)

Nous avons passé trois jours super à Lisbonne. Lucy et Mat sont très accueillants tout en nous laissant notre intimité et tranquillité. L appartement est vraiment super beau et propre et la terasse est magnifique !! Nous pouvons que les remercier et conseiller ce logement!

We had a fantastic stay at Mat & Lucy's modern, yet very cozy wooden house! Mat welcomed us with great hospitability, good tips for getting around and a nice bottle of wine :) The house itself is very conveniently located near famous neighbourhoods in the city center. It has a beautiful rooftop terrace with a nice view. It is very light, clean, and tastefully decorated which made us feel very comfortable and wishing to stay more. We would definitely recommend staying with Mat and Lucy as their house made our stay in the beautiful city even more relaxing and comfortable.

Nous sommes enchantés de notre séjour à Lisbonne dans l'appartement insolite de Mat et Lucy.... Super accueil et très bon contact naturel.
Je recommande vivement cet appartement !

This was an extremely super choice for our Lisbon stay. Mat and Lucy's apartment is in a great central location of Lisbon which is very convenient walking distances to any of the most interesting areas in Lisbon: historic part, party district, numerous restaurants and cafes. And the view from the apartment was AWESOME! We enjoyed a lot that the apartment's design is very very stylish, that the space doesn't feel closed off, but instead has windows everywhere even from the kitchen. It has a large glass door that slides and connects to the deck which has some very comfortable sitting. The bathroom/shower has a very cool design. The bed is soooo comfortable, which comes very handy for people who spend a lot of time in the airport. Great apartment!

L'appartement possède une vue incroyable et il est très moderne et agréable. L'ensemble est très propre. L'entrée n'est pas séparée (on passe par l'entrée puis un escalier à l'extérieur) et une petite table et chaise à l'intérieur serait le bienvenue.
Je conseille vivement cet appartement, l’hôte est de plus très sympa !

Una estancia muy buena, el anfitrión en todo momento nos ayudó en lo que le solicitamos, muy atento, y detallista, nos dejó una botella de vino en la nevera fresquita.
El alojamiento increíble, un apartamento precioso con unas vistas impresionantes a Lisboa, en una buena zona de Lisboa y muy cerca andando del centro.
Recomendable 100% para quien quiera pasar unos días en Lisboa.

Ein sehr geschmackvolles, schönes Appartement mit wunderschönem Blick auf Lissabon. Die Wohnung ist perfekt für zwei mit allem was man braucht ausgestattet und liegt sehr zentral. Lucy und Mat waren sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Zusätzlich hatte Lucy noch zahlreiche Tipps in einem kleinen Guide zusammengefasst (mit z.B. Anreiseinformationen, Restaurantempfehlungen) an denen wir uns dankbar orientiert haben.
We kwamen pas heel laat aan in Lissabon maar lieve Lucy vond het allemaal geen enkel probleem.

I stayed 5 nights in this fantastic apartment. It is the perfect size for a single or couple, charming, clean, well-appointed and the views are as good as they look on the website. The bus and metro are right outside.

There are (spiral) stairs from the 4th floor up to the flat, so not ideal if you are disabled or have massive luggage. There was some construction noise from the city during the day, but this didn't bother me as I was out most of each day, and it stopped in the evenings and on the weekend.

Mat & Lucy were wonderful hosts, super helpful and friendly but also respectful of my privacy. They even baked bread for me! I absolutely recommend this apartment for your stay in Lisbon. I didn't want to leave!

This was our first experience with AirBnB and it was a awesome one. We had a amazing time at Mat & Lucys home. They are very friendly and give a lot of helpful advises. Their guide is a wonderful opportunity to plan the trip and find a lot of restaurant and sightseeing options. The flat is lovely and the view from the rooftop terrace is wonderful. We enjoyed our time in Lissabon and our appartment a lot! Thank you!

The pictures shown are exactly what you get in real life, the apartment is in a great location and near to all your necessities, the interior is gorgeous and modern with great views and if you just fancy a chilled day, the terrace is perfect to sit and relax on soaking up the beautiful sun.
Wonderful apartment and extremely nice host! Couldn't have been a better stay in a great location. Host is the best communicator and we loved our time.

Mat & Lucy are wonderful to deal with, very responsive & answered all questions with thought. They are super organised and have loads of advice if you need it. Everything is brand new, and beautifully designed. You can feel that a lot of love and thought has gone into every aspect of this build. Its private, easy to access from the street, spotlessly clean and so central. We absolutely loved staying here - would highly recommend this spot, I think this must be the most peaceful place in easy access to a wondrous and buzzing Lisbon. If you want a perfect nights sleep, ready for the energetic city, this is it. Right next to a gorgeous park, you have so much outside space to see the pretty views from.
Great apartment and Mat and Lucy were kind and considerate hosts. The views of Lisbon are superb.
Beautifull view! And very nice appartment

Mat & Lucy are a very welcoming couple with lots of advice what to do and where to eat out in Lisbon. The apartment is clean, chic and with a stunning view of the city. Everything is in walking distance. We had a fantastic time and will definitely stay here again on our next visit to Lisbon!

My husband and I stayed here during our honeymoon in Portugal and we could not have been happier with Mat and Lucy's apartment! The views are simply stunning and the location was perfect. I also have to call out that the guidebook / suggestions they gave us were PERFECT. Everything just suited our taste exactly and we basically went down their list of restaurant suggestions for lunch  and dinner each day. It made planning so easy. Would definitely stay here again!

I loved to be Mat & Lucys' s guest.  They were welcoming,  prompt and reliable with the communication and arrangements.  The place is great, very well located, nicely decorated and the views are as per the pictures.  I definitely recommend this place if you visit Lisbon, like the city this place got character.

Un accueil on ne peut plus chaleureux de la part de Lucy, qui nous a donné de très bons conseils sur les restaurants et lieux d'intérêt à ne pas manquer à Lisbonne ! Digne d'un hôtel 5 étoiles !!

L'appartement est extrêmement agréable à vivre avec sa grande terrasse et très bien situé.

Spent two nights at Mat & Lucy's. great people, wonderful stay. I can only recommand it to those who want to visit Lisbon.

Mat & Lucy were the absolute perfect hosts with an amazing set-up on the rooftop of their building, right in the middle of a great city. You can definitely tell that they put time and effort into building this little gem of a place, and also put time and care into making their guests feel right at home. They gave us recommendations on where to visit and even accomodated our late arrival. Bonus, they have two of the sweetest dogs around; Snoop & Missy. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone as well as stay there again in a heartbeat.

Lucy and Mat are super nice hosts, the appartment is amazing and the location just perfect for exploring this vibrant city. This stay was a very luxury highlight at the end of our trip and we can't wait to come back!

It was a very nice place to stay. The host Mathieu and Lucy were extremely friendly. Close to a metro station and a 15min walk to the city center it's a nice starting place to discover the heart of Lisbon.
I can recommend everyone who likes to stay in a very nice apartment and friendly helpfull host.

Great family, sweet kids, and really cute dogs :)  Highly recommend.

Une excellente adresse sans hésiter!! Un studio plein de charme , très fonctionnel, avec une vue sublime. Perfect affordable room in Lisbon. The kitchen is small but adequate for basic meals like breakfast before heading off to Sintra. Augusto was flexible for check in and let us store our bags whilst he prepared the room. The room is spacious and has a nice table that is useful for meals. The window and balcony is very large and lets a nice breeze in the room, there is a fan and a heater as well. The shower has about 2 minutes of hot water (even though it’s a gas heater?) so be quick before it turns lukewarm/cold. The fridge is small (bar fridge) between 2 guest rooms and the host, so do not bring more than a few bits and pieces from the store. It’s very close to Arroios station so getting anywhere in town is easy. Remember you need an empty or a new via viagem card for riding the train to sintra, vs using the metro-buses-funiculars etc. Fares are ~10% cheaper with the via viagem card. Overall I would stay here again for the price. The room is nice, and it’s quiet on the top (6th) floor.

Augusto's apartment has its strengths and its weaknesses.
