I like dogs and I'm comfortable around them, but they got scared as I got (silently) out of my room one night, and one of them attacked me and bit me - I got blood and bruises and all that. They get nervous, I'm a strange person for them and it's only natural, but I don't think it's a good situation for both guests and dogs. But again, Augusto was super helpful when I needed something for the wound. After that, he also tried to keep the dogs from us by locking them, but it creates a stressful environment.
Also, there are some little things that needs fixing, for instance some small problems with the washing machine - nothing critical but may disturb some schedules.
It's a poor neighborhood, streets are dirty, there are lots of workers during the day and some strange people at night, but you can count with cheap places to eat. I don't mind, but some people may find the region unpleasant.
In short, it was not my worst Airbnb experience, but it was not the best.

Würde jeder Zeit wieder dort hin!

Unfortunately I didn't have the chance to meet Augusto personally since I arrived later but my boyfriend did and he said he was very welcoming. The house is amazing, everything was cleaned and the room is incredibly cozy. In 20 minutes walking you are in the old town, and you are near to public transports, even to go to the airport. This house has magic environment and a lot of quite dogs! I've never meet so quite dogs.
The floor is creaking. The streets are bit noisy.
Perfect host
Augusto is very nice and his place is about a 15-20 minute walk from the waterfront. The balcony overlooking the city is incredible!

Nous avons passé un merveilleux séjour à Lisbonne chez Augusto. L'appartement est idéalement situé dans un quartier vivant et populaire (à 200 mètres de la station de métro). Logement propre et excellente communication avec Augusto qui parle très bien le français! Malgré notre arrivée tardive, il nous a attendus et bien accueillis. N'hésitez pas à aller manger au resto "primavera" (à 30 mètres à droite de l'immeuble en sortant), typique et excellent rapport qualité prix (6,50€ pour un demi poulet grillé et son accompagnement + salade!). Et profitez des nombreuses pâtisseries du quartier qui proposent des produits de qualité et un accueil toujours souriant! Comptez 3 euros pour un café + une pâtisserie et un grand verres de jus d'oranges fraîchement pressées.

Me and my boyfriend had to stay overnight before our flight. Thoroughly enjoyed our stay and loved the house. Very quirky and interesting space on the top floor of an old apartment block. Augusto wasn't the most talkative host but told us everything we needed to know. Great stay and great location. Thankyou!
We only spend one night but we felt very well in Augusto s flat! Close to the metro and city center, cool flat and nice host! We would stay more :)
Nice room...

We had a lovely stay at Augusto's place. The apartment is spacious and homely. It has a bohemian charm to it and is very well located. Our room was private and and had a small balcony that allowed for fresh air and a view. If ever I am in Lagos again, I will most certainly return to Augusto's.

Augustos flat is a supercool place to stay when in Lisbon. Even though we were just staying for one night at Augustos place, we got the impression that he is a really communicative guy and an very experienced host. Thanks for having us around Augusto!

All of the reviews check out. Augusto was a great host who was kind enough to take a stranger like me out to one of his local favorite places to dine in Lisbon. It was a great introduction to the city and to Portuguese culture for me. He is a knowledgeable and accommodating host. If you want to add some bohemian flavor to your stay, Augusto's place is for you.
Appart tres beau, hote tres sympa et quartier calme proche de tout
I like the building, the apartment its nice and August its nice aswell. The place is well located, walking distance to center or close by Metro station. All good. Thank you!

Augusto is a solid dude who takes extremely good care of his space. This place is old and rustic, very cool inside, and he keeps the place absolutely spotless. It's a great house all over, in a great neighborhood, right by transit. Augusto also invited me out to dinner at a local spot and it was a great time. Highly recommended spot.
Appartement propre , hôte serviable, très bonne étape

This is a very nice place, you're in the center and you can visit everything by feet! Augusto is a awesome hoster, he is so uncomplicated and he even took me on a cycle-tour through lisbon! Many thanks! I highly recommend this place :)

My stay was pretty short, but enjoyed the vibe of the city very much so.
Communication with Augusto was easy and straight forward. He sent me a perfect description of his address. It was really easy to approach.
His place is very central, perfect if you have a morning flight, also perfect location if you want to visit downtown or do other activities.
Thanks again Augusto.

Augusto has a very beautiful flat. Everything is clean and the room got some artistic decoration. You've got such a tiny balcony on its room which is nice to relax in the evening when you do a lot of tourism stuff as we did.
Pia and me totally recommend to visit augusto.
La foto  refleja fielmente la habitación. Muy tranquilo. Muy limpio. Cerca de todo solo con algunas estaciones de metro
Très bon accueil, souple, il nous a permis de déposer nos sacs tôt le jour de notre arrivée, nous y avons séjourné deux nuits. La chambre était bien préparée, hôte discret mais de bon conseil.
good

My sister and I had a lovely time at Augusto's flat. It was the perfect place for us to sleep for the one night we had in Lisbon. Augusto kindly received us, showed us around the city, and even invited us to dinner. Couldn't have asked for a better experience. Thanks Augusto!
Close to bus stops and metro station. The room is big, clean and tidy as the photo shown. Highly recommended.

Augusto's place was really inviting and had an authentic Portuguese charm. Augusto himself was very helpful and informative.
Most definitely highly recommend.
Ottima posizione in prossimità di due fermate di metro. Augusto ottimo padrone di casa gentile e discreto.
Très bon séjour chez Augusto.Appartement située dans un quartier populaire tranquille, 15mins à pied de la vieille ville, 5 mins en métro.Augusto est un hote discret et disponible.
Had a short but pleasant stay at Augustos!
Our stay at Augusto's has been really great :) Thanks!
Very nice place, the location was also great with a subway station very close and the room was nice and spacious
La casa preciosa y todo muy cómodo! Las vistas de las habitaciones son espectacualares, la cama comodísima y Augusto muy simpático!

Augusto is a nice host. The discription of the add is right.
The flat is clean and the room really cute.
The metro is close, 3-4mins walk away.
And the city center is around 20-25mins by walk.
We recommend :)

Great stay at Augusto's place - his apartment is very vintage and beautiful. We really liked the space! Augusto is very friendly and kind. Close to the metro station and some excellent vegetarian and tapas restaurants around!
Nice flat with a good view

Fantastic host with lots of insight on both Portugal and the city of Lisbon. Very welcoming and made me feel as if I was part of the home. Nice balcony and good sized room. Will be sure to return again!
We had an awesome time with Augusto! Great space in a cool neighborhood with views of the city. You'll have a beautiful time here!

Augusto's place is amazing! It looks even better in person than it does in the pictures :) The decoration matched perfectly with the vibe of the apartment, giving it a very artsy feeling.
Augusto was very kind and provided us with everything we needed to enjoy our stay :) Maria, the dog, welcomed us personally as well haha Such a cute dog, great host and nice apartment! I would definitely book this place again if I ever need a place to stay in Lisbon.

Augusto's place is what you consider the perfect AirBnB place!
Easy and nice communication and check-in, super close to the Metro, city centre, restaurants and Cafés etc.
Plus we totally fell in love with the beautiful apartment.
We more than enjoyed our short stay and can only recommend it to anybody else!

Waking up at Augusto's every morning was like waking up in a dream.  The view alone is indescribable.  The flat is amazing and retains so much of it's original charm, I just fell in love with it.  He stated that he wants to fix it up, but I sincerely hope he leaves it exactly as it is.  It's charming and beautiful.  Augusto was a huge source of information, and even took me on a wonderful walking tour of the city at night, when no tourists were out.  It was amazing.  The entire city is at your doorstep here, and what a wonderful and amazing city it is.  I hope to return someday, and I will definitely only stay at Augustos beautiful place.  I felt totally at home there, and feel like staying at his home made my visit to Lisbon SO much more special than if I had stayed anywhere else!  It's magical.

Augusto is a great host. The room looks exactly as the picture in the profile. It is clean, comfortable, has a great view of the neighborhood from the balcony. The whole place has a great vibe to it. You can count on Augusto for some great music. The dogs are very friendly and well-behaved. The place is located near a bus stop and a metro station, which makes it easy to reach from the airport.

Augusto humble apartment was cozzy and comfortable. Very good location close to the metro and buss stations. Augusto is very helpful and good gaid. We get some vere good recommendations from him.
Good value for payment.
We had a good time.
Appartment is a cozy. Near center, near metro. Augousto is a very friendly.

Augusto is a great host and open-minded! We liked the music at his place and the apartment served us perfectly! 30min Walk to Downtown and everything necessary in walking distance. Very good location at low price 👍🏽
Bonne accueil
Nice host and great location. Great view in Arroios area.

Augustos flat was beautiful! Top floor of a building leaving great views out the balcony of my room looking over the neighbourhood. Was incredibly clean and organised. Wifi worked perfect and the shower was hot! Dogs were cute, but be careful not to leave any food out for Maria to take haha. Augusto was helpful with all the questions I asked him about Lisbon. Entire flat was beautiful decorated with vintage furniture and decor, Augusto also had great taste in music! The neighbourhood ain't far, within 10mins walking distance for the tube from the airport. Also everything is pretty much within walking distance, took around half an hour from the flat to the water/downtown Lisbon. Would recommend!

Augusto was flexible about our arrival time. When we checked into our room, there was a glass of port waiting for each of us. Nice touch. The room was cozy and clean, as was the bathroom. Rest of the apartment is in the process of being renovated. Lots of shops in walking distance and if you prefer walking to the city: 20 minutes and you're downtown. Make sure and start your day with some coffee and pastry from "Lido" downstairs. Thanks for everything and best of luck for the future, Augusto.

Primitive, suited for very young people or older hippies. The photo of the room is very far from reality. The bed is a mattress on a pallet. Bathroom is tiny and dark, but there is a shower. The three dogs are quiet, at least when they are in their tiny room. The host seems to have the key to how life should be lived  politically correct. I cannot recommend this place to anyone I know, although it is very cheap and also central.
Muy bueno!  Buena predisposición y ubicacion... instalación comoda
好

Really charming apartment in a lovely neighbourhood with a really fantastic host. Augusto is great guy who went out of his way to help me out on a number of occasions during the month that I stayed there. Would 100% recommended to anyone visiting Lisboa.
Good place... highly recommended

Notre séjour chez Augusto s'est très bien passé. Nous nous sommes sentis comme chez nous. Augusto s'est montré discret mais accessible. Il connait la langue française, cela facilite l'échange quand on ne parle pas un mot de portugais. Appartement très propre, la salle de bain est nettoyée quotidiennement par ex.
Le quartier est assez calme et typique (quelques maisons avec faïences murales) dans la rue, proche de la station de métro qui mène au centre ville. Une bonne adresse ...

Very cozy and charming rooms. Friendly dogs (staying in a separate room mostly). A warm shower. Anything you need is nearby (different supermarkets, shops, pharmacy, quality bakeries, and really nice cafés!). 15min walk to the downtown area. And besides a thoughtful host!

Augusto is a great host! He makes sure you have everything you need. Communication is super easy and the room is spacious and very clean.
Thank you so much!!

Augusto est un super hote. Communication tres simple. Nous avons déposer nos bagages tôt à notre arrivée et nous les avons laissés tard avant de prendre notre avion. L'appartement est idéalement situé (proche du metro, du centre, de l'aéroport), propre et bien décoré. Le seul bémol à été l'odeur. Effectivement, il pleuvait lors de notre séjour et il y avait une tres forte odeur d'humidité dans l'appartement, je ne suis pas sensible a cela, mais la c'était vraiment dérangeant. En regardant les commentaires precedent, je pense que c'était quelques chose d'exceptionnel, donc je recommanderais tout de meme l'appartement. Merci Augusto.
Augusto was a great host, and the apartment is conveniently located. Nice view from the room and easy to walk to from the center. Would book again!
its a nice place in a good central location. super host!!!!

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour à Lisbonne, l'appartement de Augusto est très agréable et bien situé (proche du métro et pas trop loin de l'aéroport). Augusto nous a fait un très bon accueil et est resté très disponible quand nous avions des questions.
On reviendra...

Nous sommes restés 4 jours à Lisbonne, non seulement nous avons apprécié la ville mais aussi notre hôte.
Il a prit le temps au cours d'une soirée de nous faire découvrir les petits coins sympa et non touristiques de Lisbonne. Un bon café dans une brasserie et un resto perché sur une colline avec au menu du poisson localement péché.
L'appartement d'augusto se trouve dans un super coin de Lisbonne, proche de tout. Ligne de metro directe pour l'aéroport.
Nous recommandons évidemment cet appartement à l'esprit d'artiste.

Augusto è stato un proprietario di casa simpatico, cordiale e gentile. La camera e la casa, in generale, corrispondono all'annuncio; ubicazione perfetta per raggiungere a piedi o con i mezzi, ogni sito di interesse. Davanti ad un buon caffè, Augusto ci ha dato ogni tipo di informazione utile richiesta. Lo consigliamo. Augusto, thanks a lot for all!!
Super Week-end chez Augusto. Appart super agréable et Augusto est super sympa. Bien situé, proche du métro et du centre ville.

I would recommend an apartment in Augusto :-)
Close to the subway, shops, next to the market.
The apartment on the 6 floor is a big plus - nice view, more sun and is quieter.
Augusto and his apartment have a wonderful soul.
Big thank you for you welcoming we have got a beautiful bedroom and amazing view on the top house. See you soon :-)

Très bonne expérience sur Lisbonne, tout d'abord l'emplacement, accès très proche moins de 10 minutes (Alameda) de la ligne rouge direct aéroport.
Après il y a un autre métro ligne verte à 5 minutes (Arroios).
A pied pour les courageux vous êtes à un peu plus de 30 minutes.
Pas mal de café et restaurant dans le coin bon marché (Ponte Velha), et aussi d’épicerie.
Appartement très facile à trouver (couleur rose), 6eme et dernier étage mais il y a un ascenseur, l'immeuble a été rénové.
Chambre très sympa, avec une armoire vide, pratique pour tout ranger, et aussi 2 bureaux et un fauteuil.
La cuisine est disponible, et vous pouvez y déjeuner sans soucis, il a un frigidaire, une bouilloire et un machine a café italienne à poser sur le feux (très bon).
Vous avez les clés, donc aucun soucis pour les horaires, vous êtes libres de rentrer et de partir quand vous le souhaitez.
La salle de bain dispose des toilettes et d'une douche très bien entretenue.
Concernant Augusto, il sait se rendre disponible et se montrer discret.
Il parle très bien français, les chiens sont en général dans sa chambre, nous les avons pratiquement pas vu.

This was my second stay with Augusto, I started in Lisbon for a few days, had a great time so returned after a few days in the Algarve. Great location near the Metro, cool vintage apartment and Augusto made everything easy.
Augusto was a great host. I would recommend his place to anyone who is planning to go to Lisbon.

We weren't there long, but Augusto was welcoming and friendly and gave us a great restaurant recommendation in the neighbourhood. It's close to the Metro and in a quieter, more local part of town which is great if you want to go out and party but come back to somewhere stylish, clean and comfortable.

Il mio ragazzo ed io siamo arrivati a tarda notte a Lisbona, ed Augusto è stato molto paziente e disponibile ad aspettarci. La casa è molto carina, un po' bohemienne, con una fantastica vista sui tetti della città. Il bagno, la cucina e l'ampia sala sono tutti spazi in comune, fruibili in ogni momento. La zona è molto comoda, servita sia da autobus che da metro. C'è un'ottima pasticceria sotto casa da non sottovalutare!!!

We only had a short stay of one night at Augusto's place, but we really enjoyed it. The room, as well as the whole appartement, is very pretty and tidy with a nice architecture and furniture. The location is also good and close to the metro station. Augusto is a very friendly and relaxed host, also the communication before the arrival was fast and easy. We would definitely recommend this place!
Augusto was a lovely host and extremely friendly. The room is good value for money and about a 20-30min walk from the centre, but with Uber this was very managable!

Super nice! Last minute booking easily possible, flexible and uncomplicated. Super sweet room with small
Bacon and view up high over the town. I would have even lived to move in!!!! :)

We had a really nice stay at Augusto's apartment. When we arrived he told us some things about Lisbon and the area where he lives, made us some coffee and we had a chat in his kitchen. The room and his whole flat it really pretty, it has a nice artsy touch and his dogs are super cute and will greet anyone. We mostly walked to the city center which took us about 15 minutes, but the metro station Arroios is close too. Thanks for a nice stay, we felt really comfortable!
Augusto is great host!! Totally recommended!!!
Espace de vie bien pensé (à côté de la cuisine et des sanitaires), accueil de la part d'Augusto très sympa et prévenant.

Augusto is a great host and he has a lovely flat high above Lisbon, great view from the balcony, clean and unique room, very flexible regarding arrival and checkout. All that I needed was there. I unfortunately only had 1 night there, but its definitely a nice place to have a home away from home, great to get into the city as well as have a nice travel chat with Augusto in the kitchen. Thank you Augusto and maybe see you again!

It was a great stay at Augusto's place. He was there for a chat or help and the room was really nice.
The neighbourhood is an authentic one with no touristic influence. There are loads of little shops and places to eat around and the green line brings you right downtown.
Augusto liet ons direct welkom voelen. Hij gaf de nodige informatie en we komen verder onze eigen gang gaan. Een zeer relaxte sfeer.

Our stay at Augusto's place couldn't have been better. The place is very clean and tidy and the room is really beautifull. Augusto is a very welcoming host and makes you feel at home right away, just like visiting an old friend. The room is close to the city centre as well to the metro, you can get anywhere really fast.
I would really recommend Augusto's place!

Augusto a été un super hôte ! Il nous a même fait découvrir un de ses restaurants favoris !
Appart super, avec un talent pour la décoration. Accueillant, simple et plein de charme en même temps, ce logement était une vraie belle surprise ! Nous ne sommes restées qu'une nuit, mais je le recommande pour un plus long séjour !

L appartement présente un double avantage, on accède facilement, en metro, au centre et à l aeroport. L ambiance de vie dans l appartement est boheme. Il ne faut pas hésiter à se promener dans le quartier où se situe l appartement, les épiceries et les restaurants y sont peu chers.
Augusto is a friendly host and knows a lot about nice places around.

Although we only stayed for the night, we felt extremely welcome and sorry that we couldn't stay longer. Augusto was welcoming and flexible about out check-in and the room was clean and tidy. Also, the metro station is really close to the apartement, which is convenient for sightseeing. All in all, we had a great time. We would surely recommend Augusto's place!

The apartment from Augusto was very cosy and clean and was very welcoming like Augusto himself, he was very friendly and generous.
We had everything we needed and the neighbourhood was nice and the metro close to the apartment. Nice little restaurants, shops and bakeries for the breakfast and a park.
Very nice and tidy room! Clean bathroom and a very friendly host!

Augusto ist der Wahnsinn! Ich hab mich sofort gefühlt, als wenn ich einen alten Freund besuche. Er hat mir nach einem entspannten Gespräch in der Küche die Stadt gezeigt fernab von touristischen Standardrouten. Außerdem waren wir so toll essen! Ein toller Gastgeber! Ich kann ihn als Host nur wärmstens weiterempfehlen!
He was very welcoming and friendly.  We were able to use the metro which was fairly close by and found our way around. Nice guy!

Augusto war ein guter Gastgeber. Das Zimmer war sehr schön und die Wohnung liegt nur ein paar Gehminuten von einer Metro Station entfernt und es sind etwa 15-20 Min zu Fuß in die Stadt. In der Wohnung leben 3 Hunde, die aber eigentlich immer in Augustos Zimmer waren - wer also kein Problem damit hat, ist hier super aufgehoben! Definitiv weiterzuempfehlen!

Augusto was very welcoming and helped us with the suitcases. He Showed us the appartment and our room. The location is a good walk from the centre but the metro and bus station are around the corner and goes directly to the centre. Also shops nearby for your everyday need.
The room has a good size and nice furniture. We booked for 5 nights but stayed only 2 because the bed was to hard for us
(even though it was a new one) and we slept poorly. There is a moist smell in the room. Also there is some noise from the streets and can be a bit hot. This is because its a old house...
One other thing is that you can't lock the room from the outside.
The room has a nice view (it's on the 6th floor, there is an elevator ;) )
The bathroom and the rest of the space are nice. Kitchen has all the basics you need.

Augusto was very nice and helped us like a true gentlemen with our early leave. Thx and all the best!!

Augusto nous a très bien accueilli, il a été de très bons conseils pour visiter la ville ! Il est très sympa et serviable. On s'est vite senti à l'aise. Le quartier est sympa et à 15 min a pied du centre.

Stay with Augusto and you won't be disappointed. Great historic apartment, great room, great view, great location. You can walk to the castle, waterfront and hotspots like Alfarma within 45mins. Train station within 2 mins. Augusto is one of the most chilled hosts we've had. He'll give you your space, but is happy to chat and give you local advice whilst making a coffee or dinner. We recommend a stay with Augusto!

Augusto was really nice and his apartament is cosy and arranged with style :) He has dogs but he keeps them away from the guests (in case you are afraid). There was a great window view from our room! It was a chilly and comfortable stay :) (we also won't forget the Bulgarian books and the folk song we heard from your room! :)
Super comfy room in a nice and clean flat. I had a great stay in Augusto's place.

The apartment is very well located, with an awesome view, just a 3 minute walk to a metro stop, and the walk downtown takes about 20-30 minutes and allowed us to discover Lisbon outside of the touristy areas. Augusto was always kind, though we often did not see him. We were glad to have use of the small but sufficient kitchen available to use, and the good water pressure and hot shower were great, not so standard in AirBnBs of this price range. The room itself was well laid out, but smelled faintly odd; keeping the window open helped, but when the dogs were out and about they could enter through the window from the large balcony that wraps around the entire flat. In the end we enjoyed our time there, but this room may not be ideal to people easily bothered by animals or odd smells.
I spent two weeks in Augustos flat and had a wonderful stay there. Augusto is a very lovely person and I felt very comfortable there. Thank you very much for everything!!
Хорошее место, чтобы остановиться в Лиссабоне. Метро очень близко. Чистая и удобная комната со всем необходимым. Хозяин очень приятный человек.

Appartement très bien situé,  ideal pour rejoindre le centre ville a pied. Le quartier n est pas touristiques ce qui permet de découvrir des restaurants authentiques le soir.  Augusto a été un très bon hote, discret, l'appartement est calme on se sent comme à la maison.  Je le recommande!

Augusto était présent lors de notre arrivée, il s'est montré disponible.
L'appartement est bien situé et est très propre.

Notre hôte nous attendais à notre arrivée. Il nous a indiqué les lieux auxquels nous avions accès. L'appartement était agréable, bien situé au centre de Lisbonne. Augusto s'est montré très disponible et d'une grande discrétion. Il parle bien le français . C'est une adresse qu'on peut recommander.

Augusto was such a good host!!! We were welcomed early in the morning (as our plane arrived at that time) with coffee and cheese! The flat is cozy and individual with interesting details and clean. The room, where we slept, has an access to a sunny balcony with a nice view over the roofs. With Augusto we had some nice and perceptive talks - a pity that Lisbon is such an interesting town that we hadn´t more time to speak! May be, next time! We felt very comfortably! Thank you very much, Augusto!
Augusto was very helpful in explaining practical matters. It was a pleasure talking to him, and getting to know his personal perspectives. The place was fully in accordance with indicated standards.

I travelled with my boyfriend and we had a really good time staying in Augustos place. The room was supernice with lots of lovely decoration and the balcony was simply amazing. Sunshine and a bright room during the morning helped us starting our days in Lisbon. Thanks a lot again, Augusto!

Augusto is a very friendly host and he invited us to a coffee after arrival and we had a nice chat in his kitchen. The room was like seen on his picture and the flat in only (max.) 5 min far away from the next metro station what is perfect to discover Lisboa. The street has a lot of typical coffee bars with the yummie pastel de natas and a small supermarket for your daily needs. The room and flat were clean and has a lot of lovely (vintage) decoration details. We definitely can recommend to stay at Augustos place.

Augusto was very welcoming and instantly made me feel at ease. His English is excellent and he told me a lot about the history of the area. The room was lovely and just as depicted on the website. I wish I could have stayed longer.

La chambre est très bien avec une magnifique vue sur les toits de Lisonne, l'appartement est beau et dans un quartier entre l'aeroport et le centre, on peut faire plein de choses à pied. Nous avons été bien accueillis par Augusto.
It was ok,host was very nice and welcoming
I booked on behalf of my son who described Augusto as 'legend'. As he is still travelling, I'm afraid I can say no more.
An authentic place with cozy neighborhood. Enjoyed the Lissabon flair and Augusto played some cool tunes
es war sehr schön bei Augusto, ein sehr freundlicher Empfang, man ist sehr zentral, die Wohnung ist super, Blick über die Dächer.

We stayed four nights at Augusto's,he was very kind and warm,very helpful and very discreet.The house is old but charming,our room was clean and we slept very well.The whole neighborhood is full of colour and welcoming people. We will surely visit another time.We really enjoyed our stay at Augusto.

Augusto is a rare gem. He is highly respectful and attentive (the kind of person you feel like you've already known for years). Charming home in a vibrant neighborhood, this stay was a defining feature of my trip to Portugal and is highly recommended.
Thanks augusto for our Nice stay at the appartment!!! It's a very plesent place and augusto is warm welcoming!!!

L'appartamento di Augusto si trovò poco distante dal centro (facilmente raggiungibile in Metropolitana) in un edificio storico; l'arredamnto della camera e dell'intera casa è studiato con molto gusto. La camera è luminosa, il letto è abbastanza confortevole, il bagno è piccolo ma equipaggiato di tutto punto (forniti asciugamani puliti, asciugacapelli, doccia con getto valido), la cucina,a disposizione degli ospiti, è  anch'essa piccolina (assemblata con mobilio di recupero) ma funzionale. Augusto è stato ospitale, ci ha fornito indicazioni sul quartiere e consigliato un posticino per la cena.

Grâce aux explications d'Augusto, le trajet entre l'aéroport et son domicile a été simple.
La chambre est exactement comme elle apparait sur la photo. Il met plein de plantes vertes dans son appartement et c'est bien agréable.
La chambre est située au soleil levant et lorsque le soleil brille, c'est un régal.
Le quartier est agréable, plutôt populaire. Nous y avons apprécié les "pastelarias" (patisseries) et nous avons trouvé un petit restaurant, où nous avons mangé tous les soirs du poisson grillé.. A deux pas de l'appartement. Il y en a un assez grand choix.
Certaines personnes ont eu des problèmes avec l'eau chaude de la douche, mon mari aussi la première fois : Il n'avait pas écouté le fonctionnement... Ensuite, il était ravi !
Il y a 3 chiens dans l'appartement qu'il a recueillis, mais nous ne les avons jamais vus et ils sont très calmes.
L'accès à la cuisine permet de prendre son petit déjeuner comme à la maison.. Et nous aurions pu aussi faire le diner mais avons préféré une autre solution !!
Son appartement est très propre et c'est très agréable d'avoir des grandes serviettes de toilette, au lieu des très petites que nous avions emmenées.
Nous avons donc passé un excellent week-end à Lisbonne. Seule ombre au tableau, une odeur d'humidité persistante, peut être normale dans un vieil immeuble. Mais désagréable pour nous.. Heureusement, nous avons peu laisser la fenêtre ouverte pendant tout notre séjour.
Nous souhaitons vivement que Augusto trouve une solution car il le mérite afin que ses projets soient un succès.

Thanks to all Augusto's explanations, it was easy to get to his place. The room is just like on the picture. His flat is full of green plants and that's lovely. The room in the morning is very nice... Particurly when it's sunny.
The area is really pleasant and it was great to have Augusto's keys... So simple.
Some people talk about troubles about hot water.. My husband had... because he didn't listen to the details and afterwards she shower works properly and he had very hot water !! No trouble at all.
hHis flat is really very clean and it's nice to have large bath-towels.
It's easy to have breakfast at Augusto's.. And we could could diner too, but we prefer enjooying a little restaurant up the street where they grill fishes for us... Just nice.. And round the corner, a lot of "Pastelarias"... Where we bought some delicious portugese pastries.
We had a lovely time in Lisbon... We had just a trouble, a smell we didn't like, humidity.. May be normal in an old flat, but difficult for us, but fortunately we could keep the window open.

We hope that Augusto'll be able to change that sometimes because he's a lovely person and it'll be nice that his projects will be successful.

Augusto est une personne très accueillante, sympathique, serviable, et très sensible au bien-être de ses hôtes. Il fait tout pour qu'on se sente bien chez lui, dans la simplicité. Appartement prppre, situé dans un quartier bien desservi par les transports en commun.
Zeer gezellie locatie. Appartement is erg gezellig ingericht en je voelt je er meteen thuis.  Top ervaring en voor herhaling vatbaar !
Augosto was a perfect host. Available, nice and with good advice. His flat is very beautiful. It's a very nice place to stay in Lisboa, easy to go in the city center (Metro realy next to the flat).

Augusto is a musician. The apartment locates well near the metro station, which is just four stops from the city centre, Rossio. Hi Augusto,

couldn't say goodbye because of early flight.. ö

Thank you for your kindness and hospitality!

Kind Regards

I have spent a lot of time at Augusto's place which means the room was amazing,so antiquely but charming and tidy.the location also great.lots restaurant ,close to the metro station .definitely recommend it!!

I had a wonderful stay at Augusto's place. The house is old (it has aged beautifully) and charming, yet also clean and well-equipped.  When I arrived the first time, Augusto was there to give me a warm welcome. Later, the dogs were happy to assist him on the job. The bed was super comfortable, the balcony nice and sunny. I truly felt at home. Moreover, I was lucky to spend some time with Augusto, besides being a great host, he's a great person. I would definitely go back.

Correu tudo bem. O Augusto é  um anfitrião gentil, fácil e flexivel nos horários de entrada e saida. Adorei a casa, a arquitectura e interiores, antigos e belos,o ambiente familiar, simples, limpo, confortável e com tudo o que é necessário . A luz e o solinho na varanda do quarto com a vista sobre os telhados de lisboa foi uma boa experiência, aliada ao silêncio e tranquilidade da casa, tornou a estadia muito agradável. Very warm welcome. The place is very authentic, cute. Around 20-25 min walking to the center, but that was exactly what we were looking for. Otherwise a very nice place to stay! Thank you
Gracias fue un placer estar en su casa

Comfortable room and good location! Value for the cash that you 'd pay!
Thanks to him..

Nice arty flat in bustling neighbourhood in Lisbon. On the main metro line into the centre, so very easy to get around. Super local restaurants in the road below the flat.
Augusto was very welcoming, the flat was spotless, and we had a good chat about Portuguese politics! I slept very well, and didn't hear any noise from the street.

Augusto is a cool and friendly man. The room has an amazing view on the city and very cozy. There are 3 dogs in the apartment, but they are nice.  There is a subway station in 3 minutes. Water in shower is a bit unpredictable, but it adds more fun:)

Cool place! Vert close to the Metro so you get to the city centre in about 5 minutes! Very old building which is very charming and the room is big and very clean!!
I would go back at augusto's without hesitation!!!
Augusto's place was a please sure to stay and very clean. The welcome was very warm and the environment really relaxed. I can recommend this place!

Augusto's made his place a really cosy one,  well decored and clean to stay. He knows how to welcome his guests! It's not far from Lisbon center and the airport. We, for sure,  would take the room without hesitation for next time!!

I fell in love with Augusto's place when I saw the photos. The reality was at least as beautiful, it was a great pleasure to stay there! The room, with open doors to the balcony in the afternoon sun - a delicate dream.
Augusto made us feel very welcome and inspite of the short amount of time we spent there, we had some interesting conversations.
Definite recommendation!:)
Cool man, cool place ...
We stayed one night at Augusto's and found him to be very welcoming. The room was really stylish, and although very central was quiet at night. Very relaxed environment. Would recommend.

We stayed at this room once before in June. And we liked it so much that we came back for 2 nights. It was really great to see Augusto again, we had a warm welcome und we felt like visiting a friend. The roum and the whole flat is very cozy and there´s always a good atmosphere.

The Location with all the small little shops and simple and cheap restaurants was perfect for our stay.

We definitely would come for a 3rd time!!! :-)
It was great, warm welcome, great room with a beutiful view. Nice neighourhood nice people. Good restaurant downstairs,hope we will be back next year. Augusto is a very good host.
The room was very cosy and clean. Location was perfect only 100 meters to metro station. Augusto was very friendly. I can recomend this Republica
It was a really beautifil flat with a great room which was clean.  Augosto helped us to find a few things in the City and answered all our questions.  It was beautiful to stay there.

Augusto's penthouse has a great location in a genuine Lisbon city neighborhood. The subway is very close by. It is a 15-20 minutes ride from the airport and only a few minutes to the city center. Walking to downtown is also very easy. The apartment is clean, and although A has dogs, the place is not smelly. He takes good care of it and makes sure it is clean and tidy, which I liked. My room was perfect, with balcony doors that could be open, a wardrobe, chairs, table, bookshelf and last but not least -  a big comfortable bed. Several pillows was a big plus. The door can be locked from the inside (not outside though) which is also very good. Although situated on the top floor, ear plugs is recommended due to some night traffic (if you are sensitive). I noticed a perfume smell close to the bookshelf (which I didn't like), and upon my leave I detected that it came from a scent improver connected to the electric socket. Had I seen this earlier I would have removed it. In my opinion it is unnecessary, cos there is no bad smell in the room. I made a suggestion to A that he informs the guests if they want this or not. A is easy to talk to and gives you all the privacy you want. This is also highly appreciated! To summarize - this a great place to stay for a night or longer. I would gladly choose this place again if I return to Lisbon.

Augusto est accueillant. Les photos de l'appartement son confirmes à la réalité. Emplacement pratique car proche du métro et des points stratégiques.
Cependant, on a noté une odeur désagréable dans la cuisine qui ne nous a pas engagé à l'utiliser.

très bon accueil de notre hôte dès notre arrivée. quartier populaire où il fait bon vivre avec tout ces commerces, ces cafés et son marché.
proche de la station de la station de métro menant au centre de Lisbonne.
logement calme et agréable avec tout ce qu'il faut dedans.
Augusto a été accueillant et bienveillant. L'appartement était comme décrit dans l'annonce. Chambre très propre, appartement très bien situé.
Augusto is very kind and the house is nice. The room si big, the in design is extremely good so it was a positive experience!

The flat is very tidy, big and well located (not far from the metro). The house smells a bit like his dogs, but it's clean. Augusto welcomes you with a coffee and lets you feel at home.
Obrigada!

Augusto is very nice and friendly host. He waited for us in the flat and shown us the place. He also perk coffee and talk with us about country and the city. His flat is very clean and the room is very well decorated. All flat was very clean and he is also ready to show the guests around the city. The flat is located near two Metro stations and it is very easy to acess all parts of the city.

It was nice apartment on the top floor of the building. Big and clean living room, bedroom and bathroom. It was an old house but good and fun looking.
Augusto was helpful and knowledgeable about history of Europe and Lisbon.
It is a good location. Not far from metro and yet a little outside of the touristy area so nice and quiet.
Thanks for letting us stay Augusto!

After the initial shock of Augusto answering the door in his underwear :P I realized that the reason I booked this room - the many positive comments left by single, female travelers - was exactly the right one. I felt very SAFE at Augusto's place. He is an easy-going host who truly makes his home your home. The room is beautifully bright and airy and very spacious by European standards, and the bed is comfortable. The house does smell a bit like his dogs, but it's clean and well located in the city. I would certainly stay here again.

The room is spaious and well decorated. Very good located, easy to get to downtown and airport! flat is clean and very nice designed!!Augusto is interesting and nice to talk to.
房間空間感很不錯，裝潢的很有特色，住的非常舒服！地點也不錯，搭地鐵就可到市中心及機場，很方便！

Apartment had a nice Lisbon vibe to it and the host seemed to suit it too! Augusto seemed nice and I was actually stunned how clean the apartment seemed. Though that wasn't a problem for us, thanks for a nice stay, Augusto!

Augusto has a wonderful house and has been nicely decorated. He is very respectful and very willing to help. We even had dinner together one night and he invited me to his friends art exhibition. Thanks again Augusto '

Unfortunately we could only stay for one night as we had to fly back the following day. Augusto is really a fantastic host. The room is cosy and spacious, the whole flat is really stylish and super clean. The district is great to discover Lisbon. We highly recommend Augustos República das bananas! :-)

This flat is veeery nice and we can only recomnd it! Very good located, flat is clean and very nice designed:)

the room was as described.. we did have a comfortable stay...:)

Great apartment, lots of beautiful books and art. The room was airy and wonderful. Augusto was interesting and great fun to chat with!

Republica das Bananas is a splendid place : very tastefully decorated (incl. vintage keyboards) and tidy. Augusto himself is an impeccable host. Very friendly, quick in response, helpful in directions and he knows a lot about Lisboa.

Augusto is a very friendly host. The facilities are perfectly clean. Augusto's dogs are cute, calm and well-behaved. I recommend Augusto's place wholeheartedly. The value for money is unbeatable.

Gerrit and Mia from Hamburg, Germany

We had a great stay at Augusto´s lovely apartment. The room was airy, cosy and clean. Augusto himself was very helpful and responsive, from welcoming us with a cup of tea after our late night arrival to saying goodbye with a marvellous chocolate cake! The apartment is well located, 3min walk to a metro station and bus stop across the street. Great places to eat and for shopping near by. Highly reccomended.

Augusto war sehr nett und hilfsbereit. Die Unterkunft war wie in den Angaben beschrieben. Das Zimmer hat eine super Anbindung zum Flughafen und zum Stadtkern. Wir hatten einen tollen Aufenthalt in Lissabon.
Augusto fue muy atento. Es una persona amable. Me agrado y quedé satisfecho con el lugar. Lo recomendaría, sin duda. Se encuentra bien ubicado, y cerca de una estación del metro.

In einer solchen Wohnung möchte man eigentlich nur länger bleiben.
Authentizität, Flair und Gastfreundschaft perfekt umgesetzt.
Wir hatten einen herrlichen Aufenthalt in Lissabon und das haben wir besonders unseren Gastgeber Augusto zu verdanken. Gerne wieder, Amigo!

A VERY NICE PLACE TO STAY ....WELL LOCATED.....AUGUSTO IS VERY FRIENDLY
THE ROOM IS CLEAN AND THE APARTMENT IS VERY CLOSE TO THE METRO
WE RECOMMEND !!!

Had a nice time at augustos flat, well located, all basic covered for a nice price, highly recommended!

Very nice stay at Augusto's place. The house is very nice and the neighbourhood as well, on walking distance of the historical center. Really recommendable, especially for couples, since a beautiful private room with a comfortable double bed is very nice.

Thanks very much Augusto.

Augusto (and his dogs) is very discret but disponible if necessary.

Nice and clean room. Good location. There are three dogs that are over-passionated.
Augusto is a really nice host, his apartment is beautiful and i felt like home. I hope to come back soon to discover more about this city.

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour chez Augusto qui a partagé avec nous ses bonnes adresses sur Lisbonne. L'appartement est exactement comme sur les photos et comme il le décrit.

Nice and cozy apartment, next to the metro station, the owner is precise and nice, everything went very smooth. Great quality/price ratio, I can recommend it.

10/10

He's a welcoming, very interesting and memorable person. I definitely recommend that place :)

Augusto was a very very nice host. Everything went perfect. He even let me stay one day longer and organised everything spontanious. The flat is very cool and the metro is just arround the corner. If I will be in Lisbon again, I will definetly contact him again!

Really nice flat, Augusto was really interressant and gave us a lot of good plans. The room was really clean and the district was quiet but close to the center, perfect stay in this flat! Thank you Augusto!

Augusto is a sweet and lovely guy who listen to good music! His flat is well located, 5min. from metro station (Arroios). The room was nice and clean. He has three dogs, we saw one of them and she was funny! We recommand this address! (:

Augusto was a great host.

Augusto had a nicely furnished room for me and my friend Isa, with small works of arts in his beautiful flat. He welcomed us friendly. As we were just one and a half days in Lissabon, we were out in town and haven´t had more contact.

Augusto was a great host, I felt welcome and the room is beautiful. It was just a short stay but I enjoyed it very much.

Great place, perfect host, metro nearby. Also this area - between Alameda and Anjos - is one of my favorite spots in Lisbon. Nearly no tourists! Hope to have another beer with you Augusto, one of these days!

Beautiful view, great location!
Excellent host!
Thanks a lot!

I spent about a week in Lisbon, Augusto is a very friendly host I felt very comfortable in the room and sharing the apartment. The balcony was brilliant and the bed was cozy. He even made me dinner and took me to a restaurant on my last night, a brilliant way to see Lisbon!

nice and inspiring apartment!

Great stay at Augusto's. They are both very nice and helpful. Great location, the room is very nice, simple but with spaces, big windows, balcony, wardrobe.

Great host.

Augusto is very nice and helpful. The room has a beautiful view and is located in a nice area and very close to the metro. All in all a good experience.
it was the best choice to stay, they are nice and friendly and hospitable. i enjoyed my stay very much!
on remercie Augusto  pour son accueil. C 'est une personne très agréable et gentil avec un très jolie appartement à 5 minutes du métro . On le recommande fortement .
Augusto is a great host and his flat is beautifull; most of all he can tell you great stories about a road trip between lisbonne and salzburg, or advices about where to go in portugal...

Augusto é um verdadeiro gentlemann! Um autêntico Lisboeta, sensível, sincero, honestíssimo, acolhedor, com extremo bom gosto, figura humana maravilhosa! Grato!

Le séjour chez Pedro était magnifique! L’appartement est très beau et très propre. Il est idéalement situé pour visiter la ville. Nous avons passé un excellent séjour et les petites attentions et la flexibilité lors de notre arrivée à été très appréciée :) merci encore!

The place was lovely and in a perfect location, very walkable and the host was very responsive when needed. I enjoyed my stay here and would recommend this place. Like all the other reviews just watch your head where some of the ceilings are lower but I think that added character to the place. Overall enjoyed my stay and would stay here again!

Pedro and his team were responsive and great hosts.  The apartment is in a great location- safe and convenient- and looks as advertised.  It is a bit difficult navigating the low ceilings, so I would not have enjoyed an extended stay. But for a few days, or if the ceiling height is not a problem for you,  I would highly recommend

Francesco una persona estremamente gentile e disponibile
Appartamento molto bello arredato con gusto,pulito
E Con delle accortezze di benvenuto molto gradevoli !
Dal bigliettino Dalla frutta ai cioccolatini e alla bottiglia del vino local !!
Buona posizione
Consigliatissimo!!!
Grazie siamo state benissimo

Grazie mille
Lovely apartment in great location.
Amazing location and lovely hosts! Thank you

Muito obrigado pela hospitalidade e por toda a atenção durante nossa estadia.
O apartamento estava impecável e muito bem localizado, o que tornou nossa experiência em Lisboa ainda mais especial.
Agradecemos também pela comunicação sempre rápida e clara — isso fez toda a diferença.
Ficamos muito satisfeitos e certamente recomendaremos.
Um abraço e até uma próxima!
Would absolutely stay at Pedro’s place again. Such an incredible place that was so local to the best restaurants and shops! Perfect place. Would stay again!

Perfect for exploring Lisbon and walking around the city. Quirky and fun place with one of the most comfortable chairs I’ve ever sat in! The bed was really comfortable with loads of nice pillows. The kitchen was great for what we needed.
Fantastic place, ideal location, spotlessly clean, great price and very helpful and accommodating hosts. Would recommend 100% and will certainly be back again soon. Thank you

Right in the Chiado close to restaurants, bars and cafes. Me and my boyfriend loved the place, and even tilting our heads a whole bunch. We booked it knowing that would be the case however! Many thanks for the clean and cosy stay.
Great location and beautiful loft :)

Très bon accueil, super appartement, décoré avec goût et idéalement placé au coeur de la ville.
Merci Pedro, nous reviendrons !
Great location and cool place to stay. But be aware you need to climb some stairs, especially if you have heavy luggage.

Appartement très agréable et hôtes très attentifs. De petites attentions ont été ajoutées, merci beaucoup !
Ils ont également réservé un taxi pour me conduire à l’aéroport rapidement, ce qui a été vraiment appréciable.
L’appartement est magnifique, et malgré le bruit de la rue, assez fréquentée le vendredi soir, je n’ai pas été dérangé du tout. Draps et serviettes impeccables, literie super confortable. Je recommande vivement !
Encore merci à vous !
it’s a super beautiful apartment for solo travel ,the location was nice and the apartment itself also creative

a real gem in Lisbon's heart. place is very well decorated, has charm and feels homey straightaway. not often that I find places that are so nice. everything inside is well thought off , you can see that they have experience with short let and that they make an effort to stand out.
Lovely stay in Chiado. The hosts were very kind and the apartment was comfortable and clean! Thank you

Great place in the heart of Lisbon. Everything is at walking distance. So many restaurants around as well as shops. Pedro and his team were amazing, met me at check in and explained everything I needed to know about the apartment. Left an itinerary, as well as all the things Lisbon has to offer, along with some treats. Extremely responsive, and they’re flexible with check in. Went above and beyond. Apartment is exactly as pictured. Spotless apartment. 100% recommended,and will definitely stay here again if I visit Lisbon again.
Staying here was a great experience. They went above and beyond to make sure I had everything I needed and were always available for any questions. The location is excellent.
Very cool space in a great location. Pedro made us feel very welcome. Would definitely stay again and recommend to anyone

I had an enjoyable stay at Pedro's Lisbon apartment! The space was neat and well decorated/designed. I especially appreciate the hosts' help during check in, as well as their responsiveness and all of the helpful information they provide about the space, including local recommendations. I was able to use the wifi for work, and I felt safe throughout my stay. Ideal and central location, walkable to hot spots and public transportation. Be aware this is a multiple story walk up apartment, and that there is nightlife especially on weekend evenings which may be of concern for light sleepers. Overall, I highly recommend this apartment for a trip to Lisbon!

tolles Apartment in super Lage mitten in der Stadt.
Einfache und unkomplizierte Kommunikation mit dem Gastgeber.
Padro met us when we arrived and was helpful with explaining the the Airbnb. The location is amazing for walking around the city. It can be a bit noisy at night but a great place to stay and explore!
Hosts were really responsive and flexible. Check in was smooth. The loft looked a little bit bigger on the pictures but it was comfortable enough for me and my parents. Really good location.

Great location and hosts for our first trip to Lisbon! A personal check-in was incredibly helpful and gave us the opportunity to ask questions. We got information about the space, appliances, and surroundings. The apartment had a lot of character and was very comfortable. Their local recommendations for activities and food were a bonus. There is a grocery market conveniently located right next door. There was some noise outside at night due to the strong presence of nightlife in the area, but being up on the third floor we felt very safe and were able to sleep easily.  We enjoyed being in the heart of the activity! The hosts quickly responded to all messages and were helpful and accommodating. Wonderful stay.

I can’t praise Pedro’s place enough. The welcome was warm and abundant, there was just the right amount of information to support the trip and they even left real oranges out to use the electric orange juicer!
It was such an abundant space and I slept well.
The location is amazing. A 10 minute walk from the meeting place for the getyourguide tours - which I highly recommend too.
A wonderful, warm, light space with lots of windows and everything you could possibly need.
I can see now why the ratings are so high!

Great place right in heart of Lisbon. You walk out the door to many restaurants and shops. No shortage of things to do! Pedro and his team were also great! They personally greeted me at the door and gave me a tour of the apartment. They were very responsive and provided a booklet with local recommendations. Highly recommend!

Loved the location and it was very clean, and had a very comfortable bed.
The only drawback for us was that we are both tall and even though the space was so lovely, we just couldn’t relax with the sloping ceiling and did hit our head a few times.
Overall we did have a lovely stay.

Prima Kommunikation, Wohnung wie im Inserat, alles top. Obwohl wir die Gegend in Chiado kannten und der Host auch darauf hinweist, war es Freitag- und Samstagnacht leider doch lauter als erwartet. Aber mit Ohrenstöpsel kann man trotzdem schlafen. Absolut liebenswert war der Supermarkt gleich nebenan. Insgesamt hatten wir tolle Tage in Lissabon und das hat die Wohnung definitiv mit beeinflusst.
Great stay! Pedro & Francisco were especially helpful :)
Eine toll eingerichtete Wohnung für ein Wochenende in Lissabon mit allem drum und dran. Uns hat es super gefallen!
It was great

The loft space was so chic and cozy. Love being to creep out to the sea, the spaciousness of the shower + rainfall shower head, the close proximity to so many restaurants, sights, shops and train station and how cool & crisp it felt at night. The host was so kind and welcome. 10/10 stay all day.

We loved our 3 nights here. The apartment was a great location with good amenities, great air conditioning and a comfy bed. Really appreciated the proactive messages from the host to ensure we were enjoying our time
Wonderful apartment, super cool place in an ideal location and spotlessly clean. Extremely responsive and helpful hosts, we’d love to return one day.

We had a wonderful stay at this Lisbon apartment. The staff was quick to respond to my messages, which made the booking and check-in process easy and stress-free. The apartment itself is very clean, well-equipped, and in a great location—close to restaurants, shops, and with a grocery store right next door.
We were able to drop off our luggage earlier than check-in time, which was a big help. Francisco welcomed us personally, walked us through how to use the appliances, and made us feel right at home. We also appreciated the thoughtful welcome gift of a bottle of wine.
It was a perfect place for me, my wife, and my son. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Lisbon.

Pedro was super communicative and even greeted me to take my bags since I arrived in Lisbon well before check in. The location is super walkable and you can reach most parts of the city via short uber or scooter if you don’t want to walk.

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour à quatre amis dans cet appartement. Il est très bien situé, proche de nombreux commerces et activités, ce qui est vraiment pratique. L’appartement correspond parfaitement à la description, propre et fonctionnel. Comme indiqué, le quartier est un peu bruyant, mais nous le savions et cela ne nous a pas dérangés. Très bonne expérience, je recommande !

Very nice appartament in the centre of lisbon.
All the team always ready to help
Highly reccomended

“Pedro was an incredible host, and his place was exactly what we were looking for—right in the heart of the city and just steps away from great restaurants. As a group of three 25-year-olds, we couldn’t have asked for a better stay. We’d highly recommend Pedro’s space to anyone visiting!”
Pedro’s place is a great home base for your time in Lisbon. It’s a really cool space in a walkable area. I definitely recommend it!
We loved staying here right in the heart of Chiado. Perfectly located. Lovely and cool with the air conditioning. Beautifully designed and a relaxing space to be in after the busyness of the city.

I had a great time staying in Pedro’s place. Super convenient location, walkable to nearly all the top attractions. Despite the place being in an old building, I was really surprised how nicely renovated it was. Very well designed layout, nice architectural details, and kitchen well stocked with tons of cooking utensils. The AC worked really well, and noise was never an issue. Highly recommend.
Everything was great. The apartment was very nice, clean and located in a very central and well connected location. Pedro was very responsive and helpful. 10/10, would definitely come back!
Beautiful place and kind welcoming hosts. This place is great for 1-2 people in the heart of Lisbon. Highly recommend

Ab dem Moment der Buchung haben wir ausschließlich eine superfreundliche, zuvorkommende und herzliche Kommunikation erlebt.
Der Check-In erfolgt persönlich und lässt keine Fragen offen.
Die Einrichtung ist hell, modern und doch authentisch. Richtig cozy!
Wer hier bleibt, sollte sich aber darüber freuen wirklich mitten im Geschehen dieser zauberhaften Großstadt zu sein!! Abends und nachts ging der Trubel weiter, wir fanden das aber sehr schön, zumal wir durch Pedro in der Beschreibung und auch nochmal nach der Buchung explizit darauf hingewiesen wurden.
Die Lage ist sensationell gut! Man stolpert aus der Haustür direkt ins Lissaboner Leben! 💜
Die Tram 28 hat ihre Endhaltestelle direkt neben der Haustür.
Herrlich war‘s, einfach! Ganz große Weiterempfehlung!
Absolutely amazing! The best airbnb in Lisbon I've ever had. Highly recommend this flat :) great location an communication with owners too!

I had a wonderful stay at Pedro‘s. I mainly communicated with Antonio and Francisco. Francisco met me the night I arrived to check me in and walk me through how things worked in the apartment (very helpful). The location is 10/10 and within walking distance to all the major attractions and so many delicious restaurants. The grocery store downstairs was really handy. I agree with other reviews stating that if you are sensitive to noise, it’s probably not the best place for you to stay. The host does describe this in the listing and I was aware and prepared for it. A small price to pay to be in an excellent area and comfortable loft. :-) Thank you all for hosting me!
Pedro’s place was very well located and clean. The AC was also great during the heat wave in Portugal. The hist and team were super responsive for anything we needed.
Wir waren zum dritten Mal in einer Unterkunft von chiadolofts und es war wiedermal top! Perfekte Unterkunft in Lissabon! Vielen Dank für alles, wir kommen sehr gerne wieder!
I had a great stay at this lovely apartment. Very centrally located and walkable area. The hosts are very friendly, responsive and easy to communicate with. Thank you so much!
Really lovely flat above bustling streets, super communicative hosts with great recommendations, would come again!

The perfect 2-night stay. The hosts were always very timely with responses prior to, and upon, arrival. They welcomed us right on arrival and even helped us walk our heavy luggages up the stairs which was a HUGE help! The space was amazing. Very cute and thoughtful touches throughout and beautiful views from the windows. The location is perfect–close by to many popular eats, fun bars, and there’s a market right at the ground floor which made it easy to grab a quick snack! We wished we were staying longer because everything was so perfect, but we will definitely be coming back to stay here!

We had a fantastic stay at Pedro’s place! The apartment was spotless and very well-maintained — you can tell cleanliness is a top priority here. The location couldn’t be better: just minutes from the heart of downtown, with tons of great restaurants, bars, and cool local spots right around the corner. It’s a perfect base for exploring the city. Pedro was also an exceptional host — super responsive, friendly, and made everything easy from check-in to checkout. Highly recommend staying here if you’re looking for a clean, convenient, and stylish spot in a vibrant neighborhood!

Pedro’s apartment is stylish and comfortable and located such that we were able to walk to local shops, charming neighborhoods and great restaurants. He provides a comprehensive list of recommended establishments  both nearby and farther out. We found fresh oranges at check-in to go with the juicer!  Thoughtful and responsive host.

Enjoyed our stay. Apartment was very clean and nicely decorated. Hosts were very responsive and greeted us when we arrived. Everything was very clean and well stocked. Yes its next to a busy alleyway but we had no issues with noise and is what we expected when staying in a busy location. Would stay here again next time we are in Lisbon.

Die Location geht nicht besser in Lissabon.
Man konnte den ganzen Spirit der Stadt genießen.
Top!
Great location in the center and the team is very friendly to welcome me. The apartment is bright and spacious enough.

The accommodation was lovely, cosy and exactly as described. The host met us at the accommodation and gave us a tour of the apartment and provided us with great recommendations for food and things to do. Wonderful stay and would highly recommend! Thanks again for all your help.
Perfect stay and very friendly check in! Thank you so much !

Die Unterkunft war wirklich fantastisch, liebevoll eingerichtet und super zentral gelegen.
Die Kommunikation war einfach klasse, nach der ersten Nacht wurde gefragt , die erste Nacht war . Zu Ostern gab es noch ein Osterbrot , unglaublich lieb und aufmerksam.
Pedro’s place is the perfect location to see Lisbon. The apartment is super clean and comfortable. We had a great stay! Highly recommend to anyone coming to visit.

Great spot in the heart of Lisbon!
One of Pedro’s team members let us check in early and was at the unit to greet me and give instructions and recommendations. Very friendly and responsive team.
The area itself is quite busy with restaurants, tourist attractions, shops, and public transit all within walking distance. The street next to the unit is particularly busy because of a cable car which people would crowd around and film and take pictures with.
At night it could get a little noisy outside but with the fan on for white noise this wasn’t much of an issue. I might also recommend earplugs and a sleep mask for this unit. Additionally, the ceiling can be very low on one side of the apartment so if you’re tall I might reconsider.
Overall though, this was a great airbnb in Lisbon and I would highly recommend it.
We would stay there again for sure!
We had a lovely but brief visit to Lisbon, enjoyed the location and exploring the neighborhoods. Our hosts made the experience even more enjoyable.

I can’t recommend Pedro’s loft enough! This was my first time solo traveling and staying at an Airbnb, and it completely set the standard for future stays. The location was perfect, and the attention to detail was outstanding. Everything I could possibly need was provided, from a binder with instructions for the apartment’s appliances to a list of restaurant and attraction recommendations. Pedro really thought of everything to ensure his guests are comfortable. I never had to send a message because all the information I needed was already there, which made my stay so easy and stress-free. The thoughtful touch of a welcome bottle of wine was much appreciated (though I sadly forgot to take it with me 😅). I wholeheartedly encourage future guests to stay here – I couldn’t have asked for a better host.
Thank you, Pedro, for making my birthday weekend so much more relaxing!
Perfect location! The location was very easy to walk to every part of the city! The perfect place for 2 people for a long weekend in Lisbon

Appartamento è molto carino e accogliente, ideale per due-tre persone, tutto esattamente com’è scritto e si vede sulle foto.
Perfettamente pulito e c’è tutto ciò che serve.
Posizione super comoda, in centro, vicino alla metropolitana, alla stazione ferroviaria, al tram e alla famosa funicolare proprio dietro l'angolo. Il supermercato si trova proprio accanto all'ingresso.
Secondo il mio gusto era tutto perfetto! Grazie per l'ottima ospitalità, è stato top 10/10! 👍🏼🫶🏻❤️

The perfect location for a stay in Lisbon. Great space, very hospitable and responsive team looking after all or any needs. Highly recommended. Easy access to some of the best Lisbon has to offer regarding eating and entertainment. Only cautionary note would be the danger of being over 6foot tall. It is a loft conversion after all!

Perfect location for exploring central Lisbon. The apartment is nice, spacious and gets a ton of natural light.
At booking, The host warned us it can get a bit loud at night due the proximity of a bar- it was noticeable but not unbearable.
Would return!
great location. great hosts.
We were welcomed and talked through the apartments amenities. They left lots of travel info and restaurant recommendations. Our third visit and still excellent.
I had an amazing stay. Was welcomed with open arms and airbnb is located in great area. Walking distance of so many great places. 10/10 would recommend!
Great!

We enjoyed a lovely stay at Pedro’s lovely Airbnb. It was cosy, homely, comfortable, spacious, clean, all the facilities you need. It was also in an excellent central location with great transport links to the main attractions. There is also a mini supermarket next door which is very convenient for snacks and drinks.
We would definitely recommend staying here, it’s a great base for exploring Lisbon. We recommend eating at boa bao which is within walking distance & incredible Asian cuisine.
The hosts were absolutely lovely and accommodating, showing us all the amenities in the Airbnb and even gave us a bottle of wine! They have a guide on what to do in Lisbon and places to eat and drink which was very helpful.
We would definitely stay here again!
Katie & Bekah

Pedro and the team were incredibly responsive and super helpful for recommendations. They also allowed us a slightly early check-in which was SUPER helpful especially since I needed to wash up to go to a work meeting. He also helped us carry our luggage upstairs, super kind of him. Would definitely stay at this adorable place again. The low roof is part of the aesthetic, but just watch your head! :) Also loved being able to use the Nespresso machine (and the Nespresso store is close by too).

Pedro's place was cozy and beautiful.  It was immaculate and everything I could need was made available including complimentary fruit, teas and coffee.  There is every amenity available that one would find in their own home.  It has a lot of sunlight but can be blocked by black shades that are removable for adjustment (a feature I really liked).  It was so homelike I found it hard to leave everyday.  There is also a twin sized pallette available for a guest. It is in an area that has plenty of restaurants and shops within walking distance as well as several tourist sites.  If I ever return to Lisbon, I would not stay anywhere else.  For those who do not do stairs well, it is a 3rd floor walkup but it was absolutely no problem for me.  I highly recommend Pedro's place

Absolutely fantastic unit hosted by an excellent team.
Even before my arrival I knew I was going to be in great hands just by the excellent communication Pedro and his staff conveyed.
Upon my arrival, I was graciously met by João. Who meticulously explained everything the unit offered…appliances, switches, & even the windows (amazing views from them by the way)
The neighborhood had a lively charm that was quite safe and comforting as well as centrally located to everything. Uber is ridiculously inexpensive in Lisbon if you want to ride back from a day out.
Just a few stairs up and I was able to appreciate a well curated space that included a full closet, washer/dryer, proper Nespresso pods, extremely fast wi-fi , blackout drapes (if needed) just to name a few !
Rest assured anyone staying here will be in fantastic hands if Pedro & his team are hosting you.
They sincerely care & it shows.
This property well exceeds its description/listing

amazing location and even better host. I can not begin to listen all the great, above and beyond, things about Pedro and the unit. central to TONS of things to do. 5 minute walk from the metro.  I will stay there again.

O apartamento do Pedro é excelente! Ficamos hospedados durante 1 semana e amamos tudo! O prédio fica localizado ao lado da rua onde tem o ponto de paragem do funicular da Bica. Também há um pequeno supermercado ao lado, além de padarias. É próximo da estação de metrô Baixa-Chiado, aproximadamente uns 350m.
Não tivemos problemas com o barulho, mas pode ser porque ficamos o tempo todo com as janelas fechadas, pois era inverno.
O apartamento é excelente para um casal e conta com tudo que você precisa para uma estadia curta ou média. Há muitos utensílios na cozinha, e tem até máquina de lavar roupa com secadora.
Quem administra as hospedagens é uma equipe muito simpática e muito eficiente na comunicação! Quem nos recepcionou durante o checkin foi o Francisco que foi muito gentil e nos deu várias dicas interessantes! Ganhamos até uns mimos! Durante nossa estadia, conhecemos também o João, que foi muito simpático e nos ajudou muito! É um ótimo lugar com uma equipe de administração nota 10 !

One of the most beautiful apartments I have visited. Super clean, cozy and simply perfect. Rui is a spectacular host, so helpful and sweet, made us feel right at home. The location is perfect, right at the centre of one of the most happening streets. Strongly recommend the apartment, will visit again :)
Recommend, comfortable flat in a great location. No issues with noise during the week like the listing mentions. Bed could have been a bit more comfortable, but that was minor and would stay again.

Aangenaam verblijf en goede locatie dichtbij horeca en het treinstation Cais do Sodre.
Het appartement was leuk ingericht en zeker proper.
Er was zoals beschreven wel een beetje straatlawaai maar dat stoorde ons niet echt. Het was ook winter dus het viel mee, en er was eigenlijk vooral gebabbel en muziek in het weekend.
Leuk verblijf!

João hat uns sehr freundlich empfangen und alles gezeigt. Die Wohnung ist super gemütlich, stilvoll eingerichtet und bietet einige liebevolle Aufmerksamkeiten. Ich würde jederzeit wiederkommen. Wir waren zu dritt, zwei von uns haben geschlafen wie Babys, aber für unsere sehr geräuschempfindliche Freundin war es leider etwas zu laut. Trotzdem schön

I had a great two-day stay at Pedro's place! Like the other reviews mention, it's right in the heart and hustle of the Chiado area — there is so much to wander, shop, explore and see. The noise at night wasn't so bad and didn't bother me, but it definitely feels lively. Check in was great and included a tour and walkthrough of recommendations around the area and city. I'd absolutely recommend :)

Great location. Easy to get in and get around. It was nice to be greeted, though that wouldn't normally be my preference, but it was helpful to know all the different switches and operations of things in the apartment. I accidentally did not note the stay was for two guests which changed the price so do make sure you have your guest count correct. Really nice to have the washer, just make sure you have time for it to run. Street noise was present, as noted in reviews. Had no issues and the host was responsive. Great launching point to get anywhere in Lisbon.

The apartment is spacious and bright, overlooking the rooftops of Lisbon. It's tastefully decorated, very clean, and felt like a boutique hotel suite. It's located in the heart of Chiado, one of the city's most touristy areas, so expect noise until 2-3 a.m. If you're clumsy like me, be careful not to bump into the roof walls! Francisco took good care of us, and it's a perfect Airbnb for discovering the city in the greatest comfort.
Superbe emplacement! Très chouette comme appartement et les hôtes sont merveilleux.

Que bela experiência tivemos. Muito obrigado pela ajuda e boas energias.
O apartamento é muito confortável, achamos que está em excelente estado de conservação. Muito completo e com detalhes s de muito boa qualidade.
Pudemos trabalhar, cozinhar, tomar banho e dormir muito bem.
É normal sentir barulho, fica mesmo no centro. Mas isso não nos afetou. Que bonito ter o som do tranvía!
A única coisa que recomendo são toalhas de mesa individuais ou tecido pequenas para a mesa.
Muito obrigado.
Clean, modern place exactly as advertised. Awesome location.

The guys were all super friendly and helpful. They’ve put a lot of thought and care into the apartment so it can be everything guests need. They warned us the street noise can be loud. It was fine on a Wednesday night but loud enough on a Thursday to keep us up. Overall we enjoyed our stay.
Location is just right middle of everything . 15min walkable distance to most of the attractions. Plenty of nice restaurant surrounding . Love the vibe here

Awesome stay! The location was in perfect walking distance to everything we wanted to do. So many great bars and restaurants in the vicinity! The hosts were super responsive and even checked in during our stay to make sure everything was going well. Would definitely stay again.

Our amazing stay in Lisbon was made all the more memorable thanks to Pedro’s apartment. This place is an absolute gem right in the heart of Lisbon. It is so unique and well-kept; spotlessly clean and pristine. Pedro was a very friendly and helpful host and gave us some great information on check-in. But what set this place apart was the location. You step outside your door to find yourself in the thick of it in one of Europe’s nicest cities. Highly recommend.

The place was excellent in so many ways… it’s very central, the neighbourhood buzz, funky apartment and the host was helpful and responsive. The only minor issue was the proximity to a bar with noisy revellers. I guess, if you can’t beat them, join them!

Loved our stay. Perfect location, had everything we needed and team were super responsive. Loved all the suggestions, made us feel right at home!
There was street noise on our last night but it was a Friday night so was expected, our other nights totally fine.
Would 100% recommend!

I've visited Portugal before, but nothing compares to Pedro's place. From the moment we booked, Pedro was incredibly responsive and helpful, and he has an amazing team to support him. Upon arrival, we were greeted with a lovely handwritten note and a complimentary bottle of wine—a truly personal touch! The apartment itself was immaculately designed and spotless, with so many thoughtful details. Pedro also provided a comprehensive list of recommendations for dining and activities, which made our stay even more enjoyable.
The location is fantastic—close to everything you’d want to explore. The only small feedback I’d offer is to consider upgrading the washer and dryer, as they didn’t dry our clothes as well as we’d hoped. Also, the area can get a bit noisy at night due to its vibrant energy, but as city folks, it didn’t really bother us. Overall, we had an amazing stay and would absolutely return!
Top

Eu e meu marido amamos o espaço, lindo, organizado e muito bem cuidado! Localização perfeita. O som da rua não entra no apartamento, pois as janelas são blindadas, então não há incômodo algum! Fomos bem recebidos e sempre obtivemos respostas rápidas! Indicamos demais! ❤️

Pedro’s space was just as described and the photos were accurate. The apartment is spacious and cozy and centrally located to lots of restaurants, shopping and sightseeing. Pedro and João were great at communicating and super helpful throughout our stay. Would absolutely recommend!

We really enjoyed our stay in Lisbon in this airbnb. The apartment is as described; AC works great, the unit smelled clean, bathroom was very clean, especially for this part of the city. We used the washing machine and it worked well, although it took awhile to dry clothes if you had a bigger load. The fridge was cold. The location was excellent; this is a very busy street with a lot of restaurants, bars, shops nearby. Although there can be noise from the bars below, it did not disturb us with the windows closed. Generally, nightlife in this particular street tapers down around 1 am. There are a lot of stairs, hills if you are coming from the train station so you should be prepared for that. Although there is a tram, you may have to wait in line to use it, so we ended up walking everywhere. Uber is affordable so I would recommend that if you have lots of luggage. Thank you so much for the great stay and we hope to be back!

Pedro was a great host, very easy to communicate with. His place was clean, exactly as described and depicted in the pics.
