Neighborhood was great, conveniently located next to a grocer store and with close proximity to all the places we needed to go. We were warmly welcomed with a few goodies which made our stay even more pleasant.

We loved staying here! The location was so central to great restaurants and fun things to do — we were worried about the noise based on previous reviews but it was not a problem at all. The apartment was a peaceful refuge and had everything we could need - along with great design, just as in the photos. Hosts were super helpful!

Pedro's place is aesthetically beautiful and in a fabulous location! Joao met us upon our arrival to show us around the apartment and gave us amazing recommendations. This will always be my first choice on my return trips to Lisbon!!

Super séjour à Lisbonne! L’emplacement est très bien pour être au cœur de la ville. On entend un peu les clameurs de la rue Bica certains soirs (aléatoires) mais c’est viable.
Très bel appartement, on s’y sent vite chez soi, décoré avec goût.
Tout était extrême y propre et nos hôtes ont été en tout réactifs, ponctuels et arrangeants ! Merci ✨

Really lovely flat. Good location and has everything you need to feel at home. Walkable to many attractions. Fast communication by the hosts as well. Thanks for everything!
Do not stay here if you are easily affected by noise from party goers outside.

We had a great 3 night stay at Pedro’s place in Chiado! Central location - walking distance or a short metro/tram ride to all the major attractions, cafes and restaurants. The apartment was as described and perfect space for our stay. The team were so lovely and very responsive. They met us at the apartment to check us in and provide extra info about our stay and Lisbon. Would stay again!
Pedro was a great host, very helpful and kind. His home is very clean and beautiful. Me and my partner enjoyed our stay, we highly recommend it.
Pedro’s place was great ! Would definetly come back again ! Thank you

We had a great stay here. The location is absolutely amazing we walked to absolutely everything without issue nothing was more than about 20-25 minutes walk. The apartment is great for two people and the ceiling height would be tough for tall people but we had no problem. The views were wonderful and you are right at the top of an iconic street. It was noisy and we were there for a major festival but we knew that going in and the host was very up front about it. Was not a problem for us. Kitchen is well equipped and there is a market right next door. Would definitely recommend this to solo or couple travelers. The WiFi was strong up until the last night and the host was responsive when we let him know of the issue.
Great location to see what Lisbon has to offer
It was a great stay. The place is amazing both in terms of location and the style. Thank you!

Very central location, walkable to many attractions. Studio apartment with everything you needed. If there was one negative, it would be that the apartment, due to its close proximity to the nightlife of Lisbon, it can be loud on the streets below in to the early hours of the morning. Loved Lisbon, would definitely come back!

The apartment was conveniently located next to a tram station and a very energetic main street in Lisbon. With that being said, it can a bit loud but we didn’t mind as it reminded us of home. We love the noise. The apartment was beautiful inside with everything as was described in the listing. Francisco was really helpful and even let us have a late check out due to our later flight which gave us enough time to fit one more Bifana! Highly recommend!

Super bel appartement!
Très bien situé pour visiter Lisbonne ! Belle communication avec l’hôte.
Le seul bémol, c’est vraiment très bruyant le soir venu !

I stayed for a week. The accommodation is quite clean and well organized. You can communicate quickly with your host. The famous tram stop No. 28 is located in front of the accommodation and is located downtown, making it very convenient for traveling to nearby cities. I highly recommend this accommodation

Great experience with them. Very friendly and responsive and provided us with many recommendations. Location is unbeatable and walkable to everywhere except Belem, so truly can’t beat. It is a very busy street, so if noise bothers you at night may not be the best fit. The only thing that was missing was there was no paper towels, but this is a minor point for an overall great experience. Would highly recommend.
Great place

This is the perfect place to stay for a weekend trip in Lisbon. Great location and most importantly the loft is spacious, cosy and has all the things you need. The hosts are also very helpful and respond quickly. They are very flexible and always looking to help.
Was a great stay and such a great location. 🙏

A great place to stay! It was in a good location, the set up was great, he had plenty of dishware, etc, internet worked well, bathroom was clean. He also had cleaning staff come halfway through my stay since it was for a longer period of time. That was a really pleasant surprise!
I would stay there again for sure. The location was super too and it had a surprisingly cool view of the river!!!
The only thing that I could see someone disliking was the noise at night. During the weekend people partied quite late... But honestly it sort of gets drowned out like the noise of a typical city does. I had no issue sleeping with it, but there is definitely "city noise". I, however, wouldn't let that stop me from staying here again.

My husband literally booked this room as we were driving to the airport. The location was central to everything. The staff, for lack of a better term, answered immediately. They let us leave our bags prior to the “official” check in and we came back at 1 pm, got the keys and that was that.
The staff was amazing. Super nice and helpful. I definitely would stay here again.

We stayed there for two nights with our 4 year old daughter and could not be happier with the apartment and the host. It's centrally located with public transport on its doorstep (literally), supermarket downstairs and walking distance to the must see places and great restaurants. The apartments itself, apart from being beautifully designed, offers well functioning zones for cooking/eating, lounging and sleeping.The kitchen is fully equipped with everything you need and more. Everything's spotless clean! You will relax there for sure and staying there will be a memorable experience (all for good reasons).
As for the host, there isn't enough space to put all the compliments about him here. We were welcomed and mainly communicated with João and he couldn't be more helpful (we had a little crises that he offered quick assistance with), accommodating and just wonderful. We felt well looked after. We'll be back when in Lisbon.The best airbnb place I've ever rented. You must go there!!

El piso es muy organizado. Siempre fue buena y rápida la comunicación con los host, fueron amables y nos recibieron para el check in.
El piso es pequeño, tal vez para más de dos personas no seria tan cómodo.
La zona es muy ruidosa y con mucha gente incluso en las noches, pero las ventanas aíslan el ruido. Quizás para quienes busquen una zona mas tranquila, no es el barrio apropiado.
Such a great place to stay! It is in my favorite neighborhood and close to everything.
Una estancia maravillosa

Ha sido una estancia extraordinaria, que no olvidaremos. Tanto Rui como Antonio han sido anfitriones inmejorables. Desgraciadamente el tiempo no acompañó para visitar la ciudad, estuvo lloviendo todos los días a todas horas, pero por suerte nos sentimos muy confortables en el apartamento, nos sentimos como en casa. Salvo las escaleras, es un apartamento perfecto para niños porque llegan a zonas más bajas a las que no llegan los adultos y se lo toman como un juego.

This airbnb is definitely one of the best airbnbs I’ve ever stayed at! It was so beautiful in every aspect. There was an incredible view down to the water from the window, but even the apartment itself was so pretty and clean. There were also small things that enhanced our stay, like having access to a dryer for our clothes and even having a juice press to make freshly squeezed orange juice in the mornings. It was truly a perfect stay and we couldn’t be happier!
Absolutely loved staying here. Such a fantastic location!! So close to everything you would want. Extremely wonderful handover, super detailed! Thanks so much for the wonderful stay

Très joli loft, idéalement situé près du centre dans un quartier très vivant.
Accueil sympathique et très bonne réactivité.
Une petite supérette juste en bas très pratique.
Le loft comprend l'essentiel.
il est situé au pied du funiculaire et du tram.
Il y a du bruit le soir assez tard, jusqu'à plus d'une heure du matin en semaine et plus le week-end car à proximité de bars et de restaurants. Certains consommateurs sortent dans la rue et y crient. Toutefois, avec des bouchons d'oreille, nos nuits furent calmes et paisibles.
C'est un logement que je nous recommandons à condition d'avoir investi dans des boules Quies ou d'avoir un sommeil de plomb.
A noter que le loft est aussi équipé d'une climatisation que nous n'avons pas utilisé car il faisait encore frais, ce qui permet d'éviter d'ouvrir les fenêtres et de subir les nuisances extérieures.

We had a fantastic stay recently at this apartment. The hosts were very responsive, informative, helpful and flexible with our arrival and departure times. They kindly showed us around the apartment, answered our questions and gave us lots of useful advice. The apartment is beautiful, with all the amenities you need and lots of light. We really loved it. The kitchen has everything you need, the bed is comfortable and we found the apartment very peaceful. The area is central and near all sites. We would thoroughly recommend staying at this apartment. Thank you for an excellent stay in Lisbon.
thanks Pedro for the amazing stay!

Hôte super accueillant, disponible et réactif.
Très bonne communication.
Appartement douillet et très sympa.
Le quartier est effectivement bruyant jusqu a 1h 2h du matin,
Mais ça ne nous a pas du tout dérangé.
Pleins de petites attentions nous attendaient à notre arrivée.
Super rapport qualité, prix et excellente literie.
Nous reviendrons sans hésitation.
Great location in Lissabon 👍
beautiful apartment, very clean and in a really good location. very good communication through out even checking in to check we was OK.

The loft was amazing! João was a great host, and we had the most amazing first time trip to Lisbon. We were provided with a lot of recommendations for food/drinks/things to see and the apartment was walking distance to all the great spots and a supermarket next to the loft. Easy transport from the metro, buses, trains + ferry. The loft was a great space, everything we needed and more, highly recommend to anyone visiting Lisbon. Thank you for having us!

Definitely a place you want to stay when visiting Lisbon! Chiado Loft is in a great location, putting you steps from coffee shops, restaurants, bars and sights. It accommodates 2 people comfortably and is perfect for anyone working abroad - the strong wi-fi signal allows for a hassle free work day. As a solo traveller for part of my stay, I felt safe coming and going at all hours without hesitation. The loft is also situated right next to a small market, which allows you to easily grab anything you might need from fruit to bread to wine! Pedro and team were proactive when reaching out about check-in and flexible to accommodate my arrival. They were also quick to respond when I had questions. I would recommend staying here (or any other property managed by Pedro) on your next trip!

L'appartamento era perfetto. Ottima la posizione molto centrale. La metro a 2 passi. Ottima la pulizia e Pedro con i suoi collaboratori è stato veramente disponibile, sopratutto nel check-in. Magari servirebbe qualche utensile in più in cucina, ma sono piccoli dettagli.
Consiglio vivamente. Ottimo Host.
Fijne plek in de stad. een verblijf waar alles was wat je nodig had!

This stay made our trip in Lisbon a huge success. It was exactly as described, very homey, and they had a wonderful list of recommendations for things to do and places to eat. We tried many of them and not a single one steered us wrong. Thank you for hosting us! We’d recommend this place to anyone.

This place was a great spot! The inside is super cozy and very well put-together. The bed was comfortable, shower had good pressure and warm water. Some other reviews mention street noise, and while you can hear people on the street, I didn't find it a big deal at all. Really cool spot!

Francisco and António were spotless in every respect: communication was always perfect and with very clear instructions on how to get to the house, valuable recommendations on places to visit, restaurants, bars, etc.
The attic is ideal for two people and located right in the heart of town, with plenty of places within walking distance or a variety of public transportation just under the building or a short distance away, not to mention a market and great cafes right on the doorstep.
Muito obrigado pela hospitalidade, which certainly helped to make us feel at home!

Ótima estadia. O apartamento estava bem localizado apesar de algum barulho à noite. Estava bem limpo e a cozinha estava bem equipada. Os anfitriões foram flexíveis com o horário de check in e check out o que foi super útil!

Looks exactly like the pictures, very clear instructions and recommendations for nearby places. You can catch tram 28 right outside the door. If you’re going to bed before midnight you probably won’t be able to sleep with the sounds of people outside. Very good location and easy to get everywhere. Would stay again

Great place in a very centrical spot. The place is very nicely decorated and elevated our stay in Lisbon. I would only suggest improving the lighting in the bathroom, a very easy fix that can elevate the bathroom to the high level of the other areas of the apartment. Great stay overall and a very responsive host.

The best apartments I've ever rented!  The host was very attentive, kind, pleasant, answered all my questions.  The apartment is equipped with all the necessary equipment, and even more.  Big and very comfortable bed.  I closed the windows and there was no noise that I was warned about.  The only thing -  house has no elevator.  But the host who met me kindly took my suitcase to the apartment.  In the apartment, a bottle of wine and oranges were waiting for me, very caring! Beautiful view, wonderful apartments.  I am grateful to the whole team for their care, you are incredible!

Apartment was very thoughtfully furnished, clean, and had all that we needed. The hosts were very kind to provide a whole list of recommendations and also left us chocolates, oranges and a bottle of wine!
One thing to note though if you are a light sleeper is that there is quite a bit of noise from the street (bar right below the apartment), so you will definitely need to bring along ear plugs and an eye mask!
Extremely well located which comes with some noise at night and early morning due to lively area.   Bed was very comfy and nice concept.  Washer/Dryer was a big plus. Highly recommend!
This place is in an amazing location in the city!
Great location. Walking distance from all points of interest. It can get loud at night due to all the restaurants and bars located around the building, but it's manageable.

Loved our stay at Pedro's! The best thing is definitely the location - we were very central and were able to walk to most of the places we wanted to check out. It does get a bit noisy on the weekends but we didn't mind with the windows shut. The place is so nicely updated with all the amenities, the hosts were gracious and communicative, and we had no issues working remotely on the fast wifi. Would book again, it was a great stay for great value!
All good - excellent place to stay 👍
This is a great beautiful and quirky (in a good way) appartement right in the middle of Lisbon, near so many nice neighbourhoods to discover. Pedro is a great host, had a great time here
Great location, super clean and roomy, very nice hosts!
Pedro was always very responsive. Location was great and spot had a lot of charm!

Francisco and the other hosts were very responsive and made checking in a breeze. The apartment had an unexpected amount of equipment, and AC was very nice to have at night. The space wasnt as loud as we expected given it’s prime location.

We had a wonderful stay. The apartment was beautiful, in the most central location, and very well appointed. We had no issues with noise and the bed and linens were beyond comfortable. All communication was kind and efficient. We would absolutely be back. Thank you!
Lovely loft in a really great central location. Very helpful host.

This is an extremely lovely apartment in Chiado. Very clean place. Beautiful decor and furniture. The bed was super comfortable.
We loved the recommendation lists provided by our host. Apartment is in a central location close to tram stop and close to shops and restaurants.
We had an amazing stay. Thank you

Fantastic, walkable location. Clean, comfortable, inviting. Incredible and responsive hosts. It definitely got loud outside every once in a while late at night, but that's totally to be expected given the central location and the host was very clear about it. We would stay again!!

Beautiful loft condo on the top floor in and ideal location in Barrio Alto. Close to restaurants, bars and public transit.
Beware for light sleepers, it is very loud at night because it’s right next to the famous tram street. People were partying and yelling all night until sunrise

We LOVED our stay in Lisbon, not only because we fell for the city but also this accommodation. Not only was it super central, clean and beautifully designed, but equally felt homely . The hosts were brilliant with their communication, I enjoyed the fact someone met you and walked you round the apartment explaining how things worked. I wouldn’t hesitate to book this place again or recommend it. Thank you to the team for hosting us. 5/5

Abbiamo trascorso 5 gg piacevolissimi.
La casa per noi è stata perfetta: bella, funzionale, luminosa, super accessoriata, moderna e pulita. L’accoglienza è stata perfetta, Pedro e il suo staff sono stati veramente molto gentili ed ospitali; inoltre si sono dimostrati super efficienti nel risolvere qualsiasi problema o richiesta che necessitava il loro intervento.
Questo appartamento è in una zona di movida un po’ rumorosa ma che, a noi, non ha dato assolutamente fastidio considerato che abbiamo 2 bambine/ragazze (il rumore, in realtà, si sente appena); la posizione è fantastica (praticamente adiacente all' "Ascensor da Bica", supermercato sotto casa e il famoso tram 28 si trova veramente a due passi) ed è vicino a molte delle attrazioni che si possono raggiungere anche a piedi.
Infine, per gli italiani, trovare macchina e capsule Nespresso è una bella sorpresa.
Ottimo tutto! E’ stato veramente bello sentirsi a casa in una città come Lisbona
Pedro and his associates made the process super easy. Super nice guys. I’ll definitely come back.
Great place I’m a good location - especially for going out and good food. Highly recommend.

Pedro’s place was the best Airbnb we have stayed in EVER! It is a 2 min walk to the shops, bars, trams, and everything else you may need. They went above and beyond by providing so many good tourist recommendations for our stay. He was always responsive and the layout of the Airbnb made us feel like home!
Great hosts and a very central location. We had a great stay!
Great location. There was a heatwave in Lisbon when we visited but the AC in the room cranks! Very comfortable.

The place was excellent and exactly what we need. Central location close to everything: restaurants, cafes, bars, metro, groceries.
Extremely clean and comfortable. place is even better in person than photos. very bright. I'd say comfy for 2 people sleeping in the same bed but not more really except a little one.
host is excellent, friendly and responsive (including in English).
As someone 6" tall, I did have to watch my head as I walked around but it wasn't too bad.
Pedro’s place was amazing! Right in the heart of Lisboa! I would stay there any time

Awesome location! We were only able to stay one night however this place is perfect. It did get a little loud until 2-3am but it didn’t bother me that much. We went to bed at midnight due to our flight and you can hear the noise outside but it wasn’t bad for me or my husband. If you are a very light sleeper maybe bring ear plugs just as a back-up. I would definitely stay here again. Awesome shower, so much natural light, very comfortable bed and amazing air conditioning right next to the bed!!!!

Could not fault this place one bit. The apartment was absolutely faultless. It was extremely clean, huge shower, air con, cool decor- absolutely spot on! And to top it off it was in a perfect location in the heart of Lisbon. Couldn’t recommend this place or the hosts more!!

We really enjoyed our stay at Pedro’s place! The location is perfect for exploring and going out, and the Studio is super cute.
António checked us in and gave us a helpful walkthrough of the space, which we appreciated! We also had the option to drop our bags off early and were able to easily coordinate with him about change in travel times.
Highly recommend this stay!

Location was perfect for our first visit to Lisbon— very walkable to restaurants/bars, markets, the train station and ferry to cross the river. Felt right in the middle of the hustle and bustle but not so loud as a few streets over, and double paned windows that really shut out any late night noise. Was very comfortable and would highly recommend! The hosts are very responsive and made check-in and out flexible and easy to navigate.

We loved staying at this apartment and found the communication incredibly easy. check in was super informative and the apartment had everything we needed. sure, it can get a little noisy at night but it is to be expected, the blackouts are a great touch. Location is great and walkable to all that Lisbon has to offer, we can't wait to come back!
Amazing flat and location, really cool inside. Loads of things on the doorstep, can be noisy area at night but fine when windows closed and aircon on. All together fantastic.
Es war wunderschön!

This was possibly the best Airbnb experience I have ever had! The unit was wonderful, all linens and towels were hotel quality.
They met us at check-in to go over the instructions for all appliances and hand us the keys. All communication was clear and they were very responsive to any messages!
LOVE this apartment!
지금껏 다닌 해외여행 숙소 중 당연 최고였습니다!

ケーブルカーに程近い観光にとても便利な立地でした。
タパスやバーが多くありとても楽しめると思います

We had a great stay at this loft. It was clean, nicely decorated, had all the amenities we needed and is in a great location!  Since we arrived in the morning,  Pedro accommodated us to let us drop off our luggage and allowed us to check in early which was greatly appreciated.
Modern bright lovely apartment in great location.  Enjoyed the business of a lively city. Close to trams and grocery store. Walkable to nice parts of city. Host was great

Great location in the middle of the action, but it wasn't noisy at all. I stayed with the same hosts earlier in my trip to Lisbon, and I was met with the same amazing hospitality.  They will walk you through the entire space, provide local recommendations on where to eat/what to see/things to do. Very clean space (looks just like the photos), and the hosts provided orange juice for me to squeeze in the morning and a Pastel de Nata. They also left a sweet note and chocolates. I love personal touches like this! The bed was like a warm hug- I couldn't get out of it! I also really liked how bright and airy the loft was. Highly recommend.
Great apartment! Great location! Great host! everything was perfect!

Pedro’s place was perfect! Walking distance to so many areas, easy to find, and very comfortable. He has a very well organized list of activities and restaurants if you’re needing recommendations.
We had some difficulties with the washing machine and he was extremely helpful and responsive.
We would gladly stay here again and highly recommend!!
Great location - second time staying with Pedro, has been great each time

Amazing Airbnb with everything we needed, we really enjoyed our three night stay there.  The Airbnb was so clean and lovely with so much character. Everything was within walking distance. Check-in was so smooth and staff were so helpful & friendly providing detailed instructions & recommendations. We felt so welcomed and loved our stay! Thank you so much for having us.

Great place, great location,
Awesome for romantic vacation
100%. Recomendable para repetí sin duda

Great place! Exactly as described. Very clean, comfy bed, nice shower, and all the items one would need to cook or do laundry. It is built into the roof line so there are low ceilings, which was fine for us but could be a struggle for tall folks. It is right above a few bars, so as others have warned it was loud at night. The hosts even warned us ahead of time so we could change locations if we wanted, but we stuck with it. If you’re planning to be at the bars or wear ear plugs/can do a sound machine, you will be fine. It’s in the middle of everything which was super convenient. Everything else was one of the best AirBnBs we’ve ever been in (re cleanliness, kitchen stock, etc)

The check in process was very easy and everything was explained Thoroughly. The apartment was extremely clean and delightful. Bath and kitchen were well equipped and modern. Very large shower was great. The stairs may be an issue for some but we were fine. Would highly recommend and stay again.
Beautiful and comfortable place in the heart of the city and close to upcoming places. Truly enjoyed the second time I stayed in Pedro’s apartment.

We really enjoyed our stay at Pedro’s place. It was exactly the way I had pictured it from the photos and very clean.
There’s lots going on in the neighborhood and at night it can get loud outside, but the windows are doing their job of keeping a lot of the noise out. To me it felt like a nice refuge from all the hustle and bustle of the city. You’re in the middle of it but if you’re not super sensitive to the noise you can still get a good night’s rest.
Pedro and the other guys managing the place were really responsive and flexible with our check-in and check-out times and helped us when we needed it.

This was a perfect location, close to everything you could need. If you're a light sleeper it can be a bit noisy outside since it's central to so much of the nightlife Lisbon has to offer but that didn't bother us. Will definitely stay here again.
Recomendo, o apartamento é muito bonito, bem localizado, confortável e limpo. O anfitrião nós recebeu muito bem e entregou uma cartilha com recomendações de restaurantes e atividades.
It’s a beautiful place and meet all my expectations!
todo perfecto
Beautiful apartment in a great location! Even better than the pictures… 100% worth the stay!
We had a great time at Pedro’s place. Easy instructions, and walkable to a lot of things. Highly recommend this stay!

Great place! Beautiful apartment! Felt like home!
Very responsive host, offered a lot of suggestions!

Great apt great location great host. We had a problem with the internet and the host act so fast. In less than half an hour the internet was back on plus he provide with a hotspot for a case something will happen again. That was very very nice. I highly appreciate the help and the stay was great.
Excellent stay, clean and comfortable loft in a great location. Lovely bathroom too!

My wife and I really enjoyed our stay here!  Pedro was a great host and gave us plenty of recommendations for what we could do in Lisbon.  The location is perfect because there’s so much to do within walking distance.  We would absolutely stay here again the next time we are in Lisbon, highly recommend.

We have been traveling for three weeks in multiple airbnbs and this was our best one. Clean, trendy, great location, and super nice host. He even had a bottle of wine in the fridge waiting for us. 10/10!!!

Beautifully decorated space. View of the old tram and the water from one of the windows. Amazing natural light.  Extremely attentive and easy to contact hosts. There waiting for us to check in after holding our bags earlier. Lots of great suggestions and personal touches.
Lovely stay. Pedro was in close contact for anything we needed and was kind enough to accommodate an early check in request.

Beautifully decorated loft with all the amenities in the centre. We really appreciated the oranges and jams and the wine that the host left for us. Just one thing to note is that it's on the third floor with no lift and narrow stairs so if you have a lot of luggage,it might be a little difficult. Also, the height is quite low at some points as shown in the photos so you might end up bumping your head like we did a few times. Rest everything was great.

What an amazing apartment, we had a fantastic weekend and could not fault it.
Firstly the apartment itself is incredibly well styled and very cosy, it has everything you need and even a few lovely extras like a coffee machine, electric juicer and a blue-tooth speaker.
Secondly the location was perfect, you have great views of the river and you're slap bang in the middle of the old town.
Lastly the hosts were very quick with all communication and very flexible where possible.
We cannot recommend this highly enough, 10/10

Had a great stay! Very clean and great communication with the host. The check in process was very easy. The only thing I would point out is that the ceilings are definitely a little low and as I taller person I was constantly having to bend down, but I was expecting that from previous reviews. Otherwise a wonderful experience in a great part of town.
Really great spot. Awesome location. Beautifully decorated. Had a lot of thoughtful amenities.
Maravilhoso!
Great location and apartment.  Updated and stylish apartment.  Communication was outstanding and location could not be better.  Highly recommend!

Could not have asked for a more perfect stay.
The host met us upon check in and went through everything in the bnb.
Beautifully decorated, clean, and the host left wine & jam AND oranges with a juice machine for fresh OJ in the morning. Literally so wonderful.
The location is within walking distance from everything and above the bustling streets, but quiet and private.
I’m in love with this apartment. We will absolutely be back. ❤️

We loved this place! Location was fantastic and the place was quite charming. We are 5’6 and didn’t have any issues with the slanted ceiling but could see how someone tall might. The oranges, wine, and hand written note upon arrival were so sweet and thoughtful. Would absolutely stay here again and recommend highly.

We will definitely stay at this flat again. We loved every second of our time there, and lamented having to move to a hotel for our last night in Lisbon. It's extremely comfortable, well-equipped, with a great location. It was the cleanest Airbnb we've ever stayed in, and probably the most beautifully decorated as well.
Check-in was fantastic and we really appreciated this given our flight put us in Lisbon after 9pm on a Thursday; communication was great altogether. If you're a light sleeper, the noise on the street might keep you up – just bring earplugs or play some white noise over the bluetooth speaker in the flat and you'll be fine.
Super close to tons of nightlife and restaurants. Great views just a few blocks away. Mini mercado right next door. Really can't recommend staying here enough. You won't regret it!

Had an amazing stay at Pedro’s! Lovely apartment in the heart of Bairro Alto, with walking distance to the city center and Alfama. Loved every part of it. Super nice and clean, and just as described. Would definitely come back! Thank you guys!
Charming flat not far from city center in Lisbon. Walking distance to a ton of bars and restaurants. Pedro and team were communicative and helpful. Would stay again!
Cannot fault the hosts, incredible stay in Lisbon
Pedro and Hamid colleagues where super helpful and friendly! The apartment itself is also very spacious and comfortable while being located in the hip barrio alto, 5 stars!

We had a fantastic stay - the apartment is in an amazing location to explore Lisbon, and is clean, light and comfortable. The hosts were brilliant + communication was speedy + easy. Would definitely recommend + hope to stay again on our next visit! Thank you for a great stay!
Love this place. Elegantly decorated and very helpful hosts.  Great recommendation ans right on the Center where you want to be. Walking distance to waterfront. To restaurants and more.

Space was amazing, they even give you a little bottle of wine and some oranges upon arrival. Being able to make freshly squeezed orange juice with the juicer at the apartment was such a nice addition to our morning! I accidentally left my AirPods at the apartment upon check out and the host arranged for me to pick them up at a later date and was extremely responsive in helping me do so. Highly recommend!

This apartment is perfect for your visit to Lisbon.
Great location for all the sights , the check in tram are amazing , the apartment has all the perfect touches including fresh oranges and wine when we arrived ! AC is a huge bonus and made the suite really cool . they left great tips for local restaurants - we tried two and they were fabulous

Great location  and great host. The apartment is strategically located close to sights restaurants and even the iconic tram with Tagus river in the background.  The place is big enough for a couple, very clean and beautifully furnished. The host responds quickly to our needs. He had fruits chocolate even a small bottle of wine as a welcome gift. The slanted ceiling was the only drawback(especially for a tall couple like us), otherwise  I strongly recommend.

Location of this place is amazing! Right in the heart of downtown Lisbon with everything you need right outside the apartment - market, restaurants, bakeries, etc. The apartment is newly renovated with a washer and dryer (very rare), air conditioning, dishwasher. A very nice welcome gift of a bottle of wine and fresh oranges and an electric juicer. Highly recommend this place!
We really enjoyed our stay! Our hosts were extremely professional and accommodating. Communication was great, and everything was clean and exactly as advertised.
Great spot in Lisbon. Right near everything you could want to visit!
Great location and beautiful cozy space. Some low ceilings so just watch your head if you're tall. Overall, perfect place to stay and explore Lisbon!

The Chiado Loft is absolutely sensational! Set in the heart of Chiado, the loft is centrally located, making it the ideal stopover for easy access to top restaurants, as well as all the beautiful places Lisbon has to offer.
The loft is a very stylish and comfortable space, offering all the amenities one would need for a smooth, stress-free trip (dishwasher, washing machine, coffee machine, etc.). We were pleasantly surprised by all the lovely personal touches - from local wine & chocolates waiting for us, to the in-depth local recommendations, nothing was left out.
Whilst we were originally concerned about the noise level at night, we were pleasantly surprised at how quiet it was thanks to the double pane street facing windows (this is a very nice touch) as well as the black out detachable blinds.
Finally, the team are friendly and responsive, and went above and beyond to make sure we had an incredible trip, making our stay a breeze. All in all, we couldn't recommend the Chiado Loft more if we tried. Thank you for having us! We'll be back!
Francisco was personable, responsive, and extremely helpful. The sunny loft was impeccably clean and cozy. It was a 5 minute walk from the metro. Thank you so much! We highly recommend staying here.

Best location in the heart of the action. We had a fantastic stay in Chiado, lots of amazing restaurants nearby and the apartment was very clean and comfortable. The hosts were excellent, very quick to respond and happy to help out. Highly recommend.
For my second visit to Lisbon, I could not have chosen a better location- close to shopping, partying, transit and history. Very clean and stylish with a view of the water.

Lovely apartment and the location couldn't be more perfect. As it says, it is a loft, so there is a bit of navigating the eaves to be done, but the apartment is beautifully styled, and totally worth it. Situated right at the top of the tram line, less than 15 minutes walk to the Time Out market and right in the heart of the Barrio Alto district with great bars and restaurants. Recommend!
This place was great!! Super fun location and beautiful apartment
Great place & great hosts — would definitely recommend.

Very happy with our stay! Location was perfect. And washer/dryer was very useful. Overall great spot and great stay. Highly recommend!
The roof slant is pretty dramatic if you’re tall, but nothing I didn’t expect. Didn’t have any issue with outside noise, though our stay was through the week, not weekend. Also, I like to sleep with it pretty cold and found the AC did a great job (being positioned right over the bed helped).

Our stay is Lisbon was a fantastic one, in part due to choosing to stay at Pedro’s place. First off, the greeting he gives you makes you feel right at home. The flat is amazingly laid out and has everything you will need. The location is fantastic for people our age 35, with bars, restaurants, groceries stores, etc, within seconds. The only thing I will say, if you are an older couple or one with a kid, it may be a little loud on the weekends as it is right on a busy bar street, but didn’t bother us at all. Overall an amazing stay and will definitely be back next time we are in Lisbon.
Great place - tiny but really central and has everything you need!
Excellent apartment if you want to be right in the mixer!

El departamento es lindo y amplio. La ducha increíble ! El host es muy amable , tuve naranjas ☺️ como cortesía y eso lo aprecié mucho. Más un vino y chocolates. Lindo detalle !!
Esta muy bien ubicado , cerca de todo !! A unos pasos del ascensor que lleva hasta el mercado y donde se puede tomar transporte para Belem y otros atractivos. Buenos restaurantes al rededor. Excelente y 100% recomendado. Por cierto , pese a estar en una zona de mucho ruido no se siente esa bulla dentro, muy bien insonorizado.

Séjour génial! L'emplacement hyper centre est super. La vue mer, sur le cristo Rei et sur le tram est dépaysant dès que l'on arrive. La rue est très bruyante mais on a adoré car immergés dans la vie de la ville et une fois les fenêtres fermées c'est très calme. Nous retiendrons aussi la disponibilité de nos hôtes, la communication et leur gentillesse avec des délicates attentions comme du vin, des oranges et des petits chocolats avec un gentil mot personnalisé à notre arrivée. Foncez les yeux fermés!!

The flat was clean, well equipped and in a great area! The hosts replied quickly and were extremely helpful at all times! All in all, a wonderful home in Lisbon- would 100% use the same hosts next time!

We loved our stay! The space is beautifully decorated and really well located. The team was flexible checking us in when we were delayed at the airport and very helpful with recommendations in the area. We also loved using the juicer and oranges for fresh squeezed juice every morning!

Great location! Only two flights of narrow stairs up to the apartment. The owners were super responsive and even left us a bowl of yummy oranges and a bottle of wine. Highly recommend. Just be aware though if you are over 6ft tall, might be dangerous.
Very beautiful place and the hosts are very attentive, accommodating, and have great recommendations for what to do in the area!

Very cute place, convenient location, we have very comfortable stay.
If you need elevator, this is not for you. But in Europe, you do expect a lot of stairs everyone anyway.
great place - just a little heads up: parts of the ceiling are a bit low for tall people 😉

Absolutely Perfect!
Wonderful, clean and well-appointed. Great location! Superb hosts.
Noise was not an issue.
Highly recommended!

Really lovely apartment! Due to a minor issue, we were offered to move to a close apartment, which was just as beautiful with a view! Both Rui & Antonio were very accommodating and friendly. We would definitely stay here again! Thank you for a great stay.

This apartment was more than we ever expected. When we arrived, we were greeted at the front door. Brought upstairs and shown around the apartment. Our flight had landed a tad earlier and we were able to check in when we arrived which was great.
We have stayed in many AirBNB’s around the world and by far this was the cleanest, chicest, best decorated apartment I have seen. There was not even a spec of dust to be found anywhere! The bed….words cannot describe how comfortable and how soft and luxurious the bedding is.
Area is extremely central. Literally walking distance to everything around. We took the metro from the airport which was 2€ and super simple to get to the apartment.
Definitely highly recommend you stay here for your trip to Lisbon. You’d never regret it.

We LOVED staying this apartment. The location was perfect, the apartment was very clean and beautifully decorated, the natural sunlight was great, and Pedro was so friendly and welcoming. Definitely recommend!

We had a great time here! The location is perfect and there's many restaurants and much to see nearby. There was some noise coming from outside during the night but that is to be expected when staying in this lively area. The apartment itself was clean, well-equipped and very beautiful. Highly recommended, thank you!

Superb pied a terre at ground zero for fun.  Our host, took the trouble to meet us and walk us through every aspect of this beautiful and considered space. Exposed brick work establishes the age of this exquisite loft but it’s the contemporary design detail that marks it out. Not for the tallest AIRBNBer the slanting roof means that our hosts have made intelligent use of this space and it is very well appointed. Fantastic attention to detail and a wonderful space for two nights. I would very much recommend and come again.
The host was amazing and the place was really cute. I would definitely stay here again.
Amazing place! Pedro and Co are super friendly and we really loved all the personal touches! Great comfortable bed too! In a wonderful location. Thanks guys
Très accessible, il était présent dès notre arrivé. Répond aux messages très rapidement.

Really enjoyed our stay - great check in process, ideal location plus numerous local recommendations.
Would highly recommend!

This is the perfect, compact apartment for a weekend in Lisbon. The space is completely as advertised and the hosts were so helpful. Most of all, we loved the location - practically every restaurant we wanted to try was a 5-10 min walk away. It was noisy on Friday and Saturday night (which you’d expect from any place in the centre of a busy city) but we used earplugs and slept really well (the bed is amazingly comfortable).
If you stay here, I’d thoroughly recommend
1. Nossa Casa - incredible food and atmosphere, family run, 3 mins from the apartment. Book at least a week in advance!
2. Hi Lisbon walking tour for a super informative intro to Lisbon’s amazing history (we did the Alfama tour with Sara and it was great)
3. See a “Fado”, a night of traditional folk music from Lisbon and Portuguese food. Tonnes of options near the apartment.
Perfect location! The loft was also really clean & beautiful!
Such a lovely and comfortable apartment in a perfect location. The hosts were so helpful and gave great local tips. We would definitely go back and stay again.
The most amazing stay! Will definitely be back to this incredible air bnb.
This was a perfect loft space in the heart of Lisbon. It’s a comfortable and cozy space, and the host is very responsive in case of any issues. Would stay again!
Alles war wirklich sehr gut !(: sehr zu empfehlen

This is a stunning apartment and it looks exactly as shown on the listing. You could not ask for a better location - no 28 tram stop is literally across the road. There are cafes, restaurants and shops all within a 2 min walk. We had such a friendly check in which we really appreciated since we arrived quite late. The apartment has everything you would need and more (dishwasher, washing machine, juicer) and the wifi worked perfectly (this was key for us as we were working one of the days we were there). We packed earplugs to ensure a good nights sleep as we were aware you could hear some bar noise from places nearby and would recommend this for a Friday and Saturday night stay (Sunday was super quiet). Otherwise we slept really well in the huge comfy bed. We really loved our stay and would stay here again when we visit Lisbon.

Pedro et son équipe sont incroyables !! De gentillesse ! De professionnalisme !!
Tout ces cadeaux 🎁, toutes ces petites attentions sont dignes sincèrement d un 5 étoiles
Malheureusement, ils n y peuvent rien, le bruit la nuit est insupportable, prendre cet appartement avec des boules Quies ou ne pas être sensible au bruit …
Sinon , à part ça , l appartement est à croquer avec un service exceptionnel !!!
Merci ! Je reviendrais dans l un de vos appartements !

Awesome location with a view to Christi statue of you look to your left out of the window. Fully equipped kitchen. We also appreciated the personal check-in and proactive messages of the host. I would definitely recommend and stay again.
The street can be a bit noisy due to people hanging out downstairs and the many windows. Bring some earplugs. We also felt a bit cold in January. Yes, there is a heater but we did not feel it with many windows and high ceilings.

Apartment was wonderful! So cozy and comfortable and an amazing view of the river. Great location, only a couple blocks from the metro and one block from tram 28 stop. Some general noise at night but that's to be expected in any city and we had no issues falling asleep. Numerous bakeries and restaurants all within walking distance along with plenty of clothing stores too. Pharmacy located 3 blocks away had walk-in covid testing for our return trip which was very convenient. Could not recommend this place more, absolutely loved our stay!
lovely place to stay !
This place is fantastic! I will recommend anyone to stay there. Location cannot be any better. The description and pictures are very accurate and the host was polite and very helpful.
It‘s a great apartment with a lot of details. I really enjoyed the stay and would definitely book it again.
Fantastic hosts, perfect location, charming loft, thoughtful furnishing.

Localização óptima, loft com tudo o que se necessita.
Excelentes restaurantes a volta…
Equipa super simpática, profissional.
Obrigado
A fantastic apartment! Would really recommend to book your stay here when you’re in Lisbon.

Pedro’s apartment is lovely. It’s in a perfect location, it’s super clean, beautifully decorated, and the bed is very comfortable! Pedro and his team are also extremely responsive—check in was very smooth and they were available to answer my questions super quickly. He also leaves a helpful guide for Lisbon in the apartment! The next time I come to Lisbon, I’ll definitely try to book his place again. I highly recommend it!

The apartment is very comfortable, extremely clean and makes you feel at home; they also let us find a bottle of wine which, given the times we were there, we couldn't drink but it was a very kind thought (in addition to oranges, coffee, etc). The area is really central even if in the evening/night frequented by dubious people but as in many other areas of the city. Super recommended

AMAZING PLACE! Best location to start our first time in Portugal and Lisbon. Vibrant street where everything is close by - supermarket, pasteis de nata, and the iconic tram! Photos are accurate.
The place is super well equipped and we had a good orientation around at check-in. There are also instructions and curated restaurant lists which were very useful during our stay.
Personally I love the kitchen so much cos it’s so well thought out - including Nespresso machine and pods! We were able to unwind, cook our own meals and do laundry over the 4 days’ stay.
Taller people, be careful walking under the sloped roof 😅 It’s part of the loft charm but I had a fair share of knocks lol
Incredible apartment, and i’d recommend to all my friends who visit Lisbon!

Great spot for a few days stay in Lisbon to enjoy the vibe of the city like the cool bars and restaurants. The apartment is beautiful and fully equipped for a perfect stay. Rui welcomed us in a super friendly way and we really enjoyed staying there.
Great place, very good location & super easy communication, highly recommended!

Staying in the heart of the city is not my style, but I'm happy I did. Loved the location. It was easy to move around whether on foot or to catch a regional train to leave the city. I used the kitchen quite often and appreciated the bonus oven. I am already planning a return so I hope to stay here again.
Very nice apartment!
Die Lage der Wohnung ist perfekt, die Wohnung war sehr sauber und beim Check-In wurden wir herzlich begrüßt.
Pedro/Rui was an excellent host and very flexible. The location of the apartment was incredible and if you want a city break in Lisbon I would highly recommend this place!

The apartment is chic, beautifully appointed, with lots of thoughtful little touches in a fantastic location, with hosts who are super-helpful and communicative. I have no reservations about whole-heartedly recommending this fabulous apartment.
Great place!

We loved our top floor flat. It was in a great location that was easy to get around and get to many different dining options. It is on the edge of the night lift part of town and there was so nose at night but with the windows closed we didn't notice it very much. Pedro and his team were responsive and very easy to work with. The ceiling you do have to watch yourself or you can bonk your head but it didn't take away from the charm of the flat and the great location. I highly recommend this flat and would absolutely stay here again.

Great location in the midst of everything. Host gave us great suggestions for restaurants, which were conveniently located within a few minutes of the apartment. Space was clean and stylishly furnished. Would stay here again.
Great apartment, great location. Couldn’t recommend it enough

Amazing, big standard of hospitality. Present to welcome and was waiting for us, they have a list of every great recommendations that you could need and even not imagine. The place is 5*, location as well and they were the most arranging. They even booked a restaurant for us. Amazing

Amazing loft apartment that was very well designed. The bed was super comfy and the stay felt more like a really great hotel (but with much larger rooms).
Communication worked very well and we were also treated to some chocolate and wine when we checked in. Even if its located by a noisy street it was so well sound proof that we couldn't hear anything while the windows were closed.
We would love to come back and stay here again next time we are in Lisbon.
An amazing apartment, fantastic location in the middle of everything and friendly and fast communication that leaves no question unanswered. We would love to come back.
Pedro’s place is clean, good located and cozy. Communication was great and informative. Thank you very much! Highly recommended!
Fantastic location, nicely laid up apartment. Bigger ironing board would’ve have been nice but really a small thing. Had a great stay

Pedro’s place is unique and well designed. Comfy bed. Great location. Check-in was easy and informative. The angled walls may challenge tall people to duck regularly. We had  a great time and would stay here again!  Thanks
Cool apartment in amazing location! Super helpful hosts too, would definitely stay here again
Everything was perfect. The apartment is sparkling clean and beautiful. It’s perfectly located in the center of Lisbon :)
Great place! Very comfortable. The location is super central. Really appreciated the coffee and thoughtful touches throughout. The ceiling is a bit low, but I found it charming.

Incredible apartment at a great location in the heart of Bairro-Alto! We stayed here for 4 nights and could not have asked for a more comfortable stay. The flat is really well equipped - especially the kitchen, from a dishwasher to all the cutlery and utensils/pans/condiments one might need, and even a juicer and a Nespresso coffee machine. Check in and communication was very efficient and the whole team was super friendly and accommodating. They even prepared a very comprehensive list of restaurants, cafes and things to do and see in the city. I can only recommend this flat very highly! :)

Fantastisch verblijf! Alles was tot in de puntjes verzorgd. Een heerlijk schoon appartement met alle voorzieningen. En er werd heel attent met ons meegedacht met het in- en uitchecken. Echt een aanrader!

Great location and great place to stay! Only complaint was that we dealt with some loud neighbors the first night - but other than that had a great stay! Also just wanted to give a shout out to the hosts for helping us with anything and everything we needed!
great host, efficient communication, beautiful location

Staying at this apartment we felt right at home, it was comfortable, clean and we couldn't fault the facilities. Pedro and the team were so helpful and had such quick responses to any need we had. We would 100% stay again and recommend to anyone looking to visit Lisbon!
Very nice studio with everything you need. Located close to the city center.

What a great place in the centrum of Lissabon.
Chiado Loft 3 is:
clean appartement, trandy and stylisch with god information from Goncalo that we were using time all the during our stay in Lissabon.
From first moment till the eind Pedro's team we supporting us. Perfect location in the center of Lissabon and I know we will come bact here for sure.

This was a great place to stay for my friend and me. The view is beautiful from the windows as you look down on the water. The neighborhood is great, and the host team is really great and responsive. The tilt in the ceilings means that you will need to duck a bit if you’re tall. We’re both over 190cm (6’), and we were still fine. Great stay! Definitely recommend.

Beautiful loft apartment in a great location. Amenities provided were generous and it was the perfect stay for me and my boyfriend. Only note is the A/C struggled to cool the whole place, but otherwise was the perfect Airbnb!

Pedro’s loft in Lisbon was the perfect place for a quick two night stay with my girlfriend.
The location is phenomenal, the apartment is tastefully decorated and has all the little touches that take your stay to the next level, and Pedro and his team also provide great recommendations for things to do and places to eat.
Best of all their team is very responsive, they met us at the apartment for a personal greeting, and I could tell they really care about their guests. I will certainly stay at one of their places next time I’m in Lisbon.
Everything was as advertised and some extra perks ;)

The apartment is in a great location central walking distance (max 15 min) to a lot of tourist spots and 3 min walk from the metro. Also right outside you can pick up the famous No 28 line. The check in process was very easy and the apartment was very clean. There is AC in the apartment but it still can get a bit warm and if you sleep with the windows open the trains can be a little loud. All in all, I would highly recommend this spot to visitors of Lisboa!

Great apartment and a great location! A bit noisy at night and too much light in the morning but that should not stop you to book this place. I would definitely recommend it. I will go back when I visit Lisboa again.

I really enjoyed my stay in this beautiful luxury urban loft, including the welcome gifts (wine, oranges, coffee). A perfect base in the centre of the city. Do however take into account that the roof does limit functional space for tall travellers. Having said this: Measuring 1,87m myself I did not mind too much however.
Amazing flat - clean, brilliant location and really professional check in.  Would highly recommend to people wanting to explore Lisbon (amazing Bars and Restaurants very close to the apartment)

Beautiful place to stay.
Really central location but still not to busy at night's we loved it over there and would book it anytime again 😊

Apartamento prático , bem localizado , bem decorado e com todas as comodidades para uma excelente estadia em casal ou família.
Check in personalizado e disponibilidade para qualquer dúvida ou esclarecimento.

La casa è bellissima, dotata di ogni piccolo confort, dall'aria condizionata allo spremiagrumi, arredata con gusto e non vi manca nulla.
Si trova in una posizione strategica, è possibile visitare il centro a piedi o arrivare facilmente ai pullman.
Accoglienza top.
Responde plenamente a las expectativas, por su situación (párquing de pago muy cerca) y calidad.

Perfect Location to explore Lisbon on foot. The apartment is comfy with an upscale style and great to stay in with two people. The guys were super friendly, helpful and took care of everything we needed. I can absolutely recommend it
Sehr hübsche Wohnung mitten in der Stadt. Wir hatten ein paar sehr schöne Tage in Lissabon
We loved the apartment. It’s incredibly beautiful and perfectly located. On the table was a brilliant guide with restaurants and bars. You have to look at it!!

The apartment was amazing. Perfect communication, the location is on point and the interior super modern and cozy at the same time.
Would highly recommend the apartment.
I will come back soon!
Precioso apartamento con estilo, acogedor y cómodo. Situación perfecta, en pleno centro, recomendable al 100%

I loved this apartment and hope to stay there again. So beautifully styled and comfortable and in the dead center of activity in Chiado, plus the bonus of a food store right next door. As mentioned, the ceiling is slanted, but I’m 6’4” and it didn’t bother me. Very noisy at night with partying revelers as mentioned, but I would still stay there again.
Inviato

This space was super clean and had a fun design. The location was right in the center of Barrio Alto so close to the nightlife. The host met me upon check in to show me around the place and point out all the amenities. He gave me a great recommendation for a Fado dinner too! Highly recommend staying in this spot.
Note: you can hear street noise at night on Friday and Saturday so maybe think twice if you’re a light sleeper but I was completely fine!

Pedros apartment was absolutely perfect for this first time visitor to Lisbon. Apart from it being extremely clean and comfortable, it is in an excellent location for exploring. I was able to walk many places, and when necessary, the Metro is only a 5 minute walk from the apartment.
I loved the added touches like wine, a bowl of the best oranges I have ever tasted, and chocolate. There is a grocery store right next door, and the best tarts are found with a quick walk down the street.
Communication both before and during the visit was exceptional.
In all, I recommend this apartment as the best home base in Lisbin! I would happily stay there again, if the opportunity presented itself.

My wife and I had a great stay. Pedro's place is close to everything, we really enjoyed having the funicular mere steps from our apartment, as well as having a grocery store down stairs. We would definitely stay there again.
Loved the place and it was so well located. Walking distance to every where we wanted to go. The hosts were Super quick to reply and always available to make our stay better!

This loft is not only extremely homely and comfortable but very well placed within Barrio Alto. A short walk away from some great local treasures and the sea front.
A few unsavoury characters hang out near the entrance of the flat near the tram but they didn’t bother us nor cause any trouble - Lisbon is a proper city with all kinds of people. Would definitely recommend this place.
Ci siamo trovate benissimo! Unica pecca: non tutte le tendine per oscurare restavano attaccate al velcro.

진짜 사진과 비슷해요!!! 호스트도 너무 좋았고 각종 집 안에 있는 커피 기계와 세탁기, 요리해 먹을 수 있는 그릇 등 잘 구비 되어있어요!! 한가지 반한 점이 포켓 와이파이까지 주시는 센스!! 그리고 음식 추천도 해주었는데 진짜 맛있엇어요!! 궁금하면 가서 정보 얻는걸로!! 약간 아쉬운 점이 있다면 옆에 트램이 다녀서 트램지나갈 때마다 쪼끔 흔들려요....ㅎㅎ그리고 밤 늦게 들어가면 흑인들이 집 주변에 몰려있더라고요...
The Airbnb was perfect. Beautiful interiors in a perfect central location with so many restaurants and attractions within walking distance. Would highly recommend!!

La casa è esattamente come nella descrizione: ottimamente equipaggiata, pulitissima, ben arredata. Molto cordiali e disponibili i padroni di casa. La posizione è centralissima, vicino a tutti i mezzi pubblici, vicino ad ogni tipo di servizio, in un quartiere bello e vivace. Per chi volesse prenotare tenga presente che (almeno in questi giorni) dalle 22 fino alle 2 e oltre nella strada di sotto c’è un’enorme confusione perché si ritrovano personaggi vari a bere, fumare e festeggiare (con tanto di strumenti a percussione). La casa è comunque sicurissima, al terzo piano e con la porta blindata. Mio figlio e mio marito hanno il sonno pesante e non si sono accorti di nulla, io mi sono messa i tappi alle orecchie e ho dormito benissimo!
Very nice space in busy Bairro Alto. The teams recommendations were great. A beautiful apartment
Excellent location, area has a great buzz. Apartment is clean and convenient.

The place is stylish and unique. Close to lots of bars and restaurants, including couple of dive bars in the same building as the apartment. The bars are a great place to pre-game before going out because they are much cheaper compare to prices at the other bars.
The bathroom, living room, bedroom, and kitchen are clean. There is a coffee maker with provided supplies and a electric hot water kettle. The washer and dryer are definitely a plus! There is a grocery store about 200ft away from the apartment. Easy location to find and the host gave good direction to the apartment. The host provided a list of things to do and restaurants to try.
FYI, the studio is on the top floor so there is a slope; if you are over 5 ft 10 then be very mindful. I hit my head a couple of times forgetting that there was a slop in the ceiling. We had a great experience at the apartment.

Location très propre et décorée avec goût.
Notre hôte était charmant et très avenant .
Malheureusement l'appartement est situé au dessus d'un bar où une centaine de personnes chaque soir boivent, chantent et crient et tout ça à l'extérieur du bar et surtout jusqu'à 3 h du matin .
Ça a été pour nous juste impossible de dormir.
Et quand on s'approche vers 22 h pour voir ce spectacle de beuverie , des gens vous accostent et vous proposent de la cocaïne et de l'héroïne..!!!!!
Quel dommage car le quartier est juste pittoresque , rempli de belles adresses.
C'est une adresse que je ne conseille pas malgré le confort de l'appartement

This apartment is beautiful, has a nice kitchen for quick meals and having a washer/dryer is so convenient while traveling! I would suggest earplugs though, the bars nearby get very loud on  a Saturday night and don’t quiet down until well into the early hours of the morning.

Very comfortable and well decorated place! The location is a bit busy but it was wonderful being so close to everything. A lot of nice touches that showed their attention to service and detail. As for the sloped ceiling, my boyfriend and I aren’t all that tall so we were not affected by it. Very comfortable bed and all the amenities needed for an extended stay with a grocery store right next door! Highly recommend!
A great apartment - very central, and really comfortable with lovely touches!
Lovely place in the heart of Baixa Chiado, the place is very central, which was perfect as we were attending the Web Summit. Antonio is very professional and courteous. Recommended!

Pedro's place was beautiful. Diogo was a gracious co-host and helped us with our luggage and showed us his favorite local spots in the incredible guide they leave for their guests. I would definitely stay at Pedro's place again. In addition to being a lovely apartment, the location can't be beat!

Awesome time in a great city.   The place is great and perfect location to see everything.  Loved all the little extras that they have thought of.   Definitely would rent again next time I’m back in Lisbon

This place is stylish and clean. We loved every little detail and the bed was super comfortable. Location was perfect for us with a shop next door and lots of cafes around. Hosts are very professional and easy to communicate.

This place is very beautiful. The apartment is decorated with love.
Unfortunately we only stayed one night.
It is directly in the old town part of Lissabon. You have restaurants, bars and anything you need just in front of the door. The only thing you have to be aware is that it gets very very noisy on the streets.

We really enjoyed our 4-night stay at this apartment!
We do need to acknowledge a couple of things to be aware of upfront. (We felt that they were well advertised, and the rest of the experience was fantastic, so this doesn’t impact our 5-star rating.) The first thing is the noise. The apartment is above a busy bar that is VERY loud until about 2am. We turned the air con on when we wanted to sleep and this blocked out the noise completely, but something to be aware of if you don’t plan to be down there with them! Secondly is the low ceiling. It is slanted as in the photos so it is difficult to use all the space, however this isn’t an issue at all where it matters (bed, kitchen and bathroom). Now for the fantastic parts!
Location: the apartment is in a great location. It is walking distance to a number of attractions and the TimeOut Market, and has lots of cool bars and restaurants in the area. It is above a small supermarket, and is at both an Uber pickup point and a stop on the famous 28 tram.
Design: the photos are accurate - it is beautifully designed! I am so impressed with what they did with the space. Great bathroom and shower, super comfortable bed, and good little kitchen area with a nespresso machine. The apartment has everything you need for a short stay, including a few little extra touches that were really appreciated.
Hospitality: our check-in was smooth, and we received quick responses to any questions. We were given lots of tips to help us make the most of our time in Lisbon, and the welcome was very friendly.
Overall we had a great experience. It is a beautiful apartment in a great location, and just what we needed as a couple exploring Lisbon for a few days.

This was definitely one of our best stays on our trip. The bed was so comfortable and the location was right downtown with so much to do! The recommendations we received were fantastic and the wine left for us was an added bonus. The washer/dryer was nice and though it definitely gets loud at night outside the window, with the AC on we had no trouble sleeping. The loft was even better than pictured! We’d definitely stay here again and highly recommend Pedro’s place! Thank you so much!

An amazingly comfortable and stylish space up in the loft with all the amenities you could need. Little extras such as coffee pods and oranges (for freshly squeezed juice) made us feel welcomed and settled, quickly. The loft overlooks a busy street which can get lively at night but this doesn’t prevent a good nights sleep- especially given a long hilly days’ stroll around all the districts and the comfiest pillows I’ve ever laid on!! It’s a great little spot in the hub of it all, with easy access to restaurants, bars, train station etc. We hope to be back soon!

We had a great stay at the AirBnB. The place was very clean and beautifully designed. The host was very quick to respond and was always very friendly. The street noise was quite loud with the window open, particularly at night, but when the window was closed the sound proofing worked well and we had no issues sleeping. We would definitely stay here again!
房子距离市区火车站步行可达，到圣胡塔斯升降机步行五分钟，楼下就有超市，生活便利。如果自己租车，建议箱子留在车内不要带行李，我们带了箱子，简直傻到极点，窄小的楼梯没有电梯，上下楼搬行李简直就是磨难……除此之外一切都很完美，床也很舒服，厨房用品一应俱全，我们在楼下超市买了火腿鸡蛋牛奶给自己做了早餐，楼下很多餐厅，生活便利！房东亲自出来接我们，是一个可爱的大男孩^_^
This apartment is a stylish space very close to everything you need to see while in Lisboa! Watch your heads as the ceiling is low but otherwise it’s a beautiful place to stay.

Wohnung ins sehr guter Lage, modern und wirklich sauber. Die Hosts waren super nett, wir konnten spontan nach Absprache schon früher Einchecken und hatten auch gute Tipps.

Pedro's place was great.  It was in a perfect location and was very clean.  His communication was timely and he even left us information on the local area as well as recommendations for restaurants and activities.  I would definitely stay here again.

I cannot fault anything about our stay in the loft. Check in and check out were easy and quick and the hosts are really responsive. The room is sparkling clean and really nicely furnished.
Ideal location for exploring Lisbon and mostly in walking distance from all the main areas and public transport hubs. Some reviewers have noted the noise from the street below but we didn’t notice it during our stay. Will 100% be back to stay again.
Cool spot- perfect location and love the way it was decorated. Clean, relaxing and shockingly quiet for being in the center of everything! Would definitely recommend 🤗

This place was absolutely stunning and SO chic (looks better than the pics). The hosts even left us a small bottle of wine, chocolates and a bowl of oranges for the citrus juicer (HOW SWEET).

Place is as described and in pics. Large and roomy. Bed was super comfortable. They nicely provided blackout curtains so you can sleep in or get it extra dark. Nice neighborhood recommendations too. Never used the stove but did do some laundry which was nice.
Great location to everything. Felt like you really were in the center of things.

This place is amazing. The location is amazing. The host is amazing.
You will not find a better stay in Lisbon.
Thank you for such a wonderful stay.

Pedro’s place is great for the right group.  It is centrally located, clean, sunny and comfortable. But it is probably not good for tall people (the ceiling slopes a lot- it is in the attic) or seniors (it is a third floor walk up).  And it isn’t a good place if you are a light sleeper. The crowds at the bars below the apartment are really loud until late (well after midnight) even on Sunday, Monday, Tuesday nights....  Pedro did disclose this but it’s hard to imagine what it really is (like a rowdy frat party every night).  We live in a city so we are used to noise and we were pretty jet lagged so we all slept but I can imagine that it would be a problem for others.
Nice location.  The most thorough host I've had.

The apartment was everything described and more! Right on the heart of Bairro Alto - easy to access much of Lisbon by foot or by public transportation at your fingertips. We could not have asked for a better location in Lisbon, and the apartment itself was great! Pedro was responsive and helpful with checking us in, and provided a wealth of recommendations for restaurants, bars, and things to do. The apartment was beautiful, with great views of the city.

We had a great time at this flat. The space is clean, stylish and check-in was very smooth. So nice and clean! Perfect location and the host was easy to communicate with. Very modern style apartment with lots of amenities.!

Very nice apartment in a great location. Everything as described. Very helpful hosts. We enjoyed our stay a lot!

Amazing place and location! Definitely recommend,  and hopefully we will be back soon
This apartment was awesome! Great location, and great hosts!

I really enjoyed staying at Loft 3. It has nice interior and lots of stylish stuffs. Staff is really kind and gentle and he was quick to answer every question I got. Antonio let us bring our luggage early and then met us later to show us the apartment and the facilities.  The apartment had everything you need and was well appointed.  The map and local restaurant suggestions were very helpful.  The location is great for getting around the city.  Thank you Antonio was being so kind and helpful.

We loved this place. The loft is perfect for two and the location couldn’t be more central. The team that manages this property was responsive and helpful. I would stay here again and would highly recommend.

Die Lage, Ausstattung, Stil, Kommunikation, check-in and -out perfekt. Besser geht’s nicht.

In case this matters to you: it feels more like an investment for AirBnB stays than the lived-in experience of temporarily renting out someone's flat; this may be one reason why the refrigerator and food-storage areas are small.

All the main attractions and restaurants were walking distance away- we come from New York City so walking 20-30 minutes is not a problem for us. However if you want to take the tram it’s just outside the apartment. There’s a well stocked grocery store just next door. It was a nice surprise that one of the main streets with bars was just under our windows. No worries about the noise as the windows were very soundproof. Pedro and his team was very helpful with communications and hospitable. Be careful if you are tall of hitting your head on the slanted roofs :) Lisbon was amazing!
Amazing location and amazing apartment!!

Sensational!
The Chiado Loft Team run a very professional service, and we couldn't rate them highly enough. Nothing is too hard and communication is spot on! The Chiado Loft is devine! It is exactly as pictured, a very stylish, comfortable space. We were pleasantly surprised with all the lovely personal touches - the wine, chocolates and a roaming wifi for our use.
The Loft is right in the heart of Chiado, a real happening place, however we were not worried by any noise at all! The apartment is on the 3rd/top floor so perhaps not suitable for anyone who would have trouble walking stairs, however, the whole of Lisbon would therefore be an issue!
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay in The Loft and would highly recommend this place and the team.

This place was wonderful. Clean, stylish, close. The space was perfect and the hosts were wonderful. Thoughtful and responsive. Also gave great tips! People were partying late into the night and the flat was still so quiet. Really amazing.
Loved being in this neighborhood, close to the river, the shops, and nightlife!
Great flat, great location

Super guter Aufenthalt...wir wurden herzlich Willkommen und es hat uns an nichts gefehlt.
Das Appartement hat eine beeindruckende Lage, war sauber und sehr gut ausgestattet. Einen besonderen Dank an Antonio, der trotz unserer späten Ankunft, sich die Zeit genommen hat uns zu begrüßen und alles zu erklären.
Kann man gutem Gewissen nur weiterempfehlen!!!

房子装修非常漂亮，位置也是超级方便！周围随便逛逛都是景点。房东一直在跟我们保持联系，入住很顺利，设施很好很便利。被成功安利了胶囊咖啡机…
唯一就是房子没有电梯，不过入住的时候Antonio为我搬了行李～

The apartment was really clean and had many personal touches. There were many recommendations of where to eat and drink in the area that were provided to us. There’s a supermarket right downstairs and it is close to transportation, restaurants, and bars. This was a really great place to stay while on our honeymoon.
Convenient location. Mobile internet was amazing and helped with getting around and finding directions.

Is a very nice place, great location if you are not travelling by car.
Weekends are noisy so is good to have earplugs.
If you are a tall person i don't think is a proper place to stay!!
They are very helpful people and the plus was the portable Wi-Fi, great idea!!

Fantastic location, walking distance to everything! Beautiful apartment and well styled. Have heard other reviews say noise was loud but it honestly was not a problem, all over by midnight with new laws. Host was very friendly even after waiting for us after our long delayed flight.
Cannot recommend this place enough!

Pedro’s place was centrally located & had everything you could need for a short stay in Lisbon. There were nice personal touches included like a bottle of wine and some chocolate upon arrival. The only thing that maybe an issue for other travellers would be the noise. This didn’t bother us as we are heavy sleepers and wore earplugs.
Pedro’s apartment could not be in a more ideal location. The place was perfect for 3 guests and Pedro went out of his way to make sure we could drop off our bags before check in.

We highly recommend Pedro’s place during your stay in Lisbon. Pedro and his counterpart António were amazing hosts and very accommodating! They were very responsive leading up to our booking and accommodated us for dropping our bags off early. Also, we had one extra guest staying with us at the last minute due to an error in her booking and Antonio went above and beyond to make her stay comfortable by providing extra blankets and towels etc. The place was exceptionally clean and has all amenities you would need. The location was perfect and allowed us to explore Lisbon by walking. We appreciated the little extra touches like nespresso machine with provided coffee/espresso pods, an aircard wifi on the go, wine in the fridge for us, and a set of recommendations for places to go and see in Lisbon, and chocolates for each guest, just to name a few. You will be very pleased with your stay at Pedro and Antonio’s in Lisbon!
Great place to stay in Lisboa! You can reach every important spot by walking and there is also some nightlife around the corner. The apartment was clean and nicely arranged.

Pedro was very attentive, courteous and very responsive. Room was very comfortable, clean and have everything we needed. I love that it had a mini coffee machine. I hope to make it back one day and would highly recommend!

We absolutely loved our stay at Pedro's place! The location is truly in the heart of it all in Lisbon and very walk-able. The space was very clean, modern and had really unique decor. We were greeted with a bottle of wine upon arrival and enjoyed the comfortable bed,  washing machine, coffee maker and window with a beautiful street view of the city! We really appreciated the recommendations given on restaurants and found some great gems near the apartment. Thank you for our wonderful stay in Lisbon!
Beautiful apartment. Great location. Wonderful shower. Not noisy at night.  Arrived late due to airport delays and Pedro met us early the next day at 1100 so we could get into apartment. Wonderful!

Would absolutely recommend this flat to anyone looking at Lisbon. It is the perfect location in the main shopping district, and five mins walk from the metro. It is a little noisy at night but the windows and black out blinds block out the vast majority of the noise.
