The flat is beautiful and peaceful - I really appreciated being able to relax on the comfy bed whilst my husband chilled out on the sofa. The bathroom has the biggest shower I've ever been in too! Communication was very quick with all issues, it was my best Airbnb experience to date.
This Chiado loft is light, airy, and super central.  Definitely appreciated the easy communication and the handwritten welcome!

We stayed in this loft apartment for four nights and thoroughly enjoyed our stay. It is located well close to tram and metro services. There are many food options nearby and the lofts amenities are great. We particularly liked the mobile wifi that we had acres to. This allowed us to travel with this device whilst moving about the city ,with reliable wifi available all the time. The addition of a welcome wine in the fridge was also a lovely touch. The space is well presented and offers a comfortable bed. The coffee pods available each morning was also a nice touch. We recommend this place to anyone who wishes to experience Lisbon and the many sights and sounds it has to offer.
Logement impeccable, à proximité de tout, hôte arrangeant... attention pour les couche tôt, la rue est très animée la nuit !

If you are looking to stay in the best location in Lisbon this apartment is a no brainer. The apartment was extremely nice and very updated. Host offered great local recommendations and was very responsible. Highly recommend.
Amazing and beautiful space in a great area. Would love to stay again. Very friendly and travel helpful. Thank you!

Se você deseja ficar hospedado com charme, bem localizado, próximo à bons restaurantes e transportes públicos, no coração do Chiado. Acertamos em cheio. Afirmo também que essa foi nossa primeira experiência em hospedar-se via Airbnb e que foi uma experiência muito gratificante é surpreendente.

Super appartement en plein coeur de Lisbonne, moderne, très bien aménagé. Accueil très agréable avec de nombreuses attentions, très réactif aux messages en cas de besoin. Parfait pour passer quelques jours dans cette ville ! En plus l'appartement est situé juste à coté d'une rue mythique de Lisbonne, et tout peut-être fait à pied.

Such a fantastic studio - very central, right next to funicular and on tram 28 route, also close to wonderful restaurants.  Pedro was v quick and helpful in response to messages and gave us some fantastic tips on where to eat. We really appreciated the personal touches on arrival. Definitely recommend to others.

Foi uma experiência muito boa! O loft é lindo, aconchegante, tem tudo o que a gente precisa, super bem localizado (por sinal, recomendo que experimentem o pastel de Belém da Manteigaria, ali pertinho - delicioso!!!!). À noite tem, sim, um certo barulho... bem embaixo do apartamento tem bares, e o povo canta (músicas brasileiras, por sinal). Mas eu sempre viajo com meus tampões de ouvido, de modo que não foi problema nenhum para mim. Ao lado do apartamento tem um supermercado, e no entorno tem uma variedade grande de restaurantes. No apartamento eles deixam: sabonetinho, chocolatinho, cápsulas nespresso, laranjas frescas... muito simpático! Além disso, tem um wi-fi que você leva junto com você, bem legal. A comunicação com eles também é facílima. Super recomendo!
Great place and first class hosts who were very quick to respond and where beyond helpful when we were there. Would highly recommend.

This apartment is in the best location and within walking distance to everything beautiful and fun in Lisbon. It is on a very popular street in the evening, but the view and location are worth it. They had great recommendations for food and a helpful map ready to go for visitors.
Beautifully styled loft in a perfect location!
Sehr schönes und gut ausgestattetes Loft im Zentrum von Lissabon, sehr nette und hilfsbereite Gastgeber, es hat uns sehr gut gefallen und wir kommen gerne wieder.
Espectacular apartamento. Limpieza excelente. Muy buena comunicación con los anfitriones y nos ayudaron mucho con cualquier duda que tuvimos. Muchas gracias por hospedarnos!
Perfect spot for my boyfriend and I’s time in Lisbon!
Stylish little space close to everything you'll need. Pedro and Team are very responsive and helpful.
Lovely stylish apartment in a great location. Beds were really comfortable, kitchen facilities were good and everything was very clean. Thank you!

Everything was great about the place - the loft was very stylish and clean, the location was in the walking distance to the pier as well as the city centre (and pretty much everything! The host provided everything we needed from bed sheets and towels to even portable Wi-Fi. The recommendations of bars and restaurants were also very helpful - the places were indeed very good!
However, there is only one BUT - the soundproofing of the flat is not very great and as the it is located on one of the main streets of Lisbon, some nights we couldn't sleep because of the noise from the outside. We could literally hear people sing songs and laugh under our windows at 3AM. Therefore, I wouldn't recommend the place to those travelling with kids.
Otherwise, the place is wonderful!
Great location and informative host. Highly recommend this place.
숙소가 매우 깔끔하고 디자인이 잘 되어있었습니다. 호스트 분이 친절하게 근처 관광지와 맛집을 소개해주셔서 로컬 맛집을 많이 방문할 수 있었어요. 블루투스 스피커도 활용할 수 있어 너무 좋았어요♡
lovely place, perfect location. A little bit noisy, fixed with earplugs:)

We had a great experience with this apartment. Antonio and team were very easy to get in touch with and responsive ahead of our stay, and gave us excellent advice and suggestions for getting around the city and things to do.
The place was perfectly clean when we arrived, and had everything we needed (towels, clean sheets, toilet paper, Nespresso pods, etc) and is in the best possible location. The apartment is near amazing restaurants and beautiful sites, and we walked almost everywhere.
The one note we have for fellow travelers is that the noise from the street below is very loud. We stayed from Saturday through Wednesday, and every night there were people yelling and playing music right outside the windows until 5 in the morning. We’d read about this in other reviews and didn’t think it would bother us since we live in Manhattan where it’s also very noisy, but we had a hard time getting any sleep. I would highly recommend bringing earplugs - we couldn’t find any in nearby stores. The beautiful apartment and location are worth the noise, but it is definitely worth noting.

Everything was as described in the photos. The hosts were great.
Portable WiFi an unexpected bonus!
Nicki

Beautiful, light filled apartment in a safe neighborhood with loads of shopping, cafés and bakeries. Baixa-Chiado metro station is just down the street. 40min journey via metro from the airport to the apt. Grocer and liquor store right next door. Forms and Cork & CO have beautifully crafted cork bags and gifts. The Mill has great coffee and toasties. Have a meal at Taberna da Rua das Flores. Quick on the go snack at Sama Sama Crêpe bar. All short walks from your stylish apartment. BYO shampoo/conditioner. Only thing not provided. I found the Millenium ATM's accepted my Canadian debit card and didn't charge a service fee for withdrawals. I would not hesitate to stay at the Chiado lofts again. Obrigado!

If you want a central apartment in Lisbon, stay here. The hospitality was the best I’ve received in any Airbnb. The apartment is incredibly equipped to give you a great stay. We were visiting for New Year’s Eve and they gifted us by surprise a Champagne and portuguese traditional sweets. The apartment can be a bit noisy at nights but it’s such a great location. I will definitely come back and stay here!

Pedro’s studio was perfect location for all the good restaurants and night out. Beautifully designed and very comfy space. Also they accommodate our check in and check out time for out flights. Highly recommend for lisbon local city experience!
Wonderful apartment and fantastic hosts who were super hospitable. Highly recommend!

this room is great and very clean! the host has given us many tipps about food, transpotions and also sight seeings. host is very very nice. room is very comfortable. the position is very very good. downstairs is a supermarket. and in 3 minutes is there a metro station. around here are lots restaurants and shops. the only thing is that at night you can hear the street singers singing and chating.

Perfektes Loft um Lissabon zu erkunden. Wir waren 3 Freunde auf der Suche nach Spaß und Zeit zusammen zu sein und zu quatschen. Sehr schönes Loft inmitten von Lissabon. Alles sauber und schön eingerichtet. Kaffee, vino & sogar Schokolade auf dem Kopfkissen. Toller Blick auf den Tejo, Jesus Statue.
Alles gut zu Fuß zu erreichen. Traumhafte Stadt mit der perfekten Unterkunft. Muito obrigado guys.
This place was perfect! The hosts are friendly and they gave us good restsurant tips. They had left even a bottle of wine for us. Very good location.
good

Perfecte locatie naast idyllisch trammetje met fantastisch uitzicht. Hele aardige gastheren met supertips. Zelfs chocolaatjes en wijn bij aankomst :). Mooie ruimte, schoon en fancy; wel schuin dak dus niet voor mensen > 1.90m.

Beautiful, clean, spacious apartment on the top floor. Perfect for four or friends willing to sleep in close quarters. Host left us wine and chocolates as a welcome gift and provided a portable WiFi for walking around w our American phones. We loved it!

The location of the apartment is great. Right in the heart of everything. The noise at night that comes along with that was expected and was mostly taken care of by some ear plugs. The ceiling is quite low and as a 6'2" guy, I found myself hunched over the majority of the time. I highly recommend the apartment for anyone looking for a unique space in a lively neighborhood.

L'appartement est absolument charmant et d'une propreté indiscutable. Nous avons été accueilli chaleureusement et nous avons beaucoup apprécié les petites attentions (chocolat, bouteille de vin).
Je le recommande vivement !

Pedro was a fantastic host and the apartment was everything we wanted for our stay. Great location and base from which to explore the city ... there's something there to find from there for everyone. Food. Especially the food! Thanks Lisbon and thank you Pedro!

Pedro e Antonio são anfitriões maravilhosos. O apartamento está todo reformado e muito bem equipado, inclusive com benefícios difíceis de encontrar em outras locações, como a máquina Nespresso (com cápsulas) e o aparelho móvel de wi-fi que nos permitiu permanecer conectados o tempo todo, em qualquer lugar da cidade. A localização é a melhor possível, no melhor lugar do bairro Chiado. Adoramos e recomendamos com certeza!
Pedro and Antonio are wonderful hosts. The apartment is all renovated and very well equipped, including benefits difficult to find in other locations, such as the Nespresso machine (with capsules) and the wi-fi mobile device that allowed us to stay connected all the time, anywhere in the city . The location is the best possible in the best place in the Chiado neighborhood. We love it and recommend it for sure!

The loft is an amazingly well-decorated place. It’s also very spacious and in a prime location in the city. Pedro and Antonio were responsive and helpful with their communication and were flexible with all requests.
I would have booked this for my entire stay in Lisbon if it had been available. You’d be hard-pressed to find any other place that provides such great value. 10/10 would recommend.
Great place to stay!  Wonderful loft, very central, great location.  Excellent communication.  Would definitely stay again!

I definitely recommend to stay at this place! It's a very nice apartment in the best area of Lissabon. Pedro and his team are very friendly and they help you with anything you need. We enjoyed our stay and we would love to come back sometime!

O apto é exatamente o que se vê nas fotos postadas no Airbnb. A localização é PERFEITA quanta à distancia de padarias, lojas, supermercados, estacionamentos, etc...
Ponto negativo, muuuito barulho que vara a madrugada até aprox. 4h da manhã , barulho alto que incomoda muuuuito para dormir, além de ter um ponto de droga na escada do Bondinho, pessoas lhe abordando o tempo todo pedindo e oferecendo drogas.
Anfitriões simpáticos, solícitos e pontuais.
Indicamos o local.
Renato e Márcia

This loft apartment is great. don't worry about the low ceiling. I'm 6ft tall and was fine...  It adds to the charm. The apartment was right on a hopping bar street, but I had no trouble sleeping. place is very convenient and clean. was happy with my decision to stay here.
This spot is in a great location especially night life. We really enjoyed our stay here and found it cozy and comfortable. The extra amenity of wifi on the go was especially great!

An excellent place to stay in Lisboa. We would definitely return.
+ Location - at the intersection of the 28 Electrico and the Ascensor da Bica in the Bairro Alta, this is a GREAT location.
+ Groceries - the Minipreço is right next door. Another grocery with a better vegetable selection is only 20 meters away.
+ Photos - the host's photos are accurate and convey the feeling of the apartment.
+ Washer/dryer - did the job for use. Detergent was included.
+ Electric juicer - we enjoyed fresher squeezed OJ
+ Air conditioning - worked quietly and efficiently.
+ Shower - large, lots of hot water.
- Poor lighting in the kitchen area and none over the dining table. Do not plan on eating dinner here.

This was our first visit to Lisbon and could not have had a better and more central place to stay.
The apartment is in a fantastic location, close to restaurants and bars and in the heart of the nightlife.
The apartment is beautifully furnished, very modern and decorated to perfection. The photos on airbnb are amazing but it is even better in real life! It felt like staying in a 5 star apartment - equipped with everything you need.
Pedro and the team make communication super easy and they are always within reach to answer a question.
This apartment comes highly recommended and we will most definitely stay here again! Thank you Pedro, Antonio & Goncalo ;)

This was our second time staying in Pedro's place, and it has been amazing both times! The apartment is wonderfully furnished and the bed is really comfortable. The neighborhood is great and there are a ton of incredible restaurants nearby. I can't recommend this place enough!
We loved our stay in Lisbon. The place was just as pictured and felt like home. Super central for our short stay. Would stay again. Communication was professional and organized.

Unbeatable location, amazing hosts, and a truly cozy apartment right in the middle of it all. Be warned that it gets very noisy at night due to all the nightlife activity in the ally below (every night from around midnight to 2am), so earplugs are a must at night! Also the ceiling gets low where it slants down in the loft, but my boyfriend (who is 6'2) didn't really have a problem. Aside from that, it really doesn't get much better than this! Highly recommend!

Very impressed by this Airbnb! The location was great, the communication was very fast and very helpful. We loved the hosts attention to detail, from providing lists of places to eat and go out, to giving a thorough explanation on how the washer works, kitchen appliances and lighting, the welcome note and goodies left were a great personal touch. The apartment was very comfortable and very nicely furnished. Our favorite Airbnb stay we have been to. We would definitely recommend it!

Great location to explore Lisboa. Apartment has true genius loci. In this area is thousend of restaurants, bars, shops and its fit for people which like night life. Equipment is more the sufficient. We would like to thanks all team for helping us with recommendations how to spend time in Lisboa. We are sure that we will return :)

Pedro was great at communication and always replied to any questions I had really quickly.
The apartment is in such a good location as literally with so much on your doorstep. There is also a super market literally next door.
With this being such a great area there is noise until around 2am at night which didnt bother my group as we were out then anyway! There was four of us who stayed here and it was really comfortable for us!
I would definitely stay here again and recommend to my friends. The apartment is exactly as described :)

Pedro's place was great, exactly as the pictures showed. Everything was clean and nicely arranged; we even had a little welcome gift.
The place is very central and therefore everything is in walking distance , i.e. Time Out market (highly recommended for lunch or dinner).
However, as it is very central it can get a little noisy on the street at night, so if you want to sleep early, just bring some ear plugs. Otherwise just join the fun nightlife right at your door step.
Thank you also for making communication and check in easy!
Very beautiful loft.  Comfortable and clean.  Central location.. can be quite noisy at night.  Otherwise fantastic place I would recommend to anyone.

Great communication, kind friendly hosts, the Chiado loft is beautifully remodeled with all modern convenience and is located right in the heart of the city, everywhere is easy to reach by walking, 3 people can comfortably stay, only slight negative is on The Weekend it can be very noisy as the street below is party central, but we stayed 3 nights & only Friday night it was loudish but still ok & if you like the nightlife you couldn't pick a better location

Loved this gem of a place. Pedro, Antonio and the rest of team were very communicative and helpful when asking about suggested parking ramps, ideas for where to eat, and how to get around, and other spots in Portugal to visit. They were timely and personable.
The space itself was unique, styled very nicely and clean. The bed was comfortable. The location was central to everything. We were warned that it's above some bars so can get a little loud. No biggie, just bring some earplugs.
Thank you - we enjoyed the apartment and exploring Lisbon. :)

The portable wifi was very handy (and not even mentioned on airbnb)!!! Thanks for that! Goncalo was extremely helpful, responsive accommodative and friendly. He provided many great recommendations we appreciated changing the checkout time and we will definitely recommend this place to friends

Un logement très pratique, fonctionnel et bien situé pour découvrir Lisbonne.
Pedro Antonio et Gonçalo ont été très réactifs à nos messages pour faciliter l'arrivée sur les lieux, qui était agrémentée de petites attentions (café, chocolat, bouteille de vin, ...)
Attention cependant aux personnes ayant le sommeil léger, comme indiqué sur l'annonce la rue est bruyante jusqu'à 2h du matin, ce qui dans notre cas nous a peu incommodé.
Rien à redire sur la propreté et la décoration au top,
Je recommande ce logement !

Fantastic location, cozy space, looks exactly like the picture. Host is super great and responsive; even checked in during my stay to make sure everything is all right. They also provide a mifi (portable wifi hotspot) which was a great help. Thanks!! Only reminder is to bring ear plugs if you are a light sleeper, as there are a few bars that can get a big loud during the night.
Excellent accueil avec quelques petites attentions. L'appartement est cosy et idéalement situé. Je le recommande.

Great appartment, clean, well furnished. Amazing location. Great landlords.
Don't hesitate to take it!

The place is even better than the amazing pictures! Cozy, central, clean and perfect for a stay in beautiful Lisbon! Pedro was very nice and left us small presents throughout the house! Definitely recommend staying there!!

The apartment is super stylish and clean! The beds are really comfortable and the towels are amazing. There is everything you could need in the apartment (incl. washing machine and dishwasher). The location is very central and it's easy to get around by foot. The metro station is quite close and there is a small supermarket just downstairs. The only downside is that it gets pretty noisy at night (lots of bars in the neighbourhood) so if you're a light sleeper, bring earplugs with you. Also, it's an attic apartment and the ceiling is slanted so if you're really tall, that might make your life a little bit uncomfortable :) Our hosts were very friendly and helpful and communication went smoothly.
Fast communication with the hosts, light and beautiful apt! Only downside that there is no elevator and many stairs..

Pedro, Antonio and Gonçalo were brilliant and replied to messages almost instantly every time. They were very helpful with check-in and let us pick up our bags later on our check-out day so we did not have to carry them around. The apartment is spotless and very nicely finished with everything you need. The location is great for heading out in evenings as the best places are close by. We would recommend these apartments to all our friends who visit Lisbon.

We're already missing our amazing apartment in Lisbon. The location is perfect, so central and just next to the vibrant party street Rua da Bica. Our hosts had warned us about th noises from the street but we slept like babies all nights. The apartment itself is very cool, beautifully and stylish decorated with a very comfortable bed. Communications beforehand were very informative and good. We can only but recommend this place to everybody, looking forward to visiting again!

This was my 6th time in Lisbon and this appartement exceeded everything so far. The location couldn't have been better, the interiorn very tasteful and clean and the communication with the host ran smoothly. Thank you for a great weekend!
Perfect! The location is ideal (but noisy until 3 am), the hosts were very thoughtful with "surprises" in the loft. The loft is as seen in the pictures, so no bad surprises.
We loved staying in the loft ,it was really central and comfortable and well equiped .Pedro was very helpful.

Amazing location with lots to do around the apt, lively place to stay near tons of restaurants, bars, etc! The loft was beautiful and kitchen had every amenity needed, plus more. Fast wi-fi and super quick communication with hosts before check in and during our stay! Highly recommend!
Thank you

This apt is fabulous.   Perfect location and so comfortable.  I was able to completely decompress after a long flight and it had everything I could ask for.  The A/C is a huge bonus - it's hot in Portugal!!! I would come again for sure.

Fantastic.
First, the hosts are so awesome. They go out of their way to make it easy to check in, and are available for any questions.
This is the SECOND time we have stayed in this unit. It's such a lovely place. You wake up with the sun streaming into the white room - so lovely. The location is fantastic - right in the heart of Chiado - walking distance to everywhere.
Washing machine works well. There's a mini grocery store literally downstairs. Very convenient. Just remember to bring some ear plugs - Chiado is a happening place, which is why you want to be there. But it can be loud on the streets until 2-3a.
Can't recommend this place enough! Perhaps our favorite Airbnb.
Der Aufenthalt war echt super. Sehr zentral gelegen, nah am Geschehen und sauber. Dazu ist die Wohnung auch sehr schön eingerichtet. Kurzum: wir würden jederzeit wiederkommen.
It was perfect😊

We really enjoyed our stay at Loft Chiado. It's in a great area of the city with many bars and restaurants very close by. Pedro was extremely organised and was great with communicating. He also provided detailed lists of places to check out in the city and directions on how to use appliances in the house. It's also worth noting this was the only place in europe we stayed that provided little household basics such as coffee pods, salt, pepper, washing powder etc which comes very handy when travelling. Overall a great stay.

It's exactly as described on the photo, very clean and stylish. It's run by an office not individuals, so the communication was great too. It was a bit smaller than it looked like on the pictures but we were 4 people and it was enough space for us. There was some marching band passing by at night right in front of the apartment so we went out to watch it. It's a very lively but quiet residential area.
Great apartment in a great location. I'll book it again when I'm back in Lisbon. Alex
The apartment was clean, modern, and well furnished. It looks exactly like the pictures and we very much enjoyed our stay. I would have to say this was one of my favorite Airbnb experiences! :)

We had a very good but short stay at Chiado Loft 3.  The loft is very clean and had all amenities.  The bathroom and shower are very roomy.  The location is great, very close to everything we wanted or needed.

Apartment was bit smaller than on pictures but everything was great.
Only one issue - it has a good central location ), and on Friday night it was a bit noisy at 4 AM )

The perfect little bolthole in a wonderful neighbourhood. The apartment is in a fantastic location on the boarders of Chado and barrio alto within walking distance to many amazing bars restaurants and tourist sights. The apartment is comfy, clean and stylishly decorated with all the little touches that make it a home from home. We plan on returning to Lisbon and won't hesitate to stay here again.x
A great spot for a base to experience Lisbon from. A lovely clean apartment.

Wonderful space in a great location. Perfectly placed for the 28 tram, the funicular down to the TimeOut market and very close to a metro station. Excellent restaurants near and literally next door to a mini-market (though a nicer one is 20 metres down the road :) ).
The flat itself is a really cool space. Very clever layout maximises the usable space. The kitchen is well stocked, the bathroom is clean and the bed is really really good.
The neighbourhood is definitely lively, which for us was a plus.
Overall, just as described. Actually, better than that!

Wir haben uns in dem sehr sauberen, geschmackvoll eingerichteten Appartement wie zu Hause gefühlt und wurden trotz verspäteter Ankunft herzlich willkommen geheißen, die Kommunikation war sehr unkommpliziert. Die Lage ist perfekt für Unternehmungen jeder Art. Ein großes Dankeschön an Pedro und sein Team - jederzeit gerne wieder!

El departamento muy bien equipado, diseño moderno y acogedor. La ubicación es muy buena, cerca de plazas y estación de tren interurbano y facil para ir hacia centro de comercio y tiendas. El Barrio Alto muy entretenido.
Un solo problema y fue que justo en la calle que dan las ventanas hay un bar "Small Bar" que hacen la noche hasta las 3 de la madrugada en la vereda y el bullicio es grande y sin pausa.
Pese a las buenas y modernas ventanas es difícil dormir.
I can absolutely recommend staying here. The flat is absolutely amazing and central and Gonçalo / Pedro and team are exceptional hosts. 100% recommendable
Very good place in town, very cute and clean appartement, great hosts, thank you for everything

We just lovend our stay in the appartment. Everything was really clean and very nicely decorated! We were warmly welcomed and there was even some wine and chocolates for us. Would definitely book this (or one of the other Chiado lofts) appartment again!
We loved our stay in the apartment. Just as pictured, though the ceilings are quite angled low. The hosts were awesome they even left us wine & chocolates as a welcome. Would happily return!

Excelente localização! Loft cozy, acolhedor, bem decorado e limpo. Apesar de a região ser muito movimentada o isolamento acústico é muito bom! Perto de mercados, restaurantes, transporte público e sightseeings! Eu recomendo!

Wonderful central location. Walked to all major attractions; literally right next to trolleys, elevator, and near metro. This location is across the street from all the liveliness of Bairro Alto, near Chiado shopping, and above a cute grocery store. Apartment is exactly how it looks in the images. Recommended for people 5'9" and shorter :)

The apartment couldn't be in a better location. We were able to walk to nearly all the main sites, and there are tons of great estaurants and bars nearby. This makes the area slightly noisy at night, but we enjoyed this. The apartment was exactly as described in the advert, and was perfectly clean. In the run-up to arriving, whenever I emailed a question, I got a very prompt response. Check in was very easy, and they gave us a complimentary bottle of wine and some chocolate, which was lovely.

So happy we decided to stay here! It was so clean and close to what we needed. Pedro and the other guys are great and communicating with them is easy. Would completely recommend this place! It really makes you feel like a part of Lisbon and not feel like a tourist. Also, metro is so close and after the first try of finding the place from the metro it's like the back of your hand after that. Thanks so much for a wonderful time!
Lovely apartment, very well situated. We enjoyed our stay in your apartment very much.

Pedro and his team were first rate and answered e mails within 30 mins normally. Nothing ever seemed too much ch effort for them, ev n ensuring a table reservation on the first night as we had not had a reply from the patron. Accommodation was spacious and photos accurate. Central property. Would certainly return to Lisbon and would rebook here again without a doubt. A good team effort from initial booking to leaving.

Fantastic location right in the middle of the action! Windows shut out the noise which was a blessing! Beautiful apartment, artfully curated with stylish pieces. Comfy bed and great views to streets below and glimpse of the sea!
Lovely place, perfect for our needs. Great location and fantastic service. Thank you x

One of the most beautiful apartments I've been in Lisbon yet. Tremendous designed, amazing area within the best restaurants, bars and stuff to do, when visiting this city. Contact was fast and easy and the place perfect for 2 persons. We'll came back for sure.

Such such an immaculate and beautifully designed apartment. Everything was exactly as it is in the pictures. Location was perfect for people that want to be a stones throw from the restaurant and bar scene. Pedro was also really accommodating, letting us leave our bags until the apartment was ready and suggesting lots of things to do.
Great place and location. Very comfortable bed. Recommended.
Fantastic place, stones throw away from great restaurants and bars. Would highly recommend! Great hosts. Really enjoyed Lisbon!

It was a pleasure to stay in such a beautiful apartment, it was right in the hustle and bustle of Lisbon and all the attractions were an easy walk away.  The host was super friendly and very accommodating.  I would definately stay again.
logement parfait mais bruyant jusque 3H du matin
Great stay,  in the heart of lisboa! Everything was exactly as it was written! Recommend it strongly!

Great place, in a good and central location. The apartment was very compact, modern and with alot of natural light. The grocery shop is downstairs and there are plenty of places to eat at the surrounding area, highly recommended!

Un appartement charmant !
Le quartier est super, typique, près de la mer.
L'appartement est pratique, chaleureux, décoré avec soin (la salle de bain est super !)
Et l'accueil fut parfait ; l'équipe est prévenante et attentionnée, et il y avait plein de petites attentions à notre arrivée ( Porto, brioche,...).
Bref, un super Airbnb!

Die Unterkunft ist sehr zentral im 3. Stock in einem Dachstock. Das Studio ist geschmackvoll eingerichtet und hat eine gut ausgestattete Küche und ein modernes Badezimmer. Allerdings würde ich es grossen Personen nicht empfehlen, da das Bett eher klein ist und man wegen der Dachschräge auch nicht viel Raum hat, wo man aufrecht stehen kann. Für Nachtschwärmer ist die Lage perfekt. Das Ausgangsviertel liegt vor der Haustüre, dadurch kehrt Ruhe auch erst gegen die frühen Morgenstunde ein - war aber für uns kein Problem.
Die Betreuung war sehr gut - Pedro ist zurecht ein Superhost.
Really nice place and the team around Pedro is amazing. Highly recommend place to stay in LISSABON.
The Flat is very nice and clean. Also the location of the flat is great (central). The host is very nice and helpful for any questions about Lissabon.
Fantastic loft apartment which is furnished to a very high level. Great location just minutes away from Bairro Alto. Would definitely stay here again!
Excellent accueil, appartement correspondant complètement au descriptif. À conseiller.

amazing place (perfect for a couple, really well designed, nice view from the window), excellent location (in Barrio Alto, easily connected with the all neighborhood of Lisbon) , great comunication with Pedro and his friends.

I'll definitely going back to this place if I'll visit Lisbon again

My boyfriend and I stayed here for 3 nights and loved the location! It's so centrally located and close to a bunch of cute restaurants in the Barrio Alto area. The Chianti rental team was also very responsive leading up to our stay and greeted us in the apartment for check-in. The entire place is adorable, completely renovated, modern, and looks just like it does in the pictures.

One thing to keep in mind is the outlet plugs in the main living space are all clustered along the very low wall, so be prepared to crawl on your hands and knees to plug in your electronics. My boyfriend and I hit our heads quite a few times trying to charge or cell phones and cameras...

A quirky loft apartment in the very best area for sightseeing with a great night life. Very close to lots of bars and restaurants. Perfect for a couple or two or three young people that want to see Lisbon and enjoy a few drinks. Lovely touch from the host with a few little gifts a left for us.

The apartment is really lovely and spacious. Very central location and next to many shops, bars and restaurants. The welcoming from the team was really nice and flexible as our flight was delayed and still it was easy to message them the new hour of our arrival and got a really quick response with their ok. Thank you for hosting us.

Pedro's apartment is fantastically located to explore the city. The place itself is quite cozy and hip, and has everything one needs.
The check-in experience was also great.
Highly recommended.

This house was perfect to feel Lisbon as it is. The location is good as it was on the center of Chiado area. It was neat, and well equipped. Pedro was very kind and explained everything we might need, very professionally. I hope to visit Lisbon again some day and stay at this loft for a little bit longer :)
stunning apartment, amazing location, just highly recommended! muito obrigada pedro & team!

The loft is just wonderful and very central, with shops nearby.
The little things Pedro arranged made it even better, like for example the fresh oranges so we could make a fresh orange juice.

Great place!!!!!!! Stylish, all facilities you need, are there and we had a very warm welcome
Location is amazing !

Lovely studio space that provided great views of the water and city. Chiado was a great home base while we stayed in Lisbon that made it super easy to get around. The hosts were always responsive to questions and were thorough in showing us the space upon check in. Would definitely recommend this place and would stay here again the next time I visit Lisbon!

Lugar ótimo, muito lindo o loft. A localização é privilegiada, pois o bairro do Chiado é maravilhoso.
Fomos muito bem atendidos.
Recomendamos para todos.
Lovely spot in the middle of a very charming neighborhood!

We had a great stay, the apartment was very clean and well equipped. Our host event left little extras (like coffee and wine). It's a great centre location.
We would definitely recommend this apartment. Thank to Pedro and the team.
Great location, fantastic apartment, perfect host. Cannot recommend enough!
Centrally located apartment well fitted out. Very comfortable, but right in the action. So can be on the noisy side. Apartment on the third floor is a little bit of a climb.

Fantastic loft, clean, brilliantly decorated, stunning views at sunrise and sunset. Great location to be in the middle of the best bars and restaurants (can be a little noisy, but the location cancelled this out for us), the bed is heaven, so comfortable.
Would highly recommend, as long as you are not tall!!!
The place was perfect and the location couldn't have been better. I wish we stayed longer!

A really wonderful and unique place to stay while visiting Lisbon! The loft was very conveniently located to shops, restaurants, and tourist attractions. It was also within easy walking distance of the train station, which made visiting Belem and having a beach day in Cascais really easy. The apartment itself comes equipped with just about anything you might need (with the exception of an iron and ironing board). Overall, a really excellent stay!
Very nice Aptm. In perfect tourist location!!

We had a fantastic stay here. The apartment is in an amazing location, right in the centre of the city. The supermarket is literally at the bottom of the stairs to the apartment, which is really convenient. The apartment is bright and spacious, and well decorated. We would definitely recommend!
Very good experience, Very well located, the staff was very nice to us.

The loft was little bit smaller than expected and has really low roof. But it´s great anyway. It is very central and a very exclusive place to stay. The interior is great and you will find everything you need. Pedro welcomed us very good and gave us great tips. I would definitely book this place again, when i´d come back to Lissabon. Thank you!

No podíamos haber elegido mejor, una buhardilla preciosa decorada con mucho gusto a la cual no le falta detalle y te hace sentir como en casa, la situación es inmejorable con mucha dificultad para estacionar pero hay un parking cercano a 13,50€ el día. Recomiendo este alojamiento a todos los quieran visitar Lisboa en un sitio diferente y acogedor.

Pedro and his team met us to ensure we knew exactly where the apartment was located. Antonio showed us the apartment and they left a list of local places that we should check out which was super helpful!
Everything was great!  Luis was getting in touch with us already at the airport. The neighbourhood was right in the old town. We enjoyed our stay very much.

Very good experience.
Pedro and his team (we dealt with António and Luis) are very good hosts. They were friendly, helpful, on time for the check-in and available when needed (we had a sewage odour problem and António came within an hour to correct the situation). They give some chocolates and a bottle of wine to welcome you!
The loft is very clean and nice. the bathroom is also very clean with a big shower. It has TV with some US and british channels and we could watch some of the Rio Olympics at night. Internet connection is very good (at least 25 Mbps).
But the biggest advantage is the amazing location of the loft, right in the center of Lisbon! You can walk the whole city from it (except for the Belém bairro). There is a Mini Market just downstair where you find almost everything. There are a lot of restaurants and shops around. There is a lot of animation days and nights which is fun and as the loft is on the third floor with air conditioning, it is not noisy when the windows are closed. The subway is only 300 meters away and there is a tramway stop downstair.
The only problem (just to find one) is the ceiling height which is a bit low in some parts of the apartment for 6ft+ people like me.
we spent 2 stays there and we enjoyed it both times.

My friend and I were due to check in to the apartment at 8.30pm and experienced significant delays which set us back 3 hours. Antonio was waiting patiently for us and was so kind and gracious about our delay. The apartment itself is beautifully styled and very comfortable, there was even a bottle of wine chilling in the fridge for us. Thanks Antonio for your patience and for a lovely stay in your immaculate apartment.

I really have no complaints about this place and would love to stay there next time I'm in town. The apartment is even more beautiful than in the pictures, the location is great and the hosts are so helpful. Loved it!

Wow! Pretty much the first word to comes to mind once you've reached the third floor of this apartment. It was the perfect place to come home to after a full day of adventure in Lisbon. We highly recommend staying in this beautiful apartment.
Loved our stay! All the amenities we needed and more. Would recommend as the perfect couples getaway :)
Buena ubicacion  y el el loft tienes todo lo necesario
Great location close to bars and restaurants of great quality

Had an amazing stay at the loft. Such a great location in a fun and beautiful neighborhood. Very comfortable for four people. The roof is at more of an angle then I realized in the photo so my tall brothers had to be careful of the ceiling which was a bit trying. But we got used to it and enjoyed the big windows with a view of the water. Would highly recommend the loft and Pedro and his team were very helpful and answered questions quickly.

This is a beautiful loft in an ideal location. The facilities could not be better although some furniture is showing a bit of wear. The area is lively and central with lots of wonderful restaurants and bars around, overall a good experience.
Perfect location, beautiful apartment with thoughtful amenities, great hosts!

Pedro provided the ultimate customer service experience. We had someone waiting for us at the loft ready to let us in and show us around. A listing of the best places to eat, drink, and visit were provided along with some awesome amenities. There was a great view, cozy vibes, and beautiful layout. My boyfriend and I are both over 6 feet tall and we still enjoyed this amazing space.

The apartment was amazing. It is on a colorful street very near the famous funicular. There's a little neighborhood grocery store just feet away if you want to cook. The apartment was immaculate and decorated in a modern style. It looked just like the photos. As you can see from the pictures it in the attic spaced of the building and had vaulted ceiling. Antonino and the team have done a great job putting together information about the area and the apartment. Antonio will walk you through some important information for the apartment before her leaves you to yourself.
You can walk to just about everything from this location. We never took public transport.
We ended up booking this place months ahead of our trip and communication was always fast. Antonio reached out just before we were set to arrive with confirmations and to check arrival times. We were early but he was there waiting for us.
I highly recommend the apartment. Every AirBNB experience should be like this.

We had a great stay in this apartment even if it was only for one night. The loft is incredible and situated in a great location (with a supermarket right downstairs) we even were provided a sneaky bottle of wine when we arrived. The team were very helpful and prompt with all our questions. Highly recommend this place!
Great host!!! Very lovely and clean apartement. The location is central and the guys very helpful. Thanks for all.

Excellent place and warm welcome on the part of the host team! The location is as central as it can possibly be with a nice market right next door and vibrant night life of Barrio Alto. The apartment is incredibly stylish and impeccably clean. Communication with Pedro was easy and he was kind enough to arrange for an early check in for us. Luis let us in and explained in detail the way things worked in the apartment as well as advised on places around it. Small treats and a bottle of white wine were a cherry on top of our positive experience. Thank you once again!
Die Lage ist top und die Einrichtung wie vom Innenarchitekt. Wer die Chance hat hier zu wohnen, wird Lissabon geniessen.

Idéal propre on se sent chez sois encore mieux!!
Bravo à la team
Lovely appartement; really clean with à great interior. Antonio explained how everything worked and treated us on oranges and wine. We had a great week in Lisbon!

The loft was exactly as pictured: clean, bright and comfortable. Luis met us upon arrival and gave us a small bottle of Portuguese wine and some great recommendations for nearby restaurants. The place is very centrally located, perfect for exploring the city on foot. We had a great stay!

Persone molto gentili e disponibili .
L'annuncio ha rispettato le aspettative .
Appartamento in centro molto carino e confortevole.
Pedro and bis team were very nice, quick to answer and made all they fan for a really pleasant stay. The flat Is beautiful and very well located.
Great stay and location! Chocolate and bottle of wine included, could not fault anything.
António and Pedro made me feel right at home in their beautiful, centrally located apartment. Just steps from the city center it made for an awesome stay and can't wait to come back!

We absolutely had a great stay!! All the things I've read are true!!
Many thanx to Luis&Pedro

This place was amazing. I stayed here with my parents and they thought it was great too! The apartment was very modern and clean, with everything we needed. We were greeted on our arrival and given a run down of the apartment and how everything worked. We were also kindly left chocolates and a bottle of wine! The location was perfect, with walking distance to a lot we wanted to see and close to the metro and trams. I would definitely recommend this place and would want to stay here again if I get back to Lisbon.

Perfect place to stay in Lisbon! It really couldn't be better located - walking distance to most major attractions, right on the route of tram 28, right next door to a grocery store, and minutes from the Metro. The apartment had absolutely everything we needed, and is very well represented in the photos. It was lovely and bright during the day, and relatively quiet at night. Pedro and his team were exceptionally helpful before and throughout our stay.

Extremely beautiful, trendy apartment in a magic location in a typical, lively area of Lisbon full of cheap, cool restaurants.
Metro is just 4 minutes. It is very easy to reach the apartment from the airport by metro with just 1 ticket .
Almost all the main Lisbon interesting area are walking distance and for all the others you can use the nearby metro or fashinating tram 28.
Pedro and Antonio are so polite and extremely helpful you cannot imagine. Really more than I expected.
The apartment has all you may need and there is a useful supermarket nextdoor open until late evening. Lots of other shops are just around.
I suggest it 100%.

The flat was absolutely beautiful, with gorgeous views of the river. The location was right in the thick of things and close to the lively Bairro Alto district which has some great bars. It was also a short walk from Baixa metro station meaning getting around the city was very simple.
We were also given a little bottle of Portuguese wine which we felt was a really nice touch.
Lovely, clean, bright apartment, close to everything!

Accoglienza molto cordiale , Appartamento molto carino e ben tenuto. le foto rappresentano fedelmente la realtà .
Molto centrale, supermercato alla porta accanto. Tram 28 a due passi,
地理位置特别好 步行可以到很多景点 非常方便 设施齐全 屋内很干净 房主很热情。房间可以看到大海和大耶稣像 我很喜欢 这个区域很安全

Très bon accueil , logement idéalement situé et conforme aux photos.
A conseiller sans hésitation!

It is a very neat loft apartment with clean design and decorated with good quality materials. A supermarket is just right downstairs and the kitchen stuff is well prepared if you ever want to cook. The host was very nice and informative on what to do in the city. The only thing I'd be whining about is the loft is on the 3rd floor and we had 2 pieces of heavy luggage that we had to carry em up all the way. Antonio was kind enough to help us out though

We had a fantastic time at Pedro's apartment. It is in a perfect location within the city, close to an amazing lookout and not far away from some seriously good cake shops! The flat itself is gorgeous and we were made to feel more than welcome by Pedro and Antonio. We had a hard time leaving Lisbon and when we do come back it will hopefully be to this place!

Très bon accueil, chaleureux et efficace.
Le loft tient largement ses promesses.

This was our first AirBnB experience and it was a great one! The apartment was completely as described, in lovely clean condition and we felt very at home. Communication with Pedro and the team was excellent and they were very helpful. We highly recommend!

My fiend and I truly enjoyed our stay in this apartment.
The location is perfect, in a great part of Lisbon, at walking distance of almost everything interesting. There is a supermarket just below.
The apartment is very well equipped (nice bathroom, kitchen with all that you need, good beds) and has a great atmosphere with nice decorations and a big bench.
At arrival we were treated with a bottle of Portuguese white wine, chocolates, Nespresso and fresh oranges to juice for breakfast.
The only remark that I can make is that the apartment has a big oblique roof over its entire length. For tall Dutch ladies as we are that is less convenient. We bumped our heads a few times. Next time we would definitely opt for an apartment of Pedro and
The Chiado Lofts & Studios Team, but we would probably choose one that has a high ceiling.
Thank you Antonio and team, for a great experience!
All the best,
Wendelien
It was an incredible apartment,spacious yet cosy and great view from 2 of the windows. Thanks guys for a great stay.
Useful and warm welcome, wine, oranges and some tips for the city. This cozy nest in Calhariz is exactly as seen in the photos. I'd definitely would come back.
Great deal: perfect location, very well decorated and responsive owners. Highly recommended!

Séjour très agréable chez antonio ( Pèdro absent) Le loft bien que petit est joliment decore, confortable  et bien situé au centre de tout.. Accueil très aimable.  Antonio très serviable à répondu à toutes nos questions de touristes

Perfect!
The apartment is so beautiful and clean! We felt home from the first day on. Furthermore it's really central! The hosts are really well organized and caring. They welcomed us with a bottle of wine, chocolate and fruits and gave us many tips for places to visit, to eat and so on. I can just recommend this place!

The apartment was beyond are expectation. It,s location is stunning.
We were met and advised about everything in the apartment and things to do in local area.
All recomendations were first class.

The place is stunning, very comfortable & beautifully decorated in an area that any visitor should have on their list. Close to everything and with a supermarket, fruit shop & pastry shops basically just downstairs it is a great starting point to reach the main sights of the city. The guys were very helpful, waited for us when our flight was delayed and the communication ran very smoothly. Thanks!

The loft in Lisbon was great! It is in the ideal location to experience Lisbon - almost everything was within walking distance. Check-in was very easy and there was a great list of recommendations for sightseeing, bars, and restaurants. The loft was very clean and comfortable. I highly recommend it!

Pedro was very responsive and greeted us warmly. There were some treats awaiting us upon arrival, which was much appreciated. The apartment was adequate for our purposes. The shower was the best part for us! It is huge and has a rainfall spout. We spent Friday, Saturday and Sunday nights there and must warn that Friday night the street noise was amazingly loud. But, that comes with the great location. It is right in the middle of everything and is very convenient for public transport. The supermarket is right next door, which was very helpful. It was also very clean and bright. Only real negative was that the WIFI was unreliable. The first night it was perfect. When we got back to the loft the second night it was not working and the router is not in the apartment. So, we called Pedro and waited over an hour for it to get working. However, it was in and out and slow for a while after that. The third night it was not working again, but we didn't call Pedro right away. After about a half hour, we texted him. However, we didn't want to wait. We just told him we'd need it in the morning before we left and went to bed. The next morning it worked, but only a short time. That was probably more details than were needed. But, I wanted to be honest about the unreliability and the fact that Pedro did try to resolve it for us. He was a great host. Thanks, Pedro for the hospitality, oranges, wine and chocolates!

Спасибо , за чудесный отдых ! Мы получили точно то , что хотели ! Просто идеальное расположение , чистая квартира , удивительная атмосфера ! Я декоратор и очень ценю со вкусом оформленные апартаменты ! Точный и радушный прием ! Отдельное спасибо , за возможность позднего выезда . Очень хорошее спальное место : матрасы ,подушки . Спалось замечательно ! Не очень хороший интернет , но может быть это временные трудности ))
Fabulous apt in a great location, had a great stay thanks

A really nice place, clean and tidy and it has much space for you to enjoy yourself. Also the position is really great, it is convenient to go anywhere. The host is responsible and enthusiastic! Nice!!
Goede locatie

Atención perfecta . Perfecto por parte del anfitrión. El apartamento era super acogedor y está localizado en pleno centro. Apoco que sales por la puerta del conoces Lisboa. El apartamento está  muy bien decorado y Tiene muchos detalles. Nos ha encantado.  Anfitrión muy cercano y en contacto permanente.

Rien à redire sur l'accueil qui était parfait. Pedro et son équipe etaient d'une grande disponibilité.
L'appartement est exactement comme sur les photos, très cosy, agreable et tres tres bien situé.
Super ! Appartement, Service, Quartier

Pedro was a great host and his loft was the perfect spot to stay at while visiting Lisbon! The bed was super comfy and the bathroom was spacious. Walking distance to all great spots in Lisbon! Definitely recommend and hope to visit again.

We had a wonderful two weeks in Chiado Loft 3. Pedro is very professional and attentive. He welcomed us and provided helpful information. Knowing that we were staying for two weeks he offered to have someone come in after the first week to freshen up the loft (much appreciated.)
The apartment is very well-located for exploring all the central areas of Lisbon (Chiado, Bairro Alto, Baixa, etc.) Walk out the door and you're in the thick of things.
The space is light-filled and--as the photos show--very stylish. The bed is comfortable and the bathroom is perfect. The air-conditioning/ heating is extremely efficient and easy to use. There are so many great and affordable restaurants that we didn't make much use of the kitchen, but it is adequately equipped.
One word of warning: As the photos show, the ceiling slopes down steeply, which reduces the amount of useable space. If you are tall--or even tallish--there is really just a few metres of navigable space connecting kitchen area to bedroom.
En un mot : SUPER !

Séjour agréable dans un quartier bien situé, à 3 min du métro.
Le loft est joliment décoré, quelques denrées pour le petit déjeuner à dispo et une petite bouteille de blanc vous attend au frais.
Très bon accueil de Pedro. Ponctualité et gentillesse.

We were welcomed by Luis who waited patiently as our plane was delayed and then landed twice in Lisbon as the first landing was aborted due to high winds. We then traipsed through on the metro which was fine but taxis are reasonable in Portugal so that was a mistake.

The apartment was as described and lovely. It was well equipped and Luis explained how everything worked. We appreciated the complmentary wine, chocolate and oranges.

Pedro welcomed us to the city right on time, as we had just gotten back from traveling from the US. He was very helpful in providing information for things to do in and around the city. The apartment's location was also really great if you enjoy being in the heart of the nightlife, which we did! It was well-designed with nice furniture and a great view of the city.

Really enjoyed our first ever AirBnB stay at Pedro's. Communication before and during the stay was easy, and we got all the info we needed from Pedro's friend who checked us in. It poured one day and another friend came by to make sure our roof wasn't leaking. The apt is situated in a very central and lively location. So convenient, cozy and comfortable. Would definitely recommend!

The neighborhood was great. Very active, very fun, and centrally located. The loft was beautifully decorated and the bed was comfortable. The shower is roomy, water pressure and temperature control were excellent. Pedro was not able to be there, but he sent someone to meet us who was on time, friendly, and gave us a quick orientation. And there was a small bottle of white wine in the frig, which we appreciated.
One cautionary comment -- tall people would probably find the sloping ceiling to be a concern.
A gorgeous airy loft with everything you need - lovely and comfortable in an amazingly central location.

L'appartement est très agréable, très lumineux, la décoration est soignée, il est idéalement situé dans Lisbonne. L'accueil est très sympathique et une liste de restaurants et lieux de soirées est préparée.

Just like all the other reviews - this is a great place in a very central location. We really enjoyed our time here and Antonio was really helpful. The team had left us some chocolates and oranges for juicing. The only thing to bare in mind is this is a loft so standing room is tight in certain parts but you get used to it. Would happily stay here again!

Die Wohnung ist genau so perfekt, wie es die Bilder und die Beschreibung versprechen! Alles super sauber, toll ausgestattet, wunderschöne Möbel und tolle Küche mit super Geräten. Aus den Fenstern kann man morgens den Tejo sehen und abends steht man mitten im Leben und findet alles was das Herz begehrt, super Kneipen und Restaurants.
Check in und out waren wirklich unkompliziert und wir wurden sehr nett empfangen. Würden die Wohnung zu 100% weiterempfehlen.

We had a lovely stay at the chiado loft! Luis was there to welcome us and gave us the keys. The team is organized, very friendly and the apartment was very nice and clean! The location is great, central, near the metro station of baixa-chiado and near the shopping area. There is also a small supermarket right next to the apartment. We would defintely recommend this cosy loft for a stay in lisboa!

This was our second time staying at the Chiado Lofts & yet again, I wouldn't consider staying anywhere else! The apartment was beautiful, clean, carefully decorated & went above and beyond with everything that we needed during our stay. The recommendations left of places to go was very helpful & having coffee and local specialties in the space made us feel very welcome. The location can't be beat!! Already looking forward to coming back for our third stay!

Great location... Couldn't have asked for any better. Comfortable accommodations with modern appliances. Definitely a great option for those who want to be right the middle of the action. Walking distance from many restaurants, bars, and public transportation. Attentive hosts who thought of everything. Thank you for making our trip memorable!!

Friendly welcome by one of Pedro's team.  This small apartment is in an amazing location and is so close to many things. The apartment itself was fantastic with supermarket downstairs. Would defiantly recommend this place and would choose here to stay again.

Mi experiencia en el Loft Chiado fue maravillosa, un lugar maravilloso, nos dieron la bienvenida con una nota con bombones, una botella de vino al frío, el Loft es mucho mas bonito que en las fotos y el lugar en pleno centro, nos dejaron un plano y los mejores lugares para visitar, si vuelvo a Lisboa volveré a alojarme sin dura allí o en cualquiera de sus apartamentos lo recomiento al 100%.
Super studio au centre du quartier du Chiado : un endroit stratégique pour un court séjour  à Lisbonne. Tout l'équipement  est parfait pour 2/3 personnes.

Easy check-in, perfect location (Chiado at 5mn walk of Barrio Alto) , nice, clean & modern flat. Only 2 things to know about... 1. Due to the way the flat is designed, it is impossible to get complete darkness and 2. Sometimes a not so good smell comes out the sinks... But anyway, we really enjoyed staying here and we recommend that place! Many thanks

Un bianco, sofisticato ed accogliente loft in posizione comodissima per visitare la città.
Pulito, con asciugamani e lenzuola profumate e completo di ogni necessità (lavatrice/asciugatrice, lavastoviglie, phon, ferro ed asse da stiro..).
Pedro è stato attento ed ospitale, ci ha fatto trovare tutta una serie di "coccole" che hanno contribuito a rendere il loft ancor più accogliente!
Lo consiglio assolutamente!!

We loved staying at this apartment! It had everything we could want, was cool, comfortable and stylish. Location is great, surrounded by awesome bars, cafes and restaurants! Easy to get around Lisbon from here. Contact was so fast, friendly and efficient, we were welcomed and given a bottle of wine! Would highly recommend staying here!
Perfect place in lisboa! Obrigado Pedro!
He was a wonderful guest, met after when we arrived, showed us around. He left us plenty of recommendations for what to do and where to eat. The apartment was perfect. We had a wonderful weekend!

We loved our stay at Pedro and António's flat. They were very welcoming and the flat is comfortable and well located, at the best spot in Lisbon! We would strongly recommend their flat and the city to anyone and hope to be back soon!

Our stay in the Chiado Loft 3 was perfect ! You cannot get a better location than this ! The apartment is a short walking distance from the Baixa-Chiado metro station and from the Rossio train station (trains to go visit beautiful Sintra). The tram 28 that brings you to the Alfama passes right in front of the door.
You are surrounded by cafés, bakeries and restaurants ! There is also a small supermarket downstairs from the apartment. One of the best places we ate at was at Casa da India. Amazing grilled food, typical and cheap, only a 2 minutes walk from the apartment. Go early, there is always a waiting line outside. And then go grab some pastel de nata at Manteigaria for desert, a 3 minutes walk from the apartment.
The apartment is beautifully decorated, exactly like in the photos. It is clean and comfortable ... The bed was so comfortable that it made it difficult to get out of it in the morning ! The air conditioning is a great plus in the hot summer months.
Thank you for everything ! If we where to come back to Lisbon, we would gladly stay here again ;-)

Very good welcome. Antonio and Luigi were welcoming us and they were very friendly and helpful showing us around the loft.
We received chocolates, fresh oranges and even a bottle of wine :)

Overall experience was very good. Close to the city centre, right next to a supermarket (literally next door), a fruit store, a bakery... Very comfortable couch and bed. The kitchen was basic, but had everything you needed. The air conditioning was heavenly in the summer.

Excellent location in a very lively neighbourhood and with easy reach to pretty much everything we wanted to see and visit. The list of restaurants and bars provided by Pedro's team was precious to spot the right places to go.

Wonderful space with an excellent location. Bright, clean and fun loft in a happening neighborhood. Surprisingly quiet given all the activity.

Team was very welcoming and accommodating, even after some last minute flight disruptions.
Nice appartment with great location! The hosts were very helpful and available when we had questions.
Our first time to Lisbon and the flat was exactly as you see in the pictures. Fantastic spot in a great location - Barrio Alto. Couldn't recommend it any higher and would book again.
A wonderful place. Clean, perfect location, great hosts. What are you waiting for? This is not the place to hesitate on. Book now.
Nice personal touches! chocolates to make us feel welcome, oranges available for a nice fresh juice in the morning

L'appartement est idéalement situé pour visiter la ville. Les commerces se trouvent au pied de l'immeuble. Le tram 28 passe juste devant l'immeuble. Séjour parfait !
Pedro nous a très bien accueilli et nous a conseillé de nombreux restaurants. Nous conseillons vivement cet appartement plein de charme.
Très belle décoration, très bon accueil, emplacement parfait avec un mini supermarché à la porte et la ville à nos pieds. Allez y sans hésiter!

Beautiful and fantastic flat! Just as pictured and very clean. Pedro and his team were wonderful in communication, and even accommodated our very late check-in. Amazing location as well. Would definitely stay here again!

We really enjoyed staying in this flat! It's clean and looks just like the photos! The neighborhood is a fun one and great to walk around :) some of the best pastel are right down the street at a shop called Manteigaria (wayyyy better than the ones in Belem). Thanks for the great visit to Lisbon!!!

Top !
Super emplacement, très bon accueil

Appartamento situato nel cuore della città, in posizione strategica per la visita, davvero molto bello, curato nel dettaglio così come l'accoglenza dell'host. Il quartiere è particolarmente suggestivo. Andateci!

Very clean and well decorated. Modern and cozy. Nice comfortable bed. All made our stay a very pleasant experience.
Check in and out...easy and pleasant.

Pedro and Antonio are excellent hosts and their loft is just wonderful. It is large, comfortable, tastefully decorated and has everything you could need. The bed is fantastic and we slept soundly after our daily adventures. Right by Bairro Alto, you are close to everything and there is even parking nearby (within a 5 min walk), which was very convenient. I can't imagine staying anywhere else in Lisboa!

Nous avons passé un merveilleux séjour dans l'appartement de Pedro. L'emplacement est idéal pour découvrir la ville et l'appartement très agréable et ensoleillé. Pedro nous a accueilli très chaleureusement et nous recommandons vivement son logement pour visiter Lisbonne !
Great space, convenient location, attentive host!

We spent three perfect nights at Pedro's appartement. The interieur is very delightful and in very good condition! The bed was really relaxing so that it doesn't matter when you have some rainy moments during the day. It was quiet although you are in the center of gravity of Lisboa! Nightlife is just footsteps away, also the famous cafés & restaurants! Also the tram 28 is just outside the door! We really enjoyed our stay and couldn't find a place which would be better to start to discover Lisboa! Many thanks to Pedro and his team!

We loved our Chiado Loft. Bright and comfortable and such a great location. The comfiest bed, super shower and everything we needed. I  loved walking out into the bustling street and the loft was amazingly peaceful. I recommend this place for a great stay in wonderful Lisbon

This was the perfect accommodation for our stay in Lisbon. Antonio was very helpful and communicative.
The loft is in a perfect location to explore Lisbon and is the perfect size for 2 people, any more would be a little cosy.
The loft is immaculate and perfectly decorated.
Perfect stay and perfect hosts.l

Très bon accueil! séjour parfait, rien à redire sur la prestation.
Nous conseillons cet appartement, situation idéale.
Notre prochain séjour se fera chez Pedro.

Super lovely Apartment in the Center of lisbon, we had a really nice Stay and enyoed our time in the Apartment. We were warmly welcomed by Antonio and the loft looks exactly like on the pictures. Perfect place to stay!!!
Very nice place..great place to be for a vacation...
Nossa experiencia foi otima. Muito bem atendidos, o apartamento é muito bem localizado. Recomendo.

It was a great pleasure to stay at Chiado Loft. It is a beautiful loft and very well styled.
The location is also perfect, just near the oldest tramline of Lisbon.

We were recommended to eat at Mercado da Ribiera just near the sea. It was really great! So when you are in Lisbon, go there too!

This was easily one of the best airbnb experiences i've had. The flat is beautiful and pedro accommodated us in every way to see that our needs and expectations were met. i highly recommend this for any couple or close friends looking to enjoy lisbon. it was like luxurious privacy with help right at your fingertips if you needed anything. great style and great location. i hope to revisit soon!
Excelent apartement, i highly recommend this Place! Thank you!

This apartment is amazing!

Antonio was there to great us when we arrived, and told us everything we needed to make our stay stress free. There was a useful guide to local cafes/bars/restaurants which, when combined with Google Maps and Trip Advisor meant that we were very knowledgeable about the local area.

The apartment is beautiful and really uniquely decorated. The double bed was large and comfortable for two people. The roof is low so you need to duck your head occasionally but this isn't a problem! The bathroom was amazing, all marble with a huge walk in shower with a waterfall shower head.

The local area is brilliant, it's right in the centre of the Chiado / Bairro Alto area. Loads of great cafes/bars/restaurants on your doorstep. A short walk to Cais de Sodre as well. Only 12-15 Euros in a taxi from the airport.

All in all I couldn't recommend this apartment enough.

Thanks Antonio & Pedro!
Great location and a very nice apartment! many thx

I absolutely loved this apartment! The décor is beautiful and cozy, and the apartment is stocked with all of the necessities. A great, lively neighborhood, down the street from the best nata place we found in Lisbon!

The hosts were very accommodating. I accidentally left my coat behind, and when they were unable to locate it and return it to me, they offered to pay for a the new one I had to buy before returning to the brutal NYC cold.

I highly recommend this place!
We had a great time in Lisbon! Super nice apartment, Very central, clean and best host ever!!

The loft was absolutely perfect for our short weekend break in Lisbon. Antonio was helpful before the trip telling us the best way to get from the airport to the apartment and was there waiting for us when we arrived. The loft itself is exactly as it looks in the pictures which is amazing plus there were lots of nice extras like a coffee machine, an orange juicer and oranges! The location is perfect overlooking the funicular and close to bars and restaurants. There was also a great list of recommendations in the apartment on place to visit to eat and drink including a must visit O Prego da Peixaria!
Overall, a great place and highly recommended

Muito boa estadia em Lisboa.
Pedro e Antonio são anfitriões muito atenciosos e prestativos. O apartamento é idêntico as fotos e o conforto é garantido. Excelente localização!

Un accueil très chaleureux et de précieuses indications données pour se sentir au mieux dans un appartement propre, fonctionnel, design, et très bien situé.
Nombre de documents sont présents pour organiser au mieux notre voyage; un appartement très chaleureux ou l'on sent d'entrée à l'aise avec une vue possible sur la mer à partir des larges fenêtres donnant sur la ruelle du funiculaire.
Les commerces au pied de l'immeuble sont nombreux, la vie nocturne présente et agréable, les restaurants de qualité et la proximité du centre ville, même à pied, un facteur plus qu'intéressant.
En résumé un très agréable séjour facilité par l'emplacement et la qualité de l'appartement mis à notre disposition.

Kommunikasjonen med Pedro var hyggelig og tydelig. Samboeren min og jeg fikk en varm velkomst av António i leiligheten, og alt av instrukser og informasjon vi trengte om Lisboa. Leiligheten var like fin som på bildene, og vi følte oss hjemme der. Stille og sentralt var dette en perfekt base å utforske Lisboa på. Vi har ingenting negativt å si. Takk for upåklagelig service, Pedro og António!
Cool apartment, with really nice decor. Lots of light & great location.. Worth a visit for sure!

Juste parfait ! Conforme à nos attentes. L'appartement est idéalement situé et équipé pour profiter pleinement du séjour dans cette superbe ville.
Commerces & Tramway #28 au pied de l'appartement. On va partout avec le pass 24 ou 48h 7 collines. Accueil tardif vers 23h40 suite vol du soir sans problème. Super séjour à refaire chez Perdo.
El lugar muy está muy bien situado. El apartamento es muy bonito y limpio, tiene de todo lo necesario. Volvería a repetir!

Fantastic apartment is an excellent location. The apartment was spotless and presented exactly like the photographs. Well decorated and very comfortable. Perfect location for a city break. 5 mins walk to the centre of the city and two minutes walk to the bairo alto. No noise problems as its located a couple of streets away from the bairo alto. I'd have no problem recommending the apartment to friends and family. Overall we had an excellent experience here. Pedro and antonio were very responsive and helpful. Top marks!

Finding the place was easy, it is very well located! The host welcomed us at the door just in time and showed us around the flat, explained some details about how to use it and some special features about it! There is a list of recommended places and restaurants to go around the neighbourhood and we even had courtesy oranges, chocolates and nespresso coffee for our stay in the loft.. we loved it and would definitely recommend it to anyone (although.. very very tall people should maybe consider twice as the roof comes a bit too low;)

We had a great New Year's Eve enjoying this very nice apartment. As you can see in the pictures, the apartments is clean and really well decorated. The host left us for the New Year's Eve one Champagne bottle and dried grapes at the table, what really surprised us! Although the tram drives just down the street, the apartment is really good isolated. We would definitely come back there when coming back to Lisbon.

Such an exelent trip. The appartment was so well ubicated, decorated, and clean. The renders solved us any problem or doubt. If we return to Lisbon, we will repeat without doubt. I really recomend it.
Ótimo apartamento, todo equipado. Localização excelente. Nossos anfitriōes foram muito carinhosos assim como todo povo português. Voltaremos! ❤️lisboa❤️

Amazing apartment in the very center of Lisbon. The photos don't lie, the apartment is very well decorated, and well equipped.  One detail that has it's importance: we stayed there in winter, and the temperature within the apartment was ideal... I recommend the place for anybody who plans to stay in Lisbon for a few days, alone or accompanied.

Antonio welcomed us at the apartment and explained us the important things about it. The apartment is very clean, nicely done up and the neighborhood is amazing. It' s centrally located, so you're in a few minutes in Lisbon downtown. The next Metro Station is only about 3 minutes away. I'd definitely recommend their place to anyone and we will for sure be checking in again if we'll be in Lisbon.
Antonio also organized us a taxi to the airport very early the morning. The communication was very uncomplicated, friendly and fast. 5 Stars for the apartment and the Hosts.

This is the perfect place to stay in Lisboa! A beautiful, cozy, well-equipped loft and incredibly central – there is so much happening all around the Chiado neighborhood, all within walking distance. Upon our arrival there were amazing touches everywhere, from the complimentary chocolates, coffee, tea and sweet ripe oranges, and Pedro and Antonio were very swift and prompt to answer any of our queries. Would come back again and again!

Our stay at the Chiado Loft by Pedro Magalhaes was like a dream! The apartment is beautiful, is located in the Chiado City Centre, has a beautiful view on the Tagus River and even on Cristo Rei and if I could I would never leave! The apartment has everything you would look for in the 'perfect place to stay': free Wi-Fi, a comfortable bed, a kitchen with all the pots and pans you could possible need, a ginormous shower, a hairdryer and even a washing machine. Tram 28, one of the main attractions Lisbon has to offer, stops right in front of the apartment, the metro-station Baxia Chiado is only 5 minutes away and there is a supermarket and there are several nice restaurants and cafés (with an overload of Pasteis de Nata) next door. What more could you wish for?

We fell in love with Lisboa (beautiful city, put it on your travel/bucket list right away!) and this place! Thank you for the lovely stay and until next time!
Très bel appartement, situé en plein cœur de la vieille ville. la décoration très design est rafraîchissante, bien équipée, chaleureux. Appartement à conseiller sans hésiter. Bon accueil.

Geweldige plek met goed ontvangst van Pedro. Hij had de tijd genomen om er wat extra's van te maken, zo lagen er sinaasappels en koffie klaar voor het ontbijt. Goede locatie, tram 28 stopt voor de deur! Fijne regendouche en mooie keuken.

My husband and I just left a great stay at the loft! Pedro was really responsive, waited for us to arrive despite a flight delay and even allowed us to check out late because there were no incoming guests.
The loft was a perfect spot to explore Lisbon. Right in the heart of the baixa chiado district with great shopping, dining and nightlife. When needing to rest or take a break the loft is really well appointed. Comfortable couches and a very comfy bed. We arrived to fresh oranges and a well stocked kitchen.
Would stay again and recommend to anyone. Thanks for a great stay, Pedro!

The pictures are very accurate! The apartment is gorgeous and was perfect for our weekend in Lisbon. Amazing location in the city and Pedro/Antonio gave us VERY helpful information about travel and entertainment in the city. If I go back, I would definitely stay here again!

Das perfekte Apartement zum Erkunden Lissabons. Super Lage mitten im pulsierenden Zentrum der Stadt.  Einziger Minuspunkt: die zentrale Lage bringt es auch mit sich, dass es in der Nacht ziemlich laut werden kann.

We arrived 35 minutes late, hot and a little tired and were greeted with the lovely Antonio. He was very kind, gave us great guidance to places to see. Top tip was a cold glass of wine in the Hotel Barra Alto, lovely terrace, beautiful views and a fantastic way to stay our hoildays.

The apartmetn is well stocked with all you coudl need. he location is fantastic location. All in all very good. Word of warning - if you are tall mind the ceiling!

Ann
very nice apartment!! would recommend to friends without hesitation. best suited for couples.
Location is superb and the place is exactly as it looks in the photos

Die Stadt und das Loft sind wirklich empfehlenswert!
Ein optimaler Ausgangspunkt um Stadt und Leute kennenzulernen.
