Die Wohnung ist sauber, sehr modern und gemütlich.
Pedro und Antonio waren sehr zu vorkommende Hosts.
Wir haben es sehr genossen!!

I really enjoyed to stay in Pedro's place,nice area with all facilities
good restaurants,cafes,grocery shopping ,shoppings

Die Wohnung war ein absoluter Traum und sieht auch genauso aus wie auf den Bildern. Eine noch zentralere Lage hätten wir gar nicht haben können und auch der Supermarkt unten im Haus, kam uns sehr gelegen. Wir haben uns vom ersten moment an sehr wohl gefühlt. Die Einrichtung ist mehr als geschmackvoll und perfekt ausgestattet. Wir wurden mit einem hangeschriebenen Zettel willkommen geheißen, was ich persönlich sehr chamant fand. Auch sonst hat alles einwandfrei geklappt.  Lissabon hat mich nicht zum letzten mal gesehen und dann werde ich auch wieder diese Wohnung mieten.

This loft is really cozy and the location is great - 28 tram and bica funicular just below the windows. Metro is close by (it didn't help us thou when we were heading to the airport and it was closed due to the strike - we are lucky))).
The bed is super comfortable! There is everything you need.
Un sitio maravilloso con un encanto muy especial, en una ubicación inmejorable

L'appartement est vraiment très bien, très bien situé et l'hôte était très accueillant et arrangeant !!

Je le recommande très vivement!

Getting to this apartment is very easy from the Airport - the location is great altogether! Next door is a supermarket and a few doors down, you have access to some of the nice cafes which sell some really nice sweets (consumption of custard tarts is a must - as many as possible). Everything else from restaurants, shops, post office, sites and anyhting else is within walking distance!
The apartment is very clean throughout and well decorated. I would definitely recommend this to anyone as this loft is very cosy with a great location. The metro lines are also very easy to follow!
The Apartment is just perfect! I would defenetly recommend it.

Very welcoming host, everything in the appartment was as described and the tips given were great. Street a bit noisy during wk even if the isolation is good. Overall, a great experience and I recommend this place.

Very nice appartment in the center of the city, with the baixa chiado subway station at 3 min by walk, a supermarket dowstair, all the things you need in the appartment, we were with our little kid 2 yo and it was perfect, a bed for baby and a high chair. Antonio was very nice and very professional.
The only problem we had was concerning the key of the door giving to the street that didn't fonctionnate but we just have to force a little bit the door without using the key and it opened : we mentioned this matter to Pedro. Otherwise I higly recommand this place. It's like a 4 stars hotel suite at a price of a 2 stars hotel in paris!! A very best value for that price.

Tres joli appartement tres bien situé a 2 pas de la station baixa chiado, et du tram . Rue annimée, avec beaucoup de restaurants, et un supermarché tres pratique en bas de l'immeuble. Tous les appareils electroménager sont présents, le loft donne une sensation d'espace tres agréable, c'est un plaisir d'y retourner apres une longue journée de visite. Peut parfaitement convenir a une famille avec 1 enfant en bas age (notre cas). Pedro réponds a tous les mails et Antonio nous a parfaitement bien accueilli.
Le seul probleme est que la clé de la porte donnant sur la rue ne marchait pas mais il suffit de forcer un peu la porte et ça s'ouvre .
Je recommande 100% cet appartment. Tres bon rapport qualité prix

A friend and I stayed one night at the Chiado Loft 3 and the experience was very pleasant. The apartment is extremely well located and it is exactly what you can expect from the pictures and profile description.
If you're new to Lisbon, refer to the suggestions the Chiado Lofts team left on the table concerning places to see, eat and go out as they are very helpful.

Just one thing: Due to cleaning schedule and heavy booking, there was not much flexibility concerning check out time for us and the hosts don't offer the possibility to keep your luggage for the checkout day. In case you need to keep your luggage safe so you can walk around lightly in your last day as we did, there's a locker service at the Rossio train station, not far from the apartment.
Enjoy your stay!

Charming, comfortable, clean and excellently located apartment right between Chiado and the Bairro Alto with the tram 28 stopping right outside and right next to a supermarket. The area is surrounded with sights, restaurants, bars and shops – everything in walking distance. Even so it is quiet at night. Bus, tram and stations are all close to the loft. The apartment is exactly as shown on the site - beautifully decorated and well-equipped with a fantastic view. We were four family members visiting Lisbon and all of us loved it.
Pedro and António are great and very helpful hosts: easy and prompt communication per mail, António was waiting for us on the hour of arrival, they even left us sweets and a hand-written message as a welcome gift. António showed us how everything in the flat works and gave us a list of recommended things to do, restaurants and places to see. They really made us feel welcome. We had a wonderful time in Lisbon and can highly recommend this accommodation!

There is only one thing you really need to know: You need to stay at this property! Pedro's property made us feel at home and is perfectly situated in Lisbon. Everything we needed was within walking distance for us, or in some cases a short cab ride away. The area is surrounded with sights and restaurants, perfect for any couple that is looking for a romantic getaway!
Pedro was a wonderful host, giving us everything we needed to get started and feel safe. When there was a minor problem with the washing machine, he had it fixed the next day...
Hurry up and rent this property, before we decide to come back and beat you to it!!

My partner and I stayed in two of Pedro's apartments on separate occasions - Pedro was very helpful prior to our stay, answering all my questions really promptly and thoroughly. Antonio met us at both apartments and was very professional and understanding about us being delayed in arriving. The apartments were spotless, very beautiful and elegant and well-equipped.. we especially appreciated the little details like chocolates and a hand-written message, fresh fruit, and even a bottle of wine in our second apartment (very sadly we didn't have time to savor it as we were rushing out to make the most of our day in the city). Very comfortable beds, tons of space for extra people even though we were only 2. Perfect location in the heart of Chiado with the tram #28 stopping right outside and right next to a supermarket. we especially loved the pasteis de nata shop a few doors down on the same street (: we wouldn't hesitate recommending pedro's apartments to our friends. thanks guys! (:

Our stay in Pedro's apartament was great!The loft is very nice,nicely decorated,clean and has everything you need.It pretty much felt like home :) Also,the location couldn't be better. Everything was just great thanks to our hosts Pedro and Antonio. We really had a great time in Lisbon.

Nous avons été très contents de cet appartement : bien situé, décoré avec goût, bien agencé : on s'y sent bien.
Accueil agréable de Pedro et Antonio.
Je recommande sans hésiter ce super loft !

Квартира очень понравилась. Светлая, просторная, оформлена в современном стиле. На кухне вся необходимая техника и посуда. Ключи от квартиры нам передали даже раньше времени check in (мы договаривались). Иногда возникали проблемы с интернетом.
Дом удобно расположен: перед ним проходит знаменитый 28 маршрут трамвая, рядом – старый трамвайчик-фуникулер (ELEVADOR DA BICA?), который везет в сторону порта, к вокзалу Cais do Sodre. Площадь Коммерции (Placa do Comercio) и Лифт Санта Хуста (Elevador de Santa Justa) в пешей доступности (15 мин). В 10 минутах ходьбы от дома расположен знаменитый Mercado da Ribeira где можно не только купить свежие продукты домой, но и вкусно поесть, т.к. в нем находится крупный фуд-корт, состоящий из популярных кафе и ресторанов Лиссабона.
Спасибо за гостеприимство. Советую!

Upon arrival to Lisbon, we were met by Pedro's brother. He was friendly and helpful in providing direction as to how everything in the flat works and what the main attractions in Lisbon are (recorded on a handy waterproof document).

The flat itself is exactly how it appears in pictures - very nicely decorated and cozy. The only somewhat annoying part of the setup is that the angle of the roof cuts out about 25% of the useable floor space of the flat and that was not obvious to us when we booked. That said, there were 3 of us and we got on very comfortably. The flat has a perfect location in walking distance of everything and this was our primary concern. It is also located above a grocery store which is awesome if you want to run down and grab anything for meals. Overall, I would definitely recommend!

Our experience at Pedro's flat was fantastic! Excellent location and fantastic flat. Loved what he has done to the place, excellent taste!

We are definitely coming back to Lissabon, and we are certanly renting one of Pedro's flats again!

Pedro and Antonio were very welcoming the apartment was better than the photos could show, located in the best part in town we enjoyed our stay immensely and also the little touches that made it feel like home! I would recommend it to anyone and definitely go back
Fantastic loft in perfect location. Pedro was the ideal host, quick to respond and gave useful advice about some hidden gem restaurants and night clubs. We will definitely be back!

We loved our stay in the Chaido Loft. It's small but beautifully formed, and had lots of little perks that made it really special: an iPhone speaker, fluffy towels, a welcome bottle of wine, chocolates (I could go on).

The place itself is in a perfect location - a beautiful old funicular tram about 3 seconds away, a mini supermarket next door, and the vibrant nightlife literally on its doorstep. It's so beautifully decorated that it was hard to tear ourselves away sometimes!

Highly recommend popping down the street to the Bairro Alto hotel and seeing the view from their terrace & heading down the street with the funicular on, where there are loads of lovely bars. Also there is a Time Out sponsored food hall 5 mins walk away with loads of brilliant Portuguese food on offer.

We'll definitely be back. Thanks Pedro!

Un super appartement que je recommande, très bien aménagé et très propre. Très bon accueil d'Antonio. L'emplacement est parfait pour profiter du Bairro Alto avec ses restaurants et bars, adapté aux personnes aimant faire la fête. Les transports sont à proximité et le petit supermarché au pied de l'appartement est très appréciable.
Nous sommes venus au moment de la saint Antoine, la rue sur laquelle donne l'appartement était très animée, parfait pour profiter des festivités mais un peu bruyant au moment du couché.
Un seul petit défaut : le manque de volets aux fenêtres. Mais ce défaut se fait vite pardonner !

We enjoyed our stay in Loft 3 very much, thank you, Antonio & Pedro & the team! Everything looks exactly as on the pictures, everything provided works perfectly, and all communication with the hosts was efficient and friendly.
There is a lot of space, not all of that for tall people. We were two people, but even three individuals would sleep here perfectly.
We would definitely come back!
Very nice and clean. Good situated. Everything perfect!

We had a fantastic stay at Pedro's Loft.  The apartment is as nice or even nicer than the pictures...everything is very neat, clean and decorated with lovely detail. The location is just perfect as it is right next to the good restaurants and bars and sightseeing in the city is even possible in walking distance.  At the same time it is quiet at night and you can sleep with the window open or even turn on the AC if required.  We were welcomed very friendly and would definitely recommend this place.  If we come back we will stay here again. Thank you!
Apartment is in a great location. Antonio was very helpful. Would love to stay here again on my next trip to Lisboa. Highly recommended!

We arrived pretty much on time and Antonio was waiting for us as planned.  We were greeted warmly and given a quick synopsis of best practices for the apartment.  Within minutes we were on our own to explore.  And Explore we did.  Chiado Lofts was the perfect location to start our journey.  Chiado/Bairro Alto area quaint and charming and overflowing with character.  The sidewalks, hills, trams, lifts and small cafes welcomed us with open arms.  And the rest is history.  We fell in love with the area and Lisbon on the whole.

Chiado Loft 3! A super cool place and could not be @ a better location! Good taste, modern and yet cosy, with a personal touch that gives a sort of "home" feeling! Selina and I were rcvd by Antônio, very kind and knowledgeable of Lisbon's life, to all tastes and ages!
I would recommend this place to anybody I know!
Thank u Antônio and Pedro for having and sharing such a nice place!
Inez and Selina
Clean and design. Nice place. Professional and flexible management.
The apartment is amazing, comftortable, practicle and perfectly located. Pedro is a great owner, nice, efficient and reactive. Thanks a lot !!!

The apartment was fantastic (as good as the pictures) and located in the heart of Chiado/Bairo Alto. The perfect place to rest our weary legs after a day exploring Lisbon. Pedro was very helpful leading and quick to respond leading up to our visit and made sure our arrival was smooth, with lots of handy tips and recommendations about the area. Ideal apartment if your thinking of visiting Lisbon, I will be telling my friends to stay here.

Perfect. A great location! Right in the heart of Chiado, with a small grocery store literally next door. A baker, butcher...and nearby lots of restaurants and bars to enjoy. Really, can't exaggerate how great this location is - the 28 tram goes right past!

The loft is exactly as pictured. The extra single bed in the other corner was very good quality. The long chair can actually fit for a child ~6 yrs of age. The sofa is looooong and comfortable. TV works like a TV.

We used the washing machine/dryer. Takes a while to run a full cycle, but was a great use! Small fridge, but small apartment, and bakery, butcher, and market right next to house.

We used Pedro at Lisbon Taxis - info at lisbontaxis dot com dot pt when we wanted to visit Sintra and other spots - and he really made the trip fantastic.

A great find. At a fantastic price. And Pedro (property manager) was great too.

Thanks for a great experience.
Superbe séjour! L'appartement est très bien situé, parfaitement équipé et a beaucoup de charme. Accueil très agréable d'Antonio.
Very comfortable apartment. Excellent location, very close to the bars and restaurants in Bairro Alto.

We were very happy with the apartment that was as cosy as the pictures promised. The location was just next to Elevador da Bica, with many cute little bars. The reception of Pedro with even some little welcome gifts was great.

Perfection! My friend and I stayed here for 2 nights. We had just finished a two week trip in Marrakech and Essaouira so Lisbon was a much welcomed change of scenery (and calmness)  Pedro greeted us upon arrival and walked us through everything. He was super helpful and responsive all throughout. I highly recommend this place to anyone spending some time in Lisbon. It was centrally located and super convenient. I definitely would stay here again during my next stay in Lisbon! Thank you for everything! :)

Pedro was a great host and we loved his flat. It's in a great location, 5 mins away from Bairro Alto which is a really fun place to go for drinks at night, and under 10 mins from the nearest tube. Also next door to a supermarket. I recommend getting lost in the area and seeing what you find.

красивая и удобная квартира, отличное расположение!
периодически лагал интернет, что порой было очень не кстати.
общее впечатление - прекрасно!! всем советую!

Excellent accueil de Pedro et de son ami. Ils ont été également de très bons conseils pour ce petit week end. Lisbonne est une très jolie Capitale.
Toute la décoration est choisi avec goût, un vrai nid douillet où il fait bon vivre.
Je le recommande sans hésitation, nous y retournerons très bientôt.
Our second time in Pedro's & Antonio's loft, it was great like the first time! Everything was perfect, we'll be back!

Pedro's place is just perfect and we loved it. Not only it's beautiful and you have everything you need, but it's also in the center of Lisbon. Thanks a lot Pedro for hosting us...We really hope we can come back soon :)

The loft is great situaded and really cosy. It felt like being at home in Lisboa. Pedro welcomed us friendly and had little attentions arranged in the flat. We enjoyed our stay and can warmly recommend this beautiful loft!

This was our first airbnb gamble and we were more than happy with what we paid for. The loft itself was fantastically situated- metro, minipreco, bars, restaurants. The place was clean and complete with the necessary amenities for a few days stay. Antonio was helpful when we arrived in the loft, answering our questions as it was our first time in Lisbon. Overall, me and my husband had a fantastic time in Lisbon, and if given the chance i would very much stay here again.

Pedro & his team are very obliging and kind.
Whenever we had a question about anything, they helped us immediately. For instance, i asked for some recommended shops and he responded very quickly.
We felt so comfortable in their appartment, it was very clean, warm & cosy.
So if you agonize about a decision if you book the chiado loft or another appartment on Airbnb, i would highly recommend to book the chiado loft ;)
by the way: the location is fantastic!!!
My tip: PARK (it's a chilly bar on a parking deck, 5 min. walking)

The flat is exactly as on the pictures: cosy, charming and stylish.
The location is perfect, right between the Bairro Alto and Chiado, at the center of everything. Despite that it is perfectly quiet at night and you'll sleep really well in the large comfy bed.
Pedro's friend welcomed us even though our flight was late and we arrived at 1am, which was nice. They arranged some little attentions for us in the flat: chocolates, fresh oranges, jam, etc.
To sum up, we loved the flat and would definitely recommend it to a couple going to Lisbon!
Thank you for all!

Localizado no Bairro Alto/Chiado, o loft é extremamente agradável ao olhar e possui muitas comodidades próximas que lhe permitem usufruir refeições no próprio apartamento (mercado, verdureiros, peixaria, etc). O local representa exatamente aquilo que pode ser observado nas fotos do apartamento, sendo que a atenção, zelo e acessibilidade do anfitrião e sua equipe são um destaque. Com certeza é um local que reservaria novamente, especialmente pela limpeza, praticidade e beleza do local.

FANTASTICO soggiorno, un ambiente confortevole,letto comodissimo,cucina super accessoriata,spazio pulitissimo insomma dovessi tornare a Lisbona tornerei qui decisamente!!!
Pedro e' sempre molto disponibile e mi fatto molto piacere che parlasse bene l'italiano.
L'appartamento e' centralissimo,vicino ad ogni tipo di servizio:banche,supermercato (sotto casa)...macelleria,fruttivendolo,tabaccaio ecc...
altro aspetto positivo si dorme benissimo (molto silenzioso).

We had a rainy trip in Lisbon. The place is in serious great location. Barrio alto cannot be more close. And the shop downstairs was useful. However it is not the best place to stay in the winter. Ladies, the hairdryer there  is not the best of the market

We rented Pedro's Loft apartment in Chiado for almost a week. We found him and his team great to deal with, excellent communication and a seamless arrival. The apartment itself was decorated to a very high standard and the location could not be better with the Barrio Alto and Chiado within a few minute's walk. The apartment was cosy and comfortable and the kitchen had everything we needed to cook for ourselves. Overall we had a fantastic stay and would recommend this great apartment.

Great apartment, ideally located for a city break in Lisbon. The photos on this site do the space justice and it has everything you need. Pedro was also kind enough to let me check in early - thanks P.
Wonderful apartment, perfect for travelers who want to spend a few days in Lisboa! It was really amazing!

Antonio and Pedro were fantastic hosts. They went above and beyond to help us get situated in Lisbon and were accommodating with a flexible checkin time. The location was great and made getting around the city on foot rather simple. The loft itself was cozy and clean. I would gladly recommend staying here to any traveler!

The apartment was amazing! So beautiful and very well equipped. Fabulous location too. We were given a list of recommended things to do and places to see; the Meat with a View Argentinian restaurant was to die for. Thank you for making our stay so perfect.

The apartment is really well furnished and equipped. Pedro organized everything to allow us to have a great stay in his apartment.
The apartment is ideally situated in the center of the city.
We spent 4 great days in Lisboa. Thanks Pedro!

I cannot tell you how great this apartment is!

If you are thinking of going to Lisbon then I highly recommend this apartment. It is just as beautiful as it looks in the photographs and the location is phenomenal!

This was out first AIRBNB experience and everything was perfect!

If we return to Lisbon we will 100% be staying here.
Very nice flat, ideally situated in Bairro Alto. Very helpful hosts... For sure will come again.

Fantastic stay once again with Pedro - this time in Chiado Loft 3. A beautifully decorated, perfectly located apartment full of the charming details that make Pedro's apartments such a joy to stay in.

The apartment is light and airy, though with a low ceiling in parts, which didn't bother us. Kitchen is well equipped, but with so many fantastic restaurant options in the area probably unnecessary!

The small touches, fresh oranges for juicing, bedside chocolates etc, all make a difference and contributed to another fabulous stay in Chiado.

I stayed here with my girlfriend. We loved this apartment! The apartment had a very nice flair. The interior makes you feel as if you were staying at home.
Metro station and the tram are very easy to reach. A small supermarket is right next door.
We recommend this apartment to everyone who wants to visit Lisbon!

Pedro's flat in Lisboa is absolutely stunning. It's exactly how its described and what you can see on the photos. It has the design and comfort of a high end hotel but with the feeling of a home at the same time (the kitchen has everything you need to be able to cook at home if you feel like it). The apartment is super well located in the heart of Lisboa. You're in walking distance from everything you need.
Emanuel and I absolutely loved our time in Lisbon. Being in Pedro's place really made all the difference, as we looked forward to going home and relaxing before going out again later.
I highly recommend Pedro to anyone going to Lisboa for a vacation!
The place was perfect.  Great location and  easy to get around and a market next door and bank across the street.   Would stay there again.

Excellent place. There is not much else to say that hasn't already been mentioned. The flat is located in absolutely prime location. Right on the bica tram route and one block from the action of Barrio Alto. Open the windows and a nice breeze fills the air, close them and you can't hear a peep from the action below. Very nicely appointed. Very comfortable bed ( I am picky about good beds), nice kitchen and beautiful bathroom. We could not have been happier. If you want a calm , comfortable and clean spot right in the heart of Lisbon this is it.
Pedro was always easy to get in touch with, no problems (except for us changing our minds and showing up late) at all with check in or check out. Nothing bad to say at all. Perfect

Simplemente perfecto. Precioso loft con una hubicacion excelente, lo que ves en las fotos es lo que te encuentras, la limpieza es optima. Lo recomiendo a cualquier pareja que quiera pasarse unos dias en Lisboa, tiendas, restaurantes, mucho ambiente en la zona tanto diurno, como nocturno para los que les guste salir a tomarse algo despues de cenar, eso si, cuando te vayas a descansar no tendras ruido alguno en el apartamento. Liboa nos sorprendio gratamente, nos encontramos con una ciudad preciosa, asi que seguro que repetiremos visita y estancia en uno de los apartamentos de Pedro. Gracias por la comodidad y confort ofrecido.

Perfect location. Very stylish interior.
Nothing to complain about :-)

Pedro was reachable throughout the whole stay. Will go there again.

The apartment is just great, we had a great weekend there! Really good atmosphere there created with nice detailed furniture. Everything went really easy from the beginning till the end. Pedro and Antonio were always quick with the reply of some questions. We would definitely recommend to stay in this apartment.

Muito Obrigado
Alex&Jonas

Great home exactly (or even better) as picture. Perfectly located in Lisbon. Pedro and Antonio were really nice host we really appreciated attention like coffee and sweets left in the home for us.
I definitely recommend this house.

Séjour très agréable, l'appartement est vraiment très bien situé.
Bien isolé, nous n'entendions pas les bruits extérieurs (nous y étions fin juillet).
Les photos correspondent bien à la réalité, décorés avec goûts, lit très confortable (plus que bien après les longues journées de marche), avec la petite clim rafraîchissante.

Tout petit bémol :
- Manque de rangement dans le coin chambre, 1 commode à la place de l'un des deux meubles aurait été plus pratique.
- Le tissu du canapé mériterait un petit rafraîchissant.


N'hésitez pas à contacter Pedro, vous passerez un agréable séjour.

Excellent location. Comfortable & stylish apartment. Quiet upstairs, great buzz of activity below.

Thank you Pedro & the Chiado loft team for hosting us in beautiful Lisbon!

We stayed a Pedro's appartment in July 2013. We really, REALLY liked the place. The location of the loft is perfect to explore Lisboa by foot and also really close to the metro station (2 min. walk). There is a grocery store just next door, you are close to restaurants and bars. The loft is as pretty as the pictures. It's also very clean. Also, it was very easy to communicate with Pedro.
Thank you Pedro!
Kristine and Phil

Lindo! Ótima localização. Pedro é muito cuidadoso e o apartamento é impecável. Está bem próximo ao Largo do Chiado e é super fácil de locomover. Tem muitos restaurantes ao redor. Se descer pela Bica, chega ao Cais de Sodré e se subir, está no Bairro Alto. Fica próximo à praça do Comércio e Miradouro São Pedro de Alcântara.  Internet funciona, e o ar condicionado nos dia de verão é muito usado. Indico demais. Se você estiver de carro, é mais complicado, mas tem um estacionamento pago à uma quadra.

This was such a nice apartment!!! Very comfortable, very clean, great location! Very quiet with the windows closed and even when they were open you could heard the sounds of the city but it wasn´t too loud. It was hard to leave the apartment some mornings and always great to come home to!!! Bakeries and markets within a short walk and all the great places in Barrion Alto at your fingertips!!! Pedro was very helpfull and kind even though we showed up an hour later than planned. Great, Great, Great is all I can say!

Nous avons beaucoup apprécié cette location. L'accueil de Pedro était parfait avec quelques petites attentions dans l'appartement. Ce dernier était très cosy et confortable, on s'y sent immédiatement comme chez soi, bonne literie et équipements de salle de bain et cuisine neufs et de bonne qualité.
De plus l'appartement est idéalement situé pour visiter Lisbonne, au pied du tram 28 et du funiculaire de la Bica.
Seul bémol, les vendredi et samedi on a eu droit a de la musique tard provenant d'un bar dans le quartier. Les autres jours étaient calmes.
Nous conseillons fortement ce loft

This is a great place in an amazing location! All the pictures and comments from the previous guests made us wonder about how great this place would be and we were still positively impressed when we got there. Pedro was a perfect host and was there to welcome us (we arrived late in the evening). Having lived in Lisbon for several years I can assure that this is one of the best possible locations for someone looking to enjoy all the good things that Lisbon has to offer. The flat is incredibly cosy and everything that could be possibly needed for a short (or even not so short) stay is in there. Completely recommend it!

10x better than any hotel! We have had a great time in this amazingly stylish and quite luxurious place, in a very nice location. Definitely coming back next time we visit Lisboa! Pedro is an attentive guy and was easy to reach by phone for questions. Obrigado Pedro!
Cheers,
Daan & Arturo

Beautiful place, beautiful environment. Easy access too all the sights in lisbon be it day or night, and also close to cais sodre train station to visit the nearby villages! Pedro was very clear and thorough about the instructions to use the facilities!

L'appartement correspond exactement à celui des photos. Très lumineux, propre et fonctionnel, il était parfait pour notre séjour. Nous avons été reçu avec des petites attentions: du pain, de la confiture, des oranges et des capsules de café. On ne s'y attendait pas, ce fut donc une belle surprise. La localisation est très bonne aussi avec tous les quartiers, commerces et ambiances à proximités. Pour les fêtards, il n'y aura pas de problème, pour les gens qui recherchent le calme, on leur conseil de ne pas réserver un jour de we, férié ou de vacances car nous sommes proches des quartiers où l'ambiance nocturne est importante. Je recommande vivement de réserver chez Pedro pour le service 4*
Great loft, modern and chic, makes you feel special! Great view, best location in the city and the people who handled it were really hospitable and professional.

Notre séjour au Chiado Loft 3 a été incroyable ! L'appartement est très bien équipé et décoré avec goût. Nous n'avons rencontré aucun problème. Pedro s'est assuré que tout se passait bien pour nous ce qui était le cas. Je recommande grandement cet appartement qui est très bien situé et qui est bien moins cher qu'un hôtel pour une prestation de même standing ! Merci pour ce magnifique séjour !

Thanks Pedro for everything, the loft was perfect!! the location brilliant, next to the metro station and 28 tram and restaurants and shops and bars and...awesome.
If we go to Lisbon again we will contact Pedro for sure and we will choose Chiado loft again.
It was better than a 5 stars hotel!! the parking was very near from the flat and only 13 euros per day, that was great.
Thanks Pedro for the marmalade, coffee and bread!! and all your help.
Important: the beds were really, really comfortable.

The apartment is absolutely gorgeous. Very well located, offers all comforts, even Nespresso coffee machine!
Pedro is a perfect host: very helpful and flexible.
I would recommend this flat to any friend.
After a day walking up & down, was very relaxing coming back to the flat for an aperitivo looking over the roofs.
Grazie
Cinzia
Super Apartment! Toller Stadtteil! Und ein wunderbarer Service! Herzlichen Dank an Pedro und Salvador! Wir kommen wieder! Hilde & Konstantin

Fantastic place, loft was a pleasure to stay in and contributed to a lovely city break in Lisbon. Very comfortable and inviting, position could not be better. Near restaurants, night life, tram 28, shops, metro etc.
Would recommend to everyone.
Pedro and Salvador were very kind and helpful.
April 2013
We had a really great trip to Lisbon. Cosy apartment and good facilities.

Everything was perfect. We made check-in in few minutes, the house was beautiful. We found everything settled at the best, we received a warm welcome and many suggestions for our stay. The location is amazing, you're near everything worth visiting in Lisbon; in few minutes walking you get everywhere, and there's a metro station to reach other insight and the mythical 28 stop under your window and... so really i don't have words to thank Pedro and to strongly suggest to book in this STUNNING place to spend a great time in Lisboa. OBRIGADO;-)

Appartement de grand confort très bien situé près de tout, Métro,Bus etcc
la réservation ses très bien passé Pedro étant d'un grand professionnalisme un lieux idéal pour visiter Lisbonne
le quartier es très animé et très agréable à vivre.Boulangerie.Supermarché,Boucherie etccc sont au pied de la porte ainsi que divers restaurant à toute les bourse vraiment un belle endroit.
je ne peut que recommander ce Loft d'un grand confort et son Hôte Pedro qui es d'un grand professionnalisme..
à bientôt pour d'autre aventure..

Stay in this apartment was really great, location is perfect – now when I know something about Lisbon I would definitely recommended this apartment to stay in it! You are near everything – two minutes to night life, to metro , center of town, 10 minutes to Alfama (everything by foot) and tramp is in front of apartment (same as famous elevator). Apartment is great inside and Pedro is really nice host!

Chiado Loft 3 it's exactly was it's name says: a Fantastic New Place! Allan and I stayed for a week and all we wanted in the end was to stay in the apartment forever! All the kitchen equipment's you need to make a rich and delicious breakfast are in the house, the furniture has all been chosen by Pedro with very good taste, the TV has lots of nacional and international channels available, and the location is the best you can find to explore Lisbon, no matter your age. Since it is located on the top of Chiado's hill, all you have to do in the morning, is to go smoothly down toward your destination. Regarding the nighttime, Loft 3 is located 2 walking minutes way from the Bairro Alto neighborhood, which is where all the reference bars and restaurants are. Pedro is an excellent host, he was flexible with our check-in and check-out and on the first day he received us and explained the rules of the house letting us very comfortable inside.
I would definitely return and I totally recommend this place to anyone who is considering to visit Lisbon. It's the perfect place to stay as on winter or summer, for a week or just a weekend, and it's easy connected to the airport (by metro) .
Great flat in the centre of the best district of Lisbon. What more can you ask for? The flat was really cool and Pedro did his outmost to assist us.

Adorei minha estadia, aqui tudo bem organizado, tudo limpinho, e o atendimento dos anfitriões excelente, principalmente do Carlos e da Marta, fiquei muito encantada com a disposição deles em me servir, nota 10 pro os dois principalmente pra Marta ela é muito fofa tenho agradecer, por ter passado esses nesse hostel maravilhoso.
Et rigtigt godt sted at bo i Lissabon. Centralt, rent, velfungerende køkken, søde mennesker og terrasse med vidunderlig udsigt.

Everything was great! Breakfast was excellent! Staff is very kind and helpfull!

Really enjoyed my time here, so much that I extended my stay by a couple of days. The staff were all very friendly and I met so many great people. Its a very nice and tidy place to stay and I would definitely come back whenever I might next be in the area.

La vista de la terraza es maravillosa! El
Personal es muy amable y la vibra del lugar es muy relajada. Lo único que pondría son cortinas en las camas para tener un poco más de privacidad. Sí volvería ☺️

De vriendelijkheid en gastvrijheid was erg authentiek waardoor ik me meteen thuisvoelde. Het was een opvallend schoon en goed georganiseerde plek. 100% de plek waar ik weer zal overnachten zodra ik in Lissabon ben.
야경이 너무 아름답고 편하게 잘 지내다가 가요!
Was only staying overnight for a layover- regardless the amenities were more than adequate, staff and other travelers were friendly. pretty view and probably good breakfast ^^
Habitación limpia, camas tipo litera cómodas, buena temperatura en todo el alojamiento, terraza con buenas vistas y chicas de recepción muy amables :)

I liked my stay at the hostel, but not recommended for those carrying heavy luggage (like me hahah). They offer a locker with a key to secure your stuff, just make sure to ask for it at the reception. Also, since people come and go or sometimes just check out the hostel, secure your valuables. It's a great place if you want to get close to the Alfama district's trams, views, and cafes as well as Fado nights. The place has an old house smell so it made me feel at home. I slept well here.
P.S. The shower is cold though. I couldn't figure out how to make it hot so be sure to ask beforehand.

Had a Lovely weekend stay here and the host sophia was super friendly and warm.
Maps will take you to the end of the street but with some help from another place i found it, its behind the castle and the entrance is about a third way up the stairs
Free to use kitchen with free fresh bread and coffee
Staff was very welcoming, helpful and nice all around. Hostel itself and people there made it easy for me to get to know Lisbon. Thank you!
Great place to stay : the hostel offer free coffee, breakfast (4€), and an incredible view.
Excelente !

I totally recommend this place for backpackers!
It’s so clean both in kitchen and a bathroom, it’s pretty quiet in here and the views from th terrace are incredible

It was one of the best hostels I’ve seen
Clean, reasonably priced, amazing terrace with a view, friendly and talkative staff they gave me a lot of tips and recommendations the location is a huge plus if you like to wonder and walk around overall my experience is great and I’ll definitely comeback one day thank you !

Super Unterkunft
Die Mitarbeiter waren äußerst freundlich & ich konnte mein Frühstück am Abreisetage nach Nachfrage bereits um 06:00 Uhr zu mir nehmen
Nice and quiet

Aktuell ist die Anreise etwas komplizierter, da eine Baustelle die Straße komplett versperrt und man nur von einer Seite zum Hostel kommt, aber das ist nur vorübergehend. Wer die Wahl hat dem würde ich die Zimmer Richtung Balkon empfehlen, die haben nämlich eine Balkontüre, somit mehr Licht und man kann besser lüften. If you have any concerns about a host, the staff will try to find a solution to your problem. For example, we had a late flight on our check-out day. We were allowed to store our luggage in a locked room while we walking, and even use the terrace later (it was extremely hot that day so we decided to have a couple of cold drinks while waiting for the plane, instead of getting sweaty). The hostel located in a center of old town so you can reach a lot of places by just walking. There are also a lot of local bars near the host so you can feel the true Lisboa evening vibes. Recommend this place.

Firstly, I have to mention the view from the apartment; it really is beautiful from sunrise to sunset. The apartment is lovely, with everything you need. It is light, airy, plenty of space with a very comfortable bed. We were greeted with a bottle of Portuguese wine and pasteis de nata on our arrival. It’s worth mentioning that it is on the top floor of a fairly old building; there are lots of stairs and they’re  steep. António did offer to help with our luggage if needed on arrival. The apartment is in a perfect location in Alfama. We walked mostly everywhere, It really isn’t far on foot to get to Chiado and Baixa. Thank you Antonio for all of the restaurant and bar recommendations. Be sure to go to A Baiuca fur a wonderful night of Fado music. Don’t hesitate to book this fabulous place in Lisbon, we will definitely be back.

이 숙소의 가장 큰 매력은 단연 위치와 조망입니다. 매일 아침 창밖으로 펼쳐지는 풍경은 마치 포르타스 도 솔(Portas do Sol) 전망대에서 직접 묵는 듯한 착각을 불러일으킬 만큼 아름다워 매일 아침이 설레었습니다. 굽이진 골목을 따라 주요 명소들을 도보로 이동할 수 있는 점도 완벽했습니다.
비행기 연착으로 아주 늦은 시간에 도착했음에도 호스트분이 친절하게 기다려 주셨고, 엘리베이터가 없는 4층임에도 무거운 짐을 함께 옮겨주셔서 정말 감사했습니다. 1월의 리스본은 다소 습하고 쌀쌀하여 숙소가 조금 춥긴했지만 날씨가 좋은 날에는 괜찮았습니다. 오래된 가옥 특유의 느낌이 알파마 지구의 삶을 깊이 있게 체험하는 특별한 경험으로 다가왔습니다.
직접 요리를 해먹을 수 있는 주방시설이 있어 좋았습니다. 소금, 식초, 올리브오일, 네스프레소 머신, 와인 오프너까지 세심하게 구비되어 있었고, 에어프라이어 겸용 전자레인지 덕분에 매일 밤 나타를 따뜻하게 데워 먹으며 행복한 시간을 보냈습니다. 근처 Pingo Doce 마트에서 식재료를 사 와서 요리하기에도 부족함이 없는 완벽한 주방이었습니다.
클래식한 감성을 누리고 싶은 분들께 강력히 추천합니다!

Kiváló elhelyezkedés és gyönyörű panoráma. Kedves fogadtatás, kifogástalan tisztaság, használható konyha. Nagyon szép 4 napot töltöttünk az apartmanban, ami nagyban hozzájárult a nyugodt és aktív pihenéshez Lisszabonban. Szívből ajánljuk!

리버뷰가 훌륭했고 감성넘치는 집 또한 훌륭했습니다.
다만, 28인치 캐리어를 가지고 올라가는데 통로가 비좁습니다. 30대 남자라서 엘리베이터 없이도 문제없을거라 생각했는데
올라가고 내려가기 힘들었습니다.
나머지는 모두 괜찮았고 리스본의 자연 경관과 역사적 명소들 잘 보고 돌아갑니다.
Wonderful communication!  Great location.

We loved this spot! Very clean and beautiful view. Great location to explore the Alfama area. Short walk to Praça do Comércio and surrounding area. We were able to see a lot of the city staying here.
The area is very hilly but it was no problem at all. If you cannot easily walk up steps - I would not recommend this area.
Great host with a great place.

Lovely place ! Highly Recommend and will definitely be returning. We have also recommended to friends and family to stay. The air BnB is just as described both hosts were so lovely and welcoming. Keeping in contact and giving local places recommendation. The location is perfect for those who want to explore the city. Overall 5/5 star experience! Thank you guys 🥰
Cute and cozy spot with a great view! Stairs were a good workout.

너무 아름답고 좋았어요!!❤️
친절한 호스트님 덕분에 편안하게 안락하게 잘 머물다가 가요~~~ 한국인분들 리스본 놀러오시면 강추요👍
작은 테라스가 있는데 뷰가 너무 예뻐서 사진도 진짜 예쁘게 나와요😍

The apartment is very small - if you have regular sized luggage and two adults are staying in the place, it’s too small. The apartment is also on the fourth floor and there is no elevator. The first floor steps are half steps and extremely steep so this isn’t a good place for older folks or kids to stay at. The apartment door was also broken upon our arrival but the host arrived within 2 hours and had the door fixed by the end of the night. Overall, it’s a very clean apartment but the location was just ok. Overall an ok deal.
Beautiful flat in a stunning location with kind and responsive hosts. Thank you ❤️

Wonderful stay! Excellent host, very responsive and friendly!  Apartment is a small studio with all the necessities.  The view was beautiful and worth the hike up the stairs to the 4th floor.  Just be ready to hike the stairs with your luggage and deal with all the uphill around Alfama neighborhood.  Catching a Bolt/Uber was difficult as most do not want to come to this area because of the tight streets and congestion in the area.

We absolutely loved our stay here. It was perfect for a quick trip to Lisbon, it's very close to many great restaurants and has a fantastic view. We would definitely stay here again if travelling to Lisbon.
Jada great stay, gorgeous view. We were able to early check to drop off our luggage.

What a nice stay. Mariana and Antonio were great hosts. Very kind, helpful and responsive. The place couldn't have been in a better spot.  Inside the beautiful historic neighborhood of Alfama, within walking distance to restaurants and attractions. I would recommend this BnB to anyone.
4층 계단이 상당히 가파르고 여러 날을 숙박수건은

What a gem of a place! I can’t rate this place high enough. Felt right at home from the first moment and couldn’t get enough of the stunning view of the city. Hosts are super responsive and friendly. Highly recommended!
Lovely place, especially for anyone traveling light!
The view from this flat is mind blowing and worth climbing up the narrow stairs (It is on the 4th floor). It is well designed and maximised and has everything you need. We loved it.

An absolutely beautiful, perfect stay!!!
Don't let the 4th-floor walk-up scare you off because each floor gets you closer to the most beautiful view you could ever imagine. Truly an absolute gem and highlight to this incredible pad.
The moment you walk in, you understand that António and Mariana were very thoughtful when putting this apartment together. Everything you could need or want was thought of: plenty of pillows and a soft blanket over the couch for comfort, coffee and any kitchen supplies you might need, clean and comfortable sheets and bed... we absolutely loved our stay here for our honeymoon. It was cozy and perfectly located. We explored for 4 days on foot and felt like our stay was right in the middle of it all - perfect for walkers. If you want to stay close, there is an incredible Fado house down the street, as well as many other restaurants and bars with awesome wine selections. Lastly, the hosts were incredibly kind and had great communication throughout our stay.

Très bel appartement au cœur d’Alfama avec une vue exceptionnelle !
Marina est à l’écoute et est une excellente hôte.
Une adresse à recommander pour une escapade à Lisbonne.

We had a wonderful stay - beautiful place in an amazing location, walkable to all the wonderful sights. The apartment had everything we needed & the hosts provided us with local recommendations, and were super responsive if we needed them. Would most definitely recommend for your trip to Lisbon. Thank you!

Superbe emplacement !
Superbe vue
Et des gens facilement accessible
Merci
wonderful stay in the alfama neighborhood!
Bien situé dans le cartier historique . L’hôte est réactif et très gentil . Nous avons passé un très beau séjour !

We had a great stay for our three nights in Lisbon. This spot is right in the heart of Alfama with stunning views from the apartment. The hosts were very responsive, arranged early check in for us, and even left us a surprise snack and bottle of wine. Would definitely recommend to anyone wanting to stay in the area.
Wonderful

The view is fantastic! Unfortunately for me a large cruise ship docked in the harbor and partially obscured the view. The place is quiet with the windows closed and very close to lots of great restaurants and cafes. Mariana sent me tons of restaurant/bakery recommendations and was very flexible with check-in.
The only cons are that as others mentioned, the many stairs up to the 4th floor really are extremely steep and narrow - a trade off for the view. When I first arrived, the key wasn’t working to lock the apt from the inside though Mariana fixed this within an hour or two.
Also noting that while Alfama is so lovely, I would choose a different neighborhood next time (it took me about 30 mins to find a Bolt to go to the train station and generally was a bit hard to get around).
Many thanks for the few days away! Hopefully we’ll be back!

Such a beautiful place! We loved the Airbnb and will definitely be back and staying here again. We even asked the host to do something special for our engagement and it was so beautifully decorated - you could tell they spent time doing this. It was really kind of them!
Quite small, a little challenging for taller folks,  but we managed. Easy to walk or take public transit.

si vous êtes en forme et avez de tres peitis bagages c' est un endroit de rêve. si non, passer votre chemin car 50 marches pour se rendre au ciel.
une fois rendu c'est merveilleux.

Très bel appartement avec vue magnifique sur le quartier d’alfama et le Tage. Excellent pour passer quelques jours à Lisbonne. Les hôtes sont très gentils et accueillants, on a été accueilli avec des pastel de nata et une bouteille de vin. Ils nous ont fait de bonnes recommandations et la communication a été facile et très agréable. Je recommande à 100%

What a fantastic apartment! It the cutesiest little town of Alfama, we had views of the whole marina and city. The hosts were incredible with such great local recommendations. They offered us any help we needed. The apartment has everything you need and it’s a beautiful stay.
Fantastic Airbnb, perfectly located in Alfama. Beautiful view over the rooftops - the stairs are worth it! We had a great stay and would recommend this place
Thank you so much! My wife and I had such a wonderful stay. We loved every minute of it and want to come back again! Everything was perfect and we will miss the view so much!

Antonio's place was wonderful and very well presented. The complimentary wine and Pastel de Natas were a lovely touch and they turned out to be the best ones we had on our whole trip!  The host communicated really well and the check in was seamless. Lisbon was 34-39 degrees during our stay and the flat is on the 4th floor which made it extremely warm and a challenge at night. A fan was provided which helped but it did just blow warm air. The flat would be perfect if there was a small air conditioning unit for these peak summer times. Otherwise, very very well equipped, pretty and we would definitely stay again in the cooler months!
The view was incredible and the location was very easy to get to great restaurants. Our host was very responsive and we had an excellent stay.
We had a wonderful stay! The location is unbeatable and the view was gorgeous, everything was as described. Thanks for a lovely time

Amazing location in Alfama and charming apartment with a beautiful view of the river. Mariana was a great host and was super accommodating and flexible. Great local recommendations. The only thing that was challenging for my partner and I, which we expected as it's in the listing, was getting up and down the stairs with our luggage. If you have very heavy luggage and are traveling by taxi, it could be worth packing an overnight bag and spending a few dollars to check your cases nearby (there was a Luggage Hero right down the street). We also couldn't get an uber to drop us off at the door and the closest pick up point was several steep blocks away, which was a little brutal in the summer heat. A small price to pay for staying in this incredible part of the city. We would definitely stay here again if we're in Lisboa, but might pack a lighter overnight bag. Thanks Mariana and António!
Very good! Relatively cool even in the summer time. Be forewarned that the climb up to the flat is not to be scoffed at. Would visit again .

The location and views were amazing, we also received lots of helpful recommendations from our host. The flat itself was cosy and clean, however as tall people we felt a bit too tall for this flat and constantly had to watch out not to hit our heads against the inclined ceiling in the kitchen. Otherwise we had a great time in Lisbon having this flat as our base.
Note that the flat doesn't have AC and only a fan so it got a bit too warm during the night. We would have slept with the windows opened but the narrow living room balcony was shared with another flat so we thought it's not safe to keep it open while sleeping.
Brilliant little place in a beautiful location! Fabulous views, a few stairs and a fantastic few days! Thank you António!

This airbnb has such a lovely view of the ocean and all the cute Lisbon orange roofs.
The Alfama area is very quaint with not much to do, however the food scene is great! It was a bit of a further walk into the main city than expected and the accomodation has numerous steep stairs in order to access the top floor, so do make sure you take up the hosts offer to help with luggage (we did not 😅). The space itself is comfortable and has everything we needed. The hosts were very communicative, left us Pasteis de Natas on the kitchen table upon arrival, and even booked us a taxi to the airport when leaving. Thank you Antonio & Mariana!
Clean! Just like the pictures. Very walkable and lots to see and do. Good location
De wijk waarin het appartement staat is zeker in de (feest)maand geweldig qua sfeer. Ook het uitzicht en de netheid van het appartement vielen op. zeker een aanrader!

Die Wohnung ist sehr zentral gelegen, dennoch ruhig mit toller Aussicht.
Man sollte gut zu Fuss sein, da die Treppe zur Wohnung sehr steil ist.
Die Ausstattung war super, es war alles da, was man braucht!
Dusche ebenfalls sauber, immer mit warmem Wasser.
Restaurant-Tipps vom Host waren ebenfalls hilfreich.
Besten Dank, wir können es gerne weiterempfehlen!

Perfect location in Lisbon to get the feel of the neighborhood and vibe. We loved Alfama and all the great re and cafes. The apartment was lovely and exactly served our needs. The four flights up was a little tiring at times but we got used to it quickly.
Great location and great spot!! And the view from the apartment is the cherry on top!!
The view is gorgeous! Loved the place

We had an amazing stay at Antonio and Mariana’s apartment! The location was unbeatable, with the most stunning view. The apartment was spotless and just as pictured. We would absolutely stay here again!

The apartment is located in the most iconic quarter of Lisbon. There are more restaurants in the vicinity than you can try within a reasonable time. But Antonio was very helpful with recommendations. You have a view of the top of many little houses on the river, might watch cruise ships come and go, jump into action, or recharge in the quiet of the apartment. Perfect location.
Wonderful hosts and brilliant home

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour , super accueil , Mariana et antonio nous ont donné de belles adresses.
Le logement est très bien situé avec une vue incroyable sur le tejo !
Nous y retournerons avec grand plaisir.

Sehr hübsche kleine Wohnung mit großartigem Ausblick auf den Tejo.
Gut zu Fuß und mit der Tram zu erreichen.
Sehr schöne Umgebung.
Alles wie beschrieben und freundliche Kommunikation mit Antonio.
Können wir sehr empfehlen.

Cosy apartment, very well situated looking out over the rooftops of Alfama towards the Tagus river. Great area to stay, easy reach on foot to main attractions and plenty of tram stops if you didn't want to climb the many hills. Antonio gave us lots of recommendations for local places to eat and we found a wonderful cosy wine bar called Santa Pausa just seconds from the apartment block.
The apartment was very comfortable with a glorious view which we shall miss. Thank you for a great trip!

This is my 5th visit to  Lisbon & this is by far my favourite Airbnb & hosts, the view from the apartment is stunning, its clean & nicely set up lovely little touches like a pastal da nata on arrival I cannot rate this high enough I would give it 6 stars if I could thank you we will be back
Antonio and Mariana were excellent hosts, very flexible and extremely responsive. Views from the apartment were gorgeous and we had a great stay!

Overall a very pleasant experience at Antonio/Mariana’s place. Location was superb and allows us to conveniently explore everywhere in Alfama. Views from the living room window were also surreal & beautiful. Apartment-wise, it had everything we needed and was very cosy.
Only caveat is that there is no lift (so be prepared for that) and only local taxis are able to enter the neighborhood you’re in (for Uber, you have to do a short walk out). Other than that, everything was 10/10.

We loved our stay at António and Mariana’s place. The location was perfect, right in the heart of Alfama, with a beautiful view and within walking distance to many restaurants and bars. Communication was great and Mariana’s recommendations for local eateries were amazing. We would definitely stay here again. Thank you António and Mariana!

Lovely small flat in the middle of the Alfama district. Great for one but would equally be lovely for a couple.
It is up steep steps but I was given the option of being met and helped.
Gorgeous views too!
Lovely little apartment in a great location to explore Lisbon. Very clean and good communication, highly recommend!

My wife and I stayed here for two nights and we couldn’t imagine a better place to be! António and Mariana were quick to respond, great to provide recommendations and have a beautiful space.
The view is what many people go to Lisbon for, and you have it right out your window! Unbeatable place in the heart of Alfama.

Everything was perfect, the host was super responsive and organised an early check in for us. The location was great, close to metro and tram. We loved exploring the local area and the recommendations from the host was a great addition - thanks!

If you want to stay in a beautiful and historic area of Lisbon, this charming apartment in the Alpha District is a special gem! We had a fantastic time, exploring the neighborhoods and cultural sites and restaurants of Lisbon. The apartment is perfectly located for getting on the yellow tram and finding Ubers and taxis or just walking. And the description is accurate, it’s on the fourth floor, so just be aware about the size of your suitcases and your cardio training! We love the apartment and had a wonderful stay. Our hosts stayed in touch through a rocky street in Lisbon due to the power outages - and we’re so helpful! Great visit!

Sehr schöne, charmante, kleine Wohnung mit super Aussicht über die Dächer Lissabons und den Tejo. Sie liegt an bester Lage, inmitten des historischen Altstadtviertels Alfama, in welchem es unzählige kleine Restaurants und Bars gibt.
Aufmerksame Gastgeber, reaktionsschnelle und angenehme Kommunikation mit Mariana, welche uns auf Wunsch innert Kürze eine weitere Bettdecke bringen liess und uns das Taxi zum Flughafen organisiert hat, vielen Dank dafür!
Wir haben unseren Aufenthalt sehr genossen und würden sofort wiederkommen.
Really nice, clean and tidy space with a pretty view. We were able to check in early and the hosts had pastel de natas waiting for us - lovely touch. Would recommend!

We loved this place! Everything from the communication, little treats left, and view were spectacular. They went above and beyond to help make sure we had a great stay with great local recommendations and even set up a ride to the airport! Would recommend to anyone!

We had a great stay Antonio’s! Location was in an area that we felt was central to a lot of what we wanted to see while not being overly congested. The host was absolutely wonderful!  They let us check in early, provided a list of recommended restaurants, and sent a link for storage lockers for us if we needed somewhere to store our stuff after checkout. Not to mention that they left us Pasteis de Nata to try! We really felt like they went above and beyond what we expected and were readily available if we had any other questions about the area. Their place also had a beautiful view of the river which was so nice to wake up to. The stairs were obviously a bit of a workout but we expected that. Would definitely stay again if we were to come back to Lisbon.
Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt! Eine sehr schöne Wohnung mit toller Lage!
The apartment was very convenient for exploring Lisbon. Right in the middle of the Alfama region, we were close to many restaurants and also areas of interest. We really enjoyed our stay.

We had a fabulous 3 nights here! The apartment is gorgeous and is well located for walking into Lisbon’s city centre as well as having lots of bars and restaurants in the vicinity. Communication was great, with help provided for booking a taxi back to the airport for us.
We would most definitely stay here again.
Communication excellent, great location

Amazing hosts! We were taking a 6 month baby with us as they were very accommodating from the start. They shared lots of recommendations and were responsive to any questions we had.
As soon as you walk into the apartment, you get a beautiful view of Alfama which was something we loved. Everything was set up including the travel cot and it was very cozy and clean - they even left a lovely treat of Pastel de natas and a bottle of wine, which was so nice to have after a day of traveling.
When it was time to leave, they booked a taxi for us and allowed us to leave our luggage for a couple of hours after check out - making our return simple.
The apartment is 4 floors up. If you have a baby, you just have to be prepared to fold the pram and carry it up (work of the natas!) We got around Alfama really easily by filtering google maps to give routes with no steps. Lots of lovely places to eat in the area. We got everywhere we needed even with a baby.
We would stay again!

it was a lovely little apartment in Alfama, which is a gem of a neighborhood within Lisbon.  it was spotless! very comfortable bed, str9ng wifi, great local recommendations.  Just important to note that the stairs and hallway up to the 4th floor are narrow so huge checked bags are challenging. although they would offer assistance for arrival. and kitchen was super clean but not well equipped if you are planning to cook a lot. but why would you with such a plethora of delicious choices right outside your door.
alloggio molto confortevole con una  bellissima vista , host attento e premuroso, consiglio vivamente questo appartamento!
Old property with lots of period charm, steep stairs and apartment on 4th floor so may not suit all.

Amazing little gem in Alfama. The host had amazing local restaurant recommendations that left us speechless! We believe food is an important part of the cultural experience and the restaurant recommendations from the hosts were consistently a 10/10 and truly enhanced our stay. Place was clean, authentic, and very spacious for 2 people. Loved the view from the balcony and the windows too. Only issue was the bathroom ventilation system wasn’t super great and had an open window directly into the kitchen. As you can imagine, that wasn’t super pleasant. The apartment is located on the 4th floor and the building had very narrow staircases but the hosts offered to come help. Overall an amazing stay! We had a great time in alfama.

Mariana and Antonio’s place was lovely. The apartment was located on the top floor of the building, but it’s a narrow steep climb up from the inside. I won’t lie - lugging our bag up those cobblestone slopes and stairs in Alfama to get to the place was not for the faint hearted. But I definitely am happy with the choice to stay there, in the heart of Lisbon.
You just cannot beat that view. Waking up to it, people watching from it, watching the sun disappear from it. It’s just gorgeous. And the apartment is comfortable and well appointed. I was able to make a quick breakfast between the stove, microwave, and fridge.
We had some issues with shower pressure, which unfortunately Mariana wasn’t able to schedule a plumber to resolve by the time we left. But she was really responsive and quick to try to address our concerns which I appreciate.
My husband is taller than average, 6 foot 3 inches, and some of the ceilings were a little low for him. But we both had an amazing time.

Had such a nice stay at the apartment. The view was unbelievable! We also really enjoyed the neighborhood. To be honest if we didn’t stay at this place I don’t think we would have as good of a time. Its neighborhood is peaceful, quiet, much cleaner than other parts of Lisbon and we loved all the restaurants. The host was very responsive and helpful. We loved the restaurant recommendations and (the sweet welcome gift) as well as pre booking our taxi! The apartment is so cute and had everything we needed. We felt extremely safe and welcomed in the neighborhood as well. The only thing I will say is that’s one creaky bedframe! I did read that in other reviews and had to laugh about it our first nights stay! You’re in the oldest most charming part of Lisbon a little creak is gonna happen. PS. Quase breakfast was unbelievable if you rent the apartment just go there as well as doVigario. We really only ate by the apartment and were happy everytime.
Alles perfekt! Habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt! Vielen Dank für alles!
房间非常温馨，设施齐全，透过窗户可以看到大海。我们带了非常重的行李，房东帮我们拿到楼上，非常感谢！
Very cute and authentic apartment with a great view.
Hosts were very welcoming and helpful. The place was perfect for us.

We had a great time at Antonio and Mariana's airbnb. The view over the river is amazing. The apartment is beautiful and in a great location with many sightseeing spots in walking distance. Be aware that cars won't be able to drop you off at the address, you'll have to walk (with your luggage) down a flight of stairs. We also felt that the tight alleys of Alfama didn't feel super safe when coming home later at night. The host's communication was excellent though and we would gladly come back anytime.
Super Unterkunft und freundliche und hilfsbereite Gastgeber, jederzeit gerne wieder! DANKE!
Wonderful place to say with a gorgeous view! Comfortable bed, very clean and very quiet (even though it was close to everything)!
Lovely little apartment in the very pleasant Alfama neighborhood!
We had a quick fabulous stay - great location and had everything we needed.  Would highly recommend this place!
창문 밖으로 보이는 리스본 풍경이 너무 아름다웠습니다. 조용한 집과 감각적인 인테리어는 아주 좋았습니다. 호스트의 적극적인 소통으로 편안하게 이용하였습니다.
Great stay, and excellent location!
This well-appointed apartment in Alfama made our stay even more memorable thanks to the amazing views!!! The place was perfect for our three day stay in Lisboa.

We really enjoyed our 36 hour stay to experience the end of our European vacation. Mariana and Antonio stayed in contact and assisted us all through our plans.  Their place gives you the pleasure and comfort to go on foot to many destinations.  Even as seniors we managed our steps and navigation through all the historic alleys and streets.  The best was sitting with the open door on the veranda to take in our view that overlooked rooftops and the water.  I highly recommend this as a destination for anyone who wants to experience the best part of Lisbon.  Sweet family and getting to meet the new baby was a treat.  <3
Beau logement, les recommandations de repas sont excellentes. Il est important de surveiller les pickpockets de la gare au Airbnb. Mariana et António ont été facile à communiquer.

Staying at Antonio’s place was an excellent experience to adventure Lisbon. Walking and getting lost in Alfamas street was a great way to find lots of cool restaurants x the view from the balcony it’s priceless.. Obrigado Antonio!!!
Thanks! ❤️
Früher Check-In war problemlos möglich. Die Wohnung hat eine tolle Aussicht und war sehr sauber.

We had an amazing stay at this Airbnb in Lisbon! The view of the ocean was absolutely breathtaking and made every morning special. The host was incredibly responsive and went above and beyond by allowing us to check in our bags early, so we could explore the city stress-free before our official check-in time.
The neighborhood was friendly and welcoming, with plenty to see and do nearby. It was also convenient to get around, as taxis can drop you off right at the door. Note that only residents and taxis can access the area by car. Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for a comfortable stay with stunning views and exceptional hospitality!

This spot is an absolute gem in Lisbon. Located in the oldest neighborhood in the city, the building has old world charm and a gorgeous view. The bed is super comfortable, the bathroom is a good size, and the kitchen and living room spaces were very nice with thoughtful touches. You’ll feel safe with a triple deadbolt lock even if you are a solo traveler. I wish I could have stayed longer in this lovely Lisboa apartment! Thanks again to the wonderful hosts.

Our stay at Antonio and Mariana’s place was amazing! The apartment was adorable and perfect for 2 people! It had everything we needed and was very clean! The place was great! Right in Alfama. He also provided great recommendations. We loved it!
