Super consigliato! Tutto perfetto, posizione meravigliosa
One of the best Airbnbs I have stayed at. Fantastic location and views. Amazing recommendations for restaurants also. Would definitely love to visit again

Fabulous place to stay and an awesome view over the lower Alfama area. Marianne was a very responsive host and the personal touches of wine and Pastel de nata were much appreciated. Also the position of the apartment was perfect.
Highly recommended.

I could not recommend this stay more- the location was beautiful, the views were incredible, and the hosts were so wonderful- helping me navigate where to eat (Pateo 13 and Alfalma Doce are a must do) but also helping me figure out transportation to my next destination in Portugal. A truly magical stay!
This apartment is perfect. Amazing view, responsive and helpful host. Ask for recommendations for restaurants. Perfect place to stay for a couple nights!

Die Unterkunft war einfach Klasse. Zentral, sauber mit einem super Blick über die Altstadt von Alfama. die Restaurant Tipps waren sehr hilfreich. wir haben einiges ausprobiert und würden nicht enttäuscht. gerne wieder.

Absolutely gorgeous apartment with a stunning balcony view across alfama and the river.
Well situated - middle of the old town but walkable to other areas of Lisbon and to the train station.
The host met us and showed us around, giving us loads of great local recommendations. She was really responsive and helpful when we asked for advice and booked us a very early morning taxi to the airport on our last day.
Oh and she even greeted us with a gorgeous bottle of local wine and custard tarts! This was such a lovely touch.
10/10 experience and will definitely be recommending to friends wanting to visit lisbon.
Great location and great view.  Very responsive host.

António and Mariana’s place was lovely. The house is located in a peaceful neighborhood and the view from the balcony was amazing! The host was extremely helpful and kind, would definitely recommend staying here!

Wow! the view is hard to beat! I actually spent a lot of time just watching the sunset, swallows, and boats come and go. Helpful recommendations, a warm welcome, and so much to do in immediate area. Wish I could have stayed longer! Mariana also helped me with a very early Cab ride. Responsive and kind!

I can’t really add much to previous reviews. Antonio and Mariana couldn’t be more helpful and eager to please.  In the 5 days that we were there they responded very quickly to emails, answering every query we had from local restaurant and bakery recommendations and opening times  to the location of the local hospital.  The apartment is superb in every way with stunning views from the living room/balcony. The 51 steps up to the apartment are well worth climbing to have that view, though hard work for the unfit or for those with mobility issues!
We had a great stay at Antonio's Airbnb. It was clean, had a beautiful view and was in a great location! Very quick and helpful responses too!

Wonderful hosts! The place was amazing & Lisboa is beautiful! Host made a lot of great recommendations for local food. The place had amazing views of the city & harbor. I would absolutely recommend this place to family & friends. Thank you for a wonderful stay in Lisboa.

Antonio and Mariana were great hosts during our short stay. Mariana was very communicative and provided local recommendations during our stay. They made sure check-in and checkout went smoothly and were attentive to our needs. The flat is just as the pictures show - wonderfully decorated, clean, and cozy. The coffee was plentiful and Mariana had some pastéis waiting for us when we arrived. The view of Alfama and the Targus river is as advertised - beautiful! The flat provides a good home base to come back to after you have spent a day exploring Lisboa.

Die Lage mitten in der charmanten Altstadt Lissabons war wunderbar. Der Ausblick auf den Hafen unbezahlbar. Es hat uns so gut gefallen, dass wir nächstes Jahr wieder kommen.
Antonio war ein sehr fürsorglicher Gastgeber, es war eine tolle Erfahrung.

Tausend Dank für eine tolle Zeit in der wunderschönen Wohnung. So eine freundliche Gastgeberin und eine perfekte Lage für einen Kurztripp. Mitten im Zentrum mit tollen Möglichkeiten alles zu Fuß zu erkunden!
Wir kommen bestimmt nochmal wieder, DANKE! Perfekter Urlaub!
Liebe Grüße

Nous avons grandement apprécié notre séjour dans cet appartement. Il est important de savoir qu'il est au 4 e étage alors pas facile d'accès avec de grosses valises. Mais tout était impeccable et tel que démontré dans les photos.

Antonio es un Excelente Anfitrión, cuida hasta el más mínimo detalle, la ubicación muy buena y tiene una vista espectacular. Toro accesible Antonio muy pendiente de nuestra llegada y muy detallista, es un súper anfitrión!!!

Wonderfully Perfect!!
Mariana and Antonio's apartment is beautiful and so romantic. My boyfriend and I spent a fantastic 3 days in their beautiful Alfama apartment.
It is furnished to the highest standards and looks exactly like the pictures.
Everything is immaculate.
And oh my goodness...... that view! ❤️
Mariana allowed us an early check in at 1pm which was fantastic but there is a left luggage shop a short walk from the apartment.
Alfama is picture perfect, full
of beautiful restaurants/bars with authentic live music. I did not want to come home.
Worth every penny and if I could grade it higher than 5 stars I would.
Thank you Mariana and Antonio for a fabulous stay. You must feel so proud to own such a stunning property.

The apartment was perfect for our stay in Lisbon. The view was incredible and the place was clean, cosy, and nicely decorated. Mariana and Antonio were very helpful, and provided us with local recommendations. The location was perfect for exploring Lisbon, in the heart of the city and close to public transport but also peaceful. We would recommend this place to anyone!

This was the most adorable place! Exactly like the pictures with a phenomenal view of Alfama from the Juliet balcony. Great location, restaurants and little markets around every corner. Marianne met us there and provided great recommendations of places to eat. We truly enjoyed our stay here and were sorry to leave. If you want to feel the heartbeat of the city, this is the place!
Great communication! Great view! Lovely place!

This place is STUNNING. Looks exactly like the photos. Was the perfect size for a week-long stay for my husband and I - we were so comfortable. We kept the windows open for a little breeze, and used the fan at night for some white noise to help us sleep (not that there was any street noise! It was peaceful). The view is unreal in the morning, and walking around Lisbon was so fun. Antonio and Mariana were excellent hosts!! Would absolutely stay here again.
Beautiful place! Really nice location and such a beautiful view. We enjoyed the restaurants and pastelarias close by! Great hosts!
Es war das perfekte Apt. für unseren 3 Tage Trip zu zweit. Fantastischer Blick, beste Lage, geschmackvolle Einrichtung, super Gastgeber - 5 Sterne!
Comfortable and thoughtful accommodation in enchanting neighborhood.  Excellent communication with host, very helpful and welcoming.
Mariana was absolutely delightful. This place has a view that is so spectacular. Right in the center of it all. Host was responsive. Clean and had everything you need. Thank you.
Great location and a beautiful apartment. We loved the view and the homey touches.

This was our third time staying at this wonderful and picturesque apartment in the heart of Alfama! I cannot recommend this place enough - not only it is spotlessly clean, beautifully decorated, with spectacular views but also in the heart of old part of Lisbon Alfama which offers many wonderful places to eat and drink! Our hosts were extremely welcoming and offered their recommendations for local places to eat and even suggested to visits other parts of Lisbon to have memorable meals out! Thank you, we cannot wait to come back soon!

Amazing location and apartment. Easy walking to everything Lisbon has to offer and has stunning views from the balcony. The place was clean, exactly as it looked in the photos and we were able to walk everywhere. At the top of the stairs is the 28 streetcar which is fun and makes getting into the city easy if you prefer not to walk. Highly recommend this apartment.

Das Apartment ist geschmackvoll eingerichtet und der Blick auf den Tejo und die Alfama sind einfach klasse.  Die Kommunikation hat prima geklappt.  Ich hoffe, dass ich in absehbarer Zeit wieder kommen kann.

We stayed here for three nights and from the moment we arrived to the moment we left the hosts were perfect.
Always responsive with messages and very accommodating with great local recommendations.
The apartment is the perfect size for a couple and had everything you could ask for. The view from the balcony is breathtaking.
You are in a wonderful historic district and as such, it offers you the perfect gateway to see Lisbon.
We will be back to Lisbon and if it is available we will stay here again.

Beautiful air bnb with an amazing view and great location. Mariana was extremely helpful with local recommendations and helped me find the apartment when I was jet lagged and got lost! I would definitely recommend staying here!

Un accueil par Marianna pour remises des clés même à 20h, très apprécié car cette pratique a tendance à se perdre avec Rbnb ! Merci aussi pour les conseils d'adresses !
Nid douillet dans le quartier typique de l'Alfama (qui se laisse découvrir sportivement dans les côtes !).
Logement parfait pour quelques jours à Lisbonne !
A savoir : chambre et salon dans une même pièce.
Un bémol pour la VMC salle de bains bruyante et rangements et vaisselle sommaires pour un plus long séjour télétravail comme nous. Chauffage d'appoint bienvenu en ce mois de janvier.
This was SO perfect. We loved every minute of it and Antonia & Mariana were wonderful hosts. We'll be back! :)

그러나 동네가 언덕에 위치하고 있어 도보로 다니긴 힘들어요. 엘리베이터 없는 4층이고 체크인할때 호스트 분이 짐 옮기는 것을 도와주셔서 간신히 옮겼어요. 겨울에 방문했는데 방이 좀 추웠어요. 이런 점을 감안하고도 뷰와 시설은 모두 만족스러워요. 특히 웬만한 리스본 전망대보다 뷰가 좋아요. 호스트 분도 매우 친절하시고 최대한 도움 주려고 하세요. 호스트 덕분에 편하게 머무르다 갑니다:)

Antonia and Mariana were incredible hosts with a beautiful apartment. The location was right in the historic neighborhood of Alfama. The street itself was just for pedestrians, so it felt very peaceful and quiet, yet just a short walk to many main attractions. The place was super clean and Antonia and Mariana were very responsive with good recommendations.
Highly recommend, it was a great stay!

The apartment is in Alfama, the older part of Lisbon, which was beautiful. The view from the apartment was gorgeous and very peaceful. The apartment was also super clean and spacious, which made the time we spent there very relaxing. I would definitely stay here again if I make my way back to Lisbon!

António and Mariana's place is a wonderful stay with views that are better than the pictures. Absolutely breathtaking. Taking a cab to the Airbnb was a bit confusing as the location is hard for cars to navigate to but it didn't cause more than a few minutes of hassle, and the instructions António and Mariana gave me were straight forward and informative. Overall an incredible stay with hosts that were extremely responsive, accommodating and kind!
location is awesome, love the balcony!! Stairs are fine for young people, worth every penny!

This apartment was everything we were looking for during our trip to Lisbon. From the beginning, they were helpful, as they allowed us to check in early. Mariana also met us at the apartment and walked us through everything in person, which was so kind and unnecessary. There is a tough walk up to the 4th floor, but the view is more than worth it. The apartment is quaint and adorable and has everything you could need. They even left us a bottle of portugués wine. Ask for recommendations, the places sent were great- we recommend the Fado one night. They were gracious and kind hosts, and we hope to come back and stay with them again one day!

we had chosen a very special stay for Christmas. we were lovingly greeted with pastei de nata. The apartment was very clean, very centrally located and lovingly furnished. when we come back to Lisboa we will contact the superhosts mariana and antonio again to be sure of a great place to stay! Happy New Year

Amazing views with amazing hosts! Be prepared for the few flights of stairs upon arrival with any luggage. Mariana helped once we arrived which was very sweet of her. Mariana also sent through so many good recommendations which made our stay even more enjoyable.
Gorgeous views from this apartment. Be aware that taxis will have a hard time finding it but it is worth it for the incredible views and wonderful neighborhood.
This is a lovely place to stay in the heart of the Alfama. Fabulous view and comfortable surroundings. Nice amenities and wonderful, thoughtful, communicative hosts. A real pleasure.

The apartment is very lovely and the location is perfect. Highly recommended!
Just be aware that there are many stairs to carry up your suitcases. But it is definitely worth it because the place is very nice :)

Antonio and Mariana’s place was spacious and perfect for a few days in Lisbon. They were very flexible with checkin and had so many thoughtful touches. You’re on the top floor so be prepared to go up several stairs to get to the room. Other than having a very heavy suitcase, it was not a problem at all for us.  Especially since they had a breathtaking view of the city and the ocean that made sunrise and/or sunsets very enjoyable. It’s right next to the tram and has a good bakery, cafe and restaurants near by, I’d recommend anyone to stay at Antonio and Mariana’s place.

Die zentrale Lage der Wohnung ist super für einen Städtetrip oder auch für längere Aufenthalte. Wir haben zwei Wochen in Lissabon verbracht und hatten in der Wohnung alles, was wir brauchten. Die Aussicht und auch die Einrichtung sind optimal für längere Aufenthalte geeignet. Das Bett ist nicht zu hart (so wie leider bei den meisten Unterkünften), sondern sehr bequem. Der Ausblick ist so super, dass wir an den Regentagen auch das Gefühl hatten mittendrin zu sein. Ein Auto solltet ihr euch höchstens für ein paar Tage mieten und die Umgebung erkunden. Wir fanden, dass sich Alfama eher zu einem ruhigeren Bezirk entwickelt hat, in dem man auf weniger Einheimische als Touristen trifft. Alles in allem ein toller Urlaub mit einer perfekten Wohnung.

This apartment was in a great location in the old historic part of Lisbon.  The centre of Lisbon is within 10 mins walk and the metro within 5 mins. If walking look out for the public elevators, including metro/train stations as they will save you a few steep climbs. The apartment is everything as described and more. Maria and Antonia are wonderful hosts helpful in so many ways.  I would highly recommend this airbnb and hope to return again.

Hard to avoid hills in Lisboa (every walk seems uphill!) but our home base at Antonio & Mariana’s was conveniently located right off the 28 Tram. Mariana greeted us upon arrival and helped carry our bags up - super nice of her! Gave us great local recs for the area and all in all, we loved our stay. Cannot wait to come back soon!
Beautiful apartment, had everything we needed. The view was amazing,the bed was comfy and the area was really pretty. Would definitely come back and can’t recommend enough. Thank you :)
Perfect! Access to everything you want or need at a fantastic value
Great location and lovely flat.
Charmante Unterkunft mitten in der Altstadt

This place is amazing! So cute, clean and the location is perfect.
Yes there are lots of stairs, but the view is worth it!
One of the best airbnbs me and my girlfriend have staying in. Stunning view and great hosts. Very clean and nice smelling apartment.

We loved staying here! António was there to greet us upon arrival and kindly carried our bags upstairs. He had a bottle of wine and pasteis de nata waiting for us. The view from the balcony was so beautiful and the location of the apartment in Alfama was great. We would definitely stay again!
Great place in the heart of Alfama. Amazing views and steps away from many restaurants, shops, bars, etc. Antonio is also a great communicator. This place is a steal so I highly recommend!
super appartement communication au top plein de recommandations resto .. petite attention de bienvenue fort appréciable et cerise sur la gâteau un emplacement idéal
Everything was perfect. The apartment is beautiful and has great location. Highly recommended.

Beautiful apartment with a spectacular view of Alfama and the ocean. Would highly recommend for any couple looking to stay in the area. Mariana and Antonio were also very helpful as hosts providing us with advice on places to go and also assisting us with booking a taxi for our departure. Could not recommend the place more.

A lovely studio with incredible views and great location. Mariana was the perfect host, sharing local recommendations and leaving thoughtful gifts in the apartment for my arrival. A lovely option in the centre of the historic part of Lisbon.

I can’t find enough amazing words to say about this place! The view is INCREDIBLE. Antonio and Mariana were wonderful hosts, and they provided great recommendations for restaurants and places to visit around Lisbon. The location is extremely convenient - just a 2 min walk to the tram stop and within walking distance to several restaurants, cafés, and viewpoints. The bed was cozy, and the fan provided was strong enough to keep the whole space comfortable throughout the day and at night.
We were excited about this apartment just based off the photos posted, but honestly it was even better in person. I would recommend this place and the Alfama neighborhood to anyone visiting Lisbon! Thank you, Antonio and Mariana, for one of the main highlights of our trip to Portugal!
Lovely little flat in a great area. Mariana also have us some good recommendations for restaurants which were delicious!

Lovely apartment with amazing views. Perfect for a few nights in Lisbon. Close to the city and most of the sights.
The apartment was on the 4th floor with no lift, this wasn’t a problem for us but something to bear in mind with luggage.
Overall, amazing! Thank you.

The view from this little flat is absolutely incredible and makes your heart sing each morning as you look out over the rooves of Alfama and beyond to the River Tagus. The neighbourhood is wonderful too - lots of ancient winding alley ways and little squares with bars and restaurants. You couldn’t ask for a better location. We loved it

Cute apartment, perfect for 1-2 people. View from the balcony is absolutely beautiful. The fan provided was sufficient to cool the space without AC. Location is great because it’s in the heart of the neighborhood but off on a quiet, residential street. Host was communicative when we had an issue with our key. Be aware that it is on the top floor of the building, so you have to climb and carry your luggage up 4 flights of stairs!
A lovely little apartment with a gorgeous view of the river. Great communication too. We had a lovely stay!

Mariana and Antonio, we fantastic hosts and so accommodating! They left us a wine in the fridge during our welcome and even took in our luggage before the Apartment was ready for us so we could do some sightseeing! The apartment is on the top floor and there are no elevators, so pack lightly! They were quick in responding to our messages and even recommended amazing places to eat! Everything is as described and Hope to be back soon! Thank you again Antonio and Mariana

My girlfriend and I had a perfect stay at Antonio and Mariana’s Alfama apartment. When we arrived, Mariana met us at our car (there is no access by car to the apartment so we parked a bit away) and she graciously helped us carry our bags up the street and apartment stairs. The apartment had everything we needed for a two night stay but would have been perfect for even longer. The view is just as amazing as the pictures. We also tried some of Mariana’s recommendations for food nearby and were thoroughly impressed. We hope to return again soon!
Cozy apartment in a good location & with an amazing view!
really nice stay!

Antonio and Mariana were so helpful and great with communication during our stay! The apartment itself is in a fantastic location that in Lisbon, great views. We will be back again someday and would recommend to anyone!

très joli appartement, au calme dans l'Alfama.
Parfait!

The apartment is located beautifully in the district of Alfama, gorgeous view over the roofs and the water. Everything was super clean and as described. The personal welcome is a huge benefit as you get tips on what restaurants and bakeries are worth a visit as well as activities to do nearby.
Fully recommend.
Lovely apartment, exactly as in the listing. The hosts are incredibly accommodating and their recommendations for local bars and restaurants were great.

Mariana is an exceptional host! We had an amazing time in their cozy AirBnB in Alfama. The location is beautiful and on the quiet side, but close to many incredible historic sites and the “hustle and bustle” of Lisbon. Many great restaurants and bars in the area, and the view from the terrace simply can not be beat. We enjoyed ourselves immensely. Thank you, Mariana and António!
A very stylish, comfortable, well located space in Alfama with an outstanding host in Mariana. She was kind, patient, and had outstanding suggestions.
Great host!!
Ich kann nichts neues hinzufügen, es wurde alles schon beschrieben. Hat uns super gut gefallen. Tolle Lage, schönes Apartment, absolut empfehlenswert!

Wow! Such helpful AirBnB hosts. We loved their dining recommendations and they even called a taxi for us to leave for the airport. A great AirBnB if you don’t have a rental car and are mostly on foot. Amazing view! Cozy bed and lovely space. Thank you so much! Patio 13 was delicious, also.
Very nice flat in a beautiful area! :-)
such a gorgeous apartment and perfect location to explore Lisbon. great value, and our hosts were incredibly helpful and responsive. highly recommend :)
This is in the heart of Alfama, Lisbon. So much history and things to see. The home is cozy and has all you need. The view is incredible and worth the 5 flight of stairs!

This apartment is in the perfect location of Alfama. The forth floor so lots of stairs… but the view is worth it for sure! Perfect size for a couple and has all the amenities you need. Hope to be back again someday!
Amazing views, location and hosts. Definitely would recommend to anyone wanting to see the older parts of Lisbon.

Great host, beautiful apartment. Responded quickly to messages. I would give one tip to anyone staying here. Ask the host for the quickest route down to the coastal streets. It makes for an easier walk to downtown ( Lisbon can feel like your constantly walking on a stair master).

We had a perfect stay in Lisbon! We were greeted upon our arrival by Mariana and she was such a gracious host to show us around the apartment, tell us about the neighborhood, and even provide recommendations of local spots to eat and drink. The view was even better than the pictures (and better even than some of the popular scenic viewpoints in the city center). Couldn’t recommend this spot enough.

Un GRAND merci à Mariana pour son accueil chaleureux et sa disponibilité tout au long de notre séjour! Un appartement très cosy et très bien situé au cœur d’Alfama. Une adresse à garder précieusement!

We had a fantastic time and absolutely recommend staying here! The apartment was exactly as listed and was well-equipped for our stay. Communication was great and check-in/out were very easy. The location is perfect and we loved exploring the neighborhood. There were so many great restaurants, bars, and places to hear Fado. We hope to visit again!
Absolutely lovely apartment, located quietly in the heard of the city, nice and helpful owners - would love to come back.

Beautiful apartment is Alfama area. Please take time to explore the are!  The apartment is clean-tiny by American standards but everything two people would need. The shower is great. Hot water and great water pressure. Beautiful sea breeze coming in the balcony door.  Would definitely stay again.
Comfortable apartment with stunning view  of the city! The host was very welcoming and had great recommendations for local spots.

It was hard to find at first and when we arrived the walk of shame up a million stairs ( 4 floors) was enough for anyone to reconsider their fitness level but once you step into this little OASAS with a spectacular view which is to die for you forget about the stairs until you have to do it again. The host was lovely and the place had everything we needed. We had a wonderful stay and the location was perfect , allowing us to visit so many local restaurants and being right on the waterfront was awesome watching the cruise lines comes in. The bottle of red wine was a nice added touch. Oops was I not to mention that Cus now you might be on the hook to provide it to every guest which I’m pretty sure was the case. Cheers 🥂
We will most definitely be back. Stairs and all lol 😆
Great location, close to a lot of bars and restaurants. Very good host.

Great apartment in a fab location and at a reasonable price. Not much more to say.
Would highly recommend!
Beautiful spot, very clean and close location to downtown Lisbon

Alfama views is fabulous apartment in the heart of the Alfama. It is close to all the excitement of the Alfama and walking distance to many things. the view itself is to die for. The apartment is well equipped for cooking small meals. It has a really cozy bed and a very comfortable sofa to set and look out.Granted you have to climb 55 stairs to get the top but it is well worth it. We were greeted by Antonio’s wife Mariana, who gave us great recommendations for dinner and helped us get a taxi for an early morning departure. This was a wonderful experience for us

Nous avons passez un très bon séjour. L’appartement est très joli, très propre idéalement situé en plein cœur du quartier historique avec une superbe vue. Nous avons été très bien accueillis par Mariana qui nous a conseillé quelques bons restaurants…

We were able to spend two super great days in Lisbon. The apartment of Antonio & Mariana was perfect for this. The view over the rooftops of Alfama and the Tejo is amazing. Mariana welcomed us warmly and showed us everything.
The curtains in the apartment do not darken, so it is light in the room quickly in the morning. Has not bothered us personally very much.
We were super happy :)

António and Mariana’s apartment is the perfect base for exploring Lisbon. It’s the cleanest AirBnB I’ve ever stayed in and has everything you could need for a comfortable stay. The view of the river is unbeatable (the pictures don’t do it justice!). We will definitely stay here again if we return to Lisbon.

Very cute apartment with an amazing view of the water! Mariana was very helpful in providing suggestions and always responded quickly. She met us at check-in and even helped carry our (very heavy) suitcases up the 4 flights of stairs. As other reviews mention, be prepared for narrow, steep stairs to get up to the apartment. Alfama ended up being our favorite neighborhood in Lisbon - so much character and charm - and still walking distance to most of the main sites, with the exception of Belem Tower and Jeronimos Monastery. Highly recommend this apartment!

As many have already mentioned, the location of this apartment is ideal. Within walking distance to many attractions. The views are fantastic and the place has all of the amenities we required. We are thrilled to have chosen this location and highly recommend it. If you have trouble climbing stairs this apartment and the area in general may be too much to handle. We loved the exercise!

We had a wonderfull stay in Lisbon at Mariana and António’s place! Very good located, close to everything, very close to Tram28, metrostation, restaurants,… If you need anything, we could ask and Mariana’s tips were very good! Thank you!
A great apartment that was quiet and relaxing while be in a central and historic neighborhood.  Mariana welcomed us personally and gave us a tour of the apartment.  Thank you!
A fabulous apartment in a great location. The Airbnb was super clean and cosy with fantastic views.

Really nice apartment in a great location. Lovely apartment with beautiful views from the balcony, and great host who communicates well and has great recommendations for where to eat like a local.
Wear comfortable shoes beacuse the stair are a killer but totally worth it.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and appreciated the beautiful design and many thoughtful touches. The location is wonderful with an excellent view and makes you feel like a true local living in quiet and quaint Alfama neighborhood. It is fully renovated and upgraded but highlights the old charm with original wood touches. It was sparkling clean and I really appreciated the espresso machine and kettle for morning coffee and evening tea. The bed is comfortable and shower heats up quick with great pressure! Antonio and his wife Mariana met us and greeted us warmly carrying our heavy bags up and showing us around. All of their recommendations were fabulous!We would absolutely recommend!
The apartment is exactly as described and really charming. It’s a great place to stay in Lisbon. The welcome from the host exceeded my expectations with a few nice touches.
Es war wunderschön! Die Gastgeberin war super nett und die Lage war auch ein Traum! Gerne wieder.

Nous recommandons chaleureusement ce logement, très propre, décoré avec goût et situé idéalement. Nous avons pu savourer la vue, et tout visiter à pied. Le quartier historique de l'Alfama est superbe, et l'accueil qui nous a été réservé fut parfait. Nous avons apprécié la communication réactive et détaillée de nos hôtes. Merci encore pour ce séjour.

Great airbnb with a beautiful view of Lisbon in the lovely neighborhood of Alfama. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay, communication with the host was easy and they gave us some amazing recommendations. Would stay again!

We absolutely loved our time here and would book again. Mariana gave us such a warm welcome and we tried out so many of her recommended bars and restaurants. They all had a great local feel - we loved going to Alfama 12 for our morning pastel de nata and A Murahla for lovely fresh fish. The location couldn't be better - you're right in the heart of Alfama - and the view was breathtaking. Thanks again!
We loved the apartment, beautiful place in a very interesting part of the city. Mariana was there a waiting for us and was very helpful and kind. We enjoyed our few days very much 😊
What a lovely place to stay! This cozy apartment has so much charm and the view is incredible! Mariana was friendly and very responsive!

Amazing stay in the old Alfama district with golden views! From the moment of arrival we felt very welcome. The host was very friendly. Communication and service were great. The apartment is on the top floor from the building. The interior is lovely and gives warm vibes with eye for detail. The bed slept very well. The bathroom was creatively designed and very nice. Overall the whole experience was amazing! Definitely a recommendation!

일주일동안 너무 행복했던 숙소였어요! 뷰가 엄청나서 매일 집에서 노을을 즐겼고 집의 인테리어도 완벽했어요. 맨 꼭대기 층이라 짐옮기기가 힘들지만 체크인&체크아웃 두번다 짐을 옮겨주셔서 너무 감사했습니다! 다음에도 리스본에 오면 이 숙소에 무조건 묵고싶습니다

파두박물관 쪽으로 걸어내려가면 금방 번화가에 도착 할 수 있어서 좋았습니다!
the perfect host, very accommodating, really friendly and let us check in early. gave us a bottle of wine also which was so kind !
Wonderful stay! I will definitely come back!
very nice and clean apartment with a great view
Great views and amazing location!

Maravillosa estancia en Alfama. Nos alojamos en este precioso alojamiento durante dos noches y nos encantó. El apartamento impecable y precioso, con unas vistas inmejorables. Y Mariana fue muy amable con nosotros en todo momento. La calle era muy tranquila y segura, y con el encanto natural de Alfama. Gracias por esta experiencia!!

Amazing !
the place is really cozy and very clean.
perfectly located.
you will enjoy the view on the balcony.
Mariana welcomed us and left a bottle of good wine, really appreciated after the walk.
definitely recommend it.

We stayed a week in this cosy, nicely renovated top floor appartment. The appartment is nicely located in lively and authentic Alfama. We especially enjoyed the beautiful view of colorful houses and the river Tagus. Marianna and Antonio are excellent hosts.
After staying here for a visit in Lisbon, you’ll never want to stay anywhere else in Lisbon. We came here for the second time and it was as perfect as the girst

A really lovely apartment in the heart of Alfama with the most incredible views; I could have spent a week just looking out the window! Small but perfectly formed with everything you could need and plenty of shops and restaurants on hand.
We had an amazing time and loved every minute of our stay in Lisbon. It was perfect and Mariana was incredibly helpful. Thank you! Fully recommend staying here and hope to be back,

Agréable séjour passé à cet endroit, parfait pour visiter le quartier historique, et la vue magnifique depuis le balcon; Mariana nous a très bien accueilli et conseillé différentes adresses locales pour déjeuner et dîner, très réactive à la moindre questions, je recommande fortement pour ceux qui veulent découvrir la capitale !

All around amazing! Ideal location, beautiful views, updated & comfortable apartment with everything you need. Mariana was SO helpful during our short stay. She was great with communication, gave good local recommendations, and even helped get our bags up the stairs! It is a 4th floor walk-up just to be aware, but well worth it :)

Een echte aanrader! Super goede communicatie met de host.
En wanneer je dan boven komt…dat uitzicht 😍
Er is echt aan alles gedacht! Zelfs douchegel, voor als je die zelf vergeten bent…
Schoon, gezellig ingericht en midden in het gezellige Alfama. Vanuit het appartement kun je alle bezienswaardigheden in Lissabon op loopafstand bezoeken.
Ook de tips die Mariana ons gegeven heeft, waren heel fijn!

Hier gibt es absolut nichts auszusetzen. Hervorragende, super saubere Wohnung mitten in Alfama mit Blick aufs Wasser. Die Hosts sind super freundlich und unkompliziert und stehen jederzeit bei Fragen zur Verfügung. Absoluter Glücksgriff!

Queria agradecer Mariana e Antonio pela simpatia e flexibilidade. Tinha que chegar antes do horario de check-in e Mariana e Antonio adaptaram-se para receber-me antes.
O apartamento é bem localisado e à proxima de tudo. Se pode andar de pe ate ao Rossio.
Estava limpo e bem ordenado.
Fui uma boa estadia. Voltarei !☺

Perfect location in Lisbon, the balcony views are just as stunning as the photos show. The wifi was fast enough to work remote and stream with no issues. I appreciated the special touches and local suggestions our host provided.

We can highly recomment Antónios and Marianas AirBnB. It is located in the center for Alfama in the highest floor of the building. From the small balcony you have a beautiful view over Alfama and towards the sea.
The appartement was very clean, well equipped and lovely furnished.
Marianas was quick to respond to messages and gave us many recommandations for what to do and see close by. She also made an early checkin possible, which was very pleasant because we arrived from the airport in the moring and were happy to place your bags in the appartement.
Thanks for everythings!

A fantastic and well equipped apartment with stunning views over the river and Alfama. Couldn't reccommend enough, great location only a short walk to the city center and perfect for a getaway to Lisbon. We will definitely be back again!

Nous avons passé un séjour très agréable chez Antonio et Mariana.
L’appartement est joliment décoré et très bien situé. La vue sur le Tage est à couper le souffle et les hôtes sont très attentionnés et pleins de bons conseils.
On recommande vivement !

We absolutely loved our stay here. The views from the balcony are unbelievable, especially if you can catch the sunrise. It was cozy and comfortable and there were so many sweet touches. The stairs could be an issue for some, but it was more than worth the climb for us. Very convenient location and Mariana gave us some great recommendations for restaurants, cafes, etc. We would definitely stay here again!

Very friendly and welcoming host. We really enjoyed our stay with an excellent view in a quiet neighborhood. Many sights are within a short distance or you can take the famous tram to the city centre. The apartment was clean and well equipped. After exploring the city we always looked forward returning to it for a nice evening at home, maybe with some Ginja.

This apartment is above and beyond in every way . Antonio is a great communicator and very helpful. Lisbon has so much to offer and to experience life in  Alfama is a bonus . We will definitely return.
Great location. Make sure you can do some stairs. Host gave us great information on things to see/do and restaurants where the locals eat. We had so much fun in this locale. View is awesome!

António and Mariana’s apartment was great — convenient location to the various neighborhoods & sights, a beautiful view of the river and Alfama neighborhood and very clean. António and Mariana were fantastic hosts as well! Mariana was there to greet us when we arrived and get us settled into the apartment and provided great dining recommendations. We enjoyed our stay so much and will definitely be back!

Great communication, Mariana met us right at the location and was very understanding and nice when we got delayed for several hours at Customs. She also provided great references and we ended up eating at all of her recommendations for breakfast, lunch and dinner and loved it. The place was spotless and provided amazing Oceanside views with beautiful sunsets every night. 10/10
Me and my daughter loved it a lot, especially the small balcony where you can sit in the sunlight from dusk till dawn.

L'appartement est comme sur les photos, jolie et très propre. Il est bien situé au coeur de l'alfama avec une super vue ! La communication avec antonio est facile et il est attentionné. Bref une bonne adresse !
Everything was perfect!

Great location in the city! Mariana and Antonio keep the place very clean and well decorated. Mariana was very helpful with our check in and even carried a suitcase up the stairs for us.
In the heart of a beautiful neighborhood, but still quiet at night so it is easy to sleep.
Definitely recommend this place!

The airbnb was wonderful! Very clean and comfortable. It had everything we need and Mariana was very helpful. She left us a bottle of wine that we enjoyed while taking in the amazing view from the balcony. Something to note is that it was tricky for the Uber app to figure out our location so you may need to carry luggage a little farther. Thank you - we’ll be back someday soon!
Clean apartment in a beautiful neighborhood with a stunning view!
We would totally recommend this place! The apartment is really clean, has an amazing view, the location is also good & the hosts are so friendly & kind!
Great place for exploring!

Incredible view, clean apartment and an extremely kind host who was always available, gave us great advice and was there to meet us on arrival, help with our bags and even left us a wine!  The neighbourhood is beautiful, although a 25 minute walk from some of Lisbon's other nightlife areas that we spent the most time in.

Mariana and Antonio were amazing hosts. Mariana met us at check-in, helped us with our bags, gave us amazing recommendations for things to do/see/eat around Alfama and Lisboa. She was incredibly responsive to our messages when we were seeking advice on where to get a COVID test and sent us a bunch of great recs for restaurants that are not tourist traps :) Would recommend this airbnb to any of our friends/family. It was clean, cute, and the pictures on the listing do not do the view justice! Such an incredible airbnb experience. Thanks to Mariana and Antonio!

Hervorragendes Appartement - sauber, gut eingerichtet und mit hervorragendem Blick auf den Tejo über die Altstadt von Alfama. Eine bessere Unterkunft hätte man sich nicht wünschen können. Die Hosts sind super erreichbar, haben eine gute und schnelle Kommunikation und geben zudem viele tolle Tipps für den Aufenthalt in Lissabon. Einer der besten Urlaube, die wir bisher hatten! Tausend Dank!

It was a very nice stay in this cosy apparment in the heart of Alfama.
The reccommendations of Mariana were awesome and we´ve had wonderufl evenings based on these fantastic restaurant tips.
The view from the balcony over the city to the Tejo river is stunning!
This very clean and comfortable appartment is highly reccomended!

Lovely apartment, very great location clean and cozy with all the amenities.  Note that it is a 4th story walk up.  Hospitality by the host was fantastic with complementary offerings.  Lisboa is amazing!

This is an amazing spot- very clean and accommodating, AMAZING river views, simply perfect. It was just what we were looking for and we are so happy to have spent the first couple of nights of our honeymoon here. Truly a wonderful location and the great recommendations from hosts on places to visit, restaurants to try, etc. will be coming back!!
Emily and Joe

We had an excellent stay at Alfama. We are a little couple and this apartment was the perfect Romantic place. The view is awesome and it’s very well situated ! We loved the charming streets and walking through Lisboa. There are lots of cute restaurants !
We thanks Mariana for a particular good welcome and all recommandations.
I recommend it blindly !!
Super schön, ruhig, sauber, großartiger Blick! absolute Weiterempfehlung! Wir kommen wieder!

We loved our stay! The location was perfect for us, and the view of the river (over Alfama) is stunning. Even though we travelled in August the flat was nice and cool at night.
Mariana was a great host and gave us some excellent recommendations. Our personal favourite is Pateo 13 - fresh sardines, great wine and very reasonable prices. Also just a few steps away from the apartment.
If you’re looking to visit Alfama, this is the place to stay!

10 out of 10. Mariana met us at the apartment and let us in. Wonderful clean small apartment. Great view with a little balcony. Mariana had great suggestions (go to the fado restaurants!).
The only thing to be aware of is that this is the top floor after a lot of stairs, in a neighborhood that is very old and steep with lots of hills and stairs. If you have trouble walking then maybe not the apartment or neighborhood for you. This wasn’t an issue for us at all but just letting you know. We would stay again if we return to Lisbon!

Un très bel appartement, décoré avec goût, fonctionnel et idéalement situé dans le quartier de l’Alfama. Mariana et António sont des hôtes adorables et très réactifs. Nous avons passé avec mon compagnon un excellent séjour, je recommande chaleureusement !

You won't regret booking this great apartment. It's comfortable, clean, has a great view and the location in the old Alfama neighborhood is perfect, close to bars, restaurants and tram 28. We loved the place and will definitely book it again when returning! Thanks Mariana and Antonio for the warm welcome, restaurant suggestions and the delicious bottle of wine!!

Cute little apartment in the heart of Lisbon. Helpful hosts. We liked it here very much.
Note that road accessibility is limited and there is a steep stair case, so if you have health troubles (walking, body weight) you should be aware of that.

One of the greatest apartments I ever been. Perfect location, very clean and Antonio and Mariana are so friendly hosts. Hope I can come back every soon.
Can definitely recommend. :)

Difficile de donner moins de 5 étoiles.
Propreté irréprochable, très bonne communication avec l’hôte.
Localisation idéale pour découvrir le quartier d’Alfama. Tram 28E à 2 minutes de l’appartement !
Les équipements étaient de bonne qualité.
Le vrai truc de « fou », c’est la vue sur le Taje. Très agréable. L’air circule d’ailleurs bien dans l’appartement.

We absolutely loved staying at António and Mariana their place. The view from the appartement is lovely, the place is clean, has a great location and all the facilities you can ask for. Mariana provided us with great recommendations for restaurants & watching the fado. We would highly recommend this place!
Tiny but perfectly formed apartment with great views right in the heart of Alfama. A little hot and noisy at night but there is a fan which was useful. Hosts were very helpful and quick to respond.

It was the most beautifulapartmenti have stayed in lisboa! I will come back.
Central, cozy, best view! Clear recommendation
magnifique appartement, localisation parfaite, vue splendide, aucun point négatif. hôte très sympathique et réactif, nous a indiqué les bons plans du quartier. foncez !

Super séjour chez Mariana et Antonio ! Emplacement parfait au coeur d’Alfama, vue imprenable !
Mariana nous a donné de tres bonnes adresses.
Merci pour cette réactivité et gentillesse !

Mariana and Antonio
Are warm hosts! The apartment is beautifully furnished and in a great location. On the 4th floor we had a unique view! We received a good tip for dinner and they even deposited a welcome gift for us. This is how we imagine Lisbon! We had absolutely nothing to complain about and recommend it to everyone.

One of the best Airbnbs I have stayed at, hands down.
What I liked:
- great location
- modern feel and stylish interior design without the typical IKEA signature
- incredible south facing old town view and lots of light in the apartment
- great bed
- modern bathroom
- well-equipped kitchen (no oven though)
- tucked away from big roads
- the hosts are super nice and helpful with anything you may want
- Mariana made sure I always have fresh towels & sheets (stayed for 6 weeks)
Important:
- the neighbors’ dog is a yapper
- neighbors smoke
- internet speed of the neighborhood (early 2021) is good for most digital work but may at times not be fast/stable enough for video calls. ~10mbit /1.5mbit Mariana went out of her way to find solutions for me, so you don’t need to let this limit you
I strongly recommend this place for short and long stays.
Una estancia genial dentro de alfama, para repetir.
Impecável! Não tenho qualquer queixa, recomendo!
Lovely place with a fantastic view. Thoughtful homey touches and books throughout the home. Worth staying for several days to take in Alfama and it’s stunning views

This is THE place to stay in Lisbon! Such a lovely apartment with amazing views and a nice vibe. I truly had the best time and loved every minute of my time in Lisbon and in the apartment. It was perfect and nothing could have made it better. Thank you! Fully recommend staying here.

When we entered the apartment, we immediately had the feeling of “woooowww amazing”. The view, the music, as we were lucky to be there during the fado concerts. The place is perfectly situated and has all you need. Not always easy to find your way in the little streets/stairs but so beautiful. We definitely will come back. Thanks again Mariana and Antonio. Stay safe 🙏🏻

L’appartement est idéalement situé, propre, et la vue est superbe sur l’Alfama !
António et Mariana vous accueilleront et vous conseilleront des adresses du quartier à faire absolument !
A great place to stay in Lisbon. Great view and really central. Thoroughly recommend.
Beautiful apartment in the middle of Alfama. Very clean and fantastic view over the river and the city. We received many helpful tips for our stay in Lisbon. We definitely want to come again.

Eine sehr schöne „kleine“ Wohnung über den Dächern der Altstadt von Lissabon. Einen Aufenthalt in dieser Wohnung kann ich nur empfehlen.
Die Lage ist sehr zentral und man kann dort alles gute zu Fuß erreichen.
Einfach herrlich.

We had a very delayed flight getting to Lisbon and the hosts were so incredibly accommodating. The views from the flat are just incredible and the area was perfect. We have an incredibly stay and the apartment was absolutely fantastic. Highly recommend!

The apartment was overwhelming! It was very clean and comfortable; has cosy decoration, is right in the middle of the best quarter of Lisbon but was still calm at night. The tram is just 2 minutes away, also restaurants and cafes are close by. Be aware though that this is Lisbon - for a nice view out of your window you have to climb some stairs :) communication was easy and fast, I was welcomed personally and got very good Tipps by a local. Highly recommended!
Die Unterkunft war super. Sehr gute Lage und super schöne Aussicht. Die Kommunikation hat aich perfekt geklappt und war super einfach zidem erhielten wir super gute Tipps was man machen kann.
Lovely Airbnb, fabulous view from the balcony :)

This place was perfectly located  - everything was within walking distance and had beautiful views of the river and city. Mariana provided great recommendations & tips for our stay in Lisbon - we couldn’t have asked for anything more!!

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour chez nos hôtes !
L’appartement est très fonctionnel, agréable et bien décoré .
La vue est magnifique ! Un gros plus !
La localisation est parfaite pour explorer Lisbonne .
Nos hôtes nous ont fourni de bons conseils pour nos sorties.
Les petites attentions sont très agréables.
Je recommande sans hésitation pour profiter de Lisbonne!
Merci beaucoup !

Amazing flat with even better views. We went to many of Mariana’s recommended local spots and all were great. She even gave us a free bottle of local wine to welcome us to the flat! Would recommend to anyone and would DEFINITELY book again :)

We really felt at home away from home. The apartment has everything you need and has a very nice design and an amazing view over the roofs of Alfama. Is is very central and nevertheless really quiet. Very recommendable and Antonio was a very friendly and welcoming host.

Un airbnb parfait: une vue imprenable sur la ville, une localisation idéale, des hôtes charmants et réactifs, la propreté de l’appartement est irréprochable. Quelques petites attentions très agréables à l’arrivée. Nous reviendrons sans aucun doute.

The small apartment is perfectly located in the old town where I found lots of good restaurants. Mariana was very kind and she recommended places to visit and typical places to eat. The apartment is on the top floor of an old residential building with a wonderful view to the river. Great to enjoy the evenings with a glass of wine. The balcony is very small and only fits one half chair. For me it was perfect and would recommend the place without hesitation. Thank you.

El apartamento está genial y ubicado en el barrio con más encanto de Lisboa. Cómo tantos otros barrios en Lisboa tiene muchísimas cuestas pero eso forma parte de su encanto. El apartamento tiene unas escaleras un pelín empinadas pero salvo que tengas alguna limitación de movilidad no tendrás ningún problema y vale la pena conocerlo porque tiene además unas vistas increíbles. Mariana y Antonio están muy pendientes de todo, sin duda una opción muy muy muy recomendable

Die Wohnung ist super schön. Es war alles sauber und sehr stimmig eingerichtet.
Ganz besonders haben wir den Ausblick über die Altstadt von Lissabon und den Fluss genossen.
Wir wurden von Mariana sehr herzlich empfangen und bekamen Tipps für lokale Restaurants und besonders sehenswerte Plätze.

Es Wagnis jetzt für mich die beste Unterkunft. Gastgeber unglaublich nett und offen, immer bereit schnell zu antworten. Leider war mein Flug zu spät aber trotzdem sind sie für mich da gewesen. Es wird mein Aufenthalt in Lissabon für immer sein. Schon der Aussicht wegen. Es ist einfach atemberaubend. Am besten selbst sehen

L’appartement bénéficie d’une localisation et d’une vue exceptionnelle. Il est très confortable et bien équipé. L’accueil de Mariana a été excellent, avec le souci de nous donner des bonnes adresses etc. Bref à essayer sans hésiter !
The appartment is in Alfama, a very nice and local neighbourhood! The appartment was very clean and looked so cute. Everything was perfect.
Perfect place!!! I loved waking up to the view and the location is amazing! It has everything you need! The steps are good exercise, but best if you pack light.

five stars all around! my husband and i had the best time here. the apartment was sparkling clean and the area is perfect, we walked the whole weekend and saw all of the sights. the apartment was quiet and stayed nice and cool at night, especially with the big fan. mariana was so kind and gave us great tips. i would recommend this place to everyone!
This is a little gem. It’s both beautifully designed and thoughtful touches throughout. Yet the main wow factor is the view from the balcony and location in Alfama. We will be back!

This is potentially the best Airbnb experience we’ve had so far. The flat looks gorgeous on the pictures already, but it feels a lot bigger in real life. And as with most beautiful things, the photos don’t do the view justice. We loved sitting by the balcony, by day or night, drinking the lovely wine António had left for us. Gazing at the view. Just watching time go by. Yes, I almost died climbing those stairs every night, but it was all worth it. We’re planning on going back to Lisbon and we wouldn’t stay anywhere else.

숙소 뷰, 인테리어 모두 너무 좋아요!
다만 엘리베이터가 없어서 캐리어가 많으신 분들은 힘드실거에요ㅜㅜ

A great airbnb to visit Lisboa! The apartment is really quiet and very cozy. It's only a few minutes to walk to get some grocery and find some great breakfast. Antonio is a really nice host with some special recommendations. The communication was always fast. It was a very nice weekend in Lisboa and i can highly recommend his airbnb! Thank you so much!

Antonio’s place is the place to stay at if you’re in Lisbon! The co host Marianna made me feel very welcome and was very patient to wait for me to arrive.  I was very satisfied with my stay here. Only downside is their steep staircase. However, the view was so good it was worth the extra steps! Give this a place a try when you’re in Lisboa!

We had a great stay at António’s place. The home itself was lovely, and the bottle of wine and pastis was a welcome surprise.
Just as a note, the location can be a bit tricky to get to when carrying luggage.
היה אחלה

Antonio and Mariana are super hosts !
Quick answers on our questions, ready to help and to give some places to go...
The apartment is at like +-10min of the Praça do Comercio and not far from the Castelo. Advantage : a really calm neighborhood...
The apartment isnt that big, but in Lisbonne it isnt a problem because you have to be outside all day long.
Thanks Antonio and Mariana for your hospitality !

My husband and I had a wonderful stay in Antonio’s apartment! The apartment is stylish and really tastefully decorated. The view really is beautiful! Mariana was outside to greet us on arrival, giving us a warm welcome and some great recommendations of places to visit and eat etc. The pastel de natas and wine were a lovely personal touch and much appreciated! Thank you Antonio and Mariana!

This was a really wonderful apartment, with a great view. It was clean and comfortable and in a great location. Antonio, the host was very welcoming and gave us some really useful tips for our stay. We would definitely recommend this place and we hope to return sometime soon.
뷰가 너무 좋아요! 짐이 많았지만 호스트가 마중나와 옥상까지 짐 옮기는걸 도와줘서 크게 불편하지는 않았습니다. 밤에는 난방이 따로 안돼서 좀 추울 수도 있어요!
Fantastic hosts, fantastic Airbnb! Would definitely stay here again if I returned to Lisbon.

Be prepared for a lot of stairs in Alfama. It’s such a charming part of town, and all those stairs add up to some amazing views. You definitely get that with this unit. I could have spent the entire trip looking out the French doors at the enchanting neighborhood. The hosts are thoughtful and have prepared a particularly nice place to stay in Lisbon.

The location speaks for itself. Great. Really cosy and clean place. Antonio and Mariana were very friendly and communicative wrt everything practical and (of course) very helpful and let us stay extended due to airline challenges. Highly recommendable

Hele leuke locatie in het oude  Lissabon met uitzicht over de daken naar de zee. Het appartement is 1 trap verwijderd van de halte van het oude trammetje 28E. Er mogen  alleen taxi's het gebied inrijden. Handig om te weten als je een transfer regelt. We werden vriendelijk ontvangen door Sara, die ons alles uitlegde en António stuurde ons nog hele leuke tips van restaurantjes, waar je o.a. ook live Fado muziek kon luisteren. Een aanrader voor een paar dagen Lissabon!

숙소가 4층이고 계단이 비좁아서 케리어를 들고 올라가기 힘든점이 있지만 안토니오가 직접 마중나와서 케리어까지 들어줍니다.  숙소는 정말청결하고 테라스에서 보는 뷰는 정말 훌륭합니다. 라디에이터가 있긴하지만 잘 때 추우니깐 따뜻한 잠옷꼭 챙겨오시길~ 그것빼곤 정말 좋은 숙소였습니다!  또 안토니오가 체크인할때 너무 친절하게 주변정보와 맛집을 알려주고 깜짝선물을 주는데 최고입니다. 다시가고싶은숙소입니다

Eine wunderschöne süße kleine Wohnung mit atemberaubenden Ausblick! Die Wohnung ist sauber und mit allem ausgestattet und befindet sich in einer tollen Wohngegend. Und António war ein super Host! Wir kommen gerne wieder!!

We enjoyed a stunning view from this cozy apartment, which is ideally located in the center of Alfama. Our host met us at the apartment, offered suggestions for dining and sightseeing and was in good communication. We recommend this to people who are both traveling to Lisbon for the first time and know the city well.
Le logement est exactement comme sur les photos; idéalement situé,  cosy, propreté irréprochable,  une vue splendide et Antonio un hôte discret et efficace.

This is An amazing air B and B! The location is great, though that part of the city is a little confusing to navigate but António and his wife do a great job of giving you helpful hints for not getting lost! The apartment is beautiful! Couldn’t have asked for a better experience!
Great place! Really fun and traditional location and a beautiful cozy space. Check in/out were a little awkward but the airbnb was worth it.
AMAZING stay, thank you so much Antonio!

This apartment is really cute and the pictures are accurate. It is a bit difficult to assess because cars are not allowed in the neighborhood so it takes about 10-15 on foot uphill to reach which is difficult with heavy luggage. It is also located on the fourth floor. I think although the apartment was beautiful, it is a bit steep for the price because housing is not too expensive in Lisbon. The apartment also does not include any shampoo/conditioner which is fine but just something to keep in mind to bring yourself. The wifi unfortunately malfunctioned when we stayed there which made the experience less pleasant but that could just be a one time mishap. It is also quite cold in the winter and the heater does not work very well.
Dtdesgdjfus

Wow! Antonio's place is amazing as soon as you walk in you get a view of the area and the pretty buildings. His apartment is clean and stylish and has everything you need. Also, the LOCATION! I like the old school feels and walking around the buildings. They're also places to eat and drink in the area. Antonio also gave us suggestions and replied fast when needed.

Everything about António's apartment was absolutely lovely and spot on (minus the steep stairs up! But that's unavoidable. Worked the legs very well haha). The views from the balcony were lush (and we were blessed with amazing weather), the space was just so cute (and smelt delicious), everything was clean, we felt safe and the bed was so comfy. Communication and recommendations from António was quick and easy - his friend Sara was also lovely letting us in. Overall we had an amazing stay without any complications whatsoever. Will definitely choose António's place next time I'm in town! Thank you António and Sara!

This is a nice apartment to stay in- very clean and modern amenities. Beautiful view overlooking the Tagus. The hosts are fantastic, very communicative during checkin. They even brought traditional Portuguese pastries and have tons of recommendations.
The location is in Alfama, charming tiny streets. It can be a bit hard to find the exact address on your own. The apartment on floor 5, no elevator, so people who have trouble with stairs may have difficulty.

안토니오는 정말 친절한 호스트에요
체크아웃하고 밖에 나왔는데 포르투로 가는 기차가 취소돼서 안토니오에게 어떻게 해야 할지 물어봤는데 자세히 답변해줘서 정말 도움이 많이 됐어요. 체크인할때는 집 안까지 캐리어 두개 다 옮겨주고 집에 대해서도 자세하고 친절하게 설명해줘서 너무 좋았어요! 텔레비전 켜는 법, 문 잠그는 법, 창문 여는 법 등등 섬세하게 알려주고 로컬 맛집도 공유해줬어요 ㅠㅠ 집도 전반적으로 깔끔하고 공간도 넓어서 좋았습니다... 12월의 리스본은 한국의 겨울에 비해서 훨씬 따뜻했지만 잘때는 좀 춥더라구요... 라디에이터가 있어서 그걸로 버티긴 했는데 혹시나 여행 오시는 분들 따뜻한 잠옷 챙겨오세요! 아 그리고 캐리어 많고 무거우신 분들은 비추에요... 계단이 진짜 좁고 가파른 계단이라 체크아웃하고 캐리어 들고 계단내려가는데 너무너무 힘들었어요 중간에 발 헛디뎌서 계단에서 굴러 떨어질뻔. 솔직히 계단만 아니였으면 완벽한 집인데 캐리어 여행자들에겐 힘든... 그리고 알파마지구가 계단+오르막길 내리막길 천지라 캐리어 끌고 역이나 버스정류장까지 가기엔 위치가 별로더라고요... 우버도 일단 도로로 나가서 타야함 ㅠㅠ 그래도 짐 별로 없다 하시면 추천해요. 사진으로 보는 뷰랑 실제로 보는 뷰랑 다르더라고요 실제가 더 더 예쁘다는 얘기 ㅠㅠ 사진으로 안담겨요 진짜... 제가 머물었던 5일중 하루 빼고는 다 비바람이 불었지만 그래도 창밖 풍경은 너무 예뻤어요. 아 그뤼고 쥬뱡도 깨끗하긴 했는데 쉭기들이 좀 둬뤄웠워요 돠른 사람들이 쓴 거 댸충 헹궈서 놓은건지 뭔지 찻주전자에 마시던 차 그댸로 냠아있어서 좀 놀랐어요ㅋㅋ 그래도 식기는 씻어서 쓰면 되니까 상관없었어요... 슈세뮈도 줨 둬러웠어요 ㅠㅠ 아무튼 지옥의 계단만 아니면 정말 정말 추천하는 집이에요

They AirBnb is a gem. This was my husband and I's first time to Europe, let alone Portugal and we had the best experience, which included staying at the quaint, authentic property. Although it is located 4 stories up and nestled in a maze of winding coblestone streets, it is worth it! The view was spectacular! It is also located in the heart if the Alfama with many restaurants, bar, and bakeries within just steps. We were given some recommendations for Fado, food, and views and these were so helpful. A couple of my favorite meal experiences were based on these recommendations. Communication was prompt and the place was clean with nice personal touches such as coffee, tea, and wine for our enjoyment. We highly recommend this as a place to stay for an authentic stay in the Alfama with an amazing view!
Great location and view of the bay. Apartment is very cozy and clean. We stay in many places and this one would for sure stay again next time in Lisbon
Lovely apartment views are outstanding. Apartment was clean a bottle of wine and cakes waiting for us.Only slight problem stairs a bit steep but not a problem for us.
Antonio is an excellent host

António’s place is a secret gem. I would recommend anyone traveling to Lisbon for the first time to stay here as you will experience and learn a lot of history in this neighborhood. António also gave great local tips and recommendations in which I met some of the coolest people and ate delicious Portuguese food. Thank you António. Cheers.

We loved our time in Lisbon! Our statin Alfama was a highlight.  The view from the balcony and the cozy apartment made it hard to want to leave.  Thank you for the great tips.   Mimos was so good! The bottle of wine you left for us was wonderful as well.  We would recommend staying here to anyone!

My boyfriend and I stayed in Antonio’s apartment for 3 nights on vacation in Lisbon and thoroughly enjoyed it. Antonio was very responsive to our questions before and during our stay. He provided good recommendations of local restaurants. He also had a bottle of local wine and pastries for us upon our arrival which was lovely. Location was nice in a quiet historic neighborhood. We were able to walk to most places throughout the city. The stairs up to the apartment are quite tiring and narrow but the view from the apartment is incredible and definitely worth it. We had a great stay!
A great location with a fine view. The local tips were good, too.

Schöne Wohnung für 2 Personen, grandiose Aussicht in die Alfama und auf den Fluss, sehr gute Lage für Exkursionen, nette Nachbarschaft, ruhig, tolle Ausstattung und tolle Tipps vom Gastgeber. Extrem schnelles Antworten und sehr gut funktionierender Check-In. Sehr zu empfehlen.

This is the only place I ever want to stay in Lisbon. The space is EXACTLY as pictured. I took a picture of the view when we got in and side by side it looks exactly like the one in the posting. My husband and I stayed here for a few days and it was perfect for us. There is a great breakfast place (not always easy to find in Europe) nearby and a terrific Danish bakery where we picked up coffee/danishes and ate in the adorable breakfast nook. The bed was very comfy and the shower was great. Sitting in the living room area and staring out the window at Alfama was absolute heaven. This part of Alfama was the absolute best place to stay in Lisbon and it made our trip amazing. We were also met by a personal family friend who showed us the tips and tricks of staying in the apartment and gave us the fantastic breakfast recommendation we used. Would highly recommend!
António was a great host giving us awesome local tips and leaving us some treats to enjoy while taking in the view of the river.

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour.
L'appartement est idéalement placé.
Aussi joli que sur les photos.
Merci à Antonio de nous avoir attendus si tard car notre avion a eu beaucoup de retard et merci pour ses bonnes adresses.

What can I say about our hosts, they were amazing, very responsive, friendly, and willing to make our stay as comfortable as possible. This apartment is perfect for couples or someone looking for a great view in a serene ambiance. The views from the balcony are simply magical. The apartment was sparkling clean and smelled great. Very quiet at night and safe. A complimentary bottle of wine was the final touch to make this stay unforgettable. The only thing to take into consideration are the steep steps to get to the top floor. But that's Lisbon, hilly, no way around it. I have a bad hip and was able to go up and down without problems. :-) The neighborhood was perfect, everything was near, and quiet. Thank you so so so much for the care you put into your apartment, it shows!, and it made our first visit to Portugal such an unforgettable one.

진짜 너무 좋았어요!!!

계단을 4층까지 오르락 내리락 해야하지만 뷰와 깔끔한 집이 모든것을 용서해줍니다

If you are looking for somewhere great to stay in Lisbon, you have found it. Antonio's place is not only beautiful, the hosts are also incredible people. My wife and I requested to check in early and they were very accommodating. The view from the terrace is absolutely beautiful. We were provided with many local recommendations and followed almost all of them. It made our time in Lisbon unforgettable! The location is perfect in the Alfama district with so much within walking distance. Definitely recommend!

Das Appartement liegt großartig für die Besichtigung der schönen Stadt - auch wenn wir uns trotz Stadtplan und GoogleMaps auch am dritten Tag im Straßengewirr der Altstadt immer mal wieder etwas verlaufen haben... Die Aussicht über den Fluss ist der Wahnsinn! Sehr freundlich wurden wir von Antonios Frau Mariana empfangen, die uns alles erklärt und so manchen tollen Tipp gegeben hat. Auch die Kommunikation vorab verlief sehr schnell und unkompliziert. Wegen unserer frühen Ankunft in Lissabon hat uns Antonio eine Möglichkeit ganz in der Nähe des Appartments genannt, wo wir unser Gepäck abgeben konnten und sobald die Wohnung fertig war, konnten wir auch schon rein. Die Wohnung war sehr sauber, hübsch eingerichtet und mit allem ausgestattet, was wir für den Aufenthalt brauchten. Sehr gerne würden wir mal wieder kommen.

뷰가 생각했던것보다 훨씬훨씬 아름다워요. 다른 어디를 가도 자꾸만 집으로 돌아오게 만드는 정도? 집이 바닥과 문이 나무로 되어 있는데 그래서 인지 소음이 좀 있기는 해요. 2인이상 묶었는데 화장실이랑 현관문 소리가 심해서 약간 신경쓰인 했어요. 그렇치만 모든 시설이 다 갖춰져있고 좋았습니다. 우버를 부르면 집앞으로 오지 않아요. 몇번이나 시도해보았는데 결국 나중에 공항으로 갈때는 안토니오를 통해 부탁해서 일반 택시를 불러서 갔어요. 안토니오가 없었다면..캐리어를 끌고 계단으로 올라갔어야 했을꺼예요...(나중에 보니 집앞 길쪽으로 바닥에서 바리케이트같이 기둥이 올라왔다 내려갔다 하는 신호가 있더라구요 그래서 우버는 안되는듯?) 어쨌든 짐이 있으시면 일반 택시 예약하셔서 꼭 집앞까지 편안히 오세요!

Great view!  Super clean space.  Nice touch to have teas available in the morning and a bigger bathroom than you often find in central Lisbon.  Fair warning: you have to climb at least four flights of stairs from the front door, but Antonio was exceedingly kind in offering to lend a hand with moving our bags up.  We couldn't get enough of Alfama's old world charm, and the apartment was easily in reach of the castle as well as several churches hiding among narrow streets.  Made for an enchanting first night in old Lisbon!

Für unser langes Wochenende in Lissabon hätten wir keine schönere Unterkunft finden können.
António ist absolut zuverlässig und hat uns gute Tipps gegeben.
Das Apartment ist süß, ganz geschmackvoll eingerichtet, und blitzsauber!
Ideal für 2 Personen, mit einem wunderbaren Bad und einer optimalen Küche.
Es liegt im Herzen von Alfama, einem der ältesten Stadtteile der Stadt.
Von dort aus kommt man überall gut hin, aber auch in der Nachbarschaft gibt es alles was man so benötigt.
Absolute Empfehlung!!
Amazing location in the heart of the Alfama district. Great culture and vibe and the apartment was sparkling clean.

This place is awesome! It is incredibly clean, impeccably decorated, and it has an amazing view! Antonio was a fantastic host and very responsive to our messages. We struggled a little bit with check-in - mostly because we were lost and exhausted (pro tip - don't ring the buzzer!). But once we made contact with Antonio's friend (Sara I believe) the check in process was wonderful! We so appreciated all the little touches as well as the advice about the area. Would stay again and recommend wholeheartedly!

Antonio's apartment was fantastic. The location is wonderful, and the apartment is very stylishly decorated. We really enjoyed the view from the window/juliette balcony which was stunning. Antonio and his wife were great hosts, very quick to communicate and gave us a ton of local tips. The only consideration for other guests is that the ceiling is a bit on the lower side, so if you are taller than 6'4" it could be a bit uncomfortable in some parts of the apartment. Overall, fantastic experience that we would highly recommend.
Beautiful view. Thank you!
What a charming flat, neighborhood, and city! Antonio and his wife were incredibly hospitable and helpful and created a magical refuge for travelers. Highly recommend!!!
This apartment is adorable and the view really is amazing. It was a great location for exploring Alfama. We only stayed one night but would have loved to stay longer!

This apartment was a dream. Antonio greeted us in person with wine and a pasteis de nata which set the tone for how wonderful our time there would be. The space is clean, neat, and has absolutely everything you need. It’s location in the heart of Alfama made exploring the city easy and the view was the perfect thing to wake up to every morning. Highly recommend Antonio’s place!

António is a wonderful host! Very communicative and easy to get in touch with. The building is located in a beautiful neighborhood close to restaurants and amazing views. Would definitely recommend if you're looking to stay in Alfama. Perfect space for 2.

The view from the balcony is amazing. The apartment is right inside the Alfama area so it's easy to tour around. However，it's hard to carry big suitcases up and down because there‘s no elevator. The host is very kind to help us carry suitcases upstairs and give us some restaurant recommendations. Overall，it's a great experience.
Such an incredible apartment in the perfect spot, and on top of that we got some amazing tips from the friendly host, Antonio. We will definitely be back in the future!
Amazing apartment with a beautiful view. Awesome advice. Absolute top notch stay!
Incredible view in the heart of Alfama, hosts were amazing and the apartment was very stylish. Would highly recommend!

Antonio was a great host. The apartment was very clean and just like the photos. The view was spectacular, the photos don’t do it justice. Antonio also gave us a few great tips on where to go and where to eat nearby. Overall a great stay!
The best place in Lisboa!!

We passed an @mazing weekend in Lisbon. The apartment is very cute and situated in a calm quarter in Alfama which have a fantastic view of Tage river, roofs of old town, night's lights city and fado's music all around you for the evening...
Antonio will advise you to eat in very good places of tradicional Portuguese's cook ... we recommend you "N°63" in Alfama.
Thanks for all Antonio
See you...
Absolutely amazing place! The location is perfect, the apartment is beautiful and very clean, and the view is fantastic. Antonio was super helpful and I would not hesitate to recommend staying there!

We really enjoyed our stay at António’s apartment. The location was ideal for us, it was so scenic and very relaxing! It was an easy walk to anywhere including all methods of public transport. The apartment was extremely clean and stylish and the view is just amazing! We highly recommend it!!

We landed super late due to a flight delay but despite this hiccup, Antonio went out of his way to ensure my husband and I were comfortably settled into his apartment. The space had everything you need and the cross breeze at night was very relaxing! I was a bit hesitant about the lack of A/C but fear not! You are near the top of alfama where the cool air sweeps through regardless of the time of day. The view is BREATHTAKING. Do not hesitate. Book this place now!

Antonio is a great host. The communication was very fast and he helped us with everything we needed. The apartment was very clean und cosy. As the apartment is located on the top floor it gets a little bit hot inside but there is a fan that helps. The steps to the apartment are a little bit steep and tight.
Alfama is a beautiful district. There are several possibilities to eat breakfast as well as dinner. To get to bairro alto, where a lot of restaurants and bars are located, you need to walk for about 30 minutes.

This is a gem of an apartment! Incredible location, quiet streets, and you can’t beat the view. Highly recommend! António was a superb host, and provided us with some wonderful dinner suggestions throughout Lisbon.

Great little apartment in Alfama, the best neighbourhood to stay in from our experience.  The view is amazing and well worth the stairs to get there.  Nice little extra touches include a bottle of wine and local pastries.  We can also recommend the bakery around the corner, fantastic food there.  Highly recommend this apartment.

Such a great apartment - only wish we had more time there! António came to greet us and provided excellent restaurant recommendations and some treats upon arrival. Great hospitality and location - thank you António!
