Shower is great, nice extra touches by António made us feel welcome. Really clean. No A/C so not sure how hot it might get in August but for us in very early July the temperature was perfect.

Antonio welcomed us very well in his accommodation by passing on the keys in person. He also made some recommendations that we appreciated during our stay. In addition, the apartment has an exceptional view of the Affama and is very close to the city center, which makes it easy to discover Lisbon! We highly recommend him.

Massively appreciate everything António did for us, was highly accommodating and the place is incredible, offers great insight into local places and helps get the perfect photo for sunset over Lisbon. Thanks would love to stay again.

Perfect location in the heart of Alfalma. Views are absolutely stunning and Antonio and his wife couldn't be more helpful when it came to finding the apartment and local tips. If you're wondering about booking... just do it! We would absolutely stay again.
We had a fabulous stay in this charming apartment - awesome view too! Antonio is a great host who communicates well and is very responsive. Highly recommend!

What can I say about this place 😍
It was a little tricky to find by taxi but next time I won’t make the mistake of not getting an Uber! Antonio was an amazing host and carried our two heavy bags up the 4 flights of stairs. Oh what a view! The steps are worth it when you see the view. Incredible in the day but even more devine in the evening.
We hung out in the apartment for a few hours before heading out for some vegan food nearby - Antonio’s recommendation. Wonderful! So much character in this city and the streets are full of life. It can be a little noisy at night but I think that’s just the time of year we came as it’s party season! There is a fan in the room which kept it cool and drowned out the exterior noise. The location is perfect and the kitchen is equipped with everything you might need if you fancy eating in. Antonio’s thoughtful gift of local wine and pastries was a wonderful touch. Thank you so much for an incredible experience!

Antonio's place was wonderful! The apartment is in the heart of Alfama, a historic neighborhood of Lisbon, but has been redone to be very modern, stylish and extremely comfortable. The best part though is a great balcony with a beautiful view of Lisbon and the ocean. Antonio was very welcoming when we arrived and went out of his way with having Pastel de Natas from a local bakery and a bottle of wine waiting for us. He also spent the time to orient us with where we were at in Lisbon and some great recommendations that he made sure to send afterwards in a message so we had in writing. We would highly recommend staying at Antonio's place if you are headed to Lisbon.
...Please note this apartment is on the fourth floor only accessible by stairs but if you're able to climb stairs okay it is more than worth it.
Great views, charming space, and Antonio is very friendly and responsive!
Antonio's apartment is beautifully designed and makes the most of the cosy space. Amenities and touches are all first class. Location is grest. And then there is that view!

Mooi appartement met fantastisch uitzicht op de wijk Alfama en op het water. Goed welkom ontvangst en prettige plek om een paar dagen Lissabon te ontdekken. Zorg wel als je met een koffer komt dat de taxi je voor de deur afzet. De smalle hobbelige wegen zijn lastige te belopen met koffers.

Both Antonio and his place were amazing! Our flight was delayed, and he waited over 2 hours for us to give us the key and was so kind and gracious about it! He also has traditional Portuguese egg tarts and wine waiting for us at the apartment. He sent us great restaurant and activity tips - and his place is BEAUTIFUL! It immediately felt like home. My husband and I kept saying how we wished we could live there permanently. :) We definitely want to come back to Alfama, and stay here again!

Antonio’s place was lovely! We really enjoyed our stay. We had everything we needed and he provided us with a nice bottle of wine and pastries upon arrival. He also offered us some great local recommendations of places to see and eat! We will definitely be back!

The apartment is beautiful with fantastic views. Really great location in Alfama with great travel links to the rest of the city. António was amazing, gave us fantastic recommendations for the city and pastel de nata and wine on arrival!! Would highly recommend.

Loved this amazing spot, just need the advice and take a map, try to leave during the day and spend time roaming, allowing yourself to get lost and familiarize yourself with the streets. It is truly hard to find, my Uber never found me for my ride to the airport! But the Alfama is known for these tiny winding streets and lovelier for it!

Excellent accueil. Appartement très agréable, nuits calmes et vue magnifique.

The location is also excellent, right in the heart of Alfama. Our only complaints were with the stairs. They are very steep, which was not so unexpected, but also the flooring was loose in places. Anyone with any mobility issues should think twice. It was also quite noisy the two nights were were there. However, I have no idea if this is typical.

Exceptionally sparkling and well equipped place which place I've never visited before.

Yes, it is a four story walk-up. But unless you have mobility issues, do not let that dissuade you. The view makes all those steps worth it the first time you get inside the door.
The space itself is perfect for a couple. It’s been modernized, so if you are hoping to experience the quirks of an old building you are out of luck. But for us, the modern bathroom and kitchen allowed us to be efficient and got us out enjoying the city quickly.
António was a great host, meeting us at the door when we arrived to give us a tour of the apartment and some (very) local recommendations that you definitely should follow.
Awesome place, and great host. Thank you for the tips, the hospitality and the wonderful place!
António’s apartment is incredible, beautifully designed with amazing views across Alfama. I would thoroughly recommend a stay.

This airbnb is perfectly located to visit the Old Lisboa, Alfama, Almada, Belém and Sintra in 5 Days or 4 days if you speed!
António has reserved us a very warm welcome with some local wine, Pastéis de nata, and some interesting place to eat.
The house is very confortable for a couple with all we need and with awesome vista!
At dinner time we hear the fado singers, and after that it's the perfect silence to sleep with open window!
We really enjoyed this week and this house!
Merci !

António is an incredible perrson, very, very helpfull. The apartment is small but very clean, perfect for two. It’s the perfect location to explore the old city. This place has everything you need to stay there few days. There is amazing view of Alfama and the river. Thanks António! Highly recommend. I hope we will see you next time...

We knew Antonio was a super host, so we had high expectations - and he didn't disappoint.  The apartment is spotless, charmingly decorated and has everything you need to be very comfortable.  The view from the living room day and night  is just magnificent - a 180 degree view of the many rooftops , beautiful churches and harbor. The apartment is located in a quiet neighborhood in the heart of Alfama, within walking distance to the Santa Apolonia Station, with access to all the trains and subways. He is very  helpful with any travel needs you may have - suggestions of where to eat, what to see, and where to listen to Fado. Great place to stay we will definitely come back!

STAY HERE. António is an incredible host and made us feel so welcome in Lisbon.  The apartment is extremely clean and well decorated, you will feel right at home. It’s the perfect location to explore the city from - quieter at night because it’s a bit further from the crazy nightlife (but a very quick and cheap Uber ride away). This place has everything you need, including amazing views of Alfama and the river.  Just be prepared to walk up 4 flights of stairs to get there, but all worth it when you do.  Thanks António! Highly recommend.

António’s apartment in the Alfama neighborhood is clean, comfortable and ideally situated. We chose this location because we wanted to get to know the Alfama. We had many choices of restaurants and stores. António met us for check in and answered our questions and gave us a good orientation to the neighborhood. The apartment had everything we needed. Just wish we could’ve stayed longer!

Charming top floor apartment in the amazing Alfama area. Be prepared to climb some steps, but then you enter a beautifully furnished, equipped and clean apartment with amazing views. Antonio is an exceptionally gracious host (helped us out with local recommendations, a late flight and checkin, and great local suggestions.

Outstanding hospitality from António. We arrived to a perfect apartment with views to die for. António also treated us to pastéis (still warm!) and wine from the region when we arrived which was a really special touch. We only wish we had more days in Lisbon! António had some excellent restaurant recommendations and we were able to have an authentic experience of Lisbon thanks to him. Super appartement, très bien situé. Très bien équipé et une vue magnifique sur le quartier d'Alfama et le Tage. Antonio est un super hôte qui saura vous conseiller sur les restaurants et les  lieux à ne pas manquer sur Lisbonne

This place is Fantastic!  In the heart of the Allama, with a beautiful view of the river.  When we arrived this view included a tall sailing ship right in the center view.  An impeccable 4th floor with balcony.  A few steps up to the famous 28 Tram, or down to Fado and Cape Verdian  music.  Delightful!

The flat was fantastic with a beautiful view of Lisbon totally worth the stairs. Location was perfect, very close to the castle and with really quick and easy public transport links to the centre and a fantastic bakery around the corner for breakfast. Take a rucksack, not a wheelie case - Alfama is cobbles and hills.
We spent a marvellous Weekend at António's Place. He is an excellent host, well organised and always willing to help. The place is very clean and cosy. Thanks António, I would always recommend you!
Great apartment in a great location.  António was a very welcoming and helpful host
Great little cosy place to stay. Wonderful view on the river. It has all the basic you need. Kitchen supplies could be more completed. Antinio is a great help if you need infomation

A wonderful apartment and lovely host with great recommendations on where to go. The views are incredible and the apartment itself is in pristine condition with everything you need for a very comfortable stay. The location is amazing and a short walk from all the major sights.
The perfect quiet spot to discover Lisbon and the secrets of Alfama.
Wunderschöne Wohnung, alles ist genau wie auf den Bildern. Antonio gibt auch gute Tipps

Casa recentemente ristrutturata, arredata benissimo e molto pulita. In casa è presente tutto il necessario e di più (anche il phon e wifi). Ci sono 3 piani a piedi senza ascensore da fare ma ci si mette un attimo. La posizione perfetta e comodissima, di fianco a tutti i mezzi di trasporto e pasticcerie, bar e ristornati.  Antonio, fantastico! ci ha dato diversi suggerimenti molto utili.
Beautiful apartment, stunning views, and a lovely welcome from Antonio. Highly recommend this places

We loved this apartment with its most beautiful view over Lisbon. The checkin was easy and smooth. António, the host, was very friendly, helped us with our heavy luggage and provided us with helpful tips for our stay in Lisbon. The apartment is greatly located close to everything you need and want to see. So, we really can recommend it!!!

We had 4 lovely days in Lisbon and the apartment is amazing. The apartment is very cosy and clean and has everything you need. Antonio welcomed us with pastel del nata and wine. The view is breathtaking and you are in the middle of Lisbons life, with bakeries, cafés, restaurants. A perfect place for a stay in this beautyful city.
L'appartement est largement conforme aux photos, propre et très bien situé. La vue est magnifique et Antonio est très disponible. Notre séjour était parfait. Merci encore!

Nous recommandons pour tout : accueil, emplacement, propreté. Tout était au rendez-vous avec la vue imprenable sur le Tage et les toits de l'Alfama. L'accueil d'Antonio était parfait. Un peu de bruit lié à l'immeuble mais logique car l'appartement est situé dans un quartier attractif de Lisbonne. Merci !

Antonio's place is in a great location in the Alfama, the oldest district of Lisbon.
Check-in worked just perfect, even though we arrived almost an hour later as expected Antonio was there to welcome us. His apartment is spotless, very cozy, with an amazing view over the Alfama and the river Tagus. Just note, that the flat is at the top floor and there is no elevator plus narrow steep stairs, although this hasn’t been an issues for us. We would definitely come back and can highly recommend Antonio's apartment to anyone who visits Lisbon and want to stay central and in one of the most beautiful district :)

We could tell from previous reviews and photos that Antonio's place was going to be great but when we arrived it was this and more! Apart from the 3 flights of stairs, everything about this place was fantastic! My partner and I were not phased by the climb up because the view is breathtaking and well worth it! The place itself is so modern and has everything you could ever want in a home away from home - we only wish we could stay longer! I have to say the bed was so super comfortable, if it wasn't for Lisbon's amazing weather, I could have easily been enticed to stay snuggled up in bed all day! Everything is well thought out and the entire home is spotless and super clean. The location is great for access to the old town and Tram 28 and we loved the nearby cafe Antonio suggested to us. Antonio himself was so accommodating with everything, even check-in when I had mistakenly informed of the wrong arrival time. We really hope to be back one day - it was heaven staying here!

The apartment was very central and had beautiful views over Alfama (a lovely part of the city) and the river. Everywhere we wanted to visit was in walking distance, although the nearest tram stop is only a 2 minute walk away. The apartment was very clean and had everything that was needed to make our stay comfortable.
Antonio was a very welcoming and went out of his way throughout our stay to give advice and answer any questions that we had. He recommended places to eat and even booked us a table at a restaurant, which was very good.
I would highly recommend this apartment and would definitely stay again!

Antonio is a very nice host.When we get lisbon，we lost in the way，and Antonio picked us and help carry our bags to the room. The house is very clean and comfortable，we love it very much.And it is very close to the views，we can walk to anywhere we want to.And the 28 bus is also very close to the house.
This is a great place to stay in Alfama. Cozy and cute with outstanding views. Everything you need and close to tram stops. Highly recommend!
位于ALFAMA中心，景色一流。虽然住的地方没有电梯，但房东很热心的帮我们搬运行李上楼，打开窗户的那一刻，一切也都值了。室内新装修的，很舒服。

Well we do I begin. Antonio was amazing from the very start of my booking this wonderful apartment. He has answered all my questions and queries I had, not to mention he went out of his way to kindly provide us with a delicious chocolate cake for my partners birthday. Antonio was very flexible and was happy to meet us at the apartment to check in after our lunch in central Lisbon. The flat is suited in a calm and residential neighbourhood. Our flat was very sweet and romantic, had an amazing view and was super clean, tidy and presentable. We definitely felt like back at our home and trust me we did not want to leave. I would highly recommend anyone this lovely flat in the heart of Alfama, we are most certain that we will come back in near future. Thank you Antonio for your hospitality.

An amazing apartment in Alfama. Would recommend Antónios place to anyone. The view is amazing, and the apartment is ideal (extremely comfy bed). Antonio is a really nice guy and it couldn't have been easier. Alfama was our favourite part of Lisbon. Would love to return.

António was the perfect host. He was flexible with the check in time and was really welcoming. Thank you again! The apartment is beautiful. It's located in a beautiful part of the city with its tiny streets and is really well located for everything I wanted to do. The apartment itself was beautiful! The bottle of wine was a lovely touch and despite climbing 4 flights of stairs the view was incredible! The balcony looked right across Lisbon and the view of the river I never got tired of. The apartment was well equipped with everything we needed and was really clean and tidy!
Thanks again António I hope to be back soon!

Antonio's place is perfect - The apartment is situated in the beautiful Old Town of Alfama, which in my eyes is the best place to stay. There are plenty of local restaurants and bars within 5 minutes walking distance, and it was really easy to access the rest of the city either by foot or by tram. The apartment itself is beautifully decorated and spotless, and it has the most wonderful view over the town. António is the loveliest guy, he greeted us at the apartment,made sure we had everything we needed and gave us helpful tips on where to go. I would highly recommend this place, its definitely one of the best we've stayed at. Thank you António!

Kann António und diese Wohnung für einen Städtetrip empfehlen! Allerdings nichts für Leute mit leichtem Schlaf: Hunde der Nachbarn bellen gern auch mitten in der Nacht ohne Unterlass. Die Nachbarn und Geräusche im Treppenhaus hört man ebenfalls deutlich.
A wonderful apartment in a perfect location, and Antonio was a great host! I would always stay here again - absoltely recommended!!!

Really great apartment with stunning view to the sea. Location is perfect, right in the heart of beautiful nabourhood of Alfama. Antonio was really friendly and gave some good advices where to eat and what to see.

António is a very welcoming and generous host. He gave us great recommendations including a lovely pastelaria and local non-touristy restaurants. His place had everything we needed and is close to lookouts, transport and mini markets. And the view is incredible! We would definitely come back again.
simply enjoy the view and the great Central location
I booked the apartment for my parents. It's cozy, romantic and it's located in Alfama. António is a great host and was very friendly and helped them to get a cab to the airport.
The apartment is perfectly appointed, and we loved being in Alfama. Antonio was very helpful and all of his recommendations are spot on! Highly recommend.
Great location and very nice host.we will come back for sure next year!

Antonio went out of his way to greet us and made us feel very welcome from the start. He is a great advocate for the city he loves.
The flat is beautifully presented and has every amenity - and the river views are indeed amazing. Standing on his little balcony is fantastic.
Alfama is a wonderful district to stay in and Antonio knows it very well; he sent us to his favourite places, including a wonderful pastelaria just minutes from the building. We really hope to return.

We both agree this was the best airbnb ever!! In the perfect location in alfama, the old town of Lisbon! We arrived with a short walk from the train station. Antonio was there to meet us, gave us a great introduction to the area and some great tips of what to do during our stay. The apartment itself, was just soo perfect!! It looks even better than in the photos and feels like the most comfortable and beautifully designed home away from home. Very clean and has everything you could need! I cannot speak highly enough about it, will recommend it to everyone! It is on the third or fourth floor so if you cannot handle stairs might not be for you, but is absolutely worth the climb. You have a cute little typical alfama balcony with the most incredible views of the area and the river. Great spot for sunsets! Antonio was easily contactable and had great advice whenever we needed.  If you are going to Lisbon, stay here, it is just perfect!!

Antonio was a friendly and responsive host. When we couldn't get the radiator working, he made time to get it started for us. Pictures don't really completely convey how beautiful this apartment this apartment and its excellent view is until you get here. I really appreciated the pastel de nata and the wine that Antonio had prepared for us - it was a warm welcoming gesture. Antonio's place is also pretty convenient, it is fairly near the metro and tram stops, with a host of eateries within walking distance. The tiring stair climbing each day was worth it! Thanks Antonio!

The apartment was absolutely perfect. Impeccably decorated and with the most breathtaking view of the alfama district. Everything was immaculate!
Antonio was also a wonderful host, met us at the door and introduced us to the best bakery in town.
Highly recommend!
Antonio was a great host. The flat was very nice with amazing view and perfect location in Alfama. Thank you Antonio. We highly recommend this place.
One of the best AirBnBs I have stayed at. Fantastic location, amazing apartment (the view!), great value and helpful host. Would definitely stay here again when coming back to Lisbon.
Great stay. Friendly welcome, right on time, even with wine and local pastries to kick off the weekend. Very knowledgeable with great recommendations. Makes for a perfect weekend.

Amazing view. Perfect location. Awesome host.
This is a 5 star recommendation. I am absolutely amazed!

This flat is very very nice. There is no elevator, but it was also new experience for my family. Antonio is also very kind to explain what we need during the trip like restaurants and bakery. I think the location is excellent because you can travel with yellow tram (No. 28) easily. Of course, the flat was very clean and the views still gave me impressive. I highly remmend this flat. Don't hesistate!!

Very welcoming host !
The appartment is very nice, quiet & clean with an amazing view.
I definitely recommend to book with Antonio

Great service from António before and upon arrival. He gave us valuable tips for where to eat and what to see. Spot clean and marvelous aparment with fantastic view over Afalma quarter and river Tejo. We could not dream of more romantic place to stay in Lisabon. We will share our experience to all couples heading for this city. Just to point out, that it is only for those who do not mind steep steps, but Afalma is full of steep steps and little streets and with feeling of real life and Fado songs around each corner. Highly reccomended!
Antonio's place is even better than expected based on pictures and description. We enjoyed it very much and highly recommend this place a starting point to explore Lisbon.
Anthonio was very helpful. He suggested places for breakfast and dinner, all of which we enjoyed very much. The apartment is beautiful and a perfect location in Alfama!

Nice appartment with amazing view! Very clean, good service from Antonio! All the things you need for a citytrip are avaible at this place.
During the trip I had some questions for him and he all answered them very quickly, even called some restaurants to make reservations.
Worth visiting again!

A spectacular apartment in an amazing location! We couldn't rave more about our stay at Antonio's apartment. It's a wonderful location in the old city, incredibly clean, comfortable, and well maintained, and has a spectacular view. Highly recommend!

We found Antonio's apartment to be exactly as described. The view is absolutely stunning, and the apartment is so clean and beautifully decorated.

Antonio was flexible and accommodating as we arrived late on Friday night, and he also allowed us to leave our luggage after check-out for a few hours which was much appreciated.

When we arrived we were greeted with a lovely bottle of red wine and delicious traditional pasteis de nata. These were an unexpected treat, and added to an overall wonderful celebratory weekend in Lisbon. We will be recommending Antonio's apartment to all our friends! :)

The Appartement was amazing. Very tidy, clean and fully refurbished with a great view. Antonio was very helpful as we had some problems to find the adress and also gave us some recommendations and clues where to go in Lisbon. He welcomed us with a bottle of portuguiese red wine and Nata, which we really enjoyed. The Appartement is the perfect place for a trip to Lisbon. The only thing is, it's very difficult if you get there by car as it's the old part of Lisbon. In this case just let Antonio know and he will help you for sure.

A fun place to stay. The area is full of character, we found the appartment as described ,compact but well furnished, everything we needed for a pleasant 3 night stay. We much enjoyed a bottle of Antonio's gift red wine as we watched sunset over the river. Close to interesting sights. we walked a lot.
Steep flights of steps to the appartment, streets around also hilly, fitting to the locality.
Antonio was very helpful at all times.
We're glad we stayed there for our Lisbon trip.

Antonio is a great host and easy to reach out. Very helpful in getting us a taxi on departure and telling us about the neighborhood, restaurants and things to see in Lisbon.
The apartment is great with a fantastic view over Alfama and viewing the river Taag.
The stairs to the apartment are rather steep (and many steps), no airco in the room and the bed was a bit too small for a tall dutch man. Alfama as an area may not always feel save later in the evenings. So, the area and apartment may not be so good for older people.

L'appartement d'Antonio est propre et décoré avec goût ! Il offre une superbe vue sur le quartier de l'Alfama.
Antonio est été très accueillant malgré notre retard. Il nous a donné quelques recommandations sur des restaurants et nous a offert des Pastéis de Nata et une bouteille de vin à notre arrivée. Nous vous recommandons vivement son appartement pour votre séjour à Lisbonne !

Gorgeous apartment with an amazing view over the city and Tagus. Antonio was very welcoming and gave us superb recommendations of places to eat / drink. The apartment is clean, modern and each room is beautifully finished - we would absolutely stay there again if in Lisbon.

Amazing, everything was great.
Lovely touches on arrival and for stay including fruit, pastries, red wine, Antonio greeted us and gave local tips/info.
Would definitely recommend and apt and would stay here again for sure. Did not want to leave!

I don't think we could have asked for any more. António's apartment is fantastic. Well equipped and with a stunning view over Lisbon. The location is perfect, right in the heart of Alfama and a great base for exploring Lisbon from. António was the perfect host and gave us some great recommendations for places to eat both locally and around Lisbon. Thank you António. We hope to come back very soon!

Antonio a été super, il a su nous donner des petites adresses, se rendre disponible pour l'accès au logement et nous a accueillir de manière très chaleureuse.
Merci beaucoup. Je recommande vraiment cette location qui est très bien situé !

Antonio's apartment was an absolute delight. Small but perfectly formed. Full of charm like the Alfama district where it is located. The early morning views from the 4th floor balcony were stunning.
Antonio was a great help and was there to meet us and carry our bags despite our late arrival.
He also sent a useful text with advice and suggestions of what to do whilst there.
A lovely Airbnb in a lovely city. Highly recommend it!!

Antonio was very kind and friendly, gave us good tips about Lisbon (unfortunately Antonio we couldn't eat at your favorite restaurant, which i don't remember the name, it was anyway fully complete) and especially about Alfama district. The flat was close to being perfect, with a certain good taste for furniture and everything needed for a convenient stay in Lisbon. After 3 days walking up and down in Lisbon, i have to admit that i would have loved to have an elevator in the building, that's the only very tiny negative point to Antonio's flat ;)
Once again, thank you Antonio and maybe see you another time!!

Antonio was fantastic with his communication from the very start until our departure! He was extremely welcoming and kindly collected us from the station! A very nice host who has a beautiful apartment, it was like home from Home! In the perfect location with stunning views! Thank you :)
Great city, amazing accomodation in the heart of alfama and the best host you can imagine. Thank you so much Antonio! Obrigado!

Ojalá hubiésemos podido pasar más días en el apartamto de Antonio! Es una casa super acogedora y Antonio un anfitrión genial y muy generoso. Espero poder volver pronto a Lisboa y tener la oportunidad de alojarme de nuevo en su casa. Gracias por todo!!

Antonio was the perfect host, seriously :)
Really interesting tips for the city, super beautiful apartment and he even carried out luggage up the stairs :)
Totally recommended <3
We hope we'll be back soon!

Tutto perfetto. Dalla gentilezza di Antonio che ci ha atteso ed accompagnati in casa, alla ubicazione, al panorama per finire alle cose di sostanza : pulizia perfetta, letto comodo con lenzuolo profumate di pulito.
Per finire un complimento ad Antonio per il gusto con cui ha reso un piccolo alloggio un gioiellino. Bella esperienza.

Everything was perfect. António was very helpful. He picked us at the trainstaition and helped us with the bagage. Also he gave us tips about Lisbon and restaurants and called us a taxi for the depature.
The flat was amazing and the view unique!

Antonio is a top host! The flat is absolutely beautiful with top kitchen and bathroom, and the view over Alfama and the Tejo river is just breathtaking. Everything is nearby so that we could walk. Antonio's tipps for eating out and a really good Fado place were fantastic!

Antonios apartment is a wonderful space, beautifully decorated, perfectly clean and just perfect for a city break in Lisbon.  The old town is beautiful and the apartment is in a great location.  Antonio was a wonderful host, he was super friendly on check in and gave is loads of tips for places to go and wonderful resturants.  On our next trip to Lisbon we will definitely stay in the apartment again!

I hope I can describe how delightful Antonio and his wondrous apartment are. He was generous with his time and shared his favourite places with us. The apartment is sublime. There was wine, a good coffee machine, a lovely bed and the most spectacular view over the rooftops down to the river from a tiny balcony.
The area is a lot of fun at night, exploring the maze of medieval alleyways and courtyards that come alive with the gorgeous fado singing and the smell of grilled fish.
Thank you Antonio, we had the best time.

Could not have asked for a better host and apartment!!!! Antonio was there to greet us at check in and made sure to give us tips and insights into his beautiful city. The view is incredible from the apartment which made it even more perfect. I would definitely advise you to book Antonio's apartment!

Antonio was a fabulous host and the apartment was a gorgeous, well-situated little haven.
We were almost an hour late meeting him due to traffic, but he waited for us and was so nice about it. The bed also broke while we were there, and he was also super kind about that as well. Not to mention the Pasteis de Nata and bottle of wine awaiting our arrival!
The apartment itself was impeccably clean and comfortable, and you can hear Fado music all night long from the balcony. All in all we really loved our two-night stay here.
Antonio was very welcoming, showed us round, made sure we had everything we needed. Brilliant host!

Our stay at António's flat could not have been any better!  The apartment was exactly as described in the photographs (beautiful!) and its location perfect. The Alfama is a great little neighborhood with amazing Fado restaurants, bakeries, and more. António was so friendly, responsive and helpful throughout our entire stay. We landed very early in the morning and he was kind to hold onto our bags until we could check in at 2pm. This allowed us to explore the city worry free!  When we did check in we were greeted with a bottle of local wine, some fresh fruit, and pastéis de natas!  I would definitely stay at António's flat again, and I recommend it to anyone looking for a great safe place to stay in Lisbon.
We had a great time. Thank you

We loved the apartment from its location in the heart of things to the very high standard finish. We had everything we needed. Antonio was the perfect host, nothing being too much trouble. The area is quiet at night though you have every bar, restaurant etc on your doorstep. Wonderful views of the water. We would recommend the apartment to all our friends. Thank you.

Antonio was such a great host - he made the extra effort to meet us and make sure we got to the right place (since our taxi driver was a bit unsure). The place was spectacular - exactly as described and pictured. We personally loved being in Alfama - neighborhood with so much character. Loved our experience!

Antonio was kind enough to meet us at the nearby station.  The apartment was great, exactly like it looks in the photos and was extremely clean.  It was so well equipped and comfortable too.  Antonio showed us around and explained how things worked, where the local bakers was, recommended some restaurants, he was also contactable if we had any questions while we were there.  He also left us a lovely bottle of wine, pasteis de nata and fresh fruit which was thoughtful and enjoyed!  The apartment was perfectly located for sightseeing, with stunning views across the water.  As mentioned the cost of this is the steep stairs, but it is worth it.  I would definitely recommend this apartment and would like to return too.  A great first Airbnb experience.  Thank you Antonio.

Antonio was an amazing host! The apartment was well-stocked beyond expectation, very clean, with a comfy bed, modern bath, and crisp kitchen. We loved the space and location, with a wonderful view over the Alfama and bay. This is an active district so we expected to hear the city - you get the idea that people don't sleep here until 7am. We could have shut the windows but we enjoyed it. It's a 4th floor walk-up, but that shouldn't bother anyone choosing to stay in Lisbon because you'll walk up and down many steps just being in the city. The reward is you get high enough to look over the rooftops for the commanding view. Worth it! We stayed for nearly a week and would definitely return. Thanks, Antonio!
The space has been designed very well. And the overlook of alfama is breathtaking. Antonio was very helpful throughout our stay. We had an amazing time. I would recommend it to anyone

António was a great host! Communication was great and he gave us some nice tips during the trip and called a taxi for us on day of return. He even had some nice pastries and a bottle of wine wating for us at the day of arrival.
Also the apartment was amazing with a great view.
If you're not to tall this place is a little gem in Alfama!

Tout était parfait : l'appartement est très mignon, pratique et idéalement situé. Alfama est un quartier plein de charme et recèle de résidents tous plus avenants les uns que les autres !
Notre hôte António a également été aux petits soins avec nous. Prévenant, attentif et très bien organisé, il a su nous distiller ses meilleurs conseils pour que nous tirions le meilleur parti de notre semaine à Lisbonne.
Nous reviendrons à coup sûr !

Antonio was a very kind and welcoming host. Due to a family bereavement I had to make a last minute change to the booking, which Antonio kindly accepted.

On arrival he greeted us and showed us around the apartment where he provided fruit, a bottle of Portuguese wine and two custard tarts.

He then emailed a list of recommendations for places to eat in the area.

He was easily contactable and happy to help with any issues.

The apartment itself is beautiful, just as it appears in the pictures. It is small but spotlessly clean and beautifully decorated. It has been kitted out with travellers in mind with a haidryer, umbrella and various other essentials.

The area is very authentic and great fun to explore. The apartment is at the top of several flights of steep stairs meaning the view is incredible.

Would definitely stay again.

Wow! What a beautiful apartment. Great location, beautiful views. Fully equipped with everything you need, and we were even left fruit, wine and pastel de nata (my favourite thing about Portugal...!) which considering we were only staying two night was really generous and unexpected. Thank you so much to Antonio who was really friendly and helpful. Make sure you take his advice on taxis and restaurants! We had a lovely short stay in this apartment, our only regret is that we couldn't stay longer! We would love to come back some day :)
Loved it! Exactly as in photos and the view is spectacular! Antonio also left touches you will for sure enjoy ! The location in Amalfa is ideal!

Antonio is a fantastic host- very responsive and extremely helpful! he was able to provide us with an overview of the area, recommendations for local restaurants, and directions to some of the major tourist sights. we absolutely loved staying at his apartment. the space is beautiful and functional and the location is great! we would absolutely stay here on a future trip!

This is a lovely flat in the great location of Alfama and would definitely recommend - very close to bars, shops, restaurants and fado venues, and also very close to walk to Baixa, Chiado and Bairro Alto. Perfect size for a couple. Antonio was a great host, we had a late flight and he was very accommodating. He also sorted me a birthday cake for my boyfriend which was very kind of him!!

Appartement idéalement situé dans le quartier de l'Alfama! Nous avons tout fait à pied d'Alfama à Graça, Baixa et Rossio, Bairro Alto et Chiado, Principe Real...(malgré le dénivelé , les marches et la poussette!).Les photos sont vraiment conformes, jolie décoration, tout est parfait! Antonio est un hôte attentif, serviable et très disponible. Il nous a accueilli avec des pasteis de Nata, fruits et bouteille de vin :-))! Et à même eu la gentillesse de nous commander notre taxi retour.
Nous recommandons vivement ! Merci pour tout Antonio!

We had a great time in Lisbon and would definitely return (and stay at Antonio's). The apartment is well located in the old town, close the castle and harbour, and only 20 mins from the city centre - we walked everywhere and also got out to the beach at Carcavelos and Belem as well.

This apartment is awsome. Why? The neighborhood is perfectly placed, close to the center, close to the Fado clubs, but quiet at night, have nice views to the city, everithing is brand new.
Antonio was very kind with us, he welcome us with a bottle of wine, some "pasteis de nata", fruits... and a long list of recomendations to enjoy the city.

We felt like home :)

nous avons passé un merveilleux séjour à lisbonne! lappartement d'antonio est tres chaleureux, tres bien situé avec une superbe vue sur alfama et la mer..
antonio a été tres serviable et disponible durant notre séjour!
nous sommes ravis et garderons de tres bons souvenirs de ce séjour !
obrigado !!!
Antonio was a brilliant host - waiting for us on arrival with fruit, coffee and wine. The apartment was perfect, had everything we needed and had beautiful views of Lisbon.

Wir fanden das Apartment genau so vor, wie im Inserat beschrieben. Einzigartige Lage. Zentral und dennoch ruhig. Geschmackvoll eingerichtet und sauber. Kaffee, Obstkorb, Wein - ein perfekter Empfang.
António ist ein wunderbarer, äußerst hilfsbereiter Gastgeber. Er empfing uns am Bahnhof, brachte uns zur Wohnung, sorgte für unsere erste Orientierung in der Altstadt und organisierte bei unserer Abreise den Transport zum Flughafen.
Bei unserem nächsten Aufenthalt in Lissabon werden wir wieder in Antónios Apartment wohnen, falls möglich.

Nous nous sommes sentis très très bien accueillis! Antonio nous a attendu jusqu'à fort tard, car notre avion avait pris presque deux heures de retard et lui nous attendait avec un grand sourire! Milles mercis!
L'appartement est vraiment magnifique et très bien équipé, tout y est. Le quartier très très calme, avec les hirondelles qui veillent ;-)
Beaucoup d'escaliers. On est revenus avec les jambes bien musclées!

We hebben genoten van ons verblijf in het appartement van Antonio! Bij aankomst werden wij hartelijk door hem ontvangen en in het appartement voel je je meteen erg thuis. Het is een erg schoon appartement en het uitzicht is echt fantastisch! De wijk Alfama is de mooiste wijk die wij gezien hebben in Lissabon en door het appartement als thuisbasis te gebruiken hebben wij extra genoten van ons bezoek aan de stad.

In una sola parola: Perfetto! Antonio è una persona splendida, siamo arrivati Domenica nel primo pomeriggio, era già davanti alla porta di casa ad aspettarci, ci ha subito fatti accomodare e rapidamente ci ha descritto l'appartamento. Era come ce lo aspettavamo! Intimo, pulitissimo e con una vista splendida. Alfama ( il nostro quartiere) era sotto i nostri occhi e davanti il mare. Il Quartiere è meraviglioso pieno di vicoli da scoprire sia di giorno che di sera, certo bisogna camminare ma tra un Mirador ( punto panoramico) e l'altro passa la fatica, allentata dai vari paesaggi e dai colori di Lisbona. Inoltre c'è tutto, dai piccoli baretti per la colazione ai ristoranti tipici per chi, la sera, vuole ascoltare qualche nota di Fado ( musica tipica di Lisbona). Non mancano piccoli super mercati per tutte le esigenze. A 5 minuti a piedi ci sono le varie fermate dei tram, in particolare il famoso ( 28) che tocca quasi tutti i punti della città. A noi piaceva più camminare e respirare la città passo dopo passo. Per concludere questa recensione posso dire che siamo stati meravigliosamente e che Lisbona è una città da vivere, è una città ricca di cose da vedere, di atmosfere particolari, di colori, di profumi, tutta da assaporare.
Grazie ad Antonio che ci ha reso questa vacanza più serena, più comoda e ci ha fatto sentire come a casa.

stayed here for a week and felt right at home! check in was super easy and quick, lovely shops and restaurants nearby. would definitely recommend for a trip to Lisboa!!!

This was a little gem of a spot! It's walkable to lots of sites.  It was a bit loud at night. However, there were festivals at night im sure its more peaceful during other times. We loved the location of the place, it’s perfect to explore Alfama and the main attractions of Lisbon. We went to a concert at Estadio da luz and the metro is really close by so it was very easy to reach. The apartment is simple but it has everything you need and the hosts are very friendly :)

Host was very responsive during checkin. Got help carrying luggage up all the stairs. Unfortunately the place didn’t reflect all the pictures posted. Place is very dull and has paint flaking off the cabinets. Not bright and welcoming as shown in the pictures. However, the apartment does have all the necessities.

João and his colleague Tiago were both very nice and easy to coordinate with; checking in was easy and Tiago quickly rectified a small issue with the linens. The location in Alfama is very convenient and close to a lot of places you would want to visit - lots of great local restaurants as well.
There were a few downsides with the apartment. The bathroom is very difficult to navigate - I am only 5 feet tall and I am not sure how anyone taller or with mobility issues could use the toilet; I had to slide in sideways to sit down and then when I sat down my knees hit the sink. There is also quite a large step up into the shower that can be hard to get in and out of.
You also are in a residential area that is close quarters, so you will be awake as soon as everyone wakes up to start their day. The mattress left a lot to be desired- only a firm futon topper. João was very helpful and nice but these are things to be aware of at his place.

We stayed only a few nights and spent most of our time exploring fabulous Lisbon! We certainly appreciated the ease of communication at the time of check-in and flexibility with our late arrival, as our flight from Faro to Lisbon was delayed twice.
Overall, we were most satisfied with these accommodations. The apartment with big windows is in a lovely laneway and walkable to all the fascinating places to see in Lisbon. Also important, is that we felt safe in this area. Small grocery shops and restaurants are all within a few minutes walk.
The apartment was clean with hand soap, shampoo, ample towels in the bathroom. Extra blankets were made available and the kitchen cupboards had basic spices, etc. (should you need to use them) and kitchenware to make meals. The bed was comfortable and the pull-out couch was handy.
It was in a very interesting old part of Lisbon.
Great location right in the center.
Perfect location, very clean, as described!
Todo bastante bien, Lisbon un chico encantador, nos ayudo mucho con todo

Un logement simple avec le strict nécessaire qui se situe en bas du quartier de l'Alfama au deuxième étage dans un immeuble ancien avec des escaliers hauts et étroits.

Appartement agréable pour un court séjour.

L'hôte est réactif.

We had a really great time in José's place. It's a small, but cozy and comfortable apartment in Alfama. Surrounded by lovely coffee shops and restaurant, also close to Metro and the train station.

Lovely place to stay.
Thank you so much.

Sehr netter & schneller Kontakt, konnten unsere Koffer schon früher einchecken als angegeben. Die Unterkunft war sauber, sehr gut gelegen und gemütlich. Responsive and friendly host- able to accommodate luggage drop off. Good location, close to the train station and metro, super easy to get around. Lots of steep stairs though (even up to the unit) so wouldn’t be accessible for everyone. Rustic vibe, good for 2 max (as unit itself is quite small).

A fantastic location in the heart of Alfama and five minutes from the train station. Jose was a great host that met us at the station and showed us around the neighborhood, even after a late arrival. Overall a fantastic stay that I would recommend to anyone.

The unit was in a great location and check in was very easy. We appreciated José’s recommendations. The unit was old and quite small, but very clean and with some newer appliances. Overall a positive stay!

logement très bien situé,  bien équipé,  tout à proximité (métro,  restaurants, magasin de proximité), José s'est montré très accueillant et réactif,  nous garderons un très bon souvenir de notre séjour

The stay was located at a great place as it is walkable to many of the attractions. We had to wait to check in as he was still cleaning the place when we arrived. The description said the place has heating but we couldn't find any or any instructions so had to sleep in the cold.
José was a great host. Despite a check in delay outside of his control, José more than made up for it and we had a short but lovely stay.

Séjour très agréable , la localisation est très bien il faut juste savoir qu’il est indispensable de prendre les transports pour le moindre déplacement. Mes enfants ont 3 ans donc ils étaient heureux de prendre le métro ,le bus ou le tram . C’est une ville sportivement jeune
Excelente todo , apartamento chico y acogedor. Jose es un excelente anfitrion. El único tema es subir las escaleras con las valijas.
José was very friendly and the location is great! the unit needs a lot of improvement but it was fine.

I don't see how Jose is a Superhost

I highly recommend staying at Jose's Airbnb. It had all of the essentials I needed and was an amazing location. Jose was a kind and gracious host. The location in the beautiful Alfama neighborhood is perfect. A very short walk to the Santa Apolonia Train and Metro station. José was there to welcome us and gave us lot of advices. He made us feel like family. Thank you José!!!

Tout a été parfait. José est aux petits soins et donne des très bons conseils. Tout était très propre et comme mentionné dans le descriptif.

José is a truly exceptional host. His recommendations were really great and provided a lot to our fantastic time in Lisbon.

Amazing location! So nice to be in the thick of it, in the coolest neighborhood in the city. Check in was a little confusing but it worked out. Grateful there was coffee in hand. Many great restaurants and cafes nearby. Wish we had gotten to stay longer!
Jose was super nice! He helped with the luggage! The apartment was great and is the perfect spot to explore Alfama.
Great spot to enjoy Lisbon from, easy to get around, and plenty of close restaurants. Lots of stairs to get up to the apartment, so be prepared.

Very easy to find and great to walk to all of Lisbon. Thanks!

This apartment is an ABSOLUTE MUST! Perfect location from the train station and to explore Alfama and all of Lisbon. It has everything you could need for a comfortable stay. Could not recommend this place enough! Enjoy!

Ubicado en el Barrio más antiguo de la ciudad con mucho encanto. Con todo lo necesario para una estancia cómoda. Repetiría. José muy atento. Muchas gracias

José a été adorable, toujours réactif à nos moindres demandes, un hôte d'exception!! Son appartement est très cosy, on s'y sent comme chez soi, c'est très agréable! Il est situé dans le quartier le plus charmant je pense de Lisbonne (quartier historique avec ses minuscules ruelles et escaliers, ses églises à chaque coin de rue,...) et il est vraiment très proche de tous moyens de transport.
Je vous le recommande vivement!!

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour, au coeur de l'Alfama dans l'appartement de José très bien situé (dans une ruelle totalement typique) et très agréable à y vivre. Nous le remercions encore une fois, et nous conseillons vivement cet hôte !

José nous a accueillis à la sortie du métro, et même aidées à porter notre valise, îl est adorable, prêt à donner de bons conseils. Son appartement est situé idéalement dans Lisbonne, et pour 4 personnes, c'est très confortable. On reviendra !

José was very welcoming and met us at the local metro station to show us the quickest route to the place as well as giving us a tour of the neighbourhood! The flat is in a perfect location, a beautiful side street of Alfama - close to lots of sights and great restaurants. The flat itself is really well equipped, spacious and very clean. José went out of his way to provide us with everything we needed - including a travel cot, sheets, towels etc. for our 8-month old baby! I can highly recommend the listing. Thank you!

Superbe appartement situé dans un quartier typique avec une charmante ruelle pour y accéder. Nous avons passé un très bon séjour et espérons revenir ! José est un hôte très disponible avec le sourire et une grande gentillesse. Nous te remercions pour notre séjour. Nous recommandons sans hésitation ce logement !!

Premier séjour pour ma maman et moi sur airbnb qui fut une expérience unique et fabuleuse!
L'appartement de Zé est très bien placé au cœur du quartier le plus ancien et le plus typique de Lisbonne : Alfama. Haut en couleurs, l'ambiance y est vivante et paisible à la fois avec des restaurants et petits commerces tout autour. Aussi ses ruelles étroites, qui montent et qui descendent, ses escaliers sans fin et les odeurs de poissons grillés où il est bon de s’y perdre pour découvrir des endroits authentiques à chaque fois et rencontrer des personnes ouvertes et attachantes.
L'appartement est parfait, il ne manque rien. Nous nous y sommes senties immédiatement à l'aise. Nous l'avons trouvé cosy, joliment décoré, bien équipé, bien agencé et très propre. De nombreuses petites attentions ainsi que de la documentation pour nous accompagner tout au long de notre séjour sont très appréciables... Il est bien situé à deux pas de la station de métro et non loin du centre de Lisbonne à pied (environ 15min de marche).
En plus d'avoir découvert une magnifique ville qu'est Lisboa et un quartier splendide et pittoresque, nous avons fait une rencontre inoubliable : celle de Zé, un hôte très accueillant, très attentionné, une personne unique et exceptionnelle de part sa gentillesse, sa générosité, toujours prêt à rendre service. Malgré notre anglais plus que moyen, il a réussi à nous comprendre et nous avons pu discuter ensemble! Il nous a accordé de son temps dès notre arrivé avec une découverte de Lisbonne sur livre photo et carte. Puis une balade dans Alfama accompagnée de très bons conseils sur les restaurants, ce qu'il faut voir, les visites à faire etc...
Soyez tranquille il sera toujours là en cas de besoin ! Nous recommandons à 200%, n'hésitez pas!
Bien plus qu'un hôte, le feeling est très bien passé dès notre rencontre, aujourd'hui Zé est un Ami. Nous te remercions sincèrement, grâce à toi notre voyage restera magique et inoubliable...
Gros bisous à toi Zé et à très vite! Prends soin de toi,
Brigitte et Mandy
It is a great place. really enjoyed my stay there. Thank you.
José was a very flexible host and made us feel very welcome. The flazt is super centrally located and beautiful, modern.
Très bien accueilli , bon conseil

Première expérience Airbnb pour nous à Lisbonne, et bien quelle magnifique surprise nous avons eu ! Le quartier est parfait, pitoresque et vivant, proche de tout, on peut tout faire à pieds. Nous n'avons utilisé les transports que pour aller à Bélèm ou la plage qui sont bien plus loins. Vous avez des petits commerces, restaurants partout autour et la station de metro est à même pas 5 minutes. L'appartement est parfait, décoré avec gout il est digne d'une revue  déco ! Spatieux, bien agencé et super équipé, vous avez tout ce qu'il vous faut. Même plus avec pleins de petites attentions très gentilles comme des fleurs, diverses choses à manger, des prospectus et des livres pour donner des idées de visites. Mais si je dois remercier quelqun, il s'agit bien de José, c'est un hote exeptionnel. Adorable et passionné par sa ville, il prend son role très a coeur et ne vous recevra pas simplement pour vous donner les clés. Il prend soin de vous et vous accompagne à votre arrivée. Il vous montre le quartier et la ville, premièrement à travers un livre avec une carte puis par une petite balade dehors pour parler des bonnes adresses comme le ferait un guide. Il est bien plus qu'un hote mais une personne en or qu'on ne peut que remercier et qui marque le voyage d'une trace indélébile. Je recommande à 100% l'adresse, gros coup de coeur.

The apartment is situated in a very good location, in Alfama, a typical district of Lisbon. Very close to the Santa Apolonia train station. 15 minutes walks from Rossio square. It is well furnished and clean.
José is a perfect airbnb host. He gave us a lot of advices concerning places where to go in Lisbon (also about food and restaurant). He also take us for a walk in Alfama. Very recommended!!!!

José est un super hôte ! Accueil parfait avec un tour du quartier. L'appartement est très propre, bien équipé et sa situation en plein cœur du quartier de l'Alfama est parfaite ! Je le recommande vivement.

We have spent 1 night in José 's apartment. It was a very pleasant experience. The apartment is clean, cosy and lovely decorated.
It is located in the heart of Alfama, very close to Military Museum.
José is a very nice, friendly and helpful host. He did everything to make our stay comfortable. He even showed us a way to the airport and helped with a dropping off the car to the rental company.
Thank you, José!
Perfect appartement for 2 in the heart of Alfama. Very friendly host with great recommendations for restaurants and more. We've had a fantastic time!

This is an excellent rental! If you've found this place to be available for your stay definitely take it. Everything you could expect from an Airbnb is there. The bed is great, fast WiFi, lots of windows, very clean, great shower, quiet.
The location is also amazing. Alfama is definitely the neighbourhood to stay in and everything is close by Jose's place. He also met us at the metro station to make finding out way in the quaint staircases and alleyways of Alfama easy.
In short, the place is fantastic and so is the host. Can't recommend it enough.

Perfect host (thanks a lot for your recommendations)
Perfect location (located in the heart of the beautiful alfama, 15 min walk to the city center)
Perfect apartment (very cosy, everything you need).
All in all it's the Airbnb experience you are looking for...

Hi Zé, thanks so much for your hospitality, you're such a great host! Thanks for having shared such good tips on what to visit in Lisboa. Alfama district is just amazing. We'll come back for sure. Recommended!

We really enjoyed our stay at José's flat! Perfect location, very clean and very well equipped! Definitely recommended.
Thank you José and Barbara :)

José's flat is soooo charming, like a doll's house : pretty, tiny and cosy, nicely decorated, very clean. Very well located in the hart of Alfama, a "must see" old district of Lisboa, full of restaurants, nice shop, old monuments and typical squares. I highly recommand ! Just notice that there are lots of steps and old pavement to get there and sharp stairs to reach the flat up to 2nd floor : that is to say for girls, don't put your high heels on that day and avoid heavy luggage !!!

C'était un formidable appartement , idéalement situé , extrêmement propre et accueillant.  Nous avons eu un séjour parfait et le confort du logement y a été important.  Accueil chaleureux du propriétaire et quartier sécuritaire .  Merci Jose !! Bravo !

José was a great host (plus he speaks English), he even fetched us at the airport as it was late. He showed us his neighbourhood so we can have landmarks in the morning. The flat is great, very clean, comfortable and provides everything. The area is 15 min from praça do comércio and 25 from bairro alto. I definitely recommend it !

José was a fantastic host! He was extremely welcoming and took time to show us around the area and give recommendations for restaurants and things to do. The apartment was beautiful and in a great location. We loved Lisbon and José's place was a great base from which to enjoy the city.

Fantastic place in the heart of Alfama. Jose is a great guy who does everything to help with your stay and to make you feel welcome. He waited for us at the station, made a quick tour of Alfama with us, showed us good places to eat, drink and listen to fado. Appartement is very cosy and clean. At our arrival there were fresh flowers and homegrown fruits. Hope we will return one day.

This was a nice and cozy little place to stay in Lisbon. The rooms were tidy and everything we needed was there, even food in the fridge. Zé gave us a short tour around Alfama and recommended great places to see, restaurants and shops. Would stay there again!
Great place, great location, great host. Would stay again and will recommend to friends.

Appartement situé dans le vieux Lisbonne: quartier très typique avec beaucoup d'escaliers! José nous a attendu jusqu'à 22h00 et a pris le temps de nous donner des repères pour visiter la ville: accueil très chaleureux!
Appartement très propre et bien équipé, on se sent chez soi. Tout est pensé, de la trousse à pharmacie aux parapluies. Il y a même de quoi dépanner dans le frigo!
Très bonne première expérience Airbnb!!!
A recommander!

Merci José, l'appartement est parfait, très agréable et tellement bien placé.
Pleines de petites attentions : fleurs fraîches, nourriture dans le frigo.
Toutes les commodités dans l'appartement.

Merci aussi à Barbara de nous avoir accompagnées le premier jour.

Muito obrigado.
It was really perfect :D

Merci Zé !

Nous avons passé un agréable séjour à Lisbonne. le logement est idéalement situé permettant de se rendre facilement et très rapidement vers nos lieux de visite.

L'accueil qui nous a été réservé à été chaleureux. Après la visite de l'appartement et les conseils d'usage, José nous a emmené faire un petit tour dans l'Alfama, ce que nous avons apprécié.

L'appartement est très propre, confortable et fonctionnel. Avec nos 2 enfants, c'était parfait !

Encore merci....
Super séjour dans ce petit appartement très fonctionnel et parfait pour quelques jours ! Très bien situé pour découvrir le vieux Lisbonne !

ES LA SEGUNDA VEZ QUE CONTRATO EL DEPARTAMENTO DE JOSE , ESTE ES PERFECTO PARA UNA PAREJA O A LO SUMO TRES PERSONAS,ESTA EQUIPADO CON "TODO" ,realmente es muy bueno,los elogios ya los hice en la otra evaluacion.Asi que GRACIAS POR TODO JOSE.Queda muy cerca del  metro hay restaurantes en toda la zona.EN especial uno con muy buena atencion y muy economico que queda en CALZADA DO FORTE nº 26 -RC RETAURANTE-Es conveniente  tomar las interseccciones de las calles para no perderse.

It was the first time I used Airbnb for a trip and I was not disappointed at all.
The appartment is perfectly fine, there is more than enough room, it's clean, you can cook by yourself and everything worked out great.
Zé helped us getting an overview about Lisbon and showed us some places to go on he map we got from him.
We could've called him when something was wrong, but since there wasn't any issue, we didn't had to make use of it.

Merci à José pour sa disponibilité, son accueil, sa présentation de la ville et ses conseils. Le logement est très agréable et chaleureux, il correspond parfaitement à la description et est très bien situé. Nous n'avons utilisé les transports que pour rejoindre Belem et le musée des azulejos sinon les quartiers du centre ville sont facilement accessibles à pieds. Une première visite de Lisbonne qui donne envie de revenir :-)

josé is a really friendly person! In the apartments are all the things you need, to feel like at home and comfortable. Near by the house, are a lot of good restaurants and cutie little bars. He is always achievable if you need something! If i visit lisbon again, i definitely go to josè`s apartment.

Épatant ! Même si les photos étaient tout à fait conformes à la réalité, elles ne pouvaient retranscrire l'âme de ce logement petit mais bien agencé et surtout de ce quartier si pittoresque, touristique mais très calme, à 250 m de la gare/station de métro de Santa Apolonia.
L'appartement était équipé de tout le nécessaire, de l'utile et même plus (fleurs, fruits, condiments frais ...).
Et puis, il y a Zé. Jamais nous n'avons été accueillis comme ça ! L’œil brillant, manifestement amoureux d'Alfama et de sa ville, il nous a fait l'inventaire de tout ce qu'il fallait voir, faire et manger à Lisbonne, appuyant son propos d'illustrations et nous indiquant toutes les directions à prendre pour les meilleurs "miradouros" !
Il ne restait qu'à s'installer et profiter de la remarquable hospitalité de Zé. Quand nous l'avons remercié pour le temps et l’énergie qu'il a consacré à nous accueillir, il a répondu que tous les Lisboètes étaient comme lui. Propos modeste mais avéré !
Encore merci, Zé !

Nos fueron a buscar ,a la terminal de trenes y nos acompanaron hasta la casa muy cerca de la estacion de tren,el departamento  esta completo,no le falta nada ,tiene de todo.Estuve solo un dia .Todo bien.

Superou as expectativas! O apartamento é acolhedor, muito limpo e bem decorado. Fica localizado num bairro histórico da capital portuguesa, próximo a transportes e importantes pontos turísticos. O José é um anfitrião muito atencioso e prestativo que nos deu boas dicas do que conhecer na cidade, além de indicações de restaurantes de culinária local. Recomendo!

One of the most friendliest hosts I have ever met. Perfect communication and a very nice welcome, I thank you very much!
The apartment is just perfect, a truly local and traditional experience right inside the best part of the whole city.
I cannot recommend this place more!

L'appartement de José était parfait pour le séjour que nous y avons passé. Très agréable, il était propre, confortable et disposait de tout le nécessaire. José a été très accueillant et arrangeant, et il nous a donné de bon conseils pour nos visites et pour se restaurer. L'appartement est très bien situé dans le quartier de l'Alfama et à 10min à pied de la praça do comércio. Nous recommandons chaudement cet appartement ! Thank you José

José was super nice and always available. The flat is fully furnished, less than 5min a walk from the subway and not far from the center. Alfama is a very typical neighborhood with narrow streets and easy access to beautiful sights over Lisbon. We had a lovely time !

All was perfect!José is very,very,very nice person.The house is clean,modern,and Jose has thought about all the details and small things to make our stay even more pleasureful! REALLY a good host and amazing flat- it is visible that Jose tries his best to make his guests feel like at home!

Really beautiful and relaxed place! Jose did everything possible to make the stay perfect. We loved the location, cozyness and tidiness of the flat. Would love to come back!
Obigado Jose!

The house is very nice and comfortable. it is in a really good position (near the city centre and the metro station santa Apolonia). when we arrived we found it very clean!
José was really kind: he showed us lots of interestig places in Lisbon (restaurants, museums and markets). he gave us a wonderful welcome and he helped us with everything! he was always available for any problems and absolutely efficient!

José is very nice, and the flat is lovely and cozy. Everything is tidy and nothing misses. we had a perfect time there!
We could enjoy a very typical neighborhood with its narrow streets, traditional Fado and beautiful view on the Lisbon.
I highly recommend!
Thanks!

I have to say that everything was perfect, as the flat, as the amabilty of the José. He his superfriendly and he could make us feel as at home!

The pace were very confortable and clean, with all you can need to spend some days traveling. All the factilies were perfect: the kitchen is provided to cook, it s also big enough, bed and other furnitures are news and confortable. I can't say any bad aspect of the flat, it surprised me!

The place, Alfama, is a very warm neighbourhood, with friendly people and good sightseeing. The only problem is the stairs, that make a little dificult to walk with the baggage. But José lead us by an alternative route in where the road was easier.

José also was worried enough for giving us all the details that we need for visiting the most beautiful places, as well as how to go from one to the other. He also give us many tips about food, transport and, in general, all we asked for. He was with us more than an hour, trying to help as much as possible!

So, if you are thinking about spending some days in Lisbon, I highly recommend you to chode José's house!

Un hôte charmant, un quartier emblématique et un appart superbe dans une ruelle sans voiture comme seule l'alfama en comporte! Tout a été pensé pour votre accueil dans les moindres détails! Lieu à recommander ++++ pour les amateurs d'authenticité et bien sûr de fado.
Vrais petits commerçants à une minute, restau populaires avec des "menu de dia" à 6,50 euros...tout compris et le sourire des portugais en plus! Exceptionnel!!

That was a really nice stay in this appartement !!! Realy thank José for your hospitality. And the tea was so good :D
Thank you for every thing.
Funcionou tudo lindamente. A casa é acolhedora, confortável, limpa e prática. A localização é perfeita. O José foi impecável e mostrou-se sempre disponível para tudo.

Zé was a great host from beginning to end.
We actually had a bit of a situation with the airlines where our luggage didn't arrive until the next day. Zé was kind enough to actually lend me a clean change of clothes! So that gives you an idea what kind of guy he is.
The apartment was as advertised and more. Nice, clean and cosy.
In regards to the location, it's a charming neighborhood with lots of attractions nearby, small cafes and bars. Zé's friends at the Café Central were also very helpful.
It's also very easy to get anywhere from there especially with the Santa Apolónia station so close by.
Thank you Zé for such a wonderful stay!

Hemos pasado unos días inolvidables en Lisboa, Jose nos esperó hasta que llegamos, a pesar de llegar tarde debido a una fortísima lluvia y varios accidentes en el camino. Allí estaba esperándonos en la Estación de Santa Apolónia, con toda la información y disponibilidad para ayudar.
Grande fué la sorpresa al llegar a su precioso apartamento en el popualar barrio de Alfama, nos recibió con un delicioso trago de La traficional Ginginha.
Luego de explicarnos en detalle el funcionamiento de todos servicios y electrodomésticos de casa, nos dió un pequeño tour por el barrio para ensañarnos donde aparcar el coche de forma segura y que sitios de interes visitar.
En general muy útil toda la información aportada, pero lo mejor, el anfitrión. Un chico joven dinámico y con una increible generosidad.
Su apartamento impecablemente limpio, cálido y acogedor,dotado de todo lo necesario para pasar unos días muy especiales.
El barrio tranquilo, de gente amable y bohemia, las casas de Fado del vecindario dan ese toque especial que ha convertido a Alfama en uno de esos barrios obligados a incluir en todo viaje a Lisboa.
Las fotos del anuncio se queda cortas y la realidad las supera.
En resumen, no se pierdan esta maravillosa experiencia en cualquier epoca del año.

José was very kind and easy to get in touch with. We booked the apt during the holidays but he was still very flexible with his schedule and helpful with all that we had doubts on. The apt is just as described in the listing. It is a very nice apt, perfect for two people to stay comfortably, there wasn't a microwave, but the stove and the oven were perfect for us because we wanted to make food during our stay. The apt was filled with amenities that can not be found at most airbnb's: we had a hair drier, iron and ironing board, extra comforters and pillows, a portable heater, etc. The house is located in the a nice neighborhood near the water. We had a car, so we did not need a metro or other public transportation, we were able to park our car in a lot on Sunday night for free that is right across from the police station.
José was a kind person and an appartment is in good location of city. everything was ok and we didn't have any problems. in case of sth José is ready to help you. ;)

Wonderful stay in Alfama!
Excellent location. Lots of restaurants and shops within easy walking distance.
The famous Tram 28 stops steps from the front door. Tip: buy a full day ticket M-F. Local ticket kiosks are closed on the weekends plus the tram is very crowded. Spend Saturday locally, visiting the nearby Flea Market and eating at the restaurants recommended by Pedro.
Pedro was a great host. In fact he helped me with a travel catastrophe (not related to the Airbnb stay).
It was great to meet his Super Mom!

Nos recibió la madre de Pedro y nos mostró todo el apartamento con lujo de detalle. La terraza del edificio tiene una vista espectacular!
Gracias Pedro por el vino de bienvenida!
Pedro’s place was lovely, conveniently located, and exactly as described in the listing. He was a wonderful host and took so much time to ensure that we had a great experience in Lisbon!
Perfect location to discover the beautiful city of Lisbon. The apartment was clean and tidy. Pedro was extremely welcoming, helpful and flexible.

Nous sommes très contents du séjour. Le calme de l'appartement est bénéfique le soir après une journée de visites. Nous recommandons le petit restaurant A Cabreira à 500m, pour les petits déjeuners authentiques et les déjeuners, au milieu des lisboètes. Nous recommandons vivement cette adresse, au sein du quartier typique, à proximité du célèbre tram 28E.

We had such an amazing stay! Pedro was so lovely, super welcoming, and went above and beyond to accommodate us. We loved the area - we felt very safe and found we could get everywhere we wanted really easily.
Thank you Pedro!
Logement très bien situé et très propre. Un réel plaisir de séjourner chez Pedro. Un excellent séjour à Lisbonne !
Great location, great host, super clean apartment, comfortable bed. I loved the little bottle of wine as a welcome gift, and the sunset from the roof was beautiful. I'd definitely recommend.
Loved our stay… taking the tram was extremely easy and convenient from our location…nice little market near by…great visit

Pedro’s place was great. It was just as described in the listing: clean, functional, and well-located in Lisbon. Pedro’s mother met us to check us in and give a brief tour of the apartment. Pedro sent us useful restaurant recommendations and was always responsive. This was a great experience and well worth the reasonable price.
Everything went perfect.

La casa di Pedro ha il pregio di essere ad Alfama , quartiere popolare e vero, di avere davanti la fermata del tram 28, vicinissima alla Fiera da ladra , e a localini piccoli e non turistici.
Il letto è super comodo e la casa molto silenziosa. Per una esperienza sublime vai al ristorante Santa Clara dos Cogumelos a pochi passi dalla casa di Pedro

We had a pleasant stay at this Airbnb. The host’s mom who showed us around was very sweet and welcoming, which made check-in easy and comfortable. The apartment is centrally located, making it convenient to explore Lisbon, and communication was always quick and responsive.
A gentle note for fellow travelers from the U.S.: as with many older buildings in Lisbon, central heating is not typical, especially in winter. It’s part of the charm of historic homes, so just come prepared if you’re visiting during colder months. Overall, we enjoyed our stay and appreciated the hospitality. Will definitely come back again!
Pedro was very kind and accommodating to my delayed check-in. The apartment is perfect for a short or mid-term stay. Location can’t be beat, though prepare yourself for Alfama’s hills and steps.

Pedros es muy amable y te explica todo super bien. El alojamiento es muy acogedor y tal cual las fotos!
Una recomendación es reservar un parking aunque tengas que subir a andar, pues es una zona con muy poco aparcamiento, ya que el que hay el sabado hay feria y no puedes aparcar! Por lo demas todo super bien! Lisboa bonito y el apartamento de 10.
Super hôte très à l’écoute. Logement top bien situé et impeccable. Merci Pedro

Pedro's flat was wonderful!!! Super convenient to have a tram stop right outside the door and walkable to many sights especially Miraduoros! Beautiful rooftop views and special touches he left us.....crackers, peach preserves, vino and fresh lemons! Thank you for a fabulous Lison visit, Pedro!

Amazing location in Lisboa.
Tips and recommendations from Pedro much appreciated,
Thank you

Pedro was a great host, always available.
Great to meet your host personally and welcome us. Too much on AirBnB these days are self check

Great stay in neighborhood setting. Must be able to walk because lots of hills and stairs. But well worth it!
Place was perfect for 4-5 nights. The host was soooo responsive, answering all our questions and going out of his way to help us.
HIGHLY recommend!!!

Pedro was an exceptional host from the moment we arrived. He greeted us personally, gave us a thorough tour of the apartment, and made sure we felt completely at ease. Throughout our stay, he was gracious, responsive, and always available to answer questions—his hospitality made a real difference.
The apartment itself exceeded our expectations: spotless, cozy, and stocked with everything we needed (and more). It felt like home from day one, with thoughtful touches that made settling in effortless.
On day of departure, I had the pleasure of seeing Pedro again—this time with his lovely mother—and was able to thank him in person for making our time in Lisboa so memorable. His kindness and attention to detail truly elevated our experience.
As a proud Portuguese, I wholeheartedly encourage anyone considering a trip to Portugal to make it happen—and when in Lisboa, staying at Pedro’s Airbnb is the perfect way to experience the warmth and charm of our culture.
Muito obrigado, Pedro!
Estadia foi ótima,  o apartamento estava impecável, tudo novinho e funcionando.
Pedro’s place is in an amazing location and the rooftop has a great view of the city! The communication was great and the place is the perfect size for a couple.

L'appartamento, in linea generale, appare come dalle immagini ma l'impressione è che sia più piccolo probabilmente perchè non è molto luminoso essendo ad un piano basso.
La cucina è veramente fornita di tutto il necessario e un grande vantaggio è la lavastoviglie

Check in e check out ottimi

Indubbiamente silenzioso
Il problema che abbiamo riscontrato è stata la sensazione di umidità persistente in modo particolare quando, in nostra assenza, non era possibile tenere le finestre aperte. Al ritorno, fortunatamente aiutati da giornate miti e ventose, era necessario fare subito corrente per eliminare l'odore classico degli ambienti umidi
Il bagno cieco non ha ventola e questo non aiuta sicuramente infatti gli asciugamani rimangono sempre umidi dopo il primo uso
Carta igienica e asciugamani in abbondanza

Abbiamo soggiornato in questo piccolo appartamento nel cuore di Alfama e ne siamo rimasti molto soddisfatti. The apartment was clean and spacious and had a very well equipped kitchen.  Pedro was a great host. When we arrived, he spent time explaining everything about the apartment and provided a lot of travel information.  Communication was fast and easy.  Location had pluses and minuses.  Alfama is a charming older neighborhood with narrow winding streets, steep staircases and an architecture influenced by Moorish design.  There are many minimarkets and restaurants close-by.  It is a 10 minute uphill walk to Graca, with a larger food market, two pharmacies and one of the best views in Lisbon.  Downside is transportation.  #28 tram is a tourist attraction, but it is crowded (often full) and slow.  We found that it is better to walk to the metro, which can be accessed at a couple of stations with a 15-20 minute walk.   For older people with mobility issues, be aware that the streets are narrow and steep and can be slippery when wet.  Staircases may lack railings.

superbe appartement Pedro est tout simplement formidable de conseils.

we highly recommend staying at Pedro'shouse

Great location with many things to do within a short walk. Lots of good restaurants nearby as well.

Nous avons apprécié notre séjour à Alfama.
