tout était parfait! le logement vraiment bien pour nous deux pour un long week-end mais aurait été parfait pour un plus long séjour. emplacement vraiment idéal. Pedro a vraiment été sympathique, clair et réactif à chaque fois. nous recommandons sans aucune réserve.

I would definitely recommend if you are staying for a couple of days in Lisbon. It was neat and clean, very cosy, all expectations were met. Bed is comfy. Nice view on the rooftop. The only con is humidity but for short term is fine.

We hadden een prima tijd in het superschone en zeer compleet ingerichte appartement van Pedro. Echt aan alles is gedacht! Zijn moeder ontving ons en heeft ons alles verteld en uitgelegd. Pedro informeerde af en toe of alles oke was en kwam met goede tips.

Great apartment with all you need. Very well equipped. Estuvimos muy bien mi pareja y yo. El apartamento muy limpio, acogedor y con todo lo necesario. Y muy cerca de miradores.

appartement très bien situé dans le quartier Alfama, très fonctionnel , accueil chaleureux par la maman de Pedro

Words can't decide how amazing Pedro and his apartment was. I know its very easy to give 5 stars and top ratings but this place 100% deserved it.

Magnifica opción para permanecer unos días en Lisboa.

Apartamento muy bonito y situado en el barrio con más encanto de Lisboa.Totalmente recomendable para una pareja!!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Pedro's apartment,  it is very convenient in an area that is full of the charm and character of the oldest area in Lisbon. The place has excellent amenities and location, and Pedro is a very hospitable host. Highly recommended!

A wonderful family, a wonderful place! Located in Alafama, on the first floor of a renovated house, the apartment provides the guest with everything necessary and even more. Great location. Tidy home. Great space. Has an outdoor terrace on the rooftop with a great view!! Pedro is really nice and you will like home away from home.
appartement tres bien situé

Everything is perfect. Everything is very clean. Nice communication with Pedro. Lots of relevant recommendations of activities and restaurants in the city. We did not use the rooftop because it is on the fourth floor and the flat is at the first floor. We really recommend this lovely flat !

Alles hat uns gut gefallen und wir kommen gerne wieder.

Hemos estado encantadas en el apartamento de Pedro. Fue un encanto, nos ayudó en todo. Nos dio recomendaciones para ver Lisboa y sus alrededores. Recomiendo 100% sin duda si vuelvo a Lisboa contactaré por él para ir. Una maravilla

Recepção calorosa com um sorriso magnífico da mãe de Pedro, super atenciosa dando um tom de 5 estrelas à nossa chegada. Pedro's place is located in quiet part of Alfama - not all areas of Alfama are quiet. The apartment is wonderful: easy, comfortable, clean, good internet, etc.. We met Pedro' s mom - who gave us a nice overview of the place - but didn't get the chance to meet Pedro. We were out a lot :).
The house is close to the Castle at the top of the hill, which makes for an easy walk down through the winding, crazy streets of Alfama to find food, music, shops and so on. There are several nice restaurants right there as you walk out the front door, a good market for supplies, and an amazing coffee shop and bakery (Copenhagen Coffee Lab) all within steps of the front door.
The trolley that should run right by the front door is suspended until some rails and roads are repaired, but you can make the walk up from the Rio Tejo or the Praca Comercio/Chiado areas if you take it slow (we're in our 60's and did it every day) get public transport up to the castle and walk down, or just take a cab or uber to the front door.
In sum, this apartment is wonderful. Pedro and his mom take beautiful care of it and it's in a fabulous location.

Pedro nous a accueillis malgré l’arrivée tardive de notre vol. Il nous a tout expliqué avec brio. Tout est parfait, tout est optimisé pour un week-end touristique au top. L’emplacement est idéal. Parfait pour un petit séjour à Lisbonne. L'appartement est en excellent état. Et Pedro est un hôte très acceuillant.

Schöne Unterkunft in einem sehr schönen alten Stadtteil. 5 Fussminuten weg vom Trubel der Massen gelegen.

Logement d'une propreté impeccable et doté d'une literie confortable, très bien équipé. De plus, il est situé au coeur de l'authentique et superbe quartier de l'Alfama. Parfait pour découvrir et déambuler dans cette sublime ville qu'est Lisbonne...

Appartamento perfetto: pulizia, tranquillità e confort nel bellissimo quartiere dell’Alfama. A questo si aggiunge la disponibilità e la collaborazione di Pedro. Una sistemazione, quindi, che suggerirò di sicuro ad amici che vogliono visitare Lisbona

Pedro is a welcoming host, he was in touch when we booked, before we travelled and during our stay. He provided lots of helpful information about Lisbon helping us to get around more easily and find things to do and see. There were also some samples of local produce and a small supply of teas and coffee which we appreciated.
Alfalma is an interesting area of Lisbon full of old winding streets and steep and narrow steps but after a couple of days we were confidently finding our way around.

We had a 3 day stay end of February. Still winter but not too cold and very wet but the apartment was nice and cosy with good heat. Elevator in the apartment, in quite a hilly part of town though for other walking.
Check in was easy and great from Pedro's mother.
We would stay here again but next time would take the metro from the airport (€1.45), versus a cab (€18).

Pedro es un anfitrión estupendo, nos recibió de noche sin poner ninguna traba, nos enseñó todo lo que respecta al piso y dio tips que fueron de mucha utilidad durante nuestra estadía. Like everyone else, we can say that this was the best Airbnb that we have been in from the start until the end. She showed us as well the terrace which is located on the top of the building from where the view is absolutely amazing - from the one side you can see the part of Alfama and S. Vicente which is a 5 minutes walk away and from the other side there is a breathtaking view to the river.
The apartment itself is absolutely perfect - there is everything you need from a dishwasher to a really comfortable bed.
Although we did not meet Pedro as he was working, he made sure to know if everything is OK throughout our entire stay - we even got two small bottles of local wine to taste as a gift. You can find as well a lot of information about the neighborhood, where to eat and what to visit in Lisbon, everything carefully explained by Pedro and his mother.
Overall, you can see that he is a very experienced host and he cares a lot for his guests, which we think is the most important. The only sad thing was that at the moment the tram 28 does not pass in front of the building as there are improvement works but that did not spoil at all our holiday. Do not hesitate to book here, as I can assure this is one of the best Airbnbs! Muito Obrigado!

Great place, great location in such a lovely city!

For your next Lisbon Trip, I hope you consider staying at Pedro's.
Other than the obviously great location, with most the significant landmarks within minutes walk away from the apartment, and the Tram 28 stopping right at the front door (not to mention the great view from the terrace), the most notable part of our experience was the refreshing thoughtfulness of the Host Pedro, and his mother Maria.
Our flight got delayed, so we arrived 4 hours after our agreed-upon check-in time. I was able to quickly let Pedro know of the delay, but we eventually arrived even later than expected since our luggage got lost (long story!). But even with all that delay, Maria was there to receive us right when we arrived, and cheerfully show us all the amenities even with her limited English. We were very touched for all the effort she took to get us settled in properly. Pedro was available whenever we had any question, and responded via chat very promptly. His family went out of their way to help us receive our Lost baggage when the Airport finally located and delivered them (I will not get into the details of that, but rest assured, their help was priceless). Pedro was also nice enough to contact the Taxi company for us ahead of time since we needed to book one to travel to the airport at 2:30AM to catch our early morning flight back.
The apartment itself is very nice. Its spacious, clean and well-fitted. Most importantly, it is very safe. As I mentioned already, the location is outstanding! Also, there are Grocery Stores, and Cafes right on the street.
The only caution I would like to provide is: Alfama is an Old city on a hilly coastal landscape with cobbled, winding streets at varying altitudes. So if you are somehow ill-disposed, or unwilling to walk uphill/downhill on uneven ground, the whole of Alfama may not be suited for you. My husband and I specially enjoyed the Old charm of the city though, so its totally personal preference. But, UBER and Taxis are always available so walking can be avoided totally.
Conclusion: Totally Recommended!

The district of Alfama is really beautiful, authentic, safe and central. We weren't disturb at all, as the workers didn't work on the five days we spent there, but maybe worth to check directly with Pedro what is the actual state.

Pedro's apartment located in the centre of Alfama was just wonderful. It's clean, comfortable and quiet, which is perfect after a long day in the city. Pedro was also an incredibly nice host; he had prepared some city guides and maps of Lisbon and Belem and explained us everything when we arrived. We would definitely come back!

Obrigado Pedro e família pela incrível experiência que tivemos em Lisboa. O bairro de Alfama é belíssimo e estar em um lugar tão típico como esse nos fez viver uma experiência sem precedentes. O stúdio é incrível. Tudo muito bem equipado nos mínimos detalhes: inúmeros utensílios de cozinha, tv a cabo, itens de limpeza. O apartamento está muito bem decorado e aconchegante. O mirante que existe no prédio já é um show à parte. Fomos calorosamente recebidos pelos pais do Pedro, a senhora Maria e o senhor Benjamim que nos explicou o funcionamento da casa nos mínimos detalhes. O bairro de Alfama já é uma atração à parte e ficamos apaixonados pelo lugar. O Pedro foi muito atencioso desde nosso primeiro contato do Brasil, conversamos muito pelo Whatsapp e ele sempre foi solícito e gentil. Nos deu várias dicas de Portugal (aliás, o apartamento é repleto de folders, mapas e dicas turísticas). Meu caro Pedro, já estou com saudades de Portugal e do seu aconchegante lar! Não consigo achar um defeito sequer...

*Ah, uma dica aos viajantes: o bairro de Alfama embora seja lindíssimo e visita obrigatória a quem vai a Lisboa, tem ruas com subidas e descidas bem ingrimes, alem de muitas escadarias...se algum viajante tiver dificuldades de mobilidade, dificulta um pouquinho.
The apartment was perfect. Great location, everything neat and tidy. Pedro received us even at 11 in the night and was super friendly. It's a good place to stay, which I can only recommend

Con Pedro nos comunicamos fluidamente por telefono. No lo vimos personalmente.
Su madre nos recibió puntualmente , fue muy amable, dinamica y simpatica. Nos explicó todos los detalles necesarios para nuestra comodidad.

Nous avons été accueillis par la mère de Pedro avec laquelle nous avez fait le 'tour' du studio en une dizaine de minutes. Pour le check out, elle nous dit de laisser les clés à l'intérieur du studio. La mère de Pedro est très agréable, pour Pedro, nous ne savons pas nous ne l'avons jamais vu.
Le logement est conforme à sa description et bien équipé.

Pedro y su familia nos han tratado muy bien y nos han puesto muchas facilidades para tener una gran estancia en Lisboa. El piso esta en el corazón de Alfama y es ideal para moverse a pie por toda la ciudad. El piso esta muy bien acondicionado ideal para dos personas.
Gracias a los tres!!!!!

Das Apartment war sauber, sehr gemütlich eingerichtet und liegt Mitten in Alfama. Zu Fuss sind es ca 15 min ins Stadtzentrum, eine Tramstation befindet sich um die Ecke. Da Pedro gerade nicht in Lissabon war, haben uns seine Eltern empfangen und uns alles sehr ausführlich und nett erklärt. Tipps gibt es auch durch von Pedro selbst erstellten Vorschlägen zur Stadtbesichtigung und Restaurantempfehlungen. Hier hat man sich wirklich sehr viel Mühe gegeben. Jederzeit wieder!

Die Unterkunft war sauber und nett eingerichte, Pedro hat uns sehr freundlich empfangen und uns gut eingewiesen. Wir habe es sehr genossen direkt in alfama zu wohnen, also sofort mitten drin. Die Wohnung war sehr ruhig, da die Fenster in den innen Hof führen. Den Dachsitz konnten wir wegen des Wetters nicht nutzen, ist aber sehr schön. Wir würde auf jeden Fall wieder kommen. Sabine Dirk

Pedro was a GREAT host : when we arrived, he has prepared a bottle of white porto, because I told him that my wife and I love wine.
We have been welcomed by his lovely mother, Maria. She explained us very well everything in this perfectly-well equiped apartment.
And it was very easy to check out : we let the key on the table and closed the door.
One last thing : go to take your breakfast in the Cultural Portuguese Café, 15 meters (!) from the apartment.
Thank you Pedro.
appartement propre et bien situé, au calme.Pedro était là pour nous accueillir et nous donner les informations sur Lisbonne.

Pedro's place is in the heart of the old centre which is the perfect location to explore old Lisbon. The flat is very well looked after and has access to a beautiful little terrace which is great for an evening drink before getting lost in the charming winding backstreets. Pedro and his mother were very accommodating. Kindly letting us have an early check in and making sure we had everything. I highly recommend staying at this very reasonably priced studio. When we are next in Lisbon we will unquestionably stay here and will recommend it to our friends. Muita obrigada Pedro x
It was very nice home
We had a very warm welcome from Pedro! He made sure we had all we needed, and provided us with maps and many helpful tips. The apartment was clean, cozy, and quiet.

Pedro is a perfect host. We felt ourselves like at home.:)
Pedro left us detailed recommendations on Lisbon and a welcome present what was very kind of him.
The apartment looks right like at the pictures: cozy and full of all necessary equipment. It's situated right in front of the line of tram 28. Everyone who visits Lisbon should definitely catch this tram! It's unbelievable how it maneuvers through such narrow streets!
The location is convenient for strolling through Alfama neighborhood. São Vicente de Fora monastery is just right around a corner. And a beautiful miradouro Portas do Sol is less than 10 minutes walking away in unhurried pace where you can enjoy pretty views of the surrounding area while having a cup of coffee. Santa Apolonia train and metro station is also not far from the apartment.
The only moment for everyone who travels in off-season: it can be a bit cold at this time. We stayed in March and even a heater could hardly help us to warm up. But it's a feature of the weather conditions and type of houses' constructions.
Pedro! Thanks a lot for everything. We enjoyed our time in Lisbon and hope to come back there soon.

Best wishes from Russia,
Svetlana

We had a wonderful weekend in Lissabon! Special thanks to Pedro and his mother who made our stay unforgettable. His apartment is perfect! Very nice neighborhood with many nice restaurants and cafes. You can reach everything by walk or just take the tram which stops directly in his street.
Again, thank you so much for this wonderful time in Lissabon! We would love to come back soon :)

L'appartement de Pedro est vraiment idéal pour découvrir Lisbonne. Situé dans le quartier typique de l'alfama, le tramway 28 passe juste devant. Pedro est un hôte accueillant, attentionné (Porto, confiture, café...), disponible et pleins de bons conseils (en anglais). L'appartement est coquet, propre et bien équipé. Séjour inoubliable. Merci Pedro !

We spent 5 days at Pedro's place which is perfect to visit Lisbon. The apartment is really well furnished, comfortable and you will find everything you need while travelling.
The neighborhood is really nice and you can find good restaurants without going far away. Plus Pedro provided us with good advices.
Don't hésitate to stay at Pedro's!

O apartamento é super bem localizado em Alfama, próximo aos pontos turísticos (ladeira para voltar), possui utensílios de cozinha, para quem quer fazer algo, ótimo para até duas pessoas!  / Great location in Alfama, next to major tourist points (hill to return from center). All kitchen needs to do something. Great to two people.

Very nice and immediate welcome from Pedro's mother.
She showed us around in the apartment very thoroughly and was very friendly, optimistic and happy. Everything in the apartment functioned very well, was very clean and we had everything we needed.

At first it was a little bit hard to find where the apartment was, but once we found it, we could find our bearings very well, with special thanks to the tram-trails in front of our building (of which we had no nuisance).

The location was good, with enough services and nice restaurants nearby.

To sum it up, we just wouldn't ask for more.

Thanks to Pedro and his mother,the appartment is perfect .
From there you can visit Lisbon just walking
What can I say ? Pedro is just the perfect guy to welcome someone in Lisbon. His kindness is absolutely amazing. Thanks again ! And see you soon !

We enjoyed every moment of our stay in Lisbon in Pedro's apartment. It is well located right on the tram line and easy to wander the Alfama neighborhood and even find our way home!!! Loads of interesting narrow streets in Lisbon.
The apartment has everything one could need (at least for us) and Pedro was in contact when we needed. We are returning to Lisbon in one week and would have come back to this apartment but it is already booked.
We spend a great week end in Lisbonn. Perdro's flat is perfect, in a nice historic quarter and very clean.

Pedro e sua mamma sono stati disponibili e simpatici.
Pedro ci ha dato degli ottimi consigli su cosa vedere a lisbona nei nostri giorni di permanenza. E' un host molto attento alle esigenze degli ospiti. L'appartamento è perfetto, ha tutto ciò che serve ed è molto funzionale.
Il quartiere è tranquillo e pittoresco, e poi con la fermata del tram 28 sotto casa, tutto è facilmente raggiungibile.

Nous avons passé 3 nuits à Lisbonne, Pedro ainsi que sa mère sont très attentionnés et réactifs. Le logement est impeccable et bien équipé (wifi, TV, cuisine tout équipée). La localisation est idéale!
Pedro nous a également réservé le taxi du retour pour l'aéroport. Royal!
A recommander sans hésiter.
Nous avons été très bien accueillis par la maman de Pedro et nous avons passé un très agréable séjour, l'appartement est bien équipé , il est calme et proche de tout. A refaire

Nous avons été très bien accueillis par Pedro. Le logement est très fonctionnel et l'aménagement conforme au descriptif. Je déconseille cependant de louer cet appartement durant l'hiver (nous avons séjourné fin décembre), en raison de l'absence d'aération et de ventilation de l'appartement, ce qui rend l'appartement extrêmement humide (serviettes qui ne sèchent pas, literie humide). Pedro nous avait mis à disposition un chauffage d'appoint, mais l'appartement manque cruellement d'une ventilation en cet saison (ventilation mécanique - VMC - indispensable). Enfin, l'accès à la terrasse (photo) n'est pas directe.

Die Begrüßung durch Pedros Mutter war sehr herzlich und freundlich.
Sie hat uns alles genau gezeigt und uns viele Tipps gegeben.
Die Unterunft entsprach der Beschreibung. Alles war äußerst sauber und funktionell eingerichtet. Die Lage der Wohnung ist für Fußgänger nahezu perfekt. Die Dachterrasse bietet eine fantastischen Ausblick auf die Altstadt. Zu viel mehr ist sie allerdings nicht zu gebrauchen.
Alles in allem sehr empfehlenswert.

The apartment is really nice, extremely clean and equipped with everything you can need. Furthermore is right on the path of the famous E28 tramway, so perfectly located. Pedro and his mother are very kind and available. Finally it's not expensive. Excellent experience.

The apartment is perfectly situated in a quiet street but very central. You can reach every thing by feet. It was well prepared with a lot of good suggestions for trips and sightseeing. We had a wonderful stay in Lisbon and we just recommend this apartment. We would always book it again. Thanks again to Pedro and his mom for the preparation.

Really terrific apartment: clean, comfortable, quiet, secure, well-located, and with pretty much everything one could imagine needing (washing machine, dishwasher, oven, heater, hairdryer, umbrella, adaptor plugs for different countries, WiFi, maps and guides...). Pedro's mum met me and showed me round the apartment when I arrived and was very kind and helpful. Pedro was also in touch before and during my stay to make sure if I was happy and to provide anything I needed, and kindly called a taxi for me on the day I was leaving (my Portuguese is not very good). Being in Alfama right in the midst of things but tucked away in a quiet street was great. I'd highly recommend this flat and will definitely try to stay here again next time I'm in Lisbon.

Foi tudo ótimo em minha estadia. O apartamento é muito bem localizado, no centro da Alfama. Perto de tudo e com um bondinho na porta. Muito limpo e arrumado, ainda conta com maquina de lavar: perfeito para ajudar os viajantes ;)
Obrigado e um abraço Pedro.

Great experience! Everything was excellent. We didn't have a any problems to find this lovely flat in  Alfama. Pedro was always responding to any of my question in no time. Flat is nice, clean and modern. Located in a beautiful part of the town. We'll come back again! Had an amazing time. Well recommended:)

Pedro (I didn't saw him) and his mother were very kind for us. I feel better than pictures. Everything was equipped for cook, bathroom, bed.... And location was very good too. I never forgot this house and Lisboa. Obrigado!
시설 좋고 주방, 화장실, 타월, 침대 등등 4박하면서 부족한것을 못느꼈다. 더 좋은 것은 28번트램이 집앞에 바로 멈춘다는 것. 메트로와 기차역인 santa apolonia 역도 걸어서 10-15분 정도 거리에 있어서 리스본 여행하기에 딱 좋지 않을까싶다! 다음에 리스본을 다시온다면 이집에서 머물것이다!

Awesome! We never have been welcomed so well! Pedro offered us a complete review of the city's best places and events. We had a wonderful week end in that beautiful flat, perfectly located close to the city center and monuments. Last but not least: the terrace/rooftop is a super place to relax and enjoy the view of the ocean! Thomas & Sabrina
We had a very nice stay with Pedro, the place was well equipt and clean.Perfect position to visit Lisbon.Thank you Pedro

Had a fabulous stay at Pedro's place! Great location, comfortable room. Had a present waiting for us when we arrived :) showed us some great places, restaurant and musuem.

And thanks to la mama de Pedro :)

You will find anything you need at Pedro's to enjoy your stay in Lisbon:
Bed sheets, towels, good mattress, coffee, maps of the city as well as places to visit and restaurants to go to. The place is super clean. The terra sse view is wonderful, and Alfama is the greatest place to stay.
We did not lack anything during our stay.
Many thanks to Pedro and his lovely mom. It was like being in a 5 stars hotel

The apartments are very good, clean, well located. Nearby there are restaurants and bars near the mini-supermarket. The windows overlook the courtyard, no noise does not interfere with sleep. Pedro quickly and very well answered all the questions in preparation for the trip. A special thanks to his mother, who greeted us and showed the apartment. In my next time I am very happy to once again stay at these   apartments!!!!

Pedro's mother most kindly welcomed us, as he was at work, and though her English is better than my Portuguese, we did rely on a lot of sign language. The apartment was as described, scrubbed as clean as can be, and very nicely laid out and appointed. Kitchen was large, complete and equipped to cook if one wished. The location is dead in the heart of Alfama, with all that entails.  Great place to be, a hilly hike to reach on foot, and not good for anyone bringing their own car.  Taxis can find it (Pedro helped book one for our early airport departure) and the tram stops at the front door. It was a great stay and I would go back.

Nuestra estancia en casa de Pedro ha sido simplemente perfecta. Nos pusimos en contacto con él un par de días antes para acordar la hora de llegada, y allí estaba esperándonos. El apartamento es tal y como se ve en las fotos, limpio, luminoso, nuevo, y tiene absolutamente todo lo necesario.

Nos explicó cómo funcionaba absolutamente todo en la casa y nos dejó unas guías de qué ver en Lisboa en dos días, mapas, recomendaciones de restaurantes... ¡todo un lujo!

Cuando volvamos a Lisboa volveremos a contactar con Pedro sin duda.

Nous avons été très gentiment accueilli par Pédro qui nous a donné toutes les informations nécessaires à un bon séjour : plan, bonnes adresses, circuits touristiques...Des spécialités locales nous avaient été laissé. L'appartement était calme et le quartier très typique du vieux Lisbonne avec le tramway 28 au bas de l'immeuble.

The Appartement is beautiful. I can' t remember when I have seen such a perfect equiped flat. Everything was there. It is also perfect situated to discover Lisboa and the Alfama. If I Comeback to Lisboa it is clear that i will try to book Pedros' Appartement again. I can recommend it really to all.

Great apartment in a great location! this place has everything you might need. Pedro was great in getting back and forth about everything I needed for my arrival. The apartment was a bit damp, but i blame that on the massive amount of rain that feel when i was visiting Lisbon.

Foram 15 dias maravilhosos no apartamento. Toda a descrição bate perfeitamente com o imóvel e a localização é maravilhosa, a 30 segundos de caminhada da parada do histórico elétrico 28 e 10 minutos do metrô e estação de trens (Santa Apolônia). Pedro merece destaque especial por ser extremamente educado e atencioso. Não irei procurar outro sítio para ficar quando regressar a Lisboa.

Je n'ai pas séjourné moi-même dans cet appartement mais mes parents. L'appartement leur a beaucoup plu, il est propre et aussi bien que sur les photos. Il était aussi très bien situé (à côté du tram) et ils ont passé un agréable voyage à Lisbonne. Les hôtes ont été très gentils et attentionnés, en effet à leur arrivée mes parents ont été accueilli avec des gâteaux! Ils ont été ravis de leur séjour dans cet appartement et remercient les hôtes. Merci encore pour eux

Pedro a été un hôte extraordinaire ! Nous n'avions jamais utilisé AirBnB avant et l'expérience auprès de Pedro a été parfaite. Il a été extrêmement accueillant, disponible et serviable pour nous. Il a été en constante communication avec nous lorsque nous avions des questions (tant sur le logement, comment s'y rendre que les activités à faire à Alfama). Son appartement est très propre et fidèle aux photos publiés. Pedro est très attentionné. Le logement est très bien situé dans le magnifique quartier (labyrinthe) de l'Alfama. Nous n'avons absolument rien de négatif à mentionner tant l'expérience a été agréable. L'appartement donne également accès à un toit terrasse qui donne une vue à couper le souffle sur le quartier de l'Alfama. Si vous lisez ce commentaire et que, comme nous, vous êtes à la recherche de commentaires positifs pour faire votre choix d'AirBnB, sachez qu'avec le logement de Pedro, vous ne vous tromperez pas ! Sautez sur ce logement s'il est disponible durant votre visite, vous ne serez clairement pas déçu. Merci encore Pedro !!
My experience could not have been better. This place and location totally exceeded my expectations. This place is well deserving of a 5 star rating. I would stay here time and time again.
We had a lovely time in lisbon thanks mainly to the best equiped flat we have stayed in so far ..a wonderfull location and pedros a great host as are his parents

This was our best airbnb experience so far:) - the apartment is really nice - cozy and it contains everything you need. The location couldn't be better - the center can be easely discovered by foot (and the famous tram nr. 28 stops exactly in front of the house). The communication with Pedro went withouth any problems. As we had our flight back to Switzerland in the evening, Pedro kinldy let us leave our luggages in a locked room in the same building during this day. And then, Pedro's lovely parents waited for us in the afternoon to pick up our luggages - that was so kind!
I higly recommend this apartment!
We fully enjoyed our stay in Pedro's place thanks to his nice tips, guides and self-made maps. He was very communicative also during our stay and replied to all our questions. The location is great.

The appartment was very clean, nice,well equipped,  quiet, in a great area Alfama, close to the center, so I will say 5 stars from 5. Pedro is a great host, very helpful. Thanks a lot for the wonderful time, we had.

Pedro nous a très bien réceptionner. Le logement et l'emplacement étais parfait.
Très bon séjour à Lisbonne.

Mieszkanie było bardzo dobrze wyposażone, czyste, bez zarzutu we wspaniałej lokalizacji, 10 m od turystycznego tramwaju 28. Taras na górze ze wspaniałym widokiem na Tag tylko umilał wieczory spędzone w Lizbonie. Gorąco polecam i z pewnością wrócimy do Alfama2You gdy będziemy ponownie w Lizbonie.
Pedro est un hôte sympathique et ses petits cadeaux à l'arrivée nous ont fait plaisir. L'appartement est calme, propre et bien situé.

Pedro è stato bravissimo, ci ha accolto meravigliosamente, spiegandoci tutte le cose più belle da vedere a Lisbona con mappe fatte da lui e divise per giorni. C'è wi-fi velocissimo e la tv coi canali portoghesi, una cucina attrezzatissima e il bagno con la doccia nella vasca, così si può farsi il bagno, molto utile quando si cammina tutto il giorno! L'appartamento è in centro ad Alfama, un quartiere affascinante e con mille angolini da scoprire. In un giorno abbiamo capito come muoverci con il tram 28 e con la metropolitana e questo ci ha permesso di vedere tutto il centro storico anche quando eravamo stanchi di camminare. Abbiamo acquistato la via viagem card alla fermata del metro, una carta ricaricabile comodissima per evitare file agli sportelli. Va benissimo anche per i treni che vanno a Belem-Cascais e a Sintra. I point of view sono uno spettacolo, ce ne sono diversi in Alfama, e in Bairro Alto, dal castello di S. jeorge si vede una panoramica meravigliosa a 360° sulla città. Abbiamo mangiato benissimo al ristorante "Salsa Restaurant & Cafè" che si trova proprio sulla prima curva uscendo a destra dall'edificio. Non fatevi ingannare dall'aspetto un po' orientale e cheap, sono gentilissimi, c'è una vista magnifica, si spende pochissimo e fanno da mangiare molto bene, leggero e saporito. Negli altri posti in giro a Lisbona a volte i condimenti sono un po' decisi.
L'appartamento di Pedro ha anche l'accesso alla terrazza sul tetto, una perla! Ci si sente lisboeti, fusi con il paesaggio, davvero la ciliegina sulla torta! Dalle finestre aperte dell'appartamento spesso si sente una musica lontana, che proviene da qualche casa più in là, un balsamo per i riposini. Una città davvero romantica e la casa di Pedro il posto ideale dove stare, ad un prezzo incredibile!

L'appartement est très bien situé, propre et au calme, et les parents de Pedro nous ont très gentiment accueilli. Le quartier est vraiment incroyable, et encore très typique. Quelques bons cafés au alentours pour prendre un petit dej, et des restaurants et bars sympas. Bref une réussite, je conseille chaudement cet appartement pour ceux qui souhaitent découvrir Lisbonne.

The apartment is in the center of the old city. Outside everything seems to be really old, a little bit dirty, but inside the block is totally renovated and new.

The apartment was really modern, and the host really prepared this small flat for everything. We could wash, cook, and really every little part of a normal house were in this flat.

Our host also prepared really detailed map and list for the restaurants and famous places what worth to check.

The apartment was quiet and nobody disturbed us after the handover. If you are alone or with your girlfriend then it is a good choice! Everything is close and worth to spend a night on the roof. The view is amazing!

We enjoyed every second there! I can just recommend this apartment and the host.

Très bonne surprise. L'appartement est parfait. Très bien équipe, très propre et confortable. A la fois calme et très bien situé. Bien que nous n'ayons pas vu Pedro il est très attentionné. Nous aurions envie de revenir. A recommander.

Très bon accueil de Pedro, pleins d'intentions à notre arrivée, des plans et des guides à disposition.
L'appartement est très très bien situé et correspond complètement à la description faite. Hall et communs très soignés. Le tram 28 passe à la porte de l'immeuble.
Depuis la gare de Saint Apolonia à 10 minutes en descente, accessible facilement depuis le bus 734.
Ne donnant pas sur la rue et au R+1, il est très calme.
Une terrasse, accessible depuis l'ascenseur, fournie une vue panoramique époustouflante sur le Tage et la vieille ville.
Logement neuf et de qualité, aménagé avec goût. Parfait!
L'équipement ménager est neuf et abondant. Il ne manque vraiment rien.
Non exposé directement au soleil, l'appartement ne souffre pas de la chaleur.
Un séjour vraiment idéal.
Pascal.

The location of this apartment  was great, close to all that you want to see. Pedro was very helpful had given us some tips and places that we may want to look at . He also provided us with some maps and direction of some areas in the Alfama location.

Una casa perfetta!! Centralissima (nell'Alfama), completamente arredata e pulitissima grazie alla mamma di Pedro, una signora veramente simpatica!
Assolutamente da provare, praticamente a un passo dalla fermata del Tram 28 (bellissimo il passaggio nel vicoletto) e di fronte a uno dei ristoranti più caratteristici e buoni della città!
Panorama senza fiato dalla terrazza: potevamo rimanerci ore!!
Pedro sempre d'aiuto e disponibilissimo!!!
Da tornarci, senza pensarci due volte!!

Avant même que j ai ouvert la porte de mon taxi, la Maman de Pedro m' attendait tous sourires. Accueil des plus aimable explications complètes sur touts les détails pouvant m'être utilespour mon séjoour.
Que demander de plus ? c' était plus qu' agréable. Merci

Thank you so much to Pedro, the apartment is lovely, exactly the same as shown. There is also a great view! We felt so confortable and the welcome was amazing.
Pedro has a personal guide and map for Lisboa, Alfama and also food, it is well written and very helpful for our week end !
I recommend, it is a 5 stars place to spend a lovely time in Lisboa !
Thank you again Pedro !!!
Sophie and Annie

Nous avons été très bien reçu.
Le logement était très propre et correspondait parfaitement à nos attentes, ainsi qu'aux photos et à sa description.

EXCELLENT location!!! Nice clean and cozy, everything you need. Pedro and his mother were so accommodating, he went the extra mile to text with us while we were trying to figure out public transport. Would highly recommend to anyone traveling to Lisbon!
Superb location in Alfama surrounded by eclectic bars and restaurants, this modern functional little pad is ideal for a couple. Good wi-fi, quiet and cool despite no a/c and hot weather. We loved it.
Pedro was a great host. He had some great tips and lots of helpful information about the city printed out. The apartment was perfectly situated and we had a great time staying at his place.

Pedro was really helpfull with us even of we did not meet and his mum was too. The flat is perfectly located and equiped. We had a wonderfull stay. If we had to come back we would book Pedro's flat again for sure!

Hi Pedro,

sorry for reacting so late, but now I´m at home again and have time to write you.
Your appartment in rua escolas gerais is perfectly situated in the Alfama and extremely well equipped. It was absolutely clean, quiet and in a very good condition. We felt ourselves at home and safe.
What we didn´t like was that it was compared to the temperatures outside rather cold (maybe Americans like that) and we missed at least some view.
Thank you for caring for us and regards,

Silke
Très  belle surprise que ce joli appartement idéalement situé, très bien aménagé et joliment décoré. On y est tout de suite comme chez soi. l'accueil était très agréable. Nous reviendrons !

Pedro is a great host. Everythin,g was good.
We didn't meet but he was available for any request or help.
The apprt is lovely and quiet like described in the pictures.
I will come back there for sure.

Pedro was an excellent host.  He thoughtfully left some Refreshments and snacks for us on arrival with plenty of useful sightseeing information. The apartment is in the most convenient and atmospheric part of Lisbon. The views from the roof are amazing and the perfect place for drinks (or a meal - we had lunch there one day). The apartment is cosy and comfortable.

Ein wirklich nettes Appartement im Herzen der Alfama, alles was es braucht für einen Städteurlaub, die historische 28E vor der Haustüre, aber kein Problem, das Appartement geht nach hinten hinaus. Schlüsselübergabe mit Pedro hat problemlos funktioniert, obwohl unser Flug einige Verspätung hatte, alles notwendige von Pedro erklärt bekommen, ein paar Tipps und wir konnten fünf schöne Tage genießen.
Das einzige was uns fehlte war die Kaffeefiltermaschine, aber es gibt viele gute Cafes und der Espresso kostet so 80Cent.
Danke Pedro

dear Pedro
we really enjoyed our stay at your lovely cozy apartment. There is NOTHING to complain! And thanks to your mother for her kind welcome and her flexibility!
Kathrin&guido

Nous sommes restés 4 jours à Lisbonne (c'était trop court pour tout voir et nous reviendrons ) et avons beaucoup apprécié l'appartement de Pedro. Tout est neuf et parfaitement propre. De plus l'appartement est super calme et garanti un repos absolu après de belles journées de promenade. Il est encore mieux que sur les photos, un bon plan pour se sentir "comme à la maison".

Perfecto! Pedro is a very kind host. He welcomed and provide us with useful maps and guide to go around Lisbon. The tram is right infront of the flat and it's easy to get around. I would definitely recommend this place!

Die Unterkunft ist perfekt für einen kürzeren oder auch längeren Aufenthalt in Lissabon und Umgebung.
Die Ausstattung lässt nichts zu wünschen übrig: von der wirklich komplett ausgestatteten Küche, in der wir immer gefrühstückt haben, über das geräumige Bad mit einer herrlichen Dusche, Handtüchern und Haartrockner, bis hin zu dem wunderbar erholsamen Bett. Es ist leise und kühl und super sauber in der Wohnung.
Das Check in übernimmt Pedros Mama, was super geklappt hat. Pedro selbst ist immer über WhatsApp oder Mail erreichbar und beantwortet alle Fragen innerhalb kürzester Zeit.
Wir haben uns rundum wohl gefühlt!!

Pedro's apartment is in an amazing location and he is an excellent host! He left us detailed maps of the city, suggested itineraries and gave us a lot of ideas for things to see while visiting Lisboa. The apartment was very clean and the terrace was wonderful!

We stayed 4 nights at Pedro's Alfama 2 You, but felt like we could stay here for months.  It had everything. Pedro's mom greeted us when we checked in.  She speaks little English and we speak little Portuguese, but she made everything perfectly clear.  Everything: how to use dishwasher, clothes washer, appliances, door locks, and WIFI; and where to find extra linens, towels, etc.  She even took us up to the roof to show us the fantastic views of Lisbon and pointed out some landmarks.  The kitchen is very well equipped.  The bed is super comfy.  Pedro has done a superb job with custom maps showing nearby sites, bars, restaurants, grocery stores, etc.  And he has several pages of reviews of bars and restaurants.  (Tia Natercia was booked for the nights we were there, but we had a very nice supper with guitar music at Bistro Gato Pardo.)  Just around the corner is a fine place for coffee.  The super cool Tram #28 runs right by the front door with stops close by.  Best to ride early in the morning before it gets crowded.

Die Unterkunft ist sehr zentral gelegen, somit idealer Ausgangspunkt für Ausflüge ins Stadtzentrum Lissabons. Die Wohnung ist schön und gemütlich eingerichtet, und war sehr sauber!  Beim sehr herzlichen Empfang von Pedros Mutter fühlte man sich direkt willkommen und heimisch. Wir können das Apartement nur weiterempfehlen.

Uns hat die Wohnung sehr gefallen: super ordentlich, das Wichtigste war vorhanden und die Lage ist einfach unschlagbar!
Pedro war jederzeit erreichbar und hat uns in vielen Dingen geholfen!
Wir würden die Wohnung auf jeden Fall weiterempfehlen.

Appartement tout à fait conforme au descriptif, fonctionnel, calme et idéalement situé dans le quartier de l'Alfama.
En montant sur la terrasse, belle vue sur Lisbonne.
Au pied de l'appartement, le célèbre tramway 28 qui nous emmène dans les autres quartiers.
Pedro nous a fourni tous les renseignements demandés avant le séjour, l'accueil par sa maman a été parfait et il a continué à prendre de nos nouvelles tout au long de notre séjour.
Nous recommandons déjà cet appartement à tous nos amis.

The place was wonderful. Clean and tidy, and welcoming. Really well provided for. The shower was perfect and the bed was big and comfy. The view from the terrace on the top of the building is stupendous!

Getting the key was super easy and there were no hassles the entire time we stayed.

Transport is amazingly simple with the tram running directly outside, and yet there's no noise and the place is beautifully quiet. So nice to come back to to recharge after a day of seeing beautiful Lisbon. There are lots of great little coffee shops and mini-restaurants/eateries nearby.

Generally the place is incredible and we were sad to leave. Highly recommended.

L'appartement est bien situé dans un quartier très sympa en centre ville, le tramway passe juste devant la porte .
Accueil chaleureux et serviable

Pedro e sua família foram absolutamente encantadores. Fizeram com que nossa estadia em Lisboa fosse melhor impossível.  O apartamento é ainda melhor que na descrição e foto. Impecavelmente limpo. Perfeito para quem deseja conhecer Lisboa a pé. Supermercados e pastelarias há cerca de 10 min. Do ap. Pudemos conhecer bem a cidade. Alfama nos pareceu ser o lugar mais "Lisboeta" e conveniente para hospedagem. Certamente se voltarmos  a Portugal regressaremos a esta jóia de apartamento.

Had a great stay here. The apartment was very clean and tidy and had all the facilities needed as well as fast wifi. The location was great and close to loads of restaurants and bars. Pedro was really helpful and gave us helpful tips on where to go and what to do. We arrived really late, after midnight but this was no problem for him and he met us there and showed us round. Good communication as well in the run up to the stay, just what you need to be put you at ease. All in all an excellent stay.
Great Host! The flat is perfectly situated in Alfama and is well equipped with all necessary stuff. And his Mum,....lovely. Book and enjoy!

Le contact avec Pedro a été super avant - pendant notre séjour et nous avons été très bien accueilli par son père.

Appartement très agréable et idéalement placé pour découvrir le vrai Lisbonne. Lieux calme pour aussi se reposer.

Nous conseillerons cette adresse.

Jean François et Régine

The stay was very comfortable and with all the facilities and location near tram station it was perfect for going around.the welcome by host and his constant advice about lisbon helped us to explore and enjoy our trip.

l'accoglienza è stata ottima e il proprietario disponibile dal primo giorno all'ultimo.
La casa era effettivamente era collocata in una posizione centrale e funzionale per poter girare tranquillamente la città.

L'appartement correspond précisément aux photos et à la description. Bien situé dans le quartier typique de l'Alfama, au pied de la ligne de tram 28, il est agréable, très bien équipé et fonctionnel. Seul regret, le chauffage un peu limite, mais nous étions en janvier. Notre hôte, très sympathique, nous a donné tous les conseils pour profiter de notre séjour. A recommander dans tous les cas, et nous espérons y revenir.

Pedro was very nice host and he made my stay very comfortable. The flat is located in very convenient location and I could walk to the city centre in 15 minutes. He also left a city map with his comments and recommendations which helped me to enjoy Lisbon.

He was also very helpful and always get back to me promptly every time I had some questions. Thank you, Pedro for all your kind help, highly recommended.

My parents stayed at Pedro's house for a week-end. The flat is well located and we can find everything we need.
My parents enjoyed their stay in Lisbon!

I genitori di Pedro mi hanno accolto nell'appartamento e sono stati molto gentili e precisi. L'appartamento corrispondeva alla descrizione data sul sito, era molto accogliente, pulito, ben arredato e confortevole. C'è tutto quello che serve e anche di più. Indicherei, per i soggiorni invernali, che il riscaldamento è fornito da un termosifone elettrico nell'appartamento.
In realtà anche a Dicembre non ha fatto veramente freddo.
L'ubicazione dell'appartamento è perfetta si pùo arrivare a piedi ovunque, anche se bisiogna essere abbastanza allenati con tutte le salite e le discese!
Se si desidera avere un'esperienza del quartiere storico di Lisboa l'appartamento è ideale. Tutte le info fornite da Pedro sulla città sono state utilissime e malgrado non sia potuto venire direttamente ad accogliermi all'arrivo è sempre stato molto disponibile con informazioni e suggerimenti.
Grazie Pedro per la bellissima ed intensa esperienza- Lisbona è una città veramente affascinante.

Pedro is a very nice guy, he will wait for you with a warm and friendly welcome in his sweet apartment in Alfama. The apartment is very nice and comfortable, in a very cool place of the city, and furnished with smart and tastefull furnitures, He's also able to give you some useful tips about the city and the neighbourhoods. A very plaesant place to stay, and a very nice person to meet. Strongly suggested!

Pedros mother gave us a very warm welcome and explained everything to us. The apartment has a very tasteful furniture and decoration and everything you need (dishwasher, washing machine, hair dryer, huge fridge) and is surrounded by good restaurants, mini markets and sightseeing. Tram 28 passes directly but you do not hear anything in the apartment. So 100% Lisbon!!!

Pedro´s appartment is on a perfect place in the alfama. The station of the tram 28 is closed to; there are a very good connection to the metro line (airport line) train and the other quaters of lisboa. LovelyRestaurants nearby with delecioses food.
The appartment is very good, perfect size and composition (ig. kitchen with a wash machine).
A warm and friendly wellcome. Happy to finde this place
FG

Séjour très agréable chez Pedro. Accueil chaleureux, à l'écoute de nos questions. La petite bouteille de Porto offerte a été très appréciée! Ses informations sur Lisbonne et les endroits où sortir nous ont beaucoup aidé. Nous avons passé un très bon séjour. Appartement bien placé, à proximité du tram, d'un supermarché, de taxi, ainsi que du centre ville. Nous recommandons à tous d'aller passer un week-end chez Pedro!

Pedro's apartment is brilliantly located and a great place to stay. Very clean and tidy. Pedro also left some great restaurant, bar & activity tips which were brilliant! And if you meet his Mum she is lovely! Highly recommend this place.
Accueil très sympathique de votre maman

Excellent accueil de Pedro malgré l'heure tardive de notre arrivée.
L'appartement est parfait, tout neuf, propre, et très bien équipé.
Il est de plus situé dans un lieu très stratégique pour visiter Lisbonne, sur la ligne du Tram 28 et juste au dessus du quartier de l'Alfama.
À conseiller !

Great apartment! Small, but convenient. We got a warm welcome from Pedro's mother and enjoyed the complementary port while settling in.
The location is very nice, at walking distance from all food, drinks and sightseeing.

L'accueil de Pedro est à la hauteur de la qualité de l'appartement: parfait!
Tout se déroule avec Pedro comme espéré.
Son appartement est très agréable, joli et calme avec tout ce qu'on est en droit d'attendre pour passer un agréable séjour en plein Lisbonne. L'Alfama est un quartier attachant que nous avons découvert dans les meilleurs conditions grace à Pedro.
Merci pour la bouteilles de Porto et toutes les propositions de visites préparées pour accueillir ses hôtes. Elles nous ont bien servis.
Une très bonne adresse que nous allons recommander à nos amis.

L'appartement correspond aux photos et à la description. Il est spacieux, fonctionnel et très bien équipé. Enfin, il est très propre.
L'appartement est situé au milieu du quartier ancien et escarpé de l'Alfama. Il est pratique pour visiter ce quartier. Par contre, pour visiter les autres quartiers, il faudra prendre les transports (tramway, métro) ou marcher.
Une terrasse (partie commune) est accessible pour avoir un panorama magnifique sur le quartier, le Tage et la ville : un réel avantage !
Un grand merci à Pedro pour tous ses conseils de visite et sa mise à disposition de plans, guides et listes de restaurants !

It was really a great stay!The city is awesome and Pedro is a great host!He was really kind and available for us,and he has prepared documents to give us tips in the city (visits,restaurants...).The flat is comfortable and perfectly located. I definitely recommend that place.

De woning van Pedro was een perfecte uitvalsbasis voor een heerlijke korte vakantie in Lissabon. De woning was gezellig ingericht, superschoon en alles wat je nodig kunt hebben was aanwezig (o.a. wasmachine, wasmachine, bad).
Ook de locatie vonden wij geweldig. Alfama is een interessant deel van de stad, tram 28 stopt bijna voor de deur en er zijn vele leuke terrasjes in de buurt.
Pedro is tot slot een innemende en zeer attente gastheer.

Pedro's apartment is in the heart of the Alfama. The apartment is cosy and very well equipped. You have access to Pedro's roof top terrace, with a wonderful view over the Alfama, the water and the city!
We had an warm hearted welcome by the grandmother.
Pedro was always replying to emails and asked during the stay if everything is ok.
We will recommend to stay at this apartment.
Christian & Stephie

We loved our stay in Alfama at Pedro's wonderful apartment. The apartment had everything we needed for our seven day stay...the kitchen is well equipped-if you like to cook and the bathroom has a great tub to soak in after a long day of wandering.
The location was perfect and in such a beautiful and historic part of town. We enjoyed spending time at Marcelino coffee shop, listening to Fado at Chapito and enjoying a glass of wine at Bebedouro which were all a short walk away from the apartment.
We highly recommend staying at Pedro's apartment when visiting Lisboa. We will be back and thanks for your hospitality.
Nicole and Paul

The apartment is a perfect place for a visit in Lisbon. It is perfectly situated in the midst of Alfama, one of the more picturesque neighborhoods of Lisbon. Every detail is taken care of and there are bonuses of maps and directed tours. It is impeccably clean. The host helped me get a taxi to the airport.
Cf journée du 23 sept

The flat is very cosy, fully- equiped, quiet, and well located in the Alfama.
I would definitely recommend this place!
Bon accueil, appartement propre, cuisine toute équipée. Bon conseil pour le restaurant et les visites. Magnifique vu sur les toits de Lisbonne.
Great host and flat. Pedro provided us with loads of info of things to do in Lisbon and Alfama was a great neighborhood to stay in

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Pedro's apartment. It was clean, spacious, and has all the utilities. We received a very warm welcome from the host's mother, and she even left a map and recommendations for us!

A very clean and well equipped apartment in a central location.  We didn't meet Pedro but he arranged for his mother to greet us and Pedro contacted me during our stay to check everything was ok.  Highly recommended but be aware that the Alfama district is very hilly and might be a problem for someone with walking difficulties.

Great jouney.
I haven t ser Pedro but he always aswer all my questions by email: he seems to be a nice person and his father too.
I shoud rent again the Pedro's appartment.

Pedro was a really friendly guy with some great maps and recommendations for restaurants, etc. The apartment was perfectly located, very contemporary and had all the amenities you might need. Definitely recommend it!
Perfect timing for the meeting time and communication. Great ressources for visiting Lisboa. Little porto and cakes as gift, cool stuff.

Pedro's apartment is excellent. It is compact, comfortable++, very well equipped and well maintained. It's location is in the heart of the Alfama with the famous tram 28 stop virtually outside the door. The apartment is ideally suited for singles and couples. It represents great value for money. The kitchen is very functional for those who want to cook like me and there is a washing machine for longer stayers or for those running out of clean clothes!
Pedro was always prompt replying to emails and although we only got to meet for a short period of time, was very friendly and welcoming. He has organised a lot of useful material about Lisbon like different walks, where to eat, shop, look and do.
The apartment and building are secure and it has a lift. You have access to Pedro's roof top terrace overlooking the Alfama and the water, great view.
Pedro's apartment is a great place to stay and I highly recommend it.
Robyn, Hobart, Tasmania/Australia.

A lovely studio flat in the heart of the cobbled, winding streets of Alfama. The apartment was clean and comfortable, with an excellent WiFi connection and equipment for daily living. The view from the terrace is spectacular. Pedro was the perfect host. He was out of town when we arrived but left us in the friendly, capable hands of his father, with some complementary port and biscuits to start off our break and many maps and information sheets offering advice of necessary. We were also able to contact him by email/phone to find out further information. Lisbon is an amazing city and Pedro's hospitality was equally outstanding. Thank you Pedro!

Perfect, well equipped apartment. With a bath! :-)
Suburb location right in the middle of Alfama. Tram 28 right outside. Good restaurants in the neighbourhood (I recommend Duetos de Se, within 10 minutes walking)
Little disappointed about the terrace. Although beautiful view (wow!!), no opportunity to sit/eat, and not directly linked to the apartment itself.
Nice welcome-gift from Pedro! I had a really good time.

Amazing studio in the hearth of Alfama. Very clean, well decorated, and everything needed was there. A lot of infos to visit Lisbon were available. Didn't meet with Pedro but his mother made sure we had everything and showed us all we needed to know.
Pedro also made sure we knew everything by email before we came in.
Highly recommended. (even left a host gift!)

This was my second time staying at Pedro's apartment, and I cannot say enough about his hospitality and warm disposition. He went above and beyond the call of duty in accommodating my schedule and helping me to make arrangements. This cozy, quiet and spotless apartment is situated in the heart of Alfama, which is a wonderful atmospheric neighbourhood, full of life and character. Thank you, Pedro, for making my visit to Lisbon such a great experience!

Pedro's apartment was perfect for us - it's in a fantastic location in Alfama (the wonderful #28 tram goes right past the door!). It's quiet (at the back of the building), has all the facilities you could need, and great views from the roof terrace. The bed is comfortable, the bathroom and kitchen are well equipped, and everything was as it appears on the listing.

Communication with Pedro himself was excellent before we arrived. He told us everything we needed to know, and was flexible about meeting times. He was very friendly and personable when we did meet, and even left us some lovely port as a welcome drink!

Very comfortable and homely apartment in old part of Lisbon. Just steps to tram and dining options and pretty close to everything. Pedro was nice and extremely helpful providing guests with detailed maps and guides which we utilized and appreciated. Kitchen was well equipped but some basic ingredients need to be provided to be able to cook at home. Overall highly recommended.
Alles bestens! Ich würde die wohnung immer wieder buchen. Ideale lage und sehr sauber!

Alfama 2 You est un endroit très sympa et très bien situé pour rester dans l'Alfama.
Pedro est un hôte aimable et sérieux et vous avez tout le confort et le rangement que vous désirez pour deux personnes.
La terrasse est sur le toit, il faut prendre l'ascenseur pour y accéder, c'est facile et sympa mais quand on voit les photos, ce n'est pas évident.
Je recommande vivement cette location!

A wonderful, easily accessible location with a number of excellent dining options close by. The apartment is quiet and well equipped with everything a traveller might need. Pedro is a gracious and accommodating host. Highly recommended!

While we did not get to meet Pedro, he had organised to have a family member available to meet us and communication with him prior was fantastic, not to mention all the maps and guides Pedro has put together for you in the apartment.
The flat itself was also great and perfect for a couple. Inside, the building and the apartment have been renovated/updated so you have a great space with modern amenities while being located in the old district full of charm. You are a short stroll from some beautiful sights and it is a pleasant walk to the main section of the city.
We would be remiss if we didnt mention the view from the roof - it is a wonderful perspective of the city and the water and tops off a great place to stay in Lisbon.

We really enjoyyed our staying in the apartment. You can find everything you need, including washing mashine.
The apt is just like on the pictures, may be even better.
Pedro was waiting for us outside, and he even left ous cookies and jam on the coffee table, which were very helpfull after our flight.
It is easy to find the apt, especially if you will take a look on the map first :-)
There is a supermarket in like 10 min walk, metro station in 15 min and a great litte cafe in the next building.
By the way you can go up on the roof of the buiding and find a really beautifull view on alfama and tejo.
We would totally recomend this place to anybody and everyone.
Hope you will enjoy it!

Pedro was a really attentive host, always staying in touch an giving good information. Also, his apartment was really nice, with port wine and guides of the city included. I can really recommend staying here!

I have nothing but wonderful things to say about Pedro and this apartment. It was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed. The building felt safe and secure and the Tram 28 literally runs in front of the front door. Pedro provides lots of maps and advice on where to eat. I sent him a message on my airbnb app regarding the location of a taxi stand and he answered me within 30 minutes. The WIFI is great.
My best advice about visiting Lisbon is to stay in Alfama! Do not stay in the more touristy areas. The Alfama is the oldest area of Lisbon and has more character than any European city I have visited. This apartment is in the heart of an incredibly interesting, beautiful city.
Nice flat in perfect location. Communication was perfect and easy and we really enjoyed our stay. Especially all the advices given were great! Thanks!

Our stay in Lisbon was excellent! The apartment is fabulous and exactly as the photos show. Might even be better than what they depict. Pablo and his family were very easy to communicate with and always responded quickly to any inquiries. The apartment is located in a priceless location in Alfama and within easy waking distance to all the places we wanted to go. The tram is actually right out the front door too! Highly recommend!
Gemütliches und sauberes Zimmer in einen sehr netten Altstadtviertel. Der Gastgeber Pedro war sehr freundlich und hatte viele Tipps parat.

After arriving back home last night from the westcoast of Portugal and Lisbon we have to say that our holidays couldn't have had a better start than in Pedros and Familia Luis nice appartment!
From the beginning on when we booked the 2 nights and days in the appartment, Pedro was a really kind person and gave us all the information that we needed to find the flat either by metro or taxi. He was always answering directly and even the late evening before our arrival when he was outside of Portugal he answered quickly our last questions. We really appreciated that!!
A pitty that we couldn't meet him, but his mother replaced him very well when she welcomed us very warm and friendly in the flat and showed us everything.
The roofterrace with the view over Lisbon is wonderful by day and night!
We can recommend the appartment from Pedro and his family to everyone. It is in a great location from where you can start your Lisbon expeditions, really clean and comfortable decorated and has everything you need for a stay.
Thank you Pedro and family! :-)

Communications with our host Pedro was very very easy. He was so accurate and very clear . We find the place easily .Very kind and patience enough to answer our questions / requests and provided us ALL informations we need about our stay in lisbon and the neigbourhood. The flat was very clean and tidy ,well furnish and eqiupped.We had a great stay, thanks Pedro.This is our first airbnb experience and would surely not the last.

Pedro's place is very clean and tidy.  He is very nice, he waited us on the street in front of the building (sorry that we were a bit late as we couldn't find the street) and let us check out at 5pm.  We had a nice stay at Lisbon.

Pedro was the perfect host, he allowed me to check in early and provided several parking options for my car in his pedestrian only neighborhood. During check in Pedro provided me with restaurant options, trolley routes, tour itineraries and maps of the area. The apartment is in a good location with great views from the terrace. Pedro has done a great job furnishing his apartment, there are a lot of little things that made it feel like home.
Pedro, thanks for a great experience. I would definitely stay at your apartment on my next trip to Lisboa.

This apartment was great for two nights in Lisbon. It's the perfect size for two people, very clean, a really good price, all just as described here. Even better, Pedro was very friendly and had his own little guidebook list of restaurants, things to do, the best rooftop dining, and a handy map. The apartment building was quiet and in a convenient location on the trolly line. Thanks Pedro!

Tolles Appartment mitten in Lissabon.
Das Appartment liegt in der Altstadt direkt an der Linie 28 (Diese alte gelben Bahnen)
Es ist nach hinten raus gelegen und daher sehr leise. Das Appartment ist klein und fein. Ideal für 2 Personen. Sauber, komplett eingerichtet und sehr komfortabel.
Der Vermieter ist sehr gut zu erreichen superfreundlich und hat viele tolle Tipps auf Laber.
Auf der Dachterasse kann man abends ein Glas Wein trinken oder sonst chillen. Sollte aber nicht zu laut sein, wegen der Nachbarn.

Insgesamt eine superadresse. Absolut empfehlenswert.

Un grazie di cuore a Pedro; la sua casa è molto carina, pulita, curata nei dettagli e fornita di ogni cosa possa essere utile. E' comodissima per visitare Lisbona, abbiamo visitato la città in lungo e in largo e quasi sempre a piedi grazie alla posizione ottimale, altre volte abbiamo viaggiato con il noto tram 28 che si ferma sotto casa, davvero splendida. Il terrazzo consente una vista dei tetti di Lisbona, del fiume Tago e del sole di Lisbona indimenticabile. Pedro è un ospite fantastico, le sue guide personalizzate fornite di foto, di indicazioni stradali e degli orari di visita sono state utilissime per visitare le zone più belle di Lisbona e dintorni.
Consiglio vivamente una vacanza a Lisbona e a casa di Pedro.

We had a very nice time at this beautiful place. Pedro gave us a friendly warm welcome and explained us the public transport of Lisbon. He also recommended interesting places to see. Besides he provides a lots of written information about the city. The cozy appartement is very clean and its nice interior makes you feel at home. And don't miss the beautiful view from the rooftop of the house allover the Alfama.
We really recommend a stay, it is the perfect place for romantic holiday in Lisbon.

Pedro's apartment is a great place to use as a base for exploring Lisbon, and especially the Alfama neighborhood. As others have experienced we did not have the pleasure of meeting Pedro in person but were welcomed by his charming mother and a nice bottle of port.
Pedro was very available and helpful over the phone, and cheerfully arranged for our 4:00 a.m. cab for us for our trip to the airport.
The apartment is perfectly set up for a couple with a great view of the city from the rooftop terrace. Thanks Pedro!

Pedro is a great hoste and his appartement is just perfect : very clean, well situated, etc...
He provided us lots of documents about Lisbon and good adresses that only a Lisboet can provied !
He was not there the day we arrived but his charming mother was there to welcome us and despit the fact that she doesn't speek English, she "explained" to us everithing we had to know about the apartement!
We definitively recomand this apartement!
Great time at Pedro's place. Great tips, guides and explanations. Will definitely recommend it and come back!!!!

If you are heading to lisbon then this is the place to stay! Pedros apartment is in immaculate condition, well equipped, in a fantastic location and Pedro himself could not have been more helpful. We would go back to lisbon just to stay here! I highly recommend staying here, you will not be disappointed!
Thanks for a fantastic stay Pedro.
great stay in this beautiful studio which was well furnished and equiped, lots of great helpful information from Pedro . would certainly stay again and tecommend without any hesitation

We had a lovely stay in this apartment! It is located in the most beautifully area we've seen in Lisbon and a tram stop (although you can walk almost everything!) in front of the door.
Pedro had his own guide, which was great and just what we needed!
Would definitely recommend a stay here!

The flat is just perfect, very well situated, beautifully decorated (modern!) and quiet. The different tips left in the appartment are very useful. Pedro's mother was here to welcome us, very nicely. We definitely would recommend this place.

The apartment is cosy, nice, calm and very clean. Very well located in Alfama. The view from the roof is wonderful. Perfect to savour a glass of Porto ;)
The welcoming was very kind, with a lot of advices and little details who make that you feel good !
Many thanks Pedro and Eva, we enjoyed our stay.
We definitely recommend this flat !

This was my first visit in Lisboa and it was great! The flat was small but very cosy with all things you need. The Information material and the suggestions were very good. I liked the City very much and I hope that I can come again very soon.

The apartment is very nice and well located, 30 seconds from a tram stop. So useful and easy! Pedro was very welcoming and helpful. We had a great time there and I would definitely recommend this place.

Pedro's apartment is a really nice and clean place to stay. It's in the middle of the charming Alfama. We spend a lot of time in tram 28, it's a good and easy way to see Lissabon. We were introduced to the apartment by Pedro's kind mother. We didn't speak the same language, but communicated anyway ;-) Pedro was very kind to help and guide us both before and after arrival - and to make sure we got a taxi to the airport going home. We will definitely recommend this apartment.

Hemos estado verdaderamente encantados en el apartamento de Pedro y con su amable trato, así como con la entrañable bienvenida de su madre. La situación es perfecta, en pleno centro de Alfama, muy cerca de la parada del tranvía 28 y próximo a buenas cafeterías y restaurantes. Lo recomendaremos a todos nuestros amigos y seguro que volveremos para seguir conociendo la maravillosa Lisboa. ¡Muchas gracias!

Very nice and very clean apartement in a cozy neigborhood! The really relaxing rooftop terrace has a blissful sight. Pedro, the owner was very flexible, nice and a source of information. The apartement is easily reachable by foot or with tram 28 from the city centre. We will be back!

We stayed at Pedro's place in a Lisbon and it was immaculate. It is a very clean and modern flat in the oldest area in Lisbon, called Alfama. We were greeted by Pedro outside of the flat on our arrival where he gave us a tour of the place and then gave us his personal maps and guides for all to see in Lisbon and all the surrounding areas. The guides were all incredibly detailed and very helpful! Pedro was a great host.

The flat is located right on the 28E tram line, so you are minutes away from all the sights, food and shopping in Lisbon. The tram line is also a great guide to bring you back from the central part of the city if you want to explore.

You have an entire place to yourself, which is great. If there is anything wrong, Pedro is a quick call or email away and will be available to assist you.

Overall, it was amazing! You'll have a great time!

Great experience in Lisbon, Alfama, Pedro's apartment. Pedro received us very kindly, he is really nice and he gives a lot of useful information to visit Lisbon. He was also very attentive to our comfort and it is very appreciated. The apartment is very cozy and complete. It was a bit cold but Pedro is looking into improving that. The apartment is situated in the charming Alfama, so beautiful! Be sure you take a taxi to the airport, it is very cheap (10 eur) and going in public transport is not easy since tram 28 is normally full of people. Obrigado Pedro!!

I stayed with my friend Emma at 'Alfama 2 You' and had a wonderful experience. The apartment is super nice, clean and is located in a great neighborhood in Lisbon. The rooftop view is FANTASTIC!!! Tram 28 passed right in front of the apartment which was really convenient. Pedro was a great host! He made a really cool map for us to use and gave us several suggestions of places to visit, and always responded to any questions we had. His mother Maria and girlfriend Eva are lovely! Pedro and Eva showed us Belem and the 'Christ King'. Can't say enough great things about our experience and strongly recommend anyone to stay at Pedro's apartment.

Muito Obrigado !
Emma and JoRi

+) Small but cosy apartment. Rather large kitchen. Fantastic view from terrace on the roof. 28 tram stop just near the entrance. 15 minutes from center, 10 minutes from subway station. Very hospitable owner. Special bonus: Portuguese vine.

-) Situated in Alfama, on hills. So, if you are out of form it will be certain problem to climb.

This was our first AirBnB experience in Europe and it was wonderful! We met Maria at the flat and she was so warm and welcoming. The flat was a perfect space for two people, clean and equipped with everything we needed. The rooftop terrace had a great view and the area of Alfama was perfect. We got to enjoy the view, Fado, the 28 Tram, St. George's Castle, and so much more in walking distance of the flat. It was the perfect location and home for our visit. It made us feel as if we lived in Lisbon. Thank you so much Maria, Pedro and familia!
Very nice, very clean apartment with amazing location. Nice roof terrace. And Pedro was very helpful and flexible. Highly recommended!

Nice trip! Pedro and his girlfriend were very friendly.
We hope go back one day in his house. Perfect location, quiet and very good bed. we slept for hours!
Lisbon is a very beautiful city.

Pedro's apartment was just as we expected from the pictures: really nice! Additionally, it was very central and even though it was in Alfama (a busy neighbourhood), it wasn't noisy at all. Also, tram 28 stops just outside the flat.

In terms of Pedro, he turned out to be an excellent host. He had the most detailed and amazing self-made guides of Lisbon which were pretty useful; also, he was happy to provide us with a heater when the weather got chilly which meant we were toasty from then onwards.

We strongly recommend anyone looking for a small studio to stay at Pedro's.

We did not know what we had to expect. Only the photos gave us a view of the apartment. Is was fine. Realy clean and Pedro is an exellent host. He guides us with enough information to find the highlights of Lisboa. He recommend us several good restaurants.
Is short, we enjoyed our stay in Lisboa very much, whit the compliments for Pedro.
When you want to go to Lisbon...? Go to Pedro.
After a day of walking mountain up and down it is fine to come "home" at Pedro's.
Arie & Ellen.

For all future Lisbon fans: Pedro's apartment is just the Best place to stay in Lisbon! Everything was just as described, but what is the most important is the atmosphere of the whole area called Alfama! The most delicious food with Fado music around, the best tram 28 in the world and all other things brought the greatest emotions for both of us!
Thank you Pedro for your help and the best place we could stay in Lisbon. It was a very good first experience to use airbnb!

This is a great location in the beautiful Alfama.
Lots of small restaurants and cafes in the area, and no problem to walk to other places in the old town - like Bairro Alto and Belem.
Pedro is professional and nice and this place is as good as any hotel.Neat and clean.

Pedro is a wonderful Airbnb host! He is professional and kind. We called on him to help us reserve a taxi and asked him various other questions and he was always helpful and got back to us right away. He awaited patiently for us to arrive from the airport then explained the apartment features to us. He gave us maps and told us all the points of interest to see while we were in Lisbon. It was so nice to have Pedro's help.
There is everything that one would need in the apartment. It is clean and well appointed. If you want to make a meal, and relax after a long day of discovering Lisbon you will have everything in the apartment to do that. It is in a safe, friendly neighborhood, with great places to eat. We highly recommend Pedro's place.
Thank you Pedro for your warm hospitality and making us feel welcomed in Lisbon!

Just great. Location amazing, everything close by. Apartment very clean and nice. We stuck in traffic on our way from Seville and Pedro was waiting for us. He provided us with lot of useful information. From this place you have 100 to 500 meters to walk to a lot of sights, and a lot of tasty small restaurants around.

Peter,

Thank you so much for letting us stay in your beautiful apartment. I hope to visit this nice city again, and definitely will stay in your place if it will be available.

Only thing I'd recommend to travelers, don't try to find this place if get to Lisbon with rented car when it's already dark :)

Pedro's place in really worth recommendation! We spent 5 nights in this extremely cozy and clean apartment. The location is fantastic - this part of Alfama is lively yet quite at night, nice places to eat or just have a coffee simply around the corner :-)
Unfortunately we have not met Pedro in person but had contact via the phone.
We really want to thank you for your effort, the handouts full of useful tips and BIG THANKS goes to your dad who was waiting for us to let us in!!!! He was very helpful trying to explain and show us around

Take care and keep up the good work with your lovely Alfama place!!!
Warm regards,
Ewelina & Ed

I'm highly recommend this apartment for all travelers :) Apartment located in old part of Lisbon, really easy to reached by taxi right from airport (about 10 Euro). Tram station is also near apartment and you can get most popular tram - 28. Cafe for breakfast directly across the street and also many restaurants around. Pedro is really helpful and he has guide for restaurants, terraces, and guide with different walks. Apartment is on first floor, fully-equipped and fully same on photos.

We realized during the week end we had the perfect location. Alfama is just so cozy and close to everything.
We took the tram to reach different areas, taxi was also easy to access in the area.
The apartment in itself was perfect for a week end, good size and bright.
We appreciated it was so clean, and the best part was Pedro's warm welcome and good ideas on what to do in Lisboa for the week end. He had prepared ideas and nice surprises! :)

We will def come back soon again! Thank you pedro!
//Philippa & Ben

We had a great stay in Pedro's apartment! The location is perfect, in bustling Alfama on the border to Graca and on line 28 (which most tourists will want to take anyway). The apartment is clean and comfortable with a great bed and it is quite. Pedro's has done a great job with lots of information about Lisboa competing with the Lonely Planet...So, overall we had a great stay and would (and maybe will) definitely come again!

We had a lovely time at Pedro's apartment. Pedro was very friendly and helpful on our arrival. The apartment is located in the heart of Lisbon, in district Alfama, perfect to visit all main locations. Pedro told us all the best interest spots and things to do in Lisbon.
We recommend this place. The apartment is exactly as described, and hosts were great.
Simply perfect :)

The apartment is located in the center of Lisbon, very convenient location. Nearby are many restaurants and cafes. The apartment is clean and beautiful.

Pedro is a nice host, on all of our questions we quickly get a competent answers. He wrote a guide specialy for guests, its really help us find a lot of great places in neighborhood.

We really enjoyed staying in this place!
We recommend accommodation in Alfama with Pedro in his apartment!

If you are looking for a great place to explore Lisbon then we highly recommend to book Pedro's appartment! The flat is well-located, in the beautiful neighbourhood of Alfama, clean and very welcoming. There is a stop of the historic tram station right in front of the house (the appartment is very quiet though), the metro and train station Santa Apolonia is in 10 minutes walking distance and many tourist sights are nearby. Pedro welcomed us with a glass of portwine and a very comprehensive restaurant and city guide that helped us to make the best out of our stay. One highlight is definitely the rooftop terrace!
