Communication was very friendly and uncomplicated. We would defenitely come back.

We had a lovely stay in in Pedro's flat. It was very well located in Alfama, very near great places. Pedro was welcoming and was very flexible for the check in and check out. The flat was clean and tidy. We warmly recommend this place !

Pedro's flat is clean,nice ,well equiped and located!!!
The flat is near to the tram.
Pedro prepared detailed guide with the different places to visit at Lisbon.
I strongly recommend Pedro's flat
Thank you Pedro

We spent a wonderful time in Pedro's flat. His advices and indications were really helpful. We couldn't have imagined a better way to visit Lisbon. In addition, an excellent glass of Porto wine welcomed us when we arrived. A great way to put yourself in the mood :)
The flat was perfect for our needs, very clean, well equiped and its location is simply ideal, right in the middle of Alfama. A special mention to the rooftop terrace which is perfect to have a little drink watching the sunset.
I strongly recommend Pedro's place. You won't be disappointed!

Pedro was an excellent host, he was incredibly helpful and the apartment was a great base for seeing Lisbon and the surrounding area. We loved having breakfast on the rooftop terrace overlooking Alfama and the ocean :)

Pedro is a great host! He welcomed us with a glass of portwine and was very well prepared with a lot of helpful informations about Lisboa (neighborhood, restaurants, bars, sightseeing, ...). The apartment was very clean and well-provided. Moreover it's just perfectly located in the heart of Alfama.

Highly highly recommended!!

It was wonderful the welcome and the maps that Pedro did for us, we could visit the most beautiful places of the town, the best restaurants and we never lost!
I really recommend this apartment to stay in Lisbon, in one of the most authentic places in the center of Alfama

This was my first booking with Airbnb and was a great experience. Pedro is a helpful and friendly host, all the communication was very easy and he provided lots of information about things to do during my visit.  The apartment is perfect - modern, comfortable, good facilities, and the location is ideal for exploring Alfama and the city centre.  Lisbon is an amazing place with so much character, and I recommend everyone to visit!

Pedro is a great host and the apartment was super!Alfama is a great area to stay in and the apartment is near restaurants, the famous tram and plenty of fado bars! The apartment was really clean, nicely decorated and modern. Everything was comfortable and the area was very safe.Thank you Pedro, we really enjoyed our stay especially the welcome drink of Port!

Big thank you to our host!! Apartment was amazing and in excellent location in the old town. The rest of the city was easily accessible by tram, with a stop right next to the apartment. And on arrival we were treated to a glass of port and given alot of information on what to do and where to go. Couldn't ask for more. If you plan on going to Lisbon look no further.

We have enjoyed our trip in Alfama, it was a very very great spot especially during the Santo Antonio celebration!! Dancing people, barbecues, beer everywhere! It was crazy and so funny.
The apartment is pefecrly located. We where in the heart of Alfama quarter. You've got everything you need, it was clean, well decorated... Pedro is very welcoming and the communication with him was very easy. Cherry on the cake, two little bottles (of Moscatel) with marmelade and cakes were wating for us. We recomend this apartment to everyone who wants to enjoy Lisboa.

We were really enthusiastic about this place :)
It is well located in the beautiful alfama and much bigger than it looked on the pictures. There is a big kitchen and fine bathroom.
Everything was well equipped and clean.
Above all, Pedro and his wife were really friendly, fast responding, and helpful.
We would recommend this apartment to everyone!

Claudia’s apartment is really lovely, it has a lot of her personal history and, of course, the most amazing view! Honestly everyday it was hard to leave the place and explore Lisbon when it felt so cozy and comfortable there! Even the building’s stairs didn’t feel like a big deal and were actually fun (and I had two huge and heavy baggages to carry!). If you want some true Lisbon experience, I highly recommend this place. The surroundings are great too, so many good restaurants, cafes, public transport, metro very near and so on. Very safe area too. Perfect mix of the traditional Lisbon and the city. Negative points: mattress could be replaced, the kitchen definitely needs a kettle and the bathroom needs some little repairs. Also I was a day without water, but Claudia sorted that out as fast as she could and was very proactive. Overall I had a great 5 days there and I’d for sure book the place again!
Cozy place, nice view not far from cafe or restaurant, I wish I spent more days in Lisbon

We had a wonderful stay in Lisbon at Claudia’s apartment. Everything was as described and Claudia was a great host. She gave us a recommendation for a restaurant where we had our best dinner in Lisbon. Lovely cosy place and we would highly recommend!
Great location, walkable to all local sights and restaurants, and great proximity to metros, trams and buses. Would definitely recommend Cláudia's place!
Soggiorno molto piacevole. La posizione è ottima e la proprietaria è stata molto gentile e disponibile. Ci tornerei senz’altro!!
The loft is located in a great location that is an easy walk to downtown. The apartment provided a peaceful respite from busy Lisbon excursions. There are many bars, restaurants and stores near.
Great communication! Amazing location!  Fantastic host!

L' emplacement du logement est bien, la vue sur le Tage est un plus .
De nombreuses activités proches, à pieds.

Nous avons adoré notre logement au cœur de Lisbonne !!
L’hôte a accepté que nous venions porter nos bagages avant l’heure du chek-in, ce que nous avons grandement apprécié.
Le balcon est grand avec une belle vue. Le logement est charmant. Nous y avons passé un très beau séjour, Merci ! ☺️
A much needed relaxing space after a full day of seeing the city. The place was very clean and unique, definitely recommend.

Claudia Alexandra was a really nice host, responsive and kind. The apartment is nice as well, located in a nice area and in order.
Will come again!
Recomendo, nossa experiência foi ótima e confortante. Claudia sempre bastante atenciosa e comunicativa, excelente!
nice location, easy check-in, good communication!

Lisbon is quite hilly so wanted somewhere on the flat. while flat is on 4th floor hence the River View. it is easy walk from Cais De Sodre so easy to access city and trains and ferry's. Time out market and bar, cafes on route to metro. It is close but just off busy area. cosy and quite while has balcony area. Claudia was a great host, quite to get back with any questions. Lisbon is amazing and this is a great place to explore while when you retire for night you feel like it's your nest.
Amazing space to use for a weekend with great outdoor views
Claudia was a wonderful host and I enjoyed the area thoroughly.

This was a nice spot to stay in the middle of bustling Lisbon. The nearby public parking garage was very handy and the flat is close to lots of restaurants. The apartment was clean and nicely decorated, though it could use a few minor repairs (missing tiles, loose stair, etc). Overall though it was a good stay!
Super kind and flexible. Appreciated her responsiveness on all the requests I had - Early check ins, luggage drop offs, questions around the place. Definitely recommend!
Die Wohnung unter dem Dach liegt fußläufig zu vielen interessanten Orten und ist sehr gut an Bahn und Bus angebunden. Sehr nette sicher Ecke in Lissabon.

Die Wohnung liegt für Unternehmungen in der Stadt sehr günstig.
Innerhalb der Wohnung muss einiges repariert werden. Beim Bad fehlt eine Klinke, die Tapete löst sich, der Wasserhahn am Handwaschbecken ist sehr locker. Das Besteck und das Geschirr bestehen aus zusammengewürfelten Dingen. Sinnvoll wäre ein Wasserkocher.
Bei unserem Aufenthalt regnete es an einem Tag stark. Dabei tropfte das Regenwasser durch die Dunstabzugshaube hinunter auf den Herd.
Die Klimaanlage ist auch als Heizung nutzbar. Nur hängt sie an der falschen Stelle. Während sie im Schlafraum tropische Temperaturen erzeugt, bleibt die Temperatur im Wohnbereich unter 20 Grad.
Beautiful apartment and views, excellent host. AAA+++
Nice host and very convenient place. I will definitely come back :)

foi perfeito
ótima localização, você consegue ir andando aos bairros chiado e passear nos restaurantes
lugar como nas fotos, muito limpo e decorado

super logement qui correspond complètement à l'annonce et aux attentes que l'on s'en fait, très charmant avec sa petite terrasse et parfaitement situé et tenu par des hôtes très sympathiques et qui font vraiment attention à ce que votre séjour se déroule parfaitement. merci à eux

This is a very fun, cosy and comfortable apartment. The 74 step climb up (no elevator) wasn’t an issue for us (hikers with backpacks) but would perhaps be tricky for people with heavy suitcases. The view and balconies were great. The host was very communicative. We loved our stay!

Claudia war sehr nett! Die Unterkunft ist schön und gut gelegen. Die Wohnung scheint etwas in die Jahre gekommen zu sein, die Matratze hat auch schon mal bessere Tage gesehen und im Bad fehlte eine Türklinke, ohne die sich aber auch eine Lösung finden ließ. Insgesamt sind wir zufrieden mit unserem Aufenthalt.
Easy to find, flexible check-in, great neighborhood
Die Lage des Airbnb ist super und die Kommunikation mit Claudia ging schnell und war einfach
Super Wohnung mit einer schönen Aussicht vom Balkon. Vieles zu Fuß erreichbar
Lovely place, perfect for up to 2 people, with a great outdoor area. Highly recommended! And Claudia was great!
We hebben een fijn verblijf gehad. Appartement was goed alleen wel wat onderhoud nodig.
Wir hatten einen tollen Aufenthalt in der tollen Wohnung! Super Lage, super Wohnung, schnelle freundliche Kommunikation! Wir kommen gern wieder wenn wir mal wieder in Lissabon sind 🥰
Niets op aan te merken.

The place was very unique and exactly as described (check in was clear and host was easy to communicate with). The areas which could be improved is that the bed/pillows were not comfortable, the bathroom door did not have a handle on the inside and we had to pay an external facility to store our bags the next day.

Nous avons passés un agréable séjour dans le logement de Claudia & Henrique.
Le logement est très bien situé et est très personnel, ça change des airbnbs qui peuvent être un peu froid, dans celui-ci on peut ressentir une forme de « vie », on se sent comme chez soi! La terrasse est un véritable plus.
⚠️⚠️ Attention à la tête pour les personnes de grande tailles, cela peut être contraignant comme le logement est sous le toit / Le bâtiment ne présente pas d’ascenseur, si vous avez une grosse valise, préparez vos muscles !
Au delà de cela, les hôtes nous ont donnés pleins de recommandations de restaurant et de lieu sur Lisbonne pour passer de très bons moments, je vous recommande les yeux fermés !
Au plaisir de revenir sur Lisbonne et dans leur logement.
This place was very cute and had stunning rooms from the balcony. The host was lovely to communicate with and was very helpful during my stay.
merci pour ce séjour
Très beau loft, encore mieux que sur les photos, Claudia est très réactive et sympathique, je recommande fortement.

Nous avons adoré séjourner chez Claudia et Henrique. Ils ont gentiment accepter que nous deposions nos bagages plus tôt que prevu. Nous avons trouvé le logement tres chaleureux et super fonctionnel. Nous avons beaucoup aimé quil y ait de vraies plantes vertes. Les terrasses sont un vrai plus. Il est situé dans un quartier vivant et à 10 min de la station de transports en commun Cais do Sodre (métro, train, tram, bus, ferry).
Enfin, un grand merci pour les petites attentions : tout le nécessaire pour le petit déjeuner et pour l apéritif !
Nous gardons précieusement cette adresse que nous recommanderons !
Een heerlijke loft om een paar dagen te verblijven. De airco was fijn en het dakterras een heerlijke plek voor een ontbijtje of drankje.
Beautiful space!

A really lovely loft apartment on the top floor as mentioned so if you have heavy luggage make sure you’re willing to carry it up the 74~ steps. Not the best apartment for tall people due to all the beams and sloped ceilings — but even the shower head is quite low and unadjustable despite there being enough room for it to be higher. The bathroom also could use some maintenance in general due to a broken window latch, broken door knob/lock, moving faucet, and missing tiles in the shower as well as it not being completely water tight for some of the shower’s settings. Hosts were very communicative and fixed a broken light while we were there, and the location was good as well.
Schöne und besondere Wohnung mitten in Lissabon& eine nette Gastgeberin. Alles ist gut zu Fuß erreichbar. Klimaanlage ist ein plus. Schöne Aussicht :)

Charming place in the middle of Lisbon but be warned! Top floor with no elevator means you have to tackle four flights of stairs every single time you step out. The bed is on a small mezzanine which means more stairs and the mezzanine itself is a little cramped if you're two sleeping. The view from the balcony is nice - once you look beyond the industrial buildings.
I still liked this place though. Close to everything that you need during the day and night life.

Perfect stay! Will be our first choice when back in Lisbon :)
thanks again!

Hosts were incredibly responsive and lovely. The location was fantastic; close to everything - great bars, restaurants and shops. We really enjoyed our stay here.
Bed was quite firm but a minor issue that could be overlooked!

Super appartement avec la terrasse par contre il y avait un nid de guêpe donc on a pu utiliser seulement que un balcon sur 2.
le lit n'était pas confortable et n'avait pas assez de couverture.J'ai adoré la grande fenetre dans le toit qu'on pouvait ouvrir très grand en ayant la vue superbe !

Quelle bonne surprise cet appartement au centre des activités de Lisbonne! À côté de tous les transports, il rend très simple la visite de la ville. C’est un appartement super agréable, frais et mignon avec une deco très réussie! Claudia et Henrique ont plein de recommandations top pour rendre le voyage le plus agréable possible. Merci!

Claudia and Henrique’s place was so cute! The loft was on the 4th floor, so a few stairs but was honestly worth it. It was incredibly clean, had such a nice little balcony and had a quirkiness to the styling of it. There was also a flexible check in time, depending on the house keeper which was amazing! The loft was in such a cute area of Lisbon with restaurants and bars close by. Claudia and Henrique also gave me some local recommendations and recommendations while I was on my day trip to Cascais. I would 100% stay here again!!
Nous avons passé un agréable séjour chez Cláudia & Henrique. L’appartement est bien équipé et très cosy pour se reposer.

Claudia was very flexible with check in allowing me to leave my bags since I flew in early and overall her communication was excellent. The river views were also amazing from the patio. The area was quiet but close enough to the train (11 min walk) and Time Out market. The bed was a bit more firm than I prefer, the shower ran hot, and the stairs are dark and creeky (apt on 4th floor) but overall Claudia's kindness, the location, and the views definitely made it worth it for me.

It was a very lovely stay, Cláudia & Henrique were attentive and helpful hosts. They recommended us a restaurant nearby, which we really enjoyed. The view from the balconies is just amazing. The apartment has great location, in walking distance to many attractions and close to the stop of the famous tram 28. Everything was exactly as on the photos and had very cozy vibe.
Self check-in was smooth, provided instructions had photos and step by step explanations, so everything was very clear.
The only weak point I could mention were steps (we expected them, but a little bit overestimated ourselves).
Apartment is located on the top floor and there is no lift inside the building. We were aware about it, but still carrying a heavy suitcase was a challenge. There are steps inside the apartment on the way to the bed and inside the bathroom, as well.
We also found it tricky to get out of the building (there is a button on the wall quite far from the door, which looks like the light switch:D)
Beautiful place to stay to make the most of the Lisbon experience! Amazing, hospitable hosts too!

This place was an excellent home base for our trip to Lisbon. The location is close enough to everything on foot without being right in the middle of a busy area. The apartment is cute and clean and the views from the balconies are great. There is just a little construction outside, but only during daytime hours and you can’t really hear it with the windows closed. We loved this place!
Very nice apartment

Claudia & Henrique's place was great, an oasis in the central area of Lisbon! Very clean, quiet and comfortable. Bedroom is up a flight of stairs in a loft. Easy to walk to many neighborhoods and attractions. Lots of good restaurants nearby too. Loved the 2 terraces with wonderful views of the city and Tagus River. Close to the Cais do Sodre metro and train station. Great communication and welcome. Highly recommended!

호스트는 언제나 친절하고 신속하게 응답해주었고 동네 즐길거리도 알려주었습니다.
숙소에 에어컨, 냉장고, 전자레인지, 커틀러리 등 모두 구비되어있어 편했습니다.
테라스 쪽에서 바다를 바라보며 지친 하루를 마무리할 수 있어서 좋았습니다.
호스트가 친절하며, 루프탑이라서 뷰가 좋습니다!
Merci, un super logement

Très agréable appartement, en ville mais sans le bruit festif de Lisbonne.
Prendre un café le matin sur la terrasse en regardant le Tage et avec les hirondelles c’ est vraiment magnifique.
L’appartement est très bien équipé.
Le quartier est typique et les transports (métro tram bus) à proximité .
Nos hôtes ont toujours étaient disponibles si besoin et de bon conseil . A cela s’ajoute la gentillesse .
Nous avons passé un séjour parfait.
Merci Claudia et Henrique.
Perfect location and a cool flat. Very friendly and available hosts
We stayed here for the second time and still loved the appartment! It was clean and nice and communication with Claudia was easy and good  :)

Amazing location. Can walk or take a short bus to all major attractions. Claudia was extremely helpful with food recommendations and even helped us get in the apartment as we have never used the specific front door key before (push the key button to make it longer). The place was extremely quiet as there is construction outside but with the windows closed you don’t hear it. The stairs to the place are not difficult as I have a torn acl and my wife is pregnant. Thanks again.

We just loved staying is this loft! Wonderful light and outdoor space, very clean, and very helpful and responsive hosts. Great location and a truly wonderful value as well. We were able to walk almost everywhere.

we had a great 4 day stay.  The house was so cute and about 20min from the main sites. We cooked breakfast two mornings and had the things we needed.  It was not hot so we kept the windows open and enjoyed the breeze and no mosquitoes came in. Great stay would come back again!

Un très charmant logement. Avec une belle vue sur Tage.
Les petites attentions pour le petit déjeuner et la communication était très bien.
Un quartier tranquille avec des restaurants autour.

Super semaine, le logement correspond à la description. Nous avons pu déposer nos bagages avant l’heure d’arriver. Claudia et Henrique nous ont tenu informer des difficultés de transport et nous ont conseillé de bons restaurants. Merci encore

it was our first time in Lisbon. Claudia & Henrique's place was the perfect place to get started from. It was a nice as their pictures led us to believe.
it was very comfortable and had everything we needed to eat and wash clothes. This is why you airbnb instead of a hotel!

Our hosts also came to our aid in a difficult situation... it was INVALUABLE to have them on our side while we were across the ocean. We have no connections in Portugal, we were all on our own. They not only quickly helped us in a time of need, they were very gracious about everything and made us feel at ease. I've never been in a situation like that... And I've never been so thankful!

Amazing apartment with a unique and cool design! The balcony gets sun all day, making it perfect for relaxing. It's in a great location—close to restaurants and all the main attractions. The hosts were incredibly helpful. Would love to stay here again!

We had a great stay in this charming top-floor apartment in Lisbon. It’s a beautifully decorated and unique space—just like in the pictures—with lovely balconies offering a nice view. The location is also very convenient, with plenty of cafes and restaurants nearby. It was within walking distance to several bus stops and about a 10-minute walk to Cais do Sodré, which made it easy to get around the city and beyond.
A great location with plenty to do around the area. The hosts were so friendly and communicated efficiently. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and can’t wait to go back❤️
The place was exactly as pictured and described! It was a lovely space and we would definitely stay here again. The place felt very homey and had beautiful views of the waterfront.

Nous avons apprécié ce logement qui nous a permis de découvrir Lisbonne et ses environs aisément.

Great location.  Unit was as described.  We Enjoyed sitting out on the patio watching the sailboats for the evening.  Thank you!

Claudia and Henrique made for a relaxing and pleasant stay. They check-in instructions were very clear and I had all the accommodations I needed. The view was lovely and it felt like I was a guest in their lovely stay. I hope to come back again in the future. Thanks!
Wir hatten vier wirklich schöne und sonnige Tage in Lissabon. Zu Fuß alles wunderbar erreichbar. Das Haus ist sehr ruhig.

Amazing location. Friendly and welcoming host. Cleans and spacious place. I really recommend booking it.

Wonderful stay in Lisbon
Apartment well equipped, perfect location and very nice hosts

Estuvimos alojados en el apartamento de Cláudia & Henrique 4 noches, y realmente bien, tiene todo lo necesario y se notaba limpio. La comunicación con los anfitriones muy buena, desde el principio hasta el final, y la ubicación nos pareció inmejorable.

Super séjour dans un appartement génial ! on s'y sent bien, très lumineux, très confortable et spacieux. Rien de négatif, un plaisir d'y séjourner !

super séjour à Lisbonne, l'appartement est très joli, la terrasse avec vue sur le Tage exceptionnel, le métro est à deux pas .. hôte très réactive et arrangeante pour l'arrivée.

The place was perfect for our needs, offering a lovely terrace to watch fireworks away from the crowd. We appreciated that the apartment felt lived-in, with essentials like salt, pepper, oil, and cleaning supplies provided—this made a big difference for us.
The location is fantastic, in one of the best areas of Lisbon, close to great restaurants and within walking distance of main attractions. Claudia was very responsive.
However, we couldn’t give 5 stars due to a few issues: the bed and pillows were uncomfortable (flat and squeaky), the apartment was cold despite the heater (which also had poor air quality), and morning construction noise was disruptive. Additionally, some quirks were initially stressful, like figuring out the old key for the door (it took 10 minutes to get in to the apartment) and the unconventional shower controls—hot water required turning to the blue side, and getting the water to flow needed pushing inward instead of outward.
Overall, it’s a good place to stay

Appartement très bien situé pour rayonner.

Overall we were happy with our stay and the location (loads of restaurants, cafes and bar s nearby). Lights unfortunately did not work, some water (puddle on the stove) came in during heavy rain. Our hosts tried to fix an were very nice about it, however due to public holiday wasn‘t feasible.

O apartamento é ótimo. A localização é maravilhosa, tem todas as facilidades por perto, inclusive um mercado e muitos bares. Dá para ir tranquilamente a pé até a Praça do Comércio e até o Cais do Sodré, de onde partem os trens para lugares próximos, como Cascais e Sintra.
O apartamento é super bem equipado. Nos sentimos em casa.

Grand logement, très bien situé. Belle vue. Au 4ème étage. Prévoir des petites valises à cause des escaliers. La salle de bain aurait besoin d’un peu de rénovation.

Beautiful apartment, lovely touches and wonderfully communicative host! FANTASTIC stay at Claudia’s !!! ❤️❤️❤️

Beau logement propre et bien situé. Il était près des transports publics ce qui est très pratique. Les bars sont pas trop loin pour qq qui veut faire la fête et la vie dans le cartier était agréable.
The loft was exactly as described and did not disappoint.  The hosts were extremely helpful answering any of our questions and the location was ideal. Loved the little breakfast tray idea. 😃

Nous sommes restés à l’appartement en septembre 2024. L’appartement est bien situé et à distance de marche du barro alto ou du traversier /gare cais de sodre.
Appartement propre et check-in facile.
Deux petites terrasses agrémentent l’appartement. À savoir: appartement dans les combles à l’étage supérieur. Les grandes personnes peuvent se sentir à l’étroit. D’importants travaux sont en cours dans le voisinage dont la construction d’une ligne de métro. Le terrain d’en face est utilisé pour la fabrication du béton. Les travaux sont du lundi au samedi inclusivement, de 6:00 à 21:00. C’est bruyant. Nous avons pu dormir en fermant les fenêtres et en démarrant la climatisation. Mais prendre le café du matin ou l’apéro sur la terrasse est désagréable. Ça peut teinter négativement l’expérience de voyage.
Cláudia was super responsive to every question and had some great tips about the area! The outdoor area was super peaceful at night and a great place to have some wine watching the boats!

Amazing, quiet and quirky loft apartment with lots of personality. Close to really good cafes and restaurants. Cláudia and Henrique were so helpful and responsive, they do their best to ensure guests are looked after. We enjoyed our short stay.
Claudia a été très réactive et le logement correspondait à nos attentes pour un week end a 2 à Lisbonne !

Overall an amazing stay. Great place. Great hosts. One caveat: If you need the windows open and are bothered by construction noise, this would not be your place for the next few months until they complete construction. Claudia and Henrique were awesome and helpful hosts. They even had some breakfast essentials, coffee, and tea available. The location is quiet and not a main thoroughfare, yet has several restaurants, shops, and bars within steps of the building. It’s within walking or a short Uber distance to everything one could want to see and do in Lisbon.

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour à Lisbonne dans l’appartement de Claudia & Henrique, qui est très bien situé, à proximité de l’océan, des transports, des restaurants et du centre :)

Great apartment in Lisbon. Especially liked the two balconies for the sunshine. Cláudia and Henrique are great hosts and very responsive. Thanks for a great stay!

Amazing apartment, with everything you need. It gave me that feeling of “maybe I should move here” that is what I usually expect from airbnbs. Don’t hesitate! Book it now! We will definitely stay here again!

Great spot located in close proximity to Tagus River and many different restaurants and bars. Claudia and Henrique provided clear instructions for check in and were available to help when needed. Thanks for the fun stay!

We’ve always stayed in Alfama so thought we would try the other side of the Praça de Comércio and we’re so pleased we did.

Cais de Sodre was also in walking distance making travel outside the city easy too.
The apartment had everything we needed and the balcony’s were lovely to enjoy a morning cuppa or a glass of vinho verde in the evening.
Highly recommend.

Muy recomendable para pasar unos días en Lisboa.

We are so happy we picked Claudia & Henrique's place. They are great hosts. They were very responsive to any questions we had and gave us a lot of good suggestions on places to go and restaurants. The check-in directions were easy to follow.
The location is pretty central to everything. We walked to most places or took a quick Uber if something was a little further away.
The condo is exactly as posted. It is on the 5th floor and there is no elevator, but you also have a view of the river. There is quite a bit of construction going on, but the condo is soundproofed, and you don't hear anything if the doors/windows are shut.
They had all of the amenities we needed and a great starter package of coffee and snacks. A few of the best things about the condo: large/soft towels, amazing shower, full size refrigerator, oven/stove, washing machine.
We would 100% stay there again.

Super locatiie
Sfeervol
Leuk uitzicht.
Niet mogelijk om te koken, maar is in Lissabon eigenlijk ook niet nodig
Fantastic! Loved the wine bar just next door and the rooftop space.
Great location, lots of good restaurants, very helpful and responsive hosts!

숙소는 넓고 깨끗했습니다. 일부 공간은 머리를 숙이고 다녀야 해서 다소 불편할 수도 있지만 크게 문제되지는 않았습니다.
여행 내내 너무 더운 날씨가 계속되었는데 에어컨으로 충분히 시원하게 지낼 수 있었고 (첫날 밤에도 에어컨을 살짝 틀어 놓았다가 추워서 다음날부터는 끄고 잤더라는...), 숙소에서 식사를 요리해 먹기에도 불편함이 전혀 없었습니다. 아, 쓰레기통이 다소 작아서 한 주 동안의 쓰레기를 감당하기에는 좀 모자르기는 했네요 🤣
숙소에서 도보로 10분 거리 이내에 버스, 지하철, 트램 정류장들이 있고, 타임아웃 마켓에서 도보로 15분 거리에 있기 때문에 관광지를 돌아다니는 데에도 크게 불편함이 없었습니다.
다른 숙소에 묵었던 친구의 이야기를 들어보면 여기 가성비가 훠어어얼씬 높은 것 같습니다.
다만, 여기는 엘레베이터가 없어서 4층까지 짐을 옮기는데 제법 힘이 많이 들기는 합니다 🤣(한국인에게는 5층에 해당하는...ㅎㅎ)
그리고 이 숙소에서 유일하게 꼽은 단점은 테라스 뷰가... 공사장이라는... 😭😭
분명 태주강이 보이고 저 건너편 지역들이 눈앞에 펼쳐져있는데 바로 그 앞쪽에 공사 중으로 인해서 크레인 뷰가 되었다는 슬픈 이야기 흑....
이것 외에는 그래도 모든 것이 좋았다!!!
나중에 다시 리스본에 온다면 재방문 의사 👍👍👍👍
Everything you need for a short stay. Wifi was great. Shower was nice and big. Walkable everywhere. Perfect hosts.

Great little stay in Lisbon. Excellent location, close to everything you want to see.  Very cosy apartment with a super cute view of the water and sail boats cruising by! I would definitely stay again!
Excellent location, apartment and responsive and friendly hosts!  Looking forward to my next visit.
Wonderful apartment in a nice modern location with some great cafes nearby.  Cláudia and Henrique were helpful and friendly.  Would highly recommend!

Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Die Wohnung ist liebevoll eingerichtet und hat alles was gebraucht wird. Die Gegend  bietet viele tolle Restaurants und ist nahe beim Knotenpunkt cais do sodre. Wir können alles uneingeschränkt weiter empfehlen. Die Tips von Claudia und Henrique waren Gold wert.  Besonders das Fischrestaurant Frade dos Mares war ausgezeichnet. Wir kommen gerne wieder!

Really recommend staying here. Amazing location with lots of great bars, restaurants and Time Out market minutes away. The apartment is lovely and homely. It’s peaceful and very comfortable with a great roof terrace. Fantastic hosts too.

Claudia’s place was just as described, quiet, close to restaurants, near the tram!! It is on the fourth floor so make sure your packing light for the stairs. But we love the little bit if extra workout to get into her place!! The air conditioning works well for those warm days too! Would book her place again if we are back in Lisbon.
Good location as near the metro and many very nice cafes, bars and restaurants. very cute and quirky flat, very friendly and responsive hosts :)

Really nice place, good location and the balcony is really nice as well!
Also the host answer pretty fast and it's convenient!

Excellent emplacement. L’air climatisé était plus qu’apprécié dans cette semaine de chaleur.
Préparez-vous à monter quelques marches mais la vue en vaut vraiment la peine.
Vous serez charmé !

Nous recommandons vivement le logement.
Claudia et Henrique très à l'écoute
Le logement est idéalement situé pour visiter Lisbonne et les environs grâce aux transports facile d'accès

Nous avons passé un super séjour chez Claudia. Nous vous recommandons ce logement. Vous ne serez pas déçus. On s'y sent comme à la maison et la terrasse avec la vue sur le tage est fabuleuse. La cuisine est très bien aménagée et la situation du logement est excellente pour visiter la ville. Nous avons pu communiquer très facilement avec Claudia.
Great location, nice views and quirky feel.  Loved it.  Easily walkable to great sites.  Fantastic overall.

Great location for exploring Lisbon! Host was very responsive and also flexible in allowing us to check in a little earlier due to our flight time. The terrace was perfect to relax in after a long day.

Lovely stay in this quirky apartment! Everything as described and very clean. The area was fantastic with so much to discover on the doorstop and easy to get to from the nearest train station. Great location for nightlife and food. The terrace is also a huge plus.
We had a perfect stay here! Good location, nice view and apartment (and a really cool key :) ).
Fabulous little place in perfect location to access the variety of restaurants and bars within walking distance - little balcony a perfect early evening sun trap ☀️

This is a great base for exploring Lisbon! We loved Santos! The neighbourhood has amazing restaurants and bars right around the corner, but still quiet at night. It was also easy to walk to other parts of the city. The apartment itself was very comfortable and cozy and Claudia was a responsive and friendly host!
Great unique spot with beautiful views. They’ve decorated it beautifully as well.
un appartement très agréable, au calme et très bien situé. idéal pour découvrir Lisbonne.
we enjoyed staying at this lovely place! Everything was perfect during our stay and it was esay to go anywhere in Lisbon.
Perfect stay in an amazing location. Loved the area and the apartment. Claudia very responsive to all communication. Hope to return soon

Parfait, le logement est très propre, fonctionnel et tout mignon. Conforme à la description. Bien situé et proche des transports en commun.
Cláudia et Henrique sont sympathiques et réactifs aux messages

Amazing location, walkable to barrio alto and alfama as well as belem tower but in a nice quiet part of town with amazing restaurants with outdoor seating. House was lovely and hosts were super great at communicating and checking in. Would love to stay here again soon!

One of the best Hosts i met, immediate response, friendly and helpful.
Location is great.
The place was clean.
Great location near Barrio Alto with tons of bars and restaurants. River view is a huge bonus and the apartment has everything you could need in it.

the hosts are very friendly. they researched and found us some very nice restaurants to eat that cater to celiacs. the unit has a great little patio that looks out to the bay. it's in a building that has history, the stairs to the fourth floor are easy. its close to the time out market and many fun places to explore. there are literally 4 place just steps away that offer coffee and breakfast.  it was the perfect place for us to explore Lisbon!
Very funky place! Lots of character (and stairs)!

C'est la première fois que je réside dans un Airbnb où il ne manque absolument rien. Chaque fois que j'avais besoin de quelque chose, je le trouvais.
Emplacement fabuleux

Lit très confortable

Die Wohnung ist sehr gemütlich und sehr sauber. Wir haben uns Wohlgefühls und es genossen, abends auf dem Balkon noch ein Glas Wein zu trinken und den Blick auf den Tejo zu genießen.
Die Kommunikation lief auch hervorragend. Wir kommen gerne zurück. Vielen Dank!

Claudia and Henrique's place was amazing! It was clean, easy to check in and out, and in a great location- we were able to walk almost anywhere we wanted to go! The loft was so cute and perfect for me and my partner. They also recommended us the most delicious restaurant (Petiscaria Ideal) that was only a 5 minute walk away. We loved our stay in Lisbon and would definitely stay in this apartment again!

Very nice little studio. The hosts encourage feedback of future improvements . There are quite a few stairs so is not suitable for someone that has difficulty waking and climbing stairs. It’s also in a nice distinct area to Lisbon with great restaurants and east walk to waterfront and metro station.
Wonderful communication with Claudia & Henrique and looking forward to visiting again soon!
Good :)
Alloggio come da descrizione ottima posizione pieno di ristoranti e supermarket ; vicino alla stazione ottimo per gli spostamenti.. host disponibili e sempre pronti ad aiutarci… consigliato!!!

Très bon séjour à Lisbonne. L'appartement est très bien situé proche de toutes les commodités. Petit Loft très agréable, chaleureux, très bien équipé, avec une belle vue sur le Tage. Nous recommandons ce logement très typique.
Awesome loft apartment. We felt right at home. Super cosy with a ton of character. The host is excellent and was available whenever needed.

Die Wohnung war super ausgestattet und sehr sauber. Wir haben uns wohlgefühlt. Die Lage der Wohnung war zentral, man konnte alles gut zu Fuß oder mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln erreichen. Die Kommunikation lief hervorragend, die Gastgeber haben sehr schnell geantwortet. Wir haben unseren Aufenthalt sehr genossen und kommen gern wieder. Danke an Claudia und Henrique.

Claudia was an amazing host. Her loft is gorgeous and has great lighting. My partner and I are from Canada so we weren’t super familiar with how these type of house keys worked at first (you have to expand the key so that it will fit and turn the lock) but fortunately Claudia was so responsive at the time of check in that we figured out in seconds with her instructions. It was a great experience and I would recommend to anyone. Also water pressure in the shower is fantastic!

I really enjoyed my stay in this apartment. The interior is small, but spacious enough for two. The balconies have a wonderful view (despite a rather large construction project immediately in front.) The neighborhood has plenty of cafes, and there are many great touristic destinations in walking distance.
Lovely, quirky apartment in fantastic location. Host Claudia was extremely friendly and helpful. We had fantastic stay, thank you. :)
Very clean and comfortable apartment, in a great location, with everything we needed.
We´ve been there for the 2nd time - simply great! Thanks to Claudia & Henrique!
The place was really clean and tidy, in a good location close to other attracts in downtown Lisbon. Really enjoyed the stay.

Great value for money stay. The location is very good and walkable to all different places.
The host was very helpful and provided a list of places to eat which was appreciated.
I would stay again and reccomend highly!
As we arrived on a very early flight, the host allowed us to drop off our bags so we didn't have to lug then around Liabon! thank you for a great stay.

Die Kommunikation mit den beiden hat super funktioniert und die Lage der Wohnung war total super - viele schöne Restaurants in der Umgebung.  Wer einen empfindlichen Schlaf hat, sollte sich für das Wochenende Ohropax einpacken. Außerdem war das Bett extrem ungemütlich. Trotzdem haben wir uns insgesamt sehr wohl gefühlt. Vielen Dank!
Their place was super homey and comfortable. In a quiet spot but still plenty close to things to do. They were also very helpful, communicative, and had loads of good local recommendations.

Localização perfeita, acomodação com muitos recursos, cozinha completa, lavadora, uma linda vista, ficamos 6 noites e com certeza voltaríamos a nos hospedar. Os anfitriões foram flexíveis no horário de check-out o que nos ajudou bastante.

Nous avons beaucoup apprécié le logement, idéalement situé et très bien exposé. L'entrée autonome est très pratique, le quartier est vivant mais pas trop bruyant la nuit.
Nos hôtes étaient réactifs et disponibles. Nous sommes plus que ravis et reviendrons volontiers dans cet appartement pour notre prochain séjour à Lisbonne.
Claudia and Henrique always reply very fast and helped us out a lot. Place was amazing and for a young couple the location couldn’t have been better!

We love our time at Claudia and Henrique’s apartment! It was the perfect spot for our few days in Lisbon. We spent every afternoon enjoying wine and sunshine on the balcony, which was just perfect. The location was great - easy connection to everything and within walking distance of good restaurants and public transportation. Plus there were little grocery stores close by so it was easy to pick up snacks, etc. Claudia was wonderful about recommending restaurants and we tried many of them (both breakfast and dinner) and loved them. This is a fabulous place to stay if you are coming to Lisbon - you won’t be disappointed!

appartement proche des transports en commun et non loin du centre
commerce à proximité

Claudia and Henrique's apartment is beautiful. It is even lovelier than it seems in the photos. The place really feels like a home, which cannot be said for many AirBnB's. Would love to come back to Lisbon sometime soon!

Claudia & Henrique place is a gem ...we stayed there for 5 nights and everything was perfect .Claudia communicated everything very clearly and nicely ...it is close to so many cafes and restaurants and general stores ..all the things you need are withing walking distance ..overall it is perfect place to stay in lovely Lisbon ...
Très bon séjour à Lisbonne. L'appartement est très jolie et fonctionnel. Henrique est réactif. Merci beaucoup.
everything is smooth and great!

Claudia and Henrique’s place was wonderful! We stayed for 9 days and were very comfortable. The location is excellent; just a short walk to the center of the city and with views of the river. The apartment is really unique, with lots of light and an outdoor terrace. Most importantly, Claudia was extremely communicative and friendly. She recommended 3 restaurants and we went to two of them—both were fantastic! Thank you for hosting us!
The Apartment was really clean very cozy. We had a few rainy days in Lisbon, so this very sweet flat was our rescue. And communication with cláudia and Henrique was always fast and friendly.

Très bon séjour dans ce logement. Un grand merci aux propriétaires pour leur accueil, leur réactivité, et leur sympathie naturelle. Logement très bien placé, on peut tout faire à pied et en tram. Je recommande !
Sehr schönes Apartment. Kommunikation war super und unkompliziert. Gerne wieder. Vielleicht dann lieber ohne sturmartigen Regen und Lissabon im Ausnahmezustand ;)
Lovely artsy and clean apartment with a balcony. Great location. Claudia was very responsive. Great value for money.
Un appartement très agréable au cœur d’une belle ville pleine de charme

This location you can’t beat in the city and a price point that is unrivaled.  Cláudia & Henrique are one of the most responsive hosts you can find.  However, there was irritating music that could be heard through the night from a bar, along with construction noise in the morning. Good thing though, both can be drained out by running the air conditioner or I would bring ear plugs.  Also, the apartment does have character but character usually comes with age. With all this being said, if you have any issues, don’t hesitate to reach out to Cláudia & Henrique. They are super helpful and always reachable.
Great stay at this apartment. the location was really good with a nice balcony and view. the communication with the host was great, they made our stay really nice.

No tengo ninguna queja. Sin embargo, me gustaría sugerir que el cheking de llegada no se hiciera tan tarde ( es verdad que lo decían en el anuncio, pero a las 18 tienes casi todo el día perdido). Por otra parte, creo que el servicio de toallas y mantas es muy básico ( yo les pedí otra manera, que me la proporcionaron muy amablemente. Pero, pienso que , en principio, tendría que estar más surtido para no tener que pedir nada(? Por último quería señalar que el acceso al dormitorio es más difícil de lo que parece una foto. No es una critica, ya que para mí no ha supuesto un problema, pero no es apto para personas con movilidad reducida. Quiero señalar que el apartamento es bonito, cómodo y muy bien situado.

Stunning studio apartment just a short walk from the Timeout market and Barrio Alto district. Claudia and Henrique were great hosts - very happy to help with any queries and were flexible regarding check-in and check-out. Thank you!

Claudia and Henrique’s home is so artistic, well designed, clean, and in the perfect location. We loved the terrace and all the great recommendations for restaurants, Fado and activities. We will stay here again. Thank you!

Communication with Claudia and Henrique was very good and they showed flexibility to address our check-in time constraints. The apartment was very clean and had all necessary equipment. The position of the flat is ideal for sightseeing, restaurants and nightlife but remains very quiet. The view is gorgeous and the terrace very much appreciated. Highly recommended
Superbe Appartement. Belle vue, emplacement idéal. Vous avez tout à proximité. Très bel accueil. Nous recommandons les yeux fermés
Appartement très agréable , la vue sur le Tage est très appréciable,l’emplacement parfait et Claudia et Henrique très disponibles et réactifs .

Great location, centric but quite and let you enjoy all the city adventures without being in the crowded area.
The place is well equipped, and very comfortable for cooking, chilling and resting.
Claudia and Henrique were amazing, very communicative and helpful.
Wish we could have stay more!

Sehr nette und gute Kommunikation mit den Hosts - immer sehr schnelle Rückmeldung.

L'appartement  atypique de Claudia et Henrique est idéalement situé (transports, bars et restaurants ) avec une petite terrasse sympa; nous n'avons malheureusement pas pû en profiter pleinement (gros chantier dans le quartier).
We had a wonderful stay at Cláudia & Henrique's! The place was well equipped and clean. The stairs were rough with our suitcases, but completely worth the climb for the view!

perfect location, great communication and the most amazing view <3

Appartement très charmant et très fonctionnel. Claudia est une super hôte ! Très disponible et vraiment à l'écoute... Très attentive à nos envies et besoins durant notre séjour. Grâce à Claudia nous avons découvert Lisbonne exactement comme nous le voulions... Un gros gros merci à elle !!! Je recommande fortement pour tout, l'emplacement de l'appartement, l'intérieur de l'appartement et pour Claudia.

We had a great stay here! Good location and quiet at night. Checking in and out was easy and communication with the host was prompt. We were thankful for the AC in the 30+ degree weather. Would stay here again if we come back to Lisbon!

Appartement super bien placé et parfaitement équipé.
Possibilité de faire beaucoup de choses à pieds!
Claudia est très réactive, communication parfaite!
Un cocon parfait pour une escapade lisboete😉
Amazing in every single way! Stay here -- you won't regret it!
I had an excellent experience. Well located, comfortably decorated, and cute.

Das Apartment ist sehr gut gelegen, wenige Fußminuten von der Altstadt und der Fortgehszene entfernt. Es ist sehr heimelig eingerichtet & hat einen ganz speziellen Charme. Insgesamt wärmstens zu empfehlen :)
I enjoyed the second time my stay in the apartment. The communication went very well and I like the apartment very much.
Excellent séjour chez Henrique et Claudia. Ce sont des hôtes attentifs et très réactifs si on a besoin de quelque chose. On a bien apprécié la terrasse et la vue sur le Tage. Merci à vous deux!

First off, the place is everything and more than we expected. The location is perfect, nearby everything and the studio was clean, neat and felt homey.  Claudia and Henrique were amazing, communication was always on point and Claudia gave us great recommendations for nearby eateries.  We will definitely stay here again and again when visiting Lisboa.

Such a beautiful apartment with an amazing location. Really close to the train station, metro, busstop, green street and pink street!
You can even eat frikandellen just around the corner at Dutch treat!!!
The neighbourhood is really nice and there are some cute shops nearby as well. The supermarket isn’t that far away either which was a huge help.
We loved this place and we are going to miss it too much.

This is the SECOND time I have stayed at Cláudia & Henrique's place. I love it here! The location is incredible and the loft immediately feels like home when you walk in. Cláudia & Henrique go above and beyond to make sure you enjoy your stay and are truly wonderful people. I couldn't recommend their place more.

It was amazing! Cláudia & Henrique we’re the perfect hosts! Communication and check in were easy. Henrique himself welcomed us and showed us the place. We even received a welcome breakfast package! Also, we could stay a little longer in the apartment which was so helpful for our time schedule. The apartment itself is beautiful, clean and quiet with a very nice rooftop terrace in the middle of Lisboa. It is located in a very nice area with lots of restaurants, bars and shops. We had a great time and would recommend the apartment to everyone who want to stay in Lisboa!
Great little loft in a perfect location to explore Lisbon. Cláudia and Henrique are fantastic hosts !

Hôtes très serviables et sympathiques,
Logement très bien équipé, le 4ème étage sans ascenseur vaut le coup pour la vue dégagée et les 2 petites terrasses.
C était notre 1er séjour à Lisbonne et nous avons trouvé que le logement est idéalement placé pour se déplacer partout rapidement sans de fort dénivelé nécessaire, à quelques minutes de l eau, et tous les modes de transport sont à quelques secondes (tramway, bus) ou minutes (funiculaire bica, train, bateaux) de l appartement.
Et il y a également beaucoup de choix de bars, petits restaurants au pied et autour de l appartement,
Le quartier semble en renouveau moins touristique peut être que d autres mais dynamique en journée et soirée sans nuisances pour autant.
Nous recommandons vivement le logement de Claudia et Henrique qui nous semble être un compromis ideal (prix, prestation, localisation, gentillesse des hôtes)

Amazing loft in a great location. Very clean and well stocked. The hosts were so so welcoming upon arrival , showing us around and giving tips for our stay. They were always on hand over the messenger for any questions and were very friendly and helpful. We felt welcomed and relaxed and really enjoyed our stay here !

Excellent stay - Claudia and Henrique were excellent hosts - very prompt communication and they helped accommodate an early check in for us. The loft itself was full of charm and character in an excellent location near downtown Lisbon but still quiet and relaxing at night.

Claudia & Henrique are really wonderful hosts. The communication is fantastic and they have many great recommendations which made our trip all the more enjoyable. The apartment location was key to being able to walk and take the tram or train places. Many wonderful restaurants to eat really close by too.

Claudia and Henrique are amazing hosts. Not only is their home in the center of everything, it was super clean and spacious though that 4th floor walk up is no joke 😅.  They made every effort to make sure our stay in Lisbon was memorable and even went the extra mile to make us dinner reservations and send recommendations of their favorite places. I would recommend this place to anyone I know going to Lisbon.

A very cool and cosy top floor apartment close to the nightlife in Lisbon. Claudia and Henrique were really helpful and responsive to all our questions, and the check-in process was great. Very recommended!
The location is very central, you can explore Lisbon perfectly by foot.  Henrique was super nice and helpful at all times. This was really extraordinary!

Cláudia & Henrique have a wonderful apartment in Lisbon. The apartment itself is clean, fully equipped and wonderfully located in a cool part of Lisbon. The only thing topping the great apartment is the personal effort by the couple to make the most of your stay in Lisbon. They respond in seconds if you have any questions and send you on your way with all the inside information on where to eat and go in Lisbon ánd the rest of Portugal. Even after we left Henrique texted us where to go in Sintra for apple pie :-). Big thumbs up for these great people.

I enjoyed the location particularly. The famous Alfama area felt a bit too crowded and tourist-filled, whereas the Santos area where the flat is in seemed more local and young. Communication was amazing, nice people. The place was very well equipped. And the view...!

A great place to stay in the heart of a bustling and interesting neighborhood. The outside deck offers a beautiful view of the river and a great place to have a meal and enjoy the view.
We loved the loft environment and it was well appointed. Bring your own electric jack if you are a foreigner - that's all we needed. Cold water was in the fridge and a light variety of breakfast snacks were a great touch.
I would highly recommend a stay in this loft. Claudia was available to answer any questions we had and even let us arrive early after our travel plans had changed.
Great flat in a perfect location in Lisbon!

Gemütliches Appartement mit vollsonniger Dachterrasse, auf der man besonders am Abend schön sitzen und auf den Fluss schauen kann. Baustelle nebenan leider tagsüber etwas lärmig. Ideale Lage, um die Stadt zu erkunden oder auch Richtung Cascais an einen der Strände zu fahren. Die Gastgeber sind unkompliziert und geben gute Tipps.

We had an amazing stay here. Cláudia and Henrique were so lovely, they gave us lots of recommendations and were very attentive. The apartment was clean, well equipped and in a
great location. The terrace was a highlight - it's a beautiful view! I would highly recommend and would stay here again 😊

We had a great couple days visiting Lisbon. Cláudia and Henrique went above and beyond to make us feel welcomed and offer suggestions to the most authentic parts of the city. Highly recommend staying at their cozy studio, plus you can’t beat the view!
Wonderful place, great view and amazing hosts who greeted us and were really flexible with everything. Amazing!

L’appartement est super charmant, la terrasse est un vrai + avec une vue sur la rivière! Henrique est un hôte au petit soin et nous a donné pleins de bons conseils pour découvrir lisbonne! Je recommande!

The apartment is adorable and perfect for 2 people. It's close to some great restaurants, about 20 min walk to Rossio (train station to Sintra), and about 10 mins to Time Out market. We enjoyed our stay so much. The hosts were communicative and generous with recommendations. Couldn't have asked for more.

Our stay was awesome. Such a lovely appartment in Santos part, where all the cool restaurants, shops and landmarks are closeby! The terrasse with the view on the ocean is also amazing. We had a wonderful time there.
Henrique is a gem! He made a lot of recommendations for restaurants and places to visit.
Would recommend to anyone 100%!

The perfect city pad - we loved the area and ate nearby a couple of times. The views and light in the apartment are incredible and you feel right in the heart of it all. Henrique was so lovely at our welcome and throughout our stay. Stairs are not for the faint hearted.

Claudia and Henrique were a pleasure to work with.  The pictures do the apartment no justice, such an amazing view of the river. Check in was smooth and easy and they communicated great. Highly recommend!

The stay at Claudia and Henrique’s apartment was a delight. It was the perfect place to unwind in between exploring the city. The place was clean, cosy, and welcoming. The views were incredible and the amount of sunlit you can enjoy thanks to the two terraces is unbeatable.

Charming studio loft near green street and waterfront. Lots of cafes right nearby and close access to lots of touristy stuff. The Ubers are really cheap so you can get to Belem Tower or Praca de Comercial pretty quick.
The space is very beautiful and spacious with lots of natural light. Everything is as stated in the ad and the space did not disappoint. We enjoyed Claudia and Henriques collection of fun mugs and DVDs as well.
It is a 4 story walk up and we actually stayed here after moving from our previous apartment so we had 4 suitcases and 2 backpacks so we were exhausted just getting everything up to the top.
That being said Henrique was a hero and power lifted multiple suitcases up the stairs for us! In general him and Claudia were very responsive to our questions and needs (us stupid Americans not knowing how to work the dishwasher or washing machines)
Would definitely stay again.

Our stay at the apartment was really nice and the view over the river is beautiful. Located close to Bairro Alto, there are plenty of bars and restaurants in the surrounding area. Checking in and out was also very easy and the communication was super nice.

Appartement très bien aménagé dans un immeuble authentique avec une superbe vue !
Idéalement situé, très calme et proche de tout, du centre et des transports.
Les hôtes sont très sympathiques, très disponibles et avenants.
Claudia, Enrique, merci pour ce séjour !

Amazing place and hosts!
Great communication and really kind 😉
One word Perfect. Very accommodating helped anyway they could. Would recommend them anyone I know traveling to lisbon

Perfect apartment in all ways… easy to find, close to public transport, and the most amazing views you will find for the price. Right near everything you need downtown and very walkable to places. Apartment has everything you’ll need to cook, wash clothes, and even has dishwasher. Host was very polite and communicative , let us do much earlier check in. 5/5 stars perfect
Worth to stay. Strongly recommend

I really loved this apartment. It was the first Airbnb I came across that felt like home to me since travelling Portugal. It was bright, cozy and I felt safe in that area. Tons of cute cafes and restaurants near by and the hosts are very responsive.

We had an amazing stay in the apartment of Claudia and Henrique and will come back for sure.
The apartment is fully equipped with really everything Someone could ask for - it feels like a real place where people used to live, not like an unpersonal hotel room.
The area is great too and one of our favorites in Lisboa. The 2 !! Balconies have also an amazing view over the tejo River. Most highly recommended!!!
Proprietários muito atenciosos e simpáticos a vista é fenomenal e a casa muito acolhedora

We loved staying at Claudia & Henrique place. The communication was great. The location is SUPERB for exploring Lisbon, getting to train station etc. The flat is very comfortable with a homely feel…home away from home. It’s probably not for anyone who struggles with climbing stairs. We stayed over the weekend and although we acknowledge we were in a busy city it was quite noisy during the night where we could hear the music ( we think from a club but we were unsure). All an all great value for money!

Appartement parfaitement situé pour découvrir Lisbonne, très fonctionnel et d’une propreté irréprochable!
Henrique nous a réservé un superbe accueil, et nous a prodigué des conseils qui nous ont permis de vraiment profiter de notre séjour!
Vraiment aucun point négatif! On recommande vivement!
Coqueto apartamento muy bien situado y muy limpio. Excelente comunicación en nuestro caso con Henrique.

This is an Airbnb to die for. Great, responsive hosts who anticipate needs. The apartment is fully equipped, cozy, and nicely located. You’re not too clustered with all the tourists which is a big plus. I was actually down with a stomach bug for most of my stay, so I couldn’t get to even a fraction of the recommendations made to me by Cláudia and Henrique. However, despite that, I was happy to be cozied up in the place for a few days while I got better. Will book again!

Very good emplacement to visit Lisbonne
Near to Tramway / Subway and restaurants
Henrique is very kind, I recommend without problem 👌🏼👌🏼

Cozy, charming and well-equipped apartment in walkable distance from the city center and near the main station. The apartment is oozing with personality and we really enjoyed the view on the Tejo river from the balcony.
Cláudia and Henrique were very accomodating and always quick to respond. They even prepared a small breakfast kit for us, as we arrived late in the afternoon.
Greatly recommended!!
Great central location and Claudia and Henrique are really helpful, you just need to ask.

Cláudia y Henrique han sido muy amables, y muy pendientes de nosotros. El piso está estupendamente ubicado a pie de todos los lugares turísticos para visitar e impecable en limpieza. Los recomiendo totalmente!!

This is a wonderful property. Great location, fantastic hosts. The 4th floor walk up won’t suit everyone but for those it does the rewards are super. Comfortable, clean, great check in…thank you so much.
La bonne formule par excellence pour un séjour à lisboa. C'est carrément parfait à tous points de vue (accueil, appartement,  conseils, amabilité). A refaire sans aucune hésitation.

The location of the studio is fantastic, you have everything on the doorstep.
Very well equipped you have all you need. I can't fault it. Highly recommend it!
Wonderful apartment! Nice neighbourhood to explore the city! Claudia and henrique are really helpful!

Wow, what a spectacular apartment! Right in the heart of the city makes the stay a quick walk to most areas. The apartment itself is cozy, but not small. Claudia and Henry were extremely accommodating and helpful. I would certainly stay here again. Oh ya... the view!!!
Apartamento em um lugar com tudo próximo! Ótima recepção da a Cláudia e Henrique!! Vale muito a pena!!

Gostamos da nossa estadia no apartamento da Cláudia & Henrique. O apartamento estava conforme anunciado e a comunicação com os anfitriões foi excelente.
Contudo, queremos levantar um ponto negativo (do nosso ponto de vista). A cama. Demasiada mole e alta tendo em conta o pé-direito no quarto.
Great view with big windows and lots of natural light. Fully equipped. Highly recommend.

Great place to stay! Great location! Sweet view of the river. Nicely decorated in bohemian style. Good communication from hosts; also they are super nice. This was not negative for me, but guests should know that staying here requires the negotiation of a few steps. I would be happy to return!!
Nice apartment in a great location
Nos encantó el alojamiento y la zona donde se encuentra. Muy cerca del centro, volveremos!
The apartment is very nice and clean. The location is  perfect with bars, restaurants and cafes nearby. And Claudia is really friendly and uncomplicated.
Totalmente recomendable. Piso adorable y muy bien posicionado.

Claudia and Henrique's place is wonderful! Claudia was extremely communicative and flexible throughout our whole stay- she allowed us to check in early, sent us great recommendations for the area based on what we told her about us- she even offered to make dinner reservations for us since we were traveling prior to arriving in Lisbon. The space is exactly as described- it's perfect for a couple and has a fully stocked kitchen, bath, living space. The ceiling heights are sloped and the bed is in a lofted area which was fine for us, but good to note if you're tall or not able to walk up stairs. The neighborhood is great (close to Time Out Market, lots of bars / restaurants) and easily walkable to the rest of the city.  Since the unit is on the top floor it's very quiet as well, which we appreciated!

Very friendly and responsive hosts! The place is very cute and has it's own quirkiness. Definitely felt like a local staying there. The place is small but very close to the city center (15 min walk) and the party district (10min). The hosts helped us with booking a Fado restaurant! Definitely ask them if they can do it for you, otherwise might be very hard to get in. The entrance to the building is not what it is on the map so do ask them for exact directions before arriving.

Thank you Claudia & Enrique for the amazing experience. Everything was great : the communication, the booking of restaurants and the flat ! Claudia and Enrique are really here to make your stay confortable ! We will come back for sure. Localisation is great as well ! See you soon!
Fabulous top floor flat. Really centrally located. Claudia and Henrique were great hosts, providing recommendations and making some bookings for us. We would stay with them again if back in Lisbon.
Everything was just great. Claudia and Henrique did the very best to make our visit in Lisbon a perfect trip!

Cláudia was such an amazing host. The flat was perfect, and the balcony was amazing. Cláudia even went the extra mile, and made us dinner reservations. She made our first night and stay in Portugal perfect. I would definitely recommend.

Merci pour le séjour. je me suis régalée et j'ai de surcroît très bien dormi..
j'ai apprécié les clins d'oeil à Banksy 👍
Bien cordialement
M.Laure
A very stylish, clean and perfectly central located apartment. Great balconies! Claudia was very helpful.
A perfect place. Claudia is a treasure, and the apartment is so comfortable.
Perfect place to stay to explore Lisbon. The place has everything you need and a great view. Very close to the centre, but quiet at night.
Apt has everything u need. Exactly like photos. Nice roof top views, close to a lot. Best hosts ever

Le séjour était parfait ! Le logement est spacieux, propre et très bien équipé. Bien situé dans la ville, proche de tout, dans un quartier sympa. L'accueil est au top, Henrique est d'une grande gentillesse et de bons conseils. Nous reviendrons c'est sur ! Je recommande fortement !

Great location and nice accommodations. This apartment has anything you would need for your stay. It is within a 20 min walk of many of the best restaurants and bars in Lisbon. The hosts also were great about providing recommendations of places to go.

Highly recommend this Airbnb. Very cute and well kept apartment within 1 mile of commerce square and downtown Lisbon. Beautiful river view and well decorated. Very easy to communicate with the hosts and they were accommodating to our needs.
A beautiful and really cosy flat. We loved the view over the sea!

What an amazing week!
The trip started badly when my girlfriend and I were not allowed on the flight due to incorrect Covid documentation meaning that we had to get the flight much later that day. After telling Cláudia, she booked us a table at an incredible local restaurant which was very kind.
From there the holiday was amazing and the studio is beautiful with a stunning view over the river. I couldn’t recommend more!

Das Apartment ist schön und sehr gut gelegen. In der Nähe sind schöne Restaurants & Bars. Die beiden Balkons sind sehr schön und die Wohnung mit allem nötigen Ausgestattet. Auch ein paar Grundnahrungsmittel und Tee/Kaffe sind vorhanden. Der Check In war sehr angenehm und ohne Probleme. Auf Fragen hat Cláudia immer schnell und hilfreich geantwortet. :)

Claudia and Henrique were the perfect hosts! Always checking in if we needed something and made our vacation just perfect!
The studio also as everything needed for a short or even a long stay
5/5
Everything perfect!

everything was perfect. communication with Claudia and henrique was excellent; they keep their distance but when you need any help/recommendations they help you right away. location is Nice - alfama and barrio alto are walkable. apartment is clean, spacious and the balcony has a nice view. highly recommended.

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour chez Henrique et dans ce top logement avec vu sur la rivière. la communication est excellente avec Henrique. l'appartement est très bien, belle décoration, au pas des très beaux quartiers de Lisbonne, très bon restaurants en bas de la porte, bars etccc. et surtout proche du Métro,  train de banlieue et ferry, franchement ouhaoooooo. allez y sans hésitez, en tt cas nous reviendrons très vite. merci Henrique

un appartement très bien situé dans un bon quartier. Cet appartement est très bien équipé.
la terrasse est vraiment génial. les hôtes essaient toujours de vous arranger.
Je recommande++++
petit nid douillet sous les toits avec vue sur le Tage, bien situé. Séjour agrémenté des conseils sympa et de la disponibilité d'Henrique et Claudia.
Apto increíble muy cuidado con excelentes vistas. Ubicación fenomenal nos encanto volveremos a repetir
Claudia and Henrique are amazing host, very friendly and help you in case you need it. I would definitely recommend it.

Súper recomendable, casa muy acogedora con muy buenas vistas y todo lo necesario.
Henrique nos ayudó muchísimo durante la estancia con sugerencias y recomendaciones, nos trató de 10!
Si volvemos, sin ninguna duda será con ellos.

Super séjour à Lisbonne. L’appartement est propre, fonctionnel, tout pour passer de bons moments. Henrique a pris le temps de nous accueillir et de nous expliquer un peu le quartier. La vue est superbe. L’appartement est tout proche des restaurants, bars et de la grande place proche des magasins. Séjour au top.
An amazing location, ver hospitable and super nice. Can’t wait to come back again.

Great location, nice views. Head room is a bit cramped(appartment is under rooftop) great homely feeling. Super equiped kitchen and stuff(even iron and washing machine, multiple coffee machines) great value. Would visit again
Great location, amazing view and well appointed.  Note the 4th Floor. I would love to visit again!

Probably one of the best Airbnb’s I’ve stayed at. Beautiful view and a very comfortable apartment with all facilities you want. Henrique and Claudia were so friendly and accommodating. I will definitely be back!
Everything was perfect! Location and apartment are great, and the place is very well equipped. The claudia and henrique were super accommodating. Really recommend this place

This appartment just has everything you need! Amazing hosts, amazing location, very clean, everything you need (bathroom, kitchen) and most of all the balcony with an amazing view. Perfect to have a little breakfast or have a drink while enjoying the view and the sun. Also very close to bus, metro etc.
Very helpful hosts: very kind, good tips for restaurants and they answer very fast.
A perfect spot when you want to explore Lisbon!

Appartement parfaitement situé pour découvrir la ville, faire un tour à Belém ou partir à la plage par le train…
Location agréable et vue dégagée sur le Tage !
Henrique est top, parle parfaitement le français et son accueil fut très chaleureux.
PS: n’hésitez pas à faire un tour au Time Out Market à proximité, ainsi qu’à l’Heim Café pour un parfait petit déjeuner avant de partir explorer la ville.

Die Lage war toll, und das Loft einfach super!!
Ich würde Jederzeit wiederkommen.

Everything was great, The flat is homy and full of sunlight and the river view is wonderful

20min walk from center
Definitely recommend !
Thank you so much !
It was a very nice stay with a wonderful view. I will gladly come again. :)
amazing location and views.  cool hosts!

I loved the apartment, it is clean, cozy, super well equiped and Claudia is super nice and comunicates well. Also, the neighborhood of the apartment is perfect in my opinion, near to a lot of beatiful sights Lisbon has to offer. I wish I could've stayed there for a year ;)
We had a great time in Claudia’s flat! It’s a beautiful space in a great location. Claudia was really communicative and gave us great recommendations. Hope to come back again soon!
Enjoyed very much the stay in the apt - the terraces (2) are 90% of the experience and brings daily pleasure to once stay - customer service is also top notch…

Lovely, well equipped apartment, ideally situated in the very heart of Lisbon.
Connections to public transport are excellent and the place makes for a perfect kick-off to a discovery of the city by foot too.
The view from the terrace facing southwards adds to the great overall experience.
I highly recommend Cláudia and Henriques apartment for couples or single travelers.
A lovely and cozy place that is perfect to live and work from. Cláudia and Henrique were super welcoming and very dedicated to make our stay enjoyable. A big plus for the patio and the view.
We loved the teracce and the river view and the whole apartment! Henrique was very helpful and welcoming. So we really recommend.
Best place in Lisbon!
Amazing cozy apartment with a great view. Absolutely recommend staying here if your passing through Lisbon.

Fantastic and cosy little loft / attic style apartment. Very stylish and homely in the way its furnished which makes it feel nice and snug. Has all the usual amenities you need to survive. Great wrap around balcony and nice top floor views of Lisbon. Centrally located with easy access to everything. Perfect spot to experience Lisbon! It is on the top floor so there’s 4 flights of stairs, but stairs are Lisbon’s middle name! And if you’re tall then you’re gonna watch your head. The hosts Claudia and Henrique are the best. Top notch place, would stay again and recommend.
This is a lovely apartment in a great location. The view was wonderful
Very cute apartment in a great location.  Claudia and Henrique are very responsive and helpful with anything you need to know with respect to Lisbon.  I would recommend staying here!
We had a fantastic time working/exploring out of Cláudia & Henrique’s home. They were incredible hosts and have an amazing location. Thank you!

Que dire d’une expérience parfaite ?
Une hospitalité sans égale, un appartement joliment décoré, parfaitement équipé et une super localisation !
