Un grand merci !

I recommend this flat to everyone. Perfect location, perfect communication. The flat is charming and I felt like home all the days I was there.
Thanks Claudia&Henrique !

El apartamento es perfecto para pasar unos días en pareja. La ubicación no está del todo mal, muy cerca del barrio alto y a 15 minutos andando de la Plaza del Comercio. Henrique ha sido un anfitrión MARAVILLOSO, muy atento desde el primer minuto, ayudando en todo (incluso nos reservaba en los restaurante que le pedíamos) y haciendo que la estancia fuese lo más cómoda posible. El apartamento está totalmente equipado, sobre todo en lo referente a  electrodomésticos. Lo recomendaría 100%
Super!

The studio is a beautiful and cozy space with thoughtful touches throughout. Claudia and Henrique are the ever attentive and lovely to converse with. It is also very convenient to most places and located on a a quiet street. And that view! You are going to want to get outside one last time before checking our. I know I did!
Appartement très fonctionnel et agréable. Le balcon est un vrai plus. Les hôtes sont joignables à tout moment et soucieux de la qualité de notre séjour. À faire, à refaire !
We had a lovely stay in the apartment. The balcony is very nice, the kitchen well equipped and the location amazing. We felt very safe and were close the everywhere you want to be in Lisbon.

Everything went ok. The apartment is in a great location with a stunning view to the river.
Not really suitable for two independent travellers but it's perfect for a couple.

Cláudia and Henrique are really nice people and we are really enjoying our trips in Lisbon, the appartement is really well located and the neighborhood is quiet. We hope come back soon when everything back to normal, Lisbon is a really nice city with nice peoples 🙂
We had such a great time in this amazing apartment! :)
It’s an amazing apartment near the city center with some awesome locals nearby. Claudia was always helpful giving us the right suggestions to ensure a memorable experience. Well done!!
Appartement bien équipé et avec une super vue. Possibilité de faire le centre ville de Lisbonne tout à pied. Je recommande.

Saying Claudia is a “superhost” is not just an AirBnB title. She actually tries to make every guest’s life a little easier and comfy (AC in apartment, coffee, DVDs!). And in our case Claudia was like a friend who helped us with timely check-in and very comfortable check-out despite that we had to delay it.
I know unexpected late check-outs could be a problem sometimes, because of cleaning, or someone may ask for earlier check-in. And I have a big respect for this help.

This place is a MUST STAY! There are two balconies, both with a beautiful view of the river. The space is small but extremely thoughtfully designed, with lots of fun touches prioritizing space, storage, and views! Very comfortable for a couple, nice big shower, and great fully outfitted kitchen. They were having a couple troubles with the toilet and fridge when we arrived but they did absolutely everything to make sure we were unaffected — great hosts and a perfect space! A travelers refuge!
Very nice flat in a good district. Close to transports, and we feel very good in the flat. I highly recommend it !!! 👌👍
super séjour, j'ai adoré le lieu et l'accueil!!

The apartment is really beautiful, and has a very nice balcony with a view on the river. The location is perfect, close to Cais de Sodre. Claudia answered very fast and helped us with every question. In the apartment you will find everything you need. We had bad luck with some of the facilities as the big fridge didn't work (we used a small one instead) and the sink had a crack that broke shortly after. But Claudia did her best, and we would highly recommend the apartment and the host!
Appartement bien situé dont nous n'avons pu qu'à moitié profiter en période de covid-19.
Everything perfect. We enjoyed our stay. If we come back to Lisbon we know where to book again ;)
Nice place with a nice view. The central location of the apartment is perfect ! We recommend !

Before and during our stay, the communication with Henrique was superb. He quickly answered and always asked to provide more information when needed.
The accomodation is like the pictures showed it. It is well located, has (more than) everything that needed, is clean and has a very nice and sunny roof terrace (due to workings currently not that quiet in the morning). We also got a big list of tips and what-to-do in and around Lisboa. Recommended!

The flat was perfect for our weekend in Lisbon, it's a cool flat with a very nice modern bathroom with a big shower and also a very well equipped kitchen with so many appliances! Cláudia and Henrique were great hosts, giving us lots of very useful recommendations for the city and always responding very quickly. The flat is in a good location, walkable (or cycle-able) to all the main sights.

L'appartement est très bien situé, un accueil chaleureux de l'hôte avec une petite attention pour le petit déjeuner. Très réactive en cas de soucis, et de très bonne adresse. Logement propre, belle vue, et proche de tout. Très bon séjour.

Claudia and Henrique made an early check-in possible, gave us lots of tips and answered every of our questions. The apartment is lovely, very well equipped with everything you want (Nespresso machine with capsules, breakfast tray with milk, juices, marmalade and cereals, enough toilet paper, even a blender was there!) We loved the view on the two balconies
We had an amazing stay at Claudia and Henrique's place. The view from the balcony over the river was amazing and they were super helpful with any tips on where to go and what to see.
Henrique est très arrangeant, attentionné et de bon conseil, et l appartement charmant est idéalement placé ! Séjour parfait grâce à Henrique
Muy recomendable para visitar lisboa en pareja y tener un espacio donde sentirte como en casa
Really great fun had, thanks !

Bien situé et belle vue. Très propre et belle accueille.
Petit ballon d’eau chaude, pas terrible en hiver. Étant grand le lieu est très mansardé. Je recommande l’été, il doit être plus agréable.

Apartamento muy acogedor y muy bonito, con una ubicación ideal, cerca del centro, bien comunicado y con un montón de servicios cercanos útiles y de calidad.
Claudia y Henrique fueron muy hospitalarios en la llegada y disponible en caso de surgir imprevistos.
En definitiva, repetiría sin ninguna duda!

Amazing stay - would highly recommend! Claudia was an extremely helpful host and responded to questions almost instantly every time. Check in was smooth, and all facilities for a homely stay were provided. We loved the space (though if you're clumsy you might find it a bit difficult to get used to the pillars, stairs to the bed, and the slanting roofs). The location was good too - it is in a gentrified area so although the immediate surroundings are not the prettiest parts of the city, it is a short distance to all the tourist parts. And lots of trendy places to eat at very close by too! Definitely perfect for a young couple who don't mind lots of stairs to climb and want fantastic value for money.
I had an amazing stay at Cláudia & Henrique’s place. Extremely friendly, kind and helpful when it comes to local tips. All in all they for sure made the visit to Lisbon a whole lot more pleasant:)
I would recommend the apartment to everybody who would like to have a nice stay at Lisbon.
房东非常友善。地理位置不用说了，到哪里都很方便。房间虽小，但是很干净，光线设计的也很好，视野很开阔，另外，设施也很齐全，做饭什么的都很方便。房东可以再准备几双洗澡时用的拖鞋，和扎头发用的皮筋儿，就更完美啦😁

La casa estupenda y en una zona óptima para ver Lisboa, Henrique una persona muy amable y dispuesta para ayudar a tener una estancia inolvidable. Nos quedamos 3 días yo y mi marido para y todo fue perfecto.

Das Appartement hat uns sehr gut gefallen, besser als erwartet! Die Begrüßung durch die Gastgeber war sehr herzlich und nett, ebenso wie die weiteren Tipps während unseres Aufenthalts. :)
Das Apartment bietet alles was man braucht, wir fühlten uns pudelwohl.
Die Lage mitten in Lissabon ist auch 1a, man erreicht sämtliche öffentliche Verkehrsmittel in wenigen Minuten ebenso wie tolle Bars und Restaurants. Sehr zu empfehlen.
Cool apartment with everything you would need, great outdoor space

Cláudia and Henrique were super friendly and welcoming with great suggestions for Lisbon.
Very lovely apartment.
Henríque muy atento y muy amable, nos explicó sitios que visitar y muy bien

Very cozy apartment supplied with everything needed for a comfortable staying. Really nice terrace with beautiful view on the river. Good location in a walking distance to metro and train station as well as to Bairro Alto a vibrant area of Lisbon. Henrique and Claudia are great hosts! Very helpful and provide you with all information about places to go. Definitely recommend to stay at this lovely apartment.

Amazing place! This loft was a great space to relax in, with a beautiful view. It is on the 4th floor with lots of stairs, but soooo worth it!! 10/10 hospitality, with recommendations for the area :)
Would recommend everyone to stay here!

Cláudia & Henrique have a truly cozy abode in Lisbon. It is well furnished, offers a beautiful view to the waterfront and is within walking distance of the old town. I would highly recommend this apartment for anyone wishing to stay for a few days in the beautiful city of Lisbon!

Henrique was an amazing host; he met us at the apartment, helped us to get acquainted with the best spots to go to in Lisbon, and stayed in constant communication to make sure our trip was the best. The apartment itself was super clean, well-located, and a great space for 2. Be careful not to bonk your head on the angles and enjoy the amazing balcony!
We loved the apartment, perfectly located, everything we could have needed & gracious hosts!

Sehr freundliche und entgegenkommende Gastgeber. Das Apartment war sehr nett, die Lage zentral mit einem schönen Blick auf den Tejo. Wir habe uns sehr wohlgefühlt und Lissabon genossen. Eine wunderbare Stadt.

Nous sommes restés 4 nuits .L' appartement est très bien situé . Il est calme , agréable, lumineux.Très bons conseils de Henrique qui est très réactif. Attention juste pour les personnes de grande taille car beaucoup de soupentes! .Je recommande.
Remarque : Lisboa est une ville à faire à pieds , prévoir des chaussures adaptées aux petits pavés qui peuvent être glissants!

Really cool space. Very comfortable. They were great hosts who had tons of great recommendations and bent over backwards to make my check-in and check-out as painless as possible. Very accommodating. I did bang my head on the angled ceilings a few times but it’s a cool and creative space. I recommend it.
Appartement très bien situé avec une vue très sympa sur le Tage. Un quartier agréable loin du bruit et de la foule mais en restant proche des moyens de transport et des lieux à visiter.
From the very first contact Claudia and Henrique were so helpful and kind. Helping with reservations and generally amazing hosts. Apartment lovely and fantastic location

Claudia & Henrique's apartment is cosy, stylish and located perfectly for exploring Lisbon. A few weeks before our trip we received some great local tips from Claudia which were perfect for planning our few days away. On arrival we received a text from Henrique and he directed us to the apartment. Our flight arrived late in the evening but Henrique greeted us at the apartment and had a map ready for the best places to eat for our dinner. Plus we were also provided with some breakfast goodies after our late arrival.
Their recommendations were superb and local tips for best view points were very accurate.
The apartment itself is great, uninterrupted view of the river which can seen throughput the apartment or enjoyed from the balcony. It was cosy and clean with a fantastic shower. The mezzanine bedroom with it sloped ceilings and creative storage facilities was all we needed for our few days stay. The bed was lovely and comfy with clean bedding and towels provided.
The apartment had a lovely welcoming feel to it and I think this was down to the hospitality that was given to us from our booking to arrival to departure by both Claudia and Henrique. I get spot to stay.
.
位置不能再好，附近有个time out market. 营业到凌晨二点，永远不用担心一日三餐，象个大食堂一样。家里厨房设备齐全，我们是自己在家做了二天伙食的。房东亲自接待我们讲解房间电灯及其他。当地的，tips 也很管用。最好的房东，美丽的里斯本。
Perfect place- beautiful space, excellent view, in the middle of everything; Henrique and Claudia provided many helpful suggestions, and communication / ease of process was excellent.

We had a wonderful stay at Cláudia & Henrique's place! The apartment itself is as lovely as the pictures, and Henrique met us to check in upon our arrival with some helpful tips. It's a great appartment. Tastefully furnished, cosy and welcoming. And quiet. The location can't be better - it's near all sights as well as the evening and night life scene. The view of the river is fascinating. And the hosts, Claudia and Enrique are real sweethearts - hospitable, friendly and helpful with everything. They made us feel welcome and at home.  We enjoyed every minute of our 5-day stay in the appartment and in Lisbon. We highly recommend it.

Es ist eine sehr gemütliche, helle Wohnung, mit schönem Ausblick und praktischer Ausstattung. Es ist alles da, was man braucht. Great care given by our hosts. They were a great help in suggesting restaurants , attractions , uber service. Etc..
. Very reliable during our whole stay. The view was worth it. This place is well priced
Wonderful place to stay. Perfect for a couple traveling and want a Lisbon location centrally located with an amazing view. Highly recommend!

Eine schöne Dachgeschosswohnung. Alles war sauber und wie in der Beschreibung angegeben. Der Check-in und die weitere Kommunikation war super. Would highly recommend! Great place, great host, great value. Claudia and Henrique went out of their way to provide additional amenities and recommendations that made our trip even that much better as well! We enjoyed our stay very much.
Amazing view near everything in a peaceful and quiet area. Perfect place to retire to after a day in town

Bon séjour. Appartement confortable.
Au 4ème étage sans ascenseur. Quartier bien situé
Un loft precioso, y la hospitalidad de los propietarios una maravilla. Repetiremos sin duda

We loved staying here! It is very central (close to the metro and bus terminals and food markets). The view is to die for and the place is equipped with everything you need. Cláudia and Henrique were very friendly and were invested in making sure you enjoy all that Lisbon has to offer.

The lovely loft will definitely add some points to your Lisbon trip!!! Everything was perfect. Location was great, one min to the bus station. Sparkling clean! And there’s an amazing postcard collection all over the world. Cool! Probably for a couple, double bed may be a little bit small but it’s okay for us two girls. Highly recommend it!!!!

Henrique y Claudia fueron unos anfitriones muy atentos, cuidan todos los detalles del apartamento al máximo, se preocuparon porque nuestra estancia, tanto en Lisboa como en su apartamento fuera perfecta.
Dejan productos para el desayuno por si no te da tiempo a comprar, tienes todo lo necesario en el baño, en la cocina, y el resto de estancias.
Nos hicieron muchísimas recomendaciones para Lisboa.....

La terraza y las vistas hacia el Río Tajo, son una maravilla.
Resumiendo, un alojamiento y unos anfitriones muy recomendables.
Gracias por todo!!

Charmant loft pour 2 personnes, sous les toits avec vue sur le Tage. La déco est jeune et sympa. Loft très bien conçu et très bien équipé. Très lumineux, triple orientation. Clim utile. 2 balcons atypiques. Cláudia & Henrique sont très réactifs par mail (nous n'avons pas eu besoin de les joindre pendant le séjour mais avant pour le préparer) et arrangeants. Allez-y sans hésitation!

Amazing apartment right in the heart of Lisbon, with a great balcony to enjoy the sunshine.
Henrique was incredibly accomodating and helpful with local tips!
Can’t wait to return!
Amazing hosts and can’t beat the location

We had a nice stay in Lissabon . Location is perfect , nearby bus , tram. We had everything we needed in the appartement .
We received good tips .
Good communication with Claudia and Henrique.

Super séjour passé chez Henrique & Claudia qui sont à l'écoute et de bons conseils.
Le logement est tout à fait conforme aux photos et très bien équipé. Je le recommande vivement.
Great location and wonderful hosts. Greats hints where to eat and what to do. All important sights are in walking distance. All in all we really recommend this appartment!

Sublime appartement au dernier étage à Lisbonne proche de tout !
Magnifique vue sur le Fleuve !
Les hôtes sont super sympa, très réactifs et d’excellents conseils ! Je recommande a tout point de vue !

By far the best thing about Claudia's place is the long wrap around balcony you can sit out on in the sun and enjoy the fantastic view of the water. It feels very private.
Claudia has thought of everything including espresso coffee and a mini breakfast basket! So nice!!
Tall people, this is a loft and has low ceilings - my fiance bashed his head against the ceiling approx 10x - he's a slow learner and 177cm tall. I'm 172cm and didn't have a problem.

Located in the centre of Lisbon, the studio of Cláudia & Henrique is a great spot to start exploring the city. Supermarket, bakery and restaurants are near and a bus and tram stop can be found 20m away.
Lovely view from the balcony, in a good location.
Den vorangegangenen Bewertungen kann ich nichts hinzufügen. Die Lage ist einfach super.

Stay here. Just do it. You will be so happy you did. It was truly one of my favorite Airbnbs. Such a charming building. The apartment was so comfortable and the view spectacular! Claudia was very helpful and accommodating. Seamless check-in. Thank you, Claudia.

Cláudia and Henrique's place is a total gem. Before we arrived, they provided us with all sorts of recommendations and places to check out in Lisbon. The apartment is exactly as shown in the pictures. Cláudia and Henrique even gave us a few great recommendations in our next stop, Porto. Awesome apartment, awesome hosts. Would not hesitate to book again next time we visit!!
Awesome! Loft ist great, good location,great people! We will come back!
A lovely stylish place with a gorgeous view! Highly recommended!

This apartment was brilliant. It was light, clean and spacious and the view from the balcony was lovely.
The location of the apartment is great, near the metro and tram 28 as well as plenty of restaurants, bars and the time out market. Its also a really safe area and we enjoyed walking around exploring.
Claudia is the best host we've had, she gave us plenty of brilliant recommendations for while we were in Lisbon, and booked us in at a place with traditional fado music that was a really fun night. She also left us a bottle of wine which was a really nice surprise, as well as a breakfast basket and pods for the coffee machine. We definitely wouldn't hesitate to visit this apartment again.

Logement très bien situé et très agréable ! Claudia et Henrique ont été très réactifs et très à l’écoute. Ils donnent beaucoup de conseils, leur accueil et leur disponibilité ont été tops :) N’hésitez pas!
Tolle Lage, schöne kleine Dachwohnung, nette Gastgeber
Absolutely brilliant! Great location, lovely apartment and the best hosts one could ask for!

We had a fantastic time in Lisbon not only but also because of the real nice apartment we had the privilege to stay at.
Obviously Claudia & Henrique created a very cosy and beautiful place, equipped with everything you might need in order to have an easy and comfortable stay. We arrived quite late on a saturday night and still received a warm welcome and a good introduction on the apartement but also for our trip in Lisbon.
The roof deck is definitely the stand out of the apartement and serves great for enjoying your late afternoon drink after a long sightseeing or shopping trip and also it's nice to have your morning coffee out there combined with a nice view on the Tejo river.
The location of the apartement is perfect for discovering the inner city of Lisbon, it's close to the Barrio Alto neighbourhood, the main station is nearby and all sorts of amazing restaurants, bars and stores are in short walking distance. We'll definitely come back!
The place and the hosts are perfect. It's that simple. Book it till it's available ;)
Si vous venez à Lisbonne, c est ici que vous devez vous arrêter. Emplacement parfait, des hôtes toujours disponible, un appartement charmant et spacieux. Merci à vous, ce fût un sejour parfait !
Chez Claudia et Henrique, c'est chaleureux, coloré, propre, équipé et très bien placé. Vous serez accueillis avec beaucoup de bienveillance. Nous recommandons sans hésiter.

This place was in a great location and there was cheap parking just across the railroad tracks.  We loved it.   Really fun view of the river.  One tiny issue is that you can hear the club music at night.  Super loud with windows are open but not too crazy when closed.

Plenty of nice places to eat out, when you want to do so. Also good museums and galleries nearby.
River view is a very big plus, and the busy street is further away, so the traffic does not bother.

All in all: lots of light, small but well functioning, cosy. Excelent location. What more could you want? Even exercise comes with the package (5. floor, stairs)!
Obrigada!
Great location downtown near the waterfront and the metro.  The place has great views and it's location makes getting around and seeing sights fairly easy.

Beautiful apartment with a great view and in an awesome location! I honestly plan on staying in this Airbnb again not only because of the place itself, but because Cláudia & Henrique are such amazing hosts. They helped make my stay in Lisbon one that I will never forget with their great recommendations, and just overall hospitality and kindness.
Lovely apartment and couple! Exceeded expectations with flexibily and kindness. Claudia is also an excellent tour guide with stellar recommendations to make the most of your trip.
Ubicación, limpieza, fácil comunicación.... todo genial. Muy recomendable.

Super accueil bel appartement près de tout
Bravo

Muy recomendable!
The apartment is in a great location and Cláudia & Henrique provided very good tips for local places to eat and drink.

Super gemütliches Apartment mit toller Lage und wunderschönem Ausblick. Wir haben die Sonne auf dem Balkon sehr genossen. Claudia und Henrique sind sehr bemüht um ihre Gäste und jederzeit zu erreichen. Das Apartment ist nur zu empfehlen!

What a lovely suite!  As advertised, this place is stylish comfortable and central to everything in beautiful Lisbon. The wonderful hosts Claudia and Henrique’s went above and beyond in their caring and hospitality. You won’t be disappointed.

The studio was very lovely, and it was very tastefully furnished and decorated. It was so clean and comfortable with its bedroom, sitting room, bathroom, fully equipped kitchen and the small balcony with a beautiful view of the river. It’s in a very quiet district and you hear no noise from the street. Cláudia & Henrique were so friendly and helpful, giving me local tips and advises where and how to go, what to do, where to eat, not only in Lisbon, but also for Sintra and Porto I have been after Lisbon.

The location is great, walking distance to everything you want to see  in the city.  The apartment is also very clean and cozy with a spectacular view for goldan hour.  The resturaunt around the apartment are amazing also, some of the best food I had in all of Portugal.  The only isssue is either there is either a bar right next to the apartment or someone  likes to play loud music in the apartment complex because at night there was frequently loud music,  but it didn’t necessarily bother me (I just used ear plugs).

This apartment was lovely! it's got a cozy loft feel and is in a great location for getting around town! It's a perfect size flat for 2 people and the balcony is perfect for your morning tea. Great people, great place, great location. Can't go wrong with this lovely apartment.

This attic apartment is what makes Airbnb a great option to travel. Lot's of personality on the objects and decoration. Comfortable sofa and bed. Coffe machine and tea was a nice amenity. Beautiful loft with river view and nice area which was full of good restaurants, bars and cafes. Trully recommend this place. And super careful and nice host I've ever met.
excelent

Great place with a view and I felt like I could walk to everything. Hosts were very responsive and even met to greet us upon arrival!

Fantastic hosts and their apartment is stylish with a great deck with a view! location is a short walk to tons of things to do. they provided us with a huge list of suggestions and are very pleasant people who communicated very well.

Un joli studio sous les toits avec une déco ludique, des hôtes attentifs et accueillants, une vue sur le Tage au 4e étage et près du Mercado de Ribeira (Time Out Market) pour se régaler. Nous avons adoré y séjourner!
Great spot. Great hosts, friendly & flexible. Perfect for 1 or couple. Clean & compact & has everything you need.
I loved my stay here. The calming views of the water, the quiet of being on the top floor, the rain shower...it was all wonderful.

We liked the appartment very much. Cláudia and Henrique are perfect host and were very helpful in spite of our late arrival and very early check-in. Cláudia’s guide to Lisbon is better than any tour book and the location is great with a river view, good transportation and really tasty Time Out Market nearby.
Sehr nette und aufmerksame Gastgeber. Das Appartment hat alles und noch ein bisschen mehr als was man benötigt.

There is nothing to complain! 100% recommendable!

Cláudia & Henrique were fab hosts, they couldn’t have done more for us... from greeting us in the early hours to accommodate our late flight to sending across many top tips to make sure our trip was the best it could be. Thank you! Faye & Jon x

Schicke Wohnung mit super Blick. Super nette Eigentümer mit ganz vielen tollen Tipps. Die Wohnung ist zentral gelegen, so dass die Innenstadt und das Flussufer auch ganz einfach zu Fuß erkundet werden können.

Logement très bien équipé et parfaitement placé pour découvrir Lisbonne

Great location ! There are charming cafes and restaurants in the neighborhood.

Claudia and Henrique provided a wonderful stay for us during the 2nd leg of our 4-part honeymoon adventure. Henrique was extremely accommodating to our arrival time, and went above and beyond to ensure a wonderful welcome to their beautiful City of Lisbon! The space itself is just as advertised, very cool looking! Almost like you're at the top of a ship! Very thoughtful stylings, and interesting use of space, coupled with a cool deck that provides a few spots to enjoy the outdoors as a nice respite from our wild-paced activities. Henrique was a pleasure to be greeted by, and was able to provide us with resources to better explore the City, along with answering some of our most pressing questions, and confirming a few spots we felt were worth visiting -- to me a great host with knowledge of the City is as valuable as the unit itself -- a reason AirBnB is so great! The unit is at the top of the building so it's a bit of a haul if you have heavy luggage, but we honestly welcomed it since we ate and drank so many things it was so nice to get a micro workout each time ha. Cláudia & Henrique were fantastic hosts. They were very helpful with local tips - what to see and where to eat. The apartment is perfect, with a nice big balcony where you can enjoy the view out over the river.

Claudia and Henrique's apartment is beautiful. It's in a super quiet part of town but within walking distance of anywhere you need to be. They were awesome and always available to answer questions and give recommendations about things to do in the city. 11/10 would recommend.

Cozy, fun apartment in a very convenient location to get around the city. Also has a great balcony with a view of the river. But most importantly, Henrique and Claudia were amazing hosts with lots of great tips!

We had a wonderful time in the apartment! It is an excellent location close to everything but just far enough away from busy touristy centers. The view of the river from

Notre séjour a été fabuleux grâce à Claudia et Henrique qui ont été particulièrement intentionnés à notre égard.

Strategic area close to all the main spots, but slightly far off the centre; wise choice to also get some sleep at night.
Check-in and check-out times super comfortable and flex.
Will come back again.

Après une arrivée nocturne (2h heure locale) Henrique nous a accueilli avec le sourire, nous a présenté l’appartement et a même pris le temps de nous donner quelques infos sur Lisbonne et différents lieux où se rendre pour profiter de la capitale Portugaise. La verdad todo tal y como nos lo imaginamos. Recomendable 100%

This place was a gem! Great location, central but tucked away in a little side alley. The apartment had all the amenities we could think of and our hosts were great, super helpful and wonderful people. We got a lot of great local tips as well. Thoroughly recommend!
Appartement très bien situé, pour 2 personnes. Enrique nous à accueilli et nous à donné de bons conseils, merci à Claudia pour la réservation à la soirée Fado, très bonne adresse !

Bel appartement, très agréable et bien situé. On y reviendra volontiers !

Fred.

Accueil chaleureux, conseils avisés, localisation idéale, appartement propre et sympa.....

Zentral gelegenes Appartement. Vor allem der Time-Out Market ist zu Fuss schnell erreichbar und ein absolutes Muss in Lissabon. ÖV ist ebenfalls in unmittelbarer Nähe.
Das Appartement ist sauber und perfekt für einen Städtetrip. Claudia & Henrique geben viele wertvolle tipps und sind tolle und unkomplizierte Gastgeber.

This apartment had everything we could possibly need, plus a fantastic location - close to everything but far enough away from restaurants and bars  to make it easy to sleep! Claudia & Henrique were helpful and accommodating, and genuinely welcoming ambassadors to Lisbon. We had a great time!

Die Verkehrsanbindung ist super, keine Minute entfernt kann man in die Tram 28 steigen, die Metro ist nicht weit, man kann aber auch sehr gut zu Fuß los. Ganz in der Nähe der Time Out Market und schöne kleine Restaurants. Die Wohnung selbst ist sehr nett und persönlich eingerichtet, sie war sehr sauber und wir haben uns wirklich wohl gefühlt.
Sie ist mit allem Wichtigem ausgestattet, Handtücher und Bettwäsche ebenso wie Fön, Shampoo oder sogar Kaffee und Tee. Claudia und Henrique haben uns mit vielen guten Tipps versorgt, wir würde die Wohnung jederzeit gerne wieder buchen.

The apartment is very close to the 'hot spots' and also very nice restaurants and bars. The view over the river is just amazing! With Claudia and Henrique as hosts you are very lucky because they have so many really great tipps and are really caring.
Awesome days in beautiful Lisboa!

Le studio de Claudia et Henrique est bien situé. Il y a tout le confort nécessaire et il est propre. Il faut monter 4 étages mais la récompense est à la clé. Nous avons rencontré le sympathique Henrique qui s'est montré disponible, il parle couramment Français. Je recommande ce logement.

Claudia & Henrique were amazing hosts!
Their apartment was exactly as stated, modern, clean, great air conditioning, superb location.
Additionally, they were extremely understanding when our flight was late to arrive (and therefore we were late to check in).
And, they sent us the most comprehensive tips for exploring the city, it made the whole experience outstanding!

We had an amazing stay in Claudia & Henrique’s apartment. It’s in a great location nearby good restaurants and transport links. The balcony was great for enjoying local wine and bread. Check in was easy and was given lots of tips. Will stay again.
Schöner Aufenthalt, zentrale Wohnung, super Dachterrasse, flexible Gastgeber :)

Wir hatten ein perfektes verlängertes Wochenende in Lissabon. Die Wohnung von Cláudia und Henrique ist super gelegen. Ruhig und doch sehr zentral. Einige Hotspots sind in ca. 10min zu Fuß zu erreichen. Ebenso die Tram, Metro oder Zug. Den ersten Kaffee morgens haben wir auf der Dachterrasse mit Blick auf den Fluss Tejo genossen. Der Kontakt zu Cláudia und Henrique war immer super, sehr schnell, sehr herzlich und zuverlässig. Schon im voraus haben uns die beiden mit guten Tips versorgt. Am Tag der Ankunft hat uns Henrique persönlich begrüßt uns die Wohnung gezeigt und uns noch viele unserer Fragen zu Unternehmungen in Lissabon beantwortet.
Derzeit wird in unmittelbarer Nähe gebaut. Die Arbeiten beginnen aber erst morgens um 08:00 Uhr und wer Lissabon sehen will ist dann auch schon wach. Am Wochenende ruht die Baustelle.
Wir würden auf jeden Fall wieder kommen.

Un super séjour à Lisbonne chez Henrique et Cláudia! L'appartement est très bien situé, nous avons pu tout faire à pied. Situé au dernier étage, il est au calme. Si vous venez en voiture, un parking à 3€ la journée  (gratuit à partir de 19h et le week end) est à 10 min de l'appartement (juste à côté de l'arrêt de train Santos). Henrique nous a très bien reçu, avec beaucoup de conseils, de suggestions de restaurants et une petite attention locale très appréciable! Il a été également très réactif à nos questions pendant le séjour, on l'en remercie beaucoup!

Cláudia and Henrique have a phenomenal apartment in an ideal location to offer with stunning views, thoughtful amenities, and great local food and coffee shops within less than a 5 minute walk. Still, their seamless communication, extra touches, and personal recommendations are what really put this Airbnb experience over the top. They even gave us advice for our further travels in Portugal, helping us select a good restaurant in Porto and even making the reservation for us, ahead of time. By far the best Airbnb experience I've had - and I use it a lot. If you're considering staying there, you won't be disappointed. Thanks again!

Very nice apartment in a good location which easy access to transport, great amenities and good contact with the hosts. The hosts provided tips and recommendations of restaurants/bars/attractions. We really enjoyed our stay here

Sono due Host fantastici ci hanno riempito di informazioni
Casa bellissima in un quartiere tranquillo ma con splendidi locali in cui bere e mangiare vicinissimo al Time Out regno gourmet!!
Non perdete l’opportunità di visitare Lisbona partendo dalla loro cada!!!

A fabulous place to stay in Lisbon.  Quirky, trendy, tasteful roof conversion very close to the old town centre, bars, restaurants, Fado bars and nightlife.  Very light and airy with two small balconies with seating, and river views.  Compact but also really comfortable with everything you need.  Fabulous shower!   The hosts are really helpful, sent loads of information and suggestions and offer to help making plans.  They booked us a great evening in a local Fado bar, the Tasca do Chico, frequented by locals as well as tourists, for an authentic Fado experience (but don’t go looking there for great food or wine!), but a highlight of our trip.  There is a climb upstairs when you arrive, but if you can’t cope with steps, don’t come to Lisbon🙂 would unhesitatingly recommend it and would return if we ever visit Lisbon again.

Henrique and Claudia were very accommodating allowing us to check in early. Henrique was very welcoming on the first day we met him.
We both really liked the location of the apartment as it wasn’t in the central tourist area but in a very manageable walking distance, it was very close to the Time Out market.
The studio itself was spacious downstairs, the bedroom upstairs was however very tight. Check - out was easy we just left the keys behind us and closed the door.

Perfekte kleine Wohnung, die Gegend ist sehr ruhig bietet aber sehr gute Restaurants die man in dem Zentrum eher seltener findet (Tipp der Gastgeberin: Petescaria Ideal!!!!) 10min zu Fuß ins Zentrum war uns die Ruhe in dem apartment wert, der Blick von der Dachterrasse wird nur etwas von einer großen und etwas lauten Baustelle gegenüber getrübt... die Jungs fangen morgens an und hören abends auf.
Der Kontakt und die Gastgeber waren sowas von unglaublich nett, hilfreich und zuverlässig, das habe ich in der Form auf Airbnb noch nicht erlebt.
Apartment bietet alles was man braucht (sogar einen nEspresso Maschine)) und ist 3min vom Time out food market weg... zum Zug nach Belem sind es wenige fussschritte.
Alles in allem empfehlenswert und ich würde wieder hingehen.
Exactly as promised + the bed is more comfy than it looks and great sound proof windows - 5 stars!

Hôtes exceptionnels. Très réactif, logement idéal pour un couple
Très bien situé, en plein centre de Lisbonne et proche des transports en commun.
A notre arrivée nous avons eu pleins de conseils ainsi qu une bouteille de vin et de la confiture maison. On recommande !!
Delightful and quirky flat with a rare outside space overlooking the river.  Well equipped, good location and thoughtful and helpful hosts.

Claudia & Henrique are probably among the best Air BnB hosts we've ever had! (very fast communication, super flexible on check-in/check-out, tons of local adresses, tons of goodies upon arrival and super friendly!). The apartment is just perfect to visit Lisbon (just a couple of minutes to Cais do Sodre / Time Out Market, clean, great river view, centrally located, nice atmosphere, nice terrasse, etc). Many thanks to both of you,  that was a perfect stay! :)

The apartment was amazing! The balcony and view was very nice, and there was a great collection of DVDs to watch as well. Loved all of the light in the home and art it was really cozy, clean, and charming! The hosts sent us great tips for places to go around Lisbon, and they answered right away whenever we had a question or needed help! Overall a great stay and would love to come back!
This place is outstanding. The place is clean and the hosts are friendly. Definitely recommend for anyone who's staying in Lisbon!
Very lovely flat with a nice view. Claudia and Henrique are great hosts.

Claudia & Henrique's place is beautiful! Very close to the central of town and really good location too. It is still quiet and very peaceful. They have a Nespresso Machine! We enjoyed a cup of coffee on their balcony, with the view of the ocean.
In terms of white goods, this is the best air bnb I have stayed in terms of plates, kitchen stuff, tea + coffee. It was really well stocked.

Très bon accueil. Très propre et confortable. Bien situé par rapport au centre. Bel appartement.
Ne pas avoir peur de monter les escaliers et ne pas être sensible aux bruits extérieurs (chantiers, musique ).

I highly suggest this apartment.  It is in a great location and easy to get to from the airport.  Quick walking distance to the TimeOut market, the trains, and many central spots.  The apartment was clean, stylish, and we were more than happy with our stay.  The balconies are a huge plus too. The hosts are very friendly and helpful in taking the time to help with recommendations.  They were easy to get ahold of and went out of their way to ensure our stay was great.
Tutto ok, comunicazione ottima.

The house is quite clean and comfortable, and the reception is quite warm and practical, also you can walk to almost everywhere you may wanna go. I will strongly recommend to choose this lovely place and you won’t regret.

Really great place, lovely to see the river and so well located for walking around the city. I’m 1.84m though and I did find the apartment ceilings a little low after staying for a week, but for a few days, or a shorter person, I would certainly recommend.

This was one of my favorite Airbnb bookings because Cláudia & Henrique went above and beyond in welcoming me and the space was so wonderful. The views, amenities, location, aesthetics, and style were all superb.

Mi estancia en el apartamento ha sido genial y tengo que decir que mi mejor experiencia en airbnb hasta ahora. Todo limpisimo y nuevo, a 10 minutos caminando del metro y a un paso de Barrio Alto. En la zona hay un monton de restaurantes ,bares de copas y un mercado. A resaltar tambien las vistas desde la terraza de la casa. Una pena no haber alargado unos dias mas la estancia pero volvere.
Super appartement avec une terrasse très agréable. Henrique fût très attentionné et toujours disponible.
Claudia and Henrique are awesome! We had an amazing time in their Appartment and were quite sad to leave.
Je vous le conseille si vous souhaitez passer un week-end ou une semaine à 2

Claudia and Henrique’s place was the perfect home base to explore Lisbon. Very centrally located in Bairro Alto, near Time Out Market and many other amazing restaurants and attractions. The apartment had a unique style and the balcony overlooking the Tagus River is sweet. Just a really cool, well designed loft! Both Claudia and Henrique were phenomenal hosts who checked in to make sure all was good, gave great suggestions/recommendations, and were just lovely. I highly recommend this beautiful home in beautiful Lisbon. Obrigado!

Great stylish apartment located in a cool area. It is a little hard to find but once you find it and settle in you realize how close to everything you are.  It is a 5-10 min walk to the nars and restaurants in baixa and about 15min walk to placa de commercio.

Great place, great views from the river.
The hosts were very kind and attentive to detail. We are thinking about coming back!
Excellent, there is really nothing to ameliorate. Claudia and Henrique were super nice, helpful, reactive and the apartment is a jewel! I will go back and definitely stay again with them!
Excellent location, excellent appartment and the most amazing host ever!
特别特别棒！满分推荐！房东很耐心的给你介绍各种路线 贴心的准备好了当地正宗餐厅  酒吧 特别是家旁边有一个无敌惊喜便宜又好吃 我们同行两个人都是学厨的 步行到TimeoutMarket就几分钟 简直是厨子的天堂 每天都要去 离地铁站也方便 每天一推开自己房间阳台 可以看到超美海景 舒服的Loft. 唯一个人觉得一点不完美是二楼客房的灯光是白色的 如果换成暖光就更完美了

Perfect location right next to the city center. Lots of restaurants close by, Metro is 5-10 min walk.
They have a small balcony perfect for breakfast outside in the sun.
Claudia & Henrique were the perfect hostess and even so helpful to call some restaurants to make reservations!
I would definitely recommend everyone to stay here.

- Mexican, hip, beers - pistola y corazon t aquaria
- Pizza, wood fire - restaurant Casanova
- Portugees, best food we had - Petiscaria ideal
Appartement avec beaucoup de charme, bien situé . Accueil sympa par Henrique qui nous a renseigné sur les lieux d'intérêts et les moyens de transport.
“I do believe what I laid eye on at the first sight must be my best choice..” I insist on my opinion.
Great hosts lovely appartment located close to time out market.
Muito obrigado e parabens!
Highly recommended, beautiful appartment, very sweet hosts!

Read no further! As long as you're okay with walking up four flights of stairs - stay here!!! Henrique was an incredible host! He went above and beyond to ensure we had an amazing trip. He was quick to respond and gave tons of tips on places to go and things to do. I've never had a better Air bnb host. The apartment itself had a wonderful balcony view, and the space itself is small but incredibly well utilized. There was plenty of space for two people to be very comfortable. Would definitely recommend staying here, it is walkable to everything and on top of it, you have a great host.
11/10 Host
10/10 Location

I had fantastic days staying in Claudia & Henrique's place. The flat was spacious, clean and cosy and with a beautiful sea view. The bed was soft and comfortable and so were also pillows and duvet. The location is perfect for explorin Lisbon and I walked everywhere. Communications with the host was easy and quick. I highly recommend this home and hope to be back again.

Great hosts. Our flight arrived early afternoon but Henrique even came out of work for a while to allows us to check in then. Claudia & Henrique text during our stay to ask if everything was ok and to recommend places to go. The accomodation was perfect, very central (10mins walk to Underground & Bairro Alto) and we especially loved the balcony. Would highly recommend.

Loft excelente, bem localizado, bem equipado.... Claudia e Henrique são excelente anfitriões. Assim que chegamos Henrique estava nos aguardando e ainda nos ajudou com as malas. Excelente opção para hospedagem em Lisboa...

Claudia & Henrique are wonderful hosts. We so enjoyed staying at this apartment with its fabulous view of the river. They were very to communicate with - and even though we didn't see them again after checking in, we knew they were only a phone call away if needed. Many thanks again Claudia & Henrique.

Tuvimos una estancia corta pero hemos disfrutado del apartamento de Cláudia&Henrique, todo muy bien, limpio, las vistas maravillosas, las fotos corresponden al 100%. Todos los lugares para visitar están muy cerca del apartamento, además de tener las paradas de metro/tren/autobús cerca. Si quieren visitar Lisboa con su pareja, creo que este es el apartamento que necesita.
Très bien situé pour découvrir Lisbonne. Les propriétaires sont très sympathiques et accueillants. Ils m'ont fait de très bonnes suggestions. Merci!

Wonderful hosts and apartment. Exceptional in every way.
Claudia was extremely helpful and kind.

Fantastic! This place is close to everything including transit. Claudia and Henrique are such amazing hosts we will be back again for longer.
Thanks for everything.
The appartment was really lovely. Henrique gave us lots of indications. The terrace was amazing. There were so many details that made our stay just perfect. We would definitely recommend it.
The apartment has stunning views. From here you are in 5 minutes in the time-out market to eat.

Zentrale, aber ruhige Lage.
Sehr warmherzige und hilfsbereite Gastgeber.
Perfekte Unterkunft für einen schönen Städtetrip.
Sehr gerne wieder !!!
Logement agréable, bien situé, accueil sympathique, tout est mis à la disposition des hôtes (cuisine, salle de bains). Cependant logement sous les combles qui ne convient pas au grande taille.

Thanks a lot Claudia for your kindness and all your tips and help.
It was a great stay. Hope to come back soon to Lisbon.
O & M
Awesome!!!

Fantastic location, great view and private balcony, and superb hosts! They gave so many recommendations for not only here, but for our continuation in Porto, going above and beyond and helping make dinner reservations for us too! They truly take care of their guests and leave no detail to chance. You will be in safe hands being hosted by these two ❤

Alles in allem einfach super.
Die Wohnung ist schön eingerichtet und sehr sauber. Am besten gefallen hat uns die Dachterrasse :)
Cláudia und Henrique sind perfekte Gastgeber. Sie antworten immer schnell und freundlich und gaben uns viele tolle Insider Tipps (Restaurants, Bars, Aussichtspunkte, etc.).
Check In und Check out haben problemlos funktioniert.
Beim nächsten Lissabon Besuch übernachten wir wieder hier! :)

Wir hatten hier im August einen kurzen Städteaufenthalt. Am komfortablsten kommt man per Taxi zur Unterkunft (das Preis/Leistung Verhältnis ist völlig in Ordnung in Lisboa. Eine Fahrt hat uns mit Gepäck ca 15—17€ gekostet)
Die Unterkunft ist sehr schön eingerichtet und sehr Sauber. Es ist alles vorhanden was man brauchen könnte und kein Wunsch bleib offen.
Die Highlights sind sicherlich: die unglaubliche Dachterasse mit Ihrem Ausblick, die auch Platz für ein Frühstück zu zweit und/oder zum relaxen nach einem anstrendendem Tagestrip bietet. Dafür muss man eine Stiege in den 4.Stock in Kauf nehmen (wir hatten damit jedoch keine Probleme)
Die Lage ist sehr Zentral, innerhalb 10 Gehminuten lässt sich sowohl das Tourizentrum als auch die Einheimischenplätzchen (entgegengesetzte Richtung) erreichen. Zum Essen gehen findet man auch jede Menge zu Fuß erreichbar.
Falls auch nur irgendeine Frage sich stellt, Claudia und Henrique stehen binnen wenigen Minuten sehr freundlich mit Rat und SMS zur Verfügung. Sie sind wirklich aussergewöhnlich Gastfreundlich. Diese Fakten haben uns zu dem Schluss gebracht, dass wir das nächste mal sicher nicht überlegen müssen wo wir in Lisboa unterkommen würden.

Claudia is an awesome host! We in contact the days before I got to her place and she had recommendations for Porto and offered to help book a restaurant there! She checked in with us the entire stay and made us feel like we had a friend in Lisbon. The apartment is quirky but super comfy and we felt right at home. Great views, and an easy walk to anywhere in Lisbon. Would absolutely stay again!

In one line: book this place, Cláudia&henrique could not be more accommodating ("text us if you're drunk and lost and we'll guide you home" we didn't but you get the sentiment and their recommendations were endless), the place is super clean, fabulously located and totally unique
More: my fears at the point of booking and how they manifested on arrival. perceived problem 1) the ceilings look low and people comment on that and my boyfriend is like 6"5 and I'm tall too so I thought he'd knock himself out or feel trapped in a cage - in reality it turns out it's just so quirky and delightful that all the beams are part of the adventure and the outside space stops you from ever feeling claustrophobic perceived problem 2) to me the bed looked cramped and like it might get overheated and weird up there - in reality it's like a glorious treehouse hideaway perfectly air conditioned, def roomy enough and the bed is super comfy perceived problem 3) people moaned about the stairs and we intended on doing lots of drinking and walking and I thought the stairs might be that backbreaking straw at the end of a long day - in reality there are a lot of them, I won't lie to you, but Lisbon is basically for eating and you'll be glad of the workout up to your lil sky nest plus the city itself is excessively hilly everywhere so if you can't manage stairs you may wanna rethink exactly what you're up to on this trip NB also: the bathroom is not captured well by the pics and may be the crowning gem here. Toilet feels literally like a thrown and the shower is enormous and drenching and heavenly
Nous avons adoré notre séjour! L'appartement est idéalement situé, très propre et a dépassé nos attentes! Nous le recommandons sans hésiter!

We had a fantastic trip to Lisbon which was made even better by staying at Claudia and Henrique's apartment. The apartment is clean, comfortable, and  in a great location near lots of great bars and restaurants and a short walk from the centre of the city. It was so easy to communicate with Claudia and Henrique and check-in was very easy to arrange. We really appreciated the recommendations they provided which were amazing. Make sure you visit The Mill for Breakfast and Hotel Chiado for drinks with an incredible view. Thanks Claudia and Henrique :)

Claudia & Henrique are great hosts! They go out of their way to help you and make your stay with them the best as possible. All the recommendations they gave us in Lisbon were amazing and we truly discovered the city and its charm thanks to them.

Claudia was very responsive and helpful over the course of the trip. She checked in almost daily to make sure everything was ok and even made us a reservation at a beautiful Fago restaurant. We really enjoyed our stay there!

We really enjoyed the stay. The AC is great, the area is very nice and still due to the 4th floor, you cannot hear most of the street noises. The river is in viewing distance and it is really the most beautiful apartment we had ever been to.

We met Claudia on the first day when we arrived in her appartment. The appartment was very clean and she was very enthousiast. She explained everything and during the week she answered very quick when we had a question. We had an amazing time in Lisbon, it's a beautiful city and thanks to the recommendings from Claudia we saw the most beautiful places. Great holiday!

Отличные Апартаменты, останавливались с подругой на 2 ночи. В квартирке есть все, что нужно, единственное-не работали пара розеток, но может мы что-то не поняли, и не было зубной пасты. А так все, что нужно-карты города, что посетить, советы от хозяина, приветственная бутылка вина :)
Cláudia et Henrique sont très accueillant et très serviable les photos et la description sont vraiment ce que j'ai vécu vous pouvez vous y rendre les yeux fermés !

A quirky apartment on the top (4th) floor with a balcony and river views. Great hosts, with Henrique on hand to help with luggage on arrival, and heaps of tips and suggestions from Claudia on places of interest, bars, restaurants, etc. Low/angular ceilings, so may be tricky for tall people (more than 170 cm), and a degree of fitness is required for the climb up the stairs. Overall, a great experience for us!

Great apartment in a nice neighborhood. Everything was just as described, and Claudia was a very gracious and communicative host. She definitely treats the place like her own and not just a rental property. Highly recommend!

Emplacement idéal avec un logement au top et disposant d'une vue superbe ! Nous y retourneront sans hésiter une seconde ! Un grand merci a Claudia pour tous ses conseils, et pour la prise en charge a notre arriver !

The nicest apartment and the nicest host we've ever experienced in our years staying in ABNB-apartments all over the world. Actually the apartment is nicer than the picture shows and during our stay we had a good communication with Claudia, who regularly asked if everything was ok and if we needed anything.
One of the benefits of vacating in Lisbon, is that you'll go home with leg-muscles of steel climbing the steep and cosy streets of the city - and also climbing to the 4.th floor to the apartment. So it's not an apartment for you if you're having physical issues regarding this.
The location close to Metro, buses and Trams made it easy to get everywhere in the Lisbon area - remember to buy a Viva Card at the Metro station Cais do Sodré. But it's not a problem to walk to most of the sightings in the city - do yourself a favour and visit the many stunning viewpoints/Miradoura.
There's a lot of small restaurants in the perimeter of the apartment and a couple of small supermarkets as well. The nearest bigger supermarket is located at the Metro stations Cais do Sodré - a short walk from the apartment.
We most definitely will return to Lisbon and when we do we'll consider us lucky to stay in Claudia's apartment again.
Claudia's apartment was lovely, the location was great and Claudia was so helpful at check in and during our stay.  We'd definitely stay there again!

The best Airbnb experience I've had yet! The apartment is beautiful with wonderful views of the river. Claudia & Henrique's hospitality is truly what set our stay apart and truly exceptional. Not only did they provide an incredible list of recommendations to make sure we had the best experience in Lisbon, but Claudia went so far as to offer to make dinner reservations for us at our prior stop in Porto! During our stay in Lisbon, she continued to check-in to make sure we were enjoying our trip. I would stay here again in a heartbeat!

The flat was located near public transportation. Easy to get from the airport to the flat. Metro line all the way there with one line transfer in between. Short walk to the town center and time out market, nightlife, train station to Cascais. Claudia was 100% helpful gave a lot of information of the area, places to see, eat in Lisbon but also in Sintra. Would highly recommend.

We loved this Airbnb - up lots of steps but it has great views and some outdoor space to have a coffee. It is very quiet and has everything you need for a stay. The hosts were delightful and could not have been kinder or more helpful.

We had a perfect stay at Claudia and Henrique's! The place was clean, in a great location, and the bed was so comfortable. And best of all was the view of the Tagus! We would stay here again in a heartbeat!

Clàudia and Henrique were the perfect hosts. Eventhough we arrived very late, we had no trouble checking in. They also provided us with a little breakfast and some great recommendations.
The rooftop flat was perfect for our short trip to Lisbon. We could reach everything by foot or the nearby metro-/tramstops.
We can highly recommend the apartment.

The photos on the website don't do Claudia and Henrique's place justice. It is much more spacious than it looks. We loved the view and the light. It was spotlessly clean and really beautifully decorated with lots of fun quirky touches. It is in walking distance to everywhere. Henrique gave us lots of great advice on where to go. We would highly recommend.

Great place with an amazing view. There are a few stairs but it's worth the climb everytime. Claudication and Henrique also recommended a bunch of great place to check out in Lisbon. Would definitely stay here again.
Perfect location, perfect flat, perfect welcome. Claudia and Enrique are so nice, and helpful: we highly recommend their place

Cláudia et Henrique sont des hôtes exceptionnels. Grâce aux conseils de Cláudia nous avons découvert Lisbonne comme si nous étions accompagnés par des autochtones.

Fomos super bem tratados pela Cláudia e pelo Henrique. Infelizmente não conhecemos a Cláudia pessoalmente, mas o Henrique foi nos receber e foi muito gentil desde o início. Nous avons passé un très bon séjour à Lisbonne grâce à Henrique et Claudia. L'appartement était parfait, très bien situé, en centre ville et dans un quartier très calme. Il est très agréable, surtout son balcon avec vue sur le Tage !
Nous avons rencontré Henrique et nous avons beaucoup échangé par message avec Claudia. Ils étaient tous les 2 très disponibles et vraiment très gentils. Ils nous ont donné beaucoup d'informations pour notre séjour et même offert de petits cadeaux !
Merci encore pour ce séjour qui était vraiment trop court !
Perfect location, fantastic host!

Todo perfecto! En el ático cuidan hasta el más mínimo detalle para que te sientas como en casa y Henrique ha estado muy pendiente de nosotros todo el viaje para realizarle cualquier consulta. Para repetir.

Séjour de rêve ! L'appartement est conforme aux photos et aux descriptions il est tres agréable avec sa terrasse avec une superbe vue sur le Tage
L'emplacement est idéal pour visiter cette belle ville
Je recommande cette adresse
Nos hôtes ont été disponibles tout au long de notre séjour avec des conseils tops

Nice and cozy apartment, hosts are interested in your well-being and very cool overall! The apartment is near some clubs on the waterfront which can be loud but wasn't a huge issue when closing the Windows. We could still sleep very well. The balcony is quite nice and the air conditioner helped greatly since the apartment got very warm from time to time. Overall a lovely stay which I would always recommend. Nearly perfect if not for the slight noise complaints and the kind of misleading photos: you can't actually see the bridge from the apartment. ;)
Great Place, Great host. Some stairs but worth it. Would stay agian.

Claudia and Henrique are very friendly,helpful and attentive. They care greatly about their guests. They're awesome!
The apartment is wonderful and especially the balcony and its view are unique!

Claudia et Henrique sont très disponibles, parlent bien le Français  et mettent tout en oeuvre pour que leurs hôtes passent un excellent séjour.  Appt sous les toits avec vue magnifique !! Très bien situé dans Lisbonne.
Freundlich, hilfsbereit, unkompliziert, gute Lage, großes Appartement
Our stay in the apartment of Cláudia & Henrique was wunderfull. Everything we needed was present and the location is super. We loved the neighborhood Santos-o-vehlo.

Wir hatten eine sehr gute Zeit in der Wohnung. Super ausgestattet mit allem was man so für ein paar Tage braucht. Super nette und vor allen Dingen sehr schnelle und zuverlässige Kommunikation. Ein sehr herzliches Willkommen. Und das alles im wunderschönen Lissabon. Was will man mehr? Sehr gerne immer wieder!

The apartment was lovely inside and out, just what we were looking for! The view from the balcony was beautiful and inside was bright and cosy.
Cláudia and Henrique were perfect hosts - very helpful and friendly. Overall we couldn't fault our stay!

Cláudia & Henrique are really welcoming and their flat is perfect : charming and well located.
Perfect!!

Je ne peux que recommander de louer l'appartement de Claudia et Henrique pour un séjour à Lisbonne.
Tout d'abord car leur appartement est très bien situé ( nous avons pu profiter de Lisbonne à pied mais il y a également de nombreux transports à proximité). Par ailleurs concernant l'appartement il a beaucoup de charme et est très chaleureux on s'y sent bien. Enfin je ne peux que recommander nos hôtes car ils sont très agréables disponibles et de bons conseils pour découvrir Lisbonne. Je retournerai sans hésitation chez Claudia et Henrique lors d'un prochain séjour à Lisbonne.
The apartment is like a Tardis. The longer you're in it the bigger it gets! Wonderful location and everything you need is provided...including wonderful hosts.

The apartment has an awesome balcony with an even better view. It's perfect for 2 people, with everything we needed for cooking and relaxing. Henrique met us at the apartment and was very helpful and accommodating throughout our stay. The area was beautiful and so close to great bars and restaurants. When I return to Lisboa, I hope I get to stay here again!!

Appartement sous les toits très agréable et confortable. Un excellent accueil de la part de notre hôte, très sympathique, aux petits soins durant l'ensemble de notre séjour et très arrangeant. Le bon pied à terre pour quelques jours à Lisbonne!

Claudia a été une hôte parfaite.
Son appartement est très bien équipé et idéalement situé pour découvrir Lisbonne.
Claudia a été très disponible pour nous donner des conseils tout au long de notre séjour.
Merci Claudia !
Appartement très agréable et bien situé pour visiter la ville. Nous avons beaucoup apprécié le balcon avec la vue sur le Tage

Claudia en Henrique hebben een mooi appartement, (wel 4 hoog) met uitzicht naar de Taag. Het appartement ligt in een opkomende wijk, winkels vlak bij, restaurants vlak bij tot beloopbaar. Echte uitgaanscentrum op loopafstand (15 minuten) en station op 10 minuten. Echt erg mooie plek met erg aardige attente eigenaren

Great choice in the heart of Lisbon. Clean, sofisticated, beautiful views of the river, very well located, luminous and completely equipped.  Henrique is very a friendly and kind host! Thanks for making my stay in Lisbon a great experience ;)

Incredible loft with everything that you  could possibly need. Great views of the water. Incredible hosts as well. They were very accommodating and make the stay 100x better. You should definitely stay here!

The home was amazing, fantastic views of the river, and so cozy as the first stop on our honeymoon trip. Claudia is a Saint and provided great suggestions for adventures in Lisbon and made us reservations for a fado night. Very pleased and we will definitely be coming back!

Cláudia and Henrique were fantastic hosts right from the start, providing us with a wide range of tips and advice to really make the most of our stay in Lisbon. Really quick to respond, flexible and super-friendly too :)
Their place was a great space for a relaxing stay. Location-wise it's a short stroll away from the bustling Time Out Market and station, and a slightly longer (but very pleasant) wander from the main tourist centre. The apartment itself is full of charm, very well equipped and has a cool outside space and a great shower.
Highly recommended!

Both of the hosts were extremely nice and probably one of the best hosts I've ever had on the site. They gave us great recommendations throughout our stay allowed us to reach out to them if we needed anything and were only a text or phone call away. I would recommend their place to anyone it is a prime location and a short walk away from everything!

Claudia and Henrique were extremely hospitable and friendly. They made us feel very welcome and made themselves available if we had any questions about anything. Their place is extremely comfortable and stylishly furnished, with a view of the water, and all of the essential amenities. We had a wonderful stay
Super apartment ! Good location and nice host.

Claudia and Henrique were wonderful and easily accessible by phone or text. At the last minute my dad came to stay with me and they were very kind to bring over an extra set of keys and sheets. The neighborhood is in development but it's in walking distance to many other touristy areas and restaurants. You can see the ocean from the living room which makes for an excellent sunrise and morning coffee experience :)
Alles Super! Freundlich, kommunikativ, hilfsbereit, tolle Tipps, late check in ohne Probleme, sogar ein Mini-Frühstück stand auf dem Herd. Tolle Unterkunft in toller Lage!

This was amazing! I can not thank Claudia enough for how helpful she was, especially with restaurant recommendations. She was so easy to communicate with and so sweet. The loft was perfect. Beautiful scenery, great location, exactly what we needed! Would definitely recommend, and we would love to return here whenever we're next in Lisbon.

It was a pleasure to stay at Claudia's apartment. We had a lot of support during our stay in Lisbon from Claudia and Henrique. When we first arrived in Lisbon and were trying finding the apartment, Claudia had arranged for a family member to meet and greet us, and on our last day during our stay, Henrique helped us a lot with our luggage arrangements. Claudia also provided us with great recommendations of things to do and also restaurants to eat at as well as reservations. The flat was clean, modern with a great view and I would definitely recommend it to anyone who needs a place to stay in Lisbon!

The nicest hosts you could ever meet. They helped us orginizing our stay in Lisbon a lot. The location and the terrace were the highlights. We enjoyed staying in a cute, warm place decorated with an artistic taste. It was well equpped also😊

Cláudia and Henrique offer a great reception in their cozy rooftop apartment. A nice, clean and very well equipped place for city explorers like me.
They actively offer help to make your stay most comfy. Excellent hosts in lovely Lisbon!

L'appartamento di Claudia ed Henrique è meraviglioso! E' pulito, comodo, ben localizzato e ben attrezzato: non manca niente! E' accogliente e in pochi minuti ti senti a casa. Le foto rispecchiano perfettamente la casa, che si trova al quarto piano di un palazzo senza ascensore.
Il quartiere esteticamente non è dei migliori, ma permette di raggiungere qualsiasi altro quartiere a piedi ed è anche vicino a tutti i mezzi pubblici (tram, metro e treno).
Infine Claudia ed Henrique sono fantastici: disponibili, gentili, simpatici, alla mano, presenti: ci hanno accolto e consigliato tantissime attrazioni (culturali, commerciali, eno-gastronomiche...), anche tra quelle più tradizionali e meno turistiche. Sono stati davvero eccezionali ed hanno reso il soggiorno ancora più gradevole!
Claudia and Henrique's apartment is wonderful!
It is clean, comfortable, well-located and well-equipped: nothing is missing! It is welcoming and within minutes you feel at home.
The photos reflect perfectly the house, located on the fourth floor of a building without elevator.
The neighborhood is not esthetically the best, but it allows you to reach any other neighborhood by walking and it's also close to all public transport (tram, metro and train).
Finally Claudia and Henrique are fantastic: helpful, gracious, friendly, easygoing, present: they welcomed us and recommended lots of attractions (cultural, commercial, food and wine ...), even among the more traditional and less touristy. They have been truly exceptional and have made the stay even more enjoyable!
Very nice flat!cute sunny terrace and lovely mezzanine bedroom. Very clean and practical- perfect location - close to barrio alto and well connected with transports!

Super apt doté d'une terrasse avec vue sur le Taje, vraiment très agréable, au calme, très bien équipé (dans le moindre détail), d'une propreté irréprochable.
Il est bien situé à proximité des transports en communs (bus, Tram à la station Santos) et proche du centre ville.
Merci à Henrique pour toutes les infos & renseignements qu'il nous a gentiment transmis en live sur place. C'était vraiment top ! Nous n'hésiterons pas à revenir !

Nous avons aimé l'appartement original, très bien équipé et bien placé dans le vieux Lisbonne.
La vue sur le Tage est exceptionnelle dans ce quartier où beaucoup d'immeubles masquent la perspective.
Claudia et Henrique se proposent pour vous aider en toutes circonstances et donnent des bonnes adresses dans tous les domaines.
Un très bon endroit pour un séjour à Lisbonne.

L'appartement est bien situé nous avons fait beaucoup de choses à pied et profité des bons conseils de nos hôtes
Très bon séjour

Nous sommes arrivé dans un fort état de stress suite au vol de tous nos bagages dans notre voiture de location!!! Et puis grâce à Hugo qui nous a ouvert l'appartement, nous avons trouvé un espace de réconfort et surtout une aide et une disponibilité précieuse. L'appartement est bien équipé, le wifi excellent. L'accès à la mezzanine et aux wc un peu acrobatique, mais les autres avantages prennent le dessus. Très important, bien convenir de l'heure d'arrivée et avoir... un bon plan ou un GPS pour trouver! Les locaux ne semblent pas connaître cette adresse.

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour à Lisbonne accueillit dans l'appartement de Henrique et Claudia du 25 octobre au 31 octobre.
Nous avons choisit cette appartement pour son emplacement et pour les nombreux commentaires positifs.
Claudia et Henrique sont très disponibles et nous ont donné de très bonnes adresses pour aller voir du fado manger dans les restaurants découvrir des bars authentiques et originales...
Nous vous réussit à aller voir un match à Benfica et obtenir des billets grâce à eux !
Au niveau de l'appartement les photos sont conformes et l'appartement très bien équipés. Se trouve à 10 minutes à pied de la station métro Cais do Sodre.
Ne pas hésiter à aller dans cette appartement.
it was fanatstic. great location. very clean and comfortable. the terrace has a fantastic view. and Henrique was very kind.

Claudia and Henrique really made our trip even more special. From the very beginning, they provided us with a host of things to do, places to see and restaurants to try. Claudia even went above and beyond making us a few reservations at some of her favorite restaurants, all of which were incredible. They were available whenever we needed them and very quick to respond.

The apartment was beautiful and exactly as pictured. It was well located and within walking distance to pretty much everything. The best part was the little balcony to sit and enjoy views of the river. Definitely one of my best AirBNB experiences!

bij aankomst hartelijk ontvangen nadat wij wat vertraging hadden opgelopen. Genoeg tips gekregen, kaarten en informatieboekjes in overvloed. Hele knusse en huiselijke sfeer, verhuurders waren continu beschikbaar indien wij vragen hadden. Locatie iets wat buiten het centrum, maar als je van wandelen houdt is dat zeker ģeen probleem. Trein/tram/taxi om de hoek. Aanrader !

We are in great emotions after staying in this perfect, creative and very nice flat!
Henrique is very kind and nice man. And smile all the time.
Can't say anything bad about this place ,because everything was perfect : from coffee machine to private balcony!
Interior of the flat is colorful, creative and bright. Full kitchen, with everything you can imagine, good bathroom. You can feel owners love to their flat!
No one problem with check in or check out. Enrique is always online and ready to give you best advices.
I'm very glad to get aquaned with this man and his perfect flat.
Please, don't think and book it immediately.
Very close to city center or railway station, its very comfortable if you are going to visit Sintra or cascais.
Thanks Enrique for the perfect satiating! We enjoyed every moment!

We had a fantastic time round Cláudia & Henrique's. Henrique was there on arrival to show us around and he was always available to give advice and recommendations. We have already recommended to friends.

Tout a été parfait chez Claudia et Henrique: les photos et la description de l'appartement correspondent à ce que nous avons découvert en arrivant: très cosy, et très propre, on s'est senti comme chez nous...Nos hôtes nous ont indiqués de très bons restos, pâtisseries et même un petit "café resto" pour écouter le fado..Le tout par sms au fil de notre découverte de Lisbonne. ..c'était nickel!

Claudia's appartman in very nice. Big leaving room, terace (no equipement to have a dinner or sunbath) where you can have a cofee or a drink later :) Nice bedroom & bathroom.

Claudia was very helpful before our visit, during and even after :) she recommanded us very good restaurant !!

The apartment is gorgeous. We felt very comfortable, like home. Everything you need is there, even everything for a small breakfast was offered by Claudia and Henrique.  The location is also perfect, the tram is round the corner, the view from the lovely roof terrace is great. Claudia and Henrique are the best hosts you can think of, Claudia provided us with very good recommendations for nice cafes, restaurants and other nice spots in Lisbon and area. You can be happy if you stay here.

Ausnahmslos perfekt - das Appartement, die Umgebung und Anbindung, und vor allem die außerordentlich warmherzige und zuvorkommende Gastfreundschaft von Claudia und Henrique! Wir wollen zurück und nie mehr weg! :)

Desde a reserva, Claudia foi extremamente simpática e atenciosa, oferecendo ajuda e dicas para que tivéssemos a melhor experiência na cidade. Nos comunicamos o tempo todo e as respostas eram muito rápidas, e Henrique nos recebeu muito bem no loft, oferecendo ótimas dicas de passeios e restaurantes nas redondezas. O apartamento é perfeito para um casal e principalmente para quem ficará poucos dias em Lisboa, pois está localizado no coração do centro turístico, a poucos minutos a pé do Bairro Alto, do Cais do Sodré, dos comboios, metro, autocarros e os famosos bondinhos passam logo à porta. As instalações são ótimas e o apartamento tem tudo o que se descreve e correspondeu às nossas expectativas perfeitamente. Somente a cama que incomodou um pouco, talvez por gosto pessoal, pois não achamos muito confortável. Todo o resto foi perfeito!

Claudia was at the apartment when we arrived and made us feel very welcome.

There was plenty of information left regarding where to eat and visit, and we had also had good communication with her previously as to the best way to travel to the apartment and also information about local amenities and the best beaches to visit.
The apartment is very pretty and exactly as it looks in the photos, so as long as you don't mind sloped ceilings and stairs to climb then you know what you are getting.

Claudia was very quick to respond to any queries we had and on a sudden electrical issue Henrique came quickly and resolved the issue - thank you Henrique!!

The air conditioning was very much needed and appreciated as the city, although lovely, was very hot whilst we were there.

I would recommend a taxi to the airport from the apartment as it cost virtually the same as the bus we came in on on arrival and the driver was great at giving us some history of the city.

Thanks again Claudia and Henrique!

Claudia and Henrique were so helpful before and during our stay in their studio. From the early bag drop prior to check in, the restaurant and activity recommendations and even help with onward travel we found them to be extremely accommodating. Claudia made good suggestions about what to do and see and especially aided our food tour of Lisbon! The studio was ideally located for us -  walking distance to all the main areas and if not, good access to public transport. The studio was fully equipped, air conditioned, compact but comfortable! The flights of stairs up to the studio were a bit of a killer but we needed the exercise after ALL the pastel de natas! If we return to Lisbon we would definitely hope to stay here again!

Se trata de um espaço original criado com amor e carinho. A localização é central de fácil acesso e o imóvel dispõe de uma incrível vista sobre o rio Tejo. Igualmente equipado com todos os utensílios domésticos necessários no dia à dia. Os anfitriões foram simpáticos e nos deram excelentes sugestões sobre o que ver e fazer na cidade. Recomendamos este imóvel

Fantastic location (walking distance from everything) and the cutest appartment!!! Claudia was very responsive and gave us so many recommendations. It was my best stay in Portugal (hotels included!). Oh and the bathroom is luxurious!!! (Only ick is that it's 4 floors up...so if you mobility impaired, this is not the place for you)...did I mention the view on their Terasse...again, amazing! Thank you Claudia!!!

Henri que et Claudine ont été geniaux, de bonnes adresses à suivre, un appartement avec une superbe vue sur le taje et Henrique nous a même aidé à monter nos valises.
Nos hôtes ont prit de nos nouvelles durant le séjour afin de savoir si tous se passait bien pour nous!!

Had an amazing time with Claudia! Despite having a 6 week old baby Claudia was so kind at ensuring we had the best stay. She recommended loads of great places to go and even booked some restaurants for us before we arrived. She was unable to meet us when we arrived but sent her lovely brother who talked us through the flat and the area. Flat is lovely, great size and in a great location!
Nous avons passé un super moment à Lisbonne. L'appartement est super et très bien situé. Nous avons été très bien accueilli et, les conseils de Henrique sont géniaux !

Great apartment and fantastic hosts, very communicative and gave a lot of tips of things to see and restaurants and bars to visit. Had an enjoyable week in Lisbon although it was very hot (first week of August). The air-condition in the apartment was however great (and necessary during the day time). Will consider staying here again if I'm going back to Lisbon.

This was our first trip to Lisbon and I am hoping not the last. Claudia despite been a new mum was one of the most communities hosts I have used. Henrique was on hand to meet using what could have been a coincidence we got lead to another apartment as the owner was a Claudia who let us in and the apartment looked nothing like the pictures. luckily. Henrique found us and lead us to the correct apartment. Be aware this is a top floor apartment with no lift, so if lots of luggage you may perspire a bit. The apartment is exactly as described and we were shown all the unique touches of the apartment. The view towards the river Targus, the seating outside for al fresco breakfast. Henrique then proceeded to recommend multiple places to try and we certainly enjoyed trying them. I can't recommend enough this for a single or couple in a easy area to navigate into and away from town.
