Public transport is very good here in Lisbon, we only needed a taxi for our early morning departure to the airport at an ungodly 4am. Come to Lisbon enjoy the city and Claudia and Henriques hospitality. Not forgetting welcoming bottle of wine and cookies!
Nous avons passé un très bon séjour à Lisbonne. L'appartement est bien situé et Henrique nous a donné beaucoup de bons conseils pour nos visites. Merci à eux.

Claudia et Henrique sont des hôtes d'une très grande gentillesse. Serviables, ils ont plein de bonnes adresses à vous proposer. L'appartement est parfaitement situé à cinq minutes à pied de Ribeira Market. La terrasse avec vue sur le Taje est très appréciable. Bref, c'est top !

Sehr engagierte und hilfsbereite Gastgeber. Alles war sehr gut organisiert und wir bekamen viele Interessante und hilfreiche Tipps zu Beginn. Die beiden waren auch während unseres Aufenthaltes immer für uns erreichbar.
Sehr gut ausgestattete Küche mit allem was man benötigt (Gewürze, FrühstücksZubehör, Eiswürfel, etc)
wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt.
in der näheren Umgebung sind sehr viele Restaurants und Kneipen, wo man abends gut hingehen kann.
Wohnung eignet sich sehr gut, um Lissabon zu erkunden.

Cláudia & Henrique were the perfect hosts. Before arrival we were in touch and got a lot of great advice and inspiration form Claudia.
The plane was delayed but Henrique was flexible and arrived to greet us the minute we got to the apartment.
The place had everything we needed: two different kinds of coffee brewing devices, toaster, electrical kettle and kitchen tools. We ate breakfeast at home every morning and enyoyed the coffee provided - thanks:) The river was closer and the bathroom bigger than it looks on the pictures. We also realy enjoyed cold white wine on the private terrasse - ahhh.
The restaurants they recommended were great and a nice way to se a young and modern Lissabon in a more mature way than the Bairro alto pub crawls;)
During our stay we sometimes texted with Claudia on different practical questions like 'where is the post office' and in the end she actually ended up posting the postcard for us, as we didn't manage to find stamps before departure. Such great service and sweet and caring people. I can totally recommend a stay at the studio and we cant wait to return.
PS: did i mention? Claudio and Henrique actually had a baby 1 week before our stay and still they had the energy for such amazing consideration and service. Wow!!

My partner and I stayed in Claudia and Henriques apartment for 5 nights. They are fantastic hosts. Very easy to contact with almost instant response. We did not have a chance to meet Claudia and Henrique as they were having their baby in the days we arrived. Even with this going on they arranged for Henriques brother to meet us on arrival who was very helpful. Prior to our stay Claudia gave lots of tips and advice from everything to restaurants to travel, we found this very useful and it helped us find some fantastic places to eat/visit etc. On checking in and out they were very flexible and made the whole trip stress free.
The apartment its self is lovely. It is very well decorated and feels fun and modern. There are so many little extras, everything you need for a trip. We really enjoyed the apartment and felt we were offered very good value for money. We would not hesitate to return if we were in Lisbon again.

What a wonderful apartment! Exactly as described. The location is great and close to lots of sights, but it's also quiet at night. Very comfy place to come home to after a long day of exploring this beautiful city. Lovely view of the river. Even more amenities than we needed. Claudia was very helpful before and during our trip, with lots of suggestions and recommendations. Easy to get to the airport via the metro (about ten minutes' walk from the apartment). Our only regret is that we couldn't stay longer. We'd definitely stay at Claudia and Henrique's the next time we're in Lisbon.

Onze eerste Airbnb ervaring was prima. Voor ons vertrek naar Lissabon had Cláudia al een aantal berichten gestuurd met suggesties. Ze heeft een restaurant gereserveerd voor de eerste avond. Ook tijdens de vakantie had ze suggesties voor activiteiten of leuke restaurantjes. Ze reageerde altijd heel snel op berichten.
De ontvangst door Henrique was hartelijk. Hij hielp ons oriënteren op de kaart. In het appartement waren ook boekjes met toeristische informatie aanwezig.
De ruimte zelf was mooi. Het is een loft, je moet soms bukken, maar het is van alle gemakken voorzien. Het bed sliep heerlijk. In de periode dat wij er waren was het erg warm maar met de airco was het goed te doen.
De omgeving is in opkomst, er zijn veel bouwactiviteiten in de buurt maar dat heeft onze vakantie niet verstoord.

Claudia was a fantastic host. She was always available to text and give us restaurant and other recommendations. She became a friend to us and we are so grateful! The bed was so comfortable and with the AC the apartment was perfect. There were breakfast items for us, shampoos and other toiletries, and any other little thing we needed. The shower was big and so nice as well. It was in a nice location and the little terrace with a view of the river was perfect. Thank you Claudia and Henrique for opening up your apartment to us! Phenomenal!!

Merci à Claudia et Henrique pour leur gentillesse, leur sens de l'accueil, leur disponibilité et leur adaptabilité pour gérer nos bagages et nos horaires (Air France : vol de retour annulé). Merci à Henrique pour avoir porter nos bagages dans les escaliers !
L'appartement est exactement comme sur les photos. Le plus est la terrasse avec une vue dégagée sur le Tage. Sa situation, à deux pas des moyens de transport en commun, permet de visiter Lisbonne facilement. Le centre ville est accessible à pied.
Surtout suivez leurs conseils si vous voulez découvrir les restaurants qui servent de la vraie cuisine portugaise délicieuse. Leur aide est également précieuse pour découvrir les points de vues insolites sur Lisbonne et les boutiques de qualité.

Claudia and Henrique were perfect hosts! They gave us wonderful tips for restaurants and sites in Lisbon - and they were available for our questions really around the clock.
The apartment as cozy and very clean. Everything we needed was there - including breakfast, wine and biscuits :-)
From the apartment you have a great view and it is a short walking distance to the centre and to public transport (tube) so that you can get there easily from the airport. This apartment is an absolute recommendation!

The listing description was very accurate. The loft was perfect for our stay of 3 nights, and the neighborhood was good. Claudia helped with different things to do, places to eat (the best local places), and overall was very welcoming. They let us check-in early and were very accommodating to us. I highly recommend staying here.

Nous avons passé 4 jours à Lisbonne.
Le mari de Claudia nous a accueilli avec de quoi prendre le petit déjeuner et bouteille de vin. Il nous a donné tous les bons coins a visiter. L'appartement était parfait. Nous avons pu profiter de la terrasse et les transports à proximités nous permettaient de nous déplacer très facilement.
Encore merci pour tout et peut être à très bientôt.

I have actually stayed in many AirBnb's in many different countries but I can safely say that Claudia's AirBnb is the best one I have stayed. Firstly, she is just simply an AWESOME host. She was in contact with my from the day I booked the room until the day I checked out. She always took the initiative to ask me whether I'd need any help. A week before I left for Lisbon, she sent me a really helpful and comprehensive list of where/what/how to visit in Lisbon. She even took the extra mile to ask and book a restaurant during our stay. All in all, she was the best host I've had so far.

As for the apartment itself, it is really cozy and comfortable. It was easy to find and upon arrival, I was greeted by her husband. He showed me the amenities and again, where to visit in Lisbon. The apartment is suitable for 2 or 3 people. The amenities are quite impressive especially in the kitchen, fully equipped with all sorts of cutleries and my favourite, tea. The location is perfect because it isn't in the middle of the city where it's too noisy. It's slightly away but not too far. It's close to all public transport such as busses, trams and trains (5-10 min away from town and 15 away from Belem) During our stay, Claudia even took the initiative to contact us there and then to ask us whether we're okay.

In short, our stay in Lisbon was one of the best AirBnb experience we've ever had. With a combination of a superb host and great accommodation, I would highly recommend this apartment to anyone!

I wish we were staying here our whole time in Lisbon!!! Loved the location. Spacious flat with lots of character and beautiful views. Comfortable bed. Also- the location was central but on a quiet street. This is tough to find. Amazing hosts that gave great recommendations.

Très bon séjour à Lisbonne grâce aux bonnes adresses et aux endroits incontournables à visiter que nos hôtes nous ont indiqué
Un appartement très charmant avec une très belle vue sur le Taje

Une super adresse à Lisbonne ! L'appartement est très propre et bien situé, la terrasse est très agréable. Mais surtout, une super rencontre avec Cláudia et son mari qui ont été parfaits et nous ont donné des adresses géniales pur découvrir la ville (roof top, point de vue, Resto....).   Un grand merci !!!

Claudia's flat was very comfortable, clean and good location.
Neighborhood was very kind and quiet.
It was so great time for me.

We had a wonderful check in process with Claudia and her husband. They told us all the places to eat, drink and visit. The property is really central to all the sights Lisbon has to offer and public transport. We really enjoyed our stay here. Thanks heaps for your welcoming hospitality!

在许多国家住过大大小小的公寓、酒店，而这座公寓和主人是我遇到过最好的！1、地理位置优越，紧邻地铁、火车、轮船的枢纽站，到机场只需要半小时，步行到著名的美食景点Timeout只需要5分钟，步行到老城区也只需要10-20分钟，乘坐火车到北仑区也只要3站左右。我们开始买了1 day-ticket,发现都不太用得到。2、公寓超级漂亮、干净、可爱，各种生活用品一应俱全而且充满了家的味道。此外还有许多精心的装饰和小摆件（比如浴室中的小鸭子、贴满冰箱的明信片、布置整齐的杯子等等）都能看出主人深深爱着这个地方。交流中他们提到，他们之前就住在这座房子里，但因为有了孩子就换到更大的房子中，因此当旅客住在其中时，就真的能感受到葡萄牙人的生活气息。3、也是最重要的，“金牌房东”的荣誉名不虚传！以前的房东都是入住时接洽一下就ok了，但是Claudia每天晚上都会耐心的给我一些十分有用的信息，包括到timeout中哪家的火腿、鱼汉堡、冰淇淋和巧克力好吃；老城区中哪家馆子最地道又便宜（我们开着手机GPRS找到她推荐那家Bastardo餐馆后，发现性价比和味道都超高！这家地道又精致到葡萄牙菜午间套餐只需要15欧，但是让我吃到了此生难忘的奴隶炖菜和芝士冰淇淋！）；哪家酒馆的Fodo好听；到辛特拉该吃啥；哪家礼品店便宜又地道；新开幕的啤酒节等等，我们一一试过发现真是名不虚传，而这些是Trip advisor 中根本办不到的！她像个老朋友一样真诚的指点我们去品尝美食、见识美景，也因此尽管在lisbon时天气不好，但这座城市却给我们留下了美好的印象！（最后一天下大雨导致我们去看罗卡角的计划泡汤，我窝在公寓沙发中连看了8集的《欢乐颂》，看着雨点砸在天窗上感觉美妙极了，就宅在自己家里一样安心又惬意～）。作为一个懒人，平生首次写这么长的点评，实在因为非常想让后来的旅行者也能体验到这座amazing 的公寓、认识这位善良可爱热情的葡萄牙朋友。Thanks so much Claudia,good luck!:)

The house is very nice, very warm. Claudia is really kind and recommended many good restaurants, cafe and art places to us. Also, thanks to her husband who help us put the luggage in the early morning.

Nous avons passé un super séjour à Lisbonne. L'accueil d'Eric et de Claudia fut excellent : très bon conseil, très disponibles... L'appartement était super, très bien localisé, et avec tout de disponible. Merci à vous deux pour tout!!

Our stay in Cláudia and Henrique's apartment is what Airbnb is all about - local people making you welcome in their city! Thanks so much for your hospitality and help for all aspects of our stay in Lisboa! The apartment is very clean and has everything you need for a comfortable stay including lovely views of the river and beyond. Great neighbourhood close to the metro as well as walking distance to all the amazing sights of this jewel box of a city! Wish we could stay longer and would definitely recommend this apartment.
Absolutely loved our stay. Great location, amazing view, wonderful hosts, and an epic shower. Would recommend to any couple travelling to Lisbon.

Nous avons été très bien reçus, le mari de Claudia nous attendais à notre arrivée tardive de l'aéroport. Claudia et lui nous ont donné d'excellents conseils pour visiter Lisbonne. L'appartement était superbe et très bien situé avec une magnifique terrasse donnant sur le port.
Un merveilleux séjour, merci !!!
marie-odile et jean-marc

We had three wonderful days in Lisbon. Claudias cozy and clean appartment has a great view on the river and is perfectly located for sightseeing. Claudia was a fantastic host arranging everything perfectly from check-in to sightseeing recommendations, restaurant bookings to checkout.
Josiane et Mathieu étaient ravis et enchantés par leur séjour. Merci pour l'accueil parfait dans votre bel appartement ! MERCI ! Une adresse à recommander !

Cláudia's helle Dachwohnung ist klein aber fein! Super eingerichtet und in Toplage mit Sicht auf den Tejo. Der sensationelle Mercado da Ribeira (nicht verpassen) ist in 5 Minuten zu Fuss erreichbar. Die ÖV sind in alle Richtungen in unmittelbarer Nähe. Wir haben viele gute Tipps von Cláudia bekommen.
Bei unserem nächsten Besuch in Lissabon würden wir gerne wieder bei ihr logieren. Sehr empfehlenswert!
Liebe Grüsse Livia&Fidel

We had a wonderful time staying at Claudia's. In the lead up to the trip she provided recommendations of restaurants to book and sites to see. We arrived late on our first evening and her husband met us and gave us a thorough walk through so we knew what was where in the appartment and orientated us to the surrounding area.
They were obliging, friendly and have an excellent appartment... the roof is a little low in places but we were both over 6ft and managed. It's worth it for the fresh, well equipped place with great views from the balcony.

Unsere Gastgeberin hat uns in dem sehr gemütlichen Apartment sehr freundlich empfangen und eine ganze Reihe toller Empfehlungen für Restaurants und Orte zu besuchen gegeben. Sie hat sogar bei spontanen Fragen..."Wo war nochmal die Fadobar?"... schnell geantwortet und weitere Tipps geschickt. Großartig! Die Lage ist perfekt, ohne Stadtlärm und alles wichtige zu Fuß zu erreichen. Bei einem Glass Wein auf der Terrasse über den Dächern ist man sicher, am richtigen Ort zu sein. Bei einer nächsten Lissabonreise würden wir sofort wieder das "Studio with River View" buchen. Absolute Empfehlung!

Un petit nid lumineux, hyper propre et douillet tres sympa et tout ce qu'il faut pour etre bien. A deux pas des tramway dans un quartier calme. Claudia et henrique font tout pour que notre sejour soit reussi. Presque mieux qu'une conciergerie privee ! Un grand merci pour nos echanges ;-)

Claudia and her husband were great hosts and gave us a very warm welcome when we first arrived (including homemade cookies!). They gave us lots of great recommendations on things to do and local restaurants, coffee shops and bars, which turned out to be some of the highlights of our trip. The apartment itself was very nice with great views and lots of sunshine. It was very clean and had everything we needed. The apartment is in a great location as well and very well connected to public transport. Claudia was also extremely accommodating about our check-in and check-out times and wanted to make sure that we had the best possible time in her apartment as well as in Lisbon.
I would highly recommend this place!

Hallo Claudiá,
wir haben uns sehr sehr wohl in Eurer tollen Wohnung mit Blick aufs Meer gefühlt und das von Anfang an! Dein Mann hat uns total nett empfangen und uns ganz tolle Tipps rund um Lissabon gegeben ;-) Wir hatten eine tolle Zeit mit vielen Highlights! Wir hatten sogar etwas in der Unterkunft vergessen und Claudiá hat es uns nachgeschickt!!! Wir würden sehr sehr gerne wieder kommen! Es war traumhaft! Lieben Dank & herzliche Grüße aus Deutschland, Bettina, Florian & Lara

A lovely place with lovely hosts in a very central location.

Claudia and her husband welcomed us for a tour of the house and with tips for what to explore in Lisbon. They had left us home made cookies, some wine and stuff for breakfast.

The place itself is great with lots of light and a beautiful view. Perfect for a couple. Some of the key tram lines are on the corner of the street and the city center is just a 15 minutes walk away. A 10 minutes walk from the central going-out area in town.

If we ever go back to Lisbon we'll no doubt try to go back here.

If you want to have a true experience of Lisbon. Look no further. I have traveled all over but never have I encountered hosts like Claudia and her husband. They never stopped providing us with where to go and most important where to eat. So if you want to have a true taste of Portugal look no further. Now getting to the apartment. It is situated in the perfect spot. It is walking distance to pretty much everything but you have excellent public transportation close by.
But the highlight of our trip was meeting Claudia and her husband. Two of the greatest people I have meet.

Alles bestens, sehr schöne kleine Wohnung mit allem, was man braucht. Hilfen, wenn wir Probleme hatten. Sehr verkehrsgünstig und trotzdem sehr ruhig mit Blick auf den Tejo. Sehr nette und fürsorgliche Kommunikation.

We were warmly welcomed by Cláudia's husband, Henrique. He was very friendly and explained us the surroundings and recommended some of the local restaurants (which we really enjoyed!). The apartment itself was really nice and everything we needed was there. We liked the location of the apartment. It is located in the centre at a short walking distance from a lot of the great restaurants and sights we wanted to visit. Contact with Cláudia and Henrique was nice. We could contact them if we needed anything. They definitely wanted to make sure that their guests enjoy their stay. We really recommend this place! Thank you again!

Mon Mari et moi avons passé un week-end très agréable sur Lisbonne, notamment grâce à la gentillesse et la disponibilité de Claudia et de sa famille!

Ils nous ont reçus à l'aéroport directement et conseillés tout au long de notre séjour! De petits présents nous attendaient même à l'arrivé dans l’appartement!

Son logement est au TOP! Très joli petit appartement sur les toits de Lisbonne, propre, rangé et décoré de bon gout. Placer entre le centre-ville, le cœur historique et Belém, avec un accès aux transports en communs facile et rapide. Tout est fait pour le bonheur de ses invités!
Nous recommandons très largement les services de Claudia! Elle nous a fait sentir comme "à la maison" !
Encore merci à Claudia, Bernardo et sa Femme ! N’hésitez pas à nous contacter si vous êtes de passage à PARIS !  Nous serions rendre l’accueil chaleureux que vous nous avez offert !

Stéphane et Sophie

Claudia was the perfect host with just the right level of interaction to make our stay as easy and exciting as possible :)

The apartment itself is ideal and very close to everything you could need (including the amazing Time Out food market!), transport is not a problem and the balcony was a wonderful touch.

We felt so welcome in this apartment and Claudia really went out of her way to accommodate our needs, would definitely stay here again! It's a beautiful city!

Claudia and Henrique are truly lovely and the vivid definition of 'SUPERHOST'. They had flexibility with our check ins and outs times, and they were available all times for any questions. I was very impressed in how they took care of every detail at this super sunny apartment, in every corner there is something to make your stay better... It was really useful to have towels, toothpaste, shampoo, milk, coffee, etc... but not only that! There are more treats I won't mention to not spoil the surprise at your arrival...! They also provided us with a very useful Lonely Planet and lots of recommendations of restaurants and places to visit. The location is great: 5-10 min walk from the buzz, so we got pleasantly silent nights. Also, the bed is bigger than it looked at the pictures... I can just say, I would definitely stay at their studio again, hopefully soon! Thank you <3

Great place to be! Cláudia make our stay really nice with all the instructions she gave, places to visit, places to eat, etc. The apartment was amazing with a beatifull view to the river! Near the center and with really good conditions! A must go in Lisbon!

We were welcomed really well to the apartment, great communication and very friendly. Claudia gave us some excellent recommendations which literally made the trip for us and was always happy to help. The place was really clean, tidy and had everything we needed. Can’t wait to come back, thanks

We really liked the apartment, the place has an amazing view over the river and is very comfortable. It is in a beautiful classical area of Lisbon but the apartment itself is really warm and well lit with skylights and great shower!
Claudia is super helpful, giving us lots of good recommendations and helped us get the most out of our time there.

Le logement de Claudia était exactement ce à quoi je m'attendais.
Un studio avec une mezzanine sous le toit, un grand velux et plusieurs fenêtres donnant sur le Tage. Le logement est très bien meublé et très confortable. De plus il est extrêmemnt propre. Tout est prévu du point de vue des ustensiles de cuisine, de salle de bain..
Le logement est décoré avec goût et est très clair et très gai. On sent que Claudia y a mis tout son coeur.
Claudia avait mis sur la table de quoi me faire plusieurs bons petits déjeuners... Elle avait aussi mis des friandises et un guide en français pour m'accueillir et me guider. Nous avons échangé tout au long de mon séjour. Elle m'a donné diverses informations sur des lieux à visiter, des bons restos, des bars..; J'en ai vraiment profité. Lorsque je retournerai à Lisbonne, je souhaite loger à nouveau chez elle. Je me suis sentie à la maison tout en étant dans une ville fabuleuse. L'appartement est très bien situé. A pied on arrive à la vieille ville en 15 minutes maximum. Le quartier lui-même est intéressant. C'est un quartier anciennement industriel qui est en pleine rénovation, avec des bars, des écoles d'art, des magasins "design". Que vouloir de plus. Ce fut un rêve !

Claudia is a very great host !! She showed us where to go, what to see and where to eat.  Her advices were precious and she was always there to answer our questions. The neighborhood is perfect and the studio is very nice with a killer view !

Great host. Claudia tried to make our stay as nice as possible, we had frequent contact both before and during our visit and got many recommendations from her about things to do and to see... she even booked a restaurant for us.

In terms of location quite close to the metro and therefore a perfect starting point for city tours. Moreover, the great Time-Out-Market is close by, which has wonderful food.

The only minus is that the building is quite old, so the stairway to the top with the luggage is not easy and the water in the shower goes down rather slowly.

We had a great time in Lisboa, at least because Claudia and her husband were wonderful hosts and gave us helpful advices where to go, where to eat and told us the "must see" spots in their city. We felt welcome and had like a "VIP"- treatment from our hosts :-) The apartment was 100 % like in the description, spotlessly clean and equipped with everything you will need for a city trip. There is absolutely nothing to complain about! Thank you Claudia for having us and feel invited to visit Germany if you like!
Tilo and Anne

Die Beschreibung des Studios und die Realität stimmten vollauf überein. Das Studio vermittelt sofort einen gastlichen Eindruck. Direkt gegenüber wird derzeit ein Haus gebaut, so dass eine gewisse Lärmbelästigung unvermeidbar ist. Claudia tut alles in ihrer Macht stehende, um den Aufenthalt für ihre Gäste angenehm zu machen.

I could not ask for more in the apartment! My house is equipped worse than Claudia's ))) It has everything you need for a holiday stay. The hosts are great and welcoming. Thanks for all the information you gave us.  Your hospitality and home made our stay even more memorable
Nice place, very welcoming and helpful hostess! All in all a comfortable stay.
Very lovely flat and best host one wishes. I felt like being home (gut aufgehoben) and well received. I missed absolutely nothing. I would come back. Recommendable.

nous avons séjourné trois jours chez Claudia , l'accueil fut parfait , l'endroit charmant , extrêmement bien situé , si vous aimez la marche vous ne prenez jamais les transports en commun pour l'accès aux principaux sites . Nous étions en novembre , la terrasse qui domine les bords du Tage nous a permis un bain de soleil apprécié . Lisbonne étant certainement une des plus agréables capitales d'Europe , et l'appartement de Claudia étant des plus cosy , vous aurez envie tout comme nous de revenir pour continuer cette découverte et Claudia sera à coup sûr notre hôte . Une réussite !
We really enjoyed the stay in claudia's apartment. The flat is well located in the city, well decorated. She gave us a lot of tips to discover Lisbonne.

Tout était parfait ! L appartement ( jolî. Fonctionnel et très propre) sa situation ( proche d'un métro et des trams, du centre et en même temps au calme) et surtout Claudia qui a été d'une grande et pleine de bons conseils, c'est un vrai bijou !!!
Si vous aviez un doute, n'hésitez vraiment pas, vous serez très bien.

The apartment is beautiful, clean, sunny, with nice terrace and river view and it has absolutlety everything you may need. You really feel at home in there. The location is perfect. Close to city center (10 minuts walking) and the surrounding area is nice, safe and authentic. It is very close to transport links including the aerobus from the airport.

Claudia and her husband are wonderful hosts. We were welcomed personaly by them. Before our stay Claudia gave us all the information needed to get to the appartment. During our time in Lisbon she gave us a lot of recomendations of great restaurants, bars, coffes, shops, markets and much more in Lisbon and surrondings.

Lisbon is colorful, vibrant, dynamic and full of interesting places to visit. People are warm, kind and helpful. I really felt in love with the city and I can not imagine a better place to stay.

I really recomend this appartment and I hope to come back again one day

Claudia's apartment has everything you need to visit Lisbon:
- a strategic position close to the city centre and the nightlife area,
- everything you need in an apartment
- a terrace overlooking the rover,
- a delightful host welcoming you with home made delicatessen, all the tips about the city and a charming smile!!!

I really love Claudia´s apartment! I did choose it because of the view on the river (which was really spectacular) but it was in all aspects marvelous. Claudia was very helpful, every day new hints concerning restaurants or places you really had to visit. The apartment is very well situated, everything is very near. And even for pensionado’s like me it’s all easy to reach. I will recommend it to all future travelers to Lisbon.

Claudia's apartment is great and she is an excellent host! The flat is in a good location and has everything you need for a very comfortable stay. It's really cosy and we couldn't have asked for more. Claudia is also very helpful and provided us with lots of tips about Lisbon to make our stay even more enjoyable. Highly recommended!

This was one of my best Airbnb experiences so far! The apartment was great in a great location. It really had everything. But the even better part was Claudia as a host. She really helped me make my trip to Lisbon better by being super serviceminded all from before I arrived until after I left.

Claudia was an amazing host who made us feel very welcome and the apartment was amazing. Looks just like the pictures and the view made it for us. All her recommendations were excellent, especially the recommendations about the best places to eat! She gave us constant updates about events and how things work in Lisbon which helped us to settle in very fast.

We had a magnificent stay in Lisbon. It was the best location and neighborhood possible. Clàudia is an angel. We spent an amazing week in this lovely city. It was such a good discover for us. The appartement has a nice view and I am so glad because of my choice. I was looking the best place to spend a week with my boyfriend and I was right. Clàudia made our stay really pleasant and we fell in love with Lisbon. We strongly recommend this flat for anyone who wishes to spend a hollydays in this gorgeous city.
we really enjoyed the stay in lisbon and in claudia's apartment... she has been a fantastic host, really caring...

Claudia was hands down amazing!!!  My girlfriend arrived the day before and Claudia was there to welcome her into her gorgeous little loft overlooking the bay.  All of her recommendations were excellent as we explored and ate such great food thanks to her.  She also kept in touch with us throughout our stay and sent a few more local events that were going on during our stay.  I noticed that people all around the world have stayed with her because of the great place and superior hospitality.  Also, most everything was within walking distance and by the second to third day we started to get more comfortable with the streets.  I'd suggest you reserve this cozy little place because you won't regret it!!!

Wonderful view from the balcony! The flat is well located in the city, well decorated and reflects how Claudia travel around the world. She gaves us a lot of tips to discover  Lisbonne (good restaurant and bars).

Claudia's apartment is in the most serene location overlooking the river Tagus. The apartment itself is truly homely and beautiful. This was the perfect base for exploring Lisbon and the surrounding area, in a great location close to transport links and a walkable distance into town too.
Claudia and her husband were wonderful. Before we arrived we were sent helpful travel tips and throughout our stay welcomed insider tips on the best places to visit. On the day we arrived there was a huge taxi strike which affected public transport and closed half the streets near the apartment- an unlucky freak! As we were stranded, Claudia and her husband offered to pick us up from a roundabout within inner Lisbon which was especially helpful! And to make us feel even more welcome we were given a gift- thank you so much Claudia!
This apartment is highly recommended. An absolute treasure!

We had a fantastic time at Claudia's cosy attic flat in the cool São Paulo district of Lisbon. Absolutely everything was provided for our comfort - from bottle openers to Nespresso machine; from a hairdryer to a shisha pipe. Every kitchen utensil, cleaning product and bathroom necessity was there when we needed it.
The flat benefits from a lovely terrace overlooking the river and neighbouring rooftops. It's just a short walk from Cais do Sodre metro station, Mercado dos Ribeiros and Bairro Alto.
Claudia and her brother were the best possible hosts. Her tips allowed us to visit places and do things in Lisbon that we wouldn't have thought of ourselves!

Claudia's appartment was exactly the same as the photos: cosy, clean, and full of litle funny objects wich made us feel like home . The local area was great, close enough to the center but also nice and quiet .

Another reason why i would recommend this appartment is Claudia herself : she is extremely helpful, both before you even get to Lisbonn and also during your stay.

Claudia's home is very cozy and clean, it is in a good location just as same as her description, it takes only several minutes to the metro station and train station, what is also worth mentioning that there is a food markt nearby, where i have tasted a dish of great seafood rice.
and for Claudia (as well as her husband), she is so friendly and helpful that she provides everything we need at home and for sightseeing, even if she was not in Lisbon at the moment, she tried to keep in touch with me everyday and answer my questions really patience.
In a word, Recommend ! Thanks, Claudia:)

Wunderschönes Appartment mit einem Wahnsinns Ausblick und einer unglaublich gut Ausgestatteten Küche! Wir waren dort 5 Tage und es war einfach perfekt! Wir können jedem nur wärmstens empfehlen sich hier einzunisten
Beim nächsten Lissabon Besuch würde ich sofort wieder Claudias Heim bewohnen!

Claudia was a great host, she provided a lot of suggestions and tips on the city, and was always very responsive to text messages. The place was well kept, and she provided beers and coffee! The location of the apartment was nice, though Lisbon is a big city and it took a while to get to many sites. The apartment is up 4 flights of steps so be warned. Also, we kept hitting out heads on the beams and the tilting roof, since it is an attic apartment. Thanks Claudia!

L'appartement est fidèle aux photos. Superbe vue et terrasse. Très propre. Claudia avait tout prévu pour que nous soyons directement à l'aise dans l'appartement : eau fraîche, bières fraîches, nécessaire pour petit déjeuner.
Très bien situé, à peine 15 min à pied de la place du commerce.
Claudia a une liste interminable de bons plans qu'elle partage avec plaisir. Elle répond à toutes vos questions très rapidement.

The apartment was perfectly described and well located (calm district yet very close to the city centre).
Claudia is a very good host and gives good advices.
We had a great time there and we recommend her apartment.

We really enjoyed our stay in Lisboa, Claudia and her husband were very helpful, sending us tips and guides all the time!
The place is very well equipped, cosy and has a enjoyable view to the river. It was great to relax on the terrace in the evening after a long day of sight seeing.

Pros: Good location, absolutely stunning view from the rooftop terrace, easy communication with our friendly host and last but not least, perfect loft apartment with all the equipment you could ever need.
Cons: None.
I can only recommend Cláudia's place and thank her for our great stay in Lisbon!

Unsere Gastegeberin Claudia war sehr aufmerksam und hat uns mit Tipps zu Ihrer Stadt (Plätze, Events, Bars, Restaurants) bestens versorgt, sodass wir uns direkt pudelwohl gefühlt haben, Das Appartment ist wirklich schön, super ausgestattet und liegt sehr gut um die schönen Ecken Lissabons entspannt zu erreichen. Wir würden jederzeit wieder in das Appartment fahren!

We stayed at Claudia's apartment for four nights. On arrival Claudia couldn't have been more helpful and gave us plenty of recommendations for restaurants and bars and talked us through what was what in the flat.

Everything was very clean and to be honest it made us want to move in - if only! The view from the balcony is amazing and location wise you are just a few minutes from Bairro Alto, the Time Out Market and the train/metro station. The bed was comfy and the flat was fully kitted out with more than what you would need.

Throughout our stay Claudia was on the other end of the phone and sent us tips and when we had a slight problem with the air conditioning her husband was straight round.

We couldn't recommend it highly enough.

We had the best days ever in Claudias appartment in Lisbon. Her flat is really excellent, clean and has a wonderful view to the Tejo. All the sights (Bairro Alto, Baixa...) were in walking distance and train/metro station is about a five minute walk. Besides the wonderful accommodation Claudias and her husbands hospitality was extraordinary. We felt more than welcome and like "at home" with all her tips for sight seeing, restaurants, best ice cream ; ) and so on..
They kind of cared for us like for good friends. All in all: we´ll come back and thanks again for the wonderful days in your hometown !

My friend and I stayed 3 nights at Cláudias apartment and had the BEST TIME ever in Lisboa. This incredibly comfortable and greatly equipped apartment is perfect for a city trip to this beautiful city. It has everything you need, an amazing view and you should definitely use the balcony to have breakfast and enjoy the river view!!

Even before arriving, Cláudia did not hesitate to send us information about places to go to, bars and clubs to hit and food to try - and her helpflusness did not stop once we arrived. Welcoming us with wine and even fresh milk and bread (since we arrived around 10:30 pm), Cláudia and her husband named us more hotspots to check out and these little hints did not stop till we left Lisboa. We would come back anytime.

Апартаменты просто восхитительны! Все в точности, как на фото. Есть все необходимое, и даже больше.
Расположение тоже отличное, рядом много транспорта, до метро 10 минут пешком.
Клаудиа прекрасная хозяйка, дала нам очень много полезных советов, которые нам реально очень помогли.
Если еще приедем в Лиссабон, обязательно вернемся!

Claudias Apartment was easy to find especially because she kept in touch with us via sms after our arrival at Lisbon and made sure that no one gets lost. It can be reached easily by using public transport and one can choose between several routes. Her cousin was the one who warmly welcomed us at the apartment, he showed us around and even gave some sightseeing tips. The apartment itself is really friendly, cosy and nicely done up. We felt comfortable from the minute we have walked in. There were sweets and a botle of wine waiting for us, accompanied by a lot of maps and things to do flyers about Lisbon. During our stay we really enjoyed the great location of the apartment and the interesting and diversified neighborhood of the new desingdistrict. We had a great time and fell in love with the city, the good wine, delicous food and the friendly and positive attitude of its inhabitants!

L'appartement correspond aux descriptions, il est super mignon, avec terrasse. Très bien situé. Nos hotes ont été parfait, ils nous ont attendus tard et ont pris la peine de nous situer, nous dire les differentes commodités à proximité  et les endroits qu'ils aimaient. Claudia n'a eu de cesse de nous conseiller tel ou tel bonne adresse selon ce que nous visitions. Ces conseils ont été très bien à chaque fois.  Franchement, tout était parfait. Malgré l'hiver,  la climatisation à été amplement suffisante, même parfois trop chaud, nous avons dû la couper !
Très bon séjour à Lisbonne dans ce logement idéalement situé. Merci à Clàudia pour l'accueil et pour le logement bien équipé.

O apartamento é fantástico. Fomos recebidos pela Vânia, que foi super querida, porque a Cláudia, infelizmente, ficou presa em Nova Iorque devido ao mau tempo. Eu e o meu namorado adoramos a nossa estadia e era fácil aceder a várias zonas a partir do apartamento, apanhando metro ou autocarro. Só temos pena de o tempo não estar muito convidativo a explorar melhor aquela zona. Recomendo mesmo!

We had a beautiful stay at Cláudia’s apartment.
Cláudia has the best tips and close to wonderful restaurants and bars.
The apartment is also great in winter, nice and warm. We would definitely book the apartment again. 100% recommended!
Thank you so much.
Studio super mignon au centre de la ville, donc proche de tout ! Un accueil parfait et pleins de bons  conseils de Claudia à suivre les yeux fermés !

My girlfriend and me were really interested in knowing Lisbon. Despite we didn't meet claudia, her cousin was waiting for us at her flat, and she gave us a lot of information about many interesting places to visit and many activities to do. Also, Claudia sent much more information by email.

The studio is really beautiful, but also it's quite cold (we went on January). All the furniture was original and novel, and she left a basket with so many typical food products in. We had a very special time in Lisbon at Claudia's flat. She took care about all the details.
Thanks!

Absolutely loved Cláudia's place! It's was quirky, fun, lots of little details that made it a great space. It was in the perfect location, easy to get anywhere we wanted. She is very friendly and helpful, told us some great places for food, drinks and exploring. Always replies quickly so if we needed anything It wouldn't be an issue. I would definitely stay here again, hopefully sometime soon! had a great time!!! :)

It was a great pleasure to visit Lisbon already third time! and it s so important to stay in places where you feel like a home. we are really like this apartment and it was nice to be for new year holidays, eat, drink, enjoy the view in this balcony and feel like in the heart of amazing city. Claudia was very attentive to us from the very begging, assist with a lot of things. Wine, sweets, coffee in the apartment make our accommodation warm and sweet. Thanks a lot!!!

Claudia est une hôte vraiment attentionnée et son appartement est comme décrit dans l'annonce! Tout au long de notre séjour, nous avons reçu des indications de la part de Claudia pour donner des adresses utiles, de bons restaurants ...
Pour l'appartement, la luminosité, la vue du balcon et les petites attentions laissées par notre hôtesse ne font que rajouter de bons points a ce studio placé à quelques pas de tous les spots de Lisbonne à visiter !! Encore Merci :)

We wanted to escape the bad weather in Germany and spend a great week in the lovely city of Lisbon over Christmas. To summarize: This loft was perfect, in a central location with a great river view to enjoy the sunrise in the morning. If you want to cook yourself, the cosy and clean apartment is perfectly furnished with extensive equipment.  Claudia herself is a great host. After a very warm welcome we stayed in contact the whole week. She knows a lot of great places in Lisbon and her suggestions were very helpful to explore the greatest sites of this beautiful city. We would definitely book the apartment again. 100% recommended!

Perfect trip in Lisbonne!!! Claudia is more than helpful, she gives you adresses, restaurants, shops!!! She knows her city perfectly and trough her advices and you Will discover "the real" Lisbonne!!! Thxs!!!!!

The location of the flat is great with a very nice view of the bridge. Really close to a lot of nice restaurants and bars.
Claudia and her husband were really helpful and recommended a lot of cool places to see.

Claudia went above and beyong to ensure that we were confortable for our entire stay. The loft is absolutely gorgeous, cozy, clean, and modern. There's no doubt we will stay there again. Everything is close , all the hip, new bars, restaurante... Easily one of the best values in Lisbon. See you again soon! ☺

Cláudia is a perfect host! We have been to a concert with her and her husband on the very first night. We stayed in frequent contact during the whole time in Lisbon. She gave us advice on things to see and Restaurants to eat. We could even stay longer in the flat because our flight was in the evening. The flat itself is great for a short stay. It has all you need and if one day the weather is not good you can watch one of the movies they have in ther collection.

My girlfriend and I had a wonderful stay at Claudia's apartment in Lisbon. The apartment is in a great location, near the water which meant we didn't have to hoof it up hills to make it back each night. Its very well located with trains, trams, the Mercado da Ribeira close all close by. The apartment itself is very cosy, the balcony over looking the river felt very secluded even though there are buildings all around. Claudia herself is a great host, she offered us many great restaurant and sight seeing suggestions and even told us about a few locations not on the beaten path.

La nostra esperienza è stata più che positiva. La casa era esattamente come illustrata nelle foto e situata a dieci minuti a piedi da centro, metro e le maggiori comodità.
Claudia ha contribuito a rendere la nostra vacanza perfetta, non solo con un'ottima accoglienza ma fornendoci preziosi consigli per vivere al meglio la città.
CONSIGLIATISSIMA.

Diese Wohnung ist wirklich sehr zu empfehlen - sie tickt alle Boxen: zentral, gemütlich, praktisch, sehr gut ausgestattet, modern, mit einem sehr schönen grossen Balkon mit Sicht auf den Fluss. Wir haben uns in der Wohnung direkt wie zuhause gefühlt. Die Vorbereitungen war auch schon hervorragend - Claudia reagiert immer wahnsinnig schnell auf Emails und ist sehr engagiert - sie gab uns viele Tipps und auch während wir da waren, hat sie immer wieder mal eine Nachricht geschickt um uns auf dem laufenden zu halten was in Lissabon gerade ansteht! Darüber hinaus ist sie einfach sehr freundlich und zuverlässig! Wenn wir mal wieder nach Lissabon reisen, werden wir auf jeden fall wieder in dieser Wohnung übernachten.
Best descision to Rent Claudias flat! Perfect Location!

Nous avons passé une semaine merveilleuse à Lisbonne, capitale qui mérite d'être découverte petit à petit, à travers des déambulations avec ou sans plan ...

L'appartement de Claudia a largement contribué à ce bien-être : il correspond tout à fait à la description, il est très propre tout en étant personnalisé, petit nid douillet pour une escapade en amoureux. Il est idéalement situé, car à 20 minutes à pied de la place du Commerce, point de départ de nombreuses ballades sur Lisbonne. Sa terrasse donne de la lumière et de la perspective à l'appartement, et permet de prendre le thé en contemplant le Tage. Toutefois, ne pas oublier que nous sommes en ville, et que vous ne serez pas à l'abri des bruits de la circulation automobile ou du train qui passe à quelques centaines de mètres de là.

Si nous n'avons malheureusement pas pu rencontrer Claudia, elle a mis toutes les conditions (mail, texto) pour nous accompagner tout au long de notre séjour, prenant en compte notre arrivée plus tardive que prévue ; elle nous a répondu rapidement lors de la prise en main de l'appartement, nous a également conseillé pour des visites ou des restaurant (on vous recommande à 5 min le "Petiscaria Ideal").
Merci à Claudia pour toutes ces attentions !

Nous avions loué une voiture pour la semaine, et avons pu ainsi sortir de Lisbonne (la côte, Sintra ..) ; nous confirmons les conseils des différents guides, c'est un peu galère pour se garer sur Lisbonne, et je recommande de prendre un GPS : un parking à proximité de l'appartement (2min à pied) permet de mettre à l'abri le véhicule mais il faut compter entre 12 et 15€ par nuit ; un parking à 20 min à pied (Docas de Santo Amaro, près du pont du du 25 avril) ne coûte que 5€ par jour : à retenir !!!

Côté météo : période idéale pour les bretons que nous sommes ; il a fait chaud, nous étions en tenue d'été et avons pu prendre nos repas en terrasse ...

Merci encore à Claudia ...

This apartment is one of the nicest places we have ever stayed. It is a very modern very chic place and everything in it is so quirky and cool. Claudia and her husband were fab hosts, we were met at the apartment and made feel very welcome, shown around, shown how everything worked etc and got a quick rundown of the local things to do etc. Claudia was always just a mail away and an absolute book of wisdom about where to go what to do, gave us fab recommendations and if I had a question she was back to me within minutes with an answer. The apartment was so nice it was hard to leave to go out for the day, it had absolutely everything from towels, shower gel to a blender and even a Nespresso machine. The shower is better than any hotel I have been to and as for the balcony and the view they were 10 out of 10. The best food and drink market I have ever been to is a 5 minute walk away and the fab riverfront with the nicest mojitos and sunset view is just a stones throw away also.  I'm only home and I can't wait to go back. I would recommend 100%.

A very nice appartement to visit Lisbon for a few days or a week! It's near de center of the city and 10 minutes walk from metrostation Cais do Sodre.
Claudia is a very friendly woman and she gives us a warm welcome. She gave special tips for dinner and hotspots in the city for me and my son.
In short, highly recommended!

Stayed at the loft apartment for 5 nights and we loved it !

Claudia is a wonderful host who welcomed us warmly. There was a welcome basket of wine & jam & biscuits - so thoughtful of her. She also gave us great suggestions on food places & was very prompt in answering our queries.

Apartment : It has everything you need - really everything. It is fully equipped and clean with quirky with interesting momentos throughout the apt. View over the river is good on a clear day. Enjoyed having some meals here.

Location : Place is 10min walk from Cais do Sodre station (the aerobus makes a stop here). It is round the corner from the Creative University building. Not too easy to find for the first time but after that it is ok. The shortest route is to walk past an alley with parked cars which may be a little dark at night. Otherwise, take the main street.

Claudia's apartment was an absolute joy to stay in! Gorgeous rooftop balcony, great welcome basket, fabulous & funky apartment with loads of quirky details and everything you need!
Despite being on her honeymoon, her mum and niece came over to help us settle in with lots of help and advice, and claudia sent loads of messages with lots of ideas on places to go and things to see, we didn't have time to do them all but if we'd stayed longer we would have! We really want to cone back, and when we do we'll stay with claudia again. Special bonus points for being ten mins walk from the timeout mercado de riberia!
Claudia is very nice and supportive, lovely appartment. We had a very good stay!

Claudia and her cousin were tremendously helpful throughout our stay, and gave us lots of advice for us to find our feet in a new city. The apartment is well located within easy walk of the trendy areas and transportation. The kitchen is well equipped and we were able to cook for ourselves in the evenings. It was especially pleasant to sit on the balcony and drink red wine overlooking the river. We look forward to staying again!

Very great location to discover Lisbon. The apartment is perfect: clean, roomy and quiet. Claudia and his brother, Rui, took time to give us some useful advices concerning how organize our visits, and restaurants, bars,... We have spent a very nice stay and we recommend this apartment.
Thanks for all to both

We really loved to stay at Claudias apartment - it was so cosy, had everything you need for a stay in Lisbon and we totally felt welcome with the welcome-package Claudia left for us. Claudia herself was away but her brother explained us everything we needed and both (Claudia and her brother Rui) gave us really good recommendations (bars, restaurants, clubs, places to go to) for our stay in Lisbon!! The apartment itself is located in Lisbons most designated district - so good restaurants/bars have never been far away!! We would definitely choose and book Claudias apartment again!!! :)

Great communication.  Claudia gave us some excellent recommendations for local restaurants, and frequently checked in by email to see if everything was ok.  The apartment was clean & bright, with great views of the river.  Other nice touches were the welcome basket, and a generous supply of Nespresso coffee pods.

This apartment and the host is just perfect! They made us feel like we were staying at a friends place. The apartment is really bright and has a great view of the river. We really enjoyed having drinks at the terrace. Whole place was really clean and kitchen has more than everything you may need.
If I ever go back to Lisbon I would definitely rent it again.

Nous venons de passer une semaine à Lisbonne dans ce merveilleux appartement, studio avec chambre en mezzanine où rien ne manque! On se sent chez soi, Claudia et son ami savent recevoir et proposent un panier bien garni de bienvenue. L'appartement est au 4ème étage sans ascenseur sous les toits, avec une grande terrasse de rêve pour les petits déjeuners et les apéros ensoleillés!! Pour se faciliter la vie pendant les vacances il y a même à disposition un lave vaisselle, un lave linge... Un grand frigo et un congélateur, machine à café etc...
Nous étions à 15min à pied de la place du commerce de Lisbonne, où il est agréable de savourer un cocktail en fin de journée après une longue marche.
Claudia a été très présente durant toute la semaine, elle répond dans la minute aux mails et aux questions et a plein de bonnes adresses à conseiller...!! Ainsi nous avons toujours bien mangé, nous avons pu profiter d'une super plage qui est à 30min en voiture (d'ailleurs pour les voitures, prévoyez un budget car les parkings souterrains sont très chers et les rues sont payantes, de plus ne laissez pas la voiture au même endroit plusieurs jours de suite car elles sont enlevées au bout de 72h..!!)
Si je peux conseiller un endroit pour dîner : Time out, concept génial avec plusieurs plats de chefs étoilés et des prix très raisonnables... À 10min à pied de l'appartement en longeant les docks vers le centre. Pour le reste, demandez à Claudia, elle saura vous être d'une grande aide !!!
Merci beaucoup à Claudia et son ami, nous gardons un merveilleux souvenir de notre semaine dans cette ville aux 7 collines!
Delphine

Claudia and her brother was a  very nice host and gave us brilliant advices to explore Lisboa. The apartment was clean and comfortable, it has a very nice atmosphere. It was really good located to reach all spots of interest. We can recommend it!!!

Claudia and her boyfriend were very helpful, welcoming and accommodating. Claudia was very fast to respond both before and after my arrival when I had questions. They left a nice welcome basket, which was a lovely surprise! The apartment is great and as described. The balcony is great for a drink on those sunny days!  It is also in a very convenient location. I would definitely recommend it.

It's been 2years we are doing airbnb. It was the 1st time we were so well hosted!
Claudia is a fantastic host! She gave us many tips about the city, provided us everything we needed during our trip. (towels, coffee, excelent tomato jam..)
The flat was well located, near some hotspots. It was well decorated, cosy and we could chill on the terasse with a view on the Tage.
We can only recommend Claudia's place cuz it's a perfect one!
Thanks so much Claudia and see you during our next holidays in Lisboa : )
Claudia was very helpful and easy to deal with. The flat is brilliant. Big balcony, lots of light and easy to get everywhere. I'll try to rent it again next time I go to Lisbon

We had a wonderful time in Claudia's flat. She was a very attentive host and she gave to us very precious advises.
She asked very fast to our mails, and we felt like home in Claudia's space. The flat is very bright, quiet and nicely decorated.
The appartment is well located next to Cais do Sodre a great area ( near to the tram, the subway and the train), and the view over the tage is amazing!

Last but not least: a gift was waiting for us at our arrival!

I recommend this flat,it's a very good place to enjoy the real Lisbonne. Thanks again to Claudia.

Great flat, great location, great host.
Myself and my girlfriend just had a wonderful stay in Lisbon, made all the better by Claudia, who was extremely friendly and helpful with tips for about town. Her flat is perfect for a couple who want to explore and enjoy Lisbon, with everything in walking distance, and a lovely balcony for when you want to stay in.
Great central location, ideal for a long weekend. Very near to the metro and tram system for visits further afield. The hosts were brilliant, really responsive and helpful. Would definitely recommend

I had a great stay in Lisbon, the apartment was perfect for what I was looking for - amazing location where I could walk to places easily. Very central, close to shops, cafés, restaurants, bars, nightlife and tourist attractions etc. I was one person staying but would be ok for two people. The apartment was comfortable and not noisy considering location. And the hosts were excellent- extremely clear information and amenable. I would stay again 😀
Great host, great flat, great location

This was a great Airbnb for our first time in Lisbon! Didn’t notice any noise at night time (but this was in February so unsure if that would impact this). We were able to check in early with Francisco to save carrying our bags around all day, he was great and super informative! The bottle of wine, oranges and juicer and little treats were a nice touch. Couldn’t have asked for anything more from the place or the team. Thank you guys for a lovely stay 😊
A very nice studio with great light and window views.  A perfect location to witness historic Lisboa!

J'ai passé un excellent séjour. Le logement est conforme aux photos et aux descriptions. Il est idéalement placé dans un quartier animé au 5ème étage (sans ascenseur) avec une belle vue. Je recommande vivement ce logement et remercie l'hôte d'avoir été flexible sur l'horaire d'arrivée.

Super bien situé puisqu’on pouvait facilement se rendre à pied aux endroits clés à visiter.  Beaucoup de restos, de jolis cafés et boutiques aux alentours.  Les hôtes répondent rapidement et font preuve d’une grande politesse.  Mon conjoint et moi avons apprécié notre séjour et nous n’hésiterons pas à y retourner si l’occasion se présente ou à recommander à des amis !
The most wonderful stay in the most wonderful location. ☺️
A estadia foi muito tranquila. Tive imprevistos com a chegada em Lisboa mas a todo momento os anfitriões foram compreensivos e comunicativos, prontos para me responder.
Magnifique séjour dans ce fabuleux logement
Very pleasant stay. Host was very helpful before check in and during, providing all necessary information. Apartment was very clean and in amazing location
Pedro was great. He was so flexible with check in and check out and was kind enough to keep our bags for us. We loved the apartment and location🤩 100% recommend
Tudo perfeito, apartamento organizado e com tudo necessario, otima localização e vista, perfeito para um casal. Atendimento e recepção tranquilos, com todas as instruções e recomendações claras

Très bon accueil, le logement était ordonné et propre. Très bien situé et magnifique vue.
Similaire aux photos et à la description.
Great location, easy and flexible check-in and very cosy flat. Everything we needed for a relaxing trip. Highly recommend!
Worked out great, excellent location. High / narrow stairway worth noting in case of mobility issues

The location is excellent to see the walkable sights and restaurants. Check-in was thorough and answered all of our questions. The loft is on the 5th floor, but the steepness of Lisboa's hills will prep you for that. My partner, who is 6'5'', and I fit in this place with ease despite the sloped ceilings. The street is lively, but not crazy, and we had no issue falling asleep. There are two queen-sized beds and a well-equipped kitchen with a washer. We had a car, and the car park was an easy  5-minute walk. This was an excellent choice to stay for our first time in Lisboa. Thank you, Pedro and team.
Excellent endroit, je recommande chaudement!

I had an absolutely fantastic stay! Very clean and in a beautiful neighborhood! Grocery store, restaurants, attractions/sightseeing all close by! Great view from the apartment, especially in the morning and at night! Check in was a breeze, and check out was even easier! The team was always very responsive and gave great recommendations! Apartment and neighborhood felt very safe. Near a lively area and makes you feel very immersed. I will definitely book again if available next time I come back!

Perfect location. The entire stay was so easy and there are so many places to go nearby. There was also a guide in the apartment that gives you so much helpful information. Hosts were so responsive and met me at the check-in with even more advice and it was just the perfect place for my first trip to Lisbon. Will definitely go back if I'm ever in Lisbon.

Es war mein 2. Aufenthalt in diesem Appartement. Pedro und sein Team sind aufmerksame und zuvorkommende Gastgeber.
Die Gegend ist schön, belebt und vieles ist zu Fuss erreichbar.
Gerne wieder!
Absolutely incredible spot to stay in Lisbon. Beautiful view, private room, great location. Can’t wait to come back and stay again!
host super gentile e reattivo, casa accogliente e pulita, posizione ottima.

This place was awesome. Pedro was extremely flexible with my check-in and let me drop my bags off early. Lisbon is HILLY so it helped not to have my luggage while I explored and waited for my check-in time. His place had everything I needed including a powerful shower. After running the Lisbon marathon is was nice to have a shower with a lot of pressure and hot water.
I did bonk my head a few times on the ceiling, but it was comical after I did it several times.
This place is also located right in the center of town with fantastic restaurants surrounding you. I highly recommend his place. You (and your glutes after walking all the stairs and hills around Lisbon) will be grateful you stayed here.
Top locatie om te verblijven! Echt een aanrader. Wij hadden zelf geen last van het geluid van de barretjes, maar wij zijn daar zelf niet zo moeilijk in.

Fantastic apartment! The location is perfect - we loved Chiado, it's so central and it was easy to walk all over Lisbon from here. The views from the apartment over the rooftops were lovely. The host was great too - super friendly and helpful.
Excelente estadia no apartamento do Pedro, muito bem localizado em uma região turística da cidade.
Location 10/10. Host was so kind in accommodating an early arrival.

We had a great stay at the apartment!
Francisco was super responsive, met us at check in and provided us with great recommendations.
The apartment was perfect, in an amazing location and better than we expected.
We are super happy with our stay and would recommend.
Es war sehr schön. Gerne wieder!

We had a wonderful stay at this charming little apartment in the heart of Lisbon! It’s located in a very old building, but the apartment itself has been completely renovated in a modern and stylish way. We especially loved that it even had a washing machine – such a nice convenience during our trip. The location couldn’t be better: right in the center, surrounded by the best restaurants and within easy walking distance to everything. The only small challenge might be the stairs up to the 5th floor, especially with heavy luggage, but even then our super friendly host kindly helped us carry our bags. Overall, a great stay – highly recommended!

Perfect stay - as described, and as pictured. Host was more than hospitable. Enjoyable for our time in Lisbon, perfectly located and very comfortable. The 5 flights of stairs weren’t too bad, as the stairs were a bit steep, but did not feel like a true 5-floor walk up. Would absolutely stay here again and would recommend this to anyone.
Our stay was amazing, great option for this area! Noise was not an issue on the 5th floor even during tourist season.

The place was in a great part of Lisbon, in a sperate unique area with local mom qnd pop.shops and lots of homes above them and not hotels to give you a flavor of the locals but it was also not too far from the more commecial touristy markets that you could walk their when
wanting to. it was a perfect location.

Such a lovely apartment and perfectly situated for exploring the heart of Lisbon.  We loved our stay here and really appreciated the comprehensive list of recommendations of things to do in Lisbon - it was most helpful!
Great location and beautiful place. well worth it

Super gelegene Wohnung, in der ich mich sofort wohl gefühlt habe. Der Raum ist sehr schön eingerichtet und es war alles vorhanden, was für einen angenehmen Aufenthalt benötigt wird. Ich war für drei Nächte dort und konnte sehr gut in dem Airbnb schlafen.
Die Lage ist wirklich exzellent - zahlreiche Cafés und Restaurants sind in unmittelbarer Nähe. Der Komfort des Airbnbs sorgte für die notwendige Entspannung. Ich komme gerne wieder!

Genel olarak oldukça memnun kaldığımız bir konaklama oldu. Konum çok iyiydi. Odaya gece geç girmemiz gerekti ve ev sahibi bize çok yardımcı oldu. Ayrıca geç çıkış için de destek verdiler. Dairenin 5. katta olması ve merdivenlerin hem dik hem de dar olması özellikle bavul taşırken yorucu oldu. Bir de teras dairesi olduğundan kullanılabilir alan biraz kısıtlıydı.

Pedro and his team were incredibly responsive and accommodating throughout our stay. The apartment is in a fantastic location—close to everything you could want: great food, sights, and plenty to explore. The view from the apartment is truly something special. It felt like a home away from home. Beautifully set up, well-stocked with everything we needed, and the bed was unbelievably comfortable. While some past reviews mentioned noise, we honestly didn’t notice a thing. Thank you again, Pedro! We’d absolutely stay here again.
tout était parfait pour notre séjour. nous reviendrons !

This apartment was wonderful. It had everything you needed and was a good size. I found it very clean and welcoming. Pedro and his team made check in easy and allowed me a complimentary slightly later check out, which was very much appreciated.
The location was very central making it easy to get around. That being said, the apartment is on a street where there is always a crowd taking pictures with the tram car and it can get pretty loud at night. Luckily there is a speaker in the apartment so I just played some music to drown out the outside noise. Overall, would recommend this apartment for its central location as long as you don’t mind some crowds and noise.
I had a great stay! Convenient location and lively area, walkable distance to many great restaurants. Hosts very communicative and helpful! Would definitely recommend!

Highly recommend staying at this apartment! It exceeded my expectations. The location is very central and walkable to lots of great cafes and restaurants. The apartment is very comfortable, great bed and shower, plus washing machine. The hosts were great to communicate with and even helped me carry my luggage upstairs. Great place to stay!
Appartamento bello e pulito, in posizione centrale e strategica. Bellissima vista.
We had a fantastic time, flexible check in, great neighbourhood, lovely apartment and our host was super helpful and we appreciated the little welcome gifts. Highly recommend

We loved our first stay in Lisbon, and this apartment made it extra special. It’s located right on the iconic Tram 28 route, we got to experience this must-do attraction right from our doorstep. The view from the window was beautiful, with a clear sightline to the waterfront and the Cristo Rei monument across the river.
The apartment was spotless, well-organized, and in a solid, well-ventilated building. We were welcomed with a bottle of wine, fresh oranges, and a pair of chocolates by the bedside—such thoughtful touches. Coffee and laundry supplies were also provided, so we didn’t have to worry about any of the little essentials.
We appreciated being able to check in early after a morning flight—it made a big difference. Our host’s warmth and energy truly stood out, we felt genuinely welcomed and cared for when he greeted us, walked us through the apartment, and explained how everything worked.
Honestly, this was one of the best stays we’ve had in Portugal. Highly recommended!!!

We loved our stay here in Lisbon and were very grateful for the air conditioning! This space was perfect for us and the access to a washing machine and kitchenette was great. Pedro left us oranges to make orange juice and it was such a nice touch. As mentioned in other reviews and the description, there is no elevator but that didn’t bother us at all. The street gets NOISY at night and that didn’t bother us too much but we were surprised how late the noise went on. Overall this was a great location - close to public transportation and Time Out Market - and we’d stay again!
Was a great stay and was a receptive host

Magnifique studio dans le centre touristique de Lisbonne. Propre, très bien équipé et super accueil de Pedro et son équipe.
Le studio peut etre un peu petit si on est 3 ou 4, mais il est parfait pour 1 ou 2 personnes.
Je suis restée un dimanche et lundi soir, et je n'ai eu aucun problème avec le bruit

We loved staying here! The apartment had everything we needed and was located in a prime, central place in a beautiful and lively part of Lisbon! The air conditioning was awesome, and the views of the city and Tagus River were beautiful! I don't really understand other reviews that complain about the noise - you are on the 5th floor, high above the street. You occasionally hear a muffled laugh or yell, but we barely noticed. The apartment is situated centrally in a very popular and busy part of the city, so some noise is to be expected in this environment - you will encounter it regardless of where you stay in the neighborhood. Overall, we had a great experience and appreciate the hosts!

Pedro is indeed a very nice and friendly host! We had a great time here, will definitely come back :)
The oranges that Pedro bought for us was super sweet! o(^▽^)o

We visited Lisbon at the start of May and we absolutely loved this apartment and the location. The apartment was exactly as described and very clean. The hosts were really communicative and helpful. The bed was so comfy! It's worth bearing in mind that at the weekend it is loud with the bars on the street below at night. But we had seen this mentioned in other reviews and the hosts made us aware upon booking. We both used earplugs and found we got to sleep no prob! The apartment is in such a great spot, making it a great base to get anywhere from. It's on a very popular street but this just added to the novelty for us. There are lots of stairs to get to the room but we didn't mind this and it meant stunning views from the windows. The hosts were very accommodating and even looked after our bags on our last day, as we had an evening flight.
Overall we would highly recommend and would definitely stay again!
Beautiful place, just as described. Had all the essentials needed for a good stay.
Great host, great place and centralised location
Everything was perfect! Lovely apartment in a great location with everything we needed. Couldn't recommend it enough if you are coming to Lisbon!
Nous avons été super bien accueillis ! Et l’emplacement est top !! Nous gardons  un excellent souvenir de Lisbonne.

Die Wohnung liegt mitten im angesagten Gebiet, direkt neben der berühmten gelben Seilbahn. Die Lage hat uns gut gefallen, man ist schnell am Bahnhof oder zB. im Time Out Market mit viel verschiedenem Essen. In alle Richtungen der Wohnung erreicht man interessante Orte.
Der Gastgeber (Joan) war sehr nett und jederzeit für Fragen da.
Die Wohnung ist sauber und hat alles was man für einen Städtetrip braucht.
Ich empfehle sie gerne weiter.
excellent accueil ! on ne pouvait espérer un appart plus central et typique :-)
Perfect location,  and perfect amenities.
Awesome place with extremely nice hosts. Can really recommend 🤩
We had a great stay. The location is great for first timers to Lisbon. The host provided a lot of recommendations for food, activities and sights.
Hosts were very helpful, especially João who gave us a warm welcome on arrival!

My stay here was perfect. This apartment is located on a street that looks like straight out of a postcard. Great views towards the ocean down the street with small trams running up and down the steep street. When I arrived for checkin I was greeted by a very friendly host that gave me a quick tour of the apartment and amenities, which was greatly appreciated. Communication before that was easy and quick as I communicated my arrival time. The apartment itself was exactly as the photos and became a home away from home during my stay there. The street can get lively but the windows have very good soundproofing for when you want it to be more quiet. With them closed I wasn't bothered at all by noice. The location is perfect for sightseeing with so many restaurants, bars, little shops, etc right there and withing walking distance. There are a lot of hills and steps in this neighborhood, which in my opinion only adds the the charm (and gives you cardio for free). Great stay!

Francisco was a fantastic host - myself and my husband had a wonderful stay here in Lisbon. The apartment was spotless. We really appreciated all of Francisco’s recommendations - the area is great. A real find. We’d certainly come back!
Amazing place for 2 people. Very clean and bright. I will definitely book it again
Great place and great host! I highly recommend! Obrigado 👏🏻🇵🇹
Cute and clean unit in a great part of Lisbon!
amazing!

It was in an extremely convenient location close to everything. Other comments mentioned about the possible noise, which was also mentioned by the host, however, once the window was closed, I could barely hear anything. Maybe it was the time of the year (late Nov), but there wasn't much partying after midnight on a Friday night either.
Loved the airbnb and made Lisbon an unforgettable experience!

L'hôte a été très accommodant en nous permettant d'arriver plus tôt. Tout était très propre et nous avons apprécié le cadeau de bienvenue. Cependant, nous n'avons pas été capable de bien dormir les deux nuits, il y a un bar et énormément de mouvement et de bruit dans la rue. Ceci a malheureusement gâché notre séjour, c'est bien dommage car il s'agit d'un beau logement.
Great location, great host and great stay. Thank you so much

ci siamo trovati benissimo, accoglienza super da parte di Francisco. E stato molto disponibile e gentile e ci è venuto incontro anche con gli orari di check in. La posizione è fantastica, comoda ai mezzi e non siamo stati disturbati per nulla da rumore, musica o altri rumori. appartamento pulitissimo e dotato di tutti i comfort. Unico tasto dolente il quinto piano, di cui comunque eravamo stati informati e dettaglio ricordatoci ancora dall'host prima della partenza. Ma nonostante noi non siamo per nulla sportivi non è stato un problema nemmeno con le valigie! consigliatissimo!!
Cute little apartment on a very popular and scenic street! Nice location and the interior was very clean.
Everything about the stay was fantastic - would highly recommend!
Great location, plenty of things to do and see around the place. Host was very communicative, helpful and friendly. Gave us many great recommendations as well. 10/10
Very friendly Host, nice flat, perfect location.
Absolutely loved staying here! Instructions were very helpful and clear. Great area that’s super walkable.

Die Wohnung war genau wie beschrieben und befand sich in einer erstklassigen Lage. Das Team hat uns stets perfekt behandelt und unterstützt. Wir fühlten uns rundum wohl und gut aufgehoben. Ein kleiner Nachteil war jedoch, dass es in der Nacht etwas laut war. Trotzdem empfehlenswert!

After our trip ended in Lisbon I cannot think of a better place to stay than here. It is central, right outside there is vibrant day and nightlife, beautiful views, comfortable space, and responsive/attentive host. Any question was answered in the matter of minutes.
Keep in mind that this is a fifth floor and it’s on one of the most photographed roads in Lisbon, so for us who were looking to be immersed in the Lisbon life, and wanted an unmatched view this place was ideal.
I’d recommend this spot without a question!
Great locale. Host was very good communicator. Clean. Comfortable. Be prepared for a 5-floor walkup. Could have used another bath-towel or two. We'd go back for sure.
Had a fantastic stay at Pedro’s place! Beautiful design and central location. He and his team were very friendly, quick to respond, and accommodating!
Lovely stay in Lisbon! Would definitely recommend. Thanks, Pedro!

Really beautiful apartment that makes you feel at home. A great amount of windows gives this space great natural sunlight. (There are block-out blinds for night/morning). Centrally located to walk to everything.
Great stay in the heart of Lisbon. The place was very clean and the hosts were great to communicate with.  Definitely recommend
Très beau séjour à Lisbonne. Appartement propre, bien situé, à proximité de plusieurs attraits touristiques et bons restaurants.
Perfect stay
Great locations, excellent hosts and a clean and comfortable place.
The perfect place to stay in Lisbon.
Excellent séjour dans un appartement extrêmement bien situé. Merci encore.

Great location, exactly as listed and shown in the photos. Highly recommend for bars, cafes, restaurants, and site seeing. Noise can be longer into the night but that's what's expected with the location and nightlife in Lisbon. I'd visit again.

Pedro, João, and Antonio were all quick to respond to messages and any questions I had. Had a TON of great recommendations on places to go and food to eat. The space itself was located in a vibrant and active part of the city, both during the day and at night.

This place could not be a better place to stay when experiencing Lisbon for the first time or anytime for that matter. My girlfriend and I were greeted wonderfully when we first arrived and taken care of the whole time, everything is in walking distance, the train station is close and good restaurants are close. It was an amazing stay! Could not pick a better place in Lisbon!

Pedro was an amazing host! He was very responsive to any questions we had about the area. The apartment was beautifully set up and in a great location in Lisbon. The WiFi worked well and he was kind enough to provide us with a remote hotspot we can take to the beach. I highly recommend this airbnb to anyone traveling to Lisbon.
Super Wohnung und top Lage. Pedro und das Team sind sehr gute Gastgeber und immer gut zu erreichen. Hatten eine super Zeit in Lissabon mit der Wohnung.
Amazing property and location, and the hosts were extremely accomodating - I even received a free upgrade to Loft 12! Highly recommended for anyone looking to explore Lisbon.

The place was smaller in person. The second mattress is on top of a ledge over the bathroom. Had everything to make it confortable. However, on the second night I was covered on my face, torso and legs with bites. They were very itching and blistered up and turned to hives. I contacted the host and Francisco was quick to come by and offered us another apartment. He was proactive in moving us out of the first apartment. They cleaned the place and claim to have not found bed bugs. I’m home and still have hives and itching for which I’m taking steroids as Benadryl isn’t quite cutting it.

Beautiful, hygge flat in the centre of Lisbon. The best places we ate were all within 15 mins walk of the flat, yes it’s somewhat noisy with the bar but if you’re okay with that (coming from London noise isn’t really an issue) then you’ll be fine :)
As hosts they had THE BEST recommendations. 10/10
Definitely coming back!

Pedro was an excellent host and the location is incredible. There are many local and delicious restaurants/bakeries walking distance away! In addition to the apartment being beautiful, Pedro was very helpful and was flexible when my flight was delayed.

O apartamento era muito bonito e estaba muito bem situado, cerca do metro e algumas ruas principais. É um quinto com umas escadas un pouco difíciles e sem ascensor, mais isso não foi muito problema.
