Tem todas as cosas necessárias para estar aí alguns dias e é bastante cómodo para três pessoas. É verdade que nós não passamos muito tempo no apartamento, mais fora nas ruas de Lisboa, visitando a cidade e no concerto de Taylor Swift.
Foi uma experiencia maravilhosa e Pedro e seus companheiros foram muito amables e nós fizeram sentir como na nossa casa.
Excelente e muito recomendado. Voltaremos sem lugar a dúvidas.

The apartment was accurately described, very clean and tidy and a beautiful view out of the window. It is located right in heart of everything, cafes and restaurants located within a 5 min walk.
We were met at the apartment by our host, he was very friendly, helpful and recommended places to eat and visit during our stay.
Would definitely recommend 😁

Wow! Great location! Literally on the steps of the historic funicular/tram! All points of interest are walkable. A mini mart/convenience store for all your needs, be it a short or long stay. Many good restaurants around! Pedro and his team were very accommodating at our request for early check-in. Rui welcomed us and showed us around the room and explained everything with detail. One slight con, depending on your noise sensitivity, is that while the room being on the 5th floor + the windows providing great  noise isolation, it is very noisy right outside as there is a small bar that can get rowdy at times, that and the throng of other tourists during the afternoon to evening hours at the tram. You might be able to hear the noise just a little bit. Just a heads up! Still worth it!

This place is a great find. The rental is actually managed by a team of incredibly friendly locals who, working together, make sure that you are never confused and always looked after. The space gave us a great and memorable “insider” experience in Lisbon and it was almost funny to have all the “other tourists” taking pictures of the famous elevator car outside our front door. Perfect for a couple looking to walk and explore. Checking in, we felt like we were being welcomed by more of a concierge than a host. And the host was very flexible with our changing check-in requests and even some help holding our bags upon check-out for a short time. Full and genuine recommendation for someone interested in the kind of space that is described in the listing.

Pedro’s place was lovely! Very clean and thoughtfully appointed with a good setup for 2 people. It is conveniently located and walkable (right on the street with the famous yellow train car!) in a popular area with lots to do. Good shower, AC, comfy beds, and the washer was also very helpful mid trip. Only thing to consider is the ceilings are quite low, as pictured, so do watch your head, especially when climbing up the ladder to the loft. We overall had a lovely stay and would definitely come back again. Thank you!

Exzellentes Apartment. Wir liebten unsere Zeit in Lissabon& die Wohnung hat den perfekten Standort. Die Gastgeber sind sehr freundlich, hilfsbereit und flexibel.
Daaanke& wir kommen wieder!😍🙌🏽
This place in Lisbon is quaint and beautiful! Perfect location and walking distance from major things to do/see in Lisbon. I’d highly recommend this place!

We were very happy with our stay in this studio. The location is absolutely perfect.
The hosts were very nice and very accommodating. The studio has everything that you need. I would book this studio again!
Perfect location and apartment, the best communication I’ve ever had with a host - thank you!

this accommodation was perfect. In the heart of the centre, it was so easy. The view is stunning. The bed is very comfortable. And if you don't sleep with open windows, it is perfectly quiet. I can recommend 100%! I will for sure book this accommodation again once I come back.
Très bel appartement dans un quartier vivant.
Great apartment and location was perfect! Host was incredibly kind and helpful! Highly recommend this place! Big bonus for us was the washing machine in the apartment!

Ich hatte einen tollen Aufenthalt in dieser außergewöhnlich schönen Wohnung. Das Apartment ist toll ausgestattet. Sehr sauber !  Der Kontakt zu den Vermietern war prima. Lage ist absolut perfekt. Ich kann alles zu 100% empfehlen.
Emplacement incroyable, accueil très chaleureux et appartement très propre et bien équipé.

Wir waren super happy mit der Unterkunft. Es war sehr sauber. Die Lage ist perfekt, um die Stadt zu Fuß zu erkunden. In direkter Nähe gibt es super Cafés, Restaurants und Bars. Ich würde sofort wiederkommen.

L’altra mento è in un’area di grande movida, ottimo per visitare Lisbona. Essendo al quinto pink non si sente il rumore della strada. Ci sono le scale da fare per salire, per noi non è stato un problema.
Host gentilissimi e molto attenti.
Grazie

Amazing location - close to everything you could need. Very thorough check in with Pedro and as he mentions in the description - the noise from outside did not bother my sleep at all!!! Great place!  Stairs are tough with luggage - without luggage you are completely fine.

Wir hatten eine tolle Zeit in Lissabon. Die Wohnung war toll und wie beschrieben. In den Straßen ist es nachts recht laut, aber die Fenster isolieren ziemlich gut und wir konnten problemlos schlafen. Die Lage ist super zentral alles in allem ein toller Urlaub

The apartment is very centrally located, and is easy to get to. It was very clean and comfortable, with an abundance of amenities for our few days stay. We were greeted by one of the hosts who was very friendly, he explained everything we needed to know about the accommodation and the area. The bar on the street outside was noisy at night however this wasn’t an issue for us, it was more background noise. The view from the window is beautiful! This was an ideal apartment for us, we would recommend. Thank you Pedro and team!

We‘ve been having some very nice days, the apartment was clean, Fransisco gave good tips and explained everything that was important for staying there. That was really great! You can reach anything from the apartment, the subway is like quick 10 min away - even if maps says different. You can even walk through the city its not that big and its absolutely pretty. Even though there is a bar downstairs its rather quiet, you hear shattering but not too loud. We really enjoyed it and absolutely recommend!

L’équipe a été très réactive et Rui a été très accueillant. L’appartement est parfaitement situé et bien équipé.
Nous recommandons pour un séjour de quelques jours.

This is a stylish well-equipped apartment right in the heart of Chiado in an iconic location in Lisbon overlooking the Bica Funicular. It had everything we needed for our two day stay with a Minipreço just around the corner to pick up groceries. There was a little bottle of wine left as a welcoming gift and a big basket of oranges ready for breakfast which was much appreciated.
I stayed here with my teenage son who loved the single bed way up in the roof space. Both beds have high quality mattresses and both of us slept well. We arrived on a Friday night so the bars in the street outside were lively, but the activity settled later in the evening and didn’t stop us sleeping well. I travel with earplugs but didn’t need to use them to sleep.
This is a unique space in Lisbon that will appeal to those who love something a bit different. I will definitely stay here again.

Amazing location, super comfy apartment, and incredibly cozy bed. I was warmly welcomed and given a full tour of the amenities. They also had some amazing recommendations for food and activities. I would absolutely stay here again!

Il soggiorno è stato perfetto: host sempre disponibile, reattivo e flessibile … abbiamo fatto late check-out che ci ha permesso di girare la città anche l’ultimo giorno. L’appartamento è molto carino e la poso ottima! Consigliato il soggiorno! Grazie !!!
Cozy and clean, very well located.

Highly recommend all the other reviews are a perfect depiction of this air bnb. I will definitely be booking again. We had 3 adults stay here - the bed up the ladder was a bit precarious to get up but not too much trouble for an able bodied person
Perfect spot to stay when you want the Lisbon experience. Location was central to everything you would want to see. Great space!

We had such a fantastic start to our Portugal trip with Pedro, Joao, and Rui as our hosts. The space was a cool layout and had a beautiful view of the city. As other guests have mentioned, the surrounding area could get a little loud at night, but it did not bother us at all (in fact, it rallied us to go out one of the nights when we thought we’d call it in early).
Another thing to note, the flat did not have a lift/elevator, but to be expected with many of the historic buildings in Lisbon.
Would highly recommend booking this Airbnb!

This place was excellent. With the iconic funicular right outside your door and views of the sea, this apartment was perfect for a few people. It was well equipped, the bed was comfortable, and the heat/AC worked well. There was a little noise from the street, but being on the top floor, it wasn’t very loud or bothersome. It is in the heart of a very walkable area with lots of nightlife and is right next to public transport. I will definitely stay here for my next trip!
The apartment was clean, quiet and in an excellent location.  Francisco was an attentive host and we really enjoyed our stay.

Accoglienza ottima.
Consigli utili riguardo a ristoranti e luoghi da vedere.
Disponibilità a soddisfare le richieste, come prenotare il taxi per il rientro. L’appartamento è davvero carino e confortevole, in una posizione centrale e caratteristica. Unica pecca i cinque piani di scale ma valgono la pena del soggiorno.
Consigliatissimo.
Had a great few nights here. Excellent location close to main areas of Lisbon with cafes, shops and restaurants close by

Had a lovely time in Lisbon ! the team is great, super responsive and attentive to our questions and needs
The apartment was exactly what we needed, super central, spotless and cozy
Strongly recommend

Студиото е на едно от най-правилните места за обикаляне на Лисабон.
Сградата в която се намира е много интересна и автентична.
Самото студио е оборудвано с всичко което може да ви е необходими по време на престоя.
Благодаря за гостоприемството на екипа на Chiado Loft.
Бих отседнал отново там!

An absolute all time favorite, loved this airbnb, the hosts were so kind, and helpful. Truly felt so safe and at home, it was in a perfect location where it was peaceful but only a couple streets away from main attractions. Beautiful airbnb clean, cozy. Loved everything about this stay.

The accommodation was simply wonderful! The three of us stayed there for four nights and it was definitely great for the period. You can walk to many bakeries, bars and restaurants very quickly. Everything is already furnished, really well equipped and simply very nice! I can highly recommend this accommodation!

We were greeted by Rui when we arrived and he was friendly and helpful. Great location. So close to the restaurants, shopping and markets (Mini Preco 2 mins away for necessities). There is a bar across the street/tram line, but it is a dull noise that cannot be noticed when you shut the window. This place has what you need packed into a small space, but I would only recommend it for two people max. Bonus, it has a washing machine (make sure you turn on the Power Switch in the kitchen to use it). If you're of Hobbit size, the best spot in this loft is actually the top mattress above the bathroom. It is nice and warm. Again, full points for location, there is simply so much to do in the vicinity.

Pedor's place is fantastic. It's hom away from home and close to many beautiful spots in Lisbon. The host was very responsive and even offered to help keep my bag on my checkout day. I highly recommend it.

Estuvimos encantadas en este apartamento. Los anfitriones (en nuestro caso Antonio) estuvieron muy pendientes de que todo estuviera genial y fueron muy amables y detallistas. El apartamento es una pasada a pesar de ser pequeño, tiene de todo y el aislamiento acústico y térmico es genial. Además está en una zona preciosa.
Great location. Beautiful spot. Lots of activity in the streets at night with the nightlife but in the apartment you can’t hear any of it so it was great.

Sehr empfehlenswerte, helle, geschmackvoll eingerichtete, kleine, saubere, gemütliche, mit öffentl. Verkehrsmitteln gut erreichbare, offene Wohnung unter dem Dach ( 5. Etage, ausschließlich über Treppen erreichbar) mit wahnsinnig schönen Ausblick über die Dächer bis hin zum Tejo und zur Cristo-Rei Statue.
Weiterhin ist das Appartement gut gelegen, da unmittelbar im lebhaften Stadtzentrum, mit allen nützlichen Gegenständen für Küche, Bad, Unterhaltungstechnik, Raumtemperaturregelung für kalt und warm..... einfach fantastisch!
Besonders erwähnenswert ist der freundliche Service und die großartige und schnelle Hilfsbereitschaft von Petro und seinem Team António, Rui und Franciso, was den Aufenthalt sehr angenehm macht!
Ich bedanke mich nochmals und komme gern wieder.
Maravillosa vista, bella habitación, excelente servicio, muy recomendable.

Nous avons passé 3 nuits dans ce très beau logement, propre, impeccable et proche de tout à pieds.
Pour deux, le logement et largement assez spacieux.
L’hôte a été très sympathique, a très bien expliqué les services qu’offrait l’appartement.
Je recommande vivement pour un séjour à Lisbonne.

Nous avons passé 4 jours "chez Pedro" . La communication a été excellente et nous a aidé pour notre arrivée à Lisbonne, pour trouver l'appartement mais aussi les restaurants et commerces autours . Logement impeccable ! Oui bien sûr , 5 étages à monter mais vous êtes juste devant le funiculaire de Bicca ( vraiment au pied !). Super quartier du Bairo Alto. Pas de bruit lors de notre visite après 22H30 .
L'appartement est cosy et très bien agencé. La hauteur sous plafond sur la mezzanine est très réduite pour aller s'installer sur le lit ; la literie est de qualité.
La vue est très belle , jusqu'au Tage !!! On peut voir le Cristo Rei illuminé la nuit !
Je recommande sans souci cette location et vous invite à venir visiter la magnifique ville de Lisbonne !

Pedro was absolutely polite and helpful. He was flexible with the check in.
The place was beautiful and really clean.
Excellent location. I definitely will return!
Thank you for a wonderful stay on Lisboa ! Everything went great, the appartement is perfect and the host very sympathetic !

Awesome place! Location, cleaning and host attention was 10/10. Would totally recommend.
Do keep in mind that there are many stairs and no elevator, so traveling with heavy luggage can make it more chellenging.
But for the rest, it was perfect! We were received with wine, oranges, coffee and Jam. Great amenities.
Thank you! We will definitely be back :)

This apartment is for those who want to be in the center of life. Right under the windows is the funicular and the street with bars. But the apartment has good sound insulation and also great view from the windows.
You’ll have everything you need!
Recommend🔥
Für einen Städtetrip war die Unterkunft völlig ausreichend. Am Abend ist es doch ein wenig lauter weil sich gegenüber eine Bar befindet.

We had a great stay at this air bnb! It’s in a perfect location for getting around Lisbon and exploring all the popular spots. Lots of restaurants within walkable distance. It’s noisy at night because of the busy area but this didn’t bother us at all. The space was very clean and comfortable!
The apartment is small but very cozy. Me and my wife had a wonderful time. The location is just perfect - close to everything you need to see. We would definitely book it again.

Great place to stay in Lisbon! In the heart of the busy city, next to countless restaurants and bars. Short walk to train and metro stations. The place was clean and beautiful with a gorgeous view, and the hosts are wonderful - there are booklets filled with local recommendations! Thanks for a great stay!!

The place was amazing! Had everything we needed and was in the best spot to explore all around Lisbon. The room was clean and beautifully presented, with some extra touches that made our stay even better. Would definitely recommend!
Todo muy bueno prolijo y ordenado. excelente ubicación
Very friendly welcome on arrival, the place was perfect for us (couple) and on the doorstep from main central attractions. Although it’s in the ‘party’ area it was pretty quiet from the top floor.

Great location in the cultural heart of Lisbon. There was always a party outside on the road, but the windows were thick enough that it didn’t bother us sleeping. Cozy, clean and comfortable. All around a great experience.

A very clean apartment that has everything needed and fully matches the description. Francisco met us, provided clear instructions and answered all questions.
We enjoyed staying in the apartment.
Eine sehr niedliche Unterkunft mit allem, was man für ein paar Tage Städtetrip braucht. Schönes Bad, kleine ausreichende Küche. Danke auch für den netten Empfang und die hilfreichen Ausflugstipps!

Céntrico, limpio y con trato cordial. Muy amables en todo momento.
Altamente recomendable.

We stayed in Pedro's apartament 3 night. The apartament is excellent, it is small, but you find there everything you need. Rui and Pedro welcomed US very friendly and explained how everything works. The location is superb. IT was one of the best places we' ve stayed with Airbnb. Thanks a lot !!!! Obrigados

Bellissimo appartamento, forse un po’ piccolo per 4 ma super accogliente.
Pulito e in un’ottima posizione.
Host super disponibile e cordiale.
We really enjoyed our time at Pedro’s!  I would stay here again for sure!

The stay was fantastic! You stay in a beautifully decorated loft, where our hosts provided some great amenities. The real highlight is the location though. You are right outside of the famous tram and there are always lively people on the street, both locals and tourists. I couldn’t recommend a better place to stay in Lisbon for exploring the city.

Fantastic service, apartment and stay.
Amazing location, street does get busy but the windows are soundproof and top floor so you can’t hear anything.
The team communicated quickly, often, and helped as much as they could.
Instructions weren’t super clear to get to the property, but we found it in the end with someone to let us in.
Thanks Pedro and team for a wonderful stay.
Thank you! Highly recommend
It’s a great place to stay. Really cozy and well located.
Très bien situé et bel endroit. L'hôte rend la chose facile et explications très claires.

If you come to Lisbon you need to stay here. The apartment is clean, cosy and thoughtfully designed and equipped. Whether you're here for a short stay or a long stay you're perfectly situated in Lisbon. The hosts are accommodating and very helpful and easy to communicate with. We didn't want to leave!
This was a very nice air bnb! The location was great too. The hosts were very helpful and responsive.

Host is great — responsive, courteous, friendly. The loft is beautiful. Had just what we needed for 3 ladies. This apartment unit is on the last floor (floor 5) in a building without an elevator. Note this when you book as I travelled with a larger suitcase.   Overall. I would stay here again, maybe this time with a smaller suitcase (haha).
Great place.  Great location.

Really friendly host and great location. Was a little loud at night so maybe not for the light sleepers. Also, we were able to squeeze 4 people but definitely would recommend only 3 at a time for others (we didn’t realize one of the beds wasn’t a double from the photos). Overall, great experience and host.

This place was a GEM. Literally in the center of everything (on a very touristy street so definitely something to consider but exactly what we wanted)! The hosts were so thoughtful and left us little gifts that really added such a nice touch to our trip. Check-in was amazing — thank you to Francisco for the helpful walkthrough. Could not recommend this cute, cozy loft more!
This Airbnb was perfect! It was a great location, the host was hospitable and the place itself was lovely. Highly recommend.
very nice and cozy loft

This place and this host was amazing! I had to back out of the trip last minute and Pedro granted my friends and I a refund for having one less person. We also scheduled for one day early and Pedro was super helpful on meeting us the day we arrived instead. My friends said the place was in a fantastic area, super clean, and very helpful hosts. Amazing!!

This was one of my favourite Airbnb stays ever! The apartment was beautiful, so well located, and clean. The team was absolutely amazing as well - quick responses, always helpful, great recommendations, and they were very kind to help us with our luggage after checkout because our flight was later in the evening. This is a must-stay in Lisbon! ☺️
Great stay - 5 stars all the way. Thank you Pedro, Antonio and Francisco!

Really enjoyed our stay in Lisbon. Pedro’s apartment was nicely decorated, comfortable and clean. Pedro and his colleagues were so helpful and friendly - regular communication, easy check in and out, super flexible and accommodating. The location does mean a fair bit of noise at nighttime - not a massive issue for us as we already knew this from other reviews, but therefore may not be suitable for everyone. Location wise - we found it really easy to get around the city and explore from the apartment - sometimes on foot and sometimes by Uber. Overall a lovely stay. Thanks!

Absolutely fantastic location in Chiado. Cool vibe and extremely walkable. Pedro was super responsive and flexible with our arrival when we had some delays. The apartment was clean, well outfitted (but no umbrellas for the rainy days we had). Would absolutely recommend. I wouldn’t give it a 4 overall, rather a 4.75, only because the second bed was simply not useable. It was up a steep ladder and a mattress without any railing on the ledge above the bathroom. The sloped ceiling over the main bed was interesting too. Be mindful of lots and lots of stairs to climb when you’re packing your bags.
Super tolles Apartment in einer sehr belebten Gegend. Alles sauber und schön eingerichtet. Die Lage war top!
Amazing place to stay with incredible hosts! The location was perfect with plenty of places to walk to and the view of the water is lovely. Definitely will be staying here again!

This apartment was fantastic, clean with a great view. Also quirky!
The apartment was in a great location and we could walk everywhere.
Buzzy area and full of bars and restaurants.
Would recommend!
Best Airbnb I’ve been so far! Would love to stay longer.

Beautiful apartment. In a great location. Despite being in the heart of things the noise from the street couldn’t be heard with the windows shut. Beautifully clean and well presented with everything you could need.

Die charmante Dachgeschosswohnung ist der perfekte Ausgangspunkt, im Lissabon zu Fuß oder per Straßenbahn zu erkunden. Die Gegend ist sehr belebt und es bleibt bis spät in die Nacht laut, was uns aber nicht gestört hat.
Die Wohnung haben wir in einem sehr sauberen Zustand und mit super Küchenausstattung angetroffen.
António war ein sehr freundlicher Ansprechpartner und die Kommunikation mit ihm verlief reibungslos.
Wirklich toller Aufenthalt! Wir können dieses AirBnB sehr empfehlen. :)
Great host, so responsive! The place is perfect - nicely styled and so clean. Great for a couple exploring Lisbon! Right on the tram line too.

Apartamento muy céntrico para recorrer Lisboa a pie. A diez minutos de las estaciones de tren de Cais do Sodre y Rossio desde donde puedes ir a Cascais, Belém y Sintra.
El apartamento es muy acogedor, limpio y ideal para parejas, tal vez un poco pequeño para una familia de cuatro. En nuestro caso, que somos cuatro, solo lo utilizamos para dormir y desayunar y fue perfecto.

This was a great stay! Pedro was so nice and accommodating. After a long night of traveling he allowed us to check in early. He was very nice and showed us how to use everything in the apartment. The location was PERFECT. It was right in the mix of the city. It was noisy at night until late hours in the morning but we didn’t mind because we were up anyway. Really great for a couple or solo traveler. Thanks!!

We had a wonderful 4 days in Lisbon and staying at this loft apartment in Chiado really was the icing on the cake. It was in a fantastic location, right in the centre of Chiado's restaurants, bars and cafes with easy access on foot to Bairro Alto, Cais do Sodre and Chiado Baixo. Being on the 5th floor, it was surprisingly peaceful, with the only noise being on the Saturday night when when the surrounding streets were full of people. The area is really picturesque, with incredible sunsets looking down the hill towards the lift.
The loft itself was clean, modern, well equipped and really homely. We were welcomed with wine, chocolates and jam as well some useful recommendations for places to eat and visit. I'd highly recommend staying here and would definitely stay again. Only proviso would be for anyone with mobility issues, since there isn't a lift.

We had a fantastic stay! The studio apartment is on the top floor, in the eves of a 400 year old or so building, with beautiful architecture features inside, and an excellent view of the Cristo Rei and water. The apartment has been well updated and finished, with a modern bathroom and kitchen. It was very clean and well decorated. Small touches such as welcome chocolates were well appreciated! Appeared as in the photos. Black out blinds included. Walking distance to many shops, restaurants, bars and the water front. Great if you want a spot within the happening part of town that is clean, has a cool vibe in a historic building. Hosts were very helpful, friendly and communicative. There are several 24/7 car parks close by as you can’t park directly in front of the building. Would totally stay again!

We were so impressed by this space! Knowing it was a bit on the smaller size, we were thrilled to find it had everything we were looking for, including a washing machine, detergent, and drying rack!
We communicated with Rui and Antonio primarily and they informed us that the apartment is located where a lot of bars are open at night and that it can get a bit noisy. They asked if we were comfortable with this and said if not, they would help us find another spot. We were happy to find that the fifth floor accommodations early negated any noise from the street below.
With such a central location, this property could not have been a better choice for us! The one thing that was a bit of a downside was the lack of an outlet in the loft space. We were able to come up with a solution with a bit of creativity, but that’s really the only thing we can think of. We feel very lucky to have been able to stay in such a great space. Many thanks to Pedro, Rui, Antonio, and the rest of their team!
Great little spot in Lisbon. Well located.
Our stay was lovely. We loved being in the city and close to restaurants, the water, and main attractions. Pedro was very responsive and helpful. Definitely will be visiting Portugal again.

Had a lovely stay here! The flat is a bit smaller than expected and does not have an elevator but there is so much to see in Lisbon it’s a central place to relax and rest up for the next adventure. Wifi can be a bit spotty fyi and can get a little noisy at night but it didn’t prevent us from having a great time.
perfect location, very clean and totally uncomplicated hosts. recommended!
Great host, couldn't have done more for us and in a great location.
Lovely apartment in a great location! Felt right at home. Hosts were  friendly, responsive and flexible with checking in/out - 10/10 would recommend!

Great apartment in a great location with great communication from the team, very flexible host, met at the apartment and shown how to operate everything. Very clean and comfortable, we were made aware of possible issue of noise at night but, for us, it was not an issue at all. Overall, a great experience. Thanks Pedro, Antonio and Francisco.

It was a great delight staying in the apartment. The location is very advantageous for those who want to have everything at their doorstep. The team was very accommodating and responsive to any requests and their recommendations is a great aid for breakfast to dinner options. I am looking forward to going back to Lisbon and stay again.
Great place. Hosts super accommodating.

Really clear info prior to arrival, we knew exactly where to go. We were greeted by Antonio who was very helpful, explained everything clearly about the apartment & gave recommendations for local area.
A really vibrant neighbourhood, lots of quirky bars & restaurants literally on the doorstep, and accessible for anywhere you wanted to go in Lisbon.
Obrigado
Great ubication, apartment clean, exactly as in the ad, fluent communication as well.

Lovely place, very clean and has a great view of the Christo rei. I was greeted at the place and was given thorough instructions (and provided printed ones as well) on how to operate the various machines. They also provided useful information about Lisbon, gave welcome wine. The neighbourhood is fairly close to the timeout market, and rua augusta and has an iconic tram right at the doorstep.  Now negatives. They did warn about the noise which I brushed it off - but I got woken up many times because I could hear it all the way to the 5th floor (which is a difficult climb). I would say this neighbourhood and place is perfect for someone who enjoys shopping, partying and socialising.

The Apartment is really pretty and cozy. There was everything you could need, like Dishwasher, coffe machine, washmashine, ironing board etc. The communication with pedro was really easy. If you want to enjoy the nightlife in Lisbon, this apartment is perfect for you like for me and my friend!
Everything was great, we'll definetly visit again!! Thanks Pedro!
Charming loft with everything at hand. Great hosts who are really helpful and add little personal touches to make you feel welcome.

Had an amazing weekend break in Lisbon and and loved staying in this apartment. Nice view from the window and within walking distance of main attractions and so many bars and restuarants. Very well designed space that feels spacious and cosy with all amenities needed to cook a meal or chill and listen to music, would very happily stay here again.
One of the best Airbnbs I’ve stayed. Clean, confortable, good location, and has everything you need for a short stay. Kudos to the hosts who were really nice & friendly and always very responsive.

Great place in a wonderful neighbourhood. Everything was perfect from start to finish! The only thing to keep in mind (which is listed in the description) is that it’s in the middle of the bar area so it can get quite loud in the evening/night. If you like a place that’s in the main hub of action then this apartment will be perfect for you.
Great hospitality! The noise didn’t bother if you close the window. The location is excellent.

Great location in the heart of Lisbon. The apartment is ideal for a couple, but it can accommodate 3 persons like it was my case. Pedro and his staff are just amazing. If you have too many luggages, the 5th floor w/o elevator can be a challenge.
I highly recommend this accommodation. It locates in the center of Lisbon and pretty convenient to access to famous places for sightseeing. The host is always kind and helps us politely.
A cosy apartment in an excellent location. Would recommend.
Besides the climbing up to the fifth floor, we totally enjoyed the stay. Great place with nice resturants. Special thank Fransico for helping us with the luggages. Great host.

Everything was great!
Nice place in the center, easy communication and everything is as we saw in the photos.

Lovely little loft apartment in a great location!
Very clean. Comms with the host were second to none.
Would definitely stay again if I was in Lisbon.
Awesome stay, wonderful place!! Would definitely recommend others and come back next time!

It was very authentic on an awesome touristic street. The apartment itself was so great we stayed the 3 of us and enjoyed spending time in the apartment as well as walk around. Everything is walking distance
Great place to stay if you want to be in the heart of this lively district. The hosts are readily accessible to answer any questions and the suite is immaculate with a great view.

I had a wonderful time. The apartment is close to everything and really comfortable. The check-in was easy, and he was extremely nice about the fact that my phone ran out of battery so I couldn’t find them for a while. (Which I really appreciated). Easy communication. Can’t recommend this place enough.
Thanks for a great stay, it’s a lovely apartment in an ideal location for exploring Lisbon! The owners were always really helpful and speedy with any questions.

My daughter and I had a wonderful stay.  The apartment is adorable with a fantastic view. It's in a great location close to lots of restaurants and bars.  Pedro was great at responding to any questions we had.  The stairs up to the 5th floor are definitely a workout.  We had a lot of luggage, so that was challenging. But other than that,  I highly recommend staying here. I would definitely go back!
Wonderful location, near all of the sights we wanted to see. On a busy street but you can't hear it at night in the room! All of the amenities needs and a great host!
Cute place!

Wir waren leider nur zwei Tage in Pedros Unterkunft zu Gast, haben den Aufenthalt aber rundum genossen! Die Lage ist wirklich perfekt, die Wohnung super sauber und gemütlich, wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Pedro und sein Team waren sehr hilfsbereit und bei allen Fragen immer zu erreichen. In der Wohnung erhält man auch tolle Lissabon-Tipps und der Blick aus dem Fenster ist ein absolutes Highlight. Weil unten an der Straße einige Bars sind, kann es abends (wir waren am Wochenende da) ein bisschen lauter werden - dafür ist eben aber auch die Lage umso toller :-)
Great property with great management!
We had a great time, as mentioned it can be loud but ear plugs are fine. It’s in a great central spot and was great to walk from, had all we needed
The apartment is beautiful with amazing views and great amenities. Everything was clean and comfortable. We had such a great time there!
Great place to stay in a great location. Plenty of bars and restaurants in walking location and only 5 mins away from the metro. Pedro was great at responding too whenever we needed anything.

Loved my stay here, waking up to the view from the window in the morning is something else! Ideal location - easy to get around from here and appreciated the suggestions on things to do and see from Rui. Lovely snug apartment perfect for the long weekend. Would 100% come stay again.
Très beau appartement

We had a very nice stay at this AirB&B! The location was nice and the apartment itself was clean and well-decorated. Also, our host was very friendly in welcoming us and made check-in very smooth!  Only complaint was all the stairs to get up to the apartment and it was a little bit noisy at night. Other than that, we really enjoyed our stay!

We’d give 6 stars for everything if we could! What a lovely, stylish, thoughtfully decorated apartment! Great location, super easy to communicate with Rui, he was very helpful and accommodating. We surely will be back!

Great owners of the apartment super attentive in check-in, giving recommendations & throughout the stay.
Would recommend highly and the location is really great.
great location, super clean and comfortable!
Had a great stay at Chiado Loft, had everything I needed, the apartment had a nice modern design and was located perfectly. Would love to stay again
The perfect appartement in Lisbon. Super clean and in the middle of the city.
Brilliant location. Clean. Lovely apartment.
Apartamento muy bonito y acogedor, como aparece en las fotos, muy bien situado y muy buena atención por parte de los anfitriones

Nossa estadia foi maravilhosa. O loft é aconchegante e bem equipado. Eram dias de muito calor e fizemos uso do ar condicionado, o que nos deixou ainda mais  relaxados. A cama é muito confortável. Nossa filha de 7 anos também amou o loft e isso o faz especial também para famílias. O fato de estar no último andar não incomodou. Na porta do prédio haviam pessoas bebendo e com música alta, mas as janelas do loft são bem preparadas para o ruído externo. A localização também é perfeita, facilitando a caminhada e o uso do transporte público. Há muitos cafés e restaurantes a toda volta. Inclusive, um pequeno mercado. Os anfitriões estão de parabéns pela rápida comunicação, gentileza, empatia e por tão bom gosto na decoração do loft. Esperamos em breve voltar e ficar com vocês novamente. Felicidades pra vocês! Nosso muito obrigado!

The best Airbnb I’ve stayed in: clean, spacious, gorgeous. The team made it easy to check-in, and we felt safe and comfortable. If you are staying in Lisbon, this is the most central place you could stay!

5 stars for sure. Amazing communication, great recommendations. Hosts were super flexible with us and about leaving our bags after check out. Cute apartment and even though it was on the top floor and in the summer, apartment was really nice and cold with the AC. Location was perfect, right in the center of Bairro Alto
Great location. Modern room. Good AC. The most friendliest host.

This spot was just amazing, right in the heart of everything! The beautiful yellow tram right outside on the door step, the best natas and cappuccinos only two minutes from the apartment and a super market basically on the door step. The street can be a little noisy at night time but not too much to stop you catching a rest. The apartment was super clean and with all the amenities you could possibly need. The team were super thoughtful and had left a whole bunch of recommendations for places to visit. We will definitely be back.

De loft is een gelegen op een geweldige locatie in Lissabon. Wij hebben heel veel gelopen, maar met de tram of bus is alles heel goed te bereiken. De loft is van alle gemakken voorzien en is heel mooi, netjes en vooral schoon.
Perfect location

The whole process from initial booking a few little amendments that were airline issues right the way through to being greeted at the accommodation by a host at almost midnight, all superb, I am not able to find a better word.
The stairs as per the accommodation description are not for the faint hearted but it does add to the experience of being in a gorgeous loft. Well thought out and decorated place. Absolutely spotlessly clean. Nice welcome items. Good local information for places to see and places to eat.
We had no reason to contact the hosts during our stay as everything was great.
Checkout was easy and we even got help down the stairs with our luggage.
Lovely stay in a lovely loft in Lisbon.
Many thanks.

My boyfriend and I stayed in this loft for 5 nights and I can truly say our experience was 10/10 and could not be better! The location of the apartment cannot be beaten - you are walking distance from every must-see area of Lisbon. The view from the apartment living room was also amazing!
The team was extremely accommodating and were willing to assist with any and all of our requests or any questions we had. All of the amenities in the apartment are extremely functional. The place is very spacious and was super clean. We will definitely be back one day!
Super clean apartment and super friendly hosts. 10/10!

Great from beginning to end.
However, be advised that it’s on the 5th floor and that bringing your luggage up and down can be challenging.
Really nice place, great location. Definitely recommend!

Pedro was a fantastic host and his property was great. We got upgraded as the place we booked had an issue with the air conditioning. The place he moved us to had an awesome location, a great amount of space, and was well worth it for the price.

Pedro and the team were great! So helpful and friendly, let us check in early and check out late! They have two guides in the accommodation on recommendation of what to do and where to eat around the city! Really helpful and a great location! Would stay again!
We had a great stay in Lisbon! Francisco and team were phenomenal and the apartment is close to everything.
Gemütliche kleine Wohnung, die alles bietet, was man braucht. Ausgezeichnete Lage, um die Stadt zu erkunden. Wir wurden sehr herzlich empfangen und haben uns sehr wohl und gut betreut gefühlt.
Great location and beautiful view from the loft!
Everything was great. Better than expected. Francisco was excellent letting us check in early, giving tips on local restaurants and leaving a complimentary bottle of wine. Highly recommended!
Amazing apartement, amazing location, great equipement, easy communication, everything was perfect - can only reccommend!

Ce fut un excellent séjour !
Pedro est accueillant et nous a donné plein de bonnes adresses. L’appartement est extrêmement bien situé. En effet il est placé dans une rue très animée. Le samedi soir était un peu plus brouillant que les autres soirs de la semaine, memes fenêtres fermées on entend… l’appartement est un peu trop humide, difficile d’y faire sécher son linge !
Au delà de ça, c’était vraiment super, je recommande !!

I can only highly recommend this cozy and stylish place!
I was afraid about the night noise on weekend (as I read in some other reviews),
but it was more than fine with closed window.
On Saturday people were singing(there is a bar nearby)on the street but it was more charming as annoying ahah!
And if you want it quiet- just close the window and you hear nothing!
We slept very very good.
The district is popular for going out and full of great bars and restaurants!
We enjoy it both :day and night there very much!!!
The guys have everything what you need and even more!
Thanks for their hospitality and hopefully we see us again:)
Really nothing to complain. Very cool modern but stylish apartment with super friendly and competent hosts. Can recommend.

L’appartement est propre, spacieux et est amplement suffisant pour deux personnes. Il est super bien placé et permet de visiter Lisbonne de la meilleure des manières. Les hôtes sont serviables et répondre très rapidement en cas de besoin.
Beautiful space in a beautiful location

Fantástico loft en Lisboa a la mano de todo y muy equipado con todo lo necesario para pasar unos días muy agusto y arropado siempre por Francisco con todo lujo de detalles.
A un paseo del centro, de la estación de Rossio para visitar Sintra y con una parada en la misma puerta del icónico tranvía 28.
Que más se puede pedir!!!
El único dato a tener en cuenta es que esta en una tercera planta sin ascensor y tienes que optimizar los viajes para no llegar arriba desfallecido 😅que lo compensa con las hermosas vistas al puente 25 de Abril.
Una pasada!!
Lo recomendamos 100%

Appartement très bien situé.
Nous avons passé une très bonne semaine.
Hôte très disponible.

Excellent endroit pour découvrir Lisbonne
L’appartement est super, en plein centre, bien équipé
L’accueil est facile et très chaleureux
Merci beaucoup !
Super cute - offers all you could wish for. From a welcome-wine to fresh orange juice. Can recommend that 100%.
Apartamento muy bien situado, muy bonito y agradable, con vistas y todo lo necesario
great apartment in very nice location. nicely equipped with everything you need, and fifth floor is high enough to get some quiet from the busy surrounding area
Amazing spot in a great location. Thank you!
Pedro’s place was absolutely perfect for us! It was very clean and in an amazing location - I could not fault the place. (But be aware you do have to be agile for the stairs!)

Cet appartement est idéal pour profiter de Lisbonne ! Extrêmement bien situé et parfaitement agencé / équipé, Pedro et son équipe sont très disponibles pour partager leurs bons plans et pour s’assurer que le séjour se passe bien. Je vous recommande fortement ce logement !

A great apartment- fantastic communication- lovely facilities- and little touches -
Maybe I have been spoilt as this was my first Airbnb- and will always use as a benchmark-/
One thing to consider for future users - they must be agile - as a lot of steps to top floor apartment

Appartement idéalement placé (métro, tram, supermarché etc) avec tout le confort nécessaire. Petite vue sur Tage pont du 25 avril.
Vous êtes dans une des rues les plus photogéniques de Lisbonne donc ne soyez pas surpris par les photographes quotidien en haut de la Pente au dessus de l’elevator da Bica ;—)
L’équipe des hôtes a été très à l’écoute et réactive sur nos différentes demandes. Nous reviendrons probablement et recommandons vivement le chiado loft ;—)

Everything was perfect. Starting from communication before the vacation and Check-in to checkout. The room was perfect for two people and even nice to just stay in on a rainy day with the small kitchen and dish washer.
As said beforehand on Friday and Saturday it was louder outside but we are living very central, so that is to be expected.
We are going to visit again definitly

The airbnb had lovely views of the river, the city and the bridge - and helpfully has blackout blinds for the morning!
The place was clean and tidy and well dressed - the bathroom was also great with a waterfall shower.
All the utilities were as promised and fully working (the A/C was super helpful especially with it being a top floor flat).
The host was really accommodating even when i got the dates mixed up, letting us check in whenever suited us and also letting us keep our bags there later than check out.
Thanks so much, would stay here again!
Really enjoyed our stay, would recommend!

We loved the stay! Everything was Organized perefctly. We received info about lisbon and got some small surprises on top :)
Thanks again - we definetily recommend to People who do not care about night life noises!!!
Could be the best location in the city, highly recommend. Awesome space as well.
Amazing stay. Great location close to everything in the city. The host was very accommodating and quickly responded to all of our messages. Would definitely recommend!

Great location, really central.
The apartment was really well equipped and anything we did need the guys we able to provide so that was really helpful.
Would definitely recommend and would look at staying again when we’re back
The guys were super nice and always available, flat is lovely and in a great location. Would definitely stay here again if I was to come back to Lisbon!
One of the best place i went in my life! Host is amazing and kind. The appartment is perfect and the view iw beautifull. For the noise, we hadn’t any problems.

Pedro's place is absolutely fantastic! The whole team was great in communicating and dealing with the check in. The place was very clean, spatious, beautiful and had everything you need in a flat. Really felt at home. The location is unique and the view from the flat was spectacular. Highly recommended!
Nice and cozy appartment in the heart of Lisbon.
Super süße Wohnung in perfekter Lage. Der Service war immer gleich da wenn man was brauchte und auch immer mega nett. Nur weiter zu empfehlen. 5 Sterne TOP !!

El mejor Airbnb donde nos hemos alojado. El piso donde nos hospedamos a pesar de ser pequeño era perfectamente funcional y estaba impecable, tanto en decoración como en limpieza. Pero lo mejor (además de la ubicación que es perfecta), fue la excelente atención y detalles del equipo que nos ayudaron siempre que lo necesitamos. Un 10 absoluto!
Een echte aanrader! Goede locatie, nette loft en aardige mensen. Kortom: perfect.
Everything was amazing, we had a great time in Lisbon thanks to you guys. Obrigada :)
Very nice and central place, we enjoyed it a lot.

A great little loft in a very lively part of Lisbon. Clean space with some wonderful welcome goodies. The pillows were so comfortable. One thing to beware of, there are a lot of stairs to get up to this cute loft.... But that seems like it is just a part of Lisbon in general. We had fresh oranges to juice for a morning pick me up and an espresso machine with pods available for the coffee drinkers.

Pedro's apartment was wonderful. Clean and in a great, central location. Pedro and his team were very responsive and easy to communicate with. I would absolutely recommend the apartment to a friend and look forward to a future stay.
This is a wonderful place, and for me since I was working during the day it was important that the WiFi was really as quick as advertised. Wonderful place and spent a great time there.

Great hosts! Definitely recommend for your stay in Lisbon as the space is central and provides all the essentials. My boyfriend is 6’5 and definitely had to be mindful of the vaulted ceilings. May be uncomfortable for taller people but otherwise a great spot!
Great location with great amenities. Bc it's in the city center, there is a bit of noise at night, but not a big deal. Host was super helpful and communicative. Thanks!

Great place to stay at Lisbon. Amazing view and cute inside. Close to public transportation and attractions. The area is very fun and popping during the weekend, so if you wanna have fun at the city this is a great spot!

Beautiful Loft in one of the best parts of the city. It is a bit smaller compared to what you'd expect because of the pictures, but it's really cosy and well equipped.
Check in was super friendly and we were pleasantly surprised by some welcome gifts.
I would chose this amazing apartment again any time !
Great location, quality apartment, nice details, impeccable service. Highly recommended!
Very nice apartment, well equipped, with a very good location. The communication with the owner was also great!

Optimal location within walking distance to all sights. And located in the adorable area of Chiado. The street of the studio itself is great for pictures, you will see people taking pictures throughout the day. Manteigaria is only a few meters away and offers the best pasteis de nata! At night, there were some drunken men in the street below so be mindful if you are traveling alone! Other than that, this was an amazing stay with gorgeous views of the rivers.
Amazing location, amazing place, amazing host…everything was perfect! Highly recommended for shorts and long periods in Lisbon, you won’t regret it!

Your stay here will be absolutely perfect! Not only do you get to stay in this beautiful and perfectly equipped apartment, but you get to do so in one of the most beautiful streets in the planet!! Everything is just a few minutes away and, if you’re looking to explore Lisbon’s nightlife, the street right above is filled with bars and restaurants that really enhance the perfect tourist experience. Pedro, Antonio and Gonzalo are incredibly helpful, they will provide you with a guide filled with places to go visit to help you have the best experience during your stay. I will definitely reach out to this place during my next visit!

Cute and well furnished apartment in 10/10 location - think the space is best for group of 2 people or single travellers as quite cosy but definitely comfortable. You really feel right in the heart of Lisbon and also the apartment has great tips books with day trip suggestions and a comprehensive restaurant and bar recommendations list. Pedro, Antonio and Goncalo are also super friendly and accommodating with fast response times. Would return!
Perfect located to discover the city! Lovely apartment.
A fantastic apartment with brilliant views over Lisbon. We couldn’t have asked for a better base to explore the city.
Super Lage, tolles Appartment mit schönem Blick und top Ausstattung.
Un apartamento pequeño y acojedor entre los barrios Bairro Alto y Cais do Sodré. La mejor manera de disfrutar Lisboa.

Fabulous studio flat - spacious enough for two people and located really centrally. The flat was sparkling clean and very modern. The host left lots of recommendations and was very accommodating in terms of check out. Highly recommend!

This was a great central location to explore Lisbon from. We really appreciated the note we got from the host before we confirmed the booking letting us know that the street is quite active at night. We were prepared for this with earplugs so the revelling did not bother us. We liked the festive atmosphere. There were great touches to make this stay exceptional. A small bottle of wine, some chocolate and oranges were left for us to enjoy. Best of all, a portable wifi unit (mobile wifi hotspot) was made available so we did not have to use data when we were out and about exploring Lisbon. That was a nice surprise! The apartment was stylish and everything we needed was there. We did not cook, but the kitchen seemed well outfitted with pots and pans etc. Although small, one could easily prepare a simple meal here.
We did not use the extra bed in the loft area. One word of caution to families considering this particular apartment...the loft bed would not be safe for children as there is no railing to prevent a roll out of bed. Ask for a different apartment if you need additional beds.
Thanks to Pedro and his team. We loved Lisbon and hope to return. We would definitely consider staying here again and/or recommended the place.

This place has been an amazing place to stay during our visit to Lisbon! It was a beautiful space, sparkling clean, comfortable, communication was excellent, and the hosts had lots of thoughtful touches waiting for us - including a very helpful book of tips and places to visit/eat :) the portable wifi box was also a really cool touch! It is located on a popular street with the famous tram, but being up on the top floor so we had absolutely no issues with noise :) would completely reccomend this place if you are looking for a place to stay in Lisbon!

My fiancé and I spent a wonderful couple of days at Pedro’s apartment. Communication was excellent both before and during our trip and and we appreciated the many thoughtful little touches that were left for us. Numerous recommendations were made for food, drink and things to see and we really couldn’t have asked for much more. This was made clear in the listing so we can’t complain but we did find the bar outside the apartment to be very noisy and although the window did help to mute the noise considerably, this might not suit very light sleepers. Possibly something to do with the time of year however as we were here during carnival. Overall, great place to stay and we would recommend it.

We enjoyed our stay in that apartment. You are in the middle of the city with many restaurants and bars. So at night it gets rather loud because many people hang out in that street. We had to close the window and then it was no problem at all.
You can easily get there to every place you like because busses, trams and metro are within walking distance.
All in all we can recommend the apartment. It was clean, well equipped and especially because of the good service and immediate response of the hosts. Thank you!

This is an amazing apartment with a super location and excellent hospitality. The apartment is clean, and the hosts are timely, knowledgeable, polite and service-minded. I will come back again! Thank you!

The apartment is well located ! I mean you can’t expect better if you want to be next the animated area.
The apartment is really clean and well decorated ! You have all that you need for your stay.
The team are really efficient in the communication, they answer really fast.
I recommend one of their apartments if you want to visit lisboa !
Obrigado e até a próxima
The apartment is really nice and in a great location. Comfy bed, great shower and thoughtful touches. The host is also very responsive and helpful. Would definitely recommend staying here.
Perfect location, very clean and nice little loft for 2 or 3 persons.

Todo en general muy bien. Está en un barrio muy concurrido por la noche y a veces puede haber demasiado ruido impidiendo dormir, a nosotros sólo nos resulto peor la noche del sábado y del domingo, los demás días muy bien.

When you book an apartment with this team, believe me you cannot go wrong. You'll find outstanding hosts, always prompt to help. The apartment is lovely - small and yet spacious due to a genius space-design, you'll also be surprised with the amazing views overlooking the tagus river. The location couldn't be better. You'll be close to the best Lisbon has to offer! Couldn't be happier with my stay
If we had not had heavy luggage, it would have been happy to stay there.

Great location. Very stylish and clean room. Outstanding hospitality and thoughtful touches. Very quick responses from the hosts and useful local tips. I’ll definitely recommend this place. This being said - be aware of a lot of stairs and a bar downstairs. Me and my husband (early 30s) enjoyed the location and setup, but I will not recommend for families with small kids or people with limited mobility.

Hit the jackpot when we discovered this condo! So central to everything we wanted to do when visiting Lisbon! Check in was seamless and Diogo took time to show us how things worked! Condo spotlessly clean. Ate at some fabulous locally recommended restaurants! Actually did most of the tours recommended and had a blast! Top floor with no elevator was no problem even for us oldies! I’d definitely stay here again if back in Lisbon and will definitely recommend it to anyone wanting a real Lisbon experience! For example it’s on the most photographed street in Lisbon with the funicular! We’re sure we are in many pictures! Awesome condo. So happy we found it on Airbnb

Wir haben uns in dieser kleinen Wohnung sehr wohl gefühlt. Der Check in verlief reibungslos und durch die tollen Tipps konnten wir gleich losziehen und die Stadt erkunden . Das Appartment liegt super zentral und ist perfekt Ausgestattet . Wir werden auf jeden Fall die Unterkunft weiterempfehlen und wenn wir wieder in Lissabon sind ,dieses Appartment nehmen .
Pedro is great and very responsive. The space is nice & very clean, but a little cramped. Very busy street at night full of people partying and drinking.
This was an amazing spot. The location was central and close to amazing restaurants and shops. Additionally, the host was hospitable and kind. I would definitely stay again.

Thank you Pedro and friends who rented this apartment to us. So stylish, different too. Nice split of wine for us was a great touch to begin our evening.
Beds were super comfortable (couch too) the view is great too and very convenient to major sites and restaurants!!
And EXCELLENT communication through booking and check in.
💗💗💗

Excelente apartamento, muy bien ubicado.
Las fotos son bastante descriptivas de lo que encontrarán, pero creo que estando ahí, el sitio es aún mejor, bello y con una estupenda vista e iluminación natural.
Nos llevamos la mejor impresión de Lisboa y en eso tiene mucho que ver el equipo de Pedro, reconocimiento especial a Diogo que siempre estuvo atento a lo que necesitáramos desde que nos recibió hasta que nos fuimos.
Son personas confiables, se nota disfrutan lo que hacen y transmiten esa sensación a sus huéspedes.
Nos vamos muy contentas y agradecidas :)
Lovely host, lots of extra touches to make us feel welcome, perfect for a couple! Really great location. The only thing I would suggest is to bring ear plugs as the streets below are noisy at night!

What a wonderful place to stay close to the heart of Lisbon. Noise in front of the house is completely blocked out by the windows. Location has a lot of charm and everything is in walking distance. Try pastel de nata at Manteigaria - better than Belem?

The apartment is in the perfect location and easy to get to from the metro. They had quick responses that made getting around the city easy. The apartment was extremely clean. This was a great place to stay and made our trip to Lisbon more enjoyable. Would definitely stay here again !

Our stay at this loft was fantastic from start to finish. Diogo was there to meet us and explain everything about the loft.  It was very clean, and stylish with all the needed amenities.  Thoughtful touches were provided such as a bottle of wine, fresh fruit, coffee and chocolates.  The portable wifi device was awesome to take along during our day trips-I have never stayed at an Air B & B that provided something like this before. The neighborhood was trendy and we were able to walk to many highlights.  Diogo was in contact with us during our stay to see if we needed anything, and he responded quickly when texted.  We really appreciated a time extension upon check out as we didn’t catch our ship until later that day.   If I could give this loft more than 5 stars I would because the hospitality of the host was exceptional.  I highly recommend this loft for your stay in Lisboa, you will not regret it.
Súper hermoso lugar, limpio y acogedor, el chico muy amable, una ubicación excelente, el mejor lugar para quedarse en Lisboa, todo esta cerca.

Pedro's house is very convenience and has beutiful view. I want to return this house. 꼬레안들만 알쑤읶는 휴기입니다. 뻬드로네 하우쑤는 오충이라 께단이 만아요. 퀘리어 들가고기 죨라 힝들어요. 호우아장실에 소ㅑ워기는 해바라기 사우어기라 죨라 불펜해요. 샤워후에 워터가 아내리강요. 머뤼콰 락 다 뺒줘야돼욥. 주말에는 집앞에 동눼 양애chi들 다 모여서 dae마 태위요. 쌔벽5씨까징 sheep애츼들 술돰배해요. 인불종문 양치애들 존마탱많아요. 내가 롸스트 한손국님이 되기를...❤️

This apartment is amazing! The location is great as well as the amenities and walkability is perfect. Apartment was extremely clean and the espresso/tea kettle and fridge were awesome amenities to have. Highly recommend going to Manteigaria for pastel de nata which is a two minute walk from the apartment. Mini marketplace next door has great affordable wine options. Check in was smooth and they gave a lot of helpful information. There are two booklets put together in case you needed reference for restaurant and bar recommendations. Altogether, this apartment was perfect for our visit to Lisbon!

BEST AIRBNB EVER. Cannot day enough amazing things.  Cutest apartment, perfect location, and so so clean.  Fit 3 comfortably and could easily sleep 4.  Everyone i was with agreed this is the best airbnb we have ever stayed in!! Would HIGHLY recommend

Beautiful studio with great amenities in a very convenient location of Lisbon. The communication with the team was flawless as was the check-in experience. Simply great. We were there in October when it wasn’t as hot so we were tempted to open the windows rather than rely on the A/C. When they state in the listing that it’s a lively street basically all night, trust me, they mean it. Bring the highest grade earplugs you can find (I think 32dB of attenuation is what you can find easily) or simply be comfortable with windows closed 24hours. The location is hard to beat otherwise.

We stayed for 5 nights and we loved it , the apartment is in a good location with a great view over the river to the statue that looks down over Lisbon.
There are a few flights of stairs to navigate to get to the accommodation but they got easier every day.
Check in was was easy and the hosts have put together a really useful information pack with advice of good eating and sites to visit.
Time out market is only a 10 minute walk down hill and there are many bars and restaurants at the top and bottom of the road.
Great apartment ,we would stay again
Expect a lot of noise in the evenings after 2200 hrs. Ear plugs might be an advantage.

We have just left after a few lovely days in Lisbon. The loft is beautiful, small but perfectly formed - ideal for a couple on a mini break. Diogo checked us in, showed us around and gave us some great tips on what to see and where to go as well as texting us after our first day to check how we were getting on. As the other reviews state the street is quite loud at night due to being above a bar (super cheap drinks make it a local nightlife hotspot!) but we didn’t mind that. The loft is on the fifth floor so not for the faint of heart with luggage but well worth it once you are up there. Wonderful central location to all attractions and transport links. Lots of bars and restaurants within walking distance. There is a supermarket on the corner for everything you need. Try Orion Cafe for breakfast, the pasteis de nata are yum!!
The team at Chiado Lofts were extremely helpful and make you feel right at home. The place is a great location for nightlife and seeing Lisbon

일단 집을 나가면 언제나 비카를 볼 수 있어요.28번 트램도 바로 탈 수 있구요. 위치가 아주 좋아요. 사진처럼 예쁘고 분위기 있어요. 모든 편의시설이 잘 갖추어져 있었어요. 식기세척기까지 있어 너무 편했어요. 그릇도 참 좋았죠~침구도 호텔침구처럼 깨끗하고 아주 편했어요. 저희에게 단점은 다락 침대는 떨어지면 위험할 거 같아 잘 수 없었어요. 그리고 밖이 광장히 시끄러워요. 모여서 술 먹는 장소인 거 같아요. 2시정도까지 아주 시끄럽게 떠들어요. 그래도 워낙 집 자체는 완벽해요

We stayed for 10 nights and couldn't be happier. The loft was perfect in every way with excellent ammenities and quality. We were greeted promptly by our host who was only ever a phone call away if we had a question. The location (and view!) on the "Bica" puts the loft in probably the most historic, lively and central location in Lisbon. Just around the corner is a market that has everything you could possibly need. We felt like it was our own home and plan to be back. Thanks Pedro, Gonçalo and team - you are true pros.

Dear Chiado Loft team,
We would like to thank you for the unforgettable stay in Lisbon.
We spontaneously booked the Chaido Loft 2 and were absolutely thrilled. Everything was exactly as described in the ad, a cute little apartment on the 5th floor with a side view of the Tejo. The location in Bairro Alto is fantastic for the younger audience - in the evening it gets a little louder in the street, but with closed windows you don't hear to much. But if you are used to the peace and quiet, it is better to book in another area of lisbon.
The apartment is perfectly equipped for a city trip and offers enough space for 2-3 persons. With a lot of love for details, many little things were thought of, like the Nespresso machine, fresh oranges or recommendations for the stay.
The contact in advance with António and Diogo worked perfectly. We were even allowed to store our luggage free of charge at 11:30 a.m. and could already move into the apartment at noon. In the ampartment we were greeted by a small handwritten welcome + Portuguese rosé wine. So every vacation can start... :)
We would like to thank you very much for your hospitality and will gladly recommend you at any time! We will surely come back soon.
Many greetings from Hamburg, Germany - Jana and Kristin

I have favorited a number of Pedro's spots and finally, after many years, have been able to stay! Sad to say it was only for one night. Loft was in a great location (quickly accessible to transport options), beautifully renovated and curated, impeccably clean, and had an amazing view.
Host team was super accommodating, quick to respond, and they obviously know their customers well and anticipate their travel needs! I mean pocket Wi-Fi? Bonus points!!!
Definitely would come back again and definitely would recommend!
Thank you guys for taking us in!
Great Location, cozy appartement, nice host!
Fantastic stay!

Had a great stay. Very central, a little noisy but knew this would be the case. The apartment had every amenity you could wish for, it was clean and very comfortable. I would say it probably suits 2 people because of the size. Great communication with the host before and on arrival. Were given some fantastic recommendations for restaurants. Definitely want to stay here again.
This place has great location! Pedro was extremely welcoming and informative. Very quick to respond to queries and extremely accommodating. We thoroughly enjoyed our trip. Thank you!

The location is great, as is the hospitality. Convenient instructions were located throughout the place on how to operate appliances as well as helpful travel tips. This place is located on a lively street but we slept just fine. They even provide black out curtains to help you sleep in...but otherwise the natural lighting is amazing. There is a cable car right outside that is a hot spot for photography. This place is close to everything; walking throughout the city is pretty easy but expect some hills!
I was amazed at how well the space here was utilized. Very well done! The bathroom is complete with a tall shower which was great since my husband is tall. The hosts are lovely and provided a thoughtful gift at check-in. OH! There was a super helpful mobile WiFi gadget we could take with us throughout the city. This place also has air conditioning but it takes a little while to cool down. As is stated, it is on the 5th floor up stairs. Pretty narrow staircase but manageable if you are 1. strong/fit or 2. pack light :) It is worth it when you reach the top!
Beau séjour au cœur du vieux Lisbonne, merci!

Hi we are Juliette and Josephine,
The location is perfect and mostly everything is in walking distance.
We loved the small things that this apartment had to offer like a portable WiFi divice, and carts with recommended restaurants on them (The team wants to help you with reservations if needed )
The apartment was smaller then we've expected,
I wouldn't advise this apartment for taller and elderly people, light sleepers and/or people who have a difficulties falling asleep as it can be noisy and loud during the evening and night.
- No elevator included, the apartment is on the fifth floor which means you have to walk up 8 staircases, good luck !
- No safe
- Only 1 key
Enjoy your stay in Lisbon,
Chiao,
Juliette & Josephine
Pedro’s was the perfect little hub for our weekend trip to Lisbon. Centrally located and a short stroll from the best Pastel de natas in the city. 10/10 would recommend.
Great apartment

The apartment was in a perfect location to go experience Lisbon. The space was well designed and included everything one would need when staying in Lisbon. Communication was quick and helpful. Thanks for making our time in Lisbon a wonderful experience. I would definitely stay here again.
Great stay in a great location.

Location is unbeatable in Chiado district, with stunning views over the city and very close to metro, bars, restaurants, sights, everything you need to explore Lisbon. The space was well maintained and clean and Pedro and his colleagues were very gracious. Highly recommend!
Appartement parfait, emplacement idéal. Le bruit de la rue ne nous a pas du tout dérangé, les lisboètes sont très sympathiques.

Super cool studio space. Walk through upon arrival was very helpful and professional. These guys are top notch!Views from the windows toward the water are phenomenal. I only wish I would have had more time to stay there. I was travelling light so it was easy but there are some stairs to contend with, just know that. Great place!!!! Thanks, Todd

Appartement tout à fait conforme au photos, très propre tout y est même des petites attentions personnalisées... très bien équipé et malgré un séjour pendant les fêtes, l’appartement est bien isolé du bruit de la rue.
Pedro’s loft was perfect for our time in Lisbon! It was located right in the middle of the action in Lisbon.

Very good appartement !
Good located (5 min walks to the centrum) ; verry verry clean an good equipped ! We had a very good stay in Lisbon and in the appartement !

Great location! Wonderful, responsive hosts. Everything you could need for your stay in Lisbon. The personal hotspot was a nice touch to be able to take around the city. A bit noisy at night from the bar downstairs and being located on a busy street; thankfully we had earplugs.

We had a wonderful time staying at Pedro’s apartment. Unfortunately, our flight was canceled on the way there and Pedro kept in touch with us throughout the ordeal to make sure someone would be there to greet us when we arrived. We got in around midnight so it was much appreciated. The apartment is centrally located and we walked pretty much everywhere. Pedro also gave us a portable WiFi hotspot to carry with us when we out adventuring that was a helpful and thoughtful touch. If you are a light sleeper, I recommend bringing earplugs as the street is full every night with nice but noisy people. I wore my earplugs and slept like a baby. The bed is very comfortable!
We highly recommend Pedro’s apartment! Boa viagem!
Really great place and great location. Lots of fun local tips

One of my favorite airbnbs I have ever stayed in. Pedro's place is in amazing, central location in Lisbon. It is situated on a street with views of the water and a cable car running down to the bottom - FYI the street is VERY steep so be prepared for a lot of walking. We were met upon check-in and given a full tour of the space and instructions on how to use the appliances, etc. There was also a mobile WiFi hotspot for guests to use when they were out in Lisbon which was such a thoughtful touch for international travelers. Pedro's place is in walking distance to tons of different restaurants and bars as well. Would 100% recommend staying here!
Bon accueil situé au coeur de toutes les activités

Pedro, Goncalo and Antonio
are really friendly hosts. They always answered promtly on our messages and questions and gave us good tipps for restaurants and bars. The check-in was so easy and uncomplicated. The appartment looked really nice and stylish, as shown on the pictures. So cozy! Bed was very comfortable. Kitchen was good equipped!! In the evening/night it gets really loud on the street as you have bars directly in front of the door and people stand outside talking. We knew that, thats why it was okay for us. But people who cant sleep with noise should be aware of that. The appartment is located directy in the centre, we had no problems to get to any attractions by train/on foot. Really comfortable! We enjoyed our stay in Lisbon and say again thanks to the Team!!!
Great location if you and very charming apt.

From the initial booking up until check out this air BnB was so easy. Quick replies and honest information. I personally thought the apartment was in a great place, we were told it would be a bit noisy because there were a few bars round, but I didn't realise that every night would be a full on street party (busier of a weekend) I thought this was so cool, people were friendly enough so we didn't feel imtimited and even with the slight noise we managed to sleep very well every night. Thanks for everything

This flat is excellent!  Our stay was so good that we decided to stay at another one of Pedro's flats for our last night in Portugal (this one wasn't available). We highly recommend staying here, be prepared to walk a lot of stairs!  The location is right in the middle of some really great restaurants and bars.  It's also walking distance from many sight-seeing opportunities.
Parfait comme toujours !
Excellent location! Excellent host! Highly recommended!
Great place in the heart of Lisbon, easy to reach by metro from the airport, surrounded by amazing food places. Spotless clean and communicative hosts. Very lively street at night. We loved it!
Great hospitality, we really appreciated the special touches including a mobile hotspot! Very responsive and helpful hosts.

Wir haben unsere Reise nach Lissabon sehr genossen und waren dank dem Apartment praktisch nie auf öffentliche Verkehrsmittel angewiesen! Das Apartment ist schön und modern eingerichtet und man verfügt über alles was man benötigt! Wir kommen gerne wieder
房间非常好 在屋里可以直接看到大耶稣像 阁楼很温馨 房东热情 提供了当地很多好吃餐厅的建议 还赠送了红酒 阁楼所在的门口在升降机的旁边 楼下还有小酒吧 每天很多人来打卡喝酒 很热闹 但是没有电梯 如果是大件行李不容易搬上来 再有就是入住的时候屋子里有只蚊子有点困扰 总之是来里斯本旅游很好的住宿选择

The apartment is so cute, has great views, and the hosts are very thoughtful. We had an awesome stay! They have great recommendations for where to eat, and the location of the apartment is perfect for seeing many different areas of Lisbon.
Pedro's flat is perfectly located for anyone that wishes to spend a great time in Lisbon close to everything, but not expensive for the great location. I will definitely come back

We had a great stay in this fantastic space. Mobile wifi hotspot was an awesome touch, since we are traveling without sim cards on our cell phones. It let us use electric scooters along the water!
Hip place, well designed and clean. Would recommend to other travelers looking for a central place to stay in Lisbon.

This place is amazing! It has beautiful views of Lisbon, it is bright and everything is nicely decorated with so much attention to details. The best part was the location, you can walk everywhere! I would particularly recommend it for young travelers since there are some steps and the street is busy with bars. We absolutely loved this place, it made us feel like true lisboans!

We spent fantastic days in this apartment ... really very characteristic, extremely clean and from which you can enjoy an incredible view.
The location is absolutely perfect for visiting Lisbon, both for daytime walks and for the evening outing.
Finally, I thank Pedro for offering to keep our luggage since we had the flight in the afternoon.
Thanks again

The reviews are accurate and the space is thoughtfully done. If you don't mind a bit of nightclub noise, this apartment is terrific becasue it is centrally located to many of the destinations you will want to explore in Lisbon. Pedro was most helpful throughout the entire process. We would stay here again!

What a great apartment! I think this might be one of my favorite Airbnbs I've stayed in. It was very well fitted out, the bed was comfortable, the view was great. It's _super_ conveniently located. António made the checkin process completely seamless - he actually spotted me on the street getting out of my Uber, and was very responsive throughout the trip.
There were some small details that I really appreciated. António made a point of showing the things that were unusual during checkin (e.g. the power switches for appliances), and left a bottle of wine behind. The towels were really nice and plush, which is unusual at Airbnbs!
There are also a few caveats worth knowing about the place - nothing that isn't clear from the listing, but just worth highlighting. The apartment has 2 beds; and although I was staying on my own, I could imagine it being a bit cramped with more people (especially because the slope of the ceiling cuts off some of the usable space). And while the flights of stairs are kind of short, it _is_ on the 5th floor (that's 6th floor for you Americans), so you do have a bit of walking to do (and the building is already uphill from a lot of the tourist areas of Lisbon).
I think it's important visitors to know all of that, but that doesn't diminish that this was a great Airbnb that I'd be very, very happy to stay at again if I'm ever back in Lisbon.
Future guests should be aware that this apartment is directly above an incredibly noisy open-street bar, which stays open until 1-2am. Bring ear plugs.

Appartamento piccolo ma molto pulito, ben arredato e curato nei minimi particolari. Ottima l’ospitalità e i servizi offerti, buona anche la posizione: l’unica precisazione che mi sento di fare è che la sera, già dalle 18, la via si riempie di ragazzi che si appostano a bere qualcosa anche sotto l’ingresso di casa, questo non è sicuramente un problema se gli ospiti sono coppie, mi sento invece di non consigliarlo a pieno a ragazze giovani che potrebbero incorrere in episodi spiacevoli. Per noi comunque è stato un piacevole soggiorno, lo consigliamo!
