Stylish , clean apartment in the most central perfect location. Pedro was spot on with communication and we checked in with no problems. The street is busy at night but because the apartment is 5 floors up (in the loft) you will not have any problems. I highly recommend this apartment to others!

The place was very very nice for two people with space for 4 if you want to squeeze in.  The hosts were wonderful and very helpful with tips and getting us checked in. Do beware that the the street below will be quite rowdy at night.

Five star apartment in a perfect location in Lisbon! In walking distance to tons of restaurants and bars including right below on the same street! Brilliant hospitality and a great host too makes this a top place to stay and enjoy your time in Lisbon!

Όμορφο και περιποιημένο σπίτι.

Από κάτω έχει μπαράκια και έντονη νυχτερινή ζωή αλλά είναι καινούρια τα παράθυρα και δεν ακούγεται σχεδόν τίποτα

It's a really wonderful place - cozy and modern apartment. There is everything you need, even for a long stay. The only thing that could bother you - the apartment is based in the very city centre and is very touristic, and there are couple noisy bars on the street (exactly in front of the apartment's window). So if you're are the person/s who're looking for absolute silence - this place could be not the one you need. But in general - it's totally ok because it's enough just to close the window
Anyway, we loved this place and totally would recommend it for your stay.
Great loft, host and stay. Supermarket next door basically and metro close as well.
Room decoration is very good, the owner recommended the restaurant is very good!It's nice to see the sea in the room!
Stunningly beautiful, great location, extremely helpful and friendly service. Best Airbnb I’ve been to ever.

The location is definitely the Nonplusultra of this nice apartment! Everything is in walking distance and the room itself is very nice, cozy and clean.
Recommendation!

Pedro’s place is in a great location the hosts we’re very nice and quick to respond to any concerns. They had thoughtful little touches and awesome recommendations the portable wifi they provided was great to help with navigating the city on your phone. Would highly recommend this airbnb or any of there others to anyone coming to lisbon :)
Great host, beautiful apartment, clean, great communications, tips on where to eat, everything you could need from an apartment!

Mi familia y yo hemos pasado unos días geniales en Lisboa y en casa de Pedro .
A pesar de ser un apartamento pequeño es muy acogedor y tiene todo lo necesario para estar cómodo y a gusto.
Es un tercer piso sin ascensor, pero tiene el encanto de estar en pleno barrio de Chiado. La ubicación del apartamento es inmejorable.

It was a really nice stay and communication was very smooth. Thank you.
bon accueil..des petites attentions

We had a wonderful stay at Pedro’s
Loft. Very central location and attentive hosts!

The stay in the Apartment was very nice and comfortable. It is a really clean and beautiful loft and we enjoyed it much. The bathroom is amazing. The Team was very kind and helpfull. The location is very good and it's not hard to find. You can reach everything by foot. We definetely recomend it to other people!

We had an excellent stay in the loft! The place was very cute and the location was amazing. Pedro was an excellent host and gave us some great restaurant recommendations. We would for sure stay again!

Pedro responded within minutes to every question we asked. The apartment is very beautiful, with an interesting design. It was immaculately clean, and thoughtfully outfitted. We enjoyed the comfortable beds and huge windows which blocked the noise of the street below. The apartment is on the top floor of a 300 year old building so it is a climb to reach it, but we felt it was worth the effort to reach it.

Great place in the middle of Lisbon. The apartment was surprisingly quiet given the lively night life just outside the front door. Everything is easily walkable and Pedro left great recommendations. Place was clean and well kept and definitely recommend.
Awesome cozy apartment in one of the famous streets of Lisbon. Everything is close. Lot’s of bars and restaurants. I can totally recommend it.
Place was sparkling clean and you couldn’t possible find a better location. Bring your ear plugs, this is a happening part of Lisbon. Hosts were exceptional and very responsive.

L’appartement de Pedro était parfait!  Même si effectivement ça bouge en soirée en bas de l’appartement, ça ne nous a pas dérangé du tout...nous avons dormi comme des bébés!  Nous avons même profité de cette animation et pris un verre devant notre porte...un beau moment de notre séjour!  Pedro et son équipe sont des hôtes attentionnés et avaient plein de bonnes adresses à nous conseiller (restos, marchés, etc).  Propreté impeccable, réservez vite!
Beautiful apartment with amazing views of the city. Very convenient location that is walkable to many of Lisbon’s top sites.
Great place, great location, easy check-in, all clean, nice touches.

Appartamento maleodorante, umido, e sporco (c'è polvere dappertutto). 1)la poltrona accanto alla tv presenta macchie marroni! 2)le stoviglie della cucina sono piene di polvere per cui, per usarle, devono essere prima lavate 3)la tendina piccola per la finestra del bagno ha cumuli di polvere (ho dovuto usare una busta di plastica al posto della tendina) 4) anche la tenda veneziana della finestra grande è piena di polvere e non ho potuto abbassarla 5) il divano è umido e ci sono macchie di umidità sul muro vicino le finestre 6)la mochette delle scale fuori la porta è sporca e ha un cattivissimo odore 7) l'appartamento intero ha un CATTIVO ODORE, è necessario tenere sempre le finestre aperte 8)le finestre piccole (bagno e cucina)affacciano su una zona in cui stanno facendo lavori e, forse per questo, entra cattivo odore 9) bagno piccolissimo, nella doccia manca il soffione mobile (esso è fisso) e la maniglia della doccia è rotta, si stacca. 10)il phon minuscolo è rotto, esce fumo; è stato sostituito con altro phon stesse dimensioni e con grata posteriore rotta. Comunque troppo piccolo per essere usato, ho dovuto comprarlo! 11)armadio umido (ho tenuto i vestiti in valigia) e scomparto superiore pieno di polvere.
Inoltre nell'annuncio sono mostrate fotografie della VISTA: la vista nelle foto dell'annuncio si può vedere solo se una persona si sporge dalla finestra per scattare una foto. all'interno dell'appartamento si vede solo il palazzo di fronte (dalla finestra centrale) e il tetto affianco(dalla finestra laterale), con piccolissimo scorcio. Non rispecchia l'annuncio. Le SCALE per raggiungere l'appartamento sono fatiscenti e maleodoranti, la prima rampa è anche consumata e questo andrebbe detto nell'annuncio!
Di mattina POSIZIONE caratteristica, rumorosa per flusso di turisti, ma terribile di sera, per la presenza di bar e locali proprio sotto l'appartamento. Altre parti di baixa-chiado non sono così! Difficile anche uscire ed entrare nel palazzo, a causa di ragazzi che si appostavano davanti al portone, ubriachi, e che urlavano fino a notte fonda. Bisogna stare chiusi dentro l'appartamento per non sentire troppi rumori, ma, se tutte le finestre sono chiuse, si sente l'odore di umidità e muffa. Fino le 3 di notte non è possibile dormire. Nell'annuncio viene detto che l'appartamento si trova in una zona piena di ronzio e di vita. Questo è riduttivo per descrivere la situazione. Solo dopo aver prenotato e pagato (senza possibilità di rimborso) l'host avvisa che c'è questo problema. perchè non scriverlo nell'annuncio?
Insomma se vuoi dormire la notte, non prenotare qui!
allo stesso prezzo è possibile soggiornare in struttura migliore. Questo appartamento non è ben tenuto. Pessimo rapporto qualità prezzo.

Un séjour à Lisbonne agréable, il faut juste fermer la fenêtre donnant sur la rue le soir à cause des bars de la rue (bruit et odeurs), mais on peut ouvrir celles qui donnent sur la cour. Par ailleurs, la situation est idéale.

Many top hotels wish they had this cozy and tasteful decor.  The location was fantastic and the host extremely attentive. He provided us with a printed list of recommendations and a portable Wi-Fi device. There are several restaurants and bars around and if you are not concerned with bit of noise at nights, this is an excellent choice for exploring Lisbon.

Pedro’s place was very nice. It was just the right size for two people, with one queen bed and one single bed up on the loft. While staying there, you have access to a refrigerator, cooktop, dishwasher, and laundry machine, which we didn’t use but was convenient. The place is located in the center of nightlife, so there are many people out on the street at nighttime, but the noise didn’t disturb us on the 5th floor. It was a very good stay, and Pedro gave us a small bottle of wine and some chocolates when we checked in, which was very sweet!

Pedros place is perfect for a couple or three people. it's small but has a great interior. The kitchen is quite new. The bathroom has a small window,which is really helpfull. The matress is comfortable. The flat is very clean! Thanks to the big windows you have a lot of light in the flat. It's located in the middle of Lisbon. You have a lot of restaurants near by. It can get loud from the street below, but if you close the window, you hear just a little. I would defenitly recommend it!
Spent 2 nights at this wonderful place in Lisbon. In a really great location close to main attractions and resultants.
Amazing little loft in one of the coolest neighbourhoods in the world. Loved it.

Das Apartment ist sehr sauber, nicht groß aber alles ist vorhanden. Die Lage ist Top, denn man kann fast alles zu Fuß erreichen. Abends ist die Strasse sehr belebt und man muss die Leute vom Eingang wegschieben, aber ich hatte damit keine Probleme. Das Fenster, hatte ich wegen den Geräuschen von der Strasse zu (Doppelverglasung), zu und dadurch das das Zimmer Air Condition hat war das kein Problem.

The apartment was spotless and beautiful, with a lot of amazing natural light. It was right in the middle of the city, but with the windows closed and the AC on, the noise wasn’t an issue at all. The location made it an easy walk to any of the restaurants and sights we were going to. The hosts was very amenible and made sure we had anything we might need. The apartment was above and beyond what we could have hoped for!

We loved our stay at Pedro’s loft! The space is even cuter than the photos, has everything you need, and the location cannot be beat! Pedro and his team were excellent with communication leading up to and throughout our stay, and had great recommendations of what to do during our time in Lisbon.

My friend and I really enjoyed our 4 night stay at Pedro’s place. Cool location, nice looking apartment, was able to ask for extra towels as he was in the building while another suite was being cleaned. Clean and well maintained.

The apartment was perfect for a few days break in Lisbon. It is smallish but has everything you’d need, comfortable bed, cooking amenities, coffee machine, washing machine. Everything was very clean and tidy ready for our stay and Gonçalo was very friendly at check-in, giving us some good tips for the area. As other reviews suggest, it is noisy at night due to the bar downstairs (everyone drinks on the street), but if you’ll be having a few drinks yourself it’s not that loud that it will keep you up. The location is excellent, minutes walk to all of barrio alto and chiado.
Simply stunning and cosy apartment with a great location! The host left very thoughtful touches and gave us great tips. Highly recommended to anyone wanting to explore Lisbon!
Had a great stay in this apartment! Really cosy loft with high standard, and the host meeting me was very nice and helpful. The apartment is also in a great area. Highly recommended!
Amazing stay in Lisbon...just go for it !

La casa e’ bellissima e arredata molto bene. Tutto nuovo e molto pulito. La posizione e’ centrale e comodissima. Grazie alle finestre nuove, non si sente il rumore dei locali aperti la sera sotto casa. Tutto perfetto... Grazie!
Un apartamento acogedor y muy bien situado para visitar la ciudad. La estancia ha sido muy agradable.

The apartment is lovely, clean and modern. The air conditioning was great (we were there on a hot week). The proximity to sights, restaurants and cafes was excellent. The only downside is that the street is very loud at night and people were partying right on our door step. The pros certainly outweighed the cons for us, but it was rowdier than we were expecting.

Amazing location with stunning views.  The apartment has everything you need and it all fits into a small space.  So stylish.  Pedro gave us some awesome tips when we checked in.  The perfect place to base our holiday in Lisbon.
Everything was very nice, we enjoyed our stay very much!

I loved this Airbnb! It’s loud at night so beware! But we loved that character and charming atmosphere. Everyone congregated here at night apparently it’s the hip place to hang.
We are in front of the famous trolley/ Tran tracks and it’s so cool to be able to get photos here.
I would recommend Pedro’s place! I had to ask for hand soap and an iron board but they are so nice and sweet to provide it!
If I come back this is where I would book :)

Pedro’s place is awesome. Funky loft in central area of Lisbon. Very clean. Bed very comfortable. Great for couple. Great little kitchen and coffee machine for making your own meals.
We were here over the weekend - really fun area - there is some noise at night since it is in the heart of Bario Alto but we still slept very well and noise is blocked out easily with iPhone white noise. Bright and beautiful views and Pedro provides black out blinds for at night.
Best part about this place is location and communication - very responsive and very easy to check in - even welcomed us in himself early to help us out. Comes with recommendations and suggestions. Would love to come back :)!!!

It’s an amazing space with a great view!
I would recommend this ! As I had a wonderful time there.

We had an amazing time! They made check in very easy and even waited an hour over the time we agreed upon for our arrival (due to a delayed flight and not being able to connect to the airport WiFi to let them know)  We had three adults ready to take in everything Portugal had to offer! We enjoyed our first meal at a place they recommended and enjoyed staying up till the early morning hours with the locals! Can't say enough about the location and they great job they did with the limited space. We had everything we needed and loved the set up!!!
I went to Lisbon with my boyfriend and we really liked this room. It's a nice and clean room with airconditioning. We would definitely recommend this room!

This apartment is in the PERFECT location to get to know the old city of Lisbon and explore. The rental team will let you know that it is a walk up (no elevator), but that's one of this loft's charming features. Beautifully furnished and decorated and perfect for a weekend escape to Lisbon. Lots of great restaurant/bar recommendations in the unit and the portable wifi was nice to be able to have service while I was out around town. HIGHLY recommend!
Great space. Really modern and clean. Great for a weekend in Lisbon. Apartment is at the top of 5 flights of stairs.
Pedro's apartment was amazing! Even though it is on top floor, it was very cozy and very stylish! Thank you so much again!

Cracking apartment in an excellent spot! This is right on the funicular line in a great spot- central and lively but not too noisy even though there are lots of bars and restaurants nearby and a 10 min walk to the ferry and TimeOut market. We had a friendly welcome from our host- the 5 storeys aren’t that bad and shouldn’t be a deterrent at all! The flat was super cute with lots of great extras that were really great- black out blinds, a welcome bottle of wine, free portable wifi, espresso machine and great restaurant and bar tips. Would stay there again in a heartbeat!
Piso pequeño pero muy completo. Muy atentos con todo.
Muy lindo apartamento, luminoso, ubicado en un sector muy turístico y bohemio. Es tal cuál se muestra en las fotos. Destaco además la amabilidad de Pedro y su excelente disposición.

This loft is absolutely gorgeous, so well designed and in the best neighborhood in Lisbon.  Goncalo easily accommodated our crazy arrival schedule, and he gave us wine and chocolates as an arrival present!  Place is ultra clean and very cool.  Would stay here again in a heartbeat.

The apartment is clean, cozy and beautiful. Unfortunately Pedro was not there to receive us fir the first time but his staff was there all the time to make sure that everything was ok! Great location with the iconic Tram ( yellow popular small train ) just in front of your door.  I extremely recommend for 1 couple or 2 couples.
Great host

The flat is super : cosy and design. The location is really great too and very central allowing you to walk around Lisbon easily. The morning view on the 25th of April bridge was terrifying! The host also welcomed us, helped us to carry the lagguages through the 5 floors (no elevator there) and gave us some nice tips and places to eat nearby. Nothing to complain, we just had a really great experience from A to Z.  One small  note  though, it might be a bit "noisy" seeing its central location but unless you really want to sleep with open windows and not using the A/C you will be more than ok!

The apartment is really lovely, perfect in every detail, with an amazing view and overlooking one of the liveliest streets of the city.
The communication with the team was always quick and they were all so kind.
Everything was perfect!

The description and photos of this apartment are very accurate and honest. The host left lots of thoughtful touches such as chocolates and a welcome note, wine and coffee! My boyfriend and I stayed here for 3 nights and loved it, the location was great and we could walk everywhere easily or walk to the tram/metro when needed. The street that the apartment is on was often busy with tourists as the funiculars run up and down in the day (great photo opportunity). There was some noise at night but this didn’t keep us awake, in-fact it was a fun spot to have a drink in the evening. The portable WiFi was useful to help us get to places whilst we were out and about. The hosts were very responsive and made check in and out really easy and gave great advice. We chose to get the metro directly to and from the airport which was less than €3 and very easy, just ask the host for more details.

Super tolles, zentral gelegenes Appartement
Immer wieder gerne würde ich sofort weiter empfehlen

This is an amazing spot. Excellent location close to the heart of the Chaido and Bairro Alto neighborhoods. The street can be quite noisy and boisterous at night, but with the window closed and the AC on you hardly notice it while in the apartment. I whole heartedly recommend this place!
캐리어를 끌고 5층까지 올라가는 게 쉽진 않았지만 숙소에서 보는 경치와 내부 인테리어가 너무 훌륭했고 호스트도 친절해서 만족스러운 숙박이었습니다 :)
Fantastic location, beautiful place, if we come back to Lisbon we will definitely stay here again!

A stylish top floor flat located centrally in a very lively part of the city. The communication was very good prior to our arrival and Antonio had left some very thorough (and excellent!) tips about eating/going out destinations in the city. Everything was easily within walking distance and anything further could be easily accessed by the metro. We absolutely loved the vibrancy of Lisbon and this flat just added to our enjoyment. Thanks!

One of the most amazing Airbnb’s I have ever stayed in. The host has a long list of fabulous recommendations and left so many cute little touches for us! The location couldn’t be any better, close to many great reataurants, the market and and the water. The loft itself is so chic and I fell in love. Would 100% recommend!!

Fabulous little place with everything we needed and more. Centrally located with a very lively nightlife just downstairs (but don’t worry, windows are very soundproof), the portable wifi they provided was so helpful navigating around the city. Lots of stairs but beautiful view made it worthwhile! Excellent, obrigado!

The apartment is well equipped, modern  and the view over the tejo river is gorgious. The apartment is located really ideal for exploring the city by foot and there are lots of restaurants and shops nearby. We had really an excellent time

This small but adorable space was great for my daughter and I’s stay in Lisbon. It was really clean, it fit the two of us nicely. But if you have a LOT of luggage, it may be too small. The location is perfect in terms of walking distance to *best* areas and metro line, but it’s also on a really famous street with the trolly and bars so at night there was a huge bar crowd swarming the front door for hours, and it was honestly pretty loud. Overall it’s a cute spot in a great location, the host is very nice, but if you’re not a night owl you may get annoyed.

We stayed at 4 different Airbnb’s in Lisbon and this was the best one! The bed was super comfortable and the apartment was very clean and cozy! Location was great!!! They have a portable WiFi you can take around with you which was a great plus. Would def stay here again!

The location of this place was great. We were able to walk to most places in the city. The apartment is small but designed very well and includes a comfortable bed and we enjoyed the coffee maker. It is on a busy street but the noise at night did not bother us.

Pedro's place is amazing and super centrally located in Lisbon! It is a 5th floor walk up but that was no problem at all and the views from the living room are gorgeous. This place is definitely in an active part of the city, and there are a few bars right downstairs - in the evenings it can definitely be a bit rowdy downstairs, but my husband and I were happy to join in the fun so this was perfect for us! Just something to keep in mind if you have small children or would like a more quiet environment. Overall the apartment was clean and comfortable, with amenities we took advantage of like a Keurig and fridge, along with the washing machine. Highly recommend this place if you are looking for a great and affordable place to stay in Lisbon!

A great place to stay when visiting Lisbon as tourist - really close to everything. We loved the stunning view over the river, the famous bridge and rooftops. Cosy and modern flat with everything you need. Can definitely recommend it! Maybe a bit noisy in the evenings when the street outside turns out into a partyplace. But it didn’t disturb our sleep anyway.
Top location and cool flat

Great place in a very central location. Fantastic views, lots of sunlight, great shower. Would stay here again. It can get loud at night in the street but it is manageable, and is a good location for wherever you need to go in Lisbon.

We absolutely loved this apartment, it was perfect for our stay. It's small but has everything you need, and gets lots of lovely sunlight during the day. Very clean and comfortable. Loved the extra touches too - a bottle of wine, oranges to juice and coffee pods. Central location and easy to get anywhere. Would absolutely reccomend to others.
Highly recommend

Absolutely great location. Close to everything you can imagine. Light sleepers might not like the noise coming from the bars outside. But it was of no issue to me and my friend. Fast response from the host. Very grateful for letting us drop our bags earlier and letting us check out a bit later as well. Will stay again if i visit Lisbon next time. Thank you for a great stay.

We had a great time in Lisbon and enjoyed our stay in Chiado very much. The area was great and packed with nice restaurants and cosy bars to discover. Unfortunately, we had some trouble with a leaking roof due to heavy rainfalls. The team around Pedro and Antonio reacted immediately and moved us to an even bigger apartment in the same are. Also, we were refunded half of the price of our total stay and told that the leaks are going to be fixed within the next days (in case you consider booking). Our resumé: Stylish apartment, great support and a perfect neighborhood for food- and wine-lovers.

Can't say enough good things about this place - very central, great amenities, check-in was fast and informative. It's a very beautiful space close to a number of bars and restaurants. Would definitely stay here again!!

Great central location, very clean and functional city pad. Definitely recommend it if you are looking to discover Chiado and Bairro Alto. We would definitely stay again when we return to Lisbon. Many thanks guys

Hospitalidade perfeita! Tudo muito preciso...comunicação, localização, limpeza e cuidados como dispositivo de internet móvel disponível, um vinho de boas vindas e dicas de restaurantes locais. Muito obrigada!
Wonderful place in a happening location. The team at Chiado lofts was super friendly and helpful.

Situé dans l'une des ruelles les plus pittoresques de Lisbonne, cet appartement nous a plongé immédiatement dans l'ambiance. La déco est simple mais faite avec goût, la propreté impeccable et l'emplacement idéal. J'avais un peu peur du bruit de la rue après avoir lu les différents commentaires. En effet, le pied de l'immeuble est l'endroit où se retrouvent beaucoup de jeunes chaque soir et jusqu'aux petit matin. Malgré tout, une fois les fenêtres fermées, le bruit d'ambiance ne nous a pas empêché de dormir. Peut-être est-ce plus compliqué l'été ou en week-end ? En tout cas, parfait pour ce petit séjour avec ma fille de 12 ans.

The loft is just perfect, it is in one of the most central and beautiful place, you have bus, metro & tram at side and you can walk almost everywhere thanks to the perfect position. The loft is small but, as you can see in the pics, full of light and air and it has a very good energy thanks to the guys that take care of it with a lot of details that will make you feel welcome from the first moment. The appartement was very clean and full equipped, the communication with the host always perfect.
Thanks guys, we'll definitely come back there next time in Lisbon!
Valeria e Fabio

We can't say enough about this apartment at the Chiado lofts. The space is small, but perfectly designed and optimizes every inch available! We loved having the Nespresso machine and views of the river. Bed was SUPER comfy (so much that we almost missed our early flight!) Location was the perfect walking distance to all of the top sights and local nightlight. As other reviews have mentioned, this is a very popular/famous photo spot with the tramline at your doorstep. On Saturday night, there was a huge gathering at the bar underneath the building. In a strange way, we love street noise so it didn't bother us a bit. But if you're sensitive things of that nature, this is something to keep in mind when booking.
We will absolutely book the Chiado loft for future trips to Lisbon. Thank you guys for everything!

Situation géographique de premier choix
Appartement au 5 ème etages sans ascenseur il faut le preciser mais qui n'a pas été un problème pour nous
Juste une remarque ,l'appartement se trouve au dessus d'un lieu rue occupé par des bars de nuits au demeurant sympathiques mais bruyant jusqu'a 1 h du matin ,alors on accepte cette nuisance ou pas ,pour nous pas de souci cela ne nous pas dérangé
Merci pour l'accueil et la qualité de propreté du logement
on y reviendra
It was beautiful. Centrally located. Really lovely to come home to :D If you are very tall the slanted ceilings might be more inconvenient, but I found them to be very easy to contend with.

Absolutely 5 stars across the board.
Check in / cleanliness / recommendations/ location were fantastic!
If I go back to Lisbon, I’ll look this up first!

在市中心，离很多餐厅也很近。
楼下有很多酒吧，周末晚上人比较闹，周末开party楼下聚集的人比较多。
房间干净，有很好的里斯本餐厅推荐，很实用。楼下就有观光tram。
推荐给两人入住。

This was our third time at this BNB & I wouldn't stay anywhere else when coming to Lisbon! The apartment is in a great neighborhood, within walking distance off the great eats and drinks of the city, communication is always quick & the space is spotless. Thanks again!

We had a fantastic stay for New Year’s Eve - the apartment is ideally located to allow you to explore Lisbon with ease. The bar below can get a bit lively in the evenings, so it’s not one for light sleepers, but we absolutely loved it. Antonio and the team took such good care of us, settling us in, giving recommendations and even leaving a bottle of champagne to see the new year in with. Just perfect!
Mitten im Zentrum, tolle location, nette Leute, wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt.
Espectacular!!! Atentísimos tanto Gonzalo como Antonio. Hemos pasado unos días geniales. Ubicación perfecta para conocer Lisboa. Recomendable 100%.

Hallo, wir waren von der Unterkunft begeistert. Die Angaben haben voll und ganz zugetroffen. Wir sind einfach froh uns für diese Loft entschieden zu haben und würden jederzeit wieder kommen. Nur weiter zu empfehlen.
Die Kommunikation war unkompliziert und die Antworten auf alle Fragen wurden sehr schnell beantwortet
Great place to stay! The apartment is beautiful and located in the center of Lisbon, there are lots of restaurants and bars within walking distance!
Everything was perfect! Great, clean space in a perfect area. Would stay again in a heartbeat!

This was our last stop on a two-week trip and by far the best Airbnb we stayed in. Everything about it exceeded our expectations. The space is BEAUTIFUL, with views of the ocean and charming Lisbon rooftops. The location was perfect - we walked everywhere, and the hosts' restaurant recommendations were all excellent. As other reviewers have said, the street noise was definitely noticeable at night, but we didn't have any trouble sleeping because of it, and we'd stay again in a heartbeat. Finally - the hosts have continued those old-school Airbnb traditions like leaving a bottle of wine and chocolates for the guests - a nice touch that few hosts still do as the service grows. Thanks for an amazing stay!
The place was very cozy and clean. Antonio was an amazing host and helped us with some local tips as well. Also, the location is awesome and there is a ton to do around it.
Really nice Appartement, perfect location in the old city center, Antonio and Pedro were so nice and helpful, would definitely recommend it

Amazing flat in the most beautiful area of Lisbon. This cosy, well-designed apartment is just perfect for two people and we can’t wait to come back again. We enjoyed every minute there and don’t have even one point to complain.

L'appart se trouve dans le centre ville, juste dans la rue avec la funiculaire de Bica. Il est super joli, propre et refait avec le gout! Un seul point negative était que il y a un bar et entre 22h et 1h du matin ca devient un endroit bien bruyant.

Sehr gemütliches, helles Appartement im 5. Stock unter der Dachschräge mit atemberaubendem Blick auf den Tejo aus dem Seitenfenster. Perfekt zu zweit, technisch sehr gut ausgestattet, ausreichend Steckdosen. Super praktisch gelegen direkt an der Abfahrt der Straßenbahn Elevador da Bica, einer der drei Standseilbahnen in Lissabon, so dass man auch sehr schnell an der empfehlenswerten Time out Markthalle ist.

Great respite in the center of town! The hosts were very helpful at check-in, meeting us to ensure we found parking and the location with ease. The apartment was very clean and equipped with all the amenities you'd need for your stay. It's centrally located in Bairro Alto is it's easy to walk everywhere. And while the street below is quite busy with late night party goers, the 5th floor was quiet and easy to sleep. Thanks for a great stay!

Location was excellent! Pedro was easy to communicate with! He met us and had tons of great suggestions of things to see and do!
He had lots of nice touches like coffee and internet that you could carry around they city with you if you don't have internet when you are in Europe (so helpful!). We loved staying here and will do so again next time we are in Lisbon!
Was a great apartment in a great location with a beautiful view of the water. Just note that it is 5 stories up!

We had a really nice time in this apartment. The apartment is amazing, there is everything you need and it’s close to the public transport and the centre of Lisboa and there is a lot of restaurants and bars around. I can really recomend to everyone to stay here.

❤️❤️❤️ Perfect location for us, close to transit, nightlife, and what a great place this is with the most up-to-date amenities! Portable wifi to take with you, wine when you arrive, chocolates by the bed, recommendations on places to eat, great layout in a tiny space.
Yes there is a very active nightlife streetside, so
If you're a light sleeper, it may not be a great fit, but turn on some soft music and enjoy a bottle of wine and being in Lisbon 5 floors up!

Das kleine, geschmackvoll eingerichtete Loft liegt im Herzen der Stadt und die wichtigsten Sehenswürdigkeiten sind gut zu Fuss erreichbar. Strassenbahn, Metro, Bäckerei, Supermarkt, Restaurants etc. befinden sich in nächster Nähe. Vis-à-vis hat es eine winzige Bar, weshalb die Party auf der Strasse stattfindet, kann auch mal etwas lauter werden. Pedro und Antonio waren jederzeit äusserst hilfsbereit - wir kommen gerne wieder!

Outstanding apartment right in the center of the city! We loved our stay and would recommend it to anyone. The noise was not a bother for us and made the atmosphere of the neighborhood lively and fun.

Das Loft liegt super zentral und ist exakt wie beschrieben. Alles ist zu Fuß erreichbar. Nachts wird es vor der Tür etwas lauter, darauf sollte man vorbereitet sein. Wir würden jederzeit wiederkommen!

This place was gorgeous, every single detail was taking care of. It looks recently fixed (remodeled). Gonzalo was super kind and available. The place was super clean and beautiful. The only difficulty was trying to reach the apartment through the stairs with all our luggage. But besides that it was a great, unforgettable stay in Lisbon. Close to restaurants, close to public transit and nite life. We fell in love with this place and Lisbon. Definitely we'll come to this beautiful amenity in our next trip to Lisbon. Recommended for young people.
Loved it!!!

Pedro's Chiado Loft 4 was perfect. It very clean and equipped to a very high standard. It had everything that we expected and more. It is a perfect location to experience the buzz and vibrancy of Lisbon and just a short walk to the city centre . Our hosts were a big plus, more than accommodating and really friendly.

Perfect little spot right in the middle of everything ! Certainly some nightlife outside - but after a long day of exploring it won't matter, adds to the local feel. We loved the place. Fit our needs for a base camp in the middle of Lisbon - easy communication. Spotless.

Заранее списались с Педро и договорились о времени прибытия. Квартиру нашли быстро. Расположение отличное. Нас встретили, все объяснили. В квартире есть переносной роутер, что очень необходимо. Квартира полностью соответствует фотографиям. Есть вся необходимая посуда. Однозначно рекомендую для знакомства с Лиссабоном.

The apartment was clean and comfortable. We were looked after more than one would expect. There were many little touches that may our stay fantabilous
One negative was the 5 flights of stairs but our cases were brought up for us. The view from our window was breathtaking
Thank you Pedro for your warmth and friendship
Jim & Marie Aherne

Amazing stay! We stayed here for 4 nights (2 people) and it's wasn't too small by any means, great facilities, they have everything you'd need for a short stay. They even provide a portable WiFi device for you which helped us getting around the city loads! Fantastic view from the window but we all know a view comes at a price, it's quite a hill walk up to the apartment and a lot of stairs to get up in the building but it's definitely worth it as the apartment is a gem. There is a bar right opposite the apartment so maybe if you're a light sleeper you should take that into consideration, after a couple glasses of wine I'm out like a light so the noise didn't bother us. Overall we thoroughly enjoyed our stay here and would recommend highly!

Thank you for a wonderful stay. The apartment contained everything we needed. The bed was very comfortable. We cooked a meal and found that we had all of the utensils and cooking equipment we needed. We even had a juicer for our breakfast orange juice! Our host supplied some much appreciated finishing touches such as a bottle of wine and some chocolates. The apartment is extremely well located in the Chiado district. The street gets very busy with people standing outside bars drinking on an evening, but as the apartment is on the fifth floor and the windows are double glazed, we weren't bothered by noise. Our host provided us with a helpful booklet containing info about local bars and restaurants which came in handy. The hosts helpfully allowed us to store our bags in the apartment after checkout and collect them before our flight. Overall a highly recommended Airbnb.

Very clean house. The location is perfect; it's very close to one of the biggest metrostations and in one of the nicest streets of Lisbon (tourists are constantly taking pictures of the view in the street!). The street is busy at nighttime and there's a pub on the other side of the street, which may cause a bit of noise but nothing too annoying. We stayed as a duo but staying as 3-4 persons is also possible. However, due to it not being big I wouldn't recommend staying with more than 3 unless you don't mind seeing eachother constantly (except in the bathroom) and don't mind the amount of space.

This apartment really added to our experience in Lisbon! It was unique, clean and beautiful. Just pack light, plenty of steps up to the loft. But worth it and not unusual to encounter your fair share of stairs in the city!

If you mind some street noise in the late evenings coming from outside, you should look for something else.
If you don't mind, you'll have absolutely awesome experience of living in the very heart of Lisbon in a an apartment which has everything to enjoy it. Fully functional powerful air conditioning, nicely equiped kitchen, washing machine, BT speaker and much more.
Convenience store is two minutes away, historic tram 28 stop is one minute away, metro and some of city's best restaurants are five minutes walking.
Would recomend staying here to all friends visiting Lisbon.
Wir hatten eine tolle Zeit in dem Loft! Es war alles wie angegeben, sauber und super zentral! Für einen Kurztrip ins schöne Lissabon einfach perfekt.

위치가 정말 좋아요. 중심가에 자리하고 있고 바다가 보이는 곳이라 관광객들이 항상 모여 사진을 찍고 있는데 그 예쁜 곳에 묵게 되어 너무 특별한 경험이었어요!
방에 있는 커다란 창을 통해 그 풍경을 편안하게 바라볼 수 있어요. 야경 포인트에 다 가봤는데 집에서 보는 야경이 제일 예뻤어요 :)
집도 정말 예쁘고 깨끗해요. 호스트가 이것저것 세심하게 신경썼다는 것도 느껴졌어요. 다만 다락이라 꼭대기에 있다는 점! 올라갈때만 조금 힘들어요ㅋㅋ 그래도 다시 리스본에 간다면 또 묵고 싶은 숙소입니다.

The apartment is absolutely beautiful with an amazing view of the water and bridge. Pedro met us upon check-in and was completely helpful in giving us an amazing suggestion for a dinner spot we never would have found on our own. The location was perfect - walking distance from everything you could possibly need! The apartment was up 5 flights of stairs so if traveling with lots of luggage that might prove to be difficult. Also the apartment is located on a very lively street and is quite noisy until very late at night. Pedro greeted us with a bottle of wine which was a very appreciated touch. We loved our Lisbon experience here in this airbnb!

I was warned about street noise but it was way beyond my expectations.  We arrived late and it was difficult to find our front door for the mass of people partying in front of it.  Great place to stay if you you don't want to sleep until 2 or 3 am.  Friday through to Sunday in my experience.  There were some nice touches with the accomodation including a portable wifi which was handy.

Such a great find! The apartment is so cleverly designed that even though it is small, it feels luxurious and spacious.
The location is great as it's so close to the metro and on a very picturesque and iconic road.
It's also great if you want easy access to the lively night-life scene.
The hosts are super helpful too.
So as long as you don't mind climbing the stairs, it's the perfect loft apartment.
Excellent experience in Lisbon
Very kind host, service was excellent!!! Never had such a great host!!!!
Beautiful, clean appartment. The same or even better than the pictures and perfect location!

Merci à l'équipe de chiado loft qui nous a attendu malgré une arrivée tardive et retardée. Nous avons reçu en amont de notre séjour tous les renseignements nécessaires à l'organisation de notre arrivée. Les échanges sont faciles et réactifs. De gentilles attentions à notre arrivée (bouteille de vin, capsules de café, chocolats et confitures) dans ce mignon studio sous les toits lisboètes.
L'appartement est fidèle à sa description, propre, bien équipé et très agréable à vivre.
Une petite borne wifi portable est à notre disposition (c'est très pratique).
Le quartier est très central et animé, l'immeuble se situe aux abords des fameux funiculaire/ tramway.
Nous craignions le bruit de ces moyens de transports, mais finalement cela n'est pas génant. En revanche des petits bars dans la rue ouverts jusqu'à 2h du matin rendent l'endroit TRÈS animé et TRÈS bruyant... bien que l'isolation soit très bonne dans l'appartement cela peu gêner les personnes sensibles au bruit (pour ma part, boules quiès nécessaires!)
Séjour parfait malgré l'environnement bruyant :-)

Location is perfect and the hosts are very nice and organized. The apartment is just like the pictures, it was very clean and has everything you need. The 5 floors are very hard to climb, but the view is worth it! The street has a great nightlife and cool bars, but it can be quite loud if you want to sleep early, I recomend you join the party!
Cute, Cozy place to stay in a lively neighborhood
Very clean, organized apartment! Close to everything. Only downfall is noise at night since it is above bars but nonetheless we loved our stay!
Mooi klein appartementje midden in het uitgaan centrum van Lissabon. In het weekend staan de straten vol met feestende mensen, erg gezellig om een keer mee te maken
Fabulous place - great decor, fully equipped (++), great location - and wonderful hosts!
We enjoyed staying at the appartment very much. It is the ideal location for exploring Lisbon. Can get noisy at night due to the bars around.

It is a absolutely beautiful loft, very clean, equipped well with anything one might need for the trip. We walked to most of the attractions from this place. Gonçalo is a wonderful host, very helpful and knowledgeable about the city.
Great location, nice appartment.

Appartement fidèle aux photos fournies ! Très propre, très bien situé proche du tram, du métro, des boutiques et du Mercado da Ribeira que nous avons adoré. Le seul point négatif du séjour est le bruit dans la rue et l'affluence de fêtards le soir qui dure tard dans la nuit. Nous avons communiqué avec Pedro qui est très réactif et très professionnel et Gonçalo qui est venu nous accueillir et qui est adorable !

Fantastic view, very clean, well equipped apartment, lively neighberhood. Definitely a place to recommend if you don't mind the noises of the bar on the street! We had a wonderful time there! Thank you!!

Мы останавливались в лофте на 3 дня. Жилье просто прекрасно! Расположенное на очень шумной и туристической улице, прямо перед остановкой фуникулера, квартира остается очень тихой и уютной, располагаясь наверху под крышей. Очень интересная планировка, которая создает ощущение пребывания в загородном доме. Светлый приятный интерьер, в котором есть все, что только может понадобиться. Множество кухонной и бытовой техники, всевозможные шкафы и тумбы для вещей, здесь очень комфортно находиться длительное время. Кухня оборудована всем необходимым, при своей небольшой площади, хорошая планировка позволяет готовить еду со всеми удобствами. Под крышей есть еще одно спальное место на втором уровне, правда прямо под кондиционером. Помимо стандартного wifi в квартире есть портативный роутер с аккумулятором, который можно носить с собой в кармане, имея всегда неограниченный доступ к интернету в любой точке города за бесплатно. Отличное решение, которое очень помогло нам, избавив от необходимости переплат за роуминг или покупки другой сим карты. Отдельно хочется отметить, что в шкафу есть раскладная сушилка для белья, вроде бы мелочь, но в большинстве случаев постиранное белье на съемной квартире сушить элементарно негде, за это отдельный плюс. Расположение квартиры с точки зрения туриста просто идеально. Набережная находится в 10 минутах неспешной ходьбы, где по дороге есть отличное заведение Mercado da Ribeira food court со множеством небольших кафе с вкусной едой и демократичными ценами, обязательно загляните, лучше всего в утренние часы, когда там практически нет людей. Буквально в двух шагах за углом расположен продуктовый маркет, где можно закупиться достаточно большим набором еды для готовки и хорошей свежей выпечкой.
Гостеприимство хозяев также выше всяческих похвал, мы смогли оставить вещи в квартире и спокойно пойти гулять задолго до времени чекина. Также при заезде мы получили приятный комплимент в виде вина и угощений, а также большой список рекомендация для посещения, за что премного благодарны.
Когда будете выезжать в аэропорт или передвигаться по городу, рекомендую воспользоваться убером а не такси, ценник получается ощутимо ниже, зачастую больше чем в два раза, из-за очень плотного движения в городе.
Квартира оставила исключительно положительные впечатления, с радостью поселились бы здесь снова!
Fantastic place, great communication with host, busy and very central location, and they had a wireless internet device that we took around the city and was a lifesaver. Great experience.

This place is amazing! My boyfriend and I couldn't believe our eyes when google maps took us to the picturesque little street that this flat is on. It's bang in the middle of Lisbon, so it's really easy to get to all of the touristy places (either walking or on public transport). The flat itself is gorgeous - small but it has everything you need. It's really modern and clean, and has little extras like a juicer, a coffee machine, which make the mornings a bit special.
As for the hosts, they were so lovely. Pedro and Gonçalo replied to our messages almost instantly. When we had an issue they came over to the flat to sort it out within an hour, even though it was late at night. They left cute little chocolates and some Easter treats, which was so sweet of them. Gonçalo was also so kind and accommodating on our last day helping us out, we really appreciated it :)
100% would recommend this place, and I can't wait to stay in one of these guys' flats again when I return to Lisbon.

I stayed here for a week. António was 100% responsive to my questions and also was really kind and helpful whenever I need a help :) The room was exactly same as the photos and the view from the window was really fantastic. WiFi worked well, and I could also listen to music via Bose bluetooth speaker, which was one of the best things I enjoyed a lot in this place. It is located in the center of the center in Lisbon so you can reach to all the tourist attractions by walk. I took a bus only one time when I went to Belem area for instance. There are many nice bars and restaurant nearby, and a cheap supermarket and fruit shop are only in 200m.
A bit minus things of this place would be: 1) There is no shower hose in the bathroom, it has only a square shower head attached to the ceiling, which was actually very uncomfortable for me. I was almost forced to wash my hair whenever I just wanted to wash my legs or arms(it kept me too sanitary though:) Also the water pressure wasn't that good enough in my opinion. 2) Although the location of this Airbnb is fantastic as I said above, it was quite noisy until late night, since there are several bars on the street and downstairs (1st floor), and always many people gathered there and talk all night.
Other than this few things, I really enjoyed staying in this Airbnb. Thanks a lot!

Amazing flat in a great location directly next to the Bica! We loved that the tram 28 was directly in front of our flat and the bica was literally in the same street. The flat is amazing and has everything you need for a couple. We loved the design and the view from the window. A minor drawback was the noise at night - the street is full of partygoers and although it's on the 5th floor you can hear it. Checkin, Checkout was excellent.

We had a great stay in Lissabon. The Apartment is very central and everything we wanted to see was near by.
Although we arrived very late in the evening, António welcomed us warmly and recommended some restaurants.

Appartement très bien conçu avec beaucoup de charme. Il ne manque rien . Très pratique la clé 3G pour bénéficier du wifi lors de nos déplacements.
Emplacement idéal dans un quartier très animé avec de nombreux bars et restaurants Le double vitrage est efficace. Nous avons passé un super séjour.

Excelente! Altamente recomendável. Bem localizado, limpo e agradável! A rua é ponto de encontro de muitos lisboetas e estrangeiros. Mas não há preocupação quanto ao barulho, pois as janelas não permitem passagem de sons. Antônio nos recebeu super bem. Voltaria a me hospedar em um dos apartamentos  dessa equipe sem sombra de dúvidas.
Conforme aux photos, très bien placé, état nickel.

We really enjoyed our stay in this loft. It is in a fantastic location - totally walkable to most of the top sights in Lisbon. There are lots of bars and restaurants around, and the host provided a comprehensive list of recommendations for us. The loft was exactly as pictured and has a beautiful view from the windows. We would definitely stay here again!

Amazing location! Great spot if you like nightlife and don't mind noise on the streets. Beautiful view, cozy, great bars/restaurants/shops nearby, exceptional design + wicked lively locale. Pedro + co were really responsive, friendly + professional. Left oranges + chocolate and a homemade note. Came over late in the eve to check heating.
Few downsides: Did feel a bit like a hotel rather than a truly authentic Airbnb experience (=staying in the home of a local). My boyfriend is 6'4 and hit his head a few times on the slanted roofs. Lastly, the noise on the street is loud (but we loved that!).
Overall, a very very highly rated experience.
Nice appartment. Very clean. Good bed and lovely kitchen with everything necessery.

L'appartamento è posizionato in una zona perfetta, sulla via di uno degli elevador più romantici e vivaci della città, vista spettacolare, molto pulito e curato nei minimi dettagli, ottima accoglienza e attenzione degli host. Insomma consigliatissimo!

L'alloggio di pedro e del suo team è stato davvero perfetto. Si trova in una zona centrale , dove è possibile godere della vera bellezza e atmosfera portoghese. La casa è molto pulita e confortevole. È stato un soggiorno molto piacevole e ringraziamo pedro e il suo team per questo.

Very cute and clean apartment at a good location.
Everything was very organized and there was a nice host.
Liked it a lot!

The flat is just perfect (beautiful, well arranged, comfortable...) and the location too.
If you have a very light sleep, be aware that 6 floors below, the street is noisy late at night.

This apartment was great in every respect -- very affordable; fully modern interior but in an old, classic building in a great location in Lisbon; and the hosts were super communicative and flexible in allowing us to checkin a little early and leave our bags in the apartment a little bit late. I would absolutely recommend this apartment or any other managed by the same group of people.
Great airbnb with super hosts (handwritten note, chocolate, etc - thanks guys!). The apartment is perfectly located and super comfy, can't have wished for more.
Increíble!

Nous avons passé un séjour magique pour le nouvel an, en amoureux, à Lisbonne, dans un logement magnifique.... Tout était parfait. Le descriptif et les photos correspondent tout à fait à l'appartement qui est situé dans un des meilleurs quartiers de Lisbonne, à proximité de tout : petite épicerie, boulangerie, bars et boutique de Pasteis... Quelques chocolats, du café, de la confiture et une bouteille de vin nous attendaient à notre arrivée un peu tardive. Nos hôtes sont charmants et très prévenants.
Allez y les yeux fermés, vous ne serez pas déçus...

Very comfortable, well-equipped and stylish flat in a great location! Just a bit loud at night because of the chatter from the bars down below but other than that highly recommended. The host was very helpful and friendly.
Perfect place. Very clean home. Nice view. Great!!

Apartamento ideal para um fim-de-semana. Foram muito simpáticos connosco. Receberam-nos com bombons, bem como compotas e cápsulas de café para o pequeno-almoço. Espaço limpo, cozinha bem equipada. O único reparo que temos a fazer é o facto de o plástico da torradeira estar a derreter e libertar um cheiro um pouco desagradável para o pão. De resto, nada a apontar. Anfitrião simpático e disponível.

The loft is on the 5th floor so if you don't mind climbing up the stairs this is the place to be. I loved the location - it's really close to everything: Shopping, sights, public transportation, restaurants. It was a delight to communicate with the owners - they helped out in any possible way and provided useful tips on what to do. They really wanted to make sure that I had a great time and everything was ok. The apartment is really nice and clean.

Pedro's pad is great, first it's right in the center of Lisbon, walking distance everything, supermarkets, restaurants, bars, bakeries and shops, and a lot of the tourist sights. you are literally right next the the Bica tram stop. The apartment itself is clean, comfortable and quiet. There's also a bottle of red wine plus capsules for the coffee machine. Pedro is flexible with a little earlier check in and the process is easy, he also explains how everything works and gave us some suggestion for food. I highly  recommend it. I would mention that it is stairs to the top floor, but then you also get a view to the ocean!
Great place and ideal location for the city, at night the street below becomes very lively into the early hours and at times can be very noisey!
You cannot fault this apartment, which is quirky, spotlessly clean, interestingly decorated and perfectly located. Thank you so much for a great stay in Lisbon!

The whole Chiado Lofts team was fantastic. They work together to make sure that questions are answered quickly, that everything is well-organized for the guests, and that generally everything goes smoothly. The place is fantastic, fairly large for a European studio, and is clean and modern with a newly remodeled bathroom.  It was really nice how clean the place was when I arrived. Also, there were small touches waiting for me (such as a bottle of wine and a list of suggested restaurants) which were also great. The apartment is centrally located, and within walking distance of essentially the whole city.   It did not bother me, but it is on the fifth floor of a walk-up. If you have trouble with stairs, this would be an issue. Overall, the place was great!

Excellent séjour dans cet appartement.
Très bien situé. La rue est un peu bruyante mais l'appartement est bien isolé, on peut dormir sans boule quies, sans soucis...
Très propre, niveau équipement y'a ce qui faut !
Bon accueil

Le 2ème lit en mezzanine n'est peut-être pas adapté pour des enfants car aucune barrière pour protéger.
A part ça je vous conseille à 200% ce logement !

Pedros team var alltid lyhörda och snabba att svara på frågor. Trots att vårt flyg kom sent på natten fanns Goncalo på plats och tog emot oss med ett leende. Loftet var superfint, rent och vackert inrett. Från gatan nedanför hördes ett mysigt sorl på kvällarna från de små barerna och restaurangerna. Trygg och vänlig stämning. Jag rekommenderar varmt detta boende.

Comfortable, modern, and stylish, this studio apartment in a 300-year-old terrace near the top of the Bica de Duarte (complete with quaint tramline running up and down the hill) was a pleasure to stay in. The location - in the heart of the buzzing Chiado quarter, a short walk from both the Bairrio Alto and the waterfront - is superb (though note that the Bice de Duarte itself is a steep hill!), the apartment is clean and well-equipped, and the Chaido Loft host team were polite, responsive, and helpful - a really professional outfit.

I was travelling alone for work (attending Web Summit 2016), so chose eating out over using the apartment's kitchen, but it is modern, clean, and has everything you would need for making simple meals during a short stay. Wifi - crucially, for me, as I had work to do - was fast and reliable.

The apartment is the perfect size for a solo traveller, and would certainly be so for a couple, too (the double bed is very comfortable). Space may be restricted for more than two people, if you were going to spend substantial time in the apartment itself. But why would you, when it's a perfect base for exploring a beautiful and fun area of town.

I would absolutely recommend Chiado Loft, and would certainly stay here again should I return to Lisbon.

This apartment was exactly as expected and the hosts were very great to work with. They went above and beyond to make us feel welcome and it seems they thought of everything. The location is perfect and we would stay here again if given the chance to return to Lisbon!

This apartment is immaculately clean and very cozy. It sits above a bunch of bars, but it's high enough that the sounds of the nightlife likely won't keep you awake. Check in was very easy, and we appreciated the bottle of wine that was left for us in the fridge!
Great location

I stayed five nights in the loft apartment and it was excellent. Upon arrival I was met by Luis who patiently introduced me to the apartment's operations and answered all my questions. I was even provided an iron and ironing board upon request.

The apartment is spotlessly clean, tastefully designed and very efficiently organized. Every appliance one needs is available, from TV, internet and washing machine, to full kitchen with dishwasher. The bathroom seems recently renovated and there is plenty of hot water via a "rain forest" shower. The bed is conformable and the windows are double glazed to block the street noise.

The apartment is centrally located with nearby public transportation, small supermarket, restaurants, and more.

Our one night stay in Portugal at this loft was wonderful.  The loft was clean, had a beautiful view of Lisbon & was convenient to walk to many places.  Pedro & the other hosts were kind, understanding & helpful.  They bought us a bottle of wine, left us chocolate & a handwritten note which was so thoughtful.  When we arrived at the loft, one of them was there to explain how everything worked in the loft & left us a list of places to eat & drink.  Mercado Da Ribeira (Time Out Market) is right down the road & is an incredible place to grab food, drinks & dessert.  I would recommend staying here because it is a perfect location to explore Lisbon.
Good description of the area and useful contacts sheets.  Right in the heart of it, fantastic location.

I stayed three weeks in the apartment and felt very much at home. Someone though of everything you might want and verything is in good taste and quality.
If you enjoy cooking, this is the place. The small kitchen has everything a good cook would want, and enough cutlery, plates and serving dishes for great meals with several friends. The sheets have the nice feel of good quality, well ironed cotton.
The street is one of the most photographed places in Lisbon and in the evening and until late at night quite a few people congregate there for drinks. They may be noisy but the windows have a good seal and cut off almost all the noise.
The cleaning is excellent.
Luís and António were very welcoming, very fast to reply to phone calls and always ready to help.
The five floors may seem daunting at first but one gets used to it.
All in all a pleasure !

Great apartment that if we had more stars to give for location then we would, having the most photographed street in Lisbon on your doorstep is unbeatable.

Amazing use of space in the apartment, would highly recommend.
Location is top for exploring the city! We enjoyed our time in lisboa. Thumps up for this Apartment! We had everything we needed!

The flat is exactly how its described. It is a small cosy place with everything you need, hair dryer, washing machine, kitchen, ... .
Additionally it is located directly in the old town so you can reach most of the sights by walking.
I can highly recommend this place and also Pedro, Antonio and his crew. Thanks a lot for this stay
Such an easy check-in. The place was so bright and lovely. Central and chic.

Absolutely loved our stay. The apartment was extremely tidy and there were lovely touches left throughout... a bottle of wine, chocolates, coffee capsules, locally grown oranges and a nice bar of soap! Highly recommended staying here!!

The place is beautiful and very modern. The apartment is located at a very nice area. You can discover the city by foot easily. I stayed with 3 friends at the apartment. It was small but if you want to discover the city and nightlife it is perfect. Everything was very clean and we were welcomed very friendly.
I would stay here again if I come to Lisbon, the location is amazing!
Thank you very much!

By far the best air b n b experience I've had, had a list of amazing restaurants in the area to eat at, and clubs to check out! Want to say thank you for being so hospitalible. Would definitely return :)!

The apartment was cozy and beautifully decorated. The bed sheets and towels were soft and comfortable. We had a great night sleep here. The loft also had many great touches that we enjoyed, like the Bose speaker, the complementary bottle of wine, and the Nepresso coffee in the morning. There are many bars, restaurants, and partying crowds right outside the door at night. Also worth mentioning the stairs a steep to the top. With lighter luggage we would definitely stay again, loved it.

We had a great time staying at Pedro's place. Him and his friends were always quick to respond if we ever had any questions, emailing us back within minutes. Check-in and check-out were easy, and Pedro's friend explained everything in the apartment as well as the surrounding neighborhood. The space is very cute and very clean. It's about 10 minutes walking from the delicious Time Out food market and other great restaurants and bakeries, 5 minutes from nightlife in the bairro alto, and another 10 minutes walking from great shopping. The #28 cable car is just at the corner, which can easily take you around the city to many other sights within minutes. We enjoyed our stay. My only concern would be for people who may be light sleepers, as it can get a little loud at night with the bars below. Luckily this was not a problem for us and we were able to sleep through it. Overall I recommend pedros's place for a great stay in Lisbon!
Exceptional experience! The flat is unique and cool, a boutique mezzanine well decorated filled with all amenities. I only wish I could have stayed longer
Amazing spot, amazing apartment and amazing host! Recommend to the air BnB community
Anfitrião muito simpático e gentil
Very nice apartment. Perfectly located in Bairro Alto.

the studio was great. good location, clean, fully equipped with everything you need for a few days. I would recommend anyone to stay in Pedro's loft. The information at our arrival was short but very clear. Luis also recommend us some nice restaurants.
We also liked the small welcome card. personally written with 2 chocolates
Thnx! :)
Pedro and his team were great. Our flights got delayed and we had someone waiting for us despite that. All the info was accurate and the place was great!

We had a fantastic time at Pedro's loft. We are a family of three and the space was perfect for us. We were late arriving and we just had to text Pedro and we were greeted at the loft in less than two minutes.  The area was great, right in the middle of the lovely Chiado area, close to many great restaurants and attractions. There were phenomenal recommendations and a tasty bottle of wine in a he fridge, chocolate on the side table with a welcome note and espresso pods for the machine.  Would highly recommend Pedro's place and would definitely come back. A fantastic host!

We had an amazing stay in Lisbon in this beautiful apartment! The location is perfect for a weekend in this city, it has a great design with a kitchen, a dishwasher and a washing machine. The bathroom is like in a hotel with towels. Communication was easy, they recommended some restaurants and even gave us a bottle of wine and fruits! Besides this the apartment was perfectly clean and the view is just amazing :)
Thank you for having us!

Newly refurbished loft apartment with every amenity needed. The place couldn't be in a better location, it's right on one of the most photographed picture postcard streets right in the centre of town. Also, within a minutes walk are one of the coolest rooftop bars in the city Park Bar. If you're staying in Lisbon you have to stay here, one the best Airbnb experiences I've had.

5 Sterne für dieses super tolle Loft. Beste Lage in Lissabon, in der schönsten Straße und super Zentral gelegen - besser geht es nicht. Alles super sauber, ordentlich und genau wie auf dem Fotos zu sehen ist. Ein Traum!!! Nur weiter zu empfehlen ohne jeglichen Kritikpunkt!!! Toller Gastgeber!!! Immer wieder gerne!! Buchen und der Traumurlaub ist perfekt.

The loft was incredible - we loved the furniture and fixtures. The location of the loft was near everything we wanted to see. The view from the loft was breathtaking. The host left plenty of suggestions of places to go/eat and things to do. It helped us see Lisbon through the eyes of a local. I would definitely stay here again!

Dieses Apartment war einfach perfekt (auch für 4 Leute, wenn es nur ein Wochenendtripp ist).
Wir wurden super freundlich empfangen. Die Wohnung liegt total zentral und in einer Straße, wie sie auf einer typischen lissabon Postkarte abgebildet ist.
Ich konnte pedro und seinem Team jederzeit fragen wenn ich Hilfe oder tipps brauchte.. Wir haben die Wohnung schon jetzt weiter empfohlen und werde definitiv wiederkommen. :)

All communication was clear, prompt and helpful, as I arrived late at night in Lisbon and Luis was there to greet me and give me the keys to the apt when I arrived. So friendly, professional and a very warm welcome with a bottle of wine upon check in. Perfect stay all around!

Great apartment very well refurbished, with washing machine and dish washer LOVED IT. Near from a metro station, Baixo Chiado ( Fado restaurants) and 30 min walk from the famous food market Mercado da Ribeira (in and out). The flat is on a 5th floor ( no elevator jeje). The comunication was excellent with Antonio and the flat us very clean. please stay there if you visit Lisbon.

We really enjoyed our trip to Lisbon! We have been there for 3 nights and loved the Chiado Loft. Even it's a small room we had everything we needed and wished for. It's the perfect location for a trip to Lisbon because it's very central and nearly everything we needed was in a walking distance. At the day of our arrival we had a delayed flight but Luis was very flexible to welcome us at the apartment and showed us the things we needed to know. He also offered to order a taxi for us at the day of our departure (Thanks!!).

Thanks to the Chiado Loft-Team, we would definitly come back!

I can't say enough positive things about our experience of staying in this apartment. Our flight was delayed by an hour so we didn't get to the flat until 10pm and our lovely host was waiting for us, he wasn't annoyed at all and he was so lovely showing us around the place whilst being totally understanding that we were quite tired from traveling. The apartment was so nicely decorated we were immediately so happy, it was immaculately clean and our host had left lovely touches such as a bottle of Portuguese wine in the fridge and some chocolates by the bed as well as some coffee capsules. The interior of the appartment was absolutely beautiful, it looks exactly as it does in the pictures, if not even nicer and comes with lovely modern touches like a Bose speaker and nespresso coffee machine. The bathroom is simply gorgeous and the shower was brilliant, really needed after a long day of travelling. There were blackout blinds for the curtains so we had a lovely sleep in the next day.

In terms of location, we couldn't have asked for better. There is a mini market on the corner for all the essentials/breakfast needs and loads of amazing restaurants such as SeaMe within very close walking distance. It's a 10 minute walk down the gorgeous tram road to the coast (which is the lovely view from the flat) and we found loads of gorgeous places along there. The owners of the apartment leave you and extraordinarily comprehensive list of places, restaurants and shops complete with a map which was so useful.

I was so impressed with this apartment and I hope this review reflects that as the owners deserve to know that it really made our holiday. I would come back and stay again in a heartbeat.

Diese fantastische kleine Wohnung befindet sich sehr zentral und ist perfekt für einen Kurz-Trip nach Lissabon! Alles war exakt wie in der Beschreibung und auf den Fotos! Die Kommunikation mit Pedro und seinem Team verlief allzeit reibungslos und alle waren sehr Bemüht uns zu jeder Zeit mit Rat und Tat zur Seite zu stehen. Bei der Ankunft am Flughafen, bekamen wir sofort Antwort und die schnellste Beschreibung, um zur Wohnung zu gelangen, wo wir mehr als freundlich empfangen wurden. Viele hilfreiche Informationen und Tipps zu Restaurants, Cafés etc. waren ebenfalls vorhanden. Vor allem die kleinen Aufmerksamkeiten, wie eine Flasche Wein, ein paar frische Orangen fürs erste Frühstück, sowie eine kleine Begrüßungskarte bleiben einem positiv in Erinnerung und sorgen dafür, dass man sich direkt wohl fühlt! Auch war es kein Problem unser Gepäck noch unterzubringen, bis wir zum Flughafen mussten. was eine große Erleichterung war, so konnten wir auch den letzten Tag noch komplett unbeschwert genießen! Ich würde jederzeit wieder eine Wohnung bei den Jungs buchen und empfehle diese wärmstens weiter!
Nice, tidy and clean apartment, in the heart of Lisbon. Strongly recommended for spending 2-3 days in the city at its best.

Chiado Loft 2 was exactly what Pedro describe. I was disappointed not to meet Pedro personally because we seem to share many interests, but team member Luis welcomed us with a quick walk through the essentials. Prior to our arrival Luis gave us detailed directions on reaching the loft via Metro from the airport, which I'm sure saved us needless wandering and uphill struggles with luggage. The list of nearby restaurants and eateries on the table was most helpful. Although we're not drinkers, the bottle of wine was a thoughtful touch. The loft is an excellent choice for a single or couple, and near to transportation (outside the door) that can get you around the city. The flights of stairs might be a challenge for some (you needed the exercise anyway) and the street noise in the early morning hours might put off some (after exploring the city all day, it won't really disturb your sleep). I heartily recommend Chiado Loft 2 as cozy and comfortable.

Die unkomplizierte, schnelle und freundliche Kommunikation und die geschmackvoll eingerichtete Wohnung hat unseren Aufenthalt in Lissabon sehr positiv beeinflusst. Die kleine, gemütliche Wohnung mit Blick auf die Dächer und den Tejo liegt in einem lebhaften Stadtviertel in der Innenstadt, ist perfekt eingerichtet (vom Fön, über eine moderne Kaffeemaschine bis zur elektrischen Orangenpresse!) und für 2 Personen ideal. Wir wurden sehr nett empfangen, erhielten eine kurze Einführung zu den Geräten und konnten uns dann mit einer kleinen Flasche Wein und 2 Pralinen gleich einstimmen. Selbst ein paar frische Orangen für den Orangensaft waren dabei! Genauso erfreulich wie schon der Start war auch der Abschied für uns: unsere Anfrage, ob wir unser Gepäck bis zur Abfahrt am Nachmittag noch unterstellen könnten, wurde sofort und freundlich positiv beantwortet.
Alles hat großartig geklappt, danke nochmals!
Katharina

Appartement moderne, idéal pour 2 personnes décoré avec beaucoup de gout dans un quartier animé de Lisbonne mais pas de nuisances dues aux bruits nocturnes. Jolie vue, très bien équipé et excellente literie. Merci à Pedro pour tous les cadeaux et ses bons plans. Excellente adresse !!!!!

Fuimos tres días en fechas de Semana Santa, el loft es precioso y muy acogedor. Tiene todas las comodidades que puedas necesitar tanto en cocina como en el resto del loft. Las vistas son preciosas, la ubicación en magnifica, a 50 metros un supermercado y a 200m un parking para dejar el coche que tan sólo cuesta 13€ el dia. El anfitrión muy amable. Valoro mi estancia de 10!!!

This apartment was clean, airy and comfortable. Small, but felt just the right size for myself and my two sons. The location is central and an ideal base for being in the city. We could hear the nightlife on the street, but it didn't keep us from getting a good night's sleep. I recommend this apartment highly.
Un appartement à recommander fortement,confort, emplacement, accueil, parfait pour séjourner et profiter du plein Lisbonne!

We received a warm welcome from Antonio who arranged an early check-in at the apartment for us due to a very early morning flight. The apartment looks just as it does in all the pictures- airy, well-furnished and comfortable. Although small, the apartment has everything you need for a city break- great shower, coffee machine and comfy bed!

The only thing I would note is that, due to being so central and close to shops/restaurants/bars, it was quite noisy over the weekend. The apartment is on the top floor (lots of stairs up!) but the noise still travels up so we were woken up quite a few times during the night by rowdy groups on the street below. Obviously this is just part and parcel of staying in such a central location so it didn't bother us too much but if you are a light sleeper then it is something to be aware of.

I would recommend the apartment to anyone seeking a city break who wants to have the best of Lisbon on their doorstep! Thanks to Antonio for the help in arranging our taxi back to the airport too.

L'appartamento corrispondeva alle nostre aspettative: accogliente, posizione perfetta, ben fornito e pulizia impeccabile. Pedro e gli altri collaboratori sono stati sempre disponibili e pronti a rispondere ad ogni nostra necessità e sono stati d'aiuto nell'indicarci i vari mezzi da prendere nei tragitti tra aeroporto e appartamento ma anche quelli da prendere nelle gite giornaliere. Sono stata davvero soddisfatta di questo soggiorno a Lisbona, consiglio a tutti questo appartamento :)

Nach unserem Portugal-Roadtrip war diese Unterkunft wirklich ein toller Abschluss! Das Apartment ist klein, aber mit 3 Personen sehr angenehem, sehr sauber und wunderschön eingerichtet. Besser kann eine Wohnung in Lissabon nicht liegen, sie ist super zentral und alles ist fußläufig erreichbar. Das Team war sehr zuvorkommend und hat uns mit einer Flasche Wein, einer Nachricht und Schokolade begrüßt und uns geholfen in Lissabon ein günstiges Parkhaus zu finden (Tipp an alle: wenn es geht nicht mit dem Auto nach Lissabon fahren, es ist die Hölle ;) ... )

Wir waren wirklich sehr zufrieden und empfehlen das Apartment auf jeden Fall weiter und würden wieder hier buchen! Alle Daumen hoch und vielen lieben Dank!

Obrigado!!! :)

We had a wonderful stay in Lisbon and the apartment was perfect! Lovely and clean with a bottle of wine, chocolates, coffee and fruit to enjoy as well and Luis was incredibly helpful and accommodating. The location is great and so easy to access different parts of the city. Will definitely be coming back and staying in the beautiful loft again! Thanks so much Pedro and Luis!

The Apartment was ver cosy, it's very very Central you can walk almost everywhere. It was easy to communicate with Antonio and he could help us with our question and our problem. I would definitley recommend it :)
Pedro and Antonio were very welcoming, provided us with lots of information and were very responsive to our requests for help.
Everything was ready and somebody was waiting for us even if we were one hour earlier.  They had prepared a portuguese white wine and coffee for our arrival! so great after a long flight!

The appartment is perfect, cosy and very well equiped. The location is also perfect in the middle of Lisbonne life (day and night). The communication with the host is really easy, and the welcome gifts are handsome !
The apartment is small but very cozy. Pedro's team is very helpfull and able to provide all the basic information regard to the city. Highly recommended! Tks, Pedro!

We had such a good time in this lovely apartment! It is so cozy and stylish and in the best possible location! Our host was great - he made us feel at home (he even left us fruit, chocolates and wine!!!)
Thanks so much - I would definitley recommend this apartment and would love to come back one day!

The apartments is lovely decorated, clean and quiet. Amazing location, lots of local restaurants and bars around, short walk to the historical part of Lisbon.
The hosts are incredibly friendly. Welcomed us with fresh fruits and a bottle of Portuguese wine. They are very flexible with check in times. Thanks guys for making the extra mile, it was a lovey experience overall!

El apartamento es maravilloso, tal y como aparece en las fotos. Cuenta con todos los utensilios necesarios para cocinar y todas las comodidades para sentirse como en casa. La ubicación es perfecta, a 200 metros tienes parada del tranvía 28 que recorre toda la ciudad y a 300 escasos metros un parking donde dejar el coche por 13 euros al día. El mirador de santa Catalina a la vuelta de la esquina y la propia calle del apartamento con su famoso tranvía lo convierten en el lugar perfecto. Volvería sin ninguna duda.

Gorgeous apartment in a perfect location. Was a bit worried about the bed, but it's super comfortable. It's a bustling area but no problems with noise. Perfect location, wonderful view. There are lots of bars nearby, a handy little supermarket, loads of amazing bakeries. It's tourist-friendly, but not touristy (although we were there in January, so that probably helped). Perfect winter escape.

Appartement tres sympa
À l égal des photos sur le site
Idéal pour 2 personnes
Plein centre du chiado à proximité des transports boutiques restaurants
Un accueil sympathique par Antonio
Merci pour ce bon séjour à lisboa
