Pedro and his team are professional and our trip in Lisboa was more than delightful to describe. First, the location of the apartment is pretty great. Two minute walk distance to the metro station and you can enjoy your view to the river from the window. Second, the loft is amazing. It is clean, well organized and well equipped, just like the picture. What's more, Pedro and his team are friendly hosts. They respond quickly and responsively. Highly recommend!
El apartamento estaba tal y como aparece en el anuncio y seguro que si volvemos a Lisboa repetiremos en este pequeño y acogedor loft del Chiado. Y es que su situación, además, es perfecta.

This was by far the best air bnb we stayed in during our European vacation.  We were welcomed by one of Pedro's colleagues.  There were fresh oranges, nespresso pods, and a nice note with two chocolates next to the bed.  We received a full run down of the apartment and a late night recommendation for dinner.   As we became more familiar with Lisbon, we realized we were staying in the perfect neighborhood.  Throughout the process, Pedro was easy to communicate with and also had ample recommendations for our stay.  We had a wonderful time in Lisbon and if (when) we come back, we will definitely book here again.

The host pedro and his associates were incredibly helpful. They were always contactable and keen to help!

The apartment was very modern, well furnished, and clean. The Beds were comfortable, the sofa was a perfect place to relax. At night we made ourselves snacks and milkshakes from the incredibly well-equipped kitchen. Needless to say, this was a good stay for myself and my two friends. We felt at home.
Ottima accoglienza, appartamento fantastico, tutto perfetto, tranne il Wi-Fi che spesso non funzionava

We enjoyed our stay very much!  Once we managed to carry our suitcases to the 5th floor, everything was there.  The apartment was clean, stylish, well equipped, had great location, nice decor, etc etc. Pedro and his team was quick to respond to our request. Would love to stay there again!
Die Kommunikation war perfekt. Die Unterkunft wie beschrieben und sehr zufriedenstellend. Ich werde sehr gerne wiederkommen.

Just came back home Friday after a fantastic stay in the Chiado Loft! My boyfriend and I visited for 4 nights, and we're slightly concerned about fitting everything in, but we needn't have worried as this apartment is right in the heart of a beautiful area of the city. We arrived Sunday lunch time to a warm we and a thorough explanation about how to use everything in there, and they even left us a bottle of wine (which never got drank, as the Portuguese Sangria is far too moreish!). The place was spotless and had every luxury necessity, from dish washer to espresso machine.
Massive thankyou to Pedro and the gang for making our Lisbon trip one to remember for all the right reasons, we will be back for sure.

Wunderschönes Loft (wie auf den Fotos) - perfekte Lage (im Viertel tolle Athmosphäre, nicht zu touristisch, alles vor der Haustür) - zuvorkommende Gastgeber (die auch bei Anreise bis 0:30 Uhr Nachts mit einer Flasche Wein und frischen Obst auf einen warten).
Mein Mann und ich haben uns sofort wohl gefühlt und haben phantastische 4 Tage verbracht. Vom Apartment aus ist Lissabon bequem zu Fuss zu erkunden (unbedingt Turnschuhe einpacken) und der schönste Miradouro inklusive Sonnenuntergang ist nur ein Katzensprung entfernt (Miradouro de Santa Catarina).

We stayed at the warm loft, located near the city center for four days and really enjoyed our stay. The team was very nice and provided very helpful service, such as recommending nearby restaurants.
We're definitely thinking about coming back! :)

We spent our honeymoon in this apartment and it was fantastic. We arrived and where very welcomed, everything in the apartment was explained to us and the team had left us little things to make our stay even better like a small bottle of local wine in the fridge, coffee soap etc. The area is great really accessible to lots of places in Lisbon and the street comes alive with cool little bars at night which are really fun. All in all we loved our stay and would happily reccormend to anyone.

Amazing. We went for 4 days and the apartment was the perfect size. The whole team was really helpful and made us feel so welcome. Thank you for a wonderful stay!
Apartment is exactly what it looks like in the pictures and the location is absolutely fantastic.

Bel emplacement au cœur d'un quartier vivant et animé de commerces et restaurants. L'appartement est propre et bien rénové, il demeure cependant petit pour 4 personnes. J'ai pris la place de ma fille de 12 ans sur la mezzanine qui avait peur du vide et je reconnais que l'air vicié s'accumule en fin de nuit dans la zone du dormeur le plus haut. Luis a été très réactif suite à un problème de robinet d'eau. À recommander

Despite having to arrive later than originally scheduled (due to a flight cancellation), Antonio of the Chiado Lofts team was there to meet me and show me the ropes of the apartment. The place was exactly as pictured, and the detailed instructions for how to operate the various appliances were helpful. The location also proved excellent: very close to great restaurants and night life, yet very quiet. It was easy to get to all the major sights of Lisbon, too. I would highly recommend this apartment to anyone visiting the city.

We spent 6 days in Lisbon staying at Pedro's loft.
It was a great experience, so close to everything we wanted to see and do in Lisbon.
The apartment was just great to stay in, very comfortable, with everything that you need.
Do not be put off by the fact that it is in the loft and there are stairs to climb, it is not a problem, even with heavy bags.
There is a view over the city and the river, the apartment is lovely and light.
Even though you are so close to all night life and restaurants, once you are there all is quiet and peacful.
We were more than happy, and were sorry to leave.
Thankyou Pedro,
Ailsa
Everything was literally perfect!! The apt is in Lisbon city center and you can reach every place by walking!! Very clean, warm and super cool!! Perfect for young people!!

Die Kommunikation im Vorfeld hat wunderbar funktioniert. Antonio hat uns sehr pünktlich erwartet und uns als Willkommensgruß sogar eine Flasche Wein geschenkt.
Die Wohnung liegt im Herzen der Stadt und die wichtigsten Sehenswürdigkeiten sind zu Fuß erreichen. Die Einrichtung ist modern, die Wohnung war sehr sauber und man fühlt sich sofort wohl darin (besonders im Hochbett ;) ).
Es war die schönste Unterkunft auf unserer Portugal-Rundreise und sie war einfach ideal, um nach einem anstrengenden Tag in Lissabon den Abend ausklingen zu lassen!
Vielen Dank Antonio und Pedro!! Es war sehr schön bei euch!

リスボンで有名なトラム28E、その中の一駅「Calhariz Bica」から徒歩30秒！
ワンルーム(ロフト付き)でしたが、とても良い内装で、ベットもロフトと下にそれぞれあり良いお部屋でした！
ただ5階(最上階)でエレベーターが無いので、荷物が多い方やお年寄りには向かないお部屋です。
果物とシャンパンが自由に頂けて、人気レストランの情報もリストアップされており良かったです！

This loft is an amazing place to stay! So close to so many bars, restaurants and sights, no need to jump in any taxis. The host is very friendly and helpful, the loft is super cozy and comfortable with everything you need :)
Would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Lisbon!

The loft was just lovely!

Great location; you could walk pretty much anywhere.

It's not very big, but has all necessities for a pleasant stay. Pedro and Antonio made us feel very welcome; they had prepared a bottle of wine in the fridge, coffee capsules for the Nespresso machine and oranges to make freshly squeezed orange juice for breakfast. They even met us earlier than first planned so we could drop off our luggage and see the nearby area while the loft was cleaned and made ready for our stay.

The kitchen is very well equipped, so you can cook for yourself if you don't feel like going out to dinner or lunch.

This was our first AirBnB experience, and we want more!

Great airbnb apartment! The place was as pictured. Decent location close to a metro stop, market, shops. There is a tram 28 stop really close by too! Can be a bit noisy during the evenings but tolerable. And you'll get a great workout walking up to the 5th floor. I would definitely recommend this place!

Gleich meine erste Airbnb-Erfahrung war ein voller Erfolg: Wunderschönes Apartment!!! Toll eingerichtet. Die kleinen Willkommensgrüße (entzückend!!!!) waren ausgesprochen herzlich und persönlich. Ich habe mich auf Anhieb wohl gefühlt.
Sehr gut ausgestattet, Bad & Küche tiptop. In der Nähe sind alles Wichtige fußläufig erreichbar: Supermarkt, U-Bahn-Station, Cafés, Bars, Restaurant, Shopping.
Bleibt also nur eins zu sagen: Fünf von fünf Punkten!!!

Pedro gave us plenty of information and was waiting for us when we arrived to show us the flat.
The location of the flat is excellent, although the climb to the fifth floor is steep.
The flat is bright and very clean and makes good use of the space available.
appart ac bcp de charme, propre, biens situé, rosé et capsules de café a larrivée excellent contact
Muito obrigado Pedro e Antonio, adoramos as dias no Chiado Loft! Thank you for the warm welcome, the little precious things and the perfect experience. This was a real Superhost Treat!
Our stay at Pedro's was wonderful and exactly as drscribed! Thank you for the nice presents you left :)

Cool place to spend a couple of nights or a full week
The attic has all the amenities one needs including a guest bed
Located just at the top of Bica elevator, the location is prime access to Bairro Alto, Cais do Sodré and Carmo
Loved the thought of having chocolate and wine waiting for us
Highly recommended

warum habe ich dieses Inserat nicht schon  viel früher entdeckt? In Zukunft werde ich eine der Unterkünfte von Pedro wählen, superschnelle Kommunikation - auch ohne internet (weil wir am Surfen waren) - so liebe kleine zusätzliche Aufmerksamkeiten und tadellos sauber - eine meiner besten airbnb Erfahrung. Tolles Team, euch weiterhin viel Erfolg!

We had a great stay at Pedros apartment. We were promptly met by his associate, Antonio who greeted us with a bottle of wine and a list of restaurants, bars and things to do which was really helpful. The apartment itself was in a great position and is virtually brand new. The only gripe was lugging suitcases up and down the steep staircases, which can be a little tricky. I'd definitely recommend this location if you a travelling light.

Malgré notre arrivée tardive, nous avons très bien été accueillis. Le loft était très propre, très bien agencé parfait pour passer quelques jours à Lisbonne! Des produits de vaisselle ainsi que lave linge à disposition. Des petites attentions comme la petite bouteille de vin et chocolats ont été très appréciés! Nous le recommanderons à nos amis/famille à coup sûr ! Merci

Great location with nice bars and restaurant closed by.
Flat is nicely decorated and clean. Host really friendly. Will come again!

We enjoyed a wonderful stay in Pedro's loft, he has been an extraordinary welcoming host and especially the small things (a bottle of wine, nespresso capsules, sweets & oranges) made us feel home immediately. Communication during our stay (we needed a drying rack for our clothes) was great and superfast and service was perfect. The loft offers everything you need including a wonderful view to river, airconditioning, ipod-dock, TV etc.
Kitchen, furniture and domestic appliances are new and in very good condition, bathroom is clean – there is simply nothing else to say than this is the place to be if you want to have a cool apartment in the heart of Lisbon.
We can highly recommend both the host and the loft and already recommended it to several of our friends.
Thanks for adding the cream to the cake of our Lisbon trip.
Another great time at one of Pedro's places.  We'll be back for sure!

Super loft! Très propre, bien aménagé, très bien situé.... Tout était au rendez-vous! Extrêmement bien situé dans la meilleure partie de Lisbonne à mon avis. Quartier très animé, avec tout à proximité. Je recommande fortement ce loft!

This flat is very nice! Not very spacious but perfect for a couple! It is very clean and cosy and you have everything you need, even a coffee machine.
Thanks Pedro!

Pedro was a great host! He was there waiting for us when we arrived to explain everything and even left fresh oranges and restaurant suggestions. The apartment was perfect and was just like the pictures!

Die Unterkunft war perfekt. Die Wohnung war sehr sauber und mit allem ausgestattet, um den Aufenthalt so angenehm wir möglich zu gestalten. Kaffee, Marmelade, Waschmittel etc. waren vorhanden und sogar eine persönliche Nachricht wurde hinterlassen.
Die Lage ist ideal, um Lissabon zu erkunden. Die Stassenbahn war direkt vor der Haustür und die Metro nur ein paar Schritte entfernt. Rund um die Wohnung konnte man auch sehr gut essen gehen.
Antonio, der uns einwies und die Schlüssel übergab, war sehr unkompliziert und freundlich.
Ich werde die Wohnung auf jeden Fall weiterempfehlen und komme auch gerne wieder :-) Danke!

We stayed in Pedro's flat for one night with my girlfriend while traveling in Lisbon. We had just stayed 3 nights in a previous apartment, but had decided to change for our last night.
Pedro was very well organized, easy to communicate with, always anticipating what we needed. We had a bit of a hard time finding the apartment in spite of that, but he was available on the phone to guide us.
The apartment in itself is exactly what I was looking. A very cute, greatly arranged, well designed love nest under the roofs, full of light, in the center of Lisbon. Its truly ideal for a couple. I wish we had found it from the first day, and if I were to return to Lisbon I would look no further. Everything was organized and ready for us, down to the little details: list of suggestions of bars and restaurants, nespresso capsules, etc. Everything was clean and tidy. We had a great stay !
Perfect location perfect place I do recommand.

Pedro was very welcoming with us. He explained us everything concerning the place and the surroundings. We had a wonderful stay in this amazing cozy apartment. Everything is here to make your stay nicer. We definitely would recommend this place to every couple planning on staying in Lisbonne.
Alles hat wunderbar geklappt & die Lage des Apartments ist top. Tolle Einrichtung mit allem, was man sich wünschen kann.
Super Appartement für 2 Personen in einer TOP-Lage in einer modernen,hellen Ausstattung.

O apartamento esta perfeito!
Para quem gosta de festejar, bica esta o lugar certo!
Ainda mais na Santo Antonio...
Foi um fim de semana muito bom.
A comunicação com Antonio e Pedro foi sem dificuldade.
Obrigado!

Die Lage ist perfekt. Mittendrin.
Alles war wie beschrieben und das Apartment ist ausreichend groß und hübsch eingerichtet.
Die Ausstattung ist sehr gut. In der Küche ist alles vorhanden was man braucht und es gab nette Begrüßungsgeschenke. (Orangen, Kaffeepads, Marmelade, Seife, Pralinen) Das hat uns gut gefallen! Die Klimaanlage funktioniert sehr gut. (Wichtig im Sommer)
Die Kommunikation mit den beiden Gastgebern war unkompliziert und beide haben immer schnell geantwortet. Wir werden wiederkommen.

Great location, the disctrict is very lively and you feel the rhythm of the city. Fantastic view from the apartment but be aware that it might be noisy at the nighttime and you can't go there by car. We struggled as we had a car and google maps didn't manage to show us the way to drive as close as possible, so we made a few circles before we reached it by feet. Overall impression is very positive.

Super nette Begrüßung und Ankommen im Loft. Location ist Mitten im alten Lissabon umgeben vom tollen Nightlife. Wir hatten zwei angenehme Tage im Loft und haben uns sauwohl dort gefühlt. Wir kommen gerne wieder.

We had a lovely stay in this fantastic little studio apartment. It's a great location, clean and modern and with everything you need for a great holiday. Pedro was a charming host, friendly and helpful.
We will certainly be returning and highly recommend it.

We had such a wonderful stay in Lisbon. The loft was just perfect for us. The location is very central, you can reach nearly everything you want by walking. Otherwise a metrostation is close and the famous Tram 28.
As we came into the loft the first time we felt like coming home. Pedro and his team created a beautiful loft with a lot of nice little things to be discovered.
This flat is totally recommendable and we would love to come back again!!!

Da dove partire... La comunicazione con Pedro via email è stata perfetta: abbiamo avuto tutte le indicazioni su quello che ci poteva fornire il suo appartamento, come raggiungerlo, quando lasciarlo. Raggiunto senza problemi all arrivo abbiamo subito trovato chi ci aspettava con chiavi pronte e indicazioni varie.
Trattasi di una deliziosa mansarda, piccola ma con spazi gestiti perfettamente e ben divisi: zona giorno, notte, cucina e bagno.
Potrete trovare ogni elettrodomestico (compreso frullatore, toast, piastra, etc...) possibile immaginabile!
Arredato con grande gusto e pezzi di design, letto molto comodo e materasso di livello, bagno con una grande doccia e tutto in marmo, pulizia impeccabile. Da considerare che è al secondo o terzo piano senza ascensore.
Sito nel centro di Lisbona, quartiere Chiado, vicino a metro e stazione treni (1km) , a pochi passi vita notturna ma senza un rumore che ci disturbasse il sonno. Voglio anche ricordare che a cinque minuti a piedi potete raggiungere il Mercado do Ribeira dove mangiare d alto livello con poco e fare acquisti acquisti alimentari. Una frutta buonissima!
Perfetto per una coppia in vacanza come noi!
Sono stati giorni incantevoli e ci ha accolto una casa che abbiamo molto amato. Consigliatissimo!

This place was just amazing. We did not want to leave. Everything worked out perfectly and we enjoyed it very much. We wished we could have taken the loft home with us. When you go to Lisbon definitely chose this place!
We had a great stay in your appartment. Location very central near the nightlife. The Appartment has a modern style and is well equipped!
Appartement splendide ! Très propre et cuisine bien équipée .. Emplacment parfait! À recommander.

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour dans ce loft qui est idéalement situé en  plein centre dans une petite rue pleine de charme. La décoration est tout à fait conforme aux photos, et la très jolie vue sur le Tage et les toits est très agréable. Il y a tout le nécessaire pour cuisiner un petit peu et prendre son petit-déjeuner, et même des capsules pour la machine à café, merci! Le lit est vraiment confortable et il y a de grands placards pour le rangement. On n'entend pas du tout le bruit de la rue, c'est parfait! L'accueil d'Antonio était très sympathique et il a répondu à toutes nos questions. Ce loft est idéal pour passer quelques jours à Lisbonne dans un cadre charmant. Je le recommande vivement!

The appartment is amazing! Very well located, bright, well furnished. This is almost better than what you can expect by the pictures. This is also one of the cleanest appartment we rent during our vacations.

The host waited for us in the appartment and gave us a list of restaurants suggestion. There were a few little attentions left for us: a private welcoming message, little chocolate, small goat milk soap. These were greatly appreciated and helped us fell like home.

The neighborhood is also great! The appartment is located just on top of the famous 'Rua da Bica de Duarte Belo' funicular. You take the funicular and it will litteraly left you at your door! Everything is at walking distance from the appartment.

Highly recommanded and will certainly try to stay there again if we have the chance to return to Lisbon.

The apartment was wonderful just like the photos. They let us leave our baggage before check in which was wonderful for us! They showed us around the whole apartment and showed us how everything worked. At night we finally realized they left us a handwritten note with chocolates which was a nice personal touch.

The apartment is exactly as shown in the photos. The place is extremely clean and nicely decorated.

Antonio welcomed me to Chiado Loft 2. He turned up to the apartment shortly after I checked in to help with an internet problem (it resolved itself and worked great for the rest of my week-long stay). He also ordered me a cab for my early morning ride to the airport. A very helpful, responsive host!

I loved everything about the loft. It was comfortable and located in the perfect spot (there's even a grocery store downstairs!).

You'll be happy here.
Alles bestens. Sehr zu empfehlen!
We had an absolutely fantastic time at the apartment! It was very clean, cosy and full of little surprises. Pedro took care on any requests or questions. We would always come back.

Nous avons passé 6 jours chez Pedro et nous avons été ravis de l'accueil de notre hôte et des prestations de l'appartement. Le logement est très agréable et très calme dans un quartier animé de Lisbonne. Une bonne adresse.

Great location to discover Lisboa!!! The apartment is totally new, modern and clean, as you can see in the pictures. Antonio was very nice and helpfull and the recommendations he and Pedro gave us were really cool! I totally recomend this Chiado Loft to spend some days in Lisbon.

Amazing space that was perfect for the two of us and our three days in the city. Perfect location and its great to see what they have done with the space! Wouldn't hesitate to recommend to anyone heading to Lisbon!

Great loft in the best position !!!!!
Not too big but very very nice with all u need in an accomodation ... Confortable bed, small kitchen stylish bathroom but above all the location ... Perfect spot for the nightlife and homebase for day trip ... I'll reccomend to all My friends that want ti visit Lisbon ... Last but not least don't drink too Much before going home cause could be very difficult to climb the stairs

We had a great time in Predro's flat - it is in a great location, very nicely furbished and in walking distance to everything you could wish for: the 28 tram, the best Natas in Lisbon, the shopping street, the river and even a supermarket. I would totally stay here again. Thanks, Pedro!

I was met by Antonio at the flat.  He was very accommodating and answered all my questions.  Flat is great and as described.  Location was perfect for a city trip.  Loved our trip and would definitely recommend/ stay again!! I would note that the flat is pretty central and in an old building… this does mean that the noise insulation can be an issue if you are planning a trip of sleeping in! A

We stayed two nights in the appartment. It is very well located in Lisboa with a lot of nice restaurants around! From there you can do (almost) everything by foot! Probably the best place for a trip in Lisboa!

Bereits die Buchung der Unterkunft lief völlig unkompliziert und schnell. In Lissabon angekommen, haben wir uns dank der extrem netten Gastgeber sofort sehr wohl gefühlt!
Die Wohnung ist liebevoll mit Liebe zum Detail eingerichtet und top ausgestattet. Die Lage des Appartements ist genial!
Falls wir jemals wieder nach Lissabon kommen, werden wir garantiert wieder ins Chiado Poft zurückkehren!

Ha sido una estancia genial aún antes de llegar con todos los mails que nos hemos enviado Pedro y yo, gracias por tu amabilidad, siento no haberte llegado a conocer. El apartamento es precioso,muy pequeño, un pelín agobiante para muchos días, pero precioso y decorado con un gusto exquisito ( me encanta la decoración y no le faltaban detalles ). El barrio, céntrico, romántico y con el ascensor de Bica en los pies, un amor de ubicación.Todo queda a un paso, los bares de copas, los restaurantes, el 28 mágico que para en la puerta. Un pequeño supermercado abierto en festivo al lado para abastecerte de lo básico.
Gracias por los bombones de bienvenida, buenísimos ¡¡¡.
Por poner una pega, no tiene ascensor y los escalones en algunos tramos son tremendamente empinados.Si teneis algún problema de movilidad no es vuestro apartamento, o si vais con maletas o niños pequeños. Desde luego que volveremos a Lisboa, y nos hospedaremos en cualquiera de los apartamentos de Pedro.Moito obrigada.

Its the best place ever!!
Location And flat is wonderfull.
Thanks Pedro

Abbiamo avuto un bellissimo soggiorno nell’appartamento di Pedro. La descrizione e le foto rappresentano davvero la realtà, anzi, se possibile, la realtà è migliore!
Posizione perfetta per visitare Lisbona sia a piedi oppure usando i mezzi pubblici, che sono molto vicini. Il quartiere è pieno di posti carini in cui mangiare o prendere cibo da cucinare.
Pedro e Antonio sono stati molto gentili e rispettosi della nostra privacy. In definitiva lo raccomandiamo assolutamente!

We spent a really nice stay at pedro's place! The flat was great exaclty as in the pictures. After one day we were asked To move in another flat because of a leak problem. But Antonio was really nice and the new flat was even better ! And in the same location. Pedro is a great host, full of attention.
The flats were perfectly located in the centre of lisbon. Overall we definetly recommand it.'

Nous avons passé 4 jours chez Pedro fin janvier. Il ne faisait pas froid dans l'apart, ça sentait bon, le quartier est sur. Une superette est située juste au coin de la rue, c'est la seule que nous avons vue d'ailleurs. Nous vous le conseillons sans hésiter mais veiller à vous munir de boules quies pour dormir car beaucoup de bruit dans la rue et de l'autre côté du  mur aussi.

Really enjoyed our stay in Lisbon and a lot of that was down to the apartment. The use of space in the loft is amazing and it has a perfect amount of light coming in, making it a lovely spot to just chill when you need a wind down. Special note to an amazing shower!

The apartment of Pedro and Antonio was such a perfect place for me. Everything was very clean and cosy and I felt very much at home. The area is quite busy but I liked that a lot. I can definitively recommend to stay there and would love to come back some day.

Our stay at the Chiado loft was just amazing and the perfect accomodation for a Lisbon trip. Everything was clean, beautifully arranged and decorated. Our hosts were so friendly and made us feel like home. We definitely come back and would recommend to stay there at Baixa/Chiado. Obrigada! Thank you so much!!!

We had a great stay in chiado. The flat is small but brilliantly put together, comfy bed and a great location. Antonio was very nice and easy to get hold of when we had questions. A wonderful place to stay - would definitely recommend!
Nous avons été extremement bien reçues et tout etait prevu pour faciliter le séjour

The appartment is confy and beautyful, it's really close to the city center and 5 minutes from central station.
Antonio and pedro have been there when needed, and the nespresso Coffee maker does the difference, what else?

L'appartement correspond exactement aux photos, juste sublime et parfaitement situé dans Lisbonne ! Très bon accueil ! J'avais des difficultés pour réserver un taxi pour le retour vers l'aéroport et Pedro s'en est chargé. Bref, super séjour, je recommande vivement !

Awesome loft and Pedro is really nice !

Le joli logement et son environnement sont parfaitement conformes aux descriptifs. Situation idéale pour découvrir agréablement cette ville attachante.
Accueil parfait et attentif de nos hôtes. Merci Pedro.
Nous reviendrons.
Great location. The place looks even more amazing in person than the pictures. Comes with full kitchen appliances and a lot of personal touches. The little gestures were sweet. Great host!

Malgrès notre retard, Antonio nous a attendons sans problème, merci à lui ! L'appartement est très joli, similaire à la photo. Les petites attentions sont appréciables ( oranges à jus, confiture etc...)
L'emplacement est idéal, en plein centre.
Je recommande vivement !
We had a perfect stay at Pedros flat. We used to stay for 3 nights, room is exactly as shown on the pics. Antonio and Pedro were very kind and helped in every situation.

Pedro was a great host. His colleague met us perfectly on time at the place and was very helpful in giving suggestions for things to do and places to eat. The space is clean and very comfortable, and was good value for the price. My only issue was that the street was noisy all 3 nights that we stayed there. I think ear plugs would block it out, but my fiancé and I did not bring them and could have used them.
Superbe petit appartement, idéalement situé dans le coeur de Lisbonne.  Accueil et organisation parfaits. Nous le recommandons vivement.
Nice and cozy apartment with  good location! We can find everything we need. The host is very nice and reply message very fast. Really good experience for stay.

This place is amazing. Well located, gorgeous design, excellent size kitchen with everything you need for cooking, lots of things supplied, wifi great, useful tips for exploring Lisbon provided by hosts. I can't imagine a better place to stay in Lisbon.

Séjour parfait. Situation géographique idéale. Pedro et Antonio sont des hôtes attentionnés, qui répondent dans l'heure à toutes les demandes formulées. Nous avons trouvé notre pied à terre à Lisbonne! Merci encore à vous deux.

This was a great little studio, very central to the main sites. Nice and quiet. Shopping mall next door. The welcome notes and treats made you feel right at home. We really enjoyed our stay. Thanks again!

Traumkurzurlaub in Traumloft!
Buchung der Unterkunft lief völlig unkompliziert und schnell. Pedro hat uns mit allen nötigen Informationen für die Anreise versorgt und war selbst zur Wohnungsübergabe da.
Die Wohnung entsprach voll und ganz den Erwartungen, die man durch die Bilder vorab hatte. Diese wurden sogar noch übertroffen, da die Gastgeber mit kleinen Details von der ersten Sekunde an für ein absolutes Wohlbefinden bei Ihren Gästen sorgen.
Das Loft ist sehr geschmackvoll eingerichtet und bietet alle vorstellbaren Annehmlichkeiten.
Die Lage der Wohnung ist super. Man ist fußläufig in kurzer Zeit im Ausgehviertel, der Kernstadt, dem Bahnhof und hat quasi vor der Tür eine der Sehenswürdigkeiten der Stadt zur Verfügung (Tram-Bahn), falls man in entlegenere Stadtteile aufbrechen will.
Alles in allem absolut weiterempfehlenswert. Wir werden garantiert wiederkommen!!!

J'ai réservé le studio pour mes parents, pour leur faire une surprise, et leurs mots en rentrant de leur séjour : tout parfait!!! Appartement très beau, propre, design, très bien situé avec le célèbre tramway 28 en bas de l immeuble! Antonio les a très bien accueilli, avec des conseils touristiques. Pedro a très bien géré toute la partie réservation, toujours à notre disposition pour répondre à nos interrogations.J'ai déjà conseillé à d'autres personnes cet appartement. Si vous devez venir à Lisbonne c'est OBLIGATOIREMENT dans cet appartement. Super rapport qualité/prix! Merci!
Très bel appartement, accueil sympathique. Les photos sont toute à fait représentatives. L'appartement est très bien placé, et aussi bien isolé du bruit de cette rue animé.
Great apartment in a very central location of Lisbon! The apartment offers all the comfort and has a great view :) I would highly recommend this place! Only not suitable for non-stairs lovers:)

The loft was fantastic. It was clean and had wonderful small details. They made the optimum out of this small apartment. Inside one of the oldest streets in Lisbon, the neighborhood was perfect for us.
Wonderful for 2 or 3 people.

Nice area, central location! If the taxi driver says he can't access because of the "big tram"' don't be afraid, the funicular is quite silent and it out of service after 10p.m.
Pedro provided us with detailed description on whereabouts and how to get from the airport.
Everything is clean and tidy, highly recommended.

Had a really nice stay. The apartment was as described, in a very central location, with good views. Antonio checked us in and was very helpful and answered all of our questions. Pedro also arranged a earlier check in for us. The stairs up to the apartment are very steep in places but it's worth it for the view.

All I can say is: PERFECT! The loft was so nice! We had a few difficulties to find the house but if you check out a map before it would be no problem. Everything was so nice. The loft is located so nicely. We would totally stay again in this Loft. Thank you for having us, Pedro!

Very nice apartment in the coolest area of Lisbon Barrio Alto with many nice Bars and restaurants nearby. Supermarket just around the corner, walking distance to the city center.
The apartment itself is nicely arranged with a modern touch and all you need for a longer weekend.
Pedro and his team are super friendly and will help you with advice if needed.
All in all a perfect stay in Lisbon! Thanks again...
Very cosy flat. Excellent location. The team was very friendly. Beautiful decoration, very clean and modern. All you need for having a good time in Lisbon. I recommend it!
Pedro's apartment was absolutely beautiful and in the perfect location. I can't imagine a better place to stay in Lisbon. Highly, highly recommended!!
The apartment is located on the 5th floor of an old building but it's brand new inside. Cool, cozy, small place, just a few steps away from the crowdy nights of Bairro Alto. Definitely recommended!

Very nice and tastefully furnished apartment. Located in one of he most beautiful streets of Lissabon, very central – close to many of the sights and close to the Barrio Alto night life. Definitely an excellent place to stay.

Really nice apartment in a great location in Lisbon. All the decorations and furniture are a really good standard and the view is really good. Antonio left us a list of things to see and places to eat, which was really handy, plus there was welcome chocolate!
The appartment was very nice and Pedro was a very friendly and good host. I can absolutely recommend this place if you want to visit Lisbon.
Sehr schöne, zentrale, top eingerichtete Wohnung! Der Empfang war herzlich obwohl wir in der Nacht angekommen sind. Wir würden sofort wieder bei Pedro wohnen!
One of the best locations in Lisbon, we loved the flat and the neighbourhood. the flat is very well equiped and we liked the interior design as well.

This apartment is in a great location in the centre of Lisbon. The apartment itself is excellent, very modern and spacious. The only downside is that it is a loft on the fifth floor, and since there is no elevator, it makes carrying luggage up and down very difficult on the steep stairs. The wifi is also a bit inconsistent and drops out. Once you reset the modem though it works again so it wasn't really a problem.
Other than that we had a fantastic stay and would definitely stay again.
Das Apartment war sehr schön, wir hatten eine schöne Zeit. Das Loft liegt mitten Chiado und ist perfekt ausgestattet. Danke an Antonio und Pedro, ihr seid echte Pros.!!!!

The apartment is exactly what the photos show. It is extremely well equipped with everything you might need. The location is great, right next to the metro and sights of Lisbon. The region is full of restaurants and bars, which helps a lot. We recommend the apartment to anyone who wants a nice and clean place. For older people, it is a bit difficult because the apartment is on the fifth floor and possess many stairs. But Pedro has other wonderful apartments with access via elevators.

What an exceptional apartment in an awesome area of Lisbon!! The communication was great, the space was sparkling clean when we arrived & the location was convenient to everything that we wanted to do. The Metro was very close as well. We loved Lisbon & won't stay anywhere else the next time we're back!!

What a wonderful time we spent in Lisbon! The loft is great: confortable, clean, perfect location and very pretty (just like in the pictures). António was very nice and explained everything we needed to know. They left us a cute welcoming note with chocolates, oranges and coffee (very nice!).
There is a small market right in the corner and the apt is a few steps far from Largo do Chiado and a subway station.
We would definitely come back and recommend it to other people.
Thanks Pedro and António for the great stay!

We enjoyed our stay in Loft 2 very much, thank you, Antonio & Pedro & the team! Everything looks exactly as on the pictures, everything provided works perfectly, and all communication with the hosts was efficient and friendly.
The Loft worked great for 3 individuals. Climbing up to the mezzanine is not everybody´s cup of tea. In weekends there are a lot of people partying in the street, but it didn´t disturb too much - and the best solution is to join the fun!
We would definitely come back!

Bon accueil, appartement impeccable avec vue sympa, très fonctionnel et situé dans un quartier très animé.
Bien situé pour accéder au tramway et métro, à proximité de nombreux bars et restaurants.
Une adresse à recommander. Nous y retournerons certainement.

Superbe appartement, avec une situation PAR FAITE ! L'appartement est propre et très agréable, avec même des petites attentions pour les hôtes :)
Pedro a été très disponible et réactif avant notre arrivée (tard le soir)
Si vous avez besoin de calme, la rue est bruyante le soir : la rançon d'une localisation au top.
Nous y retournerions sans hésiter !
Eine sehr schöne Unterkunft, die allen Erwartungen entsprach. Ich kann dieses Appartement nur empfehlen. Und auch die Konversation mit Pedro hat immer gut funktioniert. TOP!!!

Pedro & Antonio have been really nice to us. They answered our texts really quickly ! Gave us precious informations about places, sightseeings and everything in Lisbon.

The apartment is exactly like on the pictures, comfortable, cosy, peaceful, decorated with taste, functionnal and absolutely clean. It's located in a very lively and typical street, but very quite inside. THE street where you can find the famous 'Elevador da Bica', postcard.

We were quite charmed with our stay.

Studio sous les toits refait à neuf, design et bon goût : très agréable. Si vous souhaitez "être chez l'habitant" ce n'est cependant pas du tout le profil de cet appartement de location.

Très bonne situation, proche des transports. La rue est animée mais le double vitrage tout neuf préserve la tranquillité.

Les hôtes ont été très disponibles et compréhensifs malgré l'annulation de notre avion et notre arrivée un jour en retard et notre mécompression sur l'heure obligatoire du check out.

Great convenient location. Pedro was very easy to communicate with and reachable in case of any issues. The apartment was beautiful and had all the essentials. Highly recommended for a stay in Lisbon.

The appartment was nice and tidy, with everything needed inside and in the town center. next to the tram.
Antonio was there when we arrived and explained everything to us.
No complain at all.
Thanks guy.

Pedro's loft was awesome. Felt spacious, had everything we needed, and was in the best location near to the center of everything and about a 5 minute walk to the metro and 10-15 minutes to walk to transportation to Belem,  Sintra,  and Cascais.

Excellent experience from day 1. Owner support perfect to plan in advance.
Center location to discover Lisbon by foot, quality equipment, clean and full of gadgets to make your stay a perfect experience (Ipod dock for Music, Nespresso coffee machine, dishwasher, etc..).

Wir haben hier im Zentrum Lissabons wunderbare Tage verbracht. Die Wohnung liegt total zentral, man kommt überall zu Fuß hin, ist die Straßenbahn hält direkt vor der Tür und die Metro ist auch nur 5 Minuten zu Fuß.
Die Wohnung hat alles was man sich wünschen kann, die Küche ist sehr gut ausgerüstet. Das Bett ist sehr bequem und alles ist sauber und stilvoll eingerichtet.
Wir würden definitiv wieder bei Pedro wohnen!

Super appart, bien décoré et très propre, juste au sommet du célèbre funiculaire, tout est conforme à l'annonce, très bon accueil, rien à redire si ce n'est l'absence d'une passoire et de tasses à café, rien de majeur en somme. Au passage, les amateurs de Nespresso peuvent apporter des capsules, une machine les attend.

Petite supérette à deux pas, très pratique.

Je recommande ++

Wir hatten eine tolle Zeit in Lissabon. Obwohl wir früher als geplant ankamen, wurde bereits auf uns gewartet. Das Loft liegt sehr zentral und ist perfekt ausgestattet. In der Küche findet man wirklich alles, was man in irgendeiner Weise benötigen könnte. Alle Sehenswürdigkeiten sind fußläufig zu erreichen. Die Wohnung ist absolut weiterzuempfehlen!!! Danke Pedro für die tolle Zeit!

Nous avons passé trois nuits chez notre hôte et le service a été plus que parfait. Au dessus d'un hôtel ! Un accueil chaleureux et des attentions toutes particulières (des oranges pour le petit déj, des chocolats pour nous re-booster après le voyage, ...).
Pedro est toujours joignable (téléphone portable et mail) et nous a même aidé pour le trajet Aéroport - Appartement.
Pour ce qui est du loft justement, rien à redire : état impeccable, machine à café avec les dosettes de G. Clooney, salle de bain en marbre, parquet chaleureux, décoration contemporaine de très bon goût et vue magnifique.
Je reviendrai avec grand plaisir !
Amazing place very well located and clean

The appartment is really nice, very well renovated and decorated. Lisboa is an amazing city and we will come back for sure to one of Pedro's place (we saw that the appartment in front of ours has a solarium!) i recommend this place and it is very well located

estancia perfecta en el loft de Pedro. Perfecta ubicación y el apartamento es muy acogedor, nos sentimos como en casa. nos facilitaron mucha información y la verdad que no tuvimos la más mínima pega. Limpio, acogedor, calentito y  2 min de todo...que más podiamos pedir?!muy agradecidas con la nota de recibimiento, las naranjas para el desayuno y la mermelada. Gran anfitrión! si volvemos a Lisboa esperamos poder alojarnos ahí otra vez.
wonderful apartment. highly recommend it!
Beautiful apartment, great location, would definitely stay there again!

Séjour mémorable à Lisbonne, dans un appartement chaleureux, très agréable et bien situé. Tout à fait conforme à sa description sur le site airbn'b. Hôte disponible, aimable et attentionné. Une adresse à recommander +++
Et d'autres appartements à découvrir peut être lors d'un prochain séjour... car Pedro a plusieurs "loft" à louer sur Lisbonne... Le choix est difficile. Nous avions opté pour cet appartement pour son côté intime et "cocooning" avec une seule pièce de vie. Très agréable en effet pour un court séjour en amoureux.

We had a wonderful time in Lissabon in his tasteful studio. It's super central and a very good point to start to explore the city! Pedro was a great host. He even answered the phone when we called him at 5 am, because we had to leave to the airport and the door downstairs at the house won't open. We managed to get out and I'm very thankful for your remote help, Pedro! All in all a perfect place to stay for a Lisbon trip :-)

The location of the apartment could not be better and had everything we needed for our 4-day stay. It was immaculate and had a great view of charming Lisbon buildings and the sea. Pedro and his team were very reliable and quick to get back to us to answer our queries and were very friendly throughout. Everything was perfect - thank you :)
We had a very nice stay in Pedros apartment. Location is great and apartment is modern and cozy.

We had a perfect stay at Chiado Loft 2! The location was simply perfect, everything is within walking distance. We loved the appartements' design, very stylish, tasteful and of high quality. Thank you Pedro!

Hai Pedro
Our jaws literally dropped after entering your appartment for the first time. The appartement is very nicely designed and decorated and has all the functions you could ever desire on a citytrip: clean and well equiped kitchen, nice and cosy sitting area and tv, spacious and modern bathroom and above all the most amazing view over Lisboa from the window of your top floor appartement. No better way to start the day than waking up and taking a peak out of the window.
Apart from all this the appartement is also very good located. It is close to both the city center and the metro stop. Also the famous Bairro Alto disctrict laying on the other side of the street is a big surplus. We really enjoyed the fact of exiting our front door and bumping into tourists taking pictures of the famous tram of Lisbon who passes through the street (And we also would like to excuse ourselves for ruining a couple of photos by exiting our door)
Long story short: This appartement is the prefect starting point for a citytrip to the beautiful city of Lisboa. We highly recommend this one and definitely come back whenever we're back in Lisboa
Placé idéalement. hôte attentionné et disponible. deco de très bon gout. rien a dire parfait.
This loft is just amazing! thank you pedro, we had a great time! sincerely Laura and Joel

The apartment was amazing. I was travelling by myself for only a few days in Lisbon and found this place to be a really good base to work from.
Centrally located with public transport, shopping, dining and all major tourist sites within walking distance, this apartment cannot be beaten.
Communications with the host were very clear and check in and check out was easy.
I'll stay here again when I'm back next and I'll also be recommending it to all of my friends visiting the area.

Local agradável, silencioso,bom para descansar e também para agitar, já que fica bem próximo dos restaurantes e bares do Bairro Alto. Dá pra ir a pé, tranquilamente, apesar das subidas, nada impossível. Cais do Sodré tb é próximo, mas com uma caminhada um pouco maior. O apto é de bom tamanho para um casal, bem equipado (só sentimos falta de uma chaleira elétrica, jarra elétrica), limpo e muito bem localizado. Fácil de se deslocar para os pontos que se queira. Tem mercadinhos próximos, o q facilita se quiser providenciar alimentação em casa. Mas tem ótimos locais por perto para almoçar, jantar e até para o pequeno almoço. O único "problema" são as escadas de acesso, cerca de 45 a 50 degraus (contei, de tantas vezes q subi!), pois ele fica no 5o andar. Mas a vista da cidade e do Tejo compensa! E é só não levar tantas malas e tão pesadas (era meu caso!). Muito bom. Certamente voltaremos e indicamos!

We stayed at Chiado Loft 2 during New Year - and were very pleased with both the location, apartment facilities and the friendly, professionel service from both Pedro and Antonio.
The apartment is not very spacious because of the roof walls - but OK for two and your have a lot of light coming from the windows, not to mention the nice view of the river and the bridge.
There's surprisingly little noise from street, tram or neighbours, even though nightlife is active in the Bica street as well.

Amazing experience. Pedro was in contact immediately via phone or email, whichever you prefer. After a long day traveling it was nice to be greater graciously, given a tour, and seen all the little extras added to the room. Rooms are modern, clean, and have all the amenities you need to have a stress free trip in Lisbon. The rooms are also in the most convenient location, close to everything you need!

Appartement trés agréable,confortable et bien décoré.
Très bien situé pour visiter les différents quartiers de la ville.
Très bon séjour.

This is the best location ever.
Flat is modern, great design and clean.
Great value in this wonderful city

Only one word: perfect!
Thank you Pedro
Amazing apartment, perfect location.

We spent wonderful days in the apartment. The most beautiful for us was to live in this cute street with the old tram.
Also the view in Lisbon from the rooftop is amazing!

The appartment was very nice, cosy and well situated. We enjoyed discorvering Lisboa and come back for recovering a little.
Antonio welcome us very nicely...
Thanks again, it was a lovely trip

Amazing Loft in the heart of Chiado!  We would definately stay at Pedro's loft if in Lisbon again.  Antonio met us upon our late arrival and provided an overview of the apartment and neighborhood.  Rua de Bica is a great street for late night cocktails with the locals.  The loft is located easy walking distance to the tram and Metro.  It's also quite easy to explore the historic districts from Bario Alto to Almalfa on foot, no problem.  Wonderful eateries and cafe's are right out the front door, thanks Pedro and Antonio!

Everything was perfect, the place look exactly the same as the pictures. Very good location near the best nightlife place of Lisbon

Fresh orange for juice, nespresso coffe, some advice and tips on what to do, see and visit around the flat.

Thanks again to Pedro
Wonderful place in a cool location. The host was extremely the host was extremely careful with all details, since tour tips until apartment manual. I'm sure that I'll back there.

Awesome and very clean apartment, excellent location... There were some very nice touches in the loft: fresh oranges (and a juicer), coffee and chocolates! Everything was perfect! Thanks Antonio & Pedro!

Thanks alot for everything, the apparment is perfect even better than the pictures, perfectly clean, in a very good location, easy to find, with all commodities, I will for sûre comme back, as soon as I can, Lisboa was the best place for my first trip alone with my two teens girls! Great place, thanks again !

A beautiful place to stay with very nice details in furniture. It looks exactly like the pics in the internet. We spent wonderful days in Lisboa. A nice welcome with fresh oranges, nespresso capsules and some marmelade. Friendly hosts. We would stay at the place when returning to Lisboa.

I cannot fault this place, everything was great. Excellent location, very clean and finished to a high quality. The oranges and coffee were a nice touch. We would love to stay again when next in Lisbon and would recommend to others.

De Chiado Loft is een klein appartement dat heel mooi ingericht is.
Het uitzicht vanop de vijfde verdieping beperkt zich tot de daken van de omringende gebouwen.
Een nadeel vonden wij de houten trap naar de vijfde verdieping (geen lift) en ook het daaraan verbonden risico bij een eventuele brand.

The appartment is awesome!!!
Appartment is designed with the great taste, has everything for happy staying and feeling youself like at home.

Close to the touristic areas, close to train stations - to go to Porto, Cascais and Sintra, with the supermarket behind the corner and a great places to eat and party.

Hope to come back to this place one day!
Thank you very much

El loft de Pedro es exquisito y un lugar privilegiado para conocer Lisboa, tanto si vas por pocos días como si vas por varios. Nos esperaron con fruta  y mermelada y Antonio, que fue quien nos recibió fue muy amable con nosotros. Ojalá pueda ser mi hospedaje cuando vuelva a Lisboa. Muchas gracias por todo.

Great apartment!! First, the location could not be beat. I mean, you are literally in the middle of everything you will want to see/do in downtown Lisbon. Secondly, the apartment looks exactly like it does in the pictures: clean, modern, well-appointed...it really was fantastic. Highly recommend staying here!!

L'appartamento è incantevole, molto luminoso e dotato di ogni confort. Si trova in una posizione comoda per visitare la città. Inoltre Pedro è molto disponibile per ogni cosa. è stato un bellissimo soggiorno.
amazing place. Very good location. The host was just great. Will definitely use again if I come back. Thank you again ! HIGHLY HIGHLY Recommend this place. It is beautiful.
Fantastic location, spotlessly clean, extremely well equipped. Felt like a luxury apartment!
loved the apartment. fantastically designed and situated. antonio was prompt and helpful.

beautiful, cosy, nice and stylish flat in the great barrio alto area - and with a great view to the river. next to a great interior design style and very good hygienic standard, it is the details like fresh oranges and a little compliment card that really make a difference. it really feels like a boutique hotel / design home base during holiday. we had a very welcoming host who cared about everything we needed.
thanks for a great time and be sure …. we will be back!

We loved this place located in such a central, safe and easy to find spot. It's on the last floor so you have a nice view, but there's AC so don't worry about the place getting to warm in the summer. The loft is decorated with taste, is perfectly clean (crisp white linens!) and has everything you'll need. Antonio (Pedro's colleague) was very professional and we felt like if anything would happen he would be there to help. We really, really loved Lisbon as a city, and this loft made it even more pleasant. If you go to Lisbon, we highly recommend you to book this place!

Das Apartment von Petro ist genial!
Tolle Lage, sehr hübsch eingerichtet und das check in und check out hat auch super funktioniert!
Würde es jeder zeit wieder buchen :)
We spent a great time in Chiado loft ! The situation is just perfect to visit the city and everything is made to make you fell like home ! We would definitly come back as soon as we can !
The hosts, apartment and location were fantastic!  You couldn't ask for a better experience.

If you want to go to Lisbon, Chiado Loft 2 is an ideal place to visit and live the town! Pedro is a very nice guy, always helpful and contactable for any question or suggestion! He made us feel at home!

We suggest the experience

Andrea&Ludovica
Fantastic apartment,very well situated. A note for people who may find climbing steps tricky......the steps are steep and there is no elevator.
Great Place in the Heart of Lisbon. We had a wonderful time! Thanks Pedro!

Great clean, pretty and well equipped loft, well located. Pedro was very nice and helpful. Plenty guides and info were given to us upon arrival. We would definitely recommend this place. tram 28 right there!

Lovely apartment in the perfect place. This is so handy for seeing the city it's incredible. You're right beside Bairro Alto bars but its quiet. The Cais de Sodre station and travel hub is just down the road and Rossio station is close too. Apartment is really nice and manages to stay cool in the heat! Pedro was very helpful throughout and when I return to Lisbon, I'll be in touch.

Nice apartment in great location! I loved the style of apartment, it is really modern with a lot of cool things. Big windows which make apartment very cosy and full of light.
In terms of cleanliness / condition, I would say the apartment was excellent. It had obviously been cleaned fully before our arrival. All the amenities and appliances worked well. The TV, music system and WiFi were great.
Communication with the owner was perfect, quick replies from his part.
Overall a good experience and would recommend the apartment to others.
We had a really great time, the apartment is very nice  and in a perfect location. Thank you very much

Moderne loft dans un endroit stratégiquement bien situé. Lisbonne est agréable à découvrir à pied et la plupart des zones sont accessibles de l'appartement (comptez au moins 1h15 pour Bélem). La rue (non accessible aux automobiles) est sympathique avec son funiculaire et ses petits bars. Salvador nous a accueilli en nous expliquant tous les petits détails utiles concernant le loft. Nous avons été heureux d'utiliser le presseur à jus le matin avec les oranges gracieusement offertes. Les photos sont très réalistes et la déco très cozy. Guy-Antoine et Joanie, Québec, Mai 2013

We really enjoyed our stay at the Chiado loft. Wonderful location, stylish, clean apartment. Pedro was an excellent host: on time to meet us, very helpful with orienting us about apartment and the neighborhood. Will totally stay here again!
It was a very pleasant stay and Pedro was very nice and well organized. There is nothing I can complain again. I would come again in a heartbeat. Thanks for it all.
We haven't met Pedro, but his friend Salvador. Everything was perfect : the organisation, the flat, the location of the flat... I really recommand it!
The loft in Chiado is perfect and Pedro was a great host! The better place in Lisbon !
Amazing location, perfect host. Great weekend.
We can recommend everybody to stay at the Chiado Loft: It's a great apartment with amazing views, everything was perfectly organized and the communication with Pedro and Salvador was really smooth.
Very nice and clean apartment in a very nice neighborhood! We had a great time in Lisbon and in the apartment.

The apartment was stylish and clean and very centrally located, a walking distance to all the major spots and venues of central Lisbon. Rua da Bica Duarte Belo is a beautiful street, which transforms into a cosy bar street in the evenings. As the apartment is above the roof and has double layer windows, the sounds from the bars do not bother. Pedro and the team were excellent and welcoming hosts and were available always when needed. Thank you for the enjoyable time in Lisbon!

I enjoyed my first stay here so much that I am heading back for 2 weeks! This apartment is brilliantly positioned and immaculately presented and Pedro is an amazing but never intrusive host.
The apartment is perfect for that for that get away and will just as easily suit the business traveler. Its modern and yet retains some of its very beautiful original features.

En Pedro és molt amable i atent. Ens va dir que ens podia venir a recollir a l’aeroport quan arribessim i així va ser. De seguida que vam aterrar ja ens esperava en el seu cotxe amb el nostre nom. La comunicació amb ell ha sigut molt fluida i ens ha respòs sempre de seguida. L’apartament està molt ben ubicat al barri d’Alfama i a peu pots arribar als llocs més turístics. Per arribar a l’apartament, passes pels carrers l’Alfama i és molt autèntic. L’apartament és tal qual com a les fotos i està molt net. Vam tenir un problema amb la clau de l’apartament i en Pedro ens va contestar de seguida i ens ho va solucionar ben ràpid, cosa que agraïm molt. És un bon apartament per anar amb parella. Hi ha calefacció i aire fred també, cosa que et permet estar ben a gust a l’apartament. Com a cosa “negativa” diria que l’accés a l’apartament és una mica estret, hi ha unes escales molt verticals i estretes. També s’escolten els veïns de dalt i si surten de festa, se’t pot trencar el son facilment.

Nous avons passé un séjour parfait a Lisbonne . Le logement de Pedro est très bien situé dans le plus joli quartier la ville et très bien équipé. Pensez à prévoir des boules quies pour la nuit si l'appartement du dessus est loué car il y a très peu d'isolation phonique mais sinon le quartier est très calme. Merci encore a Pedro pour le transfert aéroport à l'arrivée, c'est un gros plus !

Fantastic property, ideal location and the best host!
The flat is as described with everything a couple needs to spend some days in Lisbon.
Pedro and his wife are one of the best hosts (if not the best) in Portugal! We were even picked up at the airport which is a huge, huge bonus!
Awesome!!

Pedro ist ein supertoller Gastgeber. Sehr freundlich, zuvorkommend und hilfsbereit.
Das Apartment liegt super zentral mit vielen Möglichkeiten. Pedro hat uns tolle Tipps zur Umgebung und Restaurants gegeben und auch Empfehlungen für Silvester parat gehabt, die wir genießen konnten.
Für das Appartement muss man gut zu Fuß sein. Die Treppe ins Appartement ist sehr steil, der Weg dorthin auch nicht so einfach mit viel Gepäck. Auch in der Umgebung darf man nicht eingeschränkt sein in der eigenen körperlichen Mobilität.
Trotz der zentralen Lage ist das Appartement sehr ruhig. Leider waren die Mieter in der Wohnung drüber mit Kleinkind, aufgrund der alten Bauweise sehr laut. Aber das ist kein Manko für den Pedro etwas kann.
Entgegen der Fotos handelt es sich eigentlich um ein 1-Zimmer Appartement. Das Bett steht sozusagen in der Küche, aber kochen muss man dort nicht, da alles sehr zentral ist und man zig Möglichkeiten auch preislich attraktiv, um Essen zu gehen.

We had a wonderful stay at Pedro’s AirBNB. Pedro was very gracious to pick us up from the airport.  It’s definitely a benefit since ride shares and taxis can’t actually drive into the neighborhood.  Once you’re inside,  you’re in the middle of everything and can walk to all of the different neighborhoods in the city.

Pedro had my favorite Airbnb in Portugal during my stay, and honestly, it was one of the best I’ve ever stayed in. He was extremely kind and even picked me up and dropped me off at the airport, as well as gave me great local suggestions. His Airbnb is very well located in the city center.
I can’t thank him enough. He was such an amazing host. I 100% recommend him and wish him all the best. Thanks for everything, Pedro. I truly appreciate your help and your hospitality.

Pedro was AWESOME!!!!!  If you like a good shower and clean place to stay you couldn’t pick a better place. Pedro picked us up from the ship. He took us to the airport. The best part is - my husband had a dietary change right before we left and Pedro took care of us. He put a few drinks in the refrigerator that my husband could have. I would definitely stay here again.

Ett fint boende och en fantastisk värd, Pedro. Fixade bra transporter till flygplatsen. Vi hade ett bra samtal och han pratade utmärkt engelska. Lägenheten ligger mitt i kulturstaden Alfama där du aldrig kommer få nog av nya upplevelser. Bra promenader, härliga restauranger med bl.a Fado-musik. Fin utsikt och enkelt att ta en spårvagn till andra sevärdheter/upplevelser. Jag rekommenderar alla att planera in en resa till denna fina stad och gärna också bo hos Pedro.

Excelente ubicación , nos recogió en el aeropuerto ,muy agradable .El apartamento es exactamente según la descripción ,no hemos tenido ningún problema .
Nuestra estancia a sido perfecta 😃
Pedro is a great host, he met us at the airport and drove to the flat. Flat is as was described, nice clean apartment in the city centre. Lot of great food places nearby, totally recommend!

Le logement est parfaitement conforme à la description, propre et bien équipé.
Quartier vivant où tout est accessible à pied, c’est l’emplacement parfait.
L’accueil chaleureux par Pedro qui est venu nous chercher à l’aéroport est un vrai plus.
La communication a toujours été au top 👌
Merci Pedro, vous êtes un vrai Hôte !

Con Pedro he recibido el mejor trato que he podido dar recibir en AIRBNB, me recogió en el aeropuerto, me dio recomendaciones, formas de transporte y todo para sentirme en casa. Sin ninguna duda siempre recomendaré a Pedro para cualquier persona que quiera hospedarse en Lisboa!
Pedro was a great host and very helpful. I would strongly recommend.
We had a lovely few extra days in Portugal. The area we stayed in was vibrant and interesting .

Nous avons passé un bon séjour dans ce logement.
L'appartement est fidèle à la description.
Il y a des commerces et des restaurants à proximité. Accessible à pied.
Pedro est réactif et agréable.

We had a fantastic stay here! Pedro is an incredible host who offers to pick you up from the airport when he can. That was such a kind offer and treat for us to have the transportation. This spot is in a great location and provided everything we needed.
沟通很顺畅，房子不大但很温馨

Pedro picked us up from the airport, which was super convenient. The location was amazing, and his food recommendations were spot on. The room was small but perfect for what we needed. Everything was nearby, with great food and coffee spots all around. Perfect location and stay.

Charmig lägenhet i pitoreska stadsdelen Alfama. Stort utbud av restauranger på de smala gatorna och torgen. Bageri tre minuter från lägenheten.
Hyfsat nära till järnvägsstationen Santa Apolonia och metro.
Pedro var mycket hjälpsam och hämtade oss från tågstationen.
En del ljud på kvällen från grannar och närmaste Fado-restaurang men inte sent.
Utsikt saknas från fönstret men det var inget problem för oss.

We cannot fault our stay in Pedro’s place
Pedro is the best host we have ever had, he kindly picked us up from the airport and provided an amazing welcome to the neighbourhood and his lovely apartment.
The apartment had everything we needed, in such a beautiful, traditional location - the apartment is in easy walking distance from the centre of Lisbon.
Just a note to say that there are some steep stairs up to the apartment from the front door (due to it being a traditional building), so keep in mind if you’re carrying luggage - it did not affect us however, we only had small bags.
We recommend Pedro’s place for anyone wanting a break in the beautiful Alfama district! Thank you so much!

L’appartamento si trova in una posizione centrale e molto comoda per visitare la città. Pedro è un host gentile e sempre disponibile, ci è anche venuto a prendere in aeroporto! Unica nota negativa è il letto un po’ scomodo, ma per il resto soggiorno perfetto.

Such a great spot in the heart of alfama district in a historic building with charm and quirks. Pedro is an awesome host going above and beyond to collect us from the airport,  take us right to and showing the apartment, very responsive to any enquiry. The apartment is charming and has everything  you need for a stay in Lisbon. It is right in the heart of the old town but walking distance to transit of all forms, so very easy to get around.

Pedro is a fantastic host and we thoroughly enjoyed our interactions with him. His shuttle service from the airport is fabulous and avoided us getting stressed out trying to Uber or hail a taxi. The care he showed for our comfort was refreshing and allowed for the best start possible.  We're glad we stayed in the Alfama district because it was fun to wander all around the little narrow streets getting lost.

Pedro was simply No 1 collecting us from the airport on arrival. His place is located in a truly authentic area of town away from hustle and bustle. But still good for all places to visit. Amazing places to eat within a few hundred yards ……. Great bakery too …… A true flexible host who will go out of his way for you 👌🌅🍾🥂💥🌅.
Neil & Jill UK 🇬🇧

Pedro was amazing from the beginning! Great host, super responsive and was kind and helpful.
Offered to pick us up and was very accommodating.
The location is great, felt very local and part of the Alfama historic area.
The apartments was as described and very comfortable. Would recommend this to travellers looking to get a local-feel stay in Lisbon!

Pedro provided us with clear and detailed instructions prior to our arrival and kindly arranged an airport pickup, which was an excellent way to start our first visit to Lisbon. The apartment is well-equipped with everything one might need, and its location is highly convenient for exploring the city. We greatly enjoyed our stay and would warmly recommend it to future guests.
A very cute, comfortable apartment in the heart of Alfama. Lots of character and places to eat. Close to Metro and many sights. would definitely recommend this place.

We stayed at Pedro’s place at the end of August, it was a lovely little apartment, very cute entrance, down a pedestrianised lane.
Apartment had everything we needed, the fans were welcomed!
Pedro was very kind and met us at the airport to take us to the door. Genuinely lovely guy, and his wife (I think) - friendly and fantastic English.
Alfama itself was beautiful, very atmospheric- but it is very hilly and the cobbled streets uneven - we loved this however.
Would not hesitate to recommend Pedro’s apartment for anyone wishing to have a city break in lively Lisbon.
Pedro is a fantastic host. Houses in this part of Lisbon are extremely old so some minor issues are to be expected (e.g. little ventilation in the bathroom) but we felt very comfortable.
This apartment is in a great location

El anfitrión fue por lejos el mejor que me ha tocado; nos recogió en el aeropuerto y nos llevó al alojamiento y nos dio muchos y buenos consejos. A nuestra salida también nos fue a buscar y nos dejó en la estación de tren. Recomendable 100%.
Pedro's place is very well located, close to everything in a great zone. it is small yet cozy. And he was kind enough to pick us up from the airport and drop us off at the apartment. Would recommend!

Pedro is a warm, welcoming, helpful host. He asked for our flight details to pick us up on time and dropped us off at departure. He recommended sightseeing spots and restaurants.
The flat is spacious, with both pros and cons: central location, lively streets, but also outdated pipework, bathroom humidity, and an ageing shower. Common in Alfama old buildings, these issues didn’t ruin our stay, but travelers should know.
The main problem was small cockroaches. While expected in old Lisbon houses, we wished Pedro had warned us and taken efficient preventive action. He seemed surprised, yet anti-cockroach products were already present. His fixes were not fully effective, and we had to buy more ourselves—something the host should provide. Another cockroach appeared despite our efforts.
Had Pedro been transparent and proactive, our rating would be higher. The issue caused unnecessary worry, especially in the bathroom, not ideal on holiday.

Pedro's place in Alfama was amazing.
Pedro and his wife kindly picked us up from the Airport, despite the fact that our flight was delayed by a couple hours. Pedro helped us get checked in to the place and explained all the instructions. He was very friendly and responsive.
In the heart of Alfama, the location of the place is perfect. We were able to walk everywhere we needed to go, including the Cathedral of Lisbon, Rossio Square and the castle of Sao Jorge. There were plenty of restaurants and cafes in the area.
The surrounding area is very old but the unit itself is very well maintained. There are two large fans provided, but the lack of AC is definitely noticeable at night when the unit gets up to 30 degrees Celsius.
Overall, we had a nice time at Pedro's place.
Pedro is an incredible host and was so very helpful. His apartment is very clean and homely.

Pedro met us at the train station and walked us to his place in the heart of Alfama. It is clean and renovated in an old historic building. Exactly what we were looking for! We loved the peace of the cobble streets and only voices of neighbors, no street traffic

Wir waren äußerst zufrieden: Es begann schon damit, dass uns Pedro vom Flughafen abgeholt hat - extrem hilfreich und nett!
Er hat uns alles im Appartment gezeigt und wir hatten das Gefühl, dass wir jederzeit via messager alles von ihm hätten haben können.
Ich habe selten eine so gut ausgestattete Küche bei airbnb gehabt, die Lage ist fantastisch.
Man muss wissen: Das ganze Viertel und auch das Haus sind alt, man braucht sich nicht über ein enges Stiegenhaus wundern.
Fazit: Wir würden jederzeit wieder bei Pedro buchen.

Beau séjour chez Pedro qui est venu nous récupérer directement à l’aéroport et qui s’est montré patient malgré le retard de notre vol. Heureusement qu’il est venu nous chercher parce que l’endroit peut être difficile à trouver. Les escaliers menant à l’appartement sont étroits ce qui rend l’accès difficile. Sinon, tout est à disposition et à distance de marche de plusieurs attractions. En bref, nous avons apprécié notre séjour! Merci Pedro pour l’accueil!

In the heart of the Alfama neighborhood near plenty of cafes (we loved Alfama Doce), very easy to get anywhere around Lisbon! Pedro picked us up from the airport and made sure we had everything we needed, which was amazing. The apartment was clean and even though there's no AC, the fans made it perfectly comfortable inside even though the outside temperature got above 90F/32C. With the windows open we could hear Fado music from a nearby cafe, but once we closed the windows it was perfectly quiet for us. We would definitely stay here again! As others have said, the stairs are very steep and narrow, just something to keep in mind if you have somewhat limited mobility.
This place, location, and Pedro himself were amazing! Would definitely recommend.
Pedro was a great host! He picked us up at the airport and was so kind and friendly. His place was great. We slept well and walked around Alfama easily. Thanks so much, Pedro!!
Great place to stay!
Location was amazing and apartment was very clean. Pedro gave great recommendations and also picked us up from the airport which was very sweet. I highly recommend this stay
A fantastically well placed apartment in the heart of Alfama! Surrounded by numerous restaurants and bars, we had a lovely short stay exploring Lisbon.

Super stay, Pedro was super kind and the pick up was great as previously taxis had scammed us ( watch out for this, where they increase price at end) .The area was great and we felt safe - especially with the alarm . The bakery around the corner is the friendliest and best. It was a bit hot without air cond. we had a lovely stay🤍

We went for a weekend.  This happened to coincide with the festival of St Anthony so it was very busy.  Lots of people, quite noisy. The neighbours were very noisy banging doors and shouting late at night and early morning.

Pedro was a wonderful host! He picked us up from the airport and told us about a lot of great places and gave us some great information! Pedro himself is a super nice gentleman. The apartment is very clean and we felt very safe. It is a perfect location and a short walk from many of the exciting things happening. One thing to be aware of is that if you have any mobility issues, it might be difficult for you to access, as there are a lot of stairs in that part of town and uneven sidewalks. This was not an issue for us, and we didn’t mind a little exercise. We would absolutely stay again!
Pedro was so sweet and helpful! Beautiful place to stay.
모든 게 다 마음에 들었습니다. 호스트가 매우 친절하고 사교적입니다. 숙소 시설부터 공항 픽업, 짐 옮기기까지 무엇하나 모자람이 없습니다. 다음에 리스본에 또 간다면 또 머물고 싶습니다!
Pedro is an amazing host, kind and interesting, and his place was very clean and cosy, in the heart of Lisbon

Pedro met us at the airport which was great.  He was really accommodating, gave us lots of info and tips, and communication was clear and responsive throughout. The area is very interesting, lots to see and plenty of places to eat. We had a great stay in Lisbon at Pedro's apartment!

We had a wonderful stay in Pedro’s apartment. Amazing to have free pickup from the airport. From touching down in the airport to the moment we checked out, Pedro was responsive and helpful. Apartment is exactly what you need for a few nights in Lisbon. Quiet location in historic Alfama.
Pedro è stato molto ospitale, è venuto a prenderci in areoporto ed è sempre stato disponibile. L'appartamento carino e centrale.

Pedro was great! He picked us up from the airport, dropped us in a square to wander a bit while he brought our luggage to the apartment and cleaned since we were checking in early. He met us an hour later and walked us to the apartment which we would not have found on our own! It is about a km walk through cobbled hills that cannot be driven upon. The stairs to enter are steep and the hallway is skinny so we were concerned about getting our luggage out and down to the square, but it was actually easier than we thought. There are multiple Fado and seafood restaurants in the area if you are looking for a true Portuguese dining experience, and many others along the square and along the river. It's a quick walk to Rua Augusta, and to the sights in Alfama.

We stayed for two nights, it was a bonus being picked up at the airport by Pedro, he is a very friendly and responsive host! The apt looked like the photos and was clean.
Would happily book again!
Pedro was great host and his airport pick up was much appreciated.

Excellent service as picked up from airport
Lovely appartment in the centre of Alfama. Walkable to many areas and lots of good local bars and restaurants
Would highly recommend for a stay in Lisbon

Un très bon contact avec Pedro, disponible et réactif. Pedro est même venu nous chercher à l aéroport. Le logement était bien équipé et surtout au coeur de la ville et de la vie. Parfait pour découvrir Lisbonne
We had a great stay at Pedro’s apartment in Alfama!  The airport pickup was so helpful, and the apartment is in the cutest area close to many great restaurants!  We absolutely loved our stay!

Fomos bem recepcionados.
O local nos atendeu muito bem. Próximo a lugares turísticos. E estava tudo muito limpo.
O anfitrião, Pedro, muito prestativo e educado, nos buscou no aeroporto. Foi super simpático, demonstrou o caminho para o apartamento e nos deu muitas dicas.
Ficamos muito satisfeito pelo período que ficamos em Lisboa e com certeza voltaríamos!
Pedro est d’une gentillesse incroyable!! L’appartement est parfaitement bien situé, dans un quartier typique très charmant. Nous avons adoré ce petit séjour. Je recommande x1000

The place is comfortable and cozy. You can even watch YouTube and Netflix. Pedro is a very nice guy and he picked us up from the car rental company, otherwise, it would be quite difficult to find his place.  Be aware that after entering the front door, you need to walk up a steep staircase to the unit. Other than that, everything is fine.

One of the best Air BnB experiences I have ever had! Pedro picking us up at the airport and taking us to the apartment after a long flight was amazing. He went above and beyond. The apartment itself was clean and couldn't have been in a better location right in the heart of the Alfama. I would recommend his place to anyone!

This is a great place that’s close to everything in Alfama. Pedro was an amazing and accommodating host who went above and beyond to ensure we had an amazing stay! I would highly recommend staying here.

It was really a pleasure to meet Pedro and stay at his beautiful place in Alfama!
Getting a lift from the airport was a BIG plus (because we were pretty tired!) and I felt reassured that Pedro was responsive and kept up with our flight being delayed etc. It was also great that he took us all the way to the door, because it’s easy to get turned around in that neighborhood!
The apartment is small but perfect for our needs, we just wanted a base of operations to start our adventures. It’s near public transit and plenty of interesting places to get to by foot. The apartment was quiet at night, which is not guaranteed in Alfama!
There are plenty of restaurants around and little mercados to get the basics.
Would recommend 💯
Pedro met us at the station; otherwise it might have been tricky to find the place. Easy walking distance for downtown. Everything we needed.

Pedro nous a remarquablement accueillis. Il est venu nous chercher chez le loueur de voiture et s est adapté à nos horaires.
Il nous a bien conseillé sur les restaurants à proximité.
L appartement est plus petit que sur les photos, bas de plafond et un peu sombre. On entre d abord dans un salon assez petit, possédant une porte fenêtre, puis on accède à une deuxième pièce sans fenêtre, où il y a le lit et derrière la cuisine. On a ainsi l impression que le lit est dans la cuisine. Depuis cette deuxième pièce, une porte donne accès à la salle d eau, également sans fenêtre.
La cuisine est bien équipée et fonctionnelle, la salle d eau également.
