L'appartement est dans le quartier historique d Alfama. D un côté c est pratique pour les visites, d un autre côté le quartier est mal entretenu et salle : immeubles délabrés, papiers et gravats au sol, poubelles débordantes.
Au total Pedro est vraiment accueillant et l appartement convient pour quelques jours en etant conscient de ses limites.

Hôte très accueillant, Pedro est venu nous chercher à l’aéroport et nous a donné de très bons conseils . Le logement était fidèle à la description et très bien situé dans le célèbre quartier d’Alfama .

Nuestro anfitrión Pedro fue muy amable, nos fue a buscar al Aeropuerto lo que hizo nuestra llegada a Portugal más relajada. Nos llevo hasta la puerta del piso y nos mostró como funcionaba todo, eso se agradece porque luego te sientes como en casa.
La zona es muy pintoresca, hay una pastelería muy cerca que te hace sentir en Portugal. Sin embargo no conseguimos por la zona muchos lugares para comer auténtica gastronomía portuguesa.
Everything was perfect. Clean space, good position, kind accomodation and free airport transfer by Pedro. Recommended
Pedro is an excellent host great location and place ! Recommend
Had a lovely stay. the location is amazing. right at the heart of old Lisbon. Pedro was a great host
a experiência foi excelente.  Pedro muito atencioso e gentil.  o apartamento é muito bem localizado e confortável.  recomendo muito e voltaria sem dúvidas
Zeer vriendelijke host en zeer gemakkelijk dat hij ons kwam afhalen aan de luchthaven!

We spent two nights in Lisbon staying in Pedro’s apartment. Pedro picked us up at the airport and took us to the apartment which is in Alfama. The apartment is small but all we needed for our short stay. The kitchen is fully equiped, the bed comfortable and the small lounge area also comfortable. It’s a wonderful location being in the heart of Alfama where you can just wonder the streets and enjoy the amazing old buildings.
It was so nice being picked up at the airport and Pedro also dropped us at our car rental pick up location on the day we left.
We met Pedro and his wife who were both lovely. They could not have been more helpful. I highly recommend Pedro’s apartment. We wouldn’ hesitate to stay again.
The steps up to the apartment from the front door are very steep so would be impossible for anyone who struggles with stairs.
There is a great coffee very near by at the Illy Espresso White Lady and also fabulous pastry at Fora Artisan Pastry about 6 minutes walk up the hill.
Pedro est très gentil et aidant! Il est venu nous rejoindre à notre arrivée, c’était très apprécié! Nous avons passé un beau séjour!

The apartment is very comfortable and perfectly located for exploring Lisbon. There are lovely cafés, restaurants, and the tram just a short walk away. We really appreciated being picked up at the airport by Pedro, who took us to the apartment and gave us a helpful orientation of the area. Overall, it’s great value for money, and we would happily recommend it.

Pedro est très réactif et arrangeant. Il est venu nous chercher à l’aéroport en voiture, nous n’avons pas eu à l’attendre et il était même prêt à nous emmener au restaurant que nous avions réservé pour le soir même. La communication a été fluide car Pedro répond très rapidement aux messages si vous avez besoin de lui.

En tout cas, je recommande vraiment ce logement!
Great place, had some issues with the shower, but Pedro was super responsive.

Pedro was great! He picked us up from the airport and let us walked us to the Airbnb to get us checked in. He was very responsive and allowed us a late checkout as well. The location in Alfama is great, I highly recommend!

Nos sentimos como en casa, el apartamento tiene  de todo para una buena estadía, Pedro es muy amable y un plus que nos recogiera en el aeropuerto a nuestra llegada, es sumamente amigable y siempre atento a cualquier cosa que necesites.  La zona tiene de todo y excelentes restaurantes, muy cerca de todo para disfrutar. ¡¡¡¡Súper recomendado!!!!

호스트 Pedro의 따뜻한 환대로 시작해 리스본에서의 최고의 추억을 만들 수 있었던 숙소였습니다.

Pedro e sua moglie sono persone molto ospitali. Si sono presi cura del nostro arrivo venendoci a prendere in aeroporto, cosa che ha facilitato i nostri spostamenti. Lo raccomando alla comunità AirBnb.

Pedro picked us up at the airport which was fantastic, he checked us in and explained everything very well. We really enjoyed staying in this apartment, it’s very well situated for exploring Lisbon and the surrounding area is very nice.

It's all about locatiolocation in Alfama. The place is lacking in character and could use some improvements for a better stay but if you are just in for a short bit and on a budget, it works fine.
The lovely and warm welcome made our first trip to Portugal and first day in Liboa  memorable. Thanks for all!
Nice accommodations, great location. Pedro was an excellent host and was very helpful and accommodating.

Pedro is hands down the best host I have ever had.

Pedro’s apartment hidden among the winding cobble streets in the old town of Alfama was a great location to explore Lisbon and its many sights. It was quiet and very clean with a window balcony in the lounge area, a comfy bed, well set up kitchen and nice bathroom. We were in walking distance of many quaint bars, cafes and restaurant as well as a couple of minimarts for bread and milk. Our host went above and beyond by picking us up from the airport after a long haul flight, assisting with getting luggage up the stairs to apartment and dropping us at the train station when we left for Porto. We walked a lot around city but when tired used a few taxis which were cheap and easy to hail. Highlights for us were the maritime museum, Castello St George, the view at Miradouro De Santi Luzia, exploring the Calouste Gulbeckian & tile museums, taking in a fado show with dinner in Alfama, our day trip to Peña Palace and people watching at the stunning Pracia Do Commerico.

Pedro é extremamente simpático, e mostrou-se solícito e disponível desde o princípio da estadia. Apresentou dicas locais e também como deveríamos fazer para nos deslocarmos para as cidades próximas, como cascais. Seu espaço está no coração do bairro alfama, ideal para perder-se em caminhadas! Adoramos!

Pedro is an excellent and very responsive host. His apartment is exactly as shown in the pictures. He was kind enough to pick us up at the airport and offered great recommendations around Alfama. Would definitely stay again!

He’s attentive to details and the space has everything you need to enjoy. It’s the little touches that make the space special. He also has a newly renovated bathroom with modern rain-head shower. Highly recommend booking Pedro’s listing!

Highly recommended if you are looking to stay at Alfama area.
Merci Pedro pour votre appartement et vos conseil, et surtout merci d’être venu nous chercher à l’aéroport c’est vraiment très appréciable.

Pedro picked us up from the airport and ensured our safe arrival to his home. His home was clean and in a fantastic neighborhood!

Enjoyed our stay very much. The biggest highlights of Pedro’s place were the airport pickup making for a smooth check-in, and the convenient location to walk to the city’s attractions.

A perfect place to stay in Alfama! The apartment had everything you’d need and is in a great location with lots of restaurants nearby, and walking distance to many main sights. None of this though really impacted my trip and it was a great stay. So much to see and do with some good eateries on your doorstep. Great selling point is that Pedro picked me up from the airport!

너무 친절하고 배려넘치는 호스트 덕에 행복했습니다.

Great apartment, well furnished and equipped. We lacked for nothing and it is so handy for everything.

Très chouette emplacement dans l’alfama. Top pour visiter Lisbonne et dîner dans les petits resto le soir

Nous avons passé 5 jours délicieux dans l'appartement de Pedro. Les photos sont conformes au lieu. L'appartement est atypiqueet plein de charme, extrêmement bien situé proche de tout. Caroline et Fabrice
amazing spot!  great location, great host! met us at the train station and very helpful!

If there were an option above Super host, Pedro deserve it. Pedro went above and beyond from picking us up from the airport to helping us to carry our luggage all the way to the apartment. Nous avons passé un agréable séjour.

Appartement bien équipé. Confort standard mais il ne manque rien. Excellente localisation dans le vieux Lisbonne.

Superbe séjour chez Pedro qui est venu nous chercher à l'aéroport.

Merci encore pour les petites attentions comme une bouteille de vin pour notre arrivée et le transfert aéroport / ville.

Appartement très bien situé ! Pedro est un hôte très accueillant et attentionné. Il est même venu nous chercher à l’aéroport.
Je recommande vivement

If you’re looking for authentic atmosphere staying in Alfama, Pedro’s apartment is the place to be. Pedro has a lovely place situated in the middle of beautiful Alfama. The apartment is well equipped and Pedro is very helpful.
I can highly recommend a stay at Pedro's place.

Me and my girlfriend had a great time in Pedro's flat. It is very well situated in the heart of Alfama with plenty of typical restaurants around while being very calm. I definitely recommend Pedro's flat to enjoy your stay in Lisbon!

Pedro se preocupó por nosotros desde antes de llegar. Nos vino a recoger, nos ayudó con las maletas y nos enseñó a conciencia el apartamento.
Muy amable y servicial.
Cuando volvamos a Lisboa, repetiremos apartamento.

Pedro is a fantastic host. The pick-up-service gives a first impression of the city and leads you to the a bit hidden apartment -it's uphill as is the whole district, be prepared for that. The apartment is bigger than I thought it would be. You shouldn't hesitate booking it. If you have the option of  taking a large backpack, you should definitely take it over a suitcase. Perfect apartment to visit Lisbon for some days! It has everything you need and Pedro is an excellent host. We would recommend staying here as the neighbourhood is quiet and beautiful and is close to the city center. Pedro war sehr freundlich und hat uns direkt vom Flughafen abgeholt. Auch hat er uns mittels einem Stadtplan gute Tips gegeben. Wir können das AirBnb herzlichst weiterempfehlen.
Buon appartamento. Pedro molto gentile e accogliente!

Appartement idéalement placé, à 10 minutes du centre. Dans un super quartier.

Super séjour !

Excellent séjour dans cet appartement bien équipé, propre et idéalement situé dans le quartier typique de l’alfama. Pedro est un hôte très accueillant qui est venu nous chercher à notre arrivée à Lisbonne. Super semaine. Je reviendrai avec plaisir
A wonderful place in Alfama! Convenient and central. Pedro was especially helpful with a ride from the airport and travel tips.

The apartment is really nice, clean and well cured. Pedro is very kind, the pick up service he offers is amazing and certainly not obvious.
Alfama is an exquisite area of the city, made of narrow characteristic streets.
Overall I totally suggest Pedro as an Host to visit Lisbon in a long weekend.

Pedro was a very good host! Very available and full of advice!
His place is very well located near little restaurants of fado, the castle and good point of view of the city!! There are a lot of devices in the flat which is extremely useful!
Despite the pandemic, we felt very safe since Portuguese are very careful with every safety rules!

The apartment is located inside the oldest neighborhood in Lisbon, Alfama, in a narrow quiet alley and a five-minute walk from the main street. The apartment is on the second floor. The access is from the alley, but there is a steep staircase once you open the door, so I suggest you pack lightly to get the luggage upstairs. Like any other old city in Europe, streets are rough and rugged for luggage with wheels, just a heads up. If you have a car, there is a parking lot that two blocks away that charges €12 for 24 hours. The apartment is spotless and very well equipped; you will find everything you need for your stay. There are plenty of restaurants, cafes, and mini markets close by. Pedro is a super host; he meets us at check in and check out, gave us plenty of tips for our stay in Lisbon, he was always at a reaching hand at any time. We have a fantastic stay at his place.

Pedro has a nice small cozy place in a very good location, in Alfama. It is easy to discover all historical places in Lisbon due to the convenient location. The place is equipped with all necessary items in the kitchen including kettle, microwave, iron, coffee machine etc. Pedro also picked us up in the airport which was a very nice touch. Great and easy communication with thr host during the stay

Pedro's place was our home for a full 1 month! We had a great time in this apartment. The communication was super easy and quick and the place looks exactly like it does on the pictures. Pedro met us in airport which is real cool when coming by plane to Lisbon, and he provided all the information, helping us with everything we needed (he even bought a completely new oven for the kitchen). Apartment has a great location in the city center and Alfama is the best place to discover real Lisbon.
El alojamiento es muy bonito y céntrico, tal cual las fotos y Pedro fue muy atento en todo momento.
Appartement très bien situé et très bien équipé dans le centre de l Alfama. Pedro est un hôte très attentionné. Il vient vous chercher à l aéroport, c est extra !

Buona posizione nel quartiere più caratteristico di Lisbona, pulizia impeccabile, ospitalità dell’host Pedro veramente da 5 stelle. Da tenere solo presente per chi ha problemi di deambulazione che c’è una scala per accedere all’appartamento breve ma molto ripida.

Pedro was so welcoming on arrival, picked us up from the airport and provided us with lots of information on the area and the best places to visit. The apartment was very clean and comfortable. Super accueil de Pedro qui est venu nous chercher à l'aéroport. Un vrai plus. Petit commerce de proximité avec des gens sympa.on se sent bien rapidement dans ce quartier.

Everything was as excellent as expected.

I recommend this stay with all the warmth.
Alfama es precioso, antiguo con servicio moderno, restaurante bueno cerca y padaria muy buena

Pedros place was great. He met us at the Train station and helped with our suitcases to the apartment. It was in a very good location. The apartment was very clean. Overall we would highly recommend Pedros place.
Everything was great! Pedro was very kind, and the appartment very clean. I recommand 100%!

Pedro’s place was everything listed in the description and more. If I go back to Lisbon in the future I wouldn’t want to stay in another area besides Alfama, it was an amazing stay. Vous pouvez vous rendre chez Pedro les yeux fermés. Loft sympathique et cosy, les hôtes sont disponibles, le quartier est typique et accueillant. Nous avons passé un superbe moment.
Pedro’s place was great. His pick up at the airport was so nice and thoughtful and easy! We even left us a bottle of vino :) loved it!
Pedro is very friendlly tells a lot of te city. The pickup service at the airport is great!
The airport pickup sealed the deal for us. Pedro kept us informed throughout the process. Couldn’t have asked for more.

Apartamento muy bien situado, en pleno barrio de alfama, limpio y con todo lo necesario para pasar unos días. Pedro nos recogió en el aeropuerto pese a ser muy temprano, luego nos explico cosas básicas para comer y desplazarnos, muy recomendable!!!
If Pedro's place is available, then just book it! The location is fantastic and Pedro is a brilliant host. The apartment has everything you would need. Highly recommend.
Pedro’s place was so cozy and had everything we needed. Pedro and his wife are very thoughtful and kind. We highly recommend staying here!

If you go to Lisboa book your stay in the apartment of Pedro.
Um óptimo apartamento para quem quer passar uns dias em Lisboa e sentir de perto um dos bairros mais emblemáticos de Lisboa. O Pedro é um hospedeiro atencioso e o seu apartamento muito bem cuidado.

Pedro takes his role as super host seriously.  The apartment is immaculate with all the amenities needed, like coffee, coffee filter, tea,  wine, glasses, cookware and dishes. My boyfriend and I spent a great WE in Lisboa staying at Pedro’s. The appartment is well located in the historic area and communication with Pedro was easy and nice as he even came nicely pick us at the airport.

We enjoyed our stay at this clean and comfortable apartment located in the heart of the  Alfama district. Pedro was great with communication and he met us at the train station and walked with us to the apartment- which would have been a little difficult to find on our own at night.

Central location in the iconic Alfama neighbourhood. Quiet little street- pedestrian only. Close to lots of restaurants and bars. Charming apartment, perfect for two.

Pedro is a great host.  He was very flexible in picking us up (after several mix ups on my part) and gracious.  The apartment had all the little touches that made it feel more like a home than a hotel room. Here, it's not uncommon to have outside walls that are over 1 meter thick (the apartment has an interior wall almost this thick).  If you want to actually "feel" a part of old Lisboa history, this is the place to stay.  BTW:  The Military Museum between the Fado museum and train station may be the best value in Lisbon with much more than military artifacts (i.e. art).

Pedro is a true gentleman. He picked us up from the airport and he gave us plenty of tips about Lisbon.
The location was great and the property was wonderful.

El departamento de Pedro es increíble. Hermoso, cómodo, decorado con mucho gusto y en una zona encantadora. Esta equipado con mucho detalle para que nuestra estancia sea cómoda. Destaco los elementos de seguridad que no he visto en ningún dpto q he alquilado, esto da un toque de superioridad.
Con respecto a Pedro, hemos quedado encantados con su buena onda, nos ha recomendado muchas cosas para hacer y lugares típicos para comer. Realmente recomiendo muchísimo su alojamiento.
Pedro is a very kind and warm host. We were very happy with our stay in the beautiful Alfama district. The apartment was clean, comfortable and close to many great restaurants and shops.

The location was good. Easy to walk to restaurants , shops, and into the heart of the city . Pedro is very kind and picked us up from the airport even after our flight was delayed 3 hours. We only stayed two days here but it worked perfect for us for those two day’s .

Cet appartement était très bien.  Propreté irréprochable, literie très confortable et tout ce dont vous avez besoin pour la cuisine et plus encore. Historical location, near to tram and subway stops. Apartment has all the amenities you need. Pedro is a great host and we welcomed a free airport pick up,  thank you. Would highly recommend.

Nous avons eu hospitalité hors du commun et nous recommandons cette expérience sans aucune hésitation 😀😀😀
Appartement très bien situé et pedro est au top !

Bel appartement typique et bien situé dans le quartier historique de l'Alfama.  Parfait pour deux personnes, il y a tout ce dont vous avez besoin dans l'appartement.  Les 2 ventilateurs ont été appréciés pendant notre cours séjour puisqu'il a fait exceptionnellement chaud les 17-18 septembre 2019.  Merci a Pedro pour son accueil.
It's in the old part of Lisbon, great value eating places abound. Very comfortable and so clean apartment, backed up by a very thoughtful host.

If you are looking to be close to everything in the Alfama district of Lisbon then do consider Pedro’s apartment. We found it clean, tidy and exactly as shown in the pictures. Pedro was very easy to communicate with and was most helpful. Value for the cost was very good. This apartment would not be suitable for people with mobility issues as it is on the second floor. I think Pedro mentions this in the ad. The staircase up is narrow with a short step. There is a good solid hand rail which we used particularly going down. From what we observed most older structures will be like this in Lisbon, so make are you have good, flat, non-slip footwear for buildings and the streets. We happened upon a late summer heat wave with 35 plus degree temps. This apartment can get quite hot as there is no air conditioning. There are a couple of good quality fans that certainly helped but the weather is beyond anyone’s control. In speaking with other travelers we understand that if your accommodations are in an old building there will not likely be air conditioning. For us this was fine as we wanted the experience of old Portugal. I would recommend Pedro’s place for value, cleanliness and close proximity to lots of things Portuguese!
Pedro is so kind and helpful. Having an airport pick up is such a nice touch! His place is clean, comfy and quiet. A perfect place for a couple to explore Lisbon.
Pedro was so kind and helpful! It was a great neighborhood and comfortable stay!

Our stay at Pedro’s was great! We were very grateful for the pick up at the airport, the explanation of the local area, and the bottle of wine! The location of the apartment is a short walk to the train station and right in the historic district. We would stay again in the future!

We SO appreciated meeting Pedro, his place, and the location. Alfama and Lisbon were wonderful!! We couldn’t have hoped for a better location! Pedro is an excellent host and we couldn’t recommend more highly.
Tout parfait!!!accueil propreté et emplacement. recommendé pour 2 personnes

Pedro was an amazing host. Picking us up from the airport and giving us recommendations for restaurants and where to find the best pasteis de natas. Pedro also gave us a free bottle of wine which was a lovely, thoughtful touch.

Room was clean.

Pedro is a very friendly and helpful host. It was awesome for him to pick us up from the airport and gave us helpful tips while we traveled around the neighborhood.

Had a lovely stay at Pedro’s place. He is a good host, picked us up at the train station,  and showed us the highlights. Lovely apartment in the neighborhood of Alfama.

Nice apartment with a good location. Clean and convenient. Pedro is very friendly and attentive. He took our luggage to the apartment and picked us up at the airport. I recommend it.

Appartement super. A recommander sans hésitation.

A trim and nicely designed apartment in the fascinating Alfama district of Lisbon. Pedro’s apartment was clean and simple and provided us with everything we needed, including a laundry machine! We were so grateful that Pedro picked us up from the airport and explained the neighborhood to us. We were able to walk everywhere but still felt tucked away in a nice quiet area.

Marjorie .

Bonjour,

Fantastic apartment in a great location, a short walk away from many popular tourist attractions. Pedro was a fantastic host, picking us up from airport and showing us the apartment. Amazing location. Lovely apartment and host. Would definitely stay here again. Sweet find.

Pros: apartment was clean, simple, everything you could need was in the apartment, brochures and cards for local restaurants and tours, Pedro left a bottle of wine for us (very nice), good location, relatively quiet area, comfortable bed.

Fabulous stay! :)

Very clean, modern and quaint.  Has all you need for your stay. Location is excellent and Pedro is a super host!  Airport pick up was so helpful. Highly recommend staying here if you are visiting Lisbon!
Wonderful host and a perfect location for sightseeing, dining and soaking in the historic district!
L'appartamento è bello e si trova nel cuore del magico quartiere di Alfama. Pedro è un host disponibile, chiaro e pronto a soddisfare le tue richieste. Consigliato.

Pedro's warm home in the heart of Alfama was perfect for our first trip to Lisbon. We had everything we could need in the flat, and Pedro made the check-in as easy as possible. Accueil très chaleureux de Pedro qui est venu nous chercher à l’aéroport et qui nous a conseillé sur notre séjour. L’appartement est très propre et idéal pour les couples. Pedro was great. The apartment was very clean and located in a good location. The airport pickup was perfect.
Très bon accueil et appartement impeccable. Je recommande !

El piso de Pedro es una muy buena opción si estás pensando en visitar Lisboa y sois dos personas. Tiene todo lo básico para hacer que te sientas cómoda. La ubicación es immejorable, a solo 5 minutos andando del centro.

Pedro is the best host you can find in Alfama. From the pick up at the airport up to the end of your stay, he will make you feel that he will be there for you. Apartment is clean, location perfect. Don’t hesitate if you are alone or as a couple.

It was great to be picked up at the airport after our overnight flight. With the windows closed it was quiet for sleeping. We enjoyed wondering in Alfama streets-a convenient location. Would not hesitate to stay here again.

This is a super Air BNB, Pedro is such a nice Guy. He picked us up at the airport and showed us everything in the air bnb. We could contact him whenever we wanted during our stay. Pedro was a great host. Picking us up from the airport made everything a lot less stressful when we arrived. The flat is nice and clean and fairly close to the main areas. Definitely can recommend!

Tudo na acomodação do Pedro é para além das expectativas! Pedro, retornaremos em breve para conhecer ainda mais esse bairro apaixonante que é a Alfama, e com certeza ficaremos no seu apartamento :)

What a great apartment! Definitely book this place if you can. I was only in Lisbon for a couple of days but Pedro’s place already felt like home. Pedro is very welcoming and friendly-it’s always nice when you get to meet an actual apartment owner. I hope I can return soon and spend more time!
Pedro is a very attentive host. The place is spotless, with all amenities you may need. We highly recommend this place.
Nice

Thank you for a lovely stay in your apartment Pedro! Thank you for collecting us from the airport, it set the holiday off to a great start. Thank you for the local tips and for being so welcoming. Communication throughout was great too. A very nice apartment in a great location. Emily & Finn
Pedro’s place is outstanding and in the heart of Alfama! Main attractions are within walking distance. Pedro was friendly abs provided many tips to get around Lisbon. Thank you!
Pedro was great.  Picked us up at the airport, gave us the lay of the land, and had good suggestions of what to do.  The place was nice, great location.

No need to look anywhere else to stay in Lisbon! Pedro was a great host! This was our first time in Lisbon and we greatly appreciated the personal pick up at the airport and the helpful tips for local attractions and restaurants. Obrigado, Pedro! :-)

We are so grateful for our time and for Pedro's communication. He went above and beyond to ensure we knew what was available and when we needed assistance he answered right away. Ideal for a couple. Very clean apartment with everything you will need. Great location and pick up at the airport was an unexpected extra.
The apartment was cozy and clean, the location in Alfama was excellent and Pedro was such a friendly host; he even picked us up from the airport. Can really recommend him as a host and his apartment!

Honestly could call this one of my best Airbnb experiences; from excellent communication initially to a more-than-appreciated personal  airport pickup to helpful hints and friendly conversation. Will absolutely choose here for our next trip to Lisbon.

Excelente ubicación.

nous recommandons fortement Pedro le quartier agréable n'hésitez pas une seconde vous avez trouvé votre petit nid

Lieu très bien situé dans l’alfama parfait pour se balader ,Pedro a été parfait, il est venu nous chercher à l’aéroport il nous a laissé une bouteille de vin pour notre accueil.

Excelentes acomodações. Localização previlegiada
Extremamente limpo. Acolhida no aeroporto. Pedro e um super host. Remomendo.

Pedro is a wonderful host. The location is ideally situated to capture the local tastes, sounds, and atmosphere of Lisbon. The apartment is clean and the host is gracious. Great host and wonderful location!

This is the perfect location to explore Lisbon. The apartment is perfect, clean and cute, and Pedro is a great host. Life in the heart of Alfama is magical, and Pedro’s place makes it the perfect experience.

The apartment is just in the heart of the old town. It's easy to get to all the sights. Pedro is super nice and really helpful. The room is clean and well equiped. It might be a little bit steep to get upstairs.

O espaço de Pedro é excelente e sua disponibilidade muito grande. Ele nos buscou e nos levou ao apartamento o que facilitou muito a entrada no apartamento. O espaço tinha tudo que precisávamos. Petit studio bien placé dans un quartier calme. En plein coeur de alfama et a deux pas du centre il est idéalement situé. On a été agréablement surpris par l'accueil. navette depuis l'aéroport jusqu'a l'hôtel, une bouteil de vin de bien venue, du savon des essuies et même du dentifrice. Parfait

Pedro was a great host, we felt very comfortable and at home in the apartment. It was all we asked for and we looked for.

Pedro’s place is clean and in a great location in one of the most historic neighborhoods in Lisbon. Pedro also goes above and beyond to make sure you have the best stay possible at his place. au top!très accueillant et chaleureux!
n'hésitez surtout pas

As good as it gets... incredible host that picked us up at the airport and gave us a decent understanding of our surroundings. plus a bottle of wine waiting for us in a cozy and clean apartment located in the most unique and frankly the most incredible little town I've ever been... it's like another world. and Pedro's tidy respite is located in such a perfect little nook of it. Pedro's place was great - lovely location, very clean and comfortable and Pedro himself was super helpful - he even met us at the car hire place and took us to the apartment and explained everything to us. This is a wonderful place to stay to be close to the heart of Lisbon, and the apartment was clean and comfortable. Pedro was such an excellent host. He picked us up from the bus station, took us to the apartment and gave us great local tips. I highly recommend this place!

Super nice, friendly and reliable host! Location of the apartment is perfect for walking to all major sights in Lisbon! Very good quality/price ratio as well - everything necessary was there.

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour !

Rated "about the same as expected" because this was our second visit in Pedro`s apartment - wouldn`t chose another one unless not available. Beautiful stay in Alfama. The apartment was very clean and stylish, and Pedro provided great tips and maps for exploring the area. I hope to return some day!

Pedeo’s apartment is the perfect location being only 10-15 minutes walking away from most sites and museums . Our visit had a bottle of wine and some filtered water waiting for us. Not to mention Pedro was kind enough to pick us up from the airport . Awesome host and would definitely book again.

Pedro is great! He picked us up from the airport soon after we collected our checked bags. His place is clean and comfortable. We highly recommend staying with Pedro if you know you'll be staying in Alfama.
Great host, really helpful and friendly. The apartment was just as described and the perfect location to see the City. Would recommend! Thank you.

Pedro's place was great.  Everything was as advertised.  Pedro was a great host and provided good information.  He also gave me a ride from the airport to his place. Transfer vom Flughafen hat super geklappt. Zimmer etwas ringhörig aber alles sehr sauber. Kaffee, Tee, Wein und Früchte standen bereit.

Very nice apartment in the heart of Alfama, very clean and well equipped.

Pedro and his wife were good hosts. We were met at the airport and even welcomed with wine and fruit. Thank you Pedro for making our visit so enjoyable!

Charming apartment, walkable to the Alfama and very easy to the central square. Pedro’s place was sparkling clean and he was very generous to pick us up and leave us with a welcome basket when we arrived!

We had a lovely two night stay at Pedro’s place in Alfama. It is a great apartment for a stay in Lisbon with everything you need and only a short walk to the historic city centre, castel de Jorge, metro station..
Pedro is an excellent host, very helpful and was kind enough to pick us up from the airport when we arrived.
We will definitely be back to Lisbon as two days wasn’t enough!
Muito Obrigado :)

Pedro ist ein wundervoller Gastgeber... der Abholservice und das persönliche begleiten zur Wohnung ist Spitzenklasse. Espressopulver für Espressokännchen, Kekse, frisches Obst, Britta Filterbehälter uuuuund eine leckere Flasche portugiesischer Rotwein.... wir waren einfach sprachlos über so viel Gastfreundlichkeit... 2Ventilatoren sind für warme / heisse Tage sich vorhanden.

ABER nichts desto trotz war es ein wunderschöner Aufenthalt und 1. Besuch in Lissabon und werden Pedros'Whg auf jeden Fall weiter empfehlen.

Pedro was very welcoming, meeting us at the train station, helped with luggage and was very chatty. A bottle of wine and bowl of fruit were a nice touch in the clean and comfortable apartment.  Walking distance to everything.

Drei Tage Lissabon auf dem Weg von den Azoren nach Hause!

Pedro was great. The apartment was very clean. Everything was excellent !

Great location and apartment has everything needed. Pedro picked us up from the airport and was very hospitable, giving good local tips. Would recommend staying here.

Pedro’s place was super clean and right in the heart of Alfama. He was very courteous and even picked us up from the airport. If you are visiting Lisboa anytime soon, be sure to check out Pedro’s place!

The space is very comfortable and clean. Pedro gave a us great tips for getting around during our stay. He provided wine and fruits on our first day! We could not ask for a better location. Great stay.

He is responsive to questions, makes you feel at home, & will pick you up (which is nice when you’ve travelled for a long time). The place is very clean, comfortable, and decorated with love! He thinks of everything & offers tips for places to eat & visit. He could not be more helpful!!!

pedros place is lovely and he picked us up from the airport, we were very thankful for everything he and his wife did to make our stay enjoyable! they really did go above and beyond. would highly recommend, there is some noise from upstairs however it didnt bother us and they provided earplugs if it did. Pedro and his wife were amazing and the place is in a great location in alfama!
Nous avons profité d’un accueil attentionné de la part Pedro qui met à disposition de ses hôtes un appartement d’un très bon rapport qualité-prix, au cœur d’un quartier typique et plein de vie.
We had a great stay in Alfama. Pedro and his wife met us at the airport and provided transportation to the apartment. Clean and perfect for 2 people.

We had a great stay in the lovely apartment of Pedro in Lisbon. Pedro is a super nice guy. He picked us up at the airport and gave us some tipps for Lisbon. The apartment ist perfect for a city trip, very clean and well equipped. Alfama (old town of Lisbon) has a lot of narrow streets and small shops/bakeries to get basic food/drink stuff are directly around the apartment. The very city center is about 20 minutes to walk. I can definitely recommend the apartment and would come back for sure.

The host is amazing, we were picked up at the train and taken to the home, provided with recommendations and directions and the place is so stylish and in an amazing area.
Great for a couple travelling alone or with children.
Great apartment in the heart of Alfama. Spotlessly clean, well equipped and comfortable. Pedro is a welcoming, thoughtful host with many helpful suggestions. A great stay!

Sympathique petit appartement. Idéalement situé, selon nous, dans un quartier sans doute des plus typiques de Lisbonne. Proximité des transports en commun tels que le train et le bus. Les différentes attentions de Pédro pour ses hôtes rendent le séjour encore plus agréable.
Pedro’s place was perfect and he went above and beyond with hospitality. I would highly recommend!

We had a wonderful 3 night stay at Pedro's apartment. The apartment was spotlessly clean, a good size for two people and we loved the location. Pedro's a fantastic host - from picking us up at the airport, to giving local recommendations. We will definitely return and wouldn't hesitate to recommend to others. Thank you Pedro!

Pedro's place is an amazing little house in Alfama. It is in a quiet neighborhood and so long as you're comfortable to walk a little lot of the main attractions of the city can be easily reached by foot.
The pickup by Pedro was super easy and he even helped us get a cab at 3:00 am on our way back. Very generously he even kept a bottle of wine for us.
The closest metro station is a 10 min walk away and there is a small climb involved from the metro to the house. Overall loved the location and Pedro is an amazing host always available for anything.
As above

We spent 3 days in Pedro's lovely apartments. It was comfortable, very clean and had everything you would need in the kitchen although we never did any cooking.
The apartment is in the oldest part of city, we loved it but not for someone who is less mobile as there are lots of steps getting to the apartment.
Pedro collected us from the airport which was great, he was friendly and gave us some tips around the area.
The shower is cosy so you could struggle getting in and out, but everything was was lovely.
Had a brilliant time would go back when next is Lisbon.
Logement très propre et conforme à nos attentes . Nous recommandons

Everything was perfect and exactly how it was described. Pedro picked us up at the airport. Great Service!
It was clean cozy and in the beautiful Alfama. Next time in Lisbon we‘re staying at Pedros again.
A great spot in Alfama! Just a few minutes from the train station, even fewer to a terrific bakery... Pedro's hospitality was phenomenal as well.

Pedro’s place is lovely located in the heart of Alfama. He picked us up at the Airport,  perfect on time and was very helpful with our luggage. The place is clean and fully equiped, which makes this cozy appartement the perfect accomodation for your citytrip in Lisbon!

Located in the old neighborhood its an amazing location to venture out and explore Lisbon. Bairro alto is about 20-30 min walk or 5 min taxi drive from the flat. Pedro was super quick to answer to all our questions and the complimentary pick up from the airport was very nice and well organized.
Definitely recommend.

Pedro’s apartment is absolutely wonderful. Book if you have the opportunity! It’s situated in a perfect location, equipped with everything one needs and close to everything one would want to do, in the city center. Pedro and wife graciously picked us up from the airport and we so appreciated this. Thank you both for a great stay.

Pedro’s Alfama apartment is just amazing! Spotlessly clean, stylish, and fantastically located, it is everything you could want or need in the heart of the historic district of Lisbon. Pedro picked us up from the airport (!!) and even helped carry our bags. He had a map for us and suggestions for things to see/do, and was generally super helpful, nice, and professional. We would stay in this apartment again, and have no reservation giving it our highest recommendation!

Unser Aufenthalt bei Pedro hat uns sehr gut gefallen! Von Anfang bis Ende hat alles gestimmt: die Abholung vom Flughafen, die Sauberkeit und Ausstattung des Apartments, sowie die Kommunikation.
Gastfreundschaft wird in Portugal sehr groß geschrieben und das haben wir während unseres Aufenthaltes sehr genossen.

Impecable y divino el depto. Muy bien ubicado. Lo mejor, Pedro! Nos postergaron el vuelo de conexion y llegamos más tarde de lo previsto y no tuvo problemas de ir a buscarnos y darnos una calida bienvenida.

Fantastic experience - Pedros home is stylish, comfortable and has everything you could need in a great central location. Pedro is also a fantastic host, going the extra mile to collect guests at no extra cost. Would highly recommend his place and will stay again when I visit Lisbon.

De gastheer komt je halen in zijn prius en dat werkte perfect. Naast dat het je de moeite bespaart van zelf vervoer regelen is het tweede voordeel dat je meteen weet, als je oplet, hoe je bij het appartement komt.
Het is een langerekt apartement waarin je een klein zitje vindt voor 2 , dan een zitbank met tv vervolgens het bed en daarachter de keuken en badkamer. Prima te doen, maar boek het niet voor het uitziht of de ruimte. Omdat je via een smalle trap naar boven moet is het nIet geschikt voor iemand die slecht ter been is. Als je langer bent dan 185 denk ik dat je je hoofd stoot aan de douchekop als je in de douche bent. Maar de kamer is fantastisch vanwege de ligging in de wijk alfama. Tip 1 Loop de trap af naar beneden en schiet het eerste restaurant aan je rechterhand naar binnen. Prima gegeten. Loop verder en weer aan de rechterkant een klein zaakje om smorgens koffie en een broodje en flesje water te halen. Loop verder rechtdoor en kom uiteindelijk bij een slager met heerlijke ham. Dan sta je uiteindelijk bij museu do fado. Onthou die route goed, want alleen het museum weet de taxi chauffeur te staan.Loop je vanaf de museum straat richting centrum dan vind je een heel goede ijszaak en ben je zo op een van de belangrijkste pleinen van lissabon. Kortom: aanrader.
Pedro is a great host. We had the privilege to stay in his cosy old town apartment. It had everything you need and then some more. Recommended!

Pedro was a wonderful host! He picked us up from the bus station early in the morning and brought us to the apartment, which was very helpful! The apartment was very clean and had everything we needed. It was also easy to get to everything we wanted to see in Lisbon from the apartment. We had a great stay!

Pedro picked us up from the airport, gave us amazing tips about Alfama and Lisbon. He gave us fruit to welcome us in the apartment, and the apartment was very tidy/clean when we arrived. He had maps for us and gave plenty of recommendations.
The location in Alfama is part of the old town, and there are tons of stairs surrounding Alfama. This was not an issue since my Fiancé and I are fit!
There are many restaurants that offer Fado (traditional music), and the food in Lisbon was amazing!
Try the Ginja from one of the locals, it’s a great morning wake up 😉
Thank you Pedro!

Lovely flat in a good location in the old town part of Lisbon. Pedro left a few little things for us to use - shower gel, tea etc which was great. He also picked us up from the airport and drove us to the flat - this was brilliant and meant we didn’t have to worry about finding the flat or picking up keys. Thanks Pedro!

We had a fantastic stay at Pedro’s apartment. From the moment he picked us up from the airport we felt warmly welcomed. He goes the extra mile providing detailed instructions and tips to visiting sights around Lisbon. There are many shops and restaurants within walking distance. We consider ourselves lucky to have been able to book with Pedro.

We say "ditto" to everything written before us! All the little (and big) extras that Pedro provided made the stay easy/enjoyable/fantastic even in the pouring rain. The Alfama is the area everyone should experience, including the fado around the corner. Loved the apt, the services and extras provided by Pedro, the Alfama, fado and Lisbon!

Pedro’s apartment was exactly what we were looking for! It was located in a perfect spot that felt very true to Lisbon and not too touristy. There was a mixture of local bars and restaurants near the apartment as well as attractions like the Sé cathedral and the famous number 28 tram. The apartment was extremely clean and comfortable and was perfect for a couple visiting the city, with great amenities including fast WiFi.
Pedro was a great host, he picked us up from the airport despite our flight being delayed all day. The communication between Pedro and myself was very fast and any time I needed to get in touch with him he would be back in contact straight away.
I will definitely be recommending Pedro’s apartment to friends and family that are staying in Lisbon.
Hôte très agréable et sympathique.
Lovely apartment in the Alfama. Close to everything and the extra touch being picked up at Airport by Pedro.

Pedro's apartment was great! The location was walking distance to everything we wanted to do in Lisbon, and Pedro provided us with information on the local area that was really helpful. The apartment is clean, modern, and has everything you need. Pedro is quick to respond and even picked us up for the airport! I couldn't have picked a better place to stay during my short time in Lisbon!

Pedro was an excellent host - his instructions for picking us up at the airport were clear and the pick up worked a treat (it is included in the price). This was a relaxing way to start the break. The neat apartment is well located and is within walking distance of lots of great bars, restaurants and sights. Nice touches in apartment including fruit, tea, coffee, shampoo and ear plugs (for footfall in apartment above) - the area outside was very quiet. I'd recommend Pedro.

Dit appartement is ideaal voor een korte citytrip met 2 personen naar Lissabon. Pedro haalde ons op van de luchthaven, waardoor we regelrecht naar het appartement werden gebrachten en dit dus niet zelf hoefden te zoeken of aan het appartement moesten wachten op een uitleg en de sleutels. Het appartement voldoet vrij goed aan de beschrijving en de foto's op Airbnb. Bij aankomst waren er een gevulde fruitschaal en 4 pasteitjes voor ons voorzien. Dit was een heel vriendelijk gebaar en warm onthaal! Verder klopten alle voorzieningen (shampoo, föhn, handdoeken...) zoals vermeld. Enige minpunt dat ik kan bedenken omtrent dit appartement is dat er best veel lawaai te horen was van buren/mensen in het appartement erboven (voetstappen). Maar hier was duidelijk ook al aan gedacht want er waren oordopjes voorzien op de nachtkastjes.

Nous avons passé un merveilleux séjour dans le logement de Pedro. Il se situe au cœur du plus beau quartier de Lisbonne : l’Alfama. Tout est faisable à pied, l’appartement est très mignon, très cosy, propre et dispose de tout le nécessaire. Pedro est venu nous chercher à l’aéroport, nous avons été enchanté de le rencontrer. Nous recommandons chaudement ce logement et reviendrons à notre prochain voyage à Lisbonne.
Pedro is a great host and communicator. The appartment is well located, quite neigbourhood within the alive Alfama. Had a great time

Pedro's place is awesome for a visit in Lisbon. It's situated close to almost everything in the city and gives you a real Lisbon feel as it's situated in one of the pedestrian streets on the city. Be prepared for going up and down the hills as that's how Lisbon is built.
You are within 5 minutes away as walking distance from the subway, trains or busses, 10 minutes from Praça Do Comércio and 15 from the city center.
If you plan to come by or rent a car the parking is close to the train station (or at equal distance on the streets). At the train station there is a big parking space where you can leave your car unlimited (it was priced at a max. 8 euro per day). You can also find spaces on the street or in front of the Military Museum but those are limited to a 4 hour stay between 9 and 19 (worth mentioning that after 19 it's free and you can leave your car there until the morning with the same limit. For example if you arrive at 18 you can pay for two hours and this covers the interval 18 to 19 in the afternoon and 9 to 10 the next day). Be sure to check that the places are public and not reserved for people living in the area.
The apartment is very cozy. We were visiting during January and it was a bit cold but a heater was available. Also when initially presented there was for hot water a small boiler in the kitchen. I was concerned about that but both me and my wife had showers and the hot water was there.
The place is the first floor of a three story building. As the building is quite old the walls are pretty thin so you can hear your neighbors going up and down the stairs. For sleeping this might be a problem but Pedro was nice and provided ear plugs.
Pedro is an awesome host, very responsive and helpful. He picked us up at the airport and drove us to the apartment.
This is a highly recommend place and host.

Pedro was super friendly and gave us tips where to go and what to see. Apartament was clean and cosy. We found everything we needed. Location is also perfect as it is located where the locals live, but not too far from Bairo Alto (where the best restourants are) . So we felt the reall vibes of living in Lisbon. Its so much better as to stay in a hotel in my opinion. All in all it was perfect! We really recommend it.

Pedro was available for pick-up from the airport, this allowed us to have a guide to find the apt as the Alfama true to it's history has small paths leading between the homes and could easily be a place to get lost!  The apt was clean and comfortable.  We had everything we needed!  Pedro was available for questions, though none came up.  I would definitely recommend staying in this location.  We had easy access to the oldest part of the city.
A lovely appartement is a super cute neighborhood. Everything was very clear and well organized, from the pick up at the airport to the check out. I would definitely recommend staying here.
Es war super schön in der Wohnung von Pedro. Total zentral und Top Lage !!! Pedro war sehr herzlich und freundlich !

Pedro was very helpful and kind throughout the whole process. He left great instructions for picking me up at the airport and explained how all the appliances in the apartment worked. He also had maps and instructions on how to move around the neighborhood ready for me to use. Great experience with Airbnb and Pedro in Lisbon.
Perfect location and equipped with everything you need!
Very nice apartment and Pedro is incredibly welcoming by welcoming us at the train station. Definitely recommend
Très très bien situé et au calme  car aucun véhicules ne peut accéder

Thank you!! Pedro was a superb host. Was waiting for us at the airport. Excellent communicator, personable, and very helpful with orienting to Lisbon. Apartment was warm and welcoming with coffee, tea, fruit, and delicious pastries. Would highly recommend for a stay in Lisbon.
Great place to stay in Lisbon. All you will need in one place. Pedro very lovely and easy to deal with. Airport pickup an extra help to get us settled and help us with locality of stay.

Vi hade en jättebra vistelse i Pedros lägenhet och kan verkligen rekommendera att boka den! Bra läge i charmiga Alfama. Lägenheten har allt man behöver och är ren och fin. Att Pedro erbjuder fri upphämtning på flygplatsen är suveränt! Han kom också med en hel del bra tips inför våra dagar i staden. Det stod dessutom en flaska vin och väntade på oss i lägenheten, trevligt! Tveka inte att boka detta boende!
Efficient pick-up at the airport. Nice and cosy flat. Pedro was very kind and informative while driving us from the airport and showing the flat. He had even bought some Pastel de Nata for us!

Pedro fue un anfitrión inmejorable. Nos recogió en el aeropuerto y nos llevó hasta el apartamento. Nos dio información sobre la zona y sobre la ciudad y estuvo atento para proporcionarnos el mejor servicio posible. En cuanto al apartamento todo fantástico. Si vuelvo a Lisboa no dudaría en repetir.

Pedro is an excellent host; very thoughtful and helpful. The apartment is perfect - it's in a great location and has everything you need for your stay. I will definitely recommend this place to my friends and we'll be back soon I hope. Thanks Pedro!
Alfama is a nice place to stay. Would recommend the flat...nice and close to major sights. Lovely touch of pastel de natas (custard tarts) from Pedro.

Pedro is the ultimate host. From prompt pick up from the airport, he takes you to his beautiful apartment in the heart of Alfama, pointing out local coffee shops and restaurants along the way. The apartment is the perfect size for a couple, tucked back and quiet. The only thing I will mention is if you are 6ft or taller, the shower will be a tight squeeze! Everything was fantastic and Pedro even helped organize transportation to our 3am departure flight. I highly recommend staying with Pedro!

Pedro's place is located in the heart of Alfama, such a unique and quaint place. Location is excellent and apartment is compact and spotless. Had a great time and Pedro was the perfect host. Pick up from airport and pastries on arrival is a great extra. Earplugs beside the bed were appreciated from some noise of footfall from apartment above. Would recommend this apartment.
Cute location and apartment!
Great location and very cute apartment. I would reccommend this if you want to spend few days in the centre of Alfama. Pedro was a great host, very welcoming.

Pedros place was the best place we stayed at in our 6 week journey all over Europe. First he picked us up at the airport, which is a huge help. The Apartment was very clean, it had nice touches, wine and pastel de nata were left for us as a treat =) The neighborhood is very nice, it is walking distances to a bunt of local restaurants, Fado music and close to attractions and public transportation. Do not  hesitate to stay here. It will be the highlight of your trip! Valeu Pedro!!1

Pedro's apartment is in a great location in the heart of old Lisbon. It is close to restaurants and local shops and many attractions are walkable from the apartment too. Pedro was very welcoming, providing information about the local area and collecting us from the airport which was very helpful.

Ich war für ein Städtetrip mit meinem Freund in Lissabon. Pedro holte uns vom Flughafen ab, brachte uns ins Apartment und gab uns schon auf der Fahrt sowie im Apartment Tips was wir machen könnten und was wir sehen sollen.
Das Apartment war sehr sauber und gut zu erreichen.
Uns es hat es jede Menge Spaß gemacht und können Pedro als Gastgeber nur weiter empfehlen ☺️

It was my very first time in Lisbon and the wonderful Pedro picked me up from the airport. He is so kind and helpful. the apartment is in a very central location, with tons of restaurants and sights to see. i would definitely recommend staying here!!

Lugar muy bien ubicado para conocer la parte antigua de Lisboa. El Barrio es muy pintoresco. El departamento es espacioso y muy bien equipado. Pedro es un gran anfitrión que nos hizo sentir en nuestra casa.

Pedro was really Kind, thoughtful and flexible. Although we arrived a little bit earlier, he let us check in. Because of his warm welcome and kindness, i got a great Impression of Lisboa and the People in Lisboa. i truly recommend his Studio if you are going to visit Lissbon!

Toller Gastgeber und sehr schöne Wohnung im Herzen der Altstadt! :) Pedro hat uns sehr zügig nach Ankunft vom Flughafen abgeholt und zur Wohnung gefahren. Er ist viel mehr ein Freund als ein Gastgeber. Er hat uns viele Tipps für unsere Tage in Lissabon auf den Weg gegeben und uns mit einem Stadtplan und weiteren Infos in der Wohnung versorgt. Die Wohnung eignet sich perfekt für ein junges Paar! :) Bei der Ankunft gab es sogar einen Begrüßungswein, einen Früchtekorb und die bekannten Pasteis de Nata. Ein Traum! *.* Die Wohnung befindet sich direkt in der Altstadt mit nahegelegenen kleinen Restaurants mit Fado-Gesang. Wir würden auf jeden Fall wieder kommen!

Прекрасная квартира, мы остались в полном восторге. Очень хотелось в ней остаться подольше. Хозяин очень гостеприимный и приветливый. Квартира очень чистая, стильная. Всё в квартире продуманно до мельчайших деталей. Пешком можно дойти до центра города. А гулять по запутанным улочкам Альфамы одно удовольствие. От квартира в восторге - рекомендуем всем кто едет в Лиссабон - жить у Педро.
die wohnung war sehr gut beschrieben, ebenso die lage. pedro ist ein toller gastgeber und die zeit in alfama war klasse. eine buchung bei pedro können wir bestens weiterempfehlen.

Absolut perfekt! Sehr netter Gastgeber, super Wohnung. Die beste Einrichtung die wir je hatten, incl. Wasch- und Spülmaschine. Super bad. Toll gelegen mitten in Alfama. Begrüßungswein und Obst ... beste Kommunikation. Wir kommen wieder!

Excellent apartment & location. Compact but everything you need. Pedro is a great guy - collected from airport, helped with luggage & arranged taxi pick up for departure. If you want 'old' Lisbon, this place is in the heart of it.
Pedro provides above and beyond service with airport pickup! Very personable with helpful information.  Great apartment in convenient location in Alfama. Recommended!

What a great place! Pedro was fantastic from the time we booked with great clear comms about how he would meet us at the airport. A text from the baggage hall meant we met conveniently at the front. Pedro then drove us and dropped us off for some breakfast as we were well ahead of the check-in time.
After the apartment had been meticulously cleaned we were shown around and handed control!
It was great being in the heart of Amalfa living like a local. Not sure we ever got back to the apartment the same way twice but that's the joy of exploring the twisting, tiny lanes. The local patisserie was great for breakfast and the "supermarket" great value.
Everyone is so friendly in the area you cannot fail to feel at home.
Certainly recommend this as a great place to stay and experience the real heart of Lisbon! Nice and handy for our early morning train departure as well, a pleasant ten minutes stroll.

Our stay at Pedro's apartment was perfect for our visit to Lisbon. Pedro was kind enough to pick us up from the airport and gave us a mini tour as was made our way to the apartment. He had a bottle of wine and the famous egg tarts waiting for us when we arrived. We loved Alfama and the cute narrow streets. Extra amazing about our location was the cozy Fado restaurant and bar just down the street.  The apartment was also near a lot of the Lisbon's main "attractions", yet situated in a quite residential corner, away from any noise. I would highly recommend staying at Pedro's place to anyone wanting to experience Lisbon!
Pedro was a fantastic host with the free pick up service from the airport. the apartment ist absolutely cozy and located very centrally in Alfama!
Great spot, perfect location to discover the city and Pedro is just a perfect host!
This is a very nice little apartment in a fascinating neighborhood. Pedro picked us up at the airport and was very welcoming. We had a great stay here and loved Lisbon.

Had a great time at Pedro's airbnb, he personally picked us up from the airport and helped us carry our bags from the car. Apartment was very clean and cute. He also left us a bottle of wine and some portuguese treats. All in all great trip.
Appartement idéalement situé. Décoration moderne. Super cuisine. Pedro est un hôte disponible, sympathique et serviable.

Pedro (and his wife) was very nice and gentle with us: he helped us with our luggage and welcomed us in a very kind way. He also explained what to see and do in Alfama and how to use the house furniture, he let us use everything we need.
The accommodation was colourful, clean, and with enough space for two people. The position was perfect and near to the station of Santa Apolonia, but also to the beautiful and characteristic streets of the neighbourhood.
I strongly suggest that you meet Pedro and stay in his flat!

Pedro's place was fantastic! Everything was exactly as it was in all of his pictures. The location is a bit tricky to get to, but the fact that Pedro offered us airport pickup was perfect and that we didn't need to worry about finding our own way there.
Pedro himself was one of the best hosts I've ever had. He picked us up from the airport and had ample information and maps ready for us when we arrived. I would definitely stay here again.

Pedro has been the most careing and comforting host you can imagine.
Thanks Pedro for everything!

The apartment of Pedro is nice and lovely. We felt very well and secure. its located in Alfama near to the centro and to many little typical portoguie restaurants. Pedro picked us up from the airport... we were very thankful for that. Everything is well organised including the high quality of the ear plugs (very quiet location, just needed, when the neighbour ist comming late at night). in the flat we find every stuff we needed.The communication with Pedro was clear and prombt. we can recommend the apartment one hundred percent!!! uschi + norbert

Great little place in the middle of old town Alfama. Pedro is super welcoming and even picked us up from the airport. Flat has everything you need and comes with some nice welcome touches. Definitely recommend to anyone!

Pedro holte uns pünktlich beim vereinbarten Treffpunkt am Flughafen ab. Supernett, superfreundlich und sehr zuvorkommend. Das Appartement im Alfama ist sehr stylisch eingerichtet mit viel Liebe zum Detail. Auch die Gegend ist ein  guter Ausgangspunkt für Erkundungen. Sehr ursprünglich, viel Charme, viel Fado.
Pedro was a brilliant host, he walked with us from the train station to the apartment and helped us with any questions we had. The apartment was awesome, a true Alfama experience!

I rented this apartment for my parents who decided last minute not to show up. Pedro was more than accompanying. He was communicative and understanding. Originally, he was going to pick up my parents and Pedro kept communicating with me throughout even though I was also in another country myself. I can't say more positive things about Pedrp than this. Although he didn't host my parents per say, he was more than a wonderful host.

We stayed 3 nights  at Pedro's place and loved it. Everything was just as described and seen on the pictures. Pedro picked us up at the airport, which was really nice and comfy. He even had Natas, wine and fresh fruit for us. The apartment was really clean and had everything needed. We would absolutely recommend this apartment and surely come back.
We had a great time at Pedros apartment. Its located in the heart of Alfama with lots of lovely restaurants around. Pedro was a very helpful and kind host! We definitely would come a second time!

Pedro est un hôte parfait! Malgré un retard de plus d'une heure de notre vol, il était là pour nous cueillir à l'aéroport. Petits cadeaux de bienvenue à l'entrée dans les lieux et suggestions très utiles. Merci Pedro!!

Pedro is fantastic! He picked us up from the airport, gave us tips and pointers for getting around alfama and Lisboa. And he even welcomed us with wine and pastries! He also helped us out with ordering a cab for our early morning flight! His place is in a wonderful location of Alfama, you can hear fado being sung around at many restaurants. His place is beautiful and has everything you can need inside during your stay!

The highlight of this apartment has to be both the location and the personal touches from Pedro. The alfama district is by far the most authentic, traditional area of Lisbon with narrow, winding streets and lots of ambience and Fado bars!
Pedro and his wife were amazing.. it really took the stress out of arriving in a foreign place to know that Pedro was picking us up. He left wine, fruit, local products and basic essentials for us which made all the difference.
The apartment isn't big but is perfect for two people for a few days.. there are even English channels on the tv if you have time!
The only people I wouldn't recommend this place to is people with walking difficulties due to the location.
Pedro.. we can't thank you enough for such a warm welcome!
Pedro is the best!

Pedro ist ein top Gastgeber. Die Kommunikation hat einwandfrei funktioniert und die Wohnung ist sehr sauber. Viele kleine Details -wie die Pasteis de Nata oder das Obst zur Begrüßung- haben den Aufenthalt besonders angenehm gemacht. Die Lage der Wohnung ist optimal und sie ist dennoch ruhig.
Ein perfekter Gastgeber und eine tolle Unterkunft im Zentrum von Alfama. Wir wurden sogar vom Flughafen abgeholt. Alles in allem ein gelungener Aufenthalt in Lissabon.
Pedro was a fantastic host who welcomed us to his lovely apartment. Very clean, tidy and had everything you need. Absolutely would recommend! Thanks Pedro!

Pedro's flat is very nicely decorated and very very clean. He provides toiletries and kitchen products which is very helpful. We left us wine, tarts and fruit which was so nice and a lovely start to our trip.
He was very friendly and warm and gave us lots of advice on Lisbon. He was also available for questions after check-in.
The area is beautiful. The flat was very quiet at night which was great. It is close by lots of lovely bars and restaurants in alfama. I would highly recommend staying with Pedro. The airport pick up is a great addition and takes the stress out of finding the place.
Logement très agréable, à conseiller vivement. Pédro est très disponible et a été facilement joignable dès que nous sommes arrivés à Lisbonne.

This quaint, yet modern apartment was in complete contrast to the historic setting of the Alfama district. The location was perfect, with neighborhood restaurants and markets. This hillside village was the perfect setting for our visit to Lisboa. Fado music filled the air each evening and the water way was only a short walk away. We gladly recommend Pedro's hospitality!

Pedro's apartment was a great place for exploring Lisbon, located right in the heart of Alfama. He collected us at the airport and was very helpful with directions, maps, recommendations etc. The apartment itself was spotless, with a comfy bed and everything you could need - although we ate out most of the time this would be a great place if you wanted to self-cater, as there is a fridge, freezer, oven, hobs... well equipped! Although it seems tucked away, there are lots of places to eat and drink close by and it's a short walk to tram stops, the castle and a great viewpoint across the river. We had no trouble with noise at any point and the only thing I would say to prospective guests is that the stairs are very steep (but only one floor up) so perhaps not so good if you have mobility problems. Communication was always prompt and everything went very smoothly. Thanks for a lovely stay Pedro!
Cute apartment in Alfama! Pedro and his wife were super helpful and sweet! Thanks for having us!
In the middle of the beautiful Alfama coast! Location is amazing and Pedro was a wonderful host accommodating our check in and showing us around. Would love to be able to stay here again!

Very cozy apartment. Everything is there in the apartment to stay for a longer time (stove, washing machine, coffee machine, laundry machine,...). Pedro, the owner, is a super friendly and hospitable guy. We couldn't imagine a warmer welcome to Portugal!
Great location to old lisbon. Bars restaurants close. Easy walk to metro. Great pickup ser ice from station. Gr8 welcome gifts
Sød og venlig vært. Dejligt at blive hentet i lufthavnen. Fin lille lejlighed i et utrolig hyggeligt kvarter.

Amazing place for 2 people, right in the heart of Alfama. Tucked away, so it's still quiet without a ton of foot traffic, but still right there and walkable to everything. Excellent host and we really appreciated the pickup from the airport. Good communication and provided a lot of helpful info. Highly recommended!

Pedro picked us up at the airport and got us settled. Apartment was as described and very clean. The welcome wine, custard tarts and fruit was thoughtful and appreciated. Loved the location which is very lively at night but the apartment is very quiet. The apartment is not air conditioned but it was not a problem for us. Access may be problematic if mobility is an issue - but that is the nature of Alfama. Recommended.

Pedro's place is in the historic district, on a secluded street inaccessible to cars. The apartment is a smallish one bedroom that is utterly immaculate and extremely well furnished. The location is perfect for walking to the commercial district, which is a little less than mile away, and to getting to the train station, which is about a half mile. The streets are safe at night, and there are plenty of little restaurants to try out nearby, but all the best upscale stuff (if that's your thing) is in the Commercial District. I'd advise you to take Pedro's offer to pick you up from the airport so he can show you how to get to the house the first time—he also suggested some great restaurants while we had him in the car, so that's a great resource to have on your first day in Lisbon.

Pedro was very friendly and accomendating. It was a very great gesture of him to pick us up from the airport.
The apartment was small but cozy and had all the utilities we needed. Would recommend this place to family and friends!

Pedro was very kind and accommodating. He picked us up from the airport and pick up went smoothly. We arrived in the middle of the fiesta of San Antonio which was in Alfama city center. Even if our place was very near the celebration, we did not get bothered by the noise. I would recommend Pedro's place.

Wir sind mit Baby gereist und waren sehr dankbar für den pick-up service, der einwandfrei funktioniert hat. Sogar ein Babybett und einen Babystuhl hatte Pedro uns bereit gestellt. Das Appartement ist sehr sauber, stilvoll und gut ausgestattet. Pedro war ein exzellenter Gastgeber während unseres Aufenthalts und stets zur Hilfe bei all unseren Belangen.

Pedro was a charming and welcoming host.  He met us centrally and showed us to the apartment which was very helpful.  The apartment is in a wonderful position in the centre of the Alfama district.  It was immaculate, well equipped and artistically decorated.  Pedro made us feel welcome and provided a large dish of fruit and s delicious bottle of wine which we enjoyed with our friends.

Wir verbrachten die erste Juniwoche in Lissabon. Überaus angenehm und erleichternd empfanden wir, dass unser sehr sympathische Host Pedro uns zuverlässig pünktlich vom Flughafen abholte, uns bereits auf der Fahrt nützliche Informationen gab und uns mit vorbereitetem Obst, Gebäck und einer Flasche Wein in der Wohnung überraschte. Die Wohnung selber liegt ideal im Herzen des Stadtteiles Alfama. Sie ist sauber, sehr gut ausgestattet und geschmackvoll eingerichtet. Es ist zugegebenermaßen eine Altbauwohnung mit speziellen Details wie z.B. einer extrem steilen Aufgangstreppe , aber charmant, wenn man wie wir keine Probleme damit hat. Wir haben es sehr genossen, direkt von der Haustür in kürzester Zeit zu namhaften Sehenswürdigkeiten zu Fuß gelangen zu können.
Insgesamt können wir diese Wohnung und den Service unseres Gastgebers sehr empfehlen.

Staying at Pedro's is simply perfect, from the moment he picked us up from the airport to the moment we checked out, he was the perfect host. The apartment is modern and truly impeccably clean, with all the amenities we could imagine for cooking and cleaning, and really felt like a second home for us. He surprised us with fresh fruit and two glasses to share an excellent wine, provided us with a very helpful map of the city, a collection of helpful published guides, and even gave us directions to a great commuter luggage locker for our next adventure in Lisboa the next day. Pedro's place is ideally and centrally located in Alfama, close to the Rua Sao Miguel, where Fado can be heard in the warm neighborhood in the evenings. The neighbors are very friendly and warm and the neighborhood is very diverse and very safe. We were here for a short stay on the way to Greece, and it was the perfect little retreat for us.  We would most definitely stay at Pedro's again. Thank you, Pedro!

We were very fortunate to book this apartment. Pedro waited to pick us up from the airport even though the flight was delayed an hour. On the drive to the apartment Pedro was very friendly and gave us many tips and information to help with our stay in Lisbon. We arrived feeling very confident and relaxed for our stay in Alfama. Staying 5 days meant we had time to enjoy the local area for morning coffee and very addictive Portuguese Tarts. The apartment was perfect, all the conveniences of home, great location, large enough for us to relax and a joy the local atmosphere. Trams, trains and the main sights are within walking distance. We highly recommend staying at Pedro's apartment.

Pedro was a wonderful host. He even picked us up from the train station and drove us to the apartment. The apartment was clean and had all the amenities you would need. It's located in the charming district of Alfama.
Great location in the Alfama.  It was wonderful being picked up at the airport and the apartment in very clean.  The place is small but perfectly adequate for two people.  Pedro was a great host.

Pedro's home in Alfama is a beautiful, quaint and authentic neighborhood in Lisbon.  It's super walkable to everywhere.  The home, while small, has everything you would need!  Pedro was kind enough to greet us at the airport and drive us to the house, show us how to use everything and answer our questions.  I highly recommend!

Lugar ótimo, boa localização, típico da Alfama. Apartamento limpo, confortável e funcional. Pedro é uma ótima pessoa, atencioso e chegar em Lisboa com alguém nos aguardando foi uma experiência muito especial. Obrigada Pedro!

This is a wonderful apartment in the most interesting part of Lisbon.  The apt was well equipped, clean and fresh.  Getting a free airport pick up was the icing on the cake as well as the wine and fruit on arrival. The wifi was fast and dependable.  I was able to explore Lisbon pretty much on foot.  There are markets, cafes and restaurants close by.  It is an easy walk to the train station where you can get a metro to the airport for 1.95 Euro.  I had a wonderful stay here.

The studio is very well equipped and comfortable and is in the heart of a lovely neighbourhood, full of friendly bars and restaurants. It is also within a few minutes' walk of the city centre for the sights and transport links to other areas.
Pedro is an excellent host and helped us with collection at the airport even though we were well ahead of normal check-in time. Highly recommended.

Bien ubicado en el
Barrio de Alfama. Pedro nos recogió en el aeropuerto. Eso facilitó llegar al apartamento. Una vez que te ubicas es fácil llegar. Encontramos una botella de vino tinto, unas fresas y unos paStelillos de nata, tipicos de Lisboa. En la esquina hay un restaurant que hacen un buen bacalao a la bras y unos camarones deliciosos, mientras escuchamos fado. Cerca de la estación Apolonia (unos 10 minutos caminando). Y también muy cerca del tranvía 28, qué pasa por la Catedral. Muy recomendable. El lugar limpio, con todos los servicios, la cama cómoda. Ducha chica, supongo que estilo europeo.

Formidable séjour - appartement tout équipé avec même la corbeille de fruit et la bouteille de vin de bienvenue !
En sus comme promis Pedro nous attendait à la gare pour nous emmener en voiture! Le rêve quoi....

Pedro est un hôte très aimable et accueillant. Nous avons passé un très bon séjour au calme dans son appartement au cœur du quartier Alfama. C'était un plaisir d'avoir pu découvrir un lieu charmant en bas de la rue pour le petit déjeuner avec de très bonnes choses et de se promener dans ce très joli quartier! Le centre historique est accessible à pied, la gare et la station de métro est près de l'appartement aussi. Nous recommandons!
logement parfait propre et confortable........
Lovely small apartment in a great location.
Pedro is a fantastic host who went out of his way to make our stay enjoyable! The apartment is very nice and very well located! We'll definitely stay with Pedro again on our next visit!

My husband and I spent 2 nights at Pedro's flat, it was our first trip to Lisbon and we are so happy we chose to stay here for it! Pedro was an amazing host, he picked us up from the airport despite flight delays and was incredibly friendly. The flat was in the middle of Alfama and we loved the neighbourhood - lots of restaurants and shops. The flat itself had everything we needed and was so nice, Pedro thought of everything and even gave us fruit and wine! Loved staying here and will definitely be back.

When it's about location, location, location. This one's hitting the jackpot. In the heart of Alfama, but quiet.
The apartment is really clean and well equipped.
Once you are there, you understand why Pedro picks you up from the apartment: not an easy place to find on your own. Pedro is nice, and the only negative thing I can think of is that the shower is a bit small. So: highly recommended!
Tips:
there is a rather good supermarket in the Apolonia trainstation.
Tram 28 is nice, of course. The 12 en 15 are less crowded and also nice.
Graca is a nice neighbourhood to explore if you want to see less people like yourself (tourists)

Pedro très sympa et disponible,il nous a récupéré à l'aéroport pour nous conduire au domicile qui était conforme à la description avec un super accueil (coupe de fruits frais,bouteille de vin et pasteis excellent),de bons conseils pour la visite de la ville qui est magnifique.Merci Pédro

Pedro's appartment is a wonderful hidden place right in the middle of Alfama, the most authentic and least touristic neighbourhood of Lisbon, with all the hot spots in walking distance. Pedro is a fantastic host, he picked us up from the airport and welcomed us with fresh fruit and pasteis. The appt is clean, spacious but cosy, very private and with everything you need. We would definately stay here again! Do note that the bed's perfect for lovers, but maybe a little too small for friends (140cm)😉

Well equipped apartment close walking distance to plenty of restaurants, shops, fado clubs, markets, historic sights, etc.  Pedro was super nice and picked us up from the train station and helped with the luggage and went above and beyond and took us back to train after our stay was over. He was so informative and kind. Highly recommend this apartment! Its quiet and has everything you will need to stay comfortably.
Pedro was a great host, he made us feel very welcome and even picked us up and dropped us off at the airport, the apartment was great and clean and we really enjoyed Lisbon!

Pedro was so welcoming, he picked us up from the airport and we had fruit and pastries waiting for us at the apartment
It was a very comfortable apartment and easily accessible to local bars and restaurants
Not great if you have any mobility issues however so bear that in mind of booking
All in all we had a lovely stay in Alfama in Pedro's home 😄

We loved our stay in Pedro's apartment.  Pedro was very prompt with any questions/issues before the trip and the airport pick up was great as he could give us the lay of the land.  The apartment is spacious for 2 and has very nice amenities, it's very functional and he included tons of kitchen stuff which we didn't use but I'm sure others did.  He welcomed us with delicious pastries and fruit and gave us some tips of restaurants.
