The apartment below his is being renovated now so the workmen were somewhat chatty in the morning but that is no fault of Pedro or the apartment and it really didn't impact our stay.  It was also very conveniently located, we loved being in the Amalfa district.  Thanks again for a great couple of days!

Pedro's apartment was in a great location, walkable to a lot of the main sights. The apartment had everything you could wish for and the bed was very comfortable. Pedro even met me at the airport which makes the start of your break so much more relaxing. I would definitely stay here again.

Pedro's apartment is in the perfect area. Easy, 15-20 minute walk into the historical center, while being able to stay in one of the unique and interesting areas of Alfama! We so enjoyed roamed around the narrow alleys in Alfama and discovering cute shops and markets. You will find several restaurants very close to the apartment to experience the lovely Fado music as well. When we return to Lisbon we would stay in Alfama and with Pedro.
Our host picked us up at the airport and upon arrival we had a nice bottle of wine and a beautiful plate of fresh fruit. What a welcome! Pedro was also kind enough to arrange early, Sunday morning transport back to the airport.
Pedro`s apartment is excelent. It is well located and has everything you need for an axcellent stay in Libon. I do recommend.

A comunicação com o Pedro foi muito boa .Ele foi pessoalmente nos buscar na estação de trem e nos recebeu com uma garrafa de vinho e frutas .O apartamento tem ótimas instalações e tudo que se precisa para uma estadia em Lisboa .Alfama e um bairro na cidade alta então é bom saber que há ladeiras e escadas sobretudo por causa da bagagem.No entanto o local e perto da estação de metrô Apolónia que nos leva aos principais locais de Lisboa .Recomendo a propriedade e elogio a hospitalalidade do anfitrião .

Greatly appreciated getting picked up at the airport by Pedro. It would have been a challenge finding the appartement on our own. Pedro was a charming host, eager to help. We loved  living among the locals in the Alfama district of Lisbon.

Merci à Pedro pour son acceuil chaleureux ! Appartement complètement conforme à la description !
Nous reviendrons !
Merci à Pedro pour son accueil. Appartement cosy, très bien entretenu et parfaitement situé. Endroit parfait pour passer un très bon  week-end sur Lisbonne.

Nos hemos quedado cuatro días en el apartamento de Pedro y hemos tenido una estancia magnífica.
La acogida de Pedro ha sido inmejorable: nos recogió en el aeropuerto y no acompañó hasta el apartamento. Allí encontramos una botella de vino y fruta, lo mismo que lo necesario para desayunar.
El apartamento está muy bien situado cerca del metro y a 15 minutos andando del centro. El Barrio nos encantó por su tranquilidad y tipos móviles.
Hemos tenido una estancia muy agradable y Pedro ha sido un anfitrión excepcional.
Pedro was great. He picked us up from the airport and dropped us at the apartment. He was really helpful at first then left us to do our own thing, which was perfect. 10/10!
Pedro was an amazing host who was very helpful and he even picked us up from the airport! Definitely recommend his place
Pedros apartment was very nice and cosy. We felt very well there. Pedro was also a very nice host and we wood definitly come back again.

Pedro ' s apartment is right in Alfama, which is an amazing place, take note of surroundings you can get lost easily. The apartment is comfortable, clean and well equipped. Pedro even picked me up from airport which was very appreciated. The apartment is clean and has everything you need. Would recommend to anyone who wants to get a real feel for Lisbon.
Excellent séjour et super accueil. Merci Pedro !!!

Pedro picked us up from the Airport and was Kind from the first second. He told us where to find things and the communication was easy and on point. The Apartment is very close to the center of the city and you can walk everywhere from there. It is really nice if you want to See and experience the beautiful City of lisbon.

Alfama is a lovely, historic part of Lisbon and Pedro's small apartment is the perfect place to stay. The apartment is tucked away in the hills of Alfama with delicious restaurants and cafes within walking distance. Pedro was an excellent host and was flexible with our travel plans. Highly recommend!

Pedro is an excellent host. He went an extra mile to find a car seat to pick us up from the airport and was willing to let us check out late when there was an opportunity.  The apartment is clean, comfortable and well equipped, especially in the kitchen with coffee, tea, etc and a big bowl of fresh fruits. The neighbourhood is romantic although hilly and we live among locals. We like it so much. We highly recommend staying at Pedro's apartment to explore this area of town. Thank you, Pedro!

To live in the old town of Lisboa was wonderfull. It's just amazing to walk trough those small streets and meet all these great people, to buy your bread there and get the feeling like you can experience the life in this great city. The small appartment was really nice. Everything was clean and nicely decorated. Pedro was incredibly polite, nice and helpful. We also thought, that's great to have everything important inside the appartment coffee, tea, sugar, spices, washing powder, etc. It also takes just a short time to reach all the important places and the public transport. I have to say, that Lisboa has something for everyone and for sure this wasn't our last travel to Portugal. Kind regards, Inge and Jean-Mark

We had a brilliant stay at Pedro's apartment, the location is really handy and the place is lovely. Pedro provided some really nice touches, we were well set up and everything was thought of. Highly recommended!

Pedro is a wonderful host. He picked us up at the airport. The house is really beautiful, in the heart of Alfama, small but with everything you need. Before and after our stay, Pedro took care of us. Definitely we will go back.

Pedro was a great host! He picked us up from the airport and brought us to the apartment straight and gave us good recommendations on getting around the neighborhood. The apartment itself is also very cozy and located in a quiet street in the middle of Alfama. The location is perfect for exploring Alfama and old historic center. I would recommend this place to anyone who is looking for a more local experience in Lisbon.

Everything went great; Pedro picked us up at the airport and was very flexible when we had to take a different flight due to a strike. The apartment was modernized and clean, and we had a very nice stay in the middle of Alfama. Can highly recommend!

Pedro's place was perfect for exploring Lisbon - within walking distance of the city center, public transportation, and numerous restaurants and bars.  The apartment was very clean and well-equipped.  Highly recommend.

Our stay in Pedros apartment in Lisbon was perfect! The apartment is very nice with all amenities and the location is superb. You cannot find a better host than Pedro, he picked us up from the airport, informed us about everything and took excellent care of us. I really really recommend!

Pedro and his flat were just fantastic. Pedro insisted on picking us up from the station so we didn`t have to find the flat on our own, and I could see why: it`s beautifully located in the midst of the romantic cobbled alleys that make Alfama so charming, in one of those houses I`ve so often looked at from the outside (4th visit to Lisbon) and thought I wish I could live here even just for one week.

What impressed us most was how well equipped the flat was. We usually need to go for a big shop first, and we expect it, but there was coffee (Nescafe Dolce Gusto machine!!!!), Tea, milk and sugar, shower gel and shampoo, washing detergent and even those really thoughtful little things such as a fruit bowl, a printed Google map showing us what`s nearby and how to get back to the flat, and earplugs by the bedside, if you really consider people laughing and saying good morning to each other noise. I found it charming, and if anything, helped to wake us up, as the shutters sure shut out any disturbing light that there is.

Flat is exactly what you are looking at in the pictures. Clean, bright, charming, amazingly well stocked yet not cluttered. Would have happily stayed for two weeks. WiFi is excellent.

There is a little bench outside the house, which we sat on sipping our first morning coffee, just because we could, and Pedro insisted in showing us the washing machine, and we ran a wash and put it out by the window - once again, just because we could.

Restaurants are so close you can smell them as soon as you turn the corner, and there are life Fado performances at night. You certainly don`t have to walk far to experience the best of Lisbon. 15 mins walk in either direction to get more central, and there are two metro stations close by. No parking, but you really don`t need a car if you are able bodied. Lisbon is an amazing place to discover on foot.

We`ll be back to Lisbon again, and will definitely check out Pedro`s flat first.
Recommend 100%.

Pedro's place was the most perfect place for our stay in Lisbon. He was able to get is upon our arrival which was super handy. The location of the apartment could not be beat. Close to restaurants, Fado, little markets and the city centre. We loved our stay in Alfama and were disappointed we didn't have longer. The apartment was just as advertised. Clean, comfortable and more than enough space for two of us. We hope on coming back to Lisbon and hope we can stay here during that time too.

A beautiful, sunny, comfortable flat, with Fado restaurants within a few minutes' walk. Pedro was very welcoming, and offered a free pick-up from the station, as well as fruit, tea, coffee and other essentials. The flat was very clean and well-equipped. A perfect place to stay when visiting Lisbon, and I hope to be back!

The apartment is beautiful, super clean, perfectly equipped and situated in the nice district of Alfama. Downtown is a nice walk of abt. 15 minutes away. Pedro is a very nice person and the airport pick up was perfect. We enjoyed our stay and would of course come again.

Pedro came to meet us at the airport and take us to the apartment which was amazing and a great introduction to Lisbon. Pedro helped us with lots of advice, travel , locations and places to go.
The apartment was exactly as advertised. Amenities in the apartment were great.
Thank you again Pedro what a great host.

We had a fantastic stay at Pedro's Airbnb.
He kindly picked us up from the airport and took us to the apartment, which was really lovely and extremely clean.
Pedro provided fruit, tea and coffee as well which made our stay all the most comfortable.
The apartment is in a great part of Alfama, a short walk from a metro station and easily accessible by buses and trams.
Thanks so much Pedro - we would definitely recommend staying here and will do ourselves if we are ever back in Lisbon!

Perfect location in beautiful part of Town. Pedro gave us a great welcome. Lovely characteristic and cosy appartement. All details (decoration, shampoo, fruit, babybed ready for use) were right, showing the caring hands of the owners! Thank you!

Pedro could not have made us feel more welcome, picking us up at the airport early in the morning and driving us to his beautiful apartment in the Alfama neighborhood--a unique & relatively ungentrified part of Lisbon. In addition to orienting us to the city, he gave us tips on local spots in the neighborhood. We loved especially the bakery and the fado restaurant around the corner--don't miss either one. Our only regret is that we didn't stay longer...and we hope to return to Pedro's place someday.

Pedro is an excellent host.  He went out of his way to make our stay comfortable and was prompt in answering questions.  The apartment is very comfortable and has all the necessities one needs. It is in a good location, close to wonderful restaurants and the sights of Alfama.
Pedro was a great, helpful host. He was able to give us a ride from the airport to the apartment which was much appreciated. The apartment was very comfortable.

Pedro is a great host and his apartment flawless. Central, cost, clean and lovely. We've had a great stay in Lisbon and the apartment was one of the reasons it was so great. P from picked us up at the airport and was very helpful at check in. Even when a small problem occurred during Saturday night he was quick to reply and tried his best to solve it. A great host and an amazing place to stay!

Pedro picked us up at the airport, he was very nice and well organised. The location in Alfama was great, we walked everywhere. The apartment was clean and well equipped. Only downsides: The bed was a little uncomfortable and the bathroom smelled pretty bad.

Pedro was a great host and extremely helpful; from picking us up at the airport through to helping us catch our train at the end of our stay. The apartment was spotlessly clean and perfectly located for exploring Lisbon. We had a lovely stay!

Thank you for a wonderful stay. Perfect location in Alfama, it felt submerged in the old town but only a 10 minutes walk from the center, and 5 minute walk from the train station (which also has bag storage if you need it). Pedro helpfully picked me up and was a lovely and friendly host. The apartment was great, clean with all the amenities/facilities you would need. I would definitely stay here again!

Pedro is a really nice and friendly host who took us from the car rental place to the apartment.
The apartment is very well located in Alfama (you will hear fado in the evening from the nearby restaurants) and everything is in walking distance. The apartment was clean and nice, very well equipped with everything you may need, the only weak point is the bathroom. The air circulation in the bathroom doesn't work well (and there is no window to open), so it had a very bad smell. Also the bath tray was not in great condition. These are small things, didn't ruin our stay in Pedro's apartment, but should be replaced for bigger comfort.
It was a great experience overall!

Merci à Pedro pour son accueil, jolie appartement bien décoré et fonctionnel.
Le quartier est super!
Nous recommandons vivement ce logement.

We had a wonderful time in Lisboa for 2 days, the flat was perfect, very well located and Pedro was so helpful. Communication was really easy and Pedro gave us some advice on restaurants in the neighborhood!

Our stay at Pedro's was great: the location was central to restaurants and transportation, the apartment was neat and clean (just as pictured), and Pedro was a very helpful host. He picked us up from the airport, gave us tons of recommendations and maps to use, and was very friendly.
We had a great stay and highly recommend his place!

A great little apartment in a great location. It was spotless and well stocked with everything you could need (especially the coffee pods which were a life saver in the morning!). Pedro was the perfect host; picking us up and giving us lots of information about Lisboa. We loved our stay here and would definitely come back!

Pedro war ein super Gastgeber. Er hat uns pünktlich vom Flughafen abgeholt und uns sehr gute Tipps für unseren Aufenthalt gegeben.  Es hat alles reibungslos geklappt. Der Stadtteil ist ein Traum - enge steile Gassen und ein viele Einheimische. Es ist ein belebter Stadtteil und das sollte man in seine Urlaubsplanung mit einbeziehen.

Thank you for a great stay!
Pedro picked us up at the train station and was really helpful explaining the apartment and the area. Nice apartment, with all eqipment that you would need. Apartment kept cool even during the very hot summer days. Loved Lisbon. Would absolutley recomend.
We had a warm welcome by Pedro.  Nice to be picked up at the airport. And the appartment was nice and very clean. Perfekt stay. Thanks to Pedro

Pedro was an amazing host! He picked us up at the airport and despite taking an hour at Customs, he waited patiently for us outside. He gave us a tour/explanation of Lisbon attractions on our way to the apartment and then helped us with our bags up to the apartment. Because he didn't have a booking before ours, he let us in early. He explained everything we would need to know about the apartment and showed us some good spots to eat. He even left us some bottled water for the hot weather!

The apartment was awesome! Exactly as pictured, very clean. The neighborhood is very quiet but steps away from bars and restaurants.

Pedro was amazing! Not only did he have an awesome apartment in a perfect location, he even picked us up from the airport! Pedro left us fully equipped with maps and highlighted some must see spots while on our trip. Everything was within walking distance which was great. I highly recommend staying in Alfama for a unique experience of Lisbon.  Pedro for the win!
Perfect location. Organised host. Clean apartment. Overall a great airbnb experience.

We had a lovely time in Pedro's cosy Alfama appartment. Everything in the appartment is exactly like what you see in the pictures on airbnb. The appartment is very clean. Pedro is an attentive en punctual host, he makes sure you have everything you need. The pick up from the airport is great. We really liked the neighbouring Graça area, just a few minutes uphill. Just make sure you bring your walking shoes and you have a great time in Alfama / Graça!

Pedro has a wonderful apartment great for seeing Lisbon. The  apartment has everything that you could ask for and is in a great location. It is right is the old part of Lisbon and is only a 5 minute walk from the train station and the metro. Pedro was one of the most helpful and considerate  hosts I've had with my airbnb's. I recommend staying at either of his rooms for anyone thinking of visit.
We had a wonderful time! The house is well located in Alfama which is one of the most interesting neighbouhood. Pedro was a pefect host! He picked us up at the airport and offered us fruits and wine!

Pedro was an excellent host! He and his wife came to pick us up from the airport when our flight arrived and helped us get our luggage to the apartment.
The apartment itself is very clean and well-stocked. The location is great, right in the heart of Alfama. Pedro was very easy to contact and made us feel welcome in Lisbon. I would definitely recommend this apartment and would absolutely stay there again!
Thank you Pedro!!
Very cool apartment in old city center.
Cute little place in the historic streets of Lisbon. Great place, great host, great value.

Nos encantó el apartamento nada más entrar. Es muy luminoso, limpio y acogedor, y Pedro tuvo el amable detalle de dejarnos fruta fresca, café y tés para tomar, además de otros productos para el baño, lo cual se agradece muchísimo.

El piso tiene muy buena situación, el barrio de Alfama es precioso y en 15 minutos caminado estás en la plaza del Comercio.

Pedro estuvo siempre disponible y nos orientó en lo que le preguntamos. Nos vino a buscar al aeropuerto e incluso nos guardó las mochilas durante unas horas (aterrizamos muy temprano y los anteriores clientes todavía no habían hecho el chek out).

Nos sentimos muy bien en este lugar y lo recomendamos a otros viajeros :)

Pedro est quelqu'un de très serviable et aimable. Il est venu nous récupérer à l'aéroport même après notre retard d'atterrissage.
L'appartement est en tout point conforme aux photos. Très propre avec tout le nécessaire. Une corbeille de fruits nous attendait. Ordinateur à disposition.
Le quartier est animé.

Our experience at Pedro's Alfama apartment was second to none. It began with his greeting us at the airport and providing a complimentary transfer into his apartment in the centre of Lisbon. Once we arrived, we were welcomed with a lovely bottle of wine a fresh bowl of fruit and a fully outfitted apartment with everything we needed. The Alfama district is absolutely one-of-a-kind. Within a few short steps of the apartment were beautiful shops, quaint pastelaria, where we shopped for our daily pastry, and an interesting selection of outstanding restaurants, including the famed Fado restaurants. When you venture beyond the Alfama, Lisbon is literally at your feet. We could not have been more delighted with our experience at Pedro's apartment! Thank you Pedro for offering us your home we look forward to visiting again soon!

My partner and I had a wonderful stay in Pedro's apartment. The apartment was tidy, impeccably clean, with great facilities which exceeded our expectations. It is excellently located in beautiful Alfama, which is a short walk away from many popular tourist attractions. Pedro was a fantastic host. He picked us up from airport and gave us helpful recommendations of places to eat and visit. I would highly recommend his apartment and would love to stay there again whenever I return to Lisbon.
Pedro is amazing host, he pick up me and my gf from the airport and the appartement is very nice, we really enjoyed our stayed.

Ci siamo trovati benissimo.
L'accoglienza e la disponibilità di Pedro sono stati eccellenti.
Il posto è carino, silenzioso ed estremamente funzionale in un quartiere molto caratteristico di Lisbona, a pochi passi dalla Metro.
Veramente molto contenti.

Antonio & Marta

Pedro ist ein toller und liebenswürdiger Gastgeber, der uns sogar vom Flughafen abgeholt hat. Er brachte uns in die Wohnung und zeigte uns alles und gab uns tolle Tipps. Wir fühlten uns sehr gut aufgehoben und haben uns in seiner Wohnung wie zuhause gefühlt. Die Wohnung ist genau so gemütlich wie auf den Bildern. Und die Lage der Wohnung war fabelhaft. Wenn wir zwischendurch Fragen hatten, hat Pedro sehr schnell und informativ darauf reagiert. Wir würden jederzeit wiederkommen und die Unterkunft auch anderen empfehlen! Vielen lieben Dank für alles, Pedro!

We really enjoyed our stay at Pedro's appartment in Alfama. The appartment had everything we needed and the area where it is located is really nice. There even was a basket with fresh foods awaiting us when we arrived. Pedro is a great host. He picked us up from the airport, helped us with our luggage, and explained everything we needed/wanted to know about the appartment and the city of Lisbon. There was some construction work going on in the street during our stay (Pedro told us that they were building a school). However, this did not bother us and Pedro kindly provided us with earplugs in case we wanted to sleep in.

Bonne accueil de la part de Pedro qui est venu nous chercher a l'aéroport.
Le logement est propre, par contre absence totale de vue comme ne le montre pas la photo par la seule fenêtre qui donne sur un mur. Des grands travaux immobilier vous réveillent a 8H le matin.
Le séche serviette ne fonctionne pas.
Je me suis retrouvé les pied dans l'eau en vidant l'évier..
Le lit grince comme pas permis.
Absence totale insonorisation voisin du dessus et porte palière. Vous entendez tout sans y être!!
Le chauffe-eau fait 30l pour 2 pers.???

Pedro made us feel welcome. He kindly picked us up at the airport and took us to the apartment. He explained everything fully to us and left us with generous supplies of fruit , coffee etc. The apartment is in the middle of the old town, tall old buildings and narrow cobbled streets.

Pedro responded promptly to all emails, and he was waiting for us when we came out of the airport.  He escorted us all the way to the apartment, even carrying my suitcase for me!  Pedro provided many thoughtful extras in the apartment itself, like plenty of Keurig coffee pods, big paper napkins, and a huge bowl of fruit.  The apartment itself is very comfortable, with excellent wifi, a fine bed, and a good shower.  It's location, too, was perfect--quiet, residential and within charming walking distance of all major attractions.  I can't think of any way in which Pedro could have improved upon our experience in Lisbon.

Pedro was an excellent host! He picked my husband and baby daughter and I up at the airport and then helped us with all of our things to the apartment. There was a basket of fresh fruit awaiting us and he allowed us to check in early. All of these things were a huge help to us.
Buena experiencia. Pedro es muy amable y el piso muy limpio, esta muy bien equipado.

Pedro picked us up from the airport and was able to walk us right up to the apartment which we were really thankful for as it was tucked back in the heart of alfama! Apartment was cozy and clean. It was in an awesome location where you could walk everywhere in Lisbon! We absolutely loved our time there! Lisbon is awesome!

We've just come back from a great stay at Pedro's flat in Lisbon. Pedro picked us up from the airport (thanks) and once at the flat gave us useful information about the surrounding area. The flat has everything you might need for a short stay in Lisbon - the bed is comfortable, the shower is good, and the flat is well equipped. The Alfama region is a great location for getting into town and there is good public transport nearby. There are a number of nice little restaurants and bars in the area offering super fado music. All in all, another great Airbnb find and I would recommend it to anyone.

Great apartment in a great location! Pedro was a great host and even picked us up from the airport. The arpartment was clean and tidy and had everthing we needed for our stay. We'd definitley stay again!

Pedro picked us up from the airport, which made a very relaxed en nice start. You don't have to search for the address and it's nice to talk to the owner of the place you're staying. He was very helpfull with tips on how to get around.

The appartment itself was very complete, from the kitchen to an umbrella (which we regretfully needed). The appartment is situated right in the middle of the old (very nice) neighborhood and you're a 10 min walk from the metro. We had a wonderfull stay.

Pedro é uma otima pessoa, foi nos buscar no aeroporto e nos deu varias dicas do que fazer em Lisboa assim como um mapa da cidade. O apartamente é exatamente igual as fotos e muito bem equipado, nos sentimos em casa! Recomendo a todos!

Everything. It was a perfect. The location was amazing. Few minutes up the hill and you can see the amazing views of Alfama and the river. You can sit on the bench and watch the sub rise and set. You can take the tram 28 and go back into the city through the beautiful hilly lanes.
The apartment itself was fully equiped. The kitchen was fully functioning, wifi was great, the bed was plenty for 2 people. The great thing was you can have a complete blackout even with light outside. This was great because it meant I could sleep-in.
Lastly, but not the least, Pedro is a fabulous host. He picked me up from the airport, showed me the focal point if I ever forgot where the apartment was, showed me around the apartment and made me feel at ease from the moment I met him.
When I return to Lisbon, Pedro, I know where my room will be. :)

We were in Lissabon for 3 days and 3 nights. Pedro picked us up at the airport. Pedro made us feel very welcome at his place. He also had map and all the important information of the city for us. His place was very neat, cozy and well decorated. We felt very much like home at his place. Everything necessary was available. Pedro's place is located at a very nice neighborhood in Alfama. There are nice restaurants and cute shops around. We felt very comfortable at his place and was a wonderful experience on the whole.

Meeting with Pedro was the beginning of a memorable trip to Lisbon. He hung around while our flight was delayed,and took us to the appartment which was perfect for our needs, it was very well equipped and well situated for exploring Alfama and the centre. We loved having a choise of Fado cafés on the doorstep also plenty of local food shops.  Pedro was a lovely and kind host , we were lucky to meet him.
Really nice place in a nice neighbourhood. Pedro was kind and came to pick us at the airport when we arrived. The apartement was well equiped.

we werden door Pedro hartelijk op de airport ontvangen en naar het appartement gebracht. Het ligt midden in het oude Alfama en was goed ingericht voor 2 personen. Pedro bracht zelfs onze koffer via een steile trap naar boven.
Hij heeft ons nog een aantal tips gegeven, o.a. over (Fado)restaurants, want in deze tijd van het jaar zijn er nogal wat gesloten.

Если вы решили отдохнуть в Лиссабоне, то лучшего места вам не найти. Без сомнения, хозяин апартаментов создал все условия для того, чтобы отдых был максимально комфортным. Мы приехали в Лиссабон накануне Нового года поздно вечером, когда у всех полно хлопот, тем не менее Педро нашел время нас встретить в аэропорту и помог донести тяжелые чемоданы. Апартаменты находятся в 10 мин. Ходьбы от главной площади города, таким образом вы целиком погружаетесь в жизнь той исторической части Лиссабона, которую и приехали посмотреть, это гораздо интереснее, чем жить в номерах отелей, которые одинаковы на во всех странах и континентах. Каждое возвращение в апартаменты-это маленькая экскурсия по улочкам и закоулкам с барами и аутентичными ресторанчиками, в которых пахнет рыбой на гриле и портвейном. Отдельно стоит упомянуть удивительный холл с лестницей в апартаменты, вряд ли вы еще раз встретите такой где-нибудь. В квартире есть все необходимое для жизни: электрическая плита, духовка, холодильник с морозилкой, стиральная и посудомоечная машины, чайник, тостер, кофе-машина, микроволновка, блендер, утюг, фен, компьютер, телевизор, полный набор всевозможной посуды, мебели, буклеты, карты и туристическая информация. Апартаменты оформлены в скандинавском стиле с национальными изюминками/художественными включениями с хорошим вкусом. Когда мы приехали, на кухне обнаружили приятный комплимент от хозяина – воду, чай, кофе, фрукты и портвейн. Сам Педро очень приятный в общении человек, заметно, что его дело для него – это честь оказания гостеприимства, а не банальное извлечение прибыли, возможно, потому что все было подготовлено с такой любовью, Лиссабон оставил сильное впечатление, и вспоминая Лиссабон и португальцев, мы вспоминаем Педро. Горячо рекомендуем вам эти апартаменты. If you decided to rest in Lisbon, then you will not find better place then Pedro’s apartment. Without a doubt the host of the apartment created all conditions for maximal comfort stay. We arrived in Lisbon few days before the New Year late in the evening when everyone is very busy, but Pedro found time and met us at the airport and helped bring heavy baggage. The apartment is in 10 minutes walk from the main square of the city, so you are entirely involved in the life of the historical part of Lisbon, which you would like to see. This is much more interesting than live in hotel rooms, which are the same in all countries and continents. Each return to the apartment is a small excursion to side streets and back streets with bars and authentic restaurants with smell of grilled fish and port wine. We should also mention the wonderful hall with stairs to the apartment, it is unlikely that you meet this anywhere. The apartment has everything necessary for life: electrical plate, oven, fridge-freezer, washing machine, dishwasher, kettle, toaster, coffee machine, microwave, blender, iron, hair dryer, computer, TV, complete set of all kinds of utensils and furniture, brochures, maps and tourist information. The apartments are decorated in a Scandinavian style with national features in a good manner.When we arrived, we found a nice compliment from the host: water, tea, coffee, fruit and port wine. Pedro is a really nice person, it is noticeable that he likes...

This place was more than perfect! The very hospitable host, Pedro, thoroughly prepared for my room, picked me up at the airport, and  even cared for my expected hardship (e.g., drinkable water) due to my late arrival time of Lisbon. The room was so spacious, clean, neat, cozy, convenient, and amazing that I could fully enjoy my staying at the house. Every facility in the room was in good shape and worked well. It was definitely the best room that I had stayed until now via Airbnb. I am really greatful to him for letting me stay at the house. If I ever have another chance to visit Lisbon again, my room will absolutely be his house.

Nous avons passé un merveilleux séjour à Lisbonne . L'appartement est totalement conforme à la photo, d'une propreté impeccable et très agréable pour un couple . Sa situation aux portes de l'Alfama était idéale pour nous . Et pour notre première experience Airbnb quelle chance de rencontrer Pedro ! C'est vraiment l'hôte parfait ! Malgré un accueil tardif et un retard de notre avion, Pedro est venu nous chercher à l'aéroport et nous a conduit à l'appartement. Un accueil est une gentillesse vraiment exceptionnels . Merci encore Pedro . Nous recommandons donc VIVEMENT ce logement au cœur de Lisbonne .
Nous avons passé un week end au cœur du quartier d'Alfama. Pedro est venu nous cherché à l'aéroport. Appartement idéalement situé, je recommande vivement Pedro !

Great apartment, great neighbourhood. Pedro picked us up from the train station (app 10 minute walk) and showed us around. Thank you so much for having us, we had a great time. Would recommend it to anyone!

Pedro was a very nice and thoughtful host, he even came pick us up at our arrival at the airport, great service. His appartment is very nicely situated in Alfama neighborhood, clean, very pleasant and convenient. Two little downsides though for sleep lovers like us : the bed is a little small and not extremely confortable, and the ceiling is thin so we hear the upstair neighbours in the morning. But otherwise, globally, it was a very nice experience ! I recommend.

Un grand merci à Pedro pour son accueil. L'appartement était parfait et trés bien situé. Nous sommes arrivés plus tard que prévu et Pedro nous a parfaitement accompagné. Je recommande vivement cette adresse ... je l'ai déjà recommandé à des amis d'ailleurs !

Pedro came to pick up at the airport and drove us to the apartment. That was very nice of him and much appreciated as the apartment would not have been easy to find in the small streets of Alfama.
The apartment is as described, small but fully furbished. It is suitable for a couple. As expected from Alfama, it is in an old building with wood floors and so has minimal isolation from the upper neighbors.
The first day we didn’t pay attention and came short of hot water. For the rest of our stay we used hot water more carefully and it was ok.
The neighborhood is very typical of Alfama, with restaurants featuring Fado close by and the typical tram 28 just a few minutes walk.

Nous avons passé une très bonne semaine à l'appartement de Pedro. Celui-ci est très bien situé, dans le quartier de l'Alfama (commerces et restaurants à proximité, station de métro à 10 mn à pied).
Pedro est vraiment un très bon hôte au point de laisser à ses invités quelques collations pour le séjour !

Pedro was a great host. He went further than most host and even picked us up from the airport and brought us directly to the apartment.
The apartment is exactly as shown in the images. It is very clean and in a very central location in Alfama. It is very quite. As it has only one window to the front it is a little dark, but that is the normal layout of apartment in Alfama, so everything is good.
We had a great stay and can heart warmly recommend staying at Pedros apartment.

Pedro was a great host and went beyond what was expected by kindly collecting us from the airport and taking us to his lovely apartment in Alfama. The apartment was clean, spacious but with elements of quaint Portuguese features which we were after. There were lot of restaurants near by where locals would swarm to so we knew it would be good food. The metro station was close by making it really easy to get into the very centre of Lisbon. The castle is close enough to walk, although be prepared for the hills! Overall we loves our experience and had free wifi which was great to look up reviews of the local restaurants. Definitely would recommend to a couple or friends who want to feel the real Lisbon a bit out of the lively neighbourhoods. Thank you for having us!

Lovely week-end in Lisbon at Pedro's apartment! The place is like in the pictures: very clean and nicely decorated. There is everything you need, even a bottle of wine and some fruits! The apartment is just in the middle of the very typical area of Alfama, close to the center and to metro and bus stations.

Pedro was a perfect host: picked us up at the airport, gave us all the informations we needed and was easy to talk with.

Highly recommanded!

Très très bon acueil,nous étions ravis que Pedro vienne nous chercher à l aéroport , c était très appréciable , Pedro a été très attentionné, tout est bien pensé dans l appartement , il ne manque absolument rien ( café,fruit .....) L appartement est chaleureux ,pratique et propre, surtout très bien situė dans, un quartier plein d authenticité, à conseiller sans hésitation
A very nice flat, perfectly located! Pedro was very kind and helpful, the communication was very easy and he prepared some water, coffee and a fruit bowl. Thank you Pedro!

Pedro fut un hôte attentionné, il a pris le temps de venir nous chercher à l'aéroport et nous a communiqué toutes les informations nécessaires sur Lisbonne. L'appartement, conforme aux photos, était idéalement situé, au cœur de l'Alfama. L'appartement est parfaitement équipé (lave linge, lave vaisselle, wifi,...), jusqu'à la coupe de fruit, le café et même une bouteille de vin au frais!
Nous recommanderions cet appartement à des amis, merci Pedro!
Pedro was a great and careful host, he picked us up at the airport and drove us to the apartment located in the center of the Alfama. He communicated us all the information about Lisboa. Apartment was in line with the pictures shown on Air B&B, fully equipped : washing machine, dishwasher, coffee machine with coffee tabs, fruits...and last but not least a fresh bottle of wine!
We would warmly recommend this apartment to friends, thank you Pedro !

Le séjour s'est super bien passé. Pedro est venu nous chercher à l'aéroport et nous a amené à l'appartement. L'appartement était propre et correspondait bien aux photos. Pedro nous a très bien accueil et nous a conseillé sur les endroits à visiter à Lisbonne.

Pedro was a really great host. He even picked us up from the airport. The Apartment was excactly like in the description, equiped with fresh fruits and a bottle of Water. I can really recommend this Apartment! Thank you, Pedro! :-)

Pedro communicated with us nicely before our arrival and came to meet us at the train station. He made us feel very welcome and explained everything about the city and about the area near the apartment in a very nice way. Pedro had even provided a fruit bowl and water for us when we arrived, which was really nice. The apartment was clean and perfect for two people. The apartment was tastefully decorated. The kitchen was well equipped and it was nice to have coffee for the mornings. The only small minus was that there was no air conditiong, since some nights were a bit too hot for us who come from the northern parts of Europe, but there was a fan which helped.
The location was good and it was easy to take a metro to the other parts of the city. We also visited beaches near Porto by train. In summary we really enjoyed our stay in Pedros apartment and would recomment it to other visitors!

Pedro was meeting us at the airport and gave us a ride to this cozy flat in Alfama, he also provided plenty of information you might need for your stay.
The flat is exactly like on the photos, small but more than enough for two, really nice, clean, fully equipped, refurbished and furnished with taste and style. And it was surprisingly quiet, while being in the heart of Alfama: full of restaurants, bars, lookout points and alleys, 5 to 10 minutes walk to major transport hubs. The footfall noise from the flat above is something you can expect in houses of historical districts in any major cities.
It was a really pleasant experience and we were happy to meet Pedro in person too.
Pedro was very helpful and nice, he came to pick us up at the trainstation. the apartment was great, just as the location and close to the city center.

Everything was perfect. The location was good, the apartment as well.
The owner of the flat was so friendly. 100% highly recommendable.
He picked yp us at the airport and we did the check in early in the morning.

Thanks for make our stay in Lisbon easier.

Pedro was a great host, and his apartment was absolutely perfect. Pedro picked us up from the airport and showed us to the apartment, which was very helpful, and provided us with all the information we needed for our stay. The apartment itself was in perfect condition, very clean and located in a beautiful part of Alfama, minutes from the castle and within walking distance of the city centre.

Thank you Pedro, we would be glad to stay at your apartment again in the future!

Pedro picked us up at the airport although our plane was delayed, but a simple phonecall was efficient enough. Pedro showed also some points of recognition and gave us a good plan of the neighbourhood so whe could make our orientation in the narrow Alfama Streets. (some times, mostly the first two days, we really needed that plan to find back the appartment :-)) The formalities were short, quick and efficient handled with by Pedro so we could enjoy our stay. Some fresh fruit was waiting for us in the appartment.
The appartment is really in the middle of Alfama (5 min walk to the fadomuseum, idem to the miradoura of Portas do Sol). But, wondering, it is very quiet over there => we slept all 4 nights in april (even a saturdaynight) with the window of the appartment open and we were not disturbed. Even a very nice fado-restaurant and wine-bar are at not more than 30 meters away around the corner. A good local pastelleria for the breakfast :-) is some steps further. I enjoyed it every morning with a fresh coffee thanks to the pads Pedro set available.
The photo's on airbnb are the reality. The appartment was well organised and very clean. All you need is available (dishwasher, watercooker, toiletpaper, everything to cook, ...) We did our best :-) but we couldn't image a thing we missed. And it has a feel home-touch just like the neighbourhood.
In some mails in preparation of our stay Pedro mentioned already some interesting things to do. (free bikes in Cascais, some less known musea, some things to see in Belem, ...)
Although Pedro wasn't a fan because of the dangerous traffic we hired a motorbike (at LX bikes / Av inf Dom Henrique - very correct) to visit Cascais, the big bridge and Sintra. Maybe because we are used to the traffic in Belgium and Brussels we found the Portugese drivers friendly and the traffic very fluent. We felt very safe on the motorbike. Even the policemen are helpfull instead of having a frightening approach.
We had a very nice stay in Lisboa and this appartment was a big part of it. It was our first experience with airbnb and it inspires us for a rehearsal.
Patrick and Gudrun, Belgium
Very cool apartment in a lively neighbourhood. They were helpful checking us in and communicated well.

A estadia foi ótima. A comunicação e atenção dos anfitriões é impecável. Tivemos uma recepção perfeita, com muitas informações e mimos de chegada. O prédio realmente é bem antigo e são muitos degraus para subir. A localização é muito boa. Teve a festa sábado, mas as 23h em ponto terminou e não nos atrapalhou em nada. Todos os equipamentos do apartamento funcionaram muito bem e a vista da área externa é muito bonita.
