回覆迅速，十分周到的服務團隊
還用心準備了迎賓點心及酒品
衛浴明亮舒適設備良好
有像是大理石材質的淋浴間 十分驚喜
若有大件行李，建議搭計程車前往

I would recommend this Airbnb if you are looking for a space in central Lisbon. We enjoyed the outdoor patio, and while the space is cozy, we felt like it was thoughtfully laid out and planned. The space had all of the amenities we needed during our stay and gave us a great home base for our time in Lisbon.

This place felt like home. The apartment was very clean, well-equipped and the description matched the listing. I found the location excellent, central and close to everything. As mentioned in the listing, there is some nightlife noise, but the host was upfront about that and it did not bother me. I really enjoyed my stay in this charming old neighbourhood of Lisbon.

We stayed 4 nights at this apartment, which is in a top location: centre, shopping, waterside, Bairro Alto, supermarket all within walking distance. Tram 28 stops 1 minute from the front door. All appliances you may need are provided for, lovely, homely feeling in the apartment. We had aperitif here every night before going out for dinner to one of the many restaurants at walking distance. Highly recommend.

Die Wohnung war genau wie beschrieben und super gemütlich. Wir wurden vor Ort persönlich empfangen und erhielten eine tolle Einführung. Die Kommunikation war hervorragend. Zur Begrüßung gab es eine Flasche Wein und die traditionellen portugiesischen Pastel de Nata, anbei eine schriftliche persönliche Begrüßung. Da wir zum Jahreswechsel in Lissabon waren, hat der Gastgeber außerdem einen kleinen portugiesischen Weihnachtskuchen Bolo Rei und eine Flasche Sekt, ebenfalls mit persönlicher Nachricht, in die Wohnung gestellt. Besonders aufmerksam fanden wir, das  zwei Bademäntel zur Verfügung gestellt wurden. Da es im Winter auch in Lissabon recht kühl sein kann, fanden wir es sehr angenehm, dass eine Heizung den Raum erwärmt hat. Die Lage der Wohnung ist hervorragend, viele Orte können zu Fuß erreicht werden. Trotz der zentralen Lage, war es sehr ruhig. Wir bedanken uns für den wunderbaren Aufenthalt und würden die Unterkunft jederzeit wieder buchen.
Nous avons passé un très agréable séjour dans le logement, impeccable ! Et le quartier très sympathique, on est proche de tout, je recommande !

perfect and cozy. right next to a truly iconic spot. amazing hosts with the best recommendations and communication. be warned there is some noise from downstair bars but it's easy to wash out with some white noise on ur phone or the Bose speaker they have in the apartment. I will book here every time i return to Lisbon if i can.

Loved Pedo's place! Perfect for relaxing after a long day of sightseeing, eating, wondering about all of Lisbon's beautiful streets. Absolutely worth the 5 floor walk up for the view you get of the city + ocean from the balcony. Very helpful and generous with welcome bottle of wine, coffee + delicious pastel de natas. The location was perfect with peace and quiet during the weekdays + lively, fun crowds right at your doorstep on the weekends. Very quiet and warm when you need an escape too. Would stay again in a heartbeat and would recommend you do too!

Com certeza uma das melhores localizações de Lisboa, você terá fácil acesso a pé a vários locais turísticos e está muito bem conectado ao transporte público para qualquer região da cidade.
Apartamento exatamente como demonstrado nas fotos, lindo, moderno e extremamente limpo. Com anfitriões atenciosos e solícitos, Francisco me recebeu pessoalmente, me ajudou com as malas, forneceu todas as coordenadas do apartamento e esteve sempre presente para qualquer dúvida.
Com certeza esse é um dos melhores Airbnb que já estive e como viajante solo, me senti muito segura.
Great space! We only wish we had stayed longer.

We had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb! It’s right in the central area near lots of great restaurants and bars, making it easily accessible. Our hosts were great at communicating and sharing tips for our commute prior to our stay, so appreciate all the support there!
Loved my stay at The Chiado Loft. Pedro  & Francisco were extremely helpful and responsive. Will definitely be back in the future.
Pedro was extremely responsive and very kind! Even greeted us at the door and explained all the amenities. Would recommend and would stay again!

We loved this location next to the funicular. Very central to so many attractions along with excellent cafes and restaurants align with the nightlife!
Apartment was lovely and wonderful little extras such Portuguese Tarts and bathrobes.
This apartment has no stairs but it wasn’t an issue for us.
Would absolutely stay again!

Die Loft ist toll und super zentral in sehr netter Umgebung gelegen. Es ist alles vorhanden und Fracisco war immer gut erreichbar per Chat und sehr freundlich. Wir waren für ein verlängertes Wochenende zu Zweit da. Zu beachten: Wenn man das Bett im „Mezzanine“ nutzen will, muss man klettern und kriechen.
Ich kann die Unterkunft sehr empfehlen.

This quiet apartment in Portugal was exactly what we were looking for on our first trip to Lisbon. The host was incredibly accommodating, and the view from the balcony was absolutely stunning. We’d highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting Lisbon for the first time.
The apartment was minimally perfect.  Close to lots of sights, restaurants, shopping and bars.  Great communication and a trip I’ll never forget

Loved Pedro’s place. I spent so much time on the balcony soaking up the Portuguese sun when I needed a rest from all the walking. The surrounding area is quite touristy—also meaning quite walkable!
He was very thoughtful and provided a gift of white wine and fresh pastel de natas. He’s super responsive.
You need to be specific with check in time because someone needs to meet you to open the door and hand you the keys.

The airbnb was gorgeous with a lot of natural light, which I really enjoyed, a beautiful place to watch the sunset on the terrace. Pedro was very responsive and had nice extra details in the airbnb, which I really appreciated. I stayed at 3 airbnbs while visiting Portugal and felt this one stood out because the details and the fact he was there to show me the airbnb and how everything worked.
Thank you! Our holiday was made even better because of you, your team and your wonderful flat!
Emplacement parfait. Très beau studio avec une petite terrasse sympathique. Pas trop bruyant. À noter le lit est un matelas posé sur une planche au sol, pas très confortable.

I would give this 10 stars if I could! Wonderful hosts and hospitality- very friendly and welcoming and delighted with the extra touches. Accommodated our early check in. The apartment is small but so well appointed- there’s everything you need and some really great design features. We slept soundly, and were not disturbed by noise despite the flat being “close to the action”.  Totally recommend as a base for a Lisbon city break

Wonderful loft with great views of the city! The beds and couch were comfortable and the bathroom very clean and spacious. I ended up feeling unwell for the beginning of our stay and they were very accommodating trying to check me in as soon as possible, wonderful service.
The space was clean and in a great location. Pedro and team were extremely accommodating, helpful and made me feel very welcome. I would stay here again
We had a great stay! Very beautiful apartment and perfect location. Host met us at checkin and gave us a tour of the apartment. Appreciated the pastel de natas and wine! Would recommend!
Great apartment and rooftop chill area. Prime neighborhood with countless options for food/drink/shopping/etc close by. I would stay here again for sure.

I can't say enough how amazing this loft is!! The location is perfect and was surprisingly quieter than I expected for being right on a funicular street - which also made it a totally unique and memorable stay having the tram greet you every morning and night.
The host team is incredibly communicative and nice, and was able to offer recommendations in the neighborhood. The loft is clean and modern with everything I could have needed and the roof patio is completely private which was incredible.
You are also located just a few doors down from 'O Momento - Casa de Empanadas' where I had the best empanadas of my life (and I've eaten A LOT of empanadas) - and less than a 10 minute walk from Cais do Sodre which is a fun spot to hang out and listen to music or relax on the river. I would definitely recommend renting from this team if you plan to travel to Lisboa!

This apartment is fantastic for a young couple like us in our early 30s. It’s right in the heart of the action, yet still pleasantly quiet inside. The design is well thought-out, with a nice speaker for music and plenty of natural light. Plus, the A/C works perfectly, so you can come back to a refreshingly cool space after a hot day.
Just keep in mind that there are quite a few stairs and some steep hills before you reach the apartment, so you’ll want to be in decent shape and pack light. The hosts were super helpful with check-in, and overall, it’s a perfect spot!
Best Air bnb I’ve ever stayed in.

We had a lovely time in Lisbon and Pedro's flat was perfect for the 3 of us. We liked the location, decoration and the amenities were great. I would just say that the place is more suitable for 2 persons rather than 3. The 3rd bed is accessible via a steep ladder and is directly under the top of the roof, a very narrow space. Our 14 year old son preferred to sleep on the couch to have more space. Irrespective of this, we would come again should we return to Lisbon :-).
The hosts were very friendly and forthcoming - thank you!
What a gem! The space was great for a family of three. The little veranda was a great hang space, cozy but well equipped.
Wir hatte ein paar schöne Tage in dem Appartment. Gerne wieder, wenn wir Lissabon nochmals besuchen. Vielen Dank für Alles!

Loved my stay here. The apartment has everything you need, and is in a great location in central Lisbon. I felt safe and the hosts were super accommodating and responsive. The terrace is also a huge plus. Would definitely stay again!

Had a fantastic stay, the studio is really beautiful and better even than the photos, with really lovely details and quality items. Thoughtful touches like the wine and pasties were such a nice surprise. The location is busy at weekends in the evening, but it didn’t disturb my sleep, and then it was quiet anyhow from Monday onwards. Francisco was really helpful and responsive, overall I had a brilliant stay

Wir hatten wunderbare drei Nächte in dieser Unterkunft verbracht. Sie liegt direkt an einer sehr belebten Gasse, wo das berühmte gelbe Tram fährt. In unmittelbarer Nähe gibt es zahlreiche Bars und Restaurants und man hat das Gefühl das echte Lissabon zu erleben. Wie wurden beim Check-in herzlich begrüsst und bekamen eine hervorragende Instruktion zur Unterkunft. Das Appartment ist sehr klein aber der verfügbare Platz exzellent genutzt. Die einzigen Verbesserungen wären mehr Ablagemöglichkeiten im Badezimmer (Schubladen)  und einen Sonnenschutz auf dem Balkon. Wir können die Unterkunft nur weiterempfehlen.
Tout était super! Bien placé, superbe accueil des propriétaires! Par contre il y avait du bruit qu’on entendait dehors jusqu’au petites heures du matin.
Great place, vibrant area with lots to do and eat.

Pedro and his team do a phenomenal job as host. The apartment was extremely clean and well decorated. The location was perfect right in the middle of all the activities with a plethora of bars, restaurants, and local venues. We stayed into the weekend therefore the music is played a little loud and you do hear some of the rowdy crowds beneath, so if you are a light sleeper, this may not be the best venue for you. We will definitely return to Pedro’s apartment and highly recommend it to others for a unforgettable stay.

Enjoyed a great time in Lisbon at this apartment. It's cosy and beautifully decorated and the sunny balcony is a lovely place for morning coffee. It had everything we needed for our trip and the hosts make you feel welcome with small touches - we loved the delicious oranges and wine.
The apartment is really well located, close to lots of the sights, plenty of nice bars and restaurants are just minutes away, and it has easy access to various public transport. Lots of good local recommendations provided too.
We were a little worried about noise given some of the other reviews - the street outside is very noisy, but with a set of decent earplugs it wasn't an issue at all.
I'd be happy to stay here again in future.

Tolle Stadtwohnung in/an einer der wohl meist fotografiertesten Straßen von Lissabon. Wir waren mit unserer 6jährigen Tochter für 4 Nächte dort und wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Alles war sauber und geschmackvoll eingerichtet. Sehr empfehlenswert vor allem für junge Paare. Sehr nette, persönliche Begrüßung. Die Lage ist optimal für jegliche Erkundungen, mittendrin und alles schnell zu erreichen. Absolut empfehlenswert 🙏🏻
We really enjoyed our stay here. It was even better than the photos and in a perfect location!

The apartment was beautiful , especially the terrace. So well located on the street which has the iconic funicular and close to local metro station which has links to main train stations and ferry ports. Loved evenings in the apartment as such a cosy living space. Would recommend and definitely stay again if in Lisbon.
Really enjoyed my stay! Such great hosts and an amazing location to explore from!
Great place to stay. Communication excellent and very accommodating. Highly recommend this place. Beautiful place to stay and very well thought out.
We hebben een heel fijn verblijf gehad!

Super appartement fidèle aux photos. Nous avons trouvé de belles surprises en arrivant (bouteillede vin, Folar de Pâques, orange pour le dej, etcccc).Super belle terrasse méme si nous n 'avons pas pu en profiter à cause de la pluie. Effectivement,  pas toujours facile de monter les 5 étages après autant de marche dans la journée,mais quelle plaisir de se retrouver dans cette appartement en famille. Encore merci ! C est sur que nous reviendrons. A bientot bel appart.

Great place, amazing location and super helpful recommendations! I've stayed in a lot of AirBnBs but these are amazing hosts. Above and beyond what's expected. Would love to stay there again the next time I'm in Lisbon
Wonderful flat in the heart of Lisboa, great use of space for a very comfortable stay.

Magnifique logement avec un accompagnement parfait.
J’y ai passé un week-end très agréable.

Absolutely wonderful Airbnb experience, beautiful patio, extremely clean and lots of thoughtful touches made us feel super welcome. The host was there to greet us and let us check in early after a red-eye. Really appreciate their flexibility and checked in on us during the stay to make sure we had everything. It was slightly noisy on the weeknight but we slept through it, no issues.

My husband and I stayed at Pedro’s place for the end of our Lisbon trip and overall I’d say it was a good experience. Firstly, Pedro was so accommodating, he let us drop our luggage off super early, and after the house keeper finished, he stuck around and went over everything in the home.
The location is super convenient, we were able to walk everywhere, from cool gay bars and clubs, to nice restaurants and shopping areas, it was only about a 10-15 min walk to places.
Also, one of the famous Trolley locations is conveniently located next to the Airbnb which was great for photos.
The bed was incredibly comfortable, and the shower was soothing.
I should note that there’s no elevator, if you have a disability perhaps this isn’t the Airbnb for you as there are many stairs to climb, and the furniture is a bit. low. Also, The street noise. There must be a bar below the apt because it was quite loud. But, if you’re younger or able bodied then perhaps this Airbnb would be a good fit.

Had a great stay here, Pedro and team were very responsive to messages and helped out with the awkward key to the building. We had a very warm welcome and given some recommendations for bars and restaurants.
Bedroom 1 is sufficient but very low to the ground. Bedroom 2 up some ladders in the ceiling was difficult for me but fine for a couple of nights

L'appartamento è bellissimo, ancora meglio che in foto, la luce che entra dalle vetrate rende tutto magico all'arrivo. È bene tenere presente che si tratta di un palazzo senza ascensore e quindi non adatto a tutti, ma qualora possibile, consiglio vivamente questo alloggio. La vista, l'arredamento, tutte le forniture offerte sono stupende, inoltre l'host ci ha accolto di persona con molta gentilezza, facendoci trovare una bottiglia di vino fresca, cioccolatini, caffé, té e arance e uno splendido benvenuto con dei pasteis de Nata; senza considerare che si affaccia in una delle vedute più iconiche di Lisbona.
Se proprio dobbiamo trovare un difetto a questa casa è la posizione del terzo letto sul soppalco dal soffitto molto basso, ma sinceramente per noi non è stato un problema.
Un grande pro invece, soprattutto considerando la posizione, è l'ottima insonorizzazione degli infissi, cosa rara da trovare a Lisbona.
Tornerei ancora sicuramente e lo consiglio.

The place looked just like the listing pictures. It is on a tourist focused street with the yellow trolley car. Some reviews complained about the noise, but besides one night, it really wasn’t that bad. Put on a noise machine or some music on your phone and we had zero issues. The bed was comfortable and we had everything we needed. Host was great, responsive, and allowed us drop off our luggage a little early while the cleaners got the apartment ready for checkin. Great listing and worth the price.
It was a great stay. The hosts were really nice and responsive. The house was very clean and beautiful as shown in the listing. I would highly recommend this place. Thank you once again!
The loft was our home away from home for an unforgettable stay in Lisboa. Perfect location with all that you need. The stairs will definitely get you in shape for the walking in Lisbon😊
The apartment is beautiful and ideally located. Pedro and his team are friendly and responsive. I would highly recommend it.

I’ve stayed here with my wife for 7 nights.
I’m a host myself and damn this is the way to run your Airbnb.
Starting from the welcome message with clear instructions and honest details about the apartment and the location.
The check in was as smooth as it can be, everything to a single detail was explained by a very friendly host who welcomes you upon arrival with a bottle of wine, fruit and chocolates.
The apartment is so nicely arranged and clean as a pharmacy. They even arranged free cleaning in the middle of our stay.
The bed has an additional mattress topper for added comfort, we slept like babies.
The unique location is in a lively neighborhood of Bairro Alto wich we wanted. Very close to Chiado wich was our favorite hood, and 15min walk to Baixa city centre. Lots of fine restaurants, you’ll find a recommendation list in the apartment wich was very very helpful.
Smart TV, bluetooth speaker, Nespresso machine with free coffee, amazing balcony…etc
Big 5 stars from us!

Great place - very walkable to many attractions, restaurants and shopping. Pedro’s team is very attentive from check-in to check-out, and are happy to help. The place is quirky on the top floor of a heritage building - be prepared for lots of stairs and plenty of angles in the unit. All in all, a good experience.
A wonderful stay and a perfectly located loft. 100% we would stay here again.
Wonderful stay with beautiful views.

This crew knows how to host. They communicated incredily well, had tons of quality recommendations on where to eat and what to do, and the place was very clean. But it was the little touches they provided that made this place really stand out. I have never had hosts provide me with a mobile hot stop before, very thoughtful. Yes, getting your luggage up the stairs wasn't a lot of fun, but it was definitely worth it once you get to the top. Highly recommend.

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour à Lisbonne!
L’appartement est super agréable et bien placé !

Lovely spot that is walkable to touristy spots and more niche locales too. It’s a quick jaunt to Time Out Market, the train to Cascais, and the ocean.
The location is right along a street where lots of tourists take pictures with the trolley. The area can be loud at night, especially on weekends, so be wary if that’s not your vibe or bring ear plugs.
The loft itself is cute, clean, and very functional. It’s five floors up, so double check that you didn’t forget anything before heading down!
We watched movies, sat on the balcony, and did a load of laundry. The bed is located under an eave, so it might be tight quarters for tall folks. The bed and linens were comfy.
The hosts are a sweet group of guys who are incredibly flexible, responsive, and kind.

It was very impressive that the host waited to welcome us and helped checking-in, giving detailed explanations. The house was very pretty and had a lovely, spacious balcony, which was my favorite about the apartment. When we need led anything or assistance, everything went smoothly :)
Super location and central to everything, fun space. The host was incredibly helpful and welcoming with oranges, coffee and jam:) highly recommend.

Un séjour absolument parfait ! Le logement était impeccable, conforme à la description, et encore mieux que ce que nous avions imaginé. Tout était pensé pour notre confort, et la propreté était irréprochable.
L’accueil a été chaleureux et attentionné, avec de petites attentions.
Je recommande sans hésitation.
Great location!
We enjoyed our stay in this lovely flat very much  and would come back at any time ! THANKS FOR ALL :-)

Our stay at Pedro’s apartment was absolutely fantastic! The place is spacious, bright, and equipped with everything you need for a comfortable stay. The location is perfect for exploring Lisbon, with everything within easy reach. Pedro was incredibly kind and accommodating. Knowing that our flight was late in the evening, he offered us a late check-out at no extra cost. On top of that, he welcomed us with a bottle of wine and some delicious treats, which was such a lovely touch. It was a gesture we truly appreciated. Highly recommended!

Nothing bad to say, the apartment itself is lovely and very clean.This was one of the cleanest Airbnb place I stayed. The host was very helpful providing information regarding restaurants and places to visit.

From the start, communication and responsiveness was top notch. We were allowed to check in early as our flight came in very early.
Francisco met us at the apartment to show us around. Very friendly and helpful! The apartment was spotless and as shown in photos. The terrace is amazing and so peaceful.
It is a loud area, but as soon as the windows are closed, you hear nothing.
Highly recommend! Close to so many great things.
We had an excellent experience & stay - I highly recommend! Great location, lovely home, and a very responsive & helpful host.

We had a wonderful stay at Pedro’s apartment. If we could give more stars, we would!
Beautiful and clean apartment. Very quirky with a fabulous terrace overlooking the city down to the river. Lots of lovely welcome goodies, too.
It’s right in the heart of it all but we loved that. Great sitting on the terrace with a glass of wine listening to the music in the street below. Once the patio is closed, you hear nothing and inside is very peaceful. Loved the tram passing the front door!
Close to lots of fabulous restaurants and so much to see and do on the doorstep.
Pedro gave us fabulous recommendations of restaurants. One, in particular, was 2 minutes away called Casa de India. Not Indian cuisine but a local Portuguese restaurant with a great atmosphere and beautiful food.
We have had an absolutely wonderful 3 nights here and would highly recommend it to future guests.
Pedro was the perfect host who even looked after our cases on our final day until it was time to head to the airport.

Great place very central location! The loft is very good looking and sophisticated. Very clean and have everything! At check in I got all the information I needed. The terrace is amazing the bathroom very big. It was exactly what I was looking for. Perfect especially for couples.. Of course is not for everybody: noise at night, you have stars until last floor and kitchen very small even if has everything is not for long stay. I really suggest this place and I will book it again if I come back!

Lovely top floor apartment with beautiful furnishings and excellent little porch to look out over the rooftops of Lisbon.
Generous hosts, we loved our little welcome gifts!

Sehr zuverlässiger Gastgeber!
Die wohnung war sehr sauber und die Lage ist top. Tolle Empfehlungen erhalten.
Pedro hat schnell auf Fragen reagiert und hat ebenfalls Proactive zwischendurch nachgefragt ob wir etwas benötigen.
Darüberhinaus hat Pedro rechtzeitig mitgeteilt, dass es selbst für ein paar Tage nicht erreichbar ist und hat alternative Kontakte übermittelt für den Fall wenn wir etwas benötigen.
Sehr Professionell!

We stayed in Pedros apartment and everything was perfect for the 3 of us. The communication was fast and easy, the apartment as described. On saturday there was a lot of action downstairs, but the host made us aware of that right at the booking process, offering alternatives in case we wanted - just make sure to bring earbuds if you're not going out yourself and have trouble sleeping when there's noise ;) All the other nights, it was very calm.

Amazing location in the historic centre, easy to get anywhere you need (public transport), many shops and restaurants... The apartment is clean and comfortable, fully equipped for a several days stay of a couple. The terrace is cozy and spacious, perfect for a relax with a glass of wine. You just have to take into account that the apartment is on the fifth floor without an elevator and the staircase is quite steep (a price for staying in a beautiful old building). The host (Joao) is reliable and helpful, always ready to help with anything. Recommended!
Place was wonderful, true to the photos. Very walkable location to restaurants, bars, stores. Hosts were responsive and very helpful for all questions. Loved our stay here and would return!

Amazing apartment in an old Lisbon building under the roof. Warm welcome and excellent communication, with everything explained by Pedro and Joāo and all recommendations provided to enjoy the city. The apartment is well located on an iconic street with the tramway in the city center. Plenty of options nearby, from breakfast spots to supermarkets and bars. Definitely recommended!

The apartment was beautiful and very well equipped with amenities. We were even given a few perks upon arrival to make our stay more enjoyable. The location was perfect and we loved the views from the terrace. I would highly recommend to stay here while in Lisbon. We felt safe and comfortable. 10/10 hosts and apartment.
Great place to stay in heart of Lisbon!

Eine gemütliche Wohnung in einer super Lage von Lissabon
Sehr gute Restaurants in der nahen Umgebung ( und super Frühstückslokale )
Von hier aus haben wir Lissabon sehr gut zu Fuß erkundet
Wenig Gepäck ist gut ( da man auf die 5 Etage muss ) was uns nicht gestört hat
Sehr netter Kontakt / gute Tipps und sehr schnelle Kommunikation
Für ein Wochenende in Lissabon eine tolle Wohnung - da man Nachmittags eine schöne Pause auf der Terrasse machen kann
Gerne wieder !

Le lieu est parfaitement situé et l'appartement magnifiquement agencé. Un petit cocon parfait pour un séjours à Lisbonne.
La rue est parfois un peu bruyante mais le fait d'être au dernier étage atténue la problématique. Attention car pas d'ascenseur, les 5 étages sont raides mais arrivé en haut vous ne serez pas dessus.
Nous recommandons vivement cet appartement pour sa situation, sa propreté et pour la grande réactivité de notre hôte pour chacun de nos contacts.

Really enjoyed my stay! Everything went smoothly with check in and I had no issues finding the apartment.
The apartment was in a great location and super walkable to many bars, restaurants and attractions which made getting around super convenient and stress free.
Host was always super responsive and accommodating with letting me check in a bit early which I really appreciated! I also loved the fresh fruit & pastel de nata upon arrival 😊
Apartment itself is well equipped and had a lot of added bonuses which was really great (blackout curtains, juicer, iron, blow dryer, Bluetooth sound system, Netflix etc.)
Lisbon was a dream & I can’t wait to return - will definitely stay here again 😊
Excellent host, great location. 5 starts all round, thanks.
We had an awesome stay! Amazing location. The loft was beautifully designed and had great amenities. The hosts were super friendly and responsive. Highly recommend!
Very friendly and responsive host! Apartment is just as described!

Excellent apartment, excellent host. Great location to explore Lisbon. Very walkable to the tourist spots and easy to find your way. Apartment was bigger than in the photos and had plenty of room for us. It’s up 5 flights of stairs but it’s not that bad (we had a lot of bags and still managed). Our host was great, welcomed us and gave a thorough explanation and great local recommendations. He was responsive and attentive. Couldn’t recommend this place enough.

We were welcomed to check in early, they are professional host. Left us few welcoming food and wine. Very response to our needs, even provided us with hot spot to take around but we did not use. Location is fantastic and close to a lot of fun areas. The area is safe just just like most neighborhood in Lisbon area. Will certainly come back.
We had an amazing stay! Can't say enough good things about this place. The location was perfect and the design of the airbnb was amazing. Can't recommend enough
Tolle Lage, schöne Wohnung, fantastische Terrasse. Sehr freundlicher Gastgeber und sehr schnelle und unkomplizierte Kommunikation. Vielen Dank für den schönen Aufenthalt!

We had the most wonderful stay and the host team were exceptional. The apartment was even better than the pictures! It was clean, modern and had lovely touches. We would highly recommend this stay for a young couple.
Fantastic apartment, very clean and well equipped, great location, lovely terrace. Host met us when we arrived and left wine and pasteis de nata for us. Would definitely recommend.

One of the most wholesome homes I’ve had the pleasure of staying in. The place is warm, spacious, comfortable, and has all the amenities a couple would need. The vibes and views on the outdoor patio are something out of a movie. We spent a week working from here and felt right at home. Besides the fact that the bica area is magical, this place is at most a 10 minute walk from endless exciting spots in Lisbon. Last but not least, massive kudos to the hosts who have created one of the most well organized and welcoming experiences we’ve had on Airbnb. A must visit!

Great location in the heart of it all. Loved the apartment decor! The communication from the Host team and their willingness to help really made it a next level, unforgettable experience for our first time in Lisbon
Lovely place in the city centre with a great view from the balcony. The  host was very responsive and resolved all the matters in no time.
Really responsive host and great location - central to everything Lisbon has to offer.

We just loved this space!! The walk up wasn’t as many flights as I expected, and was so convenient to everything we wanted to walk to.  So many restaurants, shops, train, waterfront, etc right there…..and the street is very lively (so very noisy), but once we were upstairs with the windows closed I couldn’t hear the noise. The A/C worked GREAT, and the hosts were so nice and helpful—they even showed us around and let us know how to use the appliances (this was super helpful).   This place was awesome for two adults (probably less so with little kids), and I totally recommend it to anyone who wants to spend time in the “belly” of old Portugal and see the historic sites!
Our stay was great & loved the apartment. Would very much recommend to anyone considering staying here.

We stayed in the 3 different airbnbs in Portugal and this was our favorite! Perfect spot for three. Incredible location. Pedro and team were extremely communicative and we were even able to check in early.

This apartment is an eclectic gem, for those of you who can appreciate great design and a toich of the old world charm.
Balcony is really the central feature and the view of Lisbon’s rooftops simply breathtaking.
Hospitality is out of ordinary with good quality coffee, and complementary bottle of wine and pastel de nata.
Everything was simply out of ordinary, and that’s why you just need to go there.
:-)

One of the best airbnbs I’ve stayed at. Host was super responsive, accommodating, and so friendly. The apartment is in one of the best and most iconic locations in Lisbon. The apartment is perfect size and the terrace is delightful. Highly recommend.

Wow! What an exceptional stay. Myself, my partner, and daughter had the privilege of staying here for the duration of time in Lisbon. Firstly the location is central, with all hotspots being no further than a 10 minute walk. The apartment itself was incredible, well decorated, and clean. The terrace was an added bonus and allowed for us to soak up the ambiance of the lively street below. Pedro and his team go above and beyond to peronalise your stay, adding little welcome gifts around the apartment. Above all Pedro and his team were the highlight of our stay, being quick to respond, attentive, and lovely for our stay and even after our departure. I would certainly recommend staying here if you get the chance. We hope to return soon.
such a lovely place to stay, the terrace is amazing and the location is perfect for exploring the city. Also great and helpful hosts, would highly recommend!
Great location. Responsive hosts. Such a great spot for a few days in Lisbon in a real neighborhood.  Right next to the Tram and a much of great restaurants.  Loved having the terrace.

our experience was absolutely amazing!
honestly, I couldn’t manage to come with anything we didn’t like or could suggest to improve!
hospitality is 10 out of 5!
guys are doing a great job!
apartment itself is nice, very clean and has absolutely everything you will possibly need during your stay.. location is great, you close to everything and there are lots of nice restaurants near by!
definitely would come back there again!
Great location and such a beautiful apartment and balcony patio. In love with this place and the location could not be better!
Highly recommend staying here. Great location and extremely helpful and welcoming host

The space was beautiful and in a great location. I loved that Rui met me there and was flexible with my check in time. It is on a busy street and you can hear people on the street, but the terrace can’t be beat. Everything about the space was wonderful and I would definitely book again.
Great place to relax! This place is super clean and well maintained.

loved our stay in this attic in a busy and lively place in lisbon. yes it's busy on a night here, but the glass must of cost a fortune, when the door was shut to the terrace you didn't hear a thing!
beautifully decorated, lots of stuff like dishwasher and washing machine, not something you'd expect in an old building in the centre. host was lovely, very responsive and helpful. we were left treats like wine, pastel de nata and chocolate. even oranges to make juice which was delicious. I will defo book this place again if we come back
Ver responsive hosts and a great location!

Pedro’s place is a great mix of new and old, with great modern amenities in a cool old building and neighborhood.  The description properly and honestly disclosed the quirks of the place (6 story walk up, potentially noisy street below, etc) but none of those things was a surprise or a problem for us.  Check-in was the most thorough of any rental we’ve ever stayed and they even worked to accommodate a pretty early checkin for us that was much appreciated after an early morning flight.  Due to the slope of the ceiling above the bed, the mattress is very low to the ground and only a single reading light is provided - a small portable book light solved the problem.  The bottle of local wine, the xtra plug adapter, the thorough book of local sites and restaurants, the coffee pods, etc. were just some of the really nice touches here.  And it’s hard to beat late afternoon beers for €2 at the local place next door!  Highly recommended - Thanks Pedro!

What a beautiful flat in the heart of the Sao Bento district! The stairs were narrow but makeable. Pedro also provided a hot spot we could walk around town with so we always had wi-fi on our phones! Fabulous stay!

Wunderschöne Wohnung in sehr zentraler Lage. Man fühlt sich wie zuhause. Sehr freundliche Gastgeber die grossen Wert auf kleine Details legen.
Vielen Dank für den schönen Aufenthalt! Wenn wir mal wieder nach Lissabon kommen dann bestimmt wieder in diese Wohnung! 😊

Nous avons passé un super week-end à Lisbonne, outre la ville qui est géniale, l'appartement et l'accueil de Pedro le sont tout autant.
La localisation est idéale et le bar en bas de l'immeuble fait plus office de joie de vivre que de nuisances.
Encore merci à Pedro pour sa disponibilité et les services proposés (les oranges à dispo pour le petit jus d'orange frais du matin et le dispositif portable pour avoir le wifi dans toute la ville pendant les promenades sont un véritable atout !
Absolutely fantastic location - could not be beaten! We will happily stay here again when we next visit Lisbon. Hosts are also very responsive & communicative.

Fernando and Pedro’s place was fantastic. They are willing to go out of their way to help anytime. Very responsive and very thorough with the check in process, which was very helpful. The apartment is very clean and we have no complaints what so ever. Would stay here again! Thank you for everything.

A beautiful apartment in an amazing location, so many things to see and do within walkable distance! The view gone the balcony is amazing especially with a nice sunset. The apartment is located in a popular street, so there can be some noise at times, but it didn’t bother us  much. Would definitely recommend staying here!
Great apartment and super helpful hosts. Super quick to answer!

Incredible apartment in the perfect location for your Lisbon adventure. We particularly appreciated how responsive and helpful the team was - you can tell this unit is professionally managed at a really high level. The location makes so much of Lisbon walkable for you. You’re in the heart of the nightlife, with everything at your fingertips, but it was never loud. There was maybe a little noise early Saturday night (I’m super noise sensitive), but otherwise totally quiet and peaceful. Although we also loved spending evenings on the patio (with a partial water + city view!). Perks for us were the laundry and little touches like a bottle of wine and fresh oranges/pastries on arrival. Will 100% stay here when we return and would recommend to friends and family.
Great communications and very creative use of space in the apartment. Lovely terrace and very grateful for the nata on arrival.
Right in the mix of the downtown area, walking distance to all things.  The balcony and the view are priceless.
Beautiful place! We loved our stay, it was clean and comfortable. They were super helpful and flexible with our check in. The place is just like the pictures. Beautiful terrace.

Having booked and stayed in another of Pedro's apartments for 3 nights, my wife fell ill on the last day and we were unable to return home as planned. The host was so accommodating and helpful, advising that whilst the apartment we were in was already booked, there was another apartment on the floor above we could have, which saved us needing to relocated to another part of the city.
They agreed we could stay in the room until the new room was ready and even came and helped us move our things. What was a worrying and frantic time was made so much easier by the assistance and consideration of the host, responding quickly and coming up with an ideal solution for our predicament.
Our sincere thanks.
Beautiful space in a fun area. Very clean and would love to return to on our next trip!

Unser Aufenthalt im Apartment war fantastisch! Die Kommunikation mit Pedro und seinem Team war exzellent. Das Apartment war sauber, gemütlich und gut ausgestattet. Trotz der zentralen Lage war es überraschend ruhig. Die lebhafte Umgebung in der Rua da Bica war perfekt. Besonders hilfreich war die Liste mit Restaurant- und Bar-Empfehlungen. Insgesamt eine uneingeschränkte Empfehlung! Vielen Dank an Pedro und das Chiado Lofts and Studios Team für eine unvergessliche Erfahrung!
Central location, perfect for a weekend break. Very responsive host. Loft exactly as we expected
We had an amazing time in Lisbon. The place is great and extremely well located to visit the city. A bit noisy at night but with earplugs it's fine!

Beautiful place, great communication, great location. We couldn’t have asked for anything more. It is a 5th floor walk up, but the guys were very helpful and brought up our luggage. Would stay here again in a heartbeat.

Really great little apartment with clever use of space in central location.  A nice balcony and view of the Tagus. It was a pleasure to stay here and appreciated the conversation with the friendly team, who couldn’t help enough. There was some noise but on New Year you would expect that. In general I think you are high enough from the street not to be bothered on a normal night.

Superbe appartement!!!
Nous y avons passé un excellent séjour.
Idéalement placé pour visiter Lisbonne.
L’hôte a été formidable, nous attendant même jusqu’à 2h du matin pour nous accueillir après le retard de notre avion.
L’appartement est très confortable et très bien équipé.
Mention spéciale pour la terrasse très agréable!!!
Évidemment nous avons eu du bruit en bas de l’immeuble mais l’hôte nous avait prévenu et vu la localisation de l’appartement cela ne nous a absolument pas gêné.
Nous y reviendrons avec grand plaisir!!!

Excellent stay in a brilliant lisbon location. Lots of bars and restaurants near by. Easy communication with the hosts. Thoughtful gifts and notes left by the hosts. The highlight was the balcony and glorious sunsets each night. Highly recommend.

This BnB was one of my favorites and it was mostly due to how great the host was.  They were very responsive, left us treats, wine, and even held our bags for us for a few hours after checkout.  100$  would recommend .

Great spot, lot's to do and see and was pre-warned about the drawbacks of the apartment. Like the flight of stairs to climb - five, no parking around the area for rental cars, only taxi or train to get there, and noise from the bars/restaurants downstairs. Apartment is designed so smart and great use of space. Top floor gets excellent light. The water pressure and hot water in the shower was so nice, i like it extremely hot! Also, the warming towel rack, so good for when it's cold.
I would move in permanently if I could, I like the space so much. The only real drawback is the noise of being in the middle of a busy city and building.

Outstanding from start to finish. Great communication, allowed us early access on arrival, and kept our bags for us to explore on our last day.
Beautiful, clean, well managed apartment, very cosy and comfortable. Robes, shampoo, conditioner and shower gel all provided. Yes it's on the 5th floor, but if you're worried about that then Lisbon probably isn't the right place for you! It's very hilly and you'll certainly work off those extra holiday calories on your travels!
We were also given a portable wireless hotspot to use all over the city, a great touch! As was the welcome bottle of wine in the fridge😉
Now to address the one 'negative' - the noisy bar on the street below. It was fairly noisy on the saturday night, but by time we had our own fun and some wine, we were so tired we zonked straight out. There was no other noise other than Saturday night. Personally for us, it was a price worth paying for such a beautiful apartment in a fantastic location. ENJOY! 😊

I thoroughly enjoyed my stay! The place had all the amenities you need, it is in a convenient location with the metro, grocery stores, restaurants and shopping at close proximity. Also, the view from the balcony is incredible and lastly, Pedro and his team were very responsive and helpful. I highly recommend!

Loved our stay. Beautiful apartment
John was fabulous at checkin. Amazing location with everything walking distance

Stunning, stylish, comfortable loft apartment in a historic building on what surely must be one of the most photographed iconic Lisbon streets. The hosts were really friendly and responsive - nothing was too much trouble. The apartment is on the 5th floor with very steep stairs - this is well advertised and the hosts checked with us that this would be ok. They also took time to explain the apartment was very close to bars and restaurants and offered us a quieter apartment if we preferred. This was not an issue for us - we loved being close to the fabulous bars and restaurants and listening to the jazz / fado from the roof terrace.  A brilliant base from which to explore the city!

The Chiado loft is a beautiful and stylish Airbnb located very close to Bairro Alto and Chiado. The location was perfect and near a variety of public transportation and within walking distance of many of Lisbon’s sites, shopping, and great restaurants . Francisco met me at the apartment for checkin and clearly explained all I needed to know about the apartment. The terrace was nice to sit and read and has a beautiful view over Lisbon and the river bridge. Since the apartment is centrally located there is noise from the street below and the walk up to the fifth floor was not so bad. I knew of these issues before hand and they did not affect my stay. Overall from check in to check out the stay was great.

We absolutely loved staying at Pedro's place it was above & beyond a special experience. The apartment is super cute with the balcony and lil kitchen. The little details like having olive oil and spices, a local bottle of wine & pastries, made us feel so good. We really appreciated an early check in with a terrific rundown of the space. Highly recommended! It's in a perfect area for getting out and seeing all of the wonders that Lisbon has to offer :)

This is an outstanding property. The loft is funky and interesting, the outdoor patio is spacious, the neighbourhood is eclectic and cool, and everything you need / want is close by and readily available.
Pedro and his colleagues are responsive and helpful, and they had a few nice touches in the loft to welcome us.
I give this property top marks!

Super friendly host personally greeted and helped with check in process go very smoothly. This place is one of the best Airbnb! Special sweet treats host provided along with a bottle of welcome drink was very nice. I also loved how clean the place was and it has everything as if it is your own sweet place. Host went above and beyond to make us feel very respectful and special. I definitely recommend this place ! Thank you so much hosting and making our stay feel very sweet and relaxed !

My stay here was so lovely. 100% would book again and come back due to the great experience. When we first aririved, we were greeted by Francisco who gave us clear instructions on the ins and outs of the property. Our first time in Portugal was easily made great due to this. The guides & instructions in the apartment were clear and easy. The  view from the terrace was beautiful & the location was amazing as well with the famous tram car right outside for some cute pictures. The couch was very comfortable as well as the bed to lounge & sleep on. Also, the interior design of the property was very appealing as well. Again couldn’t be more thankful for such a beautiful experience here.

The apartment is in a great location - east to walk to all the Lisbon sites! As the description says, the street is noisy (particularly weekend nights), but did not bother us! Wonderful host with lots of recommendations!

Great space for the 2 of us - really enjoyed the outdoor patio and all of the light in the apartment.  They were very responsive and we appreciated that they greeted us when we arrived and walked us through the apartment.  Would definitely stay here again

We had a wonderful stay at Pedro's place! The location is right outside the famous yellow tram, so you are in the middle of the action (and photos)! The terrace was especially nice for morning coffee before heading out for the day. When we come back to Lisbon, we will for sure stay here again!
The place is even better than the photos or description. Amazing location! I would stay here again without a doubt.
Really cozy design apartment right in the center of Lisbon. Great location for a weekend trip to inhale the vibrant vibes of the city.

10/10! This spot was ideal!
Great location, walkable, hosts were super responsive and the apartment was so amazing it was the best spot to take a breather on your journey through Europe!

I would stay again if I came back to Lisbon. Absolutely 10/10 for multiple reasons:
- Bedding was nothing short of that of a hotel's. Clean and ironed bedsheets, perfect pillows and crisp duvet made our sleep so sweet.
- Great location, in the heart of Lisbon, with everything close and a short walk to get to.
- Amazing amenities including speakers, champagne classes and more, topped up by pastel de nata, chocolates, oranges, and a bottle of wine as gifts upon arrival with a handwritten note.
- Such a beautiful terrace that gets a lot of sunlight.
- A beautiful bathroom with high quality towels (and a lot of it too).
- Host was so responsive, answering by the minute and made our stay so comfortable.
This place was the first Airbnb I've ever been to that was better than a hotel stay. Would absolutely recommend.

The location is absolutely perfect if you want to be in the middle of Lisbon action! Lots of restaurants are at a walking distance, as well as a bodega right around the corner. Not to mention, a historic tram running along the street. Now, the apartment is chic and no detail was left out: stylish furniture, a wifi speaker, a huge wall mirror, fashion photography wall art, a comfy couch with cute cushions, a bottle of wine (!!), Tom Ford coffee table book we couldn't put down, citrus on the kitchen table, potted flowers, a cozy patio, something we haven’t encountered at an airbnb - bath robes and the cherry on top was a personalized note with 2 delicious chocolates! This place left us feeling like we stayed at a beautiful boutique hotel! Climbing up those stairs is absolutely worth it.

Loved our stay! Very flexible when our plane was delayed and we needed to push our check in time. Meeting the host was helpful to understand the appliances and ask any questions about the area. The space was clean, comfortable and bright. We loved all of the little surprises left for us. Would stay here again! Thank you!

Great to meet host Francisco. Smooth check in and the best way to start a holiday in Lisboa. Clean, cozy and vibrant location. Close to everything in the city centre and very good value. Will stay again next time in Lisboa

Great apartment in excellent location for first time visitors to Lisbon. Charming and comfortable overall, but the real star of this place is the fantastic terrace. As others have mentioned, there are quite a few stairs to climb, but no more difficult to navigate than the rest of the city. Noise was not an issue during the week. I'd say this apartment is best for a couple--the second lofted single bed is pretty cramped and the ladder is tricky. Team was waiting  for us upon arrival. Checkin was super friendly and efficient. Location is in a lively part of the city. It was walkable to attractions and to metro, tram and train lines. Metro from airport was easy--just follow host's valuable direction to exit station through Largo Do Chiado to avoid climbing a final slope with luggage. Bottom line: great stay and we'll be recommending to other couples visiting Lisbon.

If you need the perfect air bnb to stay in Lisbon….look no further! As a solo female traveller I felt safe and comfortable staying here. The street is so fun and lively in the evenings (that being said it’s very quiet in the apartment since it’s on the 5th floor). Pedro & the team left a cute bottle of wine, some chocolates & some of the famous pasteis de nata. The patio is amazing and it was the perfect place to unwind after walking around all day or getting over jet lag. Overall this is such a perfect place to stay in Lisbon. 10/10 would recommend !!!!

Amazing place to stay. As beautiful, stylish and as clean as staying in a hotel. Recommend this place to everyone, the aircon was a life saver in the summer heat! But also, later on so lovely to have the balcony to enjoy a drink on. Lots of kind touches, coffee, wine, oranges, an iron!
Plenty of bars and places to grab a bit on the same street, I recommend Bar Pica for petiscos and a cocktail.
As stated in the listing, there’s 5 floors of steep stairs, so it’s advisable to bring a backpack over a suitcase!
This place is AMAZING! Located on such a cool street in the heart of the city. The space was clean and comfortable and was the perfect retreat after a long day of walking around the city.

There are many reasons this loft is ran by a super host. Well appointed, clean, comfortable easy to contact and an ideal location come to mind. I would not hesitate to book again, my host went out of his way to spend almost an hour with me answering general questions on everything from nightlife to train schedule on top of the packets of suggestions provided which were accurate I used several of his restaurant choices with much success. He provided a portable wifi which in my opinion is next level brilliant especially for the international tourist. The 5 flights of stairs can be a little taxing and note there is a light switch button next to each persons doorbell please USE IT to climb the stairway at night, I only figure this out the last day being American. Thanks again for providing an epic Airbnb with thoughtful touches you are the perfect example of why I love this site.

Eine sehr schöne kleine Wohnung in Lissabon, die für 3 Leute ausreichend ist und alles hat, was man für einen Kurzaufenthalt braucht! Die Betreuung durch Pedro und sein Team waren sehr gut und alle waren super freundlich. Auf dem Balkon kann man richtig schön entspannen und hat auch eine ordentliche Größe.
Die gute Lage bringt natürlich in der Nacht etwas Lärm mit sich, aber dafür ist alles fußläufig zu erreichen. Für leichte Schläfer sind Ohropax dementsprechend zu empfehlen.
Wir können es auf jeden Fall weiter empfehlen!
The host was very responsive and helped us find suitable convenient parking. The loft was ideal for a short stay in Lisbon.

Zdecydowanie było to nasze najlepsze doświadczenie z Airbnb do tej pory. Mieszkanie na żywo wyglada jeszcze lepiej niż na zdjęciach i znajdziecie tam wszystko co może przydać się podczas pobytu. Lokalizacja jest idealna, przystanki komunikacji miejskiej są w pobliżu mieszkania ale w duża ilość miejsc można bez problemu dostać się na piechotę. Gospodarz przywitał nas podczas zameldowania, był bardzo przyjazny i pomocny. Polecamy i w jeżeli będziemy w Lizbonie w przyszłości z chęcią znowu zatrzymamy się w tym miejscu.

We had a fantastic stay at Pedro’s place in Lisbon. Great location on a lively street, walkable to many great restaurants and things to do. The outdoor patio was a real treat after a long day of exploring. Don’t let the 5th floor walk-up deter you, this place is a gem.
Francisco was a great host, he was super friendly, explained everything in the apartment and provided suggestions for stuff to do nearby! Would definitely stay again!

Stayed there for 4 nights with my husband and kid (4 yrs). It‘s right in the middle of Barrio Alto with lots of restaurants and bars close by. Really nice view from the rooftop terrace. Check in was easy and the apartment has all the amenities needed (AC is great!) - we were even surprised with some pasteis de nata and a chilled white wine upon arrival, which was super sweet!
We didn’t mind the stairs, just the noise down from the streets was a bit disturbing during the weekend-nights. Overall we really enjoyed our stay and would recommend!

Clean, tidy nice size flat right in the heart of the action. Loved the atmosphere in the evening, but as mentioned a bit of chatter on the Friday night. Didn’t bother me. Hosting was flexible and helpful. Great stay, thank you.

A beautiful space with clear attention to detail, equipped with everything you may need. The balcony was our favorite feature. The hosts went above and beyond in responding to our every need and inquiry. Thank you to Rui and the team for a great first time in Lisbon!
This was the perfect place to stay! Super cool space, beautiful terrace, great amenities, and all steps away from  incredible bars and restaurants. Would absolutely stay here again!

Place was beautiful! Very open and bright. While some mentioned it was very noisy, for being right in a busy location, I couldn’t hear anything. The bed was very comfortable and bathroom clean and updated. The lighting in the bathroom was a little dark, but there was a mirror in the main living space with a little counter and plenty of natural light. Did not use the bed in the loft space, so cannot comment on that area.
Overall, great location, beautiful space, and responsive individuals to help if you need them. Would definitely stay there again if I’m ever back in Lisbon.

Thank you!!We had a great stay in your apartment.The location is fab and we would definitely recommend it to everyone!!The balcony was a welcome relief after a busy day sightseeing!! The apartment was fully equipped with everything including a lovely cold bottle of wine!Sebastian was there to meet us with a friendly welcome and was able to answer any of our questions.Lisbon….we will be back!!!

This is the perfect spot if you are looking to be in a great, walkable area! The hosts are beyond accommodating and shared so many recommendations with us that we listened to and loved! Highly recommended!

We had such a wonderful stay! We loved the terrace and the location. The welcome gift was so thoughtful and kind. Pedro was responsive and had great recommendations. We were able to walk everywhere. Loved being right by the trolley. We would definitely stay again!

Wonderful host with great communication. Apartment was squeaky clean and in a perfect location for visiting Lisbon. The two of us were very comfortable there and would not hesitate to book it again.
As others have already commented, however, be aware this is a top floor apartment with many stairs. Pack accordingly. Also, as mentioned, the area is lively at night. You will hear people having a good time outside until the wee hours. Lastly, as pictured, the bed is literally a mattress on the floor, so not the ideal situation if you have issues getting up and down.

We loved staying at this apartment! From booking all the way through check out, the hosts were incredibly communicative and clear. The apartment was beautiful and central to everything we wanted to do! We were able to walk everywhere we wanted to go in Lisbon (also a short walk to the train to see Cascáis and go into Belem).
There was some noise at night during the Santos Populares celebrations (we were given a heads up by the host months in advance) but most other nights were pretty quiet (we stayed during the week). We didn’t mind the noise at all, we were grateful to have such great proximity to the celebrations!
I would absolutely stay here again! I couldn’t recommend it enough if you are able.
It was a beautiful space with amazing views over the rooftops on the walkout balcony. Very lively area with lots to do and great food and drink!
Beautifully decorated apartment in the perfect area to walk to all the go to places. The patio was so nice to sit on and relax after a long day of walking.
Perfect apartment, great location and Pedro and the guys are fantastic hosts!
We had a fantastic stay in Lisbon. The flat was beautiful and at the perfect location to explore.
Perfect location and most beautiful flat! Highly recommend!!

Don’t let the 5 floor walk up scare you - this space is worth every single step. The loft is packed with amenities and is close to everything. The only negative is that the space is so wonderful you may not want to leave to explore Lisbon!

Absolutely fantastic. Loved this little bolt hole which was small but perfectly formed. It had been recently refurbished so the apartment was even better than the photos. There were so many lovely touches like a complimentary bottle of wine and oranges to squeeze for juice in the mornings. Communication and location were also great. Thank you to Pedro and the team.

This is probably one of my favorite airbnbs I’ve stayed in. The views from the balcony are amazing, the neighborhood is lively (can be loud at night but it’s fun to partake in the nightlife), and the space is truly immaculate. The decor is tastefully done and the hosts were extremely flexible. They let us drop off our bags before checking in so we could roam the city, they were on top of messaging, and so friendly. They provided lots of great recommendations upon arrival and even gifted wine and pastels de nata :) I’d recommend to anyone coming to Lisbon and would absolutely stay here again. Thank you Pedro and team!

My wife and I had a great experience on this beautiful place. Antonio was very helpful.
Great location and clean. The portable modem for internet was a plus especially when you are going out and knowing to have internet at all the time.
Highly recommended your place and we are definitely suggested to our friends and families.
It was a great airbnb experience! Everything was thought beautifully. And I fell in love with Lisbon.

Nous avons passé un magnifique séjour à Lisbonne, avec 5 jours de grand soleil. L'appartement est idéal situé (très centré) et nous avons tout fait à pied, ce qui est pratique. Il y a d'excellents restaurants dans la rue et beaucoup d'activité à faire à proximité. Nous conseillons vivement cet appartement pour un séjour à Lisbonne.

Everything about our stay was terrific. Well located and appointed. Personal checkin was excellent with complimentary wine and pasteis de nata, a local favorite. Outside terrace was lovely for morning coffee. Many restaurants, bakeries etc in the neighborhood. We would highly recommend.

This apartment is a great find. It is in an excellent location to enjoy Lisbon's sites, hundreds of restaurant options and fun shopping. This apartment is well equipped and maintained. Pedro and team were communicative and flexible.
Be aware there are five floors of steps (no lift) but don't let that stop you from staying here.
太棒了，房东很细心，只是第二张屋顶的床空间太小无法起身，其他的设计堪称完美
Great location, loved our stay
Nice apartment in a great location. The hosts were great and communicated quickly. 10/10 recommend.
Amazing place with a great little terrace. Right in the heart of Lisbon. Pedro and the team were super helpful too and made the stay extra special. Very much recommend

Pedro was a great, responsive host. He and his team always offered to help with bags and provide recommendations for getting around, restaurants, etc. For international travelers they also provided a mobile hotspot which was a huge help when exploring around the city. Great host and space, would recommend.
The apartment is greatly designed, cozy, clean. Every detail is thought. The location is great. We loved Pedro’s place. Definitely will stay here again our next time in Lisbon.

What a cute and quaint place! It was amazing to witness the attention to detail as every corner I’m this Airbnb has been made to be usable space. The decor is amazing. The unit is walkable to all the action. I recommend this space to anyone visiting Lisbon!
Loved staying here! Very well located and lovely apartment
Stayed here for a couple nights, met Francisco at the apartment for a very easy check in. Beautiful apartment, excellent location, I would recommend for anyone wanting to explore Lisbon.

We loved our stay at Pedro's apartment. Our hosts were responsive and very helpful, and the apartment itself is absolutely beautiful. Easily the nicest, most beautifully decorated Airbnb we've stayed at, and the location is very central.
The only two things prospective guests should be aware of is that there are a number of flights of stairs to climb, and given the central location there can be a bit of noise from the bars below so light sleepers may want to bring earplugs, but we were well aware of this before our stay and neither of these bothered us at all.
All in all, an amazing apartment, top-notch host, and we would gladly return in the future!
Superb location for night owls...

We really enjoyed the apartment. Great location. The patio was one of our favorite parts of the apartment and have a glass of wine after a full day of seeing Lisbon. we loved being able to ride the cable car up to the apartment. Your whole team especially Francisco, Anthony & Rui were always accessible and took care of any issues we had during our stay. We thank you very much.
Great place to stay.  Very quaint and close to all the amenities. Great host
Extremely responsive and very welcoming!!

Beautiful apartment, good use of space! Host was so friendly and everything worked perfectly. Great view of the roofs and river.. we took some great photos! Comfy bed, lots of low lighting which I love instead of fluorescent. The microwave and stove was difficult to understand but it is probably because we are from the USA. Great value overall!!

The apartment was fab!  There is a huge terrace with a view out toward the water and just below (tho you cannot see it from the terrace) is the Bica lift.  While we visited in January and it was a bit too damp to sit outside, with the terrace doors open the apartment almost doubles in size!  And of course with the well crafted European doors and windows, the apartment was pretty quiet with them closed.  The lighting was cozy and warm, there was a heat pump that kept the rooms perfect.  We did not cook but there was a well appointed kitchen if rather compact.  It had all the things we look for in a perfect stay:  comfy hang-out space, terrace or outdoor space and walkable to local sightseeing and good food.  Don't let the 5 floor walk-up deter you!

Pedro’s place is clean, modern and full of whatever one needs for a stay. The location could not be better. The host also left some pasteis do nata for us and a bottle of wine in the fridge. They welcomed us and gave a very detailed explanation plus kept our luggage as our flight was a bit later in the day.
Will definitely come back if we come back to Lisbon.

We had a wonderful stay in Lisbon! The check-in process far exceeded our expectations as we got a personal walkthrough of the space. The location, although in a lively area at night, was very central to a lot of the things we planned to do during our stay. It was also nice that we had some warning for how busy the area gets at night and the opportunity to rebook if needed, though we were also part of the late night crowd so this was perfect! Very easy check-out and the loft looked exactly as it did in the listing as well. I would absolutely recommend this host again!
The place is really beautiful and clean, the location is amazing , but keep mind there is no elevator

Pedro and everyone on his team were so kind, understanding, accommodating, helpful, flexible and communicative.
I would highly recommend to anyone considering Lisbon, and this neighborhood in particular, to stay here (as long as they’re ok with some stairs).
The spot alone is worth 5/5 stars. But if I could give a 6 out of 5 for the support behind this home I would. Thanks for a great time!

What a nice surprise being on the street we were on. Amazing little apartment with a cute rooftop to hear what’s going on below. Lots of stairs to the top floor but it’s worth the view. Walkable to chiado, bario alto and hundreds of bars and restaurants on the doorstep. Pedro/Francisco/Antonio we’re super responsive, friendly and helpful. We’d stay again!

Location, location, location. Pedro's place was the perfect base location to explore Lisbon from. It's located on the Tram 28 line & walking distance to Rossio station which is one of the big hubs. We were able to comfortably explore the shops, alfama, Belem Tower, LX factory, timeout market and even walk to the train station for a day trip to Sintra. I think the best part about the location is that it borders Barrio Alto, where most of the night life is so the late night walk back is always the shortest!
Yes the studio is on the 6th floor, but the flights are relatively short and shouldn't be an issue if you're reasonably fit. The studio itself was very nicely decorated & comfortable (heating & ac worked well). There were a lot of thoughtful touches that made us feel very welcome - the host greeted us with local pastries and there were chocolates & fresh oranges for us to enjoy in the studio. There were also two pamphlets of personal recommendations for things to do/places to eat which we used extensively! Overall a great place to stay & will definitely recommend it to family/friends that want to travel to Lisbon.
The place was fabulous!  I mean everything…. Actually better than the pictures and they are pretty great.  We will return and sending as a recommendation to co-worker now.
Cannot recommend this place enough! The apartment was amazing.  The location was equally as perfect.

Words can’t describe how beautiful this Airbnb was. The patio and decor were everything we could’ve wanted it. Very modern and up to date. The location could not have been better. Hosts go the extra mile in every sense. Very professional. It was slightly smaller than I had thought it would be, but the size was perfect for what we were looking for (just not a lot of storage space for clothes if you wanted to unpack).

The photos don't even do it justice how great this space is. Pedro was super welcoming and we really loved staying here.
Amazing location, awesome rooftop, beautifully decorated. Would stay again in a heartbeat.

If we could give 6 stars we would. An absolutely stunning apartment in a great location. The level of detail and design in the apartment is wonderful. We felt at home instantly. Communication with the hosts was easy and they were very accommodating in arranging an earlier check in for us. We would stay here again in a heartbeat!

I cannot speak highly enough about our stay here! Truly felt like we were in the best location (amazing restaurants & bars just steps away). The AirBnB was perfectly clean and Pedro even gifted us with a bottle of wine and a couple of traditional Portuguese pastries. Very well thought out space. 10/10 recommend.

What an absolutely amazing experience. The location could not be beat, walkable to so many shops and restaurants as well as great public transportation. Upon check-in we were given a walk through of the apartment, showing us all of the details that they included to make us feel at home. The space itself was lovely, tastefully decorated, and very comfortable for my husband and I.
We had some issues with the space on the first day and the response we received after reaching out was so fast and thorough. They had the issues sorted and presented us with options to ensure that our vacation stayed on track. The professional and courteous response to the issues made us even more determined to stay here again, if we are able to return to Lisbon. Truly, an amazing experience made even better by the support and hospitality of the hosts!
Wonderful stay and thoughtful touches!

We had a good stay. Great location! It did feel a little less safe in the evening.. we felt the need to hurry past a group of loitering people to get to our door unbothered. But no issues, of course. The flat was lovely. The bed was on the floor and not super comfortable (which only became annoying night 3 and 4 of our stay). The hosts were attentive and kind and let us check in early which was awesome! Loved the neighborhood. Good restaurants and coffee nearby.
Amazing apartment in an excellent location

We couldn’t have found a better place than Pedro’s loft. It is located in a great location- very central and the apartment is so well stocked. We loved having our own private terrace to drink glasses of wine and enjoy Lisbon! It had everything we needed including a dishwasher, laundry and a large screen TV. The kitchen is extremely well stocked. Pedro and his staff were very attentive and answered all of our questions in a very prompt manner.  We would gladly stay there again. Well done!!!

Beautiful place and fantastic location! They were very accommodating as our flight came in early and they were able to store our luggage prior to check in. It’s perfect for a couple traveling and looking for a prime location. Other reviewers noted the noise from outside but we didn’t have any issues with that. While it was definitely lively outside, it was faint / white noise on the inside. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a prime location during their stay!

Amazing location to be in the heart of Lisbon and with the night life right outside your door.
Super helpful and left us lovely local treats. Also if you don’t come with any plans, Pedro left helpful pages on places to eat and visit.
Great flat with a super location. We really had a nice stay.

This apartment is impeccably furnished and the location is great.  Transportation stops within a few minutes walking, Time Out Market maybe 10 minutes walking (and use the Funicular to bring you back), neighborhood is really safe and fun.  Would definitely stay here again!
Fantastic spot. Great hosts. The entire experience was exactly what I was hoping for.
Amazing accommodations and location. Excellent host and extremely clean apartment! We highly recommend! ❤️

Absolutely wonderful stay! The photos don’t do the apartment justice. Beautiful and just enough space for my boyfriend and I to stay for a few days. Pedro and his team were highly responsive and went out of their way to assure we had all we needed, answer our questions, and give great recommendations for how to make the most out of lisbon. We would happily stay here again. Location also was excellent, beautiful picturesque street in the heart of downtown. The stairs (there are a lot of them!) are well worth it.

The perfect spot for a stay in Lissabon! We enjoyed everything about this beautiful accommodation.. the interior is made with so much love and the roof terrace the perfect place for a breakfast and start of the day!

The host was very responsive, gave great recommendations and was overall very helpful! The apartment was very cute and clean and in a great location. I would highly recommend and definitely stay again!
Not much to say but a perfect Airbnb stay all round and you wont be disappointed if you stay here.

Would 100% recommend this to anyone. The one thing we werent sure about based on the reviews was the amount of space - we were a group of three men and thought there was plenty of room for sleeping and hanging out. Can’t beat the location, the view form the balcony, and the hospitality from the hosts.
Awesome spot and location. Highly recommend!
Such a cute airbnb! Perfect location & the hosts were so welcoming and communicative throughout our stay. Highly recommend!
Amazing Aparttment with a beautiful design and a great host that took care of us and made us feel like we’re at home. 10/10 would recommend staying there!

Amazing place with amazing location. The deck is just such a nice feature in a heavily populated area like this. Could be at an amazing restaurant 5 minutes after having wine on the deck! Can’t beat that

Pedro's place is an absolute gem. Well-located near all the sights in Lisbon and although it's a studio, it still felt extremely spacious and modern. Fantastic spot! Had everything we needed and the host was excellent
Hidden gem
Beautiful apartment, wonderful location, stunning deck. Pedro and his team made us feel especially at home.
An amazing place to stay in Lisbon! Beautifully decorated, perfect location, and a very thoughtful host. Highly recommend!
Couldn’t have asked for a better stay. Pedro communicated extremely well and place was perfect. Thanks Pedro!
Such a beautiful airbnb! in a perfect location and had everything we would need. we will be back!
the apartment and location were perfect. The hosts were so helpful and accommodating with both check in and check out and everything in between.

Incredible place for our stay in Lisbon! The apartment is truly central and close to anything you need. The outdoor area was a dream and they provided recommendations for enjoying our time in the city.

Perfect stay! Well-furnished, comfortable, with an amazing patio. Great water pressure in the shower, which had a waterfall spout. The apartment had every amenity that we could have asked for—I really appreciated the Brita filter, the electric kettle, the combo washer/dryer, the dishwasher, and the air conditioner, which all worked flawlessly. Finally, Pedro and Rui were extremely friendly, accommodating, and communicative, and even went out of their way to make sure we  knew about upcoming train strikes that might affect our travel. One of my favorite Airbnbs I’ve ever stayed in—would definitely return.

The loft itself was modern, spotlessly clean and the use of space fantastic. The terrace was an amazing space to relax after a day of exploring.  The only drawback is the noise from the street at night; there are a couple of bars which are open until late with lots of drinkers on the street, so it can get very noisy and make sleep a challenge.
This is a great place to stay in the heart of a vibrant district In Lisbon. We have stayed here before.

This is the perfect spot for a younger person to use as a home base while visiting Lisbon. Well appointed and designed with lots of extra touches in anticipation of your needs. It is a walk up and in a popular area for street festivals, so just be prepared for a bit of street noise on weekend nights. Instead of earplugs, I recommend that you just join the party!
This place is really good
We loved our stay at Pedro spot. Perfect location for starting city adventures. Pedro was very thoughtful and communicated well throughout the entire stay. Would absolutely recommend !!
Beautiful apartment, perfect location, loved our stay!

Amazing location and very cute apartment! Small space but very thoughtfully designed.
