Such a lovely place to spend a few days in Lisbon. Fabulous terrace in the sky, easily walkable to the most delicious restaurants, right on the Tram 28 for adventures further afield. Best of all, a calm and restful atmosphere to relax and delightful hosts.
Great little place in the heart of Lisbon.  Convenient to everything.  Great hosts.  Great stay.

This is a 10 star airbnb. Style and comfort is amazing. The hosts are super friendly and responsive to your needs. They go above and beyond with all sorts of thoughtful touches. Did not want to leave as it felt like my home.
Great host! One of the good Airbnb I have ever stayed in. Easy communication and they are super hospitable!
Everything was perfect. The location is great and the apartment super nice and cozy.
Great central place to stay, cool space, nice outdoor area. Very friendly host who left wine, chocolates and cakes for our arrival.
Amazing stay, the place is lovely and the view is beautiful. It’s quite spacious for a studio and didn’t feel small. Loved our stay will be happy to stay there again when in Lisbon! Thank you !

Amazing place in a great location. It was close to timeout market and all the main attractions of Lisbon. The host was amazing. This place was 100% amazing because of the extra care to details the host provided. It made us truly enjoy the Airbnb over past stays. We would definitely stay here again.
Wonderful and cozy studio located in the center of Lisbon.  The street is very busy at night, so bring earplugs.

We loved our stay here— the location is amazing, the view is gorgeous, and the interior is stylish. Antònio was the one to greet us, and he was very flexible with late check in and check out times. Super appartement, bien placé. Rien à dire et que dire des communications! Ils ont même booké un test PCR pour nous. Meilleur service ever!!!
We had a wonderful stay. Perfect location and accommodations. Our check-in process was smooth and personable. Highly recommend!
Pedro’s place was absolutely amazing. We were super comfortable, the location was great and the rooftop is a huge bonus! Highly recommend!

Beautiful place. Great position. Special features and art on the walls. The kitchen facilities are small and poor. We ate out most of the time.

Very nicely designed space. The second bed was a litte troublesome getting in and out of because of the ceiling. Central location and convenient.
Amazing stay!

Super logement pour visiter Lisbonne ! On a adoré le style du logement, son emplacement pour des restos, supérette à côté , et arrêt de tram ! This was a great place to stay! It was perfect for my husband and I. It was walking distance to a lot of places and sites! I would stay here again, highly recommend!!

Such a good location with the old trams in the same street!
The apartment was clean, trendy and had a really nice feel to it. Little extra touches and welcome gifts from the hosts were lovely as well.
Definitely recommend to anyone wanting to visit Lisbon!
The apartment was very homely. I really enjoyed staying here. The team was very helpful and welcoming.

What a great place to stay! The location is perfect for exploring the city & though we could hear people outside at night we didn’t find it too loud with the windows closed. The details were perfect & everyone we interacted with was so kind & helpful.
Amazing stay here.  I've stayed with Pedro and his team multiple times and always trust that it will be a wonderful experience.

It has been our second time at this beautiful Appartement and we again enjoyed it very much. Also the communication was very easy. Everything was perfect. We can warmly recomment this appartement for your stay at Lisbon.
AMAZING and beautiful loft. so convenient. in the heart of town and walking distance from local markets and stores. The terrace is a great feature of this loft. Would definitely stay here again.

Couldn’t have been better - we stayed for 2 nights. The location is amazing and the roof terrace is great in the evenings. Diogo was really helpful and made sure we had everything. Would definitely return again.

Among the many Airbnb's we have stayed in, this apartment was one of the most beautiful, because the all-inclusive package simply fit. We will definitely come back.
Nice place and great host. If only there are a lift ... would be perfect. Enjoyed my time there and sure will be back !

Great location, ultra stylish, and full of consideration. The property team makes sure your experience from check in to checkout is seamless. I especially loved the recommendations for food and drinks; they led us to some amazing dining experiences!
Thanks a lot, it was an amazing week end in this beautiful house.

Wow. What a place a little gem in the heart of Lisbon.

Het was een geweldig verblijf! Top locatie. Gezellig en leuk voor zowel jongeren en ouderen. Heerlijk om te koken in de keuken en te eten op het balkon. Erg gastvrij. Voor herhaling vatbaar! Zeker een aanrader!!!

Gorgeous apartment, great location and amazing hospitality with personal touches including custard tarts and a bottle of wine. Can get very noisy outside on some nights until around 2am - we slept fine most of the time but the noise kept us up on one night.

Unser Aufenthalt in Lissabon war einfach toll, das Team um Petro hat uns freundlich empfangen und uns Tipps für den ersten Abend gegeben. What a lovely space! The whole apartment is clean, comfortable, and full of thoughtful amenities. However, the best part of this apartment is the private terrace - the perfect place for soaking up the sun in Lisbon!

My wife and I just finished our trip to Spain/Portugal, staying in 5 different AirBnBs over the course of 17 nights. Here's how this one stacked up:
CHECKIN/CHECKOUT: Easy - Diogo met us at the apartment and showed us around. He had a bottle of wine and some other small gifts for us, which was very nice. I messaged him on WhatsApp and he stayed in communication with me throughout our stay. Checkout was easy as well: just leave the keys and go.
APARTMENT: This is a really cool apartment on the 5th floor with lots of great features and quirks. The balcony patio is very nice and although the view isn't great, it's wonderful to have somewhere to relax outside and drink some of that wine he gave us! It's a little small but due to the open layout it feels bigger and we were comfortable. One minor complaint is that there isn't enough lighting in the bathroom so I didn't even attempt to shave my face until our next stop.
SLEEPING: The air conditioner worked very well so the temperature was great to sleep. There are blackout curtains for all windows, including some that are custom Velcro that you attach/remove at your convenience. There are lots of windows so it's important to be able to keep it dark. The bed was extremely comfortable with one quirk: it's under a slanted part of the roof and at one side of the bed you can't really stand up...so if mobility is an issue at all, you might have a problem. Also, it can be fairly noisy late into the night. Despite being on the fifth floor, you can hear partying below. The street below as actually really neat with a funicular going up and down (not loud) and little bars where people buy drinks and sit out on the steps and drink/talk/party. If you like absolute silence at night, you will probably need earplugs. Personally, even though there was a lot of noise, it was relatively far away and I was able to sleep fine without my earplugs.
SHOWER: The shower itself is nice and the waterfall shower head should be great...but there just simply isn't enough water pressure to make it work. In fact, I think the waterfall design actually made it worse due to the low pressure. It's not horrible though - I'd call it average from my experience traveling in Europe - and maybe above average since it is spacious.
LOCATION: Noise issues aside, this is a great location. The party street below, funicular included, made it feel like a really cool/alive part of town...and we felt like it was safe. It was a short walk in any direction to the places we wanted to visit, with lots of shops and restaurants very close.
OVERALL: We really enjoyed our stay here. The shortcomings with the noise, shower, and bathroom lighting were definitely outweighed by the location, super comfortable bed, and the patio balcony!

Apartamento precioso, con una decoración espectacular, suuuuper bien situado (al lado del Barrio Alto) y con unos detalles de recibimiento signos de mención (botella de vino, dulces típicos, bombones, café...). Repetiría sin duda.

Wonderful small apartment in a lively spot of Lisbon. Everything you could need is walkable. Blackout curtains provided but we didn’t need them. Lots of stairs to walk up, so be prepared! Apartment was small but exactly as pictured. Wonderful amenities and extremely welcoming and helpful hosts!
Si vous recherchez un très bel endroit charmant avec terrasse sur les toit et en hyper centre, c'est ici !

For our first time it Lisbon it was so perfect! Apartment is right in the middle of everything ! We felt we were part of the city. Diogo and Antonio were super helpful and we would love to come back again and hopefully stay in another one of your apartments or the same one ! Thank you x

A chic small penthouse located in the most central street of Lisbon, few mins walk to the Elevador de Santa Justa. The view from the apartment is beautiful. Perfect for 2-4 people, but there is no elevator so might not easy for guest with heavy luggage.

We had a 23 hour layover in Lisbon so we could only enjoy the space for one night, but it was so nice. Five stars!!!!! Help when wanted and quick guidance for us to enjoy our private vacation trip! LOVE

Pedro's apartment was one of the best AirBnB experiences I've ever had. Great value for our family trip. Highly recommendable if you come to Lisbon. Thank you Pedro!

Excellent, clean, and stylish apartment in the heart of Lisbon. Loved the view from the patio, and all of the nice touches provided. It was everything we hoped it would be!
Wonderful neighborhood.  The apartment is lovely and the terrace is great.

Centrally located, and easy to walk to everything from bars and bustling nightlife, to great restaurants and quiet, historic neighborhoods. Very responsive hosts too! Beautiful loft with an amazing terrace. It has everything you need and it’s really close to all the central places. I would definitely recommend anybody to stay here. Very good communication with the host!

Super séjour dans cet appartement. La localisation est top, vous êtes à proximité de pas mal de choses. La terrasse est vraiment agréable quand il fait beau. Great location, walking distance to most places of interest, close to public Transportation and parking should you have a rental car,
House well decorated and perfect for a couple.

Pedro's place is extremely central and cozy. All the main points are in a walking visit, plus restaurants and bars are everywhere. We have stayed there for 5 days and all went well. Très bon emplacement pour une visite de Lisbonne et ses quartiers typiques ! Je recommende vivement cette adresse et ses hôtes.

Overall a great stay. Great location but nightlife in the area might be a problem for some. Lots of stairs to get to unit in the fifth floor so make sure you’re in shape.  Host is great and accommodating.

Great place!!

My friend and I were traveling to Lisbon for the first time with very little knowledge of the city or where to stay. The location of this apartment was so central to EVERYTHING we wanted to see in the city and it was on one of the most picturesque blocks in Chiado. The space in the apartment comfortably fit 2 people (but you can squeeze 3 without a problem). The outdoor deck is definitely an added bonus and a nice place to enjoy a glass of wine while getting ready for dinner or watching the sunset. When returning back home at night the street was filled with young people enjoying a drink from one of the many little hole-in-the-wall bars that line the block. We felt really immersed in the night life culture but never once did we feel unsafe. The street can get a bit noisy at night, but the windows and doors are relatively sound proof and did a good job blocking it out (shortly after we confirmed our booking the team made sure we were aware of it and during our stay we honestly weren’t bothered by it at all - even on the nights when we went to bed early). Our hosts were easy to get in contact with for any questions and the recommendations they provided us with were stupendous!
We were celebrating my friend’s 30th birthday while in Lisbon and Gançalo and his team went out of their way to organize balloons and champagne upon our arrival which made our experience all the more memorable! I would highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking to travel to Lisbon. If you are like me and reading all the reviews to help reinforce your decision I hope this is the review you read!
I would recommend this apartment for anyone looking for a comfortable place to stay in a great location in Lisbon with wonderful hosts!

Great location if you want to be in the heart of the lively area in Lisbon.
Lovely apartment with everything you need! And the terrace!! Wow! We really recommend this flat for anyone that want to stay in the middle of Lisbon! Great hosts!
You can expect thoughtful, caring, friendly, and flexible hosts are go the extra mile to make you feel welcome! Fabulous location!!! Wonderful apartments! Will definitely stay there again. Thanks.

We had a great 3 night stay in the loft. It was perfectly located for our neighborhood walks, with tons of great food, bars, and sights to see nearby. We would definitely recommend to friends visiting Lisbon!

2nd stay with the Chiado Loft team !!! Professionals and kind people ! You will love the warm of the apartment and some welcoming details we will surprise  entering the flat ! I will be back with you guys again for sure !

This is probably one of my favorite Airbnb's that I have stayed in. The location was fantastic and the patio was perfect to enjoy the beautiful weather. The space was big enough to accommodate 4 of us. Check in was easy and there was a lot of nice touches. If I come back to Lisbon, I would definitely stay here again.

Otherwise, this flat was lovely and as advertised, and Pedro was a great host.
Pedro’s place was great! It was central to everything & it was very beautiful, homey and quiet. Definitely recommend for anyone staying in Lisbon!

Antonio and Pedro were super hosts. Our plane was delayed and we did not arrive until after 1AM. Antonio was there to greet us and even helped carry the luggage upstairs. The apartment was had everything we needed.

Great stay in Lisbon. Thank you for help making our trip easy. I will highly recommend this place to friends.

Really amazing apartment in the heart of the city. Thank you António for being so patient when we were late with our check in and for refreshments you prepared for us. The apartment is really nice and clean, fully equipped. The mobile wifi device is a great idea.
I can fully recommend this apartment.
Nice location, comfortable bed, excellent patio and warm, helpful welcome!
Nice little apartment, well located and perfect for our needs. Communication was friendly and easy from start to finish. Would recommend.

A great location, I highly recommend the tapas at Os Bons Malandros just across the road. The apartment was beautiful, especially the balcony. Our wonderful hosts were really understanding and kind even when we were slightly difficult guests! We had an amazing time here and many happy memories were made.

we verbleven met 5 vrienden in deze prachtige, schone loft op n perfecte centrale locatie. bij aankomst lagen er kleine attenties klaar en het contact met de eigenaar verliep steeds heel soepel en hij reageerde snel. echt n aanrader!
Wow, five stars all round!
Das schöne Apartment von Pedro  würde ich immer wieder aufsuchen wenn ich nach Lissabon reise😊
Gute Unterkunft. Ein Bett war schwierig zu erreichen, selbst für Kletterer ;-) Route B3+. Sonst stylisch, sauber, Nespresso Kaffeemaschine inkl. Kapseln war top!

Amazinf stay in this place of Bairro Alto !
Perfectly located to discover the city

Prachtig appartement in een hele leuke, levendige buurt van Lissabon. Om de hoek bij een halte van tram 28 waarmee je een leuke rit door het oude centrum kunt maken. Het appartement voldeed aan alle verwachtingen. Het is mooi, schoon en de ontvangst was heel erg hartelijk. Het dakterras is ruim en heerlijk zonnig. Het appartement is precies zoals op de foto’s is weergegeven. Er is geen lift om het appartement te bereiken dus traplopen is onvermijdelijk. Er was ‘s nachts wel overlast van de bars onder het appartement (wij waren er woensdag/donderdag/vrijdag) maar met een paar oordoppen in was er goed doorheen te slapen.
L'appartement était parfait. Le voyage fut exceptionnelle et l'équipe est vraiment professionnelle et très serviable. 5 étoiles.
This was such a nice, stylish and hip apartment. Everything was clean, communication went quick and well. I would always book again
Perfect place in Lisbon! Unbeatable apartment, attention and location. I am looking forward to coming back soon. Obrigada Goncalo and the Chiado Lofts and Studios Team!

Great apartment. Amazing patio and has washer dryer (beware shrunk my clothes but a drying rack was available and don’t fault the owner).
A loud bar is downstairs if staying on thurs or fri but it seems like there is a curfew around 12am.
We had a great stay.

Magnifique appartement, très bien situé. Vue splendide sur les toits et le Tage.
Hôte très réactif, aimable et sympathique.
Petite ruelle typique lisboète avec le vieux tram et plusieurs petits bars, ambiance festive et amicale.
Bon à savoir: plusieurs étages et pas d'ascenseur.
Appartamento bellissimo, la cornice perfetta per un viaggio stupendo. Posizione comodissima, confortevole, arredato molto bene. Sicuramente consigliatissimo.
Great flat. Genuine and helpful people there to assist and help out. Nice central location for entertainment and sightseeing.

Great comuncation, beautiful appartment with amazing terrace in the heart of barrio alto.
Perfect for a long weekend in Lisboa... wish i would have stayed more.
I will definitly try to go back there when i come to Lisbon again.
强烈推荐这个地方！房东很热情，初次见面还给我们准备了蛋挞和巧克力，并给我们推荐了周边的好去处，房子更是完美，装修风格超级温馨，房子很干净，设施齐全，值得一提的是，房子的地理位置太好了，就在那个著名的缆车景点旁，每天都有许多游客前来观赏，而我们就住在那个巷子里.
What a pad! Great location, amenities, and cleanliness. Communication with the host was quick and accurate. Close to Metro and other forms of public transportation. You won’t be disappointed!
Nice host with nice location in the historical area

This place was perfect! Absolutely five star accommodation, very stylish and also very clean. Check-in was very easy with Antonio there to meet us when we arrived and was hugely helpful with tips about the best restaurants. Amazingly located with shops, bars and restaurants in walking distance. Loved it!
Our stay was great! Lovely apartment in a centric area. Recommended
Great listing with a beautiful balcony in a super central location
Excellent location in the heart of Lisbon. Stylish and very clean appartment with a large and sunny rooftop terrace. Will definitely go back upon my next visit to Lisbon!
If you are a couple looking to stay in the Chiado area of Lisbon this is your place!! Beautiful flat with amazing patio! Check-in with António was seamless. He gave great tips for local restaurants.

Fantastic apartment - ideal for 3 people and the location is ideal if you want to be in the heart of Lisbon. You can hear crowds at night from the streets below if you have the windows open - but only in a great atmospheric way. Loved this place and Pedro was a great host.
Amazing apartment located in a great neighborhood! Close to public transportation. Street is full of nightlife which we enjoyed. Hosts are amazing!

First of all: This is an amazing apartment in a prime location in Lisbon! The place is just beautiful, especially the terrace is great for epic sunsets. A brand new bathroom with a rain shower made us feel like staying in a luxury hotel and Pedro was a perfect host, treating us with wine and some local sweets.
You should be aware that the apartment is on the 5th floor of a very old building - so it's quite a challenge to get your luggage up and down the steep stairs. Also it's quite noisy all day and night as this is the neighborhood where people love to hang out for drinks, talk and music.
But overall I definitely recommend staying at Pedro's place - you're right in the middle of everything and can easily walk everywhere!

Amazing place! The location was just perfect, walkable to everything in Lisbon, great view on the terrace. Pedro’s team was had perfect and very fast communication and great hospitality - they left fruits, wine and a small surprise for us! Hanks so much guys, perfect stay!
Wonderful flat for a couple to explore Lisbon! Terrace is amazing!

Stylish apartment and we were properly welcomed by the host (tour of the house, restaurant tips, etc). Very centric location, but a bit noisy downstairs at night (important if you want a very quite area). Amenities, specially Nespresso machine coffee / red local wine and sweet local pastries added a delicous touch to our stay. Guillermo

This apartment was perfectly located in the heart of Lisbon in a very nice neighborhood full of shops, restaurants and bars . We were able to walk to all major sights and really enjoy the city. The hosts were super responsive / helpful and left very thoughtful touches in the apartment -- we found a booklet that they created with local recommendations, wine, fresh typical pastries, chocolates, and Nespresso cups. The apartment is stylish and the terrace was nice to enjoy both day and night. There is a row of bars immediately below but the noise didn’t bother us (the windows were pretty well insulated and there was a curfew).  The crowd also never bothered us when we would come home. If you have mobility issues, this may be a little tough for you because it is downhill on stairs on a street and the apartment itself is a five floor walk up (with a steep first set of stairs). We appreciated the exercise since we were conducting a little search for the best pastel de nata ;)
Piso pequeño y acogedor. Precioso tal y como sale en las fotos. Anfitrión súper atento y agradable. Ubicado en una zona muy animada y cerca del centro. Todo genial!!

We had a great time in Pedro's place. It was the little things - they left us a few pastries, a small bottle of wine, some chocolates. And the big things too - we were able to get an early check in and when we were leaving, Antonio ordered a taxi for us. The apartment is beautiful, in an ideal location. Highly recommended!
Nice and cousy place in a great position for those who want to feel the vibe of the city.

Appart très cosy et agréable, propre, bien décoré ! Un accueil au TOP ! avec des petits détails sympa pour commencer le séjour (Bouteille de vin, pasteis de Nata, welcoming card personnalisée,..) Logement bien situé dans la ville malgrès le bruit le soir des fois mais suportable ! ALMA LATINA !

This flat was and amazing place to stay in. Very nice hospitality and a spectacular view! I would go here again for sure. The flat was clean and very cozy and really looked like the pictures. When we arrived we got fruit, chocolate and a bottle of wine!

Excelente apartamento, exatamente como nas fotos. Super limpo e confortável, com todos os equipamentos necessários e úteis. O atendimento e a hospitalidade também são ótimos. O apartamento fica em bairro com vários bares e restaurantes. Há um inconveniente apenas: a balada fica abaixo da janela, e por isso tem bastante barulho, todas as noites, até tarde na madrugada.

Pedro/ Goncalo were excellent hosts. All the little treats added (Pasteis de nata/ Wine and chocolate on the bedside table) made our stay very pleasant.
The place is really nice and well located. The balcony is perfect for a pre-evening drinks before going for diner/ night out with a view of the "Sanctuary of Christ the King" and the "25th April bridge".
Nices bars/ restaurant and plenty of places to visit around.
I'll recommend Pedro's place :)
Clean, centrally located and a friendly, helpful check in process - what more could you want?

The apartment was perfect. The area was central and easily walkable, and the apartment itself was stunning. We loved the terrace and the beautiful view of the rooftops and the river. The area was quite lively at night and a little bit loud, but with the windows closed it was no problem at all. Thanks for a great stay!

Vi tyckte det var väldigt fint att bo så centralt och stadsljuden var bara en trevligt inslag för oss som bor på landet. Lägenheten var jättefin och vi avnjöt frukosten på terassen varje morgon. De branta smala trapporna upp till lägenheten gav oss fin motion :) Pedro var en bra värd och vi skulle gärna vilja komma tillbaka någongång!

Had an amazing stay at Pedro’s place. The location is very central with lots of restaurants and shops within walking distance. The place itself was perfect for our group of 4, the hosts warned us that it may be a little too crowded but we had no issues adjusting. As others (and the hosts) have stated the street below is loud at night but we were more than happy to deal with a little noise to enjoy this fantastic flat.

Lovely apartment in a fun and central location. Guests should be advised it is at the top of a 5 story walk up, although it really didn't feel that far up and the views are worth it! Lots of thoughtful touches in the apartment. Ideal for a couple or 3 people. We were 4 and a bit cramped. Would definitely stay again!

Pedro’s place was perfect for the three of us. We especially loved the big patio, the large bathroom, fluffy big towels, comfy beds and nice linens. The space was open and very stylish. We appreciated the custard tarts and the Nespresso capsules too! The location was close to the city’s best restaurants and it was easy to walk around to all the attractions. It was definitely noisy at night but we were able to close the windows and put on the air conditioner, so we were not bothered. I would recommend staying here if you are fine with night noise.

My friends and I had a great stay in Pedros place. The appartment is super cosy and the terrace amazing for a late afternoon drink with great views. Location is top, maybe a bit noisy, but not that it bothered us. Actually it brought the liveliness of Lisbon into the appartment. They are very professional and great hosts. Any questions are answered immediately and we got great tips where to eat, drink and how to get to the appartment from the airport. We would definitely stay there again. Thanks a lot - we had a great time.

Appartement chaleureux et atypique idéalement situé à proximité des commerces et des restaurants/bars (idéal pour les jeunes souhaitant profiter de la vie nocturne de Lisbonne).
L'hospitalité de notre hôte ne fait aucun doute : acceuil amical, petits gestes fort sympathiques (bouteilles de vin et chocolats) et les suggestions de sorties en sont des preuves évidentes.

As the other reviews mentioned...yes the apartment is on the 5th floor, yes there is a bar below which is quite loud, however, this apartment is all about location location location. Its on the most photographed street in Portugal and is therefore a perfect location to go anywhere in the city. The apartment also has a black out curtain at the base of the bed which was perfect for sleeping in. The bar noise didn't bother us as we are native NYCers. There was just two of us with quite a bit of luggage since we had been in Portugal for 2 weeks for a wedding. It might be tight to try and fit another 2 ppl with luggage, but for us it was perfect. All the essential amenities have been thought of. I only wish we could have stayed longer!

We would recommend this location it's located right in the main area for restaurants. Excellent service from host. Comfortable room with a great bathroom and shower. Large patio. The only concern we have is the loud music right outside that goes on until 2am each night. Don't worry we have a solution get a white noise app installed on your phone  turn it up it will drown out the street parties each night. Great location and excellent service the host has provided everything you need for a great stay.

My wife and I stayed 4 nights and absolutely loved it. The location is central to everything including all forms of transportation. We found the loft to be incredibly clean and tidy upon arrival. I would definitely book this loft again and I would recommend it to a couple or a small family.

We thoroughly enjoyed staying at your lovely bnb!  The whole team is wonderful.  Thank you for all the little kind touches throughout our stay. We highly recommend for anyone to stay here. If we return, we would like to stay here again!

great apartment.
But a lot of noice/music during the evening/night.
(the apartment is located in the "party area")
Pedro and his team were great. Antonio greeted us with a tasty pastry and some helpful tips on Lisbon. The place is smack in the heart of the city. We really enjoyed laying out on the sunny deck

Stunning apartment in the heart of the city. Many bars and restaurants are literally on the doorstep. It's a great base to explore Lisbon from.  The apartment is very clean and Antonio met us and explained everything to us. Recommended!

Très bonne location. Bouteille de vins et pastel offert a notre arrivée. Appartement tres bien situé.
Merci

Appartement très bien équipé, service nickel (changement du linge en cours de séjour, fruits et vin à l arrivée). L appartement bénéficie d une jolie terrasse bien exposée (bronzette possible de 12 à 18:00!) et il est au cœur de la hype lisboète. Revers de la médaille : la rue pourtant piétonne est très bruyante une bonne partie de la nuit. L appartement est climatisé.

Great location, especially if you like the nightlife! If you don't, then don't choose this apartment on the weekend. The loft was clean and convenient to everything. We loved the patio and the bed was very comfortable. AC couldn't keep up with the hot weather.

Apartment is in an excellent location next to restaurant, shop and bars.  Apartment was very well decorated and we enjoyed having a good sized balcony.  Although the apartment looks small it is so well laid out that it did not feel small.  Only negative was the air conditioning wasnt greatly effective.  I would return to this apartment as the location, decor and facilities were so good.

The loft is in a very central location, and it is neatly decorated. Perfect place for a couple, and the terrace is the real highlight of the flat. Keep in mind that the flat is located in a popular nightlife area. It was lively on a weekend night (Saturday), but the noise did not persist past 2300 on a Sunday night.
Highly recommend for younger couples looking to enjoy everything Lisboa has to offer, especially the nightlife! Everyone in the area was super friendly, and we felt safe even with lots of people congregating on the street right outside the apartment. The check-in process was straightforward, and Pedro was great at accommodating changes in our schedule.

Wir hatten das Glück in Pedros Apartment übernachten zu dürfen. Es ist sehr konfortabel (Geschirrspüler, Waschmaschine, alles was man braucht ist vorhanden) und modern  eingerichtet. Die Wohnung ist sehr sauber. Nach zwei Tagen wurde sogar eine Zwischenreinigung gemacht und die Hantücher erneuert. Wir wurden von Gonzales begrüßt, der sehr freundlich war und uns alles erklärte, was wichtig war. Außerdem waren wir von der Dachterrasse total begeistert. In der Nachbarschaft sind 2 Bars, daher muss man sich darauf einstellen, dass es abends auch mal lauter werden kann. Wir haben uns nach kurzer Zeit schnell daran gewöhnt. Wir möchten uns ganz herzlich bei Pedro für den netten Aufenthalt in Lissabon bedanken!

This was an absolutely perfect place for my wife and I to spend a weekend break in Lisbon. Situated right in the heart of the city's best urban scenery, nightlife and restaurants, the apartment is beautifully set up for a couple on a brief stay, with all mod cons including a/c - and a roof terrace perfect for morning coffee or evening drinks. Two minor caveats about the location: it's on the top floor, which means you have to climb quite a lot of stairs to get to it. And there's quite a noisy bar on the street just below. If you have trouble sleeping with street noise - I don't but my wife does - bring earplugs!

Great place in a great city.
Pedro and his team were great hosts. Very attentive, efficient and responsive...Nothing was ever too much trouble.
The apartment is beautifully bright, very clean and well equipped.
We all had a lovely time in this lively area of Lisbon and would definitely stay here again.
Lovely apartment in a great location. Hosts very helpful! Will definitely stay there again next time we visit Lisbon

This may well be one of the nicest airbnbs I've ever stayed in - from the incredible location to the impeccable stylish decoration inside; the beautiful outdoor patio down to the incredibly kind gestures from the hosts of a bottle of wine, some egg tarts and chocolates by the bed! It was like staying in a 5 star hotel but having the whole place to yourself! Yes, there is a bar outside where people will sit out on the street and drink with their friends, but it wasn't a disturbance to us by any means, and this area is known for its fun night life so that's why you're looking here in the first place! Lisbon stole my heart and I think there's a good chance we'll be back in the near future and we'll hopefully stay here again!

Location is perfect if you are looking for bars restaurants and nightlife. Street parties are crazy with local music and people. Friendly staff in bars within the vicinity. Pedro and Antonio were professional and helpful during check-in. Special mention to Viktor who owns the small bar (actual name) across the street. He will sort you out. 10/10 in all aspects

Pedro's apartment was very clean and tidy. The amenities are great, you have everything you need. The terrace is a great space to watch the sunset and birds fly overhead.
The location is great for getting around, close to station and local cafes etc but this meant it is very noisy at night so difficult if you're a light sleeper.

Fantastic apartment in the heart of Lisbon! We loved the place and everything about it! It's perfectly located very close to everything the city has to offer. Pedro was a superb host, great communication and flexible check-in. He left some fresh fruit, pastries and even a bottle of wine in the fridge. Big plus to the wi-fi dongle that we could carry with us when we were exploring the city.
We'll definitly come back!

Lovely place! It was so beautiful and the location was perfect the only issue was the street party for the holiday that went till 6 am and was so loud we had trouble sleeping. I wish we were warned about it before booking. On any other night this place would've been perfect!

The Chiado loft was very centrally located in a great part of town. The space is well decorated, clean and quite bright. The terrace is lovely and has a beautiful view of the city.
The listing says it can sleep 5 people, which is I suppose is possible, but would be very tight quarters. I stayed here with 2 other girls (3 total including me) and there is one double bed, one twin bed (which is lofted) and one L shaped couch (that doesn't pull out). This place is best suited for a couple or 2 people, it's quite small for 3 people, or people needing their space.
The loft is on a lively street with a lot of nightlife. It's perfect place if you are into the nightlife scene. There was a lively festival steps outside our door while we stayed, we could hear the live music from the lovely terrace.
As other folks had mentioned, the loft is on the 5th floor. It was no problem for us.
The people managing the loft were very nice. I worked with Pedro when booking and Antonio met us in person, they were both lovely.
I would probably stay here again, but either by myself or with my partner. The street is a little too happening for my own taste, but that may be rather exciting to you. Thank you!

We were really looking forward to our weeks city break in this cool apartment. On arrival we were treated to a little bottle of wine, a couple of delicious pasteis nata from Manteigaria (better than the hyped Pasteis de Belem!) and a comprehensive summery of things to do and places to go. Lovely Goncalo even helped with my bag all the way up to the 5th floor...obrigado!
The gorgeous photos trick you into thinking that the apartment is way bigger than it actually is but we were 2 people and it was just right although the place is advertised for 5...that would be pretty crammed to say the least. Everything is to very high standard, lovely bathroom, mini kitchen with all necessities, great little Nespresso machine but overall design over function. There was practically no storage space for bags/suitcases, or shoes...the wardrobe was tiny and only accessible by stepping onto the sofa. To get into and out of bed you needed to bend/crawl to avoid banging you head on the slanted ceiling. But we still loved the place, its central location and most of all the sunny terrace! A very nice touch is the wifi dongle when out and about, so no roaming charges on your mobile! In fact the wifi was very good in the apartment, there's a TV but we didn't really watch it. Goncalo, who met us when we arrived was really helpful with any requests we had and even arranged for me to leave my bag behind after check out as my flight was quite late in the day. Thanks for that, I really appreciated it.

We were delighted by how clean, modern and comfortable the apartment was. Though it is located directly on the steep street, with the yellow lift parked right in front of the entrance, it never felt unsafe. It is quite a social area at the entrance, but everyone was polite and friendly at night. Note that there will be some street noise from below on busy evenings, but we used the blackout curtains and slept very well.
Exactly where you want to be when you visit Lisbon!
This apartment was dreamy. We would come back to Lisbon just to stay here, it was hard to leave.

L'appartement est magnifique et très bien situé, avec une superbe petite  terrasse . L'accueil a été  très soigné et attentionné (petites attentions et mobilier pour bébé) , nous avons adoré notre séjour !  L'appartement est situé au-dessus d'un bar, qui est vraiment très animé (comme toute la rue) jusqu'à environ  3h du matin , afin de dormir tranquille, nous avons acheté des boules quies,  ce que je recommande. En dehors de cela, tout était parfait !

Loft ideal, perfectamente equipado y en una ubicación óptima para conocer la ciudad a pie y captar toda la esencia Lisboeta. Tanto si tu intención es salir por la noche como disfrutar del día, el apartamento de Pedro es genial y el trato de su equipo INMEJORABLE.
We spend fantastic days in Lissabon. The flat is small and cute and has many Bars, Restaurants and commodities around.

Everything was wonderful! The apartment was beautiful & Pedro was kind enough to leave us wine, pastries & chocolate. The apartment was clean & had everything that we needed. There is no elevator, so getting our heavy luggage up 5 flights of stairs was a challenge, but the beautiful apartment made it well worth it. The street is very loud, we could here chanting & music well into the night. We didn't mind, but if you are looking for a quiet place this probably isn't it. The location was perfect & if we return to Lisbon, I would gladly stay here again! :)

We enjoyed our 3 night stay at this complete compact loft apartment.  Communication for arrival was completed swiftly.  Our lengthy climb to the loft (no lift) did not despair our excitement to be in the wonderful district of bustling lively neighborhood. We did not use kitchen only breakfast , but was good.  Free mobile wifi was a wonderful addition to take each day as we explored.  Easy close-by grocery store and location very good.  Thanks again for safe clean wonderful stay.

Brilliant location. Step outside your door to the venicular to the water and Tram 28, the scenic tram.
The unit has everything you need including washer/dryer, iron, portable WiFi etc.
There is a list of all the recommended restaurants and the supermarket is just around the corner.
Just remember its the 5th floor and no lift as in the description but well worth it. Wonderful Air Bnb and highly recommend it.

We really enjoyed our couple of nights in this apartment and are already planning a return visit! The loft was beautifully laid out, had everything we needed and the location was perfect. If you're a light sleeper you may want ear plugs as the street is popular at night but it wasn't a problem for us. Antonio and the team looked after us really well and made sure we had everything we needed.

Amazing apartment! We enjoyed our stay a lot, living in one of the most typical streets of Lisbon! Climbing up the stairs to the 4th floor was challenging for my 80 years old grandparents but we they had great help with the luggage from Pedro and his team. All in all a great experience! Thanks a lot for having us!!

Perfect apartment, clean, new, designed. PERFECT city getaway. Pedro & team went above & beyond to make sure we were happy.
Do keep in mind that it's located in a busy neighborhood :)

Appartement impeccable et bien situé pour visiter la ville. Bon accueil, cadeaux de bienvenue très appréciés.
Le soir il y a des nuisances sonores dues au bar en bas de l'immeuble.
( prévoir boules quies )
Nous ne regrettons tout de même pas notre choix.
Great location, clean, good hosts.

Chiado Loft 1 is a super comfortable apartment. The outdoor space is delightful. Great sitting area, dining area, sleeping area, washing machine, dishwasher, even the steps up to the apartment helped us get our exercise!! Everything is right here. You are in the Bica--a very lively neighborhood with everything you need right here. The ascensor (funicular) is right outside your door to ride down the hill. The world is photographing this very location. There are bars, restaurants, grocery stores in every single direction. Choose a new direction each morning. The AC is a nice treat and somewhat muffles the late night celebrations. But if you are a light sleeper you will want earplugs.

Très bien accueillis par Gonçalo. Des Pasteis et une petite bouteille de vin nous attendaient à notre arrivée.
Appartement très propre et bien équipé (machine à laver, lave vaisselle, machine à café, wi-fi...).
Seuls petits inconvénients, quartier animé avec du bruit le soir jusqu'à 2-3h, et escalier étroit pour monter au 5ème étage (pas d'ascenseur). Manque quelques rangements.
Nous sommes tout de même très contents de notre séjour dans cet appartement avec une petite terrasse très agréable!

We had a fabulous trip thanks to the team at Pedro's place. Wonderful welcome touches, very easy to communicate via phone or message and the apartment was incredible both inside and location-wise! Thank you!!

Excellent apartment!
Pros
Bright and sunny
Great Location
Tastefully decorated
Thoughtful details and welcome gifts
Cons
Noisy at night, not a problem if you are venturing out until the wee hours of the morning!

L'appartement est très beau, et idéalement situé. Mais il est vendu comme un appartement pour 5 personnes, cependant 2 des personnes dorment sur le canapé (non convertible), 1 autre sur une mezzanine bas de plafond au dessus de la salle de douche. Pas de lieu prévu pour s'isoler un peu quand on est 5 à l'intérieur. Je pense qu'il est fait pour 3 personnes. Mais sinon l'accueil fut parfait, ponctuel et avenant.
Beau logement, dans une rue typique de Lisbonne! Très bon accueil de l'hôte
Such a thoughtful host! Beautiful home as advertised, and left us a bottle of wine. Great view from the terrace.

Highly recommended! I am from Lisbon so I was very careful choosing a place. The location is awesome and the apartment amazing. To make things perfect, the team is great and Antonio is the kindest hoster you can imagine.
Thank you all - we love it!
A wonderful location! You find everything you need around this amazing flat. Pedro and his team are very kind and professional. A perfect place to enjoy the city!

Pedro's loft was exceptional. Very big on the small details that stood out immediately. Bottle of wine vino being one of them! The Portuguese Tata's were also a very nice touch. Couldn't have asked for any more of the smaller details. The small details really stand out when it comes to offering a comforting and inviting stay. Extremely thankful for that!
**I will note the building is older and the unit is on the very top floor. There is no elevator for use so if you have large luggage due to traveling on elsewhere or just a lady who cares to over pack lol you will have to hike up 5 flights of steep wooden stairs. Expect to be sweating if you are making more than one trip. Other than that, exceptional!
-J

Absolutely perfect weekend break apartment. Very stylish: open plan and yet cosy also. Has everything u could hope for... including a wonderful rooftop for watching sunsets. Close to just about everything including the tourist stuff but also secluded cafes, restaurants and hangout spots. Landlord couldn't have been more helpful either... I'd highly recommend a stay here.
Great place, great value.

El apartamento sorprende al entrar. Muy luminoso y perfectamente acondicionado y cuidado en muchos detalles. Perfecto para unos dias en pareja.
La calidad del apartamento compensa la subida de los interminables y en tramos, incómodos escalones.
La situación es perfecta. A pie de casi todo, y rodeados de tiendas, restaurantes, tranvia... pero más tranquilo que el barrio alto. Es el barrio que más nos ha gustado para alojarse.
Ah, y un acierto el wifi portatil
Tudo 5 estrelas! Desde a localização, ao conforto da casa, do terraço e à simpatia e generosidade dos anfitriões. Recomendo 100%

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour en famille ! L'appartement est extrêmement bien situé, en plein coeur du quartier du chiado, niché dans les toits de Lisbonne. L'hôte a été très attentionné et à l'écoute. Et la liste des restaurants proposée à été très utile. Nous n'hésiterons pas à revenir dans cette location pour un prochain séjour.
Wonderful apartment in an amazing location. Antonio and his team were really accommodating and great hosts. Highly recommend staying here!
Standing ovation to this beautiful flat! Tastefully furnished, clean, fantastic location. My sincere recommendations!
Always perfect to stay in one of the appatments Chiado studios team..!

The Chiado Lofts & Studios Team était d'une aide précieuse dans la préparation de notre week-end à Lisbonne! Ils étaient très réactifs dans leurs réponses et l'appartement était conforme à la description. Un super séjour!

We really enjoyed staying at Pedro's place.
The Appartement is beatiful and looks exactly as on the pictures. It is bright and welcoming. From the terrace you have a view towards the river and the bridges - the perfect place to watch the sunset with a glass of wine and some good music.

It is in the perfect location to discover Lisbon and to go out at night. Everything is just in the neighborhood.

The contact with Pedro and his colleagues was perfect. They managed everything for us!

I just can recommend the place to everybody and I am looking forward to go back the next time I will visit Lisbon.
Très bon accueil et très emplacement central à Lisbonne, cumulés avec une disponibilité sans faille de notre hôte.  Une décoration faite avec goût et charme.

Really, really nice! Looks just like on the photos. We had a nice time there with 5 girls.
Directly in the city center. We had portable wifi for our trips wich was a great bonus!
The only tiny handicap is the bed on top of the bathroom. For all of us girls it was way to narrow. But for a kid it should work i guess :)
But all in all we are all highly recommending this place.
Loved this little space! Very chic, clean, great amenities, loved the terrace view - and a very convenient spot! Would certainly come back. Thank you!
Very nice stay. Great location, close to the Metro. Clean and modern. Fast internet and some English TV stations. Wish we stayed for more than a day. Perfect for two or three people.

Pedro was quick to respond the moment I inquired about booking. Leading up to our arrival, communication was easy and we were warmly greeted. The loft was in the perfect location and looked exactly as shown. There were also thoughtful treats left by the team to welcome us. I would definitely recommend a stay here if you are looking for a lively spot surrounded by great restaurants and bars, and close proximity to many of the city's best sights.

Modern and well-equipped apartment on the last floor. Huge terrace with the beautiful view! Central location near the metro. There is a loud rock pub on the ground floor and a cableway on the street but it's almost inaudible when windows are closed. Antonio greeted us warmly, communication was easy, smooth check-in and check-out. Highly recommended for short and long stay in Lisbon!

Pedro was extremely accommodating with checking in and checking out; he allowed us to leave our bags in the apartment until we had to leave for our flight.
The photos on the website are exactly as the apartment looks, the whole place was spotless and the team left chocolates, cakes and wine for us! I would definitely recommend the apartment and come back again. The nightlife outside was a little noisy - but nothing a good pair of earplugs didn't block out. We had an amazing stay and loved the apartment.

Très bel appartement.
Très bien situé.
Super accueil.
Hôte très arrangeant autant à l'arrivée qu'au départ, notamment avec nos bagages.
Fruits, patisseries et vin à notre arrivée.
TOUT PARFAIT.
Un grand merci à tous

This loft was fantastic! It's a beautiful space, very well laid out. You forget you are in a studio. It is bright and airy, and the terrace is huge. Everything is updated and modern. There is an induction stove, air conditioning, wifi, even a Bluetooth speaker. The linens are good quality. Excellent location, very short walk to just about everything.
The hosts have literally thought of everything and go out of their way to take care of you. They met us at the flat and had a chilled bottle of wine, pastries, and a handwritten note with chocolates waiting for us. Antonio took the time to show us around the flat. Overall in the booking and logistical process, his response time was immediate and always helpful.
We were very sad to leave, but would absolutely book this flat again!

Vi åkte 4 tjejer och bodde 3 nätter i denna lägenhet. Vi tyckte att lägenheten var superfin och väldigt fräsch. Även om det bara var ett rum så fungerade det väldigt bra att bo flera i den. Vi blev väl omhändertagna när vi kom. Fanns bakelser, vin o choklad som dom lämnat till oss och sängarna var renbäddade. Antonio var lätt att få kontakt med och vi kunde även checka in senare på söndagen och det var toppen. Lägenheten låg jättebra och vi kunde gå nästan överallt! Trapporna upp till lägenheten var dock väldigt brant och passar inte någon som har problem med knän el dyl! Hit vill jag åka igen!

Die Unterkunft ist sehr zentral gelegen und hält alles was sie verspricht. Die Wohnung ist sehr schön und sehr modern eingerichtet und hatte alles was wir benötigten. António hat uns sehr freundlich begrüsst und uns Tipps für Restaurants und Bars gegeben. Als kleines Geschenk standen sogar eine Flasche Wein und die leckeren Pasteis de Nata für uns bereit. Alles in allem perfekt!

The apartement is great: modern with a nice decoration, extremely well-equiped (coffee machine, washing machine, dryer, hot spot to have internet everywhere with you...), a space well-optimized and an amazing terrace perfectly oriented (you have the sun all along the afternoon, you can even see the famous bridge, the Tage and the Christ). The bed is comfy.

The location of the apartment is great also. You have everything at walking distance: the animated Bairro Alto, Chiado, Cais do Sodre and its unbelievable food court.

Pedro and Antonio are very professional. Antiono was very friendly and gave us very clear information concerning the functionning of the apartement and its equipements.

A very good place to stay in Lisboa.

We stayed here for the first three nights of our honeymoon. Antonio greeted us warmly. We appreciated that he responded quickly whenever we contacted him and was flexible with our check in and departure times. The apartment is on the top floor in an excellent location! Antonio provided a comprehensive list of restaurants to try within a quick walk. The apartment was clean and the bed and couch were comfortable. The shower had very good water pressure. The decor is modern and attractive like the photos. I would recommend the loft for people who would like to eat out, as the kitchen is small. Also, the stairs are steep. We did just fine, but it might not be best for anyone with limited mobility or tons of luggage!

Fantastic apartment with everything you needed for a city break- great location and lovely furnishings and plenty to do and see on the doorstop! Luis met us at the apartment and was incredibly warm and helpful and made it clear that he was available for any questions throughout the visit. There was a bit of noise at night time from the street but we closed the windows and used the aircon which blocked it out. Thank you for a fantastic break- we would definitely recommend this apartment to anyone staying in Lisbon!

Our host was very patient and helpful. The location was absolutely perfect, right in the heart of Bica. Tons of small bars and restaurants and arty boutique stores as well as the historic funicular railroad right outside the front door. Simply perfect!

Tudo foi perfeito, desde a reserva ate o final da nossa estadia em Lisboa. Antonio e Pedro sempre muito solicitos e prestativos. O apartamento é lindo e pratico. A localizacao é fantastica, com restaurantes, mercados e padaria na esquina. Esperamos voltar em breve!

Pedro hat uns extra angerufen, als die Wohnung schon früher bezugsfertig war, hat uns persönlich begrüßt und uns alles erklärt und gezeigt. Es gab sogar ein Begrüßungsgeschenk. Die Wohnung liegt toll und ist gut zu erreichen. Die Terasse draußen ist wunderbar. Total klasse!
Beautiful appartment and terrace ideally located. Perfect for a long weekend (can fit up to 3 people). There is a Nespresso machine and you can take away the flat's wifi thanks to a gadget.

Pedro's place in the Bairro Alto district was beautiful! Quick walk to a number of sites in Lisbon and some great bars/restaurants/clubs in the area as well. Thanks for the stay, will definitely seek out your place in Lisbon upon my return!

Pedro and his team were immaculate.  The apartment is in a prime location of Lisbon and they left a list of recommendations of things to do and places to eat.  I would say the highlights are the cleanliness, decor, the bottle of wine, tarts, and wifi card that you can carry around with you.  Helpful for those of us without unlimited international plans!  I would stay again and visit Lisbon in a heartbeat.

The team managing this place is wonderful. They are very clear and organized. The loft is so clean and designed beautifully. They even had multiple gifts for us. The location is perfect for exploring all of Lisbon. It is the best Airbnb I have stayed at.

Appartement très bien placée et d un charme fou
Tout est fait avec goût
Le propriétaire à de délicates attentions pour ses hôtes il avait prévu du vin pour notre arrivée et des pâtisseries locales
Vraiment très sympa tout est parfait
Si je devais faire une remarque c'est qu étant en plein centre et dans une rue avec des bars mêmes au 5 eme étage on entend mais cela change rien à notre avis
Appartement super sympa avec sa terrase

Nous avons été très bien accueillis, Antonio nous a facilité l'arrivée en nous permettant de déposer nos bagages avant le Check in. Nous avons apprécié les petites attentions ( vin, fruits et chocolats)
L' appartement est idéalement situé, très beau et la terrasse est parfaite ! Je recommande !

We loved our stay at the chiado loft. The loft is beautiful, and very central. It's a very convenient location for exploring central Lisbon on foot. The bed was comfy, and the terrace was lovely. Despite the party on the street level, it was whisper quiet in the space, and we slept like babies.
Perfect flat for a perfect moment !! Thank you very much Pedro

The loft has a fantastic location! It was clean and stylish and we in particular enjoyed the wonderful roof terrace! Pedro had left us a list of recommended restaurants and we were very impresed with the recommentions. We tried several and had wonderful experiences every time.

This is a fantastic apartment right in the middle of the busy and buzzing Chiado. There is everything you need inside and loads of great bars, restaurants and shops as soon as you step out of the door. It's lovely to have a rooftop terrace with views of the river. Great team too, very helpful. Highly recommended.
Great location and place! Would definitely recommend it!

Das Team rund um Pedor hat uns herzlichst empfangen, alles war zu unserer Zufriedenheit, obwohl das Appartment noch gereinigt wurde, durften wir bereits unsere Koffer dort abstellen uns wurde sogar geholfen unsere schweren Koffer in den fünften Stock zu tragen. Die Wohnung war in einem einwandfreien, sauberen Zustand und super stylisch eingerichtet. Im gemütlichen Bett haben wir 5 Nächte wunderbar geschlafen, auch wenn die Straße unten teilweise relativ viel Lärm gemacht hat, es ist nunmal ein sehr belebter Stadtteil. Falls jemand empfindlich sein sollte, einfach Oropax mitbringen ;) Von der Wohnung aus sind mehrere Supermärkte und Bäcker fußläufig zu erreichen, auch sonst sind Unmengen von Restaurants, Bars und Sehenswürdigkeiten perfekt zu erreichen. Die Jungs haben auch eine feine Liste erstellt mit Tips was man alles erkunden sollte, für die nicht fußläufig erreichbaren Teile der Stadt, einfach ein 6 Euro Tagesticket kaufen oder mal eine Rundfahrt mit den TukTuks unternehmen, vorzuziehen sind eindeutig die elektrischen ;) Wir würden jederzeit wieder kommen. Danke für die Gastfreundschaft!

Amazing apartment with everything you could need. Bed was very comfortable & apartment was very clean & tidy. Great rain shower and balcony. The added bonus for us was they had a wifi dongle that you could take out of the apartment with you, so you could always have Internet access. A little thing that was incredibly helpful. The location is fantastic on a Main Street with lots of bars & restaurants close by. If I go back to Lisbon I would definitely book this apartment again.

This apartment was fantastic! And Pedro and his team were super helpful, responsive, and friendly at every step of the way. The apartment is every bit as cool as the pictures make it out to be, and the location is perfect. It's right on a street that has a funicular going up it. In fact, I think this street was on the cover of the guidebook to Lisbon we brought with us! Such a cool feeling to come out onto the street and see people taking pictures of it every single time. Loads of restaurants and bars in easy walking distance. And the 28 tram is just at the top of the street. Even though it's in a very lively part of town, the double-paned windows kept it nice and quiet at night. Thanks for a fantastic stay!

Excellent appartement, très bien situé, nous avons été agréablement reçus avec  une multitude de petites attentions telles que, bouteille de vin, chocolats, fruits pour le petit déjeuner....ainsi que le chaleureux accueil de luis( qui je suppose doit travailler avec pedro) je recommande !!!!

Our time in Lisbon was short but could not have been better! This apartment is beautiful and perfectly located. Pedro made our arrival very easy and we were greeted with wine and pastries. I highly recommend staying here.

The studio was very cosy and we felt like we were at home, except the weather is better, food is cheaper and everybody is friendly. Location wise, it's perfect, close to everything like supermarket, tube and of course bars/restos. Luis was very helpful with our questions and we had a great communication. Highly recommended and we will definitely be back again (for the third time with these awesome hosts).
We were let in right away, the apartment was clean and modern, the location was perfect. I would 100% recommend this place to anyone looking for a local Lisbon experience. Thanks Pedro!

ABSOLUTELY LOVED THIS PLACE! We can't recommend it more. Its serious a special find in Lisbon. Gorgeous old historical building right on the train street, super modern cool space, the amazing outdoor patio to over look the rooftops, you can walk to some of the best restaurants, viewpoints, and the Time Out market from there. Small but great kitchen, fast internet, nice bed and awesome living room area! Pedro was super nice, and left us wine, egg tarts and chocolates. Such a treat.

Excellent air b n b experience. Luis was absolutely fantastic and accommodating from the time of our arrival (we arrived late after a delayed plane to wine and Portuguese tarts) until our departure. He also returned our iPhone charger which we left behind! The location is unbeatable and close to some fantastic bars and restaurants. I would thoroughly recommend this listing!

This apartment was ideal for our group of 5 girls who wanted to enjoy the city life, eat good food and drink well. It's in an ideal location, close so many nice bars and restaurants (I reccomend Park bar just 5 mins away.) we were greeted as soon as we arrived and found that our room had been kitted out with some wine to enjoy! So kind. Sleeping arrangements were absolutely fine for us, especially as we were usually out til late-  the sofas are comfy and the mezzanine is great. I would reccomend to any friendship group who want a base in the heart of the city and a fantastic view.
Des petites intentions de  bienvenue  comme des fruits ,un vin de pays, des petits chocolats  et un petit mot de bienvenue

Beautiful apartment in a great location. Nice touches from the host (wine, chocolates, free wifi - even when out and about!). Nothing seemed to be too much trouble - even when we arrived earlier than expected.

Apartment is exactly as it looks on the pictures. Balcony makes this a perfect place to stay.

Nous avons été très bien accueillis par Antonio. L'organisation était précise et le RDV a été pris dès notre réservation. Excellent accueil avec présentation de l'appartement et remise d'une fiche avec tous les bons plans aux alentours. Nous avons apprécié les gentilles attentions prévues à notre arrivée (chocolat, pasteis, oranges, bouteille de vin au frais !...), l'appartement est bien conçu et fidèle aux photos. L'emplacement est parfait. Nous étions avec notre fille de 6 ans qui n'est pas une grande marcheuse, nous étions au coeur des transports (le funiculaire da Bica qui passe dans la rue est vraiment chouette). Nous recommandons vraiment cet appartement qui a de plus une terrasse très agréable, idéale pour prendre un verre ou un café. Pas de problème de nuisances sonores. Merci nous avons passé un excellent séjour et reviendrons avec plaisir.

Wow! Our experience with this Air BnB truly set the bar sky high for our perspective of Air BnB as a whole. The hosts were absolutely AMAZING and went out of their way to provide a complimentary bottle of wine, delicious Portuguese pastries, and a free portable WiFi device for us to use. The accommodations were modern and just down right gorgeous, like we had walked into a interior design magazine set. The location was perfect, and easy to get around right in the heart of the happenings. We will definitely stay there again on our next trip to Lisbon, and I HIGHLY recommend booking this place because I guarantee you won't find a better deal.

Quel plaisir de séjourner dans cet appartement ! Nous étions 5 copines pour un EVJF et cétait vraiment L ENDROIT PARFAIT ! l appartement est idéalement situé, dans la rue la plus mignonne de Lisbonne!!! La terrasse était vraiment parfaite, l'intérieur nickel. Vraiment un superbe appartement !! Dans lequel je serai ravie de retourner en  amoureux !!
The apartment was beautiful! Plenty of extras like portable wifi that were really helpful. The location was fantastic and the place was clean with a beautiful view. We will be back soon!

This was an amazing place to stay with great amenities. We truly enjoyed lisboa and the loft was a perfect place to call home for 3 days. The wifi hotspot they provided was a great added touch and we definitely enjoyed having that with us.  We rented a Twizzy one day and were able to explore the city at our own pace and we would recommend this. We ventured to Sintra for a day and had a magical time, the sites to see there are truly amazing! Portugal is a very cool country and we wish we had more time.  The renters were very approachable, professional, and easy to communicate with. We were greeted with a bottle Wine and special Portuguese deserts.  The nespresso machine that was provided made for an easy cup of coffee in the morning, too! Thank you again for great service, accommodations , and amenities.

Loft espectacular.
Limpio,muy bien amueblado,y con todas las necesidades.
Se encuentra en pleno centro cerca restaurantes,tiendas,supermercados,y ferma das de metro.
El host resultò una persona muy cordial y disponible.
Experiencia totalmente positiva.

La casa de Pedro es, sencillamente, el alojamiento perfecto para descubrir Lisboa. Buen situado, bien comunicado, con muchísimos servicios cerca y con un encanto inigualable. Atención exquisita, limpísimo, calidad de hotel de 5 estrellas. Un placer!!

房子太漂亮了，舒适宜人，宽敞。主人精心准备了当地的特色礼品来欢迎我：白葡萄酒、葡式蛋挞、巧克力和欢迎卡！非常贴心。

最喜欢的就是这个房子门前有个电梯车，出门向上几步远就是最著名的轻轨电车28的站点！！这让我开心得不得了！

火车站、地铁站都非常近，生活购物极为方便！前往飞机场也极为便利！
A gem of an apartment on a beautiful road. The portable WiFi device is one of the best things I've ever been provided with!

Deliziosa, posta nel cuore della città.
L'ospitalità è piena di attenzioni con tanto di dolci tipici portoghesi!
Una bella esperienza
My daughter and I LOVED this loft apartment. It was so well appointed, afforded great views, and is in a sweet neighborhood. We would definitely stay there again!
Everything perfect

Everything about this apartment was great ! the communication with the team was smooth the place itself is super nice, not extra spacious but very conform to pics ! the terrace is really an extra, and we enjoyed a lot sitting there under the sun with a morning coffee ! The street is kinda loud at night, which can be great if you wanna go out (lots of bars etc), but if you plan to sleep early, definitely take some ear plugs with you !
I will add that the place is extremely well located and near to rue Marechal Saldanha that has both a super nice vegan and juice place (called Ink Cafe), a super good modern restaurant (Pharmacia) and a view point with terraces to have a drink with a view on the city !
Thank you so much for your service, Portugal is a great country and Portugese are very nice people :)

Berenice & Matt

Our host met us at the apartment and gave us a great introduction to the apartment. We loved staying here because of the terrace, and the beautiful light in the room. You could walk anywhere from the central location.

The apartment was clean, and perfect for two or three people. We loved coming back to hangout on the terrace for the afternoon. Overall amazing stay!

We absolutely LOVED this cozy loft in Chiado. It was close to so many things, a great central location! The area is definitely lively, so if you're looking for a super quiet spot, this probably isn't it, but being up on the top floor, the noise from the nightlife wasn't as noticeable. Antonio was incredibly helpful getting us settled, answering questions, and helping us to secure a cab for a VERY early flight upon our departure.

There are some wonderful restaurants and bars in the area, and we found it very convenient for walking to different parts of the city. We also loved our welcome treats, and the fact that there was a coffee machine in the apartment ready for us to use in the mornings! The deck was also just heavenly with a great view, but still private. We would stay here again in a heartbeat!

The apartment was perfect! The best thing was the location - I couldn’t imagine a better location to explore the city from. The apartment is small but has everything you need. I would recommend this place to anyone.

Excelente experiencia, se trata de un piso precioso tal cual descrito en la web. Pedro, Luis y todo su equipo cuidan cada detalle y hacen de la estancia una experiencia única en Lisboa. Recomiendo 100%
A very nice, central yet calm place.
Yes, we were met by Antonio, given his cell number for any questions we might have had. Definitely.

Très joli petit appartement idéalement situé et identique aux photos. Nous avons beaucoup apprécié la ponctualité de notre hôte autant par téléphone que lors de notre arrivée même une petite attention nous attendait.
Je recommande vivement !!
Préparez vos bagages et Via Lisbonne !!

Een prima appartement op een geweldige centraal gelegen locatie. Ontvangst met heerlijk flesje Portugese wijn, goede WiFi en goede tips over leuke plekjes.  Nespresso apparaat met een paar cupjes. Schoon, mooi ingericht , leuk dakterras met uitzicht op de Taag. We mochten later uitchecken, de verhuurder reageerde direct op al onze vragen. Twee persoonsbed sliep prima, enige minpuntje was dat het bed bovenop de kast moeilijk bereikbaar was via een wiebeltrapje. We hebben het matras gewoon op de grond gelegd. Zo konden we er goed slapen met drie personen. Aanrader!

Pedro is a really friendly host and his friend Louis welcome us after the normal check in time at midnight. The appartment is exactly how in description but it is smaller than feeling in the pictures. The appartment was clean but its an old building and there are some use trails. But all in one a nice place, in a nice area with a friendly host with good advices. Pedro is all time available and answering diectly. Thank you Lisaboa
Our stay in Lisbon was perfect! The location is unbeatable and the appartment is beautiful. Lovely terrace and perfect hosts. Helpful and very welcoming! Highly recommend this place!

Many thanks to Pedro & Antonio. We had a nice time and the apartment was exactly like the pictures , very functional and pleasant . We spent a great New Year's Eve and very pleasantly surprised by a small gift for the occasion. Thanks a lot !!

Pedro and his team are spectacular! They left local pastries,coffee, a bottle of wine and oranges that made us feel welcomed. There was a list of cool places to visit and things to do plus a description of how far away they are, so you know if you want to walk or get a taxi. The place was spotless and the location is awesome - it seems like it was close to everything.

Nos ha encantado el sitio y el trato del anfitrión. El lugar esta espectacular, super central y ideal para descubrir Lisboa en unos dias en pareja pareja. Habia un pequeño malentendido en cuanto al tiempo de la entrega de las llaves y Pedro y su hermano nos complacieron mucho en entregarnos los un poco más tarde. Muchas gracias también por los pequeños regalitos de bienvenida :)

Pedro's loft is just perfect. Exactly the same as in pictures, incredibly well located, and the check in/out was super easy.
El loft de Pedro es simplemente perfecto. Es igual que en las fotos, super bien situado y la amabilidad al llegar y salir del apto hizo la experiencia en Lisboa muy agradable.
Muy recomendable!!

Très bel appartement, propre et lumineux.
Nous avons eu la possibilité de laisser nos bagages à Antonio jusqu'à la remise des clés.
Nous recommandons cet appartement qui est extrêmement bien situé, dans une rue atypique avec le funiculaire.
We love the house. It's perfect. We enjoyed two days in there. Next time, when we travel Lison again. Hope we can live in it !! The house keeper is very nice!! Everything in the house is perfect.

Luis nous a accueilli très ponctuellement à 13h.
En gage de bienvenu, il nous a remis une bouteille de vin rouge.
L'appartement est idéalement situé au cœur de Lisbonne dans un quartier très agréable. Un tramway très atypique sur une ruelle très pentue passe juste devant la porte d'accès à l'immeuble.
Beaucoup de charme pour ce logement et les alentours.

Check-in went very smoothly, and it was easy to find the apartment, which is located very centrally and near bakeries, a grocery store, and the main shopping area. The apartment was so comfortable and beautiful, with great views and an amazing terrace, and we really enjoyed our stay here!

The perfect place in a wonderful city !
Great location, close to the metro, the fancy Chiado and the very lively Bairo Alto.
Apartment fully equiped (to cook, to relax, to live as in your own apt, maybe better).
It's as big and nice that it looks on the photos.
Vinho verde to welcome us in the fridge, great advices to discover the city, very good communication.
Couldn't recommand more !

L'appartement est fidèle aux photos (attention quand même aux photos grand angle qui donnent une impression de volume). Nous étions 5, cela allait bien que le 5 e couchage sous la toiture reste d'appoint à mon avis. Cet appartement est parfait pour un couple avec enfant. La situation reste très bonne, dans un secteur plutôt festif, le métro à côté. Attention aux escaliers d'accès à l'appartement, 4 ème étage . l'équipement est très complet
The apartment was perfect and the neighborhood was very cozy. Good cafes and creat nightlife.
Awesome apartment. Loved the terrace and the location of the apartment. The team were super helpful with check in and check out. Definitely recommend

Chiado loft is perfekt situated in this wonderful city.
Supermarket and cafes nearby also a cool rooftop bar at hotel bairro alto.
we had a warm welcome from louis, although we where a little bit late.
thanks chiado loft team for all the goodies ,
we had a wonderful time in lisbon, ulrike & franziska

Our host was very welcoming - leaving us a list of things to do and a guide to the apartment. A bottle of wine was a lovely gift.
The apartment was immaculately clean and in a great location - near to all transport links and sites to see.
It was exactly how described and more than comfortable for the 4 of us.

Our citytrip started perfect with the welcome by Luis of the Chiado team. Icecream, pasteis de nata, sweets and wine made us feel welcome. Clean sheets, soap, detergent, towels, nespresso cups... everything was there! The steps to the appartement are steep but it's worth it. Perfect located,close by train and subway, bars and resto. In the beating centre of nightlife, which is great but earplugs could come in handy if you want to go to bed early. we ate in our street in the resto Santa Bica, fresh fish, outside, in our T-shirts end of october :-) Lissabon is unbelievable beautiful, this appartement only contributes to it.

Great location within walking distance of the baixa/Alfama/chiado/bairro alto bars, restaurants, tourist sights. Nice, clean, modern loft with good, clean bathroom. Little touches- ice cream, wine and custard tarts waiting for us- were appreciated.
The loft is compact and has one double bed, one single bed located up a ladder in a very confined space (difficult to get into and out of) and a corner sofa easily transformable into 2 comfortable single beds.

Awesome apartment. Most convenient Check-In and Check-Out process. Very nice people, great insider tips. Nespresso coffee machine available etc. etc....
I can highly recommend this apartment and Pedro as a host in general for your stay in Lisbon!
Great experience, loved the location and space.

The entire team who manages the Chiado loft were very quick to respond and most helpful with our numerous questions which made our stay in Lisbon even better. Lovely apartment in a terrific location ~ so handy to everything. Just a word of caution to those who may have difficulty with stairs - there are a lot of them but we appreciated the extra exercise after all of the delicious food & wine in Lisbon. :)
Thank you again to Antonio, Luis and Pedro.

Antonio made us feel very welcome. The place was a beautiful contrast of old and modern. Extremely well situated from the train station and a short walk from a lot of cool bars, restaurants and tourist attractions. Only possible issue is that there are a lot of stairs, if you are carrying heavy bags it could be a problem, however Antonio seemed like a gentleman so I am sure he would help :)

Un grand merci à toute la team pour son accueil et son professionnalisme! Appartement super agréable, très bien conçu ou tout est parfait, ou l'on se sent vite comme c'est soi. Enfin un appartement ou on trouve un minimum pour vivre ( pastilles lave vaisselle, sel poivre, machine nespresso et capsules ..; quel plaisir de trouver une jolie vaisselle et pas des assiettes et des verres tout dépareillés !! Bref beaucoup de soins dans les détails. La localisation est parfaite pour visiter Lisbonne et idéal pour sortir et diner . Enfin pleins de petites attentions à notre arrivée digne d'un hotel 5 étoiles, je n'ai jamais vu cela dans mes nombreuses locations à l'étranger. Je recommande sans hésiter

The hosts are very prompt with responses and communication. Their place is absolutely amazing and in a really great location to experience Lisbon. The apartment is as beautiful and convenient as described. Really great experience!

We had an amazing stay at Pedros apartment. The space itself is even better than in the pictures. The location is perfect and the views from the apartment are wonderful.

Checkin was very easy and pleasant. Recommended!

The flat was amazing - beautifully decorated, so light and airy and in such a great location. Host was very helpful too talking us through the features of the flat and also some great tips on the area. Would highly recommend to anyone visiting Lisbon.

vraiment Parfait !

L'appartement était en tout point conforme à nos attentes et même davantage. Confortable et charmant. Très belle terrasse sur les toits avec vue en biais sur le Tage. très belle salle de bain aussi.
Dosettes de café offertes, petits chocolats, bouteille de vin blanc au frais, glace artisanale et spécialités locales, nous attendaient.
Nous avions 2 heures de retard ( très très longue attente de plus de 3 heures chez le loueur SIXT, alors que nous avions prépayé et que nous sommes clients...) et nous avons quand même été attendus avec le sourire.
seul petit bémol : l'appartement est situé dans une rue adorable et un quartier où les noctambules se retrouvent et passent tard dans la nuit... donc, il faut fermer les fenêtres ! mais il y a la climatisation, si il fait chaud.

This has to be the best place to stay in Lisbon. The location is amazing - right in the middle of everything, on a beautiful street. The apartment is just as stunning as it looks in the pictures. The terrace is great and the bed is heavenly. The wine and ice cream that Pedro and his team left were very much appreciated!! A great place to stay.
