What a fantastic time I have had in this apartment with 2 friends. Having a wine at sunset on the terrace is amazing and the location is more than perfect. This is my second time in one of Pedro's apartments but I am afraid I might be back again....

The apartment is perfect. Located on a very picturesque street in a trendy neighborhood near amazing restaurants and shops. It is beautifully decorated - not large but they use the space very well and it doesn't feel cramped at all. Very clean. Hosts are very helpful and nice. No complaints at all, I would want to stay here again. And the walk up isn't bad!
Best apartment we've ever stayed at! Amazing loft!
Great place to stay Lovely and nice well located just avoid heavy luggages due to nolber of stairs to get the flat sweet gifts lef by pedro many thanks

Excellent communication before our visit - upon arrival were met by Antonio and found the apartment to be exactly on the photos - lovely to sit on the terrace in the evening as it was 30 degrees during the day.  Apartment on 5th floor with no lift so would not suit everyone !! Right in the centre of the Chiado area and well placed for the Metro station, bars, shops and restaurants all within easy walking distance.  Apartment very well appointed with everything you would need and the welcoming touches very well received !!  Although in the middle of the city there was no noise to disturb you during the night or early morning.  Would definitely stay here again.  Thank you for your help and also in allowing us to leave our luggage after checkout for a couple of hours.

We've had such a lovely stay at Pedro's place.
the location is amazing, in the heart of Chiado, where lots of shops and cafes are....... also easy to get to the water front (well, easy to go down, a bit hard to come back to climb all up !) Cais do Sodre station, and the exciting food market are just a few minute away!

the room is very nice, well decorated, and air-conditioned !! that is exactly how you can see on the photos, very unique studio, and there are everything you might need (you can even squeeze fresh oranges !!)

We really appreciated that they were very flexible and arranged everything for us to stay as comfortable as possible. they allowed us to leave the bags before check-in, and after check-out too !!

Antonio and Pedro were the guys with warm hospitality. they prepared amazing welcome gift for us, that made us feel immediately at home..

If I come back to this lovely city of Lisbon, I'd definitely stay in their apartment again.

thank you Antonio and Pedro!!!!!

with lots of love
xxx

Fantastic apartment, couldn't have been better appointed. stylish and comfortable, beautiful terrace, ideal location. Great communication, warmly greeted by the host, ice cream and cherries on arrival. The perfect air bnb!

Very nice apartment, in a great part of the city.
The arrival and departure worked like a charm.

We really enjoyed staying in this apartment.  It had everything we needed and was in a great location.  The host was also very friendly and provided excellent advice about our stay.  Would definitely stay here again next time we are in Lisbon.
Pedro was very welcoming and the apartment was beautiful. He welcomed us and showed us around the apartment. There was no elevator but Pedro helped us with the luggage.

We had a great stay at Pedro's apartment! The place was really comfortable (with a sunny terrace!), modern, with little touches to make this stay special. The location was perfect, really close to the "heart" of the city, the public transports, the shops, exceptional restaurants (such as "Sea Me"), etc. Last but not least, Pedro was always available and gave us good tips for our city trip, which was really appreciated!

Aurore & Tom
My girlfriend Laura and me were very happy to stay in this amazing apartment. Everything was exactly like at the pictures, tidy and clean. And thank's a lot for the awesome icecream!!!
Great apartment, great location, great host. I would hope to come back in the future.

Wir haben uns 8 Nächte sowohl in der Wohnung als auch in der wirklich zentralen Lage in Barrio Alto rundum wohl gefühlt. Die Wohnung entsprach voll uns ganz unseren Vorstellungen und den gemachten Informationen. Die Lage mit den vielen guten Restaurants, Bar's und Geschäften ist für einen Stadturlaub perfekt!!

Wir haben uns in Lissabon verliebt und ganz sicher hat auch diese wunderschöne Wohnung ihren Teil dazu beigetragen!

Nous avons passé un très agréable séjour dans l'appartement de Pedro. Tout était parfait : appartement décoré avec soin, emplacement idéal proche des principaux sites touristiques. Nous recommandons vivement!

Die Wohnung entsprach dem Inserat. Alles was man braucht für war vorhanden. Vor allem die Lage im Barrio Alto ist sehr gut. Viele kleine, gute Restaurants und Bars sind in der Nähe. Einkaufmöglichkeiten und kleine Cafés für das Frühstück alles zu Fuss erreichbar. Das Highlight für mich war eine der alten Strassenbahnen die direkt vor der Wohnung hält. Eine andere ist bei der oberen Strasse E28. Auch die anderen öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel sind ganz in der Nähe. Diese Wohnung ist wirklich zu empfehlen.

We had such a fantastic time in Pedro's apartment. We checked in at 11:30 PM, which was no problem. The welcome was great: Antonio gave a great introduction and we headed out to one of the nice bars, which was just around. The apartment is clean, has everything you can think of.
Aircon was great during a hot night. The view from the balcony is nice, you can even see the sea!
If you are looking for the most central and extremely nice apartment in the middle of the center, just take this one!
Thanks again, Pedro!
A beautiful apartment with an amazing terrace. Very nice to eat dinner, overlooking the rooftops of Lissabon. Very good host and great tips for restaurants, sights etc... A+
Lovely flat, as described in the listing. Easy to collect the keys and quick to respond all questions. Would definitely use again. Thank you.

Pedro was very responsive to questions prior to our trip. When we finally made it to the apartment, albeit, at a delayed time than originally expected, Antonio was there to greet us with a smile and show us around the place, and give us a quick suggestions.

The place was a relaxing oasis, clean, conveniently and very well situated. Near the action, but a bit removed so you can sleep. We definitely took advantage of that terrace and the sunny weather we had.

Towels, some soap, espressos and capsules, basic cooking implements... Everything was in good working order. We had everything we needed to feel comfortable.

As some people mentioned, there is no lift in the building, but it wasn't an issue for us. It is very close to the metro station but we could basically walk everywhere.

We had a lovely time, and would definitely recommend Pedro's Chiado apartment.
Beautiful Apartment, perfect location and great host. We had a wonderful time, thanks Pedro for everything

Our trip to Lisbon was awesome and the apartment was too in every way.  Antonio meet us at the apartment and although we were early, he had it ready in 1/2 hour.  And because we were early he allowed us to keep our luggage at his apartment and he even transported all of it up stairs for us while we were out, THANK YOU ANTONIO!  We spent that time wandering the immediate neighborhood.  The neighborhood is great and felt very safe even late into the night.  The apartment is very well located with a tram stop very near, metro quite close and easy walking to great restaurants and bars.  The apartment is exactly as it shows online, beautiful and with a great patio.  Because it does have an open concept and there were 4 of us, we did have to be mindful of everyone's own times of coming/going/sleeping etc.  We were able to coordinate this so it was not a problem.  They have prepared a very helpful map as well as suggested restaurants etc.
This was an amazing spot in a great location that made Lisbon our favorite stop during our vacation!

Die Unterkunft hat den Bildern voll entsprochen. Für einen romantischen Aufenthalt kann man die Wohnung sehr empfehlen.

Die Wohnung liegt sehr zentral, allerdings sollte man den Auf- und Abstieg zur Wohnung nicht scheuen. Allerdings wäre man in diesem Fall falsch in Lissabon.

Mit einigen Kleinigkeiten und einer Osterüberraschung hiess man uns herzlich willkommen - trotz der verspäteten Ankunft. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt.

Wonderful apartment - exactly like the photos and we were lucky enough to enjoy it with perfect weather.
Great location and welcome from Antonio.
Will definitely return.
Appartement très agréable, à l'image des photos, en plein centre de Lisbonne. Accueil ponctuel, sympathique et professionnel.

The apartment was great! Located in the heart of the Bairro Alto. Got some nice chocolates on arrival and got informed about the highlights in and around the neighborhood. Definitely worth the stay when visiting Lisbon.

The apartment was beautiful, very cozy, and pristine, just like the pictures. The location was fantastic. Antonio and Pedro were very helpful and answered to our emails and questions quite promptly. We had a great time and  hope to visit Lisbon soon, we would love to stay at your place again!
Great location and great flat! I recommand highly !

The apartment is so lovely and exactly as described!! We absolutely loved it! Pedro is super nice and very responsive. The area is also close to a ton of cool restaurants that are definitely worth checking out. Thanks =D

The apartment was nice, but the weary traveler can expect to climb several flights of stairs to reach the unit.  Antonio met us at the unit and thoroughly explained everything.  One major plus is that the unit has a unitary washer-dryer.  It also has a sea view if you stretch yourself out over the balcony a bit. I didn't see the major draw to the area, but I can't fault the owner for the environment. Good stay!
Très bonne expérience. Nous nous sommes sentis comme à la maison et tout était parfait.

We enjoyed staying for 3 days in this nice and cozy apartment, having a perfect base for exploring Lisbon. There’s a beautiful energy as part of the many layers that create this home. We will definitely come back, and we give you and your apartment our best recommendations. We couldn't possibly wish for anything more for a short stay in Lisbon!

We loved staying at the Chiado Loft 1. The loft itself looked just like it does in the pictures. It was clean, with a modern design and in a great location. Most of the best restaurants, the bars of Bairro Alto and Praca do Comercio are all within walking distance, from the flat, anywhere between 5-15 minutes.

Pedro's friend welcomed us to the flat, but while we never met Pedro himself he still was a great host - excellent at communicating, helpful with information we needed and flexible with our check in and check out times. We would definitely stay here again, highly recommended.

The only 'downside' (which wasn't really a problem for us) is that the loft is on the top floor and there is no lift access, so you'd have to climb around 50 or so steps to get to it. But if you're not into climbing, then Lisbon is probably not the place for you!
Pedro's apartment was amazing. It was in the perfect location, and the space was perfect: clean, stylish, and airy. We loved it here!!

We had a great Trip to Lissabon! The Apartment is as pretty as it is shown on the pictures, very comfortable. Pedro helped us with any needs we had. If we come back, we would definately choose the Apartment again.

Everything went perfect, from communication before, to the arrival and during the stay. This is a fantastic place - I tend to say my favorite in Lisbon so far (and I've seen a few very nice others). It's perfectly located...and the apartment itself is just great. A Five Star Gem!
We enjoyed our stay very much. Absolutely great apartment: calm, central, perfect size for 2, extremely well designed. We would definetly come back.
It was simply perfect!
Wonderful place.
I can't rate this apartment highly enough.  It is a spot on description and in a fabulous location within Lisbon.  The host is vert accommodating and professional.  Enjoy staying here!

The light of Lisbon

Beautiful penthouse of Pedro, good decor, central location, there is everything you need for a great holiday
Owner helpful and very friendly
Bravo!

Highly recommended!
Smooth check in, flat fully in line with description and pics, perfect location to discover Lisboa with virtually everything within 20 minutes by walk. Supermarket, fishmonger, butcher and bakery just around the corner - we had few meals cooked at 'home' in the small but very well equipped kitchen.
Perfect for 3-4 people, nicely decorated and very bright.
Bonus: a warm welcome with a bottle of Porto, a botte of white wine and a Christmas cake!
The only small negative is the noise from the street below very busy on Friday and Saturday nights until late.

Very good experience and the location was perfect to explore... Antonio was in the loft on time with the keys to welcome us (with chocolates). Loved how convenient the loft was from inside - right heating; appliances and fresh towels. Overall a good experience!

This is a beautiful space on the highest floor of an old building.  The stairs are not a triviality:  steep and old, like in an old US farmhouse but with landings.  The building is on the most photographed street in Lisbon, by accounts.  No cars--- too steep--- just a cable car and the sidewalk is steps.  You can see the water from the top of the street which is a couple of feet away from the entry to the apartment.  All in all, a terrific location.  Great views from the wonderful terrace.  Warnings about the beds:  the one of the floor is situated under an eave, so if two occupy the bed, the inner sleeper must sort of crawl to and from his/her spot, and won't be able to sit up in the bed, which is very comfortable. The loft bed is up a ladder that is pretty much vertical.  The décor is very sleek, modern, thoughtful, stylish.   And, though the building is old, it is charming and comfortable.  These guys have done a great job with this apartment.

The accommodation was perfect and exactly like the description. We felt at home immediately. A quite place in the very center of the city. A friend of Pedro was welcoming us at the apartment and provided some very useful information about places worth to visit.

Lisbon was a very pleasant experience. Our host kept us updated on information up to our arrival, and was at the address at the exact time we had arranged.  I can definitely recommend Pedro and his apartment.
Great place and perfect location. Very clean and modern.

We had a wonderful stay at Chiado Loft 1 - the apartment is fantastic and just as it appears in the photos. Pedro and Antonio were great hosts. They adapted the check in time to suit our early arrival, all information to do with the apartment was clearly explained, and they provided recommendations of places to go in the area. One restaurant we visited and thought should be on the list - Xapuri. Wonderful Portuguese style tapas - very inventive flavours and beautifully presented food. If you stay here it is worth a visit!

Pedro and Antonio went ABOVE AND BEYOND to ensure that me and my girlfriend were comfortable for our entire stay. The loft is absolutely gorgeous, warm, cozy, clean, and modern. We ended up spending the weekend in Sintra but if we could do it again we would have stayed the entire week in Pedro's loft in Chiado! There's no doubt we will stay there again. Everything is close---all the hip, new bars, restaurants, movie theaters, retail shops. Easily one of the best values in Lisbon.

Ola Pedro,
Thank you very much for having us in your apartment. Everything has been fine, the place is perfectly located, very nice designed and very well equipped. Next time we will be in Lisbon your apartment will be our first choice again. We left you a little present from our trip to Golegã, we hope you will enjoy the "Agua Pé".
Kind regards B & B

Pedro's loft is in a great neighborhood close to restaurants, a small supermarket and the metro.
The apartment has everything you need including a nice balcony with a great view.
Pedro's friend was expecting us at the apartment even though we couldn't give an exact time since we didn't know how long it would take to get from the airport to the city center.
I would definitely recommend staying at this loft.

Great place ! The balcony is perfect for a glass of wine in the evening but also to enjoy your morning coffee ! The flat is well furnished and very comfy and welcoming.
The location is great, the flat is close to restaurants and bars. You can easily reach public transportation to go and visit the city.
We were very well welcomed and were given great recommendations on places to visit. The hosts were very helpful and agreed to have us check out a bit later than planned on the last day so we could enjoy the city one last time.

It's definitly the place to stay when visiting Lisbon !
Prompt meeting on site, very clean and cute appartment, hassle free exchange of keys.

We were warmly received and had a very thorough and thoughtful introduction to the apartment and all the fine workings of their apartment, and neighborhood eaters to recommend. We appreciated the oranges for fresh OJ, the coffee pods, the sweet treats and welcome note.  The location is perfect, the apartment very well appointed and we loved the rooftop patio…even though it rained for our entire visit - still lovely!  Thanks Antonio and pedro.

Tout était parfait, appartement magnifique et conforme aux descriptions, idéalement placé dans un quartier animé avec absolument tout à proximité (resto,  monuments, bars, boutiques...) Mon futur voyage à Lisbonne ce fera sans doute chez Pedro.

Amazing appartment located perfectly in the center of Lisbon. Both Pedro and Antonio were very helpfull. We absolutely loved Lisbon and the loft really contributed to that positive experience. Everything you need for your perfect citytrip!

If you are going to have a wonderful stay in Lisbon this is the perfect way to start. The location is perfect with walking distance to sights and restaurants. The apartment is fantastic and you feel right at home. Everything you need is there. The communication with Pedro also went smooth. I can highly recommend it!

The apartment was perfect and lived up to the photos and description. The hosts were really helpful prior to the trip and whilst we were there. There was also really useful information in the apartment on where to eat and drink locally. The apartment was clean and tidy and set in the ideal location just down the road from the vibrant location of Biarro Alto. It was perfect in every way - even down to the local shops - you must try pasteis de nata from the bakery down the road - seriously addictive!

My only complaint is that we did not stay longer! I had seen this property early on in my travel plans and just wanted to book it! I love the decor, style, whimsy but also the superb fit out of the apartment. No for the faint hearted, its up a few stairs but the little terrace and light and bright decor made up for the walk up. Perfectly clean, very well equipped kitchen (we did dine in one night, traveling for 8 weeks, restaurant food does begin to dull the palette) and great bathroom made the stay perfect. Chiado is the place to stay in Lisbon, crazy, busy, buzzy but fun. The apartment is also well insulated and quiet at night. Pedro and his crew do a great job. Hs advice on planing and helping with car parking was much appreciated.

Gourgeous apartment in Lisbon, exactly as described. The apartment had everything we needed and was a lovely place to come home to after a busy day of visiting. We really enjoyed the terrace in the evening to have some glasses of wine :-)

We enjoyed our stay at Pedro's apartment. It's a lovely place in a great location. It's close to the night life & restaurants and easy access to get around the city. The balcony gets the sun most of the day which was great. Would highly recommend! Thank you.
Really perfect stay in a perfect flat! beautyfull and well equiped appartment, great balcony and best located to visit Lisbon! we totally could recommend it!!

Fantastic apartment, great use of space and the terrace is excellent. also great location  Excellent welcome to the property from Antonio. I would recommend the appartment to anyone who can manage stairs and i would book again when we return to Lisbon
It was a beautifull appartement.  We had a great time. Thank you very much.
Such a nice appartment in one of the most famous streets of Lisbon. We loved to stay in Loft 1 for a couple of days. Thank you Pedro and team for the hospitality!
It was really great place. My staying in lisbon was happy bcause of this modern house. Strongly recommend!

Perfekt!!!
Ein wunderschöner Loft, der alles beinhaltet, was die Bilder bei airbnb versprechen.
Die Innenarchitektur ist äußerst gelungen.
Wir haben die Wohnung betreten und uns sofort wohlgefühlt.
Das Sahnehäubchen ist die Dachterrasse, mit Ausblick über die Dächern von Lissabon bis hin zum Tejo.
Darüber hinaus wurden wir immer von Pedro und Antonio freundlich und zuverlässlig beraten. Die Kommunikation war sehr gut. Das Ein- und Auschecken völlig problemlos.
Ein weiterer Highlight ist die absolut zentrale Lage. Alles ist super zu erreichen.
Bairro Alto ist für uns der schönste Stadtteil.
Lissabon und diese Unterkunft sind auf jeden Fall noch eine zweite Reise wert.
Danke für alles.
Volker&Karin

This loft apartment is really well laid out and has lots of amenities and we were very comfortable for the 5 days we stayed there. Pedro our host was very friendly and helpful, he met us at check in, clearly explained how to use all the amenities and made plenty of recommendations around the area. The apartment is situated in a lovely part of the city and is the perfect based to explore from.

This was a great experience and Pedro was very welcoming as soon as you met. He communicated early and clearly to help us find the apartment. Once we met, Pedro gave us everything we needed and even shared some nice places to visit!

The apartment is even better than the photos suggest...with this great location, I would recommend it to anyone who wants to visit Lisbon!

Myself and three friends stayed here for 3 nights on our return journey from the World Cup. Communication with Pedro throughout was excellent and check-in was very easy.

The apartment is gorgeous! It is such a unique space to stay in. The loft is incredibly light and spacious and easily accommodated the four of us. We particularity enjoyed chilling with a few drinks on the roof balcony with fantastic views overlooking the city of Lisbon. It was such a relaxing place to stop after our energetic stay in Rio.

Pedro really has invested a lot of time into the place. There are so many fine details that he has included that make the apartment a pleasure to stay in. We particularly enjoyed making fresh orange juice with the juicer! He also provided plenty of information regarding the local area, which was particularly useful when decided where to eat.

The location of the loft apartment is unrivaled, situated at the heart of Lisbon. Allowing us to explore the beautiful city right from our doorstep.

We had an absolutely fantastic stay and would recommend this quirky apartment to anyone visiting Lisbon.
Apartment in prime location.  Very noisy at night. Very clean and well equipped.  Had a wonderful stay.

Excellent communication from initial booking to checkout from Pedro and the Chiado loft team. The property was as described with excellent facilities and well maintained. The location couldn't have been better being centrally located for most tourist attractions and shops / restaurants.
The chocolates, coffee, fresh oranges and basic cooking ingredients were a nice and welcome gesture.
An excellent stay.
Beautiful apartment in a great location. Pedro was very helpful and the check in process was very smooth

We really enjoyed our stay in Loft 1, thank you, Antonio & Pedro! The apartment is absolutely lovely and located in the perfect location; close to many bars and restaurants in Bairro Alto. Everything looks exactly as on the pictures, very stylish, everything provided works perfectly, and all the communications with the hosts were efficient and friendly. Thank you so much for the warm welcome.

The loft is perfect for 2-3 people, I stayed there with my friend. The terrace is fantastic with a stunning view over the city and Rio Tejo - the best location for a sundowner. There is not too much storage room, but for both of us it was absolutely ok.

When there are Public Celebratory Events like Santo António in June there are lots of people partying in the street, but it didn't disturb too much - and the best solution is to join the fun! We liked it so much :-)

We would definitely come back! Some friends of us stayed at another apartment of Pedro at a quieter place around the corner, it was also absolutely perfect! Seems that Pedro and his team have the best places to stay in Lisbon.

We enjoyed our stay in Loft 1 very much, thank you, Antonio & Pedro & the team! Everything looks exactly as on the pictures, everything provided works perfectly, and all communication with the hosts was efficient and friendly.
The Loft is a little small for 4 individuals; for 2-3 people it would be perfect. The terrace is fantastic both in sunshine and in moonlight. There is not too much storage room, and climbing up to the mezzanine is not everybody´s cup of tea. In weekends there are a lot of people partying in the street, but it didn´t disturb too much - and the best solution is to join the fun!
We would definitely come back!
Great apartment, in a central location. Beautifully decorated. Would recommend.
Great clean flat, nice location and helpful owner - couldn't recommend more
Oui, ce second passage était à la hauteur du premier, parfait!

What a great little apartment.We really enjoyed our stay there. It's very cozy and clean. Small but very well equipped. We stayed there with 3 people and really loved the balcony where we enjoyed our morning coffee or a glass of wine in the evening with an amazing view over the rooftops of Lisboa and the Tejo.
The place is very well located. You can hop on the electrico or just take a walk and see all the neat things around that area. A little supermarket, tons of cafes and lovely restaurants are right around. I'd definitely will be beck some time. I really fell in love with Lisboa and I can just recommend this place. Pedro and Antonio are very nice, reliable and helpful with questions or suggestions. Everything worked out very well and I don't have any complaints, except that I am thinking about coming back in August and they are already booked out ;o) Good for them, bad for me.
Thanks....and whoever is going to be there next. ENJOY !!!

Très bien accueilli par Antonio. Loft conforme à nos attentes. Bonne literie, agréable d'avoir sa terrasse. Salon agréable. Bien équipé au niveau vaisselle
Super quartier
Nous recommandons ce loft sans hésitation. Et nous reviendrons.
Merci à Pedro et Antonio.

Very clever apartment in a very good location. Perfect for two, but we had two friends visiting (+10 € per person) and it was still very comfortable.

The flat is very clean and stylish and the pictures are accurate. We've only briefly met Antonio during check-in, but everything went smooth.

The kitchen is small but surprisingly well equipped and you can cook, but you should probably enjoy the nearby restaurants and bars. Check out the bakeries around the corner, their pasteis de nata are heaven!
Appartement cosy et très propre dans le centre ville. Excellent accueil à notre arrivée. Nous le recommandons vivement.
Beautiful place in a great location !

We had a fantastic time in this beautiful apartement. I can highly recomend it to everyone who wants to travel to lisboa. Pedro and his team are great hosts and i wish them all the best. The apartement is very clean and modern. If i ever return to lisboa this adress will be my first choice!
Thank you Pedro

The apartment is situated just in the heart of Lisabon. Very close to the popular area "Bairro alto". Pedro and Antonio are friendly host which replied us to our question always very quickly with useful information. We especially enjoyed the terrace which was just the perfect place to take a little break between shopping, sightseeing and exploring the neighborhood. Furthermore the apartment is very well equipped with all necessary staff (inclusive free WIFI & sound system). If you are looking for a cosy and central place to stay in Lisabon - this is it! :-)
Perfect flat, perfect terrasse, very well located.

We had a great stay at Chiado loft. Pedro is a great host, always replied immediately, very considerate to our needs, extremely helpful and very friendly. He welcomed us in his elegant & stylish apartment with wine and organic fruits. He recommended where the best places and restaurants to go are. I should say the restaurant Pedro recommended is not only the best seafood restaurant in Lisbon but maybe the best one in the planet :-)

The location of the apartment is SUPERB, right in the heart of Lisbon. I can not imagine a better location to stay. The flat is very clean, the beds are very comfortable, the atmosphere is cozy and the furnishings were artistic and cool.

We had everything we need for enjoyable stay .We strongly recommend this apartment. Pedro, thanks once again for a great stay.

The apartment was absolutely lovely and located in the perfect location; close to many of the bars and restaurants in Bairro Alto. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Lisbon! Pedro was a great host and left some handy tips on places to visit, as well as a few necessities like coffee, etc. Overall a brilliant place to stay!

The Chiado loft is, as the photos show, stylish and well designed to make for a comfortable short break in the city and despite being on the 5th floor I didn't find the stairs too much of a challenge and I'm getting on in years!

For us, the most important aspect after the accommodation itself was Pedro's communication. He's good, very good; answered all our mails promptly and efficiently (our flight was changed) and was still there to meet us after a flight delay.

Small but stylish, the loft close to really good transport links around the city, particularly good if it's raining, and I imagine that the balcony would be a great place to have a glass of wine and a takeaway sushi from the fabulous Sea Me restaurant just 200 metres away - shame it was too cold and wet when we were there!

what a great trip to a great city!! the chiado loft was really the best choice. pedro and antonio were very helpful and friendly from the beginning on (antonio got us two good seats for a benfica lisboa soccer game). we could get every information that we needed and it was easy to reach one of them. the apartment is beautiful and clean and the terrace is one of the best parts. it is very central, tram 28 is just around the corner and many bars are close by. we loved it and we will recommend it to our friends - and maybe we come back some day...
thank you guys!
ps: for everyone who has problems to walk - be aware that the apartment is on the fifth floor!

This space was sensational. It was such a pleasure to arrive back to at the end of the day. It is perfectly located within the city. My only regret is that we didn't have enough time to simply sit in the apartment and enjoy the sun and the views on the wonderful balcony. It is definitely a space worth spending a lot of down-time in. Cheers so much for the opportunity.
Thanks a lot for the stay and your warm welcome!
Excellent location, excellent appt!

Das Appartment ist sehr empfehlenswert. Mein Freund und ich waren vier Nächte in Lissabon und genossen die schöne Stadt und die super Unterkunft. Die Lage ist top und alles ist gut zu Fuss zu erreichen. Die Metrostation ist ca. 5 Gehminuten entfernt. Einen Supermarkt, Restaurants und Cafes findet man gleich um die Ecke. Die Betreuung war super nett und es war sehr sauber. Wir würden das Apartment jedem weiterempfehlen!

Ficamos dois dias apenas no Chiado Loft 1. O apartamento é um conforto só... muito bem cuidado, tudo super novo, limpo e bonito, de bom gosto! Adoramos os nossos dias em Lisboa! Também fomos recepcionadas com muito carinho, laranjas, chocolates e sabonete cheiroso! O apartamento é super bem localizado! Recomendamos! Um abraço! Ana luiza.
Très joli appartement idéalement situé dans Lisbonne. Très bien équipé et dans un état irréprochable. Accueil pro du propriétaire à l'arrivée. Rien à redire !

L'appartement est vraiment magnifique, en plein centre! La petite terrasse est très agréable. Un accueil très pro!
merci à la team!

The loft was amazing! very well fitted out and perfectly located, in the heart of the Chiado neighborhood. Pedro and Antonio were considerate and disponible. We really loved our experience there! Thanks.

My husband and I had a blast in Lisbon during Christmas and it was also because of Our stay at Pedro's apartment. It is a nice cozy, warm apartment and well decorated. You really get to enjoy everything that you see in these pics including the view. Closed by to Baixa Chiado Metro station to get you around Lisbon and The famous Tram no.28 right in front of your doorstep. Good communication and both Pedro or Antonio were really helpful. Highly recommended! Just prepare to step up 5 level to burn your fat after eating all those Delicious food :) thank you Pedro and Antonio for the lovely hospitality!
That was one of the most cosy places that we ever had been. Romantic place, totally.

Our stay at Pedro's flat has been very pleasant as in addition of being decorated with taste and very well equipped, the flat is also located on Bica, hence, very close to a variety of amenities, pastelerias and restaurants. Pedro has been very quick at sorting out some noise problems we experienced on our first morning with neighbours and made sure the flat wasn't lacking of anything to make our time there very enjoyable.

My wife and I are both quite fit, so climbing up the 5 floors to reach the flat was not a problem, however it might be a challenge for elderly people or those having mobility problems, as the building has no lift. However, the view from the flat is stunning which makes this place an excellent choice to stay in lovely Lisbon.
Appartement superbe, très fonctionnel, très bien situé

Pedro and Antonio are great hosts. The loft is very cosy, artsy, clean en well equipped - it has everything you need. The location is really central but still gives the idea that you are one of the locals. We loved it!
The apartment was fantastic! It was very clean and cozy, we really enjoyed staying there. It was very romantic, the location was perfect. Thanks
Que dire…, que du bonheur!
Great apartment, perfect location for exploring Lisbon and very friendly host. All really perfect!

We had a wonderful stay in Lisbon at the Chiado Loft, we had everything we needed in a brilliant central location. The loft is beautifully renovated and decorated, with real character and the terrace is a glorious sun-trap from mid-morning. Highly recommended.
Un apartamento encantador. Muy bien situado y con todo lo que necesitas a mano. Los anfitriones atentos y rápida comunicación con ellos

The apartment is absolutely lovely and is furnished with great taste. It's located in a really lively area with tons of nice places to eat, bars, etc. I will definitely try to come back to that very apartment on my next visit to Lisbon. Totally recommend it.

This appartment is a beautifully kept place. Very nicely decorated, clean, airy, bright and cheerfull. Me and my fiancé stayed for 4 days and were very happy every day to get "home".

We did not cook, although everything is provided. The kitchen however would be a bit small for big meals. Don't worry, the neighbourhood is so good you won't feel like cooking at all. Much to see and taste just outside your doorstep. (Try Sea Me!)

In short, we had an excellent experience for a short stay for two people, in this perfectly clean, bright and wonderful appartment.
Eine tolle Wohnung, sehr sauber und hochwertig ausgestattet, super Lage!Wir waren begeistert und würden sie zu 100% weiterempfehlen!

This loft is really a nice place to stay for a Lisbon trip. It's easy to get there by Metro and a 250m walk. The area where the loft is located is ideal, close to Bairro Alto, close to good restaurants and nice (lounge)bars! The loft itself is good equiped with good large bed, bathroom, small kitchen, fridge, tv, internet, nice terrace. It's equiped warm, modern and clean!
The iconic Tram 28 is stopping at 50m from the loft and the Bica elevator is stopping in front of the door.
We would recommand this loft to all of our friends! Just rent it, it's much more pleasant then a hotel room!!

We stayed at this appartment in Sepember month. We liked it completely! Appartments are fully equiped, it has nice design, and especially wonderful balcony. From this region it's very easy to reach to all city attractions. This is really nice and comportable place to stay. Thanks a lot to Pedro, he is very hospitable and contact guy.
We surely can reccomend this apartment to everyone!

Rita.
Very cute apartment. Pedro is an excellent host, very helpful and reliable. Thank you very much, we had a great time. Anja
L endroit idéal.... The best place to stay

We had an amazing time in Lisboa, mostly thanks to Antonio and this perfect loft. It is very well situated, in the best area to go out at night (without being noisy at all), a walking distance from pretty much any interesting place in Lisboa, close to a supermarket and with an amazing view. We enjoyed the terrace every day, the AC proved to be a great ally between 12 and 2pm. Antonio has been very helpful, even helping us on a public holiday. We recommend the CHiado loft and cannot wait to go back.

Beautiful apartment. Loved the view from the terrace. Walking distance to everything you need to see. Close to the night life which was good for us since we were a young couple. Would definitely stay again on my next trip to Lisbon.

My friend and I absolutely fell in love with this place and the surrounding neighborhood! The pictures were spot on and we loved the coziness and layout of the apartment. Although the space isn't huge, everything is perfectly laid out and everything we needed could be found easily.

One of our favorite daily rituals was to wake up, groggily move to the balcony where we would allow the sun and the chirping swallows above slowly wake us up. We would then make a quick breakfast and savor a slow morning just zoning out on the balcony. Then in the evenings after our siesta (required since it was so freaking hot out), we would have cocktails out on the balcony and listen to the street below us get ready for evening festivities. The balcony was hands down our favorite part of the apartment.

The neighborhood seemed very quiet and a bit deserted when we first arrived but it was because it's in a true lived-in/non-touristy neighborhood. There is a tram that starts literally outside of our door and gave our neighborhood a picturesque look. In the evenings is when the street came alive with spontaneous block parties. The apartment is 5 floors up (walk up) and had very thick windows so we never heard a thing when our windows were closed.

All in all we were very happy with the apartment and it was part of the reason that we fell in love with Lisbon. I look forward to returning and staying at this loft again soon!

Jinny

The flat is amazing : the terrace is a really good place to have breakfast, have a drink...Really well decorated and furnished you got all what you need.
The flat is well situated : the famous tram 28 is just in front of the door of the building. You are close to bars, restaurants of Bairro Alto and Chiado, and Cais do sodre to go to the beach.
Pedro was so nice and communication was good. Thank you !
Our time in the chiado loft was perfect. It is situated in the old centre of lisboa and the view from the terrace is great.
We had a great stay at Chiado Loft 1, spotless flat, amazing terrace and all this in a great area to explore in the evening after a day out.
appartement très bien situé, très bien équipé, silencieux et lumineux, décoré et agencé avec gout, à recommander

We´ve had a great 4-day stay at the apartment. It´s beautifully decorated and it comes with all the amenities you would need; as a plus Pedro left us some fresh bread and oranges and we had a lovely breakfast overviewing Lisbon´s rooftops (and thanks for the chocolates, they´re delicious!).
The apartment is located 50 meters away from the famous 28 tram stop and it´s just a walk away from the great restaurants and pubs area of Barrio Alto. We couldn´t expect a better location.
Overall, our experience could match a five star hotel! 100% recomended!
Just perfect! Great location, amazing view from the terrace, wondeful design...We couldn't possibly wish for anything more (or different) for a short stay in Lisbon!

Great flat in the most touristic spot in Lisbon. We shared the flat with our two young boys (on the spfas) and a friend on the raised bed area and my wife of course ! Great quality, great views and top location for a city break. I think we will return to sample th Portuguese delights soon.

The apartment is as it looks on the pictures, just perfect! The bed is really comfortable! Salvador, thank you very much for waiting for us and your help with the luggage! It is just a lovely place to stay in this great city! Thank you very much for everything! We will come back!

Un accueil parfait, appartement au top! Comme sur les photos... Concernant le quartier, pour sortir boire un verre, manger, faire la fête, rien de mieux! Je vous recommande cet appartement qui vaut le détour, et notamment la terrasse. Mon prochain voyage à Lisbonne sera au même endroit. A très vite sur AirBNB. Vincent et Gabriel

Many thanks to you, Pedro for your very positive attitude and warm welcome.
My girlfriend and I enjoyed staying for 5 days in your wonderfull apartment, having a perfect base for exploring Lisbon.
We will definetely come back, and we give you and your apartment our best recomendations.

Absolutely beautiful and well-appointed apartment in an excellent location in Lisbon. This was the perfect pad for our last stop in Portugal. Would definitely stay here next visit. Highly recommended!

The experience at Pedro's loft was great! The location is unbeatable and the apartment itself is beautiful and comfy. Salvador was there to give us the keys and explained everything about the place. He also left oranges, fresh bread, some chocolates and a nice welcoming note.
Recommended 100%, would repeat for sure.
Thank you all!

Our stay at Chiado Loft 1 was ...amazing ! Our friendly host welcomed us and the appartment was perfect! All the way at the top. Located right in the centre and walking distance to all the nice areas. It beats a hotel room for sure! The local coffee shop around the corner served very good coffee and lovely pastries. The nostalgic tram 28 stops right in front of the appartment which takes you through the coolest areas of Lisbon. It made our stay in Lisbon extra special ! So .... Obrigado!

Michael & Pierrette - Haarlem - Netherlands (March 2013)

Thanks for hosting us in your flat. It was great. The apartment is very clean and well located for two people and a couple of days in lisbon.
Thanks also for the wine, the nespresso and the smiles.

Nous avons passé un superbe séjour dans l'appartement de Pedro : l'appartement est splendide, idéalement situé, rien ne manque jusqu'aux toasts du petit-déjeuner ! Pedro nous a très bien accueilli, a fait en sorte que tout se passe pour le mieux... je recommande vivement !

We had a really pleasant stay at Pedro's appartment. Everything was perfect : wonderful appartment, good location, and great host ! I definitely recommend it :)

Matthieu

Pedro and his friend were extremely friendly, and we had a fantastic time at the apartment.  It's a large studio, though the bed is tucked into an area where the roof is a bit low.  As an added bonus, there is an enormous terrace which would be great for relaxing with a few drinks.  We also loved the Nespresso machine!  Probably the best thing about the apartment, though, is that the place is literally in the heart of Lisbon.  All you have to do is go down the stairs and you are in the middle of everything.  Of course, the downside to this is that it was a bit noisy out on the street on Saturday night, but all things told, it was a small price to pay.  We slept fine, and had a great time in Lisbon.

First time to book a accommodation from Airbnb. excellent location, well equip kitchen, I and my friends had a wonderful time in Lisbon, highly recommend this to my best friends and others! Thanks Perdro :)

Spent a long-weekend in Lisbon in this fantastic apartment - I really recommend it. The apartment is wonderfully located in an area with fun night-life, lots of restaurants, both traditional Portuguese and other international options and great access to both the tram and metro systems. There's a perfect little cafe for breakfast just around the corner beside the bookshop - good spot to try some Portuguese pastries!

The apartment itself is fabulous - small but perfectly formed! Great design throughout, some lovely unusual features (the mansard roof, tiled terrace). Pedro and his team thought of plenty of the little touches that really add to the experience - a basket of fresh Portuguese oranges, fresh bread, welcome note and chocolates all there when we arrived.

I will be back to stay in the Chiado loft!

A perfect flat in a perfect place, barrio alto is the best burrough for parties :)
Pedro is very nice and here to answer you questions, i'll come back here next time !

DEUTSCH: Das moderne Apartment ist hervorragend gelegen! Restaurants, Bars, Fados und Einkaufsläden befinden sich in unmittelbarer Nähe. Zu Fuss ist man in 5 Minuten bei der Metro Station Baixa/Chiado und in 2 Minuten an der Haltestelle zur bekannten Tramlinie 28. Pedro hat das Apartment, die Besonderheiten sowie das Quartier bestens erklärt. Die Aussicht ist wunderschön! Das Bett bequem, die Dusche selbst schön gross und alles ist sauber. Für Selbstkocher wäre alles vorhanden. Ich würde dieses Apartment jederzeit wieder mieten und kann es nur wärmstens empfehlen!

ENGLISH: This apartment is excellent! Restaurants, bars, fados and shops are located nearby. To walk to the metro station Baixa / Chiado it takes 5 minutes and 2 minutes to get to the famous tram no. 28. Pedro has declared the apartment, the specifics and the district well. The view is beautiful! The bed was comfortable, the shower itself beautifully big and everything is clean. For self-caterers all is present. I would rent this apartment again at any time and can recommend it highly!

ESPANOL: Este apartamento es excelente! Restaurantes, bares, fados y tiendas se encuentran cerca. Para caminar a la estación de metro Baixa / Chiado se tarda 5 minutos y 2 minutos para llegar al famoso tranvía no 28. Pedro ha declarado el apartamento, los detalles y el distrito. Así la vista es hermosa! La cama era cómoda, la ducha en sí maravillosamente grande y todo está limpio. Para auto-catering todo está presente. Me gustaría alquilar este apartamento nuevo en cualquier momento y lo puedo recomendar encarecidamente!

We arrived in the apartment and felt in love with it, everything was just perfect! It's newly renovated and furnished with high quality equipment. We wer even considering to stay one more week :)
The apartment couldn't be located more central, in the old town very close to many bars and restaurants but still quiet. This typical yellow elevator even stopped infront of our door!
I am recommending the apartment to my friends, definitely 5 stars!

Die Wohnung hat eine super zentrale Lage und ist gut zu Fuß erreichbar. Sie war sauber und insgesamt angenehm für unseren Aufenthalt.
Die Dachterrasse ist über eine Klappleiter und eine Luke erreichbar, daher sollte man dafür etwas beweglich und schwindelfrei sein, zumal die Absturzsicherung recht niedrig ist.
Insgesamt hatten wir eine gute Zeit.

We really enjoyed our stay here. We were there for about a week and everything about it just made our trip better. Fortunately we had fantastic weather so we were on the rooftop every day tanning, listening to music, eating, etc. It was like a getaway from the hustle and bustle of the city. Everything was super walkable, so close to great food and coffee. The hosts were incredibly kind and flexible, we felt very welcome. Can’t recommend it enough.

Sandra & Sofia’s place was the perfect home base. The location allowed us to easily walk to all the neighborhoods we wanted to see, and was close to multiple train / metro stations. Lots of great restaurants nearby, and the area was beautiful and quiet. We especially loved the roof deck! We received some great recommendations from the hosts, including general orientation of the city, and we were warmly welcomed. Would certainly recommend!

This flat is perfectly located, and the neighborhood felt safe and really well connected for the airport and by foot to all the great central areas. Sadly the weather was not great whilst I stayed so I didn’t get to make use or see the roof terrace. The only downside was it was quite noisy with the storm in the evenings, being a top floor apartment and I was also cold, despite using a blanket and putting the heater on for a few hours before bed.
地理位置佳，離自由大道很近，晚上很安靜，屋頂的景無敵美。唯一缺點是沒電梯行李要自己搬，還有處在巷子裡，女生晚上自己一個人會有點怕。但整體環境非常好。
Nice flat and friendly hosts 😊

The apartment is centrally located in a resident area of Lisbon. It takes ~20min to walk to the busy street and water front. We have walked everyday without rely on transportation except the trip outside of Lisbon. The apartment is not too big but enough for two people. It is very clean and quiet.
Sandra&Sofia is very responsive on the email communication. Since we have arrived at evening, Sandra came to meet with us to provide keys and show us around the apartment.
I definitely recommend the apartment to anyone who visit Lisbon.

I would recommend this place to anyone looking to visit Lisbon! Amazing location, so many restaurants within a few feet of you in every direction! Very close to everything you’d need or want while travelling! Friendly and responsive hosts who gave great recommendations of things to do in the city. A breath taking view on top. My only complaint is the hot water in the shower, we found we only got about 8mins of hot water before it went freezing cold. Not a big deal and we were okay to deal with this but just a heads up! Otherwise this is a fantastic place to stay and we’d stay here again in a heart beat!

Great stay, the studio is cozy and the it’s set up gives it a lot of amplitude, lots of light and windows and beautiful views. Nice for staying a couple of days and explore Lisbon. Very well located and in an charming neighborhood,
You have to climb some stairs in case you are traveling with heavy luggage.
I would definitely would stay there if I jave the chance.
We had a great stay! Best regards:)

Ein wunderschönes airbnb
due dachterrase ist ein Highlight, alles hat super geklappt, es sind viele Kleinigkeiten vor Ort - von Kaffee bis Fön - was mir sofort ein zu hause Gefühl gegeben hat.
Alles perfekt, danke!

Tout était très bien.
Nous n’avons malheureusement pas pu profiter du toit terrasse à cause de la météo pluvieuse.
Merci beaucoup pour votre accueil.

Diese Unterkunft ist perfekt für einen Aufenthalt in Lissabon.
Die Anbindung ist super, da die Metro in der Nähe ist. Allerdings kann man auch fußläufig einiges erkunden.
Die Unterkunft war sehr angenehm und man hat sich sofort wohlgefühlt.
Über eine Ausziehbarleiter gelangt man auf die Dachterrasse, welche ein richtiges Highlight ist.
Die Kommunikation und der Check-in hat wunderbar und einfach funktioniert.
Schöne Wohnung mit toller Aussicht auf Lissabon. Äußerst günstig gelegen, sodass alle Ziele gut erreichbar sind. Wohnung ist sehr ruhig und lässt sich gut durch die Rollladen verdunkeln

This apartment has a great location, on a quiet street but near restaurants and grocery stores.
It is clean and bright and has a truly spectacular rooftop terrace.
The only downside is you will need to be agile, both because it is at the top of flights of stairs but also because the stairs continue even in the apartment. You have to step down and up again to get from the bedroom to the kitchen. As it is on the top floor, if you’re tall or even not that tall the angled walls may pose an issue if you’re not mindful of them.
Overall the apartment is as described and the host was very accommodating and welcoming. It’s extremely well located for walking and taking public transit.
L'appartement est très bien situé et facile d'accès, la terrasse sur le toit est très chouette.
This was an amazing place to stay. The hosts were very friendly and welcoming, suggesting where to go in the city. The space was beautifully and we loved the terrace for our sunset views.
Great location and lovely little apartment . Brilliant hosts with lots of useful local recommendations .
We had a great weekend in Lisbon! Sandra & Sofia’s place is just as described, centrally located, walking distance to downtown, and the rooftop was a perfect spot to view the city.
Très beau séjour !!
Rooftop terrace a huge plus! One of a kind in Lisbon.
Alles bestens! Ganz oben mit Blick auf Lissabon. Ruhig gelegen aber dennoch ziemlich zentral! Sehr nette Gastgeber!
Great location and communication. Very clean apartment.
Fantastic location close to everything, and the hosts were very friendly and helpful. The AC was fantastic in the heat. I recommend staying here!

This place was more than we expected! The terrace view of the city was amazing and relaxing. We were given great advice about the area. Our trip was definitely enlighten because we stayed here. Highly recommended!

The apartment was furnitured as described and located centrally so you can do everything by foot. Nevertheless the view from the rooftop goes into the rural neighborhood and sitting there is not really relaxable. The apartment was clean and communication was easy. If you are most of the day outside, I‘d recommend this apartment.

Sandra and Sofias place was a great spot for a Lisbon visit. Ideal for accessing main tourist walking routes, comfortable neighbourhood. It was a fun quirky suite surprisingly quiet but probably a bit much for those with mobility challenges. Great, fast communication as well. Highly recommended.
Great apartment in a good location. Balcony area is fantastic.

Sandra and Sofia's place is a real quiet gem tucked away in a bustling city. The highlight of the apartment is, without doubt, the roof terrace - where we relaxed with a spot of sunbathing whilst enjoying the gorgeous views towards the river, watching cruise ships come and go. It was the ideal spot for a pre-dinner beer or glass of wine.
The apartment was easy to find and check in was smoothly handled by Santiago. All facilities were clean and we were made to feel very welcome.
The neighbourhood is extremely quiet and just a few minutes walk from great restaurants for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Aldi is about a 1 minute walk away too, exceptionally handy.
Would highly recommend if you value your sleep after a long day exploring this beautiful but lively city!

Fantastic location which proved to be quiet amongst the busy streets nearby. We had a fantastic time in the city and the apartment was always convenient to get to. When we arrived, Tiago warmly greeted us and explained a few things about the apartment that we appreciated. I would highly recommend this apartment if you are staying in Lisbon for a short trip.

We had a fabulous stay at this apartment and would recommend it to friends in a heartbeat. The private terrace is a lovely perk that we took daily use of. It's a fantastic opportunity to unwind with a coffee in the morning or an aperitivo in the evening as you watch the Lisboa skyline unwrap before you.
The location is great and very central to stations, parks, and great shopping. The Aldi grocery store just two minutes away made meals in the apartment super easy. Even with this central location, the flat and surrounding area was wonderfully quiet and we had an easy time sleeping each night.
Wir hatten einen tollen Aufenthalt in der Unterkunft von Sandra & Sophia. Sehr zu empfehlen :)

Es waren 4 wunderbare Tage in einer Mega Wohnung.
Das Highlight ist die Dachterrasse mit der Dusche.
Darüberhinaus ist die Lage großartig!
Jederzeit wieder gerne!!!

Die Wohnung von Sandra und Sofia liegt mitten im Stadtzentrum. Die Dachterrasse bietet eine wunderschöne Aussicht über die Stadt. Alles war sehr sauber.
Beim Check-in haben wir viele Informationen über die Umgebung erhalten.
vielen Dank für diese tolle Unterkunft!
Vi hade en fantastisk vistelse, mysig lägenhet och ett bra läge. Mycket trevligt med en egen takterass där man kan sitta ostört och se solnedgången. Vi kommer gärna tillbaka.
We loved the rooftop patio.

Fin lille, charmerende og godt udnyttet lejlighed med fantastisk rooftop terrasse. Beliggende dejligt stille, og trods det lige i Lisboa Centrum - grænsende op til det dejlige, gamle, historiske Alfama og Baixa område. Super god kommunikation og velkomst fra værterne🤩

Sandra & Sofia reageren snel en zijn vriendelijk.
Enorm genoten van het dakterras.
De locatie is echt ideaal.
Nice place to stay, good location, no notes!

A hospedagem na acomodação de Sandra e Sofia foi excelente. Tudo estava conforme o anúncio. A localização é ótima, próxima à Avenida da Liberdade — uma das principais de Lisboa — com excelentes restaurantes, cafés e diversas comodidades por perto. Também fica muito perto de uma estação de metrô, o que facilitou bastante a locomoção. A anfitriã foi muito simpática e solícita, nos apresentou o imóvel pessoalmente e, sempre que precisamos entrar em contato, respondeu de forma imediata. Recomendo!
We had a great stay. The flat was as described and the location and view were excellent.

A really lovely one bedroom apartment with a nice rooftop. Had everything we needed for a pleasant weekend break in Lisbon. Location was excellent too - walking distance to the tourist areas and to the quieter suburbs.
The check in was great and we were welcomed by a host who did a great job of showing us round and giving local recommendations. Check out very easy too.
Note that no lift in the building so you will need to carry suitcase up/down a few flights of stairs.
Overall, a great stay and would return.
Sandra was a very friendly and responsive host! The apartment has a beautiful rooftop terrace and is in a great location central in Lisbon!
Great location and nice, quiet apartment.
Es hat alles vom Anfang bis zum Checkout sehr gut geklappt und wir haben uns sehr wohlgefühlt.

Appartement de qualité et suffisamment spacieux pour un séjour en couple.
La terrasse est un vrai plus.
La climatisation nous été utile pour nous réchauffer.
N'avons manqué de rien.
Je recommande

I have mixed feelings after the stay. On the plus side: very central apartment, a lot of light inside. It’s the top floor apartment, we rented it mainly because of the roof terrace, but couldn’t use it because of the rain. Plus, the stairs to this roof are quite wobbly, probably reliable, but scary to use.
The apartment plan is interesting, but I didn’t expect it to be this small (wasn’t clear from the photos).
The apartment was quite cold and damp (it was +12/15 outside) despite the working radiator and AC on. We couldn’t dry our socks even for couple of days. The smell of the bed was quite damp.
The kitchen is ok, has the main utensils, but there were only 2 forks. I wish I wouldn’t need to buy soap to the bathroom (because liquid soap was unusable due to the packaging).
The host was great in communication. Overall it’s a nice apartment, but quite overpriced. It’s my 3rd trip to Lisbon, so I know what to compare it with.

I had a great stay at a well equipped apartment for my week long visit. Extra bonus points for having a flat iron as well as a hairdryer.  The terrace and view is stunning, well worth going up there. I love all the sunlight warming the apartment during daylight.  Because I have a medical condition that makes me intolerant to cold temperatures finding extra blankets made a big difference achieving comfort besides the split unit heat option and portable heater.  Would I return: absolutely, I’d love a summer weather stay.

This was our first time in Lisbon and choosing to stay at Sandra & Sofia’s place was so worthwhile! We were allowed to leave our bags early and meet the host for a walk-through of the place. With the location being fairly central, we could walk 20 min and arrive in any of the popular districts of the city. Surrounded by amazing local restaurants and shops, you never run out of things to try! Our favorite detail of our stay, was the open air terrace with 360 views of the city and river. We also love the coziness and overall appeal of the place. Definitely recommend when looking for a lovely stay in Lisboa :)

Close to the main avenue but also on a quiet side street. Easy to get around the city and the apartment itself is a nice open floorplan. Rooftop terrace is a big bonus. Communication was easy and they were very helpful. There’s a little bit of a smell coming from the drains, but with how well they handle everything else I’m sure this will be resolved immediately as well.

What a Great location to explore Lisbon for a run or a walk. The apartment was safe, clean and and offered great views of the city. The hosts were friendly and would visit and stay next time. Thank you!
Good location, great views. Local supermarkets on R. de Santa Marta (not Aldi & gift shops) are best options for most grocery needs. Would be back.
An amazing experience -- will definitely be coming back! thank you!
Lovely stay in a great location. Everything was easily accessible :) The patio was a great bonus, we would definitely recommend this place!

Sandra's place is within walking distance to Avenida Liberdade - lots of shops, restos etc and walkable distance to musums and Tagus.
Super friendly and communicative hosts, comfy bed!
Had a great stay here, very walkable area. Hosts were great and apartment has everything you would need.
We had 4 great days in Lisboa. The apartment was very nice. Perfectly located near the sights but in a quiet narrow road.
Fantastic hosts! Had an amazing time, they really went the extra mile even when we locked ourselves out! Highly recommended!

Sandra & Sofia's AirBnB was awesome. It was quiet and cozy. The rooftop deck is incredible.
The location is very close to many things. I walked everywhere. It is also close to a metro stop & bus stop. The main street with lots of shops and restaurants is only two blocks away.
I would stay here again without hesitation. I felt very safe and comfortable.
I wanted to stay and drink coffee on the deck, but I was so close to so much I also wanted to walk around Lisbon. I should have stayed more than 3 days. ;)

Das Highlight ist die Dachterrasse, die über eine steile Auszugstreppe erreichbar ist (für körperlich Fitte).
Die Ausstattung ist etwas karg, vor allem die Beleuchtung funktioniert nicht (Treppenhaus vor der Wohnungstür dunkel, Leseleuchte am Bett, Dunsthaube-Arbeitsplatte Küche)

Danke für den schönes Auffenthalt in der Wohnung. Besonders  die Dachterasse hat uns beeindruckt. Man hat einen herrlichen Blick über die Stadt. Die Altstadt ist  gut zu Fuß erreichbar. Eigentlich hat man alles, was man braucht.
Gracias Sofia, hermosa, bella, amable, atenta gracias por tu explicación , por recibirnos y la orientación que nos diste

Super appartement dans un beau quartier. Tout le centre est accessible à pied
L intérieur de l appartement est chaleureux et possède tout le nécessaire pour un séjour dans la région. Rien à redire tout était parfait !!

The apartment was walking distance from a variety of locations, we loved that there was an Aldi nearby for any needs. Upon arriving someone was waiting for us with wine, bread, and cheese such a wonderful touch and then walked us through the apartment, offered recommendations and suggestions. Sandra and Sofia are truly amazing host and made our trip perfect.
Great place to stay in Lisbon! Very centrally located, comfortable, and great responsive hosts! Would highly recommend!

Die Wohnung ist hell und freundlich. Die Dachterrasse mit dem Blick bis zum Fluss ist einfach phantastisch. Man kann hier am Ende des Tages einen Wein genießen und dabei das Licht der untergehenden Sonne beobachten. Für die Nacht gibt es vor jedem Fenster Rollos. Die Verriegelung der Wohnungstür gleicht einem Tresor - man kann also getrost die eine oder andere Wertsache in der Wohnung nun zurücklassen. Von der Wohnung ist die Metrostation nur wenige Meter entfernt. Wir haben gleich am ersten Tag in der Nähe ein wunderbares Frühstücks-Cafe und für den Abend ein Restaurant gefunden. In Summe haben wir uns hier sehr wohl gefühlt.
Great location and very cool wee place.
Über den Dächern von Lissabon. Wurden herzlich empfangen und haben viele hilfreiche Tipps bekommen. Die Dachterrasse ist schnuckelig. Wir haben die Zeit sehr genossen. Zum Weiterempfehlen!

I truly loved this apartment. It's on a high floor and surprisingly very quiet because it is in the heart of the city. However, I do want to mention that there is what I consider a dangerous situation because there is only one small piece of wooden railing between the bedroom area and the staircase. I would not recommend this place to an older person who has to get up in the night to use the bathroom because you could take one wrong step and be seriously injured. If that is not a problem for you, then this apartment is a great value, very nicely appointed and in a great location.

Eine hübsche kleine Einzimmer-Wohnung mit einer herrlichen Dachterrasse. Gutes Bett! Größe und Einrichtung wie gemacht für Menschen, die die Wohnung überwiegend zum Schlafen nutzen und abends gerne den Tag auf der Terrasse ausklingen lassen. Der Aufstieg zur Terrasse war für uns (Ü70) noch machbar.
Ausstattung ok, In der Küche war alles für 2 Personen vorhanden, selber kochen war möglich, aber essen gehen war spannender (und einfacher).
Wir haben den Aufenthalt genossen! Danke 🙏

Sandra and Sofia’s place was wonderful! Great location and very responsive hosts. We had delays in our flight and they still helped accommodate our late check in. Would recommend this location if you want to explore Lisbon.

un accueil très chaleureux et adapté à nos origines.
On ne manque de rien et il y a quelques petites attentions très agréables.
L'environnement est très paisible, il y a supermarché, bars et restaurants à proximité.
Nous avons pu tout faire à pied. Vous êtes en quelques minutes sur l'avenue de la liberté ou en 15 min à la place du commerce, par exemple. Le métro et les tramways sont facilement accessibles aussi, ou encore la gare de Rossio si vous voulez vous rendre à Sintra.
Je recommande ce lieu, très bien placé pour découvrir la ville tout en pouvant se reposer le soir.
Tolle Lage, sehr sauber

We loved our time staying here! The location couldn’t be beat- less than 5 minutes from a grocery store, with restaurants and shops close by. The space was perfect for 2, and the views from the rooftop terrace were amazing. The description of the apartment in the listing was spot on. So sad to leave and hope to be back again soon 😊

In der Wohnung habe ich mich sehr wohl gefühlt. Es war sauber, die Lage wirklich toll, Metro nur gut 3 Minuten entfernt.
Die Dachterrasse ist ein Highlight und die Kommunikation mit den Gastgebern immer schnell, freundlich und kompetent.
Ich würde die Wohnung wieder buchen.
Emplacement idéale et hôtes adorable ! je recommande à 100 % !!
Great location and we loved the roof top deck!
We loved the air b n b. It was in the perfect location

Wir hatten einen schönen Urlaub und Aufenthalt in Lissabon. Die Wohnung war wie beschrieben und alles in Ordnung. Die Gastgeberinnen gut erreichbar und sehr freundlich. Die Küche und das Bad könnten etwas Liebe vertragen, dass hat aber die sehr gute Bewertung nicht gemindert.
A beautiful compact apartment in Lisbon! The terrace was a highlight, and we were in walking distance of virtually everywhere we wanted to go. Hosts were lovely and really responsive ☺️

Sandra and Sophia's apartment was wonderful. The apartment was clean, easy to find, and in a perfect location. The rooftop terrace was magical in the mornings and evenings.
Check-in was easy and Sandra met us at the apartment to show us around. The welcome basket with cheese, bread, and wine was such a thoughtful touch!

Lovely little flat in a good area, with a fantastic rooftop terrace with amazing views and sunlight. We walked everywhere, but close to public transport if you need. ALDI just down the road for anything you need, and we'll uqipped kithchen for making food in the flat. It's small but everything thing you need for a base - would highly recommend

Perfect stay for a long weekend in Lisbon. Beautiful rooftop views across to the river. Apartment was perfect size for two people.
There are a lot of stairs with no elevator but wasn’t an issue for us.
Restaurants within throwing distance were ideal and an Aldi.

Das Apartment war ideal für unseren Kurzurlaub in Lissabon: Top Lage und dennoch eine ruhige Nachbarschaft. Die Dachterrasse ist ein weiterer besonderer Pluspunkt.
Die Wohnung war blitzsauber und es war alles da, was wir benötigten
Danke, liebe Sandra auch für die herzliche Begrüßung und die serviceorientierte und unkomplizierte Kommunikation. Wir kommen gerne wieder!

Our host greeted us and gave us the tour of the place.  The listing states 15 mins walk to all the amenities - it is the ideal spot to get to everything! The neighbourhood hosts a variety of shops, including tucked away treasures.  The rooftop terrace is a great spot to enjoy some wine and relax while enjoying the sunset.  Please note : This is not the right place for persons with mobility issues or young children.

We had a fabulous few days in Lisbon and staying at Sandra and Sofias place made our visit very easy and so accessible to the centre of Lisbon. The welcome pack was lovely and the detailed information on where and what to do got us straight out into the city. It was a real help sorting out a taxi for our very early flight which worked really well too. Highly recommend this accommodation with all amenities in the flat that you need along with the added bonus of the roof terrace which is lovely. Thank you so much Sandra and Sofia
A great little apartment with a fabulous sun terrace. Easy to find, great base to explore Lisbon with lots of amenities nearby.

nice stay in lisbon - location was good for morning breakfast places. for evenings it's a climb back up the hill. Unit was clean. had cold shower once or twice. also note a climb up many flights of stairs. perhaps not suitable for those with mobility issues. comfortable bed. good stay overall.

Die Unterkunft besteht aus einem Raum, nur das kleine Badezimmer ist separat. Die Einrichtung hat deutliche Gebrauchsspuren und man merkt dem Raum an, das hier ein hoher Durchlauf herrscht. Die Einrichtung der Küche ist spärlich und etwas lieblos. Insgesamt ist wenig Platz. Es gibt zwar einen Schrank, der ist aber komplett vollgestellt mit Reinigungsmaterial, Staubsauger und div. anderen Dingen um die Wohnung zu betreiben. Die Duschkabine ist undicht und der Boden drumherum schon ganz schwarz vom auslaufenden Wasser. Das Bett ist relativ schmal und die sehr kleine Couch schon ziemlich durchgesessen. Die Dachterrasse ist durch eine aus der Zimmerdecke ausklappbare schmale Leiter zu erklimmen. Die Bilder im Inserat sehen deutlich besser aus als die Realität.

Great place in a safe area.  Rooftop views were fantastic.  Amenities like coffee, sugar, wine, cheese and bread!  We had a great time in Lisboa and there were close by locations to catch a ride share.  Must be able to navigate a ladder and fit through a small door to access rooftop.

We really loved our stay in Sandra and Sophia’s little flat. It was bright and clean with easy access to shops and restaurants and walking distance from places of interest. The roof terrace afforded great views and once up there was a lovely place to sit and chill, however, you will need to watch your head when bending to get through access door if tall like us! Sandra and Sophia were quick to respond to queries and messages and were super accommodating to our needs and requests. Would definitely recommend this one for a stay in Lisboa.
Great deal. Great location ( next to all shops and restaurants) and lovely hosts - very welcoming and helpful. Lovely place to stay.

Sandra and Sophia's place was exactly as described. They were very communicative and helpful. Sophia met us at the apartment and stayed to explain the apartment and show us several places on the local map. They left us some complimentary apples, cheese, and wine.
The apartment was clean and had all the necessary amenities. It was close to downtown area with many shops and restaurants.
I highly recommend this stay.
Super séjour, appartement propre et bien situé 5 minutes du métro de nombreux resto à proximité. Je recommande.
Der Aufenthalt in Lissabon war wunderschön! Besonders die Dachterasse lädt zum Entspannen ein. Unsere Ankunft war super freundlich und herzlich. Vielen Dank dafür!

A fantastic studio, in a very central location and beautiful views from the roof terrace. The hosts were very friendly, responsive and even left little treats for us in the flat. The flat had everything that we needed, and the umbrella came in handy!
Note: there’s a €30 late check in fee if you arrive after 8pm. This took us by surprise as it’s hidden in the small print. Nevertheless, it was worth staying there.
Very cute little flat in a great location, perfect for a shorter stay in stunning Lisbon! Thank you so much Sandra and Sofia!
Very beautiful place in Lisbon!

Cet appartement est certes petit mais suffisant pour 2 personnes et avec tout à disposition. Il est très propre.  Il est dans le centre de Lisbonne, mais vous êtes au calme et près du métro et du train si on veut aller ailleurs : exemple Sintra,  un lieu à ne pas manquer . Les propriétaires Sandra et Sofia et je n'oublie pas Vera sont très disponibles et répondent facilement. Je vous conseille cet appartement

Superbe appartement, très bien situé... a 2 pas de la station Avenidad et a distance de marche de la Gare Rossio et de la place commerciale.  Il y a aussi une panoplie de petit restaurants a 2 pas... pratique lors des soirées pluvieuses... Nous avons adorés.
Loved our stay at Sandra and Sofia’s place! So cute, great neighborhood, amazing rooftop view! Welcoming hosts!

A cozy apartment in a nice and safe neighborhood. The only small inconvenience is that it’s on the third floor with no elevator and the stairs are pretty narrow, but we had a great experience in general!
The size and location of this place is great and the sky deck is a huge plus.
Ein sehr schönes Apartment! Wir kommen gerne wieder.

The apartment was wonderful for a 4 night stay and the rooftop terrace is a gem! The apartment is in a perfect location, easy walking distance to metro stop and top attractions. Sandra met us at time of checkin and even provided a recommendation on a fabulous toy shop where I was able to purchase gifts for my kids. I would recommend this apartment and will stay here when I return to Lisbon.

Sandra & Sofia waren sehr nett, hatten tolleTipps für die Umgebung und haben uns mit Käse, Brot und Wein empfangen. Wir durften unser Gepäck am Abreisetag im Appartement stehen lassen. Der Abholservice von Ricardo hat sehr gut funktioniert. Die Lage des Appartements ist sehr gut um Lissabon zu erkunden. Die Wohnung war sauber und ordentlich, die Dachterrasse ist ein Highlight. Unser einziger Minuspunkt ist der Schimmel in der Dusche und der damit verbunde Geruch.
This was the best Lisbon retreat ever!  We lived the little loft and then Loved our privateroof deck!  What a deal!  I have foundmy Lisbon home!

Cute and cozy space located about a block away from some incredible restaurants and walking distance to the main plaza. Sofia gave us a ton of useful information about the city, and she took extra time to help us out with a rental car issue we were having. Highly recommend staying here, especially if it's your first time in the city and you want some tips for how to get the most out of your time there.

Sandra and Sofia are wonderful hosts. Sofia met me at the apartment and was able to let me check in early since the apartment was already ready. She walked me around the apartment and took me up to the beautiful roof top. She also had wine, bread, and cheese for me which was a wonderful welcoming. Sofia also drew out all the recommendations on the map and showed me the things she recommends in walking distance. The apartment is around the corner from an Aldi’s and walking distance to the posh shopping street and other shopping. It’s a short Uber ride to the city center. The apartment doesn’t have an elevator and is on the 3rd floor. Not an issue for me but will be for anyone with mobility issues. There’s a weird gap between the living room and bedroom as others described which you’ll want to be careful with. WiFi isn’t good enough for Teams meeting calls but since I was on holiday and wasn’t supposed to be working, I didn’t mind. Thank you for the great stay Sandra and Sophia!

Great location for exploring the city either by foot or public transport. Supermarket very close and a huge selection of restaurants on the doorstep.
Love the rooftop deck for breakfast, even in November!
Just loved the place!

Excellent stay! Cute little place with a great neighborhood feel but walking distance to so many great restaurants and cafes. Hosts were very communicative, responsive and welcoming. 3 flights of stairs were a little tricky with lots of bags, but worth it for the lovely view on the roof!
Great stay! The terrace was amazing, the place was very cute and cozy and was perfect for what we needed. Would definitely stay again and easily recommend.
vielen Dank, die Gastgeberinnen waren sehr zuvorkommend.

设施：齐全，方便
独特亮点：有一个屋顶阳台
房东互动：房东太太特别好，热心细心安排得明明白白非常贴切
周边好玩：在老城区，到哪里都方便

Tolles Appartement, besonderes Highlight ist die Dachterasse mit grandiosen Ausblick, perfekt geeignet fürs Frühstück und den abendlichen Sundowner. Tolle Lage, die zu Entdeckungen einlädt, Restaurants ( Antikcafe ist sehr zu empfehlen) in der Nähe und auch ein sehr gut sortierter Aldi. Wir hatten eine wunderbare Zeit und kommen sehr gerne wieder. Petra und Claudia
Great location with easy access to the metro station, local restaurants and there is an Aldi one street over.

Our host received us with bread, olives and wine. She took ample time to introduce us to the appartment, and gave us info on our whereabouts and things to visit in Lisbon. We had a lovely stay in Lisbon and a nice appartment and welcoming host certainly helps.
Brigit and Gerard

Super logement à Lisbonne !
