Idéalement situé, à 2 rues de l’avenue principale et 2 minutes à pied du métro, l’appartement est très fonctionnel et bien équipé. Bien que proche d’une avenue passante et de nombreux restaurants, la rue est calme. Le cœur historique de Lisbonne n’est qu’à 10 minutes de marche, ce qui est très pratique pour se déplacer.
Les hôtes sont très aimables et nous ont fait de nombreuses recommandations sur les lieux à visiter et ceux à éviter.
Je recommande vivement !

Die Wohnung war toll, für zwei Personen gut geeignet. Wegen vieler anderer Möglichkeiten haben wir die Dachterasse leider nicht genutzt.
Sandra und Sophia waren super zu erreichen und haben uns auch tolle Tipps gegeben.
Wohnung liegt 20 Gehminuten vom Zentrum entfernt und hat schnellen Zugang zu öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln.
Beim nächsten Mal Lissabon, würden wir da gerne wieder unterkommen.
Vielen Dank.
Tout était parfait, le roof top est très agréable.
Lovely quiet apartment but only a few minutes walk from the centre. Would definitely recommend staying here.

En perfekt bolig til 2
Værten tog imod pp aftalte tidspunkt, viste boligen gav gode tip til seværdigheder osv har absolut kun positivt at sige om mit ophold.
Tagterrassen satte prikken over I’et skønt at kunne kravle derop og nyde udsigten 💥
Kan kun give de varmeste anbefalinger
Fabulous apartment with rooftop terrace. Highly recommend this property. Ideally situated for the main town. Local restaurants nearby.

Nous avons passé une superbe semaine à Lisbonne. L'appartement était bien situé pour nous permettre de découvrir la ville en marchant. Sofia nous a accueilli avec beaucoup de chaleur et en français ! De petites attentions complétaient le tout (vin, pain, fromage). Et que dire de la terrasse sur le toit! Quelle vue! Un plus pour cet appartement, certes petit mais très fonctionnel. Je le recommande chaudement.

Amazing place. The roof top terrace out of this world. Sandra and Sophia are hosts par excellence.  The place was everything we wished for. Situated in the best and most luscious part of Lisbon. Highly recommended! Will stay here again on my next trip.
It was a very nice apartment with a good view over the city.

Sandra & Sofia's place is truly special! it has all the amenities you need and is steps from so many of Lisbon's sights. Sandra & Sofia are welcoming hosts and give helpful tips on places to see and eat!

Sandra greeted us when we arrived in Lisbon to show us the place and give us a few recommendations! The AirBnB is definitely within walking distance to most of the popular spots in Lisbon, keep in mind, 1 Lisbon KM is different than a regular KM with all the hills 😂.
Nonetheless, the place was very clean and looked exactly like the photos! It was great for our 5 day stay in the city.
I would definitely recommend this unit for any couple or solo traveling to Lisbon!
Thank you again for hosting us, we really enjoyed our time :)

Absolutely beautiful little apartment! Such an excellent use of the space, everything we need for a few nights stay. We also loved the rooftop terrace, so cool!!
I also cannot stress enough how amazing the location is. Just a short walk to Avenida da Liberdade (which ended up being where one of our tours started!) and close to cafes, restaurants and a supermarket (Aldi). Our tour guides and Uber drivers even commented on how good the location is!
As others have mentioned, the apartment is on the third floor with no lift. Not an issue for us, but something to be mindful of for those with heavy suitcases or mobility issues.
We would highly recommend to anyone staying in Lisboa!!

We had a great stay.  Host greeted us before check in to store our bags.  She was very friendly and helpful as she showed us around the apartment and gave us great information about Lisbon.  We walked everywhere which is accessible to the apartment.  We would recommend a stay here.

Wonderful apartment located one street from local delicious, inexpensive restaurants and an Aldi grocery.  Short walk to main avenue and metro stations.  So, it happened that two of our tours started within blocks of the apartment.  Simply note that the apartment is on the top floor.  This was not an issue for us, but it could be for someone with a lot of luggage.
Excellent stay in a perfect location!
Great location and place! Good value and clean.
The perfect location and space for our stay, very close to all the best places to visit in Lisbon but also a felt quiet and safe. Thank you Sofia!

Even with a late check in at 9:30pm, our host gave us a detailed tour of the apartment and overview of where to go in Lisbon and how to get around - all which was invaluable. The three flights of small steps was barely an inconvenience and needed after all the good food we consumed! Shopping and other conveniences close by and only a 20 minute walk to main Downtown area. Amazing views from the top roof as long as you’re comfortable with attic pull down stairs. Would definitely stay here again!

Had a great stay in Lisbon for 2 nights here.  The host met us at check-in and gave us the full run down, as well as tons of recommendations.  The  location is amazing too, tons of walkable options and close to the metro as well.  The apartment was great, exactly as described.  Would definitely recommend and hope to be back in the future.

Great location, great apartment, luxury of a private terrace to enjoy the sunshine and great views. Lots of walkable places nearby, slightly hilly but we enjoyed the walking! Hosts very responsive and full of recommendations! Perfect for our 4 night stay in Lisbon!

On a vraiment apprécié notre séjour chez Sandra & Sofia. Je commence par l'accueil en personne qui etait chaleureux et tres utile en nous faisant decouvrir le logement, les activités et restaurants à faire.
Le logement était top, très propre, ensoleillé, lumineux,bien équipé.
Merci Sandra pour votre accueil et on n'hésitera pas à revenir, vivement le prochain sejour
Outstanding in every way. Generous and responsive host. Amazing location right in the heart of Lisbon. Easy to walk everywhere. Very fun relaxing rooftop too.
Great stay in a great location. Very responsive and helpful hosts!
The apartment was exactly as described. The location was walkable to everywhere we went. The roof deck was great!
Cute and interesting space. Loved the rooftop deck!

Sehr freundlicher Empfang durch Sandra inkl. ausführlicher Einweisung in das Apartment, die Umgebung mit Restaurants und Einkaufsmöglichkeiten.
Absolut tolle Dachterrasse mit phantastischem Rundblick über die Altstadt von Lissabon bis zum Tejo.
Das Apartment ist nett und zweckmäßig eingerichtet.
Der Zugang über die Ausziehleiter zur Dachterrasse ist jedoch nicht einfach.
Zwischen Schlaf- und Wohnbereich befindet sich eine tiefe Stufe, auf die man besonders achten sollte.
Generell ist die Unterkunft zu empfehlen.

Wir hatten wunderbare Tage in Lissabon! Das Apartment ist sehr schön und gemütlich, insbesondere die Dachterrasse ist ein Highlight. Toll fanden wir auch, dass um die Ecke direkt ein Supermarkt ist. Die Lage ist wirklich zentral.
Wir kommen gerne wieder :)

Sofia greeted us when we got there so check in was very smooth, and she gave us great tips on navigating Lisbon and what to do in our 2 days there. Also could not be a better location! Central to pretty much everything you’d want to do, we walked pretty much everywhere easily! Would highly recommend staying here!

Great place to stay in Lisbon and very clean.   Close to everything.   Really nice place.  Very clean great instructions from host on how to get to apartment, what to visit  and where to eat.   Sandra’s knowledge was amazing and helpful.    Would stay there again in a heart beat.
The apartment was perfect for our week in Lisbon, friendly check in, the roof terrace was great and the location was brilliant for exploring the city. Would definitely recommend this place
Sofia welcomed us personally and very friendly. We had a beautiful stay in this apartment!

Très bel appartement, parfaitement situé. L'arrêt de métro Avenida est proche et le quartier est très agréable. La terrasse sur le toit est une pépite. Nous avons passé un excellent séjour à Lisbonne.

Het huis en vooral het dakterras waren perfect! De locatie is zeer dichtbij de metro waardoor alles goed te bereiken was.
De communicatie met de host was ook goed. We moesten even wachten bij het inchecken, maar we kwamen ook erg snel uit het vliegtuig dus was dit wachten begrijpelijk en we konden snel even wat boodschappen halen bij de supermarkt om de hoek dus het wachten was geen probleem voor ons.
Ik zou ook zeker de tips uit de gids van de host proberen. Dit was een mooie aanvulling op ons verblijf in Lissabon.
Ik zou hier zeker terugkomen als ik nog een keer naar Lissabon zou gaan.

We had a lovely stay at this apartment. It was clean and well-presented throughout. The hosts were very responsive. Sofia met us at the property to check in and left us some local wine, cheese and bread which was a lovely touch. The absolute highlight of this property is the rooftop area with beautiful views over Lisbon - we enjoyed our morning coffees up there 😀 The apartment is walkable from the city centre and there is an Aldi just a minute away. Only thing to note is you do need to be quite mobile to fully enjoy the space - the apartment is located on the third floor and the rooftop requires use of a ladder to access. Overall, a great stay in Lisbon - thank you Sandra and Sofia 😀 I would recommend this place to other people visiting Lisbon.

Sehr freundliche, sehr gute und hilfreiche Betreuung durch die Gastgeberin, gut erschlossene Lage mit U-Bahnanschluss, Bahnhof gut zu Fuss erreichbar, sonnige Dachterrasse mit Zugang über Dachbodentreppe mit schönem Ausblick auf den Fluss, gute Ausstattung in kleinen Appartement, Treppensteigen war für uns kein Problem, für uns hat es insgesamt gut gepasst.
Bel accueil, bel appartement. Un peu bruyant car construction d’un édifice  à  proximité. Installations sur la terrasse demanderaient à  être  améliorer: parasol, chaises…
Really nice place, good view from the terrace and in a convenient, quiet location

This is a beautiful apartment right in the heart of Lisbon. Our host was waiting when we checked in and gave us so much wonderful information about what to see and where to go. She was so helpful and accommodating.  I highly recommend this place to anyone traveling in Lisbon. you are so close to many landmarks and great restaurants. the apartment is the perfect size for 2. Beautiful and bright and having roof access was a favourite part to enjoy coffees and drinks during sunset.

Sofia met me late in the evening to check me in. Very friendly and open person, she gave me many tips about what to do and where to eat.
The place was very cool for a short stay. The terrace has an amazing view.
Be aware, many stairs, no lift. With a hand luggage it was very easy.
It’s a quite place, has everything needed. Will advise definitely to my friends!

We had an amazing staying in the Sandra & Sofia’s place. I can’t imagine a better place in terms of location - great neighborhood with good restaurants (I really recommend all the so-called “tascas” nearby) and stores, and a short walk from the Lisbon historic center. Besides that, the apartment is really cute and comfy - the terrace gave us good moments! And both Sandra and Sofia were super responsive and kindness with us, providing tons of useful information about Lisbon and the best places to visit.
It was lovely to stay there but it was way harder to access the rooftop than what was made clear!

Wonderful top floor apartment in Lisbon with beautiful and private rooftop terrace. Only a 20 minute walk to all the highlights of old town Lisbon. The apartment is in the middle of the city but is just slightly off the beaten path so that there is only local foot traffic and is very quiet at night. There is a grocery and small shops nearby for any necessities. I would absolutely stay here again on my next visit.
Very nice place, nice view from the rooftop. Neighbor was quiet.
We had a great time here. It was perfectly situated, close to everything we wanted to walk to and see. The space was cozy, perfect for a couple on a romantic trip to Lisbon!

Sandra and Sofia were very accommodating, letting us check-in early since the apartment was available. This was an added bonus and allowed us to drop our bags and start exploring Lisbon nice and early. The recommendations given for travel, places to visit and eat were very helpful and meant we could make best use of our time. The apartment was perfect, with all the advertised facilities. Book this place! Perfect for solo traveller or a couple.

Friendly & easy check-in, great communication.
Very nice location to visit the city
Great flat, communication

Recomendo!!! Excelente estadia, boa localização, rooftop muito charmoso e a sandra nos recepcionou muitissimo bem!!! com certeza retornaremos :))

The place is generally great, and the pictures (mostly) show it as it is. However, I offer these things for the future traveler:
Pros:
- Communication was super fast and the people we talked to and met were great
- There is a rooftop terrace
- Location is great
- It is two minutes from the best restaurant we went to in Portugal: Sr. Lisboa
- The bathroom is really nice
Cons:
- The bed sinks in the middle
- You can hear everything on the street and neighboring apartments; keep a fan on to drown out the noise
- One of the other apartments (I think it is the first floor) has some serious issues with hygiene, and the entire stairwell smells as foul as a dirty zoo - hold your nose going in and out. Fortunately, the smell does not exist in the apartment!
- There is no place to hang your clothes and no drawers to put them in - you must live out of your suitcase in this place
- This is a studio apartment, which in and of itself is not a con; however, if you were expecting a one-bedroom apartment, it might be
- Getting to the rooftop terrace means pulling down a retractable ladder from a hole in the ceiling and being careful not to scrape your back crawling out
You can absolutely be comfortable staying in this place, and it has its charms, for sure. I appreciate honest reviews and so offer mine thus. Personally, I would not stay here again.

Love love love this place! The location is superb, can't beat it. However, be prepared to climb to get there. It's about 50 steps up from the entrance (no elevator), and this is usually after climbing 50 steps up from one street away near the metro. I came to Lisbon to run a 10K so am in shape and my husband and I didn't mind. But the reward is worth it! It's a little tricky to get to the top roof deck (you have to pull down the stairs from where they are tucked in above the ceiling), but the view is superb, day or night. The warm sunlight on a cool winter's day was heavenly, and the night view was lovely... there just are not that many roof decks in the city so this was a special treat. We didn't get to meet Tiago, but he had someone else meet us and she was there waiting for us when we arrived, so getting in was easy. I recommend taking a taxi or car service - we used the one Tiago recommended and the chauffeur was waiting for us with sign at the airport, just 19 Euro. Once you know where you are, you can use public transport, it's excellent in Lisbon. The Avenida metro is just a few steps away near the Tivoli theater, and you can get anywhere from there. Pay about 6 Euro for a 24 hour ticket - it will get you onto all the metros, trams and funiculars in the city. Tip: an ATM card works if you are using the machines in the metro station, but a credit card does not. The little special touches in the condo were just lovely - a bottle of wine & goat cheese & some fresh bread. Excellent internet, many channels on the cable TV (with Netflix! You won't want to stay in, but just in case it's a rainy day...), JBL speaker to hook up to your iPhone. There are a ton of windows on 3 sides so you get beautiful bright light, but you can fully close the outdoor window shades and it keeps all the light out (necessary if you want sleep after staying up all night for New Years!) I love places like this that have a separate or separated bedroom (I like sleep but my husband can stay up much longer in the other room). Caution though - in this condo to get from the living room to the bedroom area, you must cross the 3-ft wide top step of the stairway, about 10 inches lower than the floor. If you are awake and sober, this is no problem. Try not to forget this or it could be awkward. Airbnb folks always talk about the bed and shower (though how much time do we actually spend in the room folks?) So the only negative - I wish the bedding was a little newer (though the bed was comfy). Shower has great pressure and...

Tiago's apartment is compact,  excellently equipped, well provisioned, close to the Metro, numerous small shops, small supermarket, and loads of restaurants, coffee shops and excellent Tascas. A nice addition is that Tiago authored a book about Tascas in Lisbon, which proved very handy. We made full use of the rooftop terrace for breakfasts and later afternoon drinks and snacks. If we visit Lisbon again we certainly would consider staying here. Many thanks Tiago.

Tiago met us at the apt - gift basket of fruits, cheese, and wine included. Honestly I cannot say enough about our stay there. Beautiful apt, perfect part of town, the roof is AMAZING and Tiago was so welcoming. Stay here, you will not regret it.

Tiago provided us with a very accurate map which made finding the apartment very easy. He was able to bring forward the time to meet us at the apartment which was very helpful. The welcome box of fruit, wine & cheese went down very well. The apartment was exactly as described - a perfect get away for 2 people. Only drawback are the stairs. Lots of books on Lisbon are there for your use during your stay &  lots recommendations from Tiago both verbally & written. The apartment is very central & only a few minutes walk from a metro line. Lisbon is very beautiful & hopefully we will be back again.
Eine tolle Unterkunft. Zentral gelegen, mit allem, was man für einen Städtetrip braucht. Restaurants, mini Supermarkt in der Nähe. Gute Anbindung an Metro und Hauptbahnhof.

Tiago was an excellent host. He was at the apartment when we arrived and spent considerable time showing us around the apartment and answering questions. He had several suggestions concerning restaurants and transportation that were extremely helpful . He put together a little book containing restaurant suggestions and reviews as well as places of interest. We have no reservations in recommending this apartment to other travelers and will inform our friends intending on traveling to Lisbon.

Really cool place with good air con, excellent amenities and the big bonus of the super cool roof terrace made our stay excellent.
Tiago went above and beyond to make us comfortable and was incredibly responsive and easy to talk to - helping us with all aspects of our stay.
Bed was really comfortable and a good size. Would definitely recommend
We had a great time at Tiago's apartment. The roof terrace is amazing! The flat is perfect for 2 people staying in Lisbon! Definitely recommended!

It feels like piling on, given all the other glowing reviews, but it's worth repeating: This apartment is the perfect introduction to Lisbon. It starts with the host, Tiago, who couldn't be more kind, helpful and gracious -- not to mention passionate about Portugal (and Portugese food!). The location itself is accessible to anything you'll need - walking or Metro. The neighborhood is safe and scenic. And while we spent most of our day exploring Lisbon, it's hard not to at least have one meal on the rooftop terrace. We wish we could have stayed longer. Highly, highly recommended.

Great location for getting around the city! Tiago checked us in with wine cheese flowers and lots of information about the city. He even helped to call my husband and I a cab because we didn't have cell service. Great experience!

호스트가 일이 있어 직접 집을 소개해주지 못한다고 해서 걱정했는데, 에어비앤비 메시지를 통해 정말! 즉각적으로 연락이 잘 되어서 마음 편했어요. 대신 집 안내 해준 분도 정말 친절했고, 슈퍼마켓이 가까워요.
집 자체가 언덕에 있고 우리나라로 치면 4층인데 승강기가 없고 계단이 좁아서 짐이 많으면 조금 힘들구요. 전철역도 가깝고 기차역이나 트램타는 광장 모두 걸어서 이동할 수 있는 거리인데 한 10분 ~ 15분정도 걸려요. 위치를 전혀 생각하지 않고 사진 한장에 꽂혀서 예약한 곳이라 제 입장에선 그랬고.. 조용한 쪽이 좋다 하면 위치도 좋을 것 같아요 ^^ 집은 넘 예쁘고 깨끗하고, 물도 잘 나오고 좋습니다.

I rented Tiago's space for my son and his girlfriend for two days. They loved it. Especially the roof terrace. They claimed the bed was excellent and everything was in working order. They would definitely stay here again. Tiago's gracious mom, Suzanne. met us, and had a bottle of wine, cheese, bread, and peaches waiting!

We had a great stay in Tiago's apartment. It's very central and in short walking distance to all the sites, restaurants, bars and transport. Highlights were the rooftop terrace and beautiful wine, bread and local cheese which were left for us. Would highly recommend Tiago's apartment for a stay in Lisbon.
Apartment is small but perfectly formed, Tiago was a great host, leaving very detailed info regarding restaurants, etc. We will return.
Welcome from Sonia was thorough.  we loved our location easy to walk to everything in the old town.

We really enjoyed our stay at Tiago's apartment. The apartment is located very central and perfect to explore the city. It's close to a metro station or even possible to walk to the city centre. Tiago sent us lots of information on Lisbon beforehand and has collected lots of tips on restaurants, bars, etc. in the apartment which we found extremely useful. Many thanks!

Bei unserer Ankunft hatten wir uns völlig verfranst und landeten in einem indischen Restaurant. Tiago holte uns nach einem Anruf sofort von dort ab. Sehr nett!
Am 1. Tag funktionierte der Internet-Empfang aufgrund eines Problems in der Straße nicht, wie sich später herausstellte. Tiago organisierte die Reparatur innerhalb weniger Stunden, womit wir nicht gerechnet hatten.
Das Apartment liegt relativ nah an der Metro-Station "Avenida", also recht zentral.
Uns hat der Aufenthalt gefallen, aufgehalten haben wir uns allerdings dort fast nur abends.
Bedenkelos weiter empfehlenswert!

I had a wonderful stay in this apartment. Tiago was a great host. He was in touch with me a few weeks before the stay to help me find the apartment as well as sending me some useful tourist links of Lisbon. When I arrived at the flat I had portoguese bread, wine and cheese waiting for me! The rooftop terrace is fantastic and generally the flat very well located. Great flat, great host, great location. I would definitely be back!

Very nice appartement with a really lovely terrasse.
A very welcoming place.
We also tried a toscas recommended by tiago's book: toscanna casa de pasto and it was very good !

If you are looking for a great apartment to explore this beautiful city, this place is what you need. We stayed from July 25 till August 2 at Tiago's. He is a great host and and always attainable for any questions. The apartment is very well located (walking distance from metrostation, from metrostation to centre is just less then 5 minutes) and nearby all the beautiful areas of Lisbon. The apartment is clean and just as the photos show you (the description of the apartment is exactly what you get). The view from the terrace is beautiful and perfect for breakfast, a drink or something like that. The neighborhood is safe and very restful - and that's perfect because of the bustle from the city. So, no negative comment at all. Highly recommended.

We spent a wonderful week, the apartment of Tiago is a small paradise in the heart of Lisbon.
The roof offers a breathtaking 360 with sumptuous sunset.
The apartment was very clean and excellent reception of Tiago, with perfect communication.
Thanks Tiago!

Superbe week-end à Lisbonne et Tiago y est pour beaucoup!
Son appartement est très agréable et bien situé. Sa terrasse sur le toit offre une vue imprenable de Lisbonne et permet des petits-déjeuners et apéros bien appréciables au soleil!
Nous avons été chaleureusement accueillis par Sonia, une amie de Tiago, qui nous a de suite fait partager tous les conseils et recommandations sur la ville.
Bien que nous n'ayons pas rencontré Tiago, il est resté un hôte attentif et bienveillant.
Attention aux personnes ayant le vertige, la première montée est impressionnante mais la peur s'estompe au bénéfice de la vue!
Obrigado Tiago e Sonia :) !

Had a wonderful time in Lisbon. And Tiago's flat was definitely part of it. Great location, with everything you need, including a rooftop terrace. The steel ladder frightened me at first, but I forgot my fear of heights once I got up there!
As for Tiago, well, the perfect host. Very welcoming, helpful and eager to share his tips. Thanks for the wine, by the way!
Highly recommended

Tiago was a great host, gave us loads of info before we arrived and lots of recommendations. Great communication. He was always available to help us.
The apartment is in a great location, easy to get to everywhere.
It was exactly as described, a great base for exploring the city. The rooftop was amazing, brilliant views and a real sun trap!
Everything we needed was there, we stayed 10 days and were very comfortable.
Thank you Tiago!
Rosie and Stephen

Our stay at Tiago's apartment in Lisbon was exceptional. On arrival we was greeted by his neighbor Sonia as Tiago was on vacation however Sonia was friendly, welcoming and a great help. Sonia explained where local amenities were and guided us around the apartment ensuring we was comfortable and aware of where everything we could need was. Tiago's  apartment was lovely and welcoming with a arrival gift of beers, bread and Portuguese cheese! The location of the apartment itself was in the centre of Lisbon, which therefore meant we was within a walkable distance from all of Lisbon's attractions! Overall our stay at Tiago's apartment was excellent, Thank you!

Das Apartment ist absolut fantastisch! Eins der besten airbnb-Erfahrungen, die wir je hatten!!! Es gleicht einem 1-Raum-Hotel! Die Lage, die tolle Ausstattung und die Sonnenterrasse sind absolute Highlights! Es ist super ausgestattet & ideal für 2 Personen. Das Apartment hat sogar Meer- / Tejo-Blick von der Terrasse! Absolut genial! Wir kommen gerne wieder und können dieses Apartment uneingeschränkt weiterempfehlen!!!

Tiago est un hôte charmant, nous nous sommes sentis à l'aise dès notre arrivée grâce à son accueil. Très serviable et disponible, il répond tout de suite aux questions et conseille ses bonnes adresses.
L'appartement est très lumineux et chaleureux, sa situation excellente, de même que la terrasse et la vue.
Ce fut un superbe séjour, pouvoir profiter d'un appartement tel que celui de Tiago après de belles journées de visites était un bonheur.

The apartment is perfectly located near the Avenida metro stop and walking distance to most places including the areas of Bairro Alto and Alfama. Also walking distance (or metro) to train stations Rossio (to get to Sintra) and Cais do Sodre (to get to Belem/Cascais). Mini market located just a couple of minutes walk. The apartment itself has everything needed, comfortable bed, great view from the rooftop terrace (although it was too windy for us to enjoy it much), coffee machine, microwave.. and we had a lovely arrival gift which was unexpected and much appreciated. Tiago and Sonia were very helpful, meeting us on arrival and providing heaps of suggestions and advice, and the Lisbon books provided were also informative. Highly recommended! Thanks Tiago :)

We went to Lisbon for the second time and wanted to stay in Tiagos' appartement again since we had such great memories of our last stay there. We knew that we wouldn't miss a single thing...its a fully and neat equipped appartement. Tiago welcomed us personally and showed us some things he renewed: a new carpet in the living room, sun beds at the breathtaking roof terrasse. It felt like "Coming Home"! Tiago invited us for some beer at a nice beerhouse next to the appartement and explained us where to go when celebrating Nationals Day and Fiestas Lisboa that last a whole month from june till july in Lisbon and surroundings. When we returned a nice arrangement of cheese, fruits as well as some good wine awaited us for the first evening to come. Best host ever, Thanks again Tiago!

My boyfriend and I really enjoyed our stay at Tiago's apartment. Having breakfast and before dinner drinks up on the roof top patio was amazing. It's in a great location with easy access to all the other neighborhoods. And we really appreciated all of Tiago's restaurant recommendations.

Everything was great, and the terrace is beyond
all expectations!

Tiago was an amazing host! The apartment was absolutely perfect for a couple getaway and the roof top was exactly like the pictures. Having meals and drinks looking over all the old Lisbon houses was one of our favorite things on our trip. Tiago greeted us at the apartment on arrival with a basket full of Portuguese goodies! The apartment has a full kitchen,and is a 3 minute walk to the metro station. It was also alot of fun trying all the "hole in the wall" restaurants from Tiagos book! You must stay here if you are planning a trip to Lisbon!

Tiago met us at the apartment and spent a good deal of time with us, getting us acclimated .  He left us a welcome basket of wine and fruit.  In short, he was, in our opinion, the very best host we've ever had in all of our AirBnb experiences. Even though it rained, we enjoyed our time in Lisbon and at Tiago's place, very much.

J'ai été très bien accueillie par l'amie de Tiago, Sonia.
Il y avait également un plateau avec du vin, du fromage, du pain et des fruits. De quoi se sentir vraiment directement "at home".

OMG, what a beautiful and authentic flat! View is amazing!!! Unfortunately very short, work related stay but will definitely come back.... Tiago and Silvia are utterly fantastic-welcome gesture -Bottle of red &a Goat cheese, what more do you need

What an incredible experience from start to finish! The apartment is absolutely beautiful - the location is unbeatable and the terrace is to die for! Tiago even greeted me late at night with a Portugese "survival pack" of wine and cheese :) I'll be staying here for sure next time I come back! Highly highly recommended
On se sent chez soi dès le premier pas posé dans cet appartement. Tout y est, Tiago a pensé à votre séjour dans les moindres détails. On ne voulait plus partir, cette terrasse est parfaite.

Tiago and Suzana (Tiago’s mother) were very welcoming, Suzana was there on our arrival and showed us around the flat and how to access the rooftop terrace, we were also given some very nice red wine with cheese and bread which was a very nice gesture.  The apartment was perfect for us with everything we needed and the rooftop terrace was a fantastic place to relax in the evening with great views over Lisbon towards the river Tagas.  The apartment is situated in a fantastic location on a quiet street just of the avenue de liberdade in the centre of Lisbon with a lot of restaurants nearby and a supermarket less than five minutes walk.  We would definitely stay here again.

when we arrivedthere was wine and cheese, very warm welcome (only we don't drink red wine)
its a very small appartment but has everthing you needed! Good hot shower, complete kitchen, nice terrace (you have to be flexibel to get there) everything i walking distance: diners, supermarket,metro.

Tiago and Sonia were extremely welcoming. Sonia was there on our arrival, gave us a welcome pack and gave us loads of information. The flat is in a great location and everything is immaculate. We hope to return in the future.

Tiago was a wonderful host and the apartment was perfect for us! We arrived close to midnight and Tiago was more than accommodating with our late check-in. He was very knowledgeable about things to do in the city and provided us with a lovely welcome care package of cheese, bread, fruit and wine. The location of the apartment is within walking distance to everything around the city center. Our favorite part of the apartment was definitely the beautiful roof terrace which provides an amazing view of the city. We would definitely recommend staying here and we hope to be back in the future! Thanks for everything Tiago!

Tiago was an amazing host, welcoming us with traditional Portoguese products. He gave us very helpful suggestions about city attractions and Tascas! Also the apartment is very cozy (thumbs up for the terrace;) and perfectly located! This added something very special to our stay in this lovely city. ..wish to come back soon!

We had a great stay in Tiago's apartment - it's a really cosy apartment and the roof terrace is beautiful & sunny, with fantastic views. Tiago also very thoughtfully compiled a guide of restaurant & bar recommendations which we found so helpful. We also enjoyed the complimentary wine & cheese on arrival. The apartment is also centrally located so would definitely recommend as a good base to explore Lisbon!

El apartamento es ideal para descubrir Lisboa: bien situado y con todas las comodidades. Apenas pudimos disfrutar de la terraza por falta de tiempo, pero es tan bonita y tiene tan buenas vistas como aparece en la foto. Tiago es el anfitrión perfecto. Días antes del viaje ya nos hizo llegar un plano para llegar al apartamento, además de distintos enlaces con recomendaciones. Al llegar nos recibió con fruta, queso, pan y un vino estupendo. Además, nos indicó varios lugares donde comer, que fuimos visitando y fueron todo un acierto. En definitiva, un apartamento muy recomendable.

El apartamento es muy bonito y acogedor. El anfitrión se preocupa mucho por todos los detalles: deja alguna cosa de picoteo, toallas, geles, mapas, guías para salir a comer por la cuidad, qué ver, etc. Una pasada!!
Best Place in Lisboa!!!

Parfait!!! Un appartement top, idéalement situé.
Un hôte sympa et disponible.
Un très bon séjour pour de très bon souvenirs!
Very perfect place. I love this beoutiful house and Tiago was the best host I ever met. Location was good and safe, the house was clean.

L'appartamento è situato in pieno centro di Lisbona, ed è molto comodo per girare la città. Una posizione fantastica. La casa è bellissima, proprio come nelle foto. Molto soleggiata e ben arredata. Il punto di forza è il fantastico terrazzo da cui si può ammirare Lisbona dall'alto e godere di un panorama da togliere il fiato. Meraviglioso.
Non ho conosciuto Tiago di persona, mi ha accolto la sua amica Sonia, la quale mi ha accolto stupendamente mostrandomi tutta la casa e dandomi molti consigli su cosa vedere e dove andare a mangiare. Inoltre ci ha mostrato il libro scritto da Tiago con tutti i posti dove andare a mangiare. Inoltre Tiago è stato gentilissimo mandandomi via email tutte le indicazioni precise per arrivare alla casa e altri link utili per prepararmi la vacanza al meglio.
La casa è facilmente raggiungibile dall'aeroporto, in quanto l'autobus che parte dall'aeroporto si ferma a 300m dalla casa. Costo del tragitto 3.50€. Vicino alla casa c'è anche un piccolo supermercato.
L'abitazione è anche a 10 minuti a piedi dal famoso Barrio Alto, quindi posizione perfetta anche per uscire la sera.
La consiglio caldamente! Quando tornerò a Lisbona soggiornerò sempre qui :)

Tiago was a wonderful host, who is always willing to answer any questions. From restuarant recommendations to tips on your stay. A friendly face who greeted us with cheese and wine and a beautiful apartment to start the trip.
We found our trip to Lisbon to be unforgettable with many precious memories that we will cherish forever. The apartment was a true highlight of our stay. It was cosy, comfortable, clean and homely. Perfect for a romantic weekend away.
The location was perfect. Very close to a metro station, a little supermarket nearby, fruit & veg stalls and cosy restaurants. It is very convenient to travel to other parts of the city and we felt safe walking around even late in the evening.
Our tip: Make the most of the terrace! Have a nice breakfast in the morning sun and enjoy the starry sky at night with your loved ones!

We were delayed but hosts were easily contacted and responded promptly. Very friendly introduction and welcome to the apartment and very welcome wine, bread and cheese waiting for us.
We loved the neighbourhood and the apartment...the stairs were a bit alarming as there were no rails but it had everything we needed and was a great location. A big bonus was the roof but the weather was not good so we could not make much use of it. There are plenty of wonderful small places to eat nearby. It was great!

It was a vert Nice stay. Thiago welcomed us with a bottle of vine and some bread and cheese. The flat was perfect with good location (you can do a lot of things by walk, The neighborhood is very calm). the Terrace is great.

We had a really good time in Tiago's apartment. I haven't really much to add besides what many other people have written.
Tiago warmly welcomed us and was super-helpful and always easy and relaxed to communicate with.
The apartment is small and cosy, there's everything one may need for a short stay. The photos provide every detail, without surprises.
The terrace is wondeful.
Enough said :)
Wonderful place and gracious host!

Appartement idéalement situé, très bien agencé avec une superbe terrasse !
Parfait pour un couple.

Tiago was great to communicate with. His friend Sonia warmly welcomed us and was flexible with the check-in time.
The apartment is incredibly peaceful and cozy, you just feel at home (and in a Great home!). We really appreciated Tiago's suggestions.
Terrace is lovely and the location is perfect for major spots both overnight (Bairro Alto just 10 mins walking) and during the day (many trails to Castelo Sao Jorge and Alfama district).
Really easy to reach from the Airport (the Airport shuttle stops in front of the apartment - 3,5 eur/trip).
Wonderfull stay in Lisbon for the end of 2015. Tiago's appartment was perfect , clean and comfortable. We highly recomend it. Tiago is a really nice person very helpfull and close to his guests .
Tiago was great. He greeted us with a lovely wine and cheese platter and recommended all the local spots for us to take advantage of in the limited time we had in Lisbon. Awesome location. Must stay!
We really enjoyed our stay at the flat. Tiago is a very helpful and informative host. The flat is clean and cozy. The location is very good.

Tiago truly is a super host. He did everything in his power to make our stay in Lisbon enjoyable, and as a result we had a fantastic time. Can't recommend him highly enough; Tiago is definitely the best and most complete Air Bnb host I have met thus far.

The apartment was very cosy and we felt at home right away! Tiago welcoming and even left a booklet with recommendations to restaurants, bars and shops. It turned out to be very useful, since there is so much to choose from in Lisbon. Would definitely stay here again if we were to go back.
Thank you for your very clean and beautiful apartment. You were very accommodating with our schedule for our short trip. Great first Air B&B host!
FANTASTIC place to stay & warm welcome!

Un de mes meilleurs séjours Airbnb !
L'appartement est parfait : lumineux, propre, fonctionnel, bien placé. Et la terrasse est super pour le petit déjeuner et l'apéro.
Tiago a été très disponible, et ses conseils de resto sont super.
Obrigada Tiago, we loved your place and the gift basket. Hope we will come back soon :)

Un grand merci à Tiago pour ses précieux conseils avant d'arriver à Lisbonne et pour son accueil très chaleureux!
Nous avons passé un très agréable séjour au calme dans son appartement, la terrasse sur le toit était parfaite pour un petit déjeuner au soleil, même en novembre.
Nous recommandons cet hôte sans hésiter!

I stayed in João's apartment for three nights with my husband. It is very sweet little apartment, organized and well decorated, and had everything we needed to enjoy my stay.

The kitchen was well equipped for cooking. There was a hair dryer, which was very convenient. The patio is amazing. We had breakfast there most mornings, and would go up in the evening to see all the nighttime lights. Lisbon is beautiful from this spot!

The location was great, with a reasonable walk to the Marques de Pombal, or to Rossio, and close to a metro stop, and right near Avenida da Liberdade street, which has lots of food and shopping (while still being quite quiet). The area felt very safe, I would definitely have felt comfortable staying there alone. The wifi was reliable and fast. Tiago always responded very quickly to questions.

A few notes, there is a wall of glass cubes that acts as a dividing wall between the bathroom and the kitchen. It's possible to make out the outline of the person in the bathroom if you're standing in the kitchen - you can't see a lot but if I were sharing the apartment with someone who was not a partner or close friend, this would have been a bit uncomfortable for me.

Overall, I would recommend this apartment to anyone, it was safe, clean, conveniently located, and had everything I needed for an extended stay, plus wonderful views from the rooftop patio.

Tiago was a wonderful host, very welcoming and kind! He included a welcome basket with wine/cheese/fruit, that was very much appreciated. The apartment was as pictured, which was great and the terrace was amazing. We liked it so much we stayed an extra day, which he was very helpful in arranging. We would highly recommend him as a host!

Cozy apartment in a very convenient location. Tiago met us in person and it was clear how passionate he was about Lisbon, his city. The welcome food package was very welcome, and the rooftop was amazing!
Tiagos apartment is beautiful, clean, very well equipped and perfectly situated. Sonia and Tiago were perfect hosts, thanks again! I fully recommend the apartment!

Tiago's apartment was the perfect place for our Lisbon adventure. Centrally located, modern interiors and that wonderful terrace which made our trip that bit more special. Tiago was a fantastic host, leaving us with a thoughtful welcome gift and a extensive selection of city guides which really helped us to make the most of our trip.

Tiago is a great host. He takes care of his guests and gives some helpful tips about Lisabon. His apartment is very good situated, near to the subway and the river. The main city attractions are easy accessible by foot. The apartment is well furnished and equipped with everything you need to cook and to feel like at home :) Fully recommended for a Lisabon stay!!

Tiago's place in Lisboa is exactly as pictured - it's amazing! I don't know how much I have to say that pretty much every other reviewer hasn't nailed. It's a very cozy and warm place right in the middle of town. We found the location quite convenient - it was near the metro stop for Avenida but also within a 15 minute walk of a lot of great restaurants and a pleasant stroll away from Baixa, Chiado, and the Barrio Alto. Walking home after having  a few drinks on both nights we stayed there was a breeze. We were received by Tiago's friend, Sonia, who was very nice and walked us through everything we needed to know, plus some recommendations for things to do and restaurants. Tiago includes a printed booklet of his Air BnB guidebook in the living room as well as a book he wrote on Tascas, so it's your own fault if you have a bad meal because his recommendations are awesome - we tried Cervejaria Ramiro (75 minute wait for excellent seafood),  Central Parque Quiosque, Restaurante Maharaja (give the waiter a good tip - he could use it and provides excellent service), and Pinoquio - we only have praise for all of them! We were unable to find Restaurante Cartaxinho based on his map and it may not have been open on Sundays anyhow, but that was our only issue with his recommendations. Oh, if you go to Belem - try Pao Pao Queijo Queijo - affordable, fast, and delicious. Anyhow, the whole place was a wonderful way to end our honeymoon - if you have a bad time it's your own fault (especially if you don't have a glass of wine on the roof). Only two minor negatives to note: there's a gap between the bedroom and the living room that you need to be cautious of and there's no closet to hang up any coats. Thank you so much for letting us stay in your awesome apartment!

My husband & I loved our stay at Tiago's apartment! It was the perfect location - close to the metro & lots of points of interest while still being in a part of town that made our stay feel like an authentic experience! The terrace was amazing. One of our favorite things to do was come back to the apartment after a long day of sightseeing and enjoy a glass of wine together while we watched the lights of the city. It felt like having our own private rooftop bar! And Tiago was the perfect host! He provided so many tips on where to eat and visit, insider info on special events going on in town during our stay and was amazingly fast at responding to all messages and questions. We also enjoyed the thoughtful wine, fruit, cheese and bread he gave us upon arrival! We had a very early flight out & Tiago also arranged for a taxi to come & pick us up which was a huge help! Our stay was perfect & we really hope to come back to Lisbon someday & stay here again! Amazing experience! :-)
The flat is a little jewel, clean, well located and well-equipped. The rooftop is incredible, you have to try it! Tiago's friend (Sonja) welcomed us so well, thank you the stay. We highly recommend.

The apartment and the host are perfect! I was there on the week Tiago's new baby arrived and he was always available, it is incredible how fast he replies to any query you may have.
Besides all of that the material and guides he provides you with in the apartment is very helpful to improve your experience in Lisbon.
The apartment is in a great location and amazing views, I 100% recommend this place!

We had a fantastic welcome from Tiago, he was so nice and spoke great English! He gave us a lot of tips about Lisbon and even gave us a lovely welcome basket with wine, bread and cheese. The apartment was cosy and functional. It had everything we needed and was about 10 minutes walk to the centre of town. The roof top balcony was the highlight! It was so beautiful relaxing and watching the sunset from the balcony. We loved it!
Really enjoyed our stay here! The place is very clean and modern with everything we needed. Very good location. Would recommend and stay again!

What a gem!! This cosy apartment in Lisbon provided is with all we needed for our holiday in Lisbon. Tiago left a welcome basket of wine, fruit & cheese which was much appreciated and enjoyed. Convenient and safe location. We would have no hesitation in returning or recommending this apartment to friends and family. Hope to see you again Tiago. Best regards. Siobhan and Des

Our stay at Tiago's place was really nice, we felt at home and it started with a warm welcoming of Tiago as well as a basket of little things to eat & drink! The flat is small and well equiped, it sticks to the description. The terrasse was wonderful for breakfast & evening drinks, we left the blanket in the banch tho because it was a bit cold ;) it shows that this place has lived before and this is probably why you feel cosy! As for the location, just perfect! In a quiet district but close to everything 2 min away! we recommend this flat 100%!

It's easy to say that the rooftop terrace sold me when picking out an airbnb to stay at for my first time in Lisbon. It's perfect for having your morning coffee before you get your day started or if you want to lay out and get some sun. The apartment is very central as well. Close enough to everything but just off a main street (ave de Liberdad, one of the poshest streets in Lisbon) so you almost feel like a local. The metro is barely a 5 minute walk, Barrio Alto (nightlife) is probably about a 10 minute walk, down to the river front is also about a 10-15 minute walk. The neighborhood itself is nice. There's a mini mart not to far where we stocked up on essentials and there's great little restaurants around the area as well. Tiago also gave us a ton of information about Lisbon which which much appreciated. Sonia, who met us at the apartment was very nice and had a bottle of wine, cheese, and a peach waiting for us when we arrived...a cherry on top! Would definitely recommend this place for your stay in Lisbon.

Tiago is an amazing host who gave us great advice on what to do in Lisbon. The apartment is perfect for 2 people, very clean, well located and the terrace is great for having breakfast. I would highly recommend it.

Tout était parfait ! C'est une amie de Thiago, Sonia, qui nous accueillis. Très sympathique et de bons conseils. Thiago n'est pas en reste: un fascicule est à disposition dans l'appartement avec toutes les bonnes adresses de Thiago! Très précis et très appréciable! L'accueil est parfait: du vin, des fruits, du pain et du fromage ! L'appartement est bien situé, à proximité du métro, des commerces et des principaux centres d'intérêt. L'appartement est très bien équipé. Bref, parfait !

Following a late arrival from our flight Thiago greeted us with a warm welcome, tour of the apartment and wonderful gifts of local produce which were delicious. He supplied plenty of information about the local area and must see destinations which helped us plan an even better trip.

The location was ideal with the city centre just a short walk away through a safe and quiet neighbourhood lined with shops and restaurants. The apartment is as beautiful as the photos suggest and is everything you need and more for the perfect city break. The terrace is also an ideal little sun trap if you need a break from sight seeing or want to enjoy a quiet meal in, both of which go down a treat with a cold drink and some good company.

Thiago has also published a guide to the traditional Portuguese restaurants (Tascas) of the city which was the dining map for our weeks stay and to anyone who wants to get a true taste of the Lisbon culture, we would recommend you do the same. (We bought our own copy we like it so much!!)

Neither of us wanted to leave and cant wait to go back to both Lisbon and the apartment.

Tiago was great. You could not ask for a nicer host. Our flight was cancelled and then delayed and Tiago met us at the apartment at 11pm without any issues. His recommendations were great. We would definitely recommend staying here.

We had a great time at Tiago`s central apartment .
He welcomed us and was very helpful with advices on where to eat and what to do around the city.
the apartment was clean , neat and well equipped with everything needed during our stay.
location is great just in walking distence from the center, the water front and some historical sites.
we din`t have a chance to enjoy the 360 terrace but even without it we had a great experience .

Tiago and Sonia were great hosts, and the apartment was beautiful and as the listing described. Tiago was easy to get hold of if necessary. Thanks Tiago and Sonia!

Sonia nous a accueilli avec sympathie et gentillesse ! L'appartement était en tout point conforme à ce que nous attendions... Petit + : c'est eux qui nous ont réservé le taxi pour le jour du départ, nous n'avions plus qu'à y monter :-) Nous ne pouvons que conseiller cet appartement et remercier Tiago et Sonia!
Very welcoming

Sonia nous attendait avec le sourire et nous a bien renseignés sur les environs, les points d'intérêt, et à même fait pour nous une réservation pour un restaurant que nous avions sélectionné. L'appartement est très bien situé pour visiter Lisbonne, il est confortable, propre et très bien équipé. Une bonne adresse. Et merci pour le panier de bienvenue, avec de bons produits locaux.

Our experience at the apartment was wonderful! It is conveniently located near Avenida da Liberdade (and the metro), as well as a short walk to the city center. Sonia was right there to meet us upon our arrival, even though we were delayed by an entire day. The welcome package was a great touch and the rooftop terrace is unbeatable! I would definitely recommend this apartment for anyone traveling to Lisbon.
Thank you, Tiago and Sonia!

Lämmin tervetuliaistoivotus ja 110% kaikki mitä luvattiin.

Tiago's apartment is absolutely lovely. The appartement is cozy, clean and the rooftop terrace (wow!) is wonderful. The appartement located in a a traditional area and is very central and quiet. The communication with Tiago was perfect. He is very accessible and in easy contact with email.

We enjoyed our stay maximum! Thanks!

Die Unterkunft ist traumhaft und mitten in der Innenstadt.
Tiago hat an alles gedacht und alles perfekt organisiert.
Wir kommen gerne wieder.

Our stay in tiagos apartment was fantastic - beautiful views on the roof top. cheese, fruit and wine waiting for us on arrival. Amazing restaurant recommendations and directions provided - extremely helpful. Location is good. Perfection.

Amazing apartment and a great host. The apartment is in a really great location and has everything you could need right on the doorstep. Tiago was very welcoming and helpful and we would recommend this apartment to anyone who is looking for a great trip to Lisbon.

We much enjoyed our stay at tiago's apartment in Lisbon. He prepared a basket of wine, cheese and bread to welcome us. As per other reviews, the roof terrace was amazing! The clean and charming apartment was super close to the metro and tiago's restaurant recommendations were also spot on. We loved our stay and would definitely recommend this airbnb

Tiago is great host. Everything was perfect and I don't want to speak about his terrace : speechless, what a beautiful surprise!
If you are looking for a stay in Lisbon : Don't miss it, it is the place to be!

Dear Sonia, dear Raul,
we enjoyed our 6 days in Lisbon very, very much - when we arrived the sun came also (after 3 days of rain in Porto) this has been wonderful! Enjoyed our stay in this sweet little studio apartment. Very central and loved the roof space - great for relaxing and sunbathing.

Tiagos Appartment ist sehr zu empfehlen!

Tiago hat uns sehr herzlich empfangen. Eine Flasche guten Weines , Käse und Obst standen für uns bereit. Er war sehr hilfsbereit . Im Appartment findet man auch noch Tipps für Lokale, Pläne und Wegbeschreibungen.

Tiago is a super host. He waited for us until late an he welcomed us with some food and wine, so kind! Such an excellent stay, thank you Tiago!

Logement conforme aux photos, en bon état, très agréable et proche de tout (à pied ou en métro). Je recommande pour un séjour réussi à Lisbonne

Tiago est un super hôte. Sa réactivité et sa disponibilité en font une aide précieuse pour planifier des vacances de rêve. Sa terrasse de rêve est idéal pour les séjours en amoureux. We had a great experience staying in Tiago’s apartment. The location was perfect – in the middle of all the sights, shopping, public transport and restaurants. Precioso apartamento muy bien situado. Las vistas desde la terraza son espectaculares y Tiago tiene cuidado hasta el más mínimo detalle de la casa. Estupenda estancia.

Wat hebben we genoten van het appartement van Tiago. Een warm ontvangst, een leuk appartement met dakterras en een uitzicht ver boven verwachting. Charming and romantic apartment in a very convenient location. Wonderful rooftop terrace and ample light and air throughout. Plus, Tiago and his friend Sonia were very responsive, helpful and cheerful. We had a lovely time and would definitely stay here again.

L'appartement est conforme à la description. Il est très bien placé, et la terrasse est vraiment agréable. Nous avons été très bien accueilli par Tiago malgré une arrivée tardive.
Nous recommandons vivement cet appartement.

Tiago kept in contact with us from the initial booking of the apartment through to our arrival. He made things very easy for us with good instructions including a map.

Tiago is incredibly professional.  He goes to great lengths to make his guest feel welcome. Lovely house, clean, good furniture, bed was goooood (believe me, I've slept in some bad beds in my life, this one was goood). Tiago was a wonderful host. What a wonderful house!

Tiago's place was very well located and had everything we needed for our long weekend. As well, shops and facilities were just across the corner. In this way we managed to enjoy food, landscapes, sites and shopping :)

Nous avons passé un séjour très agréable dans l'appartement de Tiago. Celui-ci nous a offert un accueil plus que chaleureux, dans un français presque parfait et avec de nombreux conseils sur les endroits incontournables de Lisbonne !

Great place to stay. Cozy apartment and the welcome wine and cheese Tiago left for us made our arrival special.

We absolutely love this place and we're sad to leave after 2 nights. Book here and you won't be disappointed!

Tiago is an incredibly nice and interesting host, when he welcomed ua to his apartment we just ended up talking for an hour. He even provided us with some fruit, cheese and wine on our arrival. His house is very pleasant, full of light and very comfortable.
Awesome apartment with the best location with easy access to some of Lisboa's best restaurants, wine bats and attractions. Great place to stay!

L appartement de Tiago est l endroit idéal pour passer un séjour réussi à Lisbonne. L appartement est très bien équipé et tout ce dont vous avez besoin s y trouve. I would stay here again!

We felt very welcome with a little hamper containing wine, cheese and bread. Apartment is cute and cosy and very central. Absolutely no complaints. Would happily stay there again. Great apartment and host

Accueil très chaleureux, appartement très bien logé et un emplacement parfait à 5 minutes du centre à pied
Tiagos Wohnung hat eine perfekte Lage.  Konnten alles gut zu Fuß oder auch per Metro erreichen.  Von Sonia wurden wir super freundlich empfangen. Alles in allem ein top Gastgeber!

Tiago's apartment is a perfect choice. Guys, wish you all the best and thank you for everything!

Cool apartment in great location. The roof terrace is the total selling point it is fantastic and the morning/evening views over lisbon were delightful. A very helpful host who not only left us cheese and wine but all the information possible to have a great few days in lisbon

Awesome apartment, if is like your very own penthouse, located right in the center of the city- pretty much anything you would need including certain must see sites and restraints all within walking distance. thank you Tiago !

During our stay - we ate out every night - most of our restaurant visits went were in one of the parallel streets. Many of the alternatives, and sites ++, can be found in homemade brochures made by the host (with maps and a small review).


We only communicated with Tiago via the internet, but he always answered quickly and was helpful. For example, there was a problem with the water boiler when we came, which he fixed by a plumber the next day.

We have no problem recommending this apartment.

Mon hôte a été très disponible, il nous a attendu à l'appartement à notre arrivée par avion.

Wonderful place and Tiago is an excellent host.

The location of the apartment is perfect - literally a few minute walk from the heart of the city. The rooftop terrace offered breathtaking views of the city. Tiago, thanks for having us. Apartment has great location with easy access to everything and everywhere. The terrace is great for relaxing with a drink after a busy day. such a lovely place!

a cosy apartment, all you need for a pleasant stay!

Tiago's apartment is absolutely lovely. Merci beaucoup à Tiago et Sonia pour leur accueil. L'appartement est super, très bien placé avec une très belle vue de la terrasse :)

Nous avons passé un merveilleux séjour à Lisbonne dans cet appartement lumineux et très agréable! Bien placé, il permet de visiter la ville et ses collines à pied. Great flat, perfect location to visit the city. Tiago was very kind and gave us many tips to enjoy our stay.

We highly recommend this place !

Thank you for this great apartment for our much needed holiday! The location was perfect and we picked out a little route into the Barrio Alto without too many steps! The welcome by Sonia was great and we will be recommending the apartment to friends and hope to return ourselves. Lisbon is such a great city!

I really recommend people to stay at tiago's apartment! Location is really perfect near everything!

Ce séjour nous donné envie de revenir à Lisbonne.

This apartment is simply perfect. It's tucked away in a residential area, yet centrally located within walking distance of amazing restaurants, public transit, and the best districts for eating, drinking, shopping and getting a taste of all of the history Lisbon has to offer. The view from the roof is incredible. As for Tiago, we couldn't have asked for a better host. Communication before and during the trip was flawless and helpful. He also left us with fabulous wine and cheese and a well-stocked, clean apartment with plenty of information to help us navigate Lisbon. We later had the opportunity to break bread with Tiago in an excellent little tasca he showed us. The food and wine in Portugal is as incredible as the people. We feel like we'll always have a friend in Lisbon! Obrigado, Tiago!

Tiago's apartment is very lovely and nice, located directly in the city center, within walking distance to most of the major sightseeing. The apartment itself is not so big, but very comfortable for two people, the design is very ideal. The rooftop is just simple awesome. Tiago is very helpful and responses very quickly. Before we arrived, he also emailed us the detailed transportation connection. We didn't get a chance to meet him on our arrival but met his mother. The whole handling is very professional. We had a great stay at Tiago's apartment. Lisbon is definitely a must-visit city!

From our late arrival to providing a crib for our baby son, Tiago and his central apartment was perfect! Everything we could have needed was there for us including a welcome package with the most delicious cheese. The location allowed us to easily walk our way around; visiting tourist destinations as well as off the map shops and restaurants.
While visiting Lisbon, staying at Tiago's apartment is a must!

My wife and I really enjoyed our stay at Tiago's apartment. The location was excellent and the apartment was perfect for a couple. Tiago was a pleasure to work with, and I would recommend his apartment to anyone. Thanks again!

L'appartement de Tiago est agréable et bien situé pour visiter les quartiers de Lisbonne. L’accueil est sympathique et Tiago nous a donné une bonne adresse pour écouter du fado dans une ambiance conviviale et typique portugaise loin des club à touristes.Un bon souvenir !

Tiago's apartment makes great base for a visit to Lisbon - very well located and comfortable.
Tiago is a great host - he got in touch in advance of our holiday to let us know the easiest ways to get to the apartment and had sent some links with excellent tips for restaurants and bars. He arranged for us to be met at the apartment by his friend Sonia, who again gave a friendly and knowledgable introduction to the city.
Nous avons été très bien accueillis à l'appartement de Tiago. Son amie Sonia nous a donné plein de bons conseils. La location est très bien placée, mignonne, parfaite pour un séjour à Lisbonne!

We had a lovely trip to Lisboa. The apartment is cute and fairly well located. It is well furnished and there are all the needed commodities in the vicinity.

Tiago is a nice and receptive host. He left in the apartment a booklet with all the useful adresses and he checked with us every day by mail to make sure everything was ok.

This is a great apartment in a fantastic central area of Lisbon. Tiago was great at staying in contact and gave us some really helpful information before our trip.
Tiago's friend Sonia gave us a friendly greeting and gave some great tips on where to go.
The flat has everything you need for a wonderful time in Lisbon.
The roof terrace is particularly wonderful with spectacular views.
Thank you for wonderful stay. I hope we'll be back again soon!

Thank you Tiago - for making us feel home at your wonderful apartment in Lisboa!!
It's well equipped, centrally located and everything you need is just around the corner. Tiago was well organized, gave useful information in advance (for example about how to get to his place from the airport) and warmly welcomed us when we arrived.
We enjoyed out city-trip a lot! After all, we profited a lot from Tiago's advise about restaurants and other places to visit.

Staying at Tiago's flat was just perfect. Tiago and his friend Sonia were so welcoming and friendly, making us feel right at home. The flat was very modern and clean, located in the center of Lisbon. Everything we wanted to see was in walking distance. And just 3 min walk to the nearest metro station.
Tiago's self-made map around the flat with recommendations on restaurants and bars was also very helpful. Thanks to Tiago and Sonia, we had a wonderful honeymoon. Thank you so much!

C'est l'appartement parfait pour une découverte de cette ville.
Accueil impeccable, sur tous les plans. Ce petit nid perché est un must. La situation est idéale pour flâner dans le centre ville et retrouver un peu de calme et de confort en rentrant.
Obrigado Tiago!
We had a great time in Lisbon! And thanks to the great location of the flat, the warm welcoming and the tons of recommandations given by Tiago everything was made easier

What a nice and warm welcome to the town of Lissabon. Tiago made us feel like home and had even supplied us with some local food (we arrived late in the evening, so had not have any dinner). The location of the apartment was just perfect and we could easily  walk to the towns main attractions. If we ever visit Lissabon again, we will choose this place again!

I have nothing, but positive things to say about Tiago and his wonderful apartment. Tiago was a wonderful host! He welcomed us with cheese, bread, and local wine when we arrived. His apartment was clean, bright, and very central! Walking distance to metro which was a definite plus. Tiago provided us a lot of information on what to do/see/eat prior to arriving and in person. He also has a beautiful private terrace. Unfortunately, during our stay it was raining and we were not able to make use of it. Tiago, we will be back :) Muito obrigado!

xo,

Nina and Dave

The apartment was small, but very clean, comfortable, functional, and secure. The location was perfect for us to explore Lisbon. Having this accommodation made our first visit to Lisbon extremely enjoyable. Thank you, Tiago.

Steve and Greg

We had 4 really nice days at Tiago's place. The apartment was charming and cosy, perfect for us, Tiago was welcoming us with fruit, chees and local Wine, when we arrived. He had also made a folder with he's recomendations for restaurants, things to see etc. It was very usefull. The rooftop terrace was spectacular, even in January. We had our breakfast in the sun and the view from there is fantastic. We really hope to come back some other time. Lisboa is really worth a visit.

We had a splendid stay in Lisbon and Tiago was an excellent host. Prior to arrival, Tiago sent detailed directions to the apartment including what train and metro stops worked the best. The first night we were greeted and oriented to the apartment and neighborhood by Tiago. The greeting included a very nice "welcome box" of Portuguese treats which was much appreciated after a long day of travel. The apartment was cosy and well-appointed with everything you need. It was in a very convenient location, close to a metro stop and also walkable to other fun neighborhoods. Tiago also went above and beyond to help with a postal snafu, which was really helpful as we do not speak Portuguese. We will definitely visit Lisbon again and would love to stay again in Tiago's apartment!

It was great to stay at Tiago's place, we enjoyed it a lot. The appartment is very comfortable, has everything you may need, brilliantly located in the very center of the city still on a quiet lil street. Wish it was summer, the terrace is amazing. Thanks for everything, Tiago

I can't recommend Tiago's apartment highly enough. It is right in the middle of central Lisbon, and with walking distance of everywhere we wanted to go. The apartment was very clean, cozy, and had amazing views of the city. It also has a washer and drier that was very useful. Tiago was very helpful, and responded immediately if we had any questions at all. He also has great recommendations of things to do around Lisbon.

If you're looking for an apartment for a short stay in Lisbon this is THE apartment. And Tiago is THE host.
It's central located, next to Avenida da Liberdade: you can easily walk almost everywhere, and the Underground is about 2 minutes walk.
It is not very big, but has everything you could need. Most amazing things are windows (the house is full of light) and the rooftop.
Tiago is a very kind guest. He speaks a fluent english and was always ready to help us for any of our needs, both before our arrival and during our stay (he answers almost real time to sms!). The day of our arrival (Christmas!!) he was at the apartment waiting for us with a piece of cake, a cheese, some fruit and a bottle of wine.
In addition he placed maps, personal notes and suggestions with restaurants/points of interest in the city and in the neighborhood.
The area is safe, and full of small restaurants.
I would recommend this solution for a visit to Lisbon not only to other airbnb users, but also to my friends.

My flight got delayed and Tiago was very understanding and accommodating and met me the next morning. He has a great book of recommendations which was extremely helpful. The welcome basket of wine, bread, cheese and fruit was such a nice touch and so sweet of him. The apartment itself is really comfortable and like everyone says, it's truly located in a central spot and I felt safe waking to/from there at night. It's really close to the metro which was easy to take. My first experience with airbnb and it was perfect!

The apartment is in a great location for exploring Lisbon by foot or public transport. It's also a very convenient base from which to do a day trip to Sintra. Tiago was in contact regularly before our trip, providing lots of information, including the best way to arrive from the airport (for €1.25!). His friend Sonia welcomed us & showed us around the flat so we knew how everything worked. Tiago has also put together a booklet of recommendations for places to eat & drink in Lisbon, which we really appreciated - it saved us a lot of research. And breakfast on the roof terrace was very pleasant way to start the day!

We really enjoyed our 3 nights at Tiago's flat. It was perfect for visiting Lisboa, and enjoying the way of life in the city. The 360 terrace is magic !
Or a simplier way to say it : Tudo Bem !!

We stayed a few days at Tiago's place in early December 13. It was amazing. His place has everything as described. Wifi is great. Rooftop view is great. Heating is great. If we didn't have tours everyday I would have just stay on the roof top and chill out. At night the cable has lots of channels.
The place is very safe; just a couple streets away you'll find some luxury stores. That should tell you how safe it was.
Tiago even left us a box of local fruits, cheese and a bottle of wine. Most pleasantly surprised. Tiago also had great recommendations for food :)
Do give the Da Vinci Italian restaurant beside Pinoquio a shot as well. You'll be pleasantly surprised.
We had a wonderful time in Lisboa.
Only pity I didn't have to time type a proper letter on the typewriter for the guest book haha.

Отличная квартира, мои рекомендации! Тиаго очень положителен в общении, никаких проблем. ОРГОМНАЯ ПРОБЛЕМА С ПАРКОВКОЙ! :) Мы довольны своим пребыванием в Лиссабоне, спасибо Тиаго!

Excellent apartment, my recommendations! Tiago is very positive in the communication, no problems. BIG PROBLEM WITH CAR PARKING! :) We are happy with the stay in Lisbon, Tiago's thanks!
We have had great time in Tiago's place. It is so cosy that we had problem leaving it :) And terrace it breath taking!!! We would recommend it to everyone :)))

me and my girlfriend host at tiagos' apartment and had a perfect time.
the locution of the apartment is great, next to everything and very quite. the apartment was very clean and nurtured,

we will get with the apartment great recommending book that writing by tiago and was very us full.

Tiago's apartment was amazing, a perfect location for walking anywhere you want to in Lisbon.

The roof terrace was a great place to drink the bottle of wine he kindly left for us, with incredible views.

Sonia (his friend who let us in) was fab, and gave us some amazing tips on places to eat and drink.

We'd definitely come back, only this time for a little bit longer!

When you are in Tiago's appartment you have one problem. Do you put on your walking shoes to discover the wonderful city? Or do you stay awhile on the roof terrace, looking in the morning with a cup of coffee at the sun going up over the Lisbon roofs?
We did both, and we hope one day to have this choice again.
Communication with Tiago was perfect and Cristina welcomed us very friendly.
We enjoyed the good bed with the room with a view, and one day the well-equipped kitchen, the other the fine and inexpensive restaurants in the neighbourhood.
See you again, Tiago and Cristina!

Lovely apartment, wonderfull terrace.
very good advices for visiting the city too !
Best place ever in Lisbonne.

The trip was a surprise for my sister and her husband, kind of a pre-honeymoon. They really enjoyed their stay, the flat is really cosy, in a perfect location. Tiago was helpful, nice, he is a perfect host!
Thank you!

Great place in the heart of Lisbon. Tiago's apartment is situated right behind the Avenida Liberdade, a 5 minute walk away from the metro and a 10 minute walk away from all the hustle and bustle in Bairro Alto. Tiago is such a great host, friendly, promt when communicating. He prepared such a nice welcome package for us when arriving at the apartment with some wine, bread and local cheese. We loved the little book that he made with his favourite restaurants (we went to "taberna de rua flores" (our favourite!) and "ramiro" (a not to miss experience!). Also - please be sure to visit the beautiful little parc just behind the house (Jardim Torel), no tourists, great atmosphere and the best view! The place itself is small, but nicely decorated, very clean and obviously the roof terrace is just perfect. We highly recommend this place and hope to be back one day!

My partner and I shared 2 fabulous weeks in Tiago's central Lisbon apartment in October 2013.

We could not have asked for a better host in Tiago - he was waiting for us on arrival, had left a generous welcome package for us and was available any time we needed him.

The apartment has all the conveniences you need while travelling and the terrace is beautiful for night time star gazing.

The apartment is in one of the nicest areas of Lisbon, surrounded by restaurants, cafes and great shopping.

We can't wait to go back!

Obrigada Tiago!

It is difficult to add to the superlative comments others have already made. Tiago is a perfect host and the apartment could not be one bit better. It certainly helps that Tiago is an experienced traveler himself, as he has a practical view of what will make someone's visit even better. He has prepared a veritable catalog of information about sightseeing, restaurants, bars, and transportation in the area to make a visit the most pleasant it can be.
I look forward to a return visit! Thank you Tiago (and Sonia!)

Tiagos apartment is identical to how it looks in the pictures, clean, bright, modern and inviting. Everything you need including kitchen utensils, tea, coffee, iron is provided, he has thought of it all to make your stay pleasant. The apartment is located in a quiet street and within 10-20 minutes walking distance to every attracting you will want to visit in Lisbon. As other reviewers have said, the roof terrace is amazing and made our trip so much more enjoyable as we had breakfast and evening drinks up there every day and night. My first Airbnb experiece and Tiago has set a high standard for others to follow!

Our stay at Tiago’s apartment was fantastic. He was the perfect host and always kept in contact with us. Every question was immediately answered. The apartment was beautiful, clean, and bright. Inside a little box with wine, cheese, and bread awaited us – what a lovely welcome present. Everything was exactly as promised and we especially enjoyed the roof terrace and the beautiful view. All the interesting places were in walking distance, and the metro was nearby – so we spent our days exploring the city and relaxing at the terrace at night. It was also really quite at night. Tiago also provided a list of his favorite restaurants, which was very welcome. We strongly recommend him as a host.

This was an experience we will not forget in a long time. The apartment met all our expectations and more and the location was just great, even down to the elderly gentleman sitting in the street who we greeted each day, the first two days he ignored us but the last two days he smiled and waved to us. Tiago could not have been a better host with instant communication and the opportunity to spend an evening with Tiago and Christina at a fantastic venue will always be remembered by us. All in all, a great visit.
Frits and Judy Lang
Hamilton
New Zealand

This apartment is beautiful. It is in the most perfect location to be able to explore Lisbon by foot as well as being right near the metro for getting to and from the airport.
The roof terrace in the sun overlooking the city was a bonus and we really enjoyed having breakfast there each day.
An added bonus was a welcome gift or bread, wine and cheese and this was gratefully received as we arrived late.
Tiago was great with communication before the stay and very accommodating since we arrived late and left late on our last day. He gave lots of recommendations of bars, cafes and restaurants which was helpful too.
We would highly recommend this apartment for visitor to Lisbon.

Awesome host and place to stay! Me and my wife stayed for 2 nights in August there, and it was really good place for us - in the center of the city, close to all places of interest and transport ( which turned out quite easy to use and not so expensive as in London:). The main USP of the flat is the view from the roof terrace , we usually have a diner right there, on the "Lisbon roof" :).
Tiago is amazing host - he so quickly replied on all our requests , provide all requested info and support (he recommended us really cool surfing school).
Highly recommended place :)

This flat is perfect for exploring Lisbon. It's set in a charming little back street, walking distance from everything, quiet and safe.
