The flat itself is amazing. Everything is spotless, modern and looks really nice. But, as expected, the terrace steals the show. We had all our breakfasts up there and pre or post dinner drinks (with a blanket because it gets windy and a bit chilly up there at night).
Tiago and his mother were also perfect hosts. We received a warm welcome and a box full of local goodies.As it was my wife's birthday, Tiago even gave her a nice bottle of port.
All in all, perfect!

I had such a great experience at this place ! Tiago is the perfect host : easy to communicate with, good taste, he also gave us lots of addresses to go to in Lisbon.

The appartment is ont of the best I had on airbnb, very clean, the terrace with the shower is a place to be, we spent most of the time there chillin'

We stayed for a week in Tiago's appartment. He was a wonderful host who proved to be very helpful in informing us about Lisbon, and has provided us with a very thoughtful equipped appartment. This is the appartment/host to go to in Lisbon! It's beautiful, has everything you need, and in a great location in the centre of the city close to public transportation. Tiago is also very easy to communicate with and fluent in English. Thanks again!

Tiago was an absolutely fantastic host. He immediately replied to all emails and answered all our questions. He sent us a description including a map how to get to the apartment and it was really easy to find. When we arrived a welcome package including wine and cheese was awaiting us. Just amazing!
One could clearly feel that Tiago put a lot of heart and energy into making the stay in his apartment an unique experience. He even made the effort to make a guidebook informing about restaurants, cafes etc in town.

The apartment itself is exactly as on the pictures, super clean and tidy and the location is simply perfect. Everything is in walking distance and there is a super cosy nice park with a great view very close by. We also loved to just sit on the roof top terrace and enjoy the view.
We really loved it and will definitely come back. Thanks so much, tack så mycket Tiago!

The location was the best any one could ever hope for! Avenida Liberdade is beautiful to take a stroll on and stop at the quiosques to have a beer or coffee, it is close to metro stations (Avenida) and the site seeing hop on hop off bus tours leave close by from the Marques de Pombal plaza. We went to Cascais (gorgeous beach) using the bus and it was very easy.  The apartment was equipes with everything you need - washer dryer was nice to have for a long trip, and of course the balcony was sweet to relax a bit before heading out to the night life around. It was right in the center, but still quiet at night so a perfect mix. I'd stay there again next time!! Thanks Tiago for such a lovely stay.

What a nice trip we had thanks to Tiago's apartment and his nice advices ! First, the location was perfect and the neighborhood really really safe !
Everything was exactly like the pictures so you are not going to be disappointed at all. And of course, the icing on the cake was the terrace : the sunny breakfast was delightful !
So thanks a lot Tiago to make our stay even better !

We really enjoyed our stay in Tiago's apartment.  His friend Sonia let us in and was very kind to answer our many questions. The apartment was clean, modern and furnished with everything we needed. THE terrace is lovely and the outside shower was perfect for the hot weather we had while in Lisboa. The area is very quiet and the apartment well situated, close to Avenida da Liberdade.  There is a mini precio (small supermarket) nearby so it was very useful.  We didn't meet Tiago, but he was kind enough to book a taxi for us at 4h30 am on the day of our departure.  Overall a nice apartment, we would stay there again for sure!

Apartment was in a great location and was perfect for our stay. The apartment is very homy and comfortable to relax in. Definitely make use of the rooftop shower midday after exploring the city in the heat. It was a lifesaver! Tiago was a excellent host and easy to arrange our stay/check in.

Thank you Tiago for a wonderful apartment. It was so easy to get around Lisbon with the Avenida Metro station so close. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and your tips about places to eat was very much appreciated. It was great meeting you personally. We especially enjoyed the Fado nights at the corner restaurant.

Dear Tiago and Sonia,

I was warmly introduced by Sonia who kindly showed myself and my mum around the apartment. It is exactly what is it on the pictures. The place on a super cute quiet street with cobblestone flooring. Perfectly minutes away from Avenida Liberdade to take a cab at any time of a day, which is a huge plus if you don't know the city well. Also, the underground the bus.

The apartment was clean, good-sized, with lots of light. We were left some bread, apple and local cheese which... made a wonderful combination next to a complimentary wine or just a snack before heading out for a breakfast!

Roof terrace is such a treat!!! besides Sonia's warning a second before, I was so much in interest of seeing the view that I lifted my head a second too early... Well worth it!

Well worth it! Thank you for having me and I WILL be back!

Martin and Kaili (mum)

My boyfriend and I stayed at Tiago's apartment for 2 weeks so we could truly experience Lisboa! Not only did we fall in love with the city, but the apartment was absolutely perfect. It was definitely "cozy" for two people and two weeks, but exactly as shown in the pictures and the location was FANTASTIC. The bus from the airport drops you off practically on the doorstep and the metro is also right there to get anywhere in the city. It's also right off the beautiful Avenida da Liberdade, and a nice short walk to the water. The place was clean, adn we had absolutely everything we needed. Tiago was there waiting for us with a smile even though we were late and had no phone. He showed us the apartment and the roof - a great place to sit with wine and see the beauty of Lisboa.

I can't think of somewhere we would have been happier for our stay, and I certainly cannot think of a better host. You will not regret your decision to stay with Tiago. Let him suggest places for you to go. He knows his stuff!

Enjoy the beauty of Portugal. :)
Super hôte, super appartement, super terrasse ;-)

We appreciated Tiago's welcome and willingness to make suggestions for places to eat and to shop for groceries. He also made arrangements for a taxi right at our doorstep at we left for the airport. His suggestion of a neighborhood fado restauarant where the family (also the cook and waiter) did the singing was a unique experience. The apartment was comfy and beautiful in its contemporary lines. Wonderful views, but when we went in mid May it was a bit windy to fully enjoy the rooftop.
We are thankful for our Lisbon experience right in the middle of the Portuguese culture. Jody and Don from Lancaster, Pennsylvania

The communication leading up to our arrival from Tiago was awesome. He gave easy directions to the apartment.

On arrival we were shocked with how much information was organized for you to explore. Lists of his favourite restaurants, pubs, etc. All along with a map and little write up. He also included a bunch of Lisbon tour guides.

The aparment is clean, bright, unique and in a great location. Super easy access to Avenida Metro station

The icing on the cake was when I received an e-mail from Tiago the day before our departure, he had called a taxi company for us to arrange an early morning pick up, as we had to depart at 4am.

Tiago clearly puts a lot of pride into being a good host, I would reccomend his place to anyone!

The information provided in advance and to find the apartment was very good. The welcome basket was greatly appreciated. Good information and recommendations are also provided. The patio was terrific. We hoped the place was going to be a bit cleaner and weren't impressed with the mold in the bathroom, though. Aside from that, the patio is great and the location is very good.

Super séjour à Lisbonne où nous avons été accueilli par Tiago et sa gentillesse!!! tous ses conseils nous ont été très précieux, notamment la soirée Fado le vendredi soir dans le resto au coin de la rue, soirée Fado authentique qui nous a fait verser quelques larmes.. l'appartement est super, propre, fonctionnel, très bien placé et au calme... C'était génial! merci Tiago!

Our stay at Tiago's apartment could not have been any better. All communication prior to the stay was easy and quick. Our arrival was smooth and we were welcomed very warmly by Tiago's friend. She told us everything we needed to know and then left us to enjoy what is an incredible apartment.

The bathroom is really big and the shower is fantastic! The apartment is ideal for two.The shutters on all the windows give complete darkness which allows for a deep and peaceful sleep at night. In the morning when you open them up, the whole apartment is flooded with light. The roof terrace is utterly perfect. It gets the sun all day long, my partner and I enjoyed lots of meals up there and loved the sunsets.

The local area is picturesque and very quiet. It is only a short walk to the city centre and the busier areas. There are so many little shops right on the doorstep selling fresh fruit and vegetables and other food and drinks.

I would highly recommend staying here. We will definitely be coming back.

Estar no apartamento do Tiago fez nos sentirmos em casa. A recepção feita pela Sónia - pois o Tiago estava viajando - e foi ótima, acolhedora e muito simpática (pães, queijo e vinho deliciosos ao chegarmos tarde da noite). O lugar é perfeito, num bairro cheio de  lugares tradicionais para apreciar a culinária local e caminhar; além disso, é pertinho do metrô e da Avenida da Liberdade, cheia de lojas charmosas e de grife. O terraço é fantástico e o apartamento foi perfeito para nós. Indicaremos certamente a todos os amigos que pretendam visitar Lisboa e esperamos voltar mais vezes! Obrigada, Tiago e Sónia!!! :))
Lovely place, lovely little street, lovely roof terrace, lovely view, in a central area. We really enjoyed our time at Tiago's place. We loved Lisbon too!

My wife and I really enjoyed our stay at Tiago's apartment in early April.   It's an easy walk from the Avenida metro stop and a wonderful location for exploring old Lisbon.  The modern apartment is very comfortable for 2; wireless internet works perfectly; many small restaurants, cafes and small food stores nearby.  Just walking the old streets and exploring was great fun for us.   As newcomers to Lisbon, we found all of Tiago's suggestions about how to enjoy the city to excellent.   He really added to our enjoyment of the trip.   Our only caveat is that the driving route to this part of the city is not obvious due to one-way and pedestrian-only streets -- give Tiago's phone # to the taxi driver if you need to come by taxi.  (We overpacked so needed a taxi.)  Best advice is to travel light. That is also good advice since the apartment is a walk-up and doesn't have much storage space.   We look forward to returning to Lisbon - a wonderful city - and will definitely want to stay in Tiago's apartment again.

Thanks a lot Tiago!
Everything was wonderful: the flat, the terrace, you!
See you and come when you want by us!

Tiago was an amazing host - he was welcoming and thoughtful, leaving us with a lovely welcome food and wine box, as well as plenty of information about the local area and some great places to go.

We loved the location and the apartment - it was beautiful on the roof terrace and the apartment was very well equipped. An amazing place from which to explore Lisbon.

We spent a couple days at tiagos lovely flat. After a long day of traveling he gave us a nice welcoming with cheese and wine. The flat is really central: if you are good by foot you hardly need any public transport. And by the way: the terrace is amazing!
A great Location with a nice view! It was a amazing Weekend in Lisboa!

The apartment was perfect for our stay in Lisbon. It was a great location and was very clean and presented well. Tiago was a great host and was on hand to advise us on where to go for great food and entertainment. We highly recommend this place.

We spent a wonderful time at this apartment! It is well located, close to the avenida de liberdade, and close to a metro station. Despite all that, is located in a peaceful neighborhood with grocery stores and little supermarkets close at hand (open on Sundays ! :)).
The terrace is just terrific! The apartment is equipped with everything you need to be on your own, fully equipped kitchen, washing machine,...
We didn't have the pleasure to meet Tiago, but Sonia welcomed us perfectly, explaining all we needed to know.
Another cool thing is that Tiago prepared some plastified maps and a binder with point of interests in the neighborhood, and personal remarks on restaurants :).
I also like the fact that we are invited to let a comment on an old type writer!
I would definitely recommand this appartment to anyone who wants to enjoy a wonderful time in Lisboa!

Natürlich ist Lissabon wunderschön.
Leider hatten wir täglich mehrere Stunden Regen. Nur an den beiden letzten Tagen schien die Sonne. Somit konnten wir die Dachterrasse nicht benutzen. Vielleicht sollte man erst ab dem 15. März anreisen.
Guter Tipp für einen Tagesausflug:
Mit der Fähre über den Tejo fahren, rechts am Ufer langgehen bis zum Restaurant „Porto Final“ und dort einkehren. Wo gibt es ein schöneres Plätzchen? Anschließend mit dem Fahrstuhl nach oben in die Stadt fahren und mit dem Bus zur Jesusstatue fahren.

This was a perfect vacation experience! The apartment is as described and pictured. The location is convenient to everything and Tiago's directions were spot on. I had a great time here and would stay again.

The apartment is even better in real life! Sunlight floods the apartment and the rooftop terrace is great when the weather is warm enough to enjoy. The neighborhood is quiet and there are many restaurants nearby. Avenida metro station is less than 5 minutes' walk away and connects you easily with the whole city.

Tiago is charming and personable and took time to show us everything even though our flight was delayed and we got in quite late. He has thoughtfully provided many resources in the apartment (and a delicious welcome basket!) to ensure that you make the most of your time in Lisbon. Stay here; you will love it!

We very much enjoyed our stay at Tiago's flat! The flat has an excellent location in the center of Lisbon, is very well equipped and has a lot of daylight, even on cloudy days. The rooftop terrace is amazing.
Tiago has been a great host, giving us a very warm welcome. He was also very responsive to any of our questions both before and during our stay. Thanks a lot, Tiago, we will certainly recommend your flat to anyone planning to visit Lisbon!

As so many other comments already mention, I can only recommend to all people interested in enjoying some days in this beautiful and very alive town Lisbon to spend their journey in Tiago’s amazing apartment. Tiago is absolutely the perfect host (he gave us a very warm welcome and so many tips/deatails about the real Lisbon – not the one you’ll find in tourist brochure) and his flat is definitely great – sunny, optimized space, very clean, decorated in good taste and comfortable. All you need is there to find at home. We also had the chance to take benefit from the Terrace and afford the luxury of having breakfast end of February in sun beating down. Definitely a great place in Lisbon! Laure & Mickael, Paris

To make a long story short: A great host in a great apartment! First of all, our flight was delayed and we only arrived around midnight. That seemed to be no problem for Tiago as we had anyway informed him in advance. He waited for us in the apartment and gave a very clear and efficient description of the apartment and of the things to do in Lisbon. Then we went all together with his girl friend in a nearby Fado restaurant so the night started in a very authentic Portugese way!! The apartment is clean and light and has great views. Unfortunately the weather didn't give us the chance to stay on the terrace this time. I can wholeheartedly recommend this well located flat to all the people wanting to have a great stay in Lisbon!

Lisbon is a wonderful city, just the right place for people who want to take a break from bad weather in january or febuary.
tiago's apartement is just as wonderful - a beautiful little gem with outdoor space in a pleasant neighbourhood. a real little home from home. perfect for us.
thanks to tiago and sonya ... great hosts who exactly know how to make people feel at ease in another country. by the way, nice books and information on what to do in the city on the shelves.
The apartment is great, Tiago is the perfect host. Everything is as described. I hope to come back!

We enjoyed a wonderful, sunny weekend in Tiago's apartment. Tiago was a stellar host -- greeting us at the apartment even after our flight was delayed several hours, and helping us to get a reservation for dinner at a nice restaurant to celebrate my birthday. The apartment was clean, full of character, well-equipped, and perfectly located to explore the city. We hope to return for another weekend in the future!

Although we didn't get to meet Tiago, he was the perfect host! He made sure we were comfortable and welcome during our stay and was always willing to help and share advice when we asked for it. Sonia, Tiago's friend who welcomed us at the apartment, was also super nice, friendly and helpful. The apartment was beautiful and ideally located. If you are looking for a place in Lisbon, this is the perfect place to stay! Thanks Tiago and Sonia!
This is my second stay in the apartment in a short time.  I think that's enough said.

Tiago is 5-star AirBNB host. I cannot think of what he could have done better for my stay there. He was extremely welcoming, prepared plenty of information to help and even left some wine and food for me.

The apartment has an amazing view of the city. It is on the 3rd floor in a quiet area of Lisbon. In winter the a/c and heater come in handy as it does get a bit cold without them. The apartment is small but full of natural light and very cosy. Excellent for short and long stays for 1 or 2 people.

Miscellanous things i appreciated are: the coffee percolator, the washing machine and drier, the very fast internet connection and the comfortable sofa.

There are plenty of local restaurants and grocery shops in the area that are not expensive. The apartment is a couple of minutes walk from a blue line station and about 15-20 min walk to Bairro Alto.

Tiago's apartment is by far one of the most impressing flats I have seen recently. Not only is it nicely decorated and designed inside, but it also offers an astonishing view over Lisbon's historic centre. The place is very clean and equipped with all you need. Tiago himself is really friendly and committed to offer you a perfect stay. Thus, I can recommend Tiago's beautiful apartment without any doubt!

We had a perfect journey by Tiago. The flat is just amazing, everything you need is there. We had the feeling that an architect compose the space, because everything is at the right place!
Tiago know how to host and he is extremly helpful, whatever you need.
When he knew that Thom is vegeterian, he directly sent us some vegetarian restaurant tips. Thanks to Tiago, we had a perfect end of 2012 and an amazing begin of 2013 with our little 6 months daughter :) I can really warmly recommend him!

The apartment is very well located: central, close to the metro station and to a lot of restaurants. As the name says (and the pictures show) the terrace is really nice...even in winter. Considering, also, that Tiago is a perfect host and a deep "insider" of the Lisbon-life with a lot of maps and suggestions to visit the city: the experience is really great.

Our experience in Tiago's apartment was nothing short of amazing. The location of the apartment is great, and the terrace is wonderful. The apartment is charming and beautifully maintained.

It's hard to imagine there being a better host than Tiago. His welcome package with Portuguese wine, bread and cheese was lovely. He recommended an amazing restaurant with authentic, amateur fado nearby on our first night, and compiled a huge list of recommended bars, restaurants, and sightseeing spots that are generally off the tourist radar. He made a huge effort to ensure that our experience in Lisbon was the best it could be throughout our stay, and are dying to come back to this apartment soon!

Tiago's apartment is very cosy and I felt like home immediately. Tiago welcomed us with a tasty bottle of wine any many recommendations, what to do and where to go. The highlight is the great roof top terrace, where we had breakfast - perfect beginning of the day:-)
Many thanks to Tiago!

We had an amazing experience in this lovely apartment. It was perfect for us. It was comfortable and we loved the decoration. And the location is just perfect. Tiago gave us  the best tips about restaurantes and places to visit. We highly recommend this apartment to everyone!

My boyfriend and I stayed in Tiago's lovely terrace apartment for 6 days. Although the apartment was a little bit smaller than we had imagined, it was the perfect haven for our first visit to Lisbon. The place was cozy, well-equipped, and full of personal touches, not to mention the amazing terrace, a great place to soak in the Lisbon air. It was also in a charming and very convenient neighborhood, close to everything one would need. The best part was our host Tiago, though. He was welcoming, thoughtful and responsive - it made our stay in Lisbon easy breezy. Oh, he also made terrific recommendations to neighborhood restaurants!

Lisbon was unforgettable and we will definitely visit again!

Perfect, no more no less.
Personal in a modest way.
Lots of light.
Lots of info.
If you wanna stay by yourself & have some work to do by the computer, this is ideal. And no discrepances between description & reality.
An xtra radiator would be nice for future late autumn stays.
That´s about it.
Keep rocking!
Lisbon is fabulous. Also.
Christian

Tiago's apartment was amazing.  The photos don't do justice (the terrace is absolutely beautiful)! Tiago was an amazing host in all regards (really thoughtful towards his guests) and thank you so much to Sonia as well.  We had a wonderful time, and would DEFINITELY recommend staying here!

Fantastic location, very central, close to the metro, local shops and downtown Lisbon. Beautiful apartment, fully equipped with everything you need, with some great views - the rooftop terrace is amazing! My first time in Lisbon and it was a great experience, enhanced by staying in this wonderful apartment. Would highly recommend staying with Tiago and will definitely stay here again if we returned.

L'appartement est cosy, décoré avec goût et très  lumineux, avec une terrasse donnant une vue splendide sur la ville. Il est situé au coeur de Lisbonne, proche de l avenue de la liberté; on pourrait se croire sur l avenue des Champs Elysées avec tous ces magasins et hôtels de luxe.  Tiago parle très bien le français ce qui a facilité les échanges. Il nous a réservé un excellent accueil : bouteille de rouge, fromage portugais,bières ,...Et plein de bons conseils pour découvrir cette belle ville de Lisbonne. Vous avez à disposition  un livret d'accueil très bien renseigné ( liste des bons restaurants, des commerces, des visites à faire, etc). Je recommande vivement cet appartement.

This penthouse apartment was perfect!  Great location, impeccably clean and well-maintained with the best host.  We had a great bottle of wine, cheese and delicious bread upon our arrival and a great restaurant recommendation booklet at our disposal.  Tiago was very kind and accommodating to our arrival and departure schedule.  We highly recommend this apartment and hope to stay here again on our next visit to Lisbon.  Thank you Tiago!!

Chose this great apartment for the rooftop terrace, and it was the right choice for many reasons! We received a warm greeting at the apartment and a lovely wine, cheese & bread basket. The book with Tiago's recommendations and the maps to nearby sites were very helpful, and every time we called or texted Tiago for help with the washer/dryer or a restaurant recommendation he always quickly responded. He directed us to some fabulous food we would not have found on our own.  By far our favorite thing about the place is the terrace, with amazing views over the city and down to the river.

Great little apartment! Tiago greeted us warmly with some wine and cheese (much needed after our journey) and gave us all the local tips on sites and where to eat and go out. The apartment had everything you could posibly need and was very clean. It was the perfect get away

This flat is this little jewel in Avenida Libertade, which is close to everything really, Barrio Alto just a walk away, Rossio, the city centre, you name it. It is absolutely beautiful, full of light, it's amazing waking up in the morning looking at the blue sky from the window next to the bed.
Every morning we had breakfast in the roof terrace, from where you have a beautiful 360 degrees view of the city.
I cannot recommend this flat enough, it's absolutely perfect for a romantic weekend away! Tiago is also very attentive, and you'll have the great feeling to be really taken care of!

Thanks Tiago!
We'll be back :)

Tiago promptly and carefully answered all of our questions and did everything within his power to make our stay interesting and memorable. I can't imagine a better host. The apartment was centrally located, near public transportation and all the major sites. We came to think of Tiago as a friend, rather than a host.

It was such a pleasure to stay in this cosy appartment! And Tiagos welcome was very nice - with graves and wine, bread and chease... A really perfect stay in Lisboa; in the center, but not in the middle of touristic affairs! We would love to come back! Thanks for all!

What an amazing and special welcome to Lisbon. The apartment was in the perfect location and Tiago was an incredible host, providing recommendations on eating and experiencing Lisbon. Thank you forever, Elsbeth

We had a fantastic four days in Tiago's flat! The flat itself is very sweet and light. The area is great, so central! And the rooftop is amazing. But most and foremost, Tiago (and Sonia) were great hosts! They made us feel welcome and at home, and with their help (and that of Tiago's guide in the flat) we discovered so many great little Lisbon treasures and had some truly amazing experiences. We can't wait to get back to Lisbon and would love to stay in this flat again when we do so.
I can only recommend staying here, whether it's your first time to Lisbon or your 10th - I'm sure you'll discover new places with Tiago's guide!

This place is amazing. Tiago is the perfect airbnb-host. Because he himself was on a holiday, he made sure his (very nice!) friend Sónia was there to let us in. The apartment is everything you'd expect from the pictures. We absolutely loved it: beautiful views, the great roof terrace, a good bed & bathroom and a fully equipped kitchen. (Although, thanks to Tiago's home-made guide-book with restaurant-tips, we didn't use the kitchen very much :).
I would recommend this apartment to everyone that wants to visit Lisbon!

Tiago's apartment was a really great place for our stay. It is well located and walking distance to the major sites in Lisbon. He was a great host! The apartment itself is small, but well kept - the roof terrace really makes it  a terrific place to stay. Thank you, Tiago!

This was the best place that we stayed on a two week trip to Europe. The location is fabulous, the apartment amazing, and the roof deck... incredible. It's a must-stay if you're going to Lisbon.

Also, 5 stars for Tiago's restaurant recommendations. With so many tourist traps in the city, it was a joy to have great places to eat where we could feel like a local.

Stay here.

Our trip to Lisbon was made perfect by such an amazing apartment and host. The booking process was so simple and the apartment was exactly what we were looking for. The views from every window were amazing and the roof was so peaceful-a great place to relax and take in the city. It was in a perfect location, had all the amenities you could want, convenience to cute markets and shops and, very importantly, the comfort of having such a terrific host. Thanks, Tiago! We had a blast in what is now one of our new favorite cities!

love love love this smart,funky appartment with glorius rooftop deck..Great location- thoughtfull host well organised.. Tiargo has the recipe for the BEST stay in Lisbon...Highly recemend this to travellers who care about where they stay and what they experience...
Thanks Tiago...we will be back!

Wow could not wish for any better stay  on arrival hosts were very helpfull with advice for restaurants, train stations, day trips & shops the apartment was excellent and so close to the city centre we did not use the metro once  every thing easy walking  highly recommend

This apartment is perfect for Lisboa. Everything is within walking distance and it's near the metro. Tiago was a very nice and helpful host providing us some very interesting information on the city. We enjoyed the wine and cheese at our arrival and the terrace is crazy. Thank you Tiago.

Great welcome by Tiago and introduction to the area.
We loved the place and certainly recommend it.

Tiago is a great host and can offer many valuable tips about a trip to Lisbon. He even provided good surfing location advice. The apt is great too. Check in and out are very smooth and accommodating. The apt is very clean, quiet, has everything you need, and has nice natural lighting. And an outdoor shower on the roof deck! What's also nice is that it is located 5 minutes from the touristy neighborhoods, but the surrounding neighborhood is local, so you get a feel for what the real Lisbon is like.

This was such a perfect apartment! It was within walking distance to almost everything you could want to see in Central Lisbon and the subway is one minute's walking distance. Tiago put together a wonderful guide with recommendations for restaurants and other sites in the area.
The rooftop was amazing to enjoy breakfast and just enjoy the view. The kitchen came in handy for cooking and keeping drinks and such in the fridge. The apartment was very clean and even more beautiful than the pictures show. We had the best time in Lisbon and the apartment just made everything better!!

We have stay one week in Lisbonne and it was great.
The appartment is very clean and confortable, nothing misses !
Take a breakfast on the terrace is great !!!

And Thanks to Tiago fr his welcome !

Absolutely perfect apartment and perfect host. Could not have asked for more. Having breakfast on the roof each morning was a delight. Would highly recommend to anybody. The wine and cheese were a special touch.

Tiago is a wonderful host, a cool guy and a great friend.
The apartment with the terrace is, as you can see on the photo's, a beautiful place to stay in Lisbon. It's located right next to the "champs-elysees" of Lisbon and can be reached easily by metro from the Lisbon airport.
Tiago makes you feel very welcome in Lisbon and has recommended some great places for us to go.

A+ host and A+ apartment!

Tiago was at the apartment to meet us and gave us the best welcome we have had anywhere.  The apartment is ideal for 2 people and very good location in city and near Metro.  we only staed 2 nights but really enjoyed it and made good use of the rooftop which was excellent after the hot sun cooled abit. we are definately wanting to come back for a week next year if we can.

We spent four wonderfull days in Lisbon . Tiago was very present before and during our stay. He is a very friendly, smiling and welcoming personn. He recommended the best places in Lisbon ! The terrace of the apartment is a real advantage from morning to night!
I'll return with pleasure to the apartment of course Tiago if I come back to Lisbon

This was our first Airbnb experience and we have been forever spoilt. The apartment is everything that you need in a city centre, everything we wished for was there, from the WiFi to the TV to the wasing machine and so on, both the flat and the roof terrace are perfect for a weeks stay. It is compact but superbly laid out and easy to keep in order!
Add to this the amazing host that is Tiago who welcomes you with wine, cheese and fruit and makes sure that you have all the information you need, even texting me with a list of vegetarian restaurants ( which by the way are amazing in Lisbon) .
This was a great first experience and we will be back, for sure.

I would definitely recommend this apartment to anyone!!! It is very clean and spacious. The terrace has an AMAZING view. The location is also great as you are very close to the main attractions, as well as to many metro and bus lines.

The best part about the apartment is it's host, Tiago. He really makes sure that the apartment feels like home. His mom was waiting at the apartment when we arrived, and provided us with all necessary instructions and a small welcome gift :). Tiago has a great taste in food, and gave us a lot of restaurant recommendations. All the ones we tried turned out to be fantastic. I would definitely stay at this apartment again if we come back to Lisbon.

Perfect location, cleanliness, kitchen, terrace everything. I cannot say enough good things about this place. We stayed here during a 3 month trip through Europe using mostly airb'n'b and this has been our favorite place so far. Firstly the location is wonderful, everything is in walking distance or near the metro. The house itself was clean and set up for cooking and living. The terrace was amazing, we sat out most mornings for breakfast and pretty much any meals we had. The bed was comfortable with a nice big window next to it. Tiago the host was brilliant, really helpful, really good at communicating, the information he left was spot on, good places to eat and things to see. Beautiful city and beautiful apartment, don't hesitate to book this place.

I'd suggest this place to everyone. It's perfectly located in the city center. It is comfotable, well equiped and clean. The terrace gives you a beautiful view to the city. Tiago met us personally, and gave us good advices, which we found very useful.

Staying at Tiago's place in Lisbon was great, very central, easy to get to everywhere & Tiago was a perfect host.
Thanks Lynda & Bruce

Tiago's apartment is really outstanding. Is so cute, exactly as you can see in the pictures. Very well decorated, extremely clean and with everything you need to spend a perfect time in Lisbon. And, as an extra, has a fabulous terrace, perfect for take some sun during the day or just chill out at evening. Tiago is a warm and helpful host, interested in provide all information you need to enjoy the best time there. I highly recommend this apartment. When I am travelling around the world, it would be a privilege always find places like this.

Tiago and Susanne are the best hosts ever! After what we put them through , sorry ! Our flights were cancelled ,then delayed , then our bags were lost , poor Susanne must have waited all day for us .
Without Tiago's help we would never have seen Lisbon . He was kind enough to have our bags sent to him while we cruised the streets of Lisbon .Thank you sooo much!
Dave

First. it is exactly as Tjago has positioned it on his site!!!
He provides his guests with a unique, warm and on top of it most efficient welcome / e.g. guiding the lost taxi driver via my mobile phone and ensuring, that we were not ripped-off!! The place offers all one needs to explore and enjoy this wonderful city: a cozy, very clean and comfortable place to stay, a great location to start your tours from - no car needed since all the infrastructure is "at foot". The rooftop is a rare one of its kind - starting the day there and chilling-out with this fabulous view and calm environment is an unforgettable event (weather permitting). All in all Tjago offers a wonderful retreat in a totally non-touristic environment, a gift to Lisbon travelers like the two of us!

There's just so much love in this apartment. You can really tell Tiago loves traveling and that he wants to give something back to the travel community. He provided us with a GREAT guidebook with restaurants, cafes, hidden coffee spots and a rather classic hat shop. The apartment was clean, comfortable, central, extremely sunny and it overall really has character. Oh, and did I mention that you get the feeling you own the world when you're reading a good book on the roof top? Thanks!

Tiago's apartment is a lovely little place conveniently close to the Avenida metro station. He and his mom Susanna were great hosts - Susanna met us at the apartment and showed us around. They gave us a lovely welcome basket with cheese, wine, bread and apples which we enjoyed on the rooftop that night. Tiago was very kind offering us tips on how to get to the apartment and where to go to see fado. Great place to spend our first 3 nights in Lisbon.

Tiago and his mother Susana are the perfec hosts: kind and efficient. Susana was in the apartment when I arrived and Tiago was always in touch with me to solve any need. Tiago has done also a very useful guide to restaurants, bars, etc. that allows you to enjoy the pleasures offered by Lisbon as well as avoiding the tourist traps. The apartment is lovely, very welcoming and close to major places of the city. In addition, the terrace is an ideal place for breakfast, lunch, dinner or a glass of wine watching the city at night. Central Apartment & 360º Terrace is a perfect choice.

charming little appartement with great rooftop terrace like shown on the pictures. tiago and his mother were great hosts who take great care of you during your stay. the double bed is rather small so the appartement is suitable for couples or really close friends. very central, you can reach everything by foot.

My boyfriend and I wanted to live in this flat! Everything about it was wonderful--the location, the numerous windows, the beautiful roof. Tiago and his mother provided warm hospitality and delicious restaurant recommendations. We celebrated my boyfriend's birthday on the roof with a delicious bottle of Portuguese wine provided by our hosts. One of our best Airbnb experiences to date!

It's a really nice apartment in the center of Lisbon. The host makes your stay as pleasant as possible by taking care of everything. The apartment itself is everything that the pictures tells you !
We strongly recommend this place for everyone who wants to enjoy Lisbon !

The apartment and location are unbelievable! Tiago's mom greeted us, leaving us with a bottle of wine, bread, fruit, and DELICIOUS cheese from Portugal.  Tiago was super easy to get a hold of via text or e-mail and had a plethora of information at the apartment for us (including a book he created full of restaurants and bars with their location and a Google Map)!  The apartment is very clean, comfortable, modern, and has all the appliances or anything you would need.  I can't stop thinking about how I want to go back to Lisbon and back to this apartment to enjoy a glass of wine or breakfast on the rooftop!

It's quite simple - this is a fantastic apartment and Tiago is a great host with excellent knowledge of the local area and useful tips on what to check out, where to eat/drink. If you are 1 or 2 people I can't see you finding a better value place to stay in Lisbon than here.

We couldn`t think of a better place to stay. The flat is bright, big enough for two, perfectly appointed. The roof top is a dream. You find yourself above the roofs of a great neighbourhood which is quiete but also has lots of little local fish-restaurants. Highly recommandable.

What you see on the pictures is what you get: a perfect location in the centre and a glorious terrace on top of a small cosy flat drowning in sunlight. We couldn't have asked for a better place to stay in Lisbon!
And Tiago is a wonderful host, who will prepare everything to ensure you spend the best time in Lisbon. He definitely knows his city and all of his recommendations were spot on. Look no further, this is the perfect place in Lisbon!

Tiago was the perfect host. The communication before and during our stay was great and Tiago gave us lots of good ideas for things to do around Lisbon. His apartment is in a nice quiet area of the city but still central enough to be able to walk to all the attractions. The roof terrace was amazing with great views over the city.

I simply loved this flat. Very cool interior design, great roof terrace, super clean and very quiet in a lovely neighborhood, not touristy at all although only a few minutes walk to Chiado, Baixa, Bairro Alto etc. Supermarkets, Bars, shops, tube station around the corner. And I couldn't have asked for a better host: Tiago is fun, super helpful and offered great advice. I will definitely visit again.
Buen departamento

We loved our stay here! The apartment is situated right in the heart of Lisbon. Being able to see the lift from one window and the castle from another was breathtaking. With 3 comfortable bedrooms, there was ample space for all of us. We loved the traditional feel of the building, and I would recommend this location to anyone coming to Lisbon!

Très bien situé! Logement propre.
Nous avons adoré notre séjour!

Overall a very good experience. The hosts communicated very well and offered tips for local attractions. The location is perfect and central to everything. It’s very easy to find and quiet enough even though you’re right in the middle of the town centre. The apartment itself was clean and tidy and absolutely served its purpose for the price. Only couple of criticisms would be that if it wasn’t for reading the reviews, we wouldn’t have known it was on the 5th floor (no lift) and the rooms themselves need a bit of TLC. We also had an issue where the boiler tripped about 4 times per shower but on arrival Hugo & Idalia made us aware of how to get it back on so I would hope in the next few days this gets fixed permanently.
Estancia súper bonita, todo muy bien 🙂

What a fantastic apartment. Beds were super comfy and most importantly clean. All the amenities you could need during your stay and a great shower too. Beautiful views from every window.
The host was very helpful, asking if we were okay and if we needed anything and offering help in recommending places to go. The apartment couldn’t have been more central, step outside and you are in the main square.
We could not fault this apartment and will definitely book again if we ever visit beautiful Lisbon again.
a super responsive host and a super central, homey apartment!

Le logement est extrêmement bien placé, la communication a été super facile, l’arrivée et le départ aussi
Grace à Hugo et Idalía, nous avons passé un week end super !
Nous reviendrons avec plaisir ☺️

Le logement d'Idalia est conforme à la description, chaleureux et très bien préparé. L'accès est très facile. Le contact avec Idalia et Hugo est hyper fluide et rassurant. Ils sont proactifs et donnent des conseils pour les activités à faire sur place. Je ne peux que recommander ce logement et ces supers hôtes ! Idalia et Hugo font partie des meilleurs hotes que j'ai pu rencontrer depuis mon expérience AirBnb.

Tout s’est très bien passé.
Le logement est très bien placé proche de tout.
La communication avec les propriétaires était aussi très bien.
Malgré le petit soucis à l’arrivée les propriétaires ont essayé de trouver des solutions afin que nous ne soyons pas embêter avec nos valises.
Je recommande

We had a very pleasant stay in Lisbon with colleagues. The apartment is comfortable and very well located, allowing quick and easy access to the city’s main tourist attractions. Idália is a very friendly and responsive host, always quick to suggest solutions to make our stay easier.
A very nice apartment in the heart of Lisbon and a kind, helpful host!
We had a very good stay with my family. The place was comfortable and the location was great, close to everything we needed🙌

Location was great, restaurants and bus/train stations are a short walk away. Everything is as described.  A few things to note:  The stairs can be difficult --  I think I counted just over 100 steps to get to the flat.  Also, the apartment does show signs of age, the power kept shutting off multiple times (we just had to reset system each time).  But I do think that if you find this for a good price, then it could be worth the value since it is quite a large space -- just be ready to climb those stairs!

o único empecilho foi a questão da escadaria, que realmente são 5 andares, que se não tiver preparo físico, não recomendo, a subida com malas foi bem cansativo, mas como estávamos com malas de bordo, tudo certo, até mesmo pq sabíamos que teria essa escada. para nós valeu muito, pois a localização é incrível, bem no centro de Lisboa, com os melhores restaurantes e lojas. o apartamento não é novo, mas tudo muito limpo e cheiroso, que isso é o que importa. tem vistas maravilhosas das janelas por ser no alto. maquinas de lavar roupas e secar, o chuveiro é muito bom e bem quente. tivemos só um problema quando chegamos, que acredito que por ser virada do ano, a liberação da porta de baixo não deu certo, e tivemos que aguardar um pouco até conseguirmos entrar, mas acredito que foi um erro do site. a Idália é super querida e prestativa. com uma boa comunicação, assim que falei sobre a portada frente, pouco tempo depois ela já me explicou que haviam chaves no apartamento, com isso tudo certo.
The location is the center of Lisbon and perfect to go anywhere we wanted to go. Rooms are clean and Idalia is so nice host.

Anfitriã foi super querida, nos deixou entrar com as malas antes e deixar um tempo a mais após o horário de checkout. Café disponível na cozinha. Máquina de lavar e secar roupa disponível. Só atentar quem irá com crianças pois os andares de escada são cansativos após um dia inteiro passeando pelas ladeiras de Lisboa.

Mi familia y yo estuvimos muy bien en el apartamento de Idalia. Es muy limpio, organizado, muy bien dotado. Muy cómodo. Para mi fue un tipo de alojamiento interesante por la antigüedad del lugar. Algunos detalles normales por deterioro pero nada grave. Lo único es que realmente para una familia con niños, con un adulto mayor o con una persona que tenga algún problema de movilidad no es aconsejable porque son demasiadas escaleras. Por suerte mis hijos ya son jóvenes. Yo sufrí un poco por mis rodillas pero lo logré. Valió la pena porque esta muy bien  ubicado. Idalia es muy amable y muy dispuesta a atender las inquietudes. Volvería.

Excelente ubicación, las instruccio nes de llegada super claras y el anfitrion muy amable y al pendiente de cualquier cosa, todo estuvo muy bien, solo considera que es un 5o piso y no hay elevador.
pero vale mucho la pena por el precio y el lugar donde se encuentra, ya que esta a unos metros de plazas y centro
Ótima estadia.

La ubicación del departamento inmejorable, conocimos todo caminando. Muy cómodas y limpias las habitaciones, aunque una de ellas sin luz natural, las otras con lindas vistas a la ciudad. Cocina muy bien equipada y con elementos básicos disponibles para la estadía. Deben considerar los 6 niveles que se deben subir, pero lo valen absolutamente!
Idália is a great host! 100% recommend staying at her place

Idalia was such a great host and so accommodating. The place was so lovely and spacious, it had everything we needed and was in such a great location. The beds were very comfortable and having a washer and dryer was  so nice to have. I would definitely stay here again!

Minha experiência foi excelente. O apartamento estava impecavelmente limpo, bem decorado e muito funcional. A localização é perfeita, segura, central e com fácil acesso a restaurantes, mercados e pontos turísticos. Idália foi extremamente prestativa e sempre disponível.

This is the best apartment! There are three bedrooms, a kitchen and a washroom. Everything is perfect! Our landlord Idalia is kind, nice, and friendly! I have decided to go to Lisbon one more time, and this apartment is my choice definitely! It needs to be noticed this apartment is at 5th floor and there’s no elevator.

Definitivamente la ubicación es lo mejor, es muy céntrico para acudir a todos los sitios de interés, caminas muy a gusto en la noche, comenzó un mercado de Navidad a media cuadra que fue muy agradable visitar.
Como lo han publicado varias personas, sí está en un piso 5 un poco complicado de subir con equipaje pesado, para personas mayores definitivamente no lo recomendaría.
Mi único comentario hacia los dueños es relacionado a la comunicación, no fue muy ágil, al parecer hay una copropiedad por lo que responden 2 personas diferentes, y en ocasiones un poco lenta la respuesta.
Fuera de ese pequeño detalle la ubicación es espectacular
Great location and views.  Yes be warned about the walk up but suited us fine for a night in the heart of Lisbon.
Wir hatten einen tollen Aufenthalt und würden jederzeit wieder bei Idália wohnen.
Alles super. Es sind 107 Stufen bis zum Zimmer. Wenn man sich darauf einstellt und keine zu schweren Koffer hat ist es kein Problem
Great place, great location, quiet. The apartment is beautiful!

super Lage nahe Metro und super zentral. aufgrund der Lage in der 5. Etage total ruhig mit super Lage. Super Bettenqualität und die Küche ließ keine Wünsche offen, so wie die Gastronomie in der Gegend. gerne wieder
Satisfied! It was easy to enter the house and had everything we needed. Thank you!

Apartment was clean, spacious and in a great location. Communication with Idalia and Hugo was great. They were very helpful and went out of their way to help us with storing our cases on our last day. I would recommend this apartment as a great, central location to stay. The apartment was quiet during the evening even though it was close to restaurants/bars etc.

L'appartement est spacieux et agréable  (jusqu'à 6 personnes) joliment décoré. Sa localisation est parfaite et comme il est au dernier étage, la vue est superbe! Une très bonne adresse pour visiter le cœur de Lisbonne!

Wir hatten eine sehr schöne Zeit in Lissabon mit unseren Kindern. Die Wohnung lag sehr zentral und war in einem guten und sauberen Zustand. Die Aussicht auf den Elevador Santa Justa und die Burg waren phänomenal. Hugo und Idália waren sehr hilfsbereit und immer erreichbar. Alles in allem sehr zu empfehlen!

Excellent location in Lisbon with good amenities, including washer, dryer, and little espresso machine. We did not learn till later that rental was on 5th floor. A bit of a haul with luggage, but manageable. Idália responded to everything with helpful information.
Alles perfekt! Wir haben die Tage sehr genossen. Vielen Dank!
while the hosts were amazing and accommodating, there was a noticeable smell throughout the whole apartment! also the roof in the livingroom is falling apart!
Very good apartment

Wir hatten eine gute Zeit in der Wohnung! Sie ist gross, gemütlich und hat alles, was man so braucht. Die Lage ist top – mitten in der Stadt, alles ist easy zu Fuss erreichbar.
Es war sauber, gut ausgestattet und man fühlt sich wohl.
Ein kleiner Hinweis: Die Wohnung liegt im 5. Stock ohne Lift – mit grossen, schweren Koffern eine kleine Herausforderung, aber dafür ist das Fitnessprogramm gleich inklusive 😅.
Würden auf jeden Fall wiederkommen und können es weiterempfehlen!

Die Wohnung verfügt über 3 Schlafzimmer, einem gemütlichen Wohnzimmer, funktionaler Küche und schön grossem Badzimmer. Wir haben von Idalia und Hugo, unseren Hosts, alle wichtigen Informationen für das Check-In sowie für die Übergabe der Wohnung erhalten. Die Hosts waren proaktiv, hilfsbereit und standen immer über Airbnb oder WA zur Verfügung, vielen Dank hierfür! Die Wohnung ist zentral gelegen, an toller Lage und zahlreiche Einkaufsmöglichkeiten befinden sich vor Ort. Die Metrostation Rossio ist in wenigen Minuten erreichbar. Die Wohnung ist im 5 Stock und daher sehr ruhig. Die Wohnung verfügt jedoch über keinen Lift, weshalb man ein paar Treppenstufen erklimmen muss bis zur Wohnung. Für Personen, die keine Mühe haben mit Treppen steigen, ist die Wohnung auf alle Fälle eine GROSSE Empfehlung. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und würden gerne jederzeit wieder vorbeikommen.

Location was good, but that’s probably the only positive point. The smell in the stairwell and throughout the entire flat was nearly unbearable and nauseating. Smelled like sewage and trash our entire stay. Opening the windows seemed to make it worse; potentially due to sewage smells coming from the street. There was clearly a previous water leak or water damage in the living room. A portion of the wall & ceiling had been “patched” with some plastic white/grey board. Not sure if the leak and water damage has been fixed or addressed. Appeared to still be an issue that needed maintenance. At least there was an air purifier in the living room in case there was mold (does not excuse the unaddressed maintenance issue). The shower was also difficult to use. The shower heads were positioned in a way that sprayed directly at the glass wall, thus causing water to leak through the shower cracks (not caulked) and run onto floor. Shower didn’t drain and towels smelled sour. Needs some work.
Amazing apartment with great city views and central location. Had a lovely stay. Just note that there is no elevator so we had to lug our suitcases up and down five flights of stairs.

Great location, great host... Right in the heart of Lisbon but nice an quite apartment.
We were a group of 3 gents and each had a lovely room each.
The host cominucated brilliantly and has accommodating to looking after bags etc..
Lovely apartment.. Sending the wife's next time. Thank you

We had  less than 10 kg of luggage each . No problem with no elevator . But other guests should be informed in clear terms in the description of property that there is no elevator for this top floor rental. Hosts should not assume that guests will automatically know  that “old town building equals no elevator “, because that is not true everywhere . As for the strong smell of sewage , I do not know how the owner will fix that , when it is prevalent all through out the building . But this unit has great views and it has 3 bedrooms .  We only stayed for one night .
Sehr schöne und gut gelegene Wohnung mitten im Herzen von Lissabon. Top ausgestattet. Kommen sehr gerne wieder.

We really loved Idalias place. The location is superb, you are right in the middle of the centre. A very nice apartment, nice rooms, a kitchen with all amenities. There’s really nothing we could ask for. But be prepared to walk five floors…

wir waren insgesamt drei Nächte in der Wohnung und haben uns wohl gefühlt. die Wohnung liegt zentral und man erreicht alles sehr einfach und schnell. in der Umgebung jede Menge Supermärkte und Cafés. kleiner Makel war, dass die Wohnung im obersten Stockwerk liegt und alles Gepäck durch ein teilweise sehr steile Treppenhaus nach oben geschleppt werden muss. wir hatten mit 5 Personen viel Gepäck und das war sehr anstrengend. ansonsten drei schöne Tage in Lissabon.
Idalia was a great host and we loved our stay in Lisbon!

L appartement est  joliement meublé situé plein centre du vieux Lisbon au 5 em ( sans ascenseur) et du coup beneficie d une tres belle vue  sur le chateau st Georges ,l asenseur avec plate forme et de l autre cote le musée  archeologique ... ..Il est spacieux  fidel à la description  en plus vetuste ...et il ne faut pas etre maniaque sur la propreté.

My recent stay at Idália's Air BnB was about a week with three kids. From the moment we arrived, she made my family and me feel completely at home.
Idália is a truly fantastic host who went above and beyond, especially when my son misplaced his favorite stuffed animal. After checking out we realized we forgot my kids favorite stuffed animal. She was able to coordinate with us to get the stuffed animal back.
Her kindness and patience were truly exceptional. Beyond that moment, she was always available to answer our questions and offer great local recommendations. Her place was immaculate and perfectly suited for our family trip.
Staying with Idália wasn't just about having a place to sleep; it was about experiencing true hospitality. She's a fantastic host, and I would recommend her to anyone, especially families.
Loved the place, fantastic apartment in a great location
A lovely flat in a wonderful location.Really quiet considering the surrounding area. Well situated, spacious and an all-round fantastic stay. Would highly recommend.
Komfortabel mit toller Aussicht und bester Lage. Sehr empfehlenswert!

Precioso y con una ubicación inmejorable en pleno corazón de Lisboa .
Anfitrión muy atento y siempre dispuesto a ayudar .
Todo muy limpio y con todo lo necesario para hacer vida en el .
En definitiva el apartamento perfecto para visitas a Lisboa

Highly recommend this brilluant apartment right in the heart of beautiful Baixa area, which meant walkable to Bairro Alto and Alfagar areas, but also right on the doorstep of Rossini train station.
Tons of space in the characterful apartment for our family of 4, with great kitchen and bathroom.
Great and proactive hosts!
Only drawback was being on the top floor meant 5 flights of beautiful stairs to climb… but that also meant great views from all the windows of the Lisbon skyline and Santa Justa lift

We had a lovely stay in the apartment. The location is brilliant and we walked everywhere with restaurants and shops on the doorstep. There were over 100 steps to get up and down to the apartment however our 3 kids (youngest age 6) didn’t complain once so was very manageable.
The apartment itself was clean, spacious and well set up however did not look much like the photos and is looking much more well worn in reality.
The hosts were very helpful and responsive and regularly checked in with us to ensure we were having a good stay. Thank you!

Localização fantástica,  é possível visitar vários pontos turísticos a pé e com grande variedade de bares, restaurantes e lojas. O anfitrião é muito atencioso e solicito, sempre preocupado com o nosso bem estar. Recomendamos com certeza!

Idalia’s place was very charming and steps away from Rossio Square with many great stores and restaurants nearby. There was a book with all the recommendations and instructions that was very helpful.
Idalia was proactive with information prior to our stay and we would stay here again.

Die Lage der Wohnung könnte nicht besser sein 🌞 mega zentral - in unmittelbarer Nähe einige Sehenswürdigkeiten, Einkaufsmöglichkeiten, Lokale, Restaurants, Bars... gute Verbindung mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln.
Idália und/oder Hugo waren jeder Zeit vor/während und nach unserem Aufenthalt in kürzester Zeit erreichbar (haben uns vor Anreise schon ausführliche Wegbeschreibungen zur Wohnung, Einkaufstipps und Anweisung/Infos zum Check-in zukommen lassen). Wir durften vor offiziellen Check-in bereits unser Gepäck in der Wohnung abstellen, da wir so früh in Lissabon waren. Zum Zeitpunkt unserer Reise haben Bauarbeiten am Haus stattgefunden (uns hat es nicht gestört - da wir von morgens bis abends nicht vor Ort waren). Wir waren eine Reisegruppe von 5 Frauen - leider ist uns in der Küche am letzten Tag ein Malheur passiert (es wurde sehr freundlich und fair gelöst).
Die Wohnung hat 'Charme'. Ich würde diese Wohnung und Idália als Vermieterin jedem empfehlen und selbst gerne wiederkommen.
Despite the construction and five flights of stairs, we enjoyed our stay! The house was well decorated, clean and the information booklet was super helpful!
The location of this bnb is unbeatable, it also had everything we needed including a washing machine and dryer which is super helpful for those on longer trips.

Logement bien situé.
Bonne communication avec Idalia et Hugo qui on été réactif à nos demandes.
Des travaux de ravalement de façade nous ont malheureusement pas permis d’avoir une vue sur la place et le balcon était inaccessible pour cause de travaux également.
Logement à rafraîchir, le plafond et les murs du salon ont pris l’eau et l’écoulement de la douche ne se fait pas correctement se qui provoque des fuites malgré un débouchage quotidien.
Nous avons quand même passé un bon séjour, l’appartement est bien équipé et décoré.
Attention au 5 étages qui sont assez conséquent à monter car il y a des demi paliers entre chaque.

Loved our stay in this gorgeous Lisbon apartment, was perfectly located - genuinely can’t beat it. Had everything we needed and Idállia and Hugo were the best communicators, gave us tips, were quick to respond. We felt sad leaving this apartment & would absolutely recommend.
Excelente ubicación. Muy buena comunicación con el anfitrión
very kind owner
Tolle Wohnung mit 3 separaten Schlafzimmern, Wohnzimmer, große Küche und großes Bad. Super Lage mitten in der Stadt
Super appartement dommage qu’il y est eu des travaux.

A pleasant stay, comfortable beds, good location and a very helpful host.
Only thing to note, is that if you have issues with mobility, this apartment is up ten flights of stairs with no elevator.
Other than that, it was great!
Endroit très bien situé au cœur du quartier. Peut être bruyant pour personne qui se couche tôt
Tidy place with amazing location. Host is very helpful, we could stay a little bit longer and leave our luggage before check in. Highly recommended ;)

Emplacement idéal pour visiter Lisbonne. Plusieurs bonnes recommandations que nous avons essayé et adoré. l'hôte était très réactive pour répondre à nos demandes et s'assurait chaque jour que tout allait bien. Seuls points négatifs, ça sentait vraiment beaucoup l'humidité dans l'appartement à un point où c'était un peu désagréable malgré que tous les déshumidificateurs étaient ouverts. Les 5 étages à monter sont quelque chose, nous sommes 4 adultes très en forme et malgré l'emplacement idéale de l'appartement, nous n'y retournions que lorsque vraiment nécessaire.
Wonderful place, centralllocsted and caring, engaging host!

Great location. Spacious. The city square was steps away the apartment! Lots of restaurants, bakeries and sites to see!
Hosts were very responsive to questions, concerns and very helpful with recommendations with sites to see, as well as restaurants and pastry suggestions!
Got what I expected nice view and good area.

Great location. Near everithing you need to see or do.
Perfect.
No better place in Lisbon.
Just check your knees or the amount of bags you carry. Its on the 5th floor without lift.
Ha estat una experiència molt bona. Tant l’apartament com la comunicació ha estat excelente. Encantats amb l’experiència i recomenable 100%. L’atenció de la Idàlia ha estat meravellosa
the apartment was very beautiful and traditional, everything was up to date and working without losing the traditional feel.

We spent 4 wonderful nights at Idália home. The apartment is huge even with 5 of us staying there. We were never under each other’s feet and all had our own space to relax in an evening especially playing cards around the dining room table. We were told in advance about the scaffolding around the building but that is outside and out of Idália control. It wasn’t a problem for us as we spent all our day time exploring the city. Idália and Hugo were amazing they kept in contact with us keeping track of the weather and giving suggestions of what was worth a visit and checking if there was anything we needed for the apartment. Our time there was wonderful and we even got used to the 5 flights of stairs to the apartment,especially when you get the amazing views we had from our windows it was worth it.  Can’t wait to visit again and would recommend the apartment and Idália to anyone who asks. Thanks for having us all

We had a fantastic stay at Idalia and Hugo’s place! The home itself was lovely and well-equipped, but what truly stood out was their incredible hospitality. From the moment we arrived, they were welcoming, thoughtful, and went out of their way to ensure we had everything we needed. Even with a bit of rain during our trip, their kindness made all the difference and helped us enjoy our celebration to the fullest. We’re so grateful for their care and would absolutely recommend their place to anyone visiting the area!

Little dated but acceptable.
Rooms were small.
Moisture smell was very noticeable!
Location was awesome.
Dragging luggage 5 floors up without a lift was painful
Et godt sted, helt centralt i Lissabon

Firstly, the good points - Hugo and Idalia were great to deal with, very helpful and let us check in early. The location is excellent too, right in the heart of Lisbon so everything is walkable.
Unfortunately, the apartment is long overdue refurbishment and no longer resembles the photos. We appreciate it is an old building and we were informed the roof is being replaced next month so hopefully things improve dramatically. During our stay, it was surrounded by scaffolding with workmen there all day, outside the windows. The ceiling also leaked into the lounge during a storm.
I would suggest people are informed of the work before they arrive and a discount offered during this period of work.
Other people have mentioned the 5 flights of stairs with no elevator and we didn't think it would be an issue but it's important to be aware these are very long flights of stairs so it's quite the hike which may be difficult for some, especially with luggage.

Logement idéalement positionné dans le centre de Lisbonne. Différentes transports accessibles à côté de l’appartement et facile d’accès depuis l’aéroport puisque le métro est a 3 min à pied.
Endroit idéal pour se promener et faner dans les rues de cette ville.
L’accueil et la communication avec idália étaient très bien et chaleureuses.
Merci !

Logement parfait pour un weekend sur Lisbonne. très bon emplacement dans le centre ville. Le quartier est calme et a proximité des lieux touristiques. Le logement est conforme a la description, bonne literie. Très bonne communication a avec l'hôte.

Idalia y Hugo estuvieron siempre pendientes de nosotros!! Un lugar súper equipado y con todas las amenidades para un viaje :)
Muchas gracias.

Pros: location (literally central to everything), loads of space, comfortable, great shower, everything you could need, extra blankets, great communication and very helpful hosts.
Cons: damp smell, could be cleaner, needs a massive renovation/update, very cold (heaters didn't help at all), poor lighting.
Also worth noting there are 9 large flights of stairs. The apartment is on the top floor. No elevator.

logement bien situé hote parfaite.
c'est un logement spacieux mais de ville donc escalier et bruit nocturne mais c'est la ville donc normal.
sinon rien à dire merci pour ce séjour

Nous avons passé un super séjour à Lisbonne. Idalia a toujours été aux petits soins avec nous. La localisation est extra! Et très pratique pour venir de l’aéroport.
La proximité de la gare de Rossio est très pratique, et tous les transports en communs sont super accessibles.
Bref: nous avons eu du mal à partir. :-)

We had an amazing couple of days in Lisbon. The apartment is centrally located at Rossio Square and easy to find on foot and taxi.
Perfect location and central to everything you want to see. Lots of lovely places to eat and drink within walking distance.

交通非常方便，房東很友善，回覆很快速，有很清楚的房間使用說明書跟推薦的體驗事物，佈置用心。
但是沒有電梯，提行李箱的人需事先考慮。
Idalıa çok iyi bir ev sahibi sorularıma hızlı yanıt verdi evin konumu çok güzeldi tekrar aynı evde kalmak isterim Portekiz’de sıcak yuva Idalıa teşekkürler

Great location, very central with lots of nice restaurants nearby, and supermarkets a 5 minute walk away. Hosts were very friendly and responsive. There was a problem with the electricity supply to one of the bedrooms the evening we arrived and the host got that sorted for us the next morning. The kitchen is well stocked.
Downsides were that the flat had a damp problem, with large damp patches on the ceilings and down the walls. One night we were there, it rained and water came through the ceiling into the hallway; the noise of it hitting the floor woke us up. Looking back at previous reviews it seems that this has been a problem for a while.
It was also quite chilly. Two small heaters are provided but aren't sufficient to heat a flat of that size. We had to make use of the blankets provided when sitting on the sofa in the lounge and when in bed. The shower also leaked water across the bathroom floor which was a bit annoying. On Fri/Sat nights there's also loud music from nearby bars.

A anfitriã é muito gentil , o apartamento extremamente bem localizado, mas estava com cheiro de mofo e obras nos andares e fora do prédio . Outro grande incômodo é ser 5 andar sem elevador . Muito complicado pra quem tem algum tipo de limitação ou mesmo bagagens . O mal cheiro estava muito grande e decidimos sair no segundo dia.
This apartment is extremely centrally located. It is a huge space. It looked just like the pictures, and was very cute. The hosts were very responsive.

Spacious apartment with beautiful views right in the center perfect to explore beautiful Lisbon.
We had an amazing stay there with major sights right on the doorstep. Great warm shower was much appreciated.
Idalia was a great host, made us feel welcome with her friendly communication. Wouldn’t hesitate to come back when Im in Lisbon again!

Péssima. Sofremos propaganda enganosa. O apartamento fica num quinto andar de um antigo prédio, sem escadas. Foi um horror, tive que subir com 9 malas.
Na qualidade de consumidor, fui enganado, já que nada foi dito.
O banheiro vazava água pra todo lado, trabalhei todos os dias limpando o banheiro.
O frio era imenso, pois era só um aquecedor pra três quartos.
Internet péssima.
Em resumo, o pior lugar do mundo.
Fico imaginando o nível do setor de qualidade do Air BNB, em propiciar que desastre como esses seja associados.
Não aconselho ao meu maior desafeto.
Easy to self check-in. Location was very good, just next to Rossio square. Very near restaurants, public transportation, shopping and attractions. Would stay here again.
Had a great stay at this apartment,with everything we needed on hand and when we did require assistance the host was easy to contact and sorted the issue hastily with no problems.
Nice place

Our family of four enjoyed our stay. The unit is close to great restaurants and shopping. It’s a busy area but we did not hear any loud noises inside the apartment.
There are five flights of stairs to get inside the apartment but that didn’t bother us at all. If you have mobility issues you might take the climbing of the stairs into consideration.
I would highly recommend the unit and Idália was a gracious host and very attentive to our well being.
Fantastic central location for exploring Lisbon. Very convenient. Spacious for us all. Well equipped. Had 3 very good nights sleep which we all needed!!!
Excelentes anfitriones siempre muy al pendiente de nuestras necesidades. Nos ayudaron a encontrar un taxi muy temprano. Realmente recomendable.
We loved our stay here. Location was great and the place had everything we needed for a few nights stay. Would recommend!
Beaux séjour en famille!

Great place for a great price!
The host Idália is super friendly and always tries to help.
As mentioned in the description, the apartment is at the 5th floor. Since we are all young, it did not bother us.
Nous avons passé un super séjour entre amis dans ce logement qui était extrêmement bien placé et avec des instructions et indications toujours très pratiques et utiles avec beaucoup d’attention

Excellent location and super responsive host. Apartment was very clean and well appointed. We worked a bit from the apartment so having fast WiFi was awesome! Tons of restaurants, bars and sights to see very close by! Highly recommend booking this apartment.

La ubicación excelente y la comunicación con el anfitrión muy buena en todo momento. Sin duda repetiríamos
Gracias
War ein super Aufenthalt. Die Wohnung hat tolle Aussichten aus allen Zimmern.

Muito bom o apartamento de Idália
Não lembro de ter visto na descrição que o apt se localizava no 5 andar, sem elevador, mas tirando essa pequena dificuldade ( pois minha família tinha muitas malas ), tudo foi perfeito. Recomendadíssimo. Localização perfeita - hiper centro de Portugal. Host muito agradável e reativa.

We had a great time in the Apartment. very good location, very central, but still quite. The Apartment is beautiful very big and full of sunlight with a lot of charm and everything you could possibly need during your stay. A bit nosy during the day due to the construction outside. Definitely would recommend to a friend visiting Lissabon!

Fabulous location and right in the heart of Lisbon. We were able to walk everywhere and had easy access to great restaurants and bars. All the bedrooms were comfortable and well stocked with linens and towels. The apartment is on the top floor of a 5 floor building so do be prepared for a bit of a walk if you book the place. We didn’t have a problem at all, but I can imagine some difficulty for some people.
Idália’s place was well stocked with everything we could need! Highly recommend.

Le logement est tres bien situe dans Lisbonne.
Par contre, il se trouve au 5eme etage sans ascenseur, donc non adapté aux personnes moins mobiles.
Il est silencieux pour un logement situe en centre ville.
Les photos ne correspondent pas à la realite (couleurs et finitions).
Des travaux (surtout pour la douche) sont à prevoir pour que l'on puisse qualifier ce logement de superbe et design.
Il y avait des travaux dans le bâtiment d'a côte et nous n'avions aucune vue depuis le salon mais bien des nuisances sonores. On aurait aime en etre informés au préalable.
Nous n'avons jamais rencontré ni Idália ni Hugo. Nous n'avons eu que des contacts par messagerie.
Un grand merci à eux pour nous avoir permis de deposer nos valises à notre arrivee.
Mais je regrette qu'ils n'aient pas repondu à mes deux derniers messages concernant notre depart.
Le délai de reponse de 7 heures n'a donc pas ete respecté.
Le tourisme à Lisbonne est tres bien exploite et on s'y sent en sécurité.
Emplacement très central pour cet appartement. Un peu sportif car au 5e étage sans ascenseur, mais calme. Je recommande.

Nice host and very central place, the appartement is very good for 5 to 6 people. Walkable distance from touristic areas.
While the location is charming, it seems that there were unfinished repairs of water damage, as well as some issues with pillows and mattress that would need some refurbishing.
Photos are a bit too flattering compared to actual state.
Es war eine sehr schön eingerichtete Wohnung. Sehr zentral gelegen. Die 116 Stufen in den 5. Stock zur Wohnung haben wir gut geschafft - Muskelkater und Fitnesstraining inklusive 😊

excelente ubicación, bellisimo estudio.
limpieza impecable.
Excelente estancia

El departamento estaba limpio y amplio
Pero al no tener elevador la subida de maletas fue complicado
También se salía el agua de la regadera
Pero de lo demás todo muy bien !
Lovely flat for a quick stay in Lisbon! Beautiful views of the city. Some construction going on in the building and next door but given we weren’t there during the day it didn’t impact us.

La ubicación es excelente! Estás en medio de todo y todo queda a poca distancia caminando… Idalia estuvo en todo momento comunicada para cualquier cosa que se me pudiera ofrecer y me ayudó con mi estancia y recomendaciones locales.
El espacio es más grande de cómo se ve en las fotos y tiene muchas amenidades.
Geweldige lokatie! Fijne en snelle communicatie. Goede tips! Idalia is erg betrokken.
You couldn't ask for a better place to stay in Lisbon. Right smack in the middle of everything. A lot of stairs, but that made it feel great and quiet being on the top floor.
Great place.

Idalia and Hugo were excellent communicators.  The location was super convenient and steps from Rossio square.  We dined twice just across the street and had a great meal and great atmosphere.  The only downfall was the climb up 5 floor with my suitcase (my bad!)..but the apartment was very roomy and had everything we needed.  We had one small issue with water and it was tended to right away.  I would definitely give this place a thumbs up.  Great hosts

The place was awesome and I welcome the free experience to make it to the 5th floor. I am no longer a youngster like some of the younger people accompanying us. Overall, it was great. The location awesome.  you'll enjoy it as well.
This was a great location and walkable to attractions.

Idália was a fantastic host and we had a great time in Lisboa. Communication was very good throughout our stay and we had no issues. Check in was very straight forward and we found the apartment relatively easy with the instructions provided. It was a great location and close to a number of sites. The apartment was on the 5th floor so you will need to climb the stairs which we found very manageable even on tired legs. Great views and we would highly recommend this apartment.

Idalia place is incredible, close to the trains for getting to and from the airport along with if youre looking to get out of Lisbon for the day. Very accommodating hosts allowing to drop luggage off before check-in to allow us to get straight to enjoying Lisbon.
Great place, comfortable stay.

nous avons passé un super séjour à Lisbonne, Idalia était très à l'écoute , le logement est idéalement situé, et sécurisé, tout équipé, gros plus pour le sèche linge, literie confortable et jolies vue sur la ville .
rien a redire ! A bientôt

We stayed once night at Idália's and wish we could have stayed longer! She was very communicative and even let us check in and drop our bags off early as we were switching from a different hotel. The location is extremely convenient and located close to a lot of great restaurants, the Rossio metro station, and numerous bus lines. Aside from having to bring my luggage and stroller up 5 flights of stairs, everything about the place was great for the value - would highly recommend with the caveat of the lack of an elevator.
Très beau logement, très bien décoré et parfaitement situé pour explorer Lisbonne.
My family spent 2 nights at Idalia's place.  It was a very great surprise. Highly recommended!!!!!!!

You can't beat the location. There was a dance party at the square on one evening and we had a blast. The view from the bedroom window was spectacular. The laundry machine/dryer came in handy. The only thing I would say for future renters is that you have to be somewhat physically fit to climb the stairs (108 stairs/9flights). We climbed the stairs multiple times a day and it was a bit difficult after a long day of sight seeing averaging 9km walking per day. I would definitely rent again as long as I can climb stairs.
Thank you for making our stay and first visit to Lisbon memorable!
This was an excellent location and very clean.  There are many stairs, but also a view of the castle from the windows.   Thank you for a wonderful experience in Lisbon!
