Great location, right on the centre of everything. Apartment was spotless and very spacious. Host was responsive and very helpful throughout the whole holiday. Would highly recommend and definitely would stay there again!! Thanks for everything 🥰
Very central, lots of restaurants and attractions close by. Idalia was very helpful and good at communicating.

The apartment was really central and a great location for sightseeing and touring around Lisbon. Idalia was a very responsive host and allowed us a flexible check in to drop our bags off early, which was very helpful. The apartment was clean and provided everything we needed for our stay.
The neighbouring building was an adult club which we weren't aware of at the time of booking. There was loud music during the day but fortunately it closed early evening and so it did not affect us at all as we were out in the day. The building next door is currently a building site, but again the noise did not affect us.
Overall, we would recommend this accommodation for a central stay in Lisbon.

Great stay at Idália's apartment. The apartment was perfect for my family. The location is superb.
Idália was a great host, very proactive and always quick to reply.
Would definitely stay here again!
Mooi appartement op centrale plek in Lissabon! De Host was heel vriendelijk en reageerde snel op vragen.
Apparemment très bien situé,  à deux pas de tout. L'hôte est bienveillante et vas au devant de nos demandes. Très beau séjour.
It was a perfect appartement for our family. Very central, nice location but still quiet enough to sleep. The appartement is beautiful and the owner very nice :-)

The location was certainly a standout for this place, it doesn’t get much better! The apartment was spacious and comfortable. Idalia was very accomodating and responsive. Would recommend for groups visiting Lisbon

Apartment is in a central location, great for exploring Lisbon. Excellent communication from host before and throughout stay which was appreciated. However, wasn't made aware that the neighbouring building is under construction, obscuring views on one side of the flat with scaffolding up to the level of the windows impacting privacy. Not a big deal as noise was minimal, but would be good to have known. Unfortunately the noise from work being done on 2 flats within the block was far from minimal and went on for hours into the evening as well as filling the stairway with dust every day. Those with young kids, asthma or respiratory problems might want to check these works have been completed.

Nous avons très bien été accueilli par Idalia. Les instructions étaient claires et l' hôte toujours à disposition pour répondre à nos questions.
L'emplacement de l'appartement est incroyable, au centre, tout est à proximité.
L'appartement est grand et bien équipé. Les pièces de la cuisine et du salon manquent un peu de luminosité.
La literie est bonne. Nous avons très bien dormi.
L'appartement peut-être difficile d'accès pour les personnes à mobilité réduite car il se trouve au 5ème étage sans ascenseur mais personnellement cela ne nous a pas dérangé.
Si nous revenons à Lisbonne, nous logerions chez Idalia avec plaisir.
Merci d'avoir rendu notre séjour incroyable !
Wonderful apartment in such a fab location. Our flight landed in the morning and we were able to check in early which was a great bonus!
Appartement très bien situé pour visiter Lisbonne! Il dispose de 2 air climatisées. On a même une super vue sur le château St Jorge de la fenêtre de la chambre !

This is the perfect location to enjoy Lisbon. As a guest, I was able to easily walk to so many sites and had beautiful views of the city. Our host was helpful and clearly communicated before, during, and after our stay.

Recently travelled to Lisbon about 2 weeks ago with family and stayed in Idália/Hugo's apartment . They're wonderful hosts and the instructions, communication, responsiveness were excellent. The apartment was clean, well furnished & spacious enough for a family &  had all the listed features & amenities. When we had an issue with one of the amenities they along with Airbnb support worked to fix it for us. within hours. The location is very central, walkable & has several good restaurants & stores around. We had a very pleasant stay & highly recommend it.
Die Unterkunft ist super zentral, sehr groß und wunderschön! Ich würde sie auf jeden Fall immer wieder buchen! Die Kommunikation mit dem Vermieter war einfach und schnell

Die Lage der Unterkunft ist alles! Idalia war sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Wir würden die Unterkunft wieder buchen. Lediglich eines der drei Schlafzimmer hatte keine Fenster, das war uns nicht bewusst und das wurde stickig über die Nacht.
Aber wie gesagt, diese tolle Lage würde alles entschädigen.

Perfectly located!  3 bedrooms which was a great option when traveling with 2 boys.  We had everything we needed in the accommodation including extra blankets, several fans, paper towels, toilet paper, and laundry detergent.  There is both a washer and a dryer, which is a plus.  One thing to note is that there are many stairs to the apartment.  We knew this ahead of time, so it did not bother us.  Also there is air conditioning but only in the main living room, not in the bedrooms.  We had to keep doors open to help cool the place to our liking.  Our host communicated very quickly with any questions we had and always ready to help.  Thank you for hosting our family, you have a beautiful property in Lisbon.

Great place to stay in downtown Lisbon! Beautiful views, comfortable beds, friendly host. Very worry free place! Due to 5 stories and steep stairs, not for people with bad legs (or lots of heavy luggage).
Great location!  Lots of shops and restaurants within close proximity.  The unit is in the heart of the city but feels private with beautiful views from the bedrooms.
Idália was very helpful from the moment I booked with her. Responded very quickly to all questions and checked in on us via message numerous times during our stay to make sure all was okay.
Great place! Amazing communication throughout the stay

Sehr schöne, geräumige und saubere Wohnung im Herzen der Altstadt. Die Lage könnte wirklich nicht besser sein.
Idália hat uns mit allen Infomationen versorgt und stand uns stets mit Rat & Tat zur Seite. Das gesamte Appartment ist perfekt ausgestattet und alle Betten waren super bequem.
Wir verbrachten 4 wundervolle Tage in Lissabon und können diese Wohnung jedem wärmstens ans Herz legen.

Overall, the visit was good. We arrived with heavy luggage so the many stairs proved challenging as there is no lift. It was cool when we were visiting so we were able to open doors to let in fresh air. The location is first-rate, with easy access to restaurants and the train station is nearby. Good shopping too. Idalia was very responsive and accommodating of our early arrival and late departure; thank you. We had a lovely time in Lisbon.

Idalia’s place is in a fantastic central location with a fabulous view of St Jorge’s Castle from bedrooms and the bathroom.
The beds are very comfortable and the flat is equipped with all that should need for self catering holiday.
The hosts are helpful and eager to please. Communication was easy and prompt.
We had a lovely stay. I would definitely recommend.
We had a great time staying here. The host was very accommodating with our requests and helpful.  The place is near tourist attractions. 👍🏻

We loved our stay in Idalia's apartment. The location is excellent! It couldn't be closer to Rossio Square. And everything is in walking distance. If you are worried about the noise of such a central location, the apartment is on the top floor and we couldn't even hear the live band celebrating 25th April on a stage in Rossio Square!
The place is well equipped with a washer and dryer and an iron and ironing board.
I would warn less able or elderly guests about the amount of steps between street level and the apartment. However, we had just completed a 4 day, 75km hike on the Rota Vicentina; our legs were dead; and it wasn't particularly difficult to get upstairs.
If we visit Lisbon again, we will definitely stay!

Hugo was such a great host! The place was great and in a perfect location for the first leg of our trip. Everything was really close and it was easy to get to and from the airport. Only thing to keep note is that there are A LOT  of stairs. We thought we’d be fine carrying our luggage up and down, but it really was super difficult. If you have heavy luggage or physical limitations this may not be the place for you. If you are traveling light then this place is perfect!

Cuando llegamos al alojamiento, desconocíamos que había que subir 5 pisos andando, con las maletas, una amiga se resbaló al bajar.
El piso olía a alcantarilla y humedad, bastante desagradable cada vez que entrabas.
Además, el edificio de al lado está en obras entero y el sábado empezaron a hacer ruido desde las 8am, si lo que buscáis es descansar y comodidad, no lo recomiendo.
Lo bueno es lo céntrico que está, aunque el local pegado al portal es una discoteca que se abre hasta por la mañana, por lo que te encuentras borrachos a cualquier hora del día, no transmite mucha seguridad.
Respecto a la comunicación con Idalia con una urgencia que tuvimos, fue complicada porque no habla inglés, por lo que no nos pudo ayudar a solucionar la urgencia.
Las camas cómodas y la ropa de cama y toallas limpias, al igual que el baño y el resto de la casa en general.

Appartement spacieux et bien équipé pour un séjour en famille. Bien situé.
Hôtes réactifs et arrangeants
Idalia was a very nice hostess

Great location right on the square. Idàlia is truly the best & sweetest host I’ve ever come across. Beware that there are many stairs to the top floor for the room. Roomy place with everything that you need. Will definitely be back here

Die kleine, aber sehr feine Wohnung, kann man problemlos per Türcode betreten. Die Wohnung war sehr sauber und gut ausgestattet. Wir waren zu 6 dort und dies war kein Problem. Vielleicht würde ich sie nicht für Familien mit kleinen Kindern empfehlen, da nach einem Tag in der Stadt der 5. Stock dann eine Hürde darstellen kann.
Die Wohnung liegt in einer Seitenstraße in einer belebten Gegend, perfekt um Lissabon zu erkunden. Vieles kann man zu Fuß erreichen, es gibt viele Restaurants, einen Markt / Supermarkt in unmittelbarer Nähe , ansonsten ist auch direkt eine Metrostation an der Ecke.

Had a great stay in this apartment. It was exactly what was advertised. The location was excellent. The host, Idália, was amazing, flexible with check in and out, always responded right away and was extremely helpful. She even provided a place for us to keep our bags after we checked out. Thank you so much for everything!

Great central location with lots to do and see within walking distance.
Friendly and helpful communication with Idalia who made sure we knew how to get there and recommended things to do.
We were also able to check in ourselves which was handy as we arrived late in the evening.

Het appartement ligt geweldig centraal pal naast de Santa justa lift , het gebouw ernaast staat jammer genoeg in de steigers en dat is aan één kant je uitzicht en klopt niet met de foto’s . de host is zeer communicatief en doet er alles aan je verblijf naar de zin te maken is soepel met incheck en uitcheck wat fijn is zodat je niet met de koffers loopt te zeulen . Zij kan aan bovenstaande situatie m.b.t. tot buurpand niets veranderen. Wat ons tegenstond was de geur in het appartement het is er erg vochtig en we waren blij dat we zonnig weer hadden en alles open konden zetten. Het gebouw is oud dus ook het onderhoud is nagelang. Dat hebben we als een gegeven geaccepteerd en 5 heerlijke dagen gehad in Lissabon.
Logement spacieux, bien équipé,  et surtout très bien situé. L'hôte a été très réactive et de bons conseils
Excellent location for city visiting

We absolutely loved staying here!! It was in an amazing location, central to so many restaurants and beautiful squares! The host was very responsive and proactive with information. There was a flexible check-in and check-out. 100% would recommend staying here.
Parfait, le séjour c’est excellemment bien passé et cette hôte est très agréable et disponible! Le logement est super bien placé ! Parfait !! 👍

Tout d'abord Idália est une personne formidable.
Toujours à l'écoute et surtout elk3 nous à proposé des solutions pour nos bagages, à l'arrivée et au départ.
Le logement est spacieux, très bien situé, propre et avec des points vue très sympathique.
C'est le logement idéal pour visiter Lisbonne, il est en plein centre.
Attention, il est au cinquième étage et je ne le recommande pas aux personnes âgées ou avec des difficultés à se déplacer.
Malheureusement lors de notre séjour il y avait des travaux et échafaudages, ce qui nous bouché la vue sur l'ascenseur.
Très sincèrement je vous recommande ce logement, vous ne le regretterais pas.
Encore un grand merci à Idália.
Super responsive and great location!

Casa molto grande e soprattutto in una posizione centralissima. I punti principali si possono raggiungere a piedi. Metropolitana molto vicina come i tram e gli autobus.
Casa con tutti i comfort. Entrata nel portone e in casa con il codice.
L'unica nota negativa era che la casa era fredda e umida. Per il resto ottimo soggiorno.
O apartamento é muito bem localizado,  bonito, organizado e limpo. Além disso, Idália e Hugo foram atenciosos e pró-ativos, sempre mandando instruções claras e precisas. Super recomendado!
Excellent location in the heart of Lisbon. Idália was available whenever we had questions. I would recommend this listing for anyone interested in touring Lisbon.
Great location and great surroundings. Felt like we were home!

Il soggiorno in questo appartamento è stato perfetto, noi siamo state in quattro amiche e c’è tantissimo spazio per tutte. Eravamo vicinissime a tutte i monumenti, quartieri più interessanti e vita notturna. Veramente magico!
A localização era ótima, próximo a restaurantes e vários pontos turísticos. O espaço era grande e nos acomodou muito bem

Idália was such a great host. She was super clear with all check-in/out instructions and maintained friendly communication throughout. Apartment is exactly as described and so spacious! Right in the city centre so you can get anywhere really easily and amenities are not far at all :)

Idalia was extremely helpful and friendly, giving us recommendations for nearby bars and restaurants. She messages us throughout the stay to check if everything was okay. However, there were some things in the apartment which stood out. The 5 stairs climbing was the least of our worries. Unfortunately, the apartment did have a strong pet smell which lingered even with a humidifier turned on. It was extremely humid and dusty in the whole place, but that was probably due to the age of the building itself. The bathroom door knob was a little broken and in general the apartment does need some major renovations. There were some repairs done on the 3rd floor of the building, but thankfully we were out for most of the day. Even though the hosts were extremely accommodating and helpful, the place in an excellent location and a beautiful view indeed, I just couldn’t give the 5-star review.

Excellent location and the apartment was larger than we expected.  Idalia is very helpful, friendly, and responsive.  We stayed 8 nights and really appreciated the mid-stay clean where not only were supplies replenished but our sheets and towels changed.  The separate washing machine and dryer was very handy.  Thank you for a wonderful stay in beautiful Lisboa!
Alles einfach und  unkompliziert.

Idéalement situé dans le centre de Lisbonne, très grand, confortable.
En plus, nous avons pu déposer nos affaires avant l'aménagement (en fonction de la disponibilité du logement)
We loved our stay! Perfect location to explore the city and Idalia was so helpful throughout trip from storing our luggage to excellent local recommendations.

spacious and well located accommodation with everything required for a short or longer stay. plenty of restaurants and shops close by. easy access from the airport, near a metro station. good starting point to visit beautiful Lisbon. I would recommend it.

A estadia foi perfeita e o apartamento tinha tudo o que foi descrito. Era muito espaçoso e  acomodou bem 5 pessoas. Usamos o ar condicionado na função de aquecimento e ele funcionou muito bem para os ambientes mais amplos, o que tornou nossa estadia confortável (era uma preocupação para meus pais que não estavam acostumados com o inverno europeu). Idália foi sempre muito solícita e o check-in e check-out foram muito tranquilos. A rua não é muito silenciosa mas a localização é muito positiva por ser central e estar próxima de estações de metrô. Adoramos a estadia e recomendamos muito a acomodação!

Très contente de notre séjour, Idália est super réactive pour répondre à nos questions. Le logement est hyper bien situé, un petit bémol se sont les 5 étages à monter pour s'y poser ( mais c'était indiqué) après une bonne journée de visites , ça calme 😉.
Idalia, sempre foi muito atenciosa e o espaço era limpo e conforme as fotos, a localização é ótima e no centro, perto de vários pontos turísticos! Recomendo!

We had a lovely time at Idalia's home. It was very clean and comfortable. The location was fantastic. We had so many restaurants, coffee shops, bakeries and grocery stores to choose from within walking distance.
Idalia was a very responsive and helpful host. We would not hesitate to stay here again.
Great place to stay, almost everything is at walking distance

Très bonne communication.
Appartement très bien situé.
Very nice place to stay, close to the centre and has lots of restaurants and shops nearby. Be aware though, the stairs are a slog!

We LOVED the location of this unit. Right in the middle of everything and close to great restaurants, shopping, public transportation and cultural activities. Idalia gave helpful tips on where to eat and how to get places and was flexible on check in letting us drop bags early. She was always responsive. Unit was more spacious than we thought and the views were incredible. The stairs helped us burn off the pastries we ate😊The unit does have all the smells of a place it's age that has seen some pets. We'd stay there again! Thanks for sharing your unique property!!!
Très bel appartement conforme à la description, très bien placé , aucun problème , très simple à trouver métro à 5 min , je recommande
Great location. Very helpful host

+ die Wohnung ist sehr zentral und gut mit dem öffentlichen Verkehr erreichbar.
Die Gastgeberin war sehr nett und hilfsbereit.
- die Wohnung entspricht nicht dem Inserat und den hochgeladenen Fotos.
Die Wände sind nass und an manchen Stellen voller Wasser ( es hat auch im Wohnzimmer getöpfelt, da es an den Tagen stark geregnet hat- man hätte uns das davor bescheid heben sollen)
Viele Sachen wurden nicht gereinigt wie zB. Toaster, die Ablage fürs gewaschene Geschirr,....
Als der Gastgeber vorbeigekommen ist um sich um die tröpfelnde Decke anzuschauen haben wir uns wegen der Sauberkeit beschwert. Der Gastgeber hat gleich die Laune geändert als wir die Hälfte unseres Geldes zurück haben wollten, dennoch haben wir uns geeinigt und seit dem haben sie nicht immer auf unsere Nachrichten geantwortet wie davor. Ich hoffe, die Wohnung wird bald saniert, damit die Gäste ihren Aufenthalt genießen können.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen

Had a great stay here! So spacious and had a beautiful view which made up for the walk-up.
In a prime location as well - was able to get to everything I needed quickly (right next to a Manteigara!)
Instructions were also super clear - found the Airbnb quickly & had no issues getting in. The video provided also made it a stress-free experience.
Overall would choose this spot again so long as I don’t have too much luggage!

Our family love the place, it's like home away from home, and the location is great, it's in the center of the old town, easy access everywhere!, and Most importantly the host Idália is super responsive! Will definitely recommend the place to friends.
Anfittiones siempre a disposición y facilitando el hoario de salida

I have never written a negative review, and under normal circumstances I think this place would suite a range of guests. The current situation in this neighborhood is that some heavy construction 🚧 is taking place at night. I couldn’t even see where the activity was taking place during the day. The construction noise and voices from those on the job through most of the night was not able to be blocked out by the windows. Most urban Lisbon places block out nearly all exterior noise with good windows, but these did not. To be fair, the construction noise was so intense that I doubt any window would have made a difference. I didn’t keep exact track of the hours at which I was awakened, but my best guess is that the noise ceased after 3 am and until 5 am. I assume this project will eventually come to and end or at least that the loudest parts will be finished and that the problem will subside. But it was clean and safe and all instructions were communicated proactively.

We stayed there for a business trip and had a great time. The communication with our hosts was really great - very proactive und nice. We even could stay a little bit longer in the apartment.
The only thing you should be aware of is that the apartment is located in the 5th floor without an elevator.
Excellent situated apartment with stunning views, and ample space and comfort throughout. A great experience !

Vous pouvez y aller les yeux fermés. Idália et Hugo sont réactifs, accueillants, de bons conseils.
Le logement est fidèle à la description et idéal pour séjourner au cœur de Lisbonne. Les 5 étages sans ascenseur en valent la peine!
Nous y avons passés un excellent séjour et en garderons un très bon souvenir.
Amazing spot in the heart of Lisboa - walking distance to so much, yet feels like your own tucked away private hideout.
Nous recommandons pour l'emplacement parfait et le bon accueil.

Idalia was really reactive! The place is very well situated, close to all commodities, to restaurants, to activities. It was very clean!
Just be careful in the flights of stairs :)

l'appartement est très bien situé en plein centre de Lisbonne . malgré les 5 etages à monter,il est très fonctionnel et parfaitement adapté pour 6 personnes. la vue sur l'ascenseur Santa justa est un plus
Idalia et Hugo sont des hôtes très sympathiques , attentifs à vos besoins et très réactifs .
ils nous ont bien conseillé sur les transports et adresses de restaurants très sympas .
je recommande les yeux fermés

We had a perfect stay in the apartment. Loads of room and great location. The 5 flights of stairs were a struggle after a day of walking but the views were worth it!
Idália was so helpful throughout our stay and even posted something back to me that I left in the apartment. Would 100% recommend - we’ll be back!

Alloggio molto grande, 3 camere comodissime, bagno con tutti i servizi, compreso il bidet che per gli italiani è un must. L'unica pecca sono i 5 piani di scale senza ascensore, ma era ampiamente indicato nella descrizione e quindi nulla da eccepire. L'host è stata sempre pronta e disponibile per ogni evenienza e chiarimento. Una vacanza perfetta sotto tutti i punti di vista.

We had a wonderful time at Idalia's and Hugo's apartment. Very friendly hosts and always available for help and giving us useful tips. The apartment was exactly like on the fotos, clean and beautiful. Small supermarkets and restaurants just a few steps away. We were staying with our 1 year old daughter and everything was provided for the small one, which was extremely helpful for us parents! The apartment is located in the very city center, so everything that we did was on foot. I warmly recommend this place if you decide to come to Lisbon, especially if you are coming with bigger family. We had our peace when we stayed there and in general a lot of fun in beautiful Lisbon! :)

Un très agréable séjour chez Idalia et Hugo qui ont été très réactifs et bienveillants. Le logement est parfaitement équipé, très bien placé et sécurisé, on en oublie (presque) les 5 étages ;-)
Logement recommandé !
Merci Hugo et Idalia pour votre accueil et votre disponibilité

Fab place. Highly recommend it.
Brilliant central location, just off Rossio square (2 mins from metro).
Amazing hosts: friendly, helpful, responsive.
Tons of space and great rooftop views.
Perfect location for exploring Lisbon!
Really nice flat in a really good location - lovely long weekend!

Saubere & schöne Wohnung, entspricht den Bildern.
Sehr gute Lage, ca 2‘ von Metro entfernt, viele Restaurants in der Nähe & Sehenswürdigkeiten.
Ruhige Lage obwohl man im Zentrum ist.
Gastgeber waren super freundlich, sympathisch, hilfsbereit & immer erreichbar.
Bei Problemen waren sie immer erreichbar & lösten das Problem innert Minuten.
Wir haben den Aufenthalt hier sehr genossen & würden immer wieder kommen!
Awesome place with SPECTACULAR VIEWS!  Very accessible to all the beautiful sites in Lisbon.  Idalia’s communication and care for us was impeccable!
Lush apartment! Just what we needed! Host extremely helpful and accommodating. Central location. Would definitely come back. Thank you.

Un séjour très agréable chez Idalia et Hugo. L'appartement est charmant et très bien situé, beaucoup de restaurants et d'activités à proximité. Idalia et Hugo ont été des hôtes parfaits, attentionnés, réactifs et sympathiques. Un grand merci à tous les deux !

Really loved our stay - in the heart of Lisbon with so much to do around. Although climbing up the stairs was a bit of a struggle with all our luggage, the apartment, location and views was well worth it. Really friendly and responsive hosts - would definitely recommend

This place was perfect for my groups holiday. You couldn't ask for a more central location in Lisbon. The apartment was clean, had everything you could need in there already (apart from a cooker which was slightly strange) but we just adjusted our cooking to suit. Everything worked, it had lovely Aircon throughout the apartment and had great views out to the city. We would definitely recommend it to friends and others. If we ever come back to Lisbon we will be staying here again. The hosts were very polite and kept us updated with the weather etc.
Enjoyed staying in this very central location. The apartment accommodated our 4 single ladies well. Great communication!
Het was een geweldige ervaring. Het appartement was in het hart van de stad wat alles beloopbaar maakte.

Great location for a tourist to see the major sights of Lisbon. Lots of restaurants and shops right there within a stone’s throw. Apt is bigger than the pictures suggest, which was great for our family of 4 to spread out. Only thing to note is what previous reviews mention- the apartment is on the top floor without an elevator so be aware if you have heavy luggage or don’t like walking up 5 floors. Otherwise, great place!
Appartement très bien équipé, facile d’accès, proche de toutes commodités et des principaux lieux d’intérêt et de sorties sur Lisbonne. Hôtes très sympathiques et proactifs. Je recommande vivement!

We (a family with two children) had an incredible stay at this wonderful apartment in the heart ofLisbon. The apartment's interior is tasteful and well-furnished making the space comfortable and highly functional. The responsiveness of the hosts was another highlight of our stay. They were quick to respond to our queries we had (thank you very much again!) and made sure we felt welcome and comfortable throughout our time there. The apartment's central location is perfect for anyone eager to explore the heart of the city. Being right in the midst of all the action allowed us to easily embark on exciting adventures in the downtown area, whether it was visiting historic sites, enjoying local cuisine, or simply taking in the vibrant atmosphere. In summary, this apartment offers an exceptional stay in Lisbon. It is an ideal choice for those seeking a memorable and immersive experience in this beautiful city. Thank you for hosting us!

Merci pour ce petit coin de paradis, vu imprenable sur les toits de Lisbonne! Typique et authentique, on en oubli presque les 5 étages sans ascenseur !
Merci pour vos attentions! Prévenante et anticipation merci

Two lovely nights right in the midst of Lisbon life (but without too much noise at night thanks to being top floor), in this perfectly located apartment. It was a comfytemperature inside even when 39C outside. It is  a walk to everything, and the flat is surrounded by restaurants, cafes and everything else. Our hosts were super communicative, and flexible when we thought we needed to drop bags early (before chaos aftermath of a papal visit put paid to that idea). Apartment is well equipped, beds comfy and with views of the lift, the Castle and baixa alto from the windows. A super base for Lisbon adventuring.

Idalia & Hugo's home was great.  It was homely and so close to so many sights in Lisbon.  We did a walking tour of Lisbon the first day and the meeting place was just nearby at Rossio Square (took all of 3mins to walk there). :). I was in touch with Idalia a few times and she was always responsive and helpful.  It is very nice to be staying away from home knowing help is nearby, if needed.
Excelente departamento, mejor que las fotos y justo enfrente de una de las plazas principales.
Superb location. Very communicative and helpful host.

The place was in a great location, very clean, I slept very well.  My son said he could hear some heavy trucks passing by at night but am not sure from where as I did not hear anything. If you end up on the fifth floor, be ready for the climb; probably more of an issue for Canadians and Americans and not so much for Europeans.  It was well worth it, as you only bring luggage up once but the place is in the heart of the city. 5 min walk if you get off the metro from airport.  Close to everywhere. There was a washer and dryer to do laundry that worked very well.  Idalia was a great host, responded to questions quickly and did let us check in early so we were able to leave our luggage and enjoy the city while waiting.  On departure she also allowed us to keep the luggage a little longer so we could go shopping before leaving to our next place in Portugal .  I wanted to rent it again for a week later but it was already booked for someone else.

Super séjour. Grand appartement très bien situé dans le centre de Lisbonne. Metro, bus et différents quartiers touristiques facilement accessibles à pied. Très propre. Bien équipé. Communication aisée avec Idalia et Hugo qui sont très arrangeants, prévenants et dont les informations sont très précises.

Very nice, clean, spacious apartment right in the heart of where you need to be. Detail important to mention - as the apartment is on the 6th floor with no elevator, might be hard for many physically. Otherwise a gem of a place with incredible views all around :)

Idália & Hugo were amazing hosts. They would message daily to see if we needed anything or sheets to be washed/changed. The apartment was amazing and such stunning views from the lounge room and also the bed rooms. This place perfect for a family of 4 as it had 3 spacious bedrooms.
Please note: that the stairs to go up can be tiring as the apartment is located on level 5 and there is no lift however the central location certainly makes up for it.
I would definitely stay here again!

Very affordable stay at the heart of the tourist part of town. Place was clean and comfortable. Some wear and tear but did not take away from its value. Host was very good at communicating days before check in to make sure everything went smoothly. We loved the washer and dryer after a week of traveling around Europe. The only thing to note was unit was on the 5th floor with NO elevator. We are young and able so it was a good workout.

If you’re staying in Lisbon, this apartment is perfect! Everything is within walking distance, not to mention the stunning views from the apartment itself. Idalia and Hugo were great hosts, very quick and responsive with any issues that arose. Would definitely stay here again!

Amazing apartment in the best location in Lisbon city! The host was friendly and communication was perfect. The apartment had everything we needed for a comfortable and wonderful stay. Our family can definitely recommend this home!

We loved staying at Idalia's apartment. It's so centrally located and easy to explore the neighbourhoods, Alfama being our favourite. The apartment was well equipped with coffee pods, shower gel, shampoo etc. The bathroom is huge and the shower is very powerful. The beds are comfy and we didn't experience any difficulty sleeping at night. We didn't hear much noise due to being 5 floors up. I'd stay here again and recommend to others.
Todo perfecto, solo no tuvimos agua caliente por la mañana.

you definitely stay here for the location. you can't get more central. the stairs to the apartment can get tiresome but it's nice to have a view. unfortunately right below / next door to the apartment building is a peep show that is very loud into the early hours of the morning.
the host was very accommodating and responsive and the amenities such as washer and dryer were great as well as coffee and shampoo and conditioner supplies

Enjoyed our stay for the one night. Right in the center of town so a perfect location but yet quiet. Lots of steps to climb (which we knew about in advance) but well worth it for the view and the space it offered.
Très bel appartement et très bien situé

Wir waren sehr zufrieden! Die Lage ist perfekt und Idália war immer zu erreichen. Auch unsere Koffer konnten länger in der Unterkunft bleiben, was super war. Alles zusammen können wir sagen es war perfekt und wir würden auf jeden Fall wieder dort schlafen !

Idalia’s place was beautiful! 10/10. It was right in the heart of the city center in an absolutely perfect location. She was very responsive and flexible with our check in time. When we come back to Lisbon we will definitely be staying here again!

This apartment is in the beating heart of Lisbon.  You couldn't ask for a better location or better hosts.  The apartment is showing its age a bit which is to be expected, and one of the 3 bedrooms has no window. It didn't worry us at all but there are 5 flights of stairs to climb.  It can be noisy until around 10pm but that is to be expected in such a central location.  Would I stay there again? Absolutely.
Amazing stay - only con is that it’s on the 5th floor and no elevator.

Superbe appartement avec une vue splendide. Emplacement idéal.
Très propre.

un superbe appartement au coeur de Lisbonne
très bien situé avec une belle vue sur l'ascenseur Santa juste et le château de St Georges.
à proximité de plusieurs points touristiques et pour le shooping.
l'appartement correspond aux images et au descriptif.
l'hôte a donné de bonnes instructions et réactive par message tout le long du séjour.
merci et recommande +++

Apparement très bien placé, conforme à la description et propre.
Propriétaire réactive et soucieuse du bien être de ses clients.

Endroit idéal pour visiter Lisbonne.
Grand appartement. Séjour parfait. Hôte très attentionnée à notre séjour
Appartement déconseillé pour les personnes à mobilité réduite

It was an amazing time and the house was perfect and very cozy.
Idalia was a great host.

The apartment is situated in the center of Lisbon which makes it easy to access different parts of the city, but also means it can be a little bit noisy and there are also a lot of tourists even outside of the summer months. If you have a car, the traffic in the center is bad.
The apartment was very spacious and well equipped. I stayed for a month and worked remotely from the apartment for a couple of weeks. The WiFi is slow so if you're planning on doing this, I would recommend buying a 30-day prepaid data SIM from the Vodafone shop downstairs and using that instead. Otherwise the apartment was clean and tidy and housekeeping once a week was also great!
The photos on Airbnb seem to be outdated. Some of the furniture is different / aged compared to the photos. The 5 floors of stairs can be quite tiring.
Overall though I'd definitely recommend this stay! Idália was a great host and very responsive and easy to communicate with! It was also great value for a 30 day stay in April!
muy bien ubicada, la zona es excelente y el departamento mejor que en las fotos

Die absolut charmante Wohnung liegt einfach sensationell im Herzen Lissabons. Die Gastgeber haben immer schnell reagiert und waren auch total hilfreich und entgegenkommend. Wir hoffen, dass wir bei unserem nächsten Aufenthalt in Lissabon wieder hier wohnen dürfen!
De host was steeds bereikbaar, en bood vrijwillig hulp aan! Onze bagage mocht langer in het appartement blijven, na het uitchecken. Heel centraal gelegen, aanrader!

un endroit super sympa 😀
tout est clair, avec le petit manuel explicatif .
Idalia et Hugo sont super disponibles.
Ils ont su nous aider avec nos valises pour pouvoir profiter à fond de la valise à notre arrivée et à notre retour.
Je recommande vraiment cet endroit.

Am absolutely lovely place, with lots of lights and nice decorations. Very clean, more than the usual amenities which made the stay feel very homely as we had everything we needed & more! Fantastic location, some good views from the windows and a very welcoming host.
The stairs up to the flat can be abit tough if your not great with stairs & sometimes on the weekend, the street can be abit loud if the windows open but that’s expected in most city centre apartments!
Overall, a fantastic stay in a fantastic city.
Great stay. Great hosts

This place is beyond my expectations. I knew it is an old house but I love the location. It's right next to Rossio plaza but still quiet at night. You can see the famous castle and lift from the window. Walk to most areas. The apartment is bigger than I thought with lots of details of comfortable living. Only thing is you need to climb lots of stairs.
Idália is the most kindly and helpful host I ever met before. It was a pleasure to stay at her apartment in the beautiful Lisbon. Thanks a lot!

This airbnb is situated in a great center location and right in many tourist spots that are only few steps away, lot of restaurants and shops. Rossio metro station just across the street. We are managed to use the metro from/to LIS airport with no issue. It fits comfortably for 5 of us. The house is clean and kitchen is well equipped, even has an espresso/coffee machine. Tap water in Portugal is drinkable. Idália is a great host. She responded to our questions promptly and provided us clear checkin/out instructions and direction to her airbnb. We have no problem to find it and checkin ourself.
However, this airbnb unit is located on 5th floor, and there is no elevator. So, expected to walk up those stairs to 5th floor. It’s no issue for us, as we all just have backpacks. Do heard that most apartments in the area has no elevator anyway. Just pack light. It has washer and dryer, so we were able to wash and dry our clothes. We will definitely stay here again with no doubt.
Can’t recommend enough! Amazing location and a great space
Great stay

Gostamos muito da estadia no apartamento de Idália. A localização era excelente. Estávamos em uma curta distância dos principais pontos turísticos da cidade, além de contar com mercado, padaria e restaurantes nas proximidades. O apartamento era bem equipado e com uma ótima vista da cidade. O único ponto negativo são as escadas, pois fica no quinto andar. Foi um pouco difícil subir e descer com as malas. Tirando essa questão das escadas, estava tudo perfeito e voltaria a me hospedar quando voltar a Lisboa. Tivemos bons momentos em família por aí e com certeza voltamos da viagem com ótimas recordações.

Muy bien ubicado. Piso amplio y cómodo. Tal y como se indica, 5o sin ascensor, no lo recomendaría para gente mayor y niños pequeños.
Limpio, pero sospechas con las fundas nórdicas pq habían sábanas debajo y a lo mejor solo cambian las sábanas y no las fundas. Edificio todo de aptos turísticos. Idália muy atenta en todo momento por Wapp. Muy detallista y valorable porque hay a disposición te, cafe, azúcar, sal, aceite, servilletas… Super centrico y a un paso de todo. Metro a 300 m.

We had a great stay - the apartment was just like the photos. It’s very central but because it’s on the top floor it feels very peaceful. No lift, but this is made clear in the posting and it didn’t bother us at all. The hosts were super friendly, responsive, and the communication was clear.
Great location, very clean apartment, the hosts are super awesome, responsive and care about your stay during the time of stay.

Large 3 bed flat, lots of room. Facilities are all good and everything is clean. Location is excellent just off of Rossio square, central for most things. The apartment is on the top floor so not suitable for anyone not fit enough to climb the stairs as there is no lift. The apartment is a bit damp and the bedding feels damp when getting into bed, the owners know this as there are dehumidifiers around the flat and and an electric one in the living room. There is a bit of a smell from the damp but not enough to put you off. In the warmer months this is possibly less of an issue but in February with the flat cold it made it more obvious. There was electric heaters that we used and this helped make it more comfortable. The host is very responsive and willing to help if you have any issues.

Très bon emplacement pour cet appartement plein de charme au cœur de Lisbonne.
Communication excellente avec de très bon conseils.

The apartment was very spacious, well presented and in a great location. Close to all the key areas of the city, the metro and loads of restaurants. Idalia and Hugo were great hosts, helpful and welcoming.
A great place for our visit.
Appartamento luminoso, ampio e fornitissimo. Consiglio vivamente!

O apartamento é bem perto do metro, por isso fica muito fácil de ir qualquer lugar, também tem muitas lojas , restaurantes ou atrações turísticas perto.      E a dona do apartamento é bem simpática e amigável. Excelente viagem!! Obrigada 😀

Idalia is an amazing host, she was very communicative, friendly and attentive to our needs. Apartment is fully equipped with all the essentials including kitchen and bathroom. Pretty spacious rooms and amazing views from the windows. Two bedrooms have windows, one doesn't. The apartment did have certain smell, especially in the living room. We kept the humidifier on and the air fresheners were working, we got used to it to some extent eventually. The location is perfect, very walkable and close to multiple attractions. Going to the 5th floor was a great daily cardio as well.
Good value, location is ideal.
Idalia va ser súper atenta i ens va facilitar tota la info que necessitavem

Our family had terrible experience staying here.
Right after we opened the apartment door, a strong animal (most likely the cat) urine smell made us take a step back. We kept our breath and went in, put our luggages down and opened all the windows then went out. A couple of hours later we came back and closed all the windows, the urine smell came back. While we were upset dealing with the smell, the outside noise (trash truck or some kind of street cleaning?) continued to midnight. We could not sleep at all, so we wrote a message to the owner: "The outside street is quite noisy until now, huge sound like washing trash cans… also the pet smell is so strong that my husband wears mask inside the house. We are quite suffering"
The next day, the owner said it was the smell of the refresher outside of the apartment. Later on, the owner said it was the humidity smell.
We are extremely disappointed with the owner and the apartment!
The appartement is ok but it smells a lot the cat and this is not nice.
Très belle appartement, même si monter 5 étage c’est long !

Idalia and Hugo are very nice, easy to talk to and gave us helpful recommendations. Check in is easy, and we love how cozy the place is. Great location too, bus station, metro, restaurants, supermarket are all nearby. We would definitely recommend Idalia’s place to everyone visiting Lisboa.

El apartamento está en una ubicación privilegiada y es muy acogedor, tiene todo lo necesario y el anfitrión tiene café de cortesía, me gusto mucho. Pero no lo recomiendo si viajan con muchas maletas porque está en un quinto piso y no hay ascensor. 100% recomendado si es un viaje ligero
Very good location, it’s quiet. However, the place smells a little bit of humidity and should consider it is on a 5th floor without an elevator.

An excellently located apartment to explore key sites in the heart if the historic city. Plenty of room and well appointed bedrooms, equipped kitchen and authentic features. Host was friendly, contactable and helpful throughout the stay and we were able to check in early and leave our luggage. A great city, a great apartment and s great host.

Pasamos un fin de semana pre navidad perfecto. La ubicación es ideal y la anfitriona fue encantadora.
El piso es amplio, cálido y muy hogareño.
Me sentí muy cómoda con las instalaciones y con el trato de la anfitriona que nos ayudó en todo y nos facilitó trámites durante la estancia.
Totalmente recomendable.
Great apartment, lots of room, nice view in a great city!
Hem estat molt bé i molt ben atesos per l'amfitriona de la casa. Gràcies Idalia!

We didn’t get to stay here, at all… as there was issue with the water pipe, which couldn’t be resolved immediately… so we had to immediately look for another apmt soon after checking in.
It’ll be nice if we had been informed earlier, rather than after lugging 4 luggages up 6 flights of stairs… 😅
Aside from this, I believe this would have been a great apmt to stay in.
Hopefully this issue is properly resolved for future guests.

Great and spacious apartment in a very central and beautiful location, including amazing views from the windows. Stylish interior and many amenities.  Idalia was a super helpful and kind host. We would love to come back.
Super séjour , emplacement juste au top ! Les 5 étages sans ascenseur valent le coup.

Idalia and Hugo were excellent hosts. They were incredibly proactive and helpful, giving many local suggestions for the best places to eat and the best things to do. The accommodation itself was great and spacious, and it is very centrally located in the heart of the city. If you are planning a short trip, this is the best area to stay in because everything is walking distance, and it's so close to the airport as well so very easy when starting or ending your trip. I would just like to highlight that it is on the 5th floor and with no lift so if you or your party member have mobility issues, this is something to consider. Otherwise it is a perfect accommodation ran by two amazing hosts and my trip to Lisbon was all the  better for it. Thank you Idalia and Hugo!
Departamento grande y bonito. Muy cerca de todo. Lo único malo es qué hay que subir y bajar muchas escaleras. Pero vale la pena!

Idália and Hugo were the most helpful people. Tips & tricks, storage of our luggage, help in general. Definitely recommend a stay at their place!
Very good apartment at a top location. Very close to some beautiful squares. Available by metro and other public transportation services.
Fantastic location, very spacious and great hosts
Great location right in the centre, clean and spacious flat and very helpful hosts.  Walking up the stairs to the top floor will keep you fit too!

Great central location. Very clean, with a large bathroom and with a very good shower! The kitchen was equipped with everything we needed.
Two of the bedrooms have views of the castle, and it is possible to see the Elevador de Santa Justa from the living room.
There was good communication from the host so we had all the information we needed for check-in before we arrived, and they also helped with arranging the transfer back to the airport.
The only drawback is that the apartment might not be suitable for the elderly as it is located on the 5th floor with no elevator.
Great flat in a central location; comfy beds, great communications, views, wifi, shower all good.
Great location! Host was super responsive and communicative. Big apartment that would be good for a group of people.

Great place to stay with friends. There were three of us and so the apartment was perfect for our needs. Clean and convenient with Idália and Hugo on hand for any questions and recommendations. Check in/out was really easy, huge thanks to our hosts!
It is worth noting that because the apartment is so central there is some evening noise from surrounding bars etc, no major issue for us however.
Great location. Everything we expected. Very good and helpful communication .
Wir haben uns sehr gut aufgehoben gefühlt. Tolle zentrale Wohnung. Vielen Dank
Great communication and the location is amazing! Property was spacious and clean

Tolle Wohnung mit Blick auf die Burg und andere Highlights in Lissabon. Der Triumphbogen ist ganz in der Nähe. Wir haben die Wohnung als Ruhepohl im Trubel von Lissabon empfunden. Anmerkung: Es sind 106 Stufen bis zur Wohnung. Gern kommen wir wieder.

We had a lovely stay at Idália and Hugo’s apartment. It was very clean and well equipped. Upon arrival, the information book provided was very useful. Both hosts were very good at communicating, even going as far as to message kindly saying “have a nice day” each morning, something we both haven’t experienced with a host before. It was a superb location, within 10 minute walking distance to all the main streets and the river. The apartment had amazing views of the Santa Justa lift and the castle also. For the price as well, we felt that the apartment went above and beyond! Thank you for a lovely stay, we highly recommend! Ella & Rob

Great place and GREAT location at the top of the Baixo. Very close to the Rossio train station if you are coming by train. This place was on the 5th floor with no elevator but had great views above the surrounding buildings to the Castle and Santa Justa Elevator. The apartment had everything we needed for a 3 night stay including a separate washer and dryer, and good set up for drying clothes. Would stay here again if we went to Lisboa.
A great central apartment with all the facilities required. The owner was very helpful.
We had an amazing stay, location was perfect and Idalia was so helpful. The rooms are a good size too, comfy beds, nice bathroom. Thank you

On the way back from Lisbon after staying in this great apartment. Clean, with plenty of space and in a really good central area. Hugo’s mum was very helpful with any queries and checking us in. After a long night of great food and drink the stairs were slightly challenging, but don’t let that put you off..
Andy

An absolute ideal property close everything you could need and want to see in Lisbon. Couldn’t have asked for better hosts as they provided so much information, checking we arrived okay, giving us tips for the city and were quick to respond to any questions we had. Would highly recommend here would definitely come again!

bien positionné, confortable, tout équipé
aurait besoin d’amour ( peinture et ameublement)
communication rapide , et appréciée.
outch 5 étages assurez d’avoir tout sinon vous devez remonter 😭
nous recommandons +++

Doskonała lokalizacja. Mieszkanie funkcjonalne, bardzo dobrze wyposażone, z pięknymi widokami. Jedynym minusem jest brak windy. Gospodyni, pani Idalia, była bardzo pomocna. Dopytywała czy czegoś nam potrzeba. Spełniła każdą naszą prośbę, łącznie z wezwaniem lekarza do naszej chorej córeczki. Polecam!

Emplacement ideal pour visiter et profiter du shooping a Lisbonne. Apparemment très fonctionnelle, avec une grande salle de bain. Je recommande sans esitez pour toute personne en bonne forme (5eme etages sans ascenseur).

Appartement très bien situé dans le centre de Lisbonne. Il faut garder un peu d'énergie pour monter les 5 étages en fin de journée 😀 Petit bémol, la chambre sans fenêtre devient vite chaude en cas de forte chaleur !

Great apartment in Central location,  literally right in the middle of Lisbon but quiet.  Comfy beds,  great a/c,  good Kitchen and fab views of the castle and lift. Its a long way up but that is what made it quiet and such good views.

Very good place! Close from all tourism attractions.
Apartement is good for 6 persons…. Hugo & Idalia are very nice and careful! Just one shade: 5th floor but this is clearly mentionned in the announcement!
Een mooi en ruim appartement in het midden van de stad. Goed bereikbaar met het openbaar vervoer. Het was erg netjes en goed onderhouden. Wij hebben hier ee geweldige tijd gehad.
We had a wonderful stay with our friends!

Can’t fault the stay. The apartment was very central, and just what we were looking for and the host was amazing. Very knowledgable, easy to communicate with, and very kind - really went the extra mile. Would definitely recommend
Everything was great and just as expected. Clean and organized, with a handbook explaining everything. The host was extremely helpful and kind. Great location, highly recommended!

This apartment was perfect for our stay in Lisbon. The location is ideal and the check in was simple. We had no issues while staying there and the communication with the host was brilliant. I would highly recommend this   apartment when visiting Lisbon.

Wir waren zu fünft für zwei Nächte in der Wohnung. Es war sauber und alles da, was wir brauchten. Die Lage ist sensationell und trotz der zentralen Lage ist die Wohnung ruhig und ein angenehmer Rückzugsort in der grossen Stadt. Die Kommunikation war intensiv und schnell, sie antworteten schnell auf unsere Fragen und waren sehr hilfsbereit. Wir kommen gerne wieder!
Très bien ! Situation idéale , très bien équipée

Beautiful appartment in the middle of Lisbon, with fabulous hosts. We felt wolcomed and got all the information we needed.
Great communication with the host!

Idalia is a fantastic host with big warmth and help to make my stay enjoyable and massive pleasure and would like to thank her for all the help. Also this is in a great location if you looking to do tourism :-)

I've stayed in this Airbnb for a week with two friends. The appartment is clean, spatious and at an ideal location in the middle of the city center! The stairs are a bit of a challenge with your suitcases but the view makes you forget this very quickly. Idália is a great host as she is very helpful to make sure your stay in the city is a pleasant one. She provided us with advice on where to go, but also for example with extra coffee when we ran out. I would definitely recommend this appartement!

Accueil et conseils parfaits avec Idelia qui nous a toujours répondu très gentiment et rapidement.
Logement conforme au descriptif, très propre, bonne literie. Il est très bien placé, en plein centre de Lisbonne à quelques minutes à pied de la station métro Rossio et de la gare Rossio. Idéal pour visiter Lisbonne et ses environs.
Je recommande.
Alles okay, manchmal laute Gäste in den anderen Wohnungen

Idália's apartment is in an a fantastic central location and is very clean. It has everything you need for your stay in Lisbon, including air conditioning which you'll need having climbed the 5 flights of stairs. Idália, was extremely helpful and had lots of good recommendations and suggestions.

Amazing apartment in the heart of everything you could ask for as a visitor to Lisbon.  The apartment was spotless clean, large, and very comfortable.  The hosts were by far the best communicators  I've ever dealt with in Airbnb and so accommodating.  Highly recommend and will stay here again.
Great location, right in the heart of the city. It was a nice apartment and host was very responsive. Would recommend
Idalia was great and always kept in touch with us through our stay. Very nice flat in a great central location. I’d recommend to anyone staying in Lisbon.
Great location, communication and checkin. A/C didn’t work but we just opened the windows and it was fine. Overall good experience for a great price!

Super appartement et super localisation ! This apartment is well located in the center of the city. By walk you can go almost everywhere (it is also near tramways and metro/subway). It's guite big with 3 real bedrooms and a big livingroom (the flat is on the 5th floor no elevator with a beautiful view on the castle and on the Santa Justa elevator). Idalia is very nice and take care of you. If you have any question, she can help you. If you hesistate to choose this apartement, don't ! You will feel home there.

Idalia er utrolig hjælpsom med hensyn til hjælp og serviceminded f.eks angående info om transport - muligheder i LIssabon.
Hun er let at komme i kontakt med - svarer hurtigt. Det har været en fornøjelse at bo i hendes lejlighed.
Fantastic location, cosy apartment with a helpful, communicative host. I would choose it again.
Top, bien situe, grand et bien equipe et l escalier permet d eliminer les repas copieux de Lisbonne ^^
Ottima posizione e bell’appartamento, ottimo prezzo…unica pecca 5 piano senza ascensore..

Die Unterkunft war wirklich toll. Sehr Sauber und mit allem was man braucht. Die Gastgeberin hat uns Tipps für die Umgebung gegeben und sich stetig nach uns erkundigt. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und es war alles perfekt.☺️🥹

L’appartement de idália est top. Emplacement idéal dans Lisbonne, l’appartement est très bien équipé.
Idália est adorable et nous à donné plein de très bon conseil.
Nous y retournerons sans hésiter
I loved this place.  Perfect location and the host was very communicative.  Easy to find.  The views are wonderful.  Would stay here again if I could.  Be ready to walk up steps.
Great location.
Apartment in excellent position and comfortable. It would be perfect with an elevator to approach the fifth floor and doing a little of restyling inside
appartement très bien situé au centre ville.
Apartment in a fantastic location for a weekend in Lisbon. As described and perfect for a group of six. Idalia was very easy and quick to communicate with too. Would recommend!
Idalia’s place was beautiful with amazing views from all windows in the apartment. Highly recommended for anyone who wants to be in the centre of the city with many things nearby!
Great location. Host very responsive and fast to respond. Clean. Everything as promised.

We had a really great stay at Idalia’s apartment! Centrally located, accessible to lots of bars and cafes, public transport links and touristic activities.
The apartment is authentic, well supplied and comfy. The stairs are a challenge so be prepared! It’s good exercise though!
I would thoroughly text staying at this apartment!

Idália's place is AMAZING! Perfect location in the heart of Lisbon: close to the metro, bars, restaurants, main train station, water, and anything else you could want to do/see in the city. The apartment is beautiful with great natural lighting and all of the amenities you need. We would definitely stay here again!
We had a fantastic stay here. Clean, quiet, spacious and the location couldn’t have been better. Wouldn’t hesitate to recommend to anyone staying in Lisbon!
Emplacement idéal ! Tout à portée de mains. Idalia est très agréable et disponible. L’appartement est spacieux, propre et bien garni! Super séjour.
Superbe localisation ! Appartement qui correspondait aux photos ! Très bonne communication avec Idalia.  Je vous recommande fortement son airbnb pour un séjour à Lisbonne !
Amazing location. Host was extremely communicative and helpful. Great value.
appartement très bien situé, Idalia est facilement et rapidement joignable par téléphone, très bon séjour dans cet appartement !

Appartement charmant quoiqu'un peu vieillot.
En revanche, idéalement situé et hôte très à l'écoute et fort sympathique.

The apartment was spacious, clean, confortable and well located. We have been continuously informed before our arrival and nicely welcomed by our host.
I recommend it!
位置优越，市中心，到达圣胡塔升降机和圣若热城堡步行可到达，周边有公交和电车站。购物和餐饮也很便利。房东很热情，为我们介绍里斯本特色的餐厅，地道的红白葡萄酒，以及到达各个景点的最佳路线，有求必应，还帮我们预定去机场的出租车。使我们在里斯本度过了完美的假期。唯一不足就是房间在5楼，没有电梯。如果下次再来里斯本还会选择Hugo家！

Hugo’s place is in the old part of town right in the heart of it all! Fantastic location and very clean. His sister answered our calls right away and met us at the apartment as soon as we arrived. In fact we arrived early before check in time, but she met us there so we could drop off our bags & leave them there until the place was cleaned.
The house is clean and modern. And they have a fantastic espresso machine.
Very nice apartment with perfect location in the centre of Lisbon. Perfect for friends and for family.
This flat is in the most amazing central location, close to shops, bars and restaurants!  It’s cosy, very well equipped and the communication with our hosts was just perfect!  Thank you

Très bon séjour dans un appartement bien agencé pour 6 adultes. Très bien situé pour tout visiter à pied ou en métro. Un accueil bien sympathique par Anabela qui parlait très bien le français et a ainsi pu nous donner quelques infos pour les restos et sites à visiter.
Merci à Hugo pour sa confiance, nous gardons cette adresse pour une prochaine visite de Lisbonne.

I had the best time in Lisbon, partially thanks to Hugo's place! It is in a great location, central to everything. The place is also very spacious with 3 wonderfully sized bedrooms and a large living room. It was just the two of us and we felt like we were in a castle. It can easily fit 3 couples. Also, the customer service was phenomenal. We had a small issue with the shower and Hugo sent someone immediately to fix it. The apartment is a 5th floor walkup, but it is absolutely worth it. I highly recommend staying here while in Lisbon!

Nous avons passé 4nuits dans ce joli appartement et nous en sommes ravis! Ce logement est très propre, fonctionnel, bien décoré, extrêmement bien situé... L'accueil a été parfait.
Nous y étions avec notre petite de 2 ans et malgré les travaux dans la rue, elle y a très bien dormi! Tout est prévu pour les petits (lit bébé, chaise haute, réducteur de WC...).
Sa localisation est parfaite pour arpenter la ville à pieds, y revenir très rapidement se reposer...
Bref, nous y avons passé un très bon séjour!

We had such a pleasure staying here. Hosts were very friendly, helpful and caring!  The apartment itself  had absolutely everything we needed and more. We couldn't find the better location! Absolutely perfect! We highly recommended this place and would always return! :)
Fantastic location, stylish apartment.  Always prompt with questions, you couldn’t go wrong staying at Hugo’s apartment.
Awesome apartment in GREAT location.
Todo genial con respecto al apartamento, la ubicación también. Nos encantó todo. Volveremos....

amazing place! perfect location to walk everywhere, great views from the flat, comfortable and had everything we need. Being 5/6 levels up, it was certainly tiring walking up the stairs with no lift, but for the quiet and views, worth it. The only negative thing I can say is that the description and photographs show a bath tub, but it has been replaced by a (great big) shower. This wasn't a problem for us, just worth knowing!
Hugo and his family were such warm hosts. The place had such thoughtful touches and was in a perfect location. We had a wonderful time in Lisbon!

Appartement 5*! Nous avons eu un magnifique appartement chez Hugo et Idalia! Idalia nous attendait a l’arrivee, elle a pris le temps de tout nous expliquer. Leur guide pour les explications de l’appartement et les suggestions d’activites et de resto etaient apprecies! Je voyage beaucoup en Airbnb et ce fut pour moi une de mes plus belles experiences! Beaucoup d’attentions! Ma blonde ne boit que du deca et ils ont pris la peine de lui en acheter. L’equipement est impressionnant et tres complet, il ne manque de rien. Il y a enormement d’espace et les pieces sont tres grandes! L’appartement est en effet au 5e et c’est epique a monter, mais pour ma prt nous avions 2 poussettes, 3 valises et 3 bagages a main et nous avons reussi :)! L’appartement est tellement bien que pour ma part, je vous dis, que ceci ne devrait pas vous empecher de louer. Le rapport qualite/prix est imbattable!

Amazing stylish apartment right in the centre of Lisbon, really easy to get to from the airport, and you are able to walk to many attractions. The stairs up to the top floor keep you fit, but the views from the windows are worth it. Appreciated the late check out, we were able to leave our bags there until we left for the airport.
L'appartement est vraiment très bien situé. Vous pouvez profiter du centre de Lagos et des plages à pied. Nous avons passé un super moment chez Hugo.
Hôte très disponible, accueil  chaleureux. Appartement très bien situé, conforme en tout point à la description. Recommande fortement le lieu.

Location, location, location! You really can not beat the location. Walking distance to train station and trolley. Enjoyed staying here with everything at hand. The killer was the 5 flights of stairs with baggage but we were told about that. Also FYI there is a peep show right next door which a little strange but you can just go the other way if you have kids! The hosts were very nice and answered all of my questions! Thank you for your patience in waiting for us to arrive and for a good first experience in Lisbon !!!!!
August 2018
Excellent apartment, well equipped and very well located for a city trip. I recommend !

Comfortable and spacious, in a brilliant central location.
The apartment is on the 5th floor and there's no lift so great for fit people!
Mooi verblijf in hartje Lissabon. Voldoet aan alle verwachtingen.

Een zeer gezellig appartement in het centrum van Lissabon. Een goede uitvalsbasis om de oude wojken te bezoeken. Dichtbij alle aansluitingen met meteo, tram en bus. Het appartement is wel 5 verdiepingen hoog (zondee lift), maar eens boven echt rustig met prachtig uitzicht op de stad.  Alles is aanwezig voor een comfortabel verblijf en ook erg proper.

Excellent location near everything. Easy to use public transportation and easy to walk around. There are good restaurants very nearby. The only draw back are the stairs, which Hugo mentioned. Be prepared for the climb, but it is good exercise !
Appartement très agréable et central, parfait pour visiter la ville

Ubicación inmejorable, muy luminosa , mejor que en las fotos, contacto rápido con los dueños y facilidad para el checkout y checking. Por poner un pero que no tiene ascensor pero ya lo sabíamos, para repetir
Great place to stay in the middle of the center!
Loved the place! The location was outstanding! The air conditioning in the apartment was fantastic!  Overall was VERY happy with the place😊

Enjoyed our stay. Location was a nice spot between several popular areas.
Pros: Nice views. Air conditioning. Washer AND dryer. Location. Large space.
Cons: 5th floor with no lift (difficult with luggage and tired legs). Peep show right next door.

Incredible location, comfy beds with clean linen, really effective air conditioning!! The hosts were very approachable and friendly, they allowed us to check in early too, which was very much appreciated.

We stayed at this lovely residence for our first four nights in Lisbon. Hugo was very responsive via Whatsapp throughout the entire booking. He has a very pleasant demeanor, and was super patience about going over the apartment amenities as well as spending extra time to suggest places on what to see and where to eat. The apartment is clean, airy and bright. It's a short trek up a narrow stairwell to the apartment. You can hear much of the street noise while in the apartment - but at night we closed the doors and left the AC running and it buffered the noise. Above all we felt safe staying here. The layout of the apartment is roomy and comfortable, and the beds were comfortable. The bathroom is the only tight spot in this apartment. The shower always provided enough hot water for three people but just a word of caution, the area is tiny and a bit tricky to step out of the shower.
This apartment is a great choice if you want to be in the middle of city center. We were able to walk everywhere with no trouble. We had such a wonderful time is Lisbon. Enjoy.
Apartamento lindo, limpo e bem no centro! Ao lado da rua Augusta! A única observação é que é no 5o andar de escadas... mas para nós não foi um problema! Hugo e Idalia mto simpáticos!
Appartement très bien placé en plein centre de Lisbonne ! Hugo & sa maman ont été très arrangeants & accueillants. Je recommande !

Hugo’s place was exactly as advertised: FANTASTIC! Great location, great space. Hugo and his team were in constant contact with me (no easy feat given I relied on free WiFI!). Hugo’s team even reserved an airport cab for us for our early flight.
I cannot recommend this place more!

A very comfortable apartment in a fantastic location really central. All the amenities you would need. Ida'lia ( Hugo's mum ) is a joy and very helpful lady and a lovely person. We were fortunate she was there to great us.
Go have a great time.

Thanks to Idália & Hugo for a fantastic visit to Lisbon and for their thoughtful touch. Apartment was perfectly located and comfortably fitted 5 people. Communication was great and check in/out was made easy. Would recommend and come back!
Lovely spacious property in a central location, close to public transport, shops and some great bars and restaurants. Perfect for our girls trip away.

Great location in downtown Lisbon. Walking distance to bars and restaurants. That being said it is very noisy at night. If you are not looking for the night scene it would not be a good fit for you. Located on the 5th floor without an elevator/lift.  Great view from the apartment. Host was very accommodating and responsive to any of our needs.
Great location!  The apartment had everything we needed; it was very cozy. We highly recommend this flat.

Apartamento com localização excelente pois é próximo às principais atrações como elevador santa justa, convento do Carmo, praça do comércio  e Castelo de São Jorge (Fomos para todas essas a pé). Próximo também existem diversas opções de restaurantes. Acho que o único problema é que está situado no 5 andar de um prédio sem elevador...

Le logement est idéalement situé et très bien équipé. Nous avons été reçu par une hôtesse tes accueillante et prête à rendre service.  Nous conseillons vivement cet appartement pour un séjour à Lisbonne.
Excellent space in a perfect location. Loved visiting Lisbon from here.

We thoroughly LOVED this flat!  It is in a spectacular location and the kitchen appliances are top quality!  We didn't mind the climb to the sixth floor - in fact I think this kept the street noise to a minimum. Also, the views from every window were spectacular!  We would definitely stay here again if/when in Lisbon.

Lovely apartment in the heart of Lisbon. Host went out of their way to make sure we had everything we needed from Nespresso capsules to advice on local spots to visit. Highly recommend staying here, especially for the view of King George’s Castle from the bedrooms.
A great spot. Super location and close to everything. Hosts were very helpful too. We are a family of 4 with 2 teenagers and we all enjoyed. Only issue was the 5 flights if stairs but not bad!
Excellent accueil et contact avec Idalia . Nous avons passé un très bon séjour . A refaire !

Appartement spacieux, très propre et très bien placé à proximité de tous les sites à visiter.
Adresse locale parfaite et vue de l’appartement incroyable !
Prendre son élan pour monter les 5 étages
Appartement bien placé, propre. La literie est très bonne.

Hugo's mother Idália checked us in, and what a treat that was. I've stayed in almost a dozen airbnb's, and never have had a more personable experience. From showing how things worked, to the detailed directions to wherever we wanted to go, and even checking in with us via text during our stay. That never happens. Now, onto the apartment- We loved it! It was very large with nice size bedrooms, comfortable beds, and a huge bathroom with a wonderful shower. And the views from all the windows - awesome! Especially at night! It was a bit cold during our visit, but the heat worked great and it was a nice quiet building. I have never seen an apartment so well stocked with amenities, and really appreciated that attention to detail, especially since we cook. We have two toddlers, and got around the city just fine with the ease of multiple options for transportation close by.  We just wish our trip was longer! Thank you so much Hugo and Idália, and especially for your hospitality Idália. It was such a pleasure. We hope to be back in September!

A perfect place to stay. The hospitality we received when staying in Hugo’s apartment was amazing. We were greeted by the very helpful cleaners who allowed us to drop our bags off prior to check in.
We were given useful tips for our stay and recommendations for cafes, restaurants, bars, views etc.
the apartment itself was spotless and had everything we needed for our stay. It is in a very central location, right next to Rossio station.
I highly recommend staying here and we hope to stay again soon!

Location location is the best way to describe the apartment.
Great to be able to wash our clothes in the included washing machine
Thanks Hugo the stay was one of the best on our trip.
Leanne and Ian
great location downtown    comfortable apt   loved it

Hugo’s place is a prime location for tourists. It is also very big and spacious. Everything we wanted to do was within a short walk. We also met Hugo’s lovely mother and Sandra. She was so warm and made us feel like the home was ours. We also got our daily exercise walking up the stairs. I highly recommend Hugo’s place.

Excellent! Incredibly well located, right in the heart of old Lisbon, close to anything you might need (just steps from the subway) and convenient for getting just about anywhere in Lisbon. The hosts (Hugo and his mother Idália) were a delight and gave us many thoughtful and interesting suggestions for our stay.
* As other reviews have noted, the flat is up 5 flights of stairs but your rewarded with memorable views of the city in all directions.
* We cooked most of our meals in since the kitchen was particularly well-appointed and Lisbon's markets provide a compelling set of opportunities.
* We stayed through part of the weekend (there are bars nearby) and so the flat was a bit noisy during the evening, but less so than other flats in the neighborhood likely would have been.
A hearty 5 stars!

Super séjour à Lisbonne dans l'appartement de Hugo. Appartement très bien équipé et extrêmement bien situé !!! La maman de Hugo qui s'occupe de la location est très sympathique, très réactive et serviable. Nous avons pu faire le check in en avance. Bref je recommande nous avons passé un superbe séjour.
Great time!  Awesome location lovely apartment  we would return !

L'appartement est situé en plein centre. La maman d'Hugo nous a conseillé un petit resto juste ne bas de l'immeuble qui était parfait pour une famille avec 2 petits enfants. Les photos de l'appartement sont légèrement sur faites par rapport à la réalité mais l'appartement reste très bien, très bonne literie et très bien situé. Bon rapport qualité / prix. Merci !
Lovely flat. Very central. On 5th floor with no elevator with very steep stairs so not for the faint hearted. Communiction was great
Great location, very clean and cosy. The communication and welcome was great. Would recommend to anyone.

We had wonderful stay at Hugo's apartment. It is more spacious than we aniticipated, with plenty of room for our adult family of four. It is clean and stylish and the views of the castle and the lift are amazing! The location is central for everything - we walked everywhere.
Unfortunately we only had 2 nights so we very much hope to return one day for a longer stay.

Wonderful airy and spacious accommodation on the fifth floor with everything you would need. The location near Rossio Square and the Baixa is great - a short walk from the riverfront, metro, trams and the Elevator!
The apartment was great, clean and exactly as described. Central location close to everything yet quiet during the night!

Appartement très bien situé
Proche de tout commerces, taxi, bus....
Les 5 étages deviennent compliquer après 5L de sangria mais le challenges en vaut le coup et ça permet d’éliminer un peu tout ce gras que l’ont peut manger à Lisbonne
L’appartement est très propre parfait pour 3 couples
C’était parfait
great hosts, great location!

写一条中文评价：整体特别棒，交通很方便，周围有火车站、公交站，还有很多购物的地方，地位位置我觉得很棒。
房东人挺好的，也比较好沟通～
房间在6楼，没有电梯。行李太重的话…会比较累～
楼下对面第二家餐馆不错可以去试试
楼下有一个脱衣舞show，男士可以看看，2欧
出门往前走有自由大道，买奢侈品的，往后走是商业街，有各种小牌子～
离海边很近，走路10分钟吧～
如果你是gay，可以去bar cru看看，或者trombate bath～ 体验一下当地的gay文化～
我们呆了4天～
总体来说特别好～

This place has a great location and access to all you need for subsistence living. Has an authentic feel for how Lisboans live, which can be a nice change from the sterile character of chain hotels. WiFi was good. Be prepared to walk up 6 levels of stairs, which tends to be tougher to do at the end of the day.
Good for budget minded folks who really just like a place to sleep that has views before going to bed.

Super centrally located apartment in the heart of Rosario. Pack lightly as the apartment is on the 5th floor with no elevator. Easily sleeps 6 people. Kitchen is nicely equipped and also works for a longer stay. We would come again.

My friends and I had a lovely time here. The apartment itself was absolutely perfect with all of the needed facilities, a mini balcony, gorgeous views from the rooms and in a perfect location! Highly recommended! Muito obrigado!
Great stay! Convenient location. Lovely views.
Hugo's place is lovely, gorgeous views and immaculately clean.  Fantastic location for exploring old town of Lisbon.

Logement parfaitement fonctionnel conforme à la description sauf le bain à remous.
Attention au 5 étages rudes en fin de journée....;-)

We stayed at Hugo's place and it was a gala time we spent there. We don't have anything of meaning to grumble about. The apartment had 3 rooms and had ample space to accommodate even 6 people. The apartment is located in a very communal area with all businesses catering to basic amenities in the near neighborhood. WiFi was a high speed one and AC was decent. I thank Hugo, Ms.Idalia and Gustav for the apartment.
Best regards,
I stayed in Hugo's apartment during the summer holidays with other friends. The apartment is beautiful and located in the city center, near Bairro Alto and Praça do Comércio. I really reccomend it.
Fantastic views of beautiful Lisbon - well decorated, clean and a fantastic host - could not ask for a better location- in the heart if the city... even enjoyed the walk up ... Absolutely recommend

Nous avons passé un magnifique séjour dans cet appartement. Idéalement placé (collé à la place Rossio) mais malgré tout très calme.
Tout équipé (jusqu'à la fourniture des capsules Nespresso !!!), hyper charmant et authentique.
Mention spéciale pour l'accueil d'Idalia d'une gentillesse rare.

Beautiful, clean house. Very central and with easy access to metro. Lovely views from my bedroom of the castle. Hugo and his mother were great, lots of communication.
