Idália talked us through all the great things we could do in Lisbon and gave us some good recommendations. Couldn't rate this place highly enough.

Let me start with the plus sides: great central location right at the main square (Rossi Square), yet reasonably quiet at night; well equipped apartment with lots of supplies in the bathroom and kitchen; fair price.
On the downside: mold in the apartment due to airflow problems, 106 steps up (truly for the sporty people, and try that with a suitcase -quite the workout), three small bedrooms - one without windows.
We did value also the air conditioning in the living room and in the hallway (none in the bedrooms, you need to leave the doors open to benefit from the hallway A/C). Also, be aware that one the two floors below you is a hostel, and next door a peep show (didn't know they still existed!).
Nice spacious apartment in the middle of the center. Nearly everything in walking distance.

This apartment is located in a perfect location.... the apartment has some lovely views of the Castle. Very clean and has everything you need.
Gustava, Hugo's brother was there to meet us at the apartment and offers some great tips on where to go..
We would definitely return to this apartment!

This apartment will not disappoint. It is very centrally located and steps from Rossio and Rua Augusta. The rooms are very bright and spacious and the sheets and beds were clean and extra comfortable. It was lovely to wake up to the castle view from our bedroom. Our hosts were very attentive and had lots of suggestions and information that made our stay perfect. My sister enjoyed the free espresso machine very much. We have been to Lisbon many times before and this time will stand out as a great memory.
There are a great number of stairs to walk up to get to the apartment. It was fine for us as we are young - but getting the luggage up was definitely a workout.

Good value for the location and quality of the apartment, with a couple of things to keep an eye out for - 1) there is no lift and the apartment is on the 5th floor, so if you have big bags, it might be a bit of an issue 2) Shower curtain makes it slightly cumbersome to take a shower due to its shape, but we got used to it perfectly well. Overall, great place to stay and would come back again! The hosts are very nice and I can see why they have such amazing reviews!

Ótimo apartamento e localização. Fomos muito bem recebido. O apartamento tinha tudo que precisamos e estava impecável. Adoramos nossa estadia e com certeza é o nosso apartamento para uma possível volta à Lisboa.

Nous avons passé un agréable séjour.
Très bien situé.

Die Wohnung liegt für eine Großstadt relativ ruhig im 5. Stock, allerdings ohne Lift. Die zentrale Lage ermöglicht eine optimale fußläufige Erkundung vieler Plätze und liegt ebenso günstig zu öffenlichen Verkehrsmitteln sowie zu vielen Restaurants und Cafes. Sehr netter Empfang und optmale Organisation der Wohnungsübergabe bei der Ankunft.

The location is really perfect.
Large apartment, 3 bedrooms, huge shower room, living room and large kitchen with everything needed + espresso machine.
The beds are really comfortable and pleasant.
Disadvantage - the apartment on the 5th floor without an elevator, so if you have no problem "climb" it is awesome :)

Superbe appartement, spacieux, et propre. La localisation est central et permet de faire le tour de Lisbonne rapidement ! Hugo et Idalia sont réactifs et nous accueillent avec sourire et conseils ! Un super séjour !

Really beautiful flat in a very nice  location, apartment as described, with great views and had in everything we needed. The place is big enough for 5 people, even 6. Yes it is located on the 5th floor and the stairs are a bit of a pain, but it's really worth the view on the castle and the Old elevator. Hugo and his mum were very helpful and really easy to communicate with. Lisbon is a beautiful place and as my friends said the flat was the cherry on top of the cake! Thanks for a great stay and would definitely come back.

This place is great! I stayed at Hugo's for two nights with 3 adults and a one year old baby. His apartment was clean and well decorated and close to everything. I would definitely recommend to anyone visiting Lisbon.

We loved the location, the home and the views were great.  We could see the castle out one side and Lisbon's famous elevator out the living room window. The home was spacious and felt like home away from home. Hugo's mother Idalia was so kind and helpful.  Both Hugo and Idalia were also great communicators.  The location could not have been better, we were perfectly situated in the middle of everything, yet nestled down a quiet road so when it was time to sleep, you would not have know that you were in the city! We would HIGHLY recommend and would return!
Все было здорово! Спасибо за уют 😀

Communication with Hugo was easy and directions to get to the apparment where practical. Appartment is very centrally located, close to the metro station making it an easy start for exploring the city by public transport and /or walking.
The appartment is very well equipped and has everything you need. Nice views on some of the Lisbon highlights as the appartment is on the topfloor. The stairs to get there are good excercise

We had an amazing weekend in Lisbonne at Hugo's apartment. The place is really spacious, perfectly cleaned, with stunning views. Ideally located, it is easy to visit the city and it is closed to everything. Hugo is answering very fast to all your questions and it is easy to communicate with him. We were able to check-in before the indicated time and his mom gave us good advice. I highly recoomend to stay at Hugo's apartment !

Appartement idéalement situé en plein centre de Lisbonne. Les 5 étages à monter mettent dans l'ambiance dès l'arrivée!
L'accueil par la maman d'Hugo a été très chaleureux. On a même eu droit à un petit cours sur l'histoire du pays ! Merci!
L'équipement du logement correspond au descriptif et sa taille permet à une groupe de 5 adultes d'être à l'aise.

The flat couldn't be in a better location, and had lovely views.  It was really clean and comfortable, especially the beds.  There are many stairs, but we got used to them quite quickly. Hugo and his Mother were really lovely, kind, accommodating and flexible.  We had a wonderful weekend.

You can't beat the views from this apartment. The hike up the stairs with luggage prepares you for walking in Lisbon, but it's worth the effort. We slept comfortably in this apartment which had all the conveniences of home. It's quiet considering the central location. We would absolutely stay here again!

Unbeatable location and the apartment was exactly as described, with all amenities, including a washer/dryer, which was very useful to us. Hugo was very responsive from booking confirmation to directions, with all information ready, and his mother, who checked us in, was sweet and extremely helpful in making sure we were all set. Enjoyed our stay with a great host.

Logement situé en centre ville et à proximité des transports l'idéal.
Sinon un superbe appartement.
Accueil et service parfait. Appartement idéalement situé, pour les transports, les courses, les visites, les restos....
Ubicación muy céntrica y próxima a los principales puntos de interés de la ciudad histórica. El apartamento acogedor y muy bien equipado. La única pega es que no tiene ascensor.
This was a great location for going out during the day and a perfect place to rest our head at night! Would definitely stay here again!
TRES BON EMPLACEMENT MAIS 5 ETAGES SANS ASCENSEUR DUR DUR MAIS POUR LES JEUNES SUPER
Perfect! We had a very relaxing time in the apartment

Superbe appartement, idéalement situé. Proche des transports en commun, des boutiques, à quelques pas de la vie nocturne.
Très bon accueil par la maman de Hugo qui nous a bien conseillé à notre arrivée!

O apartamento é completamente equipado e possui todos os materiais que necessitamos.
Os anfitriões são maravilhosos e nos receberam muito bem. Adoramos tudo e esperamos retornar em breve.
The location is perfect, the appartment itself well equipped  and cosy. Lots of stairs in Lissabon, so we could manage another 9 at the end of the day!

Appartement très bien situé : 2' du métro et de la place Rossio, proche de tout. On s'y sent comme chez nous avec une vue imprenable sur le château et l'elevador Santa Justa.
Nous avons été accueillies par sa très agréable maman qui parle très bien français. Elle nous a donné des tas de p'tits conseils.
Très bon séjour.
Hugo's mom met us at check-in and was super helpful when showing us around the apartment and getting around the city. The apartment was great location and we could walk to all the touristy sites!

Le logement est spacieux et propre. Il convient bien à 6 personnes que ce soit une famille ou un groupe d'amis. Il est extrêmement bien situé dans Baixa ce qui permet de se promener à pied ou bien de prendre les transports en commun.

Tout le confort nécessaire et des lits très confortable.
Une situation géographique excellente et des hôtes très sympathique.
Une vue depuis les fenêtres incroyable.

O apartamento é muito bem localizado (próximo ao Rossio, ao Chiado e ao Terreiro do Paço...), perto da estação de metrô e de ônibus, bem equipado e apresenta uma bela vista da cidade. O único inconveniente é que ele se localiza no quinto andar e o edifício não possui elevador.
Myself and my friends had a great stay  in Hugo's apartment, clean and so central - perfect base for a trip to Lisbon!

This apartment is located very center of Lisbon city's heart, Rossio plaza so it was so convenient to go around the city. There are big supermarket 'Pingo' and metro stations nearby and the warm welcome from the host (Hugo's mom for my case) and good information was a plus.
Thank you Hugo, your apartment is perfect to visit the beautiful city of Lisbon. It has a really good location and the flat is big and clean. We had a really good time.
C'est une bonne option pour le prix qu'il a.

Very friendly
Apartment very well located
Owners available
Good value for money
To recommend

Esperienza ampiamente positiva. L'ubicazione dell'alloggio è davvero perfetta, centralissima e a 2 passi da tutto. Hugo e la madre si sono dimostrati molto disponibili ed educati. Inoltre l'appartamento era pulito e compreso di tutto.

Non consiglierei questo appartamento solo a persone anziane o a famiglie con bambini piccoli in quanto ci sono da fare 5 piani di scale a piedi (il palazzo è senza ascensore). Per tutte le altre persone CONSIGLIATISSIMO!

Ótima recepção, apto incrivel com tudo que é necessário,  ótima localização é possivel conhecer a cidade caminhando, flexibilidade com horarios de check in e check out, fácil comunicação e auxílio de transporte para o aeroporto, perfeito!
Very comfortable and the best location.We are very much pleased with the apartment.

Accueil à l'arrivée très chaleureux et plein de bons conseils. Appartement très spacieux, calme, très bien situé en centre ville à proximité de tout ! Literie excellente. Bref rien à redire, on a adoré !

Hugo et sa mère nous ont attendu plusieurs heures à l'appartement malgré notre retard..sans rien dire
Puis ils nous ont donné de bon conseils.
Appartement propre, fidèle au descriptif.

trés bon accueil , très arrangeant et disponible ; tout le nécessaire tant pour la cuisine que les chambres et salle de bains
appartement trés bien situé pour visiter Lisbonne à pied ou en transport en commun
Hugo s'est soucié de notre confort
Le seul point sensible est le bruit dans la rue si on est présent lors d'un week end mais cela n'empêche pas d'apprécier le lieu et l'appartement
Great place in the centre. Hugo's mother did welcome us and gave us some usefull tips. Nice and clean appartement. Hugo communicates very well and offers other services as well.

Appartement bien situé spacieux et très propre cuisine bien équipée . La maman d'Hugo nous a bien reçu (désolé pour notre retard) et donner toute s les astuces et commodités pour notre séjour à Lisbonne . Nous la remercions

super séjour.L' appartement est super bien situé et très bien desservi. On en oublie presque les 5 étages. L équipement de l appartement est très bien pensé. Hugo et son amie toujours à disposition si besoin d infos. une adresse à recommander !

We had a great time in Hugos appartment! We were two couples and stayed for a week. The location is perfect and the appartment is charming. You will find everything you need, it is very clean and you'll have a lot of space! His mother and a friend were very welcoming and recommened us a lot oft things to do.
We can definitely recommend Hugo's appartment!

Appartement très bien situé, très agréable, lits confortables et bien agencé.
Malgré les 5 étages sans ascenseur, je conseille vivement cette appartement!!!

Super Unterkunft, sehr zentral gelegen, Gastgeber sind sehr nett, Die Wohnung ist perfekt für 4 Personen, wir hatten viel Platz und es war alles sehr sauber. Einziges Manko - der Aufstieg in den fünften Stock war schon sehr beschwerlich (Vorallem mit Gepäck)

très bel accueil de la part d 'Hugo avec un maximum d'indications sur toutes les activités offertes par la ville, aussi bien touristiques, commerciales que pratiques. Hugo est un hôte très attentionné qui a su répondre rapidement à nos nombreuses questions. L'appartement était parfait pour 6 personnes. Il est idéalement placé au coeur de la ville et très pratique pour accéder à beaucoup de centres d'intérêt

Great host, great location, great apartment.

Highly recommended. Hugo made us feel very welcome.
Fantastic apartment to stay for my family of 6 people!

I felt very welcomed in Hugo's home.  His mother greeted my friend and I upon arrival.  She was lovely and very interested in ensuring we were comfortable.  The apartment is in a great location and very clean.  I would recommend to others.  Thank you.

Super séjour chez Hugo ! Merci a Vanessa pour son accueil tardif. Les photos correspondent bien aux lieux et l'appartement est très bien placé. Malheureusement une chambre était condamnée ce qui fait qu'une amie à du dormir sur un matelas pneumatique peu confortable. Elle a fini son séjour sur le canapé. Heureusement que nous n'étions pas 6... Je conseille tout de même ce bel appartement qui sans ce bémol aurait été parfait :-)
The apartment was an excellent location to explore Lisbon - close and central to everything! The 5 long flights of stairs were a good way to burn off all the pastels we ate.
una buona accoglienza cordiale disponibile, appartamento molto grande e ben fornito, buon collocamento in città, centrale e con servizi pubblici vicini. ottima esperienza

Nous avons passé un séjour super dans l'appartement d'Hugo. Tout était parfait : l'accueil par la maman de Hugo qui nous attendait et qui nous a fait visiter l'appartement. Nous avons également eu les informations nécessaires aux déplacements alentours.
L'appartement était tout à fait conforme aux photos : propres, lumineux, et très bien équipé. Tout y était, jusqu'au gel douche !
Nous recommandons vivement cet appartement idéalement placé au cœur de la ville. Merci à Hugo et à sa maman !

Hugo's mom met us at the apartment when we arrived. Although we arrived earlier than the check in time, they were really accommodating in letting us in. Hugo's mom Idalia was lovely, helpful and welcoming. This lovely clean apartment was in a great location. This help us tremendously since we have only 2 days to explore Lisboa as it was close to all the major attractions
Appartement très agréable, calme, situé au centre de Lisbonne, avec climatisation (très agréable au mois d'août).

Nous avons été très bien reçu par Idalia, la maman de Hugo. Elle nous a bien informé sur Lisbonne.
L'appartement est bien situé, au centre près d'une station de métro et des bus.Il est très bien équipé et propre. Nous le recommandons sans hésiter.
Bon emplacement pour ce logement au 5e sans ascenceur. Propre, climatisé, calme. Plein centre-ville.
Great location for this apartment for our 3 day stay in Lisbon.

Hugo's mum met us at the apartment when we arrived, we where a bit early to check in but was able to leave our luggage in the apartment. Hugo's mum was lovely and very helpful and welcoming.
The apartment was great, very comfortable and clean and had all the necessary amenities (toilet paper, soaps, fresh towels, kitchenware) and even a coffee machine (which is a plus for coffee drinkers)!! Supermarket near by so great for us to pick up food and drinks. Location is great, right in the heart of Lisbon next to Rossio station.
Would definitely stay again if I ever travel to Lisbon again.

Lovely clean apartment in a great location. We only had 2 nights to see as much as possible and could easily get around. We were met by Hugo's Mother who was very friendly and helpful and guided us in the right direction. Only possible drawback for others is that this apartment is on the 5th floor with no lift (steep stairs), but it wasn't an issue with hand luggage. I'd highly recommend this apartment to others!

The apartment was great! Great location, very clean and equipped with everything you need. We havent met Hugo in person, but his mother was lovely and took her time to explain everything to us and answer our questions. We can definitely highly recommend this apartment!

What a wonderful apartment in a perfect location in the center of action in Lisbon.  Hugo was very responsive and flexible with our arrival time and even booked a taxi for our return trip to the airport.  The apartment was very spacious and well laid out, but it was quite a hike to the fifth floor in a very muggy stairwell.
Situé idéalement au coeur du Lisbonne historique dans une rue calme, l'appartement est bien agencé. Hugo nous a fourni tous les conseils nécessaires à la réussite de notre séjour.

The moment we arrived we were warmly welcomed by his mother who is adorable. The apartment is very comfortable with everything you need and decorated nicely too. Fantastic communication with Hugo too which made arriving and sightseeing in Lisbon a breeze.

Nous avons été chaleureusement accueilli par la mère d'Hugo.
La communication était très facile. Nous nous sommes sentis chez nous.
L'appartement est spacieux, idéalement situé. Très propre et calme.
Je reviendrai avec plaisir

We had a great stay at Hugo's apartment. His mum was really sweet and gave us a very warm welcome. The apartment is very nice and very well located, in the heart of downtown. Only downside: there is no lift in the building, and the 5 floors can be exhausting with suitcases or grocery bags.
The apartment was great. Hugo's mother was very charming and made us feel welcome. The AirBnB is big, clean and has wonderful views (castle, elevator)! Very good location too! In one word: awesome!

It was a great experience staying at Hugo's apartment. The location cannot be better as it is right on the city centre's Rossio square.

Hugo was traveling during our stay, but his mother has kindly received us and provided with clear and useful tips, helping us to find the right direction with shortcuts.

The place is clean, spacey, bright. Right on the top floor in the middle of Lisbon's centre with a good view to the beautiful roofs nearby and the castle.

Staying with 6 people we feel quite happy with all the facilities and equipments. Hugo and his mother are kind enough to offer many tea and coffee and use of their kitchen supply.

We highly recommend staying here!

We stayed 3 nights in Hugo's apartment and enjoyed it fully. Hugo's mother and brother welcomed us. They were very nice and gave good tips on what to see and do.

The apartment is very nice and has beautiful views over Lisbon. The location is great! Almost everything is within a walking distance. The only people I wouldn't recommend Hugo's place to would be those having difficulty climbing stairs. The place is on the 5th floor and doesn't have an elevator.

Unser Gastgeber hat dafür gesorgt, dass wir (5 Leute) uns sehr wohl fühlten. Er und seine Mutter sprechen Englisch, was die Kommunikation sehr angenehm machte. Wir wurden herzlich und freundlich begrüßt. Die Erreichbarkeit war immer sehr gut.

Die Beschreibung der Wohnung im Internet stimmt.
Die Ferienwohnung hat uns sehr gefallen. Sie bot alles, was ein Urlauber braucht, um sich wohl zu fühlen: Sehr gute Ausstattung, großzügige Räume, bequeme Betten, großes Bad. Die Lage der Wohnung hat uns begeistert:sie lieg im Zentrum in der Nähe von Restaurants, Supermärkten, Sehenswürdigkeiten. Die Wohnung ist sehr sauber.
我们在这里居住了三天。第一天因为飞机到达时间很早，Hugo提出可以让我们把行李放在公寓里。接待我们的是他的母亲，是一个非常可爱好客的女士。我们都非常喜欢她。公寓非常整洁干净，设施齐全。房间布置非常有特色，卫生间也非常大。这间公寓让我们非常的惊喜。

Hugo's apartment is located exactly in the middle of the Lisbon, where all the sightseeing spots are within walkable distance.

We had very comfortable time as the apartment is spacious, clean, air-conditioned. The bed was prepared as if it were a hotel.

Hugo's brother and mother picked us up and took care of the keys. Both of them are pretty nice. Especially, Hugo's mother is a very charming lady.

I think the apartment is perfect for the young people as there is no elevator at the apartment( I can imagine that my parents at the age of 60 years old cannot make it :) )

Overall, we enjoyed our stay in Lisbon and we would like to appreciate family Hugo for letting us stay at the wonderful aparmement.

Hugo was very kind even though we didn't got to see him. He made sure everything was okay for us and his brother who welcomed us at the apartment told us pretty much everything about Lisbon, what to do, where to go, things to avoid, transportation, monuments...
The apartment is just awesome, it is clean, the air conditioning works perfectly and it's location in the city is also very good. And also the view we have is beautiful. I would definitely recommend it if you want to stay few days in Lisbon with some friends.

Das Appartement ist sehr zentral mit schönem Ausblick über die Dächer der Stadt gelegen (man darf dafür 108 Stufen in den 5. Stock zu Fuß erklimmen und trainiert kostenlos die Beinmuskulatur). Es war sehr sauber und entsprach den Eindrücken der Präsentation des Gastgebers. Die Kommunikation mit dem  Gastgeber klappte gut und er war in einigen Dingen sehr entgegenkommend. Die Ausstattung ist komfortabel, so dass kleinere Mängel nicht gravierend waren. Die Größe des Badezimmers kommt auch einer ganzen Gruppe  problemlos entgegen. Einer der 3 Schlafräume mit Doppelbett hat kein Fenster.

Hugo was a wonderful host and this apartment could not have a better location, right in the center of the city. Plenty of room for our group of five and he was always available for any questions. Highly recommend!

Superbe appartement, décoré avec beaucoup de goût, idéalement placé et pourtant très calme. Hugo et sa mère ont été très chaleureux et accueillants, nous ont donné pleins de bons conseils et adresses pour notre weekend à Lisbonne. Je recommande +++

Apartment was in a great location, and well equipped. It was perfect for our family of 5. Hugo was extremely helpful, providing a thorough travelers guide with restaurant and site recommendations, and helping with transportation directions as well.

I can definitely recommend this place. It was one of the best equipped apartments I've ever been. The kitchen has everything you'll need. The place is in the centre of Lisbon and a lot of things are in walking distance. I really enjoyed the time there with my friends and if I'm coming back to Lisbon I'll try to stay at Hugo's place again. Thank you!

La casa es preciosa, goza de una ubicación excelente, es muy amplia y bastante cómoda en general. Baño y cocina enormes, camas muy cómodas. Las vistas desde las ventanas son impresionantes. Muy recomendable.
Hay que tener en cuenta que está en un quinto piso sin ascensor en un edificio antiguo. La subida es bastante penosa especialmente cuando llevas maletas o niños pequeños. Recomiendo llevar el equipaje en mochila a la espalda.
En cuanto a las cosas que no nos gustaron: Resultó muy complicado mantener una comunicación fluida con Hugo. No respondió a nuestros mensajes en los días previos a nuestra llegada, hasta que le llamé por teléfono un día antes de viajar. Pareció fastidiado y pidió que las comunicaciones fueran a través de Airbnb. Volví a llamarlo el día de nuestra llegada porque no había nadie esperando en el piso nuestra llegada. Al poco rato apareció su madre, un encanto de mujer y nos hizo una de las más cálidas bienvenidas que hemos tenido en una casa.
Posteriormente, avisé a Hugo de que mi hija de tres años había tenido un accidente en la casa y habíamos tenido que ir apresuradamente al Hospital para las curas. Hasta la fecha no se ha interesado por su estado (está bien, con una bonita cicatriz de recuerdo). Debido al imprevisto del accidente, ocurrido en la mañana en la que abandonábamos Lisboa, y con las prisas y los nervios, dejamos atrás casi todo nuestro calzado y se lo comentamos en un mensaje para ver si lo podía comprobar y si era posible que nos los enviara. Tampoco contestó.
En la casa faltaba una secadora que estaba recogida como parte del equipamiento disponible. Eso fue un gran trastorno, puesto que nuestra visita coincidió con lluvias intensas. La limpieza no es la mejor, mucha pelusa acumulada en los calcetines con sólo dar un paseo por la casa. Había goteras en el salón.
En definitiva, gran casa, gran ubicación, pero cierta dejadez. Una pena.

Het adres is even zoeken, omdat je niet verwacht dat het direct het eerste huis is vanaf het plein. Verder is het een perfecte locatie! Werkelijk waar. In het midden van de stad, alles op loopafstand. Goeie kamers, goeie keuken, goeie bedden, supermarkt in de buurt, restaurants waar je over struikelt. Gewoon perfect!

Superbe logement en plein cœur de Lisbonne. A recommander!
L'appartement est très calme, très bien situé et très agréable. La vue est un plus qui s'ajoute au charme de l'appartement. Nous avons reçu un accueil très chaleureux et sommes très heureux d'avoir séjourné dans ce bel appartement.
Merci à Hugo et Idalia
Obrigada !

The flat was perfect in every way.  Great location just steps from Rossio Square.  Minutes away from the train station.  Flat was well equipped with everything you could need and even items you didn't think about.  Unit is on the 5th floor so prepare for a bit of a hike to get up there but worth every step, the views are amazing.  Unit is very large and extremely clean.  Beds are in good shape.  A note for parents..... the building is next door to an Adult peep show.  Was not a problem in any way but be prepared to answer some questions from your children.
Vänligt och personligt bemötande.  Lägenheten överträffade våra förväntningar,  fräsch och välutrustad. Kan verkligen rekommenderas!

Hugo's place is perfect for any tourist. Its amazing location means its smacked in the heart of city center. Taking hop-on bus tours is just a stone throw away. We didnt get to meet Hugo, but we did meet his mom. She was one of the warmest and sweetest person we have ever came across. The apartment is clean with fresh sheets and towels. Everything there is more than enough to accommodate those who choose this place. And did I mention the nice gesture of red wine that Hugo gave us? ;-)

L'accueil de la mère de Hugo était parfait : tour rapide de l'appartement et conseils divers. L'appartement était exactement comme sur les photos, belles vues, très lumineux, très propre !
L'emplacement au centre de Lisbonne est idéal pour visiter la ville et sortir le soir. A recommander !

L’appartement de Hugo est idéalement situé à 2 mn à pied du métro et à proximité à pied de plusieurs sites touristiques,  commerces et restaurants. Il est très bien équipé, calme et offre de belles vues sur la ville. Je recommande cet appartement dans lequel nous avons été accueillis chaleureusement malgré notre heure tardive d’arrivée.

Mooi appartement en fantastisch centraal gelegen. We zochten een appartement voor 3 stellen, dus we waren erg blij dat we 3 2persoonsbedden hebben kunnen vinden! Alle voorzieningen zijn aanwezig!
Enige 'nadeel' is dat je 5 verdiepingen naar boven moet lopen.

Highly recommended! Very cozy, clean and nice decorated apartment, location is perfect! It was great to have a coffee machine and a wash machine. Hugo and his mother are very friendly and caring hosts. They were in contact to provide any help we needed. My friend forgot his computer mouse when we were leaving. And Hugo's mother found time to meet with us and give it back. We are very grateful! Thank you, Hugo and Idalia!

Great stay at Hugo's apartment! His mother very kindly collected us from the airport when we arrived. Perfect location - central and walking distance to most sights, plus beautiful views from the place.
Hugo was helpful throughout our stay, and kept in touch.
Nice spacious apartment, particularly living area. The only issue was with the shower - the top part holding up the curtain was rather low, and my tall friend couldn't fit under it to shower. Otherwise a great stay, thanks!

This apartment was perfectly true to it's description and photos.
Hugo couldn't meet us when we arrived but his mother was there and spent at least 15 minutes with us. She gave us tips about the apartment for the kitchen appliances and bathroom. Then she gave us excellent recommendations for restaurants and "must visit" sites as well as a great route to Sintra.
A previous guest had had a problem with the shower curtain but Hugo was very prompt with fixing it our first day and then he too spent some time with us giving info about the city and Portugal.
This apartment was great for 6 people, very nice living space and beautiful kitchen. We were also very close to everything in downtown, historic Lisbon. Right next to shops, restaurants, squares, and stations.
While the apartment is on the 5th floor it's nothing that we couldn't handle and being so high kept the noise level to a minimum.

Overall we were immensely happy with our stay and will be back again if ever in Lisbon!!

Once you get passed the stairs, this place is absolutely great. Hugo was a great host and even though we did not meet him, his mother was such a nice and welcoming lady who showed us the place and gave us some great information regarding the city.

The apartment had everything you need in a home and more. Clean, convenient, very central and the views were amazing.

Really loved it.

Thank you.

Hugo's apartment was exactly as described and pictured.  Although we had a somewhat  late arrival time (8:00pm) Hugo's mom met us at the apartment.  She spoke English very well and was extremely friendly & helpful.   Hugo provides a very helpful document describing how everything works and also includes many suggestions for things to do. The kitchen has everything you will need including washer and dryer.  Hugo also supplied an ample supply of espresso coffee pods for the coffee machine.  This was a very comfortable place with 3 separate bedrooms which was very comfortable for our 5 adults.  The apartment was very close to all the central attractions of Lisbon - short walks to Santa Justa Lift, Sao Jorge Castle, Rossio Square, metro stops, and the Rua Agusta 'promenade' of shops and restaurants.  A five minute walk down Rua Agusta to the river and some beautiful views. The only 'downside' to this listing is the lack of an elevator - which made carrying luggage up the 106 steps a bit tiring.

On arrival at the flat we were let in by Hugo's mum and she was very helpful and friendly. The flat was exactly as described, spacious and well equipped and with great views from all windows! It was clean, bright and airy and the kitchen and all rooms were very well equipped (also with city maps which is a big help).

Being on the top floor of course there were a number of steps to climb but it is definitely worth it. It also meant the flat was pretty quiet, we could not hear much street noise which was good.

We would definitely stay again. Thank you Hugo and Idalia!

Location, view.. everything was great. Hugo's mother(I think..) welcomed us. She was very kind and she told us a lot of imformation about Lisbon. House view was wonderful. We could see Jorge's night view at home. And house was big enough to accomodate 5 members. Hugo's home let our trip more perfect. We really thanks to Hugo.
Except one thing. He didn't told us how to check in. So, I thought he would welcom us in front of building. But when we arrived, there was no one welcoming us there. We rang the doorbell at 5 floor. A woman answered to us that it's not a Hugo's home. Later we find out that we have rang the doorbell in front of Hugo's house.(at same floor) We couldn't find other doorbell at 5 floor. To make things worse we can't use our phone at Portugual, so I asked lot of people to call to Hugo instead me. But he didn't answerd.(He expained the reason later) And then someone opened a building door for us. We entered the building, walked up to 5 floor and knocked. Finally her mother came out. When we was in front of building (while having trouble with contacting Hugo), it was getting darker and lots of stranger hang around us. It was very scarry and terrible time to us. I think you need to tell more details about how to check in and if you are in trouble to contact us at our arriving time, you should tell us before we arrive there.

Very spacious and lovely apartment in the best neighborhood for a traveler to stay. Rossio is close to the water, nightlife (Bairro Alto), important sights, and Lisbon's best shopping (Chiado). The apartment is housed in a building with multiple other apartments (used for similar reasons it seemed - travelers) as well as a hostel. Very spacious and lovely space. Some noise due to the hostel on the floor below. Other than this, lovely stay! We never met Hugo but he was very responsive to email and text!
Everything was very good!

We loved staying in Hugo's flat. The flat itself is very spacious and nice, and the location couldn't really be any better - super central. We only got to meet Hugo's mum in person who was super sweet and helpful, but Hugo was extremely helpful too and on standby via mail whenever needed. Overall, highly recommended!

Très bon accueil, appartement confortable et très propre, idéalement situé... De bons mollets sont de rigueur pour monter les 5 étages !!!
Nous reviendrons avec grand plaisir...
very good location, everything is good except one thing, it is 5th floor without lift, if you have large and heavy baggage, it is a tough job.

Being at Hugo's was fantastic. The apartment is located in the heart of the city, perfectly connected to the main attractions and public transportations. It has a wonderful view on the castle and all the comforts. Hugo and his mother were supportive and welcoming. I sincerely recommend staying at their place.

3 jours fantastique à lisbonne ! L'appartement d'Hugo est super. Extrêmement bien situé pour la découverte de lisbonne et sortir le soir, tout peut se faire à pied. L'appartement est très bien, lunimeux, calme, avec une partie nuit isolée du salon, parfait pour les "couches-tôt" ou les "lèves tard" ! Accueil sympa avec les bonnes adresses et choses à faire et ce qu'il faut pour les produits de base (thé, café, lessive...). Bref, si je retourne à lisbonne, je reprendrai cet appartement
Merci hugo !

L'appartement est très bien situé, au cœur du centre historique de Lisbonne. Il est agréable et spacieux, conforme au descriptif de l'annonce. Nous avons été très bien accueilli par Hugo et sa maman. Un séjour tout simplement délicieux !!!!

He was superkind and nice to us even though he was busy so his mother gave us some tips about lisbon. I enjoyed lisbon trip and this house was so cozy and enough to stay. There wasnt elevator though haha. Thank you so much and i really recommend this house

This was a great place for me and my friends to stay in Lisbon. It was incredibly central, but also really quiet. The beds in the three bedrooms were all doubles and all very comfortable. The flat was really well equipped. Hugo was a really great host; we were so surprised and grateful that he offered to pick us up from the airport and take us directly to the flat. Thank you so much for your hospitality Hugo, we had a lovely weekend in Lisbon.

Hugo's place in Lisbon is wonderful! The apartment is fully equipped, very comfortable and has lovely views. Hugo left a very helpful list of restaurant suggestions and other tips to make our stay even better. The only challenging part was being 5 flights up - but we managed. I would definitely seek out this lovely space when I return to Lisbon.

La casa es tal cual aparece en las fotos. Es acogedora, y muy bien acondicionada y distribuida. La situación y las vistas son fantásticas, en pleno centro. Tal y como se informa es un quinto piso sin ascensor, pero es que se trata del barrio histórico y la ubicación, muy cerca de la mayoría de las cosas que hay que ver y disfrutar de Lisboa, y las vistas lo merecen. Las tres habitaciones (dos exteriores y una interior) tienen camas cómodas. El armario común tiene suficiente espacio para 4-6 personas y está bien equipado. El baño y la cocina tienen todo lo necesario (todo un detalle la cafetera con cápsulas de varios tipos de café).

The apartment is great located where is convenient to walk to the Elevator and u can easily find Rossio train station and other public transportation. If u want to cooking on yourself in the Airbnb host I think Hugo's apartment is a great choice because there are all kinds of cooking accessories including some flavoring and food materials. We received much warm welcome from Hugo's mother who is a kind and cute lady and gave us some very useful information. Highly recommended even though there is no lift

Un accueil très chaleureux par la maman de Hugo, tout était très bien. Emplacement génial pour découvrir Lisbonne. A noter qu'il y a quelques places de parking gratuit à 10-15 mn à pieds du logement surtout après 17h (rue Instituto Bactériologico)

Très joli appartement conforme aux descriptions et aux photos. Très bien pour 4 à 6 personnes, agréablement décoré et bien équipé. Il est très bien situé en centre ville, tout près des transport en commun et des commerces.La maman d'Hugo est une personne accueillante qui a pris le temps de nous indiquer les sites intéressants à visiter et comment s'y rendre. Nous sommes restés en contact avec Hugo pendant notre séjour et pouvions le prévenir de tout problème particulier. C'est une adresse à recommander sans aucun doute!
A beautyful weekend with some friends. The app. Was great and the location was great!!
Las prestaciones, ubicación y estado de la casa eran inmejorables, asi como la amabilidad de los anfitriones.

Nous avons été très bien accueilli par Hugo, sa maman était là aussi. Ils ont été charmant et nous ont bien conseillé pour notre séjour. Il y avait même une corbeille de fruits et des rafraichissements sur la table du salon.

Le logement est conforme aux photos, les lits sont confortables. L'appartement est idéalement situé au centre ville pour les visites. Le métro et les bus sont juste en bas. Le quartier est très animé : restaurants, boutiques , zone piétonne, monuments.. Nous reviendrons dans cette ville avec un grand plaisir merci encore à Hugo et sa maman.
O Hugo foi simplesmente espetacular. Tanto na sua comunicação como na sua disponibilidade mas também nos seus conselhos. Muito obrigado por ter facilitado ao máximo todo o processo.

Hugo's apartment was a wonderful place to stay during our time in Lisbon! It is very spacious and 4 of us slept very comfortably. It is in a dream location (and has amazing views!), and we walked everywhere easily. It looks just like the pictures and we were very happy with all the amenities. Hugo and his mother were incredibly thoughtful and went above and beyond to make us feel welcome and show us the city. We couldn't have asked for a better experience! Highly recommended!

I went on a trip with four friends and we had a lovely stay in Lisbon. The apartment is easily accessible with public transport. We had an uncomplicated transfer from the airport via bus, subway or taxi respectively. The location is very good, super central but for all that amazingly quiet. The perfect starting point for a day trip orpub crawl in Bairro Alto. It’s a beautiful apartment on a pedestrian street in the heart of Lisbon. Perfect for our purpose. Hugo was a very kind and helpful host. He gave us all the information we needed for our stay and lots of tips what to do in Lisbon.
Recommend!

We had such a wonderful time at Hugo´s, very comfy and absolutely well located, with everything you need for a pleasant stay at Lisbon.
Just go down the stairs and you are in the middle of the town centre ready to get lost in its streets full of places to be discovered.
Hugo was a great host, always ready in case we need anything.
The house is clean and comfortable, quite a lot of space, big dining room as well as the bathroom, kitchen and bedrooms.

Un grand bravo et un grand merci à Hugo et à sa maman (qui parle un délicieux français) pour leur accueil prévenant. Merci Hugo pour toutes les attentions prodiguées lors de ce séjour à Lisbonne, allant même jusqu'à nous réserver un taxi pour le départ. L'appartement était très agréable, spacieux, parfaitement équipé, lumineux et très propre.
Un excellent séjour dans la capitale portugaise grâce à tout cela. Je recommande chaleureusement cet hôte et cet appartement très bien situé sur la place de Rossio.

Goede ontvangst , lekker flesje wijn , proper appartement met gunstige ligging , familiale approach .
Kamers in zeer goede staat , mooi meubilair en top locatie !

Hugo was great! He stayed in excellent contact before we arrived and even after we arrived he provided information on the neighborhood like where to eat. He checked in to make sure we had everything we needed and the location of the flat was perfect! His mother met with us and even gave us HER set of keys as a third set for 3 of us couples.

Great apartment with perfect location in the heart of Lisbon. The apartment was nice, spacey and clean. Hugo is very friendly and helpful and we would recommend this apartment to anyone coming to Lisbon. Thank you Hugo.
Katrine oct. 2015

Hugo has a beautiful apartment in the heart of Lisbon very conveniently located. Its close to a variety of restaurants, shops and the important sightseeing places.
Hugo was very helpful in helping us with our luggage up to the apartment which is on the 5 th floor. Two bed rooms overlook the palace which is beautifully lit up the whole night. The apartment is beautifully decorated and well stocked with towels and kitchen utensils.
Hugo even helped us get a taxi for us to go to the airport very early in the morning. Hugo is a very friendly and supportive host.

Une seule nuit.
Accueil charmant par une dame parlant très bien le français.
Joli appartement, calme, récemment refait, très bien équipé, et impeccable. Café à volonté!
Idéalement placé en plein centre. Très belle vue depuis les chambres sur le château et la ville haute.
Trois petites choses à signaler :
-au 5e étage sans ascenseur: voyagez léger!
-une des chambres est aveugle, ce qui peut gêner certains.
-la serrure de la porte d'entrée de l'immeuble est difficile et capricieuse: prévoir patience, délicatesse et doigté!
Une adresse où je reviendrais avec plaisir et que je recommande très chaleureusement.

Hey Hugo and mom,
Thanks for making us feel at home. The appartment is centrally located and perfectly fit for a stay in Lisbon. Everything is nearby and it's a spacious place to stay.
If I come back to Lisbon I find you again!

We had a wonderful time in Lisbon, we were greeted by Hugo's brother who was very kind and informative.  The suite is very roomy and equipped with everything one might need.  It is in the heart of old town, restaurants and bars galore. Parking is nearby in a parade which was very handy.  I would definitely recommend this apt.

The perfect place to make your home base while enjoying the amazing city that is Lisbon. Close to everything you could want. Amazing views and a wonderful host. Could not ask for more. Thanks Hugo and family!!

We were met by Hugo's mum who provided so with much information about what to do in Lisbon during our brief stay and even drew maps for us which were a great help. All the advice meant we really made the most of our short stay in such a beautiful city.

The flat is absolutely stunning, in such an incredible location and with every amenity you could possibly need.

I'll definitely stay again when I comeback to Lisbon.

Thank you Hugo for a lovely stay in Lisbon!

The host (in our case Hugos mother), made us feel very welcome and greeted us with pasteis de Belem. She also showed us everything about the apartment, which included far more than we could hope for. The location is also perfect, with walking distance to the castle, the arch, Martim Moniz, Baito Alto and of course Rossio. The view from the bedrooms is fantastic, and really something to wake up to.

I would recommend this place to everyone!

Henrik,
Norway

Una casa estupenda, muy cómoda y espaciosa, tal y como aparece en las fotos. Las vistas increíbles, y la ubicación inmejorable, en pleno centro y cerca de todo. Hugo se adaptó perfectamente a nuestras necesidades y nuestros horarios. 100% recomendable. Sin duda repetiría en mi próxima visita a Lisboa.

La experiencia como siempre impecable. El piso está fenomenal. Son 3 habitaciones con cama matrimonio. Tiene un salón y una cocina y un baño muy grande. La madre de Hugo nos trató genial, explicando todo lo que podiamos ver y los servicios disponibles en la zona. Sin duda alguna repetiré mi experiencia en la casa de Hugo la proxima vez.

La única pega es que al ser un edificio antiguo es un quinto sin ascensor.

En la misma calle a pocos metros se encuentra en famoso restaurante UMA muy conocido por su arroz caldoso. Cerca de la Plaça do comerço encontramos el restaurante Cafe do Rio, especialidad en Hamburguesas Gourmet, una delicia, no olvideis probarlo.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay in Hugo's apartment. It's location couldn't be better. Right in the heart of central Lisbon and convenient for going out to restaurants, bars, all the sights of Lisbon and for transport links. We were able to walk everywhere direct from the door and to pop back conveniently throughout the day if we needed to. The flat is elegant with interesting art work and decor and rooftop views from most windows - including a fantastic view of the Castle, which is lit up at night, from one of the bedrooms. It also has fully functioning and easy to control air conditioning - much needed in August. Hugo has equipped it very generously so it is very easy to settle in and all those little things that you don't want to have to buy on arrival are already there - like soap and toiletries, coffee and tea and there are plenty of towels provided too.

We were greeted by Hugo's brother who made us feel very welcome- showed us how everything worked and gave us local tips and directions and had even drawn us a map of how to find the nearest supermarket (very close by).

We found the flat more than met our expectations. It is well worth the walk up to the fifth floor. Highly recommended.

Hugo's mother greeted us at the apartment, showed us around the apartment and what we needed to know, she also gave us tips for sightseeing, supermarket etc.
The apartment is excellently located and as described and shown in pictures. It is easy to explore Lisbon by foot or by metro from there. Tea, coffee, towels and toiletries were all provided. We really enjoyed our stay in Lisbon and found the apartment very comfortable.

We had a wonderful stay.the apartment is super well located, and very clean. Hugo's mom welcomed us with her perfect English and French as well as useful tips on things to do. I would definitely go back to the same place!

Upon arrival, we were greeted by Hugo's mother who was one of the sweetest people I've ever met. She gave us a tour of the apartment which was in immaculate condition, the pictures don't do it justice! The view is fantastic, overlooking the castle and all bedrooms were a great size. The location is prime, right off Rossio Square and a short walk to Barrio Alto and the riverfront. Hugo's Mom showed us where the supermarkets were, how to get to different attractions, and where the best places to eat in Lisbon were. There was even a bottle of wine left for us!

The five flight walk up to the apartment didn't phase us because of how pretty the apartment was and it's wonderful location.

If I am ever in Lisbon again, I would not hesitate to stay in Hugo's fabulous apartment again!

O apartamento é espetacular! Amplo, muito bem planejado e extremamente bem localizado. Além de estar perto de pontos importantes de Lisboa o apartamento é aconchegante e o proprietário e sua mãe são muito educados e solícitos. Super recomendo.
Great location with great views. We were checked in at a late hour which we very much appreciated .

Our host was very warm and welcoming. The description provided was accurate and on point. All basic amenities were provided, down to the cleaning detergents and coffee pods for the coffee machine. The apartment was within a 5 minute radius of bus, tram and airport transportation. Hugo and his mother were very helpful and gave great tips on where to visit around Lisbon. All in all, a very pleasant and wonderful stay. Would highly recommend.

Hugo was great. Very attentive with constant communication. We got in early in the morning and Hugo couldn't meet us at the apartment until later, but his mother was there to let us in and orient us to the apartment. She was awesome!
Very centrally located. You can see the entire city within easy walking distance - Lisbon is built on hills, so easy is a relative term.
Great people. Great culture. Wonderful city!
Highly recommend eating at Coimbra Taberna - Calcada de Sao Francisco 6A.

Thanks so much - Mike

Excellent appartment, excellent host. We loved to stay at Hugo's. It is almost AT Rossio, in the Heart of Lissabon. Rossio is the most touristed area in Lissabon, but it is easy to get around.

We also enjoyed visiting the less touristed places in Lissabon as well, e.g. Alfarma and Barria Alto.

The appartment is well-equipped with washing-machine, a large bathroom, three bedrooms (one without window) etc.

Great apartment very centrally located, near to the sights. Met by Hugo's mum on arrival who was very helpful and welcoming. The apartment was well equipped, lovely clean bedding/ towels etc... with everything we needed- extra touches like free coffee pods for the coffee machine, washing powder for the washing machine etc... Couldn't find any toys for our little girl as per the listing but only a minor point (perhaps these need to be requested in advance??). Overall we really enjoyed our stay. The stairs also kept us fit!! :-) many thanks

formidable séjour dans l appartement d Hugo hôte extrêmement prévenant avant et pendant le séjour
l appartement est très bien situé spacieux lumineux très propre et bien équipé
merci aussi à sa maman ( qui parle parfaitement français) pour son accueil chaleureux
à recommander!
Appartement fantastique propre et dEsign! Dans un super quartier de Lisbonne je recommande vivement !
Great location for visiting the city and great views from this 5th floor apartment. Lots of space and really well maintained. A lift to the top floor would help though!

I chose to go to Lisbon for my hen weekend with 4 of my friends. I saw Hugo's apartment on airbnb and contacted him straight away. He was very prompt at replying giving lots of information about his apartment and the local area which was very helpful and the icing on the cake that made us book his wonderful apartment. From then he was very approachable giving lots of information about lisbon. When arriving at the apartment his mother met us, she was so lovely and so helpful!! I cannot thank her enough for making us feel welcome. The apartment was in immaculate condition, perfect central location with beautiful views and couldn't fault anything (apart from those 5 flights of stairs but they were a good work out). On our last day we were flying out at 9pm and we were allowed to leave our luggage for longer and our bags were kindly put in the hostel later on which was a wonderful gesture. I will definalately be returning again with you a shadow of a doubt. Thank you hugo and idalia for letting me stay at your apartment!

The apartment is wonderfully located right in the city center just next to Rossio. Easy to find and very close to everything.
Apartment worked fine and all the features you needed were there.

super séjour grâce à cet appartement idéalement placé au cœur du quartier historique malgré les 5 étages sans ascenseur pour l'atteindre.
Contact efficace avec l’hôte, réception faite par son adorable maman qui nous a accueillis chaleureusement avec tous les renseignements utiles dans un bon français + fourniture de plans et petits croquis esquissés.
appartement très propre et bien équipé avec de belles vues sur Lisbonne ( merci les 5 étages :)
Un grand merci pour avoir permis de laisser les bagages la journée du départ .

The apartment was amazing, Hugo and his mother welcomed us very warmly. they were really nice and understanding.
We really enjoyed our stay and totally recommend the place very well located :)

thanks again

Baptiste

The few days we spent at Lisboa at Hugo's house were amazing. The central position of this appart, the kindness of Hugo and his mother, the beautiful and peaceful appart with all the comfort needed were just perfect ! I recommand it so much. We were in vacations with "home feeling"  ! Thanks a lot. Emmanuelle
Hugo's house is very clean and beautiful. His mother is so very kind!

Hugo's communication was great and he was always on email for any questions we had. The apartment was exactly as described and really couldn't find fault. There was 6 of us and the apartment was plent big enough. We were initially concerned being top floor with no lift but it really wasn't bad at all and definitely should deter. We didn't meet Hugo but his lovely mum who went out her way to make us comfortable and to make sure we had everything we needed, she even went out to buy us more coffee capsules and a power bar to give us more plug acess. With a view of the castle, in the centre of the city off Rossi square and comfortable beds with good wifi I highly recommend staying here and would always book this apartment on return trips if available!

Hugo's appartement is echt geweldig!! Op de eerste plaats vanwege de locatie (centraler dan dit kan bijna niet), maar met name vanwege het huis zelf. Het ligt op de 5e verdieping, dus het kost wat traplopen, maar dat wordt beloond met een prachtig uitzicht. Vanaf de slaapkamers heb je uitzicht op het kasteel en vanaf het balkonnetje heb je uitzicht op de elevador de santa justa  en de carmokerk. Verder is het appartement heel ruim, schoon en leuk ingericht. Bovendien is het voorzien van alles wat je nodig hebt: koffie, thee, (lekkere) espressoautomaat, genoeg handdoeken, tips/info over Lissabon, klein balkonnetje, airco etc. Tot slot zijn Hugo en zijn moeder zeer behulpzaam. Kortom: absoluut een aanrader!

This is a fantastic location, with proximity to Metro, regional train station, and most significant sites/restaurants in old downtown, all accessible by foot.
Inside, it is a spacious and comfortable 3 bedroom flat (one interior bedroom is windowless, but a good size). There is lots of closet space in the main hall.
We especially appreciated: washer/dryer in kitchen; good expresso machine with pods; very good air conditioning, which enabled a quiet, comfortable night's sleep with windows closed!
As noted in the description, there are a lot of stairs (on 6th floor), but it was nice to be on the top floor, with great views, and less noise than the lower floors.
The street entrance wasn't very clean, so it may make an unpleasant first impression, but it is perfectly safe (we were out every night, and never had a problem). Once inside, everything is very nice.
We were early but Hugo's mother greeted us warmly; it was lovely to meet her and Hugo.
Hugo était très sympa et très disponible, le logement était parfait, je recommande !
Erinomainen palvelu. Huoneiston sijainti on erittäin hyvä.

Olá Hugo, nossa estada em Lisboa foi ótima e a acomodação na Rua dos Sapateiros foi espetacular. A localização é excelente, próximo da estação de trem, restaurantes, pontos turísticos e tudo mais que um turista precisa. O apartamento é amplo, bem limpinho e confortável. Podemos recomendar com segurança.

Trés bel appartement idéalement situé dans le quartier Rossio, à proximité de tout commerces.

Nous avons eu le plaisir de rencontrer la maman d'Hugo qui à le coeur sur la main et n'hésitera pas à vous rendre service.

Trés bon séjour, à refaire!

Staying at Hugo's apartment was fantastic. The apartment is the definition of central. Airport bus: 2 min walk. Train station: 4 minute walk. Restaurants and bakeries: 2 minute walk. All the beds were really comfy. Our experience was fantastic. It is important to note that to get to the apartment, you must climb 5 flights of stairs. It was totally worth the climb in our opinion, but if you have any health problems, you may find it difficult. Our next time in Lisbon we will look to stay here again!
Hugo is a great guy. Even when we had some unexpected problems because of a pilot's strike, Hugo was super-accommodating. I would definitely stay at his place next time I'm in Lisbon.

Appartement idéalement situé en plein centre ville,conforme aux photos,décoré avec beaucoup de gout,propre et confortable.
Nous avons apprécié l accueil chaleureux de la maman d Hugo et ses bons conseils.
Nous étions une famille avec 3 grands enfants,et les 5 étages n ont pas été un problème.
En résumé,très bon séjour.

Hugo was a most welcoming host. He met us at the airport took us to the flat, explained everything to us, gave us advice about where to visit and eat. The flat was excellent, really clean, with excellent facilities. The location was perfect, within walking distance of the historic centre and so handy for good restaurants.

The house was absolutely fantastic, just as the pictures show and extremely central. We walked everywhere and it totally made us feel just at home. Would definitely recommend it and would stay here again without a seconds thought. Super thanks to Hugo!

L'appartamento è situato innuna zona veramente strategica: pochi metri dalla fermata della metro in pieno Baixa. Non abbiamo conosciuto Hugo ma la sua mamma che ci ha fornito tutto quello di cui avevamo bisogno. L'appartamento è nuovo e dotato di ogni comfort... Veramente bello! Hugo cibga comunque seguito tramite cellulare prima e durante il soggiorno. Ottima esperienza

Séjour très agréable dans ce grand appartement d'Hugo au coeur de Lisbonne est très bien situé. Appartement propre est très bien équipé. Certes les 5 étages par escaliers peuvent être difficiles pour des personnes d'un certain âge, mais l'information était donnée et on ne peut pas tout avoir.
Je recommande ce lieu.

Nous avons été accueillis avec beaucoup de chaleur par la maman d'HUGO. L'appartement était conforme à la description. Il est très bien équipé et situé centralement à 80 mètres d'une sortie de métro. Mes amis et moi avons pu ainsi passer une séjour agréable fait de nombreuses découvertes.
Une adresse à recommander !

Un grand merci à Hugo pour sa réactivité, sa patience à toute épreuve (le vol a été décalé plusieurs fois) et sa gentillesse.
Un grand merci à Idalia, la maman d'Hugo qui nous a accueilli chaleureusement et qui parle très bien Français.
Appartement tout à fait conforme aux photos, idéalement situé, très propre et très calme malgré sa situation en plein centre ville.
Belles vues, recommandations de restaurants et visites (toujours pratique), wifi, proche de plusieurs lignes de trams/bus/métro/taxis.
Bref, très bon choix !

Excelente ubicación y apartamento. Muy limpio, con cocina equipada, sábanas, toallas y lo necesario para la estadía. Hugo siempre estuvo pendiente de nosotros, ofreciéndonos su ayuda en todo momento. Muy buen anfitrión. Un apartamento muy cómodo que recomendamos al 100%.

We enjoyed our stay in the appartment very much. It was completely like it was described. Idalia, Hugo's mum, explained everything and made us feel welcome. True, we had to climb the stairs to the 5th with our suitcases, but the apartment was so nice that it was a minor aspect.  The house was very clean, the kitchen was very complete, coffee and all, the beds were excellent and the location at Rossio was top. We were really in the heart of Lisbon, an excellent place to explore the city, mostly on foot.

il nous attendait à la descente du taxi près de l'immeuble ;visite de l'appart et explication des transports dans Lisbonne.
L'appart est très propre et confortable.
pour mériter la vue sur Lisbonne il faut monter 5 étages !
nous avons fait un peu de sport.
We had a warm welcome and a great time in Hugo's appartment! Cosy, very well equipped and in the centre of the centre.
The mother of the host was extremely nice and accomodating. We were late due to getting lost and she was very understanding. Location is great. Place is very clean and cosy.

Hugo was the most exquisite host; he came and picked us up at the airport and carried Mom's luggage up the 104 steps to his marvelous apartment. The place is located super central, in "the flats" but we still enjoyed great views from all windows. Comfortable beds, well-equipped kitchen, hot water enough for 4 ladies, bright and big place and even a little balcony for the morning coffee (there is a brilliant coffee maker including coffee there) or the afternoon vinho verde.  An all in all fabulous experience!

Amazing apartment in a perfect location in the center of Lisbon. 3 rooms so can accommodate a big party - 2 of which have a nice view of the castle nearby. Huge and very nice bathroom to get ready in. Also a small patio to enjoy the view if you need to work. Apartment is on the 5th floor so your legs will get a nice workout after enjoying the beautiful sights nearby.

The apartment is very well positioned for visiting Lisboa. Rooms are nice and well-furnished even if the apartment is on fifth floor with no elevator (very common for all buildings in the city-center). Hugo was helpful and communication was straightforward from the very beginning.
Highly recommended!

The appartment was very central and good location. Hugo and his mother  were very friendly  and enthusiastic.They  provided much information about LISBON. This apartment was beautifully decorated and very comfortable. I would not hesitate to offer a recommendation in the future.

We had a great stay at Hugo's apartment - they were very accommodating before, during and after! The apartment was well stocked with everything you need, including coffee, soaps, etc - no need to stock the necessities.

It was in a perfect central location in Lisbon, close to everything - and beautiful!

This particular apartment was on the top floor of a walk-up, so my one word of advice is be prepared to get a work out going up and down the stairs. We adapted though!

Great time had...

Appartement très bien situé, au centre de la ville et à proximité du métro. Accès facile de l’aéroport ainsi que pour la visite de la ville.
Bon accueil par la maman d'Hugo.
Todo perfecto, nos ha encantado el apartamento. Recomendable 100%. Es tal como está en las fotos. Todo limpio y trato muy amable

Hugo is awesome and so does his apartment. Located in downtown Lisbon with great view to the city. Less than 5mins of walk to all kinds of public transit.
Hugo is a great great host. He loves to travel and knows traveller's needs, me and my group were impressed the efforts in details he put-in. You can pretty much goto his apartment just with your own clothes and you will be set. Make sure you ask Hugo about where to eat in the town.

Hugo et sa maman sont des gens charmants ! Ils nous ont attendu près d'une heure devant l'appartement car notre avion avait du retard, afin de nous donner les clés et nous donner des conseils sur l'utilisation du matériel et les alentours.
Un guide est à dispo, ainsi que quelques recommandations de restaurants et de visites, vraiment très attentionné !
L'appartement est super, aussi bien en famille qu'en groupe d'amis. Situé en plein centre tout près du quartier animé du Barrio Alto, et à 2min du métro/tram/bus ! Très rapide d'accès à l'aéroport également.
Seul bémol : pas de chauffage, en hiver il fait relativement froid, mais comme nous venions essentiellement pour dormir et qu'il y avait des couvertures pour les lits, cela nous a assez peu dérangé mais a du coup réduit le temps passé dans la salle de bain et le salon ;)

Ev konum olarak muhteşem bir yerde. Tam lizbon 'un merkezinde. Rossio meydanında. Alışveriş merkezleri ana caddeler hepsinim tam ortasında. Metro, Tren istasyonu, Otobüs. Aerobus hepsine 1 dakikalık yürüme mesafesinde.
Ev oldukça geniş ve ferah. Tam bir otel konforunda. Evde Tv, Wiifii, hepsi mevcut. Mutfakta tüm gerekli malzemeler var.
Yataklar temiz ve konforlu.
Hugo ve Annesi çok iyi bir ev sahibi. Bizleri son derece iyi karşıladılar. Her an telefonla ulaştılar. Bizlere hiç bir sorun yaşatmadılar. Hugo'ya ve annesine çok teşekkür ederiz.
Bu evi kesinlikle tavsiye ederim.
Tekrar gidersem yine bu evde kalmayı tercih ederim.

El Departamento fue arrendado para mi hija, quién permaneción poco mas de 5 meses, mi hija en todo momento se sintió apoyada y acompañada, gracias a la atención y preocupación por hacer de la estadía de mi hija un simple arriendo, sino que junto a su familia le brindaron soluciones a los problemas que se le fueron presentando en el tiempo, siempre con una rápida y eficaz solución, el departamento se encontraba tal cual lo pudimos ver en imágenes de internet y tanto el espacio, sus habitaciones y su ubicación fueron fundamentales paar poder ambientarse fácilmente a la ciudad y sus alrededores.

Appartement idéalement situé en plein cœur de Lisbonne.  Magnifique vue sur le château, Hugo et sa maman vous accueillent très sympathiquement et vous expliquent tous les bons tuyaux pour vos visites. Merci à eux

This appartement is very beautiful, in the center of the city. It is very good situated.
Hugo is very nice and try to help you for anything.

If you need to go to Lisbonne to visit the city, this appartement is perfect for you.

Après une semaine passé chez Hugo, nous recommandons vivement cet possibilité de logement. L'accueil est chaleureux (et en français grâce à la maman d'Hugo), l'appartement conforme à sa description dispose de tout le confort souhaité (wifi-et PC à disposition). La situation du logement permet d'atteindre à pied beaucoup de centres d'intérêt ou commerces et se situe à proximité des transports. Il s'agit d'une très bonne adresse, passée la petite difficulté du 5ème étage! Extra bonus: la vue superbe sur l'élévateur de Santa Justa et le Castelo Sao Jorge.
Bravo Hugo!
Marielle et Philippe de Nantes

We had a great experience in Hugo's apartment. It was clean and well designed and very comfortabe. We stayed for one night with my wife and 3 kids and his mother was welcoming us and provided info on city and apartment in very friendly way. We will come back for sure.

Already a week ago we spent 4 days in Hugo's appartment in Lisboa. What a wonderfull place in a great city. Hugo's mother gave us a warm welcome and mention that we could always contact her or Hugo if we had questions or needed help. I would recommend this place an defenitly come back for another city trip in Lisboa.

Hugo was a perfect host for us and our stay at the apartment was very pleasant. Good location, nice view to the castle, everything you need to start your stay in Lisbon was there: main toiletries, coffee, tea, etc.

Lovely place with everything you need to spend some time in Lisbon. If you don't mind to walk some stairs, we would highly recommend to stay here. The apartment is perfect, light and fresh. All you need is to look at the stairs as your daily exercise and you are in! Thanks a lot Hugo and Idalia!

This apartment was breathtaking. The views were amazing and the decoration was beautiful. It's right in the heart of the city so it's easy to get pretty much anywhere, and its walking distance to all the big local sights. One down side is that it's on the fifth floor and without a lift it might be a struggle to get luggage up the stairs! But our host was incredibly kind and flexible and all the amenities were perfect. I'd definitely recommend this place to friends.

Nous avons surtout était en contact avec la maman d Hugo qui a ete tres acceuillante et serviable sans oublier tres sportive ( 5e etage). L appartement est extremement agreable  propre confortable et tres bien equipe. Son emplacement en plein coeur du centre de Lisbonne est ideal pour visiter cette magnifique metropole. JE RECOMMANDE VIVEMENT CET APPARTEMENT.
We had a wonderful stay in this apartment. Fantastic location with everything we needed.

I would definitely like to recommand this place. The location couldn't be helpful and from the first moment Hugo and his mother Idalia have been so helpful to make our trip a pleasant experience. We stayed here with 5 friends, and the apartment is absolutely big enough for larger groups, also ideal for families. If you don't mind taking the stairs because the 5th floor is rather high and there was no elevator, but we didn't mind because the view from the apartment was stunning.

The flat is great, ideally placed in the center of Lisboa.
We have been really well received. Thanks again for having driven us to the airport.
The views from the windows of the flat are fabulous. Everything is new, kitchen, bathroom, bedroom are confortable.
Make us feel like being home in Lisboa like real portugueses.

We stayed for two nights in this beautiful apartment with majestic views over Lisbon. The staircase up to the flat is quite rustiq but once inside everything is super nice! There was everything one could wish for. We travelled with both a small kid and a teenager and everyone was very happy so I recommend it to everybody who wants a central location with great views!

We have stayed a week in Lisbon and got to experience a lot of what this lovely city has to offer. We were really surprised and pleased with the apartment. I don't think you can get more central than that. It is located close to tram, metro and bus connections but you can walk to Alfama, Bairro Alto etc. without any trouble. Hugo and his mother are extremely polite and they welcomed us on the arrival. Hugo gave us few ideas on what to do and what is the best way to explore Lisbon and the area for which we are really grateful. He told us about the big party on the Sardines day which was a blast. We will definitely be back in Lisbon and hope that we will be able to stay in Hugo's apartment. The bedrooms were spacious and everything was crisp and clean. The kitchen was large and well stocked. Hugo even left a laptop for us to check out the area and google train timetables and more information. WiFi was also a big help. Hugo left for us maps and guides! There is iron, washing machine, tumble dryer which was perfect.
Great apartment, right in the centre of Lisbon. 3 decent sized double rooms and good living space. Note, there are alot of stairs up to the apartment.
This flat is really great and so well located. Hugo and his mother are so weIcoming. If you go in lisbon soon, you have to stay on hugo's place.

The apartment was extremely centrally located very near Place Rossio. It was therefore really easy to walk out the door and catch tram 28 which took us across town. It was close to walk to the shopping district as well as the castle. The apartment was very clean (Hugos mother met us there and had just cleaned). It was very nicely decorated and had 3 double beds so plenty of space. Nice bathroom and kitchen facilities made the stay very comfortable. Would recommend to anyone (unless you have a problem walking stairs) and will stay there again when we come back to Lisboa. Great deal! Thanks Hugo!

Very nice appartment in the center of Lisbonne with every amenity possible: AC, WIFI, dishwater...
Hugo was very helpful, recommanding restaurants et places to visit. He even picked us up at the airport late at night : thank you ! On arrival the appartment was very clean, fresh pastries were offered on the dining table and the fridge was stocked with mineral water.
Our best Airbnb experience so far.
ps : the stairs were not a problem for our family as we pack light.
Awesome place and great location. Hugo was very helpful.

Superb appartment at one of the best spots in Lisbon! Highly recommended!

However, one has to be aware that it is located on the 5th floor (about 100 steps on the stairs) and there is no elevator. That was not a problem for us and we are happy to have booked this appartment, but this might be a problem for some people.

Fabuloso apartamento, equipado con todo detalle, inmejorablemente situado, junto al arco da bandeira en la plaza del Rossio. El apartamento estaba muy limpio y ordenado, es muy luminoso y con unas vistas preciosas de la ciudad. 100 % recomendable!

Great appartment, right in the centre of Lisbon, very near to Place Rossio. 3 beautifull double rooms, a great bathroom, beautifull views,... a perfect place to visit Lisbon !
Hugo's mother, who perfectly speak french is very weIcoming and cool.
We will surelly come back for our next trip to Lisbon.

Appartamento stupendo!!! A due passi (nel vero senso della parola) da molte attrazioni turistiche e dalla fermata della metro.
La mamma di Hugo è stata gentilissima e al nostro arrivo ci ha fatto trovare tutto quello di cui avevamo bisogno: lettino e seggiolone per il bimbo, informazioni e guide turistiche, pc con internet, frutta, caffè....insomma non mancava proprio nulla!
Tutto questo ripaga decisamente dei quattro piani di scale.
Da consigliare anche l'ottimo ristorante " O Bacalhoeiro" che si trova proprio di fronte casa. Ottimo soggiorno, un grazie a Hugo da tutti noi; Giacomo,Silvia, Nora, Emilio, Matteo ed Elena.

Hugo is a very kind host. He even picked up us at the airport when we arrived (because he was available on a sunday afternoon).
The flat has everything you need and was well located (very central in Lisbon), clean, spacious and comfortable.
The wifi was temporarily unavailable but Hugo did everything he could to get the internet access (lend us a computer with a 3G key).
On the whole, we had a very nice holidays in Lisbon and we warmly recommend Hugo's appartment.

Hugo's apartment is amazing, warm, decorated with taste, and it's location couldn't get any better - it is literally in the center of the city and in the best part of town, 2 minutes away from Rossio metro station. Hugo's mother is lovely and always ready to help. Definitely recommend, best choice in Lisboa.

Het was een schoon huisje en de host was duidelijk in communicatie en het geven van tips. Echter was het niet duidelijk dat de woonkamer gedeeld zou moeten worden met de host maar hier hebben we geen last van gehad. Qua locatie zal ik hier in de avond niet alleen op straat durven als meisje.
Buen trato y buen alojamiento

Wir hatten eine angenehme Zeit in dieser Unterkunft :). Allerdings war das Apartment sehr viel kleiner als wir dachten oder als es auf den Fotos aussieht. Zum Glück hatten wir aber die ganze Unterkunft für uns und eigenes gemütliches Licht dabei (in den Zimmern ist nur grelles Neonlicht). Auf der Straße war es etwas laut und es standen übermäßig viele Männer rum. Uns ging es aber dennoch gut und wir konnten gut schlafen.

Der Aufenthalt bei Artur und Rosária war wunderschön. Die beiden waren jederzeit erreichbar, die Anweisungen zum Check in und Check out klar und deutlich.
Die Wohnung ist liebevoll eingerichtet und sauber. Die Umgebung kann vielleicht für manche etwas laut sein, aber wenn man schnell mitten im Leben sein möchte und alles gerne per Fuß erkundet, ist sie genau richtig gelegen.
Alles in Allem eine mehr als positive Erfahrung, absolute Empfehlung

war gut, wäre besser gewesen, wenn uns vorher informiert worden wäre, dass es sich hierbei um eine geteilte Wohnung handelt. Es steht sehr kleingedruckt in einer langen Beschreibung. Ausserdem hat man als Frau in der Lage sich etwas unsicher gefühlt, da gefühlt auf der Strasse sich nur Männer befanden, auch spät nachts. Sonst war der Aufenthalt entspannt. Ich habe meinen Schal in der Unterkunft vergessen und die Gastgeberin war so freundlich, mir direkt anzubieten, ihn nach ihrem Urlaub zuzusenden. Das fand ich wirklich sehr zuvorkommend und zeigt, wie aufmerksam und zuverlässig sie ist.

L’appartamento corrisponde perfettamente a quanto mostrato nelle foto: cucina pulita condivisa, bagno privato seppur piccolo funzionale e stanza da letto comoda. Unico aspetto negativo la posizione dell’appartamento in una strada frequentata da individui poco raccomandabili e di notte spesso rumorosa.
alloggio perfetto, centrale, pulito e comodo. consiglio!
Schöne Wohnung in zentraler Lage, wir konnten alles zu Fuß erreichen! Top für ein Wochenende in Lissabon!
Great place to stay :)
Muy cómodo el lugar, de fácil acceso a los puntos centrales de Lisboa. Si bien la calle era ruidosa, con las ventanas cerradas y el ventilador prendido no tuvimos problemas. Muchas gracias!!!

이 숙소는 전용 욕실을 사용할 수는 있지만 다른 게스트와 거실, 화장실이 있는 복도 공간을 공유해야 합니다.
다행히 동일한 날짜에 다른 룸의 게스트가 없는 것 같아 불편함없이 이용했습니다만, 완전히 독립된 공간에 아님을 사전에 알았다면 더 좋았을 것 같습니다.
숙소는 관광을 하기에 좋은 위치에 있으나 숙소 주변 분위기가 조금 무서워서 여자끼리의 방문은 추천드리지 않습니다.
very beautiful apartment, very nice hosts! thanks for everything!
Nos fue bien con el alojamiento, nos permitieron dejar nuestro equipaje un rato antes del check in y las indicaciones eran claras. Gracias
Appartamento nel pieno centro di Lisbona, comodo da raggiungere a piedi e utilizzando i mezzi pubblici

l'alloggio di Art e Ros è un appartamento con due camere da letto. la posizione è molto comoda, il centro è facilmente raggiungibile a piedi e c'è una fermata della metro ad appena 500m. l'appartamento era ben curato e pulito. la stanza da letto è piccola e adatta per chi è più basso di 190cm, ma accogliente e comoda per un breve soggiorno. gli host sono stati gentili e sono stati disponibili per darci indicazioni in più sulla città.
Είχαμε μια πολύ καλή εμπειρία! Ευχαριστούμε πολύ!
Good place in this price range. Close to many atractions in the city and metro station.
The room was clean. But the location is not very safe, and we were scared to walk around the neighborhood, especially at night. The house was hard to locate as well.
c'était bien mais bruyant

Wir waren sehr zufrieden mit dem Airbnb, sauber und sehr schnelle und gute Kommunikation mit den Gastgebern. Küche ist gut ausgestattet und auch im Bad gab es Shampoo, Seife, Duschbad. Ohropax wurden freundlicherweise gestellt auch wenn es nicht besonders laut war. An dem naheliegenden Platz und der Ubahn hielten sich sehr viele Männer auf, was abends für junge Frauen unangenehm aufgefallen ist. Insgesamt waren wir aber super zufrieden mit dem Airbnb und den Gastgebern.
Hat alles gut gepasst:)
Very clean apartment and good access to the city.
Alles top außer, dass man für 6 Tage nur ein Handtuch bekommt
