Eine der besten Unterkunft: zentrale Lage, nah an der U-Bahn und der traditionellen berühmten Linie 28E.
Der Gastgeber Artur ist sehr freundlich und antwortet ganz schnell. Der Checkin und Checkout ist auch ganz einfach.
sehr gemütlich eingerichtete Wohnung.
Wir waren für 4 Tage in Lissabon und haben bei Art e Ros im AirBnB genächrigt und waren sehr zufrieden. Alles entsprach der Beschreibung. Wir danken den beiden für die Gastfreundschaft 😇

Appartamento moderno, accogliente e pulito, posizione centrale, ma un poco rumorosa e di sera non tra le zone migliori.
Camera pulita, ordinata ed insonorizzata.
L’unico difetto è il non poter effettuare il check-in prima delle 15.
L’host veramente molto gentile.
Sehr tolle Wohnung mit Klasse Lage 💪🏽

My girlfriend and I spend a couple of nights in Lisbon and had a great time staying in Artur and Rosária's accomodation. The apartmentment is as described, very nice, well cleaned and equiped, and the room is confortable. It is in an amazing location, with a lot of restaurants, bars, supermarkets, and access to public transportations and touristic attractions. Artur and Rosária were great hosts, always friendly, polite, and helpful. Overall it was an excellent experience in Lisbon, and we highly recommend staying in this accomodation!

Het verblijf was prima. Accommodatie was goed, helaas alleen geen airco. Hierdoor moesten de ramen open blijven de hele nacht en hoorde je veel lawaai tot soms wel 6 uur in de nacht. Dit kwam door de plaatselijke nacht winkels en vage types die rondhangen rondom voor het huis. De locatie is wel in een wat onveilige wijk, maar als je niet te veel op straat rondhangt in de late uren is dit geen probleem. We kwamen aan en het bed frame was helaas kapot bij aankomst. Na het aangeven hiervan werd het snel gerepareerd, maar kregen we de belachelijke rekening achteraf. Daarom was ons verblijf prima, maar zeker niet fantastisch.

Unfortunately, our experience started with a very unpleasant episode. The apartment gets extremely hot — almost unbearably so — and one night, due to the heat, we left the window open for a few hours while sleeping. Someone climbed up from the street and entered through the balcony, stealing a suitcase. The apartment is located on the first floor, just a few meters above street level. The hosts were kind and supportive and tried to help, but unfortunately, the stolen items were never recovered. If you stay here, make sure to always keep the windows closed, even at night.
That said, the apartment is in a very central area, within walking distance of most of the city’s main attractions. It’s located in a multicultural neighborhood, which may not be for everyone, but it’s lively and well connected.
The room itself is quite small, as is the bathroom, which is located down the hallway (not inside the room). However, if you’re planning to use the apartment just for sleeping and being out m

Muy bien el hospedaje, lamentablemente la ubicación no era del todo como la buscamos. De todos modos no es culpa del piso, sino de la gente de la zona. Quitando eso, estuvimos muy a gusto y nos gusto!
Muy buena opción para quedar cerca a pie de muchos puntos de interés de la ciudad

Excellent séjour passé ! Rien à dire, tout était parfait !
Merci

Top Unterkunft in einer tollen Lage und reibungslose Kommunikation mit dem Vermieter.
Würde immer wieder gerne kommen!
Das Quicklebendige Leben der Stadt bekommt man hier wunderbar mit. Nachts leider sehr laut, aber das war vorher bekannt.

El apartamento está cerca del centro, aunque el barrio no era lo que esperábamos. Había mucho ruído en la calle y no parecía del todo seguro.
La habitación estaba ordenada y limpia, al igual que el resto de instalaciones. Pensábamos que tenía baño propio, pero solo una de las tres habitaciones del apartamento tiene baño en la habitación (la suite); en nuestro caso tubimos que compartir.
Por otro lado, los anfitriones fueron muy atentos. Nos proporcionaron entrada y salida autónoma y nos dejaron guardar el equipaje en el apartamento después del check out.
En resumen, es un buen sitio para pasar una noche en Lisboa.
Art is a great host, super friendly and helpful!! The place was cute, clean and everything we needed to tour around Lisbon. Highly recommend

Ik heb enorm genoten van mijn verblijf! Alles was perfect in orde en erg aangenaam. Een absoluut hoogtepunt was het uitzicht vanaf het balkon – zo leuk om de tram voorbij te zien rijden! Dat gaf echt het gevoel van het bruisende Lissabon. Een heerlijke plek om te verblijven, met veel charme en karakter. Aanrader!
Logement partagé dans quartier populaire. C'est génial d'être vraiment au Portugal et pas dans un hôtel sans âme. Un peu bruyant mais ça passe. Prêts à revenir.
Una habitación bastante céntrica y muy recomendable
Chambre très bien situé, propre et près de tout dans Alfama.  Nous avons adoré marcher dans le beau quartier d'Alfama.  Merci!

Quarto e casa de banho limpo e agradável, check in fácil. A única coisa é que pareceu um bocadinho insegura as redondezas da estação Martim Moniz que é a mais perto do alojamento, mas de resto impecável.
Great Host, Great place to be! Fair price aswell :)

We really enjoyed our stay here. It was easy to find and check in, and we had great communication throughout with Art and Ros.
Someone mentioned in their review that the ceilings were low, they are lower than normal but my partner is 6ft2 and didn't have any issues.
Facile d’accès, propre et bon emplacement dans la quartier Alfama.
Pour des personnes qui se couchent tót, trop de bruit.

boyfriend, 1.85m tall, nearly could not stand fully. The host claimed they were 2.30m high. Furthermore there was a lot of mold on the walls, which is a serious threat to anyone’s health. The host claimed, that this mold would’ve been easy to remove, which would’ve been done by the cleaning stuff the next day as they told us. Standing in the bedroom we felt as if we were in the street, since the “windows” were super thin. For that issue the host offered ear plugs. Also the private bathroom could have only been reached crossing a non privater corridor, that should be mentioned.
We left the apartment fast after realizing it was different from the description and pictures and booked a hotel room instead. The hosts were not understanding, offering the mentioned so called solutions, but ending up refunding only a quarter of the payed price.
Consiglio vivamente l'appartamento di Art e Roz
Tout est super !

La habitación es tal cual a la de la foto, el baño y los espacios comunes también, todo funciona correctamente, solo hay un poco de ruido del resto de los departamentos y la calle pero se soluciona súper fácil con tapones, es una excelente opción para quedarse en Lisboa!
The place matches the description. Host is very helpful and responsive.

This place was a great find in Lisbon - the room is small, but is a great deal for the price. There is a bustling street below, which gave a great lively city energy to the location. The bathroom was clean, and the shared space was lovely. The apartment is in a great location, it's a manageable walk to anywhere you want to go in Lisbon. The room was a bit stuffy, and the cleanliness of the window area leaves a bit to be desired, but overall the space was great.

We were frankly a bit disappointed by this experience.
The room was miniscule and bed was narrow for even two slim people and the mattresses were a back-breaker to say with modesty.
The air inside all rooms was constantly humid and musty, especially we felt the most in our bedroom.
The concept of this deal was really mind-boggling since it was advertised as private bedroom with a private bathroom as well as all the pictures from the sitting room included whereas actually only one line hidden in the description mentioned that there would be another bedroom let out to other guests. This last point was never explicitly highlighted in their description, leading us to believe that we would be the only guests during our stay albeit we would only have one of the rental bedrooms to ourselves. And that is why we booked the apartment.
Not saying it is completely fault of the owners, but we would really recommend to make it 100% clear in the description, especially when booking from the phone.
Estuvimos muy agusto, un placer!!
Excelente acomodação. Muito bem localizada.  casa perfeita, conforme a descrição. muito obrigado Art e Ros pela hospitalidade e pelo quiches que estavam deliciosos.
Μικρό πολύ για τα λεφτά που έδωσα αν και φουλ καθαρό και είχε εξοπλισμό δε μπορώ να πω
As fotos  mostram muito  bem o lugar

Wir sind sehr zufrieden! Sehr gut und schön eingerichtete Wohnung! Schön sauber, mit voller Ausstattung, so wie erwartet!
Wir waren prinzipiell sehr zufrieden mit dem Service, die Gastgeber waren sehr leicht zu erreichen und haben uns bei etwaigen Problemen schnellstmöglichst und freundlich weitergeholfen.
Die Lage der Wohnung ist zentral gelegen. Jedoch befindet sie sich in einer engen Gasse, wo es vorallem Tagsüber bis in die späte Nacht hinein sehr laut ist. Für uns war es jedoch nicht ein allzu großes Problem, da wir nicht so geräuschempfindlich sind.
Danke liebe Gastgeber für den schönen Aufenthalt! Wir empfehlen diese Wohnung aufjedenfall damit weiter!
Amazing room, clean place. We loved staying here.
Muito excelente sua acomodação

L'appartement est vraiment très bien situé! A un quart d'heure à pied de beaucoup de choses (château Saint Georges, quartier Chiado, Alfama, place du commerce...). Le logement est plutôt grand et à tout ce qu'il faut en équipements. L'hôte est très gentil, il nous a donné des indications sur ce qu'il y avait à faire par exemple.
L'arrivée autonome est vraiment super, nous sommes repartis dans la nuit donc c'est plus simple.
J'enlève 1 étoile car c'est très bruyant. On entend tout de la rue (très bruyante jusqu'à 1h à 2h du matin environ) et que dans l'appartement et l'immeuble on entend le moindre pas. Heureusement l'hôte a gentiment mis à notre disposition des bouchons d'oreilles. L'autre point négatif est que le lit n'est pas de très bonne qualité. Nous sommes certainement habitués à nos lits de bonne qualité mais la on sentait les lattes et le moindre mouvement faisait du bruit.
Pour conclure, l'appartement est très bien malgré les quelques points négatifs énoncés.

El Depto está bien, la calle es muy ruidoso y en la vereda hay 100 hindús, muchos hombres sobre las calles, lleno, de día y de noche, eso hizo q no me pareciera atractivo Lisboa. Nos sentimos muy incómodos, no podíamos abrir la ventana porque nos miraban de abajo y uno le dijo a mi hijo que no podía filmar con el celular.

Le logement était fidèle à la description, très bien placé (la rue était bruyante mais nous avions des boules Quiès à disposition), notre salle de bain était seulement pour nous, nous avons pu faire une machine. Le plus: Possibilité d'utiliser Netflix. Merci !
We truly appreciate your hospitality and attention to detail. Everything has been perfect!

Muy lindo alojamiento . Súper cálido. Tal cual lo muestra el
Anunció. Si bien no tuvimos ningún inconveniente, La zona parece insegura.
Walkable location. Airbnb was great.

Die Wohnung war so wie auf den Bildern zu sehen. Das Schlafzimmer (dein persönlicher Raum) war eher klein aber schön eingerichtet. Auch der Rest der Wohnung war schön hergerichtet. Die Küche könnte mehr Ausstattung vertragen aber zum einfachen kochen reicht es gut aus. Die Wohnung liegt sehr zentral und von dort aus kann man gut alles in der Stadt anschauen gehen. Man hat eine sehr gute Anbindung an den Nahverkehr. Die Kommunikation lief sehr sehr gut mit nützlichen Tipps und der Beantwortung aller Fragen. Ich kann diese Wohnung weiterempfehlen.

Mi sono trovato benissimo nell’alloggio di Art e Ros, perfetta per trascorrere qualche giorno. Alloggio molto pulito e in una buona posizione. La zona sembra poco sicura ma in realtà le persone sono totalmente innocue.
Lisbona è molto sicura. Consiglio vivamente se si vuole trascorrere qualche giorno a lisbona senza spendere tanto!:)

We had a very disappointing experience with this Airbnb. Initially, I relied on the reviews and thought it was a great deal, but paying €80 for this place was a big mistake. Honestly, you’d be better off paying a little more for a hotel or another option.
The room is incredibly cramped—you can easily touch the ceiling with your hand, and it’s very small overall. With so many instructions provided in the listing, I almost expected a 5-star experience, but it was far from it.
They provide noise blockers, but even with those, you can still clearly hear conversations from the other rooms.
The neighborhood is as well so dirty and you really feel unsafe.
I strongly recommend avoiding this place. It’s just not worth the money.

Our host is very responsive and friendly!
Location is walkable to everywhere 🫶
Très sympa comme place nous avons bien aimé merci !
Alles super, tolle Lage dafür zwar etwas laut aber Gastgeberin hat sogar Oropax bereitgestellt :) nette Kommunikation und schnelle Antworten

Very nice journey, good accommodation and it is next to the city centre. The only inconvenient is the noise and there are lot of guys wandering around and in front of the entry (which can be uncomfortable, especially if you are a girl)

Bellissimo soggiorno, casa che da la possibilità di raggiungere le attrazioni principali in poco tempo.
Host reattivo nella risposta ai messaggi, gentile e disponibile!
Consiglio fortemente.
Very nice and easy place. I recommend this place.

Logement idéalement situé pour visiter Lisbonne. L’hôte est très courtois et disponible.
Mais la rue est très bruyante et mal fréquentée, nous ne nous sommes pas sentis en sécurité.
We enjoyed the few days in Lissbon and the Airbnb is perfect for this purpose.
Great place and close to everything!

We had a good stay, the place is nice and very clean, the hosts were responsive and friendly! The room is quite small for two but okay when it's a short trip.  The bathroom is across the hall but was also clean and had everything needed, as did the kitchen and living space. The locations is very convenient but also very busy and extremely noisy at night - which is doable with noise-canceling headphones or earplugs which were kindly provided.  It can get quite warm in the room, there was a fan but it was really dusty/dirty so we didn't end up using it and because of the noise and cigarette smoke coming in from outside it wasn't really possible to leave the windows open for a longer time,  plus everyone at street level was able to see inside. Overall though, it is a decent short term stay.

We had a good 5 night stay and everything went well. We checked in ourselves and did not meet the hosts. The room and bathroom are very small, a bit smaller than we expected from the photos. Unfortunately, the street is noisy and noise can be heard from the room on the 1st floor until late but the hosts left ear plugs for us to use in the room. Overall it was a good deal for the price, the location in the city centre is great and just a few hundred metres from a metro station. Thanks for this!
Muito aconchegante e organizado. Os anfitriões são muito solícitos e respondem prontamente. Gostamos muito.
We had a good stay in lisbon  and great access to the metro.

We stayed 4 nights in the apartment. From the apartment you can quickly get to the Alfama neighborhood and one metro station. We found a really nice cafe to have breakfast just around the corner (Kossies Cafe). The street is a bit spooky in the night, but we didn’t experience anything bad. The accommodation provided everything we needed! Take into account that the ceiling is quite low and the room is very small. The fan was a big plus! :) The communication with the host was perfect.

Arthur est une personne très agréable à l'écoute de nos demandes. Le logement est propre, fonctionnel dans un quartier très animé et populaire. Nous avons rencontré un problème de vibrations bruyantes qui a beaucoup perturbé nos nuits. Nous pensons à une climatisation. Arthur est venu constater et pensons et espérons que le problème est maintenant reglé .
Super séjour !
Great place to stay, close to touristic places and public transport. Clean room and bathroom.

The accomodation was very comfortable, clean and tidy. Everything I needed was in the apartment and the instructions were easy to navigate. I would certainly recommend this accomodation to fellow travellers visiting Lisbon

Place was clean and everything was nice and neat, however the room we were in was smaller than expected. Bathroom was clean and had a good shower, just a little small. The location was good, however be aware you are very close to the busy street when you open the room windows/doors. Overall it was a good place to stay for a couple nights considering we were out all day.
Lugar limpo e pequeno.
Great stay!

Das Zimmer war sehr zentral.
Klein aber ausreichend für 2 Nächte.
Lindo lugar muy céntrico a pocas cuadras de la estación Martín Moniz. Se puede recorrer a pie la gran parte de lugares turísticos

The listing is wrong about check-in/out hours. The bathroom was not private. There were other guests but the listing makes it sound like this is someone’s current home. It was dirty, the walls were stained. There were mold stains on the ceilings and it smelled musty. The bed was horrendous and the pillows rock hard, and with humidity stains. The bathroom was minuscule. The stove top was broken. If that wasn’t enough, this morning we found a cockroach in the kitchen cupboard. Wouldn’t recommend.

We loved our stay! Amazing location, very clean, and has a washer and small kitchen that were very helpful. We loved the small streets and amazing shops and restaurants nearby, and it's easy to get to any form of transportation. The ceilings are a bit low, but not really a problem, and you can't beat the price, location, and convenience.
L alloggio è in una posizione centrale, ideale per esplorare la città

Very nice and clean, the apartment itself, but the entrance to the apartment was very disappointing at the first sight, because you don’t know if the apartment is going to be the same.   Our bedroom door would not lock, didn’t feel safe.
Appartement très bien situé et bonne communication avec l’hôte!

Pros: Great communication. Place is quite clean, and has all required amenities. It is centrally located, making it very easy to walk to most of the key attractions in Lisbon, and also has great connections to Sintra and the airport.
Cons: It can be a bit noisy. Hosts do provide earplugs, and it didn't bother me much, but this might be an issue for people who have trouble with sleep. Also, the neighbourhood is not very good. It doesn't seem safe (even though I didn't actually run into any incident). Basically, it is plagued with poverty. There's these groups of poor young men smoking, hanging out, and just loitering around. This means that windows (right above the street) can't be kept open. This is primarily an issue only after sunset. During the day, there is quite a bit of tourist activity in the area so it doesn't feel this way. Maybe it looks more unsafe than it actually is, but solo women (especially if you're timid) might want to consider this vibe.
We had a wonderful stay, would recommend. Great location and great communication!

Me fui encantado! El lugar es súper cómodo y tiene todos los productos de primera que se necesita para una buena estadía. Cerca al centro a pie aprox 10 min pero las calles son excelentes para poder conocer la ciudad.
super cute stay in the heart of lisbon!

Estuvimos muy a gusto en nuestra instancia en Lisboa, todo muy limpio y ordenando en la habitación.

Very cute tiny place, amazing for a short trip

I spent a night in their stay. It was very beautiful in the morning. Overall transportations are near. Tram 28 passing everyday from your window is a beautiful bonus. It’s not big but perfect for 2 people. Love everything about it and the hosts are the loveliest :)

Arthur e Rosa são ótimos anfitriões, o check in é bem fácil e o apartamento possui tudo que se precisa para passar os dias em Lisboa. Para quem carrega muita mala e desce da estação de metrô, só existe uma pequena subida que demanda um pequeno esforço, mas nada que atrapalhe o acesso a estadia.  Em uma próxima viagem com certeza retornarei à acomodação.
Great stay, clean and convenient location. Easy check in and out process, and communication was amazing!
Logement très bien situé. Tout près d'une station de métro et à quelques pas  du centre ville.

Art and Ros' place will give you a lovely place to rest your head close to the subway system. It was nice to have multiple options for covers, as well as fans if it got too warm. It is nice to watch the iconic yellow trams go up the street nearby.
Fantastic host, fantastic accommodation.  Easy check in and great communication with host.  Would highly recommend.

Buon appartamento vicino al centro. Con il soffitto un po’ basso l’appartamento è situato in una zona multiculturale vicinissima al castello di st Jeorge (quartiere molto bello). Durante la mia esperienza la seconda camera è stata occupata solo per dormire una notte. Check in automatico con codice molto comodo ed utile come per me che sono arrivato di notte. Esperienza senza pretese e positiva.

Convenient stay with great location in Lisbon with everything you need. Super easy check in and amazing communication from the hosts. Accommodated early arrivals and late checkouts with allowing us to drop off bags. Definitely not the most bougie stay, but certainly great value!
We stayed for here for the night, was a decent stay:)

We spent one night in the apartement.
It was clean and tidy and we felt welcome from the beginning.
The Location is great you can reach everything by foot.
Since the house is old you will hear people going up and down the stairs and the street can be quite loud.
Closing the windows helps a lot.
Communication with the host and check-in and /-out was fast and easy.
We recommend staying there and also the smal Italian Restaurante across the street.
Good location - well connected via the metro and easy to walk around the old town directly from the property.

Art's communication and assistance was fantastic. Room and shared spaced was as described. Area is a bit dodgy at night. Few people always standing around in front of the main entrance to the apartment building.
We had a great stay at Art and Ros. They are super nice and gave us many information about Lisbon. The mattress was a little bit uncomfy but overall we had a great stay!
Otima localizacao e apartanento simples e bem equipado

dank der tollen und zentralen Lage der Wohnung war alles gut zu Fuß erreichbar, bzw der Weg zur nächsten U-Bahn oder Straßenbahn nicht weit. Den nächtlichen und morgendliche Straßenlärm konnten wir gut als Lissabon Erlebnis inkludieren😉🌺

I can highly recommend staying with Art and Ros. The apartment is ideally located, very easy to reach also by public transport from the airport. The room is comfortable, the apartment is very clean and the kitchen is fully equipped. Communication worked really well always with a super fast response time. Art and Ros were really helpful. I enjoyed my stay very much :)
Mieszkanie czyste, wszystko zgodnie z opisem :)

I just stayed overnight while passing through Lisbon.  But everything was fine as described.  Easy to find, to check in to.  Super central.  Had the chance to run into Art in person.  Lovely person and attentive to making your stay as enjoyable as possible.

The apartment is lovely and you can tell the hosts put a lot of effort in it to make it feel more like home. Location is great and with closed windows we slept really well! We had the pleasure to meet Arthur and he gave us some good recommendations for our short stay.
Also we were able to check in a bit earlier and after check out we could leave our luggage in the leaving room until we had to leave to the airport. Thanks again!

The communication with the hosts was great and the check-in was super easy thanks to the accurate description. The location is very central, there are many small shops on the street and the metro station is only 5 minutes away.
Muy centrico
We really enjoyed staying with Art & Ros . Absolutely no complaints.
Für einen schönen Wochenendtrip die perfekte Wohnung in Lissabon. Artur war sehr nett und hilfreich. Die Lage ist grandios, man muss jedoch mit Straßenlärm rechnen. Vielen Dank für alles!

We really enjoyed our stay! The flat was super nice and clean and we didn't miss anything. We had the double room with shared bathroom but we had it for ourselves as there were no other guests using it. The location is perfect for exploring Lisboa and Artur gave us lots of tips for the city – I would totally recommend this place!
Lovely host, great place and such a convenient location (public transport and stores)!
Amazing stay and find! Ana and her sons were very welcoming and  helpful! Great experience all around!

We had a good time staying with Artur. The place is in a good location - although very noisy and a tiny bit dodgy.
The room is small but the bed was comfortable. You should book if you are >1,90m since the ceiling is very low.
Lovely room in a lovely apartment! Good and easy communication. Had the possibility to left our luggage in the apartment after 12pm:) Thank you!

Art & Ros’s apt is great. It has everything you need, great amenities and good value! The location is nice too. The tram pass right in front of the main entrance of the building. I recommend this place.
We were really in the centre of Lisboa and could walk easily to all the sights. Our bed was really comfortable and the bathroom as well as the kitchen were pretty clean!
We enjoyed a wonderful 1 night stay with easy check in and could even leave our bags in the morning before check in which was a huge help!
Tudo certo, nada a apontar.

Super cute apartement with really lovely hosts. A super nice biological shop apposite. A warm welcome and perfect tipps from the hosts.
Thank you Art and Ros.

Cozy apartment close to the main points of interest. The room was small but we didn't spend too much time there so we didn't mind too much. The room is located just above a busy street so there is quite a bit of noise that can be heard. However close the door and it's nice and quiet for sleeping. There is a small fan too which cools the room a bit. There were some dodgy characters outside the apartment building that were hanging about all of the time and seemed to be drugged up, but this is no fault of the host. We felt safe and just kept our distance. When leaving we met Arthur who was preparing for the new guests and he was a pleasure to talk with. I recommend this place for a short weekend break.
Super Unterkunft zu einem unschlagbaren Preis. In 10-15min ist man zu Fuß im Zentrum der Stadt! 🙂

Alloggio molto carino e posizione ottima proprio vicino la metro!
Unica pecca, lavandino veramente piccolo.

Small apartment located very central. Stayed there one night and it was perfect. A short work to the metro and easy to get to/from the airport.
One thing to note is that the apartment building is old and therefore the ceilings are low. This host Art was very nice and accommodating. Check in was easy.

The apartment is very centrally located, close to a metro station on the green line. There are many cozy pedestrian streets where you can stroll around. The apartment has 3 bedrooms, one of which is yours and you will be sharing the apartment with 2 other tenants. The kitchen is well equipped and the apartment was squeeky clean.

The flat is located in very loud neighborhood so if you are looking for a quite place for sure it wouldn’t be the best choice. From the window you can touch a tram when it passes by and there are shops open 24/7. on the other hand the flat is closed to the main attractions in Lisbon and surrounded by many nice restaurants :) In the kitchen you can find everything you need to cook your own meals. It’s ok place to stay 2 or 3 nights.
The stay was amazing and great price
nice place!

Очень комфортное заселение. Приятные владельцы. В квартире есть всё необходимое. Очень близко к центру и старому городу . Идеальное расположение. Но очень низкие потолки ,шумная улица и не очень новая мебель. Цена качество соответствуют.
The location was perfect as everything was reachable by foot. The house was clean and tidy and check-in was super easy. Thank you Art & Ros.

Nette kleine Wohnung, die man sich mit einem anderen dort vermieteten Zimmer teilt. Alles ist sehr sauber. Artur selber wohnt nicht mehr in der Wohnung. Wir haben ihn einmal angetroffen, er hat uns herzlich empfangen und viele Tipps in und um Lissabon gegeben, die sehr nützlich waren 😊 ein sehr netter Mensch. Küche und Waschmaschine kann man mitbenutzen. Uns hat der Aufenthalt gut gefallen, gerade, weil die Wohnung sehr zentral liegt. Wir können es nur weiterempfehlen!
really nice place, great location, easy checking, comfortable and clean
The location was really good with a beautiful view of the old town, Art was really nice and helpful he gave us very good suggestions about beautiful places to visit in the city, I highly recommend it
Thanks Art and Ros for the wonderful stay!
The location is fantastic, the prices were great, and the check in process was super simple. Art and Ros were wonderful about communicating and working with us. highly recommend staying here.
Check-In went very smooth and Art was very friendly and gave a lot of tips. We felt very comfortable.

A perfect room in a perfect location! So close to the Martim Moniz station, plenty of stores ans restaurants nearby, and a close walk to many great sights. The flat was clean with everything you could need, and Art was an excellent and very welcoming communicator who gave GREAT suggestions!
Very nice place to stay for a few days in Lisbon

Art’s place has the best location - the city center is just around the corner. You get to explore Lisbon on foot. Art is also super responsive and kind.  The apartment itself is so clean and organized.

Schöne kleine Wohnung in top Lage um Lissabon zu erkunden. Allerdings sollte man im Juni darauf achten dass es in den Straßen rund herum sehr sehr laut sein kann aufgrund verschiedener Feiertage sodass es schwierig wird ruhig zu schlafen wenn man nicht selber in Party Laune ist.

I really enjoyed my stay at Art & Ros’s place! The flat is located really centrally, so I never needed to take public transport and could walk anywhere! The hosts made me feel really welcome and taken care of throughout the whole stay - you can see they truly care about their guests! Communication and check-in was really smooth, the place was clean and had all the amenities you may need for a comfortable stay. I also had a great chat with Art, one of the hosts, who provided great suggestions on what to do, eat and see based on my time and preferences! I will definitely recommend this place to others.
Krásná a klidná, i když krátká noc. Ubytování jsme využili u přeletu s dlouhým časovým odstupem mezi dvěma lety. Vše bylo, jak popsáno. Příště snad na více hodin :)
As advertised. Plus easy check in for our late arrival.
Great stay, great hospitality!
El vecindario es feo hay mucho ruido en la calle y gente afuera todo el tiempo. Al entrar son miedosas las escaleras pero adentro de la habitación se siente bien.
O local fica muito perto do centro da cidade a pé, e o bairro da Alfama é um charme! A cara de Lisboa! Voltaria sempre!
100% recomendable
Great location, super comfy and easy check in. Would really recommend for a city break :)
很棒的房東，很有耐心，而且地理位置非常棒！

Arthur was a great and welcoming host, his apartmant was nice and was cleaned thoroughly (no downsides there). Upon arrival he gave us some basic tips of what to see and where to eat in the city. He ocassionaly leaves his lovely cat Mia in the apartment, so if you like animals, this is definitely another positive point. I can only recommend his place for stay.
Very nice and central. A lovely cat was welcoming us.

Great place to crash for the night. Very small bathroom and you’re definitely sharing the space but super easy to get to and the hosts have got a good set up with keys / directions etc.
Would recommend to anyone passing through for a short stay.

Bein situé !
Nous avons passé un bon séjour, une chatte très câline.
Proche de tram 28.
Le tram 12 passé devant l'appartement.

C'est un endroit idéal pour un arrêt pour une nuit. Le chat était trop mignon, même s'il nous a réveillé a plusieurs reprises car il voulait rentrer dans la chambre. Sinon, c'est très très bruyant à l'extérieur pendant la nuit, il faut s'y attendre.

Chambre en plein centre de Lisbonne à deux pas du quartier alfama et de la cathedrale sé. Excellente communication avec les hôtes, appartement propre et la chambre est bien. Petot plus poir la charlante Mia, le chat de la maison. Bonne adresse

Art and Ros's house is the most strategical choice in terms of where to stay in Lisbon.
The flat is big and cosy and their cat Mia is an amazing companion.

Perfect stay, the apartment was exactly as the picture, clean and well located.
Art & Ros were available and agreed very kindly to keep our luggage for a few more hours.

La chambre et l'appartement sont propres et très bien situés pour découvrir la ville. L'appart est partagé avec d'autres voyageurs et un chat. Il se trouve au premier étage côté rue. En contrepartie et pour ces derniers points, il est un peu bruyant.
A savoir pour ceux qui recherchent de la tranquillité.
Would definitely come back again ! Everything was great, and it's in a great location to explore the city. Also the cat is absolutely adorable :)
All was as expected, comfortable, clean, good facilities.
Thanks for a cool apartment🙂
Passage éclair, une soirée/une nuit sur Lisbonne. Logement très bien situé !
Unterkunft nur zu empfehlen. Typisch klein, aber süß eingerichtet mit allem was man braucht.

L’appartement collectif proposé par Arthur & Ros est petit mais très chaleureux.
Bien situé, il nous a permis de visiter Lisbonne quelques jours.
Nous le recommandons.
Clean and cosy apartment, through no fault of the owners, the area is quite lively and loud, which makes it difficult for a good nights sleep. Other than this, a great stay!
I can really recommend this place, great location, clean and a good value for money. Comes with a very friendly cat too :)
Thank you for the great stay! Mia the cat is really lovely
I just stayed one night and for this the room was perfectly adequate. I always use Oropax for sleeping and would recommend that for anyone since the street can be quite busy.
Mitten in Alfama. Empfehlenswert!
It was great !
All good
Sweet little shared flat in a nice area of Lisboa.
Host spettacolare
Artur es un anfitrión genial, es una persona muy interesante, comunicadora y nos ayudó mucho con recomendaciones sobre Lisboa. El piso es bonito  agradable. Recomiendo la estancia en este Airbnb.

Casa situata al centro di Lisbona, in uno dei quartieri più antichi. Dotata di tutti i confort necessari, abbiamo passato una vacanza molto piacevole.
Un consiglio: munitevi di tappi per la notte, purtroppo il quartiere è molto rumoroso.
Host molto gentile, ho avuto il piacere di conoscerlo 😊
Consigliato se volete essere a due passi dal centro
Extremely convenient between two popular neighborhoods. Easy and convenient check in and check out
Es un piso acogedor y muy bien ubicado para conocer la parte histórica de Lisboa. Lo recomiendo y volveríamos a tomarlo.
the location is very good
Appartement chaleureux à côté du métro.

Great experience, neat and clean flat,
Location is also good,
Faced difficulties in shifting luggage to the room, because of upstairs also faced issues in calling host.
But overall great experience.
Chambre très bien placée. Un hôte très accueillant et très sympathique. Nous avons passé un très bon séjour ! Merci encore
It is a nice apartment, the location is convinient and Artur was a nice and understanding host.
Nice and clean place. Arthur is a super friendly host! Everything perfect.
Top
Everything was perfect
Art & Ros, were great hosts and very helpful. Can recommend fully!
L’appartement est très beau et bien situé. Il est très bien équipé, avec une cuisine très fonctionnelle. La pépite du séjour reste le chat, un amour

Great location in downtown lisbon. hosts are communicative, available, and accommodating. the rooms and bathroom is clean and the bed is pretty comfy. wifi works well throughout the flat. great book. p.s. i still don’t get why the portuguese put the light switch outside of the bathroom but that’s neither here nor there

We had a great time during our stay in Lisbon. The host is very kind, helpful and sweet and gives you very nice recommendations and tips. The room is big enough for two people and the shared bathroom is nice and clean.

Perfect!
Everything was on point🙏
Artur is a great host, he was very welcoming and gave us excellent suggestions. The apartment is beautiful and has all you need. 100% recommended

We checked into the place for a short time before discovering that the place wasn’t for us.
The neighborhood the apartment is located in is kinda sketchy. Walking as a woman did not feel comfortable to me. On the way to the apartment we’ve seen syringes and utensils for drug use.
The apartment itself is pretty small, considering you are going to share it with the owners and maybe another tenant. I could recommend this place for students or more adventurous travelers, but not for people on holiday.
Besides all the negative criteria I can definitely point out that communication with Art & Ros was always super easy and comfortable! I can imagine them being great hosts overall.

Lovely room with a shared bathroom, kitchen & living room.   Sort of like a small hostel.   Very clean & well stocked.   Great location from which to explore Alfama & the entire city of Lisbon.  Nice & close to public transportation.
Perfect location, nice place
Unfortunately we had to cancel our stay but the hosts were very understanding and communication was excellent
Das Zimmer sowie die Wohnung ist sauber. Die Wohnung liegt fussläufig zu den wichtigen Sehenswürdigkeiten und der Gastgeber war auch sehr freundlich.

The interior of the apartment is okay. The room is cosy and the bed is super comfortable, though the room looks smaller than in the photos (because of photographical distortion).
However, the building itself is really old and is located at a sketchy area/street… What’s worse is that the room (Room 1) is right next to the street so be prepared for a lot of noise at night. Also I experienced a terrible night when the neighbors right above the room were speaking till very late at night and I had to put on my noise-cancellation headphones to be able to fall asleep…
Check-in is detailed but it’s kind of difficult to open the building door with the key as it’s an old building…

Very well located, clean room.
Nothing to complain about and I loved the cat, Mia.
great location close to lots of good restaurants. the hosts were very helpful and gave me great recommendations. Will be returning when I come back to Lisbon! thank you!

Greatest place I could have picked. The location is great, the place is perfect, the host Artur is gracious and a true pleasure to socialize with. Didn’t think I’d leave Lisbon having made a new friend! Thank you for everything!
PS: Mia the cat is the queen of the place and there’s no discussion about it
Super Platz, tolle Lage, nette Leute
nice room, good area

Un apartamento estupendo, muy limpio y tranquilo. La calle del apartamento puede dar mala impresion en un pricipio pero esta muy bien situado. Llegas muy facil desde el aeropuerto, tienes paradas de metro muy cerca y la plaza de Rossio a 15 minutos andando. Muchos puntos turìsticos muy cerca del apartamento.
Anfitrión muy agradable y discreto. La gatita Mia súper cariñosa. Muy buen apartamento, lo recomiendo sin duda.
(Para entrar, no desesperes con la llave, cuesta un poco abrir la puerta de entrada de la calle). Por todo lo demas, todo estupendo!
Very cozy and perfectly located place.
Amazing location with an exceptional host. Very welcoming!

Logement bien placé et propre ! Cuisine libre d’accès. Salle de bain petite mais praticable et le fait que les toilettes soient dedans c’est assez compliqué quand les autres hôtes prennent leur douche (surtout le matin)…
Concernant la chambre, elle est propre, seulement le lit n’est pas confortable et les oreillers sont durs (merci pour le torticolis). De plus, l’isolation est horrible entre le voisin du dessus qui déménage à 4h du matin et la rue où il y a des gens qui campent h24 devant. Pensez à amener vos boules quies.
Sinon le chat est super mignon
It was great, room was clean, location is good, and lovely cat 🐈 Mia.

Excelente ubicación y limpio.
muy recomendado.
I had a great stay. After reading other reviews, I brought earplugs, which I found very helpful to block out the street noise. Very clean and seamless checkin.

We arrived at midnight, the host were very friendly and they were waiting for us with their friendly cat. The place is tiny, but cute and tidy. It's an old house in downtown, so expect small inner height&area and noisy street and upper neighbors.

Don't look for another place, you're at the right spot to enjoy Lisbon !
Really well located, you will feel at home, visiting a friend. Artur is a great host, thank you for your advices to discover your neighbour and have a taste of the city. Everything was perfect !
Tolles Zimmer, sehr gut gelegen. Host hilfsbereit und freundlich
Tout s’est bien passé, merci

Artur es increíble y el lugar también. Nuestra estancia fue corta pero muy placentera, esta cerca de todo y sin duda Artur se encargó de hacernos sentir como en casa y ayudarnos con todas las dudas que teníamos de los alrededores 😊 gracias! y esperamos volver algún día!
Loved the cat! so close to the airport and in a super cool area.

La chambre est située dans un appartement à plusieurs chambres, au premier étage d'un immeuble dans l'hypercentre. Le quartier est très sympatique, pour se garer il faut chercher un peu dans les ruelles pour éviter les parkings payants. La chambre était propre, la salle de bain (partagée avec les autres chambres) propre aussi. Côté négatif, un peu bas de plafond et un peu bruyant car la rue populaire comprend de nombreux petits commerces. En somme, bon rapport qualité-prix pour passer une nuit bien placé au coeur de Lisbonne.

Art’s place is in an excellent location - finding the apartment and check in were really easy with Art’s instructions. We had a really comfortable stay and lots of cuddles with the super friendly cat, Mia! Art was welcoming and accommodating, Obrigado!! 😊

had a great stay at Arthur's place - clean and nice location which makes it convenient to go everywhere. Arthur is one of the best host you could have, he made me use the public area just as my own place…which is really warm :) There is also a blackcat called MIA in the house who can cuddle with you for a morning/after nap (^･ｪ･^)

We were really satisfied!
Apartment was clean and nice! Thank you

This place was a perfect first stop for us in Portugal. The place had everything we needed, plus a cute and friendly cat! We were within walking distance of everything we wanted to see and Art was very friendly and helpful. We would absolutely stay here again!

Easy place to get to from the metro, had everything an Airbnb usually has and safe location with lots of lighting during the night, shared apartment with other guests, they were quiet and kept to themselves.
Nice People, cute cat, fun trip!
it was a very cute apartment in a great location. it has everything you need and it is very clean. we had a great time and were given good advice about where to go!
Simplicidade e eficiência com boa localização, tudo que um "quase local! gosta de ter.

Artur ist ein toller Gastgeber und hat uns gleich nach der Ankunft mit Tipps für Lissabon versorgt. Das Zimmer ist klein aber fein und die ganze Wohnung ist gemütlich und liegt super zentral. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt!

We can fully recommend to stay in Arthur's apartment. The location is in walking distance to discover Lisbon and also very close to the metro. Arthur was super kind and helpful with everything we wanted to know (thanks for the recommendation on the place for eating steak). Lovely and welcoming stay. Great recommendations from the host!

Superbe endroit, nous sommes arrivés tard et parti tôt mais on a pu se croiser, accueil chaleureux et sympathique !

Very nice Arthur and apartment and Mia so so so cute!
Wirklich tolles Zimmer mit super Lage! Auch mit den Gastgebern hat alles problemlos funktioniert und sie haben uns herzlich begrüßt. Sehr empfehlenswert. Würden wir auf jeden Fall weiterempfehlen! ☺️
nice apartment very clean near by to the center and Mr Arthur very gentle and polite person. The cat inside is the mascot of the house and very friendly with people
Great host and great accomodation!
great accommodation with a wonderful host!  I highly recommend

Parfait !

Absolutely the best airbnb in Lisboa. The house is clean, the location and the view is fantastic and the cat is the best thing next to Art. Really friendly host that is super helpful in recommendations. I'll be back!
Great stay at Art&Ross !! Very nice welcome and great recommendations 😊😊 Recommend to everyone passing by Lisbon !!

The moment we arrived we felt like home. The apartment is just perfect for what we were looking for and the location was even better! If you’re searching for good vibes and a comfy place to stay for a few days in Lisbon, this is the one for sure.

Nice and cozy appartment. Very clean and tidy.
Lugar charmoso e bem localizado, um pouco barulhento, mas isso não atrapalhou em nada , e tem um co-anfitriã linda a gatinha “MIA” , obrigado

Localização excelente, próximo de quase todos os pontos turísticos, porém no anúncio não tem fotos da escada de acesso ao apartamento que está literalmente caindo aos pedaços, da medo, toda suja e com mal cheiro!

Estuve alojada 7 noches y durante esos días no conocí ni al anfitrión ni a nadie que se presentara como gestor del alojamiento.
El sistema de entrada y salida se basa en cofres que hay que abrir introduciendo una numeración determinada y una vez abierto extraer una llave. Para el acceso a pie de calle el cofre está colgado en la puerta del portal y con el reflejo del sol cuesta ver los números a introducir. Durante el tiempo de los intentos, hasta llegar a la conclusión que de las tres filas de números la que interesa es la del medio, la gente que transita por la calle debe bajarse de la acera porque dos personas juntas no caben. Cuando se consigue entrar al portal, hay que subir escaleras hasta el primer piso y acceder a otro cofre que está metido dentro de un cuadro de contadores. Ahí la dificultad consiste en ver algo porque la luz de la escalera se apaga cada siete segundos y hay que moverse para que la luz se active de nuevo. Si intentamos utilizar la linterna del móvil será tarea imposible porque el cofre no tiene estabilidad fija y hay que aguantarlo con una mano y con la otra colocar la numeración requerida y todo ello sin luz en la escalera.
Hacia el segundo día de mi estancia el anfitrión me envió un mensaje de bienvenida y la indicación que si necesitara algo que no dudara en pedírselo y le aseguré que así lo haría - Tres días antes de mi partida le pedí si el día de mi salida me permitía dejar la maleta y recogerla por la tarde. La respuesta del anfitrión fue que le gustaría ayudarme pero no podía porque estaba en Londres. . EN EL ANUNCIO se indica que existe la posibilidad de guardar el equipaje
EN EL ANUNCIO también se indica que debe limpiarse el espacio usado antes de partir y eso es totalmente imposible para mí o incluso para seis o siete personas corpulentas…..En la noche antes de mi partida cayó una moneda al suelo y al iluminar debajo de la cama para recogerla visualicé con horror, a través de una altura de 1,5 cm, que separa al suelo de la estructura compacta que acoge el colchón, que debajo de la cama hay un submundo, con objetos diversos, encendedor, monedas…. y una gruesa y extensa capa de polvo a la que el huésped no puede acceder para limpiarlo y parece ser que tampoco lo hace el responsable de mantenimiento de la empresa que gestiona Art, lo cual podría acabar siendo es un problema grave de sanidad.

The first room, mine, was fine. Furnishings were shabby, i.e. broken mirror frame, broken hooks for hanging clothes/towels, cat-scratched bed frame. Silly IKEA furnishings. No top sheet-- it was hard to have a comfortable temperature during the night -- either duvet on or duvet off. Nearly constant street noise. Artur did provide ear plugs. Two other rooms had occupants never saw. There was a living room and kitchen that were fine. No one seemed to use them except me. I was surprised by the black cat though it was friendly and jumped on my lap, and when it heard me in the morning, scratched the door to be let in.

Big windows open to the narrow street. Bannister was too dirty to hang a towel to dry -- inside it never did dry.. The shower head leaked spray everywhere.
The second morning, 3 people came in before 8 a.m., used the bathroom, and were either friends of an occupant accompanying her, or she was already in and they had a key to come in... They left about an hour later, but with my door within inches of the apartment door, I was awakened.

I have no idea why there are so many hand written notes about how wonderful he is. I had no personal contact or replies.
For the price, the place was good. I think the place could use a little upkeep.
