As a former host myself, I appreciate a lot how Arthur is providing to his guests more than a roof over the head but rather a very important piece of the puzzle that makes the experience of visiting Lisbon, complete, a warm and cozy home. Thank you
Not very nice street (twice caught a thief who climbed into a backpack)
Acomodação muito limpa e tranquila. O banheiro fica perto do quarto.
Super nice place, well located and Arturo was really helpful. A bit noisy during the night but it is not a big problem.
Hospedagem confortavel e de facil acesso as regioes turisticas. O anfitriao muito simpatico e prestativo.
really good place!! the apartment is nice and well equiped. like home..🙂

Would recommend Artur's place if you're looking to stay in Lisbon– safe, clean, and the location is great! An adorable bonus: his petite cat Mia, who is friendly and will welcome you back after your day out!
Great spot for a night in Lisbon. Very friendly cat.

I just stayed one night but: Great location, great room (quite small but everything u need), self check-in instructions were perfect. Ros was very friendly the few minutes i ran into him also with some good advices!
Would definetely recommend to stay there again
..only negative point: if you are VERY sensitive to smoke from cars.. Take another room as you are on the first floor and very close to the cars in the small street when the windows are open.. For me it was no problem.

Une excellente adresse trés bien située, dans un quartier populaire et authentique. La décoration simple et de bon goût, la literie confortable.  A éviter uniquement si vous êtes allergique au chat,  ou au bruit de la rue si vous laissez la fenêtre ouverte.

We had a nice stay at this central place. The next metro station was nearby and you can easily walk to many places in the city. As mentioned in the description the room is really noisy even at night. We didn't need the ear plugs as we closed the windows so the noise was okay. Ros gave us some beach equipment, tipps for the best beaches and even offered a surfboard which we really appreciated. Finally, Mia (the cat) was our highlight everyday when coming back to the flat. Thank you!

We were only there briefly for a night and had an early flight the next morning. There is a taxi rank just down the street which makes getting to the airport very easy. Self-check in was great. Thanks.

Quartier plus que" populaire" et un peu plus de propreté aurait été bienvenue. Salle de bain et WC communs pour" 3 chambres". Chambre minuscule. Trouver un hôtel en plein centre  revient moins cher. 1 ere expÉrience AIRBNB et derniere

It was Very nice to stay ať Ros place...
you are in the centre, near the castle. Ať the night its just noice, but you will get earplugs. Definitely recommend it.

My mother and I stayed in a room and it was such a great experience. Artur is very quick to respond to any questions, make sure to ask him for suggestions (even if you want to know whether you are being ripped off or not when buying merchandise outside or taking a cab) use his guidebook and make acquaintances with the other guests. That’s what I did and the experience could not have been better.
Very nice Location in the town center! Would do it again :) !

Logement très bien situé et aux portes du metro. Entrée autonome et très bien expliquée. Chat agréable. Appartement à 1m du passage du tram ce qui vous permet de profiter du charme de Lisbonne. Attention ça peut parfois être bruyant mais Ros a pensé à mettre à disposition des boules quies

Our stay was wonderful! Artur is a great host, he is really open and easy to talk to. The location of the apartment is just great and true to the discription. The communication before hand was really nice, Artur responds very quickly. Thanks again Artur, we will definitely come  back :)
The best apartment in Lisbon! Great location, friendly and helpful host, this place just has everything you need. Staying there felt like home. Highly recommend!

Ros’ location is unbeatable if you want to be in the heart of Lisbon. There are bars, restaurants, bodegas, and a laundry service (which you won’t need since Ros kindly allows guests to use the washing machine) within a one-block radius. The double room is bright with decent closet space and hangers and balcony doors that open onto the street side of the apartment. Ros met us quickly after we arrived and gave us informative and helpful background to Lisbon. He lives in the building so he’s available if you need him. As the other reviewers pointed out, the only downside is the noise. His apartment is on an intersection of two narrow streets that seems to be a popular hangout for locals who keep very late hours. It’s fun happy noise and Arturo leaves plenty of ear plugs in the nightstand if you need them. The apartment is cozy and compact and at your disposal. There are two other bedrooms for guests so the living room, kitchen and bathroom are shared spaces.

Artur was very hospitable and gave us a lot of good locations to go to. The place is in a very central location and in a fun neighborhood. Artur was also very flexible in letting us leave our luggage in the common area. Mia, the cat, was adorable but could be an issue if you have allergies (she really liked hanging out on our bed). All in all a great place, host, and value.
Lugar excelente.
Central location right across from a local market if you want veggies or groceries. Clean apt. Had my name written on the door. Cute cat!
Ótima localização!Gostei do espaço Artur.Obrigada.
位置在老城区，有些吵。三个房间公用卫生间。家里有只喵很可爱
Ótima localização, quarto agradavel

Excellent location if you are planning to just walk around the city centre of Lisbon. It is centrally located. A lot of food options and the tourist spots are just nearby. I enjoyed playing with the baby cat owned by Artur. Highly recommended this place if you are visiting in Lisbon.
Localização muito boa, quarto confortavel e limpo e Arthur é  um anfitrião muito simpático, recomendo !

Artur is a really pleasant guy and helpful with local tips/information.
The apartment is beautifully furnished and location is excellent - close to restaurants, bars, cafes, pharmacy and convenience stores. Great having a washing machine and then a drycleaner is a short 50m walk away to get your clothes dried in 18 mins!
I stayed in 2 different rooms as a result of extending my stay. The first room had a private ensuite. Even though there is a wardrobe and shelves to store clothes, the room was very tight for my 2 luggage cases and navigating the ensuite bathroom was a challenge. Can't swing a cat in it.
The second room I stayed in had much more space and I felt a more expansive energy in there. If given a choice or booked again, I would rather have the shared bathroom, instead of the room with private ensuite as it was just so small. Excellent location for a short stay. If space is important to you, book the room with a window and shared bathroom.
The living and dining area is nice and you will be comfortable.

Artur est une personne sympathique qui nous a mis rapidement à l'aise.
La procédure d'accès à l'appartement est plutôt ludique mais très efficace pour laisser toute liberté quant à l'horaire d'accès à l'appartement.
Sa localisation (proche arrêt métro et Aérobus, et autres transports), en fait un point de départ intéressant pour se déplacer facilement, y compris à pied.
amazing location and great host
Artur fait ce qu'il faut pour être agréable et de bon conseil

Nous avons été ravis de séjourner chez Artur qui est une personne très accueillante, discrète et de bon conseil pour visiter Lisbonne. Son logement est très propre, bien situé pour ceux qui aiment marcher, nous avons toujours circulé à pied  bien que le tranway s'arrête au bas du logement et qu'une station de métro soit toute proche. Les indications lors de l'arrivée à l'aéroport sont également claires et précises. La rue est un peu bruyante mais Artur met à disposition des boules quiès. ( Pas utilisées). En plus le chat Mia est très joueur et aime beaucoup les calins. Nous vous conseillons vivement ce logements.
We had really nice time at Artur’s place. I highly recommend it.

Le logement correspond en tout point à l'annonce.
Nous avons séjourné 2 nuits chez Arthur.
L'appartement est très bien situé, près des lignes de métro, du point de départ du tram 28.
L'appartement est cosy, propre et fonctionnel.
Petit bémol, la rue est assez bruyante (inévitable en centre ville).
Arthur ne nous a pas accueilli personnellement mais les indications qu'il nous a laissé nous ont permis d'accéder sans problème au logement.
Nous recommandons le logement.

Although we stayed for only one night, we were really happy with the hospitality of Artur. He was nice and helpful, the place was clean and stylish and Mia is such a lovable cat. It is in a crowded area but its so close to lots of sights, bars, etc. We highly recommend staying at Arturs!
Best wishes,
Tosh and Kristina

Just the perfect spot in Lisboa.  Perfect location, little tip, very close by, there is a clandestine Chinese restaurant which I always go to when in Lisboa. Massive thank you to Arthur and his cat which where really nice! See you next time!

Great accommodation, I absolutely recommed! We stayed there for almost a week and during that time there was nothing to complain about. Artur was a friendly host who was interested in his quests. And Mia the cat was adorable!

Artur’s place is well-located, the building itself is a bit run down, and the room we stayed in can be noisy as it faces the street below. The bathroom is also small, the living space is ample. The value for price is excellent given the location, this is a perfect resting stop for someone who is not a light sleeper and just needs a place to lay their head down at. Artur was excellent at answering our questions during the stay. Beware, there is a very cute small cat, should you have allergies or sensitivities.
Artue is a very nice host. The home is very clean and comfortable. Great location, and the value is unbeatable! Highly recommended!
Romantisch, knus appartement maar als je een rustige omgeving nodig hebt om te slapen dan niet aan te raden. Wij hebben leuke dagen gehad en ons prima vermaakt.

Artur is so great who gives us many useful tips about our trip! Thanks again. Mia is very cute too! The house has great location and is not far away from the beginning station of Tram28. Very nice memories in Lisboa!

Staying at Arturs home for a few nights in Lisboa is highly recommendable. The apartment is located extremely central, and Artur is a nice and accommodating host, who is fast at replying for all kinds of questions.
The only thing to be aware of is, that due to the central location, there might be a little noise during the evening, but bring some earplugs and you are settled!
Thank you very much for a nice stay, Artur (and Mia).
Very convenient location. Host is very friendly, responses are very prompt.  Highly recommend.
Hermoso departamento. Cerca de todo.

The place was quite central and in a walkable distance from Lisbon’s main attractions. The flat is shared with other Airbnb guests (3 rooms in total) and all the guests share only one bathroom. The area is quite noisy at night and the flat is on the first floor. The building is in very bad conditions, something that is probably out of Artur’s control, however it should be mentioned in the listing.
The room was very cozy and the apartment was very nice as well. The location is great as you can walk pretty much everywhere and you also have a metro station very close.

Gostei muito do apartamento, tinha todas as comodidades necessárias. Comunicação excelente, embora não tenha chegado a conhecer o Artur. Mas, tive a ótima companhia do gatinho que vive lá em casa, que sem dúvida é um amor. Embora tenha sido uma estadia breve, foi bastante agradável.
Самый цент . Стильная квартира. Все необходимое и даже больше есть !

Infelizmente não conhecemos o Arthur pessoalmente, mas ele foi bem atenciosamente por telefone no momento do checkin.
A localização é bem central, por isso faz bastante barulho.
Cama confortável e banheiro compartilhado.
Good!

Lo que más nos gustó fue el trato con Artur, es una excelente persona. El barrio es en el centro de Lisboa con mucho movimiento y de fácil acceso a otros puntos turísticos. Muy recomendable! Gracias Artur!

I spent 3 nights at Artur's place. The flat is a cute little one in an old building right at the centre of the city. There are other 2 bedrooms that are also being rented. My room was bigger than it looked and has a little french balcony facing the street, it can be a bit noisy sometimes but nothing that some earplugs can't solve.
There is a lovely black cat named Mia, she is super friendly and cuddly and, along with Artur make a great pair of hosts.
Artur is very patient and generous. I had a great time and I already miss Mia!!
I wish you all the best Artur you are great! xx
Recomendo! Excelente localização. Apartamento mto bem cuidado tanto na decoração como na limpeza...quarto aconchegante! Ótima experiência!
Great place to stay in central Lisbon. Would recommend for a weekend in the city.
Amazing! Such a pleasant stay, highly reccomend.

장점과 단점으로 나누어 적을게요^-^ 우선 장점은 2층에 위치하고 있었고 근처에 맛있는 중식당이 위치하고 있고 귀여운 아기고양이 미아가 있었다는 점이예요!                                         단점은 부엌에서 바퀴벌레를 보았고 아시아인들이 많이 사는 지역인지 조금 시끄러웠어요.                                         짧게 묵어가기 좋은 숙소였던것 같아요!
Nossa estadia foi perfeita. Casa limpa, aconchegante e muito bem localizada. Arthur foi muito atencioso conosco. Checking e checkout muito fácil e simples. Recomendamos.

Logement identique à la description! Idéalement bien situé dans Lisbonne. Rue typique avec le tram qui passe au pied de l’appartement. Artur est à l’écoute et est réactif à nos messages. Le petit plus? Un adorable chat super câlin et joueur! Je vous conseil vivement ce logement.

Casa limpa, estilosa e com um charme extra a gata Mia, pra quem gosta de gato, sempre vinha me recepcionar na porta!! Localização ótima, próxima ao metrô e bonde, mas é possível fazer tudo a pé. A noite um pouco barulhento da rua, mas nada que incomode se mantiver a janela fechada. No geral correu tudo bem, recomendo!!!

Artur was very friendly, provided us full details how to find his apartment, so it was very easy to check-in (and check-out as well). The apartment is very good located, the room is clean. There is also cute and gentle black cat :)
I would definitely recommend to stay here.
Thanks Artur, I would come back with pleasure.
Atrur is very friendly an knowledgeable, the place is in a great location and super clean and the cat is awesome as well!

I do not know what I can add that has not already been said about Artur and his apartment. "Insert lots and lots of superlatives" here.
Great host, great communication, clean space in a central location. Wonderful recommendations and a lovely spot to stay in Lisbon if you want to explore the sights and sounds of the city on foot.
He allowed us to leave our luggage early as we had an early morning flight and allowed to check out late due to a late evening train. He was flexible to ensure we do not have to carry around our luggage all day.
Highly recommend and will surely be making my way back to the wonderful city and Artur's beautiful house.
Excelente localização a optimo preço! Gostei muito :)

Artur is a true gentleman. He cares about the cleanliness of the apartment and he makes you feel very welcome. Hot water abounds. His street is a typical Lisbon street although I had never been in Lisbon before so didn't know what to expect from a typical Lisbon street when I first came to the apartment. After 3 days it felt very "normal".

One of best looking houses I've used on Airbnb. The outside of the building might fool you for a bit, but the apartment itself is fully restored, the bedroom looked great, and the decoration made the whole place feel very welcoming.
Also, the friendliest cat I've ever met.

Estoy encantada de haber conocido a Artur, su hospitalidad es inmejorable, atento, responsable y amable. La habitación y todo el departamento es hermoso, con detalles de decoración que la hacen muy agradable. Equipada con todo lo necesario, me he sentido como en casa, y de ir nuevamente a Lisboa elegiría sin dudas el departamento de Artur.

La habitación es cómoda, limpia y bonita aunque un tanto pequeña. Es difícil entrar al edificio por la puerta de entrada ya que tiene algunos problemas pero según Artur están tratando de solucionarlo. Igualmente en cada ocasión que precisamos entrar, nos abrió con rapidez llamándolo al portero eléctrico. Sus recomendaciones de lugares a donde ir son buenas. Y el departamento en general es muy bonito.

Artur is really nice and friendly person. The apartment is really
convenient to go anywhere. Few mini supermarkets are nearby where u could buy many things and they are so friendly as well. The main door is difficult to open but when u lean the “rule” , it will be so easy as your “ home keys” 😊. Thanks again Artur and Mia.

Arthur
merci pour ce séjour inoubliable
accueil parfait
Arthur est à l écoute disponible et très gentil
je recommande son logement sans hésiter sans parler de la propreté du logement
PHOTOS CONFORME A LA RÉALITÉ
il est très bien situé proche du tram du métro de la gare

Even though it was only for one day, I had an amazing stay with Artur. He was very kind and a great host, and was very helpful to other guests as well! I will definitely be staying with him next time I come to Lisbon.

My first experience in Lisbon and loved it. For the value, location, price and Artur very quick to respond, and suggestions. I'd totally recommend this place for travellers. I will say the front door was a bit tricky to open, and it does require a little tweak to the right and you can't force it! But other than that. I am more than satisfied :) and the cat is awesome
Stylish and friendly place - I will definitely rent it again on next visit!
Mais uma vez meu muito obrigado. Excelente hospitalidade.

The apartment is beautiful and a great part of the city. There are tons of great food places and tourist attractions near by. Artur and Margaret are wonderful. The apartment has great accommodations and felt like a home. Overall, it’s a fantastic Airbnb run by two very sweet people.

Impeccably clean, cute apartment. Artur is friendly and helpful and clearly loves hosting. The pictures show it well, though don’t do the lovely window/balcony in the bedroom justice. Nice to have to use of the public space/TV/kitchen with all the amenities. Good internet and hot shower. The little cat is sweet and well-behaved and likes to be in the room with you. Would stay here again on future trips.

Arthur must be one of the best host I’ve ever met. He’s so kind and helpful. He gave us lots of suggestions.
This appart has a perfect location, love the atmosphere there, and really love Lisbon.
Die Wohnung war in Ordnung. Alles war sehr nett. Die Beschreibung entspricht der Angaben von airbnb.

Un sitio genial para parar en Lisboa.
Aunque es pequeño no echamos de menos nada en el piso de Artur. Indicaciones inmejorables para una cómoda llegada y una situación espectacular. No tuvimos problemas de ruido aún estando a cinco minutos andando de Rossio (centro).

Excellent location! Artur’s hospitality is above and beyond. He and Mia (the cat) made me feel like I am at home. Many places are walking distance, a bit hilly, wear good walking shoes! Excellent local eateries! Public transportation nearby!
logement très bien situé, dans un quartier populaire, un voisinage chaleureux et accueillant, appartement très fonctionnel, très propre, que du bonheur à y séjourner
Great small clean place. Only stayed for one night but I had a good time. Was able to use the washing machine and loved the company of the cat was super friendly :) thanks Arthur!

Artur’s place is in an amazing location, clean, and friendly. He wasn’t extremely quick with communication and we had no problems throughout our stay. We walked everywhere and had a lovely time. And he has a cute, cuddly kitty!

Artur's stylish apartment was everything you could hope for—clean, convenient, and close to all the amazing things that old Lisbon has to offer. And did I mention the really cute cat? I would gladly stay again!
Amazing place in the middle of Old Town, Lisboa. Accessible to all forms of transportation and super clean! Would definitely book this place again. Thanks Artur!

Had difficulty finding the place probably due to Airbnb giving broken link, hard to get in due to poor lock on street door, but once there Artur was very friendly, helpful and organised. Room was clean and very well lit. Shower was hot and powerful.  Would definitely stay again!
Buen lugar bien ubicado muy cómodo
Świetna lokalizacja, przyjemny pokój, bardzo sympatyczny i uczynny gospodarz. Polecam!
Small and central with the sweetest little cat!

Artur is a very welcoming host and his apartment is in a great old neighborhood well situated for exploring the city and for Metro and bus connections elsewhere. The only downside is it can be noisy in the street outside at night.

The apartment is exactly how it looks on the pictures: beautiful and clean! Arthur is charming and welcoming.  He took the time to explain to me how to find myself in the city and the different things to see.  The apartment is located in the real part where locals live and not in the touristic area.  Thanks to Arthur!

We stayed 1 night at Artur's place. We haven't met Artur but always received responses from him within an hour and got clear instructions how to check-in. The apartment is close to city centre. The only thing that the neighbourhood on Friday night is very loud and a little frightening. Overall, it was good value for money.

Very nice apartment. Quite small but great organized. I didnt meet Artur, but the instructions he left was very clear and detailed.
I can definitly recomend that place !
The location is perfect that you can enjoy the viewing of old town and the culture. There are some sightseeing near the flat that you can go by foot.The flat is nice and there is a lovely cat.

Artur is a wonderful, welcoming host who speaks great English! His flat is just 5 mins. up the trolley tracks from the Metro, just need to make sure you are on the right street. His flat is small & our room was very small but comfortable. Only there for one night & shared bath = no problem. It's in an interesting Lisbon neighborhood that is very multicultural, so there are multiple low-cost ethnic eateries nearby, a fantastic bonus!

Fuimos unos afortunados de haber conocido a Artur. La verdad es que lo escogimos por sus comentarios favorables, y pudimos constatar personalmente que no solo fueron ciertos, sino que fueron superados en nuestra expectativas.
Gente, no duden en ir a lo de Artur!!! todo excelente, desde la ubicación, comodidad, atención, generosidad, todo, van a ser superados sus expectativas como nosotros!
Arturo fue un anfitrión excelente, estuvo siempre atento a ayudarnos. Lo recomiendo!

Artur is a very friendly host, welcoming and prepared to assist where needed. The place is well kept and cleaned, ideally situated in Lisboa and walking distance to the city center. This is an ideal place for a short stay to experience the traditional part of Lisboa and its street culture.  We enjoyed the stay very much!

Nossa experiência na casa de Artur não poderia ter sido melhor. O acesso do aeroporto foi rápido e fácil (45 minutos de metrô). O sistema de check in e check out foi prático, a cama é confortável, o chuveiro é o máximo! Ficamos muito à vontade em casa.
É possível ir a pé de casa para muitas zonas turísticas (4 minutos do metrô, 5 minutos do tradicional Bonde 28, 15 minutos da estação de trem e de inúmeros bares, restaurantes e pastelarias).
Artur é um anfitrião muito comunicativo, o que estimula a socialização entre os hóspedes da casa. Nos mostrou algumas curiosidades de Lisboa em uma caminhada muito informativa e interessante pelo centro.
Artur é com certeza um dos melhores hosts que tivemos. Quando voltarmos a Lisboa, sem dúvida vamos procurá-lo.

Arthur is a sweet man with a welcoming disposition; his hous is comfortable convenient abd clean. The area is great for walking to the castle, the old back streets and the restaurants and bars. Thee is a tram stop just outside the door. Artur's cat is adorable. Highly recomended, great value

Nagyon jól éreztük magunkat Arturnál. Alacsony költségvetésű túrát terveztünk Lisszabonba és környékére. Lakásából rövid sétával (1-5 perc) éttermek, kávézók, csendes és forgalmas helyek egyaránt elérhetőek. Minden kérdésünkre legjobb tudása szerint válaszolt. Tényleg otthon éreztük magunkat. Utazással kapcsolatban felmerülő problémáink megoldásában is segítőkész volt! MIA a macskája sem volt zavaró, bár az ajtónkat zárva tartottuk :-)  Csak ajánlani tudjuk!
Lovely but compact apartment in an exxellent location. Artur is very friendly and accommodating.
Niedliches kleines Zimmer mit super wifi. Eine Katze war auch noch im Haus :-)

Não temos nada do que reclamar. Artur é um excelente anfitrião, super atencioso, cuidadoso... estava tudo impecável, limpo, cheiroso e bem decorado! A localização é perfeita, fizemos vários pontos turísticos a pé e usamos o metrô que é super perto!
Super accueil, logement idéalement situé, très charmant... bref on recommande !!

We had a great stay at Artur's place!
The place is really clean and is well located in Lisbon. The area can be loud during the day but it gets pretty quiet at night. It's really close to the metro and to Lisbon's old district. Artur is a great host and gave us a lot of tips and recommendations for visiting Lisbon!

When I started my search on Airbnb for a place to stay in Lisbon, Artur's place was the first one that popped up! When I read the "incredible reviews" - I said to myself "this is it!" No need to look any further and I'm pleased to say his place meet and exceeded my expectations.
Artur is an authentic, caring and kind soul. Real in every way. Soft spoken and patient. He went "over and above" to ensure my stay in Lisbon was a memorable one. I'm pleased to say that I know that I have established a life long friendship in Portugal with someone named Artur. All the best my friend!

Unser Aufenthalt in Arturs Apartment war großartig. Sehr gemütliche, liebevoll eingerichtete und sauber​e Wohnung in zentraler Lage.
Arthur ist ein toller Gastgeber, unkompliziert, hilfsbereit und sehr nett.
Alles in allem eine sehr empfehlenswerte Wohnung :)
Arthurs appartment is lovely. You find all what you need, and the fantastic center of Lisbon right in front of you! Arthur (and Mia :) )  are great hosts! Muito obrigado!
Tout simplement parfait.

Extremely nice place - very clean and tidy and with a great view onto the street. Two minute walk from tram and metro - and Lisbon's excellent public transport system will take it from there! Artur was very welcoming, and his instructions for keys were very straightforward. Highly recommended and very convenient.
Great spot in the heart of Lisbon

We logeerden een week bij Artur en hebben ons geen moment verveeld. De locatie was geweldig, dichtbij uitzichtpunten en het kasteel, en met de rest van de bezienswaardigheden op loopafstand. Artur was de beste en aardigste gastheer, van aanbevelingen voor de stad tot aftersun toen we iets te veel van de Portugese zon genoten hadden; het ontbrak ons aan niets. Ook Mia de kat is een grote toevoeging natuurlijk :) We hebben een geweldige tijd gehad en komen zeker terug wanneer we nog een keer in Lissabon zijn.
Arthur is an amazing host, very kind and friendly. The place is really good, close to everything.
Adorei! Muito bem localizado. Artur é um ótimo anfitrião, atencioso ao extremo. Recomendo!

Artur's house is perfect! Excellent position in the centre of the city, little but nice and very confortable, we really felt like at home! Artur is very kind and helpful, it's been a pleasure to stay in his home with him and his beautiful cat Mia!
Lovely room with a balcony in a really central location. Everything was clean and nice. On quite a busy road so a little noisy.

We really enjoyed staying at Arturs place. He was so welcoming and friendly. Artur helped us settle in and provided us with alot of information about Lisbon, such as where  nightlife and top attractions and the best routes to get there. Money well spent.

Artur was a gracious and helpful host!  I felt at home as soon as I arrived and he gave great recommendations as to what to see and to do during my visit.  His place is clean, comfortable, and conveniently located.  His cat, Mia, is friendly and adorable.  I would highly recommend staying at his place.  Thanks Artur for helping make for an incredible trip in Lisbon!

Appartement agréable, neuf et confortable. Artur est un hôte très accueillant et très ouvert pour donner des conseils de visite dans Lisbonne. Bien situé pour se déplacer à pied (métro et tram dans la rue aussi) mais un peu loin des quartiers sympas pour sortir le soir et rue très passante de jour comme de nuit.
Je conseille vivement cette chambre !
Super close to metro and also walkable places near by. Had a great stay! The cat was an added bonus haha
Arthur est super! Great host for a great stay!

Arturo is a nice person, but not nice enough to make up for the poor value of this rental. The room we stayed in was minuscule and, unbeknownst to us, two children slept in the apartment along with Arturo. The listing did not mention the presence of guests other than Arturo, nor did he. The apt is well located near the Martim Moniz metro station and the Castelo de São Jorge. However, it's dodgy at night and uncomfortably noisy. Closing the window to get sleep would've made the room unbearably stuffy as there was no AC. I'm not sure what the reason was for such high ratings from other guests, but I recommend staying elsewhere. There are plenty of better options in Lisbon.

This was our first AirBnb experience.. and I am writing this review already after some more AirBnb's - so I can say with confidence that Artur's place is truly great and Artur himself is a very good host!
We are very happy that we had an opportunity to stay there.
Besides that we managed to find a good free parking place rather close to this house.
We enjoyed! 5*

Arthur was great in communication. I told him my arrival time incorrectly because of my mistake but when i corrected my arrival time he was prompt in his response. He arranged my late check in at almost midnight. I had a minor issue with check in but figured out eventually. I appreciate it. The only concern I had was the bed linen. I am unsure why but it was itching. The linen looked very clean bit it was itching to me so I had to cover the bed with a towel. I felt ok then.

Artur is the best Airbnb host we've had! He gave us great recommendations for the area and was always willing to help if we had any questions. The apartment itself was very clean and had everything we needed for a short Lisbon stay.

Artur nous a très bien accueilli, il nous a donné des conseils des endroits a visiter et sur un bon restaurant peu chère en bas du logement.
L'appartement est très bien situé, en plein centre ville. Le quartier étant populaire et animé, il y a du bruit jusque tard dans la nuit. Nous remercions Artur d'avoir mis à disposition des boules Quies.

I loved my stay at Artur. The place is very clean, warm, comfortable and very well located in the Mouraria area. We are near for public transport and several services. I did everything on walk for my visit to the other neighborhoods. Artur offers all the necessary amenities. He is attentive to our needs and provides us with information about the city. Thank you for this warm welcome.
Lovely place, great host, easy to communicate, always provide us helps when needed.
Thanks for the great experience in Lisbon, we loved it, and we loved Mia the kitten, can't wait to come back!!

My parents booked this accommodation and they were impressed with everything: cleanliness, location, hospitality and communication.  Arthur is a perfect host and a very nice person. Highly recommended!
Artur is an excellent host. We enjoyed staying on his place. I will fully recommended

The stay at Artur's place was excellent. The place was clean and near a metro station. Artur is friendly and shared with us the history of Portugal and briefed us about the attractions around the area. Artur also has a cat Mia which is absolutely lovely and made the stay all the more interesting.

Arthur has a lovely home with a super nice cat! His flat is perfectly located in the old town. Everything is in walking distance and he explanes things really carefully and good! Don't bother to ask him.
In Arthur we didn't just find a good host but also a friend!
I hope you'll love it the same way we did!
Artur is a great host and is very welcoming. The place is really clean and good location. Mia the cat is too cute! Would def recommend this place!

Artur is a wonderful host! He gave us a lot of useful advices, recommended us places to go to and took time to mark all important Sightseeing and Food places in our map. We felt very comfortable around him and had a very pleasant stay. His place is located in the heart of lisbon and everything you could wish for is within Walking distance. It can get loud at night on the streets.
Since Arturs place is a shared Apartment you should be comfortable with meeting new people and sharing the bathroom.
We would always come back

Arthur is a really great host! He was super knowledgeable and informative. It was awesome of him to spend time mapping out Lisbon for us and we got great recommendations of what to see, eat, and do. His place was very cozy and very clean! He has a cat who was sociable and real sweet. Our room was very nice and had a view of the street where you see locals doing their everyday thing, which was awesome to see! Everything was within walking distance so we never had to take public transportation, although if needed it was just around the corner. The day we left we actually woke up pretty late and were about to miss the bus we bought tickets for! Arthur was so kind and ordered an uber for us, which we truly appreciated since we probably wouldn't have made it without him! Arthur is a great host and someone who was a pleasure to meet! Definitely recommend staying at his place.
Great Host with lots of suggestions for the city, would definitely recommend!

I stayed just one night with Artur but he seems to be really a great host. The place is small but it has everything one would need. The neighborhood is a bit loud at night but if you're not bothered by this it's a perfect place to stay. The location of the flat is as well pretty good.

Très bien placé pour la visite de Lisbonne
Wifi excellent
Artur est très sympa

Artur is great! Nice friendly guy who likes to hang out with people. He makes  your stay comfy as possible-so nice that the central location and clean&comfy room seem like a bonus,not the other way round. Shame I only stayed one night,really

The apartment was great and Arthur was a great host who took care of us. His cosy house made us feel at home for the two nights we stayed there and Arthur stayed up really late so that we could check in from our delayed travel to Lisbon. The street is pretty noisy and at night seems a little bit sketchy  but during the day it is lively and safe. Overall we had a great stay here.
La pasamos muy bien, excelente ubicación, puedes ir caminando a muchos lugares turísticos. Excelente persona y muy amable.

El hogar de Artur es muy bonito ,acogedor y muy limpio . Todo está en orden y se respira mucha paz y buen ambiente. Artur nos ha recibido con una gran sonrisa que siempre está con el , mucha amabilidad y muy servicial , nos ha recomendado varios lugares de Lisboa para visitar y ha estado muy pendiente de sus huéspedes, podría decir que es el perfecto anfitrión.Me he sentido como en casa . Su compañera Mía, una dulce gatita que también nos trató muy bien .
Sin duda , si vuelvo ir a Lisboa será a casa de Artur .!!!
Muy buena la estadía en lo de artur, hermoso departamento, y muy atento el, super recomendable

Great location. Artur is very kind, with a lot of good suggestions and interesting facts of Lisbon. Room is very comfortable and clean, easy to get to public transportation and walking distance from all the interesting spots of the city. Be aware that at night the street in front of the room could be noisy.

Artur is an amazing host. He was flexible regarding the check in time and was happy to check me in at 8pm. He also has given me direction and suggestions what places to visit in Lisbon. The apartment was clean and modern, located in central Lisbon and very close to the station. Would definitely love to stay there again!
enoyed the short stay
El apartamento está totalmente equipado, muy céntrico y accesible. El trato de Arturo ha sido inmejorable, un chico encantador, volvería sin dudarlo.
Recomendable, buen trato y un sitio cómodo. 👍

Artur ist ein wunderbarer Gastgeber! Das Gebäude ist ein Altbau und wird gerade renoviert, daher ist im Moment auf dem Treppenhaus nicht so einladend. Arturs Wohnung ist wiederum liebevoll eingerichtet, sauber und gemütlich! Artur ist aufmerksam, sehr, sehr sympathisch und zuvorkommend. Die Lage ist hervorragend. Ich war mit meiner 8jährige Tochter, die sich auch sehr wohl gefühlt hat und kann es nur weiterempfehlen! Danke vielmals Artur!
Artur é um excelente anfitrião! O prédio é antigo e se encontra em reforma nesse momento, por isso a escada do prédio não é o melhor cartão postal. Porém o apartamento de Artur é decorado com muito amor, limpo e aconchegante! Artur é atencioso, muito, muito simpático e cortês. A localização é maravilhosa! Eu estive com minha filha de 8 anos na casa de Artur, que também gostou muito e eu só posso aconselhar esse apartamento! Muito obrigada mais uma vez Artur!

We totally loved our short stay at Artur's cosy place. It is well located in the heart of Lisbon and everything is in the walking distance. Moreover, Artur is a great host as he gave us interesting recommendations and engaged with us on interesting topics
房东是一个非常热情善良的人，随时为房客考虑。我们受到了很好的照顾。房子的地理位置很优越，交通非常方便。

Artur was so friendly from the moment we arrived. He was willing to help and offer advice over the entirety of our holiday making our stay as easy as possible. We had a great time on a boat trip he recommended for us and joined us on. He also has a very cute cat! Thanks Artur we had a great stay with you and will recommend :)!
I liked the location, close to everything, but most of all I loved Artur's willingness to help and make us feel comfortable.

From the airport to reach this place, it's easy, 1.45€+50cents card fee. Red line first, than change to green line to Martim Moniz.
The logement is located at the foot of St. George Castle, 2mins to reach green line metro or the famous tram No.28 which gos around the old town:. Metro stop martim moniz, only two stops away from Baixa-Chiado where you will find easily the reputable local pastry: Manteigaria! It tastes better than the most famous one in Belem area. Or you just simply walk to Rossio square where you will find everything you need, the food, the restaurants, the shopping area as well, only 5-8mins away. Very central location. The owner is friendly and amicable. Kitchen is clean and convenient. Big Tv installed even with Netflix. The owner's black cat made my stay more enjoyable. Wifi is very powerful. Only the toilet and shower are quite narrow, but it doesn't bother me that much compared to everything else. Would definitely choose it again if I ever go back to Lisbon.

Strongly recommend a barbecue place called Frangaskeira Nacional. It's not a restaurant, only take-away. Best tasted barbecue ever. I chose Mixta 1: half chicken, one sausage, 4 chunk pork ribs. It costs only 6.9€! You have gotta try home-made chips as well, delicious. I'll go back to Lisbon simply because of it. You can find it out easily with google map.
Very cute apartment with a super friendly and uncomplicated host! Thanks again for the stay, it's been a pleasure!

We had a pleasant stay at Arturs place. He is very friendly and has a lot of good tips.
The house is bit loud and so you hear everything .
Artur is simply an amazing, interesting, informative, generous and friendly host. His place is compact but spotlessly clean and very well equipped. We would stay with him whenever we return.

Our time in Lisbon was super !
Arthur is awesome
Super kind
We really enjoy Lisbon
Thanks for everything
Artur was great! Friendly and open. He went above and beyond to make our stay comfortable and enjoyable.

What can I say that you wouldn't  already know from the photos and other reviews? Both Artur and his place are one-of-a-kind treasures. The space: clean, comfortable, perfectly located. The man: knowledgeable beyond your wildest dreams and passionate about you seeing the many beautiful sides of Lisboa during your stay. Do not hesitate to book this place; you'd be doing yourself an injustice by staying elsewhere.

Excelente escolha! Primeiro, pela hospitalidade do anfitrião, detalhe que sempre faz toda diferença. Artur é um host fantástico e sabe receber muito bem seus hóspedes. Segundo pela localização, bem central e perto de tudo. A casa de Artur também é muito agradável, decorada com carinho e confortável. Muito obrigado, Artur!

If you are lucky enough to have the opportunity to stay at Artur's place, you should go for it! His apartment is in a fantastic location, walking distance to restaurants and cafes. He is a kind man and very generous with his time. He helped us figure out how to get to our next stop in Portugal while touring on our bikes when we were clueless.
Schönes kleines Zimmer, perfekte zentrale Lage, mitten im Leben der schönen Stadt

Artur est une personne accueillante et disponible. Notre séjour chez lui -bien que court- a été agréable. Le logement est très bien situé et cosy. Il est en plein cœur de la vie animée de Lisbonne. Merci Artur.
We have a great experience in Lisbon and we have enjoyed of the stay in Artur's place. It's a clean and cozy room with perfect location. There is adorable cat in the apartment too! Recommend!
The room is nice.

First of all, Art is very warm-hearted and helpful. Once we arrives at home, he told us every we need to know about travelling in Lisbon. We like him. There is a female black cute cat. She is so lovely and attractive. We enjoy spend the night with her😄.
La casa de Artur está muy cerca del Castillo de San Jorge, por lo tanto de otras atracciones para los turistas. Muy cerca de las estaciones del metro. Todo muy bien.

My boyfriend and I had a really great time in Artur's place! The apartment is very central, very easy to get from the airport, clean, beautifully furnished.. He has also an adorable little cat! Artur is really friendly! He took us to see some fado (traditional music) one night and gave us many tips concerning the city. I highly recommend the place.. Everything was great! Thanks again :-)

I highly recommend this place to whoever is visiting Lisbon, suitable for solo travelers and couples. The apartment is literary central, easy to find, everything is within walking distance especially main city attractions. I will come back to this place because I loved it and Artur is an amazing guy. Don't miss this place.

We spent great time in Arthur's apartment. He was very helpful and cared about us. We could talk with him about Lisbon, Portugal but also about more philosophical topics ;) He recommended us great places to eat, visit or listen to fado (was amazing!). Apartment has good location (close to the subway, tram ect.) and we could walk to the most popular places. For sure Artur was great host and his apartment is good place to stay in Lisbon!
Artur é um excelente anfitrião, foi muito carinho ao nos receber e nos indicou muito bem para nossa única tarde em Lisboa. O quarto é fantástico, confortável e limpo. Obrigada Artur.

Se você está pensando em passar por Lisboa, não tenha dúvidas!!! A casa do Art será a sua melhor opçao! vai por mim!
O apartamento é lindo, aconchegante, limpo, quarto super confortável... mas o principal de tudo, Arthur foi o melhor anfitrião que tivemos até hoje.
Não sei se encontraremos alguém tao atencioso e disposto em ajudar como o Art fez conosco.
O lugar fica bem no centro e próximo aos principais pontos turísticos de Lisboa. Fomos eu e minha amiga e chegávamos tarde sem nenhum problema, o local é bem tranquilo e seguro.
Super recomendamos!!!
Amazing stay! Very walkable from different locations and also extremely close to the metro and tram stops!
Artur was great. Nice and comfortable house. He was always willing to help us and give us advice about Lisbon. We would come back with no doubt!
Cute and clean room. Artur is really nice to us.

We only stayed at Artur's place for a night on our way back from a holiday on the Algarve, but thoroughly enjoyed the stay! Artur welcomed us warmly, took time for exchanging thoughts and ideas, and we had our short stay sorted within a few minutes thanks to his tips. The apartment and room are small, but have all the necessities. We were equally enchanted by Mia, the adorable cat, who even chose to spend part of the night with us in the room. The location is really central and close to the airport. We hope to be back one day to properly discover Lisbon!
Arthur and his cat were very welcoming indeed... the apartment is small but nice. My room was very comfortable. Good heating during winter as well. Thank you for a great stay!

Overall the place is quite central, accessible to tons of attractions. The room we stayed in was quite small and not as pictured in the listing. But that was not an issue since we spent the most of time outside. Arthur was not there to greet us but his co-host was really nice and offered us tons useful advice. The best part is def the cat Mia, she is super friendly and she even slept with us at night.
Great location with easy access to public transport and walking distance to some main sites.

Arthur and his friends are so enthusiastic and patient! Although Arthur was not here, his friend showed us around the entire house and gave lots of recommendations to explore the city. And Arthur replied me quickly through SMS and phone call. The location is good, just 3 mins to metro and 10 mins walking to Rossio square. There is also a cute cat accompanied, I am a cat lover! I will miss her!!
There were also some communication issues for check in at the first day, and I recommend you to communicate with Arthur as specific as possible. Also bear in mind, please do not take shower for too long (like 40 mins) because the hot water is limited! Just consider for other guests.
It's very nice to live in Arthur's lovely house and I will choose his house again when I come to Lisbon next time.

Logement très joli, emplacement nickel pour tout visiter à pied.

Le chat est très mignon !

Artur nous a mis a l'aise et nous a donné plein de bon conseils.

Artur jest bardzo miłym i pomocnym gospodarzem :) Kiedy przyjechałyśmy, poczęstował nas herbatą i opowiedział o wszystkich atrakcjach w Lizbonie dając nam mapę z dokładnym opisem, gdzie i jak dotrzeć.
Mieszkanie małe i przytulne spełniło nasze oczekiwania, dodatkowo mieszka tu urocza kotka Mia, która sprawiła, że poczułyśmy się jak w domu :)
Lokalizacja jest rewelacyjna, prawie wszędzie można dojść pieszo, w okolicy jest też dużo sklepów.
Gorąco polecamy!

One of the best Airbnbs I've ever stayed at! Arthur is the best host- very kind and helpful. He gave us a map and wrote down a full page of recommendations of things to see during our short stay. His apartment is beautiful, clean, and very comfortable. Highly recommended!!!
The room is really well located and Art is a great host. Totally recommend this apartment.

Artur war ein sehr herzlicher Gastgeber, super freundlich und hilfsbereit! Er ist ein sehr offener Mensch, der sich sehr für Menschen aus anderen Ländern und Kulturen interessiert. Das Apartment ist sehr zentral gelegen, sodass viele Sehenswürdigkeiten zu Fuß erreichbar waren. Artur gibt auch gerne Tipps, wie man seinen Aufenthalt in Lissabon verbringen könnte. Insgesamt war es eine sehr positive Erfahrung und bei einem weiteren Lissabon Urlaub würde ich jederzeit wieder Arturs Zimmer buchen!

Artur's place was nice quaint little apartment. It was centrally located and close to many pints of interest! Artur is a great guy and was a great host for my friend and I. If I ever come back to Lisbon will definitely try to stay!

Boendet var bra. Vi fick dela badrum med andra gäster. Åt frukost ute då det sov gäster på vardagsrumsgolvet som var öppet till köket. Lagade bara till kaffe i köket på eftermiddagen. Artur är en härlig och välkomnande värd och tipsade oss om  bra och prisvärda restauranger i grannskapet. Fläkt och hårtork finns tillgängligt. Arturs katt Mia charmade oss direkt och spann när vi klappade katten. Tack igen, Artur!!
Recomendo fortemente. Excelente hospedagem. Uma experiência inesquecível.Apesar da área parecer um pouco perigosa, não tive problemas. Estação do Metro a poucos metros e localização privilegiada.

Artur é um ótimo anfitrião, receptivo e muito simpático, o apartamento é exatamente como a foto e fica pertinho do Castelo Mais lindo e da para ir andando em um dos lugares mais legal de Lisboa (em minha opinião)...

Eu quero voltar assim que possível.

Artur is a great host, receptive and very friendly, the apartment is exactly like the photo and is close to the Most Beautiful Castle and walking to one of the coolest places in Lisbon (in my opinion) ...

I want to go back as soon as possible.

Excelente estadía!!. La ubicación es bastante buena, ya que está muy cerca del transporte público y sitios de interés. Por otro lado Artur es un excelente anfitrión. La habitación es muy agradable y acogedora.
100% recomendada.
Артур очень гостеприимный хозяин и интересный собеседник. Не думали, что нам будет настолько комфортно. Рекомендуем!
Nice room, very central and Artur is an awesome host. Thanks again, Sebastian
Artur was absolutely amazing and his place was magnificent. I would definitely recommended his place to anyone who wants to stay downtown in a safe area near many things including the metro !

Artur is very chilax and nice host, either do we have spent initial 10 minutes and never seen each other post that. :)
The flat is lovely and well decorated, but the area is not to my liking and not very safe, especially to arrive late. The noise from outside is unbearable and prevents from sleeping.

This place is great for people who love to meet new people, stay in the heart of a busy city and walk on narrow steep streets!
I stayed at Artur's place with my boyfriend for on quick stop over in Lisbon. Communication with Artur was extremely easy from the beginning on and he really is interested in his guests wellbeing and helps out as much as he can! Too bad we couldn't spend more time with him, but we will definitely be back at Artur's the next time!
Artur's place is extremely cute and welcoming! It's location is great and you can easily walk downtown or to the Sao Jorge castle. The street is busy and noisy, so bring some earplugs to ensure a good nights sleep. The house is old with a low ceiling and wooden window fronts and the apartment is renovated and furnished with great taste. A combination that works very well.

Artur was very "zen", friendly, helpful and easy to talk to. He let us come at 5:30 AM yo drop our bags when our bus arrived early, which was amazing! We really liked the flat, well located and close to everything. Thank you!

Art is a great host, he helped us check in early and keep our bags for a later flight. Gave us a great overview of Lisbon and showed us some pretty good places to visit, the apartment is located at quite central location and close to major tourist places, definitely recommended!
Arthur is a really wonderful host! He's nice, polite and always wants to help. His place is lovely and on the perfect place. If you don't know, where to stay in Lisbon, this is the right spot :)

Arthur is a very approachable guy and he is very prompt in answering us, helping us by all means and we felt very comfortable staying in his apartment. Everything is in close proximity and  convenient to walk around to visit the main attractions.

Staying at Artur's was great. It was a lovely experience staying in Portugal with a local, he gave us great tips for moving around and we were really close from restaurants, shops and places for tourism, would definitely recommend it!

We stayed at Artur's place for a 1 night layover in Lisbon. The neighborhood is very eclectic and close to the metro. Room was very nice and apartment overall was clean and nicely decorated. Artur wasn't in town on our visit, but his sister was available to greet us.

Artur's place was very central, walking distance to the fort and the metro. Just 5 minutes away you can find great food places. His sister recieved us and was very sweet for showing us around. Artur was very good at responding back when asked about any concerns.  He has the cutest cat Mia who is super friendly. She will want to hang around with you when you are home.  The only downside was that late into the night it could get very noisy outside as people gather across the street. Would recommend the place if noise does not bother when sleeping.

Par sa gentillesse et sa convivialité
.un hôte totalement disponible à ses invités pour la découverte de sa ville.
Appartement avec plein de charme coquet et très propre.

Artur is one of the best hosts I've had without a doubt! He loves to take guests around whenever he has a chance and show them his city. Me and another girl were lucky enough to spend a lovely day with the amazing host. Perfect ending for my 2016 European city weekend trips!

Art is seriously one of the most beautiful, awesome guys I have ever met in my life. I felt at home at his place. Location is perfect. I did my laundry and he had all my clothes folded for me when I got back. One of a kind guy. I only hope that he comes to visit me so I can be as good of a host as he was to me. HIGHLY recommend.
O Artur conquistou a todos nós com sua simpatia e cortesia. A acomodação é bem próxima da estação do metrô, ponto de taxi e do centro comercial.

A wonderful little place within walking distance of almost everything of note, and if it's not within walking distance, the metro is right there! He's very easygoing, respectful, kind and informative. He'll tell you all his favorite spots and joke and just be very kind and considerate! Also, I love his cat. Miss you Mia!
Overall, if and when I come back to Lisbon, I will try my hardest to get booked with him again

Artur's description of his apartment is very accurate. It is a clean room, a clean bathroom, and definitely located in the center of Lisbon. It was not hard to get around from there at all. But by far, the real charm of Artur's place comes from the man himself. We had only known Artur for 5 minutes, but it felt as though we had known each other for years. He is a very calm and friendly person and he definitely has a lot of tips for you around Lisbon! Forget trip advisor. Listen to Artur. He recommended a place to us that was so good and affordable that we ate there two days in a row! And ordered the same thing both times! Thank you for an amazing experience in Lisbon, Artur! Hopefully we meet again! He also has an adorable cat named Mia who will probably make you feel welcome if Artur is out of the house!
Amazing host and helped me out with anything I needed. Great area and close to transportation and tons of stuff to do. I loved the room it was super cute!

Nous avons été très bien accueillis par la sœur d'Artur.
La chambre est petite, mais moderne et cosy. L'appartement est bien rénové et fonctionnel, de plus il est très bien placé pour profiter de Lisbonne.
Seul bémol, le samedi soir il y a un peu de bruit dans la rue.

Super super séjour!! Logement situé dans un quartier populaire où il ne faut pas avoir peur du bruit... Mais il faut savoir que les lisboètes vivent vraiment la nuit et parlent toujours fort!
En terme d'emplacement, c'est super facile et pratique pour les transports: métro, tramway, ou à pieds!!!
La chambre est super confortable, propre, décorée avec goût!
Dans l'appart, serviettes, nécessaire de toilette, accès à la cuisine, etc... Tellement plus pratique et cosy qu'une chambre d'hôtel!!
Et surtout, si vous avez la chance de rencontrer Artur, alors vous verrez que c'est une personne formidable! D'excellent conseil, il sera toujours à votre écoute et aura mille choses à vous faire partager!
Quant à Mia, c'est une chatte adorable qui vous demandera toujours des câlins!

Artur made us feel home right away and gave us hints about restaurants and sights of Lisbon. The rooms are bright and clean. The apartment is very close to a metro station and cultural center of the city. We would definitely come again.

Artur is a great host!
He welcomed us with drinks and some good advices for Lisboa!
Everything is clean and the cat is so sweet!:)

Thanks Art for everything,

let's stay in contact;)

Anna and Anne
This is a central location just up the street from the metro. It is only one flight of stairs to his place and there is a friendly small grocery store just across the street.  Loved staying there!

Artur & his sister were amazing host, they welcomed us with open arms. The room was perfect and everyday we were greeted by Mia the playful cat. Great location for exploring! I would definitely staying again!!!

Art is very friendly and responsive. His place is very neat and cozy. Great location to the metro and to the historic Lisbon district. The bedroom was comfortable and the bathroom was clean. He has an adorable cat which made the stay even that much better. She is very friendly and lovable. Overall, a great experience. Definitely would love to go back on my future travels.

Artur was a very nice host, he was clear in his communication and explained a lot about the neighbourhood and lisbon when we arrived. He is a calm and very friendly person and lets you feel at home. There's also a very cute cat! ;)

For us, the neighbourhood was awesome. It is very centrally located to many interesting points in Lisbon. For some people though, the streets might be a bit too noisy at night (there are often people standing outside around the corner). But we did not mind =)

Arthur est un hôte super ! Très accueillant qui nous a vite mis à l'aise ! On se sentait chez un ami !
Même si nous n'avons passé qu'une nuit Arthur nous a recommandé de très bon endroit ! Et cela valait le détour !
N'hésitez surtout pas Arthur est vraiment très sympathique !

Adresse à retenir:Arthur est un hôte merveilleux, disponible, attentif et courtois. L'appartement ,d'une propreté irréprochable correspond tout à fait au descriptif.

Si vous voulez combiner super hôte, super chambre et super localisation, c'est ici qu'il faut aller ! Nous avons parfaitement pu visiter Lisbonne à pieds, d'un bout à l'autre de la ville (et même au delà).

A special shoutout goes to the host, who was absolutely amazing throughout the entire stay. Super friendly, flexible, and incredibly helpful – from a thoughtful and really cool welcome gift to being responsive and accommodating with anything I needed. When I accidentally left something behind, they even offered to send it back to my home address. That kind of care and attention is truly rare and so appreciated!
Highly recommend this place – not just for the beautiful apartment, but for the exceptional hospitality that comes with it!

Beautiful rooftop spot, secluded, great views, sunlight and nice design and decor. Great night of sleep.
Thank you Pedro. Will be back.

The loft was cozy, clean and nice and everything worked Well. Pedro was super helpfull and answered quickly. The stairs weren’t that bad either. The location is nice. The church bells next door were a bit annoying in the morning but you get used to them.

Such a lovely loft studio! An in person welcome, a bottle of wine and some pastel de nata too was a lovely welcome. A great place for a 2-3 day trip. Myself and my sister each had a double bed in the studio, a perfect base for two travellers in the heart of Lisbon!
Sem dúvida alguma, esse foi um dos melhores Airbnbs que já alugamos. Tudo limpo, super aconchegante e com ambiente super decorado. Recomendo de olhos fechados.

A charming romantic loft right at the center.
Clean and super cozy. Great location. Would visit again!
great stay, excellent host very clean and very welcoming

We had a great stay in Lisbon! The apartment is located in a lovely neighbourhood, very central, but on a quiet street, which we really appreciated. Rui gave us such a warm welcome and was incredibly helpful, even carrying our luggage up the stairs. The apartment itself was very nice and had most of the essentials we needed. The only small things we missed were some olive oil for cooking and a larger hair dryer. Overall, we really enjoyed our stay and would happily come back!

Court mais superbe séjour dans ce logement très bien situé! L’hôte a surpassé mes attentes en me laissant accéder au logement avant l’heure prévue et en m’accueillant avec une petites bouteille de vin et des pastels de Nata. La communication était parfaite. La vue du logement est incroyable. Bref, un 10/10. J’aurai aimé rester plus longtemps!!

Antonio was on the street to meet us, minutes after we arrived. Antonio was fantastic and even helped us bring our bags up after I had injured my back earlier in the trip. Yes there are 3 flights of stairs but Pedro checked with us on a number of Occassion to make sure we realised this was the case. We were happy to go ahead and pleased we did!
It has a tiny home feel in the kitchen but it has everything you need including a washing machine/dryer which came in handy. The apartment is really cute and we enjoyed having a cuppa on the tiny balcony looking out over the church. Very close to everything and tram stops on a neighbouring street. This is a beautiful city and the apartment was central, so it made everything accessible.
Great space in a great location! Pedro was very helpful and a great host!
Beautiful flat, amazing terrace , perfect location. No complaints at all can’t wait to come back!
Magical unit in the heart of Chiado neighborhood. I would stay there again.
Superbra!
Amazing! One of the loveliest places I’ve ever stayed
Very nice little place in downtown Lisbon with great hosts!

Perfectly located, comfortable, super clean and beautifully decorated place with lots of natural light and a little terrace.

Clear instructions and tons of recommendations.
Would definitely recommend this place! We had a great stay!
The stairs are super steep, but other than that the stay was good. Nothing to complain about other than stairs
Tolle Gegend, um Lissabon zu erkunden. Großartige Kommunikation und Support, wann immer notwendig! Vielen Dank!
Great little place in the heart of Lisbon. Host was super responsive. Would definitely stay again.

The apartment was clean and cozy and lovingly furnished.
The beds are very comfortable.
You have a great view from the small roof terrace. Perfect to end the day with a glass of wine or to have breakfast.
The location of the apartment is great. There are many restaurants and cafes and minimarkets nearby.
Unfortunately our flight was delayed and they had to wait for us to hand over the key. Nevertheless, we were warmly welcomed and they took the time to show us around the apartment.
If we had a question I had to contact them and they answered very promptly.
The stay in Lisbon was wonderful.
We would love to come back.

Super séjour

Perfect location in the heart of Chiado! Beautiful views, convenient parking, and everything is within walking distance that you would want to see in Lisbon!!
Great and cozy apartment! Thank you for the uncomplicated organization!

We had a great stay in this accommodation! The flat was just like on the photos - clean, cosy and well equipped. The location was ideal and central. The host was very welcoming and kind. He was always reachable by message and replied quickly. We felt very comfortable and can highly recommend this apartment. Thank you very much for everything, we would love to come back.
This is our second stay at one of Pedro’s apartments, his hospitality and attention to detail are unmatched. We will stay in one of Pedro’s properties again next time we are in Lisbon.
Die Unterkunft war wirklich super und hatte  auch eine tolle Lage, würden wir auf jeden Fall weiterempfehlen ;)
Very cozy and nicely decorated apartment with beautiful views. Would book again and totally recommend.

Can’t recommend Pedro’s place enough! It was perfectly situated, walkable to so many restaurants and things to do, and was beautifully decorated — more importantly, it was very comfortable. The shower water pressure was something to look forward to, and the beds and couch were very comfy. Pedro and Joao were also very generous and helped us arrange an early check-in. They were also so helpful and responsive when we had a mishap with the keys. This is absolutely a place I would return to in Lisbon!

This is a really amazing place for living. The accommodation is very close to all the attractions, fully equipped, warm and cozy, the host has also thoughtfully prepared wine and egg tarts for us. This place just like home when you stay here and you can get very beautiful scenery when you stand on the balcony outside. If you prepare to come to Portugal, I’ll definitely recommend you to book this apartment!

This was what we’d definitely call a “hidden gem” in Lisbon. We loved staying here; it was cozy and comfortable, had great natural light and views from windows and outdoor patio. We also loved the location in the heart in Chiado, with great restaurants and a lively atmosphere but still it was very quiet at night. João was kind enough to give us great restaurant suggestions and sights not to miss.
I also appreciated that they let us know about the stairs (no elevator). While it might deter someone with big luggage or difficulty walking up stairs, if you only have a backpack and a carry-on bag, it’s highly worth the effort of some stairs ( like many other European apartments!).
We would stay here again if we return someday.

Exceptional value Airbnb, perfect for a couple or family with active children.
The stairs to the studio are quite steep which would be tricky for those less able.
The Airbnb is so well equipped, I was extremely impressed. There were also plenty of additional thoughtful touches.
Highly recommend.
We'd come back a thousand times! What a great space and host. He even helped us get our luggage up. 100% recommended

아주 안락하고 아름다운 장소입니다. 방은 아늑하고 더블 침대 두 개와 테이블, 쇼파로 인해 쉴 공간이 충분했으며 테라스에 나가면 놀라울 정도로 아름다운 전경을 감상할 수 있습니다. 주변에 작은 슈퍼마켓이 있어서 숙소에서 먹을 것을 편하게 마련할 수 있으며, 주요 관광지를 도보로 이용 가능합니다. 체크인할 때 기분 좋은 환대를 받았으며, 앱을 통해 즉각적인 소통이 가능하여 모든 편의를 배려 받은 곳입니다. 적극 추천합니다.
We had a great stay in Lisbon. Pedros flat was lovely and cosy. Also in a fantastic location. The hosts were very helpful and flexible with checking in etc which was very appreciated!
Friendly host made us feel at home during our 1st visit to Lisbon. The apartment had everything we needed.

Die Wohnung /Zimmer ist sehr klein, die Fotos sind gut gemacht worden.
Die Wohnung ist für max. 2 Personen und für Personen welche eher grösser sind wie 175 ist es schwierig, Bett befindet sich in einer Dachschräge zumdem schläft man am Boden auf einer dicken Matratze.
Sofa, ist auch niedrig zudem schon sehr gebraucht und riecht.
Die Treppe zur Wohnung ist sehr anspruchsvoll und ich finde dies müsste besser beschrieben werden oder fotografiert werden das jeder sieht wie steil und klein das Treppenhaus ist.
Wir haben zuviel bezahlt für diese Wohnung.

Appartement bien situé, correspondant à la description.
Accueil très sympathique. Hôte réactif et non avare de conseils.

정말 좋았습니다~

크리스마스라서 웰컴 선물도 주셨어요 ㅎㅎ
The place was great, hosts were very responsive, proactive and kind. Our only concern was the stairs. Very uncomfortable if you are carrying luggage, kids or a person with disabilities.

Communicatie zeer goed en duidelijk. Bij aankomst duidelijke instructies gekregen en deze accommodatie is top! Alles netjes in orde en aanwezig. Goed geslapen ook. De badkamer is wat klein, maar daar kun je je op aanpassen. Fijne tijd gehad en dus zeker een aanrader.

Very cosy little flat in the heart of Lisbon. Great location, a bit noisy but only over the weekends. Smaller than we imagined , and for 3 girls, only 1 mirror in the bathroom and one tiny cupboard for clothes is not enough.
The beds and sheet’s were extremely comfy and warm and everything was nice and clean.

This is a fantastic place to stay in when in Lisbon. The apartment is tiny, but set up in a very smart way, with every little detail thought of and all the amenities you need. Great location, there is soooo much in that zone, everything in walking distance. I'd definitely stay here again!

Siamo molto soddisfatti del nostro soggiorno. È un monolocale piuttosto piccolo, ma fornito di tutto il necessario per passare dei giorni in grande comodità.
Lo consiglierei ad ospiti giovani e bohemien amanti dell’arte e della bellezza.

I stayed here for a wedding with my husband and 13 year old son, and we had the best time. We will absolutely book here next time we come back. Pedro the host let us drop off our backs at 11am when we all landed, and stayed to make sure the home was clean. Upon our return when the home was clean, we got keys, and he personally gave us a tour of the home and all amenities. If we ever needed anything he was available immediately by phone and app. The apartment itself is gorgeous. The design. The bedding was comfortable. The patio overlooking the city and cathedral was gorgeous. The beautiful church bells. From every window, it was just magical views. The location was also perfect. Close enough to everything  including 5 minutes to metro, bus, train…easy uber or bolt pickup/drop off. However it was removed enough, that it was not insane traffic like at the baxia-chiado station. It was perfect. 10/10 recommend for anyone looking for an easy central location with a washer and patio.
Amazing location and view! Loved this place and would stay again.
Litet och mysigt boende med bra läge. Kuperat område med många trappor. Inga problem att få till vardagsmotionen.
Apartment is very cozy and well equipped. Take into account that there is no elevator in the building, thanks to host, who helped us with bags.
Vi havde en super fin forlægnet weekend i Pedros lejlighed, der ligger super godt i Barrio Alto, hvor vi kunne gå til det meste og ellers tage en Uber. Kan varmt anbefale lejligheden til andre.

My stay at the loft was very pleasant. The host was flexible with my arrival time which was delayed by 4 hours due to traffic and they were very kind and flexible to accommodate the changes. The loft was calm, designed with taste, the bed sheets super soft. The place is luminous and offers beautiful views and I would have stayed there for a month if I could have! I’ll be back :) lots of nice places to walk to for excellent coffee, brunch, food and sightseeing.
Eine schöne Unterkunft für zwei Personen. Die Lissabon City war gut zur Fuß erreichbar. Der Kontakt verlief unkompliziert.
Excelente la atención de Pedro, nos ayudó con información útil de la zona

Absolutely loved our stay! The flat is beautiful and the location is perfect, surrounded by loads of amazing cafes and restaurants. Pedro was on hand the whole time to give us recommendations and help out if needed. Would love to come back again soon!
Recommend! Great host team and amazing cozy place)

Lovely apartment perfect for two people who want to be close to one of the best parts of Lisbon! The apartment packs everything in to its small space and has amazing views from its terrace which is perfect to enjoy your morning coffee. We really enjoyed the location it was close by to so many restaurants sights. We will mention there are lots of stairs to get up to the apartment but the host met us at our check in and helped us move our luggage into the apartment! Highly recommend this apartment!

Das Appartment mit Terasse war super gelegen in einem tollen Stadtteil mit vielen Cafes und Restaurants. Wir haben uns gleich zu Hause gefühlt und wollten am liebsten hierbleiben. Ruhig gelegen. Kirchturm hat nur Sonntag 10 Uhr laut geklingelt. War ok. Super netter und hilfsbereiter Host! Vielen Dank für die Einweisung. Waschmaschine, Spülmaschine alles da! Toll geschlafen. Buchen wir wieder!
Best choice
Very small and cozy.

Francisco was great! Our flight arrived hours before check-in and he made arrangements for us to drop off our bags. Once we arrived, the apartment was ready early so he checked us in immediately. We absolutely loved the layout of the apartment, how centrally located it was, and the responsiveness of the hosts. This didn’t bother us but guests should be aware that you can hear the church bell ring every hour (and one ring every half hour). We highlight recommend packing lighter than we did - the stairs are narrow and the hills of Lisbon are steep! We would absolutely stay here again!

we loved our stay here…it’s in a fabulous location. there are 3 flights of steep stairs but it really didn’t matter…the apartment made up for it! smallish space but really well utilised…lots of light & airflow…comfy beds…& everything you need. rui was very nice & warmly welcomed us upon arrival.
we highly recommend as a great place to stay.

Pedro’s space was so great! My wife and I had a short stay in Lisbon and absolutely loved the location! It is so close to so many parts of the city and there is plenty of food + drink places all in walking distance! The pictures don’t even do justice to how great the space is!! It is even better in person!! Will recommend Pedro and team and would 10/10 stay again!

Had an amazing stay!
The boys were super responsive, easy going, and gave great recommendations.
Loft in a great, central location, close to lots. Lisbon will keep your glutes tight with all the hills and stairs!
Thanks guys!

A comunicação com Pedro/Rui foi ótima! Fizemos o check in de forma rápida e simples.
Havia recomendações sobre restaurantes e programas por perto e ao redor de lisboa! Adoramos o apartamento.
