Adorei a vista e a decoração do apartamento!
Recomendo e voltaria outras vezes!

This Airbnb was perfect for my friends and me. The location was great and incredibly walkable - including being one block away from fun nightlife. Hosts were responsive and had everything we could need available. Beds were comfortable and the space was spotless. Would highly recommend staying here!
The place was beautiful & close to a lot of the things we wanted to do. Will definitely stay there again when we return to Lisbon.
João was amazing and the space was so cute!
Once again, we had a wonderful stay! Everything was perfect! Thank you!
Great location and very friendly staff
Très bel appartement au centre de Lisbonne. Parfait pour un groupe de 4 personnes !
Lovely place to stay!

Pedro nous a très bien accueilli, le logement était idéalement situé et très bien équipé.
Je recommande vivement.
Fantastic airbnb, 10/10!!

Beautiful place in the heart of Lisbon. We had a great time in the city and the apartment was one of the main reasons. Directly in the city, great restaurants nearby. The apartment was lovely. Very clean, beautiful interior and easy communication with the hosts. Thanks for hosting us!

What an adorable place to stay! Great views we loved the balcony! Cozy & perfect for our girls trip! Pedro was so nice and very responsive! The neighborhood was beautiful with everything walkable! Would come back in a heart beat!

The apartment was perfect for our party's stay in Lisbon, in regard to both price range and aesthetics - the view from the terrace was particularly stunning!
It was spotless and well-stocked when we arrived, and the apartment's images were largely accurate to the reality. Our host was extremely attentive and ensured our stay was always comfortable, providing prompt replies as well as a list of recommendations for eating out and other activities.
Located in the heart of the city, the accommodation is also the perfect distance from the main sights and attractions. Overall, our stay was perfect, and we'd certainly recommend this apartment to any group planning to travel to Lisbon!

het appartement is aan de krappe kant maar met 3 vriendinnen was het heem goed te doen. De communicatie met de verhuurder was goed, komen direct wanneer er problemen zijn (brandalarm ging af door lege batterij), lossen problemen goed en snel op. erg fijn verblijf gehad!
Great location…close to river, shops, restaurants! Great view and the place was surprisingly quiet, which we really appreciated. Beautiful place and awesome patio. Wished we could have stayed longer.

Great apartment and in an excellent location. Everything was as expected and the host was very helpful and easy to contact. Pedro even helped us to carry our luggage up the very steep staircase (my advice would be to travel light!!).
We had a fabulous stay at Pedro’s well located apartment. It is exactly as described, with very lovely decor and all necessities available.

The hosts were very helpful and attentive, the location was great the apartment was beautiful. Perfect for 2 people, anything more would be a struggle as the bathroom is very small but the room itself was perfect. The only shock was the loud bell outside of our terrace every hour from 6am. But a great stay, we’ll be back

We had a great stay here! João was lovely and explained how everything in the apartment worked and gave us recs for our time in Lisbon. As others have mentioned, the stairs are steep and take some getting used to. The space is otherwise compact but cozy. Our group had 3 adults and I think that was probably the max amount of people that could share the space comfortably. The location is great, pretty much within 10-15 min walk of many things we wanted to see, do, and eat (albeit some of those walks are on hills, in true Lisbon style.)

Muy pequeño pero espacio muy bien aprovechado, no le faltaba nada. Fuimos 4 personas y estuvimos cómodos. Además antes de cogerlo nos advirtió como era, un detalle por su parte. Además muy buena localización, en pleno centro. Destaco la limpieza, es el airbnb mas limpio en el que he estado. Me lo guardo para cuando vuelva a Lisboa, un 10.

Lovely loft accommodation, small for 3 people but perfectly formed! Very well presented and maintained. Need to be ok with stairs to 3rd floor. Excellent handover from Joao who gave us all the details and lots of local recommendations.
The accommodation is in a great location. Close to lots of restaurants, city centre and transport options. Great to have extras like a washing machine (when you have been travelling awhile..) Would definitely rebook here!

Super verblijf! Heel netjes, mooi ingericht op een super locatie. We voelde ons meteen thuis. Een heel fijn extraatje was het knusse terras. Host reageerde altijd heel snel. We komen hier zeker nog een keer terug

Can recommend 100%. Cozy apartment with great location and beautiful views from the balcony. Very nice beds/pillows. Public parking conveniently around the corner. Everything was as promised or better. The host was helpful and there were tips for restaurants/sights waiting for us.
Pedro was gentle and kind. The location of the place was perfect. I would recommend here if anyone visits Lisbon.
Would definitely stay again! Great location and very responsive!

Me, my two brothers and our mother had a wonderful time in Pedro’s apartment and in Lissabon
We will definitely come back and if it’s possible gladly stay at Pedros place again.
Obrigado!

We loved this place and will definitely be back for another stay!  The location was amazing. There are definitely hills and some steep stairs, but it was worth it to be in the heart of everything and have a lovely view from the patio.  The furnishings and the house were adorable. It was small, but really well appointed. The couch is extremely comfortable. The patio was great. The bed situation is a little bit strange so you have to go into it understanding and the beds are essentially on the floor. But while they’re listed as full beds, both of them are really more like American queen size.  There is a washer dryer combo, which is incredibly helpful when you’re traveling, but beware that really only the washer works well. You will need to hang your clothes to dry.  This was no big deal considering there’s a patio and a drying rack.
Super schönes und sauberes Airbnb und vor allem sehr zentral.
Loved pedro’s place! They’re very welcoming and it’s a very comfortable little studio.
Lovely apartment in a great location. Small but beautifully finished and perfect for 2 people; lots of natural light and the cutest balcony overlooking the church.
Beautiful, very clean adorable little place. Would live there!!
It’s was a perfect apartment for the three of us in the best location! Thank you so much Pedro :)

Just home from a fabulous three night stay, we loved the apartment it was beautiful, so lovely and light and had everything we needed. Location was brilliant, easy to find (we took a taxi from the airport and it was less than 20 euros) and within walking distance of lots of cool bars and restaurants. The information in the flat was super useful too. Loved the bathroom with the cute blue tiles. Shower was great! Balcony super cute. Would definitely recommend.
This is a light and airy apartment in a great location for exploring Lisbon … thank you for a lovely weekend
I really enjoyed staying at Pedro’s place! Great location, clear and beautiful apartment, and friendly host. Would 100% stay again!
A brilliant place to say in the heart of Lisbon. Super attentive hosts and great food recommendations!
Very lovely place for stay in the centre of Lisbon

Such a sweet little flat!
A friend recommended after having stayed in the same unit. Did not dissopoint.

Great location in the middle of town. Short walking distance to restaurant and public transport. Restaurants just around the corner. Would definitely stay here again. Very warm welcome from the studio guys. Thanks!
Wonderful apartment in a fantastic location. Comfy beds and pillows. We found it quiet and very clean. Highly recommend!
I'd definitely stay here again. In the heart of the city with plenty to do. Our host was exceptional as well. Highly recommend.

Very nice apartment and quiet location with good transport connections. Enough space for two people. The apartment was really clean and all the necessary equipment was found to make breakfast. Pedro was really nice and friendly and helped us whenever needed.
10/10 - thanks for making our stay so easy and special! Beautiful accommodation, friendly and responsive hosts, and extremely well presented.

Fab base for exploring hilly Lisbon. Had an absolutely amazing time and the apartment once you got used to the stairs was a joy and the church bells I thought were really atmospheric- the church itself is well worth a visit too. Hosts were really helpful. Worked really well for myself and my husband.

Gorgeous studio flat in a great part of Lisbon, check in was so smooth and flat has all amenities needed including things to cook with! All of the team were so easy to reach via app & allowed us to store our bags in the flat before a late flight home. Would stay again!!
Rent og pent, men gulvet kunne vært renere! Mulig vi bidro med å skitne det noe til da vi ankom sent i mørket. Ellers alt vel!

Appartement très beau, lumineux et calme, il est tout équipé il ne manque vraiment rien.
Hôte très accueillant et très gentil!
Un super séjour, je recommande.

Pedro’s place in Chiado is brilliant. I was impressed by the location, impeccable design and the comfort of the place. It was very central but yet felt so private. Pedro’s attention to detail is impressive. I couldn’t recommend his place more highly.

Beautiful bright comfortable little flat in a bustling area, but up above the street so nice and peaceful. Has all the facilities you need for a comfortable stay. Furnishings are lovely, very comfy beds and super squishy sofa. Having a cute little roof terrace is a big bonus. Little touches such as provision of salt, pepper, oil and coffee are very welcome, also the big bowl of oranges for making fresh juice. Good activity and restaurant recommendations too. Pedro and his helpers were very responsive and helpful when we had any questions. I would highly recommend this apartment and will stay there again when we visit next.
De studio is mooi en de locatie middenin het centrum van Lissabon is simpelweg fantastisch. Pedro en Joao waren erg behulpzaam. Een echte aanrader!
Very helpful team, special thanks to Francisco, we were helped with any questions and difficulties we raised, the bed was very comfortable, I hope we have good weather next time we come to Lisbon.

숙소가 너무 깨끗했고~ 뷰가 너무 좋았습니다!!

Alloggio davvero carino, host reattivo e chiare indicazioni all arrivo. Erano presenti varie attività consigliate, un balcone molto carino che affaccia su una chiesa, molto soleggiato. Una mansarda davvero graziosa e ben arredata !

Merci pour ce séjour a Lisbonne entre amis. l'appartement est vraiment jolie et fonctionnel.
l'accueil et la communication est un plus !
je conseille+++++
Great stay, very nice place and good location!

We absolutely loved our stay. It was the perfect location—walkable to many places and yet still felt private and secluded. Loved the bell tower outside the window chiming in the time. He left us many recommendations and even a bottle of wine. We left some belongings behind and he helped to arrange getting them back. The bathroom/kitchen was well stocked and very clean. 10/10 would stay again if available!
Vriendelijk, behulpzaam en heel flexibel met in en uitcheck tijden.

Very comfortable stay and Pedro was so helpful accommodating us with whatever we needed. It was concerning however that a carbon monoxide device was listed but we found the device with no batteries in it and it was not in use. This didn’t give us much peace of mind. We also had to buy our own toilet paper because it wasn’t fully stocked which was an inconvenience. Overall it was a cute and comfortable stay and we enjoyed our time.

I've stayed here twice now – once with a friend and once with my family. Pedro's little apartment is a perfect pied-à-terre in a great central position – tucked up enough on a quiet street to feel part of the action but peacefully above it. The church opposite starts chiming the half-hour at 8am but we found it charming and a useful way to wake up! The place is comfortable, attractive and clean – small but perfectly formed. Pedro and his team were super friendly and helpful, and the wine and chocolates left for us was massively appreciated, as was the flexible check-in/check-out. They also had plenty of recommendations for things to do/see. The only thing I would say is that with four people this time (two adults, two kids) and the intermittent torrential October rain, it would be a good idea to have some hooks around the place to hang things up, as well as a shelf or two for the extra clothes and belongings. Apart from that, we loved it and would definitely return!
Appartement incroyable! Jolie décoration, avec une superbe vu.. Centre ville accessible à pied. Hôte très réactif 👍
Great place! Would recommend staying here!
My family love apartment and feeling like home.

We spent an amazing stay in this apartment! The location is great and close to a lot of shops, restaurants and the metro stations so you can get pretty much everywhere. We really appreciated being able to check in early so we didn't need to carry our bags around until 3pm. The view from the terrace was the highlight of the apartment as well as the comfy couch after a long day of walking. I definitely recommend this place!

We stayed here for the start of our honeymoon, and the host was kind enough to let us check in early after a very long flight. The location of this place is ideal - very central but still surprisingly quiet. The loft is VERY small, but I think that's the norm in these older neighborhoods of Lisbon. I couldn't imagine staying here as a non-couple haha! But it's so cute and the view of the church is incredible. We stayed for a week and received an extra cleaning service which was really appreciated. Plus, a bottle of wine and some oranges for fresh juice! Would recommend!
Good location, surprisingly quiet, everything you need.
Everything was perfect! The apartment was super clean and the communication was great. We were allowed to check in early so we didn’t have to carry our bags all day. We had an amazing time!
Pedro and Francisco were great hosts - super friendly and very helpful. The apartment was perfect and in a great location.
This was a great place to stay in Lisbon and the AC was a plus :). Just note, you will have to walk up stairs to get here. The host was great with check in and left us some snacks as well.

Die Kommunikation war sehr gut. Der CheckIn hat super geklappt und wir würden von Antonio persönlich begrüßt. Es gab eine kleine Einweisung für alles und Empfehlungen für Unternehmungen und Restaurants. Alles war sauber und schön eingerichtet. Wir haben unseren Aufenthalt sehr genossen und können die Unterkunft gerne weiter empfehlen.

The perfect Airbnb for you stay in Lisbon! The studio is central to all of the Lisbon attractions. Grocery store, walkable sights, bars and shopping are all just around the corner. Everything was so clean and comfortable! Only small thing id note -  it’s a very narrow and steep stairway going up to the studio. Lost of stairs, I was thankful I just had a carry on a suitcase because anything bigger would have been hard for me to get up and down on my own. If you can’t do stairs this might not be for you but I loved it!

We had a great stay at this apartment! The check-in process was very easy and Pedro was always responsive. The location was perfect for walking to all of the different neighborhoods and had a beautiful view from the balcony. Even though we were minutes from bars and restaurants, the apartment was very quite at night. Would definitely recommend and stay again!

Eine wirklich schöne Wohnung. Alles ist funktional, aber mit Stil eingerichtet. Ein wahres Raumwunder inkl. kleiner Terasse. Hat uns als Familie sehr gefallen. Die Treppen zur Wohnung sind sehr steil, was wir aber wussten.
Man ist sehr schnell zu Fuß mitten im Geschehen. Die Tram 28 hält quasi vor der Tür.
Wenn wir wieder mal nach Lissabon kommen würden wir wieder diese Wohnung nehmen.

L’appartement est un vrai cocon!
Guilherme nous attendait et a pris le temps de nous expliquer le fonctionnement du logement en détail et avec gentillesse.
Orange et vin en cadeau d’accueil.
Tout est très fonctionnel, nous n’avons manqué de rien.
La literie est confortable, la petite terrasse charmante et l’emplacement idéal.
Nous y avons passé un excellent séjour!
Merci de cette location!
Really happy we staid at Pedro’s place! The apartment exceeded our expectations, the location was unbeatable and Pedro was always super kind and responsive! Hope we can go back soon.
We hebben enorm genoten van het leuke appartement! Leuke ligging en alles wat we nodig hadden was aanwezig!

Lugar hermoso, super céntrico y un anfitrión bien servicial. Se camina facil a todos lados y de facil acceso a transportacion publica. En Lisboa hay muchas escaleras y para subir al lugar también. Dormimos 4 comodamente y fue lo mejor de Portugal. 5 estrellas. Volveremos con mucho gusto. Altamente recomendado.

Beautiful place with great lighting. We had a very restful night in the comfy beds and enjoyed a glass of wine on the balcony overlooking the sunset. The shower, although small, was very refreshing after a long day of travel. This place is great! Thank you for the stay!

One of the best Airbnb experiences my friends and I have had. We were greeted upon arrival and given detailed instructions about the apartment. The apartment was clean and centrally located. Would definitely stay again!

The room is comfortable enough and the sunny balcony is a big plus! It’s airconditioned and the WiFi is working good. We had some issues with the shower that Pedro’s team fixed swiftly after we reported it. The apartment could use some TLC here and there, particularly the curtains for blinding from sunlight. Overall a nice place to discover bot the touristic part of Lisbon as well as the trendy, more local restaurants in neighboring Santos area. Thanks Pedro and team!
Awesome place, awesome location and the crew were great with communication also gave me advice on website to book train tickets as well as called cabs for the airport when it was time to go. 5 stars!

Met drie vriendinnen in deze ruimte was het mega gezellig! Het balkon is groot genoeg en je hebt een mooi uitzicht over de stad. Je kan zien dat er veel aandacht besteed is aan dit appartement. Alles wat je nodig hebt is aanwezig. Als je elkaar al langer kent is het ook geen probleem dat je in dezelfde ruimte slaapt.
Four of us stayed at Pedro’s place and it was perfect. The beds were SO comfortable and it was centrally located, in such a cute neighborhood. Would recommend to solo or group travelers. Thanks guys!
We loved our stay at Pedro’s! The loft is the perfect space to base yourself for your Lisbon trip. Close to public transport, restaurants, bars and shops.

The apartment is in a great location & has everything you need for your stay. It is immaculate & the beds are very comfortable, for a change it actually looks like the photos!
It was very hot whilst we were there (39’) so the air con was handy when we arrived home from a walking tour.
Communication was excellent, my messages were answered straight away ,check in was on time & straight forward.
Would definitely recommend!

They were great hosts, from start to finish. Very responsive whenever I had questions. Met us at the main street to help us up the hill, and upstairs into the apartment. Explained everything about the unit at check in. Wonderful recommendations for local restaurants. The apartment was great!: clean, beautiful views, exactly as pictures and described. We would definitely stay again when back in Lisbon. Of course, the bathroom is tight quarters, but that’s not their fault. That would be the only thing that we found a challenge. But they did a wonderful job renovating an older building.
At first we felt a little jealous of Rossio Square, feeling like we wished we were closer to the action. But we quickly realized that this apartment is in the perfect place, close enough to everything, far enough away from the crowds and the nightlife, and surrounded by Lisbon residents more than tourists. We can’t thank them enough for completing our visit to Lisbon. Do not hesitate to book this place!

muy buen anfitrión a pesar que fuimos por solamente 1 noche se preocupo porque nos encontráramos a gusto.
muchas gracias
Great place to stay in Lisbon! Really appreciated how thoughtful the space was

The loft is adorable, clean, well-decorated, and had all the necessities. The view from the patio was beautiful and the location was better than we could have hoped for. Antonio was super responsive and made check in simple. I would highly recommend the loft and would love to stay again the next time we are in Lisbon.
We loved the place, looks just like on the pictures, great location and lovely balcony. Pedro and his crew were great at responding and helping us with our requests. We would stay again.
great hosts. friendly. clear. upgraded us which was nice surprise.  good neighbourhood.  lots of things to do and see and lots of varied food choices

We had a lovely stay here, in the most beautifully decorated loft. It wasn’t loud or hot and it felt like the host had thought of everything - window covers if you wanted blackout curtains, extra towels and linens, even an extra pillow to place next to the bed so you don’t accidentally hit your head on the stairs next to the mattress. The only downside was the steep and narrow stairs getting up to the loft level - maneuvering a suitcase up the stairs was difficult but manageable. Wish we could’ve stayed longer!
Beautiful Apartment in the heart of Lisbon!

Top notch hospitality from Antonio and the rest of the team! They have upgraded pur stay to the best apartment (Chiado #15) they offer in Lisbon due to a plumbing issue from this original airbnb I booked. Location was easy access to everything by foot or the subway close by. The apartment was squeaky clean and they even offer a complimentary cleaning services on our 3rd day as we were staying for 5 days. We received not only a welcome note but also, free wine, fresh oranges and pastel de nata during our check in! Antonio even helped us with one of our heavy luggage going up which was extremely helpful. I can't say enough great things as they will always make sure to offer the help you need even without asking! Extra points for having an amazing selection of books in the airbnb as well.

예약한 곳 배관문제로 근처 다른 업그레이드 룸으로 안내받았습니다.
제가 가본 에어비엔비 호스트중 가장 친절하고 안내를 잘 해주셨어요~ 사소한거 까지 친절하게 설명해 주셔서 너무 좋았습니다!
더 비싼 업그레이드 룸은 이유가 있나봐요
집이 진짜 너무너무 좋았어요
깔끔하고 뷰도 좋고
최고 였습니다.😚
침실 옆 손편지는 정말 감동🥹
단 계단이 높은 4층이라는 점이 단점이지만
다른 숙소들도 마찬가지긴 해서...
그 부분만 빼면 대만족입니다.
리스본 숙소는 여기입니다!
정말 잘 쉬다 갑니다~

Pedro’s place was incredible. We got upgraded to a different location and we loved our short stay. We wanted a place to relax prior to our flight very early and we loved the balcony and amazing shower. Rui, one of the hosts picked us up and has fresh egg tarts for us. We also had a bottle of wine and chocolates waiting at the Airbnb. Highly recommend staying at any of Pedro’s accommodations. We will be booking in the future for sure!

Exactly what we were after! Couldn't be happier with the accommodation and the communication from the hosts. Complimentary wine was a lovely touch! I will be very keen to return here and would definitely recommend to friends and family

Ficamos 2 noites no apartamento, fomos muito bem recepcionados pelo Antônio, tivemos um atraso no voo e ele nos esperou chegar, explicou tudo sobre o apartamento, e ainda tinha um vinho e pastel de nata de presente, amamos tudo, o apartamento é igual as fotos, muito aconchegante, com certeza vamos procurar o apartamento numa próxima viagem.

We had an amazing experience with Antonio and Pedro. The unit we had rented had plumbing issues so we were upgraded to an apartment close by. It was the perfect location and the apartment t was well laid out and had all the little touches such as oranges, wine and the delicious Portuguese pastries. Lists of restaurants and things to do were clear and well thought out. All in all I can’t say enough about the experience!! I also forgot my sunglasses in the apartment t and they are kindly mailing them to me. It’s nice to have such an amazing host. We will be back to Lisbon and your Airbnb.

Location was great. Close to all attractions. Clean and have everything that you need. Space was very cozy. The original location that we selected was not available due to maintained issues. Host quickly offer another location for us. He greet us upon arrival and let us check in early. Very responsive on all our location. Definitely will return back to this apartment.

The apartment was great! We had a slight snag as the apartment we originally booked had plumbing issues but Pedro contacted us immediately to let us know it was not working and offered a few different options. We ended up staying at Chiado 6 and it was great! Spacious, excellent location, and super walkable. The front door to the building is very narrow so just a heads up on that. Excellent hosts and we’ll certainly be back! Thanks again to the team!

먼저 호스트분들이 정말 친절하셨어요. 응답도 항상 빠르고, 비행기 시간때문에 밤11시가 넘은 시간에 체크인을 했음에도 불구하고 직접 문을 열어주시고 캐리어도 대신 옮겨주셨어요. 웰컴 와인과 나타 정말 고마웠어요.
숙소 위치가 아주 좋았습니다. 바로 옆에 작은 브런치 집이 있고, 예쁜 골목골목이 있어서 리스본 첫인상을 좋게 가져갈 수 있었어요. 관광지도 도보로 이동 가능한 거리였습니다.
골목 안에 위치해서 밤에는 소음없이 편안하게 잤어요. 라디에이터도 작동을 잘해서 따뜻하게 지냈습니다. 세탁기도 있어서 장기 여행하시는 분들에게 좋아요.
발코니로 보이는 뷰는 정말 러블리하고 저녁에 앉아서 와인 한 잔 하기 너무 좋았어요.
한가지 단점은 리스본 다른 에어비앤비들과 같이 엘레베이터가 없어서 무거운 짐을 옮기는게 힘들었던 점이에요. 그것말고는 정말 편안히 지낸 숙소였습니다.

The perfect stay! We actually ended up staying at another of Pedro’s lofts as they had an issue with plumbing the day before we arrived but they couldn’t have made it more easy or seamless. The new loft the offered us was absolutely perfect and was an upgrade for the trouble. Would definitely stay again!

Having stayed at a number of airbnbs, the hosts at this one made us feel really welcomed when we checked in. Not to mention the small bottle of wine and some oranges they offered were a nice gesture. Antonio took the time to give us a tour and run down on how things worked -which we really appreciated. They also have a laminated booklet of food and activity recommendations that is very detailed. The airbnb is close to a lot of eateries and stores, making it super convenient and a walkable distance.
The loft was quite small but as we were out most of the day exploring, it was adequate, although there were quite a few narrow stairs and we did feel cramped in the bathroom. Beds were comfortable though.
Overall, they were extremely accommodating too. When an issue arose, they were quick to respond and address as well. Their hospitality really meant a lot to us- we would recommend them!

The place was great.  Will definitely stay here again.  Everything was just as described in the listing.  The hosts are great, very responsive and will help you with any questions.  The host actually met me at check-in and made sure I got settled in and showed me how to work everything.  My stay here was amazing.
Great place fantastic location!

Accogienza amichevole e puntuale, anche oltre le aspettative. L'appartamento è una piccola bomboniera. Ci sono tante scale però subito compensate da un buon gusto estetico nell'arredamento, letti comodissimi e vista suggestiva. Cucina funzionale e bagno essenziale, puliti.

Great location, beautiful apartment- friendly host- they also provided recommended restaurants and things to do- they provided some oranges for us which was a nice touch.
the only item that kind of killed us since we have back pain was the lack of an elevator and the fact that the apt is on the top floor with steep stairs and many of them. next time i'll go with a carry on!

We had a fantastic time at Pedro's place. The apartment is beautifully designed and had everything we needed (including a very comfortable bed). The only downside was the rain meant we couldn't enjoy the beautiful terrace overlooking the local church. But if we come back to Lisbon we'd definitely stay here again, as Pedro and Antonio were really helpful and responsive. They even left a list of helpful recommendations, bars and restaurants across Lisbon to check out. Obrigada!
Viihtyisä ja mukava yksiö. Hyvä sijainti.

This is my 2nd time staying at this Airbnb in Lisbon and won't stay anywhere else.
The host has super fast communication and the location is superb.

This was my second stay at this beautiful loft in Lisbon! Amazing location, great layout with a great balcony view over lisbon. Great restaurants surrounding the location with the city’s landmarks walking distance away. The team at the loft is also very responsive and helpful. Great!
We absolutely loved staying here. The place was perfect, the host gave us heaps of recommendations and the location was incredible. We couldn’t fault our stay.
캐리어 끌고 계단을 올라가는게 힘들었지만 호스트 분이 도와주셔서 다행이었어요! 창문 열면 멋진 뷰가 보이는 아늑한 다락방이었습니다 :)

Logement agréable identique aux photos, Pedro a été très compréhensif lorsque nous avons demandé à avancer notre heure d’arrivée. Des oranges, de la confiture et du chocolat en petites attentions. Foncez !
Great place for a stay in Lisboa. Very central location and good amenities.

Beautiful place with cozy terrace and perfect location!
Waiting to come back in Lisbon!
The flat was wonderful and in a great location.

We felt like we were in a quiet pretty little perch up in this loft - comfortable with all the things we needed. We gobbled up all the oranges and the wine was a great too.
Steps are steep and small so watch your footing and hold that handrail! We laughed thinking about stumbles but managed to avoid it.
So many restaurants within walking distance (SeaMe was our fave).
The hosts are super quick to respond and ready if you need anything. Don’t hesitate to book, this is a special place.
정말 추천하는 숙소입니다. 다시가도 또 묵을 것 같아요. 관광지와 가까우면서 근처에도 맛있는 식당이 많습니다. 로컬 식당들을 체험하는것도 너무 즐거웠습니다. 호스트가 굉장히 친절하고 빨리 도와줍니다. 모든것이 잘 정리되어 있고 갖춰져 있습니다. 심지어 오렌지와 오렌지를 갈아먹을 도구도 있어요. 숙소 상태도 너무 예쁘고 창밖으로 보이는 풍경도 놀랍습니다.
Wonderful place in a wonderful city. Perfect host who helped when needed. Thank you, I will most certainly come back here!

We truly enjoyed the apartment. It was in a great walkable location, and private up on the top floor. Light and airy, comfy space, quiet, good amenities, helpful guides provided. They were there to receive us and show us around. We would definitely stay here again.
Amazing location and great apartment! Incredible balcony views!!
Our stay in Lisbon was perfect and the AirBnB did not disappoint! Close to everything, cozy with great views of Lisbon! Definitely will be coming back soon!
clean, beautiful and well-fuenished as well as well-located apartment. easy comminucation. smaller than on the picture but great for two people.
Amazing location, like others said, near everything but tucked away for quiet and privacy :) easy check-in process and great communication!
Nice host great location nice view

Appartement idéal pour un couple : très bon emplacement, accueil et communication parfaits !
Avons passé un excellent moment !

Pedro’s flat and his team were both great. Communication was seamless and they were very kind in accommodating our special requests for check-in and check-out. The flat is as pictured, with a beautiful balcony from which you can enjoy a lovely view of Lisbon with your morning coffee. Be prepared to walk up narrow stairs to get to the flat, and uphill if you’re going towards Chiado.
ótima estadia
Apartment and hosts couldn't have been better. We'll definitely be coming back to Lisbon and will use the same hosts. Thanks for making the stay so great!
Très bel appartement, très bien situé.

The apartment was perfect. Great location. Lots of thoughtful touches. We appreciated the in person welcome and the ease of checking in and out. The hosts were communicative and helpful, exceeding expectations.
Lovely little place, great location, fabulous view, comfy beds, has everything you need. Perfect for a couple. Good communication and check-in etc, highly recommended.
Great stay, host was there to welcome us and give tour of apartment. Great location, very close to fantastic bars and restaurants.

Wir hatten einen tollen Aufenthalt mitten im wunderschönen Lissabon. Das Apartment ist super zentral und perfekt für einen Kurztrip. Die kleine Terrasse ist ein Traum und die gesamte Unterkunft ist sehr stilvoll eingerichtet. Es ist alles da was man braucht. Wir kommen jederzeit gerne wieder.
Wonderful place. Thoughtful touches and the team taking care of it did a great job. Amazing location in heart of Lisbon. Can’t rec enough.
Our stay here was perfect in every way. Top location, very friendly and flexible host and a beautiful apartment with nothing to be missed. Would always recommend it and stay there again at any time

시내랑 인접해서 어디든 걸어서 갈 수 있어요!
분위기도 좋있습니다~ 호스트분도 친절하셨구요~~

Book this apartment!!! It’s so central to everything and was the perfect base for us!! The apartment is lovely but the church bells do ring every 15 mins from 8am and you WILL hear them, other then that it’s beautiful and definitely worth staying

On vous recommande l’appartement de Pedro! Les hôtes ont été très attentionnés autant avec la note de bienvenue que les informations utiles sur le quartier et Lisbonne qu’au niveau de la communication. C’est un endroit très confortable et propre où l’on se sent bien pour relaxer après une journée à découvrir la ville. Bon voyage!

Thank you so much for a wonderful, comfortable, clean stay in Lisbon! The apartment is very well situated and the perfect retreat from the busy city! The hosts were very welcoming and obliging!
Hopefully will come again soon!

We stayed for 2 days in this flat: 2 adults and a teenager and found it a bit small for 3 people. The bathroom in particular was very tiny. Other than that, it was nice and clean and very close to restaurants and the TimeOut market, so great location. The front of the flat faces a church and the bell might wake you up as early as 8 o’clock, but it didn’t bother us.
Just perfect. Everything we needed. Great location and loved the this charming place to stay.  Great communication too.

Great stay all around, I can’t say enough nice things about this Airbnb. The location is absolutely perfect and I slept so good every night. If you’re contemplating booking a stay here, don’t hesitate! I can’t wait to get back to Lisbon and stay at Pedro’s again!!

Wow wow wow!!
The loft is beautifully designed small space with all you can need. Located in such a great area to walk and find bars, restaurants and retail.
It’s a small space, but if you are after a luscious base to call home for a week, look no further. Antonio was so helpful and thoughtful.
I would stay here next time I’m in Lisbon :)

We had the best time staying at this Airbnb. The hosts were extremely accommodating and we couldn’t have asked for a better location. The street was very quiet but seemed to be 5-25 min walk from all the best attractions and restaurants. There were so many thoughtful touches including a bottle of wine in the fridge and fresh oranges. Can’t recommend Pedro’s Airbnb more!

this was such a memorable stay! Our host Rui went out of his way to make us comfortable! the house was clean and in a very central location. This apartment was cozy and it had all the amenities that we required, including some wine in the fridge:) The house has an amazing balcony with a view of the city and the neighboring church, as well as some spectacular sunsets. Highly highly recommend.

This place was amazing! It looked exactly like the photos and was clean and perfectly located. The host was amazing and left us a booklet of recommendations for the city and was always quick to respond! This place had great value for the cost and we wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again!
We had a very good stay in the apartment in Lisbon. It had everything we needed, the beds were comfortable and the view was very nice. There were bakeries and restaurants close by.
Great location! Balcony is great and the beds were comfortable.
Beautiful apartment in a lovely area. The service was great! We especially appreciated the orange press;) Definitely worth visiting!

We really enjoyed our stay at Pedro’s apartment and would happily stay again. The flat is in a great location right in the old town and there are lots of great little shops and cafes close by. The kitchen is well equipped to make fresh juices and all the breakfast essentials, and the patio is a massive bonus and the perfect place to have breakfast. Thanks for all the little personal touches!
Taxis in Lisbon are incredibly cheap so it’s very affordable to get around quickly too.
A lovely loft studio with great interiors, a welcoming host and amazing little terraces. We had a lovely time and wish we could have stayed longer!
Super leuke tijd gehad in Lissabon in dit appartement! Goed en makkelijk contact met Antonio gehad. Appartement ligt centraal zodat je overal snel heen kunt!
LOVE this accommodation.  It was super charming and wonderfully located.  Can't wait to go back.

Pedro's apartment is small but very cosy. We were a group of three friends and the space was very suitable for three of us. The apartment is located in a great area - lot's of restaurants around. The apartment also has absolutely everything what you need - washing machine, coffee machine, small fridge and - amazing convenient beds! It is also very stylish and beautifully decorated - we took some really beautiful photos on the balcony.

An excellent air BNB for friends or a small family. Really quiet apartment despite being in quite a busy area. Good location and lovely amenities and touches including nespresso pods and oranges left for us to make our own orange juice and a small bottle of wine for us to enjoy. Pedro and his team were friendly and helpful!
An excellent place to stay for a long weekend in Lisbon!

I had an absolutely perfect stay at this apartment! It was clean and comfortable for the three of us that stayed. The location was great as we could walk to all the places we needed to go to with ease. Communication with the hosts was easy as they were very responsive and leaving/entering the apartment every day was simple and worked out great for us. Would definitely recommend staying here!
Amazing!!! The balcony alone is a great reason to choose this spot, but additionally our hosts were so helpful and knowledgeable. An awesome spot. I would stay there again tomorrow if I could.

Apartment was exactly what we were looking for and had everything that we needed to enhance our stay in Lisboa. Centrally located for all our excursions, and in a nice neighborhood. Would definitely stay here again and recommend to others!
Such a cute, perfect apartment. Great location. Excellent communication and responsiveness. Highly recommend this place!

We had a wonderful stay in this stylish apartment with a spectacular view! It is small but is extremely well designed to supply all you need for a vacation stay. The highlight for us was the great balcony with fantastic views. It is also in a great neighbourhood and is very convenient to walk everywhere but bring good walking shoes for the tangle of hilly streets. We also had great communication with the fantastic team. I would recommend booking any of their beautiful properties (I had trouble choosing which one to book).

What an amazing sparkling clean apartment in a great location! Pedro was an incredible host and was so helpful with our check-in and reviewing all the amenities with us. Photos don’t do justice to the size and nice design of the unit. Amazing views from the terrace and super comfortable sofa and beds. Highly recommend!!
Perfect Location, Perfect Hosts, Great Experience!
Amazing place to stay. Everything you can think of they provided to their guests. Very clean, safe, easy check-in and check-out. Very cute apartment that was maintained perfectly.

Fabulous stay here! Perfect apartment for a couple or friends. Exactly as described, very well equipped with kitchen equipment and some lovely little touches from the host. Brilliant location - everywhere we went was always 10 min walk or less. Quiet little street so not loud and out of the louder Barrio Alto area.
Très bel appartement, agréable et bien décoré. Il est très bien situé et l’équipe de Pedro est très réactive. Je recommande !
Amazing, will definitely stay again!

Sehr schön gelegenes Apartment, hell und ruhig , Topausstattung. Pedro und die anderen Gastgeber waren jederzeit erreichbar , wenn man Fragen hätte. Ich habe mich sehr wohlgefühlt und werde sicher bald wieder kommen.

Fantastic stay an in unbeatable location, quiet but within short walking distance to places. Incredible view from the spacious terrace. Hosts were super helpful and added thoughtful touches to the space, including a huge local guide. Book and don’t miss out!

Pedro’s loft was the perfect Airbnb for our weekend in Lisbon. Location was ideal, bars and restaurants all within walking distance. The loft itself was gorgeous, really nicely decorated, comfortable and a good working aircon and fan. The terrace was lovely with stunning views of Lisbon rooftops, perfect for your morning coffee or evening drink! We highly recommend the loft for anyone staying in Lisbon 🇵🇹

My stay here was excellent. The apartment was spotless and in a great location with some amazing views.
Communication was great and there were lots of suggestions on places to try and things to see. I would definitely stay here my next time in Lisbon.
Un charmant petit studio, bien équipé et fonctionnel. Il est bien situé, la décoration est ravissante et la vue incroyable. Un hôte accueillant, attentionné et disponible en cas de besoin.

Schön gelegene Wohnung mitten in der Altstadt, alles super zu erreichen, mitten im Geschehen. Wir wurden sehr nett empfangen, die Kommunikation mit dem Gastgeber war hervorragend, wir wurden sehr nett empfangen. Die Wohnung war sehr gut eingerichtet und sauber. Wir würden jederzeit wieder hier buchen.
This place was awesome and had everything I needed. Definitely would stay here again!

We loved everything about our stay and Airbnb in Lisbon! The location is fabulous!! And we wanted to move into the flat! It has everything you need and the balcony is such a sweet touch! Also the beds were incredibly comfortable!! Pedro and his team were phenomenal! Thank you!
Could no fault our stay - the flat is in a great central location with everything you need and the host was extremely accommodating with regard to checking into the flat. Would highly recommend!
Friendly greeting with extra touches to make you feel welcome

The team at Chiodo Lofts was extremely communicative, helpful, and kind. Gonçalo checked us in and helped us with our very heavy bags, which was so thoughtful of him.
The apartment is in an amazing location, really close to all sorts of beautiful views and amazing restaurants and cafes and shops. There is no street parking; however, very close by there is a not-so-expensive paid parking garage.
The apartment was a bit smaller than we had expected, and I realized during this stay that my wife and I have have reached a place in our lives and travels where we don't really enjoy sleeping on the ground anymore. But if that's not an issue, and you don't need much space, then you can't beat the location or price! We fell in love with Lisbon and can't wait to come back.

Propriétaire très sympathique et toujours là s’il y a quelque chose, on peux compter sur eux ! Le cartier est parfait, tout y est et il est facile de se rendre partout depuis cet emplacement. L’appartement est confortable, allez s’y vous serez ravis 🙂
We had a good stay at Pedro’s place. Super close to everything, the terrasse is a real plus.

This apartment was fantastic. Everything was just as it looks in the photos, if not better! The beds were comfortable and the view from the terrace was unbelievable (it was our favorite spot in the apartment). Diogo also went above and beyond with local suggestions and made sure we knew where everything was during check-in. You can't beat the location; it's walking distance to everything you want to do in downtown Lisbon. I would 100 percent feel comfortable recommending this apartment. Enjoy!

Super cooles Apartment mit 1 Doppel Bett 1 großes Einzelbett und ein großes bequemes Sofa. Gute Ausstattung schöne Aussicht und vorallem eine echt geile Lage um abends weg zu gehen. Supermarkt in 5-6 Minuten erreicht alles
The apartment was beautiful. The beds and couches were really comfy. The view from the porch was breathtaking. I wish we had time to stay there for more days! Thanks for the hospitality l!
מיקום מעולה, נקי ומסודר, הדירה מקסימה ביותר אם כי קטנה ביותר בדגש על החלק של המקלחת והמטבח בנוסף יש לשים לב למדרגות מאוד תלולות ומסוכנות, לא רלוונטי לכל אדם

Nice place to stay!
Be warned: the stairs are steep and narrow, and the bathroom is made for tiny nimble people. :-)
There is a lot of nightlife in the neighbourhood, perhaps because of the Festival of St. Anthony. It still seemed very safe during the day and into late evening, but the first night (Saturday) I had trouble sleeping due to the noise.
Also, you won’t sleep past 8am because the church next door rings starts ringing its bells at that time (and stops at 10pm if I recall correctly).
Super comfortable bed, great A/C, and lots of coffee places / Pastelaria nearby for breakfast.
Enjoy!
Amazing location, outstanding hospitality, lovely apartments! Loved it! Wifi saved us! Thank you so much!

It is a so nice memory to living at here.
The room is so softable and beautiful.
Pedro is sooo handsome and friendly to treat us. The place is very well to enjoy the local life.It is nearby river and market.After dinner we went to time-out market and saw the locals go about their daily life.And also it is very close to the trailway station and MRT station.

Das Appartement ist einfach großartig! Gut gelegen, blitzsauber, modern und geschmackvoll eingerichtet, mit Klimaanlage, die bei über 30 Grad sehr angenehm ist und tadellos funktioniert. Besonders gut hat uns auch die kleine Dachterrasse gefallen, die wir oft genutzt haben, um einen der guten portugiesischen Weine zu genießen. Zu den angesagten Vierteln und zur Metro ist es nicht weit.

Great apartment for a Lisbon city break. As a family with young kids we could easily walk to most places and there were good restaurants and shops just round the corner so very convenient. Lovely to see the church from the balcony and surprisingly quiet at night given its central location. The air con was a godsend at nighttime.
Perfect place in Lisbon. The views from this place are insane, and it’s in the perfect area. Was greeted at the door, given local tips and had a wonderful stay!

This place was fantastic. I stayed here for five days with my friend and we felt welcomed, safe and very happy we chose such a good spot. Very reasonably priced, the guys who own it are helpful, friendly and totally airbnb-savvy. The apartment was stylish - with just the right amount of stuff in it (not empty, not cluttered), with dreamy beds, a huge comfy sofa and really lovely crockery! Small but perfectly formed, it was a great base from which to walk or take the tram/metro/train to all the local sights and beyond. Helpful recommendations for food/drink/music and basically an all-round gem that my friend and I would highly recommend! Obrigada guys!

The location is ideal, Barrio Alto area, next to great restaurants and bars. The space is a perfect size for 2 people and the hosts did a stellar job of design and providing all the amenities you would want including a booklet of suggestions for food, drink and sites. In addition, super friendly guys and they responded immediately. Highly recommended!
If i come one day to the Lisbon again, i will definetly stay here! THE PERFECT place =) highly recommended!

This is a lovely space with a great view from the balcony. It was also surprisingly quiet which we really appreciated! Be prepared for steep stairs... and steep streets! But that’s part of Lisboa’s charm. The beds and pillows were comfortable, and we had numerous restaurant options nearby. Thanks for a wonderful stay!

Honestly can’t fault a thing. The place was beautiful, location was unreal, had a blast. The small touches (bottle of wine on arrival, local guide map, chocolates, portable WiFi hub) made it a five star stay in my opinion. Would HIGHLY recommend 🙌🏼
Todo genial.

The very place to be if you want to explore Lisboa. Everything is just a few steps around the corner and the legendary tram 28 is your daily means of transport. Pedro did an amazing job on the apartment itself-you won’t miss a thing.

This was one of the best experiences I have ever had with Airbnb. The location was great, and walking distance to anywhere I wanted to go in the city. Pedro was very accommodating and was ready to greet us at the door, despite our flight being delayed by 3 hours. The apartment was extremely clean, very modern decoration and has lots of great amenities. I would never stay anywhere else in Lisbon.

Really enjoyed staying at Pedro's place and I am pleased to say the apartment looks exactly like in the pictures. We were welcomed by Goncalo, who provided us with a quick presentation of the apartment, the area and gave us a lovely bottle of portughese wine. On Saturday, just before Easter the guys left for us a typical portughese Easter bread, which we thought was a very nice touch. We definitely recommend staying here, it's clean, modern, has a lovely small terrace, the location is great, with plenty of bars and restaurants around and the best thing is that there is a Manteigaira Pastelaria just 5 minutes away, so you can get the very best pastel de natas in no time. :)

Es un sitio hermoso, un apartamento lleno de detalles y de delicadezas. Nos encantó. Muy muy bien ubicado. Y sus anfiitriones siempre estuvieron pendientes de nosotros, listos a ayudarnos. Quedamos muy agradecidos.  Recomendamos este sitio sin lugar a dudas.
Had a lovely stay. Great location. Small apartment but makes use of space well. Hosts outstanding.

We loved the appartment. It was clean and calm. The guys were available for check-in despite the late hour and left us a sweet note to welcome us as well as nice list of places to visit in Lisbon. The appartment is very close to the city center  and many interesing places are just a few minutes away. We loved the experience and we will make sure to check Pedro's availabilities next time we go to Lisbon.

The staircase of the building were being repainted which made also common areas of the flat a bit dusty. Apart from that, the apartment is super! Perfect location and thoughtful touches! Great communication with the host. Highly recommended!

Невероятно уютная квартира с потрясающим видом из всех окон. А вид с маленькой террасы, по-настоящему захватывает дух. Очень удобная кровать. Апартаменты находятся в уютном районе, где множество магазинов и кафе. Абсолютное соотношение цена/качества. Очень быстрые ответы. Разрешили оставить вещи раньше заезда. Портативный wifi, бутылочка вина и гостеприимная встреча.) Одно огорчило, что удалось пожить в ней меньше суток.) Кто-то обратит внимание на крутую лестницу и отсутствие лифта, но это совсем не стоит внимания, т.к тот вид, с которого я начала, способен перечеркнуть недочеты, которых я не увидела вовсе. 💛

This studio is small but perfectly formed, great for a couple. Communication and check in was really easy. As mentioned by others, the stairs are quite steep but it's not a big deal at all. The apartment was equipped with everything we needed, and the terrace is a nice bonus to sit out in the morning/evening with a glass of something. We really liked the location of this property, easy walking distance to many places, and also close to public transport, Ubers are easy to find in the area as well. Overall a great stay, thanks!
We loved this Airbnb! We only wish we could've stayed more than one night. It's in an amazing location + super clean and stylish with a gorgeous view.

Great stay !! Apartment is very comfortable, clean and quiet !! It has all the ingredients to make it one of the most enjoyable places to stay in Lisboa including a very helpful and available host !!
Keep up with the great hospitality !!

We had an amazing stay here! The communication was excellent as soon as our plane landed and the hosts were there to greet us when we arrived. The loft is a beautiful space in a great location so it was easy to explore, especially with the food and drink tips the hosts provided!
We’d highly recommend, thank you!

Me and my boyfriend stayed there for 4 nights and we didn’t want to leave. The apartment is so extremely cosy and bright with a beautiful view and sunset. Everything in walking distance. We slept like tiny little babies in the bed, so so so comfortable.
We are definitely bokking this again and bringing another couple with us, as it has another bed.
It was just perfect.
Oh, and btw. Don’t sit in the sofa, you will never stand up to explore Lisbon because it was like a marshmellow. So. Soft.
Lovely little top floor!  It is small, and the stairs were very steep - just be ready for three flights up!

Accueil et communication top👍 ce petit loft vous ravira par sa déco hyper cosy et par son emplacement à côté des 3 stations a faire à Lisbonne bairro alto, Baixa chiado et alfama(nous avons tout fait à pied le plus loin étant alfama 25min)vous avez les tram et trotinettes partout👌
La vue sur la cathédrale et les toits est très belle😍 le son de la cloche🔔 qui retenti la journée comme une douce musique mais la nuit nous n'avons rien entendu! Gonzalo Antonio Pedro sont des hôtes super sympas ✌

Best place we stayed in on our 2 week trip to Spain and Portugal! The loft is in an excellent location close to many major tourist attractions. The apartment is quiet, beautifully remodeled, comfortable bedding, amazing view from the patio. We did not want to leave! Also so many wonderful touches, such as Nespresso coffee machine, portable wi-fi device and list of great restaurants in the area. Would love to stay there again!
Super appartement très bonne  localisation très bien équipé et propre. Super séjour ne pas hésité!
Great flat, great location. Slightly on the small side but that is the nature of the town, and so it might be splitting hairs, given that most people on a city break will be out both day and night.

Pedro and his team are amazing. The apartment was a dream that made our stay in Lisbon even better. We enjoyed the views from the rooftop patio, loved the WiFi to go and were pleasantly surprised by the unique interior. Thanks for the tips, the good communication and the delicious oranges! 🍊 we would always recommend!!

Apartment felt light and spacious despite being compact. Had everything we needed and some lovely thoughtful touches. Near to bars and restaurants in the Bairro Alto but far enough away to not be too noisy. Just be aware there are very steep stairs to access the property

Pedro’s place is just wonderful. A perfect home for a Lisbon city break. My friends and I had an excellent weekend, with a very warm welcome from the hosts. They left us a very sweet welcome note, a little chocolate, some delicious oranges and a bottle of wine. Communication was speedy, and they flexed check in for us. We would highly recommend. Thanks for having us!
Foi tudo dentro do acordado. Nossa estada foi perfeita. A equipe foi sempre atenciosa e prestativa. O apartamento é confortável e a localização é muio boa.

너무 예쁘고 깨끗한 공간, 세심한 배려, 정성스러운 청소, 햇빛이 잘 드는 창문!!
따뜻한 히터, 맛있는 커피, 유용한 세탁기, 푹신푹신한 침대와 쇼파
모든 것이 완벽했습니다. 호시우광장과도 꽤 가깝구요.
계단이 좀 가파르긴 하지만, 다른 후기들과 같이 문제가 되지 않을 정도로 완벽한 숙소였어요. :D
Highly recommend the place

We really enjoyed our stay here. It was well-located and walkable to everywhere we wanted to go, including the downtown Baixa area and Alfama. We appreciated the tips they gave us for places to eat. The apartment was very clean, bright, and a lovely place to return to after a full day of exploring. They were wonderful with communication, replying right away to my messages to ensure they were here to greet us when we checked-in. Our favorite part was the amazing view from the terrace. Would stay here again.

Super Zentrale Lage!
Die Winternächte in Lissabon sind doch sehr kalt, daher war die Heizung der Wohnung ein Segen. Das kostenlose takeout WiFi war eine geniale Überraschung!

We had a great stay in lisbon. The appartment ja exactly how it is decribed. The communication with the host was perfect, answers within minutes and the check-in and check-out precedure was very easy and fast. I would recommend the appartment without any doubt.

Also Petro ist ein perfekter Gastgeber ,seine Wohnung sauber geschmackvoll und in bester Lage.Was ich aber betonen möchte der Aufgang ist sehr steil und lang und erfordert eine gewisse Fitheit .Die Wohnung kommt auf den Bildern grösser raus als sie ist .Sie hat aber alles was es braucht und das geschmackvoll und mit Liebe zum Detail eingerichtet,es fehlt an nichts.Die Lage ist traumhaft.Wir empfehlen diese Unterkunft auf jeden Fall weiter.
Absolutely amazing!! So homy and so cozy. We loved every minute of it!

Gorgeous apartment with amazing view from the balcony. Nice little touches with bottle of wine and gadgets (speaker/transportable WiFi). Very quick and efficient at responding to our messages. Thank you for a great stay in Lisbon!

What a great little loft! Perfect for my husband and I. Tho there are 2 beds...the space is best for couples. The patio is nice and you can enjoy the Church Bells hourly. They stop by 9pm. It was quiet at night, no problems sleeping, and the beds/pillows were very comfortable. Highly recommend!!

I would highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone staying in Lisbon. They have great recommendations for nearby restaurants and bars. The view from the balcony is absolutely beautiful and the hosts have truly thought of everything for their guests. Even though the home is close to everything in town it is quiet at night. One of our favorite Airbnb’s we have stayed at!
Great loft at a great location!
Cozy place, very kind host, good location which is in walking distance with Rossio station. Worth recommendation.

The apartment was beautifully designed, very comfortable to stay in and looks exactly like it does in the photos.  It's located in a great neighbourhood where it's easy to get around Lisbon from. The small terrace is a nice place to have a drink or coffee overlooking the city.  Pedro and team were always fast to respond and we really liked that the apartment came with a mobile wifi hotspot for us to use while out and about. The apartment is located on the top floor of the building so before booking it make sure you feel comfortable climbing a few flights of stairs.  There's also a church across the street where the bells ring during the day starting at around 8 in the morning. It didn't bother us though. Highly recommend this Airbnb.
Fantastic place , beautiful and comfortable .They thought about every detail .Communication was good . I will recommend this place for sure .Thank you
Local bem arejado, limpo e bem equipado. Facilidade de acesso para os passeios.

Apartment conveniently located in St Catherine neighborhood. Nice deco inside. Too small for four, but a little expensive for 2 guests. Communication with host very fluid and easy. Be prepared to carry your luggage up 3 stairs in a very steep and narrow staircase.
We have been the third time at Pedros appartment. And again we had a great time. I would have rated seven stars if possible.

We found it very easy to walk to central Lisbon from this lovely little apartment. Tram 28 runs virtually by the door and the Metro is about 15mins walk. It is easy to use the Metro for the Airport and the station.
The apartment is entered through a narrow door and up a steep flight of stairs but once inside the flat is light and airy with air con and the compact space is cleverly fitted out with a fully equipped kitchen with washing machine and dishwasher. There is even a balcony with table, bench & chairs with a view over the west of the city.
We would definitely use this place again if we returned to Lisbon and as there is still so much to see and do there it is highly likely that we will be back.

Pedro’s space was nicely decorated and very cute but much smaller than it appears in photos—suitable for 2 people but I imagine it would be very cramped for a larger group. Check in was very smooth and Goncalo was helpful in getting us settled, but a strange interaction at the close of our stay kind of soured our experience.
A cleaner showed up at our door at 10:59a sharp on the day of check out, telling us we needed to get out immediately. I expressed that we were about 10 minutes from being ready for departure, but the cleaners barged past me at the door, started cleaning around us and refused to leave while we just changed out of our pajamas. They called someone who I spoke to on the phone who reinforced that check out is 11am and we needed to leave. If leaving promptly at 11am was so important, I think it would have been helpful to have that reiterated at check in, rather than be surprised.
Overall the space is fine, a bit overpriced in my opinion, but more importantly inconsistent with the Portuguese hospitality we experienced everywhere else during our trip.

생각보다 공간 크기는 작았지만 아늑하고 좋았어요. 호스트가 정말 친절하고, 일찍 짐보관할 수 있게 도와준 것도 정말 고마웠어요. 선물로 준비해둔 와인이나 초콜릿 같은 배려도 좋았고, 근처 여행정보, 포켓 와이파이같은 세심한 배려가 너무 고마운 곳이에요. 여행객입장을 충분히 생각한다는 것이 느껴졌어요. 시계탑이 보이는 테라스도 멋지고, 빨래도 가능해서 좋아요. 짐들고 올라가기 불편하다고 해서 걱정했는데 통로가 좁긴하지만 생각보다 높지않아서 괜찮았어요. 추천합니다. :)
Great place, with a beautiful view off the porch.
Excellent place for a short stay
appartement sympa, bien placé, super accueil. Bien pour deux, juste pour quatre

The apartment is in a great location--around the corner from the hustle and bustle of Chiado/Bairro Alto. The space is cozy, charming, and clean with an impressive use of the space. We loved eating breakfast on the patio overlooking the church using the apartment's espresso maker and the orange juicer to get the morning off to a great start. (You can hop over to any of the pastry shops less than a 5 min walk in either direction to accompany your morning beverages.)
Although the street outside the back patio is lively we found that with all the windows closed (and the good AC unit blowing!), we were able to fall asleep without problems. The neighboring church does have a bell, but it only tolls every half hour between 8 AM and (maybe) 8 PM so it might wake you up, but definitely won't keep you awake at night. Really, it adds to the charm! Two things that are important to mention: 1) The stairs are quite steep and narrow. We navigated them just fine with our soft luggage, but imagine that it would be much more difficult if you used one of those big, wheeled suit cases. 2) Although there are two beds in the apartment, the space is really best suited for one couple. The apartment is a good size, but the layout isn't conducive for giving individuals a lot of privacy as the space is one large room, and the bathroom is quite small.
Check in was smooth and Goncalo (Pedro's colleague) kindly waited for us longer than anticipated when our cab driver took us in the wrong direction twice. Also, this was our last stop on our honeymoon and it was nice that we could wash some of our clothes in the unit's laundry machine. Goncalo showed us how to use it, which was a real help to these Americans whose machines look totally different! All in all, it's a great place with lovely touches--the only place we stayed during our honeymoon that provided us with a bottle of wine and little chocolates.

The location is perfect and the apartment is really nice. We were not so happy about the loud bells from the church directly opposite of the apartment, but since we were in the city most of the time it was quite okay. The bells stop at 8pm and start again at 8am each 30 minutes.
Other than that, the apartment was comfortable and cosy. The bathroom is small but it didn’t really bother us. Beds are not so good but ok.
City Centre is close by and there are a lot of restaurants really close.
Checkin was really friendly and informative and he gave a good intro of the city.
Un apartamento muy bonito y encantador. Antonio ha estado muy atento. Muy recomendable.

This was my favorite Airbnb to stay in during our travels (we stopped in Copenhagen and Amsterdam as well). Communication with the guys was easy, the room itself was very clean with a little bottle of wine to welcome us, and the location was right where most things in the city were happening. My favorite things about this stay include: the sick view on the patio (great for night caps), the espresso machine (that kept us alive), and the suggestions list made for their guests (key when you decide to wing a few days in another country). Thanks again guys!!!

Super petit appart très mignon et bien placé !
Le top : petite terrasse ombragé très agréable !
Parfait pour un couple.

Fantastic apartment in the center of Chiado. Close to good restaurants, bars in a neighborhood plenty of things to do. Nice decoration, a small terrace with fantastic views of the city skyline to enjoy the good weather. Nice and clean bathroom with a lot of light. Summarizing, great place for a trip to Lisbon just in the middle of the most exciting area of the city. Pedro is easy to locate and made our arrival extremly easy.
Super nice apartment in great location! Pedro confirmed our booking and could check us in within an hour after some last minute arrangements. Happy to be back soon again!

I had high expectations for our stay in Lisbon as the photos of the flat look fantastic! Luckily this place was absolutely as we'd hoped. Dont be fooled by the dark corridor to access the apartment, its a light, bright, airy flat very carefully and cleverly planned with a lovely little terrace for a glass of wine before sundown! Perfectly located and communication with our host was great. The only minor negative is the steps to get to the apartment, not good for anyone with really heavy bags or who struggles with steep ascents! Would love to stay here again.
The apartment was absolutely amazing! If I rate it with 6 Stars I would rate it with 7! Everything very well organized and tidy, location was perfect and pedro was very nice to! Thank you!
Acogedor y muy bien ubicado, estás en el centro de Chiado.
Amazing place with an even more amazing location. Loved it!

Beautiful modern apartment in great location with a lovely sun terrace with views over the city. The apartment generally had a cosy feel with lots of windows so felt light and spacious.  Worth noting very steep steps to get to the apartment so wouldn’t suit family with small children or elderly. Overall great stay, thank you!
Hands down the best Airbnb I’ve ever stayed in!!

Great location that is close to many bars and restaurants. The hosts were quick to respond, even last minute and were friendly and gave good advice. The apartment was very clean and had everything one would need, but is not a large space and there is no private bedroom.

We had a fantastic stay in Pedro’s loft! It was very well appointed with some really welcoming touches. Check in was personal and both the driver and Pedro’s team helped with our bags up the rather precarious stairs.
That was the only challenge in a fantastic property and location but that’s what you get when you stay in historic properties.
Well worth it and highly recommended.

Hemos pasado 4 días fantásticos en este loft, que es tal como aparece en las fotos. Situado en un barrio muy céntrico, bien comunicado, tiene unas increíbles vistas, una decoración muy bonita y se ha cuidado hasta el mínimo detalle. Cuenta con todo lo necesario para pasar una estancia agradable y la limpieza es impecable.
Mención especial merece el trato de los anfitriones, con una comunicación muy fluida y dispuestos a ayudar en todo momento.
Si quieres pasar unos días en Lisboa, en un apartamento céntrico y acogedor, éste es el sitio perfecto, siempre y cuando no tengas problemas de movilidad y viajes ligero, porque las escaleras de acceso son estrechas y empinadas.
Volvería sin dudarlo.

Está muy bien ubicado, podes ir caminando a todos lados !
Está decorado con muy buen estilo, súper equipado, tiene lavarropas, para cocinar, toallas, sábanas y nos dejaron de regalo café, té, vino y una carta de bienvenida. Hospeda ideal en Lisboa!
Al ser ultimo piso en Lisboa tiene muchas escaleras para subir con valija, pero Portugal es así! Estás todo el tiempo subiendo para llegar a todos lados.
Atardecer en terraza súper agradable!

Pedro’s place was a lovely little place! We loved the decor and the special little details. The neighbourhood is cute and there are lots of restaurants and wine bars around. António helped us in booking a cab and was very responsive - thanks for a great stay!
Lovely place, centrally located!

Pedro’s place is fantastic! Great location; beautiful terrace which is a little sun trap. We loved our stay here. The apartment was so stylish and had everything you could ask for, including a very welcome bottle of wine which was a god send after a delayed flight. The place was very clean and we had a great night’s sleep! Pedro’s team were in touch with us regularly and made our check-in seamless! Obrigada Pedro, António, Gonçalo and Catarina!

Niché en haut d’un étroit immeuble autantique cette appartement de charme et sa décoration soignée s’ouvre sur une petite terrasse surplombant les toits de Lisbonne. Une propreté uncomparable, guides et autre sur la ville de Lisbonne  à disposition, mais surtout une charmante surprise à l’arrivée ;) ! Je vous conseil vivement d’y séjourner !
Great location and good value. Lots of windows that open. Very bright. Private outdoor terrace overlooking church with bells and view of Lisbon.

Квартира полностью соответствовала описанию и фото. Виды шикарные и Квартира уютная. Отличный WiFi. Все продумано и отличная коммуникация с хозяином квартиры: оперативно и плюс он согласился принять нас раньше обозначенного времени. Рекомендую
la casa es tal y como se ve en las fotos. muy bien situada. Un poco de ruido por las campanas de la iglesia próxima
Very nice light appartment
The apartment is the perfect location! Walking distance to all the great bars, restaurants and sights! The place was just like the pictures and would highly recommend
Very nice apartment with a perfect location nearby some really great restaurants and bars. The check in and check out was very convenient.

Almost reluctant to leave a review but from entirely selfish point of view! We had a fantastic 3 night stay in Chiado loft. The apartment was perfect for both of us and the terrace was fantastic with views overlooking Lisbon.  The additional touches of Nespresso/Wine and oranges were all sampled! Antonio was so helpful and we really appreciated the flexible check in and check out times. We will definitely be back to Lisbon and Chiado Loft!
4 girls travelling to celebrate a Hen Party, the place was just perfect for it! We really liked it! Perfect to see Lisbon

Lo recomendaría siempre. El sitio tiene mucho encanto y está muy bien situado, al lado del mirador de Santa Catalina y de un parking. Repleto de detalles y muy luminoso. Limpieza genial.
Lo único malo las escaleras, las almohadas y que si te molesta La Luz matutina debes llevar un antifaz.

We were here with our two small kids (2 and 5 yo) and had a good time! The space is small and you can't be in there for too long with 2 little ones - however it's cleverly thought in terms of use of space and there are some great details (portable wifi, speakers, nespresso machine) as well as a great location (no problem with noise at all). Furthermore very responsive hosts and comfy beds - thumbs up from us!
Amazing location and apartment with incredible views. We only wish we would have stayed longer!!

Die Lage des Appartements ist super! Das Appartement selbst,hat uns sehr gut gefallen. Es ist sehr geschmackvoll eingerichtet und entspricht genau der Beschreibung bei airbnb. Würde ich immer wieder buchen!

Wir hatten zu dritt eine wundervolle Zeit in Lissabon!!
Diese traumhafte Unterkunft von Pedro hat so viel dazu beigetragen.
Die Lage ist super zentral - mitten in der Altstadt. Ruhig gelegen und es lässt sich alles perfekt zu Fuß erkunden. Die Wohnung ist sehr sauber, hell und super gemütlich eingerichtet. Ganz hin und weg waren wir von der Dachterrasse. Ein herrlicher Ausblick über Lissabon.
Pedro und sein Team waren großartige Gastgeber. Jederzeit wurden alle Fragen sofort beantwortet und auch während unseres Aufenthalts waren Sie sehr bemüht und gaben uns viele Tipps für eine unvergessliche Zeit.
Herzliches Dankeschön! Wir drei sind sehr begeistert und kommen sehr sehr gerne wieder!
Stay here.  Great place!  Nice touches!
Precioso apartamento, Antonio nos recomendó muy bien donde poder aparcar y donde cenar, ha sido muy atento, todo perfecto!

Great location. You are in a party area of town, so beware of noise or bring earplugs. It had everything I needed, except I didn't need three flights of very dangerous, steep stairs. My check-in was superb as I was hours late because of airline problems, but I was still met after midnight with a smiling face.
Great stay at this place in Lisbon! Awesome space in a great location, would highly recommend.

This is an amazingly stylish space that is also incredibly convenient to so many great neighbourhoods! Lovely extra touches as well that make for a very hospitable stay. Great communications - quick to try to accommodate requests, etc. Highly recommend the space!
Parfait pour découvrir la ville, très bien placé, et hyper cosy !
Lovely apartment and good host
Thank you guys! It was a great stay. The appartment and everything was just perfect.
Amazing location, a walk away from a great scene. The place itself was beautiful, would definitely come again!

O apartamento é imperdível e nos proporcionou uma ótima experiência em Lisboa.
A localização é ideal (próxima ao metrô e a diversos pontos importantes da cidade). Além disso, há mercados, farmácias e variadas lojas na região.
Tudo estava aconchegante e limpo quando chegamos.
Tivemos um voo atrasado no dia do check-in e, mesmo assim, fomos muito bem recebidos por António.
Super recomendo!

If I am ever lucky enough to visit Lisbon again, then I hope I will be staying at this loft. Just what AirBnB is so good at. Great location, local people, local amenities, right in the heart of buzzy barrio-alto but quiet enough to sleep cosy & well at night. My favorite part of this stay was having so many photogenic city hotspots right on my doorstep. And the terrace! Watching the reflection of the sunrise on the surrounding buildings from the terrace. Love! 💚🇵🇹❤️

This loft is simply amazing! Clean, quiet and comfortable. The location is perfect and walking distance to the shoppping district, super market, river, bars, restaurants & so much more. This is on the top floor so you will climb a lot of stairs. The amenities offered to us inside were spectacular; a Nespresso machine with pods, a book with local tips, chocolate of Portugal, a hotspot to take with you during the day for WiFi, and a bottle of welcoming wine! We felt very comfortable and homey inside this loft and will def. be back next time we’re in Lisbon! Thanks for the fantastic stay :)
Wonderful little flat with cute views, a cute space, and great hosts.
Very comfortable apartment in excellent location. Great host with lots of information. Will definitely be back.

The interior of the apartment is modern and very clean. The balcony was a speial thing of the apartment with nice view. The neighborhood is very quiet at night. Hot water is limited to 10-15 minutes each time you use the shower but it is ok as there is heater in the bathroom.
Check in is easy but note that there is steep stairs while the apartment is on 3rd floor.

Highly reccomended host.
Wonderful apartment .
Pedro and António are wery kind.

The place is exactly as described: stylish and comfortable. You will find everything you need for your stay. The apartment needed a few fixes (leaking water, a bulb) and they were extremely fast to have it all solved. The stairs to the apartment are a bit too steep, so be prepared for that.
Great place, ideally located, easy check in, clean

La casa è una bomboniera, piccolina ma davvero non le manca niente, un terrazzino che è un incanto...Il check in me lo ha fatto Antonio, ragazzo troppo carino e gentile, mi ha fatto anche posare i bagagli prima del check-in!
Appartamento curato in ogni dettaglio e proprietari molto ospitali, mi hanno fatto trovare anche il vino e i cioccolatini...se dovessi tornare a Lisbona sicuramente li ricontatterò!!
Logement très propre, avec beaucoup de charme, bien situé. Hôtes très sympas, disponibles et serviables.

Appartement cozy et très agréable. Pedro a été très accueilllant et nous a tout expliqué à notre arrivée. L'appartement est vraiment bien équipé et la petite terrasse est parfaite pour prendre son petit déjeuner. Je reviendrais sans hésiter pour mon prochain voyage à Lisbonne!

Couldn't find a better place to stay! :)
Lisboa is amazing. Pedro's apartament awesome too, super local. Love it!
Thank you.
Great place!!!

Beautiful apartment - clean and great views. Communication with Pedro was clear and fast.  Check in was extremely easy. Location of the apartment is ideal, very close to great bars and restaurants. They needed to get into the apartment twice during our stay, but as we did not need to be there is did not effect our plans. They provide a guidebook with bar and restaurant tips which was very nice. Overall great stay and would book again for my next visit.
The flat was significantly smaller than the photos indicated. We couldn’t have stayed more than two people there.
Very easy to communicate and check-in, check-out. Nice apartment and great location.

We absolutely loved this place! The area is very central with lots of great bars around (try park rooftop!). Also the communication with Goncalo was great, really friendly and being flexible with our check out time. The apartment was tidy / clean and literally had everything you need! Thanks so much for the great stay :)

Très bon accueil plein de charmantes attentions avec une liste de bonnes adresses testées et approuvées , appartement nickel et très bien situé ...c'était un plaisir d'être dans un lieu pareil. On s'y sent très vite comme à la maison . Idéal pour 2 personnes . Hôte accueillant et disponible.

This is a very efficient and well designed space. Every square inch has had thought put into its use. Bright and airy. Really like the small outdoor terrace for coffee in the mornings and wine in the evenings. The No. 28 Tram is just around the corner. Parking is convenient within a block and is very reasonably priced. The bonus to the parking garage is on the roof! There is a fantastic terrace bar with great drinks and music.
