Perfect place for viewing the sunset! The only downside to the apartment are the very steep steps. Pack light!
Great location, comfy bed, beautiful view. Would definitely stay again!

This is a nice place in a very good area that has access to everything you might need. We were met by Goncarlo who was great and explained everything to us. We were delighted with the little things provided like jams and coffee, a bottle of wine, fresh fruit and chocolate. It made us feel special. We were also thrilled with the high speed Wifi. They also supply a portable mobile wifi unit you can take with you on the streets but we never had need to use it. The Loft is clean, tidy and cosy but perhaps a little cluttered and not much closet space, although for just two of us, we made do. I just kept my clothes in my suitcase. It really was lovely. The only downside are the stairs. There is no elevator and the stair treads are very narrow. Iif you are at all unsteady on your feet or have large suitcases, you might experience some trouble. We struggled getting our cases down. This was our only problem. Otherwisse  highly recommended.

This is a little gem in a great location in the Chiado area of the old city of Lisbon. The decor is very stylish and, although the space is small (particularly the bathroom and kitchen), it is well laid out and is very comfortable. There is a small balcony which faces Santa Catarina church and has a view of the city. The fact that it had an outdoor space is the primary reason we selected this place above others. We loved it. Each morning, afternoon, and evening, we would sit on the balcony and eat, drink coffee or wine, read, and plan our next excursion.
YES--you will hear the bells. They are right there. But they don't ring all night--they stop by 9 or so and start again at 8 in the morning. We loved them! Sunday morning is a treat, with the bells beginning slowly with a song and then going into the full blown ringing. Awesome to watch.
One amenity that was really helpful was that they offered a portable wifi that you could take with you and recharge when back in the apartment. That really came in handy. There is also a mini washer/dryer which is handy if you like to pack light. We had a little problem with the washer/dryer and had to call Lorenco. He came right over and took care of it for us. He and Pedro are very responsive. Each time I emailed with a question, or to update them on our arrival time, we had a response immediately.
The other thing we loved about this apartment was all the windows. There are two sets of French doors and six more windows that can be opened. Although there is an a/c unit, we did not need it in September with all of the windows. But, if you are traveling in the heat of the summer, this apartment's a/c is a big plus.
This apartment is on the upper floor of the apartment building. There is no elevator so you must climb up three flights of narrow steps. For those with limited physical abilities, this may not be the place for them. For everyone else, this is a lovely apartment, well located, with responsive hosts.

If you can get this place and you don't have a problem walking up stairs, get it. It was absolutely amazing, Pedro left us with detailed suggestions of restaurants and spots to go to and we could not have asked for a better experience.

Wunderschön und liebevoll! Toller Empfang und Betreuung auch während des Aufenthaltes. Die Lage ist kaum zu übertreffen. Die kleine, aber sehr feine  Terrasse möchte man einpacken...  Zu beachten sind die wirklich krasse Treppe und das winzige Bad. Da passt nicht jeder rein...  Dennoch: Immer wieder gerne und in Vorfreude!!!!

Everything was better than expected.  The apartment was in a perfect location and provided a personal touch while staying in a big city.  The whole experience was perfection from check in to check out.  Exceptional communication and overall a wonderful stay in Lisbon!

Très bel accueil à notre arrivée!  Et le lieu est tel que décrit sur le site d'airbnb. Quant à l'emplacement, c'était très bien pour nous qui avions à nous déplacer pour visiter différents coin de la ville (l'appartement est près de la station Cais de Sodre)

My boyfriend and I visited this apartment on 31st aug. There is a reason why these host have so many good reviews. The apartment was beautiful exactly like the pictures. Such a beautiful place. We arrived early in the day and asked if we could check in early and Antonio said we could drop our bags off at 1130 and check in at 130 which was perfect. When we got there around 12 to our surprise everything was ready and we could check in then. Which was very nice. The hosts were perfect, so helpful. If you had any problems and if you emailed them they would reply within minutes. We had an issue with the door one day and Antonio was at the door in honestly less than 2 mins. There was also loads of extras inside the apartment such as coffee machines (two different types) wifi tablet which is a portable devise which out with you and be connected to the wifi all day. This was very helpful when finding directions around the city. I didn't even know this type of tablet existed. I could keep writing on how amazing this place was however I will wrap it up. In summary this was the most beautiful apartment, perfect hosts, perfect location everything was literally better than I could have imagined. Thank you so much to Antiono and the team! I will be recommending your apartments to both friends and family. Thank you!

Logements central proche de toute commodité.
Propre ,fonctionnel ,hôte a l écoute
Merci
Stephane

Beautiful apartment centrally located in Lisbon. The portable wifi was a huge plus. The only negative was that the bathroom is a little small to get ready in with 3 people. I would definitely stay here again if I came back to Lisbon.

My family and I had a great stay at Pedro's place! Communication and check-in were fantastic, and we appreciated all the local recommendations provided at the apartment. The space was very clean and newly renovated. The balcony was fantastic - great views of some amazing sunsets. I will say that the space is smaller than it appears in photos. Although it sleeps four, my family of three felt a bit cramped. Other than that, everything was perfect!
The flat is not so big but really nice and cosy. The position is perfect and the host very kind !! I suggest to rent it!!!!!

Very nice stay at the loft, we had a charming welcoming by Antonio, with gifts and chocolate waiting for us. The view on Lisboa is incredible and the loft is very cosy and well-thought. We will recommend it to our friends
wonderful apartment!!!

Lovely apartment with a great location. Even though the place is very central, it was pleasantly quiet at nights. The apartment is beautifully furnished and has everything you need for a wonderful stay. The balcony was really great on hot days. I would highly recommend this place!

We loved our stay here. They've done a remarkable job of converting a tiny loft into a beautiful, well-appointed place to stay, in a fantastic location.
Be prepared for lots of steps, to match the lay of the city, but as with the city itself, they're totally worth it.
The apartment wouldn't be ideal for those with very young kids - steep stairs and hard, pointy surfaces everywhere - but our 3 year old did fine.
We'd love to come back here next time we're in town. It's every bit as good as it looks in the photos.
L'appartement situé au dernier étage est bien équipé. Nous avons apprécié la petite terrasse et sa situation géographique. Christine et Christian.
Absolutely perfect from start to finish - great communication, flexibility, beautiful flat, amazing location, great value. Definitely recommend this airbnb in every way.

Loft au top, propreté parfait! L' Accueil super sympa en arrivant au loft.
Parfait pour des jeunes qui veulent passer un séjour là .

Amazing stay! Two friends and I stayed here for 3 nights and we couldn't have asked for anything better.  The location was absolutely perfect.  Close to restaurants, bars, markets, and stunning city views! The apartment was very clean and provided us with all the amenities we needed and more.  Our hosts were extremely accommodating and gave us recommendations on what to see and where to go. HIGHLY RECOMMEND if you want an amazing experience in Lisbon. Thank you!!
Perfect! As seen in pics this place is beautiful and in the perfect location. Walking distance to the centre and very close to the beautiful view point. I highly recommend :)
Everything was as expected and we are very happy with our stay!

This apartment is so well-located and perfect for two friends to stay in. The view from the balcony is incredible and having a speaker/portable wifi hotspot was so great. I would stay here over and over again.

We loved this apartment! It was quaint, in a nice lively area but still very quiet ( we were there during lisbons biggest festival)   The little balcony was soo wonderful at the end of the day!  Very clean and well decorated. Not for the faint of heart, very steep narrow stairs to get to the apartment but really just part of the charm. Hosts were wonderful and I highly recommend this apartment!
Beautiful loft with an extraordinary small terrace overlooking a nearby church and the city

Very pleasant stay in this extremely well maintained apartment. Centrally located, close to animated area but the apartment is very calm. Service from hosts is close to perfection thanks to sympathy and responsiveness. Highly recommended apartment.
Ps : stairs may look sharp to elder people.

Das Loft mitten in der schönen Altstadt von Lissabon ist wirklich wunderbar! Es ist gemütlich eingerichtet und verfügt über alles, was man für einen perfekten Aufenthalt in Lissabon benötigt. Die Küche ist sehr gut ausgestattet mit Nespresso-Maschine (sogar Kapseln waren vorhanden!), Spülmaschine, Mikrowelle & mehr. Das Bad ist hinreichend groß, die Betten sehr gut und der Ausblick von der kleinen Terrasse traumhaft. Auch für 4 Personen (wir waren mit unseren 2 fast erwachsenen Töchtern dort) ist das Appartement mit einem runden Esstisch und einem bequemen Sofa groß genug. Die Treppe hinauf ins Dachgeschoss ist zwar sehr steil, aber wir haben uns schnell daran gewöhnt.
Nachdem wir bereits ab 11.30 Uhr die Koffer abstellen konnten, begrüßte uns Goncalo um 13.30 Uhr vor dem kleinen Häuschen in der sehr malerischen und ruhigen Seitenstraße Rua da Hera. Alles war liebevoll für uns hergerichtet - sogar mit Wein & Pralinen zur Begrüßung. Die Ausstattung mit weißem Bettzeug, vielen Handtüchern und einem tragbaren WLAN-Router war perfekt.
Vom Loft aus konnten wir alles zu Fuß erreichen - obwohl die Metrostation und die Haltestellen der Tram und der Standseilbahn Bica in der Nähe waren.
Unser Tipp für den letzten Abend: die Roof Top Bar "Bar Park" auf dem Dach des Parkhauses gegenüber (nicht ausgeschildert) mit einem herrlichen Blick über die Stadt bis zum Tejo und der Ponte de 25 Abril.
Da die nachfolgenden Gäste direkt im Anschluss kamen, konnten wir unser Gepäck problemlos am Cais do Sodre in einem Schließfach unterbringen und somit auch den letzten Tag in Lissabon genießen.
Wir haben uns in "unserem" Chiado Loft sehr wohlgefühlt und wir kommen auf jeden Fall wieder! Vielen Dank an das ganze Chiado Loft Team!
Unser spezieller Dank geht jedoch an Antonio, der uns sehr geholfen hat, als wir einen Rucksack mit wichtigem Inhalt in einem Taxi vergessen hatten. Herzlichen Dank, Antonio, deine Hilfe war grandios und nicht zu erwarten!!!
Awesome place in a really nice hood. Everything went well. 5 stars.

We had a great stay in Pedro's apartment! We got the opportunity to meet in person and he took very good care of us, recommended lots of good tips on where to go and stuff to do. The apartment is very cosy and comfortablel. It is located in a very nice area of Lisbon, close to nice shops, bars and restaurants. We would highly recommend a stay in Pedro's apartment!

Stunning apartment in a great location! Great attention to detail in the design of the space, very comfortable and a beautiful view from the balcony. The stairs to the apartment are very steep! Lots of information provided regarding the local area. Thank you!

Die Unterkunft hat jegliche Annehmlichkeiten. Neben einem niedlichen Balkon, auf welchem man zu 3. gut frühstücken kann, gibt es eine Nespressomaschine inkl.Kapseln, gemütliche Betten, eine voll ausgestattete Küche und für heiße Tage eine Klimaanlage. Für die Damen gibt es einen kleinen Reisefön. Unser Favorit war das portable WLAN, welches man in der Tasche verstauen konnte und somit für ca.6 Std.das Handy für die Navigation durch die vielen kleinen Gassen Lissabons nutzen konnte. Schwierig ist lediglich der Aufstieg zur Wohnung. Die Treppe ist sehr steil und die Stufen kurz. Daran muss man sich gewöhnen. Für 3 Personen ist die Wohnung ideal.
Die Lage der Unterkunft ist sowohl perfekt geeignet, um die Stadt zu erkunden sowie für einen Start in das Partyleben Lissabons. Um die Ecke gibt es zahlreiche Restaurants, Bars, Banken und einen Supermarkt. Im Übrigen ist die Wohnung jedoch sehr ruhig, da sie sich in der Parallelstraße zur belebten Umgebung befindet.
Die Kommunikation mit Pedro, Gonçalo und Antonio hat zu jeder Zeit herrvorragend funktioniert. Uns wurde auch die Möglichkeit gegeben, unser Gepäck bis zum Abflug unterzubringen, da wir erst nach dem eigentlichen Check-out-Zeitpunkt abreisen mussten. Vom Flughafen sind wir per Taxi an- und abgereist. Die Kosten beliefen sich für eine halbstündige Fahrt auf ungefähr 15 Euro.
Danke an die Gastgeber, auch für den Wein, die Pralinen und ein die leckeren frischen Orangen.

Everything is beautiful, very clean and romantic. It's perfect to visit Lisbona and enjoy your staying. Very close to tram 28 and many good restaurants. The owners will provide you with every suggestion you need to enjoy Lisbona. Don't miss the opportunity to stay in this place.

The studio is the perfect accommodation for a stay in Lissabon. Everything you need is in walking distance - stores, bars, restaurants and Cais de Sodré train station. Bairro Alto is close by so at night it can be a bit noisy but you'll have this anywhere near the city center of a big city. On warm days the studio was pretty warm in the evening but there's an AC in the studio so no trouble sleeping. There's a church across from the studio and the bells go off every 30min but they stop at 8pm and don't go off until 8am, so perfect to start your days in Lisboa early ;) we loved having breakfast on the balcony, which has a great view, too. The communication with the hosts was always fast and super smooth. Definitely recommending the place and for sure coming back :)

A fantastic studio apartment with a lovely little terrace. The team at Chiado loft studios were fantastic, we dealt with Goncalo and he couldnt have been more hopefully or a nicer guy. Great suggestions of places to visit in lisbon. A superb apartment in an amazing location.

This apartment is well described - a lovely haven, comfortable, attractive and superb use of space. Outdoor terrace was delightful. Probably not so good for older people due to steep stairs and bed at floor level, but these guests in their 70' managed ok. Gonçalo, Antonio and Pedro were excellent hosts and very helpful. The apartment is within walking distance of central Lisbon, shopping and close to transport.

This cozy loft was an amazing place for us to stay as we passed through Lisbon. The location was perfect for walking everywhere and exploring the city--no car needed! The host was great, very responsive, and nice upon check-in. The place came with a comprehensive list of lunch, dinner, and drink spots for us to try out and some local Portugal treats:-) This would be our go to spot upon returning to this fabulous city. Two of us had our own bed while the third slept on the couch which was really wide and could double as a twin. Loved it!

I loved my stay at Pedro's place. The apartment is beautiful, the bathroom and the kitchen are both very small but we did not find this to be a problem at all. The guys were really helpful with recommendations on where to go for dinner and the apartment is close by to lots of amenities.
There is a viewpoint a few minutes from the apartment near the pharmacy museum which is definitely worth going to. There is a bar there so it is the perfect place to get a drink and soak up the views.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at the loft!
It is simply amazing! The location, the terrace and all the luxuries of e.g. a nespresso machine, a juicer and the lovely rain shower made our stay much more enjoyable.
The recommendations for lunch and dinner in and around the neighbourhood were great. Also the best Pasteís de Nata were within a 5 min walk.
Pedro has been very helpful and also arranged a taxi for us so we could get back to the airport in time.
If you're doubting to book your stay here, take it from me and do it :)

Die Lage des Apartments ist absolut perfekt, sehr zentral aber in einer ruhigen Seitenstraße, viele Sehenswürdigkeiten, Restaurants und Einkaufsmöglichkeiten sind in Laufweite. Die Einrichtung ist superstylisch, die Wohnung insgesamt sehr hell und die Terrasse ein absoluter Traum. Was man vielleicht erwähnen sollte: es führt eine relativ steile Treppe in die Wohnung und das Loft wirkt auf den Fotos fast ein bisschen größer als es in Wirklichkeit ist (zu viert wäre es mir etwas zu eng gewesen aber da wir nur zu zweit unterwegs waren, war das kein Thema). Die gesamte Organisation war sehr unkompliziert, Check-in und -out haben reibungslos geklappt. Vielen lieben Dank für die tollen Tipps und das leckere Willkommens-Geschenk! Ein absolut perfekter Osterurlaub! Vielen Lieben Dank!
(instagram: dailystyles de)

Pedro's House is located in a wonderful location, it's quite but very close to the city center, you can find whatever you want in his house! He was very kind and cautious, and also gave us a lot of recommendation of where to explore fantastic food and where to see beautiful views! We will definitely come back and recommend this house to all my friends

Sehr empfehlenswertes Quartier. Ideale zentrale Lage, sehr hübsche geschmackvolle Einrichtung, klein aber fein. Sehr gemütliche Beleuchtung, entzückende kleine Terrasse. Alles Wichtige vorhanden in der Küche, Klimaanlage und was sehr wertvoll war ein mobiles WLANgerät. Taxiabholung zum airport hat dank Pedro perfekt geklappt. Empfehlenswert kein zu großer Koffer,denn die Stiege in den 3.Stock ist schmal und sehr steil. Die Kommunikation hat perfekt funktioniert.

Beautiful apartment, very clean with lovely finishing touches such as a personalised note from the host and wine in the fridge on arrival! The check in was well organised and hosts were very friendly. Apartment is in very central location with lovely views of the Lisbon rooftops! No complaints about the apartment other than steep stairs leading up to the apartment...be careful after a few drinks!

Een top studio, alles erop en eraan. Kraakhelder en moet oog voor details. Echt een aanrader. Kleine maar functionele badkamer. Steile trap, dus minder geschikt voor mensen die slecht ter been zijn. Fijne communicatie met beheerder(s). Leuke buurt met gezellige restaurantjes.
Everything was perfect!

I loved my stay at Pedro's apt.  I was met by Antonio who was so lovely and he even brought me a delicious lunch in case I was hungry.  The apt is as beautiful as the pics and very comfortable and efficient with the most comfortable beds and a great shower!  The location is about a five minute walk to the main center and metro.  The only thing I would caution is the stairs going up may be challenging for some.  I will not think twice about renting through this very fine company again as it was stellar service from beginning to end!!  Btw... I left my heart in Lisbon.... what a special city it is!!

This is a fabulous apartment in a great location. It was very clean and had everything we needed including some little extra touches including coffee, chocolates and portable wifi!
The hosts provided us with all the information we required and more and responded very promptly when arranging our stay.
We would recommend this accommodation and would certainly stay again!

My boyfriend and I loved our stay here, it's one of the best Airbnb's we have stayed in. It looks exactly as photographed and is beautifully furnished. The communication from Pedro's team was amazing! After our flight being late we were met at the nearest Metro stop and had a short guided walk to the apartment, we were welcomed with a small bottle of wine, coffee pods, jam, chocolate and fresh oranges which we used in orange juicer. The bed was very comfortable and we used the list of recommended restaurants a couple of times. The location is perfect, just a short walk to the Timeout market and with some great bars and coffee shops nearby, really recommend The Park (carpark rooftop bar) and The Mill coffee shop for amazing breakfast.
We will highly recommend this place to all our friends and will look to stay here again on our next trip to Lisbon
Local muito bom apenas a escada que é muito íngrime

We stayed in the loft for four nights and found it to be modern, bright, airy and clean. It was tastefully decorated and very comfortable. We especially liked the small terrace overlooking the church as it was a nice place to sit out and have a drink on an evening. The team were very welcoming and provided us with lots of useful information and the bottle of wine in the fridge was a nice touch. It's location is within easy walking distance of most sights and is situated in a typical residential area. Access to the loft is up a couple of flights of steep narrow stairs - not a great problem, but something to be aware of. All in all, we would highly recommend the loft and would certainly go back again.

The place is more than awesome! We've been three girls staying for two nights and felt like home there. The view from the balcony is just as beautiful as the view out of the shower ;)
The area has some nice restaurants, wine bars and a rooftop bar on the car park just 3min walk from the apartment.
Antonio was welcoming me and showed me where I can find everything in the apartment - thanks you for all recommendations! The apartment is fully equipped and luckily had some speakers as well ;)
Thankfully I could drop my luggage even before the check in time so that was a blessing. Check out was as simple as just leaving the keys on the table.
It will definitely recommend the place to my friends and family and would stay here again if I'm back in Lisbon. Thanks :)

Cosy apartment in the heart of Lisabon! The apartment is super central right in the middle of historic buildings, nightlife and shopping.
The apartment is very well equipped and has a little terrace with a nice view over the roofs of Lisabon.
Checkin went smooth and Pedro even helped us with the booking of a taxi for our early morning flight.

This apartment is great. I stayed here with 2 friends for 3 nights and we had a great time. It's in a fantastic location, easy to walk everywhere and very near Barrio Alto if you want a night out. There is a mini supermarket nearby, as well as plenty of cafes, restaurants and shops. The apartment itself was very clean, stylish, and had everything we needed. The terrace is lovely and it's really nice to be able to sit outside. It is a small apartment, and I think any more than 4 people staying would be quite cramped, but you can make do. The only thing to be aware of is that you have to walk up 2 steep flights of stairs to get to the apartment, as it is at the top of the building.
The hosts are really great, and stayed in communication throughout. They made check in easy and also checking out, we were able to leave our bags and collect them later on. Thank you to the hosts for a perfect stay in Lisbon! We would definitely come back here.

It was great place to enjoy Lisboa.
They cared us so well that we could get wonderful experience. They brought extra radiator and blanket after we checked in. Also they didn't stop contacting to make it more comfortable for us to stay and asking how we feel. I really recommend to stay here if you are planning to enjoy Lisbon.
Schönes, sehr zentral gelegenes, kleines Apartment. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt.

Bellissima vacanza in un loft elegante e posizionato strategicamente,si può raggiungere tutto a piedi,tranne Belém.Indimenticabili le pasteis de Nata,quelle della fabbrica mantecaria,le migliori di tutte,a pochi passi da dove alloggiavamo.Scoprire angoli,localini e negozi storici è stato fantastico,tornerei con piacere.Gennaio ci ha regalato un clima ottimo,non freddo e soleggiato.Grazie Pedro
Quite possibly the best AirBnB I've ever stayed in. Dying to stay there again soon. Truly remarkable value for the price as well. 10/10

PRO:
- Wohnung genau wie auf den Bildern
- tolle Ausstattung - es war alles vorhanden inkl. Nespresso Maschine :)
- in 10 Gehminuten erreicht man alles: Supermarkt, Spätkauf, Aussichtspunkt über die Stadt, Rooftopbar, Restaurants und Bäcker, Tram 28, UBahn
- trotzdem sehr ruhig
- süsse Terrasse mit Blick auf Lissabon
- ganz tolle, freundliche Gastgeber die man super schnell erreicht hat
KONTRA:
- nicht für Gehbehinderte, da man eine recht steile Treppe hoch muss
Sonstiges:
hatten etwas Bedenken wegen der Kirchenglocken aber uns hat es nicht gestört, da sie nur zwischen 8:00 und 22:00 aktiv waren und zwar hörbar aber nicht extrem laut
Tipp:
unbedingt die Rooftop Bar auf dem Parkhaus (2 Min) und den Aussichtspunkt Santa Catarina (5 Min) besuchen
Wir fanden es toll und haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt!
Best place to stay in Lisbon! Very cozy and stylish appartment near restaurants and attractions, you can walk almost every important neighborhood and places to visit!!

I cannot recommend this place enough. We booked last minute the day before Christmas, and then changed our arrival time about 10 times. They were extremely patient and accommodating for us and were totally on top of communication. When we arrived they showed us around and gave us the tour of everything. They even helped us double check the parking rate nearby when we thought it was a different rate than what they had originally told us.
There were some yummy treats for us. That on top of the fantastic design and super cosy feel made this a true home away from home in one of the best cities in the world.
Great location, fantastic space, wonderful hosts. Highly recommended!
The host was very friendly and accomodating, we were late due to traffic but he waited for us patiently and was standing at the doorstep as we arrived so we didnt have to search for the location.
Fantastic！⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐！ 推荐，房间很干净 厨房非常方便 还有小阳台 ！位置也很好 小哥也很帅 ！

The apartment was stylish and cozy and had excellent touches like a beautiful terrace balcony and comfy beds. The arrival was easy and included some tips for the area and a great walk through of the place. I highly recommend this apartment as a base to explore Lisbon!

This was fantastic apartment more clean and and more spacious than in Fotos, Very calm at night and very central place at the same time. Pedro friends were amazing- Goncalo was detail, open and very positive person spent tons of time providing his advices and detail map explanation for car trip& Lisbon . I Strongly recommend this apartment. You will meet fantastic people and have fantastic rest after Your explorations.

Appartement très bien situé et accueil sympathique. On se sent très bien dans cet appartement. Il est cosy et, contrairement à d'autres appartements en location, il n'est pas du tout impersonnel. Nous étions deux et il nous a très bien convenu. Par contre, je n'y retournerai pas pour une semaine si nous sommes quatre, je le trouve un peu trop petit pour cela même si il y a quatre couchages.
Very lovingly furnished apartment with great views of the city and perfect starting point for exploring Lisbon - we had a great stay!
Our stay in Lisboa was great due to the great appartment and welkome of pedro and his help. I would say this was one of my best experiences with Airbnb. Thans!
Fantastic place to stay! For everyone happy climbing stairs it is perfect and there is everything you need for a stay away!! The team are fantastic to deal with too. We will be back.

Perfect location. Helpful host. They prepared  some fresh oranges, chocolates and a Bottle of wine for us. Nice touch! Place as shown in pictures. Nice terrace. Be prepared to walk up steep narrow steps.  The heater not big enough for the room size so it's chilly in some parts of the room.  Overall, it is still a good experience and would recommend it highly.

My parents spent a few nights in Lisbon and had a wonderful time. They were a little wary about what lay behind the door, as the old city is very rustic, but were charmed by the cosy apartment. The apartment was very suitable to their needs, had unique furnishings and was extremely close to the tourist buses and other sights. On checkin they were extremely impressed with the hosts, who went out of their way to be helpful and let my parents check in early.

This cozy loft is a beauty in its design, efficient use of space, and location. Pedro and his team were very accommodating and easy to communicate with--super friendly! There were nice touches too: a note, a bottle of wine, some fine chocolates, jam, and coffee. The shower was one of the best we encountered on our Portugal trip, and the beds were super comfy! I would recommend this place, most definitely.

My boyfriend and I had an incredible time at this stunning little apartment. It was very well equipped and the terrace overlooked a beautiful church, a super romantic setting for dinners! If you've saved this place down in your wishlist- book it now! You wont regret it!

Es war alles perfekt organisiert.  Man wurde angerufen wo man ist und wann man an der Unterkunft ist und dann dort herzlich empfangen. Die Lage ist unschlagbar und auch die Wohnung ist saugemütlich. Man fühlt sich in der liebevoll eingerichteten Dachwohnung sofort wohl. Die Betten sind gut und es gibt nichts auszusetzen. Wir kommen wieder.

Sind spät angekommen und dennoch super freundlich begrüßt worden. Das Zimmer ist viel kleiner als erwartet, aber es ist für ein paar Tage alles da, was macht braucht.
Auch das Bad ist super klein, aber alles war sauber, bequem und es fehlte nichts.
Kann man uneingeschränkt empfehlen, weil es auch super nah am Zentrum ist.

Super accueil
Super appart
Super emplacement
La prochaine fois je reviendrai probablement ici

We arrived two hours late due to flight delay, but Goncalo was waiting for us, and communicated with us whilst en route. He showed us the apartment, all the amenities, and how to use them.
The apartment is, as you see on the picture, clean, and has everything you need, from air con, to heaters and ceiling fan. It was nice and quiet, (the only sound was from the church bells) and secure. Only ten minutes walk to the main area, and handy for the tram. I would recommend this place, and certainly stay again, if visiting Lisbon. We were advised that a taxi from the airport would be less than 20 euros, however our taxi was 44 euros, he said this was because of the time (10.30 pm), i only had 25 on me, so he had to make do with that. In hindsight i should have asked him how much from the beginning. We had a day pass for the tram/metro and buses, which was great, and got us to the airport on our return journey. Communication with team was great, with fast response, whether by email or text.

100% recomendável. O apartamento de Pedro é fantástico, atende todas as necessidades, é muito bem localizado. Exatamente como nas fotos! Antonio, que nos recebeu, foi muito simpático e atencioso. O apartamento tem uma varanda ótima com uma vista incrível! Voltaria com certeza.

ハネムーンで利用したのですが、ほの旨を書いているとワインやオレンジ、メッセージカードを置いていてくれました！
温かな心遣いがとても嬉しかったです！

We had a wonderful stay. It was clean and cosy. The beds were great just like the view from the little balcony.
However, it was a bit difficult to climb the narrow stairs with our suitcases...

Pedro and his team gave us a warm welcome, they were very friendly and helpful. The apartement is situated in the center of Lisbon, it was clean and comfortable with a small terrace and a very nice view. I can recommend Pedros appartement to everyone.

We were warmly welcomed by Antonio who had arranged that we could leave our bags early, but as the apartment was ready we had an early check-in! The place is very beautiful and clean, full of amazing furniture and ornaments. The location excellent, with main sites close by or within walking distance, and small supermarket and plenty cafes and restaurants nearby.
It was great to have a "home" when we could recuperate after the mornings sightseeing and prepare to go out again later.
Thanks for making us so welcome.
we had a great stay in the apartment! great arranged! We love lisbon! Thanks Pedro and Antonio for the good communication and tips on the city! The atmosphere of the apartment is perfect
It was great place and nice view in room !!!

Great communication before and during the stay. We had to check in really late and this was not a problem. Clean, well furnished, modern and cosy flat - everything you need for a short stay (lovely balcony). Location is excellent, sandwiched between Bairro Alto, Chiado and Santa Catarina. Thank you for a wonderful trip!

Para quem procura qualidade e conforto, o loft tem isso e muito mais. Tem a poesia das vistas lindas dos telhados de Lisboa e o charme de um terraço debruçado sobre a igreja de Santa Catarina. Tem localização perfeita, com o restaurantes, padarias, lojas e mercados. Tem todo tipo de transporte na porta: o famoso elétrico 28, várias linhas de ônibus e o metrô Baixa-Chiado a poucas quadras.
Tem anfitriões simpáticos e prestativos. Com o Pedro tirei todas as dúvidas na fase da reserva. E na chegada, o Luis estava a nossa espera e carregou a minha mala. Encontramos no loft bombons, cápsulas de nespresso e uma garrafa de vinho branco geladinha. Quanta gentileza!
Tem dois lances de escada que não foram problema para nós que viajamos com pouca bagagem, só é bom ter atenção com os degraus que são estreitos.
Ficamos hospedados por 1 semana e tudo funcionou perfeitamentamente.
Só temos elogios ao loft.
Com certeza recomendamos a todos e voltaremos outras vezes.
Obrigada, Pedro!
Obrigada, Luis!
Até a próxima!
Deyse e Mário

Sehr netter Kontakt (Mailverkehr problemlos und in Lissabon waren sie immer zu erreichen), sehr schönes Apartment, einfach perfekte Umgebung. Vom Balkon aus hat man eine wunderschöne Aussicht auf die Stadt und auf die St. Catarina-Kirche.

Die Einrichtung ist hochwertig und stylisch. Also echt, ich weiß nicht was ich zusätzlich sagen soll. Klar, die Unterkunft ist vielleicht teurer als andere...Aber gerade für ein Wochenende lohnt es sich. Einfach um es sich gut gehen zu lassen und zu der wunderschönen Stadt auch eine wunderschöne Wohnung zu haben.

The apartment was absolutely beautiful and though small, spacious enough for two people. The hosts were very accommodating with our late evening arrival and we loved the place and decor! We enjoyed the lovely bottle of wine they left us on the balcony with an incredible view and privacy.  There were many small touches that made the place cozy and the stay inviting. We basically wanted to move in! Close to evening fun while still very quiet. Would highly recommend!

This was such an amazing experience. Everything from the apartment's amenities to its location in beautiful Lisbon was stellar. We had everything we needed to be happy in the Chiado loft. Even a bowl of fresh oranges for breakfast. It was nice to know that if we needed anything at all, we could contact whoever checked us in for help. The terrace was a huge highlight, and even the bathroom was too. It was just so great. Also, what a great location...we felt so blessed to experience such an awesome neighborhood like a true local. Hope to come back to Lisbon soon, and to stay at the Chiado loft again!

Fabulous apartment, absolutely spotless. Great location.
Lovely views from the balcony, perfect for a short stay in Lisbon. We loved it.

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour chez Pedro. Super localisation à proximité du quartier du Bairro Alto et de sa vie nocturne. Un joli petit immeuble traditionnel dans une joli rue calme. L'appartement est très agréable et lumineux avec une décoration élégante et raffinée. Le confort est de haut niveau avec l'électroménager indispensable (mention spéciale à la climatisation très discrète et efficace).
La terrasse est idéal pour le petit déjeuner à l'ombre de l'église Santa Catarina, malgré les cloches un peu envahissante le matin !
Nous avons eu le plaisir très appréciable, d'avoir un ménage complet à mi séjour.
Nous recommandons cet appartement.
Petit point d'attention si vous venez en voiture, il y a peu de places de stationnement et les parkings à proximités (un juste en face de l'appartement) souvent complets mais il restent peu chère (environ 13 à 15 € pour 12 heures et plus).
All was excellent as always thanks I recommand strongly 100% satisfaction garanty
This place is awesome. Great views, nice renovation, amazing area. Hosts were very nice. Left some wine for us to drink on the balcony before heading to dinner. Wonderful

Wir  hatten eine tolle Zeit in diesem geschmackvoll eingerichteten und liebevoll gestalteten Appartement. Man schläft sehr bequem, die Klimaanlage war ein Segen im heißen Juli. Der Ausblick vom Balkon ist wunderschön, vor allem abends. Pedro und sein Team waren tolle Gastgeber, im Vorfeld wurden alle Fragen beantwortet und auch während unseres Aufenthaltes waren sie sehr bemüht, dass es uns an nichts fehlt. Es waren vor allem die Kleinigkeiten, die den Aufenthalt perfekt gemacht haben (Nespressokapseln, Saftorangen, Marmelade, Wein...). Weil wir länger als eine Woche da waren, wurde zwischendurch die Wäsche gewechselt und geputzt, super Service. Wir können sowohl das Appartement als auch die Gastgeber sehr empfehlen.

We were immediately impressed by the cleanliness, beautiful interior decor and the view of Lisbon from the windows. It is very well located, close to lots of lovely places to eat. Our family of four had a very comfortable stay and we appreciated all of the recommendations. Thank you Chiado Loft team!!

Great place. Clean and stylish. Arrived early but didn't have to wait until we got the key. Coffee, wine and fresh oranges were included. Situated in cool area. Good places to drink of have diner are just around the corner. Would definitely recommend to stay.

Astonishing apartment, very well located, a few steps away from everything, yet very calm. Decorated with taste, tidy, comfortable. The terrace is very private and great to enjoy the fantastic view while having breakfast or a glass of wine watching the sunset. Pedro, Antonio and Luis were quick to reply every questions we had and overall perfect hosts, with a great sense of hospitality. They left welcome gifts and plenty of insightful magazines, which we really appreciated. The perfect oasis in Lisboa.

We, me, my wife and my daughter were welcomed by Pedro. He showed us this beautiful apartment. It's established with so much love for detail. We loved to have our breakfast at the balcony with a breathtaking view above Lisboa's rooftops. Everything was very clean and sanitary and the most important toiletries were there. We liked our stay and may we will come back, one day.

What an exceptional apartment for any length of stay in Lisboa. It's central location on a quiet street in the city left nothing less than your greatest expectations. Pedro and his team stayed in timely communication and left us great recommendations for visiting. I highly recommend a night, or six at this locstion.

Nous avons été très bien accueillis par Luis qui nous a donné de bons conseils concernant l'utilisation de l'appartement ainsi que des idées se sorties dans les alentours du logement (repas etc...)
Le logement était à la hauteur du descriptif effectué sur le site .
Quartier sympa,logement très proche du métro,de bon nombre de restaurants et du centre ville mais suffisamment excentré pour ne pas en subir les nuisances

Pedro's apartment is beautiful, cozy and nicely decorated. It has everything you could need, even washer/dryer and good speakers, these are not too common in Airbnbs. The terrace is a great place to have breakfast or simply enjoy the sunset: the view is amazing. Pedro and his team were extremely helpful when we were unsure on how to use the dryer and when we forgot our jackets after checkout. I highly recommend this place.

This was my second time staying in one of Pedro's Lisbon apartments. Both times, Pedro and his team have demonstrated professionalism, flexibility with check-in (i.e. allowing for earlier time if possible, or letting us drop of luggage while they are cleaning) and great communication, making the whole process super easy. Both apartments were spotless and beautifully decorated.

This apartment specifically has an excellent central location while still being on a quiet street. It is very bright and looks as good as it does in the pictures. The small patio is perfect and has a really cool view of the rooftops and an old church... we loved having a glass of wine out there before dinner.

No complaints at all!
We had a great stay at the loft in Lisbon - well located with a beautiful little terrace to enjoy breakfast on in the morning. Hosts were helpful and very responsive. Would stay again in future!

Very friendly and helpful. We enjoyed to stay in this beautiful Apartment and I want to say thank you for the nice welcome and the easy communication. Everything was truly perfect and we can strongly recommed this flat. We will be back. Thank you for this nice Airbnb experience.
We loved our stay in this loft! It is very comfortable, beautifully renovated, and convenient for exploring Lisbon. It was very easy to checkin and out.

Nous avons adoré l'appartement. Super beau design, très bien situé, juste assez grand pour 2, lits très confortables . Le petit  balcon est très agrable. Pas de bruit pour dormir. On recommande à nos amis !!!

We spent four days in Lisbon and really loved the small apartment. It has everything you need and the location is great. You can easily explore the Bairro Alto, Chiado etc. and it it just a few minutes walk for good restaurants, bars etc. Furthermore there is a really pretty lookout a few hundred metres away. Pedro and his team were really friendly and helpful. However, if you are a light sleeper it might be a bit noisy during the night, but I guess the city itself never really is quiet. We would definitely stay in this lovely apartment again and it was not our last trip to Lisbon.

What a stunning loft apartment. Antóntio and the team are amazing hosts and left us very happy with our short stay. They had some great recommendations for places to eat and they apartment is very central in Lisbon.
Absolutely beautiful apartment in a wonderful location! These guys know have to do Airbnb right. You can't go wrong in any of their apartments around Lisbon!

We loved the loft. The design is beautiful and we were very well welcomed from the team who was waiting to introduce us to the apartment. Definitely felt welcome and at home in this apartment. Location is great and size is great. Will definitely visit again if in town!

Absolutely lovely! Amazing location. The studio is clean, cozy and decorated with attention and taste.
Great shower and stunning views from balcony!
We (3 sisters) loved our stay and made our holiday very comfortable and relaxing as we could spend time relaxing at the studio and enjoying the sun in the balcony!
Logement conforme aux photos et très lumineux. Il est également très bien situé ce qui permet de faire beaucoup de choses à pied.
Tolle Unterkunft! Sehr zentral, hell, sauber und super ausgestattet. Auch Late-Check-In (22:00) war kein Problem. Kann ich wärmstens weiterempfehlen :-)

Simply perfect! The location is fantastic, bars, cafès and restaurants around the corner, a small supermarket in 3 minutes footwalk, the 28 tram a stone´s throw away and the metro station few minutes away. The apartment is lovely, the beds are very comfortable. It was very clean and tidy. The communication with the host was really professional and relaxed, they are very helpful and the answers came right after the request.  So, all in all, our stay met our full satisfaction.

Super Unterkunft, super Gastgeber! Unterkunft ist blitzsauber, alles vorhanden, was man braucht! Beste Lage in Lissabon, gute Anbindung an Tram und Metro, nette Geschäfte und Lokale in der Umgebung! Ich komme wieder!

Both my wife and I with our young daughter spent three nights at the Chiado Loft. We found the hosts wonderful, very helpful and accommodating. We also thought the property was very nicely decorated and although quite small perfect for a short break. The area is excellent right in the thick of it and surrounded by great places to eat and drink. Overall a great stay and we would highly recommend this to any other people.

Great location to see the interesting and lively part of the city. 3rd floor loft apartment has steep stairs but when you get their its worth the effort. Small but tastefully furnished with every inch (cm) put to full use. Everything you'll need, for the kitchen bathroom and lounge.  Mattress are on the floor but very comfortable, we slept the best. Would recommend and use again. Very clean and great email communications before and during stay. Thanks for the adventure.

Siamo stati molto bene a casa di Pedro. Tutto rispecchiava cio' che si vede nelle foto. Al nostro arrivo ci ha aspettato in casa Luis, un amico di Pedro, il quale ci ha dato delle informazioni utili riguardo la casa e sulla citta'.
La posizione è ottima per raggiungere il centro a piedi.
Esperienza assolutamente positiva.

We’ve had a great time in Lissabon. Even with the choice of the apartment, we were very pleased. Pedros apartment is exactly as described on his site. It's cozy but also very tastefully furnished, it’s quiet, very clean and has everything you need. We loved the wonderful view over the rooftops of the city and also at the church. Also the location of the apartment is really perfect. Just around the corner is all you need: little super markets, shops, bakeries, cafes, restaurants, bars. One can explore the city in all directions wonderful by feet, by tram or metro. And also in the evening there are so many pretty places in the near to eat, drink or just stay. Pedro and his team were very friendly and helpful and gave us lots of advice. We’ll recommend the apartment absolutely and would even like to come back someday.
Martin and Kerstin

Best bnb ever! The interior design was perfect band we can enjoy the beautiful view of Lisbon standing on the balcony. The host team was sooooooo professional and sweet, not only for the useful information they provided but also for the Easter eggs and bread as a gift for Easter holiday, and they even had a Bluetooth speaker so that we can enjoy the music. Warm and cozy! I wish I could stay in the loft for a second time! Highly recommend.
Great communication and very flexible hosts. Gorgeous flat and awesome location.

Beau studio refait à neuf, très lumineux, bien équipé, cuisine intégrée complète. Chaleureux accueil, jolies touches (cafés, oranges, bouteille de vin frais...) et jolie (petite) terrasse. Bien situé, nous sommes ravis de notre séjour !

Pedro's place was just as lovely as it looked online. It was spotlessly clean and in a nice central location. He had shared a list of suggested restaurants, bars and coffee shops and all of the ones we tried were great recommendations! So all in all a fantastic experience and I would certainly stay with Pedro again next time I am in Lisbon.

Apartamento moderno en el centro de Lisboa.
Decoración moderna y con estilo. El piso se encontraba bien situado y transportes cercanos, además la atención de los propietarios fue muy buena y al llegar nos explicaron todo lo relacionado con el piso. El piso es idéntico a las fotos publicadas.
La fachada un poco antigua y la entrada al piso con difícil acceso dado que las escaleras de subida son estrechas y con elevada pendiente. Un piso funcional pero con reducido espacio para hacerlo más confortable.
La bomba de aire no funcionaba.
L'appartement était très agréable, très bien situé et il y avait une petite attention pour nous à notre arrivée.

We arrived much later in Lisbon than we have announced, but our host Luis was waiting all the time in the flat and despite our lateness, he was so friendly and understanding - and above all, he left us a a bottle of wine. THANKS, Luis! The moment we stepped into this flat, we were overwhelmed by the beauty, the small details, the extremely good taste and evident passion for interior design. In short - everything was art...and I am not exaggerating. Moreover it is located in the best area in Lisbon - Chiado! Next to Bairro Alto, with many great restaurant, shops and Fado bars nearby.  If we ever come back to Lisbon (and we will - cause we fell in love), we would definitely choose this flat again. Simply unbeatable!

La présence de l hôte lors de notre arrivée, et son accueil chaleureux.
L appartement était agréablement décoré avec beaucoup de goût, les vrais fleurs, plantes donnent une touche de gaieté, de vie. Les draps étaient propres comme neuf, un lit frais comme j aime. La fragance pour l intérieur laisser une agréable odeur. Bref tout était magnifique.

I can highly recomend Pedros place.
Clean, new, cozy, lots of light and details, all as described.
It's close to all the nice places if you want to discover the city by walk or just hang out at one of Lisboas best views over the city for Sunset just 2 min away!!! Thanks, made my stay amazing!

Perfect airbnb experience! My boyfriend and I stayed for 4 nights in Pedros apartment and loved it from the first moment on. We arrived quite late but Pedro was waiting for us in the apartment and gave us a very warm welcome - coffee capsules, fresh oranges and a bottle of wine were prepared for us. Pedro was very caring during our whole stay and stayed in touch with us. On our last day we could even leave our bags for a couple of hours since our flight left in the evening. The apartment looks exactly as on the pictures - comfy bed & sofa, well equipped kitchen with dish washer and a shower with a view ;)  The neighborhood is quite central, we nearly did every sight seeing by foot and the famous tram 28 is just around the corner. If you have the chance to book this flat - do it! :) A big THANK YOU to Pedro & the team!

Nous étions trois et avons passé 10 jours dans ce charmant appartement, fidèle aux photos (salle de de bain un peu étroite lorsqu'on est grand), très propre, et surtout extrêmement bien situé ! Que ce soit pour faire les courses, pour les transports, ou pour sortir le soir, on trouve tout à 5 minutes !
En plus de cela, les hôtes sont très agréable, disponible en cas de problème, réponse garantie dans l'heure !
Je suis donc ravie de ces vacances passées à Lisbonne, ville charmante où il est dur de s'ennuyer :)
Je recommande !

Nous avons passé une nuit chez Pedro. L'appartement est très bien situé, full equiped, beaucoup de charme.
Notre vol avait du retard et Pedro nous a attendu tard dans la soirée malgré tout.

Best location you can get - city centre yet in a quiet side street.
Great value, the apartment is exactly as you see it, there's the air conditioning if you fancy or you can just keep the windows open and you'll get plenty of fresh air (it is on the second and last floor).
It was perfectly cleaned, and the communication was excellent. They even left 6 coffee capsules as a present. There are basic kitchen tools, enough for an average uncomplicated meal.
Extremely compact access tough.. as much else in Lisbon, you have to climb 3 very steep flight of stairs to get to the flat.
The only downside is that 2/3 times a day you get some unpleasant smell of cigarettes coming into the apartment from the neighbors downstairs. It is not the host fault, but it is an issue that should be addressed.
Overall we enjoyed the stay a lot, would be back again!

The apartment is very nice! Brilliant location close to everything and still quiet at night! Good silent air conditioner and besides windows are at all 4 sides of the flat that makes it very fresh at night, so you sleep really well without any Aircon on.  the apt could be a little small for a tall man, but you feel real Lisbon staying there.

Nous avons adoré l'appartement Santa Caterina. Il est bien situé, magnifiquement décoré, la literie est de qualité supérieure et les petits essentiels nous permettant de cuisiner sont là (huile, vinaigre, sel,...), ce qui nous facilite la vie. La situation géographique est parfaite et que dire de l'accueil! Nous sommes arrivé à minuit et le collaborateur de Pedro nous attendait à l'appartement avec le sourire. Il a même bien pris le temps de nous informer des restaurants intéressants aux alentours. Et il y avait de fort belles suggestions dans cette liste.
Un grand merci à vous deux. Nous avons fait un merveilleux voyage.
Benoit et Sylvie

Great apartment, great location. Pedro was very welcoming and even left a bunch of recommendations for places to eat and drink! The apartment was very nice and even had a washer/dryer to use, along with a killer view from the balcony. The only thing that wasn't great was the shower, there was only a bathtub and shower sprayer, you have to hold it above your head while you shower. Also the ceiling was very low in places, I could not stand up straight. If you're over 5'6" this may not be the place for you!
Very welcome in this home, received very friendly service! Apartment was accurately described. Great neighbourhood, close to the centre

Es war toll.
Pedro und Antonio waren immer für uns erreichbar. Vor und während der Reise.
Das Appartment war sehr sauber und genau wie beschrieben. Vielen Dank für die kleinen Überraschungen wie Schokolade und Kaffee.
Wir sind begeistert und kommen gerne wieder!
Very nice place, with everything all around and in the apartment. Pedro was very patient because we were to late for the meeting. I recommend this host !
A lovely welcome.  Antonio waited for us which was so kind - we were getting there after 10pm.  It was a very cosy place with everything you could want.  We loved it there.
Genial, todo muy limpio y acogedor. Amabilidad en los anfitriones. En el próximo viaje a Lisboa ya sé dónde alojarme.
Très bon accueil d'Antonio qui nous a montré le logement et indiqué quelques adresses à découvrir... logement bien situé et agréable

The apartment is well located in Lisboa, nice, convenient, clean, with a very beautiful view on the roofs. Pedro is a very pleasant and helpful person.
You can book this apartment without hesitation!
Thanks a lot Pedro!

Pedro nos recebeu com muita cordialidade em Lisboa. O apartamento é bastante funcional e muito limpo. A vista de todas as janelas são belíssimas e o apartamento é muito bem localizado. Muitos restaurantes, cafés e pastelarias bons na proximidade. Estação de metrô a 5 minutos de caminhada. Muito obrigada por nos receber Pedro!

Nous étions 2 adultes et un enfant de 10 ans et avons reçu un accueil chaleureux et efficace .
L'appartement est très bien situé avec une très belle vue sur les toits de Lisbonne. Rue calme avec de nombreux commerces à proximité : boulangerie, supérette ouverte jusqu'à 22h,restaurants. Métro "Baixa-Chiado" à 5-10 mn à pied et l'incontournable "électrico" 28 à 2mn. Nous recommandons cette adresse.

The place was great - exactly as shown in the pics. I would happily come back here again when I'm next in Lisbon. The hosts were both kind and helpful, especially with booking us a taxi to the airport. The bathroom's ceiling is low - fine for short people like me, or for those who like baths, but not so hot if you're tall or want a standing shower. Water pressure and temperature were perfect though. There is someone in a nearby flat who smokes - and my colleague tells me she occasionally smelled it - a warning for those super sensitive. I wasn't bothered by this - didn't notice it. The flat is convenient for #28 tram, and is also only a 5-8 min walk off of the metro. If walking from the metro, go in via one short street further and come in from the West  - because otherwise you'll walk up a little hill or stairs - depending on the roads before, and then back down. (This last point was really impt, as we were dragging heavy suitcases with us).

Logement très bien situé, dans une rue calme à deux pas du Bairro Alto et du mirador de Santa Catarina. L'appartement correspond tout à fait à la description et est très propre et fonctionnel. Pedro répond très vite à toute demande particulière, et Antonio nous a accueillies très gentiment. Attention cependant: salle de bains très basse de plafond, à éviter pour les grands gabarits!

Notre séjour dans l'appartement de Pedro s'est très bien passé, des petits chocolats nous attendaient à l'arrivée ! Une liste de restaurants est à notre disposition dans l'appartement. L'appartement est très bien situé. Nous étions 4 et cela n'a pas du tout posé de problèmes de place. L'appartement est très bien équipé, les draps et les serviettes de toilette sont fournies. Si nous revenons, nous n'hésiterons pas a réserver de nouveau ici.

Trés bel appartement, bien aménagé, parfaitement situé au cœur de Lisbonne rendant tout accessible à pied !
Propriétaires agréables et disponibles
On recommande !
Our stay here was very nice. Antonio met us and quickly explained everything we needed to know. The place was as in the pics, clean and nice. Location is excellent and apartment is nice and bright.

The apartment is exactly how you can see on the photos. It is clean, tidy and very comfortable:Perfect for two people. You have all the necessaries for your stay, and the apartment is in a great zone close to the metro station. Antonio was really fast on answering every time we needed some help . I can highly recommend this place.

Very cozy and well located flat - just as described! It met our needs just fine and Pedro & Antonio had arranged nice little things for us :) also the communication with them before arrival was very easy! The bathroom is really small, but for just staying a few days thats no problem at all. All in all a perfectly arranged appartment, which made our stay in beautiful Lisboa very comfortable!

Pedro is a very cool guy, very easy to deal with and really helpful. The appartment we stayed in was really perfect! Really in the heart of Lisbona, very clean, with all the comforts. I passed a weekend there with 3 friends of mine and everything was much better than expected. I can really recommend you to stay in his house and to enjoy the wonderful city of Lisbon!
A nice place in a good location. It's close to a lot of cool places to shop and eat, close to a metro stop, and a short walk to the train station for Belem. We had a nice time.
Super cosy Place in the middle of the barrio alto. Thanks a lot for giving us a home in this axing city. The flat has lots of charm. Is clean and has everything one needs. Full points

The flat is very well located and directly in Bairro Alto in Lisboa. The beds are also very comfortable and there was everything we needed. The contact with Pedro was absolutely fine, he answered very quickly and was very nice.
The only thing which we didn't like too much was the bathroom since it is very small and if you're a little bit taller, showering is quite difficult.
All in all we would recommend the flat and would like to thank Pedro for the nice days in Portugal!

Nous avions du Café et des confitures a notre arrivée:)
Il nous a donne une liste de SUPER suggestions d'ou aller pour manger dans le quartier.
Nous étions situes dans le coeur de Chiado: a 2 pas d'une rue principale ou il y a tout ce dont nous avions besoin (épicerie, pharmacie, cafés, pâtisseries, restos, etc)
Très pres de la des stations de Metro Bahia-Chiado ainsi que Cais do Sodre et a 2 pas du Tramway
Nous étions 2 mais on aurait rentre 4 confortablement.
Je leur donne 1000 etoiles
Parfait séjour.
Pedro is really a nice host,I am very enjoy the days with him
Although the bathroom is too small, the flat is nice and well located.

Een prima huisje!
Wij voelden ons er direct thuis; je kunt inderdaad naar alle kanten kijken, het is smaakvol en logisch ingericht. Er is een goed werkend kacheltje voor de wat koudere periodes. De locatie is geweldig en toch rustig (en de enorme klok in de parallelle straat beiert pas vanaf 08:00 uur). Sanitair en bedden super schoon. Wat wil je nog meer? Wij konden niks bedenken, gewoon boeken dus!
just perfect!!!!!

Das Zimmer ist perfekt geeignet um Lissabon kennen zu lernen. Es ist gemütlich eingerichtet, die Betten sind groß und bequem, Dusche etwas klein, aber das nimmt man gerne in Kauf. Wifi funktioniert einwandfrei. Eine Mikrowelle ist da, sowie ein kleiner Grill, aber auf´s Kochen sollte man verzichten, tolle Restaurants mit typischer Portugiesischer Küche sind in nächster Nähe zu Fuß gut zu erreichen. Zwei Kaffees sind auch ganz Nahe an einem tollen Aussichtspunkt.
Man sollte dran denken bei der Schlüsselübergabe pünktlich zu sein, da der Gastgeber nicht im Haus wohnt. Wir würden das Zimmer sofort wieder buchen bei unserem nächsten Aufenthalt in Lissabon.

This apartment was perfect for myself and two girlfriends who were in Lisbon for the weekend. It was as pictured/described, and though the bathroom was small (probably not good for anyone really tall) it met our needs just fine. The location was great - on the edge of the Bairro Alto (while still remaining relatively quiet), close to transit, and near cute bakeries and wine bars. Communication with Pedro beforehand was easy. Would especially recommend for a few friends or someone on their own.

piccolo appartamento pulito e confortevole. Essendo ricavato in un sottotetto, il soffitto in alcuni punti è ovviamente basso e mio marito ha preso qualche capocciata;-)
La casa è situata in un quartiere centrale e ottimamente servito, in prossimità di essa passa il tram 28 e la funicolare bica. elevato numero di pasticcerie nei dintorni!
Accoglienza dell' host precisa e puntuale. Grazie

Ho pernottato 3 notti in questo appartamento molto molto carino, a febbraio. ideale per una coppia di amici, le foto rispecchiano perfettamente le dimensioni della stanza e del suo arredamento originale.
Pedro è stato molto cortese a lasciarmi un biglietto di benvenuto con dei cioccolatini; Antonio che ci ha accolto in casa, simpatico è disponibile.
La casa si trova a due passi dalle vie movimentate del Bairro Alto.

Cosy and full of charme house in one of the nicest locations in lisbon, the miradour of santa caterina and The museo of the pharmacia! Extraordinary view and beatiful area, at sunset it gets
magic , full of young People Who drink and play guitar.. Not to miss!

Pedro and Antonio were very pleasant and we were perfectly welcomed even if we landed very late. The apartment is exactly like it appears on the photos. Pedro and Antonia well arranged it and we felt very good. It's a quite neighborhood in a very bustling and popular area. It's easy to find and the famous tram n°28 is just near the apartment. Thank you very much and we recommend it

Nous avons été bien accueillis par Antonio, qui nous a aidées à monter une valise ...Dans l'appartement une carte de bienvenue et des petits chocolats nous attendaient.
L'appartement correspond très bien à la description, propre et rangé.
Le quartier est très vivant.

Santa Catarina is well positioned studio, located in the most vibrant part of the city but still in very quite neighborhood. Studio is very sunny, functional and clean. Communication with Pedro prior the trip was efficient and smooth and Antonio, who was waiting for us, was very helpful. In addition to that, they really know how to make their guests welcomed - chocolates, coffee, wine for New Year's Eve :)
It's very good experience. We appreciate Predo's  host and thx for the wind and cake.

Appartement très bien situé en plein centre avec plein de boutiques et commerces à proximité. Tram 28 très près (2min) et métro baixa chiado plus haut (10min). Propre et conforme aux photos. Pedro est arrangeant sur les horaires d'arrivée et de départ et facilement joignable.
Cependant quelques équipements (presse agrumes et climatisation) ne fonctionne pas ou sont défaillant. Attention au 3 étages avec escaliers très escarpés et salle de bain vraiment basse (pas adapté aux personnes de plus de 1m70).
Ne prevoyez pas de faire de grasses matinées (église en face qui sonne même 24 fois à 9h30 ;-)) pas de stores ni volets. Literie de gauche (plus petit lit) à ressorts pas top.
D'une manière générale bon séjour dans cette appartement qui suffit largement pour quelques jours.

Merci à Antonio de son accueil surtout que nous sommes arrivés très tard dans la nuit.
Chocolat et mot d'accueil découvert à notre arrivée.
Studio très bien placé pour un rapport qualité prix parfait.
Tout était bien et conseillons vivement ce studio à Lisbonne.

Merci Antonio et peut être à une prochaine fois

Laurence et Michel

L'accoglienza è stata perfetta, Pedro e Antonio sono stati super disponibili e gentili. L'appartamento è davvero carino, pulito e confortevole (adorabile come appare in foto!). Si trova molto vicino al bairro alto, alla fermata della metro baixa chiado, alla fermata del tram 28 e a tanti locali e pasticcerie...insomma perfetto!

A very pleasant and exciting small apartment. Everything was clean and well run. Our contact with landlords were 100% correct. The neighborhood is great, and everything you need is very close by. We had a very nice stay of five days. We can really recommend the place.

This is a great cozy apartment, perfect for a couple or for a solo traveler. The location was perfect-a few minutes from the chiado metro and close to hundreds of restaurants around the Bairro Alto and Alto Catarina. I was thankful for the air conditioner, since Lisbon can be quite warm. The bathroom is small but this didn't bother me since it was nice to come home and take a nice bath (which is a rarity in europe).  I didn't have direct contact with Pedro, but his friend met me at the appointed time and showed me around. The internet worked well and there was a TV with some english channels (not that it matters, since there are so many better things to do in Lisbon than watch TV). My favorite feature were the breathtaking views of Lisbon, the most gorgeous city in Europe (in my opinion).

The neighbourhood was great - close to lots to do but on quiet street. Communication with Pedro before our arrival was also great. We did not meet him but Antonio was there when we arrived to show us the building and apartment. Plus to have air conditioning. Apartment is tiny and you have to crouch to use shower and to get into bed.

De advertentie beschrijving was overeenkomstig met hoe het appartement eruit zag.
Het was een prima locatie, middenin het centrum, alle voorzieningen op goed bereikbare afstanden.
Antonio heeft ons hartelijk ontvangen en de weg gewezen. We hebben echt genoten van deze 'studentikoze' woning, ook geschikt voor 50plussers!! Het toilet/ badkamer was aan de kleine kant, maar dat wisten we van te voren, zelfs met onze lengte ( 1.80 m en 1.90m) was het goed te doen.
Prima locatie voor een zeer redelijke prijs.
Je recommande ce petit studio qui a une situation centrale, à deux minutes à pied du quartier Chiado et de Bairro Alto. L'accueil de Pedro a été parfait.
Great apartment exactly as shown. Pedro and Antonio were very helpful. Size was perfect for two although may have been a squeeze with more people.

Easy communication and studio exactly as described and picture. As noted in the posting, it is a bit difficult to shower if you are tall as it is slanted but it was expected.

Location was great as Tram 28 stop is right outside and metro is a quick 10 minutes walk away.

Would stay here again if we come back to Lisbon!
A great apartment, just like it appears on the listing and in a perfect location. Helped us enjoy wonderful Lisbon to the full!

Reasonable location and decent value for money. Pedro was a great host; met us as planned, friendly, and have us some tips on local places to check out. The apartment was roughly as presented, but smaller than we'd thought - especially the bathroom (tiny). Light sleepers who want to nap during the day beware - the next door church will wake you up every 30mins starting at 8am.

What a great apartment! We loved our stay. The location was perfect, it was very clean and we really liked the ambience of the place.
It was great to have good coffee!

It was wonderful to sleep with great quality sheets and duvet and the towels were perfect! Even perfectly white tea towels!

We were welcomed by the host who explained everything very clearly. He booked us a taxi for our early flight home, which was really helpful.

The apartment is like in the pictures - it is small but everything is there. The bathroom is particularly small, but the shower is good and we had no problems with it. The air conditioning is very good and keeps the apartment cool.

The mattresses are very comfortable, although the sleeping space is quite small. Again though, we did not find this a problem.

The location of the apartment is very good - close enough to Barrio Alto to access the nightlife and culture, but far enough away that it is not too noisy at night.

Overall - we had a great time in the apartment, it was clean, comfortable, matched the description, and was laid out in the best way given the limitations of the space, and it was good value for money.

Great little apartment, in perfect location.
It's small but has everything you need.

Very unique space, great coffee, hosts were very welcoming.
Definitely recommended!

The appartement was cosy, clean and perfect place to sleep, not noisy! We had a warm welcome and good explonation of the house and the neighbourhood. There was also a present for us, mmm... i recommend the place, good price for good place!

The apartment is perfect for a few days in Lisboa. Very warm welcoming with a little sweet present ;) All was clean and beds are really confortable. Nice views! The location is just on the centric neighborhood plaint of good restaurants and bakeries. Thanks for all Pedro!!!

This is a cool little apartment! It feels like you are living on a house boat! It has a fantastic central location, five minutes walk from Bairro Alto. The bed was very comfortable. The coffee pods were a nice touch! If we come back to Lisbon we will definitely stay here again. Many thanks!!
Beautiful little apartment!! Great location, very comfortable; I recommend it!

Superbe, Wunderschön, Awesome ! I only have positive recommandations and comments about Pedro and the accomodation. The appartment was exactly like the pictures and its description on the website. For our first time in Portugal and Lisboa my friend and I, it was a really great start. Pedro was very welcoming, helpful, gave our first few tips in the area and replied quickly to the email before and during our stay. We enjoyed very much the Santa Catarina, it was full of small attentions - chocolates, Nespresso coffee capsules, welcome note - and you can find all the basics needed - towel, soap, toilet paper, even remaining food/cooking items left by former guests.
It wasn't noisy during the night, even for a location in the middle of the Bairro Alto (party,restaurant,bar area of Lisbon). It is next to a church so the ringing bell can disturb sensitive persons, anyway, everyone is outside during vacation most of the time. On our side, everything was perfect! I highly recommend and will renew this experience with Pedro's team if I come back to Portugal!
Great location, right in the life of the city.  Apartment exactly as pictured with even better views than expected. Confirmation and all admin items taken care of promptly by Pedro and his team!
La descripción del anuncio se corresponde perfectamente con el apartamento. La zona es muy céntrica!
The place was great- really romantic and a good location. Not noisy at night and in walking distance to everything. Communication was easy and truly enjoyed our stay!

Pedro's apartment is awesome! My friend and I had been traveling for almost two months and Lisbon was our last stop before returning home. The apartment was everything the listing said it would be. The beds were very comfortable and the AC was amazing. The apartment is in a great location in the city. Pedro was extremely helpful whenever I had any questions prior to check in as well as giving lots of helpful advice on how to get places around the city. I would highly recommend this apartment! We absolutely loved it!

This place was perfect for my girlfriend and I for 12 nights in Lisbon. The location is great, close to many bars and restaurants and in a beautiful old part of town. The apartment is clean, manageable and looks just like the images. Air conditioning was a definite plus on those hot summer days.

We enjoyed our stay in Santa Catarina very much, thank you, Antonio & Pedro & the team! Everything looks exactly as on the pictures, everything provided works perfectly, and all communication with the hosts was efficient and friendly.
For two people it was perfect; three good friends have surely enough room. Steep stairs and small shower were no problems at all.
We would definitely come back!
Appartement idéalement situé, lumineux, cosy et bien équipé mais bruyant en weekend.

Definitely 5*. Santa Catarina looks and feels like on the photos. Stylish and very comfortable. Perfectly located.
Pedro and his team were wonderful hosts.
We had a great time!

We had a nice stay in the apartment. The location is excellent, and it looks exactly like the photos.
If you are super tall and not flexible, you may want to opt for a bath instead of a shower as the bathroom is very narrow, and the ceiling short. But you're young, right? If you can climb the stairs to get inside the apartment, you can manage the shower. Go for it.

We've stayed in Lisbon before. This apartment is in the best location! You get 2 beautiful balcony views as it's on the top of an authentic old building. Its close to a "miradouro" (lookout over the city) where everyone hangs out.
The place is so cozy and romantic. We arrived and it was spotless and super clean and fresh. We stayed there with a baby and were received very well. The hosts are wonderful and communicated very quickly. I highly recommend staying here.

Lovely cosy apartment, with great kitchen facilities and range of tv channels if you need an occasional night in! The apartment is up 3 flights of stairs so not great for people with mobility problems, but otherwise it's highly recommended.

Séjour merveilleux dans l'appartement de Pedro!
Idéalement situé...selon nous le meilleur quartier!
Pedro est un hôte très sympathique, disponible et toujours joignable. Nous sommes arrivés le premier soir après minuit et ce dernier nous a attendu, sans problème et a même pris le temps de nous expliquer certaines choses sur Lisbonne.
L'appartement est propre, fonctionnel et les balcons très agréables.
Petit bémol, les cloches sonnent dès 8heures du matin mais cela n'a pas été dérangeant.
Je vous recommande vivement cet appartement.

Wir fanden ein gemütliches und einfaches Appartment mitten in der Stadt vor, das alles für ein paar spannende Tage in Lissabon enthält. Einige Kommentare vor uns haben schon darauf hingewiesen, dass die Dusche für größere Menschen eine echte Herausforderung ist, von daher waren wir nicht so sehr erstaunt, dass es eine gewisse Gelenkigkeit braucht, sie zu benutzen. Trotz der Innenstadtlage ist es relativ ruhig, die Kirchenglocken nehmen morgens um 8:00 Uhr ihre Arbeit auf und stellen sie abends ab 20:00 Uhr wieder ein. Insgesamt empfehlenswert.

I am very glad that in Lisbon I chose an apartment rather than a hotel.
And that I chose Santa Catarina Apartment.
Lovely apartment is small, but absolutely sufficient for two persons.
All-everything necessary for life - fridge, microwave, stove, kettle, coffee machine, every kitchen utensils. Nice linens and towels. Good wi-fi.
We were not very lucky with the weather, there were rains, but the air conditioner and heater helped dry things
The apartment is very cozy and quiet. Sleep there was just wonderful.
It was very romantic to wake up from the church bell ringing.
Very convenient location in Lisbon, close to the metro, close to the train stations Rossio and Cais do Sodre, close to the river. Close to everything!
Pedro thank you so much that you waited for our late arrival and everything showed and explained. Thank you for a lovely cozy and clean apartment!

Our stay in Pedro's apartment has been a wonderful moment. He has been a perfect host, everything was explained very clearly to us, all was absolutely clean and tidy at our arrival. We had several towels, a few coffees and chocolates, some Lisbon guides... We had everything we needed and more. The place itself had a lot of charm and was well located. The only small downpoint would be the ultra-low ceiling in the bathroom that make you take your shower crooked. But it's nothing that important, and we had a really nice time. I would highly recommand this place !

O apartamento é excelente.Adoramos a nossa estadia e recomendamo-no a todos!
My husband and I loved this cozy little studio. The design is great, view over red Lissbon roofs is awesome, though beware of steep stairs. Especially when leaving (it's a little bit hard to get down with big suitcases). But it's a good exercise every day. lol. Also there is everything a traveller needs: for cooking, for washing, for making coffee and what not. And a very good working air conditioner.
Besides location is great. Right around the corner there is a church which will substitute an alarm clock for you. There is a viewpoint over the Tejo river and Lisbon in less than 100 meters from the apartment, as well as elevador de Bica. Tram stop of the famous #28 tram is also very close to the apartment as well as the subway station. There are two railway stations in about 15 minutes walk: Rossio and Cais do Sodre from where you can go to Sintra and Cascais respectively. And near the cais do Sodre there is a very good market with frash fish, meat vegetables and fruits. Advice from locals: fish is good and fresh since Wednesday, Monday and Tuesday better buy some meat.
By the way, right around the corner there is taverna Portuguesa, a very nice place to spend evening with your friends. They serve Portuguese wine and appetizers, every day new ones.
And the last, but no the least. Pedro and Antonio are great hosts. Always ready to answer any questions and to help. We arrived very late, at midnight, and Antonio was waiting for us at the apartment.
Good job, guys. Keep going.

Great host, great flat, great city!
We had an amazing time in Lisbon. Pedro's flat is super nice and comfortable, it is clean and completely furnished. The location is amazing and the view from rooftop is unforgivable!
My friends and I highly recommend it!
Une super adresse idéalement placée entre le bairro Alto et le Chiado. L'appartement est chaleureux et les 5 fenêtres offrent une jolie vue sur les toits lisboetes.
