Appart très bien situé dans Lisbonne (quartier vivant, charmant et central) ! Tout en haut de l'immeuble, très lumineux !
Bonne adresse ! A recommander !

We had an amazing stay at the Santa Catarina Apartment - I am filled with nostalgia just typing up this review! The team was great, answering all my queries within a reasonable time frame. Check-in and check-out was a breeze.

The apartment was exactly as depicted in the photos - a cute, cozy wooden hideaway on the top floor of one of the typical colourful houses in Bairro Alto.

The place felt incredibly spacious for what it was, and I loved the interior design. It really felt like a "home", which was exactly what I was looking for as this was my first time using AirBnB.

The location couldn't have been better - I really loved the funky Bairro Alto district, with its eclectic mix of bars, restaurants and independent stores, with something for every budget. The elegant Chiado district was an easy walk away, as was Principe Real, with its gorgeous green spaces and trendy boutiques.

Transport-wise the area is well serviced with buses and the metro line, and the famous no. 28 tram was just around the corner. We found the apartment to be a good base from which to discover the city, as we really visited a lot of areas in our five days in Lisbon.

You do need to be aware of the ceiling, which slopes downwards dramatically in some parts of the apartment: namely the sleeping pods, the bathroom and the fridge/washing machine area. If you are tall and/or clumsy, you might bump your head on the ceiling. I wasn't particularly bothered by this, but my 6'2'' boyfriend did bump his head on several occasions. The bathroom in particular has a "challenging" ceiling design, so tall people would have to kneel or crouch down in order to shower.

Overall though we both had an amazing time, in large part due to this gorgeous apartment, and would stay here again in a heartbeat.

It is a very cosy little appartment inn the 3rd floor of an city house in the middle of Lisbon. The communication with Pedro and Antonio was excellent, everything went good!

The appartment offers everything you need to prepare food (such as toaster, kettle, Nespresso machine) and also has a little radiator, as it can get a bit cold in winter (we stayed here in the beginning of february).

We would very much reccomment this appartment to young people wishing to stay for a few days to explore Lisbon.

It was a perfect spot for visiting Lissabon!
The appartment was very cozy, and warm.
Pedro and his team were friendly.
So book the appartment!

A lovely, small flat in a great location. Located in the eaves of a traditional Lisbon house, me and my three friends really enjoyed staying so near to the cafes and restaurants of Chiado and Barrio Alto.
Although a little chilly at this time of year once Spring comes the flat will warm up and I can imagine enjoying having the lovely balcony windows open and looking across to the fantastic views of the city.

Very nice, unique and comfortable flat right next to Bairro Alto. Since it's on the third floor on a quiet street it's not noisy at all though during the night. The view is also great. I have nothing but good things to say about my stay there!
Great location, very clean, confortable beds.
Mooi appartement, veel oog voor details en alles wat je nodig hebt is aanwezig. Centraal gelegen in een leuke wijk van Lissabon. We waren heel blij met onze keuze!!

The apartment was great and Pedro and Antonio were very helpful when needed. The location is awesome very close to city center and also public transportation! The apartment was a but chilly despite the fact that the heat was blowing but nothing an extra layer couldn't fix. Overall a great stay!

Joli petit appartement, très bien situé pour visiter la ville. Deux lits bien séparés dans une petit chambre ce qui permis de ne pas déranger l'autre personne. Pour deux femmes de 70 ans, les escaliers étaient un peu difficiles, mais faisable deux fois par jour. Heureusement Antonio nous a aidés pour monter les valises à notre arrivée. Merci Antonio
Ewa et Georgette
Very nice place, well furnished, great experience!

We had a lovely time in Sandra's loft in Alfama. Just as we expected from the description! Sandra collected us from the airport and all communications were perfect. Lisbon is just great. And Sandra's apartment is a premium starting point to discover it all.

Appartement parfait, cosy , situation dans l'Alfama très agréable.
Sandra est une personne très accueillante, avec de bons conseils et connaît très bien sa ville !
Merci encore.

Nous avons passé un trés bon séjour sur Lisbonne, malgrés le faite que nous connaissions déjà le coin ce fut une premiere de séjourner dans le quartier de Alfama ! Fidèle aux cartes postales, une vrai petite ville ou s'entremellent les petites rues étroites et les restaurants de fado !
Nous avons eu un très bon accueil, Sandra est une personne très sympatique qui a même pensée à nous avec ses "pasteis de nata", l'appartement malgrès le faite qu'il soit petit est très fonctionnel et très bien équipé (bien insonorisé). Seul bémol pour les personnes aillants des dificultés à monter les escalier l'appartement est au troisième étage avec des escaliers très étroits. Nous avons trouvé des places de parking gratuites en haut à 300M par contre faire attention aux jours de marché.
Pour une experience unique au coeur d'un quartier historique cet appartement est idéal.
Great host. Easy to communicate and the flat was very clean.

Petit appartement trés confortable au coeur de l Alfama
Idél pour un Week end en amoureux
Sandra trés sympa
Appartment trés propre
Je recommande

Cette première expérience à Lisbonne fut parfaite. Le studio est fidèle en tous points aux photos et à la description, Sandra a été plus que disponible pour m'aider quand j'ai cherché un parking dans le quartier, puis au téléphone quand je me suis presque perdue dans les rues. Il est très bien situé, à proximité d'une gare et d'une station de métro, avec beaucoup de restaurants. Je ne suis restée qu'une nuit mais je suis plus que décidée à revenir et rester plus longtemps ! Merci encore ! :)

Sandra è stata molto gentile: ci ha fornito subito informazioni utili sia sulla casa che sul quartiere. L'appartamento era rifornito di ogni cosa e abbiamo apprezzato anche il regalo di benvenuto.
La host è stata disponibile anche nei giorni successivi per darci aiuto e prenotare alcuni ristoranti.
La casa è piccola ma ben organizzata, molto pulita e confortevole. La consiglio!

Sandra is an experienced and incredibly gracious host! She was totally helpful in every way. Her loft was absolutely perfect in size, appointments, and location. It was just me, but a couple could easily manage the well-thought out space. Everything was pristinely clean and comfortable, with space for relaxation, work, eating, or sleeping. The shower was amazing, the bed was lovely, and the whole place feels light and welcoming.
Most magical of all, however, is where this loft places a traveler. Step outside, note the tile portrait of a Biblical scene on the stucco wall, and turn left. You're just a few steps from a little old church, with cafes, shopping, the train station, and the water all a few minutes walk away. Turn right, take the winding cobblestone paths up, wander for a few minutes, and you reach the birthplace of Fado! Live guitar and soulful singing spills out of small, intimate restaurants, with wine, cheese, linguiça, grilled fish, and more. An absolutely lovely stay, I hope to return soon!

What a fantastic apartment, just as seen in the pictures. Sandra was great and was extremely helpful when the booking was made, even offering to pick us up from the airport for only 20 Euros as we arrived on an evening flight into LIsbon. Sandra showed us where everything was in the apartment and even gave us some tips of places to eat and places to visit during our stay. We stayed in the apartment for 3 nights and we found everything that we we needed and was like living in our own apartment and very cosy, much better than staying in a hotel and cheaper too. The location was great 5 minutes walk to any restaurants in Alfama and only 15 minutes walk into town.If we ever decide to stay in Lisbon again we will definitely book again.

Thanks

We stayed only for one night at Sandra's place but we had a great time! The appartment is very well located, just down alfama ! You will find everything you need at Sandra's place.
Sandra was a very kind host and was very flexible with the checking so that we have time to enjoy Lisboa! I would definitely recommend her place!

Superb and cozy apt. that really fitted our needs. Sandra was fast with communication and guides us with recommandations on how to get back to the airport in the most efficient way for checkout.
Nice surroundings, fado bars, wine bars, good dining, walking distance towards the castle and many other views.

This was a great little apartment in the Alfama! It was in a great and convenient location to the Santa Apolonia train station. The amenities were some of the best of any Airbnb I've seen! There was anything and everything you could possible need or expect to find in an Airbnb. It was very modern and very clean! Sandra had a conflict with our arrival time and gave us great instructions on where to pick the keys up and how to find the apartment! We stayed in another apartment in Lisbon earlier in out trip and after staying here I would definitely choose to stay in this one.

Sandra was the most amazing host! We were only is Lisbon for 24 hrs, Sandra picked us up from the airport which just made everything so easy. The flat is in the perfect location. We'll definitely be back! Thank you Sandra!

Perfect little gem in the heart of old Lisbon - the apartment is so well equipped you cannot want for anything more. There is washing powder, coffee, sugar, great little kitchen would you want to cook, and a nice comfortable bed. The apartment is on the third floor, so be prepared for a little healthy hike a few times a day. The place has a lovely decor and is in a really great location - the only thing is that it is in the heard to restaurants and bars' area In Alfama and at night not the quietest place, but you cannot have it both ways.
Overall, great experience and the best place to stay!

Sandra is an amazing host, I totally recommend her and I thank you a lot for the whole organisation. The apartment is so functional, it's just great! You have everything you can imagine to enjoy Lisbonne, to cook, to relax at home... even sun umbrella if you want to go to the beach!

Sandra organised everything perfectly and even ordered the cab for us early in the morning. She also speaks fluently french! Thanks again Sandra!

Wunderschönes Loft mit zentraler Lage, wir wurden toll aufgenommen, alles hat einwandfrei funktioniert und wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Sogar eine Reservierung in einem empfohlenen Restaurant Lissabons wurde uns ermöglicht, sodass wir einen wunderschönen Aufenthalt in Lissabon hatten!

Sandra s'est montrée chaleureuse à notre arrivée et nous a donné quelques indications utiles. L' appartement était vraiment impeccable et très fonctionnel. il est décoré avec goût ce qui le rend d'autant plus agréable. Ce logement est également  très bien placé : situé dans le quartier le plus charmant de Lisbonne, proche du métro, de la gare, du bus pour aller à Belem et d'un gros supermarché  (ce qui n'est pas toujours facile à trouver à Lisbonne). Nous avons vraiment apprécié notre séjour et recommandons ce airbnb sans soucis

Perfect little apartment in old town Lisbon. Sandra was excellent in her communication and was extremely helpful with information and sorting us transfers to and from the airport. You must cross the road and eat at 'Needle in the Haystack' as well as go to Taberna Sal Grosso. Both only 2mins walk from the place.
Sandra was amazing! She stocked the fridge with fruit, which was so sweet! The place was so clean and it was close to everything.
Sandra's place was perfect - exactly as described and in a fabulous location. Really well equipped for a small apartment and check in and out was a breeze. I'll definitely be back!

This was our 8th airbnb stay of our vacation in Europe so we had a lot to compare it to. This flat is charming! Everything was new and clean and very well done. It is an impressive flat for the space. Sandra was great! All the little things such as supplying coffee and paper towels are so appreciated!! She even had a bottle of wine for us!
Sandra was very helpful in recommending where to go to see sights of interest and where to eat etc. She was always available which we liked.
She even called a cab for us the day we left.
Everything was very nicely done here! It was one of the best we stayed at!
Great location in the middle of Alfama! Sandra was easy to reach and happy to wait for me for giving me the keys. Great place for 1-2 people!
Convenient location in Lisbon. Close to the Santa Apolonia metro. Good experience overall. Stayed here for 4 nights. Sandra was quick and helpful with responses.

We had a great stay at Sandras little sweet flat.Sandra was very kind and friendly and gave us some good Information for Lisboa and Alfarma.In the flat was all what we need and  it was not far away from the center and the metro station.
Cozy apartment in great location!

Sandra was a very good host. Very communicative and helpful.
The apartment was clean, very well located and good furnished as you can see in the pictures.
I can definitely recommend Sandra and her apartment.
Fantastic experience in Lisbon. Sandra gave us a lot of advice on our stay there.

Sandra nous a accueilli avec le sourire et en français. Très prévenante et riche de conseils sur notre périple à travers le pays. L'appartement sous les toits est idéalement situé dans l'alfama. Pas trop haut dans le quartier( pratique pour les valises !) et près de restos typiques. Il est parfaitement agencé, propre, le lit très confortable et il ya tout pour le pdj ! Un vrai bonheur pour cette soirée au coeur du quartier typique de Lisbonne, merci Sandra !

Sandra hat uns sehr freundlich empfangen, sie hat uns sogar vom Flughafen, gegen eine kleine Gebühr, abgeholt. Während der Fahrt hat sie uns noch so einiges über das Viertel, wo die Wohnung steht erzählt und uns Informationen zum San Antonio Fest zukommen lassen.

Sandra was a great host! She carried heavy suitcases up three flights of stairs and she also got bus schedules for us. Her loft was clean and well equipped. It's location and a great place to have a home base for seeing Lisbon. It is very small.
Stephanie
Logement décoré avec soin, quartier très agréable. Sandra nous a parfaitement accueilli! L'appartement est parfait pour 2 personnes qui souhaite passer quelques jours à Lisbonne.

We found the apartment to be clean and the bed comfortable: it was perfect for us!! Was a really enjoyable stay and I would thoroughly recommend to anyone wanting to relax in Lisbon. Thank you, Sandra:)
Great stay thank you. Sandra was a great host and the place was clean and a good space for 2 of us. She even had a yummy piece of Portuguese cake waiting for us which was a really nice touch

Sandra is a wonderful host! She kindly let us store our luggage, as we arrived very early. Apartment is small, just for 2-3 people, but very cozy and perfectly equipped. It's only 3-5 minutes to the supermarket, metro and bus stations. Lots of restaurants nearby to dine. Easy access to all the places of interest of Alfama. Sandra, thank you very much for your hospitality and especially for carrot cakes:))
Sandras apartment was a sucess ! And her service and avaible perfect. Itwas 10 of 10 points !

The apartment is very nice and the area is just wonderful. Everything was clean and nice furnished. Sandra was also very helpful and answered very fast to all of my questions. We just had one day in Lisbon, and that is definitely not enough. So we will come back one time.
Thank's Sandra, for all your tips...

Apartamento muito simpático e acolhedor numa parte linda e central da cidade. Perfeito para um casal! Condições 5estrelas, zona tranquila e com muito por fazer à volta. A Sandra é muito simpática e super disponível. A repetir sem duvida!

Everything was really good. Sandra picked us up from the airport so we had no trouble finding the place. The apartment had everthing we needed and we felt very at home. It is very nicely located, you have a Metro Station nearby but are also in the middle of the alfama neighborhood. I full recommend!

Sandra's place is lovely. It is located near the station so it is convenient to take public transport from the airport. The must-see places in Alfama are within walking distances. Would love to come back :)

Die Buchung, Begrüßung und das Apartment sowie unsere Zeit in Lissabon insgesamt war hervorragend.
Sandra war sehr unkompliziert und hat bei vielen Fragen in Bezug auf die An- und Abreise wie auch zum Sightseeing gute Tipps parat gehabt.
Das Apartment ist genauso wie in der Anzeige beschrieben. Sehr sauber und es fehlt nichts. Die Lage ist gut, wenn man die Stadt auch gern zu Fuß erkundet.
Sandra was kind enough to meet us and take us to the studio apt.  The studio suited our needs perfectly and the location, was perfect for walking around Alfama.

Sandra was a fantastic and very warm host; we were so pleased to stay in her Alfama apartment for the week, and would definitely recommend her to anyone looking to visit Lisbon.

Special thanks Sandra for picking us up from the airport and for letting us stow our luggage when we had a late flight to catch. Your hospitality really made a huge impact on us, cheers!

Sandra's flat is perfect. It is located in one of Lisbon's most beautiful neighbourhoods, with small winding streets, many small shops, restaurants and cheap places to eat like a local (do check them out!), but also very close to public transport connections (max. 5 minutes walk to train/metro station, even closer to bus stops). Although only one minute's walk away from one of the main Alfama streets, it is fairly quiet - but this is the city centre, so no place is going to be completely silent at night. The windows are new and well insulated, so if you really need the quiet you can close them.

The flat is very new, looks exactly like the photos and is spotlessly clean. It is large enough - we are both 6ft1 but had no problems. It has everything we needed and more, from cooking spices to umbrellas. We were especially happy with the couch - most other places we looked at didn't have a comfy looking place to sit, and you really need that after a day walking through Alfama. Sandra is very welcoming and super responsive. We've had so-so experiences with AirBnB in the past and therefore did not use it for a while, but Sandra restored our faith. Thoroughly recommended - better than a hotel!

This was a wonderful place to stay the night before heading to faro. Very conveniently located to the train station and the treats provided upon arrival were delicious. Would highly recommend staying here.

Sandra made us feel very welcome when we arrived at the loft and was extremely helpful and generous with her advice. The loft is in a great area within walking distance of the centre and most of the main sights. The accommodation was well equipped with everything we could have needed for our stay and Sandra was very generous in this respect. Everything in the apartment was spotlessly clean. The area is very quiet at night. Overall we had a great experience in Lisbon in Sandra's home.

L'appartement est très mignon, pratique et vraiment bien situé dans Lisbonne, nous avons adoré! Sandra a été très accueillante, nous offrant même 2 belles parts de gâteau!
L'appartement est calme...le quartier agréable...rien à redire

Wir sind mit dem Auto in die Alfama gefahren immer schön dem Naiv nach. Wir haben sogar die 28 gestoppt. Also, nicht in die Altstadt fahren! Vom Fado-Museum 2 min. Sandra ist supercool. Sie hat uns gerettet und hat wirklich gute Nerven. Die Unterkunft war sehr sauber. Super Bad. Alles klein, kuschelig romantisch.
Für Paare zu empfehlen.

Great flat in a amazing location - the wine and oranges at arrival were a bonus! Sandra was really kind and collected us from the airport which made our arrival in Portugal even easier! Thank you v much!

Hallo Sandra, it was so nice to stay at your place! We really enjoyed the apartment. It was clean, comfortable and everthing we need for cooking, eating or washing was in the apartment. The maps and the informations you gave us were really helpfull!
Alfama is also really great and the apartment is at a perfekt spot for walking around!
Thank you so much. You and your husband are doing a great job and the cake was really good and a great idea! Also the mosaik! Go on like this. Hopfully we meet again in the Future!

Sandra est une hôte super sympathique et pleine d'énergie qui nous a accueilli rapidement mais efficacement ! Nous avons eu l'occasion de plus parler avec elle lors de notre départ.
L'appartement est conforme aux photos et très mignon ! Impeccable pour prendre le métro à Saint Apolonia ou pour se rendre à pieds en ville. Petit plus : le lit est super douillet !
Nous recommandons totalement, très bons moments à Lisbonne :)

Accueil génial de la part de Sandra qui nous a mis à l'aise directement. Tout est fait pour que l'on se sente comme à la maison tant par le comfort de l'appartement que par les petits conseils et délicates attentions de Sandra. Situation idéale pour découvrir Lisbonne en parfaite autonomie grâce à la proximité des transports et ce dans le quartier emblématique de l'Alfama. Encore merci Sandra pour cet agréable séjour.

Sandra picked us up from the airport and gave us some insights to the town as we drove to the apartment...As we had arrived early she allowed us to leave our luggage while she cleaned up the apartment before we settled in and gave us instructions on how to operate the apartment, Super helpful!
Apartment was very cosy and neighbourhood is very peaceful! Great location with easy access to the local buses and metro system...will definitely consider when next in Lisbon again :)

Le petit nid de Sandra sous les toits est très charmant et très fonctionnel. Sandra nous a acceuilli avec une grande gentilesse.
A deux pas de Santa Appollonia, vous etes bien placé pour découvrir Lisbonne et Alfama. On se sent très bien et Sandra a pensé à tout. bref une base idéale pour découvrir Lisbonne.

Sandra made us feel extremely welcome.
A lovely warm apartment in an exceptionally interesting area of Lisbon.
Sandra very kindly allowed us to leave our luggage in her apartment, after we had checked out, so we could explore Lisbon.
Highly recommended, and the Fado bars are great.

Thank you for an amazing stay, Sandra!
The room was clean and you have everything you need.
Less than 5 minutes walk from Santa apolonia and there are buses n metro to everywhere.
I really recommend you to stay here!
Thanks Sandra!

très bel accueil de Sandra, petit cadeau de bienvenue, avec en plus des bonnes petites adresses et lieux à faire.
l'hébergement bien situé, au coeur de l'Affama, rue calme.
treés bon feeling avec notre hôte :-)

First off, Sandra and her husband were kind enough to pick us up at the airport even though our flight was in the evening and had a delay on top of that.

Once we got to the apartment, however, we were greeted by a present from Sandra - an excellent local cake.

To me, the apartment is the definition of cozy in the positive sense of the word. What I mean is that quite often the word is used to describe places that are small, while hiding this fact. There is no denying it here, the apartment is not the biggest, but the most has been made of the space available, all the while adding a bit of (local?) flair to the place. Sandra says she decorated the apartment herself and I must say that she did an excellent job. An added bonus is that the apartment is a short walk (subjective, I know) to the center of town.

Lastly, every utensil imaginable is present in the apartment. We were worried that an unimportant thing such as a hair dryer wouldn't be there - we were wrong. If we're ever in Lisbon again, we'll be sure to try and stay at Sandra's again.
L'appartement est très bien placé et agréable, parfait pour quelques jours de visite pour deux personnes. Sandra est attentionnée et sympatique, la communication est très facile avec elle.
Sandra's home is amazing! It's one of a kind and had so much to offer. She made sure to provide items one may forget while traveling which is thoughtful. Great place.

Sandra and her husband are the best hosts as I can say! They offered a nice breakfast on the first day, gave us lots of travel suggestions and helped us carry our luggages upstairs. I couldn't thank them enough. Her apartment is in the perfect location; minutes walk to the metro station where connects everywhere in town. And also the apartment is minutes walk to a local restaurant 'crisfama' which is ranked number two by tripadvisor. We had a meal there, incredible food with low price. If I have time, I would definitely come back! Thank you Sandra!

Passei uma noite neste fantástico loft e só tenho feedback positivo a dar. O loft é muito acolhedor, bem decorado, bem equipado e estava perfeitamente limpo. A localização em Alfama é perfeita, ficando no coração de Lisboa e que permite aceder a muitas atrações turísticas e a transportes públicos. Pernoitar num bairro tão típico de Lisboa também é uma experiência única. Não só do apartamento tenho bem a dizer, mas também como da Sandra, que nos recebeu com muita simpatia e deu-nos excelentes indicações para a nossa estadia. Nota 10/10! Recomendo! Obrigado.
Clean, comfortable, nice host and good locatet. Everytime again. Sandra's responding was always quick.
Lovely Hostess, I arrived later than expected and Sandra was kind enough to wait and give me the address instructions. The studio is great and in a very cute Lisbon neighbourhood.

Hello Sandra, thank you so much. Our stay was really good. The 'loft' was clean and perfekt for two guys. It was an excellent location and the cakes/cheese and the whitewine as a welcome gift was awesome - thanks. :) Sandra was very helpful and it was very easy to talk with her. lisbon is an very nice old city and has a lot of history, for example Alfama. Very old buildings and streets. Thank you. Greets from Germany

Kevin

Our stay at Sandra's home was really good. The house is perfect for 2 people who want silence and calm around them and want to breathe the real Lisbon's atmosphere. The flat is full equiped of all you can need and Sandra is really kind and helpfull: she had been waiting for us despite our late arrival and she let us 2 slices of cake and a bottle of wine as a gift. She also helped us booking our taxi for the airport. We absolutely suggest this loft.

Excelnte anfitriona, un piso muy lindo y lleno de detalles, super bien ubicado, Sandra nos entrego las llaves personalmente y nos explico como debíamos llegar a cada lugar.
Si volvemos a Lisboa sin duda volveríamos a quedarnos en su piso!
Gracias!

Sandra was very hospitable! She picked us up from the airport which was very handy. We were welcomed with a bottle of wine.
The flat is very small but it was very comfortable and it had all we needed. The area is lovely in the old part of town. Highly reccommended.

We had a very good Christmas at Sandras cozy and quite apartement. Sandra is a very kind lady . Thanks for the welcome gifts!
She gave us a warm and comfortable extra blanket for the bed, after we let her know that it was to could during the first night. Sandra also gave us hints how to get to special sights we wanted to visit and explained us which metro tickets we should buy. Sandra also made a taxi reservation for us to get back to the airport, because we had to leave very early in the morning.
Metro, supermarket and restaurants are close to the apartement.
If we visit Lisboa once again, we would like to stay a second time at this accomodation.
Super host!

Sandra is a really nice host, very friendly and helpful! She picked us up in the airport even though the flight was late in the evening, showed everything in the apartment and gave good ideas for our stay. She also arranged baby cot and some other baby stuff for us (even safety plugs!), which was very much appreciated! Sandra left us a local treat which we were happy to taste after long journey. It was very nice to communicate with her.
As for the apartment, it is lovely, it is not big but we found it big enough for a family with a 2-year-old toddler. The apartment is very clean, it is equipped with everything you may need during your stay and it is obvious that Sandra thought about every detail, added nice little things connected with Alfama, Lisbon and Portugal and made this place not only very sufficient but also very cosy. Location is convenient too - near metro and railway station Santa Apolonia; bus and tram stops are also nearby. It is within walking distance from Alfama places of interest and a lot of restaurants.
Overall, we are really happy with this choice of accommodation and enjoyed our stay, thank you, Sandra!

Sandra is extremely friendly, welcoming and full of great suggestions and tips for Alfama and Lisbon.  There was even a little present waiting for us at our arrival to the apartment.  The loft itself is just perfect - beautifully decorated and furnished with everything you could need for your stay.  A top recommendation.

Ce fabuleux studio additionné à la gentillesse de Sandra ont largement contribué à rendre notre séjour très agréable. Tout était parfait!  l’accueil de Sandra avec des fleurs pour nos 25 ans de mariage était très touchant et  simplement magnifique, sans oublier les pastéis de Nada. Encore merci Sandra pour ton accueil chaleureux et tes précieux conseils. Bonne continuation!

I stayed at Sandra's place for 6 nights in November. Before arriving Sandra was very quick to answer questions and let me know best way to navigate to the apartment.
Upon arrival Sandra was there to greet us and had candles and wine prepared for us - a nice touch.
The apartment had everything we needed, towels, extra blankets, kitchen utensils, hairdryer, iron etc. The bed was comfortable and shower was very good. Overall the place was spotless.
My only suggestion would be to very tall people that as it's a loft there is slanted roof pitch and low ceilings in areas.
The apartment is close to Santa Apolonia train & metro. The metro is super easy to use or can walk to main areas/plaza in around 10-15 mins.
We thoroughly enjoyed our trip and would definitely recommend!

Sandra's place was clean, comfortable and exactly like the ad. Excellent location and the cakes and wine as a welcome gift was awesome! She was very helpful and very easy to talk with. I would recommend her place to everyone!

Sandra place is very nice. Apartment is small but very well equipped and arranged. Location is superb. Alfama is probably best place to stay in at Lisbon. Also it is very close to the metro station and bus stops, so traveling around the city is very convenient.
Sandra is a great host. She was communicative and provided us with everything we've needed.
Highly recommend :-)

Sandra est une hôtesse très attentionnée. Son petit appartement est agréable et lumineux avec toutes les commodités attendues.
Il est parfaitement situé pour visiter Lisbonne et profiter de toute sa douceur de vivre.

Super séjour dans l'appartement !
Sandra est très avenante et serviable. A notre arrivée elle nous a préparé les lieux en allumant quelques bougies et des spécialités portugaises nous attendait sur la table. L'appartement est très confortable, décoré avec goût. On y trouve tout le nécessaire jusqu'au moindre détail. On s'y sent comme à la maison! La propreté est irréprochable. Il est situé à deux pas de la gare Santa Apolonia, à l'entrée du fameux quartier de L'Alfama. Je le recommande sans hésitation donc !
Merci encore Sandra, vous aimez recevoir et on le sent !

Sandra met us with a friendly smile, a lot of advice and an excellent bottle of wine on the table. The apartment is very cozy and comfortable. Apartment description coincides exactly with reality. Good location of the apartment - the subway and a supermarket is a 3-minute walk away.

This apartment is lovely! It has a great location, (in the lovely Alfama area, near trainstation and on walking distance to the flea marked near the cathedral and city center). Sandra was a very friendly super host.  We stayed in the appartment three nights. She also had left a toy for our baby to play with! Thank you very much for everything!

Imediatamente, já no aeroporto, Sandra me tratou educadamente, mas como se fossemos velhas amigas. O local é excelente e, se é possível, ainda melhor que a descrição, a localização é perfeita pra explorar tudo o que Lisboa tem a oferecer, por qualquer meio de transporte, ou a pé, como eu optei por fazer em alguns dias. Eu estava sozinha, mas me senti em casa e conheci lugares simplesmente indescritíveis graças a disponibilidade de Sandra e seu simpático marido Rui, isso tornou minha viagem incrível e inesquecível, recomendo e voltarei muitas vezes!!!

Sandra's place was lovely! Really great location tucked down a nice street with lots of friendly locals. The apartment was very nice and clean with all the necessary amenities. Definitely recommend this place to anyone (couples especially) and will be in touch when i'm back Lisbon. Thanks again!

I loved staying at this apartment. It was very clean and luxurious.The apartment had a working washing machine and a full functioning kitchen. Sandra was even so nice and left us some typical sweets from Lisabon. The apartment also had a television with many english speeking channels in case you do want to watch some TV. The apartment was walking distance to nearly everything, but Alfama is defenately the nicest place to stay at.

Sandra est aimable et attentionné. Elle nous a très bien accueilli et s'est même mis à disposition pour venir nous chercher à l'aeroport de Lisbonne!
Appartement cosy et sympathique ! Et surtout très bien situé dans le quartier d'Alfama!
Lisbonne est une très belle ville qu'il faut impérativement visiter!
On remercie notre hôte pour l'accueil avec les spécialité lisboète !
Sandra is a very good host; kind,sweet and hospitable. The house is very nice,comfortable and in a very beautiful quarter full of history. We had a very good time in Lisbon!

Super accueil. Sandra avec laquelle nous avions échangé avant mon arrivée m'a très bien accueilli. Elle m'a expliqué pleins de choses et précisé bien d'autres. Des petits gestes qui prouvent que Sandra est présente. J'ai particulièrement apprécié qu'elle accepte mon arrivée plus tôt que prévue et qu'elle me laisse son appartement l'après midi de mon départ. Elle n'avait personne mais elle n'était pas obligé de le faire. Encore Super.
Petit apéro avec son mari et escargot bien sur au bar d'en bas ! Je garde le contact pour encore plus de découvertes.

L'appartamento si trova nella zona secondo noi più affascinante di Lisbona.. un valore aggiunto a questa deliziosa location! All'interno potrete trovare TUTTO ciò che vi serve: una piccola cucina multi accessoriata, un piccolo ma funzionale bagno e un zona giorno con divano e letto. Ci sono inoltre molte mappe e biglietti della metro/treno ricaricabili!
Sandra è stata molto gentile e disponibile durante il nostro breve soggiorno (al nostro arrivo c'erano dei dolcetti tipici da lei offerti) e ci ha dato preziosi consigli su cosa visitare nella città..
Ampiamente consigliato!!
Martina&Daniele

Sandra is an extraordinary host going beyond usual hospitality. Her place is tiny,however she has truly made it a very comfortable, impeccably clean and welcoming spot. The fan keeps you cool even in the heat of summer and there is nothing missing. Having stayed in other places by now, I can truly appreciate her thoughtfulness and eye for detail. The location is great , close to train station , tourist attractions, restaurants and Sandra has good tips about sightseeing. I cannot think of anything to remark other then to watch your head if you are tall since this is a loft and that you do have to negotiate 3 flights of steps. The wine and pastries were really appreciated. Fully recommended and would love to return. Best regards to Sandra.

L'accoglienza di Sandra è stata calorosa e attenta ad ogni particolare. Il loft si trova in uno dei quartieri più suggestivi di Lisbona, l'Alfama, bellissimo da vivere di giorno ancora più vivace e romantico di sera. L'alloggio dista una manciata di minuti dalla Stazione metro di sant'Apollonia, ulteriore comodità da non sottovalutare. L'appartamento è delizioso, pulito, luminoso e pieno di ogni comfort...c'è davvero tutto! dal bollitore al tostapane, una varietà di dettagli anche nell'arredo che testimoniano la premura di Sandra verso i suoi ospiti. Lei è stata disponibile, sempre molto gentile, ci ha dato dei suggerimenti utili e sopratutto ci siamo sentiti a casa in totale relax sin dal primo istante. Vivamente consigliato!!!

Sandra, oh Sandra. What an amazing host she was. Very polite and extremely helpful for information and events going on in Lisbon. The flat was a perfect size for 2 people and was well maintained. The location could not have been better. It's located in the "old town" just off the river and only a few minutes walk to a main train station. Highly recommended!

Hemos pasado 4 días increíbles en Lisboa, la ciudad es asombrosa y la casa de Sandra no puede ser mas bonita, acogedora y funcional.
A pesar de estar ubicada en una calle estrecha tiene muchísima luz al ser una buhardilla.
La zona es la mas tranquila de Alfama, así que tienes cerca todo y por la noche se descansa muy bien.100% recomendable.
Para repetir.
Muchos besos para Sandra de Iñaki y Esther

Un accueil chaleureux, un appartement très bien décoré, avec tout ce dont vous avez besoin dans le coin cuisine et la salle de bain, des bouquins sur les activités alentour et les bars de Lisbonne a disposition, que demandez de plus.
Merci pour ces 3 nuits dans un quartier authentique et chaleureux.
The location is great, close to the metro and to nice restaurants. The flat, even though is small, had everything needed for a stay in Lisbon, not simply essentials. The host was aslo very nice.

Sandra was the best host you can imagine! We were delayed but she welcomed us very friendly and gave us all the information we needed and even more. The appartment was very cosy and clean and was very well equipped. We felt comfortable and the location in Alfama was Perfect - taxi, metro and lots of different restaurants nearby. We would definately recommend staying at Sandra's place!

Sandra was a really nice host. Caring a lot about us feeling comfortable in the appartement and that everything was good. She provided some tour guides and other useful maps in the appartment and finally she even was so kind to give us a bottle of wine as welcome gift.

The appartment is well located. Close to the centre and the metro station St. Apolonoa and located in the old district Alfama. In Alfama you get a real touch of the local Lisbon. There are several nice and yummy local restaurants.

The flat is self was great. Spacious, equipped with everything a guest need.

Thank you very mich for the nice stay, Sandra.

I loved staying at Sandra's beautiful apartment for 5 days. The location was amazing with local bars and restaurants nearby and an authentic Lisbon vibe. The flat itself was excellent and spotlessly clean with all of the utensils we needed as well as new fittings. Also, Sandra welcomed us with a bottle of wine and some cheese. This truly was the perfect way to spend our time in Lisbon. Would recommend to anyone wanting to stay here!

Sandra's place is the perfect point of departure to explore Alfama and Lisbon at large. I travelled with my sister for a couple if days and we could not ask for a better accomodation.
The location is great, close to Metro\Buses\tram and you can get around very easily, but also full of local charm. Just walking around the labirynth of small streets that climb the hill you will get immersed in true Lisbon and discover picture perfect corners.
The flat is perfectly fitted and has all you might need for your stay. From plans of the city to a comfy bed and sofa. Everything is new and in top shape while at the same time very cosy. It truly felt like a home even if for just a few days. As my first experience with airbnb, it truly was a great beginning! Thank you Sandra

L'appartamento è proprio come viene descritto e illustrato nelle foto pubblicate.
Pulito e ben equipaggiato; trovate inoltre cartine della città, guida dei ristoranti, ecc.
Ubicato in uno dei quartieri più caratteristici della città, servitissimo dai mezzi di trasporto (bus, metro)
Sandra è molto cordiale e soprattutto disponibile; ci ha organizzato all'arrivo il transfer dall'aeroporto per una modica cifra.
Lo consigliamo senz'altro per una coppia.
We had a lovely time at this cute apartment. It had everything you needed!! Close to public transport (bus/metro/train) and in the middle of Alfama. I would definitely recommend it to others!

My girlfriend and I had a really good time. Sandra, the host, was very communicative and helpful before as well as during our stay. She provided us with all infos about the city and called a taxi for us to go to the airport.

The entire appartment lives up to the "Golden Ikea Standard"; no frills, simply solid and decent equipment that works and looks nice.
Since the appartment is located in the old town, the building is - of course - not newly built. Staying there in colder months, requires heating. - Make sure to tuck yourself in at night.

Next time we visit Lisbon again, we'll stay there again.

Sempre foi um sonho meu passar uma noite em Alfama. Que para mim é o bairro mais característico de Lisboa e até mesmo de Portugal.
Pois bem, quinta realizei este pequeno sonho no estúdio da Sandra. E não podia ter sido melhor! Está tudo pensado e feito de forma profissional e completa. É dentro do bairro e ao mesmo tempo perto das melhores vias de comunicação (rua do jardim do tabaco), onde podemos estacionar o carro devido à quantidade de espaços. O loft fica bem no cimo de um edifício totalmente recuperado. E tempo-será dizer que é um local muito bonito e inspirador.
De resto, obrigado Sandra pela receção! Bons bolinhos de cenoura.

Sandra hat uns am Flughafen abgeholt und auf der Fahrt direkt ganz viel gezeigt und erklärt wie und wo wir was besuchen können. In der Wohnung hat sie uns alles gezeigt, Besonderheiten erklärt und uns auf die dort ausliegenden Broschüren und Karten über Lissabon aufmerksam gemacht. Sie hat auch mehrmals betont, dass wir sie jederzeit anrufen können wenn wir Fragen haben.
Leider funktionierte bei unserer Ankunft das TV und das Internet nicht. Sie kümmerte sich aber direkt um einen Techniker der am nächsten Tag vorbei kam und das Problem behob. Sie fragte nach unserer Erlaubnis, ob sie in der Zeit, in der der Techniker kommt und wir unterwegs sind, in die Wohnung darf. Das fand ich sehr gut. Als Entschädigung fuhr sie uns für umsonst bei der Abreise zum Flughafen zurück.
Die Wohnung ist klein, aber es ist alles da was man braucht. Da wir immer außerhalb gegessen haben, können wir zur Ausstattung der Küche nichts sagen. Das Bad ist sehr klein aber ganz neu und sauber, genauso wie die ganze Wohnung. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt.
Die Wohnung hat eine tolle Lage, nur ca. 200m vom Fluss entfernt und direkt neben dem Bahnhof Santa Apolónia. Von hier aus sind die wichtigsten Punkte um was sehen/erleben zu können gut zu Fuß (max. 20-30 Minuten) oder per Bahn zu erreichen.
Falls wir nochmal nach Lissabon reisen werden, werden wir Sandra wieder kontaktieren. Die Wohnung ist auf jeden Fall weiter zu empfehlen.

Accogliente e funzionale monolocale, dotato di tutti i comfort in uno dei quartieri più suggestivi di Lisbona,
L' appartemento è a 5 minuti a piedi dalla stazione metro e dei treni, 10 minuti a piedi dalla piazza principale di Lisbona, nel bellissimo quartiere dell'Alfama dove godersi il miglior fado, fantastico cibo portoghese e persone genuine.
Sandra è stata veramente gentile, disponibile e accogliente!

Perfeito. O apartamento é ótimo e a Sandra é uma ótima anfitriã. É uma boa escolha pra quem deseja conhecer Lisboa.

That's perfect. The apartment is great and Sandra is a great host. Its a good choice for those who want to discover Lisbon.

Parfait! L'appartement est très beau et agréable et Sandra est une bonne hôtesse. C'est un bon choix pour ceux qui veulent connaître Lisbone.
Accueil très chaleureux, très jolie cosy très bien placé avec de très bon restaurants pas loin. Je le conseille à tous les couples !

Sandra s'est montré une hôte agréable, à l'écoute et très accueillante. Elle est venue nous chercher à l'aéroport et à notre arrivée au studio quelques spécialités lisboètes nous attendaient.
L'appartement est mansardé et conforme à la description : très propre, meublé avec goût et bien situé , proche de la gare San Appolonia et en plein cœur de l'Alfama berceau du fado. La place du commerce est à un quart d'heure à pied .
Nous avons vraiment apprécié notre séjour à Lisbonne et n'avons qu'une hâte : y revenir !

Sandra is a great host. She picked us up at the station and was ready to answer any questions we had.

The apartment is new and clean and very well organized. Even though it's pretty small, you have everything you might need there and staying there was a pleasure.

Location is great too. It's in the walking distance to the city center and in most cases there is no need to use the transport. The streets might look a bit dirty, but the area is really quiet and seems to be totally safe. Lots of bars and shops around.

Overall - a great flat if you like comfort, cleanliness and exploring the city on foot. Would be happy to stay there again.
We had a great time!!! Thanks for all :))

We spent a lovely week in the Sandra's apartment ! It's very clean, cozy and fully furnished studio in the center of Lisbon! Close with subway and train station,beautiful house among the cozy streets! Thank you Sandra for your hospitality!))))
Мы провели чудную неделю в квартире Сандры, это очень чистая,уютная полностью меблированная студия в центре города.Близко к метро и жд вокзалу, она укрылась среди уютных улочек! Красивый, ухоженный дом после капитального ремонта.Красота)))

Sandra is a very hospitable and friendly hostess. She helped us with a transfer from the airport, showed everything in apartments. The apartment very pure, new repair, has all that is necessary. The area of Alfarm - heart of the old city, the best place to feel all charm of Lisbon, all main sights within walking distance.
We recommend strongly to stop at Sandra)

Сандра очень гостеприимная и приветливая хозяйка. Помогла с трансфером из аэропорта, показала все в апартаментах. Сама квартира очень чистая, новый ремонт, есть все что нужно. Район Альфарма - сердце старого города, наилучшее место, чтобы почувствовать всю прелесть Лиссабона, все основные достопримечательности в пешей доступности.
Настоятельно рекомендуем остановиться у Сандры)

We came to Lisbon for a few nights to celebrate my husband’s 40th and we couldn’t have been happier!
The apartment was perfect for us, it was clean and cosy with everything we needed. It was walkable to the local attractions and in its own vibrant area, with some amazing bars and restaurants! The host were always super responsive and were always willing to help with whatever we needed.
We had an amazing few days in Lisbon and were so impressed with the city! We’d highly recommend this place.

A superbly well-located flat in the heart of the most picturesque part of Lisbon with everything you could want on your doorstep. Lovely, helpful hosts who left wine & chocolates for our arrival, with a good coffee machine too. The apartment was perfect for 2, full of character. We had an amazing time and would thoroughly recommend staying here.
Pedro was a great host, the apartment was great and just as advertised.  Close to everything in the city center, and easy to navigate all the sights in Lisbon from here.
Great location. Walkable to all the major neighborhoods.
Central location, very responsive

Fantastic apartment spot. The apartment itself was lovely, everything was working fine and had no issues finding it. The shower was good and had plenty of furniture/equipment. The bed was soft large and clean. Aircon was great but all we did was open a window.
The location is probably the most important aspect for us. The location was perfect for us, right outside a decommissioned tram which is a lovely sight. So may bars and coffee shops every few metres. They usually shut around 2am but I never heard the noise outside as the location is high up and the windows stopped almost all the noise outside so had no issues whatsoever. Would definitely book it again
Had an absolutely amazing stay at this place! Pedro and his team were super helpful and made the process very easy. Would definitely recommend to anyone looking to stay in Lisbon.
Very helpful staff, apartment with a good location, clean and well-equipped.
Pedro and his team provided assistance right when we asked. They were very kind and helpful with everything we needed. Highly recommended!

Pedro è il team sono super disponibili, zona centralissima, appartamento con tutti i comfort anche per chi come me ama cucinare in viaggio, pulizia ottima.
Un esperienza molto bella è culturalmente autentica.
Ho fatto tardi il mio check-out per ragioni di lavoro ed i ragazzi sono stati super comprendisi!!!
CONSIGLIATO!!!

We had such an amazing stay! The room was exactly as described online and extremely clean. The location was perfect and transport is just within walking distance. Pedro was helpful and kind, making us feel at home. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and we would definitely recommend. Thank you!!
Pedro und sein Team sind superschnell und hilfsbereit. Lage ist phänomenal.
Had an amazing stay at Pedro and his teams place! Couldn’t recommend enough. Great location and lovely lovely team

We had a great stay over Christmas at this Airbnb. The hosts went above + beyond to greet us with port + pastries for the holidays. The location was right in the heart of the city + so close to many different neighbourhoods. Highly recommend. We had a great stay!
The team were great host who were very attentive! They answered fast to all our questions and were the BEST!! Who highly recommend them!
Everything as described, beautiful views from the window, modern, super clean, and also very friendly host!

Bel appartement décoré avec style avec  tous les équipements nécessaires et de petites attentions. L' insonorisation est impeccable pour cet emplacement parfait au centre de Lisbonne. Je recommande vivement cette location !
Great location. Lots of restaurants, shopping and bars very close. Some noise in the late evening but never created an issue for sleeping. Would recommend to stay here.

Great location, can be a bit lively/noisy on Friday/Saturday nights but that's to be expected with the location.
Washer/dryer worked great.
Apartment was comfortable and aesthetically pleasing.
Host was very helpful!
Nice apartment in a lively part of Lisbon with everything accessible on foot.
Incredible location and very friendly hosts
Great location with many cafes and restaurants nearby.

Pedro's place was exactly what we were looking for and was as pictured. It was in the heart of the city and easily accessible to great cafes, restaurants, and attractions. The entrance to the apartment was on a picturesque street with one of their famous trams permanently stationed for pictures. I truly enjoyed our stay as it provided us with a beautiful cultural experience, including a local market just a few steps away. Pedro was also very communicative and accommodating. I would stay here again if we were to visit Chiado.

Wonderful stay in Lisbon.
The apartment is so new, cozy and convenient.
You can reach all the view places , nice restaurants and transportation by walking.
The host shows great hospitality and offers us all the information about the city. Always replys us when needed.
Highly recommend !!

O local fica próximo à região de turismo de Lisboa. Fizemos tudo à pé. Fica pertinho do chiado. Pra comer é fácil, quem gosta de balada é o point. Recomendo demais. O pessoal é ótimo pra receber. Pode ir sem medo. Vai gostar demais. A cozinha tem tudo. E a cama é excelente pra dormir. Ar condicionado excelente. Nós dias que ficamos estava um calor de doido. Parabéns aos anfitriões.

Brilliant stay in Lisbon. The property is exactly as it looks in the photos and we really enjoyed our stay here. Hosts were very responsive to messages and offered advice when it was requested. Antonio even lifted my suitcase up the stairs when we arrived, which was very much welcomed after under-estimating the distance we would need to drag our bags between the Metro and the apartment (our fault though!)
Such a central location, you're really in the middle of it all when you stay here and I'd highly recommend it. Nice little touches on arrival, being shown around the property and left a little bottle of wine.
One thing to note, and it didn't bother us, but the stairs up to the 4th floor are pretty steep and challenging, especially with large suitcases. Perhaps something to consider if you are travelling with older people as they may not manage it many times, but don't let that put you off the property if not.
We would absolutely book here again! Thank you.

Pedro’s apartment is in the heart of Lisbon, walkable to numerous restaurants, bars, and landmarks. The apartment is on an upper floor overlooking the Rua da Bica de Duarte Belo tram car with a view of the river. The apartment was clean, had comfortable bedding, and a well appointed kitchen with laundry unit. Pedro walked us through the apartment and made sure we were settled. Communication throughout our stay was impeccable. A great home base to explore Lisbon!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Chiado Loft.  The apartment is absolutely beautiful and so relaxing.  Perfect location to walk to everything.  Metro very close by for easy transportation to further day trips.  The hospitality team was very friendly and responsive.  They had great recommendations for restaurants and  provided us with fresh oranges and juicing machine for fresh squeezed orange juice for our breakfast.  We will look forward to staying at Chiado Lofts for our next stay in Lisbon.
So cute and perfect for Lisbon! This small, cozy apartment was perfectly located and well taken care of. The host was incredibly friendly and helpful.

Pedro war sehr nett und hat uns vorab aktiv auf die turbulente Nachbarschaft hingewiesen. Die Wohnung ist klein, aber nett eingerichtet. Es ist alles vorhanden, was man für einen entspannten Aufenthalt benötigt.
Die Lage ist toll, da fussläufig eine Metro Station vorhanden und man gleich in einem lebhaften Viertel mit vielen Bars und Restaurants ist.

A wonderful stay here in Lisbon. The flat was perfect for our long weekend, very clean and loved the interiors. The bedsheets were buttery soft and the bed was comfortable - although a little squeaky! We were left some oranges to make fresh juice (they have a juicer), wine for an evening tipple and information about the flat and what to do in Lisbon. The flat was up a couple of flights of steep stairs and on a busy street with a bit of street noise - but neither bothered us and we were told all of this when we booked so packed comfy shoes and earplugs! We loved being in the middle of the city and in walking distance of all the sights. Thank you for our stay, we would definitely come back!

Die Unterkunft von Pedro liegt sehr zentral und ist ideal für einen Städtetrip. Wir haben uns sofort wohlgefühlt, und Pedro hat uns mit tollen Tipps versorgt. Am Wochenende kann es abends etwas lauter werden, was uns aber nicht gestört hat. Vielen Dank, dass wir deine Gäste sein durften!

Le logement de Pedro nous a permis de passer un excellent séjour à Lisbonne. Nous avons beaucoup apprécié les petites attentions (vin et chocolat), la décoration du airbnb et surtout la vue depuis les fenêtres qui est juste incroyable.
Le quartier est vivant et parfaitement localisé pour avoir la possibilité de visiter la ville essentiellement à pied si c’est ce que vous aimez.
Si je dois revenir à Lisbonne je n’hésiterai pas à réserver de nouveau ce logement.

Fantastic apartment in a great Lisbon neighborhood—bright, clean, and beautifully designed. Easy walk to restaurants, trams, and viewpoints. The host was friendly and helpful throughout. A perfect spot to explore the city from!

Nous avons séjourné dans cet appartement, et c’était un réel plaisir. Il est très bien localisé dans Lisbonne. Point positif pour la climatisation.
Bref nous recommandons ce logement pour son charme mais aussi pour la réactivité de Pedro à répondre à nos demandes.
This place is amazing! Close to everything, and is in an area that is unmatched by any hotel. Definitely recommend! My Wife and I were treated nicely and couldn’t have asked for more.

Incredible location and comfortable place to call Lisbon home-base. Francisco was a helpful host and greeted us for an early check-in when we arrived. We had some trouble with the wash/dryer but Francisco was able to answer our questions promptly.
Great place, great location. Cant wait to stay again

Logement vraiment beau et propre. Nous avons adoré notre séjour. L’hôte était très accueillant. Bien qu’il était mentionné que c’est plus animé la nuit, nous n’avons rien entendu. L’appartement est bien situé.
Amazing communication and place! Overall responsive and very accommodating.

The apartment was in a super convenient location on a beautiful street. There were a lot of nice restaurants in walking distance. The hosts were extremely helpful and responsive to us. Would highly recommend
We had a great stay! The location was prime. Highly recommend! Thank you!!

One of the best AirBnbs I’ve stayed in! It is in a central spot and easy to walk everywhere. It is also super cute and looks just like the photos. It was perfect for my stay and I can’t wait to be back!

This was a great location for the price. My husband and I were comfy and thought it was enough space for the two of us. We were able to check in early which made our travel day less stressful. The apartment is on a tourist-y street but honestly it is so quiet in the apartment. Everywhere we went was only a 5-10 minute walk. We were also only about a 5 minute walk from the metro station.
Really fantastic location and beautiful street. The apartment was great!
We were very comfortable, Pedro was a perfect host everything was perfect.

ce logement est une vrai pépite pour baigner dans l ambiance même du quartier du chiadé. il correspond en tout point à son descriptif. pour les personnes valides il est fantastique. nous y reviendrons volontiers lors d un prochain séjour sur lisbonne

Pedro was incredibly friendly and helpful during the check in process. Allowed us to check in early and helped us with our bags up the staircase.
The apartment could not be better located, it’s right in the centre of chiado, heaps of amazing food and drinks around. Can be busy however this is to be expected when you are in the centre of the city. Overall a really great stay.

This flat is in such a fun area! Lots to see, eat and explore! There are stairs up to the apartment so be prepared - it is a beautiful stay with a lovely street view! We had a full explanation of all the different appliances and very thorough welcome packets! Highly recommend!
Great place and responsive host!

This place is on the best street in Lisbon, such a beautiful historic road. Its lively, but we absolutely loved the buzz of the city and you can close the windows to block out most of it when you want to go to sleep. This apartment was well styled and had great amenities. The host was great too, really helpful with allowing us to store our bags and the most thorough tour of an apartment we've ever had! Only wished we could have stayed longer. We'll be back!
It was a great experiencing staying at the loft. Everyone was so responsive and helpful. Perfect walking location to everything.
This place was so nice and comfortable. Area was so fun and food was great. Felt very taken care of. Would recommend to friends and family.

We loved the unit, located in the activity heart of the city with a multitude of restaurants and sites to see nearby. Everything you need for a comfortable stay, including laundry and climate control. We would definitely recommend staying here when in Lisbon, and we'll be back.
Excellent apartment in a really great part of Lisboa! The location made everything really easy and the apartment was exactly what we needed. Thanks to Pedro and the team!
Very cute and inviting space. Perfect location for many Lisbon activities!

We absolutely loved our stay here. You walk out the door and are immediately in the center of Lisbon with access to the finest restaurants, shopping, and attractions. We felt very comfortable in the home and the host was extremely responsive and friendly. My boyfriend had forgotten his shoes and they went above and beyond to return them to us. The best of the best! We definitely recommend booking this apartment.

We had a great stay at this sweet apartment, right in the heart of Lisbon.
- Brilliant location
- Spotlessly clean
- Cool design, great lighting and features
- Comfortable bed
- Good shower
We’ll book again for our next Lisbon trip.
숙소에 엘레베이터가없고 생각보다 좁은거 빼고는 위치며 청결도며 좋았습니다
Great Airbnb in the heart of Lisbon. Located in one of the most beautiful streets with a view of the water.

This was an incredible location in Lisbon and the apartment was beautiful! It was so centrally located, everything we wanted to do was within 10-15min walking distance. So many amazing restaurants and stores nearby. Pedro and his team were some of the best communicators I’ve had on AirBnb. Super quick to respond and very helpful with check-in, recommendations, and they even held our luggage before we left for the airport! I would absolutely stay here again.

Pedro’s place is in a great location for your first visit to Lisbon. Very walkable area. His place is set up with everything that you would need. Instructions to get there were great. We took the Metro from the airport and about a 10 minute walk to Pedro’s place. Very easy with Pedro’s instructions. You can tap in and out with credit card. 1.85€ per person. Good communication with Pedro if you had any questions. The apartment as listed is on the 4th floor with no elevator. Once settled in not an issue if you don’t mind stairs. Can be a little noisy at night when bars are open but not a big issue for us. We enjoyed Pedro’s place as the location was great for us. Lots of restaurants and coffee shops close by and we walked everywhere. Pedro is a great host.
Perfect location and very clean and comfy space perfect for a couple looking to explore Lisbon. Would absolutely recommend staying here and would stay again.

Cet appartement était bien situé avec un intérieur très fonctionnel. Nous avons adoré notre séjour à Lisbonne et cet appartement y a grandement contribué.
Obrigado

My husband and I stayed here for a portion of our travels through Portugal during our honeymoon. We had never been to Lisbon before so weren’t fully sure what to expect. The hosts of this Airbnb were amazing starting from the day we booked until the day we left. The instructions to get to the unit were clear and we were surprised to find the unit overlooked one of the busiest tourist attractions in the city. We really felt right in the heart of Lisbon. Tons of sights and restaurants within walking distance. The host went above and beyond to leave some Portuguese Easter treats and fresh oranges to make freshly squeezed juice in the mornings. We would recommend this to anyone visiting Lisbon and would definitely visit again when we come back. Thank you for everything!

Pedro and team were amazing! Extremely responsive, present in check in to give a helpful walk-through, and allow us to store our bags and check in before scheduled time. They had excellent recommendations of things to do around the area. The stay is located right on a famous Hill With a trolley car that you look down on from the window.

We had a great stay here in Lisbon at the flat. It was  perfect location on a great street right in the heart of Lisbon. Within walking distance of great restaurants and bars and although a busy street was very peaceful at night. The flat was so clean with a big sofa, really comfy bed and a great bathroom. Would really recommend staying here if you get the chance when visiting Lisbon!

Er had a fantastic weekend in Lisbon. The apartment super central, with most of the best restaurants and attractions only 5-20 minutes walk away. The apartment has entrance from one of the streets with a tram going up a hill. Extremely cool and you definitely feel like you are in Lisbon. The tram stops in the evening, but there are a couple of bars at street level. We did not notice any noise, but we might have been lucky. The apartment itself has everything you need and the standard is good compared to the price you pay.
The host is extremely responsive and helpful, making it a very pleasant stay. We would definitely come back here again

Flexible, met us early to take our bags so we could explore before check in. Was much appreciated.
Central location with lots of options for eating and sight seeing. Pedro provided recommendations and we really enjoyed two of the dinners from the list.
Great location for a couple looking to get away. Very clean and as advertised.

Location, location, location!! This place was perfect for its prime location, very walkable and located on a very touristy street with the yellow tram. Be prepared to walk up many stairs which if you have big luggage like we did, may be a hastle. Luckily; the host helped us carry our bags. Easy check in and they were there to greet us. Place was like the photos. A small studio. Comfy bed, could use more pillows as they are small and very flat. The bathroom is small and nowhere to put your items to get ready or for shows. Some shelving would be nice. The hosts were extremely responsive and handled any issue we had. Were able to help us with laundry and we even came back to it hanging! The location, vibe and friendly helpful hosts were the best part. Would def recommend. The street is full of small cute bars that open up at night.
Great stay and even better host! Appreciated our time here!
Pedro was  great host, the apartment was clean, cute and situated central to everything. Great view from the front windows over looking the funicular. Would highly recommend. Thank you pedro
Pedro met us at the entrance and walked us up, and then detailed all the surrounding sites and best places to eat. He was warm and friendly. The location is PERFECT. We will visit again.
The airbnb was very comfortable with all the comforts of home, including a washing machine. The location was the best!

Nous avons adoré notre séjour!!!
Magnifique petit studio très propre au coeur de Lisbonne.
Que du bonheur !!!
Pedro est un hôte très proactif.
Je recommande sans hésitation

Great stay here, central to everything and at the top of the famous venicular location. Stairs only but no problem . Easy check-in with lots of humour , and lots of personalised suggestions of where to go. Would definitely book again!

We had a wonderful stay here. We had the best check in with a good description of how everything works and what restaurants we should check out. The apartment was super nice and smelled wonderful. It had everything we could need and everything was so clean and tidy on arrival. Will definitely stay here again when I'm back in Lisbon! thanks for the great stay ☺️
Perfect stay. Great place, great location, amazing hosts, very clean and comfortable. Had everything we needed! Thank you!

I had the most wonderful stay at Rui’s apartment in Lisbon, and I can’t recommend it highly enough! The apartment itself was absolutely lovely—clean, comfortable, and beautifully designed, making it a perfect home away from home. It had everything I needed for a relaxing and enjoyable stay.
One of the best parts of this stay was the location. The apartment is situated in a fantastic area, with everything you need within walking distance. Whether it’s charming cafes, local markets, or stunning viewpoints, everything is close by, making it incredibly easy to explore the vibrant city of Lisbon.
Rui, the host, was incredibly responsive and helpful throughout my stay. From the moment I booked, he was attentive and always available to answer any questions or provide recommendations. His hospitality truly made the experience even better.
I can’t wait to come back and visit again, hopefully in the summer, to enjoy even more of what Lisbon has to offer. Thank you, Rui, for making my stay so

Perfect stay in Lisbon. Perfect location. Really helpful kind hosts.
Everything we needed. In the perfect location, not as noisy as I thought it might be.
Can’t fault anything about our stay here.
We had a really great weekend!

L’esperienza con l’alloggio e’ stata una delle più soddisfacenti mai avute. Posizione fantastica per visitare Lisbona, host disponibilissimo e gentilissimo. La casa è molto accessoriata, bella e pulita. Assolutamente da rifare!!!!!

It was just perfect. Beautiful apartment with everything you need. Communication was easy, we felt welcomed with all small presents (coffee, wine, tea, small chocolates) and recommendations. If you visit Lisbon, stay here, we definately would like come back. Thank you.
Good place to stay for several nights, close to center

Very nice apartment which was in a great location to reach the places in the city centre. Pedro and the team behind him were very friendly and helpful when communicating and welcomed us into the apartment. They were even kind enough to provide us with a detailed list of recommendations for where to eat/visit and a bottle of fizz to celebrate 2025! We would 100% recommend staying here!

It was a great place and very centrally situated. We loved it. If you have conditions that can’t let you walk up stairs, then you should not get this place, there’s no elevator. For the rest it was a lovely experience.

Die Unterkunft und die Lage waren super. Man erreicht zu Fuß viele Restaurants, die Altstadt und einen lokalen Supermarkt.
Können wir nur weiterempfehlen.
Beautiful apartment, great location. Had everything we needed and a bottle of wine.
Nice little apartment in a great location, thank you for having me!

Loved our stay, it felt like we were at the heart of Lisbon! The location was amazing, the funicular was literally right outside and walkable distance to everything! Host was extremely responsive and accommodating. They went above and beyond to make us feel welcomed!  By far it has been one of the best places we have stayed in. HIGHLY RECOMMEND IT!

This apartment is a great unit in the downtown Bairro Alto neighborhood. Hosts were extremely communicative and responded to every message promptly. The unit is beautiful inside. The bathroom is nicely updated and the bed was comfortable. There is a significant amount of noise that comes from the street at night. If you are staying on a weekend, be aware that this may extend into the night.
Thanks very much - great communication, lovely flat and very friendly. Thanks guys!
Everything was perfect! The appartement is even better in real than in pictures and the communication can’t be better ❤️ thank you so much, will come back

My husband and I enjoyed our stay at Pedro’s apartment. Although the space was tight, it was incredibly central and featured all the amenities as described. For it being so close to several bars within Barrio Alto and the funicular, it was really quiet apart from our last night (it seems like there was a soccer game on somewhere and we could hear occasional loud cheers). Everything was clean and easy to find and check in/check out was very easy. They were incredible flexible letting us drop bags and check in with our very early morning arrival.
The team was always responsive, communicated well, and welcomed us on arrival. In addition we were given an overview of the apartment and multiple suggestions for dining.

Pedro's place was spot on.  a lovely little apartment in a great location, perfect for 2 people. communication was excellent and we were able to drop our bags off early which was very helpful. would definitely recommend.

Wir waren über ein verlängertes Wochenende in Lissabon und haben die Zeit dort sehr genossen! Beim Check-In wurden wir herzlich empfangen und über alles wichtige informiert. Dazu bekamen wir Empfehlungen für Lokale und Bars in der Nähe oder auch etwas außerhalb.
Das Apartment war wie auf den Fotos und die Lage perfekt! Wir waren überall in wenigen Minuten - entweder zu Fuß oder per Taxi/Uber.
Die Erreichbarkeit war spitze und die Lage mit der Straßenbahn direkt vor der Tür mit den Altstadthäusern bot den erhofften und gewünschten Lissabon-Flair.
Gerne kommen wir bei unserer nächsten Lissabon-Reise wieder in dieses schöne Apartment zurück!
Vielen lieben Dank an die netten Gastgeber und deren Bemühungen!
Sophie und Dominik

Joaó was a lovely host- he provided an incredible amount of information and recommendations ahead of our visit to Lisbon as well as walked through his favorite spots in person upon check-in. The apartment was spotless and very comfortable! We look forward to coming back for another visit and recommending Joaó's place to everyone we know planning a trip to Lisbon!

Francisco (co owners w Pedro) was the perfect host. He was very communicative about check in, welcomed us to the space and went over the list of “need to know” amenities. He was the most responsive air bnb host I have ever had by far! The place was exactly as listed. Perfect for two people or a solo traveler.
I injured my back in a tennis game and he helped us with our bags. The stairs are steep (4 flights) but this is said in the listing. Great air bnb. Highly recommend.
Great apartment for two! Clean, right amount of space, and best of all in a great location that made it easy to walk to a lot of Lisbon gems.

Great sized apartment for 2, very clean with lots of appliances. Pedro was very welcoming and even posted a pair of jeans back to us which we had forgotten. Perfect location to be in Lisbon. You’re walking distance from most things.

Studio sur la rue du Tramway 28. Très propre. Je n’ai eu aucun problème avec le bruit.
Près de tout. Facile d’accès en Métro. Beaucoup de resto accessible à la marche.
Noter que l’appartement est au 4e étage. Il n’y a pas d’ascenseur.
Je louerais à nouveau si je devais retourner à Lisbonne.

What a gem! The location was awesome—very  close to everything you can think of. The apartment itself was beautiful and had everything we needed. They had a list of things to do—what was walkable, what was not and prices as well. They also had an itinerary for 3 days if interested which we thought was super helpful. A bottle of wine and some chocolates were left for us and we just thought it was truly thoughtful. We’d highly recommend this stay :)
Great stay, great location, great host

Our stay in Lisbon was incredible, this AirBnb was in the most perfect location at the top of a tram stop and the apartment was very clean, comfortable and spacious Lots of great restaurants and bars nearby. Fantastic host who gave brilliant local recommendations- would definitely book here again!

Great place to stay within the Chiado area. Tram right outside stay and walking distance to many things. Very cute and updated apartment. Pedro and team always communicative with us and went over and above to wash our clothes for us even when our washer wasn’t working.
Very cozy place to stay.

Very glad I chose to stay here. Excellent location, friendly and responsive hosts. Exactly as it appeared in the photos. I had read reviews about it being noisy at night, we stayed 3 nights (week night and weekend) and I never heard anything.
Super!!
Das Apartment ist sehr zentral. Alles ist zu Fuß erreichbar. Man ist mitten in der City.

Great location for exploring all major areas in Lisbon. Very walkable, close to transportation  and restaurants. Outside the building is a bit busy as they say in the description but honestly didn’t bother us at all, the windows are pretty good at keeping sound out so don’t worry about that! Everything was clean and cozy we had a great stay!

We really enjoyed our stay at Pedro’s place! The apartment was beautifully furnished and everything we needed and more. It was in such a great location with so many bars, restaurants and attractions right at your door. Would recommend this stay to anyone and will definitely be back!

We absolutely LOVED this apartment!
João met us and gave us a thorough walkthrough of the place and so many excellent neighborhood recommendations. They even provided a lovely Portuguese white wine, which was much needed after our long journey.
The place is gorgeous and quite close to outstanding restaurants, grocery, apothecary, whatever you need.
We will absolutely try to book this place again when we come back to Lisbon. 100% worth it!

We had a wonderful stay! This studio is perfect for a weekend in Lisbon for 2 people. It was clean and comfortable for us to rest and recover from jet lag, and also right above the trolley in the heart of tons of walkable and fun local attractions. The hosts were incredibly responsive and friendly. We would highly recommend!

This apartment was fantastic!!  It's in the heart of the centre, right on a street voted one of the world's most beautiful. We usually try not to stay close to accommodation when it comes to food/exploring but there are so many amazing food places around. The street is quite busy, but we loved when other tourists left at night and it was just locals hanging around enjoying the street together. The apartment itself is super comfortable, modern and clean! The guys were really easy to deal with and super communicative. An amazing stay.
Great stay and fab location! Very very friendly owners

Had a wonderful stay in the loft! It is located in a great area, in walking distance to a bunch of great restaurants, bars, shops, etc., and on a picturesque Lisbon street. Public transportation was super easy to navigate. The place itself was spotless and very clean, and comfortable bed, couch and AC! The host was excellent- Francisco provided excellent hospitality and communication, tracked our flight and met us at the apartment to explain every detail about the space even at a late hour after our flight was delayed. We also loved the packet of recommendations and local tips, as well as little touches such as wine, oranges, chocolates. Would absolutely recommend booking this apartment, and I would return for my next trip to Lisbon!

We loved staying here to be honest we didn’t want to leave!! the airbnb is perfectly located in the hustle and bustle of the city with bars, restaurants and shops on the door step. The hosts made us feel safe and welcome. we definitely want to come back soon!
