Absolutely loved this airbnb! It was in a central location and easy to get around. It’s on the 4th floor and there’s no elevator so just be prepared to bring your luggage up. Host was very friendly and accommodating too. Will definitely stay here again!
Excellent location! Great communication with host. Would stay again! Thanks team!

Jãoa was a super host, he made every effort to accommodate our check in needs and nothing was too much trouble with personal recommendations of places to see and eat.
The accommodation was perfectly clean and had everything you needed for your stay.
The building is typical of its surroundings with a steep staircase and outside noise you expect from such a perfectly central location.
We had a great time and wouldn't hesitate to recommend or stay again.

We had a great time staying here! It was easy to arrive from the airport using Bolt. Our host was waiting for us and explained everything. The apartment is super cute and private / quiet inside but right outside it is an active, fun area! The iconic Bica Fulnicar (tram car) is right there and we had so much fun riding it down the hill and taking pictures. The area in quick walking distance has several restaurants and bars and a small market. And Bolt or taxis can pick you up a few steps away at the top of the hill to get to further away locations in the city.  Highly recommended!

OMG! Meilleur airbnb EVER pour voyager et visiter en couple. Situé du la mytihique et très populaire Rua da bica avec le tramway qui passe sous les fenêtres. Nos hôtes ont été extrêmement attentionnés. Le logement était propre, ça sentait bon. Lit confortable. Je n’aurais rien pu demander de mieux. Je recommande chaleureusement.

The host and Francesco was amazing! Made everything so easy and recommended some great spots. Was only ever a message or call away and the apartment was amazing. Right in the heart walking distance to everything. We loved it thank you!

We had an amazing stay at Pedro's place! The host(s) were extremely responsive, flexible on check-in time, walked us through how to use all the amenities, and provided excellent recommendations from sites to restaurants and bars. The location was unbelievable - so easy to get around. We highly recommend staying here!

I can’t recommend this place enough: we had an amazing stay at Pedro’s loft, a beautiful, well equipped, conveniently located place. The apartment was at a walking distance from main places like Praça do Comércio, Pink Street, Largo do Chiado. The hosts were very helpful as well, and provided us with a through guide of the city, places to eat, to visit and made sure our stay was pleasant. The place was spotless, clean and cozy. I would definitely stay there again and highly recommend it.

The loft was a charming apartment housed in an old building with steep stairs - Carrying our bags up was a challenge (we’re middle aged!) but once inside we were pleased to find a spotless & very comfortable apartment, which was light & airy, with all the amenities to make our stay pleasant- The washing machine was particularly useful!
Thanks to Pedro & team
We had a great stay in Lisbon! While being in a busy location it was quiet and peaceful in the apartment. It was easily walkable to restaurants and sites. Great amenities, comfortable and clean!
Beautiful place and great location!
This is a great location in the heart of town. The place is very well equiped and the owners are extremely helpful. If you are ok with the stairs, then don't hesitate to rent this lovely apartment.

Absolutely amazing location. The washer/dryer was so helpful for those of us who like to pack light.
As is mentioned in the description, the apartment is up several flights of stairs. We didn't find the stairs particularly difficult but it's something to consider if stairs are your enemy.
The building is quite old but the apartment itself is modern, clean, and tastefully decorated. The layout makes great use of the small space.
Other reviewers have mentioned the "lively" bar at the bottom of the building. Though the bar was quite busy we never heard a peep from the bedroom.

I really enjoyed my stay here . I felt the host was extremely communicative with anything I needed and the check in was so smooth. The location is truly prime it’s the perfect location with a nice photo spot outside ! Everything I needed was there . Had a great stay in Lisbon .

l'appartement est idéalement situé, très agréable, très bien aménagé et équipé et charmant ! nous nous y sentons bien.
la communication a été très facile, très réaction, nous avons été accueilli à notre arrivée assez tardive par Jao qui a pris le temps de tout nous montrer et nous expliquer.
je recommande
Merci pour ces quelques jours !

Had a great time at this fantastic little find in Lisbon. The funicular stops at the door !! Felt very special and secluded being 4 stories up and yet the hustle and bustle is literally on the door step. Not too noisy at all and a perfect pad for a long weekend. Personally welcomed and shown the apartment. Lots of recommendations with great communication pre, during and post stay.
If this place is free, book it, you won’t be disappointed.

Joao, Rui, Francisco, and Pedro are the best hosts anyone could hope to have. The propert(ies) are all stunningly designed, and anytime you have questions or concerns, they'll be addressed promptly and with care.
Location is in a charming part of Chiado, with many sights, restaurants, and attractions within walking distance.
We're looking forward to coming back to Lisbon and staying with them again.

Very nice street.
Good flat and good host. Thanks for everything

Awesome location! You step outside the door and step right into a lively neighbourhood. But when you’re in the place with the windows shut, it’s not that noticeable, which is nice. All the guys we interacted with were super friendly and helpful! Even went to far as to give us ideas for sights to see, restaurants to visit, etc… would totally stay here again!

Superbe appartement au centre de Lisbonne dans un quartier animé.
L' appartement est cosy et il ne manque rien! Pedro à été très arrangeant et très sympathique.
Nous recommandons ce logement.
Wir waren zwei Nächte in Lissabon. Die Unterkunft ist top gelegen. Wir wurden sehr freundlich empfangen. Gerne wieder.
Incredible location with views you won’t find anywhere else. Great host and amazing place!

Super charmantes Apartment in einer belebten Nachbarschaft. Daher abends und nachts natürlich auch lauter. Die Fenster sind gut isoliert und wer trotzdem Ruhe braucht sollte sich eine andere Lage suchen. Wir waren super zufrieden, viele super Restaurants, Cafés Bars in der Nähe. Wir wurden zum Check In sehr freundlich empfangen und haben weil wir über Ostern da waren, sogar noch kleine Geschenke bekommen. :)
Deuxième séjour chez Pedro, dans un autre appartement et toujours aussi bien : emplacement, accueil, appartement très propre et fonctionnel. Je recommande vivement !
We loved staying here. It was nice to be close to everything and the place was clean and beautiful.
fantastic stay in lisbon. great location, everything you need for a short break. thank you for a great stay
Nossa estadia foi perfeita! Nosso anfitrião sempre disposto a nos ajudar, respondia rapidamente nossas solicitações. Quem não tem problema de mobilidade o local é excelente!!

very small apartment, but lovely with everything needed for a pleasant stay.
A little noisey on an evening with bars & tram right outside, but didn't affect us too much.
The stairs upto the apartment are very steep,& sometimes the last thing you need after a busy day sightseeing in a very hilly area so if you're not good with stairs & steep hills,I'd avoid.
Overall we enjoyed our stay & the hosts were very proactive & responsive if needed.

For a first time visit to Lisbon, we struck lucky with this apartment. Great location with everything we wanted within walking distance. It is on a famous steep street where people were often taking photos of the tram car, which added to the atmosphere and experience.
We were met in person and a very friendly Jon talked us through everything and made some great recommendations. The description said the area was lively and so it was in the evenings. There was some noise but nothing too rowdy and it didn't disturb our sleep, but it might for other people.
The description pointed out that there were 4 flights of stairs, so we had no issue with this.
We would definitely stay here again.
This apartment was fantastic — perfect location and great hosts! I would highly recommend to anyone looking for a fun and comfortable stay in Lisbon!

We had an amazing stay at Pedro’s place ! The apartment could not be better located, especially if you’re not so familiar with the city : bustling neighborhood, cafes and restaurants on every corner and so many things to do at walking distance. The apartment itself was very clean, nicely decorated and the host was very responsive/accommodating both for the check-in and check-out (and easy to reach during the whole stay). 100% recommend !
Simply everything we had hoped for in terms of location, size of apartment , the helpfulness of the host team, squeaky clean . If we return to Lisbon we would definitely stay here again

This is a great studio apartment within walking distance of everything you need when in Lisbon. Inside was spotless and well maintained. There is 3 flights of stairs to get to the flat so be wary if you have heavy bags. The communication from the team was great, helped us with everything we needed. They also dropped in a bottle of champagne and a cake for us to celebrate New Year! Thanks for helping us a great time in Lisbon!

The apartment was cute and well decorated with a sunny feel!  More importantly, it is right in the center of the hustle and bustle of what's happening in Lisbon.  It is actually on the street often pictured in classic Lisbon images.  Not the choice if you want to be off the beaten path, but honestly why would you if coming to Lisbon? Many cute cafes and bars right near by.   It is a small space but did not feel cramped, and the location is really what matters when visiting a bustling city.  Host was professional and friendly!
Lovely place, walkable distance to most of the tourist spots
Fabulous apartment and plenty of amazing bars and restaurants close by . Would totally recommend!
Had a great stay, honestly couldn't have asked for more! Responsive and flexible host, amazing location and beautiful apartment. Would highly recommend staying here!

The Airbnb was on prime location. When we arrived the Airbnb, we were wondering why people were taking pictures in the area. We learned that the Airbnb is located right in front of the top of elevator da bica. One of the historic sights and known for its beautiful views. The host was responsive and answered out questions in a timely manner. We were welcomed with an in person check in, a tour of the Airbnb, and oranges on the table. The area was safe. The Airbnb itself was beautiful and clean. We stayed on the 4th floor so the noise from the streets didn’t bother us at all. We would come back and stay here again
Really cool place at the right place in the city!

This place is a must stay if you are visiting Lisbon!
Nestled in a perfect location that is within walking distance from all major attractions, restaurants and monuments.
Pedro and Joao were both very responsive and more than accommodating while we stayed.
The place is so aesthetically pleasing and was perfect for our stay.
We would recommend to all our family and friends and if my partner and I decided to visit Lisbon again we will be staying here!
This place was perfectly as described.  The host was amazing, location was perfect and the added touches were appreciated.  Can’t say enough good things!
Overall we spent about 5 days in the place. It was very comfortable and gave us easy access to about 1/2 the places we wanted to see. For a first time in Lisbon it would work well.

Amazing stay in Lisbon. The space was beautiful and in an amazing location with lots of great food and things to do. Clean, private, and incredible accommodations. Pedro and the crew were extremely helpful and responsive. They let us check in early and left us fresh oranges and local wine to try when we arrived.
Stay was amazing! 10/10

We had such an amazing stay here and the hosts were so accommodating and quick to reply to any question I had. They were able to provide an early check-in and late check-out for us too. You literally can't get a better location than here, it's right in front of the famous yellow funicular and walkable to all the main attractions. Place is exactly like the pictures, and they even provided the BEST oranges I've ever had in my life! Made some freshly squeezed OJ too. :)

The apartment is conveniently located in the Bairro Alto neighborhood.
We were a few minutes walk away from great restaurants, a pharmacy, markets and a cool and welcoming neighborhood bar.
The Baixa Chiado Metro station is five minutes away connecting you to all of Lisbon. One of the city’s funiculars is right outside the building which provides a nice alternative to walking the steep hill leading down to the flat areas of Lisbon near the river. It attracts tourists and picture takers throughout the day.
The apartment has a full kitchen, AC and a washer/dryer which came in handy and allowed us to pack lighter for the trip. It was very clean and a complimentary housecleaning was provided upon request during our stay. Be aware that the apartment is on the fifth floor and there is no elevator, so it’s best to pack light if you’re not physically up to climbing the stairs with heavy bags.
Antonio was quick to respond during our communications and a very good host.
We had a great stay, it was in a perfect location with lots to do and the host recommended lots of fun activities/ restaurants for our stay. The apartment was beautiful and very homely !

We stayed at Pedro’s place for 2 nights as a part of our honeymoon.
Such a cute space- perfect for the 2 of us.
Very clean, not too noisy- the windows do an AMAZING job at blocking out the street sounds at night.
There’s LOTS of steep stairs to get to the unit and a good hill to walk up to get to the building, but there’s a tram that can take you up & down the street as well.
Highly recommend this Airbnb & host!

We had a great time at Pedro’s place! The location was 10/10! Very close to lots of things to do within walking distance. Communication was very fast and the little details they included at our welcome was very nice including some chocolates and fruit! Future guests should know as is listed on the listing that you do need to climb stairs to get to the place but for us this was very manageable! Will stay again if we are ever in Lisbon!
Great accommodation in an amazing location! Clean, comfy and communication was super easy. Definitely recommend this studio to anyone going to Lisbon for a city break 😊

We had the most amazing experience here! The location is top notch (one of the famous Lisbon funiculars/lifts is right out the front door), and despite being in a busy nightlife area, we found the place to be very quiet and cozy.
Pedro and his team were great - very responsive and gave us a full walk through of the place before our stay. We even got recommendations which helped a lot!
The views are incredible, the space is incredible - I highly recommend!

The apartment is just as shown in the pictures – sweetly decorated, clean, and naturally a one-bedroom. It's incredibly central, and you can reach everything on foot. There's a supermarket right around the corner, which is very convenient. The host was incredibly helpful and always available for questions. I was a bit worried about the noise, as I had heard some things, but yes, it is a bit louder than in a residential area. However, it was quiet enough to sleep without earplugs, and they even had something to completely block out the noise if needed. So, we slept perfectly. For those looking to experience the city in a different way and explore the nightlife, this Airbnb is ideal. Thank you! I highly recommend the apartment
Amazing host & a fabulous location! We had the best time!
Great place, amazing location and the hosts went the extra mile by providing an iron in the space when we needed! Thanks.
Great location! Close to everything and very comfortable environment!
Amazing location, amazing airbnb
Great host and flat. Excellent location in bustling are. Responsive host, friendly and easy check in

The apartment was spotless, well designed and in an unbeatable location in the heart of Lisbon. Pedro was very responsive and flexible allowing us to check in early and there was a list of fantastic recommendations which we used. We knew the street below would be lively at night but the double glazing kept the noise levels down. So pleased we stayed - everything was in walking distance and the apartment is beautiful.

Lovely apartment. Clean, and had everything we needed. Kind and accommodating host.
Fantastic place for a couple to stay. Best of all, even though the night life is lively in that area. We couldn't hear any of it from the upstairs.
Great location and exactly as described in the listing.
The team working at this property were great! Super helpful, and informed. The property is in a great location 5-10 minute walk to most of the recommended sites in Lisbon. Would definitely recommend.

We really enjoyed our stay in Pedro’s apartment. Our hosts were very helpful and responsive which made getting there from the airport and checking in seamless. The Chiado neighborhood is great for sightseeing, restaurants, shopping, and easy access to trams and Metro. The apartment was comfortable and amazingly quiet with a well equipped kitchen for making our breakfasts. We found excellent restaurants nearby.
Perfect for our first visit to Lisbon. I highly recommend.

Pedro’s place was great. The checkin process was one of the best I’ve had through Airbnb. He met us at the apt and showed us around and explained everything well. The apt is located centrally and easy to get to. We did get home late a few nights and there were many people on the street hanging out - a few in front of the door, but it wasn’t an issue. We didn’t notice any extra noise. Would recommend staying here.

Highly recommend! Great location with everything within walking distance. The place was exactly as described and had everything we needed - very helpful hosts who were flexible and offered valuable suggestions.
Fantastic location, apartment, and host. Everything was even better than expected. Book this place.

We had a wonderful stay at this apartment! It was clean and very comfortable. The location is within close walking distance of restaurants, grocery stores, bars and the port. Pedro’s coworker, António, was very kind and helpful, and had great local recommendations. I would highly recommend!
Comfortable stay, very centrally located for most tourist destinations. Antonio & team are great communicators and put a lot of thought in to their Airbnb.
A great place to stay in Lisbon - right in the middle of things, and great access to the city! Rui was very friendly and responsive :)

We loved our stay here! Location is fantastic, you can walk everywhere! The apartment looked just like the photos and felt very comfortable and clean!! Check in and check out was super easy! The hosts were very responsive and gave us so many recommendations for restaurants, bars and sightings!! We will be back!
Great location, amazing apartment, I will most likely stay here again.
A gem of a place! If you visit Lisbon, this is the place!

Our stay was perfect!  A great place to stay to be in the heart of Lisbon hot spots!  Pedro and his associates were super friendly and helpful. Their recommendations for activities and restaurants were spot on!  Highly recommend!

The hosts are incredibly nice and helpful. There is no lift for the Airbnb and the first flight of stairs are quiet steep. We needed help with the luggage and the hosts were very helpful. Thank you so much! The location is incredibly central. Lots of good food options nearby

We had a fantastic stay here! The apartment is right on the famous Rua da Bica so is near lots of good bars and restaurants, and it’s a great base from which to explore the city. Check-in was really easy and the host team were very responsive. The apartment itself is comfortable and stylish with lots of amenities. Anything else we asked for was readily available. The lack of a lift was no problem. All in all, a brilliant stay from great hosts. Muito obrigado!

we had an amazing time at this Airbnb. The location is incredible. It is super close to delicious restaurants and the water. We enjoyed the local bars and the hosts were incredible always answering our questions and allowed an early check-in when we got there on the earlier side. overall, we had an amazing time and would highly recommend staying here.
Awesome location and comfortable apartment!
Clean and comfortable apartment in excellent location with very helpful hosts.

Pedro’s place was such a great location and so unique given that it is right above the bica tram. Super fun spot to be and such cute shops along the tramway that i wouldn’t have found otherwise. Everything was as pictured and Pedro’s team was very helpful!

Excellent check-in and responsiveness. Great location, walkable to all the main attractions and restaurants. The apartment was lovely and clean, but a bit smaller than expected. Also, the lighting on the stairs when coming down was inadequate. This made it very difficult with such a steep staircase and could be difficult for some.

We visited during the week and found Pedros place very central and close to all amenities, as in the description the apt we stayed in was on the 4th floor so there is stairs that may not be suitable for someone older.
Overall apt was spotless clean and Pedro was a great host and very helpful, we loved our stay in Lisbon.
Colm & Siobhan Ireland 🇮🇪
excexcellent host net usxat door and veryy infirmative and not rushed, all the intricacies of apartment carefully explained

Our stay at Pedro’s place was absolutely fantastic. The location is very lively and centric. As soon as we arrived, our host greeted us at the door and walked us through all the apartment instructions and left us fresh oranges and wine to enjoy our stay. They were very attentive and checked in on us all the time. Also, the area is very lively! At night we had a lot of fun going up and down the street bar hopping and getting to know the area.

Had a great stay in this flat in Bairro Alto. Very convenient location and the flat was clean and tidy, with Francisco being a very responsive host both before and during the holiday. Overall, happy days!

Lovely studio apartment that has everything you need and is in a great location for exploring central Lisbon (as explained in description, it is on a busy street that becomes lively at night but we could barely hear anything once windows were closed and had a good sleep both nights we stayed).
Was greeted by friendly Francisco upon arrival and hosts were always available if we needed anything.
Would happily stay at this place again!

Great spot in the heart of happenings. Gorgeously updated apartment in an historic building. Rui, Pedro’s associate, waited for us at the apartment and oriented us and even left us fresh oranges and a bottle of vino Branco in the fridge.
This is a great apartment for those who wish to be amidst the Lisbon action. Pick somewhere else if you go to bed early or are sensitive to noise.
We, LOVED it.

Such a beautiful space and great location. Very responsive hosts that came running when we messed up and had an issue with the washing machine (completely our fault). We're so grateful to them for making our stay peaceful and awesome!

Pedro’s place was so perfect for our stay in Lisbon. It was centrally located and close to lots of shops/restaurants. We had two of Pedro’s colleagues help us checkin, carry our luggage up the stairs, and show us around. Communication was always prompt and helpful.
We had a wonderful time staying at Pedro’s apartment. It was in a great location. The apartment is beautiful and very comfortable.

Great stay- the walk up is the only challenging part of your not up for it. The apartment is spotless- nicely decorated. We enjoyed our time here immensely. Location was central to our excursions.  Thanks again!

Great place to stay! Around so many restaurants and shops but very easy to walk to. A little crowded outside to to the tram and people taking pictures but that didn’t bother us. Great place to stay for 2 people. Had a great time!

I couldn't rate this accommodation, its location or its owners more highly. We had a brilliant stay.
So close to everything we wanted to see and really useful tips on where to eat, what to see, and how to get around the city.

Would recommend staying here! My boyfriend and I had plenty of space with the studio apartment. Location was amazing and the washer/dryer combo was a great bonus. If you are planning on working here-the only thing I would caution-is that the wifi was not great for video calls. I could easily send emails and do other work, but both of us had constant dropped call issues. If you arent wfh, the wifi will work just fine.

This was a nice place and we really enjoyed our time here. It is an amazing location on a street where a funicular goes up and down. We didn't find it too loud, as other reviews have said. You can walk to most places from the flat and it is a nice way to explore Lisbon. A small point - the fire alarm wouldn't work at the start of the trip and this wasn't replaced for the duration despite my messaging about this - it is lucky there was no fire as it is an old building with many flights of stairs.

location location location, very convenient. Lots to do all around, down the hill especially. Unit was small but beautiful.  Everything you need, including a washer AND dryer. on the weekends there is a lot going on just outside of your window,  with 2 mini bars outside your front door, but you can hear anything with the windows closed. I would stay here again.

Thanks so much for a fantastic stay!
We had the best time at this apartment last weekend! The location is amazing - walking distance to great bars, restaurants and many of the historical sites. We didn’t need to use the metro at all. It was great to be able to walk down to the river front in 10 mins also! Would recommend cycling along to Belem for a great afternoon of beautiful views and to see Belem Tower and Jerónimos monastery!
The flat was immaculate with lovely decor - the space is super light and airy!
Thanks Antonio for the great restaurant recommendations. The food at Cantinho do Aziz (Mozambican restaurant) was particularly good! We would definitely stay here again in the summer months! ☺️ Antonio was very flexible on checkout which allowed us to enjoy the city a bit more before catching our flight.

This apartment is so well located! It’s an easy metro ride from the airport and just a few minutes walk from the metro station.
There is a mini market just a few minutes away for all your food and drink needs. There is also a butchers, a green grocers and plenty of coffee shops, cafes and shops in very little walking distance.
It is a short walk to the water and to the time-out food market. Be warned though there are steep hills so wear comfy shoes or get the tram!
The area is lively but we didn’t find it noisy, there is minor street noise in the evening but it didn’t disturb us at all.
You can hear people move around in the above or side apartments but with the quiet after 10pm rule it doesn’t disturb your stay.
We found the place clean and well equipped, the hosts were excellent with communication and making sure we checked in well, it was a great place to stay

Prima Unterkunft, sehr zentral. Am besten ohne Auto!
Danke!

We loved our stay! Place was in a perfect location and the trolley was so fun! The flat was comfortable and had great amenities. It was just the right place to call home while in Lisbon! Will stay again!
My girlfriend and I had great stay at Pedros! The location is very central and it was fun to look out the window at one of the most picturesque streets of the old city center.

Couldn't speak more highly of Pedro, Francisco and the team.
Extremely responsive, great welcoming / tour of the apartment on arrival.
The location is phenomenal, right in the heart of Lisbon. Bars, Restaurants, mini-markets are literally on your doorstep.
Fantastic trip, would thoroughly recommend this apartment and Lisbon as a destination.
The place was clean and comfortable. Exactly what we expected and for a good price we would happily stay again.

Lovely studio, one of the best we’ve stayed in - really well designed and great layout. Stayed for 4 nights but would be good for a longer stay.
Location was perfect, ideal spot to explore Lisbon - we mostly walked everywhere but also used the various nearby trams.
Contact with the host’s team was very good, really made the stay stress-free and enjoyable from the start. Thanks for having us. As you can tell I definitely recommend this place!
Our stay was amazing, would recommend to everyone!

We loved our stay while we were in Lisbon! The apartment is on one of the famous trolley streets. Though it can get quite loud in the evening, wear ear plugs and you’re set! It is very walkable to lots of good places
There were very kind touches like fresh oranges and an orange juice squeezer, chocolates by our bedside and hand written notes, a bottle of wine. It also had a list of things to do, places within/out of walking distance with notes. Made it easy to be a tourist in Lisbon!

Wir haben uns sehr wohl und gleich wie Zuhause gefühlt. Die Einrichtung ist wie auf den Fotos und alles wichtige ist vorhanden. Sogar kleine welcome Snacks waren für uns da. Wir konnten schon früher in unser Apartment und etwas länger bleiben, das ergab sich spontan und hat uns sehr entlastet.

Awesome ! Everything as described. Antonio and his team were super responsive and attentive, and they allowed us to check in earlier which was much appreciated since we had flown in to Lisbon early morning. Be aware that the apartment is on a 4th floor with no elevator so better to travel light !

Great view, cozy place. The address provided doesn’t show up on the maps so it was very hard to locate the place. The reviews say the street is noisy, yes it is, but the windows are noiseproof and we barely heard anything even with the Worldcup going on. No elevator and the stairs are pretty steep. But with the amazing view, everything is forgiven. We had an issue with the shower drain, but someone came over and fixed it for us. Good place for a few nights of stay.
Absolutely love this studio! Super clearn, convenient and lovely place. Pedro and his colleague are super helpful. Highly recommend!

Great location! I can’t believe how close everything was; food, drinks, markets all within a 5 minute walk.
For those mentioning the neighborhood, not an issue at all. My wife and I felt extremely safe our entire stay. Similarly, there was hardly any noise nearby. We feel asleep with no issue, however the bed wasn’t the most comfortable.

We really enjoyed our stay at this lovely apartment! The location is perfect for exploring Lisbon with lots of great restaurants and bars nearby.  Pedro was extremely accommodating and allowed us to check in early and check out late which really made our stay extra special. The apartment has everything you could need and we will definitely return on our next trip to Lisbon.

This is a solid choice for a place to stay in Lisbon for a few days.  The location is amazing. The flat, while small has everything you need to be comfortable. While the building is quite old as all buildings in the center of Lisbon, the hosts have a done a nice job modernizing the unit so you have the best of both worlds. We were also greeted by our host who gave us a run threw of the flat and gave us local tips on the area.  It is in a lively part of town so expect street noise in the evenings.  Will definitely stay here again when we are in Lisbon again.
Pedro is a very gracious host. We loved the location and the amenities

This was a great studio apartment. We had everything we needed, Francisco meet us on arrival and gave a fantastic tour of the apartment showing us how everything worked. The attention to detail was superb - even down to the blackout blinds! I loved the bowl of oranges and enjoyed them freshly squeezed in the morning, tea and coffee were an added bonus, and the little bottle of wine was a very nice surprise.
Everything was spot on - I would 100% recommend staying here for a cheeky few days away in Lisbon.
The location was perfect for us, it was in the centre of everything, with some great restaurants and bars close by.
Thank you Airbnb for a great find.
The apartment is very centrally located. We stayed for 4 nights and didn't think it was too noisy. The bed was comfortable. Nothing to complain about.

We stayed in Pedro’s apartment for a few days and had a wonderful time. The apartment is so central, really clean and the welcoming touches were very much appreciated.
Communication with Pedro and his team was also excellent.

Fantastic location and cute studio. The apartment has everything you need for a stay and the location could not be better. It’s a little more worn then the pictures show. Take the steps seriously. They are 48 very steep steps and it’s not fun getting luggage up and down.

This was a good apartment for our stay. It was clean, the host was very helpful, and they gave us helpful recommendations on where to go in Lisbon. It had a fabulous view from the windows.
The listing does mention the noise from the street, it wasn’t too loud. We did not have a problem with noise levels, but please be aware that this Airbnb is located on a street that may feel scary at night to some. Lots of drinking, garbage, people sitting on the sidewalk, offering us drugs. The Airbnb itself was very nice, just be aware of the location.
Excellent Airbnb on one of the prettiest streets in Lisbon. Lovely area with quick access to all the tourist spots. The timeout market is just a 5 min walk away!
Perfectly located and cozy spot for our short stay in Lisbon!

Pedro was a very helpful host, very communicative and efficient. The apartment was extremely well presented and plenty of space for two people. The decor was beautiful too. I’d definitely recommend staying at this apartment!

The listing was exactly as pictured and in the best location. Close to restaurants, shops & bars. Also easy to access public transportation from here in order to get around. Apartment was clean and Pedro made check in easy. Provided list of recommendations that was so helpful.

This is a lovely little apartment on a vibrant street. Others have complained about the noise but we really didn’t have this issue on our stay. Communication was great and the hosts were kind enough to allow us a late checkout… would highly recommend!
Really nice, bright apartment that's so centrally located for you to walk to most of the really interesting parts of Lisbon. We had a great stay.
Lovely stay, and a great location. Communication was great and very friendly.

Apartment is exactly as pictured! It’s so clean, and a great location. The communication between the hosts was excellent!! They were able to accommodate us when our flight came in early with our bags as well 😊
Perfect location for exploring Lisbon - close to many great restaurants and bars, and easy to navigate. Overall, recommended to stay here for a clean, accurate, pleasant stay!

Couldn't ask for a better stay! Check in was easy: we were walked through everything we needed to know and given great resources for nearby food and sights. The apartment was clean and comfortable as well as very conveniently located. Personally, noise from the outside was minimal and did not cause any issues. We would definitely stay here again!

We were checked in by Rui, who was incredibly helpful in providing recommendations for our time in Lisbon. The apartment was very clean, accurately represented from the AirBnB posting, and a great place to stay.
I would absolutely recommend this apartment to anyone looking for a fun time in Lisbon.
Fantastic location great experience

The apartment is very well located, allowing us to explore some fantastic places, bars, resturants all by foot and on our doorstep. It was lively outside and until late at night, but with the window closed and air con on, you could not hear much at all.
The studio apartment is lovely, a great space and it worked well for us as a couple. Plus the check in and support the team were first class.
We would stay here again, especially as there is much more to experience in Lisbon.
A beautiful apartment in a fantastic location! Check-in was straightforward and incredibly helpful. We had a very pleasant and comfortable stay and would recommend this accommodation to anybody!

An airbnb that matches its listing completely. First of all, the AC works like a dream and was wonderful to come back to after exploring the city all day in the summer. Pedro was quick to respond and greet us on arrival. The bed is not the most comfortable, but not the worst either. Bathroom is clean with good water pressure. A 375ml bottle of wine was a nice welcome gift as well. Only downside is the 4th floor location with uneven stairs, and noisy bar right outside on a popular tourist street, but surprisingly we slept decently. Go to Bica Sour down the street for tapas, and wake up early for your picture with no crowd present! :)

Wonderful stay at ‘The Loft’, we stayed for 4 nights in August. It was a great location easy to walk or use public transport to access all of Lisbon. The street itself is lively with Bars but once you close the windows you can’t hear a thing! The apartment itself has everything you need for a comfortable stay. There is a well equipped kitchen and bathroom and it is airy and cool in the summer. The host were amazing and very helpful with recommendations of what to do around Lisbon and the nearby areas. We would 100% stay again and would recommend anyone else to do so as well.
Second stay at this apartment. Area is much quieter than before so sleep is much easier. Lovely stay, has everything, clean and fresh. We will be back for a 3rd time.

War alles super, die Lage ist perfekt! Man ist mitten in der Stadt und mitten im Geschehen. Direkt vor der Tür einige Bars und Restaurants, Nachts ist es etwas lauter aber das hat uns nicht gestört. Pedro hatte uns schon gewarnt. Super Apartment!

This apartment was perfect for our stay in Lisbon! It was super cute and clean. We had just came from a hotel that did not have ac, so we were so excited that the apartment came with a great ac unit. The apartment is located in a great area with lots to do. The street that the apartment is locate it on is lively during the day but nice and quite at night. I will definitely be staying here the next time I’m in Lisbon!

This apartment is very stylish, smart, well equipped and very clean. It's also located well, only a 10 minute walk down the hill to the fantastic Time Out Market. The host team is excellent at communicating and very accommodating. I would definitely recommend staying at this studio apartment to anybody, you will not regret it!

Incredibly responsive & friendly host
Brilliant location of flat
Clean and well appointed. Would highly recommend
The place was great and exactly as advertised! We had an amazing stay!
Very nice apartment in a perfect location, would recommend!

O apartamento é muito bom, exatamente como nas fotos. Tivemos um excelente atendimento no check-in  com a explicação de cada detalhe. Os únicos pontos que poderiam ser considerados negativos são algum barulho nas ruas e as escadas, mas que não prejudicaram o sono e o nosso passeio. Recomendo.

Tout était parfait, exactement comme sur les photos. L’appartement est parfaitement bien placé. On peut tout faire à pieds et les transports en commun sont juste à côté. L’appartement en lui même est aussi très pratique, il y a tout ce qu’il faut dedans. Je vous conseille vraiment ce air bnb. Les hautes ont été très agréables, ils nous ont laissé des petites surprises dans l’appartement. Ils ont également été très gentils avec nous.
N’hésitez pas et foncez pour prendre cet airbnb !! Il n’y a aucun point négatif :)

Alles super!
Würden sofort wieder kommen! :)

Such a lovely apartment in an amazing location - a stones throw away from all of the great restaurants and bars. It was quite loud out on the street in the evening, but we were expecting this due to the Portugal day festivities. Nothing a pair of ear plugs can’t fix!! Would definitely stay again. Thanks!

The most amazing apartment in Lisbon.
Had everything we needed, perfect location and the hosts were so lovely with small personal touches left for us to enjoy. Would definitely recommend
The apartment is amazingly located and has everything you need for a short stay in Lisbon.

Great location, great room. The layout - having separate sitting, eating and sleeping areas makes this studio live large. The kitchen is fully equipped with everything you could need and the table is big enough to actually eat at. The location couldn't be better - but due note there are two bars outside that are open late and generate quite a bit of noise. The windows have great sound insulation though, so I just closed at night and used the A/C. I really loved my stay - I felt right at home and, again, the location is great.
Amazing home, amazing location. Would be back in a heartbeat.

Ótimo ambiente, muitos acessórios e ótima infraestrutura. O ambiente é limpo e aconchegante. Com diversos equipamentos. O anfitrião é bem atencioso e cuidadoso. Fica bem no centro de tudo. Bares, padarias, mercados, farmácias e acesso a transporte. Perfeito pra quem quer aproveitar a cidade

Superbe appartement ! L'hôte est sympathique et il se souci vraiment du bien-être de ses locataires.
L'emplacement est idéal, situé sur la plus belle rue de Lisbonne au coeur de toutes les attractions touristiques. Nous serons de retour bientôt c'est certain !

Great little studio in a brilliant location. looks excatly as it does in the pictures and the communication with the hosts was excellent. they were also very accommodating when our flights changed and organised an early check in and a late check out. we would absolutely recommend!
Great stay in the heart of Lisbon. Easy to get to some really nice spots. I would recommend the apartment to anyone who is looking for a nice central apartment.

Awesome apartment in a fantastic location.  Rui was a great host and welcomed us when we arrived.  I was a little concerned it could be quite noisy at night based on what I'd read about the area and a couple of previous reviews,  but I had nothing to worry about.   It was hectic outside the appt but we didn't hear too much of that inside.  There are some cracking 'pavement' bars on the steep Street if you fancy a strong cocktail. I would also highly recommend the dim sum place just 20 yards down the hill. You definitely need to book though as they've only got 5 tables.    Lisbon is a great city for  long weekend.  Expect lots of quirky bars.l, awesome food, and LOTS of hills..!!!  Matt

I would highly recommend Pedro's studio for one to two travelers looking for a comfortable, clean place to stay in the center of Lisbon. The location is unbeatable - it's on a beautiful street that provides river views, and is within walking distance of Barrio Alto, Chiado, Pink Street, the Time Out Market, Alfama and Principe Real. Despite being on the edge of Barrio Alto, it's very quiet - the windows are soundproof and blackout shades are provided if needed. The apartment is surrounded by grocery stores, cafes and bars. The kitchen was well equipped, the bathroom is modern (great water pressure), and the bed and couch are very comfortable. Again, I'd highlight the location as a key reason to stay here. Pedro and his team also communicated very promptly. Rui was there to meet us when we checked in and provided a helpful overview of the apartment, a guide for sightseeing / restaurants / bars and even a free bottle of wine! I would definitely stay here again - thanks so much to the Chiado team!

We had a great stay in this apartment. It is a super central and charming place. The hosts have been very helpful, easy to communicate  with and very service minded when we had some minor issues during the stay. Recommended!
What amazing amazing apartment in a great part of the city! We loved every minute and would highly recommend!

Lovely flat right in the center and close to everything! Such beautiful decor and a great view out the window down Rua da Bica. It is a lively street close to nightlife, so just be aware if you go to bed early, but it didn't bother us, we slept soundly and we loved our stay . Great recommendation lists as well!

Just perfect!
Everything went super smooth and Francisco was a very kind and helpful.
Amazing studio apartment in a great location, right on the iconic Rua da Bica de Duarte Belo. Rui our host was super helpful and met our every need. Highly recommended.

One of the best locations in Lisbon! The Airbnb is on a cute street with a streetcar. It is truly a picture perfect location. It is within walking distance to the center of town, shopping areas, etc. The Airbnb was beautifully decorated, cozy, and clean! The couch and bed were very comfortable, there was a speaker to play music, a washer and dryer, and the shower was amazing!!! This Airbnb was a steal! The host was super helpful and accommodating. We were provided a list of restaurants, bars, famous spots/areas, and clubs with descriptions - this was super useful and helped us chose many local places to visit in Lisbon! The communication felt personal and customized. We had an amazing experience. I would definitely recommend this Airbnb and this host in general!!!
The apartment is extremely comfortable and well presented in a very central location.  The hosts are also very friendly.  Would definitely stay again!

This studio is a 10/10! It has everything you need and more! super cosy, clean and welcoming. The location is absolutely amazing! you really don't want to stay anywhere else! The hosts are so kind, Informative and keep in touch with fast response time which is so wonderful when travelling.
There are lots of little touches that really make the stay worth while. I had a look to see if I can rebook and they are nearly fully booked until August which says it all! Excellent studio! Can't wait to come back 🧡
Great location, wonderful hosts and very hospitable!

Pedro and his staff went above and beyond for our stay in Lisbon. It is in the perfect location, very close to restaurants, center squares and the water. So you have everything very close! The host also took the time to make our stay extra special with thoughtful notes, wine and sweets during our visit. We cannot recommend this Airbnb high enough and would absolutely recommend to anyone looking to visit Lisbon!
Wij hebben een leuke tijd gehad in Lissabon en het appartement was ook top. Heerlijk plekje en lag erg centraal

We loved our stay in Pedro's apartment. Everything was as advertised and the apartment is a truly beautiful place. Pedro and his crew couldn't have been more welcoming. Shout out to Francisco who checked us in and was also very helpful in letting us store and pick up our luggage after checkout. Thanks for the great stay we had in Lisbon. :)

Host had to relocate us due to a plumbing issue at our original booking. We stayed in Chiado 11 I’m pretty sure. It was very clean and had some nice extras including some wine, bottled water, pastries, fruit, and a couple pieces of chocolate. Nespresso machine was nice. Host allowed an early check-in without us asking as he knew when our flights arrived. Check-in was very thorough and detailed suggestions were left on laminated cards. The stairs aren’t for the faint of heart so this isn’t the place for you if climbing 69 stairs is a deal breaker. We parked at a parking garage around the corner for $13/day. There is no view worth mentioning. There is a good restaurant 5’ to the right of the entrance. Short walk to all the things you want to see while in Lisbon.

We had a wonderful stay! The apartment is in a fantastic location, walkable to everything we wanted to see/do - right in the center of Lisbon. The hosts were easy to communicate with, so helpful, and welcoming! We had the best time, and would gladly come back and stay again!
The apartment was fantastic and very well located. We had a great time and will be back!

Super host
Super location
Super apartment
Enjoy your stay!!!

We were informed the night before our stay that the apartment we rented would not be available to us due to a last minute issue with the pipes. This is never what you want to hear so close to your stay, however Francisco and António did everything right to make sure we were fairly transitioned to an even better apartment. They were very communicative and accommodating of all our requests, even dropping off a little gift package of wine, coffee, and chocolates. This is the correct way to treat your guests when something goes wrong. Keep up the good work!

Beautiful apartment in a great location in Lisbon. We had no complains! Our host was very welcoming and fast responders! We had a small incident with the electric and within minutes they took it care of it. I 100% recommend this place.

Amazing location with incredible views when you stepped out the door. No noise on the street so great sleep and bed super comfortable. Loft was just right with all needed facilities and great shower. I’d highly rate my stay.

I booked the Chiado studio for my friend and I for the week of October 17. A day before checking in, my sister surprised us by joining us in Portugal from dubai. I reached out to Pedro and his team and they were prompt at replying. They were accommodating and super helpful. They added extra linen and towels for my sister.
Francisco met us at the studio. He gave us a tour and explained how things work around the studio. Moreover, he was thorough answering few questions we had for him. We really felt welcomed at his place. There was a Douro wine in the fridge and fresh oranges. Later on, I noticed a personalized welcome note with couple of Portuguese chocolate.
The place was cosy and comfortable. It was walking distance to many points of view and most of all it was surrounded by great restaurants and bars. We’d definitely go back again and stay at the Chiado studio. We loved Lisbon and it’s people. What a great vacation!

Super séjour !
Hôte très réactif, disponible. L’appartement est idéalement situé, extrêmement propre et bien équipé.
Le seul point négatif que nous avons rencontré est lié au bruit (non pas de la rue car le double vitrage est très bon) mais à celui de l’immeuble en lui même et de la personne habitant à l’étage supérieur.
L’appartement est très mal isolé, nous entendons donc tout ce qui se passe dans les parties communes. Les habitants de l’étage au dessus de l’appartement ont été très bruyants à des heures tardives et très matinales.
Great place and location got everything and little more! :) the walls are thin so some ear plugs would help.
Tres bel appartement super bien situé. Nous avons passer un magnifique week end. La communication avec Pedro étais bonne. L’appartement idéalement situé. Tout était parfait.

Pedro's apartment is absolutely perfect. Great/central location to everything, nice upgraded amenities and features, comfortable bed and very helpful tips on where to go and what to see.
Communication was very responsive and helpful. Highly recommend this apartment.

Another satisfied couple staying at Pedro’s Loft! We have to give a massive thanks to Rui, who helped us lug our luggage up the absolutely brutal 4 flights of stairs! Once all of our stuff was situated, we couldn’t possibly have a single complaint: The apartment is clean, functional, comfortable bed and (the biggest perk) has air conditioning directly above the bed. This served us well during the hotter October nights and also drowned out any street noise down below. The only slightest of criticisms we could offer in this review is the directions provided to get to the apartment. Like most people, we flew into Lisbon airport and followed the strict guidance of the “how to get here” notes on the AirBNB listing. It proved to be useless as our taxi driver dropped us off a block down the street from the apartment, which required us pulling our luggage and incredibly steep incline of cobblestone steps to the apartment. If you’re reading this review, take note: Get dropped off via taxi or ride share (either is fine) at the intersectionn of Largo Calhariz and Rua da Bica de Durate - At the top of the street, where the trolley starts. You can walk down a few steps and easily enter the apartment.

Highly recommend a stay in Chiado lofts. The location was brilliant, right in the centre and close to Time Out market and the train/met stations. We didn’t hear any notice from the streets at night over the aircon- some noise from upstairs flat but nothing that ear plugs would’ve solve if you’re a light sleeper. All amenities present and even little touches from the hosts to make us feel welcome. Thank you again for a wonderful stay :)
Nice apartment. Cozy and clean. Great service, quick communication. Would definitely rent again!

We stayed 3 nights here! I can’t fault the apartment and the hosts! From the easy check in. Pedro was a super host and even accommodated us checking in early. The location was amazing, close to everything cafes,restaurants & tourist attractions! The apartment itself is very chic, gorgeous view out window too. I would definitely return

This spot was perfect for our stay in Lisbon! This studio is perfect for a couple or solo travelers. The location is amazing and the apartment was clean, just like the photos, and very well set up. Highly recommend!
This place was perfect! It’s just like the pictures. It’s in the middle of Lisbon too around a ton of stuff. Very walkable.
Everything was fantastic. The location is to die for and the hosts were so incredibly helpful. 10/10 would recommend
Ubicación perfecta. El apartamento esta reformado, decorado con mucho gusto y es ideal para 2 personas. Sin dudarlo repetiré en mi próxima visita a Lisboa!
Our stay was lovely! There are so many great touches in this studio - from the air conditioning to the equipped kitchen to the aesthetic of the whole place :)
Good communication, great host
Great apartment

Pictures match this studio perfectly- it’s a wonderful place to have as a home base in Lisboa. Comfortable bed, shower and couch, with everything you need for a pleasant city stay. The apartment location is amazing and it’s easy to walk everywhere. Really appreciated the informative instructions upon arrival, plus the recommendation guide in the apartment. Would absolutely stay here again!

100% recommend this studio. It is in such a good location, all the best places in Lisbon are just a short walk away. The apartment itself is also super clean and spacious, with a very nice bathroom. It has two lovely big windows that you can open and have a glass of wine, almost like a balcony. Gonçalo was awesome and communication was 10/10. Obrigada!!!

Diogo is an excellent host, he was available to answer any question and assist with everything.  Apartment is perfectly located to do anything in Lisbon. Will recommend with eyes closed, experience was 10/10.

The studio exceeded our expectations. The apartment was chic, located in a great area, and had everything we needed including a washer/dryer. Diego was extremely helpful and offered a ton of recommendations. I highly recommend staying here!
Very charming place in a great location on Lisbon. Communication was great and check-in/out process was very smooth.

Perfect location to everything you want to see in Lisbon! Beautiful loft equipped with every amenity you could ever need. Check in and out was seamless. There isn’t a lift in the building, so make sure you pack lightly 🤣

Great spot! Comfy big bed and well-equipped kitchen. Nicely designed with a discerning eye. Pretty quiet and very airy.
Cons: long, tight staircase up to the 4th floor, and I highly doubt there’s any parking nearby! The space is smaller than in pictures but still comfortable.
the appartement is amazing, very clean, in a very centryl location. also they explained everything to us when we arrived :) defently will go there again!
Excellent location! The hosts were super friendly and flexible. The flat is very cozy and comfortable. We had a very pleasant stay, highly recommended.

It was a great pleasure to stay at this beautiful place! Everything was fine and António is a very great host!
Can’t wait to come back!

Great studio in the heart of Bairro Alto, strongly recommend!

L appartement est tres bien situé au 4eme etage sans ascenseur dans une rue typique et calme. On peut circuler à pied pour faire les visites essentielles et le team et le metro sont tres proches. Pedro’s place location is just perfect (center) with a great view from the window ! I really recommend this place !

Die Unterkunft in Lissabon liegt perfekt, um die Stadt zu Fuß zu erkunden. Sie ist sehr sauber und gemütlich eingerichtet. Pedro war äußerst gastfreundlich und zuvorkommend. Wir können diese Unterkunft nur weiterempfehlen und würden jederzeit wieder kommen.
Enjoyed the stay at a beautiful apartment in Barrio Alto - it's like coming home!
Had a great time in Lisbon and this apartment is definitely one of the reasons! I will 100% recommend it.
Très bon emplacement. Appartement cosy très agréable.
Very well located! Apartment perfect for a couple ! Very clean and service was great ! Thank you very much
Awesome flat right in the heart of the city and Antonio was a great host in trying Covid circumstances - highly recommend!

This is the most perfect apartment. It has everything you need and it was very comfortable. The location is amazing! If you’re lucky enough to find this apartment available, just book it... you won’t be disappointed. We can’t wait to return!

Lovely little apartment, in a really central area and perfect for two people. It's cosy but felt spacious and had everything we needed. The place was absolutely spotless, bed was comfy, and really nicely proportioned space. Communication was great and very responsive throughout, with some great local tips too. The street outside can be a little noisy but we were warned about this and it didn't bother us too much! Overall this was a great place to stay and I'd highly recommend!

Direkt neben der Standseilbahn 'Elevador da Bica' befindet sich dieses kleine, feine Loft, mit allem Nötigen ausgestattet. Bis zum Fluss sind es lediglich einige Gehminuten. Auch diverse andere Sehenswürdigkeiten kann man Problemlos zu Fuss erreichen. Sehr zentral gelegen. Lärmpegel am Abend ziemlich hoch, sollte man sich darauf einstellen. Fenster isolieren jedoch ziemlich gut, wodurch dies für uns kein Problem mehr war. Loft war sehr sauber und modern eingerichtet. Die Kommunikation mit den Gastgebern verlief problemlos, waren sehr hilfsbereit und flexibel. Viele Extras werden für den Preis geboten wie z.B. Handtücher, Kaffee, Wifi im Zimmer und noch viele mehr. Definitiv zu empfehlen wenn man etwas im Zentrum sucht.
Super , super, rien à dire simplement parfait

Todo fantástico!! Apartamento muy bien decorado, con mucho encanto. No se oye prácticamente nada el ruido de la calle, esta bien insonorizado. Además tiene muy buena ubicación, cerca de metro, tranvía y bus y en calles con mucho ambiente y con supermercado  y restaurantes cerca. La comunicación con los propietarios es muy buena y se adaptaron a nuestra llegada, ya que por retraso del avión llegamos dos horas más tarde de lo previsto y no pusieron ningún inconveniente y además el último día después del check-out nos guardaron las maletas todo el día hasta la hora de volver al aeropuerto sin ningún problema ni sobrecoste. Detalles de bienvenida que se agradecen. Un Airbnb de 10 y 100% recomendable!

Such a cute apartment in a great location. Great decor, very clean, super helpful hosts, central location. Only downside is that is can be noisy at night on the streets due to your central location to night life, but it was not a problem to us! Will visit again!
Beautiful space! Location was amazing and the host was very kind and hospitable! I would definitely recommend    this space to anyone visiting Lisbon.

This place is amazing! It’s centrally located, stylish, very clean, and the guys renting it are really nice. They left little special touches in the apartment, which meant a lot. I would highly recommend this space.
Nice neighbourhood, good service and everything was clean. Recommended!
Brilliant place to stay whilst visiting Lisbon.  Really great location and close to tram 28 which is a bonus! Easy check in and great tips on where to eat too. We really enjoyed our stay.
This was my second stay in the very same room. You just can’t beat the location. The room again was clean, stylish, and the customer service van not be any better.
Beautiful place in a perfect location. Lots of local tips provided too!

Great cosy, apartment in a vibrant location. Very compact and has everything you need. Terrific location - supermarket, green grocer, butcher & baker within 50m. Easy walk into town to explore this wonderful city
Great location, super comfortable bed! Highly recommended!!

The apartment was in a really good location, it was stylish and well furnished with everything you could need. Our host was very friendly and helpful, checking in and out was really easy.
We had an unexpected issue on our second night in the apartment and we were immediately offered a full refund, in addition, our host moved us to another apartment nearby for our final night, this apartment was also lovely.
We would definitely recommend Pedro and his team and wouldn't hesitate to return to one of their apartments in the future.

My best cozy place in Lisbon ! Indeed

This is my 3rd time staying in one of Pedro’s Lisbon homes.
As always everything was perfect!
Exactly what it looks like online- if not even better in person, amazing location, super easy check in, great extras like local wine, pastel de natas, a juicer- to make fresh orange juice, a portable WiFi hotspot, and I could go on.
The guys are so friendly and polite and very quick to reply.
I won’t stay anywhere else when I come back to Lisbon. Having such an amazing place to stay nearly makes the trip!
Again, thanks for everything! Hoping to see you again soon. :)

Pedro was responsive and easy to get in touch with. His place was in a great location, with easy access to tons of great local tourist attractions. The decor was modern and stylish and made for a great time!

Beautiful apartment, central location and easy check-in and communication with the host - 100% recommend for a long weekend in Lisbon.
I booked the apartment on a recommendation from a friend who stayed over the summer. I was visiting Lisbon for my boyfriend's 30th birthday so I wanted something extra special and the apartment didn't disappoint. We arrived late on a Friday evening and received a very warm welcome with lots of tips on where to eat/drink/visit nearby. The apartment was a stylish space but really comfortable at the same time. There were lovely, unexpected extras such as a bottle of wine, coffee pods and some chocolates. The hosts even offered to store our bags for us after we had checked out which we really appreciated.
As the hosts had made us aware when we booked, the apartment is above a popular bar so may not be suitable for really light sleepers but we barely noticed the noise, even on Friday/Saturday night.
Great host and apartment. Would happily stay again!

Apartamento impecável!! Bem localizado, limpíssimo, cheiroso o tempo todo, roupas de cama e toalhas novas e limpas, decoração linda, e com todos os utensílios necessários para a estadia. A máquina de lavar e secar roupas foi essencial, pois pegamos chuva em alguns dias. A Rua da Bica, onde fica o apto, é movimentada a noite, e consequentemente barulhenta. Porém, todas as janelas têm acabamento acústico e não se escutava nada lá de dentro. Perfeito!! O Diogo nos recebeu muito bem, explicou tudo sobre o apto e ainda deixou mimos deliciosos pra gente.
Dois pontos de atenção: 1. é necessário ter atenção ao chegar na rua da Bica à noite, pois há grande presença de pessoas consumindo bebida alcoólica na porta do prédio. 2. O apto fica no 4o andar e não tem elevador, o que pode ser um dificultador para idosos ou quem tenha muita mala.
No mais, tudo excelente!! Recomendamos sem sombra de dúvidas.

Highly recommend this loft. Amazing location if you want to be around an exciting area with a lot to do. The host was incredibly friendly and helpful. He helped us design our night so we could do and see as much as possible. Lots of great touches like a welcome bottle of wine and a portable wifi hot spot. If I make my way back to Lisbon, I would definitely stay here again!

De fato, a escada íngreme dificulta para quem leva malas grandes, como nosso caso que estávamos fazendo um tour europeu. Mas nosso hoster deu aquela força. Sao muito atenciosos. O loft é perfeito. O local tambem e super interessante e bem movimentado. Adoramos !
An amazing location. Lovely unit   Very stylish with nice touches   Great greeting.  We would come back for sure.

Hi Pedro, many thanks for an outstanding stay in your studio. Diogo was extremely helpful when meeting us when we arrived, explained all the facilities in the studio and gave us some great tips about Lisbon, we also really appreciated the fact that he let us keep our bags in the studio after checkout time so that we did not have to carry them around Lisbon before going to the airport. A great team effort, we will definitely recommend your studio to our friends and family. Many thanks again for a great stay in Lisbon, Adrian & Michelle.

We wish we could have stayed here longer! Pedro and his team thought of EVERY detail and even provided a portable wifi and detailed list of recommendations in the area. By far the best Airbnb we've stayed at!

Really lovely apartment and in a great spot to explore Lisbon! The hosts were so helpful during check in and then kept our bags during the day of our check out which we really appreciated!! The street outside does get quite noisy at night but it didn’t bother us too much - if you’re a light sleeper, I think it would though. Would  definitely come back to this apartment and to Lisbon again!! Thanks for a great stay 😊
Perfectly located and clean appartment.

What an amazing place! My mother and I loved the chic interior design- right out of a magazine. Opening up the windows for some fresh air and seeing the lively energy from the street was so special. The bed was very comfortable, with pristine linens. The Nespresso machine with complimentary capsules was a great plus to get our day started! We did have to walk through a fairly big crowd of people at night to get to the apartment which did appear intimating at first but was not bad at all and very safe. We put the TV on and couldn’t hear a thing. 100% would recommend staying here because of the charming aura and wonderful  accommodations the apartment has to offer. The apartment is located on a very popular, colorful street of Lisbon and it was always so lovely coming home to this beautiful and comfortable abode :-)
Beautiful place, great location. Thoughtful little touches such as a portable wifi device was really nice!
The place is super cute. They left us wine and chocolate and a neat little portable hot spot device. The street is extra loud and active but when you close the window it's extremely quiet.

This was a charming little loft in a great location of the Chiado. The bed was comfortable, towels fluffy and the place was arranged thoughtfully for guests. The host was welcoming and responsive. Really good value!

Amazing apartment right in the centre of Lisbon, close to many great bars and restaurants. The hosts were helpful throughout and even arranged a taxi for us to the airport as we had an early flight. Overall a brilliant stay, and we will be back.

Centrally located, clean, and beautifully decorated, this apartment was a wonderful place to stay during our Lisbon trip. They even accommodated our very late check-in and showed us the apartment amenities, which I’ve never experienced at an Airbnb. The recommendations were also spot on. Highly recommend.

This is such a cute place with a great and thorough list of recommendations for places to eat and some cool extras like a portable WiFi system. The only issue I would say is that it can be a bit loud at night with lots of people out on the street outside - this makes it a lively fun place to stay near all the night life but unfortunately I had an early flight the next morning so I couldn’t partake in the nightlife. I popped some earplugs in and had no problem falling right to sleep though. Overall a great place with very responsive and hospitable hosts!!
Pedro’s apartment was absolutely fabulous. Perfect location, beautifully styled and has everything you need for a weekend away.

The apartment was gorgeous and well-situated — perfect for a few days stay. Not only was it exactly as described and photographed, but we discovered thoughtful little surprises left by our hosts: chocolates on the bedside table, fresh oranges for juicing, an extensive and helpful list of nearby restaurants, a bottle of wine cooling in the fridge, and a pocket wifi for traveling.
The bathroom counter was a bit small, if you absolutely must have counter space. But the rain shower head made up for it.
We also were not bothered by the street noise at all! Coming home, we did have to walk through some people with full beers but the crowds were polite. The big, comfy couch was perfect for unwinding after a long day and even longer night.
The washer/dryer unit was also extremely helpful to have in the apartment. We washed a large load and programmed drying time, coming home to the smell of fresh and dry laundry.
Highly recommend, especially if you're looking to stay close to all of the nightlife.

This place is terrific.  It's in the heart of Bairro Alto, literally on one of the most fun streets at night.  A short walk to Time Out, the river, Alfama, and numerous outstanding Fado and dinner places.  This is a great value, with easy check-in and out.  They even accommodated us checking in a little early after our red eye flight.  Couldn't recommend highly enough.
Great place!

Great location - we really appreciated the air conditioning and the small touches (chocolates & wine).  It does get a little loud at night, but we had no issues with sleep.  Really responsive with messages and questions.  Would stay here again!

Great communication effectiveness. The apartment itself is outstanding. Super clean. Cozy yet stylish. Kitchen is well equipped. And altho is set in one of the main nightlife streets in Lisbon if you close the windows you get full privacy. Definitly a would return

The beautiful room where you can stay on top of a famous place where is a symbol of Lisbon. Certainly able to have a comfortable time. Everything you need for your stay is sufficient, including washing machine, air conditioner, and cooking utensils.
The list of nearby recommended restaurants and tourist attractions which they provide was useful. We enjoyed cooking every night with local ingredients.
They are very helpful for guest,when I made a call, so kind enough to response immediately with ringing tone twice.
Awesome location right on the tram tracks. Thanks for the great stay!

The apartment is perfectly situated in a very busy part of Lisbon very close to the tram, the metro, restaurants, bakeries and loads of shopping. We drove a car and parked in a nearby garage for 13 euro per day and never need the car while we stayed there. We were able to walk to the marina and all most of the tourist-y spots and as well as the train to venture our further. The apartment it's self is so cute and very clean and well-decorated. It includes a washer/dryer, which was so helpful!
Speaking of helpful, the location of the entrance to the apartment is not obvious from the street, but Giancalo was there to greet us and help us find the door. There is a lot of commotion outside the window at night on the weekends, but I found this to be fun and exciting watching from the window. If you think this will bother you then pack a pair of earplugs because the apartment is perfect!
P.S. not recommended for anyone who cannot climb 3-4 flights of stairs.
Superb little flat very conveniently located for exploring the city. Thanks for such a wonderful stay!

Het appartement is echt heerlijk! Goed bed.. heerlijke douche!
Locatie was voor ons top! Genieten van alle mensen die beneden een drankje doen.. als je niet van drukte houd en goed bezochte barretjes is dit niet de locatie voor je! Rondom fantastisch veel restaurantjes etc.. wij konden ons alleen al vermaken in de buurt!

Amazing place with good location. 5 stars apartment.

Me and my husband had such a lovely stay at the apartment. The checkin with Diago was extra special, as someone used to checking my self in at an airbnb it felt really welcoming. And on our third visit to Lisbon they gave us more places to discover in Lisbon we hadn't. The space was really relaxing and stylish ideal for 2 people, the sofa area is so comfy as well. The location is perfect if you want to explore Barrio Alto part of Lisbon, with a Main Street right at the front door, with views and a tram to get you down the hill. My favourite part was going back early one night for drinks in the apartment and opening the window and listening to the music, drums and chat from the street below. But then once we closed the windows it was like we had being transported else where as we couldn't hear a thing!! Great apartment and would return.
Great flat with some of the best communications and hospitality we have ever had on AirBnB.

Great Location and accurate listing. Read the other reviews about the neighborhood as it is a lively area but very close to attractions, activities, etc. We met with Diogo and Gustavo (sp?) and they both were very accommodating. I would stay again and recommend to others.

We had a great stay at this apartment. Close to the metro station and restaurants. Even though it is located at a really busy street at night, the apartment is quiet. Very nice and clean, we would really recommend this place!

This was probably the best Airbnb I have ever stayed in. Check in and out was very easy and they were very responsive. They had special touches, directions for everything, places to go, and the location was amazing. The bed was comfortable and everything was clean, not to mention cute on the inside. We hope to stay again!

Unbelievable location on the most picture taken street in all of Lisbon. While it gets a little noisy at night, just shut the windows and you will be just fine. The place was sparkling clean, communication was quick and check-in was very easy! The list of recommendations on where to eat and what to do were endless. If I ever get back to Lisbon, I will be staying here again!
Great location and friendly hosts. Inside was very clean with everything we needed. Would recommend for someone traveling to Lisbon.

We loved our stay here. The location is incredible, on one of the most photographed streets in Lisbon with easy access to plenty of bars, restaurants and nightlife as well as the subway, within walking distance to the Time Out market (a must visit). The studio is super comfortable with everything you need for your stay, and the team hosting are incredibly helpful with excellent communication – they even kept our bags for us on our last day and met us back at the studio to give them back to us before our flight! Couldn't recommend this place enough, it's probably the best experience we've had with Airbnb.
As the other reviews say, it's a very busy street with lots of bars but with the windows closed the noise is pretty minimal, and it winds up around 2am. Thanks to António and the team for flagging this when we booked, in case we wanted to change our minds!

Thanks so much for having us at this stylish space. We loved our stay and being in the centre of everything. Host was so flexible with our changing check in times as we missed multiple trains and kept changing. Please note that this apartment is on a 4th floor, many stairs; and the street is extremely busy! Pub downstairs with very cheap drinks makes the street very busy with drunk people on street everywhere- can make it hard to get into the door at times. Please be aware of this when you book. :) otherwise a very great stay!!!

This is a superb apartment which is in ideal location for a few days spent in the City. Pedro is a great host and is very accommodating. Only a few minor points to be aware of - a lot of people spend their time sat on the street outside the apartment at night which can make it quite difficult to get into the venue, if you were alone it may also be quite daunting. The apartment was very clean and the interior was perfect however the smoke alarm is positioned directly above the cooker which means when cooking it is always set off. As said, these are minor issues and overall we had a very pleasant stay.

This is a great place to stay! The location was central to everything  which made walking around really easy.  The street below was pretty lively during our stay and got a little loud at night.  But I found that once the windows were closed this was not an issue at all.  There are so many great touches in this apartment and it looks like a lot of thought goes into making the experience enjoyable for guests. The apartment looks exactly like the pictures and was very clean!  I would not hesitate to book this apartment again if I were to visit Lisbon in the future. :)  Definitely a 5 star experience!

This place is amazing! Great hosts, super clean place and a perfect location in Lisbon. The guys have thought of everything, they even provided a portable wifi hotspot, and alot of personal touches around the place! Would definitely stay there again!!
Great apt. in nice and convenient location - walking from Chiado to Baixo-Alto. Note that there is no elevator, 4th floor walkup.

Stayed here for 3 nights and really enjoyed our stay! We were greeted in person by Pedro which was a nice touch. There's a Bose speaker for guests to use and also a portable WiFi unit which were nice touches. The studio is located on one of the busiest pedestrianised streets in Barrio Alto but the double glazing worked a treat, there is noise outside until 3am though but we slept through. We got quick responses to our questions and lots of tips on where to go. Would definitely stay again

Super welcoming, had all these thoughtful touches. Helpful advice and info. The place was clean, stylish; we loved it. It was Saint Antonio’s festival and it was so much fun to be very close to the festivities, and the apartment was quiet. Thank you! :)
