We loved our stay here. Extremely well organised and beautifully decorated spacious studio apartment.  Excellent communication. We really appreciated the mobile WiFi unit.  The location is very cool-overlooking the funicular track and street bars.   There is noise at night until late, and there are lots of steps to carry your bags up. We were fine with that because we liked the location.  We had a rental and parked all day at a close by parking building which cost 13.50 euros per day.

The apartment is fantastic. The location is brilliant for both nightlife and all the main sites to see in Lisboa. All of the team are friendly and helpful and communication is fast. Loads of nice touches in the apartment (welcome wine, local tips, WiFi hotspot). Highly recommend.

Absolutely stunning apartment in the heart of Lisbon! It is one of the busiest streets at night and was completely quiet enough to sleep well during the week but on Friday, it was overwhelmingly loud until around 4.30am even though it’s advised it would be quiet from around 2-3am. A wonderful experience nonetheless, just be mindful if you’re a light sleeper :)
All you read on other reviews is true — impeccable style, great amenities, perfect location, fast response — this guys have this figured out. Big time.  Would stay here again in a heartbeat.

The most professional and thoughtful air bnb we have stayed in.  Really cool space in a great location (on the street where the team starts and around the corner from the best Pastel de Nata at Manteigaria). They provided a portable wifi as well which was so handy for our trip. Thanks again guys!

Fantastic apartment, location was so much more than we expected. The apartment is on arguably the best street in Lisbon and has a fantastic view.
We found the apartment had everything we needed and was clean and tidy on arrival.
A little loud in the evening with bars being down below but otherwise a fantastic trip.
Highly recommend

Great place - right in the heart of the action on one of the most iconic streets which is featured on tourist books.
They offer good info on the area and tips of where to eat and the place has some really quality touches from a Bose sounds system to a Nespresso coffee machine.
A cosy place which was enough for 4-5 days although may get a little too small for someone longer than that :-) Would stay again though
Clean and cute spot in the heart of Bairro Alto! It was indeed loud outside every night but we couldn’t hear a thing in the apartment with the windows shut. Highly recommend!
Such a perfect spot and walking distance to everything you can think of.  The apartment is clean and trendy. We really enjoyed our stay! Thank you for being so welcoming and we hope to come back.

Communication with Antonio was excellent and we were warmly welcomed by Goncarlo. There were some lovely welcome gifts awaiting our arrival. The apartment is first rate in terms of furnishings, decoration and amenities. It’s location is very good for exploring Lisbon and we enjoyed much about the local area with great restaurants, bars and eateries. It is on a street that attracts a lot of tourists which was fine. We were forewarned that there would be ‘some’ noise from the bars below the apartment at night. Maybe we’re a bit old but we found the noise too loud and it went on until the early hours which didn’t allow us to get a good nights sleep.

Without a doubt, best Air BnB I've stayed in. Gonzalo was there to meet us, upon arrival, and it was clear, immediately, that they value their guests stay. From the layout of the apartment, to the thoughtful recommendations (Cafe de India is a MUST) they absolutely crushed it! They even had a mobile wifi hotspot for us!! Nobody does that. The location is prime and close to all the bumping shops. The street gets lively at night and there can be a little noise outside, but nothing that will keep you up. Cannot recommend this place enough!! If you aren't able to get this room, specifically, make sure to get one of their properties (I believe they have quite a few different locations).
O loft é ótimo, a localização é perfeita!
Had an amazing stay at Pedro's place. Extremely easy check-in and great amenities. Includes a hot spot device which was a great surprise and extremely useful!
The apartment is beautiful; light, airy, and in a very central location. Our hosts were very accommodating, and we enjoyed our stay.

This apartment was the ideal spot for our few days in Lisbon. It’s perfectly located to walk around the centre of town, with plenty of bars and restaurants nearby.
The apartment itself is beautifully decorated, with everything you might need for a short visit.
We were so impressed by the hospitality that the team demonstrated, with a really smooth check in process and lovely little welcoming touches.
I thoroughly recommend this property!

Todo fenomenal, ubicación un 10, limpieza perfecta, todo lo que puedas necesitar y más, recomendaciones acertadas,  detalle exquisito de bienvenida, por ponerle un pero es que hay que llevar tapones para dormir porque es tan céntrico que en los bajos hay locales nocturnos pero soportable.
Great, stylish space in the most amazing location! Would highly recommend!
Great apartment in great location! Would definitely recommend a stay here to anyone. Answered any questions that we had and left lots of info on local area. All in all a great few days in Lisbon!
Great studio. Nicely decorated and a lot of nice small details. Area is really crowded with locals and tourist hanging in front of the house at night, but we weren’t  bothered by this.

Brilliant 2 night stay in Pedro's apartment. Location was amazing, place was sparkling clean and comfortable and we got some great local tips. Despite being in a busy and buzzy area the noise was fine.
We had a lovely stay in Chiado loft 5, the studio. We had everything we needed in the apartment and the public transport was closeby.

Could not have asked for a better experience staying here. Not only was it a beautiful apartment in a brilliant location but Pedro and others were so helpful in looking after our bags for us and also providing the portable WiFi was brilliant! Nothing was too much and such friendly people too! Thank you!

This place is the best place where you can stay in Lisbon. The communication was perfect and Pedro and his team are super helpful. Really amazing to have such great hosts. The apartment was crazy clean, you couldn't find any dust even if you tried too. The interior is also lovely and it looks exactly as on the pictures. Everything you can think of is taken care off, there is an iron, hairdryer, fluffy towels, black-outs to cover the window so it's completely dark, bluetooth speakers, bandaid, Nespresso machine and so on. It was just perfect! The apartment is on the fourth floor, but the stairs are super easy as well and you have a beautiful view.
The only the thing you do really need to know is that you are literally above a bar. And it's a really crowded bar. The windows do block the sound well, but you will hear the music and people speaking. I am very sound sensitive, but it wasn't an issue for me at all, and earplugs will block it all. But the crowd in front of the door is a bit intimidating. Also because they actively sell "drugs". But I don't think anyone would do any real harm. It's just something which is nice to know when you book here, we were a little surprised. Still I highly recommend staying here in Lisbon!
Perfect location for exploring Lisbon. The apartment was very comfortable and great to come home to after a day of sightseeing!

Location was great, apartment was nice. That said, it was extremely loud at night, which was a bit unfortunate when trying to sleep. Also, water heater was a bit small, so when my wife and I attempted to shower in the mornings, it was a bit challenging. Not a bad stay though overall, would recommend
Pedro's place really matches the description and photos. It's very nice and clean and has everything you need. The location is an ideal home base to walk around the city from.
The apartment is well equiped, stylish, clean and just a pleasure to be in.  Ideal for a couple and in a lively, popular part of town.  What's not to like!

We had a super nice time during our stay in Lisbon. This was especially due to a very well equipped and beautiful apartment offered by amazingly nice and caring hosts. I can only recommend this place to anyone, who likes to be central and prefers a nice cold pint for 1,5 € in house over absolute quietness!
Concerning 'noises', I have to say that this is really not worth mentioning. This would never disturb anyone with a healthy sleep.
Excellent! We thoroughly enjoyed the apartment, the location and the hospitality of the hosts.

The apartment itself is one of the best we have stayed at. The location is perfect for exploring Lisbon, we could not of asked for a better position. It’s a little noisy at night but we had no issues with sleep. The flat is stylish and has been decorated to a high standard. The bed was a highlight of mine, incredibly comfortable! I would highly recommend stopping at Pedros place you will not be disappointed!
Net appartement op een goede locatie!

Would definitely recommend this to people visiting Lisbon, really central location, well styled flat, and brilliant hospitality with loads of nice little touches thrown in (portable WiFi, coffee machine and pods, wine!).
The only potential thing that might put some guests off is that given you’re in the middle of a busy bar area it is noisy at night (we were pre warned about this), we could sleep through it but it can get noisy quite late at night. There’s also a lot of stairs, so some might struggle.
But other than that, this was a great place to stay and I’d definitely recommend to anyone wanting a comfortable central place to stay in Lisbon.
The Loft is a lovely space and right in the 'happening' centre of Lisbon.  The Place is clean, bright and well maintained - in fact it really felt quite luxurious.

Wir hatten einen sehr tollen Aufenthalt. Pedro ist sehr hilfreich und ständig erreichbar. Unsere Unterkunft war sehr zentral und wir hatten beim Check-in viele tolle Info‘s bekommen mit Restaurant‘s etc.
danke für alles!

Apartment was in a great location in the middle of a hip neighborhood at the center of Lisbon. 4th floor walkup felt safe and front gate was always locked. The apartment was spacious and beautiful. Would highly recommend.

We had a fantastic stay at this lovely apartment. The apartment is very clean and tidy. It is very lively at nights in this area which we were pre warned about. Getting in and out of the apartment at night was very busy on the street with people drinking and smoking but like I say we were advised it was a busy place. Overall we had a fabulous time. We couldn’t have asked for a better host, nothing was too much trouble and the welcome gestures (wine and chocolates) were a nice touch. The apartment is well equipped with great facilities and a great location for all the sights.
Beautiful apartment with everything requierd on beautiful place, we recommend to everyone.

L'appartement est impeccable et très bien situé. Contrairement à d'autres commentaires nous n'avons pas été dérangés par le bruit des bars situés en bas de l'immeuble.
Pedro et Antonio sont disponibles et partagent les bonnes adresses avec beaucoup de bienveillance. Nous y retourneront très certainement avec grand plaisir !
Fab! We will be back.
This is an amazing air bnb with great amenities and a perfect location. The apartment is clean and stylish and the hosts are very professional. Highly recommended!!
Really lovely studio apartment, great location, great amenities and really lovely host team

This apartment was super cute and even nicer than the pictures. The street and streetcar are exactly what you would picture Lisbon to look like. Our hosts were there to meet us and helped with our luggage. They explained everything about the apartment and we even had a WiFi hotspot to use during our stay. That was so helpful while we wandered the streets exploring.
We loved our stay and would highly recommend this place.

Apartment is in really good location. Easy to come from airport by metro. Steep stairs led us in beautiful apartment. Bed was comfortable to sleep in. There is bars on the street, we weren't bothered about the noise, but if you need totally silence by night, then this is not your place to stay in. There wasn't any shampoo or soap in the shower.
Shiny clean. Good location.

Uns hat der Aufenthalt sehr gut gefallen, alles was man sich wünscht war vorhanden. Zwei Handtücher pro Person, Seife, Toilettenpapier usw. Auch Dinge die man eigentlich nicht erwartet... wie Orangen, Kaffeekapseln und Wein!
Die Gegend ist auch perfekt, gerade für junge Leute da einige Bars direkt neben der Haustüre sind. Auch die Tram 28 fährt fast direkt vorbei und zum Fluss sind es zu Fuß auch nur wenige Minuten.
Ich kann dieses Apartment nur jedem empfehlen!

This is an AMAZING spot to stay in Lisbon. Beautifully decorated, comfortable bed and beautiful morning light. They were so helpful with check-in and even helped us carry our bags in the rain. The street is definitely busy at night (which we loved) but it wasn't loud at all in the apartment if we closed the windows. A ton of stuff to do walking distance and the guys left a super helpful guide of places to eat and drink around town. Thank you so much - what a great spot to end our trip!

Great amenities. Easy communication. The WiFi hotspot was a really nice feature that I’ve never seen used by any other Airbnb before. The location is great. Lots of restaurants around. It’s also close to the center of town.
There were some late nights at the small bars down below, but the apartment really blocks out most the sound. I didn’t even notice it.
Speaking of the bars on the street level, I highly recommend joining in on the fun at least one night. It was always a group of friendly, diverse people.
I would stay here again.

We loved Pedro's place! The location is absolutely perfect - right in the middle of everything. The apartment itself is styled very well and has a large comfortable sitting area which we enjoyed. The kitchen was well equipped too. Pedro and his team were also extremely responsive when we had any questions. The only issue we had (which isn't really their fault) is that the neighbors upstairs were very loud late at night.
Great location at the heart of it all. A very stylish well thought through appartment with high end equipment and lovely details. All very open, hence ideal for a single or couple.

This is a great spot for exploring Lisbon! It's a quick walk to most places in the city center, and the street itself is a tourist favorite--perfect for photo ops with a tram! Pedro's place is modern, stylish, and cozy. Even though the street can get busy on weekend nights, we had no trouble sleeping and were always pleasantly surprised by how quiet it was in the morning. And Pedro was a wonderful host! We hope to be back!

We loved the apt and location in Chiado, chic neighborhood and walking distance to great restaurants/bars/shopping. The street is noisy at night, lively nightlife may deter those who want quiet privacy. The apt itself was comfortable, with  modern renovations, and we felt right at home. Our hosts were easy to communicate and very kind on our arrival, they also offered us great recommendations for food/activities nearby. We arrived late and they were friendly an flexible, which was much appreciated!
Great location

The apartment is gorgeous and in the perfect location in Chiado. The road is brilliant, famous street with lots of tourist coming to take photos during the day and comes to life with bars and brilliant atmosphere just outside at night, we had our last drink outside each night where everyone sits on the steps on the hill soaking up the atmosphere. There’s a rooftop bar on top of a car park less than 5 minutes walk away which is brilliant for sunset and so much more to do day and night all in walking distance. Loved our stay here and would highly recommend to anyone!! Hosts were so helpful and friendly from start to finish.

A equipe do Pedro é espetacular e nos recebeu muito bem. As fotos do local correspondem 100% ao que vai encontrar no lá. Diversas comodidades e a equipe nos deixou alguns mimos que foram muito bons. Supermercado virando a esquina aberto até bem tarde ajudou muito no dia a dia. Tudo foi nota 100% "dentro do apartamento", pois na porta do prédio tem ponto de encontro de jovens em diversos bares com cantoria e batucada até altas horas todas as noites. As janelas são a prova de som a ajudam a reter uns 75% da barulhada. Para os que gostam, super indico, mas para quem esta procurando um pouco mais de sossego, não é o mais indicado. O local fica no 4º andar de um prédio com escadas ingrimes, não adequado para pessoas com dificuldade de locomoção. Não há estacionamento e o público perto é bem caro. Mas fica a dica: O MELHOR pastel de nata de Lisboa fica a uns 100m do apartamento e só isto já relevou todo o resto......

Super emplacement sur Lisbonne, à 10-15min à pieds de tous les sites à visiter, de petits bars et cafés sympathiques.
L’appartement est propre, très bien équipé et l’équipe est agréable et attentionnée. C’etait Top !
The space is clean, well equipped and in a great location. I could not really fault the apartment. I would recommend to anyone thinking about going to Lisbon!

Great hosting, very helpful with tips for eating out, well-appointed apartment with excellent fast wifi, superb location for exploring the historic city on foot.  Lively busy street till late at night, but as the apartment is airconditioned with the windows shut you hardly hear any noise.  Very comfortable bed and lovely touches in the apartment.  They really have thought of everything you may need for a pleasant stay.  Highly recommended.

Amazing place to stay. The host were so accommodating, helped carry our bag, got us situated in the room, gave us great local tips, and made us feel welcomed. The apartment itself was really clean and way better than we had expected. Thank you guys!
Good apartment in a great part of the city

Great location and well kept apartment. If you prefer a quieter area at night I recommend not to stay here. It’s a party street which runs to about 2am. Otherwise Pedro and team were great hosts and we enjoyed our time at loft.
Great location and very well decorated! A must stay!
First time I used AirBNB and it was a great experience. Apartment exactly as described, great communication. Would highly recommend.

We spent the most magical time in this loft! 4 days was just not enough! This place is so stylish and beautiful I wanted to just spend the entire day in the loft ( but we didn’t because we had sightseeing to do). If I’m ever in Lisbon again I will make sure to book a space with Pedro! My favorite part was that they provided portable WiFi which is super handy! Be aware that it can get loud outside but for us that wasn’t a problem at all!

My husband and I stayed at Pedro’s place and we would recommend it! It was very clean, enough space for the two of us, and in walking distance to many of the main tourist spots. Great bars and restaurants around the place as well. There is noise at night and people hang out on the street below the apartment, but it isn’t a bother and is easy to sleep through.
This place was great it was in a perfect location. We were allowed to check-in early which was great and got great recommendations for bars and restaurants.
A+ experience. This apartment has every amenity to make you feel comfortable and at home on your journey. We slept amazing. Thank you Pedro!
An amazing stay in Lisbon! Would definitely stay here again - perfect location and great hosts with lots of communication. We had portable wifi which was an amazing extra! Highly recommend
Amazing Place, location and host! Would recommend to absolutely everybody.

We had a fantastic stay at Pedro's apartment. It is in a great location and the flat is finished to a high standard. There was a street party going on outside every night but it didn't disturb us with the windows closed. Would definitely stay again!

Pedro’s place was fantastic. It is located in an exciting area with plenty to offer. The space was even better than I expected and there were plenty of small touches that made it more superb. Would absolutely stay here again!!

Expect kind, patient, and thoughtful hosts. Expect a perfect location and apartments. Clean, welcoming, a hidden oasis after a hectic day of touring and sightseeing. Really exceeded our expectations. Thanks for a wonderful stay. Will definitely book again.

The place was perfectly centered in Lisbon. We read reviews and enjoyed the late night noises around the street. It just added to our Lisbon experience. The place was perfect and easy to get to from the airport using the Metro. We will be back to Lisbon very soon!

This place was amazing!!! The location was perfect - you were in the middle of everything! Yes, it definitely turns into a party outside your apartment each night - not just the weekends, but take that time to mingle with locals and listen to street music! Don’t worry about safety being an issue- we were two American girls (not really knowing the language) and never felt uncomfortable. Once we decided to called it a night we just shut our windows (which also let in an amazing breeze and had a spectacular view) and heard nothing of the outside noise. Everything was as listed!
I highly recommend checking out a wine and cheese place (they had meat also) in the area-
6 minute walk from the apartment. it’s called “By the Wine” and the wine was phenomenal and the staff took the time to pair you with wines you enjoyed.
We loved Pedro’s place! It was conveniently located, in a great part of town and the perfect space. Pedro and his team were super responsive and helpful! Would definitely come back
Great service, location and good communication.
Absolutely perfect place and hosts.  Could not ask for better!  Highly recommended

We had a great stay. The host was amazing and the loft was very clean and comfortable. It has everything you need. Be aware it’s on the 4th floor, so traveling with luggage isn’t so fun but you’re In the heart of the action with everything you need around you.

had a very great time in lisbon staying in this apartment - very clean, great features, nice host and a very central location (but my grandma was a bit afraid of the people down the street because they made noise till 3 am) 😄
so a perfect place for young people and short trips when you also want to enjoy lisbon nightlife!

We thought the place was fabulous. Clean, bright, all the essentials. We arrived at the crack of dawn so our host met us early and accommodating us by letting us drop off our luggage so we didn’t have to to cart it around town. . Made spectacular recommendations for food and where to watch the Portugal futbol game. Stairs were a little difficult at times but it was expected. Noise level was high but was exciting. Right in the heart of everything.
Magnifique studio en plein coeur de Lisbonne, séjour first classe. A recommander sauf pour les personnes à mobilité réduite car escalier difficile.

Great flat in a very central, hip and lively area.
The apartment is amazing! Great touches like a hotspot that you can take with you, a welcome gift and a nice handwritten note. Really clean and modern with some great coffee for breakfast. Sad we only stayed one night!
Note that the apartment is situated on a sharp slope and is on the 4th floor, so be conscious if traveling with heavy bags. We were 3 females and very much appreciated Antonio’s help lugging our stuff up the 4 flights.
The apartment is gorgeous, we loved our stay. But please be aware that on the weekend it is very loud outside.

Great appartment and location! Perfect for exploring the city and equipped with everything that is needed, including a variety of kitchen supplies. The street outside is very iconic, with a beautiful view. During the night it can get a little noisy due to the active nightlife outside the doorstep, however the windows block out most of the sound. Antonío was very welcoming and extremely quick and reliable with his responses. Altogether a great stay!!
Un super séjour dans un super appartement et un hôte au top!!

Great space, nice and tidy, great location! The hosts were very communicative and friendly!
a big shiny 5 star rating!

Great apartment and great communicative hosts. I can definately reccomend this place and will surely come back. Especially when you intend to go out you'll have probably one of the best locations with venues like the rooftop bar Park right around the corner (if you close the windows you won't get disturbed in the night by the commotion in the stress in barrio alto).
We had an amazing stay at this Airbnb. The location was great and António was really a great host with explaining everything. The appartment is really Nice and clean and has a lot of Nice details

Really nice clean apartment with everything you need. The neighbor hood is also nice and lots of bars and restaurants nearby. At night the street gets very busy cause there is a bar downstairs so you may could hear some noise from that. Furthermore we had a really good stay in Lissabon.
A great little loft apartment perfect for two to stay.

Wir wurden herzlich empfangen. Leider gab es kurz vor Ankunft einen Wasserschaden und es tropfte von der Decke. Dafür konnten die Vermieter aber nichts. Sie haben super reagiert und uns sofort in ein nahegelegenes Hotel untergebracht und die Kosten dafür übernommen. Wir waren begeistert! Der Schaden wurde während unseres Aufenthalts bereits behoben. Vielen Dank nochmal für die professionelle Abwicklung und die reibungslose Kommunikation.

Pedro and his team run the kind of company that are the reason we love to use airbnb. The flat couldn't be in a better location - just over the road from Barrio Alto and on one of the most photographed streets in Lisbon. The flat itself is a great use of space and has everything you need for a short stay. We particularly liked the portable wifi, which came really in handy where we were using google maps on the go. But, the best thing about our stay is how this business is run. These guys will REALLY go out of their way to make sure that their guests are taken of and we really had the best customer service during our stay. Thanks so much for making our stay a memorable one!! It really was a pleasure to have you as our hosts :)

Great experience!
Communication with Pedro and the team was easy. Able to arrange the check-in easily even though we arrived in the city pretty late (20:00).
The apartment was clean and meets all the expectations. Great location for exploring the city. On the ground floor there's a bar, but after midnight there's no more noise coming from there, so a good night's rest is guaranteed.
We had an issue with the apartment on the first evening but the team took care of that as fast as possible (we could still reach them after 00:00). The service delivered was impeccable. If we'll ever travel back to Lisbon we will definitely choose for one of their apartments again.
Superfin lägenhet i perfekt läge. Pedro är en mycket trevlig och tillmötesgående värd. Skulle säga att lägenheten är perfekt för ett par (själva eller med ett barn).
Appart tres fonctionnel, wifi portable, bose a disposition et surtout super bien situé. Il y a du monde en bas le soir... quartier vivant.
The apartment is fantastic. In a great location, sparkling clean and very nice inside. Comes with a list of recommended restaurants and bars. Highly recommend!

We enjoyed our stay at the apartment. Just a step away from restaurants and shops. The street gets a bit crowded in the evening but it did not concern us. A great base to explore Lisbon and surrounding areas :) Would definitely stay again.
Stylish apartment in a hip part of town, easy to get around by foot. Pedro and the team were fabulous and took care of us making our stay as comfortable as possible!

This apartment is on possibly one of the most photographed street on Lisbon. It’s so close to everything which makes a city break very convenient. The street outside can be quite noisy until the early hours but the apartment seems to be well sound proofed as it didn’t disturb us very much! Wonderful apartment which is beautifully decorated and the location is second to none

It was in such a cool area.  I loved watching the old tram on the street below and all the activity nearby.  Shops were so nearby and just a fantastic area to mooch about.  The bed was so comfortable and I would certainly highly recommend your place to anyone visiting Lisbon.  What a marvellous city and every person we encountered were so helpful and smiling.  Perfect place.

Wij hebben hier een leuk weekend gehad. Mooi appartement en goede ontvangst.
's avonds wat lawaai van de barretjes, maar wij hebben daar geen last van gehad.

Had a great time staying here with my gf on our trip. The loft is clean and cozy equipped with everything you’d need. The bar outside the apartment gets a little noisy at night but it’s nothing some quite music can’t wash out if you go to bed early. Would book again for sure!

Nice apartment, very central and well decorated. Perfect for a couple or solo person.  The team has been great in terms of communication and very helpful. I can only recommend this apartment if you want to stay in Lisbon.

The flat is located on one of the most photographed and unique streets in Lisbon. Chiado is fantastic - quirky, interesting, close to transport and full of brilliant places to eat. Pedro’s team were so helpful and attentive and the flat, whilst small, has everything you need for the perfect little Lisbon home.

le logement est parfait, l'appartement est très bien situé, en plein cœur du vieux Lisbonne. attention toute fois à ceux qui seraient un peu sensible au bruit car c'est un quartier animé et les bars sont juste en dessous donc le jeudi soir et we c'est animé. mais le charme de l'appartement, les petites attentions de Pedro et son équipe font vite oublier cela car vraiment on se sent bien dans l'appartement.
Great location and the room is exactly as pictured. I highly recommend!
Tolle Unterkunft, prima Abwicklung. Absolut empfehlenswert!

Appartement au top, idéalement situé en plein cœur du centre!
Bien qu’il y ait un bar juste en bas de l’appartement, le bruit reste très supportable.
L’appartement est très charmant bien que légèrement petit mais pour passer quelques jours en amoureux, il est génial !!
Puis nos hôtes ont été super avec nous, très disponible et très souriant mais aussi de bons conseils!
Nous conseillons vivement cet appartement avec mon chéri, nous avons été ravis.

Absolutely LOVED our stay here. The location is perfect. Located in the hustle & bustle of the crowds, bars, nightlight & food. Locate just beneath the stay is the coolest bar we enjoyed with such hospitality: Small Bar! The proximity to do things is also fantastic. TimeOut Market is located within a 5min walking distance. There are several great restaurants and the square is also active day & night.
At night you can hear the noise from downstairs but it’s not too noisy. However, if you’re a family with small kids or not into being surrounded by lots of people; this wouldn’t be the place for you.
Overall, A+ stay!

Im großen und ganzen hat uns die Unterkunft gut gefallen. Uns wurde zwar im Vorhinein gesagt, dass es am Wochenende abends in der Gegend laut werden könnte, allerdings waren wir nur
in der Woche da und auch dann war es recht laut. Die Wohnung entsprach den Bildern zwar, aber an der ein oder anderen Stelle sah man dann doch schon, dass die Wohnung etwas in die Jahre und Benutzung gekommen ist.
Uns hat der Aufenthalt dennoch gut gefallen!

Ons verblijf in dit appartement was echt top! Het appartement zag er super netjes en schoon uit en ligt middenin het centrum. Daardoor misschien wel wat meer geluidsoverlast maar wij vonden dat niet erg. Restaurants en gezellige bars liggen allemaal op loopafstand. Antonio was ook heel goed bereikbaar voor vragen. Wij zouden dit appartement zeker aanraden!

The loft was comfy and in a very convenient location. It's perched at the top of the BICA funicular line so can be a challenge to walk up and down the steep street. Otherwise the loft was fantastic, the amenities were great, the guys were quick to respond to questions and I'd consider staying again next time I'm in Lisbon.

Very nice apartment in central location in Bairro Alto. Great area for night life with trams and metro nearby. Even has Ascensor da Bica to the door. This brings you up from the lower level of Lisbon which has a lot of steep hills. Be prepared to climb lots of very steep streets and stairs in this area. Close to lots of restaurants and shops.
We had a great and memorable week in Lisbon.
Obrigado.
Hervorragende Lage im Zentrum. Sehr lebhaft! Kurze Wege zu vielen Sehenswürdigkeiten. Tolles Loft, sehr gepflegt! Super Kommunikation mit dem Host. Wir kommen wieder!!!

The location is fantastic, walkable distance to almost main sites of the old town. Famous yellow tram is just at the doorstep. Professional host! Highly recommend for young travelers! But if you are extremely noise-sensitive this house might not be your first choice because it is built in an very old house that sound insulation was not good enough to block steps from the staires or noise from the bar downstairs. Besides this, everything was just perfect! Personal recommendation of restaurants and bars are surprisingly good. Great value in general!
Loved this apartment, amazing central location! Hosts were so thoughtful, lots of special touches, wine, chocolate and fresh fruit. A hand written welcoming note was a special touch!

I don’t recommend to travelers who have large luggage or are the disabled. Because of there’s no elevator and the stair is steep. The room is well located but a little bit noisy. But everything else is good!

The apartment was lovely and had everything you need to enjoy your stay. Perfect location if you would like to be a part of the hustle and bustle at night. Antonio was very helpful and easy to communicate with, would highly recommend!

Das Appartement ist stylisch, super sauber, sehr zentral. Tolle nicht selbstverständliche Goodies waren: Kaffeekapseln, eine kleine Flasche Rotwein, Toilettenpapier, Seife, tolle Tipps und ein portables W-Lan Gerät. Wir haben uns jederzeit sehr wohlgefühlt und kommen gerne wieder!

Right in front of Tram line and at the center of the city makes it super convenient to roam about the city
Lots of stairs to climb up so pack light

My stay at Pedro's flat was great. The location was wonderful and communication with the hosts was very easy.
Although there are parties held directly below the flat in the street, the apartment was very insulated from the sound and we didn't have any issues sleeping.
I would stay here again next time I visit Lisbon.

We enjoyed staying here as the location was really good. Felt like a local and getting around was easy. We expected it to be bit noisy as there is a bar right outside but it didn't keep us up. There is a narrow stairway which was fine even with our roller suitcases. The tip sheet was nice as we could refer to it when we needed somewhere to eat.

Die Unterkunft ist zentral gelegen und vieles ist zu Fuss erreichbar. In Laufdistanz liegen viele Bars, Restaurants und Parkmöglichkeiten. Die Strasse direkt vor dem Apartment ist sehr belebt und nachts eher laut.
Die Ausstattung und Einrichtung der Wohnung lässt keine Wünsche übrig:)
près du centre, métro, bus et tous ce qu'il faut pour visiter Lisbonne. Près de Bairro Alto pour la vie nocturne.

Pedro's place was beautiful and in a great location. The bed was very comfortable as well. Most nights it's fairly noisy just outside. We slept fine anyway, but it might be an issue for early risers or families with kids.
Our Airbnb made our trip! It's was gorgeous, well thought out and the location was perfect. We say it's our favorite Airbnb we have ever stay.
Great place to stay in Lisbon.  Very clean and modern.  Good location (but it can get loud at night - even on a Monday or Tuesday).  A lot of restaurants and bars within walking distance.

We had a fantastic time in this apartment - we didn't know much about Lisbon before coming, but this area was actually our favourite after some exploring, and all the restaurants and shops we wanted to visit were a few minutes' walk away. It's on what must be one of the most photographed streets in the city (cobbled stone hill with trams going up and down, with the river on the horizon), and it was probably the best in terms of location out of all the Airbnbs that we've stayed in (we loved everything else about it as well!).
We were allowed to check in early as the guest before had left earlier, and there is a place to leave luggage 2mins down the street if you need to leave your things after check out. Only about 20mins from the airport (and a very affordable Uber ride), and just a great area of town. It does get noisy at night as people drink and socialise right on the street, but we didn't find this to be a problem and slept soundly every night. The facilities are perfect, there was even a pocket wifi that you could carry around with you to use when out and about!
Thank you for an amazing stay!

Herzlichen Dank an Pedro und seine Mannschaft! Wir wurden - trotz mitternächtlicher Stunde - von Goncalo äußerst freundlich empfangen und perfekt eingewiesen.
Das Apartment ist liebevoll eingerichtet, entspricht genau den Fotos und bietet technisch alles, was man braucht. Die zentrale Lage zwischen Chiado und Bairro Alto entschädigt jederzeit für das Treppensteigen in die 4. Etage. Aus dem Fenster blickt man direkt auf die Zahnradbahn, 50 m entfernt hält die traditionelle Tram 28, und in 10-15 Minuten ist man zu Fuß am Wasser, im Fischrestaurant, in der Fado-Bar, am Bahnhof. Die Kommunikation mit Pedro und Goncalo war vorbildlich: jede Frage wird sofort beantwortet, Änderungswünsche werden berücksichtigt, Tips gegeben. Vor dem nächsten Besuch klopfen wir ganz sicher wieder bei diesem Gastgeber an!
We had a pleasant stay. Great location and super host!

Alles in allem haben wir uns in dem Apartment sehr wohl gefühlt. Es liegt zentral mit etwas Geräuschpegel von außen, aber den konnten wir ignorieren. Die Einrichtung ist sehr geschmackvoll und durchdacht und wir haben nichts vermisst. Allerdings ist das hoch- und runtertragen großer Gepäckstücke eine Herausforderung, da das Treppenhaus eng und relativ steil ist.

Un super accueil, un appartement très beau et propre!!! Et des hôtes très très arrangeant!!!
Par contre bar en dessous des fêtes et voisins un peu bruyant donc n'oubliez pas vos bouchons!
Les meilleurs pastels de nada de cette année sont à 3 min à pied de l'appartement et le métro à 4 min à pied 😁😁😁
Amazing location!
An amazing apartment in a great location with great hosts, highly recommended.
Anything we could ask for and more. We will definitely return to this apartment when we visit Lisbon again!
Hip studio on lively street

This place was awesome! Spacious for a studio and super nice that we could do laundry. Lisbon is super hilly so it makes things less walkable but our location was pretty easily walkable to a ton of tourist attractions and restaurants. I would just make other people aware that the night life is LOUD here. We couldn’t hear it in the Apt at all but there were crowds outside our place at night. My boyfriend and I are in our late 20s so we took no issues, but I can imagine going with our parents or something we may have heard complaints :)
The apartment was fantastic and Pedro's hosts were friendly. Very recommend to the people like to live near facilities.

Because of recent Ryanair problems, our whole trip to Lisbon got cancelled while we were at the gate waiting to board the plane to Lisbon! But, Pedro and the whole team were amazing to deal with and made us feel completely secure. Communication was excellent and they offered help and advice. We will be booking another trip to Lisbon in the near future and we will definitely be contacting Pedro and team!

El piso es tal cual se muestra en las fotos, y es muy céntrico, tienes todas las comodidades para pasar tiempo en él. El piso está muy limpio y tiene muchos detalles que no esperas. Sin duda si volvemos a Lisboa volveremos a reservar ahí.

What a lovely place to stay. The studio was as it was described. Well appointed. On a very pretty (a very popular spot for photos) street which was busy at nights but the flat is quiet so it didn't cause us a problem. The flat is up a few flights of stairs which we were told about - but it wasn't a problem. Handy for supermarkets and bars and nice restaurants. Great and prompt communications. Early access to leave our bags which was very helpful. And a nice bottle of wine and basics to start us off. A great place to stay. Many thanks.

Great central spot. The studio was clean, easy to find, not far from the metro and communication was great. Yes it's a noisy street at night but the double glazing means it's not really an issue at all. Nice to be part of things.

We had a great stay at Pedro's place. We had a car and were able to park in a public lot nearby. The loft was easy to find and within a 15 minute walk of most places. Thr night life on the street outside is definitely busy and loud but was not very noticeable inside (even with our 18 month old); we were all able to sleep through the night. The 4 flights of stairs were no problem. We loved all the little details; oranges, wine, chocloates, Nespresso. The space was designed perfectly and we loved the King size bed. We would definitely recommend staying here when visiting Lisbon.

Die Unterkunft ist wirklich super zentral und mitten im Geschehen und in einer der bekanntesten Strassen Lissabons gelegen mit einem wundervollem Ausblick!! Fußläufig ist wirklich alles perfekt und schnell zu erreichen ! Ich würde jedem diese unterkunft sofort empfehlen !

This was a very enjoyable short stay. The apartment is very well appointed with modern appliances. We were warmly welcomed by Goncalo who explained the features of the apartment clearly and gave us hints for restaurants etc.
There is a party atmosphere in the street with restaurants and bars a few doors away. Very little noise actually made it into the apartment.
A short, but steep walk gets you to the waterfront.
Highly recommended.

The apartment was just as lovely as the pictures make it look, and in a perfect location - right in the centre above the street with yellow trams. We were told the street might be noisy at night, but we had no problems at all. We had everything we needed and more, and Pedro & Antonio were super helpful. Wonderful Airbnb!

What a fantastic location! We were able to do tons of exploring while always feeling close to our home base.
Great for a young couple looking for a mix of history and nightlife. The location is perfect because the street below transforms into very lively nightlife.
Pedro was incredibly accommodating in both pre-stay communications as well as all the very thoughtful details left throughout the unit.

The studio was very clean and looked exactly like the photos (sans the fruit in the fruit bowl). They even provide a mobile wifi hotspot for you to use when you leave the apartment. This was super helpful and convenient, especially for non-European travelers without international phone plans. Gonçalo, one of the guys who manage the place, was kind enough to show up to let us check in early and gave us some useful tips and recommendations regarding the studio and spots to hit up in Lisboa. They gave us a nice bottle of wine and some chocolates as a welcome gift as well. The bed and sofa are very comfortable. We did not use the laundry unit or the dishwasher, but they were available for use if needed (just buy your own detergent in the grocery right around the corner). Our only critique was that the apartment is located on an off-street in Bairro Alto (a street which some people may consider "sketchy" - but we felt safe enough), where a TON of people gather to drink and socialize at night, so it definitely got a bit loud. We were surprised at the number of people and how loud it got considering we stayed on a Monday. However, this was likely due to the fact it was right before a holiday in Lisbon, so folks didn't have work the next day. Lastly, please note that the studio is up 4 flights of steep stairs, and an iron/ironing board were not provided, but they are available from the guys upon request. Overall, the unit was clean, it is close to everything, and the hosts are communicative/helpful - for the price, it's definitely a good deal. We had a lovely stay, just be wary of the street it's on if you're a light sleeper or aren't keen on being at a location where the night life is certainly poppin'.

From the check in and all along our stay
We enjoyed staying there.
The apartment's location and it's design and cleanliness was great and well equipped

We had an excellent stay for 4 nights in Lisbon. Great location close to lots of restaurants, cafes and bakeries. Easy to walk to public transit if needed. Only issues were there was no shampoo and only 1 small bar of soap - we have previously had these things provided at our other AirBnBs in Portugal so did not pack our own. There were some small ants in the bathroom/bedroom area.
Also the street is VERY BUSY at night. There are crowds of people drinking literally outside your front door (you have to ask them to move to get in and out). This did not bother us but I would not recommend families with young children staying here. There is broken glass on the street at night but it is all cleaned up by the morning.
Overall we had a great trip, the team was so helpful with meeting us at check-in and also making dinner reservations for us since we did not have access to a phone. Bottle of wine and fresh oranges were great. Thank you!
Great place, great location, great host! Highly recommend staying here!

We had a wonderful stay at the chiado loft, and positive experience with Pedro and his team.  The studio was just as pictured, and perfect for a couple wishing to explore the city and Lisbon night life.  Thank you!

Apartment itself is absolutely beautiful, modern and nice. Ideally cleaned and equipped with everything you might need (even with mobile device for local internet usage). Location is very central with several steps connection to tram stop and lots of directions for walking around. There were two big issues for us. First - the street is very much noisy and covered with lots of bars' visitors - they are just sitting by your entry door and sing songs under your window. The owner promises it to be up to 2a.m., but in reality it stops not earlier then 3-3:30 a.m.  So if you tend to spend you nights in the bars - the place is perfect for you, if you expect some early rest, it might be a problem for you. Another big moment is car parking. We were promised public garage with EUR14 per 24 hours rate close to the apartment, but at 6p.m. on Thursday it was full with quite long line of cars waiting for a free space at the entrance, and we had to park at another nearest parking, which costed us EUR 44 per 24 hours. To be honest, additional overall EUR48 which we payed for parking, added for this apartment price would allow us to find place with it's private parking. All the rest was perfect - 100% clear communication, quick owners responses for all our questions, nice, modern and clean place itself.

Really enjoyed our stay in Lisbon - check in was easy and convenient and was welcoming. The apartment is very nice and very comfortable sofa! It has everything you need. Unfortunately, my husband and I are very light sleepers and found that we weren't able to sleep until about 2.30am each night because of the noise from the people drinking on the street from the bar, and a noisy neighbour upstairs. However, it's obvious that the owners have tried to do everything they can to dampen the noise.
Great location, the loft has everything you need. Can get a little busy downstairs on the weekend or if there is a football match. Nice decor.

Great little gem right at the heart of Chiado. Being at the center of night life it can be a bit noisy but the windows are covering it well. The building is a bit old but the apartment per se is lovely. Great check-in and communication with the hosts!

A great apartment in the heart of historic Lisbon!  Very close to all types of public transportation and walkable distance to many attractions, places to eat and shopping.  Apartment was extremely clean and mobile wifi was provided that was very helpful with navigating the streets so Lisbon.  Communication was very good - Antonio met us when we arrived, was very helpful with a variety of questions and had provided excellent directions on how to find the apartment from the metro station.
Perfect location!Comfortable room with all necessary facilities!

Looking for a beautiful & centralized location in Lisbon? That's certainly one of the best for an affordable price. The apartment is located in one of the most photographed and famous streets in the City and is in the middle of everything. I highly recommend this place!
Will definitely re-book if I come back in Lisbon.

We can esaily understand why this team is considered as "super hosts".  First, we already had a late check in. Worst of all? Our plane was delayed by an hour and a half.  We can never thank the team enough for going the extra mile to allow us to check in that late.  The apartment is even better than the photos and every little detail is well thought out.  The location perfect.  It is central and lively with many restaurants and places to go to.  Would we rceoomend it? Definitely!  Thanks again!

Pedro's place was exactly how described and as it looks like in the pictures.
He and his team are super nice and easy to talk with.
I had an issue with the hair dryer that burned and they bring me a new one in a few minutes.
Location is very good and easy to walk to a lot of places, it is a lively neighborhood so you will find a lot of bars and people on the street.
I would recommend his place.

If you want to be in the mix and perhaps the most popular street in Lisbon you defenitely want to stay here.  It's a great apartment and the location is amazing. It can get noisy outside at night, but if you are staying here you are within walking distance of everything so that doesn't matter.  Meaning you won'tY be in your room.  You gotta go up some stairs to get to the apartment so keep that in mind.  Would defenitely recommend this place to anyone looking into it.

Great location and a comfortable apartment.  The only downside was the noise from the bars below, this is a party street and we used earplugs.   The windows were double glazed and that help to reduce the noise.  The apartment was lovely and clean and very comfortable to relax in, close to lots of restaurants and an easy place to explore from.
Perfect stay in this stunning appartment. The location is ideal (very great and famous area) and Perdro was really welcoming. Definitely recomend this place.

Wir waren für ein langes Wochenende in Pedros Appartment. Die Kommunikation (auch vor Antritt der Reise) war spitze! Man bekam immer sehr schnell eine Rückmeldung auf seine Nachrichten und Fragen z.B. bzgl der Anreise.
Das Appartment ist wirklich klasse. Sehr schön eingerichtet, wie auf den Fotos zu sehen und sehr sauber. Wir haben uns dort überaus wohl gefühlt. Für einen Städte-Trip liegt es einfach super zentral, man kommt überall zu Fuß hin. Supermarkt, Bäcker, Bank findet man alles im Umkreis von 100m.
Die Straße ist offenbar die Partymeile von Lissabon - da die Fenster sehr gut isoliert waren, hat uns das in Kombination mit Ohropax nachts nicht gestört ;-).
Wir hatten ein paar wunderschöne Tage und würden wiederkommen.
Vielen Dank, Jungs!

This place was amazing. It was very clean. It was close to everything. The street gets very busy with people and drinks which is nice for the night life. I would definitely recommend staying at this place.

Pedro and team were amazing - very easy check-in to their AMAZING place in Lisbon. The apartment has everything a couple can want with beautiful views, decor and amenities. It is in probably one of the best locations in Lisbon, close to Barrio Alto, the waterfront, and bars and restaurants.

A fantastic location and excellent host!
A good location to explore beautiful Lisbon.

The apartment is beautifully decorated and slap bang in the middle of Bairro Alto, a great spot for discovering loads of top restaurants and bars. Most of the sights Lisbon has to offer are within walking distance and the hosts were a pleasure to deal with throughout - great communication and an easy process. At check in we were given recommendations on places to go and where to eat, as well a dongle for wifi on the go - a brilliant extra! Being on a street of bars for locals which closed in the early hours of the morning, we found the Saturday night to be particularly loud, but all other nights were fine. A superb apartment which we would not hesitate to return to and a must if you want to experience Lisbon like a local!
Charming and animated district, perfect to visit Lisbon few days!

Fantastic stay, walkable and very central to public transportation. In the heart of the nightlife area so it can get noisy but if you're able to zone it out you can have a good night sleep.  They were incredible hosts who went above and beyond and made the stay really nice.  The apartment is just like the pictures, extremely clean and well kept.

We had a great time in Lisbon! The studio is clean and well equipped and in the bathroom were enough towels. Our host Gonçalo was nice and it was easy to contact him. The location is very central and a lot of sightseeing is within walking distance. We also went to Sintra by train (station Rossio, also within walking distance). We would definitely recommend it to go there and rent an electric car at LasTours! The neighborhood is quite noisy and crowded, because of the bar and the people hanging and drinking in the street. So if you can't stand noise at night, better bring earplugs!

This apartment is absolutely amazing! We were greeted with a bottle of wine and some delicious chocolates and given a really comprehensive list of places to eat, drink and visit during our time in Lisbon. The flat also comes with a portable wifi device which gives you free wifi wherever you are which is so useful when you are exploring a city. I would definitely recommend this place and will be sure to stay again next time I am in Lisbon.
Perfect Place to be central and  direct by the nightlife, Shopping and sightseeing
One of the best places we have stayed at. Completely as described! Highly recommend!  Good home base for a trip to Lisbon.

Being down-down was great.
Apartment came with WiFi, and unexpectedly, a 4G MiFi dongle you could carry around with you during the day giving you on-the-go data "on the house" rather than your own data plan, was BRILLIANT / FANTASTIC.
Down-side of being down-town was a bar directly opposite the apartment that "got going" at 22:00, more customers on the street than inside, and didn't quieten down until around 02:00.
Travel advice. Depending on your arrival time (i.e. not late), from the airport jump on the RED metro line into town. Change at Alameda to the GREEN line toward Cais do Sodré. Jump off at Intendente, and make your way to the eastern side of the street (Avenue Alameda Reis) and the tram stop Igreja dos Anjos. From there, jump on a regular yellow north-bound 28E tram, which will quickly turn east and south, taking you down-town through some FANTASTIC initial impressions of the city. Jump off at the Calhariz - Bica stop, which is just 20 metres away from the apartment.
For days out, trains (which are really cheap!) to Sintra and Cascais should definitely be on your bucket-list. If you visit Cascais, then we'd definitely recommend hiring a CITY bike from Daniel at http://portugalrentbike.com/en/ and taking a ride along the coast road (and dedicated bike track) the beaches at Praia Grande do Guincho.
Enjoy - we did!
They were incredible hosts. They left us a very nice gift for Easter, which was a nice surprise!
The location is perfect, right in the city centre with beatiful view. The room is clean and well equipped. Highly recommend.

Perfect clean place to stay a couple of nights! A really lovely apartment in the middle of the city, everything is within easy walking distance (major sightseeings, public transport, restaurants etc)! Would definitely recommend this to everybody. Antonio and his team were very friendly and suggested a couple of good eating locations nearby. Late check-in was no problem and a huge plus was the portable wifi device, so you don't need to bring your maps and travel guides with you.

Fantastic stay in a beautifully decorated apartment. Great location in a lively neighbourhood with lots of independent restaurants and bars. Lots of thoughtful touches in the room and good recommendations from the hosts.
The hosts were more than accommodating with great communication. The unit itself is very central, clean, and cozy! We absolutely loved it and would recommend it to any future travlers

Great apartment in central location.  Communication & welcome from hosts was perfect.  Thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would fully recommend this Air BnB.  Apartment is portrayed in the photos as it is in reality.  Superb value for money...a home from home!

We had a great stay at this lovely little studio. We were met at the apartment and shown what we needed to know, along with restaurant recommendations, which we took up and were delighted with, esp Time Out Market.
There were a few nice treats, and everything in the studio was really well thought through. We enjoyed resting in the flat at the beginning and end of the day. The nearby funicular tram (Acsensor De Bica) stopped 5 steps from our front door, though we didn't know that when we first arrived with cases! One tram/metro credit well worth spending.
There's a bit of noise from the bars in the evening, but we weren't too affected as we were so exhausted from all of our walking around the Lisbon hills.
Schönes Appartement in zentraler Lage. Tagsüber glitzert der Tejo und Nachts das Partyleben.
호시우역에서 걸어서 10분 정도면 위치한 곳으로 접근성은 굉장히 좋아요. 올드타운 안에 있어 해변부터 슈퍼마켓, 식당, 바 등 다 모두 가까운 곳에 있고 쇼핑할 수 있는 상점들도 모두 인근에 있어요! 그러나 바로 앞에 바가 늦게까지 해 밤에 조금 시끄럽습니다. 방도 깨끗해요!
Great location, wonderful apartment

The apartment in Chiado is absolutely lovely. It's easy to get to from the metro and well positioned in terms of the city's amenities. Despite arriving late, we had a lovely welcome from Antonio. He showed us how everything worked and we were very happy that he left us a bottle of wine! The apartment is very well appointed, beautifully lit and very stylish. It was a lovely haven after a day out enjoying all that the wonderful city of Lisbon has to offer. We will definitely be back.

We had a great time in lovely lisbon. Great location, lively area, good views are only a close walk away and train station is very close. We were delighted with the air b&b. It was exactly like shown in the images. Bring comfortable shoes-there's plenty of walking to be done.

This is a spectacular find if your goal in Lisbon is to be exploring all the time. It is poshly decorated with tons of amenities including, cooktop stove, washing/drying machine, microwave, dishwasher, and Wifi. It is in a lively neighborhood, so if you are younger and into nightlife, the bars downstairs attract a wide array of young folk to interact with. One might think it could be noisy, but the fact that it is on the 4th floor prevents most of the noise from the street. The team of hosts take great care to be communicative and add to your trip, they even left us a bottle of wine as a welcome gift!
A lovely comfortable apartment. Pedro's team did everything to make our stay as good as possible. Steep steps helped worked off all the lovely local food.

Loft muito aconchegante! Limpo e moderno, possui vários eletrodomésticos que auxiliam nas tarefas diárias. Atendimento da equipe Chiado Loft rápida e todos muito atenciosos ! Tivemos um pequeno problema com o manuseio da máquina de lavar louças e prontamente o Antônio nos auxiliou e foi até o apartamento ver o que havia ocorrido para tomar as providências necessárias. Cama e chuveiro bastante agradável. A localização é excelente, bem próximo do metrô, dos bancos e do centro comercial do Chiado, o único ponto a citar é a grande movimentação da rua que causa barulho noturno, mas nada que impeça o sono... apenas é necessário deixar as janelas fechadas e talvez colocar uma música ambiente para "camuflar" algum barulho que possa incomodar e a escada que realmente é difícil de subir com malas grandes, mas vale a pena o esforço!!! Com certeza voltaríamos a fechar negócio com Pedro !!!
Wer die Nächte durchmachen möchte ist hier am besten Platz der Stadt positioniert. Tolle Ecke mit allm was dazu gehört. Für Frühschäfer nicht geeignet.
쑈퐈 날갔어욥 안쟈이떠떠니 뻘래 물료또욥 찜찜해뜨욥 흐규흐규 빼드뻐그 가타욥 그게 취명쩍이여욥 .... 깨끗은해뚜여... 리스본 예쁜 도십니다
Cet appartement est un vraiment très joli et très agréable. Ce fût un magnifique séjour

O apartamento é bem localizado, ideal para 02 pessoas, equipado com todos os utensílios básicos. O prédio não possui elevador, não recomendaria para pessoas com dificuldades em subir escadas. Com certeza, voltaria a alugar este apartamento.

This place deserves six stars. Fully renovated, feels like a luxury hotel, but with the coziness of an apartment. I wish my bathroom was as nice as the one they have. They took great care of the small things, leaving oranges for fresh juice in the morning, coffee pods for a couple days of espresso, and chocolates by the bed. The location is great, close to everything.
Two things to be aware of: it is on a noisy street, and that noise comes in. If you really need a quite house, this might not be the one for you. It's also a 4th floor walk-up. We didn't have a problem with either, and I'd stay here again in a heartbeat.

Logement conforme au descriptif
Quartier animé mais sans aucune gêne pour nous
Accueil parfait
Tres cosi

Nous sommes restées 3 jours à Lisbonne avec ma sœur chez Pedro, l'appartement est super bien entretenu, très bien situé, plein de charme au cœur du quartier des restaurants, bars et des funiculaires de la vieille ville.
Pedro nous a accueilli, nous a recommandé de supers adresses de restaurants, bars et nous a permis de laisser nos bagages dans l'appartement même après l'avoir rendu. Une superbe expérience, une ville Geniale, un temps de rêve en plein mois de janvier et un appartement très chaleureux. Bref nous avons adorer lisbonne et avons hâte de revenir.

Pedro and his team blew us away with their hospitality, professionalism, and attention to detail. Their apartment is beautifully designed, very well-equipped, and in a fantastic location. The bed is spacious and really comfortable, as is the ample sitting room. Overall, this was possibly the best experience we've had on Airbnb, and we can wholeheartedly recommend this team.

Bon emplacement car central.
L appartement est fonctionnel et tres bien décoré ! La petite vue de la fenêtre est vraiment sympa.
La communication avec les hotes en charge du logement est de qualité. RAS.
Attention toutefois , l appartement est situé au dessus de plusieurs bar ,il ya du bruit la nuit prevoyez des bouchons d'oreilles si vous etes sensible au bruit. l immeuble est également mal insonorisé, vous êtes prévenu.

If you are looking for a safe and beautiful, centrally-located place in Lisbon,Portugal! THIS IS THE ONE! This studio is gorgeous and even more eye-pleasing in person. The wine, chocolate, and welcome note was a nice little touch.  The bed and couch are very comfortable; The  TV was easy to operate . Also able to wash my clothes before leaving. The Apartment is very clean and well designed. You are near a super market and quick easy walk to Chiado and Barrio Alto which makes for great food options at your door steps, as well as shopping options. At night the holidays lights are gorgeous! The view down the street of the tram running up/down is iconic.  It is located on a higher floor so be mindful when going up/down stairs with luggage and/or high healed shoes(ladies), because there is no elevator/lift. When we needed a place to print tickets Antonio provided with a printer shop that was literally down the street. Stay with Chiado Studio Lofts...You will not be disappointed. They have Prompt, Courteous , and Professional Service. Exemplary! Thanks again for making my stay in Portugal Memorable.

위치가 너무 좋아요! 28번 트램을 바로 앞에서 탈수 있습니다! 호스트도 친절했고 잘 갖춰진 집이예요. 그렇지만 5층인데 엘레베이터가 없어서 체크인 체크아웃때 좀 힘들었어요. 그리고 지내는 동안 위층 발자국 소리나 이웃들이 계단 이용하는 소리가 너무 잘 들려서 예민하신분들은 참고하셔야겠어요. 그리고 옆건물에 바가 있어서 늦은 시간까지 시끄러우니 조용한집을 원하시는 분들은 참고하세요.

What a fantastic apartment located in the heart of Lisbon. Very comfortable and Antonio was great with communication and welcoming us!. Highly recommend this apartment as a perfect spot to base yourself to explore the beauty that is Lisbon!
Gorgeous studio in an absolutely fantastic location. Gonçalo was super helpful and really friendly. We can't wait to come back and explore Lisbon some more and would definitely stay here again!
Simply wonderful. Great location!

We loved staying in this apartment.  If had everything we needed and was central to everything.  Check-in was seamless and our host was even waiting for us outside when we arrived.  He was very responsive to our questions.   The welcome bottle of port and chocolates was a lovely touch.  I would definitely recommend.

You should just stay here when you visit Lisbon!  I've been traveling for months, staying mostly in Airbnbs, in Europe and this is one of the best places I've stayed at!  Great value for the money and you're on a tourist attraction street (though it's not noisy  because of this actually).  Place is clean, nice, spacious, and has a nice feel to it.  Only thing worth pointing out is the stairs, but they really aren't very hard to walk up at all.

Great stay! The room was exactly as advertised, very comfortable, clean, and stylishly decorated. The location was right in the center of the city, very easy to get around. And the team was extremely accommodating of our late-night arrival. Great price as well. Highly recommend!

Hosts were lovely! There was a bit of miscommunication upon our arrival so they arrived a bit late to meet us, but more than made up for it by bringing some pastéis with them as a welcome gift. Quickly walked us through the studio and told us everything we need to know about the apartment and neighborhood. Also gave us recommendations on where to eat, what to do and where to go out. The Studio is beautiful, looks exactly as pictured and the neighborhood was perfect. Steps away from Bairro Alto neighborhood (if you are interested in going out) but also to Time Out Market and other desirable areas. It can be a bit loud at night, as the street has a few bars and people hanging outside but it didn't bother us at all (we barely heard anything). Would definitely consider again on a future trip!

I stayed with my parents for two days.This room was very comfortable!The view from the window was also great.
I want to stay here again!

All was excellent: the reception and explanation of how to use the apartment, the equipment, the coffee, location of the apartment and the written tips on what to do in the city.
Congratulations! We are planning to visit Lisbon and this apartment soon again!

Very comfortable and stylish studio in a great location. Fast efficient communication with the host. Lots of local restaurants and sights including funicular stops right outside the front door. Very well equipped apartment. We had a great stay. Thank you.

We had a great few nights at Pedro's apartment! The location is amazing, right in the middle of the busy barrio alto, but tucked away onto a side street. There's a lot of night life right below the apartment, but with the windows closed, it was very quiet and there were no problems. The apartment was very clean and bright, and had everything we needed. Pedro and his team were also very responsive to any questions we had, and gave us great recommendations. Thanks again!
Just great

Einfach super Unterkunft im Herzen der Stadt. Die Partymeile direkt unter der Wohnung, wovon man aber dank der super Fenster nichts hört. Unser Gastgeber war sehr freundlich, der Kontakt verlief super einfach und die Wohnung hatte alles, was man braucht. Daumen hoch!

We had a great stay in this apartment, the location was perfect, it's right in the city centre with lots of things to do and see. There's great night life on the street below and the windows in the apartment block the noise. We would definitely stay there again :)
I had great time at Lisobon. Wifi worked well, well located, nice welcoming! Staying here made first Airbnb perfect

Das Apartment ist perfekt gelegen, mitten in der Altstadt. Wir wurden freundlich empfangen und konnten jederzeit Kontakt zu Pedro und seinem Team aufnehmen.
Das Apartment war sehr sauber. Es ist modern eingerichtet, komfortabel und gut geeignet für 3 Personen. Wir empfehlen das Apartment gern weiter.
Vielen Dank an Pedro und sein Team.
Awesome location, cozy flat & great people! Would love to come back!
Pedro and staff were great and the loft is beautiful, ideally located and well equipped.  Would go back tomorrow.
Great neighborhood and very accommodating host. Much nicer studio than we bargained for, would definitely rent again.

The place is exactly like the pics, very trendy, clean and cosy. When we were checking in I mentioned I might need an iron at some point so they efficiently brought one an hour later. The location is perfect just 2 mins away from Plaça Luis de Camoes. The street is just the coolest, you'll find people taking pics there all time, not overwhelming tho! I strongly recommend it and if I ever get back to Lisbon I'll definetely be staying there again :)
This a great place to stay! It is close to everything, all modern and has the best bed I have ever slept in!
Great place and amazing hospitality from Pedro! Would highly recommend to anyone.

We loved this place. We actually found it was even nicer than in the pictures (and the pics are fantastic!). Would absolutely stay here again. It was in a great location and they gave us easy and clear directions for getting there. We arrived early and were still able to check in. The guys were super responsive and quick whenever we had questions. The apartment is very well appointed with everything you need. Would absolutely stay here again. Loved it!

Pedro and team are the nicest most helpful people you'll ever meet! Perfect location - can't get better. Everything we wanted to see or eat was right here or easily accessible. The stairs up are a bit rough after a day of walking hills, but so worth it. This place may even be better than photos and I'd stay again in a heartbeat. They even go the extra mile and provide detergent for the washing machine and a great list of restaurant recommendations. Go get lost in this beautiful city and call this place home!

Pedro met us at check-in and he has very patient despite our 2 hour late arrival due to flight delays. The apartment is gorgeous and the AC was great! The neighborhood is quite charming and on a very happening street. There are tourists that stop to capture picture of the tram, and in the evening there are many bar patrons sitting on the steps. It's very young and hip, maybe too noisy for a family. For us it was fun!

Absolutely stunning space. Beautifully decorated and stocked with every amenity, dish, and glass you could ask for during your stay. The hosts met us promptly and provided a map, restaurant guide, and instructions for the appliances. The location of the studio is ideal. Easy access to Baixa-Chiado metro stop and walking distance to Príncipe Real and the waterfront.

The apartment worked well for us since we were there one night only and it had everything we needed but the building's common area really needs updating. The stairway up to the 3rd floor is difficult to navigate w/ luggage; extremely steep and very narrow.

We stayed in Lisbon for a week in August. When we arrived, Luis was already waiting for us and introduced us to the apartment. He also gave us some advise which restaurants we should visit.
Our first impression was that everything was very new and well constructed. The apartment is quite small but the interior design really makes the most of it, so that it doesn't feel small at all. You could sense that someone was very passionate about decorating the place to make it perfectly cozy. The selection of furniture couldn't be better.
As there is only one big room you don't feel separated in different rooms which was perfect for only two people.
The location was perfect as well; pretty close to the centre, right next to the cable car but inside of the apartment you've got the feeling like there is no one else in Lisbon.
All in all we have literally nothing negative to say about the apartment or the host because he made our stay unbelievably enjoyable.
We will definitely stay there again the next time.
Thank you very much
Daniella & Nikola

Our host greeted us right on time. The apartment is in an amazing location, in the heart of downtown Lisbon! It's right near the big food market, and surrounded by so many delicious bakeries. The hosts greeted us with a small bottle of wine, small chocolates and a list of suggestions for places to go/eat. The apartment was so nice and clean - we especially loved how the bathroom was finished! Would highly recommend staying here.

Merci pour les marques de bienvenue ( bouteille de vin, ensemble de dépannage pour la vinaigrette, capsules de café  expresso, petit mot d'accueil, oranges à jus, adresses utiles, et explications in vivo du studio. Le logement est très bien équipé, propre et climatisé. Et quel quartier: proche de tout! Nous nous y sommes sentis vraiment bien. Inoubliable . Je le recommande sans hésiter.

Escaliers difficiles.
Salle de bain petite
Espace réduit autour du lit

We loved our accommodation in Lisbon.  It was a great spot. Local bars and eateries all walking distance.  We had one the icon lisbon trams right outside our door step. Perfect picture opportunity!!! The place was clean and tidy with everything you needed for your stay.  The host was very accommodating and suggested some great places to eat. We would definitely stay there again!
El apartamento es perfecto para dos. Muy limpio y en ubicación perfecta para patear Lisboa. Pedro ha sido muy amable en todo momento. Para repetir!

Pedro's apartment was absolutely beautiful! It was spotlessly clean, we had a great welcome and even a bottle of white wine in the fridge :-)
The list of Lisbon recommendations was an excellent touch! We went to the Time Out market recommended to us and that was fantastic.
I would highlight recommend this stylish and well-situated apartment.
Absolut klasse. Alles hat prima geklappt, Pedro und Team sind jederzeit hilfsbereit und sehr freundlich. Jederzeit wieder. Vielen Dank!

Ich schliesse mich den anderen Kritiken gerne an. Die Unterkunft ist perfekt für einen Aufenthalt. Die Gegend war super und sehr belebt.  So bekamen wir einen guten Eindruck der Stadt. Der ideale Ausgangspunkt um alles gut erreichen zu können. Auch die Ausstattung der Wohnung lies keine Wünsche offen. Selbst eine Bluetooth-Mini-Stereoanlage war vorhanden. Für uns war es die perfekte Mischung!
Superb location!

Our stay in Lisbon at the Chiado loft was lovely. Antonio, Pedro, and team did a beautiful job creating a modern space with all the comforts of home, and still a touch of old world charm.

Upon arriving, Antonio walked us through all available amenities, and even shared a list of local restaurants! We can't thank the team enough for their thoughtful recommendations, and also for the delightful bottle of wine!

We simply had a wonderful time-- thank you for everything!
Perfect apartment in Lisbon! Great location, great amenities, great communication with the host, very clean, plenty of space and A/C!  Can't beat it, and would definitely stay here again!

Anne and I had a wonderful time staying at Chaido Loft 5. Luis promptly met us on time to let us in the apartment. Pedro and his team go above and beyond for creating a welcoming and comfortable environment. The loft is well equipped, clean and close to all the near by attractions for ultimate convenience. Thanks for making our stay so wonderful!

A great place to stay. The apartment is very modern, with good quality furnishings and appliances. We didn't cook, but appreciated touches like the coffee machine and orange juicer. Nice bathroom too.
The location is great, right in the middle of bars, restaurants and places to grab a pastry for breakfast, plus convenience shops very close by. The street is a bit of a party area at the weekend, but we didn't mind that at all, and it wasn't too noisy once indoors.
Short walk to the metro, train station and the Time Out food market (amazing place!). Cheap to get to by taxi from the airport.
Communication with the host was very good - our flight time was changed but it wasn't an issue. Good clear directions on how to get the the apartment too.
We had a brilliant long weekend in Lisbon and this was the perfect city chic crash pad for us.

We stayed in Pedro's apartment for 6 nights and loved our stay. The apartment is just as it presents in the photos. Spacious and light although compact and fine for 2 people. The location is excellent, with the Bica tram literally outside the window. Also trams and metro minutes away. The neighbourhood itself is lively, with several bars and cafes just outside the front door. Little supermarkets and cake shops a plenty. Just a great vibe. We especially enjoyed a Fado concert which plays every night at Fado in Chiado Thanks to Pedro we had a great stay. Antonio was also very obliging and provided us with a second set of keys. The only small thing lacking is an iron & ironing board, but not really essential. Also, the windows were great and blocked most of the street noise. We would highly recommend Pedro's apartment,
Linda
It's a wonderful place - very stylish decor and have everything you would need for your stay! It's also on the Tram 28 line - which makes it very easy to get around to the touristic spots.
Lovely place, excellent location, highly recommended!

Amazing location and space, I could not have asked for me. Very responsive and even left some wine for me! If I'm in Lisbon again, which I plan to do. I will be staying at this location. Very clean and modern and just what you need on vacation.
The flat is just perfect! It it in one of the most beautiful streets, wonderful decorated and well organised team. We definitely come back!

Nous avons été très bien accueillis par Antonio à notre arrivée.
L'appartement était très confortable, situé dans un quartier central et très agréable de Lisbonne. Parfait pour découvrir Lisbonne.

Wir wurden absolut freundschaftlich empfangen und waren mehr als zufrieden mit dem Loft.
