Es ist alles vorhanden, was man benötigt und die vielen Details schenken der Unterkunft einen unverwechselbaren Charme. Die Lage der Unterkunft ist ein perfekter Ausgangspunkt, um Lissabon zu erkunden. Danke für den Wein zur Begrüßung. LG C&J
Great apartment on one of the most photographed streets in Lisbon. Exactly like the photos, perfect for two people and the place has everything you need.

Check in is at 3.00pm however,Antonio was waiting for us at 1.30pm,which worked perfect for us.
After friendly welcome, he briefly explained few simple rules for LOFT "5". The studio seems to be little smaller in reality as it appears on the pictures.Saying that ,I don't mean it is small.It is just perfect for single person or two people.
Tastefully decorated,kitchen fully equipped with everything you need.Beautiful marble washroom,spacious living room area and sleeping section in the back of the room.Bottle of wine and fresh oranges waiting for us was another nice gesture of the host.
Antonio gave us his number and told us to call him anytime in case we need something (we never did, everything worked out perfectly).The street,Rua da Bica,has plenty of small bars,which were crowded on Saturday night and a little noisy till late hours on Saturday night.The studio has sound proof sealed windows; however,the noise was still a little noticeable even with the windows closed.This happened only on Saturday,the rest of the week it was quiet.
I am mentioning this in case someone is looking for a quiet place.
The location??? I don't think you can wish for a better one.
The Metro is a 10 minute walking distance.Bica funicular is 3 steps from main entrance to the studio.Tram 28 is 30 steps from the main entrance.
Cais do Sodre train station? Walk down the Rua da Bica de Duarto Belo, 10 min, (or take the funicular) and station is 5 minutes from bottom of the hill.You have also the tram 15 stop by the train station,if you want to go to Belem.From train station,you can travel to Cascais. Also, don't forget to check out the "Time out" restaurant complex in that area.
Walking towards city from studio,you have Largo the Cameos 5 minutes away,Baixa Chiado metro station next to it,Bairo Alto area ,Santa Justa elevator,Rossio square (and Rossio train station if planning to go to Sintra),Praca de Figueira,Avenue Libertate....all of this no more then 15-20 minutes walking distance from apartment.
Convenient grocery store right on the corner from the studio,and perhaps 5-6 bakeries around the area,where we always bought fresh buns and pastries for breakfast.
If you are planning to cook,the kitchen in studio is fully equipped for that.We used the Nespresso machine couple of times for breakfast,rest of the time we went for breakfast to bakeries around,and for dinner, to countless restaurants all in surrounding area.Trying to think hard if there was something negative about our stay in studio LOFT5.
The only thing I could think of, is no shelf in the shower,so you have to leave the shampoo or soap on the floor while taking a shower.Also it's 4th floor,without elevator (about 48 stairs),which is clearly mentioned in description from Pedro. But this wasn't any problem for us.
If you are looking for a nice, very good location for your stay while in Lisbon, you just found it !

Amazing location, beautiful apartment. Has everything you might need. The hosts were extremely responsive and very helpful, even organised us a taxi back to the airport. Highly recommended! We would love to return.

Goed contact vooraf.
Heldere informatie over de woning.

Appartement très propre et super bien équipé.
Des petites attentions bien agréables lors de notre arrivée.
Pedro et son équipe sont très disponibles et sympathiques
Nous recommandons sans aucun problème

Great place to stay in Lisbon - close to all of the bars and restaurants and within walking distance of all the major tourist attractions.

The apartment itself is ideal for a couple and the well designed layout is both practical and stylish.

Communication was superb and everything ran extremely smoothly, would highly recommend this apartment if you are lucky enough to find it available.

We surely recommend the Chadio loft of Pedro, Antonio and Luis.
It's exactly like on the pictures, the location is excellent ( close to the tram, metro and train station ), a supermarket at the corner of the street, nice view, very calm, a very handy list with addresses to eat and drink, a map, very well received by Antonio, and the team even left a bottle of wine in the fridge for our arrival.

If we return to Lisbon, we surely contact them again. Thank you guys!

Our stay in Lisbon was absolutely perfect. The location was very central and great for our stay, we walked everywhere for the majority but it is also very close to the metro and easy to get taxi's outside the apartment. We loved all the recommendations given and had some really great dinners during our stay that made our trip even better. The apartment is spacious, clean and comfortable and I would highly recommend it. If we come back to Lisbon we could only hope we could stay in this awesome spot again. Thank you for hosting us!
beautiful apartement in center of old town, everything was fine, thank you.

Perfecto. El apartamento esta situado en pleno centro de Lisboa, lo cual permite hacer practicamente todas las visitas a pie. Muy bien conectado del aeropuerto y en general hacia cualquier transporte: tranvia, metro, estacion (ideal para visitar los alrededores : Belem, Sintra..) Esta decorado con mucho gusto y con todas las comodidades y pequenos electrodomesticos para sentirse como en casa. Pedro y su equipo son grandes profesionales, amabilidad, puntualidad y un millar de atenciones tanto de bienvenida como de partida. Recomiendo 100%!

Perfection! In lovely Chiado...on an awesome steep street with a Cable Car line that people stop to take pictures of.  Incredible character and charm followed by a greeting from the host, who carried my very heavy suitcase upstairs for me. Wine and fruit, as well as Chocolates on the pillow...I was travelling solo, but this could potentially be a romantic get-away. It is sleek, crisp and clean and classy, as was the host who provided me with everything I needed in about 5 minutes...then left me to enjoy...Superb!
We had a fantastic stay - great location, beautiful studio apartment and great service from our host who couldn't do enough for us. Would really recommend it!

We stayed in the studio on the fourth floor of a building without an elevator, which was not a problem. All contact prior to our visit was dealt with very promptly and efficiently. We were allowed to check in early at 1.30pm and were met on our arrival by a very nice young man, whose name I have forgotten! He explained how things work etc. The studio is beautifully decorated in a contemporary style and was spotlessly clean. The bed was comfortable and the shower fantastic. The huge settees were very welcome after a day in the city. The situation of the studio is amazing, but there can be street noise at night. Antonio and Pedro could not have been more efficient and helpful when we needed to contact them during our stay. So it's a big thumbs up from us for the studio, Antonio and Pedro and beautiful Lisbon. We'll be back!

Nous avons été très bien accueilli le studio loft est très bien agencé , escalier un peu raide pour ceux qui ont peu de jambes situé en plein centre historique cette endroit permet de visiter une grande partie de la ville à pied et vous fera profiter de sa vie nocturne sans trop se déplacer . Je recommande

The apartment was great: location is awesome, the flat itself is very clean and stylish, has everything needed. We checked in easily and the hosts were very nice to leave a detailed instruction of where to go out:) would definitely recommend

We could not have asked for a better place to stay!! This apartment was just like the pictures. It was beautiful, clean, and an amazing location!!! If your coming to Lisbon, and your searching on Airbnb, stop now and book an apartment from these guys. The attention to detail they offer is #1! Antonio even stopped by in person to make sure we were ok. When staying here you can walk almost everywhere and your very close to amazing parks with spectacular views and exceptional places to shop and eat. I will be back next year for a month!!!
The host is great!
It was a great flat and in a wonderful location!
Lovely studio - great location and everything we needed on our doorstep!
Great place! Awesome location in the middle of the city. Internet worked great and we loved the couch. Will definitely come back.

Wir hatten eine tolle Zeit in Pedros "Loft 5 - The Studio! Die Innenausstattung ist sehr gut durchdacht und erinnert eher an ein Luxushotel. Alles war sauber und die Küche ist für 4 Tage schon mehr als ausreichend ausgestattet. Für zwei bis drei Personen ist der Ort perfekt. Die Lage ist auch großartig. Alle wichtigen Aktivitäten wie Nachtleben, Einkaufen, Straßenbahn und Altstadtviertel liegen in unmittelbarer Nähe, so dass wir kaum noch öffentliche Verkehrsmittel benutzten. Pedros Mitarbeiter war sehr freundlich und die Schlüsselübergabe hat auch gut geklappt. Toller Gastgeber, tolles Studio und eine großartige Stadt! Sehr empfehlenswert!

The team has welcomed us perfectly. Great hospitality, room nice, bathroom nice. Neighborhood also nice, quit busy though, but nice.
Unfortunately the WiFi was sometimes bad, but they had a backup and it was working okay, not good but okay.

Overall, pleasant stay and great guys!

Hemos pasado unos días estupendos en esta casa. António ha estado siempre atento a nuestros requerimientos, respondiendo con rapidez y eficacia. La ubicación de la vivienda es magnífica, y perfectamente insonorizada (lo que es de agradecer, ya que el barrio es un poco ruidoso). Está perfectamente equipada y es muy cómoda. Absolutamente recomendable.

We enjoyed the studio very much.  Really nicely styled, good shower, and welcoming hosts.  Great location near many cool places.  Only issue we had was one day the internet was pretty spotty, but otherwise had no complaints about the apartment.
I was welcomed wonderfully by the very attentive and detail-prone hosts. The loft is just beautiful, and perfectly located for all the attractions downtown Lisbon. Highly recommendable!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay here. The location is perfect - very central and on a very picturesque street. The studio itself didn't disappoint either - very cosy (we visited in winter), great size for two and with good quality fittings. The team were very helpful and attentive throughout the stay. We did have problems with the wifi signal which would be the only fault I could find!
Awesome host, beautiful apartment in city center!
A very nice apartment in a great location. Our host was helpful and very easy to reach out. Perfect !

Nos sorprende much la habitación, es demasiada buena!  Y el dueño es muy majo, hemos roto una botella, y check out un poco tarde, Pedro nos acordó, y no nos pidió nada de compensación.  Si tenemos otra visita a Lisboa, seguramente volvamos al apartamento de Pedro.
Mitten im Herzen Lissabons ein helles geschmackvoll eingerichtetes Studio. Wir fühlten uns auf Anhieb wohl. Ich kann es nur empfehlen.

I cannot say enough about this awesome apartment! I loved it so much I wanted to move in! My boyfriend and I stayed for 3 nights in late December. The apartment has everything you could possibly need. Great location, fully equipped kitchen, comfortable bed, beautiful bathroom. I will always stay in this apartment when I am in Lisbon!

Fabolous apartment, great area, fantastic host, who came by at Christmas with a present: Wine and cake.
Can honestly renommend. Thank you!

We had a wonderful stay at Chiado Loft 5 and couldn't have asked for a better host. Even though our flight arrived very late, Pedro was there to check us in and provided us with some great recommendations for restaurants and bars nearby. The apartment was spotless and very well equipped and we really appreciated the thoughtful little things the team had arranged for us: bottle of wine in the fridge, coffee, oranges to make some fresh juice in the morning, recommendations... The location was perfect, right in the centre of the Bairro Alto, and we walked everywhere the whole weekend. Great place, we would definitely come back!

This place is awesome! Highly recommended.
Great location, in the heart of the city, the loft is perfect for spending few days in Lisboa.
Pedro will welcome you in the most perfect way! He knows the city well, and has a great list of places to visit, eat, chill.

Top flat, Top host, Top city.

L'appartamento é molto carino, più piccolo di come appare in foto, l'abbiamo trovato pulito e ordinato, con tutti i comfort necessari, anche se essendo in un palazzo antico bisogna prestare attenzione con l'uso dell'elettricità (ma è assolutamente gestibile). È un quarto piano con scale ripide e senza ascensore, da precisare per chi ha diverse valigie.
La posizione è ottima, a piedi è possibile raggiungere sia la metro, che la maggior parte delle attrazioni turistiche, vi sono vari ristoranti e un supermercato proprio vicino casa.
Pedro é stato molto flessibile con l'orario di check-in avendolo noi modificato all'ultimo.
Lo consigliamo per tutti i motivi detti sopra.

The apartment is very well located. You can see from the window the Bica Elevator, that you my find in the post cards. It clean and exactly as shown in photos and described. We were welcomed by Luis, who is very gentile and made us feel comfortable. The kitchen small but very well equipped and you have every thin you need.
We were welcomed with a bottle of wine, oranges and chocolates, thank you guys.
I would strongly recommend for a couple.
fabulous appartement! luis, our host, was very friendly and helped us with every question we had. very clean and just like on the pictures, i totally recommend it!

The apartment is located very centrally - walking distance from all the places you would like to visit in Lisbon. Apartment is presented and designed in a very good way, with new equipment in the kitchen and bathroom; with practical and stylish layout. Pedro and his team are looking really well after their tenants and are ready to go extra mile to help you with any additional requests. We were really happy there and will stay there once again when we come back to Lisbon!

Pedro wasn't there to meet me but he sent his assistant to receive us. The apartment is very well located, just about 8mins to the baxia chiado station, and there is just a minimart round the corner of the apartment which is great if you intend to make breakfast. There is also a famous market nearby where you can have dinner in a foodcourt style setting.
The apartment itself looks huge in picture, but looked slightly smaller when we were there, but there were 5 of us so it was a bit crammed, so 2 or 3 pax would be the ideal size. However. Pedro was very accommodating and even prepared mattress for us because we ran out of space to sleep. The apartment is located on level 4, which is probably the worst part considering we had heavy luggages. So lugging them up the steep narrow stairs was certainly not easy. But once you get past it, there was really nothing much to complain about the apartment.
Overall it was a fantastic experience and the location couldn't be any better. Definitely recommend if you are travelling in small groups

Logement propre fonctionnel bien décoré idéal pour 2 personnes.
Bien placé attention au bruit le quartier est annimé, le double vitrage est efficace, et en cas de chaleur là clim est là...
L'équipement est complet, y compris un module boose.
L'accueil est parfait.
Stayed for 2 nights and it's really a nice & cozy apartment. Coffee machine is awesome:).

We had a great time in Pedro´s apartment. In reality it looked as nice as on the photo´s and we felt very comfortable there. The location is perfect for a stay in Lisbon - everything is reachable on foot. We can fully recommend a stay :).

This was my first time in Lisbon and I fell in Love with this Beautiful City!The Studio is stunning  with great location close to lots of restaurants , shops and most important transportation. Only a 5 minute walk to the metro station. The host was very friendly he even allowed me to check in acouple hours earlier then my normal check in time.Im very thankful that he was able to accomodate me otherwise i would of been walking around the city with my heavy luggage. He had also left a list of local restaurants and atractions that were helpful to us. I couldnt have made a better choice! I definitely recommend Chiado Loft to anyone who is looking to spend sometime in lisbon.

Beautiful apartment in the centre of Lisbon. It is near all the bars and restaurants, however the apartment itself is very quiet. When we arrived it was clean and the owners provided little local treats and suggestions where to eat, drink etc. Thank you for this wonderful place to stay, I would highly recommend this place for a perfect trip to Lisbon.
房子的位置实在是太好了！老城区，楼下就是电车景点，而且还不吵闹。过街就是好吃的餐馆。房东很细致，回复也很快，沟通很愉快！真的值得推荐！

The apartment in Lisbon was wonderful. It was in a central location with many bars nearby. Someone met us at the loft and explained all the ins and outs as well as giving us a map and suggestions for places to eat. We don't suggest driving into Lisbon, it can get a little chaotic! We loved using the metro and would advise anyone coming into the centre to use public transport. Thank you guys for your hospitality!
It was perfect! Super cozy and very clean! Perfect stay in lisbon!! Would definitely come back back!
We had a very nice time in Lissabon. The apparent is great and very well located. pedro and colleagues we very friendly and helpful.

Lovely bijou apartment, ideal for a couple, in a bustling and lively district very close to the centre of Lisbon.

The apartment was clean and well presented when we arrived, and the kitchen is very well equipped with everything you could need including such items as a microwave, an electric juicer, and an espresso machine. A particular highlight of the apartment is the shower, which is just fantastic!!!!!

Also provided is an excellent Bose bluetooth speaker which we streamed lots of Fado music to during our stay to get us in the mood.

There's a handy supermarket just around the corner to top up provisions, the funicular tram stops right outside the apartment, and the windows offer a view over the Tagus estuary and to the statue of Christ on the other bank.

Loads of cafes, bars and restaurants are just a short walk away as the district is the heart of Lisbon nightlife. However, the double glazed windows ensure that the apartment is quiet however much noise and bustle there is outside.

All in all an excellent base for a city break in Lisbon. I would highly recommend this apartment.
Everything we expected of the loft came true and more. Absolute  recommended when you want to stay in Lisbon.
Same excellence as last visit, and early check in was accommodated!

My boyfriend and I had a fantastic stay at this apartment in Lisbon. The location was fantastic, near to all the bars and restaurants, perfect for a couple or friends wanting to experience the night life in Lisbon. The hosts were lovely pulling out all the stops to make sure that we had a good stay, they gave us a bottle of wine, some fruit, pasta, jam and coffee on arrival. We would love to stay at the apartment again if we ever returned to Lisbon and would recommend highly to anyone travelling to Lisbon. A thoroughly enjoyable experience, thank you!

Après diverses locations à travers l'Europe, je peux dire que l'appartement de Pedro a été de loin le mieux, car il n'y a absolument rien à redire! Le temps d'un week-end avec mon fils et tous les 2 sommes repartis sous le charme du Studio! Tout parfait à tous les niveaux: situation dans le Chiado de Lisbonne fabuleuse. Accueil des hôtes au top, superbes petits détails (café Nespresso, oranges pour petit déj, bouteille vin blanc de bienvenue..). Appartement impecable, avec tout le confort et plus. Décoration d'un goût extrême. Bref... à mon avis, imposible de trouver mieux. Je retournerais c'est sûr! J'adore la ville de Lisbonne et je resigne pour ce petit studio enchanteur!
Ideal location, exactly as pictured, spotlessly clean!  The nespresso and wine were so appreciated.  We look forward to returning!

my girlfriend and i stayed at pedro place for the week. we both had a fantastic time in portugal. everything down to the house.. food and our adventures along the way.
pedro waited for us graciously upstairs till wr arrived. we were about an hour late into our schedule time but he was still there happy and helpful. gave us a tour.. set us up with our surroundings and even helped us booked a taxi for a 5am arrival to the airport. my only downside to this would be the 4 flights of stairs.. but seriously the apartment is truly worth every step.
in the final 3 nights we were there who ever was staying above us was fairly noisy but other then that everything was wonderful!
thank you pedro!

Fantasic stay in Lisbon.  The apartment was amazing, immaculate inside and perfect location to explore the city. Antonio couldn't have been more helpful, waiting for us to arrive when our flight was delayed and booking us a taxi to get us to the airport when we left.

Accoglienza calorosa da parte di Antonio, che ci ha riservato alcuni regali di benvenuto. L'appartamento confortevole con cucina ben organizzata con piastre ad induzione, lavastoviglie, lavasciuga e climatizzatore per un ottimo comfort. Bagno comodo ed essenziale con doccia molto spaziosa, la vista molto caratteristica dalla finestra che mostra uno scorcio della vita lisbonese. Ubicata in centro città molto comoda per la vita notturna data la vicinanza ai vicoli della movida e ai ristoranti, comodo per i mezzi di trasporto (tram 28 sotto casa e metropolitana a 5 minuti).
Grazie a Pedro e Antonio per l'ospitalità!
The Loft is an amazing studio with a beautiful decoration and a great location. Perfect for a romantic stay! Thank you for all the little attentions as well :)

I cannot say enough good things about our experience at the Chiado Loft 5 "The Studio." After a long flight, Luis gleefully met us at the top of the staircase and helped us inside. The apartment itself is beautiful and outfitted with everything you could possibly need. Luis was friendly, knowledgable, and happy to help answer any of our questions. The location can't be beat. You are located in the thick of it, but just enough on the outskirts that noise won't bother you at night. We enjoyed our time tremendously, just walking around the city for hours taking it all in. We would've been happy to stay even longer and plan on returning in the future. Thank you for making our experience so memorable!

We arrived earlier to Lisbon than check in and were very happy to be allowed to drop off our bags before our check in time. We were welcomed with little chocolates and given all the instructions we needed. The location was great as we were able to walk everywhere and the hosts left a list of great places to eat in Lisbon. Most importantly the apartment was very clean! Thanks so much Pedro, Antonio and team!

Wonderful Apartement. Everything there what you need and you are on the middle of everywhere.Pedro and his team are very nice and helpful in all belongings.
We will come again.

If you are thinking about booking AirB&B while in Lisbon, get this one! This apartment is literally perfect. It is an exceptional location on one of the most famous streets in Lisbon. The pictures represent the listing perfectly. It is extremely clean and very spacious. Pedro left the apartment with very clear instructions on how to use everything (dishwasher, washing machine, etc) and provided soaps for all. They also left a laminated map of the area and suggestions of restaurants and bars. There was also a sweet note with chocolates and small bottle of wine. There is also an espresso machine with coffee. The couches in the apartment are huge and super comfortable. The bathroom is exquisite and has a wonderful shower. Pedro was very easy to meet and his directions to the apartment were spot on. This is the best AirB&B I've stayed in and would recommend it to anyone. Thank you so much for making our time in Lisbon so memorable!
Superb location, fantastic design and very nice host.
We had a great time. The apartment was very clean, represented well by the photos. We found the location perfect - very easy to get around the city. Thank you!
Great new studio with the aircon right in a central location. Sleeps 3 comfortably. Everything was as described. The host was very helpful, no problems at all and I can highly recommend this place.
Great place and great host, the apartment is really central, close to a lot of cool cafes, bars and restaurants . Highly recommended! A+

Appartement très bien situé et très bien équipé.
Bon accueil à l arrivée.

We had a lovely stay in Pedro and Antonio apartment or was very tastefully decorated and lots of extra details that we enjoyed such as the coffee machine and orange squeezer. Antonio was lovely and greeted us warmly

This studio apartment was perfect for our long weekend in Lisbon. Such a fun neighborhood for a young couple to stay in. Very centrally located, clean, and a great value for the money. Check in and check out were simple and we found many great bars and restaurants within short walking distance from the flat.
Great location. Apartment very clean and modern. Only draw back would be the 4 flights of stairs (although good training for the hilly streets of Lisbon).

Had an absolutely amazing stay. The appartment is perfectly situated in the centre of Lisbon. Directly next to nice little restaurants and bars at night. The interior is smart and comfortable. Everything you need is provided: Internet, TV, Coffee machine, Air Condition and fresh & clean towels. The host was there in person to greet us and explain everything. He even gave us lots of tips what to do and where to eat. All in all a great experience. My first choice when I come back to Lisbon. Thanks to the host for the hospitality!

The Chiado studio was very comfortable, just as shown in the pictures.  Very nice design -- feels like a vacation oasis.  It's on a scenic street that is conveniently located near the Metro and trolleys (including the trolley that will take you to other touristic areas like the Alfama).  Communication with Pedro was easy.  Check in was a few minutes late and initially we were shown to the wrong apartment but it was quickly corrected so no big deal, and otherwise was a stress free check in and out. We would definitely stay again if in Lisbon.

The listing was super accurate, clean and amazing location. Pedro was very helpful with tips around the neighbourhood and on time for the check in. Overall it was a excellent experience staying in this apartment. GRACIAS!

This apartment was excellent - very clean, comfortable, modern and central. It had everything we needed for our stay and was in a great location. The pictures and description of the apartment are accurate.
We would thoroughly recommend this apartment and Pedro, who was a great host - thank you

Pedro was very helpful and easy to communicate with in terms of setting up the reservation and meeting up.  The location is perfect and the loft looks exactly as it appears in the pictures.  There are also lots of nice touches with the kitchen, coffee machine and it is really nice to have both a dishwasher and a washer/dryer.

What a great place! We didn't meet Pedro, but Antonio was there to greet us and was very nice and helpful. The apartment is stylish and really well appointed. Washing machine, functional air conditioning, kitchen, lovely design, and I want to point out how well the windows insulate sound. It was party night in Lisbon, and people were out on the street all night, but you could barely hear anything.

Sehr gute Beschreibung. s
Sehr schöne Wohnung. Unkomplizierte Handhabung.

Convenient,cozy,quiet,and chic.  We really enjoyed staying at your apartment Pedro.  We arrived early and were able to leave our bags while we waited to meet Antonio to check in.  I highly recommend renting this space for a enjoyable stay in a great part of Lisbon.

Nous avons trouvé très facilement l'adresse grâce aux explications très claires de Pedro. Nous avons été accueillis par Antonio, très souriant, parlant peu le français mais le comprenant et nous donnant des explications sur les commodités de l'appartement d'une très bonne façon. Nous regrettons l'absence de Pedro que nous aurions aimés connaître....une autre fois !
Nous avions des petites attentions qui nous ont fait très plaisir, tel le petit mot de bienvenue, bien qu'en anglais, accompagné de 2 chocolats. Des capsules Nespresso , des oranges dans une corbeille, l'accueil est top.
Le logement est conforme aux photos, très clair, très bien agencé, le confort est au rendez-vous. Le logement se trouve dans un quartier très vivant, même la nuit....L'élévador de Bica se trouve au seuil de la porte d'entrée et est une vraie attraction pour les nombreux touristes qui prennent des photos.

3eme loft essayé de Pedro... Et toujours une aussi bonne expérience ! Rien ne manque, la déco, la lumière, espace optimisé, propre, l accueil, la localisation, les équipements... Et la délicate attention à mon arrivée pour ma fidélité :) la prochaine fois je testerai le 4eme loft :)

Really nice and stylish apartment. I can absolutely recommend this place. Perfectly located and it's got all you need for a city trip to Lisbon.
Thanks again for the late check-in, Pedro!

Appartement conforme au photo, très charmant et cosy. Idéal pour un couple.
Très bien équipé, le tramway est devant la porte d'entrée, et le quartier très sympa. A 5 min a pied du Tage et de sa promenade.
Et malgré notre retard à notre arrivé, l'accueil était de qualité.
Merci Pedro

We had an amazing time in Lissabon. Pedro's apartment is very well located, modern, comfortable, well equipped, night life in walking distance...just amazing. Pedro and Antonio are perfect and charming hosts. Thank you very much... we will come back to Lissabon and to Chiado Loft.
Expérience très agréable! rue très mignonne et bien situé ! Appartement propre, bien équipé (même une enceinte bluetooth) .... Rien à redire

The apartment was immaculately finished and presented in a very hand part of town.  We were met by our friendly host and given a quick run through everything. We asked if there was a kettle and although the coffee machine could have provided us with hot water he rushed out and bought us one that afternoon! This is on the street of the Bica Funicular so you can walk down to the fantastic mercado da ribeira for a meal or two without worrying about bookings and then get the funicular back up the hill if you've had a few too many or filled up on chocolate fondant.
Beautiful apartment, perfect location: we loved our stay in Lisboa! The apartment is small but has everything you need for a comfortable stay. From here we walked all around town.
De Loft is niet groot maar smaakvol ingericht, van alle gemakken voorzien en ligt middenin het oude centrum van Lissabon. Een prima logeeradres voor een stedentrip. Leuke gastheren ook!

Excelente apartamento, con una maravillosa decoración y buen gusto.
Todo lo necesario y mucho más de lo que esperabamos.
Super limpio y sin un ruido por la noche, la insonorizacion es formidable, la cama es fantastica.
Muy muy céntrico, con todo a un paso como lugares de interes y sitios donde comer o perderse.
También, muy importante es señalar la excelente atención de Pedro y Antonio durante nuestra estancia, super disponibles y educados.
He tenido la suerte de estar alojado en este apartamento de Pedro y sin ninguna duda lo tendré como primera opción a mi regreso a Lisboa.
Gracias por colaborar a hacer nuestra estancia tan maravillosa.
Un abrazo desde Barcelona.
i loved this apartment. excellent location to explore lisbon from and great for chilling out too. thanks for letting me check in early!  had a great time, highly recommended

Todo perfecto! El apartamento muy buen equipado. Todo lo necesario para pasar tres días fantásticos. La ubicación también inmejorable. Hemos quedado muy contentos. Sin duda repetiríamos!
La atención de Pedro y Antonio fantástica. Ante cualquier duda o pregunta han estado a nuestra disposición.
Apartamento 5 estrellas!!

Pedro's place was wonderful and in a great location. Really beautiful decor. He met us on time and was so friendly. He ran through everything with us really thoroughly and made us feel really welcome. He also recommended some great places to eat. We really appreciated the bowl of oranges for breakfast, the coffee pods, the jams and the little chocolates by the bed - it's the little touches. The place is perfect for two people. We'd recommend it to anyone!

What a great apartment in the centre of Lisbon. There is a small supermarket around the corner and lot's of bakery's. Chiado is a great neighborhood to stay in. At night there are people on the street but the apartment is well isolated and the noise didn't bother me so much. The apartment was just like the photos, perfect! Would definitely recommend to stay here!

We had a wonderful stay in Lissabon! The appartment is amazing and the location is really awesome.
The appartment is pretty small but that was no problem at all! It was clean and had very good atmosphere.
Contact with Pedro before getting in Lissabon went very smooth and we got a warm welcome from Antonio.
I would recommand this appartement to everyone and I will definately come back here the next time I'll go to Lissabon! :-)

We are more than happy with our stay at Rua da Bica! Great apartment right in the middle of Lisbon with a well decorated interior. got everything everything you could wish for. Comfortable couch, hot shower and soundproof windows that makes it quite despite the tram, toursits and night life outside.  Way better than staying at a hotel!

Pedro & Antonio have been remarkable hosts and have made our stay such a pleasant, seamless experience - they provided all the information we needed ahead of our trip and have shown themselves very flexible when we've explained we would arrive quite late in the evening.

At our arrival, we were given a tour of the apartment were everything was perfectly organised, clean and beautifully decorated - the location was ideal, right next to the tram, bars, shops and some of the best bakeries in town.

The flat itself was very bright, practical & had all the comfort you could hope for - including a bluetooth music set-up which we've enjoyed as we love playing music in the morning.

I could not recommend this flat enough, our little gem in beautiful Lisbon - we'll be back!

Sophie.

First of all, I have to say that two friends and I have absolutely enjoyed our stay in this apartment.

Everything was like the description and the standard was very high. The apartment was very nicely and modern decorated with many little details and the most important: very clean! The location was absolutely perfect, you had the famous Lisbon elevator just in front of the door and the environment was really lively with many tapas and bars surrounding.

The owners were more than friendly and helpful, so we could not find a single point where we could criticize anything.

We would definetely come back to this apartment if we will return to Lisbon again.

Apartamento muito bom e aconchegante, muito bem decorado. A localização também é muito boa!
Apenas as escadas do edifício que são bem íngremes, quem estiver com malas pesadas terá dificuldades de chegar ao apartamento.
Em suma, tudo foi muito bom. Nada a reclamar.

The apt was exactly as it looked in the photos- smart and tidy and perfect for us. The kitchen was really well set up with everything you need if you want to do real cooking or just heating up. New washer worked beautifully.
What a fantastic location with the funicular running just below your window, a popular mirador nearby, a grocery store on the corner, and yet such a quiet neighbourhood.
Ótimo apartamento e localização. Recomendo!
ビッカ線沿いの坂道にあり、雰囲気抜群です！行きは荷物が多い場合、タクシーでビッカ線の坂の上に停めてもらった方が良いです。Googleマップで行ったら坂の下からのナビになり、かなり登るのが大変でした。部屋の設備も充実しており、ロケーション的にもこの値段はかなり良いかと思います
Perfect flat to stay in. Pedro & Antonio are really great and give good advices. If we come back, we will definitively book the loft. A thousand thanks to the Chiado team !

This is an absolutely immaculate apartment in a central location which was perfect for our short break in Lisbon. Pedro made us feel very welcome and we would certainly recommend the studio to others.

It was a very pleasant stay here in Pedro's apartment. The apartment is perfect - well located, beautifully decorated and you can find everything you want nearby. We were given a warm welcome and had everything we need and asked during the stay. I recommend staying here to anyone.

BEAUTIFUL PLACE, PERFECT LOCATION, CLEAN, EASY, I FULLY RECOMMEND !

Pedro est très sympathique, à l'habitude des locations donc est fiable et sait ce que les touristes attendant : du beau, du simple, du propre, voilà !

Merci beaucoup pour cette belle expérience
The appartament was in great location, near of everyplace. Lovely days in Lisbon. Pedro was very kind and professional. We hope to be back soon.

Staying at Chiado "Loft 5 The Studio" has been simply amazing. Placed in a charming electrified street due to the tram, this cute studio has everything you may need for a pleasant stay (as new, clean and comfortable as you can see in the pictures). To explore the city, you will not find a better place. Is close enough of the hot spots to get there in a walk distance and far enough from tourist areas to enjoy the true life of local folks and really feel Lisbon's heartbeat. Concerning the communication both with Pedro and Antonio (who greeted us), they prompt asked to our requests and provided us a nice welcome. With no doubts, if we have the chance to come back again, we will do it for sure. Hundred of thanks for everything and see you very soon!!!

We had an amazing time at Pedro's place.
The room is just like in the pictures. We even felt that we were the first ones to stay there, everything looks like new.

Pedro's friend Antonio welcomed us to the apartment even before it was ready and cleaned and gave us the opportunity to leave our luggage for a while. A couple of hours later we met again when the apartment was ready. He gave us a tour and some information about the room. We also had his phone number, in case we needed anything.

The location is one of the best features of the apartment. It's at walking distance of a lot of tourist seeings and close to the metro (thanks to Pedro we knew what exit to take and it saved us a lot stairs and going up to hill)

Like I already said, the apartment was spotless. The couch and bed were very comfortable and there was more than enough room for two people. Allthough it is located in a popular going out area, we didn't hear any noise during the night and slept like a baby.

I would definitely go back again during my next stay in Lisbon!

Everything was really Perfect, from The very beginning!
The Loft is exactly as beautiful as on the pictures.
Pedro and Antonio have been really kind.
Perfect Place in the Center of Lissabon!
Thank you

The Apartment is highly recommended! We had an excellent time in lisbon and spend a lot of time in this cosy flat because it was raining a lot. Pedro and Antonio are helpful Hosts. If we come back, we'll stay again in this nice and modern well-ressourced flatrate. Thanks Guys.

Had a great stay in this apartment - it's exactly how it looks in the pictures - really nicely decorated and has everything you need.  The location is brilliant - just one street away from the Bairro Alto with all the bars and restaurants and less than 5 minutes to the nearest Metro.  Pedro was really helpful with instructions on how to get there, and Antonio was there to meet us and show us the apartment.  Would definitely stay here again if I came back to Lisbon.

This was one of the best air Bnb experiences I have ever had. The location was perfect the inside of the loft was just as pictured and Pedro and his team made it so easy to be there. It was a perfect stay I highly recommend this place and one day I hope to return again.

Fantastic apartment in an ideal location, wouldn't hesitate to stay again. Despite being held up at the airport and arriving an hour later than planned, we were greeted by lovely Antonio who made us feel really welcome, with a bottle of wine and there to answer any questions. A brilliant apartment and hosts!

We had an amazing stay in Pedro's apartment ! Antonio was here to welcome us (perfectly on time and very kind, welcoming) .
The apartment was great, very clean, ideally located, very comfortable. Pedro and Antonio took into account previous negative comment and improved their services to make our stay even better .
We absolutely recommend them and we'll book them again if we go back to Lisboa!
Mult obrigada for everything !!!
Astrid

Pedro's apartment was OK, but Pedro and his partner spoiled our stay. After we arrived later than expected in Lisbon, Pedro's partner Anthony demanded an explanation why we arrived later than we said we would, and an apology. We provided both, but it seems that wasn't enough because Pedro sent us an e-mail the following day expressing his anger and demanding a further apology. We felt this was unnecessary, disrespectful and plain rude.

As for their apartment, it looked nice in the pictures but we didn't know we would be sharing it with uninvited guests such as swarms of ants, wood worms, and a mouse!

Internet worked sporadically, and when it did, it was very slow. Other than that, the apartment was in a very central location and the interior design was appealing.

Reception très agréable, précise et souriante dans ce bel endroit meublé avec gout et chaleur. On aurait juste peut être aimé quelques petites idées de visites hors guides de tourisme, des plans de la ville, des petits conseils autochtones sur la vie à Lisbonne. Par contre la liste des restaurant était parfaite pour un court séjour.

Perfect location, there is everything you need in few minutes walk.
The appartment is nice, bright and clean. All needed equipment is there.
We really enjoyed our stay here.
Recommended !!

We had a wonderful time at the loft studio. It was just as shown on the pictures. Pedro and his team even took the time to place some extra's in the apartment like coffee pads for the nespresso machine. The apartment is located in a really nice location. It's located close to many of the tourist hot spots of Lisbon. The communication with Pedro and his team went very smoothly. We would recommend the apartment for anyone who would like to visit Lisbon!

Nice, clean and cosy appartment. Location is just perfect.
Close to Tram 28 and Metro and train station.

A perfect place to relax and visit Lisboa.
Climbing the stairs (4-th floor) was not a problem at all. (we are 55+).

Withut doubt we would rebook it with the current nowledge.

This is the second time we have stayed in one of Pedro's apartments.  Once again we were really impressed by the quality and design of the apartment and also the spotless cleanliness. I really can't fault the apartment and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a nice place to stay in a central Lisbon location. Next time we are in Lisbon we will be staying here again!
A lovely flat in a great location.  The host was extremely helpful and even have me directions when we got lost in the way there. Really couldn't have asked for a better place to stay

Pedro's Chiado loft is stunning. Perfect hotel alternative. It feels like a boutique hotel with high-end amenities. The pictures do not do this apartment justice.
Beyond the apartment itself, the area is perfect for exploring. Great neighborhood with everything you could ask for.
Pedro was very accommodating with our late arrival. Loved everything. We only wish we stayed longer.

We really enjoyed our stay at  Chiado Loft 5. The appartement is really nice and cousy, so you feel really well. The area is great, located in a small street with an incredible view. Pedro and Tony were really nice and helpful. We will definetely come back to Lissabon and to Pedro´s appartment.

Simply Amazing! the apartment is so stunning, on the most charming street complete with a tram.

The location is VERY central and just a short walk to many of Lisbon's best sights. You'll find easy access to bus and train routes that take you to Belem and Sintra. There is also a grocery store conveniently located on the closest corner.

You'll find everything you need in the apartment plus more. After staying in a disappointing and expensive hotel in Lagos, our experience with the Chiado Lofts team was so refreshing.

I would highly recommend staying here.

Wow, this place awesome.  We styed in Lisbon 4 days and then explored the rest of Portugal.  We then stayed at Pedro's place for our last night.  We wish we had come here from the start.  First we were greeting by his friend Antonio who was waiting for us in the apartment. He helped us get settled in, explained how everything works and gave us helpful suggestions on where to eat.  A basket of oranges was left for us as well as little chocolates to welcome us. I cannot stress enough how perfect the location of this apartment is!  It is walking distance to everything you need in a happening part of Lisbon.  Also convenient is the fact that a grocery store is on the same block.  The apartment is compact but uses every inch effectively.  The décor is amazing and the place is very clean.  Do not hesitate to rent this place if it is within your budget.  Highly recommended!!!
Sehr schöne Wohnung in guter zentraler Lage von Bairro Alto. Vermieter sehr nett und hilfsbereit!

Thank you Antonio and Pedro. We loved this appartment which was perfectly located in the best area of Lisbon. Having been to Lisbon before and stayed in different hotels, this is by far the best value for money!

Antonio was also kind enough to give us a few ideas for dinner.

We would highly recommend this appartment.
Excellent location. We had a nice stay in this lovely well decorated flat.

Absolutely beautiful apartment! Great location and really helpful host. We arrived an hour late at 11:30pm and was still given a full explanation of the flat and the area from the friendly host. The studio was a perfect oasis after a busy day sightseeing and the area is fantastic for eating and drinking as well as being very picturesque. Will definitely stay again.
Geschmackvoll eingerichtetes kleines Loft. Alles drin, was man braucht. Sehr netter Gastgeber!

The apartment is really good, small but for 2-3 people ideal for holiday visit. Is very good furnished - you will find everything - including good nespresso coffee. Very clean! The location is perfect - from the window you will see the one of the Lisbon lifts (Bica) - nice view! Just a few steps to the tram No. 28. Thanks to Antonio who has welcome us in the apartment. He explained everything and provided with maps and another advises. We received from Antonio very nice welcome including bottle of local white wine in ice!!!
Antonio - thanks a lot!!! I recommend this apartment and Pedro / Antonio to all guests!

This apartment was perfect for my first stay in Lisbon. Very friendly and flexible host. Apartment placed in a charming area close to everything. Shopping, metro, party........ but still you don´t hear any noise from the street. I would love to go back and will surely recommend it to others.

The apartment was just as described, really excellent!
The host was very helpful too and quickly sorted us with a new pan to cook with when the one in the apartment wasn't working with the cooker.

We really enjoyed our stay in the brand new loft. The appartement is situated right in the vibrant centre of Bairro Alto.  The appartement was clean and Pedro very helpful upon arrival. Would def visit the place again.

We had a wonderful and relaxing stay at Loft 5 The Studio. The apartment was beautifully presented and was fitted and furnished to a high spec. The apartment is very centrally located to all amenities and transportation links to get around and out of Lisbon. Pedro was a brilliant host, he was very helpful, friendly and accommodating. I would really recommend this apartment for your stay in Lisbon- we simply loved it!!

It's a beautiful, spotless apartment with every convenience in a fabulous part of town. Pedro's thoughtful touches are all over the apartment: clear English info about it and the city; a welcome note and chocolates by the bed; a keen eye for decor. Pedro was also great at keeping in touch. We recommend this apartment wholeheartedly.

I enjoyed the stay at The Chiado flat very much and would recommend it a 100%.The flat was beautifully decorated, very cosy and clean. The location is perfect, walking distance to all must-sees. Pedro and Antonio were very helpful and responsive when we needed their help. Keep up the excellence quality and service.

We had an amazing time at Pedro's place! The interior design is extremely well thought out and it reminds you more of a luxury hotel really. For two to three people the place is perfect. Location is also great, all important nightlife, shopping, transport and sightseeing locations are in walking distance, so we hardly used any public transport.
Pedro was extremely responsive to all our questions prior to arrival and he met us at the flat when we got there to hand over keys.
Great host, great studio and a great city! Highly recommended!
Great stay. Superb location right next to a great viewpoint. Had everything you needed. Will definitely stay here again!
Tolle Lage, es war alles unkompliziert und wir würden jederzeit wiederkommen :)

un petit nid en plein cœur de l’Alfama. hyper pratique pour visiter tout Lisbonne et revenir dans un environnement agréable, typique et calme. Le logement est assez petit mais bien agencé, et dispose d’une vue agreable. Il est accessible par escalier.
Très bon séjour dans cet appartement. Les propriétaires sont très gentils et répondent très vite à vos messages.

Super appartement en plein coeur de Lisbonne. Très bien équipé, propre, facile d accès. Parfait pour un couple pour visiter la ville.
Hote très gentil.
Vous pouvez y aller les yeux fermés.
Encore merci
Nice flat right in  the heart of famous alafama and yet quiet for short or long stay.

Logement très bien situé dans le quartier Alfama, emplacement idéal, et belle vue. L'appartement est très propre, et soigné. Très bonne communication avec les hotes et très réactifs.
Les petits moins: l'odeur d'humidité à mon arrivée, et la literie serait effectivement à changer.
It’s a cozy, practical and clean tiny apartment. Easy to access the old town. Beautiful view to the river.
This place was amazing! Right in the center of all the fun stuff going on in Lisbon.

Bonito apartamento con todo lo imprescindible en pleno centro de Alfama. La atención de Antonio ha sido inmejorable, respuesta rápida, atento y con muy buenas indicaciones y recomendaciones. Muy recomendable.

Eu amo a Alfama e este apartamento foi a pedida certa para me sentir completamente inserido no bairro. Muito aconchegante, tinha tudo o que precisávamos e estava ao mesmo tempo perto de tudo e suficientemente longe para ser sossegado. Amei, recomendo e voltaria com certeza.

Merci beaucoup Antonio et Thais nous avons passés un séjour très agréable dans votre appartement, très fonctionnel et très bien placé. Nous avons également beaucoup apprécié vos recommandations merci !
Magnificent view of the port and cruise ship.
Great location for exploring Lisbon, lovely stay!
Great stay! We had no problems with noise, which I know was mentioned in other reviews. It was clean and comfortable, great for a stay in Alfama.

We really enjoyed our stay here! Very close to the viewpoint in Alfama, and within walking distance to other parts of the city!
The hosts were very responsive to any questions we had, and their check in/out instructions were clear.
The apartment itself is small but perfect for 2 people. The kitchen had everything we could have needed for our stay. The property was very clean. We would definitely stay here again!

A wonderful, cosy apartment in the heart of Alfama. Antonio was a fantastic host—very friendly and provided all the necessary instructions for a smooth self check-in and great local tips. Highly recommended!

The hosts allowed us to drop our luggage while the cleaning was in process which allowed us to go and visit the city luggage free. They were responsive and helpful. Placed central in Alfama and walkable distance to everything. Small place but enough to sleep over while visiting Lisbon.

O local estava limpo e organizado. Mas somos uma família de 3 pessoas, o apartamento é ideal para 2 pessoas. Para 3 pessoas ficou apertado. O acesso tem muitas escadas, estávamos com 5 malas e isso dificultou muito. Chegamos à tarde e o apartamento estava muito abafado, eles disponibilizam ventilador mas o ideal seria ar condicionado. A parede dá pra rua e também é muito próximo dos outros apartamentos e por isso sentimos cheiro forte de maconha e cigarro por muitas horas. O banheiro é mais antigo do que parece mas a ducha é boa!
Perfect location and great amenities!

Antonio siempre estuvo pendiente de si nos hacía falta alguna cosa, el alojamiento tiene muchos detalles como plancha de ropa y secador, se agradece como viajeros. Como un punto a mejorar cambiar la cama porque los muelles suenan bastante y al dormir se hace incómodo. Por lo demás todo perfecto! Lo recomendamos ☺️

The apartment is perfectly located in the heart of Alfama, with a lovely view over the rooftops and the river. Many great restaurants, cafés, and sights are just a short walk away. Communication with Antonio was easy – he was friendly, quick to reply, and very helpful.
The apartment is small but cozy and has everything you need for a short stay. The bed was comfortable (though it squeaked a bit 😄), and the bathroom, while tiny, was functional. We especially loved how peaceful it was at night – a real bonus in Alfama! Overall, a great place to enjoy the charm of Lisbon and its beautiful views.

Agradable estancia en una de las partes más históricas de Lisboa. El departamento en si es un poco pequeño pero tiene lo necesario para pasar un par de días en la ciudad.
El único punto no tan positivo es que se encuentra entre dos calles peatonales de las cuales se escucha bastante, pero era esperado teniendo en cuenta la locación. Nada que unos tapones no puedan solucionar.
Fuera de eso, es una estancia recomendable. Muchas gracias por hospedarnos.

I've booked 49 Airbnbs on 3 continents over 11 years, this is the first when I walked out in 10 minutes. The noise level is ridiculous if you stay during festivities. Loudspeakers will blast in the alley right outside, even after 11pm. Even without music, or between songs, you will hear pedestrian footsteps, civil servants dragging garbage cans, drunk tourists singing nearby. Why? Because the windows are a joke, I'm not surprised another reviewer lost stuff to theft. You will find earplugs useless when the noise level registers 50+ decibels on your Apple Watch. You will smell stuff. You will find the hallway too dark at night to find the right lockbox and enter the right combo. You will carry luggage on stairs outdoors, and have fun with it when they are wet. I'm sure the host will defend by saying festivals are only occasional (but they won't tell you beforehand), some things are out of their control and they did everything they could, but the fact is: they can't do anything about it.
