Excellent location but very small. No air conditioning which was a major issue for us during the summer heat. Also feels very expensive for what it is but that may just be Lisbon in general.

My husband and I were returning from Madeira and needed a place to stay for just one night. We’d been traveling with friends and had been in a larger Airbnb close to this neighborhood earlier in the week. We liked the location; it’s right by the #28 street car, which is a must do, and is walking distance to the river, restaurants and bars. His apartment is small and charming with everything we needed - especially appreciated the coffee in the morning! If you are looking for cute, historic place to stay, that is reasonably priced, this is it!
Amazing stay. Would highly recommend.

Nous sommes venus chez Carol et Antonio . Le logement est parfait pour un séjour de deux adultes. Le lit est très confortable , la cuisine est faite pour un séjour temporaire mais comme on passe plus de temps à l’extérieur ce n'est pas gênant. Le logement est au calme qui donne sur des ruelles piétonnières typiques de Lisbonne (extraordinaire !!). Le tramway linea 28 est à 2 minutes et autres moyen de transports sont très accessible . Les échanges avec nos hôtes sont très bons (réactifs et très cordiaux) . A recommander.

Nous avons beaucoup apprécié le logement qui est très bien situé, tout proche des trams, et du belvédère de Santa Lucia. En plein dans l'Alfama, un quartier très typique.
Le logement en lui-même correspondait à nos attentes.

Definitely super hosts , communication was superb in every way.. Apartment clean, charming, comfortable cleverly converted and equipped. However it is very compact and fine for 2 adults but would be uncomfortably  squeezed for 4 adults. The kitchen area is tricky for taller adults because the shelf supporting the microwave has sharp corners at head height. I enjoyed our stay and thank António and Carol for being excellent hosts.
Great view of Alfama!

This is a tiny and sweet apartment.
Don’t expect luxury, but a historic neighbourhood of small alleyways, lots of traditional Lisbon steps and great view to the river. The area is very touristy, but safe and I will definitely come back here when I’m in Lisbon again.

Really cute place in the heart of Alfama - great option if you’re looking to stay right in the old district. Easy to walk around to restaurants and overlooks.
The place itself was neat, definitely tiny so a good place to sleep more than hang out. Bathroom seems newly renovated.
Make sure your prepared to carry your luggage up/down stairs!

Such a beautiful space and location! We were only there for one night because we needed to leave for Porto, but Antonio’s place made us wish we had longer in Lisbon—will definitely need to come back :)

Nettes kleines Appartment mit allen, was man braucht. Die Lage ist an sich super. Wir waren mit einem Baby und Kleinkind dort. Dafür war das Apartment zu klein und der Weg dorthin über viele Treppenstufen mit Kinderwagen und Koffern unpraktisch. Als Pärchen wäre das alles kein Problem gewesen. Wir sind dankbar noch etwas bezahlbares für uns 4 gefunden zu haben.

Small, cozy apartment right in the heart of the Alfama. The location is close to shops and restaurants, and fun to walk around the older neighborhood. Easy to have dinner and enjoy Fado and then walk home. There is pedestrian street noise, especially when the cruise ships are in. This is definitely a pied-à-terre -- I'd call it a studio. We enjoyed the experience of being in an old building-- small doors (awesome locks), wide wooden floorboards, and cool stone walls. The Alfama is an old old neighborhood by the river and doesn't always smell the greatest. The apartment is small enough and overlooks an open space so it gets a good breeze and airs out quickly. Just be mindful of the flies. Otherwise, the bed is fine, and the kitchenette has what you need.
Sehr gute Kommunikation:)
Really enjoyable stay! Ideal location! Apartment is quite small but had everything we needed! Thanks

Um espaço muito agradável em pleno a uma área muito turística. O apartamento estava tudo como  esperado. E é a baixo de um mirante lindíssimo, descendo as escadarias do local. Somente a uma dificuldade para estacionar próximo por ser um centro turístico e comercial da região. No mais estava tudo ótimo.

Antonio was extremely helpful, and his place was perfect for our stay. We needed a comfortable place that wasn't going to stretch our budget and felt we struck gold when we were able to make our booking. We were even more impressed when we arrived! There was so much to do within walking distance, we did not have to worry about making many reservations or doing terrible much planning to find ways to spend our time with everything just up the steps from our front door. Less than a minute walk to food and a great lookout!

A cozy apartment in the lovely Alfama district. Perfect for exploring Lisbon, as almost all main sights are in walking distance. Even though it is centrally located, it is calm and peaceful around the apartment. Antonio and Carol were good hosts and easy to communicate with.
Don’t hesitate to stay here during your visit to Lisbon! It is a cosy appartement perfect for a couple. The location is really central and you can access everything quite easily :)
Nice little apartment in the very characteristic Alfama neighbourhood, close to restaurants and the rest of the city
Super logement idéalement situé, propre et agréable !
Excellent property. Great view and close to the center and tasty restaurants

Logement idéalement placé dans l’alfama proche des miradors avec vue exceptionnelle.
Propre et en parfait état, l’appartement donne sur une rue calme.
Excellent choix pour un séjour sur Lisbonne!!
El apartamento es perfecto para dos personas. Está muy limpio y bien situado, en pleno centro. Genial para pasar unos días en Lisboa. Antonio E Carol fue muy atento y amable, muy buen anfitrión.

Nous  avons passé un très bon séjour dans l'appartement. Les indications d'Antonio était très claires et l'appartement très propre. Il est de plus très bien situé dans le vieux Lisbonne. Nous le recommandons chaleureusement.

As everyone said before, this studio has the best location in Lisbon. It's perfect to explore Alfama and be there early in the morning and it's convenient to go to most of the other Lisbon famous sights seeings. Another thing that I liked was a very comphy bed - I slept very well there with my baby. I loved wooden beems - they give i nice look to the place and they're handy to put things on. I liked that in the morning you've got plenty of sunshine in the room and also that despite a very touristy location the place is very quiet. I had a pleasant surprise to discover my favorite Lisbon mural painting right in front of the window - this was wow!
Now, couple of small things that I liked less. The bathroom had a bit of this unpleasant smell. But I think it's quite common for old buildings in Alfama. Other thing - host is quite procedural with filling in link with info about passeports and flight number. I understand that it's good to follow rules, but it adds on work before departure.
appartement tres bien situé. explications et suggestions de visite tres interessantes. merci

Highly recommended for a stay in Lisboa. Located in the middle of the old town, there is everything you need. And Antonio e Carol are really great hosts.
I will definitively come back.....
Antonio and Carol were excellent! The place is smaller than I expected. The location is great. If you are carrying heavy luggage, you will struggle to get there (lots of stairs to climb up)
Very nice apartment and extremely helpful hosts, they helped us out in a silly situation we were in and thank to them our trip will is much more smooth :)

Appartement très mignon et très bien placé pour quelques jours à Lisbonne !
Parfait pour 2 peut être un peu petit pour 4 cependant..
Le quartier est calme sans vis à vis et une vue sympa. Juste un petit bémol sur l'isolation du logement qui n'est pas au top mais comme à beaucoup d'endroits à Lisbonne !

We had a great stay during our first night in Lisbon. The communication with the host was very friendly and the instructions were perfect. We liked that the appartement was very quiet and in walking distance of the busy areas. Highly recommended!
Cozy apartment with seaview. Kind host and easy communication
Great view!

Excellent séjour dans ce logement, calme et proche de points de vus incroyables.
Très bonne communication et transmission des informations.
Great views, friendly host. He was accommodating to us checking in early. Perfect for a quick trip to Lisbon.
Aside from the big stairs, this place is smack bang in the middle of a lot of sites. I am very happy with the stay and check in and out was not too tricky.
Beautiful place, with a great view, cafes just steps away, in a peaceful neighborhood. Antonio was very communicative and friendly!

Super petit appartement très agréable pour un séjour à Lisbonne et extrêmement bien situé (juste au pieds de la magnifique place Largo del Sol). Antonio est très réactif, les instructions pour trouver le logement sont très claires. Je recommande !
Amazing place. Amazing communication. Highly recommended!!

Smaller than expected
Hard to locate
You would pay for the neighbourhood and view

El alojamiento es perfecto para una pareja que tenga ganas de descubrir el corazón de Lisboa. Está a 10 minutos del centro de Lisboa y es precioso caminar desde el alojamiento a todos los sitios ya que el entorno es increible.
Antonio E Carol siempre atento a todo y disponible para resolver cualquier duda.
Apartamento limpio y con todo lo disponible para hacer de tu estancia perfecta. Aparte, las vistas son inmejorables.
Si tuviera que decir algo negativo, cuya culpa no es de Antonio en absoluto, es que los vecinos de arriba hacían mucho ruido y al ser el suelo de madera se notaban los pasos muchísimo.
Lo recomiendo muchísimo!!

Location location location. Be prepared to climb but oh so worth it. Suits a family of 3 . Couldn't imagine 4 here. Too small. Suited our needs perfectly. Authentic. Stunning view. Lisbon is my new favourite destination and this Airbnb contributed to this .

Sin duda volvería. Es un lugar diáfano, minimalista, confortable y con todas las comodidades. Además tiene vistas al río Tajo y a otros monumentos como el Panteón. Está en pleno dentro neurálgico de Lisboa, permitiendo desplazarse a pie, primeramente por el propio barrio Alfama, espectacular barrio típico portugués y prosiguiendo  por uno de los miradores más turísticos y emblemáticos de la capital portuguesa. El acceso al legado arquitectónico como la Plaza del Rocío o del Comercio a pocos MINUTOS del emplazamiento. La atención siempre presente y la magia desde el momento de la llegada.Lo recomiendo 100 por 100.

The place was small and cozy! It was a quick walk to coffee with a beautiful view. Antonio was very responsive, helpful, and had many local recommendations! The only downside is a bunch of stairs to get to the place which seams pretty typical. I had some nice local help me get my luggage back up the stairs to meet my Uber so it worked out okay! I would stay there again!
Très réactif, très disponibles. L’appartement est très proche de toute commodité. La literie est parfaite !!

Great location! Perfect for exploring Alfama and the surrounding areas. Apartment had everything we needed. Close to cafes, restaurants, and sites.
The entrance to the apartment was not directly accessible by car/taxi, but rather a short walk is required; but the directions sent by Antonio were perfect and still allowed for easy access (with a little walk).
Thank you for everything.
We had a great time in Antonio and Carol's place right in the middle of Alfama's streets. Felt like local living there. Really recommended.

Antonio E Carol’s place is perfect for a stay in Alfama area of Lisboa. It was comfortable, well maintained, and in a beautiful and safe location. Antonio E Carol were wonderful hosts with excellent communication. Would highly recommend!
Great location, super easy self check-in instructions and communication was quick and friendly!
Lovely place and very central. Check in was easy and the apartment was lovely especially for a single traveller. Delightful experience
Très bien

We were only there for one night but we really enjoyed it. The location is perfect and we were able to take great photos from the view. Antonio was very helpful and very patient. People is Lisbon were very nice.

Enjoy the convenience of staying in old town with great access to so much to see and culture.
Be very prepared to walk down (and back up) many stairs with your bags. That added to the experience of what it was like hundreds of years ago.
Communication was excellent, and the apartment, while small, is comfortable.

très joli petit appartement, idéalement situé pour découvrir tous les charmes de Lisbonne.
précision et communication parfaites,je recommande fortement!

This was a surprisingly spacious apartment in hilly Alfama. Easy to reach the center of the city by foot or public transit.
The internet connection was reliable but extremely slow -- it was very challenging to use several devices simultaneously or have any video calls for work.
Antonio was very responsive and his check-in/out instructions were clear!

The apartment is small and cozy. There is a great view over a murales from the main window and over the sea from the kitchen window and a lot of light during the day. Very close to the Miradouro Santa Luzia, it can be easily reached from above with taxy, uber and other vehicles. Communication is smart and efficient as it is for the instructions.

Honestly, absolutely fantastic. Very helpful, responsive and easy advice from the Host.
Apartment was great, ideal for 2 people. I didn’t stay in the room all that much but facilities available would make this easy if I needed to. Great location and easy to get to after a day getting to grips with navigating Lisbon.

Excellent communication from host. Unit is clean and exactly as described. We were even able to check in a bit early. Note there are A TON of steep hills/steps to climb before arriving at unit. We knew this prior to booking after reading other reviews, but it was still quite the workout! We are in our early 30's and moderately fit. My recommendation (especially in/out with luggage) is to get an uber to the nearest spot it will take you and walk to the unit from there. We walked from a parking lot and taking a cab from there would have been worth the extra expense.
Great location and well equipped. The host is very helpful and responsive. Lows, it’s small and you need to take a lot of steps to access, so was hard with the stroller.
A great little spot in the middle of a very cool neighborhood! Would definitely recommend to others.

I had some problem in opening the box for the self check-in, but Antonio was prompt to support me in real time. Apartment is small but cozy, in a very strategic location. Great for short or medium stays, where the intention is to eat mainly outside. I had a problem with a bottle of wine which results in some stains on the wall (sorry to the next guests), reaction was very polite. Great house and host.

This was our second stay in Antonio’s apartment. We love staying here! The location is great if you want to be in the Alfama district. Within walking distance to so many different places—restaurants, fado and historical places, public transportation and the popular Portas do Sol Terrace. The apartment is small but has everything that you need. And the view of the Tagus river is so pretty to look out at. Antonio is one of the best hosts! His communication and answers to questions was so quick and helpful.
You can’t go wrong in staying here. We would definitely stay here a third time if our travels take us back to Lisboa!

Great place to stay. There is a coffee shop/bar just a few feet away up the stairs and many more places to eat and see close by. Be aware it is about a 20 minute drive from the classic Lisbon tourist areas (monastery, Belem tower, lx factory, market, etc) but Uber is super cheap! We had a great stay and loved the area. So beautiful!
Great deal and Antonio is a responsive host. I’d definitely stay again!

Antonio’s place is a wonderful stay in the heart of Alfama! We were impressed by the location and the amount of stuff to do around the apartment. The apartment is exactly as described. While slightly warm on hotter nights, the fan provided was perfect. Great communication from the host, he even helped set up an airport transfer for us. Would definitely stay again!

Loved my stay at Antonio's place. The location couldn't be any better - it's just seconds away from an incredible viewpoint and there's also a fantastic little cafe/terrace nearby. Antonio was very quick to respond, even when messaged at late hours - I am very grateful for all his help, it made my stay very comfortable. I would be more than happy to stay again ad recommend this lovely little Airbnb to others.
Vista espectacular en el corazón de Alfama, un lugar increíble. Cerca de estaciones de metro y trenes.

Beau séjour et bel accueil : L'appartement n'est pas facile à trouver, mais la localisation est idéale pour vivre Lisbonne. L'appartement est petit, mais conforme aux photos et commode. Nous y avons séjourné 2 adultes et 2 enfants en bas âge et ce fût parfait pour 3 jours. Antonio à été très réactif et disponible pour nous aider à l'accueil. On recommande!
Hat alles was man braucht. Wohnung ist sehr klein aber für ein paar Tage sollte es in Ordnung sein. Jedoch sollten nicht mehr als 2 Personen in der Wohnung wohnen.
Très proche du centre et très propre !

L'appartement est très bien situé au cœur de l'Alfama, un quartier très mignon. Tout était très propre. Antonio est un hôte prévenant et réactif, qui communique des informations parfaitement claires et précises pour l'entrée dans les lieux et disponible tout au long du séjour .
Perfect ! Thx for everything
Excellent location, everything as described, great contact with the host. I recommend this apartment.

Nous sommes restés 5 jours dans un appartement des plus coquet à Lisbonne dans le quartier Alfama.
Bel appartement vraiment très bien situé! Je recommanderais peut-être plus pour un couple.. impeccable!
Clean spot, great location and nice host. Antonio was always available to help in any situation. The place is rather small but for 3 people should be enough.
Amazing host, excellent communication and a beautiful apartment in a great location.  Easy check in process
Great place,  amazing location. Antonio was very helpful and communication was great, getting into the apartment was very easy and it was a wonderful stay.
Great stay and would highly recommend, thanks!

We had a wonderful stay in Antonio’s appartement in Lisbon! It is a cosy appartment which had everything we needed. We loved the location in the heart of Alfama, where you can listen to Fado every night.

This place is fantastic, right in the middle of everything! It's just a staircase down from one of the best views in Lisbon. Antonio was also very responsive and helped with checkin. Even with the high temps when visiting, the fan in the apartment kept everything cool at night. Definitely recommend when visiting.

I really appreciated how quickly Antonio communicated with us! We even needed to check in early and he was able to work that out with us. Check in was easy and I loved the check list that Antonio sent right away when we booked the property!

Spent one night at this Airbnb. Loved the location in cozy Alfama with walkability to Baixa and Chiado neighborhoods. The apt was very clean, and Antonio coordinated with us so that we could drop off our luggage before check in so that we could spend the afternoon walking around freely. We were there when the day time temps were in the mid 90sF //35C, and though it did cool off a bit, making the provided fan crucial.

The place was spotless! I have never seen an airbnb this clean, loved the details!
The location is great! Beautiful views from the windows, if you find it difficult to climb stairs it’s not the place for you, otherwise the location is perfect.
I would definitely recommend Antonio’s place!
Tiny, nicely located and very clean place. Not suitable for travelers with heavy suitcases :(… many stairs to walk before reaching the apartment.
Great location & views in the heart of Alfama. Antonio & his team were great communicators through out check in to check out
Perfect location, lovely flat!
Great localisation! Here, you can truly feel like you live in an orginal place among not just turists, but also portugese people:) Ideal for short city break.

studio petit mais bien situé pour les marcheurs, au cœur d un quartier animé mais ne pas y loger entre le 10 et 13 juin sauf si vous voulez faire la fête toute la nuit car impossible de dormir,  musique très fort même fenêtres fermées (et très chaud). Déçus  de ne pas avoir été prévenus, trop fatigués pour profiter du séjour.

We really enjoyed our stay in Lissabon because of this perfect accomodation. Great appartment with a nice view. Location is perfectly in the middle of Alfama. It was easy to walk to f.e. Bairo Alto.
Communication with Antonio went really good!
Thanks Antonio!

Appartement charmant et fonctionnel en plein cœur de l alfama, à 2 pas des miradors.
Antonio est un hôte disponible et très arrangeant.

Lovely little place only let down by very noisy neighbours playing music in the square downstairs very loud all day and evening but think that was a one-off and they were friendly!!
Very comfy other than that and had everything we need! A beautiful stay in Lisbon :)
Zentrale Lage in Lissabon. Die historische Straßenbahn fährt quasi direkt an der Haustür vorbei. Praktisch eingerichtet mit allem Notwendigen. Insgesamt eher kleines Airbnb. Sehr bequemes Bett.

If you want to be in the seat of ALL the action, this is the place! Perched overlooking the river ( and Cruise boats) Surrounded by Breath-taking views around every corner, drift off to sleep with Fado music, feel the fresh sir off the water.
Antonio is very responsive-great host.
Antonio est très disponible et fait tout pour que votre séjour soit agréable. L’appartement est parfait, bien situé, fonctionnel

My criteria was finding something quiet with a nice bed and roomy bathroom, this fit all three. And we were near a vista point that was nice to walk by every day. The location was not for the faint of heart, expect to walk a lot of steps daily to get to or leave from the apartment, but that is also a part of walking in Lisbon as well.

Perfect apartment in the center of Alfama, small but big enough for two people to visit the city for few days (kitchen is only smaller part). In few steps you are in Mirador porta do Sol and in front of the window there is a beautiful graffiti. The house is over a passage street so there could be noise about people walking, but for us wasn’t a problem at all. Alfama is a quiet district so it’s up to your holiday choice. Good and clear instruction with Antonio, a really pleasure to stay there.

The apartment is quite small but clean and fairly comfortable. The location was very convenient, though if you have trouble getting up/down stairs it will be difficult - the entrance is off a small side street that does not have car access.
Great location, easy to access and to communicate! the apartment had everything I needed !!

It really is a cozy stay but we were able to get what we needed out of the space. Antonio was quick to respond and was able to accommodate early check-in for us. The location was great and we were walking distance to most of the Alfama area. About 15 minutes from the train station. Nice bathroom. Overall great stay for the price!

Fantastic location - stunning view from the viewpoint above as well as from the apartment window. Tucked in just above the alfama district- easy to walk to many sightseeing points and just explore. Antonio was easy to communicate with and kind.  We felt safe and so very relaxed. Would stay again!

This place is perfectly placed for everything you want to do in Lisbon. The flat itself is really well designed so that you get evertything you need and fell it is spacious despite the actual floor space not being huge. First evening spent taking the sea views in by taking a two minute elevator ride to the top of the hill and then having some wonderful food just one minute from the doorstep in Alfama.
Really fantastic stay and Antonio answered all my questions just prior to arriving.

Super logement, idéalement situé, très propre. Mention spécial à Antonio qui est très réactif et à l’écoute.
Nous reviendrons avec grand plaisir !!!
Perfect location in the Alfama. Just right for a couple.
the flat is good and well located. communication was easy with the host. i recommend this Airbnb

Très bon Airbnb, bien situé et avec une jolie vue.
La communication avec Antonio s'est également très bien passé.
Je recommande

Appartement très bien situé dans le de quartier de l'Alfama.
L'appartement était propre à notre arrivée et nous avons pu y déposer nos bagages plus tôt avec l'accord d'Antonio.
Nous y avons passé un agréable séjour!

Wonderful small apartment. Great location right in the middle of Alfama. Everything worked smoothly, check-in and out was easy.
Be aware that while the apartment is on the ground floor, it is on a side street without car/taxi access. It's a moderate walk up a hill or down some stairs in order to get to the front door.
adorable little apartment with a gorgeous view. perfect for a Lisbon trip. I would totally stay again.
Everythings was Good

Logement vraiment parfait pour un séjour à Lisbonne, idéalement placé dans très sympathique quartier de l'afalma, pas loin du métro et surtout du tram, arrivée dans les lieux facile, très bonne communication avec Antonio, logement propre.
Que dire de plus, je recommande.
Exactly as described and in such an amazing location. Basically living in one of the best viewpoints in Lisbon :)

The apartment was perfect for my short stay in Lisbon. Perfectly located, wonderful view and super cosy and functional, I wish I could have stayed longer! Antonio was super friendly and gave very detailed info about the self-check in and about what to visit in town. Definitely recommend!
Nice location, cool view, various amenities, items around the house could use some fixing

Un super appartement très bien placé qui nous a permis de passer un super voyage à Lisbonne.
Antonio a su être flexible sur les dates de départ et d’arrivée nous permettant de profiter à notre rythme du voyage !
Encore merci Antonio !
Fantastic Apartment, great value and good communication from Antonio. Will be staying there again and would recommend to anyone!
Bon rapport qualité prix. Studio très bien situé et communication avec l’hôte très facile
Very nice flat, good location. Check-in is well explained. Clean. Nothing to say more, you can book it !
Thank you very much again, the apartment is very well located, Antonio gives you good instructions that make you in security.

The apartment was compact but really nice, perfect for 1-2 people. The location is great in the Alfama district, close to everything.
I worked during the days in the apartment and the internet worked well.
As someone mentioned here already; the walls are very thin as old houses tend to have, so some noise and sounds can be heard to the apartment.
Antonio was a great host and answered very fast to gany questions.
I definitely recommend this apartment and will use it again if I return 😊
Staying here was great. Prime location with great views. I will say if you have trouble walking stairs this might not be the place for you. However I would stay here again as it was right for me.

Antonio’s place is very close to the great view points where you can get a nice view of the city. It is close to the city centre and a step away from the maze of alfama. There are cafes and restaurants nearby. I’d stay at his place again when I go back to Lisbon!
Authentic tiny apartment in a very nice location. I expected it to be bigger. Internet could have been better as well.

Nous avons passé un agréable séjour chez Antonio. La vue sur le Tage, l'appartement cosy et chaleureux, et dans un quartier vivant avec ses petits restos où l'on peut écouter du fado, et très bien situé, accessible aux transports en commun. Je recommande.
Great little apartment, very cosy and in a good location
Great place! Wonderful host, would love to stay again

We wouldn’t stay in another area than Alfama, should we have another city trip in Lisboa. For that reason, Antonio’s place is a perfect fit, that comes with great communication prior and during the stay, on how to operate the place (check-in and out) but also plenty of tips about the area (nearest shop, transport, luggage locker…). The room comes with all amenities and is wel organized, considering the limited space.
Warning; despite the mint condition of the room, and because it is an old building, consider noise insulation as non existent.

Casa in ottima posizione e accogliente.
Antonio gentilissimo e molto disponibile.
Super appartement  très très bien placé pour découvrir les lieux de vies lisboetes. Quartier vivant donc forcément bruyant.

Very nice place in the center of Alfama, very close to the terraces with a beautiful view on the river. It is in a small, quiet street.
The flat is fine for one or for two people. All necessary amenities are available. And Antonio is super communicative and helpful. I had a few lovely days in Lisbon :)
Estúdio muito bem localizado! pequeno mas aconchegante.
Appartement très bien situé. Hôte réactif. Super séjour !
Antonio's apartment is a great location for the older part of Lisbon, in a narrow old street. lovely cute apartment great for a central stay.

Rigtig fin kommunikation med Antonio
Køkkenforholdene er små, men alt er der, det er så fint.
Skønt område at bo i og en smuk udsigt ud over floden.
Hilsen Gitte og Claus
Best location if you love to be in the old town, cute little place!

Super sweet apartment, very nice bathroom! Perfectly located! The best place to eat is just down the street and a terrace with a view for a drink is only an elevator ride up. Apartment is cozy and offers a lovely view. Good to know: There are quite a few steps to walk up to the apartment - as is typical for that unique part of the city.  If you have a rental car bear in mind the closest car park is a about a 10 min walk up / down stairs.

Bel appartement, fonctionnel et très bien situé dans le quartier de lAlfama.
Merci à Antonio pour sa réactivité aux messages.
posizione perfetta. appartamento delizioso.grazie ad Antonio per la flessibilità e cortesia

Super ! Nous avons réservé cet appartement ma conjointe et moi pour plusieurs nuits à Lisbonne. Pour nous c’est le meilleur quartier de Lisbonne , dans les hauteurs avec vue sur le fleuve , tout est bien expliqué pour l’arrivée et pour les questions que nous avions Antonio nous a répondu extrêmement rapidement. Nous vous conseillons le petit restaurant à 50metres de l’appartement en descendant la rue « Lisboa Tu&Eu » cuisine portugaise excellent et pas cher ! Profitez en aussi pour aller à la tour de Belem ainsi que le monastère. Et surtout prévoyez une bonne journée voir deux pour aller à Sintra et ensuite prendre le bus pour le Cabo de roca ! Au dessus de l’appartement vous avez un petit commerce ainsi que plusieurs petits restaurants pour prendre un bon petit déjeuner. Je recommande a 100%

Antonio's place is small but cosy and works well for a single traveler or a couple. The location is great but there are a lot of Airbnbs around so be prepared for some (party) noise from the streets -ear plugs are a must.
Super cute flat with a view. Everything you need to roam the winding streets of Alfama. The check in/out are easy and communication with the host super smooth.

This apartment was in an amazing location in the Alfama neighborhood of Lisbon. The apartment was small but very clean and perfect for what we needed. We had a great time and recommend this place to anyone traveling to Lisbon!

Really nice apartment, located in the middle of Amalfa. The apartment has everything you need and the bed was very comfortable.
I’ll definitely come back.

Superbe appartement au cœur du quartier Alfama.
L’appartement était très propre, il ne manque rien.
Antonio est super réactif et très attentionné.
Je recommande cet appartement + + +
Hè was easy to talk to and responded very fast.

Very nice place. Cozy and welcoming.
Everything super well organized. Thank you

Hi Antonio, the Appartement is very nice and in a central location in the old city. There are plenty restaurants and much to see in a close area. We enjoyed our visit in Lissabon!
Thank you!:-)
Superbe logement, typique, avec une belle vue, bien aménagé et très bien situé dans Alfama. Et un hôte qui est réactif à nos demandes.
L’emplacement de l’appartement est très bien situé, on peut facilement ce déplacer dans la ville, appartement très propre et très agréable et surtout une belle vue

Très bon Airbnb !!
Extrêmement bien situé !!!
L’arrivé est bien indiqué sur l’interface voyageur et une bouteille d’eau au frais vous attend dans le frigo à votre arrivé dans le logement !! Un petit plus qui fait la différence!
Merci Antonio

Antonio's apartment is the perfect place to stay when visiting Lisbon. It's in the heart of Alfama, close to lots of historic attractions, nice coffee places and awesome restaurants. It also has a very nice view and you can feel what's like to live in Lisbon's oldest neighbourhood.
The place is well equipped, with a very comfortable bed and everything that you need to have a nice stay. We would definitely recommend it to our friends and family.
Comfortable space in a charming area. Would stay again.
Had a nice stay and the apartment was nice and clean. Antonio was nice and easy to communicate with.
I booked this place for my parents. They really enjoyed their stay at Antonio' s place. The location is perfect and overall everything was good. Thanks!

Hele mooie studio. Goed ingericht en op een top locatie dichtbij alle bezienswaardigheden. Bij ons kraakte de bank een beetje en lag er nog vuil in de vensterbank, maar verder was alles echt fantastisch.
Une semaine en plein coeur de Lisbonne, ville magnifique, appartement idéalement placé, conseils précieux d'Antonio, nous recommandons chaudement cette adresse !

Antonio’s had everything I needed for a comfortable stay in Lisbon. The bed is very comfortable, the kitchenette just right, and the setting so pretty. The sunrise was pretty and peaceful as the rays glistened on the river.

The location is very convenient for tourism. It's right next to a view point in a very picturesque area, with the famous trams passing through. The apartment is cozy, and for two people it was a comfortable stay.
Antonio is very reactive, and gives all the useful informations about the apartment and some adresses in the neighborhood

Appartement très sympathique, propre et surtout merveilleusement bien situé. La place du commerce est a environ 15 min, vous pourrez facilement visiter la ville a pied. L'appartement est bien équipé pour un court séjour (le ventilateur en période estivale est appréciable). Il est agréable pour 2 personnes (un peu juste pour 3 ou 4). Antonio est très réactif et se montre dévoué pour ses hôtes. Nous avons beaucoup apprécié notre séjour en amoureux à Lisbonne, merci Antonio
Amazing view from the heart of Almafa. Highly recommended for everyone :)

Très bon emplacement pour découvrir cette magnifique ville à pied !
L'appartement est conforme aux photos : très mignon. Il est calme car donne sur une rue piétonne. Merci Antonio 😊
Petit mais tout ce qu’il faut dans l’appartement ! Très bien placé, on peut tout faire à pied! Super !
Hôte aux petits soins, emplacement nickel !

This apartment is perfect to enjoy your stay in Lisboa. It is very well located in the Alfama district near to restaurants, very good point of view. It is very clean with all you need. Above all, you will be able to enjoy a very beautiful view from this apartment. I really recommand it.

Alles war TOLL außer, dass wir kurz vor dem Check-Out genaue Informationen darüber verlangt haben, wie wir auschecken sollten. Der Gastgeber hat meine 3,4 Nachrichten gelesen und sich nicht gemeldet. Er hat sich erst am nächsten Tag gemeldet, als wir schon am Flughafen waren und hat sich entschuldigt.

I used Airbnb for several times and I have to say this was the best service I ever had.
Antonio is an amazing host, very helpful. Always ready to support if anything is needed.
Well done, Antonio!

Sehr gute Lage, Einkaufsmöglichkeiten und Restaurants in der Nähe, tolle schöne kleine Gassen. Die Wohnung ist klein und süß eingerichtet, für zwei Leute ist richtig gut.
Nur man bemerkt die Raumfeuchtigkeit wenn die Fester lang geschlossen sind, am besten nur mit geöffneten Fenster bewohnbar.
Küche ist klein aber top ausgestattet.
Kommunikation mit dem Gastgeber schnell und komplikationslos.
Vielen Dank und wir werden das wiederbuchen :)

Antonio est très sympa !
L'appartement est très agréable bien qu'un peu bruyant, j'avais toujours l'impression que quelqu'un entrait, mais pas de bruit tard le soir ou la nuit :)

Piccolo appartamento adatto per una, massimo due persone, in una zona perfetta e suggestiva per esplorare Alfama e Lisbona
Nonostante le dimensioni ridotte (la cucina è veramente stretta), gli spazi sono ben utilizzati ed il letto molto comodo

Appartement typique et très bien situé, beau levers et couchers de soleil, nous avons presque tout fait à pieds de ce point.
Nous n'avons pas pu rencontrer Antonio mais il s'est montré extrêmement réactif et nous avons apprécié pouvoir laissé nos bagages pour profiter de notre dernière journée.
Great little place in Alfama with a view of the Tagus. Antonio was very responsive and welcoming (though we did not meet because of covid)!

Six stars
What a PERFECT little apartment, sun coming in windows, amazing view, beautiful artwork, super comfortable bed
I don’t have a bad word to say about it, super easy check in, I will definitely be back again
So much love for this little place
Wow!
Super quartier appartement même petit très agréable accueil convivial et chaleureux
A wonderful stay in a charming little studio flat. if you want to get a feel for the old town of Lisbon, there is probably no better place to stay!

Super locatie en een mooie studio. Erg schoon.
Communicatie was top!
If you want to spend some days in Lisbon, Alfama is the best place to stay. This apartment is well located, cozy and clean and Antonio is so willing.
Very clean apartment and great location! Antonio is very helpful and friendly, can totally recommend!
Great location, traditional but modern apartment in the heart of the old town.
Kleine aber feine Wohnung mitten in Alfama. Die Wohnung ist wirklich in einer top Lage und man kann von dort aus vieles zu Fuß erreichen. Check in & out waren unkompliziert, gerne wieder :)
Très bien situé pour visiter la ville à pieds! Près de tout et dans une petite ruelle charmante! Excellent rapport qualité-prix.
This is a tidy, tiny place in the historic Amalfa district, on the route of the 28 tram. Be prepared to walk uphill and steps!
Great place to stay at.
L’appartement est très bien situé, pratique et confortable
Such a lovely place!
Really enjoyed our stay here in Lisbon. Would highly recommend the apartment,  equipped with everything we needed. Great communication with host and would definitely come back.

What a wonderful little place! There is not a lot of space but who spends their holiday cooped up in a room!? The location was fantastic and was a great jump off point for our adventures. Communication throughout the entire process was great as well!
The location of the apartment is simply amazing! Super charming and quiet neighbourhood, close to lots of historical sites and cable car stops. Check in and communications were great!
Great position, clean and proper room, magnificent view.

Very nice apartment in the centre of Alfama. All very good arranged at our arrival and we met the host. We got quick answers if we had questions. The apartment was clean and equipped with all you need for a good stay in  wonderful Lisboa!

L’appartement était idéalement situé, au milieu de l’alfama à proximité d’une station de tram et d’une magnifique place. L’appartement était aussi très propre et confortable avec une belle vue sur le Tage.
Je recommande cet air bnb.
Merci à Antonio et Maria qui ont été très accommodants pour les horaires.

You can expect exactly what you read from the apartment description. Awesome location, close to public transportation, although I walked everywhere. Loads of cafes and restaurants within a few steps of the apartment . Great communication with Manuel, the manager, and again, location, location, location! I wouldn’t hesitate to book this rustic, charming apartment again!

I don’t like to be negative however there are a few things people need to be aware of when booking this AirBnb. First I would like to say the manager, Manuel was fabulous! He is what made me stay. He was quick to reply and help me with any questions.
However, if you need to have use of an elevator, the one here doesn’t work. Nor has it for some time. Which means you have no less than 75-80 steps to get to and from the room. That’s the easy way. I am very active but I had a lot of heavy luggage so I only booked this because of the elevator. If you don’t like stairs avoid this location. As it is in a popular place, it’s noisy from both sides of the apartment. The bathroom window shutter must be closed if you don’t want people to see you in the bathroom. Plus I was told people tend to through things in the window. It does look like the photos, maybe a bit more worn. But Lisbon is wonderful!
Cute studio in an amazing location! Quick responses, accommodating of  earlier check-in and very hospitable. Highly recommend!
Idéalement situé et parfait pour deux personnes!

Piccolo appartamento con apprezzabile vista sul Tago e sui tetti dell’Alfama. Si trova nel cuore del quartiere e consente dunque di raggiungere tutti i punti più belli della zona in pochissimo tempo. Nonostante la dimensione è molto confortevole.
Lovely place and I loved the window view you get!!  Distance to all the sights and center was very reasonable.

The flat is perfect if you want to know Alfama.
You’ve got couple monuments very close and railways and buses are near too.
10/10 for us.
What should i say - perfect tiny location, clean, cozy, love it!

Excelente espaço!!!
Nota máxima em todos os sentidos!!
Amamos!!
Beautiful place can’t ask for more
Muy buena ubicación, buen trato, perfecto todo
Convenient location in a vibrant neighborhood. Great view, tidy apartment.
Polecam to miejsce z całego serca! Świetna komunikacja z właścicielem, super lokalizacja mieszkania, wszystko bez problemów :)
Appartement très agréable et calme. La communication avec Manuel est très réactive . Nous avons aussi apprécié de pouvoir laisser nos bagages jusqu'à 15h.

Appartement conforme aux photos, petit mais bien equipé. Seul bémol le voisinage, il nous ete impossible de dormir la nuit mais le proprietaire a ete tres reactif et nous a proposé un autre appartement pour y passer la seconde nuit, qui s’est tres bien passé!
Great location! Clean place with good amenities. Walking distance to many restaurants and a minute away from a great place to watch the sunrise and even the sunset too!
Really comfortable space in a great location.  Walking distance to all that Lisbon has to offer.
Check in was timely and easy. A great location - it couldn’t be easier to see a lot of great sites and overlooks.
Un logement idéalement placé, avec beaucoup de charme 😉

Beau premier séjour à Lisbonne dans un studio petit mais suffisant pour deux personnes.
A proximité de divers points d'intérêts, reculé mais proche d'un axe principal. A la fois au calme et animé en soirée...nuit en fonction des autochtones et ou des touristes ;-)
Le tram ...waouw et non loin, à faire, la tour de Belem, le monastère de Jéronimos et un peu plus loin Sintra .

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour. Appartement très bien situé au cœur de l'Alfama
A proximité des transports métro( ligne bleue et verte) Tram 28. Manuel était très réactif. Appartement petit mais cela suffisait sachant que nous étions en visite toute la journée. Je vous recommande le lever du soleil au mirador de Santa Luzia juste au dessus ... accès à pied ou avec l’ascenseur ...un régal. Quartier calme en cette saison. nous reviendrons avec grand plaisir.

Great quaint apartment perfect for two people who just need a place to crash. Amazing location within walking distance of many attractions. Only downside about the location is that you have a lot of stairs to get to a street where cars can go. Perfect communication and hospitality!
The location was great! As other reviews have mentioned, the space is on the smaller side, but it was perfect for our last night in Lisbon!

Die Kommunikation mit den Gastgebern im Vorfeld des Besuchs war optimal. Die Wohnung ist zwar klein, aber der Raum ist optimal genutzt; es fehlt an nichts. Die Wohnung ist sehr günstig innerhalb der Altstadt gelegen; direkt gegenüber auf der anderen Straßenseite gibt es einen öffentlichen Fahrstuhl, der einem das mühselige Treppensteigen erspart. Die Wohnung ist sehr sauber und alle Geräte haben einwandfrei funktioniert. Ich würde die Unterkunft jederzeit weiterempfehlen.

Manuel was a great host, we havent the possiblity to meet him, but he always was pending in my texts asking for tips to visti lisbon. apartment was in a great location, in the middle of the old city, we hope to come back again, i recommend him 110%.
Great location, very cute and clean, Antonio met us and check in was easy, gorgeous views and couldn’t be any more “local” of a vibe. Bed was so comfy!
We loved the apartment!

Спасибо Мануэлю! Мы приезжали вечером на машине и нам оставили подробные инструкции по самостоятельному прибытию и координаты нескольких парковок ! Апартаменты небольшие, но есть все необходимое! Находятся в атмосферной исторической части города !
Great apartment - super organised and helpful hosts that go out of the way to ensure everything goes smoothly. Would definitely stay here again!
We absolutely loved it! Area is amazing views are amazing. Most amazing sunrise as the apartment faces east towards the river. Can’t wait to come back!

This property has pros and cons.
Location is amazing, in the Alfama yet a minute to Santa Luzia terrace with the fabulous views and is on the 28 tram route. Property is clean, modern and well equipped, with great views. Communication was excellent. Very comfortable bed and even feather pillows!
However although we are a couple we still found the space quite cramped, not really anywhere for bags. I would not recommend this property for 4 people the as the living area would mostly be taken up by the bed. Unless you travel very light and are all very close. The kitchen area is also micro and was awkward to use.
It’s good for a short stay, for couples or longer stays with minimal kitchen use.
Only other advice is if you are unfamiliar with Lisbon and arrive at Santa Luzia terrace, there is a public lift that takes you almost to the door of the property. This is a godsend when you have luggage! When your app directs you there and think it’s wrong to take the lift, it isn’t !

Beautiful cozy apartment in the heart of Alfama district with a great view! Antonio was a great host, quick response and the transfer back to the airport worked out perfectly even very early in the morning! Thank you we enjoyed our stay a lot!
such a lovely place to stay! very good communication!!
Nice area with bars and restaurants.  Overall we had a good experience.

We had a quick stay in the apartment with everything you needed in a great area. We just had some problems with the door to the apartment, which ended up taking much more extra time to get fixed. But other then that we had an good stay!

We stayed in Antonia and Maria's place the second time around after having stayed there on the first leg of our trip. Their place is situated in the heart of Porto do Sol. The apartment is very clean with the right amount of amenities. The bed is really comfortable. We came back after traveling to France for our last night stay and we couldn't be happier. Antonio and Maria were great hosts.
Thanks again for a wonderful stay in Lisbon! This one is definitely going down in the books! :)

Our stay in Alfama was amazing! The flat is just as advertised and was the perfect starting place to explore Lisbon, pastry and fado. The place was clean and communication related to check-in/out was easy. Recommend this place strongly! :)
Très joli appartement. Très bien situé (a 10-15 min à pied de la place Rossio).

This place is a gem! It is centrally located in Porto do Sol. Coffee shop just a short walk up the stairs with an amazing view. Lots of mom and pops restaurants around you where you can eat authentic Portuguese meals! There's also a nice mural just outside your window with a view of the ocean.
This place is perfect for a couple. It's cozy but with enough space. The bed is very comfy especially after a long day out walking around the city. The flat is very clean. Antonio and Maria were very responsive and accommodated us with an early arrival. And we love the place so much that we're coming back for a second stay! :)
Ein kleines aber gemütliches Appartment in einer sehr schönen Lage. Für einen Städtetrip wirklich zu empfehlen.

The apartment was perfect. Although it's right in the center of the Alfama (location is amazing), it was very calm and quiet at night. As we were checking in at night, we were afraid it would be hard to find the apartment at first, but Antonio and Maria arranged a shuttle for us from the airport and the driver dropped us off close to the apartment. The indications to get their were clear. Antonio and Maria always responded quickly to our questions. Everything you need is close by: small supermarket, restaurants, tram, etc. All in all, we highly recommend :)

Vous ne pouvez pas etre plus au coeur et dans le coeur de Lisbonne. Et pourtant tres au calme !! L'emplacement est incroyable. L'appartement est petit  et sans rangement, (donc 2 personnes maxi seulement) mais par-fai-te-ment aménagé, décoré avec gout, et a toutes les commodités (sauf laveuse). Ce lieu mériterait 10/10. Nois n'avons pas pu rencontrer Antonio et Maria poir l'accueil maos tout s'est bien passé.

This place was a perfect stop off for our 1 last night in Lisbon. We probably wouldn't have wanted to stay longer considering what a tiny space it is, and how limited the room for cooking would be had we wanted to do that. It's also a bit tricky to get to due to being situated on one of Lisbon's many hills, but we highly recommend taking the public Santa Luzia elevator to get to the apartment rather than walking the 50+ steep cobblestone steps! Much easier.
The views from the apartment are incredible and the street it sits on is a very typical, sweet local Lisbon street in the heart of Alfama. Very close to many things and centrally located. For that, we loved this place.

Antonio and Maria's place was super cute and comfortable for 2 people. The location was perfect, very close to restaurants, and had incredible views of Alfama. I would definitely recommend staying here!
Clean and cozy. Perfect location
Great stay. Everything as described and fast replies by the hosts.

La casa si trova in una posizione veramente ottima con una vista fantastica. Casa pulita e soprattutto essendo una casa abbastanza piccola è stato utilizzato benissimo lo spazio per avere tutti i confort.
Check in perfetto e perfettamente in orario.
La consiglio vivamente!
Grazie ancora e spero di tornarci presto!
Antonio and Maria’s place was in a great location for exploring Alfama. The space was cozy and had a good view of the water. Communication with the host was fantastic. Would recommend.

Perfect for exploring Lisbon. Very central and next to the lift (although we found out the hard way how many steps there are). The room is small but fine for a single traveller or couple who want to spend most of the time exploring. A perfect spot to look out to sea with a coffee and write your memoirs!
Unfortunately for us it was a bit too small as we had a toddler in tow and enough luggage for a small army. The house team had very kindly provided us with a fantastically equipped travel cot but this swamped the space. Don’t let this put you off if you are not with children as the house has neat space saving tricks and overall is very romantic. Perhaps a place we’ll come back to alone.
The team are also very professional and communication was excellent. They even picked us up at 4:30am to take us to the airport.
We absolutely fell in love with Lisbon and will return but with a more robust buggy that can handle the cobbles.
Great place!!
It is good located in the nice old centre with a lots of bars and restaurants, but a bit loud e specially during night time... However we had really nice time!:)
This is a cosy, nice place in an very good location. Perfect for a weekend stay. You have everything you need
Charming studio in a central location for our short stay in Lisboa.
Perfect position in the Alfama district. We stayed with our kids for only one night before flying back. Great service and very clean. Thanks

Cozy apartament in a perfect location. Might not be a perfect choice if you are looking for peace and quiet, but if you want to feel the vibe of the city and Alfama district - look no further.
Great restaurants and cafes within walking distance and a view of the river and Lisbon’s rooftops.

Excellent location, great host, a jewel in the heart of Lisbon. Wonderful place to explore Lisbon. Main historical tramp (line 28) just a steps away and I cannot wait to come back. And the bed is one of the most comfy ones I ever slept in.
Very clean and cozy studio in a perfect location. We had a great time and will definitely be back soon.

A lovely little flat, in a beautiful location.  Lisbon is so beautiful and magical.  The view from the flat is very beautiful.   Manuel, who was in contact with me about the flat, was lovely - so accommodating, responsive and helpful.   I appreciated this very much.  I would not hesitate at all to book again if the opportunity arose and am happy to recommend!

Antonio and Maria’s place was nothing short of amazing. It is a great location and the bed is the best sleep I’ve gotten in a while. They offer great amenities and were quick with responses. Planning our next trip already and to stay here again.
Couldn't have been more central. Right in the heart of the old city. Great view, food and drink available in every direction, and the chic decor makes the most of the space.
Well equipped small option in great location
Super Lage. Klein, aber für ein Städtetrip mit 2 Personen perfekt!
We spend just one night in this tidy little apartment but we felt very comfortable. Highly recommended!!! Thank you Manuel for your great service!

Our stay in the apartment was everything we could have expected.  Manuel was a very attentive host and arranged everything perfectly.  The location right in the heart of the Alfama District was excellent, many bars and food stalls right outside which made the apartment a perfect place to enjoy one of the most exciting districts of Lisbon
A* Recommended

This place is a genuine find. A cute little apartment in the middle of a very very hip cool neighborhood. We were met at the taxi, and shown everything we needed to know about the city and the neighborhood and the apartment.  We would definitely return.   Very high recommendation
Cosy cute little place in a perfect location, we loved our stay!

A really cute, modern place in the heart of the charming neighborhood of Alfama. The space is clean, has everything you need, and is perfect for a solo traveler or a couple. The host was very responsive and was kindly there to check me in even when my flight was delayed, causing me to arrive past midnight.
An authentic experience.  You won't be disappointed
Great location and clean and comfy place.

This is a great intimate studio, thoughtfully equipped and well presented. Great communication with Manuel who arranged airport transfers ( highly recommended ), met us at the drop off point and showed us around the space. More than just hosting, Manuel stayed in touch via What’s App and was like having a very welcome personal concierge on call when needed.
The location is superb and is a great base to explore the amazing local area and the wider city.
Highly recommended and we hope to return again in the future.
Great location and caring hosts

Me and my husband stayed at this place for three nights. Communication went very quickly and we were helped with what was needed. The location is amazing, very central and direct by tram 28. Only difficulty were the stairs, you had to walk them to reach the appartment. But on the other hand, going up and down hills and stairs is common in Lisboa. The appartment was very practical equipped yet with a warm en cozy vibe. We would definitly go back here!

Tout était parfait !  L’appartement est situé au cœur de l’Alfama et est facile d’accès !  Pour deux personnes, c’est l’idéal.  Il y a de bons restos à proximité et il est facile de se stationner lorsqu’on a une voiture ($$$).  Manuel nous a très bien reçu et il est même allé vérifier si nous avions bien stationné la voiture dans un stationnement gratuit !  Quel service !  Merci !
Amazing location and good value for money. On a really nice street, close to some nice restaurants and bars! *
The apartment is very well located, in the heart of Alfama, it is very comfortable and the view is amazing. I completely recommend it
Nice flat in a strategically great position. I recommend!
Een klein maar erg fijn appartement voor twee personen. Hoewel gelegen op het hoogste punt van Alfama is het toch goed bereikbaar middels de nabij gelegen lift.

Charming location and view
The place is cozy and well equipped( though very slow internet).
It s perfect for 1 person or 2, but probably too small for more.
The best thing about it is undoubtedly the location, which is amazing! Right next to Miradouro de Santa Luzia, and has a lovely view of the rooftops and staircase streets of Alfama, and of the sunrise over the river. It's really charming! Would definitely recommend for 1 or 2 wanting to be right in the hart of the old town and enjoy its charm.

The apartment is perfectly located in the center of Alfama. For one or two guests i really recommend this place. You will also get some very good tips for Lisbon from the host. I would definitely stay in this place again.

This place is a gem, located in a neighborhood with tons of character and walking distance to many areas. They made good use of the small space and the bed was super comfy, had the best nights rest there. Communication was prompt and the apartment is an excellent value.
It’s a great little space in the heart of Alfama

I had a wonderful stay at Antonio and Maria’s cozy apartment in Alfama. The pictures give a realistic feel to what you’ll encounter at this apartment. My point of contact was Luis- Antonio’s friend- during my stay and he was helpful and attentive to all my needs. He gave me a personalized list of things to do in Lisbon, which was very special.
If you’re planning on riding uber or lyft from the airport, I suggest you enter “Portas do Sol”- a bar nearby, as your destination. This apartment is situated in a pedestrian-only alley, so the maps app will make it difficult on your driver and will make you walk upwards a long way with heavy luggage. From Portas do Sol you can go down a set of steps and you’re there!
I highly recommend this lovely apartment in the heart of Alfama
Great place, awesome location! The communucation with the host was great and quick to resolve the wifi issue. Can really recommend!
Wonderful location, walking distance to many of the main attractions, lovely studio.

Luis was very welcoming and provides me useful information and good restaurants' address.
Tha flat is very nice, well located and very clean.
I recommand it.

La casa di Antonio e Maria è molto bella, nel centro storico di Alfama, un quartiere meraviglioso. La casa è piccola, molto ben arredata e con elementi tipici dell'architettura originale. Se pur piccola ha tutto quello che serve per trascorrere un periodo anche lungo (io ci sono stata 15 giorni) e ha un bagno con una doccia grande. Un'altra cosa importante è che è veramente pulita (cosa piuttosto rara) La vista sul fiume Tago è unica e rende la casa ancora più speciale. L'organizzazione del check in è stata perfetta e puntualissima e attenta alle miei esigenze di orari. Federico, che gestisce la casa, è molto simpatico e preciso nella comunicazione e puntuale nella risoluzione di qualunque problema. Consiglio vivamente di alloggiare qui.
Great communication, perfect location in Alfama only a few steps from Miradouro das Portas do Sol. Highly suggested!

This place is fantastic! It's located in the very heart of Alfama, the most suggestive area in Lisbon. The apartment is tidy, comfortable, with all the basic amenities, and more! The apartment is very well decorated and you can see a beautiful sight of the city out the window.  Sometimes you can hear some music coming from the street and it feels like you are perfectly integrating in the city. The communication with the owner has been fast and clear. I am very satisfied with the experience and I would definitely recommend this place to everyone!

The place is fantastic. Well located, clean and the hosts are extremely friendly. I would give them 10 stars if I could
Cheers
Fred Rêgo

Overall a pretty good experience at this apartment.  Even though it is a very small space the way they designed the apartment made it functional and had enough amenities for a short stay in Lisbon.  Antonio was a good host and met us on time. The location is great with plenty of options for sightseeing and food nearby.  Unfortunately the only option we were offered for parking in the area was EXTREMELY expensive (37 Euro for less than 24 hours) so if you have a rental car I wouldn't recommend this location. The cost of parking plus the price for such a small space made it in my opinion a bit overpriced.

Our stay at this Airbnb was rather traumatic. On the second day of our visit, our entire luggage was stolen while we were out exploring the city. The door locks in place are a laughable - they can be easily removed with an Phillips screw. Either a break or enter, or someone had accessed the unit with a key. The owner was shocked to hear about the incident, but unfortunately it was not the first time a theft had occurred in this particular Airbnb (see other user review from September 2018). The owner was helpful when we requested to relocate and had been cooperative with the police and Airbnb in the investigation. He also refunded our booking fee immediately. A major security overhaul to the apartment is needed before I can confidently recommend this place to others.
If a theft had not occurred, I would say that this Airbnb is accurately portrayed in the pictures. It is on the ground floor, located in a well-known tourist area (Alfama) which has its own pros and cons. Further to the troubles we experienced above, I also had a difficult time connecting with the host/property manager (not the same person as the owner) prior to my stay. I later found out that the Airbnb was in between property managers right before my reservation. Try to keep all correspondences on the Airbnb app - the property managers kept using my personal email and whatsapp.

Sehr schönes, gemütliches Appartement. Man findet hier alles, was man braucht.
Von hier aus lässt sich Lissabon hervorragend erkunden.
Sehr schön ist die Nähe zum Miradauro de Santa Luzia.
Wir haben uns sehr wohlgefühlt und würden gerne wiederkommen.
Well-located and functional appartement, though much smaller than what the pictures suggest. The host was very nice and accommodating.

We had a delightful stay at this apartment! It was a treat to be able to stay in Alfama, so beautiful and interesting and special. Checkin was well coordinated. Maria arranged a taxi for us from the airport on the day of our arrival, which was much appreciated. Highly recommend this Airbnb in you would like to stay in the old section of Lisbon.
I had a fantastic stay, the location was great!

This apartment is definitely a very modern space inside an authentic Portuguese residence. Be prepared for a good hike down stairs to your front door.
The location is fantastic. Close to lots of restaurants, bars and historic sites.

The apartment is small but clean and the interior is very efficient. Unfortunately, it was difficult to communicate with the host. Different people sent us Mails and nobody answered either calls, WhatsApp or mail. We didn't know if they were informed about our checkIn but when we got to the apartement, luckily a friendly lady opened the door. The location is great, the area is beautiful and there's a lot to see. A lot of tourists are running through the street but I guess you can't complain when you're a tourist yourself!
We had some small insects in the bathroom but other than that we felt really comfortable in this appartement!

A well-appointed studio in an unbeatable location of Alfama. Great amenities, comfortable bed and hot water. If you are very tall you might find your head bumping into things, but otherwise you can count on cozy comfort as life in Alfama hums right around the corner. The owners were particularly helpful to me when I experienced a theft during my stay. They advised where to go to report it, followed up personally on the incident, and showed concern for my well-being. They demonstrated the best side of Airbnb hosting.
Je recommande ce air B and B très bien localisé. Nous avons vraiment pu profiter de Lisbonne
Apartamento charmoso, em um dos bairros mais peculiares de Lisboa. Apesar de estar em meio ao burburinhos, apartamento solencioso e com facilidades.
when I come back to lisbon again here. :-)

A very well kept compact apartment in a wonderful location in the heart of Alfama the oldest and one of most authentic areas in Lisbon. Location is right next to Miradouro das Portas do Sol a perfect place to view the water. lots of character on the streets a great little restaurant a few steps away (Lisboa Tu e Eu) and more.
Bernardo and his team were prompt and accomodating. I wish I had more days in Lisbon. The place is a perfect base for a traveller on the go. Lots of love from NYC Bernardo thank you!
Beautiful spot in Portugal with amazing views!
Bernardo's studio in medieval Alfama is an incredibly lovely place to stay in what is probably the most picturesque area of Lisbon.

Thanks for the stay in your little and cosy flat. It's in the middle of
Alfama and you get everywhere
by foot.

Very nice experience! Everything was clean and clear.I felt very good during my stay and I would recommended it to anyone

nice, small flat in alfama. everything was pretty good, all the essentials are there. the blinders didn‘t fully close and there is no ac. wifi is very slow, not useful for netflix.
The apartment was clean, stylish and perfectly located! We would definitely return.

O apartamento do Bernardo é muito bem localizado, estando a poucos minutos dos melhores pontos turísticos de lisboa e das principais estações de metrô da cidade. O apartamento é perfeito para casais ou poucos amigos que estão viajando juntos.

This place is perfect. Luis greeted me and was very kind and welcoming. He went above and beyond to make me feel accommodated. Directions were clear and check in was super easy. The apartment is clean and the perfect size for me solo and could probably be comfy for 2 or maaaaybe 3. The neighborhood is Alfama which is my favorite neighborhood and the beauty lays just outside the big window. The location makes most things an easy walk. Walk anywhere and you will see 5 other awesome things on your way. (Uber is also very cheap here if your feet get tired and uber is also about 10 euro from the airport). I went in August and it was quite hot during the day but with the windows open and the provided fan the apartment feels cool.  All normal amenities were available!  The only small downfall was that the water in the shower did not get very hot. Thank you very much!

This place is definitely cozy...smaller than expectedn but did have a lovely view.  Good location in Alfama, near the water and restaurants.  Our only complaint is the 2 dead cockroaches we found; one each day of our stay.

eine schöne kleine Wohnung mitten in der Alfama gelegen
mit sehr nettem & hilfsbereitem Gastgeber!

It's cosy, there is no building opposite so no vis-à-vis. You feel good and relaxed in this flat instantly. It's very easy to go around and there are lots of good local places for a drink or some food. Communication with Bernardo was also really easy, checkin and checkout were very smooth.

Bernardo’s place was lovely! Cozy, quiet and with a glorious view. There was construction happening from around 8am until 6 everyday right above me in the building, so that was the only bit I wish I would have been informed about. Otherwise, I highly recommend his place! :)

You will be in central Alfama staying here! Although difficult to find the first time around (especially if you have luggage to walk up all the stairs) I loved my stay here. You are literally steps away from amazing food and views. It’s not the most quiet place but I’m from NYC so I’m used to the city buzzing about at night.

Perfect location if you want to stay in Alfama, and great for a single traveler or couple. Luis was very helpful upon arrival and provided many good tips on what to see and do in Lisbon. I had a great stay!

Great location. Very small apartment for what you’re paying. It’s run by a management company which means it lacks a bit of a personal touch. But if you want somewhere with a great view and you’re not to fussy about the rest then it’s a good pick.
Hyggelig lille studio ved siden af Largo das portas do sol. Parkering i parkeringshus tæt på, det er dog i den dyre ende.
Cute apartment with a great view and exceptional location. I will definitely try to book it again when I am back!
Nous avons passé un très bon séjour dans ce logement bien agencé et bien placé au cœur de l'Alfama

Eine sehr gute und sehr saubere Unterkunft in toller Lage, wenn man mitten in der Alfama wohnen will. Für meinen Besuch des "Sardinenfestes" war diese Wohnung perfekt!
Allerdings sollte man gut zu Fuß sein - es geht nur Treppen 'rauf oder Treppen 'runter!
Aber dafür wohnt man direkt am wohl bekanntesten Mirador Lissabons.
Great find!!

Die Wohnung liegt super schön zentral mitten  in Alfama. Alles an Ausstattung, was man benötigt, war vorhanden. Check-In und Check-Out haben gut geklappt.  Leider hatten wir ein kleines Kakerlakenproblem, um das sich einen Tag später gekümmert  wurde.
pretty good
Beautiful place centrally located. There was an issue one night when the entire block lost power, but I really appreciated the host’s super quick response and helpfulness regarding the issue.
Nice spot in a great city.

The location of this apartment is great! It will be the center of celebratuons in June! The space had all the necessities. We thank Antonio and Maria for the beautifly cozy appartment. Antonio prepared a message with lots of tips around Lisbon, wich was really nice. We loved the surrounding Alfama quartier.

This apartment was amazing! The location was great... beautiful view of the river right out our window. Antonio was easy to communicate with and very friendly. He included great tips for visiting Lisbon and we enjoyed his suggestions. Great place.

This tiny, but very cosy apartment is in an excellent location, can‘t be better in order to explore downtown Lisboa. However “travel light” you may need to carry your luggage down some steps.

Antonio is the best! Super friendly and hospitable. My friend and I didn't have a chance to stay too long in Lisbon, and so he immediately offered up some amazing tips on what we should check out so we could make the most of our stay.
The apartment, while cozy, has so much character and is central to everything. Great value especially if you are splitting the cost with someone else. Would definitely look into this place if I ever have the opportunity to visit Lisbon again.
Thanks, Antonio!

Antonio's place is the center of medieval Lisbon. The flat is tiny, and space and the neighborhood reminds of you a place 500 years ago. Ofcourse it's remodeled and has a bunch of amenities.
Joao was very gracious, waited for me for hours upon my late check-in and gave me plenty of local tips.

This is a true gem. It’s in the heart of Alfama, just a staircase away from Largo Portas do Sol, at the footsteps of the beautiful castle. The flat is perfect for a solo traveller like myself or a couple (must be very in love!) as it is quite small but perfectly proportioned. Facing the Tagus, you go to sleep looking at the fairy lights along the river and you wake up bright an early with the seagulls. Although it is very central It is not noisy at all. House was perfectly cleaned and the check-in was very smooth. I would highly recommend this place! Thanks for having me once again, obrigada!
Great location !
Luis est très gentil et explique très bien. L'emplacement est top....
Amazing space and hosts for a few days in Lisbon. Cozy, clean, and safe with a beautiful view--I would most definitely be back if in town.

This apartment was beautiful and perfect for my solo trip to lisbon. The view is  wonderful, as is the neighbourhood! Luis ( who was there to check me in) was so helpful and gave me a great list of "things to do in Lisbon".  He also checked in to make sure everything  was okay, which I really appreciated. I would highly recommend this place and would go back in a heartbeat.
Cozy and clean. Great location. Alfama is very pitoresque. A perfect spot to start discover Lisbon by walking. Nice little restaurants near by. You can reach the Fado Museum within minutes.
Definitely a must to stay in a great walking area of Lisbon, definitely a great location from which to visit the whole city
Schöne kleine Unterkunft mit Blick auf das Meer

Situation très appropriée pour découvrir Lisbonne à pied tout en appréciant la proximité de très bons restaurants. Cadre très agréable et situation privilégiée pour prendre des photos de lever et coucher de soleil. Très bon contact avec le propriétaire et son entourage.

Great appartment with wonderful view! Love this place. Super location close to all hotspots and great food.
Had a wonderful time.
Great host! Great communication!

One of the better places I've stayed at in Porto. Great location located 60 seconds walking to tram 28 stop.
The apartment has views of the Sea and the rest of Alfama not super big but cozy enough for two people with a working kitchen and great bathroom.
Great value for the money.

I absolutely loved the 3 days I spent at Antonio’s place. Luis filled in for him while he was out and was extremely responsive and helpful in getting me to the apartment and letting me settle in. The apartment is located in a picturesque neighborhood - narrow winding streets and scenic vistas all around. It’s a great neighborhood to wander around and stumble into wonderful restaurants, cafes or little stores. It’s also within walking distance of a couple of the bigger attractions like the Sao Jorge castle and Commerce Square.
The apartment had a great vibe to it too - the kind of apartment that makes you feel like you’re in a new place and encourages you to explore the neighborhood and the city. But also the kind of apartment that you’re thrilled to come back to and relax at after a long day. It was extremely cozy and maintained well.
I would definitely go back to Antonio’s place the next time I’m in Lisbon.

It was a nice clean room and very comfortable place.
It’s nice location and easy to get around the city. I enjoyed the view from the room every morning.
Antonio is a nice person. He taught me about the city and recommends some places.

Cute, adorable, clean apartment that has everything one needs! Centrally located in beautifully, hilly Alfama. It was the perfect place for me traveling on my own. Check in was brief, kind and provided me with the most important details of the apartment. If you're an independent traveler in need of a safe, comfortable space to start your exploration from, I can highly recommend this place. I would definitely book this Airbnb again.
Luis was an excellent greeter and the place has lovely views. Bring a detailed map with you as there was little in the apartment except a guide book in Portugese.
Just a really perfect place to be!
Great location for exploring Lisbon. Clean and tidy. Everything that I needed. Thanks!

Location is very nice and convenient,

Really, other neighborhoods in Lisbon are just as beautiful as Alfama, and I’d rather not go to a place that regards me as pollution.
Un très bon emplacement pour découvrir Lisbonne
Super airbnb! Très bien placé, silencieux la nuit et très propre!

Great location - easy to find (Antonio’s directions really simple to follow) and near to no. 28 tram route and some very good restaurants.  Flat is small, but well designed to make best use of the space and had everything we needed. Would certainly stay here again if returning to Lisbon.
Wonderful stay, clean and comfortable!

All essentials were supplied and communication with Antonio and his friend went seamlessly. There's a wonderful view of the river and incoming cruise ships from the window and seeing the sunrise every morning was a welcome treat. Two things to note: there is no AC, so may get warm in the summer but a fan is provided (we stayed in October and it were very comfortable). The apartment is in the middle of walking streets which means no direct street access. This means you'll have to carry your luggage down some stairs but comes with the advantage of having complete quiet. Would definitely stay here again!

Absolutely loved staying at Antonio and Maria's apartment. It was in a fabulous location and had great views of the river, especially if you catch the sunrise! Communication was efficient and fast. Although I wasn't able to meet my hosts, their friend João checked us in and was informative and so friendly. Would definitely recommend and will be happy to stay here again on my next trip to Lisbon.
Hôtes très attentifs à notre confort !
Excellent location and great space - would definitely recommend !
