The apartment is definitely cozy but has everything you need. Perfectly clean and the host was very responsive to help us check-in. The best feature is certainly the location - right in the heart of Alfama with a great view over the city down to the river. This is a perfect base to explore and enjoy Lisbon's best neighborhood.
Great little place with everything required and in an excellent location

Second time staying at Antonio's apartment and would definitely stay again in the future.
Clean, well-presented, a great base to explore Lisbon. Would recommend to everyone.

If u want to stay in Alfama this is the place. It is in the middle of one of the winding streets the neighborhood is known for. Plus if ur awake at sunrise the window fills with the sun coming up across the harbor which is spectacular. Inside the apartment is clean, well furnished, cozy and comfortable. My host was nice and helped me locate a specialty shop I was looking for. Over all it was a great experience.
Wir haben uns in der Wohnung sehr Wohlgefühlt, sie ist klein und schön und hat einen tollen Blick auf den Tejo.
We had a great time at Antonio's place. It was really conveniently located and perfect for a short stay.
El apartamento es muy lindo, está muy bien equipado y Alfama el m es un lugar genial. Muy recomendable.

An uber may be only four euro, but the hike up and down the many hills of Lisbon is worth it for the experience, scenery, culture, and surprise restaurants!
antonio's apartment is really nice and corresponds exactly to what you see in the listing. the area is one of the most lively in Lisbon and the view is fantastic!
Everything was great and worked perfectly. Nice apartment and beautiful city!

Super bel emplacement ! directement à la porta de sol ! On ne peut être plus prêt. Bien situé dans Alfama. The appartment is very cozy and near to the main places of alfama, perfect for a couple. The view is amazing, you can catch the perfect view of the sunrise from the window.
Great, very comfortable apartment in exactly the right area for exploring Lisbon. A bit noisy at night due to neighbours, street-cleaning, etc, but there's not much that can be done about that.

L'appartamento è molto carino e piccolo ma c'è tutto, ottima posizione ma essendo un quartiere molto movimentato lo è anche di notte. I proprietari sono un po' ritardatari e non ti vengono incontro con il Check in.

보이시는 사진과 크게 다르지 않지만 생각보다 훨씬 더 좁습니다. 그리고 구시가지 바로 중심이라 굉장히 혼잡하고 길이 좁고 계단이 많이 답답합니다. 다운타운과 거리가 꽤 됩니다. 그리고 숙소에 에어컨 없어서 후덥지근하니 그 점 참고하시고 제가 숙소에 있을 땐 개미와 바퀴벌레가 나와서 원래 3일 숙박 예정이었는데 하루만 묵고 바로 호텔로 이동했습니다. 체크인 9시 이후로 해서 25유로를 더 받았는데 이게 설명란에 미리 써져있는 정보라 제대로 확인 안 한 제 잘못도 있으나 저는 수 많은 에어비앤비 사용하면서 늦은 체크인으로 추가비용 받은 경우는 처음이었습니다. 심지어 원래 설명란에는 10유로라고 써 있었는데 다음날 제가 확인차 스크린샷 찍어서 왜 10유로인데 25유로를 내게햇느냐 하고 메세지를 보내니 메세지 답은 없었고 설명란에는 25유로라고 바뀌어있었습니다. 벌레도 나오고 답고 위치도 안 좋아 제가 그냥 체크아웃하겠다고 하니 그제서야 메세지 답이 오더군요. 그렇다고 호텔특가들에 비하면 가격이 엄청난 차이로 저렴한 것도 아니라 기분만 상한 숙박이었습니다.
Great little apartment in the heart of Alfama.

Antonio et Luis ont été des hôtes tres gentils et surtout disponibles qui feront tout pour que votre séjour se passe pour le mieux.
Merci d'avoir été là pour nous quand nous en avions besoin.

Antonio was a great host giving us all kinds of tips and suggestions. His place itself is super clean and cozy and perfectly located to roam around Alfama and explore the rest of Lisbon. Awesome experience!

What an endearing way to see Lisbon's Alfama district. We heard Fado in the streets, ate great food, and even found a nearby restaurant selling IPA! Thanks for the wonderful stay in Lisbon! Next time we will stay for much longer!
Very easy check in, check out. Great location, lots of excellent local tips. Recommended, thanks!
We loved staying at Antonio's place. It was cozy and cute. Just what we were looking for during our stay in Alfama. We would recommend for anyone who wants to experience daily life in this area.

Wir waren 3 Tage in dieser tollen kleinen Wohnung in. Es kam uns vor, wie eine "Oase der Ruhe" in dem lebendigen Alfama. Es hat an nichts gefehlt. Die Kommunikation war perfekt.

Antonio's apartment is in a phenomenal location in Alfama and has a breathe taking view from the window. It's really easy to get to as it's just a few steps down from Portas do Sol which is one of the main squares in Alfama.
Antonio provided amazing directions on how to get to the Airbnb and offered great communication on arrival and was at the Airbnb waiting for us on arrival. Great place to stay!

We loved staying at this apartment in Alfama. It was in walking distance to most things, and was an interesting and vibrant neighborhood. The apartment is lovely, but definitely has tight quarters in some corners. Great location. Nice and clean apartment. Lively neighborhood. Good value. Would stay here again!

Séjour très agréable au sein d'Alfama, petit studio fort agréable, avec toutes les commodités, nous n'avons pas eu à faire directement à Antonio, mais à Luis qui nous a très bien reçu et renseigné Merci pour tout

Nice Appartement, good communication with Antonio.
Great place! I was really impressed.

The apartment was great, best location within the city! It's perfect for a weekend in Lisbon or even longer. Muy bien anfitrión. Muchas gracias
The flat was better than I expected, I love the decoration, and we had everything we needed. The bed was very confortable, and the location was perfect and a very nice view.

Marc's place is in the heart of the Alfama district.  It is a cozy apartment but it has everything that you would need. This place is good for a couple. Marco’s studio is a little gem! The neighborhood is amazing and the studio is lovely; you totally get the local colour. Awesome spot in the heart of the historical area! Moments walk to the water! The apartment was perfect!!!!

I highly recommend Marco's app for couple wanted to stay in a very heart of old Lisboa. Small but comfy and cosy place in a walking distance to most of interesting sites. Contact with Marco was just perfect;) helping and friendly as every host should be;)

Wir hatten eine tolle Zeit in Lissabon. Dank der super Lage von Marcos Appartement haben wir uns "mitten drin gefühlt". Wir kommen gerne wieder!
Kim und Kai
Great location, close to everything! Marco was very helpful throughout our stay.

Make sure to use the elevators, or get ready for a hefty (but scenic) hike!
Great communication, smooth check-in, ideal location especially if you plan on wandering the beautiful streets of Alfama! We would absolutely stay here again!

Nice place ! Tiny but cozy

계단이 많은 동네라서 캐리어를 가진 우리에게는 이동하기가 매우 힘든 곳이었지만 바로 앞에 전망대도 있고 동네도 너무 좋았고 창문으로 바다가 보여서 너무 좋았어요 사정상 1박밖에 못했는데 숙소도 너무 아늑하고 깔끔하고 다음에 꼭 또 오고싶은 숙소에요

Despite Marco being away when we were staying in the apartment, he was very attentive and helped us out a lot. It's perfect for two people, has great facilities and is very clean...there isn't an oven though so don't go expecting to cook with one. Amazing location hidden away in the streets of Alfama. Easy check in and check out. Wish we could've stayed here longer. Thank you Marco!

Logement sympa pour un week-end en amoureux, très bien situé avec une belle vue sur le Tage et même s'il est petit est très bien aménagé et bien équipé. Appartement, accueil, communication, emplacement tout était parfait je recommande sans hésitation !

Super petit appart ultra fonctionnel et bien placé!

The flat was amazing, so romantic, and located in a historical centre, right next to the famous monuments.. so perfect location! Check-in and out was easy and on time!

Thanks!

The flat was amazing and Marco has been very helpful when I arrived with such a short notice.

My wife and I really enjoyed Marco's place. The location is great, right on the 28E tram line and a short walk from the metro. Un studio adorable et cozy en plein coeur de l'Alfama avec en prime une très jolie vue ! Nous avons beaucoup apprécié. De plus Marco est très avenant, il a très bien préparé notre arrivée. Je recommande !
A very nice apartment in a great district. Marco was very helpful and welcoming.

Great flat and awesome location!

The flat is quiet in Alfama. However as pedestrian streets are tiny, don't expect no noise at all.

Istancia perfecta, organización y logística inmejorable.Muy recomendable.

The perfect place for a stay in Lisbon. The flat is located into a pedestrian street in the Alfama's area who is one of the most central and nice of the city. I warmly recommend this place

The apartment is what it says. It is clean and have all the basics. It's in a lovely neighborhood and easy to get around town from, either by walking or tram. Marco sent information about restaurant, places to see etc which was very helpful.
Cozy flat in the middle of Alfama. Communication with Marco was very good and he provided lots of useful information.

The house is neat and cozy but it was very cold at winter nights because there was only one tiny heater. The spot was nice. we could walk to various places in lisbon and 28 tram stops near the house. Tout était parfait, la situation de l'appartement, le charme, l'accueil même si nous n'avons pas eu le plaisir et de rencontrer Marco. Il a été présent par messages et téléphone tout au Long de notre séjour. Sylvie et david

Un appartement petit mais où on e sent tout de suite à l'aise. Proche des transport, et propre je le recommande vivement pour les couples. Un peu surprise par la vue qui n'était pas aussi "prenante" qu'on le pensait.
Amazing and comfortable place in a great location. The bed was great and everything was thoughtfully provided for. Marco was a superb host who was always on hand if needed even if he was away.

Marco's apartment is ideal for expending some days in Lisbon: it is charming, bright, very beautiful and very comfortable. Also, the location is amazing, in the heart of Alfama. I would recommend this place to anyone interested in visiting Lisbon and I would ofc repeat!

Amazing flat, in an amazing area. Went as a couple, the only complaint is that we couldn't stay longer. Marco was great, fantastic communication, we had a change in arrival time that he accommodated which he didn't need to. Also his recommendations for the city were a nice touch. Go Marco, Go Lisbon!

Marco ist sehr nett und permanent erreichbar. Man fühlt sich die ganze Zeit wunderbar betreut. Die Wohnung ist sehr klein, dennoch gemütlich und nett eingerichtet. What a wonderful place ! The apartment of Marco is great. In the heart of the enchanting Alfama area. With a great view. Appartement calme, cosy et très bien situé dans l'Alfama, d'un arrangement et d'une propreté impeccable! Une des meilleures expériences Airbnb jusqu'à présent.

El apartamento de Marco está situado en pleno barrio residencial de Alfama, en el corazón de Lisboa. Tiene todo lo necesario para conocer la ciudad durante una corta estancia y unas bonitas vistas del Tajo a través de sus ventanas. Sin duda, muy recomendable!
Marco's apartment is located in the residential Alfama district, in the heart of Lisbon. Is only a few minutes walking to several of the most important places in Lisbon and few meters far from the tram stop. The apartment has all you need in a short stay to explore the city and beauty views of the Tajo River from its windows. No doubt, recommended!
Great place, great location.

Marco's apartment was perfect for the real Lisbon experience. The location was absolutely gorgeous. Not to mention that it was a very safe area and easy to meet other people if you're traveling alone.
Marco was very helpful, and accommodated an early check in for me, which was so convenient after my overnight flight.
Highly recommend and would definitely stay there again next time I visit Lisbon.

Marco était à l'étranger lors de notre arrivée, mais une des ses amies nous a accueilli et nous avons échangé par téléphone avec Marco.

L'appartement se trouve dans le quartier de l'Alafama, très typique, avec une jolie vue sur le Taje.
Très bon séjour à Lisbonne, nous y retournerons certainement en été ;)

Die Wohnung ist super charmant, mitten in Alfama und trotzdem total ruhig. Marco hat uns tolle Tipps gegeben und sich sehr nett um unser Wohl gekümmert. Da wir etwas früher angekommen sind, hat uns eine Bekannte die Wohnung geöffnet. Ganz in der Nähe sind Restaurants und Cafés, Bars mit Fado und man kann von dort die Stadt zufuß erforschen. Die Wohnung ist sauber, klein und fein. Wenn wir wieder in Lissabon sind werden wir versuchen, wieder bei Marco zu wohnen. Herzlichen Dank!
Perfect!!

Both my wife and myself love this self contained studio apartment and its location. It has everything you need for a comfortable stay. Will stay again in future. Host and its rep have made good effort to ensure we are properly received and oriented.
The appartement is lovely located and has everything you need. We had a great time!
Marco have been a very good host, the appartment is perfectly located in a very pretty street, near the best places of Alfama; the flat is nice and there is a beautiful view on the river. Thanks!
Very cozy and well located apartment. No difficulty with finding the place or check in, very tidy and absolutely great view from the window. Already missing this place.

El apartamento tal cual venía en la descripción, muy céntrico. De tamaño es perfecto para dos, algo pequeño para 4. The place is in a perfect location to see a lot of the famous landmarks in Lisbon. Alfalfa is beautiful and this apartment is in right in the middle of it. It has everything that you'd need for a stay in Lisbon. I would definitely re-book if I come back to the city.

Nous avons pu trouver sans difficulté dans ce quartier si pittoresque de l'Affama grâce aux explications données. La vue sur le Tage offre un spectacle qui se renouvelle sans cesse. L'appartement a beaucoup de charme. propre et clair, il comporte tout ce qu'il faut.
Je recommande ce séjour à qui souhaite profiter du charme de Lisbonne et découvrir aisément la ville.

It was really grateful. Marco is so amazing host. I didn't meet him because he left to the other country for his work, but he was very kind and thoughtful on message and call. I didn't feel any inconvenience during stay. The flat is very clean and cozy, also good location for look around Lisboa by walk or use tram. The Best!
Great location and apartment.

Perfect flat in Alfama, very close from Lisbon charming places. We are stayed 2 nights inside and we have loved this cosy apartement (beautiful bathroom !!).

Marco is really available, helpful. Furthermore, he speaks a good french!
Continue like that!

We absolutely loved Marco's flat. It is in the heart of Alfama (the best part of Lisbon in my humble opinion). It was a wonderful stay and I recommend the experience to anyone.

Fantastic location, with a wonderful view just like the photos, and giving the feeling of really living in the city. Plenty of bars, restaurants, cafes etc all around. The apartment is small but perfect for a few days to tour Lisbon. The space is clean and modern, but quaint. We really enjoyed a wonderful stay!

Das Appartement war sehr schön gelegen und man hat alle Sehenswürdigkeiten der Stadt gut erreicht. Wie beschrieben, ist das Appartement relativ klein, aber vollkommend ausreichend und man hat alles, was man braucht.
Einzig ein Nachbar im Haus war in mehreren Nächten sehr laut, sodass man teilweise nicht erholsam schlafen konnte (trotz Ohrstöpseln).

Marco was very responsive, and communicated very well. His list of recommendations was very helpful.

The only drawback of the apartment was the large number of stairs that you must drag your luggage up and down, to get to and from the apartment. You must be somewhat strong and fit to accomplish this.

Marcos place is in the heart of Alfama and one of the best Airbnb experience I had so far. The flat is small but it has all you need to discover the charming city of Lisbon.
Although I have never met Marco personally the communication via phone/text was just perfect. He also coordinated some extras, e.g. we could leave the luggage in the flat until the check-in time of the next guests.

Die Wohnung ist super gelegen, jede Menge Sehenswertes ist fußläufig erreichbar. Sie ist recht klein, aber sehr geschmackvoll und funktional eingerichtet, so dass man sich auch gerne darin aufhält. Die Tipps zu Taxi, Bussen etc. sowie Restaurants waren sehr hilfreich. Wir würden die Wohnung wieder nehmen.

Très bon accueil d'un ami de Marco, avec toutes les indications nécessaires; on se sent chez soi très vite et le quartier est très authentique,  agréable et a beaucoup de charme; l'appartement est bien conçu et fonctionnel; c'était une belle expérience.

The flat is very well located. It was a little bit weird at the begining since the person we welcome us did not speak english, but she got a translator and everything ended up well.

The host was very welcoming and gave precise information on how to get to the flat.

Nous avons adoré ce petit studio, location parfaite, vue imprenable et le quartier est fantastique.

Alfama is in the heart of the city with so much cultural and historic charm.   The view from the apartment is great too and you feel like you are living like a local instantly. The space is clean, modern, minimal but still has all the amenities you need. Thank you.
Marco is a very responsive host. The accomodation is tiny, but cozy and clean and is located in the heart of Alfama.

Everything exactly as described. Great neighbourhood...just like the airbnb motto "don't go there, live there";-). Marco wasn't around himself but very responsive. Would chose it again when in Lisbon!

Marco was great. The place was cute and like in the photos. Great neighborhood. Checkin time was a bit later than ideal, and I ended up having to wait to check in, but it seemed like Marco did his best to reduce the time. He gave a thoughtful list of recommendations. Very nice guy

Thanks a lot for this wonderful apartment that made our trip unforgettable :)

Marco was a super-nice host. Even if he was not in town he really made an effort to make our stay as easy and comfortable as possible. The flat is very nice and the location of the flat is great.
Marco was a very helpful host. His communication was exceptional.  The apartment was clean and tidy and we had a great night.
Idealnie! Perfekcyjnie!

Appartement très bien situé pour visiter Lisbonne. Petit mais bien agence, parfait pour un couple. En plein cœur de l'alfama, a 2 min du largo porta dos sole, vous pourrez facilement rejoindre tous les quartiers de Lisbonne grâce au tram 28 qui s'arrête juste à porta dos sole. Marco est italien et très sympathique. Il vous donnera de bons plans pour votre séjour
Absolutely perfect location. Cosy, with great views too. Everything was very easy and we'd definitely stay there again.

Beautiful Lisbon experience! The apartment is great for a romantic get away.
Marco was a great host. Everything was in order and we felt well taken care of in case of questions.
would definitely book again.

We had a great time in Lisboa. The place was just the right size with all that we needed. Location was easy and central to all that we wanted to do. Your recommendations and suggestions and directions were welcomed and perfect! Thank you!
The neighbourhood is great

the accommodation was amazing. both Marco and Mira was super helpful when we arrived early. they even gave us a good recommendation on some breakfast place. the location is walking distance to most of the attractions so it's all good.

Marco est très réactif et a su nous donner toutes les précisions nécessaires afin que notre arrivée se passe dans les meilleures conditions.
L'appartement est très bien situé ( quartier de l'Alfama), un peu petit mais très bien agencé. Nous sommes restés 11 jours et une machine à laver serait la bienvenue ( sous réserve de place pour l'installer..).
je recommande !
Exactly as advertised.  Easy to book.  Open line of communication.  Safe, clean, cozy, and a beautiful view. Perfect for 1-2 people.

We had a great time in Marco's apartment. He wasn't in town when we where there but he responded very quickly when we had questions. He provided us with a lot of information on restaurants etc.
The neighbourhood is quite noisy but that was no surprise since we knew where the apartment is located, so it didn't bother us.
The apartment is very well equipped.

although i could only talk to marco on the phone, he seems to be a very nice guy and great host. he has been very responsive and supportive before our stay providing us with all kinds of good information. the apartment is great. it is not very big, but marco has managed to equip it perfectly with everything you will need in a very pretty and neat way - inspiring! it was cleaned just before our arrival and hence was absolutely clean. it is located in the nicest neighborhood of lisbon which i came to love in only one day. you have a nice view and are very central to reach the centre in walking distance. we can only recommend you to stay in this apartment!

I would give Marco 10 stars instead of five for communication. His directions were detailed and he provided so much information about his neighborhood and how to get around.
Although Marco was out of town, he checked in frequently and had someone there to greet us when we arrived.
Fantastic experience !

Veramente soddisfatti dell'alloggio. Il quartiere è già di per sé una cartolina, questo alloggio (rispondente all'annuncio) ci ha fatto sentire parte del quartiere.
Marco è stato molto disponibile.
Alla prossima

The apartment was very centrally located, just a few corners away from the best places in old town. I enjoyed that everything was just a short walk away. Apartment was very clean and overall what I've expected. It had everything you would need for a short city trip. Marco was very quick to answer all my questions. Just to note that it's Pedestrian street around this house and you can hear vibe up and until midnight because probably you will want to keep windows open for fresh air.. Also bring your own shower gel, shampoo, etc. Everything else is provided.

Marco était en voyage mais il a été très agréable et disponible au téléphone. Nous avons été accueillis par Mira qui a été vraiment très gentille et accueillante malgré notre heure d'arrivée tardive.
Le quartier était très animé par une fête donc bruyant (pas après 1h) mais cela nous a permis de faire une immersion dans la vie des lisboètes. L'appartement est petit mais très propre, fonctionnel (un bémol pour le grille pain!!) joli et avec une très jolie vue. Merci à Marco et Mira.

Marco est un hôte très prévenant et à l'écoute. Avant notre arrivée il nous a envoyé un dossier très complet sur les transports, les magasins d'alimentations, les restaurants du quartier... Il n'était pas là à notre arrivée mais nous avons été très bien accueilli par Mira et nous sommes resté en contact avec Marco par sms quand cela a été nécessaire, il a été vraiment très arrangeant, merci à lui.
L'appartement est vraiment très bien, petit, cozi, bien aménagé avec du charme. Bon rapport qualité/prix. Parfait pour deux personnes. Nous recommandons vivement ce logement aux amoureux de Lisbonne, qui aiment marcher et se perdre de ruelles en escaliers... Le quartier est un des plus typiques de Lisbonne et nous avons adoré y vivre.
Un seul avertissement, si vous venez au moment de la fête de Saint Antoine (qui est vraiment chouette à vivre et pour faire la fête avec les Lisboates), l'appartement est situé juste au dessus d'une "guinguette" qui du 10 au 13 juin fait grillé des sardines et accueille les clients jusqu'à 3 heures du matin dans une ambiance festive et musicale haute en énergie... Nous nous en sommes bien sorti avec des boules quies et les fenêtres fermées... A part cela, nous avons beaucoup apprécié notre séjour chez Marco et nous recommandons vivement ce logement.
Un excellent séjour dans cet appartement certes petit mais surtout très bien agencé et tres bien situé.

We had a great time in this apartment which seems to be at the  heart of  all the  excitement found in the old-town Alfama area.  The view to the river is a big plus and it is interesting to see the huge cruise ships come and go.  Another plus for us was being able to enjoy the city during the day and then come back at night and watch the French Open Tennis tournament that I was able to record on the provided DVR/Cable box : )

Marco was a very helpful and super friendly host and provided us with some very useful insider tipps...We could'nt have enjoyed our stay in Marco's cozy flat in the most beautiful part of Lisbon more!

Quaint little apartment - basically just one room. In a very noisy area of town, but luckily I can sleep through anything :)
Super nice host Marco, very communicative and very clean place. Really enjoyed my stay!

Wir hatten eine großartige Zeit in Lissabon. Das Appartement liegt perfekt inmitten der Altstadt von Alfama. Es hat ein elegantes Design und vom Fenster einen großartigen Ausblick auf den Fluss und die großen Kreuzfahrtschiffe die dort vor Anker gegangen sind. Das Appartement ist zwar klein, aber völlig ausreichend für 2 Personen. Es hat alles was man braucht. Es ist geschmackvoll eingerichtet, sehr sauber und hat ein geräumiges und komfortables Bett sowie Badezimmer. Die Kommunikation mit Marco war stets vorbildlich. Er hat schon lange vor unserer Reise Kontakt mit uns aufgenommen und uns sehr hilfreiche Informationen und Empfehlungen zum bevorstehenden Aufenthalt gegeben. Er hat sich die ganze Zeit über um uns gekümmert und all unsere Fragen und Anliegen beantwortet. Es war fantastisch hier in Alfama bei Marco gewohnt zu haben. Wir können es nur jedem Weiterempfehlen.

Marco is very helpfull and take care about your arriving and your stay. We get a lot of Information and it was each time a good recommandation.
The Flat is small but hat every thing what you need. And the Bed is very good.

Appartement très sympa et super bien placé ! Il n'est pas très grand mais très bien aménagé. Il est parfait pour un couple qui souhaite passer quelques jours à Lisbonne.
Hôte très accueillant et disponible (malgré notre retard...) !

Nous avons apprécié notre accueil par João, très gentil (il parle très bien français), qui nous a fournit de bonnes adresses sur Lisbonne. Super appart, très bien situé au coeur du quartier Alfama. Je recommande!

Un gros merci Marco!
Posizione perfetta, appartamento pulito e fedele alle foto pubblicate. Lenzuola profumate e materasso comodo! Perfetto per visitare la bellissima Lisbona!

Great apartment with a good view over the river and well located for local amenities. Just the right size for two people for a few nights. Most importantly, clean bathroom, reliable internet, comfortable bed!

Marco was very helpful and responsive to our queries.

We would definitely stay here again.

I would stay here again in a heartbeat!  What a perfect apartment in a perfect location.  Marco is very responsive to every question - getting the key was easy and we got great restaurant recommendations.  The flat is on a long pedestrian stairway right in the middle of the Alfama - you can practically hear the Fado from your window.  The view of the cruise ships out your window is lovely.  The flat has everything you need - is very nicely decorated and has a spacious bathroom and shower.  I could live there!  We walked all throughout the town  - cabs are easy to hail right at the top of the stairs if you'd like.  Took a cab from the train station which was a good idea.  Had a wonderful time.  We had to call a cab for a very early pick up to the airport and Marco gave us a number and it was very easy - they spoke English and were waiting when we walked out the door.  Just a really perfect stay!  We love Lisbon!  We took the Eat, Walk, Drink Lisbon Food Tour that starts at the Time Out Market (to which we walked to from the flat) and would highly recommend it  - it takes you to see other neighborhoods.

Nice cozy studio in an ancient house in the old city of Lisbon.
We asked for two seperate beds and got one. The checkin was difficult - nobody there and nobody answering the phone.

The apartment is simple amazing: everything new, carefully decorated, with a really special light during the day... In addition you can feel why Marco is a superhost from the first minute: taking care of everything before and during your stay. Absolutely recommendable!!!!

Sehr gute Lage des Apartments, inmitten der Gassen von Alfama, in direkter Nähe zu vielen Restaurants, sowie zu einer wunderbaren Aussichtsplattform (Portas do Sol). Das Apartment ist klein, jedoch für 2 Personen völlig ausreichend. Sauberes Bad.
Marco selbst war während es Aufenthaltes nicht in Lissabon, dennoch gute Kommunikation. Marco schickte einen Bekannten zur Schlüsselübergabe (die reibungslos funktionierte), und erkundigte sich zwischendurch nach unserem Befinden. Unkomplizierter Check-out.
Gutes Preis-Leistungsverhältnis bei grandioser Lage. Jederzeit zu empfehlen!

Petit studio très agréable et fonctionnel en plein cœur du quartier Alfama. Nous nous y sommes sentis très bien ! Beaucoup de choses sont accessibles à pied. Idéal pour découvrir la ville !
Très bon accueil, et des échanges réguliers avec Marco qui nous a fourni beaucoup d'informations. On recommande !

Great communication with Marco who was very accomodating with us. The apartment is in a fabulous area in the Alfama district with amazing views. It is very small however! But the bathroom and shower is great, the bed is spacious and very comfortable and you get to stay in a beautiful historic building with wooden floors and lots of charm, and you have your own entrance. Plus you can hang your clothes on the washing line outside the window!

Anche se non ho avuto il piacere di incontrare Marco devo dire che la comunicazione è stata ottima. La casa è piccola (ideale per una persona) ma accogliente. Ha una splendida vista ed è in una zona veramente caratteristica. Era molto bello uscire di casa e incontrare decine di turisti che ci passavano davanti. Mi sento di consigliare questa sistemazione.

I had a lovely time at Marco's apartment in Alfama. Even if I didn't had the chance to meet him, he was very kind and the communication was excellent. The neighborhood is so pretty and the apartment is cosy and functional. Definitely recommended!

Marco is a really helpful host, who coped generously with our delay in arrival. He replied promptly to every contact, and send useful information in advance.
The apartment is lovely, very small - but all that is needed for a short stay, with a great view and a comfortable bed. The location is fantastic!

Accueil sympathique de Marco qui était là à l'arrivée. Beaucoup d'informations utiles m'ont été données (bons restaurants, sites à visiter, pratique des transports).
Le studio était propre et agréable, conforme au descriptif. Je ne peux que recommander cette location aux futurs visiteurs.
Pierre

Marco was a great host - met us at the apartment and showed us where to find everything. The apartment was in an ideal location and very well presented. Overall, a brilliant experience - would definitely stay again.

Me agrada acordarme de las vacaciones que he disfrutado en el apartamento de Marco . Un alojamiento minimalista en el cual hay de todo y nada sobra. Un apartamento en el cual tomarse un café con leche al amanecer mientras disfrutas del paisaje observando el lento transcurrir del río Tajo.

The flat was really nice, sunny on the morning, with,a good view and confortable.
Thanks, we enjoyed the 2 nights and days!!

La casa è tanto carina quanto un po piccola! Per stare qualche giorno in più di un fine settimana forse si sta un po stretti!la posizione è buon per scoprire la zona più caratteristica di Lisbona! Marco è molto disponibile a dare sempre utili consigli e informazioni!

Marco was really helpful with all the details regarding our stay. The location was ideal, as it was in the most traditional neighborhood of Lisbon, close to the tram and the city center. The house was clean, small and cosy with all the necessary equipment. Totally recommended for couples.

I spend wonderful days in Lisbon also thanks to the flat of Marco. It is very well situated : just a few stairs and you can reach largo das portas do sol, with a heart-breaking panorama. So, "coming back home", was always amazing. The flat of Marco is cozy and perfect for two, everything is correct. Marco helped us with indications, informations and the communication were always very quickly.

Marco's accomodation/appartment was one of the best places I've ever stayed in on my travels. The location & view are wonderful and you wake up in the best neighbourhood of whole Lisboa (in my opinion) Its almost like fairy tale to live in the traditional neighbourhood Alfama and waking up on the traditional Fado music.
The appartment is small and cozy but was perfect and big for me as 1 person. When I come back to Lisboa I will definetely try to sleep in this place again. Marco Thanks and Obrigado and maybe I will see you next time in Real Life in the beautiful Lisboa!

Greetings,
Ties.

L'appartement de Marco est parfait: très bien situé, avec une vue imprenable sur le Tage.
L'accueil a été très bien fait.
J'ai eu un gros souci une nuit, tard: je me suis fait voler mon sac à la terrasse d'un restaurant. Et j'ai trouvé admirable la façon de réagir de Marco et Mira: ils ont été extrêmement bienveillants, d'une aide précieuse et d'une très grande générosité.

We had a wonderful time in Lisbon. The apartment is very clean and cosy. The small place is used in a smart and efficint way. The neighborhood is also nice and you are very close to everything.
Marco is a great host, he provided lots of information for us. Unfortunately we did not meet him in person but we talked on the phone and texted. A friend of his let us in the apartment even though it was pretty late. Would for sure book his place again! :)
Thanks!

Petit appartement fonctionnel et propre dans un chouette quartier ! Je le conseille pour 2 personnes, mais pas plus.
Marco est très réactif aux mails ce qui rend les échanges faciles.
Très bonne expérience pour moi !

We spent a wonderful week in this cosy little apartment. Although it is really small, the space was used in a very intelligent way and with a lot of love and thought for details. We enjoyed the quiet neighbourhood without cars and the coffee in the morning sun with view on the river by the kitchen window. Our host was very helpful in answering questions by mail. We were recieved by a friendly woman on our arrival date. This place was great!
Absolut super, we loved staying at Marco!

We (me and my husband) stayed for a week in Marco's small but lovely apartment. It's in the wonderful Alfama district with a beautiful view, as described. The apartment is great for up to 2 people, but with luggage, it would be too cramped for more. Marco is an excellent host, very communicative and reliable. He even stopped by on his way through to take care of some business. Also, although my phone didn't have service when we arrived, he sent someone opening the apartment for us with perfect timing, just with the flight info I had given. Note that you need to be able to manage stairs to get to the apartment, as it's on a pedestrian street and Lisbon is hilly. If that's no problem, I highly recommend his apartment when staying in Lisbon!

We had a nice time in Lisbon.. in a nice part of the city.. in a really nice apartment with a really nice host. I guess we don't have to praise everthing again - it's just as great as all the other feedback tells you! : ) Even our late arrival (close to 1 am) was no problem and well organized by Marco. Just go there.. you won't regret it.

Marco was super great! His apartment is very cozy, well furnished and very well located. Marco was very nice and accommodating. If you ever want to rent an apartment in Lisbon, do not hesitate and book Marco's one, you will not regret it :)

I have just returned from a month in Marco's apartment, and I loved every second. The place is very small, but oh, so nicely and cleverly laid out, so you miss nothing. It would be cramped for four people for more than a few days, but for one or two you can easily be happy there for much longer.

The view over the river is beautiful. I cannot describe how wonderful it is to wake to a sunset over the river, and with the bells of nearby churches, such as the iconic Sao Vicente (visible from the apartment), being part of the daily rhythm.

There is no balcony, but the apartment is just a few flights of stairs down from the Largo das Portas do Sol square and the viewpoint (miradouro) of Santa Luzia, one of the most beautiful places in the city to see the sunrise. Or you can do as the locals in the street: Sit out on the stairs in the evening and chat and enjoy the brief calm between work and dinner.

Alfama, though increasingly popular with tourists during the day, is still very much a local quarter, and the old people there supposedly still have their own coded language from the time where Alfama was one of the more dubious neighbourhoods, inhabited by (according to other Lisboettas) thieves and hustlers. However, this is an area where I feel completely safe, even travelling as a lone woman and walking home alone in the middle of the night. There is a gentleness to Alfama with its' fountains, narrow streets and melancholy, that gives it an enchanted feeling.

One night I was sitting with all windows open, the full moon was rising over the river, and the distant sorrowing notes of fado from the fado houses and restaurants further down wound their way up through the alleys. That is the kind of area this is.

Marco himself, though unfortunately I never got to meet him, was the perfect host, responding promptly and kindly, and even indulged me in my meagre attempts to learn Portuguese. And everything was neat and in order.

The situation of the apartment couldn't be better. You are very close to everything, including the legendary tram line no. 28 that will take you through most of the interesting neighbourhoods of Lisbon. Do spend some time in the Estrela Park or at the Mercado de Campo de Ourique - a great place to grab something nice to eat and more authentic than the hyped Time Out Mercado da Ribeira down by Cais do Sodre - at the end of the line.

However, if you find it difficult to walk up and down stairs you might find it a bit daunting, even if there is an elevator from the alley that could bring you up to the main street. But that would be my only caveat.

I really hope to be back again. I was sorry to leave, even after a month, and it felt like home.

Marco was an amazing host, super easy communication, always responded to messages very quickly and was extremely accomodating. We didn't get to meet him but he had arranged for somebody to wait for us at the apartment when we arrived late at night.
The apartment is in a wonderful location and very cozy. We stayed for four nights and it made our trip to Lisbon as great as we hoped it would be. Would go back any time!!

We stayed Four nights at Marcos cosy apartment in Alfama. Everything perfect, except for the day when suddenly three persons came into the room to mount s fire extinguisher. This is probably a one time thing.

We couldn't meet Marco. However, he was a great host always willing to help.

Lovely place perfectly matching the description.

Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt, die erläuterten Ziele in der Nähe der Wohnung waren bestens zu erreichen! Die zentrale Lage in der Altstadt Lissabons ist sehr empfehlenswert! Die Wohnung ist sehr schön und hat eine tolle Aussicht.
Excellent contact et description conforme à la réalité.

We loved staying in Marco's flat! It was accurately described and so clean and perfect for two of us. It had everything we needed.  We particularly enjoyed having the river and roof top window to look out from and loved hearing the fado music and sounds of the neighborhood during the evening.   Alfama was a wonderful area to stay in and explore Lisbon from. Although we didn't get to meet Marco in person he was so extremely helpful with any question we had and he always responded so quickly.  We would definitely recommend this flat for anyone looking for a cozy and comfy place to stay and we would stay here again if our travels bring us back to Lisbon.

Sehr schöne, ruhige Unterkunft, die in zentraler Lage alles hielt, was sie versprach. Marco war ein sehr guter Gastgeber, der uns zwar persönlich nicht treffen konnte, aber dafür aus der Ferne umso engagierter war und uns allerlei Informationen zum Nahverkehr, Restaurants, Sehenswürdigkeiten etc. gab. Die Wohnung ist klein, aber fein und gerade für zwei Personen der optimale Ausgangspunkt, um das wunderschöne Alfama-Viertel und die ganze Stadt zu entdecken.
Die Wohnung ist außerdem bestens mit allen Küchengeräten, einem großen Fernseher und einer schnellen Internetverbindung ausgestattet.

This is a great studio in the heart of Alfama! Just a few steps down from Portas do Sol among the numerous homes around, you really feel part of the neighbourhood.

We had everything needed for the stay and Marco promptly provided all the necessary information to make sure we can locate the home and enjoy the local area.

Despite the changing plans over the course of our trip (delay from the airport, uncertain departure time...), Marco and the lady that checked us in were very gracious.

Thank you for having us! Would love to stay again next time we're in Lisbon!

We loved Marco's place! We arrived to Lisbon with our arrangements falling through and we had all of our luggage and no place to go. Marco's response time was phenomenal and he saved the day! We didn't know how much we would love Alfama until we stayed there. The location is great, the views are awesome, and the place was spotless. Marco was very friendly and kind enough to give us a little guide to the neighborhood and suggestions for places to eat/things to do. If we're ever in Lisboa again, we'll definitely love to stay at Marco's place again.

Meine Freundin und ich hatten einen tollen Aufenthalt für zwei nächste in Marcos Apartment! Es bietet alles was man für einige Tage benötigt. Eine kleine feine Küche, Sofa, Doppelbett und das alles Zentral genug. Wir waren ohne Auto dort. Die Kommunikation mit Marco war perfekt ! Wir kommen gerne wieder.

We spent some beautiful days at Marco's flat. It's perfectly located in the centre of Alfama, the best area to live Lisbon's atmosphere. We had a car, but it's quite simple to park nearby. The flat is perfect for two persons. It's very clean and cozy. It offers a nice view on the Tejo. Marco is very kind and available. He gave us a lot of usefull advices . We really recommend this accommodation!

We loved our stay at Marco's flat. It's perfectly located in the centre of Alfama and a short 15 min walk will take you to the city centre. The flat offers a nice view on the Tejo, has a very nice bathroom and a good equipment overall. We highly recommended this accommodation!

Nous n'avons malheureusement pas pu rencontrer Marco, mais Antonio, la personne missionnée pour gérer notre arrivée à parfaitement pris le relais.
L'appartement ayant eu un problème juste avant notre arrivée, Marco a assumé parfaitement cet impondérable en s'occupant de nous au-delà de nos attentes.
Nous remercions autant Marco qu'Antonio et les recommandons vivement. Nous pensons que peu d'hôtes auraient assumer de la sorte et que ce sont des hôtes très prévenant. Encore merci.
The apartment is perfect and in a very good location. Everything withing walking distance

We really enjoyed our stay at Marco's place. The apartment itself is relatively small to modest in size but incredibly functional, well laid out, nicely furnished, full of character and very clean. Prefect for two people.

The location is also fantastic, with beautiful views, delicious food and a lively atmosphere and nightlife in the Alfama district. Despite this, it is relatively quiet at night and safe. We couldn't have been happier with it.

Marco did a wonderful job of making sure we had all the information we needed, even though we wasn't around during our stay. The friends who gave us the keys wer very friendly and accommodating. He answered emails promptly and even provided us with a list to places to eat and sights to see.

My only compliant, and this is probably subjective to a certain degree, was the bed/mattress. I found that the springs dug into my back in places. I ended up sleeping on the couch a few nights because of this.

All in all, we love it though and would certainly stay again and recommend it to others.
Marco a été très attentif à tous les détails pratiques facilitant notre installation (clés, informations diverses...) et n'a pas hésité à échanger par mail et par texto

We had a fantastic time in Marco's apartment, which is exactly as it appears in the listing. The flat is beautiful; we found everything we could possibly need was provided. The flat was very clean and has a fantastic view across the rooftops of Alfama. Marco provided lots of information in advance and the flat is genuinely perfectly located in order to explore Alfama and the rest of the city. I highly recommend staying here!

The flat is charming and very confortable.
And Marco is a wonderfull host ! Thanks to him we had a perfect stay in Lisbon.

Marco est tres disponible pour toous les renseignement!
L'appartement est dans l'alfama, la vieux village

Marco's little apartment was the perfect place for my husband and I to spend a week in Lisbon. It's wonderfully situated in the Alfama, just steps from the Tram 28 stops and the beautiful view from Santa Luzia. I loved waking up to the river view, and falling asleep to the sounds of the Alfama at night. Marco was a gracious host who met us after our flight was delayed, and even helped the taxi driver find the address!

Great little flat, brand-new and spotless clean. The architect did an amazing job in this tiny but perfectly functional studio. The location is simply great, Marco is really helpful, and was flexible with both check in and out.. I would go back anytime!
Great service,  great location and nice apartment.

The apartment was neat and well located in the midst of Alfama's idyllic alleyways and miradouros offering spectacular views! All in all everything went smoothly and we were received in a friendly manner.

The apartment was the perfect spot to walk around in the Alfama, where I wanted to spend more time for my second stay in Lisbon. It was convenient to go back there for a siesta after long hours of walking and before going out for dinner. It is small but well arranged, clean, and has everything you need. Comfortable bed. Cozy, with a very nice view from the living room/kitchen. It was a bit noisy in the evening as the neighborhood was getting ready for a festival,  but more lively than disturbing. Marli, who welcomed me, was very nice and helpful. Marco had left me with a bunch of info. Overall, a good value that I would recommend to anybody who wants to visit Lisbon and be in the heart of the historic district. It felt very comfortable being there. Also, good wifi.
It was a perfect place to discover Lisbon and enjoy the atmosphere of Alfama. Thanks a lot for this great opportunity of a wonderful first stay in such an amazing City!!

Although we haven't met in person, Marco provided all information needed for a pleasant stay. The apartment is located in the heart of Alfama, cozy, clean and full equiped for short stay. Marco gives a plenty of tips which makes you feel almost as a Lisbon inhabitant. We really appreciated his flexibility with check-in times!
Thank you, Marco& Antonio!

Gentilissimo e disponibile fin dai primi contatti, ci ha dato le indicazioni per viverci al meglio la città.
La casa è in una posizione eccezionale, nel centro del quartiere dell'Alfama. Consigliatissima a tutti!!!

Appartement conforme à la description et aux photos, pas de mauvaises surprises à l'arrivée. Très bien situé avec le tram 28 juste à côté :) Marco étant en vacances à ce moment là, c'est Marli qui nous a gentillement accueilli à notre arrivée (en retard en plus de ça). Marco est de bons conseils, présents pour nous mais discret quand même :)
Un petit mail le lendemain de notre arrivée pour s'assurer que tout va bien, ça nous a fait très plaisir! En bref, je recommande :)

L'appartement était très bien situé en plein cœur du magnifique quartier de l'Alfama, très pratique. Nous avons adoré la vue depuis le studio, apprécié le calme et la propreté.
Nous avons été bien accueilli et avons eu de bon conseils pour se balader dans Lisbonne, bref super séjour!

Even we didn't met Marco personally, everything was good organized. Before we started our trip, he sent us good informations how to reach his flat. While we were in Lisboa he got in contact with us, if everything was ok. - It was! We had a very pleasant stay in the city and would recommend the flat always.

Nous sommes restés 4 nuits chez Marco et l'appartement était conforme à la description: très propre, belle vue et facile à trouver.
Marco étant en vacances pendant notre séjour, il nous avait envoyé toutes les infos en amont pour nous faciliter les quelques jours passés à Lisbonne et Marli nous a gentiment accueilli pour nous remettre les clés.

Wir können dieses Appartement total empfehlen. Es ist mitten in der Altstadt in einem traditionellen Haus in einer kleinen Gasse. Von hier kann man vieles zu Fuß erkunden.
