We had a great stay at this alfama apartment. Marco was a good and welcoming host, the communication was excellent and he provided us with all the info we needed. The place is clean, bright and comfy and the location is perfect! Close to everything you need. Although in the middle of Alfama, close to a wonderful viewpoint, it was very quiet at night. We couldn't have had a better stay! Thank you and we would definitely come back and stay there again. Cheers!

Appartement très bien placé et à proximité du tram 28. Marco a pris soin de nous laisser une carte ainsi que des bons plans pour dîner. Nous sommes restés 2 jours et cela convient très bien pour un couple de jeune.

Marco is the best host you can meet. Always available to give us insight on the city like an old friend happy to see us. He sent us a list of restaurants and place to visit before our arrival. He came to bring us in the place near the apartment that was perfect: beautiful, clean with a comfortable bad and an amazing view of the river in the alfama heart. Definitely recommend.ciao marco a presto
Great little bolt hole in a wonderful city. The apartment was clean, well provisioned, and well located, and Marco was very accommodating indeed.

Très bon séjour! Marco est très sympathique et accueillant. Il nous attendait malgré l'heure tardive, il nous a même conduit à un restaurant après nous avoir fait visiter l'appartement. Pendant le séjour il a été aussi à l'écoute.
L'appartement est agréable et bien décoré, le quartier est très très sympa.
On vous le conseille !

It was a pleasure to meet Marco ! He takes great care of the flat and would do anything to make you have a very pleasant stay. He speaks many languages, which could be helpful too !
The flat is very (but VERY) well situated in the Alfama neighbourhood, the view from the little window is great, there is anything you may need to have a comfortable stay, included if you want to cook you something. It's very nice and clean, we would definitely come back and recommend this flat to everybody ! (FYI we were travelling with a baby)

Marco was a very reliable host and helped whenever he could:
receive us, help with the luggage, stay in contact by e-mail or SMS, phone taxi etc.
The appartment is situated in a busy quarter but calm and fitted with all you need (we only missed a salad bowl).
We can totally recommend the person and the place.
Anita and WJ Mertens

Tout s'est bien passé et avec beaucoup de facilité.
Marco nous attendait à la descente du taxi pris à l'aéroport. Très sympa, cordial, amical, discret ...20/20.
L'appartement correspondait exactement à sa description, la vue sur le Tage existait bien. L’aménagement est parfait pour deux personnes et, très important, j'ai pu confortablement caser mon 1,85 m dans le lit.
Le quartier, calme, est super: petites ruelles et escaliers dans lesquels il faut bien une demi-journée pour se repérer. Mais après, on se sent vite chez soi. Petits restaus typiques pas loin. La proximité de la mythique ligne 28 du tram facilite l’accès aux autre quartiers.

Contact avec des informations très utiles avant notre arrivée ainsi que le jour même et aussi pendant notre séjour.
Appartement bien décrit et photos exacte.
Quartier très sympa, calme et près des sites touristiques qu'on pourrait accéder à pied.
Le tram 12 et 28 sont bien pratique pour se déplacer ailleurs en ville.
Hello, very nice apartment. Clean and in a great location. We had a great time there.

Thank you Marco for taking such good care of us.
The place and the location are great, we enjoyed our stay a lot !

The location is prefect!! The apartment is very nice. View from apartment is beautiful. Nuno was welcoming and very helpful during our stay. All the main sites of the city are in easy walking distance and there are lots of great bars and restaurants nearby. I would recommend this apartment!!!

Nuno a été très accueillant et très gentil nous a conseillé des restos à lisbonne et concocté un itinéraire des villes à visiter jusqu'à porto. Studio très sympa et agréable  très bonne literie les photos du site représentent tout à fait la réalité enfin bref très contents

Ha sido una experiencia muy buena. La casa esta muy bien equipada, limpia, bien ubicada y con todo lo necesario. El anfitrión nos trató muy bien e incluso nos fue recomendando lugares durante nuestro viaje, lo que hizo que nos sintieramos muy acompañados.

Nuno's apt is super cool! It's in a very romantic neighborhood. And the view to the river is fantastic. Although apt is in an old building,all facilities are in good condition. And it's close to the famous 28 tram line. I will definitely recommend it. Nuno is a very cool host. He clearly knows a lot about the city, he gave us a list of the good restaurants around. He also has a lot of knowledge of the city's history to share. Would be nice to meet him again!

Great location, smack in the  middle  of where you want to stay. Clean, small and cosy apartment and Nuno was a Superhelpful, thoughtful and kind host! We world be happy to come back again (preferably in spring Or summer as Lisbon was a little chilly)
Lovely flat, great location and nice host !

Excellent apartment in the best area of town!
Nuno has also shared with us tips of restaurants and places to visit.
Arrival was smooth and everything went well.

Definitely recommend it!

This place was ideal and just what we wanted. Perfect neighborhood experience with quaint attractions nearby. A nice walk or quick trolly to major sites. Nuno made it even better. Totally invested in ensuring you have a good experience and helped immensely.  Would definitely return.

Nuno's flat is cosy, clean and very nice. Someone was waiting for us even late in the evening at our arrival. Nuno gave us advice and hints on where to go. The flat is close to Alfama and its nice Fado restaurants and cafes. Very good.

Accueil chaleureux et très sympathique de Nuno. Son petit nid est parfait pour passer quelques jours à Lisbonne. Calme et très bien situé. Nous vous recommandons chaudement cette adresse. Nuno sera vous indiquer tous les bons plans de son quartier !

We booked a trip for our parents to Lisboa and Porto and Nuño was absolutely helpful with everything, before and during the trip (even reassuring me that my parents were arrived and all was fine).
We exchange a lot of message and he was always nice and dedicated to help me make that trip fabulous for my parents.
Thank you very much Nuño and Camilla because thanks to you my parents had a wonderful time in Lisbonne !
Die Lage ist super, das Appartement ist total schnuckelig. Es ist alles da, was man so benötigt!! Vieles ist gut zu Fuß zu erreichen, aber auch Tram u Metro sind total nah dran!

Nuno est un hôte super sympathique et accueillant. De bon conseil pour ballades et restaurants. Son appartement très propre et agréable est situé dans notre quartier préféré de Lisbonne avec vue sur le Tage. Idéal pour notre week end en amoureux. On conseille +++.

We had a very warm welcome by Nuno. He gave us the possibility to store our luggage at this own place and organised to drop it off at the studio afterwards. The studio was very clean and cosy. It has everything you need for a city trip to Lissabon. On the day of departure, we could leave our luggage in the studio until the evening, very ideal! Nuno also gave us some good tips for visiting and the location of the studio is also very good, nearby tram 28. We would definitely recommend this place and host and hope to come back one day.

The small apartement is very cosy and first class furnished and the location is probably the best in Alfama! Also Nuno supplied towels, bed linen, tea, spices and all you need for a uncomplicated stay. Everything is very clean and new. He even put some german magazines on the table. Unfortunately Nuno could not be there when we wanted to move in - but he managed a friend (hello to Camilla from Brazil) to show us the apartement. So we had to wait a bit which at least was no problem at all cause next to the meeting point is a bar with a good view over Alfama and we could enjoy some nice caipirinha. A good start for a nice stay in Lisboa!

Nous avons passé un merveilleux séjour à Lisbonne, et ce, en grande partie grâce à Nuno qui est un super hôte ! Il a toujours été disponible et réactif pour répondre à toutes nos questions et adore partager ses conseils pour découvrir cette ville qu'il adore et connait parfaitement.
L'appartement était parfait pour nous, très bien situé, dans un des plus beaux quartiers de la ville, charmant, très bien décoré, très propre et vraiment très agréable.
Je recommande vivement cette adresse à toute personne voulant visiter Lisbonne !

We had a great time in Lisboa. The apartment is in the perfect spot if you want to explore the city on foot - public transportation is in walking distance too. The apartment itself is small but more than cozy with a wonderful view of the river. We could observe brilliant sunrises everyday. Obviously, the place has everything you need incl. a small kitchen and a huge TV.
Nuno is the perfect host who has millions of suggestions where to go or what to do. Probably one of the friendliest people ever.
Nice apartment. Perfectly located and comunicated. Historic Trams 28 and 12 stop near the house. Had a great stay.

Nuno is a really nice, open and lively person. He welcomed us at a public square and went to the flat with us. So it was no problem to get there or to find it. The flat is small, clean and very cosy. A great view, especially if you like cruise ships ;) You can watch them from the kitchen window. It is a great location in a really nice neighborhood. Alfama was my favorite part of Lissabon! I highly recommend it and if I am back to Lissabon I will try to stay there again.

We loved our stay in the alfama!! The location was great in the heart of the old city with a beautiful view on the river. I would definitely recommend this address to friends who want to go to Lisbon!!

Fantastic apartment, right in the middle of beautiful Alfama, easy to reach, clean and really cosy. Nuno was a great host, he helped us with any question we had and gave us really good recommendations for the rest of our trip. We'd definitely stay in his flat again. Thank you, Nuno! If you ever need recommendations for Berlin and/or Germany, please let us know, we'd be happy to help! ;-)
Nice little apartment. Nuno was very helpful. The little note with some useful information he left in the apartment was really thoughtful.

We really loved the apartement and the central position in town. Everything went perfectly: Nuno gave us some hints where to go and what to explore nearby and made us curious for exploring the city.
Thanks a lot!!

Nous n'avons pas eu le plaisir de rencontrer Nuno, mais les différents contacts que nous avons eu ont été très cordiaux et très constructifs. L'appartement correspond complètement à la description et aux photos.
Petit, mais très propre et rénové avec goût, ils est idéalement placé en plein cœur du quartier Alfama, à 100m de la place Santa Lucia qui a une des plus belle vues sur la ville et la Tage (celle qu'on voit sur toutes les cartes postale). On peut prendre le fameux tramway 28 sur cette place. Le métro est à 10 mn à pied.
Nous avons adoré notre séjour dans cette très attachante ville de Lisbonne au charme fou. Je vous conseille vivement cette adresse pour la visiter en toute tranquillité.

My girlfriend and I had a great stay in Nuno's flat. The apartment is very well arranged. Its location in the midle of the alfama makes it the perfect base camp for those who aim to explore Lisboa's center.
Cosy. Good location.

Nuno welcomed us very warmly. The apartment is like the description says: very cosy, clean and well located. Right in the heart of Alfama, the view 1 min from the apartment is completely magical. I highly recommend this place, ideal to visit Lisbon.

Thanks nuno for six lovely days in your charming apartment. Everything went perfect, we stayed in contact all the time. He had been such helpful and friendly host during stay,the apartment was very clean and modernized and offers a direct contact to the people of Lisbon.
Highly recommended for exploring Lisbon on its own.

Our experience was great - Nuno gave us tips about where to visit before we arrived; made it easy to arrange a meeting point and really friendly and welcoming. The apartment is lovely - full of character, fab location and nice and clean with a fruit bowl in the fridge:)

Would definitely recommend and we hope to stay again on our return to Lisbon some day!

Nous avons passé quelques jours très agréables dans cet appartement, petit mais fonctionnel et plein de charme. Un vrai petit nid, qui correspond tout à fait à la description et aux photos. Il est en plein coeur du vieux Lisbonne, quartier touristique animé. Nuno s'est montré un hôte chaleureux et adorable du début à la fin : avant notre arrivée, il a toujours été réactif sur internet pour répondre à nos questions ; il nous a accueillis chaleureusement, il a été de bon conseil, et nous avons pu même faire appel à lui pour la suite de notre voyage.

Nuno a été un super hôte, bien que nous ayons eu du retard sur notre vol, il s'est rendu disponible pour nous accueillir. L'appartement est très propre, agréable et idéalement situé dans le quartier de l'Alfama pour un voyage dans la superbe ville de Lisbonne

Nuno's apartment was very nice to stay at. Great location to discover Lisbon.
Nuno was very helpful and everything worked out perfectly.
I'd definitely stay there again.

Nuno nous a réservé un accueil chaleureux. Son appartement, en plein cœur de l'Alfama (le plus vieux quartier de Lisbonne), nous a permit de visiter agréablement la ville. L'eléctrico passe dans la rue d'au-dessus et on chante le fado dans les ruelles d'en-bas. Dépaysement total. L'appart' n'est pas grand, mais suffisant pour 2 personnes.

I recommend Nuno's apartment to you ! Nuno is very nice and his help was precious to discover the amazing places of Lisbonne! He gaves us advices about the food and about the transports : in french and in english! :)
The apartment is in the center of Alfama next to one of the most beautiful view in the city!
Nuno was so flexible. Our flight in was delayed but he went out of his way to meet us. The apartment was in the best location and Nuno was very knowledgeable about the city. Great experience overall!

This apartment is really, really lovely! It's got great views and is in the perfect location! Very clean and tidy and Nuno is a lovely host.
Walking distance to loads of great sites, cafés, restaurants etc. Would definitely recommend this place to anyone travelling to Lisbon!
Great place in a wonderfull neighborhood. Nuno is extremely friendly and helpfull. Definately would like to stay here again and recommend it to everyone!

We choose Lisboa to celebrate a great moment and we choose this apartment because of Nuno.
We received much more than we were expecting.
Lisboa is a place full of culture, history and social life, Nuno may it happen in less than an hour!
Beside of that,
TOP LOCATION (Alfama) / TOP ACCOMMODATION (brand new and set up for visitors)
20" from the airport by cab
15" from plaça do commerce by foot
20" from the train station by foot

Nuno est une personne très sympathique et souriante qui donne des bons plans pour visiter Lisbonne! Il est toujours disponible si nous avons un petit problème. L'appartement est convenable car le but de notre voyage était de visiter Lisbonne et non de rester dans l'appartement. Il est très bien équipé (cuisine équipée, grande salle de bain [serviettes fournies], lits confortables [draps fournis]). A notre arrivée, l'appartement était très propre. L'appartement se situe au cœur de l'Alfama, c'était agréable de s'y promener le soir car il y a beaucoup d'ambiance mais de l'appartement nous n'entendons rien. Nous n'avons pas non plus entendu les voisins durant notre séjour. Si un jour je retourne à Lisbonne, je pense que je retournerai dans cet appartement.

Nuno's Appartement liegt mitten in symphatischen Stadtteil Alfama. Damit ist es der perfekte Ausgangspunkt, um Lissabon zu Fuß zu erkunden und den Abend quasi direkt vor der Haustür an einem der kleinen Grill-Lokale ausklingen zu lassen. Das kleine Appartement ist modern eingerichtet und sauber. Alles was man braucht, ist vorhanden, Blick auf den Rio Tejo inklusive. Nuno hat uns sehr freundlich empfangen und hat uns beim Parken des Autos geholfen. Sehr empfehlenswert! Gerne wieder ;-)

Nuno est un hôte adorable : souriant, disponible, ouvert, très gentil (et qui parle plusieurs langues ;)).
L'appartement est propre, clair et agréable. Il est très bien situé dans le quartier d'Almafa, donc très proche des autres quartiers sympa. On faire quasiment tout le centre de Lisbonne à pied.
Our stay in Jorge’s apartment was great, very peaceful and great location. Jorge was so sweet and accommodating. Obrigada!!

Jorge was extremely accommodating when it came to us checking in early. He was always responsive within a few minutes of any inquiry we had. The apartment was larger than we thought it was going to be and it was very comfortable.
It’s not in a flat area of town, but then Lisbon is not flat at all anywhere so it certainly suited us in our old town explorations. We would not hesitate to go back.
Awesome location. Jorge was a great host and very helpful.
wonderful, atmospheric small apartment in oldest part of Lisbon.
Boligen ligger perfekt i forhold til at udforske Alfama og tæt på vandet.

Een goed appartement midden in de Alfama wijk. Jorge is een man die zijn afspraken nakomt. Voor iedereen geschikt maar ik denk dat het appartement met name voor een lang verblijf in Lissabon heel aangenaam is: keuken, wasmachine en twee (kleine) woonkamers. Wij waren er maar twee nachten en hebben het prima gehad.

Lovely stay! Jorge was extreamly helpful and kind. We were in the oldest part of the city. If you are looking for modern this place is not for you. We were quite cozy after Jorge took care of the heaters. Thank you!!
Second floor walkup. We went in December so the heat didn’t really do much so it was very cold. The shower is very small. But overall, good stay!

Sejour très agréable.
Jorge très accueillant. Logement charmant. Bien situé pour exercice physique, monter- descendre les escaliers d’Alfama, joli quartier avec vues ! ...
Super. Merci Jorge.

A decent place, just a bit old. It has everything you need and the location in Alfama is good — most attractions are within walking distance. It’s a little quiet at night though, so I felt slightly uneasy walking back in the evening. Otherwise, all good.

This apartment was in a gorgeous location; in walking distance to many viewpoints in Alfama and access to the trolley. It was a fully equipped apartment, where  you could cook and relax. Jorge was very helpful and recommended restaurants in the area.
Jorge is a fantastic host! Very flexible and helpful  when my train was delayed by a strike. The apartment has everything you need, plus exceptional views over the old city centre.
Veldig fornøyd med oppholdet. Unik beliggenhet og super vert.
Loved the location, the space and the host! Jorge was super responsive and kind!

Jorge was kind enough to allow us to drop off our luggage at 11am, before check-in.
We had 4 adults and the apartment was spacious for all of us. A queen bed in a private room, a twin bed in a private room, and a folding ottoman that is about the size of a queen bed. We ordered a ride share(via BOLT), and walked a short distance down the private drive to meet our driver. Jorge speaks English very well. Thank you!

Jorge is a wonderful host. He is very friendly, responsive, and gave us great recommendations. The apartment is spacious but the shower is a pretty tight fit. The immediate area outside the apartment is quiet but we’d suggest not walking to the right when exiting the apartment. We found this area to be unsettling to walk around at night. If you go left, the area is much safer and a great place to explore.

This was such a cute, well located place. It had a really welcoming homely feel to it with a stunning view of the church from the living room. The decor was a fun vintage vibe. Jorge was very flexible and accommodating and a really nice man. And finally, the location couldn’t be better!
Lovely apartment in a superb location. Thanks for everything Jorge.
Jorge’s place has an incredible location, with a great view.
We loved the location and enjoyed walking everywhere and discovering Lisbon’s charm. Jorge gave us some great recommendations for our first night out.

Perfect location and perfect host
Very quiet spot for a busy city. Close to everything. Jorge gave us really good restaurants recommendations as well.
The only thing I would change is i wish I booked for longer
Thanks again Jorge it was an absolute treat

10月に10日間滞在しました。お城のすぐ便利でした。裏手でほぼ観光地の中に滞在してました。トラムの駅も近く便利でした。お家の前の広場では子供達の声も聞こえて癒されました。
お城からはクジャクも散歩に来てました。
お部屋は2人でしたのでゆったり使えました。洗濯もして、キッチンも全て揃っていました。

Felt like a local living in my own apartment. Very central. Walkable up to sights, restaurants and shops. Walkable down to the same. Right in the Almafa District and meters from the tram. Jorge is very friendly and helpful.

What a wonderful place!  The location was fantastic & added to the great first time visit to Lisboa.  The apartment had everything we needed, was comfortable and allowed us to feel like we were living like the locals.  Jorge was very kind & helpful when we arrived which set the standard for our stay.  If I visit Lisboa again I would come back to the apartment.  Loved it all!

Jorge had such a lovely appartment in a beautiful and calm place in Lisbon. We were greeted very warmly by him and immediately made us feel welcome. I definitely recommend and will be back when I visit Lisbon again
Lovely, quiet apartment in Alfama. In the center of everything but tucked away on a side street across from a church. Jorge is warm, welcoming and accommodating. Highly recommended.

De locatie van Jorge is centraal gelegen in het centrum van de oude stad. In de buurt zijn genoeg musea en kerken te bezoeken. Castelo de Sao Jorge is op loopafstand. Het centrum is goed te bereiken, wel rekening houden dat de straten erg smal zijn, onregelmatige steentjes, en veel verkeer. Een bushalte is in de buurt. Er is genoeg te doen, een aanrader is om de Viva Viagem-kaart te kopen bij het Metrostation. Hiermee kun je snel en voordelig de stad verkennen.
Kortom Lissabon is een mooie oude stad die het bezoeken meer dan waard is.

We stayed 3 nights and enjoyed staying with Jorge very much. The appartment was clean, the bed comfortable and the view really nice as well. Jorge was super friendly and very helpful. We want to come back!
Jorge was so incredibly helpful and a joy to meet.

Jorge and his place was amazing! Location was great. Jorge was an incredible host - meeting us to check in, helping us find parking, giving advice for our itinerary. We were so thankful to have someone so kind and helpful. Would recommend!

Stayed here for 3 nights. Both my husband and I felt it was one of the best Airbnbs we’ve stayed in. The bedroom has 2 windows which lets through a lovely breeze and shutters to block out the light. The bathroom and Kitchen were well equipped. There was even a washing machine which was very helpful as my luggage had been lost by the airline and I had limited the clothes. The lounge and side room have a stunning view of the church.
The location suited us. It was in the old town close to some lovely restaurants and bars. The castle was an easy walk. However we didn’t find it difficult either, to get into the busier streets in main town. It is hilly which we didn’t mind….everywhere in Lisbon is either up or downhill!
Jorge was great in his communication and when asked, recommended a taxi from the airport. We used Uber and thought it was very cheap.
We’d love to return again in the future to Lisbon, and to stay in this lovely apartment.
I would recommend this Air BNB it was in a fantastic area! Our host was very attentive and helpful.
Super Unterkunft, wir kommen gerne wieder.

Superbra och mysig lägenhet i fint lugnt område! Vi sov mycket bra! Häftigt bo granne med Castelo de são Jorge! Vår värd Jorge är en mycket trevlig värd! Hit vill vi gärna komma tillbaka! Vi fick två skivor att ta med hem och lyssna på, då värden Jorge är musiker. Spännande!

Jorge was friendly and welcomed us to the Airbnb himself to show us around. The location of the Airbnb is amazing and the place was exactly as pictured. We loved our stay and would recommend Jorge’s place to anyone looking for an affordable stay right in the heart of Alfama.
Great location and super walkable! Jorge was great and very accommodating :) The apartment stayed very cool despite it being quite hot outside.
We really enjoyed our stay here. It’s in a great location and we felt right at home. Jorge was amazing and super responsive to anything we needed.

Nous avons particulièrement apprécié l’accueil de Jorge ainsi que l’emplacement de l’appartement où toutes les commodités sont à proximité. Le lieu est calme et tranquille. L’appartement est resté frais malgré les températures élevées de l’extérieur.
The stat was great thank you Jorge

Obrigado o Joao!
We had such a good time, great place!

Jorge is een geweldige Host en de ligging van het appartement is geweldig. Een rustige plek.  Ideaal want even de straat uit en je bevind je in de gezellige drukte van het oude centrum.  Top : Taxi zeer goedkoop. Bracht ons voor 15 euro naar t vliegveld.
This is our second time staying with Jorge - he is a very welcoming, friendly host. The apartment is in an ideal location for exploring Alfama. We will come back :)

We had a great stay at Jorge's apartment for a few days. Jorge was flexible and helpful at check-in & check out. He helped recommend places to eat when we arrived tired and hungry and organised a taxi to the train station when we left. Ideal location, the apartment was full of old town charm, creaks and all, but breezy (in the heat of summer) and authentic.

Jorge was very pleasant to interact with from beginning to end. He was extremely responsive which I was grateful for as a solo traveller in a new country. The apartment itself was spacious and clean, with a wonderful cross-breeze on summer nights. Checking in and out was easy, as Jorge was flexible. The location is easy to walk around and you can’t beat the views!

Wir hatten einen kurzen Aufenthalt in Jorges gemütlichem Apartment. Es ist einfach, aber vollständig ausgestattet. Für eine Altstadtwohnung geräumig und sehr ruhig gelegen. Alles gut zu Fuß erreichbar.
Das Preis-/Leistungsverhältnis stimmt.
Jorge ist sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit.
Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt.
Vielen Dank noch einmal.

The apartment is in a fantastic location, soany sights and restaurants within walking distance. The apartment itself has plenty of space and everything you could need while staying. There is a lovely breeze in the bedroom to keep you cool at night. Jorge was very helpful and friendly, he met us to check in and was great at communicating before and during our stay. We would definitely recommend the apartment to anyone visiting the city!
Jorge was super friendly and helpful! We loved our quick stay at the beautiful apartment. The surrounding location is amazing!
It was a great, very well located place!
C'était mon premier séjour à Lisbonne. L'appartement de Jorge était idéal pour explorer et j'ai pu aller partout à pied.
The cutest space! Jorge was so kind and welcoming! He gave us a tour and was so hospitable! Will absolutely be back!

C'était un logement très bien situé dans Lisbonne, tout se faisait à pied, tout en étant calme aux alentours. Jorge est super gentil et réactif.J'étais septique de ne pas avoir d'air climatisé et finalement toute la famille était bien malgrés les 36 degrés le jour.

It was an amazing experience in the Jorge’s apartment. It felt very authentic especially the view from the window was magical ✨ you can definitely tell the apartment has a soul in it and is being taken care of. Jorge was always very helpful and very friendly. Definitely will come back one day ☀️
Awesome location near the castle and many shops! Was nervous about no AC in the summer but it’s very breezy, we kept the windows open and had no issues. Place was clean and accurately described!
The location of the Airbnb made everything easy to access. Jorge was extremely inviting and friendly, we had a wonderful time in Lisbon.
Thanks for the stay and help.

Cozy and comfy stay. Stayed for one night with our toddler. Jorge went above and beyond to make our trip comfortable by holding our luggage before our check in, setting up a toddler bed and toys, and being responsive. The place is a 10-15 minutes drive away walk from the entrance of Castela Sao Jorge and a short walk from many restaurants and mini markets.
Passte alles
Jorge was a friendly host. I recommend !

Muy bonito el departamento. Cumplió con todas nuestras expectativas. Muy bien ubicado, cerca de transportes y en una zona muy tranquila. Jorge siempre con muy buena actitud, desde el primer contacto hasta nuestro retiro.
prachtig gelegen appartement,  wat een uitzicht!

We stayed in Lisbon only one night but thanks to the perfect location of this apartment, we were able to explore much of Alfama on foot as the apartment is within walking distance of many beautiful viewpoints, recommended sights, and great restaurants! Somehow quiet despite close proximity to busy old town. The apartment itself was good and comfortable, older and a bit cramped but had all the amenities we needed. Jorge was a very flexible and responsive host.
we love staying in alfata and we're so grateful for the chance to stay at Jorge's apartment

We had a fabulous time in the historic Alfama. We were close to all the main attractions. Beautiful restaurants, locals were friendly. My only suggestion would be is to not pack heavy. You don’t want to be lugging around your luggage on all the hills in Lisbon.

Jorge's place although in the centre is just off the main road and as such very quiet. The apartment is fantastic with everything you could need after a day exploring Lisbon. Although we didn't really use the kitchen as we ate out, it looked well equipped.
Jorge is very welcoming, offered us some tips as to places to go to and things currently happening in Lisbon. He was very quick to answer any questions we had.
5 stars all the way.

Jorge is an excellent host. We had a lovely stay in his apartment.
Jorge was really quick to respond to our messages and helped us find a restaurant on our first night.
The apartment is a great place to stay in the Alfama district and perfect to hop on the trams and tuktuks to explore the city.
thank you for being such a good host and we hope to visit again in the future.

We loved our stay at Jorge’s place. It was authentic and we felt like locals.
Great area and an easy walk to everything.
Jorge was friendly and helpful.
Would highly recommend.

Jorge was erg vriendelijk en reageerde snel op onze berichten. Het appartement was prachtig en heerlijk rustig gelegen in een super leuk deel van de stad. Er is een perfecte mix van hip en authentiek. En het uitzicht vanuit het raam in de woonkamer is spectaculair. We hebben extreem genoten en raden het aan iedereen aan!

Super logement proposé par un superbe hôte.
Merci Jorge !

You can't beat the location for walking around the historic areas of Lisbon. The apartment was very cozy. Jorge is very kind and welcoming; we were in Lisbon during the national power outage, and when flights got grounded he very kindly offered to let us stay there longer.
L’appartement était super bien situé. Jorge a été très gentil et nous avons pu laisser nos bagages avant que l’appartement soit prêt. Un très beau séjour!

Logement bien situé dans le quartier de l’Alfama. Nombreux restaurants à proximité, bon point de départ pour visiter Lisbonne !
Points positifs : Jorge a été très gentil et serviable ! il a été aussi très réactif dans ses réponses et a accepté que l’on dépose nos valises avant l’heure d’arrivée prévue !
Points à améliorer : appartement un peu défraîchi par rapport aux photos, la salle de bain mériterait d être rénovée dans sa globalité. Le lit double est un peu dur. Il aurait été appréciable d’avoir une éponge neuve ainsi qu’un torchon + produits de douche non utilisés par d’autres personnes / idem pour le frigo non nettoyé en profondeur. L’hygiène globale pourrait être améliorée.

Het appartement voelt als thuis.
De ligging is fantastisch. Je moet wel wat klimmen, maar dat is met alles in Lissabon. Heel veel leuke en goede restautantjes in de ditecte omgeving. Zowel in Alfama (wel heel erg toeristisch) als Graca (iets minder toeristisch).
Jorge is een fijne host die als klap op de vuurpijl fantastisch mooie muziek maakt. Wij hebben een CD van hem gekocht en zijn op slag fan 😊
Dank je wel Jorge.

Jorge est un hôte très généreux et disponible. C'était un vrai bonheur de rester chez lui. Il nous a accueilli comme si nous étions de la famille et il nous a donné des recommandations d'endroits à visiter et conseils pour le voyagement. Le logement est près de tout et a tout ce dont nous avons besoin. Merci beaucoup pour tout!

Jorge was great at giving recommendations and places to visit - he sent us links and he has books on Lisbon with Portuguese phrases to learn. He was very welcoming- we had a great time there.
Location was amazing- quiet at night , and short walks to many sites.
The kitchen had everything you needed.
Felt very relaxed and comfortable at Jorge’s place.
So many windows to take the view in.
Thank you so much Jorge for your warm hospitality.
Cheers
Close to wonderful food and views. It was a great experience!
Jorge es un excelente anfitrión, su atención y trato amable hizo que nuestra estadía en Alfama fuera inolvidable!
Wij hadden een ontzettend fijn verblijf in deze airbnb. Wij waren er maar 2 dagen maar door de locatie hebben we veel kunnen zien. Dichtbij de stad, de kerk en de markt. Ook is Jorge een top host !
great central location. Jorge was great at giving helpful tips for restaurants and places to visit.

Great location in a lovely area of Lisbon. The view takes your breath away every morning! The apartment is spacious given the price, and Jorge keeps it stocked with all you may need. He was very communicative about check-in and even greeted us personally as we arrived.

Hyggelig lejlighed meget autentisk og dejligt at leve blandt de lokale.
Rigtig god vært svarer hurtig og er meget hjælpsom.
Området er perfekt både i forhold til transport, butikker og restauranter.

Jorge's place, and Jorge, were wonderful. we had a great stay in a great location. Jorge was super flexible with our late check in and was there ready to show us around when we arrived. After a friendly greeting and a wave along our way, we'd  love to return. The apartment was lovely, clean and uniquely decorated with some quirky touches. Alfama was a cool place to explore the winding lanes and stairways of Lisbon, and the apartment was neatly placed in easy reach of everything.

We absolutely love Jorge’s apartment and would love to return someday!
Fabulous location! A lovely apartment with everything we could need.
Jorge is a very friendly host and we appreciated his welcome and tips for the area.
Thankyou!

Right in the middle of the most beautiful places in Lisbon in old town alfama and it was still peaceful and quiet. Great viewpoints at walking distance and trams right outside. Highly recommend for the location. The apartment itself was good and comfortable.
Jorge was very good to communicate with and answered all queries quickly. He met us at the apt and after a quick introduction we were off to explore. The apartment is very well located.
Wonderful stay! Jorge was very responsive, kind, and informative. Apartment was just as described. Get ready for some exercice, cause there are so many great things to see in the area!
enjoyed staying at Jorge’s place very much! A perfect location on a private street in the old city of lisbon. it was cozy, comfortable and clean. I Will definitely be staying here again!

Jorge’s apartment is in a perfect part of Lisbon, easy to walk anywhere (even with all the hills) some great wine bars and view points near by too.
Jorge had a lot of great recommendations for local sights and things to do and was always very communicative and helpful. The apartment itself is spacious and has a lovely view from nearly every window. I would highly recommend staying here if you’re visiting Lisbon!
Beautiful place! Super cosy and close to the best cafes and restaurants.

We truly enjoyed our stay at Jorge's place. Nice atmosphere both in the the flat and the neighbourhood.  Very convenient to get around in the city. Jorge is such a lovely host and we would love to come back.
A very cute place that’s near the hustle and bustle of Lisbon but still quiet and peaceful at night!
Best thing about George‘s place is the location! The area is very walkable. We loved visiting Lisbon.

Jorge is a fantastic host who responded to us quickly and was very helpful with checkin. He gave great recommendations and his place is cozy, quiet and clean with lovely views of the church and city. Would definitely stay there again!

Jorge was very gracious to us as we had a few hiccups during arrival. The apartment and immediate area feels very residential. It is in a great location for walking to sights and restaurants, even the pharmacy when one of us fell ill. Thank you so much for having us there!

Tolle Unterkunft bei einem wunderbaren Gastgeber - man fühlt sich zuhause und willkommen. Hilfreiche Tipps, nette Gespräche, typische Unterkunft in einem portugiesisch traditionellen Haus mit allen Vor- und Nachteilen. Wir würden jederzeit zurückkommen, wegen der persönlichen Note!

Dziękuję Panu Jorge za gościnność. Bardzo dobra lokalizacja, chociaż trochę pod górkę jak to w Lizbonie i do samego pokoju też trzeba podreptać :) meble w pokoju prawdziwe, z duszą (na szczęście nie kolejną IKEA). Piękny widok z okna! Dziękuję Panu Jorge za szybki serwis kiedy mieliśmy problem z ciepłą wodą! Polecam gospodarza :)
Jorge was a great help. He helped us carry our luggage, booking a taxi and always responding quickly to my text. Very friendly host.

Amazing stay with Jorge in Lisbon! Beautiful area away from the hustle and bustle but close enough to everything by uber or walking. Jorge is an amazing host and great person. Will definitely stay here again!

Nous avons passé un très bon moment dans l’appartement de Jorge. Très bien situé pour découvrir Lisboa. La vue du salon lui donne beaucoup de charme. Chambre lumineuse. Tout le nécessaire pour un court séjour. Seuls points négatifs : odeur d’égout dans la salle de bain et mauvaise insonorisation.

We had a wonderful stay at Jorge’s Airbnb in the heart of the Alfama. Excellent location, beautiful surroundings, highly walkable. Though the bed was somewhat uncomfortable, the apartment had great amenities and we felt right at home.
Perfect location for exploring Alfama district

Stayed a few days with my elderly mum and loved the quiet location, aspect from all the windows and the gentle buzz of being in a local neighbourhood. Great places around to eat and shops to potter to plus supermarket close with surprise lift directly into the shop!!
We used the zap card and got public transport everywhere of which there is a good choice from the accommodation - the 10B takes you very close to the main train station and Google!Maps was our go to for the routes and times.
Jorge is a wonderful host and full of useful info plus we felt very welcome to get in touch if we needed anything else - mum wanted binoculars to look at the prolific bird life on the large tree opposite :)

Jorge was very friendly. The flat is a bit smaller than we expected based on the photos. But the location is amazing, everything is very close.

sehr freundlicher Gastgeber, kümmert sich um alles, gute Kommunikation. Perfekt für jeden der mitten in der Alfama wohnen möchte. In der Küche gibt es zwei kleine Kochplatten und einen kleinen Ofen. Da hätten wir uns eine bessere Ausstattung gewünscht.

We really enjoyed our stay in Jorge's lovely apartment. It's cosy and in a great location, really close to some great restaurants and bars and a short walk to a cool market (that's held every Tuesday and Saturday) The apartment is in a quiet little square, but moments from the 28 and 12 tramline, which is super handy. Jorge was great to deal with, and really accommodating about letting us check in early to leave our luggage. The apartment is clean and nicely furnished, exactly as shown in the photos.
We would absolutely recommend staying with Jorge and hope to be back soon!

Jorge est un hôte très sympathique et accueillant, qui nous a donné de bons conseils pour notre sejour, est venu  nous chercher à la station de métro et nous a réservé le taxi pour l'aéroport à 5h00 du matin

Jorge’s place is perfectly located in the old town of Lisbon. Lots of great view points nearby - really quiet and nicely tucked away whilst also having everything on your doorstep! Super easy to walk into the heart of Lisbon for exploring. Jorge is very friendly and warm, very attentive if you need him. overall a lovely stay!

Bonjour,
super séjour dans l'appartement de Jorge. très propre et super bien placé ! des supers restaurants et lieux à visiter à côté

The appartment is very nice and has al that you can wish for. It was very nice situated in the city with a lot of things to do in the neighbourhood. Jorge was also very friendly and told us a few things we could do there. We arrived to early but that was also not a problem, we could leave our luggage in the appartment.

Super séjour chez Jorge, qui est un hôte très accueillant et disponible.
L’appartement est très bien plaçé et équipé. Je recommande !!

Jorge's house is on a fantastic location, a
beautiful and quiet square with view of trees and a church from the window.
Jorge please invest in a bed that is slightly bigger and makes no noise, then it will be really fabulous. Thanks for giving us CD's with your music!

Jorge’s place offers a perfect location, quiet, safe , with an beautiful church right in front of your window.
The apt is clean, spacious and with with all you need for your stay .
Jorge is a kind host, always available and helpful with all your needs .
Definitely recommend and hope to be back soon !
Obrigada Jorge 😊

Jorge is the perfect host, he welcomed us warmly into his cozy home in Alfama. The house is equipped with everything you need, even washing machine and iron, plus Is very clean and quiet. The location is strategic, 2 minutes walk from the beautiful miradouro of Santa Luzia and is located in a very quiet and private square in front of a very characteristic monastery. It's very well connected by bus and tram and there are clubs and markets of all kinds just near the house. Alfama is a neighborhood waiting to be discovered, with magical and typical streets. Jorge is an attentive, kind and super helpful host, plus he will enchant you with his beautiful music!

Jorge's flat is perfectly located for anyone wishing to explore Lisbon - most of main sights are up to 15 mins away on foot. The building is really quiet and you get to experience living next to a historic convent. Jorge was very helpful and communicative throughout our stay. Highly recommend!

The apartment was clean and calm, plus in a very good location in Alfama. We enjoyed our stay a lot, Jorge was really helpful and arranged a very convenient check-in for us. The only small minus point was the slightly musty smell of the apartment, which didn't bother us too much since we could keep the windows open at all times.

We loved our experience at Jorge’s place.  Jorge was very friendly and immediately got us into the apartment when we arrived in Lisbon, set us up with a key and let us do our thing.  The apartment really has everything you could want:  it’s in the heart of the old Moorish Alfama district where amazing restaurants and taverns lie all around you at a stone’s throw; the bathroom was has fast hot water, the bedroom is cozy, there’s a kitchen, and a beautiful living room overlooking one of Lisbon’s many old beautiful Renaissance churches.  If you’re looking for a room in the old part of Lisbon, you will not be disappointed.  However, for people who are sensitive to odors, please be aware that when we stayed in September of 2021, there was a strong smell of mildew in the living room.  You can mostly clear it out by opening the window, and it’s not very noticeable in the other rooms.
Estancia en un lugar de ensueño. El apartamento muy limpio y cómodo, la ubicación perfecta, el anfitrión muy atento y siempre dispuesto a ayudar. Repetiríamos sin dudarlo!
Jorge was a great host and the place was truly spot on.

Malgré une arrivée très tardive (2h du matin), Jorge nous a acceuilli chaleureusement tout en prenant le temps de nous expliquer Lisbonne.
Je recommande l'appartement qui est très bien placé, dans un quartier vivant et authentique.

L'appartement est très charmant, propre, silencieux, et surtout très bien placé ! On se sent comme chez soi pour découvrir Lisbonne. La communication de Jorge est très réactive et très agréable. Définitivement une de nos meilleures expériences en Airbnb. N'hésitez pas !

Nous avons apprécié la localisation centrale de l'appartement de Jorge très pratique pour les visites, ainsi que le calme et la fraîcheur du lieu alors qu'il faisait relativement chaud. Toutefois, nous avons été surpris par le manque de propreté de l'appartement (cheveux dans la douche et tube de dentifrice usagé traînant dans la salle de bains, mégot de cigarette sur le rebord de la fenêtre du salon, etc), par le manque de confort du lit (le matelas à ressorts était dur ce qui ne nous a pas permis de bien dormir), par la douche (l'évacuation de l'eau était bouchée et le chauffe eau dysfonctionnait ce qui ne permettait pas d'avoir de l'eau chaude de manière constante) et par l'odeur d'humidité (qui persiste, même en aérant). Ces constats nous ont d'autant plus surpris que les commentaires précédents étaient élogieux, mais nous pensons qu'il est important que les voyageurs suivants en aient connaissance.
Cet appartement est vraiment bien situé. Visite, resto, ambiance.  Une déco soignée. Très calme et frais. La cuisine un peu sommaire mais en vacances on cuisine moins !!
La casa è molto carina e in una zona bellissima di lisbona

Jorge’s place is located right by some of the best viewpoints in Lisbon! If you’re looking to save money and walking everywhere, you’ll definitely get your steps in with all of the hills - but they’re so worth it for the charming neighborhood. There was very little noise even though you’re only a couple of blocks from major sites and feels very local. The place looks just like the pictures and has a great setup if you need to get some work done as well.
Jorge is a splendid host. He was really helpful whenever we needed some info. The house is lovely with a typical Portuguese flair and really quite at night. Near to everything. Hope to come back soon

Fantastic! An unbeatable location (it’s up a hill, even if you take the tram, so keep that in mind), but central to everything, with viewpoints and restaurants and multiple easy routes from which to explore different parts of the city, and with gorgeous views of the castle and the city. The apartment was the perfect combination of older Lisbon charm and chic details. Jorge was an outstanding host who went above and beyond, giving me a few minutes to drop my luggage and wash up earlier in the day, and even sent some stamped postcards for me when I had an early flight out. Absolutely recommend.
Good location

We really enjoyed our time in Lisbon at Jorge’s place. The location of the apartment is absolutely perfect, right in the heart of Alfama but just in a side street so it’s quiet at night. Great place to be based if you’re going to explore Lisbon. Jorge was very helpful and gave us some great local tips! Highly recommend

Jorge's place was great for us! The location is amazing, right at the heart of Alfama, walking distance to almost any touristic spot. Jorge was very responsive and quickly fixed some minor issues we had. The only thing to note is that the wifi was not very reliable. Even so, we'll be happy to stay there again.
De ligging is geweldig en erg rustig

Jorge nous a attendus et accueillis très gentiment malgré le retard de notre vol. Son appartement est idéalement situé, au calme dans le quartier de l'Alfama, près de nombreux sites d'intérêt et des transports en commun. Il est facile à trouver pour ceux qui arrivent par le métro depuis l'aéroport. Le salon/salle à manger donne sur une magnifique façade d'église, la vue depuis la chambre et la salle de bains est aussi très agréable. Il y a une cafetière et du bon café, possibilité d'écouter de la musique, des livres...de quoi se détendre après une bonne journée de marche!

We had a lovely experience from some start to finish . Communication was excellent and even when we turned up early it was no trouble for Jorge to let us in early . The apartment was large and comfortable in a fantastic location.

이 숙소는 보이는대로 사진과 거의 비슷합니다. jorge는 소통이 잘 되고, 체크인 체크아웃이 원할하게 이루어졌습니다. 언덕 위에 있어서 다니기가 좀 힘들긴 했지만, 바로 앞에 정류장이 있고 주변에 레스토랑도 많아서 편리했습니다. 더불어 상조르제 성 바로 근처에 숙소가 있어서 그 쪽을 가려고 하시는 분들에게는 좋을 것 같습니다. (바로 앞에 상조르제 성 문이 있지만 현재는 출입이 안되서 모퉁이를 돌아서 가야합니다! 티켓 판매소가 그쪽에 있어요)
Jorge is A wonderful generous host, the apartment feels like home, great area too spend time in lovely, cultural Lisboa.

Another lovely stay at Jorge's apartment. Such a convenient location and just the right size for a small family. No problem with key handover, directions. The apartment was clean and quiet, perfect place for a short stay. I'll be back.
좋은 위치, 쾌적하고 넓은 숙소, 친절한 호스트까지 모든게 좋았어요. 알파마 지구에 숙소를 잡은 덕에 근처 전망대도 올킬하고 아기자기한 분위기 속에서 머물렀네요! 다만 겨울엔 조금 추울 수 있는데 라디에이터로 공기를 훈훈하게 데우니 지낼만 했습니다 :) 좋은 숙소를 내어준 Jorge 너무 감사합니다!
Another great visit at Jorge's appartment. It's a very peaceful location despite being so central. Waking up to the sunshine and bird song is bliss and the view of the church in the evening is lovely
We had a great time staying at Jorge's flat. It was very comfortable, well located and nicely decorated. Jorge was really welcoming and we would recommend staying at his flat.
Un endroit bien situé et agréable dans la ville.  Je recommande

We can highly recommend the apartment. We had such a great time. It is at the heart of Alfama but so quiet! Everything you need is there. Also to cook a simple meal. I'm a difficult sleeper so the mattress was too wobbly for me but my boyfriend had no problem and doesn't agree ;-)
Jorge is a wonderful and warm host.
Thank you again Jorge!

Die Lage der Wohnung ist ideal, um Sightseing zu machen und das Quartier Alfama besser kennenzulernen. Das Haus liegt an ruhiger Lage. Die Wohnung ist funktional und mit allem ausgerüstet, was man braucht inklusive elektrischer Heizkörper, wenn es kühler wird.
Jorge Ist ein herzlicher Gastgeber und hat uns viele Tipps gegeben.
Charming flat located in an ideal position, quite, green and central. Bathroom and kitchen are basic. Jorge was always available and helpful
100% recomendable

Jorge’s place is close to the Castle, the tram 28 goes right past the end of the street, there are 4 miradors in walking distance and of course the Alfama with its steep cobbled streets is just there. There is a good selection of restaurants for all tastes with 2 vegetarian ones within 100m. Despite being in the center of things the appartement is quiet. We appreciated the fact Jorge was their to welcome us and say goodbye. We loved our stay and would recommend Jorge’s friendly apartment as distinct from other often characterless Airbnbs.

알파마지구 상조르즈 성 근처로 생각보다 높아 이동시  필수적으로 등산을 20분정도 해야합니다. 거실에서 앞에 성당을 바로보는 뷰는 좋았습니다. 그러나 해가 거실로는 들러오지 않고 방에만 들어옵니다. 처음 집에 들어가면 나무냄새가 많이 나서 오래된 집이라는 걸 느꼈습니다. 주방은 깨끗하지 않으므로 이용을 추천하지 않습니다. 세탁기를 돌리면 전기가 나가 두꺼비집을 계속 올려야 해서 힘들었습니다. 저녁에는 추운 날씨로 난로를 틀고 지내야 했습니다. 2~3일 머물며 리스본 알파마 를 느끼고 싶다면 추천하지만 저처럼 일주일 이상은 추천하지 않습니다.
Jorge was a great host! He was communicative and friendly. The apartment is in the perfect location with easy access to historic Lisboa and an easy commute to the airport.

L'appartement de Jorge est confortable et très bien situé. Beaucoup de visites peuvent se faire à pied, ou en tram (le tram 28 s'arrête à proximité). Jorge est un hôte accueillant et d'une grande gentillesse. C'est la deuxième fois que nous séjournons chez Jorge.
The appartment of Jorge is in the heart of Alfama and we enjoyed our stay in Lisbon alot.
Old world apartment in a great old town Lisbon location! Fantastic experience...
Simply a lovely, very central place with a peaceful vibe and a wonderful host.

Jorge’s place took us back to the beginning of Airbnb, when you could feel the authenticity and a reflection of the host’s identity, personalities and personal style. It may not be modern or luxurious, but we had the most amazing time just chilling in the living room, listening to music and looking out through the window. The wooden floors and stairs do make some noises, but we never had any problem. If you are sensitive, though, it may be something to consider. Otherwise, I would gladly recommend Jorge’s apartment to anyone traveling to Lisbon and looking to stay in the heart of Alfama.
Great place for exploring the Alfama!

상조르제성 도보 5분거리, 포르타두솔전망대 3분거리 등등 알파마 곳곳을 걸어서 여행하기 최적의 장소입니다.
창문이 많아 바람이 잘 들어와서 좋았고, 창밖 풍경도 좋고 성당에서 종소리가 시시각각 들려와 분위기가 좋았습니다.
아, 다만 세탁기가 물이 좀 세더라구요!! 그리고 화장실 문이 안에서 잠기지 않아서 그게 좀 불편했습니다.(남편과의 여행인지라 ㅋㅋㅋ)
위치 좋고 편안한 분위기에 같은 건물에 사는 친절한 호스트가 있는 리스본을 여행할수 있는 좋은 숙소였습니다.

I could not stop looking out each window! Absolutely gorgeous area of Lisbon. Jorge is a wonderful and kind host who made our short stay very comfortable and easy. Check in was a breeze and was able to let us check in a bit early which was greatly appreciated. Wish we had more time to explore since so much was at our doorstep. You will not be disappointed.
We spent a wonderful week at Jorge’s house in Lisbon. He was incredibly kind and attentive and we wouldn’t doubt to recommend his cozy apartment.

It was in a nice location but if you have a lot of luggage that you don’t want to drag up a large hill AND stairs, I would not  stay here. This place was a lot of work to get to with all of our large suitcases and this building has no elevator so we had to drag it all up the stairs. This is a nice place to chill if you are traveling very lightly and want to stay in the alfama area. Location is great and very close to portas do sol etc. apartment is cute and has everything you need if you’re just going to sleep there and be out all day. Wifi works okay.

Perfect location, could not have been more lucky with the area. 15-20 drive from the airport, charming surroundings of the aged district. Plenty of spots to eat from morning until the late night hours without the bustle of a big city. Perfect location made our first trip to Lisbon a pleasant trip. Location is at the same time quite quiet and very safe at nights. The apartment is in an old building with beautiful view from windows and everything you may need for a relaxing stay on a doorstep. Aged and charming place to soak up the local history. A very comfortable and spacious accommodation. I will happily come back.
Great location and lovely little apartment.  Not super fancy, but comfortable and really well located, walking distance to some good food/coffee and to the main sites. Will definitely recommend!!
Jorge was a superb host and we felt so lucky to be in the heart of historical Alfama

The place is cute and certainly good enough for an airbnb. It is not easy to find, however, and a good walk up the hill. That being said, it is in the heart of Alfama which is a lovely neighborhood. Jorge is a lovely host as well. D

Une expérience exceptionnelle de Lisbonne en étant chez Jorge! L’appartement est magnifique, confortable et bien situé. Les photos représentent parfaitement! On était vraiment  bien. Jorge est un hôte d’exception qui a su nous proposer des activités qui combinaient mes attentes et celles de mes enfants! Muito obrigado xx

집이 넓고 깨끗합니다. 호스트는 집에 필요한 물품 사용방법 응급상황시 대처등에 대한 자세한 설명을 해주며 친절했습니다. 근처에 레스토랑과 작은마켓이 있고 상조르즈성뒷문 바로 앞이라 경비가 상시 대기하여 안전하다고 느꼈습니다.그리고 카페garage*과 야경스팟 언덕스팟과 가까워요. 리스본자체가 캐리어끌고 다니기 힘든 바닥이어서 언덕 감안하시면 지내기 좋습니다.
Jorge was a great host, and the place was great, too! Right in the historic area with close-by tourist attractions and restaurants. The apartment was clean and the bed was comfortable. Thanks!

L’appartement est très bien situé, spacieux, calme la nuit et décoré avec goût. Jorge nous a accueillies chaleureusement, conseillées sur des concerts de qualité, et nous n’hésiterons pas une seconde à revenir chez lui.

Jorge was very welcoming and always there to help. The hot water stopped working for us but Jorge sorted it immediately! The flat is very unique and stylish and location is really fantastic - right in the middle of the historic part of Lisbon. Around 15 min walk to the central, which makes it a quite area too. There were a lot going on in the cafes and bars close to the flat and we found some great breakfast places. The cleanliness was OK. Thanks, Jorge!

We had a wonderfull stay at Jorges apartment. Great location with a beautiful view and charming restaurants and cafes close by. Jorge was very helpfull and easy to get in touch with. All in all a friendly and welcoming host. We will definitely come back :)
Merci a jorges pour l'accueil chaleureux et sa disponibilité, appartement calme et idéal pour la visite de Lisbonne.
Es un lindo Departamento, amplio y buen ubicado con un anfitrión excelente y dispuesto a ayudar en todo

Notre  séjour à Lisbonne a été fort agréable. C'est la deuxième fois que nous louons cet appartement . Il est très bien situé. Près de tout les services de transport mais également accessible à la marche à plusieurs sites d’intérêts  touristiques. L‘appartement est clair,  propre et est bien équipé pour  y  passer un court ou un long séjour. Nous y avons passé trois magnifiques semaines. Jorge notre hôte est vraiment gentil, aidant et prévenant. Il a été un excellente source  de références pour nous conseiller dans nos visites ou déplacements. Je vous conseille sans hésiter cet appartement  au coeur du plus beau quartier de Lisbonne avec un hôte à qui on peut faire confiance. Et en bonus, Jorge peut parler et comprendre le français!!
Merci à Jorge pour sa réactivité, et pour son accueil chaleureux. Le logement répondait parfaitement à nos attentes et l'emplacement est très calme pour ce quartier animé. Nous recommandons !
Très bel appartement idéalement situé qui nous a permis de découvrir Lisbonne très facilement. Jorge est très accueillant.

We had a great stay at Jorge’s place for a night. We wish we could have stayed longer. The place is very nice and very clean and comfortable and is in a beautiful location across the street from a church. It is very close to wherever you want to be. Jorge was an amazing host and helped us with recommendations, finding the train station the next morning and is even helping us get a sweatshirt that we left behind by mailing it to the USA. Highly recommend!

Jorge’s appartement is certainly the right location to start exploring Lisbon. It is very well located near some of Lisbon’s vibrant places, yet very quiet to sleep. The authentic view will charm you for sure, what a lovely beginning of your day!

The location of this apartment is absolutely perfect., so close to everything. The view of the church outside the window is beautiful. The neighbourhood is very quiet. Jorge is a very kind man who is always available to help out a traveller in a foreign country. I how stay again and highly recommend to others.
Perfect Location/helpful host/enough space for lagguage/if possible do NOT travel by car;) / Not possible to use a stroller in Most parts of alfama because of the historical ground

We really enjoyed staying at Jorge’s place! The location is amazing. Very close to all the main attractions and mostly very easy/short walks. There are two beautiful lookout spots just a couple minute walk away. We stayed there for 6 nights this time and will definitely return!

L’appartement est très bien placé, jorge est un hôte très accueillant. Nous avons adoré notre séjour. L’appartement est au frais, au cœur du centre historique. Seul bémol, il s’agit d’un vieil appartement un peu bruyant (canalisation, voisins etc. ) pensez à prendre des boules quies ! Sinon très bon rapport qualité prix.
Loved this place. JORGE was very helpful with advice on things to do and places to go. Very clean. Great location. Awesome !!.

A charming apartment on a quiet street in the  Alfama neighborhood close by the castle, consisting of four rooms nicely furnished with mid century furniture. The hot plate is anemic, but eventually gets the job done. Very quiet at night. Great location

Great stay at Jorge's place, location is fantastic just in Alfama - bit quieter than Barrio alto but beautiful views and plenty of eating and drinking places if you want to stay local. The apartment is nice all amenities you need, nice and clean and quiet. All in all a great stay for the price.

This is a conveniently located apt in the historic district yet still quiet. Jorge was very hospitable and helpful.
A great spot for a Lisbon visit!
Great place to stay and a very friendly host. You will enjoy this beautiful place, it is very quite and still perfectly located.

We absolutely loved our time in Jorge's apartment. The space had everything we needed and was perfectly located. Jorge was super helpful with any questions we had and gave us some great tips for the city. If we return to Lisbon, we'll definitely stay here!
Great flat, ideally located and a super nice host. Can fully recommend staying at Jorge's apartment!

Jorge’s place is great. A stylish, comfortable place in the heart of Alfama, but tucked away, so it is silent at night. The space is comfy and Jorge is very nice, helpful and responds quickly to messages. Great value for money as well. Would definitely stay there again!
Great time at Jorge’s home. It was very comfortable and in a great location near castelo de sao jorge.
Centrally located in the Alfama district.  Jorge was always replied quickly.

Jorge's place is a wonderful gem smack dab in the middle of the oldest neighborhood in Lisbon, the Alfama. We arrived late into the night and Jorge greeted us with a warm welcome upon arrival. We were traveling with our one-year-old daughter and we were very pleased that Jorge had a crib for her and bedding for the crib ready when we arrived. The apartment is charming and quiet with a small kitchen that we made good use of during our stay. The living/dining rooms are comfortable and well appointed and face a baroque church from the 1700s. A clothes washing machine is in the kitchen and we made use of it and hung our laundry to dry out the window like the locals. Jorge also had a great box of fun age appropriate legos for our daughter and she was was very content in the apartment. Our departure was extremely early in the morning, so Jorge met us the night before and arranged our taxi to Lisbon airport. He gave us a parting gift of his beautiful music which we will remember him by. Thank you, Jorge! We loved our visit to your beautiful history-rich city.

Jorge's place is in a fantastic location - in the heart of the old town, yet away from the noise. Within a minute, you can be sitting in a cafe listening to musicians and watching the trams go by and then just as quickly retreat to the peace and quiet of Jorge's stylish flat. Jorge is an excellent host, friendly, warm, trusting, quick to respond to queries and willing to give advice. I've stayed at his place twice and would love to stay there again.
Great location, within walking distance of many interesting places, restaurants, bars, galleries and museums. Comfortable and quiet apartment. I'd stay again.

Jorges’ place is in a fantastic location right near Castello St Jorge and walking distance to lots of the great sights, the 28 tram and metro stations. We partially enjoyed the great restaurants, cafes and viewpoints nearby and how easy it was to get around. Jorge was great at keeping in touch and gave us a great dinner recommendation on our first day. Thanks so much, Jorge!

large one bedroom, second-floor walk-up. very gracious host, with lots of good information about the area. don't expect fancy decor, but certainly has everything you need for a comfortable stay. Excellent value-for-money, and 10 minutes walk to anywhere
위치가 트램 가까이 있던 점이 무척 좋았습니다
Zeer goed gelegen appartement met zicht op een oude kerk: zeer speciaal!

We loved our stay in this beautiful old apartment. It's tucked away in a quiet spot, but it's close to great bars/ restaurants, walks and views. Jorge recommended a trip to the flea market on our first morning, and it was a great way to kick off our trip. Thank you Jorge!
A lovely place, full of charm and a great location.
I loved staying at Jorge's cozy, stylish and comfortable Alfama apartment.  It felt like home and was the perfect location from which to explore the spectacular Lisboa cityscape.
A nice flat in a fantastic area of Lisbon. Jorge was super helpful.
Excellente localisation dans une place calme au coeur du quartier d Alfama.

A moradia é sensacional!!!!!!!! A localização excelente, próximo, a poucos metros dos principais atrativos, como Castelo de São Jorge e Miradouro Porta do Sol. Os elétricos 12 e 28 param praticamente na porta. Embora, a morada seja perto de tudo é super silenciosa, pois fica numa rua fechada em frente a uma igreja. Fui com um bebê de 1a e 8m e foi tudo ótimo. Jorge disponibiliza legos e berço. A cama e a roupa de cama são bem confortáveis. Enfim, tudo muito bom.

Jorge's place is excellent, the location is ideal in the centre of alfama but still peaceful and quiet. The photos don't do justice to the wonderful view over the roof tops from the bedroom which is flooded with light in the morning and a wonderful place to start your day. Jorge was a fantastic host and waited up until well after midnight to greet us when our flight was delayed and let us check out late to enjoy the most of our last day in Lisbon

Superbement accueilli par Jorge dans un appartement très bien situé et très calme! Nous sommes restés quelques jours avec notre enfant de 7 mois (lit parapluie fourni!) et tout s'est extrêmement bien passé. Très chaudement recommandé!
ps: Jorge a même eu une attention particulière le jour de mon anniversaire ;)
Jorge is a supernice host for a quiet superlocated flat in the middle of everything.
Jorge is a very nice and helpful host. The appartment is very nice with an exellent central position. Highly recommended.
Great place to be. Enough space in the apartment with all the things you need to make your stay comfortable. Jorge is supportive when needed! We liked the place and can recommend it.

The apartment was as expected and fit our needs. It was close to everything including the sights of Lisbon, restaurants, and airport. The tram lines 28 and 12 run by the apartment and the neighborhood was very safe. The apartment was very quiet and peaceful in the morning, as the birds were chirping each morning. Jorge was very helpful and accommodating and communication was great. I would have no problem staying here again. We had a wonderful stay here during our 3 days in Lisbon!

Jorge est un hôte très charment. Nous avons découvert de très bons restaurants juste à côté de l'appartement en suivant ses conseils. Nous avons passé un excellent séjour dans cet appartement joliment décoré offrant de très belles vues.
Jorge est très gentil et attentif. Merci pour cette belle rencontre. A bientôt
Jorge was a fantastic host. He even let us keep our baggage in the apartment while we ent to see the last few city sites. Thank you so much for your hospitality!
This is a great place, Jorge is a superbe host, and the apartment is ideal located. If what you are looking for are some days of holidays and tourism in old Lisbon, I don't think you'll find better.

Walking distance to Alfama, Sao Jorge castle, Tram 28 stop and a viewpoint. Very convenient location. Jorge gave us a very friendly greeting on the first day and was very responsive to my message during our stay.  We loved the living room with a window to view an old church.  The bed was very comfortable with fluffy pillows. The bath was clean. Excellent apartment to stay in Lisbon!

My friend and I stayed at Jorge’s wonderful charming apartment. It was very quite, as described - you can hear the horns from the boats. It is very central, you can reach all the places to see by foot or via other means of transportation.
Jorge was v forward coming with the arrival and departure time. He gave us local tips which really helped.
He also warned us of a storm.
I would certainly love to stay at this wonderful apartment, if back in Lisboa and definitely recommend to others.
Thank you Jorge, to be a great host and make our stay rather pleasant.
Fantastic location across from old convent & church, old apartment with character, light, tall ceilings.

숙소가 성당 바로 앞에 있었고 전망이 굉장히 좋았습니다 ! 주변이 조용하고 한적 했어요 ~
호스트도 굉장히 좋은 분이라 친절히 답해주시고 좋았습니다 . 다만 체크인 시간이 정말 정확히 3시에만 가능 하였고 그전에 짐을 맡겨 주었습니다 :)
와이파이는 침실에서는 잘 안되는 편이었고 이 두가지 이외에는 굉장히 편안하게 쉴 수 있는 공간이었습니다 ^^ 좋은 숙소에 머물게 되어서 너무 좋았습니다 ~~

Jorge is such a lovely guy and always responded to our queries quickly. His place is in a perfect spot (close to restaurants, shops & tourist spots) and is very clean & homely. I highly recommend his place to other travellers! Thanks again Jorge!

Absolutely perfect. Far exceeded our expectations. Our host Jorge was warm and welcoming and the apartment is cosy, right in the heart of Alfama, just across the street from a splendid old church. We felt privileged to be there.

The apartment is fabulously situated in the centre of the historic Alfama district but off the Main Street so it was very peaceful and quiet to sleep. The apartment itself was spacious and very clean. It served us perfectly for our three days in Lisbon.
Great apartment away from tourist traffic.  Well-situated in safe area.  Lots of hills, but that’s Lisbon.
Ein wunderbarer Ort, um Lissabon zu erkunden!

Jorge was a great host. He gave good recommendations, and he also let us leave our bags before the check in time so we could go explore the city.
The apartment is in a good location - not too loud, but still within walking distance of the city center.

Jorge is a wonderful host. He welcomed us warmly in his beautiful flat. we felt really comfortable. The apartment is perfectly located in the middle of Alfama. Everything is in walking distance and there are numerous cafes and restaurants nearby - the Cathetral and the Castle of São Jorge are very close! Thank you for an unforgettable time

Appartement très agréable, sur une petite place à l’ancienne, très calme. Le quartier a été mon préféré de Lisbonne, accès facile à tous les autres coins de la ville. L’accueil a été extrêmement sympathique par Jorge, malgré l’heure d’arrivée tardive. L’hôte est très arrangeant. Super adresse !

Jorge's place is truly authentic, stylish, well decorated and clean. Located at a quiet square right in front of a beautiful church, it's somewhat of a hidden gem in the touristic neighbourhood of Alfama. Jorge is a kind and easy-going host, who is passionate about his city. Recommended!
Alles super. Gerne wieder.

Dear new visitors,
This wonderful apartment located directly in the old part of Lisbon (Alfama). The castle is very close and with the cable car E28 you can reach a lot of special places. Although there are a lot of bars and restaurants close by the area of the apartment is very quite.
Jorge is a fantastic host. He is very helpful and so nice!
Take your chance and visit Lisbon and use this apartment for your stay.

Jorge’s place was perfect! Really quiet even though it was in the center!
I was able to do a laundry, and Jorge help us with some places to go and things to do
Great host and very nice place!! Lisbonne was fun!

Absolutely beautiful gem truly in the heart of Lisbon. We loved our stay at Jorge’s place; everything was incredibly accessible and we were in love with the quaint streets around us. Jorge was very friendly and helpful and we would love to stay again!

We had a lovely time at Jorge's place. The flat was clean, big and had everything you needed. Everything  was as described, location was perfect very close to the main Lisbon's attractions. Jorge  gave us all the information we needed. We will definitely go there again.

Jorge’s place far exceeded our expectations. This Airbnb is located in the best area of Alfama, close to amazing restaurants and historic attractions including Castelo de Sao Jorge and many more. Jorge’s place is up the hill in Alfama; walk just 2 blocks and you will be standing at one of the most beautiful sightseeing locations of Lisbon; pretty much the highlight of the Tram 28 route and just around the corner from this Airbnb. Jorge’s place is beautifully decorated, clean, and full of natural light. We were delighted to wake up to the sound of birds and the city’s cathedral bells as well as have nights of seafood and Fado without worrying when walking alone at night (extremely safe streets). Honestly, we could not have asked for any better; we truly loved Jorge’s Airbnb, the neighborhood of Alfama, and the amazing city of Lisbon.  We are definitely coming back.

Jorge was an awesome host and very helpful in terms of both local tips and check-in. The apartment is great and the location is splendid. I will definitely be coming back to this apartment and I would recommend it to all travelers making their way through Lisbon.
Jorge est un très bon hôte. Son appartement est idéalement situé. Il est d’une très grande gentillesse!

We were lucky to stay at Jorge's apartment in the amazing Alfama neighborhood. We wished it could have been longer. The apartment has everything you might need with wonderful views of the city and is super quiet and clean. Jorge is a fantastic host and goes above and beyond to make you feel at home. We would be back to stay in a second!

The apartment is in a great location, close to lovely restaurants and within walking distance to major attractions and public transport links. Jorge was very responsive to messages and helped out when needed. I would recommend this apartment to others!
This is a nice and quiet place to stay and start discovering Lisbon.Jorge is a very helpful host. We had a good time there.
We couldn’t have asked for a better location! The apartment was spacious, with a beautiful view of the old church. Jorge was a great host- quick to respond and very helpful.
Sehr schöne, ruhig aber zentral gelegene Wohnung mit allem, was man braucht und einem sehr freundlichen Gastgeber.
We loved staying at Jorge’s place in centre Lisbon, homey, charming and close to everything... also incredibly quiet and silent for the busy neighbourhood of Alfama! Highly recommended!!!
Nice place to visit Lissabon
great place!

Jorge hat eine super gemütliche Wohnung in einem
ruhigen Hinterhof zentral in Alfama. Uns hat es super gefallen! Man kann von hier aus durch die wunderschönen Gassen Alfamas schlendern und für 2 Personen ist diese Wohnung sehr perfekt. Mit Fenstern geöffnet wird man morgens vor Vogelgezwitscher geweckt :) Jorge ist ein super netter Gastgeber mit tollen Tips. Sehr empfehlenswert ist das Restaurant Damas 10-15 min entfernt mit täglich wechselnden Speisen.
Wir kommen gerne wieder! Danke Jorge :)

Jorge is an excellent host with advice and assistance when you need it. he took the time to meet and greet us when we arrived and to say goodbye when we left. We even got a hug xxx
The accommodation was perfect for us, with lovely views from all the windows and very close to the Castle of St Jorge. We had everything we needed whilst we were there and we slept like babies. Highly recommend staying at Jorge's!!!

The apartment is located at the center of beautiful Alfama town, right next to the popular classic 28E tram. Every important spot is whitin walking distance and there are great restaurants and bars nearby. The apartment buidling itself looks like having such an old history but the inside is very clean and well cared.

Jorge is a brilliant and thoughtful host. He went extra miles to make us feel at home. His accommodation is nicely situated in Alfama and a short journey from the city centre. Would highly recommend his flat.
Emplacement idéal, au calme extrême et tout de même à deux pas de la vie nocturne ! Jorge est disponible et arrangant, je recommande !
Jorge's apartment is simply delightful: a fabulous place to stay in Lisbon. Beautifully situated. And Jorge is a thoughtful and solicitous host. It was a pleasure to stay at his place.
Jorge’s flat is in a totally alive location ... the heart of everything ... I will return because the flat is the best of the best and Jorge helped make the visit memorable.

For future travelers to Lisboa - stay here! I loved the apartment and all that it had to offer.  It was a place that I could truly live in. I felt so comfortable and relaxed in this place. It was the perfect place to return to after hours exploring the city. Two days here were not enough. The Alfama has changed since I was there last in 2002.  More people, that's for sure.  But the streets offered excitement and hidden gems at every turn.  Jorge was a great person and an excellent host.  I wish I could have spent more time hanging out with him.

Perfect location in a beatiful city. We were there during St. Antonio festival - really great festivities and parties. Jorge's apartment is in the very heart of it all, yet provides really nice tranquilitiy - we highly recommend.
We loved our stay! The appartment is lovely and the location perfect!
방과 거실 창 밖으로 보이는 풍경과 아침마다 들리는 새소리가 너무 좋은 숙소입니다. 알파마 지구 곳곳을 구경하기에 아주 좋은 위치이며 트램과 버스가 주변에 다니기 때문에 이동시에도 좋습니다.

This place is terrific!  A great location and so quiet. You wake to the local birdsong every morning. Jorge is a fabulous host - super attentive and quick to respond to any requests. I highly recommend this Airbnb.
The apartment is beautiful, and very centrally located. Jorge was very friendly, and quick to help. Recommended!

The apartament is perfect for two: spacious, sunny and with a nice view. It is perfectly located in a lively area of Lisbon. From there you can easily reach all other parts of town. The kitchen is small but well equipped but I haven't bothered to cook as there are really nice restaurants close by. The host is extremely helpful and flexible with the check in and out. We have enjoyed every moment of our stay there. Thank you Jorge.
Jorge is a very kind host who made our stay in this beautiful city so much more enjoyable.The apartment is  quiet, but still central  to most areas.

Jorge estuvo atento en todo momento, nos ayudo con el aparcamiento del coche y fue muy paciente puesto que llegamos mas tarde de la hora prevista. El apartamento es perfecto y esta muy bien ubicado, no le falta detalle. Sin duda repetiria mi estancia aqui si fuese a Lisboa de nuevo. Un placer Jorge.
A nice flat, in a good area and very helpful and engaged host

Nous avons passé 3 jours dans l'appartement de Jorge. L'appartement est très calme et idéalement situé pour bien visiter Lisbonne.
