Un grand merci à Jorge pour son accueil et sa disponibilité.

The stay at Jorge's apartment was absolutely perfect. Jorge replied all our emails, we had a very late check-in - thank you again for this, dear Jorge! - and the apartment was nice. My daughter and I spent a few days in Lisboa and we recommend Jorge's place without any hesitation. Rekha & Lisa

This apartament has everything you need. Great  localisation in a heart of Alfama, great  view and all accessories you need- even hair conditioner :) It has a vintage climat so if you like that kind of things you will have a great time there. There are lot of restaurants and shops nearby so in the evening, after a long day strolling you can eat something listening to fado and in  5 minutes walk   be in bed. Jorge, thanks a lot for your help :)

Nous avons passé un moment très agréable à Lisbonne. L'appartement est idéalement situé et Jorge est un hôte très sympa et disponible en cas de besoin.
Vous êtes a deux pas du château, de l'Alfama et du tram 28. c'est idéal pour flâner des les multiples ruelles. le quartier bouillonne dans la journée mais l'appartement est légèrement en retrait ce qui permet d'être au calme.
Nous recommandons cette adresse.
Stéphanie et Anthony

조지는 매우 섬세합니다. 집을 들어가는 순간 그가 얼마나 여행객을 배려하는지 느껴집니다.
집에서 향기가 가득 깨끗한 침구와 가구들이 기분 좋게합니다.
그리고 조지가 같은 건물에 있어 의사소통이 빠르고 정확합니다.
하지만 집이 매우 언덕에 있어 공항에서 갈때 올때는 택시를 이용하는게 좋습니다.
거리가 가까워서 얼마 나오지 않으니 택시 이용을 추천합니다.
침실이 너무 좋아서 잠을 푹 잤습니다.
다음에 리스본에 간다면 또 조지의 집을 예약할 것 입니다.
너무너무 고마웠습니다 조지
잘 쉬고갑니다!

Jorge’s apartment is in an excellent location with everything you could possibly want to make your stay in Lisbon perfect. He has created a wonderful home to give the traveller/holiday maker many comforts and facilities to enjoy when far from home. Thank you Jorge for everything you did for us. We had a wonderful stay! Sally and Antony

This is a great place to stay! Right across from a beautiful old church. And in a good neighborhood. It was so nice to be able to leave the apartment and immediately be in a beautiful part of the city, so close to a lot of things to do, but then be able to go back to the home and feel very comfortable in the quiet and relaxed space.
It smells toxic, it is dirty, cold, and not represented accurately in the photos. The host was not  helpful and seemed offended that we were not happy.
Logement tranquille et bien situé dans les hauteurs de l'Alfama. Bon accueil de Jorge.

Jorge fue muy simpatico y atento, pero el piso nos defraudó bastante. Nada más entrar el piso olía a humedad, la mampara de la ducha estaba rota, la cama hacía muchísimo ruido y en vez de tener un nórdico tamaño matrimonio, tenía 2 individuales por lo que dormir se hacía bastante incómodo. Lo bueno que tiene es la ubicación, que está en pleno barrio de Alfama!

It was real pleasure for us to stay in Jorge’s apartment. It’s located close to many different places of interest, for example St.Jorge castle was literally 5mins away. Apartment was clean, cozy and authentic. Special thanks for great vinyl collection ;)
Overall highly recommended place.
And thank you for CD Jorge ;)

Jorge's apartment is in an ideal location to explore Lisbon! There are many lovely cafes, restaurants and shops nearby but it is still quiet in the apartment. It is only fifteen minutes walk from the centre of Lisbon or you can get one of the wonderful yellow trams!
The apartment is clean, spacious and has everything you could need. Jorge is a very pleasant and helpful host.

알파마지구의 한적한 곳에 위치해있는 조지의 숙소, 28번 트램이 현재 공사중이지만 대체 버스로 운영중이라 대중교통으로 다니기도 좋고 기차역에서도 가까웠어요.
거실과 다이닝룸 바로 앞에 성당뷰라서~ 진짜 창문밖으로 그림같은 풍경이 펼쳐지고, 침실은 화사한 느낌이었어요. 사진 그대로였구요!
뜨거운물도 잘 나오고~ 부엌에도 필요한 것들 모두 잘 갖춰져있어서 간단히 아침에 조리해먹기 좋았습니다. 제가 있는동안 비가 계속 부슬부슬 내려서 살짝 추웠는데 히터도 두대나 있어서 따뜻하게 지냈구요.
조지아저씨가 체크인/체크아웃할때 친절히 맞아주시고, 공항가는 택시도 잡아주셔서 편하게 왔네요. 현지 핫스팟과 맛난 식당도 알려주셨어요. 리스본의 매력을 느낄 수 있는 그런 숙소였던것 같아요.

Jorge est un hote tres accueillant et vous donnera des conseils pour votre séjour.   Son logement est bien situé et bien équipé.  Comme indiqué dans d'autres commentaires, on peut entendre les voisins du dessus pendant la journée mais le soir tout est tres calme. Le seul vrai bémol serait le chauffage qui peut être insuffisant par temps humide et frais...preferez ce logement pour le printemps/été plutôt que pour l'hiver.  Autrement c est un bon logement pour découvrir Lisbonne.

We were warmly greated by Jorge upon our arrival.  He showed us the neighborhood and gave us tips on restaurants and places to go.  He is passionate about Lisbon and shares that with his guests.  We enjoyed this area of Lisbon so much and were glad we chose to stay here!  He is a kind man and we feel like we made a new friend!  He arranged a taxi for our early morning departure, too!

Jorge's place is great. The best thing about it is the location, tucked away in a quiet corner below the castle, no traffic or night life just peace and quiet, but everything you will love about Lisbon is a few steps away. We went up to the nearby viewpoint most evenings to watch the sun go down over the city - amazing! and if flea markets are your thing, the Santa Clara Saturday market is great, full of a bit of everything from junk to art to antiques, just a few minutes from Jorge's. The flat is exactly as described, good value, and Jorge is a very nice guy and a good host. Highly recommended.
Very nice and clean appartment located in a quite part of Alfama. Highly recommended

Appartement très agréable et très calme dans un quartier populaire de Lisbonne. Vous êtes à quelques minutes de la Plaça Figueiras.
Aisé à trouver, notre hôte était bien présent à l'heure.
Super nice host. Quiet, nice apt, close to city center.
Très bon accueil et emplacement idéal !

Small but quaint one-of-a-kind place, historic and close to everything, and Jorge is a super helpful host. The area around the castle crawls with tourists during the day/evening, but Graca is just as close in the opposite direction, and there you will find lots to see and do and fewer touristy shops and restaurants (also a big grocery store). O Prego, the resturant just steps from the apartment, is a wonderful welcoming place with good food and Fado.
Brilliant location and clean, spacious apartment. Jorge is lovely and very accommodating. We really enjoyed our stay here.
What a wonderful place, perfect location for us. Thanks jorge for your hospitality

The apartment is in great location in the old district, quite and secluded while still right there next to the castle. We couldn't wish for a better place to explore Alfama's small streets. Jorge was very quick to response, was very helpful and provided valuable tips and help to make sure we made the most from our visit. We are looking forward for the next opportunity to visit Lisbon and will definitely be looking to book this apartment again.
Jorge was wonderful and very helpful. His apt is well situated and we were thrilled with our time there
Apartment was really nice, clean, and spacious. Location is great in an older area of Lisbon, 10-15 minute walk down to "downtown" Lisbon. Jorge is great and responds to communication really quick.

Un grazie a Jorge che ha saputo accoglierci con puntualità e simpatia. La casa è molto carina e in un’ottima posizione. Un po’ complicata forse per passeggini o per chi ha problemi di deambulazione ma questa è l’Alfama: un su e giù di caratteristiche stradine !
Abbiamo apprezzato tutto e speriamo ci possa essere un’altra occasione

L'appartement de Jorge est très bien situé, conforme aux photos et dans une rue calme. Jorge est un hôte d'une extrême gentillesse et nous a accueilli chaleureusement. Nous sommes arrivés à Lisbonne tôt le matin et Jorge a accepté que nous déposions nos bagages à l'appartement afin que nous puissions commencer nos visites.
Merci beaucoup Jorge pour tout.
We had a wonderful stay a Jorge's apartment. The location is absolutely perfect, and Jorge is an excellent host. We instantly felt welcome. We will be back.
Super friendly, communicative host. Clean, authentic apartment in a great location.
Perfect location and quick communication! 5/5!

This is a fantastically located apartment in the heart of Alfama Lisbon. It is very spacious with everything you need. Jorge was a great host with some brilliant tips and very friendly. Our favourite part of the day was breakfast sitting at the window watching people going by.

The location is superb, close to the castle in the old Alfama district which is full of character. Plenty of restaurants and activity nearby but the apartment itself was tranquil. The apartment needs attention in a few areas: an information/ instruction booklet would be useful; the place is a little tired and needs some TLC including a thorough clean, new bedding/linen and the drain smell sorted. If these things were done the place would be amazing. It has wonderful views - of the facade of the Menino de Deus church from the front and over the rooftops of Alfama from the back.

We stayed at Jorges place for 3 nights and had a good stay in Lisbon. Jorge was really friendly and helpful. He even gave us advices were to shop without paying touristic prices etc. We found everything as described. The location in Alfarma is perfect.
The only minor (!) negative points were, that there is a slight musty smell due to high moisture in the building and both sleeping rooms are not totally quite. But that was totaly fine for us.

Jorge was a great host and helped us with everything we needed. The apartment was clean and nice. It has everything you need for a stay in Lisboa, especially if you want to cook in the apartment. It is located in the middle of Alfama and we could reach the city center, the hotspots and places to eat, drink and buy food (restaurants and supermarkets). We would recommend it to our family and friends if they would like to stay there so discover beautiful Lissabon. Thanks to our host and the great city, we had an awesome stay
Jorge was a wonderful host! Just a slight issues with the hot water in the shower. Amazing location with lots of good suggestions from him. Even helped us with the taxi to the airport

The location of Jorge's apartment is excellent - right in the heart of the old city but with car access limited, very peaceful and quiet. It's lovely to sit at the windows, sipping coffee or wine and watching the other tourists wind their way up to see the historic old Church opposite the apartment. Jorge couldn't have been more helpful in welcoming us, providing tourism and travel advice and arranging our taxi back to the airport.

Die Unterkunft entspricht gut dem Preis-Leisutungs-Verhältnis. Für 2 Personen hat die Wohnung eine gute Größe. Die Matratze ist relativ hart, das Schlafsofa ein klassisches IKEA-Sofa, also völlig ausreichend für ein paar Nächte (Man sollte nicht so groß sein). Wir hatten in der Wohnung alles was wir brauchten. Die Lage ist gut, wenn auch relativ viele Touristen vor dem Fenster, die den Nebeneingang zur Castelo de Jorge mit dem Haupteingang verwechseln. In der Gegend wird derzeit auch viel gebaut.
Insgesamt ist es etwas müffelig in der Wohnung, vermutlich liegt es an den Leitungen, ist aber nicht übermäßig schlimm oder störend.
Jorge ist super nett und hilft (Er hat uns bei unserem Taxi-Dilemma geholfen und mit dem Taxifahrer gesprochen, am Abreisetag hat er uns ein Taxi besorgt etc.) wo er kann.

Den lobenden Kommentaren der anderen Gäste von Jorge können wir uns nur anschließen. Die ruhige Wohnung liegt sehr zentral in Alfama, die Tram 12 fährt direkt unten an der Straße, die berühmte 28 nur ein paar Schritte weiter. In der Umgebung sind zahlreiche Restaurants und Cafes, auch zur Burg ist es nicht weit. Supermärkte sind zu Fuß etwas weiter weg, ca. 10 Minuten. Da wir recht spät am Nachmittag abgereist sind, konnten wir netterweise unser Gepäck noch bei Jorge unterstellen und er hat uns auch ein Taxi zum Flughafen gerufen und sogar mit uns draußen gewartet, bis es da war. Wir würden jederzeit zurückkommen!

Jorge ist ein sehr zuverlässiger und freundlicher Gastgeber. Seine Wohnung liegt sehr zentral in der Nähe zweier toller Lissaboner Attraktionen (Tram 12 und 24). Wir fanden die Anreise über die Google-Beschreibung eine Herausforderung, da die eigentliche Adresse nicht eingezeichnet ist. Also am besten genau nachfragen, wie man es findet. Wir waren mit einem Kleinkind (2 Jahre) da und Jorge hatte sogar etwas Spielzeug, was unserem Sohn gut gefallen hat. Die Wohnung ist beschaulich. Das Bett quietscht sehr und die Sauberkeit hat nicht ganz unseren Vorstellungen entsprochen. Das haben wir Jorge aber auch so zurück gemeldet.

L'appartamento corrisponde alla descrizione! Non moderno, ma in linea con lo standard del quartiere, che è uno di quelli residenziali/popolari degli abitanti di Lisbona!  Nelle immediate vicinanze ci sono alimentari, frutta e verdura, forni e ristoranti frequentati da gente del posto! Jorge, il proprietario di casa, è molto disponibile, risponde subito alle email che gli si inviano. Considerate sempre che l'Alfama sta in salita, quindi per raggiungere qualunque posto bisogna camminare abbastanza e faticare un po': da Piazza del commercio saranno circa 10 min, Bairro Alto, Baixa e Chiado circa 30!!
Jorge à tout simplement été un hôte remarquable! Attentif, gentil, disponible! Quant à l'appartement: genial! Tres bien situé, au calme... on y reviendra!

Jorge has a very nice, clean, comfy place, right next to the castle, a convent and church to tour, many sites, restaurants, walking distance to the local area- there's a lot of steep climbs in this part of Lisbon as it's a hilltop. Cities were build high for strategic reasons, thus making this area super old and historic. . The tram is right around the corner as well as a mini market for good prices food (groceries) and drinks.
Great host, great place, great food, great place.
Thanks again Jorge!!!
nice flat, super location, easy check in and out, jorge the host is very friendly and gave us the best support, easy communication, we will be back

Jorge est un hôte vraiment très gentil et bienveillant
L'appartement est parfait, bien situé, on dort bien
Tout est là.
Excellent rapport qualité prix!
À recommander!

The house was everything we could have asked for! It's in a super cute area close to the Alfama, Sao Jorge and dowtown areas. The place was clean and stocked for our travel! Highly recommend getting a cab there with luggage! The apartment is high up and its a steep walk!

Cute and quirky apartment ideal for a couple exploring Lisbon. Beautiful cathedral view. Central area - busy with tourists during the day but much calmer at night. Lots of options nearby for authentic food and drink and sightseeing. Apartment fully equipped, clean and well presented.

Tres bon accueil de la part de Jorge! Nous avons passé un weekend sur Lisbonne en famille avec un garçon  de 4 ans et Jorge avait ce qu'il fallait pour accueillir un enfant! Le logement en Lui meme est vraiment propre, chaleureux; au niveau emplacement c'est tres intéressant pour découvrir le quartier de l'alfama, celui ci est situé dans un quartier historique et calme.

Esperienza meravigliosa! Jorge è molto attento e sempre gentilissimo. Puntuale nella comunicazione e negli orari, è stato molto disponibile quando abbiamo chiesto di potere lasciare i bagagli. Una persona molto piacevole e molto amichevole, ci ha anche fatto un regalino al momento della partenza! La casa è splendida, ancora più bella di come appare nelle fotografie. Cucina ben equipaggiata e spazio per pranzare in quattro. Adatta anche ai bambini, con tanto di lettino e giocattoli. La posizione dell'appartamento è incantevole, nel cuore dell'Alfama ma silenziosissima e riservata. Assolutamente consigliato a tutti!
Amazing location, super friendly host. Would highly recommend.

C'était parfait .
Emplacement idéal et calme dans les hauteurs de Lisbonne . Jorge est très sympatique et de bons conseils.

Jorge's place ticks all the boxes! It's in a great cul de sac of Alfama's charming labyrinth of streets. Jorge himself is a great host, the airline we flew with lost our luggage and without Jorge's generous help it wouldn't have been possible to get it delivered. Highly recommended!
It is the perfect Place for discovering Lissabon by foot. Jorge was very helpful and gave us some very good reconmendations for Restaurants or places to visit.
recommend!

It has been a pleasure to stay at Jorge's apartment! The location of this cosy apartment is perfect - you'll stay in the heart of Alfama, in a calm tiny side street behind the church. Jorge is a great host! The communication with him has been wonderful from the beginning...if you are looking for a place to stay in Lisbon, this is it.
All I can say is thank you, Jorge for the warm welcome! It has been a pleasure to meet you! We'd love to come back some day. All the best!

The apartment is very pleasant and clean.  It has ample room for two people and could easily accommodate more.  It gets a lot of light and has wonderful views.  It is in a great location, next to the Alfama district, with winding narrow streets filled with shops and restaurants and many historical sites.  It is also within easy walking distance of Castelo de Sao Jorge, one of Lisbon's most fascinating sites.  Jorge was a gracious host.  He was easy to communicate with and made sure that all our needs were met.  We would gladly stay there again.

Jorge is a warm inviting host, whom you'd be grateful to have met! As well, his apartment is comfortable and tastefully decorated! I loved the space and quiet nights. The location is perfect!!! Only around the corner up the hill is the best lookout and sunset spot! Everything you need is right here! Super easy to get into and out of via taxi, which can be difficult in the ALFAMA. I highly recommend Jorge's as you won't be disappointed and you'll find it's a super easy stay! Thank you Jorge!

Jorge ist ein sehr liebenswerter Gastgeber. Das Appartment ist genau so wie schon vielfach hier beschrieben. Super Lage direkt in Alfama. Und vor allem ruhig. Nach seinem Tages- und Nachtprogramm kann man hier wunderbar schlafen und relaxen, um für den nächsten Tag wieder fit zu sein. Frühstück und Abendessen sind in unmittelbarer Nähe reichlich vorhanden. Und das zu moderaten Preisen. Selbst das Taxi zum Flughafen (Flug um 8:00 Uhr) kostete nur 10 €. Wir hatten einen wundervollen Aufenthalt in Lissabon und würden sofort wieder hier einziehen.
Jorge est un hôte très accueillant et très intéressant.. Disponible pour donner des infos sur sa ville. Le logement était propre et très fonctionnel. Vivement recommandé
Jorge's apartment is located in the heart of Alfama. He's an excellent host and we can only recommend him and his apartment.

Jorge was a brilliant host and upon welcoming up into the apartment, took us on a tour of the local area. The area is perfect and has everything you need all in walking distance. A great place to base exploring Lisbon from. Thanks so much Jorge, we good to see you again.

We highly recommend Jorge's apartment in Lisbon!
The apartment is nicely situated in the middle of Alfama. The view from the windows is pretty amazing as there's an old church across the small alley.
Jorge welcomed us warmly to Lisbon and after getting settled he also showed some amazing miradouros in the heart of Alfama. He also tipped us about some great restaurants and breakfast places.
We felt welcomed and really enjoyed our time in Lisbon and in Jorge's apartment.

We as a little family had some wonderful days in Jorges apartment. There was even a big box of toys for the little one. It is located pretty close to many sights but also to some areas like Graca where you can experience a more "live as usual" atmosphere. Thanks a lot.

This was our last stop on our trip and I needed some downtime.  My daughters walked to places we had previously visited while I sat having coffee in our lovely square.  It is a short walk to anything in the old district.  Wear comfortable shoes because you do a lot of up and down cobblestone little roads.  The whole apartment was ours and we cooked chicken paella the last night.  Thanks again Jorge, your apartments are lovely!

Die Lage der Unterkunft direkt unterhalb (östlich) der Burg ist der perfekte Ausgangspunkt für diejenigen, die sich durch Alfama treiben lassen möchten. Aufgrund der relativ hohen Lage ist ein wenig Fitness für die gefragt, die das zu Fuß machen wollen (Wir, 55 und 60 Jahre alt, haben 3 Tage lang alles zu Fuß gemacht und hatten keine Probleme). Nur 2 Minuten entfernt sind die Haltestellen der berühmten Elektro-Bahn. Viele Restaurants, Minimercados etc. sind ganz in der Nähe. Trotz der Lage ist es nachts ruhig, und auch am Tag nicht wirklich laut, da die Wohnung von der belebten Seite abgewandt liegt.
Die Wohnung ist schlicht eingerichtet, hat aber alles, was benötigt wird. Wer es luxuriös mag, sollte sich daher was anderes suchen. Wer es pragmatisch bevorzugt, findet eine tolle Unterkunft zu einem überzeugenden Preis-/Leistungsverhältnis. Der Vermieter Jorge ist sehr freundlich, kommunikativ und hilfsbereit, gibt Tipps für Bars und Restaurants in der Nähe und organisiert zum Ende auch bei Bedarf das Taxi. Immer wieder gerne ...

1 bon séjour au pays du fado
Appartement bien placé, quartier agréable, Tram 12 et 28 à proximité, centre ville accessible à pied.
Le soleil et la chaleur étaient au rendez-vous , top!

Jorge is an amazing host--so kind and so generous!  He was quick to reply to all questions and offered many suggestions.  The location of the apartment is on a quiet street and is wonderfully serene for light sleepers yet central.  I enjoyed the (very hilly) walks, exploring the beautiful Alfama area (and always getting lost haha), and talking to the lovely people who owned and worked in the restaurants/shops.  The apartment has unique furniture and I even bought an LP to play on the record player.  It was well-equipped with all the comforts you'll need.  If I ever travel to Lisbon again, I would stay at Jorge's apartment!
Perfect flat in the most amazing and beautiful place. Jorge is the perfect host and a genuine community guy. Can't recommend high enough and hope to return as soon as possible! Thank you, Jorge!

This apartment is lovely and quaint and very comfortable. It has a good shower and washing machine and plenty of store cupboard staples for cooking with. The location is nice and quiet, while being close to cafes, restaurants, bars and bakeries. It is also convenient for the metro and the main circular tram route into the city. Communication with Jorge is very easy and he even gave us a tour of the local area. On the first day to help us orientate ourselves. We recommend this apartment.

Stay was very nice during our visit to Lisboa.
Room is very big. Everything was very to near to Jorge place
Thank you

Jorge is a very attentive, nice and friendly host. We met him by change twice in bakery and a bar during our stay, and had a very nice time with him. He was playing his guitar and singing fado in one of the local tapas bars. He gave us good tips on excursions. The flat is lovely (large, nicely furnished) and location is great. Would highly recommend, and good value for money.
非常完美。房东是个很和蔼可亲的人。

Abbiamo scelto l'appartamento di menino deu in primo luogo leggendo le recensioni di altri viaggiatori. Siamo rimasti piacevolmente sorpresi dall'accuratezza della descrizione. Abbiamo trovato un appartamento idealmente situato nel cuore di Alfama, forse il nostro quartiere preferito a Lisbona. La pulizia era perfetta, l'appartamento gradevole, silenzioso e calmo. Jorge é un ospite pieno di attenzioni seppur discreto, di gentilezza rara.

Jorge un capo buenísima onda y muy atento. Nos recomendó lugares y siempre contesto rápidamente. El lugar es tal cual las fotos: muy limpio y bien ubicado en un barrio hermoso. Volveríamos sin dudarlo. Obrigado Jorge!

Idéalement situé, tram et  chateau au pied de l'appartement, très tranquille le soir et la nuit. Appartement sympa, propre, belles vues, wifi... Hote accueillant et prévenant. Bref, tout est simple et sympa.
LIEU DE VIE pittoresque , calme, environnement pièton , le Lisbonne historique à deux pas, castle, miradors, alfama ... Hôte accueillant, disponible Excellent séjour
A good location and a good value to visit the lovely districts of Graca and Alfama.

He is so kind and easy to contact.
The house is clean and well located in old town.
One famous view point is near the house, around 3mins to walk.
You can take a Tram, which is what you have to do in Lisbon, in front of home.
Every things you need is equipped in home.
Thank you to host us, Gorge

Jorge is a pro, answers quickly, suggest good local places, called us a cab and is overall easy going. The house is clean and location is perfect however this is not someone's home but more like a rental. That said it is still pretty nicely furnished and there is a vinyl player in the livingroom/second bedroom:) Wifi works and so does the hot water, its quiet at night and the view is beautiful.

Séjour merveilleux dans un bel appartement très agréable, au calme bien que situé en plein centre de Lisbonne (nous avons super bien dormi!!). Jorge est vraiment super sympa, plein de bons conseils et c'est le meilleur ambassadeur qui soit pour cette ville pleine de poésie et de lumière. Nous avons aussi adoré sa musique, elle a donné une saveur particulière à notre séjour.

Me and my brother stayed 6 nights at Jorges Place and everything was just great. The neighborhood is super lovely, beautiful and peaceful and energetic at the Same Time!
Tram, Bus, Taxi, Tuk Tuk or just walking up and down the beautiful streets while enjoying the stunning views - anything is possible.
Jorge was a great host, very helpful and made it possible to stay one more night when out flight got cancelt...thanks again!!
Very reomnendable appartement clean comfortabe in a populair Area of Lisboa. You should not miss this one when travelling to Lisboa!

We highly recommend Casa Menino Deus apartment with its charming host Jorge; from the first meeting and the first words of greeting you want to stay there as long as possible; you feel that Jorge loves his apartment and his Alfama and wants you to love them too.
The car is there completely unnecessary. Anywhere close, really close to the famous tram No. 12 and No. 28, metro, various buses, cafes, restaurants, boats, ferries and museums, churches, souvenir shops, flea market, viewpoints, great bakeries and places where you can buy and eat delicious pastel de nata.
After a long day in Lisbon we came back with joy to Casa Menino Deus; and we think to come here once again
Très bien placé pour la découverte de la ville. L'appartement est fonctionnel, tout est conforme aux photos et description. Jorge a été très soucieux de notre confort.
Eine kleine schmucke Wohnung im Herzen von Alfama. Relativ zentral, und die meisten Sehenswürdigkeiten sind gut zu erreichen.

Come stay at Jorge's place!  It is close to the airport - the taxi ride cost less than 15 Euros. There is no parking for cars, but you won't need one to get around Lisbon from the apartment.  If you end up needing a rental car for a day, it's easy to pick one up back at the airport.  The apartment itself has one bedroom, a full bath, a kitchen, a living room with a futon, and a dining nook off of the living room.  Jorge provides space heaters to use during the winter months as well as the warmest bankets and cushiest pillows ever!  Jorge is an excellent host.  He communicates quickly and clearly, is always nearby to help or answet questions, and makes you feel right at home.  When I arrived, he immediately took me on a tour of the neighborhood and taught me some history of the area.  Jorge shares Lisbon with his guests - friends, food, music, stories.  He will make Lisbon feel like home.
I stayed at Jorge's apartment twice, bookending my trip to Lisbon and Seville.  Full review in next write-up.
Jorge is a lovely host and he cleanes the flat very quickly as we booked the apartment on very short notice

Não conheci anfitrião melhor do que o Jorge. Solícito, atencioso e agradável, esteve à disposição todo o tempo em que permanecemos em seu apartamento. O espaço, amplo, iluminado e muito bem decorado, fica muito bem localizado, a poucos minutos de caminhada dos principais pontos turísticos e de bons restaurantes de Lisboa. Ficar hospedada ali foi, sem dúvida nenhuma, essencial para que minha experiência na cidade tenha sido maravilhosa. Voltaria facilmente. Mais que recomendado.
Very good, thank you.

Die Wohnung war von der Lage und Ausstattung genau wie beschrieben, sehr ruhiges Wohnen und trotzdem mittendrin ! Kleine Geschäfte und Restaurants in der Nachbarschaft. Öffentliche Verkehrsmittel in weniger als 200 m Entfernung.
Jorge war sehr nett, hilfsbereit und jederzeit erreichbar und hatte für alle Fragen eine Antwort und tolle Tip´s.
Die Wohnung ist gut ausgestattet, das Bett sehr bequem. Erholsamer Schlaf, selbst bei offenem Fenster, ist garantiert !
Die Einrichtung ist sehr individuell, unterschiedliche komfortable Sitzgelegenheiten etc.
Ich kann die Wohnung nur empfehlen !!

The Jorge's house in Alfama is very beautiful and comfortable. It's located in a traditional and central place, lively and, at the same time, quiet. Jorge is very nice and kind and he also gave us a lot of useful information about Lisbon.

Jorge was super welcoming and accommodating - I arrived early in the day and I was able to drop my luggage off with no problem. The flat is just as pictured and really lovely. The location is great in a beautiful city! Would definitely recommend!

Jorge est une personne admirable et charmante, un musicien très soucieux du bien-être de ses hôtes, qui a tout fait pour faciliter notre arrivée et notre fabuleux séjour à Lisbonne. Le logement romantique est très bien situé au coeur du quartier historique de l'Alfama, à deux pas du château surplombant la cité. Les fameuses lignes de tramway n° 12 et 28 passent à proximité de l'appartement, mais celui-ci à l'avantage d'être isolé du bruit et des ruelles trop passantes. Pour résumer, cette location est un très bon choix pour garantir un séjour inoubliable à Lisbonne !

Super hôte, super logement, idéalement situé, juste parfait,
Je recommande ce logement

I had a wonderful stay at Jorge's apartment. Jorge is a very nice & welcoming host. The location of his apartment is absolutely brilliant..you have the legendary 28 tram down your door step & Port du Sol 2min walk. Plenty of cafe,restaurants & shops. I recommend Jorge's apartment to anyone who's visiting Lisbon. If i visit Lisbon again I'll definitely stay at Jorge's apartment!
Thank you Jorge

Our stay was excellent– Jorge's apartment is perfectly located, and positioned so that it's easy to get away from the main tourist areas. Jorge was conscientious and helpful throughout, and made us feel very welcome. We really recommend his flat to anyone considering a break in Lisbon.

This apartment is the perfect place to stay in Lisbon. It is in a quiet cul de sac across from a beautiful church and convent just down the hill from the Castle. It is close to the tram and excellent areas for walking and also very close to good places to eat and spectacular views.
The apartment itself is clean and charming and light. Jorge is an excellent host and went out of his way to call a taxi for me when I had to leave very early in the morning. I would highly recommend this apartment.

Jorge is very helpful and interesting host.At the appartment in addition to wonderful views you can also listen to his music! His tips for the stay in Lisbon and trip to the south of Portugal were great.
Location is superb.In the heart of Alfama. Jorge's place is very cosy,everything you need for the stay is available.We can recommend Jorge and his appartment!
Jorge är mycket service inriktad. Han välkomnade oss trots att vi kom sen.

Great location, but slightly disappointed in the quality of the apartment for the price. Jorge was an accommodating and generous host, however, and did his very best to make
us feel welcome

We really liked Jorge's house and had a lovely stay. The house has everything you need. Jorge is very kind and he was ready to help with whatever questions we had. I would recommend the place to my family and friends for sure!

Jorge is just beautiful, he met us at check in - accommodating our early arrival.   Jorge is overall very helpful and accessible throughout your stay.  We really loved his apartment. Like being at home.  Very comfortable and well equipped. The views are amazing  Alfama is wonderful - there is something for everyone even dancing in the square of a night.   It's a perfect experience   We highly recommend Jorge and his beautiful apartment. We are definitely going back.
Everything as advertised. Great location, clean apartment, very friendly and helpful host.

Jorge greeted us earlier than check in time to accommodate us with our luggage. The apartment was beautiful and clean and he showed us where things were. Jorge also let us know he would be around if we had any problems and to contact him.
Cozy appartment, wonderfull view from the bedroom ... the mattress was a bit of a downer for my aching back.

L'appartement de Jorge est situé dans un quartier très pittoresque et typique de la ville, propre et très lumineux.
Toutefois, même si Jorge est un hôte accueillant, quelques conseils de sa part nous auraient été précieux pour mieux démarrer notre visite de la ville.

Jorge est un hôte très disponible et accueillant. Son appartement est idéalement placé pour toute personne aimant le quartier de l'Alfama. Avec ma compagne et nos enfants nous avons pu ainsi en seulement deux jours découvrir les ruelles qui mènent au château à pied et les autres quartiers via le tram 28 qui passe à côté de l'appartement de Jorge.

Passer un séjour à Lisbonne dans ce quartier typique et populaire est une véritable chance. L'appartement de Jorge calme et confortable permet de profiter pleinement de cette situation. Jorge nous a accueillis avec gentillesse. Nous recommandons.
This was our second stay in Jorge's apartment after spending a few days exploring Porto and the north.  It was like returning home, and we didn't want to leave!

Appartement très bien situé dans un quartier idéal pour visiter Lisbonne.et.pourtant très au calme. On peut même arriver à se garer au pied de l'immeuble.
L'appartement est confortable et chaleureux. On se sent vite chez soi.

Jorge is a wonderful host and we had the most fantastic stay in this beautiful apartment.  The location is terrific and the apartment is very thoughtfully decorated and extremely well equipped.  Thank you Jorge!

Logement conforme à la description de l'annonce. Très bien situé et très calme. Idéal pour passer un séjour en couple et/ou en famille. Jorge est très sympathique. Il a su se rendre disponible et arrangeant notamment pour garder nos valises et appeler un taxi. Ce logement est vraiment à recommander.

We could not have asked for a friendlier, more helpful host! Jorge accommodated are arrival and departure times, had lots of helpful suggestions about getting around Lisbon and made us feel genuinely welcome in his beautiful flat. Meeting him and having a couple if friendly chats became part if what made our trip to Lisbon so wonderful. Thanks Jorge!

Me and my husband spent a fantastic honeymoon in Jorge's place. The flat is big, very clean, beautifully decorated (Jorge made part of the furniture himself), and it's never hot in the building, so it's the best deal for spending summer. The location is pretty amazing too: it's close to all the main city spots, including the castle just by the door, but not noisy at all, full of good cafes and shops and completely safe to walk at night. The square with the church outside is really pretty, and you have a chance to wake up with the church bells every morning. Also, as a hidden bonus: view from the toilet window is the best ever.:)
And Jorge is the exact host you look for: thoughtful, but delicate, really good to talk to and very helpful (first he met us really late at night and in the end walked us straight to the taxi).
It's the cosiest apartment in the most beautiful part of the city, so if we come back soon, there's no doubt about where to stay.
Great apartment in a perfect location in Alfama! Beautiful design and finishes. Jorge was super helpful and made our short stay really enjoyable.

Jorge est une personne attachante prête à tout pour ses hôtes.
Il nous a accueilli avec le sourire malgré notre arrivée plus que tardive. Son appartement est très sympa et surtout... idéalement situé. Merci et à très bientôt
Had a wonderful stay in Lisbon.  Jorge was an absolute gent and very helpful.  Would definitely return.

Charming, cosy apartment in a tranquil and beautiful part of Lisbon. Very clean and close to the main attractions. Jorge was fully  available if we needed him and was v speedy with his responses. A wonderful time in a special apartment. We will return!

We had a wonderful stay at Jorge's apartment. The apartment is in a fantastic area close to many great restaurants and bars, yet located on a quiet street. The apartment its self was clean and bright with everything we needed during our stay. Jorge was an exceptional host; very friendly and knowledgeable about Lisbon and took the time to give us a tour of his favourite spots in Alfama. Highly recommended!

This apartment is super clean and well-located by Alfama. Yet, it is very quiet and peaceful at night.
The legendary tram no 28 is at your service: a nice means of transportation from and to other attractions in the centre of Lisbon.
Jorge is responsive and punctual.

Jorge was an excellent host, he replied to messages really quickly, gave helpful information and took the time to show us around the local area when we arrived. The apartment was lovely and light with cool furnishings. It was a treat to stay there. The location was great - absolutely perfect for exploring the city. It was easy to walk around Alfama, so close to the castle and was well connected for transport for places further afield. We loved our time in Lisbon and thought this was an ideal place to stay!

Nous avons été très bien accueillis par Jorge, très soucieux de nous rendre le séjour agréable. Ce fut le cas car son appartement est très bien situé, très calme, avec du charme. Tout était propre et bien pensé, une déco simple et vintage qui nous a plu.  Jorge est un hôte charmant, attentif et discret, nous le recommandons . Une très bonne adresse.

Jorge was an excellent host. He replied to all our messages immediately, made us feel welcome, and gave us very useful additional information that made our holiday even better. Furthermore, Jorge is a friendly person and a great personality. The apartment had everything the description promised, and its atmosphere was even better in reality. The location was perfect for us. The area calmed down nicely in the evening, and it was a convenient place to start our daily explorations around the city and elsewhere. A warm recommendation!

Eine wundervolle Unterkunft mit einem sehr herzlichen Gastgeber. Jorge hat uns viele Tipps gegeben und hat uns in ein sehr leckeres Restaurant entführt. Die Wohnung war mehr als schön und der Schallplattenspieler hat das Ganz noch perfekt abgerundet. Die Lager der Wohnung ist ideal, wenn man die schönen Gassen der Alfama erkunden möchte. Die Tram28, viele Restaurants und Sehenswürdigkeiten sind direkt vor der Haustür. Aus dem Fenster hat man einen tollen Ausblick und abends ist es absolut ruhig, sodass man schön schlafen kann. DANKE Jorge für den tollen Aufenthalt.<3

Appartement très bien situé. Décoré avec goût. Jorge excellent hôte. Nous a très bien conseillé. Il nous a même accompagné à l'excellent restaurant de son frère. À la même occasion il nous a fait découvrir des "trésors cachés". À découvrir.
Jorge es un anfitrion excepcional y su apartamento un verdadero sueño. Fue una visita hermosa y que recordaremos siempre.

Logement très bien situé et calme, dans un quartier authentique et plein de charme, sur les hauteurs de Lisbonne. Indéniablement notre quartier préféré!
Il est possible de rejoindre très rapidement à pied le centre et la Praça do Comercio grâce aux ascenseurs se trouvant à proximité. Les trams 28 et 12 sont à quelques pas. Beaucoup de petits restos tout près. Très pratique également pour faire ses courses dans le voisinage.
Jorge est un hôte très accueillant, attentif et discret. Il est très réactif en cas de problème.
Nous avons beaucoup apprécié la visite du quartier en sa compagnie le soir de notre arrivée et le repas que nous avons partagé dans le restaurant de son frère. Idéal pour se mettre dans l'ambiance de cette ville généreuse et très attachante!
Pascale et Pascal

Jorge was the most amazing host! The apartment was well stocked with everything we could need and perfectly placed for exploring Alfama, one of the most gorgeous areas of Lisbon. When we arrived we were allowed to drop our bags off early and Jorge gave us a little tour of the area; it helped us settle in, find our feet and realise exactly what was around us. The apartment had all the little things we could need and the chess set was a surprising hit, as well as the record player with a collection of well selected Portuguese records. We couldn't recommend the apartment highly enough - definitely the perfect place to escape to.

I can only recommend this AirBnB. We stayed there for 3 nights and had a fantastic time. The flat was as described, very clean with everything you need. The host Jorge was very friendly and accommodating, easy to reach and very helpful. The location is ideal, by the castle and the famous line 28tram only a 10minute walk to the centre. The flat is also very calm, the only sounds were the birds singing and the church bells. On the whole very good and highly recommended.

Jorge war ein sehr freundlicher und zuverlässiger Gastgeber. Die Wohnung ist wirklich ideal gelegen: inmitten eines ursprünglichen (nicht touristisch anmutenden Viertels), von dem man aber alles fußläufig  erreichen kann. Dennoch haben wir geschlafen wie die Bären im Winter, so ruhig ist das Schlafzimmer. Die Wohnung ist urig/gemütlich, es ist alles da, was man braucht, die Sammlung alter Schallplatten mit Fado und Chansons, die man auf dem Plattenspieler hören kann, sind der Hit und tragen zu einem sehr atmosphärischen Aufenthalt bei.
Très bon séjour chez Jorge! L'appartement est idéalement situé et tres agréable!!! Merci encore!
Jorge nous a très bien accueilli. L'appartement est très agréable et parfaitement situé. C'était vraiment bien.

We had a great time in Lisboa. Our host Jorge was really friendly and helpful and showed us the best sights in town. The apartment is in a quiet neighborhood, but still close to the city center. We enjoyed the nice cafes and interesting sites in Alfama. I recommend a visit!

Jorge is very kind and welcoming and the prefect host.  He has made the flat homely and individual. It is in a really nice area - very much enjoyed exploring the city from this party of town as it  has a lot of charm/interesting places on the doorstep with easy access to town by tram or on foot. Thank you -missing it already!

L'appartement est placé dans l'un des quartiers les plus sympas de la ville et l'hôte est vraiment l'incarnation de la gentillesse, ça fait du bien de rencontrer des gens comme ça!
Merci Jorge pour ce super week-end!

Superbe appartement au coeur d'un quartier à la fois calme et vivant vraiment très agréable. Je ne peux que recommander le logement de Jorge pour un séjour à Lisbonne. Jorge est très accueillant, arrangeant et disponible. Le cadre est magnifique à 2 pas de petits restaurants et délicieux et très jolis, de rues pleines de charmes et de monuments magnifiques. Les transports en commun sont également très proches, le métro à 5 min à pied en suivant la ligne 12 du petit tramway jaune, et carrément 1/2 min si l'on prend le tramway. Merci beaucoup à Jorge  pour son accueil !

I would not find any better place for Lisbon. It's in the center of "real" Lisbon. Everthing is in the walking distance. and if you go far, you can get 28 tram which is 2 minutes walk from the house.
Jorge is really the best host. He give us every detail information, and when there is any problem in the house, he fix it immediately.
and please don't miss Jorge's music. He is the real musician, you can find it on wednesday in his brother's restaurant. if course the food is one of the great in Lisbon.
totally, Jorge's house will be the best choice for Lisbon.

Jorge was a wonderful host--he was very available to help us get settled in, offered to take us on a sightseeing tour to Sintra, and helped us to call a cab for our early morning flight. Jorge and his apartment were the perfect welcome to Lisbon, and we loved staying in Alfama. The apartment is quiet, comfortable, well furnished, and ideally located.
Jorge was a great host and his apartment is amazing, beautifully designed and located in the nicest part of Lisbon! Thanks for having us stay at your place!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Jorge's apartment. It was in a lovely part of Lisbon within walking distance of most other districts and very close to the Castle. There are some lovely cafes, bars and restaurants nearby. It was quiet overnight and the bed was extremely comfortable. The apartment was clean, tidy and well equipped. We would highly recommend it to others and we would return if we went back to Lisbon.

I really really recommend this house to everyone. -especially to who want to stay in a real traditional and gorgeous building inside Alfama, the heart of Lisbon.
The interior and decaration of this house is so beautiful and vintage with great touch of sense of the art. It is natural and delicate. I felt happiness to stay in beautiful space.
And it is really well located, so I can reach every good spots by walking.
And Menino Deus, a little beautiful church is in front of the house. So you can see great view in your window everyday
+ This house is nearby my favorite cafe & restaurant, Augusto.
The host Jorge is kind and nice, easy to communicate and touch. He lives near this house, so he can help guests quickly.
Anyway, it was a real great memory to stay Jorge's house.

Quel accueil de Jorge qui a pris le temps de nous faire visiter sa ville ! Son appartement est charmant et très bien placé au pied du château de Lisbonne. Nous ne pouvons que le recommander pour qui souhaite séjourner à Lisbonne !

Me and my husband really enjoyed the stay in this appartment. The description and the photos on the web site gave a true picture of the appartment and its surroundings. It was a light, quiet, spacious and comfortable appartment with a fantastic view of the ancient part of Lisbon.
Jorge was a fantastic host - very helpful and kind! He was always quick to respond and did not complain at all when we were later than agreed.
The taxi driver had some problem to find his way (even with GPS!) and perhaps it would have helped him to tell that it was close to Rua Sao Tomé 39.
We would highly recommend this location to other and would be happy to return in future!

Jorge is very reliable and suggested the best way to get to the apartment. He came to deliver the keys, gave us suggestions and also came to say goodbye and called us a cab when we left. Very responsive and like other people we've met in Portugal, genuinely friendly and helpful. A really lovely host.The apartment is whisper quiet despite right in the centre of everything. It is an older style apartment with a rustic charm.

Jorge hat mich und meine Freundin sehr herzlich begrüßt.
Es war gleich eine sehr schöne Stimmung und er ist sehr charmant und aufmerksam. Hat uns viele gute Tips gegeben und uns z.T. selber begleitet. Wunderbar für uns gesungen und Gitarre gespielt...
Die Wohnung ist sehr ruhig obwohl sie toll in der Altstadt liegt. Für 2 perfekt, für 4 auch ok.
Insgesamt ein wunderbarer Aufenthalt mit einem guten Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis. Jederzeit gerne wieder und auch an anderer weiter zu empfehlen
Tres bonne adresse (un peu difficile a trouver quand on ne connait pas). Jorge est tres serviable, il nous a attendu tres tard pour nous recevoir. Le quartier est rustique et plein de resto pas cher.
A beautiful part of the city, peaceful, friendly and full of charm. Jorge was a wonderful host. Would highly recommend
Nice/ Perfect Place in Lisbon. We enjoyed it!

We arrived, the flat is charming, clean, good location. After showing us the space, my friend asked where a clinic was, having suffering an ear infection. Being the weekend, clinics are closed. Jorge drove us to the hospital and translated the situation to the clerk.
Later that night we had dinner at George's brothers restaurant, one of the best meals I've ever had!

We had a great time in Jorges apartment!  The nicely decorated and well equipped apartment is located in the middle of Alfama near Castelo de São Jorge and a very good starting point to explore Lisbon. Just around the corner are some small restaurants. The first evening we had a wonderful dinner at the restaurant of Jorge's brother with some life music by Jorge. On the way to the restaurant Jorge showed us some lovely spots in the neighborhood. Next time in Lisbon I will try to rent this apartment again.

Jorge's apartment is fantastic! The location is perfect. The apartment is very clean and spacious. I was very happy with the amenities in the apartment, after traveling for 2 weeks before arriving in Lisbon is was great to do a proper load of laundry in the apartment and relax. The wifi is fast and reliable. Jorge is super friendly and made sure we had everything we needed. He was available at any time if it was required.

I can't recommend this place enough. The iconic Portas do Sol lookout point is literally around the corner, and it is only a short walk to downtown. I was traveling with 2 friends, and the 3 of us were very comfortable the whole time. I will definitely be back!!

Jorge is an amazing host, very caring and thoughtful. I absolutely recommend him! The apartment is gorgeous, very unusual and full of character. We enjoyed the spaciousness, the furniture, the vinyl player with great collection of French chanson and some instrumental music. The view from the living room is envy for all my friends now and selection of Santa Luzia for 10am-8pm, Portos da Sol for after 8pm, best gelato in town down hill, unique mercado with best view in town uphill, great lifts to high street, so very hard to leave this place and not thinking of coming back. So, I'll be certainly booking it again next year!

Jorge hat uns einen sehr entspannten Aufenthalt in seiner Wohnung ermöglicht. Jorge ist sehr freundlich, aufmerksam und zuverlässig, seine Wohnung eine kleine Oase und Ruhepunkt im bunten Treiben Lissabons. Die Bilder geben einen guten Eindruck der Räume und ihrer Atmosphäre wieder und die Wohnung und unser Aufenthalt dort haben in allen Punkten unseren Erwartungen entsprochen. Wir freuen uns auf ein weiteres Mal und auf ein Wiedersehen mit Jorge.
Herzlichen Dank! Gabi & Andreas
Merci a Jorge pour son accueil et sa disponibilité. Son appartement est très chaleureux et cosy. Idéal pour découvrir Lisbonne. Il très bien situé au cœur de Lisbonne.
Cute apertment in a beautiful neighborhood. Jorge was really nice and helpful. We would definitely recommend staying there.
Très disponible au téléphone, Jorge à été très accueillant. Je recommande très vivement.

Staying at 'casa menino deus' was so lovely! As a young girl on my own (without knowing Portuguese) I felt so safe in the area and the building. Never did I remotely feel in a position of discomfort or apprehension, despite being there for a few months.
Its the perfect location to enjoy Santo Antonio festivities over the month of June, for the many beautiful views as you walk home, along with vibrant restaurants and cafes. Saying all that though, you still have a quiet place to stay that feels just tucked away. It was superb, and will be missed for sure!

Jorge was the perfect host for a great weekend in Lisbon. Really lovely little flat with everything we needed. Just round the corner from the Castelo S Jorge and the 28 tram. Some great restaurants nearby in Graca and a short walk from Portas do Sol. 5*

Fantastisch gelegen, ruim appartement in een oud, karaktervol appartementengebouw, centraal en toch heerlijk rustig. Jorge ontving ons allerhartelijkst, was heel behulpzaam met het regelen van o.a. vervoer en nam ons de eerste avond mee naar het restaurant van zijn broer (die èrg lekker kookt), waarbij wij deelgenoot werden van zijn passie: muziek! Absolute aanrader voor degenen die dit soort zaken belangrijker vinden dan een luxe omgeving.

Jorge, l'hôte de ce logement, est l'hôte idéal: accueillant, serviable et avenant. Le logement est décrit avec justesse, très grand, bien décoré et en retrait de l'animation et du bruit tout en étant bien situé dans le nord de l'Alfama.
Seul petit bémol: parfois des odeurs d'égout arrivaient des toilettes, mais en aérant quelques minutes elles s'atténuaient.

Jorge hat uns bei unserer Ankunft sehr freundlich empfangen und uns gleich alles gezeigt und erklärt. Neben einer kurzen Einführung in die Wohnung hat er uns hilfreiche Tipps und Einladungen zu Essen und Musik gegeben. Das Appartement ist sehr gemütlich, die Aussicht aus dem Bett zum liegenbleiben (weil so schön ;-)) Wir waren recht viel in der Stadt unterwegs, sodass wir wenig in der Wohnung waren. Sie bietet einen guten Startpunkt um alles zu erkunden was Lissabon zu bieten hat. Mitten im alten Alfama ist man umgeben von tollen Restaurants, bunten Häusern, sonnigen Plätzen und engen Gassen. Wir kommen gerne wieder und freuen uns schon auf unseren nächsten Besuch!

Jorge was very welcoming and helpful, and his apartment flat is both lovely to stay in, in a unique and interesting area.

Old Lisbon apartments like these are designed to lose heat easily since it gets so hot in summer, meaning it is cooler than modern places in winter - naturally the apartment has heaters and plenty of blankets - just don't run a kettle and the two heaters at the same time.

The castle/hilltop this is near to is very worthwhile visiting, so be sure to see it before you leave! Also this area is very hilly. Bring grippy walking shoes instead of leather-sole or high-heels.

Lastly, the area is tourism-focused and there are "tourist trap" restaurants in the area - be sure to check reviews before eating (for example, "Frei Papinhas", which is close by, must be avoided!) - if you walk a little further you will find better places to eat.

Wir waren 10 Tage in Casa Menino Deus und haben jeden Tag dort genossen. Die Wohnung liegt sehr zentral zwischen Alfama und Graca und ist ein idealer Ausgangspunkt, um die Stadt zu erkunden. Genauso wie die Beschreibung es versprach, haben wir die Ruhe dort sehr geschätzt. Im Übrigen gaben die Fotos und die Beschreibungen ein zutreffendes Bild von Wohnung und Umgebung. Neben der Ruhe  haben wir von dem authentischen Charme sehr angetan. Jorge war ein überaus freundlicher und hilfsbereiter Gastgeber. Wir haben seine Unterstützung wirklich gut brauchen können und seine Tipps waren ausgezeichnet. Im Restaurant seines Bruders haben wir das beste Essen in Lisboa bekommen. Außerdem sind wir Fans von Jorges Musik geworden, die uns weiter begleiten wird.

We had a great time in Lisbon, the apartment was really nice.
Amazing location, clean, beautiful view on the church!
Thanks Jorge!

Jorge was a fantastic host!, the apartment was a unique experience in Lisbon, honestly!, the views from lisbon hill from
One side, and from a very old church in the other side (just 6 meters away) makes of this a
Winner place.
Thanks Jorge!!!!
And to whom will stay there: is a gift, enjoy!

Jorge is a very friendly host. He makes sure you have everything you need and can answer every question about lisbon you can imagine. He is also very helpfull and gives tou tips for places to be in lisbon. The house is beautyfully situated in the oldest neighbourhood in lisbon and was better than expected. Clean, warm and welcoming. Lisbon is a must-see romantic city, visit it and stay at jorge!

This is a review of Jorge's lovely home and his wonderful hospitality. This place is not a luxurious five-star hotel, so if that's what you are after this accommodation is not for you. However if you want to experience what if feels like to live in Lisbon like the locals do, then you will absolutely love this typical apartment in the heart of Alfama.
This home is quite spacious and is tastefully furnished, using second-hand objects that Jorge himself (our host) transformed in creative ways.
The apartment is very airy and light, and when it's sunny outside the sun reaches every room (except for the bathroom). It is really nice to have a cup of coffee sitting in the living room and looking out of the window. Like in most Portuguese homes there is no central heating in this apartment, so it may be a little humid inside. However, two electric radiators are provided to keep the rooms warm. In the kitchen you will find all the basic equipment you might need.
I think that the most valuable resource of this accommodation is the host, Jorge. He was very nice, hospitable and friendly and he even offered to take us to Sintra for a day trip. Unfortunately we had no time to go. By chance we found out that Jorge is a musician and a singer-songwriter so we asked him if it was possible to listen to his music somewhere. He suggested we might go to his brother's restaurant where he could sing something especially for us. Well, we went to this small but cosy restaurant "Notas de degustação", where we met Jorge's brother Arnaldo and had a delicious dinner, it was excellent. After dinner Jorge started playing his guitar, it was a "private concert" just for us and, in the end, the two brothers sang together traditional Portuguese songs. It was amazing!
I think that when you are choosing a place to spend a few days in a city you've never visited before it is important to consider many factors, not just the accommodation itself. For this reason I highly recommend Jorge's place. My wife and I will never forget our short stay in Lisbon and Jorge's heart. We are really grateful for having met Casa Menino Deus and its wonderful host.
It was great to be with Jorge. We had a nice time in Lisbon and experienced the extraordinary beauty of the sea.

Nous avons passé quelques jours pendant la semaine du jour de l'an sous le ciel lumineux de Lisbonne. Nous avons été très bien accueillis par Jorge qui, après nous avoir installés dans l'appartement, nous a accompagnés pour une ballade découverte d'une partie du quartier Alfama. L'appartement est agréable, bien équipé, et le chauffage  y est prévu, ce qui est indispensable à cette période de l'année et , bien que l'appartement  reste un peu frais malgré tout, c'est tout à fait tout à fait supportable et Jorge fait tout pour que l'appartement soit confortable. Il est très bien situé dans ce quartier où nous avons eu un grand plaisir à nous perdre pour nous émerveiller à chaque coin de rue, d'escalier, de ruelle, ...  Jorge est est un hôte disponible, attentif et prêt à partager ses connaissances de la ville et sa passion de la musique. Merci Jorge !

Jorge is a wonderful host. He took us on foot around the area of Alfama, brought us to his brother's restaurant to enjoy lovely Portugese food and his music. His responses are always prompt. The surroundings of his apartment is full of history. Its location is very convenient. And his been a memorable experience.

Unseren Gastgeber Jorge war sehr nett. Seit wir eine gemütliche Wohnung für drei bei Airbnb gesucht haben er war bereit alles schnell zu beantworten und erklären. Da eine von uns drei früher angekommen war, war Jorge sehr flexibel mit dem Übergabe des Schlüssels.
Die Wohnung ist sogar schöner als beschreiben auf der Seite, es ist sehr liebevoll und feine eingerichtet und hat alles was man brauchen könnte.
Jede Morgen wird man durch die Glocken wach und zu einen neuen Tag in die wunderschöne Lissabon begleitet. Die Vorschlage wo in der nahe zu essen von Jorge waren auch sehr gut!
Wir haben unsere Reise sehr genossen und würden auf jeden Fall die Castelo weiter empfehlen. Und noch dazu: Jorge ist Musiker und während unsere Aufenthalt haben wir immer wieder seine CD gehört und nach Hause mitgebracht. Jetzt zurück in die Kälte, ist es toll dank seine schöne Musik wieder in Alfama zu sein... Muito obrigada!!

My dad and I really enjoyed staying at Jorge's appartment. From our arrival until departure it has been a pleasure. Jorge even took us on a roadtrip north of Lisbon, to see Cabo da Roca (the most western point of Europe) and the beautiful Sintra. Communication with Jorge was very fast and worked perfectly. The appartment is just the way it looks on the pictures and Jorge will make sure to fulfill all your needs.
Jorge was at the apartment to greet and welcome us into the apartment.

Bonjour!Le logement ou nous sommes restés une semaine correspond à la description ainsi que le quartier.Ce qui nous a déçu c'est le manque de propreté de l'ensemble:cuisine,salle d'eau,séjour.Des objets d'occupants précédents trainaient encore dans l'appartement ,cheveux en salle d'eau,bouteilles vides dans les placards,bougie consumée,vielles savonnettes et éponges etc...La première question de Jorge a été de nous demander à quelle heure nous allions partir car il fallait faire le ménage pour les suivants!Pendant une semaine d'automne nos serviettes sont restées humides car la salle d'eau n'est pas chauffée et elles n'ont jamais été changées.Il y a 2 radiateurs roulants mais mis en marche en meme temps ils font sauter les plombs.La lumière de l'entrée de l'immeuble n'est toujours pas réparée ainsi que le plafonnier de la salle d'eau.D'autre part la serrure de la porte d'entrée de l'appart ne fonctionne pas  bien d'où une sécurité très limite.Enfin suite à ces remarques faites de vive voix à Jorge au moment du départ,dans son intérêt et celui des suivants,cela  nous a valu de nous faire insulter et d'être mis à la porte brusquement!Réalisant sans doute les conséquences de son attitude celui-ci nous a fait des excuses par sms 2h plus tard.Il peut retirer de son site les cadeaux de bienvenue,nous n'en avons pas vu la couleur!Le seul effort fait par Jorge a été de nous restituer les 25euro de frais de ménage.Cela n'atténuera pas notre déception.

Jorge was a very nice host and I only have good things to say about how he received us and the apartment tour he gave us. The apartment is centrally located, easily accessible, well-stocked and very spacious. However, there are small annoyances future guests need to be aware of.

Things that the host cannot control -

1. It is very easy to hear noises from other levels and of people walking up and down the stairs.
2. It is also a bit noisy through the night (presumably of city cleaning staff on the streets)

Things that the host could control -

3. The shower was very awkward. The stall is too small and water is either too hot or too cold (I was not able to get comfortable temperature as long as I was there)
4. The apartment could be cleaned better and could actually be furnished less (walls and floors look too busy)

On the day of check-out, I called him at 8am (it was a Sunday) - he seemed to be annoyed by that. I was a bit confused - since he knew prior that I was going to checkout in another hour and as such, I was not made aware of his silent hours.
FORMIDABLE ! Appartement très agréable et un hôte absolument charmant et disponible. Un grand merci à Jorge !

The apartment is in old town just a 5 min walk from the castle of S. Jorge. It's 5-7mins by cab from St Apolonia stn which is pretty well connected to other parts of the city.

Jorge was a fantastic host..he gave us some very useful tips on how to explore the city. He offered to show us around Sintra and also arranged for a cab to drop us to the station on the day of check-out. The apatment is simple and sweet and has a Portuguese style to it..which is just lovely. The kitchen is well stocked with everything you need. The area around the house gets pretty quiet and deserted at night..so its best to stay indoors after 10 pm (or else you might lose your way navigating through the narrow and steep streets).

We loved the apartment and would like to thank Jorge once again for being so hospitable.

We had a wonderful time at this beautiful old apartment which has the most helpful and understanding host. Visiting as a couple we confirm that the property is clean and well furnished, spacious for a 1 bed and would readily accommodate more as advertised. This location offers the most charming & genuine Lisboa experience,. Locally & throughout, the people of this city could not be more welcoming. Some of the best views are just moments from your doorstep, an excellent range of cafe bars & restaurants too. The regular & easy bus or authentic vintage tram ride will put you in the city centre within minutes, or enjoy the 10-15 minute steep stroll down, taking in the local antiques & craft shops, then let these tackle the climb back up after your outing!
If you like old properties with some well preserved original features this will please you. Highly recommended, excellent value for money. Wifi connection quick & easy, good ventilation, no TV - ideal! Thanks Jorge for a perfect city break.

Jorge is a perfect host, incredible sympathetic - and a wonderful musician too. The appartment is just as described, equiped with everything you need, clean and cosy. The appartment is located in the terrific Barrio Alfama, with lots of bars & good restaurants just around the corner. And it's just a few minutes walk to the Castelo de Sao Jorge, Miradouro Portas do Sol or the Sé cathedral. And even Lisbons living room Rossio, Praco do Comercio or Bairro Alto are in walking distance - or take the famous Tram 28, which passes by some 50 meters away from the doorstep. I can highly recommed this appartment whether you're a single or a couple.

We enjoyed our flat, had enought space for three persons to relax on those five days we stayed at Jorges place.
It is a quiet flat in the centre of the Alfama, quiet the nicest part of Lisboa.
Jorge is a good host, we communicated for everything we needed in time.
Thank you!
Jorge ist ein netter Gastgeber, der seine Gäste gerne in die Lissaboner Kultur einführt. Die Wohnung ist gut gelegen und bietet für 2 Personen gut Platz. Ein guter Ausgangsort um Lissabon zu erleben.

Wir hatten schöne Tage in Lissabon und in der Wohnung von Jorge. Die Lage war für uns perfekt, zentral und dennoch ruhig. In Sachen Ausstattung bietet die Wohnung auch alles was benötigt wird und Jorge ist ein sehr netter Gastgeber der uns mit guten Tipps die Zeit verschönert hat.

The place is quite nice and is near all the tourism spot in Lisbone. It's a pity that we didn't have a lot of time to talk with Jorge this time, but his friend Rita was kind to show us around. It's a good place to stay at Lisbone!

primera vez en airbnb, mucha expectativa por lisboa y el departamento y todas ampliamente cumplidas. Departamento impecable, muy acogedor y gracias Jorge por la predisposición a recomendar sitios en Lisboa.

wir danken Jorge ganz herzlich für die Gastfreundschaft er hat viel beigetragen, dass wir die Menschen, das Essen, die Musik und Lisboa im allgemeinen, lieben gelernt haben. Das Quartier ist super, es ist lebendig, unvergesslich man muss es erlebt und gefühlt haben um zu verstehen was ich meine.
Die Wohnung ist eine Oase, ruhig, sauber man fühlt sich wohl.
Kurz Lisboa ist ein Gedicht wir haben es in unser Herz eingeschlossen.
Herzlichen Dank und liebe Grüsse aus Bern Lisa und Heinz

Joli appartement bien situé mais difficile d'accès en voiture.
Quatre commentaires:
1- la lumière dans l'entrée en bas ne fonctionnait pas !
le téléphone dans l'appartement pour ouvrir la porte en bas était brisé !
2- la fenêtre de la toilette sur l'extérieur donnait sur une cour intérieure où un amoncellement de rebuts et de CHATS (7) dégageait l'odeur fétide des excréments des chats.
3- les 7 chats répertoriés miaulaient sans cesse tous les matins nous obligeant à fermer les fenêtres de la chambre et de la toilette.
4- Une odeur d'humidité en entrant dans l'appartement n'était pas des plus agréables.

L'accueil de Jorge a été apprécié.

The appartement is situated at a great location in the heart of alfamalma close to the castel. It's pretty quiet, however when it rains there is a loud noise coming from the lead cover of the window. There is a music installation with (including a CD of Jorge's fado music) and a decent size living room. The bed is smaller than you would expect from the photos.

Jorge a été très accueillant et nous a donné de bons conseils pour visiter la ville.

L'appartement était très propre et ressemblait tout à fait aux photos !

Nous vous recommandons vivement cette adresse en plein cœur de l'Alfama !

Jorge's apartment is in a very special location in Lisbon. We enjoyed our stay there. What a fantastic way to start the day, looking out the windows at the beautiful neighborhood scenery, and hearing parrots in the trees. The apartment is very clean, comfortable, and equipped with everything you need. I was sad leaving but we hope to return soon.
Jorge is a very kind local who will make you feel welcomed to Lisbon. If you get the chance, go enjoy a delicious meal and hear him play guitar at a restaurant close by.

Jorge was a very pleasant host. He waited for us late into the evening when we arrived, and joined us for a late night snack and some wine/beer in the neighborhood. We enjoyed listening to his recommendations, and only wish we had seen him play guitar while we were there!

The apartment is in a great location. We walked almost everywhere we wanted to see, and easily found Trams/Busses/Taxis in the area the few times we needed them. The Alfama neighborhood is just so charming, we didn't want to leave.

Inside the apartment is simple - tastefully decorated with all the little amenities (pots/pans, maps, beddings, etc.) provided. There was a little noise from construction in the area but it was manageable (and we're light sleepers). I highly recommend a stay, you'll enjoy it!

Nice flat, looks exactly like on the picture. Jorge was very welcoming even though we arrived late on the first day. The flat is very well situated, in the old city of Lisbon, close to nice café, restaurants and viewpoints.

Jorge is a great host and his lovely appartment was just what we could wish for. We stayed at Casa Menino Deus with our toddler son and Jorge won his (and our) heart(s) immediately by presenting him with a box of duplo at our midnight arrival. Jorge provided even a toddler bed for us, which was very convenient. The house has an authentic charm and is centraly situated in the lovely Alfama. We will certainly come back when ever we have a chance and recomend this place to our friends.

Nous avons bien aimé notre séjour dans l'appartement de Jorge. Il fut un hôte attentif et prévenant. Nos fils de souviendront longtemps de la soirée au restaurant en sa compagnie et de sa musique. Merci!

Logement très agréable, avec un ameublement 'chiné dans les brocantes' qui nous a beaucoup plus. Emplacement idéal dans l'Alfama, beaucoup de restaurants et sites à visiter à proximité immédiate. Accueil et suivi attentionné de la part de Jorge, on a l'impression de se rendre chez un ami. Très bon rapport qualité-prix.

A great apartment situated in a nice and quiet neighbourhood. Short distance to graca, the fleamarket and the castelo. Jorge was a wonderful and welcoming host who took us to his brother's restaurant, where he played guitar. Thank you so much for our stay in Lisbon!

My mom and me enjoyed a lot our stay at Jorge's apartment. Is very well located, close to everything you need and very calm. The apartment is clean and comfortable. Jorge it's at your disposal if you need something! I really recommend it! Thanks Jorge!

We had such a lovely stay at Jorges apartment.
Perfectly located with a beautiful view and charming restaurants and cafes close by.
Jorge was very easy to get in touch with and was over all a warm and welcoming host.
Hope to stay at 'Casa Menino Deus' some other time.

Jorge nous as très bien reçu et accueilli, le logement était très propre et confortable. Il est également très bien situé et au calme.
Jorge nous as aussi donné de très bons conseils de ballade.
Nous avons été très satisfait de notre séjour.
Jorge was a great host. The apartment is lovely and in a fantastic location. Highly recommended!

We were running late for our meet up with Jorge as we got off at the wrong station and the taxi driver didn't know Largo Menino Deus - but we got there and Jorge was wonderfully welcoming. He gave us a tutorial on the apartment. He had planned to do a walk around the neighbourhood with us but time was against us.
The apartment was bright, neat, quiet, spacious and quite central with everything we needed for a wonderful stay.
Alfama is part of the old town and is charming and interesting with narrow winding streets and wonderful views. The number 15 and 28 trams which go to the city centre run by the street at the end of the lane with high frequency.
If you get an invite to watch Jorge play at a local restaurant don't miss it and look out for Bistro & Brecho Gato pardo on Rua de Sao Vicente nearby.

Jorge est un hôte très disponible. Son appartement est extrêmement  bien situé dans le quartier d'Alfama  à deux pas des trams 12 et 28 et de petits (Cerca Moura, O Carvoeiro) et grand( (Via Graça) restaurants.  C'est un endroit lumineux, très calme car il y a un accès très restreint pour les voitures, avec un charme tout particulier.

Jorge was a fantastic host! He gave us a walking tour of the area upon our arrival which helped to orient us, and also invited us out to dinner one night to hear him play his wonderful guitar music. We enjoyed our time with him thoroughly. As for the apartment, it is perfectly located in a beautiful, yet central area. Lots of hills, but that's part of the fun! We would stay at Jorge's again in a heartbeat!

Jorge was very welcoming and met us at the agreed-upon time. The apartment is just as pictured with beautiful views out of all the windows. Very convenient area close to the metro (though up a big hill), the 28 tram, and a beautiful overlook. It was fun to watch all the camera-toting tourists walking by the apartment from our window. I imagine they were looking up with jealousy :)
Jorges flat is a great place to stay in Lisbon! Beautiful location, beautiful and spacious place, we were very happy to stay there and would always come back.

Jorge as a host and his apartment were exactly what we needed for an amazing stay in Lisbon. The evening we arrived, Jorge was there to welcome us. After he helped us get settled in the apartment, he gave us a short tour of his city with a wonderful recommendation of where to eat. On our last evening in Lisbon, we had the pleasure to see and hear Jorge play his guitar in a delightful restaurant. The food was exceptional and the music was magic. The next day when we left, Jorge walked us to the metro and made sure we knew what line to take back to the airport. Jorge is a very gracious person and an exceptional host.

The apartment is quite "roomy" with all amenities that are needed. It is located just outside the castle wall and directly across from a cathedral on a very small street. Views out of the window toward Saint Vincent Cathedral are beautiful, especially in the morning. The apartment is close to very good cafes, shopping, the trolley lines, and some of the best views of the city.

Jorge is a great guy and his flat is located in a nice area of Lisbon. Being new to this areas he gave us a mini tour of the sights and local area which gives you a great orientation and makes it easy to get around. All good, thanks Jorge for all your assistance and we wish you well.

We had a great time in Lisbon. The apartment is just like the photos, situated in a little square. We didn't do any cooking, but there are enough pots and pans in the small kitchen to cook your own meals. The double bed has a nice firm mattress and the neighbourhood is quiet at night. There is some renovation work going on in the area. This didn't bother us at all, just a bit of hammering every now and then. (Unlike Dutch builders their Portugese colleagues do not listen to loud music all the time.)
Jorge is a marvellous landlord. He is around whenever you need him and happy to help. Jorge showed us around on our first afternoon, taught us our first words in Portugese, suggested nice things to do and explained how the public transport works. Obrigada Jorge!
We had the privilege to hear Jorge play guitar one evening, it was really special; we had a great night.
If you like a really good meal: Notas de degustaçāo, Rua do Regedor 7, is worth a visit. Great cook with a real passion for food. I'd come back to Lisbon just for the "chimney pudding". Although the name is a bit of a mystery, the taste is wonderful.
One bit of advice: when Jorge explains how the lock on the front door works, PAY ATTENTION - unlike we did - otherwise you lock yourselves out. But not to worry, Jorge came to our rescue within minutes and sorted everything out.
We were sorry to leave the Casa Menino Deus and would love to come back one day!

Jorge was a great host and his apartment is in a lovely, perfect area for visiting Lisbon. He was super welcoming and even stayed up late to let us into the apartment when our flight was delayed at we arrived at 1am. He gave us a tour of the area and was generally so kind and helpful. Highly recommend!
I have very much enjoyed my stay at Jorge's appartment: It's a perfect place to get some rest and also explore Lisbon's beautiful centre!!!

Jorge was a great host. Also, we loved the location of his building. He helped us find a nearby parking place for our car, and walked us around the neighborhood. He also led us towards the airport in his car when we were ready to leave on Sunday morning. We hope to stay there again sometime.
Obtigado, Jorge.
Dave and Susanne

Nous avons passé un super séjour à Lisbonne. L’accueil de Jorge est parfait. Cela a été très agréable et utile de faire une visite d'introduction avec lui. Merci Jorge! L'appartement est parfaitement situé pour visiter Lisbonne à pied ou en tram. On reviendra!

Nous avons passé 7 jours dans l'appartement de Jorge, celui ci est idéalement situé au coeur de l'alfama avec 2 très belles vues sur lisbonne à moins de 5 minutes ( idéales pour bien commencer ou finir une journée) et le tram 28 juste à côté. L'accueil de jorge a été parfait, merci pour la visite guidée du quartier à notre arrivée qui nous a permis de bien nous repérer dans ce dédale de petites rues et pour les petites adresses pour boire un café ou manger un morceau bien utiles au cours de notre séjour.
L'appartement est très calme lumineux et bien équipé.
Le grand point positif pour ce séjour aura été la disponibilité et l'accueil de Jorge qui est un hôte très chaleureux.
Nous recommandons donc particulièrement cette adresse

Ok! casa menino de deus is in an excellent neighbourhood where you can feel the local's vibe,you can go evewrywhere on foot.The flat is really sweet clean and cosy and jorge the artist was really helpfull and friendly!
