Jorge was a perfect host. The apartment is located in a quiet neighborhood in Alfarma. A lot of room for two persons, and a nice view from the bedroom and living room windows. We had a great time.

Oh, Jorge's appartment is very lovely. Clean, neatly furnished, quiet and with a beautiful view out of every window. Jorge is very welcoming and gentle and would help with anything we needed and had questions about. We also got the chance to see and hear him play the guitar with a very soulful old Fado singer from the neighborhood. A neighborhood that is also very friendly, quiet and charming. We had a good stay overall and would come back anytime. Thank you, Jorge! It was a pleasure to meet you.

Jorge is very welcoming host. He has a beautiful apartment with stylish design and wonderful view from the window. The apartment layout creates a sense of space. The location is very useful: it is the center of Alfama district and close to city center. Especially we liked that there was a turntable with several nice vinyl records.

We spent Christmas at Jorge's casa and it was great. The location is fabulous; it's definitely worth exploring all the little side streets and shifting from one enticing cafe / bar to the next. The flat is as per Jorge's pictures and description and Jorge himself is a congenial host. We'd love to go back to Lisbon, but only if Casa Menino Deus is available!

It's already magical to arrive at Jorge's place by taking the old tram up through the narrow streets. Jorge gave us a very warm welcome and walked with us through beautiful Alfama. He is a very funny, openminded and warm person, even played music for us in a bar of his friends! we really had a great time at his place!! the apartment is beautifully located and very cosy with wooden floor and nice furniture. when you go out of the house you have 200m to the amazing view of santa luzia, the fleemarket feira da ladra is close by  ... it was really perfect to discover lisboa starting from jorges apartment! MUITO OBRIGADA JORGE!!

Jorge is a very nice and caring host. The apartment is locate right by the castello in the heart of alfama in a quiet street with no traffic. It's nicely furnished. We stayed for 6 weeks and had a great time.

We arrived very late, flight delayed, exhausted from the journey. And Jorge was so friendly and gave us a warm welcome, even though it was past midnight.

The apartment was very cozy and it was a nice surprise to find a record-player and records. Especially since we weren't so lucky with the weather. Music, coffee, books, a rocking chair and view to the old church was perfect! When we needed a change of scenes, the little local cafe (I think it was called "Lago") was an amazing spot, to sit on the wooden terrace, looking at the life passing by, drinking coffee, reading and having a chat with Jorge, who also was a regular at the cafe.

If you ever go to Lisboa and want to blend in with the locals instead of doing all the turist tracks, go here! Stay at Jorges place and get that same feeling of belonging, that I carry with me, after a few days in Lisboa!

We've enjoyed our stay in Jorge's apartment a lot. The apartment has a decent size and especially the view from the living room is stunning. It is perfectly located to start exploring the inner city of Lisboa. A absolute tip is the café "Marcelino's" around the corner. A great place to start the day while watching the old trams passing by. It's hard to get a parking lot nearby but Jorge is very helpful there as well.

Thank you, Jorge, for the nice two days in October. We definitely want to come back, some day!

Jorges apartment is great and so is Jorge. He was very helpful and right there when we needed anything. His apartment is in a private street with double-glazed windows in the bedroom which ensured a good nights sleep. It´s close to the center in a nice neighborhood. I would definitely recommend his place!

Jorge has a wonderful apartment situated in the Alfama region of Portugal.  It is away from all the "hustle and bustle" of the city in a quiet area but still within walking distance of all the tourist attractions. It is tastefully decorated and has all the amenities to ensure a pleasurable stay. I would definitely stay here again and would recommend it to anyone thinking of staying in Lisbon.  Jorge is an excellent host and is very amenable.  We are hoping to go back again!

We had an amazing stay in an amazing city and the very good host Jorge. His appartement is located right to the Castelo in historic Lisbon. With the tram or even by foot you reach the very centre within minutes. The flat is nice, clean and has a good size. We even got a bottle of Port Wine :) Internet is delivered if needed (you don't need it because you don't have time since there are so many nice things to see in Lisbon! ;))
Totally recommend this!

The apartment is nice and clean, situated in the historical center in Lisbon, all the conveniences in the proximities.The location is comfortable to move in the other district or by foot or with the metro/bus/tram.
We have made a good stay.
Jorge's apartment was beautiful and centrally located for a great stay in Lisbon.
Jorge is a very helpful host. We enjoyed our stay very much. The apartment is in a perfect location in beatiful Lisbon.

Je recommande vivement l'appartement de Jorge à Lisbonne. Jorge nous y a accueillis très chaleureusement, nous invitant à le solliciter pour toute information complémentaire . Son appartement est très bien équipé et idéalement situé, dans le quartier historique de la ville, en face du Castelo Sao Jorge, à côté du musée d'art décoratif  (tous deux sont à visiter absolument) et d'un point de vue magnifique sur la ville. La configuration de l'appartement était parfaite pour nous 4 (deux adultes, deux enfants).

Abbiamo trascorso in casa di Jorge un weekend indimenticabile , la casa è deliziosa , pulita , luminosa, pratica e accogliente, situata in una delle zone più belle e tranquille di Lisboa .
Jorge è una persona incantevole, gentile , disponibile e accogliente .

This is a lovely apartment, very comfortable, and beautifully decorated. The kitchen is well equiped for those who want to cook some meals, and the toilet is impecable. The apartment is perfectly situated for someone wanting to explore the historical heart of Lisbon, within easy reach of tourist must-sees (e.g. the Castle, Baixa), as well as of the popular quarter of "Graca" where everyday shops (supermarket, bakery, pharmacy) and non-tourist-trap restaurants can be found. Jorge is a very friendly host. In summary: highly recommended!

J'ai loué cet appartement pour mes parents et Jorge fût très prévenant tout le long du processus de location, n'hésitant jamais à répondre à mes questions et à me donner des conseils pour préparer leurs séjour au mieux !

Voici ce qu'en ont pensé mes parents :

"Venir chez Jorge c'est comme être reçu par de la famille. Accueil au top, appart hyper sympa et situation géographique idéale nous ne sommes restés que 3 jours et ce fut bien trop court, Jorge a été un hôte absolument idéal et d'une gentillesse rare !
Ce n'est qu'un "au revoir" car comme toutes les bonnes choses, nous reviendrons avec plaisir !

Pierre et Francine."

Samy.

We loved our stay at Casa Menino Deus! The apartment was very spacious, clean, modern, and bright, with beautiful views of the neighborhood and church. Convenient on the tram, and only about a 10 minute walk downtown to the center. Jorge was very kind and incredibly responsive, always quick to respond to any inquiry. He was also so accommodating, going out of his way to keep (and carry!) our bag for us to accomodate an early flight in, and a late flight out.

Our complaint was that the stay was too short-- wish we could have stayed longer!

Lovely little apartment in the heart of the Alfama, 2 minute walk to #28 Tram stop and the Miradouro de São Vicente. Apartment is one flight up, convenient with luggage; Clean, charming, well-equipped w/kitchen & laundry. Clean modern bathroom w/tiny shower. Comfy firm bed w/gorgeous view up the hill. Renovations are currently underway on property across the courtyard, and workmen switch on the generator at 8am sharp, quit at 5. The bells of the church ring twice every half hour. The neighborhood is much quieter than Baixa or Bairro Alto. Most restaurants and taverns close down by 10 - 11pm. We were lucky to arrive during a festival in the Alfama where, each night, neighborhood associations offered grilled sardines, pork steak sandwiches, and sangria at temporary outdoor bistros. Utterly charming, authentic local feel. Jorge is very pleasant and is a kind, attentive host. We would definitely stay here again.

We had a very pleasant stay in Casa Menino Deus !
Jorge was a great host, he really welcomed us, taking us for a nice tour of Lisbon centre and beautiful places around Lisbon, helping us having a view of the soul of the city and feeling good all our stay long.
The appart is exactly as shown on the pictures, neat, clean and peaceful, we quickly felt almost at home !
The area (Alfama) is just amazing and really authentic, with its great views, little streets, next to the famous 28 tramway and the castle.
No doubt we will stay there again if we go back to Lisbon !
Pleasant and discreet host: available when needed, sharing tips and helping us out with a WiFi emergency.

We really had a nice time at Jorge's place! The area is really authentic! And Jorge gave me a great tour of the neighborhood which was the greatest introduction to Lisbon I could have hoped for. The flat is neat and clean with a lovely view...and the Alfama area really interesting. Thanks for everything!

We had a great stay at Casa Menino Deus. Jorge was an amazing host! Not only did he take us on a tour of the neighbourhood, introducing us to some great cafes and bars, he also gave us a beautiful tour of Lisbon - he really went above and beyond what we could of expected.

In addition, the apartment was lovely. The location is great, right behind the castle (literally) in the beautiful Alfama neighbourhood. Jorge made sure we had everything we needed and was very quick to get back to us when we contacted him.

We'd highly recommend Casa Menino Deus to anyone looking to spend some time in Lisbon.

The apt in a perfect area, right in the middle of the Alfama, on a sweet back street.  There is construction happening now, so check with him if it's still going on.  The only thing that would have improved the apt, and for me it was an important issue, is the fact that there is no internet.  You need to go to a very sweet nearby cafe anytime you want it.  Also, good to check with him about check out time.  His ad originally said, 'flexible', but when we got there he said we needed to be packed by 10 am.  We could leave the bags until noon, but had to be out for him to clean.  It worked for us, but worth checking.  Overall, he was very helpful and the flat is wonderful

We had a great time in Lisbon and staying at Casa Menino Deus. The apartment is in a beautiful setting, opposite a church and right at the foothills of the castle with bar's, cafes and even a supermarket nearby The apartment was clean, comfortable and stylish. There were also great little extras like tea, coffee etc in the Kitchen. On a personal note Jorge was very welcoming and really helpful and we both really enjoyed meeting him. If we come back to Lisbon we would definitely stay here again.

très bel appartement situé en plein coeur de l'Alfama sur une place d'une tranquilité agréable . Que dire de l'accueil de son propriétaire Jorge qui prend le temps de nous faire un nrepérage des lieux , très utile pour se situer dans lisbonne . A conseiller sans modération !!

Went for a long weekend with my wife and had an amazing time.
We were met by Francisco as soon as we arrived and he was super friendly and helpful, making us feel right at home.
The apartment looks exactly like the pictures and is the perfect size for a couple.
The view from the balcony was really beautiful and the bottle of wine given by the hosts was a nice touch.
The location could not be better, as you are in the middle of everything.
Finally, apt is really quiet at night and we got some great rest. Could not ask for a better experience
This place was wonderful: terrific location, good size with high ceilings and lots of light, very clean, friendly team with great communication. I highly recommend this place.
Awesome location - super easy check in and lots of recommendations. Would definitely stay here again!!

Wonderful spacious bnb right in the heart of Chiado. Perfect for exploring the hills of Lisbon. The hosts were great and walked us through everything. The building and design are clean and beautiful . Would highly recommend

Alles tip top, sehr zentral gelegen, schöne Aussicht, alles fusslöäufig zu erreichen, viele Restaurants.
Hilfsbereiter Vermieter, schade, dass es mit dem Taxi nicht geklappt hat, aber dafür kann der Vermieter nichts. Er hat sich sehr bemüht.

Conveniently located & a beautiful view.
I enjoyed staying at this studio! The hosts were communicative through my stay. I was mainly out and about but it was great having a place where I felt safe and secure when I was there.
This place was amazing and we enjoyed our stay here!!

This was the cutest apartment!!   It is located right in the center of everything - we had a blast.   The hosts were amazing, met us when we arrived and showed us around, I would love to come back to this place!

One of the best Airbnb places I’ve ever stayed. There is a balcony surrounding the entire apartment with tables and chairs, so you can sit down and appreciate the lake view from one side and the castle from the other. Everything works perfectly inside, it’s very well equipped with everything we usually need. The location is perfect!! Few steps from Convento do Carmo.  We basically walked everywhere!!! Pedro was an amazing hosting!! Super recommended and we will book it again for sure!!

As I mentioned, location was fantastic, that's what you are paying for. The large widows are beautiful and the view of the Tigris River was very nice. It was an easy walk to a lot of restaurants and sight seeing. Pedro and team were very friendly and helpful. A welcome bottle of wine was a nice touch and appreciated. Although functional, my wife and I felt that the apartment could use some upgrading as the furniture seemed dated and the available space could be
The air conditioning unit took some time to figure out but it worked well once I got the setting correct. All in all, my wife and I enjoyed our stay. Recommended for the location.

Great apartment in a great location. The view was fabulous! Near restaurants, fado, supermarket, etc., and walkable to many sights. We really enjoyed our stay. Francisco was very welcoming, and very responsive. Would definitely stay again!
Lovely place, great welcome. Thank you!

Das Apartment war einfach perfekt für uns! Besonders gut gefallen hat uns der kleine Balkon mit fantastischem Blick! Das Bett war sehr bequem, die Handtücher herrlich weich und groß. Wir wurden sehr freundlich empfangen, konnten bereits früher einchecken. Wir kommen sehr gerne wieder! Danke!
Vom Empfang bis zur Abreise: Alles wunderbar organisiert, super freundlich und ein tolles Apartment mit einer umwerfenden Aussicht! Wir kommen wieder 👍
Was a great location couldn’t have asked for better, very comfortable and as described
Loved the place. I would definitely book again when I travel to Lisbon.

My daughter and I spent 6 nights at Pedro’s studio. We were met by Francisco who provided us with a comprehensive overview of the apartment. Thank you!!
This was a great neighborhood with proximity to everything we needed—supermarket, Rossio, shops, restaurants. The studio was on the “4th” floor of and offered clear views of the Tagus from the balconies. The air conditioning was also a welcome feature after hot days walking up and down hills! Another bonus? An elevator! We did not have to worry about lugging bags up 4 flights of stairs.
WiFi was fast and reliable—this was important since I was working remotely.
Again, I can’t thank Pedro’s team enough for offering such a clean, safe, comfortable space for an unforgettable trip to Lisbon for my daughter and me.
Thank you!

Super cozy and cute studio apartment. The apt and views are stunning. Francisco was very helpful and prompt with checking us in and responding to questions. The location is perfect - near shops but also on a side street and high enough that it is quiet. We slept well on the firm bed. The view to the river from the balcony is so calming - it was great to sit out there and drink a glass of wine. We want to come back here! This made my daughter’s birthday perfect!

What a spectacular place! Pictures don’t do it justice. Great location and wonderful views of the city from the apartment. Very comfortable, felt like a home away from home. Would stay again if in Lisbon!
Amazing! They were so helpful and it’s a beautiful unit with everything you need and incredible views!

Great central location in Lisbon. Close to train stations and all the hot spots. Easy to get to public transit, restaurants, attractions. Very clean unit and the balconies were a nice bonus for enjoying coffee/wine between all our adventures. We would stay here again without a doubt next time we're in Lisbon

We had a wonderful stay at this charming apartment in Chiado! The location is absolutely perfect-right in the heart of Lisbon with easy access to shops, cafes, and public transportation. The apartment itself was clean and had a cozy, authentic feel with lovely views of the sea. The host was responsive and met us upon arrival to walk us through the apartment. He provided an extensive list of recommendations for restaurants, things to do, etc.

This location was idyllic.  Small park with kiosk around the corner, right next to famous church ruin museum.  Everything we wanted within walking distance.  Apartment was quiet, comfortable, well-furnished, with balconies and beautiful views.  Hosts excel in hospitality, responsiveness and graciousness.  Our favorite Airbnb ever.  Thank you Pedro and Antonio!

We stayed at this studio apartment for three nights and absolutely loved it. It had everything we needed including great A/C, a spectacular view and a balcony. The location was very central and yet there was no noise when the windows were closed. Pedro and his team were super quick in coming back on messages and Antonio was so friendly and  helpful when checking us in. The team were also really helpful when I made a mistake and booked three nights instead of four and we were able to stay in one of the other apartments across the hall for our last night which was so much easier than having to find another location. A note for info - it is great to have a lift but it’s quite small and I’m a bit claustrophobic so preferred to walk to the third floor apartment. My husband had no problems so I’m sure most people would be fine with the lift. We will definitely return to the apartment if/when we come back to Lisbon. I’m very still missing the beautiful view of the river!

We had a fantastic time.  The studio was very clean and perfectly equipped with everything we needed during our 3 days in Lisbon.  The air conditioning was great, as it was over 100 degrees all three of our days.  The place is centrally located and easy to walk to any of the numerous sights, shops, bars and restaurants in the area.  Thanks for a great stay!

Highly recommend Pedro’s property!! Central to everything, and walkable to top restaurants and sites.   Pedro and Teams recommendations were incredible from restaurants, markets, and shops.   We really enjoyed our stay path his beautiful flat.
Pedro’s unit was amazing-great place in a great location with great hosts.  Thank you!
Light filled And roomy. Felt very relaxed. Would definitely recommend this for friends.

Absolutely top drawer. First of all, Pedro and staff were incredibly helpful and responsive, welcoming, and clearly wanted us to have a good experience. When one small thing needed attention or we needed instructions on how to use the electrical system, they were there on the phone or in person immediately. It’s a great team they have.
As for the studio apartment, it is better than the pictures. This is a corner - fourth floor apartment with sun coming in from every direction. To the south, there is a clear view of the river and waterfront! There’s even a view of the castle to the east over the rooftops. At night, we would open all the doors and let the cool evening Lisbon air flow through. It’s right in the middle of the historic Chaido district within easy walking distance of all the best historic areas. An inexpensive taxi ride will get you up to the castle or you can take the city trolley.
Great price, great people, great accommodations, great location, great experience.
The views were fantastic. Cool breezes, bright sunshine. Comfortable bed. Fluffy, absorbent towels. Loved the two balconies. Would definitely go there again.

This is a great location with several close by bars and restaurants. Short walk from the metro, although up a fairly steep hill, so be prepared if you have heavy luggage, or take an Uber. Many nice touches like the host meeting you to check in, complementary welcome wine, espresso machine, and oranges with a juicer. Would definitely stay here again.

Pedro is a terrific host. Greeted us and walked us through utilities. Also left a detailed list of restaurants, things to do   Very thoughtful. This small space is very functional, clean and comfortable. Bed and linens are comfy. We would definitely come back!!!

My husband and I had a phenomenal stay in this beautiful, clean apartment with an incredible view in the Chiado neighborhood. The apartment had everything that we needed for our stay and the host was extremely responsive, giving local recommendations and a flavor of Lisbon. The location was perfect for walking to sights and restaurants. We would return - thank you for an incredible weekend getaway!

Thanks Pedro and team for making our stay a wonderful experience, really appreciated your attention to detail and responsiveness to our request for a late checkout! We loved the location, views, apartment and amenities. Would 100% stay again.

We had a very nice stay in Pedros appartment. Central location, but calm. We enjoyed the little balcony for breakfast and would definitely come back another time. Very good and present service and quick answers from Pedro. Easy access from the airport with metro.

Just as described! We loved the location, the height of the ceilings and how much light you get! The view of the ocean was amazing, we know it is in the description but the actual experience was amazing. We got to seat in the balcony every night between our sight seeing and dinner plans!
We will define to stay there again when we go back to Lisbon.
Host team is very attentive and willing to help - thank you Chiado apartment team!!!
Incredibly responsive host !  Amazing location!

Loved our stay in this apartment. The  balcony views are even better in person. It was great waking up to see the ocean and glimpses of both the Arco da Rua Augusta and Castelo de S. Jorge. Location was also perfect, situated right next to a beautiful square with a beer garden that was always enticing. Our host took us through the amenities in detail upon check in and was response all throughout the process. The shared washer was convenient despite the fact that a cycle took 2-3 hours so plan accordingly. Will definitely stay here again!
Wonderful! Book this place you won’t be disappointed.

This was an absolutely incredible stay! From the fresh fruit to use with the juicer, little jars of jam, lots of coffee, to the sweet note with chocolates. There is a grocery store right across the street which is affordable and convenient. Pedro was always responsive to my messages, allowed me to check in early, and had lots of recommendations. Do not hesitate to stay here if you are coming to Lisbon!

My husband and I loved staying at this beautiful apartment in the centric Chiado neighborhood. The view into the ocean from the window is lovely and the management team was super friendly and always responsive. We even got some Portuguese wine and traditional Easter bread as gifts. Definitely recommend it!
Amazing apartment with an even more amazing view!  Everything was clean, the bed is very comfortable, the hosts were as kind as can be.  Great neighborhood!  Would stay here again.
Love Pedro's place! It was a light airy studio with spectacular views! It was perfect and roomy for two with a comfortable bed. No complaints! I didn't want to leave!

Fantastic space! We really enjoyed our stay here. The host was very informative and walked through the unit with us upon check in to show us everything.  The location is great, with a grocery store right across the road and a beautiful square with cafes and patios to enjoy. Very walkable to many attractions. The unit was spacious and had everything we needed. The views from the balcony were gorgeous! Highly recommend!

Wish we could have had a few more days to enjoy this very well designed and beautiful space.  Standing on the balcony and seeing a late night church processional with lanterns was amazing and waking up to the blue sky and water right in front of you will be my fondest memory!

My wife and I stayed for three nights and loved it. The view of the Tagus River from the patio was perfect for enjoying a morning coffee and relaxing.
The location is absolutely fantastic—aside from taking a Bolt to the Jerónimos Monastery, we could easily walk everywhere we wanted to go from the apartment.
It's a very cool spot that I highly recommend!
There’s also a charming two-person elevator—just enough room for one person and some luggage. (Pro tip: don’t send the luggage up alone... lol.)
Communication with the host was excellent throughout our stay.
The bathroom and shower were also great, with strong water pressure and plenty of hot water.
You won’t be disappointed staying here!

As described. Very friendly host and great location.
Great place, nice views. I would stay here again
Fantastic place with beautiful views!

Pedro’s place was so lovely! It had the loveliest view of the sea and was in the best area of town! What really stood out was the little touches like leaving oranges to make fresh orange juice and leaving recommendations for placing to visit in the area! 10/10 recommend and would love to stay again one day!

Stayed for 4 nights and what a great place.  Pictures are exactly as shown except the view from the balcony was even more spectacular.  Terrific location close to everything.  Pedro and his team were very responsive and welcoming.  Highly recommend

A wonderful space for a couple.  Lots of light, space, the views.  Loved the location where we could walk to many places and easy pick up for BOLT.  Enjoyed the espresso machine, frig and utensils for quick meals and breakfast.  Easy communication.  When we come back to Lisbon we will defiantly check out Pedro’s spaces.

Beautiful space in a central bustling area. The view is spectacular and everything you need is within. The bed is comfortable, the kitchen is easy to use, and the living room
makes for relaxation after walking all day. Pedro was very helpful and receptive to our questions, and was focused on making our stay comfortable. Highly recommend.
Just a perfect space in the heart of Lisbon! I would definitely stay here again!
很好

Had a nice 5 night stay in Lisbon - what a great city!  The location was absolutely perfect. The apartment was cozy, comfortable, clean and well stocked. The balcony and view were great! Fantastic, friendly, great location. Would book again! 10/10 would recommend.

This apartment is a must stay! The view is beautiful and the location is perfect for exploring Lisbon. It’s on a quiet street in Chiado but walkable to all the must-sees in Lisbon and close to the trams. The apartment was clean and had all the amenities, and the hosts were very responsive and helpful with recommendations!
My 8th time staying at Pedro’s apartments, always reliably great stay.
C’est la quatrième au cinquième fois que je suis hébergé par Pedro dans cet appartement, très charmant, bien meublé, bien placé avec une vue magnifique. J’adore.

We had an amazing stay! The space is absolutely gorgeous. We felt right at home returning to the apartment after exploring Lisboa. Perfect location. The hosts were extremely welcoming and communicative. We’d definitely return!

Incredible location, incredible hosts.
They provided special treats for the new year and we watched the fireworks from our balcony.
Walkable to restaurants and attractions, shopping, and more.
Highly recommended!

This apartment is perfect for a stay in Lisbon - central location for restaurants, shopping, tourist attractions plus there is a supermarket right across the street. Overall, one of the best airbnbs I have stayed in - would highly recommend!

I had an amazing stay at this Airbnb! The gorgeous view was absolutely breathtaking, and the place was spotlessly clean and well-maintained. The host was incredibly communicative and helpful, making the entire experience seamless. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a scenic and comfortable getaway!
lovely apartment in a great location and a beautiful view. the host was very friendly and helpful. I would book this again for a trip!

Right from the time of booking the communication from pedro was excellent. All my questions were answered straight away.
On the day we arrived the handover was great, lots of useful info about the apartment and the local area.
The apartment itself was very clean, modern, very well equipped and comfortable.
The view was perfect, straight down to the river.
The location is great, close to everything. Right next door to the Carmen convent. Supermarket just across the road. Nice little bar on the square in the evenings
There really is nothing negative i could say about the customer service or the apartment.

We will be back to lisbon and to this apartment
Fantastic studio apartment in a great location. This is our second visit to one of Pedro’s apartments and it didn’t disappoint, it was very stylish and comfortable. Loved it.
这是一间令人身心愉悦的公寓，位置优越，去哪里游览都很方便，环境也很优美，阳台视野很好，特茹河宛在眼前；房间内装饰古典大气，设备齐全，提供了居住期间生活保障，居住舒适；楼下有超市，可随时满足生活需求；Predo团队热情友好，有求必应，有问必答，服务周到。感谢为我们准备的大量美味的脐橙。有机会再来里斯本还会选择住在这里。

Wonderful location right in the heart of Chiado.  Joao could not have been more helpful and was very responsive and friendly right from the start.  He greeted me upon arrival, and he went out of his way to explain everything including where to go around Lisbon and what restaurants to visit.  The apartment was great, and I would highly recommend this place to everyone.

Third  time the charm… I love this apartment, the view is incredible, on the river and on the castle. The location is very central, allows you to walk around everywhere. If you need light , a beautiful view of the river and Lisbon, and a very nice apartment this place is for you, I’ll be back in January!
This was the perfect location for exploring Lisbon and the surrounding area. The apartment was clean and suited our needs perfectly.

Could not have asked for a more ideal location. Plus the space was light, spacious, clean and comfortable.  The communication with the host was exceptional and they were as flexible and accommodating as we could have asked for.

Astounding service and very comfortable flat. Any questions were answered with 15 mins and everyone we dealt with were super kind and friendly. The area is lovely, full of cafes, restaurants and interesting buildings, sites and shops. We really felt that nothing could have been done better. Thank you so much Pedro and to your exceptional team.
We cant say enough great things about this place! The hosts were very responsive and helpful, and the location was great with unbeatable views.

Wonderful and stylish studio in the heart of Lisbon. The place was spotless and comfortable, and check in was easy. Lots of helpful information in the apartment and we were able to walk to everything. The view from the balcony is amazing too!
Pedro’s place was amazing! The apartment is beautiful and well equipped- pictures don’t do it justice. The area is super walkable with tons of cafes right around the corner

We had a wonderful stay at this charming, bright, and convenient apartment. The location is perfect, just steps away from restaurants, shops, and the river. The bed is comfortable and faces a balcony where you can take in the beautiful river views. The shower is powerful.  The host is incredibly kind and offers flexible check-in and check-out times.

Huge Thank you to Pedro and all the team.
Each team member was so welcoming, hospitable snd helpful.
The apartment was sooo lovely, great ambience and interior design..well equipped, enough space for everything , gorgeous views and the little balcony made it feel very special.
Bed was super comfortable and the modern bathroom was pristine.
The service from the hosts was outstanding and contributed to a relaxed stress free mini break.
The location within Chiado is so delightful but also convenient to walk everywhere and get the metro and overground trains.
Local supermarket is opposite and a car park for those driving.
Just perfect!
Thank you all.
Highly recommend.

The studio was fabulous, even had wine, fruit and chocolate and checked in on us daily, they took the time to show us how all the appliances worked and all the attractions and restaurants that were a must to visit, A plus.

We had a wonderful stay at Chiado Studo. Perfectly located with great access to all the sights, restaurants, local amenities and facilities and public transport.
There was a perfect little square, Plaza do Carmo located right next to the accommodation which was a lovely place to sit and have a drink and watch the world go by. The Carmo Convent is directly opposite too which was one of the sights we wanted to see.
The apartment itself was spotless and really well presented providing lovely views of Lisbon Castle, especially at night and views of the sea/ river too. A great little balcony to sit out on and enjoy a nice glass of something and although centrally located it was private and quiet and peaceful.
Would definitely recommend for anyone wanting somewhere centrally located to explore the city, we will be returning again.

Francisco was super helpful with arrival and was very communicative. The apartment was cozy and in an ideal location. The lift was also very nice for bags and after walking miles in Lisbon’s hills. Would stay again!
Great apartment in a perfect location! Highly recommend, Hosts were great, we had an introduction when we arrived and then they checked how we were doing mid stay.
Excelente lugar!
Great host! Very responsive. Clear instructions. Wonderful space!  Comfortable bed. Very nice bathroom. Loved the sunny balcony--with a view of the river! Excellent location. Highly recommend!

This place was centrally located in Lisbon, had a grocery store right across the street plus a nice outdoor seating garden. The studio apartment was just enough for our needs for 4 days, they provided coffee, tea and sugar to get us started for the first morning. They had detailed descriptions of places to see and places to eat. The bathroom was very modern and very clean. The whole apartment was clean and quiet.

Pedro’s apartment is wonderful! The location is great - easy to explore Lisbon, good restaurants and attractions nearby. The apartment is very thoughtfully decorated with nice amenities and the team greeted us with some nice, personal notes. The view to the river is spectacular and we loved sitting on the terrace to both start our days and unwind later. The entire team that supports Pedro were helpful, responsive, and kind. Would happily stay here again!
The apartment was nicely furnished, offering water views and located in a fantastic neighborhood. The team was incredibly responsive and helpful throughout our stay.
Great location and views of the water! Cute little balcony to drink coffee in the morning. Very walkable to restaurants, shopping and train station.
Fabulous!
Great place to stay with incredible view. The team was very responsive and helpful.

Pedro’s place was outstanding!!!! Cannot wait to visit again and would recommend his place to anyone!!!!!
Paul
Lovely apartment all around. Great host also.
Very neat and clean, helped us in with our luggage and had the AC running as it was a hot day! Great location with everything you need close by! Great introduction to Lisbon!

Great location. Tight for an extended stay, but workable. Bed was comfortable and the apartment was usually quiet.
Balcony was beautiful but tough with the mosquitos.
Aircon was great, and we appreciated the lift!
Cannot say enough good things about this Airbnb and our hosts. Amazing location, romantic studio with responsive hosts and extras. We will most definitely be back!!!!

Very convenient, located right next to the Carmo Convent, walkable to so many places. Loved waking up to the view of the river everyday. The streets can be heard when you open the window, but once they are shut it is so nice and quiet. We absolutely loved our stay here!!!

Chiado Studios was the perfect place for our first stay in beautiful Lisboa. It was a very walkable and convenient location to so many things. Pedro and his associates were very responsive and friendly. The studio was clean, bedding very comfortable and the balcony was the best for early morning coffee or colorful sunsets or gorgeous moon rising. We would definitely stay here again!

My husband and I loved our stay! The view was spectacular! We loved coming back and enjoying time on the balcony after a long day of exploring.
They supplied coffee and condiments for the kitchen. We were also treated with a bottle of wine and chocolates.
If we needed anything they were very quick to respond.
The space is in a very walkable area close to the boardwalk. There are lots of restaurants and shopping near by.

The apartment was in the perfect location!  We were super close to lots of restaurants and shopping.  The apartment was clean and had everything we needed. Great for the two of us!  Our host was great and answered all the questions we had. I would highly recommend!
Great place for a couple. The location was perfect, clean and a great view.

It was nice to be greeted by one of the hosts, Rui.  He walked us to the room, gave instructions, and answered our questions.  The room was as advertised. It was nice to be on the top floor and have a view of the water.  The apartment felt spacious and had all we needed. The bottom floor where you arrive smelled musty but it’s an old building. Pedro’s apartment was not musty when we were there in June. It was clean and fresh with a nice breeze off the balcony. The subway station was very close.

The apartment was perfect - good size, bright, great views, great location and had all the amenities you could want. Would recommend and would stay again. Host was friendly and gave great recommendations for restaurants and itineraries.
Loved the place! Wonderful hosts, gorgeous flat, great location, great view. Would be happy to live there. 😀😀😀
really nice place ...... superb location...... highly recommend....... all good   👍 😊👍

Segunda vez que estivemos no imóvel  e com certeza sempre será nossa hospedagem em Lisboa.
