The location was a great spot in Lisbon. They provided clear instructions on checking in and I appreciated the earlier check in time. The place was clean and had incredible views of the city. The place offered lots of natural light but it was nice to also close the blinds for evening. It was great to have access to a washer if you are traveling light. The list of recommendations for place to eat was a nice touch and it was lovely to be greeted and given a tour of the unit.

This was an excellent place to stay in Lisbon! The views are fantastic and the balcony is a great place to enjoy a glass of wine. The host was very thoughtful and left us a note with some chocolates, a bottle of Portuguese wine, and some oranges to make fresh juice. There were coffee pods and tea as well.
The location is ideal, close to the metro, lots of restaurants and stores.
I would not hesitate at all to book another stay here on my next visit to Lisbon.

Wunderschöne, moderne und zentral gelegene Wohnung. Die Wphnung überzeugt durch die coole und stilvolle Einrichtung sowie ihre top Ausstattung.
Die unkomplizierten, netten und ausserordentlich hilfsbereiten Gastgeber haben alles dafür gemacht, dass wir uns sofort wohl gefühlt haben.
Diese Wohnung kann nur weiterempfohlen werden.

We really enjoyed our stay in this lovely, bright studio apartment.  The view looking out from the front balcony is so beautiful with the characteristic rooftops and the view to the water beyond.  The apartment is in the heart of the historic Chiado district which is pretty busy with tourists but close to lots of shopping, museums and lovely squares.  The place has high ceilings, comfortable bed and a good bathroom plus a hall closet.  They make the most of the kitchenette cooking facilities with pots, pans, good knives, cutting board, juice squeezer, toaster, espresso machine, kettle and the two burner stove.  Rui, who checked us in, was right there to meet us, explain things to us and available during our stay - he even brought over an extra blanket in the evening of our first night when it was cooler than usual.  Recommended!

Rui handled meeting us and checking us in. He was very responsive when asking him questions and helped with anything we needed. The place was in such a great location and we were able to walk to so many things nearby. The view from the balcony was simply incredible!

The place was in a great location, beautiful view from the balcony, clean and well equipped. Hosts were always quick to reply to any questions we had.
Would highly recommend this apartment for your stay in Lisbon

This place was perfect! Immaculate and super well equipped in an excellent location and with incredible views out to the sea.
We loved making fresh orange juice in the morning with the oranges left by the host and the electric juicer.

Loved this little apartment in Lisbon and wish our itinerary would have allowed for a longer stay. The view is spectacular! The kitchen is decently equipped for making basic meals or washing your travel tumblers which was very helpful. The booklets of recommendations really came in handy and led us to excellent meals. Despite being above fairly busy streets at night, the windows are really well insulated- we didn’t hear a thing when they were shut. Highly recommend!
Incredible, charming, convenient.  Such a friendly and d helpful host and the location absolutely cannot be beaten.  I can’t wait to go back.

The Airbnb is spacious and the appliances are all brand new/high efficiency.
We received great instructions upon arrival and everyone was so friendly throughout the experience!
It was AMAZING.
Very central location and responsive. Check in was easy and were provided with a lot of recommendations. The views from the balcony are beautiful

Perdro's place was terrific.  The view and patio were wonderful and the location couldn't have been better.   Sleeping was perfect for two people how are friends because there is a low wall between the beds for privacy.   Highly recommend this apartment.

This place was excellent for a week in Lisbon.  Perfectly located - walkable to most everything - lots of restaurants nearby but very quiet.  Good shower, comfortable bed, dual aspect windows and responsive host.  Highly recommend.

We stayed 5 days in Lisbon and the apartment was in the middle of everything making it a perfect location for exploring the city. It’s located next to a beautiful square offering shade, live music and atmosphere. The apartment was perfect for two people with all you need and the best view overlooking the city and the waterfront.

The apartment is in a perfect position for exploring Lisbon,everything is within walking distance and the Metro station is close for getting to and from the airport. The apartment was so clean and comfortable we loved having the balcony for morning coffee or a glass of wine in the evening.
Very nice, clean, central location & excellent local & useful information.  Very helpful host.  First class.

We loved our stay in Lisbon for a week at Pedro's place. It is close to everything - easily walkable. The bed was comfy (queen size) and apartment was clean, bright, and enjoyable to hang out (even though we were gone most of the time out having fun). We even had a nice sunny and warm day to enjoy some wine on the balcony, listening to distant music playing off in the courtyard a few blocks away.
One tip - if you use a popular mapping app that starts with a G, it will give an inaccurate location (across the street). Best description of the location is on the Haggen Daaz side of the street, midway on the block, a green door with a 16 on it. We spent a little time being silly trying to find the place on the wrong side of the street. We sent an email to Pedro and he got back to us immediately with instructions.
Also - don't try to be a hero and take the stairs up to the apartment - take the elevator :-)
Beautiful apartment, excellent location. We really enjoyed our stay
Amazing place, location, view and communication - would love to stay there again.

Best check-in I've come across! Rui showed me everything in the apartment. There are documents to help with almost everything. The apartment is warm and well set out and close to lots of things in Lisbon centre, including the train station.
Being in the centre, it's not the quietest place but it's not intrusive. It's lovely to have the balcony doors open when its sunny.
The lift is very small so I climbed the stairs a lot!
The hosts are super-responsive!
There are a couple of things to watch - being an older building, the doors and windows have swelled so need a bit of care. Also there is a small hole in the wooden floorboards, probably where a knot has slipped out. Take off your jewellery away from that area in case you drop something.

We had an excellent stay in Lisbon! The apartment is very conveniently located close to the metro station (5 minute walk) to take you anywhere you need. Plenty of great restaurants and shopping within walking distance too. The view from the balcony of the apartment is beautiful! The apartment was clean and comfortable. Joao was really helpful with recommendations and explaining everything  in the apartment. He accommodated us for an early check-in, which was very convenient and much appreciated after a long flight. We would definitely stay here again!
This place was great, very accessible to the city center. Amazing views from the balcony. Very responsive host. Would definitely stay here again.
Great apt in the centre of everything!

Spectacular view over city and sea  right from the bed. Very good communication: an issue we had was solved super quickly. Nice gesture to have pasteis de nata and oranges. Comfortable and stylish. Would recommend.

We had five wonderful days at Pedro's beautiful apartment!  It was our first trip to Lisbon, and we really appreciated Rui meeting us there to show us around the apartment and answer any questions.   It's in a lovely location and central to everything.  The apartment is very quiet and private and has a wonderful view.  Just a perfect place to stay if you're visiting Lisbon.

Nice spot centrally located to restaurants, shopping, attractions.   Host was very communicative.  Place was clean. This was a great place for our time in Lisbon.  Try the bakery next door.  There is noise below from the city sounds but we closed the doors and slept quite well.
Pedro's apartment was perfect. Exactly as described. Theres a ton of shops and restaurants all walking distance. Wouldn't hesitate to stay here again if visiting Lisbon!
Awesome view of Lisbon from the apartment. The location is perfect! João was so nice and helpful.

Nous avons adoré notre séjour à Lisbonne et nous croyons que c est en partie grâce à la qualité de cet appartement. Il était tout simplement parfait pour nous. Extrêmement bien situé, confortable avec une vue magnifique sur le fleuve! Pedro et son équipe sont exceptionnellement gentils et ultra rapides à répondre aux textos. Ils sont dédiés, avenants, accommodants et professionnels. Nous nous sommes sentis privilégiés d avoir la chance de louer cet apart. À refaire sans faute! Merci infiniment
Fantastic location close to pretty much anywhere we wanted to go.  Excellent!

We absolutely loved our stay in Lisbon. The hosts greeted us at the apartment and were very helpful with showing us around the apartment, which was very comfortable, clean and modern and had a beautiful view from the balcony. The elevator was a huge plus. For New Year’s Eve, we were gifted a traditional cake and champagne with a nice message, which was very kind, and we were able to see fireworks perfectly from the balcony. We would definitely stay again!

El lugar es bien lindo, cómodo, tranquilo.  Hay restaurantes, supermercados, gelaterías bien cerca.  La comunicación con Francisco fue excelente y los detalles fueron una linda sorpresa.  Recomiendo el lugar, no se arrepentirán.  De seguro si regreso a Lisboa, no dudaré en hospedarme nuevamente en este lindo lugar.
Excellent apartment, perfect location and amenities went beyond expectations. Pedro and team were excellent and very responsive. Highly recommend!

Steps outside Carmo square, this place is all about LOCATION! It was an easy walk to amenties, including restaurants, grocery, cappucino and Hagan Daaz:)
The unit was superbly clean with fluffy soft linens on both bed and for bath. The elevator made it a nice trip up to the third floor after tromping the hilly landscape around Lisbon. The views from the balcony were breathtaking.
Hosts were always responsive and easy to communicate with. Look no further for a great location to stay while in Lisbon!

This was the perfect location to stay for our trip to Lisbon. It’s right in the heart of everything with a beautiful view of the river. Pedro and his team were wonderful, helpful and communicative. Would absolutely stay here again!
Amazing air bnb in awesome location. Walked everywhere. Large space. Very clean. Super comfy bed and luxurious. Really nice of Pedro to meet us and help us check in.
We loved our stay! Pedro was an excellent host, and the space is beautiful. The location is great, walkable to Alfama and lots of shopping and restaurants. perfect for a couple!

We very much enjoyed our stay at this wonderful location in Lisbon . The accommodations were clean,  comfortable with a most beautiful view from our balcony . What a treasure it was to wake up to see the sun coming in and be able to enjoy a coffee out on the balcony while looking out to an amazing view of Lisbon and the ocean in the distance. The location was nothing short of extraordinary with easy walking distance to museums, shopping and restaurants. We would definitely stay here again. Alison & Rick
Very responsive, excellent studio, full of light and great views.  in perfect location. A great place to stay in Lisbon
We loved the place! Location was perfect, view was amazing! I can’t recommend enough this place. Everything you need is there, best experience!

We felt right at home in this place. We could hear the music from the Carmo plaza but could easily shut out the noise by closing the windows when we wanted peace. The black out shutters made it easy to sleep in after late nights in the Bairo Alto. To put it simply - it would have been hard to find a more desirable place. The elevator was a bit sketchy but added a bit of charm to the building as well as to our experience.

It was a beautiful studio as described, and the view was amazing. We really liked the convenience of the location with lots of shops and restaurants close by and tourist attractions not too far away. The flexibility with check in and the being able to store our bags until we could collect later was really helpful!

Wonderful place to stay.  Pedro and his team were very responsive and lots of recommendations were provided.  The view was spectacular and the location was perfect for our purposes.  It's a short 5 minute walk to the Metro which is perfect for train station and airport access.  The only caveat is that there is not a lot of space for luggage or storage for clothing.  There is a small closet into which a rollaboard bag can be placed and some clothes can be hung.  If one has more than carry on luggage it may be difficult to store and access it.  It would also be nice to have a shelf in the shower for holding shampoo, etc.  We enjoyed our stay and recommend the place highly for those who travel light.

Perfect apartment for a perfect honeymoon.
Pedro went above and beyond to accommodate our flight and arrival/departure times.
Sparkly clean, super tidy, lush apartment.
Waiting for next years flights to be released do we can return

A beautiful place with an amazing view of the water. The apartment was clean with elegant linens and an adorable kitchen. It is centrally located in a quaint neighborhood. The hosts were super helpful with recommendations and always quick to respond. I highly recommend this lovely place.

We stayed here for 5 nights and really enjoyed our stay. What stands out about this property is the central location right in the heart of a fabuolus neighborhood, in walking distance to everything and right beside a vibrant square and conveniently across the street from a grocery market. We loved sitting on the balcony and taking in the spectacular city and river view. The unit itself is super cozy and well laid out not to mention a very comfy sofa and matress. We would absolutely recommend to others without hesitation.

We loved our stay at Pedro’s place! He was responsive throughout the booking and met us at the Airbnb on the day of check in to provide keys and a tour of the apt. The view from the apt is absolutely beautiful. There’s two balconies and another large window letting in plenty of sunlight throughout the day. Pedro provided a binder in the apt with a list of local things to do and places to visit with instructions on how to get there. Lots of thoughtful touches throughout, including a small bottle of wine chilled in the fridge, chocolates on the nightstand, and fresh oranges to make juice in the morning. The location was also perfect: safe, quiet, and walkable to most places. Would 100% stay here again and would highly, highly recommend!

This place was phenomenal. I can't say enough of location and cleanness. Wished we stayed longer in Lisbon. Definitely will be back here.
Pedro was a great host.

We were greeted by the hosts and shown the place. Very centrally located, close to Metro too. He has tons of recommendations especially on places to eat. We tried 5 or 6 different restaurants recommended and they all were fabulous. Breakfast Lovers restaurant was so good we went 3x, had a different dish each time and they were all fantastic. Less than 10 min walk from apt. Only bad part was the crazy stairs, but that’s Europe, and so minor hardly worth noting. Pedro is extremely responsive to any question you have. Great host.

We had such a wonderful time at this location. It was in a perfect spot right outside of a wonderful little square where we had cocktails each night even when we were tired -it was so fun. The location was great. We walked or took  Ubers everywhere, and it was easy to get to and from the train station. The unit itself was lovely sun filled space ,  quiet even though there were things going on at night. The bed was definitely the most comfortable of all of the places we stayed during our visit to Portugal. Nice washing machine shared by maybe three or four units right outside of our door. Very much appreciated!   The hosts were great and met us and even let us and a bit early which after  after flying overnight was appreciated. . Will definitely come back to the space again

Nicest Airbnb we have ever stayed in! The unit was very easy to find, and communication with the hosts was very clear and helpful. The balcony and view were incredible, and the unit was very clean when we arrived. We were provided with fresh oranges upon arrival which was a nice touch. Highly recommend this spot to anyone wanting to visit Lisbon and be close to everything while also feeling peace and quiet.
absolutely stunning apartment in Chaido. Easily walkable to all Lisbon has to offer. Amazing views.

Right in the middle of the action but literally above it all. Great views from the apartment which was comfortable, clean and complete. We were met by Francisco who walked us through everything. Lots of suggestions on places to eat and go.
There's an elevator, not exactly speedy or high capacity, but perfectly serviceable and kind of fun. A great place for this part of Lisbon- a 5 minute walk, sometimes hilly, to everything!
Awesome location, clean and comfortable. Our hosts provided fruit, wine and chocolate! What a sweet kindness! We loved staying here and recommend it very highly!

Couldn’t have asked for a better place to stay in Lisbon. Great location. Nearby plaza had music restaurants museum. Very lively. Apartment was in a very secure building. Elevator was great.
Pedro provided great instructions re places to go and things to see. Booked reservations for us at a fado dinner show. One of our trip highlights. We hope to return!

Pedro’s place is fantastic. Clean, well located, central, and easy to get around on foot as everything is 10-20 minutes away max. You will need to pay for parking if you have a car but there is an underground parking garage right across the street. Pedro was very responsive and had fantastic recommendations. 5/5 would definitely stay again.
Beautiful apartment in the perfect location. Walking distance to everything you will want to see or need. Pedro was a amazing host and I will be back next summer.

Location Location Location. This top floor flat is ideal and the view is spectacular. You will not be disappointed and it is everything advertised and more.  The elevator is so handy to have and the bed is comfortable. Your apartment feels private and is very compact but has everything you need. There is a washing machine across the hallway that you can access if needed. Perfect place to stay and would definitely recommend!
We had a great stay! Pedro’s unit is clean, comfortable, and in an excellent location. The a/c was a lifesaver during an especially hot week. Thank you for having us.

this was our second stay, and we enjoyed it as much as the first stay.
Great value, based on quality of studio, location and view.
I highly recommend this studio.
Great location, great communication, clean Airbnb with all the essentials. Enjoyed the balcony and views! Would definitely stay again.
Great Studio in a wonderful location

Antonio was a such a great host. I landed in the middle of the night and he still met me at the apartment to show me how everything works! The location is excellent! Right above all the action. If you don't mind falling asleep to some great singers from downstairs, this is great for you. He even checked on how things were going for me the next day and if I needed anything.
The price was a bit high for a solo traveler but if your 2-3 people it's definitely worth it!

My wife and I spent an entire week at Pedro's property.  We found it to be magical.  The views from the two balconies are beautiful.  We loved the cross breeze with the doors open on this corner unit.  If you close the shutters and  curtains it is pitch black and quiet for sleeping.  The air conditioner worked perfectly at night and was quiet.    Best of all was the location.  Chiado is by far the best area in Lisbon.  The property is on Largo do Carmo which was our favorite plaza in the entire city.  The metro and train are both super close.  I could go on and on but there are plenty of other positive reviews.

I thoroughly enjoyed staying here while in Lisbon!  The apartment is exactly as described.  The neighborhood has tons to do, and the view from the balcony is spectacular.  If you aren’t a fan of night life, just bring a pair of earplugs or a white noise machine.  I did, and I slept peacefully.  I highly recommended this spot!

Great central location to a lot of site seeing places a short walk away. Beautiful view and easy to locate. Pedro and Rui were extremely helpful with everything and accommodating if anything was needed. Would love to stay here again.
This apartment was amazing, great location. The restaurants and bars we’re all within walking distance, live music every night.  Cannot recommend this place enough!
The view from the apartment was incredible!
One of the most amazing places we have stayed.   Fabulous apartment with incredible view.

We have stayed in this particular studio several times and just love it. Not only does it have everything you need for a comfortable stay but it has three things that will insure vacation happiness: great location, perfect views and an elevator. Everything we wanted to do was within walking distance including the train station and a ridiculous amount of restaurants. There was not only a handy elevator in the building but I have to include the elevator in the nearby shopping center which is helpful in reaching many of the lower streets in this hilly city. Last but most beautiful is the view from the studio. It is stunning.
The host is very responsive and made sure to let us know about a huge celebration taking place around our dates. We were able to make much better plans and adjust to some places being closed. We will stay here again next time we’re in Lisbon.
It was the perfect location and a beautiful space!
Beautiful apartment in an ideal location. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.

Wow! Amazing, light filled 3Rd floor corner unit. Views from our patio to the water. Great breeze so only ran air conditioning at night. Closing Thick wooden shutters at night made for very peace sleep. Patio dining with local musicians just a few steps away for evening after dinner drinks. Elevator was very helpful for bringing up luggage and skipping stairs after long days exploring Lisbon on foot. Location, location, location.  Wish we had planned for a longer stay as 6 days was not enough.

Pedro’s place was bright and cheery with a killer view of the water from the balcony. The shower was great and everything comfortable…extras like oranges, wine and even a chocolate or two!  Ruis and Antonio were helpful while Pedro was out of the country and left good recommendations for things to do and places to eat. We are staying again for a second time in Lisbon!
Nice clean, updated, well stocked unit in a great part of Lisbon, easy walk to everything. Fabulous views from 2 balconies. Great communication with hosts. Would definitely stay there again.

What a gem of a place to stay...a cozy loft right in Chiado's safe, vibrant neighborhood. In clear, sunny weather (which we were blessed with daily), we had a spectacular view over the rooftops to the water beyond. Antonio met us the day we arrived and gave us the keys as well as helpful tips about the neighborhood and restaurants of interest. We highly recommend this loft and look forward to staying there again.

The stayed in this beautiful and comfortable Lisbon apartment in May 2023. It is ideal for a romantic couple's holiday in this colourful and vibrant city. Located in the Chiada neighbourhood, so many highlights are within walking distance. Do keep in mind though that the local cobblestone streets are steep and narrow, so if you have mobility issues you may need to make a different choice. Also, there are other Air B&B flats there. The apartment itself is accessible via a lift, and has all the amenities you could want, including a cooktop, fridge, air conditioning and access to a washing machine room. The view from the balcony, looking over the rooftops to the River Tagus is superb! The bed and couch are very comfortable and the shower is hot! Our host was very proactive with communication, and check in was a breeze. We were made to feel very welcome, little gifts were provided, and Pedro or his staff checked in with us regularly. We highly recommend this apartment for a visit to Lisbon

Lovely apartment, just off a pretty square. Check in was very thorough, with explanations about everything. Clean & comfy. Walkable to Rossio Station & square, up hill walk to return to apartment very manageable.

This was the perfect stay! Antonio was so helpful in checking us in, providing recommendations for local restaurants and being extremely helpful. The apartment is gorgeous, especially the lovely balcony over looking the water. Everything is super walkable from here but it is still quiet. Would definitely return!
Wonderful place to stay near everything, beautiful view!

Wonderful central location to explore Lisbon! It was always nice to come back to the square below for a drink and head up to the flat to relax on the small balcony overlooking the city and sea after a day walking Lisbon. Wear sensible shoes to walk up, down, and around this amazing city. Thanks for a great stay!

We loved our stay in Pedro’s beautiful apartment. The unit was spacious, well-designed and had beautiful views. The welcome gifts were a nice touch. The location is perfect for walking around Chiado. Lots of shopping, restaurants and cafes in a two-block radius. There’s even a cake shop just downstairs. We will definitely be back and would stay here again.

Can’t fault this place and the hosts. Incredibly responsive and accommodating hosts in a lovely apartment for two people in a great location within Lisbon.
Would definitely recommend!
Amazing location and studio! My second time staying at one of Pedro’s locations.

Pedro’s studio apartment was perfect for our week's stay in Lisbon. The location is perfect, walkable to major sites, transportation, restaurants, bars, and groceries. The studio is clean and comfortable with amazing views of the river and city. Pedro’s team is kind and has excellent, quick communication.  At check-in, we were greeted at the apartment and given a thorough explanation of everything. Our stay was perfect. We couldn’t imagine a better location or hosts.
If you want the best of the city, this place is ideal. Super great location! Beautiful views. Super comfortable. Super recommended

Pedro's place was perfect for our 3 day visit to Lisbon. It is very central and we walked everywhere. It is surrounded by many restaurants and shops. The streets were a little crowded with tourists but it was all worth it. Thanks Pedro and his team!

Mum and I had such a lovely visit to Lisbon. The accommodation suited us perfectly.  Clean, safe, beautiful view from balcony, central to all that Lisbon has to offer. Would definitely look to stay there again on a future trip to Lisbon.

We loved the apartment! The view was incredible, the neighborhood was quiet but central. We loved hanging out at the square at night. Francisco met us at the apartment and reviewed everything with us and answered all our questions. We would definitely stay here again.
Great location and walking distance to everywhere we wanted to explore.  Apartment was stocked and hosts were there on site to welcome us when we arrived.
It is as advertised. Excellent location is the highlight. Responsive host.

One of the best airbnbs we have ever stayed in! The view is even better than the photos and in the best location, and we were accommodated with our very late check in so kindly. Will definitely be back as soon as we can!

What an absolute treasure in the heart of Lisbon, the balcony & view are just the most wonderful addition (even in February!) beautiful apartment and even though it’s a very busy area you are high enough above things for it not to be an issue. Already looking forward to returning!
Great location. Pictures are exactly as advertised. Would stay again.
We absolutely loved our stay at Pedro's. The location was perfect! We'd definitely recommend this Airbnb and we'd love to stay again.

We would definitely stay here again. Pedro & team were quick and thorough communicators and the place was clean and had everything we needed. Not to mention the best location central to many major areas to explore.

O espaço é exatamente como descrito e apresentado nas fotos, super confortável e com o bônus de uma vista muito bonita. Tem os equipamentos de cozinha funcionais que foram mais que suficientes.
Todos os envolvidos nos contatos foram atenciosos e cordiais, sempre com respostas e atendimentos rápidos e gentis.
A localização é incrível, num dos melhores pontos de Lisboa, e apesar de não ser uma cidade para se visitar usando carro, existe um estacionamento exatamente em frente, o que facilita bastante a vida. No nosso caso, chegamos à Lisboa com um carro alugado e o deixamos nesse estacionamento apenas para o tempo de fazer o check-in e descarregar as malas, pois devolvemos o carro no mesmo dia.
Recomendo demais o espaço.

Great place to stay for a few nights in Lisbon -- we stayed here for the last two nights of our trip and it was perfect. 20 minute drive from the airport, and within walking distance of all the best spots in Lisbon. Spacious studio with a distant but lovely view of the water from a small balcony. They even left us some oranges and a juicer so we could make our own fresh OJ in the morning (:
Nice clean spot great location for walking to the main sites
Apartment with a great location.  Quiet and comfortably furnished.  Everything you need is there.  We had a great week.  We can come back here again.

Pedro’s place was the most perfect location to be for our New Year’s holiday in Lisbon, located within walking distance to major siteseeing places!  Lots of walkable restaurants, few mins walk to Roccio train station which we used when we went to our Sintra day trip! Very responsive to all our questions before and during our stay.  Rui was waiting to welcome us to show us the place and had a nice wine and chocolates. They also dropped off champagne and traditional cake on New Year’s eve which was so sweet!  Very clean apartment.  Great sunrise and water view! Enjoyed having wine and tea on the balcony.  Highly recommend!! It has everything you need for your stay in Lisbon! Thank you Pedro and team! We can’t wait to return!

We love this place, the location, the neighborhood, the staffs, the food and everything else are all together.  We walked to some great restaurants, get some healthy snacks from a health store around the corner, joined some walking tours in the area, so much fun!!  We also enjoyed the views of people from the balcony, sunrise and sunset with a cup of coffee in our hands, very relaxing and romantic.  We will be back to this place soon.

Large studio space with beautiful view of the river and city. Host was highly responsive and helpful with lots of local recommendations. I picked this place because of the high number of great reviews and it did not disappoint!

We loved everything about this place! Pedro gave us a warm welcome and provided us with all the info we could need about the place and restaurant recommendations. Location was perfect. View was great. Nice little extras. Clean. Amazing! We’d love to stay here again!

Rui was very helpful telling us about stores , restaurants and places to go. The location was exceptional, close to every thing.  The corner unit with big window and facing East allowed us spectacular Sun rise.

This is one of the best Airbnb apartment we have stayed.   The view was amazing. The location is perfect. We enjoyed the beautiful neighborhood.  The apartment was fully equipped and we really appreciate the chocolates, oranges and wine that was left for us to enjoy.  There is nothing that needed to be improved.   Easy communication.  We missed our connecting flight and did not arrived in Lisbon till almost midnight.  Rui met us at the apartment and showed us how everything works.  Amazing team.
I love how recommendations on food and activities were provided. It allowed us to enjoy ourselves!

This was the second place we stayed in Lisbon (on either end of a trip to Porto). It wasn’t available for our earlier dates sadly, because it was suuuuch a cute place and so perfectly located! The hosts are incredible - getting greeted at the apartment and shown how things worked was actually really lovely. Francisco, who greeted us and showed us around, was super friendly and welcoming. The instructions re how to use the various appliances etc were the clearest I’ve come across at an Airbnb to date. And the recommendations provided were wonderful and I wish we’d had them at the start of our trip! Stay here for sure. Cannot recommend it highly enough.  I will say that while it was private and the shutters kept out most the noise from the street, there is the usual city noise. If you’re unaccustomed to this, take note. We are from SF so it was no probs.  We hope to come back soon! Thanks for hosting!

Pedro's apartment was incredible for the 3 nights that we stayed in Lisbon.  The views are incredible, and we loved sipping wine in the evenings on the balcony with beautiful views of the city.  The apartment was perfectly clean, and the space was perfect for 2 adults.  The location was very central and easy to get everywhere we wanted to go.  The team left a list of recommendations for us, and we went to several of the restaurants on their list - all were perfect!  Pedro and his team were very responsive to all of my messages and check-in was easy and fast.  It's also very quiet in the apartment - the windows are a very high quality and we could not hear any street noise while we were sleeping.  If we are lucky enough to return to Lisbon someday we will absolutely stay in this same apartment again if we can!

Lovely stay in Lisbon, thank you! Super hosts, friendly & very quick communication. Welcomed us at night with a personal check in after our flight. Apartment has lots of nice little touches. Clean and tidy & bigger than the photos. Beautiful view from the balcony. Would recommend.

O apartamento é simplesmente incrível! Bem iluminado, com uma vista maravilhosa,  uma decoração de primeira, bem equipado e com ótimas roupas de banho e cama. A localização  então nem se fala! Num casarão  histórico no centro do Chiado, perto de tudo, e com uma varandinha com vista para o Tejo, nota 10! Por fim, para melhorar ainda o que já está ótimo, a recepção dos anfitriões é excelente! Além do bilhete de boas vindas, ainda deixam alguns mimos para receber o hóspede, e estiveram sempre à disposição  qdo precisamos. Ou seja, o hóspede se sente de fato muito bem vindo. Já recomendamos esse AP a alguns amigos, e sem sombra de dúvidas, será sempre nossa hospedagem qdo voltarmos a Lisboa. Só temos a agradecer.

This was easily the best apartment we've stayed in Europe! The view was phenomenal... we could see the sea, the sunrise and part of the castle from the apartment. The location is amazing, with most attractions and many public transportation options within walking distance. The recommendations on food and attractions provided was really helpful for us too!

Everything is perfect here! The area is lively and full of good restaurants and cafés. You could easily walk to many tourist sites from the apartment!
The view from the window of the apartment is amazing! And the flat is equipped with everything you will need furing the stay! We really enjoy our stay here and will definitely choose this place again if we are in Losbon!

We loved it here! It's probably one of the best airbnbs we've stayed in. The location was perfect, very centrally located with lots of places within walking distance, as well as the train station, metro, & tram stops. One of our favorite things about the apartment was the balcony. It had the most amazing view & some nights we could hear live music playing. Pedro was great as well, he was willing to accommodate our early check-in & even let us drop our bags off while they got the apartment ready. Overall we couldn't have asked for a better base during our time in Lisbon!

This was one of the best AirBnbs I’ve stayed and would definitely stay here again. I stayed here during my solo trip, but this room could easily accommodate 1-3 people comfortably. In addition, the pictures do not do justice and the place looks much cooler and stylish in person. Furthermore, the unit is perfectly situated in a highly desirable neighborhood surrounded by upscale boutiques, restaurants, bars and cafes. Overall, the unit is in a nice centralized location and 12 - 15 minute walk away from many tourist attractions.
Profissionais de alto nível!

This place is amazing! Great central location but still quiet and private. We were met by Rui who showed us around and gave us instructions. They were responsive when we had a bit of trouble finding the apartment. It felt safe, clean, and had all of the amenities we needed, not to mention a great view from the balcony!
Apartamento bem situado em Lisboa, em um casarão tri centenário. o único incômodo foi o barulho da rua, no restante indico a locação.
There is no better place to stay when visiting Lisbon. Our hosts were spectacular and had several recommendations on where to start our Lisbon adventure.

The Lisbon apartment hosted by Pedro and his team is probably our best ever Airbnb experience. Fantastic location in an historic building with amazing views. It was so good that we didn't have to worry about buying detergent, toilet paper and other incidentals.
We were so pleased that a coffee machine was provided and OMG they actually provided coffee pods. The communication with offers of advice and local tips was warm and genuine. We hope to return to Lisbon and would not consider staying anywhere else.
Heather and Phil
Melbourne Australia
Clean, pretty apartment in great location. Beautiful views. Great communication, assistance from hosts. Overall, lovely stay.
alles supi
Allt stóðst sem auglýst var. Besta möguleg staðsetning til að kanna gamla bæjarhlutann. Persónuleg og góð þjónusta. Mælum með þessari íbúð.

Pedro and Antonio were the perfect hosts.  Antonio met us early, gave us great restaurant recommendations and even ordered an early morning cab for us so that we could get to the airport. They thought of everything.  A modern apartment in a beautiful older building with everything you could need.  The apartment has views of the castle and the water and  is around the corner from Carmo.  I did not want to leave.  We will definitely be staying here again.
The location is ideal and the apartment has everything you need. You’re a five minute walk to the Rossin train station for local trips as well as a ten minute walk to the water. I highly recommend!
See previous comments.
Wonderful unit with delightful balconies!
It's the perfect Airbnb.  You can walk to most of Lisbon's attractions. Besides, it has a great view and convenient facilities. If I visit Lisbon again, I will use this Airbnb.  I highly recommend
Beautiful, tasteful, thoughtfully designed apartment. Central yet quiet. Tons of light and so airy. Many nice touches like oranges for juice. Comfortable bed. Had a great stay!
This was a very nice location. We trying to figure out where to stay this location was epic. Also the apartment itself was very clean and nice. Give this place a try!

Highly recommend, the apartment with great location and perfect hosts who will help with your stay. Guys were nice and attentive and meeting whilst check-in left a good impression. Apartment is clean and well equipped
The place was spotlessly clean, comfortable and very well located. Pedro, António and Francisco made sure all my questions were answered. I hope to return.
Great space & great location! We had an issue during our stay but they were there within 5 minutes to help us resolve the issue. Super responsive and lots of recommendations for food & drinks!
Wonderful place in the heart of town with great views.
Most amazing view ever and very friendly check-in process
Great place to stay with a cool view over the nearby buildings. Near plenty of restaurants too.
Great place to stay, great view and really clean and well catered for unit. Hug my recommend.

Francisco was helpful and knowledgeable. We stayed for 2 nights and throughly enjoyed the location and the view. We can’t get over the view! It was a bright, breezy, and gorgeous studio apartment that could easily fit 3 adults. The couch was comfortable to sleep on. Thanks for the stay!

The apartment is perfectly situated, with loads of city life on your doorstep. The room is beautifully decorated and has all the amenities you need. The service and communication from the team is excellent… amazing place!!

Pedro and his team go out of their way to make sure your stay is fantastic! The check in process is awesome as they thoroughly go over what to know about the apartment and provided a great list of things to do which is printed and remains in your suite. Having laundry in the building (on the floor of the units) was so handy as it was near the end of our trip so having to clean some commonly worn items was great. The location was perfect, even one of our Uber drivers said it as they dropped us off! I would go back and stay at Pedro’s (and team) place. We loved it.

This apartment is exactly as it’s described. Its a perfect location in the Chiado, at the Baixa border right at Largo do Carmo. There are a lot of restaurants, bars, shops and major sightseeing places. You can walk everywhere but know that its a very hilly area so get back uphill can be tiring but there are plenty if transportation options.
The apartment is a lovely studio, perfect for a couple. It has fantastic views and has everything you need for your stay. The hosts even leave oranges for fresh orange juice in the morning.
The hosts are fantastic to deal with. From the time we arrived, Francisco was waiting to greet us and let us into the apartment. He proceeded to give an extremely thorough explanation of everything in the apartment and provided many recommendations. After we departed, we were contacted immediately to let us know we forgot clothing in the closet. The hosts were kind enough to go to DHL and the post office to see how to return our stuff either to our next stop or back to our home country. Thank you so much!
This was a perfect stay in Lisbon and we will definitely return.
This is the second time we’ve stayed at Chiado Studios and again the place was great.  Pedro and Antonio were the best. We will certainly recommend this AIRBNB to friends wanting to visit Lisbon.
This was a marvelous stay with 1st class hosts!  We would strongly suggest you book this AirBnB, you won’t be disappointed

Pedro's place was right in the hart of Lisbon, with a beautiful view. Pedro's team was very quick to respond to our requests, they are super hosts.
Thank you!

We had a fabulous holiday in this lovely apartment. It’s was well equipped with all that you needed and the balcony was just great to sit out on to catch the sun and take in the views. The apartment was perfectly located, close to shops, bars and restaurants and the metro which was very handy to get to and from the airport. The building also had a lift which helped. We were met on arrival at the apartment by a very nice gentleman who showed us around the apartment and also how to use certain amenities. There were also some nice touches to welcome us.  We would not hesitate to stay at this apartment again and Lisbon is just so beautiful.

This was a wonderful apartment in the heart of Lisbon. So accessible to the train, waterfront, and best restaurants and bars. The apartment is clean and spacious - very comfortable. All the windows have shutters and curtains that do a great job reducing noise and light. The hosts were excellent with communication!

This is our second stay at this apartment and look forward to staying here again whenever we return to Lisbon. It is not a huge apartment but plenty big enough for two people. The best part is the view. I can’t imagine a better view in all of Lisbon and there is a romantic little balcony to go with it!The apartment is totally modernized and if good air conditioning means something to you then this is the place. We don’t normally cook but everything required seems to be there. The water pressure is strong and we had no trouble with WiFi. The host responded immediately and left plenty of information in the unit. The location is just about perfect for anything you might want to do or any public transportation you might want to access. We wholeheartedly recommend this property!
Pedro was very helpfull and in time to welcome  us.
Great apartment in a fantastic location. Light and airy and everything you need for a weekend visiting Lisbon. Fransisco and the team were incredibly helpful.
Great stay and amazing apartment in the heart of Lisbon
Amazing place and just as expected!  Pedro met us there and was so very gracious.  Location was also very central you can walk to everything!  Loved Lisbon

The best Airbnb we have ever stayed at, the view is amazing. We got a 5 star welcoming and nice touches added to the room. They make you feel very special and welcome. I was so sad we were only able to stay in Lisbon for one night. We will be back here as soon as we have the chance! Lovely powerful shower and it’s obviously very central, especially if you are doing some shopping while there. I could go on all day about how great the hosts and Airbnb are. They accommodated our very early check in, Antonio kudos to you for being such a friendly helpful host, my hero :)
Awesome apartment with an amazing view. Right in the action of town too
Very friendly hosts who personally welcomed us.
Great location near shopping and Rossio train station! Cute restaurants right around the corner and a small grocery store. Everything you need if you ask me!

Apartment was immaculate and the most amazing views! Very comfortable, clean, and spacious. Francisco was there to welcome us and was both patient and pleasant explaining everything in detail to make our stay perfect. Appliances are very modern and the apartment was very central. Will definitely look to stay again on our next trip. Much thanks to the team!

Pedro’s apartment is perfect. We were looked after by Francisco who gave us great tips on where to eat etc. The location is great, the apartment is in a building on a square where there are lots of places to eat and have drinks. It is on the 3rd floor therefore you don’t hear the noise from the street. I would have no hesitation in recommending this apartment to anyone and next time I visit Lisbon this would be my first choice.
Host was very helpful. It was clean and in a very central location. A great place to stay for a shorter Lisbon vacation.
This apartment was great for a holiday in Lisbon. The pictures do not do the balcony justice and the location was SUPERB. Simply cannot beat the location.

This was quite possibly the best Airbnb apartment I've ever stayed in. The location and views are unbeatable. The apartment is stylish with every needed amenity. The hosts were knowledgeable, helpful, prompt, and friendly. The pictures online are great, but they do not do this place justice--we would absolutely book again.
Pedros place is absolutely the best for a stay in Lisbon! Perfect location to see and do everything! Clean and comfortable
Lovely apartment in a great location. High ceilings, lots of light, balconies and some great views. Very happy with our choice.

The apt is light, bright and airy.  the balcony view is great.  It's location is perfectly central Biaxa.  The hosts are friendly, check in was in person and thoroughly reviewed the apt features.  Highly recommend!!

STAY HERE! We have stayed in Airbnbs all over the world and this was one of the best, if not #1. This is exactly what i expect out of an Airbnb, but it was also a great value. The location was right in the heart of a very charming neighborhood but a few minutes walk from the main touristy areas. Lots of delicious food and drink nearby. 10 minute walk to the water. Absolutely loved the area. The host met us and showed us around for check in. The unit itself was exactly as described! Bathroom was clean and nice with lots of hot water!! There is a washer and a kitchenette if you need for longer stays. Elevator helps with bringing luggage to 4th floor. The view of the water is unbeatable. We would 100% stay here again!!!
Hey Pedro/Antonio/Francisco, thank you! We loved the apartment - perfect location and had everything we needed for a great city break in Lisbon
very good
Excellent! We had a wonderful stay. Very good location, nice flat and balcony, and the suggestions from Pedro were very good

Our stay here was nothing short of fantastic! Francisco met us upon arrival and gave us a great overview of the apartment, and there was a small bottle of wine in the fridge and fresh clementines on the table. They have done a great job of assembling a very comprehensive list of restaurants, bars, grocery stores, etc. in the area. Two places he pointed out ended up being our favorites - Boa-Bao for asian food and Park rooftop bar!
The location is PERFECT, as is the view. The place is small, but expertly organized so it doesn't feel that way. So much shopping, restaurants, everything you'd ever want is within walking distance. The train system is so easy to use and we did an overnight trip to Cascais and Sintra - do you not miss either place!
Overall, we've stayed at many, many airbnbs over the years and this one ranks as one of the best!

Un día después seguimos con una gran sonrisa cuando recordamos nuestro paso por Lisboa. Cuatro días se nos han hecho a poco de modo que volveremos pronto. Y tenemos claro que repetiremos el alojamiento. Un trato estupendo, unas indicaciones gastronómicas y algunos consejos han sido muy oportunos y de agradecer. La recepción de 10, los detalles interminables, y no revelo sorpresas del anfitrión. El apartamento está increíblemente bien situado para ir a pie a cualquier lugar. De hecho el coche lo dejamos en el parking durante toda nuestra estancia. Y eso que viajamos con nuestra pequeña de 4 años que se recorrió una media de 9km diarios. Las vistas desde la cama son de ensueño. La estancia muy tranquila a pesar de estar en plena plaza de Carmo. El apartamento está perfectamente equipado. Espera de repetir pronto solo puedo hablar maravillas de este apartamento y sus anfitriones. Gracias, gracias y gracias.
Pedro was super responsive and flexible for our accommodations. Great place to stay and soak up all that Lisbon has to offer.

Beautiful flat with excellent views and natural light. Perfect location. Pedro responded quickly any time we messaged and someone was there to welcome us in and show us the flat. Looking forward to staying again.
Amazing place!!! The location is fantastic. Apt is spotless, gets a lot of light and is very comfortable. Zero complaints-I loved everything about this apartment!

We had such a great time in this Air BnB. The location is perfect, very central and walking distance from all of the things we wanted to see. The room was very spacious, clean and fully equipped with all appliances. The views from the balcony were amazing! We loved all of the extra touches provided by Pedro, and we were really impressed by the food and drink recommendations he provided. We definitely recommend staying here.
Location. Location. Location. The other best place to stay in Lisbon would be Arco da Rua Augusta itself.

We’d stay again, 100%. Thank you so much for making us feel welcome and at home. Great location, beautiful apartment, lovely view and we really appreciated the clear and open communication. Major good vibes. I will and would recommend
Perfect location, wonderful view, and friendly host. Stay here
Wonderful apartment - as beautiful as in the photos, with fabulous views. Well-located for sightseeing and wonderful personal touches to make our stay just perfect.
Great apartment. Great communication. Great welcoming. Great position. Highly recommended

This is a beautiful airbnb in the heart of Lisbon. The unit is attractively decorated, very comfortable, and has a great terrace/view to wake up to. Pedro was a great host, answered all our questions at check-in and left us oranges for fresh squeezed orange juice in the morning (unit comes with a juicer!).
Nice flat. Perfect location close to everything you need. Great host - always answering really fast.  We enjoyed the balconies and the wonderful sea view.

Great apartment in an excellent location. The communication with the host was great and they left us a lot of good recommendations of things to do in the area and other personal touches. The apartment was well stocked with everything one could need. The only knock on the apartment was that the bed was a bit uncomfortable (like a futon) and the listing suggested there was a dryer when it was actually just a washer. Other than that, the stay was excellent!

Great central location with good views of the city. A lot of great restaurants were nearby and most of the landmarks were easy to reach by tram. The host was very attentive to all our questions and had great recommendations for touring the city.
Premier voyage à Lisbonne et la chance de trouver cet appartement tout était parfait et l accueil chaleureux et très utile pour organiser notre séjour

This is the perfect place to stay while in Lisboa. Incredible neighborhood and amazing apartment. Francisco provided a lot of great recommendations and we were very comfortable. The patio view is incredible for a glass of wine and some cheese. I highly recommend staying here!

We absolutely loved our time in Lisbon, in huge part thanks to the fact that we chose to stay at Pedro’s lovely apartment. Everything is great about this accommodation: it’s beautiful, cosy, clean, comfortable and very central. I thought I would say that the mesmerising views over the city and the river are the best part about staying here, but it is actually the incredible hospitality, very warm welcome, top notch recommendations on what to do, eat and drink in the city, and great attention to their guests from our hosts, Pedro and the team that make this place unique and absolutely worth a visit.
The place is amazing. It is the best location in Lisbon. And the recommendations were very good. We really enjoyed the balcony with the view.

This studio apartment was perfect! It was safe, clean and had all the amenities needed. Great location and walking distance to restaurants and stores. The guide books with restaurants, bars, stores and places to visit was a nice touch and had great recommendations. Would definitely stay here again!

Such a cute apartment in a perfect location for exploring Lisbon. The studio is relatively compact but perfect for a couple. The kitchen is very well equipped including Nespresso machine and has everything you need. The balcony with a great view is the real highlight and such a lovely spot for breakfast and evening drinks. The location could not have been better for us, able to walk to most of the main attractions as well as bars and restaurants but also so close to metro if you need to access public transport. The directions we were given were perfect and really good communication for meeting us on arrival. Lots of great local recommendations provided too. We had a perfect stay! Thank you

THE BEST experience was THIS place! I highly recommend staying here.
From the views, to location, to vibe & comfort. A must !

We had an awesome time at the apartment in Lisbon. It’s perfectly located and well equipped, so that we did not miss anything.
The communication was fast and smooth and the we were welcomed at the entrance of the building, which was super nice.
Another cool thing was that there’s a small elevator which is very helpful if you have heavy luggage!
The only things we didn’t like was the uncomfortable bed and the noises of other apartments. The apartment is one of four apartments which are situated in one bigger apartment, so you share one hallway and of course you hear when somebody is leaving or coming.
But we can definitely recommend the apartment because of the perfect location!

Our stay was great for the most part! The location can’t be beat, with so many shops, cafes, restaurants right outside the front door.
The only complaint we had was that the elevator was out of service for the entirety of our stay, so walking up 4 flights of stairs several times per day wasn’t ideal.
The apartment itself was lovely, however, and had incredible views. Would definitely recommend as a great place to stay in Lisbon.
Great place in an amazing location!
definitley a great option- amazing with communcation, check in and flexibility. Would stay again!
Beautiful! Perfectly close to all the sites.
Beautiful room, amazing location and perfect experience. 100% recommend!

Pedro and his crew are very good people who are always helpful, will respond quickly to your questions and will solve any (teeny tiny) issue you might have during your stay. For example when te WiFi wasn’t working it was solved within the hour. Amazing hosts!
again, the aparment has been more than expected. excellent everything. pedro is the best superhost. we will try to return as soon as possible. dag & constanza
Diogo is a great host and the property is amazing, very clean, comfortable and super well located. I will recommend this place to anybody who wants to have a great place to stay in Lisbon!
This Airbnb was tops one of the best I’ve ever stayed! So beautifully kept and comfy. The view was astounding and location was insanely local. Best Airbnb!

10/10 - very easy check-in/check-out and the hosts were very quick to respond when we needed anything. We even accidentally spilled some wine on the sheets one night and the hosts took care of it before we even returned the next day with no effort on our part. The view is incredible, we enjoyed wine on the balcony each night after long days of exploring beautiful Lisbon. This location can’t be beat!! So easy to walk everywhere, the train station to Sintra is less than a 5 minute walk! Very comfy bed, the window shutters also make for a great night sleep. The restaurant recommendation list they provide was such a nice touch, we used it each night and the food was out of this world. If you are wishing to visit Lisbon I highly recommend staying here, we hope to be back one day!

This is one of the most beautiful places I’ve ever stayed at in Lisbon, and I have stayed at a lot of places! The views out of the balconies are spectacular. The place has an open concept and is quite comfortable while being delightful for the eyes. The place was perfectly clean and even had a maid service come in the middle of the week to clean and refresh laundry. I will stay here again. It was a dream. Bonus: I LOVE waking up and seeing the view. You will have to come here to experience it.

Great location and great view with a small balcony. You can literally walk to the sea side, Bairro Alto in few mins.
The flat is perfect for working as well.
Overall great experience and would definitely come back.
Very clean, is perfectly located at the city center  ! Nice view !

Amazing apartment,  with an incredible view and full of light! right next to a beautiful square, with many Cafés and restaurants everywhere in the neighbourhood. The host were really helpful  and super responsive. Definitely recommend.
Amazing, stylish place that puts you right on one of the most beautiful, quiet squares in the city. Decor is top notch and the balcony view is one of a kind. Hosts were fantastic too. 100% recommend!

Place is in a fantastic location.  You can walk everywhere you want to go (with exception of the Belem Tower).The metro is very close by which was much appreciated when pulling a suitcase uphill.  The portable wifi device was such a nice touch. And the views!!! This unit has both large water views from one balcony and castle views through the other windows.  Would highly recommend

A glamorous stay in a glamorous Place. From the first second we felt home. First of all we received so lovely and the team turned out to be the best hosts. The place is fabulous it is all the that is needed and then there is the view which is simply breathtaking! We loved every moment in this place. It is a true energiser yet feels calm while being at the heart of the city. Thank you so much guys, we will return!
Pedro was a great host. The unit is in a very convenient area for restaurants and shopping. I would recommend this place for a single person or a couple
Great place, wonderful location.
My best Airbnb expiriance ever!
I would highly recommend this apartment. The location is brilliant and the views are amazing. The hosts couldn't have been more helpful, it was definitely the best Airbnb we have stayed in.

I couldn’t recommend the Chiado Loft apartments enough. I have stayed at one of their other properties in Lisbon so I knew I was going to be more than happy at this apartment when visiting for a long weekend with my mum. They think of everything- from the complimentary wine, list of recommendations and not to mention the beautiful interior. This apartment has a stunning balcony with the most incredible view of the colorful Lisbon rooftops and river. This is my third time in Lisbon and this location couldn’t get any better. All my friends are coming to stay at their apartments when they visit Lisbon. If this place isn’t free for the dates you want, check out their other loft apartments- all equally beautifully curated.

뷰가 다한 집입니다.
이 팀의 숙소를 두 곳 이용했는데 대체로 깔끔하고 커피머신이나 블루투스 스피커 등이 갖춰져 만족스러웠어요.
엘리베이터가 있어 짐을 옮기는데 수월했고, 짐도 맡길 수 있어서 여행 마지막날 이용하기 좋았어요!
다만 집이 원룸 형식이고 작은 편이에요. 또 옆집과 테라스를 공유하는 형태라 완전히 프라이빗하진 않은 것 같아요.
그래도 멋진 뷰 하나면 됐다 라고 생각하시는 분은 100% 만족하실거에요.
호스트와도 소통이 잘되고 요청사항을 잘 들어줍니다!

Super appartement, bien placé, agréable et lumineux avec vue sur le Tage. Sa localisation permet de profiter de Lisbonne. L’équipe est accueillante, réactive et répond très vite aux messages. Nous y reviendrons volontiers!

It's a very nice apartment, small and nice, in a great location! Too like lying on the bed to see the feeling of the sea, there are elevator bonus points! Gave us a lot of directions and helped us book a bus to the airport. Highly recommended.

Vanaf het begin tot het einde was dit een top plek om te verblijven. We hebben veel contact gehad met de eigenaar voor tips. Bij aankomst krijg je ook een boekje met allemaal tips voor eten en bezienswaardigheden! Daarnaast hebben we veel contact gehad met de eigenaar over restaurant tips. We hebben zulke mooie en lekkere restaurantjes geprobeerd daardoor! Het appartement zelf is heerlijk ruim qua inrichting. Het bed slaapt heerlijk en ik had uit mezelf een Bluetooth speaker meegenomen maar die stond er gewoon! Daarnaast heerlijke wijn als welkomst cadeau!
All top notch!

최고의 숙소였습니다.
1. 번화가 한복판이라서 쇼핑, 치안, 메트로, 걸어서 구경 등이 매우 좋습니다.
2. 3층이라서 뷰가 멋집니다.
3. 친절하게 직접 만나서 체크인을 도와준 안토니오 감사합니다.

Pedro and his team did a great job of communication. They were there to meet us and show us around the fabulous air bnb. This was one of my fav air bnbs that I’ve ever stayed in because of the location, views, cleanliness and the little extras. Just as a nice gesture they had a portable WiFi station that we were able to use when we went out for the day. Not so expensive on their end but soooooo beneficial to visitors from US who are paying expensive WiFi costs.
We loved everything about their place. The morning sunrise view is so special and the views anytime are great. You will love it!

Gorgeous space - the view, the furnishings, the decor - absolute perfection.
Ideal location - close to the Metro/trams/buses, neighboring square with acoustic music and bar service, plenty of nearby shopping - couldn't ask for better.
Gracious host(s) - quick to respond, great tips, detailed walk-through - super for sure.
I hated to leave this apartment, in fact, I wanted to extend my stay but this listing, along with the group's other properties, book-up fast. Would stay here again in a heartbeat.

A perfect place to stay in Lisbon and a perfect host!  The pics are 100% accurate and we would stay there again when in Lisbon. The balcony view was the best place to start each day with coffee and watch even evening sunset.  Truly a perfect stay!
Absolutely the best stay of my Airbnb! Nice and cozy room with a beautiful view. The location is very convenient. What I loved the most was the host! Super kind and friendly:)

This is a beautiful apartment in an incredible location.  The view from the balcony is even better than the pictures.  Our hosts were very responsive to our needs and even left a half bottle of wine and cake!   I couldn't be happier with our stay!

일단 위치가 좋아요! 번화가 근처고 광장이나 다른 유명한 곳으로의 접근이 쉬워요. 산타후스타 엘리베이터는 5분 남짓, 쇼핑거리도 가까워요. 숙소는 정말 깨끗하고 좋습니다. 뷰도 너무 좋고. 침대도 소파도 푹신하고 편하고, 난방도 잘 되는 편이에요. 그리고 정말 좋았던 점 두가지가!!! 엘리베이터가 있다는 것과(캐리어 끌고 가파른 계단 안 올라가도됨) , 숙소에 머무르는 동안 포켓와이파이를 빌려줘요. 방안에서 충전해서 가지고 다니면서 쓸 수 있게 해줍니다. 질문에 답도 빠르게 해주고 근처 맛집 리스트도 방안에서 자세히 알려줘요. 무엇보다 체크아웃 후에 짐도 맡아줍니다. 리스본에 또 온다면 꼭 다시 묵고 싶은 숙소에요!!

I stay in multiple airbnb's throughout Europe and NA every year. This is definitely the CLASSIEST I've stayed in this year. Clean, modern decor, perfect location, and the hosts are super professional. Great value for the money.

This apartment was perfect in every way.  From the bed to the shower to the amazing patio views, we would not change a thing! Our best AirBnb experience to date! We loved coming back at the end of the day and watching Netflix on the TV, with the wonderful wine that was provided upon check-in.  The location was complete perfection, we walked everywhere and had Michelin starred restaurants within 2 blocks!

This was our second stay in this apartment.  They do an excellent job with customer care and cleanliness of the apartment.  It is an excellent location to many great areas of Lisbon!  We highly recommend it.
Pedro’s place was an amazing location in Lisbon and the hosts were great. Couldn’t have asked for a better place to stay. Would highly recommend

This was the perfect place to stay for two people! Very clean and easy to get to. In a great neighborhood that had tons of restaurants, bars and shopping. Beautiful and clean bathroom, comfortable furniture, cooking options and easy to use heaters. When we needed to go further an Uber only took a minute or two to arrive at the front door. The balcony’s view was amazing, perfect place to drink morning coffee. We would absolutely look forward to staying here again!
Excelente escolha.Apartamento ótimo no melhor bairro de Lisboa.Atendimento perfeito e preciso.

This is a compact space in the best neighborhood in Lisbon (Chiado). It is impeccably clean and very efficiently organized wit everything you will need for your stay in Lisbon.
The views from the balcony are beautiful. The host, Goncalo, was terrific. He gave a us a thorough orientation to the apartment and a list of recommended places to eat that we carried with us when we went out. He responded immediately to any inquiry and he arranged the taxi for our departure. What a kind and helpful man--he really helped to make this leg of our journey so much better.
We were close to everything--from the castle on the hill to the huge Mercado Ribiera down by the water. The restaurant recommendations they provided were all spot on.
The place is lovely and in a secure building. It is well appointed and served our needs perfectly while in Lisbon. The rate was certainly competitive. The hosts (there are actually four of them) could not be nicer or more helpful. Stay here, you won't regret it.

We loved staying here! The team was so sweet and accommodating at check in/out and always responded quickly to messages! They really focus on the little things, like giving us wine and plenty of recommendations :)

Wonderfully cute apartment with the most amazing view over the water. It was perfect for a couple, with nice touches like a bottle of wine for us to enjoy! The host was great at providing recommendations - from restaurants to nearby grocery shops. We had a fantastic stay!

I cannot imagine a more perfect apartment for a couple in Lisboa! Its location in Chiado is halfway up the hill between Baixa and Alto, which means either direction is only a 5 to 10 minute walk. The historic building is charming. The apartment is modern and chic and stylish, and has views of both the sea and the castle. The balconies, doors, windows, and shudders provide lots of options for customizing how much light and air is desired. And last but most certainly not least, Pedro and his team have found that perfect alchemy of hosting an AirBnB... everything is efficient and organized, but always with a warm, welcoming, and artistic touch. This apartment is a perfect 10!
Everything was so great!! My friend and I enjoyed the apartment a lot!! Thks for releasing this amazing accommodation in Airbnb!!

The apartment exceeded our expectations. There were so many little personal touches that made us feel right at home. The location was also  convenient and waking up to the amazing view was the icing on the cake. I would highly recommend staying at Pedro's apartment!

This was the best Airbnb experience we’ve had thus far! Diogo welcomed us when we arrived at the apartment. He gave us step by step instructions on how to use everything in the apartment, provided a list of restaurants and places to go, a portable WiFi hotspot device which came in handy, and let us know there was a washing machine down the hall. It was a fantastic stay in a great area of Lisboa. If we visit again, we will be contacting Diogo and the rest of the Chiado team! Thank you!!

We’ve stayed in a lot of Airbnb’s and Pedro’s is by far the best we’ve ever stayed in. The location is perfect, the views are incredible, and the hospitality is outstanding. Stop looking and book this place before someone else does!
Our top stay in Portugal!

We loved our time staying at Pedro's Chiado apartment.  The location is perfect and the apartment is beautiful.  The area is so central to everything but the apartment was still quiet and peaceful at night.  The park and kiosk nearby was lovely and convenient.   We definitely recommend this apartment for anyone needing a cute studio in a great neighborhood.
Wonderful place, great location, beautiful views and in the heart of all you could want.
Amazing space with a cool decoration, very cosy and comfortable the host have little details that make this stay unique

This apartment came highly recommended from friends and after arriving, within minutes we could see why! Not only is this apartment beautifully decorated and clean and comfortable, but the view from the double doors that open on to the small balcony was exquisite! The location was second to none and is right in the heart of Lisbon, among cafes, restaurants, bars, shops and sites. Yet because it is on the 3rd floor, it is quiet and restful. This was the perfect place for my husband and I to spend our anniversary and was plenty of space for 2 people. Although we didn't end up using the kitchen, other than making tea and coffee, it seemed very well equipped. We will be recommending this apartment to all of our friends and will certainly be returning!

This is a Beautiful, spotless studio with wonderful views in a great location. Being on the top floor, the small elevator was appreciated although we took the stairs down.  It’s a little pricier than we usually do but a treat & worth it. The little chocolates, bottle of wine, oranges, jam, pods & sugar for coffee set for you were nice touches. We used AC 1st night but opened the windows for cross breeze the second.  Having the portable WiFi was very nice & António was very timely in responding when we had questions. As it was just off season it was not too loud but closing the windows helps if it bothers you. You are only 2 to 10 blocks from at least 3 must sees in Lisbon & not much farther from many more. We walked basically everywhere but you are close to the metro & tram.  We would definitely consider returning if we get to return I Lisbon.

This was a gorgeous and comfortable place. The best location - nearby amazing restaurants and interesting spots. It was quieter than expected based on how central it was and it’s because of the thick windows. Made it very easy to sleep! The hosts are great and provided very good local recommendations. I will definitely stay here again next time I’m in Lisbon.

Merci encore pour ce séjour ! Nous nous sommes basés sur les excellents commentaires que vous aviez pour choisir votre logement et je dois dire que nous sommes ravis. Tout était parfait, propre, calme et digne d'un 5 étoiles.
Idéalement situé.
La cerise sur le gateau : le petit dej avec vue sur les toits et sur le Tage : inoubliable !

This place is amazing!! Highly, highly recommend. The space is stylish and clean. The amenities are top notch (ie, bath robes, portable WiFi, lists and lists of recommendations) and everything was thought of for us. We wanted for nothing. The views from the balconies were beautiful and perfect for watching the sunset. We would stay here again and again!
Pedro’s home is the perfect location for exploring Lisbon. We were blown away by the beautiful amenities and the view!

Studio extrêmement bien équipé (TV, WiFi, lave-vaisselle, micro-ondes, cafetière Nespresso, enceinte blue-tooth, ..), on sent que tout est fait pour que l'on se sente chez soi et que rien ne manque. En plein centre de Lisbonne, tout près du métro, de l'ascenseur de Santa justa, situation exceptionnelle en hauteur (avec ascenseur) sans vis à vis et avec vue sur le Tage. Une excellente adresse pour visiter cette ville où il fait bon vivre
Exactly where it needs to be and exactly how it should be. Perfect for a short stay in beautiful Lisbon.
Beautiful studio apartment in a very central location. Host was very responsive to any queries we had and apartment had all we needed for a short stay.

What a WONDERFUL apartment! Everything was perfect! The location is central to everything. The view of the city and water is beautiful! You have everything you'd need including an elevator since the apartment is on the top floor as well as access to a washer/dryer.  This was by far my favorite rental during my stay in Portugal and I highly recommend to anyone looking for a place to stay!
Simply perfect! Perfect location, really nice, beautifully decorated and super clean appartement, well equipped, with a significant attention to details... highly recommend!

Everything was great!  They really went above and beyond with the greeting and all of the extra tips.  Waking up to that view was unbelievable.  The location is perfect, we were able to walk everywhere we wanted to go and it was quiet enough at night.  I would stay here again any time!
Stylish space, centrally located. Apartment comes with great views, great facilities and welcoming hosts. Better than advertised and great value for money.

In the heart of the Chiado,  fun, vibrant, neighborhood. On the edge of the plaza where the revolution started. with restaurants and stores all around - the location is perfect. This studio has a view towards the ocean so it's nice to sit out on the fairly tiny patio and enjoy your morning coffee or an evening glass of wine. While the studio felt smallish when we arrived, it was really plenty big enough at the end of the day.
Amazing location, gorgeous apartment and thoughtful advise and consideration! I highly recommend this place to anyone, you’ll simply be taken away by it all!

We loved our stay at this place. We felt safe and the apartment was centrally located. The apartment offered an amazing river view and exceeded our expectations. There was even a portable wifi hot spot that they provided that you could take outside of the apartment. Highly recommend this apartment.

What a great experience. Diogo and the team communicated superbly and went out of their way to accommodate our needs. The apartment is perfectly placed for exploring Lisbon and was wonderfully clean and well equipped. We enjoyed our morning coffee on the sunny balcony.
Couldn’t get a better location to visit Lisbon.  Really slick high end apartment, perfect for a couple!

This one room flat is adorable and offers a stunning view of the ocean. It has everything you need, a very comfortable bed, great shower, laundry, elevator and more. Walking distance to wonderful sights, cafes and restaurants. It is very quiet at night. Will definitely be back.

Fantastic apartment in a great location close to many great restaurants and sights. Cool modern decor in a beautiful old building with an amazing view. We loved the nearby Campo square with a great kiosk bar and musicians. Hosts were wonderful and great with communication. Recommended Taberna restaurant, which was the highlight of our gastronomic experience. Would definitely stay here again! Thank you, gentlemen, and thank you, beautiful Lisboa, for a truly memorable visit! We will be back!

Look no further! Even nicer than the photos make it seem, and the location was absolutely perfect. A million great places to go right outside your door.
We loved it so much, we stayed here on both of our Lisbon stops during our trek around Portugal and couldn’t name a single regret. Eating breakfast on the balcony each morning overlooking the city and the river was such a treat and we had great luck exploring the host’s recommendations.

This was an awesome place to stay in the center of Lisbon. The pics of the view don’t do it justice. You can see the building from pretty much any of the high spots in central Lisbon.
The personal touches were terrific too.
Was grateful to have a laundry option!
I preferred to get takeout to eat on balcony because it was so beautiful.
One of my favorite Airbnb experiences! The apartment was clean, bright, and had an excellent view of the water. Definitely would stay here again!

Cute apartment perfect for the two of us. Perfect, central location close to all the main sites. Apartment was super clean and little extras were available to us (robes, coffee pods, Bluetooth speaker). We lived on the balcony when we weren’t touring the city. Love love love!!
O apartamento é muito bem decorado com super bom gosto!  A vista do Tejo e entorno è incrível. A equipe é excelente e nos atendeu perfeitamente.  Recomendo
You get what you see - place is presented very well.  Location and view from room is perfect !
Wonderful studio apartment in hip district of Chiado.  Superb location to many sites and great restaurants.  Host was great!  Very clean and comfortable.  Highly recommend!!
