Amazing location - really nice and clean place with great views of the city. Diogo our host was super helpful , gave great tips of the area.  Would highly recommend!

We really enjoyed our 5 nights at Pedro’s place, the location was ideal, very central and supermarket close by. It was bright and sunny with superb view of the Tagus river, even the castle was just visible. Had all the amenities you would need, comfortable , quiet and good security, a lift also if needed. Would recommend.

This is the 2nd time I have stayed in this apartment.
I was there for 5 nights and loved it.
Pedro, António and Gonçalo and Diogo are great hosts. Extremely friendly and helpful.
The apartment is in a beautiful old building with great views and is in a excellent location. Lots of restaurants, bars, shops, attractions all within walking distance.
The apartment is a great size for 1 or 2 people. It is very clean and has great amenities. Including a portable WiFi device which is very handy.
Thanks guys for a wonderful stay and hope to be back soon.
Randall
Beautiful views, quiet building in the heart of Chiado. Excellent hospitality! I'd stay again!

Nothing has changed since my last review of this fantastic apartment -- same stunning views, same clean great design, same amazing cross breezes, same amazing location on one of the coolest little squares in Lisbon.   Same great hospitality and communication, Pedro and his team really know what they're doing, all are so kind and welcoming.   Hot tip -- Lisbon Under the Stars at the ruins of Carmo Convent just started this week for summer, buy a ticket for 15euro!  The Convent sits adjacent to the apt.   Incredible!  (they have their own website, not sure i can list it here).   Thanks again to team Pedro for all!!  Abraçao
This is a lovely space with great views and in a great location. The bed and bedding was super comfy.  Our host was very helpful sorting out a taxi problem when we arrived.

Superb location, amazing views from the balcony, comfortable bed, great shower and great host.  Place was clean and my wife absolutely loved this place and didn't want to leave.  Great for two people.  Would not hesitate to stay there again
The property and host are as good as other reviews state. The location is excellent and it is a good base for exploring Lisbon.  We particularly enjoyed the balcony. Recommended.
Pedro and team made the experience of booking and keeping in touch easy. The apt was as advertised - clean bright quiet and in a great location. Thoughtful touches. Highly recommend it!

Our stay here was amazing!! The apartment itself is beautiful and the view over the city is breathtaking. Pedro and the others really thought of everything we might need during our stay including comfy robes, laundry, WiFi, Bluetooth speakers, and endless suggestions for restaurants and activities around town. They even welcomed us with a bottle of wine. If you are coming to Lisbon, you should stay here to make your visit even more enjoyable!
The apartment was beautiful. Communication was great & check in was smooth. Provided the travel cot and high chair for our baby. Place was spotless with gorgeous views.
A small but very well-designed apartment in a central but relatively quiet location. We were very happy with our experience. Pedro's team were easy to get hold of and helpful
We enjoyed our stay in Pedro’s studio, it is center located, walk distance to most places. The view from the patio is wonderful. Thank you Pedro and the team!

Un super séjour à Lisboa dans ce magnifique appartement. Nous avons bénéficié d'un accueil chaleureux de la part de Diogo même à une heure tardive. L'appartement est entretenu avec soin et il y a de nombreuses attentions très utiles (liste des restaurants, hotspot wifi nomade...). Un grand merci !

This is a beautiful flat to stay in for a few days, in a handy location to experience Lisbon. We walked each day from here in all directions, and never any need for a car or bus. My wife and I would recommend this flat!!!

Amazing place. Very well located.
Good hosts. Will surely recommend.
We would definitely be back.
Sanjit & Rasveen
We like to stay in clean, hospitable, safe and accommodating places. If you do too, then stay here. And it’s the perfect location for all of the Lisbon sites.

We had a great stay in the apartment. It’s located right in the thick of the streets packed with restaurants and shopping. The surrounding streets can get a bit crowded and touristy during the weekend but overall great location. The view is also unbeatable, with a lovely balcony. Interiors were also fantastic. They were also very accommodating and let us store our bags before we went to the airport. Thanks!

check in was easy as someone was there to meet up with us and show us around the apartment. nicely decorated, bright and refreshing. location was excellent!! walking distance to everywhere you want to be but also tucked away in a quiet area. great view off the balcony to enjoy your coffee/tea/breakfast in the morning.

Pedro’s place was above expectations!  Sun filled apartment all day and a wonderful terrace to enjoy coffee in the morning and a glass of vino in the evening. Clean, well appointed and thoughtfully designed. We are seriously considering Lisbon again next year for a longer stay and Pedro’s apartment will be our first choice.

Die Unterkunft liegt super zentral in einem tollen Viertel in Lissabon. Alles ist gut zu Fuß zu erreichen. In unmittelbarer Nähe der Unterkunft gibt es einen sehr gut sortierten Biomarkt und einen Nespresso-Shop für die Kapseln.
Das Appartement hat eine grandiose Aussicht und das Frühstück auf dem kleinen Balkon bei strahlendem Sonnenschein war ein absolutes Highlight. Es sieht alles so aus wie auf den Fotos. Im Bad gibt es wenig Ablageflächen und es ist etwas in die Jahre gekommen. Wir waren sieben Tage in dem Appartement und es wurde zwischendurch gereinigt und wir bekamen frische Bettwäsche und Handtücher. Klasse Service und alles super sauber.
Wir können das Appartement sehr empfehlen.

O apartamento é lindo , com uma localizacao excelente e uma vista maravilhosa do Tejo. A equipe é muito atenciosa aos detalhes , com respostas às mensagens e dedicação às solicitações . A estada foi um grande prazer !
The apartment is beautiful , with excellent location and an amazing view of the Targus. The team is very thoughtful to all details , with quick responses to messages and requests . The stay was very enjoyable !

This flat is simply perfect. Terrific central location. Wonderful views out each window and even from the bed. Tasteful and cool interior design. Classic old lift. All of it charming, welcoming and just right for the two of us. The hosts are attentive, helpful and unfailingly gracious. We loved our time in Lisbon and felt so grateful to stay in such a perfectly-situated and comfortable flat.

Very fast response, place is easy to find. The classic elevator is another experience to have. Little touch from the team that is memora ke (handwritten note, portable wifi, special tips for breakfast, lunch, dinner and drinks). Very clean place, stylish and has one of the best views. Definitely recommended.

Our second stay in this great place! Unbeatable location, amazing view, smart decoration, very friendly hosts and all necessary amenities are there! Absolutely recommended if you are looking for a cozy base to explore Lisbon!

Goncalo and Pedro both were waiting for us when we came! They were very polite. The place was absolutely charming and larger than the photos indicated. The view is wonderful. The apartment has everything you need: great kitchen that is really nicely outfitted, Nespresso, pretty bathroom with a powerful shower head, a large sofa in case you have two separate sleepers, etc. Given that it is a corner apartment, it is much quieter and there are view windows out. The bedding is really nice (not rough) and the pillows are good.
The level of support and hospitality is very high with these guys. We’ve never been taken care of so well!

Great spot and very central, the hosts were very accommodating in everything from check in to local tips and on check out and very prompt in communication during our stay.... they made our trip hassle free!
The view from the balcony was so beautiful and the the location is superb- walking distance to metro and train station, good food and various shopping places. Love the nespresso machine too.

Ich kann den vorhergehenden Bewertungen in allen Punkten nur zustimmen. Kommunikation problemlos, sehr nettes Team, Lage des Appartements sehr zentral und trotzdem ruhig,  Anbindung an U-Bahn und Tram 28 super, Einrichtung stylisch und trotzdem praktisch, grandioser Ausblick. Wir werden im nächsten Jahr definitiv wiederkommen.
Great valeu and comfort with the right touches. I highly recommend and will stay again when I return.

This flat is amazing! I can't give it high enough ratings. It is a very comfortable and quiet accommodation with amazing views. Also, the hosts included very nice touches like local wines, high quality bedding, and edible treats to make our stay extra special :)
The apartment is in a perfect, central location which made it easy to access all areas of Lisbon. The hosts also left a ton of local recommendations for restaurants - we didn't have time to try them all, but the ones we did were fabulous!

Just about a perfect Airbnb:
Awesome room, great furnishing and smart design, all amenities available.
Super nice and helpful crew with immediate responses and a ton of suggestions that turned out to be great.
Location is A+, price / benefit ratio ridiculously good. We’re staying here next time in Lisbon.
Thanks Goncalo & Co
Stylish, comfortable place with great views over the river. The location is pretty much perfect for getting around.
Great , absolutely fantastic place. It has everything you need for a pleasant stay in Lisbon.

Lovely apartment perfect located in a cozy area close to really good restaurants and bars.
The apartment is well equipped and has a wonderful view. I also want to mention the really good cushions. Walking distance to riverside and train station, very convenient if you like us want to se Sintra for example. Very quick response from our host when we needed some help and really good information about recommended restaurants. We would love to come back.

We had a great week at this apartment with our 1 year old. There is everything you need and in a fantastic location. We appreciated the view too. Great linen and comfy bed. Checkin was made easy and we appreciated the washing machine facility too! Thanks for a great week.

We arrived in Lisbon on the final days of a 3 week trip. We were tired. The apartment was clean,  bright with high ceilings, lots of windows, stylish decor and a great view. It was an excellent place to relax. The location was great. Many places to eat nearby. Loved listening to music in the square steps from the apartment in the evening. We received a quick response to all questions. I would highly recommend staying here.
Our second stay in this wonderful apartment with amazing view. Clean, quiet and with space. You can’t beat the location! Friendly warm contact with the owners. A hidden gem in Lisbon!

Absolutely beautiful apartment with amazing views! Slept with the ocean breeze on us and woke up to espresso on our own little balcony. Centrally and comfortably located near anything you need. 20 min from airport. Can’t stress enough how nice and also clean the apartment was! Great hosts!
Loved our stay in this studio. The location and view was wonderful. We had everything we needed.

Our words of advice are to book this studio if it’s available! Stylish, sparkling clean, great amenities (espresso and welcome wine!), amazing views and a nice terrace to enjoy in one of the coolest neighborhoods in Lisbon (Chiado). Don’t hesitate as you won’t be disappointed.

The location is perfect! within walking distance of restaurants, bars, train stations. there's a supermarket right next door where we bought bottle water everyday for 13 (euro) cents! the apartment view is fabulous! very much recommend this place!
The location is ideal if you want to be in the Chiado center but enough away from the tourist hordes to have quiet and sanity. The place is well kept and comfortable. Highly recommended.

It's difficult to think of how this portent could be improved upon.
Great views, stylish, near perfect location & very professional & friendly hosts.
There are a plethora of bars & restaurants within a few minutes walk & the metro stop is just 5 minutes away too.
Although being in the city centre, it's surprisingly quiet at night & we had no trouble sleeping.
The apartment is on the 3rd floor but accessed by a lift - it's also very secure & private.
We stayed for 5 days & at no time did it feel like a "studio" as there is ample space within it.
Thoroughly recommended.

This might be the best Airbnb we’ve ever stayed in - the location is fantastic and the apartment itself is SO well done, clean and just the right size. We started every morning with a coffee in the balcony with a view of the water and watched the sunset with a glass of wine every night listening to the music and bustle of the street drifting up to us. Really made our Lisbon trip a success!

Fantastic apartment in the centre of chiado, equipped with all the essentials and a stunning view from the balcony. António was very helpful prior to and on arrival and had lots of tips on  what to see and where to eat and drink. Can’t recommend enough!
Great place in a great location!  We were met by the host, the place was exactly as pictured.  Good space and we really enjoyed ourselves.
Clean, nice elevator, air conditioning, good recommendations, very communicative, great neighborhood.

The cutest apartment in the best location!! This was the perfect home base for exploring any area of Lisbon. We were able to walk everywhere and easily access excellent restaurants and shopping. Communication and check in/out is very easy and the view from the apartment was an awesome bonus :)  We were provided with local tips and a restaurant guide, which was extremely helpful! I would definitely stay here again when I’m back in Lisbon!

Had a great 4 night stay here. Pedro and his team were amazing to deal with throughout. The location is very central, everything is walkable with easy access to the Metro. The apartment is very modern and tastefully decorated, with two balconies with good views to relax with a drink. We could not have done better in Lisbon. We want to go back.

The flat, its location and the hosts were just fantastic. It has been key to make our stay in Lisbon just wonderful!
Go there with no hesitation!
Thanks for taking care of us well.  Our stay was amazing thanks to your helpfulness, beautiful apartment and great location.  Our time was better than we had hoped for!

Lovely apartment in a great location. Antonio was a wonderful host. Very responsive and great recommendations for good restaurants.
Thank you
Dave

From booking to the end of my stay this was a perfect experience. Pedro and his team were very responsive and helpful. The apartment is beautiful and nicely appointed with everything you need. It’s in a great central location with most major attractions and dining walkable. The view from the balcony is beautiful. Hi highly recommend this place for one or two people.

Great place! We were only there one night, but the apartment was awesome and in a great location. Pedro and his team really care about making sure you have a great experience, so I'd definitely recommend to anyone visiting Lisbon for the first time.

We LOVED this apartment.  We stayed here for our last two nights of a 12 day trip and truly felt at home and comfortable in this studio.  I can't say enough good things about the location of this apartment as well as the food recommendations that were left for us upon check-in.  The view out of the apartment was breath taking and it was the perfect place to retreat to late afternoon for a glass of wine after a day of exploring.  The bathroom was clean and spacious.  We will most definitely recommend this apartment to our friends and family who travel to Lisbon!
We loved our stay at Pedro’s! Such a beautiful view, wonderful location, modern just what we wanted to come back to relax to after a long day of walking around Lisbon.

We loved this studio apartment. It was clean, bright and plenty big enough for two people.  We especially enjoyed the view and sitting out on the little balcony drinking our coffee in the morning and a glass of wine in the evening. The location was brilliant and we enjoyed being right next to Carmo square and the atmosphere there during the world cup. Goncalo checked us in and he is lovely young man. We felt very sad leaving this apartment and Lisbon. Highly recommend.
perfect location and an amazing apartment - has everything you need and is sparkling clean. was lovely to be greeted by the host and shown around, great communication too.
Probably our highlight stay for our honeymoon. Has an amazing view and very nice apartment. Hosts were very thoughtful and even gave us a hotspot to use around the city. 10/10 would recommend.

Absolutely perfect! Location could not be better. Easily walkable to all the central areas with countless restaurants, bars and shops minutes away. Pedro and his team answered messages promptly with great suggestions and ideas to my questions about Lisbon. Check in and out was seamless. And the place itself has a super comfy bed and a fantastic balcony with views of the city.

What can we possibly add to all the other great reviews ... other than to say we really didn’t want leave and hopefully will visit Lisbon and your fab pad again sometime soon!Thanks Pedro Giancarlo and team  from  Alison and David

Booked the room for 4 nights. The room looks exactly like in the pictures. Clean, spacious and stylish. Theres a queen size bed and a long comfy couch. Gonçalo and the Chiado team were very helpful. There's tips and guides lamited for the guests. I would definitely recommend the Barrio do Avillez restaurant. Also thank you for the welcoming wine and chocolates. The room has 2 balconies, with views to the arch and castle ruins. On top of all these, they have a portable wifi so a huge bonus to the guests. I would highly recommend this place as it is in the centre of Lisbon so restaurants and shops around. Would definitely stay here again!

This apartment is perfect! We stayed here for 2 days and left wishing we could stay longer. The view from the balcony is amazing, the decor is beautiful and everything in the apartment is clean and functional. The hosts are very helpful and left us with many restaurant and transportation options. The location of the apartment was within walking distance of most of the things we wanted to do and see. Public transportation was also very close by. High recommend!

This apartment is everything you dream a place in Lisbon would look like. PERFECTLY located in the Chiado district of the city and within walking distance to many of Lisbon's top attractions. Couldn't recommend enough!

Definitely recommend this apartment to anyone who wants to be in the middle of all the action in Lisboa! Pedro and Gonçalo were great hosts.
The apartment offers a stunning view and cozy haven after a long day of touristing. Will definitely be back and stay here in the future!

We stayed 2 nights at Chiado for our first ever visit to Lisboa. It was in the perfect location - close to restaurants, shopping and sightseeing. The views are amazing. If you want to get a feel for being a local, this is the place! The size of the apartments was perfect for 2. Although it’s on the 3rd floor, it was no problem to walk up the flights. There is a small (1person) elevator as well, which was great for transporting our luggage. We rented a car. The manager who greeted us Gave us affordable options for us to choose from. We chose a garage about 250 km away from the apartment which worked at perfectly. Highly recommend this place!
Studio impeccable et très bien situé pour visiter Lisbonne.
Great flat and great location. You should stay here.

The apartment is absolutely immaculate!  It is well furnished, clean, modern, and has all the amenities you could ask for.  The location is superb with plenty of bakeries, restaurants, and tourist attractions well within walking distance.  We were met personally by our host when we checked in, who explained everything to us in the apartment, which we thought was a nice touch.  We would definitely recommend this place to anyone staying in Lisbon!

Antonio was a wonderful and thoughtful host. Our plane was late but he made sure to be there when we arrived. He explained everything to us about the area and how things worked.
The apartment is in an ancient building but the place is extremely modern and well equipped. And so important it was spotless! There is a nice view from both small balconies, able to see the tile roof tops and the sea. We found it be quiet and secure. Judy and I really enjoyed the square across the street plus all the restaurants and shops. There’s a natural food store (supermarket) across the street, a fabulous museum on the square no more than 150 yards from the front door. Although the elevator is small, its so charming and we both loved using it.
When we visit ‘Lisboa’ again, we hope to stay there.
Thank you for a wonderful first time Airbnb experience!
Rob and Judy
Ps.....the little bakery around the corner had the best pastel do nata (National pastry)

My wife and I loved this studio apartment in the center of Lisbon.  Location is excellent, a nice safe area to be in with plenty of restaurants & shops within easy walking distance.  The apartment was spotless and well appointed, the bed was comfortable, as was the couch.  Great views of the castle and river from the double doors that are so nice to open up and enjoy.  Communication with the hosts was excellent and Goncalo made some great recommendations for us on where to eat nearby.  We would definitely rent from them again.

Amazing apartment right in the centre of the city - the view from the balcony is great. We spent every morning eating breakfast on it! There were some great tips for places to go and see and restaurants to eat at and we got immediate responses to any queries we had :) if we ever come back to Lisbon we would definitely look to stay here again!

A nicely furnished apartment in an old building giving it a lot of character.  On a high floor with a nice view of the river.  Conveniently located in a quiet street near a Metro station and tram stop in the heart of Lisbon.  There are lots of good eateries nearby.  Goncalo who checked us in was helpful and friendly.  We would stay there again!

Geschmackvoll eingerichtete Wohnung, super zentral gelegen und ein fantastischer Blick über die Dächer von Lissabon und das Meer. Die Kommunikation mit Pedro verlief gut, sehr freundlicher Empfang. Wir haben uns sehr wohlgefühlt!! DANKE!

We had a blast at this cute, modern apartment right at the heart of downtown Lisbon. The view was breathtaking especially. Everything was clean with plenty of sunshine during the day to enjoy. The hosts were very professional at check in and out with useful tips to explore the city. We also stayed a night at another hotel, but wish we had stayed here for the entire trip. Strongly recommend!
Absolutamente recomendado. Pontuais, vista incrível e a poucos metros de ótimos restaurantes e bares, embora a rua seja bem silenciosa.
A lovely studio apartment, with great views, and in a location that is very central and yet quiet.  Highly recommended.

This apartment was superbly situated for sightseeing by foot and for bars and restaurants. The accommodation was clean and comfortable and beautifully light , perfect for a couple. Pedro and his team were always available if we had any questions and check in and out was smooth and efficient. I would highly recommend it . (If you have mobility problems be aware that it is on the third floor accessed by a beautiful but very small lift or several flights of stairs.)
No thanks

This apartment is great and it was perfect for me and my girlfriend's short trip to the city. It's a really comfortable and nicely styled place, with a great view out into the city and river. With it being in such a good location, we walked to many of the local landmarks, restaurants and bars.
António our host, was fantastic. He was really helpful on arrival and gave us lots of tips for where to go and what to do.
A great experience with this apartment and in the city on the whole.

Superbe logement, très bien situé.
Avec un ascenseur, ce qui est très utile quand on a des valises un peu lourdes.
Outstanding little appartment, we really enjoyed having breakfast with the sun on the balcony. Everything was perfect.
This studio was lovely. It has breathtaking views and is located in a great neighborhood. The Chiado Lofts & Studios team is extremely helpful and the whole experience was wonderful.

My partner and I have traveled to many foreign countries and found this apt to be extremely beautiful and in a fabulous location in the heart of Lisbon.  Pedro and his staff were very accommodating. They provided restaurant and day trip info. We look forward to returning and would stay in the same apt.

Excellent apartment - clean, modern, quiet with stunning views. Very close to shops & restaurants & the Metro Stop, Chiado Biaxa. Also very handy for jumping on board the infamous 28 tram!
Thoughtful touches from our hosts, from local restaurant recommendations to coffee pods for the Nespresso machine & champagne to bring in the new year! We also watched the fireworks from our balcony which were truly amazing! I would definitely recommend this beautiful Lisbon apartment for a travelling couple.

Appartement exceptionnel : en tout point conforme à l'annonce, situation idéale pour visiter cette magnifique capitale et un accueil au top. Nos hôtes ont été au top et se sont pliés en 4 pour répondre à nos attentes.
Je recommande fortement!

O espaço é ótimo, bem decorado, bem equipado e de tamanho excelente. A localização impecável, no miolo do Chiado, não poderia ser melhor. Toda a equipe é muito simpática e pontual. Nos presentearam com espumante e Bolo de Reis no Natal, uma grata surpresa. No edifício há uma confeitaria maravilhosa de doces portugueses típicos, e vários restaurantes ótimos bem pertinho. Sem falar do comércio. Nota-se que o Pedro e sua equipe tem apreço pelos seus hóspedes. Recomendo firmemente, e pretendo voltar este ano.

Amazing stay at Chiado studio and a very nice visit to Lisboa.   The amenities were top notch including portably WiFi which saved us having to use roaming on our phones.   The nespresso was an added touch and the balcony and view are to die for.  Only regret is we didn’t stay longer!

El mejor sitio donde hospedarte si quieres ver Lisboa estando en uno de los barrios mas céntricos. El apartamento impecable, con detalles para cuando llegas y unas vistas impresionantes desde la terraza. Sin duda lo recomiendo a cualquiera y volveré a ir si vuelvo a Lisboa.

Pedro's apartment was very clean. The view over the window and interior were superb !; it is much better than the photos in the website. And the location is perfect to look around Lisbon city.
I recommend to anybody who travel Lisbon for both sightseeing and business purpose.
This was our first stay with airbnb and surpassed all expectations. I wouldn't hesitate to book with edro again and highly recommenfd it to others.

The apartment was very cute and location could not be beat. It was right in the heart of Chiado with much shopping and restuarants...all walkable. Rossio station was a 5 minute walk which made our day trip to Sintra so very easy. I would recommend this location without a doubt.

This Apartment is wonderful with amazing views over Lisbon down to the River, everything you need is to hand. Central location right beside a square with nice Bars & Restaurants, everything is in walking distance. Communication with Antonio was excellent. Would stay here again in a heartbeat. L &S

The apartment is not suitable for three adults. The sofa is up against the bedhead of double bed and nothing else separates the two areas.Bathroom is small and no place/ ledge for soap etc in shower area. Difficult to determine if any fan exhaust operates.Patio width minimal - less than a metre. Lift old and small as is typical for these buildings but with the sound, vibration and cutting out of lights during operation, it does not engender confidence in its safe operation.
Location very good.
Great studio space in a perfect location
Easy, fast and very pleasant communication as well as check in. Perfect location and great view.
Amazing experience!
Wonderful location in Lisbon great view from the patio. Comfortable and clean.
Location is worth mentioning... They provided us with free roaming wifi which made things easier....
Pedro’s place was a great apartment in a good neighbourhood. Would have loved to stay longer than our 3 nights
Great apartment, very central with amazing views. Host very approachable also.

This apartment is even better in person. The area is outstanding and literally around the corner from everything. The moment I walked in and saw the view to the Tagus River, I knew I had made the right decision. Pedro was so welcoming and so many nice touches throughout the apartment. Mobile wifi to take with you when you're out exploring, great restaurant suggestions, a Nespresso machine, etc etc. The apartment made my stay in Lisbon very nice, especially after a long day of travel.

The Chiado studio is great. Super location, bright, clean and well done renovations. And quiet. Very good bed and pillows. TV had English channels which was nice. Also nice to have the laundry facilities. We'd recommend this unit to stay in.

I can't say enough about this amazing apartment. Amazing location to explore Lisbon from in the heart of Chiado, yet quiet at night! The decor is beautiful and the included amenities are everything you could possibly need. We loved sitting on the balcony, looking over the river and drinking delicious, affordable Portuguese wine! Would love to come back!

Wonderful apartment with breathtaking views. Check-in was swift. Owner always available. Location is unbeatable in the city. Walking distance to everything. Perfectly decorated with all the necessities you would need. Felt like a second home! Can't wait to come back!

Lovely studio in a fantastic location just on a really nice little square near lots of restaurants and bars but still peaceful at night. Convenient to get to from the airport by metro just 5 mins walk from Baixa-Chiado station. Easy walk down to the river and only 5 mins walk to Rossio train station for visiting Sintra. About 10 mins walk up to Bairro Alto for lots more bars and restaurants. The studio itself is even better than it looks in the photos and has everything you need but the best bit is waking up to the view in the morning or sitting with a glass of wine in the evening on the balcony. Communication with Pedro and the rest of the team was excellent and check in very straightforward and friendly. Very welcome little touches like some wine and chocolates. I would recommend this place to anyone going to Lisbon and would love to stay again if we are lucky enough to return.

We have stayed in 20+ Airbnb’s and this would rank as the best in our opinion. Great location. Superb view, exactly as depicted in their ad and still very quiet at night. Very helpful host too. You could not want for a better location in Lisbon. Just wish we were staying longer in the place.
Andrew & Lisa

A million dollar view. Close proximity to top restaurants, shopping, transportation and activities. The service is top notch and the team thinks of all of the little things you wouldn’t expect. Beautifully remodeled. They know how to please their guests.

Fantastic location in chic Chiado and a stone's throw to many transport options, very stylish design in a (rare!) elevator building with a gorgeous water view on the balcony. Communication was very professional, and the extra amenities are over and above what we've experienced in our many Airbnb experiences around he world: pocket mobile wifi device, wireless Bose speakers, Neapresso machine. All that for great value. Plus, this studio is adjacent with 3 others on the same floor from the same host, so it's great for either couples like us or groups of people traveling with other couples/families. Would definitely stay here again if we come back to Lisbon!

Thanks for letting us use this great apartment! It had everything we could have wanted and the views from the balcony were fantastic. Sitting out on the terrace in the morning, enjoying coffee and watching the streets below and boats on the river was special.
António was a great help and our only regret is that we couldn't have stayed longer. Thanks again!

This is a great, clean apartment, excellent location, lots of restaurants around. The view and the balcony are a bonus! We had breakfast on the balcony every morning. Gonçalo checked us in, he is a wonderful host, very prepared, organized and friendly. One of the great check ins we had with airbnb so far. The apartment is very pleasant to live in. The building is quiet, we hardly saw anyone else. Gonçalo let us use a little wifi device that we could take with us on our outings to have internet anywhere. Never saw that before, really appreciated that. We were three people and it is true that the apartment sleeps 3 people comfortably. Definitely recommend this apartment in beautiful Lisbon!

This flat is absolutely delightful! Clean, close to EVERYTHING with stunning views, we could not have been happier with our stay. Highly recommend Pedro and his team, as they were wonderful hosts.
Thanks again!!!
Great location with a view. The apartment is every bit as nice as represented by the photos in Airbnb. Highly recommend!

Perfect location to walk everywhere. We loved our balcony view. Easy communication with Pedro and he was able to accommodate us with luggage storage and an earlier check in. The description and pictures are on point and would recommend this place to anyone visiting Lisbon!!
Excellent views!!  Clean and bed is comfortable!!  Would stay there again.

A great find, the studio is very well furnished and with great style. The view from the balcony is something hotel guests elsewhere would pay a lot for. You can sit in bed and admire the view.
The location is very convenient and in one of the best parts of the city. You can walk out of the front door and be in all that the beautiful city offers. I strongly recommend this studio. Thank you to Pedro and his colleagues.
Excellent apartment.

We had a really nice stay here. The studio is really large and the view is beautiful. The bed is really comfortable and all of the furniture is really nice. Check in was really smooth and everyone was really helpful.

Best ever airbnb -and not only!- experience!
Impeccable apartment.
First class details.
Excellent taste.
Stylish.
Best location.
Pedro and his team were super professional.
The apartment looks much better than the actual photos!
Everything was above our expectations, and it will be difficult to find another apartment for our next hollidays!
Anyway, we are planning to return to Lisbon, only if this apartment will be available :-)
Thanks for this time!
Dag & Constanza

I had the incredible good fortune to stay in Chiado Studio II and Chiado Studio III on my first trip to Lisbon in July. It was my first airbnb experience...and now fear I've been spoiled! Unable to book one apt. for 5 consecutive nights (they're extremely popular, and with very good reason), so I spent 3 nights in one, then moved one door down the hall to the other. I can't say enough good things or rate the experience any higher -- the design and use of space is impeccable, each super clean with fantastic beds and bedding, gorgeous marble baths with large soft bath sheets, fresh oranges were left by the gracious hosts in a bowl to be juiced in the morning, and wine in the evening (or afternoon!) and delicious natas for a snack. The views are ridiculous/breathtaking, and the cross breezes in Chiado Studio III (a corner unit) amazing. Antonio, Gancalo and Catarina were a pleasure from the first reservation confirmation until the final goodbye, and were so accommodating with my "move" and with all communication and suggestions. The area is the best...quiet, peaceful and on a beautiful, tranquil square with a typical kiosk and a few cafes, where oddly enough i ran into the one person I know who lives in Lisbon --- the square is one of his favorite spots in the city. Amazing bakeries and restaurants and shopping all steps away from the architecturally significant building. My tip -- reserve now!

Fantastic view and value.  Very clean place and Pedro leaves great notes about the city/suggestions of where to eat.  Pedro was extremely accommodating to my husband and , giving us a tour of the place on arrival.  I would highly recommend this place!

We found the apartment easily after a short taxi ride from the airport and were greeted at the apartment. We felt very welcomed and instantly felt comfortable in the apartment.
The apartment was very clean, and felt spacious with big windows letting in lots of light.
We really enjoyed our stay and slept really well in the comfortable bed. It was a perfectly located base for exploring beautiful Lisbon.

This stylish apartment is in a great district and the view is beautiful. It is well equipped and I particularly liked the Bose speaker with blue tooth for my music and the portable wifi came in handy. There were also laundry facilities on the floor. I would definitely come back.
This is an incredible location and view, with great hosts.  Both the bed and the couch are very comfortable.  The view is uniquely spectacular.  I recommend this location and apartment strongly.

Amazing apartment with incredible views! Old charm mixed with modern amenities! Every detail was very well thought out to ensure we had a great stay. Their guidebook with many recommendations was also very helpful.

The space is exactly as pictured! The location was unbelievable, right next to the Carmo Convent and easily walkable to many great shops and restaurants. Even the hallway of the building is beautifully decorated with painted tile. The hosts were gracious and patient, the space was clean and had all the amenities as advertised. Would definitely recommend to friends visiting Lisbon!
Beautiful space, the room is very nice, with modern amenities and a contempory look. Great location, great views, nice balcony.  Overall an amazing final stop on our honeymoon.

Amazing apartment. Beautiful inside, with a perfect little balcony with a fantastic view. Great to enjoy pre-dinner drinks and lazy breakfasts. Check in was smooth, host left us a small bottle of wine to enjoy and recommendations on bars/restaurants. It's in a great location just off a small square with some nice restaurants, only a 5-10 min walk from great Fado bars and only a few mins walk from Baixa-Chiado metro. Would definitely recommend. Well worth the money.
perfectly located, well equipped, a great place to stay
This is a terrific spot for travelers. A clean well presented apartment in a fabulous location just moments from the Metro, shops etc. I have no hesitation in recommending this property.

This is the perfect base to explore Lisbon from! Right in between Avenue Liberdade and the Targus river, many of the key sights, cultural attractions, shopping locations, nightlife enclaves are all within easy reach.
The host is fantastic and responsive even when things go wrong. The conditions of the apartment is even nicer than what is shown in the photos!
We will definitely return here if we come back to Lisbon!

El departamento es fantástico! Cuenta con todas las comodidades , es muy luminoso y tiene una vista maravillosa. Los anfitriones son muy amables y además de los bombones, el vino y el café de cortesía, nos permitieron utilizar el wifi portatil.
A una cda de calle comercial y a metros de una plaza con bares y restaurantes. Lo recomiendo sin dudarlo.

El departamento de Pedro es maravilloso, no le falta nada. Super luminoso con sus tres ventanas y una de ellas con una hermosa vista del Rio Tajo.
Todo su mobiliario moderno y todo en perfectas condiciones. En cuánto a su ubicación, sencillamente no puede ser mejor, se encuentra en el barrio del Chiado, que es para mi lo más cool de Lisboa. A 50 metros del convento del Carmo, a 100 metros del elevador de Santa Julia, a 300 metros de la Plaza Rossio, a 400 metros de la Brasilera y rodeado de bares y restaurantes de todo tipo y color. Me felicito de haber alquilado este departamento y me felicito por utlizar airbnb.

Excellent stay in Lisbon. Beautiful apartment with gorgeous view. Very well situated, minutes from restaurants, bars, cafes and transport. Very helpful and accommodating hosts. Full list of recommendations in Lisbon on hand in the flat as well as portable wifi.

Amazing apartment with great views. We felt very welcomed and there was even a list of suggested restaurants nearby. Apartment was very clean with a comfortable bed. The balcony was great for drinking coffee/tea in the morning. Check-in and check-out was very easy. Would stay there again.

Tremendous Airbnb- one of my faves of all time! Super clean, well appointed, centrally located, and with terrific views to boot!  Can walk everywhere. And communication / logistics were perfect, everything went off without a hitch. We loved it! Will definitely come back next time we are in Lisbon!

Pedro's place is truly great. We can't say enough about the location - walking distance to almost everything and close to all the good shopping and restaurants.
The flat was a good size for two people and offered all the amenities we needed for a couple days in Lisbon. The view was amazing - big windows with lots of natural light. We loved sitting on the balcony with our morning coffee or having a drink before dinner - one night there were even fireworks! Despite being right in the heart of downtown we did not find it at all noisy.
The team was very easy to communicate with. We also appreciated that they were flexible with our check-in time (our taxi got lost and we unfortunately arrived past schedule). We had an early check out and they arranged a cab for us as well.
A truly great experience and highly recommended for couples traveling to Lisbon.

Very well organized team. The apartment was very clean with all new fixtures and amenities. The view was excellent and having a small bistro table on the balcony was a bonus! We enjoyed being very close to restaurans and shops and it was a great location to explore the city from on foot. Our trip was too short to fully enjoy all aspects but it was a fantastic airbnb experience none the less.

Pedro's Studio couldn't be better location wise.  The place is steps to shopping and good restaurants.  If you are looking to be in the heart of Lisbon then stay here. The studio is perfect for a couple, and with a balcony that offers a glimpse of the river, waking up or winding down after a day of sightseeing is so pleasant.

This was one of the best Airbnb's we've ever stayed in.  The apartment had everything we needed and more.  The best part was the personal wifi device that you could carry around with you and look things up.  It came in quite handy!  The hosts were very gracious, leaving little chocolates, a small bottle of wine, and a welcome note.  The location was perfect for walking pretty much everywhere in the center of Lisbon.  I would highly recommend these hosts and this studio for anyone traveling to Lisbon!

We just spent 5 days in this studio apartment and loved it! It is big enough for two to be very comfortable and has everything you need.  The view is fantastic and it's great to sit on the little balcony and watch the world go by! It's in the centre of everything, easy to walk most places and cabs are reasonable. There is a lift so you don't have to climb stairs and it is very quiet for its position, no loud noise at night and you don't hear the other apartments. There is a washing machine with power provided on the floor and a clothes rack you can take to the apartment to dry clothes and the dry very quickly. The bed is comfortable and there are reading lights. On the corner is an organic supermarket and the general supermarket is not far away. All the shops are just round the corner. There is a square on the corner with outside seating to have a coffee or a drink, we met friends there every evening for a drink before wandering off to find somewhere to eat, and you don't have to go far, we ate at Restaurant Carmo twice, It is very good, first restaurant in the square near the apartment, and their other fish restaurant at the other end of the square, also very good. We did an eating tour, Eat Drink Walk with Duarte one day, it was excellent, his wife took Rick Stein around and we ended up at restaurant Carmo for lunch.  Lisbon is great and Pedro apartment added to our enjoyment.
Sehr guter Services, sehr zentral gelegen und gute Tipps, was in der Nähe alles zu machen ist. Wenn man aufsteht, sieht man vom Bett aus den Tajo (Fluss). Sehr empfehlenswert.
We had a great stay here. What a wonderful neighborhood close to many great restaurants and sites. The view from the balcony was amazing. Would definitely stay here again if I return to Lisbon.
This studio was perfect. Great location with plenty of shops, restaurants, and bars within walking distance. The studio was spacious and had all the necessities. Can't wait to stay there again!

This apartment is beautiful, and we never tired of the view!  It was clean, comfortable and a great location to explore the city.  Communication was easy and clear; we had no problems whatsoever.  It's on a hill, so it might not be best for someone with walking problems, but Lisbon is hilly and that makes for the great view!  It's rather noisy at night, but we left the windows open, and they could have been closed as the place has A/C.  I'm very happy we were able to stay there!
So great we came back for a second stay!

Perfect location!! You can walk to all the major sights and there is a ton of great restaurants near by. Less than a 5 min walk to the metro and the major train station that takes you to Sintra. About a 10 min walk to the train station that will take you to Belem. Apartment is clean and you have a nice view of the river. If you are planning on staying in Lisbon, this is the place you want to rent.

Possibly the best AirBnB experience I have ever had. I cannot rate the apartment highly enough. The location is perfect and the views from the apartment are second to none. Also, the team letting the apartment were extremely helpful and made the whole experience easy and stress free. A brilliant holiday from start to end.
Our stay in Lisbon was amazing. Apartment was beautiful, great location, and had an awesome view of the city. Would definitely come back and stay there again.
Lovely studio in great location with lots of natural light, nice views and modern amenities. Very comfortable bed and linens. Would definitely return.
Great

We had a wonderful time at this excellent apartment. It was perfectly located to explore the city in all directions, and just as beautifully decorated as pictured. It is very central (there are some good restaurants in easy walking distance) but was pleasantly quiet at night. The apartment was modernly furnished with everything we needed - and even more than that, with a dishwasher in the kitchen and a shared washing machine in the hall. It was still very spacious for two people. Upon arrival we were made very welcome and communication with António of the Chiado Lofts Team before and during our stay was very easy and quick. We would definitely recommend staying there!

This is a great location, lively neighbourhood with plenty of good restaurants, and yet the apartment is nice and quiet.
Well appointed, very beautiful studio, spotlessly clean and just as pretty as in the photos. A lovely haven to come back to after a day walking around town. The staff is very friendly and helpful, good recommendations for restaurants. Try 'OUI' for yummy mussels in a relaxed atmosphere, Mar ao Carmo a bit pricier on the square and Aqui ha Peixe - all within walking distance.
We stayed 5 days and were so sad to leave - will definitely come back to this great apartment and city!

Flat and neighborhood are just amazing. Communication with the host was very good (clear and always prompt). The view from the little terrace is literally unbelievable: we will miss it and just hope to come back!
Daniela & Paolo

la ubicación del departamento es excelente. En Lisboa hay que caminar y esto es lo interesante. El depto está en la mejor zona. Limpio, pulcro, perfectamente equipado, hizo que me sintiera sumamente confortable. Sin dudas si retorno a Lisboa esta será nuevamente mi vivienda!!!
muy bonito el apartamento, igual o más agradable que en las fotos, nos agrado mucho, todo estuvo perfecto !
Perfect location for enjoying the area. The apartment is beautifully decorated and comfortable for 2 people.
Espaço perfeito!

The studio is amazing with a view of the river right at the foot of the bed! The light shining through the windows was beautiful to relax in and wake up to. Exactly as described and even better in person, with a high ceilings, a closet, and a beautiful bathroom. The area is central to Rossio, Praco do Comercial, Bairro Alto, shopping in Chiado, and public transport, yet quiet/peaceful at night. Hosts responded quickly to any questions we had which was great as well. Only thing is wifi got really spotty on the second half of our stay (we were there a total of 6 days), but we managed. Perfect size for my boyfriend and I, and would definitely stay here again in a heartbeat as it made our first trip to Lisbon very memorable!

Beautiful apartment with an amazing location. Close to everything: shops, restaurants, tourist attractions etc. Walking distance to many places and if needed the metro stop is 5 minutes away. Still the apartment was quiet and we were sleeping really well. Two beautiful balconies where we were enjoying our breakfast. Apartment was well equipped and beautifully decorated. We would definitely go back! Host was also really helpful and nice and the check-in and check-out went both smoothly. Highly recommended for everyone!

This place was perfect! The location couldn't be better and the spectacular view every morning was so special. We were greeted by Antonio who gave a tour of the place and a thorough overview of how everything worked. The place was very clean with a very comfortable bed lined with a down mattress cover for extreme comfort. The towels were also plush and soft like fancy hotel towels. Not to mention we were provided with a bottle of wine and chocolates as a greeting. Can't forget The Nepresso machine providing us with excellent coffee every morning. I highly recommend this place. So far the best Airbnb I've stayed in.
c'est la 3eme fois que je loue cet apartement...ça veut bien dire que je m'y sents bine, non?  tout est trés bien de l'accueil , à la situation , les services etc

This studio was an amazing place to call home for a week of exploring Lisbon. Everything was exactly as described...except the fantastic light that comes in throughout the day! I absolutely loved it, but there are curtains and shutters if you want to block it out.
The team was super easy to communicate with and even let me leave my bag after checkout so I could have another day to explore.
This place was so perfect I tried to book it again a week later, but of course it was booked : (
Five Stars across the board!!!

El departamento está muy bien decorado y con todo lo necesario para disfrutar de la estadía en Lisboa.
Las fotos indican tal cual es.
El barrio es precioso y rodeado de bares y restaurantes.
Fuè muy amable nuestro anfitrión. Lo pasamos increíble!!
The perfect place for a couple!

Everything was great and even better than advertised. The flat is very tasteful and spacious. Great light and little patio. The location is superb.
Pedro's team is truly professional
Location is very central to major sites in the city. The apartment is exceptionally clean & looks even better than the photos shown.

Place was everything and even nicer than what we expected. Antonio and Pedro were very helpful throughout the whole booking to checking out process. The flat was clean, amazing views, close to everything, and had all the essentials. I highly recommend this location for a stay in Lisbon.
Gorgeous place, highly convenient location and very professional communication. We'll definitely use t again.
We just loved Pedros apartment and the location. Such a lovely place with wonderful views, lots of light in the best part of Lisbon.

The hosts were FANTASTIC, they helped in every way possible. Gonçalo even helped my wife park the car. The room was clean and well decorated it truly felt like home. The location is awesome. Would stay here again in a minute.

das Apartment ist einfach super. Die Lage ist perfekt um die Altstadt zu erkunden und von dort aus weitere Sehenswürdigkeiten in Lissabon auszuchecken. Der Gastgeber ist in der Kommunikation sehr freundlich und hat den ein oder anderen Geheimtipp parat. Wir würden jederzeit wieder kommen!

This was honestly my best Airbnb experience. The apartment is better than the pictures! The location is flawless, the hosts are amazing and provided great tips for me to enjoy Lisbon solo. But I can't emphasize how perfect the actual studio is, it's so cute and has an amazing view!! Perfect for one or two people.
Accueil au top, studio au top! Super bien situé et bien équipé. Rien à redire : foncez !

Pedro was there to meet us bang on time, apartment everything as expected and more., so beautifully furnished, coffee , music system etc., Terrace lovely for breakfast , and light lunch some days if we were in area.
Great place to stay as regards walking to all the interesting historic places, we even walked to the amazing graveyard from Chiado,( got taxi back part of way)

Pedro even organised out taxi for early morning to airport.

The apartment is truly amazing , views to sea, lovely and quiet at night., all in all five stars , lovely hosts, will strongly recommend friends to stay.

We loved Lisbon, and thanks to hosts, plenty of information for our break left in the apartment.,enjoyed some of the restaurants they suggested.

Thank you Pedro and co hosts for a wonderful experience in Lisbon.

Ενώ φτάσαμε πολύ αργά το βράδυ, ο Λουίς μας περίμενε στο διαμέρισμα, μας έδειξε όσα χρειαζόμασταν, υπήρχε λίστα με προτάσεις για φαγητό και ποτό στη γειτονιά και ένα μπουκάλι κρασί στο ψυγείο για καλωσόρισμα. Το διαμέρισμα είχε όλα όσα χρειαζόμασταν, ο χώρος, ο εξοπλισμός και η αισθητική ήταν άψογα. Η τοποθεσία ήταν τέλεια, κοντά σε όλα, όμως ήσυχη. Το ασανσέρ και το μπαλκόνι με την θέα ήταν τα ατού του διαμερίσματος.

Our host communicated well with us. Antonio met us downstairs when we arrived and showed us in. The location was excellent and the apartment was as pictured. There was a little balcony with a great view. I would definitely recommend it to Lisbon travelers.

We had a wonderful experience. The team was great with communication, and the check-in process was flawless. The apartment was well-equipped and very clean. Having a washer made life easier. The dryer is a rack, not a machine, but all the clothes dried very quickly, so that was fine.
The view from the balcony was a real treat. The location was perfect, very easy to get anywhere. We look forward to staying again when we next visit Lisbon.

Amazing stay in Lisbon in this studio apartment. Views overlook the ocean in the distance. It has everything you need to make your stay wonderful, including a small few surprises  that make it that much more special.
We had a great 10 night stay in the apartment. Everything was as the pictures. Great views, great area and location. Would stay there again. Antonio was a great host.

You'll get the feeling of old Lisboa with all the amenities of a charming and updated apartment which is exactly as depicted plus a surprise bonus sunny view of the waterfront. This is a special find! And the hosting team, Antonio, Luis and Pedro are super on point.
Francamente perfecto

Attentiveness, view, and location of a high-end hotel at an affordable price.  My wife and I have stayed at some incredible rentals / hotels over the years, this was easily one of the best.  The area of town is walkable to all the best restaurants, bars, and sights in the city.  We spent a few nights drinking wine on our balcony looking out at the river, the sunset, and people watching on the cobblestone streets below.  Those may end up being some of my favorite memories from the trip.  It had air conditioning ... a surprising luxury for a non-hotel.  Great hosts; highly recommend!
вместо хозяина был другой человек, но он тоже был внимательным и  услужливым.

The stay was great, the location is in the center of everything, place is very clean and the view from the balcony is incredible. one night even had the fireworks show right outside of our window. The place is a bit hard to find.
Just a excellent place botn regarding location in town and wonderful view. Evertything top score from us. Staying for  3 nights in Lisboa

Très bel appartement, bien aménagé avec un canapé très confortable, dans un quartier sympa de Lisbonne. Les photos correspondent parfaitement à la réalité et nous avons eu droit à une petite bouteille de vin et à des oranges en guise de bienvenue. Très bon accueil de la part de la Chiado Team !

This apartment was breathtaking. My girlfriend and I finished a two week trip to Portugal with three nights in Lisbon, and it was the highlight of the trip. Sitting out on the balcony looking out to the water or down to the bustling street below was amazing. We hope to return to Lisbon, and if we do, we will be staying here.

Beautiful place in a great location. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it. Pedro was also very responsive and was kind to let us keep our bags in the apartment on the afternoon that we left to avoid lugging them around the city.

Le logement est très bien situé et bien équipé. Plusieurs petites attentions nous attendaient : vin au frigo, chocolat, condiments pour cuisiner... Bref, nous nous sentions chez nous. Après quelques jours, j'avais une question concernant le fonctionnement de la laveuse. J'ai reçu une réponse par texto dans les 2 minutes! Le séchage se fait par séchoir dans l'appartement. Je retournerai à cet appartment lors de ma prochaine visite!

L'appartement est très bien situé à la fois pour les visites et pour profiter de la vie nocturne (pour autant très calme). Très agréable et semblables aux photos (une seule pièce plus la salle de bain séparée). La climatisation est un plus certain pour le confort l'été. Luis qui nous a accueilli était clair dans ses explications et sympathique. On ne loge pas chez l'habitant mais la qualité de service est très élevée. Rien à redire, je suis venu 3 fois à Lisbonne (Alfama et Bairo Alto les fois précédentes) et c'est le meilleur endroit où j'ai séjourné à la fois du point de vue emplacement et qualité du logement.

Location, location, location! It can be overwhelming to choose a place on Airbnb in a destination you don't know much about. I found the location of this apartment in Chiado to be perfect for our exploration of this amazing city. A quick walk to the Baixa-Chiado subway stop (which you can easily and cheaply get to/from the airport with a connection at Alameda) and walking distance to anything we wanted to see.

The apartment is on the 4th floor of a building on a quiet street. A grocery store across the street and public square half a block away. The apartment is actually a sub-unit in what seems like it was a larger apartment that was made into independent units. The front door and small common space (including washer/dryer and iron) are shared. Each unit then has its own door with separate lock and bathroom. It was quiet and this configuration was fine, but I just had not been expecting it.

We loved the unit. It was perfect for what we wanted. The pictures show the unit exactly as it was. One very large room with a comfortable (but firm) bed, separate couch, and a cooking area with microwave, coffee maker and cook top. The separate bathroom was a nice size with plenty of hot water. The A/C in the unit was helpful on the hot day -- the room was never freezing (they were hot days) but it was good enough. Tons of natural light flowing in combined with great views on two sides and a quaint balcony.

We appreciated the laminated sheets of information on the unit as well as suggestions for local places to eat. The support team was helpful from our first inquiry to our checkout. We appreciated the flexibility in check-in and check-out times as other guest schedules permitted!

I highly recommend the unit and I would stay here again. Thanks to the host!

Pedro's apartment was amazing. The view was fantastic, everything in the apartment worked well, it was centrally located but quiet and Pedro and his team really went out of their way to ensure that we had a wonderful, comfortable stay-- Very friendly and responsive. I've mentioned on other reviews that I would stay in the same apartment when I returned to a city. This is the first time I would return to a city (Lisbon) specifically to stay in this apartment.

Pedro had prepared the room perfect. We loved every detail of the flat .The flat is situated in one of the best parts of town with a stunning view over the rooftops of old lissabon. We felt like home and like to come back.

The  apartment is as good as it looks in the pictures, but the view over the rooftops to the water is amazing. We loved this stylish apartment. Very clean. The location is excellent. Close to shops, restaurants and metro. Also a lovely square outside with lots of restaurants for outdoor dining and musicians playing. Once inside the locked building, Pedro's apartments are off a private locked hallway. Very secure. A fully equipped laundry is also provided. A wonderful and highly recommended place to stay in Lisbon.

We were made to feel very welcome at this fantastic apartment. It was better than shown in the photo's given the beautiful view. Very well located, comfortable and quiet. The outdoor terrace was a bonus. Would recommend highly.

Adorei o Studio. Fomos super bem recebidos. Nos deixaram varias dicas sobre Lisboa.
A localizaçao e muito boa. Tudo no apt esta novo e perfeito.
Com certeza voltariamos!
Amazing studio in a great location - we wish we could've stayed longer!

Nous avons été accueilli dès notre arrivée avec beaucoup de gentillesse. Le studio est parfait, aménagé dans un esprit contemporain très agréable et avec tout le confort nécessaire. Le quartier est très sympa, très calme tout à côté d'une place charmante. Malgré sa situation dans un quartier très fréquenté, il fait très calme et la vue du studio est idéale; la Tage d'un côté, le château de l'autre
Bref un séjour parfait et à recommander.

I love the place very much... Antonio was very welcoming when we arrived.
The view from the balcony was amazing. The apartment was very cosy and we felt like we were at home. Location was perfect to everywhere.
Antonio was very helpful with our questions and had a great communication.
Highly recommended and I will be back when I'm in Lisbon.
Pedro and his staff were perfect hosts. Couldn't imagine a better Airbnb experience. They were accomdating, flexible and very courteous. Highly recommend!!!

Pedro's appartment delivered the best possible experience for a traveller to Lisbon.
Location, amenities, friendliness, attention, comfort, view .... I could go on for hours.
One of the most pleasant of trip experiences I had so far. If I manage I'll be back.
Thanks to the Chiado Appartement Team!

We have stayed in one of Pedro's apartments previously and had such a good experience we booked another one for this trip. Everything was as described but the view was even better than the photos showed. Could not fault anything. Very clean, everything we needed and in a great location with a fantastic view from the balcony. A warm welcome from Antonio and the lift was a welcome bonus!

Absolutely perfect. I can think of nothing that needs improvement. Great host, great location, tastefully furnished and very comfortable with views as well! Easy communication with our host who helped us store our luggage rather than lugging it around the streets for 4 hours - called us a cab also. We would highly recommend this wonderful apartment.

A perfect apartment in a perfect location.  We throughly enjoyed our 2 weeks in Pedros' apartment.  Highly recommended for a great Lisboa and experience.  The apartment was just like the photo & description but nicer.  Felt like home.  The location is perfect for easily getting around & exploring.  For us was the nicest part of Lisboa.

Everything was great and very romantic! The apartment was even better than in the photos and the host was extremely friendly!
I will suggest this apartment to all my friends.
Great apt. Great location, clean nice feel like home  in the center of Lisbon

The host was very prompt on arrival and explained everything about the apartment very clearly to us. The apartment itself is so light and spacious- perfect for a couple of days in Lisbon. The balcony in particular was lovely to eat breakfast and drink coffee in the sun. Location wise the apartment is very central but also quiet. Could not recommend more!

The Chiado Studio III was a wonderful place to stay in Lisbon. It was located near the metro, many wonderful restaurants and shopping. The directions given to the apartment were accurate and very helpful since the apartment is on a smaller side street. The apartment looked exactly like the pictures, was very clean, had everything you needed in the kitchen and even access to laundry if you need to wash clothes. The elevator was small but great to have. Pedro left a wonderful Easter treat for us of Easter bread and Port. The air conditioner worked great at cooling the apartment down. Two small complaints though, could have used more toilet paper than was provided and there was sometimes a sewage smell in the building and apartment. It's an old building so that was understandable. The day before we left we asked Pedro to book us a taxi for the airport in the morning and it came right on time the next morning. If you're looking to stay in a wonderful apartment in a central location that has the feel of home this is the place for you.

Underbar lägenhet med utsikt hela vägen ner till floden och över Castelo från andra fönstret. Perfekt läge med närhet till shopping, många sevärdheter och kommunikationer. Vi blev väl mottagna och fick en utförlig beskrivning av hur allt i lägenheten fungerar. Hade inga problem under vistelsen. Rekommenderas starkt!
Wir waren bereits zum 2. Mal in der Wohnung und sie hat uns wieder sehr gut gefallen. Toller Ausblick, tolle Ausstattung und das Mitten im Zentrum von Lissabon! Sehr zu empfehlen!!

We had an incredible vacation in Lisbon and staying here was really wonderful. The flat is spacious, very well lit (wonderful large windows with access to two balconies), clean, comfortable, and perfectly situated downtown. The couch and bed are very comfortable, and it's an amazing view to take in from the balcony at the foot of the bed - (and to wake up to each morning). The Chiado Lofts and Studios Team was positively responsive with arranging the accommodation and with any questions we had.  There was an extensive list immediately provided to us of restaurants, cafes, and bars throughout Lisbon that proved to be really terrific. I absolutely recommend this flat to anyone looking to visit Lisbon.

Nous avons été très bien accueilli à notre arrivée. Tout est conforme à la description et aux photos. Le studio est vraiment très agréable, lumineux et avec tout le confort nécessaire. merci pour les oranges , la bouteille de vin et les dosettes Nespresso!
Sans aucun doute si nous revenons à Lisbonne, nous reviendrons au studio... A deux pas du métro, du fameux tramway, et central pour toutes les visites. Ambiance cosy et tranquille! Que du bonheur!

Parfait appartement, très propre et décoré avec gout. Parfait emplacement aussi avec le luxe de prendre le petit café matinal au soleil sur le balcon vue sur le Tage - génial! Et un merci tout particulier pour les petites attentions à notre arrivée qui font plaisir: une bouteille de vin dans le frigo et des oranges que nous avons pu presser le matin au petit dej. Nous n'aurions pas espéré mieux. A recommander sans hésiter. Nous reviendrons c'est sur. MERCI

Just one thing above all: on the wonderful balcony of this sweet apartment I've asked Simona to be my wife!
I could have done it in a hundred of places in Lisbona, but the way we felt this place gave me no choices.

The location is perfect. Walking distance from the main touristic spot.
The interior design is very refined.
There is everything you need and it's clean.
The hosts are kind and efficient.

Definitely the place to live the beautiful Lisbon.

P.S: the answer was "yes" :-)

Milo

El departamento esta en una zona privilegiada, con una vista increíble. Muy cómodo, limpio, ordenado. Todo tal cual se muestra en las fotos. Nos recibieron muy amablemente y nos dieron todas las indicaciones que necesitábamos.
Lo recomiendo 100%
accueil parfait , la personne qui m'a attendu à eté trés rapide à repondre à mes emails et disponible , les explications ont eté trés claires et utiles

Nice studio in an old building with charm, intelligently constructed inside to help make everything work up to modern standards . Great location in the heart of the action with a nice bonus view off one of the balconies.

It's nice to stay in a rental where the owners have thought things through down to the small details. Made the stay that much more enjoyable and relaxing after a long journey!!

Pedro please was perfect on many level. Location is great. Quite, yet very close to Cihado best attractions. Clean and modern and everything is working as promised. An added value is the beautiful sea and city view from one of the window. Reception was great, friendly and informative. Definitely to added to my favourites list.

Gorgeous apartment high atop the city. Pictures don't lie and it's the perfect sized studio.
Want to see the castle or the ocean? Great, just look outside. Want to lose weight from all the food and wine you'll be indulging on? Great, just skip the elevator and climb the four flights of stairs. You can't lose.

we just returned home from Lisboa. and oh my god! it was fantastic!!!
this apartment is probably the best apartment for new year celebration. from the bed out of the window we were able to see the fireworks. great show. Pedro even spend a bottle of champagne for us! For us it was a very good start out of this beautiful apartment into a new year. Obrigado! this year will be great thanks to lisboa!

Nous avons été très bien acceuillis avec quelques petits cadeaux de bienvenue comme une bouteille de champagne , de vin et quelques fruits . L'appartement correspondait exactement à la description avec le charme en plus .
Nous avons adoré la vue, la luminosité et la décoration de ce charmant appartement . Le petit balcon plein sud avec la vue sur le Tage au soleil d'hiver était un vrai bonheur ....
Trés bien situé dans un quartier animé et central . En bref il était parfait pour nous .

We had a fantastic stay here!  The location is wonderful.  We were close to all of the shopping and nightlife yet the apartment was still quiet at night.  We could not have asked for a better location, we were within walking distance to anything we wanted to do!  The apartment was very clean and looked exactly like in the pictures.  We were given a welcome gift of a bottle of wine which was perfect to sip on the beautiful balcony.  We were so happy with this apartment and our stay!!
Amazing place, amazing city!

Siamo stati in questo delizioso appartamento solo due giorni ma è stata un'esperienza positiva sotto tutti i punti di vista. L'appartamento molto carino e arredato con gusto, inoltre si trova nel cuore della città. Il proprietario molto gentile e disponibile in tutto. Da tornarci sicuramente!!!

This studio apartment is beautiful, exactly like the picture, you can see the ocean from the window, both myself and my husband really enjoyed staying there. It's very close to Chiado metro and all the shops and department store, there is a supermarket right next door. The apartment has a lot of things you need and you can do cooking no problem, so it's very good. Luis was very helpful to organise a taxi in the morning for us to go to the airport, everything was very smooth
Great experience. Loved the place and the location was perfect.

My husband and I (both in our early 70's) stayed in this apartment in November 2015, and loved it. It is exactly as described in the advertisement. We were met by Antonio who went through every thing in detail with us, and recommended several restaurants close by some of which we had the pleasure of trying during our stay. We were pleased to find the building had a elevator, making it easy to reach our 3rd floor apartment, and we always felt secure within the apartment which was important to us being an older couple. Our front balcony had river views, and we enjoyed sitting out in an evening with a local red. This apartment is walking distance to shops, and many tourist attractions. Largo do Carmo is 20 metres from the front door and is awash with many little restaurants and outdoor dining. We would certainly stay in this apartment again, and recommend it to anyone looking for somewhere central to stay in Lisbon.

The apartment was well equipped, nicely furnished and clean. Perfect location in the heart of one the nicest quarters of Lisbon. The host was always heplful with any of our request, e.g. booking a taxi or organizing a baby bed. Nice view from the balcony. Wireless access worked well.

This was absolutely fabulous!!!
I have to say this is by far the best AirBNB I have been to. The apartment is excellent, luminous, tidy, well equipped and stylish!! The room has been furnished neatly and in a beautiful style. It is the first Airbnb I have been to, in which I don't have the feeling of living in IKEA-city or in worn-out furniture. No, no, this apartment has been thought through and the furniture has been bought and assembled especially to show a very personal touch. In fact it looks as if one wants to live there actually. I was very impressed!!!
The apartment is situated in the centre of Lisbon and one gets everywhere on foot. It is located on the border of Chiado, excellent restaurants, shopping road practically at doorstep, and Bairo Alto, where the city nights are vibrant. The underground is only about 300 m away.
The facilities in the apartment are great!! Warm thanks to Luis who waited for us and provided Nespresso-caps, a bowl full of tasty oranges and a bottle of wine in the fridge. We felt very touched about these little arrangements and they were all excellent. There is a dishwasher in the kitchen and a hairdryer and: the bed is of very good quality!! No back pain, no hanging through!!! In a common-room in the hall, is a washing machine, if you want to stay longer and have laundry to do. The elevator is old-fashioned in a lovely way - it works fine, but keep one finger on the tap as the light goes out once all doors are neatly shut :) Luis also provided us with addresses of restaurants nearby or further away and the ones we tried were great.
If I go back to Lisboa, I will certainly try to have this apartment again - even if I would have to alter holiday-dates a little bit in order to get it. If it is free and you plan a visit to Lisbon - go for it!!! It's absolutely worth it!!!
Excellent experience and very beautiful apartment with an amazing view in the centre of Lisbon! I strongly recommend this apartment and the courtesy of Pedro

Response time was fast and responsive. Understand my queries and answers were positive.
The studio was exactly the same as the pictures posted. What impresses me the most was the cleanliness of the room and it was bright. Everything was so clean except one which we can live with it. So far the cleanest compared to the rest of airbnb i stayed, 5th one now.
Very well equipped for the stay. Bed, sheets and pillows were comfortable.
Towels were clean.
Wifi speed was at a reasonable speed.
The only thing that can be improved were the carpet at the TV area. Looks a little old and feels dirty.
The host was very flexible to safe keep our bags after check out and Antonio was friendly and very helpful.
Thank you for the wonderful time.
Highly recommend this team and the place.
Cheers,
Gabriel

Die Gegend ist super zentral. Das Apartment ist wunderschön, mit Blick auf Tejo (sogar vom Bett aus)!
Es hat alles perfekt geklappt und die Betreuung vor Ort war sehr zuvorkommenden!
Einfach SUPER!

This is an oustanding apartment in the heart of Lisbon. Location and views from the balcony are amazing. Pedro and his crew were amazing and extremely helpful with our late arrival (11pm). Coffee, wine, chocolate and fruit on arrival were lovely touches that were greatly appreciated.
Perfect stay! :)

The place is absolutely wonderful - starting with its location (2-3 minutes to Rossio Square, lovely view to Tejo River and St. George Castle) and ending with how the studio is arranged (fresh design, lots of light, well equipped). It was a real pleasure to stay there, as it is a very warm and cosy place - you feel at home. The host is very kind, he waited for us and showed everything around in just a few minutes. The studio has everything one would need: cooking area, living, very comfortable bed. I will certainly keep it in mind for my next visit to Lisbon and also recommend it to everybody!

Tolles Appartement, perfekte Lage !
Vielen Dank !

We were greeted by Pedro's representative, Luis on our arrival, who explained the workings of the apartment and left a nice touch of a complimentary bottle of wine for us. The studio was presented as described in the ad and in fact felt bigger than the pictures allude to. A long, narrow verandah runs around two sides providing great views of the castle and river as well as a great spot for a sunset drink. Bathroom and kitchen facilities were all very adequate and the bathroom was quite new. Laundry facilities are shared with two other studios on the same level, but this was not a problem and a modern machine was provided. The location is excellent being only a short walk to Baixa/Chiado metro, to the Baixa shopping area via the Santa Justa elevator or shank's pony and to Bairro Alto. There is also a pleasant square adjoining the building on the higher side providing easy access to bars and restaurants. We would have no hesitation in recommending this studio for a couple or booking it again if we were to return to Lisbon.
Wonderful location with fantastic view to the river. Very stylish and well equipped apartment. Hosts responded to all enquiries very promptly and efficiently, very professional.
