The listing was exactly as described and we loved the apartment. We were met on time and appreciated the half-bottle of wine and oranges that were provided.

Great accommodation. Great views and well located for exploring Lisbon. The apartment had everything we needed including what seemed like a new bed that made for a good nights sleep and a fantastic shower.
Antonio was a good host and responded promptly to all our queries.
Highly recommend.
Great flat in a lovely part of Lisbon. We had a great time and would recommend. Thanks for the hospitality.
Very nice experience ...very profesionnal
You cannot find a better apartment than this one. Beautiful, clean space in the center of Chiado. Pedro and his team are extremely efficient and helpful. Awesome hosts.

Magnifico studio nel cuore di Lisbona, pulito, con aria condizionata, luminosissimo con un bel balcone con tavolino e sedie per rilassarsi davanti al panorama sul Tejo. Come benvenuto Pedro e il suo team di accoglienza ci hanno fatto trovare una buona bottiglia di rosè in frigo e due cioccolatini con biglietto di ben arrivati. La posizione è ottima, a due passi dal convento del Carmo è accanto a tutte le vie più centrali; all'angolo c'è il supermercato biologico Brio e a tre minuti a piedi si ha la fermata della metro Baixa-Chiado. Il fine settimana può essere un po' rumoroso verso sera, ma basta chiudere le finestre e attivare il condizionatore. Il letto è strategicamente posizionato davanti alla vista sul fiume, molto romantico e comodo.

I spent the weekend in Lisbon with 2 other friends and decided to give Airbnb a try. We were greeted by our charming host on arrival who showed us around the flat and made us feel very welcome. The apartment is excellently located, clean, spacious  and thoughtfully furnished. We spent our evenings chilling over a bottle of wine in the balcony gazing out to Rio Tejo before heading out to dinner. We enjoyed our stay very much and would highly recommend that you check out this place! Love it.

The apartment was even more centrally located than I had thought, just a few short steps to the main road. There's a metro station close by, and the property manager was waiting for us when we arrive, even with a bottle of wine! I would stay here again.

We absolutely loved this place!  It was perfect in every way. We were warmly greeted by Luis who showed us round and gave us restaurant recommendations which turned out to be excellent. The location couldn't have been better as its so central but remarkably quiet as its on the third floor. For us the best bit was the balcony where we had breakfast and sundowners!  Glorious view!  The studio was spotless and equipped to a very high standard with everything you could possibly need. Pedro was so helpful throughout, giving us excellent directions from the airport and responding quickly to any questions we had. This is our first experience of Airbnb ...the bar is now set very high!  Highly recommended! Thank you Pedro.

Stunning!  My girlfriend and I just spent 2 fantastic nights at this amazing apartment, and loved everything about it.  The place is super-charming, as it's renovated with everything you could ask for -- and more.  The views from the apartment are amazing, with a well placed balcony to make the most out of the experience ;)  The location could not have been better, as it's close to all the places we want to go to.  Finally, Pedro was very engaging, answered all of our questions, and really made us feel welcome.  One of the best AIrBNB places i have ever stayed at! :)

Chiado Studio 111 is one of the best AirBnB places we have stayed in. It is stylish, comfortable and in such a fantastic location to explore Lisbon. The communication with Pedro was excellent and we had a very smooth check in. It is so easy to get from the airport on the metro to the apartment. It was fantastic to have a metro station so close by. The apartment itself is first class. We loved having a welcoming bottle of rosé & chocolates - very thoughtful & welcoming. But what we absolutely loved was the view from our room over the Targus River. It is sensational. We would highly recommend staying at any of Pedro's Chiado apartments but we feel Chiado 111 is very special.

The most amazing apartment with the most amazing view!! The location is also pretty fantastic- close to shopping and lots of night life. Would definitely stay in one of Pedro's apartments again when back in Lisboa! Couldn't have asked for a nicer experience.

A super apartment that exactly matched the description. It was comfortable, well equipped and stylishly decorated. The location proved ideal for an exploration of central Lisbon and the position on the top floor of a renovated 18th century town house, accessed by a quaint old fashioned 'cage-style' lift, was very romantic. Great views over the city too and lots of light. Although we didn't meet Pedro, his colleague Antonio met us promptly, showed us the ropes and made us feel immediately at ease. The bottle of Rose was a nice touch and the list of restaurant recommendations provided was very useful. We tried U Chiado (posh but good) and the Mercado da Ribiera, which has a really interesting 'pop-up'restaurant approach - lots of different kitchens round a central dining area in a covered market. Lisbon's well worth a visit and this accommodation would be hard to beat.

Fantastic well-located, comfortable, modern, and stylish flat.  The extremely clever interior design made this modest-size studio seem much larger.  Pedro clearly thought-through everything a traveler might want or need because this accomodation had it all, including an excellent hot/strong shower and ice-cold air conditioning.  We were warmly greeted by Luis with an orientation, complete with dining recommendations and flat instructions.  We so appreciate the care and concern Pedro shows his guests. We would not hesitate to recommend this accomodation to friends and family (and perhaps return again ourselves!)
Molt ben ubicat i bonea vistes. L'apartament està molt net i els mobles i electrodomèstics són nous. És igual que a l'anunci. Tornaria.
What an amazing place and host! Highly recommended.

A beautiful apartment, in a fantastic position. It is well appointed, with everything we could possibly need for our stay, super comfortable bed, everything obviously thoughtfully chosen and arranged. The Chiado district is an ideal location and the apartment is well placed, with shops, restaurants and bars, public transport and popular attractions like the archeological museum just a short walk from the apartment. And the view is spectacular! Great communication with the owners, and it was a pleasure to meet Antonio at check-in. We honestly couldn't have asked for more.

The host was wonderful and there to meet us on arrival, even though we were very early.
The location was superb - right in the heart of everything. The apartment itself was very well thought out and there was nothing missing in term of facilities. We would stay again if we return to Lisbon.
Everything worked fine, from key-handover till we left. Very nice and central flat.
A fantastic location, lovely apartment, helpfull host and an amazing city. Couldn't be better! Wish we stayed longer.. Next time!

Great apartment, the location is terrific, the apartment is well-appointed and is very bright. The balcony was a nice thing to have, and the view of the river over the roofs was breathtaking. The city is right outside the door. Pedro was a great host.
Perfect! Antonio was super helpful in setting us up, and the apartment could not have been nicer. And, great location!

António very kindly waited for us when we arrived later than expected & was very helpful & booked us a taxi for our 5am (!) departure. The place itself was amazing! Really tastefully decorated, in the most central location (but very quiet as on the 3rd floor), and had stunning views out over the river! Would most definitely recommend!

Antonio met us to receive us, punctually, despite our flight being late. The apartment is ABSOLUTELY GORGEOUS, with a view of the Tagus river bank and Praca cu commercio from the bed/balcony. The apartment is extremely tastefully decorated, in a gorgeous, old building complete with old-fashioned elevator. Very comfortable with all the necessary amenities. Very close to the downtown area. shopping, bars, train stations and main sights.
The sweetest touch was a hand written letter and two chocolates for us, left by Pedro and team. Pedro was very responsive and answered all our questions, including many helpful tips on navigating the neighborhood. He even called us a taxi in the morning for the airport.

Fantastic AirBnB experience. Pedro was responsive on email, and Antonio met us on time. He then showed us to apartment, which is AWESOME, and in a cool and convenient location. In 5 minutes we were checked in, holding the keys to our home in Lisbon. Everything worked as it should (including the air conditioning, which is crucial), and it was spotless when we arrived. Couldn't have been easier or better!

Awesome flat, awesome location and a great  thank you to Pedro who host us with a lot of "petites attentions" we appreciate. For those who want to discover Lisbon in the best conditions just go for it!

Accueil d'Antonio très apprécié,  il donne des informations claires et précises.  L'appartement est superbe, propre, calme et bien équipé. Séjour merveilleux ! Tout est proche ! Seul hic, les échafaudages qui cachaient la vue magnifique mais les travaux doivent se faire....! Merci Pedro, à recommander!  Yves

We stayed at Chiado Studio III two times while we were in Portugal.  Both times they were extremely accommodating with our arrival times.  The studio is even more amazing than it looks on Airbnb.  Antonio has done a great job with the decorating and layout of the place and it is super clean.  The neighborhood is great.  Could go on and on but suffice it to say if you're considering an amazing place in Lisbon this is it.
A beautiful apartment in a prime location with a wonderful view from the balcony. Most of all is the instant respond that I got from Pedro whenever I needed help with my stay..thanks Pedro

We had a really nice stay in Lisbon.
The flat - quite central - is cosy and similar to the description.
Pedro and Antonio are welcoming and accomadating...
No reason not to be back !

El apto es tal cual se ve en las fotos. Muy bien decorado, luminoso, linda vista desde uno de ellos. La cama es muy comoda, sábanas y toallas impecables. Bien equipado. Pedro es muy eficiente y amable. Las indicaciones que nos dejó sobre restaurantes y bares fueron excelentes. Los detalles de bienvenida, como la botella de vino, capsu las de cafe, bombones y naranjas para el desayuno, se agradecen. Otro tema importante para nosotros fue la ubicacion, mejor imposible, cerca de todo y zona lindisima. Hasta ahora es el mejor que alquilamos. Gracias Pedro.

Pedro did an amazing job of making the apartment feel like our home for the three days we were there. He greeted us and gave us a ton of great advice on places to go out and have meals. When we mentioned we were going on a day trip outside the city, he also sent us recommendations for where we were going. He was really accommodating and friendly, and put us at ease right away.

The apartment itself has everything you need. It was incredibly clean with beautiful views and is so well-situated in the city of Lisbon without being noisy. It was really easy for us to get to all the things we wanted to see -- it's walking distance from a lot of the older parts of the city, many restaurants and bars, and the riverfront, plus there's a subway station a block away and a parking lot around the corner.

Long story short -- I definitely would recommend this apartment for anyone traveling to Lisbon.

Nous avons passé un très  agréable séjour dans l'appartement. Nous avons été sensibles à toutes les petites attentions laissées par l'équipe pour notre accueil (les chocolats, les confitures, les oranges, le petit savon au lait d'ânesse et même la bouteille de vin blanc portugais pour nous dédommager de la vue sur le Tage encombrée par un échafaudage). Malgré le travail des artisans très discrets, appartement très calme, très bien placé, décoration et rénovation très soignée. L'emménagement s'est très bien passé dans les conditions prévues avec Pedro et Antonio très sympathique et prévenant. Des idées de restos testés et appréciés. A recommander absolument!

Thanks so much for sharing your apartment with us. Meet on arrival to a fresh clean and well thought out space. Close to everything you can walk to all the major sights and beyond and what a beautiful place Lisbon is.
Excellent. Perfect. Brilliant. Thanks!

Pedro is very gentle and his apartment is very nice and clean! It's in a perfect position, 2 minutes by walk to Baixa-Chiado Metro and you can arrive to Praca do Comercio in 10 minutes! Pedro also gave us a list about what to do in the city and we followed most of them!

This apartment was perfect for our needs.
Fantastic view, big comfy bed, good shower, great location, smooth communications with owners & exciting lift!
Very many thanks. We had a great time.

El anfitrión estuvo en en todos los detalles. Nos recibió Antonio a pesar de haber tenido problemas de tráfico para llegar en hora.
Nos explico amablemente el uso del apartamento y nos dio tips muy utiles para disfrutar la hermosa ciudad de Lisboa.
Toda la información de bares, restaurantes, lugares a visitar estaba impresa en inglés, con una breve expicación. Además nos suministro mapas de la ciudad.
Detalles como café en capsulas, mermelada y una tarjeta de recibimiento hicieron más calida la estadia.
OTROS DETALLES MUY IMPORTANTES:
- Estuvimos en pascuas y fueron especialmente a regalarnos una rosca típica
- Tuvimos que hacer late check out porque nuetro vuelo salia en la tarde y no tuvieron problema en otorgarlo sin costo adicional.

Fantastic host! Amazing apartment with great views. I had a great stay here. Apartment was clean laundry, I well decorated and comes with everything you need for a great stay, the nespresso machine was a welcomed suprise.
Located very centrally and a stones throw away from some great bakeries and shops.
Just book you won't regret it!!

Fantastic apartment -- everything exactly as pictured, and the hosts were attentive to our needs and made our week-long stay in Lisbon an enjoyable experience. The apartment is centrally located, within easy walking distance to the metro, train station, terrific restaurants and shopping. We would definitely like to stay here again on our next visit to Lisbon. Five stars!

Tout était juste parfait et identique à ce qu'on attendait. Antonio était présent à l'endroit de rdv et nous a bien expliqué tout ce dont nous avions besoin de savoir. De plus il était très sympathique et serviable. Vraiment une chambre juste parfaite pour un séjour parfait:-)

Wonderful all-around Lisbon experience.  The communication and meeting with Pedro and team to arrange and access the apartment were extremely easy.  The apartment itself was exactly as pictured--a very clean, charming and well-designed/renovated flat in an older building with great views over the rooftops out to the harbor and even up to the castle above the city.  The apartment location is perfect--in the middle of the Chiado shopping and restaurant district, just down the hill from the Bairro Alto restaurants and bars, and easy walking distance to the main Lisbon sights, metro and train stations, etc.  Pedro and team had restaurant and other activity recommendations ready and waiting, and were very friendly and welcoming.  I had a great time on a 4-day trip and would stay there again in a heartbeat--thanks so much!

Our host met us upon arrival in the apartment and we found all according to the add, well-equipped and in perfect and very clean condition. It is a very comfortable light and spacious studio with amazing views on the castle and Tago, including a lovely balcony for a sunny breakfast. Location is very good, close to the subway and the lively and busy Chiado and Bairo Alto. However the place is very quiet.
For us a definite recommendation.

We had a lovely stay at Chiado Studio III for a week. The location is fantastic. It is perfectly situated for urban explorations in Lisbon. Adjacent to the building there is a lovely outdoor square, an organic grocery store, and a variety of restaurants and cafes. It is 2 blocks walking from the metro. The Baixa and Bairra Alto neighborhoods are also within easy walking distance.

The flat itself is beautiful and light. The views to the river and surrounding neighborhoods are stunning. We had the terrace doors open every morning and night, letting in the breeze. The bed is big and comfortable. The kitchen area is small, but has everything you need to make a full dinner. There is a nespresso machine (and nespresso store also right around the corner). There is a shared laundry facility on the same floor.

Pedro and António are running a very well organized operation in Lisbon. They are friendly, efficient, patient, and easy to get in touch with. This is what AirBnB is all about. We'll be back.

We really enjoyed staying at Pedro’s apartment. It is beautifully furnished, very well equipped, centrally located, close to metro and all the major Lisbon attractions. We loved the view from the balcony  - perfect place for a morning coffee. Pedro was a great host and explained everything very well. It is perfect place to stay in Lisbon!

Communication with Pedro was really easy & we were able to check in directly after arriving. The studio apartment was delightful, exactly as the pictures showed & had everything we needed for our stay. It was in a very central location & easy to get to all the sights. Being on the 3rd floor it had beautiful views over the rooftops of the Tagus from the little balcony & there was a lift. There was a small supermarket across the road & plenty of lovely eating places nearby. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend it to anyone.

Really nice appartment, spacious and bright, on the top floor of a building right in the centre (Chiado), with a balcony where you can have breakfast in the sun, looking over the city and the river. I definitely recommend it!
We went back a second time and it was just as lovely as the first! Great view, great room, great host. Highly recommend.

Tanto pedro como Antonio, que fue a quien conocimos personalmente, fueron realmente muy amables, atentos y serviciales con nosotros. Al llegar a su apartamento Antonio ya nos estaba esperando, nos brindó información muy útil sobre Lisboa y nos facilitó un mapa de la Ciudad. Su casa es tal cual se muestra en las fotos. Muy linda, ordenada, limpia y cálida. Nos mantuvimos comunicados con él y con Pedro durante la estadía. No hubo ningún tipo de inconveniente. Fueron muy flexibles con el check in y chek out ,acorde a los horarios que a nosotros nos venían mejor. Asimismo, la ubicación del apartamento es inmejorable, muy cerca de los lugares más bellos y concurridos de lisboa, dispuesto en un edificio antiguo que es hermoso también. Realmente la pasamos muy bien, nos sentimos muy cómodos, en un ambiente muy confortable. Lo recomendamos cien por ciento!! Muchas gracias, Pedro! Muchas gracias, Antonio! Ma. Eugenia y Ruben.

From the moment we arrived at the apartment ( with very easy directions from the airport provided by Pedro)  we were shocked at how lovely it was, the pictures don't do it justice! The balcony is a beautiful feature to this apartment, especially when the sun is shining! Everything you might need is thought about, and the little touches really make that difference. The apartment is right in the heart of everything too- shops and cafes very close by and everything in walking distance. we couldn't have asked for a better place to enjoy Lisbon for the first time. Thanks a lot for such a perfect trip!
This was a wonderful experience. The apartment was perfect. It is centrally located and beautifully furnished with good taste and functionality. Thank you! I will recommend in in the future.

We loved our stay at Pedro Studio. It was awesome! Spacious, comfortable and everything there to feel at home. We enjoyed every single moment. Thanks Pedro and Antonio for your help and all informations you had us given. We hope to come back next year and strongly recommend Pedro place!!!
OBRIGADO

The location of the apartment was extremely convenient. The apartment itself was very clean and had everything we need. The balcony was an added bonus. The host was also very accommodating so all in all, a fantastic stay in Lisbon. Will definitely be back!! (..and obviously, I would totally recommend Pedro's place)

Amazing stay! This place has everything - location could not be more perfect, the building has an elevator, beautiful view from the balcony. The apartment has lots of amenities, including access to a washing machine. Pedro and Antonio were great hosts - welcomed us, explained how everything worked, and gave us some good tips for dinner options. We couldn't have been more pleased. What a find!

My girlfriend and I spent 3 nights over Christmas at the Chiado studio and we had nothing short of a 5-star experience. Pedro's professionalism was first class and he made the check-in/check-out process extremely easy and comfortable. The apartment itself is absolutely spectacular - extremely clean, well designed and layed out, plenty of naturally light, and views that the pictures don't do justice to. By far the best Airbnb experience I have had and I will definitely be back!

We very much enjoyed staying at Pedro's studio.  The location is perfect - right in the heart of the Chiado district with a short walk to the Bairro Alto and Baixa.  The metro and trams stops are also nearby so getting anywhere in Lisbon is very straightforward.  We will definitely be back!

The apartament is very well located, with all appliances working and completely amazing. The view to the river is fantastic, you can have your breakfast on the balcony, huge windows, good bed, nice couch... everything is perfect! Thank you Pedro and Antonio for the nice time in beautiful Lisboa.

Pedro did everything we could wish for to make the arrival and stay comfortable. The location of the apartment is perfect! As well as the facilities and furniture in it. I can recommend this place to everybody interested in having a great week(end) in Lisboa!

Es war fantastisch. Ein sehr liebevoll gestaltetes Appartment mit vielen tollen Details und vielen wohlfühlfaktoren - angefangen mit der Nespresso maschine bis hin zu tollen Tips - kulturell und kulinarisch. Und die aussicht ist umwerfend. Vielen Dank Pedro und Antonio für alles. Werden gerne wieder kommen.

Great place and location! Directions to the apartment were clear and Antonio was kind enough to check us in early. Waking up to a view of the sea was fantastic and I would highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Lisbon.

My parents stayed for 4 nights in Piedro's flat and had a fantastic time.
The house is beautiful and in a great location. The furnishings, the kitchen, the bathroom, everything is pretty much flawless and made them feel very comfortable. Especially the balcony provided a great view over the city, until the ocean and is the perfect spot for sunny afternoons. Even though it was a bit rainy they did not feel stuck inside since there are nice shops, restaurants and cafes in immediate proximity. The host is very friendly and was perfectly on time, so there were no problems for the check-in. In conclusion, my parents would love to come back and highly recommend Piedro's apartment and him as a host!

Immaculate studio in an excellent location.  Pedro was incredibly responsive and helpful, and Antonio showed us the unit and answered our questions.  We loved the beautiful views, and found the apartment perfectly sized and equipped for our needs.  The attention to detail was also appreciated, from decor to providing nespresso pods.  Highly recommended.

Pedro and his teammates were friendly and super helpful. We loved the appartment, well designed interesting space with lots of little details taken care of to make us feel really comfortable. I'd definitely recommend this place if in Lisbon!

We spent two really nice days in this amazing apartment. It is as you can see in the pictures, with a great view on the river and the castle. The flat is also fully equipped, with kitchen, in case you want to cook at home. Moreover, the location is perfect, few minutes walking from Baixa - Chiado metro station and from the historic Cafe Brasileira. The host was really nice and helpful..so I strongly reccomend to choose this accomodation in case you want to spend some days in Lisbon!

Our stay at the flat in Lisbon was perfect.  The reviews are correct that the pictures don't do it justice!  The view from the balcony is stunning, the bed was super comfy and the location is perfect.  I can't imagine a better place to stay in Lisbon

WOW! This is an airbnb-experience that we will never forget. The views from the apartment are breathtaking. Tejo on the one side, Castelo Sao Jorge on the other side. When we had breakfast on the balcony one sunny morning we felt like kings of Lisbon, the view of Tejo river was just magnificent.
Pedro and Antonio know how to host. They take care of every small detail and you know how important theses small details are. Everything - and I mean everything - worked out perfectly. Perfect WiFi, water that stays as warm as you like it to be, a really comfy mattress for a good night's rest, kitchen appliances that are of highest quality, a functioning elevator and and and. Last but not least the design of the apartment is incredible.
Do not hesitate to book this one, it is an absolute highlight and we will definitely come back for more views!
Super Appartment! Wir waren das 2. Mal da. Toller Ausblick auf den Tejo. Ich kann das Appartment nur empfehlen.

Perfektes Apartment für einen Städtetrip nach Lissabon für 2 Personen.

Great communication before and during the trip. We dealt with Pedro over email and Antonio once we were there and both were very helpful and accomodating. The street is a little hard to find, so do  your research on the area prior to your travel. Apartment is just as described, views are great, walkable to all major city attractions. Very lively square nearby and be prepared to walk... it is truly a city of seven hills. The elevator wasn't working one day during our stay, but the hosts made sure it was fixed in a timely manner. We had a wonderful stay overall.
Cool apartment, exactly as described, in the very center of Lisbon. Our host sent a friend of his to check us in, we had a late train and he could manage, everything felt great! :-)

We stayed here on our last part of our honeymoon and couldn't have been more impressed. This pictures do not even do justice of how beautiful this flat is. The bed was so comfortable. We stayed in Pedro's apartment during two nights and absolutely loved the place. The location is as central as it gets, in a nice area with plenty of dining and shopping options nearby, as well as bus stops and train stations to travel around.

The building is old but in good condition, and will put you straight in the local mood. The apartment is fantastic, and frankly the photos do not do it justice. The view is exceptional and you can eat breakfast on the balcony if it is sunny. The bed is very comfortable. There is a washing machine available.

We would definitely recommend this place.

AMAZING place! Absolutely gorgeous with a stunning view. We loved our time here. Every detail during our stay was perfect. The hosts were gracious and easy to connect and communicate with and left a great list of recommendations of places to eat. Would love the opportunity to stay here again!

Lovely lovely place. Cab driver dropped us off and sent us in the totally opposite direction, but we managed to find the place in the end. And boy was the location amazing! Right in the centre of everything. Apartment was very clean and Antonio was there to receive us with a smile.

A great host
Great location, cozy house, there is even elevator in the house.
supermarket and cafe just opposite the building and with less than 100 m walking distance you will find an amazing collection of restaurants

We were extremely happy with our brief stay in this charming Lisbon apartment.

The apartment is just as described. Superbly positioned in Lisbon, close to shopping, resaurants and the sights. It was clean and well appointed. I especially appreciated the Nespresso machine, for the first coffee of the day. The view to the river from the bed was beautiful.

For our first time in Lisbon and our first stay with Airbnb we couldn't have asked for more. Many thanks. I would have no hestitation to recommend any friend to stay in this apartment

Many thanks

Lovely apartment, nice views over city & river, huge choice of bars & restaurants close by. Beautiful apartment in a wonderful location. Was exactly as described and ticked all the boxes for a stay in Lisbon. Would certainly return.

On a été enchanté par l'appartement, très fidèle aux photos, super
propre, avec une vue inoubliable sur le fleuve; c'est vrai que l'immeuble est très ancien, mais l'appart est complètement rénové et le quartier du chiado est très bien situé. Nous avons beaucoup apprécié nos 5 jours à Lisbonne dans le Chiado Studio III et encore merci!
Manon et Michel

Lisbon was great! We will definitely be back to this country, the city, and this apartment. We really loved drinking wine on the balcony while enjoying the view.

Host- Pedro and team were very responsive and professional. They made the experience painless and easy.

Listing Description- Apartment looks beautiful as pictured. The view was even better! We found everything we needed was provided. Good for three people as the couch is extra long.

Only cons were that our internet sometimes didn't work and we had to go outside the apartment to get a signal. However, we were not in the apartment very often so this didn't really impact us enough to contact Pedro to fix. The AC blew very cold during the afternoon but not cold all night even when set at the same temperature. These things are easy fixes that will probably be address by the team after this post.

Wonderful place. All the modern amenities needed, great host, and beautiful view. They were kind enough to wait for our late arrival and offered excellent directions to and from. Will book again if available. Great value!

Das Appartement ist großartig! Es ist wunderschön eingerichtet und sehr sauber, hat einen unvergesslichen Blick auf den Tejo und ist perfekt gelegen um Lissabon zu Fuß zu erkunden. Très agréable séjour dans cet appartement moderne avec un balcon avec un superbe vue. Idéal pour visiter Lisbonne. Notre hôte est très accueillant: fruits, café et petit chocolat à notre arrivée! Je recommande +++ cet appart!

We were in Lisbon last week and there were three, the accommodation choice and 'proved an absolute winner for the beauty and hospitality, the view bellisdima, cleaning, and for the steategica-affirmation in the elegant Chiado that allows you to reach in a short time (even on foot) the charms of Lisbon. Thank you so much!! Such a beautiful  place. Pedro and Antonio were lovely and helpful. The apartment is stunning. The view is extraordinary. I loved every minute of being there.

Le studio est très bien situé. Il est bien équipé et aménagé avec goût.
Je recommande cet appartement.

The Studio is beautifully designed and provides a comfortable functional and lovely place to stay. Excelentes instalações e localização!!!! Recomendadíssimo!!!

How many stars are reflected in the Tagus on a moonless night? We wish we could go back tomorrow.

We had an amazing stay at the Chiado Apartment and were sad to leave!!

We stayed in Lisbon for 3 nights and chose Chiado because of its great location. It was absolutely perfect - Right in the centre of Lisbon and just a 2 minutes walk from the train station. Everything was in walking distance and some cool bars and restaurants seemed just a few minutes away. It was quiet and a little supermarket just around the corner where you can buy all the food/ drinks essentials.

The apartment was clean, spacious, tidy, plus a cute balcony with a great view over the city and sea! It has a little kitchen area with all essential, plus a Nespresso coffee mashine which was a nice 'extra'.

We definitely recommend this apartment and would book it again for our next Lisbon visit.

All the best,
Nicky and Mark (from London)

Millions of thanks Pedro, your Place really was amazing and made our trip perfect :D We both are still overwhelmed by decor,  location, your friendliness and absolutely everything. We can warmly recommend your place! Big thanks and greetings from Helsinki :)

Myself and my partner have just returned from a fantastic 4 night stay in Lisbon and we couldn't have asked for more from this great apartment! Ideally located and beautifully furnished, we were so happy with our choice and would definitely stay here again if we return to Lisbon, which we 're hoping to in the near future since we had such a great time. Antonio was there to meet us when we arrived and was extremely helpful in answering our questions. Thanks Pedro and team!

This was the a perfect flat in the most perfect location in Lisbon.  The flat was very modern and spotlessly clean, with every comfort we needed AND the view was just fantastic. I would happily recommend your place to anyone.

Stayed here for 4 days and had a lovely time. Great location, just next to a beautiful square. Easy access to lots of great restaurants. Incredibly balcony with a view out to the Tagus. Antonio, who met us on arrival, was really helpful and gave us some good tips on places to eat and visit.
The flat was clean and nicely decorated. And the perfect size.
I will be recommending this flat to friends and family!

Antonio met us at the apartment.  He shows us around the apartment and what we needed to know while staying and also what to do when we left.  The apartment was well equipped with everything we needed for our 1 week stay.  It is well situated near the Biaxa-Chiado metro and close to shopping and restaurants.  We loved our stay in the apartment.  It made us feel like we were part of the city, not just visitors.  There is a grocery store across the street and excellent restaurants close by.  There was a list of recommended sites and restaurants in the apartment.  There is a common washer available in the building which was perfect for us.  We had a couple of questions during our stay and Pedro was quick to respond to us.  Thank you for such a wonderful stay.  If I was staying in Lisbon again, I would highly recommend staying here.

This apartment is lovely, well-appointed, and the views from the multiple balconies are stunning. Pedro's Chiado flat is wonderful!  Antonio was there waiting for us even though our flight was delayed.  The flat was clean, nicely decorated and in a perfectly central location. A gem for sure

Chiado Studio lll lived up to its name in every way.  It was truly an amazing place.  It is beautifully decorated, very clean, well-equipped, in a perfect location, and the views from the balcony are breathtaking. Antonio met us at the metro and showed us the easiest route to the building and gave us an orientation to the apartment. We were provided with complimentary coffee, jam, oranges and chocolates.  I would highly recommend this "amazing place" to anyone who plans a visit to Lisbon.  We would definitely stay here again.

Appartement très agréable, bien décoré, facile à vivre et calme. Prendre un café sur le balcon en profitant de la vue sur les toits et le Tage est un délice. Bonne situation dans un quartier agréable.
Geweldig appertement, goede gelegen en mooi uitzicht. Een aanrader!

Studio muito bem localizado, confortável e bem equipado. Muito bom gosto.

L'appartement et l'accueil sont irreprochables ! La situation dans la ville est ideale : au calme tout en etant en centre ville. L'appartement est tres agreable, proprete impeccable, deco soignee. A recommander.

We stayed for 4 nights in Pedro's apartment and it was great. Like all the postitive reviews we had read previously, we can only report positive things, too. The apartment has a very good central location, yet is pleasantly quiet. It was newly renovated and is very comfortably furnished. We immediately felt at home. Pedro was right there when we arrived and showed us everything in detail. His tips on attractions, restaurants and cafes were very helpful. The view from the balcony is wonderful. All in all, we had a few great days in Lisbon. We will come back and if so, definitely to Pedro apartment. Thanks for everything.

At Pedro's place you get value for money. Beautiful river-view, all the lights of the port shine up in front of you at night, you can step out to the balcony and Barcelona is just at your feet. It's amazing.
This apartment is great, beautiful views, perfect location, super clean, well run.

My wife and I stayed in Pedro's studio 3 in Chiado, and could not have dreamed of a better home away from home. The studio is on the third floor of a perfectly located old building, and affords great views of the neighborhood & city beyond. The character of the old building has been maintained (from the tiled stairwell with an old lift at its center, to the wide plank wood floors, huge windows with their wooden shutters intact, and high ceilings in the studio), but with a well-planned modern upgrade (marble tiled bathroom with a great shower, double-glazed glass in those big windows keeping the flat cozy and quiet, and the perfect little kitchen complete with dishwasher and an espresso maker! ).
We felt right at home in the flat, but given that Lisbon has so much to offer right in the Chiado neighborhood or via short walk, tram/metro/train ride away we got to take in so much of this beautiful city. Incredible restaurants, shopping (clothes, shoes, gifts), beautiful architecture, and stunning vistas are all right there at the doorstep.
Pedro (& António who checked us in and out) is a gracious and accommodating host, he really has though of everything needed to offer his guests a comfortable stay in Lisbon. Pedro and his team are ready with recommendations for good food and must-see parts of the city, and that's the best part of the Air bnb experience: the local tips!
Don't bother looking elsewhere, if studio 3 is too cozy for you, he has three other flats in the same building! We're coming back to Lisbon and want to stay here again.
Thank you Pedro!

Super cool studio! Right in the city center and metro stations on walking distance. Also supermarkets and lots of bars and restaurants very close to the studio. The owners are super friendly and helpful! We definately recommend this studio!!!

My wife and I stayed at this studio during a four-night visit to Lisbon.

The pictures of this apartment do not do it justice: commanding view of the water and surrounding neighborhood. Antonio was waiting for us when we arrived, and check-in was a breeze. And Pedro was super-responsive to all of our pre-arrival queries. Would definitely stay here again if the opportunity arose!
Un studio vraiment très agréable, tout à fait conforme aux photos, très bien placé avec très gentil accueil.
This studio apartment was in a perfect location, perfectly appointed with a beautiful view.  It is highly recommended!

i love Lisbon, i visit every year , i appreciate very much the atmosphere of the city , the people , the food, the beautiful light

this studio is just perfect , close to my friends and to everything

We love the place, the location and the team who manages the apartment. The place is as good as the description and it's clean. We also appreciate the early check-in, so we were able to get a nap after a long journey with a toddler. We had a small incident during our stay, and  the team responded as fast as they could. We found ourselves not being able to open the gate with a very silly reason (our fault).

Pedro's place is awesome!  From the moment we were greeted by Antonio and during our 5 days in Lisbon we loved our stay.  This place looks exactly like it is shown on the site.  The view from the front window is of the Tagus River and you can see the Castle of Saint George from the side window.  Pedro spared no expense to decorate this condo, all the appliances and furnishings must have come from designer stores.  Chiado is where you want to be with dozens of restaurants and shops nearby.  The Carmo Square is just outside your door and there are many great restaurants here.  There is a specialty grocery store across the street and a larger grocery store just a couple of blocks away.  The double bed was very comfortable, the feather pillows and comforter were a bonus.  There was a large TV had many English language stations.  The small kitchenette included a kettle, a coffee maker, wine glasses, and we were welcomed with chocolates, a few coffee pods and bowl of oranges.  Our visit was in January when nights got chilly so we appreciated the three radiators.  The WiFi worked perfectly.  We would plan our next trip to Lisbon only around the dates this condo is available!

Just had a terrific week-end in this amazing flat!

The location was perfect: located in the city center nearby nice and animated streets (Rua Garett). Its a 5/10 min walk to get to Praça do Comercio one of Lisbon's main square.

The studio had great furniture & a really nice bathroom!

It was a great stay. The location was absolute perfect - central and easy to get around. The apartment was clean, cosy and well maintained. Wall was slightly thin so could hear noises from next door but was not a big problem. Would definitely recommend! Pedro was very prompt in responding to emails and messages so it really helped having peace of mind.

Ótima localização junto ao Chiado, próximo de uma infinidade de meios de transporte, de ótimos cafés e bares a serem visitados, além do próprio shopping Armazéns do Chiado. Com certeza é um local que reservaria novamente, especialmente pela amplitude das comodidades fornecidas no apartamento e nos arredores de onde está localizado.

We would definitely recommend this apartment. The location is perfect - a quiet street in a great neighbourhood, with loads of restaurants in surrounding streets and just a short walk to Barrio Alto for going out. The apartment looks exactly like it does in the pictures, including the amazing view from the balcony. And the apartment had everything we needed, including nespresso capsules for the morning and perfect internet access. Pedro and Antonio were excellent hosts.

Prendre le petit déjeuner sur un balcon face à la mer, rien de mieux ! Ce studio est un vrai cocon, en plein centre de lisbonne, proche des transports et du quartier festif. Silencieux, confortable, très bien décoré. Tout était parfait. Un grand merci à l'équipe du Chiado Studio.

Chiado Studio III Amazing Place is a great apartment!  It's in the perfect location for getting around Lisbon (both by foot and by public transportation) and has the most amazing views! The windows have shutters that block out all light and noise, making the apartment a great place to sleep.  We especially appreciated Pedro and Antonio stocking the apartment with nespresso, oranges, and jam!  If we return to Lisbon we would definitely stay here again.
The perfect place to stay in Lisbon. We had a great time. The appartment is beautiful and very good located in the center of the city. Amazing place!

This apartment really was great, looked just like the pictures and the view was fantastic. It is on the corner of the building which meant we had a balcony running around both sides of the apartment. As it was my boyfriends birthday that we were celebrating, I had contacted the host to ask if there was any way to arrange some champagne in the room on arrival. Couldn't have asked for better, very happy.

The location of the flat is ideal to get around in Lisbon both by foot, and metro..
The flat is very cosy. Each morning (November) we had our breakfast at the balcony with a view over the sea. It was marvellous.
We can only recommand for two persons to book a stay in Pedro's flat

This is a great apartment in a perfect location! Pedro was always available and responsive when I had any questions before arriving and was there to meet us on our arrival. Amazing place!! You cannot wish for a better location, and the view from the apartment was the cherry on the cake! You see it from the bed! Perfect for a romantic weekend ;)
We arrived a bit late but Antonio has been waiting for us and he was very welcoming. Many thanks to the Chiado Team!

We love and Enjoyed Stay with This Appartement, very central location and amazing place to explore the city! I Love the design of this appartement, and The View is very Stunning. Very Clean appartement and provide you with modern things. Very Clean and well cool designed!
Pedro and Antonio very nice and very helpfull with good comunication. Everything is PERFECT!! ! 100% you are gonna LOVE it!! Obrigado :)
Flat was spacious, bright and airy. Perfectly located, right in the centre. We really enjoyed our stay.

This wonderful corner unit apartment was bright and clean and had beautiful balcony views of the city. It was nicely furnished and was true to what the pictures showed. The window shutters and curtains effectively blocked out the light at night and sounds from the streets were minimal.

The apartment is located within walking distance to restaurants, transportation and more. There is a grocery store right across the street.

Pedro met us at the apartment as scheduled and all our correspondence with him was easy and quick. There was useful information in the apartment, as well as fresh oranges and coffee for our use. They were nice, welcoming touches and we'd be happy to stay here again, or recommend it to others.

We loved this apartment! It was decorated very tastefully, had all the amenities needed and it had a lot of charm! The location was so convenient. Antonio met us and was very friendly and helpful. We would stay here again without hesitation and would recommend it to others wanting to stay in this neighborhood!
A very nice and comfortably appointed apartment in Chiado. Suitable for a couple who enjoy the amenity of easy access to restaurants etc.

My mum and I stayed at the Chiado Studio III and it truly is Amazing! The apartment is beautifully decorated with the best of everything from the interior design to the kitchen equipment. La stanza da bagno vanta un box doccia in cristallo molto grande. La location è perfetta per visitare i maggiori punti di interesse di Lisbona. A piedi o con i caratteristici tram che passano a poche centinaia di metri dalla porta di casa si possono raggiungere in pochi minuti le più belle attrattive della città. Chado è inoltre un'area molto elegante e ricca di ristoranti, caffè e ottimi negozi. Consiglio vivamente questo appartamento.

Todo perfecto!!! Repetiría sin duda y se lo recomendaria a cualquiera!!! Empezando por la localización, ideal para visitar la ciudad, hasta la decoración del apartamento, el trato de Pedro y Antonio (nos guardaron las maletas el tiempo que nos hizo falta, nos recomendaron restaurantes geniales), no se puede pedir más! Fue una estancia perfecta. Gracias!!!!!!!!!

Самые прекрасные аппартамены на нашем пути. Прекрасный вид на город, отличная естественная вентиляция (окна на 2 стороны)

Amazing apartment, pictures are true to the stunning pieces you are surrounded by combined with spectacular views. Highly recommend staying here right in the thick of the action of Lisbon. And yet, its not noisy. Stay here when heading to Lisbon.

a happy traveller, Jane
Perfect location, stunning decoration and full equipment. The appartment is a small jewel perfect for a few days of relax in the center of Chiado,

Great location in the very middle of Chiado, two terraces with great view to river Tejo (Tagus). Metro station in the vicinity, major points of interest in walking distance. Good bathroom, and everything is clean. To put it simply, the apartment is superb in every possible way!
It's important to note that it is located in the downtown of a major city with vibrant life day and night, and the sound levels are appropriate to that, especially with the windows open.
gorgeous building, apartment, design, view, praca. couldn't have asked for a better place to stay. the only problem is that i don't live in this apartment full time! ;)

Perfect place for two with stunning balcony! I stayed with my girlfriend in Pedro's apartment for 5 days and we really had a great time - everything was just perfect! Pedro and his team are very very nice and helpful. Everything was perfectly arranged in the minutest details! There was even a small personal card waiting for us in the apartment. Moreover, the apartment is not only super stylish but also completely equipped with everything you can imagine and possible need - from automatic orange squeezer to special fish knifes. Highlight of the apartment definitely is the king size bed with view over the roofs of Lisbon to the Tejo! We really enjoyed our breakfasts at sunrise and the romantic dinners at sunset on the balcony! Furthermore, the extremely high walls, the old fashioned stair case and the architecture of the building itself were wonderful! The apartment is located in a very beautiful and atmospheric quarter in the centre of Lisbon with everything you may need close by. To conclude: An absolute recommendation!!!
Amazing tastefully decorated apartment in an amazing location with an amazing view. I can't fault it at all !

This place is FANTASTIC!  It is in a cute elevator building which made moving luggage easy. The pictures do not do it justice - the balcony has an incredible view of the city and water.  The bed is very comfortable, kitchen is great, and shower is incredible!!  Antonio met us to let our bags in, and was very pleasant!   The apt is 2 mins away from the Baixa/Chiado station which is very convenient.  It is in a very hopping area with lots of restaurants/cafes/stores.  The Lago do Carmo (which is the closest square) is a bit quieter with amazing cafes, a major elevator, and easy access to the Rossio station.  Lots of light in the apartment - Eye masks would be good if you want to sleep in.  Would recommend to anyone!!
Super appart ,très bien situé , propre ,calme,mon mari et moi avons y séjourné 6 jours rien a redire je retournerai .

Appartement idéal pour découvrir Lisbonne, extrêmement bien situé, une décoration très agréable, très lumineux et une vue magique sur le Tage! Merci à mes hôtes pour leur gentillesse et leurs petites attentions. Je suis très satisfaite et si je reviens à Lisbonne, ce sera dans cet endroit! Florence

Great flat! Everything was perfect.

What a fantastic apartment! If we had to personally do up our apartment in a certain way, this would be it. This was the best place that we stayed in, in our holiday across Spain and Portugal.

Everyting was so exquisitely detailed in this apartment - be it the ultra-modern look and feel (big round mirrors in the living area, extensible lamp) or the thoughtful amenities (juicer, dishwasher). The views were breathtaking - the bay vista, the up-and-down cobbled streets, the churches. The metro was nearby, so were the shopping district, the trendy bars and restaurants (e.g. Bairro Alto is only a 10 minute walk away). The elevator was especially helpful in hauling our heavy bags up and down.

If you're going to Lisbon, then you must stay here. You won't regret it!

'Pantheon' on par with paradise! Pedro's photographically plainly presented pad pairs picture-postcard premises and a perfect panorama - a petit pearl, a parlour of peace on a poetic Pessoa peninsular, picturesquely placed, perfectly positioned. Pure pleasure. Panorama is paramount. Probably part private passion, part proper profession Pedro's personal property project prioritises a palpable Portuguese pedigree. Nous allons commencer par le côté négatif, afin que tout le monde sache à quoi s'attendre : c'est très bruyant ! Les murs sont très fins, si bien qu'on entend tout ce qu'il se passe. Les serrures ont des systèmes à carte, si bien que pour sortir de la chambre, nous sommes obligés de claquer la porte : de quoi réveiller toute l'auberge de jeunesse. Le lit craquait à chaque mouvement d'orteil, ce qui n'était pas très agréable. Impossible de dormir sans bouchons d'oreilles, tous les commentaires disent vrais.
Il y a quand même beaucoup de choses positives : 2 salles de bain partagées à l'étage, qui étaient très propre. La chambre était propre et nos draps et serviettes ont même été changés après 3 nuits.
Conclusion : c'est parfait si vous voulez visiter la ville et avoir un pied à terre pour la nuit. Par contre, n'espérez pas dormir sur vos deux oreilles, le bruit se chargera de vous garder éveillés !
Un conseil pour notre hôte : changez les serrures et isolez les murs !

O apartamento de Lena é muito confortável e bem localizado. Lena foi muito proativa e rápida nas respostas e quando tivemos um pequeno problema na fechadura da porta, ela foi pronta em resolver. Recomendo!

Great little place close to fantastic restaurants. Try Tasquinha da Linha. Excellent food and the service is phenomenal!

The location is generally quiet, despite being right next to Roma-Areeiro station, which makes it really easy to catch a train to Sintra or across the 25 Abril bridge. The metro is an easy 250m walk down the road and from there it is less than 10min from the centre of Lisbon. The apartment is really well laid out, immaculately kept and has everything you would want for a short stay, including a washing machine and iron. It is located on the second floor, but the stairs were fairly straightforward to negotiate even with luggage (there is no lift). Access is via coded entry at both the street level and on the front door. The main bedroom was set out as a double for us (it can be two single beds) and our daughter slept on the comfortable sofa bed in the lounge - there was plenty of bedding provided and it was very easy to change between sofa and bed.
There is no aircon so we left the windows open for a couple of nights which meant we got bitten by a few mosquitoes and got disturbed by some occasional noise from the street (bin men collecting the rubbish in the early hours, someone talking too loud on their mobile, that sort of thing) but once we shut the windows and used the excellent vertical fan provided, it was much quieter. We also kept the window shutters down during the day to keep the apartment cool.
We would have breakfast or early evening beers out on the balcony at the back, where you would occasionally greet other residents.
There is a selection of cafes and restaurants within easy walking distance if you want to eat locally but we generally ate elsewhere or used the local supermarket just before the metro station. We did, however, visit the Italian gelaterie, just up the street, every night - it's excellent and very friendly.

Nous cherchions un logement typique et central pour notre premier séjour à Lisbonne : mission accomplie ! L’appartement d’Alexandre coche toutes les cases. L’appartement est agréable, bien équipé (machine à laver, cafetière à capsules), cependant deux dosettes de bienvenue serait parfait pour démarrer le séjour. Quelques plats pour le four et une manique seraient aussi appréciés. Nous n’avons pas rencontré Alexandre, mais avons dégusté avec plaisir la bouteille de Mateus laissée pour nous !
