Appartamento ben posizionato con check in e check out precisi e flessibili. Hostess disponibili le a venire incontro ad ogni esigenza.
Lavandino troppo piccolo, ed una camera senza finestre, quindi per 4 persone risulta poco agevole.

Appartement correspondant parfaitement à la description.
Très facile d'accès avec la majorité des monuments justes aux alentours donc avec possibilité de tout faire à pied.

Nous avons passé 3 nuits dans l'appartement d'Alexandre.
L'emplacement est idéal, très calme la nuit.
C'est assez atypique d'ouvrir la fenêtre du salon chaque matin et d'y découvrir un nouveau bateau de croisière arrivé dans la nuit.
Alexandre a été très flexible sur l'heure d'arrivée ce qui nous a beaucoup arrangé.
Le logement est propre et conforme à la description.
Nous le recommandons
Comfortable home, good location, so close to the beautiful harbour, main train station is also so close with amazing cafe bakery, grocery store.  Lots of restaurants nearby to choose.  Super host!
very accommodating and responsive we had the best time staying here.
Foi muito boa nossa estadia, Alexandre nos atendeu muito bem , o local do  apto é muito bom , voltarei com certeza.

nous avons passé un très bon séjour chez Alexandre, le logement est bien situé, propre.
nous recommandons sans soucis
Gran ubicación, Alexandre y su equipo son fabulosos anfitriones
Great stay - Alexandre and Bernardo were absolutely fantastic in their communication and recommendations for Lisbon.

Logement conforme aux photos, nous avons bien été accueilli par l’hôte avec une petite bouteille de rosé à l’arrivée.
Le logement comporte une très belle pièce à vivre, ainsi que deux chambres confortables pour dormir.
Il se situe à proximité de la gare et des divers centres d’intérêt à pied.
Si vous venez en voiture, il y a un parking public à 14 € par jour, situé à cinq minutes à pied du logement.
Le logement comporte les accessoires nécessaires.
We had a great stay in Alexandres apartment! Very good location if you want to stay for a few days. Highly recommended!

The apartment was very nice and clean, in a beautiful location and the host was very responsive and friendly. The apartment was clean and spacious enough for 4 people and we had no issues staying there for 4 days. He also gave us a nice booklet with local recommendations and best places to visit in the vicinity.

Beau logement dans un quartier bien situé.
Hôtes, accueillant et amical.
À recommander !
logement très fonctionnel et idéalement situé à proximité des transports en commun
Nous étions déjà venu chez Alexandre .L'emplacement est idéal et central  pour profitez des différents centres d intérêts de Lisbonne .
appartement très bien situé
Muy comodo y amplio el departamento. Quiero destacar la amabilidad de Alexander y Bernardo.

Alexandre (and his friend Bernardo) were great hosts! The apartment was super clean and had everything we needed for a short stay. Beds were comfy and the kitchen was well-equipped. The apartment was also walking distance from really nice shops, cafés, and sightseeing areas. Overall, great stay and we’ll be back!
Tout s'est très bien passé, logement top et bien placé !

Recomendamos alojarse en el apartamento. Fue muy fácil ingresar, ya que Alexandre brindó instrucciones claras y se comunicó con nosotros a menudo. La ubicación es excelente y está cerca de las principales atracciones turísticas. Además, no es necesario subir escaleras para llegar al apartamento desde el metro, qué está muy cerca. Cabe aclarar que el apartamento no cuenta con ascensor y está en un segundo piso, pero para nosotros no fue un inconveniente. Es un apartamento luminoso y con espacios amplios, especialmente el comedor. Tuvimos una muy buena experiencia.

L'appartement est très bien situé car il se trouve très proche du centre d'Alfama et le centre de Lisbonne est accessible à pied également, 5-10 minutes de marches.
De plus, l'appartement possède de grandes pièces avec une petite épicerie au pied de l'immeuble qui est très utile.

Très bon séjour entre amis.
Je recommande cette adresse pour aller visiter Lisbonne.

Appartement très bien situé et facile d'accès. Certains accessoires supplémentaires seraient utiles pour un accueil touristique.
Message de l'hôte précis et agréable.
Avons passé un agréable séjour sur Lisbonne.
Beautiful place! Alexandre was very helpful.
Foi ótimo.

We really enjoyed our stay here! The host was very flexible with the check in time and met me at the apartment when it was time to check in! They are very attentive! The apartment was a great location!

Alexandre ha sido muy comunicativo desde que hice la reserva. Explicándome paso a paso, cómo iba a ser la gestión del apartamento. Como mi llegada se retrasó por motivos de tráfico en carretera, nos facilitó el contacto de su amigo Bernardo. Pues Alexandre no estaría a mi llegada. Y así, nos facilitó nuestra entrada al apartamento. Estoy agradecida a la paciencia con mi retraso, tanto con Alexandre y Bernardo.
Big appartement in the city center. Thank you so much for your warm welcome!
Great spot to explore from, close distance to some good restaurants and attractions

The apartment was great.  Everything we needed was present. The location is very convenient and ideally located to stroll through the Alfama with it's restaurants and shops. The communication was excellent and the the owner is friendly and flexible.

Notre sejour familial à Lisbonne a été une réussite. Le logement d Alexandre a contribué a notre bonheur.
C'est très proche de tout , le quartier est calme et bien fréquenté.
L appartement est beau et les équipements de qualité.
Après des journées bien remplies à l extérieur, il était bon de trouver un enndroit serein pour se reposer.
Je recommande ce logement.
Edwige

El piso en una ubicación perfecta del barrio de Alfama,  a 10 minutos andando del centro de Lisboa. Muy amable Alexandre que mandó a un amigo a recibirnos y nos dió indicaciones muy útiles de donde aparcar y buenas recomendaciones. TODO BIEN

Alexandre was great and was very accommodating to our needs. He provided a safe and clean home for my family with two young children. Can’t beat the location. Walking distance to many top attractions and metro, trains and bus. Bernardo was also fantastic greeting us. Was able to provide local knowledge and great recommendations. Would highly recommend!

Supertrevligt bemötande av både Alexandre, samt Bernardo som hjälpte oss checka in. Vi fick bra lokala tips som hjälpte oss under vår vistelse i Lissabon. Dessvärre matchade inte fotona det aktuella skicket på lägenheten, köket behöver underhåll. Städningen kunde varit bättre. Allt som allt hade vi ändå väldigt trevliga dagar i härliga Alfama!

Alexandre é muito gentil, o espaço é ótimo, no bairro de Alfama, perto da avenida, não precisa de subir ladeiras com as malas. O edifício é antigo mas é característico da região e muito silencioso nos horários de silêncio, nem parece que se está em uma cidade tão turística. O apartamento é bem equipado e confortável, Alexandre providenciou que um amigo de sua confiança Bernardo fizesse nosso check-in e ele foi extremamente cortes e nos deu recomendações. Ficamos encantados com a hospitalidade. Recomendo!

Soddisfatti dell’ alloggio e della disponibilità di Alexandre.
Appartamento in zona strategica per poter muoversi a piedi
Close to downtown area shops and restaurants. Place requires updated plumbing as sinks /toilrts do not drain well. For the price we paid and cleaning was not up to par prior to our arrival.
This place was in an excellent location. Easily walkable to downtown and lots of great places to eat. Alex and Bernardo communicated really well and I highly recommend this location.
Great location and good Airbnb for the price.
Very good place to stay. Nice area
Fijn verblijf in een prachtige wijk! Appartement iets verouderd ten opzichte van de foto’s, maar alsnog een aanrader. Host reageerde altijd en belde om het inchecken te regelen.
Great location and great host

Imóvel muito bem localizado, com restaurante e bares no entorno, próximo de acesso aos transportes públicos e algumas atrações turísticas da cidade. O imóvel é muito aconchegante, foi perfeito para hospedar nós 4.  Alexandre e Bernardo prestaram todo suporte necessário, além de muito simpáticos e preocupados com nossa boa experiência, também deixaram ótimas dicas para aproveitar melhor a cidade. Recomendo e espero poder voltar em breve!
Je recommande sans hésiter!

Für 2 Tage und 4 Personen, wie in unserem Fall war es okay. Über eine längere Zeit ist es etwas zu klein und man hat wenig Möglichkeiten seine Sachen z.B. im Bad abzustellen. Insgesamt hätte es ein wenig sauberer sein können. In jedem Bett gab es nur eine große Decke, was uns alle gestört hat. Ansonsten war alles gut, von der Kommunikation über die Lage usw.

Nachdem unsere ursprüngliche Unterkunft bei Ankunft storniert wurde,  haben wir sehr unkompliziert diese Wohnung buchen können.  Es gab wegen der Kurzfristigkeit zwar keinen persönlichen Kontakt aber eine sehr gute Erreichbarkeit per Mail und auch der Check in hat super funktioniert.  Die Wohnung ist sehr gut ausgestattet und wir haben wir uns wohlgefühlt.  Sie hat eine tolle, ruhige Lage, ist aber etwas hellhörig in Bezug Schritte aus der darüberliegenden Wohnung . Die Fliesen in der Küche sind teilweise kaputt und könnten mal ausgetauscht werden .  Wir würden die Wohnung jederzeit wieder nehmen.

Apartment really well located and it was nice.
We really enjoy our stay in Lisbon.

L'host è stato molto disponibile, la posizione molto comoda.
Unica cosa è che per 4 persone era un po' stretto e non molto confortevole per il prezzo pagato.
Beautiful and cozy place!
Very nice apartment!
Our time in the apartment was amazing. The apartment is great and in a perfect location, near to bars, restaurants and cafe‘s. We would come back any time!

L’appartamento si trova in una zona tranquilla di Alfama. L’alloggio è complessivamente buono forse ha bisogno di una rinfrescata.
Nel bagno c’è un piccolo lavamani ma abbiamo apprezzato la presenza del bidet

Schöne Wohnung in guter Lage. Unkomplizierter Check-In.
Der Kühlschrank ist sehr klein und die Sauberkeit entsprach nicht unseren Ansprüchen (Geschirr und voller Aschenbecher).

Fantastic stay! Really amazing location, lots of local places to eat within a couple minutes walk and 10-15 min walk to town square. Easy to get bus and local transport to other parts of town. No aircon but fans were provided. Great communication from host. All amenities as listed. Some noise from construction during daytime hours but no noise at night. Would highly recommend!

We had a great stay here! The location in perfect and communication with Alexandre was good. Only downside was that the apartment was smaller than anticipated and that one bedroom does not have a window.
Alexandre's place is in a great location. It's easy to get to all the most popular spots in Lisbon and right in the heart of Alfama. He was also very good about responding to messages and queries.

Alojamiento perfecto para visitar Lisboa. Fácil de encontrar, bien comunicado con transporte público y Uber. Se puede visitar perfectamente caminando los sitios principales de Lisboa centro y el resto haciendo uso del transporte.
Nuestro avión se retrasó y no hubo problema para realizar un auto check in, lo cual nos dejó bastante tranquilos después del día tan caótico en el aeropuerto.
Perfecto para 4 personas.
Como pega, sería perfecto que tuviese aire acondicionado, sobre todo de cara al verano, pero disponía el alojamiento de ventiladores portátiles y calefactores (para el invierno).
No tuvimos días muy calurosos, por lo que con el ventilador fue suficiente pero imagino que días de mucho calor, sobre todo la habitación interior, será un horno.

The place is well located as described in other reviews and walkable to pretty much everywhere. The only con was that there was no coffee/tea or some cooking basics (oil, butter, salt and pepper, etc) provided for the price we paid to stay. Other than that, the host was excellent in communicating and arranging the overnight checkin and also assisting with anything we needed during our stay.

We stayed at this lovely apartment for a couple nights while exploring Lisbon.  It was a great amount of space for the two of us.  It is a perfect location if you want to enjoy a slightly more peaceful neighborhood, while being a pleasant walking distance in all directions from the more popular areas of Lisbon.  We also appreciated the flat-ground routes to different locations, because the apartment is along the coast.

Perfectly located, within walking distance for many sites and restaurants. Would really recommend for a central location and very spacious inside. Easily findable with clear instructions from Alexandre.
Super hote ! Appartement top, propre et dans un super emplacement. Double vitrage ce qui permet de bien se reposer en cas de bruit dans les rues. Recommendé à 100%

Le logement est très bien situé, presque tout se fait à la marche et nous étions en plein dans les festivités d’une fête portugaise. Il y avait beaucoup d’ambiance festive autour. Bernando était un super hôte, il s’est assuré qu’on avait tout ce dont on avait besoin et nous a donné des conseils et des recommandations pour notre visite.

Apartment is well located, very close to Praca do Comercio, easy to find. Alexandre was very communicative and always anwered all questions very fast. Bernando met us and gave all the details for the apartment and places to eat, etc. We requested extra things for the apartment and we got them 10 minutes after. Apartment itself is very simple, kitchen we didnt use at all but i wouldn’t cook there.
There is just a closet in one bedroom so if you come two couples, you wont have place to hang your clothes, there is just a commode. Whole apartment has just 2 windows-one in bedroom and another one in the living room. Maybe its good for summer, that heat wouldn’t enter.
Also in the bedroom bed is placed such way that its not easy to reach the window.
Apartment is on 2nd floor and no elevator.
Its ok for some days if you dont plan to stay too much inside.
There is a nice restaurant around the corner, Solar dos Bicos, and breakfast place Copenhagen Lab.
Amazing stay in a great location! Everything you need is within a few short blocks and it’s close enough to walk to all the main tourist areas
Location was quiet and conveniently close to shopping and transportation for all the local sights in Lisbon.

Bernando who welcomed us was very hospitable and in general simply amazing!! He really tried to accommodate to all of our needs and to give us the necessary information that we would need, as new visitors to the town. There was also written information concerning restaurants, music venues and other facilities. On that leaflet were also written the best places to shop and where to get any products that we might need on our trip.
The only disadvantage I can think of, was that because of the building's age, there was only one set of keys for the doors and as we were 4 of in our travelling group, it complicated things a bit for us, in case one wanted to return to the apartment at a different time, than the other who didn't have a key to get in. All in all, that compelled us to always leave the set of keys, at the key locker box at the entrance.

nous remercions Alexandre nous avons passé un très bon moment à Lisbonne. L'appartement est impeccable et très confortable et dans un endroit paisible mais accessible dès autres quartier a pied très facilement.
je recommande fortement
Easy-to-find, clean and quiet location! It was great to have a warm welcoming from the host. Perfect location for walk around Alfama.

Estancia tranquila, apartamento muy bien ubicado, el propietario y su amigo son muy agradables, siempre están pendientes y contestan muy rápido y te explican un montón de cosas sobre el lugar. Sin duda lo recomendaría a cualquiera.  Si algun dia vuelvo a Lisboa repetiré !
Great spot, good location, very friendly host
Tout était parfait merci beaucoup

It’s a very well located apartment in a lovely Alfama area, walking distance to the city centre as well. Clean and functional. Would have been nice to see more attention to details like better quality towels, coffee/tea, shower gel, etc.

Appartement charmant, idéalement situé : très proche des restaurants avec musiciens de fado (coup de cœur pour le Fama d’Alfama situé à 50m), du Tage, des arrêts de bus, de la gare Santa Apolónia, en plein cœur du quartier de l’Alfama.
Un grand merci à Alexandre pour ses réponses rapides et ses conseils avisés.
Je recommande.
Fijn appartement op uitstekende plek. Prijs-kwaliteit prima. Goede communicatie met Alexandre!
We loved our stay in Lisbon. Alexandre and Bernardo were incredibly helpful especially as it was our first time visiting the city. Would recommend to people for future stays.
Had a great stay! Really nice location in the old town, close to public transport and lots of things to see nearby.
Nothing to say, everything was perfect ! Location, furniture, check in instructions etc
Es war ein toller Aufenthalt bei Alexandre in Lissabon!! :)
Très bien situé, au cœur de Lisbonne et à quelques minutes à pied du centre ville. L’appartement était très propre et fonctionnel pour notre séjour à 4 !
Super poloha vybrať sa kdekoľvek. Priestranné ubytovanie, dobrá wifi. Blízko veľa reštaurácii. Príjemný hostiteľ. Super bolo že aj v zlom počasí bolo teplúčko.

Thanks so much for sharing your wonderful city of Lisbon with us! Your home was in a great location yet tucked away in a quiet corner so it very peaceful at night! We appreciate your accommodation when we arrived early with our bags!

Mon séjour dans le quartier d’Alfama à Lisbonne a été absolument merveilleux ! L’appartement était charmant, confortable et parfaitement situé pour explorer les ruelles historiques et profiter des superbes vues. L’accueil de notre hôte a été chaleureux. Expérience authentique garantie dans ce quartier plein de caractère. Je recommande vivement à ceux qui souhaitent découvrir Lisbonne.

Prime location. Responsive host with thoughtful local recs. Did not look like the photos, which must have been taken a while back. The mattress under the sheet was gross. It needs a paint job and new couch cover. The washer, which we planned to use was moldy. It was somewhat noisy in the apartment, but earplugs solved that. It was okay but overall not great.
Mooi appartement in ‘historische’ stijl, op loopafstand van het centrum. Sterke prijs-kwaliteitsverhouding.

Appartamento bello e luminoso. Dotato di tutti i comfort necessari.
Posizione ottima!
Very comfortable, cozy, pretty and well-located.

Die Lage war top. Die Wohnung war sauber und schön. Wir waren stets mit Uber unterwegs und mussten nie lange warten, da es so zentral ist. Der Gastgeber hat stets umgehend geantwortet und war sehr zuvorkommend, auch als wir neue Bettwäsche brauchten, weil unser Kind krank war. Das einzig negative war, dass wir unseren Kinderwagen stets sehr viele Treppen hochtragen mussten, da es keinen Lift hatte. Es war toll, dass es ein Babybett gab, ein Kinderstuhl wäre noch perfekt gewesen.

Très bon appartement, très bien placé a proximité de toutes les destinations a pieds.
Petite suggestion: 2 micro bouteilles de shampoo/gel douches ne suffisent pas pour 4 voyageurs prévoyez vos shampoings avec vous

Positives:
- Great location
- Apartment is relatively spacious
- Host is amenable, friendly and responsive
Negatives:
- Apartment was dusty - it could do with a clean around the mirrors, pictures etc.
- Thin walls
- The kitchen is small, and the tap is extremely high pressure, meaning water spirts everywhere when you turn it on
Ótima estadia… Amamos o espaço perto de tudo e limpeza impecável…
Very nicely located, perfect for heading into the old town. Absolutely lovely staff.

We really loved this Airbnb! No street sound whatsoever & walkable distance from the centre as well as from popular sightings. Be aware that the olive oil and herbs that are present may not be enough if you love cooking, but thankfully our hosts were willing to bring something by.
Towels super clean, bed clean, and overall a very homey feeling. We enjoyed ourselves in this little home and were certainly able to enjoy sunsets and sunrises from the big window in the living room as well.
Bernardo, a friend of Alexandre, was very kind to us and gave us some good recommendations for traditional Portugese restaurants as well.
Thank you!
PS. Be aware of the kitchen tap, it tends to splash a bit ;)
Cozy apartment near the old city of Lisboa. Great attention from hosts.
It was a simple and nice appartment located in a nice neighbourhood of Lisbon (Alfama). We had a super warm welcome and received a lot of great recommendations.

The unit is right where the cruise ships dock so it is in the middle of everything. Alfama is a quick walk up a few stairs. Great restaurants nearby. It is also a short walk to the subway and train station.
The apartment itself is a nice size, especially for Lisbon. We were working during the week so it was nice to have the space to work without being on top of each other.
Good WiFi, comfortable beds. Enough space for 4 people comfortably although it was just my husband and I.
Would stay again.

Très bien accueilli avec des spécialités locales.
Logement très propre et grand pour 4 personnes. Il est très bien exposé - à 10min de marche de la place du commerce.
Nous avons passé un très bon séjour à Lisbonne 😃

Excellente communication avec Alexandre et Bernardo.
Lorsque nous avons eu un problème, ils ont été très réactifs et le problème a été réglé dans la journée.
Merci pour votre accueil 😊
Alex and the Manager has been most amazing guys! Due to winter- there was issues occurred on the door. We called Manager mid night and he paid a quick visit and tried to help. Seems a good property !
Uma boa casa e ótimo dono
This place is a great value right in the core of the old city. Really a great place to find food and walk to several venues and markets.  I recommend it to anyone!

Alexandre a été un hôte agréable et très réactif. Au petits soins avec nous. Merci beaucoup. L’appartement profite d’un emplacement idéal pour visiter Lisbonne. De plus, propreté impeccable, fonctionnel. Rien à dire à part du positif, pour un petit weekend entre amis ou en amoureux … parfait !
Je recommande !
Amazing host and very helpful. The apartment is in very good location.

Très bon emplacement dans un quartier central.
Le logement en lui même n'est pas très agréable pour les raisons suivantes:
- manque de fenêtre (une fenêtre sur le séjour et une sur une des deux chambre)
- pas d'ambiance chaleureuse qui incite à rester (nous avons passé tous les petits déjeuners et autres repas à l'extérieur)
- finitions à refaire (murs sales, carrelage qui se décolle, odeur désagréable dans les sanitaires, sol stratifié amortis et joints du sol qui s'ouvent)
- les voisins sont audibles à toute heure, notamment lorsqu'ils marchent au dessus de votre tête entre minuit et une heure du matin.
Nous n'y retournerons pas.
Great location, great host. Lots do do around the area. We enjoyed our stay very much.

Was generally a good stay however note that the toilet door cannot be closed completely and although there was a washer, there is no detergent. As there is only 1 main window and given that the apartment is on a low floor, we usually kept the window closed which also means that the apartment would get stuffy after a while. There are also no lifts, therefore if you have heavy luggage, please be prepared to climb flights of stairs. Other than these, the apartment was a 20min walk to the main square and was central enough to most attractions.
Stay was perfect for a quick trip to Lisbon!
Great location, central to everything you want to do in Lisbon! Would definitely stay here again!
Tout s’est très bien passé. Séjour très agréable
Excellent location in the heart of the old town. Easy walking to viewpoints overlooking the Tagus and many great cafes and bars.

We had 3 great nights at Alexandre’s apartment which were a fantastic haven in the incredible heat of the city. A really good location to get to some great restaurants, transport links & a downstairs local shop that opens early until late for all your daily needs. We liaised with Bernardo who stood in for A who was away & he was wonderful. The suggestions inside the apartment are spot on (food, shopping etc) so you are well taken care of. We love Lisbon & go fairly regularly so we’ll be back there again next time
Very good place to be for visiting Lisboa ! Thank you Alexandre 😉

Hemos estado muy bien en el apartamento y Bernardo y Alexandre siempre han estado muy atentos. La ubicación era muy buena y el piso estaba bien, quizá en verano se necesita aire acondicionado debido al calor. Es un piso con encanto, céntrico, en un edificio antiguo y es por eso por lo que vimos algo elevado el precio, aunque nos imaginamos que será debido a que Lisboa se ha convertido en un sitio muy turístico. Estuvimos muy bien en el piso y la gente fue muy amable con nosotros. Muchas gracias.
Erg tevreden over deze woning! De locatie is perfect en de communicatie met Alexandre was prettig :)

bonito apartamento muy bien situado, a 5min. andando de la plaza de Comercio. zona tranquila para dormir a pesar de estar en la parte inferior de alfama.
Alexandre y Bernardo siempre pendientes para cualquier cuestión. Nos recibió Bernardo, explicando todo y recomendando como movernos por la ciudad.
Totalmente recomendable.

Logement très bien situé et assez grand pour une famille. Beaucoup de restaurants à proximité et quartier très animé… parfois jusque tard dans la nuit! Par contre, étant situé dans Alfama on s’y attendait et toutes les attractions se font bien à la marche ou en transport en commun qui est à proximité. Bonne communication avec Alexandre!
Merci encore à Alexandre pour ce superbe séjour à Lisbonne! L'appartement a été spacieux, très bien situé à l'entrée d'Alfama et la communication avec le hôte - parfaite.
great stay. only poor feedback is the lack of air conditioning in the summer months but there were fans available which compensated for this
Appartement très bien situé à Lisbonne près de l'Alfama. Hôte très réactif et disponible pour toutes questions ou demandes. Nous avons passé un super séjour à Lisbonne.

Arrivée et départ en autonomie via boitier à code donc aucun contact physique avec l'hôte Alexandre.
Bon emplacement pour visiter la ville avec de très nombreux restaurants à proximité.
Toutefois, l'immeuble est très ancien sans ascenseur, l'appartement n'était pas très propre à notre arrivée et une forte odeur de javel imprégnait les lieux, l'isolation laisse plus qu'à désirer surtout côté route très bruyant à cause des travaux.

Le logement est bien situé, à proximité des stations de métro et du centre à pied, idéal pour visiter Lisbonne.
L'appartement est agréable. Le seul. désagrément est la mauvaise odeur dans la salle de bain (problème de canalisation ?)
La communication avec Alexandre et son mari Bernardo est excellente.

Very nice flat, clean and as described.
there is everything you need, very quiet and also really close to Santa Apolonia station and Alfama.
Communication with Alexandre was really easy and friendly.
100% recommended, I'll stay there again for sure!
Thanks Alexandre!
Traditional style flat and a great place to stay for the liveliness of Alfama and easy access to the city.  Alexandre was very helpful and responsive.  Had a great time!

Si je dois retourner a Lisbonne, je reprendrais ce logement sans aucune hésitation.
Il est bien situé et est dans la partie "plate" de la ville, non négligeable pour les fins de journées 🙂
Thank you! We enjoyed our stay

Super séjour à Lisbonne, l’appartement est idéalement situé, il y a en plus une super liste de recommandations ! Tout est propre et la cuisine est bien équipée. Nous n’avons pas rencontré Alexandre, mais son ami Bernardo était adorable ! Merci encore !

Die Wohnung befindet sich in guter Lage, um Alfama und Lissabon zu erkunden. Wir haben Alexandre wegen später Anreise nicht persönlich getroffen, aber trotzdem alle möglichen nützlichen Tipps erhalten. Der Aufenthalt hat uns gut gefallen.

Bonne communication avec Alexandre. Arrivée et départs en autonomie.
Bon emplacement pour visiter la ville. Restaurants à proximité. Cependant, immeuble très ancien avec isolation inexistante. Appartement trompeur par les photos. Elles doivent dater de la rénovation il y a très très longtemps. Les prestations ne sont pas à la hauteur du tarif demandé. C’est l’équivalent d’un hôtel sans etoile.
Sols vétustes et de mauvaise qualité.
La porte de la salle de bains ne ferme pas.

The host is responsive and the location is good but I would not recommend this place unless you really only care about having a place to sleep. It is totally fine for that. It's not that there was anything horribly wrong, but it was just not very nice, especially for the money. First off, it's much smaller and darker than the photos. You have to keep windows always open otherwise it gets hot and humid inside but then there is street noise. The small bedroom has no windows so it gets hot and stuffy unless you keep the door to the living room open so then you have no privacy. Also it has nowhere to hang clothes. Many things are cheap and janky (bed lamps had broken and torn shades, towels were so worn they had holes, the furniture is laminate not real wood, the chairs, nightstands and mirror are shaky, the drawers in the small room don't open). The couch and bean chair are now grey so not the happy bright colors you see in the photos. The bigger bedroom has weird layout: the foot of the bed is 8-10 inches from the wall so it's really hard to get to the other side of the bed and the window. There is a painting on a narrow wall in the living room that is too big for that wall and sticks out 4 inches on each side, it looks so silly. Again, mostly small or medium importance things, and as I said the host was responsive and fixed some things I asked for (eg the bathroom door had no handle so you couldn't close it to have privacy so they came and installed one handle on the inside only), but it just added up to a feeling of being in a roadside Motel 6 in the U.S.
Keep in mind that the stairs to the second floor are steep! Definitely hard to climb for anyone over 60 even if they're in great health and shape like my aunt.
I thought may be this is just standard for that price range for Lisbon but after my aunt left my partner and I switched Airbnbs and the new one is in the same neighborhood for a similar price and it is a hundred times nicer, it feels like a fancy hotel. So there are definitely better options in the area if you care about having a more dialed-in experience like I do.

La camera da letto più piccola anche senza finestra era molto accogliente.
Letti, cuscini, lenzuola molto comodi.
Le foto dell’appartamento sono credo di qualche tempo fa, la casa infatti avrebbe bisogno di una rinfrescata.
Segnaliamo che:
1) la pulizia non era adeguata, fughe delle mattonelle in cucina e bagno molto sporche, molti capelli a terra, polvere sui mobili, nel freezer una busta di plastica con non so cosa dentro attaccata al ghiaccio. Si consiglia di migliorare sicuramente la pulizia ordinaria e farne di straordinarie più spesso.
2) non c’era neppure una dotazione minima di sale, zucchero o caffè (forse due cialde di cortesia e qualche bustina di zucchero si potrebbero far trovare, giusto per il primo giorno).
3) il bagno non ha la maniglia ed inoltre non si chiude, affacciando in cucina e accanto alla camera da letto non è il massimo per la privacy....
4) molti fili, elettrodomestici inseriti in una sola ciabatta.
5)in bagno mancano i portasciugamani, mettere tutti gli asciugamani per tre persone sulla scaletta presente risulta complicato.
6) nella zona del centro ci sono molti piccoli alimentari ma nessuno ben fornito, quindi se avete problematiche come intolleranze, o necessità particolari, o bambini molto piccoli avrete difficillta’ a trovare quello che vi occorre.

Zeer leuk gelegen appartement in het oude deel van Lissabon. Gezellige straatjes om de hoek met meer dan genoeg eetgelegenheden. Heb je vragen? Alexandres antwoord vrijwel direct of toch zo snel mogelijk. Zeker een aanrader!!

El alojamiento es super céntrico. Nos recibieron a la hora fijada y nos dieron información sobre las zonas que ver y restaurantes locales (muy amables desde el primer momento). Fuimos en coche y hay dos opciones para dejarlo, en las inmediaciones con zona de parquimetro o en un parking privado que sale por 12 euros diarios aprox (muy bien para dejarlo alli y recorrer la ciudad a pie). Estancia muy agradable.

Buona posizione e appartamento confortevole, quartiere tranquillo e ospitalità cordiale ma non invadente.
Consigliato
Muy bien situado, espacioso y limpio. Menaje adecuado. En definitiva, un piso muy cómodo. Y Alexandre nos lo puso muy fácil

Very nice house. The best is the position. We were with two babies and we didn’t have any problem. A parking for 8€ per day is situated not far away from the house and walking around Lisbon is really a great pleasure. I would come back again! Diogo and Alexandre were really great hosts. They prepared also wine and sardines for us at our arrival and it was a nice surprise! The only negative think is the sink in the bathroom. It is really so small so we had to wash our 8 months baby in the kitchen but it was not a problem for us.
Awesome part of town, clean and cute flat, and easy communication with Alexandre! Would definitely stay here again :)

Aconselho a qualquer um, a casa é excelente. Com tudo que uma pessoal, casal ou grupo precisam.
A localização é perfeita, tem um largo com vários lugares para estacionar.É cobrado das 9-19hrs porém nesse horário estava sempre na rua, caso não queira usar o carro tem um estacionamento pago bem em conta perto.
O Alexandre não precisa nem de comentários, sensacional.
FantAstic place in great location. Can’t wait to get back to Lisbon. I will definitely be booking here again!
A wonderful visit with the nicest welcome! I'll be sure to come back here when I find myself in Lisbon next!

Very central and convenient location in Alfama, a historical area of Lisbon. The apartment is nicely furnished and clean, although it can feel a bit dark (since there are few windows). Great communications from the host! Many thanks.
ubicacion perfecta, apartamento muy agradable y limpio

O apto é bem amplo , bem localizado , com roupas de cama e toalhas bem limpas e em bom estado o que mais me agradou . Alexandre é um excelente anfitrião e nos atendeu prontamente quando o solicitamos . Recomendamos

L'appartement est en plein cœur d'Alfama, l'emplacement est idéal pour découvrir Lisbonne et ses environs à pied ou en transport. Il se situe dans un immeuble ancien donc peu isolé phoniquement et on entend les voisins du dessus mais ce n'est pas insupportable. La literie est de très bonne qualité et il y a tout l'équipement nécessaire pour vivre confortablement pendant le séjour. Il y a des épiceries et des restaurants à proximité immédiate. Très appréciable, Alexandre s'est arrangé pour nous garder nos bagages au-delà de la plage horaire convenue.
Purely an excellent place to stay in Lisbon, you will not be disappointed.

Apartment is located close to historic Alafama, in an old building close to all amenities including a variety of restaurants. It’s located on 3rd floor fitted with all required amenities and we definitely recommend if climbing staircase is not an issue. Alexandre is prompt in response to any queries you may have.
Great location, communication, and hospitality!
Muy atento, tuvimos un problema con el pomo de la puerta y nos lo solucionó en pocas horas. Totalmente recomendado!!!
Nice apartment, great location. Need some fixes here and there but overall a solid apartment with very friendly staff.

La ubicación es excelente, está en un segundo piso sin ascensor, queda uy cerca del puerto para aquellos viajeros que tengan en mente un crucero.
Es pequeño, pero cómodo. Su anfitrión está pendiente de cada duda para ayudarte.
Lo pasamos muy bien.
Ótimo lugar

El apartamento estaba impecable, la ubicación estaba muy bien, muy cerca de las estaciones de metro y el trato que nos dieron fue estupendo! Nos dejaron un detalle de bienvenida, una guía con recomendaciones y hasta secador de pelo! Muy recomendable!
Muy buen anfitrión y el apto en una de excelente ubicación.
Lovely apartment in the Alfama area.  Loved the location.

L'appartement, spacieux, décoré d'anciens azulejos, est très bien situé au pied du quartier de l'alfama. La communication avec Alexandre a été très aisée et nous avons pu laisser nos bagages jusqu'à 16h30 le jour de notre départ.
Stylish, very well connected place. We had an amazing time here and the host has bern very friendly and easy to contact.

This was an amazing apartment in Alfama! Alfama is the oldest part of Lisboa so parking is tough. We had a retail car one more night and found street parking we did not have to pay for since it was past 6pm. This apartment is in a square so lots of metered parking. Apartment is exactly how it looks in the pictures and very clean. When back in Lisboa I would stay here again.
Super zentrales und schönes Apartment.

Alexandre’s place is very stylish and in a brilliant location in Lisbon. This was our first ever visit (travelling with our 13-year-old son) and the apartment was beautifully presented and the kitchen had everything you could possibly need. The apartment is very stylish (although perhaps a little more dated than the pictures suggest) but the entire area is lovely and clean with some incredibly welcoming touches (we had a bottle of red wine, sardines and peanuts to greet us on arrival)! I don’t think you would find a better location to stay and Alexandre’s advice on the best local bakeries and restaurants was terrific. The apartment is just near the port and when we visited for five days in September there were lots of cruise ships ... so the area gets quite busy but with the local hints of where to get your groceries and grab a terrific (friendly) coffee and pastry in the morning, it provided us our own little local sanctuary in an amazing, historic part of Lisbon. Be aware this apartment is in a very traditional, older building so there are some things that come with the territory: the toilet flush is a little temperamental and there is no air conditioning BUT there is loads of hot water and great water pressure. Not a huge amount of hanging or drawer space in the main bedroom but that didn’t bother us for our stay. Check in, check out and communication was outstanding - we would highly recommend Alexandre’s apartment (but not in summer - Lisbon was high twenties even at the end of September and while the sea breeze is fabulous, it would still be way uncomfortable without aircon if it were any hotter outside).
Nicely decorated place, with plenty of space, two rooms and complete kitchen. The apartment can get a little warm during summer, but the fans help. Would return!
Appartement bien décoré, très propre, bien situé: on peut faire beaucoup de choses à pied et les transports sont proches.
Wonderful, stylish and very well located apartment. Everything was perfect and Alexandre was very welcoming and friendly!
Un accueil très sympa et un joli appartement. Très arrangent pour l’heure d’arrivée et du départ. Je vais garder cette adresse pour un futur séjour à Lisbonne. Salutations Stéph
Sehr schönes Apartment in supertoller Lage in Lissabon. Sehr gute und schnelle Kommunikation mit Alexandre. Auf jeden Fall empfehlenswert.

Das größte Plus des Apartments ist die Lage. Man kommt wirklich zu Fuß schnell überall hin und ist nur durch eine Straße vom Fluss getrennt.
Leider ist das Apartment wirklich klein, vor allem das Badezimmer. Größeres Manko war die Hellhörigkeit. Man hört von oben, nebenan und aus dem Treppenhaus jeden Schritt. Tag und Nacht.
Kurzum: für 2 Leute oder eine Familie mit einem Kind OK - für mehr war es uns zu klein.
Danke an den Cousin von Alexandre, der uns mit guten Tipps sehr freundlich willkommen geheißen hat!
Hosts were very friendly and helpful. Apartment were clean and comfortable

My friends and I had a great stay at this flat with a great location, very easy to find, lots of local convenient stores and nice local restaurants with good price & tasty dishes. Alexandre and his cousin have been very helpful in giving tips on trips.
Nous avons passé un bon séjour chez Alexandre. L'appartement est très bien situé dans le quartier de l'Alfama.

Alexandre est très réactif. Le logement est hyper bien placé, tout en étant calme. La literie est de qualité. Le linge de toilette est doux et de grande taille. L'accueil est ponctuel et agréable. Rodrigo parle très bien français. Le petit cadeau de bienvenue à été apprécié par nous 4. On conseille vivement cet appartement. Merci Alexandre pour l'accueil.
Great location and communication from our host, Alexandre.

We had a great time at Alexandre’s place. Alexandre was a great host and was very helpful with tips and understanding when we our travel plans were delayed and we arrived to check in later than we had planned. We found the apartment to be a little older in real life than what it looks like in the photos, however, it is still a lovely, spacious apartment in a fantastic location. We would stay again!
Great spot in Lisbon!

El apartamento se encuentra muy bien ubicado, cerca del centro de Lisboa, Estación de Tren, autoservicio y frente al mar. Alexandre es una persona muy amable, con excelente comunicación. Sus tips y recomendaciones fueron de mucha utilidad.
Great location, very clean and had everything we needed.  Late check-in was great.

The apartment is at a excellent location in Alfama. It is easy to get around to the main sights and areas in Lisbon. Recommendations provided by the hosts were useful. However, the apartment is a little narrow. Bathroom is rather cramp with a tiny sink. The second bedroom without the window feels a little claustrophobic. Would recommend this place for a couple of days, not longer.
Great place and as pictured.  Would definitely come again.

Posizione perfetta per arrivare non ci sono salite, vicino alla metro e al centro sicuramente. Consiglio per questo motivo una vacanza con bambini, noi eravamo con un bambino di un anno e siamo stati benissimo. L'appartamento è come si vede nelle foto e come descritto, carino con dei particolari molto curati e altri più essenziali ma tutto confortevole. Adatto ad una coppia, la seconda camera è un metro più grande di un letto e senza finestre quindi non utilizzabile d'estate. Ad accoglierci c'era Diogo gentilissimo che si fa capire molto bene, check-in anticipato e deposito bagagli dopo il check-out. Insomma tutto bene...!!!
Great spot! Alexandre was super responsive and organized an early check in for us.

We had a great stay at Alexandre's apartment. Communication was great and Alexandre kindly let us check in an hour early. He had a bottle of wine, water, and a tin of sardines waiting for us. =) The apartment was spacious, the beds were comfortable, and the linens and towels were clean. It was conveniently located between two metro stations as well as near the Apolonia train station, and many of the main sights are within walking distance. It was mostly quiet inside the apartment--the windows must have some sort of soundproofing as they blocked out most of the outside noise. The street was pretty quiet at night. The only noise issue is the person upstairs stomping around our first morning hard enough to make the windows rattle, but that was solved with earplugs. The apartment was very clean outside of some mildew on the bathtub tile grout. Overall, an enjoyable stay!

Vale muito a pena conferir esse espaço do Alexandre. Lugar tranquilo , bonito , limpo , bem localizado pero de Tudo. Museu do Fado , Museu da Cerveja, restaurantes , lojas , supermercado e comércio em geral
Uma lojinha bem perto linda de azulejos portugueses que podem imprimir fotos, desenhos ou escolher típicas recordações de Lisboa a bom preço , rápido em 15 minutos . Alexandre e Diogo sei primo nos deixou de presente um vinho e sardinha . O apartamento é completo tem tudo que um hóspede precisa . E mais importante a calorosa atenção que viajante precisa para curtir Lisboa . Obrigada .
Great location,  very spacious and clean.

Don’t think twice to book at Alexandre’s. Everything is PERFECT. I didn’t get to meet him personally but was assisted by his cousin Rodrigo who was super friendly, cool guy, informative, helpful & responsive. The apartment is beautiful & located at a strategic location, only 15 minutes from & to the airport. I truly enjoyed my stay. Thank you Rodrigo for being such a duperb co host!
Great apartment in Lisbon! Walk-able to many attractions. Near the water, so always easy to find our way back. :) Check-in was fast and easy! Recommend!
Alexandre is really nice host. Give me detail guide of how to go to his house from the airport. Recommend！
great location, super quick feedback!

Great Host and great apartment.
Totally recommend !
Thanks again Alex!
emplacement bien, logement conforme à description, bon accueil, petit détail: lavabo à réviser et  petit

We had a very nice time in Alexandre’s apartment. Very well located in the Alfama and very tastefully furnished. The only comment we would make is that there are a number of stairs to climb to reach the apartment, which could prove problematic for those who have mobility issues.
Mike and Lucila
We had a great stay!
Super clean, good location and very easy and quick communication with the host. Would totally recommend for a party of two to discover Lisboa for the first time like we did !
wow, awesome!

Alexandre was very quick to respond to our messages. He even accommodated us for an early check in and leaving our bags at the apartment after check out. Location is great.  Walking distance to many attractions.
Un appartement très propre au cœur de l’Alfama où l’on se sent immédiatement chez soi.Il est idéalement situé pour visiter,n’hesitez pas

Great location, lovely flat and a great layout for having multiple people.
The flat is conveniently located, clean, check in was great. Alexandre’s cousin was knowledgeable and helpful on check in. It was also very easy to communicate with the hosts at all times. All round, amazing experience.
Great value and great location!

A bottle of wine and a small bread to greet us was a nice touch. Host have lots of tips to enjoy the place, maps, tour guide books, etc
Location is great for me. It is walking distance to Apolonia train station where we came through from Porto. Nearby is a Bus Stop for Bus 728 (24 he's) to Belem and passes by Tourist areas like Baixa ( where Praca de Comercio and Justa elevator, etc ). Bars, restaurants, museums, are just a few steps. Using my Google map, we walked to Castelo San Jorge from here going up and down old cobble stone Alfama neighborhood alleys that are clean and surprisingly passed by Miradouro das Portas do Sol. Locals are so glad to help with directions when Google map lost signal.
So quiet when we were there for 5 days. The only noise is from rowdy girls going up down the stairs in one night. So peaceful place.
Paid parking space below the building. The apartment is so clean. You have all you need to feel at home. Dining area looks so pleasant, big table, furnitures with well coordinated design. Two so clean and we'll decorated bedrooms. My wife loved the fully furnished kitchen. She also loved the life sized mirror in the big bedroom. Bathroom is wide and good enough for us. Towels are clean, toiletries were enough for our 5 days stay. Beds are firm and comfy. A closet in the bigger bedroom with lots of hangers. Iron is available. There are heaters but we didn't use them. Floors are clean.
I only wish the stairs have light switch sensors that turn the lights on longer. Also, the bathroom fan could be stronger. The wash sponges in the kitchen sink to be replaced. These are the only two issues I can state which by the time the next guests come in, I'm sure Alexander must have taken care of. Overall, I enjoyed my stay in this apartment.

Alexandre est très sympathique, réactif et à l'écoute. Nous sommes arrivés plus tôt que prévu et son cousin a pu nous recevoir, nous donner des conseils sur les visites à faire/restaurants à tester, en fonction de nos attentes et répondre à nos questions. Les lits sont très confortables, le quartier est silencieux et agréable tout en étant à moins de 10 min à pied de la place du commerce et au pied de l'Alfama. L'appartement est aussi bien que sur les photos, voire mieux. Rien n'est à redire, j'y retournerai sans hésiter lors d'un prochain séjour à Lisbonne!
Totalmente recomendable😊😊 si vuelvo a Lisboa repetiré!

I stayed in one of Alexandre's apartments during a weekend stay in Portugal with my Fiancé and I was overly impressed by the fantastic service provided by both Alexandre and his brother Diogo. The apartment was sparkling clean with every essential item required available, whilst the personal service and friendliness of them both made us settle in immediately. I certainly will be using Alexandre again, and I certainly recommend you do to. 5/5 in all areas - Thanks again
Great location, good communication, needs a facelift, overall good.

The location of the apartment is awesome- right in the Alfama area and super close to the river and a metro stop. The apartment was cute, clean, and well-stocked and Alexandre even provided a bottle of wine to welcome us! Very quick responses and worked with us when we arrived later than our expected check-in time. I would definitely book again on a repeat visit to Lisbon!
Apartamento muito aconchegante e bem localizado, próximo a vários pontos de interesse de isboa e da estação Santa Apolónia. O Diogo, que nos recebeu, foi muito prestativo e atencioso. Recomendo.
Lo consiglio vivamente !
Lovely place, very well located

Alexandre’s place is wonderful and stylish. It’s in a great location and Cristiano gave us great local tips. We had a great time and would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a cosy and stylish place to stay.

It was a very nice stay, the apartment is well located and perfect for 3-4 persons (We were three women and had enough space). Alexandre and his cousin were very friendly and provided us with a lot of tips for the city. So there was more or less nothing to complain, and I would recommend a stay at the apartment.
Great location in Alfama, and helpful host.
Great trip to Lisbon. Perfect location for exploring Alfama and new town, local fado, easy to reach from airport by public transport, lovely hosts.

appartement très bien situé  dans lAlfama,agréable  et clair.  Hôte  accueillant  et réactif, conciliant,nous avons apprécié  notre arrivée  dès 13heure un jour de grandes pluie . Je vous conseille ce logement.

Alexandre met us in person and shared local tips and recommendations and he had a welcome pack with wine, cheese and sardines which was such a great way to begin our city break. The apartment is very clean, with all the amenities promised and the check-in is very easy. The location is amazing, very convenient.

Excepcionalmente localizado. Muy bien comunicado. Ideal para un viaje con amigos como el que yo he realizado.

Perfect location. Felt like home. Very clean and comfortable. Alexandre’s cousin helped us with the check in process and gave us tons of tips and recommendations that made our stay even more enjoyable!

Alexandre’ s apartament is very well situated with many restaurants in the surroundings . It is right next to the Fado Museum. It offers 2 comfortable beds with quality linens and towels. Highly recommend!
Very good mornig light in the living!

Beautiful place, great location in the Alfama district which is where you definitely want to stay. Four of us stayed and it was perfect, beautiful bedrooms, comfortable beds.

Thank you so much, I would happily stay here again and easily recommend.
Location gradevole in una posizione strategica per visitare Lisbona.
The location is great，easy to acess, lots of restaurant downstairs，and it is quiet. Ideal place for family stay.
The apartment is conveniently located, very close to major attractions in Alfama. The tips provided by Host is very useful.

The apartment was really nice.  We found parking right out front.  Alexandre met us for check in and communicated with us until we reached the apartment.  He was waiting outside for us and made check in very easy!  He gave us tips and places to visit while we were in Lisbon and recommended a great bakery and places to eat while we were also visiting Sintra for the day.  Everything in old town was walking distance and was about a 40 minute drive to Sintra.  The apartment was very clean and easy to feel at home.    They had fans to help keep us cool and a little bottle of wine and cheese when we got to the apartment!  Alexandre was very helpful and I would def. recommend staying here!

We had a fantastic time in the appartment! We were four people for 3 nights and the space was enough for all of us (one couple and two friends). Alexandre and his cousin were very friendly and gave us awesome recommendations - the service was awesome and they always responded quickly. The appartment is just as it is in the photos in a great location of the city. Would recommend 100%
Fantastic host and location in Lisbon

A localização do alojamento é fantástica e acabou por se revelar extremamente sossegado, graças a uns excelentes vidros duplos nas janelas e ao cuidados dos restantes hóspedes que, nas habitações contíguas, se mostraram atentos e respeitadores. O outro teve a ver com o colchão, demasiado mole para o nosso gosto (mas isto já será "culpa" nossa). A cozinha está equipada com o necessário e suficiente e a casa de banho é funcional, com uma excelente pressão na água do duche. Resta a área comum da Sala de Visitas, o espaço nobre da casa, que nos pareceu um pouco descuidado e a merecer mais atenção por parte do anfitrião.
Alexandre was a great host, he welcomed us to the apartment and showed us around. Communication was on point and fantastic location of the place! Close to all main attractions of the city.

Thank you so much for being a great host and making sure we have everything we need during our stay ! Alexandre had his cousin meet us at Check in who gave us many great recommendations and even helped carry our luggage upstairs in the apartment. Overall a great Airbnb experience in Lisbon, thank you !
Adorable, charming place excellent location, we love the neighborhood, very authentic, very safe,  great hosts, thank you Alexandre and Diogo!

Appartement très très bien placé, en couple ou en famille, propre et qui reflète parfaitement le charme de Lisbonne.
Miguel
You'll find a lovely apartment. One of the bedrooms is a bit small.

Alexandre made us feel very welcomed and went out of his way to assist us with sorting out documents. The apartment more than met our expectations, clean, great location and very comfortable. We certainly would stay there again.

Appartement conforme à la description. Accueil chaleureux avec un vrai effort pour parler français. Métro et bus à proximité. Quartier Alfama trop top pour flâner le soir et déguster de bons plats portugais sans oublier la sangria.

Excellent location, friendly welcome and good communication before and throughout stay from host.
Excellent stay, very close to Alfama attractions and to the river.
Excellent location and charming apartment.

From the train Station you walk around 5-8 Minutes. Alexandre made sure we could check in earlier and organised a baby bed and sheets /towels for the baby which was very nice. The Apartment was renovated with good Windows. We were there as santo António festivities were taking place and with closed Windows you can only hear the music very far away. The Main bedroom is turned to the back of the Apartment so it is really quiet even during the day.
It is an old/traditional building so it is normal you hear people walking on the stairs but it is really not a big Problem and it did not wake us up. I recommend the Apartment and we will be returning for sure.

Nice apartment in a stylish, old house,
good location.
Alexandre's place was great - good location close to loads of transport and nightlife; a stylish oasis of quiet in the midst of Alfama. And Alexandre was very hospitable!
Beautiful apartment and great location. Remember to explore the cliffs behind the apartment. Alexander and Filipa were great hosts.

appartement très bien situé
calme, bien aménagé et propre je recommande cette adresse
Great location! The apartment is bright, clean and well equipped. Though it was a bit hard for us to carry our luggage without lift, we loved it. Great experience, thank  Alexandre's kind and help.

Las fotos.de el departamento llevan a confusion respecto a la realidad, el 2do dormitorio no tiene ventanas ni ventilación,  dormitorio 1 no tiene espacio para pasar de un lado a otro,  es inferior a 30 cms., baño no tiene ventilación y no se hizo entrega del depto en forma oportuna y en buenas condiciones.

Perfecta ubicación para visitar Lisboa a pie. El apartamento es tal como se muestra en las fotos con la excepción de la tv que era de pantalla plana (más moderna). Nos recibieron con un pequeño obsequio de bienvenida y Filipa fué muy agradable y simpática.

Séjour agréable dans un appartement conforme aux photos, très bien entretenu et très bien situé. Merci à Alexandre pour sa disponibilité lors de nos échanges. Je n'hésiterais pas à y retourner lors d'un prochain séjour à Lisbonne.
excellent apartment in the heart of Lisbon. Alex even provided complimentary wines and cheeses. Amazingly received even though we arrived late. Highly recommend!

Great location, accessible by car which is no small feat in Alfama!

L'appartement est idéalement situé pour un séjour à Lisbonne. Près du métro et près d'un des plus beaux quartiers : alfama. Bonne literie, belle décoration et bons équipements. Accueil chaleureux. On recommande !

ITS A PERFECTLY LOCATED FLAT IN LISBON. REALLY CONFORTABLE FOR 2, WELL EQUIPPED. IT HAS A DECENT VIEW AND THE HOST IS REALLY CONSIDERED AND DYNAMICAL.

Beautiful gem in the middle of Alfama! Very quiet, yet close to restaurants and places to see.

Everything was perfect! Alexandre asked all our questions very fast and help us in everything.
The apartment is very good located in Alfama district, in avery nice area very close of the city centre, you can go walking. Near to the house there are a very nice restaurants, cafes...etc. It is a very good area and the apartment is very nice. I recommend a lot!

Nous sommes restés 4 nuits dans le logement d'Alexandre. Les avantages: tout d'abord, Alexandre est un hôte très accueillant avec qui nous avons eu plaisir à échanger. Il a pris le temps de tout nous expliquer concernant le logement, mais aussi la ville, les choses à voir et nous avons discuté de choses et d'autres pendant un petit moment. Il est très facile de trouver le logement et Alexandre est disponible pour remettre les clés à tout moment. Ensuite, le logement est très bien situé, au pied de l'Alfama, dans un quartier vivant, mais de bonnes fenêtres permettent de l'isoler correctement des nuisances extérieures. Il est correctement équipé, bien que de petites choses pourraient être améliorées. Le plus gros point négatif a été pour nous le bruit des voisins, quasi permanent. Il est possible que l'immeuble (ancien) dans lequel se trouve l'appartement soit tout entier (ou presque) dédié à la location et de ce fait, il y a beaucoup d'allers et retours, de nuit comme de jour. De plus, l'appartement étant ancien, on entendait les voisins du dessus comme s'ils étaient dans la même pièce que nous, une femme criait après son enfant qui se mettait ensuite à pleurer, et quand ils courraient ou marchaient, on aurait dit qu'un troupeau d'éléphants traversaient la pièce... Pour conclure, je pense que ce logement est très bien pour un couple ou un groupe d'amis qui cherche uniquement un lit où se reposer et qui compte passer la plupart de son temps à l'extérieur. Or nous voyageons avec un petit enfant ce qui nous oblige à nous poser de temps à autre afin de respecter des temps de repos, de sieste etc... et là, ça devient pratiquement invivable, nous n'avions qu'une hâte, quitter le logement au plus vite! Encore une fois, Alexandre n'y est pour rien, il est très accueillant, son logement est propre et correctement équipé, mais personnellement, nous n'avons pas passé un très bon séjour à cause de ces nuisances (et attention, nous ne sommes pas des chochottes du bruit, on entend VRAIMENT tout!) et si c'était à refaire, nous ne choisirions pas ce logement de nouveau... Désolée Alexandre... :(
