Alex, our host, was very helpful and pleasant. He was always perfectly on time to meet us and he also helped us to store our luggage after the checkout.

Alexandre was a great host and welcomed us into his truly charming apartment with those beautiful tiles. He took the time to answer our questions and show us important info on the city map.  The location was perfect for exploring all that Lisbon has to offer and there were many shops and restaurants within walking distance. The apartment itself was spacious and quiet, with all the amenities we needed. We enjoyed our stay.
Nous avons passé un merveilleux week-end à Lisbonne. Notre hôte était très accueillant. L'appartement est propre,  bien équipé et très bien situé.merci a Alexandre pour la bouteille de vin.

Le logement était bien décrit.
Alexandre nous a bien renseigné et les appartement était bien situé
Petites attentions culinaires du pays

Hele fijne locatie in de historische wijk met leuke en gezellige restaurants en winkeltjes waar Lissabon bekend om staat. Ook een veilige en rustige buurt. Alles is van uit hier goed bereikbaar. Het schone appartment is precies zoaka de foto's aangeven. Alexandre is een hele fijne gastheer, spreekt zeer goed Engels, is heel gastvrij en heeft ons leuke tips gegeven. Hij woont in het blok er naast dus is goed bereikbaar en staat klaar wanneer dat nodig is. Het taxivervoer dat hij kan regelen is ook helemaal goed. Wij vertrokken tegen de avond en mochten tot die tijd het appartement nog gebruiken. Indien mogelijk zijn in- en uitcheck tijden bespreekbaar. Als wij ooit nog naar Lissabon gaan boeken we zeker weer een appartement in deze buurt bij Alexandre.
We had an amazing weekend in Lisbon. Our host was very welcoming. The apartment is neat, clean, well equipped and a great location.
Flat is located in a great area, between two underground lines and a 10 minute walk to placa do comercio. Alexandre was absolutely fantastic and helpful. Flat was quite large and very clean!
Nice location. Nice apartment.

Alexandre est un hôte qui se rend très disponible , il a répondu à toutes nos attentes , nous avions projeté d'aller surfer sur la côte , il nous a mis en relation avec une equipe sur Carcavelos, nous nous y sommes rendus en train , la personne est venue nous chercher, notre cours de surf s'est bien passé . Nous étions une famille de 4 avec 2 adolescents . L'appartement présente suffisamment d'espace . Il est joliment décoré , bien situé, proche des sites d'intérêts, les transports en communs sont proches . Juste un petit problème d'évacuation des eaux de la cuisine qui se sont retrouvées dans la salle de bains . Plomberie à revoir .
Frédérique . A
Bouches du Rhône
Great stay, great location, great accommodation, great person. Everything was more than we expect. Highly recommended!
Alexandre foi muito simpatico e comunicativo. O apartamento é um tesouro e sua localizaçao é perfeita.

Vi var meget glade for at bo i lejligheden, der
ligger perfekt i Alafama. Alexandre er
meget venlig og serviceminded.
Han hentede os i lufthavnen, og kørte os
direkte til lejligheden.
Alletiders ophold, vi kommer gerne igen.
Med venlig hilsen
Kirsten Krüger

O apartamento é charmoso, aconchegante e bem equipado. O bairro é  agradável e de fácil acesso. Foi uma ótima escolha pois foi possível realizar todos os  passeios programados pela facilidade de locomoção. Recomendo o apartamento porque ele realmente corresponde ao que está descrito no site. Agradeço ao anfitrião pelas dicas e sugestões de passeios e pela hospitalidade.

El apartamento es confortable y muy bonito, perfecto para dos parejas . Alexandre muy amablemente nos dio indicaciones sobre Lisboa y hasta nos dejó una botella de vino de detalle.
Para visitar Lisboa es perfecto, está ubicado en le barrio de Alfama que para mi es un plus.
Alexandre was a very nice gentleman, and replied timely anytime you have questions. The flat was great and we did enjoy staying there.

der Empfang von Alexandre ist ihm mit einer Flasche gutem Rotwein echt gelungen; er hat sich auch persönlich die Zeit genommen uns zu empfangen und in das Appartement und die Nachbarschaft einzuweisen; die Lage des Appartements ist absolut top!!! in der nahen Umgebung ist alles zu finden, angefangen von ein paar kleinen Tapas Bars für Frühstück-Mittag-Abendessen bis hin zu einem Ministore;

Una pasada! En pleno centro de Lisboa (cerca de la plaza del Comercio) muy limpio, cómodo y cuidado al detalle. Alexandre es muy amable y estuvo atento por si necesitábamos cualquier cosa. Muy recomendable!

Alexandre really gentle, welcoming in Lisbon with a good bottle of Red wine. Very good apartment: what you see in the photos is real.
Apartment in the center of Alfama, very close to transport (taxi are really cheap )
Apartment and host really suggested. Thanks Alexandre!

L'appartement est impeccable et très bien situé. Alexandre a été très accueillant et disponible durant tout le séjour.

Je recommande très fortement un séjour chez Alexandre.

Nous avons passés un excellent séjour dans l'appartement d'Alexandre. Il nous a plus que bien accueilli, avec une bouteille de vin et du chocolat en bonus. L'appartement  a beaucoup de charme et est décoré avec goût. Il est idéalement situé: à deux minutes à pied du Tage, du musée du Fado et à 15 minutes à pied du quartier du Chiado. A la fois calme pour dormir et proche de la vie nocturne Lisboète si l'on veut sortir, je recommande vivement!

Un séjour trop court mais absolument parfait dans cet appartement (qui mérite son titre de "charming")
Alexandre est un hôte très accueillant, chaleureux et très attentif à toutes nos attentes
Une adresse à recommander sans réserve pour tous ceux qui veulent un aperçu sur Lisbonne tout en restant près du fleuve et des embarcadère pour l'autre rive (et tous près de la fondation J.SARAMAGO, pour les amateurs)

Alexandre est un hôte parfait avec un super accueil ,vin, chocolat,explications détaillées en français et sourire en prime.
L appartement très bien situé est extrêmement calme.
Les lits super confortables
La télé, la wifi extra...
Beaucoup de doc a disposition .il y a même un guide sur le Portugal en français et des parapluies au cas où.....
Seul petit bémol il manque peut être une casserole et une poêle un peu plus grande.

We had a wonderfull stay at Alexandre's place. He welcommed us frendly and put some wine and chocolate on the table.  The appartement met our expectations although the matrassen were a little bit hard. The neighbourhood is just perfect to explore alfama and the centre is nearby. It was a nice stay in Lissabon, we enjoyed it very much.

The location of this apartment was perfect and in walking distance of lovely restaurants, shops and tourist spots.

The apartment was well decorated, clean and chocolates and wine on arrive were a nice touch!
Très bon sejour. Appartement très agréable, très propre et très accueillant. Nous avons passé un excellent séjour, le quartier est vivant mais avec l'avantage d'avoir un appartement très calme.
Alexandre offered us a nice bottle of wine, juices and chocolate that made our arrival very pleasant. The apartment is in a very good location and is very nice.

The apartment is very nice : the location near the important part of Lisbon is useful for visiting the old city, the transportation is near and pratical from the airport, the room are big and clean, the area is calm, you can kitchen if you want and enjoy the view.
Alexandre is a nice host which indicate you what to do in the city if you and he is welcomed.
Thanks for this week-end in Lisbon !

Alexandre was a great host and I cannot recommend the flat higly enough! Location is perfect for sightseeing as it's right there in the middle of old town where you can explore smaller streets and climb all those stairs that pop out of nowhere and walking distance to more urban area where you can explore more bars and restaurants.
Alexandre was kind enough to let us check-in earlier a bit and there was a very nice surprise waiting on the table in the living room!

I really recommend this place to everyone who is visiting Lisbon!

I will be back for sure shortly :)

Our stay in Lisbon started right when we met Alexandre! :) He's one of the most welcoming and helpful hosts we've met throughout our entire Europe trip! Welcome drinks and chocolates were prepared for us upon arrival :) Apart from showing us around the apartment, he was keen in striking a conversation with us :) Alexandre's apartment is located close to the metro, approximately 5 minutes walk. It is also convenient getting around attractions! The apartment has everything you need to stay comfortably :) If you are looking for a value-for-money apartment, this apartment is perfect! Although it was a short stay, we really enjoyed ourselves! Will definitely stay here again if I come back to Lisbon. Thank you Alexandre for everything, we hope to see you again! :D

The four of us stayed a Alexandre's apartment for 5 nights and had an absolut fantastic time in Lissabon!
The apartment is located in Alfama, the most beautiful part of the city with many little snack bars, restaurants, gift shops and mini supermarkets just around the corner. The next Metro stop is about 10 min walking distance away.
It was really easy and pleasent to communicate with Alexandre during the booking and trip preparation process, he always responded within a few hours.
Upon our arrival, he welcomed us very warmly and friendly, showed us around the apartment and had even prepared some drinks, a bottle of wine and chocolate for us, which was most kind of him!

The apartment itself is, just like on the photos, really comfy and decorated very tastefully. Cleanliness is not perfect, but sufficient. TV and WiFi work fine and there are several maps of Lissabon provided.
If you plan on cooking in the apartment often, you will likely get a little frustrated with the cooking equipment, as many devices (like knifes and pans) are very worn. As a plus, basic ingrediants like oil, salt, pepper & some spices, tea can be found in the kitchen cupboard.

All-in-all we would definitely recommend the apartment as a well-located, comfy and affordable accommodation. It won't be the last time we've been to Lissabon!
Very nice place, great location, and Alexandre is an excellent host. Staying here was definitely a key part of the experience of visiting Lisbon. I highly recommend it.

Tres bon emplacement de cet appartement pour partir à la découverte des ruelles de l'Alfama et d'ailleurs ,métro,bus ,taxi proches, appartement agréable, que nous partagions à 4 rien n'y manque  Vin ,chocolat de bienvenue !!Nous n'avons pas eu le plaisir de rencontrer Alexandre ,mais la personne qui nous attendait pour nous remettre les clés est charmante et parle français ! Une bonne adresse ,tres facile aussi d'accés si on vient en voiture on peut se garer en-bas de l'immeuble .
Perfect location to explore Alfama and around

Alexandre was an amazing host. The communication before the trip was amazing and very fast in response.
He kindly left us to do the check-in earlier that the usual time.
The apartment is very nice and clean, just like it is shown at the pictures. The location is perfect, 10 minutes walking from the Santa Apolonia train station and also from Plaza do Comercio (very center of Lisbon). He left us as a courtesy a bottle of wine, couple of juices and chocolate. Thanks Alexandre.
I fully recommend to stay with him.
Alexandre very warmly welcomed us to the appartment. A bottle of wine, water and chocolate was waiting for us! Alexandre reacts very fast and friendly to SMS/email and solves problems immediately.

The expreience at Alexander´s apartment was really excellent. The place is strategically located in Alfama´s neigbourhood and the place is very comfortable. We highly recomend it. Alexander is very kind and he helped us with everything we needed.
We will come back for sure! Location perfect, house is beautiful and it was very quiete and clean inside the house! Thank you so much!
Great place.  Nice people.  Central location.  Highly recommended.
Appartement de bon goût ..très bien équipé..quartier très agréable ..proximité transports en commun..je recommande sans retenue

Alexandre made sure that everything was set up from start to finish to make my stay as smooth and comfortable as possible. I never met him in person, but we talked on the phone briefly so he could give me the lay of the land and "show me around" the apartment. The place was very clean, plenty of space for 2-4 people, and has basically everything you could need. The location was good, we only wished we stayed longer! Unfortunately the weather wasn't the greatest. Note: take the metro - a taxi will cost a fortune in Lisboa.
Great apartment and great value for the money. Alexandre was a responsive host. The location was quite good too.

Awesome experience in Lisbon thanks to Alexandre and his beautiful apartment! Leading up to our stay Alexandre was in communication and offered advice and suggestions on navigating the city upon our arrival. He met us at the apartment and offered wonderful advice on how to get the most out of the city during our short stay. All of his suggestions were fantastic. The apartment was beautiful, clean, and comfortable. Thanks Alexandre!

Perfect location - neat, clean and tidy Apartment, with all needed utilities and big bathroom. Alexandre is a very easy going person - grade 10/10
In all categories.

Alexandre ist ein SUPER-Gastgeber und für einen Trip nach Lissabon absolut zu empfehlen. Die Unterkunft liegt direkt im Herzen des Stadtteils Alfama und man kann schon zu Fuß alles sehr gut erreichen, ist aber auch verkehrstechnisch gut angebunden.
Unterkunft selbst ist sehr schick, gemütlich eingerichtet, sauber und ordentlich. Da 2 Schlafzimmer vorhanden sind, hatten wir zu 4 Personen eine schöne Woche ohne Probleme.
Alexandre selbst ist sehr aufmerksam und flexibel, hatte gute Insider-Tips für unseren Aufenthalt und ist auf alle unsere Wünsche sehr entgegenkommend sowie hilfsbereit eingegangen!
Nochmals VIELEN DANK für die schöne Zeit, vielleicht sehen wir uns ja mal wieder.

Alexandre made us feel very welcome and was very accommodating. He gave us plenty of tips on what to do in Lisbon and how to get around.
The apartment is just like in the photos, it was very clean and we were given nice towels too. The location is also great, plenty to do within walking distance and also easy to get a taxi.
Thank you Alexandre!

Beautiful and clean apartment right in the centre of Lisbon. I stayed here for 2 night with my friends and we were all very satisfied. Alexandre was very friendly and even offered us a bottle of wine and chocolate, we immediately felt at home. I would definitely recommend  this apartment to my friends and family.
Incredible place!Alexander is very nice helpful and great guy.Best localization to discover Lisboa.Highly recomending!!!:)
Really nice, beautiful and comfortable appartment. Alexandre is a great friendly host. He gave us some great tips on what to visit in Lisbon

we stayed at Alexandre's apartment for a long weekend. It was very nice. The flat is comfortable and very well located. The tiles are beautiful;)
I recommend it for its location and general atmosphere ;)

The host and the neighborhood were both wonderful.  It is a very charming place in a lovely, historic neighborhood, close to the train station and many attractions.  The apartment is lovely and comfortable. We were very happy there, and would be happy to go back.  Alexandre welcomed us with everything we needed and more.

We had a wonderful stay at the Alfama Charming Apartment at Lisbon, which looks just like the photos! The Apartment has the perfect location in the beautiful Alfama and we would definitely choose this apartment again for another stay in Lisbon!

Alexandre was a true hoste, on time for the check in, very careful
with explaining where all the amenities were and work. All was according to pics and description!

Nous avons passé une très agréable semaine dans l'appartement qui correspondait aux photos, dans un quartier pittoresque et proche des sites.
Notre hote a tres bien accueilli nos amis arrivés avant nous, je regrette de ne pas avoir fait connaissance d Alexandre avant notre départ.
Comme nous n'avons pas eu le temps de tout voir nous reviendrons.
Nous conseillerons des autres amis qui doivent venir a Lisbonne de venir chez Alexandre.

Charming apartment, charming host, charming city. The flat was very clean, best located and absolutely nice equipped. Alexandre gave us a lot of useful advises for our stay in Lisbon. We couldn't imagine a better place to stay for us 3 ! Muito obrigado, Alexandre!

We found a very nice and well equipped apartment just in the middle of Alfama. Exactly as shown on the pictures. Bars, restaurants just everything nearby as well as some mini markets. The metro is a 5 minutes walk away. A 24h ticket for 6€ is recommended which can be used for metro, cable car as well as for the elevators and escalator as often as you need.
We have been welcomed by Alexandre which is just a friendly and "charming" guy. Like his apartments. We even got some small drinks, a bottle of wine and chocolate bar on our welcome. We enjoyed our 3 night stay and would recommend this apartment.

Alexandre's apartment is very tide and nice, and has a good location in Alfama (even thought the immediate outside looks a little run-down). We had a great time exploring the alleys of Alfama (and the rest of Lisbon, via easy access to public transportation) from here.

Alexandre was very nice, helpful, and always available for questions and helpful with anything we needed (including ordering for us a large taxi to the airport to accommodate us, the twins and their car seats, and the luggage).

Alexandre è veramente gentile e cordiale, ci ha dato le indicazioni per dove andare a cenare e cosa visitare a Lisbona.
L'appartamento è molto bello, spazioso e pulito. È nell'Alfama, a mio avviso il quartiere piu pittoresco della città.
Consigliatissimo!

Merci Alexandre de toutes les attentions du début à la fin.
Nous sommes arrivées vers 14h à l'appartement, tout était propre. Il est très bien agencé pour 4 personnes. Ce logement est idéalement situé pour faire des visites (en plein cœur de l'Alfama et proche du tramway et d'une station de métro). Cela nous a permis de profiter pleinement de Lisbonne pendant 4 jours.
Alexandre n'ayant pas pu être présent à l'arrivée, est passé nous rendre visite en milieu de séjour. Merci encore pour ce séjour ! Nous reviendrons sûrement.

The Apartment was really nice and cozy!  Felt like home! The best place to visit the Alfama with all the great restaurants and bars and culture! Alexandre is a very friendly host who really cares about his guests and gives you good tips where to go and what to see! Highly recommended!!!

Amfitrion amable y atento. Nos explico muy bien que y como visitar lisboa.
El piso muy bonito y muy bien situado.
Parking a escasos 100m por solo 8€ al dia.
Repitiriamos en otra ocasion
Apartment was o.k. Alexandre was inviseble.

Very warm welcome
Great location and modern clean apartment

A wonderfully located apartment right on the edge of the beautiful and historic Alfama district! Alex was extremely helpful in giving is tips on what to see and how to see things with our short stay in Lisbon. I would recommend this apartment to anyone looking to visit Lisbon!

We had a wonderful time with the ALFAMA CHARMING APARTMENT.
It is located in the central historic of Lisbon, very good neighbourhood and public transportation. Alexandre is very friend and take care all details to make all visitors welcome! Strong Recommended!
He was very kind, helpful, and the apartment was as described.Excellent location, amazing neighbourhood. Thank you so much for everything, we have a great time in Lisbon
Excellent hôte, bon emplacement, c'était parfait

Alexandre was a fantastic host, he went out of his way to make us feel comfortable and welcome. He gave us a map and showed us the areas to visit, along with some great information about local markets and points of interest. The location of the flat is great, it is in the old town within walking distance to all the main sites. The flat itself was beautiful and clean with ample space for the two of us. We can't recommend Alexandre and this apartment highly enough.

Alex was very quick to respond and very attentive. He was there to welcome us on our arrival with chocolate and a bottle of wine. In his lovely apartment, you'll find several tourist leaflets and maps which is extremely helpful.
His apartment is very clean and beautifully decorated. Most places are within walking distance, a lot of restaurants in the area and historical spots.

The pictures and descriptions truly lived up to the expectations. The apartment is in an excellent and convenient location, our host Alexandre met us there promptly and waited patiently as we arrived a little late, offered to give us local information and advice, greeted us with water and some local food offerings, and answered all of our questions about the area and apartment. It was a great stay, and was a wonderful first taste of Lisboa!
We would stay there again for sure!

A couple of my friend and their little daughter and I had a wonderful stay in Alexandre´s apartment ! He warmly welcomed us at his apartment and it is really a big surprise that he prepared chocolate, red wine and other drinks for us . Alexandre knew LISBON very well and he gave us the best recommendations for our short visit in LISBON. We follow up his advice and enjoyed our visiting to Palace of Belem, Monument to the Discoveries and other major sights . Located in ALFAMA ,his apartment is cozy and tidy just like home. It’s easy to go everywhere of LISBO . I can strongly recommend this apartment and hope to return there next time!
Alexandre was a great host and the apartment was amazing! We had such a great stay we can't wait to come back! Two days was not enough!

Alexandre greeted us upon arrival with several goodies and warm friendliness. The apartment was in a convenient location and suited our needs perfectly. The bed was very comfortable and the apartment was stocked with the most needed amenities. We would definitely recommend this apartment!
Alexandre is extremely accommodating and great help.  The unit is in a great location especially with all the festivities around at night.

We have just spent a fabulous five days at Alexandre's apartment and couldn't have asked for a better experience. Alexandre is a seasoned professional who ensured the apartment was perfect for all our needs. The location is ideal, particularly if you want to enjoy the old cobbled charm of the Alfama district, whilst still being within walking distance of the centre of town. The apartment itself was clean and comfortable and a delight to come back to after a long days sightseeing. I would recommend Alexandre's place to anyone looking to spend some time in Lisbon. Thank you for a great holiday!

Merci Alexandre pour ton chaleureux accueil accompagné d'un très sympathique petit cadeau de bienvenue !!
Nous avons beaucoup apprécié également que tu puisses garder nos bagages dans la matinée.
L'appartement était parfait, fidèle à la description, idéalement placé et très calme.
Nous avons passé un excellent séjour !!
Encore un grand merci et si nous repassons par Lisbonne, nous reviendrons chez toi avec plaisir !

L'appartement d'Alexandre est super typique et très bien placé. On a passé un bon moment, on était 4 et c'était parfait.
Alexandre est très serviable et s'est adapté à notre planning pour la remise des clefs.
Très bon choix d'appartement sur alfama!

Fomos muito bem recebido pelo representante do anfitrião, o apto é muito bom, bem confortável, bem decorado, bem iluminado e muito bem localizado que permitiu total apoio para estadia e de passeios e também de estacionamento. Gostamos muito.

Sehr herzliche und zuvorkommende Betreuung.
Schönes Appartement mit besonderem Ambiente.
Super Lage - direkt in der Alfama - alles gut erreichbar.
Kommen gerne wieder.
The apartment was beautiful, very nice stay.

This is a "dream" airbnb host and site in the Alfama district. Alexandre met us at the apartment with the warmest welcome imaginable, both in his personality and the goodies: wine, chocolate, juice. The apartment is in a superb location and very comfortable. The unique decor added to the pleasure of staying there. The kitchen was well equipped so we could have breakfast and light meals "at home." The wifi was good, hot water on demand, TV worked, and the library had very useful visitor information. We walked easily from the apartment to most places, and public transportation was very close.

We arrived with a car and had parking during our whole stay in front of the building. We only had to feed the meter, at about 8 Euros a day, free on the weekend.

Alexandre provided us with a map and directions to places we wanted to visit. He was available throughout our 4-day stay, and it was fun just bumping into him on the street. Alexandre is the kind of person we would have liked to have as a friend if we lived in the same locale! We highly recommend staying at the "Tile Apartment."

Excellent accueil, vin, chocolat et boissons fraiches nous attendaient à notre arrivée....un peu retardée.
L'appartement était en tout point conforme aux photos et au descriptif, parfaitement isolé des bruits de la rue et de la chaleur extérieur.
Le quartier de l'Alfama est très bien placé, à proximité de tous les moyens de transports (métro, tramway, tram et bus.....) ainsi que de nombreux restaurants typiques de la cuisine portugaise (prévoir les paiements généralement en espèces......).
Nous avons passé une semaine très agréable, en plus avec un très beau temps, à la découverte de Lisbonne, des nombreux musées et monuments expliquant le passé et le présent.
Alexandre nous a facilité la garde des bagages entre le check out et notre départ en fin de soirée.
A recommander.
PS: un plus pour trouver facilement l'immeuble en venant par les transports en commun serait de joindre un plan du quartier détaillé depuis la station de métro.

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour. Alexandre est très sympathique, il nous a accueilli chaleureusement malgré notre heure d'arrivée tardive. Il répond aux sms immédiatement. L'appartement est très bien situé, accès piéton au centre ville et au métro, nombreux restos et petits magasins d'appoints dans le quartier. L'appartement est très agréable, assez spacieux, bien décoré. Un petit bémol sur la literie, pas très confortable. Je recommande vraiment cet appartement.

I travelled to Lisbon with two girl friends and we really enjoyed this listing. It looks just like the pictures and the location was fantastic. Although Lisbon can be a big city, Alfama is very charming and has many great local restaurants. We loved exploring the area! Alexandre was very easy to communicate with. When we arrived he had a bottle of wine, bottled water, juice boxes and chocolate waiting for us! The listing also has a washer/dryer. Definitely recommend!

Lovely place at the nice Alfama, the place to be to enter the city highlights and to relax in the evening. Alexandre created a spacious room with everything you need in Portugese style. I'd recommend this place with all my (travel)heart. We felt really welcome.

Great apartment and amazing location! The apartment was very comfortable and had everything we needed, including a nice welcome bottle of wine! The location is very good, with lots of restaurants and stores nearby and at the bottom of a hill, which, as we discovered, made getting there much easier.  Everything was great!

Accueil chaleureux d'Alexandre malgré notre retard : il faut presque 1 heure pour venir en métro depuis l'aéroport ( mais très pratique). L'appartement était conforme à nos attentes et à la description. Bien situé, quartier bruyant fenêtre ouverte, insonore fenêtre fermée. Très bon séjour.

The apartment is perfectly located, you only have to walk few minutes to the main square. It was clean and nice as in the pictures and there were maps and all that a tourist needs. Alexandre accepted our late check in and was able to give us usefull  directions and advices. I recommend this place!

Wonderful apartment in a fantastic location.  Alexandre was very welcoming and helpful with recommendations and lots of maps/brochures in the apartment for reference.  Next time I'm in Lisbon I would definitely stay here again!

My friend and I had a fantastic stay here - Alexandre was a very welcoming host and took time out to make recommendations about the city to us which was wonderful. Great location, homely apartment - would highly recommend. Thanks Alexandre for having us!

Nous avons été très très bien accueilli à une heure tardive. L'appartement est idéalement situé près du musée du Fado. Alexandre est un hôte charmant .Des rafraîchissements nous attendaient à notre arrivée, ainsi qu'une bouteille de vin. De nombreux dépliants touristiques étaient également les bienvenus. A recommander. Marie Gamon
Excellent welcome. Description accurate. Interesting area - very convenient location for Alfama.
Great location, great host (Alexandre was there to meet us when we arrived and showed us around the apartment), place was neat and tidy.
We had a wonderful stay! Alexandre was very helpful and could check us in late at night. The apartment was clean, spacious and modern looking. Great location!

Très bon accueil d'Alexandre avec de petites attentions.
Appartement conforme à la description.

Alex was an amazing host that offered us plenty of help with our stay in Lisboa. The place was beautiful as it had a very cozy and charming vibe to it. Everything that was seen on the posting was exactly what we saw when we arrived. We were all grateful for the amount of kind hospitality and attentiveness that was given by Alex. Absolutely enjoyed our stay!

Die Wohnung ist einfach ein Traum. Die Lage in Alfama ist sehr zentral, überall in der Nähe sind Bars, kleine Lokale und Supermärkte. Das Preis-Leistungsverhältnis ist unschlagbar! Die Wohnung hat wirklich ihren ganz besonderen Charme, wie auf den Bildern schon zu erkennen ist. Die Küche ist super augestattet, die Wohnung war sehr sauber und die Heizung war ideal für die kalten Tage in Lissabon. Alexandre empfing uns äußert sympathisch und zuvorkommend. Allen unseren Wünschen wurde nachgegangen, ein wirklich toller Gastgeber. Wir können diese Wohnung wirklich empfehlen, man bekommt ein super Gesamtpaket.

Alexandre was een hele attente (en voor de dames, knappe :p) gastheer. De communicatie op voorhand verliep heel goed, alles was heel duidelijk afgesproken, en ook qua vervoer daar hadden we op voorhand alle informatie gekregen.

Eenmaal daar stond Alexandre ons op te wachten en toonde hij het appartement, en gaf hij ons extra tips. We mochten hem al onze vragen stellen.

Het appartement had een hele goede ligging in het centrum van Alfama, bus en tram zijn op wandelafstand, maar de meeste dingen doe je te voet. Het was een heel charmant typisch appartementje voor de streek, heel gezellig.

Tijdens het verblijf was hij ook de hele tijd voor ons beschikbaar. En perfecte gastheer en ideale locatie dus ;).

Tivemos dias maravilhosos. O apartamentos é limpo, muito confortável, boa localização. Alexandre é muito simpático, nos recebeu muito bem! As fotos definem o apartamento com perfeição!
Cristiane, Rita e Octavio - Brasil

Merci beaucoup à Alexandre qui est un hôte très agréable. Notre avion avait du retard et il nous a gentiment attendu.
Il nous a donné toutes les explications dont nous avions besoin y compris durant notre séjour quand nous avions besoin d'un renseignement.
L'appartement est ravissant, très bien équipé.
Très bien situé également.
Nous y reviendrons.
un accueil tres agreable,sympathique, un appartement tres bien amenager et tres bien situé!!bref,que du bonheur!!!

Alexandre welcomed us with a warm and sympathic hug, took time to explain everything and he is so much helpful! The apartment is very very nice and comfortable and the location is perfekt! For us was a wonderful stay! Thank you!

Le logement est confortable et très bien situé. Vous pouvez tout faire à pied. Nous avons été trés bien accueillis par Alexandre qui nous a offert du vin et du chocolat pour Noël. Il nous a bien conseillé pour nous rendre à Belem et Sintra. Dolorés de la Réunion

Alexandre n'était pas là à notre arrivée, mais il a été présent avant en répondant de manière précise et toujours de façon très rapide à mes questions. Son beau-père nous a très bien accueilli!
L'appartement est idéalement situé pour visiter Lisbonne, il est proche des transports et des principaux quartiers touristiques.
Il est propre, très calme et agréable. Très bon séjour!

Really great place at a perfect location! A quiet neighbourhood, but lots to do (restaurants and cafes) in just a few minutes walk. The apartment was clean and spacious. We had a hearty welcome from the father in law. So everything was just perfect for us!
Alex non c'era ma il suocero ci ha accolto egregiamente.  Due giorni piovosi, ma l'appartamento è stato pratico ed economico.

This is a lovely apartment in a great location, it was clean and we had everything we needed to feel at home. Alexandre was a thoughtful host and it was a pleasure to meet Jose, who welcomed us when we arrived.

Bonjour
nous n'avons pas été accueilli par Alexandre qui était en voyages d'affaires; mais par son beau père - father in law - José qui est un homme charmant, adorable, généreux et qui s'exprime dans un français parfait comme beaucoup de personne de sa génération au Portugal.
La qualité de l'appartement est bonne; je suggère qu'il faille mettre un peu plus de vaisselles d'une part, d'installer un grand lavabo et d'autre part de mettre du linge de table et plus de torchons, serviettes.
La proximité du quartier Alfama, bien que ancien, ce qui n'est pas en soi un défaut; est particulièrement intéressante - proche du musée du Fado, de la cathédrale, des restaurants à fado. Même sans la vue sur le port et la mer on se sent bien. Merci donc.

Wir waren super untergebracht. Das Appartment ist genial. Die Lage perfekt. Man war mitten im Lissaboner Alltagsleben. Beim morgentlichen Gang zum Bäcker die Stufen hoch konnten wir Lissabon in den Gassen der Alfama erwachen sehen. Die Wohnung ist geschmackvoll eingerichtet und super sauber. Alexandre ist ein perfekter Gastgeber, sehr zuvorkommend, freundlich und äußerst hilfbereit. Gerne kommen wir wieder.

Het was geweldig, mooi, ruim appartement op een goede plek. Dicht bij het centrum, bij Alfama en toch lekker rustig. Alexandre is een goede gastheer die veel informatie geeft en klaar staat voor zijn gasten. Hij wil je op allerlei manieren helpen om er een top verblijf van te maken. Als we nog eens naar Lissabon gaan , gaan we zeker weer terug.
Very nice apartment very well situated to visit Lisbon. Alexandre was a perfect host. We had a wonderful sunny stay!
Thank you for the warm welcome!

Nous avons été très très bien accueillis par notre hôte Alexandre. L'appartement est rmagnifique et clair, tout est propre et très bien équipé. Il est aussi très bien situé en bas d'ALFAMA, à 8 mn de la place du Commerce, pratique pour tout visiter à pied. Nous y retournerons avec plaisir.

Alexandre was a wonderful host who stayed up late to receive us even though our flight was at 11pm. The apartment was very tastefully designed and located in the historical alfama district. It was easy to get around to most places and there was no shortage of restaurants in the vicinity. Would stay here again on our next trip to Lisbon!

Alex was a great host. His place had everything you needed and was decorated very nicely. A nice arrival gift of wine and chocolate, he was always available and even booked us a taxi for our flight out of town as we didn't speak Portuguese. Thanks so much!
-Jeff and Tom
Alexandre is a really nice guy, very warm and welcoming! Location is great as is the apartment. I would definitely recommend staying here.

Super séjour ! Appartement propre et bien situé !
Alexandre nous a donnée de bonnes adresses et bien conseillés pour les visite importantes.
Accueil parfait

Merci Alexandre
Everything was as described. We felt very welcome and at home immediately. We enjoyed experiencing lisbon on foot from here.
Très bon accueil !!

Accueil chaleureux d'Alexandre qui a su composé avec notre heure d'arrivée matinale et a accepté de garder nos sacs l'après midi de notre retour avant de prendre l'avion.L'appartement est idéalement placé en bas d'alfama(pas besoin de trainer les valises dans les montées étroites et pavées de Lisbonne) et calme .Bien aménagé et agréablement décoré également bien situé pour découvrir les quartiers à pied,proche des transports en commun,gare,bus,métro et tram.excellent séjour à Lisbonne

Staying in Alexandres Apartment was perfect for the four of us. We could reach everything easily by foot or bus and we felt very welcome and safe. The Apartment is sunny, very nicely furnitured and well equipped.

Alexandre è stato molto gentile e premuroso. All'arrivo ci ha fatto trovare una bottiglia di vino e del cioccolato per le nostre bambine.
La posizione centralissima dell'appartamento, molto carino e ben arredato, è stata perfetta per noi che viaggiavamo con due bambine piccole.

Alexandre nous a réservé un accueil chaleureux et attentionné.
Son appartement est excellent : idéalement placé, calme avec une salle de vie lumineuse et bien adapté pour une famille de 4 personnes.
A recommander.
The apartment was in a good location and we had a very enjoyable stay. The rooms were clean and comfortable and it was quiet at night. Thanks for a great few days in lisbon.

L'appartement d'Alexandre est idéalement placé au pied de l'alfama, dans une zone très touristique et pourtant très calme. Il est ensuite très facilement accessible en voiture car situé sur les quais, à 10 minutes à pied de la grande place du commerce. L'appartement est enfin très confortable et convient parfaitement pour une famille de 4 personnes. Alexandre est une personne charmante qui parle un anglais remarquable et comprend le Français. il nous a donné de bons conseils et nous a réservé un chaleureux accueil.

We hebben een geweldig verblijf gehad in het appartement van Alexandre. Het ziet er precies zo uit als op de foto's en leek zelfs nog groter; goed onderhouden en gerenoveerd. Alexandre stond klaar met een fles wijn en chocolade en was er voor de vragen die we hadden. Het appartement ligt in een mooie, rustige buurt en van hier loop je in een kwartiertje naar het centrum. Perfect! Mochten we ooit teruggaan naar Lissabon dan zeker naar dit appartement.

Très bon séjour.
Alexandre est un homme charmant et très serviable.
L'appartement est tel que sur les photos et très bien placé pour les ballades à pieds dans la vieille ville.
Prévoir un appareil pour les moustiques à Lisbonne .
Très bonne adresse

La gentilezza e la disponibilità di Alexandre, la simpatia della moglie Sofia (ottimo il suo italiano), la posizione e la qualità dell'appartamento (funzionale, grazioso e arredato con gusto) rendono il soggiorno piacevole e consigliato per qualunque esigenza. Ottima base di partenza per visitare Lisbona senza difficoltà.
The apartment was beautiful and in a great location. Alex was a wonderful host - very kind, helpful and easy to contact. Would definitely recommend!

The apartment is very nice and is well located for easy access to everything we wanted. A car is not necessary with all the easy public transportation options. Alexandre is a wonderful host and was very helpful. An excellent choice!

Great location, very close to old town,easy to get to from the airport (10min by taxi). Lovely decor, clean and exactly as per images. Alexandre could not be more helpful. He was very friendky and made us feel very welcome. We will definitely be back one day.

In June 2014, my parents and I travelled to Lisbonne. Alexandre’s apartment caught my eyes on airbnb. The charming colour and nice decoration in this newly furnished apartment added a lot of pleasure for our stay. The apartment has a great location, 5 min to the city sighting bus, and 8-10 min to metro station and 10 min to shopping zone. A lot of typical Portugal restaurants and bars just at the walking distance.
Alexandre is extremely friendly. He offered us useful city visiting information and helped us reserved the taxi on our departure.
You should have a try to be within this charming place.
Alexandre, thank you again and wish you all the best.

Many thanks to Alexandre for being a nice host! Our plane was delayed so we arrived much later than planned but it wasn't a problem at all. The apartment is located in Alfama and the city centre is only a 10-minute walk away. There are a mini-market shop and two good restaurants right next to the apartment. I definitely recommend staying at this place!

Perfect location, very close to city centre, clean, spacious, cosy, everything you need was there - plates, glasses, cutlery, guide books, towels, cable tv, free wi fi, only toiletries like shampoo and shower gel were missing so make sure you bring some. The host was very kind and friendly and even gave us a bottle of Portuguese red wine as a welcoming gift.
Strongly recommend this flat!

Nossa estadia foi excelente no apartamento do Alexandre. Tudo como publicado, local tranquilo e numa área nobre de Alfama. Alexandre nos recebeu calorosamente, ficou à disposição e nos brindou com belos mimos portugueses. Altamente recomendado.

L'appartement est parfaitement situé dans le quartier d'Alfama. C'est idéal pour les visites et les balades dans Lisbonne. Il est entièrement rénové, double vitrage pour éviter le bruit, la literie est très bien. Et pour finir Alexandre est extrêmement gentil et à l’écoute, la communication a été tout le long parfaite. Je ne peux que recommander.
The Alfama apartment is amazing!!  We met Alexandre on the first day and he was so helpful and friendly.  The location is perfect and it had everything we needed.  Thank you Alexandre!

The apartment is really very nice and well located in the neighborhood of Alfama.
Alexandre is a welcoming and helpful
Highly recommended !

Alexandre is the type of guy you want to be greeted by!
Friendly and cool. We had an interesting conversation.
The appartment is simple and convenient and very well located.
Alexandre is very flexible, especially for the check in/out time and makes the most for you to have a great stay.
Go for it!

L'appartement d'Alexandre est très central. Il nous a permis de sillonner les quartiers de l'alfama, du chiado, de la baixa et du bairro alto à pied avec notre petite fille de 5 ans. Alexandre est très disponible, chaleureux et accueillant.

Lovely apartment. Very well located, very central, nice view on a square with purple flowered trees. Spacious, clean and well equiped, and nicely decorated with the tiles (of course) and antique doors. Alexandre was very kind: we were welcomed with a smile, nice tips and even with presents and he brought us a childrens bed, which we had forgotten to ask for in advance.

Appartement extrêmement bien situé pour se balader à pied ou pour rejoindre très vite métro et bus et partir à la découverte de tous les autres quartiers de Lisbonne ; petits commerces et restos sympas à proximité pour être complètement autonomes et s'imprégner de l'Alfama ; appartement bien équipé; hôte charmant et de bon conseil.

Emplacement idéal pour visiter Lisbonne! L'appartement est très chaleureux et fonctionnel.
Alexandre, le propriétaire, est disponible et nous a offert du chocolat et une bouteille de vin portugais.
Très bon souvenir de ce séjour : accueil chaleureux, appartement calme, en accord avec le descriptif. A recommander.

This place is lovely!  Great location, close to downtown and about a ten minute walk to the train stations, which will get you to Belem and Cascais on frequent trains.  Alexandre is a great host - he welcomed us with a bottle of local wine and chocolate and sat with us for 15 minutes as we asked questions about the city.  Definitely recommend this place, and will stay here again in the future!

Nous avons passé 5 jours parfaits à Lisbonne. L'appartement d'Alexandre et sa gentillesse y ont fortement contribué ! L'appartement est très propre confortable et bien équipé mais surtout il est très bien situé dans ce quartier si charmant de l'Alfama à la fois proche du centre ville et calme

Alexandre est vraiment disponible et serviable ; ses conseils ont été précieux pour notre séjour !

Merci encore
Appartement très bien équipé et placé idéalement au coeur d'un quartier historique et vivant .

très chouette appartement au pied du quartier de l'Alfama et de ses petits restaurants! Idéal pour sillonner Lisbonne à pied. Appartement très propre, très bien tenu. L'accueil est des plus chaleureux, Alexandre est vraiment sympathique et prêt à rendre notre séjour très agréable.

Alex was very helpful from the moment I made the booking until the very last day of my stay in Lisbon. The place was very clean and it was just like what was advertised. He also helped us with some tips about halal places to eat and the famous Belem Pastries. We would certainly come back if there is a chance. Overall, I would recommend Alex and his place if you want a satisfying experience in Lisbon.

We had a great stay at Alexandre's flat. It was perfect for 4 persons - really clean, warm, tastefullly decorated :) and it was fully equipped (rooms and kitchen) aswell.

The location is really convenient - walking distance to the main attractions and the city centre. Also the neighbourhood has convenience stores right down the corner.

Alexander was a very warm and kind host - he answered to all our doubts and questions and gave us tips on moving around the city. He was also very flexible in terms of check-in/out timings and keeping our luggage.

Surely recommended flat for a comfortable and reliable stay in Lisbon city!

We couldn't believe our luck finding this place for a four night stay while booking just ten days before. Perfect location, and a real homely feel. Alex had no problem accommodating a very late check-in and made sure we had all our questions answered before he left. Would definitely stay again. Thanks Alex! :-)

Alexandre welcomed us very friendly and accepted to do it nightly because of our flight. He was available during our stay.
Lisbon is great and the apartment was ideally placed to enjoy the city (the restaurant down the street is very good!). The two bedrooms were very convenient for the four of us. It's fully equipped and the decoration is very nice.

The location of the apartment was perfect for travellers. You can reach several places on foot in 15 minutes. Alfama, where the apartment located, has unique atmosphere of old Lisbon. Supermarket is near from the apartment.

Also the apartment was clean and cozy. Alexandre was a truly warm and kind host. The positive impression of Lisbon was partially from Alexandre! He did best what he could do for us, and I will definitely come back when I visit Lisbon again.

we stayed with 4 friends for a week and had a perfect stay.

the apartment is big enough for four. there are two bedrooms (one without extra window, but connected through the living space), each equipped with a very comfortable double bed (both 1,40*2,00m). there are two very large and warm covers and two thinner ones available, so if you stay in the apartment during cold season and are not a couple sharing a bed you might want to bring something extra.

very clean. lovely hot shower. kitchen well equipped and good to use. well situated. interior lets you feel good.

i can only join the opinion of the other users that alexandre is a very kind, caring and well organized host. easy communication via e-mail.

highly recommended!
Excellent value for this appartment very well located. Alexandre is really nice and available. We spent a week end a Lisbon (4 friends) and the place was perfect for us.
Perfect appartment with a perfect host. Thank you!

We loved Lisbon and Alexandre's apartment was ideal for our stay. Right at the edge of the Alfama district, the prettiest area in Lisbon, and walking distance to the castle and handy for the trams.
There were small food and drink shops nearby and lots of places to eat. The Fado museum was literally at the end of the street.
The apartment itself was comfortable and spacious - only 2 of us so nice to have a room each and a good powerful hot shower.
Alexandre was the perfect host with tips, plus wine and chocolates on our arrival.
Can't wait to go back!

Appartement très bien situé, propre et agréable, wifi et plans très utiles. Un très bon point de départ pour découvrir Lisbonne à pied ou en transport en commun (métro et train proche). Alexandre est très sympathique et très disponible, à recommander!
Super appart. Très bien placė. Je recommande. Alexandre est super sympa et arrangeant.

Notre séjour a été très agréable, l'appartement est très bien situé avec les transports en commun à proximité.
L'appartement correspond parfaitement à l'annonce .
Accueil très chaleureux de la part d'Alexandre.
Patrick

My friends and I have recently returned from our trip in Portugal and we got to stay in Lisbon for a couple of nights. We stayed at Alexandre's apartment, which was very nice and clean, also well located.

Very good host! Friendly, helpful, reliable.

The flat is basic and for the price absolutely fine.

We stayed in Alexander's apartment 2 nights (3 people) and had a great time! the apartment is in the best location, walking distance from almost all the attractions in Lisbon, it is clean and spacious, very nicely furnished and styled! Alexandre welcomed us in the apartment with wine and chocolate, and was very kind and helpful. the communication with Alexandre was very easy as he answered all our mails within very short time.
we sure recommend this great apartment which easily accommodates 4 people.

Thank you very much, Alexandre for such a great apartment and very nice welcome! The apartment is great and very conveniently located. Alexandre was very kind allowing us to check in earlier and left us some nice extras like wine, milk etc. we really enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend the apartment for 3-4 people. Thank you!

We absolutely loved the few nights we stayed in Alfama! The apartment was beautiful, the beds very comfortable and it was walking distance to everything we could have wanted to explore within the city. Plus Alex was an amazing host! He greeted us with wine and chocolates and gave us recommendations on where to go in town. I would highly recommend staying here- you'll love it!!

Un grand merci à Alexandre pour son accueil très chaleureux malgré notre heure d'arrivée très tardive. Nous avons passez un très agréable séjour dans son appartement confortable et particulièrement bien situé. Nous avons découvert une ville magnifique aux nombreux et sompteux monuments chargés d'histoire et goûté au charme du Fado au coeur de ce quartier d'Alfama si pittoresque.

Alexandre's apartment was GREAT. Excellent location in Alfama, beautiful clean spacious apartment on the 2nd floor. Many small (grocery) shops and restaurants nearby. Whenever we had questions (before and during our stay), Alexandre was very responsive. We can highly recommend this apartment!

Want to say a big thanks to Alexandre for all. Beautiful apartment, well furnished, it has everything necessary for cooking and living. Very pleased shop on the street:) The location also very good - near the city centre, convenient to walk on foot, many cafes nearby.
Alexandre friendly and helpful host. All told, gave us a lot of advice, helped with taxi call and answered all the questions.

Please do not hesitate to rent this apartment!

Alexandre is a wonderful host, and we very much enjoyed our stay in Alfama.  The apartment has a lot of character, and it comfortably sleeps four people.  It was a great departure point to explore Lisbon.  Just staring out of the window and watching the action unfolding on the street below was a delight!

We had an amazing time is Lisbon! The apartment could not be better located. Alexandre did everything to make us feel at home and left us a bottle of wine when we arrived. This lovely apartment and Alexandre gave us an even better souvenir of this awesome capital!
Thank you so much!

Stayed at Alexandre's lovely apartment for the last two nights of a wonderful Portuguese holiday! The location is perfect, very convenient to main Lisbon downtown area and great for catching some Fado!
The apartment was perfect for our needs, although it must be said we used it for little else but to sleep! Alexandre even left a generous welcoming gift of wine and chocolate, which we were unfortunately unable to find the time to consume!
The apartment was as lovely as the pictures. Alexandre welcomed us with chocolates and a bottle of wine which was unexpected. He was very helpful and friendly and we all had a pleasant stay

Alexandres appartment is very good value for money. Alexandre is a great host who was very helpful and flexible. The location is very central in Alfarma and the appartment is charming and clean.
I recommend this place as a very cheap option for a family or friends wanting to stay in the heart of Alfarma. Thanks Alexandre

Das Appartment liegt in der interessantesten Umgebung in Lissabon am Fuß des historischen Alfama. Strategisch sehr günstig gelegen als Startpunkt für Stadtspaziergänge in der Alfama, Baixa und am Tejo-Ufer. Auch alle wichtigen Bushaltestellen und der Bahnhof Apolonia mit Metrostation (400 m von der Wohnung) sind zu Fuß in ein paar Minuten erreichbar. Man ist mitten drin im Herzen Lissabons. In der Umgebung gibt es unzählige Bars und Restaurants. Vom geöffneten Wohnzimmerfenster mit einem Glas Wein in Hand kann man das Leben in diesem Viertel so verfolgen, als wenn man selbst dort wohnt. Allerdings ist das leider auch das einzige richtige Fenster im Apartment, bis auf eine kleine Öffnung mit Blick auf eine Mauer im hinteren Schlafzimmer. Das zweite Schlafzimmer hat leider gar kein Fenster.

Ganz praktisch: unten neben der Eingangstür befindet sich ein Kiosk, der von morgens bis spät abends geöffnet hat. Der sehr zuvorkommende Besitzer hat von kalten Getränken, über Eis, Knabbereien, Duschgel usw. alles da, was man für ein paar Tage so braucht und hat uns sogar extra frische Brötchen besorgt. Ein paar Türen weiter gibt es ein kleines unscheinbares Cafe, in das sich kaum Touristen verirren. Dort kann man neben portugiesischen Handwerkern, die sich dort einen schnellen "Bica" gönnen, einen günstigen, herrvorragenden Kaffee oder Gebäck genießen. Der Aufenthalt dort hat schon ein anderes Flair als ein anonymes Hotel.
Alexandre ist sehr nett und hilfsbereit. Er hat uns geholfen, das viele Gepäck unseres vorausgegangenen 2 wöchigen Sommerurlaubs an der Küste in den 2 Stock zu schleppen und uns für die Abreise früh morgens ein Taxi zum Appartment bestellt.

Das Appartment ist sehr schön und typisch (mit Azulejos an den Wänden) eingerichtet. Einziger Nachteil war, dass die Küche sehr übersichtlich ausgestattet war. Aufs Kochen sollte man verzichten, kann man aber auch, da man in der Umgebung alles bekommt. Zumindest eine Kaffemaschine wäre schön gewesen! Unsere Kinder haben etwas bedauert, dass man am Fernseher nur 3 portugisische Programme empfangen konnte. Aber das sind Kleinigkeiten, die uns nicht davon abhalten würden, dort jederzeit wieder zu buchen. Der Preis ist ja für 4 Personen unschlagbar für die Lage.

Kleiner Tip für Abernds: Nur ein paar Schritte zu Fuß, ein paar Stufen hoch, gibt es ein tolles kleines Fado Restaurant, das Sao Miguel d Álfama in der Rua de S.Miguel 9-11! Das war kein Touristen-Nepp! Junge Fado Künstler (Rui Vaz und Anna Paulo) beweisen mit viel Enthusiasmus neben "alten Hasen" (Jose Matoso und auch der Chefin des Hauses) fast jeden Abend ihr Können. Das kleine Lokal war bis auf den letzten Platz besetzt, wo es eben ging, hat man noch Stühle dazugeschoben, um Nachzügler unterzubringen. Unbedingt ein paar Stunden vorher einen Tisch reservieren und bis 20.00 Uhr dort sein!

L'appartement est très propre et en bon état. Il est situé dans un vieux quartier de Lisbonne et beaucoup de sites sont accessible à pied. Le propriétaire nous a procuré un locker pour entreposer nos bagages en attendant la disponibilité du logement. Il a volontier ajusté son horaire au nôtre, et ce fut grandement apprécié. Un hôte très agréable qui nous a reçu avec une bouteille de vin et du chocolat pour les enfants. Excellente expérience, nous le recommendons fortement.

Alexandre 's apartment its just perfect, just like The pictures. The decoration its beautifull and his place is with everithing you would need in your stay. He was really sweet and left US a bottle Of wine and chocolate as a Welcome gift and as our flight was very late he even let us leave our lugagge in his warehouse .
The day we arrive he provide US with maps and information and tips for our stay. The place is walking distance from many atractions and train stations to take you to Sintra or Cas Cais. I would definetlly recomend the place and stay there again if i visit Lisbon!

Great location, spacious apartment with good facilities! Centrally located to train stations and the center of Lisbon.
Friendly and welcoming owner who left us yummy chocolate and wine !! Great value for money and would recommend this to fellow travellers !
We had a very pleasant stay at Alexandre's appartment, when we arrived we were very pleased to find a cosy and clean appartment well situated and Alexandre left us a bottle of local wine.
Loved the apartment and the location. Alexandre is very hospitable and greeted us on arrival. Would be happy to stay here again. Loved Lisbon :)

This apt was fantastic for our family of 4 ! It was a great experience to 'live like a local'. The apt has a lot of old world charm with all the conveniences that you need. It is located perfectly for us to walk and enjoy the trams. Thanks to Alexandre for being so kind and providing us with information and this great place to stay.

Kim and family
Canada

The apartment was clean and very nice. It can be located easily and is near the train station. We were received by Alexandre's wife who was very friendly. Although we did not meet Alexandre, he was there to assist us when we contacted him. I would definitely recommend this Alexandre's apartment and stay here again! 5 Stars!
Heerlijk appartement op een mooie strategische plek in de stad. Alles wat je nodig hebt is aanwezig. Behulpzame aardige verhuurder! Wij vonden de bedden veel te hard.

We had the greatest time in Lisbon. The appartment is really nice, convinient, comfortable, clean and most of all it is perfectly located. Alexandre and is wife are as charming as their flat. It was great to feel so welcomed. For sure we recommend the flat, the town and the hosts !

Our stay in Alfama apartment was really great and allowed us to discover Lisbon as locals. The situation of the apartment is very centric and in a 5 minutes walk you can find the Plaza Comercio. The apartment itself is very comfy and fully equipped!
Alexander and his wife were really friendly and open-minded, so they gave as a few guidelines to take the most of our stay and we definitely enjoyed it!!
They even welcomed us with a bottle of wine :)
I would recommend this apartment to a group of friends or a family.
Alexandre fue muy atento y puntual. Se preocupó por los detalles y por dar buenas recomendaciones y el piso fue exactamente lo que esperábamos por las fotos mostradas. Altamente recomendable!

Appartement avec beaucoup de cachet, fonctionnel, bonne literie.

The flat is quilt, very well decorated with Mali modern rustic furniture. It is newly refurbished and we do not feel we are in a 17th century building. The taxi driver who drove us from the airport to the flat said that "to breathe more history we would have to sleep in the Saint Jorge Castle or in the Sé Church which are behind the flat. The location is good for those doing tourism in Lisbon; walking distance to underground stations, to the Rocio and to the Baixa. We walked to the Se and to the Castle, and it did not took as much effort from our tired legs (it was the last day of our 10 days vacation) as we thought.
The building is not served by lifts (we though it was, but it was our mistake) and Alexandre was absolutely nice and carried our heavy bags up and down. Alexandre is very nice, received us with a bottle os wine and a plate of delicious season fruits. The only but is that the kitchen is not equipped for real cooking, but only for breakfast and quick pre-prepared meals. So, if you are planning to do some cooking in Lisbon you better check with Alexandre and we are quite sure he would be happy to provide the additional pens you will need.
The flat is suitable for 4 people, as it has 2 bedrooms with 2 small double beds. The internet is not really fast, but more than enough for tourism needs. We recommend the flat without any negative remark.

We enjoyed an excellent stay at the Alfama apartment of Alexandre Soares, which is extremely charming, as well as perfectly located and beautifully presented! The bright, cheerful apartment is right on the waterfront, near to great restaurants and lovely local shops, and is only a short, lovely, winding stroll from the beautiful Cathedral.
Alex was a wonderful and accommodating host, offering help and guidance for our visit, and helping us to best discover his amazing city ourselves without ever being overbearing. I would not hesitate to recommend this great apartment for anyone looking to spend a wonderful holiday in Lisbon.

Alfama Charming Apartment is ideal place to stay in Lisbon. It has great location, not far from city center, subway and supermarkets. Also there are many restaurants with good prices and food nearby. Alexandre is a great host, we aquired all needed information from him.
We're looking forward to staying at this place again.

Alexander was a great host and very accommodating before and during our stay. I would definitely go back and recommend to everyone.

Amazing views, fresh appliances, and a comfortable bed. The heaters keep the place warm during winter.
Cons:

If you are staying solo, the host provides only one shower towel for the entire stay. Extra towels cost €10 per set, which I found a bit unreasonable. Also, only one small pillow is provided instead of the basic standard of two proper pillows you would expect even in a budget hotel.
During heavy winds, there was significant noise coming from the roof, which could be quite disturbing.
Other than these issues, the place is great and the extra steps are worth it for the views.

Excellent location, beautiful apartment and views. The place is clean and well maintained and communication with the host was flexible and quick. Would absolutely stay here again, and highly recommend.

Très bel appartement...très propre et idéalement situé ..

Apartment is as described and pictured. Water was hot and the fan worked well with the night air. Bathroom was nice and clean. Could not ask for more at that price and location.

Amazing stay! Fantastic views and such a great space, will come back again for sure

Absolutely amazing place! There was an extra bed that I did not expect which was perfect for my dad and I. Esnest’s flat was amazing! It was really clean, well equipped and it has a cute terrace with an amazing view so you can enjoy romantic sunsents of Lisbon. It’s 5 minutes from a metro station and it’s also close to the city centre. We had a really good time there! :)

Logement très propre et grand (parait plus grand que sur les photos), bien équipé. Belle terrasse, métro à proximité et toutes commodités. Tout pour passer un agréable séjour. Hôte très sympathique, instructions claires. Ne pas hésiter à sejourner dans cet appartement.
Merci pour tout.

My stay was absolutely wonderful. The appartement is truly amazing. I’m very sensitive to noise and except for the birds singing in the morning (<3) it was extremely peaceful and quiet. The views is breathtaking. I will definitely come back and advise this place for a stay in Lisbon.

Beautiful apartment near the old town of Lisbon! The views and natural light inside the apartment were nothing short of incredible. Walkable to many parts of the city. The location was great, the view from the bedroom and the small terrace was beautiful and the self check in option was super practical. However, the bathroom was incredibly drafty and the door to the bathroom was very hard to open and close as it stuck. The main double bed was comfortable though and the view from it spectacular. Wir mochten die Wohnung im Großen und Ganzen sehr gerne. Sie ist sehr gut gelegen: zentral und doch ruhig, es gibt ein paar kleinere Supermärkte und gute (relativ günstige) Restaurants ganz in der Nähe. Wir waren eine Woche dort und haben uns zu zweit sehr wohl gefühlt. Für mehr als 3 Personen könnte es aber eng werden, denke ich. Das Highlight: Die Aussicht, insbesondere vom Bad und der kleinen Terrasse, ist fantastisch. Es gibt zwei Betten und eine Couch: Ein Bett war sehr gut, das zweite ok, doch die Couch ist ziemlich durchgesessen. Checkin und Checkout waren total easy, wobei wir nie jemanden gesehen haben. Das WLAN funktionierte gut. Antworten vom Verwaltungsteam kamen meist schnell.
Ein paar negative Aspekte gab es dennoch: Für 7 Tage haben wir trotz Nachfrage nur einen Satz Handtücher pro Person bekommen. Verwiesen wurde auf die Waschmaschine im Apartment, die jedoch zumindest während unseres Aufenthalts kaputt war. Die Küche war geschirrmäßig gut ausgestattet, aber an "Basics" gab es nur Salz. Weitere Basics waren zu knapp bemessen: nur ein kleiner Rest Toilettenpapier, als wir kamen, nur zwei Müllbeutel, kein Spülmittel. Es wäre einfach etwas angenehmer, wenn das bereit gestellt würde.
Dennoch: Wir hatten eine super Zeit dort und würden die Wohnung jederzeit wieder buchen!

I am surprised this place gets such great reviews. Our expectations were very high after reading reviews and looking through the bright, professional photos. The space, however, is a very bare-bones, minimal AirBnB. The bathroom has mold on the curtain above the sink as well as near the sink and in the shower. The couch is a bit old with stained arm rests and a blanket covering the bottom cushions. All the plates and many cups are mix-matched with 1 glass wine glass and 3 plastic ones. Not a very detail-oriented place. We also were surprised that they did, in fact, have a coffee machine but not any coffee. I have stayed in countless AirBnBs and they, at the least, provide instant coffee. We were told to go buy pods at a local shop that didn't actually have the correct ones. This is an affordable AirBnB with a great location and SPECTACULAR view however the 6 flight walk-up and small issues were enough that we left disappointed and wished we had booked a nicer place. However, keep your expectations in check and you will enjoy this listing.
