The apartment was great!!
Just what I needed!!!!
Team were super helpful with allowing me early entry!!
Thank you!!
Bien situado, limpio y acogedor.
We had a great time staying at Ernest’s apartment! The location is great - close to the center and metro. The apartment has great view as well. Quick to response at the check in and easy check out.

Ernest's apartment was clean and nicely laid out, up some 6 flights of stairs (workout which we quite enjoyed). A little more worn than pictures let on, but in good condition throughout. WiFi was reliable, bed comfy and apartment quiet - just a shame weather was super windy so couldn't enjoy the balcony and the amazing view to the fullest!  Ernest's assistant Sara was quick to help with queries (such as restocking missing coffee pods and advising on luggage storage upon departure), however we feel there could have been a little "welcome pack" in the apartment as a guide to the immediate local area to help with settling in. Nevertheless, had a great stay and would recommend!

The location is incredible and so are the views from the apartment. It is on the level 6, but it's definitely worth the view. It was pretty hot when we travelled in mid may and had a lot of mosquitos, so we requested for a fan and a mosquito repellant. We were provided the fan the following day but the repellant couldnt be organised. I think these are necessities  though on hot days. Other than that, all good. Communication was very prompt which was great.
Хорошие апартаменты с классным видом, от центра близко. Но будьте готовы, что придется нести тяжелый чемодан на 6 этаж

Despite an brief delay in the check-in process, we had a great stay at Ernest’s place. The 7 flights of stairs were tough, but the view from the terrace was definitely worth it. The location was great, a short walk from most of the sights in Lisbon. Ernest was readily reachable and responded quickly to all messages. We would stay here again. Thanks!
Great apartment in an amazing location. Stellar views.
The view from the patio was better than we ever expected. If this spot is available during your time in Lisbon, I would 100% recommend it!

We enjoyed our stay in Lisbon very much. The appartment was perfect and very central.
Thanks a lot and best regards!

Vi hade en perfekt vistelse i Ernest lägenhet. Bra geografiskt läge, underbar balkong med bra solläge och otrolig utsikt. Ernest var enkelt att kommunicera med och vi kan varmt rekommendera att bo i lägenheten.

Fantastic apartment in Lisboa. The view over the red tiled homes of Alfama and the location among the narrow cobblestone laneways was an excellent experience. The apartment was clean and had a nice charm to it - worth the climb up the stairs. Ernest was an excellent host, and I 'd be happy to recommend his home to other travelers.

Appartement sympathique avec une vue très agréable. Très bien situé, près du château Saint Jorge, de plusieurs points de vue sur Lisbonne, des quartiers typiques de Lisbonne. Il est très facile de s'y rendre par le métro (25 min environ). Ernest est très sympathique, arrangeant et réactif.
Great location, and a great view! Perfect for a quick stop over! I will be back!
没见到房东，从商店拿的钥匙，公寓在六层，楼梯比较窄，小行李箱还可以搬上去。公寓里面没有衣柜，不过阳台的风景很好。公寓在山上，离公交站和一些景点不远，就是需要爬坡。
Nice place good location lots of stairs

Me and my friends have had a really nice stay in Ernest apartment, which is exactly like you can see in the photos. In particular, the view from the terrace is amazing!
Communication with Ernest was easy and always clear.
Overall we really recommend his place :)
Great space with incredible views!

Amazing location and good communication and check-in from Ernest. Loved the views from the patio. The only note I have is to try to pack lightly.. the six floors can be tough if you have a bulky/heavy suitcase.
An excellent host & an amazing apartment! Perfectly located with an exceptional view overlooking the entire city. We had a fantastic weekend thanks for everything Ernest!

Ernest’s apartment was clean and relatively centrally located. The only downside was the hike up the six flights of stairs. They’re definitely not for the faint of heart. There are not many plugs available in the apartment, but there were extension cords with additional slots. I’d recommend packing extra long charging cables. Overall Ernest was very friendly and offered great local recommendations. I would highly recommend.
Very good home with priceless views of Lisbon!

the view is literally better than what the photos show on a sunny day. the neighborhood is not bad but single lady I won't recommend going out and in late at night by herself. I think this is near Chinatown or at least I saw a lot of Chinese operated stores. once again, the view is gorgeous.

Very nice apartment with an amazing view. Superb location (had tu use the metro only twice, to get from and to the airport) and a very reliable and friendly host.
Can only recommend it further.
Beautiful view!! Worth the 6 staircase climb!!
Well thought out space. Great location with stunning city views. Everything was comfortable. We especially loved the terrace. Great space to return to again.

Ernest’s place was nice but hard to find and hard to get the key (from a local shop). It has the views as described and is centrally located. If you’re familiar with Portugal’s windy roads you’ll be fine, but if it’s your first trip it’s a hard place to get to. The several stairs were uneven, so if you have balance problems be careful.

It was great because of location, view of balcony and support from the host. I am willing to stay again in case of returning back to Lisbon.
Thanks Ernest.
Best regards.
Stunning view and good location!
A great choice if you want to enjoy a picturesque view of Lisbon. No complaints
Ernest was so easy to contact and even made it possible for us to check in earlier than we had requested! such a lovely place to stay, would absolutely recommend!
The apartment is great, it’s situated near the city centre and offers an amazing view. We didn’t get the chance to meet Ernest, but he was replying to all my queries very quickly, great stay!

Ernest and his place are definitely  very recommendable. His house is all what you need for a perfect stay in Lisbon. Ernest is very quick in responding for whatever need you may have and has a lot of tips to give you. I also appreciate that he allowed us to leave our in his apartment after check out hours so we could enjoy our last day in Lisbon without carrying our luggage with us ! 100% reccomended !
Must be able to climb stairs but the place was great and centrally situated, very comfortable with a great view of Lisbon. Would recommend.

Has fantastic viewpoint. It's at the highest floor (6th floor) and no lift but everyone will tell you it's worth it! Ernest was in constant communication to make sure we are comfortable and everything is ok. Highly recommended.

We spent an amazing journey at Ernest’s appartement. The place is perfectly located, it is clean and nicely decorated. Moreover Ernest is an amazing host he’s really kind and you’ll feel like at home.
Really great place that’s close to the Metro. Very clean and all you could need. Ernest was fantastic at communicating and helping out where possible.

Nice apartment and great location. Even though we never met him, Ernest was very friendly and always responded to questions. We spent a few days in December here with our little daughter. There is only one little heater for 2 rooms and the bathroom, so it was quite cold and sometimes moist in the apartment. Better probably in summer, also to use the terrace with the great view.

The stairs can be intimidating but the place and view is worth it. It was very well located in Lisbon and close to the metro that gets you everywhere. Ernest really does have one of the most amazing views of Lisbon and he also is very good at staying in touch and making sure it all goes smoothly. I really appreciated it.

Amazing view in the heart of Alfama.
Have to climb a few stairs to get to the apartment and have to mind your head as the entrance is low but it's well worth it!

Ernest’s place is gorgeous, charming, and the view is well worth the climb up the stairs (which are fairly innocuous, wide, and easy to navigate). The terrace is a gorgeous way to enjoy Lisbon from above, and the layout was perfect for one couple with kids. There wasn’t a lot of hand holding about the city, but as it wasn’t our first visit, that was fine with us! The location is close to metro and central. I would definitely recommend the apartment!

Great location and view. Place was very clean and the host is very responsive to messages. There are a lot of stairs to get to the apartment, so it may not be the best option for anyone who would have difficulty ascending and descending stairs.

We really enjoyed staying at Ernest's place! It is in a great location just a short walk from the Martim Moniz Metro station with great views of the city! Ernest was very flexible with our check in when our plans changed and we didn't arrive until much later than planned, and he was very responsive. He also left us a bottle of Portuguese wine to enjoy! The only things to be aware of before booking this apartment is that there is no elevator up to the 6th or 7th floor, and the staircase is quite narrow and steep, so lugging heavy/large suitcases can be difficult. The apartment also smelled like a smoker had been in it prior, but if that doesn't bother you, no worries.
Probléme d'eau chaude a réglé, appartement froid. tres belle vu .
Amazing Location,  in the heart of Alfama District, exceptional cleaning conditions and great right on time communication,  highly recommend

Ernest's place was exactly what we wanted in Lisbon. A well-located, clean, relaxing flat with a gorgeous city view. We absolutely loved his flat! Ernest communicated super well with me before and after the booking and he was so nice and thoughtful ! I highly recommend his flat in Lisbon, overall a lovely experience!
Ernest was a phenominal host and super helpful with our travels. 5/5 would reccomend.
The view is absolutely amazing
Can’t beat the view. A really nice space for your visit in Lisbon and well worth the stairs up.
Staggering views of Lisbon, lovely apartment, good location and really friendly host and cleaning lady.
Incredible view!

We loved Ernest’s flat. The location is fantastic and the views were just as good as expected. We both slept so well there. Ernest is very responsive to messages and was very welcoming. He was also kind enough to let us check in early.

Amazing location! Amazing view!! Ernest even gave us a bottle of vinho verde which was amazing to drink on the terrace. Definitely would recommend this to anyone. I was walking around at almost 2am and felt safe in the neighborhood. Great walking distance to a little plaza nearby where the Tram 28 comes with many restaurants with outside seating. The stores/shops next to the metro station that is close by were great. Great walking distance to the central part of the city as Lisbon. You’ll love waking up with that view.

A comfortable loft apartment with the most fantastic view. The kitchen is well equipped with what you need to cook. Ernest even greeted with a bottle of wine upon arrival.
Communication was very effective and Ernest was very helpful and accommodating.
Thank you!

Ernest’s apartment was fantastic, it was clean and easily accessible from the metro. The view was incredible and was more than we expected and we really appreciated the bottle of wine he left as a gift. This was our favourite Air BNB of our whole trip. We couldn’t fault it!

We had a great time at Ernest's place! His responses were quick and friendly and he met us early at the apartment to let us in and give a quick tour. There were great amenities including shower supplies and coffee. The apartment is cozy and the view is incredible - worth the stairs to access the penthouse! As three young women, we did Uber to and from the apartment at night but were able to enjoy the walk during the day. The neighbourhood is a close walk to the busy streets of Lisbon.

We loved our stay in Ernest's appartment. It's spacious, comfortable and quiet and was well-equipped with everything you could need. The view from the balcony is amazing (the best we saw in Lisbon!), as are the views from all of the windows. Would highly recommend it for couples -  it's a great place to say in Lisbon!

Definitely stay here - the view is worth the 7 flights of stairs and more. Sunsets at the apartment terrace are picturesque - you won’t wanna miss it! Also the apartment is well stocked with toiletries, and whatever you may need. We were even given a welcome gift of wine and pasteis de nata - a great way to start off in Alfama.
The view from the terrace is worth it, just spectacular. Perfect location to visit one of the best part of Lisbon. Ernest was also really reactive. Thank you!

Ernest’s place is perfect for us. He has been such a nice host with smooth communication since I placed the order. He gave us the tips for exploring the city with local eyes, and warmly welcomed us with tart and wine. Very sweet and considerate. As for the flat itself, the view is fantastic and feel so chill to sit at the balcony with big part of Lisbon in front of you. The beds are clean and comfortable, shampoo etc. are all well set. Hope one day we will come back and try it again. Thank you Ernest!

This was incredible, the view was amazing, the place is so clean and very beautiful. Ernest answers you right away and his team will give you great suggestions for things to do. I am definitely coming back here! I was traveling alone and it was my first time in Portugal and this was just absolutely perfect. From the bedroom you will see the best view of Portugal you could ever wake up to. Highly recommend staying here!!!

Beautiful spot in a trendy neighbourhood of Lisboa, with an absolutely stunning balcony over the whole city. It really makes the whole place, and we spent a few hours just sitting here each day taking in the sun. Will definitely revisit when we're back in Lisbon. Cheers

Stunning apartment in the heart of Lisbon! The location was great and Ernest was so friendly and helpful! The apartment was very clean. Ernest had a bottle of wine and Nata’s for us on the table when we arrived. The view from the balcony is the best in Lisbon. We hope to return someday :)
Gemütliche Unterkunft, top Aussicht vom Balkon und dazu eine sehr gute Lage!!
The Appartement has an amazing view. Thanks for everything.
Nice apartment and great location!
Very nice place in the best area of Lissabon

You've got an amazing place Ernest!
Great location with an incredible view, I can highly recommend staying at your apartment and will hopefully do so again myself the next time I'm in Lisbon.

Chris

The terrace view over the city is marvelous and compensates the walk up to the sixth floor. Apartment is very nice, and Ernest was very responsive and quick in responding. Thanks a lot Ernest for hosting us! Manuel

Place is amazing. View is the best. I’d say better than even the viewpoints around the city. Great to enjoy wine and cheese in the comfort of your own private balcony.
Place was immaculate. No dust. Very clean. All amenities including washing machine, pegs, detergent, coffee machine and pods. Great shower and comfortable bed.
Be warned steep staircase however worth it everytime considering the view you get from the comfort of your bedroom and own private balcony. Going down staircase is easy.
Would recommend highly.
The apartment is very nice, well furnished, good position and an amazing wiew. The host is very gentle and always available. I definitely reccomend it

We loved Ernest’s place! It was very clean and we loved the terrace with view. Great place to sip the complimentary wine! Definitely recommend! Must be willing to climb stairs! It’s on the 6th floor of the building with no elevator. Other reviewers and I think Ernest warned of this so we expected it, but just reiterating.

Certes au 6eme étage sans ascenseur mais la vue en vaut le coup
Appartement cosy, hôte très sympathique (et merci pour le Vihno verde !)

A nice and relaxing location with great views of the city! Was perfect for our first trip to Lisbon.

Amazing place with an outstanding view over the city. terrace where you can watch the sunset and A hammock in the common area to make stay more chill and relaxing. Make sure you can carry your luggage to the 5th floor as there is no elevator.

Ernest was a great host and provided us with lots of tips on where to visit in Lisbon. The apartment is great for those wanting to be in the heart of Lisbon with everything within walking distance. The view is definitely worth the stairs! We would definitely stay again. Thank you Ernest :)
Ernest provide amazing hospitality and he was very responsive. The apartment has a balcony with beautiful view. The location is perfect and close to majority of the monuments and touristy spots.

The apartment could have used a little bit of upkeep but everything was very clean, the hammock was a fun touch, and the view did not disappoint. Ernest was very quick to communicate instructions and check in/out was easy.
The general location is good as it is near Martim Moniz but the steer the apartment is on seemed a bit sketchy.
Amazing view! Lovely place, quite a couple of stairs to go up, but you will feel like you have the best view of Lisbon from your balcony.
Nice place, great view, good location, lots of stairs. Would stay here again!
What a view!!!
Exellent and helpful host. The apartment was nice and had a spectacular veiw from the balcony. The heatwave came during our stay and Ernest was quick to fix an extra fan so we could sleep.

Great apartment, great communication, nice attention to details that make you feel welcome. Only point of attention is that it’s located on a steep hill that Uber drivers sometimes find hard to find. For the rest no issues whatsoever.
Très bon emplacement , vue de terrasse exceptionnelle et hôte réactif dans sa communication. Appartement très propre et confortable
Ernest's place is the perfect place for a short break in Lisbon. Amazing views, amazing location, and a stunning balcony. Highly recommended.
Absolutely beautiful place. Very kind and helpful host, would absolutely recommend his place to anyone staying in Lisbon! The view is worth it alone!
Best view of the city with seating for two. Perfect for a glass of wine with a sunset!

We had a great stay at Ernest’s place. The view is amazing. Be prepared to walk up the stairs, but the view is worth it. Ernest was very responsive and allowed us to drop off our bags early. He offered many great tips and is very responsive. We recommend this apartment!

Ernest was a great host! Super friendly and helpful, and he answered to all messages very quickly. We stayed at the apartment with a 1,5 year old toddler, so the stairs were a good workout. ;) The view is amazing and the location superb.
Really good location and the view is spectacular!
The apartment is  at a prime location. The rooftop is amazing, you will have a proper panorama to the city center. Apartmen was nice and clean with a bottle of welcome wine and coffee. Recommended
Ernest is a very friendly guy that helps us a lot with everything we needed! We recommended 100%
Great place to stay in Lisbon. The view is the best in this location.

Lovely apartment in residential location close to everything. You feel like you’re experiencing true Lisbon life yet you’re close to Alfama, Castelo S Jorge, etc. The views are great. If you visit soon, however, know that they’re remodeling the apartment below this one; it was noisy most days starting at 8/8:30.

Ernest was extremely flexible and helpful in regards to arranging check-in time. He was very fast in responding to any questions I had, and his place was absolutely wonderful. I definitely recommend to stay at his place if you are ever traveling in Portugal.
Great location and view !
the Best , will def be back !

Great location with an amazing view. Ernest was very good about accommodating our check-in/check-out schedule to suit or flights needs. The long staircase going up to the apartment was a bit cumbersome with bags, but hey we managed. I wouldn’t suggest it if you have mobility issues.
Great location, very helpful host - no complaints at all!
Very nice and sunny apartment. Be ready to climb the stares to get there however.
It’s well worth The 6 floor (7 in US) walkup.  The quintessential urban Airnb experience.
Ernest was an amazing host! Very communicative and easy to talk with. Thanks for everything!
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at this location. Would definitely recommend. Great location and amazing views. Very clean and had everything you need!
Vale a pena subir os vários vãos de escada para chegar ao apartamento do Ernest. Excelente vista, num local com encanto.
Very nice, clean & good looking appartment! Spacey, amazing view, and with the cutest little terrace. Would definity recommend for both short & longer stays.
Charming place with fantastic views. We would definitely stay there again
Great space, views and location. Very stylish appartment. No elevator to reach the top floor which could be problematic for some tenants. However, overall an awesome stay and would recommend!

The apartment looked exactly like it did in the pictures! Ernest was attentive and responsive to all of our needs. The apartment was spotless, and the view from the balcony was to die for! I would recommend this place to anybody visiting the city.
Rent this place for the terrace.  You can't beat that view.  And the apartment is quiet and cozy.
Nice view, nice location.
A beautiful apartment in a great area! Walking distance to so many great restaurants and shops. We couldn’t have found a better place to explore Lisbon! Definitely recommend!
A great stay at the apartment. The view from the terrace was amazing

Kleines, nettes Appartement in schöner Lage. Für zwei Personen ausreichend, für uns zu viert war etwas eng, Badezimmer nur durch das Schlafzimmer zu erreichen.

This a key location if you want to enjoy a great view of Lisbon and still be in a quiet but central place.  The apartment has everything you need and is optimal locations for a couple or a single person.
Everything was just as amazing as described. Perfectly suited appartment for exploring lissabon. Thanks Ernest

A brilliant place to stay with fantastic views over Lisbon! Its in a great location and its very easy to walk to many places around the city. I would very much recommend to anyone who is looking for a quirky and fun place to stay whilst exploring Lisbon. I would definitely stay here again!

Logement idéalement situé au 6 eme étage d’un immeuble rénové sans ascenseur mais avec une vue imprenable sur la ville juste magnifique.

Dommage sinon ça aurait été parfait

From the first minute we really felt at home in Ernest's accomodation. Everthing was perfect and the view is breathtaking. Also the Check-in was easy and flexibel. We will definitely come back some time and can highly recommend the flat and Ernest as a host.
À deux pas du métro, du tram et des ruelles animées. Idéalement situé entre deux quartiers. Vue exceptionnelle, ensoleillement idéal en fin de journée.

Vorweg: Die Lage ist super. Man kann fast alles in 15 Minuten zu Fuß erreichen. Der Balkon bietet einen 90 Grad Blick auf Lissabon. Bei drei Leuten wurde es aber schon etwas eng darauf. Das Schlafzimmer ist kein abgeschlossener Raum, sondern alle, die auf Toilette oder auf den Balkon wollten, mussten am Bett entlang gehen. Die Küchenausstattung ist für fünf Leute sehr knapp bemessen.

Ernest was quick to reply to our request for a reservation when our return flight to Boston was canceled due to the Nor-easter storm in the New England and needed a place to stay for an additional 2 days in Lisbon. It's all about location. His apartment offers unique Lisbon charm. Close to walk everywhere downtown. The views of Lisbon from the balcony are phenomenal. A lot of Mercado's (grocery markets) and small restaurants within walking distance. The Castelo de Sao Jorge can be seen from the sky window and is walking distance away. We had a great time exploring more of Lisbon with our extra days in Lisbon. Be prepared, this location is typical Lisbon charm, no lift and 6 flights up. Don't let that deter you from staying here. Great location.
Beautiful views!
房子看外面风景不错，离地铁站不远。老房子没有电梯，建议有大件行李的朋友们多考虑考虑再看。

Ernest’s place was in the perfect location! It was a quick walk to amazing restaurants and local spots. The balcony had a beautiful view overlooking the city where we enjoyed some wine and sweets he had left for us. He was very accommodating and the space was quite clean!
Ernest was really friendly and helpful. The apartment it’s just the greatest place to fell the Lisbon’s atmosphere, with a great view from the terrace. Wish I could stay longer there!

Le logement est top, bien décoré, et très ludique pour les enfants avec le hamac à suspendre dans le salon. La vue est superbe, époustouflante ! Ernest a été très réactif avant notre arrivée, et très prévenant. Merci encore pour la bouteille de vin et les délicieuses pâtisseries.
2 points problématiques pour nous :
- Les chauffeurs Uber que nous avons pris ont eu beaucoup de mal à trouver la rue, et nous avons perdu pas mal de temps à tourner dans les ruelles
- Au moment de rendre les clés, nous avions convenu avec l'amie d'Ernest de quitter les lieux à 10h30. Elle n'est jamais venue (nous devions laisser les clés dans le logement, mais elle ne nous l'avait pas dit) et Ernest était à ce moment injoignable. Nous avons donc attendu 1h15 avant de finalement partir en laissant les clés sur le palier...mais nous avons perdu toute la fin de la matinée à attendre, dommage...

Our stay in Ernest's apartment was amazing, very cozy, clean and you have the best view of the city ever, amazing! Best Regards Renan and Juh.

虽然房东人很好，很热情，第一天还用香槟和蛋挞欢迎了我们，但我还是不推荐这个住处。最初因为看到图片上的天台很赞，所以选择了这个住处，但是因为公寓没有电梯，我和爸妈拖着三个箱子爬了七层楼，累得不行，尤其是我爸妈。而且冬天的时候，天台太冷了，根本不能长待。所以，大家千万别因为那个看上去很好的天台而被冲昏了头脑，血的教训！并且，房子也有些破旧，没有空调，电暖气只有一台，另一个电暖炉我们用的时候还导致房子跳闸了。因为是在屋顶，所以客厅有一部分的屋顶是斜的，下面放了床，很容易碰到脑袋。洗澡的时候水也是忽冷忽热。没有电视，网速也很慢。里斯本的消费水平其实很低，这个住处我们当时是每晚花了将近七百块，同样的价格，我们在西班牙的塞维利亚住的非常好。所以，这个住处我真的不是很推荐，性价比较低。

Ernest's flat is very conveniently located in the center of Lisboa... close to all useful transportation. It is quiet and well suited for two (and more guests). And the view on  surrounding landscape from the terrasse is really amazing and one easily forget that one had to climb the stairs to the apartment. Despite the external low temperature, the flat was warm enough... except in the bathroom. Thanks for the warm welcome with a bottle of vino verde.

The place is really good, only one little problem, it is at the 6th floor and there is no lift, but the view and style are wonderful.
Thanks for the wine. Nice detail.

This place has the best views you can ask for in Lisbon. Great location and amazing host. We would love to go back as soon as we can! Thank you Ernest for providing the best AirBnb experience in Lisbon!
Le logement est parfaitement bien placé entre Baixa et Alfama! Une terrasse unique avec vue sur Lisbonne! Je vous recommande cet appartement!

Nous avons bien aimé la terrasse ainsi que la disponibilité d’Ernest. L’appartement était propre et nous avons apprécié les natas et la bouteille de vin offerte par Ernest.
Top!

Отличная квартира в самом центре не далеко от метро. Потрясающий вид с балкона. Больше счастье пить кофе на балконе утром и смотреть как просыпается город. Вид панорамный. Amazing view, wonderful apartment. Very central. Ernest was a wonderful host and was very quick with communication - definitely recommend!

Somos una familia de 5. Los niños aún pequeños. Hemos estado a gusto en el apartamento aunque para nosotros muy justo, pequeño. Faltan sillas para poder comer juntos y la mesa es muy pequeña. El paso el lavabo es por la habitación. No hay televisión, y se agradece, pero tampoco juegos de mesa.
Es un apartamento muy silencioso, luminoso y agradable. El Barrio el más viejo de la ciudad, muy bien ubicado para llegar a pie a toda la ciudad.
Estancia agradable.
Ernest place was awesome and with fantastic views to the castle. Perfect stay during our portuguese trip.

La casa è un po’ piccola ma completa di tutte le comodità, inoltre, Rodrigo ci ha fatto trovare caffè, asciugamani, phon e un piccolo regalo di benvenuto. pedro及其团队热情友好，可以说是有求必应。住房没有电梯，但是staff还是帮我们搬了一个行李箱，人很nice。房间非常干净整洁，周围景点都在步行十五分钟内的距离，一切都很好。
He was incredible. Highly recommend. Amazing location and really lovely apartment.

Wir hatten ein paar schöne Tage in der Unterkunft. Sie hat alles was man braucht und noch mehr. Die Gastgeber waren sehr aufmerksam und haben unseren Aufenthalt sehr angenehm gemacht. Die Lage der Unterkunft ist auch ideal, um die Stadt zu Fuß zu erkunden.
Sehr empfehlenswert!
非常好的房东，入住时提供了详细的城市游览说明和周边餐厅介绍，并且提供了葡萄酒和3天的咖啡。整个公寓也特别干净，是我入住过的所有公寓最好的。强烈推荐给大家！
Eine gute & gemütliche Unterkunft in toller Lage! Die Wohnung bietet alles was man braucht & die Kommunikation mit den Gastgebern war super inkl. die Tipps rund um Lissabon.
El apartamento estaba genial, cómodo y limpio con todo lo necesario. Además, la ubicación era inmejorable y los anfitriones fueron súper atentos y amables! Lo recomiendo 100% si vas a Lisboa!

너무 친절하고 곤란한 상황일때 적극적으로 대응해주고 해결해주려고 신경써주셔서 정말 좋은 여행이 됐습니다
엘리베이터 없는게 흠이긴 하지만 그거 빼면 전부 다 좋아요
주변에 맛집들도 많고 어디 가기도 편합니다.
숙소자체는 정말 깔끔하고 예쁩니다
아내가 제일 맘에 들어했어요

From beginning to end the host was responsive and helpful. Upon arrival we were met in person at the apartment and given a tour. The heat had already been turned on to warm up the apartment before we arrived. We also appreciated the recommendations for eating and visiting Lisboa. We loved the location to easily get to many places in Lisboa. We would definitely stay here again without any hesitation!!!

Ideal for exploring Lisbon. The location was walking distance to Chiado, Bairro Alto and easy access to trams and the riverfront. Apartment was clean, comfortable and exactly as described.
We liked being in the neighbourhood with shops and cafes near by. Uber was our friend to save our legs in the evenings.
Great communication from the host, would recommend and would stay here again.
Tolle Lage und wunderschöne Wohnung! Sehr zu empfehlen!

We had a fantastic stay in Lisbon over New Year’s and would absolutely recommend this apartment. The hosting team were excellent throughout, with clear, responsive communication. Francisco greeted us on arrival, which was a very welcome personal touch. The apartment was clean, comfortable, well equipped, and quiet at night, with everything needed for a short or longer stay. The location is superb — central, around 20 minutes from the airport, with cheap, safe, and reliable public transport and easy walking access to many sights. New Year’s celebrations were epic. Note: Lisbon is hilly and the apartment is on the fourth floor with stairs. Highly recommended for couples or small families. We would happily stay again in any season.
Simple and neat accommodation at a beautiful location in Lisbon !
Lugar nota 10.

This was the perfect Airbnb for our long weekend in Lisbon! The place was very clean and well stocked, and we really appreciated the small treats left for us. The space is very comfortable for 3-4 people. The location is also excellent! Would highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone.

Just had a very comfortable stay at the apartment. Great location within the Chiado district. Close to a good selection of places to eat. And not far from the shops and going down to the waterfront and train station etc. great base to
Plan your activities.
Would recommend 🙂 and rebook. Excellent communication from Francisco.

Excellent séjour emplacement extraordinaire et grande flexibilité de la part de Pedro tout etait parfait
Un grand merci
Excellent

Nous avons passé deux nuits chez notre hote, très bien accueillis en dépit du retard causé par notre vol. Il nous a attendu et a été très sympa, nous proposant même de nous aider avec les bagages.
De petits cadeaux de bienvenue étaient également laissé à notre attention.
Appartement très bien situé. Conforme aux photos.
Seul bemol, ce sont les escaliers et l'entrée un peu exiguë, mais dès l'entrée dans le logement on oublie un peu les 4 etages montés.
En somme nous (4) avons passé un agréable sejour d'anniversaire.

아늑한 숙소와 친절한 설명,카몽이스 광장과 시아두 메인 거리 인접한 점이 매우 편리했습니다.
다만 건물의 좁은 입구, 가파른 계단 등은 큰 캐리어를 들고 이동하기에 어려움이 있었습니다.

Ich bin nun bereits zum 2. Mal in einer der Wohnungen gewesen. Ich liebe die Lage, die Wohnung war super sauber, toll eingerichtet und die Vermieter waren immer sofort zu erreichen. Ich werde wiederkommen !! Vielen lieben Dank !!!

These accommodations were in a great location and Pedro was very responsive with any questions we had.  Check-in was extremely smooth.  If the unit upstais is occupied, expect to have noise, ear plugs work great.  I definitely recommend staying here!
Sehr zu empfehlen! Super Lage für einen Städtetrip, sehr nette Gastgeber! Die Unterkunft ist mit allem ausgestattet, was man braucht. Klare Empfehlung!

Francisco was a great host. He met us at the apartment and showed us how to work everything. He provided an extensive list of local recommendations. We especially loved La Piadina - just across the street. He also provided a bottle of local wine and some chocolates - lovely little touches that make the stay even better.
The apartment is very stylish and clean with everything you could need. The AC was great. The sofa and beds are comfortable. We didn't cook but there is everything you need.
The apartment is up a set of narrow steep stairs which is understandable as it is an old building. However, the final set of stairs does not have a handrail which makes it feel quite unsafe. If you have large bags or mobility issues this could be a problem.
The location is great. It's walkable to a lot of local sights or to the metro station. There's a supermarket just down the street.
We would stay again.

The place was a delight! It was a perfect location in Lisbon that allowed us to walk to almost anywhere we wanted. The apartment was fully equipped and functional with adequate supplies and necessities (toilet paper, soap, and even coffee!). The beds were comfy, the master A/C unit was a hit! Admittedly the stairs were not as popular—but you were fully transparent about those in the ad, and they added to the memorableness of the place:). Great information in printed guides of Lisbon were provided, and the convenience of Aushan and NUMEROUS places to eat was a bonus. I could go on, but you get the idea: we absolutely love the place and it made our time in Lisbon so much more memorable.

Through out the booking, prior to arrival to leaving, the hosts were really helpful.  The apartment had everything and more that we could of wanted and was ideally located on the main tram line to the see the city highlights.

We had a wonderful stay at the loft. The team were exceptional hosts - we had Francisco meet us to show us around the loft, answer any questions we had, and he gave us local tips and food recommendations.
The apartment itself was spotless, and we slept well on very comfortable beds.
The location is also perfect, central to everything, but it was still so quiet. Highly recommend this beautiful loft and we would absolutely stay again.
Thanks Francisco, Pedro, and Chiado team.

The place was as described. Central location and walkable to various restaurants. We were greeted and given a tour of the place. Host was very friendly and responsive. They were generous and flexible with check-in time. I would definitely recommend. One thing to note is that it is upstairs either no elevator, but that was described in the listing details so we expected this.

A cozy place near the famous tram photo spot! Easy to use metro, great cafes and restaurants in the neighborhood. I stayed at Friday night so it was a bit noisy outside but the bedrooms were quiet. Really enjoyed the stay.
And about the steep stairs- you will get used to it!
Lovely apartment. Perfect location with lovely bakeries and local restaurants close by. Make sure you don’t have big bags because of narrow steep staircases

This was the second time I stayed at Pedro's apartment and I loved it once again!
The apartment itself is beautiful, well decorated, very thoughtful towards guests. It's the perfect space to stay when visiting Lisbon! Will be back again :)

Great location, close by to dining and shops.
Space was smaller than expected but I assume this is the case for most of Lisbon. as mentioned by others 4 flights of narrow stairs to enter.
Clean and great location!

Everything was perfect about the apartment - a really nice main living space with a well equipped kitchen, great shower, comfortable beds. We had a warm welcome when we arrived and a thorough introduction to the apartment and the local area. Lots of information on things to do and places to go.
The location was excellent, with the metro just down the road. The apartment was also quiet with a great view of the surrounding buildings and street below. We would definitely stay here again.
Great start
Posizione ideale per vivere Lisbona. Appartamento molto centrale, elegante e pulito. peccato i 4 piani a piedi con scale ripide, in linea con il resto della città.
Pedro and the group of hosts was amazing and extremely helpful! Great place to stay!
Great place in a great location! The apartment was clean and the hosts were very welcoming. They provided excellent recommendations!
O apto é excelente. Extremamente bem localizado, super equipado e aconchegante. O anfitrião respondeu prontamente sempre que precisamos. 10/10. Sem dúvida voltaremos da próxima vez em Lisboa.

Прекрасне географічне розташування, поряд із центром - все в пішій доступності. Красива автентична будівля (будь готові до крутих сходів на 4-й поверх), простора оселя та дуже любʼязні господарі. Наші найкращі рекомендації.

Perfection! The location couldn’t be better, the hosts nicer. If you’re looking to stay a bit out of where it’s super loud/busy, but within walking distance, stay here! Apartment has everything you’d need. We can’t thank Pedro & co. enough.
Great apartment in a fantastic location! Just a short walk from so many amazing restaurants and shops. We found the apartment to be clean and well maintained!
fantastic location and beautiful apartment! the stairs are quite intense so be prepared but otherwise, it was a wonderful place.

Pros:
-great location! In the heart of Lisbon with tons in walking distance
-very clean Airbnb
-AC works very well
-Very quiet as rooms are in the back away from tram
-very comfortable bedding!
-great price for all that you get!
-amazing host who was very helpful, flexible and immediately responsive with us!
Cons:
-4 flights of tight narrow steps to get up to apartment (it is also not well lit, which makes it very scary at night)..motion lights in the halls would be very helpful
-slippery front steps..they need a new grip strip
-using too many appliances at the same time trips the breaker (ex. Iron + laundry)…we think the iron was bad and needs replaced
Overall was a great spot and would stay again!

Pedro’s place was amazing. When we got to the Airbnb we were greeted by both hosts and they gave us thorough instructions on how everything worked in the house, all the way from opening the windows to using the dishwasher. They also provided us with wine, extra sheets, oranges to juice, tide pods and many more things to make our experience better! The also had packets of different places to eat breakfast, lunch and dinner and provided whether it was walking distance or “not so walking distance”. They also explained to us different actives we could do. What wonderful hosts and I hope I get to use their place in the future again. The best Airbnb hosts I have ever had!!

We had a great time in the apartment! There was  everything we needed and it is centrally located with good transport links. The apartment is on the fourth floor and there is no lift. Communication was fast and smooth.
Really nice spot and the team who welcomed me were great.

Lovely apartment in a great location. Do heed the notice about the steep stairs, but they are not a problem. Everything you need will be there for you in the apartment. Tram 28e right outside and metro stop 2 minutes walk so perfect to explore the city

We had a lovely stay at this apartment! The location was absolutely perfect—within minutes of really great restaurants, bars, shopping, and attractions. Because of the central location, we pretty much walked everywhere. The apartment was spotlessly clean and looked just like the photos. I loved the marble bathroom—the water pressure in the shower was great. The apartment overall is quaint, and just enough space for 3 people max, with the bedrooms being on the smaller side. As the description mentioned there are 4 flights of steep stairs, so be prepared! We liked that there was a convenient store next door for snacks, water, etc. I think the apartment was priced fairly and I would recommend it overall!
房東很親切，位置很好，離市中心很近

We spent 3 nights at Pedro's apartment as a couple and it was perfect for our stay in Lisbon. The location was great and there were so many great places to see and to eat and drink within walking distance. The apartment itself was lovely and it looked even better in person than it did in the pictures! The hosts were great and we were made to feel welcome as soon as we arrived in the apartment. I'd easily recommend Pedro's place and would happily stay again.
Espaço aconchegante, limpo e muito bem localizado. Recepção agradável, com frutas e um vinho de cortezia!
Great location and very nice place. Would come back!

Francisco and the team were great hosts! He greeted us and helped us get to the apartment. Keep in mind it is on the 4th floor and there are no elevators! But he was very responsive and helpful.  Great location, very hilly. Be careful with young children while walking. Overall a great place to stay with awesome management!

Everything was as described, and very convenient for a family of four. We have been warmly welcomed, by a very sympathic and professional host. I strongly recomand this appartment for anyone who want to have a nice stay in Lisboa.

Nous avons passé un super séjour à Lisbonne ! 🇵🇹 L’appartement est idéalement situé dans un quartier vivant et charmant, avec plein de restos, brunchs et bars à proximité. Tout peut se faire à pied, ce qui est parfait pour profiter de la ville.
Le logement est propre, bien équipé et confortable pour trois personnes. Les chambres, à l’arrière, sont très calmes malgré l’animation du quartier. Le salon donne sur la rue, donc un peu plus bruyant, mais rien de dramatique. À noter : l’accès se fait par un escalier assez raide, peu adapté aux personnes à mobilité réduite.
Un grand merci pour l’accueil chaleureux et leur réactivité tout au long du séjour — communication fluide et efficace !
Et gros coup de cœur pour la petite attention de Pâques : une spécialité locale délicieuse qui nous a beaucoup touchées 🐣💛
On recommande cet appartement les yeux fermés et on y reviendra avec plaisir !
A return customer here to a few different apartments of Pedro. Happy every time

My family enjoyed Pedro’s place so much! It’s in a heart of the old city,  almost next to the iconic yellow tram 28, while the apartment itself is very quiet. the apartment is very stylish, equipped with quality furniture, kitchenware and linens, with a lot of little touches, we felt very welcomed. High recommended, you won’t regret staying here!

great location! very walkable to everything. Really made it easier after long days of walking around the hilly parts of Lisbon. central to bairro alto, which is where the night life is. Very quiet at night, however. Place was spacious. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. Definitely recommend this place and the hosts. Although getting up the 4th floor was a bit troublesome with 4 luggages, the host came and helped carry our luggages up! Thank you for hosting us! We hope to return very soon!! 😊
Tips: instead of uber, we used bolt to get around and you will save 50% on your first 3 rides.

Pedro’s place is perfect for a stay in Lisbon! A great location which is walkable to many landmarks, easy to get to from the airport and has some amazing local restaurants on the Main Street. Predro was a great host, who’s team allowed us to leave our bags at the flat before check in, gave us recommendations and were very responsive to all queries. We would highly recommend staying!

Pedro and co-hosts were very responsible, caring and friendly.  The location was perfect for visitors to Lisbon, close or easily accessible to all the important areas to visit.  We especially loved the clean and new bathroom and kitchenette with some treats provided.  During our stay, Francisco was so responsive and helpful and gracious, he really personalized our stay.  The dwelling is so original, which we loved and didn't mind the stairs and even though the outside was busy, we only heard a little noise from an adjacent place as would be expected for this age dwelling and prime location. Obrigada to our wonderful hosts!

Amazing flat in a perfect location! Everything was clean, stylish, and very comfortable. Our host was absolutely fantastic so kind, helpful, and welcoming. We really appreciated the gift wine and the great local suggestions!
One funny thing: the door on the street was quite narrow, and as a 192 cm tall man, getting in was a bit tricky—but it just added to the experience and made us laugh!
Overall, a perfect stay, and we would love to come back. Highly recommended.

We had a lovely stay in the apartment, our host was very welcoming and helpful.
The apartment is in a superb location for Lisbon with bars and restaurants all around and an iconic street a few metres away.
The apartment is quiet and stylish and fully equipped if you fancy cooking or staying in for an evening.
The mattress is quite soft in the main bedroom which is fine for me but not for my partner.
All in all a lovely stay and would highly recommend
Great spot! Would book again

Appartement proche de toutes les commodités (transports, commerces, restaurants)
Le quartier est idéal !
Je recommande pour une escapade en famille ou en couple !

Great location. The apartment was very clean. Joao was very helpful. He got a fan for me so my clothes would dry. I’d stay there again. Be aware, there are 4 flights of narrow stairs to the apartment.

Bella accoglienza da parte di Joao. L' ubicazione dell' alloggio è perfetta per raggiungere a piedi il centro. Zona servita da tutto. Alloggio delizioso, pulito e ordinato. Disponibilità estrema per check-in e check out. L' entrata del portoncino è un pochino stretta e, come segnalato le scale sono strette e con ultima rampa senza corrimano. Non è stato per noi un grande problema ma può esserlo se si hanno problemi di deambulazione.
Utili suggerimenti per dove andare a mangiare.
Siamo stati molto bene e lo consigliamo.

The place was right in the middle of everything - restaurants, entertainment, stores, etc. The apartment was clean and orderly. The location is excellent but very loud on the weekends which is understandable. The front door is a tight squeeze and the steps going up to the apartment are very steep but that’s due to the classic structure of the buildings. We were provided with a personal check-in and a comprehensive list of recommended restaurants and entertainment. Overall, we would highly recommend this apartment and working with the Chiado Lofts and Studios Team.

Super séjour chez Pedro. L’appartement était très propre, les équipements sont très biens. Pedro est très réactif et agréable, il a fait en sorte de nous arranger concernant l’heure d’arrivée et de départ.
L’appartement est très bien situé, proche du centre. Tout peut être fait à pieds.
Amazing stay ! Good location and very cute interior design of the apartment xx
Merveilleux séjour dans cet appartement calme et très bien situé. Les adresses recommandées par l’hôte sont top. Je recommande à 100%

We were so happy that Pedro was right there when we arrived. He met us at the bottom and carried our bags up the four stories of steep stairs. I must say we missed you when we checked out! :) The apartment was in a great location.

L’appartement est parfait 👌
Il était propre et la qualité des serviettes et des draps un dos wow!
L’appartement est très bien situé proche de tout les restaurants et boutiques.
Seul petit commentaire… il faut être en forme car il y à beaucoup d’escalier pour atteindre le 4 ieme étage.
Pour nous cela n’était pas un problème.
J’y retournerai sans problème.
Merci

Great place to stay for a citytrip in Lisbon. Central location close to tourist activities and lots of bars and restaurants. Friendly staff and clear instructions upon arrival. Would recommend it and when I go back to Lisbon I will return to this place.
We really enjoyed our stay! Our hosts were super friendly and offered tons of recommendations. The location was perfect and close to numerous sites and restaurants!
Pedro was extremely kind and accommodating to me and my friends! Also allowed us to have a late check out which was very thoughtful and overall a great experience!

This apartment has everything you need to feel part of Lisbon and enjoy everything the city has to offer.
Listening to the street below, the E28 tram and the smell of pastries during the day was intoxicating and magical. You couldn't hear a sound in the evening, the windows shut out any noise.
There are excellent bars, restaurants and cafes all at walking distance. Tram, bus and underground stops are only a few minutes walk away.
The apartment has everything you need and presented in a tidy, neat and lovely way. we especially admired the converted trunk with the glasses and cutlery.
The shower is roomy and powerful. The washing machine and iron came in handy too.
We will definitely recommend this apartment to our friends and family.
There are narrow stairs up to the apartment, they'll get your heart pumping and keep you fit. This is all mentioned in the accurate description.
Thank you for a truly memorable and comfortable stay.
Merveilleux accueil, merveilleux appartement! Tout était parfait!

Great place for exploring Lisbon, close to restaurants and shops, walking distance to the main square and festivities. Quiet at night so a decent sleep. Apartment has all home comforts and good to relax in. steep stairs so a 22kg suitcase is a bit of a haul, but easy payoff for being away from any noise.
Our host was fantastic, held on to meet us even though our flight was delayed.
Surprised us with a wonderful gift for New Year.
Would we consider to stay again? WITHOUT HESITATION.
Stunning City, stunning place, stunning Host.
Great host and great location
Disfrutamos mucho de nuestra estadía. El alojamiento se encuentra muy cerca de la mayoría de lugares a visitar a pie o en transporte público. Definitivamente lo tendremos en cuenta cuando volvamos.

Our stay here was amazing!! Great location (a priority for us) and the host responsiveness was impeccable. The stairs are steep, so if you have mobility issues, I would opt for another place. Overall such a great experience and would absolutely stay here again!

Pedro foi extremamente gentil e prestativo, nos permitiu deixar as malas antes do checkin.
O apartamento está no coração do Chiado, a poucos passos da região mais badalada da cidade, o metrô é muito perto! Na própria rua do apartamento tem TUDO: farmácia, padaria, mercado, lojas de lembrancinha… tudo!!!
O apartamento é muito confortável e bem equipado. O único ponto extremamente negativo é que fica no 4° andar, não tem elevador e os lances de escadas são estreitos e muito íngremes.
Para quem tem dificuldade de locomoção ou então um baixo condicionamento físico, terá muitas dificuldades no acesso.

Really enjoyed our stay at this lovely apartment in a great central location in Lisbon. Hosts were very welcoming and gave us good local recommendations. They were able to accommodate an early check in which was very helpful. Would definitely recommend!

Highly recommend! The place was super clean and cozy I wish I could have stayed longer! There were a lot of place to enjoy food and night life. Very convenient to go anywhere. And a housekeeper guy was very kind and friendly! Special thanks for his help xx
Huge recommand! Pedro’s place is great!
Very hospitable and attentive to details.
Great stay, excellent hosts! Area is a great spot in Lisbon very close to many things!

Great stay at Pedro’s place - very conveniently located and great check in/introduction. Spotlessly clean and very comfortable. We would happily stay again. We were very grateful for being able to leave our luggage for a few hours after check out.
I couldn’t fault the apartment or the location and the host was really accommodating.

These hosts are fantastic! They are very responsive, friendly, and helpful. Some of the best communication I’ve had with a host. On top of that, the place is amazing and the neighborhood is in a prime area

Bel appartement , le canapé a du vécu
Belles attentions à notre arrivée
Odeur désagréable

Tivemos uma excelente estadia! O apartamento é otimo, aconchegante, limpo, tudo funciona muito bem. Ele é exatamente como descrito no anúncio. A região é otima, com bons restaurantes e cafeterias! O anfitrião é muito educado e atencioso!
Great location, great price. Very clean and check in was very informative. One of the best places I have stayed at.
Really enjoyed our stay in Lisbon. The apartment was well equipped and very comfortable. The location was great too - very close to bars, restaurants, shops and museums.

Absolutely loved how comfy and clean this place was. Pedro and his team are extremely kind and responsive. They made us feel very welcomed upon arrival. Please note anyone with mobility issues might find this place challenging due to it being on the 4th floor.

Our stay was 11 days and our second visit to Lisboa. It's a great location easy access to Metro Station Baxia and very walkable. Great mini mart a few doors down. Pedro arranged a complimentary cleaning midway through our stay which was much appreciated. As others have mentioned the stairs are something to be aware of so travel light. But by the end of two weeks we were lean and strong. The exercise in addition to walking about The seven hills of the city left us in better shape than upon arrival. Pedro and his team were very responsive and we were able to check in early which was also very nice. We would definitely stay there again and recommend to our friends. Obrigada!
Great location, close to bars area. Great hosts and the place is as pictured! Would highly recommend.

We had an amazing stay at Pedro’s place. It was exactly what we needed, super clean and in a great area. Rui met us to check in and greeted us with a tour and bottle of wine, which made us feel right at home and welcomed. We struggled with the wifi not working on our phones for some reason, but the hosts checked right after we mentioned it. Would definitely return!

We had an amazing stay at Pedro’s loft during our trip to Lisbon. The loft is in a great area, and walkable to many restaurants, shopping, and other fun neighbourhoods. The loft itself is very spacious and very intentionally decorated. It had everything that we needed and then some. Pedro was a wonderful host - very friendly, responsive, and helpful. We were even provided with a bottle of wine and some fresh oranges to make orange juice in the morning. Thank you for a wonderful stay!

We had a very pleasant stay at Pedro’s loft. He was very communicative throughout the entire process and responded very quickly to any questions that we had prior to, or during our stay. It was very clean and centrally located. Would highly recommend!

Air bnb is amazing - great place to stay while in Lisbon. It had everything you could need inside and it was very close to all of the main attractions, restaurants and shops. Would recommend for anyone visiting
Wonderful stay! In a nice location, close enough to the hustle but far enough away that it never felt too crowded or touristy.
Todo excelente. Lindo departamento, muy bien ubicado. Pedro muy buen host. Recomendable
Great stay. Apartment was lovely and perfectly located close to the action. The host was very responsive and met us on arrival which was a super smooth process. Would highly recommend.

Lovely apartment, stylishly furnished, well equipped, perfect size for our needs and the location couldn’t be better. Pedro, Francisco and António were extremely helpful hosts, responsive and pleasant to deal with throughout, we really enjoyed our stay!
Highly recommended! Apartment is spacious & has everything you need in a great location. Pedro & co were great hosts - 10/10 communication, friendly, proactive & lots of attention to detail.

Foi uma experiência excelente, uma das acomodações mais confortáveis que ficamos dentre todas as cidades que visitanos na Europa. Apesar de não ter elevador o prédio, não diminuiu em nada a boa experiência. Os donos do local são muito solícitos e muito atenciosos. Ar-condicionado dos quartos perfeitos. Deixaram uns mimos para nós como vinho, chocolates... Muito bom!!!

Great accommodation right in the middle of Lisbons tourist zone and the popular places to visit while on holiday .
We were met on arrival and shown the apartment which was modern, comfortable and clean.
The 2 bedrooms were at the back and so did not get the road noise.
Good communication with host and would highly recommend.
Perfect location, clean & comfortable space, amazing hosts
Amazing location!

The flat was terrific, it was in a great location and was the perfect size for two grown-ups and a teenager.  It was better than the photos with fun and comfortable furnishings and interesting spaces.  We walked everywhere and found some great local restaurants and could hang out when needed as it was so central.  We would definitely stay here again!

The place was very nice, great location with all you need within walking distance. Still, the neighborhood was relatively quiet. Be prepared for very narrow stairs up to the 4th floor, maybe not very convenient for older people or families with small children and a lot to carry. Comfortable beds and all necessary facilities. The hosts were very friendly and flexible, we arrived late the first day and were still met personally in the apartment. We were also allowed a very late check-out on the departure day due to some car rental problems. Thank you to Pedro and Rui for a great stay!

Notre accueil était parfait, nous avons même pus arriver avant l’heure prévue. L’emplacement était aussi parfait.
Seule bémol: pas d’essuie-tout ou napkins ny de papier mouchoir.
Très bruyant en haut!

Perfect location! I was easily 10-15 minutes from everything I wanted to see.
The place looks just like the photos. The beds are comfortable and the air conditioning is a huge plus!
Great spot, close to downtown.

My friends and I really enjoyed our stay here! It was our first time in Lisbon. Francisco greeted us and gave us a really wonderful tour of the place. His instructions were clear and the place looked as advertised.
The place was very clean and tidy. The location is central to the city and very convenient to get to various locations. Tram 28 stops on this route which was great! There is a great booklet of recommendations around the city as well. Overall, we enjoyed it and would stay here again.

Great airbnb! The location is perfect! Very walkable to different places. The rooms are also big and bathroom is nice. There is a washing machine but no dryer. Also there are 4 flights of stairs so make you’re okay with that before booking. Overall we loved this airbnb and would definitely stay again!
Excellent apartment in a great location.

Estadia maravilhosa, tudo conforme as fotos.
O anfitrião foi muito solícito e deu todo o suporte necessário.

My friend and I stayed at Pedro’s place, and had an absolutely wonderful experience! We were able to check in earlier than the stated time, and were met by João who helped us carry our suitcase up the steps. He gave us a very thorough tour of the flat, and also some brilliant recommendations of restaurants etc. He also left us with a bottle of wine, and some lovely chocolates! The flat was so clean and tidy, and was very true to the photos - if not nicer! It was a great space for us both - the sofa was very comfy as were the beds, the shower was brilliant, and the location of the flat itself was fantastic. Walking distance to lots of bars, restaurants, a supermarket and lovely shops too. It’s also only a 12 or so minute walk to Rossio station where you can get the train to Sintra, in just over half an hour - we would absolutely recommend this to see the Palace Of Pena and the park surrounding it. All in all, we can’t fault our stay - would definitely stay here again!

Highly recommend this apartment for your stay in Lisbon. The team of hosts were welcoming and detailed with check in, along with responsive for any issues that arose during the trip. The apartment was clean and although close to everything in the city center, was quiet during nights for restful sleep. Easy to catch public transportation or Ubers. Would definitely stay here again!
Great host, excellent location, highly recommend a visit!

questo appartamento è l'ideale per visitare Lisbona. la sua ubicazione è perfetta. tutto quello che serve lo si trova nelle vicinanze (negozi alimentari, pasticcerie, ristoranti, mezzi pubblici, ecc..)
l'appartamento era molto ordinato e pulito e tutte le operazioni di check in e check out sono state molto semplici.
consiglio vivamente questo alloggio

We very much enjoyed our stay! The host added a few personal touches which made us feel right at home and helped us settle in easily - a bottle of wine and fresh oranges to make fresh squeezed juice! The location was awesome. We felt like there was so much to explore so close to the apartment. Loved this spot!

Pedro’s apartment perfectly matched the description. The apartment was well located, in a very central part of Lisbon - surrounded by historical restaurants, stores, streets and main transport lines.
The apartment was fulfilled with all the listed amenities and more: there was a bottle of a Portuguese wine on the fridge and coffee capsules and marmalade, additionally to a handwritten note and chocolates waiting for us.
It was easy to get to the apartment, we were received by João that proactively explained all about the house and its amenities functioning - João was also kind taking my mom’s luggage through the stairs to the 4th floor 😅
Even located on a very busy zone, the apartment was pretty quiet - yet, the only con for us was the fact that, due to the ancient building, we could hear and feel the neighbor’s movements through the floor. Despite of it, I strongly recommend Pedro’s place for those who visit Lisbon.

Unterkunft war wie beschrieben, gute Lage, sehr sauber. Einzig sehr viele Treppen (darauf wurde aber auch hingewiesen). Die Gastgeber waren sehr nett und haben uns persönlich empfangen und alles in der Wohnung gezeigt. Ausserdem haben wir kleine Pralinen und frische Orangen bekommen. Würde ich auf jeden Fall weiterempfehlen.

친절하게 해주시고 짐이 많고 무거운데도 체크인,체크아웃 시 다 도와주셨어요~!
숙소는 말할것도 없이 너무 이쁘고 편하게 묵을 수 있는 곳으로 리스본을 방문한다면 이 숙소를 적극적으로 추천드립니다.
Fantastic location and amenities. Quite a climb up to the fourth floor but nothing you won’t be prepared for when exploring Lisbon! Thanks so much.
AMAZING place ! I can only recommend to book this place, perfectly located with amazing hosts. If I go back to Lisbon I 100% would book it again. Loved it.
Great location, beautiful apartment. Our check in was perfect with lots of info about the apartment.
Friendly and responsive host, very centrally located, close to heaps of restaurants. Perfect for a weekend in Lisbon.

The apartment was just like the photos. It is quite small but everything about it is perfect & so comfortable - from the sofa, beds, shower & kitchen.  The location is fabulous - right in the centre. We came with our 16 year teenage son and had an amazing 3 days in Lisbon.

The appartment is in a brilliant location, very well equipped and very clean. We were met on arrival and talked through all the amenities  and shown how things work so felt at home immediately. Without a doubt the best hosts we have experienced on AirBNB to date. Nothing was too much trouble. As well as some fruit, wine and chocolates on arrival we even had a traditional Easter cake dropped in during the stay. The team are super responsive and provided some great recommendations for restaurants, bars and things to do while we were staying. The appartment is next to the tram for ease of access and we had no notice issues. Yes the stairs are a bit steep but well worth it for a great experience and no issues at all during the stay. We would certainly recommend the appartment and book again with Pedro and the team next time we visit Lisbon. Thank you

Great apartment - comfortable, clean, great location. Very friendly and helpful hosts - Joao met us at the apartment to show us around and to give us some really helpful tips about sightseeing and eating out.  Many thanks

I think Pedro and his team are some of the best hosts I have ever engaged with on Airbnb.
Communication, decor, amenities, accuracy - they hit all the targets.
Excellent location and great hosts!

The apartment was gorgeous & Pedro and his team were wonderful hosts! Thank you for being so responsive and prompt, and thank you Francisco for checking us in ☺️ The climb to the apartment with the narrow stairs was a bit treacherous with all our heavy luggage but it was a fun experience for my family for sure 😆😆😆

The apartment was cozy and bright with all of the essentials provided. Tastefully decorated with plenty of room for the two of us. It was nice to have our own bedrooms. It was great to be able to throw in a load of laundry. Very much appreciated the help upstairs with our luggage. Would not hesitate to stay again.
Perfect little place to explore the beautiful city of Lisbon

Pedro’s place was absolutely beautifully decorated inside.
It’s true to the photos. Some of the most responsive hosts I’ve ever had the pleasure of dealing with on airbnb. Joao met us in person to give us a walk-through of the apartment and explain some local restaurant/bar/exploring suggestions. We appreciated that.
We weren’t at the apartment much except to sleep, but it is near everything central and super walkable to everything you could possibly need.
It’s surprisingly quiet inside even though it’s in a loud area. I couldn’t hear any outside noise except for the tram. Heads up, if you are an extremely light sleeper like me, the tram can be heard almost all night long, every few minutes (even over a white noise machine I brought). If you’re a normal of heavy sleeper, you will be just fine!
They left us a nice bottle of white wine on arrival, some jams, chocolates, and some oranges to make fresh orange juice. Super nice touches! Thanks for a great stay!
great, hosts were responsive, place was newly renovated and in a convenient location!

I loved everything about this apartment. The location is perfect, right in the heart of Chiado, the apartment is beautiful in every detail and the host is super helpful and welcoming. I appreciated the host kindness and making me feel like I was at home! big thank you!

Die Unterkunft war sauber und gross genug für 4 Personen (eine Person musste auf dem Sofa schlafen). Die Wohnung ist mitten im Zentrum in Chiado und am Fuss von Bairro Alto. Von dort aus ist alles gut zu Fuss erreichbar. Die beliebte PARK Bar ist gleich gegenüber. Pedro hat auf meine Chat Nachrichten immer sofort geantwortet und war flexibel mit dem Check in und Check out. Die Wohnung ist sehr ringhörig, mit Ohrstöpsel aber kein Problem.

Our Flight was delayed by 45 minutes due to fog in Lisbon so we arrived later than planned. Rui appeared a few minutes later and helped us up the stairs with our luggage. He showed us the apartment which was clean and fairly well equipped. We appreciated the bottle of wine, chocolates and oranges.
The apartment proved to be quiet apart from the occasional rumble of the passing trams on the road below which did not disturb us but added to the atmosphere.
Initially we ate out in the tourist areas where we found the food mediocre and quite pricey for what it was. It was only later we tried the Orion cafe two doors away where the food was both very good and half the price of the other restaurants we had used. The staff were very friendly.
Rui arranged for a taxi to collect us on the final day and take us to the airport. The driver charged us the €13.50 shown on the meter. This contrasted with the €33.50 charged by the the taxi we took from the official rank on our arrival.

The stay went super smoothly and is managed by an attentive team.  We were welcomed very warmly by João, who took the time to walk-through the apartment and prepared some local tips. The location is superb — very walkable with attractions and great restaurants at your doorstep.

Amazing apartment! Perfectly located, within walking distance to all the best spots in Lisbon. The team were super accommodating and helpful with recommendations. The apartments was incredibly clean with very comfortable sofas and beds. Be prepared to walk up a couple of steep flights of stairs (all part of the experience 😉).
lovely place and very central to all attractions. lovely host - was easy to contact. apartment was clean and provided nice touches
Casa magnifica, in pieno centro, pulita e gestita in maniera eccellente. Super consigliato.

It was my first time in Lisbon, Portugal and I wasn't disappointed. The property is as described and was perfect! Once inside I felt right at home, even my Mum was happy. The stairs are as steep as previously mentioned, but once you climb them, you get used to it! if my Mum of 70yrs can manage it, you can also (smilie face)!
The location was perfect, close to restaurants etc a great spot to start walking around and seeing the daily life of local people. As I went in January it was beautiful and calm. I will assume in the peak season the area would be much more hectic. I have no complaints from the team member I met, Francisco (very helpful) and for Antonio in answering my questions.
Casa muito limpa. As toalhas super macias e cheirosas. E uma ótima localização.
Super central spot with extremely communicative hosts that were kind enough to help us carry all our luggage 4 flights of stairs.  Great location and cute apartment, highly recommend

I had a great staying at Pedro's apartment. The apartment is in a great location, is beautiful and has everything you need for a great, comfortable stay. The location is fantastic and very walkable to most things you would want to do in Lisbon as a tourist and is close to lots of good restaurants, bars, etc.
The check in was also great. We were met at the apartment right when we arrived, and were given a really helpful, detailed explanation of the apartment and all the amenities.
Also, they surprised us with NY Eve treats, including a nice bottle of champagne and a traditional Portuguese holiday cake, etc.
I would definitely look to stay again when I return.
Thanks!

We arrived on Christmas day, and António was there to greet us and familiarize us with the apartment.  They also left us some treats (including the traditional bolo de rei).  The neighborhood was very walkable, and the apartment is close to a lot of restaurants and tourist attractions which are outlined in a handy guide they've put together.  They checked in with us and made sure we had everything we needed after a couple of days.  I would highly recommend staying here!

We had a great stay at the apartment! Pedro and Francisco were always very responsive and made us feel at home at all times.
The place is lovely, very cozy and incredibly well situated just at the heart of Lisbon old town.
Our hosts took care of every little detail and we even got a few Christmas surprises which was extremely nice.
We can’t recommend enough staying with them!
Very nice apartment in a great area of the city. There were many options to eat and things to do nearby. The hosts react super fast and are very friendly!

Pedro’s team were very responsive and made check in seamless. A comfortable space for a 3 night stay, with nice touches such as oranges so we could make freshly squeezed orange juice and hand crafted guides for the city.
The main door entrance is narrow whilst the staircase is steep to the 4th floor. Not a problem for our stay but be aware if you have lots of luggage or have mobility issues.
Would recommend Pedro’s apartment and would stay again.
casa muito limpa, organizada e confortável, recomendo vivamente alugar com o Pedro!

We had a great time at Pedro’s apartment
It’s right in the centre of everything and as long as you are aware that there’s lots of hills in Lisbon you will have a great time here.
The flights of stairs to the apartment are steep but we were aware of that as it’s clearly outlined in the apartments description so it didn’t bother us.
We would have no problem coming back to stay here again next time we are in Lisbon.

Prima Unterkunft um Lissabon zu erkunden! Auch zu 4.war ausreichend Platz. Die drei Betten und das  Schlafsofa waren angenehm, das Badezimmer sauber. Pedro und sein Team standen uns immer bei Fragen und Unklarheiten prompt zur Verfügung. Für ältere Menschen sowie Menschen mit Beeinträchtigung sind die steilen Stufen bis in den 4.Stock schwer zu bewältigen.

We had a great stay at Pedro’s place. The hosts were super friendly and welcoming, meeting us at the apartment and showing us all the details. They left wine and oranges for juice as well! They have two great folders with many suggested restaurants and things to do.
The apartment is in a super location, easy to walk to all parts of Lisbon. Despite being in the center of the action, it was very quiet for sleeping.
As many have mentioned it is on the fourth floor and the stairs are fairly narrow and steep. We just considered it our exercise and other than a bit of haul for getting luggage up, it really wasn’t an issue.
We would stay again for sure.

We loved being in this Lisbon neighborhood! We walked to everything we wanted to see, and the weekend nightlife was bustling right around the corner. The apartment was perfect for the 3 of us, and the beds were very comfortable. Since we were exhausted from our overnight travel, we were allowed to check in earlier than expected. Pedro was responsive to all inquiries, and the apartment was lovely, charming and clean. There were also helpful printouts for attractions and dining. I would absolutely stay again.

Great place would stay again, great location and very helpful and responsive host. Comfortable couch and very sound insulating windows. Can’t hear the busy street at all. Only thing to watch out is the entry way is quite narrow as well as the hallways inside the apartment.

Great stay, everything as described
Location, clean, very nice space!
Thank you for a nice stay!

Det er en meget hyggelig bolig med alt, man har brug for. Den ligger meget centralt med gåafstand til butikker og restauranter. Boligen var rent og pænt, lå dog i fjerde sal med en smal og stejl trappe.

Pedro’ place was exactly how it was described. We loved it it was trendy and in great location. As he was warning us the stairs was a little struggle to get our big suitcases up but it didn’t effect our stay. Would recommend to anyone!

We were greeted warmly even after an unfortunate travel delay and had a full tour of the place. I found the location to be perfect… walkable to all the monuments and close to great restaurants, bakeries, and nightlife. The pictures of the apartment are accurate.  Highly reccommend this stay.

The host was super kind and responsive, it was a very comfortable stylish place with lots of small affectionate touches.
Only downside is narrow and steep staircase but every other places in Portugal is like this too!

We had a great stay at Pedro’s place. We were welcomed by Francisco who was a gracious host. The location is perfect and very walkable to nearby restaurants and sight seeing. Not a deterrent but be mindful of the staircase (in terms of luggage) as it is a bit steep and narrow. It was perfect for 3 of us. Would highly recommmend staying here! We hope to stay again soon.
We loved our stay here. The location was perfect. Easy to find. Pictures were just like the apartment! Would definitely recommend.

Nous avons bien été reçu par les hôtes. Ils nous ont aidé à monter les valises dans les marches sans problème. Nous avions plusieurs recommandations de restaurants et activités. Le logement est bien situé pour visiter plusieurs quartiers à pied. Il y a du stationnement payant à proximité à bon prix. Le logement était très propre et encore mieux que sur les photos. Il est situé dans un quartier plus allumé en soirée ce qui est parfait si vous recherchez le nightlife.

Pedro was an excellent host, greeting us on arrival in Lisbon. He allowed us to place our bags in the AirBnb prior to check in so we could explore while our place was prepared. He left a bottle of wine and chocolates for us. We really enjoyed our stay and highly recommend for a great location along the tram 28 route.

This apartment is in a fantastic spot near a lot of public transport, everything you want is walkable, at max 15 minutes, though you could be at great restaurants in 2!
Super comfy beds, living space had a great vibe. Would stay there again!
We really enjoyed our stay! Very easy to communicate with the host. Great location and clean apartment. Would recommend!
Great location right in the heart of the city but no noise as the bedrooms are not street side. Great for a family of 3!
Great stay in Lisbon,  very quiet and restful apartment despite being in a busy street!
근처에 노란색 트램과 맛집들 그리고 에그타르트집이 많아서 너무 행복했습니다. 물론 4층까지 걸어 올라갔다 내려갔다 하는 일은 너무 힘들었지만, 숙소의 청결함과 호스트의 친절함으로 머무는 동안 편안히 지낼 수 있었습니다.
muito bom!
Super appartement, très bien placé, avec des hôtes amicaux et réactifs, que ce soit seul ou à plusieurs je recommande !

The only downfall but is very common is no elevator. Three flights up very narrow stairs and doorway. Everything else was perfect. Beautiful apartment with everything that you’ll need.
Very gracious host!

Amazing location, beautifully clean apartment. Loved our 2 nights here. The stairs were definitely a hike … but manageable !
Francisco was so quick to respond to my questions. This is definitely a great place for a family as well !

Pedro and the rest of the Chiado team were thoughtful all the way through, never missing a detail, from leaving a welcome note and bottles of white wine for us to enjoy, to a detailed tour upon arrival. More than that, the team was extremely helpful – it was my parents' 30th anniversary, and their team helped coordinate pickup of flowers to surprise my parents when they first stepped in. Anything we needed, they immediately responded. The place itself is a sanctuary amidst the bustle, yet situated ideally for exploration. The stairs up to the loft are not for the faint of heart, but you do get used to it, just be careful!
