I would not hesitate to stay here on my next visit to Lisbon and heartily recommend it to fellow travellers.
Loved this place, it was perfect!! So chic, clean and in a great location. We definitely will be staying here next time we’re visiting. Highly recommend.
It was so great and comfortable!

Pedro was extremely responsive from the moment we inquired about the property until we booked and throughout our stay in Lisbon.  The apartment was extremely comfortable and clean.  The location is central to all Lisbon has to offer and within a walkable distance from major transportation (trains, bus, & trolleys).  There are a plethora of restaurants and eateries near the property, so you can't go wrong with the location.
Great experience. Very helpful

This Airbnb was located in a great area. You could definitely walk around to restaurants, La Plaza and some bars. We loved our stay here, the only detail is if you have big luggage and not in great shape the stairs are very narrow and steep. We loved our stay here.

Our stay was excellent. Communication was proactive and extremely responsive, we were able to keep them up to date with delayed flights and were met at the apartment despite it being midnight when we arrived.
The space was perfect for two friends. Kitchen is ideal for snacks, breakfast, and coffee. Beds are very comfortable. Air con is effective.
Fourth floor location means the space is quiet despite central location. Looks just like the pictures.
Lovely monsoon style shower. Plenty of space.
Perfectly located to walk everywhere and near transport links.

We loved Pedro’s Airbnb so so much! It was beautiful, clean and very well located. Pedro was also quick to respond to our needs. We wanted to stay here longer. Highly, highly recommend! Thank you Pedro!!
Great stay!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay! However, it is worth mentioning that the place is located on the 4th floor and has a rather unconventional staircase. Fortunately, the host graciously assisted us with our luggage.
Wir waren mit allem sehr zufrieden. Super Lage u. sehr sauber!

The apartment was exactly as listed, and Francisco even left us oranges for fresh squeezed juice in the morning. Best shower I had in 2 weeks. Apartment in walking distance to amazing restaurants and bars. I would stay here again.

Apartment is beautiful, well distributed and detailed, appreciate the personal touches, entrance door  is tight and no elevator but this aspect is listed clearly.  Overall great stay in a great neighborhood.

Apartamento muito bom, limpo, excelente localização(lugar para tomar café da manhã e mercado muito perto), não escutávamos barulho da rua.
O anfitrião responde rapidamente e tem uma equipe que está sempre a disposição!
O único ponto é que o prédio não tem elevador e subir com malas até o quarto andar é muito difícil pois a porta e a escada são muito estreitas, entretanto, tanto no check in quanto no check out o anfitrião disponibilizou ajuda para subir e descer nossas malas, foi providencial!
We loved staying at this spot in Lisbon. Couldn’t have had a better stay!
We loved our stay. The location is amazing, so central and near lots to do. The check in was smooth and the host was friendly and gave excellent recommendations, can’t recommend enough!

What a great apartment - just perfect for the two of us. The location was very central - close to lovely cafes, restaurants, shops and transport. It was so nice to be met when we arrived, and shown around the flat.
The flat itself was very clean, very comfortable, and had all we needed for our short stay. It had been thoughtfully equipped so there was no need to go out and buy washing liquid, extra loo roll, etc...
The team communicated with us throughout our stay though we didn't need any help as it had all been so well explained in the first place.
Would highly recommend!
Great host, amazing communication, clean apartment with all necessary amenities, perfect location.

A perfect spot in Lissabon, very friendly host who will do everything to make yourself at home.
Tram 28 drives straight through the street but with the windows closed it will not bother you.
Keep in mind, stairs and front door are quite narrow.

Once up the narrow stairs with luggage to the fourth floor, everything was fabulous! Felt right at home immediately. Busy street but bedrooms in back of apartment so no problem.
Would highly recommend!!!!
Excepto las escaleras que están medio mal,  todo lo demás excelente. Gracias Pedro
תודה רבה!

This was my first trip to Lisbon and the hosts really made my trip . Check in directions were clear. I was met at the door by Rui and Lucas who were nice enough to bring my luggage upstairs. They explained the apt in detail, and they even have recommendations of restaurants and things to do, which is very helpful. As everyone else has mentioned, the stairs are indeed very steep and entrances are narrow, but you’ll be fine if you have a carry on and bookbag like I did. The listing was spotless, and felt like a true home away from home. As far as noise, I truly didn’t hear anything that was alarming. I plan on staying here each visit to Lisbon.
Location Location Location!! An absolute gem and conveniently located. Communicating with the team was very easy - we had a great time.
Amazing apartment in a really central location. Host was very responsive and helpful! Thank you so much for a wonderful stay!
Cozy place, especially living room. And hosts are always reachable and take care of us

The location is great, good for exploring Lisbon and the area by foot and using transport. The flat is well designed and equipped, with good WiFi and wireless Bose. However,  there were some communication issues and some basics were not provided.

Great place super close to all the action.  This place was a last minute booking and it did not disappoint. Beds were extremely comfortable and the couch was great as well.  American TV as well as Portuguese. Kitchen was small but had what we needed. Hot shower and big towels! We enjoyed our stay very much.  The only problem we had was too much luggage but we managed. The stairs are steep and there is no lift. The door to the building is small.  Nothing you can’t handle just be aware.

We had the best time in Lisbon. Apartment was perfectly located for us and all the wandering, eating and drinking we wanted to do for our 3 day stay.
Flexible check in, clean place, lots of help and advice/recommendations given to us during face-to-face check in. So much to appreciate!
We were aware of the 4th floor and the narrow stairway to enter so it didn’t bother us!

Cute place in a good location. Francisco met us to check us in and show us the apartment and all the details. We loved the oranges they provided for our fresh morning juice. Very thoughtful touch. I would recommend and stay here again.

Our family of 3 had a lovely stay during our 10-day vacation in Lisbon. Great value. Great hosts who are very responsive and provide great instructions on how to arrive via metro. Location is very convenient, close to public transportation, including right along the street where the popular #28E tram runs and next to the Bica funicular. However, very quiet, particularly in the bedrooms. The kitchen is very small but enough for our needs since we only ate breakfast at home and the occasional leftovers for lunch/dinner. There is a dishwasher, microwave, and oven. There is also a washing machine, and our clothes dried very quickly when we hung them on the drying rack in a bedroom with a heater. Beds are comfortable; shower is great w/ excellent water pressure. The hosts even provided a cleaning during our 10-day stay. Only warning is that the main entrance into the building is narrow, and there are 4 flights of narrow, steep stairs to the apartment.
매우 가파른 4층(한국으로 따지면 5층)이라는 단점을 제외하면 모든 것이 완벽한 숙소입니다. 숙소는 따뜻했고 호스트도 친절했습니다. 새해를 묵는다고 와인 두병이랑 기념일에 먹는다는 디저트를 준비해주신 친절함에 감동받았습니다. 감사합니다.

We had a great stay in Lisbon. The apartment was well located, lots of food options close by, central, and easy access to public transport. Beds were comfortable, space was homey, though they aren't joking about the narrow entryway / staircase -- it worked fine for us, but if you have a lot of luggage or accessibility is important it's something to keep in mind.
Would definitely recommend and return.
머무는 동안 내내 잘 지내다 왔습니다! 이 숙소 덕분에 리스본이 더욱 좋아졌어요! 한동안 리스본 매력에서 헤어 나올 수가 없을 것 같네요 엘리베이터 없는 4층에 위치해 있지만 지내다 보면 익숙해지고 오를만 합니다 ㅎㅎ무엇보다 숙소가 정~~~말 쾌적하고 좋습니다 👍

Ideal place for a weekend break. Very central and walkable. It is easy to reach from the airport via metro. Nice atmosphere below but not too loud as it is on the 4th floor. There is a nice breakfast place just downstairs and a small supermarket as well.
The apartment is clean and modern. We were met at check in Francisco who was very friendly and went through how to use the appliances and answered any questions.
Not great if you have lots of luggage as it is four floors up a narrow flight of stairs and the door is heavy but this is fine if you have a backpack.

Nuestra estancia fue tal y como esperábamos. Magnifica!!
El apartamento es aun mas bonito de lo que aparece en las fotos.
Limpieza perfecta, camas cómodas y ubicación inmejorable, con pequeños detalles en el apartamento que te hacen la llegada mas fácil,
Respecto a la organización, estuvieron pendientes en todo momento y nos hicieron sentir como en casa ayudándonos en todo lo que hemos necesitado
Son un gran equipo!!
Sin duda repetiríamos y muchas gracias por todo!

A mi esposo y a mi nos encanto el lugar, su ubicación es excelente para ir a cualquier lugar!!!
Y el apto muy cómodo y súper limpio.
Great stay! Everything went well. 100% recommend
Awesome apartment that is walking distance from lots of restaurants and sightseeing spots. Pedro and Rui were very welcoming and responsive. We had a great stay!
todo perfecto
great location... walking distanceto everything - walk and get lost don't be afraid to walkup or down a hill and get ready to be amazed at what you'll discover...

My partner, sister and I enjoyed our weekend stay in this comfortable apartment.
It is located very centrally - the 28 tram goes right past the building, which is very convenient - and despite being in a busy part of town the place is surprisingly quiet. It helps that the bedrooms are at the back, away from the street.
The place was super clean and very comfortable. The beds and linen were lovely and there is plenty of space to relax and eat in the sitting/dining room.
There is an excellent brand new cafe - Breakfast Lovers - just 2 minutes walk from the front door. Palacio Chiado was great for a special birthday dinner. And By The Wine - which is also close by - is a cool and impressive wine bar which is surprisingly inexpensive.
And don’t forget to visit the viewpoint near the Musueo do Pharmacia for amazing views of the city and river.
Just bear in mind the flat is on the 4th floor so try not to bring too much luggage as there is no lift in the historic building!
I loved this place! Great location, absolutely clean room, well decorated furnitures. And It was so quite at night. I definitely recommend this apatment!
Great location and communication! Thank you!
The apartment is very nice and comfortable! Location is very convenient, near good restaurants and public transport. Pedro was very helpful and friendly, he’s a super host!

We (1 parent, 2 kids 16&17 years) loved our stay at this place. Everything you need is there, great beds, nice shower, little extra’s that give you a warm welcome.
We’ve walked a lot, the stairs were quit oké - while I’m not the most sportive one.

Wonderful, wonderful, wonderful! This airbnb is exactly as pictured. Pedro and his team were great with communication and were always helpful with answering any questions we had in a timely manner. I will Def be coming back and also recommend staying here for those visiting Lisbon.
Helpful. Easy. Great location. Lots of advice on the city in the apartment. Would recommend 👍🏼
A beautiful, modern and comfortable flat to stay in whilst in Lisbon, handy for everything really, the shops, metro and riverfront. Excellent hosts, lovely welcome and no problems at all.
Such an incredible stay! The apartment was perfect and in such an ideal area. Could not recommend a stay here enough!
Had a great stay! Good location for Lisbon nightlife. Accommodating host. Lovely apartment!

joli veille appartement très bien décoré et très propre avec tout le confort nécessaire.
quartier bien placé.
juste un bémol sur les escaliers, au quatrième étage et surtout très étroits ainsi que la porte du bas.
mais nous sommes gentiment accueillis et disponible pour toutes questions.

This is in the central tourist area. Great to get on the # 28 tram to take you through the city. Along with being central also comes noise. You just have to close the windows to block out the sounds.
It was very clean and had everything needed. The 4 flights of stairs are challenging with luggage because they are so steep and narrow.
This is the place to be if you want to be in the center of the action.
Pedro’s place was fantastic. Great location and amenities. As long as you can fit through the door and endure the steep stairs, it is a wonderful place to stay and was perfect for our honeymoon.
Clean and Spacious. Perfect location. Quiet despite being on a main road and near Bairro Alto.

This was the best AirBnb we stayed at during our cross country Portugal trip! Don’t even hesitate, just book it now if you’re staying in Lisbon. You won’t regret it!
Location is 10/10 - right in the heart of downtown Lisbon, a 5 minute walk from nearly anything you need.
Actual unit is 10/10 - spacious, nice and super comfortable. Just a word of warning that it’s up 4 flights of stairs so if you have any accessibility issues, it may not be for you.
Host was 10/10 - accidentally locked myself out - Pedro and Antonio were super nice about it and quick to respond. Antonio’s introduction to the place was a really nice touch. He even left us a bottle of wine!
Appartement très bien situé et conforme à l’annonce : merci et peut-être à un prochain séjour !
Great location and space !!!

Pedro and team were amazing hosts.  They have made this space extremely accommodating for a several day/ week stay with everything one would need. The location is perfectly situated to navigate Lisbon sites. We would stay here again.  Just a note - the stairs.  A reality of most of Lisbon.

We really enjoyed our stay! The location is in an excellent location and provided a great jumping off point for exploring Lisbon. The host was incredibly helpful and went above and beyond, providing parking recommendations and organizing a cab to the airport on our last day. We would definitely recommend this Airbnb!
Great place and location.

Had a fantastic stay here! Excellent communication with the host. The apartment is in a great location, clean, and very comfortable for 3 people. The host was also kind enough to leave us some wine / chocolate / oranges to welcome us. Would 100% recommend staying here!

Perfect location, perfect check-in, we enjoyed our week in Lisbon.
The apartment is very well located, near a lot of restaurants and bakeries.
The metro is 5 min away.

We loved our stay from beginning to end. We booked months in advance but always received fast responses. The details for arriving to the apartment made traveling easier. Communication from booking had been awesome. We felt so relaxed arriving to Lisbon because of the communication. The apartments literally up straight 4 flights of narrow steps. But location is central to so many things. Close to trolley, Uber ride, walk to metro or train. Tons of food and they provide a list for places. We used the travel list to get every where and find food. The apartment is very clean and modern. Don’t forget to pack converters for electronics. But you can purchase them for cheap at corner stores. Again a wonderful stay.

This flat is beautiful and so comfortable. Every detail is well thought out and the location couldn’t be more perfect. The apartment is steps from so many restaurants, cafes and shops ( pack comfortable shoes! ) Nightlife is nearby if you want it, but you cannot hear it when you are inside the apartment.  The stairs are not for the faint of heart. Those with mobility issues should probably avoid this fourth floor walk up, but if you are healthy and strong, this place is perfection!

Loved our stay here, communication was great and the hosts were very helpful even let us check in a little earlier than planned. The apartment was clean and tidy and plenty of space for the 3 of us. Would recommend.

This was one one of the best experiences I’ve ever had with an Airbnb. I sincerely cannot say enough about it. The hosts communicated with us the whole time and timely in responses. The location looks exactly like the photos and it’s a great central location as mentioned. When we arrived, we were greeted by one of the hosts and they showed us around the apartment to welcome and explain to us how some of the amenities worked. They left us with some city information, wine, and fresh fruit to enjoy. I later found a hand written note to us which added that personal touch. The host also checked on us the first night to see how our stay had started out.  Sincerely a wonderful experience. I would stay again in a heartbeat and recommend to everyone.
Great appartment onna great spot! Nothing negative to say.

Location right in the heart of the tourist area. Apartment on the top floor, clean, comfortable, great A/C.  The place was close to all popular sites and a safe neighborhood, and we enjoyed how close the cafes were.
Great location, apartment is in fantastic condition, and the hosts are super accommodating. Highly recommend. We were so grateful to have AC in both bedrooms after being in the heat all day.
We’ve had a wonderful time and would recommend this lovely apartment 100%!!
Beautiful apartment in a great location. Would recommend to anyone!
Lugar maravilhoso, limpo, bonito e agradável. Localização incrível e pessoal muito atencioso.
Couldn’t have stayed in a more perfect air bnb for our city break in Lisbon! Amazing location and great communication. Can’t wait to come back soon!
Really great place in the heart of Lisbon- clean and quiet- just what we needed

beautifully appointed flat, very much in the heart of Lisbon and yet very serene, especially in the bedrooms which were away from the main street. The large cosy corner sofa was much appreciated for chilling out after sightseeing around Lisbon, and the coffee maker kept us fuelled. The checkin, welcome and recommendations for restaurants and bars was great.
Otima hospedagem, apartamento aconchegante e confortavel, bem equipado e limpo. Localizacao perfeita!

Can’t say enough positive things about this unit & location. Located in the heart of Chiado, it was spacious, clean, and convenient to the Metro, Tram 28 stops, Praça Luís de Camões (excellent place for a drink from kiosk, people watching, and daily Pastéis de Nata from Manteigaria).
The unit is snuggled between two store fronts on a bustling street. Once you navigate the 4 flights of stairs, (53 steps in all) you are well rewarded w/a well appointed, bright, secure, and airy apartment. Appreciated all the small welcoming touches from tea and coffee to a bowl of oranges for making freshly squeezed juice. Because the bedroom is at the back of the unit, we were never disturbed by the busy street below. Bed was very comfortable and we loved the extra room w/single bed, used as our closet/changing room. The ability to sleep w/open windows kept the space cool and very comfortable. Many AirBnB units skimp on seating- this place has a huge and comfy sectional that allows you to stretch out and power nap at the end of a long day of exploring. Be sure and make Pastelaria Orion a daily routine- just one door down-we started every morning there with an Americano, tea and a brioche or buttered toast (lovely & efficient service).
Obrigada to Francisco who welcomed us upon arrival, walked us through all aspects of the unit, provided a list of restaurant recommendations, offered to make reservations for us, responded asap to a bad battery in the carbon monoxide detector, and quickly directed us to a Covid test site when we realized the tests we brought along wouldn't work for our airlines.
Without hesitation, this was one of our best AirBnB experiences. Would definitely stay here again. Pedro and team were excellent hosts from 1st communication to check out.
This is a great Airbnb in Lisbon. It has a great location and was overall, a very comfortable stay. The apartment is well equipped and stylish.

This apartment run by Pedro and his colleagues is a great place to stay for visiting Lisbon. Conveniently located in the heart of a great neighborhood, surprisingly quiet for sleeping (the bedrooms are tucked away off of the street), comfortable and clean. My friend and I lacked for nothing while staying at the apartment.
I would definitely stay there again if visiting Lisbon with a friend.
Thanks to Pedro and his team for a great stay!

Great location. Very central and super clean, quite and comfortable. The only issue for families with little kids, with stollers, is that it is at fourth floor (without elevator). In any case the house is not recommended as baby friendly, so nothing to complain!

We enjoyed our stay at Pedro’s place. It was very comfortable and well equipped. There was also a detailed manual with lots of local recommendations. Communication was great and check in was very easy. Thanks again for having us!

The apartment was fantastic! Well equipped and beautifully furnished. Check in was very smooth and Francisco was very very helpful and accommodating providing us with info on the local area. The apartment is in a great location and has a nice modern vibe. The hosts were all fab and even left us some traditional Portuguese Easter bread over the weekend - above and beyond! Would recommend to anyone!

Joli petit appartement, propre, bien équipé et très bien situé. Les chambres donnent sur l'arrière et sont donc relativement calmes.
Antonio est resté très bienveillant, arrangeant et disponible tout le long du séjour. Bien que notre semaine se soit déroulée sans problème, on sent qu'il est là pour répondre à toutes questions/demandes.
Comme mentionné par d'autres, l'appartement n'est pas adapté aux personnes à mobilité réduite (4ème sans ascenseur - escalier raide)
Il y a également peu de place pour ranger les vêtements (pour un séjour de 3-4 jours, c'est parfait mais une semaine ou plus, ça devient un peu juste)
Autre petit bémol: l'insonorisation (le quartier étant prisé par les fêtards, vous n'êtes pas à l'abri de quelques nuisances venant de l'appartement voisin aussi en location - nous en avons fait les frais le samedi soir - mais cela fait partie de l'expérience lisboète!)
Super sympa

Everything was excellent. The host answered us with a very little notice, and was ready to check us in about 45 min from the time we made the reservation. The place was super clean, the location in Chiado exceeded all our expecations, so many great restaurants, cafes, shops and beautiful streets nearby. Not to mention the 28 tram had a stop just outside the building. Great apartment also if you need to work, silent when windows closed and a good WiFi-connection. Overall extremely cozy apartment, old building feeling but with modern details!

Fantastic location with a busy street right outside and excellent eateries around every corner. The provided recommendations were a delight and the host was a pleasure to work with. The place itself was pretty spacious with excellent amenities, especially the shower which can accommodate taller people. I would stay here again.
Excellent location. Great host. Accurate listing.
Great place for a weekend in Lisbon.

Excellent séjour chez Pedro avec de très belles attentions à notre arrivée et départ. Idéalement situé, appartement de qualité et très confortable. On se sent comme à la maison. Un grand merci à toute l équipe de Pedro très attentive et à l écoute. Exceptionnel

El alojamiento es estupendo, tal y como se ve en las fotos. La localización es perfecta para conocer la ciudad y los anfitriones son de lo más agradable, dispuestos a facilitar todo cuanto esté en sus manos.
Lo único que merece la pena destacar son las escaleras que hay que subir para llegar al 4º piso, que no son aptas para personas con movilidad reducida o carritos de bebé.
It was a great experience, great location and very flexible host!

The flat is so great in one of the best locations with loads of restaurants and shops. The flat offers EVERYTHING you’d need in the most perfect condition! The hosts were really helpful. We couldn’t ask for a better time in Lisbon. Thank you!!
Thuy & Robert
Convenient location, cute place, great hosts!
Communication was flawless and super fast. Apartment was clean, well equipped and cozy. Thanks to Pedro and his team for the great service
Fijne host, vriendelijk en betrokken. Je kan altijd vragen stellen en communiceren. Bedankt !

Super locatie, net appartement en van alle voorzieningen voorzien. De hosts waren super behulpzaam. Zij zorgden ervoor dat ons verblijf aan niks ontbrak. De volgende keer zullen we hier zonder twijfel weer verblijven!

I highly recommend! Amazing location, great communication and very easy check-in. Antonio and Rui were so friendly and flexible with me as my travel plans changed last minute. Baixa-Chiado is central / walking distance to everything you want to see, and the neighborhood is very safe and has cute restaurants, cafes, and shops all around. The stairs were not an issue at all -- even though the apartment is on the 4th floor, it's only 4 flights of stairs, not 8 like it is in the U.S. This airbnb was so clean and has everything you'd need!
Great location to stay during your stay. Loved the quality of the bedding, sheets and towels. This place has heating which is a great bonus.
Really lovely hosts. Great communication, they also surprised us with a bottle of bubbly to celebrate New Years. Home is as described. Beautifully decorated and in a great location.

I highly recommend Pedro’s pad !!
Incredible location, amazing hospitality. Hope to return soon!!
Do yourself a favour and stay here.
Amazing location and very helpful hosts!
Loved the place and the guys were such a help for anything at all that we needed.
Great location. Nice apartment with all that you need. Keep in mind is 4th floor….if you don’t mind stairs it was perfect for our family.
This flat was by far one of the cleanest places I've ever stayed at. Communication was excellent, flat was over our expectations, and location was centrally located.

Great stay in a superbly located apartment in the heart of Chiado. As the bedrooms are at the back (not on the main road) we had a very quiet and peaceful sleep. Check in was efficient and friendly within 2 mins of us arriving outside the apartment, and there are all the amenities you need - no problems with anything that we used including wifi.
The little bottle of wine and coffee pods on arrival is a nice touch :)
Do be aware as per the listing there are 4 flights of stairs to come up, but with Lisbon being such a hilly city you will find this throughout your entire trip - unless you stay on the ground floor or a hotel with lifts I would say this is unavoidable.
Would definitely recommend and whenever we visit Lisbon again we’d stay here again!

This is a great place that I would recommend to anyone going to stay in Lisbon. We went as a group of 3 friends. It’s a great location with most things in walking distance, quiet, spotless, and a lovely touch of some wine, coffee and fresh oranges supplied! Thank you!
Amazing apartment, super convenient and fun! Pedro left us some amazing recommendations for our trip and we couldn’t recommend his place more.
Pedro is a great host, everything was very simple and well organized!
Very smooth check in, good communication, helpful people, clean apprtment, perfect location

Staying here was a good choice. Near everything, cute little pebbled streets all around, cafés, restaurants, grocery, sightseeings –all walking distance. Even being a neighborhood full of live, it’s quiet and great to rest and have good sleep at night. The flat is very complete, has all facilities and commodities (washing machine, well equipped kitchen, aa, hairdryer, tv, etc). Beside the utility, it’s comfortable and cozy with great taste. Communication with António and further check in with Francisco was smooth, kind and friendly. They have lots of recommendations to enjoy Lisbon at it’s best and are always there for anything 💫🙏🏽

Lots of kind little touches and thoughtful in person check in.  (Even really helpful when our daughter was immediately sick on arrival!)  Great with small kids.  Nice location for walking the whole city.

This apartment is great! Good location, walking distance everywhere! Host met us at check in and walked us through everything in the apartment and gave us several recommendations. Apartment is right next to a nice cafe. We went there most mornings for espresso and pastries. Only warning and not a bad thing: this apartment is on the 4th floor. If you can’t walk stairs, this is not the right apartment for you.
Beautiful accommodation in the heart of the city . Would recommend this to anyone planning to explore Lisbon. Lots of thought had been put in including a guide to local restaurants ! Amazing stay

Rrreeeally perfect location! Decoration beatiful, equipment and linen of higher quality. Very nice and helpful welcome and information! Would really recommand to stay here!
Only thing u should know: Very narrow and steep staircase, narrow door.

Pedro’s place is fantastic. I would give it 10 stars if I could!! The apartment itself is so gorgeous, spacious and had everything we needed for our stay. They even supplied plug adapters for us in case we forgot them. That’s a lovely touch. Everything was perfect. The location is second to none and although it’s in the city centre, it’s really quiet at night. We had the best time in this Airbnb. Book it if you get the opportunity to go to Lisbon!
We spend 2 wonderful nights at this place in Lisbon. I can fully recommend it. Perfect spot, great places to visit around, very nice apartment, fully equipped and the host was very helpful. 10/10!
Goede locatie voor centrum Lissabon. Vlakbij trein naar de stranden en vlakbij bairro Alto. Erg netjes en goede host

The two of us loved our stay at Pedro’s place! Clean, well furnished, spacious for the two of us. The location is absolutely superb. As advertised - the 4 sets of stairs are steep and worth considering for guests less mobile. It had everything we needed. Thank you very much again!

Non potevo chiedere di meglio! l'appartamento di Pedro è in pieno centro, lungo la via dove passa il famoso tram n.28 che attraverso tutta la città. Appartamento grande e funzionale, arredato con cura. All'arrivo abbiamo trovato anche una ottima bottiglia di vino, e un biglietto di benvenuto con due cioccolatini... noi venendo da Perugia ci siamo però presentati con una scatola di Baci Perugina che hanno fatto molto piacere al nostro host. Nonostante a poche decine di metri ci siano i migliori locali del Bairro Alto con una quantità di gente assurda specie il fine settimana, l'appartamento gode di un silenzio assurdo. Addirittura la notte sentivamo solo le vibrazioni di quando passava il tram per strada, molto molto leggere. Insomma se volete passare qualche giorno per visitare l'incantevole Lisbona, l'appartamento di Pedro è da consigliare... tra l'altro ci ha aspettato fino a sera a causa del volo arrivato oltre le 20, ci ha consigliato i migliori ristoranti (fuori dal giro turistico) dove abbiamo mangiato benissimo... che dire... vorrei tornare anche domani! Grazie!!!

Central, comfortable, everything we needed was there… the in person welcome, the manual/guide, and gifts were wonderful. The hosts really take care of their place and it shows. There’s a washing machine, dishwasher, AC, comfy beds, and great pillows. Book this place!
Awesome apartment! Great location with 28e trolley station and Bica funicular very close. Great food and sight recommendations. Very attentive and accessable hosts!

The apartment was just perfect for us.Everything is as shown on the pictures and as mentioned in the description.we really liked how the apartment was decorated.
Communication with the hosts was perfect at any time. There even were some fresh fruits and a bottle of wine for us when we arrived.the apartment is in a central location,bit still quiet. the stairs are steep and narrow,but the host was so kind to carry our luggage up to the 4th floor. thanks again,we really appreciated it!
i can recommend this apartment from the bottom of my heart for everyone who wants to spend a couple of days for sightseeing in lisbon.
The piedina shop on the other side of the street was great,too.

Perfect experience in every aspect. The apartment is lovely, clean and the position is just perfect to visit Lisbon. The team really pays attention to every detail to make you feel welcome. It was one of the best experiences we have had with Airbnb so far! We can't wait to come back.

I stayed in Lisbon for two nights with couple friends and we were very lucky to find this accommodation: the apartment is great from every point of view. Moreover Pedro and the team gave us a very warm welcome, despite the very late arrival and check-in (landed at the airport well after midnight), with plenty of recommendations to enjoy Lisbon, accompanied by a bottle of nice wine. Totally recommend!
Amazing location! Can walk to everything in Lisbon. One thing to note is the stairs to get to the apartment are steep and narrow. Hosts were very responsive and accommodating.

Una estancia estupenda en el centro de Lisboa y equipado con todo lo necesario.
Diogo y Pedro nos dejaron muchos detalles por la casa, chocolate, mermelada, té, café...
The flat is nicely decorated and very convenient. The location is also good.
This apartment is very clean, perfectly located to visit Lisbon ! The photos reflect the apartment’s reality. Pedro is a friendly and very available host !

The best host I've had with Airbnb. Communication was excellent: easy, quick, friendly and very helpful. They have great recommendations if you want them, and were responsive and helpful throughout the entire weekend we stayed in Lisbon. I hope to stay again in the future
Great flat! It was the perfect size for three people, very centrally located, and clean!
Amazing location and great service 👍 Personalized check in experience, tips on local restaurants, clean place.
Excellent location and a great choice for a short to mid term stay. Surprisingly quiet even considering the location. Can recommend to people wanting to discover the city.
Perfectly placed to explore Bairro Alto. Very clean. The bedrooms are on the side of the courtyard, so it's calm at night. Check-In was very easy. I can recommend!

L'appartement est charmant et très propre. On y trouve tout le confort nécessaire. A notre arrivée, nous avons été chaleureusement accueillies ; la visite a été très claire et rapide.
Si vous aimez marcher, beaucoup de choses sont accessibles à pied. Autrement, le quartier est très bien desservi (tram, métro, bus, taxi, ferry...).
C'est parfait, j'ai adoré, je recommande !
PS : attention aux 4 étages à monter ; les escaliers sont abruptes.

Wonderful apartment, clean, perfectly located with stylish interior and very useful facilities.  The communication with the host was super easy and the provided tips were very helpful and made our stay unforgettable.
Great airbnb! Fantastic amenities! Welcome bottle of wine and mobile wifi router were incredible! Would definitely stay there again!! Cheers

Appartement très bien situé,proche de tout a pied.
Belle décoration, propre mais petit pour plus de 2 personnes et surtout, pas du tout adapté a un enfant en bas âge.
Manque un peu de luminosité car les fenêtres sont très petites et les plafonds bas sinon la literie etait tres bien,et bien équipé.
Les 4 étages sont très raides et assez dangereux mais ca fait parti du charme de l architecture de Lisbonne!

We loved the place. Beautiful, clean, perfect location and thoughtful touches with the bottle of wine and chocolates. The local tips really helped us too! Comfortable couch and beds, really no complaints. Thanks for the great stay and great communication as well!

Place is absolutely nice , perfect location , amazing welcoming service with bottle of wine, mobile router with free WiFi to use in the city and of course the Bluetooth speaker.
It’s clean and cozy with all the needed things inside.
The only annoying things were the stairs which are too narrow and no elevator :)
Great place, excellent location, cozy apartment, well equipped. The hosts are very helpful, responsive and flexible.
An excellent apartment hosted by excellent people. By far the easiest Airbnb we've stayed in.

Just stop looking for another Airbnb, this one is perfect. Seriously, I know you think you need to check all options, but this checks all of the boxes. Great area near everything, rooms tucked away for quiet sleeping, soft beds, washer, dishwasher, clean as can be, a hair dryer, comfy couch, air conditioning, heater, responsive host, great local recommendations, easy check in, a great shower with good water pressure, homey touches like oranges and wine... see? No need to look any further. I’m a picky girl and I have zero complaints. Only warning which is mentioned several times, these stairs are no freakin joke. They are very small, 4 flights of a steep climb (I’m a relatively fit 30 year old for reference). So if you are older or very drunk, beware. Have fun in Lisbon! Make sure to eat as many pastel de nata as you can.

정말 너무 편하게 잘 쉬다 간 곳입니다. 정말 추천해요. 집도 깨끗하고 안락하고, 위치도 정말 좋아요. 다만 엘레베이터 없이 4층을 올라가려니 너무 힘들었지만 그것을 감안하더라도 여긴 정말정말 좋은 점만 가득합니다. 특히 호스트의 친절도가 최고에요 :)
Thank u, so much☺️
I was impressed with your memo and chocolates. Thank u very much your kindness . Lovely house:)

We really loved to stay this apartment! The explanation that was given at check -in was so great and the interior was so fancy! also the location is perfect. I‘d love to stay here later when i visit Lisbon again really.

정말 깨끗해요 그래서 여행내내 너무 즐거웠어요. 침대도 푹신하고 따듯한 물도 잘 나오고 무엇보다 방 자체가 따듯해서 기분 좋아요! 신발 신고 들어가도 된다했는데 바닥을 보니 너무 깨끗해서 그냥 슬리퍼와 맨발로 다녔어요(실내 슬리퍼 미리 챙기세요) 위치는 대로변이긴한데 늦은밤은 조금 위험할 것 같아요. 여기 사는 현지인들 말로는 저녁에 근처에서 마약판매 한다고 하더라구요. 근데 뭐 하도 대로변이라 판매를 하든 말든 위험한 느낌은 없었고 시차가 한국이랑 많이 달라서 늦은 밤 9시 이후에 나갈 일이 없을거에요 ㅠㅠ 엘레베이터 없는 4층이라 체크인과 체크아웃시 매우 힘든 것 말고는ㅋㅋㅋ 저는 추천해요

혼자 하는 여행이라 위치상 안전한지와 난방이 잘 되는지, 그리고 청결한지를 최우선으로 보고 선택했어요. 안전하고 아늑할 뿐 아니라 에어컨 겸용 온풍이 되어 땀 흘리면서 잤습니다. 필요한 모든 것이 구비되어 있고, 위치도 정말 좋습니다. 개인적으로 블루투스스피커를 아주 유용하게 사용했습니다!
또 체크인할 때 호스트가 숙소 이용방법을 친절하게 알려주고 주변의 명소나 맛집 등도 소개해줍니다.
다만 엘리베이터가 없는 꼭대기층이고 계단이 협소하고 매우 가파릅니다. 저는 첫날엔 호스트가 짐옮기는 걸 도와줬고요. 체크아웃하는 날에는 짐 내릴 때 별 볼 뻔 했습니다. 짐이 많거나 여자 혼자시라면 이 부분 잘 고민해보세요!
전반적으로 굉장히 깔끔하고 만족스럽습니다. 남은 여정에도 이 팀의 다른 숙소를 예약해두었는데 기대가 됩니다!
Everything is really nice. Would have been great if there’s a lift. But still, excellent stay!
Well designed, clean, and great location. The host is really nice, and provide lots of tips for our trip. Thanks for everything, we had a wonderful stay here!

Great place to stay. Plenty of room for three girls! We were able to drop off our bags early which was great. There’s also a portable WiFi which was helpful too. Great location. Everything was walking distance! Great local recommendations! Stairs very steep but totally doable. Very clean and spacious.
청결하고 세심하게 배려해 주어서 너무 좋았어요^^ 포르투갈에 또 여행을 가게된다면 한번 더 이용하고 싶은 숙소입니다!

여러 후기에 나온대로 4층을 걸어올라가야하는걸 빼면 좋은 숙소였다.
방은 따뜻했고, 깨끗했고, 주변 관광지와 가까웠고, 호스트가 소개해준 주변 식당등 정보는 유용했다.
다만, 숙소 바로옆 골목에서 밤이 되면 마약을 판다고 판단되는 친구들이 있어서 치안이 걱정되긴 했지만, 워낙 사람들이 많이 오가는 곳이라 아주 늦은 밤만 아니면 큰 문제는 없을듯하다.

The apartment is very central located, with a homie and thoughtful design. The flat was sparkling clean and the team was super friendly and very responsive.
If you chose this apartment, make sure not to bring big or heavy luggages as the flat is on the 4th floor with no elevator and the stair-house is small also. But it has it's own charm. :)
To sum up: if I visit Lisbon again, with no hesitation I'll stay here again.
Pedros place was in an excellent location. He left us wine and raisins for the new year! He also checked in mid way into our stay to make sure we were doing well. Great hospitality !

Séjour en famille, appartement très bien situé, il est très calme  très propre et confortable.Je le conseille fortement , que des compliments à faire.Très bonne communication , ils sont réactifs et ont eu la gentillesse de nous attendre suite au retard de notre avion.Nous avons appréciés également les cadeaux de bienvenue et pour Noël.Encore merci , un excellent choix et une équipe professionnelle.
Una estancia estupenda, trato muy amable y un apartamento encantador.
clean apartment and spacey living room. perfectly situated in vibrant bairo alto. 5 minutes by foot from downtown. great service and quick responses.

Excelente! Fomos recebidos pelo Gonçalo que apresentou o apto com muita presteza. Completo, limpo, arejado, estiloso, sofisticado e Confortável. Ótima localização, embora alguns degraus a subir, vale a pena. Altamente recomendado.
This is about as central to the nightlife in Chiado as it gets. The 4 flights if stairs aren’t for the out of shape, but the space is beautiful.

This has been one of my BEST Airbnb experiences. There are a few people who host this flat but we primarily communicated with António. He left us wonderful recommendations, a couple small bottles of wine, and some chocolates! He even let us drop our bags off early since we had an early flight. He always responded immediately and he even messaged us after our first day just to make sure we had everything. Above and beyond hospitality. The master bed was SO COMFORTABLE! The whole place was spotless clean. I can’t really recommend this place enough! Keep in mind it’s on the 4th floor and the stairs are narrow. It wasn’t an issue for us because we travelled very light, but I would imagine it would be hard to get a large suitcase up there. The location is very central and it’s easy to walk to all the main areas. Overall, outstanding hospitality, central location, very clean and comfortable!

Pedro & the team were AWESOME. The amenities they listed were accurately described but in addition you can also login to netflix on the TV and there is a PORTABLE wifi to take with you around lisbon. This was SUPER helpful as none of us had data plans on our phones. The apartment was very clean, they left us chocolates and a bottle of wine and they helped us checkin and had printed instructions on how to easily access/ use all the appliances. The apartment is beautifully decorated and spacious for 4 people. We really enjoyed our stay here and the kindness from our interactions with Pedro. Highly recommend and there is also a really good gelato/crepe place next door. This is also a short walk to timeout market and Rossio Square ( which can take you to Sintra).
Amazing stay, we can not recommend this place enough!

Great apartment with a nice central location. Close to many popular bars and restaurants.
Make sure to grab some pastele de nata downstairs at Pastelería Orion!

The flat is very well located, cozy and new. We loved spending time there after a long day sightseeing. It’s on the fourth floor with no lift, so not suitable for everyone, but hosts were very transparent from the beginning about this (I stayed with my mom, she complained a little bit, but she liked the place very much so she said that she would definitely stay there again :) ).

O apartamento é MUITO bem localizado, nao tem barulho nenhum da rua, tudo de extremo bom gosto, o Diogo que nos atendeu foi excepcional e eles pensam em cada detalhe, nunca pensaríamos em outro lugar para ficar em Lisboa!

A lovely clean apartment with good quality bedding and towels. The apartment was in a great position for getting around Lisbon and for reaching the train stations to visit Cascais and Sintra. Great hosts with excellent communication and we received a lovely welcome! Thank you.
Fab place to stay for a few days. Great location, stylish apartment, good hosts and value for money.
Affordable, excellent host, easy access to public transportation.  Big shout out to one of their partners the “Blue House”.  Check them out as well to assist with transportation needs etc.
Beautiful apartment with a great location. Highly recommended and I would definitely stay there again.
Apartamento limpio, ordenado, con estilo. Recepcion perfecta. La escala de subida es un poco angosta y cansadora. Lo pasamos muy bien. Muchas gracias

We really enjoyed our stay! Perfect location with great places to eat just a few steps away. Be sure to check out the Orion cafe below and Pic Perfect ice cream shop a few doors down—if they have the lemon pie ice cream, get some, it was divine! Also easy walking distance to many stellar restaurants. The apartment was very comfortable and had everything we needed for a fabulous visit. The whole team was great! So many thoughtful touches throughout and helpful recommendations of places to go. We would definitely stay here again!
Sehr engagierte und nette Gastgeber! Uns sehr schnell als „locals“ gefühlt...
very nice, exceed expectation. The location is great, beds are cozy and soft. The landlords are helpful

It is a lovely place at a very good location. The hosts are easy to communicate with, they give you really good travel tips and they make the check out process quick and easy. It was difficult to bring the bags down as the apartment is in the top floor and the stairs are very steep

The apartment is in a great location, clean, and well air conditioned. You are on a busy street but no noise at all in the bedroom.
Pedro responded quickly and check in/out was very easy. I would recommend his apartment!
The apartment is lovely, we really enjoyed our stay. Also the communication with the hosts was perfect. Thank you so much for everything ❤️ Highly, highly recommended!

Pedro and all his Team offer a fantastic space with
Great location
Stylish space
Well equipped
Lots of nice details
That make your stay to be a very special one.
I totally recommend it
Mooie en nette studio. Fijne ligging in de stad en van alle comfort voorzien. Ook een erg fijn bed ;-). Aan alle details is gedacht. Ook de communicatie via de mail ging erg snel. Zeker een aanrader.

Muito bom, recomendo!
Apartamento muito bem localizado, acolhedor e limpo! O Diogo foi muito prestável!
La ubicación del piso es inmejorable. El piso está muy bien y tiene de todo.

What a wonderful apartment in a fun, bustling neighborhood. Be sure to look over the restaurant recommendations provided, we frequented many and we were never disappointed. Be aware, many were closed on Monday night, so if one of them interests you, be sure to check ahead. Diogo was so helpful and friendly upon check-in. He recommend Pizzeria Lisboa as an option after our late check in and it was delicious!
We would not hesitate to stay here again!
This is an amazing apartment in a great location! Wonderful amenities and it comes with a portable WiFi which is great. It’s in walking distance of so many things I highly recco!

Hôte sympathique, appartement propre et qui sent bon.
Bémol - escaliers assez dangereux pour accéder à l’appartement (56 marches) quand il y a des enfants.
Les escaliers n’ont pas été précisé dans la description

This is a lovely, comfortable apartment in an excellent location for exploring the city of Lisbon. The hosts were friendly and always very quick to respond to our questions and provide advice for visiting different areas. There were some nice welcoming touches for our arrival which we appreciated.
Great apartment in the perfect location. We really enjoyed our stay here. Was a pleasure dealing with the Chiado Lofts & Studios team.

Beautiful apartment in a great location. Close to the Metro, Bica and the Tram28 stop is a few feet away. In addition, there’s a mini prego super market a few feet away for most of your groceries needs.
This apartment has all the comforts of home with Netflix, Cable channels and they even provide you with a portable WIFI. This host has thought of ever single need you may have during your trip. They left fruit, coffee pods, wine and chocolates as a welcome gift and they certainly went beyond my expectation as a 1st time Airbnb user. You will not be disappointed!!!!

This place is a great value for a central location only a few minutes walk from a downtown metro stop. The apartment is on a very popular street that is lined with numerous reasonably priced cafes. The hosts are very amenable and responsive!

Location location location! We could walk to some many different places in Lisbon because Pedro's place was so central. His place was perfect for 3 people and we felt very comfortable at his place. All the amenities were amazing and made our trip the best it could've been in Lisbon! Thank you Pedro!
Great stay! Great location! You cannot go wrong!
Thank you for the hospitality gents !! Amo Lisboa

Fantastic location and great hospitality.   The host was a fantastic and prompt communicator, both arranging to meet at the apartment as well as throughout our stay when we had questions.  Excellent stay!

The perfect place! We were a family of four and could not believe how wonderful this place is. It is sparkling clean, great air conditioning, the perfect central location, and fully stocked. A teenager slept on the extra large couch comfortably. The recommendations for food was appreciated- best food we had in our ten days was just a few doors down! They left us a portable wifi which helped us get around the city. Don’t let the four flights of stairs put you off- just up once slowly with luggage and at the end of the day it is worth it. Lovely lovely place- I would recommend to everyone!
Great

Emplacement top, dans quartier de la nuit et pourtant on n’entend vraiment pas la rue dans les chambres. L’appartment est vraiment charmant, encore mieux que les photos ! Et des oranges fraîches à notre arrivée :-)

This was all you could ask for in an Airbnb, with an espresso machine and a bottle of Rose to top it all off. The place was very clean and stylish and super close to the main areas. Would recommend very highly!

Gonzalo is the best host. He is super available, reachable and helpful. All basic information is printed in the apartment.
The location was perfect. Super central. Walk distance to all touristic locations, many restaurants and nightlife.
I loved the complements like the letter, the chocolates, the wine, the fruit, etc. I give you 5*****
We will be back for sure.

Such a great location. Spacious for 2 adults. Nice personal touches-welcome bottle of wine on arrival. Option to bring out a mobile wifi device when out and about. Had the option to check in early,which was a great bonus. Would definitely recommend this apartment, a good base to explore the city.

El apartamento es precioso. Súper equipado, cómodo y bonito. La ubicación es inmejorable. Los anfitriones amables y respondieron rápidamente los mensajes. Los remiendo 100%. Si vuelvo a Lisboa sin duda los vuelvo a elegir
Greatest place to stay in Lisbon.
Splendido appartamento in posizione centrale, facilmente raggiungibile, ben arredato e pulito. Consiglio assolutamente!
Great location & one of the best Airbnb’s we’ve ever stayed in. Great amenities & extra touches - highly recommend staying here.
The apartment is perfect even at 4th floor, but the surrounding are quite noisy ...

A very lovely, Well situated and clean appartment. Just as described and with a High level of comfort.
The place is so close to everything, great restaurants, shopping etc., and the communication throughout both booking and arrival was superb., and it was a very friendly host.
We highly recommend this place, and would not hesitate to book again.

Great apartment in an excellent location about a 5-10 min walk from Baixa-Chiado station. It was very clean and surprisingly spacious. The windows kept the noise out, and with the bedrooms at the back of the unit, it was very peaceful at night. Communication was great and we were greeted by Gonçalo at exactly the agreed upon time. We would highly recommend to anyone.
Lovely apartment, very clean, comfortable and in an excellent location. Pedro was a great host.

You will love the location in Chiado.Two bedrooms were a bonus for my sister and I .People are delightful and helped greatly.Just remember a short train brings you to the most beautiful beach Carcavelos surfing and Cascais.Also go to Sintra.Remember there a four flights of stairs so you must be in very good shape to stay there.Love the host"s.
Snel duidelijk, mooi app voorziet in alles/ fraaie locatie, enkele lekkere restaurants in de buurt

Fabulous, fashionable loft with the most ridiculously comfortable couch EVER. Within walking distance of everything, yet surprisingly quiet. Loved our little espresso maker and all the counter space in the bathroom. Our hosts left so many thoughtful touches around the apartment—very welcoming.
Emplacement parfait, très propre, rien à redire ! Communication rapide et agréable :)
Great apartment and host!

A very comfortable appartment. Antonio was very kind with us.
very recommended

The place is just as described great location beutyfull place a gem to visit this wonderful city all the recommendations where great awesome restaurantes and food the hosts are grade A will definitely recomend and hope to return soon
Lovely place. Great host. Excellent location.

위치가 굉장히 좋아 모든 것이 편리했어요. 준비해 주신 오렌지와 커피도 맛있고 방문시 친절하게 설명 잘해주신다~ 밤이 늦어도 걱정없는 곳이라고 생각들어요.
28e 트램 정거장, 24시간 편의점, 푸니쿨라도 바로 옆에 있어서 대박 편해요.
엘베 없고 통로는 날쒼해야 다닐수 있어요. 최고의 장점으로는 매일매일 자동 스쿼트할 수 있어서, 건강해짐을 느낄 수 있어요.
Awesome place. Hosts are very helpful and kind. Clean and spacious in a great location.

Our stay here was fantastic. The location was unbeatable and the apartment was wonderful. Pedro & team were so easy to work with and communicate with, and they met us right at the apartment to help get us settled. I would recommend this place 100 times over to anyone staying in Lisbon.
Amazing apartment in great location

The flat is amazing. Really fancy and with a perfect position! I definitely recommend this place if you plan to go to Lisbon. The hosts were very kind and ready to answer to all our questions anytime. Everything was just perfect!

O apartamento é maravilhoso, a localização excelente e fomos muito bem recebidos. As camas são muito confortáveis, banho com aquecimento central, roupa de cama e toalhas de banho de otima qualidade. Só temos elogios!

Everything was excellent. Very nice and stylish flat in an excellent location.
Communication was fine. Would definitely stay here again.
Great host, great location, excellent service!

This place is in a perfect location very clean the host was very delicate and kind
I would love to comeback later
숙소가 예쁘고 깨끗해요 물도 잘나오고 난방도 잘됩니다 근데 엘레베이터가 없어서 그게 좀 불편했어요
Perfect for a short stay. Brilliant location, really comfortable bed and living space. Highly recommend. Only complaint was that we wished we had booked for longer!
Excelente apartamento, bien situado, bien comunicado y muy limpio. Estancia muy  agradable.
Phenomenal location, homely and great value. Pedro and other hosts were incredibly easy to deal with, left a lovely welcome bottle of wine and oranges. Thoroughly recommend.
우선 위치가 딱 좋았어요! 인테리어도 이쁘구 깨끗하고 좋아요 난방도 좋구요!  음 단점이라면 엘리베이터가 없는 4층이라는것?!ㅜㅜㅎㅎ그것 빼고는 다 좋았어요
Apartamento impecável, muito bem localizado.

솔직히 이 숙소는 별 백개 줘도 마땅한 곳이라고 생각돼요. 이 팀이 하는 다른 에어비앤비도 가보고 싶을 정도로 최고의 에어비앤비 입니다. 벨렘지구 제외하고 도보로 이동 다 가능하고, 만테가리아 에그타르트 집도 가까워서 아침에 사러 갔다왔네요. 위치뿐만 아니라 휴대용 와이파이 기기랑 스피커를 구비하고 있는 것도 너무 좋았고, 내부도 진짜 깨끗+깔끔+신식 그 자체여서 너무 좋았어요! 또 호스트랑 연락도 잘되고, 첫날 체크인하면 주변 맛집뿐만 아니라 리스본 맛집 등 추천 리스트 작성한 걸 주는데 정말 도움이 많이 되었어요! 비록 맨 위층이고 엘레베이터가 없어서 캐리어를 오르고 내릴 때 약간 힘들었지만 그것 외에는 별 백개를 주고 싶을 정도로 정말정말 추천합니다!
perfect place for whom visiting lisboa

The apartment was lovely and very comfortable.  We really appreciated the extra touches of a small bottle of wine and oranges that Pedro had welcoming us.  The only drawback was the steep 4 flights of stairs but it allowed us to eat more of the wonderful pastries that the city had to offer.  Also the recommendations that Pedro provided made our visit much easier. Thank you again for a wonderful stay.
Todo estupendo y como las fotos. Lo único que no cuenta con ascensor como todos los pisos del centro y por eso tiene el encanto de Lisboa.

Located in super convenient area which you can reach almost everywhere in the city. Also right next to the apartment, there is a perfect breakfast spot called Orion-liked very much!
Rooms are clean and all the facilities are in a good condition and user friendly.
Will def recommend this place to ppl!<3

Absolutely lovely flat in an excellent location to explore the city from. Welcoming hosts, very chic and great amenities. Worth noting it's up four flights of stairs, but if you're in Lisbon you'll have your fair share of hills to contend with anyway! Would absolutely return and recommend to anyone else planning on visiting the city.
great apartment! Very spacious and comfortable. Best thing was the location! Very centrally located to many attractions, shops, restaurants and bars.

Adorable area and can’t beat the location. Walkable to everything you need - restaurants, metro, trolley, etc. It was very clean and spacious - great for 2-3 people. They give you their recommendations on local eateries which I suggest you follow. We weren’t disappointed. If we are ever back in Lisbon we will be sure to stay here again! Hospitality was on point.

Pedro was really helpfull with us and the apartment was really good too. It's located in the Chiado area, so in the heart of Lisbon, really close to supermarkets, shops and restaurants. Also if it's just in the city center, it's not noisy. I recommend this apartment if you're going to choose an apartment in Lisbon. The only thing is that if you have with you infants or aged people can become a problem the steps.

Gute location. Empfehlenswert. Allerdings viele steile Stufen mit enger Treppe, oben ohne Geländer.
Sonst gut

We had a great stay at this apartment. Centrally located, beautifully decorated, thoughtfully equipped space. Especially loved the complimentary wine at check in, all the local tips, portable wifi and washing machine.
Only downsides- no soap, lotion, shampoo provided. Small opening to the apartment and lots of stairs! It can be managed, but if you are not in shape for it, it may be exhausting.
Perfect location! Clean & stylish apartment.
The place it’s amazing,  well designed apartment in Chiado! Loved all the details!  Made our stay in Lisbon WONDERFUL!!!!

Everything was well organized and very professional. So highly recommend everyone to chose that place.
Thanks again
Banu

Perfect location to all things Lisbon. Especially helpful was the mobile WiFi hotspot device. We liked using so much that we purchased one for the remainder of our Portugal trip. Thank you so much for all the special touches.

Excelente espaço! Super confortável e funcional! Organização e limpeza impecáveis! Boa localização! Pronto atendimento aos questionamentos, recepção com explicação de tudo sobre o apartamento e orientações sobre a cidade. Única dificuldade são as escadas para subir e descer as malas, mas tivemos ajuda na recepção. Volto com certeza!

Friendly host, great local tips, brilliant location and extremely clean apartment. Bottle of wine on arrival was a lovely touch! Host was kind enough to warn us of an incoming hurricane which we would otherwise not known about. Would definitely recommend and stay again.
Amazing clean and stylish apartment, no noise even though it is super central. lovely extra touches like wine, chocolate by the bed. very awesome apartment

The apartment is amazing, looks better than the picture, I enjoyed so much, the only downside is the entry door and stairs are very narrow. But I get use to it, later on.
The bed is very comfortable, and you won't hear street noise in the bedroom. I will definitely stay here again.

Fantastic location and everything you need to enjoy the city. It has been tastefully done, with new appliances and comfortable beds. Whilst it is on a busy street you can't hear the noise at night. I would definitely stay again. Just remember it is on the 4th floor, but it kept us fit more than anything!
Super place to stay in Lisboa. Very good location, clean, nice style, friendly communication - just perfect. :)

Fabulous apartment. Chic, well appointed, sparklingly clean and in a great location. It’s a easy to reach via the metro from the airport and then just a short walk from the nearest Metro stop. The apartment is on busy road but you wouldn’t know it, the bedrooms are at the back and it is lovely and peaceful at night.
Plenty of bars and restaurants and a supermarket are just a short walk away. But then you are never far from anywhere in Lisbon. Get your comfy walking shoes on and enjoy everything Lisbon has to offer, this is a great place to stay and do it, I highly recommend it.

This is a five star property. The loft is in the middle of everything on the popular tourist tram route, around the corner from the great restaurants, walking distance to the local attractions and close tot he night life. Like most places in Lisbon, walking  up and down steep stairs is part of the experience, so too is this beautiful oasis. The property has a great heating and air conditioning. Washing machine and dishwasher were a blessing. Local grocery store very close. All of the uber drivers know the address well. The bedroom Linen is just beautiful. António and his team were fantastic, keeping us up to date with information along the way. Thank you for your kindness and for enabling us to check in early. Our stay at your property has been one of the highlights so far.

The place is unique. The decoration is a must. Every piece is well-chosen and has its own character /story. A lot os space. We really loved the flat for that point.
We stayed 8 days. We regret the lack of furnitures or products. For safety reasons, they are available only at your requests. So, ask when check-in, to avoid stress/frustration when needed.
Antonio is also very arranging, flexible, ready to help with luggage, ready to bring anything necessary for your stay. So thank you for your kindness.

The apartment is right in the middle of all the action - so close to the best pastel de nata place (manteigaria), and you can pretty much walk to all the main sights in lisbon which was super convenient. The apartment was well kept and super clean. Would definitely recommend for your stay in Lisbon.

We had a great stay in Lisbon.  Pedro and the Team have been very helpful from the very beginning to the end.  Very timely communication and smooth checkin.  The great location.  Literally hundreds of restaurants within the walking distance and the restaurants recommended to us were superb.  The room was clean and stylish.  We particularly liked the complimentary bottles of wine in the fridge, free mobile wifi and Bluetooth Speaker.  The apartment is located on the lively street but it is quiet once the window in a living room is closed.  We would highly recommend Pedro’s place.

With excellent access to Tram 28, restaurant and bars, a 5 minutes down hill walk to Time Out Market, and a large space to spread out - we loved our stay.  Recommended, as long as you are fairly capable of walking up 4 flights of steep steps to get to the apartment.
Perfect!

The flat is nice, but access to the apartment is bad enough, the 4th floor without a lift, the cape and steep stairs, little storage space for three people....
The apartment was very clean, nice decorated and great location!
Very cool place in a great location. Hosts were very helpful and flexible. Excellent stay!
Thank you

Todo genial ,ubicación sin duda inmejorable si queréis estar por el centro de chiado,números bares y restaurante para comer. Y el tranvía 28 con parada en la puerta!!!
Encanto con el anfitrión muy amable al llegar y explicarnos varias cosas que hacer por la ciudad,sin duda repetiría!!!
This apartment has a fantastic location and is gorgeous. Our host met us outside exactly when we arrived and was most helpful with orienting us to the apartment and suggesting dinner places.
The place is absolutely amazing! I highly recommend it.

Un piso impecable de limpio,  acogedor, muy agradable y muy bien situado.  Tiene todo lo necesario para una estancia, lo que lo hace muy cómodo.  Sin embargo hay que tener en cuenta que está en un cuarto piso sin ascensor.
Amazing host and location.  Will definitely recommend !!

Thanks for a fab weekend in Lisbon. Perfectly situated, really lovely, comfortable and clean accommodation. Went above and beyond to get bags dropped off before check in! Lovely host. Great restaurant recommendations. Perfect.
This apartment is in a very accessible part of the city.  The host went above and beyond to make our stay more enjoyable.  If we return to Lisbon, we’d love to stay in this apartment again.

Great stay here - very cool place, amazing location and the guys were extremely proactive in giving advice and checking up on us to make sure all was ok. The wine in the fridge on arrival was a very welcome touch indeed! Would absolutely recommend staying here.
Great spot right in the center. Worm welcome, thoughtful accessories. Good communication with the host. Great way to  stay in the center of night life in Lisbon.

Our stay at Pedro's apartment was amazing! The space was the perfect size, with everything we needed. The location was perfect, right in the heart of Chiado, just a 5-10 minute walk to the metro station and right off of the 28 streetcar line. We walked or used those for transportation most of the time and occasionally took Ubers. It was an easy (albeit hilly) walk to anywhere in Chiado or Bairro from the apartment. It's also right on top of and across from multiple restaurants, bars, and bodegas. Would definitely recommend this apartment for your stay in Lisbon!
Great place, very clean, right in centre of Bairro Alto, good communications, friendly owner. Everything perfect
Host was very receptive and willing to help in any way. Location was perfect for visiting Lisbon , very lively during the day  and quiet at night. Anything you could want or need within 1km.

Great Location in a pat of Lisbon where there is so much to do and see. great bars and restaurants to choose from.
The accommodation was outstanding. Beautifully decorated and so clean and spacious. We were greeted upon arrival by a very friendly host who went through the whole apartment with us and answered our many questions. some personal touches included a welcome bottle of wine, a welcome note and a chocolate... we recently stayed in an Air B and B in Barcelona and didn't even get soap to wash our hands...so we were blown away by this. There was also a list of bars and restaurants left for us...which we consulted and tried.
I would definitely recommend this place to anyone travelling to Lisbon.
We adore this apartment and so glad we chose it for our stay in Lisbon!

This space is pretty much perfect. It’s super clean and spacious, and the location puts you right in the middle of it all. The staff also leaves you a book of tips and places to eat, and they even leave you with a mobile hotspot to take with you around the city, so you don’t have to use your phone’s data. We would definitely stay here again.

Great location, great apartment and great communication. Lot's to do and see in this district and easy to get around from here too. I was accommodated for an early check-in and nothing was a problem. Nice complimentary bottle of wine on arrival and all facilities available for cooking, washing cloths etc. plus air-con in both bedrooms. Only one thing to watch out for.... if you have trouble with stairs you may have a problem as the apartment on the 4th floor and the stairs are steep. I have no problem recommending this apartment. :-)
Wonderful apartment in a great location. Spacious and bright and lovely thoughtful and personal touches from the host to make the stay special and comfortable!
Alles wie erwartet, wir waren sehr zufrieden!
Excellent stylish apartment, with nice little touches.

Clean and very cozy apartment which is close to metro station, just 3 minutes walking distance. It has everything you need even a wine cabinet. Really quick response from the host, and have many tips and suggestions about nice places in Lisboa. Highly recommended!
Best of all the places I stayed!! Antonio was so helpful and nice. The apartment is beautiful and is near all the cool places. Will definitely stay here again.

Die Wohnung ist sehr sauber und die Betten bequem.
Uns hat es an nichts gefehlt. Waren mit unseren beiden Kindern 4J und 1J da.
Kommunikation sowie Übergabe haben promblemlos geklappt.
Achtung: Kinderwagen kann nicht im Treppenhaus abgestellt werden. (Eng und kein Platz vorhanden). Muss in die Wohnung in der 4 Etage getragen werden.
Können die Wohnung absolut weiter empfehlen

Best of all the places we stayed at overall.  We stayed at 8 different ABNB on our trip and they were all terrific but hands down this was the best for extras like portable WiFi, Netflix bottle of wine:)  Great communication when we had questions.  The place was sparkling clean, stylish, spacious and the location is great. Close to some great places and train station.  Just be aware of the 4 flight walk up and the tiny tiny door to get into the building should you have very large or heavy luggage.  The apartment is newly refurbished in a a very old building.  Highly recommend!

This place is in a great location, is beautifully decorated, and is quiet! 3 of us stayed here comfortably, and found the hosts to be really helpful with their recommendations and quick, kind responses! I highly recommend!
A very excellent flat in the middle of everything, a busy area yet the flat is quiet. Stylish, clean, and spacious. Contact with the owners is quick and  effortless. Thanks!

Fantastic host & experience! The apartment is in the heart of Bairro Alto District but it is quiet & peaceful. Close to the great bars & restaurants.
Pedro & team were very communicative & made the process easy. They also provided great tips for taking full advantage of all that Lisbon had to offer. Highly recommend!

Wij hebben met 3 volwassenen genoten van ons verblijf in het geweldige verblijf! Perfecte centrale ligging, metro 28 stopt zelfs voor de deur. Ook winkels en restaurants op loopafstand. Ondanks dit alles geen last van het geluid buiten. Verder goede communicatie met de verhuurders en ook prima ontvangst met tips en presentjes(wijn, chocolade en jam). Kortom een perfect verblijf!

location is great. All the facility is good quality. the only problem is you have to walk up and down by a little narrow stairs to 4th floor. if you do not have any physical problem we will definitely recommend it to everybody who travel to Lisbon.
Volvería a alojarme en ese apartamento. Estuvimos muy bien
Inmejorable! Todo muy limpio, moderno y ubicación perfecta. Recomendable
Absolutely perfect location with full of facility you need!

Pedro's place was one of the best AirBnb I've stayed at so far. It was very clean and in such a central location near Bairro Alto. Checking in was easy and he was very communicative. I appreciated the small touches like chocolate, a bottle of wine, and local recommendations he left for us. But mostly we loved the portable Wi-fi he provided, which made navigation around Portugal super easy. The apartment was clean and everything in working order. Wonderful stay overall. Thanks Pedro and team!
Great appartement, Pedro and his staff is absolutely adorable and helpful, making our stay so much easier. Very clean and the decoration is beautiful, thanks again!

Wir waren super zufrieden mit dem Apartment! Die Kommunikation war sehr gut, schnell und einfach, vor Ort wurden wir nett begrüßt. Wem Sauberkeit und eine hochwertige Ausstattung wichtig ist, ist hier genau richtig. Es gibt natürlich ein paar günstigere Unterkünfte, aber hier ist jeder Euro berechtigt. Wir haben uns sehr sicher und wohl gefühlt. Die Lage ist ausgezeichnet und sowohl in der Umgebung als auch im Haushalt hat es uns an nichts gefehlt, außer vielleicht einer Rolle Toilettenpapier :D
Vielen Dank!

My two friends and I had a fantastic stay at this apartment. The apartment is in the perfect location - so central and close to everything. The beds were comfortable and the place was stylish. Pedro and his colleagues were very responsive and patient as our plane was very delayed and we had some issues with entry into the apartment one night. Would highly recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Lisboa!
Lovely location and close to nice restaurants and bars. There was a book of tips for restaurants which was really helpful. Highly recommend it!
My friend and I really enjoyed our stay. It's close to everything you need and we especially  loved the welcoming gift :-)

매우 추천합니다.
위치가 매우 좋습니다. 대로변에 위치해 있고 주변에 광장, 전망대, 술집, 빵집, 식당들이 많습니다. 리스본의 양대 타르트집 중 하나의 본점도 코 앞에 있습니다. 너무 편리하게 여행을 다닌 덕에 숙소 위치의 중요성을 이번에 참 많이 느낀 것 같네요.
청결도도 좋습니다.
웰컴푸드로 작은 와인과 잼, 캡슐커피도 받았고 주변 식당들에 대한 정보도 많이 제공받아 좋았습니다. 그리고 다른 숙소에서는 볼 수 없었던 블루투스 스피커와 휴대용 와이파이 기기까지 준비되어 있어 여행의 분위기도 한층 살고 편리했습니다.
다음에 리스본에 간다면 또 묵고 싶은 숙소네요.

Een keurig verzorgd, schoon en mooi appartement. De locatie is prima, het lawaai van de straat is binnen niet te horen. Naast de deur zit de leuke Pastelaria"Orion" voor een heerlijk zoet broodje met koffie, een goed begin van de dag. Er zijn genoeg winkeltjes en restaurantjes in de directe omgeving. Er ligt een boekje met tips voor restaurantjes en bij aankomst krijg je vriendelijk en duidelijke uitleg over alles en wat je verder maar wilt weten. Openbaar vervoer en taxi's is heel goed te doen en niet duur. Een aanrader!

Great location, great place. They let us check in early, that was very nice.
Definitely recommend.

This place is affordable and clean. It had two bedrooms (1) queen size bed (1) twin bed. This apartment was stylish, had Netflix, and was located right in the city center...like IN the center. The best part was that we were given a portable wifi --that alone is 5 stars. Me and my friends were very comfortable here. We felt safe and despite the stairs (4 flights) we would book here again. Beware of the pit to no-where it should be a popular tour if it could be- if not get a great picture standing by it.
perfect!

We would like to thank you for being an excellent host. Everything we needed was to hand. The little extras like the wine and chocolates added special touches to our stay. We would definitely recommend to friends and family. The apartment was very central which was fantastic.
Appartement à conseiller. Très bon séjour avec un très bon accueil.

11/10 stay. The apartment was beautiful, clean, well-heated with great amenities. The location was in the heart of Lisbon and convenient to walk or take any public transport. The hosts were very efficient with communications, helpful and friendly. The extra special touches in the apartment added to the memorable time in Lisbon and made this the perfect stay.

This is magnificent apartment, I like a lot the decoration. And the location is quite convenient, you can walk to everywhere. The shopping mall, restaurants, you can have everything! Pedro is also very considerable! I believe I will visit Lisbon again, this apartment will be a very good choice!

Superbe petit loft mais très bien organisé avec 2 chambres fermées. Il est hyper cosy et on a envie d'y relaxer après une journée à visiter Lisbonne.
Il y a une belle atmosphère et la deco est tres cool
Le wifi est dispo et même ils offrent une hotspot que l'on peut amener avec nous et avoir accès u wifi en tout temps durant la journée!! C'était une belle attention!!!
La communication etait hyper facile et tout s'est déroulé comme un charme
2 choses à savoir : il y a 4 étages et elles sont étroites à monter , Ca ajoute un peu d'exercice à votre journée!!
On a adoré notre séjour!!
Merci

DESDE O INÍCIO O PEDRO FOI BASTANTE ATENCIOSO, PASSANDO TODAS AS INFORMAÇÕES NECESSÁRIAS E TIRANDO TODAS AS DÚVIDAS.
O APARTAMENTO É MUITO BOM E FICA NUM BAIRRO BASTANTE AGRADÁVEL.
APROVO E RECOMENDO O IMÓVEL.

Pedro and his team were outstanding hosts. They met us at the flat to show us into the apartment, and gave us a very thorough tour of the property before leaving. There were all kinds of thoughtful touches around the flat, too, that made the experience feel really special. Pedro et al were also extremely responsive and helpful in helping us find local resources, and helped make our stay in Lisbon extremely enjoyable. I highly recommend Pedro and the Chiado Loft 6!

Die Wohnung war blitzeblank, es gibt Bettwäsche und Handtücher von super Qualität, die Ausstattung ist top und die Lage 1A. Die Betreuung durch die Gastgeber ist auch spitzenmäßig, super empfehlenswert!

Great 3rd floor walk-up apartment with nice location. Easy to get to bars and restaurants. The hosts were great with lots of useful tips and info. We were two guys in our 30's so selected this location due to its proximity to bars and restaurants. This apt was perfect walking distance to things like pink street and timeout market. Would stay here again if I'm ever back in the area.

Brilliant apartment with everything you could want-lovely rainforest shower, coffee machine is a brilliant addition and the guys leaving us a bottle of wine was lovely as well. Perfect place to enjoy Lisbon in the heart of barrio alto-close enough to walk everywhere, book it if you can!!

Had a fantastic time here. Pedro and his team made sure we were fully accommodated for, and when our coffee machine broke down they replaced it the next day. Such a lifesaver! With that they gave us recommendations for places to eat, go out, and an extra cot as we were (3) people. Would BNB with Pedro again.
Great location. They gave us a detailed greeting. Communication was excellent.

O espaço de Pedro é lindo, espaçoso , limpo e com comodidades incríveis!
A localização é incrível e sempre tem algo para fazer em qualquer horário!
Perfect location close to everything. The apartment is amazing – very clean, functional. Host is really flexible and tries to adapt to travelers’ needs!

Pedro and his team (António and Gonçalo) were excellent. Communication was great both before and during our stay. Gonçalo met us for the check-in and he was very friendly and even ran off to make us an extra set of keys. It's a good space, accurate to the photos. The beds were comfortable, the kitchen was well-stocked for a short stay, the location is great and busy, while at night it's a quiet sleep (the beds are at the back). I highly recommend it.

Wir hatten eine superschöne Zeit in einem superschönen Apartment! Die Wohnung liegt inmitten des Altstadtviertels und man kann von dort aus perfekt Lissabon zu Fuß erkunden. Pedro war ein toller und hilfsbereiter Gastgeber! Die Wohnung war sehr sauber, geschmackvoll eingerichtet und es hat uns wirklich an nichts gefehlt. Vielen Dank für alles - wir kommen wieder!

Lovely apartment, so very centrally located! If you don't want to cook, there are cafes and restaurants very close by.
