The #28 tram stops almost outside, and the apartment is just along from the top of the Bica elevador. It really is super easy to get around the city. Because it's so central, it may be a little noisy, but the noise doesn't last very late into the night! (and you're on the 4th floor, so it's not loud). Warning: 4th floor, so if you don't want to climb stairs, choose somewhere else - however, I was grateful for the opportunity to burn off some of the wonderful food available all around the city!
They also provide a portable mobile wifi hotspot, so if you don't have a good roaming plan, you can use that, what a great idea!
The team is very responsive to any communications, and the apartment is very comfortable. Great location, highly recommended.

The apartment was very comfortable, well-equipped, and located in an ideal area saturated with bakeries, restaurants and grocery stores. The apartment even looks nicer in person than in the photos! Pedro supplied this portable wifi thing which ended up being very helpful. A lot of things are walkable from the apartment, like the Rossio train station which will get you to Sintra or Caiscais.
Pedro provided a large list of food options within walking distance along with descriptions/tips for each one, which saved us a lot of time. Trust this list as it never failed us.
One of Lisbon's iconic vintage trams departs about 30 steps away from the apartment. I think this is the one that usually adorns the covers of most travel books & articles about Lisbon. If you plan on taking photos of it/selfies with it (you will see people taking selfies nonstop as you pass it), I recommend getting up just after sunrise as no one else will be around.
Chiado is a nice area and Bairro Alto is right around the corner. I recommend walking to Solar Antiques to pick out tiles as souvenirs.
Whether you are a couple, a group of friends or a family with kids (like us) I recommend this apartment as the perfect home base from which to explore Lisbon. This is my favorite Airbnb experience so far. Thanks, Pedro!

This beautiful and very convenient flat is located in a busy district close to main touristic attractions. It's on the fourth floor of a building without elevator and with very narrow stairs so if you have heavy luggage it might be problematic to get it up. But once you get into the flat you forget all the inconveniences. The flat is very stylish, comfortable and well equiped with everything you might need during your stay. Wifi is stable only in the leaving room but there's a small remote wifi router that you can take to the beadroom or even outside the flat to have permanent access to the internet.
Me and 2 my friends strongly recommend this place and we'd gladly stay there again when we're in Lisbon.

Pedro's place is tastefully designed in an incredible location. He is a gracious host and even left us the most delicious coffee. It was so incredibly clean and really beautiful. Bravo Pedro, you will definitely be my second home in the beautiful city of Lisbon.
Excellent communication, everything was taken care for us and we loved the location.

Everything exceeded my  expectations. The place, location, amities, and service was absolutely wonderful. The personalized welcome note on my night stand with chocolates, the bottle of wine, and the coffee pods were all an unexpected and great touch. Would stay here again!

Fantastic place - central, spacious and clean. On a central busy street but you would never know as very quiet in the apartment. Fantastic communication. Added bonus was air conditioning in each room which was great for the warm evenings. Four floors up but when you make it to top with your bags then perfect place to stay in Lisbon.

This is a great top floor appartment in a central location in the heart of the old city and although there is a tram stop just outside the building, you can walk to most places in the centre. The appartment is modern and well equipped and the AirBNB description is accurate. I would definitely stay here again and recommend the appartment.

Best Airbnb I have ever stayed in. They even had a mobile phone sized portable wifi to carry with you when you leave the apartment. Communication was impeccable.
Location couldn't be better. I would like to stay here every time we come to Lisbon.
Book it if you can.
The apartment was fantastic - very well equipped, great location, and very helpful hosts. Strongly recommend.
Amazing location. Def recommend this place if your trying to stay in Lisbon. Had everything we needed and more. Would stay at this place again in a heartbeat!
Very recommended!

Localização excelente, mas devido às escadas muito íngremes e estreitas, este apartamento deve ser utilizado apenas por pessoas jovens e em boa forma física.
É uma pena que a região (apesar do fácil acesso a qualquer ponto turístico ou não) conte com apenas 2 estacionamentos públicos - normalmente lotados, e com um elevado preço de utilização.

Optimo. Genial. El piso es mas bonito de lo que se ve en fotos. Tiene todo lo necesario para estar comodo. Incluso un wifi portátil que se agradece cuando estás fuera. Las habitaciones y las camas muy comodas. Todo limpio e impecable. La ubicacion está genial muy centrica y con todo tipo de sitios de ocio y supermercados y restaurantes a mano. Y cerca de Plaza Camoes donde hay una linea de metro que tambien es muy práctica. Nada que objetar. Hemos tenido una estancia muy agradable. Y Antonio nuestro anfitrión ha sido muy amable también. Muy buena eleccion.
Amazing location, the owners are awesome- incredibly helpful with recommendations etc. I would 100% recommend
Great location, amazing apartment and very hospitable hosts. Pedro was very helpful and everything went smoothly. Would highly recommend and return!

Très bel appartement tel que décrit: central et très fonctionnel. Les chambres sont calmes car elles donnent sur un patio intérieur. Bon accueil de Pedro avec des petites marques d'attention locale.
Nous recommandons fortement
Great location, clean apartment, and it includes a mobile WiFi hotspot we were able to take around with us. Very helpful!
This is a very comfortable appartement with great facilities and perfect location.

Very central and close to everything you need to see in Lisbon as the famous tram 28 going to Alfama passes on the street of the building!
You just need to climb stairs to the 4th floor and you'll be in this charming appartement.
Great equipment, even a loudspeaker to put your own music and a great coffee machine to add some comfort to your mornings!
The team managing the flat is very professional and friendly!
I definitely recommend this flat and the hosts.
Belle appartement, agréable et propre. Je recommande.

Este apartamento esta muito bem localizado no Chiado. O equipo do Pedro e muito eficaz e simpáticos foi muito bem recebido e voltarei otravez. O unico desafio são os degraus para entrar e sair com as malas.
Recomendo este apartamento.
A perfect host of a perfect appartement.
A very good place in Bairro Alto! They are also really kind!

We had a fantastic time in Lisbon and stayed in the AirBnB apartment for 7 nights. The host team were great. Highly recommend to stay here. The apartment is very spacious with comfortable beds. All the luxury you need. I will definitely recommend them to my family and friends. They even had a portable Wifi device which came in very handy.

I stayed here with my 2 sisters and we loved it! Plenty of space for the three of us, the apartment was in an amazing location, it was very comfortable, well decorated and well equipped. Lots to do nearby! I would recommend going to Park Rooftop Bar which is across the road when the sun sets at around 9pm - great music and cocktails too. There's a bakery and supermarket a few meters away and a tram stop. It's also really easy to hail down a taxi just outside the apartment which we did quite a lot as it's very cheap. We called the team with an issue on our first night there and they went above and beyond to help us! Would definitely stay here again.
Very nice, clean and a great location to visit the center of town
Amazing appartment. Pefectly furnished. Just great.

Lovely apartment in the centre of all of the action. Very little noise from the outside though so it's a nice sanctuary after a day exploring the city. Very clean and nicely decorated and the AC is a great relief when it's warm! Lovely area and they left recommendations for local restaurants and bars which we found really helpful.
Our whole experience was great, Antonio was there to check us in and let us in early. He also allowed for a later check-out as we had a night-time flight home. I would definitely recommend this apartment.

The Chiado Loft is a charming place to stay especially for a first visit to Lisbon. The attention to detail including amenities and decorations allows one to feel right at home! We could walk in any direction from the apartment and find pleasant surprises (coffee, pastries, art, wine, tapas, beautiful tile work, street musicians, shopping). Highly recommended!

My sister and I stayed at this apartment for 3 nights and it was the perfect place to stay. The apartment itself is very clean and had everything we needed. It was also easy to find after getting the metro from the airport. The area is lively with lots of restaurants and bars within walking distance but the apartment itself is very quiet. It has good links to all sorts of transport. We walked to the train station to get the train to the beach one day. There was a range of information left in the apartment about restaurants etc. which was a helpful touch. I'd definitely recommend.

Pedro's apartment is located in the centre of the city. Within walking distance, you can find lots of good restaurants and shopping spots. Besides the wifi in the apartment, they also provide us a portable WIFI so that we can use during our stay in Lisbon! That's very helpful! Just a reminder, the apartment is located on the 4th floor without elevator, if you have very big luggage, that's a bit challenge. But Pedro and his buddies can help you on this!
Oh, my friend said the hosts are very handsome. We met two of them (i think they are a group of three), both are helpful and charming!!!
Perfect accomodation for a perfect trip
Excelente localização

Great apartment in a great location -hands down the nicest place I've stayed in from airbnb.
The apartment is central to everything, near to bars and restaurants in Barrio Alto and Chiado. It is well presented and very well equipped. I went with my boyfriend and his mum and there was plenty of room for all of us. It is worth noting that this is a third floor flat at the top of some very steep stairs so may be difficult for some people to climb. Although the apartment is on the main road, it is quiet - particularly in the bedrooms where it is almost silent with the windows open.
Pedro's place is amazing. Beautifully decorated, really clean and in a great location. Pedro was a great host - would highly recommend.
O apto é muito confortável, claro, limpo como prometido, bem equipado e localizado e a recepção do Gonçalo foi ótima; uma ótima experiência.

Lovely apartment in an excellent central location. They were very accommodating- left some treats for us and brought us a rack to dry our clothes :). Location could not be better. The space is well designed and there is plenty of room for 4 people. Highly recommend!
The loft was exactly as described! Great location, fun area and timely communication. I would definitely stay here again!

The place is perfect for a long weekend with friends! Is very close to bars and restaurants in Bairro Alto, trains to Sintra and Cascais within walking distance. There is a mobile Wifi in the apartment to take with you while outside, which was great. Thanks we will be back!

i could just copy and paste my previous comments ...been at this apartment allready, it's great , comfortable , super central , close to everything , but when inside very quiet and cosy , spacious and well funished , communication super easy , thank you for the new super helpful walkable wi-fi device... totally recommend this apartment , great for 2 or 3   LF

Wir hatten einen wunderbaren Aufenthalt. Im Herzen der Stadt zu wohnen war toll und trotz des Lebens rundherum ein ruhiger erholsamer Ort. Das Schlafzimmer mit Fenster nach hinten liegt sehr ruhig. Die Betreuung war von Anfang an sehr gut und alles hat bestens geklappt. Die tolle Lage macht es leicht die Stadt kennenzulernen und am Abend kann man zu Fuß bestens das Nachleben auskosten. Die kleine Küchenzeile reicht für das Alltägliche, wir haben jedoch immer in einem der vielen sehr guten Restaurants gegessen. Wir empfehlen: Lost In: super Küche, tolle Aussicht, nette Bedienung, eher hochpreisig.

This apartment is very modern and clean.  Perfect location to get to everything you want within walking distance.  They even have a Netflix account for you to use while staying!  I do recommend opening the windows in all rooms to get some great airflow, or you can choose to use the A/C units which are amazing.  Everything in this apartment is high quality!  Only note to point out is that the apartment is a 4th FL walkup (which I think is perfectly normal/fine).  Highly recommend booking this apartment!
The perfect place to stay on a visit to Lisbon!
Great place! Very good hospitality, with personal notes and flexibility. Perfect choice for your stay in Lisbon!
L'appartement est parfaitement situé. Attention, les étages sont raides mais vraiment, c'est un lieu très très agréable pour séjourner à Lisbonne.

This apartment was GREAT for me/my 2 friends in Lisbon for a week. It could not be in a better location: only a few minutes walk from a metro, the bica tram, a supermarket, and lots of trendy shops and restaurants. An amazing home base for exploring Lisbon and doing day trips. Yes, be warned about the narrow staircase and 4 flights of stairs, but this was one of the only negatives. Amazing, we even had a pocket wi-fi which saved one of us a TON of money. The apartment was spacious, had lovely design, and SO clean. The hosts were also SO responsive whenever we had any questions. Would definitely stay here again!!!!!!!

Super location, bars/cafes (place downstairs is lovely and bar around the corner on the cross-roads is great value) and restaurants on door-step.
Apartment is very well suited for a short break - it is quite small, but has everything you might need - lovely shower and beds very comfy / modern vibe.
The only thing I must say - is the steps are hell. You have to be very fit (4 very steep and narrow step flights) as they are hard to navigate - we under-estimated them to be honest and don't consider ourselves old !!! But apart from that, it is a great place .... would recommend!
We had a great time here. The apartment is spacious & stylish decor in a great location to see Lisbon sights. Host gave handy recommendations & assisted with booking taxi. Would recommend .
El departamento es perfecto, tiene todo lo necesario. Amplio, moderno, cosas básicas y necesarias para tener una perfecta estadía. Quedaron cortos los días.
A quite nice flat in Bairro Alto. It's perfect located with a lot of nice restaurants and bars around. Although in the heart of Lisbon on a busy street it's really quiet inside! Great recommendation!
Great communication and a fantastic location!

Bem localizado e ótimo apartamento.
Pontos a melhorar : internet não pega no apartamento inteiro e o banheiro estava com cheiro forte.

Pedro's loft was amazing: beautifully decorated, fully equipped and cozy. The location was perfect, allowing us to walk pretty much everywhere, not to mention it was only 5 minutes away from the metro station. The neighbourhood was lively and full of nice bars, restaurants, bakeries and 'pastelarias'.
We had been warned about the 4 flights of stairs before booking the place, but that was no problem whatsoever.
We are planning another trip to Lisbon and hope to book this flat again.

We had an excellent stay at the apartment. It is barely a five minute walk from the metro, tram 28 passes by, and the ascensor de Bica is literally next to the building. It is very conveniently located next to various shops and restaurants. Communication with all the members of the team was excellent, and we were given good advice.
The flat is in the 4th floor; it is very pleasant to stay in, fully equipped, and very quiet even if it is a lively area. I would definitely come back again.

The apartment truly was beautiful- plus close to the city center which was very practical- and the host very welcoming. The beds were so comfortable you're guaranteed to sleep well! We had an amazing stay!

Très bel appartement, bien situé.
Je recommande cette appartement

Very nice apartment , for its proportions , light and location . Close to everything , walking distance . Every detail is there to make you feel home , furnished kitchen , nice bathroom , super comfortable bed and rooms , great place for a couple with a kid , the apartment is super central near the animated area of Bairro Alto , though is very quiet , i slept very well ! I could have stayed in this flat for a month ... no problem ;) I will be back. L

Wonderful apartment in an amazing location for young people, the streets around are full with bars and restaurants (within walking distance). Not so suitable for families with young children (the street can be noisy sometimes). The stairs to the apartment are narrow and not so easy to walk so notice that. The apartment was very clean when we arrived and well furnished with everything we needed (the kitchen is a little bit small), the communication was very good, but the thing that was the most outstanding is how close it was to public transport!! Very easy to travel across the city when you have a 5 min' walk to a metro station!!
Highly recommend!!

O apartamento é muito bem localizado, bons restaurantes por perto e é exatamente como as fotos. Muito confortável, tudo limpo e bastante silencioso para descansar depois dos passeios.  O anfitrião nos ajudou bastante e foi muito prestativo. Certamente recomendaria.

Communication was fantastic and they were able to accommodate our check in time. We were met by the team and they were super friendly and gave us a tour of the house and gave us some amazing recommendations, it's in a great location. Just to note, the apartment is on the top floor so would need to walk up a few flights of stairs which wasn't an issue for us but might be for others. Great stay, thanks for having us!
Our stay was perfect. The apartment is centrally located near shops and restaurants, but is quiet at night. The apartment is very clean and beautiful.

Logement très agréable et bien situé.
Très calme malgré son emplacement très urbain.
Un accueil de qualité.
On se sent chez soi.
The apartment is gorgeous and central. I have been wonderfully checked in even if was late. Highly recommended!

O apartamento é lindo, muito limpo e cheiroso (e a calefação é ótima, importante no inverno!). Localização perfeita, dá para visitar as principais atrações a pé. Antonio nos recebeu e foi muito atencioso e amável, adoramos a estada!
Perfect location, extremely comfortable ... just what you want for a city adventure . Looking forward to coming back.

El apartamento es muy bonito y comodo, muy bien situado y tiene todo lo necesario. La informacion q hay en el apto de donde comer, comprar, hacer, etc nos fue muy util.  Pedro el anfitrion fue muy amable y servicial. Nos encantoooó!! Mil graciass. Volveremos.

This is a perfect place to stay in Lisbon. Located in the downtown Bairro Alto district, and close to everything (<10 min from subway stop, close to Chiado shopping district and dozens of great restaurants (I would recommend the Taberna da Rua das Flores), a 1 min walk to the the supermarket). Plus, Ubers are insanely cheap here - an airport Uber will cost you only about 12 euros.
The apartment is looks recently renovated and comes with new appliances (stove, microwave, dishwasher), utensils, a spacious living room, very clean bathroom, and two beds with clean white sheets. Couldn't ask for more and only of the best Airbnb's I've stayed at. The only thing to note is that the apartment is on the 4th floor and there is no elevator, so anyone who is not in the best health should consider other places.

Antonio was there waiting for us to show us around the apartment. He was super friendly and answered all the questions we had. The apartment was gorgeous, in a really central area. Comfy bed. No complaints whatsoever.

El apartamento esta genial, tal y como aparece en el anuncio. Viajamos en el mes de diciembre y gracias a la calefacción estuvimos muy agusto. El apartamento es muy luminoso y esta muy completo, con lavavajillas, cafetera,... esta situado en una zona genial, con supermercado de barrio, frutería,.. a los pies tenéis la parada del tranvía 28 y por la noche hay muy bien ambiente por la zona llena de bares. Al ser un cuarto sin ascensor y con escaleras estrechas, se hace un poco incomodo para la llegada y salida con maletas pero merece ese esfuerzo. Repetiría sin duda.

This apartment was very comfortable and the hosts made us feel welcome and we're very responsive and accommodating. They brought us a coffee pot with filters so we could have American style coffee and also booked a can for us. We stayed in 2 different apartments of theirs now and highly recommend them! Great location, apartment and experience!

Fabuloso apartamento situado en un lugar perfecto.
Sin duda repetiremos.
Gracias por vuestra atencion y recibimiento.
Vega y Pepe.
Perfect location, perfect appartment, perfect vacation! Really enjoyed our stay!
Made to feel very welcome nice touch with the chocolates, tasty too and great intro to the local area .

L'accueil a été chaleureux avec une présentation détaillée du logement et de petites attentions portées à notre égard qui ont été très appréciables. De plus, Pedro s'est montré disponible durant notre séjour (réservation d'un taxi pour nous à 3h30 du matin pour notre retour à l'aéroport).

L'appartement est propre, bien décoré et parfaitement situé, en plein cœur du Chiado. Bien que situé dans une rue passante, sa localisation au 4ème et dernier étage du bâtiment et son isolation phonique (double vitrage), le rende calme. Prévoir malgré tout de bonnes jambes car, comme tout immeuble d'une quartier historique, il n'est pas équipé d'un ascenseur.

De cette adresse, vous pourrez prendre le tram n°28 et un funiculaire qui descend au pied de la ville. Tout le Chiado mais également Bairro Alto et la Baixa pombalina peuvent se visiter à pieds. Le Vieux Marché de la Ribeira n'est qu'à 10-15 minutes de marché tout comme la gare Cais do Sodré qui vous mènera à Bélem (10 minutes de train). Le quartier dénombre également une multitude de patisseries et de restaurants qui vous permettrons de découvrir les saveurs locales.
Thoughtfully designed and agreeable flat, with a cozy atmosphere. Well located in the center, not far away from the major attractions. Helpful staff. Will recommend it to friends.
La ubicación del apartamento es genial!!! Súper recomendable. Es tal cual se ve en las fotos. quedamos muuuuy contentos con la estadía en Lisboa. La atención del anfitrión un 10!!!

Great moment in this flat. The localisation is perfect, you have beckerry, tram, bus very close and you ca also do all by walking. The Flat is very clean, and it was so nice to be there for 4 days.
This flat is like all positive point as hotel but we all positive things as you own appartment.

A very central spot, beautifully decorated, new cosy apartment with all comforts you need. Clean, fresh smelling linnen, clean kitchen and bathroom etc. Our hosts were fast to respond, very friendly, easy-going, polite and spoke excellent english: this was especially helpful when we needed their assistance: once after midnight and once after we had checked-out, they were there to help us. A great experience and i am curious to try one of the other apartments next time when I am in Lisbon!
Nice an warm welcome, beatiful flat.
Great place in a fantastic location, would definitely recommend and stay here again!
Photos were accurate. Great communication. Host even helped us call a cab for our early flight. Location was perfect, right in the middle of shopping, restaurant, bars, and transportation.

This studio in baixa-chiado is perfectly located. The rooms are spacious and comfortable. ACs are in each bedroom and works well. Antonio is a responsive and helpful host. We have to admit we don't always enjoy the 4 storeys climb up the narrow stairway but that's the only thing to think about for those with mobility issues and bring your personal toiletries. Otherwise we loved our stay and would love to come back some time. Thanks for everything!

The apartment is beautifully decorated and super comfortable. You feel as if you are at home. Super spacious and clean..we loved it! Keep in mind you have to go up a lot of stairs with luggage but once you arrive its all worth it!! If i return I will stay here...we loved it. The host were both awesome..they were understanding and very responsive and accesible at all times. You can rent with no worries!

We had a great stay at the apartment. It was 3 of us and we all had plenty of space. The decor is wonderful! You can tell they have put a lot of thought and effort. The apartment is very clean, beds are spacious, and you feel right at home. Communication was fast and easy and would respond quickly. They even allowed us to drop off our bags while they got the apartment ready for us. It's also a great location for restaurants and night life. Highly recommend!

My brother, sister and I had a great stay at this AirBnB. The listing was very spacious and matched the description and photos perfectly. Check-in went smoothly, and we were provided with all the information we needed. Communication was easy, and I always received a response to any questions or updates within minutes. The best part of this listing was the location - a short 5-7 minute walk from the metro station and extremely centrally located for everything we wanted to do. We absolutely loved our time in Lisbon, and our stay at this apartment made our trip that much better. Thank you for everything, Pedro and friends! We hope to be back some day :)

We had a great stay in the Pedro's listing: the listing is really close to lots of bars/restaurants & to all kind of transports. Pedro & Antonio have been flexible regarding the check-in & have been responding super quickly to all of our messages.
The bathroom is fantastic & the beds are really comfy too.

The only negative aspect I would mention is the size of the listing, as the pictures made my cousin & myself believe that the living room & the cooking space would be much bigger.

I would definitely recommend this place though - thanks again Pedro & Antonio!

The apartment was very clean and a lot more spacious than seen in the photos. You can tell a lot of effort was put into the design and decor of the space. Also in the perfect location for all top sights in Lisbon. Would stay here again!

My friend and I stayed for 3 nights in this very centrally located apartment. If you want to be close to the nightlife and restaurants, you can't fault its location. As others have mentioned though, the climb to the 4th floor is steep and narrow so I would not recommend for those with difficulties using stairs.
The apartment itself was immaculate- very well kept and comfortable for our stay.
The Chiado lofts team were always quick to reply when I emailed questions, they even let us know of a fashion night that was on while we were there!
Although on a main road, I couldn't hear a thing from within the apartment. It is true that there is little wifi connection in the bedrooms but that didn't really bother me as the connection was great in the living room.
I would certainly recommend to anyone wanting an apartment close to the action. Great stay!
Mi padre se quedo en el apartamento de pedro en lisbona y me diji que todo estuvo excelente y que el era muy amable. Que definitivamente se lo recomienda a otros huespedes.

Extremamente cuidados, solícitos e educados. O apartamento é excelente. Uma questão é não ter elevador e as escadas serem íngremes   Mas essa é a beleza de fica num prédio em Lisboa, é lindo! Super equipado de tudo funciona! Amei Lisboa e amei a equipe!
The apartment was perfectly located in Bairro Alto, great location for going out at night. The apartment was beautiful and looked exactly like the photos.
The apartment was great! In particular, the location is very central to some of the best parts of Lisbon.

The apartment was exactly as pictured. Impeccably clean and nicely decorated. Only drawback are the flights of stairs up and down with luggage, but we were advised prior to arrival. Great location central to many bars, shops and restaurants. Hosts were readily available to assist with directions. Great experience overall.

This apartment is walking distance to most tourist sites. The apartment is very spacious. It is located on a tram line but you only hear the tram in the living room. I did not hear any noise in the bedroom. It is very quiet.

The apartment is modern, spacious, clean, and quiet overall.
There are only two issues that may be a concern.

1) the internet in the bedroom is non-existent.
2) it is on the 5th floor (the main floor is counted at zero) and there is no elevator. This is only a problem when moving in and out. We were helped with our baggage on the way in. We managed fine on the way out. It is always easier going downstair.

Despite these small criticisms i would highly recommend staying here. It is a great home base from where to see Lisbon. It is a pleasure to come home to this place after 12 hours of walking and sightseeing.

Muy buena experiencia en una de mis ciudades favoritas. La situación y el apartamento en general fueron perfectos, y aunque yo llegué un poco más tarde, mis acompañantes me dijeron que no tuvieron ningún problema para encontrar el piso ni para contactar. Muy recomendable.

Éramos 3 pessoas. Fomos recebidas pelo Antônio, quem nos mostrou todas as facilidades do imóvel. Ao abrir a geladeira fomos surpreendidas por um delicioso vinho branco, combinando perfeitamente com o dia de calor que fazia. O apartamento é extremamente limpo e bem localizado, perto dos principais pontos turísticos de Lisboa e do aeroporto.
Pretendo voltar logo á Lisboa e não pensarei duas vezes em ficar novamente neste apartamento.
We spent a very good time in Pedro's place. The appartment is  very clean and well located in Lisbon town. We really enjoyed our stay there and definitly recommend it!
Très bon séjour au Portugal. Quartier plein de charme. Appartement tres jolie et très pratique

The entire experience was excellent! António, Pedro, and the team truly reflect the spirit of the Air BnB community - they went above and beyond to make us feel welcomed and safe.

The apartment is well kept and well situated. I would stay there again!

Pedro and his team were wonderful, great and easy communication. The apartment looks just like shown in the pictures; maybe even better.  It felt like home and we could easily have stayed for another week. This place was the perfect welcome to Lisbon, the location was very convenient with tram 28 right on on the doorstep and plenty of options of restaurants all within 5-10 min of walking distance. Definitely recommend it!

Lovely place to stay. The narrow stairs up to the 4th apartment are challenging with luggage. But the flat is great and in a central location with all amenities. A brilliant shower and comfy beds :) we would stay again

Great communication, met by Antonio on time and showed through apartment.  Before our stay asked if there were any recommendations of things to do while we were in Lisbon and was provided with a comprehensive list of things to see while we were in Lisbon.  A great list of eating places was provided in the apartment also.  Antonio also organised a cab for us to get to airport on last day.  Apartment is in a great location, and is modern and clean, had everything we needed.  Recommended!

The apartment is like you see on the picture. Well equipped,  decorated with a very  good taste. The apartment content 2 air conditioning for the 2 rooms, that is great. When you shut the windows, you don't hear anything from outside, that is very important in this area. The apartment was clean and proper. Antonio take care to get the apartment sooner than we can get. He left for us white wine and oranges. Also in the apartment you have different spices,  oil and useful stuff for the kitchen. The information that you can find in the house is very useful. The location is great, it is very close to the most important and interesting points in Lisbon. It's situed 4 minutes from the baixa station. You can find a lot of restaurant,  bars, coffee shop around. The night life quarter Barrio alto is in a short walk distance from there. The only problem in this apartment that he is located on the 4 floor without elevator. To be honest we knew that in advance. Specially when you came with your luggage.

Muito bom anfitrião, muito boa a estadia e muita prontidão a tratar de tudo, casa muito acolhedora e prontinha para receber. Fiquei muito contente por ter passado a minha estadia em Lisboa aqui, assim como os outros hóspedes que estavam comigo! Recomendo a 100%!
Com os melhores cumprimentos*
Really comfortable and clean apartment, exactly as pictured. Good location definitely recommend

Pedro's apartment was absolutely fantastic. Exceptionally clean, beautifully designed and in a great location. Pedro was also very quick to respond to any queries and kindly allowed us to leave our bags in the apartment for a couple of hours before catching our flight. One of the best airbnbs I've stayed in.

Wow what an apartment! Everything the previous reviews have said have hit the nail on the head. Yes there are 4 flights of stairs but the privacy, location and the actual apartment itself are worth it. Nice finishes and touches (absolutely loved the BOSE bluetooth speaker and the couch is comfy as!) and everything is thought of. So many good places to eat and drink all in the same street. Value for money and wouldn't stay anywhere else.

Antonio of the managing team allowed us to move in earlier since we arrived early. He came to the steep stairs to help take the luggage to the apartment. He showed us how to use the equipment and passed us the keys. Antonio even left us a bottle of wine, coffee, fruit jam, orange and chocolate. When we found the dish-washing detergent is gone, he quickly went outside to buy a new bottle for us.
The neighborhood is fine and has many stores within walking distance.

Le logement était parfait, exactement comme sur les photos dans un quartier animé, mais très calme la nuit. Antonío qui travaille avec Pedro a été très gentil et amicale avec nous, nous avons adoré!!!!

Nous avons reçu un très bon accueil de Luis qui nous a attendu.
l 'appartement est très agréable et très bien situé dans Lisbonne.
c 'est un appartement très bien équipé qui offre un confort certain pour 3 personnes.
Nous recommandons vivement.
merci encore à Pedro et Luis;
maryse et alain (lyon)

My stay at this apartment was great.  The check in process was easy and Antonio was kind enough to wait for me since I was running behind.  The apartment is exactly as shown in the pictures and it was well equipped and very clean. I would say the noise and lack of soundproofing from the upstairs apartment was only a slight issue.  Everything else was perfect including the location.  Don't think twice and book asap.

We had a very good experience - the apartment was very nice and Pedro & his team communicated promptly from the first contact to the end.
First about the flat: the location is perfect, it is well equipped and everything worked. It is perfect for a couple, with an extra bedroom with single bed for a kid or a guest.
The only negative side of the flat is the rather narrow and steep stairs to the fourth floor, but one gets used to them quickly. There was a nice welcome pack waiting for us in flat when we arrived, including a bottle of wine. However, you need to bring your own shampoo and other toiletries or buy them from a store next door.
Pedro and his team were very accommodating with our arrival & departure and everything worked smoothly. We liked the apartment a lot and won't hesitate to recommend it to our friends & other Airbnb users.

This was the perfect stay! The host welcomed us on time and was very easy to communicate with him via text message. The flat is in a perfect location, very central and close to the best bars, clubs, restaurants, and main attractions of the city.

The apartment is decorated and furnished to the detail, with beautiful furniture and tasteful design. Everything in the apartment is of very high quality, there's a dishwasher, washing machine, and even a BOSE speaker to connect your phone. Will definitely go back there when in Lisbon again.

I spent 4 days at Pedro's place and I was very happy to have picked this appartement! It was very clean and nicely furnished (pictures perfectly correspond to the reality). Sheets and towels are also clean and fresh. It is perfectly located, we walked everywhere and didn't need to use public transport. We were able to checked in a little earlier than allowed so it was also a positive aspect. Overall I highly recommend this place!

Me and my mother stayed at the apartment for 4 nights And it was totally amazing. The apartment is great: Perfect location, in the middle of the centre of bairro alto at a busy street, but at the moment you close your Doors, all the noise is going And you are complete relaxt at this apartment. It has everything you need for a great stay: good beds, great shower, perfect WiFi, a dishwasher And a good couch: a great place to relax after a long day out.
The team has information available about good food And drinks in the Area. Also a bottle of wine And chocolates to welcome you.
I higly recommend Loft 6 as the place to stay, to make a visit to Lissabon a journey like you could only wish for!

The apartment is in a fun, energetic neighborhood, conveniently located to shopping and restaurants. The entire apartment was very clean and the beds were comfortable. The apartment is on a busy street however the bedrooms were quiet. We found the laminated restaurant recommendation list useful. There is a beautiful overlook of Lisbon a few blocks from the apartment, don't miss it for sunset. Hospitality touches include free coffee and expresso maker,  small bottle of wine and chocolates. The Chiado team let us check in a  little earlier which was much appreciated and their email communications were great.

We had a great time at this flat - perfect size for the three of us. The location is great, excellent neighborhood with tons of restaurants, bars, nightlife, but very quiet in the flat itself. Easy walk to most of the other big sights in Lisbon.

The host was very accommodating and responsive, helpful with recommendations and even let us leave our bags after checkout before our flight. There were several nice touches like wine and bluetooth speakers! Absolutely recommend and would definitely stay again!

Great little loft in an excellent location. Pedro and his team were super helpful, and allowed us to check in as early as possible, as our flight arrived very early in the morning.

I would definitely stay here again if I came back to Lisbon.

Excellent séjour à Lisbonne et dans ce magnifique appartement tout confort et idéalement situé au cœur d'un quartier agréable, très bien desservi (métro à 5min, sur la ligne du typique Electrico n°28, à proximité immédiate du funiculaire de Bica...). En conclusion un appartement parfait pour un séjour réussi !! De plus nous avons été très bien reçus, petits présents et hôte très gentil. Je recommande sans modération!!!!

Erg prettig en mooi appartement in een goeie buurt in Lisbon. Gezellig binnenkomen met een heerlijk chocolaatje. Nespresso aanwezig en zelfs een wasmachine. Ligging is top, alles op loopafstand, om de hoek loopt het oude beroemde trammetje.
De moeite waard en erg prettige ontvangst.
The apartment is great! Clean, comfortable and the location is perfect.

Lovely experience! We were three people in the apartment and the place is even more than it is described. Luis welcomed us and guided everything in the apartment. For me and my friends, we are truly amazed by the home feeling staying in Lisbon!!!
In spite of the narrow stair way which may bother a little bit if you have big luggages, everything that you could ever imagine can all be found here! 110% recommend!

El apartamento está bien ubicado, muy cerca del centro de la ciudad (10 minutos andando), perfectamente comunicado (Estación de Cais de Sodré, Estación de Rossio, Estación de Metro Baixa-Chiado, todos ellos a 10 minutos andando) y con todo tipo de servicios a su alrededor (Supermercado a 50 metros, etc.).
Cuenta con todo lo necesario para una estancia de varios días y su distribución es perfecta para 3 ó 4 personas. La zona es céntrica y tiene mucha vida durante el día, aunque por la noche es muy tranquila y los ruidos de la calle no llegan al apartamento gracias a su altura (4º piso) y aislamiento.
La recepción por parte de Antonio fue perfecta, facilitando todo tipo de información relativa al apartamento y su entorno. Y los presentes de acogida son todo un detalle por parte del anfitrión. A tener en cuenta que el edificio no tiene ascensor y las escaleras son estrechas, por lo que personas con movilidad reducida tendrán dificultades para acceder al apartamento.
En definitiva, una muy buena opción de alojamiento en Lisboa que recomiendo a todas aquellas personas que estén pensando en visitar esta maravillosa ciudad.

I will comment first about the location. The location could not get any better. It is in a perfect location. Around the area, in fact just downstairs are bakeries, supermarkets, restaurants, cafes, patios, plazas and churches. It is literally in a place any tourist would want to be. The metro Baixa/Chiado is just 3 minutes walk. The street Calcada de Combro has electric trams and taxis running both ways. You would not have any problems about going around places.
Now, the flat. It is exactly as described in the ad. You have everything you need. Kitchen and dining with lots of pans, wares, cutleries, chinas. A nice sized bathroom and 2 bedrooms. The flat is super clean.
Now the team, they are the best of the best hosts. We arrived at the place and Luis is on time. He was super nice and helped carried our luggages upstairs to the flat. He explained things inside the flat, how the stove works, the washer, the dishwasher and everything. Antonio answers questions quickly when posed through AIRBNB messaging. He booked as a taxi going to the airport. And Pedro, he came to the flat with goodies as their traditional treats for Easter, that was so awesome and that was a pleasant surprise because I never expected. It cannot get any better gesture than that how they care so much about their guests. And one more thing, when we arrived, there were a bottle of wine, oranges on the dining table and chocolates for 2 in the master bedroom waiting for us. This was so sweet of them. Love all these personal touches which you cannot get in a hotel.
Thank you team for making our stay in Lisbon easy and the best. Hope to have you as hosts again someday.

We had such an amazing time at Pedro's place. The location couldn't be any more perfect. Very easy to find from the Baixa - Chiado station, and everything is in walking distance. There's nice bars, restaurants and supermarket just around the corner.

The apartment is nicely decorated and has all the bits and bobs to make breakfast and relax after long day of walking. Antonio welcomed us and gave us all the information needed. Would definitely book this apartment again!

We were met by a smiling, and friendly person.
He told us about the appartment, and helped with our questions.
All was good and friendly.

We had a great time at Pedro's place. The apartment is really comfortable and   well decorated. The neighborhood is convenient with supermarket, bakery and restaurants nearby. Antônio welcomed us and was always available for special needs and doubts. He even kindly booked a cab to the airport. The only isssue has to do with the stairs. If you have mobility problems, I would not reccomend the place. But if it's not the case, I'd reccomend Pedro's apartament.

Nous avons séjourné une semaine dans cet appartement de la Chiado Team et nous en sommes revenus enchantés. Idéalement situé et décoré avec goût, il s'est avéré parfait pour recharger les batteries après de longues heures à sillonner la ville. En cette fin février le quartier était somme toute tranquille et nous y avons passé de très bonnes nuits de sommeil. Tout le nécessaire était présent (machine à laver, lave vaisselle, toaster, ustensiles de cuisine, sèche cheveux, serviettes, TV, wifi, livres, micro-ondes, réfrigérateur) et en parfait état de fonctionnement. Nous avons pu à plusieurs reprises y préparer quelques repas simples... Une pastelaria cafetaria est à l'angle de la rue ce qui permet de déjeûner tous les matins avec de délicieuses viennoiseries. A peine plus loin se trouve une supérette que nous avons trouvé très utile pour compléter nos quelques courses. Le métro, quant à lui, est à 3 ou 4 minutes à pieds.
Notre hôte, Antonio, a toujours été disponible et serviable pour nous renseigner ou nous glisser quelques bonnes adresses...

Pour le retour, alors que nous partions de bon matin (avion à 6h) nous avons eu la chance de tomber nez à nez avec un taxi qui passait dans la rue et qui nous a donc conduit illico presto à l'aéroport en un temps record. La course nous a coûté 11,60€, encore moins cher qu'à notre arrivée en pleine journée...

Le seul bémol que je mettrai concerne les escaliers qui mènent à l'appartement (au dernier étage) : ils sont étroits et d'une raideur qui pourrait les rendre inappropriés à certaines catégories de voyageurs. Pour tout le reste rien à redire.

Un grand et chaleureux merci pour ce séjour que nous avons beaucoup apprécié, à commencer par toutes vos petites attentions ;-)
Muito obrigado !

Lovely loft apartment in the lively location of Chiado, just a stroll away from the busy central district and near Bairro Alto where the nightlife is great. The accommodation was clean, comfortable and perfect for our trip. We were greeted promptly and given recommendations for our stay. Overall, I would highly recommend this accommodation.

A nossa estadia em Lisboa foi maravilhosa. Para começar fomos recepcionados pelo Luís que nos esperava ao apartamento. Luís e Antônio desde o começo foram sempre muito disponiveis e atenciosos!
O apartamento é um amor, limpo, bem organizado e iluminado, em uma posição central e comoda. Tem todos os confortos que uma casa pode oferecer!

Luis welcomed us on time and eager to help.  The apartment was being cleaned but we were early and were more than happy to wait.  Moreover Luis allowed us to leave the luggage in the apartment while we went to get something to eat.  The apartment is on the 4th floor, which we expected, but as I had a fairly heavy bag, Luis decided to take it up himself.  I can't thank him enough for that!  The apartment is exactly as pictured.  It's lovely.  It's in the heart of Chiado--a lively and historic district of Lisbon.  It's a comfortable apartment with all amenities although I would suggest not cooking anything as the kitchenette is rather limited despite the fact that it does have a couple of burners.  The host left us a lovely bottle of wine, which we enjoyed and appreciated on the last night we were there.  I can't say enough about the central location of this apartment.  We were within walking distance to most places, excellent restaurants and coffee shops.  Both the bed and the sofa were extremely comfortable.  We would definitely choose this lovely apartment again on a return visit to Lisbon.
Me encanto el piso. Todo muy correcto, de acuerdo con el anuncio. Optima ubicación, piso muy limpio y soleado. Vale la pena! Gracias Pedro y Antonio.
Great location, incredible apartment with a beautiful design. Very comfortable space. Would unquestionably stay here again.

The apartment was very comfortable clean and well equipment. Situated in Chiado it is right in the centre of Lisbon and close to some great restaurants and attractions. We would certainly stay here again and would recommend to our friends. The only thing to bear in mind are the four flights of stairs which would make it unsuitable for anyone with mobility problems.
房东人很好房子有问题还给我们安排了宾馆！

Had a lovely stay in this clean, comfortable, modern, and very well located flat. Antonio, and colleagues are nice, and accommodating. We were four people and we all fit just fine but the place would be perfect for three. Would love to stay again if I have the pleasure of visiting lisbon a second time.

Incredible place. Just in the heart of the town, nearby Bairro Alto which is one of the places where nightlife happens.
We still had a plus with a bottle of champagne and a cake for New Year's Eve from the hosts.
Awesome stay. Defo would recommend it.

We had a very pleasant stay in Lisbon and specifically Pedro's apartment in Chiado was super nice. Located in a nice neighborhood close to everything, the apartment is super clean, beautifully decorated, with everything you might need. Pedro and other guys managing the flat are really friendly and professional. Everything went as expected, warm welcome on arrival with nice welcome  drinks waiting for us, short briefing about how things work and a list of good places to eat. We could leave our luggages for a while in the flat as our flight was in the evening. The also book Ed us a taxi to the airport who picked us up on time and costed less than what we paid when arrived. In two  words: totally recommend

Pedro's friend welcomed us very warmly and nicely at midnight!!! The apartement was exactly like described on the pictures. Very comfortable and super location. It was very quiet at night. We appreciated the gift upon arrival and on the 24th of December. We will recomended to our friends in Belgium and France.
the apartment is as described, clean and tidy . Contacting the host was very simple as soon as we arrived . Perfect position , very central . We really recommend it .

Perfecto apartamento en el centro de Lisboa. Es exactamente como se ve en las fotos. Limpio, agradable y muy cómodo, tenía todo lo que necesitábamos para nuestra estancia.
Aunque esté situado en una calle céntrica, el apartamento es súper silencioso, y la cama muy cómoda así como el sofá del salón.
Si alguna vez vuelvo a Lisboa, cosa que espero hacer, volvería a elegir sin duda el apartamento de Pedro! :)
------
Perfect apartment in the center of Lisbon. It is exactly as you can see in the pictures. Clean, cozy, comfy, with all that we needed for our stay.
Despite being located in a center street, the apartment is really quiet and the bed is very confortable as well as the sofa in the living room.
If I ever go back to Lisbon (thing that I really hope to do!) I definitely would choose Pedro's apartment again!

We loved our experience at Chiado Loft 6. It is a beautiful apartment and is very centrally located. The living area is very comfortable and the kitchen is small, but well equipped with pots, pans, an espresso machine, toaster, etc.
If we are in Lisbon again, we will definitely return.
Thank you!!!

The apartment is exactly as described. Nicely furnished, clean and tidy.
The heating system works perfectly, I recommend it also for winter vacation.
We really had a pleasant stay, the surrounds are lovely and lively.
The apartment is very quiet despite its position over a busy street.
Only one negative point about the apartment: you must climb not less than 50 steps of a very narrow stair with your luggage before reach it.

Cosa dire...appartamento molto bello,posizione fantastica!mezzi di trasporto sotto casa.
Tutto molto pulito e confortevole,appena arrivate siamo state accolte è ci è stato mostrato l'appartamento:due stanze da letto,bagno e salotto cucina,arredamento impeccabile pulizia altrettanto.molto curato nei dettagli(macchina del caffè con cialde,bollitore elettrico,lavatrice,cassa per amplificare la musica...).
La location ideale a lisbona!❤
Super schönes Appartment, super Lage (Restaurants, Linie 28 Minimarkt, shopping center) perfekter Urlaub!
Amazing find! Loved staying here. Clean, spacious, just like the pictures. Would stay here again in a heart beat! Fantastic weekend.

Fiquei hospedado com mais 2 amigos por 4 dias. Encontramos o apartamento em perfeito estado, limpo e com tudo que precisávamos para a nossa breve estadia. A localização é privilegiada, bem no centro do bairro alto lisboeta.
Os hosts foram aprazíveis e prestativos na resolução de eventuais problemas ou dúvidas.
O único porém, já especificado no anúncio, é a falta de elevador. Mas, depois de subir e descer tantas charmosas ladeiras, os 4 andares são vencidos rapidamente.
Não deixem de provar os pastéis de nata da Manteigaria, bem em frente ao Largo de Camões. Em minha opinião, os melhores da cidade.
Recomendo fortemente a estadia e, sem dúvida alguma, voltaria a me hospedar aqui.

After the reservation Pedro provided us very detailed information about the way to reach the appartment. We had a flight delay and arrived around 23:00, Antonio waited for us patiently and explained all the necessary. A welcome wine as well as pralines and fruits were ready for us.
The appartment is spotlessly clean and it's location can hardly be topped. You will find practically everything you need in the near neighbourhood. Most of the tourist attractions can be reached on foot ( but be aware of the hilly and sometimes steep surroundings ).
We had a great time in Lisbon, thanks again to the Chiado team.

Pedro's team member, Antonio, greeted us at the apartment and made us feel right at home! There were fresh oranges and a bottle of wine waiting for us upon arrival, as well as a comprehensive list of restaurant recommendations which was quite helpful. The apartment was nicely decorated and very clean. The main bedroom was quiet at night and we used the second bedroom for our luggage. It was a bonus to have a lounge area to relax in after coming home from a day of sight-seeing. The apartment is located in a very central neighbourhood within walking distance of shops, cafes and restaurants. This was a perfect spot for two and we will definitely return next time we are in Lisbon!
The apartment was nice and clean. It was very close to public transit and close to the waterfront. We really enjoyed our stay!

Very nice and comfortable apartment, just like the pictures. Luis was there to hand us the keys and make us feel at home with fresh oranges and a bottle of wine. Everything was very comfortable and clean. The location is superb: close to Cais do Sodré and within walking distance you'll find many nice places to have lunch or dinner, or just drinks. We think the best pasteis de nata are to be found just a few steps away from the apartment at Manteigaria de Camões.

Malgré notre retard, Louis, membre de l'équipe de Pedro, était là pour nous accueillir d'une manière efficace.
Les attentions tel que petit mot d'accueil écrit à la main, les chocolats, la bouteille de vin et les oranges pour se faire du jus d'orange frais le matin sont là pour nous mettre à l'aise.
L'appartement est tout à fait ressemblant aux images présentées sur le site. L'équipement est complet (lave-vaisselle, lave-linge, dock pour la musique via notre smartphone). La vaisselle est propre, le wifi fonctionne sans difficulté, les matelas sont épais et la décoration est une vraie et chaleureuse décoration. La propreté des lieux ainsi que le linge de maison sont appréciables. Impeccable ! Ce séjour chez Pedro nous donne vraiment envie de revenir visiter Lisbonne, d'autant plus que la localisation est idéale (proche des transports, des restaurants...). Un grand merci à l'équipe.

We loved staying in Pedro's loft! The location couldn't be more perfect; it was right in the Chiado district. The apartment was a little smaller in person than in the pictures, but still a good size for two people. Pedro had a bottle of vinho verde and some coffee and oranges for us when we arrived, which was so nice! Also, the air conditioners in the bedrooms work super well. All in all a great place to stay in Lisbon!
Just perfect.

Bel appartement très bien décoré, très fonctionnel et calme!Tout est bien pensé et surtout très bien placé près de l'arrêt Tram 28, proche des commerces et desrestos. Attention escalier raide comme les rues de Lisbonne...
The flat was beautiful and the neighborhood was excellent. Luis met us early and was very accommodating. I highly recommend this airbnb listing - you will love it!

The apt. was located in a dynamic, hip section of Lisbon. It was artistically decorated, spacious, and well equipped for all of our needs. We felt very welcomed by additional gifts of oranges, wine, and chocolates! Pedro and his team were helpful, informative, and provided excellent directions to the apt. Our family wished we could have stayed longer. Everything was great!

The Loft is in a fantastic location with many great bakeries and restaurants close by and you can walk to the main shopping street or down to the waterfront in just a couple of minutes. The apartment itself is awesome. Very new, modern and well maintained. The host were great providing us with a welcome drink and with plenty of information and recommendations for Lisbon. Would definitely stay here again.

This was the best Lisbon apartment we could ask for - super friendly host, very nice and clean and the perfect location!
One of the best areas in the city, just one block away from loads of great restaurants and bars, tram 28 outside the door and a supermarket nearby.
A big extra plus for the host. Our first flight got cancelled due to strike, no problem re-booking the apartment for 6 months later.
I recommend everyone to come and stay here during their visit in Lisbon!

Pedro was extremely helpful and the apartment was clean, well furnished with modern facilities. The position is very good with excellent places to eat and drink. I would book again if I return to Lisbon.

Beautiful cozy apartment in the middle of bairro alto.
The apartment is well furnished, with all you need to stay a few days to visit Lisbon.
Very good position, close to a parking.
The guest was very helpful with us and he gives us many suggestion where to eat in Lisbon
Kindly recommended

Luis, membre dynamique de la "Chiado Team", nous attendait à notre arrivée. Heureusement qu'il était là pour porter la valise, alors que je m'étais démonté un genou dans la montée d'escaliers en pente raide ! Fais pas bon vieillir...
Une bouteille de vin au frais, des fruits dans la corbeille, des chocolats et un petit mot sympa sur la table de nuit. Autant de délicates attentions dignes de gentlemen.
L'appartement est encore mieux que sur les photos. Idéalement situé entre Chiado et Barro Alto, là où pulse le coeur de Lisbonne. Le mythique Tram 28 passe à la porte. Le funiculaire de Bica est au coin de la rue pour relier Cais Do Sodré et le métro se trouve 700 mètres plus bas ! Côté restos, plein de bonne adresses dans un rayon de 100 mètres. Et une foule de magasins pour ravitailler.
Vu l'intense activité du quartier et comme on est à Lisbonne, on pourrait s'attendre à subir le brouhaha. Il n'en est rien. L'appartement est un havre de paix, une bulle de silence. Idéal pour se ressourcer après une journée de visite. D'autant qu'il est cosy, confortable, parfaitement équipé et très élégamment agencé. Nos compliments pour la déco originale et raffinée.
Si bémol il y a, il concernerait ce damné escalier. Finalement, l'appartement de Pedro est à l'image de Lisbonne. Il ne se livre qu'au bout d'une rude ascension. Mais en haut, on découvre un petit coin de paradis.

My first experience of airbnb was amazing! I really love the apartment in the center of Lisbon ! It is 5 min far away from the metro station! The apartment is completely furnished by sweetly style ！If I have a apartment, I would like to furnish it like this style.the bath room is a little bit small but has the quality of the 4 stars hotel! And the bed is comfort for resting when u finish a tired visit in the city! I really love the apartment! Really want to back again!

Nous avons pu apprécier le sérieux voire le professionnalisme du loueur.
L appartement était en tout point conforme à la description.
Nous recommandons les services de Pedro à qui veut passer un joli séjour lisboète

Super, douillet, très bien situé pour ce logement accueil convivial et transfert au second appartement organisé comme convenu ! hé oui j'en ai testé deux.
On se sens aussitôt chez nous . Comme mentionné les marches sont raides mais reflet de Lisbonne ou ça grimpe toujours
Merci à bientôt
Ci siamo trovati bene, alloggio pulito e arredato bene.

It was nice travel in lisbon.
lodging have a good location.
Because many tourist attraction is close. So we were going to sight by walking or take the tram. Stop is very nearly.
And all room is clean and aircondition in the all room.
We enjoyed in lisbon.
After maybe i will come lisbon. I will book pedro's house. Thank U. :)

Nous avons passé un super séjour à Lisbonne et l'appartement y est pour beaucoup. Propre et bien aménagé, il correspond parfaitement aux photos. A proximité du métro et tramway 28, il est bien placé pour visiter cette ville. Nous avons été bien accueilli par Antonio, qui nous a donné de bons conseils. Nous avons apprécié la climatisation ! Nous ne regrettons pas notre choix. Encore merci.

This is the PERFECT apartment in the best neighbourhood in Lisbon. The apartment is spotlessly clean and super comfortable. Loved our stay! Will definitely be staying here again on our next trip to Lisbon.

This apartment was incredible! We thoroughly enjoyed staying in Pedro's place. It was spacious and well decorated. Just a quick walk to the Metro stop. We walked almost everywhere and ended up only taking the metro from the airport. There are several bakeries down the street that were nice for coffee and pastries in the morning. The only thing to be aware of if you are staying here is the stairs. A bit of hike up the stairs with a suitcase in tow, but thus is life in Europe! Please please stay here!! You won't regret it!!

Pedro was there to welcome us himself. The apartment is wonderful, just like the pictures are describing. It was a nice, clean , typical central apartment. When we arrived we received wonderful famous Pasteis de Belem, coffee, chocolate and oranges! So wonderful! We appreciated this a lot! f we needed something we could always reach Pedro. Thanks you so much for the wonderful stay and being such a wonderful host.

We had a great stay at Pedro's apartment. The apartment was clean, comfortable and tastefully furnished - it's even nicer in real life than the photos! Pedro was easy to communicate with and kindly let us check in early. He even left us chocolates which was very sweet. The location was fantastic - very central, close to heaps of bars, restaurants and shopping. There are also many bakeries right along the street which was nice for breakfast and sampling portuguese tarts. The apartment was also close to trams lines, train stations and the metro, so it was easy to get anywhere in the city or do day trips. Would definitely recommend this apartment to family and friends, and would stay here again next time we're in Lisbon!

Hallo --- soeben heimgekehrt aus Lissabon und wir sind noch voller Eindrücke! Wir waren zu Dritt dort (3 Frauen) und wurden von Antonio zu angegebenen Zeit erwartet. Er hat bei dem Gepäck geholfen. Die Treppe zum 4. Stock ist ein wenig steil. Dann hat er uns alles gezeit in der wirklich super eingerichteten Wohnung, incl. WLan, Geschirrspüler etc... Ein Korb mit Orangen stand liebevoll auf dem Tisch und eine süße Kleinigkeit zur Begrüßung auf dem Nachttisch. Wir haben uns dort super wohl gefühlt....  Mitten im Geschehen und doch recht ruhig, da die Schlafzimmer nach hinten gehen. Wir können die Wohnung auf ALLE FÄLLE weiterempfehlen. Danke und Obrigada von Sandra, Connie und Margitta

Pedro and Antonio were the most helpful hosts! The first indication of this was when we inquired about a late (around midnight) check-in time. Pedro assured us that someone would be there to get us acclimated. Then, when our flight arrived late, I jumped on the airport WIFI to email him and Pedro said that it was okay and that one of them would be at the flat waiting for us. GREAT CUSTOMER SERVICE!! The flat was exactly as it's described on the posting, if not, BETTER. It was the perfect size for the two of us (there is a single bed for a third guest, but we kept all of our luggage in that room) and was cozy and comfortable. We started our honeymoon with 6 days here. The flat is located in one of the most lively areas of town. The first few days were wonderful: we grocery shopped about a block from the flat at Mini Preco. We never took a cab because we could walk everywhere in Lisbon that we wanted to and could walk to the trains to explore the surrounding areas. Then, in the middle of our stay was Portugal Day and it was a BLAST. We were in the heart of the party in Barrio Alto! Wonderful.

The flat included everything we could have needed: refrigerator, microwave, stove top, sink, dish washer, a few dishes, coffee maker, espresso machine, hair dryer, AC, cable, WIFI, comfortable bed and couch, and a modern bathroom!

Perfect location, fabulous flat, we loved every minute of it.

The apartment was really lovely and exactly as shown in the photos, and in a great location for Bairro Alto nightlife and exploring the city.  We had a great stay and António was very friendly and helpful when we arrived.  We'd definitely look to stay here again on another visit to Lisbon, and thank you for the chocolates!

Pedro was great at communicating and always quickly replied to any messages. It was great that Pedro told us different options from the airport. Antonio came to meet us and showed us where everything is in the apartment. Its a lovely apartment with everything you need and a great location.  I always need a coffee in the morning so having the Nespresso machine was perfect and there is a speaker you can link to Bluetooth to play your music. I would recommend this wonderful place to stay.

We did not have a chance to meet Pedro but Antonio. Antonio is a great host in describing everything very clear to us including which is the best part of area to visit even recommending the best phymacy for us to get prescription for the back pain of my daughter.

The apartment was very equipped, clean and stylist. We enjoyed the apartment very much.


Thanks for Pedro and Antonio

We met Antonio in the flat - he was very kind and showed us everything in the apartment, which was even more beautiful than on the photos... ;-) It has a lot of nice extra-features such as magazines, books, fresh oranges, a very well equipped kitchen & lovely decoration everywhere... The flat was perfectly located for us in the centre, next to Barrio Alto. We definitely would come back! Thanks for everything guys!

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour à Lisbonne. L'appartement de Pedro était tout à fait conforme à l'annonce, il est très bien situé avec le tram n°28 juste en bas. Nous avons pu tout faire en tram et à pied.
L'appartement se situe dans un quartier animé de Lisbonne mais les chambres ne donnant pas sur la rue sont très calmes.
La seule chose qui pourrait poser problème à certaines personnes c'est que l'appartement se trouve au 4ème étage sans ascenseur avec un escalier plutôt raide.

Pedro and António have been super hosts. The location of the apartment is just fantastic - next to Bairro Alto with plenty of excellent restaurants and bars. The apartment itself is spacious, very stylish - just super good. We felt absolutely comfortable and would definitiely come back and recommend it to everyone!
We were welcomed really warmthly, they explained the way to the center and were really friendly. A really great place!

Flat muito agradável, tal como nas fotos, equipado com tudo o que se precisa. A localização é ótima, no Chiado próximo ao Bairro Alto, com acesso fácil ao metro, trem, ônibus e bonde, sendo que muito do que se tem pra ver na parte central de Lisboa é possível fazer a pé a partir do flat. Recomendo muito.

We were greeted and welcomed with a friendly attitude and they showed us around the apartment. The location could not have been more perfect! Near great restaurants, cafes, and located near all the night life. The apartment was decorated perfectly and with great taste, and it was extremely clean. Couldn't imagined a better place to stay in Lisboa!

Appartamento molto curato, piacevole, nuovo, dotato di ogni confort.
Anche il letto ricavato sul divano è molto comodo.
Benvenuto con cesta di frutta e caffè a disposizione.
Posizione ottima in pieno centro.
Se proprio devo trovare una nota dolente posso solo segnalare le scale un pochino ripide 4 piani che potrebbero essere difficoltose ma giusto per le persone anziane.
Consigliato assolutamente.

the apartment was great and as the pictures showed. it is stylish and super clean!
the neighborhood has many lively restaurants.
Perfeita localização, apartamento muito bonito e limpo. Recomendo a todos.

Nous avons vraiment apprécié notre séjour a Lisbonne et en grande partie Grace a l'appartement de Pedro : très bien situé dans une rue animée avec des commerces et des restaurants sympathiques mais sans nuisances sonores, proches des quartiers plus animés la nuit (bars, clubs...) et des quartiers du Bairro Alto et Chiado. Tout est faisable a pieds. Le célèbre tramway 28 passe devant l'appartement. Très bien équipé et vraiment propre. Nous avons été accueilli par un gentil message, des chocolats et une corbeille d'oranges. Une délicieuse pâtisserie au rez de chaussée pour des petits déjeuners gourmands. Je recommande cette adresse sans hésiter !

Appartement bien situé, bien équipé; Pedro et Antonio ont le sens du service et ont été présents en cas de besoin pendant notre séjour, ce qui est vraiment appréciable.
A recommander sans hésitations.

Just returned from staying 5 nights in Loft 6. Feels slightly smaller than pictures make it look but it's smart, very clean and stylish! It's on the fourth floor, narrow steep stairs to climb but worth it when you're in the apartment. Bedrooms are in the back of the apartment so quiet at night.Chocolates were left by the bedside and Easter bread left on the table too, lovely touches. We didn't really get on well with the Nespresso machine, but we don't drink coffee. Antonio supplied us with a kettle which was MUCH appreciated. Leaving for the airport early on Easter Sunday morning I enquired about a taxi to the airport, Pedro booked one for us which turned up on time. All in all, these guys have fantastic properties which I would highly recommend. Thank you both for your efforts to make our stay in Lisbon a great one!

This was a really really nice AirBnB accommodation. Honestly it felt more like a resort, it was so nice. We even had a nice note and chocolates when we checked in! Pretty awesome. The apartment was in a PERFECT location (arguably the best "pastel de nata" were a 5 minute walk down the street, and a cheap grocery store was near as well, not to mention being in a great part of town). The apartment was SUPER clear, the beds were super comfortable, and overall I'd absolutely stay here again and recommend friends do the same!

Un accueil efficace et attentionné pour découvrir un superbe appartement au 4ème étage d'un petit immeuble au centre de la capitale. Propre et parfaitement équipé avec en + la corbeille de fruit frais.
Les chambres à l'arrière sont d'un calme parfait pour se reposer après une longue journée. Devant la porte passe le tram 28 qui permet d'accéder à tous les lieux touristiques de la capitale et non loin de cais de Sodré point de départ vers Belem, Cascais, etc...
A recommander sans hésiter sauf si vous n'aimer vraiment pas les escaliers.

We had the best time in Lisbon, and after treating ourselves to this beautiful apartment, we did not want to leave! It's looks just as beautiful as it seemed in the pictures. The waterfall shower was so relaxing, especially after a long day of surfing and both the beds were very cozy. The living room was not only adorable but a great place to hang out after a long day or before going out at night to explore.  The location was perfect and I couldn't have been happier with my first AirBnB experience. If I make it back to Lisbon, I will definitely stay here again!

The apartment was great! Everything in excellent condition, very clean, comfy bed & sofas etc. couldn't fault anything. Location was perfect - close enough to the nightlife & great restaurants but not so close to be too noisy. Loved everything about it!! Also little welcoming note & chocolates which was nice. Would definitely recommend!
La casa es tal como se ve en las fotos, más acogedora imposible. Estuvimos como en nuestra casa y la situación es inmejorable.

L'appartement est super ! très propre, très beau. Situation idéale dans la ville, il est tout près de Bairro Alto à pied (sortir le soir, aller manger, ...) sans en avoir les inconvénients pour dormir (pas de bruit des noctambules). Le tram 28 passe dans la rue, les chambres sont à l'arrière. Nous avons été bien accueilli par Antonio...
Bref appartement à conseiller !

Pedro and his friend António were the utmost professionals. António was able to meet us at the apartment almost 1.5 hours before the normal check-in, as that was when our train got in. And the apartment itself was incredible - luxury style for such a great price. The four flights of stairs up to the loft were a little difficult with luggage, but the trek was well worth it.

This flat was really perfect!  The location is excellent, the flat itself is clean, orderly, and very comfortable.  Although we didn't meet Pedro himself, his friends who let us in were very friendly, spoke perfect English and even gave us an often used tip about where to get the best custard cake things that Lisbon has to offer.  Thank you again for the great accommodation and for helping make a surprise birthday weekend a really wonderful time!

The whole experience from booking to our arrival and stay was fantastic,the apartment is absolutely fabulous and in a fantastic location,everything is within walking distance yet the apartment is really quiet.The decor was outstanding, bedrooms really bright and comfortable.It really felt like staying in a very expensive suite in a very trendy boutique. We loved it and would highly recommend it and Lisbon.

Jimmy

Nos hospedamos no Chiado Loft 6 no início de 2015 e tivemos uma experiência maravilhosa. O apartamente era limpo, bem decorado, arrumado e muito agradável. Não é muito grande, mas era exatamente isso que eu e minha família estávamos buscando, então posso dizer que superou todas as nossas expectativas. Também fomos muito bem recebidos.

The apartment was amazing! Definitely what it looks like in the photos is what it looks like in person. Sadly, we did not meet Pedro, but got to meet with Antonio. They are both very helpful and communication was great! The apartment is located in Bairro Alto where you'll find a ton of good places to eat, drink, and have a wonderful time. We would definitely recommend this apartment.

O apartamento é tal qual se vê nas fotos. A sala é bem ampla e confortável. É muito bem equipado com recursos e utensílios de excelente qualidade. Cama e travesseiros confortáveis. Não tem telefone , mas a internet funcionou muito bem.Tudo de muito bom gosto. Mimos como geleias, chocolates, cartão de boas vindas, capsulas de café nespresso e sachets de açúcar. A localização é perfeita. Tem mercado, açougue, peixaria e padaria muito próximos. Fica bem perto do Ascensor da Bica. Excelentes restaurantes, muito perto da praça de Camões e estação de metro Baixa Chiado. O Electrico 28 passa em frente e o electrico de uma das empresas de City Tour tb. Muitas lojas e o shopping Armazens do Chiado. Com uma breve caminhada chega-se ao Largo do Carmo, Rua Augusta, Praça do Comércio, Cais do Sodre e Rossio. O único senão, mas que já era de nosso conhecimento, são as escadas que atrapalham apenas na hora da chegada e partida com as malas (Se isso for um impedimento, Pedro possui os studios em um predio com elevador com localização ainda mais próxima do shopping). Fomos recebidos de forma breve por Antonio que nos apresentou o loft e respondeu todas as nossas dúvidas. Durante a estadia fizemos alguns contatos por email para tirar dúvidas com Pedro que nos respondeu muito rápido. Super recomendamos !!! Esse loft tornou Lisboa ainda mais especial. Outros: Na chegada pegamos um taxista no aeroporto que pre fixou a corrida em 25 euros e depois baixou para 20. No check out pegamos um táxi na rua , em frente a porta e pelo taximetro custou 11 euros. De uma próxima vez, com certeza, escolheríamos um loft ou studio de Pedro na mesma localização ou repetiríamos o mesmo. Muito, muito bom !!!

L'appartement était magnifique et l'accueil très attentionné.
En outre, l'appartement est idéalement placé, dans un des quartiers les plus vivants de Lisbonne.
Que demander de plus!
Un grand merci
Olivier

Tout était parfait !! super appartement très bien situé avec tout le confort, une décoration soignée et des matériaux de qualité au rendez-vous. Rapport qualité-prix imbattable ! Hôtes très accueillants et facile à joindre en cas de besoin. Si un jour je retourne sur Lisbonne je réserverais sans hésiter un de leurs logements.

Beautiful flat, clean and warm. It really looks like the pictures, even better! Well located, closed to the famous "electrico" 28 and the metro station. Great place to stay. We ve really enjoyed the trip.

The flat was beautiful and in great part of the city. The hosts were really friendly and completely accommodating. I would highly recommend staying here. What's also had a great time in Lisbon generally and the apartment
Was definitely part of this.

L'appartement de Pedro est vraiment génial, très bien entretenu spacieux, moderne et pratique. Il est très bien situé et au calme....
Pedro est très disponible, sympathique et plein d'attention pour ses hôtes.
Je vous recommande ce lieu pour passer des moments sympas à Lisbonne !

Florine et Marc
Antonio was very nice and easy to reach. The apartment is just as described, very cosy atmosphere. The location is just perfect. I would definitely come back.
Very nice apartment. The decoration is superb, all the amenities, really well situated. Could not be more perfect. Very nice host who will take good care of you. Highly recommended.

The Chiado loft is a perfect place to call home during a visit to Lisbon!  The location in/near Chiado/Bairro Alto/Principe Real puts great restaurants, nightlife, coffee/pastries and transportation option (including the 28 Tram) right out the door...and the top floor is very quiet.
