The loft is well decorated and has a very efficient design, with wonderful small kitchen and large bathroom.   I look forward to the next visit...

The house was comfortable, clean en perfect for what we wanted. We were given a warm welcome and had a pleasant stay. The appartment is well situated near metro. Bars, restaurants etc are nearby, and the supermarket is close.
We can recommend this place.
It was one of my best expiriences with airbnb. Everything great. The house perfect And beautifull. Highly recomended.
We really recommend this light, clean and cosy appartment. Great location, nice athmosphere, and superb hosting made this stay rememberable!
Great location, exactly in city center and great apartment. I really hope to turn there again. Magic moments.
What can I say: the perfect place in the perfect location for a great time in lisbon. I will definitely recommend it!

We arrived to a warm welcome from Antonio, Pedro's brother (I think). The flat is tastefully furnished and finished to an extremely high standard. It was scrupulously clean and fragranced with some traditional Porto incense (i.e. a much nicer scent than the incense we get elsewhere in Western Europe). There were even a couple of chocolates for my girlfriend and I next to our bed. A couple of induction hobs would likely provide all the cooking facilities we would have needed, had we not eaten out every single meal. The flat is in a great location on the tram 28 line, about a 5 minute walk from the metro, Barrio Alto, and a load of other stuff Antonio told us about. He also gave us a good list of restaurants and bars, of which we sampled several. I would strongly recommend visiting the Time Out food market at least once; this is about 7/8min walk away, mostly downhill, and houses kiosks from the best restaurants in Lisbon.
Antonio was an excellent host and fixed a water problem we had while we were out. These things happen and they dealt with the problem quickly and politely.
We had a lovely few days in Lisbon and can't recommend the flat enough.

Rob

The flat was really beautiful, with lovely fixtures and very comfortable beds. The area is fantastic, right at the south of Barrio Alto, so you only need to cross the road to find lovely bars and restaurants. Also only 2 mins walk from the Bica. This flat is very stylish and feels luxurious, I couldnt recommend it more!

La casa è molto carina e equipaggiata di tutto ciò che può servire. Raffinato l'interno, le foto non rendono la sua bellezza.
Siamo stati a Lisbona con nostra figlia di 7 anni, il quartiere è tranquillo e piacevole da girare, in pochi minuti si raggiunge il centro e la fermata della metropolitana.

Beautiful flat.
Very kind, Pedro&Antonio make everything to make you feel at Home.
Thank you.

Although we've arrived pretty late, Antonio was waiting for us in the apartment.The place is newly renovated and is in a good neighbourhood. I would recommend it for everybody and I'm sure if I visit Lisbon again, I will stay here again.

Good location. Close to main attractions, 150 meters from public parking. Very well equipped appartment (like the best equipped i've ever encountered). Was clean. Host was friendly. I've enjoyed the stay very much.

My friend and I stayed at Pedro's beautiful apartment in Lisbon and absolutely loved it. We were welcomed by Antonio who was waiting for us.  The place was gorgeous and exactly the way it looks in the pictures. The beds were very comfortable, the place was very clean and so well located next to restaurants, bars, banks and attractions. We would highly recommend the apartment to everyone. Thank you Pedro and Antonio for a lovely stay in the most beautiful city in Europe, Lisbon. Muito obrigado!!!

We had a wonderful time in Lisbon staying in this beautifully furnished apartment. We were greeted by Antonio who patiently waited for us due to our flight being slightly delayed and showed us around the apartment. We found the list of cafes restaurants and bars really useful and the air conditioning was a blessing. The icing on the cake was the little touches such as a chilled bottle of wine and chocolates by the bed. Thank you for an unforgettable experience :)

We had a wonderful stay. The flat is beautiful, and they gave us excellent dinner suggestions. Location is also excellent with  trendy bars and restaurants withing 5 min walk. Would stay there again without hesitation. Having aircon is a massive plus in such a warm city.
Lovely and cozy apartment and welcoming. All the facilities necessary and perfectly clean. Highly recommended.

Great little suite , very clean and well kept. Nice kitchen, bath, living room and bedrooms. In suite washing machine was very handy. No complaints!
Must be mobile to access since the suite is 4 floors up a narrow, steep staircase. 10' walk from metro. Thx Antonio!

Great property - in an excellent location! We were welcomed by Antonio who gave us great restaurant/bar recommendations. Fantastic stay - will be back again soon!

Lovely and clean with all mod cons.

This apartment is fantastic - it's very clean and chic and has been recently remodeled and has all the conveniences plus charm. The area is perfect too. Close to everything. The stairs up are pretty steep and the door small to enter which adds to the charm but is good to note! Pedro was super accommodating with communication as unfortunately our flight was cancelled so we arrived a day later. Thank you for a lovely and extremely comfortable stay!! We wish we could have stayed longer.

The apartment was absolutely great in terms of location, cleanliness and style, and António and Pedro couldn't have been more helpful when we were preparing for our trip and once we were in Lisbon. We loved the little details in the apartment (some coffee, a little chocolate, chilled bottle of wine, some recommendations for restaurants/bars), and how well equipped the flat was. Brilliant!
Great stay in Lisbon at Chiado 6. The place was clean, comfortable, in great condition, and in a good location. Also, it is a fairly large place - good value for the price!
Host was great! He had many recommendations that turned out excellent. Place was comfortable, clean and great location!

Where to begin? The flat impeccable, the location premium, bedrooms oriented away from the street super-quiet (and comfortable beds)! Even though on the 4th floor, not a problem to walk up. Cannot recommend highly enough, really wonderful experience!
Прекрасная квартира, очень удобное место расположения! В квартире все красиво, чисто и удобно. Педру и Антониу очень отзывчивые и дружелюбные. Всем рекомендую

This apartment was absolutely fantastic! The location was great as we could walk easily to the train or tram, and it was a very short walk into Bario Alto for the evenings. The hosts took special care to have the apartment perfectly clean and left city guides, restaurant information, and even a bottle of wine. We will happily stay here again and highly recommend it for two or three people.

Excellent accueil malgré notre retard de 2 heures en raison d'un atterrissage tardif.
Pédro et Antonio ont été très prévenant avec nous, et n'ont pas hésité à intervenir dans la demi-heure pour nous dépanner (porte fermée accidentellement avec les clés à l’intérieur).
L'appartement est très propre, conforme aux photos, bien équipé, joli et très bien situé (seul petit bémol, l'escalier est rude et le logement est peut-être à déconseiller aux personnes ayant des difficultés a "grimper" les escaliers).
Un superbe petit nid pour découvrir la magnifique ville de Lisbonne.

A la hauteur de nos espérances ! Un hôte très accueillant , un appartement propre et très bien situé
A recommander !!!
Very nice flat! We highly recommend to stay at Pedros!! We profit from his wonderful suggestions where to go out in Lisbon for dinner. Thank's a lot to you and your team!

In apartment everything was really great. It is nicely furnished, clean and fragrant. You can clearly see that Pedro prepared every detail with love and style. The location of apartment, Barrio Alto quarter, is also great neighborhood.

We were just amazed at how beautiful this apartment was and how it is ideally located! We didn't want to leave. Pedro was extremely responsive and helpful and easy to contact. I wouldn't stay anywhere else. This place should be featured in a magazine!
Thank you Pedro!

We spent one week in this apartment and I strongly recommend it.
The location is extremely central and easy to access by metro. The tram 28 stop is right by the door and there are always taxis passing by in the street.
And although it is right between two of the neighbourhoods with most lively nightlife in Lisbon (Bairro Alto and Bica), it was quiet inside. The bedroom is not towards the street, so we managed to get a good night sleep even in Santo António, the busiest and most chaotic night of the year in Lisbon.
It was very practical to live so close to a supermarket and a good fruit store. The pastries on the cafe next door are also highly recommended.
The flat was nicely renovated and it had everything we needed. It was bliss to come home and be able to turn on the air conditioned on the days when the temperature outside rose above 30C.
I had to work during my stay and the wi-fi internet proved to be quite fast and reliable.
Pedro and Antonio were very easy to communicate with and we felt very welcome. I will surely recommend this apartment to my friends.
Although, that wasn't a problem for us, our only remark is: this is an old building with very narrow and steep stairs and the apartment is on the 4th floor.

Всё отлично! Это если в двух словах.
Молодая пара. Останавливались на неделю в июне 2014-го. Полностью экипированная и чистая квартира с незаурядным интерьером. Кровать, душ, кухонный уголок - удобные. Как впрочем и всё остальное. Приветливый хозяин (Спасибо, Педро!). Расположение удачное: центр, пешком до метро Baixa/Chiado минут 5, до станции Cais do Sodre (если нужно в Белем или Кашкаиш) минут 10-15, до станции Rossio (если нужно в Синтру) столько же. До большинства городских достопримечательностей тоже ходили пешком. Район старый и очень приятный. Много кафе и ресторанов. Небольшой супермаркет рядом с домом, но советую пользоваться тем, который в здании станции Cais do Sodre - лучше. Да, на тот случай если вы не в форме - чтобы попасть в квартиру нужно проскользнуть в узкую дверь подъезда и подняться на 4 этаж по крутой и опять же узкой деревянной лестнице))
Хорошего отдыха! Эта квартира к нему располагает.

Super fijne tijd gehad, heel mooi huis dat heel proper was en een aangenaam bed om in te slapen. De locatie kan niet beter in die prachtig oude stadsgedeelte van Lissabon. Communicatie was top van begin tot einde. Madalena, die ons ontving, was heel behulpzaam en we werden met lekkers verrast!
We will be back! Loved the location and the host was lovely too.

Very lovely place, looks just like the pictures and is very cosy. The apartment is located in the oldest neighbourhood so it’s not the most soundproof especially on a weekend but we didn’t mind. Magdalena was very sweet and kind in picking us up, giving us tips, and getting fresh pastries for us. We’d recommend!

This place is amazing and located in the heart of Lisbon, which makes everything very walkable and close to the station. The host was very nice, checked in with us occasionally, and always responded quickly when we had questions. We really appreciated the communication.
The only reason I’m giving four stars instead of five is because when we ran out of some basic necessities, such as toilet paper, they were not able to provide more and we had to buy them ourselves. Since we were on vacation, I expected those basic items to be included during our stay.
Overall, it was still a great place to stay and we enjoyed our time here. I would definitely give five stars if the basic necessities were better supplied.
Lovely home- more spacious than expected & hosts were really helpful & great neighbourhood!

The apartment was perfect for our three night stay in Lisbon. We were met by friendly Madalena who took us to the apartment, explained things, and kept in touch. We appreciated the wine and pastries too. The location in the Alfama district was peaceful but easy to walk to the busier districts for sightseeing. The kitchen is well equipped if you want to prepare simple meals. There are restaurants and bakeries nearby too.

La bouteille de vin et les pâtisseries ont été très appréciés. Boucherie, pâtisserie et petits marchés de qualité à proximité. L'appartement est central. Belle vue sur le fleuve à partir de la cuisine. Magdalena a nous accueilli au musée du Fado pour nous mener à l'appartement qui se trouvait à 3 minutes de marche. Très bon pour le prix.

Pasamos unos días hermosos en la casa de Monica & João.
El apartamento es igual que en las fotos. Tiene una vista increíble. Muy cómodo, con todo lo necesario en la cocina.
Nos dejaron incluso de regalo una botella de vino, los tradicionales pasteis de nata para el desayuno, y chocolatada para mis hijos.
Tiene también un patio adorable que pudimos disfrutar gracias al buen clima.
Muy cómoda la cama de la habitación principal y un sillón grande en el living.
Nos recibió Madalena que fue súper amable y nos dio consejos valiosos sobre los locales y atracciones de la zona.
Lo único que tiene de malo es que sólo se pueden hacer a pie los últimos 300m, y son en subida. Y el apartamento tiene una escalera larga para poder subir.
Y la otra "contra" es que es tan lindo y cómodo el apartamento que nos costaba salir por la mañana porque queríamos quedarnos a disfrutarlo 🙂

We had a fantastic four night in this lovely apartment in a beautiful part of this wonderful city. You couldn't ask for a better location, and the apartment itself is spacious, full of character with not one - but two - view points of the city. The balcony by the kitchen gives stunning views of the river, and the private terrace area by the living room is a wonderful place to enjoy a coffee in the morning or relax with a glass of wine after a day exploring the city. Despite being right in the heart of the action, within easy walking distance to all the big sightseeing spots (and many other gems you'll stumble across around every corner!), the apartment itself is peaceful, quiet and feels like a real oasis in the heart of the most characterful and historic part of the city. We will be back!

Madelena was warm, welcoming, and ensured we entered and were oriented to the space in-person! The pastel de nata and bottle of wine waiting for us upon arrival were sweet touches that elevated the experience. A very spacious place with gorgeous patio and views. Would stay again!
Great place, location, nice and responsive host. I really appreciated being able to drop off bags and leave them while the place was gotten ready. Loved the space and design. Thanks again
Virkelig hyggelig lejlighed, ren og fin. Den er placeret super godt i et smukt kvarter. Monica og Joao var super gode værter, god kontakt og meget hjælpsomme.
Appartement pittoresque très mignon, juste assez difficile d'accès mais si vous n'êtes pas charger alors foncez!

We really enjoyed our stay with our toddler. The neighbourhood was quaint with many restaurant options nearby and walkable to so much. The apartment itself was lovely and comfortable. Thank you for having us.

Schöne Unterkunft, alles ist wie auf den Bildern. Ganz besonders hat uns die Lage in Alfama, einem der ältesten Stadtteile in Europa, gefallen. Die Kommunikation verlief meistens über eine dritte Person vor Ort und war anfangs etwas holprig, aber Madalena hat sich wunderbar gekümmert und uns sogar extra die leckeren Pasteis de nata gebracht 🥰.
Die Wohnung ist etwas feucht bzw. klamm, was wahrscheinlich auch der Jahreszeit geschuldet ist. Und der Strom ist häufig ausgefallen, aber wir konnten das System selbstständig rebooten, sodass es wieder funktionierte, aber es passierte schon sehr häufig. Wir empfehlen insgesamt trotzdem diese Unterkunft.

We truly enjoyed our stay here - tucked away in Alfama‘s cozy neighborhood and close to lots of attractions. Great starting point to explore various neighborhoods if you enjoy walking. Public transport is also fairly close. The place itself is gorgeous, very bright and cozy. Would definitely recommend!

Leider hatten wir Schimmel im Wohnzimmer, der deutlich sichtbar und zu riechen war. Wir konnten und wollten das Wohnzimmer so nicht benutzen, da wir mit Baby unterwegs waren. Der Vermieter hat zwar freundlich reagiert, das mit dem vielen Regen in den letzten Wochen begründet und angeboten, dass er uns den Betrag erstattet, wenn wir eine andere Wohnung nehmen möchten. Nach der langen Anreise mit Baby und Gepäck war das aber für die wenigen Tage nicht realistisch. Schade, sonst wär’s gut gewesen.
Majoitus oli ihana ja mahtavalla sijainnilla! Vietimme upean loman Lissabonissa ja tulemme uudestaan!
Nice place, excellent location, friendly and helpful hosts. Would definitely stay there again.
Todo estaba perfecto, la zona es preciosa y la terraza muy útil. La cama muy cómoda y el baño limpio.
Apartment was perfect for our visit to Lisbon. Very spacious and beautiful neighbourhood. Everything we needed in the apartment. Thanks to Magdalena for meeting us and taking us to the apartment
Ci siamo trovati benissimo, la casa è ben posizionata, spaziosa e molto accogliente
Situated at the heart of Alfama, everything is a 5 minute e-scooter ride away. Loved the place!

Beautiful apartment in the oldest part of Lisbon - exciting and vibrant, yet peaceful as well. Full of character and we had a great stay. Madalena, who met us and took us to the apartment was very helpful and friendly. Many thanks!

Beautiful accommodation in the old part of Lisbon, the apartment was renovated and at the same time had a huge charm. We appreciated the extras supplied by the host and the lady who checked us in was lovely, helpful and have us lots of local advice

Hemos estado muy agusto en el  Apartamento. Magadalena fué muy atenta e incluso se puso en contacto con  nosotros por que nos habiamos dejado ropa en el apartamento e hizo lo posible para quedar y devolvernosla. Muchas gracias Magdalena !!!!

We enjoyed our stay in such a historic area of Lisbon and the extra welcoming touches provided us. We really appreciated the detailed instructions of where to meet Madelena to take us to the condominium, she was such a great help with the best way to get our heavy bag up the steep 2 flights of internal stairs to the condominium. Once inside, the condominium was spacious, with a great area on the terrace to relax, lots of information about Lisbon's sights and eateries, and a very comfortable bed after a busy day.

Had a wonderful 6 nights, great location. Madalena met us at the Fado museum and then took us to the lovely apartment. So clean, with everything you could need, thank you for the wine, fruit and pastries. Madalena helped us when there was a leak and booked us a local taxi for the airport. She was so kind and helpful. The apartment has a terrace with table and chairs, with views of the cruise ships and the sea. The bed was very comfortable. Monika sent instructions before we arrived with precise instructions on how to get here and also suggested places to visit. Alfama is very characterful with lots of bars and restaurants, easy to get around, and not far from a railway station. The buses and trams are easy to use with your bank card. We had a wonderful week. And will def be back.
The stairs to the apartment are very steep, not recommended if you have mobility problems.
Très bien situé. Avons aimé notre séjour
Nice to be there in the old city of Lisbon, clean and good apartment with a nice terras.

We had a fabulous stay here. The location in the Alfama district is unique and central to a lot of Lisbon’s attractions. You can’t beat the view from the kitchen and the spacious apartment. The stairs to get up are steep and the key to the door can be a little tricky at first try but don’t let that scare you. I would highly recommend!
Alles so wie beschrieben. Sauber, einfacherer Check-In, wunderschöne Gegend, authentisch und toller Blick aus der Küche!

Hii. I have stayed for 2 nights and 3 days. Madalena came to meet me near airbnb location to guide to the airbnb location. The place was just okey of me. But I would like to write honest review for others to consider ;
I would really appreciate her help coming all the way, however, with all the luggages, it would be nicer if we met in airbnb location cause we came all the way down, and we went all the way up to the hills which I felt is not convenient.
The stairways to airbnb is very tiny and very steep. I would not recommend to people who are older for safety reasons.
Since there are people who's living in the same building, and since after 23:00 is quiet time, till 3am everyday, you can hear the sounds of talking, walking, laughing, and stepping of floor and stairs. You can hear them in the bedroom which was not pleasant for me, and couldn't sleep in bedroom unfortunately.
The air conditioner is only one in bedroom, which during the day, in kitchen and living room is very hot.

It was a great stay. The apartment had everything we needed. It was clean and comfortable. Most of all, our host was very helpful, responsive, and kind. The location is convenient, making it easy to explore many of the best sights of Lisbon.
Wir hatten eine tolle Zeit in Lissabon. Es war sehr schön, nach unseren Unternehmungen wieder in die tolle Wohnung zurückzukehren. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Vielen Dank!

This place was such a breath of fresh air. Alfama is beautiful; it's also very tight, and most of the places are very small. This place had too much room for just the two of us! A balcony and a patio for outside time, and lots of space inside. The in-unit clothes washer was also very handy.
We did not meet Monica and João, but Magdalena, who was incredibly kind and helpful. She was really the highlight of our stay here.
Everything about this Airbnb was as describe. Madalaena helped us check in and even brought us some pastry! She was very helpful throughout the entirety of our stay.

Our flight was late and Madalena who met us was lovely, chatting to us about the neighbourhood, making sure we knew how to get in and out and making suggestions for our stay. Half way through the week we came back to find o lovely bowl of fruit and freshly baked rolls which was a delightful surprise.
The apartment is up a long flight of stairs but there are good handrails: I walk with a stick and got up and down fine.
Inside it is a great space - well appointed kitchen with a nice space to eat, and you can see across to the Tagus.
The bedroom has air conditioning which was very welcome in a week when the temperature seemed to be above 30 degrees most of the time.
The living space opens out onto a really great patio area with table and chairs where you can eat, enjoy the sun or the morning shade.
It’s a short walk up to find the 28 tram, you can walk to Baixa and the castle, and Santa Apolónia metro station is walkable too - which gets you everywhere else in Lisbon.
Highly recommend.
thank you Monica ans Joao! we really enjoy our week end in your flat!
We loved the flat and the beautiful view from the kitchen and sitting out on the patio.  The location was ideal for getting around.

Madalena was a great host and the apartment is beautiful and well located for anyone wanting to stay in Lisbon's old town. Maybe goes without saying but this isn't the place for you if you have accessibility requirements, there will be a lot of hills and a steep staircase to contend with. If those things don't bother you though then this place is perfect.

Great airbnb for our stay in Lisbon. Place was spotless clean, beautiful view and incredible patio to spend some time. Washing machine worked great and bed was extremely comfortable. AC in the bedroom was perfect and Monica and Joao left snacks and fruit and wine- were so kind and responsive. Would highly recommend.
The stairs up are steep as described so just to keep in mind. They were perfectly fine for us!

This is a charming apartment located in historic  neighborhood of Alfama. We were greeted by Madalena, who helps host and care for the home. She is a lovely person who met us and helped us navigate to the apartment on arrival. She brought us wine and our very first pastel de nata pastries. The apartment itself has every amenity you could need away from home including a fully stocked kitchen, dishwasher, and washing machine! The bedroom is air conditioned and very comfortable. Madalena shared many local insights and things to do. She even brought us fruit and cheese on our second day after hiking in Sintra. It felt very personal and cozy. The neighborhood of Alfama is quieter but still easy to reach the city center by walk or other transportation. Be aware that the steps up to the apartment are very steep; caution if you are unable to climb stairs or have large luggage. Otherwise, everything here was perfect and we would definitely stay again. Thank you for your hospitality!

Logement avec grande terrasse situé dans le quartier historique Alfama avec tous les services nécessaires à deux pas. Belle ambiance de quartier. On peut facilement marcher au centre-ville qui se trouve à 10-15 minutes de l'appart. Madalena nous a retrouvé face au musée du Fado lors de notre arrivée pour faciliter notre check in. Plusieurs petites attentions dans le logement, dont un bon rouge. Dans ce type d'appartement avec porte et escalier étroit, il est préférable de voyager plus léger.
A lovely host, and a lovely place. Clean, matched description, and easy to get around. Highly recommend!
Super vacances dans cet appartement. Très bien localisé, l’appartement superbe ! Nous avons adorés

The apartment’s location was excellent—close to restaurants, public transportation, and just a 20-minute walk to the downtown area and shopping districts. However, it’s situated up a hill where cars aren’t allowed, so be prepared for a 5-minute walk up a cobblestone path with your luggage. Inside the building, the stairs are narrow and quite steep, which could be challenging for anyone with mobility issues. That said, we had a lovely stay overall and would recommend it.
We had a lovely stay for my partner’s birthday. The space was clean and as pictured. Great communication from all hosts involved. We had an amazing stay and the location was perfect. Thank  you!
Wonderful! Location is incredible and the apartment itself was very cute and spacious.

Loved this place in the heart of Alfama. Walkable, easy to get to anywhere, including right by the Santa Apolina train station. Felt like a local with celebrating the feast of St. Anthony with the entire neighborhood.
The place is very clean, with a great bathroom/shower! I would seriously stay here again!!!
Die Wohnung ist wie beschrieben.Die Kommunikation war super einfach und sehr nett.Lage top!

Die Wohnung war sehr schön gelegen, mitten in Alfama mit Restaurants und Cafés um die Ecke, aber trotzdem ruhig. Die Räume sind großzügig und sehr hell. Alles war blitzsauber und es gibt eine schöne Aussicht auf den Fluss. Wir wurden persönlich abgeholt und haben sogar eine Flasche Wein und frische Pastel de Nata als Willkommen bekommen. Vielen Dank! Wir würden definitiv wieder kommen.
Nice apartment with great view in good location with terrace

This is a real gem of a place; well-equipped  comfortable and spacious. It is ideally located, near shops and eateries but quiet at night. There are excellent transport links to get to other parts of the city.

We verbleven 5 nachten en hebben van ieder moment genoten.
We werden door de beheerster ontvangen bij het Fado museum en er stonden taartjes en wijn voor ons klaar. De buurt is ontzettend gezellig en er zijn vele restaurantjes en toch is het in de avond en nacht rustig. Om de hoek zit een geweldige lokale bakker waar we iedere dag hebben ontbeten.
Ik zou deze accommodatie zeer zeker aanraden! Heel erg bedankt voor het fijne verblijf.

Nous sommes des habitués de Lisbonne, et nous voulions absolument être dans le cœur d'Alfama. Cet appartement a totalement répondu à nos attentes. L'emplacement est juste parfait, la vue est magnifique, surtout côté cuisine, l'appartement est vraiment grand pour ce quartier et au calme ! le plus, la terrasse ! c'est très agréable. Si je peux me permettre une observation, il serait intéressant de mettre de vrais volets ou des rideaux plus occultants. Pour les personnes ayant besoin de dormir dans le noir, c'est problématique. Cependant, l'appartement vaut tout de même un 5*  . Nous reviendrons sans hésiter.

Die Wohnung mit der Terrasse ist total super, toll gelegen in Alfama. Wir wurden von Magdalena super betreut. Wir kommen wieder.
Erika und Jürgen

Wahnsinnig schönes Appartement!Wenn es möglich wäre, würde ich 6* vergeben!
Die Gastgeberin ist sehr zuvorkommend und hat uns sogar noch eine typische Spezialität geschenkt.

A fabulous stay in the Alfalma District, checkin with Medelina was perfect. The apartment was well appointed, spacious and clean. Views were beautiful and worth the stairs.
We thoroughly enjoyed our time in Lisbon, this apartment forming a great space to explore the city.

Really enjoyed our stay. Location was very convenient,  lots of great restaurants with fado music. Only downside was that someone collecting laundry entered the apartment without knocking after we had checked in. This was unsettling.
Lovely flat in the heart of the Alfama. Great views on the river and the neighborhood. The flat was clean and spacious. Madalena was kind, responsive, and flexible. We recommend this experience!

This was a very nice and affordable apartment in the middle of Alfama. The place was clean, spacious and the bed was very comfortable. Madelena met us at the Fado Museum and assisted us with getting to the apartment and giving us information needed for our stay. She was very sweet and helpful. We appreciated the milk and water in the fridge, the fresh pastries she bought and the bottle of wine. The view of the river from the kitchen window was beautiful and the outdoor patio was great.
Just be aware that there are cobblestone walking paths with hills to climb to get to the apartment and the stairs in the building are quite narrow and steep to navigate. I would highly recommend the apartment to anyone who doesn't have any mobility issues.
Thanks to Monica, Joao and Madelena for a great stay in Lisboa!

This is a beautiful apartment in a fantastic location within easy reach of lots of attractions, bars and restaurants. The apartment looks exactly as it does in the pictures. It was spotlessly clean and the patio area is amazing.
Checking in was very easy with Madelena meeting us to show us into the apartment and explain everything to us. As others have mentioned, the streets, and also the stairs to the apartment, are very steep. Not a problem for us at all but just something to be aware of. It’s well worth though as you get great views when you get there.
If you’re visiting Lisbon I highly recommend this apartment.
Charmant appartement, avec une jolie vue et une super petite terrasse au calme. Tout était propre , en état , et bien rangé.

Excellent séjour dans cet appartement en plein centre du quartier d Alfama! Madalena est très arrangeante et disponible pour les hôtes!
Nous recommandons vivement ce logement

A lovely apartment in Alfama, up a cobbled street. Quiet at night and peaceful. The apartment was quirky and spacious. As other reviews have said the stairs are steep but ok if you're fairly mobile. We had an issue with the outside door whilst we were there but it was sorted the same day and Monica kept us updated.  Welcome pack of custard pastries and wine was lovely. The apartment was clean and bed very comfortable.

We had a fantastic stay at this apartment in Lisbon! The space was incredibly clean, spacious, and beautifull with amazing views. The location was perfect—making it easy to explore all the amazing sights, restaurants, and local spots. The hosts were very helpfull and ensured everything was seamless from check-in to check-out. We would highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Lisbon and would love to stay again in the future!

We had an excellent stay.  We spent a month in this apartment.  The location in Alfama was perfect.  It's a beautiful part of Lisbon.  Our host was extremely attentive and quickly responded to any questions we had.  We wouldn't hesitate to recommend this apartment.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay here, there was plenty of room for us to relax and a wonderful outdoor patio to sit in. The area was safe and wonderful Fado music everywhere nearby it is located on a pedestrian street and we were met and escorted to the home. It is a steep staircase up to the second floor however we’re used to that so it was not a problem.

Monica's place was in a fantastic location to explore the old part of Lisbon. Close to tram, restaurants and walkable to the city centre. The drscription is accurate - the stairs are steep! But the apartment is clean, convenient and comfortable.
Excellent value for money

Really enjoyable stay. Lovely touch with the complimentary wine, snacks and soft drinks, very kind and appreciated after a long day of travelling.
Madalena gave us lots of helpful advice and recommendations for both restaurants and activities. Furthermore, she gave us a thorough tour of the apartment. Lots of towels, bedding and cushions. There is a lot of climbing/stairs to get to the apartment however it is in keeping with the oldest and traditional part of Lisbon so to be expected.
Thank you very much.

This location was in a very convenient and accessible location. The elevator in the building and in-unit washer were very convenient. The place also had great proximity to the local transportation methods and nearby tourist sites. Many places were easily walkable. Monica and Joao were very responsible and even provided enjoyable recommendations for Porto

Wonderful cozy place to stay.  Very close to the bus and tram and lots to walk to.  Magdelena was kind and helpful greeting us for an arranged early check in and accompanied us to the apartment .  There she gave us pastries and helpful hints about the neighborhood, transportation etc.  There are lots of steps up to the apartment and the passage is very narrow so if you have large luggage it may be difficult but once there the place is clean, cute, cozy and spacious.  The patio is an extra bonus which we really enjoyed!

Everything was pretty okay. Cute deco and had everything you need. There are a lot of steep stairs and hills so be mindful with luggage. The only complaint that I have is that the place really needs to be deep cleaned. There was different types of hair everywhere and it was pretty gross.

We really enjoyed our stay in the apartment- communication was easy and Madelena was very friendly & helpful. The location is lovely & quiet at night as no vehicle access and we felt close to everything - the whole city was within walking distance. 😊

Vi elsker stedet! Det er ca. 12 minutter til sentrum/downtown og bare noen minutters spasertur til ulike severdigheter eller bussen/trikken. Leiligheten gir en svært avslappende følelse. Den er veldig ren og har alt man trenger. Velkomstgaver som en flaske rødvin, brus, juice og pastel de nata var en svært hyggelig overraskelse :) Anbefales sterkt!

Belle appartement dans un quartier calme mais mal insonorisé (vis à vis des voisins).
Arrivée non autonome contrairement à la description de l annonce.
Tout le reste nickel.

This apartment is a small gem. Beautifully decorated, equipped and sunny. Located in a quiet location in historic Alfama. Yes there are many steps but this is Lisbon. Monica offered many recommendations for places to visit and Mrs. Madalena, the  care taker, was also very helpful and kind.

We couldn’t have been happier with this apartment. We enjoy the funky, offbeat nature of the Alfama, and the apartment was a clean and comfortable haven, with a unique and enjoyable character, to come home to. The bed is particularly comfortable. The apartment had all the equipment we needed to eat at home when we chose to. The views from the terrace over the red tile roofs to the Tagus are wonderful and the terrace is a great place for a morning workout or an afternoon glass of wine
I will caution though that this flat, and the Alfama in general, may not be for everyone. The Alfama is a maze of steeply sloping cobbled alleys and stairways, and the apartment is up a VERY steep and narrow staircase, which anyone in less than reasonable physical condition, (or with heavy luggage) will find challenging. Some may find the Alfama too rough for their taste, with laundry hanging from upper stories and a tendency to get lost.
But for us, the Alfama and this apartment are simply perfect!
Massively enjoyed our time staying here, lovely get away location and the flat had everything we possibly needed.

Had a great stay, the patio is huge and such a plus! The place was very clean and comfortable. Seemed even bigger than the pictures. FYI: I read reviews but I still couldn't believe how very small and steep the stairs into the apartment were, it was hard to get our bags up. But other than that it was perfect if you are okay with the workout it take to get there lol!
Le logement est super et la communication excellente

This place is beautiful! The host is amazing at making people feel welcomed and provide a lot of essential detailed information, as well as things to make you feel comfortable in your stay. As my first time in the country, I found this place to be the best I've stayed in. Everything is so close that I didn't need to use public transportation to get to all the main points of interest & restaurants as they were all within walking distance 5-15 min. It's also close to main public transportation so even if you have to go around town, you can with no issues. I enjoyed my time here, and I'm sure you will too.

We had a lovely stay, clean and welcoming.  Madalena met us at the Fado Museum and walked us up to the apartment.  She even stopped by the bakery and picked up some pastel de nata for us😍. I do feel the need to mention the walk to the flat was rough with heavy bags.  We had heavy bags from cruising and it’s quite a steep walk.  No fault of the hosts!!  Just wanted to mention it to future travelers.

This is a little treasure! The apartment is just as listed, quaint, quiet, and in the heart of the second oldest neighborhood in Europe. We’d stay here again, 100%
Madalena personally greeted us, explained everything in the apartment, and gifted us pastries and chocolate! What a wonderful way to start our stay.
Some of the other reviewers commented on the narrow steep stairs and hilly terrain. We found these realities only added to the wonderful experience.
May you enjoy this little treasure as much as we did
Great stay! Beautiful airbnb. Monica, João and Madalena were all very helpful and kind.

Great location in the heart of Alfama. Very clean and it has everything you will need. Note that this is a pedestrian street and transportation can't drop you off at the door. lots of stairs and uneven walkways. 2 Stories of very steep stairs to get to the apartment and there are stairs within the apartment itself. love the place but be aware that if you have mobility issues this is not the place for you. Madalena was very helpful and answers quickly. I would definitely stay there again.

Alojamiento según se ve en las fotos. Limpio, ordenado y con todo lo necesario. Nos ha encantado la ubicación, en pleno barrio de Alfama, con muchos sitios de fados. Han sido muy detallistas y estado pendientes de nosotros en todo momento. Nos han recomendado muchas cosas. Muy recomendable.

Monica & Joao’s place is adorable and as described. Very comfortable with all amenities you would need. The neighborhood is very walkable (yet crazy hilly!) and there are lots of restaurants close by. Great location.
Beautiful home centrally located would 100% stay there again!

Appartamento con tutti i confort, luminosa, molto carina e tenuta benissimo, non adatta per persone con limitata mobilità per via della scala di accesso all'appartamento molto ripida.
Madalena che ci ha accolti all'arrivo, è stata gentilissima .
Abbiamo molto apprezzato sia i pastel de nata che il vino, che ci ha fatto trovare.
Grazie mille a Monica &Joao e Madalena per l'ospitalità

Die Wohnung war sehr gerâumig für 4 Personen und was besonders schön und eher selten für Innenstadtlage ist, war die Terrasse mit großem Sonnenschirm. Man hat einen schönen Blick vom Küchenfenster auf den Tejo mit den Kreuzfahrtschiffen.
Die Lage mitten in der Alfama hat uns gut gefallen, da es sehr ruhig war (kein Autoverkehr) und man trotzdem relativ schnell zu Fuß ins Zentrum gelangen konnte.
Die Kommunikation im Vorfeld mit den freundlichen Gastgebern war sehr gut, so dass auch die Schlüsselübergabe trotz später Ankunft in der Nacht (aufgrund der Flugzeiten) reibungslos geklappt hat.
Nicht ganz optimal ist die Lage und Größe des Bades (wenig Ablagemöglichkeiten), das vom Schlafzimmer aus etwas entfernt liegt. Aber es hat ein kleines Fenster zum Lüften und eine schöne ebenerdige Dusche.
Ein kleiner Minuspunkt war, dass nur drei Holzstühle auf der schönen Terrasse benutzt werden konnten, da ein Stuhl defekt an der Wand lehnte. Der wird aber bestimmt ersetzt werden.

We stayed in three air bnbs during our time in Portugal and this was our favorite! Such a charming apartment with an amazing shower to boot! I would recommend not bringing large luggage as there are lots of hills and steep staircase. A wonderful stay and great value!

The apartment is roomy and comfortable and well appointed. The charming neighborhood is quiet with plenty of markets and eateries. It’s a nice retreat after a busy crowded sightseeing day, and the terrace is peaceful for morning coffee listening to birds. I appreciated the natas and wine welcome gift. While we like being on an upper level and don’t mind stairs, be aware they are very steep and narrow. We dropped ourselves a pin to find our way back in the labyrinth lanes, which are fun to explore.
Great spot if you don’t mind a couple hills!

Le logement de Monica & João est une petite perle, confortable et conforme à la description. Nous avons été très bien accueillis par leur représentante. Nous avons bien apprécié les petites attentions sucrées!!! Merci! Bien localisé pour visiter la vieille ville et près du métro. Je recommande ce logement sans hésiter !

Staying at this flat in Alfama made our stay in Lisbon extra special. It is the second oldest neighbourhood in Europe. We were met by Madelena who walked us to the flat and throughly explained all we needed to know. This flat has so much character and we loved the large outdoor terrace. It did not bother us but you should know there are steep, narrow stairs you need to tackle to get into the flat. Personally we felt  it added to the charm!! Don’t hesitate to book!
Casa favolosa in una posizione strategica. Tutto rispettava la descrizione e le foto condivise. Host disponibile e gentile. Grazie ancora

This is the best airbnb that we have ever stayed in during trips to Europe. It is so spacious, comfortable bed, beautiful views and a wonderful host. The wine and sweets upon checking in is a nice touch. And it is very walkable and so quiet at night. Highly recommend this stay.
Fabulous apartment in a great location in Lisbon. Easy to walk everywhere and close to the one of the main stations. We loved our stay here and would highly recommend.

The place is perfectly located in a quiet neighborhood next to great restaurants. Madalena was very responsive and friendly. She bought fresh, yummy pastries for breakfast and a nice bottle of wine. Great experience!
Very nice stay.  Good location, nice views, clean and we felt the bed was comfortable.

- schöne Unterkunft
- nah am Zentrum, viel zu Fuß erreichbar
- in der Nähe einer U-Bahn-Station
- steiler Treppenaufgang, einige Stiegen in der Wohnung
- es gibt eine gut funktionierende Klimaanlage

Monica and John's apartment was in a perfect location in Alfama. The apartment was as described and had everything we needed for our stay. Plenty of restaurants and cafes on our doorstep with the bonus of Fado musicians performing regularly. Thanks to Madalena too who was very helpful during our stay. Look forward to booking again when we next visit Lisbon.

Nous avons adoré notre expérience! L’appartement est parfaitement situé dans le quartier d’Alfama, près du centre ville, tout en étant plus calme et harmonieux.
L’accueil de l’assistante des propriétaires était absolument incroyable, nous nous sommes senties les bienvenues. Nous avons même reçu un cadeau de bienvenue!
Nous recommandons cet appartement sans hésitation!

This place is beautiful with great views and located in our favorite neighborhood in Lisbon. Very clean and spacious. The entrance stairs are very steep, but I think that adds to the charm of the apartment. Lots of restaurants and amenities within seconds. We will definitely stay there again!
Danke für die schöne Zeit. Wir konnten unseren Urlaub sehr geniessen und haben uns immer wohl in der Wohnung gefühlt.

A beautiful apartment 1 minute away from restaurants, fado en public transport ( though we walked mostly). The terrace is a bonus and the view from the kitchen gorgeous over the Taag. Madalena is a charm en Monica responded on everything quickly and nice. We recommend this apartment highly.

We had an amazing stay.  The apartment was comfortable, homely and in a fantastic location. Monica's communication was second to none and Madelena was a great help throughout our stay. I can't recommend this apartment and area of Lisbon highly enough.
Absolutely perfect week stay in Alfama. Magdalena was great. Highly recommended.
Lovely little spot and location!
We loved our stay in the apartment. It’s in a great location to explore Alfama, to hop on the tram and explore the rest of the city. We wouldn’t hesitate to book again.
Un beau logement typique dans le quartier Alfama de Lisbonne. Tramway 28 à quelques pas et une pâtisserie incroyable à côté du logement. Un superbe endroit pour vivre à Lisbonne.
Top Flat and super Communication. Thx
Beautiful place

숙소는 전체적으로 너무 아름다웠습니다. 올라가는 계단이 가파르고 좁아서 캐리어를 가지고 올라가기에는 힘들었음.. 처음에 계단보고 깜짝 놀라 실망했지만 친절하게 맞이해준 호스트와 깨끗하고 예쁘고 편안한 숙소에 위안이 되었습니다,,
트램이 바로 근처에 있어서 시내도 가까워서 좋았어요
Great location, great views and fantastic interiors, a great place for a stay in alfama.

Super appartement vraiment bien situé et propre. Très belle expérience, tout était parfait! Si vous hésitez entre un sac à dos et une valise, peut-être opter pour le sac à dos, il y à beaucoup de marches pour se rendre à l’appartement, mais ça fait partie du charme du logement.
Lovely apartment!
Perfekt um Lisboa zu Erkunden
We had a wonderful stay in Lisbon! We loved the location of the apartment and all the personal touches we were greeted with. The location in the Alfama district was so much fun!
Coming back felt a bit like coming home. We enjoyed our second stay again very much.

A special Thank you to Madelena, the cleaning staff for meeting us early to drop off our luggage on the day of our arrival when she was so busy!
We had a great time and the location was perfect for us!
One of the most beautiful places I’ve ever visited and stayed.

This is a very charming flat in the middle of Alfama with a lot of beauty inside and around. You can reach interesting places by foot and we enjoyed the great views. We’ ll come back when we return home. Thank you!

Nice clean and cool place with pretty convenient access to public transport. Cool view from the kitchen to the Tagus and the hosts were helpful. It will get noisy at night if there are celebrations/parties so you may want to bring earplugs.

We had a brilliant stay here for 4 nights. It's very well located, close to lots of attractions and there is easy access to the metro. They left some treats for us which was a lovely touch and Madalena was very flexible with our arrival time/showing us around and settling us in. Any noise outside stopped by 11pm and it was lovely and quiet. We did have one evening of the upstairs neighbours being noisy until 1am so bring earplugs just in case! The stairs are VERY steep and narrow up to the flat and Aflama is very hilly so bring comfortable shoes :) We loved staying here and would definitely come back!

Perfect stay- airbnb is located in the best part of Lisbon, check-in was seamless and the apartment super clean.
Highly recommended.

Logement très bien situé dans un quartier agréable. Madalena est venue à notre rencontre devant le musée du Fado afin de nous accompagner jusqu'au logement, situé à environ 5 minutes à pieds. Madalena est une personne très sympathique et agréable, qui nous a donné des recommandations en plus des nombreuses recommandations que m'avait envoyé Monica précédemment par messages.
Merci beaucoup à toutes les 2 !
Le logement de Monica et João est super, c'est un joli appartement, bien équipé et avec une jolie terrasse, très agréable.
Lisbonne est une très jolie ville, mon copain et moi y avons passé 2 jours, c'était super ! 😉

Great place to stay in the Alfama neighborhood.  Very walkable  to many destinations.  Magdalena was wonderful to escort us to the AirBNB and point out close restaurants .  The hosts were sweet to leave wine, coffee and morning pastries.   Very quiet for sleeping which we needed.  Very positive experience.

We had a wonderful day at this lovely apartment in Lisbon. Challenging steps up to the door for anyone with a disability but we managed. Great location close to lots of restaurants and close to the cruise terminals. Could watch the cruise liners arrive and depart from the kitchen window!!

The apartment is as shown. We were a little taken back on how steep and narrow the door were. Thank goodness we are average built and in good shape!  We were met by Magnelena who showed us to apartment which was needed because it would be hard to find.  We enjoy the wine, pastries and chocolate! Thank you for sharing your home ! Lisbon was our first stop.
Weniger geeignet für ältere, mobilitätseingeschränkte Menschen. Das sollte in der Anzeige vermerkt sein.

Wir haben Sehr wohl gefühlt und waren direkt zuhause, in der Wohnung, im Stadtteil. Man kommt sehr gut zu Fuß überall hin, aber auch Bushaltestellen sind in wenigen Minuten erreicht. Einkaufen kam man z. B. Am Bahnhof Apolonia, ein Lidl ist der Nähe, große Supermärkte sind etwas weiter weg. In der Wohnung ist alles was man braucht und sie ist sehr gemütlich und von der Küche aus ist der Blick auf den Tejo toll. Wer, wie ich, einen leichten Schlaf hat, der sollte sich Lärmschutz mitbringen oder darauf einstellen, dass es einfach sehr hellhörig ist. Wir kommen bestimmt wieder, vielen lieben Dank von Herzen auch an Madalena, die sehr herzlich und hilfsbereit ist. Es war eine tolle Woche!

The apartment is spacious and spotlessly clean- towels and bedding were changed part way through our week’s stay as well as the apartment being thoroughly cleaned .
Our arrival flight was delayed by more than 2 hours but communication was excellent and we were made very welcome even though it was very late by then .
The Alfama area is extremely interesting and we found the Portuguese very welcoming . We definitely hope to return !

This is a wonderful place in the heart of Alfama, bright and spacious, with great views, a modern bathroom, a peaceful patio, every amenity thought through, and even a tasty welcome gift from the hosts. Madalena, who met us at the Museu do Fado and accompanied to the house, was extremely helpful and patient. We appreciated the local tips and an extra umbrella she brought on that rainy afternoon. Happy to recommend Monica and João’s house; just be mindful, in case of mobility issues or bulky luggage, that it has a steep staircase.

Es war alles wie beschrieben und hat uns sehr gut gefallen. Es war sehr ruhig, obwohl die Lage sehr zentral ist. Das fanden wir super. Die Aussicht und die Terrasse sind ein weiteres Highlight der Wohnung. Die Kommunikation mit den Gastgebern verlief ebenfalls problemlos. Ich werde gerne wiederkommen.

Nous avons apprécié notre séjour dans le grand appartement de Monica et João.  L’appartement est confortable, et parfaitement situé dans Alfama à moins de 10 minutes à pieds de la station de train de Santa Apolonia et est tout près du musée du Fado.  Madalena nous a bien accueillis. Elle nous a guidé à travers les petites ruelles d'Alfama pour nous montrer le chemin jusqu'à l'appartement, nous aidant  à transporter une de nos valises. Ce fut très apprécié.

Wir haben uns in der Unterkunft sehr wohl gefühlt und konnten uns gut von den Tagesausflügen in und um Lissabon erholen. Trotz der zentralen Lage war es sehr ruhig. Die Wohnung ist groß und geschmackvoll eingerichtet. Das Bad ist modern. Wir können die Unterkunft auf jeden Fall empfehlen.
Lovely home located in an amazing area. The host’s were great, gave really good recommendations of places to visit and made us feel right at home.

logement atypique très agréable à vivre. Environnement paisible au coeur d un quartier authentique. métro à proximité.
Réactivité et disponibilité de l hôte.

We loved our stay at Monica and Joao's apartment. It was extremely well located in the Alfama, within walking distance to many attractions as well as train stations. The space was airy, brigth and felt very peaceful. It was such a great reprieve to come to after a day out wandering the streets if Lisbon. The hosts and Madalena were very responsive and attentive. We highly recommend their space and would come back when we are back in Lisbon.
Lovely place to stay, such a good location. Felt right at home and had everything we needed. Really responsive great hosts with great recommendations

Just came back from a fabulous 5 night stay at Monica & João's place. Ideal location for all the amenities and attractions, we walked lots to discover the back streets but also used the metro, buses and trams when the legs were a bit tired. The apartment looks just like the pictures and had everything you would need. It was a fantastic break and we would definitely here stay again.
Huge thanks to Madalena, her advice was invaluable!
Tutto veramente belle autentico! Si respira e si sente la vera Lisbona e lo spirito del Fado!

We had a really wonderful time here! Our friend joined us and stayed on the couch in the living room, which worked great - the space is organized in three levels, with a terrace in a courtyard and a small balcony off the kitchen - so it was possible to have quite siesta time without disturbing each other.  We spent a lot of time playing cards in the kitchen. And we were kindly welcomed by a lovely guide who showed us the landmarks to easily walk to to our apartment, which was in a magical tangle of narrow alleys, just fifteen minutes from the ocean and downtown.

My stay in Lisbon was terrific, thank you for that well located Airbnb! Not only was it the cutest, I could do (almost) everything by foot. Communication with host was great and warm. Madalena was very nice and full of valuable information about the neighborhood. Clean, luminous, all included and still on point with the Alfama charm, if I come back to Lisbon, I am not staying anywhere else!

Appartement très agréable, confortable et original. Idéal pour une personne ou un couple dynamique. Accessible à pied à 5 minutes du musée du Fado et à proximité des transports en commun. Petits commerces et distributeur de billets autour du logement, pratique. Quartier traditionnel calme, avec des caractéristiques à prendre en compte (escalier très raide et étroit pour accéder à l’appartement, ruelle en pente pour accès , plafond plutôt bas dans la salle de bain.) Merci encore à Madalena pour son accueil, ses conseils en anglais et ses attentions.
J’y reviendrai volontiers pour continuer à découvrir cette belle ville.
Super séjour chez Monico et João. Le logement est bien situé, propre, très bien agencé ! C’était parfait.
Wonderful place in Alfama, perfect for exploring Lisbon. Our hosts were wonderful and provided recommendations, along with delicious wine and pasteis de nata. We recommend.

Our stay here was absolutely amazing. The location in the center of Alfama is perfect, with tons  of things to do and see right in the area. Downtown is a short stroll away (~10 mins), making everything feel very close by. The place was beautiful and spacious with a wonderful view from the kitchen. Monica was extremely friendly, and even brought us some Pastel de Nada on our last day. Would definitely reccomend staying here!

An amazing private and cosy apartment close to everything.
Communication was spotless and helpful in every aspect and we will certainly come back again.

We had a wonderful 9 day stay after Christmas and the apartment was truly a cozy and inviting home away from home!  Larger than we expected and super clean with an amazing view of the Tagus. Everything and more was provided and this was truly a perfect place to stay to experience Alfama and Lisbon. A close walk (under 10 minutes) to Santa Apolonia train station made day trips and exploring a breeze. We found many fantastic restaurants close by and hit our favourite pastry shop for breakfast every morning about 30 seconds away (Alfama Doce) for croissants and pastel de nata. The terrace was a nice bonus. Monica was excellent to communicate with and Madalena was amazing. She checked us in and went above and beyond to answer our questions about the best way to reach various towns and to make sure we were enjoying our stay. We also really appreciated the bottle of wine and pastries to start our trip. We will definitely be recommending this spot to any friends visiting Lisbon.

Every morning was a new view from the kitchen window. Some days the river was hosted a cruise ship and others the perfect sunrise. We truly enjoyed having the back deck and listening to the bells chime from the various churches around. The host provided us with the essentials and met us at the museum so we didn't have to navigate those hills alone the first time. They have recently renovated the bathroom with a terrific shower. Obrigada!

This place is in the heart of Alfama, lots to do in the area and walking distance to many sights. For us, we had to climb stairs to get to the apartment. The apartment was clean, bed was comfortable, and bathroom was newly renovated & clean. They will support you with any questions you have throughout your stay! Madalena was super nice to us. Thanks for a great time in Lisbon!

Heerlijke ruimte, gezellig ingericht. Goede service waardoor we ook tegen middernacht in het appartement konden. En natuurlijk heerlijke pastel de nata. Fijn rustig stukje van de stad, waar je toch snel de drukte in loopt.

What a great apartment in a lovely area! Madalena was easy to contact and met us when we arrived in the neighbourhood to take us to the apartment. Instructions were clear and easy to follow, and the apartment matched the listing exactly, although it’s actually a nicer space than the photos suggest. The stairs are steep, but that adds to the overall charm as the area is very old. Easy to walk to all areas in Lisbon, and easy to get to from the airport due to their brilliant metro system. We would not hesitate to recommend this place to others. Obrigada!
fantastic! I really enjoyed my stay. The apartmentis beautiful and the location is perfect. I highly recommend.
Great place near good restaurants and public transportation

Tres bien je vous recommande vivement
L’appartement est spacieux et offre une jolie luminosité entre les différentes pièces
L’hôte était très agréable et accueillante merci pour ce séjour

What a wonderful apartment to enjoy all that Lisboa has to offer. Really close to the cruise terminal and a great base for exploring by foot or by public transport. The apartment is ultra comfortable and decorated with some lovely features. The sun terrace is perfect for enjoying the beautiful weather. Communication with Monica was excellent and the check in assistance provided by Madalena got everything off to a great start. She is a champion. Thoughtful touches including a welcome bottle of local wine and Portughese pastries made this experience one of our most enjoyable stays in a home away from home.
Joli appartement très bien placé au cœur de l'Alfama. Belle terrasse, cuisine bien équipée avec vue sur le Tage. Idéal pour découvrir Lisbonne à pied.

Cet appartement est tellement cosy et confortable. Nous avons passé un excellent séjour ! Nous nous sommes sentis comme à la maison et avons super bien dormi. La terrasse sur les toits de l'Alfama est magique. Nous avons été accueillis par le sourire et les bons conseils de Madalena ainsi que des pasteis de nata et du bon vin. L'appartement est en plein coeur de l'Alfama à quelques minutes à pied du centre, du Chateau Sao Jorge... Tout est fait pour se sentir bien ! Si nous retournons à Lisbonne, nous reviendrons évidemment dans cet appartement ! Merci encore !
Sehr schön gelegene Wohnung mit schönem Blick, steile Treppe zur Wohnung, sehr freundlicher Kontakt,

een dag vantevoren contact gekregen met madalena die ons vanaf een meeting point naar het ruime appartement bracht waar allerlei lekkers te eten en drinken klaarstond. heel gastvrij en behulpzaam. karakteristiek appartement middenin alfama. behalve dat het erg gehorig is (bovenburen die lopen) was alles top. fijn terras ook

Wir haben ein paar sehr schöne Tage in Lissabon verbracht. Die Lage der Wohnung ist super und man kann direkt vor der Haustür anfangen zu besichtigen. Trotzdem war es in der Wohnung ruhig. Und obwohl man mitten zwischen Restaurants wohnt, wird man NICHT durch nächtlichen Kneipenlärm gestört. Toll. Die Anreise mit Koffer und zu Fuß durch die kleinen Gassen ist etwas mühsam, aber das ist eben ganz typisch Lissabon. Die Wohnung ist sehr hübsch eingerichtet, wie man auf den Fotos sieht. Allerdings ist sie im Vergleich zu anderen Airbnb-Wohnungen nicht besonders sauber, wenn man zum Beispiel die Schränke dort öffnet. Auch sind einige Dinge (Schranktüren, Elektrik) schon etwas in die Jahre gekommen. Die Sauberkeit ist für uns ein Nachteil gewesen. Aber ansonsten ist es ein guter Ausgangspunkt für schöne Tage. Und vor der großen Küchentür geht morgens die Sonne auf. Schön!

We had a great stay at this apartment. The place matched the description and we were comfortable. Madelana met us at the Museum and explained everything about the apartment. We enjoyed waking up to a new cruise ship each morning which we could see from the kitchen. A bottle of wine was left for us and Madelana made a second trip up the VERY STEEP  stairs ( which we quickly learned how to navigate) to bring us pastels. Nice!  Alfama was a great location for a stay in Portugal and we found many surprises around every corner as we walked!
Very helpful hosts, late check-in was no problem. Very nice accommodation to discover Lisbon
We enjoyed staying in the wonderful apartment and Madalena who hosts the apartment is an outstanding ambassador to the neighborhood!
Wir hatten einen schönen Kurzurlaub in der Wohnung. Ideal um alle Sehenswürdigkeiten Lissabons zu erkunden, wenn man gut zu Fuss unterwegs ist.

Cute spot!!! I was on my own and felt so cozy and safe here. Monica was such a great host and came to meet me at the train station when I arrived. She was super easy to communicate with and gave me tons of recommendations while I was there! Bed is comfy, quiet place and such great lighting in the apartment. Shower is super cute and the balcony is to die for!

Beau quartier de Alfama.
Appartement sympa
Merci

A beautiful apartment - the terrace was lovely to sit and enjoy a morning coffee. We were made to feel very welcome by the hosts who were very responsive. The apartment was comfortable and spotless, and we loved the pastels on arrival! The only slight downside was that due to the construction of the buildings in the old-town, you can hear your neighbours walking around upstairs.

This apartment is a wonderful find in a beautiful, local area of Lisbon. The hosts are incredibly responsive and provided lots of helpful recommendations for us as first time Portugal visitors. Not only was the apartment perfectly clean, the bed was comfortable, there was ample space in the unit, and we got an added bonus of a welcome bottle of wine and pastries. One thing to note is that, much like the rest of Lisbon, this unit is up a fairly substantial hill, as well as a tight staircase, so packing light will help you here. Highly recommend!!
Bonne localisation, belles petites attentions et divan lit très confortable !

If you desire to stay in the Alfama this is a nice little place.  It is quirky (all the buildings are very old) and smallish (the bathroom is quite small).  It had everything we needed.  We were grateful for the AC in the bedroom.  Plenty of room in the living room for a little morning yoga.  The Wifi worked well for having video calls and whatever else.  Madalena checked us in and was very thorough, plus she brought us cheese and pastries!  :-)  There are several methods for making coffee and if you prefer - just steps to a great pastry/coffee shop.
Good location in Alfama. Nice appartment true to the description. Lovely hosts
A great hostess, a great apartment, gladly again :-)
Wir hatten einen sehr schönen Aufenthalt in dieser tollen Wohnung, die sehr portugiesisch ist.
Lovely place to stay and within walking distance of many resturnts and cafes. Has a nice little terrace as well which is enjoyable in the evening!

Appartamento in posizione centralissima nello splendido quartiere di Alfama: zona tranquilla e strategica per gli spostamenti in città.
Alloggio spazioso con comodo terrazzo. La host è stata molto disponibile, ci ha accolto a tarda ora facendoci trovare del vino e i tipici pastel de nata. Super consigliato!

Très bon séjour, l'appartement est conforme à l'annonce, très propre, calme avec vue sur le Tage et très bien situé. Très bien accueillis par Madalena, avec en prime un cadeau de bienvenue et une gentille attention le lendemain de notre arrivée! (pain et fromage apportés par Madalena).
Nous recommandons cette location!
Très bel appartement avec une vue imprenable sur le Tage depuis la cuisine. Nous avons passé un très bon séjour.

Monica was very helpful right from the beginning. Her help, Madalena, met as at the meeting point and took to the apartment. Everything was very smooth and friendly.
In the apartment was waiting for us a bottle of wine and pasteis de nata-very nice touch!
The flat had all that we needed-fully equipped kitchen, air condition in the master bedroom, nice terrace.
The location is perfect for a couple or a family (like ours:2+2). In the very Alfama, close to all the main Alfamas attractions. Be prepared to walk a lot :)
Highly recommended! The apartment and the hosts :) thanks for the lovely week in Lisbon!!
Everything was as expected & our trip went exactly as we’d imagined. This space was perfect for us & we got to enjoy the neighborhood!

je n'aurai pas assez de 1000 caractères pour dire à quel point j'ai aimé mon court séjour dans ce magnifique appartement. il est bien situé au coeur d'Alfama. Il est bien caché. Madalena nous y a bien guidée et nous a bien assistée. Tant de bon conseils et de bonnes adresses nous ont été fournie. Tant de petites attentions nous attendaient tels du vin, des tartelettes, du lait au chocolat. l'appartement était parfait pour notre famille de 4. La charmante et ensoleillée terrasse était parfaite pour se reposer, prendre un verre et faire sécher le linge. ce n'est malheureusement pas un appartement pour les gens à mobilité réduite.

Wonderfully located in the heart of Alfama. We could hear fado singing while on the terrace. Some equipments need a bit of update but overall a very good stay.
Hosts were very reactive to any question and we were picked up at the nearby fado museum to find the way easily.
Thank you for the great stay in Lisbon!

Nous avons adoré notre séjour. Belle terrasse qui en vaut le coup ! Monica et Madalena sont très accueillantes avec pleins de petites attentions. Nous recommandons définitivement! Merci et au plaisir!

This is a very cool and quirky apartment, up a super-steep set of stairs, after you traverse a couple blocks of cobblestone alleyways.  This is the Alfama neighborhood, super-cool, ancient, and a bit gritty.  Maria, the caretaker, met us at the bottom of the hill and escorted us up, telling us about the area and making suggestions for nearby attractions.  The apartment is air conditioned in the bedroom only  (very comfortable) and is oddly shaped with multiple levels, the bathroom down the hall and through the living room -- it feels like a cleverly converted attic. The protected and private porch is comfortable.  The views only barely include the water, but look out rather over rooftops and courtyards and clotheslines -- again, interesting and authentic. We wandered alleys and ate in local restaurants and found this to be delightful. The host also helped us with logistics such as luggage storage in the apartment.

Monic & Joao’s place is bigger than the photos. It is in the old part of town with wonderful old streets and buildings. There is a labyrinth of cobble stone streets all around and good restaurants. Don’t miss going to a Fado show well worth it!

Nous avons passé un séjour très agréable chez Monica et João. Madalena nous a bien accueillies, le logement était très agréable et bien placé. Nous avons apprécié les petites attentions. Nous recommandons vivement !
Fantastic apartment in an amazing neighborhood full of fun and cultural experiences.  Amazing host!  Will be back.
Alles wunderschön

We’ve just got home from a great stay here. Madalena met us to take us to the apartment which was really appreciated as it is down lots of little streets in Alfama. The apartment was lovely, in a great location. Comfy bed! Any question we had was answered promptly and with helpful answers. Really lovely stay and are sad to be home!
Definitely try out the restaurants in the nearby streets; Pateo 13 and Morgadinha da Alfama especially.

A couple of things that were difficult were that the overflowing garbage outside of the apartment was never picked up. This was not the fault of the owners. The area of this apartment is nice. Lots of hills and winding streets with some good food nearby. Good to have GPS to walk around. The shower didn’t drain well, although the water pressure and heat were excellent! They responded immediately to try to fix the draining issue. Madalena was fabulous, leaving us treats and wine. Overall a lovely time.
Loverly apartment with helpful host. Very close to some amazing places to eat and explore in a beautiful area.
We loved it. Great hosts and a great neighborhood

Our stay here was absolutely perfect, especially in early June when Lisbon is especially popular given the festivals throughout town and Alfama, especially! Their recommendations were wonderful and delicious, and it was easy to get anywhere we needed or wanted. The terrace made space for a lovely afternoon rest and wine, everything was clean and well-supplied, and the best was super comfortable. We are only sad we did not get to stay longer! Thank you!
Good stay there. The apartment is well located, ideal for exploring Lisbon on foot.

This place was perfect for what we needed. I will say it is a little bit of a hike to get into, so if you’re not completely able-bodied I would not stay here. It was clean, had a great view, and a great terrace. Madalena was lovely and made us very comfortable.

on recommande ce logement, idéal pour un séjour afin de découvrir la ville. Quartier dynamique avec tout a proximité .
logement parfait et très propre.petot plus pour la terrasse avec vue sur le tage

We were met by Madalena who walked us to our apartment. Madalena was excellent in providing us with local tips how to get around. The apartment was amazing. Exactly as the photos show. Great location. Alfama is the best place to stay. Would highly recommend this property.

Un séjour très agréable chez Monica avec notre fille de 18 mois. Tout était parfait pour notre fille (lit bébé et chaise haute). Nous avons été bien accueilli par Madalena qui s’est rendue disponible et réactive lors de notre séjour.
L’appartement est très bien placé pour visiter la ville et le quartier de l’Alfama particulièrement. Il est aussi et surtout très confortable avec une terrasse bien appréciable !
Petit bémol il y a beaucoup de marches pour monter à l’appartement donc il est préférable d’avoir un sac à dos plutôt qu’une grosse valise comme nous mais on s’est débrouillé :)
Merci pour ce séjour dans votre appartement !
We enjoyed our time at your place.  Would stay there again.  We loved the terrace.   Magdalena was great!
Very comfortable and nice place!
the terrace was lovely to sit outside, we appreciated the treats left by the host. The short internal stairs were steep.
Nice stay, very responsive hosts. Definitely a bit of a walk/hike up to the apartment so wouldn’t recommend to everybody! But overall great stay and nice quiet neighborhood.
Great place to stay for Fado music.
Tout était parfait ! Un super accueil, le logement est joli, très bien placé et fonctionnel! Nous nous sommes sentis comme à la maison!
Good location, views were excellent, comfortable bed.

A fabulous apartment in Alfama. It had everything we needed in a quiet area but with restaurants and shops very close by. We had the windows open at night in the bedroom and didn’t hear a sound from outside. There were some thoughtful treats on arrival and Magdalena gave us advice on where to go for groceries, the bus and tram. It was an easy Uber ride from the airport, around €9, but we got the metro when we returned for the journey home, having fathomed the public transport system by then! Lisbon is lovely, lots to see and do, just bring some comfy shoes, leave the heels at home! We walked almost everywhere but the buses and trams are very affordable and accessible too.
A beautiful apartment in a great location. Highly recommend.

A spacious apartment set in the Alfama district with plenty of restaurants and Fado bars to choose from. Just a few steps away from Tram 28 and a number of buses to other parts of Lisbon. We enjoyed the space and the area.

The location of this apartment is great for exploring Alfama and Lisbon. It was spotlessly clean, the bed was comfortable and we had everything we needed. The view from the kitchen is lovely and we made use of the outdoor terrace. Communication was excellent and Madalena gave us lots of useful information. As others have said, the staircase is steep and narrow but manageable.

We loved our time in this beautiful property and city. Communication was excellent with Monica and we were greeted very warmly by Madalena. We really appreciated the personal touches (the pastries were so appreciated after a long day’s travel!).
We especially enjoyed having breakfast on the lovely balcony and exploring the unique Alfama neighbourhood. Apartment is very comfortable. Great shower and lovely decor. Highly recommended! Our only complaint was that we didn’t have longer!

I had a great stay at Monica & João’s place! They as well as Madalena were highly responsive and helpful! The location was perfect! In the middle of everything great to see and do but also quiet and peaceful. We enjoyed having a glass of wine on the balcony and relaxing on the comfortable couch after long days of walking and exploring! The bed was extremely comfortable and. the water pressure was great. I would definitely return next time I’m in Lisbon!
The apartment is very spacious and comfortable. The host provided helpful recommendations and accommodated our early luggage drop off. We enjoyed our stay!
Great location (although you need to be fairly fit for all the steps & pulling your suitcase up the hill!)

The apartment was very spacious and clean and in the heart of the city, very easy to walk around to all the major sites! The views were incredibly nice as well. I would note that the stairs are steep so keep that in mind getting up to the apartment
Nous avond choisi le logement en lisant les commentaires et nous regrettons pas notre choix ! bonne localisation et logement très bien équipé. Ça été une très belle expérience.
Great stay! We really enjoyed :) Thank you!

Wir waren das 1. Mal in Lissabon und hatten eine tolle Zeit in der Wohnung.  Die Wohnung war wie beschrieben, sauber und geschmackvoll eingerichtet. Die Gegend, in der sie liegt, ist großartig. Viele sehenswerte Orte sind fußläufig zu erreichen. Wir wurden am Treffpunkt abgeholt, mit Pastel de Nata und einer Flasche Wein herzlich empfangen und mit vielen guten Tipps versorgt. Auch beim nächsten Lissabon-Trip würden wir wieder die Wohnung von Monica & Joao wählen.
Je recommande fortement l’appartement. La terrasse a été très apprécié. Madalena était très disponible.
Thanks Madalena for being flexible, professional and for providing useful and timely information.
The place was great! Clean, good location, very helpful hosts, and a good neighborhood to explore.

The apartment was walking distance to many Alfama sites. It is a great neighborhood.  the apartment was nicely stocked and furnished with everything we needed.  Many markets and restaurants were nearby.   we greatly appreciated the bottle of wine and a local pastry that was left for us.  it was a nice personal touch.  The host let us know she was always available if we needed anything.  The stairs to the apartment were manageable but quite narrow and steep.   We would definitely stay here again
Lovely apartment in the charming Alfama neighborhood of Lisbon. Plenty of space, a terrace, and the complimentary wine/pastel de nata were appreciated.

We loved this house, and we will stay here again next time we visit Lisbon. The inside looks exactly like the photos, and the host met us and walked us to the apartment even though we had a very late flight. 10/10.

We absolutely loved staying in Alfama and this place was the perfect spot. It was so unique for us and we loved exploring the neighborhood. The place was comfortable and tidy. We had some great lunches out on the patio as well.
Hosts were responsive and flexible throughout our stay. No complaints at all!

Visiting Lisbon for the first time we were blown away with how charming and beautiful Alfama is. As the second oldest neighborhood in all of Europe you'll enjoy walking through winding alleys and staircases in it's original architecture. When we arrived we noticed that the apartment is a large one bedroom with a big kitchen overlooking the sea. It even has a beautiful outdoor space where you can have dinner and wine which we'd like to use next time we visit. They even left us a bottle of wine and two pastel de nata to get our trip started. It's centrally located and only a 20 minute walk from downtown Lisbon. For sure on my short list of places to stay in Lisbon!
This place is a great find. Situated in a very unique and beautiful neighborhood. Wish we could have stayed longer to explore more of Lisbon.

A delightful apartment in one of the most charming neighborhoods in Europe.  Stairs rather steep so would not be ideal for the elderl, but in every other respect this is a perfect spot to spend a stay in Lisbon. We’ll definitely want to come back.
