La situación ideal! En el barrio más único y especial de Lisboa. La casa súper cómoda , tiene todo lo que necesitas para sentirte como en casa. Tuvieron detalles bonitos como dejarnos una botella de vino y unas natas. La ducha con bastante presión, el wifi funciona bien. Perfecta elección!
Great spot in Lisbon. Easy to walk to many places. Great recommendations! Comfortable bed!
Perfect place to stay in the Alfama neighborhood! The host was incredibly helpful and generous and the apartment was spotless, well-furnished, and comfortable.
appartement très agréable, bien situé,calme , grand, avec beaucoup de charme une vue superbe

My wife and I loved this flat. Right in the heart of Alfama, there is no shortage of great food and wine in walking distance. An easy 0.4-0.5 mile walk to metro stops and multiple bus stations, this is an excellent base of operations to explore Lisbon.

Love this apartment and location. Check in was easy and they even let us drop our bags a few hours early, which made for an easy day exploring Lisbon.  This is in an extremely convenient location near the castle and many lookout spots plus in the evenings the Fado all over nearby is incredible.  What a cool experience.

We stayed at Monica’s apartment for 5 nights. Monica is really friendly and give us ideas to make our trip more fruitful. And we felt here like home because of the warm welcome. It was a perfect apartment for holiday or vacation. Very nice location, at the Alfama district. All the living stuffs you could find here, microwave, dish washer, washing machine, oven, refrigerator, hair dryer, etc… What you need to do is just enjoy your trip. If we have a chance to go back sometime in the future, we’ll definitely to do so!! Thanks for this wonderful apartment :)

We very much enjoyed our stay here. The place was quiet, clean, and very spacious. The hosts provided recommendations regarding things to do and places to eat, which we appreciated. I would stay here again.
Nice place to stay, but you need to be okay with stairs.

O apartamento é muito bem equipado e decorado. A receptividade dos anfitriões é excelente, eles deixaram vários presentes de recepção para nós. Uma ponto de atenção importante é que o local não é apropriado para pessoas com dificuldade de locomoção.

Het appartement is prima, zeker ook het terras. De locatie is geweldig.
De trap is erg steil. In huis moet er hier en daar wel wat geklust worden.
Magdalena is heel aardig en behulpzaam.
Appartement très bien situé dans le quartier d'Alfama. Très propre et très joli ! L'accueil de Madalena était parfait.

We had stayed in Monica's apartment before and the apartment is just a great as I remembered. It is very clean and one of the best equipped apartments we have stayed in. It had everything you could possibly need. The shower pressure was brilliant. The apartment is very quirky. I love the different levels. The balcony was a real bonus. The hosts are great to communicate with and check in was stress free. And the treats were a lovely touch.  The apartment is in a lovely area, very quiet with plenty of restaurants, shops, cafes etc nearby. The steps up into the apartment are very steep so maybe not suitable for any one with mobility issues. But I would definately stay here again if we are back in Lisbon.

What a wonderful stay! The location is fabulous in the Alfama district. Great little coffee shops and bars right outside your door. The place was clean, comfortable and the bed is just right. Would recommend as long as you are able to navigate steep stairs and are not hauling a lot of luggage.  Many thanks to Madalena who’s helped us settle in.

What a great location and lovely place!  Madalena did a fantastic job of showing me around and giving me tips. Also incredibly responsive. The patio is lovely! Would definitely recommend and stay again.

What a lovely apartment right in the heart of the Alfarma district. It really feels like you are living with the locals. Communication with Monica & Joao was great, lots of useful tips and recommendations in advance of our stay. We met Madalena by the Fado Museum in order to get to the apartment. She was full of local knowledge and couldn't do enough for us. Location is an easy walk to local transport links but equally there is so much to explore with all the lanes around the apartment. We loved it here and will be recommending to friends and families!

Wonderful stay, great location, view, amenities, and very clean.  We had a wonderful time exploring the area.  Communication and information provided was great.  You cannot go far without finding something to do.  Would highly recommend.
Great place to stay. Perfect location and super helpful hosts.
Amazing neighborhood! Very steep stairs but it makes for a good workout after all the great food. Bed was super comfortable! Nice terrace and views fantastic.

An authentic fully equipped apartment bang in the wonderful district of Alfama. If you are looking for a base to stay then this works really well and allows you to walk no more than 15 mins to downtown Lisbon. The local area is teeming with bars and restaurants. We wanted to try out a Fado experience and the Parreirinha de Alfama 1939 is only 5 mins walk and a really good night out.
This apartment is a 10 min walk from Santa Apolonia stn.
Het appartement is echt geweldig. Alles wat hiervoor al geschrevenis, klopt exact.
Buena ubicacion y limpieza de la casa, la persona anfitrirona estuvo en el punto a tiempo para enseñarnos el lugar, cerca de los lugares para visitar
Great place to stay! Very close to all Lisbon has to offer. It was quiet and comfy. The patio is a huge bonus and we would absolutely stay again next time we are visiting Lisbon!

Highly recommend this place! Madalena took care of me the entire time by meeting me at the local train station and walking me to the apartment. She cleaned everything and left me such a sweet treat when I came back to the place. Very communicative and the apartment is beautiful with a gorgeous view in the heart of Alfama. Only thing to be aware of is that this is located in between many hills and has a narrow staircase up to the apartment so keep that in mind that you’ll have to carry it if you have heavy luggage. Great stay!

Nous avons apprécié notre séjour de 7 nuits dans l’appartement de Monica et João. Nous avons été bien accueilli par Madalena  qui est venu nous chercher au Musée du Fado et nous a amené à l’appartement. Tout au long de notre séjour, elle a répondu très rapidement à nos questions. L’appartement est situé dans une petite rue non-accessible en voiture. Il est au deuxième étage. Il est  conforme aux photos que l’on retrouve dans l’annonce. Nous avons apprécié le point de vue sur le Tage, la lumière est très belle le matin. Nous avons utilisé le patio pour le dîner où nous avons pu faire des grillades tout en appréciant la musique et les chants de Fado. La chambre est isolée et climatisée. Cela nous a permis de bien dormir la nuit et reprendre nos forces après avoir tant marché dans les rues de Lisbonne. Malgré que ce soit un quartier populaire pour ses restaurants, les soirées se terminent assez tôt et tout redevient calme rapidement. Nous recommandons avec plaisir cet appartement.

Super séjour rien à dire. Si nous revenons sur Lisbonne, nous espérons que le logement sera à nouveau libre.
Cordialement
Rameau Morgane

THIS IS THE PLACE TO BE! The Alfama neighborhood is not only incredibly rich in its deep history but also arguably boasts the BEST FOOD IN TOWN! The area is absolutely buzzing with little restaurants everywhere and you are just steps from it all at this perfect home base. You can walk out your door in any direction and find charming cafes and more in every direction. The Airbnb is so spacious, bright, clean, comfortable, and is the best place to be to see Lisbon. The patio is a beautiful spot to relax outside and the kitchen nook with its view to the river is so peaceful. The hosts also left some very nice welcome gifts which was such a sweet touch! Highly recommend!
We had a great stay! The steps leading to the apartment are steep, as others have mentioned. The patio is great!

L'appartement de Mini-cassette et Joao est très bien situé. Il est confortable et bien aménagé avec une belle décoration. Jolie vue sur le Tage et agréable terrasse.  Un accueil sympathique et attentif. Une très bonne adresse à Lisbonne.
Amazing stay!
Great stay, beautiful area. Steep stairs so I would not recommend to anybody with walking difficulties.
Appartement bien équipé et agréable, très bien situé dans le quartier de l'Alfama, séjour dépaysant et haut en couleur.

Très bien située en plein cœur de Lisbonne le logement est en plus hyper calme
Très clair propre et chaleureux
Très bon acceuil
Je recommande 😊

We had a very nice stay here! We were met by Madalena who gave us a lot of tips on what to do, answered any question we had, and was very helpful. The apartment was very nice with a lovely terrace and nice bed. The steps to the apartment is very steep and it was a bit dirty some places in the kitchen and bathroom. Overall, a very good stay, I recommend it!
Amazing apartment in a great location!

Très belle appartement placé idéalement car toutes les commodités sont a proximité. Accueil et conseil super. Situation très calme permettant de bien dormir.
On reviendra sans problème.
We enjoyed our stay!

This was our first time in Lisbon and Monica’s apartment was the perfect place to get around, the location can’t be beat, right at heart of the Alfama district. It’s tastefully decorated and has everything you need. Definitely recommended, can’t wait to come back! Obrigada, até a próxima!

Monica and João’s apartment was a great place to stay in the Alfama district. So close to all the action but tucked away so it was quiet and peaceful. Very easy to walk to many parts of Lisbon, and the tram and metro are both close by. Great communication and helpful tips. We would definitely stay there again.
We really enjoyed our stay at Monica’s flat in Alfama. The location was very central and allows to visit many places of interest. The flat itself was clean, bright and very comfortable.

Just as you see in photos. We loved hearing the music from the patio, laundry available and watching the ships come in to dock. There are steep steps as explained so beware if this will be a problem. The bed was good and the shower was great but small. If you want Alfama then this is your place.

What a gem of a place! I was only in Lisbon for one night for a long layover but I'll absolutely be back soon and can hopefully stay again in this apartment. It was very comfortable and clean and has everything you could need. The patio was the biggest selling point -- I sat outside for hours just enjoying the sounds of the city! The other big plus for me is that they kindly let me drop off my stuff and check in earlier than expected. The check-in process was very smooth and personal, which I really appreciated. The stairs to the apartment are indeed steep, as mentioned in other reviews, but they're fine if you move carefully. Overall, this is one of the best airbnbs I have ever stayed in!
Beautiful appartment in the centre of the historic town. Perfect location for 2 people, nice interieur, fully equipped kitchen, awesome terrace! Super located to explore Lisbon!!

This was a nice little apartment that was centrally located. Lots of places to eat or grab a drink in the area or just wander around and take in the sights. The terrace was super nice to relax on in the evenings with some wine. We would definitely stay here again!

Great place if your are looking to experience the Alfama area. Very simple and has all that you would need. The stairs are quite steep but easy to manage as long as you don’t have any mobility issues. The outdoor terrace is a bonus and you can enjoy the surroundings and nightlife. We loved our stay! Being in the heart of the Alfama neighborhood with all its alleys and charm was truly special. We felt like locals while staying here. Just a short walk to Miradouro de Santa Luzia and Miradouro de Portas do Sol with their amazing views was such a treat. Btw, there's a great brunch place nearby called Augusto Lisboa that we highly recommend! The airbnb has a lovely view of the ocean and a lovely terrace. Definitely keep in mind the steep and narrow stairs to get up to the apartment. They are extremely narrow and almost vertical, bringing our suitcases up was a workout! But we did not mind at all, it honestly just adds to the charm. There were 2 other doors as we walked up the stairs which we learned afterwards are other rentals (unclear if from same host or not). This apartment is the last one at the top of the stairs. The layout of this place is interesting. The entrance door opens to a small hallway with the bedroom being adjacent. To the left of the little hallway there's the kitchen (the glass door offerring the ocean views is in the kitchen), and straight up from the hallway, down a few steps, there's the living room with a door leading to the terrace. The bathroom is in the living room so you gotta walk a bit and go down the steps to go from the bedroom to the bathroom. Mind you, it's a small place, so it was no big deal. On our first night there were guests in the other rentals that left really early in the morning. The sounds coming from the stairs as they carried their luggage and talked went straight into the bedroom so be sure to close the bedroom door at night. Might want to bring earplugs just to be prepared. The second night it was absolutely quiet the whole time so it will just depend if there are guests in the other rooms and how loud they are while getting in and out of their apartments. Sound travels easily so be considerate yourself. The lady who cleans the place met us at the Fado Museum to show us the way to the apartment and let us store our luggage prior to check-in while she cleaned, which we appreciated. The place was very clean and tidy when we finally checked-in. We were surprised by a complimentary bottle of wine (plus 2 other bottles available for purchase) and two complimentary pastel de nata... they were delicious! Basic utensils, some milk, complimentary soda, and espresso maker were also available. I'm a big coffee drinker but I like milky coffee (no milk steamer) so I did not use the espresso maker but instead indulged in the many coffee shops that are within walking distance. There's also a dishwasher and washing machine which was great! Another thing to keep in mind is that the hot water in the shower runs out! Be sure to take quick showers. The shower was small but had nice water pressure. Overall, we would most definitely stay here again. You will not regret staying in this neighborhood, it is such a charming place and 100% our favorite place that we visited in Lisbon. We loved our stay. Thank you, Monica!

We cannot recommend highly enough!

Our flight was delayed by 24 hours and we arrived on New Year's Day.  Not only did the hosts agree to meet us early on January 1st, they also shopped for us so we would have food and made sure we felt right at home.  The place is also lovely and centrally located.  Definitely a great place to stay!

The apartment is very clean and comfortable with great views. It is well situated for exploring the Alfama. Also, João is a wonderful host who spent time sharing suggestions with us to make sure we enjoyed our stay. We wished we could’ve stayed longer.

This place is great.  The pictures are accurate and the apartment is very clean.  We were not able to enjoy the patio as much as we would have liked due to rain, but it was nice to have a place to step outside.  Joao is a great host.  He greeted us at the Fado Museum and escorted us to the apartment.  He sat with us for 30+ minutes giving us suggestions for our visit. The stairs are step, but manageable.  The area is very quiet.  The #23 stops at the top of a hill and you can walk down to the apartment.  Use Salsa's Restaurant as the address to call an Uber for pick up.

Monica and Joao's place is great!  It is the perfect size for a couple or a small family.  Joao was very accommodating about meeting us when we arrived and took plenty of time to provide information about the area.  Their place was very clean and we really appreciated having some coffee, tea, etc to get us started.  Great hosts, great location, great space.

Great apartment! I travel a lot, and I Airbnb all the time. Monica & João’s place was fantastic. The space was larger than we expected and very well set up. We had everything we needed. It isn't often that when traveling in Europe there are 2 pillows for each person but we were so happy to find that this was the case here- this may seem like a small detail but it made all the difference for me (a bad sleeper).  There were snacks, wine and cold water waiting for us which was a very nice welcome. We met the host at the bottom of the hill as the place is a bit hard to find the first time you try. He walked us to the apartment and spend some time with us telling us where to visit, gave us some great restaurant and bar tips. The neighborhood is wonderful. Old, quaint winding streets, set in the hills as is all of Lisbon, but very charming. We loved our stay and highly recommend renting this spot.

Joao's place was absolutely perfect. He gave lots of great recommendations and bought us the yummiest nata de lisboa. The location couldn't have been better. Very charming with fado all around and a spacious roof terrace to relax. And the communication with Joao went very smoothly.
Place is awesome! Cool and very old neighborhood. Joao was attentive and gave us great tips. Would stay again.

Our stay in this lovely apartment in Alfama was perfect. The apartment was clean, had great amenities, and you can’t beat sitting on the terrace looking up at the Portuguese sky with a glass of wine! Joao was so incredibly helpful and took the time to sit down with us when we arrived to map out some of his favorite spots. We had some of our best meals in Lisbon based on his recommendations! Would stay again in a heartbeat!

Great location! Directions to meet were perfect! We were greeted with a feast! All the small added touches make it so comfortable and great! Can’t wait to visit again. We easily felt that we were immersed in the culture and neighborhood.

Monica and Joao’s place was absolutely cozy cute and perfect! Super spacious for a couple to stay and the view was beautiful! There’s a patio where you can sit and have drinks as well. He had a bottle of wine and the Lisbon tart as a welcoming gift. I will definitely be back to stay at his flat.
logement impeccable très bien situé
We had an excellent stay at this apartment. João was incredibly hospitable, friendly, and genuinely interested in ensuring we had a great stay not only in the apartment but also in Lisbon.

This is it. Everything we were looking for, location, value, view and great space. And it went way beyond expectations.
João met us at a nearby square to walk us up. He has amazing tips: tart shops, grocery stores, bars, restaurant, whatever you’re looking for, João has an answer.
The photos of the apartment on this post is exactly what it looks like and the views are as beautiful as they seem. It’s a quick walk to the main attractions and subways, but never too touristy around these alleys.
For us this was beyond perfect
Adorable! Be sure to try the nearby bakery - Pastelaria Alfama Doce - delicious and so closeby!
Logement bien situé avec tout ce qu’il faut pour rendre le séjour agréable.

This is a great apartment for 2 people, quirky, clean and well situated with all the amenities you need. The little touches of a bottle of wine, coffee and milk were very welcome.  Check in/out was very easy. Joao was a great host, very down to earth and made us feel really welcome and gave us some great hints and tips.  I would highly recommend.
A hidden gem

It is actually very difficult to review perfection! We loved every moment of our trip to Lisbon. Meeting Joao on Friday evening was so wonderful  - he shopped for us, gave us a HUGE amount of time, detailing what to do, where to eat and drink and welcoming us to the beautiful apartment in gorgeous, quirky Alfama. The recommendations he gave were fabulous- my best tips... take all Joao's advice 👍👍 We GENUINELY can fault nothing - we cannot recommend this apartment highly enough. Joao...you are a gentleman and we look forward to our next visit already xxx

Wonderful stay in this authentic, spacious, clean home! Lots of tour tips from João. Location was great!
All amenities we needed in the home, generous welcome goodies from the hosts, everything else right outside our door!
Thank you!!

What a perfect place to stay while visiting Lisbon! Just in the central area of the old city, the quite and elegant apartment has everything you will need for a pleasant, comfortable stay. The kitchen balcony looks out over the sea, while the living room has another larger balcony perfect for breakfast or dining.
And the hosts were delightful, accommodating me with grace at very short notice. I highly recommend it!

A lovely apartment situated in the heart of the Alfama. The apartment had everything we needed and has views over the rooftops to the river as well as a sunny terrace. A perfect location for a holiday in Lisbon.

Beautiful apartment in a lovely neighborhood! The terrace is better than we could've imagined. We really enjoyed watching the sunset and listening to the strains of Fado music from below. Jaoa responded promptly to our questions beforehand and was helpful at check in.
Joao is a very nice host, prepared some presents for us and provided a lot of useful information. We spent two wonderful days in Lisbon. It will come again.

Appartement super bien situé et malgré tout très au calme. La terrasse est très agréable pour boire un verre, offert par notre hôte :-) Joao a pris le temps de nous conseiller en fonction de la durée de notre séjour et nous n'avons pas été déçu !! L'appartement est très propre, très agréable et bien équipé, nous serions bien resté plus longtemps...
Very nice apartment, João was very friendly and helpful. The location is great. We would definitely come back and recommend to others.

We had a great stay in Alfama at Monica and Joao’s apartment. Joao welcomed us and spent time sharing his local knowledge and providing excellent tips on where to go, and the best places to eat and drink.
The apartment was clean and had everything we needed including air conditioning in the bedroom and a great outdoor terrace.
I would definitely stay there again and thoroughly recommend this apartment.

Diese Wohnung im Herzen der Alfama ist einfach perfekt! Die Lage ist super um alles fußläufig zu erreichen. Ein Highlight sind der Blick auf den Tejo und die große Terrasse. Nur zu empfehlen, wir kommen gerne wieder!

We really enjoyed our stay at your place!! It is perfectly located in the Alfama district and very central for good restaurants nearby. We really enjoyed the terrace! Madalena was very informative and helpful and we really appreciated the food items you left for us which was a really nice touch to make us feel welcome!

We had a wonderful stay in Monica and Joao's apartment. It is in a perfect location to explore the city and is beautifully decorated. So nice to have the outside balcony space as well! Joao met us (messages and instructions were really clear) and took us to the apartment and gave us some wonderful recommendations for our stay. He also left some extra local touches for us to try (pastel de nata, cheese etc) which was really thoughtful and a great introduction when we arrived! I would definitely stay here again and would recommend to anyone!

C’est dans ce appartement que vous devez séjourner si vous désirez visiter Lisbonne. João est un hôte très attentionné qui ne manque pas de vous préparer des attentions.
Que dire de l’appartement situé au cœur de l’Alfama. Il est vraiment magnifique avec sa terrasse qui permet de se détendre après une journée de visite.

Stylish apartment in the heart of Alfama, within easy walking distance of a number of attractions and good bars and restaurants. You can’t park outside so João (lovely) met us and helped us find the local car park (around a 10-min walk away, 8 euros a day). He also helped us find the apartment - not so easy - and with our luggage. We loved our stay there but a note of caution - it’s a steeply located place with very steep stairs once you get there!

Super appartement situé dans l'Alfama et à proximité du centre. Nous avons adoré arpenter les rues du quartier en journée comme en soirée et nous laissé surprendre par la beauté des lieux.
De par son lieux, je ne peux que conseiller l'appartement de Joao qui vous mets à moins de 10 min à pieds des principaux transports en commun.
L'appartement est très fonctionnel et moderne, nous avons apprécié prendre l'apéro sur la terrasse.
Enfin Joao est quelqu'un de très disponible, avenant et surtout arrangeant : il a été super avec nos filles à notre arrivée en leur proposant leur goûter et nous a montré les bons plans à faire avec des enfants durant notre séjour !

I'd highly recommend booking this amazing apartment for your stay in Lisbon. Perfect location in the winding streets of Alfama; with restaurants and shops, an amazing bakery a stones throw away and a popular viewing spot also close by. A short walk takes you down town to the busy streets with bars and more restaurants. Communication was first class throughout and João took time to explain the city, with some recommendations too. This helped us get our bearings in the city from the start. Yes, the stairs leading up to the apartment are very steep so if you have mobility issues, it is worth considering - however, all in all, do not let it put you off booking here as it's the perfect base and Alfama was our favourite neighbourhood too. Oh, almost forgot about the terrace. Just perfect. An afternoon sun trap for chilling, and a BBQ :)

Gute und ruhige Lage, toller Ausblick, klasse Einrichtung, große Terrasse
Drei Minuten Fußweg zum Mirador, Blick von der Küche auf den Tejo und eine großzügige Terrasse zur anderen Seite der Wohnung - hier wohnt man einfach gern. Ein Bäcker fürs Frühstück ist um die Ecke, mehrere Restaurants und ein kleiner Supermercado ebenso. Die Wohnung liegt in einer kleinen Gasse in der zweiten Etage, im Fußgängerbereich. Mit dem Taxi kann man nicht direkt vorfahren, aber die 150 zur Straße am Museo do Fado schafft man sicher auch mit viel Gepäck gut.
João ist ein sehr freundlicher und zuvorkommender Gastgeber.

This apartment, this place. The best of Alfama. You definitely need to visit here and stay in the most beautiful neighborhood of Lissabon called Alfama.
Joao was very kind and took the time to explain us everything and tell us a lot of Lissabon.
We will definitely come back to Lissabon, very beautiful city and we will stay at this place again.

Appartement parfait, bien situé dans l’ancien quartier pittoresque d’alafama. Calme (on entend un peu les bruits de pas des voisins) et bien équipé!
Joao est tres accueillant!

Wow! I could not recommend staying here enough. Not only was the apartment beautiful, spacious and clean, but João made us feel welcome the moment we arrived. He met up with us prior to our checkin to make sure we could find the place and offered us a quick tour of our neighborhood. He introduced us to the best cafe (we traveled around Portugal and still felt this was the best), told us about his favorite spots and the history of Alfama. We only had moments with him and felt like old friends immediately. We even fell asleep to the beautiful sounds of Fado coming through our windows at night. It couldn't have been a better way to start our Honeymoon in Portugal.

It was a very beautiful, stylish and charming Apartment in almafa a beautiful Part of Lisboa. João gave us many great tips what to do and where to eat. Also the terrace has a nice view over the city you can even see the sea. It was a amazing stay. Thank you! 🌞

Hard to beat the views and location. Joao set us up quite nicely to enjoy our stay in Alfama - and was extremely attentive to our needs given that we are traveling with a little one. Nice local touches and the terrace make this feel like home. Our only regret wasn’t staying at least a day longer.
We love this place. Stayed here twice. Perfect place for us.

Monica & João’s apartment is an absolute gem. It is nestled in the beautiful Alfama district. We were traveling with our 6 month old son, and João met us near our car and helped us with our luggage. He was part host, part tour guide as we wove through the cobbled streets. He stopped at a local pastelaria and picked us up treats for the apartment. He even carried our enormous luggage up the super steep and narrow staircase up to the apartment. Staples awaited us in the kitchen, such as wine, water, milk, coffee etc. The space is beautifully decorated and very family friendly (once up the stairs). Our son went to bed early, but we were still able to enjoy the sounds of fado as we relaxed on the terrace. We can not recommend this Airbnb enough!
Excellent clean apartment. Wow! Great view! Would love to come back someday! Special thanks for the treats you left!

This host really looks after their guests! Lots of friendly advice and local tips, great apartment with everything you need, on a quiet Alfama street. Joao picked us up and even bough us breakfast for the next morning. Comfortable bed, air-condition, kitchen with a view and spacious terrace. Really recommended for a fantastic stay in Lisboa. Thank you so much :)

Great place, centrally located, and charming hosts! Can’t get to it by car so a little walk up a mild hill that Joao walked us too. He’s fantastic and lovely little touches like leaving some wine and custard tarts went a long way. Great place and a perfect place to call home when you visit this lovely city.
João and Monica’s apartment is the perfect place for a trip to Lisboa! They’re great hosts, we even had lunch with João and some of his friends. Location is also great!

Joao was so kind, meeting us from a nearby landmark and directing us to the property. He provided us with a few local treats and took the time to sit with us to show us a map of the local area and key points of interest. He could not have done more for us and communication during, before and after our stay was perfect. We didn’t meet Monica but I’m sure she’s just as lovely!
Beautiful accommodation, gorgeous terrace to catch some sun between sightseeing and very clean. Location was in the old part of town which we actually preferred to the main part of the city. Couldn’t fault this place!

Great apartment, Great location, Great communication and tips from Joao on arrival. We especially appreciated the welcome gifts (wine, bread, cheese, fruit, pastries etc) that greeted us. Little touches make all the difference :)  Thank you Joao

My wife gave me a four-day trip to Lisbon as a gift and we arrived with a nine-month-old baby. We were warmly welcomed by a friend of Monica & Joao named Madalena. She collected us at the Fado Museum and accompanied us to our apartment. On the way she already gave us some valuable tips. Everything was well prepared (baby cot, baby chair etc.). As a small welcome present we got fresh pasteis, a bottle of wine and cool drinks. We were very happy about that.

The apartment was super clean, neat and equipped with everything you need. From the kitchen you have a great view over the old town of Alfama and the Tejo. There is a nice terrace with a charcoal grill (even charcoal was provided). All in all we felt very comfortable there during our trip and can recommend the apartment without restrictions. Many thanks to Monica, Joao and Madalena.
Great place great host👍🏻

Great flat direct in the heart if Alfama. Easy to find and perfect to start exploring Lisbon!
The flat offers all you can ask for, plus a beautiful terrace and stunning views over the roofs of Lisbon.
João has been really helpful to show the best places in the neighborhood and was always easy to reach.
We can only recommend to stay there anytime.
Thanks and all the best

Authentic old town experience.  Lovely views from the kitchen and the terrace.  As others noted, the steps to the apartment are steep and shallow.  Airport pick up by Joao a huge plus and well worth the cost.  We walked to everything.  The Portuguese people are very friendly and always helpful to visitors.

Joao y Mónica son unos anfitriones espectaculares. El apartamento es muy céntrico ubicado en el barrio pintoresco de Alfama un lugar maravilloso con mucha personalidad. Nos sentimos cómodos con la comunicación que obtuvimos y el apartamento es mucho mejor de lo que se ve en fotos.

Highly recommend this amazing place! Excellent location in the Alfama district. Joao was an amazing host - met us for check in and was very helpful with explaining the city and where to go. Beautiful space. Thank you for a great stay! :)

Pour faire court : je ne me suis jamais sentie aussi bien dans une location AirBnB. João était super, nous a donné des conseils de visite et nous a accueilli avec des touches d'attention comme jamais ! L'appartement est propre, on s'y sent comme à la maison, avec des équipements pour enfant (lit et chaise haute), la vue de la cuisine le matin est juste sublime, la terrasse géniale pour discuter le soir... Le quartier de l'Alfama est sur une colline donc c'est toute une aventure d'arriver à l'appartement (qui est au second étage avec des marches un peu étroites) mais ça en vaut tellement la chandelle... Si c'était à refaire je ne changerais rien ! Un véritable rêve. Merci !

If you want an authentic experience in Lisbon this is the place to choose. The apartment is quirky, stylish and a joy to stay in. Monica and João are the perfect hosts. Communication was easy and João met us as planned. The wine and pastries were very much appreciated. The terrace is a great bonus and the view from the kitchen over the river kept us entertained watching the cruise ships docking. Everything is within walking distance of the apartment. We highly recommend this apartment.
Adresse à ne pas manquer emplacement super, appartement tres sympa et une magnifique terrasse. Joao est un hôte d une infime gentillesse.

This apartment is ideal if your are looking to experience the charm of Alfama, the place itself is very quaint and has a lovely outdoor terrace which can be used to entertain - not to mention the views.
João was a lovely host, he met me in person and allowed me to check in earlier with my luggage - would highly recommend to anyone traveling to Lisbon.
Thank you once again João!

This apartment is even nicer than it looks in pictures. The view is fantastic and Joao was the most helpful host we have ever experienced. He was so friendly and helped us learn how to get around.
I would highly recommend booking this property if you are capable of climbing stairs and hills of cobblestone. If you can avoid bringing a roller bag, you will be glad you did. There is a fun restaurant with great fado music just a few steps away.

I cannot say enough wonderful things about Monica and Joao place. Joao meet us to take us to their wonderful flat. The photo didn’t do it justice. It was perfect in every way. Location is amazing if you want to stay in Alfama. An excellent bakery around the corner, short walk to the city centre and what made this AirBnB even more amazing was that Joao actually sat and told us many recommendations that I think would be missed if you didn’t talk to a local. Plus his information made our day trips simple as we knew exactly where to go without google.
The flat is clean, cosy and just beautifully decorated. I would stay there again and I would definitely recommend it to friends and family. It had everything you could need including the fruit, pastries, drinks and wine left for us as a welcome gift. Thank you so much for your hospitality.

Excellent séjour chez Monica et Joâo !
Le logement est idéalement placé en plein cœur de l ‘Alfama.
Tout y est impeccable et quel bonheur de profiter de la terrasse !
Joâo nous a parfaitement accueilli et nous a donné beaucoup d informations sur Lisbonne.
Nous reviendrons avec beaucoup de plaisir !

Fantastic trip and we strongly recommend joao and Monica.
Very beautiful city, service and reception on top.
You want regret it.
10/10

Tout y est , l'accueil, la disponibilité, l'humour et les bons conseils ;-)  l'emplacement au cœur de ce quartier typique, le confort, la déco, la propreté, la grande terrasse pour profiter de la fraicheur matinale… Encore merci !
This is a wonderful place to stay. The location, apartment, views  and facilities are very good. We given great local advice by João and made to feel welcome in this lovely city.

Die Unterkunft ist sauber und entspricht den Fotos im vollen Umfang. Für zwei Personen ist mehr als reichlich Platz vorhanden und die Küche bietet alles, was man für einen Urlaub benötigt. Zur Begrüßung gab es ein wenig Obst, Gebäck und eine leckere Flasche Wein. João hat uns tolle Tipps gegeben. Die Wohnung war sauber und wir haben morgens den Ausblick aus der Küche auf das Wasser genossen. Der „Aufstieg“ abends nach einem langen Fußmarsch durch die Stadt war recht abenteuerlich, aber das bringt die Lage in der Altstadt mit sich. Wir sind ohne Auto super klar gekommen und konnten alles mögliche erlaufen. Auf jeden Fall eine Empfehlung im schönen Lissabon.
Joao is a lovely person and the apartment is so beautiful. Thanks a lot.
Tolle Wohnung mitten in der Altstadt und super Tipps.

We had a wonderful time. The location is perfect for exploring the Alfama-- lots of great places to eat and easy to walk to the big view points. The terrace and kitchen window were lovely. The steps up to the apartment are quite steep, but we were able to navigate them with our 14 month old in arms.

What a fantastic place and hosts! The location is great, very idilic views and in easy walking distance of many attractions. João gave us some fantastic tips when he picked us up for check in. Unfortunately we didn't have enough time to do/see them all so we'll have to come back.
The place has everything you could possibly need, including some thoughtful amenities left by the hosts. I couldn't recommend this place more and will definitely come back!

It felt like I was being welcomed by family. João patiently took the time to give us so many wonderful suggestions. The ones we had time to follow turned out to be spot on perfect. I liked the different levels in the apartment, since it seemed like I was constantly discovering a new area to enjoy. The bed was super comfortable. The place is light and airy, and it seemed like every detail was well thought out and every need was covered. There was even wine, coffee and milk, and a couple other things in the fridge. The Wi-Fi worked perfectly in the downstairs areas.

Great location and view, but travelers should be aware of the the narrow, steep staircase to the unit. Joao and Monica were very responsive and provided many helpful suggestions for things to do and places to visit in Lisbon. We’d definitely stay here again.

Wonderful light and very beautiful apartment with perfect location. Owners quickly answer and do everything in order that to guests it was good. All photos are true. Very purely. The view from kitchen on roofs and the river tremendous, and a terrace disposes to rest. We advise all and we will return. Thank you, Monica & João!
*****
Чудесная светлая и очень красивая квартира с прекрасным расположением. Хозяева быстро отвечают и делают всё для того, чтобы гостям было хорошо. Все фото соответствуют действительности. Очень чисто. Вид из кухни на крыши и реку потрясающий, а терраса располагает к отдыху. Всем советуем и сами вернемся. Спасибо вам, Моника и Жоао!

We can't thank João enough for the hospitality. We met João at the museum and showed us where the apartment was but along the way he pointed out where the bakery, shop and fish shop was. We really appreciated the touches he left in apartment. João sat down with us when we got to the apartment and showed us on a map the best places to go and see and also to eat. The fish restaurant he recommended was so good we eat there twice!  The apartment itself was beautiful. It had everything you could need, lovely touches and very clean. Pictures dont do it justice. We loved lisbon my only complaint is that I wished I had been able to stay longer. I will definitely be back to lisbon and will definitely stay in João apartment again. He is one of he best hosts I have come across! Goes above and beyond. Thanks João
Alfama is an incredible neighborhood and the best possible spot for exploring Lisbon. Monica & João gave us a great orientation to the city and helped us feel settled in. We would definitely go back.

Adorable apartment in the middle of the Alfama maze. Looked just like the pictures with spectacular views out of the kitchen and outdoor patio. This is in the oldest part of Lisbon and therefore the most difficult to access due to the hills, cobblestone alleys and lack of car entrances to the streets. We had backpacks and were able to trek up to it easily but I would not recommend bringing large, rolling suitcases! (I wouldn’t recommend those anywhere in Europe actually!) In Europe, it’s a bit different from the states - the hosts meet you and escort you into the rental, as opposed to in the US where most Air Bnbs just have a lockbox and a code to enter. The host sat down with us once he let us in and showed us the sights of Lisbon on a map. Great spot for the middle of our vacation to do some laundry and cook some food to save money! We visited the Copenhagen Coffee Bar up the street daily. It’s the hipster coffee joint in the neighborhood with cold brew, avocado toast and quinoa salad. It’s a cozy and light-filled space and we highly recommend it!

What a great stay we had at Monica & João’s place. Good location, really nice apartment. Comfy bed and lots of thoughtful touches. We had João pick us up at the airport which I recommend- you will learn a lot between the airport and the apartment- plus finding the apartment on your own might be a bit challenging for a weary traveler. Highly recommend this bnb.

Thank you to Monica & João !! How could I describe this stay ? Simply amazing !! Monica and João are very nice, the flat was perfectly clean, beautiful and everything is done for you to have the perfect stay in Lisboa. I hardly recomand this appartment for your next stay. Thank you again and see you next time !

This place was an awesome stay. If you want an authentic and historical Lisbon stay, this place is it.
They hosts met us in person and brought us to the home, which was so important because we would’ve never found the place ourselves.
There, Fred gave us plenty of suggestions of places to go and eat. We met Monica at the home and she was very welcoming and took the time to show us the place and left some wine and pastries for us.
This place overall was a great stay and we will be back!
A great place in a fantastic location. 10 minutes from the castle and a short walk to the city centre.
Perfect place to stay. Great value for money would recommand this place

We had a great 4 night stay. The apartment is in the Alfama district which does have a LOT of hills and stairs, but so does all of Lisbon! The stairs to the apartment are steep and skinny, as well. But the apartment is wonderful when you arrive. It feels like a home and you feel like you have space to spread out. The washing machine was great, there is a clothes line to dry. We really liked the apartment and Monica was helpful with suggestions!

Het appartement van Monica is echt geweldig! Qua locatie kan het niet beter. Het ligt midden in het hart van de mooiste wijk van Lissabon Alfama. Monica, Joaos en Fred zijn hele hartelijke mensen. Absoluut aan te raden. Wij hebben een perfect weekend gehad.

The Alfama apartment was a terrific spot for my first visit to Lisboa.  The apartment was clean, colorful, comfortable and had everything I needed for a delightful stay.  I loved the views and all of the shops & cafes about.  The arrival pickup at the airport (and drop off) was much appreciated.  The snacks, fruit and drinks provided my Monica were a real blessing!  Thank You!
Great apartment in a fabulous location in Alfama
Great location but be prepared to walk which we love doing. Explore the neighborhood- you will find some great restaurants and bars. Very lively at night and fun.

Excellent communication from João and he collected us from the airport. A greeting of custard tarts, chocolate and a bottle of red on arrival, with milk and juice also in the fridge. João gave us some great tips, and even dropped us off in the centre.
The accommodation is a good size, the shower is excellent and the kitchen has all the appliances you need. the bed is comfortable and the view from the kitchen over the Tagus is great.
The stairs are steep to get in, but we didn't have any trouble with them.
Overall a very enjoyable stay, and I would recommend.
A real gem. Spotlessly clean and in an amazing location right in the heart of the neighbourhood. All the amenities plus a lovely terrace. Recommended!

Joao’s Apartment is beautiful! Perfect location for visiting Lisbon. It was sparkling clean with amazing views over the river. Joao wa very kind to meet us at the metro very early in the morning and kindly gave us a small hamper of food. Highly recommend staying here. Thanks again! X

Lovely little apartment in Alfama, close to amenities. Restaurants and cafes closeby. We bought the Lisbon card which was great for getting about and the transport was on our doorstep. The outside patio area at the flat is lovely. The welcome bottle of wine was nice and water etc in the fridge great. Joao met us and took us to the apartment and spent time giving us good advice and marking places to go on a map which we found useful . Everything in the flat we needed. It is in a hilly area so be prepared but we came back feeling fit despite eating lots of Portuguese tarts.

Wonderfully stylish apartment in a centrally located area. João was there to meet us in person even though our flight was delayed. He gave us recommendations of where to visit, which we followed (pension of love and fish restaurant), both excellent choices. Apartment was perfect in every way and we appreciated the welcome hamper. Thanks for a wonderful stay.

Nous avons passé un très agréable séjour dans l'appartement de Joao.
Notre hôte a été attentionné et à notre écoute.
Nous vous recommandons cet appartement.

Unique experience to live in a traditional  and one of the oldest neighborhood in Lisbon. João welcomes us with great hospitality and gave us very nice tips for local restaurants. Can’t forget the experience :)

A beautiful space in the perfect spot for exploring Lisbon. João and Monica were so helpful and responsive. They provided numerous great recommendations. The apartment was clean, comfortable and everything we needed. It is within walking distance of all the top sights and we really enjoyed listening to fado in the neighborhood at night. Thank you João & Monica!!
Very convenient location, great host! João gave us many useful suggestions about traveling and restaurants. Highly recommended!

Really nice apartment, in a nice neighborhood not too far from the city center. The apartment is equipped with everything you need and out of the kitchen window you have a nice view over town. João was a really nice host and had some good tips for us on what to do in Lisbon.
This was a beautiful space in a perfect location. Thank you for a lovely stay!
If you want to stay at an authentic old world Alfama apartment with all the modern amenities, stay here.  Be prepared to walk uphill a little, but worth every step!
Can’t say enough good things about the host, the apartment, and the location. João was accommodating and helpful during check in, and had great recommendations. Thanks for the great stay!

Very nice flat in the nice area of the
Alfama. Close to lots of things to do and see in Lisboa. Very nice contact to the owners. Thank you

The location of the apartment in the Alfama is great. The apartment is very comfortable and feels roomy for two people. The bathroom is located at the opposite end of the apartment from the bedroom and there are a few steps. It was okay. We just left a light on in the living room to avoid any problems during nighttime trips to the bathroom.
Joao met us and took us to the apartment. He always responded quickly. Great place to stay in Lisbon.

This apartment was a delight from the first moment. (And it was such a relief to get to it, with Joao's help, after the madness of the airport and the long climb up.)
Joao was a great help in getting us up the hill and the stairs and then in finding us a pharmacy to give advice and treatment for my wife's apparent eye infection.
We were very comfortable there and had ample space in which not only to sleep and eat but also to use our laptops. The kitchen had more than we needed (one would be crazy to do much cooking in a food town like Lisbon), and what we did use worked perfectly.
Our only regret is that we never got to use the patio. We were both out all day, every day, and the weather was also a bit cold for sitting outdoors. But we imagined ourselves sitting out there on a return trip, which we would try to time so we could stay once again at Joao and Monica's wonderful place.
A lovely place with great restaurants in the area. Just loved the visit.
You can expect a clean comfortable suite in a well located neighbourhood

Amazing location. Alfama could not be more charming or romantic. The apartment is super cool - tucked away down a small pedestrian alleyway. Has everything that you need and Monica and Joao can not be nicer. Very responsive and very helpful.

Very nice big apartment. Very clean. Comfortable bed. Beautiful well build kitchen. We were offered pastries, fruits and wine. Also there is wine for purchase. Great views from kitchen. Big terrace. Shower is one of the best we  found on our 3 month travel this year. Apartment has a very good collection of travel books about Lisbon and Portugal overall. Very good location. Monica met us on arrival. Very nice lady.  Felt very welcomed. Thank you. Of course, as anywhere in Alfama you need to climb stairs.

We had the best time in Lisbon staying at this very nice apartment. Everything is just like it looks on the pictures. João gave us wonderful tips on food, bars and the most important sights. The location, in the heart of the city, is perfect. There are nice restaurants close by and it is wonderful to stroll around.
We would love to come again!

We stayed at this apartment with João hosting and we had an amazing time. The city of Lisbon and the neighborhood of Alfama are the perfect backdrop for a beautiful stay, and João was the definition of a "Superhost"! He picked us up and gave us a walking tour of Alfama as we made our way to the apartment. His tips on the local places to eat, buy food, listen to fado were exceptional and very much appreciated. The apartment was very nice, clean, and accurate to the description and photos. There was a beautiful view from the kitchen where you had a clear view of the river and neighboring rooftops. The common area and terrace were also very nice and made for cozy moments curled up on the sofa and for meals outside. João's hospitality and helpfulness outshined our expectations and we would recommend anyone to stay here. We most definitely will return!

This is a great place to stay! The apartment is clean, bright and very beautiful; and sitting on the roof terrace with a cup of coffee and some pastries from the local bakery is a perfect way to start your day.  João is a great host, very friendly and welcoming and quick to respond if you have questions. A definite recommendation!

Fairy tale perfect location, very close to Santa Apolonia station.
The apartment is Spotless and very well appointed. Fabulous view over the Tagus and huge patio. However, the walls are so think, wifi doesn’t reach every room.
The host is extremely knowledgable.

Super Unterkunft, alles wie beschrieben, Bilder sind authentisch.
Gastgeber João hat und herzlich empfangen und uns tolle Tips gegeben.
Besser geht nicht, weiter so!

This apartment was super well appointed and comfy. The location was great in the Alfama district, close to Fado, shopping and restaurants. The front stairs are very steep and narrow and there is no light at the top of the stairs, making it potentially dangerous.
The walls are quite thin, especially in the bedroom. Sleeping in the living room on the futon might be a better option if you are a light sleeper. On our first night, we received a note written on a napkin from the downstairs neighbor informing us that we be aware the walls are thin and to keep it down. We thought it was very unreasonable and rude because we were not playing music nor being loud. We also were alarmed when the doorbell rang several times in the middle of the night and someone knocked on our door twice during the second night of our stay.
The terrace is beautiful and welcoming. The AC in the bedroom works very well, because the apartment got quite warm. We also loved the washer, although there is no dryer our clothes dried in no time.
We’d definitely stay here again!!
Lovely and comfortable apartment with adorable and elegant decoration, convenient location, helpful tips and warm hospitality from João, thanks very much! Will come back!

Monica and Joao's place was wonderfully located in the heart of Alfama, and had a unique multi-level setup that reflected the hilly location.
Joao was a wonderful host and gave us a ton of really great local dining and touring tips during check-in. Really enjoyed our stay!

We had a wonderful stay in this cute airbnb in Alfama. Loved the authenticity and history of the location - lots of al fresco restaurants in the area & only a 10 min walk to the center square area. The airbnb was artfully decorated and I loved the cute patio. The bottle of wine and coffee were nice touches. We arranged for airport transfer with Joao and that definitely made the check in process easier. As noted in other reviews, the apartment is up the narrow cobblestone hills and you must carry your luggage up (cannot roll on ground).
Wish we could have stayed longer!!

João is a wonderful host - warm welcome and several suggestions shared with us. The flat is nice, clean, spacious with all amenities. Location is right in the center of Alfama and 10-min walking distance from most historic city highlights. Just be aware of the steep stairs leading to the apartment.

W O W! This apartment could easily be the showcase for an ideal Airbnb experience. João met us personally near the apartment and provided us with a tour and tips to make our 1 night in Lisbon one we will not soon forget.
This apartment is pure unfiltered Portugal, perfect views, location & comfort. Do yourself a favor and don’t miss this one :)
Excellent value and the terrace was perfect for sitting out at the end of the day.

The apartment is located in the middle of Alfama which gives a special twist to the stay. It is surrounded by lots of narrow streets with small but very interesting restaurants. The apartment as such is very convenient, all you need is available. The big terrace is nice for whatever meals you prefer to have in private. The only real challenge are the steep and narrow stairs leading to the apartment on the 2nd floor, so it would be best to travel without heavy luggage, which we didn't do. But João was kind enough to help us to get the stuff up to the apartment. He also provided loads of local hints out of which we were able to utilize a few. All in all a great stay!

Das Apartment ist der absolute Hit! João hat uns sehr herzlich empfangen und sich viel Zeit genommen um uns viele tolle Tipps für Alfama und Lissabon zu geben.
Die Wohnung ist perfekt ausgestattet, sehr sauber und genau so schön wie auf den Bildern. Der Ausblick auf den Tejo und die Terasse sind einfach fantastisch.
Eine richtige Oase im Trubel der Großstadt! Die Kommunikation mit Monica und João war sehr freundlich - vielen Dank auch nochmals für die Pastéis de Nata und den Wein!
Wir können die Wohnung einfach nur empfehlen!

The apartment is comfortable and cosy with an elegant decor. It is well equipped with all amenities. The terrace and views of the Tagus are beautiful. It is a privilege to be able to stay in the atmospheric location of Alfama and feel the soul of fado.
João was an excellent host who spent time with us explaining the special sights and places to eat in Lisbon. We were welcomed with Portuguese tarts and great bottle of red wine.
The apartment is centrally located making it easy to explore the enchanting city of Lisbon. We have no hesitation recommending the apartment.

I would recommend this place to anyone staying in Lisbon! The hosts are so kind and João met us to walk us up the windy streets to the apartment. It was beautiful and the patio was great; so clean; best location in the old town. Please beware that the stairs to get up to the apartment are very steep and narrow - difficult with bags. Otherwise everything was perfect!

Just as described, this place is perfect for a quiet stay in Alfama. The flat is spacious and the back terrace is the perfect spot for morning coffee or evening night cap. It is up a very narrow alley and the steps to the flat are extremely steep and narrow, so be prepared. Worth every bit to get there. Joao was extremely accommodating and sat down with us once we got to apartment for about half an hour to tell us about all the best spots to go. He also had a welcome bottle of wine for us, which was so very nice. Would recommend this to anyone! Lovely time in Lisbon because of this spot!

Eine sehr schöne Unterkunft vom Monica und Joao. Die Wohnung entspricht absolut den Bildern und ist sehr sauber und super zentral in der Alfama gelegen. Die Innenstadt und alle Sehenswürdigkeiten sind besten zu Fuß in Kürze zu erreichen. Lediglich ein wenig Treppensteigen ist in diesem Viertel angesagt.
Die Kommunikation im Vorfeld mit Joao war bestens. Er hat uns mit einem Getränk am Treffpunkt empfangen und uns auf dem Weg in die Unterkunft kurz das Viertel erklärt und unterwegs bei einem Bäcker zwei super leckere Pasteis de Nata gekauft. Der Empfang war sehr herzlich und Joao hat isch kurz Zeit genommen und die Sehenswürdigkeiten zu erklären und Tipps für Restaurants gegeben. Vielen Dank dafür. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt!
Super appart, super hôte!!! Obrigado👍👍👍
Joao was a wonderful host. The flat is big and very nice. In the heart of Alfama, it was very plaisant to stay here. We recommend!

Monica and João are amazing hosts and have a beautiful space in the heart of everything. João went out of his way to help us with a late check in and had a little snack waiting. Would stay here again any day!

Monica & Joao have a beautiful apartment in the Alfama neighborhood of Lisbon. It's a historic area,  and perfect for wandering and getting lost. The apartment is very well equipped with all the modern conveniences you would want (dishwasher, washing machine, etc). We spent a lot of time sitting outside on the beautiful terrace enjoying our breakfasts in the morning and vinho verde in the afternoon. The bed is very comfortable, with soft linens, and there is and air conditioning in the bedroom as well. Joao met us at a convenient spot and escorted us to the apartment which was greatly appreciated, as the apartment is situated in a very high spot up in the Alfama. He gave us wonderful restaurant recommendations, and offered suggestions for sight seeing. The one issue we would caution about is the height of the stairs to the apartment: if you have any mobility issues, it will be difficult to access as there is no elevator and the apartment is very high up on a steep hill. We loved our stay and would definitely recommend this wonderful place in magical Lisbon!

Monica and João have an absolutely wonderful place and are also great hosts. Located in Alfama, the apartment is conveniently located near bars, restaurants and tourist sights. Monica was extremely helpful when it came to meeting on the day and handing over the keys. She also gave us tips about local places to visit. Will definitely recommend them to friends and family. Thank you very much
To make it short: It’s an awesome Appartement, wonderful terrace, ideally located  with great views and a great and helpful host awaits you to arrive. 10 out of 10. GREAT!

Appartement très agréable, parfaitement situé dans Alfama à 10 min de la station de métro Santa Appolonia et tout près du musée du Fado. L'accueil fut très chaleureux, la propriétaire nous a guidé à travers les petites ruelles d'Alfama pour nous montrer le chemin jusqu'à l'appartement. Pour ceux qui ne connaissent pas, ruelles étroites qui montent et pavés partout mais les valises à roulette y parviennent quand même ;-), par contre charme indéniable ! L'appartement au premier étage possède une entrée minuscule mais s'étale à l'intérieur sur les immeubles voisins, très belle déco, atmosphère très agréable et en bonus, une grande terrasse. Y séjourner sans hésitation !

The apartment is spacious (especially for two), bright and airy and in a wonderful location - a vibrant area and close to many attractions, but still quiet.  The two short flights of stairs are steep but manageable.  Joao was a brilliant host - taking us to the apartment (it would have been difficult to find without him), helping us with our luggage and spending time with us to go through a map of Lisbon, pointing out his recommended highlights, which all lived up to expectations.  We wouldn’t hesitate to recommend the apartment to friends and to stay there again ourselves.

Benjamin and I loved our stay at Monica's and João’s apartment. It was the PERFECT location and beautiful space. The outdoor deck was perfect, and I believe pretty rare to find in the Alfama!  From the moment we arrived, we wished we could stay longer.  I recommend this apartment 1000%!!

João took time to meet with us out on the beautiful terrace to offer insights and travel advice that proved helpful.  He was available when  needed.  The apartment was clean and cozy.  Perfect for our needs!!!
Amazing place with amazing host! You feel welcomed and just at home!

The apartment was a dream to stay in. It was just the right size for two people. It was sunny and airy, yet also private even with the balcony open. Don’t leave the balcony open when you go to bed or go out. I really recommend this apartment. The host was so welcoming and informative.

Very nice appartment, everything in it with a personal character. Perfectly located in the quarter Alfama. Nearby you find many good restaurants, bars and cafés. Just follow Joaôs hints - he is the perfect host
A brilliant apartment in a beautiful part of Lisbon. Great host with lots of passion. Highly recommended

We had a great stay at joao and Monica's. The apartment is perfectly located to explore the city and is in a lovely area of the alfama with lots of bars and restaurants nearby. Joao had lots of amazing suggestions for our stay which we took advantage of. The apartment itself is really spacious and the views from the kitchen and terrace were beautiful. We would highly recommended.

As with most of the reviews this place is fantastic, great views over the Tagus, a lovely little courtyard at the rear. Good space and an excellent host who was extremely responsive and left some nice little touches for us to enjoy on arrival.
The only downside I can think of is that it would be good to have some washing and dish washing detergent as you end up buying a large amount which does not make it easier if you want to travel light. Also, the stairs are a killer and if you have any mobility issues then I would suggest you not stay here. Otherwise highly recommended.

Wir können und den anderen Bewertungen nur anschliessen. Sehr nette Kommunikation und
wertvolle Tipps für den Aufenthalt in Lissabon. Es gab Törtchen und Wein zur Begrüssung. Wir konnten am Abreisetag unser Gepäck auch noch etwas länger in der Wohnung lassen-das kam uns sehr entgegen.
Loved the outside terrace so much!! Be prepared that the stairs to access the apartment are very steep...keep your bags small and light weight:)

The flat is really nice and in a great location.  The owner is very helpful with tips and advice.  I would recommend that you eat at the local fish restaurant that Joao recommends.  The fish is fresh and very enjoyable.  You'll have to book or get there early or late or alternatively be prepared to wait for 15 minutes until a table becomes available.

We loved Joao and Monica's place in the Alfama! It was so cool being in such an old and traditional part of town with the hills and winding alleyways (pack light, the apartment is not directly accessible by car and the steps are steep), but having a bright and modern apartment to come back to! Joao was super flexible about our check-in when our flight was delayed, and took time to sit down and walk through his personal recommendations for Lisboa with us. I would definitely stay here again and recommend it to others!

Great spacious apartment bang in the middle of alfama
João was great with communication leading up to our arrival and met us just a short walk from the apartment
Nice personal touches on arrival , a bottle of wine and some pastel de Natas from the local pastaria,
There are a ridiculous amount of quality bars and restaurants in close proximity
João took time to recommend lots of local places to visit and we had a lovely chat in the heartbeat of the property, the lovely garden area
Overall a great value for money apartment
Cheers João, we'll be in touch if/when we come back to Lisbon

We highly recommend this apartment. It was within walking distance to all the major sites. The place was spotless and well-equipped.
In addition, Joao was a fab host. We didn't have cell or email service upon our arrival in Lisbon. He waited for us for about 40 minutes at a pre-designated destination (we were late...). Then, he spent a good amount of time with us, telling us about sites and restaurants. Most useful.
As with much of Europe, there are hills and stairs. You must be up for climbing them around Lisbon, including the stairs up to the apartment. Once you get there, it's very delightful and lots of good light.
Top Lage, super Gastfreundlichkeit!!! Erreichbarkeit mit der Metro sehr gut. Schöne Tipps für Lissabon erhalten. Sehr empfehlenswert.

You are looking for a nice apartment in Lisbon? And you want to live in Alfama? Then you have found the best apartment with a beautiful view.
João is really a super host. For every question or problem he had the answer.
We enjoyed our stay in this fantastic city and apartment!

The flat is perfect located in the middle of the old Alfama town. There is a wonderful and very useful terrasse and all is great about the flat. Joao and Monica are very nice and helpful hosts. One of the best Airbnb stays ever :)

Monica and Joao’s place was perfectly located in the Alfama with an amazing view over the river. It was quiet for sleeping and close to many great restaurants and sights. We loved the terrace and João was very helpful answering any questions we had. We would love to stay at this place again in the future.
Monica and João are wonderful hosts. The apartment is really lovely and the perfect place to explore the Alfama. There were so many personal touches and the terrace is beautiful.

Het appartement is in alle aspecten een goede plaats om te verblijven. Het is comfortabel en een prima startpunt om op pad te gaan in de stad. De traditionele restaurants (lees Fado) vind je letterlijk om de hoek. Kortom wij vinden dit appartement een echte aanrader. Bus, tram, metro zijn op loopafstand. Evenals de meest prachtige pleinen aan de Taag !

Nous avons passé 5  jours dans ce superbe appartement, idéalement situé. Tout est à portée de main, et peut se faire à pieds pour les plus sportifs, sinon le métro est à quelques pas. Nous avons été accueilli par Jao, qui est un hôte charmant, et qui nous a aiguillé pour des adresses de bars et restaurants ainsi que visites. Si je reviens à Lisbonne, je reviendrai ici sans hésitation. En espérant juste que la prochaine fois la météo sera plus avenante.

Great place to go everywhere in Lisboa, in the heart of the best neighborhood, very safe, extremely clean and lovely view. Besides that the best hosts I ever had in Airbnb. Don't doubt it just book it right away! Actually, if you are seeing space for booking you are lucky!
Recomendo
A lovely place in a great spot with a wonderfully helpful and knowledgeable host. Makes staying in a great city even better. Highly recommended.

Our stay at João‘s apartment was amazing. It‘s located in a very charming area from where you can reach most of Lisboa‘s sights on foot. João gave us many useful tipps and was always there when we had questions. He is a very great and friendly guy and we can highly recommend a stay at his place! We will come back for sure :)

Das Apartment ist absolut zu empfehlen. Es ist eine wundervolle, schön eingerichtete und sehr gut ausgestattete Wohnung. Man fühlt sich direkt zu Hause. João hat uns am Museo do Fado abgeholt und im Apartment noch viele Tipps gegeben. Die Lage ist ebenso großartig. Mitten in Alfama taucht man direkt in das Leben der Portugiesen ein. Alfama ist ein Viertel, in dem sich die Nachbarn kennen, einen Plausch auf der Straße halten, einfach gemütlich. Ein Bäcker ist direkt ein Stück die Straße hinunter. Ein Supermarkt ist bei der Metrohaltestelle, die 6-7 min. Fußweg entfernt ist. In die Stadt kann man gut laufen, oder auch die Metro nutzen. Zu bedenken ist, dass es viele Hügel und Treppen in Alfama und auch generell in Lissabon gibt. Man sollte also gut zu Fuß sein.

Lovely flat, stylishly furnished with pictures and other Objets.
Very comfortable bed.
Joao gave us lots of tips about places to go-we could not do it all!
Very close to an excellent bakery and yards from a traditional restaurant (not exactly "Haute Cuisine", but acceptable, with Fado singing.)
Steep stairs with narrow treads up to the flat, so visitors need to be reasonably fit. Nice open terrace-apparently a rarity in Alfama, and also other properties in Lisbon.Highly recommended.
Excellent place. Located in a fantastic section of Alfama. Tricky to find, but that’s part of the fun!
A beautiful apartment in a lovely part of the city. Monica and Joao made us feel very welcome and gave us some excellent ideas for places to visit and delicious restaurants to go to during our stay

Great apartment in a fabulous location!
Joao was a great host - very charming and accommodating - allowed an early check in which was great. He offered many insider tips which was nice. Provided a great welcome package of basic breakfast things and wine.
Lots of stairs up as on the 3rd floor - not an issue for us but could be if older/children/etc.
Small note- basics such as hand soap/shampoo not provided so be prepared.
Great place!

Our stay at Monica and Joao’s flat was a wonderful experience. João greeted us upon our arrival and personally escorted us through the charming narrow streets of Alfama to the apartment. He provided us with delicious wine, cheese and fruit, and provided helpful tips and recommendations. The apartment itself was perfectly located for us! Just minutes walking to the Santa Apolonia train station where we were able to get the metro, and trains to other parts of Portugal. From the apartment we were able to walk all over the city, however there were also delicious local restaurants, pastelarias and shops at our fingertips. The apartment was clean, beautiful and quiet. We enjoyed wine on the terrace and beautiful views of the Tagus river. We would recommend this apartment to solo travelers, couples or small families. It was a lovely stay!!!

Allez y les yeux fermés !
Un accueil, un logement, un quartier......d’exception !!!
un véritable paradis....
on ne peut pas dire mieux!

I booked the flat as a surprise trip for my husband and son. Joao was really helpful during booking and before the trip and even offered to collect them from the airport. The plane was delayed but he waited for them and then took them to the flat and out for a drink and a chat. They told me the flat was brilliant and the sofa bed was comfy. Thanks Joao for making my Christmas present such a success.
Excellent flat in Alfama. Quirky layout, comfortable bed, wonderful roof terrace & views. Most gracious host. We loved this flat, and will be back!

Joao is really kind.
When we used a hair dryer at first time, It was broken already. So he took a new hair dryer at am 00:30.
And the house was very clean and cozy.
Recommend to all visiter.

Nous avons passé un très agréable séjour chez Monica et Joao. L'appartement est très beau , très lumineux , bien décoré , la vue de la cuisine est magnifique et la terrasse est superbe .
Un grand merci à Joao pour son accueil , il nous a donné rendez - vous au musée du Fado pour nous accompagner à l'appartement , a pris le temps de nous expliquer les endroits à visiter et les restaurants à faire . il a aussi accepté que nous laissions nos bagages dans l'appartement en dehors des horaires d'arrivée et de départ ce qui nous a permis de commencer la visite de cette magnifique ville qu'est Lisbonne !

We really enjoyed staying at Monica & João’s place in Alfama. The location was excellent and the hospitality was really appreciated. The communication throughout was very good and we appreciated that João met us to take us to the apartment as it would have been difficult to find it on our own.

This place was a lovely first stop on our honeymoon. To start, the apartment had wonderful views, was close to everything we wanted to see, and felt like a perfect home away from home. João was very helpful in giving us ideas of where to eat and what to see and even provided us with a map. I'd stay here again in a heartbeat.

Beautiful place to stay in the charming neighbourhood of Alfama. João was very welcoming and gave us lots of information about where to eat and places to explore during our stay in Lisbon. Thanks so much. We hope to return in the future!

Monica and Joao are an amazing hosts that live up to the Airbnb vision. Not only were their apartment right in the truly local part of the city, but they also took the time to welcome us and hand over their local knowledge to ensure we had a great time. Their apartment was beautifully furnished yet retained its quirky local touches. The only thing to note is that the last flight stairs in the apartment block is narrow and steep so keep your baggage light and small!

I will start by saying we run an Airbnb and have stayed in many over the last couple of years. Previous to our visit to João’s place, we stayed in another location that was rather low priced, but a convenient location, and we got what we paid for. THIS location, however, exceeded our expectations!
João gave us excellent instructions on where to meet, as this flat is in a pedestrian area. This was our second visit to Lisbon and I knew I wanted to stay in this neighborhood. We met, had a coffee and João personalized recommendations to suit our brief visit and interests. He then helped us with our luggage up the winding stone streets, pointing out points of interest, shops and traditions. A mini tour that helped us remember how to find the flat later!
We were early and he was kind enough to let us drop our luggage off and introduce us to the space.
The steps are narrow and steep, typical of the homes in the area. We laughed at how you would get up them should you drink too much GINJINHA! We agreed al fours would work best.
The flat is beautiful, uncluttered yet tastefully decorated. The kitchen is modern and has everything you need. Had we stayed stayed longer, we would have taken advantage of the modern appliances. We were at the end of a two week vacation, ending in Lisbon for New Year’s Eve and were happy to find a washing machine and traditional line outside the kitchen window door.
The bed was comfortable with crisp, clean sheets and lush fluffy pillows.
We spent time in the sofa and caught up with the news on the TV, munching on the fab local soft goat cheese and a lovely bottle of wine left for us. They also left us additional wines to purchase which I thought was a lovely touch.
The bathroom is lined with beautiful tile that reminds you of the sea, enhanced by a waterfall shower head with great pressure. Again, very clean and modern.
The veranda was why I chose the place. A cozy area with a grill, table and chairs and umbrella. Here, relax with the sunset and a coffee. The internet is best on this side of the house, not so good in the bedroom.
Many thanks to João and Monica for sharing their traditional, yet modern living space in this beautiful city!

This apartment is great - very stylish and in a great location - everything is walkable. Alfama is a really interesting area and well worth a visit. Joao met us and explained a lot about Lisbon and gave us some great tips to visit around the city - he also left us a few treats too! Definitely recommend this if you're staying in Lisbon - it would be good for longer stays too since it has nice space and even a clothes washing machine

Monica & João’s couldn’t have been better hosts. Outstandingly kind and helpful. The apartment was clean and stylish and the little terrace and its view was quaint and lovely. Thank you so much, Monica & João!

Appartement idéalement situé au cœur de l'Alfama; un quartier pittoresque avec ses ruelles étroites, ses escaliers...ses commerçants...
Nous nous sommes sentit chez nous pendant 4 jours!
Joao nous a très bien accueillis et à pris à cœur de nous donner ses bonnes adresses! Merci mille fois!
Nous avons passé un super séjour; Lisbonne est vraiment une ville à découvrir!
Kein parkplatz vor dem haus. Aber 5 min entfernt gibt es einen grossen sicheren parkplatz.  Dafuer ist die wohnung sehr ruhig da kein verkehr.  Die wohnung ist empfehlenswert

Airbnb at its best!! We had an amazing stay at Monica & Joaos place. The apartment is very nice and comfortable, close to transportation and nightlife, yet surprisingly quiet. The neighborhood is touristy, of course, but very charming. The bed was super comfy. If you are planning on spending some time in beautiful Alfama, this is a great option! A word about João : if a host could get 6 stars out of 5, he would :)
We had a great weekend in Lisbon! The apartment was in a perfect location for us. Check in was so smooth and we really appreciated the custard tarts on check in :-)

João hat uns bei strömenden Regen sogar persönlich vom Bahnhof abgeholt und uns bei einem Bier seine kulinarischen Empfehlungen genannt. Die Unterkunft hatte eine super Lage, alle wichtigen Sehenswürdigkeiten waren fußläufig erreichbar.  Ansonsten ist die Metro nur 10 Minuten vom Appartement entfernt gewesen.  Die Unterkunft war sauber und liebevoll eingerichtet, nur die Spülmaschine funktionierte nicht.  Wir waren rundum zufrieden und haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Wir empfehlen die Unterkunft 100% weiter.

Joao is an amazing host! Since the apartment is not accessible by car, he met us nearby and walked us over.
