He sat down with us for a good half hour, asked us what we were interested in, and listed recommendations on a city map. He also let us leave our bags for a few hours prior to check-in and after check-out, and gave us some pastries, beer, and wine!
The apartment is lovely and located in the heart of Alfama. The balcony is great for enjoying a beverage at any time of day. You can easily walk to public transit (28 tram, buses, train station), restaurants, sites, etc. The staircase is extremely narrow so keep that in mind if you have large suitcases.
Joao is an outstanding host. He greeted us upon arrival and spent time with us to ensure an excellent stay. Everything went very smoothly and we had a lovely stay. Thank you very much!

Der Blick auf den Tejo ist atemberaubend! Ein Genuss am Morgen in die Küche zu kommen. Auf der Terrasse ist die Sonne im November von 11.00 bis 15.30 Uhr.  Die Gastgeber sind sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Zur Begrüßung gab es die berühmten Pastel de Nata. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und kommen gerne wieder :).
Appartement très bien situé,atypique et bien décoré.le propriétaire prend du temps pour nous montrer des bonnes adresses.encore merci.
Top location in Alfama, a wonderful terrace with late morning & midday sunshine in November.

a wonderful place to discover an extraordinary town
We will come back
Thanks for all

We had a fantastic stay at Monica and João‘s place. The apartment is very beautiful, and it‘s location in Alfama is perfect for excursions through Lisbon. Everything is very neat and clean.
João welcomed us remarkably friendly; he even left us fruit, bread, cheese and a bottle of superb wine - as „welcome gift“ he told us smiling.
Then he took a lot of time to show us where to go. His tips were great, we had a lot of great moments in Lisbon.
Thank you a lot, Monica and João!

We met Joao at the meeting point he could not have been friendlier or more helpful. The flat was as described very clean and nicely decorated. The location was good, could walk to most place or go take the Metro or railway at San Apolino station. I would stay here again and would recommend it.

João nous a très bien accueilli, des petits cadeaux étaient présents pour notre arrivée. Il a prit le temps de nous donner pleins de conseils pour les restaurants du quartier et les bars locaux. L appartement est magnifique et très bien décoré, avec une jolie terrasse spacieuse accompagnée d une jolie vue. L emplacement est top car en plein dans le quartier de l Alfama, dans les petites rues piétonnes, un très bon choix de logement !

Dit sfeervolle appartement is een aanrader. Het is sfeervol met een lekker rustig terras. Joao heeft ons opgehaald van het vliegveld en we kregen een aantal leuke tips van hem. Ook stond er wijn en lekkers klaar voor ons. Heel gastvrij.
Het appartement ligt in de gezellige oude wijk Alfama. Bekend om de fado en de steile smalle straatjes. Als je niet goed ter been bent dan is deze wijk wellicht geen aanrader. Ook adviseren wij om te reizen met een kleine koffer (handbagage) ivm de vele trappetjes naar het appartement en de steile kleine trap naar de 2e verdieping waar het appartement zich bevindt. 's Nachts is het heerlijk stil. Een metrostation hebben wij niet direct in de buurt gevonden maar taxi's zijn goedkoop in Lissabon.

João was a great host- met us to give some great recommendations for Lisbon. The apartment was even better than the pictures and was located in the perfect romantic neighborhood of Alfama. The steps to the apartment were quite steep but added to the fun of staying in the neighborhood! Loved loved the entire experience. Highly recommend!
Great place, gorgeous view, still felt like the old town residential area of Lisbon. Just quite a climb to get to but worth it
Wonderful stay and great hosts.  Thank you so much for your hospitality and for the suggestions for our visits and travels beyond Lisboa.  We will certainly recommend your apartment

Such a wonderful place in the super nice area of Alfama. João was a perfect host and he helped us finding a perfect next destination in Algarve. We enjoyed our stay a lot and would love to stay there again any time!

Ein wunderhübsches Apartment in der Alfama. Ich würde das jeder Zeit wieder buchen. Joao hat uns mit super Tipps über Restaurants etc. versorgt und war uns extrem behilflich betreffend Gepäck, was sehr hilfreich war in diesem Gelände.
Er hat uns mit den portugiesischen Küchlein versorgt und wenn man ihn fragt, holt er einen sogar vom Flughafen ab.
Vielen Dank nochmal.
Cornelia

Tres bien situé, les hôtes sont tres généreux et disponnible. Joao a prir le temps de s'asseoir avec nous pour nous donner des bin conseils. Des petites attentions laissé ds l'appartement ! L'emplacement, pour nous etait parfait, ds le centre de Alfama. L'appartement etait impeccable, belle terrasse et ont voit le Tage de la cuisine.  Je recommande fortement !

Bonsoir Monica et Joao, nous venons d'arriver à Porto aujourd'hui et repartons jeudi pour Paris.
Nous gardons un souvenir très agréable de notre séjour dans votre appartement dans le quartier d'Alfama. Votre accueil, votre disponibilité, le bel appartement que vous proposez avec plus particulièrement la vue sur le Tage et la petite terrasse très appréciable ont contribué à faire de notre séjour à Lisbonne une réussite. Nous remercions également Joao de nous avoir envoyé des indications pour Porto.
Nous recommanderons vivement votre appartement à notre entourage.
Bien cordialement
Joëlle et Guy
Very charming apartment in a great location

We loved João and Monica's apartment. Located in central Alfama you feel just like a local staying there. João was a great host, very kind and generous and will provide you with as little or as much information as you need. His communication was good and he was waiting for us on arrival.
The apartment was spotless, quirky in a good way, and had very effective air-conditioning in the bedroom. The French balcony in the kitchen and full outside terrace is an added bonus.
Please be aware that in order to access the apartment you must climb an extremely steep set of stairs (not a problem for us though).
We loved Lisbon and would certainly recommend this apartment if you want to stay in Alfama.
You should stay here for a really central location in the old city but within striking distance of everywhere you wish to walk to.

Super appartement tres bien placé dans le Cœur de l'Alfama. Bus à proximité très facile d'accès qui emmènent dans le centre ville à toutes heures. Appartement tres propre super accueil et superbe vue sur le Tage. Des gourmandises nous attendaient à l'arrivée ! Quartier très sympa pour découvrir le Lisbonne le plus authentique. Gros + pour le restaurant Pateo13 juste en bas de la rue qui sert du poisson frais, c'est pour nous le meilleur restaurant de l'alfama !! Nous avons passé une super semaine ! Merci Joao Et Monica ! ❤️

Joao hat uns sehr nett empfangen und uns viele hilfreiche Tipps gegeben. Die Kommunikation war von Anfang an hervorragend. Wir haben uns sehr wohlgefühlt in der schönen Wohnung, die mitten in der Altstadt und dennoch ruhig gelegen ist. Die Wohnung selbst ist sehr gemütlich und geschmackvoll eingerichetet, sehr sauber und gut ausgestattet. Die Dachterasse ist großartig, um nachmittags eine Pause einzulegen oder abends zu grillen. Der Blick von der Küche auf den Tejo ist traumhaft. Die Wohnung war für uns Drei (2 Erwachsene und 1 Kind) genau richtig. Zu Fuß kann man alle wichtigen Verkehrsknoten und Sehenswürdigkeiten erreichen. Restaurants liegen in unmittelbarer Nähe.

Un joli logement calme et situé au cœur de l'Alfama avec une terrasse.
Joao est une personne charmante et un précieux conseil pour visiter le Portugal.

The apartment is really well-located in the historical area. On our way to the apartment, João introduced us to all the services available in the neighbourhood, gave us many usefull advices and suggestions: great help. The place is comfortable, well-equipped, large terrace to enjoy aperos and fado in the background.
We definitely recommand the place.
Toll gelegene Wohnung im zentralen und erstaunlicherweise ruhigem Stadtteil alfama; wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt; João ist sehr herzlich und hilfsbereit, wir kommen gern wieder

Un logement plein de charme, propre et très bien agencé, dans un quartier pittoresque, un hôte charmant avec des recommandations bienveillantes, des attentions pour le palais (bouteille de vin et délicieux gateaux).... bref, juste de quoi tomber amoureux de Lisbonne. Je reviendrai sans aucun doute.
Magnifique appartement, très bien placé. Très bel accueil. Nous reprendrons et appartement lors de notre prochain voyage à Lisboa

What a wonderful place! Joao is a super host. He met us at Museu do Fado and helped to carry our language. He explained where to eat, to buy fish, meat and fruits. He gave us great suggestions what to see and how to get there. He was extremely accommodating and allowed us to store our luggage after noon check out time as our plane was later in the evening.
I highly recommend his place. Great location, amazing view from kitchen balcony. It was clean, and fully stocked with all nessessary stuff.
Great place and great people!

Alfama is a great place to stay - close to everything, historical atmosphere and lots of authentic cafes/ restaurants. The apartment is beautiful and cozy and the terrace perfect to enjoy some sun or hang out. Joao and Monica are great hosts and gave us lots of insights where to go and what to do in Lisboa. The perfect place to stay at!

Great place to stay. Calm, central and cozy apartment. João was a really nice host: helpful and kind with many tips about what to do in Lisbon. Highly recommended for anyone who wants to stay in a nice place in Alfama.

This is a great little apartment set in Alfama. The apartment has a lovely roof terrace which we sat out on a lot. The stairs to the apartment are very steep but this just added to the view from the kitchen. It is set in windy narrow roads which are full of Lisbon character. The bed was comfy and the apartment was clean. The host was really accommodating and recommended some great places to eat. I would definitely recommend staying in this amazing apartment.

João was the best host! He picked us up from Museu do Fado and helped us with our luggage all the way up to the apartment. He even took the time to give us a lot of helpful tips for Lisbon. He also made sure everything was fine. The apartment was great. Clean and just as pictured. The location of the apartment is great. I would totally recommend to stay at Monicas and Joãos place when you're in Lisbon!

Bel appartement, bien situé dans l'Alfama.
Accueil très sympathique de Joao

What a lovely couple. What a warm welcome.
We had a wonderful stay at Monica & Joao's apartment. Joao took the time to give us all the tips and recommendations he could think of for our stay in Lisbon. The flat is in a great location and has everything you might need. We particularly enjoyed the terrace for our little breakfast made of local coffee and pasta de Natal.
We'll definitely be going back.
Highly recommended.
Luc and Charlotte

Die zentrale Lage ist der Hit!
Gleich um die Ecke gibt es eine Bäckerei, in der man alles fürs Frühstück bekommt, Restaurants und Kneipen sind ebenfalls fußläufig zu erreichen.
Die Unterkunft ist allerdings nur zu empfehlen, wenn man gut zu Fuß ist und Treppen steigen kann ( also nichts für Leute mit Knieproblemen...) die Treppe zur Wohnung ist nämlich megasteil und auch die Umgebung ist sehr hügelig. Ansonsten sehr gemütlich und geschmackvoll eingerichtet! Das Schlafsofa ist auch sehr geräumig und bietet genug Platz für 2 Personen. Abends kann man prima auf der Terrasse sitzen und das milde Wetter genießen, wir waren wirklich begeistert.

Joâo a été un hôte très précieux qui a su nous fournir continuellement des informations pertinentes pour agrémenter notre séjour. Pour partager le quotidien des locaux, son appartement ( avec terrasse) est un choix judicieux. Je le recommande sans aucune hésitation.

João places is charming and tucked away in the beautiful neighborhood of Alfama. The listing is comfortable, has all the necessities need for one's travel and within walking distance to other parts of town. Note that the listing is in a pedestrian only zone and requires climbing a steep flight of stairs - so bear that in mind if you have heavy luggage, or other issues.
Awesome place, perfectly equipped, great patio, perfect location and very welcoming owner.

An absolutely amazing place to stay in Lisbon. Joao was very helpful with suggestions of places to eat and sites to visit. We felt very welcomed.
The home is flawless. Very clean and in a very good location.
Could not have had a better experience. Highly recommend this home for your stay in Portugal.

Excellent séjour chez Monica et João. Nous avons eu un accueil très chaleureux avec beaucoup de bons plans.
L'appartement est parfait, très bien équipé, très bien placé dans le vieux quartier de l'Alfama pour partir visiter directement à pied.
Nous vous le recommandons chaudement !!!!

My mother, my brother and I had a really nice stay in the appartment. It is very beautiful, clean and comfortable. The alfama qurtier is also very nice. Calm with portuguese restaurants, bakers, butcher and small shops for fish. We recommend Monica and Joaos appartment for a trip to Lisboa!

Das Appartement liegt mitten in Alfama zwischen kleinen Gässchen, die mit dem Auto nicht zu erreichen sind. João hat uns daher vor dem Museo do Fado abgeholt und zur Wohnung gebracht. Die Wohnung ist sehr sauber, gemütlich und hat eine Dachterasse, von der man einen Blick auf den Tejo hat und abends den Fado aus einem kleinen Restaurant unterhalb der Wohnung hört. Die nächste Bus/Bahn/U-Bahn-Station ist nur ca. 3 Minuten zu Fuß entfernt, die Haltestelle der Tram 28 nur 300 Meter und auch sonst ist alles prima zu Fuß zu erreichen. Eine Bäckerei, ein kleiner Supermarkt und ein Fischhändler sind ebenfalls direkt in der Nähe. João hat uns bei der Ankunft noch sehr gute Tipps gegeben, was man unbedingt sehen sollte und wo man gut essen kann. Ich würde dieses Appartement jederzeit uneingeschränkt weiterempfehlen.

What a amazing Air B and B! Joao was a fantastic host who welcomed us at the nearby Musea De Fado near the central train station. We actually rented a car and there was ample parking nearby at the cruise ship port. Joao took some of his time once we arrived at the Air B and B to show us a map and give some suggestions of attractions and restaurants to go to to during our trip. The A/C is really nice to have in the master bedroom and we felt that the place was very clean and tidy. He left us a bottle of wine and their is other wine that he has their with prices on the bottle 7- 11 euro, just leave cash on the counter for the wine. I work in Aspen and rent high end homes so I know hospitality and properties very well, Joao's place is a gem in the wonderful Alfama district! I look forward to travelling back to Lisbon and to this Air B and B hopefully with my golf clubs!
Great place, great location

From the beginning Joao was the most gracious and kind host. Very helpful and welcoming. Check-in was seamless and the apt is really lovely. The space is open and more than enough for two. The terrace is perfect! Highly recommend staying here.

Die Wohnung ist ideal gelegen in den winkeligen, malerischen Gassen von Alfama. Besonders toll ist die schöne Terrasse, aber auch die Zimmer sind geräumig und sowohl praktisch und als auch stilvoll eingerichtet. Wir haben uns dort sehr wohl gefühlt und können diese Unterkunft sehr empfehlen.

Lovely apartment, well-equipped with a delightful terrace; excellently situated in the old town. Quiet despite proximity to restaurants and nightlife. João couldn't be more helpful. Only disadvantage: very steep, narrow staircase. Otherwise a gem.

We instantly felt at home in the apartment. It is beautiful with amazing views & a lovely terrace where we enjoyed breakfast. They were quick to respond to all of our questions and João gave us a tour of useful local shops & great recommendations to see around the city. Our stay here couldn't have been better!
Great location for exploring Alfama.
Appartement très bien placé dans alfama, tout était parfait et La terrasse était vraiment un plus. N hésitez pas car de notre côté nous reviendrons!
Accueil très agréable, appartement bien situé dans un quartier pittoresque tout en étant au calme. Très bien équipé et très propre. A recommander les yeux fermés.

Ein wirklich schönes Appartement im Herzen von Alfama. Herzlicher Empfang und super ausgestattet. Ruhig, aber zentral. Super Kommunikation - netter Kontakt. Würden jederzeit wiederkommen und empfehlen das App. uneingeschränkt weiter!
We had a fantastic time in this cosy, clean and comfortable appartment with a very nice terrace in a nice neighborhood. Thank you João, for your warm welcome and tips for the city!

We spent 2 nights in Joao and Monica's beautiful apartment in the heart of the historic Alfama district.  The apartment was spotless and full of light, with a lovely terrace and views of the water from the kitchen balcony.  Joao met us at the nearby Museum of Fado, helped us with our luggage, and spent more than an hour giving us tips on the area, showing us around, and driving us to a market he recommended for lunch.   He is a fantastic host!! We also appreciate the bottle of wine and box of pastries he left for us.    Our time in Lisbon was too short, and we hope that we can return someday and stay here again.  Thanks Joao!!

Wonderful location at the heart of the Alfama area. Appartment full of character with lovely terrace, very peaceful at night. Our host was very welcoming, collection at the airport much appreciated. We found some lovely restaurants in the area, two in particular Santa Maria and Velho Eurico, very tasty Portuguese food and wine👍🎉🍷🍷

L'appartement est très bien équipé et idéalement placé dans le quartier ancien et typique d'ALFAMA, proche des transports en commun très bien organisés à Lisbonne. Commerçants du secteur très sympas et parfait accueil par Joao qui nous a donné toutes les ficelles pour un séjour magnifique. Vraiment une belle découverte. Attention toutefois, valises à roulettes obligatoire pour arriver et repartir par les rues étroites, en pentes et comme partout à Lisbonne, pavées.

Great location and the apartment was as expected. Host's helped us with every thing we needed and close to the best pattiserie shop to get your local tarts. Its worth noting that the apartment does have towels, which was missing from the description.
A fantastic place to stay. Couldn't have asked for a nicer welcome and everything in the apartment was great.
I could have easily made this apartment my home.  Fantastic terrace, easily walkable to restaurants, city centre and shops.  Wish we could have stayed longer.
The apartment is perfect! We could not ask for anything better, we feel lucky to have found such a great place to stay, we hope to return again soon. Excellent in every way, thanks!

Tout était parfait! accueil excellent de Joao , appartement super
Nous nous sommes sentis parfaitement bien! Merci Joao pour tout

Beautiful apartment in an amazing location in Lisbon. Joao was extremely helpful, taking the time to sit down with us and review the must see places (including bars and restaurants) of Lisbon.
Apartment was very clean, and super well decorated.
on top of that, an amazing terrace where to sit back and relax.

Monica and Joao are super hosts. They love their town and enjoy sharing it with their guests. Joao told us of places to see and things to do.
Their home has 1 bedroom with a sleeper couch in the lounge. A fully kitted out kitchen, small dining area and bathroom.
The website states that one should pack light as there is a flight of stairs which you have to negotiate.. well this is so true, a very narrow and tightly packed staircase to the flat. Joao is extremly helpful in moving luggage. Also to get to the flat you have to traverse several interesting cobbled passage ways.
This little bnb is a must and you won't be disappointed.
Thank you Monica and Joao

Everything was perfect from the beginning to the end. Joao is always available to give any information and help. The apartment is exactly like description, warmly decorated and very comfortable. It is well located in a quiet place, surrounded by typical restaurants and shops. The route from airport to train station is easy as well. And from there it takes no long time to reach the apartment. Check-in and check out were easy. Nice presents were waiting for us when we arrived... A lovely attention we appreciated.
I hope I come back!!!

Joao was extremely gracious and helpful in showing us around and pointing out shops and cafes in the area.
We enjoyed Lisbon very much and intend to come back. We would enjoy staying here again.
Thanks João

Appartement de caractère très bien aménagé  avec une terrasse aussi jolie qu'agréable. La vue de la cuisine avec les bateaux qui passent su le Tage est très belle. Joao nous a accueilli de façon très sympathique et nous avons passé un très bon séjour.
Séjour très agréable dans ce bel appartement. Bien situé, au calme et avec une très jolie vue sur le Tage.

Die im alten Lissaboner Stadtteil Alfama gelegene Wohnung ist vom Flughafen aus mit der roten und blauen Linie (reine Fahrzeit gut 30 Minuten) bequem erreichbar (Kosten für eine Fahrt 1,40 € und für ein Tagesticket 6 € zuzüglich einmalig 0,50 € für die Karte, auf die das Ticket gebucht wird). Von der Endhaltestelle Santa Apolonia sind es etwa 7 Minuten Gehzeit zum Fadomuseum. Dort hat uns João nach einem Anruf abgeholt und zur 3-4 Minuten entfernten Wohnung begleitet. Die im 2. Geschoss gelegene Unterkunft ist über eine steile Treppe erreichbar. In der Wohnung konnten wir unsere Koffer bereits vor 16 h während der Reinigung abstellen und erhielten den Schlüssel. João gab uns außerdem Informationen zu interessanten Punkten in und um Lissabon.
Die Wohnung verfügt über ein recht großes Schlafzimmer mit einer eher zu weichen Matratze, eine Küche mit Sitzmöglichkeiten und ein Wohnzimmer mit zusätzlichem kleinen Essbereich. Dieser liegt 4 Stufen unterhalb des Flures, das eigentliche Wohnzimmer (mit Fernsehgerät ohne deutsche Programme) nochmals 2 Stufen tiefer. Direkt vom Wohnzimmer aus ist das Badezimmer über 2 weitere Stufen erreichbar. Die Terrasse ist recht groß. Ein Blick auf den Tejo ist aber eher von der Küche aus möglich.
Trotz des ruhigen Umfeldes liegt die Wohnung recht zentral (Bäckerei 1 Minute, Lebensmittelgeschäft 3 Minuten, Bus 5, Metro 10, Innenstadt ca. 15).
Insgesamt hat uns der Aufenthalt sehr gut gefallen.

The experience in Monica and Joao's apartment was wonderful. It was very comfortable, relaxing and centrally located helping us to have an amazing time. Joao is a wonderfully caring man who made us feel welcome. He is one of the main reasons we would stay in his place again. Truly a great experience.

João acted as the perfect host, and his charming flat offers wonderful views from the heart of Alfama.
I appreciated the communication in the days before my arrival, and the warm greeting I received when I met João. After familiarizing me with the apartment, he pointed out a number of recommendations for dining and sight seeing, identifying them on the map he provided. He then treated me to a cup of coffee (in addition to the gift of wine and cheese!) before offering to drive me to the nearby central market for my first meal in the city.
I cannot recommend João and his flat highly enough. An outstanding value.

Joao is the best owner we ever had on Air BnB ! he came to pick us up and carry our luggage up to the appartment . héas so generous of his time and gave us many very useful and good tips about many topics. very useful. the appartment is so special, cosy and the terrace is great (and rare!). everything is so clean. very confortable bed and furniture. the view is great and The owner took care of so many details (bought us egg tarts, milk, cafe wine, water, etc). the deco is great and refined and the location just perfect in the middle of Alfama and it is very quiet at the same time. WE really enjoy our stay and the generous and warm welcome of the owner. Just not enough long ! Watch out: the stairs are pretty steep!

My stay at this dreamy terrace was nothing short of amazing! João picked us up from the airport and brought us to the apartment. He also carried up our oversized luggages up the narrow, steep stairs for us! He acquainted us with the area, providing us with a map and list of places we must go. We took all of his suggestions and did not regret it! There was even a welcome bottle of wine for us! We felt at home here and lived like locals for our time in Portugal. We not only fell in love with the apartment but also Alfama. We would not hesitate to stay here again in the future, and absolutely plan to come back. Thank you Monica and João for an amazing experience!

It is an famous apartement in a fabulous surrounding!
Joao expected us as agreed. We had some wonderful days!

Thank you, Monica & Joao!

We loved staying here, everything was as described, it was spotlessly clean and everything we could need was there. It was nice and quiet, bright and cheery and so nice to wake with views over the Tagus. The wee terrace was a pleasure .

Joao was very warm and helpful settling us in giving us info on where to eat. We really enjoyed the Time Out Market just along the road.

We enjoyed the complimentary wine and Natos ... thank you .

It was very thoughtful having bottles of wine in the house which we could pay for ... saved us going hunting it down! A very nice touch.

5 stars all round Monica and Joao! Thank you for your kind hospitality.

Cathy, John and Pat
Un séjour formidable. L appartement de Joa et Monica est splendide

Das Apartment hat eine tolle Lage und eine super Aussicht aus der Küche. João ist ein sehr guter Gastgeber und hat uns viele Tipps für Lissabon und Umgebung gegeben. Die Einrichtung ist stimmig und es ist alles vorhanden was man braucht. Es war wirklich ein schöner Aufenthalt und Lissabon ist wirklich zu empfehlen.

In der Wohnung war es tatsächlich so schön, wie die Fotos es versprechen. Für 2 Personen ist sie richtig groß und sehr ansprechend eingerichtet. Sie liegt mitten in der Alfama und ist somit nur zu Fuß erreichbar. Der Empfang war sehr nett und Joao hat uns einige Tipps für unseren Aufenthalt gegeben.

Joao tool a lot of effort to support us with luggage and an odd arrival time. Lovely appartement with big outside area and a great view from the French balcony in the kitchen on the cruiseships arriving and leaving. Perfectly located to visit Lisbon.

A lovely flat, comfortable, light and airy with an outdoor terrace high up overlooking the red roofs of this ancient corner of Lisbon, right up to the river Tagus. Our wellbeing was enhanced by the kind help of our hosts, Jaoa and Monica. All of which made our stay in Lisbon a memorable and happy time, and our recommendations are heartfelt. Nevertheless a note of caution: Alfama is in a traditional part of Lisbon characterized by steep, narrow streets, and the stairways up to apartments are steeper and narrower still.  Anyone suffering from restrictions due to age or disability may find these challenging.  As I did myself but although our hosts offered to relocate us I was proud to stay the course!

Sehr charmantes und gepflegtes Appartement in ansprechender und angenehmer Gegend. Großzügig, sauber, hell, ruhig, bestens und geschmackvoll ausgestattet. Die Gastgeber sind überaus freundlich und hilfsbereit, den touristischen und kulinarischen Tipps von Joao sollte man unbedingt Folge leisten. Ich kann mir für uns keine angenehmere Unterkunft in Lissabon vorstellen! Obrigado an Monica und Joao!

We had a wonderful stay in this appartment. When we arrived, Joao met up with us and helped us getting in. His hospitality was heartfelt and we felt welcome instantly. He gave us lots of info and tips to spend our holiday as pleasurable as possible. Also, Monica and Joao left the most delicious pasteis de nata and lots of lovely stuff for us to eat in the fridge, which was overwhelming!
We would recommend this appartment to anyone and wish to thank our hosts for the great care! Obrigada!

Nous avons beaucoup apprécié l'accueil de Joao et les explications à notre arrivée.
L'appartement est conforme à la description et idéalement situé.
Il est très bien équipé pour un couple avec un enfant (lit, chaise haute) et les marches ne nous ont pas gênés!
Encore merci pour tout, nous espérons revenir un jour !
Joao was very helpful, friendly and communicative, responded quickly. The apartment was fantastic. We absolutely recommend both Joao and the apartment

We stayed only one night at João and Monica's apartment but we had a wonderful time. We should point out the exceptional assistance of our hosts before and during our stay. We arrived late in Alfama because of traffic but João patiently waited for us, welcomed us with excellent advice about the neighborhood, and was kind enough to walk with us to the closest supermarket still open for us to by some sea food that we later enjoyed on the apartment terrace. A wonderful and very sweet attention from him.
The apartment has a tremendous view on the Lisbon bay from the kitchen and the terrace is extremely enjoyable. Everything fully equipped in a super clean apartment.
Perfectly located in vibrant Alfama, seconds away from picturesque restaurant and cafés. An absolute recommend!

This was our second stay with Monica and Joao so it is clear that we really like the apartment and their amazing hospitality.  And cannot ask for a better location to enjoy the music, beauty and food of historic Alfama.

We had a warm welcome by Joao, who introduced us all the people in Alfama, and who made us discover the famous food such as pastries, cheese, ...
Thanks again for the time we spent together, and, if we come back to Alfama, I don't want to go somewhere else as in Joao and Monica's flat !

This was one of the best Airbnb experiences I've had. Joao met us at the Fado Museum (it's the closet spot to be dropped by car) and helped us to the apartment. He gave us great suggestions for places to go and things to do.

The custard tarts he left us from the local bakery were exponentially better than the famous ones in Belem!

The apartment has strong air conditioning in the bedroom. The bathroom is a decent size with a very nice shower. The bed was quite comfortable. Don't hesitate to stay with Monica and Joao!

Dear Jaoa and Monica
Thank you so much for the time you took to meet us, to park our car and the perfect guiding of the area and the restaurants.
We loved staying in your fantastic appartment, loved the interior, loved the terrasse with view over the roofs of the wonderful part of Lissabon, Alfarma, loved the view the from the kitchen over the City and river. Felt so much at home in your appartment and will for sure be back.
Best Air BnB ever!

Monica and Joao were the most welcoming possible hosts. Since I was getting in late and my folks were getting in early I didn't want to leave them hanging. Joao met with them early, gave them a map covered with activities, and sent them on a fantastic journey to kickstart their aventura Portugal. The house itself is obviously fantastic (as you can see from the photos) and the town is just as wonderful. Muito obrigado por todo

Nous avons été accueillis avec grandeur et générosité. Monica et Joao sont des hôtes parfaits, très disponibles et soucieux des gens. Ils sont vraiment dans leur élément. Le logement est décoré avec goût, d'une propreté exemplaire, bien équipé, confortable et calme. La terrasse est superbe, il fait bon si reposer après de longues et agréables marches dans la ville. Nous avons eu un coup de coeur pour le quartier de l'Alfama qui est très bien situé. Notre seul regret est de ne pas y avoir passé suffisamment de temps.
Lisbonne est une ville splendide où il fait bon de vivre au rythme doux des Portugais.
Nous gardons cette adresse précieusement en espérant y retourner bientôt.
Merci à vous Monica et Joao d'avoir fait de notre séjour un moment fort de notre voyage.
Et à vous locateurs, nous disons : N'hésitez pas, cette adresse est une valeur sûre, un laisser-passer pour un séjour mémorable vers l'authenticité du quartier de l'Alfama et l'extrême gentillesse des ses hôtes.
Ginette et Yvan
Québec, Canada

We had a wonderful stay in Lisbon and Monica & Joao's apartment was absolutely lovely - beautifully decorated, it was light and bright, with a stunning view of the river from the kitchen. The terrace is the perfect place to sit and enjoy the afternoon sun, looking out over the rooftops of Alfama. Joao and Monica were incredibly welcoming and accommodating, letting us drop off our luggage before the check in time and leave it after check out the next day so we could enjoy the sights without lugging bags around with us. Joao was really helpful on arrival and talked us through some good places to visit as well as recommending a number of local restaurants (we thought the first restaurant you come to just down the hill from the apartment was great - fantastic salt cod and sangria). He also very kindly bought us some delicious Pasteis de Nata and a bottle of wine. We will definitely be back and have recommended the apartment to family and friends. Thanks so much Monica and Joao for your hospitality - we were really sad to leave Lisbon!

L'accueil par João a été parfait : aucune difficulté pour le retrouver au rendez-vous fixé ; de nombreux conseils adaptés à nos attentes pour découvrir Lisbonne ; proche des stations de bus et de métro (pratique pour venir de l'aéroport) ; des produits locaux offerts...
Le logement est conforme au descriptif, propre, spacieux, bien agencé et bien situé dans l'Alfama. Le petit plus : les airs de Fado audibles depuis la terrasse le soir.
Monica et João qui nous avaient assuré de leur disponibilité en cas de besoin, ont répondu présents avec beaucoup de gentillesse lorsque cela nous a été nécessaire.
Nous recommandons vivement cet appartement que nous avons énormément apprécié durant nos 10 jours à Lisbonne.

Arriving in Lisbon and meeting Monica & João was like returning to old friends: A very warm and exceptional welcome. They even provided some food (very delicious!) and drinks for me and advised me about where to go and what to eat - which I can only recommend further!
The apartment is even more beautiful than in the photos and you can hear the Fado played downstairs every evening. I even got to chat with a Fado singer and a musician one evening.
The view over Alfama and the river is equally nice and the atmosphere serene. While I was there, the were numerous local fiestas, which invited to mix with the locals (and watch soccer as well).
I was very sad when I had to leave and hope to be back soon!

We had a wonderful reception from Joao. He was extremely helpful when meeting us, showing us the local area and advising us on the best way to spend our few days. The apartment and terrace were lovely and bright. The apartment is 'arty' and full of character and very comfortable. The area, although hilly, is really interesting being in the old part of Lisbon, we managed to navigate out way through the old streets to the center without any problems.
Thank you, we had a fantastic time and would love to come back!

Joao pick us up in front of the Fado museum. It was super easy and he is super friendly. He bring us to the Apartment, which is between the little roads in middle of the tourism center and Fado aria. He explained us everything with passion and shows us, where we can bye breakfast and which places are nice to discover.
The interior of the apartment is super nice, it is modern, new and clean. Made with Love! My friends and I had a super nice stay and missed nothing. We really recommended this apartment. You can discover Lisbon from there, you can walk or take the tram or crap one of the cheap taxis.

Eine sehr schöne saubere Unterkunft mit viel Platz. Die Terrasse ist Gold wert. In den Pausen oder abends kann man entspannt draußen sitzen oder morgens seinen ersten Kaffee trinken. Obwohl im Inn-Viertel Alfama ist es schön ruhig gelegen, abends hört man den Fado.
Von hier aus kann man gut fast ganz Lissabon zu Fuß erleben oder schnell in eine Strassenbahn steigen.
Joao hat uns vom Fado-Museum abgeholt und uns noch ein paar Tipps gegeben, er ist sehr nett. Die Abwicklung war superschnell und problemlos, alles auf Englisch.
Wenn 4 Personen in die Wohnung kommen, sollten sie sich gut kennen, der Weg zur Toilette führt durch das Wohnzimmer, in dem 2 Personnen schlafen. Finde ich ist kein Problem, sollte man nur wissen.
Danke, es war sehr schön und ist unbedingt zu empfehlen!

The apartment of Monica and João is just perfect: The central location in old Alfama, the quiet, well appointed terrace with nice views, the cozy rooms with many appealing details, …
It was a pleasure to plan the day in the morning on the terrace and end the day in the evening with a glass of wine and the varied great experiences in Lisbon.
Monica and João were from the first contact very interested to provide us with helpful information. The friendly and cheerful way to welcome us, has given the stay a special touch. We definitely recommend this beautiful apartment.
Joao nous a donné rdv pour nous accompagner à l appartement et nous a accordé du temps pour nous donner des informations sur lisbonne alors qu il était déja plus de minuit.

My partner and I were visiting Lisbon for just one day as a day trip from the Algarve. Right from the beginning João was incredibly helpful, he suggested which train station to go to and how it might be best to get there.

On the morning of our arrival João was happy to meet us much earlier than planned - he met us at 12.30pm even though our check-in time wasn't until 3pm. He showed us the way to the apartment through the historic and winding streets of Alfama and pointed out some history on the way.

When we arrived at the apartment...wow! It is beautiful. It is decorated to a high standard and the amenities are first class. The views from kitchen across to the Tagus are amazing and the terrace is the perfect place to have dinner. We even heard some Fado as we ate!

João had left us some wine, fruit and pastes du nata which was very kind. He also sat down with a map of Lisbon and pointed out all that we could viably do in a short 24 hour visit - we followed his advice and had a great time! The area is very historic and there is lots to see. Unfortunately the weather was bad and it rained a lot but this can't be helped.

The air conditioning unit in the bedroom is amazing and the quietest I have ever heard - it was barely noticeable as we slept. The bed is SO comfortable also.

Thank you Monica and João for such a lovely stay in Lisboa!
The photos don't do the place justice. Excellent location and beautiful apartment. Very helpful and informative host too.

Sehr hübsche Ferienwohnung in bester und ruhiger Lage mitten in Alfama. Schöne, sonnige Terrasse mit guter Möblierung und Grill, ansprechendes Wohn- und Badezimmer, große, optimal ausgestattete Küche mit tollem Blick vom franz. Balkon. Alles sauber und gepflegt. Unser besonderer Dank gilt dem liebenswürdigen Gastgeberpaar mit seinem herzlichen Empfang, den umfangreichen Erklärungen und Tipps sowie den kulinarischen Geschenken. Eine absolute Empfehlung !!!

Les échanges avant le voyage avec Monica et Joao se sont fait facilement et en français. Très sympathiques et organisés. Check in parfait : accueil à 5 min du métro (Santa Apolonia) pour nous guider jusqu'à l'appartement, bcp d'explications, pts cadeaux de bienvenue. Le quartier est typique, calme. Beaucoup d'escaliers dans le secteur de l'Alfama + escalier intérieur menant à l'appartement très pentu . Les photos sont conformes à la réalité. L'appartement est superbe : très propre, joliment décoré, calme et spacieux. Tout est prévu : vaisselle, linge de toilette, TV, lave-ligne, lave vaisselle et même congélateur... La terrasse est magnifique (parasol et transat prévu!) Bref tout est prévu pour passer de bonnes vacances. Je recommande vivement cet appartement.

Très bon accueil, très sympathique et simple.

L'arrivé dans l'appartement était parfaite : le quartier typique et très accueillant, bien situé pour commencer la visite de la ville, rien à redire.

L’hôte, Joao a même prit le temps de nous montrer sur une carte ce que nous pouvions faire pas loin du logement. L'appartement était très bien agencé, grande cuisine, salon très correct, et le couchage dans le canapé-lit tout à fait convenable pour quelque jours. Chambre spacieuse avec rangement. Vraiment agréable. Très propre, refait a neuf, vraiment top, sans parler de la terrasse bien exposée et très calme. Parfait !

Rien à redire, si je dois revenir sur Lisbonne, je prendrais certainement le même appartement, à conseiller sans hésiter.

Квартира очень комфортная и светлая, расположена прямо в старом городе, приятная терраса и шикарный вид с кухни. С террасы вид на маленький зеленый дворик. Единственно, может быть немного холодно ночью, но это мы северные люди избалованы центральным отоплением. Хозяин был гостеприимен, долго рассказывал что и как стоит посмотреть в Лиссабоне, где поесть. Всем рекомендую.

Great hospitality, thank u especially for wine and cheese :-). Really nice appartment in a really cool area.
Also thank you for the tips you provided to us.
We felt really well in the appartment - even if there was too much rain but I think I cannot blame you for this ;)).
Only little challenge were the stairs to the appartment - not that easy to climb with a baby.
5 stars from me!

Tout est parfait!! De L accueil de Joao qui nous a accompagné jusqu'à l appartement situé idéalement dans un quartier authentique magnifique et calme,en passant par les spécialités portugaises qui nous s'attendaient sur la table de la cuisine,et sans oublier le logement neuf,bien équipé,agréable à souhait!!! Un enchantement à quelques minutes du centre ville.....
From inquiry about this beautiful condo to booking ;to arrival; to staying for 2 days Joao was amazing to work with. Lisbon was our first stop on 4 month journey around the world

The apartman was the very same as in the pictures and description, or more beautiful. The view on Tejo, the terrace, the bedroom, the living room - I can't decide which was my favourite.
The welcome was perfect, as well. Joao is very nice and communicative person.
Thank you so much for staying at your apartman.

Den här lägenheten är en femstjärnig upplevelse. Utrustningen är första klass med diskmaskin, tvättmaskin, strykjärn, strykbräde, dammsugare - ja allt man kan behöva för en lite längre vistelse. Sängen är mycket bekväm och passar även den något överviktiga. Sänglinnen, handdukar och annan utrustning håller hög kvalitet. Läget är lugnt och vi hörde varken av grannar eller av det byggarbete som var på gång utanför köket. Terassen gör att man till fullo kan njuta av det härliga klimatet. Vill man gå ut och äta så har Alfama hundratals resturanger i olika prisklasser bara några steg från lägenheten. Jämfört med Skandinavien är priserna mycket moderata. Vinerna är goda och maten håller hög internationell nivå.
Har du svårt att gå i trappor är lägenheten inte helt optimal eftersom trappan i trapphuset fordrar viss ansträngning men å andra sidan får man sin belöning då man tagit sig upp.
Värdparet Monica & João är helt fantastiska människor som får dig att känna dig välkommen från första sekund. Det känner sin hemort väl och står gärna till tjänst med råd och hjälp i alla lägen. Vi kunde inte ha valt ett bättre boende och kommer att försöka finna plats hos dem även nästa gång vi är i Lissabon. Lägenheten är mycket populär och det lönar sig att boka i god tid.
Vi, Gitta och Nile bodde i lägenheten mellan den 30.11.2015 och 10.12.2015.
Vi kan varmt rekommendera både lägenheten och värdparet.

Super accueil de Joao convivial plein d'entrain nous informant sur toutes les possibilités de sa si charmante ville.
L'appartement est un vrai petit nid de bonheur tout y est parfait.
Bien sûr le quartier est tout en côte et descente il faut être en forme pour le visiter et atteindre l'appartement
Monica tout aussi sympathique nous a même conduite jusqu'au restaurant le soir de notre arrivée
A bientôt

Super appartement!! Propre, agréable et super bien entretenu!
je recommande! Quartier idéalement situé. A refaire sans hésitation!!
Réservez les yeux fermés, la terrasse et la vue vous comblerons!
Encore merci pour votre accueil et votre gentillesse!!

Die sehr saubere, gepflegte Wohnung liegt in der Altstadt von Alfama und ist umfassend ausgestattet. Von der Waschmaschine bis zum Geschirrspüler fehlt nichts. Die Einrichtung ist mit Liebe zum Detail. Wir haben es genossen auf der großen Terrasse zu sitzen und morgens konnten wir vor dem Küchenfenster die Ozeanriesen einlaufen sehen. Die Wohnung liegt zentral in der Altstadt, so dass alle touristischen Ziele fußläufig erreichbar sind.
Ein Bäcker, zahllose Restaurants und kleine Läden befinden sich in unmittelbarer Nähe. Trotzdem liegt die Wohnung sehr ruhig.
Die Metrostation St. Apolonia befindet sich in 500m Entfernung und eignet sich hervorragend zur Anfahrt auf den Flughafen (ca. 40 Minuten).
Die Gastgeber Monica und Joao haben uns einen herzlichen Empfang bereitet und uns willkommen geheißen mit einer Flasche Rotwein, etwas zu essen und zahllosen Tips für Lissabon.
Uns ist noch ein kleiner Unfall passiert und Monica und Joao haben sich rührend um uns gekümmert und bei den Behördengängen unterstützt. Weit über das übliche Mass hinaus. Vielen Dank an die großartigsten Gastgeber der Welt!
Wenn Lissabon, dann bei Monica und Joao!

We had an amazing time in Lisbon. We arrived early in the morning and agreed with Joao to meet on a square close to the apartment.
He helped with our suitcases and when we arrived at the apartment he took the time to tell us all about what to do in Lisbon.
His tips were very good.
The apartment was perfect, very clean, spacious and a wonderful terrace to where we had breakfast every morning.
The location of the apartment is also absolutely great, In a lovely authentic street and with a very cozy square you really experience the mediterranean life.
Overall we would absolutely recommend Lisbon and definitely the great apartment of Joao en Monica!

Monica and Joao are a perfect Portuguese couple and perfect Hosts. Joao was so kind to pick us from Museo do Fado and bring us to their lovely apartment. Monica was so nice and helpful, she made us feel like in home.

The apartment is located in the most romantic and picturesque neighbour of Lisbon, Alfama. It has a balcony with a breathtaking view of Lisbon and an incredible bedroom and living room. When we arrived, the house was clean and fully prepare for any common needs. On top of that, Monica and Joao gave us as some presents: a tasty bottle of red wine, bread and a cremy local cheese.

I would highlight the good communication with the host before and after the check-in, the insuperable location, the spotless apartment, and the warm welcome we received from the hosts.

Joao and Monica are great hosts , very helpful and have a wonderful apartment with an incredible view . We would always choose the apartment and thank Joao and Monica that they made ​​our stay in Lisbon special.

Wir haben uns sehr wohl und willkommen gefühlt. Mit den ganz persönlichen Tipps hatten wir einen sehr guten Einstieg in eine wirklich schöne Ecke der Stadt. Falls es uns wieder einmal nach Lissabon verschlägt, werden wir definitiv wieder bei Monica und Joao übernachten.

Realy a warm welcome in this lovely appartment. We could relax after our trip with a glas of whine and delicious snacks on the patio. The place was very good and joao and Monica were very helpfull. Thanks for the great stay.

Wir sind herzlich empfangen worden und Joao hat sich Zeit genommen uns Tipps für die Stadt gegeben. Die Wohnung ist super gelegen, mit allem Komfort ausgestattet und geschmackvoll mit Liebe zum Detail eingerichtet. Das Highlight ist natürlich die große private Terrasse.  Alles in allem eine der schönsten privaten Unterkünfte, die ich auf vielen Reisen bewohnt habe. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Auch bei Fragen oder Problemen sind beide jederzeit erreichbar und kümmern sich sofort. Ein dickes Danke, sollte ich wieder nach Lissabon kommen, dann wäre diese Unterkunft meine erste Wahl. Absolut empfehlenswert :-) Allerdings ideal zu zweit, zu viert wird es unserer Meinung nach etwas eng.

It was our first time in Lisboa and it was fantastic! The weather, the apartment, the district in wich the apartment is, the city and last but not least Monica and João Contreras, the owners who rented the house. Thanks, again, for the travel directions from the airport to Alfama, the hearthy greeting, the bottle of wine and the clean sheats! (And many more things). We will be back!
Best regards from Gerlinde and Alette from Holland.

Joao was so helpful and waited around most of the day for us to arrive when we missed our train. He sat down and gave us great recommendations about the surrounding area and made sure we had time to ask all of our questions.

The apartment is up very steep steps and it's gorgeous, and well appointed. I will definitely stay here again on my next trip.

Nous avons été très bien accueilli par Joao qui nous a guidé pour arriver jusqu'à l'appartement .Il nous a proposé un certain nombre de visites à faire en fonction de la durée de notre séjour. L'appartement,très agréable, est conforme à la description (y compris les photos), très propre, confortable  et  bien situé.Nous avons pu laisser nos bagages dans l'appartement un peu plus tard que prévu (car les autres hôtes arrivaient un peu plus tard ). Ce qui nous a permis de continuer à visiter cette belle ville .Et petite attention très agréable, nous avons  eu droit à une bouteille de vin rouge et 2 "pasteis da nata" pour démarrer notre séjour . Merci beaucoup pour tout

Ce voyage à Lisbonne était un cadeau pour nos parents. Ils ont adoré le séjour chez Monica et Joao.
Un appartement agréable, spacieux, bien équipé,très bien placé en plein coeur du quartier le plus typique de la ville.
Ils ont été ravis de l'accueil de Joao, de ses bons conseils et de sa gentillesse et de sa disponibilité.
Une adresse à connaître et à partager.

We had a wonderful stay in the apartment. It was perfect for us and in such a brilliant part of Lisbon.  Joao was incredibly kind and helpful - meeting us and guiding us to the apartment through the narrow little streets and going to a lot of trouble giving us helpful advice on which restaurants to go to. Our flight was delayed and so we were late arriving. Joao had even gone to the trouble of leaving lunch ready for us in the apartment on our arrival.

Joao is a very nice and helpful guy. He picked us up at the airport and drove us to the apartment. The apartment is in a very nice neighborhood in the center of alfama. You can arrive a lot of beautiful places by walking. The equipment in the apartment is perfect and you can find everything to make your stay comfortable. Some wine and water is in the fridge and makes the arrival so nice. We will definitely come back to Monica and Joao. Perfect stay for short and long trips in Lisbon.

We had the best time in Lisboa. Joao met us although we came a bit late, he explained us everything we wanted to know about the city and even came with us to park our car (we came from the north). The apartment is super clean designed and we enjoyed it very much. The location is superb.

Monica & Joao's Appartment liegt sehr zentral in dem angesagten Viertel Alfama und ist umgeben von netten kleinen Restaurants und Lokalen. Dennoch ist es sehr ruhig und verfügt über einen wunderschöne Terrasse. Es ist einfach perfekt für eine gute Zeit in Lissabon. Wir wurden herzlich mit Wein und Mehlspeisen empfangen und bekamen sehr brauchbare Tipps für unsere Reise. Sehr, sehr empfehlenswert!!

Excellent accueil de Monica et Joao ! sourire, serviable, disponible, très sympathique ! l'appartement dans le quartier de Alfama est superbe, très bien entretenue et d'une grande qualité! Emplacement idéal, en plein cœur du quartier mythique!
Je recommande vivement cette location !!

João qui nous attendait comme convenu devant le musé du Fado nous a accueilli très chaleureusement et nous a présenté le quartier et son appartement. Il nous a conseillé les meilleurs endroits. Son appartement correspond parfaitement à la description et aux photos. Il est très bien équipé et il ne manque rien. Le quartier est typique et animé mais l'appartement est très au calme. C'était parfait et nous serions bien restés plus longtemps. Merci João.

Apartament jest wspaniały, zdjęcia dobrze oddają rzeczywistość. Lokalizacja - perfekcyjna! Po przyjeździe zostaliśmy bardzo ciepło przywitani przez Monikę i Joao, otrzymaliśmy mnóstwo pożytecznych wskazówek jak dobrze spędzić czas w Lizbonie i okolicy - warto było posłuchać :) czekał nas też miły poczęstunek :) nasz czas w Lizbonie był wspaniały!

Monica & Joao are very kind.
Very nice and comfortable space!
We had a wonderful stay at Joaos and Monicas place. Joao was really friendly, helped us with some "where to go" tips. Their flat is great and good located. Thank you!

Wir wurden herzlich von Monika und Joao empfangen. Zur Begrüßung standen auf dem Küchentisch ein typischer Käse, Brot, Kuchen und Wein. Die Wohnung ist geräumig, sehr gepflegt und geschmackvoll eingerichtet. Sie ist ruhig und sehr günstig in der Alfama gelegen. Von der Küche aus hat man einen herrlichen Blick über das Dächermeer und den Tejo - wir haben immer am Abend eine Weile an dem französischen Balkon in der Küche gesessen und die Aussicht genossen.

Die Küche ist sehr gut ausgestattet. Gerne haben wir auf der großzügigen Terrasse unser Frühstück eingenommen oder den Abend verbracht.

Die Beschreibung und die Fotos entsprechen absolut der Realität.

Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und können diese Wohnung und die freundlichen Gastgeber, die uns über die Umgebung engagiert und ausführlich informiert haben, ausdrücklich empfehlen.

Karl-Heinz und Karen

We had a very nice travel to Lisbon and loved to live in Joaos and Monicas Apartment. Joao was a really gentleman and helped us with the suitcases, after that he gave us some examples, where we could find the nicest places in the city. And yummy, yummy - thanks for the natas, the he gave us as a gift :-)
The apartment is absolutely nice, espacially the terrace. It's just five minutes to walk to the nice Puntas Sol, where you have a fantastic view over Lisbon. With the famous "28" you can travel nearly directly to the apartment, it's just a 2-3 minutes walk. An absolutely nice time in Lisbon. Thanks a lot for all, Joao and Monica! :-)

We stayed in Monica and Joao's apartment for one week in July. They are a very friendly couple and their apartment made our stay in Lisbon extremely pleasant. Joao picked us up nearby when we arrived and helped us with our bags. The short walk to the apartment he showed us where to buy fresh fish, bread and pastries. He also recommended some restaurants on the way that we later tried, they were excellent! The apartment is fantastic. Fully equipped with everything you need for a great vacation. Comfy bed and AC in bedroom. A large terrace where we ate our breakfast and we even got a bottle of wine, cheese, and some pastries when we arrived at the apartment that we could enjoy on the terrace while listening to Fado-music from the streets. We loved everything about this welcoming, fresh and clean apartment. Thank you Monica and Joao!

Our hosts were incredible - they were especially welcoming, provided quick responses, and even met us at a nearby location to help us with our luggage and findparking.  As we arrived around noon, they allowed us to store our luggage in the apartment prior to check-in at 3pm which was wonderful.  We really appreciated this gesture. Further, they helped make a reservation for Fado nearby which was a wonderful, intimate experience.  As to the apartment, it is very spacious and has a lovely terrace out back where we enjoyed a glass of wine and even a meal.  They even left us a few welcoming goodies (breads, cheese, wine, pastries) - a lovely personal touch.  I loved the interaction with the host and really enjoyed the apartment.   It is true that you can easily get lost in the historic district of Alfama which adds to the charm.  It was great to always have that closeby proximity point - Museo de Fado - to always help us find our way back if lost. It was also a short 10 minute walk to the City Center and could easily get around the city from this apartment.  Thanks for making our stay in Lisbon welcoming and charming.

This was an outstanding experience staying in Monica and Joao's flat! Joao welcomed us upon arrival, carried our bags up the narrow alleyways, and gave us travel tips and a snack upon arrival. The apartment is clean, well-equipped, and in a historic part of Lisbon.
A lovely light and clean apartment with a sweet terrace in Alfama. João was waiting for us and couldn't have been more helpful. Lots of great advice. Perfect for our 2 night stay.

We spent three wonderful nights at Monica and Joao's apartment! Our hosts were exceedingly helpful regarding sites to see, and places to enjoy.  Their apartment is modern, and has every convenience. Yet it is located in the heart of one of Lisbon's  most historic  neighborhoods. We experienced the best of the old world,  and the new in their home!  Many thanks to Monica and Joao! This was an  experience we will cherish!

We had an amazing experience. The house is beautiful, all looks as in the pictures, everything very clean, cosy, handy. We loved it! Fantastic view from the kitchen balcony on the roofs of Alfama and very relaxing terrace. We were welcomed very warmly, Joao went to pick us up, spent time with us explaining various tips and recommendations what to do and where to eat in Lisboa. As welcome present we even received a bottle of very nice Douro wine and local sweet pastry, delicious.
The neighbourhood of Alfama is somehow magical, we absolutely loved it. The house is really well located, walking distance to many sight of Lisbon. All in all, we had amazing time, thank you!

Many thanks to Monica & Joao for their availability and nice welcoming! They provide us some good advice to discover Lisboa and its surroundings (Sintra & Cascais).The flat was also really nice with a good location in Alfama. We spent good time un Portugal thanks to them :-)

Merci beaucoup à Joao qui nous a reçu si chaleureusement. L'appartement est très confortable et très bien situé. Les conseils avisés de Joao nous ont permis de découvrir Lisbonne et de pouvoir apprécier ses différents quartiers. Notre séjour fût bref mais nous reviendrons ...
Je recommande vivement ce logement au cœur de l'Alfama.

Monica und Joao sind großartige Gastgeber! Bei einen Begrüßungsgetränk direkt gegenüber des Museu do Fado haben Sie uns schon einige tolle Insider-Tipps zu Lissabon allgemein und Alfama im speziellen gegeben. Im Appartement standen dann sogar noch eine Flasche Rotwein und ein paar Pasteis de Naja für uns bereit.
Die Räume sind sehr geschmackvoll eingerichtet und die Atmosphäre der wunderschönen Altstadt lässt sich bereits morgens beim ersten Kaffee mit Blick auf dem Tejo, bis hin zum Abend auf der Terrasse mit Fado-Gesang im Hintergrund, erleben.
Wir kommen gerne wieder und können die Wohnung von Monica und Joao nur jedem Lissabon Besucher Empfehlen.

Monica und Joao sind perfekte Gastgeber! Jede Anfrage wurde sofort beantwortet, die Übergabe der Wohnung war sehr gut organisiert, das Appartement ist sehr gepflegt und sehr sauber. Wir sind recht spät angekommen, das war kein Problem, wir wurden persönlich begrüßt und eine Flasche Wein, Pasteis de Naja, Käse und Brot waren für uns eingekauft. Danke nochmal dafür! Die Wohnung ist gemütlich, liebevoll eingerichtet und die Terrasse ein Traum! Der Aufstieg zur Wohnung über steile Stufen lohnt sich auf jeden Fall. Die Lage ist sehr gut, man ist mitten in Alfama, aber auch die U-Bahn ist mit ein paar Minuten Fußweg gut zu erreichen. In unmittelbarer Nähe findet man alles, was man so braucht (Bäckerei, Lebensmittelladen, Restaurants). Wir haben von unseren Gastgebern noch wertvolle Tipps erhalten (Ribeira do Mercados,...), von uns gibt es daher auf jeden Fall eine Empfehlung, wenn wir nochmal nach Lissabon kommen werden wir uns auf jeden Fall wieder bei Monica und Joao melden.

I have rented several places in Alfama, but this is definitely the flat I have liked the best and as well as beautiful it is also the most practical and easy to live in, even for a longer time. This is my favorite flat!

The first time I saw it, I said to Monica & João "- It is like you made this according to my wish list!":
Well functioning and equipped kitchen (electrical stove, water boiler, dish washer, washing machine) end even with a river view.
Next to the living room a private terrace with a large parasol.
In the bathroom a wonderful shower and an electric towel rack.
In the bedroom a big comfortable bed and room for all your clothes.
A well functioning wi fi covers the living room and the terrace.

The flat is - for Alfama - unusually calm and quiet even when windows in the bedroom are open.

- All in all a very worry-free and lovely flat!

I stayed for three weeks and this place will definitely be my first choice next time I go to Lisboa.

It is also so very easy to get there, either going up from the Fado Museum or going down from the tram stop in Rua das Escolas Gerais.

The hosts are easy-going and relaxed people, quick in response and kind in their approach. João even drove in to Alfama at midnight to help me with a matter!

The drawbacks are very small and hardly worth mentioning, really:
- In the living room there are a couple of small glass brick windows giving daylight to the flat below. No real problem when you are aware of it.
- The steps in the staircase up to the flat are very steep, but they are not so many. You get used to it very quickly.
- During my stay, a lady left her dog out in the back yard for many days and it was crying so the whole neighborhood could hear it. This was a temporary thing that I think will be dealt with.

I hope to be back again very soon to enjoy Alfama and Lisbon from Monica & João's flat in Beco do Loureiro! <3

Die wunderschöne Dachwohnung in Alfama hat ein ganz besonderes Flair, ist sehr gemütlich und praktisch eingerichtet und liegt einfach ideal. Mit Auto oder Taxi ist die Wohnung allerdings nicht erreichbar, man muss also einige Treppen - bis hinauf zur steilen Stiege im Haus - überwinden, um das Feriendomizil zu erreichen. Trotz der Lage mitten in der Altstadt war es während unseres Aufenthalts sehr ruhig und angenehm, der Bäcker um die Ecke und das Lebensmittellädchen in der Nähe sowie jede Menge Restaurants rundum und natürlich der Ribeira do Mercados (große Markthalle mit genialen Essständen) in Laufweite lassen einfach keine Wünsche offen.
Monica und Joao sind sehr engagierte und liebenswerte Gastgeber, die sich wirklich bemühen jede Bitte zu erfüllen und möglichst viele Tipps zu Ihrer STadt zu geben.
Wir haben die Zeit dort rundum genossen und kommen gerne wieder.

Fantastic apartment in a wonderful location - was even better than described! Was great to meet Joao and his recommendations were spot-on - the seafood at Cervejeria Ribiera was some of the best I've ever had and the atmosphere there was brilliant! Would definitely stay here again

My wife and I were very happy with this apartment.  João was a fantastic host, and gave us a lot of tips on what to see and do in the area and Lisbon in general.  Made us feel very at home.  Apartment itself was clean and comfortable, and the location was excellent.   The two nights we were there were definitely not enough.

The apartment exceeded all our expectations and all equipment for a comfortable stay was there - including bed linen and towels.
We were welcomed by Monica with a selection of local delicatessens and a nice bottle of Portuguese red wine.
We'll definitely stay in this lovely apartment the next time we go to Lisbon. Highly recommended!

Best wishes
Annette & Ove

Très bon accueil ! Appartement vraiment agréable avec toutes les commodités nécessaires et une grande terrasse qu'on a adoré utiliser !
Appartement confortable.
Nous garderons un très bon souvenir de notre voyage à Lisbonne.

Nice and honest apartment with everything needed for a great getaway from home. We also find your pictures truthful.

Great neighbourghood and central position in the small streets of Alfama.

Joao was very helpful and friendly. We took your advice on the Ramiro restaurant and a bicycle ride from Cascais to the north and we were greatful for the tip.

Also we enjoyed the calm terrace very much.

4 stars from us because everything was clean, nice and just as functional and convienient as expected. We choose to reserve the 5-star rating for the absolutely extraordinary luxury accomodation.

Hence we give your apartment our very best recommendations in general.

Kind regards,
Tania & Jorn

Op verzoek van Joao schrijf ik deze review in het Nederlands.
De kennismaking was prettig. Nadat we ons bij het Fado museum hadden laten afzetten was Joao in 5 minuten bij ons, nam een koffer van ons over en bracht ons naar het appartement.
Daar heeft hij ruim de tijd genomen om ons wegwijs te maken ten aanzien van de wijk, de bakker, de slager en de kleine supermarkjes (allemaal op loopafstand van 5 minuten). Ook kregen we uitgebreid informatie over Lissabon en hij adviseerde ons naar Cascais te gaan en een deel van de kustroute te fietsen. Dat was zeer de moeite waard.
In de keuken stond een fles portugese wijn en 2 glazen voor ons klaar, 2 heerlijke natas (de zoete lekkernij van lissabon) en de fruitschaal ruim gevuld was.
Het appartement was schoon en we hebben, mede door het fijne appartement een fantastische week in Lissabon gehad.
We zullen het zeker bij onze vrienden aanbevelen.

João and Monica were amazing hosts and landlords! João not only took the time to give me and my friends some detailed infos and tips on what to do and see in Lisbon, but he immediately was on the spot when we had a problem with the toilet flush in the apartment and fixed it in no time! We could not have wished for a better accommodation and nicer hosts. My friends and I agree that we all would definitely stay at this apartment again next time we are in town!

Bei unserer Ankunft und schon vorher fühlten wir uns ausgezeichnet von Joao betreut, denn wir waren in guter Kommunikation über Treffpunkt und Zeiten. Hevorragende Tipps für unsere Unternehmungen haben wir von Joao erhalten. Die Wohnung ist genau wie beschrieben, einfach ganz großartig und super gelegen. Morgens kann man in einer kleinen, freundlichen Pastelleria, die nur 50 m von der Wohnung entfernt ist, Kleinigkeiten für das Frühstück besorgen..
Achtung, die Treppen im Haus sind sehr steil - also nichts für Gehbehinderte! Wir danken Joao und hoffen, dass er immer ein so liebevoller Gastgeber bleibt!
Birgit & Reinhard

Appartement très agréable, très fonctionnel, bien équipé et décoré avec goût. Facile à rejoindre à partir de Santa Apolonnia (métro)
Accueil chaleureux et souriant de Joao et Monica qui ont a cœur de vous donner les clés pour vous faire passer un bon séjour.
A recommander grandement!

Quand on arrive dans l'Alfama, on est déjà subjugué par ses petites rues dignes d'un décor de film. Le quartier est vraiment charmant et quand on arrive a l'appartement on est totalement sous le charme. Très beau, très pratique, tout est là pour passer un bon week-end ou une bonne semaine au choix, dans tout les cas, on resterait bien un peu plus que prévu. Et en plus Joao est disponible, très sympathique et vous accueille avec pleins de bons plans, et des petites attentions très agréable.
Je ne vois pas quoi demander de plus.
Je conseille. :)

Gorgeous apartment and stunning setting and views! We loved our time there and did not want to leave. The apartment had everything that we needed and we loved having breakfast in the kitchen looking out over views of the river and rooftops. Joao was so helpful and friendly! With welcome natas and wine and fruit we were so grateful. We would love to come back and stay again one day!

Wir hatten eine wunderbare Zeit in der Wohnung von Monica und Joao! Die beiden haben uns sehr herzlich empfangen und neben sehr nützlichen Tipps für die Umgebung sogar eine Flasche leckeren Wein und ein paar Kleinigkeiten zum Essen besorgt.

Das Apartment bietet alles, was man sich wünschen kann. Eine liebevolle Einrichtung, phantastische Lage und einen tollen Blick über den Tejo. Wir werden gerne wiederkommen!

Vielen Dank und bis bald,

Claudia & Tobias

Accueil très chaleureux par Antonio et charmante attention de nos hôtes à notre arrivée : vinho tinto et spécialités locales nous attendaient !

L'appartement est encore plus beau et plus grand en vrai que sur les photos : il est bien pensé et très agréablement décoré : on se sent tout de suite chez soi !

La vue de la cuisine est dépaysante et la grande terrasse est parfaite pour déguster la cuisine locale, même en plein hiver ! Allez y :-)

Joao was an excellent host, he came to pick us up in front of the Fado museum although we had a really late night flight. After that he helped us carry our bags and gave us all the information we needed. This cozy, clean and well equiped appartment is in the heart of charming Alfama quarter which is ideal as a base for your stay in Lisabon. We loved it!
Thank you Monica and Joao (especially for the bottle of good portugese wine :)

We had a wonderful week long stay in João and Monica's apartment. It's situated deep in the heart of Alfama, Lisbon's oldest neighborhood. The apartment has been fully restored, is tastefully furnished and is exceptionally clean. The kitchen is well appointed -- even has a dishwasher for nights that you want to prepare meals in. There is a small grocery, a vegetable shop, a butcher (also selling local cheeses) and a pastry shop all within a couple minutes walk. The apartment also has a lovely balcony overlooking the Tagus and a cozy private terrace with seating and a barbeque grill.

Communication with João is easy and uncomplicated and he is very responsive. Upon our arrival, he met us promptly and helped us with our luggage. He also left us some wonderful treats and a bottle of wine as a welcome gift. This is our fifth visit to Portugal because we love the country and it's hospitable people. João is certainly no exception. I am grateful for the opportunity to meet him and stay in his lovely apartment. Thanks so much João for being such a gracious host!

My boyfriend and I stayed here, and we absolutely LOVED it! Joao made us feel very welcome--he even brought us dinner on our first night! The neighborhood is beautiful, and there's a delicious restaurant right below the apartment. The house is very modern with a lovely terrace and a balcony. I can't wait to come back!

The flat is absolutely lovely and Monica and João were lovely hosts.
They were there to welcome us and had great tips for us to start our explorations of Lisbon. They even left us some pasteis de nata as a surprise welcome!
The location couldn't be better as everything is walkable as well as having buses and trams nearby. Charming Alfama fills up with Fado at night so you can virtually listen to it from the gorgeous terrace over a glass of Douro... We'd be back any time.
Great place to stay, both location and the aparment itself. The hosts were so sweet and were flexible with check-out/in. We can highly recomend it!

Very nice apartment - perfectly equipped - excellent view to the Tejo and a very nice terrasse......
Very nice welcome performed by Monica and Joao....
We recommend this apartment to all....
Brillant! A Great Location! Nice Appartement und they were so Kind! Any time again..

We had a great time at Monica & Joao's. The hosts were very hospitable and considerate. They gave us a lot of good advices and tips about Lisbon. The appartment was lovely, very cosy and clean. It has all types of equipment and linen you would need. The terrace with a barbecue was a great place for the quiet dinner. Joao and Monica you are great, thank you for the excellent vacation, we would love to come to your place once again!

Joao est venu nous chercher devant le musee du fado pour nous accompagner jusqu'a l'appartement. L'accueil etait tres chaleureux avec fruits, patisserie et eau fraiche ! Ils nous ont ensuite donné des conseils et de bonnes adresses. L'appartement est tres sympa et plus grand que sur les photos ! La terrasse est appreciable pour prendre le petit dejeuner. Au coeur de l'alfama, un emplacement authentique et calme. Je recommande cette adresse sans hésiter

Monica und Joao waren sehr freundliche Gastgeber! Sie haben uns sehr freundlich und herzlich begrüßt. Das nette Ehepaar hat sich fast eine Stunde lang Zeit genommen uns (sehr informative!) Insidertipps für Lissabon (und die Algarve) zu geben! Die Wohnung war äußerst sauber und WUNDERSCHÖN! Die Einrichtung ist sehr liebevoll und detailreich. Ein absolutes Highlight sind der Ausblick aus dem franz. Balkon in der Küche und auf der großen Terasse. Man sieht über die Dächer von Alfama bis hinunter zum Meer. Die Lage ist Ideal um ganz Lissabon zu erkunden und trotzdem ruhig. Auch zu viert wäre die Wohnung sehr geeignet. Wenn wir das nächste Mal nach Lissabon kommen, werden wir bestimmt wieder diese tolle Wohnung buchen :-)

Nous avons séjourné 4 nuits dans cet appartement. Nous avons été accueillis chaleureusement par João qui n'a pas manqué de nous donner de bons conseils sur les "bons plans" (lieux, resto, ..) de Lisbonne et de ses environs. L'appartement est très agréable, on s'y sent comme à la maison. Tout y est bien pensé. Nous avons profité de la terrasse, le soir, au doux son du fado. Le quartier est très calme, on en oublie que l'on se trouve en plein cœur d'une grande ville. Nous recommandons fortement cet appartement.
They were great host and the flat is in a good location

L’appartement est agréable et bien placé, à 5-10min à pieds du centre. Je pense que les photos sont un peu vielles par ce que l’appartement est quand même dans son jus surtout au niveau des salles de bains et un peu des chambres. Cette chambre là est bien car elle est séparée des autres. Nous n’avons pas beaucoup vu les autres locataires car nous ne sommes pas restés la journée dans l’appart. Mais le partage des espaces se fait bien, les murs sont un peu fins et on entend mais c’est correct. Le quartier est sympa avec plusieurs restaurants cool en se baladant même si le soir ça zone un peu. Le propriétaire est facilement joignable donc top! Je pense que ça convient très bien pour des étudiants en voyage qui souhaite un logement abordable sans que ce soit du luxe. Et Lisbonne est super sympa à visiter ! Merci !
All good :)
Muito atencioso e manteve uma comunicação ágil e precisa. O condiz com o que foi anunciado.
Ambiente bem organizado e limpo. Instruções claras e precisas. Sem problemas.

Super host and experience! Rafael has been hosting for over 11 years and has added modern details to an old apartment, for a perfect stay.
I loved the quiet bedroom and comfortable bed (perfect for sleeping), the fully equipped kitchen, the plants in the shared area, and easy check-in and check-out. I really appreciated the daily cleaning.
Rafael is thoughtful too. He provided an extra blanket (because it was winter). And for my 2 week stay, he provided an extra set of towels.
Excellent communication - clear check-in instructions with many photos; he responds immediately to messages; and happily shares his knowledge about the Portuguese language, the history of Lisbon, and local places to eat and visit. Talk to him about your travel plans because he has great suggestions.
The apartment is in a great location - the area is historic and it's walkable to all the highlights of the city. What can be better than that when visiting Lisbon!

Die Unterkunft von Rafael hat eine tolle zentrale Lage und es ist problemlos möglich sich Lissabon von hier aus zu Fuß anzuschauen. Unser Zimmer war sehr sauber und roch direkt beim Betreten des Raumes nach frischer Bettwäsche. Wir fühlten uns sehr wohl und können einen Aufenthalt hier sehr empfehlen.

Está muy bien ubicado muy cerca a zona turística y transporte público. Si se va acompañado se siente segura la zona. Tuvimos un inconveniente desafortunado, después de la segunda noche amanecimos llenos de picaduras de ácaros :( esto nos perjudicó el resto del viaje. El anfitrión muy atento y cordial y cambiaron de inmediato las sábanas, pero pienso deben tomar medidas frente a ello, cambiar cada tanto por nuevos, lavar con agua caliente, usar productos especiales para evitar o minimizar esto.

Zona comodissima e super ben fornita. a 15/20 minuti a piedi si raggiungono i più bei punti panoramici della città, e il centro. Il quartiere multietnico l'ho trovato davvero interessante. Per quanto riguarda l'alloggio è molto carino a mio parere, un po' vecchio stile ma ha il suo perché. Ci ritornerei molto volentieri, ma apprezzerei una maggiore pulizia per quanto riguarda il bagno! in ogni caso bel soggiorno.

a short one night stay but found lots to do around for the next time. it will be a pleasure to come back again. the place is well cleaned.
shame the selective waste that Rafael put in place is not respected even though the instructions are clear. That made the kitchen feels a bit messier.

Buona posizione rispetto ai Luoghi da vedere
Difficoltoso il parcheggio di auto, solo a pagamento e poca disponibilità

Um lugar é muito confortável, bem cuidado pelo Rafael que foi muito gentil ao nos receber. A localização é ótima, perto de vários lugares legais para caminhar, restaurantes, conveniências. O anfitrião nos deu ótimas dicas e sempre respondia com rapidez. Recomendo o local 🩷
If you want to be in a energetic neighborhood, with lots of fun, funky things to see, this place is for you!
Fantastic host, I recomend him strongly!
Boa localização e ótimo custo benefício, fácil acesso aos principais pontos turísticos, Rafael responde muito rápido, recomendo.

👍🏽
Very central and easy check in
👎🏽
The room did not match the pictures at all:
Mattress was only on a slatted frame - a kind of folding bed, not a real bed
Bed squeaked extremely
Thin mattress
Unfortunately very run down…
Bon séjour, je le recommande

El apartamento está muy bien ubicado, a pocos minutos caminando de varios lugares turísticos, lo cual lo hace muy conveniente como punto de partida para explorar la ciudad. Es amplio, estaba limpio a nuestra llegada y en general la experiencia fue buena.
Dicho esto, hay algunos aspectos por mejorar: la cama resultó incómoda ya que el colchón no era cómodo y hacía ruido con cada movimiento, lo cual afectó bastante nuestro descanso durante las noches. Las almohadas tampoco eran muy buenas.
Al llegar, el conductor del Uber desde el aeropuerto comentó que la zona podía ser insegura, aunque en nuestra experiencia no tuvimos ningún problema.
En general, es una opción práctica y bien ubicada, con algunos detalles de confort que, si se mejoran, harían la estadía mucho más agradable.
