Self check in and everything, clear check in instructions, convenient location, room and bathroom pretty clean👍🏻 only thing is really follow his description of the route to the place, because first time I just followed google map, and there’s a lot of stairs, make sure to read the description carefully.

sijainti todella hyvä. asunto vastasi kuvausta täysin. Mouraria on alueena todella kansainvälinen. Erittäin ystävällisiä ihmisiä. Yöllä sai nukkua rauhassa, ei ollut meteleliä. Kävellen löytyi paljon nähtävää. Lissabon on ihana, kaunis kaupunki.
Suosittelen Rafaelin majoitusta lämpimästi.

Buen alojamiento relación calidad-precio. Está subiendo una cuesta y tiene escaleras por lo que si tienes movilidad reducida no es tu opción. Al margen de esto la habitación era cómoda y el baño y la cocina contaban con todos los elementos necesarios para una estancia corta. No es que esté ubicado en todo el centro, pero sí que a pocos minutos andando puedes llegar sin problema.

The host was incredibly kind, polite, and communicative, which made my stay so comfortable. The suite was in fantastic condition, and everything was perfectly prepared. I highly recommend this lovely Airbnb and would be happy to stay again.
Acomodação ótima, limpa e organizada. Completa com tudo que precisamos. Os arredores de madrugada é um pouco barulhento e com uma comunidade bem cheia de indianos, mas nada que atrapalhe.
Perfekte Lage, leider sah das Zimmer nicht wirklich so aus wie auf den Bildern. Das Bett ist ein ganz anderes ohne Kopf- und Fußteil. Ansonsten war alles super.

As far as accommodation, u get what u pay for. Everything is clean, spacious and private.
The only bad thing is that u dont get much sleep because of the noise outside untill late night , u are located in some sort of indian pakistani hood area. When u close the windows its fine, but then u get the neighbors from above who makes too much noise, not caring about other people. And then if its not them, then other people from accomodation doesnt respect the 11-7 rule.
I know its not something that owner can help, but its the only thing that stands out that needs mentioning.
War super!
Was een fijne locatie en een mooi gebouw. Alleen de sloten zijn wat ouder dus soms wat lastiger open te krijgen.

Amazing location , great space . you can work around the neighborhood.
the host was really good , very communicative , provided all the information needed .
Will surely book again when visiting

En general estaba todo estupendo, el barrio céntrico y el piso muy limpio y muy bien equipado. Eso sí el barrio céntrico pero tuvimos un altercado por la noche con un hombre que nos quiso atracar. Preguntamos a la gente de la zona y no le resultó raro del todo.
War alles gut. Nachrichten wurden schnell beantwortet. Die Gegend ist etwas gruselig, aber war am Ende echt okay und man war sehr schnell in der Stadtmitte:) gern wieder

Wir waren für eine Nacht dort.
Der Check-In ging einfach, ohne Probleme.
Die Unterkunft/Zimmer war genauso wie beschrieben. Es gibt zwei Bäder, die man sich mit anderen Gästen teilen muss, daher gab es ab und an die Situation, das man mal warten musste, bis man in eins der Bäder konnte. Die Lage ist an sich in Ordnung, nur bei Nacht hat man sich immer ein wenig unwohl gefühlt, gibt leider schon ein paar sehr merkwürdige Leute in der Gegend. Ein süßes Café haben wir auch in der Straße finden können.
Bad mattress and no ac
Overall great place!
Muy buen trato. Lo recomiendo!
El tipic9 lugar bueno,bonito y barato.Buena zona,buena ducha,y tofo lo necesario para unos dias en Lisboa.Gracias Rafael!

Apparemment fonctionnel bien situé dans un quartier authentique de Lisbonne. L’endroit est vivant, surtout le soir et la nuit. L’hôte laisse des instructions très claires et communiqué bien.
Nous recommandons.

We loved our stay here! The check in instruction were amazing, very clear and easy to follow.
The place was very clean and the room was nice and quiet, we slept so well. Walking distance to Alfama.
Rafael was great at communicating.
L’alloggio si trova nella zona di Mouraria che è una zona multietnica, comoda per gli spostamenti, vicina a una delle delle fermate del famoso 28. La visita alla città e’ stata indimenticabile.

Rafael was wonderful! We really appreciated the clear check in and check out instructions. He was friendly, kind, and his place overall has a cozy and charming feel.
Definitely recommend!
Alles bestens, schöne Unterkunft für eine Nacht in Lissabon! Jederzeit wieder.

It was a good deal for what we needed as we were only staying a night in Lisbon. Rafael gave great instructions on how to get our keys with plenty of helpful photos. The bed was comfortable and the room spacious enough for two. It did get very hot during the night and the fan did little to help unfortunately. We did have the window open but other apartments close by were very noisy with a baby crying close by for most of the night. Not Rafael's fault, obvisouly. I'd recommend the room for anyone travelling on a budget in the cooler months.
Rafael’s place is totally recommended!! He’s a super clear host and the apartment is in the perfect location :)
the airbnb had everything we needed! great location, great host, and always clean.

Very convenient location to explore old region of Lisbon. Instructions and recommendations were also very good. Unfortunately the parking was practically non existent near the apartment and it was a extremely difficult parking situation in the neighborhood.

Merci à Rafael pour les instructions claires et l’accueil dans son logement partagé. Très bonne réactivité, de bons conseils sur les restaurants c’est parfait pour un premier séjour.
Le logement est proche d’une station de métro très pratique.
Très bon logement! Rue tranquille mais quartier qui bouge beaucoup. Proche du métro! Prévoir des bons souliers pour l’ascension vers le logement!

Nice little spot in central Lisbon at a great price with a kitchen so you can cook etc.
Place was sparkling clean and instructions really clear.
I personally found the immediate area a little sketchy but that's nothing to do with the Airbnb itself.
Easy and great communication with Rafael
Rafael was a great host! Phenomenal at communicating and made our stay awesome
Lovely and big room for a decent price. Location was great and walking distance to everything.
È la seconda volta che alloggiamo nell’appartamento di Rafael, abbiamo rifatto tappa dopo alcuni giorni trascorso a sud. Tutto perfetto!

Apart from the lack of AC (got a bit hot during the night even in May, even with the fan) the appartment was perfect. At short distance from the heart of Alfama and of a subway station, it was perfect to explore most of Lisbon in three days.

Espaço muito limpo e organizado, exatamente como descrito. Facil de chegar.

Rafaels place is very handy to a lot of the old sites and attractions in Lisbon. I could say it does have the old world charm once you have been there for a day or so. We had a hire car and parking is quite difficult with nearly all places full day or night. The accomodation is adequate and appeared safe. Lisbon is very condensed and appeared full of all nationalities and tourists everywhere. We did have a power Cut to the actual building but Rafael sorted it quickly and is a very responsive host.

Nice

Si bien el alojamiento se encuentra en una muy buena ubicación cerca de muchos puntos turísticos y a un par de minutos del centro. Everything was great and exactly as described! We would stay here again :)

The space was super clean and Rafael was friendly and responsive. We took one of his recommendations on places to eat and we loved it. It was only for one night but perfect for that short stop. In the center and nearly all sights and views in walking distance. Only parking lots are stressful.
All Informationen from Rafael were easy to follow. We can recommend that apartment.

I was in room number four and I didn’t explore much but probably there are four bedrooms. At least for the night I was there, people were considerate and had left the common areas clean. The host was great about getting back to me with my various messages/questions.

The room is clean and near the Metro. It is located in old town and easy access to many popular sights. The landlord is nice and happy to provide useful information for the trip. I would like to recommend to those who want to visit Lisbon

Linda ubicación,  linda ambientacion,  buena limpieza.  Nos recibieron y nos facilitaron la información de la entrada y salida del lugar. Comodo aunque se escucha lo de las otras habitaciones.  Pero por el precio es buena calidad y recomendable.

A nossa estadia em Lisboa foi excelente. O espaço de Rafael correspondia ao anúncio, tinha todas as comodidades descritas e de fácil check-in e check-out.  Cama confortável,  quarto grande e iluminado, cozinha com o básico para fazer pequenas refeições. A localização é tranquila e fica a poucos minutos de caminhada para a área mais turística. Fizemos tudo à pé. Recomendamos com certeza.
Great place for exploring Lisbon. All the highlights are in walkable distance, and metro station is also very close. I loved the vibe on the streets in this part of Lisbon.

Rafael byl milý hostitel. Skvělé komunikoval a popsal příjezd. Ubytování bylo velmi čisté. We recommend the place, it’s good for a short stay to explore the beautiful city of Lisbon

La stanza era molto diversa da quella descritta. Inoltre, le lenzuola e le coperte erano in condizioni non igieniche. Il materasso sembrava infestato da cimici, poiché, una volta rientrato in Italia, ho iniziato a manifestare prurito su tutto il corpo e ho dovuto ricorrere all’uso di cortisone.
L’intera stanza era arredata con mobili vecchi, i muri presentavano evidenti tracce di muffa e le tende erano sporche. Ho soggiornato solo due notti, e meno male, perché restare più a lungo avrebbe potuto mettere seriamente a rischio la mia salute a causa della scarsa igiene.
L’appartamento,anzi la camera è di giuste dimensioni,molto datata nelle finiture e negli arredi. Ambienti puliti,ed istruiti ottime per potervi accedere.

It is very clean and comfy place. We were staying just one night but everything was great. :) Maybe area didn’t feel very safe at night but the host said it is so I believe it was just a feeling.
Es un poco lejos del centro pero accesible mediante autobuses. Muy cómodo con todo incluido, muy buena atención del anfitrión
l'appartement de Rafael est bien, bien placé par rapport au centre

Had a great stay with Rafael. He was very accommodating and let us drop off our bags in the living area before check in. Gute Ausgangslage für einen Tag in Lissabon.  Zweckmäßige Zimmer und gut ausgestattete Gemeinschaftsräume. Zentrumsnah mit tollen  Tipps vom sehr freundlichen Gastgeber.

Very nice place for one or two nights

apartamento super limpo! Eu surto bem ventilado e aconchegante.

I would recommend Rafael’s place if you’re looking for a cheap accommodation (with shared restrooms) in the city center to explore Lisbon. Great stay!

The building and area were full of Lisbon’s unique and charming historical character. Our room was clean and Rafael’s directions super clear. in other rooms in the flat.

Good location and Rafael was very helpful with any questions we had.

location fiable à la description,  facile d'accès et description pour arriver clair et précise, aucune difficulté à y accéder, les locataires du logement au dessus lors de notre séjour était plutôt bruyant jusqu'à tard, mais cela nous a 0as empêcher de passer un bon séjour, je recommande quand même
very nice location. easy to communicate with host. room was as described

Great stay!

Si abren la puerta para salir, te va a despertar porque suena fuerte. No hay ventilacion en la habitacion y se siente mucho calor. La zona de dia es movida y pintoresca pero de noche puede sentirse inseguro.
Logement correct pour le pour le prix payé

Zentral gelegenes und gemütliches Airbnb!

It has been a nice stay! The host was nice and always responsive. The place is very well positioned.

En general, el alojamiento fue lo esperado. Estaba limpio y la habitación era como se mostraba en las fotos. Aunque no está demasiado céntrico, se llega rápido, además hay escaleras mecánicas que te ayudan con las cuestas (las puedes encontrar en el mapa como Escadinhas da Saúde).
Por otra parte, Rafael es muy amable, si tienes cuestiones antes o durante tu estancia, te recomiendo escribirle a su número de teléfono, ya que sus mensajes de Airbnb son automáticos y no se detiene en resolver las cuestiones, pero por teléfono es sencillo comunicarse con él.
Lo peor (que no depende de Rafael) ha sido cuando llegaba gente con las maletas a las 6-7am, introduciendo las llaves y armando alboroto, cuando los huéspedes intentábamos dormir, han sido demasiado desconsiderados con los demás. Aún así, valoro positivamente que se puedan dejar las maletas en el apartamento a la llegada y a la salida, pero deberían ponerse horarios para no llegar de madrugada.
En resumen, recomiendo la estancia aquí.

I am a very light sleeper and even struggled with the street noise, however my partner who is a heavy sleeper was fine but also kept awake by the noise of the people staying at the same time. Although the first night other guests of the house arrived very late and making noise, it has nothing to do with what Rafael offered.

Die Lage der Wohnung war wirklich sehr gut, zur Innenstadt oder zum Castello hat man zu Fuss nicht lange. Das Zimmer war gross und man fühlte sich wohl.

Nice place, kitchen had everything you’d need, clean bedroom and bathroom. Great stay
Muito boa estadia, quarto e banheiros organizados e muito limpos. A localização também é muito boa e fica de próximo acesso ao metro. Com certeza recomendo!

We had a very good stay at this Airbnb, it was the first stop on our European trip - Rafael was very responsive, and the room was very clean, albeit smaller than we perceived through the photos, but lovely nonetheless! The other spaces were also pretty clean, especially considering that some of the spaces were shared. Both showers have an opening that does not allow you to fully enclose the shower space, though, which does lead to some water on the floor but this is mitigated by an absorbent mat. Overall, we had a good stay and found it to be of good value!
My expectations were,re right. It’s cozy, clean and nice for a student like me who came with a good friend.
All good and neat.
Instruções claras, fácil de realizar a entrada no apartamento, local com dois banheiros limpos. Essa acomodação está em um lugar bem central, acesso ao transporte público.
Good value.

Loved the place and had an amazing time, even though I only stayed one night. The only thing I didn’t like, was that when someone is using one of the two bathrooms, the hot water wasn’t constant but beside that minor factor, the overall experience was great and I will stay there next time I visit beautiful Lisbon ♥️
100% recommended!
Very nice convenient clean  and pleasant stay with quiet and nice atmosphere  but quiet strange at night the neighbourhood.
buena relación calidad precio
Sentimos em casa muito próximo de tudo ! Ele sempre rápido a responder grata

On the positive side, the communication with the host went well. He also makes sure to provide detailed instructions both on the application, but in the apartment as well, thus making sure everyone feels as comfortable as they can. The kitchen and bathrooms are decently equipped (coffee, tea, shampoo...), and the owner provided us with towels. He gives his best in order to keep the place as tidy as possible.
On the negative side, the neighborhood is very sketchy, I would advise not to roam the street alone at night. The bed is old, short and should be replaced. I'm 181 cm tall, and my feet were touching the bottom when sleeping. Pillows were not the cleanest, either. Our room had this nasty smell of moisture. Fortunately, we could keep the window open during the night. Also, there is something off with hot water, as it keeps lagging during the usage.

We only stayed one night and spent the day outside so we're not the best candidates to write a review but in general the room was big, comfortable and clean. Also the bathrooms were clean and provided with shampoo, body wash etc. We didn't use the kitchen.
One negative thing I'd like to mention for female solo travellers is that the area is a bit sketchy at night. Maybe nothing happens but I'd feel a bit unsafe if I were to walk the streets by myself at night.
Apart from that it is a convenient location with both metro station and bus stop just a few minutes away on foot. And one of the major view point with breathtaking view on Lisbon is only a 10-minute walk away.
bagno sporco e inutilizzabile. posizione comoda e strategica. stanza comunque pulita e ben sistemata
Rafael's place is conveniently located to the metro. very clean and early check at 1pm which was nice coming off a transatlantic flight.

We had a layover and stayed here for one night.  it was perfect for what we were looking for (just somewhere to sleep). The location is perfect, next to the metro, and was very clean. Would definitely book again!
Great place to stay in & easy access to central Lisbon

I would not recommend staying at this place. Although it's very cheap, the bedding felt unclean and extremely uncomfortable. The bathrooms were terrible and tiny, and the hot water even after ages was only a trickle. The area did not feel safe at all.

Check-in Informationen waren vom Gastgeber sehr gut beschrieben. Unterkunft liegt zentral und Sehenswürdigkeiten sind zu Fuß zu erreichen. Eine Metro Station ist auch in der Nähe. Leider ist die Unterkunft recht hellhörig aber für eine Nacht auf jeden Fall zu empfehlen.
Perto de tudo, ambiente limpo casa tranquila, adoramos!
The place and host were nice. The location is okay as well but a lot of men on the streets and felt a little bit dangerous at night.

È stato complicato parlare con Rafael, anche scrivendogli giorni prima. Quando finalmente siamo riusciti a contattarlo tramite un vicino è stato molto gentile e ci ha permesso di lasciare le valigie dentro all'immobile sia prima del check in che dopo il check out.
la zona non ci è sembrata molto sicura, soprattutto la sera. Per tornare a casa dopo cena abbiamo preferito prendere un Uber.

Die Wohnung ist zentral gelegen, alles gut zu erreichen.
Für den Preis absolut okay.
Die Küche könnte etwas besser ausgestattet sein.
parfait pour un passage de 2 nuits à Lisbonne

Hemos estado tres noches. La casa es antigua y le falta algunos arreglos (el pomo de uno de los baños, las cerrojos de las puertas complicados, donde dos veces tuvimos que pedir ayuda poder entrar en la casa y en nuestra habitación. También cuando cerrábamos la ventana, se concentraba un olor a cerrado y había que ventilar durante un buen rato.
Hay que destacar que en nuestra habitación al cerrar con llave, se podía observar un hueco entre el marco de la puerta y la puerta y eso hace que no haya demasiada intimidad ya que se puede entrever desde el pasillo de la casa, lo que también ocurre en la puerta principal.
La limpieza de la casa estaba bien pero depende principalmente del resto de los huéspedes.
La cocina bien equipada.
En conclusión, esta bien para pasar unos días y está bieen ubicado ya que se encuentra en el centro turístico de Lisboa.
Godd place to stay for short rips

Come mi aspettavo: ottimo rapporto qualità/prezzo. Non è un albergo 5 stelle ma sei hai piacere di incontrare qualche ospite come te che viene da chissà dove, è il posto giusto. Ottimo per la posizione centrale in città
Super Lage, parken hat sich etwas schwierig gestaltet.
Thank you so much for the help,the pizza and the Fado Restaurant recommendation.
La zona era perfecta para nosotros y Rafael nos recomendó varios sitios para comer. Súper amable, con incluye toallas, café, etc GENIAL!

Pretty house, cozy room and my partner loved espresso.
Nice location!
Gute Unterkunft. Einfache Kommunikation. Lage war ok, man kann zu Fuß alles gut erreichen. Der Gastgeber war sehr höflich, bemüht und entgegenkommend.

The AirBnB is easy to find and the check-in is very flexible with door-codes. The room was decorated a little bit differently than on the photos and it was quite loud at night because of the noisy neighborhood and the traffic. The bed is a little bit short for tall people and since it’s an antique apartment, especially the kitchen and bathrooms could use some renovations. Though the room was clean and the communal areas were also cleaned everyday,  of course the bathrooms were not perfectly clean because they were used by other guests. Besides that, Rafael is easy to contact and helps you with all your issues. There is shampoo and soap for the guests. The location of the apartment is good and you can reach almost every sight walking by foot. Since the neighborhood is quite busy, we felt safe, but maybe you should know that at night there are some homeless people around, people are selling drugs and we almost exclusively saw men.
Ik zou zeker terug komen !
Rafael foi super atencioso e o apartamento dele é ótimo, o quarto tem luz e fica numa rua tranquila num bairro lindo e perto de tudo. Recomendo!!

A perfect first impression of Lisboa. We felt like locals staying here, just off the main tourist block. Our room was spacious and cool with a window and view. The house is super clean and even the shared bathroom was absolutely fine. We actually didn’t see one other guest while staying here and there were 5 other rooms which were all booked. Rafael was great and we have stored a bag with him for the week while we walk Camino.
Rafael was very easy to communicate with, gave all the necessary steps to get inside and made it a very easy process. Good location and very easily accessible from metro.
We really enjoyed staying at Rafaels place. Very central, clean and the host is responsive. The only issue is noise as the location is central ( it comes with perks).
Todo correcto, el alojamiento es como en las fotos, habitación limpia y Rafael un anfitrión encantador.
Spent a great few days in the apartment, which was well situated for visiting central Lisbon and very comfortable.
Very clean and very kind/flexible host. Would recommend.
I loved visiting Lisbon and staying at Rafael’a place
Our stay in one of Rafael’s room was very pleasant. Rafael was a very kind and helpful host. His place is well located to explore the city and had everything we needed.
Stayed for 4 days, no issues at all and a helpful host

My recent stay at this Airbnb was absolutely amazing! The accommodations were fantastic, Rafael was super friendly and attentive, and the location was perfect. I highly recommend it for a memorable getaway! 5 stars!

Great location and super close to everything that we wanted to see - plus all transit spots were in walking distance which made things very easy! The room was very clean and tidy and very quaint - would definitely recommend for anyone visiting. Really good value.

Our stay at Rafaels place was great. He was a really good hoast and everything in the apartment was as in pictures. The neighbourhood is perfect for discovering Lisbon since it is so close to everything.
Rafael was a great host. He was very attentive and helpful.

Comme on dit, on en a pour notre argent!
Le logement est propre mais mériterait un rafraîchissement, surtout au niveau des salles de bain.
Néanmoins, à ce tarif, c’est un bon rapport qualité prix.
En ce qui nous concerne, nous mangions chaque repas à l’extérieur, nous n’y étions que pour dormir. Bien que le quartier soit plutôt dynamique, le logement est calme.
Nous rejoignions en 10 minutes à pied le centre, ce qui est très bien placé.
Rafael est très serviable, disponible et souriant.
Ce fut une bonne 1ere expérience Airbnb !

Rafaels place is the perfect place to stay in Lisbon. The place is easy to find, has a really perfect location (walking distance to all major spots and miradouros), and was spotless clean. I felt very safe in the area as a female solo Traveller. Rafael was a very nice, responsive, and helpful host. He took care of the guest personally upon arrival. He pays attention to detail (for example there’s even a hair dryer in both bathrooms!). Overall I was very happy to stay there, slept very well, the room was cozy and beautiful (look at the ceilings!). Highly recommend.
Schöne Lage- sehr zentral.

Great location, walking distance to city center and other interesting places. Near is supermarket and cafe, restaurants. Rafael is very kind and helpful. These things I very appreciate.
On the other hand, conditions of the apartment were not very conforming for us. There was plenty of mold and no as clean as we expected. On the photos it looks better than it was.
Amazing stay! Would love to stay at Rafael’s place again next time i’m in Lisbon

Séjour agréable
Je recommande
Rafael est un hôte très réactif. Séjour très bon rapport qualité/prix.

Only issue we had was the wifi was a bit touch and go and didn’t work in the bedroom. Rafael was kind enough to let us leave our bags at the apartment until the afternoon. Overall great value!

Overall location is good but the street is really noisy. Room is hot (already in May) but with open window quite impossible to sleep because of the noise on the street. Check-in quite unclear, we had to wait when outside when apparently someone comes. Apartment could have some new refreshment,  doors are just moving (making extra noise) etc.
The room was everything I expected! Good location and had a great stay overall. Would book again!
Stayed at Rafael’s place overnight for a layover and it was just what we needed. Very nice location within walking distance to dining and activities.

Alloggio in ottima posizione per visitare la città.

Consigliato!!
Raphael was very friendly and there to welcome us. Spacious and very clean place, great location, we could walk everywhere we wanted to go. Would go back again. Thank you very much.

Rafael was incredibly flexible and wonderfully helpful, I had some weird flight times early in the morning or late and night and Rafael was understanding and flexible with letting me in and getting my room set up. Great experience
Fantastic location and very comfortable flat. Rafael was communicative, helpful and friendly. Highly recommended!

All good. Rafael was very nice. However the bed was quite small, for people over 170cm it gets uncomfortable. The other rooms in the apartment are also rented out which is something we did not expect, and the people staying there weren’t being very respectful with the noise.
Loved this airbnb, very convenient and easy to get to most places by walking. Would stay again if I ever visit Lisbon again
Really characterful room in a lively part of city. Only downside was I’m 6.2 and the bed was a bit short. Apart from that, a great one-night stay.

O Rafael foi além do que precisava fazer e recebeu uma carta para mim e tbm a mala da minha namorada que chegou com atraso de 1 dia enquanto estávamos fora, ele também nos deu todas as instruções de forma objetiva e fácil.
Tivemos uma bela e tranquila estadia, muito obrigado Rafael!
Superb location and room. Nice host.
This was a good place to stay for one night, with a comfy double bed and good shower. The property needs maintenance, e.g. paint was pealing off, damp spots in bathrooms, kitchen tap very loose.

Rafael sempre nos respondeu rapidamente.
Ótimos mercados ao redores, é perto dos pontos turísticos, você consegue fazer a maioria a pé.

Em relação ao custo x beneficio está Ok.
Posizione ottima, comodissima per tutte le principali attrazioni di Lisbona. È stato un soggiorno piacevole, abbiamo anche sfruttato la cucina.
Habitación y cama confortables

Die Unterkunft bei Rafael war gut erreichbar, Preis -Leistungsverhältnis ist top. Die Zimmer sind einfach und sauber. Die Unterkunft selbst war ausgebucht, von den anderen Gästen habe ich kaum etwas mitbekommen.
Die Kommunikation mit Rafael war gut, ich würde wieder diese Unterkunft nehmen.
Rafael’s place is good value due to the location and the simple bedroom was all that we needed!
Rafael's apartment was a great choice.
The apartment was beautiful, with a nice balcony and convenient, walkable location. The bathrooms and kitchens were clean and convenient for use. Rafael was a great host!
super stay
The accommodation was close to the subway station, the facilities were comfortable, and the hosts were friendly.

The apartment is in a great location and was very clean.
Rafael was very welcoming only negative is that the place is a little bit noisy.

I only needed a place for the night and this was perfect. Convenient location to be able to explore as well as and everything you need if you want to be able to cook etc.
Rafael went above and beyond, helping me with a particularly obnoxious taxi driver who was trying to take advantage of me. His kindness and support was very much appreciated and evidence of how he wants to make sure his guests have the best experience.

I stayed one night at Rafael’s place and had a very positive experience. Check-in was really easy, there were clear instructions on how to find the home. Rafael was very friendly and gave me restaurant recommendations in the neighbourhood. The room was also comfortable with everything I needed in the apartment. The location of the home is great, near to a metro and walking distance from the main highlights of the city, though be aware it is in a hilly neighbourhood. I enjoyed my stay at Rafael’s place!

El alojamiento no es para nada lo que uno espera tenía un olor no agradable y estaban sucios los baños y la cocina igual, el sector en el cual está ubicado no me parece que sea un gran zona las calles son muy estrechas y casi no se encuentra estacionamiento reserve para dos noches pero solo pude estar una era casi imposible estar en el lugar no era para nada agradable
Thank you for hosting us. It was a pleasant stay!!
Excelente acomodação com ótima localização. O anfitrião foi muito simpático e atencioso. Recomendo!
host is very friendly and the place is really nice, enjoyed it a lot!

Very nice

とにかく思いやりに溢れるホストです。設備は古いのでそのあたりを気にされない方にはとてもおすすめです。
The apartment is in a great location. The room was very clean and Rafael was very welcoming. The communication was also efficient. Will definitely come back here on our next trip to Lisbon!

We stayed in the guesthouse for one night and had an overall nice experience! The communication was awesome and very kind, the room was big and as expected and the area where it’s located was also extremely good. Other than that there was plenty of mold in every room which is the only downgrade.

The accommodation is in the real city center so you can walk everywhere. The room was clean and offered everything we needed.
You can cook if you wish and you have two complete toilets.
If I come back to Lisbon, i'll repeat at Rafael's place.
Everything was good. Good place to stay for a couple of days.
Very good place to stay in lissabon!
queda muy bien ubicado, Rafael nos dió algunas indicaciones para comer
Keuken en badkamer kan beter bij gehouden worden.
muito bom local, porém recomendo ir de Uber ou táxi pois tem subida e com malas e complicado. mais restante tudo certo. local bem localizado.

Leider waren nach dem ersten Tag die Handtücher im Bad verschwunden, sodass man sich die Hände nicht mehr abtrocknen konnte. Alles in allem ein gutes Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis :)
Apartment is in a really good location. Vera and Rafael were really kind and accommodating.
Appartement agréable en plein cœur de Lisbonne. On s’y sent comme chez soi.

Séjour sympa chez Vera. L'appartement est idéalement situé dans Lisbonne. Nous sommes arrives tard et le fils de Vera nous a très gentiment attendu et accueilli. Nous recommandons pour un bon rapport qualité prix.

Rafael was great and helped us with check in. The location is good and within walking distance of many attractions to see in the city. The WiFi seemed to be a little spotty in our room at times but was overall good and the room tended to be a bit warm at night. Overall, we are very happy with our stay and think it is a great value

Lovely apartment!  Very good location - walking distance to the center 15 minutes.  The apartment has everything you need - cups, cutlery, etc. Beautiful and atmospheric interior - you can feel the culture of the country.  In addition, great contact with the host :) I highly recommend!

pro

Rafael was a kind host and gave us all the necessary informations on our arrival.

Very nice apartment near the centre of Lisbon. Everything was within walking distance. The kitchen is quite simple but absolutely sufficient equipped. Even though, all 4 rooms were occupied, there were never a problem finding a free bathroom. Definitely recommend this apartment!!
Perfect place to stay, great location and would highly recommend to others.

For what it’s worth, our stay was pleasant enough. The neighbourhood has plenty of food places to eat. But there seems to be a lot of foreigners. But we had no issues. The room was spacious and clean.

The Apartment is very close to the city center of Lisboa. The room was very nice.
At the moment there is a construction in the neighborhood, that’s a bit loud even in the night.
But overall it was a pretty nice stay.
Ein schöner Aufenthalt! Die Kommunikation war super unkompliziert. Wir wurden nett empfangen und das Zimmer war wie beschrieben. Durch die zentrale Lage war alles gut zu erreichen.

Muy buena ubicación y lindo cuarto

Perfect location, just 20min to the city center.
The apartment is very well equipped, it has everything you need, even free parking.
The owner is also very lovely and answers really fast.
Totally recommend staying there 😊

The area is a bit dodgy and noisy at night but the Bus station and Metro is within quick walking distance same with stores to pick up food. Everything you need to make food is alsi there. Unfortunately, the washer is broken and the locks are fiddly. Otherwise, an okay stay.
Alloggio carino e semplice compreso di tutto L essenziale per soggiornare
Bon séjour, bon emplacement
photos sont super attrayante......la vérité est tout autre....besoin d'un bon rafraîchissement.......emplacement idéale dommage que le quartier soit aussi sale
Super Lage und genau richtig für die zwei Tage Lissabon. Wohnung ist sehr zentral sauber und wir konnten die Koffer schon vor dem Check-In da lassen. Auch die Liste mit den Tips ist hilfreich:)
La habitación es tal y como se muestra en el anuncio, hemos estado genial.

The apartment is well-located, in a 4-room apartment with 2 bathrooms and a kitchen. We were pretty satisfied about everything, the apt is 10 mins on walk from Praça do Comércio. Considering the price-value ratio, the only thing that we'd have appreciated improvement in is the kitchen, which is not very well equipped (ex. there is no cooking fan). Thank you, Rafael.
Zentrale Lage; sauberes Zimmer; leichter Check-in

Really nice place to stay for a few days in Lisboa. You can walk every by foot or the tram is close by.
Would always recommend it again.
Clean room, great hosts, central to the city, would totally recommend
Good place for short stay. Very close to city center.

L'appartement de Vera est très confortable et très bien situé.
Nous avons été reçu par Rafael (le fils de Vera) qui nous a accueilli dans l'appartement pour nous expliquer tout ce qu'il fallait savoir lors de notre séjour. Rafael laisse également son numéro aux hôtes afin que ceux-ci puissent le contacter via WhatsApp en cas de problème (ou même s'ils ont une simple question).
Rafael est très disponible, c'est extrêmement appréciable.
Concernant l'appartement, il est bien équipé pour passer une semaine tranquille. Il y a quatre chambre, vous aurez donc peut-être des colocataires. Il y a également deux douches/toilettes afin de minimiser les files le matin avant de partir :-)
Concernant sa situation, l'appartement est à proximité immédiate du quartier de l'Alfama, le coeur populaire de Lisbonne, ainsi que de la Baixa Pombalienne.
Si vous venez l'été, lors des grosses températures, il y a un ventilateur dans la chambre (nous n'en avons pas eu besoin, mais c'est un petit plus !)
Passez la tête par la fenêtre de la Room 1, aussi, pour faire un petit coucou à la voisine. Tapez-lui la conversation en français. Elle se fera un plaisir de vous répondre en portugais. Ça peut durer longtemps, comme ça :-)
Tolle Lage , sehr zu empfehlen! Besser ohne Auto, da sehr zentral. Leider stand das Auto nicht sicher, weil es dort einfach überall zu eng ist.Wir haben jetzt eine kaputte Seite über Nacht.
Chouette logement.
Fomos bem atendidos. A localização é boa, próxima a restaurantes, mercados e a estação de metrô.
The place was in a great location. It was very clean and comfortable. Rafael was very accommodating in letting us check in later after our flight was delayed. Would definitely stay again.

We very much enjoyed our stay! If you are looking for a no-frills stay that is clean, safe, and close to the metro, this is a great option. We had some troubles finding the building but once we did we had a great experience checking in with Raphael. Would definitely consider staying here again if we come back to Lisbon!
This was a beautiful room, very quiet, not too warm even in 34 degrees heat. Check-in was quick and easy, loved the stay here!

This airbnb is located at really authentic neighborhood in Lisbon. Im glad I chose this one because there are lots of good food places and spots to see sunset all around. It was really convenient to get around the city too. I highly recommend Vera’s place!!
Man kriegt für den Preis ein schönes Zimmer mit toller Lage, natürlich gibt es keinen Luxus aber der hat uns auch nicht gefehlt :)

We would recommend this place to anyone travelling to Lisbon! Great location to visit all the sights by foot or public transit. Lots of delicious food nearby. O lugar é incrível. Perto de tudo. Tem supermercado, metrô e ônibus. O anfitrião é muito legal e prestativo. Recomendo a todos que desejam ter uma boa experiência.

Thank you so much, it was a pleasure! Easy to enjoy the sunset within 10 minutes from the apartment. We loved to stroll around the streets in the evening and enjoy lots of bars and cafes nearby. Rafael was very Kind and waited for us, when our flight got delayed (11pm+).
È stato piacevole trovare una camera con due letti, invece che uno. L'appartamento è pulito e la posizione molto comoda. Apprezzata la presenza della macchinetta per il caffè
Great place! In walking distance to many great sights in Lisbon. Very comfortable. Rafael (Vera’s son) was very helpful!
Wir hatten dort eine Nacht. Für eine Nacht vollkommen in Ordnung. Sehr zentral.

We went to Lisbon for 3 nights and really enjoyed Vera’s apartment. Her son and husband gave us the keys and were very open and friendly and gave us many tips for our stay in Lisbon. Also it is located in the center of the city, so we could walk everywhere easily. Highly recommend it :)

Localização é razoável dentro do centro histórico. As dependências do apartamento estão com estado de conservação não tão legal. Necessita de uma boa reforma pra tornar agradável.

Very good location and communication with host.

Good value for money apartment . Not the most comfortable but great for travelling / layovers . Host nice enough if not a tad rushed. Good response time . Hot water can be issue .
Amei a hospedagem, Rafael é uma pessoa extremamente educada e prestativa! Estava tudo limpo e foi tudo muito agradável.
Very good location in Lisboa. Rafael(Vera's son) was very friendly and kind so nothing negative about our experience with them. Recommended!
The apartment was very warm. I would book that room again for sure. It is in a convinient location and value the money.
I stayed here for a month,  everything was great ;) Rafa is a great host
Las paredes son de papel, el anfitrion es majo pero desorganizado y el barrio se siente peligroso ya que presenciamos varias disputas entre vecinos gritando.

Besides this two things is the apartment a good value, a combination of good location and friendly price.

We were welcomed to the apartment by Raphael (Vera's son) who was extremely helpful. We really enjoyed our stay and found the apartment ideally situated to get around Lisbon by foot. We parked our car on the road outside the house without a problem.
Clean room, shared apartment with other guests and they were all so friendly. Great location.

It was an ok stay, the location, price and communication were great. But in the 3 days we were there, the tea-towel in the kitchen and hand towel in the bathroom had not been changed. You had a box next to the shower, and the wet towels were there until we left. The building is quite old, so the wooden floor creaks with every step, and there is no door separating the rooms and kitchen/bathroom, so a little bit noisy (just bring ear-plugs). Would I go there again if I didn't want to go to hostels? Yes, but there are some improvements that can be made.

Lovely stay at a great location near the center. Welcome was warm and the house was clean. The house could use a bit of renovations but it's great value for what you pay. One minor point of improvement is that I would liked to have a little more kitchen utensils.
Muy cómodo, buena ubicación y todo muy limpio!! :)

Estuvo todo muy bien! La houseguest es cómoda, bonita y útil. Compartes casa con no mucha gente, cosa que se agradece. No tuvimos ningún problema, quizás lo único fue que era un barrio peligroso y malo, no era de los mejores. Pero por el resto sin ningún problema!

This place was great!  The room was very cute and a decent size for two people. The water was hot and the ease of check-in was wonderful. The shared space was also cute although we were out most of the day, so we didn’t spend much time there. The location isn’t right in the center of Lisbon, but it wasn’t a super long walk from the main plaza.  We really enjoyed our stay here!  Thank you very much :)
Vera’s place was perfect for our needs. Everything was very clean, in a great location to see Lisbon and the checkin was very friendly and helpful.
Everything top, the check in was a bit complicated and because gas was empty we had no warm water for the first day.

The stay in Vera's house was very pleasant! Super clean house and simple communication, we stayed for a long time and the owner was really very nice! Highly recommended house for location if you want to easily reach every part of the city even on foot!

Amazing house closed to the center and in a very beautiful location. The room was clean and spacious.
We enjoyed it very much, I recommend it!
There is no 2 beds like in pictures. be carefulll read all text before ordering the place
Nice place with very nice host.
Charmant appartement, dans un quartier historique à deux pas du centre ville.
Nice room in shared apartment, ideal location, clean and fully-equipped. Would recommend!
Great location
Muy recomendado! Ubicación perfecta, super amables, habitación cómoda... Repetiriamos!

Nous avons passés un court séjour dans ce Airbnb. Les photos ne sont conformes à la réalité : le logement est très vétuste (fissure dans les murs, aucune isolation phonique).
Le point fort du logement est qu'il est peu cher et situé à 10min du centre. En revanche, il faut traverser quelques roues qui n'inspire pas confiance.

We stayed only briefly during a layover in Lisbon, and the place was great! We were walking distance from many restaurants, and it was a short Uber ride to and from the airport. The room and the shared spaces were clean, and we had plenty of space. The walls do, however, let in a lot of noise from the home and surrounding areas, so if you are a light sleeper, this might not be the best place for you. However, the bed was very comfortable!
Great place! Very pleasant location
Great location, nice and easy stay, definitely recomend.
Excellent place to stay, very good value. Shared space was fine.
Nice apartement with great location and best support by the host Rafael! We would recommend it definitively!
Perfect location and clean room. The host was very friendly.

Le logement est très bien situé. Je l'ai trouvé plus vétuste que ce que j'imaginais sur les photos. Nous étions quasiment tout seul, ce qui était d'un sens agréable & je dirai surtout lorsque l'on a de jeunes ados, l'insonorisation peut faire que l'on gêne les autres. La cuisinière ne fonctionne pas, il y a le micro-onde & il faut trouver le petit truc pour que la cafetière ne fuit pas.
En arrivant Rafael m'a appris que le petit déjeuner ne se faisait plus depuis une semaine, je l'avais eu 15 jours avant au téléphone. Je ne l'ai pas revu.
J'ai été déçue que Rafael, le fils de Vera, ne me réponde pas à mes questions sur place (conseils +. Remboursement des petits déjeuners), ou pour ma demande en passant par le site Airbnb, ce n'est pas les commentaires laissés habituellement.

Excellent location, just 10-15 minutes by foot from the main areas. The room is clean and quiet as far from busy streets, also very stylish and comfortable. Located on the 1st floor so not too steep access (no lift). I could leave my luggage before a late flight so this was also very convenient. Worth every penny. I'd stay again when back to Lisbon.
Good apartament in the very center of Lisboa, Alfama and it has a very good price so It has a great quality/price ratio

Chambre dans un appartement assez ancien, il y a 3 autres chambres.
Il y a deux salles de bain et une cuisine mais il n'y a pas de salon, il n'y a que de petites tables pour prendre le petit déjeuné. L'appartement est situé à 15 min à pied du centre.
Lovley place to stay, great localisation, full equipment and helpful  host

Die Unterkunft liegt mitten in einem belebten, ehrlichen und charmanten Viertel. Zu Fuß kann man so vieles erkunden, Sehenswürdigkeiten besuchen und ist fast aus jedem Winkel Lissabons schnell „Zuhause“.
Auch wenn die Wohnung sehr hellhörig ist, macht es die Umgebung und die liebevolle Einrichtung wieder wett. :)
Wir hatten eine wunderbare Zeit und kommen aufjedenfall wieder!

Il y avait à mon sens une grande différence entre les photos et la prestation : l’ensemble est vraiment limite en vétusté, on ne peut même pas se faire chauffer un plat (pas de micro-onde, la gazinière est hors-service, la machine à café ne fonctionne plus)... il y avait toutes les nuits beaucoup de bruit dans l’immeuble et aucune isolation phonique.

A localização foi ótima pra vários passeios, a casa é muito segura. Alguns hóspedes não colaboram com a limpeza, porém os anfitriões não deixam a desejar e organizam tudo. Sempre disponíveis para tirar dúvidas. Foi ótimo. 👍🏽
Ce quartier est très chaotique mais tout à fait charmant. Sans Google map, On s'y perd s'est garantie!!

O espaço é muito agradável, limpo e aconchegante. Sempre limpo! A localização é ótima. O anfitrião Rafael é muito prestativo e gentil. Nos recebeu e nos deu dicas preciosas, bem como, nos deixa a vontade e leva todas as manhãs frutas e pão o que nos faz ter a sensação de estarmos realmente em casa. Adorei. Voltarei com certeza.
Es un lugar cómodo, práctico y bien ubicado. El cuarto es amplio y tiene lo necesario para una estadía en Lisboa
地理位置很好，房间也很干净。房东为我们准备了丰盛的早餐，还为我们推荐了好吃的餐厅。总之十分推荐！
Vera is a great person!! Very kind and quick response!! I really recommend her apartment!!

El sitio no es agradable.  La habitación no tiene lo que ofrecen.  Las almohadas, sábanas, toallas no dan la sensación de estar limpias.  Se ven viejas y acabadas.  La cama no está bien tendida.  En fin,  ni la habitación ni el lugar donde llegamos son recomendables.  No volvería a ese lugar.  Lo único bueno que tiene es el wifi
Appartamento in zona comoda per girare la città a piedi, silenzioso, accoglienza ottima.
Great location! Recommended 👍🏼

Its all about the location and convenience. And not much more than that. The place is centrally located in Alfama and is a 5 minute walk away from Martim Moniz metro station (which is also the starting point of Tram 28). It is also close to Ramiro (must visit for seafood lovers) and other good eating places. We never had the breakfast at the apartment as its not something amazing (no hot meals as one cannot cook in the apartment) and much better breakfast options are available nearby. The San Jorge castle is 15 minutes by walk. We had an early morning flight out of Lisbon and it was very easy to get an Uber at 3 AM (I had scheduled a trip in the app).
Rafael is a great host (who, mind you, does not live in the apartment) and helps with all the questions you post. He visits the place for restocking and welcoming guests. He says the place needs some renovation and I could not see myself disagreeing with that. The pictures on the listing are definitely old at this point and the cracks on the wall are very obvious. The mattress could have been better. It is located in an older part of Lisbon and it reflects on the apartment.
It is a fine place if you have a short stay of a few days. I would suggest looking elsewhere in Alfama for longer stays.
Would I stay again in the apartment - Probably not.
Would I stay again if the place is renovated - Yes.
Would I recommend Alfama as a place to stay for tourists - Absolutely!
Its a very good location. Walking distance to metro station. And the host is very kind and thoughtful.
Good price/value rooms.
Great place to stay and in no time you are in the center.
Excelente lugar , ótima receptividade, tudo perfeito ! Recomendo !
Ótimo , Rafael muito atencioso, gostei de tudo.

Excellent location as it's near the main town areas and very convenient for dining and shopping. Also, love that it's on the first floor so lugging our bags up one floor wasn't too bad :)
However, the place does not look quite as sparkling clean and new as the photos :) Just a note too that the road leading up to the house is very steep and could be quite difficult with luggage. We took a Free Now (download app) ride from and to the airport and it was only about €7 per trip - worth considering.

Excellent location as it's near the main town area and perfectly convenient for dining and shopping! :)Also loved that it's on the first floor, so not too difficult to bring up baggage.
However, the place does not look quite as sparkling nice and new as the photos. The room was rather old and had cracks on the walls. Also, just a note that the road leading up to the place is rather steep, could be difficult for big luggage. We used Free Now (download app) to book taxis from and to the airport which only costs about €7 per trip. Worth considering.

Place is good enough and there's breakfast served with good coffee, bread, fruit, cheese, ham, jam, butter, milk and fruit juice. Pretty awesome! Love it that it's on the first floor and hence not too much trouble bringing our luggage upstairs... However, the place isn't as new and sparkling clean as it looks in the photos. It's old and there are cracks on the walls. Not as clean as expected.

I like Airbnb’s supposed mission  of facilitating the exchange of cultures. Increasingly m, in my experience, this can’t happen because the host arranges to get you in, often without even needing to be there, then  is not around for your entire stay. Even “super hosts” are often missing in action. Vera met me and was as sweet as can be, but she doesn’t live there. In fact, nobody can live there on a daily basis because there is no functioning way to cook. So the “home” consists of three bedrooms for Airbnb customers and two bathrooms. It is quite old-fashioned, but functional for people who are away all day and come back to sleep, like Airbnb people.
Good stay, very accommodating hosts!

Vera's place is amazing, at first Raphael checked us in at 9:30pm and he was very helpful, the flat and our room were clean and well organized,the door has lock he gave us 2 towels one for each and gave us some helpful tips. Breakfast was fare includes cheese, 2 types of ham, bread, milk, jams and fruits with many beverages.
The location is perfect since it's close to the metro station and to Rossio the centre of Lisbon but it can get dark and a bit scary at night.
I would recommend this place a lot.

The hosts were very kind and they even let us leave the luggage in the house before the check in. The place was in a rougher state than presented in the pictures. It is true that they uploaded new pictures with the actual state, but when I reserved the pictures were a bit misleading. Otherwise, the place was clean, the bed comfortable and the value for money is very good.

- tidy but small and noisy rooms
- central location
- the house can get quite bussy since they have four rooms
Bien

Hospitalidade excelente, No que for preciso o Rafael trata de tudo!!
Podem contar com eles para tudo.
Obrigado

What a special spot !! The home is lovely clean warm and location the best !! You can walk everywhere and food is so good lots of yummy local places 😊easy checkin and such helpful host !!
Will be staying here again for sure 😊
Warmly
Donna USA

Die Lage der Unterkunft war super,  ganz in der Nähe befindet sich eine Metro-Station und ein Busbahnhof, so dass ich keine Probleme hatte, auch nachts zum Flughafen zu kommen und ich konnte bequem zu Fuß das Zentrum erreichen. Die Gastgeber waren sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit, das Zimmer sehr geräumig und sauber. Schade war, dass man in der Unterkunft nicht kochen kann und das Frühstück ist wirklich sehr einfach. Insgesamt fand ich meinen Aufenthalt bei Vera und Rafael sehr angenehm und ich hatte eine gute Zeit in Lissabon!
Rafael foi maravilhoso.  Você se sente em casa! Tudo limpo, organizado, dois banheiros disponíveis e com um plus de um café muito bom.  A leveza dele é fantástica.  Obrigada por toda a ajuda.

The room is nice for two people- a liiiiitle tight for 3, but we enjoyed our stay. The breakfast was a great add-on; and we were able to leave our bags for a few hours after check out while we took a tour. Rafael was on top of everything
Quaint accommodation with lovely shared spaces. The other guests were pleasant and respectful.
Nice little apartment in a very central location in Lisbon. Vera and Rafeal were good hosts, and they gave us good suggestions on places to visit and eat. Would stay again for sure.

Die Lage war super. Wir waren in nicht einmal 5 Minuten in der Innenstadt von Lissabon. Hatten kleine Supermärkte direkt um die Ecke. Die Adresse war etwas schwer zu finden, da überall Einbahnstraßen sind und wenn man falsch gefahren ist nochmal komplett außenrum musste. Es gab zwei Bäder. Leider liefen in einem die Ameisen ein und aus und war auch nicht sonderlich einladend. Das zweite Bad war dagegen gut! Wenn man etwas vom Frühstück haben möchte muss man schnell sein. Wir haben leider nichts abbekommen von Toast, Käse oder Wurst. Leider sind die Bilder sehr veraltet. Die Wände im Zimmer haben alle Risse und an den Decken sieht man das dort wohl mal einen Wasserschaden gab. Sonst: Der Check-In und die Kommunikation war super. Und die Lage war top!

Vera's place is a nice cozy little apartment. If you want to live in an authentic Portuguese home then this place is ideal. It's close to most attractions and there is even light breakfast available, including fresh fruits. Vera's son greeted me at the door and showed me around the place. Very nice and helpful folks.

The apartment has 3 bedrooms and two shared baths. We did not have to wait to use the bathrooms and Rafael gave us a tour and keys. Note that there is no lock box or key code so you have to provide the exact time of arrival which was hard for us given we were coming from another city and returning a rental. My main concern was there were ants in the kitchen and bathrooms and perhaps the pictures are outdated.

This place is really well located, perfect to explore the city. Rafael is kindly welcoming you and ready to help. Pictures of the room are a bit outdated but it is clean.
Note: if you have heavy luggage I would not recommend this place, as you have to climb some stairs after the metro (or do a detour but still going up).
The flat from vera is the perfect stay for a short trip at lisboa. We enjoyed the great central location of the flat.
Very nice hosts. A room in a multi-room flat with a public kitchen and two bathrooms. Charming old tenement house, clean apartment. Thanks and greetings from Poland!

I only stayed a night but I had a good welcome and the place is very clean and tidy. The bed and sheets are really comfortable! They have thought about small details for travellers. Its a great area. Lovely hosts
An awesome room just a few minutes walk away from Martim-Moniz metro station! Great location for exploring all the tourist spots of historic Lisbon core.
Wir haben uns die wenigen Tage in Lissabon sehr wohl gefühlt.
Great! Very clean. 2 shared bathrooms were nice. Breakfast provided was easy and good as we had an early flight. Great location by a few good restaurants.
Apartamento en perfectas condiciones y ubicación ideal. La atención fue muy buena.
Very clean and enjoyed the fan that was in the room especially since we were there in August. They accommodated to our early check in with good communication.
Clean room located in an old apartment building near public transportation. Breakfast items were available in the kitchen. Rafael was very helpful in providing local information. Nice stay.
Nice clean stay in Lisbon.  A quick easy walk to the main tourist area.  Good amenities and host with great tips re Lisbon and beyond.

We enjoyed our night here very much and Rafael was very patient and helpful as I was flying out late in the evening and needed somewhere to keep my bags for a few hours after check out. Thank you again Rafael!
The location is very central and the vibrant streets are easily accessible from the guesthouse. It is a beautiful old apartment!

This Airbnb is fantastic! You can’t beat the location (such a great area, close to everything!). The room itself is very spacious, nice, and clean. The bed is comfy! Vera offers breakfast for hosts (so great!) with fresh fruit, among other tasty items! Vera was responsive to our inquiries and even allowed us to drop our bags off early, which made a hugely positive impact on our trip. I wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again - book now! It’s wonderful :)
Super

Maybe my expectations were too high because of all the great reviews, but my group and I did not have a great stay. I realize the building is very old but the room condition really reflected that, unlike other old buildings I have stayed in. The bedding and towels were very worn and we had to wait to use the bathrooms at night. It was very hot in our room so we had to keep the window open at night, but it was very loud outside so it was very difficult to fall asleep. I think the place was just a bad choice because I was traveling with my parents, so that is not Vera’s fault, but I had not expected these things based on the listing. Next time, I would spend a little more money and book a hotel or nicer place instead.

Die Unterkunft ist perfekt gelegen, mitten im historischen Zentrum. In Mouraria wohnen auch viele Migranten, sodass das Viertel sehr bunt wirkt. Die Wohnung selbst war ein schöner Altbau, der jedoch ein wenig renovierungsbedürftig ist. Das Schlafzimmer sah auf den Bildern besser aus, als in Wirklichkeit und das eine Bad hätte gepflegter sein können. Dafür war das andere total in Ordnung. Die Ausstattung der Wohnung war gut und die Kommunikation mit den Gastgebern sehr schnell!
The room was much smaller than looked in the photos, location was great. Host friendly and helpful.
Very helpful hosts
Excellent location, better host.
It was one of the best accomodation i have ever experienced. Rafael clean apartment and prepare breakfast every day. I 100% recommended it.
Amazing location. Hosts were very accommodating and answered any questions we had.

Lovely family was very kind! They helped to carry our luggages. They offer nice meal and comfort bed. Also, it was quite at night. I hope to come back here when I will visit Lisbon again. Muito Obrigada!!! :)
We very much enjoyed our stay! Great value and good people. The apartment is close to everything and the breakfast is such a nice touch. Thank you Vera and Rafael!

В Лиссабоне мы были проездом, 1 сутки, на такси от аэропорта 20 минут, Рафаэль очень гостеприимно нас встретил, показал все удобства, все было очень чисто, имелись продукты на завтрак, сок, чай, кофе фрукты, тосты, сыры и тд. Кровать была удобная, для недлительного проживания я рекомендую эту комнату.
Grande rapporto qualitá prezzo. Ospitalitá famigliare. Super consigliato
Solicite toalhas de banho no check-in

Vera is a kind and friendly host. The apartment was in a good location. We walked everywhere. The room is simple and well kept and there are two bathrooms—both very clean. The only thing to mention is the building is old so sound travels and we were woken up twice by people upstairs above us.
We really enjoyed our stay at Vera’s place! The room was very pretty and clean. It was perfect to have a simple breakfast included! Thanks again.

Rafael is a great host. He cleans the place every day which makes this an amazing place. He also provided us with many tips on Lisbon which made our trip amazing. The place was very stylish too. Charming like an one of those air b and bs you stumble upon in a village
La ubicación es muy buena y la habitación era muy limpia y buena
Great room in shared apartment. Everything was clean and the host were great.

Chambre privée dans un appartement assez grand avec deux salles de bain, pratiques pour les 4 chambres en location ! Petit déjeuner très correct, propreté impeccable.
L'appartement est vraiment très bien placé, rien que pour ça, ça vaut le coup de rester chez Raphaël et Verra !
De plus, Raphaël a été de très bon conseil en ce qui concerne les restaurants :) merci encore !

Hostel znajduje sie w bardzo dobrej lokalizacji - praktycznie centrum miasta. Blisko do zabytków, komunikacji miejskiej i sklepów. Pokoje lepiej wyglądają na zdjęciach niż w rzeczywistości ale można spokojnie spędzić w nich kilka nocy. Mankamentem jest ciepła woda, wprawdzie jest ale nie zawsze wystarcza do komfortowej kąpieli.
Jeśli szukacie opcji ze śniadaniami, to zdecydowanie nie polecam! Przede wszystkim zbyt mało - nie wystarczająco dla wszystkich gości hostelu, do tego czerstwy chleb i również nie pierwszej świeżości ser. Śniadania przygotowuje się samemu z produktów zakupionych przez gospodarza.
Ambiente  pitoresco, muito bem localizado e o anfitrião é muito solicito e gentil. Excelente custo-benefício!
El lugar es 100% agradable muy cerca de todas las atracciones turísticas.
C'est la seconde fois que je viens chez Vera et Rafael, je ne suis toujours pas déçue !! Guesthouse très mignonne et propre, super emplacement, bonne réactivité dans les échanges ! :)

Vera and Rafael provide a very homely experience in a great part of Lisbon, with the main castle just a ten minute walk away, and all the main attractions easily accessible either on foot or by public transport.

Location was awesome! Located in a stone throw away from the city centre! Also, Vera and Rafael were being so kind towards our stay in Lisbon! Not only helping us to print the boarding passes, but also allowing us to check out late! Much appreciated !!

Nous avons été reçus par Rafael qui nous a très bien accueillis. L’appartement est charmant et idéalement situé pour découvrir Lisbonne quelques jours.
Petit plus pour le petit déjeuner laissé à disposition chaque jour, on recommande !
Muy buen lugar, nos ayudó bastante el anfitrión, nos dio recomendaciones de movilidad y turismo. Recomendado.
It's so good. Vera and her son are so kind.
Het huis was ok maar voor ons iets te basic. Kleine badkamer met weinig warm water. Huis geeft zeer veel geluiden door, dat was voor ons een minpunt. Ook het ontbijt is zeer basic (toastbrood).

Les photos sont trompeuses. Le logement est vieillot, murs fissurés, literie ancienne et très peu confortable, SDB d’un autre temps. Malgré tout, l’accueil par le fils de Vera était très chaleureux. Logement très bien situé.
Host was really helpful, everything was clean on daily basis. I appreciate vintage looking room, with enough light and space in it. Thank you, it was really nice trip, recommend this apartment.

A great stay in this apartment. The room was spacious, clean and comfortable. Great location, walking distance to Alfama district. Everything we would need was there, only the wifi could have been better. The host was responsive and very helpful. Would absolutly recommend!

It's a nice and cosy place for a couple of nights in Lissabon. The location was perfect (though mind some of the alleys at night). As described before, the doors are rather noisy (level of noise depends on the other guests). Plus the place might need some deep cleaning (shower curtains, dusty shelves etc.). However,  Rafael took care of the most general cleaning every day. We enjoyed our stay and thank you for your hospitality.
Todo estuvo muy bien, recomendable. Muchas cosas turísticas les van a quedar cerca.
Guest House perfeita. Rafael é uma ótima pessoa, explicou muito bem sobre tudo e deu ótimas dicas. O espaço é muito organizado e foi uma ótima surpresa. Voltaremos com certeza.

Great location, about 20 mins from the airport, walking distance to Alfama district. Very good value, clean, and beautiful. Hosts are very communicative and flexible for travelers. There are two shared bathrooms that are very clean and the shared kitchen includes breakfast, coffee, and tea, which is really nice. I highly recommend!
Excellent!
Posizione ottima e Rafael è molto disponibile. Consiglio.

It’s located in a lovely place because there are lots of Lisbon-style houses there.
The room was really cozy, so we felt as if we had been in our home :)
I really liked it!
There are two bathrooms, so it was really convenient and comfortable.
And also you can have breakfast for free there :)
Highly recommended!
A very nice clean room with great location.

Super réactivité pour répondre à nos messages! Je n'ai passé qu'une nuit dans ce logement, mais je peux dire que c'est un appartement propre, sympa et situé dans le charmant quartier de Mouraria, à proximité du centre de Lisbonne. Ce n'est pas le "grand luxe" mais tout y est pour passer un séjour simple et agréable.

Vera est une bonne hôte.
L’appartement est bien situé, proche du métro et proche du centre à pieds.
Pour ma part le petit déjeuner était un peu léger.
Les photos sont plus attrayantes mais en soit la chambre est très bien
Je recommande Vera pour les prochaines réservations :)

Vera and her son Rafael were super hosts! The location, cleanliness, space, amenities, level of privacy and helpful advice were all to a high standard. Couldn't have been happier with our choice of accommodation for our trip to Lisbon! Thank you very much to Vera and Rafael for their brilliant hospitality, highly recommend this spot
Location was great. The place was very cozy and comfortable. Vera is one of the most heart-warming hosts I have met. Absolutely recommended
A nice and clean place to stay, the hosts were responsive and helpful. We were allowed to store our luggage for a few hours before leaving Lisbon, thanks to the hosts.

Die Unterkunft war gut, sehr zentral gelegen. Für paar nächste total ok. Allerdings war es sehr laut (Wände dünn wie Papier) man wird leider ständig wach und das Bett war sehr hart. Etwas ungemütlich also. Aber ansonsten ist es für paar Tage ok!! Check in war super

Lisbon is an absolutely amazing city and this space is the cherry on top! This place is in a great location where you get to feel like your in a local neighborhood but just walking distance away from everything! Awesome space with a lock on your door to your room/ your belongings feel extra safe while you’re out and about. Rafael even gave us a promo code for Lisbon’s version of Uber and we got a free ride back to the airport!! Such a perfect mix of privacy and hospitality. 10/10 would recommend!! Thanks Rafael and Vera for making our stay so special!

We had a lovely time at Vera’s guest house! The apartment is centrally located:  it’s a 5-10 Minute walk to restaurants, shops etc. around Alfama and a 20 minute walk to bars in Bairro Alto. There’s a metro station close by so if you want to get somewhere further like to the airport it’s no problem either. Vera was an extremely friendly and helpful host. She cleaned the shared rooms (kitchen, 2 bathrooms, living room) every day so the apartment was always very tidy. Like people said before the guest house is actually a bit older than it looks in the photos but we personally loved the authentic vibe. Our room was next to the kitchen which could get a bit noisier when the other gets got up and had their breakfast in the morning but it wasn’t a big a deal to us. The bed was super comfortable and we loved the cute furniture and decoration in our room. We could leave our luggage at the apartment before and after check out which was definitely a big plus. All in all I 100% recommend Vera’s guest house and I would definitely stay there again! Thanks again, Vera :)
Really nice place and great location. The hosts are super nice and helpful!
비행기 도착이 늦어서 체크인이 늦었는데 걸을때마다 나무 바닦애서 소리가나고 주방이 없어서 불편했어요
Nice host, Good place for getting rest , near to the metro station, the only thing is the poor wifi . Otherwise all was fine.
Great value and location. I would stay here again. Vera's place was very clean.

Thank you for having us! We are extremely happy about the breakfast in the morning. That was a great time and money saver for us. Communication was great as well. We also appreciate that they let us keep the luggage past the checkout time. Overall we had a great time in Lisbon!

Really enjoyed staying in this clean and friendly apartment. Only minor downside was the second shower didn't have a hook for the showerhead. But altogether really pleasant and plenty of amenities (like breakfast and hot drink supplies) were provided, and the hosts accommodated our difficult transport situation very well!

This is a shared appartment. How you like it, depends mostly on who you live with. But this place is close to the city center. You get coffee and breakfast in the morning, which is really nice. The bedrooms are spacious. The bathrooms could have been more clean, though.

Wir waren nur für eine Nacht bei Vera in der Unterkunft. Es ist recht hellhörig, aber sauber und ordentlich. Das Frühstück ist in der Küche zum selbstbedienen, deshalb ist es besser wenn man nicht zu spät aufsteht, sonst bekommt man was übrig bleibt ;) aber alles gut soweit. Wir hatten alles was wir brauchten.
A great stay in this apartment. Rafael was really nice and very accommodating, we would definitely stay there again!
Perfect location for the city. Friendly host. Great value.
Thanks for your kind hospitality!

Room was clean and had everything that we needed. There are two bathrooms and a kitchen which was available to everyone. Close to Rossio square which was nice. They were very quick to respond. Would recommend this room to anyone coming to Lisbon
Definitely value for money to stay and the location is central as we got off the bus from the airport and we managed to walk 800m with our travel bags.
Clean, simple, and a good location.
un endroit simple mais bien placé. tout y était, le fait de pouvoir utiliser la cuisine est bien.
Leider war der versprochene Kaffee am Morgen nicht da, schade.

Our stay at Vera and Rafael’s place was nice. The bnb is situated in a good location, easy to walk to local attractions, shops and restaurants. They were very kind to let us check in early and leave our bags there after check out. However, we did have some trouble communicating with the hosts and due to the fact that there are three other rooms in the place, it can get a bit noisy at night.

Vera and her son was very attentive to help us find the home and guide us to find a parking spot!
I would highly advise who planning to stay there but to come with a car. Parking is nearly impossible!

Das beste an dieser Unterkunft ist die Lage des Apartments . Es liegt wirklich sehr zentral .
Nur leider kann die Wirklichkeit mit den Fotos nicht konkurrieren .
Das größte Problem in unserem Zimmer war das Bett,von dem ein komischer Geruch ausging . Zudem ist es nicht für größere Menschen geeignet , da es nicht sehr lang ist .
Die Bettwäsche war auch etwas old-school .
Die Küche die wir nicht weiter benutzt haben , war auch nicht gerade ein Ort des Wohlfühlens d.h. Sie war etwas unsauber .
Das Bad war ok .

Apparement très bien situé dans Lisbonne proche du quartier alfama,
Nous avons tout fait à pieds.
Très propre et très bon accueil par le fils de Véra,
Cependant nous avons rencontrés des difficultés pour contacter l’hôte avant notre arrivée il nous manquait des informations telle que où sonner une fois devant l’immeuble.
Mais très bonne expérience , je recommande vivement

Un hôte hyper réactif , arrangeant et agréable ..le.gíte est idealement placé en face d une rue typique , pour deux étudiantes , rassurant de pouvoir rentrer calmement à pied ..de nombreuses proximités avec resto, bars et superette ainsi que station de transports...nous avons rencontrés des pb auxquels Rafaello à su répondre rapidement ..le déjeuner est par contre assez simple , pour les gourmands ne pas compter dessus l'annonce ( pas de panique il y des pâtisseries proches et pas.cher )..
둘 이상이라면 공항에서 우버를 타고 가는게 편해요. 7.50유로 나왔고. 공항에서 우버를 부르면 키스앤바이 라고 불리는 우측 위촉 주차장에서 우버기사를 만날 수 있어요. 하루이틀 자고 가기 좋았습니다!
Rafael was a very kind host who helped us also in difficult situations
excelente local, tudo bem pontual e muito prático. O Rafael nos atendeu super bem.
Thank you Rafael and Vera! We would definitely recommend to stay at your flat!!
The room was nice and tidy. Owner was very easy to communicate with. It was in a good location to get around the city. Would happily stay there again.
Casa muy centrica, esta bien para quien quiera algl barato y no mecesite mucho lujo, la cocina no se puede utilizar

The location here is PERFECT!  You are in the heart of the town, amazing restaurants and bars within spitting distance.  Vera and Rafael have made a quaint little B&B and I loved having a private room in a flat with people from all over the world.  Amazing stay in Lisbon!
amazing!

Wij hebben ontzettend genoten van onze tijd in Lissabon. Het appartement had een gemakkelijk bereikbare locatie en je bent binnen en mum van tijd overal waar je zijn wilde. Het bed is iets aan de kleine kant voor wat grote mensen (1.75). Ook kan het af en toe wat lawaaierig zijn maar daar hadden wij persoonlijk niet zoveel last van.

가장 큰 단점은 위치입니다 ㅠㅠ 그냥 리스본 돌길도 캐리어끌고가기 불편한데 경사까지 상당한 편이어서 무거운 짐을 갖고 접근하기 꽤 힘들어요. 이 점 빼고는 대체로 만족했던 숙소입니당! 가장 마음에 들었던 점은 호스트의 빠른 연락이었어요. 답장이 오분도 채 걸리지 않는 것 같았습니다 ㅋㅋㅋ 답장 속도를 중요시하는 저에게 아주 최고였어요 :) 덕분에 숙소도 잘찾아갔고, 짐도 들어주셔서 편하게 들어갈 수 있었습니다.
방 안 시설은 대체적으로 편했고, 욕실은 작지만 깨끗해서 딱히 큰 불만은 없었어요. 아침식사도 그래놀라,빵,우유,과일 등 다양하게 구비돼있어서 좋았고요!
아, 무엇보다 저희 일행이 체크아웃 당일날 밤 9시 30분 야간버스를 탈 예정이었어서 그 전까지 짐을 맡길 곳이 필요했는데 호스트분께서 흔쾌히 늦은 시간까지 짐을 맡아주셔서 정말 감사했습니다 ㅠㅠ
진짜 딱 하루 묵은 숙소였지만 편안하게 지내다 가네요. Thank you, Vera and Rafael :)

Nice spacious bedroom; it was one of I believe 3 or 4 bedrooms in the apartment. Two bathrooms were small but clean. Our bed was very very uncomfortable, you could feel every spring in your back. We only stayed one night. The host was really nice and offered fruits, bread, milk, coffee and other kitchen amenities so you could cook if you wanted to. Good location.

Room in guest house, shared bathroom and kitchen space. Easy to get to from the airport. A little outside of the central tourist area. WiFi could be a lot better, but good value if you’re looking for a place to crash in Lisbon.
Cerca del transporte, habitación grande, host súper atento y respetuoso. Muchas gracias por todo!

5 stars for our stay here. Rafael greeted us with open arms and helped us settle into our room. He checked in on us every day during our stay to make sure we had clean towels, a clean bathroom and food in the kitchen. He gave us AMAZING restaurant recommendations- all of which we tried and were the highlights of our trip. The bedroom was so quaint and perfect and we couldn't have asked for a better stay here at Vera and Rafael's home. Thank you!

This is a great place to stay  the host is very helpful and they provide light breakfast supplies. The apartment is in an 18th century building which was also  nice. It's an ideal location to walk to the sites around you  Rafael was very helpful in all his suggestions of things we should see and where to eat  and he made sure all of our requests were met. Great place to stay
Nice small place. Good location.

The location is great. It is a clean and nice place where you can spend your holiday. Rafael is a great host and he gave us a lot of tips about Lisbon, things that we can do around and how to arrive to different places.

Großartige Lage! Tolle Zimmer und alles da, was man brauch. Die Wohnung ist wohl sehr hellhörig, was uns aber nicht weiter gestört hat. Oropax sollte man auf jeden fall einpacken, wenn man geräuschempfindlich ist!

El hospedaje en casa de Vera y Rafael fue genial, una respuesta rápida, una habitación cómo, limpia y tal como la ofrecen, la ubicación es muy buen, estación de metro a 2 bloques, recomendado para viajar!
We liked the stay very much! Very nice location and good tips from Rafael. We had only one night there, but enjoyed it very much. Thanks again!
We had a great stay here. Went above and beyond helping us with a credit card issue at a gas station! Really appreciate the hospitality!

Si vous chercher l'impossible à ce prix, le luxe et l'espace... c'est pas là qu'il faut loger.
Par contre, la situation, l'accueil, le logement sont d'un bon rapport qualité/prix.
Great little room in an awesome part of town. Rafael was a very nice man - I definitely recommend this spot if you’re visiting Lisboa

Amazing hosts, location, room and so on!
Thank you for an amazing stay, we’ll remember it for a long time and definitely choose to stay with you again.
Thanks!

Este es sin duda alguna El Sitio para quedarte en Lisboa. ¡Queda prácticamente al lado del Castillo de San Jorge! Rafael me recibió de una manera muy amable y me entregó las llaves de mi habitación de una manera tal que me sentí como en casa. La habitación es muy amplia y cómoda y se cuenta con dos baños impecables para el apartamento. Este sitio está en un encantador barrio antiguo de Lisboa: a escasos metros pasa el tranvía 28 y puedes disfrutar de la oferta gastronómica (muy económica) de la plaza Martim Moriz.
The host was wonderful and helpful and it is located very central to everything. The rooms are much smaller than the picture.

Vera and her son Rafael were extremely good hosts, very helpful and responsive. The place itself is located in a great neighbourhood in the city centre, but still peaceful. The space is really tidy and nicely decorated, the only thing I might complain about is a bit old mattress in the room I was given. Regarding the breakfast, the hosts always take care to prepare enough food for all the guests so, even if someone decides to sleep a bit longer, that shouldn't mean that will find the fridge empty.
All in all, very recommendable!
We had a good timeat Veras ansRafaels house. Thanks a lot for good Service, rooms and Breakfast!
Great location near castle, in the middle of city, everywhere is closed. Nice stay.
