Chambre un peu décevante par rapport aux photos. Cependant la chambre est correcte et surtout la situation de l'appartement est idéale pour découvrir le centre ville. De plus Raphael a su répondre à toutes nos demandes et nous a très bien accueilli.
Apartment is clean and quiet. Location is superb; close to the metro station as well as the start of the iconic Tram 28. Check-in was also a breeze. Highly recommended.

Vera i Rafael byli bardzo mili i pomocni. Dom położony w wielokulturowej dzielnicy ale okolica wydaje się w miarę bezpieczna. Do większości atrakcji można dojść pieszo, a na dalsze wypady jest niedaleko stacja metra i tramwaje. Pokoje w trochę gorszym stanie niż na zdjęciach ale kilka dni można przenocować. Po zwróceniu uwagi na brudną zasłonę prysznicową, została ona wymieniona na nową tego samego dnia, więc duży plus za podejście do gości. Śniadania bardzo podstawowe, ale mimo wszystko to jednak spore udogodnienie.

Auf einem Roadtrip durch Portugal haben meine Cousine und ich eine Nacht bei Vera verbracht. Rafael, Veras Sohn hat die Kontaktaufnahme und den Check In übernommen. Er war sehr nett und hat uns Tips für Lissabon gegeben. Anders als angenommen, ist die Unterkunft schon ein bisschen in die Jahre gekommen (Die Matrazen waren durchgelegen und ein großer Riss zierte die Wand hinter dem Bett). Die Küche ist nicht zum Kochen ausgelegt, was aber völlig in Ordnung war, da Lissabon viele tolle Restaurants bietet. Für einen Städtetrip ist die Wohnung sehr gut gelegen und bietet ein gutes Preis-Leistungsverhältnis.

Appartement bien situer dabs Lisbonne, facile d'accès metro/tram.
Bon rapport qualité prix.
Foi tudo perfeito! O Rafael nos recebeu super bem e o local era exatamente como nas fotos! Recomendo muito essa hospedagem, localização excelente e tudo bem organizado!

Die Unterkunft hält alle ihre Versprechungen. Vera oder aber auch ihr Sohn Raffael sind immer kontaktierbar und antworten bei Fragen direkt und sind dazu überaus freundlich! Das Appartement ist schön gemütlich eingerichtet und in eiener super tollen Lage. Kann es also nur weiter empfehlen, das nächste mal wenn ich wieder nach Lissabon komme werde ich versuchen wieder hier zu buchen ;)

Great place to stay in Lisbon! Loved the room and the coffee and toast you had out in the morning. Thank you for the heater in the room as it did get chilly overnight (march). Thanks for sharing your place :)

Vera nos recebeu super bem, foi muito atenciosa e prestativa. Nos aguardou na hora combinada para o check in, o único imprevisto foi que a companhia estava com problema, mas rapidamente conseguimos entrar em contato.
O Rafael, filho da Vera, também foi muito solícito, nos respondeu rapidamente pelo telefone e inclusive nos deu dicas sobre restaurantes locais.
Recomendo se hospedarem lá.
Vera and her son Rafael were very hospitable. My advice is if you need to contact them or ask any questions to use the WhatsApp number provided. Overall enjoyed my experience with them.
性价比很高，交通很便利，各方面设施也很齐全，房东很热情，回复都非常及时！就是因为是老房子，隔音稍稍差一点，晚上不是很安静，别的方面都非常好了！这是个很舒适的房子，值得选择！

Fomos muito bem atendidos pelo Rafael e Vera que nos passaram informações importantes sobre pontos turísticos, restaurantes e transportes. O quarto estava limpo e organizado e a distância da residência até os meios de transporte é curta. Gostamos muito e voltaremos se tivermos oportunidade.
The Appartement has an amazing location and we even got a little breakfast. Thank you for the pleasant stay!

Nice place, good location! I'm guessing the picture is taken with a wide-angle lens, so it (really) looks bigger than it is. About the bed: I am 1.83 and my boyfriend is even taller: it was too small for both of us. But we had a good night rest. No noise. Overall I think its good value. And Vera and Rafaël are nice people :)

Fomos recebidos com atraso no check in, sendo que Rafael não nos respondeu as mensagens enviadas em dias anteriores, exatamente questionando sobre o check-in, pois não tínhamos internet disponivel na chegada do Brasil e gostaria de programar uma hora exata na chegada. Posteriormente, Rafael nos colocou em outro quarto, pois o pé da cama estava quebrado. No entanto, chegaram no dia seguinte outros hóspedes que reservaram o quarto que estávamos, portanto tivemos que nos mudar com a cama do pé quebrado com uma gambiarra. Foi incoveniente, mas tudo bem, pois sei que imprevistos acontecem. O que achei realmente uma falha enorme foi o check-in, pois ficamos muito tempo na porta tocando o interfone, sendo que ele estava lá dentro tentando arrumar o pé da cama e não nos recebeu. Ele comentou que teria entrada por outra entrada, mas não havia outra entrada, o que achei de extrema falta de educação e profissionalismo não ter exposto o problema ligo de início. o restante foi okay, pouco caro pelo que foi oferecido.

Super indico a acomodação do Rafael e da Vera. Excelente localização (metro trem e ônibus), acomodação super aconchegante e limpa. Excelentes as dicas locais dos anfitriões e rápido retorno de dúvidas. Indo a Lisboa, não deixe de se hospedar na casa da vera e Rafael. Até a próxima experiência 👍🏻

The property was in an outstanding location. I absolutely loved the neighborhood but it also wasn’t too far from the center, definitely walkable or a very cheap cab ride. Also very close to the metro station. The apartment made you feel like you were a part of the neighborhood which was really special.

Great apartment, clean and  walkable to the town center and Alfama! Rafael and Vera went above and beyond helping with our travel and giving local recs! They were so thoughtful providing breakfast and we would love to stay there again if we go back to Lisbon!
Very charming local guesthouse offering a shared space.  In the heart of Lisbon, which made for a great cultural experience.
Actual room is pretty much different from picture. Lack of basic amenities in bathroom. But location is good; close to city center.

Nous avons passé une nuit dans ce logement et nous avons été déçus en tous points! Le logement est situé dans un quartier douteux et mal famé. La chambre ne correspondait pas aux photos, elle était exiguë. Le lit était également petit, nous ne pouvions même pas dormir sur le dos car il était trop petit en longueur!! D’ailleurs, les draps avaient une grosse tache. Les murs étaient bricolés pour ne pas qu on voie les fissures, du coup on entendait tout ce qui se passait dans les chambres à côté, dehors, etc. Les murs des toilettes étaient moisis, nous devions partager douche et toilettes avec les autres chambres. Nous déconseillons fortement ce logement, à ce prix là et sans petit déjeuner, autant payer 10.- de plus et on peut trouver un 3 étoiles minimum sur Lisbonne!
Все отлично. Спасибо за приём.
房間位置很好，出行挺方便，離地鐵站10分鐘車程，在去地鐵站途中有一中餐廳「大碗面」非常捧，有問題也可獲得當地的必要的資訊，房東也很好人，還為我們叫出租車到機場去，10歐元車費，我們來去機場都是坐出租車，很方便。下次來里斯本一定會再住

We just stayed for one night, but it's a really nice place to stay if you wanna discover the area around Graca. Raphael recommended us some spots around so we had a brilliant evening!the rooms are clean and cosy with beautiful details. As the next guests arrived really late the next day- we could leave  our luggage a bit longer in the room before we had to leave to the airport- that was really nice and helpful of Raphael- thanks again!
Recomendable para visitar Lisboa.

Only stayed one night. We were welcomed by Vera and her son who spoke more English gave us some advise where to eat.
Comfortable beds (a bit short if you are a tall person). Breakfast was included plus toothpaste, soap etc in the bathroom.
Both hosts are great. Helpful and knowledgeable about the area. The place is just what you need if you’re looking to explore the city lots.

I booked Vera's place for my parents and they enjoyed their stay. Vera's son was very nice and hospitable during the check-in. My parents enjoyed everything, the room was comfortable, warm, not so much noise at nighttime and a rather comfortable bed, they also enjoyed breakfast, which was included. Thanks a lot for everything!

Great place, located within walking distance from most interesting areas of Lisbon.
A nice room, sufficiently spacious and clean. The bed is a bit short, so if you are over 1.90m, your feet will be on the wooden edge of the bed.
The kitchen is nice and there is a good coffee machine with coffee capsules included.
The total place has two bathrooms which are shared by four rooms, so this works very well.
The building itself is quite historic, which gives it a nice touch; however sound isolation is correspondingly reduced, so don't expect absolute silence!
The host family is very nice, helpful and communication is very easy, thank you!!

We had a great stay at the appartement. We were very warmly welcomed. The room was cosy and although we were in a lively neighbourhood it was not too noisy at night. The only trouble we had was with the door that was very hard to open. All in all a great stay for a very reasonable price.

Muito obrigada! Thanks!
Gosto muito! Fui maravilhoso!
It was perfect, we want to come back!
Todo tal cual la explicación en la app. Rafael me espero y explicó todo, me ayudó con las direcciones y fue muy amable. Comodidad y limpieza por doquier, un placer, 100% recomendable.
Parfait pour découvrir Lisbonne
Raphael was very sharp and helpful. The place was clean and very central. We had everything we needed for a pleasant stay!
Very confortable!!!

Die Unterkunft ist sehr gut gelegen. Wir konnten alles fußläufig erreichen. Die Wohnung liegt im ersten Stock.
Wir waren im Raum Nummer 4, das Zimmer war direkt neben der Küche und dem Putzraum gelegen. Und dadurch morgens sehr laut, da die anderen Gäste sich Frühstück gemacht haben. Das Bett war außerdem viel zu klein für meinen Freund (1,90m). Mit offenem Fenster schlafen war aufgrund des Lärms durch Autos oder Menschen leider nicht möglich - also auf jedenfall Ohropax mitnehmen ;)
Die zwei Badezimmer sind ausreichend. Selten sind beide besetzt gewesen. Zustand ok, teilweise Schimmel an den Wänden.
Das Frühstück war auch ausreichend. Toast, Käse, Marmelade, Butter, Milch, Kaffee, Tee und Saft. Wir konnten in dem Tisch in unserem Zimmer frühstücken.
Aber für den Preis alles in allem ok.

Rafael è stato molto disponibile e preciso, la comunicazione efficiente e le informazioni dettagliate. La casa è molto carina, con due bagni e una buona disposizione. Wi fi e prima colazione inclusi! Bella la posizione, in quartiere poco turistico. Per chi ama passeggiare si può raggiungere tutto in poco tempo.
Grazie Rafael!

Definitely recommend staying here. Rafa went the extra mile to make sure everything ran smoothly and the Airbnb itself was very homey and charming. I felt right at home and the complimentary breakfast was nice too. The apartment has 3 other rooms that are also available for guest which just adds to the experience in my opinion.
Very nice Lisobn apartment. Exactly as in the description.

We had a really good time in your rooms....hope to see you again !
Thank you !

Vera's / Rafael's B&B bietet eine einzigartige, zentrumsnahe Lage. Alle wesentlichen Hotspots sind zu Fuß, oder mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln zu erreichen. Das Frühstück war etwas spärlich, aber am Ende ist das Preis- / Leistungsverhältnis unschlagbar. Wir haben uns blendend erholt und hatten eine tolle Zeit in Lissabon.
Vielen Dank!!!
Grüße,
Jenny & Ralf

Rafael met us, thanks for your hospitality! The apartments are in an excellent location, almost all points of interest are within walking distance. The apartment has everything for life. Breakfast products are a nice bonus!
Although we stayed only one night, we really liked the apartment and the dialogue with Rafael. I recomend to stay here!
The apartment is very close to many palces of turistic interest as well as to the trams. We walked everywhere. Highly recommend

Unterkunft in top Lage mit sehr freundlicher Begrüßung und Unterstützung wo man sie benötigt. Das Apartment besteht aus 4 Doppelzimmern mit Gemeinschaftsküche und 2 Badezimmern. Die Matratzen sind leider schon etwas durchgelegen. Für ein paar Nächte in Lissabon wo man sowieso nur zum schlafen in der Unterkunft ist bestens geeignet. Man braucht nur eine Einweisung und etwas Fingerspitzengefühl um mit den Schlössern an Haustür und Eingangstür zurechtzukommen.
这天本来是去辛特拉但改变计划之前的房间没有房了所以只是将就一晚，里斯本很想，房间几乎就在商业区，去时候没有看见房东本人而是他的儿子，房间被分割成四个房间，设施还算齐全，这个价位性价比也还算高了，房东准备早餐食材可以自己做，如果对住宿没有太多要求的这是个不错选择。
Dziękujemy Rafael za miłe przyjęcie, świetne przygotowanie pokoju oraz wszystkie wskazówki. Było naprawdę miło a Lizbona to przepiękne miasto. Pozdrawiamy

Bon accueil de la part de Raphaël -Logement très bien situé en centre ville ( mais quartier peu rassurant La nuit..).    Cependant il faut aimer les joies de la Colocation ( cuisine , salle de bain, mais surtout le Bruit )

Ce logement est tres bien pour passer quelques jours! Bien placé à côté des transports et près des endroits à voir, des places, des restaurants et boutiques.
Ce qui m'a posé problèmes c'est l'eau de la douche. On arrivait pas toujours à avoir de l'eau chaude.
Ensuite il y a du bruit la nuit avec des chiens qui aboient régulièrement et en pleine nuit. Mais aussi de la musique forte le matin, on ne sait toujours pas d'où ca vient.
Sinon l'appartement est propre, il y a ce qu'il faut.
Rafael est très gentil et serviable.
On a passé un agréable séjour.
The place is very pleasant, cosy, well located, clean. Breakfast, coffee, tea and fridge. And good advice for nice restaurants around.
Excelente lugar, muy cómodo, muy buena limpieza, y personas muy amables.
Very nice and charming place, and Vera and Rafael were very nice. I can definitely recommend.

Bon rapport qualité prix.
Peu d'intimité car c'est un vieil appartement.
L'emplacement est très bien .
괜찮은 곳이에요 ㅎ

Vera and Rafael were perfect host. The communication was very easy and helpful. We had a nice conversation upon my arrival. The apartment and bathrooms were very clean and everything was nicely decorated. The neighborhood is very authentic. Thank you!
Vera's place is in a great location in Lisbon and we really enjoyed our stay here

Posizione ottima per la vicinanza con la fermata della metropolitana, raggiungibile a piedi in pochi minuti. Raphael è stato molto disponibile. L'unico  appunto che sento di fare è per la colazione, a mio parere, scarsissima.

The apartment was really cozy and clean.
It is well-located and just a few minutes to the center of the city.
Metro and Tram are also very close.
The apartment itself has 4 rooms, we had a really cozy one, just by the kitchen with all things for breakfast including ( groceries are refilled every day )
There are also 2 Bathrooms with Shower.
We were happy to stay at Vera's apartment and recommend it!
Great location.  Friendly host.  Small place with 4 rooms.  Very clean but with a small and uncomfortable bed

What a lovely welcome in Lisbon! Although we didn't meet Vera her son could not have been more helpful. He really helped us out with parking in those narrow streets! The apartment is within walking distance of the centre of the city and the older, touristy spots, though it's a bit of a climb! The room was lovely and the breakfast available in the kitchen was a nice touch. Great hosts!
位置非常好，临近市中心，房租虽然是合住，但也很干净很整齐很舒适，不错的旅行体验！

O ambiente de Vera e Rafael é muito bom: bem localizado (o bairro da Mouraria é muito animado e tem restaurantes típicos portugueses muito bons), limpo, aconchegante e bem organizado - café da manhã bom também. Próximo ao Metro e às principais atrações turísticas de Lisboa.
Fomos recebidos e orientados pelo Rafael (filho da Vera) que também administra o local - Não temos palavras para falar sobre Rafael - é uma pessoa maravilhosa, que nos atendeu super bem, nos dando dicas de tudo que perguntávamos, com a maior paciência e atenção - Excelente anfitrião!
Esperamos voltar ao local e à Portugal assim que possível!
Marize e Marco.

Le logement est bien et propre ! C'était très tranquille lorsque nous y étions ! Il y a 2 salles de bains complètes pour les 4 chambres, ce qui est bien ! La chambre est grande et confortable ! Nous recommandons !
Sehr netter Kontakt, das Zimmer ist sehr einfach und klein. Stadtteil ist multikulti und superzentral. Jederzeit wieder.

WHile the location is central, it is in a seedy area with lot of pick pockets in the vicinity. There is no lift and one had to lug the luggage up steep stairs. There is no fan or air-conditioning and it was hot in June in Lisbon making it difficult to get good sleep. The neighourhood is quite noisy until early morning also making it difficult to sleep. The building does not have adequate lighting making it difficult to climb the stairs in the night. My wallet got picked early morning while we were walking down with our luggage to the taxi stand. The caretaker's son had promised that he would book a taxi for early morning departure but the taxi did not arrive, forcing us to walk down to the taxi stand in a neighbourhood which did not appear to be safe during late & very early hours. The room was quite small and the bed was making a lot of sound. The caretaker cannot speak English and only way of communication was with her son who speaks good English. Also it is not an attached bathroom. You share two bathrooms for three double rooms.
Otherwise the kitchen was well stocked and had all the implements to make a nice meal. The location is centrally located with easy access to all forms of public transport.
Very walkable to all you want to see in Lisboa!

It's a very cosy place to stay in my journey. The traffic is fine to every where, and the location is remarkable for a walking to the topical tourists spot；and the bed is comfortable for a good rest. The host are very nice and thoughtful.
It's totally worth recommended.

Tivemos uma ótima recepção! Rafael e Vera foram muito solícitos e o local é muito bom. O apartamento é organizado, limpo, confortável e fica localizado no coração de Lisboa, tendo ainda fácil acesso ao metrô. Indico a todos!
Lugar pintoresco y de difícil acceso en coche.  Imposible aparcamiento en proximidad.  Es aceptable para gente joven y con ganas de aventuas

We really enjoyed staying at room 4 of Mouraria apartment. All rooms were occupied but our room wasn't close to the living room, so we were not bothered at all. The apartment was clean, nicely decorated and our room had all we need. There are two bathrooms, one is better than the other, looks like it was recently renovated.
The only downside was the kitchen, the breakfast included is very limited for 8 people staying in the apartment. One morning there was nothing left. Cooking didn't seem possible, the stove was not working and there was no equipment even to make a plate of pasta.
Finally, it could have been nice to provide two small towels, for face, hands or hair.
Thank you Raphael for your kind welcome and your interest,
Loue and Baptiste

Lugar bem localizado, próximo ao centro de Lisboa. Certamente os anfitriões farão toda a diferença!!!
Obrigado por tudo!

Very sweet little room in a nice historical Appartement. I was just for one night there but everything was very well organized and clean and comfortable. I could sleep very well. And the area was perfect. You can reach everything by walking. Thumbs up :)

Perfect for a budget traveler to stay a night in. The apartment is clean, cozy, bedroom is big enough. And it's close to the metro station. However, It was kinda hard for me to sleep well at night.because of the noise from the street and the mosquitoes.
Rafaël est charmant et à l'écoute. Très bon rapport qualité prix.

Vera's son Rafael is an excellent host, so helpful and interesting and responsive to questions about Lisbon.  The rooms are beautifully decorated and the place is close to the metro and to two important squares in Lisbon.  Lots of dining opportunities and coffee shops in the immediate area.  A great choice for accommodations.
Everything is fine except a bit nosy at night.

When we arrived there was nobody there. The host was 40 min. late. When he showed us our room, it wasn't even prepared (at 4pm). There were still the bed sheets missing. Overall the whole appartement seemed disordered. The bathroom was disguisting. There were hair all over the place, everything was really old and in a bad condition.  The bed is too small for a 1.75m person and really uncomfortable. There was also a strange third singlebed in our room. The room didn't look like on the pictures. The keys for the frontdoor also didn't really work. We were lucky that there was a friendly neighbour opening the door for us. The only good thing was the location. Mouraria is a really nice neighbourhood.
Great area - very convenient. A lovely apartment. Light and airy room. I would certainly stay here again. A good choice for exploring Lisbon.

Wir waren für 5 Tage in Lissabon und hatten einen sehr angenehmen Aufenthalt. Der kleine Abzug bezüglich der Sauberkeit ist darauf zurückzuführen, dass die Küche von bis zu 4 Parteien genutzt wird. Rafael, Veras Sohn kommt jedoch jeden Tag vorbei und putzt den gesamten Gemeinschaftsbereich. Wie das aufschließen der Türen funktioniert sollte man sich lieber direkt zeigen lassen, da es ein wenig schwierig ist.

It's an amazing house, very clean and cozy. Perfect communication from the host. He let us keep all of our luggage in the house even that we checked out. Love the house. Highly recommend for staying in Lisbon.
Raffael, Veras son, welcomed us very friendly and gave us a lot of good tips on what we could do in Lisbon. He was very friendly and we had a wonderful time in Lisbon.

Super Lage, netter und unkomplizierter Host.
Frühstück ist sehr sperlich ausgefallen.
Insgesamt simple aber nutzbare Unterkunft.
Un très bon accueil par Rafael !
It was a very nice apartment. Our room was clean and everything was as described. The area is really relaxed with many authentic restaurants

Parfaitement bien situé, l'appartement de Vera est idéal comme camp de base. Raphael vous accueillera, vous guidera et saura être disponible pour vous. Il connait de bonnes adresses qui vous plongeront directement dans le Lisbonne authentique. A première vue le quartier peut paraître quelque peu aventureux mais ce qui est plutôt bien dans cette ville c'est que vous ne vous faites jamais embêter dans la rue par les "couches-tard". Profitez bien de votre séjour !

El piso de Vera muy centrico para utilizar transporte publico en la ciudad.
Tranvia 12(castillo) a 5 mn andando el 15 (Belem) y panoramico 28 a 10 mn escasos. La hab 1: bien. En cuanto a cocina y servicios muy basicos. Dificil de aparcar en la zona si vas en coche.

This space was great! Centrally located, nearby the Metro, but also within the main area to explore on foot, this apartment is well-equipped and well-suited for a night or a week! In addition, Rafael was very kind and gave great recommendations for local spots to eat. I'll definitely return here! :)

Good value room. Neighbourhood is a bit down at heel but it is convenient for the castle and there's one of Lisbon's best viewpoints just up the hill. Kitchen is quite basic but there's free breakfast things. Living room is also pretty small but fine for a quick breakfast. Bed has some creaky springs but otherwise comfortable. There's three other rooms in the flat.
Fui bem recebido pelo Rafael, muito explicativo. Estava tudo em conformidade

At first when we reached, the host was not available and the phone is unreachable. We waited at the airport for quite a while and lastly decided to check in to the hotel for the night. Right before we check in for the hotel, Rafael called back and so we took another taxi to the apartment. The neighborhood was quite crowded with people standing by the streets. however, its really near to the metro and we could walk to both the rossio square and praca de comercio in 15-20 mins so its alright. The toilets are quite small and the water heater doesnt work very well. The current got cut off a few times. Maybe because of the heater but i'm not too sure.. Other than that, everything else was alright.

The room was nice and clean, but the bathrooms and kitchen were not really clean.
There is no possibility to cook and we did not like the part of the city, we didnt feel safe. But it is to say that the city center is close and the room is really cheap. So it was okay to stay for two nights especially for the price. Raphael was very friendly.
Sorry for not given a very good review but I just describe my opinion.

This is place is great because of its location but during our entire weekend stay we did not have an ounce of hot water. We tried to take showers at all different times of the day (even 1 am) and ended up having to take cold showers. Also, the person listed as the owner (Vera) was nowhere to be found -- another person who seemed to be another guest showed us the room. We also didn't have toilet paper for half of one day. So, this place is very convenient to Lisbon but the amenities are lacking for the price you pay and it was impossible to contact someone about these issues because Vera didn't seem to exist!

Very unique and romantic location. Perfect for detecting the town. Lots of authentic, friendly, very good and cheap restaurants around. Inly 5 minutes to walk for the next metro station. One of the friendliest hosts, I ever met!

We were welcomed warmly by Vera's son Rafael. He showed us everything and told us everything we needed to know.
We chose Vera's airbnb because we only had a short stay in Lisbon and wanted to enjoy the view of the viewpoint Monte, which is very close. Thanks for having us, even if only for one night!
Nice apartment in excellent location. Very good host

Very good host -- (Vera's son) Raffael met us at the front door and Explained everything to us. There was tea and milk and cereal provided and the rooms were nice and had character. The location (two blocks away) from Maetin Moniz Metro stop and about 25 min walk from Castelo Sao Jorge were also great.
리스본의 분위기에 잘 어울리는 숙소였습니다. 간단한 아침식사가 제공되고 여러 가지로 부족할 것 없는 숙소였습니다. 특히 Rafael이 매우 친절했고, 여행 중에 생기는 여러 어려움 해결에도 적극적으로 도와주었습니다!
Good location, very central, and Rafael was helpful. Make sure you ask him how to unlock the doors, or else you'll be standing outside hoping someone will let you in.

We were received by Vera's son, Rafael, who was very helpful and informative. He even arranged a cab for us as we had to leave for the airport very early the next morning. The place is clean, our bedroom was very comfortable. Breakfast was a self service from the kitchen, which was very suitable for our early check out.
Vera's place is in a quiet street in Mouraira, a busy area in Lisbon where you can find restaurants and shops of any sort. Recommended.

Rafael made us feel very welcome as Vera was out of town! The room exactly matched the pictures and was very clean. Rafael responded to texts/emails very promptly and helped us with anything we needed.

Solo uno noche aquí pero podría ser más! El location estuvo muy bien y los direcciones por Vera era muy puntual. Su hijo nos ayudó la noche su nuestra viaje para disfrutar más la ciudad. La única cosa para mejorar sería mejor comunicación antes del viaje. No recibimos nada antes de llegar al habitación.
Fantastic location and a lovely, historic room with beautiful mouldings and lots of light. Everything was clean. Overall a great guesthouse!
Rafael foi muito simpático e recebeu-nos muito bem ... As acomodações são muito bonitas e tradicionais, a relação preço qualidade parece me muito justa . Muito obrigado um abraço Hugo
Good location !

Woning ligt middenin de stad wat op zich prettig is, alleen hebben wij geen oog dicht gedaan door het lawaai buiten. Nadelig was ook de nogal criminele sfeer in de avond. Werd veel gedeald op de hoek van de straat.
Verder was het bed te kort voor ons en wij zijn niet uitzonderlijk groot (1.70m).
Zentrale Lage am Martim Moniz. Sehr gutes Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis. Wenn man nicht zu hohe Ansprüche hat, genau richtig!

Fernando was a bit overloaded but very nice and comprehensive with our needs. The house is in the center and close to everything interesting, quiet and clean. And there is even some breakfast some mornings!
The place was exactly as described. Its a very nice flat and perfectly located!

Excellent location! We walked by foot to the Alfama, Sao Jorge castle, the waterfront, rua Augusta, Rossio, santa just a lift, etc. Accommodation exactly as shown. I felt it was good value for your money. Metro stop 5 minutes walk from the door. In the heart of old town Lisbon.
Nice and close to the city

Das Zimmer ist etwas kleiner als es auf den Bildern den Anschein macht und das Bett ist nicht sehr bequem, es ist aber ausreichend für ein paar Nächte. Die Lage der Wohnung ist dafür auch wirklich perfekt! Leider ist es nachts etwas lauter in der Nachbarschaft, das war für uns aber kein großes Problem.

Расположение квартиры отличное, , рядом метро, жд станция откуда легко можно добраться до синтры , кашкая и т.д. , однако несмотря на то что квартира  находится в центре это район эмигрантов. Комната  в целом неплохая, но кровать ужасная и  кривая. Хозяева отзывчивые, в холодильнике есть продукты для завтрака. Общая зона убиралась нечасто. В целом жилье удовлетворительное, но не более
This trip was absolutely great. Rafael (vera's son) is a perfect host. Mouraria is for us the best place to discover Lisbon.

Vera was very welcoming and gave us a good feeling.
The location was perfect.
We were a bit surprised with the room that was small, darker and a bit stuffy. Different feeling than we got from the picture.
Our stay was good thought and fitted to our needs for a one night in Lisbon on our way to the north of Portugal

The room was exactly like the photo, however, the bed is small in length, and because my boyfriend is very tall (1.92 metres), the bed was too small for him. But as we found out during our travels this was often the case in Portugal. Otherwise the place as great and the hosts were both very kind and helpful.

This was a nice, clean room for a one-night seat in Lisbon. Rafael met us immediately at the door and was very thorough with explaining everything. Guesthouse is shared with others but each room has a lock and there are two bathrooms, so it's easy to do your own thing.
Neighbourhood is fantastic for restaurants and bars.

This apartment was in a great location , very close to the city centre. The apartment was nice and clean and had two bathrooms which was a good. The only down fall would be there was no fan in the room so it was very hot during the night and also very loud at night with a small bar located down the road.

Rafael welcomed us at our arrival.
The room was clean. The Guesthouse is a good place to stay for a few days as there are 4 rooms in total.
We appreciated to have the breakfast in the morning.

Vera was very helpful at the beginning and communicative when we arrived. Unfortunately there were road works in the morning and some nights a very noisy neighborhood, so you cant spleep with open window. Overall I would recommend the place because its close to the metro, to restaurants and the center of Lissabon. Our room was like in the picture and we had everything we needed, although we thout that breakfast was served. Did not matter!

The Airbnb is very central to many food stands and some cafe places. We were only there for a night and it was perfect. The room was super clean. The only down fall was the bathrooms, one bathroom did not look very clean and the second more modern bathroom was wonderful however when you showered the drain did not drain so the shower would flood. Fix this and this would be amazing.
Nice GH! Good location!
This was a nice place close to a great dinner spot. The room was a good size and a great start to our trip.  We had to switch rooms,  but it was still very good.
We loved this place!  It is clean and organized.  The host was really great.  I definitely recommend it.
Very nice place, comfortable and pleasant. Thank you very much for your hosting !!
This apparment is located in the center of a busy part of Lisbon. It is easily accessible and the neighbourhood is fine, although at night it was very noisy.
Great location and room! Vera was there to welcome us and she was very friendly even though she doesn't speak English! Clean and nice room and common areas! Definitely recommend it!

Our stay in Lisbon at Vera's place was excellent. The apartment was easy to find and was very cute and well equipped. It was in a great location close to the centre and the castle. Both easy walks. The wifi was great and the shower had amazing pressure! There was very good security. If I came back to Lisbon I would definitely stay here again.

The guesthouse is located at a very central position in Lisbon city center, close to the metro station, the station from which a lot of buses and trams leave and the castle, very convenient. We were warmly welcomed by Rafael. He explained us everything and said to contact him if anything was wrong or when we wanted travelling advice. The place looks a bit smaller than on the pictures, but it was nice and cool. I would recommend this place to other guests, only remark is that the place is not suited for people taller than 1,75-1,80m (bed and shower). For the rest, I would visit Rafael again if I need a place to stay in Lisbon!
Nice place if you stay in Lisbon for a couple of days! Clean apartment and good location.

Upon arrival, we were surprised to see the whole street under construction. There was barely any room to walk on the sidewalk. It would have been a courteous thing to inform guests of the road condition before they arrive. We ended up staying one night instead of four. The guesthouse definitely showed it's age and the bed was quite uncomfortable (very squeaky and no support). I recommend that they invest in a more comfortable bed since it's important to get a good night sleep as a traveller.
Nice, easy, Central, Shared rooms
kind host and good location～
Great

PLEASE DO NOT GO. 비추천입니다 절대가지마세요 絶対行かないでください。希望您不去这个地方。
This is my very first bad review ever. I have stayed in many guesthouses and this one was the worst. The host, Rafael (Vera's son), had unwelcoming attitude and very offensive.
Here is what happened-
Check-in was 12pm (stated on AirBnB) and Rafael told me that I can drop the luggages first at 10:30am. So we agreed to meet at 10:30am but he was 30 mins late. We had to stay on the street waiting for him and when we finally met Rafael, he didn't even apologize (he eventually did later during the incident). So we entered the house 11am and decided to wait in the living room until 12pm to check-in the room because the room was getting cleaned and we wanted to rest & unpack stuff first. Rafael told that we could wait, so we waited. At 12pm, I asked him if I can go inside of the room, he said the "real" check-in time is 2pm which I didnt get at all. He said that in his house, the "check-in time" means the luggage-drop time and I can go inside of the room at 2pm when the room is clean. He insisted he emailed me about this but I never got and I have never seen anywhere takes "check-in time" means only luggage dropping time and going-into-the-room-time is 2 hours later. What I was uncomfortable with was Rafael's attitude. He was very unprofessional and accusing me as it was my fault. He asked me why I was complaining and it was because I paid for the room and it was below the expectations and what we agreed. I felt very uncomfortable and have never seen anyone who is so irresponsible and unwelcoming. During the conversation, Rafael apologized but I felt he didnt truly mean it. He was not apolozing from his heart and he just did because he had to. I hope you dont make the same mistake as I did.
호스트 라파엘은 너무나 불친절하고 약속을 안지켰습니다. 에어비앤비에 나와있는 체크인시간은 오후12시였고 먼저 아침 10:30시에 와서 짐만 내려놓아도 된다 했기에 아침 10:30시까지 약속장소로 갔습니다. 하지만 라파엘은 30분이나 늦었고 저희는 길에서 한참을 기다렸어야 했습니다. 그런데도 미안하다고 사과도 안하더군요. 우여곡절끝이 집에 11시에 들어가고 저희방은 청소중이라고 했습니다. 한시간후면 방에 들어갈수 있었기에 거실에서 기다린다고 했습니다 (먼저 짐을 풀고 좀 쉬고싶었습니다). 라파엘이 기다려도 좋다고 하더군요. 마침내 12시가 되고 방에 들어가도 되냐고 물아보니, 체크인은 2시에나 가능하다며 말을 바꿨습니다. 이게 도대체 무슨소린가싶엌ㅋㅋ 에어비앤비에 체크인이 12시로 나와있는데 무슨소리냐고 물었더니 라파엘이 본인집에서는.. (쓰는 와중에도 다시 화가 나는군요) 본인집에서는 "체크인 시간"은 짐을 거실에 내려놓을수있는 시간을 뜻하고 방은 그후로부터 2시간뒤에 들어갈수있답니다... 라파엘이 에어비앤비를 통해 메일을 보냈다는데 저는 그런 메일을 받은적도없고 (방금도 체크했으나 역시나 없네요. 거짓말같아요ㅋㅋ) 태도가 너무 차갑고 기분 나쁜 말투로 형식적인 대답만 하더군요. 그러면서 저보고 왜 불평을 하냐는데.. 당연히 제가 돈까지내고 부당한 서비스를 받는데 그럼 가만히 있나요? 제가 기분 나빴던것은 라파엘의 태도와 말투입니다. 사람을 무시하고 계속 말을 교묘하게 바꿔가며 교활하게 굴더군요. 저도 지지않고 영어로 자세하게 따지니깐 영어로 암쏘리~이러는데.. 미안해 근데 어쩌라고? 딱 이런 느낌이였습니다. 여튼 너무 비추고 절대절대 가지마세요!
絶対行かないでください。ホスト、ラファエルは本当に不親切だし、態度が最悪でした。
the host is very good. We enjoyed the travel in Lisbon.

The apartment is brilliantly situated close to the castle in the heart of Lisbon. The room is nice with wooden flooring and plenty of space. Unfortunately the shower does not work well and we mainly had cold showers. The toilet seat was also completely broken so slid around.
Our biggest gripe was the poor communication. We asked 4 times if there was parking nearby and each email was ignored. When we arrived it became clear that the host did not want to mention that the entire road was being dug up which meant that not only was parking very difficult but driving to the apartment was nearly impossible...

It was our first ever stay at an Airbnb place and this was very pleasant. The neighbourhood is quite old by NA standards but the apartment was clean and well managed. Our host Rafael was most helpful, meeting us at the metro and telling us the real Portuguese places to eat. The place was not easy to find but we got a good feel for the area after 3 great days. Very authentic Lisbon experience and we enjoyed our stay.

I loved staying at Vera's place. It was my second time to stay there. Her son Rafael is extremely kind and very helpful. His is an interesting and worldly person and he was quiet enjoyable to have conversations with. The guest there are also interesting to meet. Please see my other reviews. I would really recommend staying there. Thanks for making my first trip to Lisbon and Portugal memorable. Cynthia
Rafaël heeft ons erg gastvrij ontvangen. Hij was erg behulpzaam en vriendelijk.

I was met by the Vera's son, Rafael. He came to take me from the subway stop as the old town streets are not to easy to navigate at 9:30 at night. He was very welcoming and really kind. He was available for all things that I needed. The place was spotless. There are shared bathrooms and kitchen. All the guest during my stay were very considerate to each other. The place was on the first floor so it was easy to come and go with luggage. It is close to so many of the sights and easy to navigate your way from their place. I already book my return to Lisbon next week at their place. Thanks for everything.
Boa localização, quarto super confortável e ainda tínhamos café da manhã. Recomendo à todos.

Vera e' molto gentile e le camere sono molto accoglienti.
Il quartiere e' in pieno centro. Buon rapporto qualita' prezzo!
Everything is good. Rafael was very friendly and helpful.
It was a nice place to stay. Cheap, clean, and the location is close to the down town.

We arrived quite late at night and were welcomed by Vera's son who took care of us. He kindly provided us with extra beedsheets and all the neccessaires that we left in our lost luggage in the airplane. The room was simple but nice and very much like expected. We did not have breakfast in the flat but the kitchen is fully equipped and the joint flatmates were super friedly. The place is super central and great to explore the old town for one or two days. Many thanks to the hosts!

Wir wurden bei der Ankunft von Rafael, Vera's Sohn, empfangen. Er hat uns kurz durch die Wohnung geführt und alles erklärt. In der Wohnung ist alles vorhanden, was das Herz begehrt. Sie ist mitten im Zentrum gelegen und nur 5 min von der U-Bahn entfernt, so dass man sie auch super leicht mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln erreichen kann (z.B. vom Flughafen aus).
Die Kommunikation hat reibungslos funktioniert und ich kann die Gastgeber nur empfehlen!

Nice room, bed comfortable, very good location at a quiet place in Moraria, very near Castel de S Jorge. You don't even need public transport to visit many of the main touristic places (Gracia, Alfama...). Rafael is a super kind person and he was of great help when I needed it.

The apartment was easy to find and close to a metro stop. Check-in was very easy and Rafael was very nice and welcoming. That night we walked around the area, which was both close to some resturants and the very beautiful tiny streets of the area. Quite picturesque! We very much enjoyed our one-night stay and would absolutely go back.

Appartement spacieux, bien équipé , propre.
Quartier populaire et vivant.
Raphaël le fils de Vera nous très bien accueilli. Une petite attention très sympa (petit déjeuner offert café, yaourts, jus).
Il nous a conseillé par ailleurs un très bon resto qui pratiqué tout les jours tellement il était bon et pas cher et local.
Bonne adresse

Staying at Vera's place was a great choice. We felt central to reach any possible place in the city, the house was cozy and our communication before and during the staying was perfect. Thanks so much Rafael for your kind welcome! If I ever come back I will totally stay here again!
Vera's place was great, just as cute as pictured and in a good location. There were other people staying in another room of the apartment but it wasn't at all a problem. I would stay here again.
Perfect localisation and nice place. Two bathrooms to share with the other bedroom.

El apartamento de Vera está ubicado en un lugar estupendo, a 10 minutos de la Plaza del Comercio y justo donde comienza el Barrio Pesquero de la Alfama. El acceso en coche es un poco complicado pero muy cerca hay tranvia y autobus. La casa está bien equipada y tanto Vera como su hijo Raphael son muy amables. Muy recomendable

Accueil chaleureux par le fils de Vera, qui donne des infirmations très judicieuses sur les visites à faire à Lisbonne. Appartement lumineux, belle chambre. Le petit déjeuner fourni avec beaucoup de choix.
Appartement à 5 minutes du métro. Une grande partie du centre se découvre à pied. Parfait.

Tuvimos una estancia muy agradable. La habitación es bonita, la cama comodisima, hay 2 baños, cocina totalmente equipada con desayuno y saloncito y pudimos encontrarlo fácilmente e incluso aparcar muy cerca. Recomendación muy alta.

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour.
L’accueil était parfait, ainsi que la propreté et la localisation de la chambre d’hôte.
Seul problème, notre chambre était séparée de l'escalier de l'immeuble par une cloison très mince. Nous entendions les bruits de l'escalier comme si nous y étions.
Nous recommandons le séjour dans cette chambre d'hôte à condition de séjourner dans d'autres chambres.

Nice appartment .Easy communication and luckily very helpfull with the fact that I'm to big to fit in there normal beds.

Had a lovely stay at the guesthouse.
All lovely and great location. Big recommendation.

Thank you for helping us, with our missing luggage.
The flat is really beautiful and centered in the old and really nice part of Lissabon.
Unfortunately, there was no jam in the kitchen where we left. But that should be a problem, we took some butter on the bread roll.
A really nice place to be; I would have stayed a bit longer.. Full recommendation ! :-)

The booking was confirmed soon - but contact afterwards were troubled. We received an answer only 1 day before we arrived - but by then we were already leaving our other appartment in north of Portugal (who checks mail during his holidays - was just a lucky accident i discovered this one). So arrival time and adress were fixed.
The house and pictures show reality it is a cosy flat with four double rooms. However unfortunately we never met Vera in person but her son jumped in for this duty. Breakfast included means here unfortunately that you can serve yourself from the kitchen and you have to arrange your plans/habbits with the other guests. If you need anything additional - you are welcomed to buy further stuff and put it into the fridge. Washing is then (hopefully) done some time in the evening. It was a bit fuzzy to get the plan of presence there.
However the location of the appartment is great - really in the center and you dont have to take this famous tram 28 to make a round trip - you just start to walk and make funny pictures of one way roads with a tram where its actualy not a one-way road at some hours a day...
Lissabon was real fun and it pays of to walk around instead of taking the tube/tram/bus - you see more and you'll be faster. Also we can recommend to visit the Fado Museum which is just a short walk away. During our 4-days stay we had nice time with the other guests in the flat - if you like to chitchat with other guests and the host you should try this apartment.

We had a lovely stay at Vera's guesthouse in Lisbon. On arrival we were met by Vera's son Raphael, who gave us some great tips for our short stay in the city which proved to be really useful. Two bathrooms are shared by the guesthouse's four rooms, however this did not detract from the experience for us. The location of the gueshouse is close to the diverse area of Martim Moniz on the typical narrow cobblestoned streets, a short walk from the metro and famous tram. The area can get a little noisy at night however wasn't a problem for us with the windows closed.

Overall we had a very enjoyable experience and would recommend for those looking for a good value place to stay near central Lisbon.

Vera's apartment is as described.  When we arrived we were met by Rapael.  Although it was well past check in time our room was not ready and we had to wait while Vera was cleaning it.  The area is extremely noisy all night and into the morning hours,  even with the windows closed.  There was NO hot water for showers the two days we stayed.  Although the listing says the breakfast is included, it was extremely limited and not replenished.  We had booked four days but checked out after only two nights because we were not satisfied.  We would not recommend it.
Bem localizado, instalações limpas e organizado. Custo benefício muito bom! Perto do metrô, fácil acesso do aeroporto. Rafael e Vera muito gentis e solícitos!

Thanks to Vera we had a great time in Lissabon. The guest house is located cloes to all sight seeing locations. Flat was very clean. We have met nice people who gave us good tips for our stay. Thank You Friederike & Thomas

Me and my husband had a great time at Vera's place.
Rafael was very attentive all the time, went down to pick us up by walking and offered help to carry my lugage.
If you want to experience how to leave in a late 19th century bulding there is a great spot. Very close to a metro station and we could do a lot by walking distance.
Everybody was very nice.
Our room was a bit noisy but we could have a good sleep anyway.
And we forgot to mention to Vera that the matres was a bit uneven and would be nice if she could change it.
We had a great stay there and we totally recommend!

Our room fitted the description.
The two bathrooms are clean, but very tiny.
The neighbourhood is quiet noisy in the night.
It was really nice from Rafael to give us the possibility at the last day to leave our baggage in the flat until evening, so that we did not had to carry it the whole day with us.
Thanks for your great hospitalitity!
It' s ok. Very kind man who helped us and answered all our questions! Thank you. But the beds are to small and it is not visible from the picture. But for the price totally ok.

Vera was good with communicating with us.  We did not meet her, but the gentleman there met us at the metro station to help with our luggage and show us to our room.  He was helpful in telling us places we could visit in the area and how to get there.  I have to confess that the photos look nicer than the Place is, the room was fine, but while making sandwiches in the kitchen we watched a cockroach walk by on the counter.   There was juice, bread, jams, etc. that you could use to make your own breakfast in the morning.  It was extremely loud and noisy outside of our bedroom and we did not get much sleep.  We could not Close our window because it was too hot, and ear plugs did not help.

This place was perfect for our stay in Lisbon! The location was great, close to the metro and within walking distance to several attractions. It was lots of fun meeting people from all over the world that were staying there and it was no problem sharing the two bathrooms. Rafael was a generous host who took time to give us recommendations and directions on what to do and where to go. We can't wait to visit again!

Ich wurde freundlich von Mauro begrüsst. (Bruder von Vera). Er hat mir alles in der Wohnung erklärt. Die Wohnung ist freundlich und sauber. Ich fühlte mich sehr wohl.  Die Nachbarschaft ist ab 11 Uhr Nachts bis morgens 5 sehr laut. Ich habe aber ein Ventilator bekommen konnte die Fenster schliessen und so war es nicht zu warm im Zimmer und die Fenster sind gut isoliert man hört den Lärm nicht.

The house is in a good location, near by the metro and the center... . The rooms are clean and nice. We didn't met Vera.
Our stay in Lisabon was great.

Nous sommes restés "chez Vera" 1 nuit.
Je suis également très sceptique sur l'existence de Vera.
Apres envoyé plusieurs messages pour savoir a quelle heure nous pouvions arriver, nous n'avons eu aucune réponse. Nous avons donc décidé de nous pointer vers 12h pour déposer nos bagages.
En utilisant les informations qui sont décrites dans le détail de la rubrique itinéraire ce n'est pas si difficile a trouver.
Nous avons été plutôt bien accueilli mais je pense qu'il s'agit plus d'un "intendant" qui dort dans un coin de l'appart que du fils de Vera.
La chambre était nickel et les salles de bains super propres rien a dire !
Bon cote quartier, c'est la Mouraria ... donc bien sur c'est populaire et bruyant mais c'est tout le charme du coin. A 2 pas du metro sur la ligne direct de l'aéroport et a 5 min de l'arret de tram pour aller a Belleme c'est tout de meme pratique.
La seule mauvaise surprise est apparue le matin de notre départ. Nous avions prévenu des notre arrivée que nous avions besoin de laisser le bagages dans l'appartement jusqu'a 17h ce qui n'avait pas l'air de poser de problème. Quelle surprise quand on nous a annoncé a la dernière minute que cela se monnayait a 5€ !!!

The place was value for money and very clean. The apartment is nicely decorated allthough a bit small for 3 persons with shared facilities. The breakfast is simple but ok. The apartment is in a very lively neighbourhood with lots of noise untill very late. If it's not too hot you can close the window and the noise will not bother you so much. I would not recommend this accommodation for females travelling alone.
Location was great, bed was comfortable, and we only wished we could have stayed longer!

L'adresse n'est pas clairement indiquée et l'hôtesse ne répond pas lorsqu'on lui demande par téléphone de préciser l'emplacement exact. Le gardien Raphael est, lui, par contre, très serviable, sérieux et compétent. Chambre correcte, propre et bien située, dans une rue néanmoins bruyante.

The apartment was excellent! Not hard to find, in a great location! The place was amazingly clean- two bathrooms were a huge plus! Our host was excellent, so so kind and helpful and great to chat with! He had amazing recommendations for the area which we took! Would stay again in a heartbeat!

Tuvimos muy buena experiencia en la casa de Vera, el apartamento está bastante bien situado, la habitación es acogedora, limpia y bien decorada. El anfitrión fue Mauro, el hermano de Vera, muy educado y atento para ayudarnos con indicaciones y lo que necesitáramos. Lo recomendamos totalmente!

We arrived earlier than we should but the host took care of us no problem. The beds were clean and comfortable. Bathrooms though shared with others but still clean and pleasant. Kitchen well equipped.

Vacances entre copines pour découvrir la ville !

Deux jours avant notre arrivée, nous avons contacté par mail Vera pour obtenir des infos sur l'heure d'entrée, mail resté sans réponse... Nous avons donc décidé de nous pointer vers 14H. Nous avons bien eu du mal à trouver l'appartement étant donné que l'adresse ne correspondait pas à ce qui était mentionné sur le site (Lisbonne, District de Lisbonne 1100-376, Portugal). Nous avons donc du demander à des locaux pour trouver notre chemin, qui au passage nous ont dit de ne pas trainer le soir car il y a du traffic de drogue dans le quartier.. Eux-même n'ont pas su nous renseigner, nous avons donc du appeler au numéro de téléphone donné dasn l'annonce.

Il est mentionné que notre hôte était Vera, or nous ne l'avons pas vue.. C'était un hommen (qui fait office d'intendant?).

Bref, si vous chercher vraiment une chambre chez l'habitant, passez votre chemin, ici c'est un "hotel" déguisé en guest-house.

The room was very nice and checking in went well. Vera's son Raphael was great to deal with on arrival and was keen to give recommendations. Not a huge deal but the small communal space was dominated both nights by non guests who were quite loud until late. It was difficult to communicate with them due to our lack of Portuguese and their lack of English. This may have been a one off as the other rooms were empty. The other reviews seem to suggest so. Also, there was a window between our room and another covered only by a sheet of cloth where Vera's live in family member resided and smoked inside. All in all it was a relatively pleasant stay but keep this in mind if it would be an issue.

Right in the heart of Lisbon!
We had a very nice stay in Lisbon and in Vera's apartment. Her son Rafael and the uncle welcomed us and made sure that everything is fine! The apartment is clean, the breakfast tasty and the room quite big although a little bit noisy, because of thin walls.
The apartment is located in a very cute neighborhood and everything important was in walking distance! :) Very nice!
Thank you

This property was comfortable and our host (Vera's son-did not see Vera) offered us an array of information at the point of meeting. We did not see him again for the weekend. We arrived after a severely delayed flight so we were well and truly ready to 'check-in' to our bnb and check-out (to bed) for the evening. It was a shame to reach our home for the weekend and be told that we were required to pay an additional fee to him ! This being €30. I had originally booked for my friend and I and as the booking had changed to 1p in the process I had emailed Vera twice with no reply. I thought okay perhaps this is fine they have read my emails and all is okay. To be 'slapped with an additional charge' so to speak was not welcomed. We were given the reason that Vera had broken her small finger a week ago and could not respond to my emails sent one month prior and also that Vera has many properties to look after so my emails had been dismissed and forgotten about.
If you are looking for a genuine airbnb experience I would not recommend.
When given the above reasons I felt more like I was dealing with an institution! Far beyond the nature airbnb does so well to uphold all over Europe.
The room was also very hot, and suffered from much noise from the street.
Would be okay if staying outside of summer time and looking to join the night time festivities. Also if you are willing to over-spend.

The location of the house is quite good! It's close to a metro station, tram 28, and you can also take a 15 minutes walk to the city center Rossio train station. The room is lovely and well-furnished. The breakfast is nice. And the host is friendly and helpful, the first day we came to Lisbon quite late, he and his uncle came to the metro station to pick us up. The other day, our wallet was stolen, the host provided us some useful information.
Lovely place. I really enjoyed the breakfast there.
We liked how the host welcomed and treated us. Very friendly and he likes what he's doing. The area is close to major attractions.
The apartment is in a good location, in a walking distance to the main attractions of the city. The room is nice and clean but the double bed is a little small. Rafael is a good host.

La chambre est située dans un quartier populaire, très pratique car près de la station Martim Moniz
Depuis l’aéroport, nous conseillons de prendre le taxi, la chambre est difficile à trouver la première fois (taxi de l’aéroport à la chambre seulement 8.50€)
L'accueil même très tardif est possible et Rafael nous a chaleureusement et efficacement accueillis.
La chambre est propre et bien, mais ne vous fiez pas aux photos qui sont prises avec un plan très élargi et une luminosité exceptionnelle
Le calme est relatif, chaudière très bruyante mais eau chaude assurée !!! aboiement et bruits de rue le week end
Les salles de bain sont relativement propres mais pas assez aménagées pour un accueil commun 4 chambres (tapis de bain trempé).
Le fonctionnement de l’utilisation de la cuisine et de la salle de bain en commun demande un respect de la part de tous
(vaisselle non faite, engorgement des tablettes de salle de bain…) une petite affichette informant que nous ne sommes pas à l’hôtel serait peut être nécessaire pour responsabiliser chacune et chacun.
Pour 30€ la nuit à 2 c'était cependant adéquat.
Rafael visited us in front of the house. He showed the place and told everything that was important. Rafael is really nice guy. He knows Lisbon history well and he is a very intelligent host.
This was a lovely home, for an amazing value. We had plenty of room and the shard living spaces were as clean as could be. I recommend this Airbnb to any couple traveling though Lisbon.
Great stay...Rafa (Vera's son) was very nice and accommodating.

Lisboa is such a wonderful city and Vera's (Rafael's) apartment a perfect location to explore the beautiful Mouraria district!! But other parts of the city are also in walking-distance. For those who don't like to walk ;) -> Public transport is easy and close to the house. Also from the airport: very easy with the Metro.
Vera was (unfortunately) on holiday when my friend Heike and I arrived but we were welcomed very warm and friendly by her son Rafael!
The room was exactly as shown on the photo. The first 3 days we had the whole place to ourselves. With 2 bathrooms it was "luxury"! :):)
Everything was clean and breakfast provided every day.
Mouraria district is quite lively at night - but we didn't mind this at all!
Windows are double-glazed… ;)
Rafael is a very open-minded and bright person! We loved our conversations with him and did learn a lot about Lisboa, Portugal, his home country Brasil and life-experience in general. :)
WE WOULD/WILL COME BACK FOR SURE and recommend this accommodation 100% which is furnished in a beautiful old portuguese style!! THANK YOU RAFAEL, TAKE CARE and SEE YOU!
Heike & Susanne
Thanks Vera and Rafael, we had a wondeful time at Apartamento Mouraria.

Thank you so much for the welcome experience we had at your place!
Sadly it was a short stay for us, but we know for sure that we are coming back..and hope sonner than later. The place is so warm and friendly and we enjoyed our staying there. Such a beautiful city...and so many beautiful details the city has!
I would recommend this place if you want to feel like home . Enjoy your stay!

Bij aankomst met een taxi werden we verwelkomd door Rafael die gelijk klaar stond met een plattegrond en tips over dingen die wat hem betreft zeker de moeite waard zijn om te bekijken. De gehuurde kamer zag er precies zo uit als op de foto en beviel goed. De badkamers werden gedeeld met andere gasten, maar dit leverde geen problemen op. We hebben 2 fijne overnachtingen gehad in een hele mooie stad en zullen deze accommodatie zeker aanraden aan anderen.

Bonjour, nous avons passé un agréable séjour à Lisbonne. Votre appartement est très bien situé, au calme et nous avons apprécié le petit déjeuner.
Antoine remercie encore Rafaello pour l'écharpe qu'il lui a offert.
Antoine, Laurent et Virginie
Sehr gute Kommunikation mit den Gastgebern und ein sehr schönes, zentral gelegenes Apartment, das mit viel Liebe eingerichtet wurde!
this is a very good house and host, it is more convenient to get the house by taxi. The Internet is so stable ~

De taxichauffeur moest even zoeken om het te vinden en rekende dan ook 25 euro(!) Terug gingen we op aanraden van de host met de metro 1,80(!). Dat ging sneller en een stuk goedkoper. Het is 5 minuten lopen naar de metro. De ligging is dan ook perfect, middenin een typische Lissabonse wijk en op loopafstand van het centrum, metro en de beroemde lijn 28. Overdag komen er veel toeristen doorheen, maar 's avonds nogal wat ongure types op straat. Ze hebben ons verder niet lastig gevallen, maar ik vond het toch niet zo prettig voelen zo samen met mijn moeder. Desalniettemin liepen we wel elke keer in plaats van de taxi te nemen.

De kamer was erg schoon. De badkamer was wel schoon, maar had wat mij betreft nog iets schoner gemogen. Ontbijt bestond met name uit toast en jam en kon je zelf maken. Je kunt zelf ook eten in de koelkast bewaren als je wilt.

Ontvangst was prima. Rafaël gaf nog wat tips over wat te doen in de omgeving en was gedurende het verblijf ook goed bereikbaar via Whatsapp.

Voor een betaalbaar weekend in een authentiek gedeelte van Lissabon kan ik het zeker aanraden!

Hello everyone, I would like to say few words about this particular place. First of all I need to say very BIG thank you to our hosts. The room was perfectly prepered, the price is suitable. Add to this hospitality and many helpful advices and then you will realize that this apartment is for you.

P.S. The neighborhood ist so bad, as it looks like for the first time. My advice? Try it for your own you wont regret it.

Rafael was very efficient, helpful and nice. The guesthouse is well located (though females traveling alone/in twos should not come back too late or take a taxi), short walk to Alfama, and the room itself is clean, airy and pretty. No complaints! If you're the sort to be fussy about it, bring your own toiletries. Thanks very much for the great experience.

Raphael hat uns gleich herzlich empfangen und in seiner freundlichen Art gezeigt, wo wir am besten essen gehen können und wie wir uns gut in der Stadt Lissabon zurechtfinden. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Vielen Dank!

Vielen Dank. Gracias. obrigado.
Wir hatten eine tolle Zeit in Lissabon und haben uns über den netten Empfang von Rafael gefreut. Für diese Jahreszeit ist es sehr wichtig, dass man darauf achtet das die Apartments Heizungen hatten. Rafael hat uns zwei elektrische Heizungen zur Verfügung gestellt.

Gerne wieder. Hasta pronto.

Rafael and Vera were both very helpful and welcoming. Their apartment is beautiful and built in the traditional style. This means it can be a bit cold in winter though! But Rafael provided us with an extra heater for the room. Apartment is perfectly situated for getting to the main squares and the Alfama. It was a wonderful trip to Lisbon and I only wish we could have stayed a bit longer!

Vera and Rafael were so welcoming! They had the house very ready and clean when we arrived. Rafael was a great recourse and even showed us where to go in town! The house had everything we needed for the weekend!
Mein gastgeber war super nett und sehr hilsbereit.
Very well located flat. Super cosy and clean. Host waited for me till midnight to show me around. Great value for money.
Centraal gelegen, prima en betaalbaar guesthouse.

Super séjour dans cette ravissante guesthouse, dans un quartier très sympa.
Raquel et Leo ont été très accueillants.
On recommande vivement !

Very nice and cozy bed and breakfast in the center of Lisboa. Very friendly hosts as well. I would recommend this to everyone smaller than 1,90m, since the only minor point is the small size of the beds.

Nous avons été ravis par l'accueil chaleureux et plein de gentillesse de Raquel & Leo. Les lieux sont tenus chaque jour en parfait état de propreté. La guesthouse est vraiment proche de tous les endroits typiques du vieux Lisbonne.Pour les amateurs de Fado, l'endroit rêvé. Encore merci Raquel et Leo pour votre hospitalité.
Claire et Guy.
Bruxelles.
Thank you so much for our stay in your cosy apartment. Even if we lost the match, we really loved our stay in Lisboa and we really want to come back to your beautiful city 😊

We had a wonderful stay at this property in Lisbon. The apartment had everything we needed and more! It is a great location and Pedro's team was very helpful. We would recommend this listing to everyone.

Very nice place to stay for 2 located right in the middle of many hot spots. Walkable and access to Ubers is seamless. Conveniently located by the train and tram. We were welcomed with a bottle of wine which was nice.
I was prepared for the stairs, but the only hard part was how narrow the building entrance was and narrow and steep staircase was. For the last flight of steps, there is no rail so be aware. If you are traveling with a large suitcase, I do not recommend. Philipe was great and helped me with my suitcase upon arrival.

De locatie van het verblijf is super. Midden in het centrum, tussen alle winkels en restaurants. Gemakkelijk tram 28 te pakken voor de deur. Communicatie met de eigenaar is mega vlot en super vriendelijk. Wij hebben er van genoten! 10/10!

This is the single best trip in Europe so far. I originally planned for 2pax, but unfortunately broke up one week before the trip, but still decided to come alone. The rooftop was stunning, and I found a home in Lisbon, where I also rediscovered myself. The hosts were super sweet and the apartment has everything you’ll ever need. Simply amazing.
A área do Chiado é incrível, e foi melhor ainda com este apartamento! recomendamos fortemente! Muito bom!!!

The accommodation was great for a short stay. There were couple of things that didn’t work in the flat and probably would be frustrating for a longer visit but I’m sure they will be fixed in no time. Host was very helpful and communicative. Central location is a plus for quick city exploration.

계단이 높긴 했지만 아주 좋은 위치에 있어서 여행하기 너무 좋았습니다!
해가 들어오면 숙소도 너무 이뻤어요!
감사합니다!

The host was very accommodating! Beautiful loft, loved the area it’s so close to everything you need. Appliances were in great condition, place was super clean and the host went above and beyond to make us feel welcomed. We were also provided with a list of recommendations of places to go to by the host. 10/10 experience highly recommend.

Host was so amazing he helped us in every need and always so kind. Most of all the place was very clean especially the bed smelled so fresh and sleeping was so nice here. Shower booth and bathroom was also very nice. Location of this place was very convenient. View from the window was so beautiful ❤️
I wanna come back to here and want to thank to the best host I experienced in Lisbon
공간을 존중할 수 있는 한국분들께 추천드립니다 매우 께끗하고 예쁜 복층 방에 친절하고 빠른 답변 해주는 호스트였고 새벽에 택시잡는것도 도와줬어용! 그리고 Chiado 동네 너무 좋고 위치가 께끗한 거리 근처여서 주변에 예쁜 카페랑 식당이많았어요 계단만 괜찮다면 완전 추천 ❤️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Beautiful apartment and amazing location, Pedro also helped us with the luggages, highly recommend to everyone!
주요 지역을 도보로 갈 수 있어 접근성이 좋은 숙소입니다! 테라스가 정말 좋습니다 :)
Beautiful place, spectacular terrace, very well located
Super Cozy appartment in a 5Stars area. Perfect located and awesome Host :)
A small gem at the city’s heart: walkable to everything, peaceful away from the chaos.

Es war ein super Aufenthalt. Wir waren sehr zentral und hatten viele Möglichkeiten etwas zu unternehmen. Würde ich jedem weiterempfehlen. Ausserdem waren die Gastgeber sehr zuvorkommend und äusserst freundlich.

Communication agréable et utile. Appartement très bien équipé, fidèle aux photos et extrêmement bien placé, avec un super pack de bienvenue. Je ne peux que recommander les hôtes et cet appartement. Parfait de À à Z! Merci beaucoup
The stay was perfect! The location is right in the center of Lisbon. The apartment was very clean and peaceful. It was easy to communicate with the hosts. Would definitely recommend. Thank you ☺️

Great location with a comfy loft. The stairs were really actually quite steep and narrow, so be prepared for that. However the location makes it all worth it, great restaurants within minutes and train station nearby.
Definitely worth considering if you are a couple touring about Lisbon!
Fantastic space. Very comfortable and excellent location. Cant really fault it.
Apartment in great location. Host very reactive and helpful. Apartment very clean and cosy for the 3 of us. (2 adults one child) thanks a lot for the stay

Great stay. Short walk to/from metro. Right next to Bairro Alto where all the bars, restaurants and night life is at. Bit of a climb to get to the place and another climb in order to make it to the apartment. The entrance and stairs are a bit tight; large luggage will be a hassle to carry. The apartment is clean and spacious, but could use with more lighting. The location is also right off a street with a cable car line, so it can get a bit noisy at night. Host is very friendly and super responsive to messages. We had no problem with check-in, with the host being there to greet us. and they were flexible with allowing us to check in early.
Overall, great couple of nights in Lisbon and we had no major complaints with the listing!
Lovely apartment, very helpful hosts! Would definitely recommend! :)
Charming loft, a lovely place to spend our first two nights on Lisbon!

Such a cute appartment, well equiped and absolutely perfectly located.
Very responsive and friendly hosts. Would stay here again, we loved our stay. 🤩
