Thank you 😊

Place was convenient. Host was friendly and responsive. We had some issues with the shower but host was quick in resolving the problem. Appreciate the fast action taken! if you don't mind the stairs, it's a great place to stay in!

Absolutely fantastic stay. Couldn’t recommend the location more for a quiet but central stay in Lisbon. The patio was perfect to enjoy coffee or a glass of wine. The bed took a bit getting used to, but was cozy and comfortable. The team also helped us book a very early cab to the airport seamlessly and we’re extremely responsive!

This was by far the nicest airbnb that we've stay at. He allowed us to check in a couple hours early. There was a beautiful note waiting for us with chocolates, a bottle of wine and a basket of fresh oranges, Nespresso, jams and teas. Two robes waiting for us as well. I've never been to an airbnb that had all those extra little touches that really made the experience that much better.
The shower had conditioner, body wash and shampoo, and a blow dryer with a diffuser, perfect for my curly hair!
The location itself was right in the action of it all! Restaurants, bars, coffee shops, exactly what my husband and I enjoy. People made comments about being able to hear the tram. but this was not an issue. we're from toronto living downtown, so if anything it felt like a quiet getaway. Not an issue.
The coolest part was that they provided us with a portable wifi pack so we could have wifi anywhere in protugal. This saved us so much money on data!
Thanks again for a lovely experience.

We enjoyed our trip to Lisbon and our stay was great. The location was perfect for those who like to explore, restaurants and shopping were within walking distance.
Communication with Pedro and his team was top notch. The loft was perfect, clean and private. As others have mentioned the stairs were steep, but worth the climb.
We will certainly stay again on our next trip to Lisbon.
Superbe accueil. Logement fonctionnel et conforme aux photos. En plein centre de Lisbonne. Merci pour les recommandations.

We loved our stay here in Lisbon! The team is incredibly helpful with check in instructions and recommendations and very willing to be flexible with our arrival.
The place is exactly as the pictures show, very clean and comfortable, lots of beautiful natural light and homey touches, with a nice little terrace to sit outside.
There are A Lot of steep narrow steps to go up and down so if that is an issue I’d recommend looking for a different spot, carrying suitcases up and down is tricky but we’ll worth the stay. We loved the place and would stay again!

Great place to stay in the heart of a lively district. Be aware that if you are light sleepers or want peace and quiet the tram line runs next to the flat from early till late and Saturday night in particular was noisy all night. But if you want access to the city and don't mind city noises then it's a fantastic location. The hosts were also fantastic, our flight was delayed by two hours so we ended up checking in at 10pm and they were very understanding, responsive to messages and met us at the apartment to let us in and show us around. Would definitely stay again.

Throughly enjoyed my stay. Would like to shout out Antonio who met us when we checked in and helped bring our incredibly heavy bags up about 4 flights of stairs (the only downside of the place). It was above and beyond. They also let us check in a little early when our schedule changed.
The place has an incredible location central to so many amazing places in Lisbon. The outside area is very nice and extremely private too. Overall a great place w wonderful people running it.

A great location to explore Lisbon from. The roof terrace was a lovely place to chill during slow mornings before heading out. Only criticism would be the bed situation wasn’t ideal - you are quite tucked into the angular roof so as a tall man, I did occasionally bang my head when I sat up. Even so, would highly recommend for a short term stay.
..haben eine traumhafte Woche verbracht - Lissabon- Amore mio 😍

We had a great stay at Chiado Lofts! Coordinating our arrival was easy as the host was extremely communicative and responsive. He also personally met us at the apartment at check in to let us in and show us the features of the place. The space is clean, beautifully decorated and comfortable. We loved the patio and view from the living room window. The location was perfect for our itinerary. We would absolutely stay here again!

We had a fantastic stay - the studio was exactly as described and in a perfect location for us to explore Lisbon.  The roof terrace was a real added bonus and a great place for breakfast and for a well earned glass of wine at the end of a day exploring the city.

We absolutely loved our stay here. We cannot fault it! The location was fantastic, easy to get to from the airport and the perfect home base to explore Lisbon from. You are right in the heart of it all. The place itself has clearly been well thought out, everything is catered for, great attention to detail, clean and welcoming. The terrace is a bonus and feels like a little oasis. The shower is great and the beds are super comfortable. Our only suggestion would be a long mirror upstairs, as we were on a girls trip and an extra mirror would have gone down a treat. The hosts were brilliant, very communicative and had great recommendations, which we used to our advantage. We highly recommend booking this place, you will not be disappointed. Thank you Pedro for a great trip!

Would absolutely stay here again when back in Lisbon! Perfect location, spotless loft, confortable beds and great hosts. Even though the flat is on a busy street, we were never disturbed by noise. The charming terrace was a big plus for us too.
excelente!
This was a great airbnb with a very friendly and attentive host. Pictures and description matched the space very well, super cute place and highly recommend!

This was a great apartment in the centre of Lisbon and was very convenient to get from here to all the other surrounding areas. We would definitely recommend this apartment to friends. Just one point though! We didn’t find it clear that there is an extra fee for having a 3rd person in the apartment and we’re quite surprised by this the day before we’d travelled, especially after giving details months before. However, even with this, the apartment was good value for money!

The place was very nice and most importantly at a great location. They were flexible checking us in a little earlier than anticipated and that was super helpful as we arrived in Lisbon early in the morning. We enjoyed the apartment and the outdoor area whenever we were not out and about that wonderful city. I recommend this apartment and it’s gracious host.

I loved staying here. It was perfect. Really nice place and super clean, which I appreciated. Best neighborhood to walk everywhere. I like how communicative everyone was with checking in and how easy it was to get there. Thank you!! I will stay again for sure

Pedro + his team were amazing - very communicative before + during the trip. Checking in w/ Francisco was easy and they were flexible based on our arrival. He showed us around and made sure we knew how to access and use everything. Such thoughtful touches at the airbnb - they left chocolates and a bottle of wine and thorough lists of recommendations and checked on us during our stay. Place is super cute and charming. Outdoor patio was very nice to enjoy a glass of wine after a long day.
As others have mentioned, it's 4 flights up some steep steps but to be perfectly honest, if that's an issue, Lisbon may not be for you!
Just a note that the laundry is a washing unit and then air drying. This is probably obvious to some! but was a surprise to me. However air drying was easy - esp in July
Great location - we spent most of our nights in Alfama area but liked the short walk back and it's close to the very busy nightlife in Barrio Alto without being loud at all. Would definitely return!

The place was perfect and we would definitely stay again! The team was very responsive to messages, we’re incredibly friendly and helpful, and we’re very flexible in timing for helping us get checked in. They offered great recommendations for restaurants and bars nearby and were super helpful throughout the process. Apartment is nice and clean. We slept very well on the bed - one of the most comfortable mattresses we’ve had at an airbnb! Stairs into the apartment are steep (and there’s a lot of them!) but wasn’t an issue for us - just something to be aware of if anyone finds stairs difficult. And the host was super helpful in helping us with one of our bags too. Location was excellent- a lot of great restaurants and bars nearby - and everything in the city is super walkable anyways. No complaints at all - would definitely stay here again and recommend this place to anyone!

Pedro’s loft was lovely! The location was very central although does require a climb up to the neighborhood of about 100-200 feet. It’s also a very lively area with much to do and many locations stay open very late but you can’t hear the noise from inside. When you arrive, you have to climb up 4 very steep flights of stairs as well and the doorway to the building is very narrow. The hosts provided two booklets of local recommendations, one for restaurants and one for activities. I appreciated the full size toiletries and the oranges provided for us to make fresh orange juice in the morning with the juicer which was wonderful. The patio does not have a view although the pictures do make it appear as though there is one. It was too hot for us to hang out on the patio anyway. The AC works well but doesn’t quite reach the mattress area as well as we would have liked. The hosts were all very responsive and attentive. Would recommend this stay!
Väldigt fin lägenhet i perfekt läge. Rent och fräscht, värden var serviceinriktad, kommunikativ och mycket trevlig. Bra instruktioner. Kan varmt rekommendera detta boende.

A fantastic loft space in Lisbon right by the famous tram stop. Surrounded by at least 6 of the best brunch and coffee spots too. Communication was almost instant. Will stay again and can’t recommend highly enough.

What a great base to explore Lisbon from - in a busy and beautiful neighbourhood full of great bars and restaurants, walking distance to the harbour and the centre, and right on the route of the 28 tram that goes all over the city.
It was wonderful to start each day on the little sunny terrace with freshly squeezed orange juice, and a pastel de nata from the pastelaria next door.
The hosts were brilliant at responding to messages via Airbnb very quickly and everything was so easy.
And the four flights of stairs up to the apartment kept us fit!

This was our base while we explored Lisbon. The loft was a great central location with a lot to do including restaurants, shops, cafes, bars, the harbor, Pink Street, and the 28 Tram route. The terrace was lovely in the morning or after a full day of exploring. The loft was cozy and perfect for my husband and I. Pedro and his team were responsive, very helpful and made check in easy. We would definitely stay again!
I had a great stay at the apartment. It has an awesome location really close to the centre of Lisbon. Balcony is perfect in the evening too and host was fantastic!!
All good. Nice apartment which I can only recommend. Very central, lots of good bars and restaurants to reach by foot.

Truly such a great host and spot to stay at! right in the center of Lisbon. Feels like you're one with the city and right at home. The host went of his way to check us in and help us find the place.  Bed was comfy too. Would definitely go back!

This is a great spot if you’re looking to be close to the hub of a lot in Lisbon, but still want some privacy and quiet space. The tram runs right to the front door, there’s wonderful restaurants and little beer stands near by. A wonderful square and you’re a 10/15min walk to pink street. I would suggest not walking from the chiado station with luggage, but otherwise very good public transportation in the area. It was clean and the terrace was a nice spot to relax. The height of the ceiling was not a huge problem for us, though if you’re taller than 6’ it may be. They met us and had great contact with us for check in and were very flexible.

The location could not have been any better. It’s so central to everything my group and I had planned. The pocket wifi provided was also super convenient. Definitely would stay here again if I come back to Lisbon! Pedro and his team were also super responsive and helpful when I had any questions!

Had a very pleasant stay overall at Pedro‘s place! The apartment had everything we needed for three people and even an extra mattress was provided. The communication was very smooth and quick. The location is very central in Bairro Alto with multiple restaurants, bars and sights in walking distance. However, it can be noisy during night when sleeping with the window open, (especially over the weekend) but that is to be expected. The entrance door is very small (not for big people) and be aware that you have to walk up the narrow staircase to get to the apartment on fourth floor. All in all I can recommend it.

Lovely flat in a great location. Spacious, comfortable, terrace was great for sitting out and relaxing in the sun. Host was responsive, helpful and check in was easy. Lots of recommendations for nearby places to eat/drink/things to do.
Great stay! Would stay again!
Good experience! Perfect location
Would stay again. Place was accurate to description. Host was responsive, place was clean. Thanks!

Tudo perfeito .
Apartamento, localização , dicas , e comunicação rápida .
Voltaremos com certeza .

Pedro’s team was incredibly kind & so accommodating! They graciously waited up on us past 11PM to check us in & give us a tour of the space as we experienced an incoming flight delay. Really great place to stay. So close to all the bars and restaurants. Lovely apartment and balcony was nice to catch some morning sun on. Really helpful with check in and check out. Highly recommend!

We had a brilliant stay at this apartment which is in a great location for shops, bars and restaurants. We loved sitting out on the patio with our coffee in the morning. The apartment is bright and spacious and had everything we needed. Communication with Pedro's team was always quick and responsive and check in was very smooth despite our delayed flight! Would recommend this apartment to anyone wanting to visit Lisbon.
Great area, very walkable. Beautiful space with thoughtful designs. Check in was great. We were met by the host where he showed us everything we needed to know about the apartment.
We had a lovely stay in Pedros flat. The apartment was spotless and the neighbourhood was booming with good restaurant and drinks options. A perfect place for a little getaway.
Wonderful apartment, perfect location!  charming and attentive host, everything perfect!  Thanks

loved this stay. so cosy, bright and spotless. very close to the centre of town, the harbour, pink street etc. fantastic shower! and great little extras set out for us, like oranges to juice in the morning! really great communication from the host. would love to come back.

Amazing apartment right in the heart of Lisbon, close to everything! 4th floor without an elevator but worth the work-out ;-) the apartment was clean, spacious and bright. Beds are on the floor and ceilings can be a bit low. The patio and the view from the place were lovely. 100% recommend!
Only small inconvenience, the front door of the building is very narrow if you have a big suitcase!
Pedro was great to deal with was very responsive , location was central to anything , also close to subway highly recommend . A++
Tout était parfait!

The apartment was beautiful and bright, and the terrace was a great place to chill out after a long day. The stairs to get up there definitely gave me a workout and I could ‘feel the burn’ afterward :) hahaha but a little exercise never hurt anyone.
I would recommend this place to anyone staying in Lisbon.

Vi hade en fantastisk långhelg i Pedros lägenhet. Det var så fräscha och sköna sängar och mycket trevligt med badrock och små välkomstgåvor. Det ligger mitt i smeten så är man känslig för ljud och om man inte är en nattsuddare så rekommenderas öronproppar! Så trevligt mottagande och en härlig vistelse!

Absolutely loved the stay in the loft - very friendly welcome, super responsive communication, and warm and light space with view of the city. Close walking distance to lots of great shops and restaurants. If you’re not a fan of stairs, definitely not the place for you as the apartment is up 4 flights, and the apartment itself is split over 2 levels. All and all, highly recommend.
We had a wonderful stay. Place was super central, close to lots of shops and restaurants. Would definitely come stay again!

The apartment was comfortable and cosy.
It was very clean and full of character with a fabulous view from the window.
There was lots of information on what to do around town which was helpful.
The shower was hot and the kitchen functionable.
The hosts were helpful and kept in good communication when we needed them.
All in all we had a great stay.
Thank you!
Pedro and his team were very responsive and communicative. The apartment was as described in the listing. Great neighborhood. Highly recommend

Pedro’s place was perfect. The description of the space was very accurate. It was clean and comfortable. Great location for getting everywhere.
Pedro and his team were incredibly responsive and friendly. We had a few snafus on our trip and they responded quickly with helpful tips and solutions. I was very impressed with his team

Wonderful stay with Pedro (and team)! We were right on a fun and thriving street with plenty of stores and restaurants. Check in and checkout were as easy as they could have been, and Pedro was highly responsive and flexible to requests. Couldn’t have asked for a more adorable place to stay for a couple nights, and we loved being able to use the patio. Thanks Chiado!

Overall, we were absolutely happy to stay at Pedro's place! A clean and modern flat in a very central location. Pedro's communication ahead of our stay was great and he responded instantly to any questions we had.

Merci Pedro pour l’accueil, la communication facile et le séjour. Appartement magnifique et très bien localisé ! Propre et plein de belles attentions pour notre arrivée.
Je vous recommande fortement ce logement qui est parfait pour profiter de Lisbonne !

Great little place for a long weekend. Ideal for a couple or friends catch up. Super comfy bed. Very walkable and close to busy area for nightlife but apartment itself is peaceful, quiet, light and cosy. Definitely recommend. Thank you
Great location close to several restaurants.
Lovely, cosy apartment right in the centre of Lisbon, making it easy to travel around. Great communication with the hosts, thank you!

We had a wonderful stay at this apartment in November.  The space was clean, tidy, thoughtfully decorated and had all the amenities we needed for our five day stay.  The apartment is in a great location and is close to public transport to visit other areas of the city.  We very much enjoyed relaxing on the patio with a glass of wine.  Pedro and Team were very responsive and check in was very easy.  We would definitely stay here again for our next trip to Lisbon!
This flat is compact but has everything you’ll need for a stay in Lisbon.  Our favourite part was its ideal location - walking distance from many nice restaurants and bars!
Comfortable and stylish apartment in a great location! Excellent communication. Would recommend.

A great location. A cute room. Good communication with staff.
The neighborhood is awesome !!

This was a great place to stay with so much to do and experience so close by. The hosts are very helpful, accommodating and friendly. I will for sure stay here again if I come back!
Great location, hospitable hosts. would recommend.
Amazing location and has all the amenities we could have ever needed. Would stay here again!
Emplacement idéal, logement très propre et agréable, hôtes disponibles et attentionnés. Un séjour parfait pour nous!!

Despite arriving at the airbnb quite late around 11:30pm, Pedro met me at the airbnb to give me a walkthrough of the place. He even carried my luggage up the steep stairs for which I am still grateful! The tour was thorough but brief which was great as I was quite tired.
The airbnb is just lovely, its well appointed, cozy and quiet. It really has everything you could need, the great shower and nice bathrobes provided were the cherry on top. The outdoor patio was wonderful for a morning cup of coffee. The location is excellent as its super centrally located which was ideal for my quick 36 hour trip. My only warning would be that the stairs are quite steep and not super well lit, I would not recommend for anyone with mobility challenges.
Perfect apartment, location and service - will definitely book again!

The apartment is a magnificent use of space and very attractive from a design point of view . Having a patio for breakfast such a nice relief from the busy city .
The quick clear communication was so helpful and put us at ease arriving from another country .
A very well appointed and clean space . We slept like babies at night and walked to everything by day as thr location was fabulous
We highly recommend this air bnb

This is a great little apartment, in an amazing neighborhood. Lots of great bars and restaurants right on your doorstep - and we really appreciated the extensive list of recommendations from our hosts. The apartment is small, but makes good use of a small space. We also appreciated the bottle of wine that was left for us at check-in as well as the complementary mobile hot spot device that we could use all around Lisbon. The apartment is at the top of several steep sets of stairs, so you need to be in good shape to stay here! Overall, a very nice place to stay for a long weekend.
Great location!    Lots of stairs - so be prepared.    While it’s a small space, it makes super efficient use of every inch and is beautifully appointed.   Wish we could have stayed here longer!

Pedro and his team were wonderful start to finish. The apartment looks just the the photos and is on two levels on the 5th floor of a building in a great neighborhood. If you don’t mind climbing stairs, you will absolutely love this place.  My only regret is that I didn’t have more time.
Great spot!

I would recommend staying here. The team for this Airbnb were accommodating and allowed us to store our luggage before check in. The location is very central, although very busy and hilly. The space has everything you would need to have a comfortable stay.

Das Appartement ist absolut wunderbar! Wenn man die sehr steile Treppe mit der etwas schwierigen tür überwunden hat, wird man mit einem sehr schönen Appartement in der besten Lage belohnt, und der service mit der superschnellen Antwortzeit ist hervorragend! :)
Die Whg ist ganz klar daraufhin ausgerichtet dass man viel abends Essen und trinken geht, sprich, die Küche ist wirklich sehr klein und kochen sollte man daher auf das allernötigste beschränken. Beautiful place. Amazing location. Fantastic check in. Highly recommend

This airbnb was everything you could ask for in an Airbnb. We felt super safe in the apartment and had all of the necessities. Staying here made Lisbon even better than we could have imagined. 10/10 would recommend and stay here again in the future.
The apartment is very, very beautiful, super clean and has everything you need for a perfect stay. The location couldn't be better in the middle of everything…..we enjoyed it to the fullest ✨✨✨✨✨
A second visit can often be disappointing but not on this occasion. Lovely property in a great location.
Excellent service from the team and very accommodating. Brilliant location and highly recommend.
Wonderful apartment in nice area. The beds are extremely comfortable!

Easy to communicate with host, clean apt and nice location - place is just like on the photos. Good value for money. Would come again.

This was a fantastic stay in a great location in Lisbon. It’s less than a minute away from bars, cafes, restaurants, tram 28, and only a few minutes from the nearest metro station. The insulation in the apartment must be very good though as there is no noise from the street when inside.
It was clean, stylish, and well stocked, the hosts also dropped off an iron when we asked for one. The terrace was a nice place to sit both morning and evening and got plenty of sun. Check in was smooth, and there was a lot of information from the hosts about local bars/restaurants etc. Was a great price too.

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour dans cet appartement, tout à fait conforme à la description et aux photos. Très bien situé dans le quartier du Barrio Alto.

Hôte très réactif dans tous les échanges et disponible pour un check in tardif .
On recommande vivement !

The apartment was amazing and perfect for a couple or a single individual. The location was very central and in reach of everything you would need.
Pedro and his team were really helpful and accommodating, giving us really good recommendations and even let us check out later than planned. Would definitely recommend!
Perfect location and very clean, will stay again for sure!
Amazing hosts!

Super cute, great location and very comfortable, we loved our stay here! Lots of thoughtful touches such as fresh fruit, chocolates and a bottle of wine were most appreciated. Be prepared for the typical steep stairs, and you’ll be rewarded with a lovely flat. We were charmed by being able to watch the adorable trolley roll by, and the double paned windows kept everything quiet.

We had the loveliest stay at this apartment. The small touches like leaving us a note with a bottle of wine and chocolate were very sweet. We had issues getting to Lisbon and Francisco’s communication was great and he was very accommodating with our altered arrival time. The location is perfect for getting out and about - so many delicious food spots. The roof terrace is a great little sun trap and we loved our late lunches on it!
We loved this apartment, it was very comfortable and had wonderful views. The location is also ideal for exploring Chiado and Bairro Alto.

This place is in a great location for exploring Lisbon. It is a fairly small space and up narrow stairs but the lovely attention to details make it very comfortable. It was wonderful to have a washer to refresh my clothes after traveling for several days. The quality of towels and linen were excellent. The bed was a Mattress on the floor but was very comfortable. They have great communication and left excellent notes on the space and surrounding area. There are so many little shops and restaurants very close. We loved our stay here.

One of the best AirBnB experiences I've had to date. Apartment was exactly as described on the listing, if not slightly bigger in size.
The team added a lot of small touches to apartment for our stay, and the dressing gowns were a lovely touch. The apartment was very well kitted out too (coffee, wine, shower gel, plenty of utensils) which made the stay very relaxing.
The star of the apartment is the terrace which is a lovely space to have a morning coffee or evening drink. It feels very secluded and quiet.
A final special mention to the check in team who were very accommodating to an earlier check in and later check out.
Overall a great stay!
Great location for the city and lovely apartment 👍🏼
Best stay ever in Portugal! The apartement is so precious,  super well arranged and well equipped! A luxury experience while staying at home!
Great Airbnb! Rui met us outside the Airbnb and gave us a tour of the Airbnb. They provided us oranges and wine :) loved the location as well. Would recommend to anyone visiting Lisbon
Great apartment in a great location!
Pedro’s apartment is perfectly located right next to Bairro Alto and close to the metro station. The flat is nicely decorated with beautiful furniture and is spacious. The view is stunning.
Great host - great team - always very helpful and replying fast. This was our second time on one of their aprartments and we will definately come back. Highly recommended!
We had a great stay at this apartment in Lisbon! Location was fantastic and loved the open rooftop patio!

We loved this Airbnb so much it felt like home. It was so clean, had all of the amenities, and the beds were super comfortable. Location could not be better, it was a 15min walk or less to all attractions in the city. Street was also quiet. It was an incredible experience. Definitely recommend staying here!

Wonderful stay in a perfect location of Lisbon! The apartment was spacious, clean, had great AC, and we loved the balcony. The hosts were very accommodating with our schedule as well. Would definitely stay again.
Everything great
Super nice place with very accommodating hosts in a great part of Lisbon. Highly recommend

Great location, great host. Super helpful. The one small issue we had (over the course of one week) was dealt with. Lots of steps, a compact space. But if you don't mind that we really recommend this place. We'd book it again.

Brilliant apartment couldn’t of asked for more. Location is great and hosts are quick to reply with any enquiries you have. The extra touches you receive make it that bit more special (Oranges to make fresh orange juice in the morning was lovely). If you’re in Lisbon to have a good walk around you’re in the centre of everything here! Will definitely be returning thank you!

The apartment was in a fantastic central location, with a lovely rooftop patio which gets the sun for most of the day.
Communication from the host team was great - when I asked for an iron, a member of the team dropped one at the apartment straight away.
Francisco, who checked us in, was really friendly and knowledgeable.

Also, the beds are on the floor in an alcove (as pictured), which was ok but not the most comfortable situation!
Overall the apartment was finished really well and we enjoyed our stay.
This place was perfect for my stay in Lisboa! The patio was beautiful and the apartment itself is clean and modern. Would stay here again!
We had a great weeks stay here and would visit again. Lovely clean accommodation.

A little gem.
We stayed for 4 nights and couldn’t of been happier with this apartment. Super clean and had everything we needed. Location is great!

Gorgeous place! Would recommend staying here to anyone. Location is perfect and the hosts left us all the essentials you’d need - such as coffee!

We loved our stay here!  Every request we made was immediately addressed.  Pedro and his team are very responsive.  The place itself is beautiful, with water views and an amazing patio. Seamless booking/ check in and very clean comfortable studio apartment in a great location with some luxeries like a speaker/ portable wifi/ dishwasher/ washing machine/  outdoor terrace and really good central heating and stunning bathroom! Would definitely stay again.

Absolute recommendation. ✨
Super cosy with the ideal location. The guys are super friendly and caring. All in all the perfect stay, thank you!

Pedro hosted a very nice space. He set up a greeting that worked out great with a walk-through. He was very honest about the 4th floor walk up and made it easy for us to navigate the city. The suggestions were great too.

A well-equipped apartment in a great location. The check-in process was smooth and the hosts were communicative and shared lots of great tips for things to do in Lisbon. There were also lots of nice, little touches in the apartment and we had everything we needed for a short stay. Would highly recommend!

Very nice place in the heart of Lisbon. I walked everywhere and the location couldn’t have been better. The hosts were super helpful, even helping carry my bags from a convenient car park down the street. Note the beds are on the floor in two alcoves which didn’t bother me, but was not a traditional setup. Nice outdoor deck was a nice addition.   Great value for Lisboa

Fantastic stay. Most organized hosts I've stayed with, everything clean, organized, great guides, and all the amenities you could need. Perfect location, central to some of the best spots in town. Cute patio. Very communicative and accommodating hosts. The only thing to note is that the flat is 3 stories up steep and narrow stairs without an elevator, so a bit of a challenge with luggage for some.

It was a pleasure staying at Pedro‘s. The loft is located in a very beautiful neighborhood with just two minutes walking distance to one of the best sunsets you can ever whitness. The check-in was super easy, the apartment has everything you can wish for.

Wonderful spot, steps away from everywhere you want to be and very thoughtful hosts. The portable wifi hotspot included in the apartment is an amazing touch and so helpful to carry around for wifi while exploiting Lisbon. My only note (not an issue for us, but just helpful to know) would be that the door is very narrow and the apartment is up 5 flights of steep stairs. This would be more challenging for guests with mobility or accessibility needs. Thank you for a lovely stay!

Pedro's apartment was perfect! Ideally located to explore Lisbon, whilst being spacious, tastefully decorated and very clean. We particularly loved the roof terrace, comfy bed and big shower. Would definitely return!
Our stay at Pedro's was absolutely amazing ! The flat is very well located, very well equipped and furnished.
Best feature is the private terrace. Lovely spot to have a glass of wine in the afternoon
Charming apartment in a perfect location. Everything you could need. Outside terrace a highlight

Very chic loft in a great area in Chiado-near the markets east to catch the tram or bus. Very close to to fresh markets and restaurants that Pedro recommends. The kitchen is well equipped and it is a plus having a washer. The outdoor terrace was great enjoyed having our wine and  tapas outside .Just be aware that there is no lift and over 5o stairs to climb up to get to to the loft .Pedro and his staff are very communitive .Enjoyed our stay.
Everything was perfect from check in to departure! Great location, lovely apartment and Francisco was available to answer any questions we had throughout our stay. Highly recommend!

This apartment is in a perfect location - walking distance to so many sights, wonderful restaurants, and bars! The apartment is very clean and is a great spot to explore the beautiful city of Lisbon from. Also really appreciate the great recommendations for restaurants and activities Pedro and team have available for you - long, detailed lists! Thanks for the wonderful stay!

We had a great time at this apartment, the check-in and -out was perfect and António was so great at responding all our questions quickly which was amazing. The location is really central and the balcony is lovely.

Amazing location; walk everywhere you want to go! Check-in was very friendly and detailed. Nice little touches like fresh oranges and a juicer. I only mention this because I didn’t see it in the pictures: the bathroom does have a door (it slides). I would stay here again.

The flat is amazing, very well located and very charming. Pedro and his friend Gonçalo who hosted us were very nice and very easy to communicate with.
I fully recommand this flat for a stay at Lisbon

Beatiful. The position is perfect located in the very middle of Bairro alto. Pedro and the other guys are very kind and always available for suggestions or help. The patio is lovely especially in the nights

Cosy and well equipped apartment in a great location! Nice little patio and view. We appreciated the little attentions of wine, fruit & chocolate as well as the small kitchen. As you are on a relatively busy street where the tram rides there is quite some noise at night and in the morning.
Great apartment in a great location. We had a great stay and really recommend staying here. Pedro and the guys are really helpful with great suggestions for local restaurants etc

Très bien situé : Tout proche des quartiers sympas et des restos réputés : on vous recommande le Casa de India et surtout le Mini Bar Teatro (bistronome excellent !) !Très bien équipé : rien ne manque ! Un patio top pour les petits dej ou les fins de journée !
Bref on a très apprécié notre séjour ici avec un très bon accueil et un suivi de Diogo !
Lisbonne : on adore …

We had a very good experience with the host. Diogo welcomed us at the apartment, showed us around and gave us some very good tips of places to go! There was a bottle of wine in the fridge and other little things the team had arranged. The appartment was just as beautiful as we expected and very clean. We had a lovely time!

Petit appartement idéalement situé, calme avec une mini terrasse sans vis à vis fort agréable.
Équipement suffisant pour un court séjour.
Accueil très professionnel des gestionnaires du logement.

Gonçalo, qui s’est occupé de nous pendant notre séjour, est très communicatif et fait son maximum pour que le séjour soit agréable et sans stress.
Petites attentions ( capsules de café, fruit et bouteille de rosé) à l’arrivée.
Flexibles dans les heures d’arrivée et de départ quand le planning le permet.
Je recommande fortement cet hôte.
Concernant l’appartement, il est bien agencé, propre et très bien situé: aucune fausse note. Nous avons passé un excellent séjour.
Top!
Really lovely apartment, very comfortable and amazing location. Top notch amenities. Host was super helpful with check-in and providing advice for our stay. I can’t imagine finding a better spot.

This was our first time in Lisbon and Pedro's apartment made it an amazing experience. The apartment had everything we needed and more to be comfortable and enjoy such a vibrant city. The location is perfect as it is near by to many tourist attractions and delicious restaurants. We also loved having a private patio to enjoy wine on in the evenings. Thank you, Pedro and team!

The apartment is amazing for a duo. Insanely well placed. Common space is very spacious and nicely decorated. The patio is awesome for breakfast and night chills. The host gave us plenty of advices for our stay and we're available for any question.
Accueil très réactif, simple et pratique. Appartement bien conçu, jolis volumes, confortable et bien équilibré entre la touche moderne et quelques jolis meubles. Très bien. Merci !
Everything was perfect! From communication, check in, convenience and cleanliness of the apartment, hospitality, etc! We absolutely loved it and will return!
great location, lovely apartment, efficient check in. would stay again !!

We had an amazing long weekend in Lisbon and such a great time in the Airbnb. Especially with the check in and check out, everything was super flexible and we were also able to leave our luggage in the apartment on the last day while enjoying the day in the city until the flight back home.
The terrace is super nice and has a lot of sun. Also the area is just amazing. Metro 5 min away, cool restaurants and bars around the corner. We would always come back again.
nice apartment with cute roofterras, with total privacy. Good bed and shower. Location is also great!

We loved our stay here. The location is perfect, on the same road as park rooftop bar. We were also in walking distance of so many lovely restaurants. The rooftop is a real sun trap perfect for a bit of private sun bathing. We will definitely be back!

The location is great, central, in a busy neighbourhood with everything needed can be done by foot. The flat is very clean and the terrace is amazing, enjoying sun for the whole day. The apartment is very well equipped and the communication from Pedro, Antonio and Gonzalo was amazing. Make sure to check their other properties.
Gorgeous apartment, the terrace gets sunshine pretty much all day long which was fab. Cosy, comfortable, everything works, and communication with the host was easy and helpful, highly recommend!
Great place with a sunny terrace!
Amazing apartment and the location was perfect.

Great location for exploring bairro alto and the city. The terrace is great for tanning and the apartment is beautiful. It was on the 4th floor with no elevator but that wasn’t an issue at all for us. Enjoyed our stay in Lisbon and the apartment.
Also a tip, don’t park your car on the other side of the ride to the right on weekdays as the police will tow it.

Cute apartment in a great location: The apartment is in Chiado, right on the border with the nightlife district Bairro Alto. So you can sleep relatively quietly at night and still be quickly in the middle of the action. In general, many beautiful locations in Lisbon are within walking distance of the apartment. And in the event that the destination is further away: the famous Tram 28 stops right in front of the house. Once you've squeezed your way through the narrow front door (quite a challenge with suitcases or shopping bags, but that's part of the charm of the residential area) and conquered the steep stairs, you can only feel comfortable: kitchen, bathroom and living room, which are accessed by a staircase connected to the lower floor, everything a holiday apartment needs to have is tastefully furnished and very well maintained, including the electrical appliances. From a window you can see the Tagus over the roofs. The apartment has a quite large terrace, which is quite difficult to find in Lisbon (at least I searched for a longer time). Ideal for breakfast and lazing around. We felt very comfortable and can only recommend the apartment!

If you’re staying in Lisbon then stay here!!
The apartment is beautiful and so well designed. It’s not a huge space but it really feels it!! It’s bright, with a great view from one of the windows and very stylish!
There are quite a few stairs to get to the flat but if you’re young and fit then it’s sooo worth it. It’s in a fantastic location on a Main Street but you hear nothing from being so high up!
I cannot recommend this flat and these hosts enough - they have us great tips on where to go and what to do and put small touches into the apartment when we checked in which was so welcoming!!
Thank you so much for such a well needed trip to Lisbon!! :)

I had such a great time at Pedro’s pad . It’s such a great location for Lisbon and was easy to navigate around the city from here with the added bonus that Tram 28 literally stops outside. The whole apartment is lovely and the added bonus of a roof terrace. Only 1 downside that there is no iron and it’s needed when you have cloths out of a case . But apart from that all amazing and thanks 🙃
A really stylish apartment, managed in a really professional way. It had everything we needed and is in a great location for bars and restaurants.

Perfect location, this appartement is absolutely lovely, very stylish, all the furniture are wonderful, a lot of small attentions from the host (shower gel, shampoo, soap, coffee for the coffee machine, books and guides) a beautiful terrace with only one thing to pay attention to that is a ventilateur noise from a restaurant downstairs in the street (I guess) that you hear through the day and that stops at around 8pm. But being outside most of the time during the day it didn’t bother us too much. Thanks again to the host who was the best host we met so far.

We had a really nice time. The hosts were very nice and the communication fast always fast and easy. The apartment was beautiful but to get the luggage upstairs was really hard because the aisle is very thin. We liked our stay but we would recommend the apartment for a pair without kids.
Great spot!

Let’s face it : this place is a 5-star.
But Ssshhh, don’t repeat it!!

Always nice to stay at Pedro’s apartment.
The location and the services are just perfect.
Also great in communication & advices
Sehr schöne Ferienwohnung in optimaler Lage. Super Kommunikation mit dem Gastgeber. Perfekt für einen Aufenthalt zur Erkundung der Stadt.

Uma excelente localização , um loft bem charmoso, tudo limpo e com várias comodidades( cozinha bem completa apesar de não termos cozinhado )! Realmente tem vários lances de escadas, que não nos incomodou em nada!
Um local para se voltar na belíssima Lisboa!

Beste Lage um Lissabon zu erkunden! Absolut gut durchdachte Einrichtung, aber nichts für sehr sehr große Menschen (Achtung Kopfstoßgefahr), für uns war es aber vollkommen okay! Wir würden jederzeit hier wieder buchen!
Tout était parfait. L'appartement est très bien placé et, très propre.

The loft was beautiful and very clean. It was very close to anything we wanted to do, which made coordinating plans extremely simple. We got plenty of recommendations that were true to their worth. I would  happily stay here again.
Pedro and team provide a very professional rental service and a great apartment and I would highly recommend this location to anyone visiting Lisbon for the first time.

De petites attentions nous attendaient à l’arrivée pour passer l’année 2019 !
Tout était parfait ! Vraiment comme à l’hôtel ! Sans compter sur l’emplacement idéal !

Diogo/Pedro are great and responsive hosts.
We were surprised to receive wine, champagne and a cake for the Christmas. It was great gesture and much appreciated by my family. Overall, the location was convenient to go to many places and apartment is clean. For us, it was an experience to stay at a loft over a period of days and we enjoyed it. The only downside is probably the lack of elevator, which make it a challenge if you have many luggage.
Ein Superhost, ein schönes Apartment mit toller Ausstattung, zentral gelegen. Klare Empfehlung, wir kommen gerne wieder. Dankeschön!

We had a fantastic time in the apartment. It’s beautifully furnished and the roof top terrace is a nice add-on. Communication with Antonio and the team went really smooth. Couldn’t have asked for a better accommodation in Lisbon!

Amazing hospitality! Very friendly, quick with responses and helpful. Almost felt like staying at a hotel with robes to use and the nice comfy sheets blankets and pillows. Very nice location. Close to lots of restaurants and bars and only a short walk to the time our market which was a lot of fun. I would definitely stay again!!
Great place!
My 3 friends and I loved staying here. It is super stylish and in a great location. The rooftop terrace made the flat feel bigger and the kitchen had all that we needed.

Can't say anything bad. Nice place, good communication and very nice located.
Thanks!

Wir hatten eine tolle Zeit in diesem wundervollen Apartment. Die Lage ist perfekt, es war super sauber, die Ausstattung ist hochwertig und geschmackvoll. Wir haben zu viert 6 Tage in Lissabon verbracht und fanden den Platz ausreichend. Die Geräusche durch die Belüftung auf der Terrasse haben uns persönlich nicht gestört. Diogo hat uns herzlich empfangen und uns tolle Tips gegeben. Nach 3 Tagen wurden sogar Bettwäsche und Handtücher gewechselt und die Wohnung geputzt. Wir können diese Unterkunft uneingeschränkt weiter empfehlen.

Thank you so much for letting us stay! Your place was perfectly located, clean, and comfortable, and we really appreciated how responsive/flexible you were and all the suggestions for things to do/eat/see in the city!
Amazing value for money. Great location. Thoughtful hosts. Would go back for sure.

Excelente apartamento para padrões europeus. A única dificuldade é ficar no quinto andar sem elevador. Não foi fácil subir e descer as malas. Também importante mencionar que é ideal para três pessoas..  mais que isso dificulta p trânsito no loft.

Clean, modern, and perfect location!!! Seriously, we loved the neighborhood. Everything is close by, as well as a nice stop for tram 28, which you should ride for fun. We enjoyed the very helpful recommendations left for us at the apartment. The place is quiet and the patio is so nice!!! We would stay here again. I also enjoyed very quick responses to my messages. Great hosts, great place.
We really appreciated Pedro‘s hospitality and we loved the apartment! The terasse is absolutely amazing. There is love in every detail!

Perfect apartment in a great location. The apartment is not in the heart of the city, which my wife and I prefer, but walking distance to most places. We used the metro a few times to get around, but mainly walked. Everything was clean and Antonio was very informative and gave great recommendations, which we had our first lunch at Casa da India of authentic Portuguese food (not an Indian restaurant). The grilled salmon was amazing. One thing to note is that there are 54 stairs to climb to get to the apartment. If you are okay with stairs, this should not be an issue and you will burn a lot of calories from the delicious food and drinks that you consume. Also, the bathroom is not on the main level with the sleeping quarters and living room. You will have to go down about 10-12 steps to the first level so if you have to go in the middle of the night, keep this in mind. We used the patio a few times in the mornings and evenings having coffee and wine. Overall, the apartment was perfect for our needs and we would stay here again.
Had a great stay. Awesome location and great apartment. Loved the patio!
This loft is perfect. Clean, stylish, all the amenities you need, perfect location, quick responses and a lovely little patio.
Great location within walking distance everywhere. Stylish space and the patio was a nice touch.

This is our fifth time to Lisbon and second time staying at one of the amazingly stylish apartments the team owns. I love the feeling of having our own place in Lisbon over a hotel. These gentleman go above and beyond on every detail. You will not be disappointed. The only tip is the stairs are on an extreme incline and not built to carry luggage up and down. Be weary and do not overpack!
Highly recommended!  Great location and extraordinary hosts!

Ich kann die Unterkunft absolut empfehlen. Tolle Ausstattung, kleine aber feine Küche und eine super Lage, um Lissabon zu erkunden! Die bekannte Tram 28 fährt direkt vor der Tür, Metro ist in 5-7 Minuten zu erreichen und auch alles andere der Altstadt ist bequem (wenn man von den Steigungen absieht :) ) zu erreichen.
Wir würden wiederkommen!
Excellent location. If you’re used to AC in the summer you won’t find too many places in Lisbon but this place has it. Very comfortable. Great hosts.
Fab stay! Great location, very clean and stylish, great advice on local restaurants and activities... Cannot recommend enough. Thank you!

Un super accueil, dans notre langue natale en plus (français), très gentil ! À l'écoute, très réactif dans les messages, l'appartement était très propre, magnifique, une super déco et très bien placé ! Je recommande vivement !
Lovely apartment right in the heart of Chiado. All amenities and transport within walking distance. Really enjoyed breakfast on the sunny patio every morning.

This apartment is so nice and stylish. The hosts were amazing with dealing our late check in due to flight delays and even at 1:30am Diogo was such a lovely man.
The location is near everything and you even get a massive list of recommendations. This place have everything you need and more. I wouldn’t look anywhere else to stay in Lisbon.
Diogo and his team are very professional. The flat is everything the description and photos show. Diogo's willingness to please made this Airbnb experience a memorable one

A charming place with wonderful amenities and beautifully decorated.
Brilliant location, comfy, relaxing and very tasteful would definitely stat again.  Thanks

It’s the second time I’ve stayed in this apartment and will definitely stay again on my next visit to Lisbon.

I don't want to discourage people from booking this flat, it is in a great location and quite pretty.  But the price is high for the size and more attention needs to be paid to the bug problem.  The host was attentive and replied to all my requests, so I believe he will be attentive to these comments too.
Great apartment right downtown. 4th floor with very steep and narrow staircase. Hosts very friendly, gave us useful restaurant recommendations and wine+chocolate welcome.
Great accommodation, great location and great hosts.. will definitely be back

Hello Pedro, we enjoyed our stay at your place very much. Your Service was excellent. The location is really in the middle of Lisboas innercity. Everything was as promised. The only thing was, that the roofterrace was very loud during daytime because of the ventilationnoise of the neighbour building. Best regard Thomas and Brigitte
Great little apartment. Centrally located. Very clean and stylish. Good communication and efficient check in. We loved it (and Lisbon).

Between the 3 of us we had plenty of space to lay out our suitcases and also enjoy the living space. The patio is a nice feature as well- great for relaxing outside after a long day or in the morning before we went out.

So great!
Expect many gastronomical delights nearby.  Either up the hill or down the hill, there are many local highlights and very close to the Metro.

We had a fabulous stay at Pedro’s gorgeous apartment. Very thoughtful touches and all the amenities we could ask for. Also kind enough to take our large suitcases up the stairs. Highly recommended for anyone planning a short trip to Lisbon!
Great location. Perfect communication.
Highly recommended
A great place to stay in the perfect location!

Really good experience at this home, everything was very professional with nice touches. The home is exactly as pictured, small but very clean and it has everything you need for a good stay. There are a lot of stairs so be prepared to climb, location is well worth the climb.
Kann man nur empfehlen.
위치도 좋고 모든 것이 다 좋았어요. 다만 4층이라 짐을 들고 계단을 올라가는 것이 조금은 힘들 수 있어요,

The loft was fantastic-

The flat was gorgeous- lovely terrrace and very stylish. Pedro was a brilliant host and so helpful before and during the stay. Would highly recommend

It is in a convenient and central location. Even though it is a busy street, it was quiet and peaceful inside the apartment. The outside terrace was an added bonus. The bed was not comfortable. Being situated under a cramped sloped ceiling made it stuffy and warm at night, even with the air conditioning running. The couch also needs to be replaced as it is in rough shape.

Nous avons été ravis de notre séjour et avons pu profiter de la terrasse le soir !
L'accueil est chaleureux et convivial.
Highly recommended!!!

A great stay. I buy upscale and luxury hotels as part of my day job, and I’ve stayed in countless airbnbs around the world for vacation. This was the most outstanding stay of them all. Although there are a few design flaws (eg. You can tell this place was designed by men because there isn’t a single mirror on the main floor where the bedroom, living room, and balcony are so you have to run downstairs every time you need a mirror, and the bathroom doesn’t have any hooks for you to hang your clothes - the towel rack’s taken up by the towels), it’s mostly functional and comfortable. Even though you get the whole apartment to yourself, one of the hosts was waiting for us ahead of our arrival at the apartment so that he could show us how everything worked and answer any questions.
I did appreciate the small details - the flat comes with an electric juicer and they also leave you with a whole tray of oranges so you can make fresh orange juice in the morning. Other things really make this a really comfortable stay, including: bathrobes, chocolate (like you’d get as part of turn down service in hotels), detachable blackout curtains, spices for cooking, dishwasher, washing machine, a toothbrush holder, a rainforest shower head, and even a directory of recommended restaurants close by and in other parts of the city! We tried some of them and can say the hosts have excellent tastes! Little details - like the welcome surprise in the kitchen (won’t spoil this for you) and the fact that the toilet paper is embossed with the Ghostbuster ghost - kept us amused and entertained.
Location is superb - you’re a minute from the bustling Camões Square in Chiado but you get none of the noise. You’re also a minute away from the fabulous Pharmacia, a themed restaurant and bar with a nice lawn - it’s great for afternoon tea/cocktails or just some great views of the Tagus River.
The hosts were also very responsive before and during our stay so we felt very well looked after. Also really liked the fact that amenities like shower gel and body lotion all come in larger bottles instead of small, single bottles (so more environmentally-friendly). Like I said, there’s room for improvement (eg. Mirrors and hooks would make this far more functional), it’s been a very very good stay indeed.
All in all, I would definitely recommend this spot.

Seul petite remarque pratique : il manque quelques accessoires pratiques notamment dans l'entrée pour accrocher des manteaux par exemple ou bien dans la salle de bain pour disposer des produits de toilette. Nous y sommes restés 2 nuits donc ce n'était pas vraiment un problème mais pour un plus long séjour, je pense qu'il faut améliorer ce détail.

This is perfect apartment for young people not for older people. There are 57 stairs to get to the first part of the apartment which has the kitchen galley and bathroom. There's another 14 stairs to get to the main floor which has the kitchen table and beds. The mattresses are on the floor and the roof is slanted. We hit our heads numerous times climbing in and out of bed. Great location though. Easy access to the metro and tram 28.

The flat is fantastic and EXACTLY as described, gorgeous with a nice terrace, very functional and really well located. We were given loads of restaurant and bar tips by the hosts and they were very responsive. Really recommend this place.

Very nice loft apartment right in the center of a lively bar neighborhood. Diogo checked us in and was very nice and gave us great recommendations. The apartment was beautiful and the patio was great to hang out on. Would 100% recommend.

The apartment is a really lovely and stylish space. It’s a pleasure to have the patio and the location is amazing.
The team were responsive and helpful.
We can’t wait to return!

This place was perfect! Walking distance to everything, lots of good restaurants, and beautiful space. The host was so helpful and kind, and the portable WiFi was a game changer for sure. Thank you all for a great stay- can’t wait to come back!
Perfect location in walking distance to many great Lisbon spots. The host provided a list of recommendations for things to do and places to eat which made everything so easy. Thanks for a great stay!
Super accueil, super propre, super séjour je recommande vraiment

Pedro's places are very comfortable and stylish. They met me at both my locations and carried up my luggage. Really great service. They definitely have the hospitality service down. Both apartments were lovely and in very convenient locations. Highly recommend.
Great flat. Great location. Great stay. Thanks a lot!
A great place in a great location !
Very nice pace in a great location by Barrio Alto in Lisboa. Great hospitality, nice little terrace. I walked everyday to The Mill for the most amazing coffee.
Recommended! Nice place with stylish touch and very easy to commune to any tourist attraction places
Lovely loft in a convenient spot
I would highly recommend this place for a long weekend as it was very central. Host was very accommodating and friendly too.
Close to the best Pastel de Nata maker in all of Lisbon!! Amazing. Comfortable space with an enjoyable outdoor patio. Lots of steps but worth it.
Magnífico apartamento con estilazo, situado genial y los dueños muy amables....lo recomiendo sin ninguna duda!!!
Es un sitio perfecto para alojarte por unos días en Lisboa
Truly amazing property, location is phenomenal. Very professional managed. Truly recommend for a short or long term stay in Lisbon!
Amazing!! Lots of stairs to walk up so be conscious when packing ;).
We can recommend this place, everything went well and apartment was wonderful! :)

로프트가 너무 아기자기하고 예뻐요. 친절한 호스트가 맞이해주시고 필요한 모든 것 외에도 우리를 위한 작은 와인도 준비해줬어요. 물은 따로 없었지만 집 바로 근처에 슈퍼마켓이 있어서 필요한 것은 그때그때 살 수 있었어요. 주요 관광지에 도보로 다닐 수 있을 정도로 위치도 좋고요. 그런데 밤이 되면 여자 혼자 돌아다니기엔 약간 무서웠어요.
굉장한 언덕위에 있다는 것 말고는 흠잡을 곳 없는 완벽한 숙소 입니다. 캐리어나 무거운 짐을 끌고 가실 때는 꼭 교통수단을 이용하시기 바랍니다:)
Outstanding hospitality. The apartment is just perfect. thank u !
Great comfortable place in walking distance to everything. We enjoyed our stay and would recommend the place to anyone.

As lovely as it looks in the photos! Pedro is an excellent host and thoughtful about small details. We enjoyed going out for coffee at the bakery next door. We also spent a pleasant evening at Flower Power, a cheerful restaurant just across the street.
Zeer schoon en goede ontvangst.
Pedro and staff were amazing and responsive.  Great location and space.  Note that the apartment is a few floors up.  Thanks and cheers!

This loft is lovely with a location that can't be beat.  Its within walking distance to all major attractions and many restaurants, bars, and grocery store are steps away.   The loft was super clean, and unbelievably quiet.  Its in the heart of a bustling area but when you close the windows its very quiet.  The bed is comfortable and the patio outside is lovely.  We especially appreciated the portable wifi they provided.  Pedro's team gave amazing service always there to help and answer any questions.  I would highly recommend this loft.

If you are planning a trip to Lisbon - stay here! The apartment was very clean, beautifully furnished and very comfortable. The location is perfect and the roof terrace is a great added bonus. Lovely views towards the sea. Communication was excellent and the handover at the start of our stay was very professional, friendly and informative. Thank you for a great stay. I will certainly be recommending your apartment to friends. Thanks again!

El Departamento es increible, mejor que en las fotos. Esta muy bien ubicado y te dejan muchos detalles que hacen que tu estadia ahi sea increible. Mucha malcrianza.
Nos encanto el Departamento y volveriamos si vamos a Lisboa.
The location of the flat was amazing it was right in the centre of town but so quiet at night. That flat was beautiful and so clean! Thanks for having us!

We really enjoyed our stay at Pedro’s apartment. The location was perfect and the apartment was comfortable and beautifully designed. The apartment was spotless and came with air conditioning, a coffee machine, a washer and dryer, and cable TV. The hosts were also very responsive and met us for a late check in after our flight was delayed. We even got some great tips for local food.
This place is amazing can’t say a bad thing, beautiful !! Thank you!
This is a lovely and peaceful Place to take a rest between exploring the City. We really liked our stay at this loft apartment.

What a wonderful & chic little loft! We enjoyed sipping vinho verde on the terrace and slept deeply during some hot summer nights in Portugal due to the comfort of A/C. Incredibly clean apartment & close to so many things!

The suite itself was clean, bright, and it had to most comfortable bed I slept on the whole two weeks we were travelling Portugal.
The water temperature fluctuated a little while showering, but the rain head was a nice touch.
I dealt with Gonçarlo and he was prompt, polite, and very accommodating.
The location is very central, and although it was loud outside, I could not hear the hustle and bustle of the street from in the apartment.
The doorway to enter the building is quite narrow to pass through with a backpack, and the stairs are steep to the top, but if you're young and fit you'll do just fine.
Highly recommended, I would stay there again!  :)

Pedro’s place is right in the centre of activity in Lisbon and offers a stylish, clean and spacious retreat. The host’s are incredibly attentive and go the extra mile to make sure your stay is as enjoyable as possible. I would highly reccommend this air bnb!

Amazing space! This was the perfect fun, walkable, trendy location for my (then) boyfriend and I... and we got engaged inside this loft so we will definitely be back!! Cute outdoor patio for enjoying a bottle of wine at night. Stairs to get here are steep and ceilings low inside the loft, so make sure you are agile. Location was perfect to go everywhere we wanted, and a couple fabulous breakfast spots super close by!

We had a great stay here. Central location, perfect size for our group. Great AC and shower. The stairs are no joke but add character! Very responsive communication and flexible on check in and check out.
loved this place. great location and gorgeous apartment.
beautiful apartment with a great view and location
Great space and great location
El alojamiento está genial, cuidado hasta el último detalle. Agradecimos mucho todo los consejos sobre sitios a los que ir y visitar.
Super apartment & host!
Great airbnb in the perfect location.  It is just steps from a ton of shops and restaurants.  I would highly recommend this place to anyone visiting.
Supernice apartment!!!
Great location & an amazing apartment.  Everything you need for a perfect city break.

this loft was soooo cute & very centrally located. It was walkable to a lot of things that we wanted to see. We didn't need it but there was a kitchen with every you would need, also laundry which came in handy. Everything was spotless. There was even a portable wifi for your use around town which came in handy for us because we didnt get a chance to buy a sim card. Definitely recommend.
Great Place!

This is a great flat in a perfect location, right next to the 28 tram stop as well as a 10 minute walk to central Lisbon and the train station. A local supermarket is just a 2 minute walk down the road, with lots of lovely bars and restaurants within a stones throw!
The stairs into the apartment are very steep, however we managed fine.
The flat is fully booked equipped with everything you could need including air conditioning a fridge and a portable WiFi. It is very clean and comfortable.
The hosts are great, very friendly and helpful and always responded to our messages and accommodated our late hour check in, as well as allowing us to keep our luggage at the loft until it was time for us to leave!
Would definitely return!

Amazing host! The apartment was immaculate, the recommendations for restaurants were spot on and not necessarily what we would have chosen ourselves and the location was perfect for walking to the time out market, the shopping area and the castle. Will definitely stay again if I go back to Lisbon

The apartment is clean and modern, located right in the heart of an upbeat neighborhood. The space is surprisingly  very quiet given how lively the area is. Our hosts were kind and helpful, and the apartment was great to come back to after a long day of walking about Lisbon.

The communication with the host was absolutely perfect. For every question I asked, a quick response came just after the message was sent. The apartment is clean and beautiful, and it is located in one of the best parts of lisbon. We are sad that we had to leave this place already but we will hopefully be back someday. Thank you!

We stayed at this apartment for three nights. I would stay there again. The location is excellent. Everything you want is within walking distance. The apartment is lovely and was spotless. Great pillows and comfy bed. Loved the patio. We arrived  quite late as our flight was delayed. Antonio was so accommodating. Communication was very easy. Highly reccomend!! Great apartment and hosts!!

This apartment was very chic and stylish. It has amazing views and is centrally located in a great part of time. We were able to walk everywhere we needed to go. The patio lovely, but we were out and about so much that we weren’t able to fully take advantage of it. Pedro and his team were great at communicating and check in was a breeze. I would definitely stay in one of his apartments again in the future.

Pedro's apartment is perfectly located in Chiado and a short walk to Alfama. It was very clean, well stocked, and had a wonderful porch. It's perfect for a quick trip and has beautiful views from the windows. We'll be back!

Great apartment with a sun trapped roof top terrace. The location is spot on with an excellent selection of restaurants and bars all within easy access. Even the tram 28 stop is a few steps away from the apartment. Clean, stylish and all round a winner. Fab comms from the owners so 5 stars from us, my friend and I would recommend this apartment.
Kjempefin leilighet, rent og perfekt beliggenhet. Verten var kjempe hyggelig, behjelpelig og svarte raskt om det var noe vi lurte på. Neste tur til Lisboa skal vi garantert bo på samme sted.

Vi gillade lägenheten! Det var rent och snyggt. Takterassen är inte så stor, men det var trevligt att sitta där och sola. Den ligger perfekt placerad i Lissabon, med närhet till allt man kan tänka sig. Har man frågor till värden så får man snabba och bra svar. Gratis Wi-Fi både i lägenheten och att ta med sig är ytterligare fördelar!

Fantastic hosts and a comfortable, central location. Everything was as detailed on the Airbnb site and the little extras were much appreciated. I have stayed twice in Pedro’s apartments now and will use again when I am next in Lisbon.

Appartement extrêmement bien situé en plein coeur de Lisbonne avec commerces à proximité.
Logement très propre et lumineux.

This was perfect for our needs. Three women, two nights in Lisbon. Communication was excellent -we typically got immediate responses from the team. Location is close to restaurants, bars, markets. Obviously you have to tackle hills in Lisbon, but the apartment is right near the top of one of the trams from the waterfront if you need it. The mobile WiFi hotspot was a great plus. Be aware, it is truly a loft. You have to climb about 50 fairly narrow steps to the door, then another 12 or so to the living area. Comfortable twin and queen mattresses on the floor where the roof is angled. So if stairs are difficult or you have trouble getting up and down from the floor where the ceiling is low, this is not for you. View of the water from the flat is also nice and we used the washer and drying rack while we were there which helped with our packing for several stops in Spain/Portugal.
Nem indtjekning, super ren og pæn lejlighed (dog lidt mindre end vi troede), super beliggenhed.

Amazing views what you see in the pictures is exactly what it’s like.  Antonio and the whole team were amazing at answering our questions and being super helpful.  They have this suggestion book about places to go to and the park bar is by far the best bar with a view.  Thank you so much for letting us stay in your home

The apartment was really, really fantastic. It’s in a central location and within walking distance to some of the great places we visited.
The apartment is compact and the hosts have utilised all the space available in a super stylish way. There were some really great touches; a portable wifi to take round Lisbon, smart TV so we could watch Netflix one evening, etc. The AC works great and you’re able to keep the apartment cool in the hot weather.
Overall, we can’t wait to come back to Lisbon and will 100% be booking the same apartment.
Perfect!
很棒的bnb，室內設計和舒適度很棒，整體而言是很棒的住宿體驗，在整天行程後能好好的休息，就算雨天待在屋子裡也很享受！

Beautiful appartement, design and cosy in the center of Lisbonne.
Wonderful place to stay.
I recommend warmly and the hosts are really kind and helpful

Wir haben uns von Anfang an wie zuhause gefühlt! Wir wurden sehr freundlich empfangen, es war sehr sauber und wir haben einen frisch gebackenen Osterzopf und eine Flasche Rotwein geschenkt bekommen. Die Lage ist ein absoluter Traum und die Wohnung ist wirklich fantastisch! Es war wirklich perfekt. Vielen Dank.
A great apartment in a great location - light, bright and airy! Highly recommended.

The apartment is very cool, with a full kitchen and bathroom downstairs and a living area upstairs with a lovely patio. It's very centrally located to everything in Lisbon and easy to get around from. Would highly recommend staying here!

Everything excellent! Only thing; at the photos on airbnb the appartment looks really bigger than it is reality. Its a rooftop, so at the edges of the room large people cannot stand. But at the end not a very big issue... Cheers!
Wonderful stay! Perfect location and the portable WiFi was an amazing unexpected touch!

This apartment is amazing! Everything you can imagine is within walking distance. Pedro was a wonderful host from meeting us for check-in to providing us with great restaurant recommendations. We had such a comfortable stay and would love to visit again.

This apartment loft is perfect for a few days in Lisbon as it is close to many attractions, restaurants and metro. The staff was very accommodating with early check in and I could not have been happier with this stay.

Nous avons beaucoup apprécié l'accueil de Pedro et l'appartement qui est très agréable dans un super quartier en plein cœur de l'animation. Pedro nous a accueilli avec des présents de bienvenue, l'appartement est très lumineux, calme et confortable. Une adresse que nous recommandons.

This is an amazing place in a fantastic location with very thoughtful hosts providing local tips. The place is even more beautiful in person.
Can't recommend it enough.
The location is amazing, it is very convenient to go everywhere. The cafeteria and restaurant near by the apartment is great. The room not big but cozy .

Un grand merci à Pedro pour sa gentillesse et son hospitalité. Toujours disponible pour répondre à nos questions et à nos attentes.
Le logement est parfait : très propre, idéalement situé et très bien équipé. A noter les petits plus : une petite bouteille de vin et des dosettes de café offerts ainsi qu'un petit livret avec toutes les bonnes adresse de Lisbonne. Nous avons passé un excellent séjour. Je recommande très vivement Pedro.

Ons verblijf was precies wat we zochten, de locatie is echt geweldig. Het zit midden in Barrio Alto en op steenworp afstand van bijvoorbeeld Park (bekende rooftop bar). Het appartement was schoon, mooi ingericht en had eigenlijk alles wat we nodig hadden voor een lang weekend. Er stond zelfs een flesje wijn en chocolade voor ons klaar! De bedden lagen goed, we moesten even wennen aan het zeer schuine dak waar we onder lagen maar zijn uiteindelijk andersom gaan liggen, met onze voeten naar het schuine dak toe, wat uiteindelijk beter lag. Perfect voor 3 personen dus!
This lofted space is beautiful and perfect for exploring Lisbon. My girlfriend and I felt right at home and enjoyed walking to and from many great restaurants and sights. Highly recommend!
Perfect. A wonderfull place. We enjoyed our time very much. We come back soon.
Great location, helpful host, clean flat, would love to come back and stay again!

Comfortable, friendly host.
Pictures brighter than reality. Sealing a little bit too low for me.

Die Unterkunft ist mitten im Herzen von Lissabon. Die Tram 28 hält direkt vor der Haustür. Alles ist fußläufig gut zu erreichen. Die Wohnung ist sehr schön und gut ausgestattet. Sie liegt allerdings im vierten Stock und nur erreichbar über ein schmales Treppenhaus und viele Treppen. Somit nichts für Fußkranke. Die Kommunikation mit Pedro war perfekt und die Übergabe der Wohnung völlig problemlos. Ein schöner Ort um sich mitten ins Leben von Lissabon zu stürzen.
Such great hosts - organised, made no fuss about us needing to reduce our stay by 1 night, left thoughtful, generous new year gifts for us in the apartment. We were so happy/impressed!

The place was in a perfect location, shops and restaurants are all around. The place was very nicely decorated and cozy. Our host was very friendly and helped with the luggage. He provided many amenities and place is very clean. But if you go here, pack light since there is no elevator. Otherwise, the place is great and we would love to come back.
In the middle of everything. The hosts are super responsive and friendly. Lots to eat and see nearby. The metro is close as well as Carris right outside. Would go back.
Parfait petit pied a terre pour découvrir Lisbonne! <3

Our stay in this apartment was great! The location was PERFECT, close to all the nice restaurants and in a really nice neighbourhood. The apartment itself was really nice and cosy, clean and had all facilities you need. The host left us a long list of places to go for food, drinks etc close-by and further away, which was very useful. Next time I'm in Lissabon I would really consider coming back to stay here!
Excelente atencion y amabilidad. Un apartamento muy bien arreglado.
Would stay in this home again. Great communication and they have thought about every detail. Sweet note, washer, recommendations, wifi. Definitely book this place!
Excellent hosts wirh a great central location to tour Lisbon. Highly recommend!

Absolutely Incredible stay! Perfect location, stylish loft and amazingly quick responses! Check in was a breeze and when our shower wasn't working at 2 in the morning, they were there 7 minutes later to fix it! Unparalleled experience - we enjoyed every little detail from the note and chocolate to the wine. Thank you!

We had a wonderful stay in the most beautiful apartment. We really needed and loved the airconditioning. Works perfectly! Everything in the apartment is very neat and new. It has everything for either a short or longer stay. This neighborhood is in my opinion the best place to stay since you have all the nice restaurants and sightseeings over here - and it is a plus that it is up in the hill so you wont have painful leggies :)

Pedro and his friends are friendly, reliable and communicative hosts. They provided us with all necessary information before our arrival. Upon our arrival they welcomed us with a bottle of wine and explained us all that we needed to know. The apartment is exactly as nice, clean and spacious as in the pictures. It is fully equipped for a really comfortable stay. Its location is great - right in the old town with the stop of the legendary tram no. 28 just next to the door of the building. On the other hand, despite of its location in a busy quarter, the apartment is very quiet. Just consider your physical condition since the apartment is on the 4th floor without lift and the staircase is quite steep (but beautiful - old wooden staircase). We really enjoyed the week at Pedro´s apartment and we can recommend it to everyone looking for the comfortable stay in the heart of the old Lisbon.

Great apartment with wonderful terasse! The kitchen is small but has the supplies to make a nice breakfast.
We stayed a week, and during the week house keeping stopped by with cleanig, new sheets and towels, and refill on coffee, jam etc. Wow! Handy little wifi-thing that you could bring around town is also available in the apartment, as well as great Bose speakers.
Fantastic spot, great location, super fast communication. Would recommend 10/10

We love the apartment very much, it’s exactly the same as it shows in the Airbnb pictures. The team are very nice and answered all our questions patiently.
