All the little things they  prepared for us made us feel warm welcomed. Good location as well, walking distance to the sea and public transportation.Highly recommended.

An very good place to stay in Lisboa. We might return. There are two negative aspects:
1. 71 steps up "treacherous" stairs from the street. You need to be part mountain goat.
2. Two levels for the apartment. Having the bathroom downstairs is annoying at night.
+ Location - near the intersection of the 28 Electrico and the Ascensor da Bica in the Bairro Alta, this is a GREAT location.
+ Patio! - Wonderful, quiet place to relax. River view.
+ Groceries - the Minipreço is about 30 meters away.
+ Photos - the host's photos are accurate and convey the feeling of the apartment.
+ Washer - did the job for us. Detergent was included.
+ Electric juicer - we enjoyed fresher squeezed OJ
+ Air conditioning - worked quietly and efficiently.
+ Shower - average size, lots of hot water.
- No lighting over the dining table. Do not plan on eating dinner here.
- The kitchen is not designed for actually cooking a meal.

Hip loft in the middle of it all. Great style and close to everything in Lisbon. Do know that you are walking up four flights of stairs so pack light. We had huge bags and surf boards so it was tough but a good burn in the legs! If you are looking for peaceful, maybe this isn’t the spot. There are double pane windows to block out noise but people party in this Neighborhood so make sure to shut everything at night. There is a great Israeli restaurant that just opened on the next block with the best falafel and epic cafe downstairs plus a rad look out right around the corner. I’m not a city girl but this was an epic spot for someone looking to explore Lisbon, save money and stay in a super stylish loft . It’s compact tho so I recommend  no more than 2 ppl. The hosts are great and even let us check in early. He showed up rushing with sweat on his face just to make sure we got in ok. Really nice guys, great style, Lisbon is loud and bright but this spot is as good as it gets.
Great stay! The loft was super cute, very clean, and the neighborhood was awesome! Just a note, its a fourth floor walk up, lots of stairs with a narrow hallway but that's most of Europe.

We really enjoyed our stay and the owners were extremely helpful and easily contactable. The accommodation was exactly as it looked on the photos and even though there were four (women) of us  in one room it was homely if a little chaotic.  The only downside was the fourth bed was not made up and was too hard but for 3 people it was perfect. Also the stairs you need to climb to get to the apartment are very steep and there are quite a lot but we loved the place. It was very clean,quiet and the little kitchen was fully equipped.  It is extremely central and is very convenient. Would definitely recommend. Thankyou for being our lovely hosts.

My sister and I stayed here for a few days. The location is perfect. Excellent to get to the castle, sea front, museums, bars and restaurants.
As we were told the stairs into the apartment are very steep, not easy with a case but we made it. We are both in our 60,s. The apartment is modern and lovely towels and linen. Lovely cafe next door for breakfast, coffee and cakes. The balcony is a great bonus. We were told about the cafe air conditioning unit and this does go off about 8pm so no issue. All in all a great stay.
A fantastic apartment in the middle of Lisbon. Has everything you need and is very clean and modern.

This flat couldn't be in a better location and looks exactly as it does in the pictures. It was very clean and thoughtfully decorated and the patio was a wonderful sun trap and a great place to enjoy breakfast or a late afternoon drink. Our hosts were fantastic and easy to communicate with and went out of their way to accommodate our requests to store luggage before and after check in, which was really helpful. The only negative is the steep staircase - there is no elevator so if you aren't fit (or are 5 month pregnant!) it can be quite difficult. We would definitely return.

Well located and the host was good at communicating up to a point. Unfortunately, we discovered cockroaches in the kitchen and they were not able to offer a solution... which resulted in an uncomfortable stay as the bed is a mattress on the floor.

L appartement était parfait, propre et conforme aux photos! 4 étages très raides mais ça entraîne pour la visite de lisbonne! Tout le nécessaire disponible sur place. Merci bcp à notre hôte de nous avoir dépanné si vite et avec le sourire qd nous nous sommes enfermés dehors! ;)
Awesome flat! Very modern and comfortable. It's located directly in the center. We'll come back again for sure.

This place was great! You cannot get in a better location in town and the Baixa Chiado metro stop is a 2 minute walk away. The apartment is excellent: split across two levels which makes it feel really big and cool. The patio area was a real sun trap in the mornings and the bed and sofa were really comfortable too. The stairs are pretty steep and narrow up to the loft but we didn't mind -  the whole city seemed to be on a steep incline anyway! The area was great and got really lively at night with loads of bars and restaurants serving til late.  The recommendations given for restaurants lived up to their expectations and we really enjoyed our stay.

Pedro's loft is truly perfection! Located right in the heart of Bairro Alto, the loft is very clean and comfortable. Communicating was also very easy and we were thankful to be able to drop off our luggage before check-in.
Definitely recommend staying here!

This is a great apartment - very well decorated and thoughtfully designed. My
husband and I also enjoyed the apartment's proximity to the very lively Bairro Alto neighborhood!

A spotlessly clean place in the heart of the city, this is definitely worth the money.
PROS: About a 20-minute walk away from just about everything, including every restaurant we wanted to attend in Lisbon.
It's also kitted out with an nice powerful air conditioner (a must, as we were in town during the sweltering heat of July), a washing machine to clean clothes (immensely practical and a money-saver), and a great shower for washing off the sweat of a long day climbing Lisbon's steep hills.
Most importantly, the windows and glass patio door are double glazed and seal tight when closed, which render the apartment almost totally silent. This is of immense important in this section of town, which is definitely a nighttime party area: People roam up and down the streets in a loud, rollicking mood, especially on weekends, and if you're a light sleeper the noise could be a real problem. In this loft, it was like none of that existed.
CONS: It's a top-floor walkup, and the stairs are perilously steep. This place is not for you if you have mobility issues.
As others have noted, the ceiling above the beds slants down steeply; I'm 6'1" and banged my head at least twice.
But these are mild negatives -- the experience was great. Plus they provide a mobile wifi device to keep your smartphone connected while roaming the city. Pretty swell stay. Thanks all!

My husband, 8 year old son and I enjoyed a great week in the apartment. It was exactly as described and a perfect base for our holiday. We appreciated being met there even though it was very late as our flight was delayed. The sun terrace was a big hit with us, particularly for star spotting at night! The location within Lisbon was great too, meaning we were within walking distance of many places. We really liked the Chiado area. There are lots of good restaurants and cafes nearby as well as a couple of small supermarkets. Thanks for a great stay. We would love to come back.
The loft was beautiful and in a great location. The hosts had thought of everything and check in went great. Would definitely stay here again!
Awesome pad in a brilliant part of town. No matter what you're doing in Lisbon this property is great - styling, chilled, roof patio sun trap, close to everything. Highly recommended

Location. location, location!
Superb apartment located in the hub of downtown Lisbon! Couldn't have asked for a better location.
Apartment itself has a brilliant terrace which is great for sitting out and catching sun.
Great shower. No issues with WiFi. Comfortable bed.
Great hosts with excellent communication. Waiting when we arrived.
Only negative (and it is a VERY small negative) is the entrance is a little bit of a tight squeeze and the stairs are quite steep. But it wouldn't stop us staying here again, which says it all really.
Highly recommended. Thanks again.
Great apartment in the perfect location. Very easy communication and thought the place was perfect!

This apartment was absolutely perfect. The location couldn't be better and the loft itself was in great condition. It had been cleaned right before we checked in, which was appreciated. Pedro and Antonia left us with portable wifi to take with us around the city, as well as wifi in the loft, chocolates and a bottle of wine. The personally written thank you note was so kind as well.  I would definitely recommend this loft to anyone going to Lisbon - can't be beat!

This beautifully decorated loft apartment was a real find. The location was perfect- right in the middle of all the action at Bica but still secluded enough not to hear anything.
The terrace was great, the air con unit from the building next door did not bother us and went off at 8pm.
It was 37 degrees though when we were there so we did not spend much time time outdoors! The air con inside the apartment worked a treat!
The bed was comfortable. The shower great but the bathroom needs some DIY jobs done.
They provide black out blinds too which was great for lie-ins.
Thanks for a lovely stay and I have no hesitation in recommending this place.

We had a wonderful time in Pedros apartment. The communication was excellent and we had everything we needed in the warm and cozy apartment. Being in the middle of Lissabon, we could use the Metro or just enter the night life right before our door. The patio is wonderful for a break, especially in the evening. best regards Ina and Eric

We cannot wait to return! This is an amazing place to stay with all the comforts of home right in an exciting neighborhood with so much to do and see. Pedro (Antonió & Gonçalo) were so responsive and so helpful at every step. After traveling leading up to our stay here, it was really fantastic to be able to speak with Gonçalo about getting to the apartment as we traveled from the airport - he even helped us get our bags into the apartment! I especially loved the added bonus of portable wifi to help us as we navigated the city, they've really thought of everything!

We have just returned from a 4 day break in Lisbon where we spent 3 nights in this wonderfully cozy apartment. It's centrally located and although in a busy area, its 4th floor position means it's fairly quiet. Gonzalo was there to greet us and gave us some useful info on the area etc. Flat was spotless, modern and stylish. People have complained about air con noise on rooftop area but it was fine- to be expected in a hot climate. Hardly noticed it. Flat is perfect for 2/3 people and very comfortable with all mod cons provided. Our only negative was the narrow stairs and ultra narrow front door! :) thanks for a great break!

The location is great for visiting, shopping, eating, and the flat lovely (exactly as per description and pictures). Although it is one big room, the way it is conceived allows 3 adults to be very confortable. Antonio is the perfect host (late check in, communication, taxi booking), in addition he gave us a wifi on the go device which made our Lisbon discovery much better and easier! The only minor point to consider is the air con noise when you stand on the terrace. Overall a great, highly recommended place to visit the lovely Lisbon!

The place was as described on Airbnb and the marble bathroom is in great condition. We found the location of the apartment to be very convenient to get get to local attractions; walking distance to the river and Timeout market. The host replied promptly to our enquiries and was extremely helpful in giving recommendations. We would definitely stay at Chiado apartment again!

Loft en un maravilloso lugar, cerca de todo y lleno de detalles del equipo!
Lo recomiendo especialmente para gente joven!

This place is just great! Small but perfectly formed. Myself and three friends stayed there for three nights. Is was so clean, stylish and comfortable. You are sleeping where you hangout, but you don't hang stay in the room for long as there is too much to do near by. We had great hosts who were extremely helpful.
Super séjour !! Appartement très propre et dans un quartier super cool.

The apartment is very comfortable, well furnished and the patio is so great.
Very nice stay for us and the team which welcomed us was very attentive to our comfort and always willing to help us
Beautiful flat and perfect location. Book this flat if you want a nice stay in Lisboa.
A lovely apartment! Very central location, walkable distance to pretty much everywhere! Loved the roof terrace, a beautiful sun trap! The team were great upon arrival. Would definitely return!

Great Airbnb, fantastic location, very stylish and modern, amazing roof balcony. Pedro and team were amazing with communication and even gave us wine and chocolates on arrival. We had a great weekend in Lisbon and would recommend this apartment to everyone.
Great spot!  The portable wifi was a huge help!!
GREAT CENTRAL PLACE! STRONGLY RECOMMEND!

This place is awesome. Great location and the hosts are excellent as well. Very friendly, great communication and so thoughtful. They left us treats for Easter to celebrate in a traditional Portuguese way. I enjoyed my stay in Lisbon and was extremely comfortable with the arrangements. Felt like home. Even did some laundry :) don't hesitate to book. This apartment is close to many sites in Portugal.

Chic loft w/ocean glimpses & roof patio. Tastefully done, airy and friendly. Excellent for couple.
Lovely typical surroundings, all shops and restaurants handy.
Sparkling clean and modern.
Excellent value. Great memories.
Prime location. High quality renovation. Awesome terrace. Can't go wrong.

Super stay in the heart of Chiado!  Gorgeous and comfortable flat in the center of a vibrant neighborhood. We so appreciated the tips of where to eat/drink as well as the excellent surprise of a mobile wifi hotspot to take along with us on adventures.  We had a quick stay in Lisbon and appreciated a centrally located flat from which it was easy to explore by foot.  Excellent double pane windows really cut down on the sounds of the city to allow for some good rest at night.  We highly recommend this flat for a city break to Lisbon!

2 of us stayed at this flat towards the end of March and had a really great stay.
We were a little confused by the numbers (jumped from 10 to 24!) so called Gonçalo who was very polite and gave clear instructions on how to find the apartment.
Antonio was there to greet us and talked us through everything to do with the flat and some pointers for the local area.
The apartment was spotlessly clean and had everything you would need plus a couple of extras (coffee machine!), which was a really nice touch.
The patio was a nice place to sit in the afternoon after a long morning's walk. Too bad the weather was a tad patchy, otherwise we would've used it a little more. Yes, there is some noise from the air con unit, however this was not an issue for us during our periods on the patio. You could not hear it at night.
On our street we had some amazing shops and everything was walkable from our location. Time Out market is around a 10min walk; An amazing nata place, Manteigaria, on the street; And the main station, Rossio, is a 10min walk away taking you to Sintra.
It was a really great apartment and we can't wait to go back and visit Lisbon again!

Great little loft in a very busy and happening area. Lots of great food near by and close to the metro. Can be a little nerve racking coming through the rowdy crowd late at night but fun too if that is what you are in to. Host were very nice. Place was very clean. We would stay again.

We are a couple of 62 and 47 years and we really enjoyed this appartment.
We were very near to everything and have visited to whole old Lisbon by foot.
The flat is absolutely gorgeous and very clean.
Pedro and friends are helpful and reply immediately when you contact them. They always have a solution to any of your problems or questions.
Bakery right next to the flat with excellent breakfast formulas. Metro & Tram very near.
Restaurants all around.
Very quiet.
We will go back to this flat on our next trip to Lisbon !

Lindo apartamento!
Espaçoso e muito bem equipado. Equipe pronta pra te ajudar.
Great location. Clean appartment. Communication with Pedro and his friends is real fast and accurate.

Host was waiting in the flat to meet us, good location next to top of Bica funicular, with tram 28 outside the door.  Apartment was creatively designed to make the most of the space and light and airy.  Well equipped place including a dishwasher and washing machine and especially loved the mobile wifi unit to take out with us.  A point to note if you are short and round like me, or pregnant; the front door to the building is vertically split giving a very narrow opening with a very high step up - quite a struggle.

My husband and I had a wonderful stay! The flat is comfortable, modern, airy and very clean. The outside balcony was perfect to have a coffee in the morning. The apartment felt very private but the minute you walk out, you're surrounded by cafes, each better than the last.  Very easy to get to other neighborhoods and to hop onto Tram 28. Thank you for a lovely stay!

Loved this place so much I am reluctant to share !!
Beautiful modern apt, spotless, incredible views , a warm welcome , 5 star luxurious towels.
Smack in the centre of Lisbon..couldn't have asked for more...
The nespresso caps and bottle of wine and oranges were just such a warm welcoming generous touch!
Obrigada

The loft is really pleasant, very clean and has got everything one needs for a comfortable stay. Great location! The host replies to any queries immediately and makes us feel at home, waiting for the guests with special treaties.

We had a fantastic time staying here (2 of us for a long weekend in Lisbon). The apartment was clean and well-equipped, and we were able to check-in a bit early which was great, as we could leave our suitcases and go exploring on the first day.
The apartment is in a great location just minutes walk from Baixa-Chiado metro stop, with loads of little shops and restaurants nearby.
great location and nice host. We love the restruants list provided by host so much.

Location was absolutely amazing! Great neighbourhood, close to everything, tram 28 right outside. Super clean and very accommodating. We arrived earlier than check in and they allowed us to drop our bags and check in almost an hour early. We were three and it was a little small, but we were only there 2 nights so it was perfect to see the city in a short time. Climbing four flights of narrow staircases with our suitcase was a bit tiring, but we are getting old ;) would definitely recommend to anyone staying in Lisbon!!!!

The loft is great and very centrally located! Everyone was extremely helpful and stayed in communication with us as needed. There is also useful information about where to go to eat and for nightlife. I would absolutely stay here again!
Great place. Feels good right away. Thanks for the mobile wifi. Over delivered. We definitely highly recommend it

We had a fantastic stay at Pedro's place. I was visiting with my brother for three nights on vacation.
Highlights:
Communication prior to the visit was great. They were super responsive and accommodating to our flight's arrival being earlier than the listed check in time.
Perfect location - very central to most areas of interest.
Little treats - left a basket of oranges, Nespresso packets and wine for us.
They had a portable wifi device which meant not going over our data overage!!
Lowlights:
Everything is as pictured with the exception of the degree to which the ceilings above the bed are slanted...we bumped our heads a few times in the middle of the night and getting in and out of bed.

Really lovely place to stay, ideally located to visit the city, and right next to a lovely bakery.
I highly recommend this place.
just perfect

La estancia estaba muy limpia y acogedora. Muy céntrico tal y como indicaba el anuncio y con detalles en el interior para hacerlo más agradable.
El acceso con equipaje es algo complicado pero merece la pena porque puedes conocer el centro de Lisboa a pie.
Inconveniente el aparcamiento privado, con coste adicional al viaje.

Great apartment, excellent location for what we wanted. The host was so lovely, brought us a bottle of champagne and traditional desert the day before Christmas which was so thiughtful. Couldn't suggest this apartment anymore!! Everything is amazing.

Excelente, la mejor zona para hospedarse en Lisboa. Los propietarios son muy amables y están siempre disponibles y atentos. Nos recibieron con detalles que te hacen sentir mejor que en casa. Lo único a tener en cuenta es que hay que subir 4 pisos por escalera por lo que no es accesible para personas con movilidad reducida. Estas escaleras de todos modos son totalmente tolerables. El apartamento vale mucho la pena!

This apartment is great. Looks like the photos. A lot of care was taken to make the apartment as convenient as possible for your stay. Location was perfect. Convenient to pretty much everything you'd want to see. Highly recommended.

La estancia en el apartamento ha sido una maravilla. Desde que llegamos nos recibió Gonzalo para explicarnos todas las cosas del apartamento. Esta completisimo, no le falta de nada. Las fotos que salen son totalmente reales. Te dejan muchos detalles para que tu estancia sea lo mas cómoda posible. Si volviese a Lisboa seguro que escogería de nuevo este mismo apartamento. Ha sido un placer.

We instantly felt like home. The plants, the brightness, the wood.... it all looks so beautiful. It is a bit pricey but i felt like it was definately worth it. It was quite rainy during our stay so we were suuuper happy to have such a nice place to stay in.... and the heating came in very handy aswell.... we were quite soaked up on our arrival.

We have stayed at Pedro's place for the week-end out in Lisbon. Pedro was absolutely superb in helping me to book restaurants around the place (which was a good thing to do as many good places are overbooked for the week-end). The place has great cozy atmosphere and great views over the city. All the great restaurants, cafes and bars are in the walking distance. Check out the Rooftop bar at the Parking garage nearby at sunset - you will enjoy beautiful views over Ponte 25 de Abril and Christo Rei. There is a fully equipped kitchen in the flat so you can try to cook (if you fancy to). Word of advice - the grocery stores nearby close at 10pm, be sure to buy wine to enjoy at Pedro's balcony before the stores are closed.

Fantastic place.
Very clean.
Very modern.
Great location.
Highly recommend.
Very nice, newly renovated location in the centre of Lisbon (Chiado/ Bairro Alto). Pedro & team are very professional, friendly, and communicated always promptly.

A very nice apartment, located in the centre of Lisbon. Antonio and his team are best host you can imagine. It's worth to spend some nights at this apartment. Had a great time and I would really recommend.
Great space! Very comfortable. Arrival and checkout was a breeze. Fabolous location to explore Lisbon and get a feel for the city. Would highly recommend.

We loved this loft place in Lisbon. GREAT location - within walking distance to many sights, restaurants, bars, and fun stuff to do in Lisbon. Place was exactly as pictured, clean and stylish. My girlfriends and I had a great experience and would definitely stay again!
Absolutely loved this gorgeous loft! So central, so well looked after and fantastic hosts who went the extra mile - they even had treats waiting for us on arrival! Will definitely be back :)

Amazing apartment very close to the centre of Lisbon. The flat was very clean and well decorated and we enjoyed the outdoor terrace. Pedro and his team were very helpful and were quick to reply to communication. Highly recommend this apartment for a stay in Lisbon.

Everything was OK. Louiz showed us the Appartment, told us what we needed to know and of course said, if we need anything, we can call him or send a massage (we want a cab back to the airport - they manage it). The place is nice, TOP location (Bario Alto) it was clean and it's perfect for 3 (possible) four persons. Only thing you have to know, there are about 60 stairs, and the Air conditional system outside of the building is a little bit annoying - but they don’t hide it. It works only till 7pm and don't work on Sundays.
Next time I go to Lisoba, I would stay there again.
p.s.- the prepared also a nice welcoming package - :)

My husband and I absolutely loved staying in Pedro's apartment. The location is ideal, with the 28 tram stopping just outside the building and within walking distance of many sites. The apartment is very spacious and comfortable. We were so glad to have air conditioning as it was really hot out while we visited. Antonio and Luis met us upon arrival and were extremely friendly. They showed us around the apartment and showed us how everything worked, which was helpful. They provide a list of recommendations for restaurants and bars, and all of the ones we tried were great. It was a nice touch to have a bottle of wine, oranges, and some chocolates waiting for us. They also have a mobile Wi-Fi hotspot you can take and use outside of the apartment, which was great for us as we didn't have our cell phones switched on for international roaming. The TV did stop working one day before we left, but we weren't there to watch TV so it wasn't a big deal. Don't hesitate to book!

The Chiado Loft was likely the best experience we've ever had with Airbnb. The apartment was perfect. It was very clean, the bed was comfortable, there was lots of space, the location was great and the apartment was easy to find, and Pedro's team was great at communication. They even left us a bottle of wine in the fridge as a welcome gift! We will definitely be back. Just a note though - do not stay here if you have mobility issues. There are lots of very steep stairs to the apartment. Not a problem for us, but could be for some.
Todo estuvo muy bien!!! La casa es preciosa, nos recibieron con muy buena disposición y atención. Está muy bien ubicado, cerca de todo...Recomendadísimo.

So awesome!! In the perfect spot with everything you need.  Cutest little retreat from the busy streets of Lisbon. "Noisy unit" next door did not bother us in the least, and road noise was non existent. Great wifi, and comfy bed! Terrace was so lovely.

We loved our stay in Lisbon. The apartment was very clean with a lot of light and it quickly felt like home. It is great for a more intimate setting with a nice opportunity to go outside and live like a local. The apartment is very close to many great restaurants and local goods and clothing stores. The area is safe with a lot of tourists and friendly people. We are very happy that we had such a pleasant experience.

We really enjoyed our stay in this stylish  loft in the heart of Lisboa. Although it couldnt be located any more Central, it is very quiet, so one can enjoy the evenings on the amazing balcony. We really loved the sound system

Die perfekte Unterkunft in Lissabon. Die Wohnung ist stylisch, sehr sauber und man findet alles was man benötigt und noch mehr.
Alles weitere findet man in direkter Umgebung. Man hat eine sehr gute Anbindung an die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel, ein Parkhaus ist in der selben Straße, welches auch nicht zu übertrieben teuer ist. Antonio ist ein sehr guter Gastgeber und hat auch ein paar gute Tipps für den Aufenthalt parat. Der Preis ist gerechtfertigt und absolut weiterzuempfehlen.

Fab little apartment with lovely views and great location. People have mentioned about the air con outside but we didn't think it was too loud at all! The wine and chocolates were a great addition. Thanks to Luis for showing us round

The apartment is the perfect place to stay when exploring Lisbon. It is located just 2 walking minutes away from the famous bar streets in Bairro Alto and about 5 minutes of walking to famous shops like Zara, Bershka and Pull&Bear. However the neighborhood is a cozy part of the old town even though a bit overrun with tourists. But this will not disturb you in the 4th floor.
The apartment itself is bright, modern equipped and very stylish. The only minus is the annoyingly loud ventilation of the building which you can hear when sitting on the roof top terrace. But this will stop after 8pm which makes this beautiful terrace the perfect spot for a relaxed evening with some wine or else.
I fully recommend the Loft for people who want to explore Lisbon during the days, go for some drinks at nights and still have the option to chill at home!

My friends and I really loved staying at the Chiado Loft! The place is truly beautiful, all features are top notch and it is conveniently located. Having an outdoor space to enjoy before going to bed was an extra bonus. Worth saying that it's a very quiet place, despite being located close to restaurants and bars.

This is a stunning apartment in central Lisbon. It is furnished to a high standard and has used the space available really well. The beds are very comfy, the sun terrace is a delight and it is so close to everything you want to see and do in Lisbon - tram 28 stops on your doorstep! It is great value for money and I am already looking forward to re-booking this apartment and going back again!

Pedro's apartment was lovely and within walking distance of everything we needed. Thoroughly enjoyed our stay- would highly recommend this apartment.

Thanks Pedro!

Excellent location, very nice rooms with furniture in good quality and excellent design. Nice terrace, but only of use after 8:30pm, because a fairly loud AC is working outside from early morning before breakfast until 8/8:30pm. Withouth this, is would be the perfect recommendation. Pedro and his team were excellent hosts. Everything needed was there, and we felt really comfortable and highly welcome. Thanks a lot to the team, very comfortable and positive experience! The location in Bairry Alto / Chiado is best for anyone starting to culture, shopping or night pubcrawl tours. You can here the tram and city noise clearly, however it feels normal and is absolutely not disturbing. The AC is really helpful and was used a lot from us. Good luck to the team, and thanks a lot!

Très bel appartement, calme, lumineux et propre.
Hôtes disponibles et accueillants.
Couldn't have had a better experience. The place was great—clean, well-stocked and a nice environment. Luis and António were both communicative, friendly and helpful. I would stay there again.

We had a great welcome and the chilled bottle of wine was much appreciated.  Plenty of clean bedding and towels for the 4 of us.  The AirCon was great but a very minor criticism was that the wifi was a little slow and the aircon unit outside was a little noisy until 8pm.  4 flights of stairs to the front door but we were aware of this and it does mean that the apartment is well away from any noise in the street below.  Overall a great open plan apartment that suited us well.  Also, the location was perfect for us - very central.
We had a Great stay in Pedros Loft. Everything was as expected; great situated to visit the City and enjoy Night life. I highly recommend this location.

Loved everything about this apartment! We were met on time and greeted with chocolates and a bottle of wine. The apartment was clean and looked exactly as it does in the pictures. The downstairs bathroom and kitchen were small, but more than suitable for 3 of us staying in the apartment. Balcony was a lovely way to chill in the evening! The beds were comfy and although it was hot outside, the air con meant we stayed cool! The location was perfect and the list of recommendations meant we enjoyed some delicious food! Loved Lisbon and would return to this apartment!
Great stay, super efficient hosts and perfect location! We will definitely be coming back

Family trip.
A Nice play to stay.
Very well located to visit the city.
A lot of bar and restaurant nearby.
Clean and very well equiped.
We highly recommend it !

Highly recommended, great location, very cleverly designed apartment. The apartment is very clean and comfortable. We tried a couple of the recommended restaurants in the area and they were great too. We would definitely stay there again!

Great communication with Pedro and his team leading up to our stay at the loft. The space is well lit, comfortable and clean. We loved the location and ease of access to great restaurants and the many recommendation Pedro and his team left for us during the stay. I would highly recommend staying at one of the Chiado Loft Team's apartments for a great time in Lisbon!

Das Appartement liegt sehr zentral. Einrichtung, Ausstattung und Komfort haben uns gut gefallen. Die kleine Terrasse, auf die wir uns besonders freuten, konnte man tagsüber jedoch bedingt durch die grosse Hitze nicht benutzen. Zudem störte ein lauter Lüftungsschacht die Ruhe, die man sich in dieser an sich sehr lauten Stadt wünscht. Der Service war jedoch top und wir empfehlen Pedros Loft gerne weiter.

This first time to Lisbon was just perfect and Pedro's flat has been a good part of this happiness... Ideally located, very confortable, very clean and equiped... Everything was really perfect... Pedro's collegue was really nice and friendly welcome us... I will be back ,it is sure !!! Thanks for all...

We stayed in Pedro's amazing loft apartment in June 2016 and just loved it --  the apartment is immaculately clean and the location could not be better! Since we stayed for ten days, the host had the apartment cleaned (with clean towels and bed linen), which was very nice. Although this apartment has been listed as not being family friendly, we chose to stay here with our six-month-old baby boy, and it was okay thanks to our foldable baby stroller (which was a blessing in the steep and narrow staircase). Also, Pedro warned us about the noisy ventilation system on the patio, but it didn't bother us too much. Overall, this place is much better than a hotel!!!
We just loved this loft. Everything modern, clean, bright, as pictured. Great location, easy check-in. Penthouse living!

Cannot fault our stay.  Highly recommend both flat and service offered.  We didn't arrive at the airport until 1am but not a problem.  One of the team was there at the flat to greet us with a warm welcome.  Immaculate, clean, stylish and the patio was a real bonus.    Don't think you'll beat the location.  Great cafes all around, tram 28 stop just outside and Elevador da Bica, the tram down to the market only yards away.  Think I might just move in and stay,  Thanks Pedro and team...

The overall experience was nothing but excellent! Pedro was on time, very easy to talk to and effective in showing us around the loft.  The space itself is beautiful, very cleanly decorated with a natural feel, awash in sunlight (but with black out panels avalaible) and the location is perfect for walking to food, shops and further transportation around the city. The only things you can knock about this place is the sound of the neighbor's airconditioning during the day if you're on the patio and the slanted attic-like ceiling right over the bed -super cute but you bump into it a bit- both of which are things that Pedro very kindly discloses. These tiny points are nothing compared to the great care shown and the amazing benefits of staying there. Plus: fesh towels, local soap, and the easiest chek out ever!

Wir wurden bei unserer Ankunft von Antonio aus dem Studio-Team freundlich empfangen und über alles Wichtige informiert. Zur Begrüßung standen eine Flasche Weißwein, Orangen und Pralinen bereit. Das Apartment ist sehr sauber und modern eingerichtet und es hat voll unseren Erwartungen entsprochen, denn es fehlte an nichts. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt; das morgendliche Highlight war das Frühstück auf der sonnigen Dachterrasse; kleines Manko ist der Lüfter (Geräusche) er wird allerdings 20.00 Uhr ausgestellt.Genial ist die Lage, mitten in der Altstadt; die Haltestelle der ehrwürdigen Straßenbahnlinie "28" direkt vor der Haustür, die Bushaltestelle nur wenige Gehminuten entfernt. Supermarkt, Bäckereien und eine Vielzahl an Gaststätten befinden sich in unmittelbarer Nähe; zu empfehlen ist unbedingt das Restaurant "ALFAIA", leckeres Essen und sehr guter portugiesischer Wein.
Lissabon ist eine traumhafte, lebendige Stadt und wir kommen gern wieder.

De loft is volledig vergelijkbaar met de foto's. Om ons welkom te laten voelen was er een fles witte wijn in de koelkast gezet en lag er chocolade klaar. Heel attent! Alles was erg schoon en goed onderhouden en de locatie was perfect. Echt een aanrader!

Everything was like the description, very clean, well equipped, everything you need for a stay in Lisboa. I would recommend this Apartment and want to return one day. unfortunately  the weather was really bad, so we couldn' t use the Patio in the evening.

Pedro's loft was perfect for my friends and me. It was clean and just as it appeared in photos. The street was lively and had a great selection of restaurants. Pedro left his recommendations for restaurants and snacks as well as night life.  He was also quick to reply when we had a question about a specific restaurant.  Our experience was great and I would highly recommend this apartment.

Appartement impeccable, très fonctionnel et parfaitement situé !
Je le recommande !
Excellent appartement: très bien situé à Lisbonne, beau, agréable à vivre... Le propriétaire répond extrêmement vite aux messages. Un très bon choix!

Pedro was right on time to welcome us. Cleaning was made by a professional so the apartment was perfectly clean. The place is fully equipped and we were offered a bottle of Portuguese wine and fresh oranges for the next breakfast. The decoration is made with great taste, with unique wooden handcraft furnitures. The terrace is nice (while the view on the Tage is from the living room, not from the terrace). There were many little attentions made by the owners and we felt really well during our stay. We must also mention that the neighborhood is amazing, close the baixa chiado metro line (crossroad of blue and green, very convenient), and tram 28e, with a really nice trajectory through the city, comes down the street. It is full of restaurants, bars, shops (trendy clothing and pastries, not cheap souvenirs one). Pedro also gave us a list of restaurants close and far from the appartment. We tested the paparucha and the Pharmacia, which we really enjoyed.
We fully recommend the place. Lisbon is a great city to visit and live in, and Pedro's appartment is a very good choice to enjoy your stay.

This is a gorgeous apartment in every way. I stayed with my two young sons and from the minute the host met us in the apartment the rest of our stay in Lisbon was fantastic. The apartment is chic, clean and comfortable with gorgeous lighting and everything you could need. There is a window that offers a view over beautiful terracotta roofs with the sea beyond and the terrace is the perfect sun trap. How lovely of the hosts to leave wine and chocolates too! And Chiado is a great neighbourhood to stay in while exploring Lisbon. 100% recommend this.
Fantastic place to live in Lisbon! So sweet and confutable!

Pedro and his team were perfect hosts.
The apartment was clean and full of little surprises, which made our stay really pleasant! Plus it is perfectly located in the bairro alto.
The service was awesome!
I strongly recommend.

Super cute loft in a fantastic neighbourhood. Duplex with all facilities one needs: hot shower, cosy and clean living area and a kitchen if one wants to cook. Nice little rooftop patio as well with a lot sun in the morning. Hosts were excellent! Gave us a true warm welcome!

This was a wonderful place to get to know Lissabon! We felt like we were locals and enjoyed the loft with its patio in the middle of town. It was a perfect location for the three of us, couldn`t have been better and closer to all the attractions and restaurants . Very clean, a friendly welcome, stylish and tasteful interieur ,cosy beds.....we want to come back again!!!

The house was quirky, meticulously decorated and clean.
The location is perfect for anyone visiting Lisbon and it provides all the amenities one would want.
It's bright, airy and a really confortable place to be.
The house is pretty and everything is perfect!

This flat is amazing! It's just like the photos and as described. Pedro and António left us some welcoming gifts which were much appreciated. I was very impressed with how thoughtful they were! The place was spotlessly clean and the location was absolutely perfect (5 mins away from the metro entrance and right in the centre). Would definitely come back and recommend to others!

I can only recommend staying at Pedro's apartment when you're visiting Lisbon. The apartment is very cozy and modern and hosts everything you need for your trip. The location of the apartment is great too – from here you can discover the city in all directions. Considering the price, it's a great value! Would love to come back!

Luis, Pedro and their team were very disponible and answer all our questions before and during our trip ! Everytime we were searching for a cool place to go, it was in the street of the apartement ! Our trip was awesome thanks to this sweet apartement !
We had the great time in the excellent and well decorated apartment.  Also, the location is convenient.

Gorgeous well decorated apartment in central Lisbon. It is light and airy and perfect for a break in the city, very clean and tidy and comfortable beds. We also loved the Bose speakers so we could play music in the apartment and liked the recommended restaurant list. A bottle of wine and some oranges were left for us on arrival which was a really nice touch thank you!
It is in a great location for exploring Lisbon, really close to the main city centre and lots of restaurants and shops nearby. We went to Pharmacia which is 2 minutes round the corner and was excellent food!
There is a great bakery a few doors down and also a small supermarket too.
Highly recommend this apartment - would definitely come back! Thank you!

I felt so comfortable with this everything in this flat. We arrived at lisbon late and due to some problems with my phone so we couldn't contact with the landlord, but they waited us for nearly 2-3hours. Both of us felt sorry about this but the assistant/friend of Pedro didn't say any complaints.
The flat is clean and tidy. Everything is fantastic. They even left us some oranges, coffee and a bottle of wine. The location is also good, just a few minutes walk to the nearest tube station. I strongly recommend everyone to there. If i would go to Lisbon again I'm pretty sure that I'll come back to here:)

Thanks a lot!!

Hej
Vi blev taget rigitg godt i mod. Fik en god rundvisning og der var købt både frugt og en fl vin til os. I løbet af ugen havde vi spørgsmål og de blev hurtigt og venligt besvaret.
Lejligheden levede op til vores forventninger og billederne snød ikke. Lejligheden ligger helt ekstremt godt. Lige i hjertet af Lissabon. Mange cafeer, vinbarer og restauranter indenfor få minutters gang.
Køkkenet er lille men godt udstyret. Fungerer fint da vi spiste alle måltider ude på nær morgenmad.
Den 31.12 kom værten med champagne og en traditionel kage. Meget venligt af ham.
Lejligheden kan på det varmeste anbefales til 3 personer.

The house was very beautifully decorated, and makes great use of the space. It was quiet and very comfortable - in a great location. We had a very pleasant stay, and would recommend the place to anybody looking for a base while they explore Lisbon.

Antonio met us in the apartment and he went through all the important things to know and we even got some welcome treats which was very appreciated!

The apartment is AMAZING, both in regards of the actual apartment, view and location. It has all the necessities (washing machine, dish washer and hair dryer for an example) that one could need for a very comfortable stay in Lisbon. It is close to everything worth seeing while in Lisbon and Portugal. Beds where very comfortable and everything was clean!

We have told all of our friends to stay here whenever they visit Lisbon!

Two tips for you: This might not be a great option if you have a lot of luggage and if you're not super strong, very steep and narrow stairs up to the apartment, although it seems to be pretty common in Lisbon so check before you book.

Also, don't hire/use your car if you don't have to, it's very hard to find a parking spot around the area after 5 pm, but most of all, the traffic is crazy there as well so it will take you ages to go only a couple of streets in peak time, plus there are a lot of single way streets!

La casa estaba en perfecto estado, con todos los elementos necesarios para una estancia cómoda y agradable. Muy limpia. Los espacios muy bien aprovechados. Muy bonita la decoración. Las fotos eran fiel reflejo de lo que es la casa. El anfitrión nos recibió muy amablemente y se ofreció a darnos toda la información que necesitáramos. El barrio donde se encuentra la casa es muy céntrico y a su alrededor hay bastantes restaurantes, cafeterías, bares, tiendas... En general todo ha sido estupendo.

La experiencia en casa de Pedro fue muy positiva. Nos recibieron muy puntuales, con bombones y vino tinto de regalo. La casa, muy nueva, estaba limpia y era muy cómoda. La localización era perfecta, la zona con mucho ambiente, tiendas, y muy fácil para desplazarse a todas las zonas de Lisboa. Hemos estado muy a gusto.
This is a super nice and comfortable place. Would recommend.

The person who greeted us was such an accommodating gentleman! My friend and I really loved staying here. This place had everything we needed and then some. The view is wonderful, the outside patio is so relaxing and the beds/couch are incredibly comfortable. A perfect location as well, definitely would recommend and would stay here again!

Pedro s'est montré très prévenant dès le premier contact.  Sur place, nous avons été accueilli par Antonio.  Notre avion atterrissait vers 10h et le check in avait été convenu pour 13h.  A midi, Antonio nous appelait pour nous signaler que l'appartement était déjà  prêt, ce qui nous a permis de profiter plus vite de notre séjour.  Accueil très sympathique, explications très claires et hôtes disponibles et de bons conseils.  L'appartement est tel que décrit dans l'offre,situé dans un super quartier, il est très fonctionnel et confortable (mention spéciale pour le très bon lit, d'ailleurs) et d'une propreté irréprochable.  Notez aussi qu'il est possible de très bien manger et à un prix plus que démocratique, juste en face  chez "Flower power" (non répertorié dans la liste laissée dans l'appartement, je crois). Tout petit bémol concernant l'adorable petite terrasse dont il est difficile de profiter avec le bruit incessant d'une soufflerie voisine.  En conclusion, excellente expérience pour nous, merci à Pedro et à son équipe à qui nous ferons sans hésiter encore appel pour un éventuel prochain séjour à Lisbonne (qui elle aussi nous a conquis).

A colleague of Pedro came to meet us at the apartment and showed us around the place. There's maps and a list of restaurants recommendation for us.
Apartment was great! Very clean with modern facilities and is within walking distance to the metro. Nice restaurants/ egg tarts/ supermarket are just along the street downstairs. Not recommended for people with huge luggage as the apartment is on the highest floor of the building.
Overall, great host and fantastic apartment!

La experiencia en casa de Pedro ha sido maravillosa. Nos recibió en su casa para explicarnos su funcionamiento y nos dejó una botellita de vino, unos bombones y una nota deseándonos una feliz estancia. Además se puso a nuestra entera disposición por si neceistabamos cualquier cosa.

El loft es ideal, incluso mejor que en las fotos. Todo de diseño y la decoración es exquisita. La cama y el sofá son comodísimos y te sientes como en casa. Estaba todo limpísimo.

La situación es inmejorable. Muchos turistas cuando investigan sobre Lisboa se piensan que las mejores zonas son avenida liberdade y baixa. En mi opinion no es así. La avenida liberdade está más apartada de lo que es el centro tradicional de Lisboa y si vives o has visitado otras grandes ciudades de Europa te decepcionará esa avenida. Y la baixa, en mi opinion tiene edificios en ruinas y demasiado embiente turistico del tipo menu: paella y fideua. El loft se encuentra a escasos metros de la Plaza de Camoes en pleno Chiado. Esta zona es ideal. Tiene un aire bohemio pero a la vez se nota el ambiente lujoso. Hermés y la famosísima boutique de porcelanas Vista Alegre se encuentran aquí, ademas del Café Brasileira, tiendas como zara , benetton etc. Y los almacenes de Chiado.

La única pega que le pondría es que el Loft se encuentra en un cuarto piso sin ascensor. Las escaleras son estrechas y muy empinadas. Aunque esto es algo común en los edificios del centro de Lisboa.

RECOMIENDO 100% ESTE LOFT POR:
LIMPIEZA
ESTILO Y DECORACIÓN
LOCALIZACIÓN

Lo tiene todo!!!
Bello appartamento
Great location and a very nice apartment, me and my girlfriend had a great time

The loft was beautifully decorated, clean and had everything we needed. We were met by Antonio who answered all our questions about the area, the best places to eat meals and explore the city.  They left a bottle of wine, fruit and chocolates. The terrace was wonderful and the futon beds were clean and comfortable.

Our stay at the Chiado Loft was simply perfect. Check-in and check-out went smoothly and easy, Luis - one of the guys - was there when I arrived, to welcome me and to show me the house and its facilities. The loft was exactly as pictured on the website and its position perfect for the sightseeing during the day and for experiencing the nightlife after dark.
Thank you also for the little welcoming gifts we found!
I would definitely recommend the Chiado Loft if you are planning a trip to Lisbon!

This loft is a great base from which to explore Lisbon. Very centrally located and easy to find being within a couple of moments from the top of the elevador de Bica. We arrived very late having been on a delayed easyjet flight - Luis was waiting for us and was most patient, showed us around and was in good spirits considering we were so late! The studio is compact and very clean. All facilities work well, lots of hot water in the well fitted shower room. A word of warning if you have any joint issues or stairs are a problem - the studio is at 5th floor level and no lift. Only other negative is the extractor fan noise on the terrace (didn't bother me at all but my wife found it a bit intrusive). Would have been a great place for an evening drink but it was raining when we visited. I would happily return and had great service from Luis and the team.
Pedro and the team made us feel very relaxed and welcome, they waited kindly for our delayed flight which was amazing and then advised us on the best places to eat in Lisbon... All in all amazing!
Warm welcome and clear explanation of how it works. The flat is fitted with taste and aesthetically. Well situated, within walking distance to many great places.
perfect!!!!!
Nice to look out of the window watch the passerbys. The terrace has no view but the place is airy and so central. Everything works properly. The wine they had left for us was priceless.
The host did a great job making us feel welcome, and it was quite accurate to the listing

We had an amazing stay in this fantastic apartment. The guys were great to deal with from the time we booked to the time we left - even leaving fruit, chocs and wine for us on arrival. We had an early flight the day we left and the guys even organised booking our taxi to the airport. Great apartment in a great location. Highly recommended.
Très bien accueilli !

Só lisboeta mais vivo no estrangeiro e passar uma noite nesse apartamento foi como descobrir uma nova maneira (espetacularmente agradável ) de viver no bairro alto! O apartamento muito limpo e conforme as fotos, muito bem situado. Voltarei;)

It was the second time we spent some time in Pedro's appartements, we rented two different ones for two different week-ends, they where both very well located, perfectly clean and nice. The organisation was also perfect. Next time we go to Lisbonne, it will be at Pedro's place again!
Fantastic stay, amazing loft with great spaces and views. The hosting was excellent also with an unbelievable response to all queries. Thanks Pedro and team.

Fantastic apartment! Do not have anything bad to say... The apartment is in a great location and safe neighborhood. The loft looks exactly as pictured and is very clean. The terrace deck is amazing and great for relaxing. The apartment had everything you would need ... a blow dryer, dishwasher, washer, iron, etc. If/when I return to Lisbon, I would love to stay at this loft again!

It s a nice and clean flat.
Pedro is a kind host. It was a really nice place to stay. I suggest you this flat to book for your stay at Lisbon.
Thanks to Pedro!!

Good communication and welcome by Pedro's friend.

The appartment is neat & clean and just looks like on the pictures.
Beware of the fact that the kitchen is quite small. It didn't cause us trouble as we went out to eat.
The appartment itself is located in the center of the city.
The appartment is perfect for two but there are beds for 3 (1x2 persons bed + 1x1 person bed).

As stated in the description there's a quite noisy ventilation on the terrace but it shuts down at ± 8PM.

Conclusion : I recommend.

Great place in a perfect location. My sister and I stayed for 4 nights and was perfect for the both of us. The apartment was clean and tidy with lots of modern touches. The patio was great to sit in the sun in the morning or have a drink on before going out. It is located in Bairro alto which is within walking distance to most places you want to visit. A stop for the tram 28 (that takes you to the castle at the top of Lisbon) is just outside. Lots of nice restaurants and bars very close by. Pedro and his team were very helpful from booking and answered all queries we had. I would definitely stay there again should I go back to Lisbon.

Un appart conforme aux photos, grand, chaleureux, tout équipé. Il ne nous manquait rien. Très très bien placé. Hôtes à l'écoute. On y reviendra sans problème. On y a passé 4 jours mémorables. Merci à Pedro et Antonio pour tout.

The apartment is lovely! As the photos suggested, clean, tidy and comfortable. The location was also ideal for Someone like me-new to Lisbon and a lone traveller. It was central, vibrant, busy, close to the airport but not noisy during the night. Communication before and during my trip was excellent. The wine and chocolates left for me at the apartment were delicious too. I really appreciate the hosts hospitality and hope to return soon :-).

Very nice location in the heart of barrio alto. A lot of bars and restaurants. Pedro and Luis were extremely kind and helpful, and available for any question we had. The loft is beautifully decorated and the beds really comfortable. Nespresso machine is practical! And the patio is really nice to have drinks in the evening when the building's air conditioning is off (8pm). We would definitely come back! Thanks guys!

Très bel appartement ou nous avons séjourné 3 nuits à 3 personnes, dont un enfant. L'emplacement est très pratique pour visiter Lisbonne, et les hôtes sont très sympathiques, réactifs et arrangeant pour les horaires.

We stayed at Pedro and Antonio's loft in Lisbon for 5 days and I could not recommend it more. The team were very friendly and helpful (especially when we could not get the buzzer to work - they came and found us!) The location is perfect, the apartment was beautiful and the accommodation was perfect for us (as a couple). It was wonderful to have the terrace to relax on and we took advantage of their coffee machine! They also put in the extra effort with the little details, which is wonderful. Lisbon is an amazing city and you can make the most of it from this apartment.

We really enjoyed staying at Pedro's apartment! :) We were three girls staying for a week. Clean, stylish and homey. Just like in the pictures! The roofterasse was worth the stairclimb, soo lovely especially for breakfast and some evening chillout. The location of the apartement was also very good, walking distance to almost everything! Got a nice welcome by Antonio and tips on places to go/restaurants. The supermarket is also really close to the apartment and the kitchen is great to cook in. You have to eat in Mercado da ribeira and visit the beach of Cascais, amazing! We would love to stay at Pedro's again if.. no when we return to Lisbon! :)

Had a great stay at loft 7! It was exactly as did robes and pictured and in an awesome neighborhood. Walking distance to everything we wanted to see and do! The guys were also excellent and took time to show us around and even left us little goodies! Can't say enough good things!

Superbe accueil ! Appartement correspond parfaitement à la description ! Pedro a répondu à toutes nos questions. L'appartement dispose de tout le nécessaire (linge de maison, lave vaisselle, machine à laver, fer à repasser, sèche-cheveux etc...). Le seul petit bémol c'est que l'appartement ne dispose d'aucun rangement pour les vêtements...

The place and the host were top notch! My husband and I had to move our check-in out by an hour and the host was very accommodating and easy to get in touch with.
The apartment was perfection-super stylish, very clean and most importantly, in the perfect location.

Pedro and Antonio were great hosts and extremely accommodating. The apartment is located in a very nice neighborhood and close to everything we wanted to see and do. We really enjoyed the place including the outdoor patio. It looks exactly as it shows up in the pictures. Our trip to Lisbon was fantastic and the apartment added to the fun and comfort.

Pedro was fantastic and extremely attentive throughout our entire stay. The apartment is in an amazing location, with bars, restaurants and the station nearby and only a short stroll downhill to the bay. I would highly recommend staying at one of Pedro's apartments when you're in Lisbon!

We really enjoyed our stay in Lisboa. Pierre has feeling for style which you can see in all details of his cosy apartment. Location is perfect. Apartment has all facilities you need and a small roof terrace.

Excellent apartment in a great central location, exactly as appears on photos. Small but functional kitchen, nice roof terrace, bit of noise from neighbours aircon on terrace during the day but not too bad and don't notice much with some music on, Pedro also let us know this when we booked. There is a great mini bose Bluetooth speaker in the apartment. Good communication from Pedro and good welcome to the apartment by Antonio who showed us around. Nice roof bar about 20 metres from the apartment with great views and good food/drinks. Thoroughly enjoyed our stay and loved Lisbon, would stay here again. Great value for the price. Thanks Pedro

The apartment is exactly as pictured and very well located. There are tons of cafes around and even a grocery store down the street! We were so comfortable we were actually quite tempted to just stay in the apartment all day. Antonio and Pedro are amazing hosts as well. They answer questions efficiently and adapted to our multiple requests. Couldn't thank them enough. Highly recommend this place!!

Extremely well situated in the heart of one of the best areas of Lisbon, with a multitude of nice cafes, bars and cosy restaurants around the corner - but we still slept like babies during the night. And the apartment was super cosy, and very stylish. With everything you could ask for when away from home.

To top it off, Pedro and his friend Antonio was really attentive and quickly answered all questions and thoughts we had, both prior to and during our wonderful stay.

I will definitely try to book this when we return!

Great apartment in perfect location for city break. Everything was as described, clean and stylish interior, comfortable bed. We enjoyed having all small  comforts like good quality coffee machine, juicer, portable speaker... would definitely recommend it. Pedro and Antonio are great hosts, very friendly, helpful  and efficient.Thanks for great place to stay in Lisbon!

Magnifique appartement, sur 2 étages, idéale pour couple. L'appartement est en plein coeur d'un quartier très vivant ! La team a été très efficace pour nous accueillir, ce fut rapide et simple ! Nous avons passé 2 très belles nuits !

Very stylish apartment in a fabulous part of town! Had everything we needed beds were comfortable apartment was on the top part of the building so there are a few flights of stairs to climb but once you got the luggage up it was fine. The magazines were a nice touch. Thanks for a great stay! Love love love Lisbon such an amazing city :)
Appartement vraiment bien placé, et très clean, très clair. Avec la terrasse en bonus pour le pti déjeuner....
Everything was very nice!

We had a great time in Lisbon in Pedro's apartment. The location is great, the apartment really nice and has a great roof patio. Everything was clean and Pedro answered all our questions and was very flexible with the check in and out. Thank you for a lovely vacation.

In the heart of the city - you truely feel like you live in Lisbon for a few short days, with the 28 tram passing right past the front door, and the food market just one downhill away. Impeccable apartment, with washing mashine, dishwasher and nespresso coffee maker.

Parking 100m away in public gargage. If ever in Lisbon again, this would be my first pick to stay.

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour à Lisbonne . Le quartier est vraiment super et l appartement conforme au descriptif. Par contre il faudrait préciser que le 2ème matelas est pour 1 personne uniquement . Nous étions 2 couples donc pas vraiment pratique. Ce logement magnifique est plutôt prévu pour 1 couple avec éventuellement 1 enfant.Merci pour l accueil très sympa

the chiado loft of pedros is quite delighful--comfortably spacious, a sideways view of the river, an outside sitting area, all mod.coms--and situated bang in the middle of the historical centre of lissabon.

all the arrangements for the stay went without a hitch--someone was there when we arrived, all necessary instructions were given--and then we left, as we had wished--to our own devices.

the loft can be recommended to all--except perhaps to the over eighty: the beds are very low and the staircase quite steep. the knees are somewhat challenged.

helmuth schroeder

Cosy, well equipped, modern appartement which perfectly located. Steeps stairs a daily challenge & excercise. Hartly welcome by Antonio, both in person as by means of a small gift & welcome word. Regardless the pretty busy street busy street downstairs, peaceful upstairs. That is to say, as long as one remains inside. the moment the terrace door is opened, a disturbing, continuous humming from a (restaurant/bakery) exhaust is observed. What c-/should have been the icing on the cake, eventually turned out to be the only (unmentioned) minus.
Beautiful yet physically challenging city, warm people, good food... Both the city as the appartment deserve our warmest recommendation. Keep up the good work guys and thx for having us. Frank, Inge, Nina

Nous avons été accueillies par Antonio tard le soir (environ minuit), ce qui est déjà un très bon point. L'appartement est vraiment beau, fidèles aux photos, très fonctionnel, propre et décoré avec beaucoup de goût. La literie est très bien, nous avons dormi comme des reines. Le patio est un vrai plus! Le café au soleil le matin ou l'apéro en fin de journée sont de vrais petits bonheurs...
Les hôtes sont vraiment très professionnels. Gentils, souriants et disponibles. De petites attentions nous attendaient ainsi que quelques conseils pour nos différentes sorties. Pedro a eu la gentillesse de nous réserver un taxi la veille de notre départ et de répondre à nos différentes questions, une fois sur place.
L'appartement est judicieusement situé, tout à côté du Bairro Alto et tout proche du centre (Rua Augusta, etc.). Le funiculaire da Bica et l'arrêt du Tram n°28 se trouve à 20 mètres à peine. Plusieurs boulangeries, une supérette et quelques commerces complètent la rue. Vraiment très pratique.
Nous ne pouvons que recommander cet appartement pour votre séjour. Nul doutes que nous y reviendrons, si nous revenons à Lisbonne dans le futur! Merci Pedro et Antonio, tout était parfait et notre séjour plus que réussi, en partie grâce à vous!

- 明亮整洁而温馨的 Studio，位置很好，设施齐全；
- 楼梯很陡且窄，不方便大行李，p.s. 房东见到女生艰难地提着大箱子并不会伸出援手；
- 四个人会变得有些拥挤，三个人最多；
- 日式床垫的设计，最好头朝外睡，免得撞头；
- 厨房十分狭小，不要指望有多好的下厨体验；
- 入住顺利，提前告知抵达时间，房东的小伙伴就在屋内等你了；
- 总体令人满意，天气好的时候，阳台也很棒 :)

We are very happy with our stay at Chiado loft 7. The apartment us very nice, very spacious and clean. The interior is super, and not to mention the outdoor area where you can see the whole of Lisbon. We recommend to stay here!

The Chiado loft is a great place to stay. It is extremely clever and efficient in its design. The location can not be beat, on the edge but not in the middle of all the Chiado action.  The patio is a great oasis to have in the city. Every amenity we needed was provided in the apartment as well. Antonio was very helpful with providing information and assisting with transport. I would definitely stay here again.

We had a great stay in this cosy, modern and comfortable apartment, which has everything you need and a great location too. Our host greeted us with some information about the place and a small surprise. He helped us with tips on where to eat and with a taxi when we returned home.
Perfect place ideally situated for a city weekend. Cute, very stylish and clean! But noisy from the street but otherwise perfect.

Martijn en ik hadden een geweldig week-end in Lissasbon, mede dankzij de gastvrijheid van Antonio en Pedro. Het appartement - ideaal voor 2 personen -  is perfect gelegen in een zeer gezellige en energieke buurt van Lissabon. We konden veel activiteiten lopend ondernemen. In het appartement ligt een goed en actueel overzicht van goede restaurants en uitgaansgelegenheden in de buurt. Twee keer wilden we extreem vroeg op pad; Antonio zorgde dat er op tijd een taxi aanwezig was!

The host was waiting for us at the apartment, even when we changed our arrival time, a bit later than we had said. He was kind in walking us through the main features of the apartment and all we needed to know. Towels that were left were more than enough. Toilet paper was not, but we quickly found a place two steps away from the apartment and replenished and left more at the place. We absolutely loved the location and the apartment, albeit small, it worked for two adults and one child perfectly well. The stairs up are steep and narrow, do not bring oversized luggage, it will be hard to haul upstairs. The neighborhood has all you need and more. It is like NYC's SOHO, we would come back and stay there again anytime!

We very much enjoyed our stay in Petro's apartment.  We had requested early access which was easily arranged, and we had a good welcome and introduction.  The apartment is very stylish and very clean.  The kitchen is well equipped.  There is a lovely view across the roofs to the river.  The situation of the flat is perfect for exploring Lisbon, especially as the iconic Tram 28 stops right outside. We would certainly stay at the apartment again and can absolutely recommend it.
Great location and lovely flat! Really enjoyed our stay there.

Merci à Pedro pour son accueil très pro! L'appartement est en tous point conforme à la description. Belle déco, matériaux choisis avec gout, literie confortable...Bien situé par rapport au centre historique, quartier sympathique et animé, nous y avons passé un séjour fort agréable. J'ai recommandé le loft à des amis qui envisagent quelques jours à Lisbonne! Muete obrigado Pedro!

Me and two friends stayed here and had an amazing weekend. The apartment was lovely and provided us with everything we needed. We also couldn't have asked for a better location. Would happily come back and do highly recommend.

Nous avons été accueillis de manière chaleureuse, rapide, efficace, par Antonio que nous avons contacté par téléphone à notre arrivée à l’aéroport. ( suite au info transmisse par Pédro nous avons choisi le taxi pour nous rendre au loft.)
L'appartement correspond exactement aux photos, nous avons été vraiment bien logés avec de petites délicates attentions de Pédro. Il est très agréable à vivre, bien agencé, propre comme neuf et lumineux. ( Peut-être moins adapté aux personnes de grandes tailles mais cela n'était pas notre cas)
Détail pratique, il y a une pâtisserie-boulangerie au pied de l'immeuble et supermarché à 50m. Le quartier est vivant et regorge de coins sympas avec passage de la ligne 28 du tramway.

Je recommande vivement de vous rendre à Lisbonne en passant par Pédro.
Merci :)

Lovely loft. Location is perfect, near all touristic spots and coffees where you can have delicious breakfast. The only thing to bear in mind is that it is a fourth floor without a lift and the stairs are very steep. I wouldn't recommend it if you aren't fit.

We really enjoyed our long weekend at Pedro's place. The apartment is beautiful- bright and spacious and the terrace is ideal for a romantic bottle of wine! The location is ideal too, we were able to walk everywhere by foot or take the historic tram 28 from right outside the apartment. We hope to return soon. Many thanks!

최신식 가전제품과 좋은 집 위치.
근처에 맛있는 음식점과 bar 많다
바다가 보이는 전망좋은 위치
흡연 할 수 있는 테라스.
호텔급 화장실
모든게 완벽하다
다만, 천장이 조금 낮아서 머리를 조심해야한다 :)

Nous avons été acceuillis de manière chaleureuse, rapide, efficace, visiblement par un jeune homme qui a l'habitude et sais faire.
L'appartement correspond exactement aux photos, sans surprise nous avons été vraiment bien logés. Il est très agréable à vivre, bien agencé, propre comme neuf et lumineux.
Détail important et très pratique, il y a un petit supermarché à 50m, (alors que nous n'en avons pas croisé un seul autre durant notre séjour!). Le quartier est vivant et regorge de coins sympas.
Je recommande vivement de prendre contact avec Pedro en cas de prévision de voyage à Lisbonne.
Merci à lui! :)

I can characterize our short stay in this apartment with 3 words: terrific friendliness, good location and wonderful details.

Firstly we were greeted with a cozy welcome card which was handwritten and supplied with 2 lovely chocolate candies. The apartment fulfilled our expectations. Although we arrived late at 23.50 pm, Antonio was friendly cap itself and welcome us with the guide information. Communication was great, from the booking to departure and it took max 10 min before we got the answer to the most we wondered. He was also assist with orders of the taxi and had a very good guide about different places in Lisbon where we can eat or go out.

We had a litte accident and locked our key in the apartment, Antonio came pretty fast without any hint of dissatisfaction, with just friendly smile and words: " It happends".

So thanks again to Chiado Team for a lovely stay and all work and dedication you put into rentals of these apartments, that makes you happy to stay in Lisbon.

We had a wonderful stay in Pedro's appartment, Other than the perfect location the appartment is nicely decorated and thoughtful details such as oranges and a nespresso machine make you feel instantly at home. I already recommended it to my friends next time they go to the lovely city of Lisbon.

We had a very nice welcome by Pedro in perfect accordance of what any AirBnB fan can expect ! Oranges, coffee, marmelade was offered to us. A very useful good addresses list was given to us and Pedro took time to explain us how to use everything. The appartement is beautiful, very well decorated, cosy, well situated and it was really clean. Nice little terrasse and a beautiful view on the roofs of Lisbon and the Tage. One morning, we had a little problem with the hot water but Pedro responded immediately to it ! We absolutely recommend this Loft.

We had a short but great stay in this apartment. Very well located in the city center with everything at walking distance. The apartment is very cleverly and well equipped to make bet use of the available space.  Our host was friendly helpful and flexible. Highly recommended!

Pedro & Antonio are very helpful and hospitable. The apart is very good located (300m to the metro Baixa-Chiado), clean and light, perfect designed, excellent equipped (there are dishwasher, squeezer, washing machine, Bose compact sound system, everything is in a good condition). Highly recommend to stay during the trip in Lisboa..

very well located in the center
very well equipped to have a nice stay in Lisbon (very clean, warm furniture) / the promise was there according to the add
Clear explanations for our arrival

Tuve el placer de conocer personalmente a Antonio, desde el primer momento se preocupó de que mi estancia en el apartamento fuera perfecta. Tuvo el detalle de transmitirme el mensaje de un amigo para mi recibida.

El apartamento está en perfectas condiciones. Muy cómodo, práctico y desde luego en una ubicación fantástica.
Lo único que me faltó, fue algún tipo de luz que pudiera encender y apagar al estirarme en la cama. Porque al estar bajo un techo inclinado, con la poca visibilidad puedes golpearte la cabeza.
Pero en términos generales mi estancia en loft chiado fue GENIAL.
Muchas gracias

Pedro's flat is perfectly located within Bairro Alto - an extremely short distance away from all the action. It's a 5 minute walk from the metro, as well. The flat is perfect for two people...it does sleep more, but would likely become cramped if you're doing more than just sleeping there. The patio has a great view and plenty of seating. Pedro and Antonio were both very helpful and communicative. Antonio met us at the flat and gave us recommendations on where to eat and start our night. I'd definitely recommend staying here to anyone and would absolutely stay again during my next trip to Lisbon.

Ci ha accolto Antonio, persona gentile e concreta. ci ha spiegato tutto quello che c'era da sapere in 10 min e poi è andato.
Appartamento molto bello, doccia spaziosa terrazzina per fumarsi una sigaretta, cassa della Bose, televisore satellitare belle statue, divano avvolgente, il tutto crea un'armonioso appartamento.

Unico piccolo neo, le scale.......ma cercando di vedere positivo si nota come dopo 3 gg passati in quell'app si migliora l'arrivo alla 4 rampa sia in tempo che in fiato, anche lisbona aiuta molto a far riprendere un pò di forma.

The apartment is  clean and really beautiful  - just as on the pictures. Pedro and Antonio were both extremely welcoming and responsive throughout our stay and also in advance. Antonio even arranged a taxi for us. The location of the apartment is unbeatable. Only downside: the patio cannot be used before 6 pm due to a very noisy air conditioning.

Skøn lejlighed, pænt og rent. Lidt nabolarm og larm på terrassen må påregnes, men det var ikke et problem. De ventede på os i lejligheden og tog pænt i mod os. Kaffe, fine informationer og dejlig velkomst.
Beliggenheden er super skøn, hvis man ønsker at bo midt i det centrale og lidt lokale Lisboa.
Incredible location. Close to fantastic restaurants, bars and clubs. 5th floor walkup will help build up your appetite. The apartment is stunning and well equipped.

Excellent stay! We were met on time by the host, assisted up the stairs with our luggage, with a great introduction on restaurants and sights to see within the area. Very nice unit also, in a great location!

Cet appartement est un cocon (climatisé!) parfaitement bien situé.

Pas de place au hasard, toute la décoration et l'agencement de l'appartement sont étudiés et choisis avec beaucoup de gout. C'est un vrai plaisir d'arriver dans cet endroit tous les soirs.

Antonio nous a accueillis de façon très chaleureuse et nous a montré l'appartement bien que nous arrivions tard de l'aéroport.

La communication avec Pedro s'est faite rapidement et de façon très naturelle.

Un super appartement, une localisation parfaite et des hôtes très agréables.

Paul, Bryan & Lou.
