This place is a (air conditioned!) cocoon perfectly well located!

No place for fate, here, every little details is wisely and smartly chosen and displayed. It's such a pleasure to come back home every night! (because it really felt like home)

Even if we arrived late from the airport, Antonio took time to warmly welcome us and to show the apartment.

The communication with our dear Pedro have been very quick and natural.

Great place, perfect location in the city and very nice people.

We couldn't dream of something better!
Thank you Pedro and Antonio!
Hope to come back soon!

Paul, Bryan & Lou.

My arrival was delayed because of a LONG taxi line and bad traffic. António could not have been more friendly, he called to make sure I was on my way. Once I arrived, he still took the time to show me the loft and give me directions to the grocery store and bank.

The listing was exactly as described / pictured. The loft is in a very nice active area. There are many sites to see and restaurants all within walking distance.

The apartment is fantastic, very well located in Chiado and the hosts are very kind. I met Pedro only  by telephone and Antonio was waiting for me, and show me the place. There were many small details to make me feel at home and welcomed. Thanks!

Awesome loft in Chiado - perfect location if you're looking for food, drink and a night out. There's a great patio on which to relax after being a tourist all day.
Really appreciated the recommendations too - made avoiding tourist traps a lot easier.
All in all, great accommodation - would go back for sure.
Really great property, just as it looks in the pictures and excellent location for seeing the city. Really helpful, friendly introduction from the host and some handy recommendations as well.

Nettes Willkommen mit einer kleinen Aufmerksamkeit und frischen Früchten.
Die Unterkunft war genau so wie beschrieben. Auf dem Balkon befindet sich allerdings eine ziemlich laute Ablüftung vom Nebengebäude was den Outdoor Aufenthalt nicht besonders angenehm macht.

Nous ne pouvions pas mieux trouver pour notre séjour à Lisbonne! Nous avions un vol tardif et sommes arrivés vers minuit à l'appartement où Antonio nous attendait. L'accueil a été très chaleureux malgré l'heure tardive et tout nous a été expliqué concernant l'appartement et les lieux à visiter. De petites attentions avaient été laissées pour nous, ce que nous avons beaucoup apprécié ainsi qu'un guide de Lisbonne en français. L'appartement est très bien situé, en plein Chiado, quartier authentique de la ville, on y trouve le célèbre Tramway 28 au pied du bâtiment et une multitude de restaurants/patisseries/"mini-market" à proximité.
L'appartement est au calme, la climatisation est appréciable après 1 journée de baroudage et les petits-déjeuners sur la terrasse ont bien meilleur goût!
Un sans faute pour notre séjour.

Great appartment in optimal location, everything was perfect. Organisation was also uncomplicated, very nice!
The flat is super clean, modern design, high quality und functional equipment. Best place to stay near Bairro alto!

If you are lucky enough to find out this place, do not go farther. Pedro's loft is amazing. Just, book it right away. The place feels homy, has everything you need and even more. Decorated with taste and the location could not be better to discover the charming Lisboa. The only question you will have is where to have your meal:  outside on the terrasse or inside because it is getting too hot and A/C feels good sometimes.

Deuxième loft de Pedro, j avais gardé un souvenir très très positif du précédent loft situé à deux pas de celui ci, dans le quartier qu il faut. J'ai donc réserve les yeux fermés. Loft très agréable avec sa terrasse (un luxe) et sa décoration très moderne et soignée tout confort. Seul regret pas de Dock iPod pour écouter de la musique (sûrement pour le voisinage). L appartement est tout nouvellement rénové, sûrement pour cette raison que des odeurs d égouts se sont fait ressentir au niveau du lave vaisselle. Literie (futons) très confortable pour trois. Le sofa reste confortable et pourra dépanner une personne une nuit. En résume un séjour agréable comme toujours dans les lofts de Pedro même si j ai ma grande préférence pour celui de l année dernière ;) Obrigado Pedro !

Nous avons été très bien accueillis par Antonio qui nous a expliqué le fonctionnement de l'appartement. Un guide de la ville en Français nous était prêté, un cadeau de bienvenue offert). Les photos correspondent parfaitement à la description, même si j'imaginais l'appartement plus grand.
L'appartement est très propre, fonctionnel, la décoration soignée et réalisée avec beaucoup de goût, le linge de maison impeccable. Le quartier est central, très vivant, les restaurants et cafés ne manquent pas.
Seuls bémols : la terrasse est située sous les systèmes de climatisation et donc un peu bruyante (nous n'avons pu en profiter), le logement est parfait pour coucher 3 personnes, pas 4 (matelas à poser sur le canapé pour le quatrième) et enfin, l'appartement est un peu bruyant (bruits de la rue). Dernier détail : 4 étages très raides à monter.
En bref : très joli studio parfait pour 3 personnes.
Very nice loft in the city center. I totally recommend this loft!

Great Treatment from Pedro and even a very beautyful and well located flat.
We had a Great Time there!

My partner and I stayed in two of Pedro's apartments on separate occasions - Pedro was very helpful prior to our stay, answering all my questions really promptly and thoroughly. Antonio met us at both apartments and was very professional and understanding about us being delayed in arriving. The apartments were spotless, very beautiful and elegant and well-equipped.. we especially appreciated the little details like chocolates and a hand-written message, fresh fruit, and even a bottle of wine in our second apartment (very sadly we didn't have time to savor it as we were rushing out to make the most of our day in the city). Very comfortable beds, tons of space for extra people even though we were only 2. Perfect location in the heart of Chiado with the tram #28 stopping right outside and right next to a supermarket. we especially loved the pasteis de nata shop a few doors down on the same street (: we wouldn't hesitate recommending pedro's apartments to our friends.

thanks guys! (:

We never actually got to meet Pedro. Instead his friend gave us a warm welcome when we arrived.
The location of the apartment couldn't be better. It is literally located in the center of Lisbon, and, personally, I think it's the coolest area to stay. There's heaps of cute little cafes, pastry shops, galleries and hip boutiques in the area and Lisbon's best nightlife is also just a short walk away.
The apartment itself it beautifully decorated and is equipped with absolutely everything you could wish for. Despite the central location, it is very well isolated and you don't hear any street noise when the windows are shut. The highlight is definitely the spacious terrace that invites you to sunbathe and while away the hours with a glass of port wine in your hand.
The only thing that needs some fixing is the shower, as every time we took a shower half the bathroom was flooded. There's gotta be a hole in there somewhere.
However, we'd definitely stay at Pedro's again and can only recommend this beautiful place.

Pedro's loft is a beautifully renovated loft, perfectly located in central Lisbon within walking distance of Barrio Alto and the central station that will take you to Cascais by train or to Cacilhas by boat.
The loft is perfect for a couple, but has room for three people. There's a very nice rooftop terrace, dish washer and washing machine and a very nice bathroom.
We'll be back!

Apartamento aceptable, muy bien ubicado y limpio
Logement très agréable et très bien situé

Ótima localização! Espaço confortável e renovado. O anfitrião demonstrou cuidado em todos os detalhes e teve uma ótima comunicação.
Nous avons séjourné 4 jours dans cet appartement. Il était très agréable, propre et idéalement placé pour visiter lisbonne !

Nous avons passé un séjour absolument parfait dans ce logement. Tout était conforme à l’annonce. L’appartement est impeccable, décoré avec goût et parfaitement équipé. La literie est très confortable et tout est pensé pour que l’on se sente comme chez soi.
L’emplacement est idéal, proche des commodités et des points d’intérêt.
Les hôtes sont très réactifs. La communication a été fluide du début à la fin.
Nous recommandons ce logement les yeux fermés.

We had a wonderful stay at Alexandre’s apartment. The apartment is exactly as it appears in the photos. The location is unbeatable. Steps from restaurants and shopping, yet peaceful and quiet inside. The apartment is on the 4th floor of a historic building and involves negotiating steep and narrow stairs. Although this was not a problem for us, it could be an issue for persons with mobility challenges.

We stayed for a couple of days on a family trip to Lisbon, and our stay was very pleasant! The hosts were very helpful and responsive. The location is amazing and extremely accessible. If you are looking to stay a couple of days in Lisbon I highly recommend this listing.

Highly recommend this place for young visitors to Lisboa or families! We were a group of 4 people and had tons of space with the 2 floors- looked exactly like the photos. The best part was the location, everything was walkable and the small street that the Airbnb was located on felt very safe. The streets were lively at night, but it did not bother us. Alexandre was very communicative and helpful, allowed us to store our luggage before check-in time so we could explore while we waited.
As others have mentioned, the stairs are the toughest thing so it may not be the best choice for elderly or handicapped guests as the 4 flights of stairs are quite steep.
Overall we had a great stay and would definitely come back!

Somos uma família de 5 pessoas e tivemos uma estadia excelente no apartamento. Tudo estava muito limpo, camas confortáveis e lençóis e toalhas de banho de qualidade. A localização do imóvel é excelente, bem no centro histórico de Lisboa. Hospede-se sem hesitação!

We had such an amazing stay at this apartment! The location in Chiado is perfect—it’s easily one of the most charming neighborhoods in Lisbon, surrounded by incredible restaurants and within walking distance of some of the main tourist sites. It’s also very easy to hop on public transport to reach areas further out.
​The apartment itself is modern, sparkling clean, and really well-equipped for a family with kids. Just a heads-up: be prepared to get a leg workout! The place is on the fourth floor with no elevator, so carrying luggage up can be a bit of a challenge.
​A huge thank you to Alexandre and Kikas for being such wonderful hosts. They were always in contact and made sure we had everything we needed. We definitely recommend this place—you’ll have a great time here!
Best location to stay in Lisbon!

Excellent séjour chez Alexandre. Nous y avons passé 3 nuits. L’appartement est très propre et spacieux. La communication avec l’hôte a aussi été excellente.
Nous avons particulièrement apprécié l’emplacement du logement. Tout pouvait se faire à pieds ou en transports en commun. Nous avons ainsi pu découvrir et nous émerveiller de Lisbonne en cette période de fêtes.
Nous recommandons et reviendrons. Merci Alexandre

We had an amazing weekend right in the heart of Lisbon. Communication with the host was excellent from start to finish — always kind, responsive, and incredibly helpful. The host was very flexible with both check-in and check-out and also shared many great recommendations on what to see and do in this beautiful city.
The apartment is absolutely charming. From the moment we arrived, my friends and I felt at home and truly experienced the authentic atmosphere of Lisbon. The place was comfortable, well maintained, and full of character.
Overall, a fantastic stay. Highly recommended — we would definitely come back!

excellent place to stay and explore the lively area, very walkable to restaurants.

Great location, easy check in
Lovely apartment , great location lots of restaurants . Fantastic hosts .
Le logement est parfaitement bien situé, très propre. Les hôtes sont très réactifs, nous recommandons ce logement.

Alexandre’s place was wonderful! It was in an excellent location in the middle of everything. It was the perfect spot for exploring Lisboa. Communication during our stay was outstanding. Todo excelente. La ubicación es inmejorable. Anfitriones muy amables. Volvería sin pensarlo. Agradecido por todo.

Alexandre’s place is in the perfect spot for getting around Lisbon. There are loads of great restaurants, markets, and attractions nearby, and it’s very easy to reach the metro. The apartment comfortably fit 7 of us, and we would absolutely stay here again if we returned to Lisbon.
Excellent location, super quiet with windows closed, be prepared for a workout to get up the stairs

Le logement était parfait pour notre séjour d'une semaine !

Right in the historic district, surrounded by many activities, restaurants, and convenient transportation. Everything was as described. Very responsive host!

Un séjour parfait. Appartement extrêmement bien placés. Tout était conforme aux photos, très propre.

We had a great stay in the appartment of Paula and alex who are very Nice and reactive hosts. The appartment is very clean and fonctional . I absolutly recommend !!!!!

This apartment is conveniently located in one of the most buzzing areas of the city, Bairro Alto. Despite being part of an older building, it is renovated, modern and has all the amenities to enjoy a pleasant stay. Communication and check-in coordination was also great and our hosts went above and beyond to accommodate our special requests. Highly recommended!
Thank you! Perfect accommodation

Amazing flat, Paula and her husband are very nice and helpful ! We definitely recommend that place ! Very well situated, close to shops and historical places, we could not find a better place to stay!
Excellent flat , warm and clean, like living in the hotel . I would definitely recommending it .
Sehr zu empfehlen  , super  Lage top!!

Great place in a really good spot for exploring the city. Tram stop is a few steps away (although do be careful on the tram as i was robbed!) and the metro is also very close by. The apartmemts are very clean and have all the amenities you would need....the umbrellas in particular came in very handy! Thank you to Alwc and Paula for being great hosts!
Prime location! Warm hospitality and quick responses. Alex and Paula even helped us to find a driver for a one day trip outside Lisbon.
Very central and nice space.

Great location, lots of restaurants nearby and walkable to everywhere in Lisbon. Would recommend this appartment - we had a great time and the hosts were incredibly responsive to any messages. Although located in the Bairro Alto being on the 4th floor helped to avoid most of the noise so we could sleep well.
Fabulous location, open and bright unit. Beautifully renovated with well thought through lighting.  The stairs (4 flights) enable you to enjoy the local sweet treats guilt free.
The apartment is exactly how it shows in the pictures, very stylish, close by restaurants and shops..!! Would deffo recommend.!

The Appartement is really good located in Lisbon. Big appartment and nice deco. The appartment is at the last floor (3rd) a lot of stairs, for families with kids or people with handicap. The communication with Alex and Paula was really easy always reply fast. Really kind people? We are coming back for sure :)

The Host is super friendly and helpful and was very welcoming!
The Apt ist great, everything you need and perfectly located in the center of lisboa...we had a great stay!
Thanks a lot.

非常愉快的旅行，非常好的房东。首先，公寓的设施和介绍的一样，各类设施一应俱全，适合两到三家共同旅行共住;其次，房东人很好，不用担心沟通问题，发生问题及时响应，还会给你很多旅游建议，开始二楼空调有点控制问题第二天就修好了，非常满意;最后是公寓的位置相当不错，周边超市饭店地铁都很近，很方便。最后提醒其他朋友，（1）这个公寓在顶楼，没有电梯，如果大件行李很多的话要准备好体力;（2）热水器可能是电加热的，所以如果有很多人一起住需要使用热水洗澡，建议分开，否则可能热水供应不上来。

We hebben een geweldige tijd in Lissabon gehad , mede door het prachtige apartement op een goede locatie, en de super gastvrije ontvangst van Alex en Paula. Zij waren zeer behulpzaam gedurende het verblijf.
Fantastic stay at this beautiful duplex apartment near all you need in Lisbon! Paula was a great host with all help and the communication was perfect! Would definitely recommend this apartment
Pasamos unos dias geniales en el departamento!! Fue muy comodo, muy bien equipado, limpio y como se ve en las fotos. La ubicacion es excelente. Volveriamos sin duda y lo recomendaremos!!
This is absolutely the place to stay in this area of Lisbon.  Great apartment and even better hosts.  So much to do and the metro minutes away.
Great apartment in a great location. Will definitely look at staying here again the next time I visit Lisbon. Highly recommend.
Nice experience and good location.
Apartamento muito bonito, fiel às descrições, perto de restaurantes e padarias.
Fuimos un grupo de amigos a pasar el fin de semana. La casa está fenomenal, y muy muy bien situada. Recomendable 100%!!

Paula’s place was very nice and up to date. She was wonderful in terms of communication. The pictures on AirBNB are completely accurate. However, we experienced a few downsides for us personally which I’ll mention but are not related to anything Paula did wrong or could’ve prevented. For one, there is no elevator so you have to climb up four flights of narrow stairs which can be a pain if you are traveling internationally with suitcases and/or with family. Also, the neighborhood is very centrally located to restaurants and bars but this also makes it pretty loud at night, particularly the Friday night we stayed so we could not fall asleep til it quieted down at 2-3am. Finally, for some reason at night there was an awful smell of sewage coming from the downstairs bathroom that filled the entire bottom floor of the apartment. It was unbearable and we tried to close the doors to prevent it from coming into the living spaces but it still made it in. I felt bad for our family members who had to seep on the bottom floor. We could not use the bottom bathroom, kitchen, or hallway for this reason. Again, this hasn’t been reported before and Paula was unaware of it so it likely doesn’t happen often but it just by chance happened on the day we visited. These are just things to keep in mind, otherwise the place was very nice and Paula was great about keeping in touch the entire time.

Very nice place with a good location, nice appartment, nice shower and good contact with Paula.
I recommend this place!

Loved the place and is in a great part of Lisbon! It is a historical apartment complex from 1890, but with modern furnishings inside.
Amazing location and plenty of great places to check out right in the neighborhood.

Nossa família se encantou com o apartamento: sua modernidade, seu conforto, suas instalações, sua localização, e as dicas do casal... Nos fizeram muito satisfeitos!
Saímos agradecidos e com gostinho de "quero mais"!!
Recomendamos!!!!

The location is absolutely the best. You could not stay in a better spot while in Lisbon. Even though it is in a busy place, you will find it to be relatively quiet at night! You can walk to most main attractions - everything is within two kilometres.
The host was very responsive and gave outstanding tips on where to go and what to see. Alex met us in person and went through every detail. He gave some great suggestions that really helped us plan our week.
The home was very clean and welcoming. Every amenity for our 15 month old daughter was provided, including a bed. The stairs to the apartment are steep, as is most of Lisbon, so don’t bother with a stroller!
非常棒的公寓，地理位置靠近贾梅士广场，步行可以走到罗西欧广场和海边，电车站也就在附近，靠近大型购物中心，很便捷。公寓宽敞明亮，适合群体旅游入住，环境干净整洁，与房东也非常便捷，有任何问题都可以快速回复。推荐！！

Paula and Alex were kind hosts! They waited for us at the check-in and suggested us with places to go.
The apartment was well located, at walkable distance from the main touristic points.
It's important to warn that the apartment it is located on 4th floor, without a lift and with a steep stair. So, if you come with little children, please take it count.
Very nice place and Paula was very helpful!
Só um detalhe dos banheiros escore um pouco de água nada de catástrofe mas poderia melhorar
Center of Lisbon, clean and comfortable home. Also they’re interested of their guests. Thank you
ÓPTIMO ESPAÇO E ÓPTIMA LOCALIZAÇÃO.

Very comfortable and spacious appartment in the heart of Bairro Alto. If you want to enjoy some days in the center of vibrant Lissabon with your friends and don't want to miss an inviting place to sleep and spend some quite hours it is a perfect place.
Un accueil et des contacts au top ! L appartement est bien placé et bien aménagé . Nous avons apprécié
Great spot, great service

Very central in the heart of Lisbon. Immaculately clean and tidy apartment with everything you could need. Lots of restaurants, bars and cafes within a few minutes walk. We were two couples and we loved in here - will definitely be back. Fantastic hosts, very quick to respond to our questions.

Merci à Paula et Alex pour ce super appartement.  Correspondant bien aux photos, accueil sympathique et bien situé. Alex propose même de faire le transfert avec rémunération bien sûr et c'est bien pratique. Merci encore c'était super.
We had an amazing stay! Location was great and host was very accommodating and flexible with check in/check outs. Highly recommend

Wunderschöne Maisonette-Wohnung im Herzen von Bairo Alto. Umgeben von vielen Restaurants und Läden. Die Sehenswürdigkeiten sind gut zu Fuß oder mit der Metro (Station um die Ecke) zu erreichen. Trotzdem ruhig in der Nacht. Gute und schnelle Kommunikation mit Paula und Alex.
Fünf Sterne Deluxe!

Paula's apartment has a great location and is in proximity to all you need while in Lisboa. The walking tour starts right there, there is a stop for tram # 28 and plenty of restaurants, bars, shops, convenience stores around. The area is rather lively and buzzing with activities all through the day and night. We loved the apartment as well, the top suite is brilliant with a walk in shower! All amenities that you would need for your stay are well provided for. Check in and check out process was smooth and easy, the hosts provide a great introduction to the city, what to do and how. Check it out if you're looking for  a centrally located apartment for 4-6 people in Lisboa.
Fantastic place in the best part of Lisbon! Great communication with the host. Highly recommend this place!

The unit was clean, spacious and lovely. It is located in a central location of the historic district of Lisbon. A lot of restaurants and shops within a few blocks. Very nice. Wish we can stay a bit longer.

Paula and her husband Alex were incredibly helpful from the start all the way to check out--communication was fast and clear; at the apartment they had excellent recommendations written out that were personal. My colleagues and I were also happy to get a shuttle arranged for us from the airport to the apartment and it couldn't have been easier.
Beds were fairly comfortable but the apartment is on a street where it seemed drunk people walked down. They could be heard at around 4 in the morning shouting, but this would happen in any apartment.
Would definitely recommend staying here and would book again!
Really good and nice place to stay. All good and Alex welcomed us really well.

Appartement correspondant aux photos. Attention aux 4 étages avec les valises mais sinon l'appartement est très bien situé proche des commerces et des restaurants. en revanche pour le prix de location, un effort pourrait être fait sur les équipements : pas de torchons pour la cuisine, pas d'éponge, un demi-rouleau de papier toilettes par toilettes ..., nombre de petites serviettes inférieur aux occupants. Aucun pack d'accueil du type à minima une bouteille d'eau. Nous avons signalé une fuite d'eau de la douche en cours de séjour mais sinon le séjour s'est bien déroulé.

Great place in a perfect location!  Check in was great as was communication in general. Paula and Alex have a nice binder with local recommendations and maps, and Alex even gave us a quick rundown when we arrived :)

Sehr schöne, neu renovierte Wohnung in excellenter Lage. Sehr zentral, mitten in der Altstadt, dennoch ruhig, da sie in einer kleinen Seitenstraße, im vierten Stock liegt. Direkte Kommunikation mit der Gastgeberin und problemlose Schlüsselübergabe. Ich würde diese Wohnung jederzeit wieder buchen.
Geweldig appartement dichtbij leuke restaurantjes en barretjes. Ideaal voor een paar dagen Lissabon

The apartment is located perfectly in the heart of Lisbon. The host are very friendly and helpful. The suggestions they had for us were super. Always would book this place again for another stay. I can recommend it definitely!

We were 6 friends staying at Paula´s and Alex apartment on a Thursday night and everything was perfect. The location is simply amazing, the apartment itself great (beautiful wooden floors, design furniture, comfortable beds, well equipped bathrooms and nice view from the window...Lisboa is just a dream).
Lastly, Alex was there for us before and throughout the stay ready to answer any kind of questions.
Thanks a lot! Julia

Great apartment in the best centeral location.  Clean, equipped, lighted apartment.  The connection with Paula and Alex is great.  Honestly recommended.  Just can be problem if you don't like claiming stairs.  it's quite high. Enjoy your stay in this lovely apartment in the best nightberhood.

We had a fantastic stay with paula. W3had a big group of 7 and this apartment was exactly what we needed. It is super clean and centrally located. We felt safe walking in the neighbourhood even late at night. The only thing is this apartment is located on the 4th floor with no elevators - we were just fine but it is something to note for people with mobility issues or older tourists. Overall an amazing stay! We would definitely come back if we return to Lisbon for another visit!

Paula and Alex were more than kind and helpful before, during, and after our trip. They allowed us to check in early, provided transit from the airport to the flat, and emailed us to say that we had left a couple of items in the apartment, then mailed them to us.
The apartment is absolutely beautiful and spotless. Paula and Alex put together a binder of information regarding places to eat, barhop, sites to see along with maps and suggested itineraries.
The apartment is wonderfully located for eating and sightseeing. Thank you both for a fantastic stay.

Extremely nice apartment with modern design/decor. Location is about as good as it gets -- right in the middle of bairro alto (people will be drinking on outside of the bars on the street), near a big square a free walking tour we took coincidentally started, as well as a subway station. Would definitely recommend it to friends.
great location
Paula and Alex were fine hosts. The place was as expected, cleans and comfortable. It was nice to be close to shops and restaurents.

Wat een prachtig appartement op een toplocatie.
Zeker aan te bevelen!!

The apartment is great. Very comfortable and clean and spacious with great interior design. It is in the heart of Lisbon with access to everything you'd want within walking distance. Communication and info package were great. Best stay we've had in Lisbon. I highly recommend it and will definitely stay here again next time!

Magnifique appartement avec du charme et équipements modernes. Excellente situation géographique. Paula est très flexible pour les horaires d'arrivée et de départ et une borchure vous attend avec pleins de conseils et de suggestion pour visiter la ville.

This location is ideal for people that like to have late night's! Not only was it close to touristic attractions, but they had a great night life outside of the doorstep! They have a great selection of bars on the street and food places.
The host gave us great recommendations and the apt was not only clean and very spacious it made you feel right at home. The apartment style was very modern. It was a duplex with 2 bedrooms and 2 full bath. The upstairs room felt like it own apartment loft. There are a lot of stairs to get to the actual apartment, which is not a big of a deal, but your calves will hate you for it.
Overall, a very great experience with the host, location and space of the apartment. I would recommend this apartment to EVERYONE! This is the place to be if you love nightlife, tourism, and food!
A beautiful apartment in a very lively and nice neighborhood.

The appartment is directly in the Centre of Lisboa. Around the appartment are a lot of bars and restaurants and you can celebrate the whole night there! I would recommend it to people who want to experience the nightlife of Lisboa. Breakfast place was around the corner and also public transport! Very nice!
Lovely flat. Brilliant location. Helpful and communicative host. Will definitely book again.

This apartment is located in central Downtown Lisbon. With 5-10 minutes walking distance so much shopping, great restaurants and Cafés. Also close by are some sites like Santa justa lift and commercial square. The apt was a great place for our family of 5, with room to spare. Clean and modern. Although the host was away on vacation, we were in easy contact by text.
I would definitely recommend and would stay here again. Thank you Paula and Alex for being wonderful hosts.
Amazing apartment! Very clean and excellent communication from Paula before/during our stay. I would definitely stay here again!
A fantastic apartment. Superb location. Very flexible host. Great value.

I stayed one night in the appartment and it was really great. Very clean, cosy and an excellent location if you want to go out at night.
Paula and her husband were very helpful, the communication went really well, it was very easy to get in contact and for that reason the stay went smoothly.

Apartamento muito bem localizado, com toda a infraestrutura para uma estadia agradável e tranquila com tudo próximo. Gostamos muito da recepção do Alexandre e da organização e receptividade com a nossa chegada. Incialmente as escadas parecem um infortúnio porém ela se torna discreta diante de tudo que é ofertado pelos anfitriões . Adoramos. Indico e com certeza voltaremos. Grande abraço é muito obrigado por tudo.

The host is pretty nice I have to say since I have a bad day when I arrive the Portugal!! I left my passport in the flight so I am not sure what exactly check in time!!! the host being so patient and also lend me exchanged plug!!! It's really helpful!
When I arrive the house, host introduces shop, restaurant, club and so on to me!!!
It's really nice house with great host! Highly recommend
Excelente apartamento!!! Tudo muito bom. Limpeza, localização,  comforto, comodidades. Recomendo!!!
Bien situé, accès facile à tous les secteurs de Lisbonne.

Paula and Alex are very experienced hosts. The apartment, while small, is very well appointed and in a wonderful location. They also have great recommendations for dinner, sightseeing, you name it. I highly recommend staying here.
The apartment is superb. Beautifully decorated.
Beautiful,unique apartment in a great location of Lisbon. Close to great restaurants, shops, trolley stop, etc.
Very nice apartment, ideally located, very comfortable. We had a very kind welcome. Paula is very nice, and communication was perfect. I highly recommend this wonderful apartment.

Very well appointed apartment in a fabulous neighborhood!
It is perfect for a family, a group of up to 5 friends, or two couples travelling together.
Could not have been easier to use public transit to and from the apartment, as the nearest station was less than a 5 minute walk away.
We wish we could have stayed longer than one night!
Nice apartment in popular area of Lisbon. Close to everything.
Wonderful location and excellent host. Brilliant from start to finish - would highly recommend.

We throughly enjoyed our stay in Lisbon!
The airport pick up by Paula's Husband, Alex, was perfect, he gave us a little trip around which really prepared us well for navigating the city! We were also super grateful that he allowed us to leave our bags in the apartment before the check-in time.
The apartment itself was wonderful, it had everything we would need and the location was ideal, the noise at night is the trade off for this- but more than worth it (and the air con was a bonus so you can close the windows)
Alex's recommendation of the Pasteis de Nata (a 2 second walk from the front door) was invaluable, they are delicious and far better than the famous ones in Belem!
Again having Alex collect is and drop us back at the airport was so handy, he has a great knowledge of Lisbon and is a genuinely lovely man!
We will be back!
房子在老城区，去海边和很多景点很方便，步行就可以。入住沟通很流畅，设施也很齐全，就是周围停车都比较贵，如果想要便宜点的停车场，需要走一点距离。

Lovely, bright apartment in a fantastic location. There were four adults and one baby in our group, and it was plenty spacious. The hosts were extremely prompt and communication was super easy. They were flexible and accomodating. The apartment is so nice you won't want to leave! Very close to the metro and walkable, fun neighborhood everyone will want to explore. Would definitely stay here again!

Wir hatten eine super Zeit in einem schönen, modernen und sehr sauberen Appartement. Wir konnten alles zu Fuß erreichen. Das Appartement kann auch super mit 6 Personen bewohnt werden. Wir würden wieder kommen!

We were greeted by Alex, Paula's husband. Alex was super warm, informative and inviting. He explained us in details the neighborhood and what to expect from the neighborhood, including the restaurants ( a long list), public transportation, sightseeing, parking and supermarkets. Alex was super professional. Really impressive by his knowledge and introduction! The flat was excellent designed, full of taste. Definitely recommend it!!
Great location, good size flat, very clean, friendly and helpful hosts.

Très bonne adresse. Logement très bien équipé et bien situé  pour bénéficier de la vie à Lisbonne (visites, restaurants, bars, vie nocturne tout à proximité). Ne pas être effrayé par les escaliers et les rues pentues.

We would really recommend the appartment of Paula and Alexandre! If we had any questions they answered very quickly so the communication was very easy. The appartment was very clean and is very central in a quarter with many bars and restaurants. We had a great stay in this appartment!
Accueil parfait. L'appartement est propre et très beau. L'emplacement est idéal tout peut se faire à pied.

This place is absolutely wonderful.. Full of character and decorated so beautifully. The apartment is located in a vibrant and bustling area, right in the heart of Barrio Alto. A 2 minute walk to shops and bars, a 15 min walk to the sea front an a easy 20 mins from the airport so perfect for our weekend trip. Its also a 15mins walk to the train station where you can get a train to the beach which I would 100% recommend! The apartment has everything you would need and is super clean! Paula and Alex were wonderful from the moment we booked until the time Alex waved us off at the airport after doing a transfer for us. They were available on watsapp the entire time we were there and had some great recommendations for places to eat and visit. I can not recommend this place enough :)
A very nice home and very nice hosts!  Would stay again.
Sitio acogedor en una zona céntrica, animada y bien comunicado. Hay bares, restaurantes, pubs. TOTALMENTE RECOMENDABLE
A wonderful place and a fantastic moment. I recommend Paula's apartment. Thanks again for all 😉🙂

Excellent apartment. Location is an A+. Minimalist and modern decour. Paula and Alexandre are amazing hosts. The Apartment's Guidebook is a súper plus.
Obrigado!

You could eat dinner off the spotless floor in this apartment. It's on two floors, and the upper bedroom and bathroom are like a separate suite, so the space suits two couples very well.
We were allowed an earlier check-in which really helped, and we could have left our luggage there until mid-afternoon if we needed to on the day we left.
The location can't be beat - a few steps from Trolley #28, and a Metro stop, and surrounded by lovely shops and restaurants, and a pastel de nata pastry shop that rivals the famous one in Belem mentioned by the guidebooks.
The stairs are many, it's true, but the benefit is getting an apartment at the top of the building that is completely quiet - no noise from other tenants at all.
Alex greeted us, and had to stand out in the teeming rain to help change a flat tire our rental car developed when we arrived at the address. He got quite wet but was very cheerful about it.
Highly recommended - these are very professional people who take great pride in their work.

This is a fantastic apartment! We spent our last night in Lisbon here before heading home and we were so sad to leave this place. The location is very central to shops, nightlife and restaurants. The apartment is beautifully renovated and had everything we needed. Paula and Alex are EXCELLENT hosts. We would stay here again in a heartbeat!

El alojamiento se corresponde con las fotos (sólo añadir que si se va con niños pequeños, la habitación superior no es recomendable porque las escaleras son muy empinadas). Es un lugar muy agradable y muy céntrico para recorrer Lisboa a pie, y los anfitriones nos dieron todas las facilidades. Muy recomendable.

We could not have asked for a better place to stay.
The appartment is close to everything and Paula and her husband were great hosts.

Amazing place! Right in the heart of bairro alto the best neighbourhood for restaurants, bars, live music, dancing etc. The apartment is beautiful, spacious and comfortable. Thank you Paula and Alex!!
Magníficamente situado, es tal y como se describe.

Paula e seu marido Alexandre são pessoas extremamente cordiais e atenciosas. O apartamento é lindíssimo, amplo, iluminado, muito bem decorado, limpo e com excelente localização. Certamente me hospedaria novamente com eles!
Very convenient for a family, very well maintened and fantastic place in Barrio Alto dowtown of Lisbon. We really enjoyed this stay in such place.

Amazing apartment in a perfect location, could not recommend it enough.Close to everything yet not noisy. Alex was an incredible host, extremely helpful with lots of tips and very accommodating about check in and check out times. All the transfers to the airport were also organised despite one of the girls in our party arriving and leaving at different times than the rest of us, really appreciate it. We will be coming back for sure! Thanks Alex and Paula!

This is a really lovely well-equipped apartment in a convenient and central location. I gave it 5-star ratings. We only stayed one night but would have liked to stay longer! The accommodation is on the fourth floor so you should be aware that there are a lot of stairs up. Paula's husband, who greeted us, was very helpful and directed us to a hostel where we could leave our bags after check-out and before our flight.

Cette appartement en duplexe est un petit coin de paradis au cœur de Lisbonne : espace à vivre agréable, tout équipé, un coin nuit douillet et chaleureux. De plus, la localisation est plus que parfaite : pub, bar, restaurant, commerces, boutiques en bas de l’immeuble. Tout ce dont on a besoin pour notre séjour à portée de main.
Le Tramway 28, 15 et métro (toujours en bas de l'immeuble) vous permet de rejoindre les sites touristiques rapidement.
Tout était parfait :-) Ne pas hésiter !!
Merci Paula.

Lovely apartment right in the centre of Lisbon. Walking distance to everything you would want to see, and Paula and Alex provide a very detailed folder of walks, restaurants, clubs, sights to see, etc. Great stay.

Paula et Alexander sont des hôtes parfaits. Accueil chaleureux, disponibilité, conseils, guide (restaurants, lieux de visite...) à disposition, ils font tout pour faciliter l'arrivée et préparer le séjour.
L'appartement est idéalement situé dans un quartier vivant de jour comme de nuit. Malgré cela, il est calme et nous n'avons jamais été dérangé pas les bruits extérieurs.
La décoration est réalisée avec goût et l'ensemble de l'appartement est à la fois très propre et en très bon état. L'équipement électronique est moderne.

En revanche, l'appartement n'a que 2 vraies chambres. La troisième est attenante au séjour et équipée d'un canapé convertible. Nous étions 6 personnes, dont 4 enfants, ce qui est beaucoup pour l'appartement : la table manger n'a que 4 vraies chaises, la batterie de cuisine est plus adaptée pour 4. Les deux salles de bains sont, elles, très appréciables.
Comme tous les appartements du Portugal, il est dépourvu de chauffage central. C'est donc une climatisation réversibles qui fait office de chauffage dans la chambre du haut. Elle est efficace mais trop bruyante pour la laisser la nuit. Or en février, lors de notre séjour, c'était nécessaire.
Dernière précision, l'appartement est situé au quatrième étage sans ascenseur et les escaliers sont relativement raides.
Very nice apartment and nice couple, the location is vey convenient as well, highly recommend
Nice place to stay! In the middle of the center. I realy recommend this place and the host!

Exceptional apartment, clean, well located, close to Baixa-Chiado metro station. Booking procedure and communication with Paula was excellent. Information about where to eat and what to visit in Lisbon were also very useful. I would recommend it to anyone that is looking for a comfortable place to stay while enjoying Lisbon.

Paula was such a wonderful and accommodating host. The apartment was clean, spacious and comfortable. We walked almost everywhere and we were near amazing restaurants and bars. Paula also had prepared suggestions of several eateries as well as sites to see near the area. We truly enjoyed our stay and most definitely its location.
Thanks again, Paula!

Excelente apartamento, com uma decoração muito clean e agradável. O espaço estava muito bem conservado e devidamente higienizado.
Apesar de se localizar numa zona de grande atividade noturna, não causa qualquer transtorno, pois o apartamento tem muito bom isolamento.
Os anfitriões caraterizam-se pela simpatia e prestabilidade.

We had a great stay at Paula's place. This apartment is very cute, modern, spacious, and well-equipped for a short stay. We were six people and felt quite comfortable in the apartment. The heating works fantastically, the kitchen has all the appliances you might need, the internet is fast, and to top it off the apartment has two bathrooms!
Our communication with our hosts was stellar - no problems there.
And finally, the neighborhood where the apartment is located is super central to all the great sites in Lisbon and also to public transportation. It was a breeze to get around.
Just note that the apartment is on a fourth floor walkup if you're coming with lots of bags! But our host was kind enough to help us get them up to the apartment. Amazing! I'd highly recommend.
Ótima estadia :) casa acolhedora e numa excelente localização :)

Joli appartement Trés Bien situé et calme
Seul bémol les 4 étages assez raides à monter ; idem pour la chambre en duplex sous les toits, l escalier d accès est tres raide : ne convient pas à des personnes faisant plus d 1m72

Die Wohnung ist toll. Gute Lage, tolle Einrichtung, ausreichend Platz. Paula hat sich sehr bemüht, hat uns den Link zur benachbarten Tiefgarage geschickt und das Gepäck bereits am Vormittag in die Wohnung bringen lassen.

Bon accueil dans le logement, explications détaillées concernant le quartier et mise à disposition d'un guide très pratique.

Apartamento muito bem situado e refeito de novo a pouco. Decoração fina com muito gosto. O quarto no dúplex é famoso com a sua casa de banho. A Paula e seu marido foram adoráveis, e no entanto chegámos bem tarde para o check in (0.30 am) Aconselho!
Great apartment - clean, spacious and in a brilliant location. Would recommend!
We were met in the flat and very well informed.
Perfect communication and a warm welcome in a perfect place. Thank you very much. Highly recommended apartment in Bairro Alto, perfect place to stay.

We arrived at the apartment and were greeted by Alex who showed us around the flat. He gave us loads of good recommendations and was easily contactable throughout our stay. Paula & Alex did a great job. After a number of AirBnB stays this was the first time that we felt like personal guests. The apartment is in a great area of a great city. The apartment has been very well renovated & everything you need for a short stay was there. The accommodation for 4-6 people is really good.

Alex provided maps, tour recommendations, suggested itineraries & restaurant suggestions. As a result we really enjoyed Lisbon & the surrounding areas.

The partment is on the 4th floor & there is no lift but we didin't find that an issue. We viewed each step as on closer tto a little gem.

I would recommend this apartment to my friends.. If we have an opportunity to return to Lisbon at some time we would stay there again

5*s from me!

After we made the reservation Paula kept in touch on a regular basis to make sure that all our questions are answered. Alex welcomed us at the appartment, and his advice from parking to places to visit helped us save time and money :)

Thank you!
Dorel Onea
The flat really is well located and rigorously conform to the pictures. The only negative point would be the arrival/departure schedule (too tight).

Perfect place to stay for a couple days to visit Lisbon, cannot be more in the city center, you're right there in the middle of Bairro Alto!!  The flat is wonderful. Thank you for the nice city guide, with all the useful information for foreigners.

We had a brilliant holiday in Lisbon and the apartment was perfect for what we needed. Alex made us feel very welcome when we arrived and was able to provide useful information regarding the location of restaurants, bars and transport links. The apartment is in a perfect location with everything on your doorstop. The interior is very modern and has everything you would need. I would highly recommend this apartment!
The apartment was really great, it was just like the pictures. It was clean and comfortable. It was worth its money. Also, the location was perfect

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour dans cette ville très attachante et nous recommandons très volontiers l'appartement de Paula !

We had a great stay in Lisbon and the flat was fab. Could not ask for a better location as so central. It really worked well being collected from the airport and being taken back on our day of departure as it cut out all of the hassle - I think we might have struggled finding the flat on our.
Lisbon was such a surprise and surpassed our expectation

Fantastic appartment in a wonderful location.

Excellent stay!
Precioso dúplex en el centro histórico de Lisboa. Lo mejor: el apartamento en sí mismo, decorado con sumo gusto y su situación. El único pero, el carecer de ascensor.

My family and I stayed at Paula's beautiful apartment in Lisbon. It was as described. Modern, clean, and in a good location. Her husband Alex was there to meet us when we arrived. Een geweldige tijd gehad in dit appartement. Het is ruim en schoon en voorzien van alle gemakken. Enige nadeel zijn de trappen. Ligging is perfect, vlak bij metro en tram in het oude centrum. Wonderful apartment located in a great neighborhood. Nice airy spaces and very comfortable beds. Above all, it is soooo clean! Easy to access transportation and within walking to numerous must-see places and restaurants.
Alex and Paula were accessible at all times—in spite of the fact that they were expecting a baby at any moment. Apartment and its location make stairs to the third floor and neighborhood steep hills worth every step. I highly recommend Design Duplex Apartment BA/Chiado!

Nous venons de passer 1 semaine à Lisbonne dans l'appartement de Paula & Alexandre. Parfaitement adapté aux familles et calme malgré l'animation des rues certains soirs. Et si vous ne voulez pas faire le petit-déjeuner, vous pouvez le prendre à deux pas, dans un des café les plus emblématiques de Lisbonne !

We spent a great time in this beautiful flat which is very well located. We didn't hear any noise from outside. Paula husband's was very kind and welcoming. He suggest us what we should visit and where we should eat. Everything was perfect !

Vores modtagelse (vi var 4 voksne), ophold i og lejlighedens beskaffenhed var eksemplarisk på vores 7 dages ophold i marts måned 2016.

Lejligheden var ren og helt stille, nyrenoveret og med aircondition/varme. Jeg kan 100% anbefale lejligheden til et besøg i Lissabon, hvor man mærker byens puls, så snart man forlader lejligheden.
Paula and her husband were extremely helpful and easy to work with. The apartment was in a great location and I wouldn't change a thing!
Casa bellissima nel centro di Lisbona ... Comodissima per tutto ... Ci siamo trovate benissimo !!!!

Hemos ido 5 amigas y todas coincidíamos: hicimos la mejor elección!!

The apartment was as described and we were met at apartment by  Alexandre as  arranged to drop off our bags as we were on an early flight. He was very friendly and helpful and gave us some good information to enjoy our stay in Lisbon

Paula ja Alex olivat mitä ystävällisimmät ja avuliaimmat isännät! Asunto oli erittäin tyylikäs, siisti ja hyvällä paikalla. Joka paikkaan oli helppo kävellä. Vierailusta jäi erittäin hyvä mieli koko seurueellemme.
Very nice appartment in a lovely area. Perfect for young people exploring this wonderfull city

A very nice stay at Lisboa. The appartement is amaizing, clean and a very good location to visit the town. I recommand this appartement. Alex (Paula's husband) is very kind and pick us at the airport. No worry and very good holidays.

The apartment complied with photos and description . the apartment is well positioned . The host is nice and pleasant .
I recommend !

Paula & Alex are really nices host. The flat is great, very clean, with all that you need if you want feeling good. The place is perfect. Close to the high-light, supermarket, bars, restaurants. une adresse à recommander pour un séjour en famille ou entre amis à la découverte de Lisbonne

Paula and Alex were great! Helpful with information about the fly, the area, and anything we asked. The apartment was extremely comfortable with lots of room and a great location. We toured around Lisbon, day trips to Sintra and Cascais. We had a great trip and thank you both for such great preparations.

Excellent stay in this double decked apartment.

Located in the very convenient location of Lisbon, the apartment allows us to travel to wherever we want within a reasonable time. Photos can reflect the reality accurately.

EVERYTHING numbered and written down clearly including locations on map and price range. What we can expect more? I can't think of any!

One and the only one thing you should consider is that the apartment is located on the 4th floor and there is no elevator whatsoever. Although the host offered their help to move the luggage upstairs, walking up and down everyday and when you depart is obviously something that you need to take note of.

In general, I highly recommend this apartment. Once you enter it, you will be amazed by the internal design, planning, information given and so on. Great one.
We stayed 3 days and enjoyed it very much. The location is very central, the hosts are well organized and very friendly and the apartment is great. Absolutely nothing to criticize.
Appartamento ben arredato e dotato di tutti i comforts !! Ottima la posizione.

Everything was absolutely wonderful.  The apartment was in the perfect location and was the perfect size for our family. Paula had great communication with us as soon as we booked the apartment.

She was always very accessible
To us and had someone there to receive us upon arrival.

I can't say enough great things about this place - it provided value far beyond any hotel you could stay at and the neighborhood is exciting, vibrant and beautiful.

Paula was a great host. She was very responsive and helpful before the trip and she made sure everything was ready for our arrival.
The apartment is awesome, even with a kid.

Paula and Alexandre were great hosts. Very friendly, helpful and gave us a super guide with personal/insider recommandations of restaurants, bars and places to visit.

We recommend it HIGHLY!! And if we should come back we will come again here!
Thank you very much Paula and Alexandre!!

Paula and Alex are great hosts. Communication was really easy and Alex was waiting for us although we arrived very late from the airport.

Great hosts, great apartment, great city! Thank you, I hope we can come back!

Was ein schönes Appartement! Die Lage war genial. Mitten in der Stadt und doch ein wenig abseits des Troubles. Paula war sehr nett und hilfsbereit. Die Ausstattung des Appartement s ist genial. Alles was man für einen Kurztrip benötigt, ist vorhanden. Wenn nochmal nach Lissabon, dann hier!!!

Nous avons passé un séjour merveilleux à Lisbonne, l'appartement de Paula est situé dans une rue semi piétonne, avec le métro, le tramway, les taxis à 2 pas et non avons pu nous déplacer très facilement et profiter pleinement de Lisbonne.
L'appartement est très agréable, très fonctionnel et très propre.

Échange avec l’hôte au Top. 👌
Studio très bien équipé et situé.
Il correspond à la description. Emplacement idéal pour visiter les différents sites historiques. Train, bus et métro à proximité.
Je recommande vivement !
Un logement idéalement placé pour découvrir Lisbonne, les échanges avec Patricia ont été très sympathiques.

I spent 11 nights here (after extending my initial booking), and would have stayed longer if the dates were available! The location is great, especially for beginning a trip to Lisbon and having it be your base. Lots of restaurants and things to do within walking distance, as well as ideal and within walking distance to other nearby parts of Lisbon - I really think this area is quite perfect for a Lisbon visit.
Patricia was very helpful and always very responsive. She even offered to refresh the sheets and towels halfway through my stay, which was much appreciated!
The unit was clean, secure, and very comfortable.
The windows do block most of the street noise. In fact, the last few nights I left one window cracked open because it was so hard to wake up in the morning - that’s how quiet it was! By 11pm-ish the street is quiet anyway, but you will definitely not be complaining about noise here.
I would book this place again in the future if available!
Idéalement placé dans l’hypercentre. Tout est à proximité à pied. Logement confortable. Je recommande.
Perfect central stay in Lisbon! Cute space, easy to access, and relatively quiet. Great for a solo traveler.
The apartment was lovely and cosy, and so close to everything you need in Lisbon! I would recommend.

A localização é um grande diferencial dessa hospedagem. Duas ruas da rua Augusta apenas. Melhor impossível.
What a beautiful place so well located! Perfect and convenient for my stay! Thanks Patricia!

We loved our stay at this Lisbon apartment! Despite being close to everything, the apartment felt comfortable and relaxing.

Location: The best selling point of this apartment is its location. Literally at the centre of all key attractions in historic Lisbon, you are just a few minutes walk away from Commercial Plaza, Alfama, Rossio, Baixa-Chiado and Time Out Market. There is a grocery store less than five minutes away where you can buy bottled water, milk, bread and other groceries. Truly, this apartment is situated in prime real estate, and being in such a convenient location allowed us to return to the apartment during the day to rest and recharge.
Apartment: The apartment is situated on the third floor of a narrow building, which is accessed by a narrow wooden staircase or elevator. However, the elevator begins on the first floor, and must be reached by climbing one flight of stairs. This can be troublesome for travellers bearing large, heavy luggage, or elderly persons. The elevator itself is small, fitting only two people and some luggage. Considering this is an historic building, the addition of even a small elevator is welcome. The door to the apartment is secured by an old-style lock which takes some practice to use; but once you get the hang of it, it's easy enough to unlock. The apartment has an "L"-shape layout with ample storage space for luggage and clothes. The windows overlook a fairly busy street with a tram line, and can be noisy with street traffic and if you have the windows open. Thankfully, the windows are noise-dampening, and when closed greatly mute the outside noise. However you still get the occasional rumble of the trams as they pass. But being on the third floor, we found the noise and tram passing very tolerable with the windows closed, and we had no problems sleeping through the night. It's all part of the charm of being at the centre of a bustling city!
Amenities: The apartment is equipped with a simple Nespresso machine and appliances needed to prepare simple meals. We brought eggs, bread and fruits from a nearby market and were able to make quick breakfast in the mornings. We found the bed to be comfortable, and the air conditioning (which also has a built-in Fan mode) to be very welcoming after a long day of travelling. All in all, the apartment had enough amenities to make our stay an easy and enjoyable one.
Host: Patrícia was very responsive and replied to all our questions quickly. We arrived at the apartment early, and Patrícia accommodated by allowing us to leave our luggage there before our official check-in time. All in all, Patrícia was a great host who helped made our stay in Lisbon an enjoyable one.

Ansonsten hat alles reibungslos geklappt, sowohl bei der Anreise als auch bei der Abreise. In der Wohnung ist alles vorhanden, was man zu zweit für einen Wochenendtrip benötigt.
Patricia was very accommodating and responsive. Check-in was easy and she answered any questions we had. The place is cute and central to everything.
Perfect ! Thank you

Le logement est parfaitement situé dans le Baixa; à proximité de tous les transports ( métro à 5min à pied, bus + tram + navette aéroport en bas de l'immeuble).
L'appartement était très propre et équipé du nécessaire pour de la cuisine de vacances. Il est aussi très lumineux et joliment décoré.
Patricia a toujours été très réactive et disponible pour tous renseignements complémentaires. C'est une hôte charmante et très serviable.
Je recommanderai cet appartement à un ami.

we were very satisfied with our stay in this apartment. It has a very nice location thats easily walkable to almost everything. We did struggle with the door a bit. Patricia leaves a note about that, so obviously we were the first or only ones, but even with her instructions, you have to budget a few extra minutes to get into the apartment at night. But thats not a big deal at all. We loved our vacation, and this apartment was a big part of that.

Appartamento consigliato! Patricia è stata super efficiente e discretissima, non l'abbiamo incrociata per via degli orari ma lei ha provveduto a lasciarci le chiavi in altro modo. L'appartamento è super centrale, comodissimo per raggiungere qualsiasi quartiere di Lisbona, a 12 minuti a piedi dalla stazione treni (5€ in taxi) e molto vicino alla stazione degli autobus

We had a great stay! Walking distance to a lot of sights and shopping. Patricia was very responsive and answered all our questions. She also has a huge collection of maps and guidebooks that helped us to plan our day trip to Sintra.

Bien s'entendre avec elle pour votre arrivée...
Elle envoie une femme de menage avec retard...et vous attendez ...sur le trottoir...pour nous..c'etait..la pluie !!

O apartamento é  confortável e ideal para duas e ou no máximo três pessoas, com excelente localização e  bem equipado. Passamos 4 dias bem agradáveis. Patrícia foi muito atenciosa conosco no check-in.
Отличный вариант познавательного бюдж,етного отдыха, идеальное расположение, чистая уютная квартира, разумная кухня, очень четкая и приятная хозяйка.

Tivemos uma excelente estadia no Apartamento da Patrícia e quando voltarmos à Lisboa será nossa escolha. O apartamento é muito bem localizado, limpo e arejado. A Patrícia foi sempre muito atenciosa. A única ressalva é para quem tem alguma dificuldade de locomoção, pois é preciso subir um lance de escada para acessar o elevador.

Fantastic location, and exactly as it appears in the listing. Patricia was easy to contact and quick with responses, and she made sure we had all the information we needed on arrival. Hope to stay there again for my next trip!
The apartment is in very central location and one can walk down to most of places. Patricia communicates promptly. Reasonable amenities available in room.

Patricia was an amazing host and this truly has been the best airbnb experience I have had. She was great in communicating within minutes to help us throughout the trip and she definitely went above and beyond to make sure our needs were met at times of emergency.
Her flat is professionally cleaned each time a guest checks out, so fresh bedding, towels, sink, kitchen everything! (Tip: utensils, dishes stove were in perfect condition for cooking if one needs it)
She was also most understanding when she allowed us to leave our luggages before check in time and extended check out time (although this was only possible as she didn’t have guests coming in our check out date), which allowed to explore Lisbon even more!
There’s a great pizza place just next door, which was perfect for snacking and sardine store, perfect for last minute souvenir shopping!
There’s also bus stop for airports, belem and many more just 30 seconds from the flat.
She was also very welcoming and offered useful local tips such as sites to see, restaurants, famous dishes etc.
Honestly, couldn’t recommend it more and will definitely go back to hers when visiting Lisbon.
Thank you Patricia for a great stay!

Patricia's apartment is very well located and thanks to its great isolation, you barely don't hear the tram passing. Great point: there is a lift in the building! It's small, but well equipped and very clean, even if there was a bad smell during our stay probably due to the continuous rain during the weekend.
At the begining it has not been very easy reaching Patricia, but in the end she gave us all the needed and usefull information possible. She was not able to be there when we arrived, but she arranged everything to facilitate our arrival to the apartment and she was very flexible about the time for leaving the apartment too.
appartement bien placé a tous les niveaux, Patricia est très présente et réagit très vite a toutes les demandes, je conseil cette location.
Nous avons passé un super séjour à Lisbonne chez Patricia. L'appartement était conforme à la description et très bien situé. Parfait pour un long week end pour découvrir la ville
Patrícia has been super helpful with all my questions regarding our stay in Lisbon and the apartment was perfect. Great location and cozy place, definitely recommended.

Lovely flat and very central. The place had everything I needed and was comfortable. The only issue for me was the noise from the street but that cannot be changed because there are already double-glazed windows...it's just right in the very centre of Lisbon so just bear that in mind if you are a light sleeper like I am.
J’ai loué cet appartement pour mes parents qui sont revenus enchantés. L’emplacement de l’appartement est parfait et tout est impeccable. Merci Patricia !
This a a great location in Lisbon, so close to everything you need and attractions. The apartment is very clean. Would highly recommend this apartment
Patrícia’s apartment was perfect for our stay in Lisbon. It’s located minutes walking away from everything you could need and she gave us great recommendations for things to do and eat!

La posizione dell’appartamento è ottima e l’appartamento gradevole, purtroppo ho trovato il letto scomodo.
Ma il vero problema del mio soggiorno è stata la puzza di fogna proveniente dalle tubature.

Inmejorable hospedaje en Lisboa! El departamento es tal cual lo muestra Patricia en las fotos, está muy bien ubicado, limpio, cómodo y con todo lo necesario para tener una estadía impecable. No llegamos a conocer a Patricia pero en todo momento estuvo atenta a nuestras consultas y nos esperó con lindos detalles. Recomendamos y volvemos seguro!
L'appartamento è perfetto per 2-3 persone. La posizione è ottima, a pochi passi dalle principali attrazioni e fermate dei mezzi pubblici.

Die Wohnung hat eine super Lage und bietet alles was man für einen Städtetrip braucht. Patricia ist sehr freundlich und kam uns bei den Check in und Check out Zeiten sehr entgegen! Kann es absolut empfehlen!

Excellent location, very clean and cozy apartment!
We never met Patricia in person, but she always responded quickly and kindly.
A great place to stay in Lisbon!

Fijn appartement in het centrum. Patricia is erg aardig en communiceert snel en duidelijk. Flexibel in de ontvangst. Alles aanwezig wat nodig is. Appartement is op 3e verdieping. Prima uitvalsbasis voor een citytrip.
Perfect location in the middle of town!

Appartement très bien situé (des zones touristiques et des transports en commun en particulier). Très facile à localiser avec les indications de Patricia. Propreté impeccable (en particulier le linge de maison). Très joliment décoré. WIFI fonctionnel. Guides, cartes et prospectus à dispositions.
Nous n’avons pas rencontrés Patricia car absente mais elle a été d’une grande réactivité sur la messagerie tout au long de notre séjour. Check-list d’entrée en Français complète dans l’appartement.
Modérément bruyant malgré double vitrage car le tram/voitures passent dans la rue (prévoir bouchons d’oreilles pour les plus sensibles).
Literie moyenne : matelas mou et creusé en son milieu/ sommier rebondissant.

Patricia is a wonderful host who has shown flexibility and consideration for her guests. The apartment is very well maintained and is quiet in the evening which is important for us light sleepers! The location is extremely well placed and is conveniently located to everything you need.

Great apartment, close to everything. Clean and tidy. Great communication.
Only downside, If your a light sleeper the trams and traffic outside the window will wake you at early hours of the morning

My mom and stayed here during our short trip to Lisbon and it was perfect! You can't beat the location-- right between downtown and the famous Alfama district, perfectly situated next to all of the transportation stops you need. I also appreciated how responsive Patricia was to questions and so on. She made the trip so smooth!

Location, location, location. Could not have chosen a better spot. The famous tram 28 right at your doorstep and being in the city centre, all major sites were within walking distance. Patrìcia also left many suggestions on what to see, do, and eat, which we used as a guide during our stay there. Those tips made our stay in Lisbon absolutely memorable!

Centrally located and super convenient. This is the place to stay if you want to be close to everything that's happened in do Lisbon. Even so we managed to sleep as it wasn't noisy and we enjoyed eating in and out. Also Patricia is super helpful and knows how to host well. Her directions, communication and instructions are well thought-out and accurate. Thank you Patricia for making this trip such a memorable one. We'll be back!
thank for the accommodate for staying a week in yr cosy apartment , everything work fine! obligadooo

Patricia is amazing!  She was very responsive, offering terrific directions and allowing us to leave our bags at the apartment early.  The location cannot be beat.  You cannot be any more central in Lisbon.  The apartment was clean and met all our needs - it was just as described.  There is a pasteleria across the street for your sweet tooth needs and an awesome pizza place just down stairs that is open late.
Ideal location, close to the historic centre of Lisbon, retail hub and the river. The room was very comfortable and well fitted. There were some nice touches that made our stay special too.

Our stay at Patricia´s place was great! the flat is very clean and cosy and very close to everything. With the window closed it is very quiet although the apartment is located in the middle of the city. I can absolutely recommend Patricia´s apartment! We would like to come back!
This place is really well-equipped (not a washer thought), free coffee, in a wonderful location and Patricia was very nice! I definitely recommend this location!
The appartement is in the action! The location is perfect, it's clean and comfortable! We really enjoyed our time there! Thank you Patricia!

Patrícia's place was lovely. In my opinion it was slightly roomier than the pictures show, it was definitely enough space for two adults (my mom and I shared the studio and Patrícia provided an extra pop up bed, which was very helpful). I would say people should know you can hear the trams running well into the night, particularly on weekends, but when the windows are closed it is not too much of an issue. And it is worth it for the location! Easy to get almost anywhere in Lisbon, metro and train station (Rossio) within walking distance. Check-in was smooth as well. Patrícia was going to meet us at the flat, but unfortunately our train was delayed over an hour in the evening and, understandably, she had to leave, but provided very clear and sufficient directions to get the keys and gain access to everything. I would recommend!

It is a well equipped well positioned flat in downtown Lisbon so if windows are open it is a bit noisy but it's location more than makes up for this and Patricia was very helpful in spite of our late arrival

We had a great stay at Patricia's place! Very convenient location, right in the heart of Lisbon. Walking distance to lots of great bars, restaurants and shops. The apartment was more spacious than I was expecting, it easily fit the two of us and was very comfortable. Despite being in a very lively area it was quiet inside the apartment. I would definitely stay here again if I'm lucky enough to revisit beautiful Lisbon!
Great flat! Patricia very helpful- perfect location
The apartment is really nice,sunny and well placed,perfect for a couple

Patricia's apartment was very central--the downtown district was literally outside your door close to many buses and the metro. I loved watching tram 28 go by from the window :) At night the soundproof window was definitely necessary and helped a lot  to keep things quiet. The apartment is a cozy studio but spacious enough for 2 people. We did not get to meet Patricia when we were there but she was very good at communicating with us about our check-in and had a guide for us when we got there. Overall, we had a lovely stay and if we are in Lisbon again, would love to be back!
Excellent location. Quiet and clean apartment with everything you need. Patricia is easy to communicate with.

We just spent a week at Patricia's place and loved every minute of it. Patricia has really put a lot of thought into what her guests might require and it shows in all the amenities that the apartment has to offer, besides the great location of course.
Couple of suggestions... If gelato is something you look forward to, you have to try Gelato Therapy which is down the street and hands down the best gelato we have ever tried.
If you need to get to Patricia's place from the airport, use uber or a taxi app if you can. We hailed a regular taxi from the taxi stand and were ripped off by the taxi driver as he charged us additional baggage surcharges. I have since heard that it is quite common for taxi drivers to rip off tourists being picked up at the airport. Our taxi ride from the airport to Patricia's place cost €24 while our uber ride to the airport cost just over €10.

It was wonderful to be back at Patrícia's apartment! Everything, from her kindness in communication to thoughtful accents throughout the apartment, makes you feel at home. The location is absolutely ideal and despite being right on one of the main streets with the tram line, the noise didn't bother us at all as the windows are new and very soundproof. Great place for a couple to stay while making it a home base for exploring one of the most beautiful cities in the world!
Per una famiglia di max 3 persone l'appartamento è l'ideale. Posizione comodissima e tutti i comfort di cui si può avere bisogno. Anche se piccolo, non manca niente!
Patricia's apartment is perfect for touring around Lisbon. Everything was great.
Place was in a great location!
Très bien placé. Appart tout équipé avec des serviettes de bain etc. Ville magnifique.
Patrícia was amazing! She ensured we had everything we needed and provided great tips on exploring Lisbon. Her place is perfectly located to allow you to easily explore and enjoy all of Lisbon.

Great stay! The location is perfect- within walking distance to Time Out and many restaurants and transportation. The windows really are soundproof and the bed is extremely comfortable. The AC is strong and everything was perfect! Even the studio was larger than I expected! Thank you, Patricia!

Location is in the center of Baixa, close to the metro station and train station, multiple buses nearby the apartment. Apartment have kitchen which have all for cooking. Patricia is very nice. I'll recommend it

Patricia's place is everything that was described.
Thank you for letting us check in early and check out a little later .
We were so well located in old city that we hardly even used public transport. We just need to walked everywhere. It was also St Antonio's festival. With windows shut, you can hardly heard the traffic and noise outside.
Compared to many old buildings in the area, these are one of the few that has an elevator.
Being foodie, Patricia recommended really good places to eat too.
My only complain is the damp musky odour that lingers in the apartment and outside the apartment. It can't be help as it is an old building. Once you switch on the air condition for a while or open the window to air the room and it'll be fine.
The mattress was a little too soft for me but this is really subjective to individual liking.
Please note this place is suitable for single and couple. A 3rd person will be too cramp unless you have a child.
In all, an enjoyable stay and wished we could stay longer. We will certainly be back.
Thanks Patricia!

We absolutely loved our stay here. It's in the greatest location to explore Lisbon on foot or by public transit. It's a cute studio with natural light, windows overlooking a beautiful street, and a fully stocked kitchen. The neighborhood was gorgeous and Patricia was very helpful with check-in and suggestions! 5 stars for sure!
Great location. Little bit noisy, but it is the city center so it is normal. Stairs are narrow, but we can use them even with baby cart.

Patricia nous a tres bien accueilli même tardivement. Son appartement tres sympa , propre et lumineux il est idéalement situé pour découvrir la ville à pied. En 5 mn vous rejoignez les bords du Tage dont la promenade est tres agréable.
L'appartement est dans un quartier vivant, restaurants, boutiques, transport en commun notamment le fameux tram 28, tout pour vivre comme un lisboète .
Appartement ligt super centraal, weinig lawaai ondanks drukke straat

Lejligheden ligger et perfekt sted - tæt på alt. Der er hvad der skal være og der er ingen gadestøj, trods masser af trafik - lydisolerede vinduer.
Patricia er en vældig sød udlejer, der gav os en masse informationer.

Anfitriã fantástica!
Solícita, com respostas imediatas e muito atenciosa.
A localização do apartamento é incrível. Perto de tudo que Lisboa tem de melhor.

Super appartement, très bien situé, proche de tous les transports (bus, métro, tram) et de nombreux restaurants ou boutiques. Patricia nous a bien accueilli. L'appartement est sympa et très bien agencé.

We had a lovely stay at Patricia's apartment. The location was fabulous, so central and within walking distance to all the main attractions. Check in was easy, apartment was clean and bed was comfortable. We would definitely recommend this place to anyone!
Patricia was a fantastic host, she helped is to check in earlier than expected and she provided good info about things to do in lisbon. The place is very central and would recommend it to anyone.

Posizione centralissima, comoda per spostarsi a piedi o con i mezzi. Cucina con tutto il necessario, giusti spazi/armadi per due persone, finestre insonorizzate per il rumore del traffico, molto luminosa. Io e il mio ragazzo ci siamo trovati molto bene!
Beautiful city, lovely apartment and caring host. Totally suggested
Really nice place in the center of Lisbon. Location is amazing, just between alafama and bairro. The apartment has everything with a cool and useful deco. We loved staying there!

Patricia was a great host. Once we arrived, she received us and explained everything one needs to know about the stay. The room was very beautiful, neat and had everything one needed for a nice stay. Coffee machine always happy :) The location was on the most important things, its right in the center of the town, walking distance to many sights and on the road of Tram Nr.28. Would totally recommend Patricia and her place.
We had a great stay at Patricia's place. Great location in the heart of Lisbon. The apartment is great, very comfortable and well decorated. Highly recommend!

This was the perfect central location to explore Lisbon! We walked pretty much everywhere. It was the best area to stay if you want to be in the middle of everything. There also is an elevator (a rare find) which made bringing our bags up much easier.

We visted Patricia's studio apartment for a city break to Lisbon. This apartment is superbly located in the centre of Lisbon. A stones throw from all the main haunts of Lisbon. It's 20 steps from the nearest 28 Tram Stop (a must-do activity to do when visiting).
This is a compact studio apartment, but it has everything required for a comfortable stay. It even has air-conditioning to cool you down after walking all the hills of Lisbon!

Arrendé este departamento para mis suegros por un fin de semana Quedaron fascinados con él, tanto por su ubicación, comodidad, y por la buena disposición de Patricia, la dueña. Absolutamente recomendable!

This cozy apartment served our needs just fine - the bed was comfortable, shower and bathroom sufficient, fridge and stove plate worked well. The nespresso was a nice touch. Given the central location we were able to walk to many of the major tourist attractions with ease and catch the trams, metro, and busses just a few blocks away. Our host provided us with topical advice and tour suggestions and made check in and out very easy. We'd highly recommend this apartment.
Boa localização, bem centralizado.

L'appartamento era come da descrizione pulito e funzionale.
