Situato in centro a sole 3 traverse da Piazza del Commercio, nelle immediate vicinanze si può trovare tutto ciò che serve per passare un ottima vacanza: bar,ristoranti, market, fermate dei mezzi pubblici compresa la fermata del famosissimo tram 28, fermata del tram 15, quello che porta al Monastero dei Geromiti e al quartiere di Belem, ed infine sono presenti varie fermate della metro.
Patricia è stata molto cortese e disponibile, al nostro arrivo ci ha dato dei consigli utili e ci ha dato una mappa della città.
Per concludere mi sento di consigliare Patricia ed il suo appartamento noi siamo stati veramente bene.
Lovely, central studio flat.
Perfect service, cleaning "made in Switzerland" and easy to use stuff (WiFi, ...) :-)

This flat is fantastic. I've been there every time I am in Lisbon. The localization is perfect, the flat has everything a couple may need to have a pleasant time, it is clean and organized. Patricia is a special super host. She is very kind and answers all messages very quickly. I really recommend her flat.

the apartment was excellent! perfect location near everything! very clean and still quiet though it is so central located! i would defenately recommend this apartment. we enjoyed our stay very very much. thanks patricia!

We're so exited for our stay at Patrícia's place! It's well-located near Lisbon center - just 1 min. walk to Praça do Comércio. It's easy to reach all of the main sights of Lisbon. There's The Timeout Market near Patrícia's apartments where you could eat everything you want in lots of café and mini-restaurants. The apartment was cozy and stylish. Host is really helpful and kind. Thank you very much, Patrícia. Looking forward to stay at your apartments again!
-
Мы просто в восторге от жилья! Расположено в самом центре Лиссабона (в минуте ходьбы до Praça do Comércio), удобно посещать все достопримечательности, рядом рынок, на котором можно вкусно поесть в любой из десятка кафе/ресторанчиков. Очень уютный и стильный номер. Хозяйка доброжелательная, большое спасибо за все, с удовольствием остановимся у нее в будущем.

Patricia met us when we arrived, she was friendly and gave us some great tips! The apartment is just as it looks, very cosy, clean and comfortable for two. The kitchen is stocked with pots, pans and crockery making it easy to cook a dinner at home if you would like.
It was fantastic having tram 28 at our doorstep and the pizza shop just below the apartment is great!
It was a wonderful apartment, central in Lisbon, we loved it! If we were going to lisbon again, we will definitely contact Patricia!
Nice and cozy flat that's surprisingly quiet given its very central location. Great base to explore Lisbon on foot!
Ottima posizione, ottima accoglienza e pulizia
We feel like coming home. It is recommended to stay there.
Patricia is very nice and here place is great to discover Lissabon. Sine the place is in the very central, by foot everything can be reached.
Patricia a tout fait pour rendre notre séjour agréable. Elle s'est arrangée pour nous accueillir relativement tard... L'appart est conforme aux photos. Merci pour tout.
We had a lovely stay in Patrícia's apartment. Super central in a great and lively area close to restaurants, shops and many must-see spots.

Patricias Unterkunft ist genau das, was wir gesucht haben: eine charmante kleine Bleibe in bester Lage. Patricia war sehr hilfsbereit und zuvorkommend und hat immer schnell auf Fragen reagiert.
Ganz herzlichen Dank dafür!

Patrícia was a wonderful host. She was so helpful and her apartment was beautiful.
Location was superb, everything you could want and need within walking distance.
Thank you for for a great stay :)
Thank you -- lovely stay in a great location :)

L'appartament-ino di Patricia è perfetto per un giro a Lisbona: centralissimo, a due passi da mezzi e attrazioni, era pulito, arredato con gusto e non mancava assolutamente nulla. Se proprio dovessi trovare un difetto, direi un po' di umidità dovuta al bagno cieco e il pavimento scricchiolante, sciocchezze. Non abbiamo conosciuto di persona Patricia perché era il compleanno di suo figlio, ma è stata comunque disponibilissima via email/sms e ci ha lasciato un foglio con tutto quello che poteva servirci. Consigliatissimo! Obrigada, Patricia!

A great stay in Lisbon thanks to a welcoming host and a wonderful apartment. It's a small apartment but has everything you need for a comfortable stay. The location is perfect for sightseeing and eating out, and Patricia was eager to give us some tips on where to get the best food in Lisbon, from seafood to pastries. Also, she was flexible about checking in and out times, which allowed us to make the most out of our time in Lisbon. All in all, a perfect airbnb experience!
We really enjoyed our stay! Great location and very cosy apartment! Thank you, Patricia.

Amazing! Perfect location, 5 minutes walking from restaurants, metro station, river and the main square (praça do comércio). The kitchen is very well equiped and the apartment is very cosy. Patricia is nice and helpfull. We would definitely stay there again. Thank you, Patricia !
Great stay!

The apartment is really well located.  Close to the major shopping street, museums, waterfront, and transportation.  The host was super friendly, informative, and accommodating in terms of letting me check in a bit early, leaving my bags there for a few hours, etc. The apartment is very clean and just as pictured, and has everything you need for a few days stay.  Would stay there again.
Central location was convenient for everything. Patricia was very informative and helpful, including getting a taxi for us at 5a. The apartment is basic but has all the necessities.

The place was exactly in the city center where everything happens. Within a few seconds you are on the main street with all kind of restaurants and shops. The place is clean and modern. Everything you need for a stay in Lisboa.
Cute apartment in a great location with easy access to everything. Very clean and great value for the money.

We enyoned it here. The location is perfect!
The appartment is clean and it has good fascilities. We will recommend this stay to our family and friends.

We had a fantastic time in Patricia's apartment.
The room was clean including the bathroom.
The place had all the things you needed including a coffee machine with pods.
The view from both windows looks down at the street and trams.
Walking distance to great restaurants and cafe.
Air-conditioning worked really well in all rooms.
You are centrally located to all areas like Alfama & Baixa Chiado.
Would recommend this place and would stay here again if we returned.
Thank you Patricia - especially for all your tips.

Patricia was waiting for us at the apartment when we arrived. We took a taxi from the airport and had no problems finding the apartment. The apartment is perfectly located to see Lisbon, and I highly recommend it to anyone who wants to get acquainted with the city on a more personal level.

Thank you, Patricia! We will definitely consider staying here again when we return to Lisbon.

apartment are in excellent maintenance! everything is clean like newly installed. location is good too, few minutes walk from metro. communication with host easy and response quick. She leave us milk,juice, water. since we stay for 5 days,lots of items need to unpack, there are enough drawers for storage. excellent host!

Patricia was waiting for us when we arrived and she helped us out with all our queries. Her apartment was quite self sufficient and was very centrally located near the Comercio Square. We had a pleasant stay.

I had a great two night stay in Patrícias apartment. A cute and neat space with all you need. And a really comfortable bed! Great location, easy to get to and a great base for exploring the city. Tram right outside and the metro just a short walk away.
I arrived a couple of hours before check-in, but Patrícia let me in to leave my luggage and pick up a set of keys which was really helpful.
Great little place in a great city!

Our stay at Patricias apartment was really nice. The location is in the city center. We felt very safe in that area. The flat is modern and has everything you need. The air conditioner was quite useful. Patricia was waiting for us at our arrival and explained everything and recommend things worth to see in the neighborhood. Our breakfast we had every morning in the little, cosy bakery opposite of the flat. We felt really at home during our 4day-trip in Lisboa. We love the city and will come back for sure.

This apartment is great. It is very central and close to shops and restaurants but completely quiet and cool with the windows closed and air con on. Everything you might need is provided including Nespresso pods and some milk for breakfast.  Patricia was waiting for us on arrival and was very helpful with tips for our stay.  Would definitely recommend!

If you are reading this review to find a place to stay in Lisbon, look no further! This studio apartment was perfect in every way.....location, comfort, cleanliness, decor, and Patricia who gave us maps, directions and suggestions to enjoy Lisbon, it's food and culture to the fullest. We will be back and we will want to stay here again!
Patricia is a friendly and helpful hostess. The apartment is centrally located and the famous tram #28 is just steps away. We have enjoyed our stay in Lisbon. Thank you'

El lugar donde está ubicada es ideal, ruidoso, pero está perfectamente aislado. Tiene aire acondicionado, con lo cual no importa permanecer con las ventanas cerradas.
Si el viaje es para una pareja el lugar es ideal

Patricia's studio is in an incredible location!!! My husband and I could not have picked a more convenient spot for 4 nights sightseeing in Lisbon. Patricia met us there as soon as we arrived and walked us through everything we needed to know for a comfortable stay. Her studio is the perfect size for two people and she has thought of everything we might need. It was very clean. With the windows closed it was almost silent inside. We used the air conditioning unit and it was also silent and very efficient.

All in all a very good experience. The flat was perfect for two people, with all the necessary equipment and kitchenware. Everything was exactly as it says in the description of the flat. Very good location in the center of the city but when you close the windows, you can hardly hear the sounds of the nearby street. Patrícia  is a great host and answers very promptly to any questions you might have. Thank you again for the great service and the lovely holiday home!

Patricia, es muy buena anfitrión. Estuvo siempre en contacto permanente ofreciéndonos ayuda y recomendaciones de lugares para visitar. El lugar es muy cómodo y estaba en perfecto orden a nuestro párroco. Su ubicación es perfecta y cerca de los principales lugares para visitar

Beaucoup de documentation de Lisbonne à disposition et des conseils suggérés pour visite et restaurant

Appartement très bien situé (gare ferroviaire, bus, métro et bus pour l'aéroport à proximité). Décoration soignée, logement lumineux et bien isolé

Accueil sympathique
The apartment is in a great location, clean and as described. Patrícia was lovely and quick to respond to any queries. Would highly recommend :)

Très bon séjour dans le studio de Patricia. Studio très bien agencé et fonctionnel et très bien placé dans Lisbonne. studio très propre, on s'y sentait comme à la maison. Très bon accueil de Patricia. Bref que du positif.

The apartment is very similar to what is shown in the pictures. It is a little apartment and it is perfect for couples. The best of the apartment is its LOCATION! It is in the city center which allows you to arrive to the main city attractions in walking distance. Patrícia is very nice and she worries a lot about her guests comfort before their stay in her apartment. I highly recommend this apartment, especially for its location!

This small cosy flat is perfect for two people. Being right in the centre of Lisbon you can reach all the major sights quickly. There is a great local cafe across the street, which Patricia recomended to us. Patricia was very friendly and gave us some good tips for our time in Lisbon.
Nice apartment, clean and tidy. Nice landlady, she is very very helpful.
Patricia ha  sido una muy buena anfitriona. Nos hizo sentir a gusto desde la llegada.

Nous sommes arrivés très facilement à l'appartement en suivant les indications. Patricia nous attendait et nous a donné tous les renseignements sur le logement , le quartier, les différents moyens de transport...et les indications pour notre départ.
Le quartier est idéal comme point de départ de toutes les découvertes de la ville.C'est très animé.
Cet appartement est pratique pour trois personnes.derrière le rideau en dentelle, notre petite fille était ravie d'avoir son coin personnel.

L'appartamento e' piccolo ma molto grazioso e confortevole...in cucina non manca nulla...neanche il buon caffe' italiano! la posizione ottima.. a pochi passi da piazza del commercio e alla fermata metro. Patricia e' stata accogliente e gentile! consigliatissimo!

Patricia waited for us till 2 am in the night (our flight was delayed) and still explained us, where to go and what to see. She already prepared a Map of Lisbon for us!! The Appartment is really cute and clean and wonderful! U have anything you'll need. It is super central to everything you want to see. Shops, Metro, Bus, Restaurants, Sights - everything is really close, so you can walk a lot around.
Portugal is a beautifu country and potuguese people is gentle.  I liked so  much your apartment, clean anda pleasant.  Patricia is friendly and helpful.  Thanks.  I'll will be back sure.

Super accueil et super suivi de notre hote.
Tres agreable et courtois.
Le logement est super propre et tres bien situé. tout se fait a pied.
Merci encore a patricia pour son accueil.

Je recommande cette personne et ce logement.
Cordialement,

Wonderful apartment, even lovelier than the photos! Amazing location right in the centre making it easy to walk around and see the city. Patrícia was more than helpful and gave lots of great advice on what to do and see and was very easy to contact. Would definitely recommend!

Patricia's home in Lisbon was exactly what we were looking for! It was incredibly cozy and the location was perfect! When she says the flat is central, she sure does mean it! We were walking distance from every where we wanted to go! If we ever wanted to go freshen up or drop things off at the flat, we were always only a few minutes away. The bed was so comfortable and having a heater for the flat was the cherry on top! I will definitely be back to this little place when I go back to Lisbon!

Appartamento in pieno centro, vicino a metro e tram, magnifico punto di partenza per visitare la città. La casa è piccolina, ma non manca nulla (ci sono anche tè, caffè e burro per fare colazione...). Ottimo rapporto qualità/prezzo. Ci siamo fermati tre notti e lo consigliamo caldamente.

A localização do apartamento é perfeita e Patrícia faz com que tudo seja mais fácil, providencia táxi, dá dicas de compras e passeios.
Está sempre disponível e mantém seu apartamento (ambos, porque já nos hospedamos no outro e a boa qualidade é a mesma) sempre impecável, limpo, organizado e com tudo que seja necessário para uma estadia perfeita.
Sempre que voltarmos a Lisboa nos hospedaremos com Patrícia.
Patricia was lovely, she explained us a bit what are the main thing to do in Lisbon.  The apartment is in the city center, so it is very easy to reach for everything.
Adoramos o apartamento. O localização é sensacional, o apartamento tem tudo que é necessário para se hospedar com comodidade e a Patrícia foi muito simpática e solícita. Recomendo!!!

We had been very well greeted by Patricia, a great host. Smooth and fast check in as in few minutes she showed us the flat: she was also very informative when we asked her suggestions on how to move in Lisboa. The flat is as you can see it in the picture, very clean, cozy and conveniently located in the heart of the town, few steps to reach many important places to visit. The bed was confortable and the kitchen very well equipped. I'll suggest Patricia's place to my friends going to Portugal.
Nice, small and well-furnished apartment in downtown Lisbon, the location was perfect. Patricia handled everything professionally.

La casa di Patricia è davvero in una posizione strategica, perfetta per girare tutta la città e comodissima per prendere i treni verso le maggiori località della zona.
La casa è accogliente e completa di tutto ciò che serve per le prime necessità.
Grazie infinite per l'accoglienza a Patricia!!

It was great location and a homely apartment. Patricia always gave very swift responses, and she helped me returning back to the room after my check-out to find my left tickets. Kind heart and great help. Thank you Patricia !

We spent 3 days in the apartment. I would say that location is PERFECT! very close to the river, to Alfama, and to main street with many shops and restaurant. Easily you can go to Rossio and take train to Sintra. You can use famous 28 tram which is just in front of the house. Apartment is perfect for 2 persons, everything you need is there. Patricia is very helpful, she is flexible with check in hours.
We spent lovely time in Lisbon and if we recommend Patricia's place to any tourist!

I stayed in Patricías flat for 4 weeks during November- December. I absolutely loved the flat, it is very central and you can walk basically everywhere within the city center from there. The tram passes by just outside the door, as does the airport bus. Patricía was a very helpful host and always answered emails and texts very quickly. I have no complaints at all. I highly recommend staying in this flat- it is a perfect place to discover Lisbon from.

Patricia was there waiting for us, she gave us all of the info regarding the apartment and then some local information about where to go and what to see. We knew that we could contact her at any time if we had any problems.

We loved this appartment which was very cute and well situated, close to many attractions, pedestrian streets and to the river by walking distance. Patricia is accessible and made our arrival very easy. She kindly gave us information to help us enjoy our stay in Lisbon. We definitely think about going back to Patricia's appartment if we go back to Lisbon.

Je n'ai pas eu de chance car à mon arrivée à l'aéroport de Lisbonne, Patricia m'a avertie qu'elle avait un contre temps. C'est Regina, assez pressée et parlant uniquement le portugais qui m'a remis les clefs sans donc aucun échange puisque je parle anglais, espagnol mais pas le portugais. J'ai échangé par whatsapp avec Patricia surtout à cause d'un problème d' internet: bonne connexion mais impossible d'ouvrir aucune page...

L'appartement de Patricia, lumineux, calme et très propre, bien aménagé est idéalement situé pour visiter à pied ou prendre les transports à leur départ et ainsi être assis, ce qui n'est pas négligeable vue l'affluence de touristes.
Tout le nécessaire est présent pour passer un bon séjour, jusqu'au sèche cheveux, fer à repasser, clim ainsi que la machine à nexpresso et le café.
La TV ne s'adresse qu'aux hôtes parlant portugais.

Il y a un excellent restaurant, en sortant à droite puis à gauche Da Prata 52, excellentes tapas et bon vin, avec un serveur parlant français très convivial et de très bon conseil. (Petit et toujours plein, il est préférable de réserver);

Je recommande cet appartement pour son confort et sa situation.

El apartamento está en un lugar estupendo.
Patrícia es muy amable y nos he dejado bastante la voluntad.
Los puntos principales están muy cercanos.
Hay muchos restaurantes cercanos.
No hay ruído y o lugar es bien seguro. Podrás caminar tranquilo por la noche.
Lo recomiendo.

Simplesmente Perfeito! Ótima localização, super bem arejado, silencioso, cama de verdade, banho bom, etc.
O apartamento é muito bem cuidado. Patricia pensou com muito carinho em cada detalhe, para que os hospedes se sentissem a vontade e pudessem aproveitar descansados o que Lisboa tem de melhor.

Patricia welcomed us upon our arrival and provided very helpful information and advice. The apartment is perfect in every way! Great location, wonderful facilities and a beautiful place to stay. Four nights was way too short a time to spend in fascinating, fabulous Lisbon and in this gorgeous apartment! We will be back and will recommend Patricia's place to friends and family! Thank you Patricia for your thoughtful and generous hosting!

Very good equipped flat in the center of Lisboa! We have everything we need: air conditioner, hair-dryer, soundproof windows, good bed, all crockery. Patricia was very nice and tell us all about apartment and Lisboa. We have great time in this place. Highly recommended!

Perfect!! This apartment is big enough and very beautiful and Central. The location is perfect, we arrive at here by aerobus, when you get off the bus,just 5 minutes to here. When you leave here and go to airport, the bus station is more closer!! Just 30 seconds, you can arrive the station and waiting for aerobus!!! I highly recommend this apartment yo you guys! The team 28 just in front of this apartment!!! What amazing!!
Besides, if you have enough time visiting Lisbon, you can go to Rossio train station and buy one day tickets to Sintra, its 15 euro per person, it's including train tickets and bus in Sintra, and Sintra to cabo do roca, and here to cascais, cascais to Lisbon sodge. Its useful~Sintra is beautiful and when you arrive at here, take 434 to visit here.. When you finish Sintra and come back to Sintra train station, You can take 403 from Sintra to roca, and from there you also can go to cascais, and when you arrive at cascais, you can take train back to Lisbon sodge, it's another train station and very near to this apartment! All of this just 15 euro! Don't forget to save the receipt when you buy this one day tickets, because some driver will see the receipt~
There has another restaurant named Da Prata 52, it's yummy! Especially black pork and shrimp with garlic!
If I go to Lisbon again, I will definitely choose this lovely apartment again!

Gostamos muito do apartamento da Patrícia. Excelente localização e a Patrícia foi uma grande anfitriã. Tivemos um atraso em nosso vôo e perdemos uma conexão, o que fez nossas malas não chegarem em lisboa no dia que chegamos. Patrícia foi muito compreensiva e paciente nos aguardando até 1 hora da madrugada no apartamento para fazermos o check in. Recomendo o apartamento.
Nous avons été bien accueillis par Patricia. Le studio est comme la photo.

The apartment is very well located in Lisboa. All the attractions are in foot distance and is near the bus stop of the famous 28, the airbus for airport and also the tram for Belem. There is also a supermarket and a lot of restaurant and pasteleries... The house is well fournished and very pretty and clean and Patricia is a fabolous host! All was perfect! Don't miss to eat "pasteiss the nata" before leave Lisboa!! :)

Superb apartment in the heart of Lisbon. This is a treat of a place to stay. It is well equipped and the space superbly designed. It suited the needs of myself and daughter perfectly.  Paticia was welcoming and informative about the area and we couldn't have had a better place to stay

L'appartement est situé idéalement. Malgré une rue bruyante quand on ferme la fenêtre on est totalement isolé.
Particulièrement propre lors de notre arrivée c'est très agréable !
Je vais clairement le conseiller à tout mon entourage

This apartment is the perfect place for a stay in Lisbon. It's a very central location close to the metro and to the airport drop off location. It's within walking distance of most major attractions. I love that is a a walk away from the waterfront.

The apartment is just as seen in the photos. Very clean, working AC, good WiFi reception. Patricia was also very informative on things to see/do (she provided a little cheat sheet and a map) around Lisbon. The elevator is quite small and the stairs going up to the apartment are very narrow. I didn't have any issues carrying my luggage up because I packed very lightly, but for anyone else carrying a big heavy suitcase, you might struggle a bit. Overall, I had a fantastic time staying at Patricia's apartment. I would definitely recommend this place to any friend/family.

Thanks!

Superbe appartement, très bien situé dans le centre historique de Lisbonne, au pied de la Sé et de la Praça do Comercio.

Patricia est très accueillante et sympathique.

Super séjour !!!

Жилье в прекрасном районе, рядом остановка 28 трамвая, пешком доступны достопримечательности. Есть все что может понадобиться, даже кофеварка и радио. Patricia  - очень внимательна, встретила нас поздно ночью, все рассказала и помогла. Рекомендую
Nice apartment with strategic localization for exploring Lisbon.

We absolutely loved Patricia's place! She truly cares about the experience of the renters which can be seen in the little details that she took care of in her apartment - like leaving juice and milk in the refrigerator and providing an espresso machine. The apartment itself is very central to everything and is in a fantastic neighborhood -  approx. 3 blocks away from the Arco da Rua Augusta with plenty of restaurants and shops around. The apartment is clean and very much as described in the listing. Patricia was really nice and helpful throughout the process of staying at her place. Though we never got to meet her (she was on vacation), Anabela with the Lisbon Concierge was super friendly and helpful on check-in day.

Loved, loved, loved this apartment! Patricia was so kind and helpful, getting us situated, our car parked and stocking the apartment with plenty of coffee!! The flat was perfect for our little family and so comfortable. We (especially our 3-year-old son) loved having the trollies right out the door and the location was very convenient for getting to plenty of restaurants and sites. Even the parking cost turned out to be lower than we expected. Thank you for a wonderful stay in Lisbon.

Die Wohnung liegt zentral und im 3.Stock des Hauses, den 1. Stock muss man zu Fuß gehen, danach kann man den Lift benutzen. Es ist eine schön eingerichtete, kleine Wohnung mit einer  Küche und einem Bad mit WC. Die Betten waren gut und der Fernseher funktionierte tadellos. Internet war mit einem Gratis-WLan verfügbar. Die Gastgeberin ist sehr freundlich und gibt auch gerne Tipps für den Aufenthalt. Ich werde das nächste mal bestimmt wieder bei Ihr wohnen...

Our experience with staying in the apartment was really great. Perfect location in the center of the city, just few steps to ocean, main squares and restaurants. The apartment is very clean and has everything you need. Patricia is very friendly and helpful. We recommend this place for any couple to spend a great time in Lisbon.

Nous avons passé une très belle semaine à Lisbonne dans l'appartement de Patricia. Elle était facilement disponible pour répondre à nos questions avant et pendant notre séjour. Le jour de notre arrivée, elle est venue nous accueillir et nous expliquer ce que nous avions à savoir. L'appartement est tout à fait comme décrit. Il est très bien situé pour profiter de tout ce que Lisbonne offre, et il y a des services (resto, petit marché, bars, fromagerie, etc.) à proximité. Le quartier est très animé, mais une fois les fenêtres fermées c'est très calme pour bien dormir le soir. Merci Patricia!

Patricia apartment was nice. Had everything you needed. Centrally located in Lisbon. Walking distance to metro, bus, shops, restaurants, & wine bar.
Patricia was kind to let us leave our bags on our check-out day, so we could explore more of the city without the added weight of our suitcases.
The World needs Pastel de Nata, yummy!
l appartement est très bien situé, très chaleureux...Patricia nous a très bien accueillis tout était parfait Lisbonne est une très belle ville. Merci encore Patricia

Patrícia ist eine sehr nette und freundliche Gastgeberin. Ihr Apartment liegt mitten im Zentrum von Lisboa, sobald man aus der Haustür fällt und um die Ecke schaut, befindet man sich in der Haupteinkaufsstraße. Besonders hat uns das Viertel Bairro Alto gefallen, in welchen viele kleine Läden sind und unzählig viele Bars und Kneipen, wirklich für jeden was dabei! Von der Rockbar bis zur Bluesbar :-) und die Getränke sind sehr günstig :-)
Das Apartment war sehr sehr sauber und die Klimaanlage top!
Gerne wieder :-)
Patricia met us as quickly as possible after we contacted her.  The place was nice and clean and bright.  The location was very good.

Patricia is very lovely. She showed us everything, was very helpful and the apartment was great. The location was perfect - more central is impossible. Everything was mega-clean and well organized. We could go there in a heartbeat.
Patricia, thank you again for allowing Phoebe and I to staying in your beautiful apartment.  We can't recommend the place more highly and absolutely loved our time in Lisbon.

Le logement était conforme aux photos et aux annonces que nous avions vues via le site Airbnb.
Il était très très bien placé dans le centre de Lisbonne, proche de la place du commerce où beaucoup de transport peuvent être accessibles rapidement.

Bel appartement lumineux à deux pas du Tage, des transports (aéroport), des commerces ... Confortable accueillant et fonctionnel. Notre fille a été très bien accueillie par Patricia puisqu'elle est arrivée avant nous.Elle a eu une très bonne connexion wifi pour son activité. Adresse à retenir pour une prochaine visite.

Great experience and ideally located studio in the city center.. For a couple, or a family with one child. It's literally 2mn from Praca de commercio, the bus to the airport is at the corner. Half-way between Alfama and Barrio Alto, what else can be asked!
Patricia is really helpful. I had a small Internet issue during one afternoon and she solved it within minutes!!

The appartment description was perfect! The appartment was in excellent conditions with all the things you may need during your stay. We feel at home and Patricia was a very kind host also received us with some nice stuff like juice coffee, milk and some things that are necessary for basic cooking!
Our days in the appartment were great and was in the center close to the metro, bus, etc and lot of stores.

O apartamento é aconchegante e bem localizado. Silencioso à noite, banheiro com bom chuveiro quente, cozinha bem equipada, guia de instruções claro. Patrícia foi gentil ao permitir antecipar os procedimentos de check-in, mostrou-me o apartamento e foi muito solícita ao responder os meus questionamentos sobre a vizinhança e a cidade de Lisboa. Recomendo a estadia nesse apartamento.

Appartement parfait pour découvrir cette ville magnifique!!!
Une hôte accueillante, chaleureuse et de bons conseils, un appartement de qualité, très propre, fonctionnel, calme, parfaitement équipée et surtout idéalement situé! Rien à redire, juste envie d'y revenir!
Merci Patricia

Patricia nous a très chaleureusement accueilli dans son studio clair, impeccable et équipé parfaitement.
Idéalement placé pour découvrir Lisbonne (plein centre de Baixa) il est de ce fait un peu bruyant mais il suffit de fermer la fenêtre et l'on entend plus un bruit!
C'est la 1ère fois que nous utilisons airbnb et sommes ravis de cette expérience grâce à Patricia que nous remercions !

Hi Patricia,
It was a pleasure staying in your apartment. The apartment was clean and comfortable. We couldn't have found a better location... the best access to all of the trendy Chiado neighbourhood.
To all travelers booking this apartment: from Baixa/Chiado subway station use exit to Rua Crucifixio and you have only 4 minutes walk to the apartment.
Thank you Patricia for the opportunity.
Monika & Gilbert

Excellent séjour passé dans l'appartement de Patricia, fidèle aux photos, très bien équipé, il y a tout ce dont on a besoin. Nous avons été très bien reçus et elle nous a donné toutes les informations nécessaires pour notre séjour. L'appartement est idéalement situé, même pour une brève pause dans la journée pour se reposer entre deux visites, et permet d'accéder facilement à tous les quartiers de Lisbonne.

Patricia's apartment was absolutely lovely - perfect location to explore Lisbon in three days! Patricia had thought of everything to make our stay comfortable (even stocking a few essentials in the fridge on arrival) and gave us some useful tips to make sure we got the most from our time in Lisbon. I would recommend this apartment to anyone looking to stay in Lisbon for a few days.

Patricia nous a très bien accueilli, ses informations ont été très claires. L'appartement est tel que décrit, il est super propre et on y trouve tout le nécessaire. Bien insonorisé on y dort très bien. L'excellente situation  géographique en fait un appartement de choix.

We had a wonderful stay at Patricia's place. The location is perfect - right in the middle of everything and a very short walk to other areas of the city. It's a very lively and busy area, but if you want quiet all you have to do is close the windows. Amazing soundproofing!! The apartment is spacious for two people and well equipped with everything you might need (including reliable/fast wifi)! Patricia was very helpful in terms of making suggestions and answering questions and was always available if needed. Thanks for a great time!
Sehr zentral gelegene Wohnung in Lisboa. Die Wohnung war sehr liebevoll eingerichtet, so dass man sich sehr wohl gefühlt hat.

Bien que Patricia fut elle-même en vacances pendant notre séjour, nous avons pu communiquer sans aucun soucis. Très accueillant, l'appartement dispose de tout ce dont on a besoin pour un séjour de 3 jours comme nous l'avons fait. Plus de temps n'aurait évidemment posé aucun problème ! Idéalement placé, nous avons pu découvrir toute la ville à pied. La possibilité de pouvoir faire une petite pause à l'appartement durant la journée était très agréable également.
Nous recommandons donc Patricia et son appartement de bon coeur.
We could not imagine a better location to explore Lisboa. Patricia's apartment is extremely well located in the very heart of the city. Patricia is really helpful and we do recommend her place.

Patricia is the best! As soon as you walk into her home, you can immediately see the level of care that she puts into making sure that you feel at home. The apartment is beautiful and the location can't be beat -- at least coming from first timers for Lisbon. I highly recommend staying here again, because I can't imagine too many places being better.
La casa è molto carina e confortevole, e situata in centro, posizione ottima per gli spostamenti, sia a piedi che con i mezzi pubblici. Patricia è stata molto gentile e puntuale.

Very neat studio! We arrived very early in the morning and Patricia met us soon after. She gave us water and juice it was nice. The apartment was really neat with new windows :) just beware of the small elevator. It was something special.

Patrícia was extremely welcoming! She gave us a lot of information and suggestions on how and where to spend our time in Lisbon. She was very responsive too. The apartment was in a great location and walking distance to everything. I would definitely suggest staying here

Inconvenient, unhappy and uncomfortable probably won't do justice to my stay at Patricias. The internet was intermittent at best, the electricity went out one of the days and she even yelled at me when I was checking out. I would never recommend anyone stay with her in a vacation unless if you are one of those people who enjoys being on a strict schedule.

Patricia ci ha accolte nel suo carinissimo appartamento fornendoci tutte le indicazioni per vivere appieno Lisbona! l'appartamento è piccolo ma ha davvero tutto, sia per un week end sia per un soggiorno più lungo essendo dotato di ogni comfort.
La posizione è eccellente essendo a 3 minuti a piedi da Placa do Comercio e, pur essendo così centrale e su una via di forte passaggio, è molto silenzioso!!
Grazie Patricia ;)

L'appartement est idéalement situé en plein Baixa. Il est lumineux, rénové et suffisamment spacieux. Il y a du double vitrage récent donc pas de bruit (sauf vibrations du tram).
Patricia donne de très bons conseils dès notre arrivée et est disponible. Parfait pour visiter Lisbonne et être au centre des quartiers et proche des accès vers Belem, Sintra et Cascais.

La breve estancia en el apartamento de Patricia ha sido perfecta. Más de lo que esperaba. La descripción del apartamento en el anuncio era la correcta. Patricia había previsto leche, café, mantequilla y mermelada, aceite y vinagre, etc. Es decir aquellas cosas que agradeces nada más llegar. Además de mapas y explicaciones sobre Lisboa.
Me gustó mucho estar en el centro de la ciudad. Aunque un problemilla es el coche. Para futuros huéspedes les recomendaría el Parque de EMEL del Bairro Alto, en Calçada do Combro, 70 a 78 . Es cubierto y cuesta unos 13,50 € las 24 horas. Es el más económico de los cercanos. Se puede ir paseando desde el apartamento de Patricia.

Bu bizim airbnb ile ilk deneyimimiz ama çok şanslı olduğumuzu düşünüyorum,Patricia harika bir ev sahibi,bizi evde, hemen ihtiyacımız olabilecegini düşünerek elinde bir şişe su ile karşıladı. evi,çevresini ve yapabileceklerimiz konusunda bize çok açıklayıcı bilgiler verdi.çok güleryüzlü ve samimiydi. ev fotoğraflarda gördüğümüzden çok daha güzeldi. ve inanılmaz temizdi.Lizbona gidecek herkese hem lokasyonu hem de temizliği açısından önerebileceğimiz ev. Biz hem Patricianın sıcaklığı hem de evin temizliğinden çok mutlu olduk. Teşekkürler airbnb...

Perfect location.
Have everything !

Un séjour extraordinaire dans une ville magnifique! L'appartement est génial, fonctionnel, propre et surtout idéalement placé pour tout.
Merci Patricia et peut être à bientôt!

Patricia is a kind hostess. It is the second time I stayed in her flat and, as in the first one, she provided all the information and answered all my request soon.
The flat is very good and the neighborhood is fantastic and safe. It is possible to go to a lot of places on foot or by public transport.
I definitely recommend this flat for those looking for a conformable and well-located place from where to explore Lisbon.

Die Wohnung hatte eine super Lage, und es war alles da was man brauchte. Wir waren nur ein paar Tage in Lissabon, von diesem Ausgangspunkt konnten wir aber alles in kurzer Zeit erreichen.
Die Straßenbahn und die Busse fuhren direkt vor der Haustüre ab, klar leicht hört man sie dann auch Nachts, was uns aber nicht gestört hat.
Patrícia war sehr flexibel, auch was die Ankunfts- und Abfahrtszeiten an belangte und gab uns noch ein paar gute Tipps mit auf den Weg.
Vielen Dank, es war un wunderschönes Wochenende.
Amazingly located- and very cozy.we stayed a week and we found it perfect.
Very comfortable apt in a fantastic location.  Quiet at night which was a real plus for sleeping.  Clean and just as the photos show - very cute.  Highly recommend!
This studio was perfect for a short stay in lisbon i recommend it !

Thanks a lot Patricia fort these wonderful days in Lisboa =)
Thanks to your advice we did have a perfect time there, and enjoying discovering the city by foot as the location is just amazing !
I would definitely come again another time if it appears that i come back once more !
We are really grateful =)

I stayed in the apartment for one month(November) and had a great time. Patricia was very kind and gave me a range of good advises for my stay. The Baixa-Chiado is great area to stay especially for a first timer to Lisbon. Very central and safe.

The apartment was very clean, kitchen was well-equipped, never heard the neighbors and the A/C was nice in the beginning of November when the temperature was still high.

Some reviewers mention the noise of the street but I found it to be no problem. I did sleep with earplugs though. There's a supermarket quite close(Pingo Doce) and a laundromat - very practical.

All in all I highly recommend this apartment.

ottima accoglienza al nostro orario di arrivo serale  e massima disponibilità e cortesia di fornire prime informazioni su come muoversi e vivere  bene a Lisbona e dintorni . Guide e depliant disponibili in casa. L'appartamentino è fornito di tutto ciò che serve (anche area condizionata e wi-fi) ed è praticamente in centro a poche decine di metri dalle  fermate aereobus- bus-tram (28 e 12)  e pochissimi  minuti a piedi da  piazza Comercio, da Figueira, da Rossio (Treno x Sintra) e da Baixa (metrò). Terzo piano con ascensore. Chi non ha il sonno pesante qualche rumore dalla strada arriva....ma siamo in una città che vive. Consigliatissimo.

The apartment is located in central Lisbon and a perfect spot for exploring the city. Patricia met us when we arrived and provided us with information about the city which was very useful. The apartment is light, sunny and nicely decorated. It was also larger than we were expecting based on the photos and also as its a studio apartment. Patricia was a great host and accommodating as her next guests were checking in that night, allowed us a later check out which suited our schedule better. Overall we really enjoyed our stay!

Patricia's apartment is conveniently located close to the subway & in the center of town.  The apartment itself is clean & comfortable & is furnished just right for a short stay.  We were in Lisbon at end of October but had sort of a heatwave, so having the A/C was very nice after going around sightseeing.  We especially enjoyed the restaurant straight across the street.  It only does breakfast & lunch but is always full.

Absolutely charming studio flat in an amazing central location, perfect for our weekend stay. Patricia was very accommodating so check-in/check-out was a breeze. The flat was clean, cozy and a comfortable size for 2 adults. We are used to city living so the outside noise didn't bother us at all, but it may not be best for those expecting serene, quiet evenings.

Patricia was a great host. She was very welcoming and explain everything to us and assisted with where we wanted to go
The apartment was extremely comfortable and very well equipped with everything we needed. There was also a few supplies in the fridge and cupboard to start with
The apartment is in a great location and within walking distance to many sights
Highly recommend

O bairro é o melhor de Lisboa para um turista, perto de tudo e com ótimos transportes à porta. O estúdio tem tudo que um casal precisa para curtir as férias. É muito limpo e preparado para bem receber os convidados. A Patrícia se esmera como anfitriã.

Patricia was extremely punctual and very responsive from booking thru the end of the stay. She gave great tips on what to see around Lisbon and the best way to do so, as well getting to/from the airport. The apartment was very clean and perfectly located - easy to get to/from the airport as well as perfect location to explore the city. Great cafe across the street. Wine shops, supermarket, restaurants all conveniently located nearby. Highly recommend - I would stay here again.
Patricia was a lovely host and very accommadating. Her apartment was just as I expected and the trip could not have gone smoother.

Patricia was a great host. Her apartment was exceptionally clean & styled beautifully !

Thanx P !!!

R & K

Patricia hat uns sehr herzlich empfangen und uns ihr Appartement sogar schon vorab zum Gepäck abstellen zur Verfügung gestellt. Auch die Highlights ihrer Stadt hat sie uns näher gebracht. Ihr Appartement war super gepflegt und von der Lage hervorragend.

The appartment is perfectly located to visit Lisbon. It is very pretty and clean, with all the equipments one would need to feel at home !
Patricia is a lovely host, very welcoming and she provided good tips to enjoy our stay in the city.
Patricia's flat is perfectly located in the center of Lisbon. It was very clean, well furnished and really well decorated. We appreciated the A/C and would recommend it in the future !

It is a very lovely and cozy apartment. It's extremely well located in city center and has all facilities you need. Patricia is a great host, very nice and helpful. We really enjoyed our stay in this place and recommend the apartment to everyone who wants to spend some time in Lisbon.
Wonderful experience! I truly recommend Patricia's apartment. Clean, well and nicely furnished, excellent location. Patricia is a great host. Next time in Lisbon, I will certainly call her again.

Patricia was a great host. The place immaculate and had everything we needed. She have us great tips about Lisbon, and answered any questions we had.
Thank you Patricia for a wonderful stay!

Strongly recommended! It was really nice place, great location and super clean apartment. We loved it at first sight. Small wine bottles and breakfast stuff made us happy. The only negative about the apartment was the noise of the trams passing all the day, but it was really normal in the heart of the city. Thanks for everything Patrice!

It is one of the best appartements I have been in! Very clean, you have all the furniture you need, it has a perfect location and the host is very welcoming! There is just one weakness, the noise! We almost didn't sleep during our stay, but i really recommend that place, it was very nice to stay there.
Patricia gave me valuable tips about Lisbon. The apartment was as described, slightly noisy at night but very central, cute and tidy. I had a great stay!

My entire experience with Patricia and this property was perfect.   Communication was prompt, easy and accurate.  She let me store luggage before check-in and also took the time to give me a quick run down on the apartment and the area and make my dinner reservations for me in Portuguese.  Another great thing about Patricia is she is available if any questions or issues arise during your stay.  I am so glad I chose this apartment, not just for the reasons listed but also because the location was perfect.  You simply can't stay in a more central location !

This place is so nice! Patricia was very easy to communicate with prior to our trip, and provided excellent directions on how to locate the apartment. She was there waiting for us when we arrived, and she provided coffee and some complimentary drinks in the fridge.

The apartment itself is beautiful! You should stay here. Seriously, it is so cute that I can barely stand it. It is perfectly clean and very well maintained. The building was very quiet; I don't think we ever heard our neighbors. Plus, the location is absolutely perfect. It is like two blocks from the Praca do Comercio, and walking distance to the water, to the Castelo de Sao Jorge and the Lisbon Cathedral, as well as many restaurants and good shopping places. There is a fair amount of street noise as you should expect in such a location, but with the windows closed it is really not significant. Plus the very picturesque trams run right down your street! Also if it's a hot day, there is nice cold air-conditioning (always a plus!)

Thank you Patricia for letting us stay at your beautiful apartment! I hope we will come back soon!

This place is perfect! The location is the best thing. The apartment is clean and has everything you need. Its true, you can hear the tram line but we had ear-plugs and it didnt bother us. And the true is, if you want to stay in that location, a little street noise is the price you have to pay. But it is really not that bad. Air conditioner was working perfect, the shower is strong and warm. The bed wasnt perfect for me. Although I did sleep good, it wasnt 100% comfortable. But my boyfriend didnt have any complaints about the bed.
The one thing it was a little bit annoying was the construction in the apartment next door. Patricia tried her best and talked with the constructors, but still, there is nothing you can do. So they started hammering at 8-9 am till late in the night. But when we came home in the night and they saw us, they stopped working. Of course this has nothing to do with the host or apartment, but that is the risk you have with airbnb.
Patricia is a great host, she gave us 2 small bottles port wine as welcome, we had milk and coffee for each day of our stay and orange juice. She gave us a city-map and some recommendations.
The best thing was that she allowed us a late check-out without any extra charging.

We really enjoyed our stay in Lisbon. Patricia's apartment was centrally located to major sites and transportation. The apartment was easily accessible by airport shuttle (Aerobus). Nicely decorated, very clean, and the air conditioning was a plus!
We never met Patricia but communication was great and prompt, she even reserved a taxi for us for an early morning flight. 
At night, the street below was somewhat noisy as there was garbage collection, although it may have just been during the dates of our stay. 
We would definitely stay there again! Thank you, Patricia!

We had a great time in Patricia's house. The house is very nice and well located. She was an excellent host, very helpful and kind. She gave us great advice about Lisbon. Thanks Patricia for being such a nice host.

Patricia was a perfect host, the arrangements were clear and she was there to welcome us even though we arrived earlier than expected. The small apartment is ideal for a short break, great location and facilities. Even the little but essential things were there such as a hairdryer and a kettle.
Patricia made us feel particularly welcome with the little snacks and drinks and gave us good advice about what to see in Lisbon. I would recommend this to anyone looking for good value accommodation to see the city. Pastel de Nata available both cafes opposite the buidling - what more could you want.

Very nice appartment. We recommend Patricia's appartment for anyone visiting in Lisbon. The location is amazing and the appartment clean, cozy and well-equipped.
Tuomas&Eveliina

Nous avons passé quelques jours chez Patricia, dans cet appartement très propre et très bien situé.
Tout était très bien. Patricia est très accueillante, nous a attendu bien que notre vol ait eu du retard et avait même prévu un petit porto pour notre arrivée.
Seul petit bémol, l'appartement étant très central, il est un peu bruyant...

Un très bon séjour a Lisbonne. Malgré le retard de l'avion, Patricia nous a patiemment attendu a l'appartement pour nous y accueillir. Appartement très agréable (même si un peu bruyant) et surtout très bien situé!!
Nous recommendons a la fois l'appartement et l'hôte!!
Great place. Highly recommended.
The apartment is spotlessly clean, well set up and perfect for a couple. It couldn't be in a better location and I thouroughly recommend it. Obrigado!
The listing exceeded expectations, and Patricia was very helpful.  It was indeed sunny and central, and quite pleasant to stay in.

Patricia is the perfect host in a perfect apartment in a perfect location. She was very helpful by suggesting what to see and do, and what not to do. Most of Lisboa's top attractions are walking distance from the apartment, and the romantic electrico 28 passes right below the window.

Thank you Patricia, we will definitely be back.

Frank and Palma
May 2014.

Patricia was the most amazing host - she gave us recommendations of where to go and what to do, as well as how to get there. We loved the apartment, the location is incredible (as central as it gets). It has everything you need. We will definitely be back, and will certainly stay with Patricia! Thank you!

Excepcional ubicación y apartamento pequeño pero muy agradable y con todas las comodidades. Situado a un paso de todo y con los principales medios de transporte a mano.
Imposible aparcar aunque la ayuda de Patricia fue inestimable así como sus detalles haciendo la vida más fácil en la llegada.
En el caso de que te molesten mucho los ruidos para dormir, que no es mi caso, la calle es bulliciosa y el tráfico constante

Apartment is clean and enough for 1-2 people maximum.  Right in the heart of downtown Lisbon, this was a very convenient location.  Patricia was a good host and informative.  Broken elevator was a bummer, as you must climb about 4 flights of narrow stairs to get to the apartment..a problem if you are not fit and strong to lift heavy luggage...but luckily I was! Thanks for the wonderful stay!

Really nice studio apartment, very clean, well equipped and nicely decorated. Downtown central location, most things are at walking distance. Patricia is a friendly host. On arrival you are welcomed with water, coffee, tea and even wine! I would not hesitate to recommend it. Thank you Patricia

We had a really nice stay at Patricia's place ! The appartment is very well located, next to everything you have to see and even if your stay is rainy, it's very pleasant to be in this cosy and useful flat ! Patricia is a very welcoming host and had very good advice for your trip. We warmly recommand you this flat !

El apartamento está en una ubicación excepcional. Todo queda cerca y es perfecto para disfrutar de Lisboa. Es un apartamento muy limpio y cómodo porque dispone de todo lo necesario para la cocina y el baño, incluso secador para el pelo. Se escucha un poco de tráfico pero es normal ya que está en pleno centro y pasa por delante el tranvía 28, pero no es algo que moleste mucho (por lo menos con la ventana cerrada). Mi novio se quejaba de que la cama no le resultaba cómoda porque es blanda y se curva un poco en el centro, pero yo dormí de maravilla, no tengo ninguna queja.

Patricia es muy buena anfitriona, te ayuda desde el primer momento y es muy atenta a las preguntas. Nos dejó un mapa de Lisboa y nos hizo unas cuantas recomendaciones. Otra cosa a favor es que se adapta a los horarios con flexibilidad y te deja cosas básicas como té, café, zumos y algunas cosas más que vienen muy bien. Si volviese a Lisboa repetiría. Lo recomiendo 100%

Patricia was a very helpful host, arranged a suitable check in time and also let us stay on for a late check out. Flat was in a very central location, clean, tidy and plenty big enough for the 2 of us.
Only comments to people would be it is quite noisy - but this is to be expected for the location (not really a negative) and the bed/pillows were not the most comfortable, very minor and did not impact our overall expereince! I would recomend this flat to anyone that was looking for a nice sunny central flat to explore all the sights of Lisbon. Thanks very much!
Really clean flat, cosy and in a super central location. Being on a main street is not super quite, mainly because of the trams passing by. Everything else was perfect.

Patricia was very helpful
We had a late arrival at around 11pm but that was no problem for her
Before we arrived she showed us many different ways to get to the city, so it was very easy to find the apartment
Once we asked some tourist stuff for the Lisbon oceanario and she called oceanario for us
Thanks again
The apartment is in the best area, near to the river, to the shopping area and perfect for bars and transfer to the airport
In the apartment we found all that we needed, had a small kitchen, a warm shower and a comfortable bed and fast Wifi
All together we can recommend Patricia and here apartment a 100%
I hope that we can come and stay in her apartment again.
Many thanks

Nuestra estancia en el apartamento de Patrícia fue estupenda. Céntrico, cómodo, limpio, práctico y con flexibilidad de horarios de entrada y salida. Patrícia fue muy buena anfitriona, amable y detallista.
A tener en cuenta los contras de alojarse en una calle céntrica en cuanto a ruido del exterior.
Gracias Patrícia!

This is a nice studio apartment right in the center of Lisbon and everything is at walking distance. Patricia is a very friendly host that told us some great tips about where to go and what to eat. We had a really good time here. Thanks

El apartamento fue ideal para nuestro viaje, mejor que estar en una habitación de un buen hotel. La ubicación es ideal cerca de lo más atractivo de Lisboa.  Tiene una cocina muy bien integrada en el ambiente y durante cinco días pudimos desayunar y algún día cenar en el apartamento, muy confortable.

We cannot say enough wonderful things about Patricia and her beautiful apartment! She is a lovely host and takes an immense pride in making her guests feel at home and maintaining the quality of her place. The apartment is immaculately clean, very tastefully decorated, has a comfortable bed, fantastic kitchen and nice bathroom, and if you lean out of the window, a great view of Rua da Conceiçao and the tram line :) The location is superb and you cannot be more central than this. With that said, the street noise didn't bother us at all. There is also a great choice of bakeries, cafes, restaurants and shops within a few blocks of the apartment, so there is plenty to explore in that area. We were very sad to leave and hope to be back soon. Thank you, Patricia!

A estadia foi maravilhosa! O apartamento é muito aconchegante, organizadíssimo, confortável, bonito, novinho e muito central (inclusive o ônibus que leva ao aeroporto passa do lado do apartamento)!

A Patrícia é muito legal, zelosa, organizada e objetiva. É um prazer lidar com gente assim!
J'ai adoré Lisboa, L’appartement est parfait, bien situé et Patricia adorable. Merci !

The flat is in an excellent location. I was able get to all the places I wanted to visit with no problem. There are grocery stores close by and even health food stores about ten blocks away. The flat was very clean, sunny, nice bathroom, comfortable bed, and a fully equipped kitchen. It was nicely decorated with taste. The owner has made some changes and the flat looks better than in the photo.
I strongly recommend this place for a maximum of three people. A couple and a child or less.

Patricia was very nice and gave us very good advice on where to visit on our trip. The apartment was very well-furnished, extremely clean, and at a fantastic location. There is some noise at night from the street but not too much that it affected my sleep (only noticed before falling asleep). Would definitely stay here again!

Appartement très bien situé, entre la Place du Commerce et Restauradores.... Vraiment bien pour un premier contact avec Lisbonne où vous pourrez vous rendre à pied aux principaux points d'intérêt... Sinon, petit studio très propre, avec cafetière Nespresso, donc rien à redire. Patricia a été très réactive (réservation la veille avant de repasser sur Lisbonne).

When we arrived Patricia were waiting for us for showing us the apartment and all the things we may have needed.
The apartment is nicely fitted with Ikea style objects and furniture and the location is wonderful: very near to city center and all tourists attractions while remaining quiet.
Patricia has been very kind by reserving a taxi to take us to the airport the last day.

Our stay at Pat's flat was very pleasant, it is extremely centered, trams and shuttles bus from/to the airport is across the street, the flat is very clean, equipped as described (bring shampoo with u), the bed is very comfortable and just in front of the house there is a tiny restaurant where local people r eating their which is unexpensive and very good food. The neighborhood is safe. We have just two remarks: 1. Pat didn't tell us that there are like 20 steps until u reach the elevator; 2. There is noices at night from the tram. Overall we like our stay and we recommend it 2 u all.
The host is a very nice women, speaks good English and is very helpfull. We had some problems with our laptop and we couldn't communicate to her WiFi so she called her husband and through the phone she&him fixed the problem. She gaves us some very good tips and the local restaurant's recommendation.

This appartement is very central, very good location.
All was very clean.
Patricia let us a welcome food pack with water, coffee and orange juice!!
She ´ s a great host.... Very Nice and comprehensive with a late arrival and a one days more...
You must try the typical pasteleria just across the street....

We had a pleasant stay in the appartement. It was al very clean, and the location was perfect, just in the citycenter. The owner was very helpfull, and did her best to inform us about the city.
It was a little small, but big enough for three of us.

Minhas férias em Lisboa ficaram ainda melhor no apartamento que aluguei com a Patricia Palma. Bem localizado, arrumado, equipado e com todas as facilidades que um casal precisa para aproveitar o melhor de Lisboa. Além disso, Patricia foi generosa e cuidadosa na recepção, na nossa chegada a Lisboa. Recomendo muito.
Great location, very clean and nice flat !

We had a trip in Lisbon for a week and stayed at Patricia's.
The place was perfectly located, furnished and served perfectly the purpose of our trip.
Everything that you may need should be there:
Price, location, cleanliness, quality furnitures and warm welcome.

My stay at Patricia's apartment was absolutely superb! The place was immaculate, its location could not be better (close to public transportation and easy to get to and from airport).
Patricia met me at the apartment and provided me with helpful information about the area.
Do try the Pasteis de Belem if you stay in Lisbon....but if you don't make it to Belem..go to to pastry/coffee shop around the corner from Patricia's apartment..they are just as good....and Patricia, I had 5 Pasteis de Belem!
Thanks so much for a wonderful stay!
Eduado
Chicago, IL

Patricia's studio apartment in Lisbon was fantastic. The location is amazing walking distance to all the local attractions. There was also a very nice pastry shop just across the street which was very dangerous. The flat is fantastic with wifi, a nice comfy bed, separate shower and bathroom and a nice little kitchen area.
Thank you so much for letting me stay in your lovely place, I will defiantly stay again if I am back in Lisbon.

The stay has been very good.
Patricia have a beautiful apartment with all details.
Thanks for all!

Hi, the very best of this apartment is that it has a very good location...it's perfect for two but we were three and the space was ok. We found everything you might need in the kitchen and Patricia was very kind and friendly.
I strongly recommend it.

Nuria (August 2013)

Patricia place was a great apartment for 2 in the heart of Lisbon. Can't recommend her apartment enough. Everything was clean and tidy and the apartment had all the amenities you could need for a short or long stay. Even a nice welcome drink of Port for your stay, thanks Patricia!

The apartment is really nice, very clean and well equipped, (dishes, towels, sheets, hair dryer, ...) and very central. the famous tram 18, metro, busses, the coast, several shops, restaurants are just some steps away. due to the location, its a bit loud, but i guess lisboa never sleeps! ;)

patricia herself was on holidays when we stayed in lisboa. but we were warmly welcomed by a friend of her and some lovely gifts in the fridge. (fresh bread and fruits, juice, milk, portwine ...)

so: all thumbs up - highly recommended!

Cet appartement est idéal pour passer un court ou long séjour à Lisbonne (j'y ai passé plus de quatre semaines et y retournerais sans hésiter). Patricia est une hôte sympathique et efficace. Tout dans l'appartement est fonctionnel, les armoires de cuisine sont bien garnies, etc.  L'appartement est fort confortable, aéré, très propre et est encore plus beau que sur les photos.  Situé dans la Baixa, le cœur du centre historique de la ville: un très beau site archéologique situé dans les soubassements d'une banque de la rue voisine révèle les vestiges romains et pré-romains de la ville datant du 5e siècle avant J.C. ! À deux pas de la Place du Commerce (qui borde le Tage) et à trois minustes de marche du Rossio (place centrale), cet appartement permet à son occupant de rayonner facilement vers l'est: Alfama est à 5 minutes à pied, le quartier du Castelo, 7 m., la Mouraria, 7 m., et Graça, 10 m.; ou vers l'ouest: le Chiado à  5 m., la Bica, à 7 m., et le Bairro Alto, à 7 m. Pour le reste, il y a trois stations de métro à deux pas, des eléctricos qui passent devant la porte ! et les traversiers pour Cacilhias au Cais do Sodré à 7 minutes de marche. Mon enthousiasme n'est pas feint, louez cet petit studio sans hésiter.
Perfect! Great place, great service.

I stayed in Patricia's apartment for 5 nights with two other friends and we highly recommend this apartment to anyone staying in Lisbon.
Very clean apartment with everything you need. It's in a great location with transport walking distance from the apartment - 2 train stations, trams and buses.
Patricia is a great host. She met us at the apartment and gave us a brief intro to Lisbon and recommended places to go to. She is also very quick to respond if you need anything.
I would highly recommend this apartment to anyone staying in Lisbon.

Exceptional apartment and host! The apartment was in an ideal location - convenient for sightseeing, buses, 2 train stations for side trips, and nightlife. It was very clean, and had everything we needed (and more), bedding, soap, dishes, hairdryer, iron.

Patricia was very easy to communicate with, quick to respond. She met us when we arrived at the apartment. She even left us some fresh bread, fruit, milk for coffee and some local Porto wine. She really went above and beyond to help us enjoy our stay.

Highly recommended!

Very nice flat. Everything you need is ready for you when you arrive. Great location. A 20 min metro ride from the airport or a 9 Euro cab ride. 3 blocks from the coast. You can walk to everything you would want to see in Lisbon within 15 minutes. Many stores, grocery stores and restaurants are within 5 minutes or directly across the street.

My mom and I stayed in Patricias appartment for four nights,and had a wonderful time. The appartment is light and well equipped. It is located right in the centre, which means you are in walking distance to lots of the main attractions and to areas with nice restaurants (like Chiado and Alfama). If you are not in the mood for walking, the famous tram 28 is also right on your doorstep. Patricia is a wonderful host who made us feel very welcome, and she could be reached at all times if we had any problems or questions. This appartment was perfect for us, and I would recommend it at any time!
Fantastic place as a frequent business traveler to stay right in the heart of the city close to all sights - thumbs up and highly recommended!

L’appartement est très bien, agréable, lumineux et très propre. Il est par ailleurs vraiment central (Baixa), ce qui a été pour moi très pratique durant ma semaine, pour rentrer m'y poser, et repartir.
En outre, plein de petites attentions vous attendent à votre arrivée (qui sont encore plus agréables quand vous arrivez un dimanche soir...).
J’ai passé une excellente semaine à Lisbonne, et mon bien-être dans cet appartement y a contribué.
Le seul inconvénient est que sa centralité s’accompagne d’une proximité avec les voies de circulation. Personnellement, ça ne m’a pas eu d’incidence sur mon sommeil (j’ai très bien dormi).

My boyfriend and I stayed for a week in Patricia's lovely flat this January. It's the first time we rent a flat instead of going to a hotel and it was really experience! Everything was very clean, great location and she even left some treats for us the day we arrive. I totally recommend it! Thnxs Patricia.

My wife and I had a great stay at Patricia's perfect studio apartment in Lisbon. The location could not have been more perfect and the apartment itself gave us a great home base for our few days in town. Highly, highly recommended!

Lisbon is wonderful place to visit and Patricia's flat was perfect for my stay. I spent 4 December days in Lisbon, Patricia was warm and welcoming host, flat was comfy for me, very central (thus might be a bit too noisy street for sound-sensitive persons but I only enjoyed the advantage of being in very central location), flat has all that one can need - equipped kitchen, bathroom, wifi etc. Waterfront is only 5 min walk from the flat - it is nice to begin and/or and the day there, lovely conditory just in front of the house, touristic tram 28 - at front doors, bus from/to airport - just around the corner etc etc.
Highly recommendable experience!

This was my first airbnb experience and Patricia has set the bar very high. Very convenient location, able to get to it easily from the Terreiro do Paco metro and then hub in and out for visits to the Lisbao Castle, fado, Sintra, Cascais, more. Newly renovated so it is clean and attractive. These items alone would earn the five stars. But Patricia adds so much more. She provided treats for us upon arrival, had the apartment stocked with travel materials, offered interesting suggestions for our visit, and responded immediately to all of our communications (in excellent English). When we needed more time she was very accommodating. I feel like I've made a new friend!

Hello! My friend and I stay for a weekend at Patricia´s place and it was perfect! is a small private apartment very well located! She was very nice and put many things to have for breakfast! I recommend you this place!!

Our stay in Lisboa was great! We enjoyed the city and really appreciated to stay at Patricia's apartment. It's so lovely and convenient!
We were there with our 1-year-old baby and Patricia prepared many things for him: little baby bed, baby chair, baby bath, a baby night light, sweet baby towels and bed-linen, little toys... lovely things you didn't think of!
The apartment is perfect situated and perfect arranged. We did not miss anything!
We recommend!

Nous recommandons l'appart de Patricia: super bien situé et tellement mignon! Nous étions à Lisbonne pour quelques jours avec notre bébé d'un an. Patricia a tout prévu pour lui: lit, chaise, baignoire, jolies serviettes de bain, etc.

We empfehlen Patricias Apartment. Die Lage ist perfekt und Patricia eine super Gastgeberin! Sie hatte alles für unser 1-jähriges Baby vorbereitet.

Thank you very much Patricia, we had a lovely time at your place. The appartment is cosy, nicely furnished and very clean. We felt really at home and welcomed by you. Even our late arrival was no problem. We can absolutely recommend the place for a trip to Lisbon.
The apartment is very comfy, clean and central. I already suggested it to some of my friends who want to visit Lisbon!
Great host, great location and great hospitality. The only thing missing was a washing machine but the host offered us a couple of towels for the week. Thanks very much and we will surely return!

The place is small, but cozy and sweet - right in the center of Lisbon. It is equiped with everything that you need for a stay - even coffee, tea, basics of food... I had such a great time there! Patricia was very friendly and helpful, everything worked out perfectly. I would like to come back one day!

My stay at Patricia's apartment in Lisbon was perfect. The apartment itself is gorgeous and it has everything you need, whether you're staying for a few days, or for a longer period of time, the apartment immediately feels like home. We couldn't have asked for a better location. Patricia is a great host, she was very helpful and kind. We really appreciated the little treats she left for us upon our arrival.

People have made comments regarding the street noise. It is not at all excessive, and being a light sleeper myself, I was fine with my earplugs. I slept great, especially after a long day exploring the city.
Book this place if you want a lovely stay in the heart of a beautiful and vibrant city. I can't wait to come back!

My stay at Patricia's apartment was perfect. The location is right in the thick of the city, and the connections to transport are all right at your fingertips. The apartment is immaculate and comfortable, and Patricia is extremely helpful and lovely. I highly recommend staying here, just bring earplugs if you're a light sleeper, as the tram runs right outside! (not too noisy, but if you're not used to it, it might be)
Thanks Patricia for a wonderful stay!

Très bel appart, très propre. Proprio gentille, nous accueille avec des fruits, du pain, café dispo, génial!  Seul hic, le bruit. Mal insonorisé et le tramway passe directement sur la rue jusqu'aux petites heures... avis a ceux qui ont le sommeil léger!

To be honest, there is no better place to live while in Lisbon. Everything is close and you can feel the vibe of the city. Apartment itself is as nice as you can see on the pictures - tidy and comfortable. Patricia was very kind and always helpful host. Tip: if the wi-fi is not working, use the local community net.

Great location and lovely space to sleep in and rest and hang out in for a break from the streets. Patricia is a fabulous host and has good tips. The little cafe across the road which she suggested is a bit of a treasure. I felt at home. Obrigada!

It was a really nice stay at patricias place. the apartment is perfect.
it is nicely furnished, good located and patricia is awesome.
you can call her anytime, if you have a problem and she will help you
right away.

we enjoyed the stay and will definitely come back.
Patricia was very nice and helpful. Her apartment ist located right in the centre of Lisbon - which was perfect for our sightseeing through the city. Everything was nice and clean. Thank you so much!

First to say that Lisbon is an amazing city, and this lovely apartment is in the heart of the downtown. You cannot have a better location if you want to roam around Lisbon. The famous tram 28 goes through the street, and it stops just few steps from the building (the trams are very old, so they can be a bit noisy).
The apartment itself is just perfect. It even looks better than in the photos. You have everything that you can possibly need, free WiFi, Nespresso machine, fridge filled with refreshments, great rocking chair and a walk-in closet.
Patricia is a great host. She waited for us and she was perfectly ok with our late arrival due to a late flight. She showed us everything around the apartment, gave us the map and some suggestions what to do/see. She even bought us some pastry and fruit, because everything was closed when we arrived.
We loved the apartment and the city. Everything was just great.
We would recommend it to anyone (especially to the couples), and we would definitely go back.
Dušan and Tamara
I really enjoyed my stay in Patricias appartment. It was really nice, clean and central. I also got food when I arrived! If I go back to Lisbon I would love to rent the appartment again.

The apartment was nice and very clean. Rita prepare for us also some food and drinks for the first time.
It's cenral and also very noisy.
Rita put us also an aditional bed at disposal. The couch for two persons is not so advisable.
Just the internet didn't work . In Portugal it's still quite difficult to find free WiFi in the city.
We would go there again:))

This is a beautiful, and amazingly clean apartment in a lovely old building. The location is super central--great for travelers who want to see a lot of the city and have a good home base. Patricia was a wonderful host and provided us with lots of great information and resources. The absolute only negative thing is that the street noise at night is quite loud (and this from a former New York City-dweller), due to the trams rattling by and echoing off the buildings. Bring earplugs, and you'll be set.

It was great! the location of the Patricia's papartment is fantastic-very central! The apartment is very clean and cozy and has absolutely everything you need, even more (Nespresso coffee machine for example :))
Patricia is very sweet and helpful person. If and when i am in Lisbon again i will definitely stay in this apartment again.
Recibimiento acagedor, piso pequeño pero muy céntrico, confortable, y limpio. Patricia nos habia dejado café, pan y fruta y fue muy agradable con nosotras.

Great location and convenient to all the hot spots downtown and to transport to other areas in Lisbon. Patricia was a perfect host and even started us off with some fresh bread and snacks when we arrived.

Apartment was beautiful, well equipped (hooray for the espresso machine!), and had everything we needed.

Thanks for everything Patricia, highly recommended!

This hyperequipped apartment is perfect for a short stay in Lisbon. It is centric, a few metres from the Airport bus stop and metro station and with most touristic attractions nearby. Patricia was a very kind host, providing with fruit and all the necessary for breakfast. This was a very positive experience, very reccomendable.

Right place in the very center of Lisbon.
If you do not bother yourself because of city noise - look no further!

I had 4 wonderful days in lissabon.
This apartment was very nice , central and very clean.
Everything worked out really well. ! Thanks !!

Recomiendo totalmente este apartamento. Es ideal para visitar Lisboa, esta muy bien situado y muy bien comunicado, desde la puerta de la casa se coge el tranvia y el bus, tambien el aerobus que lleva al aeropuerto. El metro tambien está muy cerca, a menos de 5' a pie.
El apartamento tiene todas las comodidades, esta totalmente reformado y nuevo, en la cocina incluso hay cosas sin estrenar.
Patricia es muy buena anfitriona, nos dejó incluso cosas para poder desayunar al dia siguiente, fue un buen detalle por su parte.
La unica pega es que al estar en el centro hay ruido en la calle, pero eso es algo inevitable dado su localizacion, pero por la noche se puede dormir.
Si volviese a Lisboa repetiria. 100% recomendable.

Patricia was most welcoming and helpful. Her apartment is located in a great spot with transportation at your door front.
The flat is impeccable, clean and comfortable and very well equipped for vacationers.
Thank you Patricia for a nice experience!

Patrícia has the cutest apartment! Everything is SO clean, this is the first apartment that I stayed at that I didn't feel the need for shower sandals or indoor slippers :)

If she isn't already she should become an interior designer. Her place had the cutest details! Nespresso machine was a great bonus as well!

I definitely recommend her apartment - Lisbon was a great city, so if and when I return I am definitely contacting Patrícia again.

We had a great time staying in Patricia's apartment, and I would recommend it to any prospective visitors. The location is very central, and a short walk from the nearest Metro station; the apartment itself is great, with plenty of space and light, and is equipped with everything you could need (aside from a washer/dryer), and is very tastefully designed. We had some problems accessing the WiFi, as Patricia had noted with previous guests, but it didn't cause any major problems as there is an unsecured network that reaches the apartment in any case. All in all, a very nice stay, and we wouldn't hesitate to visit again. Thanks Patricia!

First off, Patricia is a fantastic host: friendly, helpful, quick to respond to messages… everything you could ask for. The apartment is clean , comfortable and fantastically located, with trams and cabs available right out the front door, tons of restaurants nearby and a grocery store right around the corner. The central location means there's some noise at night, but I had no trouble sleeping.
