Oh, and Patricia provided coffee (by way of a Nespresso machine) and some basic groceries (break, milk, fruit). Great host!

The apartment is very much in the centre of the turistic areas with excellent public transport links. One of the most popular tram routes to take in the city passes by straight out the front. The airport bus stops literally around the corner, and the nearest metro station is only a 5min walk away. But in case you still don't know what you're doing, don't worry as easy going Patricia goes out of her way to assist you with tourist information including how to get around.

The apartment itself is quaint but well laid out - three of us managed to live there comfortably for four nights. In fact this might sound strange but the best aspect of Patricia's apartment is her thoughtful selection of objects and supplies! The Nespresso machine complete with pods got a good work out while we were there, and I think we managed to consume almost all the nibblies and drinks Patricia left for us. Better still, all the normal things you take for granted like salt and oil, multiple hand towels, sharp knives etc that most hosts renting out their entire apartment forget about, were all there in full force.

The only things to note when considering staying here would be the stairs and noise (however we didn't find either of these a problem). As the elevator does not start until the first floor so if you can't walk one flight of stairs this might be a bit difficult. Also as it is right in the centre of town, particularly a touristic area of course it is inevitable that there will occasionally be people wandering around making noise late at night. However as noted above, we didn't find either of these to be a problem, and in fact found the apartment to be great value for money with Patricia being an excellent and thoughtful host.

We had an awesome days in Lisbon- lovely accommodations, best place to stay!!!...sunny, clean, slept like a baby. ... Feel the city from the window!!..Patricia is a fabulous host, overall could not ask for a better experience. We will be back!
Patricia is really kind and truly cares for her guests. The apartment is very cozy and nice, near to the best places of Lisbon.

My Boyfriend and I had a great time at Patricia's place! The flat is perfect for 2 people. Really Cute, perfectly clean and very well furnished. We had everything we could need. Besides, it is in the perfect location, right in the centre of the town. Patricia has been very nice with us and provided us with plenty of maps and advices to visit the place. She even left some bread, butter, jam and fruits for us for the breakfast. Thank you Patricia! We would définitely choose your place again if we come back to Lisboa!

Estoy muy feliz por haber elegido este alojamiento en Lisboa.Sin duda, lo mejor. Patricia me respondió a todas mis dudas muy amablemente. No tuve la suerte de conocerla en persona, pero sí a sus suegros que me parecieron unas magníficas personas. Ellos nos recibieron incluso más temprano de la hora acordada porque nuestro transporte llegó antes de tiempo. Tenían preparado todo al detalle, pan, zumos, mantequilla, mermelada,agua... muchas gracias!! y estuvieron un buen rato con nosotros hablandonos de Lisboa y oriéntandonos sobre sitios importantes para visitar.
En cuanto al apartamento, simplemente perfecto!! SOLEADO y PRECIOSO, con toda la cocina completa, y detalles de la decoración que hicieron nuestra estancia una total comodidad! incluso máquina de café Nesspreso a nuestra disposición. mucha luz natural y muchas lámparas para relajarse. Además Patricia había preparado multitud de mapas y folletos turísticos de Lisboa.
La cama grande muy amplia y cómoda, y la pequeña también muy cómoda. Internet, tv, radio...genial!!
Todo muy limpio, ordenado y con un gran espacio para colocar las cosas. No tuvimos ningún problema, estaba todo muy bien preparado y pensado para los huéspedes.
En cuanto a la ubicación, sin duda, la mejor, una magnífica zona, con todos los transportes posibles cerca. El tranvia 28 en la misma calle, oficinas de turismo, minisupermercados a muy buen precio, tiendas de todo tipo, etc muy segura y tranquila por la noche, por lo que descansábamos muy bien despues de hacer turismo. Y si quiere coger un taxi para salir por la noche, por la puerta pasaban muchos fuera la hora que fuera.
Muchas gracias por todo, a Patricia, a Coralia y a su marido. Esperamos volver pronto, mis tias y yo estuvimos como en casa y felices de haber conocido Lisboa tan confortable.
Es una suerte y un orgullo encontrarse personas así.

Creo que no podríamos haber elegido un mejor lugar para hospedarnos en Lisboa, simplemente prefecto!!!! Lamentablemente no pudimos conocer a Patricia personalmente, pero su amiga Rita nos recibió muy amablemente y nos brindó toda la información que necesitamos para nuestra estadía!! A su vez quiero destacar la hospitalidad ya que tenían preparado para recibirnos pan, leche, jugos, mantequilla, mermelada,agua...y una cafetera nesspreso (mi novio estuvo muy agradecido jaja) !!  A  su vez Patricia había preparado una cantidad de mapas y folletos turísticos de Lisboa los cuales fueron de mucha utilidad. La ubicación es excelente, a pasos caminando de las principales atracciones y es muy segura para andar caminando de noche. El departamento super limpio y con todos los detalles para hacer la estadía de lo más agradable! La única desventaja que encontramos de Lisboa es que el parking es carisimo por esa zona (42 euros/noche) y no hay lugar para dejarlo en la calle, pero si se alejan un poquito pueden encontrar mejor precio. Sin dudas si volvemos a Lisboa nos hospedaremos en el departamento de Patricia y lo recomendaré a todos mis amigos!!

Patricia's place is in the perfect location!  It's right downtown on the 28 (touristy trolly car) and near all the walking destinations of DT Lisbon.  The  studio was great for what I needed and Patricia even brought some fresh bread and marmalade to share with me upon arrival. The building even had a lift! I would definitely go back.  She's a wonderful host and you will not be disappointed!
Patricia was a lovely host and the apartment is absolutely beautiful. It is also very conveniently located and well connected. I will definitely want to stay here again the next time I am in Lisbon!

A apartamento é exatamente como nas fotos. Localização incrível, ao lado do time out literalmente. O  espaço é amplo, banheiro espaçoso, cozinha pequenas, mas extremamente funcional com todos os utensílios necessários para fazer refeições em casa. Tinha café, açúcar,  assim como temperos e várias coisas. Ling nos permitiu entrar antes do horário. Recomento demais o espaço, podem fechar sem medo.
Localização perfeita.

A nossa estadia em Lisboa foi excelente! O apartamento da Ling tem um ótimo aspecto de novo e estava impecavelmente limpo em todos os ambientes. Destaco especialmente as roupas de cama e o banheiro, que é super bonito e bem cuidado. A localização é fantástica, o que tornou a nossa chegada e o processo de entrada muito fáceis e práticos. Além disso, a Ling foi uma anfitriã extremamente atenciosa. Recomendo totalmente!
ling的房屋令人非常满意，整洁宽敞，住宿体验舒适，不行就可以抵达里斯本广场，对面是网红time out market，自驾的话停在对面停车场30欧一天。
Tudo ótimo!!

우선 보안이 정말 철저한 장소입니다. 3인이다보니 호텔을 잡기 어려워 유럽에서 계속 불안한 마음을 가지고 숙소를 이용했는데요, 여기는 로비에 경비도 항상 계시고 보안도 철저하게 들어가서 너무 마음이 편했어요. 숙소도 넓고 청결하며 따뜻한 물도 너무나도 잘나옵니다. 유럽 마지막 도시였는데 가장 마음 편하게 머문 곳입니다. 바로앞에 타임아웃마켓 있구요, 푸니쿨라 명소도 계단 올라가면 바로에요~! 시내라고 부를 수 잇는 코메르시우 광장쪽은 걸어서 10~15분정도인데 이정도는 리스본에서 걸을만 하다고 봅니다. 리스보아카드하시면 버스 이용하셔도 되구요. 너무나도 추천합니다!!

The apartment’s location was excellent—very close to the Time Out Market and the river. Ling was very responsive and supportive throughout our stay. The apartment had all the amenities we needed for our trip to Lisbon, and the sofa was super comfortable. We highly recommend Ling and his apartment to anyone visiting Lisbon.
Tudo muito perfeito... recomendo.
We enjoyed the apartment. The location was great and Ling was a very great communicator. Thank you!
Very nice apartment. very nice location to walk to the downtown attractions. If you have a rental car you need to be aware of $35 charges per day for the parking.
King’s place was perfect for our last night in Lisbon before catching our flight. Great area, beautiful building, big open floor plan and comfortable beds.
Ling’s apartment is very pretty. We love it so much! Ling is very friendly and helpful. Many thanks to Ling for agree us to put our luggage in the apartment first before check in.
na
Amazing person so nice to deal with her.

We loved our stay at Ling’s place! It’s a great location a few minutes walk from everything you need. The check-in process was easy, directions were clear, and my friends and I felt very safe and comfortable. There is a doorman at the lobby and you have to swipe your key to get on the elevator and the hallway. The place is clean and felt like a sanctuary to return to every night. Ling is a wonderful host and let us check in early, and was very responsive throughout. We highly recommend staying here! In fact, we’re coming back for our second stay :)

Overall a great stay. EZ to find, EZ to enter, unit, great location to walk around nearby attractions. Loved Time Out - food hall across street that has 50 options of chef prepared variety of foods. Grocery within 5 minute walk. Italian downstairs, pizza within 7 min walk, Schwarma within 5 min. Plenty of food options.
1. All ABB bdg. 50 units w Lifts. Unit on 1st floor.
2. Unit updated and clean. Everything U need - even sunscreen lol! Host left 5 bottles of water which as a traveler is always appreciated!
3. Ling stored our luggage starting 9am so we can explore while we wait for the unit to be ready - greatly appreciated!
4. Only con is that the building is a U shape with center a common area. Around 2am, there were some shouting and youth smoking and chatting about so their voices echo due to the shape of bldg. Not to offset any of the pros above, but be aware of potential noise if light sleeper.
Overall great stay and I would definitely stay again and great Host!
Loved it. Great location. Close to restaurants and transportation.
O apartamento é incrível! Localizado em um ótimo lugar de Lisboa, as camas são ótimas, o ar condicionado, tem tudo para uma ótima estadia e a Ling sempre atendia com rapidez!

Notre nuit chez Ling s’est très bien passé. L’appartement disposait de tout ce dont nous pouvions avoir besoin, on se sent vraiment comme à la maison ! La communication était parfaite et Ling est très sympathique. Le seul petit bémol, les chambres donnent sur une cour qui peut être un peu bruyante à l’heure du repas le soir mais pendant la nuit c’est plutôt calme.
Contrairement à ça, l’emplacement est idéal pour visiter le centre ville à pied !
On reviendrai avec plaisir ☺️
Our time in this beautiful Lisbon condominium was truly exceptional, and we owe a massive thank you to our host, Ling. We were so impressed and grateful for her hospitality from start to finish.

Sehr saubere Wohnung in zentraler, lebhafter Lage. Parken und einchecken war dank der Hinweise von Ling problemlos. Fenster gehen zum Hinterhof, der deutlich ruhiger als das belebte Viertel ist. Sehr bequeme Betten. Rooftop Bar im Haus.

Ótimo apartamento e excelente localização. Limpeza impecavel, espaço enorme e bem equipado. Perto da estação Cais do Sodré, de excelentes restaurantes e do famoso Time Out Market. A comunicação com o anfitrião também foi fácil e rápida. Super recomendo!

5 of us (3 adults, 2 kids) stayed at Ling’s apartment. The apartment was well located and within easy walking distance into central Lisbon. It was well connected in terms of transport. There were lots of food options nearby. We went to Sangine’s one evening for churros and ice cream - would definitely recommend. Ling was very helpful and friendly, good place!

Great communication. Very good location. Spacious and well equipped. Kitchen worktop space very limited, wouldn’t be suitable for comprehensive meal preparation. The only meals we prepared was breakfast. Beds were comfortable and the shower was very effective. Always plenty of hot water. Windows face onto a courtyard restaurant, limited natural light coming into the apartment. Noise from the restaurant could be intrusive on some nights be never went beyond midnight.
Great place to stay. Thank you Ling for a great hospitality. Definitely a good choice whenever in Lisbon.
Excelente anfitrião! Super atencioso, excelente apartamento em ótima localização
Gute Wohnung in einem phantastischen Haus. Eine ganz zentrale Lage. Etliche Restaurants, Bars und der Time-Out-Markt in direkter Umgebung.

Ling is great and very quick to respond to messages. Her apartment is exactly how it is on the pictures and perfectly situated with everything close by.
We would highly recommend anyone considering staying at Ling’s apartment.

The location of the condo could not have been better. Easy reach to everything. Walking distance to most everything and a very easy Uber to everything else.  The beds were very comfortable and the condo was surprisingly quiet.  Very spacious.

The location is fantastic — just a short walk from the Time Out Market and Pink Street! The building has a beautiful rooftop bar with great views, and Ling was amazing — very helpful and super easy to communicate with. Highly recommend!

Fuimos en familia 4 personas, muy cómodo, dos canas grandes y una chica, más el zofa. Muy espacioso. Con detalles que se valoran, papel higiénico, reparadores, condimentos, etc. hasta jabón para el lavarropas.
Todo impecable, muy recomendable.
Gracias Ling!
Ling was so kind and helpful! We were only there for a night but she still made all efforts to make us comfortable. The apt is spacious, clean and in a great location

Ling est un hôte très proactif. Il répond très vite en cas de besoin.
Très beau logement spacieux.
Malheureusement, le four ne fonctionnait pas et nous avons eu de la difficulté avec les cartes d'accès mais l'hôte a pris action très rapidement. Nous en très reconnaissant.
The apartment is exactly as shown in the pictures, very spacious and has all the basic amenities. Great location as well, given vicinity to most places, including public transport terminals.

L’appartamento è bellissimo, collocato all’interno di un affascinante condominio al centro di Lisbona. Ling è l’host perfetto, chiara nelle indicazioni, sempre pronta a venire incontro agli ospiti, davvero tanti complimenti al servizio che offre e all’appartamento.

Die Wohnung ist Zentrum nah, aber in der Wohnung sehr ruhig, da die Fenster zu Ihnenhof ausgerichtet sind. Sehr sauber und gut ausgestattet.
Die Küche ist leider sehr klein, die Microwelle im Schrank muss man erst mit einem langen Kabel anschließen um zubenutzen. Die Tür im Badezimmer klemmt.
Großes Lob an Host, sehr freundlich und kommuniziert proakriv, hilfsbereit.
Excellent stay. The property was clean, secure, and exactly as described. Host/Ling responded quickly and check-in was smooth. Location is convenient, quiet at night, and safe. Highly recommend.

We have stayed at this apartment previously and it is a gem.   Located in a great area for restaurants, bars, parking, tourist attractions and no hills !   It is on the quiet side of the busy Main Street, so while it’s a popular area, it is nice to have an insulated, quiet building at night.  Clean and secure.  Great stay !
Ling was communicative and proactive in providing clear checkin/checkout instructions. The place is as described and close to a lot of attractions. Would recommend
Parfait, encore merci !
le logement est bien équipé et hyper bien placé ! Ling a été une super hôte a à l'écoute et très réactive !

Appartement parfaitement situé en face du Time out, proche gare et des quartiers centraux de Lisbonne.
Hôte très réactif
Je recommande

El apto coincidía con todas las especificaciones, la anfitriona siempre estuvo atenta y fue muy fácil y rápida la comunicación con ella ,todo estaba limpio y ordenado ,a sus alrededores muchos negocios locales de fácil acceso.
reservaría de Nuevo sin dudarlo

Hele fijne B&B in een leuke, levendige locatie. Veel restaurants ed op loopafstand, ook metro vlakbij, maar geen gebruik van gemaakt. Bij restaurant Sophia kun je lekker, sfeervol en betaalbaar Italiaans eten.
Ling is echt een SUPERHOST, vriendelijk en reageert altijd snel heeft veel informatie indien nodig. Goede bedden, krachtige douche en zeer ruime woonkamer. Zeer veel opbergruimte in elke ruimte van de b&b. Fijn dat de basis benodigdheden aanwezig waren en, zoals wat kruiden, thee, koffie olie ed.. Hele fijne dagen gehad, B&B is een aanrader! Levendige wijk en voelt ook veilig.

J’ai passé un séjour absolument formidable dans ce logement ! L’appartement est confortable et parfaitement situé dans un quartier agréable, qui permet de rejoindre le centre de Lisbonne à pied tout en profitant du calme.
Le personnel est extrêmement accueillant et chaleureux, toujours prêt à rendre service.
Le rooftop de l’immeuble est un vrai atout : il offre une vue magnifique sur le pont du 25 Avril, idéale pour admirer le coucher de soleil.
Une adresse que je recommande vivement pour passer des vacances mémorables à Lisbonne !

Ling was very helpful throughout the process. We had a small issue with getting into the apartment, which was quickly solved. The location is great, lots of restaurants around. The apartment was perfect for 5 people, very comfortable and clean.
logement assez spacieux, bien situé,meriterai quelques révisions,ling est très réactif

De accommodatie van Ling en haar zoon is perfect. De lokatie kan niet beter, op loopafstand van de gezelligste wijk van Lissabon en met bovendien de Time-Out Market voor de deur.
Het centraal station (inclusief metro) zit aan de overkant van de straat.
Het appartement is ruim genoeg (gezin van 5 personen waarvan 3 pubers) en van alle gemakken voorzien.
Helaas was de airco kapot bij ons, maar dat werd keurig opgelost doordat ze 3 mobiele airco’s hadden neergezet.
Deze maakten wel wat lawaai, waardoor we ze in de nacht niet aan konden zetten. Het was dus wel vrij warm in het appartement, maar in Lissabon zelf was het alle dagen toen wij er waren ook boven de 35 graden.
Maar Ling en haar zoon zijn zeer behulpzaam en welwillend, bovendien reageren ze enorm snel als je contact met ze zoekt.
Een absolute aanrader dit appartement!
Ling's communication all through the process was brilliant and was quick to come back with any queries. Would highly recommend staying with her.

Ling is a great host, and communication was easy. Location is great. However, the airconditioning and oven were broken and one of the beds as well. I slept on the couch due to this. We only had 2 nights, so it was doable but not as it should be.
Perfect location, close to great food, great views, and more!
A great location for exploring Lisbon.

First of all Ling and her son were both very welcoming, kind, and responsive. The apartment was clean and as described. The best part was a great location. Very near to shops, a park, and great places to eat such as The Timeout Market. From the apartment all the major attractions of Lisbon are near by. During our stay the AC was broke but Ling did provide some floor AC units in bedrooms which were helpful. Overall I’d recommend this place for a quick stay in Lisbon.

The place was spacious, clean and modern.  The biggest disappointment was that the AC had broken down the day we stayed, and Ling was unable to get it repaired that day.  He tried to address the problem with portable units, but the exhaust hoses needed to go out the windows, and nothing was provided to secure the hoses through the windows (so they ultimately didn't cool down the apartment).  I would have expected some kind of compensation for the inconvenience but Ling didn't offer, even after I mentioned it.    Also, the security desk was unmanned when we arrived, and although Ling explained about the lockbox, we didn't fully understand the setup (photos would have been helpful).
Excelente localização.

Can't really say a bad thing about this rental. Ling was very accommodating with holding our luggage on checkout and any questions we had were answered. The apartment itself is in the best location, right next to Time Out Market which made is really easy to navigate Ubers. The roof top of this apartment block is home to Java which was just the loveliest roof top bar/restaurant. The apartment was really really secure and felt very safe. Lots of space, clean and the shower was lovely! As three ladies there was a lack of mirrors when getting ready but the apartment had lots of amenities we weren't expecting.
Excelente localização, espaço amplo.

I rented Ling's apartment for the month of June. A few weeks before my trip, the Portuguese government extended their lockdown restrictions, meaning I was no longer able to take my trip. When I attempted to cancel my reservation, Ling claimed only Airbnb could cancel it, so I had to talk to them. I called Airbnb twice, and both times they told me that only Ling had the power to refund my money. The two parties went on this way for some time, passing the buck as to who was responsible for refunding my stay.
I understand Ling has a "strict" cancellation policy, so it was within her rights to refuse to refund. That said, I would've hoped for a little compassion during a global pandemic. Instead, Ling kept my $1900 in spite of the fact I never stepped foot in Portugal.
Along the way, Ling chastised me for continuing to "bother" her about cancelling. She sent me screenshots of her correspondence with other guests to demonstrate how easily I could cancel the trip myself, knowing full well I would get next to nothing ($63) back if I did so. I thought it pretty unprofessional to share messaging with past guests, as this communication is supposed to be confidential.
This entire experience was a nightmare. I've been an Airbnb user since 2012, but this host and the company's response was bad enough that I won't be using the platform again.

We are a family of 3 adults, and this was our 5th and final stay in an Air B&B during our two week tour of Portugal. When we landed in Portugal at the start of our trip we spent two nights in the Alfama neighborhood of Lisbon. We decided to spend the last 3 days of our trip in the Bairro Alto neighborhood of Lisbon to experience a different area. We stayed in this apartment for 3 nights. The apartment is centrally located in a residential pedestrian walkway. There are no restaurants or cafe on this walkway. All the apartments seemed to be residences that was occupied by owners, or rented out to tourists like us. It is centrally located and you can walk to practically everywhere, if you can tackle hills. We were able to explore a whole different area of Lisbon and discovered many lovely neighborhoods, places of interests, cafes etc when we decided to walk down an alleyway that looked interesting. Our Uber driver dropped us off at the end of the cobblestone walkway, which was about a 2 block walk from the apartment. I had corresponded regularly with Joao from the US as well as after and he was very responsive to all my questions, and gave me various suggestions. Joao also gave me a code for auto-check-in. I was under the impression that you enter the code, the door opens you walk in the apartment and the keys would be there. No. You enter the code, and a lock box opens (you need to know this). Inside the lock box is the key. Then you enter the main door of the apartment complex. Then you use the key to enter the actual apartment. If I had been alone, I would have given up. My college age son figured the whole thing out - thank goodness! We knew our apartment was on the 2nd floor but didn't quite know which door was ours. After trying a couple of doors we got in (it would be helpful to put numbers on the doors for future guests). Though I was able to communicate with Joao throughout our checking in procedure via the ABB app, it was a bit odd and impersonal to go into an apartment on our own, since we had the caretakers or owners letting us in during all our past stays (I realize, other guests may like this approach). Joao had left wine, crackers and various fish spreads, espresso machine with capsules (thank you!), milk and sugar. We also appreciated the roll of paper towel in the kitchen and the paper napkins in the dining room. There was also two different kinds of cereal in cereal dispensers. However, since we didn't know how long this had been sitting in the dispenser we didn't use it. There were also several adapters which allowed us to charge our devices separately as opposed to sharing the one adapter which we had brought along with us - this was...

O apartamento é muito bem situado, silencioso e funcional. Fizemos quase tudo a pé. Anabela foi super simpática e a comunicação funcionou perfeitamente. Uma excelente opção de hospedagem.
Accueil parfait, très central
Joaos place is perfectly located and a very nice and cozy place. Best for exploring the city and resting after all the walking through the beautiful streets of lisbon!
Very polite host, perfect service around checking and out. We liked our stay very much. The apartment is a perfect base to discover the city by day and perfect for nightlife in bairro alto at night.
Good place to stay. João provided a lot of food and drink for us. He also answered many questions we raised. Very heart-warming and dynamic host!
Great place for our short stay. Had everything we needed, even provided breakfast for us during our stay. good location in bairro alto district.

João's apartment was really nice and in a perfect location in the old town but still quite and not in the middle of the party streets. There is a lot of space and for four people it's Perfect. João couldn't be there to check in but he left us all the Information to check in by ourselfes and he was always available. Perfect location

El departamento es tal como se muestra en las fotos, nuestra estancia fue excelente, joao estuvo en constante comunicación conmigo respondiendo de inmediato a cualquier duda, la próxima vez que viaje a lisboa volveré a hospedarme aquí :)

We had such a great time in Lisbon, exploring the city.  Joao's place was clean, decribed very accurately with a super location,  Restaurants in Lisbon are fabulous and the very best we ate at was 16 steps from the front door!  Joao communicated exceptionally well and helped us navigate things.  Would highly recommend a stay here!

Perfect stay, perfect location. Joao is very helpful person. You can ask him everythink you want and he'll help.
Flat is in historical center, everythink is close :)
Appartement conforme aux photos, bonne communication de joao. Pour se garer  il y a un parking tout près à 13€ les 24h, pas le choix en hypertexte centre..
L appartement de Joao est parfaitement bien situé. Impec pour visiter la ville à pied. Joao est très accueillant et arrangeant pour notre arrivée. Nous recommandons sans problème !!

Nous avons été très bien accueilli par Joao, qui était disponible en cas de besoin. L appartement est conforme aux photos et est bien situé pour prendre les différents transports et visiter la ville. Très bon rapport qualité / prix. Nous vous le recommandons. Virg&Seb

This is a great place to stay and explore Lisboa! As a family of 2 adults and 3 children (5 to 11 years), we spent one week in Joao's place and we really had a great time. The apartment is very well situated in the St. Cathrin's part of Barrio Alto, in a quiet street just next to the Museum of Pharmacy with the St. Cathrin's Mirador,  and 200 meters away from the next stop of the historical Tramway Nr 28, and it's also very easy to go down to the metro and train station of Cais do Sodré or to Baixa. Joao is a fantastic host who really made us feel at home. The hand-over of keys was very easy even though we arrived late from the airport. The apartment has 4 separated rooms (2 bedrooms each with a big bed, a saloon and a dining room with a kitchenette), what is really nice. There is also a convertible sofa in the saloon, which we did not need as the children could easily sleep in one bed. The bathroom with toilet is small but functional and clean. We would definitely be very happy to return to Joao's place if we come back to Lisboa!
The apartment is exactly as it is described in the profile. It's located on a quite street but very close to the historic centre. There were 5 of us staying there and we did enjoy it.
Joao and his cousin Jose were hospitable,wonderful and very accommodating hosts, my friends and I had a great time and would highly recommend staying here!

João's flat is exactly as it looks on Airbnb. It was very clean and comfortable for our 1 week stay. João ensured we had extra blankets and heaters as the weather was chilly.
His communication was excellent and he responded very quickly to any queries and booked a taxi to get us to the airport very early in the morning for our flight home. He also greeted us early at the flat as we arrived before check in time.
The flat is central with Tram 28 running along the end of the road.
Just be aware that the shower is small and if you're a larger person, you may find getting in and out a bit tricky.
We would highly recommend João's flat to anyone visiting Lisbon and hope to return again. Lisbon is a beautiful city.
Thank you so much João.

Logement tres propre et idéalement situé pour les visites du centre de Lisbonne . transports en commun tram ,trai à proximité.
Joao est très accueillant et à l'écoute de ses hotes .

The place was in a great location and very clean.  Joao was very responsive and quick to accommodate us! The street was a little noisy, but no different from any other, I'm sure it would be the same throughout Lisbon. Highly recommend!

Ottima location e un appartamentino davvero molto curato. Noi siamo andati in 5 e non abbiamo avuto difficoltà, tranne il fatto che il bagno è solo uno e bisognava fare a turno. Centralissimo e raggiungibile a piedi da Bairro Alto. Unica nota negativa è stato il rumore assordante dei muratori che di sopra facevano lavori, per il resto molto raccomandabile e Joao super disponibile.

Everything was exactly as the ad describes! Joao was very kind: he bought something for us for breakfast and a bottle of wine! We had a problem with hot water and Joao quickly repaired it! I recommend it!
Apartamento simples, mas perto de tudo, adoramos a estadia .

This location is PRIME! The place is amazing. Accurate as described. The host, Joao was one of the kindest individuals I've encountered with air bnb. He went above and beyond to make sure we were accommodated. He has local books from Portugal on the book shelf and the feel of Portugal can be seen here. I wouldn't change a thing and I'm looking forward to booking again the next time I visit Lisboa!

Gostei da recepcao do Joao q foi bastante limpatico e pontual. O apto é simples e aconchegante. Achei a localização mto boa, pois tivemos acesso fácil à parte turística da cidade. Não recomendo deixar o carro estacionado na rua pela aparente falta de segurança. Recomendo para pessoas com certa disposição para subir escada e magras, pois o boxe do banheiro é pequeno.

Joaos Apartment ist sehr zentral in Lissabon gelegen, es ist einfach, aber ausreichend ausgestattet und sauber. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Joao selbst war immer erreichbar. Er hat am ersten Abend noch eine Stunde länger auf uns gewartet, weil wir Verspätung hatten und es war auch kein Problem, dass wir am letzten Tag erst gegen Abend auschecken wollten. Für die Bauarbeiten in der Straße und den damit verbundenen Lärm hat er sich überschwänglich entschuldigt und uns sogar noch eine weitere kostenlose Nacht angeboten. Wichtig zu wissen ist, dass das Apartment wie die meisten Häuser in Portugal nicht gedämmt ist, weswegen es Anfang Februar auch drinnen recht kalt ist. Es gab allerdings mehrere elektrische Heizungen, mit denen man die Räume etwas erwärmen konnte.
Insgesamt eine schöne Zeit, wir waren sehr zufrieden.
Fui a Lisboa con unos amigos y la casa es perfecta!! Muy limpia,céntrica y con mucho encanto!
Perfect location, clean and beautiful flat. Highly recommended!

L'appartement dans l'ensemble est très bien, parfaitement situé. Nous avons été merveilleusement bien accueilli par João qui est très à l'écoute et qui répond très rapidement à vos questions. Endroit idéal pour passer un merveilleux séjour au beau temps à Lisbonne.

Overall, this was a good stay, especially considering the very reasonable price.
Pedro was not available at check-in due to work, but his son Melchoir welcomed me. He was very kind and helpful, showing me how to use the keys and leaving his contact in case I needed anything, which I really appreciated.
The house and room have a lovely artistic atmosphere, which makes the place quite unique.
One thing to note is that the sound insulation is not very strong, so it may not be ideal for light sleepers. I personally didn’t sleep very well during my stay.
Otherwise, everything was good and it offers great value for the price.
Super nice room, in an interesting building😊 Locstion was perfect, central but cozy

La ubicación de Pedro está a 2 cuadras de metro y queda a menos de 10 cuadras de varios puntos de interés . Hay que esperar subir escaleras porque son 4 pisos . Sin embargo la habitación y su casa están impecables.

Pedro is an excellent Superhost. The home was extremely clean and tidy, and the room was exactly as described. Pedro communicated clearly and replied fast whenever I had a question. I really liked staying here and I will definitely look to return.. thank you so much 😊
Such a lovely stay in a beautiful flat! The location was great and check-in and check-out were seamless.
Pedro的房源非常美！并且就在自由大道上，位置极其便利！整个房子就像一个精致的美术馆！可惜他没有发过环境照片！我去的时候简直惊呆了！

Pedro responded in time, checked on me when my flight got delayed, and gave some good recommendations on the things to do in the neighborhood. He’s also very understanding and kind. His home is very clean and comfortable, also decorated with great style. Love the attic. I would stay here again if I visit again.

Zauberhaftes Zimmer im 4. OG mit Altbau Charme. Die Lage ist super zentral und sehr gut mit der Metro zu erreichen.
Pedro ist ein freundlicher Gastgeber, der sich beim Check-in sehr flexibel gezeigt hat.
Ich habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt.
Und die kleine Elektro-Heizung war toll! Es hat nämlich die ganze Zeit geregnet und so konnte ich über Nacht die Kleidung wieder trocknen 😉
Gerne wieder!
Beautiful, quiet place in the middle of Lisbon. Friendly and responsive host. Couldn’t ask for more.

Pedros Unterkunft ist einmalig wo man sich sofort wohl fühlt. Das ganze Haus ist wunderschön und hat sehr viele Geschichten. Die Lage ist sehr zentral aber doch ruhig. Pedro ist ein sehr angenehmer, hilfsbereiter, authentischer Mann.
Ich würde sofort wieder kommen! Sehr empfehlenswert!
Such a memorable stay! Loved being immersed in this historic building and artist oasis. 10/10 Location and very easy check in- Pedro made me feel welcome right away.

The location of this apartment is absolutely perfect. It’s incredibly convenient for visiting all the main sights. There is a metro station and a train station just nearby, which makes getting around the city extremely easy.
The apartment is located in a historic heritage building. The building itself feels like a piece of art, and many people living inside are artists, which creates a very inspiring and charming atmosphere.
The host is extremely kind and responsive. The room is also lovely and beautifully decorated, and the overall living experience was very comfortable and enjoyable. The apartment is close to the street and a nearby square, so before bedtime there can sometimes be some outside noise, but for me it didn’t affect my sleep at all.
I truly enjoyed staying here and would happily come back again.
まず美しい建物内部に驚いた！静かな部屋は居心地良く、Pedroさんはとても親切に色々と助けてくれた。キッチンの窓にカモメも。また遊びに行きたい！

I had a very comfortable stay at Pedro’s place in Lisbon. The location is perfect, right in the city center. The best part is that it’s so easy to come back and rest when you get tired and then go out again, which made exploring the city even more enjoyable. The host is very kind, helpful, and understanding. Everything was great, and I would definitely recommend this place.
Tout était parfait.  L’immeuble est splendide et super bien situé.

Pedro was very communicative and accommodated me even when I was coming into Lisbon last minute! His place is within walking distance and metro to a lot of the main areas so highly recommend. There is no elevator though so be aware of that, otherwise great stay!

Pedro is a lovely host and an amazing artist. The entire place looks like an art gallery! The room was comfortable, the location is central, communication was good. Everything was clean and as described.
It is easy to get in and out on your own. However, since it's a room in an apartment and the noise travels easily, it won't be possible to take a shower after 23:00.
Thank you for a lovely stay!
Charming place to stay with a great host. I’d come back!

Pedro is a kind and generous host! I really felt at home in his place. He was Delightful to chat with, and he had great recommendations for places to go. He also saved me a lot of time by giving me more direct routes to places I wanted to visit than Google maps was offering me.
Pedro’s place will be my first choice for my next visit to Lisbon!

Everything I needed for a two day solo stay in Lisbon. I felt completely safe and the location truly can’t be beat. As a bonus the room and the house are full of charm—you’re in the home of an artist. Obrigada, Pedro!
Todo de 10 en Pedro. Muy muy limpio. El es súper amable.
Good value
I couldn’t have asked for anything more.  Pedro and the space exceeded any expectations.  I only wish I had more time to spend in the apartment and exploring Lisbon and all the city’s offerings.
Incredible host, location, and poetic space. Loved this for my short stay
Pedro was great, super friendly the entire time and the room was so homey - great time. :)
Beautiful, clean room in a convenient location. The apartment has a lot of charm and is clean as well. Pedro is a very friendly host that makes you feel right at home :) Thank you!
Viihdyin todella hyvin, Pedro oli ystävällinen ja kaikki sujui todella kätevästi ja helposti!
It’s perfectly situated, 2 minutes from the metro and you can walk easily to discover the city. Loved the balcony!

Jolie chambre dans un magnifique appartement (lui même dans un immeuble incroyable). Accueil très sympathique de Pedro. Attention si vous avez le sommeil léger (quartier très bruyant malgré le double vitrage - Pedro n'y peut rien). Emplacement hyper central et idéal pour visiter le centre historique.

Ich war nur für 2 Nächte auf der Durchreise. Ich wäre auch länger geblieben, habe mich super wohl gefühlt. Pedro ist sehr freundlich, hilfsbereit und gastfreundlich. Vielen Dank, Pedro!
Wenn ich darf, komme ich sehr gern wieder.

I had a lovely stay with Pedro. He was a wonderful host and happy to chat while also gave me my own space. The accommodation was as advertised and very central which was useful as I travevelled out of Lisbon most days. Overall a wonderful host and place to stay which I recommend.

Not a big deal for me since I only had a backpack with me. Just me mindful of your planning to bring luggages.
I would definitely stay here again if I’m in Lisbon again.

Das Zimmer ist sehr urig und gemütlich. Ich mochte den Weg durch das dekorierte Treppenhaus und oben die Gemälde. Alles ist sehr individuell gestaltet. Die Wohnung ist günstig gelegen, sodass man viele Dinge zu Fuß erkunden konnte.

I had a very nice time at Pedro's place. He was very welcoming and easy to communicate with. His flat is super cozy and is located very close to tourist attractions, bars and restaurants. Highly recommended!
The place was clean, comfortable and so cool. Art everywhere, funky furniture, great houseplants! And the location is perfect for exploring Lisbon.
Pedro has such  a beautiful apartment and well cared for home. He is a very inviting host who was a pleasure to chat with during my stay. Perfect spot.
Really beautiful location in an old building filled with his art

Alloggiare a casa di Pedro é stata un’esperienza unica, autentica. Si é immersi in un’atmosfera artistica, rilassante, molto accogliente e caratteristica.

La posizione é perfetta, molto centrale.

Mi sono sentita un’ospite benvenuta, un soggiorno indimenticabile nel nido di un artista locale. Consiglio vivamente a tutti e ci ritornerei sicuramente!

I stayed at Pedro’s home for 7 days and truly found the experience to be top notch. The room is as described and offered a lovely escape from the busy neighborhood where it sits. The place clean, quiet ( with windows shut, and very comfortable.
I would recommend Pedro’s place for any single travelers who would like to be in the very heart of a great part of Lisboa, and who appreciate staying in a beautiful house from the 18th century
Pedro’s place is great and right in the heart of things. Pedro is very helpful & his home very arty.

I had a fantastic stay at Pedro's place in Baixa-Chiado - the neighbourhood is unbeatable. The metro station is not even five minutes' walk away, it is an easy walk to Cais do Sodre, and many historic buildings are located nearby. The house was clean and unique, featuring lots of original artwork and plants which I felt brightened the environment. My room had a lock, which felt very secure and the temperature was perfect: easily modifiable with a fan and heater. I slept well, and Pedro himself was friendly and accommodating, which is important for me because I have a disability. I highly recommend this place.

I stayed at Pedro’s place for 7 days and i can’t recommend it enough. Beautiful 18th century  building, in a great neighborhood in Chiado. The room was a cute attic with a nice view on the 4th floor. Pedro is an artist (painter) and his place has lots of artwork and vintage rustic style. The neighborhood is great, super walkable and close to everything. Barro Alto, the bar scene area is 3 min walk, great restaurants, close to shops etc. Pedro was very responsive and friendly. I enjoyed my stay at his place. It was nice and quiet environment. I am happy with the choice i made and i will be returning to his place when i wm back in Lisbon.

I had such a great visit staying at Pedro’s place. The space is so beautiful and it’s a very unique experience. I really felt like a welcomed guest. For anyone looking for a bit more of a unique and authentic experience I would definitely recommend. The also had to work a bit during my trip and the WiFi was very strong.

Really cool and quirky spot with lots of character. The room is artsy and eccentric in a fun way, and everything was clean and comfortable. No AC, but it cooled down at night so sleeping wasn’t an issue. The location is amazing. Easy walk to most attractions, great restaurants, and the metro. Overall, a unique and memorable stay.
Great location and nice room. It was above a really cool hotel. Quiet and homey.
I enjoyed the homely feeling of Pedro's place. He was very kind and responsive, and the apartment was very conveniently located, close to tourist attractions.
Ich habe es bei Pedro sehr genossen. Nur zu empfehlen

I had a great one night stay at Pedro’s apartment. Pedro was very helpful and responsive. I could leave my luggage earlier.
The location is great to discover Lisbon, very central. Lots to do by foot, public transport is also very very close. The neighborhood is however quite busy and loud at night (I stayed during the weekend, maybe it’s different during the week). It didn’t bother me but I would consider it if you’re sensitive to noise. :)
I would definitely stay here again!

Localização perfeita!
O apartamento é um charme.
Pedro super atencioso.

Pedro is a great host: Makes you feel welcome, responsive, flexible and up for deep talks.

Highly recommend to stay at his place.

This place is such a find.  I would never stay anywhere else in Lisbon now.  Right in the middle of a vibrant part of the city, yet apart from it.  Pedro is very welcoming and gave excellent specific recommendations.  The flat is also very characterful and personalised, which all adds to the magic of staying there.
As a female traveling alone, I felt very safe in Pedro’s home. I recommend

the stay at Pedros place was great.

the location of the place is great and the apartment lovely, authentic and with a lot of Charme.

I really enjoyed playing the piano and my room was great. Will be back again!

Pedro's place is very clean and cozy and well decorated and full of amazing paintings. Pedro is a very responsive host and his son was also very helpful and friendly. This place is close to many stores and restaurants and is in a historical section of the city with easy access to public transport. I recommend trying it out. For older folks just be notified that the apartment is on the fourth floor and you will have to take some stairs.

I had a wonderful stay in Pedro’s apartment in Baixa-Chiado. The neighborhood is lovely and central, perfect for exploring Lisbon. The building itself is a beautifully preserved historical gem—full of charm and character. The apartment is decorated with incredible taste, blending old Portuguese style with an artistic, studio-like flair. My private room was on the top floor, right under the roof, and the view was absolutely breathtaking. Everything was spotlessly clean, and the whole space felt warm and inspiring. Pedro was a fantastic host - attentive, helpful, and welcoming. I genuinely loved everything about my stay and would highly recommend it to anyone visiting Lisbon!
A wonderful and unique find full of beautiful art and with great sunlight. Pedro was a great host. Highly recommend!

Pedro and his son were very welcoming and made staying at their place very comfortable. They are both very kind and helpful. It was easy to check in and out. The place is clean and nice with a great location. Highly recommend.
Very comfortable house. Very confident from every spots

Pedro's place is beautiful. The location is great,  in the mix of all the things, & the building is stunning. Also & he's a wonderful host-- very kind, easy going & straightforward. It is a 4th floor walk-up, but totally worth it. I would stay there again. Highly recommend

Excellent séjour chez Pedro. Il est accueillant, arrangeant et réactif. Le logement correspond à l'annonce et est particulièrement bien situé au coeur de la ville.

très bien 👍👍👍👍

Pedros house is a cozy haven of art, design and authenticity, a very relaxing place in the middle of one the most visited areas of Lisbon.

Great host, great place and a great location!

Pedro’s place was sooo beautiful and I felt right at home. Pedro made sure I had everything I needed and was always responsive. I actually had the entire place to myself which was an unexpected bonus. Thank you so much Pedro for sharing your beautiful home with me!
This place is precious and Pedro is a fantastic host, gentle, friendly and very responsive! His indications were spot on! Thank you Pedro!
Es war eine schöne urige Wohnung im vierten Stockwerk. Es gibt kein Fahrstuhl. Aber ein sehr schönes Treppenhaus mit Gemälde von Pedro.. Morgens hört man Klaviermusik im Treppenhaus..

the most charming apartment! La chambre est parfaite, très bien située au cœur de Lisbonne, juste à côté du métro et à proximité de commerces, lieux culturels et quartiers à visiter. La communication avec Pedro fut très bonne, je ne peux que recommander :)

Pedro’s place was cozy , clean and homely. Its location is excellent, close to restaurants and transport.Pedro was a good host always there, if needed. The apartment is in a building with beautiful decoration that makes you feel welcome. Will certainly come back, if possible. Thank you Pedro for your hospitality!

Pedro was an amazing host, the best I could have asked for. Particularly kind, helpful and attentive during my stay. The location within the city is superb, with lots of transport links and attractions within walking distances. The sights from the room's window are beautiful as well. Great value, I gladly recommend Pedro and his cozy warm artistic home!

Pedro was a great host. Provided great local recommendations and things to do. The accommodation is in the best possible location to be close to everything. Highly recommend and will visit again

as the place is in the middle of the center of lisbon you have the good things st hand: restaurants, the best chocolate cake in the world, pastel de natas. with being this close to everything comes with some noise at night of drunken tourists. didn’t bother me, but bring earplugs if you’re a light sleeper.
it’s a great place to stay!
hospedagem excelente! O local é encantador e muito limpo e cheiroso. foi tudo perfeito, pena que fiquei apenas uma noite, mas Pedro foi muito simpático. vale muito a pena

I loved staying here! Beautiful and comfortable apartment, great location with nice restaurants, and very welcoming host.
Muy bonito lugar

This room is in a beautiful restored 250 year old building. It is a good value for a budget traveler, but you must climb 4 long flights of stairs to reach the top floor of the building. So get yourself in shape before you come. The host was very gracious and welcomed me with information about the apartment. The building and neighborhood are safe for a woman traveling alone. I do suggest taking a taxi or Uber to climb the steep hill to the building and find the location. When I left, it was easy to walk straight down the street to the waterfront. I enjoyed this little hideaway and would stay here again.
Pedro, thank you for your hospitality. And thank your neighbor in the building for playing beautiful classical piano music for me as I walked down the stairs to depart.

Beautiful old original house in the very Center of Lisboa, you can walk everywhere. I recommend earplugs for the night for the trams ;)
Pedro is very nice and a painter :) a true artist home.

After a spontaneous decision to welcome 2025 somewhere out of the UK, Lisbon was on a very long list of alternatives. As I had a limited budget Pedro's ABB looked as a good deal, and it was. Communications were excellent, check in was trouble free and Pedro and everybody else in the house were great hosts. Yes, it is in the fourth floor, but the beauty of the decoration of the first three floors made it easier . The facilities were basic , the bathroom was always clean and as a not too tall person I had no problem with the low shower head, the kitchen had everything you needed if wanted and the bedroom large enough for a comfortable stay, as a bonus there was access to a small balcony to enjoy a little peek outside to the street. Excellent location, close to all amenities you could wish for, by foot or public transport.
It was my first visit to Lisbon, and staying at Pedro's made it a very enjoyable experience.
Thanks Pedro!
and yes, I would recommend it to everybody .
Perfect location. Great host!
Amazing stay, top tier location and so aesthetic. Even better than the photos. Is on 4th floor with no elevator

お世話になりました。
ありがとうございました。

Pedro's flat is in the attic of a historical building. It is necessary to bear in mind that you are living in someone's home, sharing their bathroom and kitchen, but everyone I met was nice and as Pedro is an artist, his home is beautifully decorated. The room is cosy, has a nice small balcony with a view and is ideal for a single person or a couple who just need some space to spend the night and relax after a busy day outside. I imagine the attic can be cold in winter and hot in summer, but there was a heater (which I didn't use in November) and I assume in hotter months there would be a fan available.
The location is amazing for a traveller, in the middle of the city, next to the Luís de Camões square, 3 minutes walking from Baixa-Chiado metro station, 10 minutes from Cais do Sodre or Rossio. The area can be a bit noisy, but in a good way, you hear the trams, people and even music from street artists in the square every evening. And with shut windows you sleep in quiet.

Minha estadia com o Pedro foi incrível! Desde o início, ele foi super simpático e sempre se comunicou de forma clara e assertiva, o que tornou tudo muito fácil. Me senti em casa! Além disso, ele me quebrou o maior galho permitindo que eu deixasse a mala um pouco depois do check-out, já que meu voo era consideravelmente mais tarde. Foi um detalhe que fez toda a diferença! Com certeza voltaria a me hospedar com ele sem pensar duas vezes. Obrigado por tudo, Pedro!
Pedro war sehr freundlich und die Wohnung ist sehr schön. Ich habe mich wie zuhause gefühlt, danke Pedro.
발코니가 있고 인테리어가 예뻐서 지내는동안 즐거웠습니다. 다만 4층(한국 기준 5층)까지 가기 위한 엘레베이터가 없어서 유산소 운동 열심히 했습니다 화장실도 깨끗해서 좋았어요

A toda persona q observe este comentario les digo es un excelente lugar acogedor atención al 100%
Y muy tranquilo y pedro una persona muy educada y amable le doy un 10 👌👌✔️🙏👍😎🇵🇹❤️ en general excelente lugar
Amazing location
Staying at Pedro's was a great experience. His home is colorful, inviting and in a great location to see the sights. Highly recommended.

The host is artist and he decorates his place and stairs with lots of his works. And this is very unique.
A little weakness of this place is the roof of shower tub is low and I am 160 cm high. For those people higher than 165cm should be careful otherwise you will hit your head during shower.

Pedro is a friendly and generous host. He and his son were polite and kind. As stated by the other reviewers, the building is located at a steep hill and the home is on the fourth floor. Additionally, there is another room in the house that could be rented by another traveler. I had no issues with sharing the restroom. Quiet hours are from 11p-7a since the shower makes noise. The room is very cozy. As a female solo traveler, I found it to be very safe and comfortable. Thank you so much, Pedro!

Pedro var en snill og hyggelig kar som tok meg godt i mot. Han kom med gode anbefalinger. Var alltid imøtekommende og kom med tips. Leiligheten var koselig og jeg trivdes godt. Leiligheten lå kjempefint til og det skjedde mye i området. Kan absolutt anbefale stedet :)
Pedro vil ta deg godt i mot.
Every time I stay at Pedro's Airbnb I feel at home.

Great location! Couldn’t ask for a better spot. There was only one bathroom that is shared with potentially up to four people as the host and the hosts son also lives there (along with an other AIRBNB room). I found myself having to wait to use the bathroom multiple times. Bed and pillows were uncomfortable. Host was very aware of any and all noise. He told me that the previous guest showered in the early morning and disturbed the host, so you’re not allowed to shower early in the morning. I brushed my teeth late at night and was told I was making noise. So be careful with making any noise. If you are above 5 feet and 7 inches tall you will have trouble in the shower as the shower head is VERY low, you need to bend over to shower. The apartment is 8 sets of stairs up high, so be prepared to walk a lot of stairs. I had no issues but if you have cardio issues you might want to avoid. Great location and pretty good price. Not sure I’d stay there again though due to the above reasons.
Lovely room with a great view on the top floor of a beautiful building in the best location. Would definitely stay here again!
Excelente custo benefício.  Pedro foi muito receptivo,  a casa muito limpa e organizada e bem próximo aos pontos turísticos.
I enjoyed my stay at Pedro’s, who knows maybe till next time in Lisbon!

I was delighted with my stay at Pedros place on my solo trip to Lisbon, perfect for a single female in every way. The location could not be better, right in the centre of the city, I could walk everywhere from there but also had transport right on the Square. Pedro and his son were excellent hosts, the apartment is  authentic old Lisbon, the room was bright and airy with an ambient temperature, if you are a person who likes to get up, go explore and relax with good wifi, a book and the kiosk on your doorstep for good coffee and drinks while listening to live music, this is for you. Highly recommended

I loved staying at Pedro's place, The situation right in the middle of Chiado couldn't have been better. It was easy to access from the airport too. The room is charming and I slept well, The firm mattress and feather pillows and duvet suited me very well.

Pedro a été super gentil et j'ai apprécié qu'il est fait l'effort de parler en français. Le quartier correspondait à mes attentes vu que j'étais toute seule. Beaucoup d'animations à proximité. Je recommande

Mein Aufenthalt bei Pedro war durch und durch großartig. Pedro ist ein äußerst freundlicher und aufmerksamer Gastgeber, der mir viele wertvolle Tipps gegeben hat. Die Wohnung ist in einem sehr gepflegten Zustand, und mein Zimmer hatte mit den bodentiefen Fenstern einen kleinen Austritt/Balkon, den ich besonders schätzte. Der Blick über die Dächer von Lissabon bis hin zum Meer war atemberaubend. Auf der bequemen, festen Matratze - sie verdient eine Erwähnung – habe ich wunderbar tief und fest geschlafen. Vielen Dank, Pedro!

Mi sono trovata benissimo. Stanza grande e molto bella, Pedro é stato molto gentile e mi ha spiegato tutto bene. Posizione secondo me perfetta per raggiungere tutti i mezzi e la sera mi fermavo sempre ad ascoltare i buskers per strada.
Lo consiglierò a tutti quelli che vorranno venire a visitare Lisbona e dintorni.

I needed a bed for one night before an early flight. Pedro knew this. He rents out multiple rooms in his home for travelers, so I assumed he would be used to people coming and going at odd hours.
When I am a guest, I try my best to be quiet and respectful. My other host reviews reflect this. When I returned to Pedro's home late at night, I tried to wash up quietly. As I was washing my face, he rapped on the door and yelled at me for making noise. The only noise was running water. This made me afraid to shower or use the toilet at all.
Pedro didn't give written instructions on where to leave the keys when checking out, but did strongly emphasize that the door locks behind you. Because I was leaving early and didn't want to wake him to ask, I thought it may be best to leave the door open with the keys inside. As I was leaving, he followed me to the stairs and yelled at me for this misunderstanding.
His home is beautiful but Pedro needs to better communicate his expectations to guests.
Das Zimmer war gemütlich und so wie beschrieben. Pedro war sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Ich empfehle diese Unterkunft meinen Freunden.
Very cozy and clean apartament, in a central area close to a metro station. Pedro was very useful and friendly. Would definitely come back.
Alles perfekt gewesen! Danke für den tollen Aufenthalt✨
El alojamiento de Pedro es fantástico para pasar unos días en Lisboa.

Es una habitación muy linda y en una ubicación increíble. Pedro fue siempre muy amable conmigo, hablamos bastante sobre Portugal.
Realmente recomiendo esta habitación en el departamento de Pedro, es genial.
Very clean and beautiful place. Excellent location and lovely host. So helpful and kind! Wouldn’t recommend enough👍
Séjour très agréable !

It was an absolute pleasure staying with Pedro. He is kind, helpful and responsive. . His place is beautiful, like a museum and very clean. The room was spacious and comfortable. Location is great. Highly recommended!!
Gute Unterkunft mit mit perfekter Lage kann ich nur weiterempfehlen.

if you have health problems or if you are tall, this might not be the best place for you to stay. The accomodation is on the fourth floor and the shower ceiling is low. I did knock my head on the ceiling while taking a shower a couple times which is not really convenient.
the room is pretty cute and VERY VERY VERY well located

The room was very clean. The building and the unit is now new one , the room is also old but big and bright enough. It is located right in the city centre , walking to the main streets and many sightseeing. Only thing since it is centre at night was very noise from the street , I had hard time to fall asleep. Pedro is very kind and nice person. If I travel to Lisbon again I would take this room again .
좋아요
Przepiękne miejsce z artystyczną duszą! Dużo ładniej niż na zdjęciach. Lokalizacja w samym centrum, blisko komunikacji miejskiej i portu. Pedro był bardzo miły. Chętnie tam wrócę następnym razem :)
Too noisy. Did not get much sleep because two taverns right underneath the room with music and chatter until sometimes 3:00 am.

Pedro's house is absolutely beautiful, even more than you can imagine from the pictures in the advertisement. The location is perfect, surrounded by hills of the old town full of life. I stayed here one night while traveling alone and it was really perfect. I would recommend this room to anyone looking for a central location and artistic house to stay in. And Pedro was very kind and responsive. Obrigada :)

J’ai réservé ce logement pour être proche de la station Cais do Sodré pour aller au festival Nos Alive. Ayant un sommeil léger je n’ai pas forcément bien dormi car il y avait quelques bruits de travaux à l’étage inférieur. Ma chambre était proche de la porte d’entrée et j’entendais très bien les entrées et sorties des personnes résidentes. J’avais un décalage vu que je me couchais tard après les concerts et ne dormais pas très bien.
Au final l’appartement était très bien.
In the heart of Lisbon, this is a perfect bnb for solo travellers! Pedro was a nice host and explained all the amenities with ease.
Logement correspondant à la description, très bien placé tout est accessible à pieds

I adored Pedro’s place that is decorated beautifully and situated right in the center of everything. Pedro was extremely kind, patient, and accommodating, and I would absolutely love to come back the next time I’m in Lisbon
Lovely place to stay! Great location and host. Thanks so much!
La ubicación es inmejorable, la habitación y el departamento muy cómodos. Pedro fue muy amable y estuvo siempre disponible. Lo recomiendo sin dudarlo.
Pedro's place was clean and cute and Pedro was a very gracious host. I wish I could have stayed longer.

the place took a lot longer to walk because no one told me which exit of the Baixa Chiado Metro to exit. Turns out there is one exit with four or five escalators which would have saved me much climbing. I think the exit is Mesiorcordia. Although the Lisbon metro has poor signage. I twice got on the wrong train in the wrond direction.
Pedro was very nice. The one think I suggest is no one who is tall stay here if you want shower. The slating roof even almost hit my head in the shower I am not tall: only five foot eight inches. If you are much taller it would be very uncomfortable in the shower.
It would have been nice to have some little things that many Air BnBs have: coffee, tea, milk etc. Many do. Not here. The bed was confortable The area is very noisy at night, and did not get quiet until 3 or 4 in the morning. Also note bathroom is shared: down the hall and was never a problem. Pedro also allowed me to put some food in the frig which was nice.

The location here is perfffffect! I wish I would've booked more nights here- cozy, close to everything and the artistry aesthetic makes it even more quaint. The GPS on the address listed took me to the wrong spot but that is the  GPS fault! ha! check in was easy, location is very central, room is cozy, flexible and laid back host- I would def stay here if I came back!
Pedro’s apartment is delightfully whimsical and incredibly central. Great for being a tourist in Lisbon but also experiencing an artist’s home. Very comfortable and a pleasure for the eyes too!

A great place to stay close to many Lisbon attractions and public transport options. The apartment was lovely, clean, and provided everything that I needed for my stay. Pedro is a wonderful and very kind host. I would recommend 100%!

O apartamento de Pedro é charmosissimo, muito bem localizado e cheio de personalidade. O anfitriao é também artista plástico e pai. Só levei boas impressões! O único senão é o banheiro único que para muitas pessoas pode ser desconfortável, mas em nada na altura me incomodou. Fica numa bela rua em pleno bairro alto. Aproveitem!
Das Zimmer in Pedros Dachgeschosswohnung ist perfekt, wenn man Lissabon alleine erkunden will. Die Wohnung liegt sehr zentral, weshalb es abends etwas lauter werden kann.

Pedro’s attic was great! Very cozy, great location, and he provides a fan for the heat (Lisbon summer is no joke). Very low price for an excellent place! Highly recommend you stay here. Private room that you can lock as well so no need to worry about privacy.
Som altid en fornøjelse at bo hos Pedro

Always love coming back to Pedro's place. Right in the middle of Chiado you are immediatly in the heart of Lisbon. Close to the Bairro Alto but also close to the sea, which you can beautifully see from your little balcony.
Looking forward to coming back already!
Great value for place, Pedro was very nice and the room is more spacious than it appears in photos. I was only there for one night but I recommend it! Great area as well, close to everything

Airbnb vraiment super ! Très beau, propre et spacieux. La chambre était incroyable !  L'hôte est vraiment super également ! J'ai été super bien accueilli et la communication était bonne. L'emplacement est génial ! En plein centre-ville, à côté du métro et le soir il y a un côté plus festif. J'aurai aimé y rester plus longtemps ahah :)
Très bon accueil, logement  confortable et et coloré, je recommande !

I had very short but great stay at Pedro’s.
He is incredibly helpful and understanding.
The flat is charming and location is very handy.
I would definitely stay again once I’m in Lisbon
Thank you!!!

The room is in a beautiful building in central location. Super easy to access metro and walkable to lots of places. The hosts were very accessible and friendly. The street noise was pretty loud in the middle of the night on some nights, but that is to be expected with the location and age of building. I enjoyed being able to hear the music from the nearby square with the balcony doors open. Loved the character and relaxed vibe of this space. It felt very welcoming and comfortable.
Short but sweet stay. Location is very central so it was perfect to explore the city. The apartment is a beautiful artsy place. Enjoyed it a lot!
The place is super convenient for travelers. Pedro is very responsive and provided everything I needed for a great stay. Highly recommend!

Pedro's place is fantastic - amazing location, very nice room and building, well connected to all the main sights in central Lisbon. Also a great host, was very welcomed at his place. No hesitations in recommending to others!

Pedro’s place is very cute and cozy. The room was perfect for one person, the house has lots of character and beautiful art in it. The location is very close to the main areas of Lisbon and I felt safe walking back home at night by myself. Pedro is also a lovely host.
I would recommend it!

Logement magnifique, chambre spatieuse et confortable, tout est très propre et très bien situé
Vous pouvez y aller les yeux fermés 😄
Petro und Irena sind sehr warme, ruhige Menschen. Die sehr zentrale Lage ist hervorragend. Metro und Tram sind gleich um die Ecke. Sowie Einkaufsmöglichkeiten, Restaurants und Frühstücksmöglichkeit.

The place is beautiful: I’ve sent the pictures to my family with the room and the view and they actually jealoused me) Pedro and his family are sweet and kind - they let me leave my heavy backpack at their place for the whole day though they didn’t have to.
My big recommendation!
Such a sweet host and a beautiful room. Felt perfectly safe and at home as a solo female traveler.
A acomodação foi ótima e Pedro é muito atencioso.
Had an amazing stay. Really impressed with Pedro’s beautiful home and the quality of accommodation offered.

living with Pedro was so very nice, he’s a call and friendly person who will help you out when you ask him! The place itself is well located near a Metro Station and the pink street. Normally there is quite the nightlife in the neighborhood but you Sleep very calmly without too much noise there ! I’d come back when i get the chance to :)
His place has nice warm touch and much more spacious than expected. For the location, I don’t think I could find anywhere better than his place for the price I paid !

I absolutely loved staying in Pedro’s beautiful apartment and would definitely come back! It’s centrally located, the room is spacious, and Pedro is very kind, nice to chat with, and helpful. I wholeheartedly recommend booking this place if you’re  looking for a central location in lovely Lisboa.

Es war eine der besten Air BnB Erfahrungen, die ich bislang hatte. Pedro war sehr freundlich, seine Unterkunft gemütlich und entsprach genau den Bildern. Die Lage ist super zentral und ich habe es geliebt abends der Live Musik von draußen zu lauschen. Das Treppenhaus war zudem für mich ein richtiges Highlight. Ich liebe die Farben und die Holztreppe!
Danke für deine Gastfreundlichkeit Pedro, ich komme gerne wieder!

La ubicación y el estilo de la habitación excelentes, también la limpieza y la atencion. Sin embargo, estuve dos noches y la segunda noche la pasé bastante incómodo y avergonzado por comentarios respecto a mi estado de salud por parte del anfitrión. OBVIAMENTE conozco mi estado de salud y por eso suelo alquilar habitaciones privadas. No necesito que me recomienden ir al médico y mucho menos hacerme sentir incómodo.

Pedro si è dimostrato molto accogliente e disponibile. Riservato e rispettoso degli spazi, nonostante si alloggi in casa sua.
La casa è molto carina.
La posizione è davvero ottima, di fianco alla metro, in una delle zone più belle di Lisbona e, sebbene ci sia molta movida notturna, rimane in un punto abbastanza silenzioso che permette di riposare bene.
Grazie!!

J’ai passé un excellent séjour chez Pedro !
Il est très sympathique et accueillant ! Je me suis sentie comme à la maison. Le logement est très beau avec toutes ces couleurs et il est très bien situé ! Je reviendrai avec plaisir !
Fantastisk leilighet og svært god beliggenhet! Følte meg godt tatt imot og trygg i leiligheten. Anbefaler på det varmeste:)
Pedro was very friendly and extremely easy going host. He made me feel like home and he arranged everything that I needed to make my stay perfect. Would definitely come back.
Wonderful place right in the heart of Lisbon. Would definitely recommend!
C’était parfait merci pour tout
Stones throw from pink street. Note there are stairs required
Pedro was an excellent communicative host and the location of his home is walkable to much of Lisbon. Was a perfect stay for my first night in the city.

Excellent location and very charming airbnb, Pedro’s house is very cosy and authentic. Great communication as well. I stayed there for a week and had a wonderful stay. Definitely recommend for both long and short stays
Pedro ist ein sehr netter, ruhiger Gastgeber. Vielen Dank für alles.
Peaceful

Pedro’s place was super cozy and extremely well located in the heart of Lisbon. He was very welcoming and made sure I was well settled, he also gave me incredible tips on what to see and how to best spend my time in the city. His home is stunning, clean and exactly as it’s shown on the pictures. You can get around the city on foot, since it’s located in the very center. Thanks Pedro for the loveliest welcome! I had great time :)

밑에 역으로 가기도 좋고 주변 관광지도 가까워요 합리적인 가격에 편안한 환경이었습니다.
문율 줨둬 솰솰돧으뤄궈 눈취줘눈궈말궈는 다괜촪
Adorei a minha estadia na casa de Pedro. Ele foi muito simpático e atencioso. Com certeza é um lugar que eu voltaria! A localização é bem centralizada. Lisboa é uma cidade encantadora!

Incredible location in Lisbon, this Airbnb is a room in Pedro’s house.  He rents two rooms while he and his son also live there.  The home was clean with strong WiFi and hot water.  It’s up on the 5th floor so a nice little workout every time you arrive.  The value was very good and Pedro very friendly.   It is located only a few blocks from the Baixa metro station.  Very good value as well and would def use again.
Muy buena estadía, muy buena ubicación, todo bien. Volvería.
Simple but spotlessly clean accommodation. Good comms from Pedro. Location is amazing - 2 minutes to Metro and close to Pink Street, Food Market, pastél de nata shops!

Pedro fue un excelente anfitrión. Desde el inicio estuvo pendiente de mi llegada y recibirme en su casa. Su hogar es acogedor, te sentirás como en casa. La habitación es muy grande, ventilada e iluminada. Recomendada!

Pedro was a phenomenal host in a great home! He makes you feel welcome and right at home. The location is great, it’s right by heart of Bairro Alto (which can be loud at night if you aren’t prepared) and is extremely walkable. The room is spacious and cozy. I would stay here again!
Another excellent stay at Pedro’s in an old charming building and great ambiance! Warm welcome from the host who is a painter & artist.
최상층이어서 짐 끌고올 때는 힘든데, 그래도 주변 위치나 호스트가 친절해서 좋았습니다.

En ole aikaisemmin yöpynyt kenenkään luona, mutta tämä vahvisti sen, että matkustan näin myös jatkossa. Oma huoneeni oli erittäin kaunis ja ihastelin asunnon yksityiskohtia ja värejä.
Sijainti ei olisi voinut olla parempi, siitä pääsi joka paikkaan helposti kävellen, metrolla tai ratikalla. Minulla ei ole mitään huonoa sanottavaa.
Pedro oli myös erittäin kohtelias ja vieraanvarainen. Hän puhuu myös erittäin hyvää englantia. Sain myös jättää matkalaukkuni sinne päivän ajaksi, koska lensin vasta illalla. Suosittelen lämpimästi <3 Obrigada!
I enjoyed my stay in Lisbon! Perfect for a solo traveller looking for a cozy and quaint accommodation ☺️
Quarto charmoso, localização ótima e anfitrião muito simpático!!!

I had a great stay at Pedro’s apartment. The room is on the top floor of the building and there is no elevator, however I had a small suitcase so I was fine. The room was clean, and very well decorated. He was so kind and helpful throughout my stay, he offered me tea which I really appreciated as it was a chilly night in Lisbon. Thank you Pedro!

Fantastic room in a brilliant location. The perfect room for a city break right in the heart of the city. Pedro was kind, polite and immediately set me up so I could come and go as I please. Thoroughly recommended.
Une jolie chambre calme et super bien placée.. trés bien accueillie chez Pedro!!
I love all the art! Great location and Pedro is so easy and quick to respond. Very sweet!

Tenho viajado bastante e sem dúvida Pedro foi o melhor host que encontrei. Me senti hospedado na casa de um bom amigo. O apartamento é muito charmoso e vc fica hospedado em um pedaço de história de Lisboa! Estando em Lisboa futuramente esse será de novo meu endereço.
A localização é muito boa e a casa muito especial, principalmente por todas as plantas que estão muito bem cuidadas.
Utrolig hyggelig å bo hos! Vennlig og imøtekommende. Kan anbefales!

Pedro’s apartment and the room I stayed in were even nicer than I had expected, the room is charming, a perfect size and it would be great for a couple too.
The bathroom is clean with a decent shower, and the flat is decorated beautifully. The central location is very handy, I walked everywhere!
And Pedro is a polite and friendly host. I highly recommend!
Great location and easy stay
It was a great stay and everything went really smoothly. I spent two days there exploring Lisbon. It's a perfect base station. Many thanks Pedro!
Thanks Pedro. Very much enjoyed my stay at yours.
Perfect for a short stay in Lisbon old town. Pedro is a lovely host and his flat is decorated in the most wonderful and quirky way. Let me leave my bags after check-out which was much appreciated!
Everything was very nice and Pedro is a very friendly person :)
It was lovely to stay in Pedro's home- the room had everything I needed and it was a peaceful stay in a great location. His home is artistic and quirky and great for a quick trip!

Very nice room in a beautiful flat, minutes walk from the bustling Lisbon old town, yet quiet and private, Pedro and his son are such lovely hosts, very helpful and friendly, I had a great stay and will definitely book again!

A fantastic apartment…a really great way to see an actual Lisbon living space. Pedro was extremely friendly and very accommodating. We had some great conversation and a lot of laughs! Fantastic experience!

Muy amable, servicial, cálido.
Bajo los 4 pisos con mi valija y los otros 4 ó 5 pisos hasta el metro, no andaba el ascensor, hasta me donó un paraguas.
Esos gestos lo pintan de cuerpo entero.
Sumamente recomendable.
Really great location, in the historic centre, close to the metro & even the E28 tram stop is literally just there.

I loved staying at Pedro’s home! It is a beautiful and eclectic space and it could not be more perfectly located. It is a fourth-floor walk-up, it can be a bit noisy at night, and the common spaces are shared among you, Pedro, his son, and another guest — but as long as you are aware of those things, there will be no problems and you will enjoy your stay. Pedro is very kind and you will learn a lot about life in Lisbon by talking to him.
Hassle free stay

Pedro was such a nice host he allowed me to leave my luggage even 1 hour before my check-in time which I appreciate so much! The room has a nice atmosphere so artsy! I loved journaling next to the window (when you’re there you feel inspired to create).
The views from the room are absolutely amazing. I wanted to stay longer but unfortunately it was already booked for the rest of the month. I would totally recommend Pedro’s place to anyone coming to Lisbon, especially first timers, and want to walk within a distance to the most touristy spots in the city.

This was my first time in Lisboa, and it was only as I started to wander more, go on experiences, and meet up with people did I realize how well Pedro's home is situated. Most likely anywhere you want to go will require walking up a hill, and by the time I got to the building, I was sweating much more than I was proud of. That was on me, because I thought it was going to be cooler (I'd say a t-shirt with a light sweater/cardigan will do for most days), so I was wearing more than I needed to, and I was carrying my carry-on. The Metro lets out of the bottom of the hill, also, so when I wanted to go Caiscais or Belem, it was an easy trip down the hill. As an aside, I bought the 42Euro 3-day Lisboa pass, took the Metro, trams and busses every day, and visited museums and it still wasn't worth it, but I do recommend probably get some kind of pass; the city transportations were all clean, though very crowded at peak times.

There were plenty of options for bedding: thick blanket on top, medium weight comforter below that, then very lights sheets on the bed. The only issues I had with sleeping were self-induced: Lisbon is a city that stays out late, but turning the fan on that's provided creates some great white noise. And on another night I had an espresso at a great local restaurant 2 hours before bed. 0/10, would not recommend.
Pedro was great with communication, and I never felt like I was imposing on his home life, though, as anywhere else, it's always a good idea to be respectful in someone else's home.
