Pedro is an excellent host, welcoming  and helpful. He has a beautiful home. It would have been good to have stayed a bit longer to get his artist’s insight on this beautiful city. If I go back to Lisbon I would definitely book again.
I stayed for four weeks and had an amazing time. The place was comfortable and easy to live in. Pedro was fantastic. The location is amazing. I will be back!
What a perfect appartment in a beautiful and very central part of Lisbon. Pedro was friendly, welcoming, interesting and flexible. I loved my stay and only wish it was longer.
Very kind and friendly host! Beautiful house! And excellent neighborhood, close to many interesting things in Lisbon! Highly recommended!

Pedro’s house is amazing. It is located very centrally in Chiado, close to fabulous restaurants, bars and historic attractions. The best suburb in Lisbon. The house itself is full of character, beautifully decorated with Pedro’s own art. The room was very comfortable, very clean and everything I needed. A shared house, so especially good for solo travellers looking to meet people and benefit from the advice of a Lisbon local. Pedro was helpful and kind. 10/10 would recommend!
i loved it! very cute space probably only for one person, great location, nice bathroom and pedro is very nice and accommodating.
Pedro’s apt is beautiful, clean, and close to everything! Already dying to come back.
A great stay - the room was wonderful with a lovely view of the Lisbon harbour and Pedro was the perfect host.

Location, location, location. Single, comfortable room in the attic of an apartment in the old town area. Perfect for just about anything you'd want to do in Lisbon. Pedro is a very kind host and likes to chat. PS ask him to brew up one of his thyme and honey teas - lovely!

El alojamiento en casa de Pedro es fantástico. Excelentemente ubicado, es sencillo y acogedor. Pedro y su hijo fueron amables, la comunicación fue muy fluida, y en la casa todo estaba cuidado.  Estuve charlando con él, y es un hombre inteligente y muy educado, y en la casa se respira el arte. Es un edificio antiguo y bello, no tiene ascensor, pero vale la pena en todos los sentidos. Aunque yo estuve en fiestas, y al lado hay una plaza bulliciosa, el ruido no llegaba a mi ventana, dormí como un bebé. Lo recomiendo totalmente y en cuanto pueda, volveré.

the location was great and Pedro was communicative via text and helpful for check in. that said, I did not realize that this space would also be shared with three other individuals (Pedro, his teenage son and another Airbnb guest). at times it felt a bit crowded given the size of the apartment although every place in Lisbon is likely on the smaller side.
the other minor things to be aware of is that it's quite loud Friday and Saturday evenings (even with earplugs) and the bedroom door doesn't close fully (there's a small gap in between the doors that allows for a view of the bedroom from outside if one peers in), which means no sound proofing in the apartment at all (wooden creaky floors etc).

Bel endroit et situation parfaite
Bon accueil de Pedro
Appartement plein de charme

o Pedro é um excelente anfitrião. O quarto é uma graça e entrega tudo o que o anuncia diz. A localização é ótima, e mesmo sendo uma das ruas do burburinho, não dá pra ouvir barulho.
Adorei ter ficado aqui, e super recomendo.

The photos don't do Pedro's place justice - it's beautifully decorated and very cozy. I would highly recommend this stay!

Pedro's place was a great choice for me - coming from the airport it feels like coming home. A good balance of privacy and yet having other people around too. The apartment has such a nice vibe, love all the details. The room is exactly as described and even though the location is so central, when the window is closed it is nice and quite.
Pedro was very accomodating and helpful, making sure you have a pleasant time in Lisbon. thank you!
Very cozy and nice room in the center of Lissabon

What an incredible place! Pedro was welcoming and easy to get in contact with, the room is small and lovely, and the kitchen is absolutely gorgeous. The flat is in a great location, very close to public transport and not far from wonderful restaurants and beautiful views. Would recommend!
You can expect a good size room with a comfortable bed and a good view.
Charming room in a fantastic location.
Es increíble el lugar , me encantó
Pedro is a nice guy, nice place to stay

I had enjoyed my short stay at Pedro‘s place. It’s centrally located and perfect for exploring Lisbon on foot. The room was clean, gets enough light, and had a cute little balcony to stand and enjoy the vibe of the city.
As Pedro mentioned in the description, the apartment is at an old building that has a bit of sound insulation issue (most old buildings have that and it was not a problem for me).
Pedro was a great host and explained everything properly. The kitchen was well-equipped and the bathroom was clean.
This is a great location to explore Lisbon. Pedro is very easy to work with and nice. there is steps but then this is Lisbon, get used to it.
I had a very good time in Lissabon- thanks to Pedro and the nice room under the roof!
Great location and a very nice spot.  Pedro was a fantastic host.  Highly recommend.

The location of Pedro‘s flat couldn‘t be better. The room is cute and exactly what the pictures show. Pedro and his son
are nice and easy going people.

I had a pleasant stay at Pedro's. The place is quiet so I had a good rest, the location is great and Pedro has been welcoming, helpful and flexible. The apartment is at the 4th floor so stairs are a challenge for carrying big luggage. I recommend the place for those who like the patina of time.

I had a very good time at Pedro's place.
It's a charming apartment and has a very friendly, calm atmosphere.
Very special, in a very positive sense :)
beautiful room in an even prettier apartment. Pedro is very kind, responds very soon and everything went well. Perfect location!
Excellent location! Pedro was very responsive and made me feel welcome during the short stay. Thanks.

Pedro's place is as wonderful as it looks in the photos. Comfy bed, nice hot shower, great little balcony with a nice view, nice decor throughout. Pedro was also very quick and helpful with his responses. Can't recommend this place enough.

Thank you Pedro for everything.
I spent one month in a very lovely room at Pedro’s place.
The flat is well located and Pedro is a very flexible and careful host, who always has good tips and recommendations. I would definitely come back !

The location of Pedro's place couldn't be better. It was my first time to Lisbon and I coudn't have been in a better spot. The place is very charming with a lovely view. I would definitely stay here again.
A very cosy apartment in the centre of Lisbon. Pedro and his son are very friendly.
Pedro's place was perfect, such an amazing location, great value and incredibly characterful. Really highly recommended!
Fantastic location and a comfortable, snug room with everything you need from which to explore Lisbon. It feels like a real home. There's also a tiny balcony for a glass of wine in the evening!

Baixa-ciado 전철역 근처 위치는 엄청 좋았어요. 호스트를 포함한 포루투칼 사람들은 대부분 좋은거 같아요. 질문에 대힌 답도 빨랐습니다. 추웠는데 두꺼비집이 내려가니 히터를 중간으로 밖에 틀수가 없었습니다. ㅠㅠ 함깨 쓰는 공동쌰워욕쪼 넘넘 짝았습니다. 한국 여행책자도 빌려주셨습니다. 저녁을 안 먹고 늦게 도착해서, 과일빵도 빌려 먹었습니다. 화가 가정집이 궁금해서 간다면 괜찮습니다.
Fantastic Stay. Perfect location. Warm welcome. I just staid one night for a connection flight and definitely want to come back!

It was overall a good stay. Perfect location. There has been some miscommunication on Pedros side, like having to ask to use the kitchen, you should be aware of that, he is very specific about his stuff. But very respectful and nice.
Great apartment with even better host
Great place right in the heart of Lisbon

Great clean place in a building near the center of town! There are a lot of steps as it’s on the 4th floor but the view from the room and balcony is superb! Pedro helped me print out documents I needed and I felt very welcome. Thanks again

사진에는 다락방 천장에 창문이 있는 방인데 다른 방으로 주셨어요. 그 창문이 있는 방에 로망이 있어 온거였어서 아쉬웠지만 방이 이뻐서 즐겁게 지냈습니다.

Pedro's room I had was big enough for 1 person and was comfortable. He was very agreeable and attentive about what I needed. The flat is very well situated, at most 10 min of several stations and near the centre. Nice stay I would recommend to have in Lisbon. Thank you Pedro!
Sweet place with kind pedro!

La ubicación es posiblemente la mejor de todo Lisboa, está cerca de todo, desde el barrio alto a la plaza de comercio. had a great stay at the room in Pedros appartement. Pedro ist a great host, would definitly recommend it.

That was perfect! I loved the old (1780) palace with paints of old portughese ships. Pedro was very kind and helpfull. I felt like at home.
Great place with a great location. It's in the city center. Plus pedro is really friendly and helpful.

La stanza è molto bella. Perfetta per una/due persone.

Fantástico espaço, acolhedor e limpo, inspirador e muito bem localizado. Pedro foi muito bom anfitrião, me recebeu bem e me deixou bastante a vontade. Lindíssimas artes por todos os lados do flat. Voltarei!

Die Wohnung von Pedro liegt wunderbar zentral in einem alten charaktervollen Haus. Das Zimmer ist groß und sauber, ich habe mich dort super wohl gefühlt. Alles ist perfekt zu Fuß zu erreichen und die Metro und die Straßenbahn sind auch direkt um die Ecke. Es war der perfekte Aufenthalt für mich.
Great place!
Pedro's place is in a perfect location in the heart of historic Lisboa. He is Avery good host and full of excellent recommendations for your stay.

I had a geat stay at Pedro's Attic room.  Pedro is very welcoming and checked me in  in person. The room is clean, well lit, airy, large and very comfortable. The location is unbeatible, specially for those visiting Lisboa for the first time willing to be staying in a very central , strategical location steps to public transportation., bars , restaurants, and a numberof  tourist spots.

A fantastic host who makes you feel at home and is very helpful.
Simply said you cannot go wrong here.
The location is perfect and Pedro was an amazing person who help me a lot. I’d love to stay there again!

Eigenwillige Kreativität in jedem Gegenstand, dazu alles typisch für einen Altbau. Ein Glück für die Übernachtungsgäste.

Absolutely central and thus perfect location. The host is super nice and won't interfere with anything but still provides useful tips.
I enjoyed my stay and would always recommend Pedro as a host.
Amazing place and Pedro is super helpful and nice

Pedro’s house is wonderfully atmospheric with its original walls, wood floors, tall ceilings and tiny balconies on all sides giving it good views and fresh air. Pedro is super-accommodating. You can’t go wrong staying here!

I stayed only for 1 night at Pedro's and was very happy with it. The apartment is in the very centre of Lisboa. The room was very clean and had everything I needed.

Espaço muito lindo e único, e localização ótima - adorei me hospedar aqui durante meu tempo em Lisboa.

Where to start - Pedro’s apartment is incredible! I was initially going to stay at a  hostel but decided to stay here on a whim. I was not disappointed! Pedro was extremely gracious with check-in/out times and so accommodating! The apartment was not only clean, well-kept, comfortable, and artistic but the building is beautiful and everything is so serene. I honestly don’t think the listing pictures do this place justice, if I would’ve paid 3x as much it still would’ve been worth it. Run, don’t walk to Pedro’s attic loft!
Great place, great central location, near the Metro. Nice room and comfortable bed. Pedro is a friendly man, he explained everything. I liked the place very much.

A very homey feel to this Airbnb, a home away from home. Fast WiFi, big bathroom but shower under an angled wall so may be difficult to shower if you’re tall!! A nice touch was a hanging rail with hangers to hang my clothes. Great host, friendly, great directions from airport to the flat via metro. Thanks for the great stay!!
Great location
Very nice place and people. Recommend :)
Absolut empfehlenswert! Es passte alles.. danke Pedro!

I feel very fortunate.  He and his young son are so very nice!  Loved having a peek into their domestic daily lives.  If your needs are low, then the experience is wonderful.
위치가 좋아서 편리했어요. 가까이에 맛있는 커피가 있는 카페도 있고, 꼭대기층이라 매우 힘들지만 그만큼 미니테라스에서 일출 일몰을 살짝 볼 수 있어요. 콤콤한냄새가 나는건 어쩔수없는거 같아서 예민하신분은 피하세요. 그 외에는 아티스틱한 집, 코지한 느낌의 다락방과 화장실, 친절한 호스팅까지 잘 머물다 갑니다!

Frendly and good host Pedro. If i visit Lisboa again, also choose this room.

Pedro’s place is a little gem in a perfect location! Full of character and charm, I really enjoyed staying and definitely recommend it! Obrigado!

Very central and beautiful location. Pedro is very nice, helpful and gives clear instructions.

Great place to stay - perfect location !
The room is clean and well decorated. I like the way the sunlight come into the room. Bathroom is clean. I had a good stay for 4 nights in Lisbon.

Pedro s Place is very special and beautifully decorated, located in a nice old building with an impressive wooden  hallway. He is a very kind and lovely person and we had an interesting conversation at the breakfast table. I would definitely go there again!

Pedro is a great host with a very nice apartment.

Thank you. Great location, super kind, and loved Lisbon!
여행 다니면서 묵었던 그 어떤 숙소보다 아름답고 멋졌어요. 집 지으면 페드로 집처럼 꾸미고 싶어요. 진짜 강추! 위치도 주요 랜드마크 가깝고 좋아요. 집이 굉장히 오래되서 삐걱삐걱 나무 소리가 나지만 오래되서 더 매력적인것 같아요.

I stayed at Pedro's place for one night and left Lisbon wishing I had stayed there for all the days we spent in the city. The apartment is in the heart of the city and literally less than a block away from the park where many free walking tours start. It's also really close to the metro and a stop for tram 28 (if you're feeling touristy). Coming here from the airport was as simple and cheap as a metro ticket. The space is on the 4th floor and there is no elevator, but it lends a beautiful view of the surrounding streets and is delightfully quieter than being on a lower floor. It is a little warm during the day since it is the attic space, but there is a fan in the room and overall temperatures in Lisbon cool off considerably at night. Plus, who spends all day in the room when you're on vacation?
Overall, I loved this building. Yes- you will have to take the stairs each time you return, but I really didn't mind because there is a lot to admire about the wide staircase and age of the building in general. Pedro can tell you how old it is and he can also speak incredibly fluent English!

Pedro is a great host and the flat as well as the room are wonderful. Pedro recommended nice restaurants and places to visit. You will have a great time when you come here.
Pedro was a wonderful host and was very hospitable, ensuring that I had a comfortable stay in Lisbon. If you can, travel light as his apartment is on the top floor. Thanks Pedro for everything !
O apartamento é estiloso já que é casa de artista. Ambiente limpo e muito bem localizado, pois apesar de estar em um bairro altamente turístico, ele fica em uma rua silenciosa.

The place is very centrally located. One should be aware that there is a 4 floor walk up which was  good exercise.  I highly recommend and will definitely stay there again.

Lovely room in charismatic apartment and great location.

Very central and genuine and artistic flat.

Great place to stay. Had a wonderful time!

Séjour très agréable, dans cet appartement spacieux, plein de caractère  et de touches de créativité. Je m'y suis sentie comme chez moi. Le seul bémol est que quatre étages sans ascenseur en fin de journée, c'est haut (l'escalier est magnifique et classé, ce qui peut donner du courage).
Nice place! Really cool and great location. Pedro is a great host.

Charming artistic top floor suite perfectly located in the lively Bairro Alto district. You can even enjoy the great music of amazing musicians playing in street from the little balcony in the room. Great stay here in a lovely apartment

Cuisine : vu l'état du placard à vaisselle, nous avons lavé la vaisselle avant de l'utiliser, la cafetière filtre ne fonctionne pas, la hotte est pleine de graisse qui nous a dissuadé de cuisiner de peur des retombées dans la casserole, la porte du frigifaire est cassée aucun rengement possible dans la porte pour mettre une bouteille debout, le freezer est plein de glace qui empêche la fermeture de la porte.
Salle de bain : receveur de douche jaune, le rideau est plein de tâches marron qui font penser à des excréments, papier toilette posé sur une boite hors d'âge pas de dérouleur.
Chambre pas de chevet ni de lampe comme présenté sur les photos, l'armoire est une demie armoire comparée à la photo, il n'y a que des cintres sans aucune étagère.
Le ménage n'est pas fait ou pas correctement, seul les draps et serviettes étaient propres
Nous ne recommandons pas du tout ce logement

Logement vétuste qui nécessite quelques rénovations : pas de mitigeur dans la cuisine, fenêtre de la salle de bain impossible à ouvrir donc énormément d’humidité, rideau de douche moisi, cuvette des toilettes fortement abîmée, portes qui restent bloquées, eaux usées qui remontent dans la douche avec différents ingrédients (pas mal si vous voulez boire une bonne soupe !), vieux matelas à ressorts très inconfortable qui ne permet pas de se reposer tranquillement et linge de lit tachés ! (on a eu le malheur de regarder sous le lit et on a découvert une nouvel écosystème…). Pour finir après avoir fait de nombreux logements à Lisbonne cet appartement était vraiment mal isolé et très bruyant.
Néanmoins l’hôte a été réactif et cordial, l’emplacement est très bon. Appartement qui a du charme mais nécessite grandement un ménage de printemps.
loved it!

La ubicación es buena y el trato por parte de Ricardo han sido muy bueno. El estado del apartamento deja mucho que desear, en las escaleras del portal por las noches a veces no funciona la luz por lo tanto no hay visión y las escaleras están bastante inclinadas, la casa bastante fría y carece de mantas auxiliares (solo un edredón en la cama), y dos radiadores eléct. Muebles en general bastante deteriorados y antiguos, el colchón es lo más triste que he encontrado en todas mis estancias en Airbnb sinceramente.. colchón de muelles, viejo y con agujeros importantes en su estructura por lo que dormir y descansar es algo inviable en esas condiciones,y ya por último en las reglas pone que no se puede hacer ruido de 21 a 8 y me parece correcto, sin embargo, la vecina de arriba TODOS LOS DIAS a las 7 de la mañana se encarga de despertarte con su radio a todo volumen. Para un día de paso está bien por la ubicación, para una estancia un poco más larga como en nuestro caso, no lo recomiendo.
Хозяин был очень вежливый и помог быстро заселиться. Квартира удобная и уютная. Самый лучший опыт пребывания в Лисабоне
Amazing location, amazing house, very neat and clean. The host was very nice. Perfect 💜

Die Wohnung war leider nicht wirklich wie der Eindruck den die Bilder vermittelt haben. Es war nicht besonders gemütlich und alles wirkte relativ alt und abgenutzt. Die Matratze war wirklich sehr unbequem und auf der Bettwäsche waren einige Flecken. Die Lage der Wohnung war sehr gut aber das alleine reicht für uns nicht um einen Preis wie diesen für eine Wohnung zu gerechtfertigen.

I stayed at Alexandre place couple of days and it was really good, pictures matched the place and the management person was right on on my messages, I would stay there again on the future. It’s a great apartment for spending a few days in Lisbon. The place is quiet and very close to the nightlife and main monuments. Great connections and close to the main street in case of coming by car

El apartamento tenía todas las comodidades que necesitamos para una estadía placentera. Con un estilo muy pintoresco y agradable. El barrio era bonito y el anfitrión muy atento con nosotros. Volveremos!
Super recomendamos !
Muy bueno!!!
Beautiful flat, great location,  walking distance from most attractions and spots. a tiny bit loud (neighbours and pets) but super worth the price, would book it again for our next trip to Lisbon

A zona muito boa. Lugar bem aconchegante. Os pontos negativos são: a cama muito ruim, os móveis muito antigo e se ouve muito barulho dos carros lá em baixo. O Alexandre muito prestativo e simpático. 👍🏻
Great location and a super flat.  Loved it.
Alexandre’s place was in a great location! Usually within walking distance to where we wanted to go. Check in was easy and the apartment had everything we needed.
Localização perfeita, apartamento ótimo e confortável! Já queremos nos hospedar novamente.
A gorgeous stay in a gorgeous apartment! This was the perfect base for exploring Lisbon.
großartige Lage mitten in Alfalma und in direkter Nähe zum Bahnhof. Die Unterkunft hätte an sich sauberer sein können im Besonderen im Bad. Die Küche wurde von uns nicht benutzt.
Great location and very clean apartment. I would recommend this apartment to others and definitely stay again!
Alexandre was always responsive. Great location. Couldn’t fault it.

L’appartement est vraiment agréable, bien situé et joliment décoré. En revanche, pour 126€ la nuit pour deux, on espérait pouvoir mieux se reposer. Le lit nous a semblé assez inconfortable : mon conjoint et moi avons mal dormi et je me suis même réveillée avec le dos bloqué. Après une semaine en van, on pensait qu’un lit d’appartement serait plus reposant que notre matelas improvisé, mais ça n’a malheureusement pas été le cas. Thank you a lot for the stay. Everything is as expected and very lovely hosts :)

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour dans cet appartement idéalement situé au pied du quartier d’Alfama. Sa localisation hyper centrale permet de tout visiter à pied. Place was clean and nice. I loved the Alfama area so the location was perfect. Close to good restaurants and fado! Would recommend.

It was a lovely introduction to Lisbon. Perfectly located, walking distance from public transport and most sites. Opposite the recycling bins so a little noisy late at night. We stayed in the heatwave so aircon instead of fans would have been great.. but we loved it!
Great stay, location, overall extremely nice and I would definitely recommend.

Alex’s flat is very convenient for the area and is nicely decorated, but the general impression of the location is that it is dirty and not very well kept.

Every thing was nearby , awesome location, cozy apartment,, all are sounding good

Top locatie, prachtig appartement en leuk balkonnetje!

We had a great time at this flat! It was a great space in a great location with all the amenities you could need. Communication with Alexandre was great and all of the check in and check out instructions were very clear. Thank you for a great stay!

Nice, simple and clean apartment. Nicely decorated. Near many restaurants and small stores to buy essentials.
Bernardo was friendly and professional. He responded to all our questions. The walls are thin but overall we recommend this place.

This place is in a great location in Alfama, a lovely neighbourhood to explore and walking distance to most parts of the city. The apartment is nice and spacious albeit a little cold at night and can be a little noisy. Although, nothing unexpected for a city centre apartment.
Lovely little apartment, very easy check in and out. Thank you for a lovely stay!
Perfect location, nice stay.

Très bel appartement, bien situé et conforme aux photos. La communication avec l’hôte a été excellente. Les transports en commun sont à proximité et il y a des supérettes juste en dessous.

Nous venons d'y passer 2 jours et l'appartement est très bien situé dans le quartier Alfama. Alexandre nous a permis d'avoir le logement un peu plus tôt ce qui a été très apprécie. Par contre, le lit est vraiment inconfortable, on ressent les ressorts et au matin nous sommes mal en point.

We enjoyed our stay at this apartment as it was really nice and had lots of natural light. The apartment was cosy and had all the amenities listed in a good condition. The host was super friendly and responsive. Definitely would recommend the stay here.

Alexandre’s place was very close to the most of the sightseeings. Was in an old neighborhood in the central part of the Lisbon.

Wir waren für zwei Tage in Lissabon und dafür war die Lage sehr gut. Wir wurden sehr freundlich empfangen und haben viele Tipps für Lissabon erhalten. Alles war wie beschrieben, nur das Sofa und das Bett sind sehr hart und leider nicht wirklich bequem, für 2 Tage aber okay.

Great apartment in the heart of the city. Alexandre was very responsive and helpful. I will be happy to go back anytime.

Logement bien placé et lumineux. Hôte précis. Peut être un peu bruyant le matin.

The location of the accommodation is very good though which we enjoyed.
A good option to stay if you want to be in the centre of it all. Nice apartment and great host!
Espaço e localidade maravilhosa, anfitrião atencioso e prestativo.Gostamos muito.Esperamos voltar em outro momento.
The apartment is beautiful and central. It is within walking distance to many places. Thank you so much Alexandre for hosting us.

This was my second stay with Alexandre, and I would do it again!
Lovely flat, perfect location for old town and very near metro stations. Was great for a week long stay and we were given recommendations for restaurants and activities!

L'appartement d'Alexandre bénéficie d'un excellent rapport qualité/prix. Il est situé dans le quartier d'Alfama et est très bien situé. La place du Commerce et le centre ville sont accessibles en 10-15 minutes de marche.

1. Bernardo (the secondary host/management) was great- there was no soap in the bathroom, he got us soap within the hour. He was very kind!
2. The location is excellent
3. The natural light is really nice. The living room is a great space, letting in plenty of natural light.

A great stay! It's a beautiful apartment in a great location that's only a few minutes from most tourist attractions and transportation! Will definitely stay here again when I come back to Lisbon!

We had a perfect stay in this apartment! Easy to find, well located in an area with lots of typical restaurants and walkable from everything to see in Lisbon! Alexandre was a very accommodating host, always responsive and clear! Great experience!
Очень чистая и уютная квартира со всем необходимым для комфортного пребывания. Отзывчивые хозяева. Обязательно вернусь туда снова
We had a great stay! Alexandre was great at communication and the place was in a wonderful location. Super roomy and lots of natural light. So nice to have a washing machine and stove.

Es hat einfach alles gepasst und wir haben eine tolle Zeit in Lissabon verbracht. Die Pastelleria Guadelupe gleich unter der Wohnung bietet tolles Frühstück und Mittagessen, gleich neben dem Hauseigentümer befindet sich ein kleiner Lebensmittelladen.
Die Lage ist toll, denn außerhalb vom zentralen Touristentrubel aber trotzdem alles zu Fuß perfekt erreichbar.

zu dritt (Paar mit Baby) war das Bett km Schlafzimmer etwas eng, aber wir haben dann auch das Sofa im Wohnzimmer zum Schlafen dazu genommen.
Der Gastgeber war sehr zuvorkommend mit jeder Anfrage.
Good little flat, amazing location.

The property's location proved advantageous, situated amidst local shops and within proximity to various attractions, restaurants, and transportation hubs. The house itself offered tidy and adequate accommodation for my wife and I through our 5-nights stay, allowing us to settle in comfortably with our luggage.
Communication with Alexander was pleasant and effective, as he provided a comprehensive guide to Lisbon with clear instructions.
However, our experience was marred by a common issue in Lisbon: mold. The pervasive smell upon entering the house, coupled with inadequate ventilation, posed discomfort and affected our ability to rest, particularly on the first night.
Furthermore, discrepancies between the house and its advertised depiction were disappointing: the sofa bed proved smaller and uncomfortable, chairs and side tables were missing, and the wardrobe was notably smaller than anticipated. Additionally, the absence of bedside lighting, an oven deviated from our expectations.

I’d be very happy to recommend this place but I’d advise avoiding the shop on the right hand side of the apartment (we’re pretty sure we got scammed).

Lovely little apartment in Alfama, wooden floor, lots of light. the kitchen could use a little love but all in all we were very happy with our stay. Alexandre was very friendly and did attend to every question or request . Thanks! :)

Logement bien situé, permet de visiter Lisbonne à pieds (loin du quartier Belém). Inconvenient : très bruyant (chien dans l’immeuble qui aboie souvent et vous réveil à 6h30-7h tous les matins) et bruit de la rue car pas d’isolation phonique.

Lovely stay at Alexandre's place. The location is handy to explore the city and the flat is cosy & clean. Diogo, who did the check-in, was very friendly & easy-going and gave us useful local tips about restaurants & places to visit. Highly recommended if you're going Lisbon!
It was super easy to communicate with Alexandre. He was very helpful and accommodating. The apartment was really comfey and central, which made the stay very pleasant. Thanks, Alexandre and Diogo!

Overall great value, great location. Would consider staying there again. Ran into an issue with the keys and the door, which was fixed relatively speedily. The host’s cousin Diogo was very helpful! Would recommend, perfect location!

Alexandre and his cousin are great hosts and waited patiently and kindly for our late arrival through the traffic jam. Thank you for your kindness and for welcoming us with such hospitality. The apartment is in an unbeatable location, cleanliness is good and has everything you need to make your stay enjoyable, although access is uncomfortable by the stairs and the state of the building. It is very difficult to sleep, not because of the comfort of the beds, but because the neighborhood is very noisy. Since there is no heating, the radiators must be plugged in and they are very noisy.
In spite of that we have greatly enjoyed your accommodation and hope to return soon to Lisbon.
Recomendado,  buena ubicación y excelente comunicación con Alexandre. Departamento muy limpio y moderno

The location was very good, we were able to walk everywhere in the city center. The apartment was clean, the sheets, towels, bathroom, kitchen were all spotless. They even included mosquito repellers, which is a nice touch. Our host was waiting for us at the property, he introduced us to the apartment and he gave us priceless tips about Lisbon. Being a classic Alfama apartment, it is somewhat small but it didn’t bother us much. Thanks for the hospitality.

Sehr saubere und gut gelegene Wohnung. Schnell ist man in Lissabon Downtown, sowie Alfama. Öffentliche Verkehrsmittel erreicht man sehr schnell zu Fuß, Metro ca. 5-10min Fussweg. Busse erreicht man ebenfalls Schnell. Cafés Restaurants und Kleine Läden sind in Unmittelbarer Nähe des Apartments. Apartment hat freies WiFi, hat eine Küche die ich selber nicht genutzt habe, und ein Bad mit Dusche. Das Apartment befindet sich im 3 Stock eines älteren Gebäudes, Die Treppe ist schmal und eng. Clean, stylish flat, fantastic location!

Rodrigo, cousin d'Alexandre, a été adorable par son accueil.
Des gestes bien attentionnés, des explications très utiles ont été bien agréables.
Super emplacement à proximité de tout.
Merci
Great location for this cute apartment. Alexandre was very nice, good communication and helpful. We had a great stay at his place.
Extraordinary apartment close to the city center and great hospitality. We had a great time. We can definitely recommend this special place!

Perfect stay, could love to come back again and stay with alexandre 's apartment again. Thank you

Great apartment located conveniently in Alfama but not too noisy. The shower is fantastic and the apartment is stylish and extremely comfortable. Diogo took time during check in to learn what we like and then made perfect suggestions for us. I highly recommend this spot and would stay here again for sure!!

O apartamento é bem agradável, a zona tem restaurantes e mercadinhos . O único probleminha  pode ser a escadaria . Eu estava com problemas na mão , mas é um problema meu , não do apartamento em si . De resto , fomos bem recebidos . A claridade é ótima do apartamento.

The apartment is very bright (good natural light) and the mattress comfortable. It is walking distance to a lot of restaurants, shopping, and other nightlife, as well as museums and some castles. It is also close to a supermarket located in the nearby train station, where we stocked up on fruit, yogurt, and other snacks.
The downside for us was that The neighborhood was noisy into the night.

To be fair, I should first qualify this by saying my sister and I are 60 years old although we are both very active and have good mobility.  Even so, I would say this Airbnb is much more suited to young people who don’t mind going up and down 3 flights of very narrow, steep and treacherous stairs.  (Unless you have a night out drinking!) Check in was fine, water pressure was good,  location was good.  It was clean. Dining table chairs need to go back in the dumpster where they came from. They were not safe to sit on.  Artwork is a nice touch.  We would not stay in this apartment again, but perhaps one of their other ones would have been more suitable for us.
Great location in Alfama. All was as expected and without any problems besides a narrow entry stair. Would recommend.

The location is amazing. You can easily walk to most major attractions in central Lisbon. The apartment was older but well maintained and nicely decorated. It gets a little bit warm and keeping the windows open lets bugs in but it was cool enough at night and fans were provided. We would definitely stay again. Note that you have to climb three flights of very narrow stairs to get to the apartment so those with mobility concerns may have issues.

very nice host, reactive and helpfull. The appartment is nicely situated in Lisbon. A little bit noisy at night (neighbours and street noises). The appartement is globbaly well furbished but the chairs are way too small for the little table in the living room. There are so old that it is tottally unpleasant to sit on it. It is therefore impossible to eat in the appartment.

Cute and very centrally located apartment in Alfama with everything you might need. Alexandre was very helpful and attentive. I would definitely stay again! Some of the chairs were more decorative than functional but that was only an issue since we were using the sofa bed.

A beautiful, super clean and perfectly located apartment with wonderful hosts!
The apartment has everything you need to feel at home ! The neighborhood can be a bit loud but that is expectable considering it’s location! Overall, we do recommend this place to other travelers!
Very clean, nice details at the apartment and very friendly communication.

우선 위치는 리스본 명소와 20분정도 떨어져있어서 다 보고 집으로 돌아오는 길에 다리가 굉장히 아팠습니다 그리고 마트와도 600미터 떨어져 있다고 나오는데 기본 15분은 걸어야 하구요 가격은 12만원인데 정말 가격대비 너무 별로에요 주방있고 쇼파있고 티비 다 갖춰져 있지만 그냥 딱 아~ 있구나 이정도? 솔직히 많은 에어비앤비도 다녀봤고 호스텔 호텔 한인민박 다녀봤지만 그냥 똑같은 가격이라면 고급 호텔을 추천드릴게요
Alexandre’s place was great. Ideal location, walking distance to anywhere, comfortable, nicely decorated, lots of sunlight. Check in was easy. I would definitely stay there again.

Great location and the apartment was super clean. We loved the open windows and the city sounds. The steep flight of stairs wasn’t an issue for us, but could be a challenge for others.  Check in was made easy by our friendly host.
Great host and place. Will definitely recommend.
Great atmosphere,  perfect location. The host was awesome and worked with our check in times

Quaint space with a great location within walking distance of the Train and metro station, major sites, restaurants and shopping.  All the conveniences of a home including a washer. Excellent hébergement,  jolie déco, et emplacement très pratique pour visiter Lisbonne
Great location and great host! Thank you!

This was our first experience with Airbnb and it was fantastic. Alexandre's place is very central and walking distance to multiple must-see sites. The apartment was an ideal size and close to restaurants, groceries etc. Would highly recommend it.

We entered a bright, cozy gem of a space that concentrated the color and light of Lisbon like a prism. After viewing the street from one of the small balconies, then taking a walk, we grasped what others meant by “the perfect location.” You are on the lower edge of the Alfama, where it sweeps into the Baixa—with easy access to the Alta and Chiado (to name only two). The street shimmies with residents of this still-authentic neighborhood, along with a quiet, steady flow of fellow travelers. Light streams through in the morning (there are shutters to dim it) and fills the space with a day-long glow. Alexandre was very responsive, clear, and kind— even arranging for us to check in many hours early. His cousin Diogo, who greeted us warmly, gave a helpful orientation to Lisbon and the unit. Surfboard Apartment— well-equipped, exactly as represented, and perfect for a couple fleeing pre-fab travel— was the high point of a magical visit. Pessoa would have loved it.
Beautiful location
Perfect base for exploring Lisbon,we had an amazing long weekend and the apartment was the perfect place to come back to.

I had a great time staying at Alexandre's place.

Everything is in walking distance.
Tolle Lage in der Alfama, sehr originell, liebevoll und individuell eingerichtet, alles da, was man für einen tollen Aufenthalt braucht. Absolut empfehlenswert!
호스트와의 의사소통, 위치가 좋았습니다! 단지 욕실에 대한 보수, 숙소의 온도는 고려해야할것입니다! 하지만 바르셀로나가 관광의메카라는것또한 고려해야합니다!

Great place and great hospitality! Alexandre was out of town but had a wonderful family member meet us for check in, and he helped us out by providing great recommendations for sites and restaurants. We loved the bottle of wine, cheese, and water on arrival. The location is fine as well, right by the water, and walking distance to several places in Alfama. Not very close to a metro stop but an Uber ride in the city is fast and cheap. I would recommend this apartment.
Great location in Alfama, close to amenities and public transport plus  lovely breakfast place 5mn away, Alfama Doce, highly recommend!
tres bon accueil, bonne dispo. l appartement est agreable, tres bien situé et cosy.

Chouette adresse pour un séjour à 4. Bien situé au calme, facile d'accès, commerces autour du logement (supérette, petits bistrots et restos). A recommander pour visiter Lisbonne entre amis ou en famille (sauf si vous avez une poussette... situé au 3ème et pas d'ascenseur).

Had a great stay at one of the little old homes I had been admiring immensely.
The wine, snacks and water bottles were a nice touch.

L'appartement d'Alexandre est très bien situé. Le quartier est très agréable à visiter.
Vous trouverez ce qu'il faut dans l'appartement et en restaurant dans le coin.

Situé au bord de l’Alfama, l’appartement est superbe et suffisant pour 2 personnes. À côté de tout même si nous aurions préféré être d’avantage au cœur du quartier. Le logement est parfait, avec une déco "topissime" , il y a tout et c'est super propre . Emplacement idéal, situé au pied de l'Alfama, on peut tout faire à pied...les restos, les bus, les taxis, la gare à 5 mn...

Alexandre's place was in a sparkling clean and in a great location.  Everything was comfortable and we enjoyed our stay very much. Thanks!

Great location, lovely windows which you can open and hear the city life. There is a great bakers below for breakfast. Yes there are uneven steps but it's an old building. For a short break it's fine.

Very cute place, stylishly decorated and located in a great area. All the great restaurants were nearby, as well as the Museum of Fado across the street. It’s located in a very walkable and historic area, close to most of Lisbon’s attractions.
The apartment was cozy, had all the needed amenities and communication with host was easy and fast. Highly recommended.
The surfboard apartment is in a great location and Alexandre and Diogo are excellent hosts.

Stayed with my husband for 4 nights. We really enjoyed our stay!
Alexandre's was unable to meet us in person but her arranged Cristiano who was fantastic and gave us lots of great tips. The place was very comfortable, good internet, giant towels, awesome light when the doors are opened and funky character everywhere. I enjoyed the old staircase leading up to the apartment it was authentic. The neighborhood is perfect. We walked all over night and day. There are restaurants and shops everywhere. Tons to do and see. Definitely recommend!
Special thank you for being able to hold our luggage past check out. It significantly helped us out :-)

Alexandre’s place is in an ideal location for exploring Alfama and rest of Lisbon. We walked to see amazing Fado music right around the corner on our first night in town. The apartment has very cute decor and a nice balcony for some fresh air. Lovely spot.
Great location!

Wir haben im Juli 3 Tage im Appartement verbracht. Die Wohnung ist sehr schön eingerichtet und es ist alles vorhanden was man benötigt. Alexandre hat immer sehr schnell geantwortet.

Alexandre is a wonderful host. It was of immense help that he let us check-in early, since we arrived bleary-eyed and jet-lagged, toting our luggage in the morning. The apartment is in the heart of the Alfema district, famous for Fado music. It is within walking distance of several great places. Since Fado begins later in the evening, it is nice to walk back easily. This apartment allows you to experience Lisbon beautifully.
We loved our stay at this apartment, it is in a great location and Alexandre and his cousin were SO helpful.  It was a great way to kick off our honeymoon

It was a pleasure to stay there. The flat was clean, nicely designed and really close to the center. You can get into the buzzing city life in only a few minutes. We had everything we wished for in the flat, thank you, Alexandre!

logement parfait pour deux personnes.
Eviter le canapé du salon en juin ( 13 au 18 pour nous) lorsqu'il y a de la musique via hauts-parleurs dans la rue jusqu'à environ minuit.

Super centrally located and easy to walk around the Alfama neighborhood. Also, walking distance (~8 min) to Santa Apolonia station for those talking an early train up to Porto. This apartment is clean and perfect for a couple staying in Lisbon. Alexandre let us drop off our bags early which was super helpful. great apartment and location exactly what we wanted.  terrific value and central to the best neighborhood. we met Philippa, she was great and from there everything went smooth.  would highly recommend!!

If you like to be in the heart & soul of Lisbon you will love this place. Great location, within walking distance of endless restaurants, metro stations and historic sights. Well equipped apartment with fast WiFi and a lovely feel altogether. Looking forward to returning one day

Nice place, clean with good decoration. The appartment is fully equiped with everything you need. Alexandre could not be there, but his cousin Filipa took care of helping me settle in. She was very helpful and welcoming. Gave me plenty of tips to enjoy the city.

We were able to walk to other neighborhoods as well and enjoyed exploring the city on foot.  We would absolutely recommend staying here if you are planning a trip to Lisbon!

Alexandre is an excellent host, helpful, accommodating and quick to respond.

at the heart of the Alfama. An excellent baker's shop (for splendid pasteis de nata) is almost next door and good, genuine Portuguese restaurants and excellent fado houses are 2minutes walk away. Do visit the Museu de Fado!

Logement bien situé au coeur du quartier alfama vivant proche des stations bus metro et tram. Toutes commodités à proximité (bar, restaurants, superette...). Appartement calme, propre et bien équipé. Plein de bonnes informations et offre des produits locaux en bien venus. Je recommande vivement. Notre sejour sait tres bien passé.

Appartement très bien situé, lumineux , bien décoré, réconfortant après une journée de visite.

Gospodarze bardzo mili i pomocni. na miejscu sporo materiałów dot. zwiedzania. Powiedzą również gdzie zjesć coś lokalnego, etc.

parfaitement situé en plein cœur de la ville historique.

Excellent location. Cool, modern and clean apartment. Thanks to Alexandre and his cousin Filipa for their kindness. So good experience in Lisbon for me and my friend Veronica!

The apartment is as advertised. Central to Alfama. A few minutes to the central shopping area.

Un accueil parfait à notre arrivée dans les lieux et de petites attentions très agréables.

Superbe expérience et bonus déco !

What a fun place to stay! Host was so amazing Always checking in and was available if the need arose. The location off sets the noise of the unit by far!

We loved the location as it’s close to a lot of great restaurants. The apartment is smaller than the photos imply. Lovely appartment. Close to everything in Alfarma. Alexandre has a great hospitallity.

What an amazing apartment! The location is great for exploring Lisbon, especially Alfama. Not as nice as the pictures show. The bed was too small for a couple and it was a very firm mattress. VERY loud as you're on a busy street. Not a problem for us- but note that the entryway stairs are steep and hard to climb with luggage.
Fantastic location for tourists.
Would not book again.

This apartment is ideal for people wanting to experience the Alfama district while being able to easily get into the heart of Lisbon. The apartment was clean and so very comfortable. Alexandre was very welcoming and helpful. Fully recommend staying here!

Alexandre's place was great, exactly like described and has a lot of personality. The location is great and there are lots of restaurants nearby. It was also very easy to reach Alexandre and everything went smoothly.
Alexandre's place is located close to the railway station. You are right in the centre of things in Alfama - it could be a bit noisy for some. A lot of stairs to up to the apartment.
Great! Exactly how it's described!
The apartment was lovely in a very authentic area of Lisbon. Alexandre was very kind and I can only recommend to stay there!
Funky little apartment in heart of Alfama. Thanks Alexandre!

Appartement idéalement situé pour découvrir la ville ! Le quartier de l'Alfama est vraiment génial.
Alexandre s'est montré très gentil et très accueillant.
Petit plus pour la décoration qui est superbe !
I loved the apartment and the neighboorhood was so beautiful!
Nice, cute and comfortable apartment in the historical area. The railway station and supermarket is 7 min walking, lots of restaurants around.
Nice appartment in the middle of a lively neighbourhood
This appartement is perfectly located to visit Lisboa. The place is really nice and well furnished and Alexander was very helping during all our trip.

The apartment was very cool and in a great location. Just a note to guest that the four flights of stairs to get up to the apartment are pretty steep and are not lit at night. Other then that it's a very good place to stay.

Alexandre was very nice to work with and we all loved staying at his place! Very close to the town and walking was easy. He was always willing to help and communication was easy. Thanks for everything!
Great location, host was very responsive. Stay here on your trip to Lisbon. Small, cozy, hip little apartment!
Super cute and great location! We loved staying at Alexandre's place which is perfectly situated for exploring the Alfama district and beyond. He is an excellent host.

Great place to be in lisboa and great host always available
If I come back in Lisboa I'm looking for alexandre apartments for sure !

If you are looking for a nice cosy place snuggled in the heart of down town Lisboa then look no further! Unfortunately, Alexandre was unable to meet me but his cousin Filipa was at the flat to welcome me. The two were always reachable to assist. I look forward to returning soon.

Wonderful place to stay right in the Alfama. Easy walk to downtown's main area or the train station.
Great host.
Perfect location, awesome deco, great welcome. All is there in Alexandre's place to make your stay perfect!

Alexandre's place was rad. Highly recommend – cowabunga! :)

Super lieux pour un séjour en plein coeur de Lisbonne.
Petite épicerie et resstaurants au pied de l'appartement.
This place is lovely and exactly as shown. Communication was easy and pleasant. Highly recommend. Many thanks to Alexandre.

My 2 friends and I stayed in Alexandre's apartment and had a great time! It's in a perfect location to explore Lisbon from, with plenty of restaurants and bars close by. I would definitely recommend this apartment to friends.

It's been a great stay at Alexandre's apartment. Location is perfect for exploring the city, check-in was super.

Alexandre was very communicative and flexible about trying to coordinate a place to stow our bags when we checked out. I would definitely recommend Alexandre's place to anyone visiting Lisbon!
Alexandre's apartment is perfectly located in Alfama. My friends and I were able to easily walk around Lisboa's main neighborhoods and access convenience stores for groceries. Totally recommended!

The app is located in the old town , an actually u can get by feet everywhere. Alexandre's place is the perfect place to start your discovery of Lisbon. The apartment is clean, comfortable and close to everything. Localisation parfaite, et appartement impeccable!

Alexandre was so helpful and accommodating. His place is very comfortable and centrally located - close to great restaurants, sight seeing and, most importantly, the train to the beaches ! I hope to be back soon.

Really nice flat and welcoming host, the flat is situated in a residential area where we could easily go by foot visiting some monuments and nice places to eat. Alexandre was very welcoming and helpful, I recommend his flat for a trip in Lisboa!

Alex's place is the heart of Alfama district. It is very clean and offers lots of amenities. o appartamento esta maravilhosa !

Fabulous flat, perfect location and fantastic host!  Our family had everything we needed, plus great recommendations from our host.  Thank you!!!
Great place in a great area, perfect as a base to explore the city. Alexandre was a wonderful host, we would definitely come back, very recommendable!

Nice apartment in a lovely charming neighborhood. It is close to everything. Alex was a very friendly and warm host! He waited for us to help us check-in even we arrived later than planned. We had a great stay in Lisbon!

We unfortunately only stayed two nights in Lisbon, but through the excellent location of the apartment we were able to see a lot of the city! Great host who is always available even when the power goes out :)
Good location, nice appartment

Malgré les odeurs nauséabondes de la salle de bain (joints inexistant), c'est une très bel appartement, décoré finement avec beaucoup de couleur. On s'y sent vite chez soi. Très bien situé et literies très confortables. Presque que du positif !

Alexandre is a great Host, and the apartment was very nice, clean, close to public transportation.

The apartment was very cosy and clean, i really like the decoration! I was there with my 3 friends and there was enough place for us. We had a great time in Lisbon.

Muy recomendable! Todo fue perfecto. Alexandre muy amable, se adaptó a nuestro horario sin problema. la amabilidad de alxandre y su atención excelentes. Buena ubicación con facil acceso a los distintos puntos turisticos de la ciudad.

Great place and host!

Nice and clean apartment but not for one who cannot take the stairs. Very convenient. Nice comfy bed. Alexandre was  very helpful and accommodating.

amazing apartment. cute. clean. very welcomed. in the very center of Lisbon. nice view. nice design. nothing more to say than - strongly recommended appartment to rent! Alexander was just perfect. wish to be back and to spend there more time) thank you 🙏🏻

L'accueil fut conforme aux attentes. Alexandre était sur place à l'arrivée à l'heure prévue. Il faut disponible durant notre séjour, par téléphone, lorsque nous avions des questions reliées aux équipements de l'appartement.
L'appartement est bien éclairé, au troisième étage. Le quartier de l'Alfama est idéal comme point de départ des visites des autres quartiers de Lisbonne. Et certainement le quartier le plus typique de la ville.
L'appartement est non fumeur; par contre une odeur de fumée de cigarette émanant des autres appartements et de l'escalier réussi à pénétrer un peu dans l'appartement. Les propriétaires du logement de l'étage supérieur ont deux chiens qui manifestent leur impatience en jappant en attendant leur arrivée en fin de journée.

Alexandre s'est arrangé pour répondre à nos désirs le mieux possible. Il nous a offert des petits cadeaux de bienvenue, et a mis des dépliants touristiques à notre disposition.
Alexandre s'est enquis de notre bien-être. Dommage que nous ne l'ayons jamais rencontré !

We had a great stay at the Surfboard apartment. Alexandre was a fabulous host and went out of his way to accommodate us from letting us drop off our bags early before check-in (so we didn't have to lug them around the city), to letting us check out 30 minutes late. Everything in the apartment was as advertised, and the location is perfect for exploring the cute neighborhood of Alfama. Only one small complaint would be that the neighbors upstairs have a couple of dogs that occasionally got riled up and barked for awhile in the evening - thankfully this didn't go on overnight, so I wouldn't say it was a huge issue, and I'd still recommend this property!
as it should be. thanks.

nous sommes ravis de ces quatre jours à Lisbonne .

Situé au bord d'un quartier charmant, cet appartement joliment décoré nous a permis de passer un agréable séjour pour découvrir Lisbonne. Muy recomendable!

We had an excellent time in the apartment. When you step outside you have good choices for restaurants. The place is not very big but really cute. Alexandre was a great host.  He answered all of our questions and gave us several excellent tips about our itinerary in the city when we arrived. The apartment is exactly how it appears on the listing and is perfect for a couple or single traveler. We will definitely stay here on our next visit to Lisbon which I'm hoping is soon (I miss it already)!

Alexandre was waiting for us at the apartment when we arrived and he was really friendly and very helpful. He provided a list of restaurants for us to eat and responded quickly when we messaged him. We loved the apartment! Very well decorated, very clean and perfect location. se dovessimo tornare a lisbona ritorneremmo in questo appartamento molto volentieri!

Nicely decorated, clean apartment in a good and central location. Easy to walk almost anywhere. Alexandre was very patient and welcoming even though we arrived quite delayed. The stairs are a bit of a challenge with a suitcase.

We had a nice time in Alexandres appartment. It is really beautiful and well situated for exploring the city. The key delivery was easy as we met Alexandre in front of the appartment. I can really recommend Alexandres appartment!
