Nous avons été gentiment accueilli à notre arrivée par Alexandre qui parle couramment Anglais et se défend très bien en Français. Grace à son sens de l'hospitalité  (une bouteille de vin + échantillon apéritif local, une carte de Lisbonne) et sa disponibilité pour nous prodiguer des conseils, nous avons pu profiter au mieux de notre séjour de 5 jours à Lisbonne et visiter ses alentours (Cascais, Sintra). L'appartement est à la fois « cosy » et fonctionnel, il est situé dans un quartier très vivant (restaurants, épiceries) et à une distance proche de tous les sites principaux selon ses préférences à savoir marche à pied ou par transports en communs de l'appartement (bus, tramway, train, métro). Pendant notre séjour, Alexandre est resté très à l'écoute et disponible, venant même nous changer la pomme de douche seulement 15 mn après que nous l'ayons prévenu que la douche ne fonctionnait pas correctement. Merci Alexandre, it has been a pleasure to stay in your flat and meet with you ;-)

The Alfama apartment was wonderful. It was very clean, Alexandre welcomed us with treats and was extremely responsive our entire stay! I would absolutely love to stay here again. So much so that we did not want to leave. Thank you Alexandre!
Everything good. Thank you.

Nous avons eu un super accueil de la part d'Alexandre il a été très sympathique nous avons eu le logement un peu plus tôt et il nous a proposé de quitter un peu plus tard. Son appartement est jolie et confortable on s'y est senti comme à la maison. En plus il bien situé en plein quartier de L'Alfama, nombreux commerces à proximité. Un vrai coup de cœur!

Really great apartment - looks just like the pictures and is spacious enough for 4 people. Also in a great area - Alfama with lots of nice places to eat and drink nearby, plus its close to the centre. Alexandre was really helpful and offered to give us any tips about the area. Would recommend!

Alexandre was extremely helpful from start to finish. The apartment was very clean and fit 4 people perfectly. There was even a nice little welcome gift. Alexandre was very kind about our late checkout and gave great tips for local eateries. Would definitely recommend!

Everythings was PERFECT !
Alexandre est un hôte Génial, un très bon contact par sms avant l'arrivée, toujours disponible. Il est très accueillant et chaleureux, il nous a tout expliqué à notre arrivée et à excusé notre heure de retard ...
L'appartement est conforme aux photos, une très bonne literie et tout le nécessaire pour passer un très bon séjour (3 nuits pour nous)
Tout se fait à pieds depuis l'appartement, Sé 5mins, Château St Jorge 10 mins, Praça do Comercio 10 minutes.
Un vrai plaisir !
Nous avons également profité de la proximité avec les gares pour visiter SINTRA et CASCAIS : sublime !
Conclusion : vous pouvez réserver sans hésiter avec Alexandre.
OBRIGADA Alexandre :)

We had a great time in Lisboa thanks to a warm welcome from Alexandre, who flexibly adapted to our delayed arrival and provided good tips for our stay. The apartment is perfectly located and top clean.
We really enjoyed staying in this apartment, which was ideally located to explore the city. Alexandre was the perfect host, giving us some good dinner ideas and kindly letting us check out late.

Although Alexandre wasn't there to meet us, he made sure his main met us there and messaged me to make sure I got there okay. The rental was clean, roomy and well centralized. Convenient store just downstairs for small groceries and water. Highly recommend!

Alexandre was incredible as he waited up until almost 2am to welcome us after our flight was severely delayed! He was very kind and warm despite tiredness and gave us some tips of where to go. Great welcome gifts too.

It was a perfect apartment in the old town...so easy to get to the castle and to get to the beautiful views.
V peaceful flat, but tough stairs to get to it, so make sure you can carry bags. Also shower is not good.
But otherwise all ideal.

Alexandre est un hôte accueillant, réactif et arrangeant
L appartement est bien situé, deco sympa.
Les voisins du dessus sont bruyants et les escaliers un peu raides

Great host! Great apartment! Great city!
Everything works perfekt!
Highly recommended!!!!

Malgré une heure très tardive d'arrivée (23h), Alexandre nous attendait avec le sourire à l'appartement.
L'accueil a été immédiatement sympathique, chaleureux et amical... en un mot parfait.
Alexandre a pris le temps de nous expliquer les quartiers, les activités, les moyens de transport, les lieux proches de Lisbonne...
Grace a ses conseils et aux réponses à nos questions (nous avions un peu étudié le sujet avant de partir), nous avons pu découvrir Lisbonne dans les meilleures conditions.
Alexandre est présent pour ses hôtes en cas de problème. Un simple appel et tout est résolu.
L'appartement est charmant, bien aménagé, très bien situé et parfait comme point de départ pour visiter la ville. Il est exactement conforme à l'annonce.

Merci beaucoup Alexandre.

We had a great stay at this apartment! Very clean, in a great location and really well designed flat! Alexandre is a keen surfer and it shows in this place!! Bed was really comfortable and located right in heart of fado area!! Recommend!!

This is an excellent apartment and Alexandre has been a great host. The apartment is at a walkable distance to several tourist destinations and some good restaurants. There are couple of stores just outside the apartment which was extremely helpful to buy esssentials for the baby. Alexandre has also been very flexible by allowing us to have an ealry check in and late check out. Thanks a lot Alexandre :)

Thank you very much, Alexandre! The apartment is beautiful, clean and cosy, exactly like in the description and photos. The location is perfect for exploring the city. Alexandre was very responsive and kind. We are looking forward to coming back another time. Muito obrigadas!

Had a fantastic stay in Lisbon.  The apartment was brilliant, really close to transport links and just steps away from the restaurants and cafe's of Alfama.  Alexandre was great, allowed us to stow our case in the apartment as we arrived in Lisbon very early.  He is so knowledgable about the city and answers any questions very quickly.  I would highly recommend Charming Apartments and Lisbon!!
Super hote qui parles très bien français =) l'appartement est super beau et très bien situé !! N'hésitez pas et Booker !! Attention escalier pas évident si vous êtes à mobilité réduite !! 5 sur 5 !!

The host was very friendly and gentle.
The apartment clean and well decorated.
The area was just like discribed on the website.
Love it.

Merci beaucoup Alexandre, l'acceuil était parfait et arrangeant, les conseils avisés, l'appartement et son mobilier et le petit cadeau d'arrivée. Un sans faute pour découvrir cette somptueuse ville!!
Obrigado et à la prochaine!!!

Everything was perfect with Alexandre: communication, flat, time etc....
It was also a perfect location. I recommand the flat !

Alex was a great host. When my friends and I arrived everything was prepared for us and the woman in charge of cleaning the house explained us where everything was.
The apartment was perfect for us and it is in a great and beautiful location.
The funniest part of our stay was going up the stairs.
We also got to meet our neighbors because they couldn't open their door and had to go though our apartment so they could get in from the balcony. The last day of our stay they gave us a present for our kindness, something that doesn't happen very often in Barcelona so we were very thankfull.
Our stay in lisbon was wonderful and I firmly recommend Alex's apartment.

Du chocolat et des boissons nous attendaient. L'appart d'Alexandre est très bien situé, très pratique pour commencer les visites, le métro n'est pas loin, les bus et tram non plus, une grande gare aussi. Nous nous y sommes sentis comme chez nous. Nous le recommandons.

Appartamento piccolo ma curato e con tutto il necessario. Si trova in una zona comoda da raggiungere sia con i mezzi che con l'auto. Si può raggiungere comodamente a piedi la Baixa è tutto il centro ed vicina alla metropolitana. Non abbiamo incontrato Alexanndre, ma è sempre rimasto in contatto con noi via mail per qualquasi problema, che non ci sono stati. Noi eravamo in 4 con due bambini, e l'appartamento è stato perfetto. Lo consiglio

L'accueil fait par la gouvernante était parfait, tout a été fait pour rendre notre séjour agréable. l'appartement était mieux que ce que l'on peux voir sur les photos.
Merci encore à Alexandre pour sa disponibilité. Je conseille chaleureusement cette location.

Alexandre is very polite and easy-to-communicate with.
Even he was not in Lisboa during our days, he set everything perfectly and was very kind to leave us the apartment with late check-out until 5 pm (late evening inbound flight + no other customers scheduled that day, we got lucky)
Apartment is as shown in the pictures, 5/8 min walk from nearest Metro station and located in the beautiful Alfama
Definitely Recommended!

We stayed in this apartment for a visit to Lisbona.
All perfect!
The location, the apartment and Alexandre.
It's in the historic center and a short walk to the city center, where you can move to visit the city.
Highly recommended.

Wonderful stay at Alexandre's place! He contacted me well before to prepare my arrival and everything was nicely planned. and organised. A very good communication.
And the flat is just as on the pictures! Very nice, very cosy, very well located and walking distance from man touristic areas. It was a real pleasure to stay there.

We had a very nice time at Alexandre's place in Alfama. The location is perfect as it is very close to many good restaurants and the St. Jorge castle. It is not a far stop from the metro or tram 28E either. The apartment is as advertised and very comfortable and clean. Alexandre gave us a nice introduction when we arrived and was in good communication throughout the stay. Would recommend!

Alexandre a été très gentil, il a répondu à toutes nos questions et a été flexible sur nos horaires d'arrivée et de départ. C'est un très bon hôte, disponible et accueillant. Nous avons eu droit à une bouteille de vin et à du chocolat comme cadeaux d'arrivée. L'appartement correspond parfaitement aux photos. Il est meublé avec beaucoup de goût et d'originalité. L'emplacement du logement est également parfait et il proche de tous les sites importants. Le quartier d'Alfama est particulièrement agréable pour se balader. Je garde un très bon souvenir de mon séjour. Je recommande vivement ce logement.

Buenos días, quiero agradecerte por el excelente apartamento,el cual cumplió todas nuestras expectativas, adicional tu atención y especial interés hace que quedemos listos para volver a esa hermosa ciudad y en especial a Alfama, un abrazo y mil gracias por habernos permitido tan inolvidable estancia .Saludos Juan,Claudia,María y Juanita

Un accueil super, ponctualité, sympathie des petits cadeaux vous attendent a l'arrivée, dans cet appartement placé prés du centre et permet de découvrir la ville de Lisbon.... a découvrir , merci encore pour tout.

The apartment is lovely just like the city itself! The cosy interior creates a warm atmosphere located in one of the best neighborhoods of Lisbon. Alexandre was really kind to gave us the opportunity to leave our luggage in the apartment before the actual check in time due to our early time of arrival.

The apartment is very clean, has all the necessary facilities and is located nearby the Commerce Square. Due to a number of business cards left in the apartment we were able to wine & dine in some very good restaurants/bars.

A charming apartment in a charming neighborhood! Thank you Alexandre for your hospitality.

The house and host was so good. He was very kind. I asked the last day of check out. He said he didn't have any guests yet so I could have enough time to leave home. But suddenly he sent me a message that I had to leave home by 11 am before one hour on the day. Although we were having late breakfast , I tried to pack the my luggages and leave the house. At 10:50, the cleaner arrived and pushed me out. Unfortunately she couldn't speak English well. I asked to give me 10 minutes and finished packing. Until at that time, I wasn't disappointed at all. Behind the door new guests already arrived and waited for my check out. The host told me the check out only available after 3 pm. Because of being in a hurry, I left my provisions in the refrigerator.  I took them from South Korea for this trip. My children couldn't eat well foreign foods so my wife took them from South Korea. If I had 15 minutes,  I wouldn't miss them. The host was good but last sevice was not good.
Great location for Fado and in the heart of Alfama.
Alexander was a nice host. Hè made us feel comfortabel. The appartement was just like the pictures.

Muy bien situado, a los pies de la Alfama i a 5 mn andando de la plaza Comercio. Y donde se puede pasar con el coche. El apartamento muy luminoso y bien decorado, la cocina perfectamente equipada. Limpieza impecable. Es una tercera planta aunque no nos fue ningún inconveniente. Volvería

Alexandre hat sich sehr um uns bemüht, auf uns wie verabredet gewartet und uns alles erklärt.
Die Lage am Fuße der Alfama ist perfekt, man kann fast alles zu Fuß erreichen (Sehenswürdigkeiten...) und ist super an den öffentlichen Verkehr angebunden. Taxis + Busse fahren regelmäßig vorbei, Metro, Straßenbahn und der Bahnhof Santa Apolonia sind zu Fuß in 5 Minuten zu erreichen. Die Straße ist recht befahren, zum Schlafen haben wir die Fenster zur Straße plus Fensterläden geschlossen und nach hinten geöffnet und gut geschlafen.
Das Apartment ist gut ausgestattet, es fehlt an nichts, wie in den übrigen Bewertungen geschrieben muss eine sehr steile Treppe erklommen werden, wie das in den alten Häusern dort üblich ist. Direkt nebenan an gibt es zwei Händler, bei denen man sich mit dem nötigsten versorgen kann und ein nettes, kleines Cafe, mit leckeren Teilchen und gutem Kaffee und, zumindest im Dezember, kaum Touristen.
Während unseres Aufenthalts legte die Queen Mary 2 und ein anderes Kreuzfahrtschiff direkt vor der Tür an, allein der Anblick war bereits ein Erlebnis.

We enjoyed our stay in the lovely alfama neighbourhood. The flat is close to Santa Apollonia, which is convenient to join the airport. It's also at walking distance of Baixa and Bairro Alto. Flat is clean and cute.
Good location, close to old town and main touristic attractions. very well decorated cosy flat with all functions.

This is in a league of its own. Beautifully decorated with hand-crafted furniture nice images on the wall, wooden floorboards. Makes you feel at home immediately. On top we got a nice welcome pack with water, wine, chocolates - really lovely. The apartment is perfectly equipped and the location perfect. Walking distance to main train station shops for daily needs just downstairs and right below beautiful alfama with its winding stairs and streets, restaurants and bars. The Lisbon experience couldn't have been better!

Excellent Host and Apartment
We were met by Alex shortly after our arrival to the apartment. He was very personable and willing to answer any and all questions. He spent a while going over the map of the area with us giving us his personal recommendations on places to go. This was very helpful and much appreciated. The apartment was small but teaming with energy. It was located in a great part of town and was plenty large enough for my wife and me. I would highly recommend any of Alex's apartments just so you get to meet this wonderful host. Safe travels!

Thanx, Alexandre, you made our days in Lisboa a perfekt stay!
I never met you, you gave the keys to my friend, cause I arrived a bit later. But here I tell you and everybody else: your Flat is magnificent! We loved your style, the sun shining in in the morning and the small shops and bars downstairs. The Lux Club just a few minutes to walk and the beautifull old town all around. Not to forget, the Tejo just across the road... All the best for you and your family! Wiebke

O bairro é maravilhoso! O apartamento perfeitamente como indicado na descrição e fotos!
O Alexandre foi super atencioso e pode receber nossas bagagens antes do check in.
Já no apartamento, nos agraciou com vinho, chocolate, água e suco.
Depois de uma conversa super agradável, nos deu algumas orientações e dicas sobre a cidade e se disponibilizou a qualquer coisa que precisássemos.
A apartamento é muito bem localizado. Há alguns minutos da Estação Santa Apolônia. Pode-se ir andando mesmo.
Próximo ao Museu do Fado, José Saramago e com um passeio de poucos minutos se chega ao Castelo de São Jorge, Sé, Praça do Comércio.
Espero ter oportunidade de voltar a Lisboa e se sim, com certeza repetiríamos a experiência com o Alexandre!
Very nice place, unfortunatly we couldn't meet Alexander but eveything was perfect, we didn't miss anything. Clean, well situated... I recomend it!

L appartement est situé dans un quartier très sympa et animé , l appart est propre et très joli
Un appartement que je recommande
Thanks Alexandre! A lovely welcome at a beautiful place in Lisbon. Definitely one of my best stays at Airbnb. :)

The apartment has everything we need to stay comfortable during some days, it was clean and very well located in the heart of Alfama. We were able to explore the most beautiful parts of the city by foot. We really had a great time there. Thanks to Alexandre who welcomed us late in the evening with smile and good humour… Strongly recommended.
Obrigado por tudo

We had the perfect stay in Alexandre's apartments! It's in the best location possible in Lisbon in the wonderful alfama area with every amenity at your availability. The apartments are beautifully decorated with lovely artwork and statement pieces. You have everything (and more) than you need for your stay. Alexandre's attention to detail and thoughtfulness is splendid. We particularly enjoyed the wine and chocolate as a welcome surprise! Alexandre himself is a wonderfully helpful & friendly host, available at all times, flexible and full of good advice and really goes above and beyond to ensure you have the best stay. We can't wait to come back and stay here, and have to say Alex and his lovely apartments really completed our experience!

Alexandre was really kind and friendly host. We were late but he waited us for giving some information of the city and the instruction. It was really useful.
The apartment itself was really nice and located in center of Alfama. I think everybody will like this place.
After first night, we wanted to extand but it was fully booked. If you are looking for a place to feel real Lisbon then just book this place. You will be satisfied with everything.

Alexandre was a fantastic host and the apartment was perfect. It's in a great location - walking distance to many bars and restaurants in Alfama. We had everything we needed and Alexandre was very accommodating. He even allowed us to check-in early since our flight arrived before check-in. Next time we are in Lisbon we will absolutely stay here again!

Alexandre is very friendly and an excellent host.  We had a small issue with the TV remote (dead battery) and he was there to fix it immediately.  The apartment is well situated in Alfama and is very close to shopping, restaurants and many tourist attractions.  We loved our time in Lisbon and would recommend this apartment and would return on our next visit.

We had a great time in Lisbon and a big reason for this was the location and comfort of this flat.
In the day it was easy to stroll into the centre and enjoy the culture and food (we particularly enjoyed the Mercado da Ribeira). In the evening we could sit on the balcony and hear the Fado music performed live from the Fado museum courtyard across the road. We spent most of of our evenings exploring the immediate area, with it's beautiful streets leading up to the castle and a myriad of other delights.
Alexandre was a perfect host, giving us some insight into the city and eager to make sure we were comfortable and at ease.

Appartement bien situé pour pouvoir visiter la ville .
Alexandre est très sympathique
Logement clair , mais un peu bruyant, salle de bain exigüe
L'appartement est charmant, très bien situé et parfait comme point de départ pour visiter la ville. Alexandre nous a donné des conseils utiles  pour l'ensemble de notre séjour.
Great location in a fab old building. The flat was spotlessly clean and exceeded our expectations. Alexandre was a great host and really helpful.  Highly recommended!

Alexandre was a great host, couldn't ask for more. The flat is very charming, clean, everything you need and more... Best location, plenty of cafés and restaurants around. We loved it there and will be back. I would highly recommend it. Thank you again Alexandre!

This appartment can be highly recommended, Alexandre a very nice host who provided most essential tips for our stay in Lisbon.
The surrounding is nice, even if at day quite noisy and its located very into the oldest district of Lisbon next to Fado museum, with restaurant and bars around (which are only partially to recommend as very touristy without any Portuguese inside).
It will definitely not the last time I´ve been there.

Alexandre was super in coordinating with us on our arrival time. The apartment was great and located in a great spot for exploring. Tons of restaurants and little cafes all around.
Lisbon is awesome!

Supernetter Gastgeber: telefonische Vorabstimmung zur Anreise hat perfekt geklappt. Empfang mit einer Flasche Wein und netten Tipps für die Tage in Lissabon.  Das Apartment hat die perfekte Lage für fußläufige Ausflüge in die Altstadt. Auch Parkplätze sind trotz der zentralen Lage vorhanden. Nachteil der zentralen Lage ist die Lautstärke - die lässt sich morgens auch bei geschlossenen Fenstern nicht ganz ausblenden. Ansonsten: Alles super und gerne wieder.

Nice and simple to get to (easy cab ride from airport) this apartment is close enough to the heart of Lisbon that we walked everywhere. Great place that provides a nice safe respite from the bustle of Lisbon outside.

Really nice Flat in the heart of Lisbon. The Rooms are clean and equipped with nice furnitures. The space is enough to stay a couple Nights with 4 Person.
The host is more than friendly and we got all informations of the town we need.

Alexandre nous a accueillis gentiment dans son appartement. Celui ci a une décoration soignée et est extrêmement lumineux !
Par le balcon vous aurez un avant goût de l'animation de Lisbonne trépidante et bruyante !! Merci à Alexandre pour ses attentions !
Un parking payant 8 euro par jour est à proximité le long du Tage.
N 'hésitez pas, à aller manger au restaurant du Fado, excellent !
Métro et train à proximité !!

Wir haben uns wirklich sehr wohl gefühlt. Alexandre ist ein sehr herzlicher, zuverlässiger und hilfsbereiter Gastgeber gewesen. Das Apartment liegt wirklich toll am Fuße des schönsten Stadtteils Lissabons. Man muss nur zwei Dinge wissen. Die Alfama ist ein Viertel in dem auch noch nachts viel los ist und daher ist es nicht leise zum Schlafen. Das zweite ist unbedingt das Küchenfenster zu lassen und keine Nahrungsmittel offen rumliegen lassen. In 3 Tagen hatten wir zweimal eine Taube im Apartment und das war wirklich nicht schön. Ansonsten gibt es unten im Haus einen  Supermarkt und auch die Küche ermöglicht normales Kochen. Es gibt frische Handtücher und die Wohnung ist sehr sauber. Wir hatten wirklich einen tollen Aufenthalt. Dieses Apartment ist wirklich jedem zu empfehlen!
The flat was perfectly located and really cosy. Alexandre is a very kind host and gave us great recommondations in and around Lisboa. We enjoyed our stay very much!
Alexandre was a very welcoming host! He waited for us and welcomed us into his home, giving us directions and tips for Lisbon. The apartment is very cute and comfortable and we had a great stay!

L'appartement d'Alexandre est tout à fait conforme à l'annonce. Bien qu'assez petit, il est très clair, très bien agencé et décoré avec beaucoup de goût. Du coup, même à 4 (avec deux enfants en bas âge), nous y étions à l'aise. Le logement est au pied d'un quartier vivant et très agréable qui regorge de restaurants. Il est situé sur une rue passante mais les doubles vitrages sont très efficaces et les fenêtres arrière, sur cour, permettent de rafraîchir la nuit. Alexandre est un hôte très accueillant et attentionné (petits présents offerts à notre arrivée). On le sent soucieux de la satisfaction de ses invités.
Alexandre var meget hjælpsom og hurtig til at svare på vores henvendelser
The flat is fantastic! Alexandre is a very nice person, frendly and soulful. And a special thank for the Lisboa's tips)

Alexandre's apartment is tastefully designed and the location is unique - in the historical Alfama district and close to the train station. Alexandre was also friendly and helpful with providing tips about local restaurants and getting around. A plus point was that there were complimentary drinks and chocolate when we arrived. It was slightly noisy at night as it is near the main road, but it was tolerable and we were so tired from walking that we slept well anyway. Overall we enjoyed our stay very much and would recommend this to friends.

We enjoyed our 4 days in this apartment a lot...it could not have been any better!
First of all the beds were really comfortable and we loved the furniture which made us feel like we were at home!
Additionally, the apartment is placed in a nice neighborhood and all other places we wanted to see were easy to reach by foot, bus or train.
But the best thing of all were the nice conversations we had with Alexandre, and the information about the city he gave us!

My parents and I had a wonderful stay in Alexandre´s apartment! The place is cozy and the location perfect for discovering Lisbon. He offered us help and advise about what to see and what to do. I can warmly recommend this apartment and would always return there! Muito obrigada!

We had a lovely stay in Lisbon, the apartment was great and the location was brilliant. It was fully stocked with everything you might need inc dinnerware and washing machine. Alexandre was very accommodating and very flexible with checkin/ checkout times. Overall I would definitely stay there again.

Appartement calme, lumineux, bien décoré, très agréable, dans le quartier Alfama, proche du musée du Fado, facile d'accès en transport en commun. Très bonne situation dans une rue comportant des cafés, des épiceries, des restaurants à proximité.
Il semblait plus spacieux sur les photos du site mais le couchage à 4 reste possible (2 lits doubles, un dans la chambre, un dans le salon).
Alexandre était présent pour nous accueillir malgré notre arrivée tardive et a été très réactif lorsque nous l'avons sollicité pour une petite réparation dans la salle de bain.
Cependant, l'escalier d'accès à l'appartement est raide et peu être une difficulté pour certaines personnes.
O Alexandre nos recebeu muito bem e foi muito gentil. Seu apartamento estava muito limpo e tinha tudo que precisávamos. Apenas o sofá cama não era confortável, no mais estava tudo perfeito.

This was a great place to stay. Location was very central. The description and pictures are very accurate - there were no surprises! Alexandre was there to greet and welcome us to Lisbon. Would highly recommend.

Hi Alexandre, we had a very nice stay at your appartment. Its very cosy and colorful it felt als a warm home. Thank you for the nice wine! Sterre and Sol also have good memories! I hope I can come back one day.

Great apartment in a great location to stay in Lisbon. Alexandre was very kind. There was a yummy bottle of wine waiting when we arrived and chocolate too! Apartment was cute and clean and well stocked with everything we needed. Great experience.

The apartment was very nice and perfect located. Alexandre told us some spotlights on the map and was very helpful especially when you forgot something in the apartment.
We would rent this apartment again and highly recommend this to anyone!

Alexandre went out of his way to meet us early before check-in time and was very accommodating to my schedule. The apartment was very nice and exactly what we were expecting. He was very helpful and answered our questions about Lisbon. The apartment had maps and other useful info regarding the city.  The location is perfect! Very close to the city center, but also in the Alfama area which is very charming- you get the best of both worlds. I would highly recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Lisbon. Staying here made my trip that much better!

super nice and light apartment in a quiet spot in the beautiful old town. very romantic, modern and comfy flat, even better then it looks on the pictures!
warm, kind and relaxed welcoming by Alexandre, who can gice you any information you need.
we couldn't have chosen a better place for our discovery of Lisbon.

Alexandre is a super helpful host and we could not have asked for anything more. The apartment is very characterful (in a really good way!) and I don't think it would be possible to find a better location; right at the foot of the old city which is so beautiful with a little grocery shop next door, bars & restaurants close, superb communications on the doorstep and not at all noisy. And thanks for the vino! Alexandre, we'll come back to stay in your apartment the next time we come to fantastic Lisbon.

It's very beautiful !!! Nous avons été tres bien recu par Alexandre, tres souriant, il nous a bien expliqué ce qu'il y avait a visité pour ce court séjour ! Nous sommes ravis de cette escapade à lisbonne , quartier Alfama, c'etait totalement typique, des petites rues, des restaurants, nous avons rencontré des personnes fort sympathique, nous avons eu le temps de voir beaucoup de choses. Je le recommande cet appartement vraiment bien situé, propre, fonctionnel pour 4 personnes et avec une belle vue sur le quartier ! GENIAL OBRIGADO

Alexandre met us at the apartment and made us feel very welcome. He suggested a few places to visit and showed us around the apartment. The apartment was as good as I had hoped - the photographs show it well- bright, airy, very comfortable and everything you need. The location is great- in the interesting Alfama district- well placed for everything you would want to visit; for small shops to get provisions; for cafes and restaurants. The fact that it is near the coast is an added bonus. I would highly recommend it.

Nous avons passé 2 nuits à Lisbonne avec ma femme avant d'entreprendre un "road trip" jusqu'à Porto. Alexandre nous a personnellement accueilli à l'appartement et nous a dispensé tous les bons conseils pour vivre une expérience magnifique. Nous avons même eu droit à de petites attentions (chocolat, vin, bouteille d'eau) preuve de sa grande hospitalité. L'appartement est très bien situé à Alfama. Pleins de restaurants et de locaux de fado se trouvent à quelques minutes à pied. Facile également de rejoindre la praça do comercio à 5 minutes à pied. L'appartement est charmant et décoré avec goût. Encore merci à Alexandre! Je retournerai bien volontiers dans son appartement pour un prochain we lisboète!

Alexandre welcomed us in his apartment. He's a very friendly and helpful guy.
The apartment was very clean and is in a great location with walking distance to the city centre.
We had a wonderful time in Alexandre's apartment. It's ideally located to walk in the city and to take  every public transport. It's sunny and lovely and well equipped. We loved it.

Alexandre was a wonderful host. He was available to meet us when we needed and gave a good tour of the apartment. There was a nice "welcome package" of wine, water, chocolate, juice, and candies. He also had a great selection of tourist pamphlets for ideas of what to do. The most impressive thing was we had a late departure time, and he stored our luggage in a convenient location for us! We had a wonderful experience here.

Alexandre was waiting for us at the apartment when we arrived and made us feel very welcome. He provided us with lots of useful information about the apartment and Lisbon. We had a very pleasant stay and would recommend this apartment as a perfect base for exploring Lisbon!

Alex's flat was incredily nice. Really well placed and well organized, you will like it there
+ Alex was full of tips and advise about the neighborhood, best spot to surf etc.
I really recommend !

Excellent apartment! So bright clean and cheerful. Alexandre met us at the apartment. He was so friendly and helpful. The bottle of wine and chocolate was a lovely touch.

Location was perfect. The narrow streets behind had many fado music clubs.
Very pretty city, will certainly return.
Without hesitation would stay again in Alexandre's apartment.

Alexandre nous a accueilli chaleureusement .Il nous a donné quelques conseils pour profiter au maximum de Lisbonne.L'appartement est conforme à la description. Il est très bien placé.Nous avons pu visiter de nombreux quartiers à pied depuis l'appartement.

Alexandre was very professional,welcoming us 2 hours before official time check in with wine and treats for kids.The apartment is authentic and has everything you need.We enjoyed very much our trip to Lisbon.

Thanks very much for nice stay.

Alexandre es muy amable y dispuesto. Nos dio facilidades para el check in-out adaptándose a nuestras necesidades de horario. La casa era justo lo que necesitábamos para nuestra estancia en Lisboa. Esta muy cerca de la estación de Santa apolonia, que es donde llegábamos nosotros. Desde allí, se puede visitar todos los barrios del centro de lisboa a pie. La casa esta bien acondicionada y limpia. La cocina estaba equipada, aunque no la utilizamos. Quien quiere cocinar en lisboa?

Alexandre was a very welcoming host and his apartment was perfect for our stay. The flat is really nicely decorated with some quirky touches and all the facilities you might need for self catering. The location is also great- right in the picturesque alfama area but at the bottom of the hill so not too much walking up and down!
Accueil très chaleureux d'Alexandre. Merci pour le vin et les chocolats ! Superbe appartement décoré avec beaucoup de goût. On recommande vivement !

We had a great experience in this apartment. The size was very comfortable for 3 of us. The location is in a fairly quiet neighborhood that is only 15 walking from the busiest areas, which was very convenient for us. Alexandre was very welcoming and helpful, offering us wine and chocolate as well as ideas on places to go. We would definitely recommend this apartment.

We had great time in Lisbon. Alexandre was very kind and welcome us with chocolate and wine :) The apartment was very clean and with a great location, very close to the main interest of this awesome city. You will find everything you need to feel like home: comfortable bed full equiped kitchen, supermarket downstairs... The area was safe(we got 2 kids) and we highly appreciate being in the heart of the city close to everything and also in a quiet place. The only thing we regret: we would love to spend more days but for sure we will be back! Thank you Alexandre!

Alexandre was an ideal host. He was easy to get ahold of and met us out front of the apartment upon arrival with the keys. The apartment was lovely--not huge, but perfect for us. With just a few days to explore Lisbon, we were mostly looking for a place to crash. But we enjoyed every minute in the apartment (esp. with big walk-out windows that gave a great view of the Alfama neighbourhood.)
Alexandre welcomed us with a bottle of wine and chocolate which was an extra nice touch. He also pulled out a map and highlighted all of the must-sees in the city for us which helped narrow down our adventuring! He was a great host and the place was perfect. We would stay again in a heartbeat!

Alexandre é de uma simpatia e gentileza impressionantes! Fomos extremamente bem acolhidos e tratados por ele em Lisboa, seu apartamento na Alfama é muito bem localizado e encantador, c tudo o que se precisa para a estadia tranquila e confortável. Recomendadíssimo!!!

We hebben een fijne tijd gehad in Lissabon. Het appartement was prima en voldeed aan onze verwachtingen. De communicatie met Alexander verliep soepel en we werden erg gastvrij ontvangen! Een fles wijn voor ons, chocola voor de kinderen en water en melk in de koelkast. Helemaal super! Een echte aanrader dus!

Alexandre é um excelente anfitrião e nos ajudou desde o momento em que chegamos. O apartamento é exatamente como aparece nas fotos: charmoso e muito bem localizado! Sem dúvida não poderíamos ter escolhido lugar melhor! Recomendo!

Alexandre ci ha accolto con bottiglia di vino e cioccolata. In frigo abbiamo trovato acqua e latte.
L'appartamento e' veramente carino e luminoso.
Vicino al centro (10 minuti a piedi) e al castello (10 minuti a piedi).
Siamo stati veramente bene. Grazie Alexandre!!!

Alexandre is an excellent host, he was there to welcome us although we arrived quite late and gave us all the necessary information to start discovering the city. A bottle of wine, chocolate, milk, water were also there for us..Alexandre was proactive in providing us with an extra heating machine (it must have been one of the cold-est weekends) and helped us find back the mobile phone that we forgot in a cafe on the other side of the town (he found the phone number of the place and gave them a call!). The appartment is lovely, warm and it is decorated with great taste. The neighborhood is also "top", because it's within walking distance of all the nice places in the city, and it also has two mini-markets right next door. We had a great stay and we will certainly come back!

Great apartment in the city center close to public transport! Alexandre was very kind and welcomed us with a bottle of wine and chocolate. We loved the little streets of Alfama, LX factory and the  yellow historic trams. Everyone in Lisbon was very friendly and helpful. A wonderful city!

Great and lovely Appartement, Location Perfect for Visiting old town.
Father in law of alexandre was very friendly and helpful, he even saved us and defended us against a Crazy Taxi driver.
Thanks for a Great Weekend!

Everything about our experience was great! Apartment is in a terrific central location, and is spacious, and charming! We loved the open windows and apartment came with everything we could possibly need. Had a small problem with keys not working but Alexandre made sure we had an extra key and fixed it as soon as possible. I highly recommend this host & flat.

The apartment is very well located and welcoming , we were received by a parent Alexander a very charming and kind man .
We will return to Lisbon, and will be delighted to once again enjoy this very charming apartment.
Thank you Alexandre

Alexandre was quick and helpful to reply to queries via email prior to arriving in Lisbon.  He was away during my stay, however had arranged for his father in law to let me in and show me around, who was very nice and was waiting for me upon my arrival.  Alexandre had left a bottle of wine and some chocolate as a welcome gift (thanks for that!), and the apartment was as advertised.  I stayed over a weekend and there was quite a bit of noise during the night from the downstairs neighbours and people outside on the street, but thankfully I was quite tired from checking out the city and didn't have trouble sleeping.

Alexandre war sehr aufmerksam und alles entsprach unseren Vorstellungen. Sehr gutes Preis/Leistungsverhältnis.
Vielen Dank

Alexandre nous a accueilli très chaleureusement à notre arrivée tardive dans la soirée et nous a donné des indications touristiques précieuses. L'appartement est joliment décoré, lumineux, propre, fonctionnel, très bien situé dans le quartier d'Alfama, et proche des moyens de transport (tramways et bus). Notre séjour d'une semaine a été très agréable. Merci en encore pour votre accueil Alexandre !

Alexandre is an excellent host. He responded quickly to all my e-mails with good information and helpful suggestions. He was very kind to
Let us stay longer in the apartment on the day of our departure since we had a later flight back home.
The wine and chocolate were very much appreciated . Very good wifi connection
The apartment was very clean and tidy. The neighborhood is great.

We had issues with our taxi overcharging and Alexandre immediately came down and helped us. He gave us a tour of the apartment and made sure we had no questions before leaving. For anyone taking a cab make sure you ask first and don't take a taxi bigger than you need as they charge more. Apt was exactly as pictured. Street noise was minimal but we did hear noise out back as many buildings back on each other. Fyi for anyone with mobility issues that Apt is 3 steep flights. Location was absolutely perfect

What a wonderful appartement! What a perfect host!
Everything was clean, prepared and just like promised.
We loved to be so close to all the important places in Lissabon. You can walk everywhere. And the train station to Estoril and Cascais is near by.
Thanks, Alexandre, for your warm welcome.

We had a great stay in Lisbon. The flat was great. Alex left a welcome pack featuring, amongst other things, a nice bottle of red wine. There is a cupboard with essentials which is always great to have. The location is brilliant, 2 mins walk around the corner and you get lost in a maze of little streets with loads of laid-back restaurants.
I strongly recommend it.

Sejour tres agreable. Appartement idealement situe dans le quartier de l'Alfama, petit commerce en bas de l'immeuble ouvert 24h sur 24.
Nous avons tout fait a pied, et Alexandre a ete un hote tres prevenant, en nous informant des quartiers, et lieux a visiter. Le petit plus, une bouteille de vin rouge et tablette de chocolat :-)
Appartement tres lumineux ou l on se sent chez soi tout de suite.
Merci encore Alexandre !

Alexandre nous a accueilli chaleureusement dans son appartement très bien situé dans un quartier typique de Lisbonne trés proche des transports en commun ,bus, tram dont la 28 â prendre absoluement. L'appartement est petit mais fonctionnel et suffisant pour quelques jours de vacances. Et sans oublier le petit cadeau de bienvenue! Bref, vraiment â conseiller

Alexandre is a great person, he welcomed us with a wine and choclate to his lovely and fully equipped apartment
The place is really nice and more beautiful to experience. We had a living room with complete amenities (TV, wifi, dining table).. Fully equipped kitchen with a wash machine, microwave, grill machine.. The bathroom, bedroom was really clean (though the bedroom is a little small but notwithstanding it is cozy and comfortable). The view from the living room is amazing nd morning rays filled the room we had our breakfast.. simply superb .. Thanks Alexandre, you have a great taste for home decor and a beautiful place !

We really enjoyed our stay at this apartment in Lisbon.  It was really cute, clean, and had a really great location - easy to find, and very close to a main train station.  It's quiet, but within easy walking distance to the main city center and the cute Alhambra neighborhood.  The photos are very accurate and Alexandre was a great host - he arranged to get us the keys and important information right when we arrived, and made himself available for any questions or advice.  Highly recommend it!

L'appartement a été plutôt bien décrit, il est agréable et très bien situé,
équipé avec le nécessaire, rien ne manquait.
Alexandre SOARES nous a accueilli, avec gentillesse et un petit cadeau de bienvenue.

Super séjour, l'appartement est idéalement situé, au coeur du quartier typique de l'alfama. Alexandre est un hôte très agréable,   il nous a accueilli avec une bonne bouteille de vin portugais, il est  avenant et très arrangeant. Un hôte au Top ! Merci alexandre ;)

Alexandre est une personne très aimable, accueillante, et disponible en cas de problème. Il nous a super bien reçu avec un petit cadeau de bienvenu et nous a donné quelques informations sur Lisbonne.
Concernant le logement, conforme à ce qu'il y a sur internet, très moderne. avec un quartier sympathique mais bruyant, pour dormir le soir fenêtres ouvertes, ce n'est pas évident !!!

Really nice apartment, not that big but good enough.
Alexandra is a friendly en helpful host !
we couldn't ask for any better.
accept for the weather everything was pretty perfect.

Perfect Location for a City Tour. You can walk everywhere in the city within 10 minutes. Alexandre is a really nice host. Did take care for everything. Apartment has everything you need. Would recommend it for a couple who also wants to go out at Night. Wouldn't recommend it for families with young children because of the noise at night.

We stayed at Alexandre's apartment in Lisbon for 4 nights.
It's beautiful, quiet and well decorated.
If you have a car it's quite easy to park around the house, but during the week you have to pay a toll.
The apartment is in a tipical Lisbon area, maybe not the safest one, it's well located and close to restaurants, shops, the touristc center and to the main attractions in Lisbon. It's also next to bus and tram stops.
Alexandre was very nice to us, he is a good host, he found the way to let us in the apartment even if we arrived late at night, and was always very helpful and kind.
Unfortunately i'm very allergic to dust mites and molds and a lot of other things and I had always asthma crisis during the night, probably just because i'm very unlucky :)
Despite this inconvenience we would recommend to stay at Alexandre apartment if you are in Lisbon for a few days!

The flat look really similar as is on web. Alexandre was very nice, show us everything. The flat is in Alfama near the river and very near the down town. You can visit all town by walk. Flat was clean adn equiped as a sudent flat. I do reccomend it!

Alexandre was an awesome host and very helpful (including when our taxi driver decided to take us on a detour, we got Alexandre on the phone to sort him out). He gave us heaps of information about Lisbon and the apartment was great. Location was perfect and was exactly like the pictures.  Would highly recommend staying here.

El apartamento es tal cual esta publicado, cuenta con todo lo necesario para la estancia. La ubicacion es perfecta, se puede ir a pie a recorrer la ciudad.  Alexander nos recibio muy amablemente, dandonos informacion de la ciudad.  Muy recomendable!!

Upon our arrival, we were welcomed by Alexandre in person, who patiently put up with our lagging communication before - we came to Lisbon at the end of an incredibly busy summer. The apartment was clean, comfortable and in a fantastic location - close to historic sites, public transportation, restaurants, the lively docks, cafes, bars by the river. I found a great running route immediately. We had a whole week to discover Lisbon and the surrounding area and it was great to be close to everything. One thing we missed was rest - there was an almost continuous dog barking in the building, sometimes what appeared to be up to 3 dogs barking without human control. It did not ruin our holiday, but I caution people who visit Lisbon not only to party but to rest, to check if the dog situation is resolved.

Alexandre offers a beautiful little apartment in that is just perfect if you want to explore Lisbon with up to 4 people.
Located in the beautiful old part of the city (the metro station is just 5 min away), the apartment is in a very nice old building, very well renovated and nicely equipped with everything you need to have a comfortable stay and to feel a little bit at home. Alexandre also is a great host that welcomes his guests personally and provides you with all the insider tips you need for a great stay!

Alexander è stato molto accogliente e disponibile. L'appartamento è carino, in posizione centrale , comodissimo per gli spostamenti. Dalle finestre,se aperte,arriva il rumore della strada. Il rapporto qualità prezzo è ottimo. Serena e Michele , Italia-Firenze

We had a really good time, the host is very gentle and nice. The house was like the description.
Very suggested!

This apartment was a great find - wonderful location, clean, comfortable and cosy. Alexandre was on hand to greet us with a bottle of wine and pint of milk (the perfect survival kit!) and was happy to answer questions and offer recommendations via text and phone call throughout our stay. Highly recommended!

We spent seven nights there. The apartment is as nice as it looks in the pictures. Alexandre was a very welcoming host. He took some time to tell us about different places and was very interested in making us have a nice stay.
If you need a place to stay in Lisbon, these adress is the good one.
Thank You, Alexandre!

Appartement très bien situé, excellent rapport qualité/ prix, très fonctionnel, propre, lumineux , parfait pour 4 personnes
Alexandre: hôte très à l'écoute de nos besoins, arrangeant pour les modalités pratiques(horaires d'arrivée, départ etc...) accueillant et chaleureux: : location parfaite, ne pas hésiter

This was my first time using Airbnb and i was a little nervous, however once dealing with Alexandre I felt completely comfortable. He is extremely polite and an absolute pleasure to deal with.
The apartment was perfect, what you see in the pictures is what you get and so clean! Absolutely loved this place, would definitely recommend. This place had everything you need and more!

The whole stay was fantastic. The apartment is as nice as it looks in the pics. Perfect location to visit all the highlights of the city but in a very authentic neighborhood of Lisbon full of restaurants and nice laberinthic streets. Alexandre was a perfect host with useful tips and a welcome treat.

We spent six nights in the apartment, and were very satisfied. My two kids appreciated especially the very fast and reliable private wifi network. The apartment was equipped with everything we needed, and then some. Alexandre was a very welcoming and informative host who also greeted us with wine and chocolates and invited us to check out late since there were no other guests immediately after us. The only small problem was that there is some kind of office next to the apartment with men walking the steep stairs and talking loudly at night, and also one or two dogs barking at odd hours making it hard to sleep. I would highly recommend this apartment to anyone coming to Lisbon, its location just on the edge of Alfama is perfect and the communication with the host was excellent!

Very comfortable apartment in a really nice area. Alexandre took some time to tell me about different places and was very interested in making me have a nice stay.
I can definitely recommend this place.

Stayed at Alexandre's apartment for 3 nights with 3 other girls. It is a gorgeous apartment, loved all the decorations and little details that shows that a lot of thought was put into the place. It was well-equipped with all the necessary machines, condiments, pots, pans etc. Oh and Alexandre was really sweet to greet us with a bottle of wine & chocolates!
The location was extremely central (walking distance to the main square as well as the castle up the hill). Neighbourhood can get a little noisy at night but it didn't bother us & we were able to get decent nights' sleep (after catching back-to-back episodes of Castle on AXN - yay for cable TV!)
Size-wise was just right for 4 girls on a short stay. The day bed expanded to a really huge and comfy double bed. Sheets, towels and a blanket all provided :)
Leading up to the 3rd floor apartment was a long flight of steep stairs which may not be ideal if you have heavy luggage but thankfully Alexandre was very willing to help us. Other than that it wasn't a problem but may be an issue if you travel with elderly etc.
Lisbon is a lovely rustic place, we had fun just wandering up and down alleyways. If you have the time, consider taking a day trip out to Sintra to see Moorish Castle & Pena Palace! It's easy & cheap to get to from Rossio Stn and the sights are breath-taking :)

Wir hatten wunderschöne Tage in Lissabon. Alexandre ist ein sehr freundlicher, hilfsbereiter und sehr angenehmer Gastgeber. Die Wohnung entspricht genau den Bildern, ist sehr stylisch eingerichtet und liegt super günstig um Lissabon zu erkunden. Wir kommen gerne wieder.

Appartement très agréable, qui correspond à l'annonce.
Alexandre est aux petits soins de ses invites.

Alexandre was a great host, providing constant communication, a very warm welcome, and even letting one of our friends store her bags/get into the apt early when she arrived earlier than the check in time. The apt is very centrally located, and feels very bright, hip and airy. The kitchen was really nice to cook in and it was so helpful to have a washer in the apt too. Highly recommended!
Great central located place! Perfect to discover Alfama and the rest of wonderful Lisboa. Alexandre is a great and flexible host.
We had a nice time at Alexande´s appartment. A friendly guy and a cosy place in Lisboa. ---->recommended<----
We were very happy in this apartment! Our stay was very comfortable and Alexandre's a great guy! Thank you and see you again!
Pretty much perfect. Nice neighbourhood in walking distance of the centre and close to the Metro. Alex was waiting for us when we arrived. Apartment a good size, clean, and well stocked.

We were traveling with a small kid and alhough the space in Alexandres appartment is somewhat limited it was totally sufficient for us and our baby bed. As shown on the pictures the furniture and equipment has a great style so that we felt very comfortable. Alexandre was really friendly and helpful and provided some good recommendations. Together with ita great location at the bottom od the Alfama this makes it a perfect place to stay on Lissabon.

Très bel appartement dans un quartier vivant et typique de Lisbonne. Tout près de bons petits restaurants (nous vous conseillons Barracao de Alfama, rua de San Pedro). Alex est très sympa. Bref la recette idéale pour un séjour inoubliable !!!

Nous avons passé un séjour très agréable.
L'appartement de Alexandre est vraiment très sympa, meublé avec goût , et très bien placé dans le quartier ancien d'Alfama.
En bas de l'immeuble il y a 2 supérettes et une pâtisserie bien pratiques pour un petit déjeuner.
Notre hôte Alexandre est lui même très sympa, et très accueillant .
Bref nous recommandons cette location

Very Nice appt. Good location.
Perhaps just the matress could be upgraded my Dear Alex !
I recommend this appt !
Franck
PS we were with our two kids.

Alexandre ist super nett und unkompliziert. Er ist sehr hilfsbereit in allen Dingen. Sein Apartment ist wirklich super gelegen und total stylisch und witzig eingerichtet. Kann man nur weiterempfehlen, alles tip top!!!!!

Pasamos unos dias espectaculares. Muy bien ubicado, accesible a toda la ciudad con facilidad. El departamento esta impecable, y equipado con todo lo necesario para una buena estadia. Alexandre es muy amable y cumplio con todo lo pactado. SSuper recomendable!!

O apartamento do Alexandre é muito charmoso, confortável e muito bem localizado. Alexandre foi muito atencioso e compreensivo conosco. Ele nos ofereceu chocolate e uma garrafa de vinho da região e na geladeira tinha leite e agua. Enfim tudo correu muito bem e realmente recomendo.

Wir hatte eine super Zeit in Lissabon. Die Wohung war top! Sehr zentral gelegen, sauber, super stylisch eingerichtet und mit allem nötigen ausgestattet.
Alexandre ist ein sympathischer Host, welche sich vorzüglich um seine Gäste kümmert.
Kann die Wohnung von Alexandre herzlichst weiter empfehlen.
Thanks Alexandre for being such a great host! The apartment was incredible and you were always available and accommodating to our needs! Thanks again!

It was a lovely place to stay and was our first experience of airbnb. The location was great in Alfama and there were several authentic delicious Portuguese restaurants within a few minutes walk. The host wasn't available to meet us that weekend but dispatched his charming father in law to greet us. The appartment has everything you need and is clean, decorated in a simple but artsy style - we felt instantly very at home here. I recommend it!

We stayed at the Surfboard Apartment for 3 nights, the Apartment was just as it was described and as you can see in the pictures: it was well decorated, clean, with excellent Wi-Fi, fully equipped kitchen and located very centrally. We had everything we needed! Although Alexandre was away during that time (pity we couldn't meet in person, maybe next time!), he organised everything well for us and welcomed us with a complimentary bottle of wine and chocolate. All in all, really pleasant stay to enjoy lovely Lisbon city!

Alexandre  couldn't have been a better host! He was so helpful and accommodating. Anytime we needed anything he respond immediately. He had great information about everything in Lisbon. We felt very welcomed! The apartment was adorable, and plenty spacious. It was also very clean! The location of the apartment was great and we felt very safe. Alexandre place was perfect for our stay in Lisbon! I highly recommended it!

Perfect location to explore Lisbon. Alexandres apartment is very cozy so we felt very at ease. Everything we needed was there. Shower and beds were great by the way. We would go back to this place for the second time, without a doubt.
Tolles apartment, gute Lage, netter zuverlässiger Host.

We had a pleasant time in Lisboa. The apartement was great for the four of us (kids 4,1). Although our flight was cancelled and we arrived very late, Alexandre was helpful and fast to show us everything. Perfect! And it is in walking distance to the sightseeing stuff.

The apartment was as described. Alexandre is very friendly and met us. He was very happy to answer our questions. The apartment was clean and centrally located. I would definitely visit again and recommend it to others.

Nous avons passé un séjour en toute légèreté! L'appartement est au pied de l'Alfama - bus et métro à proximité, le centre à quelques minutes à pied. Dans les petites rues derrière et juste en bas de l'immeuble on trouve tout ce dont on a besoin pour boire un café ou faire des courses.
L'appartement est très bien équipé - les matelas sont très confortables.
Alexandre est un hôte des plus aimables - il répond très rapidement à toutes les questions, aussi bien avant le séjour que pendant. Il est de toute confiance!

The time I spent in the surfboard apartment was indeed a time well spent.

The apartment was tastefully decorated and fully equipped both in room and kitchen. There are brochures that helped me to navigate the city and there's even cable TV!

It is located in Alfama arena so it is easy to reach and close to other area in Lisbon, walking distance to Fado Museum, Castle Sao Jorge, Se Cathedral, Comercio and other main attractions of Lisbon. I could easily go to the other parts of Lisbon as it is close to bus and tram.

Alexandre was a wonderful host. He didn't have the chance to welcome me but he sent his family to welcome and explained the apartment. We met later and he recommended me places from local point of view. He was also easy to contact at all time. He even ordered me taxi as I had to leave Lisbon very early.

This place is highly recommended and I will surely back.

We had a wonderful time at the surfboard apartment. Alexandre is a wonderful and very thoughtful host, the flat was immaculate, very tastefully furnished, and in a perfect location. We will surely book here again on our next trip to Lisbon!

Nous avons passé un très bon moment à Lisbonne, l'appartement est chaleureux et bien équipé avec une décoration très agréable. Il est situé à proximité de tout commerces dans un quartier authentique. Alexandre a été très accueillant et arrangeant pour les horaires, en nous conseillant les itinéraires à faire et avec une bonne bouteille de vin rouge portugais pour nous accueillir!

We stayed at the surfboard apartment for 3 days.  The apartment was clean, well decorated and had everything we needed.  Alexandre was very organized and emailed us the directions and provided parking instructions (lots of metered parking outside the apartment).  The apartment had excellent WiFi internet, cable TV and comfortable couch, with a well stocked kitchen (great for making your own light breakfast).  The location is close to down town, and right below the apartment are several convenience shops which is great for getting water and fruits.   We went and ate at the cute Cafe Pois and Cafe Cruz near by with delicious lunches and dinners.  Great Stay!

First time in Portugal and hopefully not the last one. Alexandre's appartment was perfect; clean, strategically positioned close to everything: cathedral, monuments, museums, restaurants, river, etc. Alexandre was very helpful. I would definitely recommend this place.

We had a lovely time in Alexandre's appartement. The location is great, not far from the center and full of transport just by. The stairs are a little stiff but not high. Great experience on the whole. Thank you Alexandre!
Alexandre was very polite and helpful. The apartment was clean and beautifully decorated. Appreciated the nice bottle of wine and chocolate that greeted us upon arrival.

Alexandre is the perfect host, friendly, informative & quick to respond. The complementary bottle of vinho was a lovely gesture!
The apartment was very well equipped with the kitchen having coffee, tea & all the condiments required.
We would not hesitate to return.
One note, be aware of the barking dog upstairs, would recommend ear plugs if you are a light sleeper!

We are a family of 4 (including 2 teenage children) and really enjoyed our stay in Lisbon (last week of december) and particularly in Alexandre's appartment.
Alexendre described it as small but cozy and this is exactly what it is. It's also well located and an invitation to walk in the Alfama district and beyond.
We had a wonderful time at Aexandre's appartment. He gave us very good pieces of advise and his appartment is perfectly located.

My friends and I were in Lisbon for a short stay and Alexandre's apartment was perfect for the trip! It is located in Alfama, the old part of the city, so it's really near the Pantheon and St George's Castle, and we pretty much walked everywhere. The kitchen is well equipped with all the necessities, and even better, we were given a complimentary bottle of wine and some chocolate and mints, plus access to coffee and tea as well! With my friends, we spent a really good time in Lisbon. The Alexandre's apartment was really nice, clean, very well equipped.

A stylish apartment in an excellent location down a quiet side street. Great restaurants and bars are a stone's throw away. You can pretty much walk to all the major sights, or hop on a tram. We had a fabulous stay and would definitely come again.
The apartment is in a wonderful location and we were very pleased withe communication before and during the stay. You will be greatful at the end of the day for the elevator!
리스본여행을 위한 최적의 위치(Carmo 수녀원 바로 옆)임에도 상당히 조용하다. 특히 Hosting team의 역할이 훌륭하다. 겨울철에 여행하는 경우, 난방 걱정을 하지 않아도 될 만큼 난방시스템이 잘 되어있고, 엘리베이터가 있어서 좋았다.
Pedro's place is hip, clean, and central to so many things. He was super responsive and helpful, and had a great book of local recommendations. Would definitely stay here again!

This is a lovely, stylish apartment. We stayed for 4 nights over Xmas. The place had a lovely warm homely feel to it. Sofas were a dream to relax on. Bed so comfortable. Linen and towels were top quality. Place was very clean too.
We didn’t need the heating on as it was quite warm inside, in fact we had the balcony doors open when we were in. At night you could not hear the street noise with the balcony doors shut. The only noise we had was that from upstairs walking on their wooden floor, however it wasn’t a huge deal and only heard it in morning and early evening.
There’s a communal laundry room which is shared with the other three studios and houses the washing machine, clothes airers, ironing board and irons. Also supplied is washing powder, conditioner and extra toilet paper if needed.
Location is fantastic. Walking distance to train station, trams and buses. After walking around the other areas, Chiado is definitely the one we preferred.
There is everything in the apartment you need to self cater. We used the Bose system (not too loudly though), although with the balcony doors open you can hear music from the streets below which was lovely. Very useful having the portable WiFi unit too.
Ladies, note that the hairdryer is a small travel one with just one speed setting and one heat setting. I’m afraid my long hair didn’t like it.
We also received a bottle of champagne and the Portuguese Christmas cake which was a very thoughtful gesture along with hand written notes.
Overall, a great stay in a lovely apartment and I would not hesitate to recommend to stay here. The team have thought about travellers need. Thinking about it, if they supplied shower and hair gel too then they would have it spot on. (Sorry I meant to have included this suggestion in my personal feedback).

We arrived late in the night to Chiado all excited about our very first trip to Portugal and there was Pedro's team waiting to let us in and explain all the amenities of this wonderful apartment. Property is situated in the heart of Chiado and close to all attractions including Rossio Square at a walking distance. Me and my boyfriend had a wonderful time in Lisbon and thanks a ton for making our stay comfortable and memorable. We will be back! :)
nice team . comfortable location
Great location, smart decoration, excellent communication, everything you need in your base to explore Lisbon is here!

Thank you very much for your hospitality and friendliness. We had a fantastic stay.
We got very good advise how to reach the flat. Of course everything was super clean, the flat was well equipped, the WiFi was very good.
We would like to came back to enjoy the tasteful design of the flat and the great area of Chiado.

Fantastic location in the heart of the Chiado neighborhood. It was easily walkable to everything in the historic downtown. The building is located on a quiet street so there was no noise late at night. Getting a cab or Uber was very easy because the apartment is near a major landmark. The GPS in the Uber app was a bit challenging in some parts of the city; I found it was easier for the driver to find me when I entered a landmark rather than an address.
Great views from the balcony. The elevator was a welcome bonus for help with bags. The kitchen facilities were very nice. There is a grocery store across the street if you plan to cook. The portable WiFi in the apartment was a big help. Be sure to bring your own shampoo and toiletries. The bathroom was lovely and water pressure was great.

Расположение квартиры превосходное. В пешей доступности одни из самых красивых видов Лиссабона. Буквально за углом лифт Санта-Жуште. Рядом с домом небольшой сквер, где можно попробовать знаменитый ликёр Жиньжинья! Станция метро и большой торговый центр на соседней улице. Жильё понравилось, стильный интерьер, чисто, красивый вид с балкончика,единственный минус кошачий запах в туалете. Если хозяин исправит проблему, то квартира будет идеальной!!!
Amazing place, can't beat the location! The square next to the building was our favorite! Go book this place, you'll love it!
Excelente localização! Adoramos a receptividade e a lista de restaurantes próximos ao apartamento. Cama muito confortável!

Tiny street, great location.  My husband and I stayed at the Chiado Lofts for 6 nights in late Oct/early Nov.  Fantastic location -- walking distance to the metro, trains to Sintra and Belem, great restaurants, Castelo Sao Jorge, the Alfama, spectacular viewpoints, and shopping.   It's also relatively quiet for such an active area.  Check-in was easy.  Pedro and the team were very responsive.  I don't think we could have made a better choice for our accommodation in Lisbon.
Great apartment and many thoughtful touches. Location superb and the flexibility on the last day with regards to bag storage was much appreciated. Highly recommended.

This is an incredible apartment!!  The location is perfect; you are in the middle of everything and yet there is no street noise.  The apartment is even nicer than in the pictures. Super nice and comfortable.  And the host is very responsive.  We will definitely come back!!
Perfect size and location for my wife and I. We could sit on The balcony and drink wine. Thank you Pedro!

Very stylish and thoughtfully put together Airbnb. Our host greeted us  earlier than checkin and allowed us to drop off our bags earlier as well as we arrived at 8am in the morning. The space has everything you need and with a stylish twist! Great view of the ocean and of the castle. A full kitchen is included along with all cooking utensils. Our host even gifted us a bottle of wine! This was a great stay in Lisbon and will gladly recommend it others

Great location for exploring Lisbon. Stylish apartment with everything you need. Antonio was waiting for us to arrive and quick to respond to any questions we contacted him about. Would definitely recommend to friends/family.

Very stylish designed apartment.  Enjoyed watching the sunset with a bottle of wine and light breeze and the street music in the little balcony with my hubby.  Exceptional convenient and good hospitality!

파두 공연장, 펍들이 모여있는 골목에서 걸어서 5분거리, 테주강과 호시우역 등도 걸어서 10분 이내입니다. 오래된 아파트지만 내부는 깔끔합니다. 호스트의 답변은 빠르게 왔고 저희가 밤 11시 반에 도착했는데도 숙소 앞에서 시간 맞춰 저희를 기다리고 있었습니다. 비록 아주 오래된 엘레베이터지만 엘레베이터가 있어서 좋았습니다. 다만 샤워기가 머리 위에서 쏟아지는 고정식 샤워기라 머리 안감고 몸만 씻을때는 조금 불편할 수 있네요.
Prachtig appartement qua ligging en inrichting. Ik raad het iedereen aan.

The place is just as beautiful as in the pictures. The view from the balcony was wonderful to see the moon and the sunrise. The area is great for bars and restaurants. Well connected with public transport.

Place was in a great location really central...the Carmo plaza was a nice spot to be in, good food options and performers, you can sit on the apartments balcony and hear some of the music, really relaxed vibe. The actual apartment was really nice. Having an elevator and AC was great after a long day of walking. Everything was clean and in good shape. They provided us with a portable WiFi which was huge to help us find our way around with our using our data. We loved being in Lisbon and would stay at this place again.
Comfortable, stylish, spacious studio right in the city centre

Location was very convenient, check-in was easy and had no problems accommodating our earlier arrival time. All communications were prompt, even some questions we had after arriving. Apartment was very clean and spacious. Made our first trip to Lisbon even more enjoyable. Thanks!
A wonderful place to stay in Lisbon/Chiado! Very clean, stocked with some nice amenities and in a great location. We loved it.

We loved our stay! The check in with
was friendly and thorough. The apartment was both gorgeous and very centrally located. Amazing bathroom and large, comfortable bed. We only wish we could have stayed longer. Book it!

You can't beat this location in Lisbon.  The park next door was a huge plus with good restaurants , evening drinks under the beautiful trees and some wonderful street musicians. Pedro's place is clean and comfortable for our 5 night stay.  Be sure to communicate with Pedro's team about your arrival since you really want them to meet you at the door to get into the building; It's a little tricky.  It wasn't clear what button we were supposed to push and cause us some stress since we didn't have cell access. Our host arrived just at the perfect time to unlock and show us around.

Thank you so much to Antonio, Pedro and the team – my mother and I had a wonderful few night stay in the heart of Chiado, steps away from some of our favorite spots. What a wonderful way to spend the way touring the city as a home base. Apartment was sparkling clean, with everything you might need, from a mini terrace, to Nespresso pods, a mini fridge for groceries, Bose bluetooth speakers, portable WiFi, comfortable bedding, shared laundry, and an impeccable bathroom. Highly recommended. Muito obrigado!

Had a great experience and was happily surprised in every aspect. The place was extremely stylish and clean, and had everything we needed (and more!) They had a portable Bose speaker, and even had a portable wifi device that we could bring out with us so that we could have wifi everywhere we went. Check-in was easy, and Antonio let us leave our luggages with them on our last day since we had some time after check out before we had to fly out. The bathroom was very nice, with all marble. The location was great, very central. All in all I would highly recommend this place to anybody looking to stay in Lisbon.

Lovely apartment in a central area, with great touches like a coffee machine and bluetooth Bose speaker. Side view of the sea and over the rooftops on a little balcony. The MOST comfortable bed!! We really enjoyed our stay and would recommend it. Good value for money.

We had a great time at Pedro’s apartment! The location is excellent, Alfama, Baixa, and train and bus station are all within walking distance. There is a small square outside of the apartment with an outdoor bar and restaurant which we enjoyed sitting at after dinner. Comfortable bed and dark quiet apartment was great for sleeping. Antonio’s recommendations for restaurants and sightseeing were all excellent. Thanks for a great stay!

We had an amazing time at our airbnb. The space was just as advertised.  It was very clean and super spacious. Check in was easy as we were greeted by our host to tell us the ins and outs of our stay. The building also has an elevator which was helpful as we did not need to carry our luggage up multiple flights of stairs. Also, after walking and sightseeing all day the last thing you may want to do is climb steps.  In the airbnb there was a list of local spots that were recommended which was helpful, and our hosts also left a nice bottle of white wine for us which was a nice touch. Overall, this was a very positive experience and I would recommend this airbnb to anyone!
He is  a great host. Also the apartment is located at the heart of the lisbon. This is really a perfect opportunity for people who seek comfort and perfection.

Very nice place to stay, centrally located and easy to reach. From the inside - superb furnishing and amenities. Hosts were professional and friendly.
When we stayed Lisbon had extreme high temperatures. The flat had an issue with the trash odour in the entrance ground floor and the strong ammonia odour in the bathroom. The hosts have numerous stick scent diffusers, which solves the issue partially.
Nontheless the flat is definitely to recommend and leaves a good impression.
A well equipped, furnished and maintained apartment in a great location and overseen by a very attentive host. Hope to visit again soon.
Service fiable et attentionné! Un très bel appartement dans un quartier très "in".
Cozy studio in the heart of Chiado.
Chiado and this little park area where these apartments are, make the perfect place to base your Lisbon visit.

Great location in Lisbon if you love classic spaces and street music. This was magic for us, we opened the big windows turned off the AC and let the street music filter in, just great (If you close the windows it was silent).  The space itself was as described, very comfortable with better than usual amenities.  The apartment just felt right and again the location was brilliant.
This is a very stylish and comfortable apartment in an excellent location. António was really helpful and made our stay very easy and enjoyable. I would thoroughly recommend this property.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Pedro’s apartment. Our flight was delayed and arrived later than expected, but Gonçalo waited to explain everything to us on our arrival close to midnight!
Stylish, spacious and located close to the action. Comfortable bed, nice shower, coffee machine and even champagne glasses are available.
We would choose this place when we come to Lisbon again!
Amazing location and beautiful place, we would definitely stay here again!

This place is fantastic for a stay in Lisbon! Location can't be beat, easy walk to so many restaurants and shopping. There's a cute little square right around the corner, musicians frequently play music which you can hear from the small balcony. So lovely to sit outside and enjoy a drink with the view of the water and music playing! We were very sad to leave. Apt has everything you need and the hosts are very helpful!

Je conseille  vivement les appartements de Pedro idéalement placés  en plein centre près de toutes les visites, ses appartements sont très bien agencés  et très joliment décorés  au calme dans un quartier sympa près du métro  des taxis des trams des supermarchés  quartier où vous n'aurez que l'embarras du choix  pour choisir des restos sympas accueil chaleureux malgres notre arrivée tardive allez y vous pouvez être  qu'enchantés
This apartment was great...in a great location and very well equipped! Check in, communication and service were all easy. We would return!

The host always responded quickly, which was extremely helpful. The apartment was as gorgeous as it looks in the photos, and the location was perfect. This was one of our favorite Airbnbs and it really made our first time in Lisbon special. Thank you!

Location, location, location .... The apartment is in a great spot in the Chiado district. Couldn't be closer to great restaurants and shopping.
Also, the space is great. Very clean and well maintained. Plenty of room for two people and comfortably appointed.
Thoughtful touch: portable wi-fi!
Very nice apartment in perfect location

We really enjoyed our stay at Pedro's place. We were welcomed by Gonçalo, who was waiting for us when we got there. He was extremely helpful and friendly.  The apartment is very comfortable, and well fitted out with everything one might need.  Great bathroom also and nice bed and bedding. The location in Chiado was perfect, being in a quiet street, but just a short walk to the main centre - and also to neighbouring Bairro Alto. Lots going on during the day.  And many places close by to eat or sit outside and have a drink. Obrigado !
Great apartments in a very central location. Comfy bed and close walk to plenty of restaurants and bars. Nice views of the river and the castle as well.

Very central location in Chiado - walk to basically everywhere you need within 15-20 minutes max. The apartment was well laid out and had everything we needed. Special thank you to Goncalo for the late night visit to help us with an issue with our key (which they replaced the next day too) - these guys make sure you are well looked after!

A fantastic spacious apartment in a great location and the team of hosts were superb. Responsive and helpful from the moment we booked to sorting and answering questions during our stay. It makes such a difference. We experienced this as the perfect apartment for a couple looking for a comfortable spacious place to come back to and enjoy being in, after time in the city
