Important to confirm the bed is very comfortable ( key requirements!) great bathroom and with a good shower. Best of all the light spacious apartment: huge sofas, well fitted out kitchen and a wonderful small outdoor balcony that just about fits two for that glass of wine before heading out for dinner in the evening. You can just see the sea over the rooftops. We loved our stay here and would definitely return when coming back to Lisbon.

We are just back from a great trip to Lisbon, staying in the beautiful studio in Chiado. The studio is exactly as pictured in the photos and had everything we needed for our stay. It is bright, clean and very comfortable with great facilities, including nespresso machine, juicer, toaster, etc.
The location is excellent, full of character and charm, with lots of nice restaurants and shops nearby.
Communication with the host was excellent, all through the booking process, also at check-in and check-out. We appreciated very much how helpful our host was regarding our arrival and departure times.
We are hoping to return again soon to the beautiful city of Lisbon and to stay again in this lovely studio for a longer visit next time

The place matches the pictures and description. Enjoy your coffee or wine on the little balcony while you listen to the locals going about their day on the lively street below. The neighborhood quiets down though in the evenings so you'll get a good night's sleep on the big comfy bed. Location is great and communication with the hosts was quick and easy. Highly recommended!

Pedro's apartment located in the best area of Lisbon!
We enjoyed the apartment, the only thing that was missing is amenities as soap and toilet paper, beside that everything was great.

Antonio was a very attentive host.  We had a minor problem with the key and he showed ASAP with a solution.  The apartment is very comfortable with everything we needed.  We especially enjoyed lounging in the morning sun on the comfy couches.  The location is brilliant.

This was in the perfect location! It was a quick walk from the metro when we first arrived and was in the center of everything. The mobile hotspot they provide was just brilliant and made our time in Lisbon a breeze. The one frustration was the door to the building can be tricky to open, but this was in no way their fault and we were taught how to open it upon arrival. It was such a perk to have access to the hall washer and iron during our stay. As is expected in Europe, there are less outlets than you may be used to in the US but we made it work.
They were very quick to respond and even suggested dinner options for us on the Easter holiday. I would not hesitate to stay here again and it is hard to beat the location.
If you have come to Lisbon to explore the old city, I would highly recommend this place.  It's perfectly located and sits in a great neighborhood.

Antonio looked after us during our stay and he was wonderfully helpful about everything. The apartment is in a lovely location literally footsteps from a beautiful square with restaurants and shops of very high quality. Would recommend very highly!

Excellent option in Chiado area! The Studio is super trendy and modern! Antonio was a great host and gave me valuable tips on places to eat. Very nice neighborhood. Seeing Sao Jorge Castle from my window was absolutely special

This is a fantastic apartment in a location both convenient to sight seeing and otherwise lively and fun. Lots of great shopping nearby with quality restaurants and even an affordable vegetarian buffet or an organic market across the street for lazier days. Do not miss the archeological museum hidden across the square. Pedro assembled a helpful and comprehensive guide, a thoughtful added gesture of hospitality. We would definitely stay here again and will recommend to our friends and family planning trips to Portugal.

This place was AWESOME.  Less than 300 meters t most of Lisbon's coolest bars and restaurants, amazing space, and affordably priced.  One of the best AirBnB experiences I have had anywhere in the world!

A real gem ...great location

Fabulous appliances including the orange juicer

E' la 5 volta che vengo a Lisbona ma quest'appartamento mi è piaciuto
veramente tanto per l'atmosfera e i suoi confort.
Locatie uitstekend!

Beautiful, spacious studio apartment in absolutely the best location in Lisbon. Everything on your doorstep and the guys were great to deal with. including great recommendations for restaurants. Couldn’t recommend it highly enough.
今までのAirbnbで利用した中で最高の部屋で、かつ滞在中のホストの対応も素晴らしいものでした。紹介され、予約していただいたレストランも大変美味でした。自信を持って誰にでもこの部屋を薦めることができます。すべての面で満足でき、完璧です。部屋にportable wifiが装備されていたのは、滞在中の行動において、大変プラスでした。ありがとうございました。

Extremamente atencioso e cordial. Dicas de sítios para visitar/comer, apartmento limpo e acolhedor. Agradeço imenso ter-nos recebido no seu espaço que nos fez sentir em casa e também a ajuda que me deu com o item esquecido aquando do check-out. Não poderia estar mais contente com a minha escolha. Obrigada por tudo.
The apartment was exactly what we were looking for, great stylish space, quiet building and in a bustling location. We will definitely return!

Excellent AirBNB place. One of the best we have had so far. We can only recommend it if you are planning a visit to Lisbon. Perfect location, amazing old building (with a charming elevator) and a fantastic view over the river. Only a few steps away from the sights, tons of restaurants, boutique shops, and many more. The place is clean and comfortable.  Very good value for money. Thanks to the whole team.

This place is a perfectly located, super clean apartment. We were there for 2 nights, everything is walking distance, the place smells nice, looks and feels nice and has everything you need. We got tips, wine and friendly hosts. We could even store our bags in the hall as a favour as our flight was only later in the day. Would stay here again in a heartbeat!
This was amazing!

The place is in a very good location (near everything), good sun light, the comunication with the host was really good.
The only but is that the place is not as new as you can see in the pictures.

The apartment was great for our party of two and the location was perfect for exploring the city! I would stay here again on another trip to Lisbon. The mifi hot spot was a nice perk, and the team was very responsive and friendly throughout our stay. You'll need to bring your own shampoo, soap, etc, but thankfully we did so it wasn't a problem. The airbnb was less than a five minute walk to Manteigaria so needless to say we got our fill of Pasteis de Nata multiple times a day! It's also a quick walk away from Povo which was a super cute bar with live fado. The fado cocktail there with Porto wine is a must!

Excelente localização, confortável e super equipado. Tudo perto, restaurantes, manteigarias fábrica de pastéis de nata, cafés, lojas, e transporte público. Comunicação  com o proprietario extremamente facil. Recomendo com empenho.

This is a terrific, comfortable apartment in a great location. It is well equipped and charming and quiet even though in the heart of the area. There are lots of good restaurants and transport or walking to other areas is very easy.

Amazing location. Communication with Pedro and his team was brilliant and efficient. They kept our luggage due to our evening flight. Will certainly stay here again when I return to Lisbon. The apartment was fantastic- luxurious and comfortable.
Très bel appartment en plein centre mais au calme. Jolie déco, literie de qualité, contacts avec le propriétaire très facile, bonne liste d'adresses. Une excellente adresse !
Great apartment with the little extras you appreaciate whilst travelling.  Lovely couch and styled very nicely.

Great accommodation in a great location in the heart of the best of Lisbon. Would recommend for couples looking for a romantic break. Everything built for comfort and relaxation. Well equipped, air con if needed.
The apartment is beautiful and the location is ridiculously handy for everywhere you might want to walk to.

O apartamento é excelente!
Estava muito limpo (cozinha e banheiro, inclusive), que é o que mais nos importa.
Recebe sol de manhã e é claro durante o dia.
Está muito bem localizado, ao lado do Largo do Carmo, o que nos permitiu fazer muitos passeios a pé e também acessar facilmente ônibus, metrô e até mesmo o trem que nos levou a Sintra.
Por causa de restrições alimentares, preparamos nossas próprias refeições, embora haja uma infinidade de restaurantes na vizinhança. A cozinha do apartamento atendeu perfeitamente a nossas necessidades, para o período que ficamos (6 dias). Na metade da estadia, foi feita uma limpeza extra na casa e foram trocadas as roupas de cama e banho.
Havia até uma máquina de lavar roupas (igualmente limpa) à nossa disposição.
Mais: diferentemente dos prédios baixos do centro de Lisboa, este tinha elevador - era pequeno, bem antigo e simpático (daqueles com porta sanfonada), o que foi ótimo não só para subir e descer as malas, como também para chegar ao apartamento depois dos longos passeios a pé pela cidade.
Simplesmente perfeito!

Super accueil!!   Nous avons été accueilli de façon exceptionnelle. Les petites attentions tel que la bouteille de vin au frais, la borne wi-fi portative et la réservation du taxi pour l'aéroport ont grandement faciliter notre séjour.  De plus, la communication avec Pedro était sans faille!! Je recommande grandement cet hôte si vous devez séjourner à Lisbonne.  L'emplacement est parfait!
We had a great time at this apartment.  It is in a very busy neighborhood but is removed enough to be quiet.  The view from the balcony is also a real plus.
Very clean, great location, professional management and thoughtful extras - we would stay at this apartment again without hesitation.

This apartment is everything you can expect. The disposition is really efficient, the design is made with a lot of taste and cozy. We enjoyed coming back at the end of the day to relax while having a glass of wine on the confortable couch talking about our day. The area was our favorite of Lisbon, calm but with cute restaurants and boutiques. Our host was really organized, nice, communication was great.
Would surely recommend it!
Thank you
Great apartment in great part of town. Super nice communication and smooth check in. Recommended.
The apartment is perfect for exploring Lisboa on foot.  Highly recommend staying here.  The Apartment was comfortable and well maintained.

Add this to the list of glowing reviews for this lovely accommodation!  A big thank you to Goncalo and Pedro for their warm welcome and great hospitality.  Everything was ready when I arrived, and they gave me so many little "extras" to make me feel more welcome (Nespresso capsules, chocolates, a detailed list of places to go/things to do, and so forth).  I highly recommend this home to anyone visiting Lisbon, you won't regret it :)

Apartment very well located near everything, very clean, our host was always available and very friendly. I would not hesitate to go back. Thank you for your warm welcome and your valuable information.
Wonderful place. VERY clean. Beautiful spot in the city across from a great food market. I would stay here again for sure. They have all the amenities you could ask for.

Pedro and his associates are very easy to communicate with and are very helpful and accommodating. We were warmly welcomed, and every detail of the apartment utilities was carefully explained. Nice touches such as welcoming wine and a piece of chocolate were also very nice after a long day.
The apartment is clean, comfortable, and in a wonderful location close to transportation, restaurants, and sites. Also provided was a portable wifi device that made getting around even easier.
We would highly recommend staying in this apartment, and would return here in the future.

This apartment is in the perfect location in Lisbon. It's quiet yet extremely central to all of the tourist sites as well and the best bars and restaurants in town. We had a great stay here and would definitely come back to this apartment again.
We had the best time. Great location, quiet and wonderful place to discover this beautiful city.

El apartamento es precioso y muy bien acondicionado lo que permite estar perfectamente cómodos en Lisboa. El transporte público está muy cerca y hay todo tipo de servicios en las proximidades
El trato de los propietarios y su acogida son exquisitos.
If you see these apartments available on your dates - NO doubts - book it! :) Great location, awesome design and super friendly hosts! Highly recommended
Honest to goodness the best Airbnb I've ever stayed in.

This was by far the best Airbnb we've ever stayed in. Spotlessly clean, beautiful decor, seamless check in/check out, communicative and gracious hosts. They left us an incredible packet full of restaurant/bar ideas, we ended up having our best meals of the trip thanks to them. They also gave us a portable wifi device so we could explore the city without having to use too much international data. The area around the apartment is spectacular too-- fabulous restaurants and shops-- and it only took us about 20 min in a cab to get to the airport. Highly recommend!

We had an amazing time at the apartment!
Great location, luxurious and exactly as described.
Worth every cent!!!
Will definitely be back!
Amazingly helpful and hospitable hosts 5* service and a beautiful 5* apartment, perfectly situated for Chiado, Barrio Alto and the main shopping and central Lisbon sights.

Great location! Really enjoyed our time. Thanks to Antonio for accommodating us and for the instructions.
P.S. The pocket WiFi 🖒 :)
Really great place, central, walking distance from many good places, superb host and fantastic apartment. Would love to come back!
We loved the airbnb. It is very clean, spacious, and the location was perfect. And the staff was very helpful both before check-in and during our stay. I cannot recommend it highly enough.

If you want to explore the history of Lisbon and its fabulous buildings and attractions, you couldn't do better than this studio offered by Pedro and his colleagues. It is ideal accommodation for two travellers, provides all facilities, and is located right in the heart of the Baixa/Chiado district - Ruinas do Carmo and laid-back eating and drinking in the square are all only 50 metres away.  Just about every historic site is within walking distance, but be prepared to negotiate the steep, cobbled streets and stairways. We stayed 7 nights - thoroughly recommend.

Hi,
We loved our stay in your apartment- it was beautiful, stylish and clean. It also had a fantastic view! We really enjoyed drinking a Nespresso coffee with the windows open and the sun coming through whilst we were having breakfast.
The hosts were fantastic too. Really cared about us enjoying our stay. Also very helpful in recommending places to eat etc.
The area was superb - so central. The lift was great too.
We would have no hesitation in recommending you to any of our friends who want to stay in Lisbon in the future. Hopefully we will be back someday too!
Kind regards
Gill

Ottimo il nostro soggiorno nel bell’appartamento di Baixiia Chiado.Accolti in modo perfetto da Antonio.Centralissimo, quartiere pieno di vita, tutti collegamenti a pochi minuti di strada. Si affaccia sul delizioso Largo do Carmo, un salotto all’aperto circondato da alberi di gelso che in questo periodo si riempiono di bellissimi colori viola.Abbiamo potuto lasciare per qualche ora il nostro bagaglio in deposito.

La comunicación siempre fue fluida y nos esperaron en el apartamento a la hora acordada. Excelente ubicación, en el centro de Chiado, pero a la vez se trata de un lugar tranquilo y silencioso para descansar. El apartamento está muy bien decorado y cuenta con todo lo necesario. El ascensor genial si vas con equipaje pesado. Muy buenas opciones de wifi. Lo recomiendo sin dudar.

We are so happy with our stay at Pedro's place. The apartment in centrally located, with many restaurants and bars in a short walking distance. The space was very clean, which made our stay very comfortable. Communication and check in were easy, and we were greeted with a bottle of wine and chocolates. Thank you Pedro!

My husband and I had such a great stay at Pedro's apartment! It's exactly as pictured and described (LOVED the all marble bathroom!). Pedro was there to meet us right on time (he kindly accommodated us before check-in time which we appreciated!). He also left us a bottle of wine and chocolate! The apartment was very spacious, clean and equipped with everything you would need for a comfortable stay. There's even a portable wifi router that you can take around with you which was AMAZING to have! The apartment is located on a quiet street, yet 2 blocks away from all the shopping, restaurants, and center of everything. We were able to come back during the day for rest easily since it's located so close to everything. Even Rossio Train Station is close by if you want to take day trips out of Lisbon. I would definitely recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Lisbon!
Fantastic apartment. The team are very welcoming. Nice touch that they also provide mobile internet whilst you roam the city.
Excellent location and host! Would strongly recommend

Hemos estado el puente de mayo. La estancia en el apartamento ha sido genial. Muy bien situado. Centrico y a la vez tranquilo por la noche, para poder dormir. El apartamento estaba muy limpio. Es muy funcional. La cama muy comoda, lo que nos ha permitido descansar. Nada que objetar.
Gonzalo ha sido muy amable. Estuvo pendiente de nuestra llegada, y gestiono la guarda de nuestras maletas hasta que nos fuimos por la tarde.
Excepcional.
Great location, great place to stay, great hospitilaty. We will be back. Recommend strongly
Emplacement parfait et logement confortable
Great Host, great place. We will come back and recommed it. If you wanne stay central and quit than choose this apartment. Thanks for everthing!!
Great location and a really great host who was very helpful with local recommendations and accommodating with our flight times.
Beautiful apartment very nicely furnished and very comfortable. Great location for everything. Loved my stay and would highly recommend.
The apartment is perfect for a stay in Lisbon. It is in a great area and views from the balcony are nice.  Hosts were good and nice little touches.  Nearest metro is Baixa-Chiado (5min walk).

Antonio was a great hosts! Communication with him was stellar when we had questions or issues. The apartment was very comfortable and great to come back to after hiking the city.
The apartment's location was very central, yet very quiet. It came with a portable wifi which came in handy while running around the city. Also, be sure to bring your own shower toiletries if you're staying here.

Fantastic location with plenty of places to eat and drink within walking distance. Great flat that was very comfortable and had everything you could want and more.  The coffee and pastries left were a very nice touch as was the hand written note, wine and chocolates! I look forward to staying again o my next visit.

Pedro's apartment is excellent. It is located right in the centre of town with lots of good places to eat and drink nearby. The small features in the flat made a big difference - coffee machine, bose speaker, great shower and bathroom, lovely balcony. I'd thoroughly recommend it if you are thinking of staying in Lisbon and want a comfortable stay.
Great location and modern apartment with facilities as described. Would recommend to anyone visiting Lisbon wanting a central location to explore.

Fantastic apartment - clean, ultra modern, airy with all the modern appliances available. Very close to the central district with restaurants and nightlife as well as starting point of most touristic tours.
Some flips, just so you know: This is part of a group of serviced apartments, not a stand alone apartment. While towels etc are provided, consumables like shower gel, shampoo aren't.
Don't be too enamored by the balcony, apart from the occasional peek you won't get much value off it. The building is a heritage building and the elevator is slightly scary!
That said, none of these are deal breakers. The apartment overall is a great value for money.. they add other nice touches like a gratis pocket wifi device (for those who don't have a net connection).
Overall, if I came to Lisbon again, I wouldn't hesitate in booking the same apartment.
Highly recommend.

Really enjoyed our stay at Pedro's apartment. The team was very flexible when a winter storm changed our travel plans and was in constant communication to help us check in to the apartment. The apartment itself is perfectly located to explore Lisbon by foot and is beautifully decorated. The bathroom is especially nice! The team left us a bottle of wine and chocolates as a welcome gift. We would definitely stay again!

Logement idéalement situé pour notre séjour. En plein cœur de la ville mais au calme tout Lisbonne est à quelques pas de découverte! Appartement à la décoration soigneuse, moderne et chaleureuse, Fidel o photos!
Avec patience notre hôte a attendu tard dans la nuit notre arrivée car notre vol avait eu du retard! Souriant et accueillant! Une très bonne adresse pour une découverte typique de la ville.

Pedro and the team beyond helpful leading up to the trip by checking in regularly, meeting us at the apartment upon arrival to give us the lay of the land and provide us with lots of suggestions and tips. The apartment itself was perfect for our 5 day trip. The pictures were an exact representation of the apartment, with a pleasant surprise with how nice with bathroom was! It had the feel of a nice hotel. On top of how great the apartment was, the location was ideal. We were also within walking distance to all the must see spots throughout the city, shops, restaurants, and a 3-4 minute walk to the metro stop and tram station stops. Overall we were thrilled with our apartment and I would highly recommend staying here on your visit to this beautiful city.

Super appartement pour deux personnes, tous les engagements sont tenus. Cadre particulièrement agréable, emplacement exceptionnel, grande disponibilité de l'équipe. Très au calme en plein centre animé. Lisbonne est à nous...

If you want the ultimate perfect central location in central Lisbon....this is it, all at your doorstep. A top flight studio apartment with all the top modern conveniences. The convenience of this venue for a stay in Central Lisbon cannot be emphasized enough. Highly recommended!
Pedro's place is top notch in every sense. It is in a GREAT location, the best, beautiful interior design where every need is taken care of. We had an incredible stay, it doesn't get better.
Great stay, everything was as described. Host we'e flexible with looking after our bags before the official check-in time. Would highly recommend.

We had a great time at Pedros place! The location is perfect, you can reach all the interesting places by foot and the subwaystation is also very close. There are a lot of good places around for snacks and drinks! The appartment ist beautifull and has everything you need and even more. It's a cozy, stylish and lovely place; we would absolutely recommend it! Everything was really clean and nice decorated. We even had a Bose soundbox and a nice little kitchen with everything you need for cooking (including a dishwasher). The Check-In was very uncomplicated, we could even check in earlier than agreed because my girlfriend arrived earlier. Pedro and his crew were very helpfull and gentle!
Thanks for having us!

O Apartamento é muito bem decorado e limpo. A localização é excelente. O atendimento de primeira classe.
Recomendo.
Neri

Pedro listing is located in Central Lisbon (Chiado) neighborhood with various shopping centers, nightlife and restaurants. Very accommodating. Highly recommend this listing. You will not be disappointing.

Nos ha encantado disfrutar de la ciudad desde este apartamento. Nos recibieron puntualmente a nuestra llegada y nos obsequiaron con una botella de vino portugués. El apartamento es cálido y tranquilo. Absolutamente recomendable.

Our stay at this apartment was just amazing!! The apartment was nothing short of a five star hotel suite- beautiful interiors, all amenities, fully equipped, very modern. At the same time, as soon as you step out in the balcony or outside the apartment building, you are bang in the historic centre of the city. The important squares of Lisbon city like Comercio and Rossio are all walking distance. A lot of shops and restaurants are close by. Lastly, the checkin process was so smooth with the hosts and they were kind to explain everything. They even left complimentary wine, champagne and traditional Portuguese Christmas cake for us in the room. I would highly recommend this place who wants to enjoy the Lisbon city along with modern comforts.
Fantastic place right in the city centre. Didn't want to leave!
Tudo foi dentro do esperado.
Antonio welcomed us, carried all our bags up to the apartment, gave us a good arrival briefing. The apartment is large and luxurious. Perfect for our needs. We had a great time in Lisbon.

We had a great stay in Pedro's place. The apartment is tastefully decorated with all the amenities you need.
The location is great nearby to shopping, restaurants and walkable to most of the attractions. The communication from the start was great and we really enjoyed our stay. Recommending this place to anyone who wants to visit Lisbon.

Appartement superbe, très bien équipé, très fidèle aux photos et idéalement situé.
Accueil chaleureux et très professionnel.

Pedro's apartments are just right: The location is great at the heart of Chicado-Baixa close to many restaurant, shopping locations and the chic streets of the city. The apartments are newly renovated with good taste, are large, well lighted, spacious and even though centrally located are quiet. The staff is very helpful and responsive. Overall it was a great experience staying at the apartment!

Auf Anfrage erhielten wir eine detaillierte Wegbeschreibung vom Flughafen zur Unterkunft, alternativ mit der Metro oder per Taxi. Wir wurden persönlich empfangen und in alles eingewiesen. Zusätzlich lagen Informationskarten bereit, die Restaurants und Einkaufsmöglichkeiten in der Nähe oder weiteren Umgebung enthielten. Ebenso gab es einen kleinen Stadtplan für Chiado und Baixcha. Zusätzlich fanden wir einen handgeschriebenen Willkommensgruß vom Team und Betthupferl vor. Im Kühlschrank stand eine Flasche Wein, Orangen auf dem Tisch. In einem Kästchen auf der Arbeitsplatte der Küchenzeile gab es zwei Gläschen Marmelade, Nespressokapseln und einen Teebeutel mit Tee aus Portugal. In der Mitte unseres 9tägigen Aufenthalts wurde das Appartement grundgereinigt und die Betten frisch bezogen, die Handtücher ausgewechselt.

Wir haben uns von Anfang an wie zu Hause fühlen können und trennten uns nur schwer - von der Stadt und vom Appartement! Weil die Temperaturen es gut mit uns meinten, konnten wir auch viele Stunden bei einem Wein oder Espresso auf dem Balkon verbringen, der zwar sehr klein ist, aber einen phantastischen Ausblick bis hinunter zum Tejo bietet, so dass man sich nicht daran stört, wenn man eng zusammenrücken muss.

Sollte uns der Weg noch einmal nach Lissabon führen, kämen wir sehr gern in das Appartement zurück!

Das Apartment ist absolut empehelnswert, insbesondere aufgrund der sehr guten Lage. Der Kontakt war sehr freundlich und die Abwicklung professionell. Auf Fragen im Vorfeld gab es schnelle und umfassende Antworten. Die Austattung des Apartments war gut, die Bilder geben es zutreffend wieder. Für historische Bauten dieser Art nicht unüblich, ist es hellhörig, was Nachts als störend empfunden werden könnte.
Great flat and very helpful host! Thank you!

We really enjoyed our stay at this lovely apartment! The place is really nice and well decorated. The bed is very comfortable! The location is perfect, nice neighbourhood in the centre of Lisbon and there's a little market across the street. The organisation with Pedro and Antonio went very smoothly: they are very flexible and were very nice when we arrived. We would definitely recommend this place!

Superbe appartement, idéalement situé, tout le confort avec belle decoration nous nous imaginions un peu comme chez nous.
Je le recommande vivement
We had a great stay at Pedros place. Great location very clean and exactly as pictured. Would definitely  stay here again
Fantastic stay! Top location, very kind host!!

Hosts were very responsive. Appreciate that they let us drop our luggage early.  The flat is in a great location, within easy walking distance to many sites, restaurants, museums.  Very clean. Good choice for a stay in Lisbon.

Pasamos tres días increíbles en el departamento.
Tanto durante las etapas de reserva como durante la estadía y para los momentos de checkin/checkout la comuniación fue excelente, el trato impecable y el servicio muy profesional en todo sentido.

El departamento es tal cual se lo ve en las fotos (incluso es más amplio de lo que se ve, o al menos fue mi sensación cuando llegué). Se encuentra en un edificio antiguo, bien cuidado (no hizo más que sumar al encanto del departamento).

La ubicación es muy buena, cerquita de la estación de Baixa-Chiado del metro, o de Rossio (trenes). Restaurantes, bares y demás por doquier.

No sufrimos el ruido en ningún momento. Con las ventanas abiertas, por supuesto entra un poco de ruido de la ciudad. Pero las cerrás y parece magia, SILENCIO!! El aire acondicionado es pequeño pero refrigera correctamente el apartamento, por lo que dormimos las tres noches con las ventanas cerradas y el aire acondicionado, super agradable.

El sillón es MUY amplio!! Y comodísimo.

Lo mismo el baño y la ducha, super amplios y cómodos.

Lisboa es una ciudad magnífica, y el habernos hospedado en tan lindo departamento hizo que todo sea más genial aún. Gracias por todo chicos!!

The perfect spot to stay!! In a great location, close to all the good spots :)
We really enjoyed staying here.

This is a great apartment in a very convenient location. Antonio was there to meet us at check in and there were no problems at all. Everything is exactly as good as it looks in the photos and the apartment is spacious and lovely. We had a great time.

One of the best Airbnb experiences I have ever had - amazing, modern flat in the heart of Lisbon, within walking distance of all the main attractions and close to bars, restaurants and cafes.  The flat is exactly how it looks in the photos and is very spacious and clean.  Antonio was very helpful and friendly and we had no issues at all during our stay.  Would definitely recommend this place!
숙소에 먼저 도착하였고 제가 도착메일을 Pedro에게 발송하고 얼마 안되어 직접 와서 설명해줬습니다. 숙소 위치가 정말 좋고, 실내도 매우 훌륭합니다. 추천합니다.

Maravillosa estancia en Lisboa en un apartamento inmejorablemente situado, decorado con mucho gusto y un anfitrión excelente que nos dio buenas recomendaciones para los dos días que pasamos. Las fotos reflejan exactamente como es el apartamento.  Repetiremos

The location of this apartment is prime!  It's right in the heart of Lisbon but it has a real neighborhood feel. The park next door has an outdoor bar and seating for several good restaurants. We enjoyed breakfast outdoors each day at Carmo. We also ate dinner there one night and were impressed with the quality and selection. Two blocks away, you know you're in the center of city life. The metro station is a block away. The apartment is perfect for two people. The high-end design and furnishings make the small space feel large and welcoming. The 3rd floor location provides a river view from the small balcony and a relief from the auto and people traffic noises below.  The bed and couch are quite comfortable and the marble bathroom is lovely.  The small, antique elevator is quaint and much appreciated after long days of exploring the city.  We left the city feeling like we had chosen a perfect place for experiencing all that Lisbon had to offer.   I also highly recommend the oceanarium and the trip to Sintra. Both were rewarding and enlightening.

Our stay was absolutely amazing.
The flat is gorgeous, stylish, luxurious and super central located.
I absolutely recommend it and I would love to stay there again on my next trip to Lisbon.

Amazing! The apartment was exactly as described and pictures,  impeccably clean and beautiful. It was in a perfect spot too, close to everything and good restaurants. Everything went smoothly and everybody we met and spoke to was so wonderful and nice. I absolutely would return here when visiting Lisbon again!
The whole experience from start to finish was just immaculate. You could not have asked for a better location, a more friendly and helpful team, or a nicer apartment!!! Honestly 10/10!!!

This is a fantastic apartment in a perfect location to explore all that Lisbon has to offer. We loved the decor, natural light, and amazing view of the river from the balcony. It was very comfortable and very clean. The hosts take particular care to ensure a great experience for their guests. The apartment is in an old building, which itself is quite beautiful, so there are  some older-building quirks. For example, the elevator can be tricky to use the first time (but you can also just use the stairs). Also, the air conditioning wasn't very strong but we also didn't feel that we needed it that much, and we were there in August. Overall we truly had a lovely stay and would highly recommend this apartment.
We had a great time at Pedro's in a great location in Lisbon. Very easy to check in and very organized and everything was provided for us!

très bel appartement, très bien décoré, très bien équipé. L'emplacement est parfait. On se trouve dans le Chiado, quasiment sur le largo do Carmo sans les nuisances sonores grâce au double vitrage.
Les échanges avec Pedro, Antonio ont été parfaits avant et pendant le séjour. Tout a été fait pour que l'on se sente bien.

Chaudement recommandé
La ubicación es muy buena. El apartamento coincide con lo previsto y la recepción muy adecuada.

We have stayed in this flat for a week. It was amazing. The flat is awesome, very well decorated and full of light. The balcony is small but very good to have a breakfast or a coffee at night. A lot of equipments are available (Nespresso, speakers, TV with international channels, Wifi etc...).
The neigborhood is the perfect place to visit Lisbon and surrounding areas (10 min by foot to go to Cais do Sodre or Rossi train stations). Moreover, our host has explained to us where are the good restaurants, the beaches etc...when we arrived.
On top of that, Pedro and its team where always available during the stay, answering our messages in less than an hour. They have booked a taxi for us to go to the airport when we left.

To conclude, amazing experience with this apartment, thank you for everything !

This has to be one of the most gorgeous apartments I have ever stayed in. Clean, comfortable, spacious and with a balcony with a sea view to the right. Some nice treats left (including wine and coffee) and a note from the host really added a personal touch. Was only here for one night and was not enough time to make the most of the apartment. Will be recommending to friends and family who visit Lisbon

The perfect place to stay to explore Lisbon. Beautiful apartment, very clean with great light. Has everything you need. Communication was easy and listing was accurate. Thank you, Pedro, for an amazing experience!

Hôte très accueillant, qui a bien pris la peine de nous présenter l'appartement et de nous faire un point "carte en main" sur les endroit ou boire et manger.
Appartement propre, correspondant aux photos. Il est très agréable d'où il est aisément possible de rallier les quartiers de l'Alfama, Baixa, et Bairro Alto à pieds.

Fomos muito bem recebidos, no horário combinado, com simpatia e muita atenção. O apartamento não poderia ser melhor. Confortável, limpo, tudo funcionando perfeitamente.
Localização excelente, a 200 metros do metrô Baixa-Chiado, entre as lojas da Baixa e os restaurantes e bares do Bairro Alto.
Isolamento acústico perfeito, linda vista para o Tejo.
Foi uma ótima escolha.

From the arrangements in getting to the apartment, being greeted and shown the apartment through to leaving the apartment and arranging a taxi back to the airport the service from Pedro and the team could not be faulted they were excellent.
The apartment was excellent, comfortable, interesting design and features, superb shower and in a fantastic location for exploring Lisbon. There is a lovely historic square 2 minutes away where we had some fantastic times in the sunshine chilling out to quality buskers in the sunshine over a glass or three. The apartment is in easy walking distance of bars, restaurants and public transport. We were that impressed we are looking to return next year. Thankyou to all the team who helped in making our stay a fantastic and memorable one, we hope to see you again soon.

Lovely welcome by Luis who explained the functions of the equipment and appliances in the apartment. Coffee, fruit and wine had been left for us which was a lovely touch. The apartment was stylish, tidy and clean and beautifully central to the old part of Lisbon. Telephone numbers were left in case we required any help or advice but we didn't need to use them as three sheets of abundant local information had been left for us. Overall, a delightful stay.

Amazing apartment to explore Lisbon! Well located, very clean, super comfortable bed, and looks exactly like the photos. This apartment exceeded my every expectation and I would definitely recommend it to other travelers. Many great restaurants and bars nearby, but located on a very quiet side street. Has everything you might need to fix a little meal if you'd like, including orange juicer and oranges for amazing fresh squeezed juice!
Amazing place! We really enjoyed our stay. Perfect location.

Long story short: If you are looking for a comfy place in a high class neighbourhood and you do not want any problems on arrival and departure it is just perfect. Go for it.

The photos give you a good impression of the place. It is what it seems: pretty high class and very comfy. Even though I did not like every piece of the interior they manage to create an atmosphere to enjoy. It is equipped with everything you might need and some little somethings show that the guys understand their job.

On our way to the place we got lost and Antonio picked us up in the streets. He showed us the appartment and gave us a quick and very clear intoduction to make sure we could operate everything. When we left they booked a taxi for us and it was in time. They are professionals.

As good as this is it might be the only thing that you could complain about – if you do airbnb to come to know locals and dive into their way of life. The neighbourhood with its' high class designer stores is quite posh. Nevertheless beautiful. But you have to walk a little bit to find a down to earth supermarket (or maybe we just did not see it). The prices in the organic food store on the other side of the road are just insane. But if you do some research, different than we did for a 2 days stay, this should not surprise you.

Arrivé avec du retard Pedro nous a reçu avec beaucoup de gentillesse.
L' appartement est plus grand que sur les photos,très bien entretenu et la déco magnifique et la vue sur l'océan très agréable.
Idéalement situé près du métro,des commerces et des rues piétonnes,on peut visiter tout Lisbonne sans probléme.

Amazing apartment! Great location only a few minutes walking from the main city center, but still feels very private and secluded in the hip neighborhood of Chiado.

Loved the shower, actually had great water pressure and enough room to move around in.

Wahnsinnswohnung! Genau dafür gibt es Airbrnb.
Die Lage ist perfekt, da man viele Dinge zu Fuss machen kann. Um die Ecke gleich ein schöner Platz zum Entspannen. Das Treffen pünktlich, die Einweisung sehr freundlich mit nützlichen Tipps für die Umgebung.
Die ideale Wohnung, um Lissabon zu erleben. Die Gegend sehr sicher, wobei wir uns in Lissabon sowieso sehr sicher fühlten.
Alles sehr sauber, wohl durchdacht und gut organisiert. Überhaupt kein Risiko. Wir werden es Freunden ans Herz legen.

Lovely clean apartment, exactly how it looks in the pictures. Perfect location, walking distance to most neighborhoods of interest - 5 minute walk to a Number 28 tram stop to take you to the others. Louis welcomed us on our first day and showed us around the apartment. We also had a small issue that the hosts resolved straight away after contacting them. The apartment has great views from the balcony across the Tagus River, especially around sunset - balcony does not have a table but has a small chair and enough space for two people to sit and enjoy a drink! Here's a tip - The apartment is just around the corner from the top level of the famous Santa Justa lift (only realised this on our last day!), save waiting in the queue to go on this from the bottom and enjoy the amazing views from the top! I would definitely recommend this apartment to friends and family, and would not hesitate in staying again.

Great apartment; exactly as advertised. Very clean, quiet and in a great location for exploring Lisbon. Hosts were very helpful and all arrangements were promptly deal with, and thoughtful touches like a bottle of wine and some chocolates. I would highly recommend this apartment. Bev

Très bon accueil; le guidage dans LISBOA est complexe : même mon GPS s'est planté, aussi ne me plaindrais-je pas des indications téléphoniques de notre hôte…
L'appart. est parfait en lui-même et dans sa localisation.

Antonia was a great host! He was very helpful in recommendations of how to get to the apartment from the airport, and was there to show us the overview when we arrived. The apartment was incredible - beautifully decorated and in the most amazing location. We could not have asked for anything better! The kitchen had everything we needed  - coffee machine (with pods!), perfect size refrigerator and dishwasher, plenty of space. The patio provided a great view of the city and even the castle. The apartment was very clean and had all the amenities we needed. I would certainly stay in the apartment if I returned to Lisbon.

Stellar apartment! This was a great place to use as home base to explore Lisbon - easy to walk to most of everything, fun neighborhood, but quiet enough locale to get some sleep with the windows wide open at night. Pedro and his team accommodated letting us drop our bags off early before check-in after an early morning arrival. Apartment was comfortable, great bright light and breeze, neat old elevator.  Thanks for the oranges and treats.

Our host Antonio welcomed us with a warm smile and gave us all the information we needed to begin our stay at the beautiful Chiado studio. He left a nice welcome note and chocolates, fruit, coffee, and a bottle of wine. So nice.The studio was clean and beautifully decorated. The kitchen was modern and suited our needs. From the balcony we could see the ocean and also the St. Jorge Castle. Stunning! The apartment at night was very quiet and I slept better than I can ever remember there. We didn't want to leave.
The neighborhood was centrally located. Everything was within walking distance. The train station was a 10 minute walk. We walked everywhere. There was a really good grocery store right across the street too. Antonio left us a map and other directions that helped us find our way around the terrific Chaido neiborhood.
Super appartement, très bien situé proche de tous les transports et des centres d'intérêts. Très bon accueil, nous avons passé un excellent séjour.
Great apartment exactly as advertised. Great location in a lovely city. Luis look after us and was very helpful.

Tolles Appartment, superzentrale Lage, sehr kompetenter und freundlicher Service. Alles genau wie angegeben, und auf den Fotos zu sehen. Wir waren über Ostern da und haben sogar noch liebevolle kleine Ostergeschenke bekommen. Weil wir erst abends abgeflogen sind, konnten wir unser Gepäck noch den ganzen Tag im Appartment lassen. Wir hatten eine tolle Zeit in Lissabon, waren superzufrieden und würden jederzeit wiederkommen!!!

It all was great, the appartment is really beatifull, really well decorared, well equiped, very comfortable and perfectly located, we are looking forward to coming back  and would definetively recommend It to anyone

Fantástico apartamento de diseño con detalles de muy buen gusto y estilo logrado y por encima de lo estándar en el interior. Muy acogedor, estás como en casa, muy cómodo y con todas las comodidades y pequeños lujos. Está perfectamente equipado. Situado en el centro de Lisboa, al lado de tiendas, transporte urbano, plazas y restaurantes de moda. Me gustó el baño de mármol, muy limpio, te hacía sentir como en un hotel. Un sitio para repetir, sin duda.

It was a very nice apartment in a perfect location, very easy to find. It has a small balcony with a view. Antonio was very responsive to our needs, and very easy to reach through e-mail and phone. There is an old elevator in the building, which made it a genuine experience for us and it worked well.  Wi-fi was very fast. It was clean, beds were made with white sheets and pillows were comfy. Heating worked very well, and it was easily adjustable manually. The coffee machine made a nice touch for breakfast- and free coffee and tea bags were in the apartment for our use, as well as olive oil, balsamic vinegar, salt and pepper- things you need in the kitchen for a short stay but don't come in small packages in the markets. We loved Lisbon and Chiado. The little plaza -Largo do Carmo was also very nice, just outside our apartment. I would definetly book again with Pedro and Antonio.

The location is excellent, in the very center of Lisbon. Lots of sightseeing points are so close, by walking distance. The hosts are so polite, make a nice orientation of the house and left nice surprises around the house. Strongly recommend!
The studio is clean and tidy, at the centre of the city, close to metro and shops.

El anfitrión en todo momento fue muy cordial , el barrio esta situado en todo el centro , y el apartamento es tal como se ve en la foto , algo que destacar , la cama de matrimonio era bastante grande y muy cómoda , ha sido un alojamiento de 10 .

El departamento es maravilloso. Excelente zona, al igual que el anfitrión.
Definitivamente para recomendarlo.

Not only the location was great, and the apartment beautiful (exactly as in the picture), but the team had arranged small things such as wine and chocolate to make us feel even more welcome. Easy check in and check out, would recommend it to anyone coming in Lisbon !

Our stay in the apartment was perfect! The location is perfect, easy walk from the metro and from loads of bars and restaurants. It was also very easy to get down to the waterfront and walk to Alfama and St Georges Castle (which we could see the tip of from our window!). The space itself was perfect for the two of us, with comfortable bed and sofa and amazing shower. Bottle of wine was a lovely touch! We would definitely stay here again.

To do a short review: this place is a bliss!
The apartment is perfectly located, is beautiful and cheap, and the host is lovely.
10/10, would recommend to all.

Nuestra estancia en el apartamento ha sido maravillosa, esos pequeños detalles de bienvenida han hecho que nos sintiésemos como en casa.
Los electrodomésticos y menaje de la casa, así como la descripción del anuncio corresponde fielmente a la realidad.
El barrio muy céntrico pero a la vez tranquilo, ideal para descansar.
Sin duda recomendable al 100 %.
One of the best experiences I have ever had in Airbnb! Clean, well located, comfortable, spacious, well maintained, affordable...I would totally recommend it

Wow is the only word for this flat in Lisbon!!! Simply amazing.. Beautifully decorated, equipped with everything you could need and then some. We fell in love with the couch, and talked the whole time about buying a similar one as soon as we get back to the states!!! Fantastic location, almost too good in fact!!! Breathtaking views from inside and outside the apartment, a very easy walk from the Metro, lots of restaurants and shopping within a very short walk. Lisbon rocked, we absolutely fell in love with it and hope to return sometime soon!!!! Check in was super smooth, in fact, we arrived a few minutes later than planned due to a flight delay, so we ended up missing each other by minutes, but, he came back right away to let us in. The gifts in the flat were a very nice touch, and we loved the guide to Lisbon that was prepared by the host, lot's of good suggestions there!! For a first time visitor to Lisbon, you can't do better than you can here!!!
Great apartment, location and hospitality.

We were nicely welcomed by a member of the team who shown us the apartment. Clean, modern and with all the basic kitchen equipment. The description matched perfectly with what was 'promised' to us and we were very surprised how pleasant it was.
A perfect place to spend quality time with your half.

We loved the details from the natural soap to the 'help yourself' expresso coffee. We had two bottles of wine, courtesy from the house and on Christmas eve we got a 'bolo rei' (a christmas traditional portuguese cake) and a bottle of champagne.

My husband loved the area, Largo do Carmo - quiet and just off the main track but close enough to restaurants, transports and grocery shops - and Chiado, where everything happens. As for me, being from Lisbon, I was very proud of our so famous natural skill of being a good host and delight with the wonderful city we have - looking outside from the living room you can see the castle Sao Jorge.

We won't hesitate staying there again, as we had a very pleasant time.

'Obrigada' team.

Ana & Stu
Great apartment, great location, great city ! We will come back for sure !

The crew of Chiado Studios was always ready and fast to answer my questions from booking to arriving. When we arrived, they welcomed us very friendly and informed every details about the flat and also left a paper with lots of recommendation about Lisbon. The flat was NOT the typical Airbnb home decorated with IKEA furnitures. The decoration was unique, well considered and artsy. It was the perfect combination of an old century apartment with a modern touch. Beside of this cool decoration, the flat was perfectly clean and well equiped. We had everything we could need. Overall, this experience just set my expectations higher for the next airbnb's. Thanks to Chiado Studios family for such a professional service!

Nos hemos encontrado como en casa, el apartamento es cómodo y acogedor, no hemos echado nada de menos.
Se encuentra en una ubicación perfecta para pasear y conocer Lisboa. Volveremos.

We loved our experience with Pedro. The apt. was exactly as shown, clean, centrally located and our host was very help and courteous. We felt welcomed and very comfortable. They left us a bottle of wine, fruit and chocolate as a welcome gift. We definitely recommend staying here and we would definitely visit again.

We had a wonderful stay in Lisbon.  The listing was was better than expected and in a great location.  Pedro and Antonio were fantastic hosts and made our time on Lisbon very comfortable.  They took care of all of the little details that make travel difficult.
Very nice, clean and central flat with lots of good restaurants within walking distance!

La casa acogedora y muy céntrica. Tenia todo lo que necesitas para unos días en Lisboa. Gran acierto la elección de nuestras vacaciones, repetiría sin duda. El último día pedimos a Pedro si nos podía guardar las maletas y audio sin problema.

The studio is perfectly located in a nice quiet street up in central Lisbon and the host gave us an excellent description of how to best get there from the airport and was waiting for us upon arrival. Everything was in great shape and the place is beautifully done. Very nice little extra touches included a little hand written note and the well stocked kitchen including coffee and basics. I could not think of a better place to stay at in Lisbon and hope to come back soon!
Apartment was great. Location was fabulous!

Everything at Pedro's was AMAZING. The extra details, the location the whole apartment was fantastic. We had such a great time and couldn't fault the place at all. I would recommend staying here for sure!! The perfect place for 2 people to have a lovely holiday away.

Great apartment with good facilities and very conveniently situated for restaurants, bars and sightseeing.

A metro station is also nearby.

I would recommend staying here and I look forward to doing so again.
Great place. Very well located!

Apartment is well presented and equipped. It is in a very central but quiet location. We stayed 5 nights. We were met at the apartment as arranged by Antonio ( I think that was his name) We asked for some information on a particular issue and told by Antonio that Pedro would contact us by email. We heard nothing further from Pedro or his team which was disappointing.

Perfektes Studio im Herzen von Lissabon. Das Appartment ist sehr stylisch und geschmackvoll eingerichtet, wie auf den Fotos. Die Lage ist grandios: nur einige Fußminuten zur Metrostation Baixa/Chiado, alle Attraktionen und Viertel sind fussläufig zu erreichen. Viele nette Cafes und Restaurants (z.B. “Carmo” am Largo do Carmo) gleich um die Ecke. +Biosupermarkt 1min entfernt
+Kleiner Balkon mit Tejo-Blick, um die Vormittagssonne zu geniessen
+Nostalgischer Aufzug erpart viele Stufen in den 3. Stock
+Föhn, Kaffeeautomat + ein paar Kapseln Kaffee, eine Flasche Wein, Handtücher
+eine große Couch und ein sehr bequemes Bett
+Internetverbindung funktioniert tadellos

Great experience at the Chiado apartment! Everything was perfectly organized and ready for us at our arrival. Here is why I think the service provided was superior in quality:
1. The apartment was ready and tidy at our arrival.
2. The host, Pedro, was punctual and always on-time.
3. Pedro provided us with perfect guidelines on how to "consume" our stay at the apartment.
4. Pedro gave us extra information on how to pass a good time in Lisbon.

I was totally blown away by how amazing this place was! The location could not have been better. Steps from shopping, great restaurants and easily walkable to all the key sites. Very easy to get to from the airport, just a 5 minute walk from the train/subway.

The apartment itself was beautiful. Very modern and clean. It exceeded my expectations.

We were left a fantastic list of nearby restaurants and everything we tried was wonderful.

I highly recommend staying here. I'd definitely book again the next time I'm in Lisbon!

From start to finish I was greeted warmly efficiently and with most helpful directions the apartment was exactly as I saw in the pictures it was beautiful space I would highly recommend the location it is fantastic for anybody that's interested in the history of Portugal!

The host met us just when he said he would and showed us all of the essentials of the lovely studio apt. There was even a washer where we could do laundry, fresh oranges for juice, and a bottle of wine. :) Much appreciated!

This place was perfect.  Amazing location, great host and the apartment is fantastic. There  really isn't a reason to stay anywhere else.  I am pretty picky when it comes to places to stay and this was really just the best.
Absolutely superb and Antonio/Pedro great hosts. Wonderful location, modern apartment and lovely extra touches. Would highly recommend.
Great stylish apt in the best part of the city, would love to spend a few days there again
Beautiful apartment and very well located. We loved our stay!

Apartment was great - had everything we wanted for our one week stay in Lisbon.  Location was also fantastic - walkable to everything but in a quiet enough area that we were still able to get to bed without street noise waking us up.  Antonio was there waiting for us when we got there, even though we were a little bit late arriving because of a delayed flight.
Tres belle experience! Romantic!
We had a wonderful time in Lisbonne! The appartment was idealy located, great services & such a beautiful place. Thanks a lot Pedro for making our journey the best AirBnb experiance ever!
The host is nice, the studio is excellent. And the location is prefect! It must be a best choice in Lisbon . Highly recommended about CHIADO STUDIO !!!

This is a great apartment with modern appliances and bathroom.  The location is superb - convenient to the major areas of Lisbon as well as to public transportation.  Communication was good - we received detailed and clear directions how to find the apartment.  Luis was waiting for us, and showed us how to use each key and how to operate the various appliances.  He even supplied us with a complementary bottle of wine.  Overall, a very positive experience.

Absolutely the perfect spot in Lisbon. Stylish, pampering, ideal location, sunny with professional hosts that provide you all you need.  Every small detail is thought of, and you feel you can enjoy without worrying that you'll miss something. Stayed there and  in Lisbon only for 1 night and defiantly come back for more next time, and recommend this place to others.

We were welcomed by Antonio who went out of his way to help us with parking our car. He warned us about the expensive parking across the street from the apartment. I wished that we had listened as it was outrageously expensive. (44 euros/day).He then showed us everything in the apartment and recommended a great place for lunch. The apartment is beautifully designed and spacious enough for three people for a short visit and perfect for two people for a longer stay. The neighborhood is safe and next to a square where you can sit, listen to music and have a drink. It is a short walk to the water and there is great shopping in the area.  Booking the apartment was very easy and Pedro responded immediately to our request. We cannot wait to return to the beautiful city of Lisbon. It reminded us of San Francisco. Thank you for a wonderful stay!
Esta foi a segunda estada num período de 1 semana. Repito tudo o que disse no comentário anterior. Excelente!

Fomos recebidos por Luís e por Antonio, ambos muito gentis e solícitos. O studio está muito bem localizado, no coração do Chiado. A decoração é de muito bom gosto, o espaço é amplo e tudo é muito confortável. Limpeza e organização impecáveis. Estive com meu pai e minha mãe, ambos com mais de 65 anos, e tudo correu excelentemente bem.

We loved our stay at Chiada Studio 4. It is exactly as described and pictured and communication was always prompt, pleasant and helpful. Antonio and Luis were there to meet us on arrival , told us all we needed to know for our stay and also offered to book our taxi to the airport for our return . The apartment isn't the easiest to find at first but with their instructions for us to give to the taxi driver we were successful. The taxi to the apartment cost 16 Euos and the return to the airport was 11 Euros. Definitely worth it in our opinion.Once there we found it to be in a wonderful location that was so easy to walk to almost anywhere ,so long as you are good with some hills and stairs. Lisbon is a lovely city and there is lots to see and do. Just be very aware that pickpockets are abundant there and unfortuately we found this out the hard way, even though we thought we were being vigilant. So just beware of ANYONE close to you!  The apartment was very clean, modern and comfortable with wonderful air conditioning! We didn't use the laundry but it also was very handy. We would definitely recommend Pedro's place!

This apartment is an oasis among the hippest streets of Lisbon. The location is perfect, walking distance to attractions and all the restaurants we wanted to eat at, yet vv quiet at night. We loved the little touches the team left behind, like the chocolates and oranges. I own a Nespresso machine that i use every morning, so this felt like a home away from home. The view of the ocean from the balcony was awesome and a great place to people watch and admire the facades of the buildings! Highly recommend!!

Wonderful apartment! Our Chiado studio was just as described. Pedro was very helpful and responsive with all communications. Antonio welcomed us upon arrival and oriented us to the apartment and neighborhood. Chiado is a beautiful and vibrant neighborhood, the most fashionable in Lisbon, full of old world charm. Restaurants, shops, bars, cafes all nearby. Highly recommended!
El apartamento tal cual en el anuncio. El barrio muy céntrico y tranquilo por las noches.

Bonjour,

L'appartement est très agréable et conforme à la description. Les hôtes ont été gentils, attentionnés et réactifs. Le mobilier est de qualité, et le logement est joliment décoré. De plus l'appartement est très bien situé ce qui permet de visiter Lisbonne et de sortir le soir avec beaucoup de facilité tout en bénéficiant du calme (calme tout de même relatif, nous sommes quand même en centre ville!) puisque l'appartement se situe au 3ème étage. Le logement était très propre et la salle de bain plutôt grande.

Seule ombre au tableau: la présence d'un échafaudage sur la façade de l'immeuble qui nous a empêché de profiter de la superbe vue et du petit balcon. Même si nos hôtes avaient l'air désolé de la situation en nous affirmant que l'échafaudage aurait dû être retiré avant notre arrivée, nous aurions aimé être prévenus à l'avance.

Pour conclure, hormis ce petit détails d’échafaudage qui semblait être dû au hasard, nous avons passé un très agréable séjour et nous recommandons sans hésiter cet appartement. Le rapport qualité prix est très correct!

Merci et à bientôt!

Pierre et Marion

A great apartment in a great location. Close to the Metro and a very short walk to the Rossio or to the Bairro Alto, the location can't be beat. There is even a grocery store on the corner. The apartment itself is elegant and very comfortable. We had a truly wonderful time there.

Having been to Lisbon before I knew I wanted to stay in Chiado this time around. The location of the apartment was perfect as it was right next to Carmo square with easy access to a supermarket (right across the street), shopping (100 meters away), sights such as Carmo Museum and Santa Justa lift where all under our noses and tons of restaurants and cafes. Typically, I avoid renting from companies as I find that you lose some of the personal touch that you get from individual owners. I went against my own bias and rented this apartment based on excellent reviews and I am glad that I did. My communication with Pedro leading up to the trip was friendly, helpful and prompt. Antonio gave us a detailed tour of the apartment when we checked in and was there to meet us for an earlier than planned check in. Finally the apartment had lots of nice small touches like a pair of welcome chocolates, plenty of coffee and lots of oranges and a juicer!

il nous a reçu avec tout ça gentillesse un hôte génial très paient car nous sommes arriver très en retard a couse es gréves
Obrigado Pedro pour tudo
Fabulous apartment, location and Pedro couldn't have been more helpful or charming / greatly looking forward to a return visit!'

We were met upon arrival by an associate of Pedro. The neighborhood was great with a square around the corner, shopping 2 blocks away. The 2 apartments we booked were nicely furnished and comfortable with large bathrooms. We had problems with the elevator on our first 2 days because someone did not close the elevator's inner iron door so it got stuck on the 3rd floor. But once that tenant left on 3rd day, we did not have problems with the elevator again.

Провели чудесное время в апартаментах . С нами общался Антонио. Очень пунктуально и гостеприимно встретил нас . Все объяснил и показал . В течение всего пребывания был на связи. Очень ему благодарны.
Апартаменты очень комфортные , с отличным дизайном. Удобная кровать . Есть все необходимое . А расположение- лучше не придумать. Достаточно тихое место . И рядом со всеми основными достопримечательностями. Очень надеемся еще раз остановиться в этих замечательных апартаментах ! Настоятельно рекомендуем всем эти апартаменты , не пожалеете .

Thank you Pedro & Team! This was our second stay in the Chiado Studios and it was just as great as we remembered. The studio is a relaxing retreat after a day of exploring Lisbon. Clean, beautifully designed, and with great views of Lisbon no matter which window you chose. The The neighborhood is full of shops of all kinds, plenty of good dining options, and there's a Metro stop 3 blocks away meaning Lisbon is at your doorstep. Highly recommended, unless you're want the week we want!

Tudo muito bom: os anfitriões, o apartamento e a região.

Everything is perfect: the apartment, the hosts and the neighborhood.

Magnifique logement dans un des plus beaux quartiers de Lisbonne. Appartement tres bien équipé avec machine a expresso, lave vaisselle, Tv, presse agrumes électrique... Une propreté irréprochable. Accueil chaleureux à 1h du matin, notre vol ne nous permettant pas d arriver plus tôt. Une réactivité exemplaire avec pour chaque mail envoyé, une réponse dans la demi-journée. Nous recommandons donc vivement ce logement à toute personne souhaitant visiter Lisbonne.

Wohnung entsprach genau der Beschreibung. Sehr gute Ausstattung. Es war alles vorhanden und in gepflegtem Zustand.
Die Lage ist top, direkt im Zentrum, Nähe Aufzug. Kontakt zu Pedro und Antonio sehr gut, Schlüsselübergabe reibungslos. Das Team war sehr hilfsbereit und hat wertvolle Tipps für unseren Besuch in Lissabon gegeben. Nur zu empfehlen, wir würden jeder Zeit wiederkommen und können das Apartment nur empfehlen.

This was a great studio with all that's needed and a great ocean view.  Great location. There is an awesome elevator in the building. Antonio was waiting for us in the unit and explained everything. Will gladly stay here again!

Highly recommended!
Excellent host and ideal location - the place was as nice as it looked and it was ideally located to enjoy the sites and the surrounding neighbourhoods.
Was good to get advice on how to get around and where to eat etc and we had a great trip all round.
Would recommend this place to anyone heading to Lisbon.

Excellent room ! Very spacious and extremely well furnished and equipped. With stove, pans, pots, juicer, coffee maker, fridge , dish washer. Very nice of owner to give oranges. The only thing that was a little inconvenient was the lift that was a bit old so it's quite scary at night. Very cosy apartment ! Will definitely recommend it.

The apartment looked exactly like the photos! It is in a lovely old building in the heart of the city, right next to a square. Walk out the door and there is great shopping, amazing restaurants, charming squares, and close access to the train station.

We were greeted by Antonio and given a tour of the apartment and instructions on how to use the various appliances. They were very thoughtful and included soap powder for the dishwasher and laundry detergent and a drying rack for washing clothes.

Loved the bed; it was VERY comfortable and large. My daughter slept on the sofa and she commented on how comfortable it was.

I've recommended this apartment (actually any managed by Pedro) to my friends. Much better than a hotel and cheaper! I can't say enough about how wonderful it was.

The apartment was all i expected and MORE! Reasonable price. I really loved staying in this apartment - clean, beautifully decorated and stylish! My type of apartment. I would LOVE to live here! Pedro responded to inquiries very quick and I met with Antonio who gave me the keys and brief intro to the apt. Location is superb! When back in Lisbon, I hope to stay here again.

A beautiful apartment in the best part of Lisbon. Very  close to Bairro Alto (far enough to dodge disturbance) and Piazza Rossio. Elegant and clean, both Pedro and Antonio have been very kind an suggestive, as well as answering to our email requests. Without a doubt, I would suggest this place to anyone.

Ne pas hésiter à réserver ce appartement qui n'a que des avantages! Excellent rapport qualité/situation/prix! Nous avons pu prendre possession de l'appartement pour déposer nos bagages à midi, avant l'heure prévue donc ce qui fut fort confortable. Nous avons été accueilli à l'heure prévue (attention ne pas se tromper de sonnette!), notre hôte était tout à fait disponible et ouvert à nos questions, avant notre départ et même par téléphone durant notre séjour en cas de besoin.  L'appartement était impeccable, propre, confortable très bon lit, même si pas très grand) et la décoration parfaitement pensée, exactement comme sur les photos, sans vis à vis (avec vue sur le château au dessus des toits)  et tout à fait calme la nuit (excepté en journée durant notre séjour vu travaux de rénovations de l'étage du dessous à partir de 8h30).  Impeccablement situé, central, entre les quartiers Baixa (rue commerçante) et Barrio Alto (bars). A  2 rues de la station de metro Baixa Chiado (facile de l'aéroport). Impeccable. Jusqu'au capsules de Nespresso fournies. Merci.

Perfect ! Great location, lovely studio, warm hosting.

Couldn't have asked for more and would recommend Lisbon and Chiado studio IV every single time.
Logement très bien situé, décoré avec beaucoup de goût, calme. Un excellent choix pour une visite à Lisbonne!

The best airbnb experience. Pedro was expecting us and very kindly explained all the important details about the apartment, which is beautiful.
Very clean, cozy and nicely arranged, just like the pictures.
Outside it was cold, and the heat was perfect, the bathroom was very comfortable and the best thing: the location. It's easy to get lost in Lisbon but we always ended up near the apartment.
The apartment was fantastic - clean and beautiful. The location could not have been better. We strongly recommend this apartment to anyone planning a trip to Lisbon

I have nothing but wonderful things to say about my hosts - They left chocolates and a note to welcome me, showed me around the place, had notes about restaurants and services in the area, and the apartment itself was great.  Clean, quiet, great location, and all amenities.  The lights in the entryway to the building seldom worked, so I'd caution people going in or out of the building to watch their footing.

Pedro's friend Antonio was our contact - he was warm, spoke impeccable English and very organised. The apartment was filled with coffee, chocolates and oranges on arrival. It was very clean, reasonably spacious and had one of the best locations in all of Lisbon. I can wholeheartedly recommend this experience.
very good service

One of the easiest and most professional airbnb experiences I have had! From start to finish communication with Pedro (and Antonio) has been flawless, precise and timely.

The flat itself is extremely well situated, clean, spacious, well decorated and fully equiped and prepared to receive guests. We arrived late at night and were met in the flat by Antonio who introduced us to the space as well as the local amenities in a very clear, succinct and friendly way.

Our Lisbon experience was great and staying at the Chiado Studio IV definitely contributed to that. Highly recommended!

Studio très très bien situé et très agréable.
idéal pour découvrir Lisbonne!

Nous sommes ravis de notre séjour. L'appartement était tel que sur les photos super bien décoré. Il est en plus situé dans un des meilleurs quartiers de Lisbonne et tout est autour. Nous le recommandons vivement pour un séjour à Lisbonne

Estuvimos en Lisboa de 15 al 19 de noviembre en Chiado IV, este apartamento está tal como aparece en las fotos. Es un apartamento muy bien decorado, es luminoso y se encuentra en perfectas condiciones, incluso se puede ver el Castillo de San Jorge desde la ventana del salón. Se encuentra ubicado en uno de los mejores barrios de la ciudad junto al elevador de Santa Justa desde el que se accede a la Plaza (preciosa) donde está la vivienda. Se puede ir caminado al Chiado, Barrio Alto y la zona céntrica y comercial. Nos recibió Antonio, que es una persona encantadora y muy atenta. Sin duda, es un sitio para volver, lo recomendamos. Gracias, hasta pronto.

We hadden een aangenaam verblijf in de mooi ingerichte studio, alles wat nodig was , was aanwezig. De studio is centraal gelegen om heel Lissabon te verkennen. De studio is gelegen in een aangename buurt.

Perfectly situated, gorgeously designed and renovated apartment in a very old building. The view was beautiful and our hosts could not have been any more helpful and nice! We had the best time.
Any time there was the slightest hint of a problem Pedro and Antonio were there to solve it immediately.
The apartment is in the center of Chiado and close to all the sights (walking distance). Only for Belem you may wanna take a train or bus.
The list of recommended restaurants in the area was also great.
Probably my best air bnb experience so far!

C'est "the place to be " pour visiter Lisbonne. En plein coeur de Chiado, l'appartement est très calme et très comfortable. Bravo à Pedro pour son talent de Décorateur et à Antonio pour sa gentillesse et son efficacité. On n'a qu'un seul regret, c'est de partir...

Our host - Antonio - made us feel really welcome and I had also spoken before arrival to Pedro to ask a couple of questions about the apartment. Descriptions of the amenities were accurate and the neigbourhood was great!

the apartment was compact and very well equipped- comfy bed, quiet day and night and great shower. It was very convenient to most of Lisbon's sights, the shops and many restaurants, bars and cafes. We spent four very comfortable days there, even though it rained ++ Padro was great he met us at the pre arranged time and organised a taxi to take us the the railway station, thanks Pedro

Communication towards our stay was very good. Pedro gave us a perfect description on how to go to the appartment. It was quite easy to find from the Metrostation. The appartment is in one of the most lively areas in Lisbon, however once you are inside the appartment it is quiet and nice. The appartment looks just like the pictures and it nice and comfy. It is close to the main sightseeing areas and offers all the luxury one can ask for. Communcation during our stay with Pedro was also pleasant. He was very quick to respond. To round it off; a great value for money in a wonderfull area in a nice a cozy appartment.

Highly recommend staying here. Location is Ideal, very close to metro station and tram stops. Apartment is exactly as pictured and described. The flat is spotlessly clean. At night I would open the doors to the balcony and music would float in from the street below creating such a beautiful atmosphere.
The listing was as described. It is clean and very well located.

My host met us even though our flight was delayed and we arrived late and explained everything very well about the lovely flat as well as the area.  I nor my friend could fault the place in any way and I wold happily recommend the place to my friends.  Well done Pedro and Antonio!   Judy

Das Appartment war sehr sauber, extrem schön und stilvoll eingerichtet und super gut gelegen in einem tollen Ausgehviertel in Lissabon. Die Vermieter Pedro und Antonio waren super freundlich und flexibel was die An- und Abreisezeiten betrifft. Wir haben uns super wohl gefühlt. Ich kann das Appartment nur jedem wärmstens empfehlen. Vielen Dank für alles Antonio und Pedro!

Apartment was great, it is in a perfect location easily accessible to all of the old Lisbon neighborhoods.  Pedro and Antonio were accessible when we need we needed to communicate with them.  Would recommend to anyone traveling to Lisbon.
Ganz toller Empfang, perfekter Service, toll ausgestattete, saubere Wohnung in Superlage.

The studio is just awesome, the apartment has everything you need to stay, made ​​very stylish, comfortable and beautiful. Location is great at it in a couple of minutes walk from the main street. Within walking distance are shops, cafes, restaurants and bars.

We stay 6 days in Lisboa. The flat was very Nice, big enough, very clean and had a kitchenette which was very usefull. At night, the neighbourhood is calm so we had no problems to sleep! There is a lovely place with cafés and some people singing sometimes. Very pleasant. The view on the Tage is very nice!
Pedro was very welcoming as Antonio!
We will definitely come back!

The apartment is amazing! Perfect location and beautifully decorated. After a 5 week adventure throughout Europe in both hotels and Airbnb apartments this apartment was by far the best.
The location is central with shops and restaurants very close. While being very central the apartment was quiet.
The attention to detail was surberb with complimentary coffee capsules, chocolates and oranges (for juicing) all made for a fantastic stay.
Would recommend the apartment to anyone looking for accommodation in Lisbon.
Great apartment in a great location.  We'd go back in a heartbeat ...

The perfect spot to explore Lisbon from. The apartment is super central and the neighbourhood is full of quaint squares (complete with live jazz players) and lovely local restaurants. A brief walk and you're in Barrio Alto, with amazing nightlife, and the main squares for everything from designer shopping to restaurants. The apartment is located right in the heart but it's extremely quiet and very secure.  We were made to feel really welcome, Antonio, Pedro and the team are incredibly organised and everything went like clockwork, our only issue was having to leave. The apartment was very comfortable, cool (thank you air con!) and had a relaxed style that made it feel like home from home. We fitted 4 adults very comfortably but it would also be lovely for a couple or family. Places to note (very) locally; there's a beautiful local deli right next door who's charming owner was happy for us to try everything and anything, and there's a lovely gift shop on the corner of the block which sells lovely clothes and ceramics from local producers in Lisbon - not a hint of tat in sight. I can't recommend this apartment enough and will definitely be coming back.

This is a gorgeous apartment in a great location. The flat is very spacious for a studio and really beautifully designed. My boyfriend and I were very comfortable staying here for 3 days and found that we had everything we needed. Check in was easy and all communication was very clear and straightforward. Pedro was an excellent host and we would definitely recommend this spot for anyone looking for a place to stay in Lisbon.

This apartment is in an excellent location on a historic square and within walking distance to a host of interesting sites.  It is secure, spacious and comfortable, well equipped, and close to wide variety of shops/restaurants/transport.   All communication with Pedro was straight forward, prompt and easy.  Nothing was a trouble.  All in all, a great choice of accommodation.

We stayed there 4 days, and could seriously not have a better accommodation! The location was amazing, walking distance to almost everything.
