We had an incredible time in Lisbon, couldn't ask for more! The apartment was REALLY NICE (looked even better then the pictures), everything was nice and clean with beautiful interior. You had everything you needed there, all kitchen equipment and even a dishwasher. Pedro helped us get settled when we arrived (big plus that he was flexible since our flight was early) gave us all information we needed, we even got great recommendations regarding good beaches, restaurants, nightlife etc.  Pedro really gave us an outstanding service, and he was reachable 24/7 if we had questions or whatever. To summarize, everything was amazing we couldn't ask for more and thank you Pedro for everything!!! We really recommend this place to everyone who want to have a great place to live in Lisbon! Best regards, I

We loved this apartment in Lisbon. The decor and furniture was to a very high standard and was much nicer than many 4 star hotels we have stayed in. The apartment is large with high ceilings very bright with great aircon. The facilities were excellent we had everything we needed for the stay. The list of restaurants that was left for us was spot on and very helpful.  The location was great near to the shops and bars near by but not at all noisy at night time. It was a pleasure to come back to this apartment after days and nights out in city. Couldn't fault it. Perfect stay!

Lovely oasis in Lisboa! Pedro was a wonderful host- check in was a breeze, and he thoroughly explained all the little quirks of the place - the keys, the power, the appliances. Oranges to make fresh juice and coffee pods were a really nice touch. Also appreciated the list of recommended restaurants and the many maps and guidebooks.
The decor is the highlight of this place. We were traveling with a group and everyone who visited agreed our place was the nicest.
The location is excellent, and handy to have a grocery store across the street. Right around the corner from the action, but on a very nice quiet side street.
The one tiny flaw was the faucet in the bathroom was so hard to turn! Probably will be fixed quickly given the obviously high standards of the place.
Pedro was also very accommodating with a VERY last minute emergency extension of the reservation, so thanks also for that. Hope to see you again :)

Wonderful apartment in a prime location for site seeing. Close to shopping and food. The apartment is spacious and has all of the amenities you could want! Pedro and Antonio were both extremely helpful and responsive.

We spent a week in this beautiful apartment, very stylishly furnished and immaculate.Also very central for everything, although we did have a problem actually finding the apartment on the first day,  and problem with mobile phone, making us very late for our check in with Antonio. Thankfully he was still there waiting for us and was extremely helpful. Thanks Antonio.. Would definitely recommend this apartment to anyone.  Great. !!

Estuvimos en Chiado IV desde el 28 de mayo hasta 16 junio . El apartamento es tal cual se muestra en las fotos y la reseña: luminoso, decorado con buen gusto, limpio. Pedro y su equipo son atentos, simpáticos. El recibimiento, lleno de pequeños detalles: bombones, mermelada, naranjas, café. El barrio, precioso. Desde allí se puede caminar a casi todos los atractivos turísticos. Buses, metro y tranvías a 5 minutos. Nuestra estadía fue maravillosa!! Ademas contamos con el servicio de limpieza semanal, realizado por muy buenas profesionales, simpáticas y atentas a todos los detalles. No duden en elegir los hogares de Pedro para vivir en Lisboa.Muchas gracias!!!
Our stay in Chiado IV during 20 days was perfect! Everything was like in pictures. Pedro and his team, are very nice and helpful. The apartment is sunny, with very good taste and in a very nice neighborhood, near to everywhere, walking or by metro, bus, train.
Pedro makes you feel at home and welcome with oranges, wine, sweets!! Antonio and the maintenance team make a great job making feel at home!! Don't doubt to choose Pedro's homes to live In Lisboa!!

Il nostro soggiorno a Lisbona è stato fantastico! L'appartamento di Pedro rispecchia esattamente la descrizione, curato nei minimi particolari, pulito e accessoriato di tutto, persino la macchina per il caffè (con anche qualche cialda, zucchero, the ecc.). Il divano letto è comodissimo per due persone. Al nostro arrivo siamo stati accolti da Antonio, un amico di Pedro che ci ha spiegato ogni cosa che riguardava la casa con estrema cortesia e gentilezza. Che dire...tutto veramente positivo! Consiglio vivamente questo appartamento che tra l'altro si trova in una posizione veramente eccezionale, nel cuore di Lisbona. Grazie a Pedro e ad Antonio!
Nadia

Da gibt es nicht viel zu sagen. Alles war genau so wie versprochen.
Beste Lage, geschmackvolle Einrichtung, freundliche und unkomplizierte Übergabe.
Wir würden jederzeit wiederkommen.

Fantastic apartment, just like the photos, fantastic location close to largo do carmo square, which has the church ruins, great atmosphere, nice restaurants and close to the Santa justa lift with great views of the city! I couldn't recommend staying here highly enough :)

We felt very cosy and everything was well prepared. Antonio was very kind and helpful. Thannx again. In this appartement in Chiado you life realy comfortable. Il y a meme un ascenseur! See you next time!

Our stay at Pedro's was great. nice and close to every thing loved Lisbon .
We arrived early before check in time Pedro's organised for us to be able to leave our luggage in the apartment. Would stay here again
uma excelente opção em Lisboa ! Excelente localização e apartamento, perfeito ! Super bem decorado, muito limpo e excelente recepção dada pelo Antônio. Recomendo fortemente !

Pedro is the kind of host you'd like to experience every time you travel: helpful, precise and careful. His studio is simply perfect. Located in the very center of Lisbon, but still quiet and relaxing. The charming interior design and the old style building make this accommodation simply the best to live the real Lisbon.

We had a wonderful time in Lisbon, also thanks to this spacious, well equiped and very clean appartment within walking distance to everything you would want to do in Lisbon. We would always come back here. Thankyou Pedro!

Amazing stay in Lisbon...Pedro was really great and informative on our arrival. I'd recommend anyone to stay here. The apartment was incredibly clean and would love to come back here one day...
Thanks again Pedro!

Het was onze 1ste ervaring met airbnb maar we doen het zeker nog.
Pedro was een heel goede gastheer hij heeft ons goed ontvangen en tips gegeven om de omgeving te verkennen.
De flat was heel tof ingericht en heel netjes en charmant. Er lagen zelfs appelsienen en enkele confituurtjes alsook een expressomachine voor de koffie. Kortom GEWELDIG we hebben ervan genoten, we komen graag nog eens terug.

This Chiado studio was a perfect touch pad for exploring Lisbon, walkable to so many points of interest and close to public transportation.  The studio itself was clean, charming and well equipped.  Would definitely stay here again.

Wir hatten eine wunderschöne Woche in diesem.,wirklich sehr zentral gelegenen und geschmackvoll eingerichtetem ,Appartement. Antonio hat uns freundlich empfangen und alles  gut erklärt. Direkt gegenüber gibt es einen großen,gut sortierten Biomarkt.Auf der anderen Seite des Platzes liegt etwas versteckt in einer kleinen Seitenstraße ein kleiner Lebensmittelladen. Auch sonst ist alles sehr gut erreichbar. Wir werden auf jeden Fall wieder einmal in diese fantastische Stadt reisen und den Urlaub in Pedros Appartement verbringen.

Wonderful experience!
Everything was perfect.
I would love to come back asap and I will recommend it anytime.

Thanks a lot.

natalia
Great apt in a great neighborhood. Ideal base for discovering lovely Lisbon.

Il soggiorno a Lisboa è stato bellissimo.
Alla nostra accoglienza c'era Antonio, un amico di Pedro, che ci ha mostrato l'appartamento e illustrato il funzionamento della cucina.
Le foto rispecchiano totalmente la realtà e l'appartamento è molto carino, moderno e curato sotto ogni punto di vista (per esempio non mi aspettavo che ci fossero asciugamani in bagno).
Inoltre è nel cuore della città a due passi dalla metro Baixa-Chiado.
Questo appartamento ha reso la nostra vacanza indimenticabile.
Obrigada.

A great city, a well-located apt in the dynamic neighborhood of Chiado with a tasteful decoration equals a peaceful place to stay, that feels just like home!
This is certainly one of the best place you could ever stay in Lisbon : it is quite close to great restaurants, bars and also the undergroud which made our stay so easier and pleasurable...

Nous avons adoré notre séjour dans ce super appartement !
Il est très bien situé, en plein centre ville.
L'appartement était très propre et très confortable !
Je vous le recommande !

Beautiful apartment with a great view, immaculate design, all of the amenities you could ever ask for and to make it all even that much better, it's a short walk from the water, restaurants, historical monuments, museums and more. Highly recommended!

J'ai fais un we à Lisbonne avec des amis et Airbnb était le meilleur compromis pour profiter de la ville. L'appartement est très bien situé. L'ambiance y est cosy et chaleureuse. Parfait pour chiller après de bonnes journées à visiter les environs. Nous avions vu sur la mer depuis le balcon. Il ne manquait rien. Le couchage est confortable. A notre disposition, nous avions des guides touristiques en français. Si nous repartons à Lisbonne nous reprendrons contact avec Pedro qui est un très bon hôte. Merci à lui pour notre super séjour.

There is nothing much to add if you have already read the great reviews of this place. The apartment is very well decorated and comfortable. You fell the luxury of a hotel and the warmness of a central located home. The team is really professional and I really enjoyed my stay here for couple of days of the amazing city of Lisbon. Thanks!!

We had such a great time in this absolutely beautiful, peaceful and romantic place! It's location is perfect (very central) and the area is lively with all utilities close-by, but not noisy which we appreciated a lot. Pedro welcomed us very kindly and explained us all we needed to know and we spent 5 five wonderful days visiting and appreciating every minute in that beautiful city.
Parlez de votre séjour aux autres membres de la communauté Airbnb.

Everything about the place, whether Pedro’s team, the studio itself or its location exceeded our expectations.

The studio was easy to reach and find. It is close to all must see places, ideally located in fashionable Chiado and its designer shops, halfway between Baixa’s main shopping street and Barro Alto with its great night live.

Pedro and his team were the perfect hosts, running the place to a professional level. Communication was friendly and to the point.

The apartment had everything needed to feel comfortable (toaster, kettle & a proper teapot, nespresso machine, juicer, etc.). It was quiet, clean and stunning in terms on design. Congrats to the creative team.

When back in Lisbon I would be delighted to stay at Pedro’s again and would it recommend without hesitation.

PS. Thank you for the fresh oranges - a lovely treat greatly appreciated in the morning.

I had a wonderful stay at Pedro's apartment at Chiado. It is in the most convenient area in Lisbon. You can get to subways, Tram 28, and most of the attractions in short walking distance.
The apartment itself is very clean and nicely decorated. Communication with Pedro is very good because he always replies very promptly.
I'd like to stay at his listing again in my next visit!
Obrigata, Pedro!

Das Apartment ist einfach großartig! Mitten in der Stadt und trotzdem total ruhig. Modern und stylisch eingerichtet. Nespresso Maschine, frische Orangen und Saftpresse standen bereit. Und alles perfekt sauber. Wir wären gerne länger geblieben und möchten unbedingt wieder kommen!

Wir wurden freundlich empfangen im schönen
Appartment mitten in der Stadt. Wirklich eine super schöne und unheimlich praktische Lokation. Wir konnten sogar bei offenem Fenster schlafen. Chiado ist ein tolles Quartier - the place to be!
Muito obrigada Pedro!
This is really the best location in Lisbon... Nice, clean quiet sidestreet, we could sleep with the windows open!
Muito obrigada Pedro

The apartment is fabulous - I couldn't recommend it highly enough. It's luxuriously fitted, and in a fabulous location. The logistics worked perfectly, and there were so many nice touches in the flat that made it beyond great - fresh oranges and a juicer to make orange juice in the morning, coffee and a coffee machine, chocolates by the bed, and ipad dock to name just a few. I'd come back here in a heartbeat and recommend it to anyone. So much better than staying in a hotel, and at such a bargain price.

The apartment is just wonderful!  Excellent location.  The flat is clean and neat. The communication with the host could not be better.  The flat is exactly as shown on the pics.  I will definitely pick this apartment shall I travel to Lisbon again.

We had a great stay - the apartment was really well located in Chiado and easy walking distance to Bairro Alto and all the main areas. Lovely sea view from the balcony. The apartment was bright and airy with a comfy bed and beautifully clean. Nice touch with the expresso machine and free capsules. We would definitely stay again.
Great apartment and location. Pedro was really efficient and would have provided more support if we'd needed it. A perfect place for us to stay. Would highly recommend this apartment.

Great and well located apartment with stylish and cozy interieur. The view from the small balcony is wonderful, everything matched to the airbnb photos. Pedro and Antonio were great hosts and even helped us out as we were not staying in the apartment anymore. Definitely highly recommended! We will come back! Thank you for everything.

I can't rate Pedro's apartment highly enough! If only I could give it 6 stars! I had an absolutely amazing time staying here. The photos reflect the apartment 100% accurately and it is such a comfortable place to call home during our stay in Lisbon.

What I loved about it:
- The apartment is in the very handy location of Chiado, which is in the middle of the town, close to all the restaurants, a metro stop, Rossio train station and main square, nightlife and the old area of Alfama.
- There's a balcony overlooking the historic streets and having a glass of wine while watching the sun set into the sea. The apartment also has views of the Castle of Sao Jorge, the historic castle in Lisbon.
- The apartment has all amenities if you do want to cook. We didn't cook, but having wine glasses, ample glassware, dishwasher, Nespresso machine with pods included were very nice touches.
- There's a washing machine shared with a few other apartments in the main corridor which is very handy, especially if you stay for a few days and during summer.
- Pedro and Antonio were always able to be contacted and responded immediately to my queries and welcomed me to the apartment.
- The apartment is very clean, the bathroom is gorgeous and the furniture, as you can see from the photos, is artsy and modern.

The only downside was to leave! I will definitely stay here again if and when I return to Lisbon! I highly recommend this apartment.

They were really fantastic 4 days in Chiado IV Apartment!Great location,lovely view on Tag and the roofs of houses,close to most important places.The apartment is very tasty,original,comfortable and beautiful!!!
Anna

The Chiado Studio IV is perfect in every way. It is as beautiful as shown in the pictures; clean, and well-equipped. From the apartment, it is only a few minutes downhill walk to the Rossio square, the Comercio Riverside square, and other historical attractions. The Santa Justa Elevator is only a few steps away and the famous Sao Roque Church can be reached in just a few minutes. There is a Starbucks in a nearby mall, an organic supermarket opposite, and there are numerous nice restaurants in the surrounding area.
The "Chiado Studio Team" was very gracious and quick in responding to emails. I was extremely satisfied with my stay, and would certainly recommend this apartment to anyone traveling in Lisbon.

En wunderbarer Aufenthalt. Das Appartement ist genauso schön und geschmackvoll wie auf den fotos zu sehen. Es liegt total zentral an einem Platz, an dem wir uns täglich zum entspannen eingefunden haben. Vielen dank!

Appartamento delizioso ed in posizione centrale, perfetto per un weekend.
Noi eravamo in 4, 2 adulti e due bambini e siamo stati molto bene.
Ringrazio Pedro per l'accoglienza, per la cura dei dettagli e per la sua disponibilità

Hello, nous avons passé un séjour juste parfait! Pedro et son équipe ont été au rdv. Rien n'a été laissé au hasard. L'appartement est fidèle aux photos présentés sur le site, propreté des lieux, équipement moderne et très spacieux. L'emplacement est idéalement situé au coeur du quartier historique et du meilleur quartier de Lisbonne avec une vue mer. Nous vous conseillons d'aller déjeuner ou diner au Carmo situé sur la place au pied de l'immeuble : acceuil et nourriture irréprochable. N'hésitez pas à gouter également les pastei de nasta au petit café sur la place et de déguster une caipirina au kiosque également sur la place. En résumé vous ne serez pas déçu par la Chiado team. Bon séjour. Virginie et David

It is just a great apartment. Perfect location , clean , nicely decorated and well equipped. The staff is very friendly , helpful and flexible. We could make our check-in even in the night time. We would definitely recommend this apartment.
Perfect flat in perfect location! Very clean and equipped with quality furniture/kitchen.

This place is truly amazing and as beautiful as the pictures portray. Clean, artistic, and stylishly furnished, we spent two wonderful days in Pedro's flat in the chic Chiado area. The location in excellent and close to historical sites, shopping, and cafes. Also, the flat is close to public transportation and would make an excellent home base for exploring Lisbon. Only regret is that we did not stay longer. We would definitely return and recommend Pedro's place.  June 2013

This lovely apartment is located in a great part of Lisbon in Chiado, and is within walking distance to just about every part we wanted to see.  The apartment has everything we needed to make our stay comfortable, such as internet access, air conditioning, washing machine, refrigerator, dishwasher, very roomy couch, great shower, queen size bed, balcony with a nice view of the river, and an elevator.  There is also a nice square just outside the main door that has a few small restaurants with outdoor seating and good for a meal, quick bite, espresso or beer. Looks like a local hangout as well. What more could you ask for?  The staff was very welcoming. We would definitely recommend this place for your Lisbon stay.

This apartment has been the start of an amazing week!

Pedro was very helpful by providing us with detailed information about how to get there. He kindly explained how everything worked and has been available by phone throughout our stay. He welcomed us with a nice bottle of chilled white wine, some oranges for juicing, chocolates, coffee and a hand written welcome note. Just amazing, we've never felt so welcome!

This apartment is beautifully decorated (as you can see in the pictures) and super comfortable. It's located on this idyllic little square with a couple of restaurants and musicians playing. It never gets to crowded or noisy but always has a great atmosphere. A great place to have a couple of drinks at the end of a long day.

Furthermore the location is perfect for exploring Lisbon and its surroundings (the area was recommended to us by a friend from Lisbon). Within 2-3 minutes you stroll down right into the centre and all train stations are within a 10 minute reach.

I'd definitely recommend staying at one of Pedro's apartments. One of the best experiences we had so far. And not because of a lack of good experiences, it's just that good.

Un seul mot s'impose : parfait !
L'accueil de Pedro, l'appartement décoré avec soin et fidèle aux photos, une vue imprenable, dans une rue calme à 2 mn du coeur de la ville.
Sans oublier les conseils pour les visites, les restaurants à disposition...
Nous n'avons qu'une hâte : y retourner !
Un grand merci à Pedro et son équipe qui le temps d'un long week-end nous ont fait oublier le rythme effréné de Paris. Cela vaut une semaine de vacances !
O veja muito logo para um episódio encantado novo !

What a wonderful apartment- comfortable, well furnished (very stylish too), well equipped, clean and in a great location- close to everything, but nice and quiet.  We really enjoyed our stay here- the little touches also made it extra special and welcoming- wine, little chocolates, oranges for juicing and pots of jam.  This was our first Airbnb experience and we were very impressed with Pedro and the apartment.  Communication with Pedro was excellent - including tips on getting from the airport to the apartment and being ready for our arrival.  We’d certainly recommend staying here- thanks Pedro!
Perfect location, perfect place to enjoy Lisbon ! Perfect host, thanks Pedro !

The apartment was great! Perfect location and the apartment itself was very nice and clean and everything you hope an Airbnb place will be. And Pedro was very nice and helpful. I can't recommend the place enough and will definitely rent it again when I come back to Lisbon.

Excellent apartment, great host!
The apartment ist perfectly located, super clean and well-equipped. Pedro is a very friendly and helpful host, I absolutely enjoyed to stay at his apartment. Thanks again!
Great location, cute home! Will 100% stay with Helena again if I have the chance!

We had a fantastic stay here in Lisbon – the location couldn’t have been better. The apartment was lovely and exactly what we were looking for to celebrate a 50th birthday, making the trip feel extra special.
There are some great restaurants and bars just a minute’s walk away, and right opposite is the perfect spot to grab breakfast – we highly recommend the power bowl!
Thank you so much for having us, we’d happily stay again and will be recommending you to friends and family.
We had a great time! Great place, great location!

Great location. Apartment has lots of character and plenty of space. Washing machine was much appreciated. Very nice bathroom and kitchen. Coffee pods were a nice bonus. Additional heaters did the trick even on a pretty cold and rainy March night.  Bed in master bedroom was very comfy.  The only downside were the single twin mattresses in the smaller room. They might be OK for young children, but for older adults they were very hard and uncomfortable.  Nonetheless, we really enjoyed our stay.
The place was very clean and comfortable, and the location was great. We had a pleasant stay for 3 nights and 4 days and are leaving well-rested.
Great deal on a beautiful apartment in a good location!

Helena’s place was perfect! The location was exactly what we were looking for. In the historic area within walking distance to many great sites including San Jorge Castle at the top of the hill. The apartment was well appointed and the beds were super comfortable.
Helena was very quick to respond to questions and gave helpful recommendations including the cafe below which was the best breakfast ever!
Thanks for sharing your amazing space!
샤워실을 30분 정도 사용한 이후에는 뜨거운 물이 나오지 않았습니다. 이 숙소의 유일한 단점입니다. 호스트가 친절하고 연락이 잘되며 집이 매우 예쁩니다.

L’emplacement ne pouvait pas être mieux ! Au pied de la cathédrale Sé et au cœur d’Alfama pour visiter et se reposer. Le quartier est très calme et à proximité de nombreux restaurants. Enfin l’appartement est décoré avec beaucoup de goût. Je recommande vivement !

a great stay in a very beautiful apartment in an old building with lots of character. the location is great as it is very close to multiple attractions and at the same time very quiet. highly recommended!

Wir haben uns in der Wohnung sehr wohl gefühlt. Sie hat eine sehr gute Lage, um Lissabon zu erkunden und entspricht den Fotos sowie der Beschreibung. Zu viert biete die Wohnung mehr als ausreichend Platz, sie war super sauber und die Betten sehr bequem. Wir würden, wenn wir nochmal nach Lissabon reisten, gerne wieder bei Helena in der Wohnung wohnen. Vielen Dank für die schöne Zeit.

We had a great stay.  The apartment is right in the center of Lisbon.  Everything was walk-able.  We found free parking a few streets away and didn't need our car again until it was time to check out.  Helena responded very quickly with helpful tips and suggestions.

A wonderful and very authentic place. Great location, spotlessly clean, and Helena is an excellent host. Everything went smoothly from start to finish. I'd definitely stay here again and highly recommend it.
Helena a été très gentille et ses instructions étaient précises pour l’arrivée. Interactions agréables et logement propre et confortable. Merci!!
Good location.

O apartamento estava exatamente como nas fotos: muito bonito, com móveis novos e bem cuidados. A cozinha é completa, com todos os utensílios necessários, o banheiro estava impecável e tudo funcionava perfeitamente. Inclusive havia um adaptador universal para tomadas, o que foi um ótimo detalhe.
Apenas uma observação: para quem é sensível a barulho, a acústica do imóvel não é das melhores, pois há um bar na rua ao lado e, nos fins de semana, as pessoas costumam ficar do lado de fora até por volta da meia-noite, o que pode dificultar o sono de quem tem sono leve.
Fora isso, o apartamento é excelente e a anfitriã, Helana, foi sempre muito atenciosa e respondeu rapidamente a todas as mensagens.
Beautiful place and very comfy

70대,60대,30대 부부 4명이 이용했습니다.
위치가 아주 좋습니다.
알파마 지구 대부분을 도보로 걸어다닐수 있고
1층에 위치해 있어 적은 오르막길을 걷게 됩니다.
부엌이 잘 갖추어져 있어서 요리를 해먹기 좋았습니다. 욕실은 수압이 좋았어요.
단, 거실이나 방에 거울이 갖추어져 있지않아 조금 불편했습니다.

Our stay at Helena’s was our favorite during our entire trip to Portugal. We can’t say enough about Helena’s kindness and responsiveness - she really helped us out when we had an unexpected situation pop up during our trip. Helena gave us great recommendations for food, sight seeing, and shopping - we stopped at all of her recommendations!
Her apartment is beautiful, clean and walking distance to the downtown and historic districts. It is a short walk from one of the public train stations, so it was easy for us to get there from the airport and further parts of town.

Very convenient location! Walkable to luggage storage and the cruise ship terminal.
Beds were comfortable and it was quiet at night for sleeping.
Great communication from the host. Fantastic location.

Lovely flat right across the street from the old cathedral and in the middle of the Fado district. Helena was very responsive and easy to connect with. We had one small issue with some sewer gas smells coming from the drain in the kitchen but it was resolved. We have since learned that this is a common issue in some of the very old buildings in Lisbon. Great spot to explore the city.

Helena’s place was in the perfect location. The apartment itself had so much character. We loved the decor! Street noise can be a bit loud and beds a little uncomfortable, but not the end of the world. Helena was very responsive and warm. Would recommend as a great place in Lisbon!

We wish we stayed longer at this house!! Location is 10/10!! Right next to a beautiful cathedral, walking distance to the water, Arco da Rua Augusta and great resturants. Also only a 20 min car ride to the airport. The house itself was beautiful and big modern bathroom. Was a little worried about no AC with only fans but the fans were strong and we were very comfortable. Would love to stay here again!
Excellent location and very stylish space, spacious interior and comfortable bedrooms.

Séjour très agréable dans ce magnifique logement. A la fois fonctionnel et avec beaucoup de charme.
Très bien placé, sur la ligne du Tram 28, au pied de la cathédrale et au milieu des restaurants.
Bel appartement avec du charme, fidèle aux photos et très bien placé. Helena est une hôte disponible et réactive.
Wir hatten eine tolle Zeit im Herzen von Lissabon. Die Lage an der Se ist einmalig. Die Unterkunft vereint authentische, rustikale Elemente mit modernem Komfort.
Tres bon emplacement pr visiter, choix de restaurants variés et nombreux, Helena etait toujours là pr repondre a nos questions. Brau séjour dans ce logis.

The apartment is perfectly located – right next to the cathedral in the heart of Lisbon, you couldn’t ask for a better spot! Everything is within walking distance yet pleasantly quiet. Very clean, cozy, and ideal for an authentic stay in the old town.

Wij raden dit verblijf echt heel erg aan! Het, en alles daar omheen, is echt goed te bereiken. Bij binnenkomst voelden wij ons meteen thuis en het ziet er allemaal geweldig uit. Ook is het fijn dat de ruimte groot genoeg is om even bij te komen van de citytrip. Aan de eettafel of op de bank, je zou hier makkelijk een week kunnen blijven. De keuken is van alle gemakken voorzien. Ook Helena is een hele fijne gastvrouw, ze reageert snel en denkt graag mee.
Wat betreft gehorigheid, dat is het wel een beetje maar hebben wij niet echt last van gehad. Helena informeerde ons dat er een filmset en filmopnames bezig waren in de straat, ja ze waren zeker rumoerig en gingen tot ver in de nacht door, maar met oortjes in had ik er weinig tot geen last van. En Hey, wie kan er nou vertellen dat ze 2 dagen op een filmset aanwezig waren?!? Wij!
Al met al, zeker dit appartement nemen voor een citytrip in Lissabon!
We had a great stay at Helena’s place. The location is amazing and conveniently located near shops, restaurants and attractions. Very clean and comfortable! We would definitely stay there again!!!

Helena's place was wonderful.   It is in the center of a lot of activity (restaurants, etc.).  The apartment was a perfect blend of modern with old world charm.  As others have mentioned, there is no Ac (wasn't a problem for us- there are fans); there is a walk and stairs to get to the apartment so that is something to consider if you have multiple bags or heavy bags.

Tolle Unterkunft von der aus man sehr viel zu Fuß entdecken kann. Da es sehr zentral liegt, hört man auch nachts das Treiben auf der Straße. Aber wen das nicht stört findet hier eine sehr (!) saubere, gepflegte, zentrale Unterkunft, die einen tollen Charme hat!
Comfortable beds and quality sheets. Very central for visiting Lisbon.

eine wunderbare und toll eingerichtete Wohnung, wo man abends auf dem Sofa den leisen  Fadogesängen lauschen kann, trotzdem ruhig und gut schläft und die Wohnung ein ganz besonderer Ort ist. einfach wunderbar um Lissabon zu entdecken und sich dann vom Trubel der Stadt zu erholen.

Très beau logement proposé par Helena : propre, spacieux et idéalement situé. Il se trouve à environ 100 m de l’église de Lisbonne et à 300 m de la place du Commerce.

Nous reviendrons avec grand plaisir !!!
Merci pour tout 🙏
Lovely clean and spacious place. Great location and brilliant value for money. Would book again!
Alles super, tolle Lage und super Wohnung.

Superbe appartement avec beaucoup de cachet dans un des meilleurs quartiers de Lisbonne. L'appartement en soit est magnifique et son emplacement est exceptionnel en plus de répondre parfaitement à nos besoins et nos attentes. Il est très bien équipé pour les jeunes familles avec plusieurs jouets, chaise haute, vaisselle pour enfants, etc. Nous avons passé un agréable séjour. Je vous le recommande sans hésiter!

Helena’s apartment is absolutely beautiful, with modern amenities, yet historic character.
The location is central to many restaurants and tourist sites, great jumping off spot for sight seeing. Cafe, and restaurants right outside the door really made it convenient.
Helena provided clear instructions and was a very responsive host.

Goede gastvrouw die duidelijk en snel communiceert. Perfecte locatie in het hart van de oude stad recht tegenover de prachtige kathedraal.  Ondanks de drukte in het hoogseizoen, een aangename buurt met dichtbij goede restaurantjes en ontbijtplekken. Charmant en proper appartement. Geen airco, maar goede ventilatie. Zou fijn zijn moesten de schuiframen kunnen open blijven staan.
On a beaucoup apprécié notre séjour à Lisbonne. Tout était à proximité.

Helena's  place was excellent despite the lack of AC (fans in each room) and we knew this ahead of booking. The location was SO  incredible! Right in the heart of Lisbon and so close to Lisbon Cathedral you can almost touch it. Helena went over and above for us - she was very accommodating, friendly, and responsive. Would happily recommend to others.

Helena's place was beautiful and the location was amazing! close to everything, it matched the description and it was peaceful at night. I highly recommend it to anyone coming to Lisbon, we absolutely enjoyed it!
Great location for exploring Lisbon with our family and returning to a comfortable place to relax

Logement spacieux, bien aménagé et très bien placé par rapport au centre de Lisbonne. Helena est une hôte très réactive qui nous a apporté tous les renseignements nécessaires. En période estivale, je vous conseille de prendre des bouchons d'oreilles ( si vous avez le sommeil léger) car il y a une vie nocturne avec restaurants autour de l'appartement

We liked this authentic and cosy apartment 😍 got there very easily; very good location; there was enough space for our family of 5. Overall, it was a nice stay!

The photos do not do this apartment justice, it is so beautiful! Unfortunately I was only there for 1 night but would definitely stay there again. And the location was great, Alfama is a great area and there were great bars and restaurants within steps.

It was a pleasure to stay in Helena's beautiful apartment. Helena answered all our questions before and on the day of the trip, in fact everything we asked her she answered in detail and in a very short time, which is sometimes necessary so as not to wait too long. You can count on her service. In addition to excellent communication, her apartment is decorated pleasantly and with love, from the furniture to the pictures on the wall, everything is TOP. I highly recommend it. The apartment is also in a great location.

Great place in the Alfama area. So close to all the bars and restaurants in the old area along with the main church. Parking was really close and we didn’t need the car for our stay except going to Sintra.
The apartment was clean, great kitchen stuff, big dining room table and all the towels you need. They also had some spices to cook, tea and coffee pods.
Great place to stay in Lisbon

a beautiful and spacious apartment full of old world charm. you couldn't find a better location. the only downside, should you consider it one, is the absence of air conditioning (fans do the trick), and the noise from the street, as the apartment is not high up and is located close to several restaurants and bars in a very busy tourist area.

Beautiful apartment with nice orgional features in local old town neighbourhood.
Helena was professional and friendly to communicate with throughout our very haappy stay.
A unique apartment in a historic area of Lisbon.

Helena went above and beyond to make sure our stay was incredible. She is hands down the most wonderful air bnb host we have encountered. She was welcoming, kind, and so responsive. The place was truly stunning with so much in walking distance and we will be dreaming of our stay for a long time!
Wonderful place, in the center, spacious apartment and wonderful hosts. Totally recommend.
The location is great, plenty of things to do walking or close to easy uber/taxis pickup. Helena also gave us freer recommendations and was extremely friendly and helpful throughout our stay!
Great place in a perfect location. Would recommend!

We spent the last night of our Spain/Portugal, three-week vacation in Helena's beautifully appointed apartment in an ancient building across the narrow and steep cobbled street from the huge stone wall of the cathedral. We only had a one night stay at Helena’s place, however it was a great location and the space was so charming and beautiful!
Great location in the heart of the city. Kitchen was SO nice and the perfect place for us.

Lovely, modern apartment, great space and location! Would recommend!
Die Wohnung ist super und sieht aus, wie auf den Fotos. Die Lage ist noch besser, als ich es erwartet habe. Wirklich super.

Precioso apartamento con localización céntrica a pie de la catedral. Rodeado de restaurantes y punto de partida para cualquier paseo por Lis barrios de Lisboa. Muy bien equipado y decorado. Preciosos ventanales. Nos alojamos la familia entera, dos adultos y tres jóvenes.

リスボンの観光地からアクセスが良く、ヘレナさんの案内もスピーディかつ正確で安心して滞在できました！部屋もお洒落でアメニティ類も充実しており、快適でした。
建物がかなり古いのでバスルームの扉の建て付けが悪く、何度か閉め出されそうになったのと、バスルームに少しだけ漏水が見られた点だけ気になりました。

Très bel appartement, très propre et vraiment bien situé.
Excellente communication avec Helena.
Je recommande vivement !

Ce logement était conforme à l’annonce, très bien situé et très propre.
Héléna a été très accommodante pour l’arrivée.
Nous avons passé un excellent séjour et je recommande sans hésiter!!
Super place!!!

Les indications transmises étaient très claires, nous n'avons eu aucun mal à trouver le logement et y entrer. Le logement était propre, très fonctionnel, rien ne manquait.

Je recommande cet appartement sans hésiter.
Super séjour à Lisbonne, l'appartement est idéalement situé :)
Nice stay! Helena is super nice and easy to communicate!

Zentraler kann man in Lissabon nicht wohnen. Sehr gemütlich und geschmackvoll eingerichtet, für kühlere Abende sind zwei mobile Heizkörper vorhanden. Wir kommen sehr gern wieder!
This place is extremely central. The area feels safe and it’s walkable! We had a great stay.

This was a perfect spot to explore Lisbon. Great location and cute neighborhood. The apartment was very nice and had many nice touches like places to hang things, extra blankets, coffee. One of the nicest units we have stayed in. Would highly recommend!

The apartment was lovely! We were in Lisbon during a very rainy weekend and hat a great cosy time in the apartment. The location is amazing to walk around Alfama and there are a ton of Cafés and shops around.
Would definitely stay there again! Thank you very much!
Beautiful apartment in the centre. Very comfortable, also with small children. And lovely hosts.. thank you very much!

Très bon séjour pour 4 personnes, dont 2 adolescentes.
Emplacement idéal, parfait pour visiter Lisbonne.
Un grand merci à Héléna!

Helena is a nice host, giving the detailed check-in information. The apartment is near the city centre and it is well-decorated. I really like this apartment will definitely stay here for the next time!

Perfekte Unterkunft – absolut empfehlenswert!

房东贴心周到 很好的住宿体验

O local fica exatamente ao lado da Sé de Lisboa. O apartamento é muito confortável (queria ter ficado mais tempo 😅) e as instruções da sra. Helena são bem precisas.

Recomendo a todos da comunidade Airbnb

Hemos estado muy a gusto estos tres dias en casa de Helena.. bien equipada y las camas muy comodas. La ubicacion es excelente para acceder al centro y la decoracion del apartamento es muy original.

Excelente apartamento na região da Alfama em Lisboa. A localização é excelente, próximo a bares e restaurantes. Os quartos são espaçosos, bem como a sala e o banheiro. Tivemos uma excelente comunicação com a anfitriã. Super recomendado.

A super cute and cozy apartment right beside the oldest cathedral in Lisbon. Very cool spot, right in the old town near the Fado bars yet nice and quiet. We loved it. If we come back to Lisbon we will definitely stay there again.

This beautiful accommodation was exactly what we were looking for. Great for a family of four or two couples. Centrally located to many restaurants, cafes, grocery store and historical sites. Lots of hot water and great water pressure. Helena, the cohost, was kind, friendly, very responsive and helpful with any questions we had. We would highly recommend this lovely apartment.

This has been one of the best stays I have had. the place is really big and confortable. The common areas are really great as well, it was just perfect for my family. The location was spot on. 8 minute walk to the Placa de comercio or 10 minute walk to Baxia. There are a lot of restaurants near by, which was really helpful. 10/10 would recommend. The host was also really flexible and responsive.

Helena was a great host! She responded quickly and was helpful. Her place is ideally situated within walking distance - close to restaurants and the Lisbon Cathedral. We really loved the space, the beds were comfortable and she provided everything we needed for a comfortable stay. We would happily return!

Helena's apartment is perfect for visiting the city – the main attractions are very close by. The apartment has everything needed for a comfortable stay, it is spacious and has a charming rustic style. Helena also sent clear instructions in advance, and since it’s self check-in, everything went smoothly without any issues. I only stayed for one nigh, but I would definitely return.

Everything was generally ok. The bed room with two beds was a little cramp and the beds there creaked and the front main door was difficult to open at times  but everything else was good for us. Loved the way the unit was designed, with tasteful art, furniture and exposed walls to show the original building structure. There's a short flight of steps to the unit as it's on first floor, so whilst it's easy to get to, it means all noise from street can be heard. It wasn't frequent when we were there (Dec) but when there is, you can hear it, whatever time it is. A pair of ear plugs should solve that.

😍 Wow!!! I was truly mesmerised by the amazing place Helen had in the heart of Lisbon. I have never fell in love with an Airbnb like I did with this one before! I'm obssesed!!!
Not only was the place was charming and beautiful, with a super cool and spacious bathroom. But also the view from the apartment was spectacular as well, we could see the Lisbon cathedral from the windows and it looks amazing!!
I totally recommend everyone to come stay here, the place looks wayyy more beautiful in real life than it is in the photos!
We really enjoyed our stay in Helena’s apartment. Great neighborhood and a clean apartment. Helena was a fantastic host aswell!

Excelente lugar para llegar en Lisboa.
Muy bien ubicado, amplio, bonito, acogedor, cómodo, bien iluminado.

We loved staying here! Helena supplied us with toys, games, a high chair and crib for our toddler - it was very 2 year old friendly. It’s a peaceful space in a busy city. Incredible location, we were able to walk everywhere we wanted to go and had countless delicious options for restaurants within a 5 minute walk. Highly recommend!

siamo stati bene
casa molto luminosa per essere ad Alfama

For a family of 5 in Europe (where nothing seems to cater to groups > 4 people), this place is a great deal and in a great location. The location was amazing - right next to the Lisbon Cathedral, lots of restaurants, and easy walking distance to lots of sites and public transport.  The few things we struggled with as Americans were the beds being less soft than we're used to and being able to hear the noise outside the apartment very well late into the night, but ear plugs solved this problem. We would definitely recommend.
This place is absolutely amazing. Everything that I needed. She made sure that we had and it was absolutely the best day.
Helena was super responsive and communicative, flexible with our needs. Place is as described in the photo. Very spacious!

This apartment is very huge as good for family( 4person). It was near by Sé de lisboa only 1 mins by walk. And also can find alot of good restaurants very easily.
In aparment has everything what do we need, it was wonderful time to stay with Helena's apartment. When i have chance again, i definitely will choose her apartment again. So lovely place 😍
一棟老建築，很有年代感，進入建築需先上一小段樓梯，屋內地板也有部分是傾斜的，很特別，設備都有很齊全，就在主教堂旁邊，窗戶可以望著教堂，走路可以到達很多地方，附近餐廳很多，很棒住宿點。

Fantastic flat in probably the best neighborhood possible! Restaurants & bars (and cathedrals, street art, groceries, viewpoints) right out your front door. Helene was very helpful with recommendations for some local spots and tips-n-tricks for the old windows/shutters. We can't wait to come back!
Schöne zentrale Lage,  belebte Gegend mit einigen Restaurants. Wie in der Beschreibung erwähnt,  kann es Abends etwas mehr Geräuschkulisse geben! Wir fanden es authentisch und hat uns nicht gestört.

Such a stylish and comfortable apartment on a beautiful street and ideally located for exploring Lisbon. Restaurants, bars and culture in the doorstep but also far enough from the crowds. We loved it!

Ótimo apartamento. Helena sempre respondeu rapidamente e disposta a ajudar.

O apto estava limpo, tivemos facilidade para fazer o check in e o check out.
Recomendo
Helena is an excellent host and her space was perfect for our stay! Very spacious and in a great neighborhood. Hope to be back one day!

The spacious flat is perfectly located for a Lisbon holiday.  Many historic sites are a short, but somewhat hilly, walk away.  Many great eateries are nearby.  The flat is across the street from the Lisbon Cathedral and historic in itself.  Beds were comfy and the living areas are quite large...perfect for my wife and I and out adult daughter.  The kitchen was well equipped and ready for a homecooked meal.  The flat is up a single set of stairs which is a positive in old historic buildings.  As the building is 200+ years old, I recommend reaching out to Helena with questions when things pop up.  We would stay at Helena's place again!

I had the pleasure of meeting Helena in person. She was very kind, communicative and accommodating. The apartment was spacious and clean. The location was the best part, right next to the Cathedral which was an easy reference point. I would recommend!

Helena was very responsive and friendly throughout our stay.  The flat was perfect for our situation: sight seeing and celebrating family birthdays.  Very picturesque part of town, some hill walking, next to the impressive cathedral da Se.  Lively nightlife below but not intrusive.  Lovely light flat; big enough for 4 comfortably, with antique wooden shutters.  Useful kitchen.  Highly recommend!
Perfect place for a stay in Lisbon! The apartment is super nice and located in the perfect area to explore the city.

Ce logement est superbe avec un emplacement idéal .
Helena est très réactive et nous a même aidé sur des situations autres que sur le logement . Elle était soucieuse du bon déroulement de notre voyage sur tous les points avec une réactivité au top .
Le logement était parfait et son hôte aussi .
Je recommande ;)
交通便利，在大教堂旁边，房屋设施齐全空间大，温馨的老公寓。
Great stay, great location

The apartment was beautiful, in a fabulous location. Very vibrant atmosphere lots of restaurants near by. I found location very central to everything only a 10 - 15 min walk to any attractions. Helena was very warm and welcoming and very responsive to anything we needed. Incredible stay thank you very much I highly recommend

We had a great stay at Helena's place. The apartment is stylish, immaculate and accurately pictured/described. It is in a fab location - walkable to several tourist sights, places to eat and transport hubs. Helena was friendly and helpful with local recommendations.
L'allotjament te encant i es correspon exactament amb les fotos. Està molt ben ubicat, al costat de la catedral de Lisboa. El barri és divertit i ple de restaurants i locals per prendre una copa.
Alles war super! Von der Kommunikation bis zur Lage, top. Immer wieder gerne! Danke Helena:)
Très bel appartement plein de charme, idéalement situé dans l'Alfama.
Wonderful stay with the apartment was beautiful and clean and In a great location, thanks for having us stay in your lovely home.

The apartment was really great; the location was excellent and not noisy despite being very central. The apartment was clean and larger than we expected. Overall, it was great value and we would happily stay here again.
Wonderful apartment. It's a great location and beautiful decorated. We have  truly enjoyed it.

The place is amazing and location is unbelievable.
Really enjoyed our stay and my family couldn’t be happier.

All in all
We really enjoyed our time and look forward to the next time we come to Lisbon to hopefully be welcomed back to this beautiful place Helena had for us.
Thanks for everything.

The location of the property in Alfama was great.  It is at the bottom of the hill and at the top of the hill is the castle. The property does not have air conditioning, but fans were provided for all rooms.  There is a grocery store very near.

Lovely and cozy place by the cathedral. Helena is a wonderful host (kind, friendly, responsive...). We stayed during 2 very hot days and we missed not having A/C and a big refrigerator., but we loved Helena's place.
En sentral og veldig hyggelig leilighet, og mange gode tips fra Helena.

Such an amazing apartment, right in the heart of Lisboa and beautifully appointed. The timer starts from your first journey and ends either 24, 48 or 72 hours after, so plan ahead. Sintra, Setubal and Cascais all on the trains. I could go on, but think I’m getting boring!
We can’t wait to come back. Obrigado from the Brown Family
Alles war perfekt! Wunderschöne gemütliche Wohnung, sehr zentral gelegen, zu Fuß alles gut erreichbar...würde ich sofort wieder buchen! :)

Logement de caractère magnifique,  très bien situé lorsqu'on a peu de temps à Lisbonne, dans le quartier historique, typique de la ville. Helena est très accueillante et donne de nombreuses recommandations utiles ! Encore merci à elle.

Excellent location for us, really suited our needs. Its just one flight of stairs up to the apartment and more spacious than we expected. Some great restaurants nearby, transport on the doorstep. Would definitely recommend.

Helena was so helpful! Both before and during our stay, she responded quickly and made sure we had what we needed. My luggage was delayed by over 2 days, but Helena gave me recommendations for where to go to restock necessities in the meantime. She also gave tips for restaurants and local grocery shopping.
Her apartment is charming and stocked with everything we needed. The location couldn’t have been better - overlooking the Cathedral and easy walking distance to public transport & all Alfama has to offer!
Typical of the apartment’s age, the bedroom and bathroom doors and locks can be a little finicky. We managed them ok, but they could be difficult for younger children - fyi.
We loved our stay in Lisbon and will remember it fondly!
Très beau logement et très bien situé
一切都很完美

Helena’s apartment was beautiful! She was very responsive and helpful, allowing us to store our bags early before we were able to check in. It’s in a great walkable location with lots do! Very clean and large space. I would highly recommend!
Had a great time in Helena's place. Amazing location and beautiful apartment. Looking forward to the next stay already.

Sehr gute Lage, sehr Gute Restaurants 5 min zu Fuß.
Wäre schön wenn man Fenster öffnen kann zum Lüften. Sehr schöne Wohnung,sehr Gut ausgestattet , nur Nächte sehr laut , uns hat nicht gestört. Sehr nette Gastgeberin.

Nous avons été charmé par l'appartement et les environs. Accessible par les transports en commun (métro à proximité, tramways, bus, etc.).
This was a completely fabulous place to stay, and Helena was a wonderful very communicative host. Can’t beat the location right in the very center of where you would want to be in Lisbon.
Had a fantastic stay! Host provided helpful recommendations and responded quickly!

Thank you Helena and Miguel. So pleased we could get in when we arrived and the place was super clean. Lovely, well appointed, large living area with rooms far enough apart to not hear snoring lol main bed very comfortable, pull out bed in second room comfortable. Great pressure in the shower, would suggest turning off while you soap n shampoo so enough water for the next person. Suck a great location, walkable to the sights and we loved the lift at the top of the street down to the waterfront. Easy walk to Rue Augustus from there. Great eateries especially the food next door at Santa. I would come back n stay here again. Great location, great space, great hosts.

Amazing apartment. Excellent location in the city for exploring and day trips (both train stations at walking distance). The apartment is very pretty, old architecture, but well renovated. modern kitchenand bathroom. Helena was very helpful and had lots of tips to make our stay enjoyable!
Alojamiento acogedor. Bien ubicado para visitar la ciudad.

Helena was a great host and kept the entire place in pristine condition. It’s a great location right beside the Se Cathedral. It was a bit loud a night sometimes but great for those looking to socialize and enjoy great food and drinks.
Our family of 4 stayed at Helena’s place for 3 nights in April. The location of the place is great, in the centre of Lisboa’s old town. The apartment had everything needed for good city break.

You need to be prepared for some background noise in the evenings with the windows open but nothing that prevented us from sleeping.  Very comfortable beds.  The cars are not able to take you right to the door as the street has restricted access being right next to the Se but we managed fine with suitcases with wheels.  A bit of an effort but well worth it.  We would definitely recommend it.
Can’t recommend this airbnb enough! The apartment was great, the location was perfect, and Helena was a lovely and responsive host.
Zeer aangenaam en ruim appartement met alle voorzieningen. Wij verbleven er jammer genoeg maar een nacht.

Helena’s place is extremely central and well located to see the historic area of the city. If you plan to arrive by car it’s a challenge to enter the restricted area - as it is physically blocked to all cars and only can open up to residents. We arrived very late night with kids so this was a bit complicated initially - as we weren’t familiar with the area and needed to find it in the dark while carrying all the luggage. That said, once inside, it was a very nice apartment - comfortable and easy to get inside with the key box once we reached the doorway. Best for people who want to be in the historic center and without a car. Or, if you can arrive earlier like in daylight it should be much more manageable to find and enter. Helena was in any case very communicative and helpful. Overall a very short but good stay and the apartment itself was nice.

this was a great space.  Very central to sites, resturants and activities. Apartment worked well for our group of for.  Only draw back is potential street noise from restaurants and bar that stay open late.
Absolutely amazing apartment , beautifully decorated and with a very tasteful mix of old and modern , fantastic location , would come back , recommend !

We only stayed one night, but the apartment suited our needs very well - it's well located in a lively part of town with lots of options for live music and eating out within a short walk. The apartment itself was clean, spacious and comfortable. Helena was friendly and communicative; her instructions were clear and there was a key-safe so we could check in and out when it suited us.

Wir hatten das Glück und konnten direkt nach der Landung sofort das Gepäck in der Unterkunft ablegen. Danke, Helena! Der Check-In funktionierte problemlos über eine Schlüsselbox.
Die Wohnung ist schön hell und sieht aus wie auf den Bilder. Der Dielenboden ist so schön. Wir waren 3 Erwachsene und hatten genügend Platz.
Die Unterkunft lag ideal, um durch die Stadt zu schlendern. Eine U-Bahn-Station ist ca. 5-10 min zu Fuß entfernt. In der Umgebung der Unterkunft gibt es zahlreiche Frühstückslokale und Restaurant. Zu einem vernünftigen Supermarkt läuft man auch nur 10 min. Die Küche ist sehr gut ausgestattet, wenn man selbst kochen möchte. Die Waschmaschine war sehr praktisch, um unsere Sportkleidung nach dem Halbmarathon zu waschen.
Wenn ich etwas kritisieren müsste, dann wäre es die Lautstärke nachts. Mich hat es aber nicht wirklich gestört. Bei der tollen Lage muss man das in Kauf nehmen.
Wir würde die Unterkunft auf jeden Fall wieder buchen!

I travel a lot. America, Mexico,
Maldives, Europe. But this place is in top 5 in my list of best Airbnb apartments.
It’s more fancy than at the pictures. Simple amazing. It’s a great location, we really like combining modern and authentic style and how all elements combine together.
Thank you so much

An absolute gem of a flat in the hear of Alfama.  The apartment is exactly as described and pictured, with everything you need.  The Cathedral is an excellent location to catch a Bolt or Uber from.  We throughly enjoyed our stay.  The local restaurants were excellent and we enjoyed the short stroll to the Crafty Corner, craft beer bar, in the evening.   would highly recommend a stay at this beautiful apartment.

Helena’s place was awesome, the location cannot be beat. It’s literally a few steps from the Cathedral and there are buses/trams you can take to go anywhere. Even Uber to the airport  would cost around $12 which is cheap. We have 2 little boys ages 3 and 6 in our family and we couldn’t have asked for a better location for them with tons of restaurants in with-in walking distance. We stayed 3 nights here and we didn’t even turn on the stove since there were so many dining options around. My only complaint would be the antique TV that’s in the house. It had a lot of channels, but it’s so small and slow that it was frustrating to use it. With little kids going to bed early, we really needed some time to unwind watching some Netflix and wine, but the TV kind of ruined it. Couples without kids probably wouldn’t care for the TV as they would be partying out late at night, but a decently large TV is a must for parents with young kids to unwind after a long day of walking with the kids 😄
We loved our stay! Will definitely stay here again

Staying at Helena’s place was perfect for our few days in Lisbon. The great location by the Sé meant it was beautiful but we also had many restaurants and bars to choose from! Just a quick walk to some lovely brunch places and then into the city centre, or down to the water. Would definitely recommend Helena’s place to anyone who would like a comfortable and stylish space in central Lisbon!

Nous avons passés un excellent séjour à Lisbonne. La ville est très jolie, le gros plus a été l’emplacement du logement. Possibilité de faire pleins de choses à pieds (ou utilisation des transports) Endroit très stratégique
Le logement était conforme à l’annonce, propre et spacieux pour 4 personnes.
En effet, si vous souhaitez du calme le soir c’est un peu bruyant mais nous le savions et cela ne nous a pas déranger à dormir après quelques kilomètres… 😉
Je recommande vivement ce logement!
Merci également à Helena qui a été très réactive et arrangeante. À bientôt 👋🏼
Amazing place to stay. Helena was awesome with responses. Would highly recommend.
Well-situated nice and sunny apartment in the heart of Lisbon. Helena was very hospitable and provided clear and helpful instructions. Clean and with all necessary commodities. Good for family stays.
Perfect stay.  The only thing I can mention is the occasional sewer odour in kitchen area

Adoramos o apartamento, a localização é excelente, podemos fazer quase tudo a pé. O apartamento tinha tudo que precisávamos e o anúncio condiz com a realidade. Foram dias perfeitos e muito abençoados. Muito obrigada
Helena pela sua hospedagem.

Alojamiento increíble, muy bien ubicado y de muy fácil acceso a través del elevador (gratuito).
Muy bien decorado y con fácil acceso a metro, bus y tram, aunque lo mejor es siempre recorrer las calles de Lisboa a pié.
La única “pega” es la de no poder dejar el equipaje el último día en el apartamento si tienes un vuelo tardío.
Pero recomiendo absolutamente este apartamento y si alguna vez vuelvo a Lisboa, intentaré repetir.
Muy importante: rodeado de muy buenos restaurantes.

Como chegamos muito tarde em Lisboa, estávamos preocupados com o check in, mas foi um auto check in, com um perfeito funcionamento. o apartamento estava muito limpo e as roupas de cama e banho são de muita qualidade. O espaço do AP é ideal para 4 pessoas. O que mais gostei foi a localização, simplesmente perfeita, estávamos perto de TUDO!! Super indico esse AP. Ter bares por perto é uma vantagem, mesmo tendo um pouco de barulho durante à noite. voltando para Lisboa, sem dúvida, ficarei nesse mesmo AP. Obrigada  Helena por todas as valiosas dicas.
Very tasteful, cozy, spacious apartment; excellent small non-touristy restaurants around the corner; close to river and blue metro station. Definitely hoping to stay there again!
To say that Helena’s place is the best, is an understatement. We had the best time in Lisbon and will definitely be back at Helena’s place.

appartement parfait, très bien situé. Helena est très réactive à nos demandes, c'est très appréciable. Un peu de bruit le soir du côté de lachambre à 2 lits mais sans incidence sur notre séjour. Ascenseur public gratuit à côté de l'appartement qui permet de se rendre très vite à la place du commerce.
Excellent location! Very friendly and responsive host! Would love to come back.
Great location, very nice place. Has everything what you need.

Die Wohnung war wunderschön un der Check In war kontaktlos und seht einfach. Die Wohnung liegt sehr zentral, man kann dur meistens Sachen zu Fuß erreichen.  Die Ausstattung ist auch seht gut, es gibt Info Material über Lissabon und Portugal aber auch Spiele für Kinder. Direkt neben der Wohnung ist ein Lokal, wo man sehr gutes Frühstück gibt, abends kann man dort auch gut etwas trinken. Wir hatten einen sehr schönen Aufenthalt!

One of the best apartments I’ve stayed at. Felt right at home! The place is huge, perfect for a family, entirely renovated and clean. The location is also superb but I already knew that from my last visit in Lisbon. This part of Alfama is perfect as it is right between the old town and the city centre so everything is a walking distance - also, Alfama has the best restaurants. The host was also so nice and responsive, recommending us places to eat and more. Would definitely visit again!

A beautiful appartement. Great decor. Helena gave us useful instructions and recommendations so it was easy to access from the underground. The neighbourhood offers a choice of restaurants and shops nearby. We would happily recommend the place for a long weekend in Lisbon.

So close to many restaurants.
I do agree with other reviews; can be quite noisy
Up until 1am some nites. I also did note an odour from the kitchen sink- again not too bad.
Location excellent, well priced, felt safe, roomy apartment. Host was very accommodating and helpful
Bonito apartamento en una ubicación excelente. La anfitriona es muy amable
Ci siamo fermati due giorni ed è stata un’esperienza molto bella perché nel cuore di Lisbona
Bel appartement dans un des quartiers de Lisbonne à visiter, tout juste à côté de la cathédrale
Tolle, sehr zentrale Lage. Dadurch allerdings nachts auch etwas lauter (aber nicht bis in die Morgenstunden). Die Küche hat etwas gemüffelt. Sonst alles Top und netter Kontakt! Wunderschöne Wohnung.
Appartement magnifique avec beaucoup de cachet et parfaitement situé . Je recommande vivement !!
Excellent séjour , très bien situé et équipe et Helena de très bon conseil
Nice apartment, exactly as described. Can recommend to go there.

A beautiful apartment! comfortable, clean and welcoming. great location near the cathedral and many restaurants/ cafes nearby. Would recommend staying here if you are visiting Lisbon

Really nice apartment. We only stayed one night but had everything we needed. Stunning bathroom and kitchen. Next door to some great bars and restaurants (which can get a little noisy). Soggiorno stupendo
helena molto disponibile ha cercato di soddisfare le nostre richieste al meglio
grazie molte

Helena’s apartment was spacious and clean and we enjoyed our time there. Helena was quick to respond to any queries we had which was very helpful. Our only niggle was that we had a 5 day booking and needed to use the washing machine. There was no washing powder and we were then told if it had run out we needed to purchase our own. It would have been helpful if this had been checked before we arrived. Brief instructions for the windows and appliances would also have been helpful.

Helena's place is really in a great location, right in the old town. We found a public elevator next to it which goes down to the harbor which we very convenient. The place is pretty loud due to restaurants downstairs, thus I suggest to choose if you stay up late, else it could be hard to sleep until the midnight.

The place super cute,it had everything including washer.
Restaurants around and close to everything.
Helena, the host was nice, responsive and very helpful.
We loved our staying, felt like home.
Súper recommended

Helena She is a Super Host .
Very comunicative and always available.
The flat is in a great location , very central .
Helena thought about everything inside from coffee to extra linen and toiletries.
Definitely I’ll would stay here again !
Thank you !

Wunderschöne, sehr geräumige Wohnung in der man sich sofort wohlfühlt mit sehr speziellen Details, die den Aufenthalt zu etwas Besonderem gemacht haben!
Lieben Dank an die Gastgeber, die sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit waren!
Perfekte, sehr zentrale Lage! Danke!!
Great location in the middle of the old city. easy walking to great restaurants.
El apartamento esta genial, la ubicacion es muy buena y la anfitriona fue muy atenta pero tengo que destacar que es extremadamente ruidoso y se hace dificil dormir por las noches.
very nice flat, comfortable with fans in the bedrooms which was very welcome.
Great location next to Si Cathedral. Easy walking distance to all old city attractions.
Great location, great host, fantastic stay, 5/5 would book again!
We had a great time!

Helena made sure our family of four was comfortable. She prepared a sleeping cot for our 9 month old and toys for our 3 year old. The apartment is in a beautiful and ancient part of town in Alfama. Very central and near plenty of restaurants. Due to its location there are many tourists and lively attractions with activity all throughout the night. It is above the ground floor with windows facing the main road which makes it a great location to people watch. If you’re a light sleeper consider a pair of earplugs just in case. We enjoyed the location and the traditional cuisine all around us.

très bel appartement avec beauoup de cachet, spacieux et particulieremn bien situé. idéal pour visiter Lisbonne !
Helena à été particulièrement réactive, un gros plus

Comsigliamo di alloggiare da Helena: l'appartamento è molto elegante e funzionale, anche grazie alla presenza di detersivi e prodotti per l'igiene. Facilissimo da raggiungere con i mezzi ma anche a piedi, si trova in pieno centro di Lisbona, accanto alla Cattedrale, in una zona caratterizzata da molti locali tipici e da piacevole intrattenimento serale (abbiamo potutoascoltareil Fado dalla finestra del soggiorno). Molto comoda la cassetta per le chiavi che consente di non portarsele dietro durante il giorno.

This apartment was better than advertised. it felt so cozy and comfortable. We had a great stay with the VERY nice, communicative, and helpful hosts. The fans in the apartment made it possible to close the windows eliminating the noise from the outside. comfortable beds, a brand new kitchen and bathroom, and many restaurants near by made this a perfect stay! Thanks Helena and Miguel!!

Très bel appartement, au centre de tout! L’appartement est charmant, ce qui nous plonge dans l’ambiance de Lisbonne! Difficile d’ouvrir les fenêtres (très vieilles fenêtres) et comme il n’y a pas d’air climatisé, ça peut être compliqué. La rue est piétonne devant avec des terrasses en saison. Nous avons adoré être au cœur de Lisbonne! Merci!
Hienolla paikalla tyylikäs ja historiaa tulviva  asunto. Siisti, toimiva, kiva tunnelma. Jonkin verran kadun äänet häiritsivät unta mutta se lienee kuuluu siurkaupunkeihin.
Fabulous location! The place is even more beautiful and spacious than in the photos. Thank you!

Logement spacieux, propre avec toutes les commodités. Nombreux restos en bas de l’appartement. On entend le bruit de la clientèle en soirée mais ne nous a pas empêché de dormir. Situé dans le quartier de l’Alfama, près de club de Fado. Généralement en 15 min de marche, on se retrouve au cœur de l’action. Bien situé et j’y retournerais sans hésitation.
Amazing and spacious apartment with everything we needed for a lovely stay in Lisbon! Fantastic location to explore Lisbon especially through our short stay! Highly recommended !
Spending time in your cozy place has made the whole experience even more special. Thank you!

Overall good stay, great location. The key to open the front door needs to be inserted almost all the way (not fully) otherwise it won't open. There was a strong foul smell coming from bathroom - the owner said it was the stones. There is no AC in the bedroooms, but there are small fans. I would recommend bigger fans for the summer. And lastly there was a giant cockroach in the bathroom. There was a pest control device in there also, so it's likely a known problem. Need to fumigate completely. Comfortable living room, good wifi, nice kitchen

Helena’s place was perfect! Easy to find, great space, amazing location - it was perfect for a couples trip to Lisbon. We loved the open family room and the kitchen and bathroom was well maintained and clean. Loved the location - so easy to everything and felt very safe. Would recommend to anyone traveling to Lisbon
Helena’s place is ideally located near Sé! It was beautiful inside and it had everything we needed for our stay.

It was our first visit to Lisbon and we loved it.
The apartment is perfectly located.

Great location in the heart of the old town. Comfortable beds and a very light and bright sitting room.

Would recommend

Great a appartment with two bedrooms and a living room, even a separate kitchen. More amenities when we expected - I believe washing machine wasn’t listed in an ad, but was super handy when traveling with kids.
Location is in an old part of town which gives it unique vibe, but also means a lot of noise at nights.

Place is much prettier than the pictures, and is right across from Se cathedral.  If you come in June it is walking distance to the June feria, but not so close you are in the middle it.  Place is beautifully appointed.  I left something behind and host has been great about working with me to arrange pick up when we come back through in a few weeks.  I would happily stay here again next time I come and highly recommend.

Fantastic location right between shopping streets and the Alfama district. Bit noisy at night but that's to be expected as we stayed during a local holiday. We had everything we needed and everything was super clean. Nicely decorated place as well. 😊 Thank you Helena!
Thank you so much for letting us stay, we had a wonderful time!
Great place, super location, lovely interior! Just as described. Thank you very much!
Wonderful location in Alfalma district across from the Cathedral.  Walkable to many sights and restaurants as well as metro.  We thoroughly enjoyed the stay!

Hermoso departamento, con todas las comodidades y más. La comunicación con Helena fue fluida y estuvo atenta a nuestras necesidades. Tuvimos oportunidad de tener check in flexible, muy agradecidos. Elegiría su departamento para una próxima oportunidad.

Es uno de los air bnb MÁS bonitos en los que he estado, super limpio , confortable y excelente ubicación. Piękne miejsce w samym centrum historycznej Lizbony.  Wszystko co ciekawe w zasięgu krótkiego spaceru. Znakomite miejsce dla turystów nastawionych na poznanie historii i teraźniejszości tego miasta.  Mieszkanie jest wygodne i w harmonijny sposób łączy elementy historyczne  oraz współczesne.

The location of the apartment is perfect if you want to visit the old town area, like us. You can do everything on foot. Beautiful furnished rooms, a lot of attention on details, there were some little touches for our kids. Helena is very responsive and understanding.
Wish to stay longer…
I would highly recommend it.

Logement très agréable, très propre, fonctionnel et spacieux, très bonne literie (dans les 2 chambres). Accès avec une boite à clé sécurisée. On entend quelques bruits de la rue qui est animée, ça ne nous a pas gêné, prévoir des bouchons d'oreilles éventuellement. Nous n'avons pas rencontré Helena, mais elle a été très réactive aux messages, et nous avons bien communiqué. Obrigada, Helena.

This was an amazing stay - extremely convenient, clean and comfortable. Everything we needed and more was available. However overall, I would definitely recommend this place!

Very cool apartment, nicely decorated, renovated and clean. Located near Sé but on a side street without traffic (only for residents) which made it calmer but still with plenty of really good restaurants and bars around.

La casa di Helena è in uno dei quartieri più antichi e affascinanti di Lisbona, Alfama. Dalle finestre si vede la Cattedrale, quartiere pieno di bar e ristoranti. Casa molto pulita ed accogliente, Helena sempre gentile e disponibile, ottimo Host! Ci tornerei sicuramente
Great stay in great location with great host!

My family and I recently had the pleasure of staying at Helen’s Airbnb, and it was a delightful experience. Helen was extremely responsive and accommodating, always promptly answering any questions I had about the listing.
The Airbnb itself was exactly as described in the listing - clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. The location was also very convenient, with easy access to nearby restaurants, shops, and public transportation.
Throughout our stay, Helen was an excellent host, ensuring that we had everything we needed to make our stay as enjoyable as possible. Overall, I highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for a comfortable, convenient, and enjoyable stay in the area.
We loved this apartment, the location was stunning, next to the cathedral and lots of bars and restaurants near by. The apartment was super clean and comfortable and spacious. Perfect for my family.

Amazing beautiful apartment in the middle of Alfama! :) we would totally recommend the place, it’s a beautiful with great charme (mix of vintage and modern decoration) 👌
Helena is extremely friendly and helpful :)
If you want to the Lisbon Alfama experience, book this place!!! :)

Helena's apartment was very good and we enjoyed staying there. It's completely renewed in an high style class with a mixture of old elements (stone and wood) with new design furnitures. The apartment is at the first floor above a couple of restaurants/bar and even there could be some noise due to the people talking in the street till midnight we always slept very well, especially because after that hour the area becomes very, very quiet. The position is also very good, the Cathedral is just a couple of minutes walking so are the first stop of the tram/buses, but also the center itself is very near. The apartment is very well equiped and has everything you need in your staying in Lisbon. Helena is a very good host and reply quickly to all the questions we had. If we will come back to Lisbon  we will consider to stay in the same apartment.
Absolutely amazing host.

Beautiful fully equipped apartment within walking distance of so many historical sites and great access to the metro system if you want to expand your exploration.  Being on a controlled road made it very quiet considering the bustle of the historical area just 100m away.  Would consider booking again.
location was exceptional. Helena was very courteous and helpful. Thank you.

Well located apartment. Excellent communication with the owner. I recommend the restaurant : Casa Tradição, just in the corner of the building. Will come back.
.
Nous avons passé un très bon moment, l'appartement est vraiment sympa et très bien placé.
Parfait ! Très bien équipé, y compris la cuisine avec de nombreux ustensiles et un large plan de travail pour cuisiner.

This is a beautiful apartment in a fantastic location. We walked everywhere in the city, and there was easy public transport to further away sights. Just a few steps to viewpoints, excellent bars and restaurants and fun tram rides. We had a few changes to our plans - our flight times changed significantly, then our daughter fell ill meaning only myself and my son travelled instead of our family of four. It was stressful sorting all that out but Helena's kindness and responsiveness really helped and we especially appreciated her accommodating a late check out. The apartment was spotlessly clean, exceptionally well equiped and a really comfortable place to relax among busy sight seeing.  The wifi was excellent which was really important as we needed to keep in touch with home.  The buzz from the neighbouring restaurants was part of the vibe of being in the centre and quietened down after midnight so we we slept well.  We will return with the rest of the family soon. Thank you Helena!

The apartment exceeds our expectations!!! It is actually better than the pictures on Airbnb. It’s so tidy and clean. It’s very spacious and everything seems new. The heaters work very well. we loved this apartment, so clean and we felt super safe. the host communicated well and we enjoyed our trip to Lisbon immensely because of the great location.
We really did enjoy our stay. Great location. Thanks again Helena!
Beautiful, tasteful apartment in an excellent location. Highly recommend.
Good communication, apartment was easy to find, and we'll located.
L'appartement est très beau et très bien situé. Nous avons passé un très beau séjour à Lisbonne.

Anfitriã carismática, gentil, prestativa, comunicativa e respondeu prontamente aos contatos.
Apartamento fantástico, muito aconchegante, amplo, arejado, tudo conforme o anúncio.
Localização perfeita e excelente, ao lado da Catedral da Sé, próximo de várias atrações turísticas, bares, restaurantes, padareia e supermercado, sendo que muitos percursos podem ser feitos à pé.
