리스본 성당과 가까운곳에 위치하고 있어서 좋았으며 체크인도 쉽고 간편하게 할 수 있어서 너무 좋았습니다.

Helena was very helpful.  We took the metro from the airport and got lost.  She was directing us on how to get to her place and we were still lost.  Imagine being in a city for the first time, looking around and trying to figure out how to get to the airbnb and a car pulls up and you hear your name called (I have my photo on airbnb so she knew what I looked like)!  Helena and her husband very kindly rescued us and drove us to their apartment.  We liked being right next to the Cathedral (convenient to tell Uber drivers where to drop you) and the place was bright and clean.  Would recommend!

Bel appartement lumineux propre et spacieux , chauffage disponible si la température descend. Bien équipé. Hôte réactive et sympathique. Seul bémol qui semble commun à nombres de logement au Portugal, aucune isolation par les fenêtres, il y a donc pas mal de bruit de la rue, avec les restaurantes en dessous, cela ne nous a pas déranger outre mesure mais c’est important de le savoir.
Les petits jeux internationaux sur place ont bien plu aux enfants ! On atteint vite la place de commerce et la station de métro via l’ascenseur ! Bel emplacement ! Nous avons passé un agréable séjour !
It was my second time at Helen’s apartment …everything about Helens place it’s just perfect! It is full of character and it will make your stay at Lisbon even more magical.

Appartamento fantastico in una zona comodissima per spostarsi a Lisbona e visitare tutto il centro. L'appartamento è davvero bello: pulito, con grandi stanze ed un salotto luminoso, ben accessoriato con cucina e bagno moderni. Ci siamo sentiti a casa e lo consiglieremo senza dubbio a tutti.

We had a lovely stay and warmly recommend this apartment. It has a cozy atmosphere and a nice, clean interior. It is located next to a beautiful church in the lively, and charming Alfama area. Thank you Helena.
This place is a great value. Excellent location and beautiful interior.

Helena’s place is fantastic. The apartment is close to transport links (bus, metro and tram) and there are plenty of shops and restaurants nearby. I would definitely recommend this place for anyone looking to visit Lisbon!

Perfect combination of historic charm with modern amenities. Beautiful apartment in general with Exposed stone in parts, and modern touches and finishes. Incredibly convenient location minutes from many of the best parts of Lisbon. Right next to the Lisbon Cathedral. Host was incredibly accommodating for us and our kids. We could not have asked for a better stay! Highly recommend.

Notre séjour chez Héléna a été remarquable tant par sa situation que par la qualité et de l'équipement de l'appartement.

Wir haben Helenas Apartment für einen Stadturlaub mit unseren Kindern gebucht.
Die schön renovierte und gut eingerichtete Wohnung liegt im Hochparterre eines Altbaus. Das innenliegende Duschbad mit großem Waschtisch überrascht mit den freigelegten Bruchsteinwänden.
Wir waren auch begeistert von der Lage: zentral neben der Kathedrale gelegen, vom Flughafen mit der U-Bahn und kurzem Fußweg zu erreichen, nette Gaststätten direkt unter der Wohnung (->Caso Sério) und in nächster Nähe. Straßenbahnhaltestelle der Linie 28 liegt unmittelbar um die Ecke vor der Kathedrale. Am Rande der Alfama gelegen sind es auch nur kurze Wege zum Castelo de S. Jorge, Praça do Comércio oder Praça do Rossio.
Durch die Anwohnerparkregelung liegt die Wohnung sehr ruhig - außer der nächtlichen Müllabfuhr und den am Wochenende bis spät früh in den Morgen durch die Straße laufenden Partygänger.
Und auch wenn wir Helena nicht persönlich getroffen haben, alle Fragen wurden immer schnell und hilfsbereit von Ihr beantwortet.
Wir hatten einen wunderschöner Aufenthalt im Apartment und in Lissabon.

The apartment is in an amazing location, great restaurants within 100m (Esperanca, Tapas with friends, Cruzes Credo) and easy walking distance to Alfama, Terreiro de Paco, the cathedral and most tourist attractions. We mostly walked everywhere or got the tram. Basilio is a great cafe close by for Açaí or pancakes too. Helena was very easy to communicate with, helped by providing a port a cot & high chair for our son & when we had a minor issue come up during our stay was willing to come over to look at fixing it.
Downsides to the apartment to consider are (1) it is located on the ground floor and particularly the main bedroom is right by the entrance to the central staircase for the apartment building, which means you get lots of road noise as people walk past the window plus noise late at night as people come & go from the building. (2) The seals on the windows are poor particularly in the main bedroom so we had a lot of cigarette smoke smell coming into the bedroom mostly late at night. Likely it was flowing down from the restaurants & cafes close by. We are non-smokers and this was a real disappointment for us. The smell was strong enough that we had trouble sleeping at times.
Otherwise in terms of value for money & location the apartment is great & exactly as the photos show.

The apartment itself is as shown in the photos, clean and nicely presented and with loads of utilities. Fabulous flat in the Historic city center of Lisboa ! The flat is Very good (A bit noisy) and Very plaisant tu stay !
Thank you for this trip, obligado !

Hélena n'était pas présente à notre arrivée mais sa maman était là pour nous accueillir. Nous avions un petit mot rédigé par Héléna nous souhaitant la bienvenue ainsi que des bonnes adresses (restaurants, magasins, sites à visiter...)
This was a lovely appartment in an perfect location, and the hosts have been great!
The apartment is really beautiful and decorated with so much good taste ! It is spacious, clean and ideally located !  We couldn't have found a better place to stay in Lisbon !

The apartment is in a terrific area of town, it is right by all the sites and fun neighborhoods. The hosts are kind, reply promptly, and prepared a map with many things to see on our visit.
The visit could be improved if there were places to hang clothes in both rooms, if there were better ventilation in the bedrooms (and in the bathroom as the pipes smelled pretty bad), and one room faces lots of noise and has a mattress that isn't very comfortable. The hosts seemed nice so I imagine they will look into these, and otherwise it's a great place to be to visit the beautiful city of Lisbon!
CHALEUREUX, SEJOUR SUPER

Helena was such a great host, warm hearted and friendly. She gave us a lot of information about the city and stuff to do and visit. The apartment is a perfect place to stay, central located, spacious and very nice renovated. I will recommend it to everybody who wants to visit lisbon! Thank you again Helena!

Helena was at the apartment before we arrived so she could let us in. She then spent almost an hour giving us suggestions of places that we could visit. The neighbourhood is the best in town with bars right underneath the flat and easy walking to the interesting Alfama district.  Also right near to tram 28 , the cathedral and lots of other interesting places.

Die Wohnung ist wirklich ausgesprochen schön eingerichtet, wir sind von jeder Unternehmung sehr gerne dorthin zurückgekehrt und haben so manches mal lieber dort gekocht und gegessen, als auszugehen! Helena war immer für uns ansprechbar, sehr hilfsbereit und hat uns wertvolle Tips gegeben. Die Lage ist perfekt, zwischen Alfama und Baixa, direkt an der Kathedrale, an der man sich von überall orientieren kann. Nachts ist es durch die Restaurants und die engen Straßen recht unruhig, aber das haben wir für die tolle Lage gerne in Kauf genommen. Vielen Dank für die schönen Tage in Lissabon!

Appartement plein de charme dans un quartier très agréable
Hotes très accueillants

Eine tolle Wohnung, wo die moderne und traditionelle Baukunst wunderbar umgesetzt wurde. Von den Fenstern aus schaut man auf die alte Mauer des Kastels. Einmalig. Netter Gastgeber. Die Parkplätze vor dem Haus unter Umständen vorhanden - man muss halt Glück haben. Die Gassen sind sehr eng und man muss schon beim Autofahren geschickt sein. Empfehlenswert.
Alles war prima und sehr herzlich.

Helene and Miguel's place was fabulous! It's impeccably decorated, scrupulously clean, and well situated in Lisbon. It's fun being next to the cathedral. We loved it. They were wonderful hosts and even picked us up at the airport! Thank you! We hope to come back one day.
Die Wohnung ist sehr schön, zentral gelegen und sehr schön renoviert und eingerichtet. Helena war sehr nett und hilfsbereit!

Superbe appartement, immeuble ancien mais intérieur de l'appartement refait à neuf.
Accueil sympathique
Bien situé pour visiter
TV avec le cable

El apartamento es realmente muy lindo, está ubicado muy cerca del centro de Lisboa. Se llega fácilmente caminando en 10 minutos. Helena fue muy amable y atenta, nos ayudó tanto a la llegada como a la salida. Carlota también fue muy amable el día que llegamos, todo estaba limpio y ordenado. Sin duda alguna un excelente lugar para quedarse en Lisboa.

Helena et Miguel sont très accueillants et chaleureux. Le logement est très confortable et très bien situé pour visiter la ville (près de la cathédrale à l'entrée du quartier d'Alfama). Nous le conseillons vivement !

mooie plek in het oude centrum.
hartelijke ontvangst
prachtig appartement voor 4 personen

Our hosts went out of their way to make our stay as comfortable and convenient as possible, giving us a lift from the airport to the apartment. We were given loads of helpful tips about the area and how to get around. The apartment was clean, modern and well equipped; we couldn't ask for any more. The location is perfect and it's easy to walk to most of Lisbon's main attractions. A big thanks to our hosts for everything! We would all definitely recommend this as a place to stay.

Helena is an amazing host and the apartment is just lovely. Beautiful, clean and very comfy beds. Helena was so kind when we got a bit lost! The flat is very close to all the sights - a perfect stay in a perfect flat !

Hôtesse attentionnée qui vous accueille avec le sourire à votre arrivée et vous donne toutes les informations sur le quartier, les moyens de transport ...Appartement très bien situé dans le pittoresque quartier d'Alfama, cosy,très propre et pratique.

Helena and Miguel are great hosts! They were amazing sending us great tips abput the beaches and picking us up from the airport.The apartment is beautiful and very well equipped! Right in the middle of Lisbon!
Nous avons passé un excellent séjour à Lisbonne. Helena était disponible pour répondre à nos questions.

Wonderful hosts and beautiful apartment. We couldn't fault anything, really loved staying there.
The location is perfect, only a five minute walk to the main square and the castle, surrounded by lovely places to eat and next to the cathedral.
Six of us stayed in the apartment plus my baby and there was plenty of space. The apartment is modern with rustic features such as the window shutters and exposed wall, and includes all amenities required.
The hosts were very lovely and helpful.
Thanks so much for a wonderful stay! Xxx

Fue una estancia breve pero muy buena. Helena se portó genial con nosotros, incluso recogió nuestro equipaje para que no cargaramos con el todo el día.

Muchísimas gracias, espero volver!

Ideally situated next to the cathedral, the apartment is beautiful, completely renovated but they kept the original stone walls in some parts. Clean, spacious and very well equiped, it was perfect for our family of 4. Helena and Miguel are very helpful, quick to reply to any queries before and during our stay. A little gem highly recommended ! We will for sure come back. Thanks for everything :-)

Great location downtown! The apartment is a tasteful mix of 100+ year-old brick, stone and wood features with a modern and nicely appointed kitchen and bathroom. The mattresses were very comfortable.
We had a wonderful meal (pizza, pasta and caprese salad) at the pizzeria only twenty meters from the apartment and we could easily walk to a large wine store (two of them across the street from each other), many downtown attractions, and the waterfront.
Miguel and Helena were very pleasant to deal with and allowed us to check in early.
It's the perfect place to call home while you explore downtown Lisbon for a few days. Don't bother renting a car. It was a quick 20-minute taxi ride (less than 10 euros) and a 7.30 euro Uber ride back to the airport. You can walk everywhere else.

Una estancia muy satisfactoria, el piso es súper acogedor, las sabanas las camas, las toallas, la limpieza todo genial.Ademas aclarar que la ubicación es muy buena y se agradece mucho las atenciones para el nene con juguetes y la cuna.
Helena y su esposo con diferencia los mejores anfitriones q hemos podido tener, muchas gracias.
Gente como ellos hacen que esto funcione mucho mejor.

Le logement était très propre, bien situé, parfait pour découvrir la ville. Helena et son mari ont été extrêmement sympathique, ils nous ont notamment donné une carte détaillée de la ville avec des conseils. Ils ont également été disponible par mail avant notre départ afin de répondre à nos questions. Appartement que je conseille absolument!
Merci à Helena :-)

The apartment is great; the style is a beautiful mix between historic and modern luxury. Located next to the Cathedral, only five minutes to the metro and some nice hip restaurants in the street, this apartment has everything you need to spend a nice time in Lisbon. Contact with Helena was always quick and easy, we were welcomed into the apartment by her mother, because Helena was working, but she was herself available for questions on the phone and airbnb and she left us a map with recommendations on where to eat and go. Definetely recommended!

This place was awesome! I was so impressed with Helena, the apartment, and the location. Quite frankly she could charge a lot more! It is a great great value!!! It is really nice and super clean! I give it 5 plus plus stars!

Excellent acuel parfait
Encore merci Helena pour tout
Barbara & Philippe

Great hosts, excellent location, what else could you ask for? Elena and her husband Miguel were there when we arrived, gave us great tips about the area, and were the perfect hosts. The apartment is beautifully decorated yet very comfortable, and the location is really central.

Wir wurden sehr freundlich empfangen, das Appartement entsprach genau den Bildern. Die Lage ist extrem zentral mitten in der Alfama. Hat den Vorteil, mitten im Geschehen zu sein (täglich diverse Lokale mit Fado Live Angebot) aber auch den Nachteil dass erst ab 1 Uhr früh ruhig wird (schalldichte Fenster sind in Lissabon in der Altstadt nicht üblich) Die Zimmer waren sehr sauber, die Küche ausgezeichnet bestückt und die Betten sehr gut.

Super appartement bien placé à recommander++++++
Merci à Helana et miguel pour leur accueil et leurs conseils; des gens très sympatrique .

Miguel and Helena where very helpfull and supportive. The Appartment was very nice and in the middle of the old part of Lissabon.
We like everything and will come again!

Helena a été une hôte parfaite et très souriante, de bons conseils et très disponible!
L'appartement est idéalement situé, proche métro, place du commerce, restaurants et l'alfama, le plus beau quartier de lisbonne pour nous.
Il est bien équipé et rénové avec goût.
Nous recommandons sans hesiter !!

Helena es una super anfitriona!!! tuvimos una demora en la entrega de nuestro equipaje y amablemente se encargó de hacer las llamadas por el reclamo, ya que nuestro portugués es muy básico! Además tuvo la amabilidad de llevarlos a la estación cuando nos iíbamos!
El departamento es tal cual se lo ve en las fotos, luminoso, amplio y con todas las comodidades para una familia de 4. Impecable. La ubicación excelente, frente a la catedral cerca de todo!
Sólo tengo para decirle a Helena MUCHAS GRACIAS la pasamos genial en Lisboa y en gran parte se debe a su hospitalidad!!

What a wonderful host and super apartment!  Helena made us feel very welcome, took time to tell us where to find local restaurants and trams, as well as making great suggestions about how to spend our couple of days in Lisbon which were perfect.  The photographs do not do justice to the apartment - it is delightful and in a great location.  Also Helena keeps it perfectly.  We would definitely have liked to stay longer!  Highly recommended.

Diese Wohnung ist ein Traum. Wir wurden sehr herzlich empfangen und die Wohnung ist sehr liebevoll eingerichtet. Vin dort kann man sehr viel zu Fuß erreichen und die Wohnung ist umgeben von schönen Kneipen und Straßen. Man ist mitten im Geschehen. Helena hat viele hilfreiche Tips hinterlassen und alle um uns herum waren sehr nett.
Ich würde es sofort wieder buchen.

Helena en haar man hebben ons geweldig geholpen in Lisabon.
Na onze verdwaal actie met de huurauto zijn we dankzij Helena veilig Bij haar appartament aangekomen.
Het appartement ziet er mooi,moderne en verzorgt uit.
Bovendien in het centrum van hele mooie gebouwen en andere bezienswaardigheden.
Echt een Top locatie een aanrader voor andere.
Mijn dank is groot aan Helena en haar man.

Lovely apartment in cosy neiborhood with lots of good restaurants nearby.
Helena is very friendly and provided us with several good tips for places to eat and places of interest
When I return to Lisbon , I would like to stay in Helena's apartment again !

Accueil parfait d'Helena qui nous a attendu près de 2 heures suite à un retard de notre avion!!
L'appartement est au pied de l'Alfama et est très bien équipé (vous y trouverez à peu près tout). Il y a quelques restaurants et bars avec terrasse.
Seul petit point noir : pour les couches-tôt, il y a un peu de bruit jusqu'à la fermeture des terrasses!!
Très content de cette appartement :oD

Appartement correspondant tout à fait à nos attentes, plein de charme alliant modernisme et ancienneté avec bon goût, calme, très bien équipé et super bien placé à côté de la cathédrale, proche de la Praxa de comercio d'où partent beaucoup de transports en commun. Helena s'est organisée pour nous accueillir malgré un horaire en dehors de la plage prévue. Accueil chaleureux, avec des tuyaux pour la découverte de la ville, des restaurants et des sorties. Aide pour la réservation d'un taxi pour aller à l'aéroport. Adresse à recommander sans hésitation.

Helena was a wonderful hostess.. When we arrived at the appartment she welcomed us with open arms and lots off information about what we should see and where to eat!! Next to that the appartment was lovely, spacious and in a nice neighbourhood.. I fell in love with the bathroom the second I saw it! Without a doubt THE best place to stay in Lisboa.. :)

I had the lucky opportunity to meet both Miguel and Helena during my stay and they were amazing. They were so responsive and always kept in contact, Helena came to the rescue when I locked myself out of the apartment with my luggage still inside on check-out! The apartment is comfortable and spotless clean. No complaints at all! The listing is in a great spot and a really lovely area to walk around in. Couldn't recommend it more :)

Cet appartement était parfait ! Grand, décoré avec goût, bien situé, propre, lits et couettes très confortables.
Propriétaire très sympa à l'arrivée et de bons conseils.
À recommander !

Helena was waiting for us in the appartment.After a warm welcome
she showed us around the flat and explained.
A nice, clean appartment, a wellequipped kitchen etc. Everything
as you require it for a pleasant stay !
The Luminoso appt. is right in the center of Alfama, one of the old
quarters of Lisboa. Food, drink and culture, all in walking distance.
Helena is a wonderful host, and the apartment is beautiful (both location and interior). Would definitely go there again!

Schöne kleine Wohnung, für uns perfekt gelegen am Rande der Altstadt von Lissabon. Mehrere Cafés, Restaurants, Einkaufsmöglichkeiten sowie touristisch interessante Ziele (z.B die Straßenbahnlinie 28 und die Kirche Sé Patriarcal sind in der unmittelbaren Umgebung.
Helena und Miguel waren sehr nette und hilfsbereite Gastgeber. Wir kommen gerne wieder :)

Helena et Miguel sont très accueillant et ont pris le temps de nous donner quelques tuyaux pour mieux profiter de notre voyage.
L'appartement est superbe (bien placé, grand, et entièrement rénové).
Nous avons passé un très agréable weekend à Lisbonne :)

Hola Helena. Han sido unos días fabulosos. La casa estaba en el barrio mas bonito y vivo de Lisboa. Al lado mismo de la catedral, en Alfama. Con la parada del tranvía 28 a cinco metros y cerca del castilo, miradores, la plaza de Comercio, Baixa. Impresionante. Un pio acogedor y xon todo lo necesqrio para pasar unos días inolvidables. Excelente calidad precio. Lo recomendaré a quien quiera ir a Lisboa. Gracias por todo Helena y lástima no habernos conocido.

J'ai passé un super séjour à Lisbonne avec des copines. L'appart est spacieux, propre et accueillant. Il est situé au centre ville, à côté de la Sé et de pleins de magasins et restaurants ce qui nous à permis de visiter presque toute la ville sans à peine prendre de transport publique.
Malgré ne pas avoir rencontré Helena, elle s'est toujours montré très aimable et accueillante par message et elle nous à donné plein de petits conseils pour notre séjour.
Seul un petit point négatif: comme il s'agit d'un immeuble ancien, comme l'appart est à l'entre sol on entend un peu le bruit de la rue.
Vraiment super!!!
We had a lovely stay in Helenas flat which is right in the city centre and really nice, super clean and spacious. Moreover Helena was there for us for any questions and concerns!

The apartment is beautiful. It is well located and spotlessly clean. Helena was there when I arrived and she is charming and helpful. There is everything there that you require and I would love to return some day.

Great central location, lovely flat, photos do not do it justice.  Fado sounds waft up from the bar below during the early evening.  Provided all acessories for our baby including high chair, cot and nice extra touches including sound and music projector and cot mobile.

Great hosts, very nice people!
Location of the flat is great - just in the middle of old town Alfama. 2 minutes walking distance to lovely cafes and fado restaurants and shops. 10 minutes walking distance to the square and the coast as well as subway.
Inside the flat the decoration is both authentic and modern. Definetely recommended!
公寓地理位置佳，紧邻教堂，离河也很近。非常干净整洁，床单被单非常舒适。

Helena was such an amazing host, very helpful with directions and attractions around Lisboa, such as giving good recommendations for restaurants as well as different places to check out. Would definitely go back to visit and stay in the apartment as it was spacious and lovely! Hot water was scarce, and windows thin, but the location was amazing and heaters were provided to keep indoors relatively warm. Definitely our favorite place we've stayed at so far!

Février 2016, très beau voyage d'une semaine à Lisbonne. Appartement très propre, spacieux ( mieux que sur les photos) et excellement bien situé dans Lisbonne en plein quartier d'Alfama et à deux pas de Baixa ( 5 mn à pied) On peut visiter la majeure partie de Lisbonne à pied depuis l'appartement.
Helena est une hôtesse hors pair, prête à rendre service( elle nous a elle même cherché et acheté des billets pour une match de foot).
Bar / restaurant en dessous de l'appartement qui peut être bruyant ( musique le soir) mais sans se prolonger tard dans la nuit.
Je recommande vivement cet appartement.

La casa de Helena y Miguel nos encantó a mis 5 amigas y a mí. La casa se ajusta perfectamente a las fotos y podríamos decir que es incluso mejor. Siendo seis personas la encontramos espaciosa y agradable. La cocina y el baño tienen todos los utensilios y aparatos que uno podría necesitar. El barrio es genial en varios aspectos: no necesitas apenas usar transporte para ir de un lado a otro porque todo está relativamente cerca (Alfama a un lado y Barrio alto al otro), hay varios restaurantes y cafés donde se come barato y bien (además helena nos recomendó lugares donde comer), y la zona en sí es muy bonita (y no es tan turística como barrio alto por ejemplo).
Por otro lado, Helena y Miguel fueron unos anfitriones maravillosos. Nos dejaron mapas y señalaron los lugares de interés el primer día, además de ser muy flexibles con las horas de llegada y salida del apartamento.
En caso de volver a lisboa, no dudaría en volver a escoger este apartamento.
Accoglienza meravigliosa da una bella famiglia. L'appartamento è più bello delle foto pubblicate. Eccellente la pulizia e ottima la posizione della casa nella città. Ritornerei ben volentieri.
The location is perfect. We really enjoyed our stay here. Helena is a very warm hearted.

Héléna est une personne très agréable, gentille, à l'écoute et au service pour tout. L'appartement est neuf, avec un coté rustique et contemporain et très propre. Il est aussi très bien situé à 5 min du métro. Très pratique pour pouvoir ce déplacer facilement dans Lisbonne. Appartement fortement conseiller pour séjourné à Lisbonne.

Helena and her husband were amaizing hosts. Flat was very clean, absolutly looks like on the pictures. Windows are located on the street, so sometimes my friend could not sleep because of the voices from the street and passing cars. But it was only few times. Because the street is not the most lively.
And once hot water at the shower was over. But maybe it happens at all city, maybe only Russians got used to stand in the shower without time limit :) We had to wait 30 minutes or an hour, until it warms up again.
Perhaps this is just my troubles, and for the others it will not be important. Overall, I really liked the apartment.
The hosts was so hospitable that even helped with the delivery of our luggage at the airport, as our flight was in the evening and had to leave in the afternoon.
Nice modern apartment in an interesting part of town. It was very spacious and clean, would recommend.

Nuestra estancia ha sido maravillosa. El apartamento es precioso, mejor que en las fotos y la ubicación es magnífica. Muy recomendable. Si volvemos a Lisboa sin duda intentaremos reservar aquí otra vez.

Beautiful apartment! We met Miguel who was helpful in helping us unload all our things, finding us a place to park, recommend places to eat and things to do. Also, they made sure we had everything we needed for our baby. The apartment has recently been renovated with modern conveniences. Very charming place to stay. Keep in mind it's conveniently located in the old town so street parking is limited, but you should be able to find a garage to leave your car. We parked and we were able to walk everywhere or use public transportation.
Very nice location, beautiful apartment, very helpful host! Thank you

Magnífico apartamento. En edificio antiguo pero totalmente reformado con exquisito gusto por parte de los propietarios.No le falta  detalle para sentirse muy a gusto. La zona es de las mejores de Lisboa para hacer turismo y pasar unos dias innovidables. La informacion que aparece en la pagina web es real y adecuada. Helena muy amable y atenta. Nos hizo sentir como en casa con un detalle de bienvenida que nos cautivó. Lo recomendamos sin duda. Repetiremos muy pronto.

I met Helena in the apartment, coming from the airport. she was very nice, and welcoming. The apartment was just perfect, no question about it. well lit, and comfortable.

Great location. Absolutely recommended.
Bel appartement. Situation idéale. Helena prend soin de ses "invités". C'était parfait !

Helena y Miguel son geniales, teníamos un horario de llegada y salida un poco complicado y nos facilitaron muchísimo la vida. Se preocuparon desde el primer momento de nuestra llegada y estuvieron muy atentos explicando nos los mejores sitios para cenar y comer.
El apartamento es muy grande y es exactamente igual a como lo veis en las fotos, muy nuevo, muy cómodo y espacioso, ademas de estar decorado con mucho gusto.
El barrio es perfecto, puedes tocar la pared de la catedral sin salir de casa :-) , tienes un montón de opciones de comida en los alrededores, ademas de ser uno de los barrios mas bonitos de Lisboa.


Como ya comentan en el anuncio, hay que ir un poco con cuidado si te pasas poniendo aparatos eléctricos de consumo (la calefacción o el horno).

Una apuesta segura

Helena and her husband were wonderful hosts! Their apartment was impeccable, perfectly situated and beautifully furnished- clean and recently renovated but its rustic charm still intact. Everything was perfect--absolutely recommend!!!

La mejor opción para hospedarte en Lisboa. El apartamento está situado a los pies de la Catedral da Sé con restaurantes y bares cerca, pero nada ruidosos. Muy cerca de todo y muy bien conectado!
Es exactamente como en las fotos, genial y precioso. Decorado con mucho gusto y muy cómodo. Tiene todas las necesidades para poder disfrutar de unas vacaciones geniales.
Helena es la anfitriona perfecta. Muy simpática y agradable. Nos hizo una guía para visitar Lisboa y nos dio información de la ciudad. Incluso nos acompañó a dejar el coche en un parking cercano. Para el check in y check out es muy flexible!!!
100% recomendable!!!!!!
Un saludo Helena!

After reading all the comment mentioning how Alfama neighbourhood is very hilly, I was afraid I would be very tired getting out and getting back to this apartment. Although this is true, it was really not that bad, especially if you do explore all the close neighborhoods (and don't stay only in Alfama)
I was pleasantly surprised to have a digital key for both the building door and the apartment.
The linens smelled really good throughout the week.
Overall very nice fully furnished small apartment with a beautiful view from the windows.
Only thing is I wish the shower could have been higher than it was.
Thank you!

Logement situé au cœur du quartier D’alfama. Beaucoup des lieux touristiques sont accessibles à pieds.
Logement fidèle à la description.
Clim réversible

Everything in the Appartment was great. we were a family of three and our 1-year old slept in a crib that the host provided.
We totally recommend to stay in the area and will definitely come back again.
Be mindful that the third floor with narrow stairs was for us part of the experience of living in the old town. we deliberately wanted to avoid sterilozed hotel environment and stayed very satisfied 🙂

Bel emplacement, hôtes très réactif et disponibles.
L'appartement était propre et bien entretenu.
Nous entendons un peu nos voisins, mais nous comprenons que c'est un vieux bâtiments ce qui fait son charme !

Die Wohnung ist sehr schön gelegen und hat eine wunderbare Aussicht. Sie ist gepflegt und mit allem, was es braucht, ausgestattet. Die Kommunikation mit Hugo war sehr unkompliziert und freundlich. Besonders die Möglichkeit, das Gepäck bei der Ankunft bereits früher in die Wohnung zu stellen, war toll. Rundum weiterzuempfehlen!

Apartment with a beautiful view of the Tagus in the upper part of the quaint Alfama neighborhood.
But:
- the access staircase is narrow and vertical, not suitable for heavy luggage;
- the bedroom is cramped, with the double bed pushed against one wall, making access awkward for those sleeping on that side;
- there is no dishwasher.
In our particular case, we found a large, unpleasant stain of black liquid on the stovetop (caused, according to the host, by a liquid leak on some rust) and a kitchen door, the one covering the trash can, was torn off due to a broken hinge. This made our initial impression on the apartment less pleasant.
The hosts were responsive and responded to our concerns.
Really nice small functional apartment, in a great location! Hosts were very helpful and responsive. Would definitely recommend!

We stayed at Huge & Silvia's place for two nights. The accommodation was well appointed and and well located with a lovely view from the balcony. Hugo was easy to communicate with and super responsive to our requests. Highly recommend!
Very nice flat in charming old parts of Lisbon, and very helful hosts. Can highly recommend.

L'appartamento si trova in una posizione ottima, centrale ma silenzioso. Corrispondeva perfettamente alle foto, e la pulizia dei locali, delle lenzuola, degli asciugamani e di tutto il resto era impeccabile. C'era proprio un buon odore entrando in casa! Doccia grande e bagno comodo.
Abbiamo apprezzato molto il piccolo balconcino che permetteva la vista sul fiume Tago.
La cucina era fornita di tutto, molto funzionale.
Le scale all'entrata erano un po' ripide, ma sono quelle tipicamente lisbonesi.
Gli host sono stati sempre reattivi, non abbiamo avuto bisogno di nulla ma sapevamo di poter contare su di loro. Le indicazioni per il check-in sono state chiarissime. Se dovessi ritornare a Lisbona, sceglierei nuovamente questo appartamento, mi sono trovata davvero bene!
The view was beautiful and it felt like being home,the apartment had everything we needed, Hugo was very helpful and kind... I would definitely recommend! Nice bars and music close to the house 🎶

Wir haben uns sehr wohl in der Unterkunft gefühlt.
Die Lage ist perfekt um direkt loszugehen und die Stadt zu erkunden.
Die Wohnung war sehr sauber und hatte alles was man so benötigt.
Hugo war auch sehr hilfreich und hat uns vorab einen Transfer vom Flughafen zum Apartment organisiert.
Der einzige Minuspunkt was das Schlafsofa im Wohnzimmer. Dies war viel zu kurz und super unbequem und eigentlich nicht als Schlafsofa geeignet.
Wer nicht vorhat dies zu benutzen, dem können wir die Unterkunft zu 100% weiterempfehlen.

As the pictures outline, lovely space with clear instructions on how to get to the apartment. Clean, tidy - great view from the balcony. The only thing to flag is the steps a steep, but that is entirely expected given this is an old apartment in the old town.

Joli deux pièces dans un quartier parfait pour découvrir Lisbonne
Il n’est pas accessible en taxi , la rue est du coup très calme mais non éclairée la nuit
L’immeuble est plein de logements de air b n b ce qui peut être parfois bruyant
L’ouverture de la porte d’entrée se fait uniquement via le téléphone portable , ce qui permet une arrivée autonome mais nécessite une bonne connexion Internet
Une alternative avec une vraie clé au trait été bienvenue
L’hôte que je n’ai jamais vu a toujours été réactif à mes demandes par mail

O apartamento do Hugo é perfeito. Fica perto de tudo, é possível fazer tudo andando. Além de ser muito espaçoso e confortável. Passei 4 dias com minha esposa e nos sentimos em casa.
Acima de tudo o Hugo é extremamente proativo e simpático. Ele nos ajudou no dia da volta nos chamando um táxi para nos buscar à porta pois sairíamos extremamente cedo.
Tudo impecável, com certeza voltaremos.
Amazing flat and very responsive hosts. Thank you so much!
Nice stay!

Hugo and Silvia’s place was spotless, bright, and ideally located within walking distance of all the major attractions and Tram 28. It had everything we needed for a comfortable and relaxing stay. Situated in Alfama—the oldest and most peaceful part of the city—the apartment offered a lovely river view. They were very responsive and shared many helpful tips, and their instructions were clear and accurate. We immediately felt at home and loved waking up to the morning sun. We had a wonderful time in Lisbon and were pleasantly surprised to find so many great vegan restaurants nearby. Highly recommended!

Great location, minutes from tram station and short walk to historic monuments.
Spotlessly clean and very comfortable bed.
Communication was great, always prompt and very helpful.

I had a fantastic stay at this lovely apartment! The place was clean and had all the amenities I needed for a comfortable visit. The highlight was definitely the beautiful view of the river.
The hosts were incredibly friendly and made me feel welcome. They were always available to answer any questions and shared some great local tips. I highly recommend this apartment for anyone looking for a relaxing getaway!
Nice, cozy and clean apartment with a beautiful view. The street is super quiet. Great choice!
Had a great time. Location was only a 13 minute Walk to the Metro. Room was quiet and the AC worked great.
Very nice accommodations, our host was very helpful!

This Airbnb was amazing! We had trouble finding it but that was to be expected after such a long travel day and being in a new place. Hugo was super quick to respond and help us navigate. The apartment was very clean (you could smell the bedding!) and in a great location. The neighborhood it is located in became my favorite area because it was so peaceful to come back to after a long day. The view from the balcony was picture perfect, we spent a lot of time just sitting and looking at it. The only downside is that it is up a steep flight of stairs so was tricky to get up with our bags but not too bad. We would definitely stay here again!
Great place! Looks just like the photos, & in a great location! Tons of bars, restaurants and little tourists shops in the neighborhood all within walking distance. Would definitely stay here again!

Had such a lovely stay at Hugo's. He was really responsive and especially helped out when I was checking out. I had a flight at an unearthly time, and Huge booked a taxi for me. Unfortunately, private cars cannot enter the street, where the house is located - but apparently taxis can. Really appreciate the additional help.
The home also is very well located in Alfama, just a hop skip and jump from cafes, restaurants etc. Lovely house that felt safe, especially for a solo traveler. Thank you once again
Great place, clean and in a nice location

A fabulous place in the oldest neighbourhood in Lisbon! This had everything you needed to enjoy Lisbon! Hosts were excellent and good communication!
Would definitely recommend this place!

Thank you for sharing your beautiful space with us. It was very comfortable and clean. We had the best time in Lisbon and loved the area! Lots of walking and exploring! The view was amazing! Best location in Alfama.
Our stay was a pleasant one.  The location is great and the place was comfortable and welcoming.  Hugo is very responsive and informative.

Der Aufenthalt war rundum perfekt! Die Unterkunft war sauber, gemütlich und genau wie beschrieben. Die Gastgeberin war sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit – der Check-in verlief völlig problemlos. Ich würde jederzeit wiederkommen. Absolute Empfehlung!
Comfortable stay! Would recommend!
Great location. Easy access by walking. Responsive host. Room as in pictures. Clean.
알파마 한가운데 있어 언덕에 숙소가 있어요. 주변에 맛난 빵집과 좋은 레스토랑도 많고 분위기 좋아요, 관광객들이 많이 돌아다니는 골목이라 위험한 느낌도 별로 없습니다. 대신 방으로 올라가는 가파른 계단은 좀 조심하셔야 해요 ㅎㅎ
Great stay at Hugo & Silvia’s - definitely recommend for anyone’s stay in Lisbon!

L’appartement était impeccable, bien équipé et parfaitement conforme à la description. Le quartier est calme, même si l’isolation de l’immeuble pourrait être meilleure. Cela reste toutefois un détail lorsqu’on en est conscient. La literie est confortable et l’appartement très fonctionnel. Le centre est facilement accessible à pied, et il est également simple de se faire déposer par un Uber à proximité du logement.
Notre séjour a été parfait et nous n’hésiterons pas à revenir lors d’un prochain passage à Lisbonne.
We enjoyed our stay at Hugo & Silvia’s place! The place has beautiful views of Alfama and was in a great spot. Was a nice place to relax after a day spent exploring the city.

It was a lovely spot for our visit to Lisbon. The apartment was well located to explore the Alfama district and visit local restaurants. The apartment is located on the 3rd floor (with a lovely view from the windows) but the first set of stairs are quite step - we had no issues but worth mentioning. Hugo and Silvia were friendly, helpful and responsive, and had the sofa bed set up upon arrival which was appreciated. Would recommend this apartment to friends and family travelling to Lisbon.
We had a great time here. The street was quiet and peaceful with such a nice view of the water. The apartment was very comfortable and clean!

Appartement moderne de qualité, très propre et confortable. Il est situé dans une rue calme et permet d'accéder rapidement à un ensemble de restaurants et de bars animés. Nous avons beaucoup aimé, je recommande vivement.

Hugo and Silvia’s flat was beyond expectations, spotless and even cuter than the photos. View was beautiful, and as a Vegan, only 2-5 minute walk to Vegan tapas and restaurants.  Hugo responded immediately to all questions. Location in Alfama was perfect and very safe. Wonderful stay

Perfect little place to explore Alfama and center of Lisbon. The apartment is quiet and functional, you have everything you need in the kitchen etc.
Only thing to notice is that the stairs to the place are VERY steep, would not recommend it if you have a large suitcase and/or have a challenge with back or lifting heavy.
Très beau séjour à Lisbonne. Le logement était propre et confortable. L’accès à l’appartement était simple et pratique. Rien à redire, tout s’est très bien passé !

The location is incredible, in the heart of Alfama, near a great coffee and pastry shop (Alfama Dolce) around plenty of Fado restaurants. The view is awesome from the flat, giving access to the landscape of the city and the River. We will strongly recommend to friends, and anyone willing to relax in Lisbon.

Soon after we arrive, we realised why the place received so many good reviews and was highly rated by the British tourists. The location was great, the nearby restaurant was amazing and staff there were super kind and helpful. We couldn't fault the actual apartment, it was everything it was described (and more) on the website. The only struggle we had was the 3 flights of stairs to our allocated apartment. A small price to pay if you got the river view, staring at 2 huge cruise liners was awesome.
We had to call Hugo so many times as we weren’t sure how to work out the keypad to open both street door and inner door. thanks for being so patient with us, Hugo.
I would go back to this place and recommendvit to friends and family. It had a certain ambience / warm and inviting character to it.

Amazing location and even better view! Hugo and Silvia are extremely kind and informative and their space is comfortable and clean. I will certainly book again if I’m ever in Lisbon again! I absolutely loved my stay here.

Hugo and Silvia's place is so charming with a gorgeous view of the river and red tiled roof tops of Alfama.  The space is airy and bright, AC works well.  On a very quiet traffic restricted street but within easy walking distance to cafes, restaurants, and everything you need in the atmospheric neighbourhood of Alfama. A wonderful location!  Hugo and Silvia were responsive in their communication.
The accommodation was in an excellent location with a beautiful view. It was very clean and we had a very comfortable stay. Would definitely recommend!

We liked our stay at this lovely apartment, tucked away in the heart of Lisbon’s historic Alfama neighborhood. The location is ideal — full of character, and within walking distance to many of the city’s major attractions, including viewpoints, cafes, and the iconic tram lines.
The apartment itself is clean, well equipped, and very cute — a perfect blend of comfort and local charm. One of the highlights was the spectacular view from the window — waking up to those classic Lisbon rooftops and narrow cobbled streets was unforgettable.
A quick tip for future guests: the house isn’t accessible by car, and parking nearby is very limited. We recommend arriving by Uber or taxi and traveling light if possible.
Overall, a fantastic stay in one of the most authentic parts of Lisbon — highly recommended!
This was the perfect stay in Lisbon - beautiful view, peaceful, and pristine. We could not have asked for anything more. Hugo and Sylvia were so responsive and friendly. Highly recommend!
Lovely flat in a vibrant place amongst a mass of tiny cobbled streets with good restaurants and bars

Wir hatten drei wirklich tolle Tage in Hugos Wohnung bzw. in Lissabon.
Die Wohnung selber ist in dem super belebten Altstadtviertel Alfama. Man kann super zu Fuß die ganze Stadt erkunden und ist abends sehr schnell an lokaler Gastronomie. Hier möchte ich im besonderen auf die Santa Pausa hinweisen, eine Bar in der man auch super was kleines essen kann und wo wir den besten Sangria jemals genießen konnten. Die Bar ist nur gut 30 Meter von der Wohnung entfernt. Dies nur als kurzer Hinweis.
Was noch erwähnenswert ist, dass die Wohnung super hellhörig ist. Wir waren zu eine rezitiert da, in der gefühlt das gesamte Viertel gefeiert hat und die Lautstärke sowohl innerhalb des Hauses als auch außerhalb dringt stark nach innen. Untern Strich möchte ich aber dafür keinen Stern abziehen, da es sich hier um ältere Bauten handelt und man sich mitten im Stadtkern befindet. Man sollte das nur vorher wissen, dass es lauter werden kann.

Everything was great, but we were disturbed by noise from the upstairs neighbors that started around 9:00 in the morning and woke us up. The apartment is on the third floor, and carrying suitcases up and down was a bit difficult. Despite everything, it was a good accommodation experience.

The perfect spot in the heart of Alfama! With the beautiful view and quiet neighborhood it was also central to so
Much!

Hugo and Silvia’s home in Alfama was perfect for our trip! The interior and amenities matched the description and they were extremely responsive and helpful hosts with clear instructions and helped us book taxis when needed. Alfama is the perfect neighborhood to immerse yourself in the city, just be warned there are tons of hills! We had no issues with our stay whatsoever, I’d easily recommend Hugo and Silvia’s home.
Had a great week in Lisbon, local surroundings, very friendly host. Worth a stay for sure!

Amazing place in the heart of the Alfama neighborhood. Perfectly located to walk into center city but definitely quiet and in a cute neighborhood away from the crowds. The place was super clean and nice. Hugo was very responsive.
Would 100% stay here again! Ps. Check out Fora Bakery right around the corner - we went every morning!
We had a great stay. place is just as described. we would Come back ! 5 stars !
Thanks for the great stay!

The place was very cute and had everything we needed, right in the heart of Alfama. The hills and stairs gave us a workout, though!! The host was very responsive any time we needed anything, and even met us at check in to make sure we got inside okay & carried our suitcase up the 3 flights of stairs! I would definitely recommend staying here.
Thank you for hospitality. Can’t stress enough how helpful Hugo was to arrange our ride to the airport.

Grossartige Unterkunft!
Sauber, gut ausgestattet, schöner Blick über die Dächer bis zum Tejo.
We loved the location and the apartment itself was very clean and well appointed

We had a great stay. Nice apartment with good view. Very clean and hosts easy to communicate with. This area is very hilly, with small uneven sidewalks. We walked with our rolling suitcases from the metro and it was a lot of work; we regret not taking a taxi closer to the apartment.
Would recommend.

Wir hatten perfekte Tage in Lissabon. Die Unterkunft war prima, wir können sie jedem empfehlen, der ein paar Tage in dieser schönen Stadt verbringen möchte. Lediglich die schmale, steile Treppe ist mit großem Koffer eine kleine Herausforderung. Aber auch diese ist zu meistern. Vielen Dank Für die tolle Zeit und die hervorragende Kommunikation.

o apartamento esta muito bem localizado, fizemos muitas coisas caminhando. Estava tudo muito limpo e organizado. A internet funciona muito bem e o proprietário foi super solicito.
A vista era um show a parte, fantástico!!! O acesso ao apartamento e feito por escadas, mas é típico dos prédios da região. Recomendo!
We really enjoyed Hugo and Silvia’s place! The river view from the windows was amazing, and the location was perfect for us to fully experience Alfama.
The place was amazing and well located. Hugo made sure that we had a nice stay and was very responsive. Will definitely stay there again!!

The host was always in touch and provided all the instructions clearly and regularly.
The house was spotless and very cute, with a lovely view. The bathroom and kitchen were very clean as well.
This is definitely not a reason to give a low rating or not to stay here again, but I’d like to share a couple of small improvement points:
There’s no holder for the showerhead in the bathroom, so you need to hold it in your hand while showering. Also, there’s no small shelf or similar space inside the shower to place your items.
Additionally, the power outlet under the window in the living room wasn’t working.
If these things are improved, the place would be absolutely perfect!

The apartment offers a mesmerizing view of the river, and we’ve thoroughly enjoyed our stay here. It was clean, and the host was very responsive, providing clear instructions for the check-in process. The only downside is that the apartment is on the third floor with no elevator (which is typical for the neighborhood), and it's situated in a hilly area that may be difficult to walk for some people.

The apartment was spacious for two and very clean. We we’re greeted by Hugo as we arrived who told us the basics about the apartment and gave some tips about the neighbourhood. It’s very close to most of the great sights in Lisbon and close to public traffic tacking you anywhere.
All in all we had a lovely time and would stay here again.

Un endroit juste parfait, vue sur la mer, dans un quartier magique à mes yeux avec tout ce qu’il faut aux alentours pour connaître Lisbonne. J’ai passé un séjour magique, et me suis sentie comme chez moi. Malgré un souci par ma faute dès le premier soir j’ai pu compter sur l’aide de Hugo qui a été réactif. ☺️🙏

Apartments was located in a lovely neighborhood in Lisbon. It felt like you were local to the area with access to cute shops and restaurants in walking distance, including the famous Tram 28. Hugo was incredible responsive and very welcoming, he even gave us a tour of the apartment and gave us recommendations for Lisbon. Furthermore, the view from the 3rd floor was incredible over the water and old city with many famous landmarks in viewing distance. Can definitely recommend especially for the price.

Ottimo alloggio in Alfama nel cuore di Lisbona, vicino a molte attrazioni principali e ben collegato con i mezzi pubblici, fermata del tram 28 a due minuti a piedi. Molto pulito e in ordine e con anche una bella vista sul fiume Tago. Occhio alle scale un pò ripide, ma da quanto ho capito sono cosi in parecchie case della zona e quello che mi è dispiciuto è stata la mancanza del soffione della doccia, ci si lava comunque bene con il doccino, ma in una cabina doccia così bella e spaziosa è davvero un peccato non avere un soffione all'altezza del posto. In ogni caso consiglio vivamente questo posto se venite in visita a Lisbona.

Ich hatte einen tollen Aufenthalt in der Wohnung von Hugo und Silvia. Die Wohnung war sauber und entsprach den Bildern. Die Küche war gut ausgestattet und das Bett sehr bequem. Leider ist die Wohnung sehr ringhörig sodass man die anderen Gäste deutlich hören kann. Zudem befindet sich die Wohnung im 3. Stock mit extrem steilen Treppen, was eine kleine Herausforderung war mit dem schweren Koffer. Trotzdem war mein Aufenthalt toll und ich würde die Wohnung jederzeit weiterempfehlen für einen Aufenthalt in Lissabon!

Charmant appartement, très propre, avec tout le nécessaire.
Très chouette vue depuis le balcon.
Très bien localisé, quartier sympa, avec bons restaurants, petites épiceries proches, et à faible distance de marche de principaux sites touristiques ou des transports en commun.
Communication et accès simples.
Un bémol sur l’insonorisation (on entend beaucoup les voisins du dessus et dans le couloir).
Nous recommandons !

Loved staying at Hugo and Silvia’s! We didn’t need any flexibility with the check-in as we arrived later. Even getting in well after dark it was easy to find, with shops, restaurants, sites and transportation within steps. The bed was great! I usually don’t sleep good the first night on a new bed, and I was out all night! Everything with our stay was amazing!! Highly recommend if you’re visiting Lisbon!!

A cute and cozy place right at the heart of Alfama. Its very walkable to all the important tourist destinations. Its on the third floor with some steep stairs and narrow staircases so I would recommend a back pack but the view makes it totally worth it :)

L’appartement était propre, joliment décoré, et la vue est très belle. Le quartier est animé avec de très bons restaurants, tout est accessible à pieds tant qu’on est prêt à grimper quelques escaliers.
L’immeuble n’est pas très bien insonorisé mais les locataires font attention à ne pas faire trop de bruit donc nous n’avons pas eu de problème. Hugo était très réactif par message, je recommande!

Hugo and Silvia’s place is cosy and welcoming. The flat was pristine clean, comfortable and functional. It is located in a beautiful neighborhood where you can walk around and get lost in the amazing tiny streets of Lisbon. Only 25 mins walking from Plaza del Comercio and 10 mins from Castelo de Sao Jorge. The building stairs are quite high and challenging for people with reduced mobility but we had no issues. There’s plenty of mini markets around to get essentials since the flat didn’t provide toiletries nor food/beverages but the mini market has everything you need to.
L’appartement est idéalement situé pour visiter Lisbonne avec de bonnes adresses aux alentours. Proche de transports en communs

This Airbnb was perfect for my friend and mine’s short weekend trip to Lisbon. As it was both of our first times, Alfama was a quiet neighborhood which was nice, and we were within walking distance of many nice restaurants and small shops. Hugo was a great host, and very responsive to any questions we had. Would recommend this stay to anyone looking at a nice Airbnb in Lisbon!

Jag tyckte mycket om boendet. vacker utsikt, fint område. Tyst och lugnt.
Trappan upp till lägenheten var väldigt smal och brant men det hade de talat om när jag bokade.
Det ända negativa var bäddsoffan i vardagsrummet, den var knölig och obekväm. Lätt att åtgärda.
Jag kan rekommendera detta boende och värdarna.
Had a good stay.  The place is walkable to some of the attractions in Lisbon. Would recommend it.

Alfama is a lovely neighborhood. Walkable (only residential cars are allowed in), lots of restaurants and historical places to visit. The apt was beautiful, clean, spacious and comfortable (very well equipped). Lots of sunshine with great views of the city. I worked remotely a couple of days and the wifi worked perfectly (even for video calls). Also, I visited during the winter and the heat kept the apt warm and cozy. Lastly, I would note that it's a 3 floor walk-up and some of the steps are steep, but it wasn't a problem for me.
Hugo and Silvia were very friendly and responsive at all times. They kindly offered flexibility checking in since my flight was delayed, and even helped coordinating last-minute transportation from the airport.
Gorgeous apt and amazing hosts. Highly recommend!

Quartier tres agréable et apaisant. Calme. A proximité immediate de tout, transports, restaurant, petites epiceries, tramways, lieux à visiter ...
De la prise de contacts à chaque étape, le contact a été spontané, agréable, ...et tout correspondait à ce qui nous avait fait choisir ce lieux.
Merci Hugo et Silvia
Really cool location. Quiet at night but still in a great part of the city. Apartment was clean and nice. Hugo was very responsive and accommodating. Thanks!
캐리어가 많거나 무거우면 추천하지 않습니다. 그게 아니라면 중심부에 있어서 편해요

This apartment is spotlessly clean and in a terrific location, just a quick walk to restaurants and coffee shops. Also, it is a short walk to the the fantastic castle at the top of the hill and to other sites. The kitchen contains every convenience. The bedding and towels are top quality.
The bedroom was quite small -- one side of the bed was pushed against the wall, making it hard for a second person to climb in and out. Also, the apartment is located on the third floor. The first flight of stairs is extremely steep.
Overall it's a very comfortable place and I would definitely stay here again.

Beautiful views each morning in the heart of Lisbon! The apartment looks exactly like the photos and is very clean. Bed is comfortable and kitchen has enough supplies to cook simple meals (minus oil)
It is very centrally located with many nearby delicious restaurants and cafes. Bus transportation is within a 5 minute walk, which was very convenient especially after the long days walking the hills of Alfama and Chiado! The neighborhood gives a more authentic feel for Lisbon compared to Chiado, which has more shopping. Though, they are only a 15 min walk from each other so you can experience both wherever you stay. :)
Please note: Be prepared to walk on cobblestone for two blocks and lift luggage up 3 flights of narrow stairs. Due to the historic location, our Bolt driver could only drop us off down the street. We were so thankful we opted to get a Bolt from the airport. Only $12 USD (stayed during December). The train is cheaper but is a 10 min uphill walk on the same cobblestone

The flat was as beautiful as the photos, and the entire unit was clean and as described. We enjoyed the small balcony and river view. Although we didn’t use the kitchen much, it was well equipped and would be more than sufficient for making a meal to eat in. The neighbourhood felt safe day and night and the local shopkeepers were kind and helpful.
Communication with Hugo was clear and easy. Others may find it useful know that our initial entrance to the building required us to access a code online. The Wi-Fi in the unit was strong and reliable. The stairs were fine for us but less mobile travellers might find them steep. Although not too disruptive for us, we could hear other people coming and going in the stairwell as well as the people above us.
All-in-all, a lovely spot, and we would stay here again.
Mooi appartement met een mooi uitzicht en een fijne zon ligging.
Absolutely wonderful home. Host was extremely helpful and quick with responses. Looked just like the photos and the view was beautiful.

My husband and I had a fabulous stay for our wedding anniversary! Hugo was extremely responsive from the time of reservation all the way through to check out. The apartment is in great condition and as described/pictured. Absolutely no criticism of the apartment, but just be prepared for very steep stairs and three floors to climb which after an exhausting day of steps and hills and Lisbon can be a challenge! Short walks to lots of lovely restaurants and the tram stop. Overall a fantastic experience, thank you!

Great place, great views, great hosts! Hugo recommended an authentic restaurant nearby for dinner and met us at check in. The place was very clean and had a great balcony view. Located right by the trolley and very walkable. Note: if you have mobility issues, this may not be the place for you (stairs and cobblestone for a 5 minute walk from car access and another 3 flights of narrow stairs once you are inside the building). If you are driving into the city, there is free parking a 10 minute walk away, but not on Tuesdays and Saturdays.
We had a lovely stay there. Cozy and lean apartment, excellent location. Hugo was very responsive so he could help us out if we had any issues. Would stay again :)
Everything was good, good communication with the host, great location

L’appartamento di Hugo & Silvia è davvero un gioiello: la casa è confortevole e con una vista bellissima sulla città.
La zona di Alfama è molto caratteristica ma un po’ scomoda, considerando che si trova nella parte collinare della città: puoi spostarti a piedi o con i due famosi tram che ti portano verso il centro.
Siamo state pochi giorni e dovremo tornare sicuramente.

A beautiful apartment with a beautiful river view over the rooftops. The Alfama neighbourhood is lively and amazing, absolutely loved staying here. Hugo and Silvia here very nice and helpful. I recommend!

Excellent séjour, parfaitement conforme aux photos et aux avis des précédents hôtes.
Arrivée autonome du fait de notre arrivée tardive, les instructions d’Hugo étaient parfaitement claires et adaptées.
Vue absolument magnifique sur le Tage. L’appartement est calme, très lumineux et très bien agencé. Vous trouverez tout ce qu’il faut pour un séjour de quelques jours à Lisbonne.
Je recommande sans hésitation et à refaire avec grand plaisir pour un prochain séjour ici !

우리 여행에서 가장 좋은 숙소였어요.
좁은 계단만 빼면 정말 완벽했어요.
다 청결하고 가구부터 식기까지 모든게 마음에 들어서 두고두고 기억에 남을 숙소입니다.

Loved the old town Alfama location. Lots of stairs but really added to the charm. Uber drops you off close to apartment or short walk to tram or train. The apartment had a better view than the photos could show. Walkable to main sites and transport. Loved our stay, highly recommend 😊

The location of the apartment is ideal, you are right in the middle of Alfama. However, you need some stamina to get there because it is a bit higher up ;) Otherwise, great accommodation, everything you need is there and clean. Communication with the owners was fast, uncomplicated and friendly! Thank you!
Cannot fault this apartment! It was perfectly located, walkable to all parts of the city and a beautiful area. It was very clean and comfortable - perfect for what we needed!

What a hidden gem! Hugo and Sylvia’s place was exactly as described and pictured. It has everything you need for a short or longer stay. The flat is well designed and sparking clean and the third-floor view, peaceful and picturesque. The Alfama neighborhood is a treasure. While the rest of Lisbon is changing quickly, Alfama still retains its history and uniqueness. Cabs and Ubers can’t travel on the street outside the flat, so you may need a little help finding it. Hugo very graciously met at the Uber stop and carried a heavy suitcase up three very steep flights of stairs. He was an excellent communicator and very helpful with suggestions and recommendations. . . Make sure not to miss Insano Gelato right around the corner. Their gelato is insanely good.

Our phones Global Pass did not work so we could not use the instructions for the electronic key. We called Hugo and he explained how to get in. Life saving!
Lots of steep stars getting to the flat but once you are there,it is spectacular. Great views from the flat!
Uber can only take you only so far into the neighborhood. Then it’s a walk. Do your home work first and have gps available

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Hugo’s flat in Alfama is an absolute gem! The location couldn’t be better—literally steps away from the iconic 28 tram and with breathtaking views of the ocean right from the balcony. The flat itself was spotless and beautifully maintained, with fantastic bedding that made for an incredibly comfortable stay. It had everything we needed, and the charm of staying in the oldest neighborhood in Lisbon made it all the more special. We loved every moment here. Thank you, Hugo, for making our Lisbon experience perfect! Highly recommend!
We really enjoyed our stay here! The location is great and the place was very clean and comfortable. Hugo was proactive in communicating a change to the entry and responsive to any questions.

Alfama is the place to be! We had a great time exploring the area while in Lisbon. We were in a fabulous location - very walkable to a lot of hot spots (praca do comercio, rua Augusta, pink street, time out market etc). Would definitely stay here again!
Thanks, place was a great location in Lisbon and very flexible to check in and out of. Thank you very much!
We had a wonderful stay. We would definitely go back there again. Hugo was kind and very helpful. He always responded in a timely manner. Highly recommend!
Great property. Ideally located. Matched photos. Very clean.
Stunning views, spotlessly clean, comfortable and cozy, and friendly, communicative hosts. 10/10 recommend!
Hugo and Silvia were great! Amazing location. Very peaceful and quiet, but only a couple minutes walk to great restaurants and shops. Would absolutely stay again!
Great, clean place in the heart of beautiful Alfama. Would stay again!
Awesome apartment in lovely area of Lisbon. Host was very responsive & friendly.
Wonderful flat in a great location! You can walk all over the city and back to the place.

We had a wonderful time in Hugo‘s lovely apartment. We loved how spacious and inviting it was and especially the amazing view onto the water. We felt at home very quickly.
It was clean and nicely situated in the cozy district of Alfama, which we loved to explore by foot. There are also amazing spots to drink and dine close by.
We would definitely return!
Just as a little remark: the stairs leading up to the apartment are very steep. It was no problem for us, though.

We had a wonderful stay at the Alfama Blue. The apartment was spacious, clean and quiet, and close to many great restaurants. The apartment is close to many sites, as well as metro, bus, and train stations, which made it easy to get around. The host was very responsive and provided good suggestions for restaurants and things to see. We highly recommend this place.

This is the perfect place to stay for a visit to Lisbon. Its location in the narrow and twisting streets of Alfama allows you to really engage with the old city architect and still be central enough to walk to most places.
Overall, we found the place relatively quiet (there are still multiple units so you may occasionally hear the upstairs neighbors). The blinds and secluded bedroom made sleeping wonder. The shower pressure and head were also great.
Would definitely recommend!
Nous avons adoré notre séjour, l’appartement est très bien situé au cœur d’Alfama, très propre et avec toutes les commodités. Merci pour votre accueil!

je suis très reconnaissante envers Hugo. Nous avions perdu un de nos passeports dans le taxi et grâce a lui nous avons pu le récupérer. Il a fait les démarches auprès des compagnies de taxi et par miracle nous avons pu le récupérer. Il nous a sauver beaucoup de problèmes et de sous. merci beaucoup. Le logement est super propre et la vue est magnifique

Ci siamo trovati davvero bene, l’appartamento corrisponde effettivamente alla descrizione, era molto carino e accogliente. I due host impeccabili, sempre presenti. Ci è piaciuto molto soggiornare in questo appartamento!

The internal steps to the apartment are quite steep and the apartment is quite small. These are not written as negatives but rather just to give people an accurate description of the place. It is though, very clean and comfortable. Air con and tv simple and effective, kit hen and bathroom very functional. Location is fabulous, overall I would recommend it

We had a great stay here. The view is fantastic: A+. The location is ideal for Alfama…the apartment is quiet but close enough if you want to go down into the heart of the old town or up for a nice view and into other neighborhoods. The viewing point about 5 min walk away has a great view and is a great place to get a drink as the sun sets. The apartment itself is just as in the photos…clean, well put together, in perfect shape. Zero complaints. Last, Hugo was very accommodating and helpful. Would stay here again for sure.

We loved our stay! The place was clean, had a beautiful view, and was conveniently located. Hugo was extremely responsive to our questions/needs and I found the cost of this place to be extremely reasonable for what we received!

Their place has an incredible view of the ocean! It's comfortable clean and very thoughtfully put together. I was so grateful for the pitcher of cold water in the refrigerator when we arrived because Lisbon was 28 and there are many stairs!

Hugo and Silvia’s flat was clean, comfortable, and optimally located in a great neighborhood. Beautiful walk to the Alfama waterfront, Chiado, the Moorish Quarter, Castelo, Graca. The view is lovely and the street is a quieter one. I loved my time in Lisbon and can’t wait to return. Thank you, Hugo and Silvia!
We had a great stay at Hugo and Silvia’s apartment. The location was great and the place matched the description exactly. They were also super quick with their replies. Would definitely recommend!

The apartment was wonderful! We were in walking distance of many attractions and restaurants. Hugo was helpful and responsive. He even offered us the option to check in early after we made a mistake with our flights. We would definitely recommend if you are staying in Lisbon!
Fantastic place to stay in the Alfama with a great view of the river from the balcony.  Hugo was very flexible with us and responsive to our texts.  Will book here again in the Alfama neighborhood!
A spotlessly clean property in old town Alfama district with an outstanding view. Hugo and Sylvia kept in touch.

It was a little hard to find, even with the cab driver!    But we called Hugo and he responded right away.   Once inside, the stairs took us to the third floor, and wow, what a wonderful little home for our Lisboa stay.   With double balcony doors that offer a sweeping view of the river and surrounding houses,  it felt right in the heartbeat of Alfama.  When we arrived on Saturday night, Lisboa was in the month long celebration of its patron saint,  and the tiny cobblestone streets were full of music, dancing, and food.  Absolutely full of life.   At Hugo's apartment, the comfortable bed, the beautiful blue interior, and two little sitting areas, plus the couch, made for a great stay.  It was surprisingly quiet with the balcony doors shut, but opening them brought you into the center of the old city.  Super clean, Hugo was a very responsive host, and close to everything.   A classic place to stay in Lisboa.

Our stay began with Hugo meeting us in person to give us instructions and review the space. He was so kind and accommodating, helping carry one of our bags up the 3 flights of steps! Great location that is easy to catch the tram or walk. We were here during the “Feast of St. Anthony” where there were many celebrations in the streets. We loved it, and the space provided a nice place to retire in the evenings, and blocked much of the sounds that were occurring throughout town. We will stay here again when we come back!

L’appartement est très bien situé au coeur des petites rues festives d’Alfama. Il est possible d’aller partout à pied. Le logement est très agréable, bien aménagé, confortable, idéal pour une personne seule ou un couple. La vue sur le Tage est spectaculaire et j’ai passé beaucoup de temps sur le balcon. L’appartement est au 3 ièm étage. Sachez que l’escalier est étroit et raide. La récompense des efforts pour monter est la vue…Pour moi, n’ayant pas de téléphone, l’entrée on ligne a été compliquée.
Malgré tout, je recommande vivement cet appartement.
We really enjoyed our stay here, lovely neighbourhood and nice clean comfortable apartment

Silvia et Hugo sont des hôtes agréables, réactifs, et de très bons conseils.
Leur appartement au cœur du quartier d'Alfama, est un écrin, dans un quartier historique. typique, et dynamique de Lisbonne, et à deux pas du centre de Lisbonne.
j'y reviendrais cela est sûre, et, je recommande ce bien.

Très bel appartement avec un excellent emplacement et une superbe vue. Nous avons passé une super séjour.
Hugo est très réactif. Nous recommandons !

Fabulous top level apartment in the heart of Alfama. Views of river and excellent amenities.  Very steep stairs. And you need to be connected to internet through your phone to access. Despite this minor issues, highly recommend

Really lovely property, light and fresh and beautiful view out to the water! Alfama is easy to explore from here, all the little cobbled streets. The front door is activated by a web-based button, this can just be held near to the door (no specific receiver); this confused us a little! Thanks for letting us stay!

Die Wohnung liegt in einer sehr schönen Region und zu Fuss ist alles sehr gut erreichbar. Es gibt verschiedene Shops in der Nähe und auch viele Restaurants.
Die Aussicht auf das Meer war wunderschön. Die Treppen sind ein bisschen steil, aber alles ist sehr schön - eine richtige Wohnung in der Stadt.
Die Inneneinrichtung ist modern.
Hugo und Silvia haben uns bei Fragen sehr schnell zurückgeschrieben.
Die Wohnung ist sehr empfehlenswert! Wir danken für die schöne Zeit.

Great location and lovely flat. Amazing view of the river from the window. Lots of great places to eat and drink nearby. Hugo was a great host, very responsive, and was flexible about check in/out times which we appreciated. We would definitely stay again!

We had a wonderful stay in Alfama. Hugo was so responsive and friendly. Truly enjoyed all the memories made in Alfama. Definitely check out the nearby pastry shop Alfama Doce. Very convenient and walkable location. Would stay here again!
I had a wonderful stay! The apartment was exactly as described and the area is wonderful. The hosts were extremely helpful and quick to communicate. Highly recommend, thank you Hugo and Silvia!
great location - quiet but central. The apartment has an amazing view, and Hugo was very responsive. The great water pressure was a bonus

Mooi appartement met prachtig uitzicht over het water. Schoon en netjes. Centraal gelegen in de oude wijk alfama. Alles op loopafstand. Goede communicatie met de host. Reageert snel en vriendelijk.
Een echte aanrader dit appartement!
Great 3 nights in Alfama!   Hugo was an excellent communicator. Met us and assisted us to 4th floor apartment. Perfect space for a couple. Clean   Fantastic linens.  Centrally located.
Awesome stay,  with some amazing views. Lovely neighborhood.. not much more you could ask for in the heart of Alfama.
Great apartment for short stay
We really enjoyed Hugo & Silvia’s place. We’d definitely stay there again.
Had a lovely stay, will definitely come here again if i’m ever back in Lisbon

Nice location. The walls in the flat are thin so you'll hear others in the surrounding flats. Neighborhood was quiet except for another group that was blasting loud music / singing late into the night. Someone was also smoking cigarettes in the hall and the smell travelled into the flat, but this was all out of Hugo's hands. Not much you can do about another obnoxious group.
A few other things to note: The steps up into the flat are steep / narrow. You'll need cell service to check into the apartment. We had to unlock the doors with a website initially which was a little difficult to do in the rain. It takes a few seconds so be patient. Once we did this the first time we were able to use a key to enter and a keypad to enter the flat. Once you leave you'll have to wait a few seconds for the door to auto lock behind you.
Overall the flat was clean and in a good spot.
Great location in the heart of Alfama!

A beautiful and comfortable flat with a terrific view of the Tagus.
Alfama is the oldest part of Lisbon, and it does show. It can be a little intimidating at first, but it's actually a lovely part of the city. The apartment is located close to the Castello and the Sé, with many tiny bars and restaurants nearby.
The apartment is up some very steep stairs, but if you can manage Lisbon's infamous hills you will have no problem with the stairs.
We would be very happy to stay in the apartment again.

Pros - Hugo and Silvia were lovely and very responsive! The apartment was in a great location, very close to the main sights of Lisbon, and had a beautiful view.
Cons - some amenities were not as described. We could not find soap in the apartment, so we had to buy hand and body soap ourselves. Furthermore, the sofa bed even with the mattress topper was extremely uncomfortable / unusable for us especially as there is a metal spine running right through the center of the sofa. I would only recommend two people stay here if you were both going to share the double bed.

Had a wonderful stay! The apartment is modern and well equipped.  Nice river view from the kitchen balcony. The location in Alfama is very central and close to several major attractions. Hugo was very friendly and responsive. All in all, a great experience. Thank you Hugo for hosting us!
Nice place to spend a few days in Lisbon, I would recommend!
Amazing apartment with a beautiful view, in a great neighbourhood in Alfama with lovely shops and people. Would recommend to anyone taking a trip to Lisbon

I had a lovely, albeit quick, overnight at Hugo & Silvia’s place before flying out of Lisbon. I loved the location and found the check-in process to be very straightforward. I slept well and felt like i lived in my own little flat in Lisbon. It was perfect for what I needed and I so appreciated how responsive and communicative Hugo and Silvia were throughout my stay. Thank you!!!
Hugo and Silvia’s apartment was nicely decorated, had a beautiful of the water, and was very clean. Definitely recommend staying here.

Hugos apartment is located in beautiful area of Alfama surrounded by restaurants and historic monuments.
Quiet with amazing view on Tagus river and colorful houses of Alfama.
It is clean and has all amenities for short stays.
Hugo is friendly and responsive host, highly recommended.

This was certainly one of the most memorable trips. Hugo & Silvia's apartment is clean, perfectly located in Alfama (highly recommend to stay in that neighborhood), super clean, with an outstanding view of the river even from the bedroom. Lisbon will always be a special memory especially because of their apartment.
Communication with the host was smooth and very easy.
Thank you Hugo and Silvia for making our trip as memorable.
Beim nächsten Besuch gerne wieder
Vista mozzafiato sul Tago. L appartamento era in ordine e pulito. Il quartiere Alfama offre un sacco di locali vicini al appartamento
Lovely flat in the centre of Alfama, exactly as described and pictures show! Would recommend to anyone wanting to stay in Lisbon!
El apartamento era igual o mejor que en las fotos. La zona era céntrica y turística. Si volvemos a ir a Lisboa, seguramente repetiremos.

Great stay in Alfama! The apartment was lovely with great views of the river. Very close to lots of nice things to do in Alfama. Hugo was very helpful and made check in easy and provided a nice stay. Would definitely stay again!
super séjour, merci pour tout

El alojamiento estuvo espectacular, muy bien ubicado y con todo lo necesario para estar cómodos. Hugo y Silvia unos gran anfitriones siempre dispuestos a ayudarnos, a la llegada nos perdimos pero Hugo nos oriento para llegar, Alfama tiene muchas calles y es fácil perderse pero es parte del encanto. recomendado 100%
Very smooth communication with Hugo. Enjoyed the stay in the apartment and Lisbon.

This is a sweet little apartment in an amazing medieval neighbourhood of narrow twisting streets and alleys, full of restaurants and corner stores in a few minutes walk,   one road beneath a main tram route and an easy walk to the centre of town.  It has a lovely view.  The two cautions are that it is a three storey walk up and you need to have internet data to operate the door locks, at least the day you arrive.
