Hugo and Silvia responded immediately to our queries.

We had a great time at the beautiful flat with a nice view of the river! It was exceptionally clean and the bedroom is very cozy. Besides hearing the neighbours steps due to the wood floors, it was very quiet and comfortable! We loved the surrounding streets and found many nice cafés and restaurants. Would return anytime ☺️
Très bien
Nice appartment, with a great view on Lisbon, and well placed. Good experience !

We loved our stay at Hugo’s! The place was very clean and perfect for two people. We loved the view and the easy walking distance to Lisbon center and other cute areas. Hugo was flexible about our check-in time, which was lovely! He was quick to respond to our messages and very kind.
The place was very clean and cozy. It was conveniently located to take  public transportations or to walk around areas. My wife and I enjoyed our trip while staying this nice place.
Um lugar limpo, com vista perfeita!

Very pleasant place to stay (late October) in a nice and lively neighbourhood (Alfama). The flat is cosy, sober and well-tasted decoration. The view on the riverside is a nice plus, and the bedroom got a charming inside window that you can open toward the living room.
Easy communication with the host, we didn’t need his help since the flat is well equipped but he checked on how we were doing from time to time, just in case.

Our stay at Hugo and Silvia's was great. The apartment is clean, a good size, a great view. The location is good, as it is in the heart of the touristy Alfama district, but in a quiet side street, with great soundproofing on the windows -- best of both worlds. Lots of stairs in the neighborhood and to get to the apartment, but that was not a problem for us. We were two friends looking for a place with two separate beds, during the stay Hugo bought a mattress topper for the second bed (sofa bed), which made it much more confortable, we greatly appreciated the gesture.  Would very much recommend the place.

This is a fabulous, quaint, cozy little flat. Great location, great price. The bedroom is in a little room with shutters to the living room.
There's even a tiny "Juliette Balcony" that overlooks the street.
Everything is pristine, the interior is comfortable and clean, Hugo is very responsive and helpful. Good ventilation.
**NOTE: if you can't climb numerous steep stairs or have heavy, large luggage, this might be a difficult location for you**
Most taxi's and Ubers will drop you off on the upper street (the quaint street that this flat is on, is a quiet historic street that's closed to most vehicles.) This means you must climb down two steep flights of stairs to get to the street you need to be on.
Then, once you're at the residence, the flat is up 3 flights of very narrow/steep stairs. We had (2) 20 kilo carry-on luggage filled with wine. That was a challenge getting upstairs and back down again!
If stair climbing doesn't deter you, this is an AWESOME find! We LOVED it!

Самые приятные впечатления от квартиры: аккуратный дизайн и прекрасный вид из окна. В квартире есть все необходимое и аптечка первой помощи и индикация выхода и безопасности. Отдельное спасибо за Мицелярную воду и ватные спонжи.
К квартире сложно подъезжают такси, но буквально в 3 минутах ходьбы остановка 28 трамвая, и пересечение улиц, которые легко находят вся такси.
70% туристических мест в пешей доступности.
Рядом есть рестораны чтобы поужинать и позавтракать.
Рекомендую эту квартиру, и даже готова остановится еще раз.
Спасибо.

This Alfama gem is sunny, homey and very well located.  There were so many thoughtful touches, a carafe of cold water in the fridge, face clothes in the bathroom, charming decorations, a few kitchen staples: rice, olive oil, etc.  The location was perfect for me to explore Lisbon.  I loved just wandering the labyrinthine streets, but I could also get to other areas easily by foot. There is a lovely view and I enjoyed watching the cruise ships come and go. I must say that I love walking and climbing stairs!  This would not be a good location for anyone with mobility issues.  The first set of stairs at Alfama Blue House are very steep and narrow.  You do 'earn the price of admission' to this sunny apartment!  If stairs are not an issue I highly recommend their space.  Additionally, they were super helpful with getting a taxi booked for an early morning departure, and advice on how to use Uber in the neighborhood.

Hugo and Sylvia’s place was wonderful. The location was great with amazing restaurants and coffee shops very close by. It was the perfect location to experience Alfama and also easy walking distance to other popular areas of Lisbon. The Airbnb itself was very clean and comfortable, and we would highly recommend this place to others! Thanks Hugo and Sylvia!

Awesome neighborhood! The Blue House is located roughly a 15 minute walk from the main attractions of Lisbon. It’s in a very quiet and safe neighborhood. Beautiful views of the river and of the cruise ships coming in. The house itself is spacious yet cozy for two. I had the pleasure of meeting Hugo. He was very accommodating and recommended our favorite dinner of the trip!

Hugo & Sylvia have great taste. All the fixtures, furnishings and finishes are high quality and beautiful. The walls are painted a beautiful robin’s egg blue color which is so serene. The mattress on the bed is very comfortable, but I personally didn’t find the foam pillows to be as comfortable and Hugo agreed with me and said they would be upgrading the pillows soon. The shower has excellent water pressure and there was plenty of hot water. The view of the river from the living room is quite beautiful.
Remote checkin was smooth and very straight forward. I was skeptical because the front door doesn’t appear to have a modern app-based entry capability, but trust the instructions because if followed correctly, they work perfectly.
I heard noises from the rental unit directly above that kept me up late. I haven’t seen this mentioned in other reviews, so maybe the people in the unit above that night were abnormally loud. I admit to being a very light sleeper so maybe it's just me.

Felt hospitable and most importantly clean. The stairs were a challenge but after a while we got used to it . The neighbourhood restaurants we loved had a great , community oriented.
Overall a very good stay and the host was super helpful and very responsive

just spent 3nts at Hugo & Sylvia's. really terrific flat, in a beautiful residential area.
clean, stylish, cosy and perfect for the two of us.
Hosts were fantastic. Really responsive, and helpful. would highly recommend.
Would really recommend exploring the cafes, restaurants and bars in the local area.

Уютная аккуратная симпатичная квартира с красивым видом. Расположение отличное: атмосфера старого города.
Очень все четко со стороны хозяев: удаленное заселение, советы, быстрая обратная связь.
Очень рекомендую.
Спасибо!
Perfect accommodation for our stay in Lisbon! Great communication and attentive hosts.

Lovely view of Rio Tejo even though large cruise ships show up in the mornings. As others have noted, stairs up to apartment are steep and narrow but we are light packers so it was not an issue. The app for operating doors was a bit to figure out the first time but once we did, we had no problem. Apartment was tidy and comfortable with a large well-equipped kitchen. Lots of good restaurants nearby as well as a mini-mart for snacks and drinks and laundromat. Ubering is cheap way to get around as the trolleys are always crowded. We figured out that it was easier to get Uber pick up by the trolley stop since that is a wider, more traveled street than the street the apartment is on. Trolley stops are just a short distance away. Location made it easy to get up to the castle and many other places in Alfama- which means lots of cool twists and turns.

Die Wohnung von Hugo & Silvia hat einen hinreißenden Ausblick über die Altstadt von Lissabon und den Tejo. Sie ist hell und gemütlich und äußerst sauber. Man fühlt sich sofort Zuhause. Die beiden Gastgeber sind sehr engagiert, hilfsbereit und freundlich. Es dauert keine Minute bis man eine hilfreiche Rückmeldung erhält. Eine klare Empfehlung hier zu übernachten.

A wonderful apartment in a perfect situated location in Alfama close to many wonderful restaurants, shops and sights! The view from the apartment balcony is beautiful, the apartment is spacious and very clean. Hugo and Silvia were perfect hosts with very fast responses and helpful suggestions. I really recommend a trip to Sinatra and Cascais, both beautiful places to visit! Thank you for a fabulous stay :)

Très bon séjour dans ce bel appartement en plein cœur de l’alfama. La vue est magnifique, le mobilier est de bonne qualité et l’appartement est charmant. On s’y sent comme chez soi.
Hugo était très réactif et présent à chaque question ou éventuel problème et nous nous sommes vraiment sentis privilégiés grâce à lui.
Cependant attention ! La toiture et les murs sont très peu insonorisés, alors pour le peu que quelqu’un marchait dans les parties communes nous l’entendions et nous nous sommes fait réveillé le matin très tôt et le soir très tard par les voisins du dessus avec qui on avait l’impression d’habiter tellement le bruit était intense. Gros point dérangeant qui a eu de sérieuses répercutions sur notre sommeil mais pas de la faute d’Hugo, surtout si l’appartement du dessus est aussi un air bnb, ça variera au fil du temps (en tout cas pour notre part ils étaient vraiment très bruyant, le sol et les verres tremblait lorsqu’ils marchaient).
Seul gros bémol sinon je recommends grandemen

The stay at Hugos Apartment was great. For us it was the perfect location to experience Alfama and its little streets and corners and to discover some hidden gems. The view out the window was even better than the pictures show. Also close to the main street next to the port to take a bus along the coastline. Hugo was very fast at replying to questions and the instructions on how to get to and into the apartment left no questions. Great stay.

The AC worked well, the views were pretty, and the hosts were extremely responsive. Just a note that you’re up 3 steep flights of steps so something to consider with luggage. Definitely doable, though. The location was close by to the center of Alfama. Great spot!
Sehr gute Unterkunft für einen Aufenthalt in Lissabon

El apartamento está muy bien, tal cual se describe en el anuncio, y en una ubicación excelente.
El problema llega si vienes con tu coche, pues no hay acceso, y si además llevas mucho equipaje, la cosa se complica bastante. No hay ascensor y las escaleras son estrechas.
El apartamento es pequeño pero muy cómodo, con aire acondicionado.
Aquí el problema aparece por la estructura antigua del edificio, los suelos son de madera, sin aislamiento, y las pisadas de los vecinos de arriba causan un gran estruendo. Si esto sucede a altas horas de la noche o muy temprano, como fue en nuestro caso en varios días de nuestra estancia, dormir es complicado.

This was an amazing place to stay! We had a great time. Hugo & Silvia were incredibly responsive and we felt like we had everything we needed for a great stay. The location is in a great place close to everything we wanted to see.
Enjoyed our stay in alfama.  Nice view, cool breeze, local restaurants, quiet mornings and well located. Recommended

Très belle appartement, nous avons eu un super séjour. Nous avons demandé à Hugo des conseils et tout de suite nous avons eu une réponse claire et précise. Hugo à également fait les démarches pour nous afin que nous puissions bénéficier de funny tour pour le retour et ce très tôt le matin,service impeccable. Il est vrai qu’avec une grosse valises il est plus difficile de se rendre à l’appartement, mais nous avons tout de même été capable. Très belle vue, quartier bien situé. Bref tout était parfait, je recommande assurément. Merci pour tout Hugo et Silva.
We had a great stay at the apartment! Excellent value and great location in Alfama.
Overall this was a wonderful stay. Fantastic location, very clean apartment, and Hugo was a kind and responsive host to any issues that came up. We would stay here again.

Hugo is a great host. He was available to address all queries, and his inputs were fabulous. We had a great stay. The apartment is well appointed, and perfect for 2 people. It has everything you need. The apartment is located within walking distance of major tourist attractions in Alfama, and is well connected by public transport. The locality is quiet and peaceful. We recommend this apartment wholeheartedly for couples.
We loved our stay in Lisbon.  Alfama was the perfect location.  We would easily recommend this place as well as staying here again!

This is a third floor walk up, narrow steep stairs for luggage.  The electronic locks are a test of patience but Hugo was very quick to get us inside and set us up with a key and keypad.  Once we became accustomed to the uniqueness of the neighborhood we really enjoyed our stay.  The view is sublime especially on a full moon.
Great place, clean, the host let us drop off our baggage early and was very responsive when we had needs. Neighborhood was pretty quiet, especially with AC on at night. Thanks for a great stay!

Hugo is the most responsive Airbnb host I’ve ever encountered. The self-checkin and checkout worked flawlessly. The apartment was spotless. Hugo was super helpful with all our questions and his help made our stay go really smoothly.
Alfama is a beautiful neighborhood, there’s so much to do and Belem, Santa Apolonia Station, Tram 28, everything is really accessible.
We had a wonderful stay and would absolutely stay at Alfama Blue House again.

Hugo was very helpful in allowing us to check in early and he was very informative on recommending the places to visit. Great location close to Santa Apolonia metro/train station. We really enjoyed our stay in Lisbon

Très
Bonne localisation .
Les hôtes sont très sympathiques , répondent vite et bien aux demandent
Hugo & Silvia’s place was great! Exactly as pictured, extremely clean, and a great location within Alfama.

We really enjoyed our stay in Lisbon. The apartment was very quiet (despite the festival close by!) and easy to walk everywhere. The space was really nicely decorated and the bed extremely comfortable. Check in /access was easy once we we worked out the online instructions! Overall a perfect place to stay for a short break!

Wir hatten eine schöne Zeit in Lissabon. Die Wohnung befindet sich in einem
traditionellen Haus mit mehreren Einheiten. Einige davon sind via airbnb vermietet. Die Lage ist absolut zu empfehlen - wir liebten die Altstadt. Sie bietet einen tolle Ausgangspunkt für Unternehmungen. Man sollte wissen, dass die Häuser sehr hellhörig sind und man rundherum alles versteht. Mit Kleinkind leider nicht zu empfehlen. Ansonsten jedoch eine absolute top Adresse.
Great location, close to center and pretty view from the balcony! Hugo was great in communicating. Thanks for a great stay!

Logement super propre et bien situé.
Hôtes faciles à joindre et agréables.
Lit confortable et propre, ça sentait bon et frais (des oreillers de meilleure qualité et en plus grande quantité seraient un petit plus appréciable. 😉)
Vue partielle, mais vraiment chouette sur le Taj et les environs.
Très beau séjour dans cet endroit.
Great spot

Beautiful location with stunning views! We loved staying in Alfama & it was exactly what we were looking for! Check- in & a later check out time, especially when on vacation, was perfect! If you are not great with stairs, it is important to note this is the 3 rd floor up very steep stairs and Alfama is very hilly in general. We knew this going in and it did not affect our stay.

The apartment is very well located and has it's charm. Very clean with a beautifull view to Rio Tejo, right in the heart of Alfama. Hugo was super nice and very easy to comunicate. We enjoyed our stay and hope to come back again soon!

This is a lovely little 1 BR ideally located in the Alfama neighborhood with a gorgeous view - Hugo was very responsive, helpful and accommodating. Self check in was very convenient (but required phone service). One thing to note: Ubers cannot access the street where the flat is located (only official taxis) so you may end up taking a lot of stairs to get there.
A gem of a spot - we highly recommend.

Hugo and Silvia's apartment has been cleverly modernised to a very high standard to make good use of space. It is three floors up with a great view from the balcony over the roof tops to the river. It is well positioned in the heart of Alfama close to excellent small restaurants and shops run by friendly locals, a short walk up to the 28 tram stop and within easy distance of Castelo S. Jorge. It has well designed access and security. Our hosts kept in regular and helpful contact before and during our stay. Also strongly recommend the driver they sent to meet us at the Airport.

I had the best short stay at Hugo&Silvia’s apartment in historic Alfama! Amazing location to explore the city and feel at home. This place makes for a very authentic Lisbon experience! Highly recommend and the hosts are incredibly helpful and responsive.

We loved staying here because 1.  Hugo was extremely responsive to all of our questions, even ordering us a taxi for the morning we left 2.  The Alfama neighborhood was absolutely charming with its narrow hilly streets and friendly restaurants. 3.  The apartment was very comfortable, with a full kitchen, a clean and modern bathroom, and plenty of sitting space.  You do need to be able to go up and down steep narrow stairs, the apartment is on the 3rd floor, which was fine for us.
GREAT PLACE! THE BEST PLACE I STAYED IN LISBON

Awesome appartment, great views on the harbor of Lisbon. Please be aware that often big cruise ships obstruct the view on the ocean, but that’s the reality in many cities of the world nowadays.
The appartment is perfectly located and has all the things you need. Very recommendable!

Hugo and Silvia’s apartment in Alfama was a perfect spot for me and my girlfriend to stay for a few days in Lisbon. All the directions were very clear and they were able to accommodate us a couple hours early since our flight got in early. We would stay here again!

Hugo and Silvia’s place is perfect if you are a solo traveler or a pair wanting to stay and explore all of the wonders and charm of history Alfama and downtown Lisbon! Everything is walking and all of the stunning Miraduos are around every corner!

Stayed here for 4 nights whilst exploring Lisbon. A lovely apartment. Excellent amenities, with a great kitchen, bathroom and lounge. We loved the view from the balcony over the river and it had the sun during the day
A great location in Aflama. Close to the centre, yet quiet and peaceful. A 5 minute walk from a superb viewpoint and also a 2 minutes walk from a most lovely bakery
Hugo was extremely helpful before we visited and also during with his communication. If we return to Lisbon, we will definitely look to stay here again. Superb accommodation. Thank you

Great little apartment. The area is lovely and picturesque, close to bars, restaurants, trams and minimarkets, but also surprisingly quiet in terms of noise when we visited. The view from the balcony is great. The first flight of stairs up to the apartment is pretty steep, might be a slightly hard to handle for one person with heavy luggage, but not an issue if that’s not your case. Would definitely book again!

Tout d’abord Hugo nous a déconseillé d’arriver en voiture et heureusement nous l’avons écouté. Il nous a recommandé un service de navette « Funny Tour Cie » et l’expérience a été excellente. Notre chauffeur nous attendait à l’aéroport et nous a amenés à destination sans anicroches. Même chose pour le retour. Nous recommandons nos hôtes à tous sans hésitation. Expérience très conviviale. Merci Hugo & Silvia.

We liked the apartment for its location.  The views from the balconies are incredible.  We ate at nearby restaurants.  Very convenient after a day of walking around the city, and all had fantastic seafood !

This is a beautiful flat in Alfama with amazing views across Lisbon. There are lots of restaurants, coffee shops and viewpoints all within walking distance. The flat was clean and comfortable and the hosts were easy to contact and very responsive. Thank you for a lovely stay!

Hugo was an exceptional host, he let us into the apartment personally when we arrived early and was very communicative. The apartment is well situated in Alfama, which is quaint and very popular amongst tourists. One thing to note is that the shower is a detachable head that is affixed very low to the wall.
très bien placé, très propre , très belle vue, appartement de grande taille , escaliers raides mais pas un problème ! Merci pour le séjour !

Wir hatten einen tollen Aufenthalt in Hugos Appartement. Insbesondere der Ausblick auf den Tejo und die zentrale Lage in Alfama haben uns sehr gut gefallen.
Die Wohnung ist in einem top Zustand, einladend und gut ausgestattet.
Wir würden sie definitiv weiterempfehlen.

Beautiful airbnb!
It has a beautiful view and is spacious. Hugo was very quick to answer all my questions and even let me drop my suitcase off before check in. In the historic Alfama neighborhood which is hilly and there are a lot of stairs just in case you have lots of luggage. You’ll get in shape quick
:)
I would definitely stay here again!

Had a great stay at Hugo and Silvia’s apartment. The place is right at the heart Alfama, and within 5-10 walking to some hidden gems and awesome viewpoints. The apartment is clean and spacious for 1-2 people. I love the big windows that face the river. The hosts were super proactive in communicating, so I had a seamless check in and check out. It’s also in a residential area, so much quieter at night compared to other areas. Highly recommend!
Beautiful apartment and communicative hosts. The only thing that was disappointing was lack of shower gel. Otherwise would stay again.

We really enjoyed our 4 nights at Alfama Blue House. The apartment is lovely (and spotless) with a stunning view on the Tagus. Its location is perfect for visiting Lisbon (tram 28 is just a few steps away). Hugo was very responsive and helpful.  I definitely recommend!

I really enjoyed just wandering the neighborhood! The apartment was perfect for what I needed. You can catch the trams right around the corner and it was near a train station. I would love to stay again! The view from the apartment was also great for sunrises!

The flat is great! Spotless clean, perfectly located in the cute area of Alfama. The view is really nice and we enjoyed our 4-day stay the 2 of us. A few things to keep in mind: bring your own coffee if you want some, shower gel and shampoo. Also you can hear the neighbor upstairs so bring your earplugs. This was not disturbing at all and it was overall very quiet. Would definitely recommend and we are even thinking of going back! Thank you Hugo and Silvia!

The place is amazing! It is beautiful and almost everything is near by walk. we enjoyed a lot our stay here. Hugo is very kind we did not meet him in person, but he was great.
I recommend 100% this Airbnb if you come to Lisbon.

Simply a gem in the heart of Alfama historical district! Most of Lisboa highlights are in walkable distance from the airbnb. The flat is cozy and beautifully styled. Hugo was particularly helpful and responsive. Everything went beyond our expectations, definitely recommended !
Great location, in a clean house with a lovely view. Perfect spot for 2 to explore Lisbon.
Top Lage, super Einrichtung. Wir waren sehr gerne dort.
Excellent place, excellent location!

Mi pareja y yo hemos pasado un fin de semana espectacular en este apartamento. Ubicado en el barrio más bonito de Lisboa y con todas las comodidades. resaltar que las vistas desde el balcón son preciosas.
Respecto a Hugo le damos un 10 como anfitrión, se mostró flexible y amable y nos resolvió rápidamente todas nuestras dudas.
Repetiría sin dudarlo!
Perfect stay!

Hugo is a great host. Always responsive and helpful. The apartment is small, perfect for two people. Very clean. Easy self check-in and out. Amazing location to explore Lisbon with lots to do and see in a walking distance. 28E tram is just around the corner.  Be prepared to climb up the steep stairs. Overall - great stay, we would come back.
Hugo was nice and VERY responsive. would recommend.

intimate and cozy apartment in Alfama, located in a very quiet street (very silent), fully equipped and with a great view on the Lisbon rooftops and Tago river from a little balcony. Our three days here were perfect and romantic
Die Kommunikation mit Hugo hat gut funktioniert. Die Lage ist für ein Kurztrip fantastisch. Wir werden sicherlich nochmal nach Lissabon reisen und die Wohnung kann ich weiterempfehlen.
Make sure you have data on phone for check in. Amazing location, great clean apartment with everything you could need and amazing views. Definitely would stay here again.

We had an incredibly comfortable stay - everything was exactly as indicated, and the hosts were very helpful. The location is phenomenal - right next to many authentic fado restaurants and in the heart of the old city. Very easy walk to touristy destinations and the city center.
Great location to experience Alfama as a local ! Hugo was great help as a host :)

Excelente relación calidad-precio. El apartamento cuenta con una ubicación inmejorable, en el corazón de la Alfama. Muy limpio y funcional. La comunicación con Hugo fue excelente en todo momento, y la llegada automatizada resulta muy eficiente. Recomendado al 100%

When our travel plans changed due to canceled and rebooked flights, Hugo and Silvia were very accomodating and let us book another one of their properties so we had a nice place to stay even before our original booking began.
we had a really pleasant stay, the communication was easy. The flat is very clean with a nice view on the Tage river
Great stay! Amazing view!
Clean, comfortable place in an excellent location in the old walking part of Lisbon.
Hugo was super helpful in setting us up in the flat at really short notice. Great location, the flat was exactly what we need to in the heart of Alfama.
Great place in a very cool location with lots of little shops and restaurants around every corner! Hugo was very accommodating and helpful!
Had a lovely stay at the River House. The apartment was perfect and clean and in a handy location. Communication with Hugo was also excellent. Would recommend and would definitely stay again!
Lovely stay in the middle of Alfama
Hugo was a great responsive host. Just be cautious of the stairs walking up to the apartment as they are quite steep.
Great location, view, and apt. Really enjoyed my stay here!

This is a beautiful, modern apartment, perfectly located in the Alfama. The location made our stay in Lisbon special. The hosts were very helpful and communicative. We highly recommend this to anyone staying in Lisbon.

Hugo and Silvia were very kind to us and helped us with everything. The flat was very modern with smart door locks (quite impressive). We had everything that we needed and its quite cosy and clean. The shower could be warmer, but maybe you don’t need a very hot shower in warm Lisbon. The internet is not the fastest, but it works for surfing and messaging. Streaming HD can be difficult.

We had a wonderful stay at Hugo and Silvia's. The apartment has lots of natural light and a nice direct view of the river. The neighborhood can be challenging to navigate if you have a lot of luggage or have difficulty with stairs because it is all cobblestone and hills. The apartment is on the third floor and there is no elevator - just something to factor into your planning. However, down the street from the apartment is a wonderful tile shop that we enjoyed spending time in. Alfama Doce was our favorite bakery in Lisbon and is just a couple of minutes walk from the apartment. Quase cafe, a 5 minutes walk away, has a Power Brunch that is an incredible amount of very delicious food for very low prices. There is also a very nice Copenhagen Coffee Lab about 3 minutes from the apartment, with both indoor and outdoor seating that is perfect for breakfast or an afternoon coffee/tea break. There are many historic sites nearby, all within walking distance. Other than taking the metro from the airport towards Alfama, we exclusively walked throughout Lisbon and the excellent location of the apartment made that very possible. We would highly recommend this apartment and Hugo made the process extremely easy for us!

The apartment was lovely. Really gorgeous view and in such a cool neighborhood. Silvia and Hugo were really flexible when we ran into travel issues and gave us a bunch of ideas when it looked like we'd have to stay an extra night in Lisbon.
Tidy apartment in a lovely Alfama location. Beautiful view. Good communication with host, fast responses.

A lovely stay, a perfect location. It felt very safe and was quiet at night, but very close to bars and restaurants. It’s a very hilly part of the city (although the whole city is hilly!) the stairs are very steep if you have a large suitcase. The apartment was lovely, good aircon and lovely windows with a juliet balcony. The only thing that could have been better was if there was a kettle available, I’m sure this will be rectified by the owners though as it’s quite an essential! Hugo was very friendly and communication was great.

Lisbon is always worth a trip: beautiful historic buildings, lovely city, many great restaurants, and everything within walking distance! Everything else can be easily reached by public transport or Uber.
The apartment is in a great location that comes with some noise at night as the building is old and you can hear the other people living next door. Besides this you'll find everything you need within the apartment. There is a beautiful view of the town.
The communication with Hugo is nice and easy.
Please note: There is a steep staircase leading up to the apartment therefore it is a pain to carry heavy luggage up there..
Very good location, good communication with the host and nice, bright and clean apartment. Highly recommended!

This Alfama home was a perfect base for our exploration of Lisbon.  Charming apartment, both sentral and quite. All the facilities wee wanted. Clean. Good communication with the hosts. Altogethervery happy, easily reccomended!
Beautiful little apartment with gorgeous views. Clean and comfy. Excellent location and quiet.

Hugo & Silvia's apartment is very well located in the old town and is great to come back to after a long day of exploring Lisbon. The apartment is well decorated and stocked with necessities. The highlight of the apartment is the view!! We will miss waking up to the view of the Tagus river.

Je recommande à tous!!
L'appartement est super beau et propre. Lit très très confortable. Belle vue sur Lisbonne. Nous n'avons pas eu la chance de rencontrer Hugo, mais la communication par message fût toujours simple et rapide. Hugo est soucieux de notre confort et à demander de nos nouvelles lors du séjour.
Appartement bien situé, près de plusieurs miradouro. Le quartier est très tranquille (notamment, car seulement certaines voitures ont accès à la rue), mais tout près à 2-3 minutes de marche vous avez accès à plusieurs restaurants qui offre des spectacles de Fado.
Les escaliers de l’appartement sont un peu abrupte ; difficile de descendre de grosses valises.
Tel que mentionné dans différents commentaires, il y a en effet du bruit provenant des pas des gens de l'appartement d'en haut. Cela n'a pas été problématique, c'était un niveau de bruit normal qui ne nous a pas empêché de dormir.
Si Hugo vous propose une compagnie locale pour votre transport de l'aéroport n'hésitez pas; service impeccable, Ricardo a gardé nos bagages de notre arrivée jusqu'à notre check-in et même monté nos bagages au 3e étage 🙌
Notre séjour a été plus qu'agréable!!!

Hugo and Silvia's apartment was perfect for our stay in Lisbon. After having walked through most of the tourist neighborhoods in Lisbon, Alfama is definitely our favorite The apartment is perfectly located in Alfama, steps away from tram 28, close to many Portuguese restaurants with fado music and a few blocks down the hill from Miradouro das Portas do Sol and Castelo De Sao Jorge. We especially loved Alfama Doce, a cafe located a minute away. It was one of the favorite places we visited in Lisbon;  the pastries are all delicious and inexpensive. The kitchen was fully stocked with cookware, but most went unused due to all the delicious food we had in the neighborhood! Fair warning, the steps up to the apartment are quite steep and the there is some noise from the street and other apartments as mentioned in other reviews. If you are not able bodied or are a light sleeper you may want to look elsewhere, but otherwise this is a highly recommended Airbnb.

The apartment is in a great location. You can walk to several gorgeous terraces nearby for a drink in the evening and is really close to the castle, the train station, and around 20mins walk to the more commercial shopping district - which is great as the trams were very crowded. There are also lots of good restaurants nearby, we would recommend “chapito a mesa” by the castle, good for casual dining after a day of walking.
The only thing I’d say is that it is in an old building and we could hear the people in the flat above us walking around a lot at night, so maybe bring earplugs if you are a light sleeper. Otherwise, we would recommend this apartment as a great base to explore.
We had a fantastic stay. Breathtaking view. Centrally located in the historic Alfama area. Clean and bright apartment with everything we needed. Would love to stay here again!

Eine tolle Wohnung in Lissabon mit einer super Lage und einer guten Größe für zwei Personen!
Der Kontakt zu Hugo und Silvia war sehr freundlich und unkompliziert.
Wir kommen gerne wieder! :-)
A really beautiful flat in Lissabon. Enough space for 2 people. The communication with Hugo and Silvia was pretty easy and fast.
We like to visit you again. :-)

This gorgeous apartment is in an excellent position to explore Lisbon. Set in a quiet area it is clean, modern and convenient. Hugo and Silvia were wonderful hosts and were very helpful from airport transfers to other recommendations. View of the water were amazing over the roof tops of Alfama. Thanks for a wonderful holiday.

Hugo and Silvia’s place in Alfama was great! It is centrally located to restaurants, view points as well as quiet spaces (streets/alleyways)  to wander through when you need a break from the hustle bustle of tourists. I look forward to the time I can return and stay in this cozy apartment!
Very nice apartment in a great location. We really enjoyed our stay.

Well-located, spacious apartment with stunning views and a comfortable bed.  Great location in a charming part of Lisbon within easy walking distance of restaurants, bars, museums etc. The staircase is a bit steep and narrow - as you'd expect in this type of building. Very good communication from the hosts with lots of helpful information. There was a minor issue with the automatic door access system the day we arrived but it was no problem since the hosts were so communicative and helpful.

Fantastic apartment and great hosts!
We really enjoyed staying with Hugo and Silvia. The apartment was clean, cozy and the air conditioning was much welcomed. Hugo was quick in responding and a caring host. Alfama is an older part of the city and so has the authentic charm. Would recommend!
Very well located, clean & bright

Overall nice spot, great location in the heart of Alfama and good access to food and downtown. Unit is as advertised in photos with good air con. Check in requires use of a website which may be hard for international travelers and the apartment building is a bit noisy (we have lived in major cities and the noise from apartment above was surprising even for us). Overall a great spot minus the noise and would stay again
Great location, clean apartment, and very quiet at night. Air conditioning works great and check-in was super easy. Highly recommend staying here!

Small but cute apartment with all the necessary. We particularly appreciated how quiet it was despite being in the middle of the Alfama. This neighborhood can be a bit much in terms of noise, music being played from speakers and things like that but we didn’t have problems sleeping at night. We never met the host but communication was great, both before and during our stay.

Place is great. view from 3 floor is nice. As others have said stairs are narrow so keep that in mind. also the uber cannot come into the street so you'll have to walk up or down the streets to catch one. Should be fine if you are not older.

Everything was perfect! Great area to explore Lisboa, the apartment was perfectly clean, the communication was quick and easy and Hugo & Silvia are great hosts!
Will defensively consider to stay there again if I will travel to Lisboa next time!

A fantastic space and location. This was our first time in Lisbon, so we appreciated being in such close proximity to both historical attractions and lively, new restaurants/bars/businesses—it’s a great neighborhood to explore. The apartment itself is clean, cool (AC!), comfortable, and offers the perfect amount of space for a couple or solo traveler. The view from the room is lovely, too. Hugo & Silvia were very communicative and friendly, and check-in/check-out was easy. Overall, I would highly recommend. :)

Great communication with Hugo.
Beautiful property with everything you need if self catering, once you navigate the door entry for first time and narrow staircase to carry luggage up to apartment.
Air conditioning was essential this week for sure!
Unfortunately I found Alfama very hard to not get lost!
I prefer a quieter location and home, so for me personally it was too noisy both inside and outside (ie hearing people thudding about upstairs).
Alfama certainly know how to celebrate in the streets this week and looked fun for locals, but
music until 5am and street processions at 10.30pm were not for me. This is not Hugo's fault though!!

Un très bel appartement au cœur d’un superbe quartier de Lisbonne !
Nous avons passé un très agréable séjour chez Hugo et Silvia. Rien à redire sur ce beau logement idéalement placé dans le quartier d’Alfama. L’arrivée s’est faite facilement, le logement est bien équipé et la vue magnifique.
Les bruits de pas venant du dessus le matin sont finalement le seul bémol de l’appartement.
Merci Hugo et Silvia pour ce Airbnb ! :)
A great flat in Alfama. Easy to walk to other neighborhoods. The hosts were wonderful. Very attentive! Highly recommend the flat!
Perfect apartment for a trip to Lisbon. Great location, well equipped and clean. Check in smooth and easy. Host was lovely and easy to interact with.

Great location in the heart of Alfama!  The flat was on the 3rd floor (which means climbing some stairs, but we didn’t mind). We could see the river from our room. Our host arranged for private transportation to and from the airport — GREAT decision!  Lots of restaurants and grocery marts to get supplies. Would return and highly recommend. 👍
We had a great time at Hugo and Silvia’s.  The location is perfect and everything was as presented in the listing.  We would definitely stay here again!

Good location, very clean, good security, compact but comfortable stay. As you would expect in the city centre the balcony is a Juliette balcony. Accurate listing. Good communication from host.  Nice touches that made the stay pleasant.

We spent an amazing 4 days in Hugo & Sylvia’s flat.  Hugo was a very responsive and helpful host, making suggestions for things to do and where to eat and even offering to make dinner reservations for us at his favourite restaurant! The flat is immaculately clean and has everything you need for a comfortable stay.  The location is excellent with amazing views of the river and is an excellent base for exploring Lisbon.  When not walking we used public transport as the metro, bus and tram were all in walking distance from the flat.  Yes Alfama is hilly and it’s a climb to the flat but 1. It’s worth it for the views and 2. You get to work off all the amazing food you will eat!! Thank you Hugo for a very enjoyable stay!

Great accomodation with just everything you need, clean, airy & spatious and of a very good taste. There is divine silence at night, though as it is a historical building, you can hear the steps of people walking in the flat above you which can wake you up in the morning. The bed is very comfortable and soft (but not too much).
Both the door of the building and the appartment are accessed through an app, so make sure your mobile phone ia always charged otherwise you won’t be able to get home. Also, I was personally unable to open the main door using the app, and had to call the owner on my arrival to open it for me but once you get inside the appartment, there is a key you can use, which I think is better. The apparment door already does work smoothly.
There are quite narrow and steep stairs, if you have a large luggage it can be difficult to manipulate it inside. Something smaller is definitely preferable ☺
Generally this was a great experience and I had a delightful stay in the very heart of Alfama ❤

Séjour très agréable dans le meilleur quartier de Lisbonne !
Nous aurions aimé rencontrer nos hôtes, mais ils étaient très réactifs par message.
Joli appartement. Aucun bruit venant de l’extérieur, en revanche on entend beaucoup les voisins du haut.
Nous recommandons !

This is a wonderful gem in Alfama with a water view and great neighborhood. Hugo is very good at responding to any question you ask him.
The only warning, as mentioned by others, if you have bad knees this might not be the place for you. There are stairs - but those stairs lead to this gem and great view!!
Great place with an awesome location! Would definitely stay again!
Excellent Airbnb in a great location. The hosts are very attentive and they keep a clean house. I would definitely stay here again.
Great location right in the heart of Alfama. Super easy check in process, and the apartment was super cute and looked just like the pictures

The arcade (as JT homes calls it) is one of the most unique and wonderful places we have ever stayed. Every detail in this home is done with a purpose. From the fresh smell of the space, the light drenched living room with street view, to the stone walls, you feel like
you’re staying in a luxurious, upscale resort. The owners could not be more friendly or accommodating. You can tell they absolutely love to have visitors and love their city. They provided such a detailed list of things for us to do in Porto, were readily available via text with any questions we had, and happily checked in on us to see if we needed anything. Everything is walkable from the Airbnb. We were only there one night, but felt like we were family upon leaving. We can’t say enough about this airBnB, the owners or Porto itself. 10000 stars.
Great apartment! Cozy and a good location. The view was really cool.

Alfama Blue House is a modern and stylish apartment in the historic district of the city. We found it a great base to explore and the ocean views were a great start to the our days. The apartment is on a hill but the walk up and down is doable without being super fit. If you don’t fancy walking, the famous 28E tram is easily accessible within a 2 minute walk. Only met Hugo on arrival but he was very helpful with arranging a transfer from the airport and storing luggage before check-in.  Would definitely recommend the apartment and felt it was good value.

The flat is great for a single traveler or a couple. Although you are located away from the city center of LIsboa, you can easily take a tram (trolley), bus, or metro to reach the sites. The flat was clean and beautifully decorated. I had brought a converter for the outlet but mine was not working so I appreciated that there was one at the flat. There are tour books available at the flat for planning your day and I used them a lot. The coffee maker was convenient and the kitchen was well stocked. I did not cook or watch tv so I cannot speak to those.
The Alfama neighborhood is hilly and was designed to confuse invaders so the streets are challenging to maneuver especially if you are directionally challenged as I am. I enjoyed getting lost but was very relieved when I located the flat.

Absolut zu empfehlen!!! Sehr sauber, mit einem Super Ausblick zum Meer und in einer ruhigen Gegend, abseits der großen Straßen!
Es war eine wunderschöne Zeit! Vielen Dank!
Very lovely flat, extremely good neighborhood

Appartement très bien situé pour profiter de l’Alfama pleinement. Appartement bien équipé. Hugo est un hôte très réactif !
Seul petit bémol, personne au sommeil léger s’abstenir ! Aucune isolation phonique dans le coin chambre, on en tout se qu’il se passe au dessus, les pas, le vibreur du réveil entre autres…
Spacious flat, good appliances (big fridge, cooker, coffee machine, etc.). Great view from the living room to the sea. All in all great stay.
hugo was very kind and the house is amazing with great view. Unfortunately there were some leftovers hair on the wall/door of the bathroom, probably just a lack of attention during cleaning. cheers
Hugo and Silvia were great hosts, promptly responding to my questions and requests. Their flat is comfortable and the view is great, providing authentic Alfama experience.

Hugo and Silvia have an adorable loft located in the heart of Alfama. We accessed it on foot, from the Santa Apolonia train station, and by Uber nearby without any difficulties. It was so fun to wander the streets of Alfama and get lost in the twisting cobblestone roads! The loft itself had everything we needed and is great for couples. Not to mention a beautiful view of the water from the front windows!

Loved the place.
Apartment is very centrally located.
Check in was uncomplicated.
Host was very kind.
All in all I can highly recommend the place.
Nice apartement in the old city center. Very clear and good comunication with Hugo, highly recommended

El apartamento es perfecto: bien ubicado y con todo lo necesario para que la estadía en Lisboa sea genial.
Hugo & Silvia fueron excelentes hosts: comunicación fluida y muy atentos.
Muy recomendable!

A perfect stay at Hugo & Silva's apartment. This comfy apartment is incredibly located at the heart of the famous Alfama neighbourhood, with a lot of natural light and a great view of the Tage. Hugo & Silva were great hosts and easy to communicate with. We definitely recommend it !

Un séjour très agréable dans ce charmant logement.
Hugo était très disponible pour répondre à nos questions quand cela était nécessaire.
Le logement est très bien situé, confortable, et bien équipé.
Tout ce qu’il faut pour passer un agréable séjour à Lisbonne

Todo perfecto.
El único pero el sofa, es muy bonito pero no muy cómodo.
Lo demás todo genial.

Fantastic flat for exploring Lisbon and Alfama. Flat contains everything required for a comfortable holiday. Amazing views of the river from the balcony.
Cheers, Ethan

Hugo and Silvias apartment is just as is advertised. The inside is clean, updated and comes with everything needed to have a comfortable stay. The apartment location is perfect for a stay in the hills of alfama with a great view. Make sure you pack light because there’s walking! Overall wonderful stay and will be back.
The location was excellent, the apartment clean and well equipped. It was a pleasure to spend a few days there - would recommend choosing this for a Lisbon stay!

הדירה הייתה מאוד נקיה ומזמינה, דיי זהה למה שמפורסם כאן בתמונות
המיקום שלה באלפמה מאוד יפה ויחסית קרוב לכל דרך תחבורה אפשרית, אבל לכל כיוון הדרך היא עליה תלולה או ירידה תלולה

Logement hyper agréable et super bien situé à Lisbonne.
Nous recommandons!

We never met Hugo, but if you have any questions, he is there for you via WhatsApp. The flat looks a bit bigger in the photos than it is, but it is perfectly adequate. The bathroom is small and the flat is very bright, clean with steep stairs in the beginning. The location is unbeatable central and the view just great. I would definitely recommend the flat as you are right in the middle of the beautiful old town on Tram 28.

Apartament was exactly like in description, the view from window was perfect.
In response to some comments before, the couch is now new :)

Great stay in Lisbon! This apartment is in such a beautiful area and within walking distance to the top attractions and sights in Lisbon. Hugo was a great host and very communicative. He helped us check in and made sure we were comfortable during our stay. Highly recommended!
Great apt! Great location, very cute inside, and easy check in and out process. Hugo and Silvia were very responsive. Would definitely recommend !
5/5 apartment has great location and value. Beautiful view to the ocean from the balcony. Hugo&Silvia answered to all of our questions almost immediately. Great place!

Great place with a nice view! Very quiet street despite being close to everything.

Thoroughly enjoyed our stay at the apartment, in an ideal location for exploring Alfama!

Apartment was great. Nice layout and lots of room. Beautiful view of the water. It’s in a great spot to access fado restaurants and all the good things in the Alfama. The stairs going up to the apartment are quite steep so people with reduced mobility might find it hard. It’s was also hard to find in the beginning but  the odd numbers are on one side and down the street are the even numbers, and once you walk around a bit and get used to the area it’s easier. The area is  really cute and the apartment is really comfortable. The shower is a weak  but overall I enjoyed my stay

Perfect for two, clean and nicely decorated apartment in the oldest neighborhood of Lisbon.
Be prepared for lots of climbing.
Stop for Tram 28 is close by.
Hugo et Sylvia réagissent rapidement , ont organisé pour nous le transfert de l'aéroport très efficace. L'appartement est propre et bien équipé, bien situé.

We loved the apartment, everything you need is there and it is the same as you see it  in photos. The most amazing thing for us was the view from the apartment, it was incredible and it just made our days in Lisbon more special. Hugo was also very helpful and responsive.

Nous avons passé 3 nuits dans l appartement de Hugo et Silvia. Nous pouvons que recommander ce lieu pour un très agréable séjour à Lisbonne. Nous avons était merveilleusement bien accueillis par Hugo, qui a également était très arrangeant pour l heure d arrivée. L appartement est parfait ! Super propre, conforme aux photos et surtout localisé dans le plus vieux cartier et plus authentique quartier de Lisbonne. Nous recommandons sans hésiter!! Encore un immense merci Hugo pour tout. J espère que nous pourrons vite revenir à Lisbonne.

L'emplacement de l'appartement de Hugo est parfait, le logement est rénové et il est moderne. Le soir, on entendait par la fenêtre ouverte le Fago qui résonné dans Alfama et c'était relaxant. L'appartement est bien situé avec une vue magnifique sur le tage et il est à 2min du tram 28.
A bientôt !
Super hôte accueillant et disponible! L’appartement qui est bien situé, a répondu à 100% a nos attentes!
Hugo war ein super Gastgeber, wird wurden herzlich empfangen. Die Wohnung ist sehr schön und sauber an guter Lage. Check-in hat bestens funktioniert. Wir würden sofort wiederkommen.

A fantastic location - in amongst great restaurants & fado in Alfama. Hugo was great with communication & met us at the apartment & gave us helpful tips on eating & sightseeing. Like all places in Alfama, there are many steps to climb to get to the apartment. A great stay.

Think of a 21st century apartment parachuted into an 9th century medina. We had a wonderful eight days in the Alfama in this spectacular and well located apartment. I loved opening the door/windows with french balconies in the morning and watching the ships come into or leave the river and harbour of Lisbon or to open them at night and listen to the Fado music drift up from enumerable restaurants or the distant rumbling of Tram 28 on the street above us.  The location allowed us to walk to the centre of the City and access transit to take us further a field. It was a very comfortable apartment with excellent AC. The Alfama, is located on a large hill (the rest of Lisbon is built on a total of seven hills) and therefore there a many twisting, steep, and narrow roads linked with many large sets of stairs. A car is next to useless but transit is easily accessable. As the apartment is located on the third floor there is a narrow set of stairs going up to the apartment. You should note that my wife and I are in our mid 60s and found that it was only a small challenge to navigate.

Hugo est un très bon hôte. Il nous a très bien accueilli et a assuré le suivi pendant tout notre séjour. Il nous a prodigué de bon conseils pour découvrir Lisbonne. L appartement est très bien situé et tout à fait conforme aux photos.

Harmonie en bleu pour cet appartement superbement rénové, remarquablement propre, très bien placé et d'où l'on peut contempler les toits de Lisbonne et la Mer de Paille. Dans ce vieil immeuble on entend parfois les voisins mais l'appartement reste un havre de quiétude. Hugo et Silvia nous ont très gentiment aidés pour les transports, en nous proposant une solution pour aller nous chercher à l'aéroport et en nous réservant un taxi pour le retour. Bref, un excellent séjour !

처음 bnb를 이용해봤어요. Alfama의 중턱에 위치해있지만 Tajo 강변이 보이는 멋진 riverview가 강점입니다. 숙소에서 전망대와 tram 28 정류장이 가깝고요. 에어컨, 냉장고를 포함한 full kitchen, 커피 테이블까지 공간은 작지만 필요한 집기들을 아기자기하게 갖추고 있어요. 샴푸, 바디워시는 없었으니 참고하시고, 근처에 pingo dose같은 마트가 없으나 구멍가게는 있어요. 장기간 여행이신분은 근처 셀프빨래방을 이용하실 수도 있네요.

Très bien situé dans un magnifique vieux quartier de Lisbonne...parfait pour découvrir les restaurants locaux et écouter le Fado à deux pas. Hôte très attentif qui nous attendait et qui a porté nos valises dans l'étroit escalier. L’endroit est petit mais très propre et parfait pour deux voyageurs. Merci Hugo et Silvia pour votre accueil!
Gilles et Josée
Hugo was very helpful at check in, the flat was very clean, with a wonderful view.

L'appartement de Hugo et Silvia est parfait pour un séjour à Lisbonne. Situé dans le pittoresque quartier d'Alfama, il est idéalement placé pour découvrir ce quartier et les environs (Chateau Saint Georges accessible en quelques minutes et arrêt du fameux tram 28 à quelques pas) et la ville dans son ensemble (métro et gares à 10 min à pied) Bien que le quartier soit plutôt animé, l'appartement est très calme et parfait pour se reposer après une journée à gravir les collines de Lisbonne.
L'appartement est très bien équipé et très confortable.
Hugo a été très réactif et nous a accueilli chaleureusement ce qui est très appréciable. Le gros point fort de l'appartement est sa vue sublime sur le fleuve.
Je recommande vivement cet appartement à tous ceux qui veulent découvrir Lisbonne. Merci encore de nous avoir accueillis !

This place was great. We had trouble with our flights but Hugo was very understanding and helped to arrange transportation.  There is not a better location in the area. You are within walking distance of all the sights and some amazing food. He gave some great recommendations for food. Would recommend to anyone!!

Great flat in Alfama district of Lisbon! Clean and newly remodeled. Its three flights up and no elevator, so not friendly for people physical disabilities. It’s tiny, but it’s the perfect size for two people. It has a great view and is close to a lot of good restaurants and sites in Lisbon. The only issue we had was that there was not much water pressure for the hot water in the shower, only the cold water. I’ve alerted the host, and I’m sure he’ll fix it. We really enjoyed the flat and Lisbon!

Our stay at Alfama Blue House was very good. The place was very clean and had amazing views of Lisbon and the river. Only downsides are: small bedroom, lack of shampoo and body wash, lack of coffee and other kitchen essentials, and there are very steep hills from the train station to the apartment and the first set of stairs are also steep. But, the view, cleanliness, and location are all great.
Hugo & Silvia were attentive hosts. The flat was clean and tidy as expected. The Alfama location was extremely convenient to most attractions. Great stay from start to finish! Would stay again.

Hugo and Silvias place is in the perfect location and offers wonderful views. Hugo arranged a pickup from the airport and a taxi on our return which was very much appreciated as our return flight was early in the morning.
We had a great time in Lisbon and ate some wonderful food based on Hugos recommendations.
The apartment is spacious and clean with a very comfy bed and all the amenities you would need to cook.
Thanks for a great stay!

Central, charming area, easy access by foot, tram or TukTuk down to Baixa. Very nice communication with Hugo, who also very conveniently arranged transport from Oriente train station at our arrival. We were aware of the steep stairs to climb the first floor. The flat is functioning well, and is clean.

This is by far the best experience we have had to date in Air BnB. Hugo and Silvia are amazing hosts. From the start excellent communication, directions and instructions on how to get from the airport to Santa Apolónia metro station (the closest station to the apartment, which is only a short few minutes walk). When we arrived Hugo met us at the station and brought us to the apartment.
The apartment is absolutely perfect, spotless clean, fast wifi, in a fantastic location for exploring the city, and the view from the balcony is absolutely stunning. Waking up to a fresh coffee and this view out over Lisbon every morning was unbelievable. The area of Alfama is full of history, character, amazing views, and some of the best old seafood resteraunt I have every come across. The old Lisbon tram line also runs just around the corner from the apartment and is a must. If we are to return to Lisbon, or have any friends or family traveling I will most certainly be recommending Alfama Blue House. Thank you for everything Hugo and Silvia.

This is a beautiful apartment located in Alfama neighborhood of Libon. it is exactly as described with a nice view. Hugo is a
wonderful host. We
enjoyed everything about this Airbnb stay and we look forward to coming back in the future.

This apartment is absolutely the perfect place for a couple to stay and explore Lisbon. Wonderful location in heart of Alfalma neighborhood. The view is spectacular. Hugo was a great host very good at communicating and arranged transportation from airport for us. Highly recommend!

Nice appartement in prfect location. Very clean, friendly host, everything available.
Fully equipped kitchen.

Hugo and Silvia’s Alfama apartment was a perfect place to stay while in Lisbon.  It is in a lovely, historic neighborhood with fantastic views.  Our host was exceptional.  Hugo recommended restaurants and local sites and helped us figure out how to get to each one.  We had a great driver from the airport to the apartment who was also very kind and helpful.  We would definitely recommend staying at Hugo and Silvia’s apartment.

We loved staying here! It is in the Alfama neighborhood, which turned out to be our absolute favorite part of Lisbon. The water view from the room is beautiful. The apartment itself is very modern and clean. And the hosts were awesome. The one catch is that staying in Alfama requires you to take a lot of stairs to get anywhere, and the apartment is up several flights of stairs too. Definitely still worth it for us - but something to be aware of if you have mobility issues. Overall I would highly recommend!

This is a nice apartment with an amazing view of the river. The location is in a narrow and quiet Alfama street, close to many of the historic sights and viewpoints. There are also many small fado restaurants just around the corner. The stairway in this building is quite steep, and has not been modernized like the apartment itself. The apartment is not soundproof, so if you are a light sleeper, you will notice if people upstairs walk around in their apartment. Hugo is a very flexible and hands-on host, who is easy to communicate with.

The apartment is perfectly located in the Alfama district with it’s quaint cobblestone streets and alleys. At night the sound of the Fado music was great. Excellent restaurants nearby. Very close to no 28 Tram, Sai Jorge Castello and other Lisbon highlights. The stairs to the apartment are challenging but worth it!

Alfama is like a maze of traditional Portuguese houses. If you are thinking of taking heels think on as it’s flat Comfy shoes and a rucksack if you want Heels. The apartment is clean and has all you need and very secure. Temperature can drop at night so take an extra layer. Hugo was exceptional at communication and helps you so much . I would recommend this accommodation every day of the week. The views are stunning from the apartment and we feel lucky to have found this gem xx
The apartment is in a great neighborhood and Hugo was very helpful.

We loved our stay in hilly but picturesque Lisboa.  The apartment was very attractive, squeaky clean, and perfectly comfortable as well as economical.   The Alfama area is amazingly interesting with lots to do and see nearby, yet the apartment was on a quiet street and we felt safe there.  We enjoyed the complimentary hot tea and coffee each morning.  We were thankful that Hugo carried our suitcases up the steep steps and that he picked us up at the nearby station and arranged for a prompt taxi to the airport at the end of our vacation.  If you have no walking limitations, you cannot go wrong with this place!
je recommande vivement malgré le voisin du dessus parfois bruyant

L'appartement est très bien situé au centre du quartier historique. L'intérieur est joliment décoré et bien équipé. Malgré l'ambiance du quartier, l'appartement est très calme et parfaitement isolé. Il y a aussi une jolie vue sur le Tage. Hugo est très réactif et nous a commandé un chauffeur pour nous récupérer à l'aéroport. L'entrée et la sortie des lieux s'est faite sans aucun problème. Une très belle expérience à Lisbonne.
Apartamento muito giro e acolhedor, mesmo no coração de Alfama, com muitos restaurantes e muita vida! Hugo muito simpático e hospitaleiro! Muito obrigado! Experiência a repetir! :)

The apartment is located in a neighborhood which give you an opportunity to explore Alfama. Several Fado bars are nearby. A miradouro is also a few steps away from the apartment. The view from the balcony is awesome. Hugo is kind enough to pick me up from Santa Apolonia station. Highly recommended.

The apartment is really beautiful. It is in a wonderful location in the Alfama district. The view was very nice from the apartment. Hugo was very helpful in arranging transportation and offered great tips of things to check out!
Sehr schöne, saubere Unterkunft in ruhiger Lage in der Altstadt. Die Kommunikation war hervorragend. Hatten eine ausgezeichnete Zeit in Lissabon!

Everything was very good !
They were really Nice and accepted to give some additional hours in the flat to be flexible with our flight time .
Very Nice flat , very calm and nice area.
Thank you for your hospitality and réactivity
I really recommand this adress

L’appartement est génial, bien conçu et une vue .... digne des plus grands étoilés.
Hugo a été au top 👌
À très vite

Overall a good stay at Hugo & Silvia's. Exactly as described. Yes, there are a ton of narrow steps inside the building leading to the apt, BUT that is just what you get in an Alfama property. The hosts provided all the information we needed, but nothing above and beyond.

A great place for a visit to Lisbon. The central locality gave you a look at city life in Lisbon with lots of history. You did not have to walk far for a choice of dozens of restaurants. The bedroom was tiny but very comfortable. We were well rested for our adventures each day. Right near the yellow tram. Wonderful place.
We spent 4 days in this lovely, clean and comfortable apartment. Hugo was a very friendly host, the communication was easy and supportive. Highly recommended!

Fantastic little apartment. The view of the Tagus from the little French balcony is gorgeous, and the place is done out in a really well thought out manner. The location is central to many of the restaurants in Alfama. One word of warning - you need to be good on your feet, as it is a very hilly neighbourhood. That’s nothing against the apartment, but simply part of the geography of Alfama.
Hugo was very welcoming, making sure that he was always available via message should we need anything, and arranged a taxi pickup to take us back to the airport.
Definitely recommend staying here if you are looking for a good value, clean, cute little place in the middle of a fantastic district.
Thanks Hugo & Silvia!
Perfect location with a very nice view!! The appartement is clean and modern and Hugo is a really nice host! We will come back for sure :)

Schöne, helle, ruhige, sehr saubere und freundliche Unterkunft inmitten von Alfama. Herrlicher Blick auf den Tejo und über Teile von Lissabon. Sehr gut ausgestattete Wohnung. Kurzer Weg zur Metro. Freundliche Gastgeber. Die Wohnung befindet sich im 3. Obergeschoss in einem historischen, renovierten Haus und hat daher eine wirklich sehr steile, enge Treppe. Etwas hellhöriges Haus, aber dafür ist man mitten in der Altstadt. Sehr empfehlenswert.

Great location in the historic Alfama district. You need to be physically fit though, lots of steps and hills. Loads of great eating and drinking establishments nearby.
Hugo and Silvia are thoughtful, helpful and attentive hosts. They really helped us out, especially when we locked the keys inside on the first night! Great tips about arriving and parking as well. We loved our weekend in Lisbon - gained some weight too, which we tried to work off in the steep streets of Alfama, but didn't succeed! :)

We had an amazing time in this beautiful appartement. Hugo really went above and beyond to make sure that everything was perfect for us. The location of the flat is absolutely amazing, you're right in the middle of it all. Can't recommend this place enough! Me, my wife and our 10 months old daughter really enjoyed our time there.

A great place to stay in alfama neighborhood! Hugo and Joachim were amazing and communicative, the place is clean and quiet, the bed is comfortable, and it's a good base to explore all of Lisbon. Thank you so much! Elizabeth and Gilad.

Hugo is truly a "Super Host"!  He was more than okay for a very late check-in due to our flight and met us at the apartment to welcome us and showed us everything including tips about the city and the neighborhood.  He had arranged for our pick-up from the airport with a very nice gentleman who dropped us right infront of the apartment.  Hugo responded to all of our queries quickly from day 1 to the last and even helped us with a personal request.  He's a very friendly and patient host!  His apartment is an amazing place to stay at! The neighborhood of Alfama is a jewel! A piece of history beautifully still breathing ever so lively in the present!  The apartment was extremely clean and had a very fresh and new modern look to it yet very cozy and welcoming! Perfect for 2 people! He had everything stocked and available and the appliances worked great. One thing I'm very picky with is the quality of the towels and beddings and they were like new, clean and fresh! Hugo and his apartment gets only praises and no complaints from us! The only complaint is that we didn't stay there long enough! Thank you Hugo for making such a beautiful house available for people to enjoy and for taking such good care of your guests.  We loved the river view from the balcony and the charming restaurants with live Fado music so close to your house.  This place is worth every penny spent on it! :)

Un havre de paix dans ce quartier animé . La décoration est jolie et fraîche et aide à la détente....tout est accessible à pied dans ce quartier de l'Alfama. Nous recommandons aux gens qui viennent pour la première fois de prendre la solution de pick up à l'aéroport proposée par les hôtes, plus facile et rapide pour un prix raisonnable.
Merci à Hugo et Sylvia
Chris

These couple of days in Hugo & Silvia's flat were awesome. Everything was really well organized, starting with a pick up service from the airport, who organized the meeting with Hugo at the flat, even it was a little late in the evening. Hugo gave us nice advice about what to see in Lisbon and was always really helpful.
The view from the flat is amazing! You can have breakfast sitting in the sun...
The flat was really well equiped, we had everything that we needed (even coffee, oil, salt, etc... hair dryer etc). And a lot of details with love, we felt really comfortable. Also the localization in Alfama with everything in walking distance is great. It's a really quiet flat where you can sleep very well, and you have bars and restaurants around the corner.
Thanks Hugo and Silvia, for this nice stay in Lisbon and for your nice hospitality!
We would definitely return to your apartment!

We had a wonderful stay in Lisbon thanks to Hugo & Silvia place.
The view is amazing, the appartment is so clean, everything you need is inside, and the location is just great to discover this beautiful city.
Hugo came to pick us to the metro and gave us nice recommandations about the city, the area and where to enjoy Portuguese food!
I will definitively come back next time in Lisbon!!!

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour dans l’appartement d’Hugo et Sylvia, tout est conforme aux photos, l’appartement est moderne, très propre et fonctionnel, la literie est très bien (c’est toujours agréable!)
Hugo est très sympathique, de bon conseil et arrangeant, il nous a réservé le taxi pour l’aéroport lors de notre départ.
Pour ce qui est du quartier de l’Alfama il faudra cependant noter que ce quartier est beaucoup plus vivant en haute saison, en février (dans notre cas) le quartier est très calme et beaucoup moins animé que le Bairro Alto ou Chiado.
Idéal donc pour être au calme hors saison, mais moins si vous souhaitez baigner dans l’ambiance nocturne des bars, restaurants.
Nous recommandons chaudement cet appartement donc!

Hugo og Silvias lejlighed er super indrettet, den er ren og har en vidunderlig beliggenhed og udsigt. Lejligheden er placeret i hjertet af Alfama, som er det mest charmerende kvarter i Lissabon. De franske altandøre er sydvendte, hvilket giver solskin fra formiddag til sen eftermiddag. Gode restauranter og cafeer i nabolaget. Alt er godt - skynd jer at booke lejligheden :)
We really enjoyed seeing Lisbon from Hugo and Silvia’s place. It was lovely to come home to. Everything about it was just as indicated. We were very well looked after. I can’t rate it enough.
Very good location for someone that is visiting the city for a few days. The flat itself is a perfect size, not too big nor too small and very well equipped.
My wife and I loved our stay at Hugo & Silvia’s flat in the beautiful Alfama district of Lisbon. Great location, wonderful hosts & impeccable cleanliness made for a great 3 night stay.
Hugo and Silvia were great hosts giving lots of good tips and help when needed. There place is cozy and located in a perfect location to see Alfama.

Tolle Wohnung. Die Kommunikation im Vorfeld unseres Aufenthaltes und währendessen sowie der Check-In haben super geklappt. Die Wohnung selbst war sehr sauber und hatte alles, was wir während unseres Aufenthalts gebraucht haben. Der Ausblick ist fantastisch. Die Lage ist auch sehr gut. Wir sind fast überall hin gelaufen. Von uns also eine absolute Empfehlung!

Second time staying in this wonderful apartment. Great river view, lovely location in the vibrant alfalma neighbourhood. Highly recommend for couples looking for a nice chilled out cosy space. Already planning my return trip.

El piso de Hugo y Silvia es genial - todo muy, muy bien! (todo igual de como parece en las fotos) Lo pasamos fenomenal!
Es un piso muy bonito, limpio, cómodo, tranquilo y tiene unas vistas preciosas.
Está ubicado en un barrio típico de Lisboa con mucho encanto "Alfama" y se puede ir andando a todos lados para visitar la ciudad.
Hugo estuvo muy pendiente/atento con nosotros y nos ayudó mucho en aparcar y nos dio muchas recomendaciones que nos ayudó mucho en disfrutar de la ciudad.
¡Volveríamos sin duda! Gracias Hugo!!

We loved staying in Hugo's apartment. Hugo is very responsive and kind. He even picked us up from metro station when we arrived at Alfama. The location is great and clean but the view from the balcony is what we will always remember from Lisbon. Thanks to the Hugo's recommendation, we experienced also a really nice real Fado night. So, Hugo's flat will be our first choice for our next visit!

This flat is in the heart of Alfama and has a great view of the river.  There is really nothing lacking here and the place is very comfortable whether you’re coming back from a long tiring day of sightseeing or just spending a quiet night in.  You can open the balcony doors and hear the Fado music in the evenings but is still on a quiet street with mostly only foot traffic, so is otherwise fairly quiet.  Hugo was very gracious, picking us up at the railway station, and taking us to the flat - even helping to carry up our luggage.  He gave us a great overview of the area, helping us plan our short stay there.  We really recommend this place if you have the chance to stay here.

We loved staying here! The location is great and the view can’t be beat. It’s a short walk to Santa Apolonia station and located in the heart of Alfama district. We had a great time and loved coming back to a cozy apartment at the end of the day.

Hugo and Silvia’s place is fantastic. Nestled in the Alfama district, you can enjoy wonderful views from the living room balcony. The neighborhood is safe and quiet but you can hear Fado singers at night from nearby restaurants. The apartment has all of the amenities you need and is very clean. Lastly, Hugo was super helpful during our stay, walked both of our bags up the three flights of stairs and was responsive with communication when we reached out. We enjoyed our stay and recommend this apartment and Hugo as a host.

Sehr zentral gelegen, sehr hell, toller Ausblick! Küchenausstattung für jemanden, der selber kochen möchte ok. Die Kommunikation mit dem Gastgeber  war sehr gut. Die Wohnung ist aber hellhörig, man nimmt am Leben der Nachbarn teil.

A estadia na casa do Hugo foi fantástica. Desde o check-in e a forma exemplar como o Hugo recebeu-nos, até à experiência do bairro de Alfama. Espaço muito
acolhedor, limpo e exactamente como descrito no anuncio da Airbnb.
Recomendo vivamente a todos os futuros hospedes.
5*

A great place! We had a great stay in Hugo and Silvia's place. Unfortunately we didn't meet Hugo but he was very reactive by phone our email. The flat is very comfortable with magnificent views. We are looking forward to coming back again. Thanks for everything Hugo and Silvia!

Es ist eine sehr schöne Unterkunft, genauso wie beschrieben, alles sehr sauber und schön eingerichtet. Das Apartment liegt perfekt mitten in Alfama, von wo aus man alles zu Fuß erreichen kann. Es gibt genügend Restaurants und Bistros direkt in der Nähe.
Great location, close to many restaurants.
It is a vers nice and quiet place. Hugo is very arranging, helping you for the transferts from and to thé airport. Only a balcony bigger is missing to put a longchair !! 😊

Très belle prestation pour cet appartement décoré avec goût, propre, calme et fonctionnel. Comme sur les photos, la vue est superbe et l appart est idéalement situé dans le quartier typique d'Alfama. On y dort tres bien grâce à une bonne literie et une bonne isolation sonore. Allez y les yeux fermés! Hugo est facilement joignable et de bon conseil

Vi havde nogle dejlige dage i Silvia og Hugo Lejlighed.
Fin, ren, hyggelig og godt placeret i gå afstand til det meste.
Hugo og Silvia var søde til at kontakte os flere gange for at tilbyde deres hjælp, med stort og småt.
Vi tager gerne tilbage, og kan VARMT anbefale stedet!
Mette

This is a great location in Alfama. Close to Porta del Sol and Tram 28 , with a beautiful view from the small balcony.
The apartment is well appointed.
Hugo patiently waited for us to check in (It took us well over an hour via metro from the airport) and carried our heavy suitcase up the stairs. He provided helpful information on what to do during our short stay. And helped us arrange a taxi back to the airport.
There is a little bakery (Alfama Doce) not too far if you want to have breakfast with the locals or take goodies back to the apartment. Be prepared to walk a lot of steps in that neighborhood, it is worth it.
Apartamento exatamente como descrito, limpo e com uma vista incrível! Recomendamos a todos!

Die Wohnung in der Alfama ist großartig, mit einem tollen Blick über den Tejo und die Stadt. Alles war blitzblank sauber und die Abwicklung war sehr einfach und komfortabel.
Lediglich das Treppenhaus ist

테라스의 전망이 정말 멋져요. 호스트와 연락도 잘 되구요, 불편하지 않게 배려해주는 모습이었습니다. 알파마 지구라서 언덕길이 많지만 리스본 전망을 볼 수 있는 곳들이 주변에 많이 있어요. 28번 트램 정류장이랑도 가까웠구요. 침대나 침구류 모두 깨끗하게 준비되어 있었습니다. 근처에 파두 공연하는 식당이 있어서 밤 늦게까지 소리가 잘 들려요.! I couldn't have asked for a better place! We had a great time in Hugo and Silvia's Blue house. Thank you :)

Mehr Mittendrin und trotzdem erholsam und ruhig geht kaum! Wir wurden von Hugo herzlich in Empfang genommen. Er half uns beim Ausladen, und beim Finden eines geeigneten Parkplatzes!
Die Wohnung entspricht voll den Erwartungen der Bilder!
Der Ausblick ist wirklich malerisch!
Die Wohnung ist sehr sauber und kinderfreundlich. Sogar ein Babybett war für unsere kleine Tochter bereitgestellt. Trotz der sehr zentralen Lage, ist es am Abend relativ ruhig, was wir mit einem Kleinkind als sehr angenehm empfanden!
Die Ausstattung ist top!
Wir würden jederzeit wiederkommen!

No words needed. We fell in love with the city and the apartment. Actually the view is even better than  on the pictures. Just awesome! We really hope to come back one Day. Thank you so much for letting us stay, giving so useful advices and helping us organising the trip. :))
Great apartment and location for our Lisbon visit.

Super Lage und Wohnung um Lissabon und Alfama zu erkunden. Kleine aber sehr feine Wohnung - exakt wie auf den Bildern - mit tollem Blick auf den Tejo. Die historische Tramlinie 28 fährt in unmittelbare Nähe, es gibt sehr gute und günstige Restaurants keine fünf Min zu Fuß entfernt. Und trotzdem sehr ruhig.

The apartment is very charmingly decorated, modern and well organised.
The location is second to none. What a delight to enjoy a morning coffee in the sunshine looking at the river.
Public transport are very close and the neighbourhood offer nice day walks as well as an enjoyable nightlife.
It is a perfect location to discover what Lisbon has to offer.
Hugo is a very friendly host, very helpful and full of great advices and recommendation.
I highly recommend his place.
