A beautiful apartment with everything you need, perfectly located in the Alfama district of Lisbon. A little gem. Hugo and Silvia are perfect hosts. Great communication and very helpful.  The apartment is exactly as described and seen in the photos. Thank you Hugo and Silvia!

Alfama Blue House was perfect! Exactly how it appears on the photos. Hugo very kindly came to meet us and let us in early to suit our arrival time. The flat was lovely and clean, very comfortable bed and it's in a really great little part of Alfama, we loved it, we'll be back! Thank you to Hugo for everything!

Hugo and Silvia's flat is just perfect : amazing view, cute decoration and very clean. It's well located in a calm street, perfect to visit Alfama and near a metro station (5min by foot).
Hugo is a friendly host, his advices about Lisbon were very revelant.
We spent a very good stay in Lisbon thanks to this apartment !

Dès notre arrivé à l'aéroport, Joaquim est venu nous chercher! Puisque nous étions trop tôt pour acceder à l'appartement, il a gardé nos valises jusqu'à 14h et nous a rejoint pour nous donner accès ensuite. Très gentil, excellente communication. Appart bien décoré, très propre et calme! Situé à proximité de tout dans un quartier moins touristique, ce que nous avons apprécié! Nous le recommandons sans aucune hésitation!
Everything you need in a great spot

We had a great experience living at Hugo's and Silvia's apartment! It is at a very convenient location in the Alfama area, 10 mins walking distance from Santa Apolonia station and 2 minutes from the historic tram 28 route. It was very clean, well equipped, with lovely decorations and a nice river view. Hugo had been very responsive in all communications and very hospitable. He kindly accepted to check us in early at the time of our arrival. He took the time to explain all the features in the house, the neighbourhood and give us recommendations for restaurants. He very kindly offered us a nice bottle of wine which we enjoyed with the river view on our wedding anniversary! We really felt like we were at home in Lisbon and highly recommend it!

Hugo was an excellent host and the flat was just as described and pictured. It was in the perfect location on a quiet street in the heart of Alfama with great views of the river and the rooftops. Hugo suggested a wonderful restaurant and gave us excellent information about the area and the city. We would definitely recommend and look forward to returning in the future!
We had a great stay at Hugo&Silvia's place and we would definitely recommend it to a friend! :)

Great place to stay! Hugo was great with communication. He gave us some great advice on where to eat. Make sure you have google maps as Alfama can be a very confusing place to get around if you don't!

I can highly recommend this lovely apartment in one of the best areas in Lisbon! It has an amazing view and the host Hugo welcomed us in person and even brought our luggage up to the apartment. We would come back any time!

Hugo was very attentive and responsive. The place was beautifully decorated, very clean, and in a wonderful location. There wasn't a question Hugo couldn't answer, or request he couldn't accommodate. I am hoping to stay here again during my next trip to Lisbon - whenever that may be. Highly recommended!

Wie ja alle schreiben die Betreuung durch Hugo perfekt.
Für einen airbnb-Neling wie mich war es spannend, wie alles laufe würde un es könntenictbsser orgaisert sein. Ob nun dieKommunikation vorab per Mail, die gschicte Präsetation oder insbsondre die Abholung per Auto an der Metrostation mit prsönliche Einweisung in das Appartement.
Die Lage ist toll, Alfama mit seine vrwinkete Gassen un morbidem Charme ist für Erkundunggänge super, die berühmte electrico 28 fährt glic um die Ecke.
Das Appartemet entsprac schlicht den Bildern und das ist gut so. Man hat wirklich einen Blick auf den Tejo. Alles war sauber, die Einrichtung ist mit Geschick und Geschmack gemacht. Der Weg durch as Treppenhaus bietet eine Blick in da Viertel: morbid und etwas abenteuerlich, um so bemerkenswerter der Kontrast zur Wohnung.
Ich möchte gern noch einmal hin!
Olaf aus Hamburg

Hugo & Silvias Studio in der Alfama ist ein Juwel; eigentlich 6 Sterne wert! Die Kommunikation vor und nach der Buchung war perfekt. Hugo organisierte uns einen Fahrer, der uns spätabends noch von unserem verspäteten Flieger abholte. Wir erlebten ein herzliches Willkommen und eine sehr gute Einführung beim Check-in. Das Apartment liegt mitten in der Alfama, 10 min von der U-Bahn, 3 min von der Straßenbahn, mit wunderbarem Blick über den Fluss – einfach traumhaft! Alles neu renoviert, sehr sauber, mit Liebe zum Detail, und angenehmer Klimaanlage. Hugo ist ein perfekter Gastgeber, und hat uns zur Abreise sogar noch ein Taxi organisiert. Wir können diese Unterkunft nur wärmstens weiterempfehlen, und würden jederzeit wieder kommen!

Mieszkanie ładne, przytulne i wyposażone we wszystko czego potrzeba (wyposażona kuchnia, super sypialnia, ze sporą szafą, jest też klimatyzacja). Położone w najciekawszej dzielnicy Lizbony - Alfamie, ze świetnym balkonem i bardzo ładnym widokiem na okolicę. Bardzo dobrze skomunikowane (autobus i metro) jest świetną bazą wypadową do wszystkich atrakcji. Do tego jeszcze bardzo mili i gościnni gospodarze, którzy są pomocni w każdej sytuacji, m.in. dzięki nim pierwsza podróż do mieszkania przebiegła gładko i bez żadnych problemów. Polecamy serdecznie i sami mamy nadzieję jeszcze tam wrócić.

Hugo's apartment is absolutely beautiful. It looks EXACTLY like the photos he posted on Airbnb. Super clean and modern with all of the amenities you'd need. He even left us a complimentary bottle of wine! Just so nice and throughtful. He set us up with a ride to and from the airport to the apartment, which is above and beyond what any Airbnb host has ever done in my experiences. His communication was quick and resourceful, giving us recommendations for beaches near Lisbon and dinner within our neighborhood. The overall experience was absolutely incredible.

Thank you to Hugo and Silvia for a fantastic stay at Alfama Blue House II.  The apartment is brilliantly located for public transport, sight seeing and eating options and the view was amazing to wake up to everyday. Alfama is a maze of twisty turny alleyways, hills and steps but well worth spending time there.  We mostly ate in restaurants in that area at night  There is no lift in the building and the apartment is on the third floor up some quite steep stairs.  However, this was not a problem for us at all, and it helped to burn some calories after enjoying the local hospitality! Hugo very kindly picked us up at St Apolonia station when we arrived on the Metro from the airport and was in communication prior to our stay with useful information and recommendations for places to eat. I would fully recommend staying here.

This apartment is very modern and has obviously been recently remodeled.  Overall it is very roomy, clean, and comfortable for two people although the bedroom is small.  The view is fabulous overlooking the river and the rooftops from the two French doors in the living room.  A word of warning: there are quite a few steps leading up to the apartment and they are narrow and steep.  And I highly recommend taking the offer to have Joaquim pick you up at the airport or train station because the neighborhood is very confusing and you may have a hard time finding the place on your own.  We found the Alfama neighborhood to be charming and colorful with lots of small and wonderful restaurants and many choices for Fado.  There's also a great outdoor bar close by with views of the river.

Hugo is a great host, communication was precise and always on time, location and view of appartment in Alfama is better than I expected, cozy, nice, flat in historic center. Hugo helped arranged transfer from and to an airport, also suggested a lot of places to see around. Big thanks for hospitality, welcome wine, late check out opportunity, great appartment, hope to come back one day!

Hugo's and Silvia's flat has been the perfect spot for us! Great location in the wonderful Alfama area. Hugo picked us up at the metro when we arrived and gave us some interesting insights. We will definitely return and recommend this Airbnb gem!

Wunderschön gelegen in dem Stadtviertel Alfama, dem ältesten Stadtteil von Lissabon.
Gute Kommunikation mit dem Gastgeber, hat die Anreise für uns organisiert & uns abgeholt bei der Metrostation und uns noch ein wenig das Viertel gezeigt. Wir würden wieder kommen!

This is a perfect apartment located in Alfama with views of the river for a stay in Lisbon! We stayed at this apartment for three nights while exploring Lisbon. Hugo picked us up from the train station and checked us in to the apartment and gave us lots of good recommendations for places to go and eat (we loved Pateo 13 restaurant for great reasonably priced food!). The apartment is clean, modern and comfortable for two people. It is on the top floor so the views are so enjoyable! We loved walking around Alfama at night time and being able to come back to this beautiful apartment. Thank you Hugo, we will always remember our stay in Lisbon.

Excellent stay. Very CLEAN and modern apartment. In old building amd old neighborhood. Amazing views from the balcony. Very well equipped and modernised for short stay. Hugo is excellent: in communication, in making every effort to make your sta great. He helped us with transportation to and from airport. Gave a lot of tips and guidance for orientation in the city. Highly recommended place to stay, for those who do not afraid of the neighborhood on the hills and steep stairs to the 3rd floor without elevator.

We loved the apartment! It was the perfect size for two people and made a great home base for exploring Lisbon. It had everything we needed and was in a great location.
Hugo and Silvia were very quick to answer our questions and made our first AirBnB experience very enjoyable.

We really enjoyed our stay at Hugo and Silvia's. Hugo's recommendations for the area were spot on. Getting to the flat was easy and meeting meeting the host was problem free.
Thanks for having us! We can't wait to come back!
Kamil
Cudowne miejsce.swietna lokalizacja. Wszystko na najwyzszym poziomie. Polecam !!!

We really enjoyed this lovely place in a wonderful fascinating location. Hugo is a great host. He was proactive with sending all the necessary information ahead of time, accommodating (we had an additional unexpected guest joining us) and helpful – among other things with organizing a transfer for us from the airport which was a right thing to do considering smart phones’ struggles with navigating in these historic narrow streets.  We have great memories of Lisbon and Alfama Blue House. Thank you, Hugo!

This apartment was very clean, very comfortable and located in the coolest area of Lisbon. We are so glad that we chose the Alfama as home base. The ever changing view over the city to the river was spellbinding, especially when the Swallows were flying, the local church bells and the voices of locals immersed us right into local life.
Hugo was most helpful with our arrival, meeting us at the train station, taking us to the apartment and getting us settled. He arranged a cab to pick us up when we left. Though we never needed to contact him during our stay, I'm sure he would have been very helpful.
We will remember this trip with the fondest memories, and know you will be happy with your choice of staying at Hugo and Silvia's place.
Great place, beautiful view and super friendly hosts. My best air bnb experience, Hugo and Silvia were extremely helpful and accommodating. Thanks so much, can't wait to visit Lisbon again soon!
La qualité de l'accueil, et de l'hébergement ainsi que son emplacement au sein du quartier le pplus ancien de Lisbonne garantissent un merveilleux séjour

Just back from Lisbon after a lovely stay in the Alfama Blue House. Hugo met us at the train station on arrival and gave us a lift to the house. He gave excellent information on the area, which was useful. The apartment itself is very clean and modern with an excellent view of the sea. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay here, highly recommend!

The apartment is really central in the historic neighborhood of Alfama. M station, restaurants and most of the historic spots/monuments within walking distance. The apartment is superclean, all what we needed was there, fantastic view on the river and roofs. Hugo organizes a pick up from/to the airport when needed. Absolutely reccomended. Thanks Hugo and Silvia!

Die Wohnung von Hugo liegt im schönen Alfama Quartier mit malerischen Gässchen. Die Wohnung ist sehr sauber und schön eingerichtet. Lissabon bietet extrem viel, so dass wir nur zum Schlafen in der Wohnung waren. Hugo hat uns im Vorfeld eine Präsentation mit super Infos zur Anreise und Unternehmungen in / um Lissabon geschickt. Hugo konnte uns nicht persönlich empfangen, aber die Übergabe hat bestens geklappt und er war stets per Handy erreichbar. Wir hatten eine tolle Zeit :-)

We had a great time in Lisbon! The apartment was exactly as it looked in the pictures, even down to the welcoming bottle of wine on the kitchen table. Check-in and check-out couldn't have been simpler, especially as Hugo was able to pick us up from the metro station to take us to the apartment when we arrived. The views were fantastic and we couldn't have asked for a nicer location for our stay, the perfect base for exploring a lovely city!

Très bel appartement, tranquille, cosy, très propre et bien situé dans Lisbonne. Il se trouve dans le joli quartier de l'Alfama, vivant et pittoresque. Très jolie vue sur le Tage et le soir on peut même entendre le son du Fado...
Hugo est gentil, serviable et attentionné. Ses informations pour trouver l'appartement étaient très claires. Si je reviens à Lisbonne je retournerai chez eux sans hésiter. Très bonne adresse!
Had a great time at this flat in Lisbon. Nicely furnished, with a lovely view, in a great location. Appreciated flexibility about check in and good communication throughout.

Liebevoll eingerichtetes airbnb mit einem unglaublich schönem Blick über den Fluss. Flasche Wein und Wasser als kleines Willkommensgeschenk. Alfama ist eine tolle und vor allem ruhige Gegend zum Wohnen, möchte man jedoch näher am Nachtleben sein, empfiehlt sich eher barrio Alto. Wir würden jederzeit wiederkommen. Hugo und Silvia haben wir leider nicht angetroffen, stattdessen kam ein Freund sehr verspätet zum Check in und konnte uns leider keine Infos geben. Kommunikation mit Hugo lief aber super über die airbnb app!

Wir haben die Zeit in Lassabon sehr genossen. Die Lage des Apartments ist Alfama war die richtige Wahl. Die Anbindung an die Tram ist hervorragend. Die Umgebung ist auch hervorragend zu Fuß zu erkunden. Die Innenstadt ist fussläufig in 10 bis 12 Minuten zu erreichen und in der direkten Umgebung gibtbes zahlreiche Pastelerias zum Frühstücken und für Abends jede Menge Restaurants. Die Wohnung ist sehr gepflegt, absolut sauber und die Ausstattung absolut top. Wir können es nur weiter empfehlen. Auch ist die Gastfreundschaft und Hilfsbereitschaft äußerst positiv zu bewerten. Danke an Hugo&Silvia.

The Alfama Blue House is the right place to enjoy Lisbon. Very close to the center (10min walk), on the tramway 28 (20 steps away), in the middle of alfama with nice sourrunding and good view. The house is clean and exactly as described. No surprises and Hugo is a perfect host!
Strongly recommend!
Luigi
Lovely cosy flat in Lisbon's charming Alfama neighborhood with views to the River Tagus. Stylish and well-equipped with everything needed for a week stay or longer.
All we can say is: We will recommend this place to our best friends. Thank you for everything!

The hosts give their best to make it a comfortable stay. We were picked up and brought to the apartment which is very charming and cosy and in a lovely neighboorhood. The view on the river is stunning and we enjoyed our stay very much. Thanks!

Hugo went the extra mile to pick me up from the train station and show me around the neighborhood, explain public transportation, give suggestions, etc. When I was having a key problem (totally my fault), he responded to me within minutes. He also went above and beyond and reserved a taxi for me for my early morning flight. The flat was beautiful and was in a phenomenal location. I highly recommend staying here!
Excellent stay with gorgeous view of the ocean.  Everything  is as described.

That was a great airbnb experience!
Communication, comfort, location - everything wa great!
Hugo has picked us up near the train station, drove us to the flat by car and presented us with a bottle of wine, which was a very nice touch to our stay! Such things are what makes airbnb stays really special!
The appartment is modern and well-equipped with the things you might need. There is AC which also works on heating (which was quite useful in January). Alfama is beautiful and you have a view to Tejo river and roofs of Alfama from a small balcony.
The bed might be short for you if you are 190+ cm high. And the apt is a bit small with narrow passages between rooms. But this is the price you have to pay if you want to stay in an old historic building. And you won't be staying in a lot anyways because this is Lisbon, it is beautiful!
We definitely recommend staying at Hugo & Silvia's place and will do this ourselves whenever we are back to Lisbon.
really nice

Wonderful centrally located flat. Hugo was fantastic with communication and sent us a slide show about the neighborhood and places to visit.  The only, and very minor, thing I would note is the coffee maker was broken and we had a hard time finding the pods for the pod coffee maker.

The apartment was beautiful - especially the view. The flat was very tidy and well cleaned. In the kitchen you have everything to cook and at the arrival Hugo and Silvia brought us a bottle of good wine and a bottle of water. Also the late check in (11:30 pm) worked very well. Hugo & Silvia were such great hosts and they asked several times if everything is all right and answered every question. Everything was perfect :) We enjoyed our trip so much. Maybe we'll come back once again.

Une magnifique expérience ! Hugo est vraiment très gentil, il nous a même emmené en voiture de la station de métro à l'appartement. L'emplacement est idéal, au coeur de l'Alfama, dans une ruelle pleine de charme, à 2 pas de l'arrêt du tram 28, à quelques minutes à pieds du château. L'appartement en lui même est en tout point conforme aux photos, très propre, très cosy, avec une très belle vue. C'est l'appartement idéal pour une visite de Lisbonne !!

I can really recommend this place. From this flat you have amazing view on the river! Flat is clean and very cozy.
Hugo is very helpful, he also helped us with transportation from and to the airport.

If we come back to lisbon again we would love to stay here. It was wonderful, a dreamy journey to 1000 years past. Thank you so much for your hospitality, delicious wine and patient explanations of your recommendations.  Your place is truly amazing.
Nous avons passé un très agréable séjour. L'appartement est très bien situé au coeur du quartier Alfama. Nous le recommandons.

Everythink fine, pleasant host, nice flat but if you want to park your car on the flat not possible, traffic calmed area only for residents. But for me not a problem, i 5 min food distance you have a lot of parking space for the rental car. Gladly again.

Hugo's place is outstanding. It is impeccably clean, in a fantastic location and beautifully remodeled. Exactly as pictured, except that the view is even more gorgeous than the pictures show. Hugo is also a wonderful host-- he picked us up from the train station and gave us a neighborhood tour before dropping us off. He had excellent communication with us throughout. Couldn't recommend Hugo's place more highly; anyone would be lucky to stay here!

This apartment is absolutely wonderful! If we come back to Lisbon, we would definitely want to rent from Hugo & Silvia again.
First off, the apartment is impeccably clean. It is so well maintained and everything is set up so that we had everything we needed at our fingertips (wifi, hair dryer, towels, etc). Hugo even provided us with wine and bottled water on the house! Speaking of Hugo, he is a great host. He met us at the apartment and shared many local tips & recommendations with us which was so helpful!
The location of the apartment is in Alfama. A very unique neighborhood in Lisbon - so if you really want to get a feel of living like a local - this neighborhood is for you! It's really close to the Tram 28 line that you can use to get to the other neighborhoods very easily.
All in all - we really enjoyed our stay in Lisbon and it was made even better because we had such a great apartment to come back to every evening. Thanks Hugo and Silvia!

We had a wonderful stay in Lisbon. Hugo and Silvia's apartment was terrific. Hugo kindly collected us at the station and showed us the local area. The apartment was in a brilliant location, lovely view and a terrific base to explore the city from. All in all a great trip! Thanks Hugo and Silvia.

We had a truly amazing weekend in Lisbon. And it started great, Hugo picked us up form the airport and gave us some really good tips on sightseeing Lisbon. Thank you, Hugo, you're such a kind person. The flat is located in the beautiful district of Alfama and it has the most amazing view form its two balconies! We hope to be back! Highly recommended.
A wonderful welcome by Hugo & Silvia to a lovely apartment. Couldn't think of a better base to explore this fantastic city :)

We stayed 3 nights in Hugo & Silvia's apartment and had an absolutely fantastic time.  We were greeted at the airport by a very friendly driver organised by  Hugo who was able to hang on to our luggage until the apartment was free which was very helpful. The apartment is perfect - lovely and bright, and perfectly clean and best of all in the perfect location of beautiful Alfama.  I would love the chance to stay here again.  Thanks Hugo & Silvia for an extremely good first impression of your beautiful city, Lisbon.
Lovely accommodation,  beautiful views, close to town.
Très agréable séjour dans un superbe appartement conforme aux photos et descriptif. Propreté impeccable.

A really good place. The flat is clean, quiet but not far from the places to go out the evening.
Hugo is really helpfull.

The apartment is nicely located and has a perfect view across the water. Easy to access city by walking or taking the old tram just in the street behind the apartment. Hugo and Silvia shared very helpful information upfront and the apartment is clean has everything you need for a short stay.

Hugo and Silvia's apartment is fantastic. It is exactly as described and is in a perfect location. Hugo also collected us from the metro and gave us a small tour of the area. The apartment made our stay.

The apartment is beautiful and the pictures don't show off just how great the view is. We loved living in the old city of Alfama for a few days, where you can open the balcony doors and listen to the beautiful sounds of fado singers carry into the apartment. We were greeted by Hugo's wonderful wife and Hugo was in contact with us throughout the trip. The apartment is a short walk to most of the important sites, and the area is a blast to explore!
We had him order us a taxi to the airport, which only cost about €11. The only thing, Alfama is a very hilly and the apartment is on the 5th floor with no elevator, so if you are older or have knee problems, I might recommend not staying in Alfama. It was a perfect place for us though and I would not stay anywhere else!

This apartment shows that a lot of thought and love was put into making it super comfortable, couldn't have asked for more We had everything we needed, great view, quiet, everything worked perfectly in the apartment, what can we say we definitely recommend this little nest in Alfama a neighborhood with so much character and warmth
Thank you soooo much Hugo Silvia and joquin! Yedida and Avner

Hugo met us at the train station and gave us a guided tour of the neighbourhoods while on route to the flat. It was really helpful as Lisbon is a big city!

The flat itself is perfect, exactly how it looks in the pictures. The view is great- was really interesting to wake up and see a different cruise ship each morning.

Location is right in the heart of the Alfama district with some traditional small bars and restaurants nearby.

Hugo seemed really nice and when we return to visit Lisbon, we wouldn't look elsewhere for accomodation.

Thank-you!

Très bon accueil d'Hugo qui a eu la possibilité de venir nous chercher à l'aéroport. Appartement propre, cosy et très bien situé dans le quartier de l'Alfama (la nuit tombée, les chants de Fado remontent des rues !!). Hugo est resté disponible et de très bons conseils. Vous pouvez réserver les yeux fermés.

Place was great. Spectacular view from the window. amazing to wake up to.
Really good acoustic in the shower. Great for singing Fado!

We had a fantastic stay in this apartment. Hugo was such a welcoming host. He met us at the airport and on the way to the apartment he brought us to a couple of viewpoints, one of them is only a couple of minutes walk from his place.
This apartment is well equipped, comfortable, clean and in a great location. The spectacular views over the rooftops of the Alfama and the river were an added bonus.
Public transport is within easy reach from the apartment. The winding streets of the Alfama make exploring this area of Lisbon a joy as the sounds of Fado can be heard from the local bars offering this entertainment. All in all our experience of Lisbon was very positive and we know this was added to by our accommodation. We will definitely be returning.

Hugo und Silvia haben uns super über Lissabon informiert und sehr gute Insidertipps gegeben. Sie waren total freudlich und wir konnten uns jederzeit bei Problemen an sie wenden. Die Unterkunft und die Gastgeber waren einfach phantastisch. Wir können sie nur uneingeschränkt weiterempfehlen.
Hugo and Silvia's place was great! Great view and central location.

What a great place to stay for our week in Lisbon. Hugo was kind enough to collect us from the local train station. He brought us for a little tour of the area, including a lovely viewpoint giving us some information and tips for our week in Lisbon. The apartment itself is nestled in the middle of Alfama with a stunning view over rooftops to the river. The apartment was cosy, clean and well equipped. Only a two minute walk to a tram stop and in walking distance from some great restaurants and bars. I would highly recommend staying here, we will be sure to visit again!

I didn't expect that kind of view. One can oversee the river Tejo, roofs of the alfama up to the Miradouro das Portas do sol on your right from the two "french balconies". So, stepping out with two feet I had to clap my hands and sigh deeply.
Hugo was very kind and reachable throughout our whole stay. He even picked us up from the car-rental at Oriente, although a cab from and to the airport is just about 12 €.
The design of the accomodation is harmonious, the walls have a light touch of blue. On hot days it endows you with a cooling atmosphere.
Our so far still favourite restaurant "Pateo13" is not even a five minute walk away. Sé Cathedral about 10 minutes. If you wanna leave to Sintra, Rossio Station is about a 25 minutes walk. The closest mini-market is just one stairflight up from the apartment. The closest bus-station - do not think you could use the 28 tramway during the day to get from A to B, it's packed - is a 7 minutes walk to the Casa do Conto station. From there within 25 minutes you can get directly to "Belem" (Jéronimos Monastery) with Bus No. 728.
And last but not least: Anyone who has already been to Lisboa can confirm that staying in the heart of Alfama is the key to happiness!

Thank you, Hugo, for supplying us two tourist with that diamond of an accomodation!

Even though our plane landed at midnight Hugo picked us from the airport and on our way to apartment showed us magnificent view of Lisbon from one of the 'Miradouros'. Additionally he gave us a lot of helpful hints of what to see/do in Lisbon.
The apartment, which offers Tejo river view, is cozy, clean, very well equipped and located in the heart of Alfama (oldest district of Lisbon). You can not expect more!

The perfect base for a short break in Lisbon. The apartment was exactly as described and we really appreciated Hugo picking us up from the nearby train station even after we were delayed - thank you! He also arranged a taxi for our departure. The Alfama area has lots of character and easy to walk to nearby Chiado and other areas, as long as you don't mind some steep roads and lots of steps! We left feeling we had a really authentic first trip to Lisbon, I'm sure we'll be back!

Le logement était en tout point exact à la description et extrêmement propre. Nous sommes restées 5 nuits, juste parfait pour découvrir Lisbonne d'autant que l'appartement situé dans l'Alfama est très central. Vue en effet sur le Tage et même si le balcon ne permet pas de poser table et chaises, la table du salon située près de la fenêtre permet de prendre ses repas avec vue sur Tage. L’appartement est situé dans un quartier calme et même si le fado (très agréable) prend parfois le dessus :), il est aisé de fermer la fenêtre (double vitrage). Assurément, nous reviendrons à Lisbonne. Nos hôtes étaient en congés pendant notre séjour mais ils ont tout fait pour que cela ne se ressente pas. Organisation avant départ + possibilité de contacter un de leur ami pendant notre séjour. Vraiment rien à redire et A conseiller.
Lisbonne est une ville ou il fait bon vivre. Sortez parfois des itinéraires indiqués dans les guides et découvrez les cafés, restaurants .... locaux ou vous serez toujours bien accueillis. Françoise
Very nice and cozy flat. Looks exactly like the pictures. Excellent location in the Alfama District. Very friendly host, would recommend without hesitation!
What you see is what you get! An truly honest advertisement for a wonderful apartment. Everything was perfect!

Hugo est très serviable et totalement dévoué au service de ses locataires. L'appartement est joliment décoré avec une belle vue sur le Tage.L'emplacement est parfait pour apprécier la douceur de la ville. Le logement est bien équipé pour un court séjour. Le bémol , les oreillers sont hauts et durs ..un détail ..

The place looks exactly as described. Perfect for two people. The air conditioning worked great and the building was quiet. Everything you need for a great trip to Lisbon - plenty of guide books, a quick tour of the neighborhood by Hugo on arrival, good wifi. Amazing view from the apartment as well. Other reviews have mentioned the challenging stairs, so you'll want to make sure you're fit enough for a few flights of narrow steps each day. Other than that, the apartment was perfect!

Neighborhood - Alfama is beautiful with nice restaurants and is not too touristy. One drawback is that the neighborhood is difficult to navigate, so uber has trouble locating the apartment and accessing it by car. Also, for groceries and ATM/cash, we found it easier to go closer to the city center.

Our stay at Hugo's and Sylvia's place was wonderful! My boyfriend and I truly enjoyed our stay and really recommend the apartment. If you are looking for a cosy, warm and well located place then look no further (+ the river view is amazing). Hugo replied instantly and he was a great host. All and all 5/5 experience!

The apartment was lovely and very well located in the old section of Lisbon. It was perfect to spend each day walking and exploring. Everything was as in the photos and listing, with wifi, a modern new kitchen and bathroom, and very clean. The view from the window was beautiful. Hugo was great for communication and very hospitable on arrival. I would definitely recommend!

Un séjour dès plus agréable grâce à l'extrême gentillesse et la disponibilité d'Hugo. L'appartement est douillet, clair, joliment décoré, d'une propreté impeccable et doté d'une très belle vue sur le Tage. Tout est fait pour se sentir chez toi. Un très bon souvenir !

Alojarse en este apartamento ha sido todo un acierto. Bien comunicado y cerca de todo. A pesar de que a nosotros nos gusta andar disponíamos a escasos metros del tranvía 28, maravilloso.  El apartamento muy limpio, sin ruídos, con aire acondicionado y unas espectaculares vistas sobre el río Tajo. Hugo estuvo siempre atento. Se ofreció a buscarnos a un punto de encuentro con su vehículo y tuvo un precioso detalle de bienvenida. Muy pero que muy recomendable. Gracias!!!!.

子連れ、海外携帯レンタル等で連絡取り合うのが難しいかも、と伝えたところ、空港まで迎え来てくれ、道中もいろいろ説明してくれました。
本当によくして頂いて、ポルトガル初日から期待値超えました！
エリアも、想定以上に便利な場所で、坂道はあるけれど感じの良い食堂やミニスーパー、トラム、メトロ、何もかも徒歩圏内。室内の清潔感や窓からの眺めなど、これからの旅路、これを基準にしたらどこもいまいちに感じるではないかと思うほどでした。ホストはさすがの評価通り、納得です。素敵なカップルでした！

Helt perfekt. Hugo var extremt professionell samtidigt som han var hjälpsam och trevlig. Lägenheten är i extremt bra skick och ser ut som på bilderna. Området är lugnt, trevligt och väldigt historiskt. Skulle inte tveka över att bo hos Hugo igen. Finns inget att negativt att anmärka på överhuvudtaget.

My lady and I had a wonderul time in Hugo's gorgeous flag. Location was and the view was stunning. However, the best thing was the huge mirror right in front of the bed, which gave us some nice "points of view"... jokes aside everything was perfect. Hugo is a great welcoming host. we totally recommend his flat for anyone visiting Lisbon.

Really enjoyed our stay in Hugo and Silvia's flat in Alfama. The flat was just as described on the listing and was really nicely decorated. Comfortable bed, nice view of the water which we enjoyed while eating breakfast and the flat was really clean and tidy with plenty of storage space. Was great to meet Hugo after the metro down from the airport, and he drove us to the flat passing a lookout point en-route to help us get our bearings. Hugo was really friendly and helped us quickly settle in. The flat is located in the heart of Alfama close to the centre of Lisbon in a friendly neighbourhood and it was easy to get to all the places we wanted to visit while in Lisbon. Would highly recommend staying at the flat and enjoying everything that Lisbon has to offer!

Hugo is a super host, it is a great place to see Lisbon from and the flat itself is a wonderful place to hang out.
Highly recommended

Die Wohnung von Hugo und Silvia war super schön, sauber und genau wie auf den Fotos abgebildet. Wir haben besonders den morgendlichen Blick auf den Fluss und das Stadtviertel sehr genossen. Hugo hat uns am Bahnhof sehr herzlich in Empfang genommen, so dass wir unseren Aufenthalt von der ersten Minute an genießen konnten. Die Lage der Wohnung ist super um Lissabon entweder zu Fuß oder mit der Tram 28, die gleich um die Ecke fährt, zu entdecken. Wir haben uns sowohl in die Wohnung als auch die schöne Stadt verliebt und können beides nur empfehlen :)

One of the best Airbnb I've ever been!  What an amazing view over the river. The apartment is in perfect order, tasteful decorated and perfectly locatet in the old town of lisbon. Very friendly and helpfully people! Definitely recommend it.
Endroit parfait dans le plus jolie quartier de Lisbonne

We had a wonderful stay at Hugo's place. He his very welcoming, we really appreciated his help with our luggage upon our arrival.

We booked our holidays at the last moment, but we definitely picked up the right city and the right place to stay. The apartment is perfectly located, fully equipped and super clean.

Thank you for this amazing stay ! We won't hesitate to come back ;)

Appartement superbe ! Nous avons été très bien accueilli au métro par Hugo qui nous a expliqué les bons plans de la ville . Il nous a très bien accompagné à l appartement qui est superbe . Nous nous sommes sentis très bien , tout le confort est présent . Nous étions en plein cœur d Alfama mais l appartement est dans une rue silencieuse . Literie excellente . Vue sur le tage. Mobilier neuf . Tout est fait pour se sentir comme chez soi. nous recommandons vivement ce logement c est notre meilleure expérience Airbnb !

Dès notre arrivée à Lisbonne, nous avons été très bien accueilli par Hugo et Sylvia. L'appartement est tout à fait conforme aux photos.
Bien agencé, bien décoré, bien équipé, très bien entretenu, il est de plus très bien situé dans le quartier de l'Alfama. Au centre de tout, il est paradoxalement très calme !
bref ... vous pouvez y aller les yeux fermés !

Hugo (and Silvia) were absolutely amazing! I have never had such amazing hosts before! Hugo picked us up from the train station, gave us a little tour of the neighborhood, told us so much about Lisbon, and helped bring our luggage into the apartment. The apartment itself is beautiful. And the views are just spectacular!!! I have nothing negative to say about Hugo & Silvia, the apartment, the location or Lisbon! All around A+++ and I would definitely stay here again when I return to Lisbon!

Really beautiful apartment, just like the photos! It was immaculately cleaned and had everything I needed for my stay. Every evening, I sat with the window's open, had some wine, and listened to the Fado music from down the street.

Hugo went above and beyond the call of hospitality: picking me up from the train station, giving me a few pointers on getting around the city, and even a bottle of wine to enjoy during my stay. Would definitely stay here again!
Fantastique séjour à Lisbonne grâce à l'aide de Hugo et Silvia. L'appartement est idéalement situé au cœur de l'algarade. Superbe décoration désign, confort, tout pour un souvenir inoubliable.

Hugo picked us up at the train station and took us on a mini tour by car of Alfama and Graca, up to a viewpoint where we could see the city and he could point out good places to visit. We thought that was great.
The Alfama Blue House apartment is exactly as it looks in the photo. Bright, modern and clean. The view across the river is great. From outside the front door it is only 5 minutes walk up to Portas Do Sol and the various bars and terraces with great views down over Alfama to the river.
There are neighbourhood convenience shops within 2 mins walk.
The neighbourhood feels very safe. There are people around at all times of day and, while it is quiet, it is very well lit at night and we felt safe walking around after midnight. No problem at all.
We recommend that you walk around the neighbourhoods of Alfama and Graca, sampling the various cafes and restaurants. Within 10 minutes walk is the castle and within 20 minutes walk is Baixa and downtown.
We would definitely ask Hugo and Silvia if we can stay in the apartment again if we go back to Lisbon.

Nicely located in the hearth of Alfama, this apartment is the right choice for those who want to spend their holidays close to the real potuguese lifestyle of Lisbon. The flat is furnished with modern taste and equipped with everything you need, very clean and bright with a fantastic view on the Tage.
Hugo is a very nice, helpful and professional landlord!
We definitely recommend this flat and our mark is 10 cum Laude!

Nous avons vraiment très apprécié cette expérience portugaise que même le mauvais temps par moment n'a pas entamé.
Arrivant tard sur Lisbonne, Hugo est venu nous chercher à l'aéroport. Il a été parfait en convivialité, en explications,...
Situé dans un cartier historique de Lisbonne l'Alfama, l'appartement est très bien équipé, avec tout ce qu'il faut autour (Transports, restaurants, petits commerces,...).
Merci encore à Silvia et Hugo pour leur gentillesse.

Hi friends
Our trip was so good and the apartment is very nice to stay. Perfect geographic situation, nice view and good advices from Hugo to have some wonderful remember from Lisboa!
Thanks,
Fabien

Das Apartment ist ein Traum und der Aufenthalt ein Genuß. Super süß eingerichtet und mit tollem Blick auf den Teso. Die Lage in Mitte der Alfama mit netten Fado Restaurants und den typischen kleinen Gassen ist hervorragend um direkt in Urlaubsstimmung zu kommen. Hugo hat uns von der Metro abgeholt und mit uns noch eine kleine Stadtrundfahrt gemacht. Das war klasse und wir haben viele nützliche Informationen bekommen. Alles in allem ist das Apartment sehr zu empfehlen! Top Lage, gute Ausstattung und super sauber. Wir kommen sicher wieder!

Appartement très agréable et très bien équipé en plein cœur d'Alfama.
L'accueil d'Hugo était très sympatique et ses conseils sur les endroits à voir à Lisbonne nous ont été précieux.
Nous avons été bien reçu par Hugo qui est venu nous chercher à la gare. l'appartement était super comme sur les images. Nous recommandons.

We had a great time in Lisboa. The flat has really great view and has very good location in Lisboa. It is about 3 minutes far from tram station and not more as 10 minutes far from St. Apolonia train station. The apartment is very comfortable and has everything what you need.
Hugo was very helpful to us. He picked us from the train station and showed us the area. On the end of our trip he ordered us the taxi (only 11 Euro to airport!!!) One tipp. It was very helpful for us to buy internet sim card for internet (only internet for 12 Euro by vodafone). Thos card we used for google navigation. Thanks again Hugo for the great time.
Elena and Dimitri
Great flat in charming Alfama. The view over the Tage really worth it. Hugo take the time to welcome us and give us some advices to make our stay memorable. Thank you again !

We really enjoyed our stay in Lisbon and at Alfama Blue House.  Apartment exactly as described, all home comforts, great location and views.  Hugo met us at nearby train station and gave us overall view of city and our location which was very helpful.  Also kindly arranged a taxi for our return to airport.  Would have no hesitation recommending this accommodation and Lisbon for a relaxed chilled break.

Well... I've delayed a little my review because I couldn't find words to describe how marvelous Hugo and his apartament were. As I couldn't find yet, I'll do it anyway!
First, the reception was amazing. Hugo took us in the airport's door right on time and explained some important things along the way to the apartament - in the middle of the way, he stopped in the most beautiful "miradouro" of the city and gave us the opportunity to see the city on the sunrise. Besides that, there were cheese, yogurt, milk, mineral water, butter, a local (and tasty) bread and a bottle of wine waiting for us - which was terrific, considering that we were tired and we didn't have food with us. In short, everything started in a amazing way.
Ah, I must say: it all happened before 6AM.
Hugo kept in touch all the trip long and provided us a "cleaning day", in the middle of our stay, which was very kind.
About the apartament, it's great. Cozy, confortable, well equipped, well located, with a wonderful view... The best place we ever stayed in. The kitchen is complete - we cook a lot of different things there. The bed is pretty good and I fell in love with the pillows! Nothing better than wake up in the morning and take a look at "Tagus River"...
Once in Lisbon again, I'll stay in Hugo's appartament for sure. It was unforgettable.
Appartement au top a tous points de vue et hôtes super accueillants et arrangeants!

We had a wonderful stay in Hugo's apartment in Alfama. Hugo came and picked us up in the airport upon arrival and took the time to tell us about Lisbon and showed us some good places to visit before we got to the apartment. The apartment is very well located in the center of beautiful Alfama with restaurants, mini markets, and tram stop just around the corner. We travelled with our 2 year old daughter, and Hugo had arranged both a children seat for her in the car and a bed for her in the apartment. The apartment was perfect for the 3 of us with a small living room with a great view, kitchen and a bedroom. It was very clean and had all the basic things you would need. Hugo even made sure a bottle of red wine was ready for us, when we arrived :-)
In general, Hugo's showed great hospitality and recommended some good restaurants and was also so kind to help us picking out a hospital when our daughter unfortunately needed medical treatment.
We can definitely recommend Hugo's apartment if you are in Lisbon and wants to stay in Alfama - and Hugo is a perfect host :-)
L'appartement est bien situé, conforme aux photos et fonctionnel pour 2 personnes. Hugo est très sympathique et nous a aidé lorsqu'on en avait besoin.

This was one of my best experiences with Airbnb. The apartment is as described, located in one of the most beautiful areas in Lisbon, conveniently located, very clean, and quiet. There are plenty of great restaurants in this neighborhood, and a couple of supermarkets near by.
The communication with Hugo was prompt, and he was helpful in every way possible. We are planning to come back as one week was clearly not enough to see everything in this wonderful city.
Many thanks again!

Hugo e Silvia, boa tarde.

Nossa estadia no apartamento foi ótima, tudo estava perfeitamente limpo e muito agradável.

Agradecemos mais uma vez pela atenção do Hugo em nos disponibilizar o berço para nossa filha e também pela ajuda em nos buscar no aeroporto.

Quando voltarmos a Lisboa, certamente lembraremos de vocês.

Abraço.
Bruno
Nous avons été tres bien accueillis par notre hôte .le logement correspond bien au descriptif ,bien situé dans la vieille ville et calme.

Wir haben uns in der wunderschön gelegenen und toll eingerichteten Wohnung super wohl gefühlt. Wir wurden trotz des späten Fluges von der U-Bahn abgeholt, mit Wein empfangen, und durften uns noch ein paar Reisetipps abholen. Grandios ist die morgendliche Sonnenflut, die in das Wohnzimmer strömt. Nach dem Umherstreifen in der Stadt wurde uns klar, dass Alfama das schönste Viertel sein muss. Kleine Restaurants um die Ecke, aufgeleinte Wäsche in den Straßen, verkachelte Wände und beeindruckend enge Straßen......wir können die Wohnung nur weiterempfehlen!!
Nous avons été ravis de notre séjour à Lisbonne. Notre hôte a été charmant et le lieu adorable. De plus l'appartement est parfaitement situé. Que demander de plus !!!

Mooie tijd gehad in dit schattige appartement! Schoon, nieuw, mooi & sfeervol! Niks op aan te merken. De bereikbaarheid is goed met tram 28 waardoor je gemakkelijk kan verplaatsen. Vriendelijk ontvangen door Hugo met een kleine introductie over Lissabon en een flesje wijn.

Hugo nous a accueilli à l'aéroport et nous as montré les différents quartiers de Lisbonne, l'appartement est très propre et très fonctionnel.
Le quartier de l'Alfama est charmant et très bien situé. Une valeur sur pour un agréable séjour à Lisbonne.

This is a just a wonderful place: the apartment's location is perfect (in a quiet street in Alfama close to the famous tramway line 28) and the view on the river is fantastic. The flat is freshly renovated, nicely furnished and very clean. Hugo was such a nice host: he met me at the airport and was very helpful in showing me around and organizing my departure back home. I can highly recommend this place! Thank you, Hugo, for everything.

Appartement tres sympa, fonctionnel au cœur de l'alfama. La vue du salon, sur le Tage, est superbe. Lieu très calme et bien organisé, décoré sobrement. L'accueil d'Hugo, venu nous chercher en voiture a la gare de San Apolonia pour nous amener à l'appartement, fut un vrai plus. A réserver les yeux fermés.

Very cute apartment, well furnished.
A really good and sympathic host. The best ever met.
He came to the airport to pick us up.
Good area, close to the city center (10min by walk).
I recommend strongly.

Situación: el apartamento está situado en uno de los barrios más emblemáticos de Portugal. Calles pequeñas, muchas cuestas , y sitios geniales para visitar y comer muy cerca. El metro y el tranvía están a 10 min y el acceso desde el aeropuerto es fácil. Hugo nos pidió un taxi a la vuelta y fueron sólo 12€.
Apartamento: el piso está impecable y todo nuevo, la cama es cómoda y tienes todas las facilidades que se necesitan. Las vistas, de diez ¡Impresionantes! Es un segundo sin ascensor y las escaleras son empinadas, a tener en cuenta si tienes problemas de movilidad. Si no tienes problemas con eso, lo recomiendo 100%
Anfitrión: Hugo nos dio indicaciones para llegar al piso, de las lineas de metro e incluso nos ofreció recogernos del aeropuerto. Nos facilitó el piso desde por la mañana y fue muy flexible. Nos dio recomendaciones geniales del area y nos pidió un taxi de vuelta.

¡Sin dudarlo lo recomiendo!

Hugo hat uns von der Bahn-Station Santa Apolonia mit dem Auto abgeholt und uns gleich von einem der zahlreichen Aussichtspunkte nützliche Informationen zu Stadt gegeben. Die Wohnung war wie auf den Bildern sehr sauber  und schön eingerichtet. Der Ausblick aus vom kleinen Balkon ist traumhaft. Das Begrüßungsgeschenk war sehr nett.

cet appartement est une perle rare !! : la propreté est irréprochable, il est situé à deux pas du tram 28, à proximité de restaurants, petites épiceries, cafés....... la vue sur la Tage est magnifique.
Pouvoir entendre le fado à la tombée de la nuit, c'était extra. Passé 22h00, plus un bruit, on a du mal à imaginer que l'on puisse être dans une capitale avec ce silence !
La literie est très confortable et l'appartement dispose de tout le nécessaire, le wi fi marche très bien.
Hugo a été un hôte aux petits soins pour nous, de la réservation à notre départ. Il est venu nous chercher à l'aéroport et nous à emmené vers un point de vue afin de nous donner toutes les infos nécessaires pour découvrir la ville.
Je conseillerais sans hésiter cet appartement, allez y, foncez !!

Notre séjour fut parfait. L'accueil D'Hugo fut bref mais efficace. Cinq petite minutes ont suffit pour nous expliquer tout ce qu'il fallait savoir sur l'appartement et le quartier... et nous offrir une bouteille de vin local en guise de bienvenue. Décoré avec soin et simplicité, l'appartement est joli et fonctionnel. Et la vue sur le Tage est un plus indéniable! Nous avions une petite appréhension, au niveau du bruit, à être en plein milieu de l'Alfama: ce fut tout l'inverse. Les nuits furent très calmes. Et les soirées délicieusement perturbées par le fado de l'un des restaurants tout proche. La situation est parfaite (metro à 10 minutes, tram à 2 minutes, restaurant tout proches). Bref, à recommander!

Et kjempeflott opphold i en fin og koselig leilighet midt i Alfama. Hugo & Silvia er fantastiske verter. Vi var litt nervøse ettersom dette var vår første reise med vår 4 måneder gamle sønn, men Hugo hentet oss på flyplassen, og hadde til og med et barnesete i bilen til vår lille gutt. I tillegg hadde de plassert en barneseng i leiligheten til ham.

Leiligheten ligger perfekt til i Alfama. Det er stille og rolig på kvelden, selv om man bor midt i byen. Utsikten fra leiligheten er deilig og man kan sitte og se utover mens man hører Fadosang fra gatene. Sangen er ikke plagsom, fordi restaurantene ligger ikke rett nedenfor i den samme gaten.

Leiligheten ligger i tredje etasje og fremstår nyrenovert og fresh. Trappeoppgangen er trang, men den fine utsikten gjør det imidlertid verdt trappeturen alene.

Kan absolutt anbefale denne leiligheten for de som ønsker en tur til Lisboa.

Hugo was a great host and it really made our Lisbon experience!
The pre arrival communication was great especially the specialised website information provided once we'd confirmed our booking.
We loved staying in Alfama and the location was perfect, quiet in the evening but a short stroll to most things.
The airport pick up was a bonus and the flexibility with our arrival and departure time. We'd definitely recommend for others looking for a short stay in Lisbon. The view in the morning was extra special.
Thanks Hugo for a great Lisbon experience.

Hugo and Sylvia made us feel very welcome by communicating with us warmly and clearly before our arrival, and Hugo also picked us up at the nearby station and took us to the apartment, helped with the luggage, and showed us around the apartment. He was also helpful when we needed a taxi at the end of our stay.

The apartment was beautifully clean and in great condition, and everything was as in the photos. We really appreciated having a fully equipped kitchen, and plenty of basic supplies such as tea, coffee, salt, oil, and toilet rolls. There was even makeup remover in the bathroom, which was brilliant because I had forgotten mine!

I particularly loved the view over the rooftops down to the river, and spent lots of time drinking coffee on the sofa, watching the ships go by, and listening to the sound of fado drifting up from the street. It was the perfect way to relax after a long day sightseeing.

We also really appreciated how quiet the apartment was at night. As long as we kept the balcony doors closed, we couldn't hear anything, and slept really well every night. It was also great to be in the Alfama, as it is such a characterful neighbourhood, and a great introduction to Portuguese street life.

You have to be pretty fit to stay there though, because the flat is up three flights of narrow steep stairs, and the whole of the district is on a hill so there are many slopes and steps to contend with whenever leaving or arriving at the flat. We actually enjoyed the exercise, but it might be a bit much for some people.

Highly recommended!

S ubytováním jsme byli moc spokojení, vše je jako na obrázku. Hugo se nám snažil ve všem vyjít vstříc. Lokalita je dobrá, jen jsme se občas v těch uličkách ztratili, ale to bylo spíš dobrodružství. Jen musím upozornit na menší postel - pro dlouhé lidi to opravdu není a při otevřeném oknu je tam poměrně hluk, ale dá se pustit klimatizace. Byt byl čistý a uklizený. Mohu vřele doporučit.

Nice, clean flat about 3 stories up somewhat narrow steps, so be prepared/try to keep luggage light. The flat is as described and as pictured in the listing. It is clean, bright, and airy - has a great view out over the water. Hugo was extremely responsive and welcoming. He even picked us up, gave us a lot of information about the area, showed us a nice look-out to snap photos, and arranged for a taxi on our departure. The neighborhood is truly a local neighborhood with many mini markets, restaurants and sites to see. Good wif-fi, good AC and heat that takes care of the entire flat. The flat was very accommodating and had all the amenities (and appliances) to feel like home (including some basics like napkins, coffee, salt/pepper). I would recommend it.

Wir hatten das vergnügen 1 Woche in dem Apartment von Hugo & Silvia zu Wohnen, schon der erste Eindruck war grandios !

Hugo gab uns eine schnelle unkomplizierte Einführung und ein paar Tipps was man so in Lissabon erleben kann .

Das Apartment war wirklich sehr ordentlich und liebevoll eingerichtet ,es war alles da was man brauch .
Ein unglaublich schöner Ausblick auf den Hafen und die sehr gute Lage waren ein weiteres Plus .

Wir können das Apartment absolut weiter empfehlen !

The apartment was lovely and so was the wine! Hugo was a great host, we gave us a ride from the airport and took us to a viewing point thag had breath taking view. I'll definitely recommend this apartment, as it adds to the amazing Lisbon experience. Thanks Hugo & Silvia!

Hugo and Silvia are exceptional hosts! Hugo picked us up from the airport and gave us great recommendations concerning the city plus he stopped at a really nice viewpoint! Wow!
The apartment is also really nice! Very clean and everything there you need for a nice stay. Oh, and Hugo also provided a bottle of really nice wine.
The location of the apartment is great! 100% traditional Lisbon!
I can highly recommend this place! If I visit Lisbon again for sure I'll try to stay at Hugo's and Silvia's place!
It was just great!

We had an amazing 5 days in Lisbon in Hugo and Sylvia's apartment - it's right in the middle of Alfama which is a gorgeous local neighbourhood to explore, quite near the castle and we walked into Bairro Alto/Cais de Sodre everyday for more sights, bars and restaurants etc which takes 20 mins although there's a tram and metro too.
Apartment was perfect for us, great kitchen, wifi and you can see the sea when having breakfast! Would definitely stay again next time in Lisbon, Thanks guys!

Ce petit appartement est idéalement placé dans un immeuble typiquement portugais aux escaliers escarpés. La vue sur le Tage est magnifique, et l'arrière sur une cour intérieur avec des chiens, les monuments aux alentours sont à quelques minutes de marche. Nous avons bien profité de notre séjour. L'appartement est très bien équipe, propre. Pas besoin d'aller bien loin pour écouter du fado depuis le balcon on peut en profiter...Nous recommandons vivement cet appartement charmant et bien décoré, parfait pour un couple et aussi avec un enfant

A very charming apartment with a wonderful view over the Tejo river. The rooms are very clean and comfortable. You are in the very centre oft he town and will be sung into sleep by Fado-singers.
The hospitality was outstanding. We can recommend to use the service Hugo friendly offers to pick you up from the airport. If you have your luggage with you, the narrow labyrinth of Alfama must be difficult to discover without a professional guide. Hugo took really care of us. Don’t hesitate to ask him. He gave us very worthy advices for restaurants and interesting locations like the flee market.
Das Appartment ist klein, aber durch den weiten Blick nicht beengend. Die Gegend ist charmant und pittoresk. Hugo hat uns zu Beginn eine kleine Übersicht über Lissabon gegeben. Er ist wirklich ein sehr umsichtiger, verlässlicher, dabei aber unaufdringlicher Gastgeber, der sehr gut erspürt, was einem den Aufenthalt wirklich angenehm macht. Das ist ihm ein großes Anliegen, so hat er uns zum Beispiel für die Abreise ein Taxi zum Flughafen vorbestellt.

My friend and I very much enjoyed our stay at Hugo and Silvia's apartment.  It is exactly as it appears in the pictures:  immaculate, bright, attractively and simply furnished.  The view from the living room is very pretty, and the Alfama neighborhood is fun to wander in.  We ate well and enjoyed fado in several places very close by.  Silvia was kind when we arrived.  We came from the Apolonia train station, not from the airport; the train station is a short but confusing walk to the apartment (if one is not used to the winding streets of the Alfama).  I would advise others who are arriving on their own to have a very good map.  And as a friendly suggestion to Hugo and Silvia, their description of the apartment might including walking directions for travelers arriving by train, as we did.  Another tip:  the stairs up to the apartment are very steep, and someone with physical difficulties might find them forbidding, although they were no problem for us.  And the view from the apartment is a reward for the climb!  I should also mention that Hugo and Silvia went out of their way to accommodate us when we thought we would need to leave our luggage a little extra time on our departure day.  They could not have been nicer, and communication with them throughout was excellent, and in both English and Spanish.  In sum, it was a great place to stay for us, and we had an unforgettable few days in lovely Lisbon.
