Das Apartment hat was. Alte und neue Möbel schön kombiniert. Urig und charmant, zum wohl fühlen.
Good value and close to the city center. The neighborhood is a bit busy and can get noisy at times. The door lock can be tricky. Rafael is a friendly host.

Rafael ist ein toller Gastgeber, hat schnell geantwortet,  alles hat sehr gut geklappt, präzise Info zum Check-in. Zimmer bzw. Apartment sehr sauber. Gute Restaurants in Laufnähe. Kommen gerne wieder.
Logement bien situé pour visiter à pied le quartier de la Mouraria. La bâtisse est vieille mais c’est propre.

Habitación sucia, con pulgas y cinches. El baño tiene el tejado totalmente bufado por la humedad. Hemos tenido que dejar l’habitacion de noche por las pulgas y cinches que no paravan de salir desde la paret y de la cama. L’anfitrion nos atendió 1 hora después diciendo que iba a disinfectsr l’habitacion (era nuestra última noche ahí ) y que nos pusiéramos en contacto con airbnb para encontrar una solución. No nos contestó a las llamadas y simplemente se limitó a ofrecerme parte de rembolso que evidentemente no era suficiente para pagar una noche en un hotel en lisboa sin antelación. Una actitud pesima considerando la gravedad de la situación.
El barrio está cerca de todo pero es bastante peligroso. Hubo una pelea de noche y tiraron los contenedores al suelo, además había mucha gente poco recomendable que salía y bajava desde el portal.
En general no recomiendo para nada este sitio, a menos que os apetezca coger una multidud de enfermedades.
Süßes Zimmer in einer sehr zentralen Lage!
Rafael is the best!

Pernottamento rovinato da punture di cimici del letto.
Il materasso sembra nuovo ma lenzuola, asciugamani e coperte un po datati ( non chiaro tra l’altro la necessità di avere un piumone ad agosto e neanche un lenzuolo).
Le punture sono uscite dopo ultima notte, l’ho segnalato al proprietario e ha detto che l’appartamento è disinfettato piu volte al mese. Comunque non sono il primo che lo ha segnalato.
L’appartamento ha 4 o 5 stanze con due bagni in quartiere multietinico, in una posizione che puo essere ok per visitare la citta in brevi soggiorni
Saubere und zentrale Unterkunft. Wir hatten eine wunderbare Zeit!

Everything worked out well for our night here. The area near the closest metro is busy at night but interesting. Get ready to walk up some steps or take an alternative street which has a few escalators. Would recommend Rafael’s place!
Overall a good Airbnb.
Pour le prix c'etais correct, mais lemplacement laisse à désirer.

Logement très bien placé, dans un quartier un peu glauque quand on arrive de nuit mais nous n'avons eu aucun problème. Tout est hyper accessible ! La rue est silencieuse, mais pas forcément les colocataires. La chambre se trouve dans une maison avec plancher, ça peut être TRÈS bruyant, surtout avec les portes qui claquent fort... Ça peut dépendre de qui louera en même temps. Le lit est très propre, mais les murs sont un peu sales. L'une des salles de bains est un peu croulante et la cuisine rudimentaire. Cela dit, bon rapport qualité prix. En soi, tout est efficace, et c'est ce qui compte ! Un petit rafraîchissement peut  être envisagé, mais pour l'emplacement, je ne rechignerai pas ! :)
Lovely private room with communal kitchen and 2 shared bathrooms for 4 other bedrooms. Convenient location and lovely early check-in at 1pm. Definitely recommend!

Die Unterkunft ist sehr zentral. In der Nähe gibt es eine Metro Station, ansonsten kann man auch alles gut zu Fuß erreichen! Unser Zimmer war klein, aber sehr gemütlich und hat perfekt gepasst für die paar Tage. Alles sauber und Rafael ist super zu erreichen, sollte etwas sein.

O quarto é relativamente agradável, a mobilia é antiga e o colchão é satisfatório. Quanto ao resto da casa, tem uma cozinha pequena que nao tem mesa nem cadeiras por isso as pessoas devem comer ou de pé na cozinha, ou numa pequena mesa no meio da casa entre os quartos. Na cozinha existe o minimo de utensílios para cozinhar, e fazer algumas refeições rápidas. Existem duas casas de banho que funcionam, mas uma é muito estreita e baixa e, ambas precisam de uma renovação. Se você está a pensar em sair da casa e ver uma jardim em flores este nao é o local ideal, por isso aconselho uma inspeção prévia ao bairro, pois á noite e mesmo durante o dia o barulho entra pelas janelas da casa se voce estiver com a janela aberta. Como a minha estádia era de 15 dias, estava á espera que me fosse oferecido pelo menos para a segunda semana um jogo de toalhas novas e lençóis uma vez que faz muito calor em Lisboa no mes de Julho e com o calor durante o dia as noites tornam-se bastante suadas.
Logement conforme à la description. Logement bien placé. Rafael a été très réactif, merci beaucoup !

Wie beschrieben. Sehr sauber und gemütlich eingerichtet. Alles nötige in Bad und Küche vorhanden.
Zentrum fußläufig....
Nous avons passé un super séjour chez Rafael. L’hôte est très arrangeant et réactif.
Local muito bom, apesar disso grande rodízio de hóspedes,  Local muito central, perto dos melhores pontos de Lisboa.  Supermercado próximo.  Recomendo.
La camera era piccola ma super carina con tutto il necessario!
Todo muy bien

Ubytovanie bolo čisté, ale zislo by sa ho upraviť - špinavé steny, pleseň pod oknom, praskliny na strope. V kupelni tiekla tepla voda len v krátkych intervaloch. A najhoršie na koniec - extrémne hlučný susedia nad bytom. Trieskanie s nábytkom takmer celú noc kazdy deň. Na druhú stranu poloha ubytovania bola skvelá - pešia dostupnosť takmer všade a neďaleko stanica tramvaje 28 a metro.

Nous avons apprécié notre séjour chez Rafael. Le logement est à 10 minutes à pied des parties les plus intéressantes de la ville. Il est près de la vie, sans être dans les quartiers bruyants. Le ventilateur nous a permis de bien dormir. La cuisine est complète et les deux salles de bains! J’y retournerais volontiers!
Great stay!

Rafael was a very kind and responsive host. He let us keep our bags in the living room before and after check out so we didn’t have to lug them around the city. The place is a bit old and could use some updating but it is cheap, in a good location and a good spot to lay your head for the night. So if you’re on a budget it’s perfect!
La habitación era muy bonita y al casa contaba con todo lo necesario. Los otros inquilinos con los que compartimos la casa fueron agradables. La relación calidad-precio es de lo más destacable.
Would highly recommend, great value for money with a kitchen as well and super walkable to everywhere you need! Rafael was very helpful and responsive

Notre chambre était très mignonne  et convenait à tous nos besoins ! Les espaces partagés étaient très propres et bien équipés. L'emplacement est superbe ! À 5 min de marche du métro,5 min de marche du magnifique quartier Alfama, 10 min de marche du train léger sur rail qui se rend à Belèm et à seulement 10 min de marche de la station de train qui permet d'aller à Sintra ! Nous recommandons vivement!

We had a great time here the room was super tidy and the place had virtually everything we could have needed. I really appreciated there being shampoo and conditioner in the washroom as well.
The street that the apartment is on is super steep so if you plan to travel with a big suitcase I would prepare to lug that up a 90° hill. Its location is good although not too close to the main city centre and you have to walk through an odd part of town to get down to the water.
All in all we had a great time. The price for the place was great. Rafael was super kind and we really enjoyed being a little removed from the city.

Very nice place and Rafael is suepr friendly and helpulf !
Handy location too, but wouldn't want to be walking around there too late at night as a single woman.
overall very pleased with our stay 😊

Très belle chambre dans un appartement de 5 chambres. Les autres locataires étaient très agréables. Nous avons aimé l’emplacement du AirBnB pour sa tranquillité, sa sécurité, ses deux toilettes avec douche et sa proximité de tout (Métro, supermarché, restos, dépanneurs, sites historiques, magasins, etc). Le petit balcon était un endroit parfait pour souper paisiblement en contemplant la beauté du quotidien lisboète.
Great place, great host and Portugal is absolutely beautiful! Thank you Rafael for the hospitality:)

Rafael si è mostrato sempre gentile e disponibile a risolvere i nostri piccoli problemi con la spesa e l’entrata post check out (avevamo lasciato le valigie nel soggiorno).
Ha risolto i nostri problemi in maniera tempestiva quando l’ho contattato.
ci ha fornito inoltre molti consigli sulla città.
L’appartamento carino, rispecchiava la descrizione. I bagni un pochino stretti ma c’era tutto il necessario (phone compreso).
La posizione perfetta per le nostre esigenze, vicino a metro, centro, mercatini e market.
Molto soddisfatte! Grazie Rafael!

Nice room in the heart of the city, many sights in walking distance - if not, the metro station with buses and taxis too is a 5 min walk away. Flexible check-in, you can also leave your luggage in the living room if you arive too early. Rafael is kind and always responds fast. Recommended if you want to stay in the centre with all the good (everything is near) and bad (can be noisy) that comes with it, and don't mind thin walls. :)

Room was as described. Great for the one night stay we needed and well priced. Location was convenient and walkable to many things. Home and decor could use some updating to make it a little more appealing, but it was fine for what we needed.

Todo como esperado, la zona no es muy linda ni tranquila de noche pero las ventanas son muy hermeticas, el departamento es tal cual las fotos y descripcion, lo unico que nos falto fue aceite para cocinar, el resto perfecto, muchas gracias Rafael!

This was a great air bnb just a couple minute walk to the city center and great accommodations. Rafael allowed us to keep our bags in the living room after we checked out. I would definitely come back.
Bon logement situé proche du quartier animé et touristique Alfama.

like some others pointed out, this place is quite old. it is totally ok to stay for a couple of nights, the toilet and shower are very clean. however, the bedroom I was in has a strange smell and I couldn't figure out what the smell is.
due to the size of the room and public area, it will be noisy when people work around or talk. price wise it is certainly not expensive. so I get what I paid for

Gute Lage und ein sehr gutes Preis Leistungsverhältnis.
Check in gut organisiert mit Bildern

We really enjoyed our stay. Everything matches the description.
I definitely recommend it.
Alloggio pulito, semplice ma confortevole. Rafael host molto puntuale e rapido nelle risposte. Grandi consigli sul cibo!

Great place to stay near the center and the historical tram 28.
10 mins walk to the center and great views from Lisbon panorama views

Fantástica estadía en el departamento de Rafael. Limpieza REALMENTE destacable (baño, cocina, espacios comunes siempre impecables). Tiene todas las comodidades: lo que puedas necesitar para cocinar, para preparar el desayuno, para bañarse, todo. Muy cerca del metro, con miles de conexiones vía bus. Rafael nos permitió dejar nuestras valijas hasta después del check-in, lo que fue realmente un plus, ya que caminar en Lisboa con valijas por un par de horas (y bajo la lluvia) podría haber sido difícil.
Muy agradecida.
Recomiendo 100%.

Gute Unterkunft, um preiswert in Lissabon zu übernachten. Die Wohnung ist gut ausgestattet, aber auch nicht mehr die neueste. Zudem ist sie recht hellhörig, sodass man die anderen Mitwohnenden hört. Für das Geld aber top! Wer eine günstige Unterkunft sucht ist hier an einer guten Adresse!
Great location in a quiet neighborhood with some hidden restaurant gems!
Gute kleine Unterkunft Mouraria. Hist Rafael sehr friendly und antworten schnell und zuverlässig an die Fragen  :)
Great place for a great price.
La casa de cumple con lo ofrecido,  Rafael nos dio la opción de dejar nuestro equipaje antes de la hora y nos dio instrucciones útiles. Casa ordenada y cerca de lugares de interés, la recomiendo.

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour à Lisbonne grâce à Rafael. Il a été très disponible et nous a bien conseillés sur les restaurants à proximité.
De plus, l'emplacement est vraiment idéal, facilement accessible en métro depuis l'aéroport et proche du centre à pied.
Merci pour ce beau séjour !
We loved our stay. The kitchen had everything we needed, there were two great bathrooms and the house was super clean. I definitely recommend it.
Un cartier à visiter absolument!
Agradable aunque solo estuvimos por las noches, en el momento de descanso.
10日間のとても楽しい滞在でした。紹介して頂いたレストランも素敵なお店でした。手順も分かりやすく、対応も直ぐにしていただきました。ありがとうございました。

A very comfortable place as described in the listings.
Centrally located in the Mouraria neighborhood of Lisbon with charming stone-paved streets, alleys and staircases. Plenty of shops of all kinds nearby; close to transit hub and Fado Quarter.
Rafael was friendly and helpful with lots of local recommendations. Even though the building is old and typical for this area, it is well maintained and nicely furnished.

The place needed to climb up some hills. The room was cold in winter, the blanket was not thick enough. The water was cold while showering, but it provided shampoo and body gel. Kitchenwares were also adequate. The wifi was stable.

Raffael was very friendly and immediately ready to respond. He also recommended some nice places to eat so as not to spend too much and frequented by the locals. The house is as in the picture, very clean and tidy. Personal advice, if you have to get to the apartment do not take the road that Maps recommends because it will take you to very steep and narrow stairs, uncomfortable if you have your bags. Take the recommended route secondarily!!!
Very easy communication, nice apartment for a few days. Rafael is very accommodating. I'd definitely go there again!

Overall, the place was very nice. Rafael did a good job describing what you’ll be getting here. The doors are horrible to get into, so we had to listen to people try and get into their room for 20 minutes late at night. Nice little location though.

Logement bien placé, proche du centre ce qui est pratique pour la visite de Lisbonne. Rafael a était accueillant, réactif et arrangeant en cas de soucis.
Les salles de bains sont correct.
Le quartier est plutôt calme, cependant quelques autres voyageurs présent lors de notre séjour non pas étaient très respectueux du calme durant les horaires indiqués.
Je recommande tout de même pour un court séjour.

The host is nice and helpful we were able to store our luggages before check in and after check out. As said in the description it is more like an hostel and not the host house. Yet, the host is present by messages and come around 12 for cleaning making it possible to ask him questions if needed.  We recommend this place
Great place, great host. Very authentic vibe

Recomendado! muy cerca de los principales miradores y zona turística de Lisboa.
Rafael es muy atento y brinda recomendaciones muy detalladas de lugares para comer. 💯
Super location without being noisy. Room was  lovely and kitchen/bathroom well equipped. 100% recommend!
A convenient spot for a brief visit to Lisbon, close to public transportation and within walking distance of major tourist attractions. The room precisely matches the images provided.
Lindo

We booked the Apartment for one overnight stay.
Very easy to reach from the Airport, easy to Access & Rafael very quickly Repliedwto questions.
Apartment is easy but More than good for 1 Night stay, clean & fair Price.
We booked it again for our overnight stay on our travel back Home.
Lugar súper bien ubicado.
It was a good place to stop for a night in Lisbon
Cosy, quiet and clean room. Rafael was helpful. The area is lovely, small streets and hills.
Centrally located. Close to a variety of amenities. Cozy and comfortable room. Clean and well equipped kitchen. We enjoyed our stay in Lisboa!

Good luck finding a better value in this area! I really just needed a place to sleep close to laundromats as a recovery day in my journey.  I probably could have even used the washer in house if it hadn't been raining, but there are plenty of inexpensive laundries around...anyway, the highlight of the stay was the incredible bed!  I can barely recall another bed that was so perfect in my recent travels ranging from shared rooms to 4-star hotels. This one was superb! The home is very well cared for too!
一切都很完美 除了wifi
The room was clean, nice, quiet. The accomodation is easy to find, near to the centre, restarants etc. and to the airport too. I can recommend it :)
Rafael is a very nice guy, if you have the opportunity to meet him!
Foi tudo ótimo! Adoramos a acomodação de Rafael!
Localização muito boa! Fica próximo às principais atrações de Lisboa, isto é, dá pra fazer tudo a pé mesmo. Local seguro e confortável. Recomendo!

Me sentí en casa.El dueño muy majo , gentil, servicial y generoso. Tendrás a tu disponibilidad de forma gratuita,café , varios tipos de tés, cereales …etc , también gel de ducha, champù, acondicionador, secador de pelo …etc( y eso por generosidad del dueño) , la casa es muy bonita,acogedora y limpia.El sitio súper céntrico y puedes visitar a casi todos los sitios turísticos andando.

Good place to leave your language but nothing more. Definitely not recommend If you want to rest and have a good sleep at night.
Very strange and loud noises during the night. At 5 am somebody was banging to the front door. After spending 3 nights at this location we checked- out tired.

very cheap and good value for money. Like a private hostel and I appreciated the privacy a lot. 2 bathrooms made it easy to go when needed and didn't need to wait on other guests to shower. Clean and spacious overall. Good location with lots to eat and drink nearby.

We had a great time at Rafael’s place, if it is a bit noisy outside at night the windows do a really good job to soundproof the room. The two shared bathrooms make it easy to not run into the other guests when in need to use them, overall a nice stay, only thing to keep in mind is that the road to move around the city is a bit steep.
Rafael helped me to move the luggage and things were very easy, straightforward
Good location and a very nice space!
Indications très claires, logement facile d’accès. Environnement bruyant

Communication avec Raphaël très mauvaise. Pas de réponse aux questions posées plusieurs jours avant notre arrivée. Dans l'annonce, il est mentionnée que l'on peut laisser nos bagages après avoir libéré le logement à 11h le temps de prendre notre vol le soir. Or, il nous a renvoyé vers un locker payant de façon très désagréable!
seul point vraiment négatif : Rafael ne répond pas aux messages avant l'arrivée et pendant le séjour
Super ubytovani, až na část města, ale dalo se to zvladnout. Doporucuji

The accommodation completely corresponded to the photos and description, it is a short walk from some viewpoints and a metro station. The accommodation was clean and nicely decorated, you can just hear every step in the corridor, the sound is carried and maybe it could use some renovations, but for the price it was still perfect.

location and price is great, unfortunately we had a couple issues with our stay. The room was fine and seemed clean, our main issue was the bathrooms. Both bathrooms were not as clean or functional as they seemed in the pictures and one of the bathrooms has a permanently open window with someone’s balcony pointed directly at it. I was terrified someone would be having a morning smoke and see me on the bowl. There is a blind that doesn’t stay down so it doesn’t really matter. Went to take a shower in the other bathroom, water was freezing. Its also advertised to us that a host will meet us at the airbnb to let us in, we tried to message the host a few times to organize a meeting time until he eventually let us know there’s different instructions on how to get in. Not the worst thing, but definitely confusing and weird to check ourselves in. We just needed the room for one night so it was fine but I would strongly suggest the hosts clean and fix those bathrooms

The apartment is very easy to find and check in instruction is very clear and process is easy to navigate. The location is super close to main attractions, and totally the authentic Lisbon experience. The room fits descriptions and the bathrooms are clean and available given all rooms are occupied, which was a concern for me initially.

Dieser Unterkunft kann man nur empfehlen!
Zu Beginn hat Rafael eine einfach wunderbare und super klare Erklärung vorbereitet, wie in die Wohnung zu bekommen, so dass unsere späte Ankunft kein Problem war. Die Wohnung war sehr sauber, alle zum Kochen benötigten Geschirr waren auch vorhanden. Die Wohnung ist im Zentrum, so dass wir kaum öffentliche Verkehrsmittel nutzten. Der Aufenthalt bei Rafael war unsere beste Idee.
Really enjoyed staying in this Airbnb. Great location, lots to do, good kitchen setup, and just as described.
Tutto ok!

Habitación agradable ordenado y limpia,más habitaciones para mas clientes,cocina y baños limpios y agradables
Sitio cercano al centro,20 minutos andando,lo malo zona de muchas bajadas y subidas grandes.

Rafael was a very nice host, my parents really liked him. He was polite and communicated very well. As for the room, the neighborhood is a bit shady and the room is ok. Ideal for short stays and budget travel, but there is room for improvement.

Had a great stay at Rafael’s, everything matched description and the communal areas were cleaned daily. Rafael is friendly and was very helpful with planning our stay in Lisbon. I would recommend staying here.
Was clean and convenient

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour : hôte accueillant et réactif, logement agréable et bien équipé, lit confortable, transports en commun tout proches... Parfait ! (Pensez à bien lire les informations données dans la description, il y a plein de choses utiles)
Rafael is an amazing host, the place was clean and cozy. Two bathrooms definitely made an experience better. I had good times and would like thank Rafael for hosting me.
Sympa
Un buen lugar en una zona de fácil acceso.
Rafael was very considerate, great host!
Great place for the price. But couldnt get the hot water working!

Rafael was very kind and his place was as shown in the photos. For the price we paid we were happy with our stay. For those looking for a more private type of accommodation, this would probably not be the place for you. Overall, we had a good experience with Rafael

nous avons passé un très bonne nuit. Le logement est à proximité du centre et facile d'accès. Rafael à été accueillant et réactif. le logement et conforme a la description. Nous recommandons sans hésiter.

We were very happy to stay at Rafaels place - he was kind and hospitable! We would definitely recommend Rafaels place to everyone visiting Lisboa :-)
- Emma and Sophia

Nossa estadia foi ótima. Pros: Rafael foi super atencioso e sempre respondeu nossas mensagens e nos deu dicas do que fazer até mesmo em dias chuvosos. O lugar é EXTREMAMENTE bem situado. Digo, extremamente mesmo. O apartamento em sí é charmoso, evoca bastante a ideia romantica de velha Lisboa. A cozinha é até que bem equipada. Coisa simples mas tudo que vc precisa tá lá. dá pra cozinhar bastante coisa com os utensilios disponiveis. Vale MUITO se hospedar.
Contras:
O lugar em sí é simples, e existem outros quartos com outros hospedes, que nem sempre serão tão cuidadosos em deixar o banheiro seco após tomarem banho, etc. É necessario subir dois lances de escada para levar as malas. Os chuveiros são bem baixos. Tambem não há muita privacidade pois pode-se ouvir outros hospedes pelas paredes. porém, nada disso me foi um problema. apenas cito para outra potencial hospede. eu estava muito feliz em Lisboa e passava a maior parte do dia fora de casa.
muito obrigado por tudo Rafael!

Sweet short stay in the cozy apartment. Feel like home. Rafael showed me everything and it was quite flexible whenever I checked in.
Thank you!

This place is very affordable for how walkable it is to the attractions in Lisbon. We loved how Rafael greeted us when we checked in and taught us how to open the door and gave us a tour of the place and what amenities there are. It feels very much like a bread and breakfast as each room is being rented out. The room was spacious and clean. Towels were also provided. The area seemed to have lots of people lurking around at night but we still felt safe enough. Had a great stay!
Toilet amenities must improve, and a touch of fresh painting would do as well
Ein besseres Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis ist in Lissabon wahrscheinlich nicht zu finden!
Rafael was a great host and very responsive. This air bnb is gorgeous and great for an overnight or a few. Shower was hot and had great water pressure! I will definitely stay here again if in Lisbon.
Unfortunately, we got a bad case with bedbugs from our stay here. Considering our circumstances we are 100% sure it is from this room.

Guest house molto pulita, ottimo prezzo.
Zona accessibile facilmente dall'aereoporto e vicina a attrazioni della città.
Rafael è stato molto accogliente e gentile.
Consigliato
Rafael is very friendly and responsive. He showed us around his nice place which has everything you need. There are a lot of information about things to do around in Lisbon.

Okay for a budget stay, house needs lot of maintenance. Location was the best part of the apartment. You will be sharing common spaces with others, including bathrooms and expect guests walking in the night. It's a very small place in general to share with other people.

Good location, close to centre. Property was a little hard to get into at the start, the front door lock is quite dodgy so could be replaced. Rooms are quite small and easy to lock yourself out but a decent stay for a couple nights.

Central location, we we're able to walk to most attractions.
The 2 full bathrooms we're very useful.
The check-in and check-out hours we're great hours for us since we arrived early afternoon.
Rafael’s place is close to busy scenes of Lisbon while also being faraway enough so that you can sleep at night. Great value if you’re visiting this beautiful city.
basic apartment but good for a few nights in Lisboa.
Great location, friendly service and cute apartment!

I hate to say this but I was bitten by bed bugs after my one night stay here. The room and apartment overall was also not as new and well kept as in the photos. I just needed a place to stay for one night and this would have been fine had it not been for the bed bugs. While Rafael was indeed apologetic and responsive after I texted him a photo of my bites, it disturbs me to think that the room I was staying in must not have been cleaned thoroughly. I was given a refund (after I asked for it). I have stayed in over 100 airbnbs and this has been my first unfortunate bed bug experience. Rafael said he would cancel the bookings and get the place cleaned so I just hope that happens so no one else has to go through my experience.
Wonderful host, great place to stay and immerse yourself in Lisbon
The place was clean, Raphael was available and welcomed us nicely. A short and happy stay!
Rafael was welcoming and helpful. The room was exactly as advertised. Great place to stay.
un gran anfitrión...
Good value for a one night stay. Clean and strategic spot at the centre of lisbon. Good stay :)
good location. issues with hot water
Great host and amazing localization!!! Good for the price.

Rafael is an amazing and commicative host and the place itself is very cozy. We liked staying there as it was tidy, clean, charming and the location is great. It is literally only a 5 minute walk to Miradouro da Senhora do Monte.

Our stay at Rafael's place was comfortable. It's an old historical building so it is dated but very warm and cozy. The walls are thin, and Lisbon is loud, so bring ear plugs. Both my mom and I slept with them, and it really helped. Rafael was a great host and very responsive, making check-in very easy. We would stay again!
muy buen anfitrión....
Je recommande à 100%, très pratique pour un week-end à Lisbonne, proche de tout !
Rafael is a very kind and flexible host. He takes time to welcome you and give you thé local d’avocette you need. The room was perfectly clean and cosy. Thank you for this stay!
O local estava de acordo com a descrição. O Rafael foi solícito e claro na apresentação do imóvel.

Rafael was great in expressing that he wanted to switch the mattress, however our schedules didn’t allow for them to go in the room and actually switch it. The walls are very thin and you share the apartment with 3 other rooms so we had about 8 people in the apartment at once. If you are a light sleeper, I don’t recommend this place. The locks on the doors are very loud and you could be stuck with inconsiderate house mates. There is hot water but if everyone showers on the same day, you’re unlikely to get any of it. 방이 생각보다 좁음 .. 그리고 욕실 두개인데 하나는 괜찮은데 작은 욕실에선 조금 냄새가 나고 곰팡이가 있었음 아침은 빵이랑 과일이라고 해서 9시쯤 부엌에 갔는데 과일은 여자 주먹만한 사과 하나랑 보통크기 바나나 하나 있었음 참고로 우린 두명 그래서 빵을 토스트기에 넣었는데 앞사람이 잘못쓴건지 토스트기가 고장나있어서 그냥 맨 빵에 잼만 발라먹었음 그리고 에어비앤비 메세지 답장도 잘 안해주고 .. 그치만 만났을 땐 친절했음 언덕에 있어서 올라가기 힘들지만 우버타면 3유로? 정도라서 기차에서 내려서 우버타고 가세요 무조건 절대 캐리어끌고 걸어서 못감 내려올땐 괜츈 ! 방음 진짜 안되고 그치만 워낙 싸서 다 참을 수 있었지만 남자 두분이라면 아마 많이 좁을 듯
Vera’s apartment is small and cozy, very close to the Metro station, supermarkets and lots of public attractions (as The Castel of San George)!

Great location! Very close to a Metro stop, great cafes, Praca da Figueira, Castelo de Sao Jorge, etc. Wonderful space, perfect for resting after a day walking around Lisbon. The neighborhood can sometimes be a little noisy at night, so bring earplugs if that is something that will bother you. Rafael and Vera are very responsive and work very hard to keep the space comfortable and clean.
An ideal base for exploring Lisbon. Very close to great restaurants and public transport links. Friendly and helpful host. Good value.
Everything was okay . Recomended!! Thanks :)
Great location, flexible check in, nice and clean place, the Appartement hast 2 bathrooms so we didn't have to wait for the toilet or shower. Clean and comfortable.
Great place.  Great location.
We were satisfied with the chosen place. Excellent location and welcoming welcome of the hosts.

This Airbnb is in a great location, not only for walking around and exploring but it’s also very easy to metro to and from the airport or train station. Solid sized bedroom and bathroom, and there is food and coffee for breakfast. Highly recommend!
We had a great stay, Vera and her husband let us check in early which was very kind of them. They were very response over messaging and then space and location were perfect!

Excellent place, clean and very close to the center. The room was spacious and comfortable, and Vera was super friendly, she welcomed us warmly and showed and explained everything in the apartment. I highly recommend them

We had a good time at this apartment. It‘s near to the city centre and the breakfast offer is a good start for the day.
Enjoyed it
Affordable, well located and a overall nice apartment. I’d recommend the space.
Friendly, clean basic room close to cafes and public transit.
Very lovely neighbourhood. Close to everything in Lisbon. Get ready to walk climb a few hills to get there but otherwise you will love it here. :)
Vera lakása nagyon szép környéken fekszik. A szobával meg voltunk elégedve, a reggeli benne van az árban. A fogadtatás rendkívül kedves és figyelmes volt, bátran ajánljuk.

Rafael nos recebeu super bem, muito simpático.

Fantastische service, erg gastvrij!

Great space for good value in a nice location.

Perfect for what we wanted - clean, inexpensive, quaint, in a good location walking distance to many of the main sites. Two bathrooms shared with 2 other rooms of guests while we were there.  Only negative was there was no hot water in the shower.
Location was perfect! Confortable rooms, nice apartment. I would be back to Lisbon, and definitely I will stay at veras again, no doubts!👍🏻
Apartamento com excelente localização, receptividade maravilhosa do Rafael que nos recebeu tão bem!com certeza indicaremos aos nosso amigos!

The value is great and the thoughtfulness with breakfast prep is wonderful. The place is very stylish and clean.
My only notes for why we didn’t rate more highly, was the bed we stayed on was very hard and loud when we moved around. Also, there is renovation happening on the floor above and they were working past midnight which made it extremely loud and difficult to sleep. Since we had to leave for a flight at 4:45 in the morning, it was fine for a quick stay- but could be a problem for a longer stay.
I’m sure this isn’t the case every time, and Luis was a very kind and gracious host. Would recommend for the value and warmth offered!

Parfaitement place pour un week-end à Lisbonne, hôte très disponible
Aucune remarque négative

Thanks again Rafael, especially for receiving me so late, I really appreciated that!  I had a nice stay again, all the best for the future!
位置很好，靠近罗西奥火车站，在老城区古老街道，客房装修不错，性价比很高。推荐

The room is spacious with a pretty decent view of the local neighbourhood.  There is a bit of noise of people coming and going in the building, but it's not too bad.  The location is GREAT!!!

La habitación y el cuarto de baño estaban muy bien, Rafael es muy simpático y nos dio unos consejos sobre donde ir a cenar. Volvería 100%!

nice
Vera é super atenciosa e gentil. O local é limpo e próximo a várias atrações.

Appartement suffisant pour un week end . Le prix et sa situation géographique sont top !

Tres bon accueil, Rafael est aux petits soins, la chambre est top et confortable, il y a deux salle de bains avec toilettes et douches, c'est vraiment top ! Le must
Great and approachable host. Spic and span house, clear communication and great location. What else would you want?
comodo e carino. problemi con acqua calda.
Todo excelente

great location and comfortable room. They let us leave the luggage in the livingroom, this was kind. unfortunately we had problems with breakfast: the fridge remaind empty for 2 days (we had to go in a bar)
Good location, simple communication with the host, stay here if you want some shared space, choose another place if you want some privacy

Vera and Rafael were wonderful.  I had some travel delays which put me in much later than expected, but Vera stayed late to check me in with no problem. The room was spacious and I had everything that I needed. The other houseguests were respectful of the quiet hours. The location is super convenient being 2 streets up from the subway, bus stop and tram.

We met Vera’s son Rafael who was super nice and hospitable. He gave us a tour and made himself accessible if we had issues. They put us in a nicer room than originally expected as another one of their guests had cancelled. Check in and check out was really easy. Easy walk to Ramiro - keep in mind that the apartment is in a very hilly area (Lisbon is very hilly in general) and we had to scale a hill to get to the apartment from the metro.
O local fica perto de muitos pontos turísticos. O anfitrião foi bastante atencioso!

Excelente localização, fácil acesso aos principais pontos turísticos e ao metro!

Com certeza voltarei em breve.
Rafael greated us in person. The place is clean and cute.It is well located. but the hill was a bit steep. Overall it is above the value and I would recommend it !

Accurately represented in the descriptions - but as European travellers we didn't expect the whole house to not have heating! We we freezing most of the time and both slept in jumpers. Even our bath towels had couldn't dry off for days since the air was very moist and cold.
The room is small, but good value for money if you don't mind the temperature and sometimes mildly-warm shower. Also, as other people wrote the walls are very thin and you can hear other people talking.
The breakfast is pretty basic, but we didn't run out of it.
Vera was very nice and even through our flight was delayed waited for us in the apartment till after 12am.
All in all the apartment is surely ok in the summertime, but will defiantly look for heating the next time I book an apartment in a 'warmer' country in autumn/winter.

Fui recebida muito bem pela anfitriã, ela é muito simpática. A localização da acomodação é ótima, próxima ao metrô e ao centro histórico de Lisboa. Quarto estiloso, limpo e confortável. Uma única crítica que faço é quanto ao colchão, de molas, que a qualquer pequeno movimento faz muito barulho (eu mesma acordava toda vez que me virava na cama). No demais, tudo perfeito!
Emplacement idéal .proche de tout .quartier calme mais insonorisation intérieure inexistante .dommage que certains hôtes oublient qu' ils ne sont pas tout seuls

Leider scheinen die Fotos hier schon mehrere Jahre alt zu sein.
Die Unterkunft hat inzwischen einige Renovierungsarbeiten und eine Grundreinigung nötig.
Einige der Möbel wurden ersetzt bzw. sind einfach weg.
In der Küche gibt nun es einen winzigen Kühlschrank in dem man sich mit allen 5 Zimmern zusammen ein Fach teilt, außerdem ist der Kühlschrank total dreckig und verschimmelt.
Viele Wände sind provisorisch eingezogene Trennwände und es ist unfassbar hellhörig, wenn einer schnarcht hört man das durch alle Zimmer.
Abgesehen von den ganzen anderen Menschen begegnet einem in der Wohnung auch immer mal wieder Schimmel, besonders im Bad und in unserem Schlafzimmer.
Leider sind die Kleiderhaken im Schlafzimmer so angebracht das man seine Kleidung oder Handtücher mitten in den Schimmel hängen müsste.
Da wir noch halbwegs gutes Wetter hatten konnten wir bei offenem Fenster schlafen und hatten daher weniger bedenken wegen der Sporen.
Fazit:
Für zwei Nächte kann man das überleben, aber ich gehe dann zukünftig lieber wieder in Hostels, da hat man für weniger Geld mehr Sauberkeit und Ruhe nachts.
A very minimal place to stay...doable but not very pleasant...it felt somewhat shoddy and uncared for.  The location is great...one of the rooms barely had space for our suitcases.

Cheap, close to everything, and Rafael was very helpful in getting us get settled and had some great local tips of where to eat.
Has everything you need for a few nights in Lisbon.

Rafael apartment is very well located, close to some of the most important monuments in the city. It is definitely not fancy, you should look for something else if you are not using your Airbnb only for sleeping. The apartment has other 3 rooms for Airbnb, and you must share 2 bathrooms with all the guests, which may be difficult if you want a shower. Rafael is very kind and includes the breakfast with the fee. However, if you don't wake up early enough, you will find only bread and butter, because the early birds usually take the ham and cheese. The bed is really soft and a little noisy, which may me uncomfortable. The walls are very thin, so you can perfectly listen to chatting of the guests in the next room. If you have a light sleep, i suggest ear plugs. the is a street light just next to the room, so you will be illuminated all night even using the blackout.
Our time at Vera's place was great. Great location and wonderful local tips from her son Rafael. We couldn't have really asked for more. Thank you!

best host ever! Rafael is so nice and patient, gave us many advices. the apartment is super cute and cosy. we loved to stay there! the neighbourhood is perfect to take walkings through Lisboa, to eat,die and discover some nice spots. it was great.
El alojamiento de vera está en buena ubicación! Está en el centro de la ciudad! Y se llega fácil del aeropuerto al hospedaje! Le recomiendo este hospedaje!

Das Zimmer in der Wohnung war klein,aber völlig ausreichend. Alles in der Wohnung war so wie beschrieben. Rafael war jeden Tag da,hat sich um Ordnung und Sauberkeit gekümmert,war auch per WhatsApp immer ansprechbar für Fragen und Wünsche.Die Wohnung hat WG-flair; insgesamt ein sehr gutes Preis-Leistung-Verhältnis.
Was uns gestört hat,war der nächtliche Lärm auf der Straße (wir mussten mit offenem Fenster schlafen,da zu warm),die sehr helle Straßenlaterne vor unserem Fenster und das extrem harte Bett.
Für ein paar Tage in dieser wunderbaren Stadt aber völlig okay.

This is convenient,comfortable and friendly accomodation. Vera and her son Rafael were wonderful hosts, and provided us with lots of good local recommendations. We found our room a little hot and the bed a little hard, but would still recommend staying here. Good value and well located.
Located downtown, nice room to stay in while visiting

Отличное расположение в центре города, быстрый и своевременный контакт с хозяином , хорошие советы от хозяина дома. Завтрака как такового не было, но можно было приготовить самому из продуктов в холодильнике.

Es war alles soweit in Ordnung, es ist nur extrem hellhörig und das Bett ist ungemütlich.
Das Zimmer reicht aus für einen Kurztrip nach Lissabon.
The location is not for kids and families.

We loved the location and the host Raphael was friendly and helpful.
However we found the place didn't quite live up to the photos shown on airbnb, breakfast was basic at it's best, kitchen a bit smelly and 2nd bathroom due a good clean

Estuvo muy bien! Muchas gracias a Vera y su hijo Rafael que hicieron todo para apoyarnos con las maletas y recibirnos lo mejor que se podia. Pudimos descansar muy rico durante nuestra estancia y el lugar es muy centrico.
Very nice Vara and Rafael. Sympathetic room, right in the center, good breakfast. I would recommend! :)
The house Is very nice and Raphael Is kind persone All perfect!!!

Erstmal zum positiven:
Die Lage ist gut man ist innerhalb 5 Minuten an der Bahnhaltestelle und man hat viele kleine „Supermärkte“ und Gassen um die ecke. Rafael der Sohn von Vera hat sich um alles gekümmert und hat auch relativ schnell geantwortet und sich um Probleme gekümmert.
Nun leider zum schlechten:
Da alle Zimmer auf den Bildern wunderschön aussehen haben wir uns sehr auf die Wohnung gefreut doch als wir ankamen waren wir verunsichert ob das wirklich die Wohnung ist die wir online gesehen haben. Das Bett war kleiner als dargestellt die Küche hat einen kleineren Kühlschrank in dem man nur 2 Fächer benutzten darf, die ganze Wohnung hat andere Möbel. Es sind zwei Bäder vorhanden, in dem „kleinem“ wo man sich als 185cm größer Mensch den Kopf beim duschen stoßt, hat Rost am dusch Boden was nur mit einer Gummi Matte „repariert“ wurde die drauf gelegt ist. Wenn man im kleinem Bad duscht ist unteranderem danach auch das ganze Bad unter Wasser. Das andere Bad war ganz Oke jedoch am abreise tag bildete sich ein loch zwischen den fließen wo Wasser austrat.
In unserem Zimmer riss am 2 Tag da regal aus der wand obwohl wir nur 2 Handtücher dort hängen hatten. Die Steckdosen sind der horror weil sie so alt sind das jeder Stecker direkt rausfliegt. Das Bett knarzt bei jeder Bewegung und ist viel zu klein für 2 Leute unteranderem kann man direkt auf dem Boden schlafen weil die Matratze sehr sehr hart ist. Fürs Frühstück war nur Toast,Marmeladen,butter,milch und 2 abgelaufene Säfte vor Ort. Am 2 Tag sagte uns eine Mitbewohnerin im Airbnb das wir Früchte nicht offen liegen lassen sollten wegen Ameisen in der Wohnung. Und wie auch schon in anderen Rezensionen genannt ist die Wohnung sehr hellhörig womit wir aber keine Probleme hatten dank Oropax. Die Föhns hörten nach 5 min auf zu funktionieren weil sie anscheinend überhitzt waren und unteranderem viel auch die Fensterbank auseinander.
Fazit: Die Besitzer sollten die ganze Bude renovieren und neue ECHTE Fotos reinstellen.
Vera was a lovely host. The room was clean and comfortable for two people. Under the breakfast you should understand: coffee, juice and toast.

La casa di Vera è molto carina ed arredata con gusto. Si avverte una atmosfera autentica. La casa e le camere sono semplici, senza fronzoli, un pò spartane, ma c'è tutto ciò che occorre ed è ben posizionata non lontano dal centro.
Rafael, che ci ha accolti, è stato molto gentile e disponibile.

We didn’t have the chance to meet Vera, but we did meet her son, Rafael. He responded quickly and was nice enough to let us check in before noon. He even let us leave our bags the next day after check out. The apartment was clean even with three additional rooms with other Airbnb guests. In the morning, we were able to make coffee and a small breakfast, which was a nice change as most Airbnb’s don’t offer this. Furthermore, the apartment was very close to central Lisbon. We were able to walk everywhere! Overall, we enjoyed our stay and would recommend Rafael and Vera’s place if visiting Lisbon.

We really enjoyed staying in Vera’s place. The apartment was located near the metro, with a walking distance to the city center. Apartment was quiet, we slept very well. We visited also other Portuguese towns and got great tips where to go and how to get there. Highly recommended!
O alojamento é muito típico e a Vera e o filho são extremamente simpáticos!
Superbe petite auberge dans un endroit très pratique pour partir en excursion !
Great location, easy to get around

Charming apartment on the 2nd floor located walking distance from the metro. Breakfast items were provided for in the kitchen which was appreciated. Great place to stay to easily explore one of the best cities in the world!
El alojamiento de Vera y Rafael es fantástico, cerca de todo y además limpio y confortable. Recomendados !!!
A little off the beaten path but close to the metro and pretty quiet.
Muy buen alojamiento calidad precio, los anfitriones han sido perfectos con nosotros en todos los sentidos, totalmente recomendable

The apartment was bit smaller than I expected but really sweet and tidy. Very good location and super hospitality! Rafael hosted us and he was really outgoing and nice, although we had several baggage problems which meant that we didn't arrive on time and couldn't leave on time. Super forthcoming, helpful and cool host! Although we spent only one night there, we had a really nice time. Thank you!

I travelled to Lisbon with my mom, and we felt very welcomed by Rafael, who was so friendly and helpful for everything we needed. The place is very stylish, and ventilated, it has a nice breeze during the day flowing through the bedroom. The neighbourhood is very close to touristic places, and we had no trouble walking about and sightseeing. We definitely recommend it, and we hope to travel again to Lisbon sometime, and staying again in Mouraria Guesthouse :)
Everything was great! Thanks Rafaele!

Rafael is an amazing host.... the airline lost our luggage and when they found it he took the calls & stayed at the appartment until they arrived! he helped us with suggestions for restaurants & where to go. We really enjoyed our stay. Close to everything & very clean! Thank you for absolutely everything!
Nice place, close to city center and metro. We had contact with Rafael on the day that we arrived, he explaind everything very well about the house, and was very friendly.
Great location, wonderful hosts, I would highly recommend Vera/Rafael’s place!
A good option.

The apartment is well located however be aware that the locals are loud in the street.
Raphael was very nice in let us check in before time.
We found our bed small for us and every time my husband turned , it squirmed:)
Bathrooms are ok. For me, it could be a little more clean but it is my personal opinion.
Yes, they do offer a small breakfast like fruit, bread, cookies, juice.
The people who share the place with us were considering.

This spot will have everything you need when it comes to essentials, especially if you are out all day in the city (which you should be) and only there to sleep!  Everyone is different about this, but the bed we had was very stiff.  It ended up being fine, but worth noting if that might mess with your sleep.  Make sure you get proper directions before you arrive or else it could be a little tricky to find, but not impossible.  You should be satisfied with the setup with multiple bathrooms and showers so you aren’t waiting on other guests to get in and out.
Beautiful room, really good location. Cannot beat the value - would recommend to anyone.

Vera and Rafael were great hosts. Easy to communicate with, hospitable, and their place shows that they think about the little things.
We loved the location. It’s in the heart of the older town but very close to the nightlife, as well as transit!
We would definitely stay again!
Nice location. Hard bed and a bit noisy.  I would recommend it though.

Merveilleux spot de séjour au coeur de Lisbonne et dans le fameux quartier du Fado. Nous n'avons pas eu l'occasion de rencontrer nos hôtes hormis au moment de l'accueil qui fut précis, cordial et disponible. Parties communes à part égérie
Fantastic location, walking distance to main tourist sights and hotspots, including beach and castle.
This is a great place to stay: clean, comfortable, and an incredible location. Check in was professional and friendly!
Very nice place!! We recommend it for your stay 😊

Although I only stayed at Vera and Raphael's for one night on a quick layover in Lisbon, I had a great stay at the apartment. Raphael was waiting for us at the time we said we were checking in, and gave us some good recommendations in the area as well as a map. There was also breakfast available in the morning which was really helpful since we had to leave bright and early for the airport the next day.

Our stay was really pleasant. Even if some things were not perfect, like the level of loudness, or the mattress that was too hard for me (personal preferences I guess), the location, the communication and breakfast in the morning definitely made up for it :) Good calue for money! :)

Sehr viele gute Restaurants, Cafés in unmittelbarer Nähe. Zu Fuss ist man schnell in Barrio Alto und im Stadtteil Alfama. Auf die letzten Nachrichten kamen keine Antworten mehr von Vera, der Check in hat trotzdem gut geklappt. Ein Bekannter von Vera hat uns empfangen und uns sehr hilfreiche Restaurant-Tipps gegeben.

I stayed here for one night only but that one night was one of my best Airbnb experiences ever. They held my luggage since I arrived before check-in with no issues and while I was out, they put my stuff in my room for me. The room was lovely. The fact that they have a little kitchen with all the amenities you may need is my favorite thing.  The shower had hot water with great pressure and since it was chilly at night, I closed my bedroom window. There are 4 rooms for guest and a common area with a balcony. This is great for solo travelers such as myself because it allows you to meet other travelers. I dont have anything negative to say about this experience, it was simply wonderful. Also, the location is perfect. A taxi from the Airport was about 10 Euros and the location is walking distance everywhere.
Cosy place to stay during your holiday in Lisbon.

I stayed for two nights and this was everything I needed as a base from which to explore. I ha e to admit that I’m a bit of a spontaneous traveller and hadn’t really researched the area, so I was thrilled to find it was only about a ten minute walk from Rossio station - perfect for my train trip to Sintra! Everything was clean and well presented with excellent directions from the airport given.
Very nice people
Leuk appartement dichtbij metrostation/stadscentrum van lissabon. Wel wat gehorig dus oordopjes zijn handig!

We had a very pleasant stay at Veras' place. We stayed judt one night and needed a place that was central with good access to public transport. The location was cery convenient as it's only a minute from the metro and walking to downtown is really quick as well.
The apartment itself was very clean and tidy. The only real downside was the poor sound isolation in the apartment/rooms; you could clearly hear most people going around the apartment and there was some noise from outside too. Luckily the apartment is a bit removed from the busiest streets so the npise from outside didn't keep us up or anything.
Vera was very quick to reply when we had a small problem with the water heater and the thing was solved in minutes from me messaging Vera. Couldn't ask for better service, it was a very nice stay!
We had a great time, everything was very good and clean and comfortable. Top located, in walking distance to the castelo and the cosy backstreets of alfama. Beautifuy location 😊👍

Proche du centre ville, ce logement vous fait découvrir une autre version de Lisbonne.
L’appartement est bien situé et bien équipé.
Raphael qui nous a accueilli est très sympathique et prêt à donner des petits conseils sur la ville.
Très chouette séjour.

Goede locatie. Je moet een beetje geluk hebben met de kamer die je krijgt, sommigen zijn wat groter dan andere. We hadden wel wat problemen met een tekort aan warm water. Prijs/kwaliteit verhouding ok.

Great people - Rafael is a fountain of local info and helped us get out feet on the ground in Lisbon. Great location - we were able to walk everywhere and again Rafael gave us the key tram and bus routes for getting around and out of Lisbon. Authentic Portuguese experience with a hint of Brazil!

A cosy private room in an apartment hosting more guests situated in the heart of the historic Alfama area with a number of nice local bars and transport links. A shared kitchen with a fridge, toaster and hobs as well as basic breakfast provisions is also at the guests' disposal. Rafael was very helpful accommodating for our late check in.
Zentral gelegen, nette Gastgeber und sehr schön eingerichtet. Gut für Städtetrip nach Lissabon!

Apartment really cute, very well located in Lisbon (downtown) ! Good way to discover the typical Lisbon !! It's also very clean ! I came with my mother and she enjoyed as much as me !!
Vera and Rafael were clear and responsive in case of questions !
I will recommend this experience to my friends and to my family !! :)

Great room in historic neighborhood of Lisbon. Raphael was waiting for us when we arrived and made getting settled in very easy. Room was clean and apartment had everything we needed. Good location for exploring surrounding areas and landmarks on foot. Highly recommend doing the Free Walking Tour offered just down the hill in Rossio Square to start out the trip and get some inside tips on seeing the sites.

Het is een schattige woning met 4 kamers. Je deelt dus 2 badkamers en de keuken met elkaar. De woning straalt heel veel sfeer uit en we vonden de details  prachtig. De locatie is perfect, je bent echt zo op het plein Martin Moniz. Dus beter kon het niet. Bakkerij, kleine winkels zijn allemaal op loopafstand 20-150 m. Voor de prijs mogen wij echt niet klagen en was het een goede prijs-kwaliteitsverhouding. Wat wij wat minder vonden, was dat de woning ontzettend gehorig is. Je hoort letterlijk alles van je buren, van omdraaien in bed, hoesten, gesprekken letterlijk alles. Neem oordopjes mee! De woning is ook ontzettend vochtig (er was geen verwarming in onze kamer (!) en ook de de handdoeken zijn ruiken muf en zijn vochtig. Helaas waren wij iets teleurgesteld over de communicatie. Wij hebben meer dan 1,5 maanden op een reactie via airbnb moeten wachten (daarna ging het iets vlotter) omtrent vragen en ook ter plaatse verliep de communicatie niet helemaal soepel. Vera hebben wij nooit ontmoet, maar wel haar zoon Rafael. Op de dag van aankomst, kon de taxi chauffeur het huisnummer niet vinden en hebben wij geprobeerd iemand te bereiken. Geen gehoor. Na heel veel gedoe uiteindelijk het appartement gevonden, maar was niemand te bekennen bij het appartement, terwijl wij van tevoren het tijdstip keurig hadden doorgegeven. Het zou niet erg geweest zijn als het droog was maar een bui naar de andere kwam naar beneden en waren waren gewoon helemaal nat. Gelukkig kwam uiteindelijk een buurman langs en liet ons tenminste naar binnen. Later kwam ook Rafael en hij vertelde dat hij in de file stond en 2 uur te laat was. Dus onze kamer was dan ook nog niet klaar en konden wij uiteindelijk rond 20.00 uur naar binnen. Niet erg maar geef dit even door, je hebt ons nummer! Stel daar was geen buurman geweest die toevallig langskwam, en hadden wij 2 uur buiten voor de deur moeten staan! Wij waren weggegaan en hadden een andere locatie geboekt.  Ook bij vertrek hadden wij een vraag omtrent de sleutels en via whatsapp kwam pas uren daarna een reactie. Als gastheer kun je tenminste een 'fijne vlucht of bedankt dat jullie hier waren' sturen, maar ook dit kwam niet. Dus samenvatting, leuk appartement, prijs was super, locatie top, appartement extreem gehorig en vochtig (wellicht niet in de zomer maar wij hadden alleen regen) maar omtrent de communicatie van gastvrouw en gastheer zijn wij teleurgesteld en hadden wij meer verwacht.
Everything was perfect! Very close to the citycentre and shops. we will come back ! Thanks

Felt like we lived in this picturesque, old world area - so much more fun than a hotel. Easily walkable, safe, but watch for daytime pickpockets outside! Very clean and easy and helpful. Bed was hard and not so comfortable.
Vera’s apartment is cosy and well located. Rafael met us and made check in very easy and gave us some great tips of Lisbon and Sintra. We had a great stay!
Sehr schöne und saubere Zimmer und überaus hilfsbereite Gastgeber.

Vera und Rafael sind wundervolle Gastgeber, die es verstehen eine tolle Übernachtungsmöglichkeit zu bieten. Ja, es ist wahrscheinlich ein wenig hellhörig, doch das gehört nun wirklich zum bunten Treiben in Lissabon dazu. Vor allem die zahlreichen Tipps von Rafael seien nochmals gesondert hervorzuheben. Ganzgleich ob eine Einkaufsmöglichkeit, Restauranthinweise oder die Gelegenheit unsere Koffer noch ein wenig länger unterzustellen kein Wunsch sollte uns abgeschlagen werden. Wir bedanken uns vielmals und wünschen den Beiden weiterhin alles Gute. :)
Great location , clean room, highly recommended :)

One of the best hosts you could imagine. SO flexible with our check-in when our flight was delayed, so helpful with local tips and cultural advice, and so accommodating overall. These are people who genuinely care about their guests. Highly recommend staying with them not only for the lovely space in a perfect neighbourhood, but because they are great human beings.

We had the pleasure of spending a few nights here and had a wonderful stay. We arrived a bit early but luckily Rafael was incredibly accommodating, he showed us around the apartment and let us know about some nearby sights. The room was spotless and the overall apartment was very clean. They also offer breakfast items and coffee to guests.
The location was great, lots of small markets nearby as well as some really great local restaurants. Our favourite was "A vaidosa do terreirinho", a small family-run place only a few minutes walk away.

Super séjour ! L'appartement est très sympa et très bien situé.
Vera et son fils sont arrangeants.
Je recommande vivement.

Due to the long-haul flight with the delayed schedule for the transit, I got to this apartment even later than 10 p.m. so I felt really sorry to Rafael(Vera's son) and also appreciated his warm welcome and quick and helpful house tour.
The stay was meaningful cause I have wondered how it would be like behind the big gate of typical Southern European apartments. Just like the descriptions, it is traditional(hostoric or old) apartment located in Lisbon's multicultural Alfama district. Vera seemed to put some effort into this house to give charater to each room and space. Everything was quite old but well organised to give guests convenience.
It was a wise choice to take a taxi from the airport especially at night because of the cobbled hillside street and also (sorry but) the less welcoming atmosphere at night. Some reviewers also mentioned the thin wall and I agree with them. I could hear snoring sounds and low voice chats coming from the neighbouring rooms.
Les photos embelisse la réalité (taille des pièces), nous avons était déçu par rapport à ce à quoi nous nous entendions. Cependant Le fils de vera qui s'est occupé de nous accueillir est très gentil.

Vera’a place was amazing. The location is centrally located so everywas easily accessible. It was an authentic Portuguese flat which made us feel like we were getting the full experience! Her son Rafeal made Check in easy and offered some great tips for sight seeing. We would definitely stay here again!
Alex ha sido muy amable. El piso está bien ubicado y Alex nos ha dado muy buenos consejos para visitar la ciudad. Muy recomendable

Super Appartement, it is clean, nice Breakfast. Vera an Rafael are super friendly, kind and helpful. The only thing is that I think there are quite a lot of rooms for that space in the appertment. But of course the price and what you get for it is absolutely fine. Thank you
Cute room. Rafael gave helpful tips when asked about Lisbon. Little bits for breakfast provided as well.
Great host, was very helpful and kind. Nice room to stay in and apartment to share with other guests.

Although the host was very kind and clear in his explanations, we were disappointed because of the difference between photos and the actual condition of the apartment. Our room was tiny, and the cleaning is not great especially in the bathrooms.
Bueno piso

Vera and her son Raffa, are very nice and pleasant people. We really enjoyed our stay and had great time in Lisbon. Raffa explained in detail every thing and during our arrival he waited and put much effort to welcome us.
Very nice place to stay in a superb location. The bed is not the broadest for the less social sleepers between us, yet that is made up for by the cosyness.

This is a bit more like a hostel than a guesthouse. It is clean and neat and within easy walking distance to a nice coffee shop and metro. I never met Vera but her son gave me a very warm welcome. My room was lovely and my bed comfortable. If you are a light sleeper, you may struggle to sleep as the walls are very thin and the wooden floors are quite squeaky so you can hear other guests talking in their rooms and doors opening and closing and people moving around the space. The other thing you should know is that the hot water situation isn't great in the showers - water was either cold or barely lukewarm. Breakfast is basic (cereal, milk, bread, cheese, jam) but does the job and is included in the price. However, ingredients ran out twice during my four night (milk and cheese) stay so you have to be flexible and eat what is there rather than what you really wanted (toast with jam instead of say, cereal). If you are a woman traveling on your own, you may not want to arrive as late as I did in the evening (around 8:30pm). I felt quite uncomfortable looking at directions on my phone while a lot of men stood around outside bars and on street corners drinking. The area is safe but I did feel quite vulnerable. I had a good stay but for the purpose of a transparent review I felt the need to note the above.

Está justo en el centro de Lisboa con acceso fácil al Metro. La zona se sentía insegura. Rafael es un muy buen anfitrión y el cuarto estaba limpio. Falta un poco de limpieza en la ducha pero dentro de todo y por el precio, bastante bien!

We were welcomed by Rafael. He was nice and very helpful. The place is beautiful and close from everything. It was nice to have somerhing to eat on the morning.
It was perfect for 2 days in Lisbon.

merci pour votre attente malgré notre retard .
location propre et calme
Nette Gastgeber. Super zentrale Lage. Perfekt um die Stadt zu erkunden. Gerne wieder!
Nice stay, friendly host.

Vera's place was cute, clean, perfectly located for access to Alfama, and served as the perfect accommodations for a travelling couple. Even though there are shared spaces, it easily feels like it is just you. Vera and her son were incredibly hospitable and even allowed us to leave our bags there after check-out to give us more time in the city. I will definitely stay here again if I return!

Vera's place is wonderful. It is a charming old house, very tastefully done and the location is excellent. Vera was there to receive us. Although we had a language barrier, we ended up communicating without any effort. She and her son Rafael are both very friendly and had made sure that the place was ready by the time we arrived. The kitchen was well-stocked too. Although we had to share the kitchen, bathroom & living room with other people, it was not a problem for us at all probably because our schedule didn't clash with others. All in all, it was a great stay. I would surely recommend Vera's place.

The flat has the basics needed for a quick stay. The host was very easy to check in with especially late in the evening. The bed is a little stiff and the room was warm but there was a fan. There are two bathrooms for you, which was nice. It’s a little behind some of the Rossio area but easy to walk to. Good value.

O quarto é fofo, com uma decoração linda e aconchegante. A casa também é linda em um local super próximo ao metro e ônibus. Fui super bem recebida pelo Rafael filho da Vera. Ele foi muito gentil e atencioso comigo me mostrando toda a casa e se dispondo pra tudo que eu precisasse. Eles deixam alguns mimos na geladeira para os hóspedes, eu achei incrível. E a casa é toda equipada. Vale a pena ficar hospedado na casa da Vera. Eu amei tudo!
Muito boa a estancia fazia muito calor no quarto mas era um dia demaseado quente de resto tudo perfecto

We had a really good stay! Rafael (Vera's son) is a really nice and helpful person and really interesting to talk to. Communication was really easy. The appartment is great and has everything you need, even two bathrooms. The bed is comfortable and the location perfect -
you can easily walk the city from there. We can highly recommend staying there!
The place is clean and very near the center. Bathrooms were always clean and tidy. Rafael is a very nice and helpful host.

The apartment is very well situated, the area is beautiful and fun. The room was nice, there was some food and coffee for breakfast, and the hosts were very helpful. It's true that the apartment is a bit noisy but we were already aware of this when we reserved so it did not bother us!

Rafael was a great host and the place was fantastic! He was more than willing to provide tips on what to do/where to eat, and was very helpful in answering all my questions and assisting me (even late at night when I had difficulties unlocking the door). It is a great, clean, quaint place and has everything you need - even breakfast! Highly recommend staying here and would book again.
Best place to get to know Lisbon in a short time. The location is really close to the Center of the city.

Vera's son Rafael did the check in and the overall communication with us. He seemed friendly to us and also cares regularly about the accommodation: Rafael provides basic breakfast including bread, jam, coffee and milk in the morning. You can have breakfast in a bright room equipped with three little tables and stools, which creates a very cozy vacation atmosphere. In the same room, you can find lots of tourist information on Lisbon. There are four guest rooms and two bathrooms. Although all guest rooms were fully booked, we never experienced any trouble with bathroom waiting times. The neighborhood is cute and lovely and not (yet) taken over by tourists. A stroll around is worth it.

Really nice place, good location, good size bed for two friends to sleep in and some character yet clean. Super big plus for the flexibility considering check-in/-out. Con was that on our last day, there was no breakfast but I guess that is due to the other people who also stayed in the apartment (6 plus us 2) or maybe they just should have stocked the fridge a bit better. :) nevertheless, would pick this location again! Kiitos x

Very nice and cozy apartment with pretty rooms. Kitchen is available. There are four bedrooms in total and two bathrooms which is very nice to have. When we stayed, there was one other couple staying as well. Check-in was easy with Vera. She seems to be a nice & sweet person. Since she doesn't speak English, her son Rafeal does communication via cell phone.
Mattresses are rather hard :(. At nights the very lively neighborhood seems too be even livelier and a little shady. Not recommended for solo female travelers at night!
The location is close to the Castel and a Metro station. No big supermarkets nearby.
In the summer, bedrooms heat up. Opening windows is possible if you can deal with noise and bright street lights.
Overall, nice stay.
The apartment is nice and very clean! The host was kind and very helpful! Recommended!
Buena ubicación, muy buenos anfitriones, cerca del centro, cordialidad, respeto, atención, limpieza, transportes accesibles. Es para recomendarlo!
Notre chambre dans l'appartement de Vera était très cosy et le lit top ! La place principale de Lisbonne est à 5 minutes à pied donc très pratique pour visiter la ville.

Raphael was so helpful and made check-in very easy with great directions and was there to greet us and show us around the apartment. You're very close to the centre of the city at this apartment and places to eat.
We only spent one night, but really enjoyed it.

We had a really nice stay at Vera's and Rafael's apartment. It's very close to the city center and to the Metro station "Martim Moniz". The apartment is clean, our room was comfortable and we felt very welcome.
Thanks a lot, especially to Rafael who did the check-in with us.

Wir haben 2 Nächte hier verbracht und waren total begeistert!
Es war überall sehr sauber und insgesamt gemütlich eingerichtet.
Die Wohnung liegt gut, in einem etwas ruhigeren Viertel. Dennoch ist man schnell im Zentrum Lissabons und nur 10 Minuten entfernt liegt ein Aussichtspunkt, der einen über ganz Lissabon blicken lässt.
Wir haben unseren Aufenthalt sehr genossen!:)
Wir hatten eine sehr schöne Zeit in der gut gelegenen und liebevoll eingerichteten Wohnung von Vera und Rafael. Beide waren sehr nett und super flexibel. Wir kommen gerne wieder!
HIGHLY recommended.  Cozy, secure, and great location.  Pictures are accurate and the hosts are incredibly accommodating.

Wij hebben een fijne tijd gehad in Lissabon in Appartemento Mouraria. De ligging is goed, ongeveer 15 min lopen tot het centrum. Het appartement is prima en netjes, alleen het matras is heel erg hard. Je hebt het gevoel alsof je op een plank ligt. Dit was iets minder, verder adviseer ik dit appartement zeker.

La chambre que nous avons louée était très bien, conforme aux photos (même si les plans larges laissent penser que les locaux sont plus grands). L'appartement à partager ne pose pas de souci, au niveau de la propreté des salles de bain ou de la cuisine, c'est correct. Le fils de Vera, Rafael, vient semble-t-il quasi quotidiennement pour nettoyer. L'emplacement est très pratique, l'accueil est agréable, le petit-déjeuner du matin est un plus. Je recommande ! Tout s'est très bien passé et le rapport qualité-prix est bon.
Petit bémol sur le bruit le soir qui gêne un petit peu, et la dureté du matelas...

Bardzo dobra lokalizacja mieszkania oraz komunikacja z gospodarzami.
Możemy polecić!
Mały minus: czystość kuchni oraz brak czajnika elektrycznego.

The house is in a great location, very easy to get to, a bit of a hill up but tuc tucs and taxis everywhere if you have lots of bags! Area is great, lots of good places and is at the start of the tram 28 route which is great! Bed was a tad firm but room good and kitchen and bathroom facilities great with breakfast there! Thanks!

Nous avons passé un très agréable séjour dans cette chambre !
L'accueil a été très chaleureux et l’hôte nous a beaucoup aidé sur les visites importantes à faire à Lisbonne (nous y sommes resté que 2 jours).
Le bnb est conforme aux photos et est idéalement situé pour faire une grande partie des visites à pieds ou rejoindre le métro.

O local da Vera e Rafael é muito bem organizado, limpo e de ótima localização - A Mouraria é um lugar muito agradável, com bares e restaurantes e próximo do Centro de Lisboa, inclusive à pé ou de Metro.
Quarto agradável, cama boa com todas as comodidades necessárias.
Rafael nos recebeu de forma muito carinhosa, solícito e nos dando todas as informações que precisávamos, sempre com a maior paciência - Um diferencial em relação a outros airbnb que ficamos.
Recomendo muito o local.
Marize e Marco
The apatment is vey close to the City center! We had a nice stay.

Das apartment ist super gelgen für einen Aufenthalt in Lissabon und Vera ist eine freundliche Gastgeberin. Die meisten Hotspots könnten wir zu Fuß erreichen.
Das Zimmer war schön eingerichtet. Einzig das bett ist etwas klein. Für große Leute vielleicht etwas schwierig.
Vera hat die Wohnung jeden Tag geputzt und es war angenehm sauber.
Frühstück haben wir uns selber besorgt, weil wir lieber Obst wollten. Es gibt nur toast, cornflakes und Kaffee/ Tee.
Vera was a lovely and accommodating host. The apartment was clean and tidy and well located. I will certainly think of this place for my next stay in Lisbon.
Séjour agréable qui a commencé par un accueil chaleureux du fils de Vera. La chambre est fidèle à la photo. Petit bémol sur le store qui laisse beaucoup trop passer la lumière.
Rafael es un excelente anfitrión! El departamento es muy agradable y acogedor con todo lo necesario para que la estadía sea amena. Buena ubicación, cerca del metro.
Доброжелательный прием и отзывчивые хозяева

The apartment was perfect for a short stay in Lisbon, Raphael was a perfect host, he is always willing to help and available to solve all your questions. We arrived somewhat late and Raphael waited for us very patiently. The room was clean, comfortable but can be a little bit noisy at night. However the apartment is big with a well equipped kitchen and bathrooms, also it is close to public transportation and some restaurants.
Het was een fijne plek, leuk ingericht. De buurt lag centraal was goed bereikbaar en het contact met Rafael was erg aangenaam en verliep heel vlot!
The apartement is situated in a very good position, communication with Rafael was unproblematic - everything fine! :)

Местоположение хорошее. Цена неплохая.
В квартире газовая колонка для нагрева воды, которая работала от случая к случаю, и почти всегда приходилось умываться в холодной воде. Иногда и при приеме душа горячая вода не включалась. Что нас неприятно удивило в самом начале: при предварительном общении нам сказали, что можно пользоваться кухней и готовить еду. По приезду выяснилось, что пользоваться можно холодильником, чайником и микроволновкой, но не плитой, т.к. "плитой можно пользоваться при выкупе всех апартаментов. Если живут разные люди то при возникновении пожара, непонятно кто будет виноват". Есть проблема с входной дверью в дом: замок клинит и нужно особым образом вставлять и поворачивать ключ, чтобы его открыть. На это уходило до 10 минут. Согласитесь, не очень приятно вернуться с прогулки вечером и 10 минут ковыряться в замке. Хозяин на это сказал только, что нам нужно "больше практики".
Также обращу внимание на превосходную слышимость между комнатами - слышно, что говорят люди в соседней комнате, и сильный шум с улицы -
при открытом окне слышно грохот мусоровоза, убирающего мусор ночью или ранним утром, газующие в горку машины и шум из ближайшего бара.Мусорную корзину внутри комнаты за неделю ни разу не убрали, постельное белье не меняли. Наверно это предполагается при проживании в хостеле, но 2 года назад в этом же районе за схожие деньги в комнате проводилась ежедневная уборка и смена белья.
На долгий срок - не рекомендую, на пару ночей - вполне подойдет.

Very central; close to metro station. Very friendly welcome. Room clean; good bed. Fully equipped kitchen and bathrooms. Can be noisy at night, but double glazing makes a difference. Good value for money. Recommended.
Merci pour tout, l'emplacement est parfait. Super rapport qualité/prix.

This place is amazing! We loved staying here. It is a great location and very close to everything including a metro stop. It is set up like a bed and breakfast with 4 different rooms. Every room has a locked door. There are two full bathrooms that were both very clean. There is a kitchen with breakfast in the morning. We had a lovely stay and would come back in a heartbeat! Thank you Rafael!
nice place, clean and as expected

Aanrader! Erg fijne kamer praktisch in het centrum. Het is een ruime kamer in een 4 slaapkamer apartement, die dus gedeeld wordt met anderen. Ontbijt wordt soor de eigenaren achtergelaten (brood, cornflakes). 2 douches + toiletten, worden schoongemaakt. Eigenaar makkelijk te bereiken, en erg aardig. Aanrader!

apartamento ruidoso, y las camas muy muy duras, por lo que descansar fue algo difícil (los colchones son demasiado viejos y son como dormir en el suelo). el barrio está en una zona cercana a muchas cosas para visitar a pie. lo malo fue el ruido y la cama, la zona del barrio no parece muy segura, por la noche teníamos un poco de miedo al volver a casa. Además la llave del portal no funcionaba bien.
Very nice appartment in a central location. Great for spending a day or two in Lisbon!
Muy buen lugar, comodo y accesible. Cerca de todo. Rafael muy servicial, el desayuno bueno para arrancar el día sin preocuparte de tomarlo afuera. Muy recomendable.

El departamento está muy bien ubicado, nos permitió sentir Lisboa desde adentro! Es un piso muy cómodo, habitación amplia y limpio. Rafael fue de gran ayuda, nos recomendó lugares que no debíamos dejar de conocer y fue muy detallista en cómo llegar a cada uno de ellos. Agradecidos!
The room was prettier than we thought. Service was to a professional standard. Located around public transport. We would highly recommend!

We spent 6 nights at Vera's place and quite enjoyed them. One of the down sides of the room is its size, which is quite small for a longer stay in which you sometimes would just like to chill out in the room for a while. Also, for a day or two there wasn't any toast left - it got replenished, though. The location is excellent and allows you to do most (if not all) of the sightseeing on foot. All in all, this place offers very good value for money and Rafael provided some useful tips at our arrival.

Unser Aufenthalt war sehr angenehm. Die Lage ist super, das Zentrum ist 5 min. zu Fuß entfernt. Alles ist sauber und Rafael ist jeden Tag in der Wohnung und stets ansprechbar. Zwei Sachen muss ich loswerden: die AirBnB ist relativ groß und es kommen täglich neue Gäste und die Gegend ist - sagen wir mal - interessant. Ansonsten alles top.

The location is good, close to the city center. Room was clean, bright and stylish:). But take your earplugs with you - walls are thin. In the apartment you can also use kitchen (with juice, bread, butter, jam, milk and cornflakes for the breakfast) which was clean and two barhrooms. Highly reccomend!
My room in this apartment was fine. Clean kitchen and bathrooms and great location. Im very satisfied with my stay here. Thank you!
位置很不错，离景点很近，性价比也很不错
Beautiful cosy & authentic Lisbon guesthouse! Rafael & Vera were super helpful & welcoming. Would really recommend if you want somewhere that feels authentic both in guesthouse and location!
