Rafael es un excelente y educado anfitriòn. Nos recibiò en tiempo y forma correcta. Sus indicaciones fueron vitales para movernos durante 24 hs en Lisboa. La habitaciòn es luminosa y ventilada naturalmente, fue reciclada a nueva con pintura es silenciosa y posee muy buen wifi.

Vera's son Rafael welcomed us nicely and gave us some Restaurant tips. The communication was easy and polite, they answered all our questions right away.
The room is small, but quite cozy, totally fine for a short stay, but maybe not for a week, because the kitchen and bathroom are not that comfortable. The neighbourhood is lively, so it can be a bit louder during the night. But all in all they were nice hosts and tried their best for us to have a good trip!

Appartement très bien situé dans le vieux Lisbonne mais assez bruyant certains soirs pour les chambres donnant côté rue. Ameublement standard et accueil sympathique.
Petit déjeuner aléatoire suivant les jours et l'occupation de l'appartement.
Bien si vous ne restez qu'une nuit à Lisbonne
Cool place in a lovely neighborhood. Rafael was an excellent, very responsive and helpful guest. I recommend!

Habitación muy linda y acogedora, el departamento es también muy bonito, con espacios comunes amplios, y dos baños compartidos. Nos recibió Rafael, el hijo de Vera, súper atento y amable, nos recomendó lugares para comer y nos permitió dejar las valijas al momento de irnos. Muchas gracias!

Great welcome and check-in. Place is nicely tucked away from (but close to) the action and pretty easy to find. A quick 5 minute walk and you'll be feasting on delicious salt cod, sangria and pastries galore. Good value!
Great

It's a beautiful place to stay! And you'r really fast anywhere. Rafael was really nice and helpful.
bedsheets and and towels were fresh, just the appartement is in general not the cleanest. But still ok, since it's 'just' dust.
But we will for sure choose this place again in case of coming back!

It was as advertised, clean and excellently located in the historic part of Lisbon.
The apartment was basic, cute, and clean. Very nice host.
Good location which is near the castle! Rafael recommended some restaurants nearby the apartment which serve good food with good price! Room is very spacious for two of us!
Fim de semana muito positivo...Boa localização. ..qualidade preço e excelente comunicação.  A repetir :)

Makkelijk gevonden vanuit de luchthaven, bij aankomst heeft Rafaël ons goed ontvangen. Kamertje is wat aan de kleine kant, maar qua prijs redelijk voor wat je krijgt. Het bed is wel slecht, na een half uur rechtop zitten voel je je achterste niet meer.
Er zijn 2 badkamers, eentje dat klein is en heel veel roest bevat (oa ook op het toilet) en een andere dat bijna constant onder water staat door het gebruik van de douche. Handdoeken zijn wel ter plaatse en vers gewassen.
In de keuken is een gasvuur wat het handig maakt om af en toe eens te koken. Ook staat er een broodrooster wat handig is voor 's ochtends mee te onbijten.
Locatie is goed, op 10minuten van het Rossio plein. Enkel ligt het wel meer in een eigenaardigere buurt van Lissabon, maar dat valt best mee.

L'appartamento è molto carino ed accogliente e si trova in una zona perfetta, a pochi minuti a piedi dai principali monumenti del centro. Rafael è stato un host molto gentile e disponibile che ci aiutato molto con la prenotazione di una cena in un ristorante per ben due giorni.

Un lugar central, perfecto para conocer lo más íntimo de la ciudad. Se puede llegar caminando a muchos lugares de interés o tienes cerca transporte público para movilizarte. Es un barrio muy antiguo, pero con el tranvía cerca, todo tiene su encanto.
Great location, and authentic apartment.
It was a very cute apartment. Rafael was a very helpful and nice host. It wasn't very soundproof.

El Apartamento Mouraria esta muy bien comunicado ! el barrio de Baixa tiene unas vistas preciosas de la ciudad de Lisboa. Rafael fue muy amable y pudimos dejar unas horas nuestro equipaje en la casa antes de nuestro vuelo. Nos encanta Lisboa ! volveremos !
Great place very close to the lovey town of Alfama. Very price worthy and included everything we expected plus more.

nice place and very nice welcoming,
just the sound insultation in the apartment is not so good, but overall a good adress

Dirty and mess all over the place. We've check-in after 3h30PM and our room was not ready with pillows wets and apt. was discanting dirty. old neighborhood with creep guys around the corners selling drugs. Me and my wife decide not too stay, and left immediately.

Had a wonderful stay at Vera's place! Rafael was very helpful on arrival, and the included breakfast was a great bonus! Everything was very clean, the area was quiet, and it was an overall great location.

Raphael is a great host and very easy to contact. The apartment is nice and it has the basic stuff. It is not in a very friendly area but the metro is very near and you can get very fast to the touristic areas. The bathroom is complicated because it is difficult to keep it clean having other guests.

merci à Rafael pour sin accueil. effectivement le logement est très bien situé tout près du château,le métro est à  3minutes à pied et le quartier et sympa. logement propre. un peu bruyant le soir mais ca ne dure pas.
A basic but convenient accommodation to visit the city. Okay for one night but wouldn't stay longer: the room was very small and the bathroom not well cleaned.
Notre hôte a été très acceuillant et arrangeant pendant notre séjour et je L en remercie

Cozy rooms with charm. The location is superb and the apartment quite. We enjoyed our stay a lot and were positively surprised by the provided breakfast. Rafa (Vera's son) was super helpful, flexible and willing to help. It is definitely a place to stay if you are there for leisure, not if you are there for work. There are two showers for 4 rooms and you might need to wait if they are all occupied. I totally recommend this place for a rustic experience.

Rafael was able to accommodate our late check-in and was very helpful, even letting us take a larger, comfortable room which was unoccupied. The apartment is somewhat noisy -- both from within and outside the building, but it is central, after all. We were able to park on the street nearby without too much trouble (though we'd recommend *not* trying to drive in Lisbon), and the place suited our needs for an overnight stay!
Passé un tres bon sejour chez Vera ,,, son fils Rafael a ete tres gentil,,,, la seule chose négative,,, les mur son en carton,mal insonorisé

La casa di Vera è in posizione centralissima ma un po' nascosta alla vista; pulita, accessoriata, ordinata e con un ottimo wifi. Posizionata su più livelli garantisce comunque il massimo confort contro rumori e confusione. La cucina è sempre ben fornita per la colazione e i pasti. Raphael, figlio di Vera, è stato disponibile per ogni tipo di informazione ed esigenza e parla un ottimo inglese.

Omistaja oli helposti saavutettavissa ja auttavainen. Naapurusto oli lähellä kaupungin keskustaa ja hyvin viehättävä. Kaikkea oli tarjolla kävelymatkan päässä. Wifi toimi hyvin ja huoneisto oli siisti.
very good location, nice room, everything was fine. thank you

Rafael, Vera's son, is a very nice guy. The room looks like the photos but smaller. The location is near city center and close to metro station but not in the best neighbourhood. The acces to the bathrooms is through the kitchen and this was a bit an inconvenient. The nice part was that there was some breakfast in the morning for all guest.
If you're looking for a pleasant and inexpensive place to stay in Lisbon this is the right place for you.
El apartamento es acogedor aunque un poco ruidoso. Raphael fue atento connlas direcciones de la ubicacion
Obrigado Rafael! Deu tudo certo, adorei o quarto! tchau, até mais
Very nice accommodation

Wir wurden sehr herzlich begrüßt und haben uns sofort wohlgefühlt. Die Zimmer sind nett und sinnvoll eingerichtet. In der Küche konnte man sich morgens selber das Frühstück zusammenstellen, was praktisch ist, wenn man wie wir einen sehr frühen Flug hat. Das Appartement ist sehr gut gelegen, wir konnten alles zu Fuß erreichen. In den kleinen Gassen sind  nette Lokale, wo man günstig und gut essen kann! Besser als auf den großen Plätzen der Stadt! Um die Ecke gibt es ein kleines afrikanisches Restaurant, was sehr zu empfehlen ist! Besonders nett fanden wir, dass Rafael uns gegen ein kleines Entgelt am nächsten Morgen zum Flughafen gefahren hat. Wir werden bestimmt wieder kommen!

A Vera e Rafael foram muito atenciosos desde o início.
Infelizmente só fiquei hospedada uma noite, mas tudo ocorreu muito bem. O apartamento é limpo, bem equipado e os quartos são de muito bom gosto.
Como houve uma desistência de uma outra reserva na mesma noite que eu cheguei, eles fizeram a gentileza de me acolher em um quarto maior.
A rua estava em reforma e não tinha muita sinalização, o que dificultou um pouco achar o endereço.

Wir waren für vier Nächte in Veras B&B. Die Wohnung ist für eine Stadterkundung sehr gut gelegen, sehr nah an der Metro-Station Martim Moniz. Veras Sohn Rafael empfing uns und zeigte uns alles. Auch war er beinahe täglich in der Wohnung und beantwortete Fragen stets. Die Wohnung war außerdem sehr sauber. Zu bemängeln ist einzig die relativ schlecht ausgestattet Küche. Falls jemand kochen möchte, wird das relativ schwieg. Da der Toaster in der Zeit, in der wir dort waren, kaputt war, gab es zum Frühstück nur Cornflakes.
Vor dem Haus befindet sich außerdem eine Baustelle, was relativ laut ist.

The location is just great, all famous attractions within walking distance. A very warm and nice welcome from Raphael.
The price is ok, but for the price one has to make compromises. You have to share one (rather poor equipped) kitchen, and two small bathrooms with 5 to 6 strangers. The shared living room is very small.

Es la primera ve que uso airbnb en mis viajes y en realidad fue una experiencia grata. Respecto a la ubicación es excelente pues resulta súper céntrico tanto para caminar como para movilizarse a pie. Rafael fue bastante amable y cordial y dispuesto a ayudar constantemente.
La habitación estaba bastante limpia.

The apartment is in a great area, although it is problematic with a car with all the road work. We found free parking on the street a couple blocks away. Secure parking is 33.90€ per day!!! The area is safe and lots of restaurants and pastarias very close by. We would certainly stay again.

We had great three days in Lisbon! The Vera's flat was very convenient point to exploring the city. Her son Rafael was very polite and accurate! He gave us a ride to the airport and explained us haw we get to the St. George castle. Tank you Rafael!

Wir waren zwei Nächte bei Vera. Alles in allem war der Aufenthalt in Ordnung. Kleinigkeit sind trotzdem zu bemängeln. Die gestellten Handtücher rochen muffig, wenn sie feucht waren. Wir konnten keinen Föhn finden und das Bett war für zwei Personen (wir sind kein Pärchen nur Freunde) eher klein. Auch bekommt man nur 1 Laken/ Decke unter dem man zu zweit schläft, worauf man sich als Mitteleuropäer erstmal einstellen muss. Die Größe des Zimmers war für zwei Nächte Okay, für längere Aufenthalte oder mehr Gepäck aber grenzwertig. Die anderen Zimmer waren allerdings etwas größer. Das Frühstück war okay, allerdings gab es am zweiten Morgen keinen Kaffee mehr und auch die Milch war schon so gut wie leer. Dir Küche ist nicht sonderlich gut ausgestattet und selber Abends etwas größer kochen erfordert Improvisation.
Wir hatten irgendwie etwas anderes erwartet und waren deshalb etwas überrascht als wir ankamen. Wie schon andere geschrieben haben, ist es eher wie ein kleines, nettes Hostel.
Die Lage ist zentral nur die Nachbarschaft ist etwas gewöhnungsbedürftig. Unsicher haben wir uns aber nicht gefühlt.
Alles in allem war das Preis-Leistungsverhältnis in Ordnung aber ich würde das Zimmer nur für Leute empfehlen, die nicht aufs selber Kochen angewiesen sind oder nur ein paar Tage bleiben.

We stayed for one night and it was a great base in Lisbon. It was difficult to get in touch before hand, however Vera was really helpful on arrival, especially when we turned up with bikes. The apartment felt like an authentic Lisbon flat, charming, bright and clean.
We stayed just for 2 nights. Vera and her son are very friendly and helpful. The room was small and quiet warm, but it had a fan.

Een hartelijke ontvangst. Een gezellig ingerichte kamer. Goed bed.
Ontbijt s'morgens Cornflakes, geroosterd brood en goede koffie, voldoende om de dag te beginnen.
Ideale plek om Lissabon te verkennen.
Met der VIVA viagremkaart al het openbaar vervoer voor € 1,25 per rit.

Apartment is well located near the city center. Rafael was waiting for us, even if we arrived late. The room was ok, well decorated, although we had the lamp from the street just in front of our window. We stayed only 1 night so we did not use the common kitchen. The common bathrooms were not super clean...

Rafael, Veras son, gave us a warm welcome and showed us the flat. He knows a lot about Lisboa and could recommend you nice places to visit and to eat cheap but very delicious foot.  The apartement offers everythging you need, but it has more an hostel character than sharing a flat with local people. But the common room offers you a simple possibility to get in contact with the other guests. The apartement is in a lively surrounding and close to the centre, so it gets sometimes a bit louder in the night. Earplugs are a benefit in this case. But all in all we would recommend this place for people who wants to discouver the city. Thanks Vera and Rafael for beeing your guests.

This is essentially a typical hostel experience - a few private (locking) rooms within a large apartment, with two full bathrooms and a shared kitchen/living space. The neighborhood has a great local, energetic, young vibe (a little gritty but I always felt safe) and is just down the street from a great plaza with semi-permanent food huts (that serve alcohol) and, when I was there, live music - something I likely wouldn't have found otherwise. I was only there for a long overnight layover, but it is a great "base" location for seeing the city - a short walk from the central neighborhood, and right on the green subway line. Logistically, I was met at the door immediately upon my arrival - everything was straightforward and simple. My room was adequate, but bare, with a firm bed. Lisbon is hot in the summer and there was no a/c, so I needed to have the window open; unfortunately, there was a large streetlight directly outside the window, but I do not think this is the case in all the rooms. The apartment is clean, but my room had a slight lingering body odor. Overall, for the value, this place is fantastic, and was perfectly suited for my short 12-hour visit to Lisbon. But it is not the oft-cited "Airbnb-experience" of living with and engaging with your hosts over the breakfast table, and like I said, is more of a typical European hostel arrangement.
It was perfect in Vera's guesthouse. A little room in a space to share with others. Very clean, in the best area of lisboa! I really recommend.
Great Location and nice owner!
Endroit joli et bien placé. L'essentiel était présent afin de passer quelques belles journées à Lisbonne.

Vera guesthouse is a nice apartment in the heart of Mouraria, a very original neighborhood of Lisbon, very central, you can reach any part of the city just walking. Our room was cozy and tidy, Vera is really pleasant and helpful. For a couple of days, this is the perfect (and cheap) accomodation.

The location is central but in a back street so it's not nice to get there at night. Moreover, the street is very noisy and the room wasn't too clean (there was dust but the sheets were clean). Everything is quite old. Miguel was friendly though and made us decide between two rooms which were both empty.
a nice place, nice room. good welcome. unfortunately there was big roadwork in the whole street starting at 8:30 in the morning... and just to know, you can't cook with the stove in the kitchen.

Es war unter anderem wegen der Unterkunft eine wunderschöne Zeit in Lissabon für uns. Die Unterkunft ist ein richtiges Zuhause und genau so wie beschrieben. Sie liegt sehr zentral und war wirklich sauber und gepflegt. Einzig die Baustelle an der Straße hat morgens etwas gestört, aber dafür kann ja niemand etwas :) Insgesamt Top und empfehlenswert! Wir kommen gerne wieder :)
A nossa estadia foi curta mas fomos muito bem recebidos. Obrigada e até a proxima

Lovely experience. Right in the old part of Lisbon close to St. George's castle. Our room was not so spacey, but we were exploring the town most of the day anyway. Totally loved the stay. Thank you :-)

We had a great stay of three nights at Vera's place two weeks ago! The apartment is a bit smaller than expected, but very lovely and well located - you can even walk to many locations like the castle and the metro connection is perfect. Vera and her son also offered some stuff for breakfast (what we didn't know before). Thank you so much!
Nous avons passée un merveilleux séjour, l'appartement est très bien situer et près de nombreux sites touristiques.

Beautiful room and a great location in the heart of the old town. The pictures are very accurate and the room was spotless with ironed sheets and all!
Upon arrival there had been a miscommunication about our arrival time so no one was there to greet us. We were able to find wifi in order to contact the host however, Rafael - the son - answered and was incredibly irate and short with me hardly allowing me to explain the communication problems. When Rafael's arrival he was very kind to us and helped carry our things up the stairs. He had unfortunately forgotten the keys to the room we had reserved so we had to wait for him to clean a different room in the other apartment guesthouse that they rent out in the same building. This wasn't much of a problem as the room was the same as the picture, however waiting for him to clean it wasn't appreciated seeing as how we had just waited over an hour outside the flat to meet up with him.
We never did meet Vera, however Rafael gave us really wonderful advice on local Portuguese restaurants that we nearby and helpful tips on how to get around to see the city cheap on the metro/bus/tram/train. We really appreciated his knowledge on the city and transportation. They also provided us with wonderful itineraries for day trips etc. Breakfast was also provided, bread, jam, peanut butter, cereal, orange juice and milk!

Die Lage der Wohnung ist super: zentral, direkt an der Metrostation und alle Sehenswürdigkeiten können fußläufig erreicht werden. Das Zimmer ist für ein paar Tage absolut ausreichend. 2 Badezimmer, jew. mit Duschmöglichkeit, werden geteilt, was aber problemlos klappt.
Leider fehlte uns insgesamt der airbnb-Gedanke bei Vera's Wohnung und wir sind schon oft darüber verreist. Wir sahen Rafael nur bei der Anreise und konnten danach nie wieder mit einem "local" reden. Das Frühstück bestand aus Toast und Cornflakes, hätten wir auch mehr erwartet. Sauberkeit ganz ok.
Insgesamt ist die Wohnung eher ein Hostel als ein B&B. Zwar günstig, aber wir werden sie nicht wieder buchen und können sie auch nur eingeschränkt weiter empfehlen.

We had a lovely stay!

We had a nice little room for two in a guest house right in the centre of Lisbon (Martim Moniz). So the metro was pretty close as well as the traditional old tram 28. There were little supermarkets around and it was a walking distance from nightlife and restaurants. Close to our stay were some really good (secrete) chinese restaurants.

Everything was clean, breakfast was inclueded, towels provided and there were two bathrooms. Even if they were road works in front of the house at that time, it hasn't distured our stay.

Thank you Rafael&Vera for having us and your hospitality! We will be back for sure - because the beautiful city of Lisbon is deep in our hearts!

Unfortunately I think we misread this Airbnb & did not realise we were going to a dorm/hostel type of set up. We don't use Airbnb to book rooms like this (we like meeting locals/living like locals) - so honestly didn't enjoy our stay - it's the first time in 5 weeks of travelling & 10 Airbnb bookings that we haven't given great feedback. This room is in an apartment with 3 other bedrooms that are also rented out to guests, with shared common areas & bathrooms. The walls are very thin & noise from other guests meant we didn't sleep much. The bed was like a slab of concrete (which also didn't help with sleeping!) & it has been the first place where no towels have been provided - we double checked when we realised this in the morning, but didn't want the hassle (and didn't have the time) for Rafael to drop some off to us - so we just went without a shower! Communication with Vera & Rafael was fine, I know they are working hard to make money from this, but I would have preferred to pay more for the room for a better Airbnb experience. If we wanted a hostel we would have booked one instead.
Great place, great house. Cosy bedroom and very clean! Vera's son was very kind and helped us with everything we needed.

Vera's apartment is gorgeous and the location is perfect for exploring Lisbon. It is only a short walk to Alfama and close to the Metro and Trams at Martim Moniz. Rafael was unbelievably helpful and gave us lots of useful advice and tips for our visit. The apartment is clean and well maintained and feels very homely. We would 100% recommend staying at Vera's!
Very lovely Place! It's super easy to get there by metro and it's just a 5-Minute-walk to the City Centre! Thank you Rafael for having us and your hospitality! We will be back!

Fomos excelentemente recebidos por Rafael, filho de Vera. Rafael deu-nos valorosas dicas de atrações na cidade, como também nos acompanhou em algumas caminhadas pelas ruas de Lisboa. Nos deixou bem a vontade na hospedagem. O bairro é bem antigo e típico de Lisboa. Muito bem localizado.  A descrição do apartamento é adequada. Prédio bem antigo com quase 200 anos. Tínhamos tudo para o café da manhã, exceto frutas, mas podíamos adquirir em vendas próximas.
We had a great stay, a very good spot to explore the city. Nice to have 2 bathrooms...

Die Wohnung war einfach mit der Metro zu erreichen. Vera hatte es uns zuvor sehr gut per Mail erklärt. Das Zimmer ist in der Altstadt gelegen, der perfekte Ort um das authentische, alte Lissabon zu erleben, ein wundervoller und zentraler Ausgangspunkt um alles zu entdecken. In der Nachbarschaft wurde leider täglich bis 4 Uhr früh sehr laut gefeiert, also Ohropax nicht vergessen. Die Wohnung selbst und das Zimmer sind hübsch, Bad und Küche vintage und ein bisschen shabby, doch sauber. Vera und ihr Sohn sind sehr freundlich, An-und Abreise waren sehr unkompliziert. Zurück ging es mit dem Taxi, da die Metro Samstags erst um 6:30 öffnet, was sehr unkompliziert und günstig (10€) war.
Es war eine schöne Woche und Veras Apartment ist zu empfehlen.
Vera's house is very nice, located in an area not far from Rossio Station. I really enjoyed it.

Vera is very nice person and prepared our room very well. The location of the house is perfect, near the castle and squares. We can walk to the city center, enjoy the seaside view nearby. Thanks to Vera for our perfect days there.
Best wishes.

Apartment is in the great location. We barely used metro, because everything we wanted to see was in a distace of 1 km so it was no use travelling by metro/tram/bus. Vera and her son were very frinedly, helpul and replied to our messages fast.
The apartment was clean and nice. Two bathrooms were enough for 4 rooms which are offered to guests.

I would really recommend this place and if only I had chance will definitely visit again!

We stayed three nights at Vera's place, and everything was perfect. The location is good (easy to find and less than 5 minutes away from the place Minar Moniz).
The room was very cosy and cleaned. The fridge is filled with some juice and foods, and coffee is freely available for breakfast. In a nutshell, that was a very good place to stay in Lisbon.
Good location. Host is very kind and the facilities are perfect. It's a good choice for you!

We had a lovely stay at Vera's apartment in Lisbon.  Vera's son Rafael checked us in and was very helpful in showing us around the apartment, which was clean and surprisingly spacious.  It's also very well located in a beautiful neighborhood - I truly felt as though my stay helped me get the authentic Lisbon experience.  Obrigado!
Très bonne situation. Une grande disponibilité de notre hôte et des chambres sympas.
All perfect, thank you so much for an awesome weekend in Lisboa!! Raphael's recommendations were the best and he was a lovely host.

Rafael hat uns sehr freundlich empfangen. Das Zimmer war sehr hell aber ich fand es sehr schön, richtiges Urlaubsfeeling.
Die Vintage Einrichtung fand ich am besten. Außerdem war das Bett super bequem. Ich komme gerne wieder.

The area is fairly central and is a short walk to the main squares (about 10-15 min). The street, like much of Lisbon, has a dilapidated charm. The room was simple but comfortable, and the apartment too, with all the essentials provided. The bed was very firm, quite lively area full of locals.....

We had a great time in Lisbon and we were always happy to come back to our cozy room after a long sightseeing day. After less than 5 minutes walking you were at the metro station or you just walked to the city centre. All in all a great place to stay in Lisbon!

Vera und Rafael waren tolle Gastgeber, die für Fragen stets erreichbar waren und zudem ein tolles, zentrales Appartement boten. Es fehlte an nichts. Sehr zu schätzen wussten wir die Flexibilität von Rafael, der uns nach Mitternacht den Check-In ermöglichte. Auch ein später Check-Out war kein Problem.
Wer Lissabon ab einem zentralen, fußläufigen Ort erkunden möchte und zudem auf gemütliche Gastgeber wert legt, der macht hier absolut keinen Fehler! Klare Weiterempfehlung.

Vielen Dank für Alles, wir hatten eine tolle Reise!
Sebastian & Wibke

Vera and Rafael were excellent communicators and helped us with everything we needed. They were friendly and available. The area is fairly central and is a short walk to the main squares (about 10-15 min). The street, like much of Lisbon, has a dilapidated charm. The room was simple but comfortable, and the apartment too, with all the essentials provided. The bed was very firm, which we appreciated :) We enjoyed our stay at this spot.

It was really nice place to stay. I stayed at Mouraria for 6 days and Rafael was a wonderful host. He even walked with me and my Boyfriend until the flee market we wanted to find and meanwhile explained a lot about the neighborhood. In personal, Somehow it felt like staying in flat with flatmate. Oh, the way to the house seem little dangerous but no need worrying. Thanks for Rafael. :)

Vera was super available and Raphael welcomed me like a prince.
Helped me find a parking outside, show me the apartment and gave me good tips around the place.
Super room and place, ideal for several friends as there are several rooms !

I totally recommend this place in Lisbon center.
Great location, nice room and helpful host

Amazing place! Good breakfast provided with a good variety. Rooms are spacious and have all the essentials to put away belongings. Very clean and well located just 3 minutes from nearest metro. Host very friendly and helpful. Would absolutely recommend it and I would come back again.
the location is not so good even if so near the city-centre. And the sound insulation was so bad and it was noisy in the night wiz other gustes. However, the host Raphael was nice to us :p

My friend and I had a very nice experience staying at Vera's guesthouse. Centrally located in a nice neighborhood.
It felt like we were staying in someone's home and not a shared accommodation.
Last but not least Rafael was very friendly and helpful.

Nuestra estancia en la casa de vera y Rafael ha sido muy agradable. La habitación estaba limpia y cerca del centro.
Rafael ha sido muy agradable con nosotros y nos ha explicado todo lo que le hemos preguntado sobre la ciudad

Rafael (vera's son) is nice and friendly, he recommended us a great place for dinner. The area made us feel a little uncomfortable initially, but we soon realized that it is a safe area and the youngsters hanging around are harmless. All in all a great stay but because the room we were supposed to stay in was double booked, we had to swap room in the middle of the day and that interrupted our schedule of travelling around lisbon.
I would also like to add that communication with the host before arrival is rather difficult as rafael and vera are both busy.

Rafael was very friendly the one time we met and offered us useful tips. Next days we spent away, visiting the city, but we noticed that he had been coming to clean up and to fix the water heater.
The neighbourhood at first gave us a rather scary impression but we soon realized that it was completely safe and before all very well located.
Our stay was very satisfying!

Fue una estancia agradable, la habitación muy confortable y ámplia. El anfitrión, fue muy correcto y amable y nos indicó cosas interesantes. El barrio estaba bien y con metro cerca...Una buena opción para ir a Lisboa que nos encantó...ah, y el desayuno muy completo ;)

Habitación amplia con baño compartido cerca del centro, que incluye un pequeño desayuno ideal para comenzar el día. A nuestra llegada nos estaba esperando el hijo de vera, que nos explicó todo y nos recomendó donde cenar (todo un acierto el Eurico!)
Great place to visit Lisboa, the apartment is quiet and nice. Raphael and Vera are very kind and helpfull !
We had a very nice stay! Good location and clean. Thanks

We had a great time in Vera's and Rafael's place. Rafael in particular is a great host, he takes care of his guests from the very first moment of arrival till the departure and also offered us a lift to cascais...it all at a reasonable price! I strongly recommend his place to everybody who wants to live the real Lisbon!

We had a very nice stay here! Unfortunately, Vera was sick, but her son, Rafael, welcomed us very well. He's such a nice and friendly person! He adviced romantic places and picked us up because there were no busses in the evening. And he ate pizza with us because it was 3 for the price of 1 ;) very sociable! It's a cosy and clean appartment near by the metro station and tram stop.

Bon séjour dans ce quartier qui est l'âme de Lisbonne . Chambre sympathique et cosy. Hôte accueillant. Et 30 mètres plus bas : le café années 60 ! Ambiance
Jean-François

We had a lovely stay at Guesthouse Apartamento. Perfect place to explore Lisbon for a weekend, We booked just 2 days in advance and got a reply and all information immediatley, Rafeal is an easy going guy and he can advise you where to go and what to do. We felt quite comfortable in his little guesthouse. Thx a lot!
I have rented this place for two friends of mine that were on holidays in Portugal and they were very happy with the whole experience!

My boyfriend and I stayed at Raquel &Leo guesthouse for a week. We had a fantastic Time on Lisboa.
The guesthouse si perfectly located, on the popular and beautifull neighborhood of Lisboa, at 15min walk of almost everything !
The guesthouse is really clean and pretty.
There is everything you need ( Wifi, bath toile, soap...) and a good bed to rest after a long day walking around the city.
They serve small but nice breakfast, include on the price.
It's definitly better than an hôtel !!!
Raquel & Léo are the sweetest person ever, they are helpfull, they give you some advise !
I felt bad on sunday and Léo help us find a farmacie open and take care of us realy well. It was realy kind !
Every single places they recommande were great !
We highly recomanded the Mouraria guesthouse.

Guesthouse céntrica, con buena comunicación de transporte, al lado de metro y tranvía. Fácil de llegar a San Jorge. La habitación estaba limpia y el diseño interior muy cuidado.

Raquel y Leo fueron muy amables, y el desayuno era muy bueno. Nos explicaron toda la información turística que necesitábamos.

En definitiva, un sitio en el que repetiríamos si volvemos por Lisboa.

Super sweet stay in a great neighborhood in Lisboa. Raquel was very hospitable to get in touch with me, welcome me upon arrival, take time to show me the house and answer questions, as well as to help familiarize me with the area and some highlights, sightseeing points, restaurants, etc. The place itself was clean, organized, thoughtfully decorated and taken care of by the hosts. They also provided a breakfast service to make it a cozy experience for somebody away from home. Thanks Raquel and Leo - Guesthouse Apartamento Mouraria 3 comes highly recommended!

On our way back from Morocco, my mother and me stayed a second time at Raquel & Leo´s. Leo gave us a warm welcome in the evening. This time we stayed in another room to see something new - and it was as nice, stylishly decorated and quiet at night as the other one, only a little smaller. but this time, lovely Raquel had even baked a cake for breakfast, as the apartment was fully booked. we enjoyed our stay greatly - especially that the apartment is located in walking distance to so many sights is awesome. i can very much recommend this place to Lisbon travellers! best wishes, christina

La comunicación fue clara y fluida con el anfitrión, no tuvimos problemas para encontrar el edificio y entrar a la habitación.
El alojamiento estaba muy cerca del aeropuerto, que es lo que queríamos.
¡Recomendable para estadías cortas!

Antonio was awesome!
Very friendly and very quick to respond.
He was flexible, understanding, and accommodating especially when my husband got sick.
The room is cozy and the place is just a minute or two away from the station which made it convenient to get to the city centre.
Not only that, but the airport is only 7-10 minutes by Uber which is super convenient when catching an early flight out.

It was a pleasure to have been at Maria’s home. The space was even better than the photographs and her sons were wonderful people. The Metro being close was a lovely convenience but the sounds are audible as well and it took a while to get used to. Everything else was as good as it gets and I would definitely recommend Maria’s art house if you love art and music. It’s such a beautiful place to relax after exploring the beautiful city of Lisbon. Will definitely be visiting again one day in the future.
Extremely accessible if you want to explore Lisbon but stay in a quieter area.

Definitely the best choice in Lisbon. I had a wonderful time in the apartment, as the hosts, Maria, Antonio and Jose, are extremely friendly and welcoming. The room is super clean, the whole area is well decorated, a functional kitchen with all kinds of condiments. I just felt at home. There are several supermarkets around. 10 minutes of bus ride to the airport. 2 minutes of walk to the metro station “Areeiro” , and few minutes of metro you will get to the center. Highly recommended. and thanks for the convenience you guys have provided for me !
The apartment was very nice and exactly like the pictures. Such a pleasant stay!
I recommend Maria’s place. Perfect location and close to the “metro”. The hosts are very nice and friendly.
离地铁口只有一百米的距离，非常安全的街区，入住非常方便不用担心找不到！下次前往里斯本还会选择😁房东非常的友好并且乐于助人，是私人的厕所。整个房间非常有艺术氛围～
nice place with nice hosts

Foi excelente o tempo que ficamos hospedados na casa de Maria. A localização é perfeita, o ambiente muito agradável e tudo muito bem equipado. Os moradores, filhos de Maria, foram extremamente simpáticos e acolhedores. Achamos a experiência excelente e indicamos fortemente a hospedagem na casa de Maria!

The host was super welcoming, the place is in a great spot and the room was really clean. We only stayed one night but would’ve loved to stay longer. The kitchen could be a bit cleaner though.
See you next time
Disfrutamos mucho de la ciudad porque la ubicación de nuestro alojamiento está muy bien conectado. Antonio fue muy amable y estuvo atento a lo que necesitábamos.
Good stay!

The apartment was in a convenient location, close to the train station, metro, and not too far from the Airport. We stayed here only one night (our last night in Lisbon before flying out).
Note that the metro / subway rumbles the apartment every few minutes.
専用のバス・トイレがあり、気兼ねなく使える。鉄道、地下鉄、バス停、スーパー、飲食店が近くにあり、生活にも観光にも便利です。
No complaints, great location and clean!

The room was exactly what we expected. even better. We met the host's family, and they warmly greeted us. The room had everything we wanted to have. If there was not for a flight, we wanted to stay longer!

Antoine et Joseph était toujours disposé pour nous et d 'une grande aide avec plein de conseils. Merci les garçons et continuer votre bon travail. Toujours de bonne humeur. Un gros merci.
Obrigado

Fijne mensen, vriendelijke ontvangst.
Kamertje was wel klein voor 2 personen, maar we kwamen dan ook om Lissabon te zien.
Klein minpuntje: keuken mocht beter opgeruimd worden.
Good instructions and communications. Sufficient for my one night stay although the room was a bit hot and aeroplane noise even though a way away from the airport

Quarto muito agradável e limpo, num bom bairro, e pertíssimo do metro e do comboio. Check-in perfeito. Anfitriã muito simpática.
Só ficámos uma noite, porque estávamos em trânsito, mas ficámos com vontade de regressar e ficar alguns dias.
A rapidez com que se chega ao aeroporto é também um ponto positivo.
Nous avons passé un beau sejour  Avantage pret station météo et de train.

We had a lovely stay here! The location is just far enough from the city center to have a relaxed atmosphere, but is also surrounded by many transport options to get you to the city center in ~10 minutes! There are grocery shops, bakeries and also lovely brunch spots nearby, so you have everything you need! The two brothers who live in the airbnb are very friendly and have great recommendations!
Tvarkingas kambarys

Maria è stata un host molto cortese ed ospitale. Le indicazioni per check-in sono state rapide e veloci, non abbiamo avuto problemi.
La stanza è carina, con piccolo bagno a disposizione.
Per due persone per qualche giorno può andare bene.
La metropolitana è sotto casa, la zona è tranquilla e l’aeroporto ai raggiunge in 15 minuti di macchina.
Un buon punto di appoggio per chi come noi ha visitato Lisbona in 3 giorni.

È stato molto piacevo soggiornare da Maria. Posizione ottima se si arriva/parta in tarda serata. Inoltre con la metro, vicinissima all’ appartamento, si arriva in centro in una decina di minuti. L’unica pecca è che la camera è un po’ piccola per due persone.
Il figlio di Maria è stato molto disponibile e socievole con noi!
Lo consigliamo 😁

Wij hebben een heel fijn verblijf gehad in Lissabon bij Maria. De plek was ideaal , vlakbij de metro en treinstation. Supermarkten dichtbij. Het appartement had alles wat je nodig hebt. Wij zijn erg fijn ontvangen en kregen veel tips over dingen die we konden doen. Zeker een plek om aan te raden voor een leuke tijd in Lissabon!

We had a very nice stay in Lisbon, because the apartment was nice and clean, with a rooftop terrace. The location of the apartment is fantastic. It’s very close to the trainstation and the metrostation. The owners of the apartment were also very nice and gave us tips about what to see and do in Lisbon.
Conveniently located if you have an early flight

Die Unterkunft ist gut gelegen, man ist mit der Metro innerhalb von 20 Minuten im Zentrum. Die zwei Brüder sind sehr freundlich und geben einem das Gefühl willkommen zu sein. Das Zimmer ist zwar etwas klein aber vollkommen ausreichend.
Had a great time!

Great spot in Lisbon. Out of the downtown area, so you will not be kept up all night by loud music/ people, but it is a few minutes walk from a Metro station that can get you there in 10-15 minutes. It is also right by a train station that gets you to Sintra in ~45 minutes. Check-in instructions were clear and straightforward, and it was nice to have a quiet spot to ourselves. Thank you, Maria!

Malgré l’absence de ménage fait à notre arrivée en raison d’un imprévu, Maria a su nous prévenir et nous dédommager. Ses fils présents dans l’appartement ont été très accueillants et disponibles. La chambre est fonctionnelle et agréable.
Bien en général nous avons apprécié et hôte très gentille! Un peu petit pour 2 par contre la chambre est très petite alors prévoyez en conséquence

Der Aufenthalt bei Maria war super. Es war sauber und ordentlich. Die Wohnung war einfach zu finden und die Lage war in Ordnung. Die Kommunikation mit Maria war sehr gut. Wir würden sie weiterempfehlen. 🌞

チェックインの説明がわかりやすく、スムーズにできました。
2人の息子さんがフレンドリーで、質問にも的確に答えてくれましたし、適当な距離感も確保してくれているようです。
メトロの通過時に音が高まりますが、私はそれほど気になりませんでした。
それ以外は落ち着いて過ごせました。
周辺には店も十分あって、食事も楽です。

Loved staying at Maria's place. We were out and about most of the time so didn't spend a ton of time in the space, but every moment we did spend there was wonderful. Se was great to chat with and really helpful during our stay. Highly recommend!
Wij waren hier voor een paar dagen. Was een prima kamer! Goede ligging van het appartement, duidelijke instructies en goede communicatie met de host

Quarto pequeno demais para 2 pessoas por 3 noites.
Não nos sentimos confortáveis para usar a cozinha ou o terraço ou outro espaço, porquê não queríamos atrapalhar o proprietário que se mantinha à distância.
Achamos muito impessoal e para nós, não é o que buscamos quando optamos por um quarto numa casa de família.

Le logement était parfait pour nous, très bien situé dans Lisbonne. On peut se rendre au métro et au train en 3 minutes de marche. L’épicerie est également très proche! Le lit était confortable et propre. La nuit était un peu chaude à notre goût, mais il y a un ventilateur dans la chambre. La salle de bain était propre, seulement la douche avait des traces de moisissures par terre et au plafond. Nous avons été bien accueilli par le fils de Maria qui était très sympathique! Nous recommandons fortement ce logement, il permet de bien visiter Lisbonne dans le confort et la propreté!

Het appartement is heel gezellig ingericht. Ik denk dat er een artistieke familie woont. Mooie inrichting. We hadden heerlijk geslapen, douche heeft een lekkere harde straal. En het was fijn om ‘s morgens even lekker een koffie buiten te kunnen zitten. Privacy wordt gerespecteerd door de zoons. Ze zijn zelf de hele dag weg voor hun opleiding. Contact was heel vriendelijk.
Een groot voordeel is dat het vlakbij metrostation is. Tip: als je heerlijk en goedgesproken wil eten : zoek dan naar lucky sushi en worknaar lucky

Der komplette Aufenthalt war sehr nett und unkompliziert. Antonio hat angeboten ein Menü für uns zu kochen und das haben wir gern in Anspruch genommen. Es gab traditionelle portugiesische Gerichte auf Wunsch für uns vegetarisch abgewandelt. Uns hat es sehr gut gefallen und wir haben neue Gerichte kennengelernt. Das Ambiente war auch sehr nett, wir haben auf der kleinen Terrasse gegessen und es gab einen guten portugiesischen Weißwein. Abgerundet wurde der Abend mit einem köstlichen Nachtisch und einem lokalen Likör aus der Gegend , in der seine Mutter nun lebt.  Antonio hat für einen besonderen Abend für uns gesorgt. Vielen Dank. Wir können seine Kochkünste sehr weiterempfehlen.

Estadia excelente! Casa muito limpa, muito bonita e extremamente confortável!
Aconselho a 100%!!
Nota: Primeiro Airbnb que vejo com livros do Basquiat 😁

El alojamiento estaba muy bien, buena ubicación,  cerca del metro, rodeado de  paradas de bus para poder moverse a cualquier sitio, zona tranquila. La habitación era tal cual el anuncio y la instrucciones muy buenas para acceder. Aunque estuvimos poco tiempo Antonio fue muy amable recibiendonos  y nos ayudo en lo todo lo necesitamos. Recomendado, volvería otra vez. Gracias por todo.

Maria’s son was very helpful and pleasant. But the hammering and drilling construction in apartment above was intolerable. I had to leave until they stopped at 5:30. The soon found out they were starting again at 9:00. Luckily I had an early flight. A review of 3 weeks ago had the same complaint. Maria should have warned guests and given them of an option of a refund.
屋主非常友好并积极回覆问题，我们对于良好的亲切的沟通感到非常高兴。

这个家真的不愧是艺术之家，我们被室内的温馨、艺术感十足的设计震撼！
位置离地铁、火车站都非常近，往返机场很方便。
我们还在漂亮的厨房享用了完美的早午餐。
我们因为行李托运弄丢了，充电和洗漱用品成了大问题，房东和她的儿子非常热心地帮我们匀出足够的充电插头、洗发水；还帮我们沟通当地寄送行李的司机，让我们退房后还能留在这里休息等待。
如果有六星，我愿意给六颗星。谢谢招待！

Alles in allem Super.
Einzig und allein war die Wohnung sehr laut. Die Nachbarn haben einigen krach gemacht und die U-Bahn ist wahnsinnig laut.
Vorteil: U-Bahn Station direkt nebenan.
Das Zimmer an sich und die Vermieter waren super👍
Good place for exploring Lisbon for a couple of days and hospitable host Antonio

Le logement de Maria est très bien situé, il est facile d’accéder au centre ou à l’aéroport. Tout est propre, nous avons seulement été surpris des travaux le matin à 8h45.
La communication a été facile également
Lovely home in a residential area of Lisbon. Short trip to centre of the City on the local metro. Local bars and restaurants. Was able to store or cycles in the property.
Il soggiorno è stato ottimo anche se solo per una notte!!
L'alloggio di Maria è comodo e ben servito, siamo stati bene
Excelente lugar muy cerca del transporte
Мені дуже сподобалось перебування. І спілкування. Дякую за гостинність.
Gastvrije broers! Een heel erg huiselijk verblijf!

We really loved the place! The apartment is situated close to many public transports like the bus and metro. For groceries, you can find an Aldi nearby. We had lovely hosts too, suggesting us attractions and towns nearby to visit. Thanks for the lovely stay!
Ocorreu tudo bem, é de frente ao metrô e a parada de ônibus. passamos apenas 2 dias lá, tempo insuficiente para conhecer nossos anfitriões, mas foram solícitos e nós atenderam bem na chegada.

Stay was nice! Maria’s sons were lovely- that’s who live inside the Airbnb. Area was very nice, close to transit. Easy to get to the airport and downtown.
You do hear the metro but it didn’t bother us. It is damp in the apartment but that’s what it is was like our previous time in Lisbon as well.
Would recommend to stay at Maria’s apartment. Kind hosts, great location for a bit more of a local life.

It was great for a short stay, the house is very convenient for transport. The room was cozy and clean, although a little bit small. Maria is very nice to talk to and flexible with our early bag drop.
位置很好，就在地铁站边上，打车去机场只需要15分钟内，去大教堂等地铁20分钟。房间很干净，有包含在内的卫生间。房东态度非常好，我们离开之后还让我们存放了几个小时行李。非常喜欢房间的装饰，也喜欢房东的书和酒，舒服。感谢！
Bizim için hoş bir konaklama deneyimi oldu. Antonio ve Se mükemmel iki kardeş bizlere çok yardımcı oldular, çok teşekkür ederiz, herkese tavsiye ederiz!
Maria and Anthony were very nice and friendly. The house is very clean including the bathroom and the linens. We had a great time!

Great location, very easy to get around, safe area, appropriately sized bedroom, only issue was that other people were there as well which we were unaware of until we arrived, but otherwise great stay! Thank you.

Alojamiento perfecto con el pleno centro a tan solo 8 minutos en metro (la boca de metro está justo en la puerta de casa). El metro cuesta 1,80€ con la tarjeta navegante (los huéspedes suelen dejar allí tarjetas).
Los restaurantes de alrededor son maravillosos y baratos (Tasquinha da Linha y Churrasqueria Areeiro)
Es preferible estar más alejados del centro y vivir la experiencia de estar en pleno barrio portugués con restaurantes de barrio buenos y baratos (en el centro son caza turistas caros).
Parking a solo 3€/día a unos minutos andando (Manuel de Gouveia).
La habitación es cómoda (algo bastante fría también he de decir, por muchos nórdicos y paños), el baño está bien. No hay gente por casa, solo coincidimos con uno de sus hijos de los 3 días que estuvimos.
Para repetir el alojamiento

Es war sehr nett bei Maria! Ihren Sohn haben wir persönlich getroffen und er war sehr nett und zuvorkommend! Wir wurden herzlich willkommen geheißen!
Kommen gerne wieder!!

This place in Lisbon is great. It's not far to the old town (20 minutes) and you will be surrendered by Lisbon local peoples instead of tourists (everything there is cheaper than old town). The room and access to the apartment is fantastic and there are tons of restaurants and groceries around. If I come to Lisbon for sure I m staying here.

O local é tranquilo. O quarto fica em um apartamento acolhedor. Antônio que reside no apartamento, filho de Maria, é muito receptivo. Sugiro que nos dias frios deixem um aquecedor disponível no quarto, pois nem sempre encontramos alguém para pedir.
Foi super bacana hospedar na casa de Maria. A localização é excelente, perto de comércios e estações! Chegamos e a casa estava organizada e limpa, bem como o nosso quarto.

I loved staying here. First, the location was ideal for me. If you’re looking to be in the super touristy downtown, this place is not for you; however, if you want to stay in a beautiful Portuguese apartment in an area free from most tourists, with an authentic local feel, this is your spot! There are great cafes for breakfast or snacks within a block, as well as an amazing restaurant for dinner on the street over. There is a self-service laundromat within a 5 minute walk, and you can get to the train (green line) to get you downtown with about a 3 minute walk (super easy).
Maria’s space is so well decorated. I LOVED it! Maria and her sons were so accommodating, and they helped my friend out when she was in a rough situation. I think for most of our stay, we had the apartment to ourselves, so it really didn’t feel like just renting a room.
Overall, would not hesitate to stay with Maria again if I come back to Lisbon.
Thank you Maria and fam!
Sehr freundliche Gastgeber, fühlte mich sehr wohl bei Maria. Gerne wieder !

Gran alojamiento! Departamento muy agradable, a unos pasos del metro y cerca del aeropuerto. Todo muy ordenado y limpio, cama cómoda y baño privado, estancia corta pero volveríamos!! El hijo de María fue muy amable con nosotros, buena plática. Gracias!!
O alojamento era muito bom, obrigado

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour chez Maria. Nous avons été très bien accueillies. Nous avons reçu de bonnes recommandations. Les hôtes nous ont permis de déposer nos bagages avant 15h. On entend le métro depuis le logement mais cela ne nous a pas dérangées pour dormir. La chambre est propre. Tout ce dont nous avions besoin était mis à disposition. Je recommande ce Airbnb !
Lovely apartment a little bit outside of Lisbon’s city center, communication was direct and super welcoming, would love to visit again! Nothing to be unhappy about.

Beau logement avec commodités. Il s'agit d'une chambre avec salle de bain privée. Les 2 garçons qui habitent là sont hyper gentils et attentionnés avec les visiteurs. Malgré le fait de cohabiter avec eux, ils sont discrets et l'appartement est grand. Chacun fait ce qu'il a à faire.
Ils sauront répondre à vos questions par rapport à Lisbonne et le pays.
Une expérience très positive que nous recommandons sans hésitation.
Nous garderons d'excellents souvenirs.

Convenient to metro and rail at Roma Areeiro. Close to airport which is why we chose. Authentic beautiful home stay with tasteful  art . Full use of homes kitchen and living area. Small single room with shower toilet ensuite. Host is friendly and helpful. Recommend as short stay before departure Lisbon airport. Uber €5 -6 to airport
Wir hatten eine gute Zeit im Apartment, es war sehr schön und wir würden wiederkommen.

Stayed for a night. Room was exactly as described. Really close to the airport and city centre. Maria and her sons were accommodating and let us drop off our luggage earlier and let us rest in their living room while the room was being cleaned. Highly recommended.
Me encanto la casa, el hijo de María es un divino charlamos un montón. La ubicación es perfecta.Super recomendable💞

Très bon séjour chez Maria,et ses fils.
Facilement trouvable grâce aux instructions de Maria. A proximité du métro, bus, et train pour se déplacer, même jusqu'à Sintra grâce à la lisboa card.
Le logement est impeccable d'un point de vue propreté, et appréciable d'avoir une salle de bain privée, l'accès à la cuisine et la petite terrasse sont un plus....
Nous avons pu laisser nos bagages chez Maria jusqu' en fin de journée avant notre vol début de soirée.
Très bonne adresse pour un futur voyage à Lisbonne..

Maria’s place was clean, and easy to find. It’s close proximity to the airport makes it a great place to stay if you have an early flight the next day. Keep in mind that it can take 20-30 minutes to get to city center from this location

Unser Aufenthalt bei Maria und ihren Söhnen war wirklich schön.
Sie alle haben uns herzlich aufgenommen und uns ein heimeliges Gefühl gegeben.
Die Wohnung entsprach den Bildern und bot von der Lage her gute Anbindungsmöglichkeiten.
Bei Nachfragen, waren alle stets zuvorkommend und auch für ihre Insidertipps waren wir sehr dankbar.
Wir empfehlen die Unterkunft wärmstens weiter.

Un appartement agréable, à proximité des commerces et du métro.
En 15-20 minutes vous êtes à l'aéroport ou sur la place du commerce.
Only stayed one night but the place was nice and clean and the host was friendly.

Les photos correspondent bien a l'appartement et celui ci est proche du métro et d'une gare pour aller à Sintra, très pratique !
Par contre, le bruit du métro est plutôt gênant (malgré des boules quies) et démarre a 6h du matin.
Lovely home with great host

Hele lieve broers en ontzettend goed ontvangen!
Dank jullie wel voor de gastvrijheid!
Heel fijn verblijf!
We enjoyed our short stay here. Very clean and comfortable!

El alojamiento tiene todas las comodidades que se necesitan para pasar unos días. Habitación un poco pequeña pero suficiente para dos personas. Todo muy limpio.El metro está a 200 metros escasos de la casa, super cerca para que puedas ir a cualquier parte de Lisboa. Se escucha un poco el metro pero si estás cansado ni lo notas, no es un ruido molesto. La zona es muy tranquila y tienes muchos comercios cerca. Bastante aparcamiento en la zona. Los anfitriones muy amables y atentos a que estés lo más cómodo posible. Sin duda volvería a repetir.

Il soggiorno è stato piacevole e tranquillo.
l'host è stato molto gentile e la camera è stata molto accogliente.
Il centro di Lisbona è comodamente raggiungibile in metro.
pokoj je dobře umístěny. je to blízko do centra. vše bylo čisté a pěkné

I had a very nice stay in Maria’s home. Check in was extremely easy and the room was clean and comfortable. The only problem was that I never received a key from Maria, so I wasn’t able to lock the bedroom door at night.

We had a wonderful stay at Maria's house. The location is convenient for all types of commute - rail, bus and metro. The house is beautifully done and artsy just as it shows in pictures. For someone who likes to cook, the kitchen is amazingly set up and could get your inner chef out. The patio is cherry on the cake, as your get some beautiful space to have a cup of coffee or a glass of wine. Antonio was a wonderful host and made sure he helped whenever we approached.
As a suggestion - The room is slightly small if you're carrying bigger luggage. Highly recommend this place for short stay.
We love staying at Maria’s before we fly out. Great hosts

Maria's place was comfortable. Antonio the son was extremely helpful and accommodating. The room was a little small for 2 guests, our suitcases took up the entire walking space in our room but it was manageable if it's a short stay. Neighbourhood was great during the day but can feel a bit unsafe at night 2 girls. The attached bathroom was super clean, towels and linens provided however we did notice some stains on the sheets. The patio/terrace was gorgeous however and really made our stay lovely! Would stay here again for a short stay.

Mi estancia fue muy agradable, tiene muy buena ubicación. Recomiendo alojarse aquí, fuimos unas amigas y la verdad que estuvimos encantadas. Antonio nos recomendó sitios para ver y comer, nos hizo la visita muy agradable. Repetiré sin duda :)
I had a lovely stay, the location was great for going to the university. I got used to the metro noise quickly. Having the private bathroom was super, and checkin very easy. Would stay again.

The bedroom in Maria's place was very comfortable and exactly what we needed for one night. They're a very kind and helpful family! The area is closer towards the airport and was very nice to see a much calmer side of a Lisbon suburb. There's still lots to do in the area regardless! We would definitely stay here again if we were back in Lisbon!

Maria was proactive and helpful in her communication. She offered an early check-in and was very friendly. It was nice to meet her family. Her house is ideally located between 2 stations which made commute very easy from Lisbon downtown or catch the train to Sintra. Both stations are 2 min walk from the house.
The room was nice and cosy and cleaned up well. We would definitely recommend her place

We loved our stay in Maria’s place. It is lovely like in the pics. It is very close to the tube, it has a bar/bakery for a lovely breakfast, a nice restaurant and a small supermarket on the same road. Maria is very prompt in responding to texts and very helpful. Highly recommend it.

Maria's home was just the perfect air bnb that we were looking for in a bustling city of Lisbon.
Maria was very responsive, friendly and warm when it came to communication. The directions as mentioned on the page and her instructions to get in the apartment were apt. Her sons who were sometimes at home were also very hospitable and nice to talk to.
this place is very well located and very close to the public transport and a very safe area to stay in.
we would highly recommend it to anyone coming to Lisbon.
Warm Regards,
Kunal and Radhika
PS : we hope we come back again just to eat some good food made by you. we got to know that you are a great chef only on the day when we were leaving.

The apartment was cosy and felt like home (just like on the photos).The location of the apartment is in a convinient place, with lots of shops, caffes and so on. The metro station is very near and it helps when you want to explore Lisbon. The host Maria was responive. We had the chance to meet Maria's son which were very friendly and talkative. All in all a great place to stay in Lisbon. 😊
I only stayed one night here but the place was easy to access and just as described.

Maria`s place was very familiar and nice. The outside space was small and lovely and we had all we needed inside too. We met Maria´s sons and they  were helpful and kind so we would of course recommend this place.

房间非常艺术，入住也很顺利。
房东人很好，这是一套非常艺术化的房子，周边地铁站也很方便。
但是由于地铁在房子底下，晚上时候，地铁运行经过房子会带来共振有一点点吵，如果对安静有需求的房客需要记得自备耳塞。

Good location, on the ground floor with metro, restaurants and supermarket nearby, easy self check in if the host is unavailable to greet. As with others have also reviewed, the location can get a little noisy with the passing metro trains so do take note if you are sensitive to noise. Also as the weather gets warmer there may be more and more bugs around as the windows of the room opens up directly to the terrace. If these are ok with you, definitely recommended!
Very hospitable hosts. Made us feel at home. Easy place to view Lisbon. Thank you.

We found Maria's place to be more convenient with all the public transport systems around Lisbon and was an excellent transit point toward Lisbon Airport. The one small detail that we kind of noticed is that in the photos, the place looks a little bigger, but in reality it's quite smaller, and it is something that has to be expected in a big city like Lisbon. Overall we had a comfortable stay here.
Me pareció muy cómodo, el anfitrión fue súper lindo. Excelente ubicación y fácil acceso. Super recomendado

Les instructions données en amont par Maria étaient très claires.
L’appartement est facile d’accès depuis l’aéroport et il se trouve sur la ligne verte du métro très centrale (1min à pied du logement).
Petit quartier très sympa avec un restaurant local au bout, un petit supermarché et une boulangerie pâtisserie parfait pour prendre le petit déjeuner pour commencer votre journée !
Nous avons eu l’occasion de discuter rapidement avec les fils de Maria qui sont très sympas et accueillants.
Nous reviendrons à l’occasion ☺️
Decent place to stay! The sons are really nice and helpful! Great time in the apartment and we will miss it!

Great location where you can easily take the metro to lisbon centre. The bed was fine, slightly small for me. The room and facilities where good. Showering with the window open did not seem like a issue with moist problems, however the bathroom could use a paintjob. Would still recommend. Antonio is super friendly, helpfull and made us feel welcoming in their home.

We had a good time! The room is small but had everything needed for a short stay. Bring ear plugs since you’ll hear the doors going from the other rooms and the metro underneath the ground. Antonio was very nice and welcoming!

The shaded area, filled with pot plants just out the back door was a lovely area to eat and chat and view from my bed - the boys do, however smoke out there. . They immediately promised not to while I was there ( as I am an asthmatic) but the
presence of ash was still present. Ze & Antonio & their friends were extremely interesting and pleasant to talk with.
I’ll definitely go back there if I return to Porto.

We loved our stay!
The apartment looks exactly like the pictures. Marias sons were really nice, welcoming and helpful. The kitchen is well-equipped and the terrace is insane!!!! The check in is easy and the apartment was quiet and empty most of the time. We were worried about the location but it was perfect. Right in front of the Areeiro metro station and Roma-Areeiro train station (for Sintra/oriente trains).
Definitely recommend and will be coming back for sure.
não tive contato com a Maria durante minha estadia. As instruções do checkin foram passadas pelo chat e foi bem tranquilo de entender.
Cozy and very well located, thanks for everything!
Lovely place, very attentive hosts.
The host was really nice, easy to communicate.
Leuk verblijf! Veel tips over Lisbon gekregen.

Very nice one night stay. It is actually Maria's two sons who live here and run the place. We met Antonio, a charming young man. He made us feel at home in the space.
The bedroom and bath are small but all you need for a few nights. At first it seems there is not much to the neighborhood but within a quick walk there are many stores and restaurants. We ate at Pote (?) just around the corner. It was excellent and reasonable, not touristy at all.
The place is very close to the airport and trains. We didn't bother to go into the main area of Lisbon as we had seen it a week earlier but instead enjoyed this neighborhood.
The entrance to the apartment is right on the ground floor within the doors of the apt building. It seems a bit strange at first but is quite welcoming inside. There is room in the fridge if you bring some food and things such as tea and coffee are there.
Good value for the money in Lisbon. The hosts are flexible about leaving luggage if you have a late flight. Thanks!
Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt, die beiden Söhne von Maria haben uns herzlich empfangen und bei fragen weiter geholfen. Es war ein toller Aufenthalt in Lissabon für uns ;)
Prima locatie, makkelijke aankomst, kleine kamer en badkamer niet heel schoon.

My stay at Maria’s was excellent. Highly recommended. Room was spotless. I wouid stay here again! You can get to the centre easily on the metro. There are some good places to eat nearby and a handy supermarket. Communication was great throughout. Thank you Maria!

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour chez Maria, où ses fils nous ont très bien accueilli. Le lieu était très agréable, spacieux et propre. Proche de tous les moyens de transport (métro et train) nous avons pu visiter Lisbonne matin et soir.
Nos hôtes étaient d’ailleurs très flexibles à notre arrivée sachant que nous avions un vol de nuit et que nous sommes arrivées à presque minuit. Je recommande vivement !
Super location. (Airbnb review asks question, was it worth it? I am not impressed with airbnb.) Maria venue and location was super

Hyvä sijainti ja metroasema lähellä. Juna kulki talon alta ja se kuului sisälle. Makuuhuoneen ja kylpyhuoneen ilmanvaihto oli olematon ja joutui pitämään ikkunoita auki kylmällä ja sateisella ilmalla. Keittiö oli käytössä ja hyvin varusteltu. Emäntä vastasi ystävällisesti viesteihin ja antoi selkeät ohjeet. Erittäin helppo oli löytää perille.
房间不错，干净，就是稍微小了一点
房间很棒，房东很热情，非常适合两个人居住，并且出行很方便！

De ontvangst was warm en hartelijk. De ruimte is schoon en groot genoeg.
Het was vrij donker met weinig daglicht. Maar de locatie maakt alles goed.

Maria was very friendly to communicate with, and provided very clear instructions for check in. We did not meet and our stay in Lisboa was short, but the apartment was comfortable. Very close to the metro station and the location made it easy to travel around in the city and to and from the airport.

Great location, right next to the metro, friendly host (the son who lives there is super nice as well), the room is small but fine for two people. For the price it was a great find and was all that we needed for our stay. My only complaint was the lack of ventilation in the room which caused there to be some mold on the ceiling in the bathroom as well as in the bedroom by the window. It didn’t bother us but if you’re sensitive to that keep that in mind! Other than that it was clean and comfortable. If you’re on a budget it’s still a great option!
房间很漂亮！！房东的儿子热情地向我们介绍了房间和后花园，很舒适的入住体验！

It was great to stay here! Cozy place.
Although there was some noise from the underground, for me, it was okay.
Emplacement idéal. Proche de l’aéroport (10 min en bus) et du centre (15/20 min via le métro). Le logement de Maria correspond à l’annonce. Super séjour. Je recommande.
Great space for day tripping adventures in Lisbon.  Zé was clutch!  Nóbrega friends, so grateful for them.  Look forward to returning.

We had a nice stay in Maria‘s house. We were met by her son, Antonio and he allowed us to keep our luggage there and come back and check in later. It is very close to the green line and a short 10 minute ride into the city.
The place is as described, and is very convenient and comfortable
Great location, and it was a pleasure chatting with Maria’s son.
편안하게 쉬다가 왔습니다 환기가 잘 안돼서습한게 조금 아쉬웠습니다. 그래도 따듯하게 맞이해주셔서 감사합니다!
Great find! Maria's son was very friendly, polite and welcoming. Comfortable and clean space, central location in Lisbon (metro areeiro at your doorsteps)! Thank you Maria :)

We really had a wonderful time at Maria’s comfortable apartment. Our room and private bath were more than enough space. The common living spaces were also available to us and we made good use of the professional style kitchen over the 6 nights there. Maria and her 2 charming sons and 1 charming husband were around here and there. Always warm and helpful, but never intrusive. Highly recommend.
Good place for those who don't want to stay right in the centre of Lisbon and good value for money. From here, it's easy access to the centre via the metro.
Very comfortable room and super convenient location from the airport. Apartment is just a block from the Metro so it’s easy to get around town quickly!

We had a great stay here during our stopover in Lisbon! The apartment is clean, cosy, and comfortable, and Maria’s son was very friendly and gave lots of good recommendations. The apartment is also very close to the airport (40 minutes by foot even!) and a metro station, so both downtown and the airport are easily accessible.
The one thing to be aware of is that it can be quite loud with both the airport and metro, but aside from that it’s a great place to stay!
Excellent communication the place was really nice 😊 as described host really nice and friendly close to the Metro station I definitely recommend this place 👌🏻
Beautiful artistic place. 5/5 host. Highly recommended.
Loved staying at Maria’s! Such a friendly place, would recommend!
Great local neighborhood a bit away from the touristy areas of Lisbon. Fantastic & friendly hosts who gave me some great tips on where to find the best Portuguese food.
Great spot close to the airport.
Had a great stay - great location right next to metro and Areeiro station for train to Sintra. Friendly hosts with clear communication. Highly recommend!
Kodinomainen ja hintalaatusuhde kohdillaan. Kiva sisustus.
관광지에서 조금 떨어져 있지만 바로 근처에 지하철이 있어 이동하기 편리했습니다. 호스트의 두 아들들이 공동주택에서 관리해주는데 굉장히 친절했습니다. 가격대비 훌륭한 숙소에서 머물다 갑니다!
Local de muito fácil acesso ao metro Areeiro. Casa com limpeza impecável. Quarto e baheiro correspondem fielmente ao anúncio. Muito bem recebido pelos filhos da Maria.
it's really a very nice place to be...!

Nice, welcoming apartment. Clean, bright, lovely bedroom. Nice, friendly hosts. Happy to stay there.
E&M
Very nice home to spend the night in. Antonio was pleasant and we had a great meal at Thai garden nearby.

So freundlich und familiär! Das Zimmer ist gemütlich und hat ein frisches Ambiente. Das eigene Bad war toll wie auch die Mitbenutzung von Küche und Sitzecke im Freien.
Ein stilvolles und praktisches Appartement!
Wir wurden bei Fragen von der gastgebenden Familie sehr gut beraten und durften sogar eine Maschine Wäsche waschen.
Ein sehr angenehmes Wohnviertel! Wir kommen wieder :)

We really enjoyed staying there.
Definitely, we will come back to here.
Thank you so much.
Wir waren sehr zufrieden! Gerne wieder! Die Lage ist sehr nah an einer Metro und das Bett sehr bequem.

Wir hatten einen tollen Aufenthalt bei Maria, das Zimmer ist schön und man es gibt alles, was man braucht . Auch der Rest der Wohnung ist wunderschön! Maria ist eine herzliche Gastgeberin, wir haben in der Nacht noch selbst gemachtes Mangoeis probieren dürfen :-) Die Unterkunft ist uneingeschränkt weiterzuempfehlen.
Great place to stay in Lisbon!
We stayed with Maria for just one day but we can tell that her place is amazing. Very aesthetic, comfortable and cozy. The hosts were very friendly and helpfull. Highly recommended

Check in was easy. The Ubers were so cheap going downtown that we just used them, but it's also close to the metro. The son of the host made some recommendations which was nice. Cute apartment and it was nice to have your own bathroom.
Very nice and well located apartment. Maria's son was really kind to us. We did appreciate our last night in Lisbon. Tha appartment is cute and very clean I do recommand :)
Very friendly in any way!!

Una estancia genial en una casa muy bonita y cuidada. Muy cerca del metro.
Muy recomendable
Check in was easy. It was easy to find with a short walk from the metro station. Great to have our own bathroom. You definitely hear the underground.

Very well located, just 2 min away from the metro station, 15min by metro from the old town center. The flat is decorated with good taste, full of artwork and even a piano. We had the chance to interact more with Antony and he was super friendly. The room is cosy, with a private bathroom. The kitchen is well equipped and it's got a nice terrace. We'll definitely come back on our next trip to Portugal if available.
Stanza molto carina! Siamo stati accolti da un ragazzo simpaticissimo. Comodo e perfetto per chi fa lunghi viaggi e deve lavare i vestiti, perché la lavatrice è inclusa.
Awesome stay!! Maria’s sons were so kind and gave us tips about Lisboa!! Also was a very beautiful place.

Antony (Maria's son) was super friendly and helpful. It felt like we were invited to a friend's place. Location was really nice because the metro is at 1 min walk and it's the green line, which is the one to go downtown. It's about 15 min from downtown Lisbon. The place is clean and quite. As stated there is no AC, so it was quite hot in our room, so think about it if you come in August!
Maria’s place has everything you need! The art is also amazing. I had to modify my travel and Maria was very kind and understanding.

Beautiful easy accessible apartment w/ small outdoor patio. Small but convenient bedroom w/ private bathroom.
The apartment is attractive, quiet at night, decorated with paintings and books - and home to the sons of the owner. I had a lovely conversation with one of them.
I stayed for one night, while the pope was in town. For that reason the price of the room must have been bumped, it was rather expensive but worth it to me and I will definitely come back if the price is a little lower next time.
Nice apartment in Lisbon, enough space for 2 people with a private en suite, the two brothers that are living there are very friendly and helpful, would recommend

Der Aufenthalt in der Wohnung von Maria hat uns gut gefallen. Das Zimmer ist zwar klein, aber es reicht aus, um ein paar Tage Lissabon zu erkunden. Die Wohnung ist sehr ansprechend eingerichtet und man bekommt einen Eindruck, wie die Lissaboner leben. Die Metro-Station und eine Bushaltestelle sind in der Nähe, so dass man auch schnell das Zentrum erreichen kann.
Da wir sehr spät angekommen sind, waren wir auf einen flexiblen Check-In angewiesen. Dies war problemlos möglich. Vielen Dank!
We had a great stay at this appartment. It's very near to the metro (good connection to the airport) and we felt very welcome.

The room was cozy, clean and a great midpoint between the city and the airport. Truly perfect for our needs. Maria was responsive and flexible, letting us drop off bags and change clothes before official check in time. Felt like home, even for just a night. Thank you!

We loved our stay! We had a really time. The two brothers who live in Maria’s house (her sons) were super helpful and really kind. We felt right at home.
It is a bit out of the center which makes it a nice and quiet stay and especially the little terrace with all the beautiful plants!
The train to sintra is 2 minutes walking away and the metro which takes you into the old center within 15 minutes is 3 minutes walking away. Perfect! Grocery store around the corner. Everything you need.

We had a lovely stay at the apartment. The sons who lived there were very sweet and helpful and we felt very welcome and at home. There was a lovely little garden where we could relax and the kitchen and other rooms were fully equipped en clean. The space was as lovely as on the pictures. The train and metrostation were right next to the apartment what made it easy to travel to the city, and also a supermarket was nearby which was great.
The check-in was a little messy, instructions were very clear but the room hadn't been cleaned yet and the host wouldn't respond on our request if it had been cleaned or not. We had to wait a while until one of the sons came home. He apologized and fixed everything, which was very nice. This was a part that could have been a bit better, but overall we had a very great time and we would definitely go back again!
It’s a very nice flat with a beautiful terrace and close to train, metro and bus. Very nice owner, we would come back.

Perfect as a stop-over stay (roughly halfway between airport and city).
Cozy and very clean, very friendly hosts, would gladly stay there again!
One caveat: metro is quite noticeable, especially at night.

Maria stellt ein kleines, aber feines Zimmer mit eigenem Bad zur Verfügung, das direkt auf die grüne Terrasse schaut. Man hört zwar die Bahn, aber es ist trotzdem ruhig und sehr zentral zum Flughafen, Metro und Bahn gelegen. Wir hatten einen schönen Aufenthalt in einer privaten Unterkunft und haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Maria war sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit! Vielen Dank!

We had such a nice stay here! The hosts were really friendly and helpful with recommending local restaurants and places to go. We felt right at home in their home! Such a great convenient location in Lisbon too, so easy to get around. Would definitely recommend.
Die Unterkunft war gut.

Erg fijn verblijf gehad! Heel dicht bij de metro waardoor je zo in de binnenstad bent. De kamer is schoon en netjes. Van te voren contact gehad of ik mijn koffers wat eerder kon brengen en dat was mogelijk. Erg fijn.
Je hoort de metro wel af en toe, maar dat was niet storend.
Als soloreiziger was dit een perfecte uitvalsbasis!

Thank you Maria and family for the great stay! It was a perfect place to be for a few days before getting to the airport. The art house has a personal touch and at the same time , privacy, with having a locked door and personal bathroom to use.
Maria provided the perfect private space for our last night in Lisbon. It had everything we needed and it was easy to get in and out!

Ich bin sehr zufrieden mit der Unterkunft gewesen. Genau wie auf den Fotos.
Sobald man in die Wohnung kommt, ist diese angenehm Einladend.
Das Zimmer ist fein und gemütlich, da mit eigener Dusche.
Gut für Singles als auch 2. Personen.
Neben der Küche kommt man auf den Balkon. Dieser ist auch sehr angenehm für zum Frühstücken oder am Abend zum verweilen.
Apotheke oder ein kleiner Shop gleich um die Ecke.
10 min. vom Zentrum entfernt mit der U-Bahn.
Eine durchaus positive Erfahrung.
Sehr zum Empfehlen.

Excellent room with really clear and easy transport links. The apartment was vey clean and Maria provided excellent instructions (even if you don’t know Portuguese). Antonio was very hospitable and even made me a coffee when I arrived early. Definitely recommend for a good layover or weekend getaway.

Maria‘s place is real gem. I only met her 2 sons who showed me around. The room is small but really quiet and the entire apartment is decorated with a lot of love.
Although it‘s a bit further out of the city center it only takes 15 min by metro to get there.
Definitely recommended.

Danke für den tollen Aufenthalt und Austausch. Wir kommen gerne wieder.
Viel Erfolg an Sporting! ;)

facilement accessible, près du métro
hôte très sympathique
Tous ces bien passé ! Belle appartement bien placé et bien équipé ! De bonne discussion! Merci beaucoup !

Het huis wordt bewoond door de zonen van Maria. De mannen zijn bijzonder gastvrij, aardig en behulpzaam. Onze slaapkamer was ruim genoeg en aangrenzend is een eigen badkamer met toilet.
De keuken is voorzien van alle artikelen die je nodig kunt hebben en we hebben onbeperkt gebruik kunnen en mogen maken van zowel de woonkamer, keuken als het terras.

My husband and I really enjoyed our time here. It was quite, clean and we felt at home.
We loved all the art in the house!
Great experience!
Het is een fijne kamer en schone badkamer. De host is gastvrij en behulpzaam. We kregen goede restaurant tips bij aankomst. Zeker een aanrader!

Nos recibieron los hijos de María y fueron muy amables, el lugar está muy cerca del aeropuerto y es fácil llegar, habitación muy cómoda, silenciosa, cerca de estación de metro y de tren.
Muchas gracias, la pasamos muy bien :)
Maria’s place is great for a long layover. Easy to get to from their airport by metro or Uber.
Maria est chaleureuse, et relationnelle

Only stayed one night but it was exactly what we needed (a couple). The room was quite small, but having a bathroom inside the room was perfect for us to get refreshed after long travels.
