Maria sent all the info we needed to arrive late and leave early. Had fun looking at the extensive bookshelf titles too!

Imagine arriving to Lisbon at 9 pm after a series of delayed flights and a total travel time of over 8 hours. Mobile phone is almost dead, Uber pickup location at the airport is far from the arrivals hall. Get to this apartment after dark; hard for the taxi driver to find, since little outdoor lighting. Good instructions given by the host for getting into the apartment building and unit. However, door to the private room and bath was firmly locked. I had messaged to host two days before arrival with approximate arrival time and inquiry about nearby grocery. No response. Messaged her about delayed flights. No response. Called her number at least 3 times when I could not get into my room. No response. Was so exhausted I ended up trying to sleep in her son’s bed; used sheets - ugh! Finally after about 2 hours of searching for a key to the room, clean towels, sheets, anything, I gave up. Host finally texted me and apologized. A friend/neighbor came over and unlocked the door to the room.
Sehr freundliche und aufgeschlossene Gastgeber. Nach einem langen Reisetag ein freundlicher Empfang und ein Glas Wein. Großartig!
Nice place to stay.. not in the center of town but near metro and train.. 15 min to get to the center... lovely terrace, kitchen and room..
Very friendly host, eager to help.
Lovely property close to the city, Her sons really made us feel at home, often giving us advice about where to go and food to eat. Cannot fault this Airbnb stay one bit😁 amazing

Highly recommend! I felt like I was staying at home, Maria’s sons were excellent and thoughtful hosts. Made efforts to make you feel welcome and connected. Grateful to have been welcomed into their home!

The place was impeccable. Close to the airport which was convenient for us as it was a short stay.
Host was very responsive and courteous.
Perfect spot for us. Love it !
Highly recommend it !!
Nice to beach Antonio. Very helpful and we had a few good laughs. I had a great day. Thank you.

Appartement très bien situé, tout près du métro et de petits marchés. Les fils de Maria nous ont accueillis et ils ont été à la fois discrets et serviables. Les deux parlent super bien l'anglais ce qui facilite grandement les communications. La petite terrasse à l'arrière de l'appartement est fort jolie et nous y avons passé beaucoup de temps le matin avant de partir et le soir au retour de nos visites. On peut accéder au centre-ville de Lisbonne en 20 minutes environ par le métro. L'aéroport et les gares de train sont très proches aussi, on y accède en taxi pour à peine une dizaine d'euros. Le quartier où est situé l'appartement est très tranquille. Comme à peu près partout, on entend le métro lorsqu'il passe mais ce n'est pas vraiment dérangeant.

Maria's place was a great crash pad for us in Lisbon for the two 1-night stays during our trip to Porto. The space is a private room in an apt and comes with its own private (small but effective) bathroom. The kitchen area is shared but the home owners make you feel at home. We were 2 of us using the room and with our 3 large suitcases (since Portugal was only 1 stop on our travel itinerary) the room felt like a little bit of a squeeze, but the comfortable bed took care of our main objective i.e. restful sleep!
Communicating with the home owners was a breeze and they are all very helpful and accommodating.
Location is also very convenient, the metro (intracity) and regional train (intercity) stations are a quick walk from the place.
All in all, we recommend this place for other travelers looking for similar accommodations in Lisbon.

It was a pleasure to stay with Maria and the boys! Such perfect hosts, welcoming, but also giving you a lot of privacy. The neighborhood is very nice, not touristic at all and has many nice shops you can't find in Bairro Alto. Yet, one can be in the city centre real quick. Definitely recommend this great place with extraordinary nice art and people. Gonna come back for sure, obrigada!

Nous avons passé un bon séjour, arrivée flexible (tardive)
Obrigada 🙂
Cozy room to stay before flight the next morning. Maria and her family were very welcoming.
was nice. There was someone living there in the other part of the house at the time, but was not bothered.

Maria hat ein helles und liebevolles Zuhause. Der Gästebereich besteht aus einem Schlafzimmer mit Bad (WC und Dusche) und ist gut und zweckmäßig ausgestattet. Die Küche und die Terrasse darf mit benutzt werden. Beides ist gemütlich und einladend.
Die Küche ist modern ausgestattet, der Essbereich ist hell und freundlich. Die Terrasse ist über eine Tür von der Küche aus erreichbar.
Bon séjour, emplacement top (métro à 2min) mais logement un peu humide. Je recommande ce Airbnb
Nice place to stay
Prima verblijf, vriendelijke en gastvrije zoons

I enjoyed staying here. The location is easy to reach from the airport (I used the bus) and has a Metro station closed to it so the whole of Lisbon is accessible.
I liked that it is far enough from the center to be quiet and peaceful. The local restaurant “Fome de Leao” is good.
I didn’t meat Maria but her sons. Two super capable young men who were very polite and friendly.
I’d book again in a heartbeat

Lovely place! The flat was beautifully decorated with clean white spaces and gorgeous original artworks in every room. We enjoyed the touches and attention to detail and shared a glass of wine on the terrace surrounded by succulents and vines. The area was a short bus ride from the airport and good connections to the tourist spots. Would recommend!  Maria was super friendly and helpful, she is lovely! We would love to be back there!
Vey well located and easy
For us it was the perfect place to stay overnight before continuing out journey: close to the airport, clean, cosy and with a comfy bed for a good night sleep.

I enjoyed my stay. Lisbon and surrounding area are full of crowds and exciting sights and sounds and adventures. Coming home to this apartment, making food for myself, and resting in the private room with private bathroom was perfect. The location is not in the middle of all the sights, and it is accessible to everything I wanted to do by bus and metro. The terrace looked peaceful but I didn't use it because it was a little chilly. The gelateria downstairs was closed but there were some restaurants and a couple of small grocery stores with produce nearby. This place is also close to the airport and accessible by bus to the airport.
Maria's kids live in this apartment too, and this was completely fine.
Great place to stay and the host son is very helpful and had good recommendations for Lisboa. Would stay again.
Gute Lage, gute Verbindung, versorgungsmöglichkeiten wie Supermarket, Apotheke, Bäcker und leckeres Grill Hänchen und Fisch auf der gleiche Stasse.
Excelente acomodação, precisei deixar minhas bagagens antes do horário do check in e foi super tranquilo.

Thank you for help and hospitality ♥️
A sure recommendation for all the travelers who need tea, sympathy and a very clean and cozy space

Le logement est super, propre, joli, il y a tout ce qu’il faut. L’emplacement est parfait, le métro est à 2 minutes à pied.
Nous avons été accueilli chaleureusement, tout était parfait.
sehr kommunikativer Gastgeber, schönes Zimmer mit guter Anbindung an die Innenstadt/Flughafen. gern wieder
Perfeito
Very communicative host, and beautiful apartment. Great location if you want to be close to airport.

Chambre avec douche et toilettes privées, agréable dans un bel appartement, très bien équipé (cuisine partagée, salon).Très bien localisée près du métro (une centaine de mètres). Parfait pour parcourir Lisbonne.
Communication très aisée avec Maria.

Nice cosy appartment, a few meters from the metro station Areeiro. Nice host and communication was really good.
A good place to stay for a few days.
Minha estadia foi ótima, o apartamento é aconchegante, o rapaz que me recebeu muito educado, ótima localização, recomendo!
Perfect place for our brief layover through Lisbon. Beautiful apartment and neighborhood, Maria and her family were very friendly and welcoming and we had a comfortable, quiet room.
Great place! Great location! Beautiful room!

This was the perfect stay. So convenient to Metro and within walking distance of plenty of shops and restaurants. I was able to store my luggage prior to check in and after check out. I would definitely recommend!
ótimo lugar para ficar. A Maria é uma excelente pessoa. Super recomendamos eu e minha esposa fomos muito bem recebidos, o lugar e ótimo, limpo, aconchegante. Com certeza voltaremos lá. Vlw Maria

Good communication to the center and to the airport. Very efficient contact with Maria, we were able to leave our backpacks earlier, for which we thank you. The room is quite small but clean and functional. My partner had trouble sleeping (despite earplugs) due to the noise from the subway, it didn't bother me. The kitchen is super equipped and pleasant to use.
localização excelente, de frente para estação de metro. Na minha opinião só faltou uma TV. fora isso, tudo perfeito.
Foi perfeita . Próxima ao metrô e do aeroporto . A próxima vez que voltar, queremos ficar novamente.

La comunicación fue clara, el apartamento está bien ubicado, la habitación limpia y bonita, bien equipada. María nos permitió dejar las maletas en su casa luego del checkout y se agradece mucho.
El desayuno es autoservicio.

das zimmer ist klein aber fein. ich war nur eine nacht dort, aber ich habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt und ich wurde freundlich empfangen. maria und ihr sohn zé sind sehr nett und hilfsbereit und ich konnte mich auf sie verlassen😍 ich werde sicher wieder dort buchen beim nächsten mal.
Wir haben uns wohl gefühlt, super Lage und gutes Zimmer :)

Pequeño, olía un poco a humedad la habitación y lo del desayuno en terraza, es autoservicio.
Por lo demás una buena ubicación
We had a good stay in Maria's appartment. The bed is comfortable and the metro is just a few minutes away.

This was quite a convenient stay. About a 3 minute walk to the Areerio metro or the bus(es) to the airport. I was only in the space for about 8 hours, but could’ve easily stayed a few days longer. The host was welcoming, letting me drop my bags before check-in time. The room is a nice size, decorated with cool art. The bed is comfartable and the private on-suite bathroom gives and exclusive feel.

Top Lage, vom Airport an besten mit der Buslinie 705 erreichbar. Metro, Zug, Bus in unmittelbarer Nähe, ca. 15min damit ins Zentrum. Sehr freundlicher und einfacher  Check In, tolle Tipps vom Sohn. Beschreibung stimmt überein, sauberes Zimmer. Freundlich, hat etwas von einer WG mit den beiden Söhnen. Allein die Versorgung für das Frühstück kann verbessert werden. Bett auch für 2 Personen ok. Jederzeit empfehlenswert!
Great place to stay  Even if is not in the city center  and For sure I will come again
Parfait emplacement près des métro et gare. Chambre avec douche et wc impeccable ! Quelques petits bruits la nuit mais normal dans une grande ville.
unkompliziert, sehr herzliche familie
This was our second stay. Convenient. Clean. Great restaurant on the corner, gelato down stairs, metro and small shops right down the street. Perfect for a stopover

Maria's place is wonderful. I was able check-in without trouble at an unpopular time due to delays in my train schedule, had a great sleep on the comfortable mattress, and easily got to Lisbon Airport early morning. I definetely would stay there again whenever I am in Lisbon. Thank you for accommodating me, Maria!
We had a great stay! We needed a place closer to the airport and this location was perfect. The room was as described and the host was very communicative.
Netter Gastgeber und süßes Zimmer in super Lage.

Clean and convenient albeit small. The listing is accurate and the building is safe. Very close to the airport and an excellent value. The host is kind and welcoming. I don’t think the space will work for all body sizes. My husband and slim/athletic build And tall (6’3” and 5’10”) with long wingspans and we found the shower challenging though we made it work. Bed is comfortable. Quiet place. Lovely patio

Apartamento confortável, limpo e bem-decorado. A comunicação com a anfitriã é rápida e bastante eficaz, o check-in é fácil e qualquer pergunta recebe resposta em menos de uma hora.
Além do quarto ideal para duas pessoas a casa disponibiliza um agradável e acolhedor terraço, excelente para um bom pequeno-almoço. No geral, uma ótima experiência!

Merci pour ce séjour josé nous a super bien reçu et nous a aidé pour organiser nos vacances !merci bien à lui
Dommage que Maria était absente elle aurait peut-être plus suivi le petit déjeuner en libre service!c’est le seul bémol
Nous garderons un bon souvenir

Für unseren Zwischenaufenthalt in Lissabon war es die ideale Unterkunft. Man ist mit der metrooder de Bus schnell am Flughafen oder in der Stadt. Es ist ein kleines Frühstück inklusive, man hat ein eigenes Bad und man kann bei schönem Wetterauf der Terrasse sitzen.
We didn’t stay long, but we felt welcomed and safe while there. We showed up late and had an early flight out the next morning. Perfect for what we needed.

Schöne Unterkunft mit guter Anbindung zum Flughafen (Bus) und zur Innenstadt (Metro). Kleines Zimmer mit privatem Bad und davor einem kleinem ,,Balkon,, auf dem man entspannt frühstücken kann.
Zwei sehr nette Jungs mit vielen guten Tipps (ein wenig ,,WG-Atmospähre").
Küche hätte ein wenig sauberer, und der Nachschub an Lebensmitteln fürs Frühstück ein wenig konsistenter sein können ;)
I needed a place to crash for the night. Maria's sons were great at helping me feel welcome. The airport is super close so you get airplane noise, but nothing wrong with the space itself
Super appartement avec une localisation parfaite à proximité des transports en commun !

Chambre très propre et fonctionnelle avec sa salle de bain privative.
Le seul regret est de ne pas avoir croisé notre hôte qui selon les voyageurs précédents est quelqu’un de très agréable !!! Un merci particulier à Maria qui à accepté une modification de dernière minute dû à mouvement de grève easyjet

The perfect space for quick travel days! The host was very kind and offered us great local recommendations of restaurants and places to visit. Easy walk to the metro and close to the airport. It is a shared apartment, so be mindful if you’re looking for something completely private.
Great stay. Great location, easy to get to all the sights. Host was accommodating and the place was very clean. Highly Recommended

El alojamiento es muy lindo y limpio. la habitación cómoda, con baño privado. El alojamiento se encuentra a una hora caminando del centro histórico y las principales atracciones de la ciudad, pero esta conectado perfectamente con la línea de metro que te lleva en menos de 20 minutos al centro.
Algo a mejorar: el servicio de desayuno. Si se encuentra incluido en la tarifa y no es una atención (como en este caso) recomendaría que sea mejor en calidad y variedad y estado de las cosas. También, que este señalizado qué es lo de consumo de airbnb, para no pasar situaciones incómodas
Amazing! Close to Metro! Nice and clean! Great host!
chambre privée avec salle de bain très propre. Malgré notre court séjour, l'hôtesse s'est montré très accueillante.

The apartment is very nice with beautiful art on the walls. It is very convenient that the room has its own bathroom. The terrasse is as nice as it looks on the pictures and we enjoyed having our breakfast there. The location is not in the middle of town but everything is perfectly accessable by metro.
Great location, clean room and nice host!

Stanza molto carina, fornita di tutto il necessario. Abbiamo solo avuto un piccolo problema con le formiche che sono entrate nelle valigie che erano sul pavimento.
La casa è situata in una zona tranquilla, vicinissima alla metro, tramite cui raggiungere il centro della città in pochi minuti.
Nice place to stay, good location with easy connection to the city centre. Good communication.

Molto apprezzato il check in automatico, ma sarebbe carino dare indicazioni sul resto dell'alloggio. Come ad esempio, indicare agli ospiti come poter fare colazione in autonomia, dato che l'host non era presente in casa e dato che c'era una cucina in condivisione. Basterebbe fare un cartello in cucina con indicazioni chiare oppure mandare un messaggio prima dell'arrivo. Noi non abbiamo potuto usufruire della colazione inclusa nel prezzo perché non volevamo correre il rischio di prendere del cibo in frigo che fosse di qualcun'altro.
Great location. Very friendly people. A really lovely place to stay in Lisbon. We would recommend.
anfitriões excelentes. ótima acolhida. lugar próximo a metrô e trem para outras cidades. quarto limpo e cheiroso. excelente experiência
Très bon séjour

Ficamos apenas um dia e foi uma ótima estadia.
Fomos bem recebidos e o apartamento da Maria fica em uma ótima localização, próximo ao metro.
O quarto estava limpo e foi tudo certo conforme esperávamos.
Chambre nickel, bon accueil

Our stay at Maria's Airbnb was great because:
- location of the apartment (near to Metro station and just 10 mins away from airport)
- very good communication and it was able to store our bags hours before official check in time
- everything was clean, fresh and functioning
- good infrastructure (supermarket, bakery etc)
- apartment was cozy, authentic and we had our own bathroom
- perfect for (short) stays in Lisbon
I had a wonderful time
Everything was wonderful!
Super convenient location for airport travel, and really easy checkin.
Maria gave us the instructions to arrive at the place very clearly. The room was good although a bit smaller than looks on the pictures. It was a great experience in general.
Antonio et Nick sont très sympathiques. Ils sont très accommodants aussi. Nous recommandons!
great place near metro station, with AWESOME kitchen and plenty of amenities
Thank you Maria and sons for a lovely flat. We like your art :-)

It’s a great place near the airport.
Our flight was delayed and we arrived super late. Maria left the light on for us and gave us great instructions on how to get in.

We greatly enjoyed our stay at Maria's private room. Our room had a clean bed with fresh sheets and towels, a private bathroom located in the room itself and privacy shades on the windows. We needed a place to crash before heading to the airport in the morning and this was great for that. Theres a gelato store next door and great restaurants on the block. Its not in a very touristy area, so if youre looking for that, you might be disappointed, but we loved it and would definitely stay here again.
Lovely! Very clean and convenient and great communication
A estadia foi ótima e a comunicação também, super simpáticos e amáveis.

Lovely apartment, located near the Areeiro metro station. Make it easy to reach the old part of Lisboa. We were welcomed by Maria's son Ze, he gave us all the information we needed and was overall very helpful.
My stay was fantastic. One of the sons let me in and they were wonderful hosts. Great location I highly recommend scootering to see the city from where they live!

Very nice and cosy room with private bathroom, kitchen and beautiful terrace where you can eat breakfast provided by the owners. Maria and her family was very kind and hospitable for us. Great localisation in the calm district, not in the city center but really close to the Arreiro metro station. I higly recommend!
Great stay. Host was very helpful.
Excellent host! Great place, convenient location, fantastic recommendations for Lisbon sights and activities. Thanks!!
A small room in a house, comes with bathroom and own little dresser. We didn’t have breakfast, because we had an early flight. But we were offered the ingredients to make if we had chosen to.

Une très bonne adresse. J’y ai séjourné avec ma petite fille de 9 ans. Idéalement située à côté de la gare qui vous emmène à Sintra ou à l’Océanorium que nous voulions visiter. Près du métro avec lequel on arrive en centre ville. Joignable facilement de l’aéroport en bus ou en métro. Accueil très chaleureux de Maria et de son fils José qui nous a très bien conseillés. Merci à Maria et José

My husband and I really enjoyed our stay here. We felt welcome and at home the entire time, and the host was friendly, helpful and full of great suggestions. The location is a bit out of the way, but it's up the street from the metro and it's a quick ride down to the more touristy areas. It's also a block away from the train station that takes you to Sintra ... super convenient if you're planning day trips!

We basically just needed a place to stay the night before our flight the next morning, and this was perfect for that. It’s about 15 minutes from the airport. The hosts were really welcoming and easygoing and offered up suggestions for places to go/things to do and we had access to the kitchen and backyard area though the listing is for a guest room w bath! Slightly further out from the city center/downtown area but the metro is super close so it made traveling easy

Marías apartment is a wonderful place with the coziest room and a private bath. Maria’s son greeted me with all information about the place and was available the whole time for any assistance. At one point I heard someone playing the piano in the leaving room, and it was so nice and lively, it added so much charisma to my stay :)
Fully recommended!

Merci à Maria et à Zay pour l accueil proposé. La chambre était très propre et les conditions annoncées respectées. Le bruit du métro est tout à fait vivable pour 2 ou 3 nuits et peut bien être concédé pour sa proximité.
Correu tudo bem.

I had a great experience staying at Maria’s place. The home is well decorated with fun and curated pieces, but still very homey. It’s only a 1-2 minute walk to the metro station, making it very convenient to travel considering Lisbon has many hills and inclines. There is a small rattle where the metro passes by, but it did not bother or awaken me. I would stay at Maria’s place again if I were to travel to Lisbon again.
Ótima acomodação ! A Maria foi muito atenciosa. Recomendo !

If you are looking for a «  feel at home » place , Maria’s little oasis is just the place to be.
Perfect for two people for a short stay, close to means of transportation , very clean.
In the area just on the other side of the street a good local restaurant as well few blocks away … grilled chicken is delicious.. lots of cafés
You get to downtown in few minutes with the metro Arreiro near by. Very quiet place also with good hot shower.
Highly recommend!

Great place
Very hospitable

The apartment is located in a standard, fortunately not crazy touristic area of Lisbon. You can get to the buzzing city hot spots easily by bus or metro within 15 minutes.
Sharing the apartment with Maria and her son really made our stay a very personal one. That felt very nice!

Location, location, location! Short walk or Uber to any destination in Lisbon. There was a gelato store, convenient store, and bakery literally right outside your door. Maria’s sons lived on property and provided us with everything we needed to know/see during our stay, they were a wealth of knowledge. Will stay here again on our next European vacation.

Good welcoming with Antonio..
All was as described.
Very quiet… and respectful.

Great location, close to lots of food, shops. Great back seating area. Super kind guests and willing to answer all your questions. Let us drop our bags off early which was great for us. Close to public transportation.
Welcoming family, super clean and uncomplicated. Breakfast included, do it yourself. Would definitely stay again!
Très bien placé et pour quelques nuits, le bruit du métro n’est pas très gênant! Antonio était très serviable merci à lui.
Maria was excellent in communication and helped us with a midnight check in. The location is nice and has a kitchen, plus an outdoors dining area. would highly recommend staying with Maria
Wonderful accommodation where you feel yourself more like a part of a host family than a regular visitor. One time we cooked together with Jõse and enjoyed a great soccer match.

Belle accueil,  très propre et convivial. Appartement situé près de la ligne verte du métro, entre le centre-ville et l’aéroport. Bruit perceptible du métro qui passe sous la maison, mais pas dérangeant la nuit. Merci pour le séjour!

not very quiet, but no big deal I didn't use the room much. the cleaning fee was 1/3 of the price, which seems high.
The person who greeted me did not speak any English or Spanish, so that was awkward but was also my own lack of Portuguese
Lovely spot, very welcoming. Antonio was very helpful. A wonderful place to stay in Lisbon.

Perfect stay! Highly recommended for any traveller. Wanted to stay longer but this is a popular spot and it was booked. Location is close to airport, Metro, shops, restaurants and museums. Having a private bath in my room was ideal too. Maria’s sons hosted me and were generous with their conversation and information about Portugal. Felt comfortable as a solo traveller. Lovely garden to enjoy coffee too. A+++
Rien à redire, hôte très arrangeant, chambre propre et bien équipée, facilités d'accès. Je recommande !

We had a wonderful stay in Lisbon at Maria’s place. Thanks to both her sons her were lovely and gave us lots of tips on places to go! It was the perfect spot to get buses and metros into town. Definitely recommend staying here.

Todo de acuerdo a lo publicado, excelente atención y comodidad. Su hijo fue muy hospitalario y nos hizo recomendaciones para visitar la ciudad. El desayuno estaba incluido. Nos convidaron un rico vino portugués. Muy recomendable alojamiento.
Maria's place is very nice and although we didn't meet Maria, her sons are so welcoming and helpful! I strongly recommend!

tout s est bien passé chez Maria. chambre au calme très propre idéale pour séjourner quelques jrs à Lisbonne en toute autonomie.
nous avons pu rentrer nos vélos sur la terrasse sécurisée et c'est très appréciable. allez y les yeux fermés.
It’s a great room an the host been pretty kind!

Maria's sons Antonio and Ze were fantastic hosts. Both have been overwhelmingly welcoming, gave us tips and lots of travel advice. We got the chance to use the kitchen, terrace and even had a cheeky wonder around the roof - all spaces very atmospheric and very cozy. Will be definitely coming back!

Excellent Airbnb ! Great value for money, the location is great (next to metro, city center and train station), the host super helpful and welcoming (thanks again José!), and the place in itself is super charming. I can only recommend that place if you visit Lisbon !
Correu tudo muito bem, a comunicação foi fácil, assim como o check in... Tudo estava impecável!

A comfortable room with a good private bathroom. The house is really cozy with a lovely ouside space to eat or read. The hosts were really welcoming and made us feel at home. Perfect for a short trip to the city!

Maria's place is very nice, the room is a bit on the smaller side but we really liked it. Felt nice and cozy. Her son Antonio met us there, he was very nice and welcoming. He provided us with plenty of coffee and even nice wine.
The room is located very near the Areeiro Metro Station where you can use the Linha Verde, this line takes you directly to the Praça da Figueira in the center or Lisboa, and also connects with the Linha Verdelha that takes you to and from the airport.
Overall a great experience and if we have the chance we'd stay here again!
Everyone was so friendly :) Our stay was wonderful; the unit was clean and so well decorated.
Maria is very nice. The room is clean and everything you need is there. We didn’t see Maria and didn’t really got an explanation about the location. On the other side, our privacy was well respected.

really good Place for your stay in lisboa.
it's near the airport and metro. the two guys living there were really cool and nice. one evening we got a private concert from a son of Maria and he's really good at the piano.
it's perfect to explore lisboa and have a great time. everything was uncomplicated.
definitely recommend 👍
A wonderful and clean place, nearby a metrostation to the centre of Lissabon. We felt really welcome. You will have your own room and bathroom.
Buona posizione e bella casa
Maria, is a great host. She made everything easy for us, Listing is as described. Thanks so much.

We needed a place to basically just sleep before flying to the airport the next morning and it was perfect. We were able to drop our bags and go explore Lisbon, get a good night's sleep and catch an Uber to the airport for less than 5 Euros. The bedroom is connected to the bath so its fairly private for a room in an apartment. We never heard anyone. The room is not big, but plenty, and the sheets and towels were nice and fresh. Great place for a quick stopover.
The room and apartment is really nice, clean and has everything that one needs. I was warmly welcomed and had a great time, nearly felt at home/as part of the family. Great place 👍

We loved calling this place our temporary home in Lisboa. It’s a little removed from the center of the city, but close to the airport, the train system, and in a safe neighborhood with decent local fare (restaurants, pharmacy, grocery store, even gelato). The room itself is compact but perfect for two and the bed is quite comfortable. But the real prize was getting to know Maria’s sons, both very friendly and available to give us pointers on the best way to get around. We had an absolute dream of a vacation in Portugal and will be back to say hello again!

Maria’s appartment is the perfect place. Cosy, clean and perfectly located.
I was travelling alone and I will come again for sure !

Unfortunately we couldn’t stay at Maria’s place. We got there and saw the apartment but had to leave the same night.
She was very easy to talk to and the apartment was beautiful and clean.
Thanks for everything!
Nicely decorated apartment near metro and airport. Clean and well-equipped, host’s son also welcomed us and explained everything. Lovely plants and art too!
Very kindly mother and son.

Es war ein sehr schöner Aufenthalt bei Maria. Ihr Sohn hat uns Empfangen, ein sehr netter Junge. Die Wohnung ist sehr geschmackvoll eingerichtet, es ist einfach sich hier wohl zu fühlen. Sehr zu empfehlen.

Ich habe mich bei Maria sofort wohlgefühlt. Die Unterkunft ist wunderbar gelegen und bietet Ruhe und Erholung. Besonders gefallen hat mir die geschmackvolle Einrichtung der gesamten Wohnung, sowie die Sauberkeit und Herzlichkeit. Die Terrasse ist außerdem ein wirklich großes Plus!
Die Küche ist sehr gut ausgestattet und ich wurde eingeladen mich frei zu bedienen.
Ich kann diese Unterkunft nur jedem empfehlen, vielen lieben Dank!

The room is really nice. It is a bit small, but the fact that we could use the rest of the beautiful house made it perfect! And sitting on the terrace was really cozy. The house is situated near a metro station which makes travelling to the centre of Lisbon very easy. But also trips to Sintra or Costa da Caprica were very easy. We'd totally recommend this place if you're looking for a quiet place to stay. :-)
It was really great there!:) I would absolutely recommend it! Very clean, super friendly and the apartment is close to the airport und close to the city center.

What a beautiful apartment, beautifully decorated and full of art. The room is very comfortable and the private bathroom is definitely a plus. We loved sitting outside and having coffee surrounded by beautiful flowers and plants. It’s very close to the city center, train station for a trip to Sintra, and the subway. To make things even better, Maria and her family are great and welcoming, and very generous as well. We highly recommend and are very grateful for such a great experience.
Thank you, we will definitely return someday.
Rayja and Soraya

Such a lovely spot to kick off our Portugal journey. Arriero is a beautiful suburb of lisbon and there are tons of great restaurants and parks nearby. Also Maria, Antonio and the whole family were so welcoming and kind. They went above and beyond to help us learn about Lisbon and Portuguese lifestyle. I highly recommend you consider their offering.

I had a wonderful stay in Maria‘s beautiful apartment. My room was very nice decorated and clean, the bed very comfortable. The bathroom was integrated in my room which was very comfortable. I meet her son Antonio during the check in, very nice guy who explained everything. Breakfast was available in the kitchen. I love the location of the apartment, it is in my favorite local neighborhood. In the building itself is also best Italian ice cream shop - highly recommend. I would recommend this place to friends.

L’accueil de Maria est chaleureux. personne Maria est généreuse et dynamique.Elle nous a été d’une grande générosité particulièrement en cette période de pandémie: comme on ne pouvait circuler, elle nous a préparé des plats délicieux . Son appartement est plein de vie ,
et la petite terrasse agréable. Je recommande fortement et nous , on y retournera
Very nice accommodation. Clean, spacious and a nice host. Plus the apartment is right next to a metro and train station. I can only recommend it.

Très bonne adresse et propreté impeccable
Gare a 100m, métro/bus a proximité et a 15mn en bus de l'aéroport
Quartier calme et hôte très accueillante !
Logement parfaitement propre et à proximité des transports, parfait...
This place is amazing! Metro and bus are super close. The room is super clean and comfortable. Matress is so relaxing. A great stay for us, we will come back again! Obrigada Maria!!!
super freundliche Gastgeberin, sauber und  gemütlich

Maria's place was great! The room/bathroom were perfect for me and my husband and the outdoor space was lovely. Maria offered us full use of the kitchen, including breakfast and coffee, as well as wine to enjoy at night. She was very kind and attentive and made us feel like we were at home. We would definitely stay again!

Right up the street from Maria's is a great coffee shop and on the corner, a wonderful take out or eat in restaurant.  This place is close to the Metro and makes exploring Lisbon fun and easy.    Highly recommended.

Really appreciate Maria and her son José. Cute and stylish house with lots of books and modern pictures, tidy, wonderful kitchen and comfortable room what we lived in.
House situated in few minutes from metro station, railway station, near some cafes and minimarket.
Uber ride to Lisbon aéroport costs 3.13€.
Thank you very much and have a nice experience in the future too!

Highly recommend ，near the metro station ，only need 7minutes go to the city center （may need to bear the sound from the train before 12）～near the mini market ，where food and fresh fruit are available ～ household is super nice ～
Stayed for one night and was just what we needed. Residential, quiet part of town. Nice to have a private bathroom.

Marias is a really friendly, open and uncomplicated host. Thank you very much for your great hospitability and the nice days at your place. The Apartment is perfectly located to explore Lisboa and its surrounding area. Just what I has to get used to as a person from the countryside is that

Maria's home was absolutely lovely! The room was just what we needed after a long day of traveling and the bed was incredibly comfortable!! The private bathroom was a huge plus for us and allowed us to get ready in our own time. She was very accommodating with late check in and late baggage pick up allowing us to go explore the city. She opened up her fully stocked kitchen to us if we wanted to cook and the coffee was delicious! We would stay there 100% again!!
Just what you want and need for a perfect holiday. Maria is a wonderful lady and she will do everything to make you feel comfortable.
It’s a convenient place near Metro station. Maria is really friendly, and efficiently communication.
good

Maria was an amazing host.
I booked last minute for my stay during a long layover. Her home is easy to reach from the airport by Uber and very inexpensive to reach as well.
The home itself is beautiful. It was by far the cleanest Airbnb I have ever stayed in, and the hospitality was great. Maria and her son made me feel so at home during my long few days of traveling. I am bummed I only had a few hours in Lisbon. They make me want to return as soon as possible!
If I could give more than 5 stars, I would. This place and Maria are amazing. I would recommend to anyone coming to Lisbon!
Very friendly and welcoming host, nice apartment. Room is basic, definitely not spacious so better fit for short stays.
A perfect spot for our final day! Maria is very hospitable and her place is very clean and comfortable. The apartment is very close to the airport and walking distance to restaurants.

Maria's son's home is very well equipped and stylish. It was nice to have easy access which allowed us to come and go as we pleased. We didnt even see Maria's son - the room is very private especially because there is a private bathroom.
It took 30/40minutes to walk into the centre, but there are 2 metro stations close to the apartment if preferred. The metro is super easy to use and is cheap - its can be use for the airport too! If not ubers are frequent and very cheap.
Thank you for a lovely stay :)
房东很好，很多需求都第一时间满足
Maria est très hospitalière. Vous serez très bien reçu chez elle. Merci pour le sejour

Maria's apartment was just what we wanted for our last night in Lisbon -- a cozy room close to the airport. We appreciated the wine in the evening, refrigerator stocked with food for breakfast, and the demo of how to use the coffee maker. Maria was communicative and gave tips on nearby places for dinner. It was great to have our final Portugal meal in a local restaurant far from the tourist paths. Thank you!

Enchantée de mon séjour chez Maria, des personnes très accueillantes, très bon emplacement avec le bus et le métro à 2min à pied..proximité de la gare aussi qui fait que l'on entend les trains (mais ils ne circulent pas toute la nuit !) cependant cela ne m'a pas déranger avec des boules quies.
La déco est soignée, la chambre est très propre, je suis partie seule et on se sens très en sécurité ainsi que dans le quartier, je conseille fortement ce logement !
위치가 시내랑 조금 떨어져 있어서 지하철을 타야하지만 오히려 시내의 좁은 골목으로 짐을 끌고가지 않아도 된다는 점이 좋았습니다. 공항에서 십분거리이고 지하철역 근처라 소음이 조금 있지만 작은 테라스에서 여유를 즐길 수 있는 좋은 공간입니다.

Amazing water pressure in the shower! Close to metro and split distance to and from the airport to downtown. There was periodic rumblings from the metro, but other reviews alluded to it so it wasn’t anything unexpected. Great communication and easy check in. She offered the place as if we were old friends. Gorgeous garden area where we could have coffee in the morning or a port wine she offered at night. Would recommend.

Maria is a lovely, welcoming person and quickly makes you feel at home. The guest room and bathroom are comfortable and spotlessly clean. A little small for 2 but perfect for me, a solo traveller. I loved the little outside area where I had my breakfast.
Very well situated on the green metro line so just a few stops into the centre. Also easy for railway stations and only 6euros by taxi to the airport.

Maria was a very kind and attentive host! The bedroom was perfect, and bathroom was clean and private. And her patio was a very cute place to grab breakfast! Definitely would recommend staying here to other guests looking for a place to stay in Lisbon.

We stayed for only one night for a stop over in Lisbon. The apartment is very nice and clean and has a great terrace which we weren’t able to use since we had to leave very early in the morning. Next time we would stay a bit longer.

Chez Maria on se sent comme à la maison dans son appartement d hôte
Très bon accueil. Petite terrasse très sympa pour le petit déjeuner
Sa cuisine était à notre disposition pour le petit déjeuner ainsi que du vin et du Porto pour l accueil
Room with just everything you need. Close to the airport and the metro. For us a perfect location.

An amazing room with private bathroom.
The host was kind enough to accommodate in such a short notice and provide us a place to stay before our flight.

마리아랑 아들 모두 엄청 친절하게 맞아주셨어요!체크인 시간을 계속 변경했는데도 개의치 않으셨고, 자정에 도착하는 것도 괜찮다고 해주셨어요.
아침식사는 직접 해먹을 수 있게 빵이랑 계란, 치즈, 잼 등을 다 구비해두셨고, 요리 뚝딱해서 테라스에서 먹었는데 너무 좋았어요! 밤에 테라스에서 포트와인에 탄산수 타먹고, 과일 사와서 먹었는데 증말 행복했습니다. 방도 예쁘고, 지하철역이랑 기차역 모두 근처에 있어서 좋았습니다!

The room is very cosy and exactly what one might need.
Maria is awesome and takes us in with care, we just loved meeting her.
The bed is very good, blackouts are as well, the breakfast is really nice and the patio a nice relaxing location.
The 3 stars overall review is due to 2 factors:
* Airplane noise and vibration felt in the house, it is not for us.
* Lisboa is very hot and sadly the nights are difficult to handle, since the room is at a lower level with easy access to other buildings we could not leave the window open and the fan was too noisy for us. We are a spoiled couple, i know.
We still loved Maria, the bedroom and the house, this might be nice for you if those 2 factors are manageable.
화장실 공용인건 생각보다 불편하지 않았습니다 너무 좋았고 위치는 시내에서 30분정도 걸어야하는데 언덕이 심해서 조금 힘들었지만 집은 좋았습니다

욕실과 침실에 개미가 너무 많았어요ㅠㅠ
호스팅은 친절했는데,
1박만 한게 다행이라는 생각이 들었습니다

Everything the reviews say and more! We stayed for 7 nights in August. The location is great; accessible to both the metro and the train station which is key in Lisbon. Fridge is full of great breakfast options and she has a variety of appliances to use (freshly squeezed orange juice was our favourite). I’m a sucker for a beautiful garden and the terrace was a nice addition to our mornings. Thank you Maria!

Maria's home is a great place to stay for young travelers on the go. The rooms are neat and clean and the check-in process is very easy. The kitchen and shared living space are hostel-style, so that you can use as you please to hang out or prepare your own meals. The location is easily accessible and very close to the airport, but not central to Lisbon nightlife. Everything is a short Uber ride away.

Maria’s place is great! The room is nice and clean and the private bathroom is a major plus. We also loved the back patio to relax at after our busy days. She also provided wine and breakfast and we loved that as well. We were sad we didn’t book for longer!
The room is very clean.There is lovely terrace outside.Metro and bus station is nearby the apartment.It is easy to go around and get anywhere in Lisbon.Recommendation.
It is one of the very place to stay at Lisboa (Lisbon) -  good location, easy to access public transportation, and very close to downtown or airport.

Kann man nur empfehlen. Tolle,stylische Wohnung in ner super Ecke in lisboa. Tolle Anbindung mit der Metro und super ruhig gelegen.Das kleine Zimmer mit eigenem Bad war wunderschön,gemütlich und super sauber.Buchen uns auch bei unserem nächsten lissabon Trip sicher dort ein.
Maria’s place is wonderful and nearby everything what you will need during your time in Lisbon. I can highly recommend Maria’s place to others!

L'appartamento di Maria vi accoglierà facendovi sentire a casa. Antonio, suo figlio, è stato molto ospitale e disponibile, offrendoci subito un ottimo porto come benvenuto. La nostra stanza, piccolina ma completa di tutto con il bagno in camera, affacciava direttamente sul terrazzo. Abbiamo avuto a disposizione anche la cucina completa di tutto e un'ottima colazione in cui non ci hanno fatto mancare nulla: yogurt, caffè, latte, pane tostato, burro, marmellate, succhi, ecc. La posizione è strategica vicino sia alla fermata della metro di Areeiro (linea verde) sia del treno Roma-Areeiro per Sintra! Assolutamente consigliato! Obrigado!!

The location of Maria's place is great: it takes about 10 minutes by taxi to the airport and when heading to the city centre, it is only a couple of metro stops. Maria is extremely friendly, and guests can make their own breakfast in a spacious kitchen and eat it in a terrace under sunshine - a suberb way to kick of your day in Lisbon.

Maria is deservedly a Superhost because she opens her home and heart to you. The room and bed are a little small for 2 people, but there is a very aesthetic living room and fully stocked kitchen that she gives you free rein in. Be prepared that there is a constant rumbling of the subway beneath the building, but other than that, a very homey, artistically decorated apartment.
Maria’s place was absolutely wonderful. She was very accommodating and the place was extremely clean and felt like a home away from home. Would absolutely recommend to  stay here!

Appartement propre, accueil chaleureux et belle petite terrasse! Très près de la fare de train et aéroport. Pas tres loin du centre également.
Je recommande cet endroit
Enjoyed the breeze on the outdoor patio and the well appointed kitchen. Maria was most gracious in welcoming me into her home.

The appartment is located near the airport (11 minutes by Taxi for around 5 €), the metro is just around the corner to get easily to the main attractions.
Communication with Maria was excellent- we arrived quite late at night which was not an issue at all.
The room is quite small, but clean and comfortable.
We did not spent much time in the room and only came to sleep.
It should may be mentioned that you can hear the metro trains arriving in the station from the room, however you get used to it easily.
Maria est une hôtesse sympathique et très discrète. La chambre est très propre et fonctionnelle. Les plus: le petit déjeuner sur la terrasse et la proximité du métro et de la gare.

Maria's apartment was easy to find and a fantastic location for exploring the city as it is so close to the subway. It was perfect for what we needed and I would highly recommend staying here if you come to visit Lisbon.

Maria ist eine sehr freundliche, stets hilfsbereite und liebevolle Gastgeberin gewesen.
Man hat sich wirklich wie zu Hause gefühlt.
Die Wohnung liegt nicht mitten im Zentrum, aber alles ist ganz entspannt von der nächstgelegen Metrostation zu erreichen (ca. 3min. zu Fuß).
Dazu kommt noch der Luxus einer Terrasse, den man in der Innenstadt sicher nicht hat.
Ich kann die Unterkunft nur weiterempfehlen!

Un beau logement, chambre avec une salle de bain, lit confortable, cuisine complète avec auto-déjeuner, un beau quartier près des services et un metro tout près. En bruit de fond l'aéroport mais qui ne dérange pas le sommeil. Un bel endroit de qualité.

Maria was very welcoming and showed us the entire place . She made us feel like we were at home and gave us local tips . The space was very nice at a perfect location in Lisbon .  Highly recommended. Thanks Maria !!

We wholeheartedly recommend Maria’s airbnb! The room was small, but plenty room for two people and hand luggage. We could make use of the kitchen and terrace, where we could prepare our own food. Only two minutes away from the metro station, and about 10 minutes with public transport from Rossio station. Maria and her family are very warm, inviting people that made us feel at home.

A Maria foi incrível. Recebeu-nos muito bem, o quarto era super confortável, a sala super linda, e deixou-nos à vontade para usar a cozinha e comermos de tudo o que havia, como se estivéssemos em casa. Ao pequeno-almoço ainda tivemos oportunidade de conhecer o filho da Maria, que também foi muito atencioso e simpático. Não há dúvidas de que, quando voltarmos a Lisboa, é aqui que vamos ficar. Obrigada Maria, pelo fim-de-semana.

고민하지 말고 선택하세요. 이곳은 당신의 예상을 뛰어넘는 숙소입니다. 친절한 호스트와 그들의 가족들이 당신을 편안하게 해줄겁니다. 그리고 마리아가 제공하는 모든것들로 인해 당신의 리스본 여행은 완벽해질겁니다.
그리고 집옆 mini presco보다 메트로 옆 my auntes...? 암튼 거기가 더 큼. 여기집 개져음!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

The place is around 9 min to the airport by uber. Maria’s son checked me in, greeted me and familiarized me with the amenities. The room is very clean and looks as described, the patio is amazing from the window of the room. I checked out very early in the morning to catch a flight in the airport, hopefully I didn’t disturb your sleep. As a solo traveler, I highly recommend Maria’s place, and I look forward to visiting again in the future.
Maria is incredible friendly and thoughtful host. Can’t recommend enough! Lovely home and great location (really close to the airport and city centre).
房子的位置非常好，房间非常干净舒适并且有有独立卫生间。Maria是一位非常好沟通的房主，帮我们预定了赶早班飞机的出租车，非常感谢～
It is a beautiful room which is kept extremely clean. We were there for just one night, but everything seemed as described. Had a great stay.

Great place to stay. Right between the airport and the square. The place was spotless and loved all the extra soaps and creams. Was able to make a breakfast and coffee and have it out on the patio before heading out for the day.

We enjoyed our stay in Maria's apartment very much. Maria's greeting was warm and friendly, and she made it clear we had the freedom to use the kitchen, terrace, and even the lounge room. She supplied a wide range of breakfast foods, and when I mentioned a liking for the Portuguese speciality of ricotta cheese and pumpkin jam (on toast, for breakfast!), she very kindly went out and bought some for me. Unfortunately she was busy with her catering business during our time there, so we didn't get to talk to her as much as we would have liked. However, her son Jose is very capable and hospitable, and speaks excellent English, and we enjoyed talking with him. He was particularly helpful in explaining how we coud catch the train to Sintra from the station outside the apartment.
Although a little out of the centre, this apartment is in a quiet residential area mercifully free of tourists, and is only a few minutes' walk from the nearest metro, and from there it is only about 5 minutes to Rossio or Baixa-Chiado. We were not really troubled much by the sound of planes and trains that some other reviewers have mentioned, and they stop between about 12 and 6 anyway. A modest local restaurant, the Sesimbrence, is just across the street, and a small supermarket is up the street a little way. Our only concern was that the bedroom was a little on the small side for two people with two large suitcases.
Ok!😃
Such great hosts. We were made to feel right at home. We loved being able to prepare our own breakfast before heading out on our adventures. A glass of wine on the terrace was wonderful.

Staying at Maria’s was a pleasant experience. The hostess provided us with lots of ingredients to make a lovely breakfast for all the days we stayed in and shared local tips for restaurants and pastry shops in the neighbourhood. The room was also very clean and as described. Overall, we left quite content! :)

We loved staying in Maria’s home! She was very warm and welcoming to us and opened the house up to us as if we were family friends of
theirs. The bedroom was very comfy and clean and we really enjoyed our time there. It’s very close to a metro station which makes it very convenient and easy to get around and see the sights of Lisbon. So glad we chose to stay here.

It's located a very good place because there are two stations(train & Metro) near of the house in 5 min. You can easily access any place using two public transportation. Host will make you be comfortable and help  you anything you want. Also you can be allowed your baggage leave in the house during travel even after check out.

숙소 넘 조아용ㅎㅎ 스페인처럼 대문 열기가 좀 뽝치긴햇지만 그거말고는 다 좋았어요 친절하시거 숙소안에 화장실도 잇구 ㅎㅎ 시내랑은 거리가 좀 있지만 역이랑은 가까웟어욤  I really recommend this accommodation. Since check-in, it's nice to come in person, and the view is fantastic. Maria is always kind and We had a nice breakfast everyday with various yogurt, fruits and so on.

Maria is a superhost. She is very welcoming, friendly and generous and will do whatever in her capacity to accomodate your needs. The space is super clean, stylish and cosy. It is literally 1 to 2 mins away from the bus, train and metro stations and very convenient in terms of services (cafes, restaurants and supermarkets.. Etc. If you are ever in Lisbon, I totally recommend you stay at Maria's.. Thanks a lot for hosting us
Belle emplacement. Habiter chez Maria on se sent chez nous. A 5 minutes du métro à pied. La cuisine est fonctionnel et on a pu l’utiliser. Maria est une hôtesse exceptionnelle.
mooie plek om Lissabon te verkennen. zeer gastvrij gezin.

Maria’s place is wonderful. Located in a safe, easy-to-access neighborhood (less than 5 min walk from the subway), the apartment has a lot of character and great colors. We really enjoyed our stay, and will be happy to return!

I had been felt that I was staying at my lovely aunt’s house. (Feels like home)
Maria’s place was so comfortable and I liked the decorations. We also could use her kitchen and living room.
You can easily access to the city centre by metro and only takes 10-12minutes. Also only 8-10 minutes away from Lisbon airport.
Very nice room!

I couldn’t haven’t picked a better place to stay in Lisbon! It was my first time in the city so Marias was a comfortable home base for me to explored, located in between two metro stops. The neighborhood was quiet and close to the airport, but only a few minutes away from restaurants and nightlife. Maria and her two sons are very accommodating and even let my friend in when we accidentally got separated. There was always coffee, yogurts, fruit and toast to snack on. Overall a great place to stay!

It was so easy and nice to have the accommodation by Maria's home. Everything went like agreed. The room was beautiful and very clean. The location was perfect. Easy to go by metro to the city center and very early in the morning by taxi to the airport. Tt was only 15 minutes by taxi to the airport and about 8 euros. I can highly recommend Maria's place.
Outstanding location and super host. Close to downtown and cultural sites. Maria and her family are wonderful hosts.
Maria一家非常热情地接待了我们。我们的房间非常干净整洁，后院布置的也非常有格调，厨房很干净，设施也非常齐全，你可以用冰箱里的任何东西。Maria的房子非常靠近地铁站，出行很方便，同时和很适合坐早班飞机的人。
logement bien placé, très propre. peu d'échange avec les hôtes

These three days we felt like home. Our room was small, but Maria even got extra bed for our little girl and treated her with presents. At home and kitchen we had everything we need, also inclooded breakfast. Maria is very welcoming and beautiful woman and we where really glad to meet her and her sons. And she had really nice terrace with plants. Thank you for everything and see you next time. Adele, Eliza, Inese

Maria’s plane was sparkling clean, beautiful, and very artsy. Her son Antonio welcomes us at the door, kindly showed us the place, offered us anything we may like from the kitchen which was fully stocked including delicious Porto wine, suggested places to visit, and made sure we had everything we needed. There was more than enough hot water in the shower which I’m always very grateful for. The bed was very comfortable, the blankets plenty, and a space heater was provided in case we wanted to be cozier. I could hear overhead airplanes and underground trains but found it very endearing for some reason! The place is 5 minutes from the airport vía Uber/Kapten for only 5 euros and walking distance to many good restaurants! We loved Fish Tail, try it!! All in all a great experience.

Maria was super accommodating for me even though I was spending less than a day in Lisbon, she set up the room very nicely and greeted me outside & gave me a tour of the apartment. Super cute & spacious bedroom with a private attached bathroom!

Nous avons été ravie par la maison de Maria qui était très propre et joliment décorée. Nous avons apprécié les équipements, la terrasse, le piano et la cuisine où nous pouvions nous servir librement pour le déjeuner. Très proche de la station de métro, il a été facile d’aller au centre.

시내에서 지하철 몇 정거장 거리에요.
시끄러운 시내에 비하면 너무 조용하고 평화로운 곳입니다. 완전히 내집이다~ 하고 지내실 수 있게 편하게 해주셔요. 딱히 귀찮게 하고 그런 것도 아니고 정말 편하게 잘 해주십니다. 방 시설, 청결, 와이파이 모두 완벽했어요. 화장실에 샴푸랑 바디샴푸, 바디로션 다 냄새도 너무 좋고요.. 리스본 올 때마다 묵고 싶어요.

Maria is friendly and helpful. She made me feel very welcome. The bedroom and bathroom are clean and cozy. The apartment is close to the metro and in a quiet, safe area. I really liked the patio area and artwork in her home as well. Such a lovely place and close to the airport!
We had a very pleasant stay at Maria's place. It's a nice, clean room with a good bathroom. There is a train station and a metro station nearby, which was very convenient.
Very convenient location.
Prima verblijf!
Location is perfect for an early flight at the airport! Clean room & your own private bathroom! Just what I needed after traveling for two weeks!
정말좋습니다.
It is very good located near to metro station and you are in the centrum of city for few minutes. It is also near by airport. Maria and his family was very friendly and helpful.

The apartment is cosy and convenient! Maria and her family have a good taste of art and made the room so lovely! We were free to use the kitchen, and the refrigerator was full of drinks and snacks! Though it is not in the very center of the city, the metro station is just 5 mins walk and you can get to major tourist area in 20 mins. We enjoy our stay in Lisboa, Obrigada!
지하철역이 가까워서 편하게 이동할 수 있었고, 호스트도 매우 친절했습니다. 방에 화장실이 딸려있어서 편리하게 사용했어요. 조식도 부담없이 먹을 수 있어서 좋았습니다. 적극 추천합니다.
Great place to stay, perfect location with easy access to Metro, close to Airport.  The host (Maria) was excellent and it is a beautiful home.
Great host, easy to access and nice breakfast. Strongly recommend!

La camera è molto graziosa forse un po’ piccolina, ero con il mio compagno, ma per un soggiorno di pochi giorni è perfetta. Maria è molto ospitale, ci ha fatto trovare anche dolci tipici portoghesi preparati da lei. Veramente ospitale
It's wonderful

Maria是一个很棒的房东，美丽，可爱，人很好，她的两个儿子也很有礼貌。房间温馨干净，最好的是有一个独立卫生间，我觉得这点很值得。厨房装备齐全，可以使用一切。如果你想，也可以在自己的房间待一整天。
设施齐全，床很软很舒服，我认为更适合一位旅行者，两个人会比较拥挤。
另外，我觉得订房前你们有必要知道的是地铁线从旁边地下穿过，会听见地铁的声音。这很荒谬，难以想象居民每天都会有感觉。
晚上地铁少了以后对睡觉毫无影响，但是早上7点左右你很可能再次听见。我习惯早起，也不太敏感所以对我基本没有影响，对我来说房子几乎完美，会选择再次入住，如果你是对声音比较敏感的人，建议多加考虑。

Maria’s place is perfect if you want to be near the airport with easy access to the city. The room was comfortable and clean, and she made sure her son was there to show me around upon my arrival.  I enjoyed my stay. Thanks!

Excellent hospitality! She and her son are so kind when you arrive and provide great recommendations about the city. I also appreciate the fact she makes available her food if you want to make breakfast. I hope to be back in Lisboa soon!

Maria is a great host, she was very friendly and supportive during our stay. The apartment is really nice and classy, the balcony is great for having a nice breakfast in the middle of Lisbon. I can recommend this flat to the fullest and it would be a pleasure staying with Maria and her sons another time.

Nice stay, beautiful, artistic appartment, good communication with airport and city center, big choice for breakfast. I highly recommend Maria and her family. At Maria’s place you will find all what you need to enjoy the Portuguese experience. We could even play Fado music while eating breakfast :-).
Very discrete and respectful . Highly recommended.

Cozy place, very well located, near Metro and train stations.
We enjoyed meeting Zè and Antonio, they are very courteous young men!
Thank you very much,
Liliana Jim

Maria's home is welcoming, comfortable and charming. It is very convenient to public transportation. The metro and buses are within 5 minutes walking. The room was perfect for me, very clean, quiet, well decorated and the bed was comfortable. Maria and her family are very kind and helpful as well. Liosbon is a wonderful place to visit.
Maria and Antonio were so friendly, their place is very clean and comfortable with a good location, next to a metro station. We highly recommend this Airbnb!

We had a lovely stay at Maria’s home. It was very clean and we were made to feel very comfortable, even in the common areas. Maria is extremely friendly and has some lovely lunch tips. Highly recommend staying at Maria’s!

Maria is a very kind person and I was happy to speak spanish with her.
We could eat everything in the fridge, there was pretty much stuff!
We liked the neighbourhood, it is not too touristic.
We would go there again!
Maria's place is lovely, so many nice amenities.  Nice to stay with a local!

Maria is a wonderful host and an even more amazing cook! My girlfriend and I had a wonderful time in her flat. She was very welcoming and genuinely interested in getting to know us and in turn, a very interesting person to get to know. We will definitely come back to stay with Maria the next time we come back to Lisbon!

Maria and her son are great hosts. Our communication was great. The room and private bathroom in the apartment are very clean and cozy. The bed was really confortable. Very quiet place and adorable apartment. Highly recommended.
We had a great time at Maria's flat. Very friendly family, very good communication, the flat as a whole ans the room are top, in the center of the city and close to a Metro station.
We had a great stay! Maria is very warm and inviting. Her home is lovely. Very close to the metro too.
Nice to be at this place!
Maria was extremely accommodating and went out of her way to make my stay a pleasure. I recommend highly. Fantastic host fantastic Accomodation.

Loved this charming place and the great location is a bonus (close to the centre and the airport). Maria is lovely and enjoyed the hospitality and amenities. Check-in was smooth and exactly the place one needs for a short trip and an early morning departure.
Though I didn't use the kitchen, it has everything you can think of. The entire place was clean and we enjoyed our short and sweet stay here. Highly recommended!
很热情的房东，让我们用厨房里的所有东西做早餐。
房子的位置非常好，距离地铁口很近，离机场也不远，由于第二天要趁飞机离开葡萄牙，因此选了这家，房子装修很漂亮，房间也很整洁，房东和她两个儿子英语都很好，推荐！
Super fijne kamer in een prachtig appartement bij zeer gastvrije mensen. Metro en bushalte op 2 minuten lopen en vlakbij het centrum. Echt een aanrader.

Maria und ihre Söhne sind super Gastgeber! Wir kamen 1,5 Stunden früher an als erwartet und obwohl noch keiner zuhause war stand ihr Sohn 3 Minuten später vor der Tür und hat uns alles gezeigt. Das Zimmer ist klein und süß, man hat ein sauberes eigenes Bad im Zimmer und man kommt in 5 Minuten zur u-Bahn, mit der man auch nur 5 Minuten in Lissabons Zentrum fahren muss. Eine perfekte Unterkunft!
家里很棒的葡萄酒可以同享。

Great location, amazing hospitality and comfortable amenities. The room is stylish and you can open the windows for fresh air at night. The bathroom is clean and the shower has good temperature control. The kitchen is well equipped with everything you need to stay in and cook. They even have a good Porto wine ready for you. The bed is good for one but a bit small for two people. Overall I highly recommend this place!
Very neat apartment with great facilities. good location with easy metro ride to heart of Lisbon. Also easy access to airport
As described, convenient location close to airport. 4-5 euro Uber to airport.
Just as expected no surprises. Close to airport clean and a lovely garden outside !

Habitación y baño muy limpios, ordenados y agradables. El único “pero” es que era pequeño para maniobrar dos personas.
Para la función que necesitabamos, que era hacer noche e ir al aeropuerto pronto, perfecto!
Recomendable muy buena ubicación.
L appartement dispose de tout le confort nécessaire, la chambre communique avec votre salle de bain privé. Le métro est à 3 minutes à pieds.
Thank you Maria for your kindness I felt myself, like in a family! Full trust and support!

Words can’t describe how much I appreciated my stay in Maria’s beautiful home ! The location is good with metro and train very close by. Also very close to the airport. Maria hung out my washing while I had a nap. Every need was catered to. Maria is very motherly which was exactly what I needed after travelling solo for 10 weeks.. reminded me of home ! I had free reign of the kitchen, appliances and food, for breakfast and it was beautiful to sit and relax on the terrace. Maria’s son was very quiet and well mannered. There is a great traditional restaurant on the corner and delicious gelato shop down stairs. Very clean room with a very comfortable bed !!

A very clean room with private bath en-suite and good infrastructure. I was encouraged not only to use the kitchen actively, but also to eat and drink whatever was available in the kitchen and the big and well-stocked fridge. Perfect host!

Apesar de ser uma suíte, achei o espaço um pouco pequeno para duas pessoas. A localização é excelente e mesmo longe dos pontos turísticos, o deslocamento é muito fácil e rápido, pois o metro fica na porta. E para quem está de carro, também existe um parking na mesma rua. O local é bem servido de restaurantes, cafés, sorveteria, supermercado

Maria’s place is very private with access to small garden from the fully equipped kitchen. The bedroom has private bathroom and the bedroom window is facing the garden. The bad room is equipped with extra pillows and blankets. Access to TV in family room is also available.
Apartment has great location, close to subway and train station. On the street, there are two coffee/bakery stores and across, family restaurant with local menu.
The coffee from local stores is fantastic and a dinner from family restaurant across the street was one of the best dinner in Lisbon.
We can highly recommend Maria’s place and her as a fantastic host.
Jolanta
We enjoyed our stay here, the terrace is lovely! We arrived later then our expected check in time due to difficulties at the airport, but they were very accommodating.
Nice place. Great communication.

We were only at this airbnb for one night, but it was exactly what we needed for that night. We needed a place to stay near the airport for an early flight the next morning and this Airbnb more than met those expectations. Maria made sure someone was there to check us in even though we arrived hours earlier than we were supposed to. The Airbnb was very clean and it had a very nice family feel to it. It was exactly what we needed for our purposes and I would recommend it to anyone looking a convenient place near the airport.
Very nice room. Close to the Metro, train and busstation. Would definitely recommend.

Our stay was just great. The place had very clean room, very clean bathroom and it was like home. The greeting was amazing and they helped us alot with tips and to-dos. The place is very accessible by bus or metro or even trains. The location is very helpful. I just can say thank you so much for the amazing stay.

중심가에서 떨어진 신시가지 지역이라 조용힌 동네였고 호스트들은 아주 친절하며 바로 옆 코너에있는 식당도 훌륭합니다.
재숙박 의향도 있습니다.
Foi perfeita pra fazer uma viagem curta. A Maria nos tratou mto bem e os filhos deles tbm. O local eh mto bom e sossego.
Très bon accueil

We had an absolutely perfect stay at Marias, where we just met her sons, who live in the flat and are very kind and helpful. (Thanks for calling the Uber!!) The room was clean and comfortable, we had the little patio for our own and were allowed to pick some things for breakfast out of the fridge. Everyday fresh bread - awesome! Maria even recommended a Fado restaurant (Casa Linhares). The Metrostation (Aeeiro) is nearby (about 3 minutes to walk) - so we had everything we needed for a shorttrip to Lisbon. Thank you, guys, for offering your home to others and being such nice hosts!
We can highly recommend that place.

Maria est un rayon de soleil, acceuil très chaleureux ! Même si nous ne sommes restés qu'une nuit, tout était parfait, nous avons particulièrement apprécié le vin portugais mis à notre disposition pour goûter ;) On recommande sans hésiter !

L'hospitalité de Maria est exceptionnelle. Elle nous reçoit chez elle et elle nous donne accès à tout l'appartement, qui est très chaleureux avec plein de bouteilles de vin
à l'intérieur et des plantes variées dans un charmant coin jardin. On peut utiliser la cuisine pour le petit déjeuner en toute tranquillité. On se sent vite à l'aise chez Maria.
L'appartement se situe entre la gare d'autobus et de train Sete Rios et l'aéroport, juste à côté d'une station de métro qui mène directement au centre de Lisbonne. Le tout est donc très avantageux.

Es war eines der schönsten Orte, die wir sahen. Bei Maria hat man das Gefühl man sei ein Teil der Familie und zuHause. Sie war unglaublich nett, hilfsbereit und kochte sogar etwas für uns. Wir lernten auch einen ihrer Söhne kennen, der sehr nett , kommunikativ und hilfsbereit war. Wenn man wirklich das Feeling des portugiesischen Flairs haben möchte , dann sollte man zur Maria gehen :)

Maria has been a wonderful host,
We arrived late from the plane and she made a tasteful dinner.
It was amazing, a very nice feeling !
Very close to the airport so if you want to have an overnight before leaving or after landing, that’s the perfect spot !
Maria is a wonderful host and her place was really nice. It was clean and it had many amenities. We only stayed one night but would gladly go back and stay longer one day.

Maria is such a lovely host! We only stayed one night with her but wish we had been there longer. The space is very well decorated and felt homey. She gave us full access to the apartment and kitchen and amenities. She bought fresh bread for us and answered all of our questions.
The best host we could wish in a perfect place : thank you Maria !
Maria is a super host! You feel at home within seconds!
Maria is very kind and generous host! She really makes you feel like home. Life in Lisboa is easy thanks to her advices. I definitely recommand her

We had a really great time at Maria’s. Everything was very clean and we could use everything - she let us feel like home. The apartment is directly next to the metro and bus station, so you can be very quick in the heart of the city. We really enjoyed staying there!

Stanza con bagno privato, a 10 min dall’aeroporto e a 5 min dalla metto verde che ti porta al centro. Maria e suo figlio sono stati presenti e ci hanno dato la possibilità di fare il check out ben dopo l’orario standard.

Dejligt sted at bo- morgenmad var inkluderet! Privat toilet og bad var virkelig rart. Søde værter! Området er lidt kedeligt, men metroen er lige udenfor og ellers tager det kun 30-45min at gå ind til byen.

Maria's place was extremely warm and welcoming, my friend and I were greeted kindly into her home. Morning breakfast on the patio and a beautiful, clean space for ourselves. The prime location allowed my friend and I to have easy access to the metro and public transportation. There is nothing bad that I could possibly say about our stay, rather that I would re-book Maria's place in  a heartbeat during my next trip back to Portugal.

Great spot, clean, with a private bathroom and a lovely garden.
Maria was very understanding about us changing our check in time, which we really appreciated. Check in was very smooth, and everything was explained very well.
While the apartment isn't located right in downtown Lisbon, it is only a few minutes from the metro, and is an ~€6 taxi ride to the airport.
Apartamento al detalle, cercano al metro y amabilidad de su dueña
Maria is so nice and the room is perfect!
Very close to the airport. Ideal place to stay if you have an early flight.

Maria is a great host! She gave us very good directions and provided a map of the transit system which was useful. She provided food for us to make ourselves breakfast each morning which was always fresh and delicious. Her place is a short walk to the metro station which was convenient. Private bathroom was a great to have.
Was short but a great stay! Spotless clean and Outstanding hospitality.

We had a great stay at Maria’s place. It is so close to the airport and only cost us €4.50 in an Uber. Antonio (Marias son) checked us in and was very accommodating and helpful. Amenities were great and very clean, everything we needed for our first night in Lisbon. Would thoroughly recommend Maria’s place to anyone.

My brief stay in Lisbon with Maria was a successful one. I love Maria's appartement with the nice patio with green plants & flowers, a nice area to enjoy your personal breakfast or just chill out with a book. The room has a good atmosphere with your personal bathroom, which is important when you stay in a person's home.
Maria & Antonio is easy going people and you don't feel like a stranger at all. They're warm, welcoming and helpful, and make you feel at ease, almost like at home. They both gave me good intstructions: a charming visit to the old city with tram 24, crowded but joyful, winding & bending. Chef Maria knows where you can find delicious Bachalau & fried herring. The only bémol was that I expected an answer from Maria, when I booked three weeks earlier. This faded away getting to know her, anyways she contacted me the day before my arrival, so really no problema..
Maria's appartement is well situated between the airport and the centre of Lisbon, with the metro taking you down-town in 10 minutes. The appartement is calm without noises from the city. Because the lack of sleep on my way to Lisbon I had to recover before I took the evening bus to Ericeira. Maria let me stay for the whole Sunday, since the next Airbnb guest was due in the evening. It's the first time I've experienced such a treat, I'm very thankful to Maria. Don't look any further, you can book Maria's Airbnb with your eyes closed, unless you have to be in the center of Lisbon.
Obrigada Maria, See you next time in Lisbon. All the best from Maya🌺

I travel all over the world and have stayed in many places. Maria was the best ,most helpful ,caring host in the world! She treated me like family and we had many conversations on many topics. She has a beautiful apartment in a real building where Portuguese actually live. It is not an Airbnb hotel where there used to be families!
I cannot even Express how nice the entire experience was for me!
Will stay there again for in for sure!!
this is a very pretty apartment with a kind host. It is just one or two minutes away from the Metro and from there you can get all around the city very easily. I highly recommend this place.
One of the best airbnb :-) just amazing!
Maria is kind and makes you feel welcome. Thanks for hosting!
Everything you need, above and beyond. Perfect place in all ways. Artisitic home and garden patio, close to everything! Amazing details. We absolutely LOVED it!
A very nice room and great host!

Maria's home is warm and welcoming and truly like a home. We were met by her husband and son and they are both delightful hosts. Everything is as described and photographed. The terrace is a real bonus. We only stayed one night but this is one of the places where it would be very comfortable to stay an extended time.
Un petit bout de femme agréable et d  une grande gentillesse
Maria and her son Antoneu were so friendly and generous with us. They gave us a lovely welcome, the room was perfect, and we had a great stay there.

I stayed with Maria twice during my recent trip to Lisbon.  It was a great stay and Maria is a warm and welcoming person.  She was very accommodating to my request for early check-in.  I enjoyed the neighbourhood restaurants especially the gelato next door and Frango Assado around the corner.  I will definitely return if available.
Très bon emplacement près du métro allez y

Ich habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt, sehr netter empfang, familiäres ambiente, bei schönwetter ist die terrasse ein plus!
Nettes frühstück, sehr sauber, nah zur Metro, hat super gepasst, komme gern wieder!

I stayed at Maria's couple of times during my recent trip to Lisbon.  Excellent location with great local restaurants and very close to Areeiro Metro station and airport.  Maria is very hospitable and her place is very nice for a single or a couple.  I appreciated the access to her kitchen and also her generosity with amenities in her home.  I would definitely stay at her place again if available.
房子靠近公共交通，整个空间充满设计感，又很有生活气息，设施一应俱全，有一个超赞的露台，但是因为下雨没能在外面brunch；房东Maria一家很热情，很开心住在这里～

Maria vous accueille comme si vous étiez de sa famille et vous vous sentez chez vous de suite . La chambre est très confortable , proche de l’aéroport avec tout l’équipement nécessaire ! À refaire sans hésiter
Maria has a lovely room  with bathroom in her beautiful house. It is a bit out of the busy areas but those areas are easily to reach by metro or bus. Ideal if you like to keep it quiet at night.
Chambre agréable mais à proximité d'une gare

Abbiamo soggiornato solo una notte. Maria è una persona molto disponibile e pronta ad aiutarti per qualsiasi cosa. Ci ha anche consigliato un ottimo ristorante dove abbiamo mangiato benissimo. Consigliato
Spectacular place! Close to everything. Bus, subway and train. Place is cute and clean and Maria is very nice and caring. Would recommend a million times over

Maria ‘s place was very good for us, we loved that it was clean and white sheets and towels, we felt like in hotel :), she has everything you need in the kitchen, it is quite close to underground like 200m and it take you directly to center in 15min, also very close to airport about 10 min by taxi and it was only 5€ with Uber....
Maria let us do early check-in about 9am, Antonio, her son met us and he was very nice to explain and to make us feel confortable in their place.......Maria is an outstanding host, I highly recommend !!!
Thank you again!

Maria is a wonderful host: she is really hospitable and friendly. The place itself is nice and modern: lots of contemporary pictures, piano and so many books! Also I was truly amazed by the kitchen amenities: Maria was so kind to share the space without any limitations, which was truly appreciated. The guest room has a private bathroom, which is very comfortable. Everything inside the room is clean and tidy, but with a slight hint of sunny Lisbon spirit :) Truly recommended! The apartment is easily accessible by metro (just a few stops from all central sightseeings) and taxi (from and to airport), and there are several shops nearby. By the way, the terrace is very useful to enjoy a sip of Porto and just relax. Thank you, Maria, for such a welcome stay! We would definitely come again with pleasure.

Das Zimmer mit eigenem Badezimmer in Marias Wohnung war perfekt. Und sie selbst und ihr Sohn waren ausgezeichnete Gastgeber, die uns stets gute Tipps gegeben haben. Deswegen konnten wir ganz frei die Küche, Wohnzimmer und Terrasse nach belieben mitbenutzen. Auch die Lebensmittel in der perfekt ausgestatteten Küche standen uns zur Verfügung, was außergewöhnlich toll war! Die Gegend war ebenso ausgezeichnet, mit hervorragenden Zugang zu den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln wie Bus, Metro und Bahnhof/Zug- alle nur einen Steinwurf entfernt! Jedoch hörte man auch die vorbeifahrende Straßenbahn, was uns jedoch nicht sosehr gestört hat. Alles in allem ein tolles Zimmer für 2 Personen, mit WG-Feeling und einer super Gastgeberin. Gerne jederzeit wieder!

Maria was so welcoming and friendly, and offered up her kitchen and all the items inside for me to use! The room itself was very clean and neat, and having the bathroom inside the room was a huge plus (she even had toothbrushes and toothpaste available)! It is very close to a metro station that takes you directly to the main shopping/tourist area. The surrounding area is not as tourist-heavy, which is nice because it's much quieter.
