She let me check in and check out earlier because of my flight arrangements, which I greatly appreciated.

Absolutely perfect place. I’ve stayed there in Lisbon only one day during a long layover. I was traveling with my daughter and have never been to Portugal before. Maria and her sons made sure the stay was as enjoyable as possible. Having breakfast ingredients was great especially during such a short stay!
Location was fantastic. Few min away from the airport and only few metro stops from the center of the city.
Thank you Maria!

Arieero 역에서 가깝고 숙소 옆에 마트가 있어서 장보고 음식하기 좋아요 ^^ 주인 분 진짜 좋고 아들이 주로 집에 있어요 ^^ 둘째아들 진짜 착합니다 ㅎ 방이 둘이쓰기엔 살짝 작은 느낌이 들긴 하지만 괜찮앗어요 ㅎ 주방이 너무 좋아서 여행 내내 하루 한끼이상 숙소에서 요리해먹었네요 ㅎ 다만 겨울에는 많이 추울것 같아요 _ 라디에이터하나잇는데 비가 마니오고 그러니 습하고 춥고 그러더라구여 ㅎㅎ 샤워기 너무 조아요 ㅎㅎㅎ 따뜻한물 잘 나오고 ㅎㅎ 리스본 여행내내 숙소때문에 불편했던건 없었습니다 ㅎㅎ 추천해요 !!

Maria und ihre Söhne sind sehr freundliche Gastgeber. Wir konnten den Checkin und Checkout ganz flexibel gestalten, alle Lebensmittel in der Küche konnten selbstverständlich mitgenutzt werden. Man fühlte sich nicht zu Gast, sondern Zuhause. Einzig: Die Unterkunft ist recht laut, da man regelmäßig die U-Bahn unter oder ein Flugzeug über dem Apartment rattern hört.
Die Kommunikation mit Maria verlief problemlos! Leider konnten wir sie nicht persönlich kennenlernen, aber ihre Söhne waren sehr nett! Zu empfehlen!

Maria’s home is beautiful, located in an easily accessible neighborhood, and her home itself is a treat to be in. Her and her family are so hospitable, they treat their guests like family and makes us feel at home. It was really a pleasure to stay with her.
Nice room, clean and good localisation to visit the town.
A very thoughtful and genuine host. The place was in great condition and we were made to feel like an extension of the family.
Very conveniet place.Easy to find.The hosters r very kind and generous! We feel like at home.Thank Maria and  her two handsome sons! Recommand 100%.

Vraiment sympa la chambre, l’accueil même très tard et les petits déjeuners en self-service sont top ... la localisation est sans problème et quand on trouve plus de place pour se garer on a un excellent parking á proximité. Je reviendrais, pour profiter un peu plus de la terrasse á la belle saison...

Super séjour chez Maria qui a été très arrangeante et nous a laissé poser nos valises dès notre arrivée tôt le matin. Le logement est idéalement situé entre l'aéroport (bus direct) et le centre ville. Accueil parfait !

Maria is a beautiful woman with a warm generous heart. She works as a private chef and her passion is cooking. This app it is shared with her two university aged sons who were quiet and equally helpful. Maria lives nearby in another apt with her Dona’s stepfather. She is in and out throughout the day cooking for her clients and sons. She very generously shared her kitchen with me in a hospital fashion. This is a very comfortable setting to base your exploration of Lisbon. You will find Mario to rank in the range of best of super hosts. Enjoy.

Maria is the most welcoming host and provides an excellent space. The room is cozy and has an attached bathroom. I was only in Lisbon for the night with a long layover and this was the perfect location for it, as it was right next to transit. I would most definitely stay here again.
La chambre est simple mais Maria est très gentille et accueillante et elle à un dons pour la cuisine et la pâtisserie.
我住过的最棒的airbnb

그녀는 친절하고,
숙소는 완벽하며,
우리의 휴일은 즐거울수밖에 없었습니다.

I stayed here alone for about 10 days. Maria is a great host, the room is small but as pictured and fine for one person. Really appreciated having my own bathroom. Also appreciated having food for breakfast available in the kitchen. The only annoying thing is that there was a lot of construction noise in the building during the day (Not the host’s fault, of course) and also be aware that the metro runs right under the building so that was also kind of loud. Other than that, this was a great find if you want to be in a more residential area but close to a metro.

Maria is very nice and welcoming, like a relative you haven’t met before. The room was tidy, has it’s own bathroom, and has everything you need, including a heater (my stay was in December). It’s close to the public transportation, restaurants and the airport so it’s perfect for the days at the beginning or end of your trip and exploring Lisbon. It was nice to stay in a real family home for a change. She has a great artistic touch that lends a lot of character to the apartment.

Maria's place is clean, cozy and  comfortable. The private roon with the private bathroom is well organized. The host is very friendly and fast in replying to questions. She kindly asked me to use the room and the common area just like my home. I enjoyed making my breakfast with the sufficient foods (provided by Maria) in the kitchen. Her place is close to the airport (bus # 705 or taxi for around $13 in a rush hour), IST (Instituto Superior Técnico) and the city center. You can take a metro from the airport, but you need to change Metro lines (Red to Green). Maria's place is on the same floor as the building's entrance. So you don't need to walk up stairs!  The neighborhood is peaceful and also convenient with a few cafes, restaurants and grocery stores. If you'd like to avoid the hustle and bustle of Lisbon's city center but stay close to it in a clean, cozy, comfortable, convenient place, you can find a perfect match in Maria's place.
Comfortable place in a good location

Un superbe acceuil de maria et son fils antonio!tres bel appartement bien situé !chambre agreable et petite salle de bain impecable!et a proximité des transports!juste dommage pa de chauffage dans l.appartement !
I can recommend this place!
Local muito bem localizado, perto de transportes, limpo, acolhedor e só tivemos pena de não ter aproveitado para desfrutar do pequeno almoço no terraço!

If you are looking for a place close to the airport and close to down Lisbon via metro, Maria's place is perfect! Clean, beautiful, and wonderful breakfast. Maria, we hate we couldn't meet you in person, but thank Antonio for the wonderful conversation and to you for the wonderful meal!
A beautiful place! Maria is very nice and accommodating. She allowed me to check in at 9 am.
Great

Sehr gute Lage, und die Gastgeber waren sehr freundlich und unterstützend. Wir haben lecker gekocht und auf der schönen Dachterasse in der Sonne gesessen. Die Gegend ist sehr angenehm und verfügt über gute Einkaufsmöglichkeiten.
A perfect location for getting into the city centre and to the airport. Maria was great and very welcoming.  A great experience. I would definitely return.

Nous avons réservé une nuit à l’appartement de Maria. Bel accueil de son fils. Tout était parfait. Maria est passée un peu plus tard et elle est très gentille. La chambre était parfaite et très propre avec salle de bain privée. L’appartement était tout équipé et tout était à notre disposition. Quel appartement chaleureux et très belle famille aimable! J’y retournerai sans hésiter et je recommande fortement!

Accueil très chaleureux et généreux : nous en avons été touchés.
Logement hyper bien situé : à 5 minutes du métro et d'une gare, d'une facilité inégalée pour les excursions à Queluz ou Sintra (à recommander!). On entend le bruit des trains, mais cela n'empêche pas de dormir.
Autres points appréciables : la terrasse, la cuisine hyper équipée, la salle de bain privée.

Die Kommunikation mit Maria war freundlich und sie war sehr gut zu erreichen. Die Wohnung ist gut gelegen, schön eingerichtet und die Küche super ausgestattet.
ABER: Wir empfehlen Menschen, die größer als 1,80m sind, eine andere Unterkunft zu buchen, denn das Bett ist kürzer als herkömmliche Betten!
Ansonsten war aber alles gut, WG Feeling inklusive.
Beautiful, clean and quiet apartment very close to the airport - perfect!!

We werden gastvrij ontvangen. Mochten keuken en huiskamer gebruiken. Wat nog het fijnste was het terrasje en omdat we mooi weer hadden hebben we hier veel gebruik van gemaakt. Kamer was niet groot maar wel een eigen badkamer. Alle ruimtes waren ook heel schoon. Maria besteed aan zowel schoonmaak als inrichting veel aandacht. Zeker een aanrader.
Maria is an excellent host. My husband and I would have loved to stay longer in her place. But we'll be back and we'll surely recommend it to our family and friends!
Maria and her son were so kind. The house and the room was very comfortable and clean. The apartment is very close to the metro that takes you right downtown.
Très belle appartement
We were warmly welcomed and had a great time! The flat is clean and well located - just what we needed.
Clean, bright & airy apartment perfect for a short stay in Lisbon. Friendly host.
Kan rekomendera

Maria's place is perfect if you are looking to spend a couple days in Lisbon! Her home is a 3 min walk from the train station and a 5 min walk to the metro. The metro makes it simple to get into Lisbon's city center. The room is clean and it has a private bathroom attached. We never met Maria, but her son helped us check in and he was very helpful and polite! Would stay with Maria and her family again in a heartbeat

Eine super schöne und ruhige Unterkunft! Das Zimmer ist zwar klein, aber sehr liebevoll eingerichtet, so wie der Rest der Wohnung auch. Die Lage ist ruhig, aber sehr nah an der Metro, sodass man schnell in der Innenstadt ist. Maria ist eine sehr herzliche und tolle Gastgeberin! Ich kann diese Unterkunft nur empfehlen!!

Our stay at Maria's place was perfect. The airport and the bus terminal are really close - but if you want to go downtown our in the city center, you have to take the metro. The breakfast was really nice, Maria has everything and you can enjoy your breakfast in the small garden - just perfect :)
Maria and her sons are so friendly and helpful. Thank you for everything! :)
Due to a scheduling error on our part we weren't able to stay in Maria's lovely home which was too bad as we were so looking forward to it!

We only stayed with Maria for 1 night but it was the perfect stop for us. It was walking distance to bus stops and the Metro trains. There is a nice Portuguese restaurant, bakery, supermarket and a well-recommended gelato store all within the same block of Maria's place. Her home is so cozy and clean. Our room was a little tight for 2 people with 2 large luggages but we love that it has its own bathroom. We were looking to add more days to our reservation but the days we wanted were no longer available. Thanks Maria for the warm welcome!!

Besser hätte man es sich nicht wünschen können! Maria ist eine der nettesten Personen, die wir bisher kennengelernt haben! Die Wohnung ist suuuper schön und das Zimmer auch! Man hat ein eigenes Badezimmer und Frühstück auf der Terrasse :)
Es war definitiv der beste Airbnb Aufenthalt den wir bisher hatten und wir hatten schon einige 😄

Maria place is as shown in the photos.  It is much like a B&B where you have a bedroom with an ensuite but you cook your own breakfast from the food provided.  There is a lounge area that you can relax in to read or watch TV and there is a patio to enjoy as well.  Maria was kind enough to pre-order a taxi so we could catch our early morning flight and generously gave us a bottle of lovely red wine to drink our last night in Lisbon.  If you were spending more than a night or two in Lisbon this place may seem a bit small but  it served us well for the short time we were there.  Its close proximity to the Areeiro metro station on the green line is very handy for trips to downtown Lisbon and to the airport.

La casa de María esta muy bien comunicada, cerca del aeropuerto, del centro y de la estación de tren para ir a Sintra. Nos han recibido con mucha amabilidad y nos hemos sentido como en casa. Ambiente muy tranquilo.

We loved the location which was very close to the metro. Our host was very helpful and made every effort to make our stay comfortable. The room is very clean but a little too cosy for 2 people with big luggages.
What a warm and welcoming home.  Maria made you feel like you were a part of her family.  It will always be a special memory!
Convenient location for the airport, we stayed for only 1 night and left early in the am for the airport. I was able to have some fruit and yogart from the stocked kitchen.
Maria is the best hostess ever. Very kind and friendly and would recommend her place 110%

Excelente opção. Minha primeira vez alugando um quarto através do Airbnb e o resultado foi acima de minhas expectativas. Fui muito bem recebido e o quarto é bastante confortável. O endereço está a apenas 200m do metro. Ambiente agradável e anfitriões muito simpáticos. Recomendo muito!

La habitación se encuentra en un barrio Lisboeta en un ambiente familiar, barrio  tranquilo, se escucha el metro pasar pero todo perfecto. Cambiamos horario de llegada en el último momento y María gestionó la llegada. No disfrutamos del breakfast al irnos temprano pero el cuarto es perfecto con baño propio y muy limpio. Nosotros íbamos con coche y es fácil aparcar en la misma calle.

Superb apartment which is very clean and beautiful. The sons of Maria have given us a very good welcome and have helped us a lot. We have not seen much Maria but she is adorable.
I recommend this charming house and their very nice hosts.

All communications with Maria were efficiently handled. Check- in with Maria's friend Lena was also as promised. However we were never informed before arrival that Maria was going to be on holiday and that we would be totally unhosted. This is not an issue for us if that is what we book but reviews say much about Maria's hosting abilities and that is what we expected. Additionally, we were never informed at check-in that Maria's youngest son was there st the same time and only found out that someone was there from the noises we heard from his room. Maybe he's shy but we never saw him and he never introduced himself. We assumed there was another guest and only found out who it was when Maria's oldest son turned up the following evening from holiday and told us he was hosting us in Maria's absence. We never saw him again before we were scheduled to leave the following morning at 10am. All in all it was a rather surreal experience after 21 hours flying from Perth, after which we were somewhat jet-lagged, which probably didn't help our 'ghost host' experience.
The room itself was perfectly clean and tidy, with a comfortable bed and decent shower and there was a small patio to sit on and also a lounge. We obviously had free use of the kitchen as we were seemingly alone but didn't bother cooking in what is obviously a "cook's kitchen". There was also plentiful coffee for the machine and a few things for breakfast.
After this somewhat surreal introduction to Lisbon, we might well consider booking again but would clarify that a hosted accommodation actually has a real host.

Great location from which to explore Lisbon. Very private, quiet and calm - a nice respite from the city center but still very close to enjoy all the sights. It's great to be able to be in a less touristy neighborhood. The apartment is very clean and beautiful. Wonderful patio on which to enjoy a morning coffee! Although its just one room in the apartment it feels like you have it all to yourself. Maria was a wonderful host and made things very easy on our arrival and departure.

Thanks to both Maria and Lena for such a short by lovely stay in Lisbon. The apartment was lovely and we'd highly recommend it to anyone looking to stay in Lisbon.

We stayed at Maria's place for only one night as we had a stop over in Lisbon. I asked her if it's ok that we check in earlier as we landed in Lisbon in the morning and wanted to leave our luggage in the apartment so that we can use the rest of the day to explore Lisbon. Maria replied that an early check-in is not a problem and I should just send her a message once we're at the airport. We did so and drove to the apartment. Once we were there, we didn't really know where to ring, as there we no names listed at the house, so we tried to call Maria. We tried several times but couldn't reach her, so I left a couple of message on Airbnb, Whatsapp and sent a text, to notify that we would like to enter the building but were clueless where, when and how. As we had our luggage with us, we had to find lockers in one of the metro stations, which was overall a little bit of a hassle, as the city was crowded with backpackers who had the same idea.
Two to three hours later, I finally received a message from Maria on Airbnb (luckily I had data roaming) that we should meet her friend at the apartment later in the day. It was at first still not very clear how and when to meet her, as we tried to reach her friend on the phone but the number Maria gave us wasn't working.
We finally managed in the evening, after receiving more info from Maria (apparently she was traveling herself), to enter the building. We didn't meet her friend, but one of her two sons opened the door for us. He was very friendly and showed us the apartment.
I can see that a lot of people had a very positive experience with Maria, so I guess this was an exception in terms of check-in arrangements. I would still recommend this Airbnb as the place was very nicely decorated and cosy, however, the complicated check-in made our day in Lisbon significantly more stressful.

Absolute stellar location. Besides that, we loved the place. We had everything we needed, from dishwasher to washing machine. Also, a really nice spacious bathroom that even had 2 sinks. Great loft style apartment. Amazing location, great cafes and restaurants around the area. Friendly hosts and very flexible with check in times

Fantastic place to stay. Would definitely consider it again

Hugo was very responsive in communication. Apartment was clean and spacious and in a central location. Would definitely stay again!!

We had a smooth and perfect stay in Lisbon with the help of Hugo and his mother. They were always ready to help and made everything clear. They were always so thoughtful.

Wer direkt im Herzen von Lissabon übernachten möchte ist hier genau richtig. Super loft, très bien placé ! Idalya la maman est très sympathique et rassurante !

Sehr netter Kontakt, immer hilfsbereit und flexibel auch wenn es kein persönlicher Kontakt vor Ort war. Super flexibel beim Check in und Check out. Die dachschräge ist für große Menschen speziell. Estuvimos 4 días en invierno y no tuvimos que poner el aire acondicionado en ningún momento. Cocina totalmente equipada. Y la ubicación, increíble. No se me ocurre una mejor. En pleno centro pero una vez en el apartamento no escuchas nada. El único “pero” es que quizás para personas no en forma, o de cierta edad, el subir las escaleras pueda ser un poco incómodo. Para nosotros perfecto: ¡hay que hacer ejercicio!

Особенно рекомендую тем, кто хочет погрузиться в атмосферу жизни в мансарде европейского города. Это непередаваемое)) Все остальное перечислять бессмысленно. Квартира прямо на площади Россио. Все достопримечательности в шаге. Отдельное спасибо за информационное сопровождение, особенно в то время как начали отменять рейсы в связи с коронавирусом. В минутах ходьбы рестораны, кафе и супермаркет для тех, кто предпочтет ужин при свечах!!! Еще раз спасибо хозяевам.

This property is in a fantastic location for exploring Lisbon on foot (and via local transport). The airport bus stop is just a 2 minute walk to the Airbnb from Rossio Square. The apartment itself is top floor (without a lift) and is a great hub space to sleep, eat and refresh.
Communications via WhatsApp are also fantastic! This really helped us during the emergence of the COVID-19 issues.

Vous serez séduit par cet appartement idéalement situé et très bien équipé. Il est d'une propreté irréprochable et d'un bon confort. L'accès au 4ème étage sans ascenseur est un peu sportif, mais sa localisation au cœur de la ville le compense largement. Les seuls bémols sont le bruit (essentiellement les véhicules dans la rue) et le manque de fenêtre/velux dans la pièce principale. Pour tout le reste c'est parfait, de l'accueil aux équipements.

Hugo's apartment is exactly what I wanted; spacious, clean, comfortable and easy to get to. The check-in process was easy and stress-free. The amenities were excellent and overall it was a very nice stay in a very nice apartment. Would definitely recommend.

Wir hatten eine tolle Zeit in Lissabon. Das Apartment was suuuppeeerrr zentral gelegen! Sehr zu empfehlen. Alles war um die Ecke - Shopping Meile, Restaurants! Einfach alles! Man sollte nur beachten, dass das Apartment im 4. OG ist, für diejenigen, die vielleicht nicht ganz fit sind. Das Apartment hatte alles was man braucht! Eine klare Weiterempfehlung! :-)))

値段が安く、便利なロケーションにあるのがとてもよかった！
コーヒーマシンが使えたのも助かりました！
The location is really great and the host was very friendly. I will choose again if I come back to Lisbon.

A very stylish place at the heart of Lisbon's old town and close to transport, day tour meetup points and other local attractions. The kitchen was well stocked with coffee and tea facilities, the beds provided for were comfy and the place overall was great. It's a bit of a climb up to the top floor but it's no issue to me and my friend. There's also no window but it wasn't really bother. Given it's an attic I think they really maximised the place's useable space.
I appreciate Idalia for checking up on us every now and then. That was really thoughtful.
On a personal note, I also appreciate that they have a Philips Thermoprotect hairdryer in the bathroom. I have the same hairdyer back home which I couldnt bring to my travel. I was really happy when I saw it :D
Highly recommend this place to any traveler who wants to stay in the middle of the action. Would drfinitely stay here again!
Eğer uzun boyluysanız ve asansör kullanmak durumundaysanız önceden emin olarak teyit etmenizi öneririm.
The apartment is really lovely with great location and almost everything we need. Idalia and Hugo is very helpful. Would recommend it to anyone visiting Lisbon!

Nice host with very useful information. The location is perfect in Lisbon’s old town and quite near to metro & main square. It’s more like an attic and sometimes it’s not easy to stand in the kitchen or bathroom but generally it’s a pretty good apartment!
너무 만족합니다. 다만 4층이기 때문에 무거운 짐을 갖고 움직이는 것은 힘들 것이라 생각합니다. 그것 말고는 정말 좋습니다.

Amazing place and really beautiful!me and my girlfriend was satisfied to the fullest.  It was close to so many things and their tips for places and food was a really nice touch. Hospitality was top notch

We stayed 6 days with our 10 months old baby and loved it! The loft is ideally located to discover Lisbon, it's close to all transportation and to the main sights of the city. The loft itself was very comfortable and surprisingly calm considering the location. Perfect for families.
We didn't actually meet Hugo and Idalia but exchanged via text and Idalia was really nice and helpful.
Very lovely host. Very accurate indications and it was an amazing place!
Love everything about this place and you can find anything you need here! :) Host is always contactable as well! Enjoyed it 😊
Lovely space right in the heart of Lisbon! The loft ceiling can be a little tricky for tall guests, but the cool space and great amenities more than make up for it.

Hugo's apartment is perfect to visit Lisboa. It is central, near the public transport and it is perfc, nothing is missing!
I recommend this cozy loft for your perfect stay in Lisboa!
위치 좋고 대형마트 가깝고 길에 위치해서 치안도 좋고 다좋은데 제일 꼭대기 층에 있어서 캐리어 끌고 올라가기 너무 힘들어요 ... 중간에 쉬었다가 올라가야함 여성분들은 진짜 체크인 체크아웃 힘들거같아여 근데 온수도 잘나오고 세탁기 있고 다락방 갬성 느끼시려면 좋습니다 넓구요 !! 위치는 일단 너무좋아여

The location of this apartment is great! The hosts are very responsive and the apartment is very nice. The only thing to notice is that if you are a tall person, it might be a bit tight. I am relatively tall and the sloped ceilings proves to be a bit difficult.
Great stylish apartment that is right in the heart of the city.  Hugo and Idalia kept in contact with me at all times and were very informative throughout our stay.

Great place and unbeatable location. I’ve met Idália at the check in. She is very kind and helpful throughout my stay. Just a little note that the loft is on the 4th floor so if you like taking healthy way up the stairs like I do, this place is perfect for you. The room is spacious and cute, all amenities are provided. Strongly recommended
It’s a very good location for metro and attractions!

The apartment is located at the very center of the city and it’s really convenient to go anywhere. A lot of eatery and public transportation are available nearby. The place is just as described and very well equipped. Idália was very sweet and helpful every time. The only downside was the unstable electricity and lack of windows. The electricity went completely off a few times while we were staying and we had to stay all night without a light or heater. But Idália took an immediate action for us. Overall we are satisfied with our stay.
Excelente lugar!! Muy cercano de casi todos los sitios de interés y el trato de Idalia y Hugo fue excelente.

Très bon séjour
Situation en centre ville idéale pour découvrir Lisbonne
Un peu bruyant pour moi car j'ai le sommeil léger mais c'est l'unique petit point négatif.

A great apartment in a great location. It was large, comfortable, well appointed and well located. Idalia (Hugo's mother) was very attentive/quick to respond to any queries we had. I would highly recommend it.
Hugo's place is great, perfect location, very comfy and well equipped. I will recommend the place for a comfortable stay near all the major attractions

Hugo and Idália couldn't have been more welcoming and accommodating! We were able to check in early in this great mezzanine apartment. The space couldn't have been better located, right in the heart of Lisbon, close to the metro and train station. It was very clean and functional, good kitchen as well.
As others have noted, there's only one window and since it is a mezzanine, you have to watch sometimes not to bump your head. Small inconveniences compared to all the positives the place offers!

If you’re looking to stay in the heart of Lisbon’s most popular districts, then look no further.
My girlfriend and I stayed for a few nights before flying back to the U.S.
Hugo’s apartment was the perfect spot for us to explore Lisbon’s famous sights.
90% of what we wanted to see was within walking distance (15 min or less).
For everything else, the metro is easily accessible and the airport is only $9USD.
Don’t hesitate to book Hugo’s place today!

Best location, a short walk to anything you need. The hosts were the best I have ever had in all my years of renting from Airbnb. The loft was phenomenal, cozy, very clean, quiet and very well designed, even had a clothes washer/dryer, it was a real pleasure staying there. The hosts, Hugo and Idalia were very kind, and friendly always making sure you I had what I needed. Cannot say enough about how great an experience it was to stay in their place. When staying in Lisbon their places will be the first I will look for, very highly recommended.

This place was awesome! It was in a great location, updated, cozy, and had everything we needed and more. Idalia was easy to communicate with and checked in on us to make sure everything was up to our expectations. Would highly recommend.
One thing I enjoyed was that it was SO quiet compared to other places we stayed in busy areas. It’s on the top floor of the building, so lots of steps to get up but we didn’t mind. There is also only one window which some people may not enjoy. It was nice to not hear the street noise and get a good night sleep. I’m a light sleeper so this was key. The bed was very comfortable. Best bed we stayed in the entire 2 weeks in Portugal.
We were actually able to unpack and not feel like we were crammed in a tiny space. Haha the only thing is if you are tall be careful with some sections of the ceiling. My husband is tall and bumped his head a couple of times.
Overall this place is great and I would highly recommend.

Amazing location and great value for money! Hugo and Idalia’s apartment was lovely.
The apartment was located in the most ideal location. We walk everywhere and it was extremely convenient and central. Close to the several metro/subways, Tram28, and many major attractions and restaurants!
We were NOT bothered by the sets of stairs (no elevator) and the lack of windows since we were out exploring for the most part of the day.
Idalia (Hugo’s mom) is a super host! She checked up on us all the time. She even allowed us to leave our luggage at the apartment / late check out which was super convenient for us to still enjoy our last day of our vacation.
I would highly recommend their lovely home to anyone visiting Lisbon!
This place is located at a perfect spot right in the citycenter. Nice big loft and very clean. The owner was really nice and offered more then just a service! Highly recommend this place.

We had a really good stay at this AirBnB. Idalia's (Hugo's mum) instructions on finding the place was easy to follow (it's not hard to find anyway) - it's a brief walk from the Baixa-chiado metro station. We got in with the provided codes and there was no need to meet with anyone.
We didn't find the loft hot or stuffy. Perhaps a little warm initially but it never took long to cool with the airconditioning and we never needed any cooling once the area was a comfortable temperature.
Just about everthing was provided ... much more than we expected. The list is too long to mention. Though some tea-towels would have come in handy. There was no real noise issue though trams could be heard in the morning ... for us that was not a problem as we are awake early. The bed was comfortable and we slept well.
The location really couldn't be beaten ... it was super convenient to get around. Buses, trams and metro were all within minutes of the place. All the patisseries, restaurants and shops you ever want are close by. In terms of location, you really can't go wrong. It was truly a pleasure to stay here.
Only thing is the 8 flights of stairs, but we managed it at least twice a day and we are in our 50s :-)
Bien situé et propre. Bon accueil. Super!

Location, location, location! This place was perfectly located in the heart of it all. Despite the central location, I wasn't bothered with much noise from the road. Hugo and his mom take special care to make sure that guests are comfortable and have what they need. The space is a combination of traditional and modern, with all the amenities you would expect from a hotel. I really enjoyed my stay and appreciated the speedy communication with Hugo and his mom. I highly recommend you book this place - it won't be available for very long!

Great apartment directly in the city center. All in all everything was thought out and in place, no objections from our side. Perfect fit for couples to spend a few days in Lissabon. Unfortunately there was only one small window available, but as per Huge there is one more planned.
Ten out a ten. Nice appartment at an central place. Good service and communication.

Very friendly host, quick at responding and very helpfull. The apartment is very stylish, clean and well equipped! Location is super very close to metro, bars, restaurants and sightseeing stuff. You can expect a lovely stay!
Great cosy apartment perfect location

Hugo and his mother Idalia were wonderful hosts! They were so kind and attentive, and made our stay very enjoyable. The apartment is great (be warned: it is up five floors of stairs), with a comfortable bed, modern kitchen/bathroom with all amenities, and a powerful air conditioner! The location is also very central in the old town of Lisbon. We would highly recommend staying at Hugo and Idalia’s apartment!

L'appartamento è bello, pulito e ben attrezzato. Hugo e Idalia sono stati cortesi e disponibili, rispondendo entro pochi minuti ai nostri dubbi e assicurandosi che tutto andasse bene durante l'intero soggiorno. La posizione è ottima per visitare la città sia a piedi, sia con i vari mezzi, con le fermate a 2 minuti a piedi.
El alojamiento es muy interesante, inconvenientes: las escaleras son duras y las máquinas de aire acondicionado situadas en el patio, producen un ruido importante.por las noches.

Hugo & Idalia are wonderful hosts! The loft was exactly as described, spotless, and located in the heart of downtown! I absolutely recommend them to anyone looking for a comfortable stay away from home!!
This place was great!

Je recommande sans soucis. Appartement super propre, super bien placé au centre de tout. Toutes commodités au pied de l’appart. Très bonne communication et hôte très réactif et sympathique. N’hésitez pas si vous souhaitez visiter Lisbonne.

Bell’appartamento centralissimo e ben posizionato. In realtà è una piccola mansarda ma è molto ben organizzata. Ha tutto. Ci sono 4 piani da fare a piedi ma in compenso vi ritroverete all’ultimo piano.
This apartment is in an excellent location. The amenities were great and the air conditioning worked very well. The hosts were very communicative and the check in was very easy.

This loft is amazing! It was the perfect "homebase" for a three musketeers trip to Lisbon. Great resources, tastefully decorated and an incredible location. Better than that, Hugo and Idalia are a wealth of recommendations-- their tips came in very handy!

The apartment was super cosy, very pleasant and perfectly situated. We enjoyed the complete description of the apartment and its facilities made  through a guide, in addition to other little guides of the city provided.

This place is amazing! Close to everything in the city center, including the metro station. The apartment was very EASY to find and get in. The apartment has enough kitchen to stay in for a meal if you want or is very close to restaurants, bars, fado, etc. Those traveling to Lisbon with backpacks know that stairs are very typical in the cities, so the walk up four flights of stairs was not a deal breaker for us. Communication was spectacular. I would definitely stay here again!
A really spacious apartment, incredibly stylish and 'cool' and well furnished. Perfect location for a visit to Lisbon & helpful, informative, responsive hosts.

We really had a very nice stay in this apartment! It is so well equipped and the location is amazing! We mostly communicated with Hugo’s mom and she is the sweetest and always answered super fast and nice! Don’t look any further if you’re looking for an apartment in Lisbon centre, this one is perfect!
Prachtige loft in het centrum van Lissabon met veel leuke plekjes in de buurt. Idália en Hugo hebben ons goed geholpen en handige tips gegeven. Een aanrader!

Hugo’s apartment was nothing short of exceptional. I cannot believe for the price we got such a spacious, modern and beautiful apartment. The location of the apartment itself is near on perfect, I doubt there was anywhere more ideally placed. Hugo and his mother were on hand whenever I needed them, but they ensured they gave us as much information as we needed. The newly installed homeit app meant that the stress of remembering codes to get into buildings was also gone. When we got into the apartment as well as it being gorgeous, there was pretty much everything you’d ever need there. I can’t recommend it enough.
Great place , amazing location, very clean and cosy, will definitely go back
The room is very cozy and has everything you need! The location is amazing!

立地が最高。ホストの対応も極めて高い。
ルーフトップ（四階）なのが大変なところだが、それをcompensateするだけのホスト対応と立地と価格でした。

We loved staying in Hugo’s apartment!  Comfortable, well furnished, and warm, and so convenient! A really lovely space.  We felt very well looked after and staying here definitely enhanced our enjoyment of this great city.

We stayed at Hugo's place for two nights. It's a lovely loft a apartment, great location for exploring Lisbon. Hugo very kindly arranged for us to drop off our bags early on our first day too which made our lives much easier. A word of warning, it is up a lot of stairs and there is no lift, making it tricky with large bags! The apartment itself is very modern and has everything you need, just a shame it's so dark I'm there, which I know Hugo is trying to improve by fitting and extra window. The only real downside to the apartment is the bed is quite squeaky and noisy, so we did wake up quite a lot in the night.

Super séjour dans l'appartement d'Hugo.merci à Idàlia qui a communiqué avec nous avant et pendant le séjour.nous n'avons pas vu les hôtes mais ce n'était pas un problème pour nous car tout est très clair et Idàlia s'est bien proposée de nous accueillir.logement très bien situé, proche de tout.propre.très bien équipé.Merci Elodie&Jf

Hugo’s loft is in the PERFECT location for seeing all that Lisboa has to offer. We walked every where we went and felt completely safe while doing so. We found the loft to be plenty comfortable for 3 people, but wouldn’t recommend doing more than 4. Hugo and his mother were always quick to answer our questions and the book provided by Hugo with all the recommendations came in handy! The next time I return to Lisboa I will be sure to book at this airbnb again. Thank you
You may expect a comfortable and spacy, calm place amidst the very centre of historic Lisbon

The apartment was amazing we were met by Hugo’s mum who kindly let us drop our bags off before check in so we could go and explore. It’s so close to everything. It was the perfect place to stay in Lisbon

Logement idéalement situé en plein cœur de Lisbonne, aussi bien à proximité de tous les transports en commun et des restaurants. Il est également proche de nombreux lieux touristiques à pieds. Très facile d’accès depuis l’aéroport. L’appartement est fonctionnel et agréable à vivre. Je le recommande à toute personne qui voudrait visiter cette très belle ville !
Stylish apartment right in the heart of Lisbon. Hugo was a great host! I would recommend his place to anyone visiting Lisbon.

O espaço disponibilizado por Hugo/Dona Idália, sua mãe, é exatamente como foi apresentado. Muito central, facilitando todos os deslocamentos que havíamos previsto (ônibus, metrô e trem). Fomos muito bem recebidos e constantemente Dona Idália comunicava-se  dispondo-se a ajudar. Recomendamos o seu apartamento.

Loft agradável, bem localizado próximo ao metrô, ônibus, tours.
O espaço é totalmente renovado e estiloso. Tivemos assistência e todo o cuidado durante a estadia.
Recomendo.

Hugo’s place was very well located in very city-centre. Everything was so nearby so that we could truly enjoyed ourselves without wasting our time ! And he responded very quickly to my questions and inquiries.

Great place to stay with a great location, very close to everything you might need to have a great weekend.
The place is very well kept, well accommodated and really comfy.
Highly recommend it.
As well Hugo and Idalia have been great hosts!!
Zentraler in Lissabon geht es fast nicht! Das finde ich ein plus dieser Unterkunft.
A lovely, sparkling clean apartment in a very central location.  The hosts were very accommodating, everything we required and more was supplied. Would love to come back and visit again!
Apartamento muito lindo e limpo. Ótima localização, facilita visitar alguns pontos andando.

Excelente ubicación. Cerca de metro, autobús, tranvía, tren y zonas principales de Lisboa. Aunque hay que subir muchas escaleras, lo cierto es que lo haces una vez a día porque solo vas a dormir. El apartamento, en general, todo muy correcto.

무엇보다도 위치가 정말 좋았습니다!
계단이 가파르고 높다는 단점 빼고는 전반적으로 모두 좋았습니다. 샤워 부스에 문이 없다는 점은 살짝 아쉽긴 해요. 하지만 최고의 숙소임은 확실합니다!! 따뜻한 물도 잘나와요.
Wonderful flat and amazing location. Great bed and range of facilities. We had a super trip in Lisbon- would recommend!
A very unique place to stay. Cozy, quite, and clean!
That's what i call hospitality. Always helpful and super accomodating. The place is nice and perfectly located. I'm very fortunate that i booked your place. Thank you very much!
일단 위치가 너무 좋았어요! 바로옆이 호시우 광장이라 버스랑 메트로가 가까이 있고 왠만한 관광지 걸어갈수 있구요. 그리고 친절했습니다! sandra가 짐옮기는거 도와주었어요ㅎㅎ 4층 +반층 더 올라가야 해서 힘든것 빼고는 매우 만족하였습니다. 적극추천해요

This lovely little apartment is right in the middle of lisbon within easy access to the metro and to many local tourist spots. The apartment has everything you need and is clean and tidy, Hugo had also provided some local tips and kept in very good communication throughout.

This appartment ticked every box for us. Amazing price, amazing location, extremely friendly hosts and very good night's sleep. I couldn't possibly find any fault with our stay. We loved the hosts's recommendations for restaurants, views of the city and bars. Do yourself a favour and stay here if you're visiting Lisbon.
Nice place in a cool part of town
Outstanding apartment.lovely place,kind people and a beautiful city. THANK YOU .Made our break extra special
Рекомендуем на 100%. Расположение, сами Аппартаменты и хозяева - все просто идеально.

Hugo and Dona Idália are great hosta! Always worried if everything was great with us. Dona Anabela who open the door to us and gave us the key was very kind. The house is in a great localization, in the heart of Lisbon. And all the communication was easily done and everything easily arranged :) We highly recommended! Ana and Aleks

Séjour à Lisbonne extra. Appartement très bien placé, conforme aux photos et au descriptif, un joli cocon! Hugo a été très réactif, il est très gentil ainsi que sa maman Idalia, et Anabela et Sandra. Merci beaucoup! On reviendra avec nos 3 loulous! Ville extra. On a adoré notre week-end hors du temps!
This is place a fabulous place to stay in the heart of Lisbon. You can walk to everything great. We will be back.
Cet appartement plein de charme est idéalement situé.  Il est conforme à la description. Merci pour votre réactivité et votre accueil !
Hugo’s flat was very cosy, closed to the centre and so nice. We very appreciated the reactivity of Hugo and his relatives were very kind and friendly. I recommend this flat to everyone!

Great place to stay and explore Lisbon. Right in the heart of the city. The place was just exactly as on photos, be prepared to do some stairs to get there but it's worth :) We had no issues throughout the whole stay and we would defintley return.
We had a wonderful time! The place is cozy and fabulous and the location is perfect for exploring Lisbon and beyond.  Thanks again! Ian & Tracy

I really enjoyed my stay at Hugo's apartment. Everything and more was foreseen.
Good communication with Hugo's mom Idalia and friend Sandra.
Highly recommended.
The only negative thing is the fire security, because there is no way out to escape in case of a fire (windows being barred). I know that Hugo wants to place another window, so this can solve this issue.
Perfect location for for exploring the heart of Lisbon! The place is perfect for one or a couple. It was impeccably clean and very comfortable.

Je recommande à 100% l’appartement !
Il a, en plus d’une localisation IDÉALE (nous n’avons même pas eu besoin de prendre de ticket de tram sauf pour le trajet depuis l’aéroport), un charme fou! Le manque de fenêtre ? Si cela peut gêner certain nous avons adoré être isolé, totalement emmitouflé dans ce petit cocon.
Les hôtes sont adorables ! En plus de parler bien le français, ils ont été très accueillant et réactifs. Ils ont créé un petit livret recensant les meilleures adresses de la ville qui nous a été grandement utile.
Idéal pour un court séjour en couple pour s’immerger dans la culture portugaise.

Very nice loft space in a great location! Within walking distance to lots and was super easy check in process. We definitely worked off all the wine and food with the stairs up to the place. A little dark because there's only one window but we were barley in the space! Cute decor and newly renovated kitchen and bathroom.
Great location. Great host. Beautiful place. Would highly recommend. Next time I’m in Lisbon I’ll definitely be back!!
Many, many stairs up to room. No windows but great location.

This place was perfect!
location, facilities, cozy place, clean and you have everything you need!
Hugo’s friend helped us to check in and she was so warm.
just one thing, there are no elevator as the place is on 4th floor, that is some hard part with your luggages.
But I highly recommend and love to come again;)

The place was great. It had everything we needed. We had a little issue with the shower drain and the problem was taken care of immediately. The best location possible to stay in Lisbon. It’s a bit noisy but it quietes down after 11 pm. If you have heavy luggage consider the walk upstairs since there is no elevator. It worked perfectly fine for us since we had small luggages. Overall it’s an awesome place to stay.
Un petit joyau au cœur de Lisbonne, dans le quartier le plus merveilleux qu'il soit. A voir à tout prix. Merci Hugo
Wie erwartet ein Apartment im Herzen von Lisabon! Sehr gut geeignet für einen Städtetrip zu Zweit!

The appartement is great located (which was the main reason for us to choose it) and is looking nice. There is only one window, but this worried us not too much as we were only for sleep in the appartement. The communication was very smoothly, Hugo/Idália provided a good description how to reach the appartement. Also the check out was flexible, we could leave our luggage some more hours in the appartement after the official check out time as the next guests were arriving later on.
So all in all a good accomodation in a perfect location.

The apartment is exactly like it's shown on the pictures. It met all expectations.
It's perfect located in the heart of Lisbon. The only minus point of this apartment: It isn't the most silent one. Sometimes you have loud sirens and have some Aircraft noise. For us it wasn't a problem because the bed was a dream and we slept like queen and king.
The apartment included some exercise :) cause it's in the 4th floor and it's quite challenging with big luggage.
The communication with hugo was great. He recommanded us so many restaurants and markets. At the checkin and out we didn't met Hugo, but Anabela and Suzana were also very friendly and helpful.
A big plus was that we could leave the luggage an hour longer than the checkout in the apartment.
We've always eaten in restaurants but the kitchen is good equiped and there is a supermarket just a few minutes away.
It was a great stay and if we visit Lisbon again we'll definately book the apartment a second time.
Thanks for having us.
Great location and very kind hosts! The stay was great.
Très beau loft dans sa forme mais fenêtre manquante, manque de lumière, et d'air frais

This was a stylish and comfortable apartment very centrally located. It was on the top floor for of a 5 story building the ceiling was slanted and low in some parts but the apartment was nice and had everything we needed. The bed was also very comfortable and the host was responsive.

Super sweet Airbnb that is a stone's throw from the buzz of Lisbon. Be it shopping, night life, main city points - this Airbnb delivers not just on location and style but also on hospitality and responsiveness. I never stay in the same Airbnb but I'd go back here!
Perfect location to visit lisbon.

Hugo´s Appartment ist super!!! Wir wurden sehr herzlich empfangen und betreut während unseres Aufenthaltes. Wir haben tolle Tipps zu Lissabon bekommen und uns direkt von Anfang an wie zuhause in Hugo´s Appartment gefühlt.
Es war sauber und gemütlich und uns hat es an nichts gefehlt. Die Lage ist perfekt. Man kann vieles zu Fuß erkunden und hat die Metro, Trams und Busse direkt vor der Tür.
Lissabon ist eine echt tolle Stadt und wir werden auf jeden Fall wiederkommen.

Hugo’s apartment is wonderful. It is in a very central location, everything is in walking distance. The place is very trendy and clean, the bed was very comfortable and the kitchen is very well equipped, so it would be comfortable for a longer stay as well. Hugo was on Holiday during our stay but his mom and friend kept in touch with us. They were very helpful, friendly and responded quickly every time. We would recommend the Apartment to anyone.
I loved the place and the location. Everything was perfect!
Amazing Location, and very nice apartment. Be prepared to walk up several flights of stairs!
Magnifique appartement, très bien décoré!Situation exceptionnelle!L'hôte est réactif,disponible et de bon conseil!

Perfect central location and smooth check in. Would recommend to business travellers as well as it had everything you need but was much more interesting than a hotel. Excellent shower and lovely decor.

Como prós, o apartamento é muito limpo, bem servido e confortável. A localização é excelente, perto de tudo, em meio ao melhor de Lisboa. O contato foi muito tranquilo e a Paula, que nos recebeu no check-in, foi muito prestativa.
Como contras, o apartamento é um sótão sobre o quarto andar (ou seja, é o quinto andar), e a escadaria de acesso, além de longa, é estreita (muito difícil para subir com malas) e escura (o sensor de luz demora muito a acender). Para idosos, como meu marido e eu, é bom levar em conta este detalhe. Além disso, não tem janela no sótão, apenas uma pequena janela na escadaria de acesso, e o pé direito é o próprio telhado em duas águas, e tem que prestar atenção ao andar dentro do apartamento.
Great location, spacious loft with fantastic amenities (including washing machine and a kitchen!). We really enjoyed our stay there and we highly recommend Hugo’s place. There is no elevator.

Recomendamos a todos, um canto extremamente charmoso e completo na Baixa.
Limpo, bem localizado e agradável.
Agradecimento a Paula pela recepção e pela lembrança neste momento especial.
Até breve.

Great location in the centre of Lisbon, check-in was swift and efficient, but we didn’t have the opportunity to meet the owner; we also felt a bit pressured to leave the apartment as soon as possible. We would have liked a more personal approach. Good apartment, but could use ventilation in the kitchen and bathroom.

Cute little place in a great location. I realise others have said this, but it’s worth repeating- there are no windows in the actual apartment. There’s one in the stairs before you get to the bedroom, but that’s it. That meant that it was really hot (which was kind of a blessing because our washing dried quickly) but took a while to cool down once we blasted the aircon.
Idália was a great communicator before we arrived and while we were there. The place has great style and is cute and lovely and there’s a washing machine, which is useful. The only downside was the lack of natural light.

Very nicely located spot. Central but almost no street noise or anything like that. Well-equipped with A/C and a washer and dryer. Just make sure to watch your head with the low ceiling! Host was very nice to let us leave our bags for a few hours after check-out.

The place is exactly as pictured/described and really clean. Such a cool space with everything you could ask for available.
Hugo picked us up from the airport when we had a really late flight, which we are really grateful for. He’s super friendly and has plenty of advice on where to go/what to see etc.
Amazing stay-will recommend to friends!

Un grand merci à Idália la maman de Hugo pour ses conseils, son accueil et l'organisation de notre arrivée! L'appartement est idéalement bien situé et agréable, propreté irréprochable! Nous avons passés 5 jours magnifiques, je recommande l'appartement de Hugo, ce n'était que du bonheur! Merci!

You won’t find a better base location to explore the sights of Lisboa than Hugo’s place. Sparkling clean with room to spread out, easy check-in and check-out, great communication and restaurant suggestions. Good air conditioning and the washer/dryer make it all the better. We’d stay there again without hesitation.

Superb location right in the middle of the center!
We had a good sleep as it was quiet in the loft.
It's provided with air conditioning and all services to have a longer stay.
Bathroom was clean and everything was present.

Hugo and his apartment are great! His mom helps organize the details for the reservation and she is very nice and responsive. The apartment is centrally located, super clean and has nice amenities, such as coffee, shampoo and body soap. Definitely would recommend working with Hugo to anyone interested in visiting lisbon!

INGANNATI
Purtroppo siamo stati ingannati dalle foto (anche se effettivamente ricontrollando si nota che non ci sono finestre) che sembrano molto luminose. L'appartamento è arredato con stile e gusto.
Purtroppo abbiamo trovato l'appartamento molto sporco con molti capelli a terra e batuffoli di polvere (ho fatto le foto e le ho mandate all'assistenza)
Hugo è sempre stato molto disponibile e cordiale.

Nos convivemos mais com Dona Idália. Ela e’ extremamente gentil atenciosa delicada comprometida eficiente simpática alegre comunicativa. Ela e‘ nota dez ! A localização deste loft e’ espetacular. Mas lembre-se não tem elevador e o loft fica localizado no quarto andar.
The apartment is located very centrally in Lisbon. It's cute and offers everything you need. I can highly recommend it.

This flat is so ideal for exploring Lisbon. It's right in the centre making almost all locations walkable. It's in the eaves of the building so sloping ceiling but still more than enough space and it adds character. It's also decorated really nicely. Lovely touches like having a caffetiere  (we are big coffee drinkers!) And  a washing machine with tablets. Communication was excellent, our flight was delayed which was a pain but the hosts were very flexible. Just one thing - there are a lot of stairs (4th floor, no lift). Not a problem at all for us but might be for some people. I would definitely recommend this flat and I'll book it again if I'm in Lisbon again.

O loft do Hugo era tal qual as fotos exibidas, simples, porém muito estiloso e aconchegante. Apesar de estar localizado no quarto andar, a localização do prédio é super central, ao pé da Praça da Figueira e de várias atrações locais. Não conhecemos o Hugo pessoalmente, quem se comunicou connosco foi a sua mãe e quem nos recebeu fui sua amiga; as duas foram sempre prestativas e atenciosas em todo o momento de comunicação, pessoal e virtual.
Recomendamos a estadia para casais e jovens em especial. A cama é super confortável.

Had a great time in Lisbon, the location of the flat definitely went towards that.
The flat itself was cool, communication with the Hosts was quick and easy - they picked me and my girlfriend up from the airport at 00:30 which made things so much easier. I would recommend this place to anyone!

Hugo's place is lovely! I am just going to say I never met or spoke to Hugo but from the moment I booked the apartment his mum was very responsive on my messages and arranged an early check in for me (even remembering 8 months after I asked) and sending me lots of very useful information on how to get to the apartment. When we arrived Sandra was lovely and friendly and showed us all we needed about the apartment.
The location is great, right in the middle of the city and it means there is easy access to everything. It also means you can hear the trams and buses early in the morning but its not the worst.
The apartment was very clean, comfortable and beautiful and it had everything we needed. It is of course a loft and there are a lot of stairs to get to the top and they are steep so just be aware.
Just FYI the wifi isn't great.
This last point I am only making because I think its fair people know but I understand it might not be a problem for everyone. Just to give some context my husband and I were away for our first trip together since we had a baby and my mindset has changed slightly. The first thing I noticed about the flat was that there is no fire escape and not only no fire escape but every single window has metal bars on so there would be no escape if there was a fire. I made a complaint to AirBnB to see if we could move but they said there was nothing they could do and its ok because the law is more lenient in Portugal so "lets hope there isn't a fire". Hugo's mum also emailed to say they were aware of the issue and are planning to put a window in but are waiting for residents approval before they proceed with the work and offered us a discount for any returning visits.

Das Apartment ist genau wie auf den Bildern beschrieben. Wir persönlich fanden es für einen 5 Tages Trip perfekt. Es ist liebevoll eingerichtet. Alles war sauber und der Empfang war herzlich. Auch die Kommunikation mit dem Host war zügig.
Das Apartment ist mitten in der Altstadt und viele Sehenswürdigkeiten und Geschäfte sind daher zu Fuß prima erreichbar. Gerne wieder.

Прекрасная квартира на мансардном этаже. Всё очень чисто и аккуратно. Стильный дизайн интерьера. В квартире есть абсолютно всё для удобств путешественников. Можно оставаться на длительное время. Очень отзывчивые хозяева. Спасибо за отличный приём!
Un beau studio, bien placé mais manque un velux... j’espère que vos voisins vous permettront d’en installer un ;) merci pour votre réceptivité et accueil

Emplacement parfait pour découvrir la ville. Dommage qu’il n’y ait pas de velux mais ça ne s’aurait tarder. Accueil parfait et très agréable. Très disponible
Je recommande

Foi nossa primeira e melhor experiência em Lisboa. A mãe do Hugo dna Idalia, muito atenciosa e prestativa. Excelente localização com todo conforto necessário e disposição em ajudar. Um ponto negativo é de quem tiver malas grandes são algumas escadas estreitas a subir. De todo resto eu indico sem a menor dúvida. Ótima localização, preço justo e total conforto.
Thanks to Idalia and Sandra for a quick response, the location center nearby to public transport and walking distance to attraction places in town, clean and spacious room.

A hip attic loft right in the heart of city center and only a 5 minute walk to the Rossi metro station and the Santa Justa lift. The loft itself was well thought out and had pretty decent amenities. The only complaint would be the cross beams in the roof. You have to be careful not to bump your head in certain parts of the loft (especially if you’re on the taller side). Overall a great place to stay in Lisbon.

Hugo's apartment was an ideal base for a week in Lisbon. We were looked after right from arrival, thanks to Vanessa waiting for us at the airport even when our incoming flight was delayed. Hugo's mother Idalia stayed in contact throughout and was the perfect host. The apartment is in a great central location while still not being noisy at night. We would definitely stay there again next time we visit Lisbon.
Az elhelyezkedés tökéletes, de a negyedik emeletre nagyon nehéz volt felvinni lift nélkül a csomagokat és rossz volt, hogy nincs ablak.

Leuk appartement op een perfecte locatie! Bus en metro stations zijn te vinden voor de deur op het plein (Rossio), wat het erg makkelijk maakt om rond te reizen met het OV. De communicatie met de verhuurder was erg goed, wat een aardige mensen! Verder was het appartement perfect voor een paar dagen, het is erg netjes en schoon en er is een wasmachine en vaatwasser. Er is inderdaad geen raam, maar dit vonden wij geen probleem aangezien we toch veel de deur uit waren. Tip: bezoek Sintra, wat een prachtige omgeving! Wel zijn de schuine wanden van het appartement soms wat onhandig voor langere mensen (vooral in de badkamer). En we waren iets wat verbaast dat ondanks het appartement zich op de 4e verdieping bevindt , je toch veel geluid had van het verkeer op straat en de wind. Al met al, een prima plekje voor een citytrip naar Lissabon!

Ik kan alleen maar bevestigen wat anderen reeds schreven. Samengevat: smaakvol gerenoveerd en gedecoreerd, ZEER goed uitgerust (incl paraplu die uitzonderlijk nodig was), heel proper, sympathieke en snelle communicatie door Hugo en zijn moeder. Ook leuk dat er koffie en thee was, alsook goeie handdoeken en douchezeep.
Enige tip voor slechte slapers zoals ik: breng goeie oordoppen mee. Al lig je op het 4de verdiep in de zolder, het verkeer en de tram zijn toch goed hoorbaar. Maar met oordoppen lukte het goed te slapen in deze zalige loft.

Fantastic location - quick walk to everything, quiet at night. Great hosts - very helpful & quick responses. Lovely accommodations - had everything we needed (note: 4th floor, so a few flights to climb), very clean & tasteful. Would recommend this place in this wonderfully warm & vibrant city.

This apartment was in a great location for exploring the city. It is right next to the metro station which made it easy to get around. It is a walk up on the top floor of the building which was kind of exhausting on some nights after a lot of walking but it wasn't too bad. The apartment was clean and had everything that we needed.
The appartement was very nice and well located in center of Lisbonne. We may come back again in Lisbonne and in this place :)

Very nice loft in the center of Lisbon. The apartment was clean and nicely decorated. We came a bit earlier than regular check in time but they were able to clean the apartment quickly from the previous guests for an earlier check-in; very appreciated! Recommend it!

The location could not be any better. It was so easy to get around and drop in during the day if we wanted to drop things off or just chill. The apartment itself was very nicely decorated, there were lots of useful amenities in the kitchen and bathroom, and the host gave us tips about the city. Just wish that there was a window!

Très bonne réactivité avant le voyage et très bon accueil de Sandra, une amie du propriétaire, à notre arrivée. L'appartement est idéalement situé en plein centre, parfait pour un weekend de visite. Sandra nous a également aidé à trouvé un bon restaurant. A refaire sans hésiter.
Perfect situation. Near all public transports. Clean and Quiet. We did not met Hugo but the person in charge of us was very polite and helpful. Great stay in Lisbon. We recommend.

Hugo's place is the perfect location for a fortnight in Lisbon! Perfectly cleaned and comfortable, he will always be available for you and help you as much as he can.
We will definitely come back.
Great place, well located. Easy to get to all attractions by foot. Hugo and Sandra are extremely accomodating and easy to communicate with. Highly recommended.

Excellent location !! Right at Figueira Square, so it means you can walk to anywhere in that area. Safe neighborhood, full of decent restaurants. The instruction is clearly explained and the building is easily accessible (no elevator but that’s not my problem).
Room is clean and fully equipped. WiFi is fast. All amenities are provided (washing machine, hair dryer, dish washer, oven etc.)
Really worth my money and yes, this is one of the best airbnb I ever stay.
Very nice loft !
We loved staying here, great location, cosy space with good heating. One of my favourite places yet.
This loft was very conveniently located in the Baixa. There were all the necessary amenities there; however, there are no windows, which was not clear from the description or photos.
Séjour parfait, très bon accueil chaleureux, appartement idéalement situé et très fonctionnel.
Nicely furnished, but taller guests might have trouble with the ceiling height.

Ce qui nous a plus est la localité et le rapport qualité prix. Le studio est sur la place centrale de Lisbonne et pour le prix est très intéressant. Cependant il est au 4ème étage sans ascenseur et les escaliers ne sont pas pratiques, un peu rikiki.
L’appartement manque de fenêtres et le chauffage ne fonctionnait pas. Du coup l’appartement est resté froid pendant tout le week-end.
Le studio est sous le toit et ce n’est pas pratique pour gens trop grands.
Le deuxième « lit » c’est un canapé pas confortable.
C’est conseillé pour la zone et pour le prix par rapport à la localisation.

L'appartement est propre et bien équipé et il convient très bien pour 2 personnes; il est idéalement placé dans le Baixa et proche de tous les transports.
Nous avons particulièrement apprécié la gentillesse et la disponibilité de la famille de Hugo avec notamment des conseils très utiles pour la visite de Lisbonne.

BEST location ever ! The flat really is right at the center and it is so nice to be able to walk everywhere !
The flat looks amazing, really cool deco & furnitures.
2 things that could be annoying :
- Really steep stairs (but I guess it was still quite good for Lisbon as it is like this in every building =)
- No daylight / no windows
Posizione Centralissima e comoda per raggiungere qualsiasi zona della citta' appartamento molto carino con tutti i confort necessari, consiglio vivamente!!
일단 위치 대박이구요ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ숙소도 넓어요! 그리고 수건도 많이 주고 뜨신물도 잘나옵니다ㅋㅋㅋ위치가 너무 좋아서 교통비 많이 안들어가요. 계단이 없는 다락방에 위치하지만 왠만한 유럽건물은 전부 이래서 별로 문제되진 않아요. 그리고 방음도 잘돼서 괜찮습니다!!
Thank you very much Mrs. Idalia for his kindness, courtesy and for the sweet and very good wine, excellent tea and coffee really very complete the house was equipped with everything you need.

Nos ha encantado pasar estos 3 días en Lisboa. El loft, situado en el centro, te permite ir andando a cualquier lugar del casco antiguo. En cuánto a los 4 pisos ... sí son duros, pero ese es el encanto de un edificio antiguo. Por lo demás todo perfecto, sin ninguna duda repetiría. Por último, muchas gracias a Hugo, un gran anfitrión y persona.
Perfect location, super stylish and great apartment! We really enjoyed our stay in the best city in the world!!

Nous avons été très bien acueilli à notre arrivée par Ana, une amie, qui nous attendait à l'appartement. L'appartement était très joliment decoré, propre et très bien équipé.  Il était également parfaitement situé et proches des differents sites a visiter. Nous y retournerions sans hésiter pour un prochain séjour!
Centralissimo, comodissimo e pulitissimo. Vicino a tutti i punti di interesse!
EXCELENTE LUGAR, CENTRICO, LIMPIO Y ESPACIOSO PARA 2-3 PERSONAS. SOLO QUE ESTA HASTA EL 4TO PISO, PERO ES UN SITIO MUY RECOMENDABLE
Ana me recibió correctamente

ultra bien situé proche des quartiers vivants et à 30s du métro, nous avons été bien reçus. Plein d'info à notre disposition sur la ville. Les petits bémols sont les 4 étages, en rentrant après avoir marché toute la journée, cela pique un peu et la manque de fenêtre (qui n'est pas très gênant car au final nous passions les journées entières dehors). Propreté parfaite, équipement aussi (machine à laver, four, plaque induction, petit lave vaisselle etc...). Un rapport qualité prix vraiment exceptionnel.
Loved our stay here! Great communication, flexibility on letting us leave our bags to pick up at the end of the day when we flew out, super cute apartment and above all an amazingly central location.

La casa si trova in una posizione strategica che permette di visitare interamente la città. Appartamento pulito, accogliente, dotato di tutti i confort ed arredato con gusto. Unica pecca: i quattro piani a piedi che con le valige sono un po’ scomodi da fare. Host consigliato !
Great and clean amenities, well situated in the centre of the city. Would definitely recommend the apartment!
Super! Tres agréable séjour et appartement génial

Wir hatten wirklich einen wunderbaren Aufenthalt in Lissabon. Die Unterkunft ist gut gelegen und bietet wirklich alles was wir für unseren Aufenthalt gebraucht haben. Ich wurde ausgesprochen nett in Empfang genommen und mir wurde alles detailliert gezeigt. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und werden sicher wieder kommen.

Kul leilighet med topp beliggenhet. Kort vei til hele sentrum og til metro og trikk.
Merk at det ligger i femte etasje uten heis. Kan også være lavt under taket for en nordboer, men funker likevel greit. Greit også å vite at det ikke er noe brukbart vindu i leiligheten annet enn et lite i trappen mot bakgård. Er aircon her så temperaturmessig går det fint uten vindu!
Er du sensitiv for bylyder om natten er heller ikke dette et sted for deg. Det ligger midt i sentrum og trikken går rett forbi. Personlig plaget ikke det meg.
Veldig oppmerksomme verter og meget bra renhold. Kan anbefales til en eller to personer.

Outstanding location! You will find it hard to beat this location, near the old town and shops and a ten minute walk to the water's edge. My first visit to Lisbon so I wasn't sure when I booked where everything was. As the visit went on we found we were in exactly the right spot. Great host and I thoroughly recommend them.

We had an excellent stay at Hugos place! The apartment is in a very central location and tastefully furnished. We had an awesome time in Lisboa and would certainly like to come back. Communication was excellent, we received valuable advice on directions to/from the airport. Highly recommended!

The apartment is in a central location, clean and comfortable and we had great time there. Host very kind, plus we found a useful sheet with a lot of suggestions about restaurants and places to visit. 5 stars!

Hugo's place was perfect! Amazing location and so easy to get in and out. Walk everywhere! Perfect for my girlfriend and I! I loved that you had a picture of the apt. from the square. We got dropped off in a cab from the airport and knew exactly where to go! Couldn't have been easier !
Real nice place to stay, excellent location, very cozy house with WiFi and tea and washing machine! Very supportive host.
We loved our stay in Lisbon at Hugo's appartment. It was as stylish as it looks in the photos (even better!) nothing was missing, and it is super central. It was fantastic! Would recommend 100% :)

Très joli appartement situé en plein coeur de Lisbonne, très pratique pour se déplacer. Jolie décoration et propreté impeccable. Juste un petit bémol sur le bruit des transports en commun jusqu'à minuit une heure. Hôte très serviable & sympathique.

너무 만족스러웠어요. 우선 위치가 환상적이에요. 구시가 중심 피궤이라 광장 바로 앞이라 어디든 이동하기 편해요. 도보이동은 물론 주요 관광지로 가는 트램과 버스도 다 다녀요. 숙소는 깨끗하고 편했어요. 호스트도 친절했어요. 한가지 유일한 단점이라면 엘리베이터가 없어서 체크인, 체크아웃 시에 캐리어 들고 계단 오르내리기 힘들었어요. 이외에는 정말 너무나 만족해요!
Logement avec une localisation excellente pour visiter Lisbonne facilement (métro proche, sites touristiques proches...).

Location is always the most important thing to my wife and me when choosing an Airbnb and this place was perfect. The convenience of the location was more important than our minor complaints.
The slanted ceilings were quite uncomfortable-- my wife bumped her head while getting up and I had to squat to use the toilet standing up. We knew this was an attic-like unit but we didn't know how low the ceilings got. The toilet seat was also broken and the shower drain was not working well.

Muy recomendado, ubicación ideal cerca a estaciones del metro, tranvías y buses que van a cualquier lugar de la ciudad.
Apartamento cómodo muy bien organizado y muy limpio.
Es en un piso elevado pero aun así es cómodo y se cumple con todo lo que se promete.
Leuke loft met moderne inrichting. Locatie is uitstekend, je zit op wandelafstand van alle leuke locaties. Alle comfort is beschikbaar.
As described! Central, particularly close to transport hubs.Helpful & easy contacts.

Best location! Very clean apartment, top floor so it was quite but also required us to walk up a couple flights of stairs; worth it though! we had a great stay and would stay there again if we return to Lisbon!
Nice location and the hosts were very helpful. They provided a detailed list of places to check out and were flexible with our checkin.
We enjoyed the time at Hugo's apartment a lot. The location is great and communication was easy. The apartment is very clean!

Hugo's place was a great find for us during our stay at Lisbon. It was centrally located to a lot of restaurants and all the sites we had wanted to see was walkable from it. Definitely recommend his place and if we ever visit again will choose his place!

A wonderfully equipped and extremely well situated apartment. Spotlessly clean and secure. The hosts were very helpful. We loved our stay and would gladly return however some people might find access difficult due to the number of stairs and might not like the lack of natural light. Good luck Hugo in getting approval for extra windows!

Estupendo apartamento situado en el mismísimo centro de Lisboa. Muy bien ubicado y con todos los lujos. Todo lo que aparece en el anuncio es cierto y nos sirvió de centro de operaciones para planear el resto de días en Portugal. El único inconveniente que tiene el apartamento es que la finca no dispone de ascensor. Pero más allá de eso es un 10 en todo. Si volvemos intentaremos repetir.

I had a wonderful time at Hugo's apartment.
The location is more than perfect, being in the heart of Lisbon with train and Metro stations close by. Visitors MUST take the train to Sintra - a highlight of my trip.
Hugo's communication was brilliant, and I would happily recommend this apartment to my friends and family.
Be warned - it is on the top floor of an old building with no lift. So put on those walking shoes and prepare for a walk up flights of stairs at the end of your day.

Logement très beau et agréable, avec climatisation ( heureusement ).
Il se situe au 4eme étage, sans ascenseur , les escaliers sont assez étroits , il ne faut pas être très chargé quand on monte.
Tout le reste très bien , la décoration , la propreté , le lit est confortable... L'appartement est bien situé.
Perfect location, very clean place, Excellent Landlady. The only remark would be about the flat, a little bit too dark, under the roofs...

We had a really pleasant stay at Hugo's apartment, with easy communication and check in and the flat was in a really convenient location.
It also had all the necessary amenities including washing machine/dryer and dish washer.
We would definitely stay here again.

L'appartement est super ! Propre, confortable, la décoration est très sympa. On s'y sent bien, et l'emplacement est idéal. C'est Gustavo le frère d'Hugo qui nous a reçu, il comprend bien le français, et nous à très bien accueillies. Allez y les yeux fermés, vous ne serez pas déçu. ☺️

Mooi en schoon appartement in het midden van het centrum, zeker een aanrader als je de stad gaat verkennen. Het appartement heeft nauwelijks daglicht omdat er maar 1 raam in zit maar dat is geen probleem als je er alleen slaapt. Communicatie was erg goed en we konden onze tassen ook makkelijk kwijt voor en na check-in.

L'appartement est très agréable, en plein centre de Lisbonne, proche des boutiques, restaurants, de la mer et des transports !
Nous avons été très bien accueillis et n'avons rencontré aucun problèmes d'organisation.
Nous recommandons fortemebt cet appartement !!
Beautiful room, had air conditioning, very accommodating people who helped us with every need we had, great location

Die Kommunikation und der Empfang in Hugos Apartment verlief wunderbar, die Lage der Wohnung ist auch toll, alles ist gut zu erreichen! Ebenso der Einrichtungsstil und die Sauberkeit waren sehr schön. Für einen längeren Aufenthalt würde ich persönlich unbedingt Tageslicht in der Wohnung benötigen.
Hugo's place is very centrally located and clean. Communication was very easy and he was extremely accommodating. Highly recommended!

Very nice hosts. They gave us good tips for our tour in Lisbon. Very central and located place. Close to everything. Very clean. You need to be in good shape to clime the 4.5 stairs. Start practicing.

This place is great! We stayed a week and enjoyed having a home to come too after being a tourist all day! Great location to get around and sight see. Safe and walkable at all hours. Be warned there are 87 steps up to the loft... and there are low ceilings throughout... bathroom included..
We had an amazing stay! The location was great, right in the center of the city. The apartment was beautiful!

Hugo's place is just as shown in the photos, very cosy and lovely attic room, with all the items needed for a comfortable stay. The space is big for 2 of us, and we absolutely loved the decorations in the house.
Hugo and Idalia were very responsive in communication and gave us very clear directions, as well as useful tips on places to visit and go.
Location is very ideal! Close to many restaurants and sightseeing areas. Super convenient.
Would love to book this place if we were back again!
4eme etg sans ascenseur. Sinon impect ;)
Perfect location!

방도 너무 예쁘고 깨끗했으며, 자정이 넘어 도착했는데도 Hugo가 집 앞까지 나와 기다려 주었습니다. 웃는얼굴로 반겨주었고 근처 슈퍼마켓이나 편의 시설에 대하여 자세히 적힌 종이와 지도도 건네받았습니다. 세탁기나 오븐,에어컨과 같은 전자기기 사용도 무척 편리했으며 전체적으로 너무 좋았습니다. 다만 한가지 아쉬운점은 집이 4층(0층부터 시작하니 실제로는5번째 층)이었는데도 엘리베이터가 없어서 좁은 계단길을 짐을들고 올라가야했다는 것인데, 이부분만 이해하실 수 있다면 입지조건이나 청결 등 모든 부분에서 만족하실 수 있을거에요. 추천합니다~!!

Hugo and Idália are super hosts ! It was a huge pleasure to stay in their flat and we HIGHLY recommend it ! The flat is super well located right nearby a metro and in the center of Lisbon so you can enjoy the city. There are tons of restaurants, things to see, shops etc... around. The flat itself is really nice (better than we expected) and is filled with everything you need to enjoy your stay in Lisbon. Hugo and his mother Idália are always available if you need anything and they will give you worthy advices. Again : they are super hosts. Thank you so much ! It will be a pleasure to return when we come back to Lisbon.
(One thing to note : if you are old and/or have issues walking, the stairs to go up to the last floor of the building to reach the flat are a bit stiff.)

This great little studio apartment was in a great location. It is exactly as it is described. There are many steps up so it is not for the faint of heart. I had a leg brace at the time and was still able to manage it slowly.. There are no windows and no view but we were ready to go to bed by the time we got back every night.
Stay at Hugo's apartment was great! Location, cleanliness and key handover worked flawlessly. Thank you for the hospitality :)

L'alloggio di Hugo è in un'ottima posizione, centrale sia per quanto riguarda i mezzi che per le attività, molto carino, un po' caldo essendo ricavato da un sottotetto ma comunque ben disposto e accogliente. Molto gentile e carina è stata la sua amica Ana che ci ha accolte perché lui era fuori città. Nel complesso è stata un'esperienza molto positiva.
Todo según lo publicado
Lugar bem central, moveis novos e bem equipado. Nao pode ir com muitas malas e grandes pois são 4 andares de escada apertada
Très bel appartement, très bien situé dans le coeur de la ville. A proximité de tous les monuments et lieux de vie. Au calme la nuit.
Amazing loft, perfect for a city break stay. The location was ideal for restaurants and bars as well as shopping and transport! Not much more you could ask for!!
Appartement très bien situé et conforme aux photos. Petit bémol l'insonorisation et la douche pas très pratique.

Un appartement idéalement situé, Hugo n'a pas pu être présent mais c'était sa maman qui nous a remis les clés, elle nous a donné toutes les explications pour nos déplacements. Pour une première avec Airbnb, c'est à refaire !!
It was a nice central place to stay

Hugo was a great host - met us at the airport following our late arrival to Lisbon. Also offered some great restaurant tips off the beaten track. Top floor apartment so stairs can be a killer after a full day walking!
We had a great time at Hugo's place - apart from the 4 floors bringing our luggage up, it was clean, centrally located and well-furnished. If we come back to Lisbon, we'll stay here again!
