Un petit apartement sous comble très bien agencé. Parfait pour un petit séjour. Remarque :pas d'ascenseur. Très bel emplacement face à la place da figueira. Super.

Hugo was very nice, give us lot of information about his appartment, Lisbonna, how to find his appartment since the aeroport... appartment great, clean, similary to the pictures and with a great localization! I recommand! 👍

Wonderful location! Really enjoyed the stay. The ceilings are a bit low; my brother bumped his head a couple of times. Apart from that, it's a great space.
I would definitely stay here again.

Also das Apartment hat eine sehr zentrale Lage und ist nur 2 min Fußweg vom Wasser entfernt.
Es gibt viele Restaurant in der näheren Umgebung von touristisch bis lokal.
Der Check-In verlief ohne Probleme und wir wurden freundlich von Ana empfangen.
Die Wohnung liegt zwar im 4 Stock, aber daran gewöhnt man sich relativ schnell.
Das Apartment war sehr sauber und aufgeräumt.
Es gab eine voll ausgestattete Küche und sogar ein paar Sorten Tee und Kaffee, waren auch da.
Zusätzlich waren auch Handtücher, Duschgele und Föhn vorhanden.
Das einzige kleine Manko an der Wohnung war, dass sie kein Fenster hat außer im Flur und man somit nie besonders viel Tageslicht bekommt.
Aber wenn man, so wie wir, die Stadt in vollen Zügen genießen will, muss man ja nicht die Zeit in der Wohnung verbringen.
Zusätzlich zu der tollen Wohnung in TOP Lage, konnten wir auch noch relativ spät den Check-out machen und konnten so auch den letzten Tag in der Stadt genießen, ohne die Koffer die ganzer Zeit mitzuschleppen.
Alles in allem kann ich dieses Apartment nur empfehlen, weil alles super lief und unkompliziert.
Und die Lage ist wirklich super. :)
the loft is very cute and nice。
Todo muy bien, la comunicación ha sido genial. Cuando coloquen la ventana ya será perfecto sin duda. Muchas gracias por todo!

Recomiendo mucho este Apartamento, el lugar perfecto! Todo muy bien, sólo que les recomiendo no llevar maletas grandes ni muy pesadas. Ya que son 4 pisos de escaleras. Fuera de eso todo perfecto. Gracias

Appartement propre, moderne , bien équipé et très bien situé ( proximité direct métro Rossio , supermarché, etc .. ) . Logement idéal pour un couple pour passer un bon séjour à Lisbonne. Nous avons été très bien accueilli et nous reviendrons l'année prochaine. Merci encore Hugo .

Perfect location, absolutely clean, very well decorated and quiet. The flat is perfect for a weekend as is right in the heart of the city, within walking distance of many of the attractions, a huge range of shops and public transport. Hugo was very nice and let us to check out late.

Very nice, cozy and really clean place, centrally located, quaiet even though it is by a main Street, has all the amenities you may need. Optimal for a short stay. It is on the forth floor with no lift, so not ideal if you are a heavy packer! But worked perfectly for us.

Super appartement! Super indications et super accueil
Nous avions tout ce dont nous aviez besoin!
Localisation géniale en plein centre
Appartement très agréable, bien aménagé et agencé!
Nous recommandons vivement !!
Magnifiquement placé en plein centre !

L'appartamento di Hugo è in una posizione ottimale sia per girare e conoscere la città di giorno che per la vita notturna perché è vicino alle zone dei ristoranti/locali. La casa è molto bella curata nei dettagli. L'unica pecca è che ha una sola finestra sulle scale e quindi è buia. Però è molto intima e confortevole.
Logement tres bien situé dans lisbonne, proche de toutes commodités, accueil parfait, espace propre et très bien décoré, appartement chaleureux et fonctionnel merci Hugo! Je le recommande vivement!
Nice place, in the center of Lisbon. Perfect for a couple.

O apartamento é muito bem localizado. Hugo sempre mandava mensagens, comunicativo. A recepção foi muito boa, não cheguei a conhecer o Hugo, quem nos recepcionou foi sua mãe, muito gentil e simpática. Nós deu ótimas dicas da cidade. Apartamento limpo, bem arrumado e bonito. A única dificuldade que tivemos foram com as escadas. Super recomendado!

We had a wonderful stay at Hugo's place. It was very clean and neat. Same as on the picture, it has all the ammenities like oven (we didn't use it) , dishwasher and microwave. It includes small breakfast items like cofee, tea... we just had to bring pastries in in the morning we was just walking distance. The location is great, at first when you arrive from airport it is just a 5min walk from the underground station which is great since rolling luggage and paved road are not really good friends. Then all the way we just keep walking, it is a corner away from the famous St Maria Elevator, a bit further to the castle and the tage bit nothing extrem (less than a k). close to tram 28 departure station and main railway station (forget the name) to Sintra for example. Not too far from Bario so a good walk after some enjoyable nighttime, I recommend this place for a couple who really want to explore Lisbon. It is not located at a party location so quite in the evening and a bit nooisy in the morning dur to the tram passing down the street but really nothing which prevent form having very good sleeps in very nice beddings

Hugo é super prestativo! Nos ajudou desde do começo! Nosso voo chegava muito cedo e se preocupo em nos ajudar a entrar mais cedo em seu apartamento. Nós conhecemos a Vanessa que é a simpatia em pessoa e nos ajudou a entrar mais cedo também. Ela nos deu varias dicas sobre Lisboa. O apartamento é exatamente os das fotos, muito limpo, grande e confortável. O único ruim é por não ter elevador mas estamos cientes disso mas no final do dia era engraçado super as escadas kkkkkk Amamos conhecer Lisboa e ficamos apaixonados! Obrigada Hugo e Vanessa :)

Lovely clean apartment in a fantastic location. Vanessa was very helpful and friendly, and gave us many tips of places to see while we stayed in Lisbon. I will definitely be using this apartment the next time I visit Lisbon.

The hosts were easy to communicate with, and very accessible for tips and pointers during our stay.
Amazing location right in the center. Public transportation is nearby. Trains to towns, such as SIntra, are also very close to the apartment.
The apartment is so cozy and had everything we needed. Immaculate! Super comfy bed, spacious living and dining areas, and the coffee pods were a nice touch.
Definitely recommend!

Logement bien situé
Acceuil très agréable
La surface au sol est grande mais attention à pas se cogner la tête sur les côtés

This apartment has a great location, very central. It's tidy, clean, lovely decorated and the shower is great. Hugo is very fast and easy to communicate with. Vanessa received us and was happy to give us some tips and directions. I took my boyfriend here for his birthday and they gave us a bottle of wine to celebrate. Talking about going the extra mile for your guests!!! We had a great time and would definitely recommend this apartment and go here again ourselves.

Our stay in Lisbon was excellent! Hugo's apartment is very cozy and well decorated in a prime location!
Vanessa was amazing and friendly! She gave us great tips on Lisbon and always so happy to help and easily reached!
Only thing I would note is that there are a lot of steps and it can be hard carrying heavy luggage, like mine was! Lol However again Vanessa was great help!
I would definetely recommend Hugos place and would definetely stay there again

Very nice apartment, at the top floor of a centrally located house. The location is awesome - at walking distance from everything. Vanessa has been really helpful and resourceful in making us feel welcome. The only downside was that during the night it was definitely cold - even with the heater on. But everything considered, I would wholeheartedly recommend this place!
Ótima localização, apto confortável. A Vanessa, pessoa com quem interagi todo o tempo fez toda a diferença para uma estadia ótima e orientações gerais!

Great location and very helpful host!! The flat was very clean with all the necessary amenities. Located at the city centre, close to metro, shops and restaurants. Host helped a lot in finding the flat and gave us very helpful tips for the trip. Strongly recommended!!
Très bon accueil, appartement super bien placé dans le centre ville. Spacieux, confortable et bien entretenu. De bons conseils sont apportés pour que votre séjour se déroule pour le mieux. A refaire!

Very nice apartment close to all you need in Lisbon (subway, Bairro Alto, etc.). Hugo and Vanessa are very nice and helpful.
Everything was fine.
Hugo's place is amazing. The location can't be any better. It's cute and cozy, we had an absolutely great time for the two nights we were there.

Friendly host who provided travel information and was very accommodating. The apartment was clean and modern and very close to surrounding tourist spots. Thank you for the wonderful stay.  The only slight problem was located in an attic made it a little tricky to get up and down with heavy luggage as there is no elevator but otherwise great place.

Thank you, guys! Vanessa, you was realy helpful, frendly and easy-going. We were glad you take us from the airport and give us a lot of reccomendation about Lisbon and Sintra. Hugo, you have very good and cozy apartment!

All the best both of you!

Beautiful apartment, amazing staying there. Hugo is very kind person and his friend Vanessa who told us everything important in Lisbon too, thank you for tips. I can recommend this place, perfect position in the centre of the city, we were absolutely satisfied, thank you. ;)

Notre séjour à Lisbonne s'est très bien passé.
Arrivant dans la soirée, Hugo nous a proposé qu'une amie vienne nous chercher à l'aéroport. Vanessa a été très gentille et serviable, elle nous a donné pleins de bons trucs pour faciliter notre séjour et nous guider vers les meilleures choses à voir à Lisbonne.
L'appartement était confirme aux descriptions et aux photos, il était propre et très bien situé dans la ville
Si je me rend à nouveau à Lisbonne je retournerai sans hésiter chez Hugo, je ne peux que recommander cet appartement.

This was an ideal apartment for us (a couple) to use as a base to visit the beautiful city of Lisbon. It's in the center, close to all neighborhoods and multiple metro stops and the train station of Rossio. The apartment is on the top floor of an old apartment building and it's very charming, neat, nicely decorated. The stairs are quite a climb, but after eating delicious foods all day, it was a welcome exercise!

Hugo, though we have not met him personally, was very communicative and he referred us to Vanessa, who was there to help us with everything. She was very fast to reply on Whatsapp and gave of tons of great tips to do in and around Lisbon.

A tiny remark: it is useful to mention that there is only one small window in the whole apartment and it's in the hallway. There is plenty of lighting , but some might prefer more of a view. For us it was good.

I would definitely book it again next time we come to Lisbon.

Hugo's apartment was great!
Just as described in pictures, while the apartment is full equipped with everything a traveler need and even more.
The apartment is in the city center!! the best location you can ask in a pretty quite street.
Vanessa (Hugo's friends that welcomed us) was amazing and so responsive & helpful - really recomend to stay here!

A perfect flat located in the heart of Lisbon. You could walk anywhere you wanted within 5-15 minutes. The flat was amazing and included everything that was needed. Good contact with Hugo throughout our journey.
Highly recommended, beautiful apartment  perfectly  located in Lisbon for our first visit. Extremely helpful and friendly hosts. Would love to stay here again.

Estuve en el apartamento de Hugo durante 5 días y sólo puedo decir buenas referencias, la atención a mi llegada fue excepcional por parte de Vanesa, y tanto ella como Hugo estuvieron pendientes durante mi estancia.
El apartamento está muy bien situado y perfectamente equipado para que los días que pases ahí no te falte ninguna comodidad.

Vanessa, who manages the listing on behalf of Hugo, picked me up from the airport, which made my arrival very stress-free and convenient, considering I arrived quite late into Lisbon. She even bought me a bottle of wine for my birthday.

The location is excellent. It is very central and we were able to walk pretty much everywhere within the city center.

The flat is clean and ideal for two people. I would recommend this place.

The trip overall was brilliant! Couldn't ask for more. Hugo's friend Vanessa was communicating with us all week, giving restaurant tips and even organized a taxi for us so we could get back to the airport! The flat was brilliant, clean, had everything we needed and we immediately felt at home. There was a lot of steps to get to the apartment but that didn't bother us as we needed to burn off all the food we ate. Thanks Hugo and Vanessa.
schöne Wohnung, tolle Lage, Fitness durch Treppenhaus garantiert :-)

We stayed one week at Hugo's flat and it was an amazing experience. We were welcomed by Vanessa, she was very nice, she gave us tips about lisbon and was always available to answer our questions by whatsapp.
The flat is cute, cosy and wasn't noisy.
If you have the opportunity to come to Lisbon, don't hesitate to stay at Hugo's flat!

Vanessa took the time to talk about the highlights of the city. This was really helpful. I would definitely recommend this accommodation if you travel with 2 a 3 persons, especially if you rather life outside than inside the loft.

L'appartamento è in una posizione centralissima. E' un loft arredato con gusto e accogliente. Il proprietario è stato sempre gentile e puntuale nelle risposte e al nostro arrivo era già lì ad attenderci.

Appartement très agréable, idéalement situé avec toutes les commodités. Très bon accueil de la part de l'hôte qui nous a donné de très bons conseils pour profiter au mieux de notre séjour à Lisbonne. Je recommande vivement ce logement et cet hôte et je n'hésiterai pas à y retourner !
Sin duda alguna,una casa cuidada, con todos los detalles, acogedora, muy bien ubicada, etc. Hugo muchas gracias por todo, esperamos volver!!

The apartment was perfect! The location is really great, every trip in Lisbon should start at Rossio. They installed an airco during our week, so the apartment is now even greater! Hugo is very friendly and helpfull, he gave us a big discount the days without the airco, because of the heat last week. The loft is 4 high, so your condition is great after your stay ;-) Hugo's friend gave us some tips to do, so we rented a scooter and saw beautiful places close to Lisbon. There is not much daylight in the loft, but this wasn't a problem for us, because Lisbon has so much to do outside. We only slept in the apartment. Only during the check out, we didnt know what to do with the key and our bags, and the owner didnt reply on time, so we left strict at 12:00 without saying goodbye, I would recomment to arrange this before your leaving day. Makes it less stressfull. After all, the apartment is really great and we had an amazing time in Lisbon. The price and the location of this apartment makes it totally worth a visit

Io e il mio ragazzo siamo stati ospiti da Hugo due volte nella stessa settimana. La prima volta era libero anche l'appartamento sotto, perciò siccome non era ancora stata installata l'aria condizionata nell'appartamento dove saremmo dovuti stare, ci siamo trasferiti giù per avere un po' più di fresco. La seconda volta purtroppo l'appartamento sotto era occupato quindi abbiamo sofferto abbastanza il caldo nonostante 3 ventilatori (si tratta di una mansarda con una sola finestra quindi molto difficile da rinfrescare d'estate). A parte questo inconveniente climatico, è andato tutto bene. Hugo è disponibile e ci siamo scritti spesso durante il nostro soggiorno. La casa è come appare nelle foto e molto pulita. Zona perfetta per visitare il centro di Lisbona e la Piazza del Commercio a piedi. Consigliato!
We had a great stay at Hugo's apartment! Good location and a very cool loft. Would recommend :)

O Hugo foi muito atencioso conosco, mesmo antes da nossa chegada, chegando mesmo providenciar transporte do aeroporto para o loft no dia da nossa chegada. O lugar é muito bem localizado e nos permitiu explorar à pé, ou de transporte público a cidade de Lisboa. O loft é exatamente como está nas fotografias e o anfitrião muito atencioso.

Both Hugo and Vanessa were helpful from the start of the booking - they responded quickly and offered me their mobile number during our stay so we could ask them any trivial experiences. We stayed here during the Nos Alive Festival and for that it was perfect: the lack of windows played to our advantage as we had plenty time to sleep in without sunlight waking us up. We struggled a little with the heat towards the end of the afternoon but that might be due to us being from the blizzardy wildernesses of northern Scotland. All in all this is a perfect little hideaway for a weekend break in Lisboa.
Estaba todo ordenado y se preocupo de que al no estar el su familia podría antendernos

Hugo's apartment is definitely one of my AirBnB favorites.
We were greeted at the apartment by one of Hugo's friends. She was extremely helpful giving us tips and ideas of what to see and do in Lisbon. Her energy represented the warm and helpful people we met everywhere in Lisbon.
The apartment is very trendy and well laid out considering it is in the loft of the building. Just a word of advice, the apartment was on the 4th floor so it is a bit of exercise coming in and out!
The apartment is in a great central location with trams, shops and restaurants right outside and around the corner.
The bathroom was immaculate. The kitchen was well stocked with all the utensils for cooking.
Thanks for hosting us in your beautiful city Hugo!

Génial! Je connais plutôt bien lisbonne et cette fois-ci j'ai pu apprécier le fait d'être en plein centre ville !!!! Tout est à 30 secondes de l'appartement c'est l'emplacement parfait pour ne pas perdre de temps (Metro, bus, aerobus...)
L'appartement est très beau, tres design, exactement comme sur les photos! Il est très fonctionnel comme décrit.
Il n'y a pas de fenêtre donc il fait tres chaud, mais il y a deux ventilateurs pour rafraîchir la pièce et donc j'ai tres tres bien dormi avec mon ami (4 nuits)
Bref, je recommande l'appartement d'Hugo pour un petit séjour de quelques jours !
Merci Hugo!
we arrived in Lisbon in June. hugo was on holiday so his friend welcomed us at the gate. it was a very nice flat, especially for two girls. clean and spacious, loved a lot~ :D

We had a lovely time in Lisbon and at Hugo's apartment. However the studio apartment has no windows or natural light. The room is at the top of four steeps sets of stairs and has no natural light or ventilation. Considering the heat and humidity of Lisbon at this time of the year (June) plus climbing the stairs each time, arriving into a hot apartment was not the most ideal. Hugo does provide two large fans which we used gratefully!
Of course we did book it without seeing any photos because it was being renovated.

Overall, the apartment is very modern and trendy and in a perfect location, right in the centre of the city. It's also very quiet and we never had any trouble sleeping. There is everything you need including a washing machine, coffee maker, plenty of storage and seating. A great apartment! But perhaps a window could be put in at some stage to make it even better!
Hugo is a great hostes! The flat is very cozy, perfectly clean and very well equiped. It was a wonderful experience.

Flat very central and very convenient. Be careful, it is at the 4th floor. Which is a shame, it is a lack of light because there is no windows in the roof. We must turn on the electricity and it is a pity. Another point: no ventilation in the bathroom.
Well renovated appartement, Lisoba is a great city with fantastic Pasteis de Belem....

Had a great stay in Hugo's apartment -he was very communicative with clear details, and his friend helped check me in, who was also great in sharing a lot of information about the home and the surrounding neighborhood. The loft is very spacious and very quiet (despite the central and busy location, you cannot hear any noise!), the location was really best of all - next to everything!

The bed and furniture were comfortable, with the room well decorated and very clean. The apartment was out of soap and coffee, and someone promptly dropped supplies off the next day. Despite the slanted ceilings, not that it doesn't impact most of the spaces in which you stand, so it's not a problem!

Nous avons passé un séjour formidable à Lisbonne. L'appartement est très chaleureux et très bien situé en plein centre historique.
Merci pour les suggestions faites à notre arrivée. Nous recommandons vivement ce logement. Lisbonne est une ville superbe et les locaux sont très accueillants. Nous reviendrons sans aucun doute.
Mélanie & Sandra

Logement confortable et aménagé avec goût, très fonctionnel et bien situé.
Hugo s'est montré disponible au téléphone, un regret de n'avoir pu le rencontrer, mais ce sera pour une prochaine fois à l'occasion d'une autre visite de Lisbonne.
Une remarque, à savoir que l'escalier pourrait être difficile à monter pour certaines personnes.
L'aménagement d'une fenêtre sera un plus au charme de ce comble aménagé.

Merci encore à Hugo pour cet hébergement

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour chez Hugo au mois de mai.
Malgré que nous soyons arrivés quelques heures en avance, Hugo ne nous a fait patienter que 10 minutes afin de découvrir son charmant loft. Celui ci est très propre et parfaitement équipé, nous étions ravis: machine à laver, four, plaques à induction, hotte, congélateur, lave vaisselle, fer à repasser... tout y est comme à la maison ;) Seul bémol, l'absence de fenêtre mais cela ne nous a pas dérangé.
De plus, la localisation est parfaite: en plein centre, avec tous les services et transports à proximité. Très pratique la station de métro qui nous relie directement à l'aéroport! A 10 minutes à pieds le quartier avec bars et boîtes de nuit...
Nous étions 2 mais à 4 personnes on peut y loger sans problème.
Rien à redire, nous reviendrons chez Hugo avec grand plaisir.
Un grand merci Hugo, à très bientôt!

What to say first...we were so happy with the apartment, location at first. All sights that should be seen can be such easily reached, either by walking distance or tramp/train/metro. All stops are on walking distance, few minutes away from the apartment. Apartment is so nice and fully equiped, it has everything you need and more. Espresso machine was great! We also had some problem with flight and came one day later than planed. Hugo was so good to us not charging us that first night althoug we reserved the apartment and didn't came on that day. Addition to that, Hugo picked us at the airport which we didn't ask for and which was so great by his side. I wish that all air bnb hosts are like Hugo. He also helped us with giving us some advices where to go, eat and what to see. If we ever decide to visit Lisbon again, we will definetly stay at Hugo's apartment again. I honestly recommend this listing to every single person who wants to stay at cozy apartment in the city center. Hugo, thank you once again for being such a great host and for making our expirience so much better!

Great location, great flat, the Hugo's flat was exactly what we're looking for!
You cannot be disappointed!
And thank you Hugo for your welcoming :)
